papers.title: FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Realistic and editable animal fur reconstruction from multi-view images is challenging due to fine-scale detail, self-occlusion and obfuscation, and, unlike human hair, the lack of animal-fur datasets. Fur usually covers most of an animal's body, with large inter-species and intra-species variability. We present FurE, an efficient strand-based animal fur reconstruction method that recovers a per-strand, editable groom by optimizing a root-conditioned latent field, decoded into strand geometry via a PCA-based decoder. We reconstruct a defurred animal body using local fur-thickness cues from a surface-constrained Gaussian Frosting representation together with part-based priors. We further show that a PCA-based decoder learned from human-hair strand data can alleviate animal-data scarcity while enabling substantially faster optimization. FurE achieves a 10x speedup in strand training over current SOTA dense per-strand optimization while retaining strand fidelity and generalizing across synthetic and real-world sequences, with quantitative and qualitative validation despite the reduction in training time.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://toshi2k2.github.io/fure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FurE 用根条件隐场 (root-conditioned latent field) 加 PCA 解码器从多视角图像重建逐根可编辑的动物毛发，在无人类毛发数据集预训练的 PCA 解码器下实现相对当前 SOTA 逐根优化 10 倍的训练加速，同时保持根部保真度并在合成与真实序列上泛化。
Motivation: 动物毛发重建缺少专用数据集，且存在细尺度细节、自遮挡与种内种间高变异，现有逐根优化方法训练昂贵。
Method: 优化根条件隐场，经基于 PCA 的解码器解码为根部几何；用表面约束的 Gaussian Frosting 表示结合部件先验重建无毛动物身体并推断局部毛发粗细线索；解码器从人类毛发根部数据学习以缓解动物数据稀缺。
Result: 逐根训练相对当前 SOTA 稠密逐根优化获得 10 倍加速，同时保持根部保真度，并在合成与真实序列上泛化，给出定量与定性验证。
Conclusion: 用人类毛发数据预训练的 PCA 解码器可在缺少动物毛发数据集的条件下大幅加速逐根毛发优化而不牺牲保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Telescopic Language Models
papers.abstract_en: One deployed language model must often serve many compute budgets, yet serving each budget still means a separate training or compression run per point. We train a Telescopic Language Model (TLM) to be that continuum: a nested-capacity Transformer supervised by stochastic prefix supervision with a full anchor. At every step, one randomly truncated prefix of the capacity axis is trained against the full next-token target, alongside one full-capacity pass, so the trained artifact is a valid language model at every depth. Two forward-backward passes per step, no architectural change, nothing extra at inference. Fixed-exit suites such as Matryoshka Language Model Suites (MLMS) occupy one point in this design space, and the point has a cost: supervising only a few fixed exits leaves the nested model at chance level everywhere else (perplexity 10^2-10^5 in our baselines). On a 200M proxy suite (20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, identical data stream for all methods), a single TLM run is a valid language model at every one of its twenty layer prefixes, in perplexity and on perplexity-sensitive downstream tasks, reducing the area under the quality-budget curve by 43-44% relative to the fixed-exit suites while matching them at full capacity, at ~12% lower GPU cost per run. The prefix sampling density is a dial: concentrating it on a few depths recovers fixed-exit quality there at the price of the continuum, so the operating points become a training-time choice rather than an architectural one. These results indicate that the training objective, not the nesting itself, is what makes a model elastic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Telescopic Language Model (TLM)：嵌套容量 Transformer 用随机截断前缀监督加全容量锚点训练，每步一次随机深度前缀对全 next-token 目标、外加一次全容量前向反向，使模型在每个深度前缀上都是合法语言模型。在 200M proxy（20B FineWeb-Edu tokens）上，质量-预算曲线下面积相对固定出口套件 (MLMS) 降低 43-44%，全容量处持平，单次运行 GPU 成本约低 12%。
Motivation: 一个已部署模型要服务多种算力预算，但每个预算点都得单独训练或压缩一次；固定出口套件只监督少数深度，其余深度上嵌套模型处于随机水平（基线 perplexity 10^2–10^5）。
Method: 嵌套容量 Transformer，采用 stochastic prefix supervision with a full anchor：每步随机截断容量轴前缀对全 next-token 目标训练，同时做一次全容量 pass；每步两次前向-反向，不改架构、推理无额外开销。前缀采样密度可调，集中在少数深度即可在该处恢复固定出口质量。
Result: 200M proxy suite（20B FineWeb-Edu tokens，所有方法同一数据流）上，单次 TLM 运行在其二十个层前缀上均为合法语言模型（perplexity 与 perplexity 敏感下游任务均成立），质量-预算曲线下面积相对固定出口套件降低 43-44%，全容量处与之持平，每次运行 GPU 成本约低 12%；固定出口基线在未监督深度 perplexity 达 10^2–10^5。
Conclusion: 让模型具备弹性的是训练目标而非嵌套结构本身；前缀采样密度是训练期旋钮，运行点由训练时选择而非架构决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD) to filter critic errors. PDMD projects out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student-critic endpoint residual. At a fixed noisy query, we prove that this residual is an unbiased estimate of the critic's endpoint error. Under high-dimensional assumptions, this projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding only a vanishing fraction of ideal DMD signal. Empirically, the projection stabilizes training and improves sample quality where DMD degrades and develops unnatural textures. PDMD requires only a one-line code change to DMD, with no extra loss, network, data, model pass, or multi-stage training. With Wan2.1, PDMD achieves a VBench total score of 83.73 at 4 NFE, surpassing matched DMD by 1.03 points. On MiniMax-H3 joint video-audio generation, PDMD achieves a VideoGen-Eval visual total score of 83.17, 0.41 points above the strongest distilled baseline. PDMD also achieves the best performance on all six audio metrics among the compared 4-NFE models. Qualitative comparisons and user studies favor PDMD over the distilled baselines in visual quality, motion, and audio quality. Code and models are available at https://pdmd2026.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDMD 在 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) 的更新方向上投影掉与 student-critic 端点残差平行的分量，从而滤除 critic 误差、抑制视频扩散蒸馏训练中的过饱和与伪影。在固定噪声查询下该残差被证明是 critic 端点误差的无偏估计，高维假设下投影去掉常数比例的 critic 误差而只丢弃趋于零的理想 DMD 信号。Wan2.1 上 4 NFE 时 VBench 总分 83.73，比同设置 DMD 高 1.03 分。
Motivation: DMD 能把视频扩散的去噪评估次数 (NFE) 压到几次，但训练中样本会逐步过饱和并出现伪影；作者把这种不稳定归因于 critic 误差在连续 student 更新中累积。
Method: PDMD 把 DMD 更新中与 student-critic 端点残差平行的分量投影掉：固定噪声查询下证明该残差是 critic 端点误差的无偏估计，高维假设下投影去除常数比例误差而只损失趋于零的理想信号。实现上只需对 DMD 改一行代码，不引入额外损失、网络、数据、模型前向或多阶段训练。
Result: 在 Wan2.1 上，PDMD 以 4 NFE 取得 VBench 总分 83.73，比匹配设置的 DMD 高 1.03 分；在 MiniMax-H3 联合视频-音频生成上 VideoGen-Eval 视觉总分 83.17，比最强蒸馏基线高 0.41 分，并在所比较的 4-NFE 模型中六项音频指标全部最佳。定性对比与用户研究在视觉质量、运动和音频质量上偏向 PDMD。
Conclusion: 把 critic 误差的平行分量投影掉即可稳定 DMD 蒸馏并提升样本质量，且代价只是对 DMD 的一行改动；该做法在 Wan2.1 与 MiniMax-H3 的 4 NFE 设定下同时改善视觉与音频指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. We introduce UMM-Reflection, which applies reinforcement learning (RL) to complete reflection trajectories inside one unified model: sibling trajectories share one initial image, so the group-relative advantage compares reflection strategies, and one trajectory-level advantage updates both the reflection tokens and the flow-based revisions, avoiding the combinatorial blow-up of per-round credit assignment. Unlike single-round editing or pipelines with an external critic, credit flows across rounds and to both roles of the same model, and no verifier is needed at inference. On BAGEL, UMM-Reflection improves GenEval by 12.05 points over SFT, and the gains transfer to WISE (+10.97), OneIG-Bench (+3.48), and T2I-CompBench++ (+4.63), none of which is used in training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UMM-Reflection：在统一多模态模型内部用强化学习联合训练反思文本与基于 flow 的图像修订，兄弟轨迹共享同一初始图像、以组相对优势比较反思策略，单条轨迹级优势同时更新反思 token 与生成端。在 BAGEL 上 GenEval 比 SFT 高 12.05 点，迁移至训练未用的 WISE +10.97、OneIG-Bench +3.48、T2I-CompBench++ +4.63，推理无需外部 verifier。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型能自诊自修，但修订是否有效要渲染后才知道，反思文本与图像生成必须跨整条回路联合学习；SFT 只能冷启动，只优化渲染端或单一 head 的朴素 RL 拿不到大部分收益。
Method: UMM-Reflection 对统一模型内的完整反思轨迹做 RL：兄弟轨迹共享同一初始图像，用组相对优势 (group-relative advantage) 比较反思策略，以轨迹级优势同时更新反思 token 与 flow-based 修订，避免逐轮 credit assignment 的组合爆炸；SFT 反思轨迹作冷启动。
Result: 在 BAGEL 上 GenEval 比 SFT 提升 12.05 点；增益迁移到训练中未使用的 WISE +10.97、OneIG-Bench +3.48、T2I-CompBench++ +4.63。
Conclusion: 反思文本与图像修订应在整条轨迹上以单一优势联合优化，credit 跨轮次流向同一模型的两个角色，推理阶段不需要外部 critic 或 verifier。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose
papers.abstract_en: Sparse inertial pose estimation promises camera-free motion capture from consumer devices, but consumer sensors are unreliable: firmware-fused orientations are biased, mounting varies between sessions, and streams drift or drop out. On a new 35-take single-subject benchmark pairing an earbud head inertial measurement unit (IMU) with two smart-insole foot IMUs (SAM-3D-Body pseudo-ground-truth labels), we show the reliability problem is channel-level: a channel ablation isolates foot acceleration as the most informative input (66.6 mm vs. 79.0 mm head-only) and the firmware-fused foot orientation as the liability that destroys the gain. We therefore let the model learn how much to trust each channel of each stream: one temporal gate per stream per channel block, trained with an auxiliary reliability objective on synthetically corrupted pretraining data. The channel-gated model is the most accurate of our learned fusion arms on clean data (69.4 mm vs. 83.7 static, 86.6 ungated) and under every simulated fault (bias in training; drift, dropout eval-only); its gates suppress the natively biased foot-orientation channels on clean real data without test-time supervision and flag dropout bursts at 0.92-0.999 AUROC. Two contrasts: dropping a channel known a priori to fail is flat across foot faults but collapses when an unanticipated stream fails (head dropout: 92.9 vs. 79.3 mm); and a fine-tuned HMD-Poser is more accurate on clean data (64.4 mm) and nominally under drift, with no significant paired difference under bias or dropout, but a larger worst-case degradation from clean (+16.1 vs. +3.5 mm, single seed). Learning to gate reliability instead of sensor count is the lever for deployable sparse inertial capture. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/reliability-gated-imu-fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在稀疏惯性动作捕捉中，可靠性门控 (reliability gating) 让模型按流、按通道块学习该信任多少：在 35 段单被试耳机头 IMU + 双智能鞋垫脚 IMU 基准上，干净数据 MPJPE 69.4 mm，优于静态融合 83.7 mm 与无门控 86.6 mm，并在所有模拟故障下最优；门控自动压制原生有偏的脚部固件融合朝向通道，dropout 突发检出 AUROC 0.92–0.999。
Motivation: 消费级传感器不可靠：固件融合朝向有偏、佩戴方式跨 session 变化、流会漂移或掉线，而稀疏惯性捕捉需要在无相机条件下从这些设备得到可用的下肢 3D 姿态。
Method: 在新 35-take 单被试基准（耳机头 IMU + 两个智能鞋垫脚 IMU，SAM-3D-Body 伪真值标签）上做通道消融定位问题通道，再为每条流的每个通道块学一个时间门，用合成损坏的预训练数据加辅助可靠性目标训练；评测含干净数据与训练时 bias、评测时 drift/dropout 三类模拟故障。
Result: 通道消融显示脚部加速度信息量最大（66.6 mm vs. 仅头 79.0 mm），而脚部固件融合朝向是拖累项；门控模型干净数据 69.4 mm，优于静态 83.7 mm 与无门控 86.6 mm，且在每种模拟故障下最准；dropout 突发检出 AUROC 0.92–0.999。先验丢弃已知失效通道在各类脚部故障下表现持平，但遇到未预料的头流 dropout 时崩溃（92.9 vs. 79.3 mm）。微调的 HMD-Poser 干净数据更准（64.4 mm）、drift 下名义更优，bias/dropout 下配对差异不显著，但最坏退化更大（+16.1 vs. +3.5 mm，单 seed）。
Conclusion: 可部署的稀疏惯性捕捉，杠杆是让模型学可靠性门控而非增减传感器数量；先验丢通道的固定策略在未预料的流失效面前不稳健。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: \emph{Distributional training} provides collective supervision for one-step visual generation by matching real and generated features in frozen representation spaces. We introduce \emph{a unified theoretical framework} that separates distribution modeling from matching discrepancy and connects global objectives to pointwise feature updates through Wasserstein gradient flow. Under this framework, FD-Loss and Gaussian-kernel Drifting are recovered through Gaussian optimal transport and kernel-density-based KL matching, respectively. The framework motivates \textbf{MGFlow}, which models feature distributions with Gaussian mixtures at an adjustable granularity between global moments and sample-based representations. MGFlow supports both optimal transport and score-based matching, and couples mass-constrained sample assignment with paired component updates to address mode collapse that mixture expressivity alone does not resolve. On ImageNet $256\times256$, MGFlow substantially surpasses the FD-Loss baseline, achieving state-of-the-art results with \textbf{1.45} $\mathrm{FDr}^6$ on pMF-H and \textbf{1.64} on JiT-H. For text-to-image generation, MGFlow post-trains FLUX.2 [klein] 4B into a one-step generator that outperforms the original four-step model on both GenEval and PickScore. Project page: https://shihaoyang0423.github.io/MGFlow-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGFlow 用可调粒度的高斯混合 (Gaussian mixture) 建模冻结表征空间中的特征分布，把分布建模与匹配差异分开，并通过 Wasserstein gradient flow 把全局目标连到逐点特征更新。在 ImageNet 256×256 上以 1.45 FDr⁶ (pMF-H) 和 1.64 (JiT-H) 取得 SOTA，大幅超过 FD-Loss 基线；用于文生图时把 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 后训练成一步生成器，在 GenEval 与 PickScore 上胜过原四步模型。
Motivation: 一步视觉生成的分布类训练目标把分布建模与匹配差异混在一起，全局目标如何落到逐点特征更新缺少统一解释；且混合分布的表达力本身不足以解决 mode collapse。
Method: 提出统一理论框架：以 Wasserstein gradient flow 连接全局目标与逐点特征更新，在此框架下从 Gaussian optimal transport 与基于核密度的 KL matching 分别恢复 FD-Loss 和 Gaussian-kernel Drifting；据此提出 MGFlow，用可调粒度的高斯混合建模特征分布，同时支持 optimal transport 与 score-based matching，并以质量约束的样本分配 (mass-constrained sample assignment) 配对成分更新来抑制 mode collapse。
Result: ImageNet 256×256 上 MGFlow 取得 1.45 FDr⁶ (pMF-H) 与 1.64 (JiT-H)，大幅超过 FD-Loss 基线并达到 SOTA；文生图上将 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 后训练为一步生成器，在 GenEval 与 PickScore 两个指标上均优于原始四步模型。
Conclusion: 把分布建模与匹配差异解耦、再用高斯混合加质量约束分配去补表达力之外的 mode collapse，是一步视觉生成分布训练的有效统一路径。

papers.title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract_en: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. The total consumption of a task is therefore hard to predict before execution and the prediction must be revised as the run unfolds. In this paper, we propose TokenCast, which learns a composable cost representation for each execution segment, recording its own consumption and the context growth it introduces. Composing adjacent segments yields a cumulative estimate that captures the extra input cost incurred when context from earlier segments is re-read by every later call. As execution unfolds, newly observed evidence refreshes the forecast, requiring no additional LLM calls and incurring a mean cumulative prediction time of 32.8 ms per run on SWE-bench Verified. Across 4 task suites and 6 agent models, TokenCast's mean absolute error reduction against the strongest comparator averages 14.5% over 96 evaluated combinations. In offline budget-control replay, TokenCast uses 21.3% fewer tokens on average than a fixed-budget policy at matched trace completion. The code is available at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/TokenCast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TokenCast 为 LLM agent 执行的每个 segment 学习可组合的 token 成本表示，把各段自身消耗与它引入的上下文增长拼接成累计估计，并随执行中新证据在线刷新预测，无需额外 LLM 调用。在 SWE-bench Verified 上每次运行的平均累计预测耗时 32.8 ms；相对最强对照的 MAE 降幅在 4 个任务套件、6 个 agent 模型共 96 种组合上平均 14.5%；离线预算控制回放中在同等 trace 完成率下比固定预算策略少用 21.3% token。
Motivation: 同一任务多次执行的 token 消耗可相差一个数量级以上，且 agent 依据工具反馈逐步决策、上下文不断膨胀，导致任务总消耗在执行前难以预测、执行中必须不断修正。
Method: 为每个执行 segment 学习可组合的成本表示，记录该段自身消耗及其带来的上下文增长；相邻段组合得到累计估计，从而刻画早期段上下文被后续每次调用重读产生的额外输入成本；执行过程中用新观测证据刷新预测，不需要额外 LLM 调用。
Result: SWE-bench Verified 上每次运行平均累计预测时间 32.8 ms；在 4 个任务套件 × 6 个 agent 模型的 96 个评估组合上，相对最强对照的 MAE 降幅平均 14.5%；离线预算控制回放中，在相同 trace 完成率下比固定预算策略平均少用 21.3% token。
Conclusion: 把执行过程按 segment 建模并组合、再随证据在线刷新，可以在不增加 LLM 调用的前提下持续给出可用的 token 消耗预测，并据此比固定预算更省 token。

papers.title: Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control
papers.abstract_en: We present a representation-learning framework for composite adaptive tracking control under dynamically coupled disturbances. The framework connects classical disturbance-accommodating control (DAC) to recent last-layer adaptive disturbance-rejection methods. Specifically, we introduce a statistically principled hard expectation-maximization (hard-EM) procedure, with a Kalman smoother in the hard E-step, to identify dynamical representations of disturbance whose latent evolution is uniformly contractive. The learned representation evolves a latent disturbance-excitation state from measured plant features and control inputs and decodes that state into the time-varying disturbance acting on the nominal plant, thereby extending prior "fixed-decay" last-layer adaptive methods to a learned, predictive DAC-style formulation. Combined with Bayesian filtering of the learned latent state, this representation yields a composite adaptive tracking controller with predictive capability and provable exponential convergence to a bounded neighborhood. We validate our approach experimentally on a slippery ground vehicle carrying a liquid-sloshing tank and a pendulum load, and we further assess its robustness on a system of coupled Duffing oscillators. Across both settings, the method achieves accurate disturbance prediction and improved overall tracking performance relative to fixed-decay representation-learning ablations, LTI disturbance-accommodating baselines, and model-based PD baselines.
papers.comment: 9 pages, including an additional one-page appendix in this arXiv version. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把经典扰动补偿控制 (DAC) 与 last-layer 自适应扰动抑制结合的表示学习框架：用带 Kalman smoother 的硬 EM (hard-EM) 学出隐状态演化一致收缩 (uniformly contractive) 的扰动表示，再与贝叶斯滤波组成复合自适应跟踪控制器，可证明指数收敛到有界邻域。在载液晃动水箱与摆锤负载的湿滑地面车辆实验、以及耦合 Duffing 振子鲁棒性检验中，扰动预测更准、跟踪性能优于固定衰减表示学习消融、LTI DAC 基线与基于模型的 PD 基线。
Motivation: 动态耦合扰动下的跟踪控制中，既有 last-layer 自适应方法依赖人工设定的固定衰减 (fixed-decay) 扰动表示，无法预测时变扰动；经典 DAC 虽能补偿扰动却缺少学习到的预测性表示。
Method: 以硬 EM 识别隐状态一致收缩的扰动动力学表示，硬 E 步用 Kalman smoother；表示从被控对象测量特征与控制输入演化隐扰动激励状态，并解码为作用于标称对象的时变扰动，把固定衰减的 last-layer 自适应扩展为学习式、预测式 DAC；再对该学习隐状态做贝叶斯滤波，构成复合自适应跟踪控制器。
Result: 在载液晃动水箱加摆锤负载的湿滑地面车辆实验与耦合 Duffing 振子鲁棒性检验两个设置中，方法均实现准确的扰动预测，且相对固定衰减表示学习消融、LTI 扰动补偿基线和基于模型的 PD 基线取得更好的整体跟踪性能；理论上给出指数收敛到有界邻域的可证明保证。
Conclusion: 把扰动表示的收缩性约束与硬 EM 学习嵌入复合自适应控制，可在动态耦合扰动下同时获得预测能力和可证明的指数收敛，性能优于固定衰减与 LTI/PD 基线。

papers.title: Neural Harmonic Measure Operator
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Neural Harmonic Measure Operator (NHMO), a neural solver for elliptic PDE problems on variable-shape domains. The harmonic measure of a domain is the boundary probability distribution that, integrated against any boundary data, returns the Dirichlet Laplace solution. It depends only on the geometry, not on the boundary data. NHMO parameterizes the density of this measure as a transformer-based boundary kernel supervised by Walk-on-Spheres exit samples, so one trained kernel handles different boundary values on a shape with no retraining. We extend it to Poisson via a classical decomposition, with an auxiliary network amortizing the source-induced correction and avoiding the singular volume quadrature that breaks direct evaluation. At inference, new boundary values and new sources both yield PDE solutions by re-integration against the fitted kernel and lift, with no retraining. NHMO improves over four prior baselines on the MCB-B 3D variable-shape Poisson benchmark across all five categories, and is competitive with major neural-operator baselines on a controlled 2D testbed.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). 30 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NHMO 把变形状区域上椭圆 PDE 的 Dirichlet 解写成边界调和测度对边界数据的积分，用 transformer 参数化该测度密度并以 Walk-on-Spheres 退出样本监督，训练一次即可对同一形状上的新边界值与新源项直接重积分求解、无需重训练。在 MCB-B 3D 变形状 Poisson 基准的全部五类上优于四个先前基线，并在受控 2D 测试床上与主流 neural operator 基线相当。
Motivation: 神经算子通常把边界数据或源项绑进网络输入，换一组边界条件就要重训；椭圆 PDE 的调和测度本身只依赖几何，这一可复用结构此前没有被直接参数化。
Method: NHMO 将调和测度密度表示为 transformer 结构的边界核，用 Walk-on-Spheres 的退出样本作监督；Poisson 问题经经典分解处理，另加一个辅助网络摊销 (amortize) 源项引起的修正，从而绕开会破坏直接求值的奇异体积分。推理时对拟合出的核与 lift 重新积分即得新边界值、新源项下的解。
Result: 在 MCB-B 3D 变形状 Poisson 基准上，NHMO 在全部五个类别中均优于四个先前基线；在受控 2D 测试床上与主要 neural operator 基线表现相当。同一训练好的核可在不重训练的情况下处理同一形状上的不同边界值。
Conclusion: 把几何决定的调和测度当作可复用算子来学，边界条件与源项变化时只需重积分即可得到解，无需重训练。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把几何决定的调和测度当作可复用算子来学，边界条件与源项变化时只需重积分即可得到解，无需重训练。

papers.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Foil 这一 looped MoE 循环方式：在专家参数量与每 token 专家计算量固定的前提下，把专家层压扁一半、每层专家数翻倍、循环次数翻倍，并为每次循环解耦独立的 attention 参数（专家与 router 仍共享）。100B token 预训练时 loss 随压扁程度单调下降，最压扁配置在等参数等算力下比未压扁基线低 0.012 nat，下游精度持平或更好；解耦 attention 使路由更均衡也更自信。
Motivation: Looped Transformer 与稀疏 MoE 结合后缺少公认的循环方式：如何在固定专家参数与每 token 算力下安排专家层结构与 attention 共享，直接决定专家利用率与路由健康度。
Method: Foil 两项改动：一是 flatten experts，专家层数减半、每层专家数翻倍、循环遍数翻倍，使每次路由从更大专家池中选择；二是 untie attention，每次循环拥有独立 attention 参数，专家与 router 跨循环共享。消融实验用于解释 Foil 有效的原因并导出设计准则。
Result: 20B token 时所有 Foil 模型的预训练 loss 均低于未压扁循环基线；100B token 时 loss 随压扁程度单调改善，最压扁配置在等参数等算力下比基线低 0.012 nat，下游精度持平或更优。同等结构下解耦 attention 带来更均衡、更自信的路由。
Conclusion: 循环与加宽专家层的收益相互放大，路由置信度比负载均衡更能反映专家健康使用，因此稀疏 looped MoE 应采用每层更多专家与更多循环遍数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Scaling the horizon of agentic LLMs is bottlenecked by the need to fit ever longer context traces in GPU memory. Context compaction has been the most popular mechanism to alleviate this issue, keeping GPU memory constant for a given trace. Unfortunately, most compaction strategies rely on prefilling the LLM context many times over, hindering training throughput. To alleviate this bottleneck and enable efficient trainable compaction, we propose KV-streams, a plug-and-play strategy compatible with any compaction strategy that substantially increases throughput while showing no evidence of hindering performance. KV-streams enable scalable compaction by streaming the KV cache forward rather than flushing it after each compaction. We show that KV-streams enable three different compaction strategies, achieving a 2.6 to 5x wall-clock speedup in training. Beyond efficiency, we find that the streamed KV cache can act as a recurrent state, carrying forward information that has long since disappeared from the context. Specifically, in a controlled setting we show that, contrary to prior work, RL alone is all that is needed for this behavior to emerge. Overall, we show KV-streams to be an efficient and lightweight plug-and-play addition to any post-training pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KV-streams：上下文压缩 (context compaction) 后不再清空 KV cache，而是把它向前流式传递，作为可插拔模块兼容任意压缩策略。训练墙钟时间加速 2.6–5 倍且无性能受损证据；流式 KV cache 还能充当循环状态，携带早已滑出上下文的信息，且受控设定下仅靠 RL 即可涌现该行为。
Motivation: agentic LLM 的长轨迹必须整段放进 GPU 显存，而主流压缩策略要反复 prefill 上下文，严重拖慢训练吞吐，限制了可训练的长程智能体扩展。
Method: KV-streams 把 KV cache 在每次 compaction 后向前流式传递而非 flush，作为即插即用层叠加在任意压缩策略之上；在三种不同 compaction 策略上验证兼容性，并用受控设定检验流式 cache 作为循环状态、仅由 RL 驱动涌现。
Result: 在三种 compaction 策略上训练墙钟加速 2.6–5 倍，且没有性能受损的证据；受控设定下，与先前工作相反，仅靠 RL 就足以让流式 KV cache 携带已滑出上下文的信息这一行为涌现。
Conclusion: KV-streams 是任何 post-training 流程都可加的轻量高效组件：既解决压缩导致的重复 prefill 吞吐瓶颈，又让 KV cache 本身成为跨压缩的记忆载体。

papers.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation. Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs. However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored. Through post-training looped transformers, we study the accuracy-compute slope, measured as the accuracy gain per doubling of test-time decoding FLOPs. We find that existing looped transformers often yield steeper slopes than their non-looped baseline, yet underperform it at matched compute. While fixed-depth looping spends extra iterations on every token, our analysis shows that many tokens do not benefit from extra iterations. We therefore propose TaH2, which enables the model to focus extra iterations on the tokens that benefit from looping. It jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider through lookahead depth supervision, which uses online labels indicating whether further iteration improves the prediction. TaH2 improves both the efficiency and attainable accuracy of test-time scaling. On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 improves the accuracy-compute slope by 53% (2.74 vs. 1.79) over the non-looped baseline, exceeding the baseline's peak accuracy by about 3.4 points at matched test-time compute. As the maximum iteration depth increases, existing looped models largely plateau, while TaH2's gain over the non-looped baseline continues to grow from +2.8 points at depth 2 to +3.9 points at depth 8. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对循环 Transformer (looped transformer) 在测试时扩展上算力效率不足，提出 TaH2：联合后训练骨干与迭代决策器，用 lookahead depth supervision 把额外迭代只分配给真正受益的 token。在 AIME 上，TaH2 将精度-算力斜率相对非循环基线提升 53%（2.74 vs 1.79），同等测试算力下峰值精度高出约 3.4 分。
Motivation: 既有循环与非循环模型的对比停留在等参数或等 per-token FLOPs，而输出变长时循环是否改善测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 尚不清楚；固定深度循环给每个 token 都花额外迭代，但许多 token 并不受益。
Method: TaH2 联合后训练骨干网络与一个迭代决策器 (iteration decider)，用 lookahead depth supervision 提供在线标签——标出继续迭代是否改善预测——从而把额外迭代集中到受益 token 上；评估指标为精度-算力斜率，即测试时解码 FLOPs 每翻倍带来的精度增益。
Result: 在 AIME 基准上，TaH2 的精度-算力斜率比非循环基线高 53%（2.74 vs 1.79），同等测试算力下超过基线峰值精度约 3.4 分；随最大迭代深度增加，既有循环模型基本持平，而 TaH2 相对非循环基线的增益从深度 2 的 +2.8 分增长到深度 8 的 +3.9 分。
Conclusion: 把额外迭代按 token 自适应分配而非均匀施加，能同时提升测试时扩展的效率与可达精度；固定深度循环在深度加大时趋于饱和，自适应方案的增益则继续增长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) are designed to replace the attention in Softmax ViTs with the linear-complexity attention operator for more efficient token routing, but they require from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform the original Softmax version. How to initialize linear ViTs both efficiently and effectively still remains unclear. In this work, we explicitly ask: given that most foundation ViTs are built on the mainstream Softmax attention, can linear ViTs benefit from their pre-trained weights? Recent works on Attention Transfer show that attention is the effective transferable component between Softmax ViTs, suggesting attention alone suffices for such reuse. However, we find the opposite for Softmax-to-linear transfer. The attention weights are operator-specific: copying them barely helps, and is sometimes even worse than random initialization. Instead, the attention's token routing behavior can be recovered through distillation with a proper loss design, letting linear ViTs reduce the gap and even match Softmax ones. In contrast, the MLP weights, which carry the learned representation, are operator-agnostic: they can be transferred by simple direct copying, which already carries most of the benefit of the pre-trained weights. Thus, copying MLPs can serve as an effective foundation for Softmax-to-linear transfer: paired with the distilled attention, linear ViTs eventually close the remaining gap and even surpass Softmax ones. These findings hold consistently across various linear ViT variants, different model sizes, and diverse datasets. We hope this study deepens the understanding of reusing pre-trained weights across attention operators: copy what stays the same and distill what differs, to recover the benefit across the Softmax-to-linear boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 线性 ViT 可以复用 Softmax ViT 的预训练权重，但要分部件处理：注意力权重是算子特有的，直接复制几乎无效甚至不如随机初始化，必须用蒸馏恢复其 token routing 行为；MLP 权重是算子无关的，直接复制即可带走大部分收益。两者结合后线性 ViT 能追平甚至超过 Softmax 版本，结论在多种线性 ViT 变体、模型规模和数据集上一致成立。
Motivation: 线性 ViT 用线性复杂度注意力替换 Softmax 注意力以提升 token routing 效率，但通常需要从头预训练且性能不及 Softmax 版本，如何高效有效地初始化仍不清楚。
Method: 提出 Copy the Same, Distill the Difference：MLP 权重（承载学到的表示、算子无关）直接复制自预训练 Softmax ViT，注意力部分不复制权重而是通过带恰当损失设计的蒸馏恢复 token routing 行为，再在多种线性 ViT 变体、不同模型规模与数据集上检验。
Result: 直接复制注意力权重几乎无帮助、有时甚至差于随机初始化；仅蒸馏注意力即可缩小差距并追平 Softmax ViT；仅复制 MLP 已携带预训练权重的大部分收益；复制 MLP 加蒸馏注意力后线性 ViT 关闭剩余差距并超过 Softmax ViT，且该发现在各种线性 ViT 变体、不同模型规模和多样数据集上一致成立。
Conclusion: 跨注意力算子复用预训练权重的原则是「复制不变的部分，蒸馏变化的部分」：MLP 直接复制、注意力靠蒸馏，线性 ViT 因此不必从头预训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable criteria carries it across tasks. In long-horizon loops that follow the expert guidance, a writer agent researches every expected value and a reviewer agent verifies it, and failures escalate to a human. On three expert-authored finance benchmarks, its rubrics track expert scoring as closely as the strongest evaluated generator while stating the expert rubric's expected value for more criteria, their scores agree with human grading, and in-house analysts prefer them in a blind review. The released 100-query FinAutoRubric Benchmark, built from in-house analysts' key questions across 78 tasks and eight asset classes, shows that rubrics from an earlier model generation still leave headroom for a later one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinAutoRubric 让专家只写可复用的评估指引与 Task Bank 准则，由 writer agent 检索每个期望值、reviewer agent 核验、失败升级到人工，代码强制执行规则，自动生成金融研究 agent 的逐题 rubric。在三个专家撰写的金融基准上，其 rubric 与专家打分的贴合度追平最强的被评估生成器，且覆盖更多准则的期望值，分数与人工评分一致，盲评中更受内部分析师偏好。
Motivation: 金融研究 agent 的评估依赖专家逐题 rubric，成本高、难以扩展，也无法编码各机构自己的标准，且期望值需以信息截止日为准。
Method: 专家提供可复用的评估指引（作为 prompt 与代码强制的规则）和 Task Bank 准则；长程循环中 writer agent 检索每个期望值、reviewer agent 核验，失败升级人工；发布 100-query FinAutoRubric Benchmark，取自内部分析师在 78 个任务、八类资产上的关键问题。

papers.title: InfiniHand: Streaming World-Space Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: World-space hand motion estimation from egocentric video requires recovering 3D articulated hand geometry while tracking camera egomotion. Existing approaches heavily rely on cascading independent hand pose estimators and SLAM systems, resulting in error accumulation, complex pipelines, and severe computational overhead. To address these limitations, we present InfiniHand, an end-to-end streaming feed-forward framework that jointly estimates MANO parameters, camera trajectories, and hand locations directly from uncalibrated egocentric video. InfiniHand integrates persistent spatiotemporal memory with hand-centered visual features, explicitly coupling camera motion with local hand geometry within a unified architecture. We train InfiniHand in two progressive stages by first learning robust camera-space hand priors and then extending to streaming world-space reconstruction. To support this process, we aggregate a pretraining corpus of approximately 5,000 hours of egocentric data across multiple public datasets. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that InfiniHand outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on in-domain benchmarks, achieving a 21.4% reduction in ARCTIC PA-p compared to ViDiHand while substantially mitigating world-space drift. Furthermore, InfiniHand generalizes robustly to in-the-wild videos and operates at 11.19 FPS, delivering more than twice the throughput of HaWoR.

TL;DR: InfiniHand 用端到端流式前馈框架从无标定第一人称视频直接联合估计 MANO 手部参数、相机轨迹与手部世界坐标，取代级联的 pose estimator + SLAM 管线。在 ARCTIC 基准上 PA-p 较 ViDiHand 降低 21.4%，世界系漂移显著缓解，野外视频泛化且吞吐 11.19 FPS，超过 HaWoR 两倍以上。
Motivation: 现有方法把独立的手部姿态估计器与 SLAM 串联，导致误差累积、管线复杂、计算开销严重，世界系漂移难以控制。
Method: 端到端流式前馈框架，把持久时空记忆 (persistent spatiotemporal memory) 与以手为中心的视觉特征结合，在统一架构中显式耦合相机运动与局部手部几何；两阶段渐进训练，先学相机系手部先验，再扩展到流式世界系重建；预训练语料聚合约 5,000 小时跨多个公开数据集的第一人称数据。
Result: ARCTIC 基准上 PA-p 相比 ViDiHand 降低 21.4%，并大幅缓解世界系漂移；在 in-domain 基准上优于 SOTA 基线，可泛化到野外视频；运行速度 11.19 FPS，吞吐为 HaWoR 的两倍以上。

papers.title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL
papers.abstract_en: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone. The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO's 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT)：智能体完成任务后只对自己的经验生成回顾性解释，再仅用解释 token 的 next-token loss 微调，不用外部教师、奖励或策略更新。在 Qwen3.5-4B 的软件工程实验中，ROFT 20 次更新后 SWE-bench Verified/Pro 解决率达 49.2%/26.8%，超过 GRPO 40 次更新的 48.0%/25.3%。
Motivation: 语言模型智能体能否只靠复述和解释自身经验来改进后续动作，而不依赖 RL 的奖励与策略更新，这一问题尚缺最小化的隔离实验。
Method: ROFT 是在线最小流程：智能体尝试任务、观察可用反馈、生成回顾解释，再仅对解释 token 施加 next-token prediction loss 微调；训练数据混合成功与失败的基座模型尝试，全程不用 verifier、外部教师或基于奖励的策略更新。
Result: 在 held-out SWE-bench Verified 与 Pro 上，ROFT 20 次更新后解决率 49.2% 与 26.8%，对照 GRPO 40 次更新的 48.0% 与 25.3%（评测运行中），且训练时间与采样尝试数上早期进展更快；ROFT 还能学会基座模型 64 次采样全部失败的个别任务。行为分析显示 ROFT 间接对动作做信用分配，鼓励好动作、抑制错误动作；提示回顾强调更直接的解法后，后续尝试变短，即使没有显式长度惩罚。
Conclusion: 学会解释也能改进会做，自生成回顾可作为有用训练目标，且学习不必以任何初始成功轨迹为前提；作者据此提出 explanation-to-action transfer 值得进一步研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning, which trains a proposer model to revise a solver's harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playing the role of weight updates in gradient-based adaptation. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the task performance of revised harnesses as the reward. At test time, the proposer uses feedback from successive executions on a new task to refine the harness, without performing any parameter-space update. Experiments on reasoning and multi-hop question answering show that harness learning improves revision quality and that the ability to adapt at test time transfers to unseen tasks. Policies trained on individual revisions can continue improving harnesses over multiple rounds, while the benefits of training on revision sequences vary across settings. These findings suggest a path towards continually learning agents that turn accumulated experience into generalizable improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 harness learning：用强化学习训练 proposer 模型，依据执行反馈改写 solver 的 harness（组织模型调用、工具使用与信息流的可执行程序），把 harness 修订当作梯度下降式权重更新的类比，从而在测试时无需参数更新即可适配新任务。在推理与多跳问答实验中，harness learning 提升修订质量，测试时适配能力可迁移到未见任务。
Motivation: 语言模型 agent 由模型与 harness 共同决定，而不同任务需要不同的调用与信息流组织方式，靠人工逐任务调整 harness 无法规模化，且参数微调在测试时不可行。
Method: 把 harness 修订形式化为对可执行程序的 meta-learning，修订对应梯度适应中的权重更新；proposer 用 RL 训练，奖励是修订后 harness 的任务表现；测试时 proposer 依据新任务上连续执行的反馈迭代改写 harness，不做任何参数空间更新。
Result: 在推理与多跳问答 (multi-hop QA) 上，harness learning 提升修订质量，测试时适配能力迁移到未见任务；在单次修订上训练的策略能跨多轮持续改进 harness，而在修订序列上训练的收益随设置不同而变化。
Conclusion: 把执行反馈转成对可执行 harness 的程序级修订，是让 agent 把累积经验变成可泛化改进、走向持续学习的一条路径。

papers.title: GeoVerse: World-Consistent Novel View Synthesis in Geometric Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints. Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation. We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views by performing generation within the geometric latent space of a pretrained 3D foundation model and injecting appearance priors from a video generative model. Specifically, GeoVerse extracts multilevel features from Wan2.2 VACE and injects them into the geometric latent diffusion model via a ControlNet-style adapter, incorporating video-learned appearance priors to enhance structural completion. To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoVerse 在预训练 3D 基础模型的几何 latent 空间内做新视角合成，用 Wan2.2 VACE 的多层视频外观先验经 ControlNet 式 adapter 注入，并以全局空间记忆重投影目标对齐引导来约束跨视角一致性。相比 GLD，DL3DV 上 PSNR 高 2.23 dB，Mip-NeRF360 上 ATE 降低 32.4%。
Motivation: 稀疏图像新视角合成需同时忠实重建已见区域、合理补全未见内容并保持跨视角世界一致性；几何方法补不出未见区域，视频生成模型则在序列生成中累积不一致。
Method: 在预训练 3D 基础模型的几何 latent 空间内执行扩散生成，从 Wan2.2 VACE 提取多层特征并经 ControlNet 式 adapter 注入几何 latent 扩散模型；全局空间记忆持续聚合已观测与已合成内容，重投影目标对齐引导以锚定后续预测到共享场景表示。
Result: 相比 GLD，DL3DV 上 PSNR 提高 2.23 dB，Mip-NeRF360 上 ATE 降低 32.4%；作者称在多样数据集上提升了视觉质量与几何一致性。
Conclusion: 把视频外观先验注入几何 latent 空间并配合全局空间记忆，可在补全未见内容的同时维持跨视角世界一致性。

papers.title: Failure-Transparent Agents: Benchmarking Post-Failure Reporting in Tool-Using Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents can fail twice: a required tool can fail, and the agent can then report success without the evidence needed to justify it. Existing benchmarks often entangle this reporting failure with tool selection, recovery, and environment dynamics. We introduce Failure-Transparent Agents (FTA), a controlled benchmark that fixes the failed observation and required evidence state before generation, making post-failure claims directly auditable. FTA contains 100 tasks with deterministic failure traces spanning five failure families, a neutral control, and four user-pressure conditions, and evaluates unsupported claims alongside useful recovery. Across six models, three response policies, and 3,600 human-annotated responses, false-success rates are 22.8% under the baseline policy, 9.3% with a transparency instruction, and 0.8% with a structured evidence contract. Fabricated-detail rates decrease from 28.3% to 14.3% and 0.8%, while useful responses increase from 74.9% to 89.2% and 98.8%, respectively. The tested evidence-contract policy is associated with substantially lower post-failure reporting errors while useful-response rates remain high within this blocked-task benchmark.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出受控基准 Failure-Transparent Agents (FTA)：在生成前固定失败观测与所需证据状态，使工具失败后的成功声明可直接审计。跨 6 个模型、3 种响应策略、3,600 条人工标注回复，false-success 率从基线策略 22.8% 降到透明性指令 9.3%、结构化证据契约 0.8%，同时有用回复率从 74.9% 升到 98.8%。
Motivation: 工具使用智能体会先遭遇工具失败、再无证据地报告成功；现有基准把这种报告失败与工具选择、恢复和环境动态纠缠在一起，无法单独审计失败后的声明。
Method: FTA 在生成前固定失败观测与所需证据状态，含 100 个任务、确定性失败轨迹，覆盖五类失败族、一个中性对照和四种用户施压条件；评测同时统计无支撑声明与有用恢复，覆盖 6 个模型、3 种响应策略和 3,600 条人工标注回复。
Result: false-success 率：基线策略 22.8%，透明性指令 9.3%，结构化证据契约 0.8%；fabricated-detail 率依次 28.3%、14.3%、0.8%；有用回复率依次 74.9%、89.2%、98.8%。
Conclusion: 在该 blocked-task 基准内，结构化证据契约与显著更低的失败后报告错误相关，同时有用回复率保持在高位。

papers.title: FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning
papers.abstract_en: We present FlowAct-R2, a framework for interactive humanoid video generation that combines continuous multimodal control with proactive agent planning. Our method consists of two coupled components. First, a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video backbone to accept rolling action prompts, streaming audio, and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references. Video-driven rotary positional embeddings align reference chunks with the generation timeline, while reference-plus-image conditioning and partially noised historical motion frames preserve appearance and avoid accumulated drift. Second, a Proactive Interaction Agent separates pre-online planning from online scheduling and response: it prepares a persona, a long-horizon agenda, and reusable multimodal skills in advance, then autonomously schedules behaviors, responds to audience input, and handles interruptions during a live session. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time 720p generation and hour-scale streaming across entertainment streaming, live shopping, video chatting, and live vlogging.
papers.comment: Project page: https://bone-11.github.io/Flowact-R2; Hugging Face Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/ProAudience/FlowAct-R2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowAct-R2 把交互式人形视频生成拆成两部分：Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer 在 Seedance 2.0 Mini 参考到视频骨干上接受滚动动作提示、流式音频与动态更新的图像/音频/视频参考，用 video-driven rotary positional embeddings 对齐参考块与生成时间线，并以参考加图像条件和部分加噪的历史运动帧保持外观、抑制累积漂移；Proactive Interaction Agent 预先准备 persona、长期议程与可复用多模态技能，再在线自主调度行为、响应观众输入并处理打断。系统支持实时 720p 生成与小时级流式输出，面向娱乐直播、直播带货、视频聊天与直播 vlog。
Motivation: 交互式数字人直播需要连续多模态控制与主动规划：既要长时间流式生成不漂移，又要在线响应观众输入和打断，单一参考到视频骨干做不到。

Result: 系统支持实时 720p 生成与小时级 (hour-scale) 流式输出，覆盖娱乐直播、直播带货、视频聊天与直播 vlog 场景。

papers.title: Impact of Patient Orientation in Single- and Multi-View Camera Environments for AI-based Rehabilitation Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel separability metric to quantify an algorithm's ability to distinguish between valid and faulty exercise repetitions. Using these tools, we analyze how various RGB-based pose-estimation strategies are suitable for exercise quality assessment under varying camera placements. In particular, we analyze single-camera 2D and 3D pose estimation and four multi-camera strategies: a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, 3D triangulation, weighted 3D fusion, and an AI-based pose-estimation transformer model specifically trained from two synchronized cameras. Our findings reveal that an optimally placed 2D camera can improve the separability by 16.9\,\% over the commonly used $0^\circ$ frontal view and frequently outperforms single-camera 3D estimation, while combining two views can further improve accuracy by up to 13.1\,\%. These results offer practical guidance for deploying rehabilitation monitoring in both home and clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出康复动作质量评估数据集 REHAB26-ViewAngles（覆盖大范围相机角度的正确/错误动作）与衡量算法区分有效与错误重复能力的 separability 指标，用其比较单相机 2D/3D 与四种多相机策略。最优摆放的 2D 相机比常用 0° 正面视角提升 separability 16.9%，且常优于单相机 3D 估计；两视角组合可再提升精度至多 13.1%。
Motivation: RGB 姿态估计方法众多，但相机摆位如何影响临床相关动作错误的检出仍研究不足，居家与临床部署缺少选位依据。
Method: 构建 REHAB26-ViewAngles 数据集（含正确与错误康复动作、多角度拍摄），提出量化有效/错误重复可分性的 separability 指标；据此分析单相机 2D 与 3D 姿态估计，以及四种多相机策略：两个正交 2D 视角组合、3D triangulation、weighted 3D fusion、以及用两台同步相机专门训练的 AI 姿态估计 transformer 模型。
Result: 最优摆放的 2D 相机较常用 0° 正面视角将 separability 提升 16.9%，且常优于单相机 3D 估计；结合两个视角可再提升精度至多 13.1%。
Conclusion: 相机摆位对康复动作质量评估的影响可量化，合理摆放的 2D 相机加双视角组合即可在居家与临床部署中取得更好的错误检出。

papers.title: Superquadric Primitive Decomposition of 3D point clouds via Geometric-Aware Inlier Refinement
papers.abstract_en: The decomposition of 3D point clouds into interpretable geometric primitives remains a longstanding challenge in Computer Vision and Computer Graphics. Among the available representations, superquadrics offer a compact and expressive model capable of capturing a wide range of shapes. However, their estimation is inherently challenging, as it requires solving a non-linear optimization problem and is particularly sensitive to noise, outliers, and overlapping structures. While robust estimation methods such as RANSAC and its variants achieve strong performance, they rely primarily on spatial proximity and residual-based criteria, often leading to incorrect inlier assignments across adjacent or complex arrangements of primitives. In this work, we introduce a geometric-aware framework for primitive decomposition that explicitly incorporates local surface properties into the fitting process. Specifically, we propose an inlier refinement step formulated as an energy minimization problem and solved via graph-cut optimization. Our formulation integrates geometric priors, such as normal consistency, enabling more reliable inlier selection beyond purely residual-based criteria. The approach naturally applies to both single-model estimation and multi-model decomposition. By leveraging geometric information beyond point-wise residuals, our method reduces erroneous inlier propagation and stabilizes parameter estimation. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show consistent improvements in geometric accuracy, robustness to noise and outliers, and convergence efficiency compared to state-of-the-art RANSAC-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出几何感知的超二次曲面 (superquadric) 图元分解框架，把法向一致性等局部表面性质写进能量最小化，用 graph-cut 求解 inlier refinement，取代纯残差判据。合成与真实数据上相比 SOTA 的 RANSAC 类方法在几何精度、噪声与外点鲁棒性、收敛效率上一致改善。
Motivation: 超二次曲面估计需解非线性优化，对噪声、外点和重叠结构敏感；RANSAC 类方法只依赖空间邻近与残差，在相邻或复杂排布的图元上会给出错误的 inlier 归属。
Method: 在拟合过程中显式引入局部表面属性，提出一个写成能量最小化问题的 inlier refinement 步骤，用 graph-cut 优化求解；能量中整合法向一致性 (normal consistency) 等几何先验，使 inlier 选择超出纯残差判据，同时适用于单模型估计与多模型分解。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，相比 SOTA 的 RANSAC 类方法，在几何精度、对噪声与外点的鲁棒性、收敛效率三方面均取得一致改善，并减少错误的 inlier 传播、稳定参数估计。
Conclusion: 把几何先验而非仅残差用于 inlier 归属，可以稳定超二次曲面的参数估计并减少错误传播，且同一框架可覆盖单模型与多模型分解。

papers.title: Hard Vision, Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals Across Computer Vision
papers.abstract_en: Frontier general-purpose systems are rapidly expanding beyond visual understanding into capabilities traditionally handled by dedicated computer-vision models. As these capabilities expand, a central question for the computer-vision community is how far this reach extends, and what remains hard. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra alongside five frontier general-purpose AI systems across 34 capabilities and 55 benchmarks spanning nine areas of computer vision. We compare their performance with dedicated models and humans where suitable references are available. Astra demonstrates broad visual capability, with substantial gains over other frontier systems in visual and spatial reasoning and several forms of structured prediction. Across the state-of-the-art systems, a consistent pattern emerges. Capabilities involving semantic interpretation, reasoning, and object-centric prediction increasingly approach or reach available reference levels. In contrast, larger gaps remain when tasks require metric geometric accuracy, faithful reconstruction, temporally consistent dense prediction, or specialized fine-grained visual knowledge. Additional reasoning and specialist tools close selected gaps, but their benefits vary across capabilities. These results map a changing landscape of computer vision in which increasingly sophisticated visual tasks are accessible through a general-purpose interface, while precise and fidelity-sensitive perception remains an important frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 GPT-6 Astra 与另外五个前沿通用 AI 系统在计算机视觉九大领域、34 项能力、55 个基准上做横向评测，并在可用处对照专用模型与人类参考。语义解释、推理与以对象为中心的预测类能力已接近或达到参考水平，而需要度量级几何精度、忠实重建、时间一致的稠密预测与细粒度专业知识的任务仍存在明显差距；追加推理工具与专用工具只能部分缩小差距，且收益因能力而异。
Motivation: 通用系统正侵入原本由专用 CV 模型承担的任务，CV 社区需要知道其能力边界在哪里、哪些任务仍然做不好。
Method: 评测 GPT-6 Astra 与五个前沿通用 AI 系统，覆盖 34 项能力、55 个基准、九大 CV 领域；在有合适参照时与专用模型和人类表现对比，并考察追加推理工具与专用工具的效果。
Result: Astra 在视觉与空间推理以及多类结构化预测上较其他前沿系统有显著提升；跨系统一致的模式是语义解释、推理、对象中心预测接近或达到可用参考水平，而度量几何精度、忠实重建、时间一致稠密预测、细粒度专业知识类任务差距较大；额外推理与专用工具可缩小部分差距但收益随能力不同。
Conclusion: 越来越多复杂视觉任务可通过通用接口完成，但对精度与保真度敏感的感知仍是未被攻克的前沿。

papers.title: X-Reset: Scaling Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Embodiment Resets
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can train dexterous manipulation policies without robot demonstrations, but training a single generalist policy with task-agnostic rewards faces a severe exploration problem: approaching, grasping, and reorienting diverse objects with many degrees of freedom is difficult to discover from scratch. Prior works make exploration tractable with high-quality robot demonstrations, per-task reward shaping, or by restricting policies to narrow modes of behavior. We propose X-Reset, a framework that instead resolves exploration with human hand-object demonstrations. Rather than imitating or tracking retargeted human motion, X-Reset kinematically retargets hand-object states to noisy robot states, filters out states that are unstable in simulation, and samples the remainder as resets during RL training with general-purpose object-centric rewards. The resulting policy depends only on object state and goal, with demonstrations entering training through the reset distribution. We show that X-Reset trains generalist policies on 20 objects across three embodiments---a 22-DoF hand on two different arms and a parallel-jaw gripper---and resolves the exploration challenges of RL from scratch. X-Reset scales with the number of training objects, generalizes to unseen objects, can learn from imperfect hand-pose estimates, and transfers behaviors zero-shot from sim-to-real.

papers.title: Lagrangian--Hamiltonian Flows for Video Prediction and Image Generation: A Symplectic Perspective
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LHFM, a geometric framework for learning image dynamics. Drawing on structures central to classical mechanics, symplectic geometry, and geometric quantization, LHFM represents each image as an exact Lagrangian graph and models its evolution through image-dependent Hamiltonian flows, which yield a transport--source parameterization of image velocities. Our primary application is deterministic video prediction: LHFM-V is a recurrent model that advances frames by integrating predicted transport and source fields, and achieves the lowest reported FLOP count among the compared recurrent models with similar prediction accuracy. The image variant, LHFM-I, shows that the same construction is compatible with flow matching: in a matched experiment, it attains a lower FID than the flow-matching baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LHFM 把每张图像表示为精确 Lagrangian graph，用依赖图像的 Hamiltonian 流演化，得到图像速度的 transport–source 参数化；其视频版 LHFM-V 递归地积分预测的 transport 与 source 场推进帧，在对比的递归模型中以相近预测精度取得最低 FLOP 计数，图像版 LHFM-I 在匹配实验中比 flow matching 基线取得更低 FID。
Motivation: 视频预测与图像生成中的图像动力学建模缺少统一的几何框架，递归模型的计算开销与生成质量往往需要折中。
Method: LHFM 借助经典力学、辛几何与几何量子化结构，将图像表示为精确 Lagrangian graph，用 image-dependent Hamiltonian 流建模演化并导出 transport–source 参数化；LHFM-V 作为递归模型通过积分预测的 transport 与 source 场推进帧，LHFM-I 将同一构造接入 flow matching。
Result: LHFM-V 在所比较的递归模型中取得最低 FLOP 计数且预测精度相近；在匹配实验中 LHFM-I 的 FID 低于 flow-matching 基线。
Conclusion: 辛几何视角的 Lagrangian–Hamiltonian 流可以同时服务视频预测与图像生成，并在递归视频预测上以更低计算开销维持精度、在图像生成上取得更低 FID。

papers.title: Mind the RefGAP: Correcting Reference Attention in Diffusion-Based Visual Editing
papers.abstract_en: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We identify a potential bottleneck in diffusion editors: many methods provide limited reference-attention allocation. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefGAP 发现扩散式参考引导编辑中编辑区查询分配给参考的注意力质量过低（LoomVideo 中不足 1%），提出训练无关的在线 logit 偏移校正：按前向传播实测的参考注意力质量逐层确定偏移量，正偏移强化参考使用、负偏移限制编辑区外的参考诱导变化。在七个扩散图像/视频编辑器上提升换头与换脸的身份保真度，且无需逐方法扫描强度。
Motivation: 参考引导扩散编辑器难以忠实复现用户提供的参考，瓶颈在于参考注意力分配受限，编辑区查询对参考的注意力质量不足 1%（LoomVideo），导致身份保真度受限。
Method: RefGAP 是训练无关的校正方法：前向传播中测量参考注意力质量，在每层在线决定 logit 偏移幅度；对编辑区查询施加正偏移以强化参考使用，对保留区查询施加负偏移以限制编辑区外的参考诱导变化。两个全局系数在四个开发扩散编辑器的验证数据上一次性选定并固定。
Result: 在七个扩散式图像/视频编辑器上，RefGAP 提升换头 (head swapping) 与换脸 (face swapping) 的身份保真度；在保真度-保持权衡上与单独调优的常量编辑侧偏置相当，且无需逐方法强度扫描；另在虚拟试穿 (virtual try-on) 与背景替换上检验超出身份编辑的迁移性。
Conclusion: 参考注意力分配不足是扩散编辑器保真度的可在线纠正瓶颈，用前向实测质量驱动的逐层 logit 偏移即可在多个编辑器上通用生效，无需训练或逐方法调参。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScAn-Bench: Evaluating Scaling Analysis Methodology
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in machine learning is driven by large-scale foundation models, where scaling laws and finding optimal scaling prescriptions for architecture, data, and hyperparameters are key in advancing the state-of-the-art. Therefore, it is surprising that no systematic study evaluates the methodology to obtain scaling laws and prescriptions across different model types. To shed light on this crucial blind spot and facilitate future research, we introduce the surrogate benchmarks ScAn-Bench-LLM and ScAn-Bench-VLM based on 4524 and 8024 checkpoints of language and vision-language model pipelines. On our benchmarks, we perform the first systematic evaluation of both data acquisition and extrapolation methodology for scaling analysis across different data modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出代理基准 ScAn-Bench-LLM 与 ScAn-Bench-VLM（分别基于 4524 和 8024 个语言与视觉语言模型 pipeline 的 checkpoint），首次系统评估 scaling law 分析中的数据获取与外推方法学。核心论断是：现有 scaling law 与最优处方的获取方法学本身缺乏跨模型类型的系统检验，该工作用可复现的 checkpoint 基准来填补这一盲区。
Motivation: 基础模型的进展依赖 scaling law 与架构、数据、超参的最优 scaling 处方，但没有系统研究去评估不同模型类型上获取 scaling law 与处方的方法学，形成一个关键盲区。
Method: 构建两个代理基准 ScAn-Bench-LLM 与 ScAn-Bench-VLM，语料为 4524 与 8024 个语言及视觉语言模型 pipeline 的 checkpoint；在此之上对 scaling 分析的数据获取 (data acquisition) 与外推 (extrapolation) 方法学做跨数据模态的系统评估。
Result: 基准规模为 ScAn-Bench-LLM 4524 个 checkpoint、ScAn-Bench-VLM 8024 个 checkpoint；评估覆盖数据获取与外推两类 scaling 分析方法学，并跨语言与视觉语言两种数据模态进行。
Conclusion: scaling law 与 scaling 处方的获取方法学应被视为可被基准化、可系统比较的对象，而非默认可信的既定流程。

papers.title: Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI Night-Scientist 用强化学习 (GRPO) 教 LLM 何时以及如何偏离可预测推理，按认知科学把创造力拆成 action、process、outcome 三轴来训练。相比基座模型，研究方向多样性提升 27.8%、贡献类型提升 14.9%，预测引用影响最高提升 32.0 个百分点、原创性提升 66.2 分；单纯调高 decoding temperature 复现不了这些增益，指明要追求何种创造力的语义引导才是关键。
Motivation: LLM 在结构化可验证任务上表现好，但低熵偏好导致输出同质、可预测，难以支撑开放式科学构思中从 day science 到松散、偶发的 night science 的完整创造谱系。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 AI Night-Scientist，以认知科学为依据把创造力建模为三轴：action（做什么、多有创造性）、process（何时 explore 与 exploit）、outcome（想法的新颖性与有用性）；用 GRPO 训练，训练过程中暴露不同程度与形式的创造力。
Result: 相对基座模型，研究方向范围扩大 27.8%，贡献类型扩大 14.9%；预测 citation impact 最高提升 32.0 个百分点，originality 提升 66.2 分。仅提高 decoding temperature 无法复现这些增益，指定追求何种创造力的语义引导是关键。
Conclusion: 创造力是一种可学习、可在多个层级塑造的能力，语义引导下的 RL 训练能让模型提出超出其通常探索范围的想法，而非靠加大采样随机性。

papers.title: DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer's camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynaTokens 用一组场景专属的可学习 token，在冻结基座相机可控世界模型的前提下，通过 cross-attention 从少量示例轨迹中教会模型物体动力学，从而在新查询相机路径下同时保留场景动态。核心依据是两种运动的不对称性：相机运动全局影响画面，物体动力学空间局部化。在 VBench2 与 WorldScore 上，其动力学-相机权衡优于 LoRA、block finetuning 与专门可训练层基线。
Motivation: 现有相机可控视频模型在静态场景能处理相机运动，但面对动态场景时物体保持静止、运动错误或生成质量下降，用户无法在推进相机的同时让场景动力学继续演化。
Method: 提出 DynaTokens：一组轻量、场景专属的可学习 token，通过 cross-attention 从该场景的少量示例轨迹中训练，基座模型全程冻结；设计出发点是相机运动全局、物体动力学空间局部的不对称性，使可训练接口与学习目标的结构对齐。
Result: 在 VBench2 与 WorldScore 评测上，DynaTokens 的动力学-相机同时权衡优于 LoRA、block finetuning 和专门的可训练层基线；token 注意力分析、消融与运动时序性 (motion temporality) 分析支持可训练接口需匹配学习目标结构这一判断。
Conclusion: 把可训练接口对齐到目标的空间结构（局部物体动力学用局部化 token 表达），比全局低秩或整块微调更适合在冻结世界模型上做相机可控的动力学适配。

papers.title: A Unified Uncertainty Representation for Graph Neural Networks via Doubly-Spectral Stochastic Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Reliable deployment of graph neural networks requires calibration, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, and robustness to distribution shift, yet existing methods address these needs with separate models and objectives. We model uncertain node embeddings as random graph signals: graph Fourier filters capture structural variation, and a scalar orthogonal-polynomial chaos coordinate captures latent stochastic variation. The resulting doubly-spectral stochastic (DSS) expansion supplies task-matched readouts from one representation: the mean coefficient encodes class evidence for the energy-based OOD score, the higher-order coefficients encode structured logit variation, and quadrature averaging over the chaos coordinate defines the single predictive distribution used for prediction and calibration. A capacity theorem shows that, under a full-rank feature assumption, a restricted subfamily matches the chaos coefficients of any Gaussian-latent random graph signal, with exponentially decaying truncation error under a growth condition; the task-level claims are established empirically. DSS-GNN has two deployment modes: standalone, or as a residual branch beside a deterministic encoder (DSS-Hybrid). Standalone DSS-GNN achieves the lowest Brier score among the compared uncertainty-aware baselines on all 14 node classification benchmarks without post-hoc correction; DSS-Hybrid achieves the best AUROC on most node-OOD settings, competitive cross-graph OOD detection, and the strongest shifted accuracy on all 7 GOOD concept-shift benchmarks under standard empirical risk minimization (ERM). Cross-evaluating both modes on all three tasks shows that each remains effective on the other's tasks, with documented exceptions, and yields explicit deployment guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 GNN 的节点嵌入当作随机图信号，用图 Fourier 滤波器刻画结构变化、用标量正交多项式 chaos 坐标刻画隐含随机变化，构成 doubly-spectral stochastic (DSS) 展开，从单一表示同时产出校准、OOD 检测与分布偏移鲁棒性的读出。在 14 个节点分类基准上，独立版 DSS-GNN 无需后处理校正即取得所比较不确定性基线中最低的 Brier 分数；在 7 个 GOOD 概念偏移基准上 DSS-Hybrid 在标准 ERM 下取得最强的偏移后准确率。
Motivation: GNN 部署需要校准、OOD 检测与分布偏移鲁棒性，但现有方法要用不同模型和不同目标分别处理这三件事，缺少统一的不确定性表示。
Method: 将不确定节点嵌入建模为随机图信号：图 Fourier 滤波器捕捉结构变化，标量正交多项式 chaos 坐标捕捉隐含随机变化，得到 DSS 展开。均值系数作为能量型 OOD 分数的类别证据，高阶系数编码结构化 logit 变化，对 chaos 坐标做求积平均 (quadrature averaging) 得到唯一的预测分布，同时用于预测与校准；提供 standalone 与作为确定性编码器旁残差分支的 DSS-Hybrid 两种部署模式。另给出 capacity 定理：在 full-rank 特征假设下受限子族可匹配任意 Gaussian-latent 随机图信号的 chaos 系数，增长条件下截断误差指数衰减。
Result: Standalone DSS-GNN 在全部 14 个节点分类基准上取得所比较不确定性感知基线中最低的 Brier 分数，且不做后处理校正；DSS-Hybrid 在多数 node-OOD 设定上 AUROC 最佳，cross-graph OOD 检测具有竞争力，并在全部 7 个 GOOD 概念偏移基准上在标准 ERM 下取得最强的偏移准确率。两种模式在三项任务上交叉评测时对彼此任务仍有效，但存在已记录的例外。
Conclusion: 一个 doubly-spectral 展开即可同时充当校准、OOD 检测与分布偏移鲁棒性的统一表示，其任务级结论由实证建立（capacity 定理只覆盖 chaos 系数匹配与截断误差），并给出两种部署模式的显式选择指引。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: MeqMuon: Matrix-Equilibrating Muon for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: The success of large language models (LLMs) has been accompanied by continued growth in model size and pretraining costs. Muon offers high accuracy and training efficiency in LLM pretraining. Recent work introduces row-wise normalization into Muon to balance update magnitudes and improve pretraining performance. However, row-wise normalization alone cannot accommodate different imbalance patterns in update matrices. In this paper, we propose an improved Muon optimizer, called \underline{m}atrix-\underline{eq}uilibrating Muon~(MeqMuon), for LLM pretraining. MeqMuon balances both row and column magnitudes through normalization that can be automatically tailored to different imbalance patterns without manual intervention. Moreover, MeqMuon eliminates the need to store AdamW's second-moment estimates, reducing optimizer-state memory usage. Empirical results demonstrate that MeqMuon achieves better convergence performance than AdamW, Muon, and other baselines in LLM pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeqMuon 是面向 LLM 预训练的 Muon 改进优化器：对更新矩阵同时做行、列两个方向的均衡归一化，归一化方式按矩阵自身的失衡模式自动选择，无需手动调参。它还省去 AdamW 的二阶矩估计，降低优化器状态显存；在 LLM 预训练上收敛优于 AdamW、Muon 及其他基线。
Motivation: Muon 已在 LLM 预训练中展现精度与训练效率优势，但近期引入的行向归一化只能处理单一方向的失衡，无法适应更新矩阵中不同的行/列失衡模式，且 Muon 类方法仍需搭配 AdamW 保存二阶矩，占用优化器状态显存。
Method: 提出 MeqMuon：在 Muon 的更新上施加行与列双向的矩阵均衡归一化 (matrix-equilibrating normalization)，归一化形式依据更新矩阵的失衡模式自动确定，无需人工干预；同时移除 AdamW 的二阶矩估计存储，从而减少优化器状态内存占用。
Result: 实证结果显示 MeqMuon 在 LLM 预训练中的收敛表现优于 AdamW、Muon 及其他基线；同时优化器状态内存因去掉二阶矩估计而下降。
Conclusion: 按矩阵实际失衡模式做行、列联合均衡的 Muon 变体，能在 LLM 预训练上取得比 AdamW 与原版 Muon 更好的收敛，并顺带省掉二阶矩的显存开销。

papers.title: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Distillation attacks copy the reasoning capabilities of closed-source large language models, allowing bad actors to replicate state-of-the-art performance at low cost. Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that a more realistic threat model includes further training with reinforcement learning after distillation. A misspecified threat model can give a false sense of security -- some defenses that seem effective after distillation can be broken after subsequent reinforcement learning. Practically, reinforcement learning lowers the bar for a distillation attack to be effective. We show that simple attacks can steal reasoning capabilities from existing closed-source language models using data easily obtainable from current APIs, yielding reasoning improvements equivalent to more sophisticated attacks that extract the full hidden traces. Results indicate that any distillation defense that leaks sufficient information to reconstruct approximate reasoning traces is likely ineffective. We conclude by discussing broader implications and batch-level distillation defenses which could be more effective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证：蒸馏攻击的防御若只在蒸馏刚结束时评估，会被后续强化学习训练击穿——RL 让攻击者用 API 就能轻易窃取闭源模型的推理能力，效果等同于提取完整隐藏轨迹的复杂攻击。作者据此判定，任何泄漏足以重建近似推理轨迹信息的蒸馏防御都大概率无效。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏防御的评估隐含假设攻击者蒸馏后不再训练，威胁模型错配会带来虚假安全感；更现实的威胁模型必须包含蒸馏后的强化学习继续训练。
Method: 提出包含蒸馏后 RL 继续训练的威胁模型，并展示用当前 API 即可轻易获取的数据发起简单攻击、窃取闭源模型推理能力的攻击路径，以此检验防御在 RL 后是否仍成立。
Result: 简单攻击（数据来自现有 API）带来的推理提升等同于提取完整隐藏轨迹的更复杂攻击；结果表明任何泄漏足以重建近似推理轨迹信息的蒸馏防御都可能失效。
Conclusion: 蒸馏后继续做 RL 会大幅降低蒸馏攻击的门槛，因此防御评估必须纳入 RL 阶段；作者建议转向 batch-level 蒸馏防御这类可能更有效的方案。

papers.title: Provable Benefits of Regularization: Fast Rates for Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study adversarial imitation learning (AIL), in which an agent learns to imitate expert demonstrations by optimizing a policy against an adversarial reward that distinguishes expert and learner behavior. Historically, reward regularization and entropy-based policy regularization are key components of empirically successful methods such as GAIL and LS-IQ, yet their finite-sample benefits remain underexplored. We establish fast rates for jointly regularized AIL in finite-horizon Markov decision processes with general function approximation. Our model-free algorithm, Dually Regularized AIL, combines KL policy regularization with a quadratic reward penalty weighted by expert and learner occupancies. With K online episodes and N expert trajectories, we prove a $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{K}+\frac{1}{N}\right)$ bound on the regularized imitation gap for fixed regularization parameters. Our analysis combines an online mirror descent construction for general convex reward classes to control estimation error from finite expert data and stochastic learner feedback, with a sharp analysis of optimistic KL-regularized policy learning. To the best of our knowledge, Dually Regularized AIL is the first algorithm to simultaneously achieve $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}ε\right)$ sample complexity in both expert demonstrations and online interactions for this regularized AIL objective, even with stochastic experts. These results provide a rigorous characterization of the complementary statistical benefits of reward and policy regularization in AIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限时域 MDP 与一般函数逼近下，提出 Dually Regularized AIL：同时对奖励加按专家/学习者占用测度加权的二次惩罚、对策略加 KL 正则，证明固定正则参数下模仿间隙为 Õ(1/K+1/N)，并成为首个在专家示范与在线交互两侧同时达到 Õ(1/ε) 样本复杂度的正则化 AIL 算法（含随机专家情形）。
Motivation: GAIL、LS-IQ 等对抗模仿学习方法长期依赖奖励正则与基于熵的策略正则，但它们在有限样本下的收益缺少理论刻画；已有分析未同时覆盖有限专家数据与随机学习者反馈带来的估计误差。
Method: 提出 model-free 的 Dually Regularized AIL：KL 策略正则加按专家与学习者占用测度加权的二次奖励惩罚。分析上用面向一般凸奖励类的 online mirror descent 控制有限专家数据与随机在线反馈的估计误差，再对乐观 KL 正则策略学习做精细分析。
Result: 固定正则参数下，K 个在线回合、N 条专家轨迹的正则化模仿间隙为 Õ(1/K+1/N)；样本复杂度在专家示范与在线交互两侧均为 Õ(1/ε)，且在随机专家下也成立。
Conclusion: 奖励正则与策略正则在 AIL 中提供互补的统计收益，联合正则化可在一般函数逼近下同时获得两侧快速收敛率。

papers.title: Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather than a generator capability bottleneck. While reward models could in principle exploit this headroom, they are poorly calibrated for personalization, and their billion-parameter scale makes scoring large candidate pools prohibitively expensive. To overcome this limitation, we propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing million-parameter scale multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ranking models. Our personalized ranking model directly reuses the internal embeddings of the base generator with minimal overhead. By scaling train-time data to provide fine-grained personalized preferences, this million-parameter ranking model accurately scores large candidate pools and can seamlessly guide generation to reduce the cost of materializing N candidates. Extensive experiments on nine datasets spanning three personalized generation settings show that our personalized ranking model effectively exploits the discovered headroom, outperforming billion-parameter generalist reward models on every dataset, with under 0.4% of their parameters and four orders of magnitude lower scoring latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对个性化生成中单一用户目标的标准对齐范式，提出用百万参数级 MLP 排序模型在测试时做 Best-of-N 候选匹配，直接复用基座生成器的内部 embedding。在九个数据集、三种个性化生成设定上，该排序模型以不到通用奖励模型 0.4% 的参数量、低四个数量级的打分延迟，在每个数据集上都超过十亿参数级通用奖励模型。
Motivation: 标准对齐范式按单一用户优化，压掉了个性化生成的性能空间；十亿参数奖励模型打分校准差且对大候选池打分代价过高，Best-of-N 的潜力用不上。
Method: 把个性化生成视为候选匹配问题而非生成能力瓶颈，训练百万参数级多层感知机 (MLP) 排序模型，直接复用基座生成器内部 embedding；通过扩大训练期数据提供细粒度个性化偏好，用该排序模型给大候选池打分并引导生成，减少物化 N 个候选的成本。
Result: 在九个数据集、三种个性化生成设定上，个性化排序模型在每个数据集上都超过十亿参数级通用奖励模型，参数量不到其 0.4%，打分延迟低四个数量级；实证研究显示测试时对齐存在大量未开发的性能空间。
Conclusion: 个性化生成的瓶颈在候选匹配而非生成能力，用复用生成器 embedding 的轻量排序模型做测试时对齐，即可在极低参数与延迟代价下吃掉这块空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRMs), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates. We show that prompt encodings need only preserve the information required for the correct text-conditional score, rather than exactly match teacher features, and use a staged curriculum to learn a compact prompt encoder that replaces the teacher Transformer at inference. We adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance and incorporate gold-solution endpoints to supplement sparse rewards. Our supervised models outperform reported results from recent continuous-diffusion baselines at comparable backbone scales on mathematical reasoning and HumanEval code generation. With a 638M-parameter denoising backbone and learned prompt conditioning, post-NFT LFRM-L achieves 63.74% pass@1 on GSM8K and 24.6% on MATH500 at 64 denoising steps, and 32.85% on HumanEval and 30.18% on HumanEval+ at 128 denoising steps. Code will be available at: https://github.com/chengxiang/LFRM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRM)：在连续潜空间扩散中生成完整推理答案，用多层教师特征训练紧凑表示，并以分阶段课程学出的紧凑 prompt 编码器在推理时替代教师 Transformer。638M 去噪骨干的 LFRM-L 在 NFT 后于 GSM8K 达 63.74% pass@1、MATH500 24.6%（64 步），HumanEval 32.85%、HumanEval+ 30.18%（128 步），在同等骨干规模下超过近期连续扩散基线的已报告结果。
Motivation: 连续扩散推理中解码准确并不自动带来强推理能力，且推理时依赖大型自回归教师的开销高，需要在保持条件分数正确的前提下压缩表示与条件编码。
Method: ELF 训练与推理配方：从强自回归教师的多层学习紧凑表示，其分解支持不同速率的异步去噪；prompt 编码只需保留正确 text-conditional score 所需信息，用分阶段课程训练紧凑 prompt 编码器替代教师 Transformer；将 DiffusionNFT 改造为 learned self-conditioning guidance，并用 gold-solution 端点补充稀疏奖励。
Result: 638M 参数去噪骨干 + learned prompt conditioning 的 LFRM-L 在 NFT 后：GSM8K 63.74% pass@1、MATH500 24.6%（64 去噪步）；HumanEval 32.85%、HumanEval+ 30.18%（128 去噪步）；监督模型在数学推理与 HumanEval 代码生成上超过近期连续扩散基线在可比骨干规模下的已报告结果。
Conclusion: 准确解码本身不足以保证强推理，压缩的多层教师表示加可替代教师的 prompt 编码器足以支撑连续潜空间扩散在数学与代码推理上取得竞争力结果。

papers.title: Report: Progressive Disclosure of Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Users of Workday's deployed LLM-based agents often request features which can be addressed by defining named procedures, also known as skills, in the LLM context, effectively augmenting agents' capabilities. However, as an agent's skills library grows in size, so does the agent's operational cost. Progressive disclosure (lazy-loading) of skills as needed may reduce operational costs, but its impact on overall latency and skill-retrieval quality remains unclear. In this report, we investigate the impact empirically and find that progressive disclosure improves skill-retrieval quality but marginally degrades overall latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Workday 已部署 LLM agent 技能库膨胀带来的运营成本问题，实证检验按需渐进披露 (progressive disclosure / lazy-loading) 技能的效果：技能检索质量提升，但整体延迟略有恶化。
Motivation: agent 的技能库越大运营成本越高，按需懒加载虽可能降本，但其对整体延迟与技能检索质量的影响此前不清楚。
Method: 在 Workday 已部署的 LLM-based agent 场景下做实证研究，对比渐进披露与（隐含的）全量加载在技能检索质量和整体延迟上的表现。
Result: 实证发现：渐进披露提升技能检索质量，同时整体延迟轻微下降（即略有恶化）。
Conclusion: 渐进披露是降低技能库运营成本的可行方向，其代价是小幅延迟增加，收益主要体现在检索质量上。
Relevance: 2
