papers.title: Rethinking Circuit Evaluation: Do Circuits Explain Model Errors?
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) aims to explain a model's behaviour through analyzing its internal computations; circuit-based explanations aim to isolate these computations with compact subnetworks validated by ablating the rest of the model. We show that circuits validated this way may fail to recover the underlying mechanism of the model's behaviour by closely reproducing its successful decisions while failing to account for most of its errors. Such explanations should account for the model's particular errors as well as its successes. We evaluate this requirement by measuring exact answer agreement separately on model successes and failures, across circuit sizes and ablation settings, on IOI, Docstring, and six model-task settings from the Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark. We discover that many tested circuits closely replicate correct behaviour while missing most of the model's errors. On indirect object identification (IOI) for GPT-2 small, under mean ablation, the manual circuit and tested automated circuits, including one trained against the model's full output distribution, agree with the model on 97.3-99.5% of prompts it answers correctly but only 11.4-41.7% of errors. An IOI case study shows that lost errors are recoverable by restoring omitted attention-heads which raise error reproduction from 14.2% to 75.1% on a separate held-out set with 0.41 percentage point decrease on correct agreement, exceeding matched random extensions and scalar-biased control. Intervention traces show how omitted computations produce specific wrong answers for a reproducible subset of errors. In all, these findings show circuits can preserve task success without adequately explaining model's failures, and support exact error reproduction as a necessary, but not sufficient, test of circuit-based explanations of model behaviour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机制可解释性 (MI) 中按消融验证的 circuit 只复现模型答对的决策，却漏掉大部分错误：在 GPT-2 small 的 IOI 上，mean ablation 下手工与自动 circuit 对模型答对的 prompt 一致率 97.3–99.5%，对错误仅 11.4–41.7%。补回被省略的 attention head 可把错误复现率从 14.2% 提到 75.1%，正确一致率仅降 0.41 个百分点，且超过匹配的随机扩展与标量偏置对照。作者主张把 exact error reproduction 作为 circuit 解释的必要（但非充分）检验。
Motivation: circuit 类解释靠消融后仍复现成功决策来验证，但这种验证可能只保住任务成功而与模型真实机制脱节，无法解释模型为何出错。
Method: 在模型成功与失败两类 prompt 上分别度量 exact answer agreement，跨多种 circuit 尺寸与 ablation 设置（含 mean ablation）评测；数据集为 IOI、Docstring 与 Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark 的六个 model-task 设置，并对 IOI 做补回省略 attention head 的案例研究与 intervention trace 分析。
Result: GPT-2 small 的 IOI 在 mean ablation 下，手工 circuit 与被测自动 circuit（含一个针对模型完整输出分布训练的）对模型答对 prompt 一致率 97.3–99.5%，对错误仅 11.4–41.7%；案例研究中恢复被省略的 attention head 使错误复现率从 14.2% 升到 75.1%（独立 held-out 集），正确一致率仅下降 0.41 个百分点，优于匹配随机扩展与 scalar-biased 对照。
Conclusion: circuit 可以在不充分解释模型失败的情况下保住任务成功，因此 exact error reproduction 应作为 circuit 类解释的必要而非充分检验。

papers.title: The Hidden Perception Constraint in Task-Aware Compression
papers.abstract_en: With the recent advancements of neural compressors, explicitly incorporating perception constraints into the design of compression schemes has gained significant attention. Traditionally, these perception constraints ensure that the distribution of the reconstruction does not significantly deviate from the distribution of the source, thus attesting to the perceptual quality of the reconstruction. In this work, we uncover several perception constraints that are naturally present in task-aware compression. In particular, we consider a problem where the primary task is reconstruction and the secondary task is classification (i.e., a statistical test). We study this problem at varying levels of domain information available to us and discuss how to utilize the naturally emerging perception constraints to design rate-minimal compression schemes that also maximize the utility of our secondary task. We show that in this setting, if the decision boundaries of the classifier are ill-defined (mismatch) for our source distribution, then matching onto a target distribution enhances our classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在任务感知压缩中，当分类器决策边界对源分布失配 (mismatch) 时，把重建匹配到目标分布反而提升分类准确率，从而给出率最小且最大化次任务效用的压缩设计。
Motivation: 神经压缩中感知约束通常只保证重建分布不偏离源分布，但任务感知压缩里自然涌现的感知约束尚未被刻画，且次任务效用与率最小化如何权衡不清。
Method: 以重建为主任务、分类（统计检验）为次任务的问题设定，在不同层级的域信息条件下分析，利用自然涌现的感知约束设计率最小压缩方案并最大化次任务效用。
Result: 证明在分类器决策边界对源分布失配时，匹配到目标分布可提升分类准确率；并给出不同域信息水平下率最小且最大化次任务效用的压缩方案设计。
Conclusion: 任务感知压缩中的感知约束是自然存在的：决策边界失配时匹配目标分布是提升分类准确率的正确设计方向，而非一味匹配源分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verifier Errors in RLVR: Reward Hacking, Limits of Feedback, and Selective Control
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), imperfect verifiers can reward incorrect responses, creating opportunities for reward hacking. Using gradient flow with a fixed verifier, we characterize the conditions under which reward rises while correctness falls. We then show that the observations available during RLVR are, in general, insufficient to detect or identify accepted errors, or to guarantee their reduction without sacrificing correct responses. To address this limit, we construct a correction using additional feedback about correctness from audits. This correction achieves \emph{selective control}: at the current policy, it lowers the probability of accepted errors and raises that of correct responses, provided it outweighs the pressure toward errors from verifier reward. Experiments with log linear and neural contextual bandits and with a language model support the analysis and show that selective control under partial auditing reduces accepted errors while increasing correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RLVR 中，不完美 verifier 会奖励错误回答；论文用固定 verifier 的梯度流刻画奖励上升而正确率下降的条件，并证明仅靠 RLVR 观测一般无法检测或识别被接受的错误。引入基于审计 (audit) 的正确性反馈后可实现选择性控制 (selective control)：在当前策略上降低被接受错误的概率、提高正确回答概率，前提是审计信号强过 verifier 把策略推向错误的压力。
Motivation: RLVR 依赖可验证奖励，但 verifier 本身可能出错并奖励不正确回答，形成 reward hacking；需要判定这种失效何时发生、以及现有观测能否发现它。
Method: 以固定 verifier 下的梯度流 (gradient flow) 分析奖励与正确率的演化条件，论证 RLVR 可用观测不足以检测/识别被接受错误；再构造利用审计 (audit) 提供的正确性反馈的修正项，导出选择性控制的成立条件，并在 log-linear 与 neural contextual bandit 以及语言模型上做实验。
Result: 选择性控制在当前策略上同时降低被接受错误概率、提高正确回答概率，条件是审计修正强过 verifier 对错误的压力；部分审计 (partial auditing) 下的实验支持该分析，显示被接受错误减少而正确率上升。

papers.title: Explainable Deep Learning for Probabilistic Nowcasting of Radar Reflectivity in Tornadic Storms
papers.abstract_en: Tornadoes pose substantial risk to human life and property in the United States, causing more than 50 fatalities and \$100 million of property damage on average annually. When tornadoes are likely, weather radar provides critical information for forecasters by providing information on storm morphology, storm motion, and intensity trends. Additional tools such as satellite and numerical weather prediction model runs can provide useful short-term information for understanding changes in storm characteristics. This work demonstrates a U-Net deep-learning system for nowcasting the evolution of radar reflectivity following tornadogenesis, which can provide value to forecasters by synthesizing large amounts of input data (e.g., radar imagery, near-storm environment data) and generating predictions of radar reflectivity from its inputs. Inputs to the model are radar imagery from the Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) dataset and near-storm environment data from the High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) numerical weather prediction model. The U-Net is trained on a dataset of tornadic storms to produce 30 minutes of probabilistic predictions of radar reflectivity following tornadogenesis, with probabilistic predictions obtained by predicting parameters of the SinhArcSinh, or SHASH, distribution. The model produces physically realistic predictions of radar evolution, achieves comparable skill to next-hour forecasts from the HRRR, demonstrates reasonable probabilistic calibration and is accompanied by a variety of explainability methods to improve understanding by end users. Additionally, predictions from the model can be obtained much more quickly than those from a numerical weather prediction model. With further development, this model could be extended to nowcast radar reflectivity evolution in an operational setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 U-Net 对龙卷生成 (tornadogenesis) 之后的雷达反射率演变做 30 分钟概率临近预报，输入 MRMS 雷达图像与 HRRR 近风暴环境数据，通过预测 SinhArcSinh (SHASH) 分布参数给出概率预报。模型产出物理上合理的反射率演变，技巧与 HRRR 的 next-hour 预报相当，概率校准合理，且推理速度远快于数值模式，并配套多种可解释性方法。
Motivation: 龙卷每年在美国造成 50 以上死亡和 1 亿美元以上财产损失，预报员依赖雷达判断风暴形态与强度趋势，但数值模式更新慢、输入数据量大，缺少能快速综合多源观测并给出概率预报的工具。
Method: U-Net 深度学习系统，输入为 Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) 雷达图像与 High-Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR) 的近风暴环境数据，在龙卷风暴数据集上训练，输出龙卷生成后 30 分钟的雷达反射率概率预报；概率性通过预测 SinhArcSinh (SHASH) 分布参数实现，并附带多种可解释性方法供终端用户理解。
Result: 产出物理上合理的雷达演变预报；技巧与 HRRR 的 next-hour 预报相当；概率校准合理；预报获取速度远快于数值天气预报模式。
Conclusion: 以 SHASH 分布参数化的 U-Net 能在龙卷生成后 30 分钟尺度上给出校准合理、速度远超 NWP 的概率雷达临近预报，进一步开发后可走向业务化应用。

papers.title: FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Tool-based image editing (image retouching) is commonly formulated with autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that sequentially generate reasoning, tool selections, and parameter values. In this work, we present a novel approach to tool-based image editing by framing the task as a flow matching problem. We introduce FlowTool, a framework that directly models the distribution of high-quality tool parameters conditioned on the input image and user instruction using conditional rectified flow. FlowTool combines a vision-language model backbone for multimodal understanding with a Diffusion Transformer parameter generator that transforms Gaussian noise into an editing plan. We train FlowTool with a two-stage supervised flow-matching curriculum, followed by reward-based post-training. Across MMArt-Bench, FlowTool-Eval, ArtEdit-Bench, and MIT-Adobe5K, FlowTool achieves significantly stronger reference-based performance than specialized MLLM editing agents and proprietary MLLMs, while remaining competitive with proprietary models under reference-free evaluation. Moreover, FlowTool significantly improves inference efficiency, reducing latency by at least $50\times$ while requiring nearly $2\times$ less memory than the compared baselines. These results demonstrate that tool-based image editing can be effectively modeled as conditional generation over structured continuous editing parameters, without autoregressive reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowTool 把基于工具的图像修图从自回归 MLLM 推理改为条件流匹配 (conditional rectified flow)：VLM 骨干理解图像与指令，Diffusion Transformer 直接把高斯噪声生成连续编辑参数。在 MMArt-Bench、FlowTool-Eval、ArtEdit-Bench、MIT-Adobe5K 上参考式指标显著强于专用 MLLM 编辑智能体与闭源模型，延迟至少降低 50×、内存省近 2×。
Motivation: 自回归多模态 LLM 做工具式修图要顺序生成推理、工具选择与参数值，延迟高、内存开销大，且把连续参数当离散 token 生成并不自然。
Method: 以 conditional rectified flow 直接建模给定输入图像与用户指令下的高质量工具参数分布：VLM 骨干负责多模态理解，Diffusion Transformer 参数生成器把高斯噪声变换为编辑计划；训练采用两阶段监督 flow-matching 课程，随后做基于奖励的后训练 (reward-based post-training)。
Result: 在 MMArt-Bench、FlowTool-Eval、ArtEdit-Bench、MIT-Adobe5K 上，参考式 (reference-based) 指标显著优于专用 MLLM 编辑智能体与闭源 MLLM，无参考 (reference-free) 评测下与闭源模型相当；推理延迟至少降低 50×，内存比对照基线少近 2×。
Conclusion: 工具式图像编辑可以建模为对结构化连续编辑参数的条件生成，无需自回归推理，同时大幅改善延迟与内存。

papers.title: PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception--action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision--language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation---and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app's GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it deterministically in sub-second time at zero VLM cost; open-ended interaction and every failure of the compiled path fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter, exactly the pure VLM agent, so compilation can only help. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves the task success rate while reducing steps and token consumption, and it transfers to AndroidWorld's official M3A agent with consistent efficiency gains. What PhoneCLI compiles is the app's navigation rather than one run, so it serves new tasks, not only repeated ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhoneCLI 把移动 App 的 GUI 导航离线编译成可复用的命令库：从外部探索目标 App，将屏幕、可交互元素与导航边蒸馏成语义标注地图，每屏对应一条确定性回放命令。在线时智能体先选命令、执行前校验、再以亚秒级零 VLM 成本确定性执行，开放式交互与编译路径的失败则回退到内嵌 VLM 解释器，因此编译只会带来增益。在 AndroidLab 上任务成功率提升的同时步数与 token 消耗下降，并可迁移到 AndroidWorld 的官方 M3A 智能体取得一致的效率收益。
Motivation: 移动 GUI 智能体的感知-动作循环每步都要截图、调用 VLM 再输出动作，慢、贵且脆弱，而其中大部分工作只是静态、有序、反复出现的导航。
Method: 离线阶段从外部探索目标 App，不依赖 App 内部 API、运行时插桩或模型训练，把屏幕、可交互元素与导航边蒸馏成语义标注地图，每个屏幕产出一条确定性回放命令；在线阶段智能体选择命令、执行前校验、再确定性执行，开放式交互与编译路径失败回退到内嵌 VLM 解释器（等同纯 VLM 智能体）。
Result: 在 AndroidLab 上，PhoneCLI 在提升任务成功率的同时减少步数与 token 消耗；迁移到 AndroidWorld 的官方 M3A 智能体后取得一致的效率增益。编译对象是 App 导航而非单次运行，因此可服务新任务。
Conclusion: 把可重复的 GUI 导航编译成带校验的确定性命令、失败回退 VLM，能在不训练模型的前提下同时改善成功率与开销，且编译产物可跨任务复用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learned Preconditioning for a Primal-Dual Interior-Point Method
papers.abstract_en: Interior-point methods (IPMs) are among the most widely used algorithms for constrained optimization, yet their Newton-based search directions require costly second-order information and large linear-system solves. Learning to optimize offers cheaper updates learned from data, but the singular behavior of logarithmic barriers near constraint boundaries makes IPMs highly sensitive to perturbations, complicating both warm starting and learning reliable updates. We introduce pdLIP, an IPM for smooth nonlinear programs that integrates learned preconditioning with pdProj, an all-shifted primal-dual projected-search IPM. A shared coordinate-wise recurrent network predicts a positive diagonal preconditioner that scales the right-hand side of the reduced Newton system for the primal step, and the remaining slack and multiplier directions are recovered analytically. The learned iterations avoid Hessian evaluations and Newton-system solves, using only first-order and coordinate-wise operations amenable to GPU parallelization. Training is self-supervised, with a loss based on a penalty-barrier merit function and the residual of perturbed optimality conditions, requiring neither target directions nor precomputed solutions. Primal and dual shifts mitigate the barrier's sensitivity to perturbations near constraint boundaries, enabling effective warm starting. Across four classes of 200-dimensional convex and nonconvex constrained problems, pdLIP warm starts reduce pdProj refinement iterations by 63-67% compared with cold starts at the same KKT residual tolerance of $10^{-8}$, with negligible warm-start generation cost relative to the subsequent pdProj solve. Improvements persist on box-constrained QPs with 1000 variables and extend to applications including portfolio optimization, support vector machines, and a nonlinear control example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 pdLIP：把学习到的对角预条件器嵌入全平移原始-对偶投影搜索内点法 pdProj，用共享的逐坐标循环网络预测正对角预条件器来缩约化 Newton 系统的右端项，slack 与乘子方向解析恢复，从而避开 Hessian 求值与 Newton 系统求解。在四类 200 维凸与非凸约束问题上，pdLIP 热启动在 KKT 残差容差 1e-8 下把 pdProj 精化迭代减少 63-67%，热启动生成开销相对后续求解可忽略。
Motivation: 内点法的 Newton 搜索方向需要昂贵的二阶信息与大型线性系统求解，而对数障碍在约束边界附近的奇异行为使 IPM 对扰动高度敏感，热启动与学习可靠更新都因此变难。
Method: pdLIP 由 pdProj（all-shifted primal-dual projected-search IPM）与一个共享的逐坐标循环网络组成：网络预测正对角预条件器，缩放原始步约化 Newton 系统的右端项，slack 与乘子方向解析恢复；训练为自监督，损失基于 penalty-barrier merit function 与扰动最优性条件残差，不需要目标方向或预计算解；primal 与 dual shifts 缓解约束边界附近的扰动敏感性以支持热启动。
Result: 在四类 200 维凸与非凸约束问题上，pdLIP 热启动相对冷启动在相同 KKT 残差容差 1e-8 下减少 63-67% 的 pdProj 精化迭代，热启动生成成本相对后续 pdProj 求解可忽略；改进在 1000 变量的 box-constrained QP 上保持，并扩展到 portfolio optimization、support vector machines 与一个非线性控制算例。
Conclusion: 学习预条件加 primal/dual shifts 能让 IPM 迭代避开二阶求解并有效热启动，在所测的约束问题类上以可忽略的生成开销显著减少精化迭代。

summary_sections.method: pdLIP 由 pdProj（all-shifted primal-dual projected-search IPM）与一个共享的逐坐标循环网络组成：网络预测正对角预条件器，缩放原始步约化 Newton 系统的右端项，slack 与乘子方向解析恢复；训练为自监督，损失基于 penalty-barrier merit function 与扰动最优性条件残差，不需要目标方向或预计算解；primal 与 dual shifts 缓解约束边界附近的扰动敏感性以支持热启动。
summary_sections.result: 在四类 200 维凸与非凸约束问题上，pdLIP 热启动相对冷启动在相同 KKT 残差容差 1e-8 下减少 63-67% 的 pdProj 精化迭代，热启动生成成本相对后续 pdProj 求解可忽略；改进在 1000 变量的 box-constrained QP 上保持，并扩展到 portfolio optimization、support vector machines 与一个非线性控制算例。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学习预条件加 primal/dual shifts 能让 IPM 迭代避开二阶求解并有效热启动，在所测的约束问题类上以可忽略的生成开销显著减少精化迭代。

papers.title: MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size. This multi-resolution decomposition draws on principles from Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM), adapting them to the gated linear attention setting. We evaluate MS-GLA on language modeling, recall-intensive tasks, and long-context generalization. Across all settings, MS-GLA consistently achieves higher accuracy and lower perplexity than GLA at matched parameter counts, with up to 18.9% improvement on recall-intensive tasks and 9.5% lower average perplexity on language modeling benchmarks, validating multi-temporal resolution decomposition as a principled and effective extension of Gated Linear Attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS-GLA 把 GLA 的注意力头分配到多个时间分辨率上：粗分辨率池化更长 token 段专攻长程依赖，细分辨率保留局部句法，再用可学习的输入依赖融合层在每步重组各头组输出，在不增大单头状态的前提下扩大有效记忆容量。在参数量对齐下，召回密集任务最高提升 18.9%，语言建模基准平均困惑度降低 9.5%。
Motivation: GLA 各头的固定容量记忆矩阵都在单一时间分辨率上逐 token 处理，必须同时编码局部句法与长程语义，形成仅靠门控无法解决的表示瓶颈。
Method: 将注意力头按多时间分辨率分组，粗组池化长 token 段、细组保留局部句法；用可学习、输入依赖的融合层在每个时间步重组头组输出，思路借鉴 Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM) 并适配到 gated linear attention 设置；在语言建模、召回密集任务与长上下文泛化上评测。
Result: 在参数量匹配 (matched parameter counts) 下，MS-GLA 在全部设置中准确率高于 GLA、困惑度更低：召回密集任务最高提升 18.9%，语言建模基准平均困惑度降低 9.5%。
Conclusion: 多时间分辨率分解是扩展 Gated Linear Attention 的有效原则：在不增加单头状态大小的情况下扩大有效记忆容量，同时改善召回与语言建模困惑度。

papers.title: Many Eyes, One World: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Mixed Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Real-world capture is heterogeneous: perspective, fisheye, and $360^\circ$ panoramic images can coexist within a single reconstruction task, yet most feed-forward 3D reconstruction models assume perspective imagery and a uniform input representation. Recent models handling several camera types are either informed of the camera type for each view or reconstruct one image pair at a time. No single-pass method reconstructs mixed-camera tuples containing full panoramas from images alone. We present MEOW, a feed-forward system that jointly reconstructs metric pointmaps and camera poses from one N-view tuple mixing perspective, fisheye and full-panorama images, in a single forward pass from images alone: no calibration, distortion parameters, camera-type labels or poses are supplied for any view. Our guiding design philosophy is to treat heterogeneous-camera reconstruction as a data-adaptation problem rather than an architectural redesign. MEOW retains a perspective-pretrained backbone and learns heterogeneous cameras entirely from a procedural data engine, which renders each scene across a continuous manifold of camera models with exact rays and depth, and certifies covisibility for every camera-sampled training tuple. Trained on synthetic tuples only, MEOW transfers zero-shot to real captures: on heterogeneous 2D3DS tuples it achieves 79.9 mAA@30 against 53.8 for Wid3R given the camera type of every view; on our laser-scanned mixed-camera benchmark it registers every four-view mixed tuple with 79.4 AUC@30. The data engine, benchmark, and complete evaluation pipeline will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEOW 用单次前向从混合相机（透视、鱼眼、全景）的 N 视图元组同时重建度量点图与相机位姿，不给标定、畸变参数、相机类型标签或位姿。它把异构相机当作数据适配问题：保留透视预训练 backbone，仅用程序化数据引擎渲染的合成元组训练，零样本迁移到真实采集。在 2D3DS 异构元组上达 79.9 mAA@30（Wid3R 在已知每视图相机类型下为 53.8），激光扫描混合相机基准上四视图元组全部配准、AUC@30 为 79.4。
Motivation: 真实采集常混合透视、鱼眼与 360° 全景，但现有前馈 3D 重建模型假设透视输入与统一表示；能处理多相机类型的方法要么需要每视图相机类型，要么逐对重建，尚无单次前向、仅凭图像处理含全景的混合相机元组的方法。
Method: MEOW 保留透视预训练 backbone，把异构相机学习交给程序化数据引擎：对每个场景在连续相机模型流形上渲染，给出精确射线与深度，并为每个相机采样的训练元组认证共视性 (covisibility)。仅用合成元组训练，单次前向输出度量点图与相机位姿，输入端不提供标定、畸变参数、相机类型标签或位姿。
Result: 在异构 2D3DS 元组上取得 79.9 mAA@30，对比已知每视图相机类型的 Wid3R 的 53.8；在作者的激光扫描混合相机基准上，每个四视图混合元组均成功配准，AUC@30 为 79.4。
Conclusion: 异构相机重建可以作为数据适配问题解决：只靠程序化合成数据训练的透视 backbone 能零样本迁移到真实混合相机采集，并在无相机类型信息下超过被告知相机类型的基线。数据引擎、基准与完整评测流程将开源。

papers.title: CMDO: A Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization Algorithm for Adaptive Population-Based Search
papers.abstract_en: Population-based optimization methods often use previous search information through successful solutions, parameter adaptation, or operator performance, but they rarely retain the context in which a search behavior succeeded or failed. We introduce Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization (CMDO), a derivative-free population-based optimizer that represents experience as the relationship between search context, search behavior, and observed outcome. CMDO organizes these experiences across working, episodic, and consolidated memory, retrieves them according to similarity with the current search state, and uses both positive and negative evidence to guide subsequent search. Retrieved experience does not replay previous candidate locations; instead, it selects search recipes that are reconstructed from the current population through exploratory, directed, and local search behaviors with adaptive search geometry. We evaluate CMDO on selected Blackbox Optimization Benchmarking test suite on COCO (BBOB/COCO) and Congress on Evolutionary Computation 2017 (CEC2017) problems against DE, CMA-ES, SHADE, GWO, HHO, and ORCA, and further study its application to seven-parameter photovoltaic model estimation using measured current--voltage data. The results show problem-dependent but competitive optimization performance, including the lowest median error among the compared methods on CEC2017 F10. More importantly, analysis of the search traces shows that context-dependent recall changes the distribution of executed search behaviors, while unsuccessful experiences remain available as negative evidence for later decisions, showing that accumulated experience directly influences subsequent search behavior. These results support the use of explicit context--behavior--outcome memory as an active mechanism for controlling population-based search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CMDO 是一种无导数种群优化器，把搜索经验表示为「上下文-行为-结果」三元组，存入工作、情景与巩固记忆并按当前状态相似度检索，用正负证据共同决定后续搜索行为。检索到的经验不回放旧候选点，而是从当前种群重建探索式、定向式与局部搜索配方；在 BBOB/COCO 与 CEC2017 上相对 DE、CMA-ES、SHADE、GWO、HHO、ORCA 表现具竞争力，CEC2017 F10 取得最低中位误差。
Motivation: 种群优化方法虽利用成功解、参数自适应或算子表现，却几乎不保留搜索行为成功或失败时的上下文，导致历史经验无法按情境复用。
Method: CMDO 将经验组织为 working、episodic、consolidated 三层记忆，按与当前搜索状态的相似度检索，并同时利用正例与负例证据；检索结果不重放历史候选位置，而是从当前种群重建 exploratory、directed、local 三种搜索行为与自适应搜索几何。评测用 BBOB/COCO 与 CEC2017，基线为 DE、CMA-ES、SHADE、GWO、HHO、ORCA，并用于七参数光伏模型估计（实测 I-V 数据）。
Result: 在 CEC2017 F10 上取得所比较方法中最低的中位误差；整体表现为问题依赖但具竞争力。搜索轨迹分析显示上下文依赖的回忆改变了已执行搜索行为的分布，未成功经验作为负证据保留并影响后续决策。
Conclusion: 显式的上下文-行为-结果记忆可以作为主动机制来控制种群搜索，累积经验直接塑造后续搜索行为。

papers.title: Guided Uncertainty-Aware Robust Domain Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence models deployed as clinical decision support tools often suffer substantial performance degradation over time and across institutions due to covariate shift, concept drift, and cross-system heterogeneity. Fully retraining complex models is frequently infeasible, particularly in EHR settings where labeled outcome data are scarce and regulatory constraints limit model modification. We propose GUARD (Guided and Uncertainty-Aware Robustness to Domain shift), a unified statistical framework for updating an existing deployed model using limited labeled target data and multiple heterogeneous source populations while guarding against future distributional shifts. GUARD formulates robust multi-source transfer learning as a semi-supervised, adversarial optimization problem anchored at the current model, and employs double machine learning with cross-fitting to obtain debiased, efficient estimates that leverage abundant unlabeled target covariates. It then constructs an uncertainty-aware, guided group DRO estimator that combines source and target information while accounting for sampling variability in the source models. Our framework jointly provides principled robustness to domain shift, efficient semi-supervised estimation, and valid statistical inference for multi-source transfer of clinical prediction models. We demonstrate the utility of GUARD via extensive simulation experiments and a real world application to predicting future disease activity in rheumatoid arthritis from EHR data spanning more than a decade. GUARD recalibrates a pretrained model with only a small number of labeled records per year and remains accurate over multi-year horizons where target-only and standard transfer estimators degrade sharply.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUARD 用半监督对抗式多源迁移框架更新已部署的临床预测模型：以当前模型为锚点做鲁棒迁移，用 double machine learning 加 cross-fitting 消偏并利用大量无标签目标协变量，再构造带不确定性的 guided group DRO 估计量。在类风湿关节炎 EHR 数据（跨度十余年）上，每年只需少量带标签记录即可重校准预训练模型，并在多年期 horizon 上保持准确，而 target-only 与标准迁移估计量性能急剧下降。
Motivation: 临床决策支持模型因 covariate shift、concept drift 与跨机构异构性随时间性能大幅退化；EHR 中带标签结局稀缺且监管限制模型修改，完全重训往往不可行。
Method: GUARD 把鲁棒多源迁移学习表述为以当前模型为锚的半监督对抗优化问题；用 double machine learning 与 cross-fitting 得到去偏、有效的估计以利用大量无标签目标协变量；再构造 uncertainty-aware 的 guided group DRO 估计量，合并源域与目标域信息并计入源模型的抽样变异性，同时给出有效统计推断。
Result: 在模拟实验与真实 EHR 应用（预测类风湿关节炎未来疾病活动度，数据跨度十余年）中，GUARD 每年仅用少量带标签记录重校准预训练模型，多年期 horizon 上保持准确，而 target-only 与标准迁移估计量急剧退化。
Conclusion: 以当前模型为锚、结合去偏半监督估计与 guided group DRO，可以在标签极少的临床场景下同时获得域偏移鲁棒性、半监督效率与有效推断。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Transferable Mass Spectrum Prediction via Reference-Guided Test-time Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Tandem mass spectrum prediction supports compound identification across metabolomics, natural-product discovery, and environmental analysis. However, pretrained predictors often degrade under shifts in chemical space and acquisition conditions, while retraining domain-specific models from scratch is costly. We introduce SPARC, a retrieval-guided test-time specialization framework that adapts a pretrained predictor using a spectral reference library without accessing test-query spectra. For each target query, SPARC retrieves chemically related reference spectra to recalibrate fragment intensities within the learned fragmentation space. During Transfer, SPARC combines reference-guided spectral adaptation with reliability-aware consistency, using reconstruction behavior on retrieved spectra to selectively preserve trustworthy predictions during continual specialization. Across MassSpecGym, NPLIB1 and application-specific GNPS libraries, SPARC improves spectral prediction under multiple transfer settings. These results establish retrieval-guided test-time specialization as a practical strategy for extending pretrained MS/MS predictors to specific chemical and acquisition domains, with continual test-time training providing further refinement during deployment.

papers.title: CoSE-E: A Benchmark for Code-switched Speech Evaluation in Enterprise Settings
papers.abstract_en: Code-switching (CS), a seamless alternation between languages within a single utterance, remains a critical challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). While prior works focus on conversational CS-ASR, enterprise settings demand evaluation of operational impact beyond edit-distance errors: how code-switching transcription errors propagate to downstream voice agent task failures. In this work, we propose (1) a CS-ASR synthetic benchmark and multidimensional evaluation framework tailored to enterprise domains, (2) systematic evaluation of frontier ASR systems across 5 language pairs, (3) diagnostic analysis of the additional transcription errors that code-switching introduces across language pairs and models. We release COSE-E to support enterprise-focused CSASR evaluation for multilingual voice agents in enterprise deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to SALMA Workshop (Oral) at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoSE-E 提出面向企业场景的 code-switching ASR 合成基准与多维评估框架，把评估重心从编辑距离错误移到转写错误如何传导为下游 voice agent 任务失败，并在 5 个语言对上系统评测前沿 ASR 系统，诊断 code-switching 额外引入的转写错误。
Motivation: 既有 CS-ASR 工作集中在对话场景，而企业部署关心的是转写错误对下游任务的实际影响，编辑距离不足以刻画这种运营层面的失败。
Method: 构建 CS-ASR 合成基准与面向企业域的多维评估框架，覆盖 5 个语言对，对前沿 ASR 系统做系统评测，并对 code-switching 额外引入的转写错误做跨语言对、跨模型的诊断分析。
Result: 在 5 个语言对上完成对前沿 ASR 系统的系统评测，并给出跨语言对与跨模型的 code-switching 附加转写错误诊断分析；发布 COSE-E 以支持企业多语 voice agent 的 CS-ASR 评估。
Conclusion: 企业 CS-ASR 评估应超越编辑距离、纳入下游任务失败这一维度，COSE-E 即为此目的开源的基准。

papers.title: Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models can perform multi-step reasoning and improve task performance through different forms of intermediate computation, from token-based traces to computation carried out in latent space. However, a question remains open: do these different forms of thinking rely on the same underlying mechanism? To address this, we train and compare five variants of the same GPTNeoX backbone from scratch on an extended multi-hop reasoning task (ProsQA-Ext): a vanilla model, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) model, a Pause Token model, and two latent-reasoning models that are optimized end-to-end without intermediate reasoning traces. We find that, strong in-distribution (ID) performance does not guarantee depth generalization. Vanilla, CoT, and Pause Token models solve ID problems well, but rely largely on local graph features and generalize poorly to out-of-distribution (OOD) problems with longer hops. In contrast, latent variants generalize better and show internal dynamics consistent with forward reachability propagation on the graph. Causal interventions and circuit analysis localize this computation to a sparse recurrent search circuit in the bottleneck latent model: an attention head retrieves graph relations, an MLP and the residual stream update the reachability state across recurrent steps, while multiple attention heads together then do the candidate matching. Together, these results show that different thinking mechanisms can learn distinct computational solutions, even at similar ID performance. In this setting, latent recurrence supports a reusable forward-search algorithm that generalizes beyond the training depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一 GPTNeoX 骨干从零训练的五种思维变体在 ProsQA-Ext 多跳推理上 ID 表现相近，但深度泛化分化：vanilla、CoT、Pause Token 依赖局部图特征，OOD 长跳数上泛化差；latent 推理变体泛化更好，其内部动力学与图上的前向可达性传播一致。因果干预与电路分析把该计算定位到 bottleneck latent 模型中的稀疏递归搜索回路。
Motivation: 不同形态的中间计算（token 轨迹 vs. latent 空间）是否依赖同一底层机制尚无定论；且强 ID 表现并不保证向更长跳数的 OOD 深度泛化。
Method: 从零训练并对比同一 GPTNeoX 骨干的五个变体：vanilla、Chain-of-Thought (CoT)、Pause Token，以及两个端到端优化、无中间推理轨迹的 latent 推理模型；任务为扩展多跳推理数据集 ProsQA-Ext。用因果干预 (causal interventions) 与电路分析 (circuit analysis) 定位计算所在回路。
Result: vanilla、CoT、Pause Token 在 ID 问题上表现好但主要依赖局部图特征，OOD 更长跳数上泛化差；latent 变体泛化更好，内部动力学与图上前向可达性传播一致。回路定位结果：一个 attention head 检索图关系，MLP 与 residual stream 在递归步间更新可达性状态，多个 attention head 共同完成候选匹配。
Conclusion: 不同思维机制即使 ID 性能相近也会学到不同的计算解；在该设定下 latent 递归支撑一种可复用、能超出训练深度泛化的前向搜索算法。

papers.title: Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench, with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench-Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate---GPT-Image-2.5---solves 21.4% of VVRBench-Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可程序化验证的图像奖励框架 Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR)：每个任务是几何物体场景，同时导出 prompt 与确定性验证器，用其分数做强化学习 (RLVVR) 训练图像生成模型。Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 在 VVRBench 上的准确率从 2.8% 升到 28.3%，并呈现由易到难的泛化，增益还延伸到域外基准。
Motivation: 图像生成的精确指令遵循（物体计数、空间关系）依赖目标检测器与视觉语言模型这类不可靠奖励模型来学习，奖励信号本身不可验证，制约了该能力的提升。
Method: 每个 VVR 任务是一个由几何物体及其关系构成的场景，从中同时派生 prompt 和确定性验证器，任务可按需生成且复杂度可控；用 VVR 分数作为 RL 奖励 (RLVVR) 训练 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium，并把 VVR 混入现有目标函数。发布 VVRBench（10,000 个任务、32 种约束类型）与 VVRBench-Challenge（720 个更复杂任务）。
Result: VVRBench-Challenge 上被评估的最强模型 GPT-Image-2.5 解出 21.4%；RLVVR 使 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 在 VVRBench 上的准确率从 2.8% 升至 28.3%，并展示一致的 easy-to-hard 泛化；增益延伸到域外基准，混入 VVR 进一步提升整体性能与人类偏好。
Conclusion: 可验证的合成场景奖励能迁移到自然 prompt 上的指令遵循，作者主张把 VVR 纳入图像生成的标准后训练流程。

papers.title: GPUPhysBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Correct and Efficient GPU Physics Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Writing fast GPU code for physical simulation is difficult: implementations must preserve numerical accuracy while handling irregular data access, synchronization, and iterative solvers. We introduce GPUPhysBench, a benchmark of 50 tasks testing whether coding agents can meet these demands. Tasks cover fluids, deformable solids, and granular materials, from individual simulation operators to complete simulators. Agents write, compile, test, and optimize GPU code with access to a NVIDIA GPU under fixed time budgets. We report pass rates and runtime performance relative to expert-optimized reference implementations. In a single-attempt evaluation of six frontier model-harness pairs, the two strongest pass all 50 tasks, but even the fastest reaches at least 0.9 the reference speed on only 22% of them, and no submission is more than 5% faster than the reference. The largest gaps arise in collision detection, constraint solving, and iterative solvers. GPUPhysBench brings physical simulation workloads to coding-agent evaluation, testing both the ability to implement numerical methods correctly and the ability to make them run efficiently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPUPhysBench 把 GPU 物理仿真写码任务做成 50 题基准，覆盖流体、可变形固体与颗粒材料，从单个仿真算子到完整模拟器，让 coding agent 在固定时限内于 NVIDIA GPU 上编写、编译、测试并优化代码。单次评测六个前沿 model-harness 组合，最强两个通过全部 50 题，但最快者仅 22% 的任务达到参考实现速度的 0.9 倍，且没有任何提交比参考快 5% 以上。
Motivation: 写 GPU 物理仿真代码要同时守住数值精度并处理不规则访存、同步与迭代求解器，现有 coding-agent 评测缺少覆盖这类数值正确性与运行效率双重要求的工作负载。
Method: 构建 50 个任务的基准，覆盖流体、可变形固体、颗粒材料，粒度从单个仿真算子到完整模拟器；agent 在固定时间预算下于 NVIDIA GPU 上编写、编译、测试并优化代码，报告通过率与相对专家优化参考实现的运行时性能。
Result: 单次尝试评测六个前沿 model-harness 组合：最强两个通过全部 50 题；最快者仅在 22% 的任务上达到参考实现速度的至少 0.9 倍；没有任何提交比参考实现快 5% 以上。最大差距出现在碰撞检测、约束求解与迭代求解器。
Conclusion: 前沿 coding agent 已能基本正确实现 GPU 物理仿真，但要达到专家优化的运行效率仍普遍不足，性能瓶颈集中在碰撞检测、约束求解与迭代求解器。

papers.title: RT-Super: Learning Tumor Segmentation from Longitudinal Images and Reports
papers.abstract_en: Multi-tumor segmentation is important for early cancer detection and allows radiologists to visualize, verify, and understand AI predictions. However, tumor segmentation masks are expensive, time-consuming, and unavailable for many tumor types in public data. Instead, hospitals have vast, readily available data that can guide segmentation: radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. We use this readily available data to substitute for tumor masks in training AI for tumor segmentation. To this end, we propose a new architecture, RT-Super. It has a teacher network, which analyzes the patient's longitudinal images and reports to create high-quality tumor masks. These masks train a student network, which sees a single image and no report. At inference, when longitudinal images and reports are unavailable, we use the student. RT-Super uses a new CNN-Transformer architecture and novel Consistency Losses that exploit tumor location consistency across longitudinal images. We train RT-Super to segment esophagus, uterus and spleen tumors, which have few or no public masks. Even without training masks, RT-Super can segment these tumors and surpass public AI models. Overall, we demonstrate that learning from longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and reports can overcome mask scarcity and advance multi-cancer detection and segmentation. Code: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/RT-Super
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RT-Super 用教师-学生蒸馏把放疗报告与纵向/多期影像当作分割监督的替代品：教师看纵向影像和报告生成肿瘤掩码，学生只看单张影像和无报告，推理时用学生。在食管、子宫、脾肿瘤上即使训练掩码为零也能分割并超过公开 AI 模型。
Motivation: 多肿瘤分割需要掩码，但标注昂贵、公开数据中多数肿瘤类型没有掩码；医院里现成的报告、纵向影像和多期影像却大量存在。
Method: 提出 RT-Super：教师网络分析患者纵向影像与报告生成高质量肿瘤掩码，用这些掩码训练只看单张影像的学生网络；架构为新的 CNN-Transformer，并加入利用肿瘤位置跨纵向一致性的 Consistency Losses。
Result: 在食管、子宫、脾肿瘤上训练，这些类型公开掩码很少或没有；即使没有训练掩码，RT-Super 仍能分割这些肿瘤并超过公开 AI 模型。
Conclusion: 从纵向影像、多期影像和报告中学习可以替代掩码、缓解标注稀缺，从而推进多癌种检测与分割；推理阶段在无纵向影像和报告时使用学生网络。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Bounding Retraining Equivalence and the Deletion Floor in Materials Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: In materials machine learning, closely related retained structures can sustain accurate property predictions even after removing a specific record, rendering post-deletion prediction error an ambiguous metric for machine unlearning. To resolve this ambiguity, we define the deletion floor as the expected target loss under a specified retraining procedure at the deleted request. Standard indistinguishability constraints yield a sharp interval bounding an update's target loss around this baseline reference. Theoretically, a conditional neighbor bound links a low deletion floor directly to retained fit, prediction regularity, and local label agreement, while an exact ridge identity isolates residual fit from the prediction change induced by record deletion. Empirically, controlled redundancy sweeps show an $\approx 8\times$ drop in median normalized retraining loss when one retained relative remains after deletion. Across two distinct fitting regimes in a paired Materials Project study, the lower-floor regime also exhibits a larger prediction change on more than 50% of the shared requests. Systematic comparisons against approximate updates and the original model decouple deliberate target suppression from preserved overall model utility. Consequently, request-level unlearning evaluations should report reference loss, prediction change, and retained utility together, interpreting post-deletion accuracy against what retraining itself leaves behind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 材料机器学习中删除记录后仍靠相近保留结构维持准确预测，使删除后预测误差无法判定遗忘是否成功；论文把 deletion floor 定义为指定重训练过程在被删请求处的期望目标损失，并给出标准不可区分约束下更新目标损失围绕该基线的锐区间。冗余扫描中保留一个“亲属”时中位归一化重训练损失约降 8×，因此请求级遗忘评测须同时报告 reference loss、prediction change 与 retained utility。
Motivation: 材料 ML 中相近保留结构可在删除后继续给出准确预测，导致删除后预测误差作为机器遗忘指标含义模糊，无法区分真正抑制与残留拟合。
Method: 定义 deletion floor 为指定重训练过程在删除请求处的期望目标损失；用标准 indistinguishability 约束导出更新目标损失围绕该基线的锐区间，并给出 conditional neighbor bound（把低 deletion floor 与保留拟合、预测正则性、局部标签一致性联系）与精确 ridge identity（分离残差拟合与删除引起的预测变化）；实证部分做受控冗余扫描与 Materials Project 配对研究，对照近似更新与原模型。
Result: 受控冗余扫描显示删除后仍保留一个 retained relative 时中位归一化重训练损失约下降 8×；在 Materials Project 配对研究的两种拟合 regime 中，lower-floor regime 在超过 50% 的共享请求上表现出更大的 prediction change；并与 approximate updates 及原模型做了系统对照，以区分刻意 target suppression 与保留的整体模型 utility。
Conclusion: 请求级遗忘评测应把 reference loss、prediction change、retained utility 三者一起报告，用重训练本身留下的预测来解读删除后精度，而不是单看删除后误差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DR-net-Mamba: Selective State-Space Modeling for Long-Range ECG Time-Series Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings are corrupted by non-stationary noise sources that degrade diagnostic reliability, particularly in ambulatory and long-duration recordings. Deep learning denoisers exist, but convolutional architectures are limited by their receptive field, transformer-based models scale quadratically with sequence length, and diffusion-based approaches incur prohibitive inference cost. We propose a Mamba-augmented model that inserts selective state-space blocks at the convolutional bottleneck, combining local feature extraction with long-range temporal modeling at linear complexity. We comprehensively evaluate the proposed model with respect to reconstruction fidelity, noise robustness, recording-length scaling, and downstream diagnostic classification across over 40 pathology classes. On synthetic and real datasets, our model achieves the highest SNR and lowest RMSE, with the Mamba advantage increasing with sequence length and in low-SNR regimes. On classification with two independent classifiers, the proposed Mamba-based models achieve the best macro AUROC among all denoisers and improve over their convolutional base models. Calibration is more nuanced and classifier-dependent: denoising improves Binary Cross-Entropy and Brier score on Inception1D but often fails to beat the noisy input on ResNet1D-Wang, and the lead-specific Mamba variant is the only denoiser to improve both calibration metrics over the noisy baseline on both classifiers. Per-class analysis reveals a morphology-dependent benefit: Mamba substantially improves ST/T-change diagnoses, which depend on broad, context-sensitive waveforms.
papers.comment: First three authors are co-first. Last two authors are co-last
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DR-net-Mamba 在卷积瓶颈处插入选择性状态空间 (Mamba) 模块做 ECG 长程去噪，以线性复杂度兼顾局部特征与长程时序建模。在合成与真实数据上取得最高 SNR 与最低 RMSE，且序列越长、SNR 越低优势越大；在 40 余个病理类别的下游分类中取得最佳 macro AUROC，其中 lead-specific 变体是唯一在两个分类器上同时改善 BCE 与 Brier 校准的去噪器。
Motivation: ECG 受非平稳噪声污染，现有深度去噪器各有瓶颈：卷积感受野受限、transformer 随序列长度二次方增长、扩散方法推理成本过高，长程动态与长记录场景难以兼顾。
Method: 在卷积自编码器瓶颈处插入 Mamba 选择性状态空间块，把局部特征提取与线性复杂度的长程时序建模结合；从重建保真度、噪声鲁棒性、记录长度扩展性和下游诊断分类四个维度评估，并含 lead-specific 变体，用两个独立分类器 (Inception1D、ResNet1D-Wang) 检验。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上取得最高 SNR 与最低 RMSE，Mamba 优势随序列长度增加、在低 SNR 区间更明显；在 40 余个病理类别的分类中，Mamba 模型在所有去噪器里 macro AUROC 最高并优于其卷积基座。校准表现依分类器而异：Inception1D 上去噪改善 BCE 与 Brier，ResNet1D-Wang 上常不敌含噪输入；lead-specific 变体是唯一在两个分类器上同时优于含噪基线两个校准指标的去噪器。逐类分析显示 ST/T 改变类诊断获益最大。
Conclusion: 把选择性状态空间块放进卷积瓶颈能在长程 ECG 去噪上以线性复杂度换来更高保真与下游判别收益，但校准收益依赖分类器，需按分类器与病理形态分别验证。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Which the Eye Fears: Writing with Read-Blindness Explains Massive Activations in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Massive activation features (MAs) in Transformers are extreme-value residual-stream features that persist across layers despite the model's ability to suppress them. Why do they survive? Our investigation using an operator-level mechanistic analysis of attention and feed-forward (FFN) blocks reveals that these blocks systematically ignore MA coordinates while reading, but not while writing; creating a read-write asymmetry that blocks corrective feedback while allowing continued accumulation. We find that both attention and feed-forward layers have this read-blindness, and contribute to the emergence and persistence of MAs. To validate prior work that hypothesized that FFN's amplification abilities is the primary reason for MAs (Sun et al., 2026), we analyze the model checkpoints during learning. Contrary to our expectation, read-blindness emerges before FFN amplification, suggesting that it acts upstream in the MA mechanism. We further contribute gradient analysis to link this behavior to surprising asymmetries in the loss landscape, concluding that the model actively maintains this read-blindness. Finally, we find that removing read-blocking at different locations induces compensatory shifts elsewhere, but MAs still persist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用算子级机制分析解释 Transformer 中 massive activation (MA) 为何跨层存活：attention 与 FFN 在读取时系统性忽略 MA 坐标、写入时却不忽略，形成读写不对称，阻断纠正性反馈而允许持续累积。训练检查点显示 read-blindness 先于 FFN 放大出现，处于 MA 机制上游；梯度分析将其与损失景观的不对称联系起来，说明模型主动维持这种读盲性。
Motivation: MA 是残差流中跨层持续的极端值特征，而模型本有能力抑制它们却抑制不掉；此前工作（Sun et al., 2026）把成因归于 FFN 的放大能力，其因果顺序与机制来源尚不清楚。
Method: 对 attention 与 FFN 块做算子级机制分析，区分读取与写入两个方向上的行为；分析训练过程中的模型检查点以确定 read-blindness 与 FFN 放大的出现顺序；补充梯度分析关联损失景观的不对称；并在不同位置移除 read-blocking 观察补偿性转移。
Result: attention 与 FFN 均表现出 read-blindness 并共同促成 MA 的出现与持续；read-blindness 在训练中先于 FFN 放大涌现，早于 Sun et al. (2026) 假设的主因；在不同位置移除 read-blocking 会引发其他位置的补偿性转移，但 MA 仍然存活。
Conclusion: MA 的存活源于模型主动维持的读写不对称而非单纯的 FFN 放大，read-blindness 处于机制上游；单点移除读阻断不足以消除 MA，因为系统会补偿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys
papers.abstract_en: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. Remarkably, with 32 or 64 sampled teams, SANTA++ uses 16% to 22% of dense attention's KV reads and retains 94% to 99% of the dense-attention baseline's scores on LongBench v2 and HELMET's retrieval-augmented generation subset, and 85% to 91% on RULER, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context. With 31 sampled teams, our GPU implementation delivers a $1.69\times$ attention speedup over the dense FlashAttention baseline at 32K context. By reducing the number of cache entries read, SANTA++ in principle complements architectures with compressed KV representations, such as multi-head latent attention. Our kernels are available at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SANTA++ 是一种免训练的随机注意力方法：把 KV cache 的 key 分成 teams，query 只对每个 team 打一个代表分来决定采样哪些 team，在被采样 team 内算精确注意力并按入样概率倒数重加权，从而用采样预算换内存读取。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、32K 上下文下，32 或 64 个采样 team 只读 dense attention 16%–22% 的 KV，LongBench v2 与 HELMET RAG 子集保留 dense 分数的 94%–99%、RULER 保留 85%–91%；31 个 team 时 GPU 实现相对 dense FlashAttention 加速 1.69×。
Motivation: 注意力往往只集中在上下文的一小部分 token 上，且这一子集随 query 改变；逐 query 扫描整个 KV cache 的内存读取代价高，需要在不全量扫描的前提下逼近 dense attention。
Method: 免训练的随机注意力：cached keys 组织成 teams，query 对每个 team 只评一个代表 key 以决定采样哪些 team；在被采样 team 内计算精确 attention 分数，并按该 team 入样概率的倒数重加权，用重要性采样估计全 cache 的注意力，采样预算可在内存读取与精度之间权衡；并给出 GPU kernel 实现。
Result: 在 LongBench v2 与 HELMET 的 retrieval-augmented generation 子集上，32 或 64 个采样 team 用 dense attention 16%–22% 的 KV 读取，保留 dense 基线分数的 94%–99%；RULER 上保留 85%–91%（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，32K 上下文）。31 个采样 team 时 GPU 实现在 32K 上下文相对 dense FlashAttention 达到 1.69× attention 加速。
Conclusion: 按入样概率倒数重加权的 team 级重要性采样，可以在只读一小部分 KV cache 的情况下逼近 dense attention 分数并带来实际加速，且原则上可与压缩 KV 表示（如 multi-head latent attention）叠加。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 免训练的随机注意力：cached keys 组织成 teams，query 对每个 team 只评一个代表 key 以决定采样哪些 team；在被采样 team 内计算精确 attention 分数，并按该 team 入样概率的倒数重加权，用重要性采样估计全 cache 的注意力，采样预算可在内存读取与精度之间权衡；并给出 GPU kernel 实现。
summary_sections.result: 在 LongBench v2 与 HELMET 的 retrieval-augmented generation 子集上，32 或 64 个采样 team 用 dense attention 16%–22% 的 KV 读取，保留 dense 基线分数的 94%–99%；RULER 上保留 85%–91%（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，32K 上下文）。31 个采样 team 时 GPU 实现在 32K 上下文相对 dense FlashAttention 达到 1.69× attention 加速。
summary_sections.conclusion: 按入样概率倒数重加权的 team 级重要性采样，可以在只读一小部分 KV cache 的情况下逼近 dense attention 分数并带来实际加速，且原则上可与压缩 KV 表示（如 multi-head latent attention）叠加。

papers.title: Arbitrary-Accuracy Neural Approximation with Optimal Neuron Count and Near-Optimal Bit Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We study the minimum number of hidden neurons required for arbitrary-accuracy approximation of multivariate Hölder-continuous functions on $[0,1]^d$ and the associated encoding complexity. For $d\geq 2$, we construct a fixed, explicitly defined activation function for which a closed-form network with two hidden layers of widths $d$ and $1$ achieves arbitrary accuracy in the uniform norm. We prove that $d+1$ is the exact minimum total number of hidden neurons among standard feedforward networks with locally integrable activations and affine outputs. We further give a simpler construction using a single elementary activation that combines the floor and exponential functions. This construction requires three hidden layers of widths $d$, $1$, and $2$, only two neurons above the minimum. If a skip connection is allowed, widths $d$, $1$, and $1$ suffice. These constructions use explicit grid addressing and integer encoding of quantized function values. For a bounded $α$-Hölder class, they require $O(\varepsilon^{-d/α}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bits, matching the metric-entropy lower bound up to a logarithmic factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在 [0,1]^d 上逼近任意 d 元 Hölder 连续函数时，标准前馈网络（局部可积激活 + 仿射输出）的隐藏神经元总数下确界恰为 d+1，并给出显式达到该下界的构造：两层宽度 d 与 1 的闭式网络即可在一致范数下任意精度逼近。用 floor+exp 组合的初等激活需三层宽度 d、1、2（仅比下界多两个神经元），允许 skip connection 时 d、1、1 即可；量化函数值的整数编码使位复杂度为 O(ε^{-d/α} log(1/ε))，与 metric-entropy 下界只差一个对数因子。
Motivation: 神经网络逼近论中隐藏神经元最小数目与编码复杂度缺少精确刻画：已知结果多为上界或渐近阶，无法回答给定精度下最少需要多少神经元、以及存储输出需要多少比特。
Method: 对 d≥2 构造一个显式定义的固定激活函数，配两层宽度 d 与 1 的闭式网络；再给出用 floor 与 exp 组合的单一初等激活的更简构造（三层宽度 d、1、2，允许 skip connection 时 d、1、1）。构造采用显式网格寻址 (grid addressing) 与量化函数值的整数编码，并对有界 α-Hölder 类分析位复杂度。
Result: 证明 d+1 是标准前馈网络（局部可积激活、仿射输出）逼近 d 元 Hölder 函数的精确最小隐藏神经元总数（d≥2）；两层宽度 d 与 1 的构造在一致范数下达到任意精度；初等激活构造三层宽度 d、1、2，仅比下界多两个神经元；位复杂度 O(ε^{-d/α} log(1/ε))，与 metric-entropy 下界只差一个对数因子。
Conclusion: 任意精度逼近多变量 Hölder 函数所需的隐藏神经元可以精确到 d+1，且编码复杂度在忽略对数因子意义下达到信息论下界；额外的 skip connection 能把初等激活构造压到仅比下界多一个神经元的宽度配置。

papers.title: RIDE: Reference-Anchored Inference-Time Diffusion Editing for Scaffold Hopping
papers.abstract_en: Scaffold hopping is a critical task in drug discovery, which seeks to discover new, structurally distinct molecules that share key functional groups and similar 3D shape with a reference binding ligand. Existing diffusion-based scaffold hopping methods formulate the problem as conditional generation of scaffolds given the functional groups. However, they lack a principled mechanism to jointly enforce 2D structural novelty and preserve the 3D shape of the reference ligand. Here, we introduce RIDE, a Reference-anchored Inference-time Diffusion Editing framework for scaffold hopping. RIDE recovers the reference diffusion noise trajectory conditioned on the binding pocket and functional groups, selects an optimal trajectory segment for editing via noise perturbation, and conducts a value-guided scaffold sampling to generate new scaffolds. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that, compared to baselines, RIDE consistently generates scaffolds with lower 2D similarity and higher 3D similarity to the reference, with an average improvements of 11.7% and 7.3%, respectively. Further analysis reveals that RIDE can accommodate various reward functions, and can preserve 3D similarity even when this is not explicitly included in the reward. Two case studies illustrate RIDE's ability to generate distinct scaffolds with different structures and properties, and its ability to introduce substantial 2D variation while maintaining very high 3D similarity. RIDE is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RIDE-C8A0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIDE 是面向药物发现骨架跃迁 (scaffold hopping) 的参考锚定推理时扩散编辑框架：在结合口袋与官能团条件下恢复参考配体的扩散噪声轨迹，选一段最优轨迹做噪声扰动编辑，再用价值引导采样生成新骨架。相比基线，生成骨架的 2D 相似度平均降低 11.7%、与参考配体的 3D 相似度平均提高 7.3%。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的骨架跃迁方法只能以官能团为条件生成骨架，缺少同时保证 2D 结构新颖性并保留参考配体 3D 形状的原理性机制。
Method: RIDE 在结合口袋与官能团条件下恢复参考配体的扩散噪声轨迹，通过噪声扰动选出最优轨迹段进行编辑，再执行价值引导 (value-guided) 的骨架采样；框架可兼容多种奖励函数。
Result: 相比基线，RIDE 生成骨架的 2D 相似度更低、与参考的 3D 相似度更高，平均改善分别为 11.7% 与 7.3%；即使奖励函数中不含 3D 相似度项，仍能保持 3D 相似度；两个案例研究展示了在引入大幅 2D 变化的同时维持极高 3D 相似度。
Conclusion: 在推理时锚定参考噪声轨迹并做价值引导编辑，可以在骨架跃迁中同时推进 2D 新颖性与 3D 形状保持，且对奖励函数设计不敏感。

papers.title: Elicitation and Decision Geometry in Single-Index Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study two-arm contextual bandits with arm-specific single indices and a shared unknown monotone link. Monotonicity makes the optimal action depend only on the contrast between the index directions, hence arm-specific reward functions need not be estimated. We introduce Natural Boundary Learning (NBL), a greedy procedure that uses a sequential Stein contrast to learn the optimal boundary directly, without estimating the reward functions or the common link. We characterize the local Riemannian dynamics of NBL through a decision stability coefficient balancing arm separation, link geometry, and the context distribution. We show that this stability is connected to the elicitation geometry of the underlying convex potential. Under local decision stability, NBL contracts toward the optimal boundary and achieves $O(\log n)$ expected regret. Numerical experiments illustrate the predicted stability regimes and compare NBL with a parametric greedy benchmark under link misspecification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两臂上下文 bandit 中各臂有独立 single index、共享未知单调 link 时，最优动作只取决于两个 index 方向的对比，因此无需估计奖励函数。提出 Natural Boundary Learning (NBL)：用序列 Stein 对比直接贪心学习最优决策边界，并以 decision stability coefficient（权衡臂分离、link 几何与上下文分布）刻画局部 Riemannian 动力学；在局部决策稳定下 NBL 向最优边界收缩并取得 O(log n) 期望后悔。
Motivation: 臂专属奖励函数加共享单调 link 的设定下，直接估计奖励与 link 冗余且在 link 误设时脆弱，需要一条只学决策边界的路径并给出其稳定性条件。
Method: NBL 是贪心过程，用 sequential Stein contrast 直接学习最优边界，不估计奖励函数与公共 link；以 decision stability coefficient 刻画局部 Riemannian 动力学，并把该稳定性与底层凸势的 elicitation geometry 联系起来；数值实验检验预测的稳定域并与 parametric greedy benchmark 在 link 误设下对比。
Result: 在局部决策稳定条件下 NBL 向最优边界收缩，期望后悔为 O(log n)；数值实验展示了所预测的稳定域，并在 link misspecification 下将 NBL 与 parametric greedy benchmark 作比较。
Conclusion: 单调性把两臂上下文 bandit 化简为学边界问题，决策稳定性由臂分离、link 几何与上下文分布共同决定，且与凸势的 elicitation 几何相连，稳定时可得对数级后悔。

papers.title: Cartridges++: KV Cache Compression without Off-Context Derailment
papers.abstract_en: Serving long documents to a Large Language Model (LLM) repeatedly is expensive: computations grow with context length, and the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache balloons. Compressed KV (CKV) representations aim to mimic the cache of a document and are typically computed once and for all, ahead of inference time. Methods to obtain CKVs range from drop mechanisms that reduce their number of columns, to learned approaches. Among the latter, Cartridges have emerged as a leading compression method, learning compact KV representations through distillation on relevant Q/A pairs. While existing evaluations focus primarily on whether Cartridges and other CKVs yield approximately similar responses to document-related, on-context queries, we investigate the crucial deployment question of whether they can handle off-context queries, something the native KV representation is particularly good at, thanks to the mechanics of attention. We observe a fundamental trade-off: while Cartridges perform better for on-context queries, heuristic-variants preserve better the original LLM's ability to operate off-context. We measure this through their capability to avoid context contamination in their response, retain general knowledge, and follow instructions. We propose Cartridges++, simple modifications to cartridges that retain off-context abilities at small or negligible cost. The router variant decides at inference time whether the query should use the learned long-context memory, while the data-mixing variant allocates a small fraction of training Q/As to queries outside the reference long document. Our study shows that assessing CKVs on document utility alone can mask substantial degradation in broader model capabilities, yet those issues can be fixed with benign changes to CKV inference or training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cartridges++ 用两个轻量改动修复压缩 KV (CKV) 的 off-context 能力退化：router 变体在推理时判断查询该走学习到的长文档记忆还是原模型，data-mixing 变体把一小部分训练 Q/A 分给文档之外的查询。作者发现 Cartridges 在 on-context 查询上更好，而启发式变体更能保留原 LLM 的 off-context 能力，且这些修复代价很小或可忽略。
Motivation: 长文档反复送入 LLM 时计算随上下文长度增长、KV cache 占用膨胀，CKV 压缩方法（如 Cartridges）的评测几乎只看文档内查询的回答是否近似，忽略了部署中更关键的 off-context 查询能力。
Method: Cartridges 通过在相关 Q/A 对上蒸馏学习紧凑 KV 表示；Cartridges++ 在其上做两处简单修改——推理期 router 决定是否使用学习到的长上下文记忆，data-mixing 把少量训练 Q/A 分配给参考长文档之外的查询。评测维度为避免上下文污染、保留通用知识、遵循指令三方面。
Result: 观察到一个基本权衡：Cartridges 在 on-context 查询上表现更好，启发式变体则更好地保留原 LLM 的 off-context 能力。仅按文档效用评估 CKV 会掩盖更广泛模型能力的显著退化，而这些退化可用对 CKV 推理或训练的良性改动修复。
Conclusion: 只用文档内效用评估 CKV 会掩盖通用能力的实质退化，但该问题可通过推理期路由或训练数据混合这类代价很小的改动修复。

papers.title: Attention Graphons: A Graph Limit Perspective on Graph Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Graph Transformers produce, for each attention head, a dense $n\times n$ matrix of learned pairwise interactions. We ask a fundamental question: do these attention-induced graphs converge to a stable limit object as $n$ grows, or does the learned interaction pattern remain unstructured and size-dependent? We answer this using dense graph limit theory, treating each attention matrix as a finite sample from an underlying kernel---an \emph{attention graphon}---and studying concentration around this limit under the cut-distance. We derive a worst-case variance bound requiring no assumptions on the graphon, and a sharper regularity-aware bound based on nonparametric estimation theory. To operationalize the theory, we propose a canonicalize-then-block-average pipeline for estimating dataset-level attention graphons, and a variance-based diagnostic for testing whether attention admits a stable continuum description. Experiments across multiple graph benchmarks show that learned attention stabilizes to dataset-specific graphon structure on several datasets; that empirical cut-distance and cut-norm variance decreases with $n$ consistent with our bounds; and that attention graphons transfer to larger graph sizes with error decreasing in $n$.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在多个图基准上的实验显示：学到的注意力在若干数据集上稳定到数据集特定的 graphon 结构；经验 cut-distance 与 cut-norm 方差随 n 增大而下降，与推导的界一致；attention graphon 可迁移到更大图规模，误差随 n 减小。

papers.title: From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness
papers.abstract_en: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. We extend Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions (behavioural, computational, intrinsic causal-structural, organismic, and organism-environment) grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability. The major theories of consciousness are positioned within this hierarchy according to which level they take to be critical, and for each level we develop operationalisable indicators and assess current AI systems against them. A Bayesian model then combines theoretical credences with indicator evidence into an overall credence in a system's capacity for consciousness. In illustrative assessments, the verdict for current LLMs is driven as much by where theoretical credence is placed as by how the evidence is read: under different stipulated readings and credence distributions, assessments range from below 0.01 to roughly 0.8, showing sensitivity to assumptions. Finally, the consciousness indicators at each level closely overlap with the architectural features needed for general intelligence, suggesting that increasingly capable AI may become a stronger candidate for consciousness. The framework supports a structured agnosticism, in which theoretical commitments are made explicit, credences are updated as evidence accumulates, and assessments take the form of aggregated probabilities rather than verdicts.
papers.comment: 150 pages, 43 figures, 6 tables. Interactive tool: https://ai-cognition.org/cacophony-tool/ ; code: https://github.com/arvomm/cacophony-public-code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把意识的 hard problem 与 mapping problem 分离，在承认经验随系统组织实现（supervenience）的前提下，将 Marr 三层扩展为五层功能描述层级（行为、计算、内在因果-结构、有机体、有机体-环境），把各主要意识理论定位到相应层级并为每层给出可操作指标，再用 Bayesian 模型把理论 credence 与指标证据合成对系统意识能力的总体 credence。对当前 LLM 的示例评估在不同读法与 credence 分布下从低于 0.01 到约 0.8，结论是判定高度依赖假设；各层意识指标与通用智能所需架构特征高度重叠，故能力更强的 AI 可能成为更强的意识候选。
Motivation: AI 意识研究被彼此互不对话的竞争理论拖住：各理论在不同描述粒度上争论，缺少统一框架把理论承诺与经验证据分开评估。
Method: 先区分 hard problem 与 mapping problem，搁置最深的形而上学分歧；以 supervenience、coarse-graining 与 multiple realisability 为基础把 Marr 三层扩展为五层功能描述层级，将主要意识理论按其关键层级定位，为每层开发可操作指标并据此评估当前 AI 系统；最后用 Bayesian 模型把理论 credence 与指标证据合成为总体意识能力 credence。
Result: 在示例评估中，当前 LLM 的判定既取决于理论 credence 放在哪里，也取决于证据如何读取：在不同规定读法与 credence 分布下，评估结果从低于 0.01 到约 0.8。各层意识指标与通用智能所需架构特征高度重叠。
Conclusion: 作者主张结构化的不可知论（structured agnosticism）：显式声明理论承诺、随证据累积更新 credence、以聚合概率而非裁决形式给出评估；并暗示能力更强的 AI 可能成为更强的意识候选。

papers.title: EvolvingAvatar: Interactive 3D Head Generation That Adapts as Conversations Unfold
papers.abstract_en: Interactive 3D head generation requires coordinated speaking and listening motion that responds to an evolving conversation. Existing generators use incoming observations as context but keep their parameters fixed, leaving conversational patterns unused as a learning signal. We introduce EvolvingAvatar, a causal generator that uses test-time training to adapt to user face video and dyadic audio during interaction. Its dyadic context prediction objective provides a self-supervised learning signal from audiovisual context without target motion labels at test time. Persistent fast weights accumulate these updates within each conversation to guide motion generation, while transient jaw adaptation responds to current audiovisual context. Predicted speech activity controls how persistent adaptation guides motion. We also introduce InterHead-Bench, a unified 455.95-hour benchmark built from single-view and dual-view conversation videos. Experiments show improved conversational motion statistics over strong baselines. On the hardest out-of-distribution split, generation improves as conversations unfold, reducing mismatch with recorded user-avatar expression statistics by up to 11.1% from the first interval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvolvingAvatar 是一个因果式 3D 头像生成器，在交互过程中用 test-time training 适配用户人脸视频与双人音频：以 dyadic context prediction 作为无目标动作标签的自监督信号，用 persistent fast weights 累积会话内更新、transient jaw adaptation 响应当前上下文，并由预测的语音活动决定持久适配如何引导动作。在最难的 out-of-distribution 划分上，随对话推进生成质量提升，与录制的用户-头像表情统计的失配相比第一个时间区间最多降低 11.1%。
Motivation: 现有交互式 3D 头像生成器把输入观测当上下文但参数固定，对话中累积的会话模式没有被当作学习信号，导致说话/倾听动作难以随对话演化。
Method: 因果生成器在测试时用 dyadic context prediction 目标从视听上下文自监督适配（无需目标动作标签）；persistent fast weights 在单次对话内累积更新以指导动作生成，transient jaw adaptation 处理当前视听上下文，预测的语音活动 (speech activity) 控制持久适配的作用方式。配套提出 InterHead-Bench，由单视角与双视角对话视频构成的统一基准。
Result: InterHead-Bench 总量 455.95 小时，覆盖单视角与双视角对话视频；实验显示对话动作统计优于强基线；在最难的 out-of-distribution 划分上，生成随对话推进而改善，与录制的用户-头像表情统计失配相比第一个时间区间最多减少 11.1%。
Conclusion: 把对话过程中的视听上下文当作测试时学习信号、用 fast weights 跨时间区间累积，可让 3D 头像动作随对话展开而持续逼近真实用户表情统计，尤其在分布外场景。

papers.title: Behavioral Foundation Models for Quality Diversity
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) are an emerging paradigm in reinforcement learning, playing a role analogous to large language models in natural language processing: they have shown remarkable versatility, enabling zero-shot performance, fast imitation, and online adaptation, all by exploiting the structure of a latent space. In this work, we investigate whether the latent behavioral space induced by BFMs can serve as an effective search space to discover large repertoires of behaviorally diverse and high-performing policies through Quality-Diversity (QD) methods. While QD methods generally search directly in high-dimensional policy parameter space, in this paper, we present BFM-QD, a framework that performs QD search in the compact latent space of a BFM. We further show that the BFM-QD framework provides a closed-form, gradient-free policy improvement operator that approximates a policy gradient update, but requires no critic training and no backpropagation. Across continuous-control benchmarks spanning dense locomotion, sparse navigation, and contact-rich manipulation, BFM-QD consistently outperforms parameter-space baselines, with particularly stark gains in sparse and deceptive settings, where all tested parameter-space QD methods collapse to near-zero performance. These results show the effectiveness of the BFM-QD framework, benefiting from the synergy between dimensionality reduction of the search space and offline pretraining from diverse behavioral data. This positions BFMs as a general-purpose backbone for QD optimization, extending their utility beyond zero-shot task solving to the discovery of diverse behavioral repertoires.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BFM-QD 把 Quality-Diversity 搜索从高维策略参数空间搬到行为基础模型 (Behavioral Foundation Model) 的紧凑潜在空间，并给出一个闭式、免梯度的策略改进算子，近似一次 policy gradient 更新而无需 critic 训练与反向传播。在覆盖密集运动、稀疏导航与接触丰富操作的连续控制基准上，它一致优于参数空间基线；在稀疏且具欺骗性的设定中，所有被测参数空间 QD 方法都塌缩到接近零性能。
Motivation: QD 方法通常直接在高维策略参数空间搜索，维度灾难使其在稀疏、欺骗性奖励下难以发现高性能且行为多样的策略库。
Method: BFM-QD 在 BFM 由离线多样行为数据预训练得到的潜在行为空间中执行 QD 搜索，并利用该框架提供闭式、免梯度的策略改进算子来近似 policy gradient 更新，省去 critic 训练与反向传播。
Result: 在密集运动、稀疏导航、接触丰富操作三类连续控制基准上，BFM-QD 一致优于参数空间 QD 基线；在稀疏与欺骗性设定中提升尤其显著，所有被测参数空间 QD 方法塌缩到接近零性能。
Conclusion: 降维后的潜在搜索空间与离线多样行为预训练的协同，使 BFM 成为 QD 优化的通用骨干，其用途从零样本任务求解扩展到发现多样行为库。

papers.title: EvE: An Alternate Optimizer to Adam
papers.abstract_en: Adam and its variants dominate neural network training, but a single run only reveals whether a configuration works well after most of its budget is spent, a poor fit for hyperparameter or architecture search, where configurations must be ranked cheaply and pruned early. We introduce EvE (Evolutionary Explorer), a steady-state, population-of-four differential evolution (DE) optimizer with a targeted Adam fallback: each iteration proposes one candidate via DE, running a short burst of gradient descent only if the DE step fails to improve on the incumbent. Selection is greedy, so on a deterministic objective the best-so-far value is provably monotone non-increasing, and since gradients are used only as a targeted rescue, per-iteration cost stays within a constant factor of a single Adam step regardless of dimension. Under a fixed, evaluation-cost-matched budget, EvE wins or ties Adam on 76% of 70 (problem, dimension) cells across seven scalable benchmarks up to one million variables. On three real neural-network tasks (an MLP on MNIST, and LoRA fine-tuning of a 1.5B-parameter language model on two datasets) EvE finishes the same charged budget 1.7-3.9x faster, at a modest cost in final quality (about one accuracy point on MNIST, 9-11% higher relative test loss on the two fine-tuning tasks; on GSM8K, Adam is about 5 accuracy points more accurate, and fine-tuning lowers accuracy below the base model for both). Inside successive halving on UCI Adult, EvE completes hyperparameter and architecture searches 3.1-3.5x faster, ranking configurations about as consistently with Adam as Adam does with itself across seeds (Kendall's tau 0.66-0.69). EvE is not a total replacement for Adam as a final-stage trainer, but a fast, gradient-aware proxy for the search-heavy, budget-constrained regime one level up.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvE (Evolutionary Explorer) 用种群为 4 的稳态差分进化 (DE) 每轮提出一个候选，仅当 DE 步不如现任解时才触发一次短程梯度下降作为定向回退，从而在固定评估成本预算下廉价排序配置。在 7 个可扩展基准、最多 100 万变量的 70 个 (问题, 维度) 格子上，EvE 以 76% 胜或平 Adam；在 MNIST MLP 与 1.5B 参数模型 LoRA 微调上同预算快 1.7–3.9 倍，代价是最终质量略降。作者的定位是：EvE 不取代 Adam 做最终训练，而是搜索密集、预算受限阶段的快速梯度感知代理。
Motivation: 单次 Adam 训练只有在预算花掉大半后才知道配置好坏，不适合超参或架构搜索这种需要廉价排序并尽早剪枝的场景。
Method: EvE 是稳态、种群为 4 的差分进化 (DE) 优化器，每轮用 DE 提出一个候选，仅当 DE 步未能改进现任解时才跑一小段梯度下降 (targeted Adam fallback)；选择是贪心的，梯度只作定向救援，使每轮开销相对单步 Adam 保持常数因子。
Result: 在评估成本对齐的固定预算下，EvE 在 7 个可扩展基准、最多 100 万变量的 70 个 (问题, 维度) 格子上 76% 胜或平 Adam。三个真实神经网络任务 (MNIST 上的 MLP，1.5B 参数语言模型在两个数据集上的 LoRA 微调) 中，EvE 同一计费预算快 1.7–3.9 倍，代价是 MNIST 约 1 个准确率点、两个微调任务相对测试损失高 9–11%；GSM8K 上 Adam 准确率高约 5 个点，且两种方法微调后准确率都低于 base model。在 UCI Adult 的 successive halving 内，EvE 完成超参与架构搜索快 3.1–3.5 倍，配置排序与 Adam 的一致性约等于 Adam 自身跨种子的一致性 (Kendall's tau 0.66–0.69)。

papers.title: Remote Sensing Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Depth Image-Based Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing novel view synthesis under sparse observations remains challenging due to insufficient geometric constraints and limited cross-view supervision. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods are prone to overfitting and face challenges of depth ambiguities, missing cross-view information, and insufficient constraints in under-observed regions. To address these challenges, we propose DIBR-GS, a neural Gaussian Splatting framework that exploits Depth Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) to generate pseudo views for cross-view consistency supervision. Specifically, reliable geometric initialization is constructed by aligning monocular depth priors with sparse SfM reconstruction, and cross-view appearance priors are incorporated into neural Gaussian representations to enhance appearance modeling under sparse observations. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive DIBR-based pseudo-view supervision strategy to provide additional geometric and appearance constraints, enabling more complete reconstruction of weakly observed regions. In addition, a height-constrained anchor growth strategy is designed to suppress unreasonable Gaussian expansion. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance over existing approaches when training with only 3 input views. Compared with the previous best-performing method, it improves PSNR by 6.83 dB, with relative gains of 14\% in SSIM and 60\% in LPIPS, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIBR-GS 用 Depth Image-Based Rendering 从稀疏视角生成伪视角，为遥感新视角合成补上跨视角一致性监督。仅用 3 张输入视角训练时，相比此前最佳方法 PSNR 提升 6.83 dB，SSIM 相对提升 14%，LPIPS 相对提升 60%，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率。
Motivation: 遥感稀疏视角下几何约束不足、跨视角监督有限，现有 NeRF 与 3DGS 易过拟合，并受深度歧义、缺失跨视角信息和欠观测区域约束不足困扰。
Method: DIBR-GS 框架：将单目深度先验与稀疏 SfM 重建对齐以构造可靠几何初始化；把跨视角外观先验注入神经高斯表示；用渐进式 DIBR 伪视角监督补充几何与外观约束；再加高度约束的 anchor 增长策略抑制高斯不合理扩张。
Result: 仅用 3 个输入视角训练时优于现有方法：相比此前最佳方法 PSNR 提升 6.83 dB，SSIM 相对增益 14%，LPIPS 相对增益 60%，并保持有竞争力的计算效率。
Conclusion: 以 DIBR 伪视角加几何/外观先验的组合可在极稀疏（3 视角）遥感观测下显著改善新视角合成质量，且不牺牲计算效率。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editing has achieved strong performance in single-turn settings, yet practical editing is often iterative, with each instruction applied to the output of the previous turn. We find that existing editing models degrade rapidly under recursive editing and attribute this failure to a train-test mismatch in the conditioning distribution: models are trained on clean source images but must repeatedly condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference time. To address this, we propose MT-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that trains the model on self-generated conditioning states with editing supervision from a clean-conditioned teacher, without requiring multi-turn annotations. We further introduce LME-Bench, a benchmark of 100 ten-turn editing sessions for evaluating long-horizon robustness. Experiments across three editing backbones show that MT-OPSD substantially improves long-horizon editing success and reduces multi-turn collapse while largely preserving single-turn editing quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MT-OPSD 用 on-policy 自蒸馏解决多轮指令图像编辑中的递归退化：训练时让模型以自己生成的中间结果为条件，用干净条件下的 teacher 提供编辑监督，无需多轮标注数据。作者提出含 100 个十轮编辑会话的 LME-Bench，跨三个编辑 backbone 的实验显示长时程编辑成功率显著提升、多轮崩溃减少，同时基本保持单轮编辑质量。
Motivation: 指令式图像编辑在单轮上已很强，但实际编辑是逐轮迭代的：模型训练时吃干净源图，推理时却要反复以自己不完美的输出为条件，导致递归编辑下性能快速退化。
Method: MT-OPSD（on-policy self-distillation）在自生成的条件状态上训练模型，编辑监督来自一个以干净图像为条件的 teacher，因而不需要多轮编辑标注；配套提出 LME-Bench，含 100 个十轮编辑会话用于评测长时程鲁棒性。
Result: 跨三个编辑 backbone 的实验中，MT-OPSD 显著提升长时程（十轮）编辑成功率、减少多轮崩溃，同时大体保持单轮编辑质量；评测基于 LME-Bench 的 100 个十轮编辑会话。
Conclusion: 多轮编辑崩溃的根因是条件分布上的训练-测试不匹配，在自生成条件状态上做自蒸馏即可修复，且不必牺牲单轮能力。

papers.title: Twist, Don't Tilt: Trajectory-Exact Constrained Decoding for Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Constrained decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) aims to ensure that generated outputs satisfy a specified structure or syntax constraint. MDLMs generate outputs by repeatedly unmasking masked positions present in their current state. Recent strategies for constrained decoding constrain the model's per-step mean-field posterior (which factorizes over masked positions) by enforcing the desired constraint with an automaton. The resulting chain-structured factor graph allows exact constrained sampling via dynamic programming. However, despite each draw being exact and constraint-satisfying, we prove that their composition, in general, tilts away from the model's relative probabilities over valid trajectories, thus leading to trajectory bias. We derive an exact expression for this bias as a product of ratios measuring how valid continuation mass changes when the denoiser is reconditioned, and characterize when the bias vanishes. We then correct the bias by introducing TWISTER, the first automaton-twisted Sequential Monte Carlo decoder for MDLMs, using the step-exact decoder as the proposal. We show that for regular language constraints, the Feynman-Kac correction is exactly computable, with the twists obtained efficiently using quantities pre-computed for step-exact sampling. We prove that the resulting Feynman-Kac model targets the unbiased Doob h-transformed path law conditioned on constraint satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MDLM 约束解码中，逐步对 per-step mean-field 后验做自动机约束虽每步采样精确且满足约束，但其复合会偏离模型在合法轨迹上的相对概率（trajectory bias）。作者给出该偏差的精确表达式（去噪器重条件化时合法延续质量变化之比的乘积）并刻画其消失条件，随后提出 TWISTER：以 step-exact 解码器为 proposal 的自动机扭曲 Sequential Monte Carlo 解码器，对正则语言约束其 Feynman-Kac 修正可精确计算，且目标为无偏的 Doob h-transformed path law。
Motivation: 现有 MDLM 约束解码策略只保证单步采样精确且满足约束，但逐步约束的复合会系统性扭曲合法轨迹之间的相对概率，导致生成分布有偏。
Method: 先证明逐步约束的组合会倾斜模型在合法轨迹上的相对概率，并推导偏差的精确表达式与消失条件；再提出 TWISTER，用自动机扭曲的 Sequential Monte Carlo 解码器纠正偏差，以 step-exact 解码器作为 proposal，正则语言约束下用 step-exact 预计算量高效得到 twist。
Result: 证明了逐步精确且满足约束的采样复合一般会偏离合法轨迹的相对概率（trajectory bias），给出偏差作为重条件化下合法延续质量比值乘积的精确表达式及其消失条件；证明 TWISTER 的 Feynman-Kac 模型以无偏的、以约束满足为条件的 Doob h-transformed path law 为目标。
Conclusion: 逐步约束解码的精确性不等于轨迹层面的无偏性，需用 Feynman-Kac/SMC 修正才能恢复对合法轨迹的无偏采样。

papers.title: Simultaneous Translation between Sign Languages
papers.abstract_en: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted. Live use cases - e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls - instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing. We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign-to-sign (S2S) translation system, with two wait-k regimes: test-time wait-k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait-k model via stochastic multi-path supervision. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL, a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output. Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline. A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages - a consequence of simultaneous translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个手语到手语的同声翻译 (simultaneous sign-to-sign translation) 系统，用两种 wait-k 策略——对全句模型做测试时 wait-k 推理，以及经随机多路径监督 (stochastic multi-path supervision) 训练的 wait-k 模型——在源手语者仍在打的同时输出目标手语，并新定义计算感知延迟指标 ca-Stream-AL。在六个 S2S 方向、人工校验测试集与较大合成语料上，流式系统相对全句基线把 ca-Stream-AL 降低 38%，代价是 DTW-PA-MPJPE 上升不超过 9%、BLEU-4 下降 2.1。
Motivation: 现有手语到手语翻译系统都是离线的，必须等源视频播完才输出，无法支撑直播解说、双向视频通话等需要边签边译的实时场景。
Method: 两条 wait-k 路线：一是对全句模型直接做测试时 wait-k 推理，二是用随机多路径监督训练 wait-k 模型；同时提出 ca-Stream-AL，一个把计算开销计入的流式输出延迟指标；并用词序案例研究考察不同手语间词序差异在同声翻译下的处理。
Result: 在六个 S2S 方向、人工校验测试集与较大合成 S2S 语料上平均：ca-Stream-AL 相对全句基线降低 38%，同时 DTW-PA-MPJPE 增幅控制在 9% 以内，BLEU-4 下降 2.1。
Conclusion: 手语同声翻译可以在可接受的质量与时延代价内做到边签边译，wait-k 是可行的流式范式，代价由 BLEU-4 与姿态误差的有限退化体现。

papers.title: TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.
