papers.title: Control-Geometry Straightening for Sampling-Based Latent Planning
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures enable planning with latent world models, but accurate transition prediction alone does not ensure that the planning objective is easy to optimize. We introduce Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS), a single auxiliary loss that learns planner-friendly representations by directly straightening control geometry for sampling-efficient planning. CGS matches pairwise cosine similarities among actions to those among corresponding latent differences only using local transitions from pixel-action pairs. The loss can be applied across world-model architectures using end-to-end learned or pretrained representations. Under linear-dynamics, our theoretical analysis connects this objective to temporal straightening and more balanced terminal-cost curvature across the full planning horizon, yielding finite-budget guarantees for MPPI, local contraction results for CEM, and convergence bounds for gradient descent. Across four control environments and multiple planners, CGS improves planning with fewer sampled candidates and refinement steps, achieving success-rate gains up to 20 and 12.6 percentage points over LeWorldModel (LeWM) and its temporal-straightening variant (LeWM+TS), respectively, with sampling-based planners using 128 candidates per update. Probes, comparisons with DINO-WM architecture, and planner-side ablations clarify how latent motion organization, state dependence, and dynamical context shape planning behavior. Straightening control geometry thus makes good action sequences easier to find under limited planning budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单一辅助损失 Control-Geometry Straightening (CGS)，把动作两两余弦相似度与对应 latent 差分的相似度对齐，仅用像素-动作局部转移即可让控制几何变直、规划目标更易优化。在四个控制环境与多种采样规划器下，每轮仅采 128 个候选时成功率较 LeWM 最多提升 20 个百分点、较 LeWM+TS 提升 12.6 个百分点。
Motivation: JEPA 类 latent world model 里转移预测准并不等于规划目标好优化；在有限规划预算下，采样式规划器难以找到好的动作序列。
Method: CGS 作为单个辅助损失，用局部像素-动作转移匹配动作间余弦相似度与对应 latent 差分相似度，可套用于端到端学习或预训练表征及不同 world-model 架构；在线性动力学下把该目标与 temporal straightening 及整个规划时域上更均匀的终端代价曲率联系起来。
Result: 在四个控制环境、多个规划器、每轮 128 个采样候选的设置下，成功率较 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 最多提升 20 个百分点，较其 temporal-straightening 变体 (LeWM+TS) 提升 12.6 个百分点，且所需采样候选与精调步数更少；理论部分给出 MPPI 的有限预算保证、CEM 的局部收敛结果与梯度下降的收敛界。
Conclusion: 在有限规划预算下，把 latent 中的控制几何拉直就能让好的动作序列更容易被找到，且该辅助损失可跨 world-model 架构与规划器复用。

papers.title: Signatures of semantic search in the activations of large language models
papers.abstract_en: When recalling lists of concepts (e.g., animals) during the semantic fluency task (SFT), both humans and large language models (LLMs) organise their output into clusters of related items (e.g., sea animals) that are punctuated by strategic switches between clusters. In humans, this pattern can be explained by a semantic foraging process, whereby distinct neural and behavioural signatures accompany within-cluster production ("exploit") and between-cluster switching ("explore"). Whether LLMs likewise represent these two search regimes within their internal states is unknown. Here, we apply a range of mechanistic interpretability techniques to provide evidence for this. In Study 1, we use the Jacobian lens (J-lens), which maps intermediate-layer residual-stream representations to token-level activations, to show that concept-level activations predict switching. First, we find that switching coincides with low next-token activations. Moreover, the probability of switching rises as the set of strongest J-lens activations (the J-space) becomes depleted of items from the category currently being produced, analogous to explore-exploit decision-making during patch foraging. We then show that middle-layer J-lens activations of abstract category-related labels (e.g., "water") increase in anticipation of switching into that category. We confirm these representations to causally influence switching by deriving steering vectors that target category switching. In Study 2, we identify generic residual stream directions that are activated during and in anticipation of switching. By steering activations along these directions, we bias increased or decreased rates of switching. Our study extends the semantic foraging framework to artificial intelligences and provides evidence that LLMs maintain distinct representational signatures for exploration and exploitation as they verbalise conceptual information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用语义流畅性任务 (SFT) 检验 LLM 是否像人类一样在概念列举中区分“利用”与“探索”两种搜索状态：J-lens 把中间层 residual stream 映射到 token 级激活，显示切换概率随当前类别在 J-space 中被耗尽而上升，且针对类别切换的 steering vector 能因果地改变切换率。结论是 LLM 在口述概念信息时确实维持探索与利用的分离表征签名。
Motivation: 人类语义流畅性中的簇内产出与簇间切换可由语义觅食 (semantic foraging) 解释，但 LLM 内部状态是否同样表征这两种搜索 regime 尚不清楚。
Method: Study 1 用 J-lens 将中间层 residual stream 表征映射到 token 级激活，考察概念级激活与切换的关系，并推导针对类别切换的 steering vector 做因果干预；Study 2 识别切换期间及切换前被激活的通用 residual stream 方向，沿这些方向 steering 激活以增减切换率。
Result: 切换与低 next-token 激活同时出现；当 J-space 中最强激活逐渐耗尽当前正在产出类别的条目时，切换概率上升，类似 patch foraging 中的 explore-exploit 决策；中间层对抽象类别标签（如 "water"）的 J-lens 激活在切换进入该类别之前升高；steering vector 与 residual stream 方向可因果地提高或降低切换率。
Conclusion: LLM 在口述概念信息时维持探索与利用的分离表征签名，语义觅食框架可扩展到人工智能系统。

papers.title: Learning Conditional Expectation Operators via Functional Newton Updates
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Functional Spectral-Newton Method (FSNM) for learning the leading singular structure of a conditional expectation operator without fixing a basis or reproducing kernel Hilbert space. FSNM fits a low-rank representation of the centered joint-to-product density ratio kernel by alternating functional Newton updates. Each update reduces to a preconditioned regression, which we approximate with vector-valued regression trees in a stagewise boosting procedure. At the population level, we establish descent and an $O(1/T)$ best-iterate block-stationarity rate under a relative weak-learner accuracy condition, and show that every nondegenerate local minimum over the full centered $L^2$ spaces is a globally optimal rank-$d$ approximation. Synthetic experiments show that FSNM recovers a low-rank density ratio and its leading spectral structure, and that the same learned kernel can answer multiple conditional queries without refitting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Functional Spectral-Newton Method (FSNM)，在不固定基或 RKHS 的前提下，用交替 functional Newton 更新学习条件期望算子的主奇异结构，每次更新化为预条件回归并用向量值回归树的 stagewise boosting 近似。在 population 层面证明 O(1/T) 的 best-iterate block-stationarity 速率，并证明中心化 L² 空间上每个非退化局部极小都是全局最优 rank-d 逼近；合成实验中恢复低秩密度比与主谱结构，同一学到的核可直接回答多种条件查询而无需重拟合。
Motivation: 学习条件期望算子的低秩结构通常要预先固定基或 RKHS，限制了表示的灵活性；且密度比核往往需针对每个条件查询重复拟合。
Method: FSNM 拟合中心化 joint-to-product 密度比核的低秩表示，交替执行 functional Newton 更新；每次更新化为预条件回归，用向量值回归树 (vector-valued regression trees) 的 stagewise boosting 近似求解。
Result: Population 层面在相对弱学习器精度条件下证明下降性与 O(1/T) 的 best-iterate block-stationarity 速率；证明中心化 L² 空间上每个非退化局部极小都是全局最优 rank-d 逼近。合成实验中 FSNM 恢复低秩密度比及其主谱结构，同一学到的核可回答多种条件查询而无需重拟合。
Conclusion: 交替 functional Newton 更新加 boosting 回归可在不固定基或 RKHS 的情况下学习条件期望算子的主奇异结构，且一次拟合的核可复用于多种条件查询。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SEABench: Benchmarking Endogenous Misalignment In Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving LLM agents have gained prominence for their ability to improve after deployment by modifying their harness, including their controller instructions, memory management protocols, and reusable tools and skills, in response to user and environment feedback. However, locally useful updates may persist into later tasks where they produce unsafe behavior, even without direct adversarial influence. To study this risk, we introduce SEABench, a benchmark for studying endogenous misalignment arising from agent self-evolution, with 48 longitudinal task sequences that span multiple evolution surfaces, task domains, and harm types in a rich personal-assistant environment. To account for the stochasticity inherent in agentic operations, we provide an adaptive trajectory discovery pipeline that probes for failures while preserving original task intent and supports causal attribution through paired non-evolving agents and attribution scores. Our evaluation across multiple recent LLMs, evolution surfaces, and harm types reveals that self-evolution indeed increases task completion rates but often at the cost of safety failures that are absent for paired non-evolving baseline agents. We also show that qualitatively different safety behaviors emerge across evolution surfaces and harm types. Further, we show that this divergence in safety behavior is reflected in agents' chain-of-thought reasoning, which yields an effective monitoring strategy that can mitigate unsafe behavior with a low false positive rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEABench 用 48 条纵向任务序列量化自进化 LLM agent 的内生失配 (endogenous misalignment)：自进化确实提高任务完成率，但同时引入配对非进化基线 agent 上不存在的安全失败，且不同进化面与伤害类型呈现质性不同的安全行为。作者进一步用 agent 的 chain-of-thought 推理做监控，能在低误报率下缓解不安全行为。
Motivation: agent 部署后自行改写控制器指令、记忆协议与工具技能，局部有益的更新会残留到后续任务并产生不安全行为，即使没有直接对抗影响；此前缺少能纵向、因果地度量这一风险的评测载体。
Method: 构建含 48 条纵向任务序列的基准，覆盖多个 evolution surfaces、任务域与伤害类型，环境为富个人助理场景；配自适应轨迹发现 pipeline，在保留原始任务意图的前提下探测失败，并通过配对的非进化 agent 与 attribution scores 支持因果归因。
Result: 在多个近期 LLM、进化面与伤害类型上的评测显示：自进化提升任务完成率，但常伴随安全失败，而配对非进化基线 agent 没有这些失败；安全行为随 evolution surface 与 harm type 呈质性差异，该差异也反映在 chain-of-thought 推理中，据此的监控策略能以低误报率缓解不安全行为。
Conclusion: 自进化带来的完成率收益与安全风险是绑定的，且风险形态取决于进化面与伤害类型，因此监控 agent 的 chain-of-thought 是一条可行的低成本防线。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建含 48 条纵向任务序列的基准，覆盖多个 evolution surfaces、任务域与伤害类型，环境为富个人助理场景；配自适应轨迹发现 pipeline，在保留原始任务意图的前提下探测失败，并通过配对的非进化 agent 与 attribution scores 支持因果归因。
summary_sections.result: 在多个近期 LLM、进化面与伤害类型上的评测显示：自进化提升任务完成率，但常伴随安全失败，而配对非进化基线 agent 没有这些失败；安全行为随 evolution surface 与 harm type 呈质性差异，该差异也反映在 chain-of-thought 推理中，据此的监控策略能以低误报率缓解不安全行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自进化带来的完成率收益与安全风险是绑定的，且风险形态取决于进化面与伤害类型，因此监控 agent 的 chain-of-thought 是一条可行的低成本防线。

papers.title: ReSS: Residual-Restoring Sparse Attention for 3D Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: 3D vision transformers such as VGGT predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass, but their global attention over all concatenated view tokens dominates computation as the number of views grows. To reduce this cost, SparseVGGT and HeSS sparsify attention at the block level, and both retain blocks with high attention probability. However, we observe that attention probability poorly predicts how much the model's behavior actually changes when a block is removed, and we show that this mismatch is why performance collapses as sparsity increases. In this paper, we propose ReSS (ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Attention), which recasts block selection from a problem of maximizing the retained attention mass to one of minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream. We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much each block shifts the residual, and, since the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors rather than on their magnitudes alone, an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole. Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity. Two further results support drift as the quantity that governs the cost of sparsification: maximizing drift degrades performance faster than random selection, and plotted against realized drift instead of sparsity, all methods fall approximately onto a single curve. Code is available at https://github.com/libary753/ReSS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSS 把 3D vision transformer 的块级稀疏注意力从「保留注意力概率最高的块」改为「最小化稀疏化在 residual stream 上留下的漂移」：用 drift score 度量每个块对残差的位移，再用迭代残差恢复过程整体修正 drop set。在三个 backbone、五个数据集上，同等稀疏度下比 SparseVGGT、HeSS 更好地保持 dense 性能；最大化 drift 的选择比随机选择更快劣化，且各方法按实际 drift 而非稀疏度作图时近似落在同一条曲线上。
Motivation: VGGT 类模型对拼接后的全部 view token 做全局注意力，随视角数增长计算量占主导；现有块级稀疏化方法按注意力概率保留块，但注意力概率并不能预测移除该块后模型行为的实际变化，导致稀疏度上升时性能崩塌。
Method: 提出 ReSS (Residual-Restoring Sparse Attention)：把块选择重写为最小化稀疏化残余漂移的优化问题，引入量化每个块对 residual stream 位移的 drift score；由于 drop set 的漂移取决于贡献向量的方向而非仅大小，再用迭代残差恢复过程对整个 drop set 做整体精化。
Result: 在三个 backbone 和五个数据集上，ReSS 在匹配稀疏度下比 SparseVGGT、HeSS 更好地保持 dense 性能；最大化 drift 的块选择比随机选择使性能下降更快；以实际实现的 drift 而非稀疏度为横轴时，所有方法近似落在同一条曲线上。
Conclusion: 稀疏化的性能代价由 residual drift 而非稀疏度或注意力概率决定，因此块选择应直接最小化 drift。

papers.title: Source-preserving alignment for robust evidence localization in scientific PDFS
papers.abstract_en: Scientific information-extraction systems often return a claim with an evidence string, which users must locate in the original PDF. This is challenging because the extracted evidence and PDF text layer are different representations: line wrapping, Unicode variants, superscripts, citation markers, and fragmented items alter text sequences and geometry. We present a source-preserving alignment framework: normalize text for robust matching while preserving provenance for accurate localization. It aligns evidence with normalized page text, maps matches back to source-character spans, and renders only their geometry. When exact alignment fails, line-break-aware token alignment recovers supported spans while excluding unmatched noise. Experiments on 1,020 chemistry papers show that the framework achieves a 92.6\% quote-level automatic localization rate, compared with 43.6\% for text search and 19.1\% for a precomputed bounding-box baseline. Component ablation confirms distinct contributions from normalization and approximate token alignment, while human verification assesses the visual correctness of returned highlights. Overall, these results demonstrate that reliable evidence verification requires robust matching and precise localization within a shared source-preserving alignment representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向科学 PDF 证据定位提出 source-preserving alignment 框架：先归一化文本做鲁棒匹配，再把命中映射回源字符跨度并只渲染其几何；精确匹配失败时用换行感知的 token 对齐找回受支持跨度、剔除未匹配噪声。在 1,020 篇化学论文上引文级自动定位率 92.6%，远高于文本搜索 43.6% 与预计算 bounding-box 基线 19.1%。
Motivation: 科学信息抽取返回的证据串与 PDF 文本层是两种表示，行折行、Unicode 变体、上标、引用标记与碎片化条目会改变文本序列和几何，导致用户难以在原文中定位证据。
Method: 框架分三步：归一化文本以稳健匹配同时保留 provenance，将证据与归一化页文本对齐，再把匹配映射回源字符跨度并只渲染其几何；精确对齐失败时改用换行感知的 token 对齐恢复受支持跨度并排除未匹配噪声。
Result: 在 1,020 篇化学论文上，引文级自动定位率 92.6%，对比文本搜索 43.6%、预计算 bounding-box 基线 19.1%；组件消融确认归一化与近似 token 对齐各有独立贡献，并由人工核验返回高亮的视觉正确性。
Conclusion: 可靠的证据核验需要在共享的 source-preserving 对齐表示中同时做到稳健匹配与精确定位，归一化与近似 token 对齐缺一不可。

papers.title: Hardware-Aware Features for CUTLASS Kernel Selection
papers.abstract_en: GPU libraries such as CUTLASS expose tens of thousands of semantically equivalent kernels for a single operation, making exhaustive autotuning expensive and execution-free selection difficult. Existing analytical selectors require hand-designed performance rules, while learned selectors operate on raw configuration parameters and must infer hardware consequences from data. We introduce a hardware-aware representation for CUTLASS kernel selection that augments candidate configurations with statically computable estimates of induced hardware behavior. We construct a dataset of 4.9 million CUTLASS kernels and train gradient-boosted and neural learning-to-rank models to rank candidates within each problem. On held-out exhaustive evaluation problems, hardware-aware representations reduce selection regret by up to 40\% relative to structural baselines and 64.2\% relative to NVIDIA's matrix-multiply heuristics. We further evaluate data-efficient cross-precision and epilogue-fusion transfer within CUTLASS GEMM, showing that explicitly representing candidate-induced hardware behavior provides a useful inductive bias for learned kernel selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 CUTLASS 单算子上万个语义等价 kernel 导致穷举 autotuning 昂贵、免执行选择困难的问题，提出在候选配置上附加可静态计算的硬件行为估计（hardware-aware representation），并用 gradient-boosted 与神经 learning-to-rank 模型在问题内排序候选。在留出的穷举评估问题上，该表示把选择 regret 相对结构化基线最多降低 40%，相对 NVIDIA 矩阵乘启发式降低 64.2%。
Motivation: CUTLASS 为单一操作暴露数万个等价 kernel，穷举 autotuning 成本过高；现有解析选择器依赖人工性能规则，学习型选择器只吃原始配置参数，须从数据中自行推断硬件后果。
Method: 构建 490 万个 CUTLASS kernel 数据集，为每个候选配置附加静态可计算的诱导硬件行为估计，训练 gradient-boosted 与神经 learning-to-rank 模型在每个问题内部对候选排序，并考察跨精度与 epilogue-fusion 的数据高效迁移。
Result: 在留出的穷举评估问题上，hardware-aware 表示相对结构化基线把选择 regret 最多降低 40%，相对 NVIDIA 矩阵乘启发式降低 64.2%；数据集含 490 万个 CUTLASS kernel；在 CUTLASS GEMM 内的跨精度与 epilogue-fusion 迁移评估中，显式表示候选诱导硬件行为构成有用归纳偏置。
Conclusion: 把候选配置的硬件后果显式写进表示，是学习型 kernel 选择的有效归纳偏置，可在免执行条件下压低选择 regret 并支持跨精度、跨 epilogue 的数据高效迁移。

papers.title: IMC-CLINIC: Coupled Loss-Informed Newton Iterations for Clipping in Analog In-Memory Computing
papers.abstract_en: Analog in-memory computing (IMC) offers a promising path toward energy-efficient large language model (LLM) inference by executing matrix multiplications (MatMul) directly within memory arrays in the analog domain. Its efficiency, however, comes with an additional source of error: limited-precision analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) quantize accumulated analog partial sums, introducing output-side error distinct from conventional activation and weight quantization at the MatMul inputs. Clipping can mitigate both operand and ADC quantization errors, but the optimal clipping factors must jointly balance activation rounding and clipping, weight rounding and clipping, and ADC quantization. Existing clipping methods, designed for digital quantization, do not explicitly optimize these coupled sources of IMC error and often rely on costly search-based calibration. We introduce IMC-CLINIC (Coupled Loss-Informed Newton Iterations for Clipping), a clipping calibration framework based on an analytical surrogate for IMC MatMul output error. The surrogate jointly models operand quantization, accumulated clipping-induced bias, and ADC quantization, enabling efficient evaluation of its gradient and approximate curvature from a small calibration set. IMC-CLINIC jointly optimizes activation and weight clipping factors using a safeguarded Newton-type method. Across multiple models and datasets, it improves average zero-shot accuracy by 6.5-11.5 percentage points over the grid search baseline while reducing calibration time by factors of 10.0-12.1. Its analytical surrogate closely tracks empirical IMC output error, and its optimizer is certified within 1% of the global optimum under the loss objective across all projections on two representative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMC-CLINIC 用一个解析代理损失联合建模模拟存内计算 (IMC) MatMul 的操作数量化、累积裁剪偏置与 ADC 量化，再用带保护的 Newton 型方法同时优化激活与权重裁剪因子。相比网格搜索基线，多模型多数据集上平均 zero-shot 准确率提升 6.5–11.5 个百分点，标定时间缩短 10.0–12.1 倍，优化器在两个代表性模型的全部投影上被认证在全局最优 1% 以内。
Motivation: IMC 中有限精度 ADC 对模拟部分和的量化引入输出侧误差，最优裁剪因子需同时平衡激活/权重的取整与裁剪及 ADC 量化；现有为数字量化设计的裁剪方法不显式优化这些耦合误差源，且依赖代价高昂的搜索式标定。
Method: 构建 IMC MatMul 输出误差的解析代理 (analytical surrogate)，联合刻画操作数量化、累积裁剪偏置与 ADC 量化，可从少量标定集高效计算梯度与近似曲率；再用带保护的 Newton 型方法 (safeguarded Newton-type method) 联合优化激活与权重裁剪因子。
Result: 在多个模型与数据集上，相比网格搜索 (grid search) 基线，平均 zero-shot 准确率提升 6.5–11.5 个百分点，标定时间缩短 10.0–12.1 倍；解析代理紧密追踪经验 IMC 输出误差，优化器在两个代表性模型的所有投影上被认证处于损失目标全局最优的 1% 以内。
Conclusion: 把 IMC 的耦合误差源写成可微的解析代理并用 Newton 迭代求解裁剪因子，可同时取代搜索式标定并逼近全局最优。

papers.title: What Paired Evaluations Reveal under Visual Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Robustness evaluation must examine diverse visual perturbations, while benchmarks cover only some real-world conditions and physical testing is costly. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, capturing changes in correctness, confidence, and acceptance beyond aggregate accuracy. We investigate how this image correspondence supports two needs in robustness evaluation: interpreting paired evaluation results and prioritizing samples for physical testing. To interpret paired evaluation results, we fix both sets of prediction records and vary their correspondence within each class. We prove that classwise correct-correct counts give the same sharp bounds on lost acceptance and mean true-class probability decrease among retained-correct inputs as any feasible five-state refinement. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further constrain accepted-error transitions, while shared correspondence can establish policy orderings left unresolved by separate cost intervals. To prioritize samples for physical testing, we retain each image's synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption. Across 44 classifiers, testing the highest-risk 20% finds 67% and 45% of failures under mild screen and print recaptures, versus 58% and 36% for clean confidence and 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. With both probability averaging and an A3Rank scoring adaptation, the tested corruption set yields higher mean failure recall than the natural-transform set; differences between scores depend on the source and budget. Together, these findings show that the value of correspondence depends on the evaluation objective: classwise counts suffice for specified reliability bounds, while image-specific synthetic responses improve the allocation of physical tests within the evaluated pool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出配对评估 (paired evaluation)：把同一张图的干净预测与扰动预测配对，用来解释鲁棒性结果并排序物理测试样本。证明类内 correct-correct 计数对 lost acceptance 与保留正确样本的真实类概率均值下降给出与任意可行五态细化同样紧的界；在 44 个分类器上按合成扰动下真实类概率均值排序，取风险最高的 20% 可在轻微屏幕与打印重拍摄 (screen/print recaptures) 下分别找到 67% 与 45% 的失败，优于干净置信度的 58% 与 36% 及等量自然变换平均的 60% 与 37%。
Motivation: 鲁棒性评估需要覆盖多样视觉扰动，但现有基准只覆盖部分真实条件，而物理测试成本高；聚合准确率掩盖了同一图像在扰动前后正确性、置信度与接受度的对应变化。
Method: 固定两组预测记录、在类内改变其对应关系，给出 lost acceptance 与保留正确输入真实类概率均值下降的紧界，并用持续/变化错误区分约束 accepted-error 转移；排序阶段保留每张图的合成扰动响应，按合成扰动下真实类概率均值给干净正确图像排序，并加入 A3Rank 打分适配。
Result: 在 44 个分类器上，测试风险最高的 20% 样本，在轻微 screen recaptures 与 print recaptures 下分别找到 67% 与 45% 的失败，而干净置信度为 58% 与 36%、等量自然变换平均为 60% 与 37%；概率平均加 A3Rank 适配下，所测合成扰动集的平均失败召回高于自然变换集，两种打分的差异取决于数据来源与预算。
Conclusion: 对应关系的价值取决于评估目标：类内计数足以给出指定的可靠性界，而图像级合成扰动响应能在已评估池内更好地分配物理测试预算。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: QC-Stark: A Multi-Task Benchmark Revealing Capability Dissociations in LLMs Evaluated on Quantum Computing Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce QC-Stark, a benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) on 11 quantum computing (QC) tasks, spanning circuit construction, debugging, compilation, error correction, and simulation. Across 2,750 evaluations (10 models $\times$ 11 tasks x 5 difficulty levels x 5 seeds), we find that overall rankings mask substantial per-task variation. The Spearman correlation between overall and per-task rankings is statistically insignificant for 4 out of the 11 tasks included in this benchmark. A 2-parameter Item Response Theory (IRT) model validates measurement quality, and prompt sensitivity analysis confirms ranking robustness across prompt conditions. All tasks are auto-verifiable via execution, thus not requiring any manual evaluation. We make the code and data publicly available on Huggingface.
papers.comment: accepted at the Quantum AI Workshop, Indianapolis IN, August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QC-Stark 是一个用执行自动判分的量子计算 LLM 基准，覆盖 11 项任务（电路构造、调试、编译、纠错、仿真），在 2,750 次评测中发现总分会掩盖单任务差异：11 项任务中有 4 项的总排名与单任务排名 Spearman 相关在统计上不显著。结论是不能用一个综合排名代表模型的量子计算能力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基准多用单一总分排名，但量子计算任务之间能力差异大，总排名可能掩盖模型在具体任务上的真实表现，且人工评测成本高。
Method: 构建 11 项 QC 任务、5 个难度级别，对 10 个模型 × 11 任务 × 5 难度 × 5 种子共 2,750 次评测；用 2 参数 Item Response Theory (IRT) 模型检验测量质量，并做 prompt 敏感性分析检验排名稳健性；所有任务通过执行自动验证，无需人工评分。
Result: 共 2,750 次评测（10 模型 × 11 任务 × 5 难度 × 5 种子）；11 项任务中 4 项的总排名与单任务排名 Spearman 相关在统计上不显著；2 参数 IRT 模型验证测量质量，prompt 敏感性分析确认各 prompt 条件下排名稳健。
Conclusion: LLM 的量子计算能力是按任务分离的，单一综合排名不可靠；代码与数据已在 Huggingface 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Output-aware Residual Stream Pruning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Residual stream pruning methods reduce inference cost by shrinking the model's hidden dimension, but existing approaches typically choose these dimensions by minimizing activation reconstruction error. This criterion implicitly treats all perturbation directions as equally important, ignoring the sensitivity of downstream layers. We introduce a sensitivity-aware approach to residual-stream pruning that directly accounts for this direction-dependent sensitivity. Using a second-order approximation to the output KL divergence, we characterize the effect of a residual-stream perturbation through both its activation covariance and the local sensitivity of the model output. The resulting subspace selection objective couples these two quantities, but is difficult to optimize directly. We derive a tractable spectral upper bound that reduces subspace selection to an eigendecomposition of a sensitivity-weighted covariance matrix, retaining the efficiency and structural simplicity of rotation-based pruning methods. Across several instruction-tuned language model families, our method consistently reduces calibration KL divergence relative to activation-only pruning and improves perplexity and downstream task performance over a range of compression levels. Our results show that preserving activation energy alone is insufficient for residual-stream pruning, and that explicitly accounting for how perturbations propagate to the model output provides a more effective criterion for selecting dimensions to remove.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 残差流剪枝 (residual stream pruning) 现有做法按激活重构误差选要删的维度，把所有扰动方向当成同等重要。本文用输出 KL 散度的二阶近似，把方向敏感度写进子空间选择目标，并推出可解的谱上界，化为对敏感度加权协方差矩阵的特征分解；在多个指令微调语言模型族上，该准则相对仅用激活的剪枝持续降低校准 KL 散度，并在多种压缩率下改善困惑度与下游任务表现。
Motivation: 残差流剪枝靠缩小隐藏维降低推理成本，但以激活重构误差选维忽略了下游层对不同扰动方向的敏感度差异，删维准则本身就不对。
Method: 对残差流扰动做输出 KL 散度的二阶近似，用激活协方差与模型输出的局部敏感度共同刻画扰动影响；两者耦合的子空间选择目标难直接优化，作者推导一个可解的谱上界，把选维化为敏感度加权协方差矩阵的特征分解，保留基于旋转的剪枝方法的效率与结构简洁性。
Result: 在多个指令微调语言模型族上，相对仅基于激活的剪枝，本文方法在一系列压缩率下持续降低校准 KL 散度，并改善困惑度与下游任务表现。
Conclusion: 只保留激活能量不足以决定残差流该删哪些维度，必须显式计入扰动如何传播到模型输出，才能选出更有效的删除方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FactorEngram: Factorized N-gram Memory with Basis-Level Gating for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Lookup-based memory has been a promising way to scale the parameters of large language models (LLMs). It retrieves learned representations of local token patterns, such as n-grams, instead of reconstructing them through successive layers of computation. However, existing designs such as Engram treat each retrieved embedding as a monolithic unit. Each embedding is stored in its own hashed slot and modulated by a single scalar gate. As a result, polysemous patterns cannot selectively read out the components of their memory that are relevant to the context. Moreover, parameters are shared only through hash collisions, which are largely unrelated to semantics. We propose FactorEngram, a factorized n-gram memory with basis-level contextual gating. FactorEngram retrieves sparsity-regularized coefficients over a dictionary of basis vectors shared across patterns, so related patterns can reuse common components. The same dictionary is also used for gating. The backbone hidden state is scored against each basis vector to gate the corresponding coefficient before reconstruction, which lets the context modulate each memory component individually. FactorEngram also covers both individual tokens and multi-token n-grams, and we systematically study where the memory branch should be inserted. On 340M- and 1B-parameter Transformer backbones, FactorEngram improves language modeling and downstream task performance. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component and identify insertion before the attention sublayer in the middle layers as an effective configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactorEngram 把 Engram 的整块 n-gram 记忆向量拆成共享基向量字典上的稀疏系数，用同一字典对每个基做上下文门控后再重建，使多义模式可按语境选择性读出记忆分量。在 340M 与 1B Transformer 主干上改进语言建模与下游任务，消融确认中层 attention 子层之前插入记忆分支是有效配置。
Motivation: 现有 lookup 式记忆（如 Engram）把每个检索到的嵌入当作整体存进独立哈希槽、只用单个标量门调制，多义模式无法按语境选择性读出相关分量，参数也只通过与语义无关的哈希碰撞共享。
Method: 检索共享基向量字典上的稀疏正则系数（sparsity-regularized coefficients），同一字典同时用于门控：主干隐状态与每个基向量打分，逐基门控对应系数后再重建；记忆覆盖单 token 与多 token n-gram，并系统考察记忆分支插入位置。
Result: 在 340M 与 1B 参数 Transformer 主干上，FactorEngram 改善语言建模与下游任务表现；消融研究确认各组件均有贡献，并定位到中层 attention 子层之前插入为有效配置。
Conclusion: 把 n-gram 记忆从整块嵌入改为共享基上的可门控分解，能让相关模式复用公共分量并按上下文单独调制，插入位置本身也是关键设计变量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant's persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human-agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60-80% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 artifact-mediated propagation：对抗内容经共享工件（如报告）写入助手持久记忆，再被复现到后续工件并被其他助手读取，从而在独立 LLM 助手间自我传播。在模拟工件交换的时间轴人机环境中，攻击可跨多个助手存活并延续多个交互序列；较大规模环境中 GPT-5.6 Luna 也出现显著扩散，触达 60-80% 的 agent，传播链最长八跳。
Motivation: 有状态 LLM 助手通过工具读写持久工件，工件在用户间共享后成为独立助手之间的间接通信通道，使攻击可以越过单次交互存活并跨隔离助手扩散，这一失败模式此前缺少刻画。
Method: 定义 artifact-mediated propagation 机制，并在 temporal human-agent universes 中评估：该环境模拟独立运行的助手随时间交换工件，测量攻击在连续交接中的存活、到达的 hop 数与扩散广度。
Result: 攻击可跨多个独立助手传播并在长交互序列中持续；在更大规模的模拟环境中，GPT-5.6 Luna 也出现显著扩散，触达 60-80% 的 agent，传播链延伸至八跳。
Conclusion: 持久工件可充当对抗状态的持久载体，使攻击比单次交互更长寿并在彼此隔离的助手之间扩散。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

papers.title: Less Is More: Genetic Frame Selection for Efficient Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward novel view synthesis reconstructs a scene from many input images in a single forward pass, yet more views do not necessarily improve performance: redundant or poorly chosen frames increase computational cost and may degrade reconstruction quality. We address the problem of selecting, from an already captured sequence, a fixed-size subset of input views that is most informative for reconstructing specified target viewpoints. We propose a render-free view selector that scores candidate frames based on three complementary criteria: target-view coverage, measured against observed frames that stand in for the targets, redundancy with previously selected views, and image sharpness. A lightweight scoring network then selects the most informative frames without rendering, reconstruction, or per-scene optimization at inference time. To train the selector, we distill an expensive offline search procedure in which a genetic algorithm identifies high-quality subsets by directly optimizing reconstruction performance on training scenes. The selector learns to reproduce these choices from geometric and image-level features alone. Across six datasets and multiple input budgets, our method consistently outperforms both geometric and reconstruction-aware view-selection baselines while incurring significantly lower selection costs than reconstruction-based alternatives. Moreover, carefully selected subsets can outperform feed-forward reconstruction from the full input sequence. The learned selector generalizes across diverse reconstruction paradigms (feed-forward, 3D Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF), to object-targeted reconstruction and to a cross-capture setting in which the target views come from a separate acquisition pass. More broadly, our results indicate that explicitly reasoning about target relevance and inter-view redundancy is a fundamental factor in efficient scene reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 前馈新视角合成中输入视图越多未必越好，冗余或选得差的帧会增加计算并拉低重建质量。提出免渲染 (render-free) 视图选择器，用目标视角覆盖度、与已选视图的冗余度、图像清晰度三项打分，并把遗传算法离线搜索出的高质量子集蒸馏进轻量打分网络。在六个数据集与多种输入预算下稳定超过几何类与重建感知类选择基线，且精选子集可胜过使用全部输入序列的前馈重建。
Motivation: 前馈新视角合成依赖大量输入图像，冗余帧抬高计算成本甚至降低重建质量；重建感知的选择方法又需要渲染或逐场景优化，选择开销高。
Method: 免渲染选择器按三准则给候选帧打分：以观测帧代替目标视角度量 target-view coverage、与已选视图的冗余度、图像清晰度；推理时用轻量打分网络直接选帧，不做渲染、重建或逐场景优化。训练阶段蒸馏一个昂贵的离线搜索：遗传算法在训练场景上直接优化重建性能找出高质量子集，选择器仅凭几何与图像级特征复现这些选择。
Result: 在六个数据集与多种输入预算下，一致优于几何与重建感知两类视图选择基线，选择开销显著低于基于重建的替代方法；精心选出的子集可超过使用完整输入序列的前馈重建。选择器可跨前馈、3D Gaussian Splatting、NeRF 三类重建范式泛化，并适用于 object-targeted 重建与目标视角来自另一次采集的 cross-capture 设定。
Conclusion: 显式建模目标相关性与视图间冗余是高效场景重建的根本因素，免渲染的蒸馏式选择器即可在多种重建范式上给出优于全序列输入的固定大小视图子集。

papers.title: Representation Alignment as a Bottleneck in LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
papers.abstract_en: While LLMs show promise in general reasoning, symbolic planning in chemistry remains a bottleneck. Direct ''SMILES-to-PDDL'' attempts fail because they force models to juggle chemical analysis and planning-language structuring simultaneously. We hypothesize that this failure stems from a lack of intermediate abstractions rather than insufficient model capacity. By decomposing retrosynthesis into molecule mapping, reaction mapping, and PDDL generation, we achieve high success rates where end-to-end approaches fail. This provides evidence that a primary bottleneck lies in representation alignment rather than raw model capacity. Our structural analysis demonstrates that intermediate representations are essential in retrosynthesis planning, highlighting the importance of representation-centric design in future systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 LLM 逆合成规划 (retrosynthesis planning) 拆成分子映射、反应映射、PDDL 生成三个中间表示阶段，使原本失败的端到端 SMILES-to-PDDL 任务取得高成功率，说明瓶颈在表示对齐而非模型容量。
Motivation: LLM 在化学符号规划上表现受限，直接从 SMILES 生成 PDDL 要求模型同时处理化学分析与规划语言构造，端到端方案失败。
Method: 将逆合成规划分解为 molecule mapping、reaction mapping、PDDL generation 三个中间抽象阶段，逐级对齐表示后再产出 PDDL 规划语言。
Result: 分解式流程在端到端方法失败的任务上取得高成功率；结构性分析显示中间表示对逆合成规划是必要的。
Conclusion: 逆合成规划的主要瓶颈是表示对齐而非原始模型容量，未来系统应采用以表示为中心的设计。

papers.title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EdgeVLN 把 StreamVLN 量化到 4-bit 并配上轻量停止头 LATTE，在 Jetson Orin NX 上跑通全部 1,839 条 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen 回合：SR 达 58.02%，比 BF16 基线更高而每步只多 0.013 s 延迟。只有 IQ4_NL 加自家 VLN driver 能装进 16 GB 板子（常驻 11.35 GB），比存储流式 BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍；同为 4-bit 的格式 SR 几乎相同但步能耗差 36.8 倍，INT2 直接崩溃。
Motivation: VLN 模型只在算力充裕平台上表现好，装不进内存和功耗受限的机器人边缘设备；单纯压缩无法判断模型是否同时满足内存、延迟、能耗预算且保住导航行为。
Method: 组合量化 StreamVLN 与 LATTE（轻量 causal transformer，复用 backbone hidden states 预测 Stop Action verifier rank 来改进实时停止，不加第二个视觉编码器也不多跑一次 backbone），全部经自研 llama.cpp VLN driver 执行，重建 streaming context 并在板上剪枝 memory token；对预训练 StreamVLN 在 8 到 2 bit 权重量化与多种推理 runtime 上做特性扫描以找可行工作点。
Result: 在 BF16 与 IQ4_NL 两种精度、六种 backbone 精度和七个候选停止头上评估全部 1,839 条 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen 回合：LATTE 在部署的 4-bit 模型上取得最高 SR 58.02%，超过 BF16 基线，每导航步仅多 0.013 s 延迟；4-bit 各格式 SR 几乎一致，但步能耗因执行路径不同相差 36.8 倍；仅 IQ4_NL 配 VLN driver 能装入 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB，常驻内存 11.35 GB，较存储流式 BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍；INT2 崩溃。
Conclusion: 边缘 VLN 部署必须同时选对 runtime、剪 memory token 并量化，单靠压缩不足以保证在内存/延迟/能耗预算内保住导航行为。

papers.title: Beyond Energy: When Sustainability Dimensions Reshape LLM Serving Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) serving has environmental impacts across energy consumption, carbon emission, water consumption, and biodiversity loss. Yet these dimensions are largely evaluated in isolation, leaving it unclear when and how they lead to different optimization decisions. We present PRISM, a unified framework for characterizing and optimizing LLM serving across energy, carbon, water, and biodiversity impacts. Our analysis reveals a fundamental distinction: computing configurations determine energy consumption, whereas where and when LLM serving is deployed determine its carbon, water, and biodiversity impacts. Under a fixed deployment choice and operational-only accounting, all dimensions preserve the same energy-based configuration ranking. Deployment rankings can diverge across dimensions, while embodied impacts can break configuration invariance when they exceed a lifecycle crossover boundary. PRISM identifies these conditions, quantifies cross-dimensional regrets, and balances the four dimensions. In regional-routing experiments, PRISM reduces median worst-case regret by 50.2% relative to the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 把 LLM serving 的能耗、碳、水、生物多样性四个维度放进同一优化框架，发现配置只决定能耗，而部署地点与时间决定碳、水、生物多样性。固定部署且只算运行阶段时四维给出同一能耗排序；一旦计入 embodied 影响并越过生命周期交叉边界，配置不变性被打破。区域路由实验中 PRISM 把中位最坏 regret 相对最强基线降低 50.2%。
Motivation: LLM serving 的环境影响被按能耗、碳、水、生物多样性分别评估，无法判断这些维度何时会导出互相冲突的优化决策。
Method: PRISM 统一刻画并优化四个维度：区分由计算配置决定的能耗与由部署地点/时间决定的碳、水、生物多样性，识别配置不变性成立与失效的条件（含 embodied 影响的 lifecycle crossover boundary），量化跨维度 regret 并在四维间做权衡。
Result: 固定部署且仅计运行阶段时，四个维度保持相同的基于能耗的配置排序；部署排序会跨维度分歧，embodied 影响超过生命周期交叉边界时可打破配置不变性。区域路由实验中 PRISM 将中位最坏 regret 相对最强基线降低 50.2%。
Conclusion: 能耗排序不能代表其他可持续性维度：维度间分歧由部署选择与 embodied 影响驱动，服务决策需按跨维度 regret 而非单一能耗指标来做。

summary_sections.conclusion: 能耗排序不能代表其他可持续性维度：维度间分歧由部署选择与 embodied 影响驱动，服务决策需按跨维度 regret 而非单一能耗指标来做。

papers.title: From Experience to Expertise: Adoption-Aware Memory Learning for Data-Scarce NPU Kernel Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: High-performance kernels underpin efficient accelerator execution but require expert tuning and lengthy manual optimization cycles. LLM coding agents promise automation, yet their CUDA knowledge transfers poorly to data-scarce domain-specific architectures (DSAs) such as NPUs, whose execution models and memory hierarchies differ substantially from those of GPUs. To address this transfer gap, post-training methods adapt LLMs to NPU programming but depend on scarce expert data and substantial training compute. Memory-learning agents instead adapt through external memory, but their uniform credit assignment gives adopted and unused experiences the same reward target, potentially biasing subsequent retrieval rankings. Moreover, when learned values guide only retrieval, high-value experiences that generalize across operators must be retrieved repeatedly rather than retained in context, thereby increasing retrieval overhead and weakening cross-task guidance. We therefore present SAGE, a persistent self-improving agent for NPU kernel synthesis. Adoption-Traced Utility estimation (ATU) combines explicit adoption records with kernel evaluation outcomes for adoption-aware credit assignment. Utility-Gated Consolidation (UGC) uses positive utility and repeated adoption across operators to select and abstract reusable rules into a bounded resident context. On NPUKernelBench, SAGE achieves a 95.5% execution rate versus 84.1% for the strongest controlled baseline, with 86.9% of solved operators outperforming torch_npu. With GLM-5.3, SAGE achieves a 43.99x speedup over the torch_npu reference on sparse flash attention. These results show that adoption-aware credit assignment and selective consolidation enable agents to accumulate and reuse hardware-specific knowledge across tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是面向 NPU kernel 合成的持久自改进 LLM agent，用 Adoption-Traced Utility (ATU) 按采纳记录与 kernel 评测结果做 credit assignment，再用 Utility-Gated Consolidation (UGC) 把跨算子复用的高价值经验抽象成有界常驻上下文。在 NPUKernelBench 上执行率 95.5%（最强受控基线 84.1%），86.9% 已解算子超过 torch_npu，GLM-5.3 驱动时 sparse flash attention 相对 torch_npu 加速 43.99x。
Motivation: LLM 的 CUDA 知识难以迁移到执行模型与内存层次迥异的 NPU 等 DSA；依赖专家数据的 post-training 又受限于数据稀缺，而 memory-learning agent 的均匀 credit assignment 会把已采纳与未用经验混为一谈，污染检索排序。
Method: SAGE 由两部分组成：ATU 把显式采纳记录与 kernel 评测结果结合，做采纳感知的 utility 估计与 credit assignment；UGC 依据正 utility 与跨算子的重复采纳筛选并抽象可复用规则，写入有界的常驻上下文，避免高价值经验只能被反复检索。
Result: 在 NPUKernelBench 上，SAGE 执行率 95.5%，对比最强受控基线 84.1%；已解算子中 86.9% 优于 torch_npu；配合 GLM-5.3，在 sparse flash attention 上相对 torch_npu 参考实现取得 43.99x 加速。
Conclusion: 采纳感知的 credit assignment 加选择性 consolidation，能让 agent 跨任务累积并复用硬件专属知识，缓解 NPU kernel 合成中专家数据与训练算力的双重稀缺。

papers.title: Almieyar: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Arabic speech technology has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving the living dialects spoken by hundreds of millions under-served. We introduce ALMIEYAR, a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families, built entirely from newly recorded speech unseen by existing models. Dialect-community coordinators selected culturally relevant images across 10 topics, and native speakers described them through five structured scenarios, yielding approximately 50 minutes per dialect (13.7 hours total). We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art ASR systems zero-shot, including GPT-4o-transcribe, Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, Whisper, SeamlessM4T-v2, and wav2vec2-based models. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall WER at 35.0%, followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, and Whisper-Large-v3 at 41.1%, 45.9%, and 49.5%, respectively, indicating substantial remaining errors across Arabic dialect communities. Performance varies considerably across dialect groups, with no model performing uniformly best across all groups. WER alone also obscures dialectal ASR behaviour: wav2vec2-based models show large WER/CER gaps, where character-level agreement remains much higher than word-level accuracy, motivating joint WER/CER reporting. ALMIEYAR provides a unified benchmark for culturally grounded Arabic ASR evaluation, including the first published benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALMIEYAR 是一个文化扎根的阿拉伯语方言 ASR 基准，覆盖 6 大方言族共 17 种方言，全部用现有模型未见过的新录音构建：由方言社区协调者选图、母语者在 5 种结构化场景下描述，每方言约 50 分钟、总计 13.7 小时。对 12 个 SOTA ASR 系统做 zero-shot 评测，GPT-4o-transcribe 总体 WER 最低 35.0%，但各方言族上无模型一致最优，且 WER 与 CER 差距大，作者主张联合报告 WER/CER。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语语音技术长期只服务现代标准阿拉伯语 (MSA)，数亿人使用的活方言缺乏评测数据；现有模型也没有覆盖 Ahwazi Arabic 的公开基准。
Method: 由方言社区协调者在 10 个主题下挑选文化相关图片，母语者经 5 种结构化场景口述描述，录制全新语音构成 17 方言、13.7 小时语料；对 12 个 SOTA ASR 系统（GPT-4o-transcribe、Voxtral-Mini-4B、Fanar-STT-LF、Whisper、SeamlessM4T-v2、wav2vec2 系列等）做 zero-shot 基准测试，同时统计 WER 与 CER。
Result: 总体 WER：GPT-4o-transcribe 35.0% 最低，Voxtral-Mini-4B 41.1%、Fanar-STT-LF 45.9%、Whisper-Large-v3 49.5% 依次随后；性能在方言族间差异显著，无模型在所有方言族上一致最优；wav2vec2 系列的 WER/CER 差距大，字符级一致率远高于词级准确率。
Conclusion: 阿拉伯方言 ASR 仍有大量残余错误，单一 WER 会掩盖方言化行为，评测应联合报告 WER 与 CER 并按方言族分层；ALMIEYAR 提供统一评测基准，含首个 Ahwazi Arabic 公开基准。

papers.title: Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study on risky tackle detection in American football prac- tice videos. The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used focal loss, Taguchi L18 augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation. It reported risky- class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to specific scripts, fold out- puts, and aggregation files. The reproduced headline is run_15. It com- bines Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is 0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise. Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show iden- tifiable student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是 ICPR 2026 美式橄榄球危险擒抱检测研究的可复现性配套件：把 ViViT 在 733 段 SATT-3 标注视频上的结果追溯到具体脚本与折输出，复现的 headline 配置 run_15（高斯噪声+静态亮度降低、不旋转不翻转）折均危险类 recall 0.667、F1 0.588，与原文四舍五入后一致。消融显示亮度是主导增益项（主效应极差 0.055，大于旋转、翻转、噪声），而完全不加增强时 ViViT 危险类 recall 仅 0.545，低于 C3D 基线的 0.583。
Motivation: 原研究报告的危险类指标难以独立核验，且增强策略的选择依据不透明；配套件要把 headline 数字落到具体脚本、折输出与聚合文件上，并说明数据因含可识别学生运动员而不能再分发。
Method: 以原研究的 ViViT 微调流程为对象：733 段 SATT-3 标注剪辑、focal loss、Taguchi L18 增强设计、5 折交叉验证；配套件复跑并定位 run_15 配置，同时做增强因子（亮度、旋转、翻转、噪声）的主效应消融，并对照 C3D 基线。
Result: 复现 headline run_15 折均危险类 recall 0.667、F1 0.588，与原文 0.67/0.59 四舍五入后一致；亮度的危险类 recall 主效应极差 0.055，大于旋转、翻转与噪声；无增强时 ViViT 危险类 recall 0.545，不超过 C3D 基线 0.583。
Conclusion: 原研究的 headline 数字可由 released artifact 精确复现，且增强收益主要由亮度降低贡献——去掉增强后 ViViT 甚至不敌 C3D；数据因隐私只能通过公开样例与受控通道审阅。

papers.title: RSI-Master: Structuring Experiments to Guide Autonomous Model Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to enable AI systems to participate in improving their own capabilities. A concrete pathway is autonomous model development, where agents iteratively explore post-training strategies to improve a base model. This setting faces two challenges: agents may exploit open-ended experimental actions through hacking, and repeated experimentation may lead to strategy lock-in, where an early direction is refined rather than reconsidered. We introduce RSI-Master, which addresses the two challenges at two levels: regularize step-wise actions, avoiding hacking behaviors, and promote well-structured exploration of research directions, avoiding strategy lock-in. RSI-Master consists of an Experiment OS, which enables regularized experimental actions and maintains persistent, traceable experimental records, and Reviewer-Guided Research Orchestration, which organizes Workers and Reviewers in a dynamically growing research DAG. Workers explore diverse research directions and Reviewers compare evidence across related experiments for subsequent explorations. On PostTrainBench with Qwen3-4B-Base, it averages 54.49 versus 46.53 for the strongest agent baseline, with a 0.0\% hacking rate. Scaling to 35B model, RSI-Master surpasses the human-developed Instruct model on LiveCodeBench-v6 (41.21 vs. 37.36) and SciCode, and reaches a nonzero score on HorizonMath, a benchmark of unsolved research problems on which most frontier models score near zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSI-Master 用两层机制约束自主模型改进：Experiment OS 规范化逐步实验动作并留下可追溯记录，Reviewer-Guided Research Orchestration 用动态增长的 research DAG 组织 Worker 与 Reviewer，抑制 hacking 与策略锁死。在 PostTrainBench + Qwen3-4B-Base 上平均 54.49，对比最强 agent 基线 46.53，hacking 率 0.0%；扩到 35B 模型后在 LiveCodeBench-v6 上以 41.21 对 37.36 超过人工开发的 Instruct 模型。
Motivation: 自主模型开发中，agent 可能通过 hacking 滥用开放式实验动作，且反复实验容易锁死在早期方向上，只细化而不重新审视研究路线。
Method: RSI-Master 分两层：Experiment OS 规范实验动作并维护持久、可追溯的实验记录；Reviewer-Guided Research Orchestration 在动态增长的 research DAG 中组织 Worker 与 Reviewer，Worker 探索多样研究方向，Reviewer 跨相关实验证据比较以指导下一轮探索。
Result: PostTrainBench 上以 Qwen3-4B-Base 为底模平均 54.49，最强 agent 基线 46.53，hacking 率 0.0%；扩展到 35B 模型后，LiveCodeBench-v6 上 41.21 对人工开发 Instruct 模型的 37.36，并在 SciCode 上超过该模型，在 HorizonMath（多数前沿模型接近零分的未解研究问题基准）上取得非零分数。
Conclusion: 把实验动作规范化并用 Reviewer 跨实验比对证据来编排探索，可以在保持零 hacking 的同时让自主后训练超过强 agent 基线，并在代码与科学推理基准上追平或超过人工开发的模型。

papers.title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldPlay2 把分解式混合控制接口（帧对齐动作 + 场景外观/角色身份/动态语义事件的结构化语义控制）与压缩记忆、稳定蒸馏耦合，实现实时交互且长时一致的世界模型。历史上下文被压成自回归学生与双向教师共享的 memory token，蒸馏改为 clip-wise 的记忆条件评分而非整段 rollout 联合处理；Stable Forcing 用 few-step 初始化学生并以 full-rollout replay 保住长时质量。
Motivation: 交互式世界模型要同时满足实时响应与长时一致性，但异构控制难建模，上下文爆炸与蒸馏不稳使两者难以兼得。
Method: 三部分协同：分解式混合控制接口把帧对齐动作控制与结构化语义控制（显式解耦场景外观、角色身份、动态语义事件）结合；把历史上下文压缩为自回归学生与双向教师共享的紧凑 memory token，蒸馏改为 clip-wise、记忆条件的 score 评估；Stable Forcing 以 few-step 策略初始化自回归学生，并用 full-rollout replay 维持长时 rollout 质量。
Result: 大量实验显示模型泛化性强，性能优于现有方法；摘要以定性对比为主，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 控制接口分解、共享压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏三者联合设计，是同时拿到实时交互和长时一致性的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Search to Research: Exploring Search Scaling in Autonomous Quantitative Factor Mining
papers.abstract_en: Inference scaling has been shown to improve large language model (LLM) performance, and this principle naturally extends to autonomous LLM agents through increased search budgets, which we refer to as *search scaling*. Although prior work has characterized the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and performance limits of LLM inference scaling, much less is known about these questions in autonomous research. Therefore, we investigate how search scaling affects research performance and what mechanisms drive these gains using 50 quantitative factor-mining tasks grounded in financial research reports. Each task requires an agent to carry out an end-to-end research loop, from interpreting a hypothesis and implementing it in code to evaluating and iteratively refining the resulting factor. Across nine models, we examine how model capability, search depth, and search organization shape factor quality by tracing performance across varying budgets, transferring intermediate research states between models, and comparing different search strategies. We find that (1) initial performance is more strongly associated with model capability, while deeper search can narrow cross-model gaps; (2) model grafting shows that the early research state materially shapes final performance; and (3) parallel search outperforms sequential search under the same iteration budget, consistent with benefits from broader coverage of the search space. Further trajectory analysis shows that higher-performing models more effectively diagnose failures, revise search directions, and preserve the intended economic hypothesis when selecting candidates. These findings suggest that future progress in autonomous research will require stronger models together with adaptive policies for deploying test-time computation throughout the research process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 50 个量化因子挖掘任务上研究 agent 的 search scaling：随搜索预算增加因子质量提升，初始性能更依赖模型能力而更深搜索能缩小模型间差距；同等迭代预算下并行搜索优于顺序搜索，早期研究状态会实质影响最终结果。
Motivation: 已有工作刻画了 LLM 推理扩展的机制与极限，但自主研究 (autonomous research) 场景下搜索预算如何影响产出、由什么机制驱动，此前了解很少。
Method: 构建 50 个源自金融研究报告的量化因子挖掘任务，每个任务要求 agent 完成从解读假设、写代码实现到评估并迭代改进因子的端到端研究循环；在 9 个模型上通过改变预算追踪性能、在模型间转移中间研究状态 (model grafting)，并比较不同搜索策略。
Result: 发现三点：初始性能与模型能力关联更强，而更深搜索可缩小跨模型差距；model grafting 表明早期研究状态实质决定最终性能；同等迭代预算下并行搜索优于顺序搜索，与搜索空间覆盖更广一致。轨迹分析显示更强的模型更能诊断失败、修正搜索方向，并在选候选时保留原经济假设。
Conclusion: 自主研究的后续进展需要更强的模型，配合在整个研究过程中自适应分配 test-time 计算的策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Compiler May Read It, the Agent May Not: Keeping Part of a Research Code Away from a Coding Agent
papers.abstract_en: The compiler must read modules a physics-based solver cannot build without; the coding agent must not read that intellectual property. The harness does not ship that rule. We classified fifteen read routes against a container, permission rules and a sandbox. None of the three can tell which program is reading.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Ancillary files: the classification and history scripts with their outputs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向科研代码的 IP 保护：把物理求解器必需、但不能让 coding agent 读到的模块隔离起来，而现有 harness 不会下发这条规则。作者把十五条读取路径对照容器、权限规则和 sandbox 分类，指出三者都无法判断当前是哪个程序在读。
Motivation: 科研代码里编译器必须读的模块正是要保护的知识产权，但 coding agent 一旦读到就泄露；现有 harness 不携带这条访问规则。
Method: 对十五条 read route 做分类，逐条对照容器隔离、权限规则与 sandbox 三种机制的能力边界；附带分类脚本与历史脚本及其输出。
Result: 分类了 15 条读取路径；结论是容器、权限规则、sandbox 三种机制中没有任何一种能识别正在读取的程序身份。
Conclusion: 按进程身份区分读取者是当前隔离机制的共同盲区，仅靠容器、权限或 sandbox 无法实现编译器可读、agent 不可读的分隔。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Simplex Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative modeling for continuous data through the gradual refinement of a belief state. This iterative refinement has not yet carried over to discrete diffusion models, which discard uncertainty at intermediate steps through categorical sampling (information collapse). We propose Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs), a framework that lifts the diffusion process to the probability simplex to represent beliefs over categories. SDMs admit probability paths with closed-form reverse transitions and can be trained with a simple cross-entropy loss. Contrary to earlier proposals such as Dirichlet Flow Matching which requires integrating an ordinary differential equation, we introduce a DDIM-like sampler with a tunable level of stochasticity. Because SDMs operate on samples on the simplex, they can carry uncertainty across denoising steps, which mitigates information collapse. On OpenWebText, SDMs are competitive with strong Discrete Diffusion baselines, achieving $17.0$ GenPPL at $5.46$ unigram entropy in 64 sampling steps, close to real validation data. Even without Self-Conditioning (SC), SDMs outperform masked and uniform diffusion (with SC or predictor-corrector sampling) on code generation (TinyGSM, $T=0.1$; $49.0\%$ vs. $45.8\%$). Distilled down to 8 steps, SDMs solve $32.1\%$ of GSM8K problems, more than distilled Discrete Diffusion models with 128 steps ($21.4\%$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Simplex Diffusion Models (SDM) 把离散扩散的状态从 one-hot 提升到概率单纯形，用闭式逆向概率路径与交叉熵训练，在去噪各步携带类别不确定性，从而缓解离散扩散的信息坍缩。在 OpenWebText 上 64 步采样达到 17.0 GenPPL（unigram 熵 5.46），接近真实验证数据；无 Self-Conditioning 时 TinyGSM (T=0.1) 49.0% 对 45.8%，蒸馏到 8 步在 GSM8K 上 32.1%，超过蒸馏离散扩散 128 步的 21.4%。
Motivation: 离散扩散每步用类别采样丢弃中间不确定性（信息坍缩），而连续扩散的逐步信念精化机制尚未迁移到离散域；已有方案如 Dirichlet Flow Matching 需要积分 ODE，训练与采样都不够轻便。
Method: 将扩散过程提升到概率单纯形以表示类别上的信念分布，得到带闭式逆向转移的概率路径，用简单交叉熵损失训练；并提出类 DDIM 的可调随机性采样器，替代需积分 ODE 的 Dirichlet Flow Matching。
Result: OpenWebText 上 64 步采样 17.0 GenPPL @ unigram 熵 5.46，接近真实验证数据；代码生成 TinyGSM (T=0.1) 上即使不用 Self-Conditioning 也达 49.0%，对比带 SC 或 predictor-corrector 采样的 masked/uniform diffusion 的 45.8%；蒸馏至 8 步后 GSM8K 解出 32.1%，多于蒸馏离散扩散模型 128 步的 21.4%。
Conclusion: 在单纯形上做扩散并全程携带不确定性，可以在文本与代码生成上与强离散扩散基线竞争，同时把采样步数与蒸馏成本大幅压低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BaRe-Mem: Bayesian Reliability Memory for Robust and Adaptive Agent Consultation
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent systems, reliable consultation is challenging because advisor capabilities vary across tasks, and misleading information can make consultation worse than autonomous reasoning. We introduce BaRe-Mem, an online Bayesian reliability memory for multi-agent consultation. It estimates advisor reliability based on the central model's internal belief representations and updates these estimates from historical interactions. These estimates modulate the influence of advisor responses and guide the choice between consultation and autonomous reasoning. Across nine benchmarks and six central models, BaRe-Mem is more robust to misleading advisor information than debate and majority voting. On the more challenging tasks, it remains above autonomous reasoning across all tested misleading levels. Moreover, we extend the BaRe-Mem mechanism to worker allocation in agent teams. On the MuSiQue benchmark, BaRe-Mem improves task completion over routing by historical success counts and identifies capable workers earlier.
papers.comment: BaRe-Mem is an online Bayesian reliability memory that learns context-dependent advisor reliability from verified interactions, modulates external advice accordingly, and adaptively decides whether to consult or reason autonomously
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BaRe-Mem 是面向多智能体咨询的在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆：用中心模型的内部信念表征估计各 advisor 的可靠性，从历史交互中在线更新，据此调制外部建议的权重并决定咨询还是自主推理。在 9 个 benchmark、6 个中心模型上，它比 debate 和 majority voting 更抗误导性建议；在更难任务上，即使误导程度拉满也始终优于纯自主推理。
Motivation: 多智能体系统里各 advisor 能力随任务变化，误导性建议会让咨询结果比自主推理更差，而 debate 与 majority voting 对此缺乏可靠的加权与取舍机制。
Method: 在线贝叶斯可靠性记忆：以中心模型的内部 belief 表征为输入估计 advisor 可靠性，用历史交互持续更新；该估计既调制 advisor 回答的影响权重，也作为咨询与自主推理之间的门控，并可扩展到 agent 团队的 worker 分配。
Result: 在 9 个 benchmark、6 个中心模型上，对误导性 advisor 信息的鲁棒性优于 debate 与 majority voting；在更难任务上，所有测试的误导水平下均保持高于自主推理。扩展到 worker 分配后，在 MuSiQue 上任务完成率超过按历史成功计数的路由，并能更早识别出有能力的 worker。
Conclusion: 把 advisor 可靠性建成随任务上下文变化的在线贝叶斯记忆并用于门控咨询，可以在误导信息存在时稳定优于辩论、投票和纯自主推理，同一机制也能迁移到团队内的 worker 选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RareDx: Controlled Knowledge Integration and Graph-Grounded Policy Optimization for Rare-Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Rare-disease diagnosis is a long-tail reasoning problem: phenotypes are incomplete, individual disorders are sparsely documented, and relevant evidence is distributed across ontologies, gene annotations, and biomedical text. Language models consequently favor common conditions, miss rare candidates, or produce plausible but invalid names. We introduce RareDx, which couples controlled evidence use with knowledge-graph-grounded policy optimization. RareDx-Harness normalizes heterogeneous records into one ranked-diagnosis task and compares direct inference, static retrieval, adaptive tools, and structured phenotype-gene-disease reasoning over a shared knowledge layer. The training pipeline combines Top-10 post-training with RareDx-KGPO, our knowledge-graph-grounded policy optimization method. Its reward projects predictions into a canonical disease graph and integrates curated graded relevance, ontology proximity, biomedical similarity, and phenotype consistency. Vocabulary and output-budget constraints prevent dense partial credit from rewarding fabricated or overlong differentials. Across eight benchmarks, the complete RareDx system centered on Qwen3.5-9B reaches 38.34 macro Hit@10, 1.60 points above GPT-5.5 under the archived protocol; a disjoint validation-selection audit retains a 6.80-point routing gain over Direct on held-out cases. The 27B system reaches 23.53/36.56/40.76 at Hit@1/5/10. Controlled ablations show that retrieval is not uniformly helpful and that controlled routing is central to the gain. These results indicate that structured medical knowledge can turn a compact model into a competitive diagnostic ranker across heterogeneous long-tail settings in clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RareDx 把稀有病诊断做成受控证据使用 + 知识图谱落地的策略优化：RareDx-Harness 将异构病历归一为统一的排序诊断任务，RareDx-KGPO 的奖励把预测投射到规范疾病图上并叠加词表与输出预算约束。八个基准上以 Qwen3.5-9B 为核心的完整系统 macro Hit@10 达 38.34，比 GPT-5.5 高 1.60 点；消融显示检索并非一律有益，受控路由才是增益来源。
Motivation: 稀有病诊断是长尾推理问题：表型不全、单个疾病文献稀少、证据分散在本体、基因注释与生物医学文本中，导致语言模型偏向常见病、漏掉稀有候选或编造看似合理但无效的病名。
Method: RareDx-Harness 把异构记录归一为单一排序诊断任务，在共享知识层上对比直接推理、静态检索、自适应工具与结构化 phenotype-gene-disease 推理四种模式；训练管线为 Top-10 post-training 加 RareDx-KGPO，其奖励将预测投影到规范疾病图，整合人工分级相关度、本体邻近度、生物医学相似性与表型一致性，并用词表和输出预算约束阻止密集部分分奖励伪造或超长鉴别诊断。
Result: 八个基准上，以 Qwen3.5-9B 为核心的完整 RareDx 系统 macro Hit@10 为 38.34，比 GPT-5.5 在 archived protocol 下高 1.60 点；不相交的 validation-selection 审计在留出病例上保留相对 Direct 的 6.80 点路由增益；27B 系统 Hit@1/5/10 分别为 23.53/36.56/40.76；受控消融显示检索并非一律有益。
Conclusion: 结构化医学知识加受控路由能把紧凑模型变成在异构长尾临床设置中有竞争力的诊断排序器，而检索本身不是稳定增益来源。

papers.title: Graph World Models for Constrained Epidemic Policy Planning
papers.abstract_en: Epidemic policy planning often requires coordination between geographical regions, taking into account mobility-driven spillovers and how to make use of limited resources. Existing methods either lack action-conditioned models of coupled dynamics or cannot guarantee per-period feasibility. We present EpiMind, a graph world model framework for constrained epidemic policy planning across regions. A graph-factored recurrent state-space model generates joint policy-conditioned rollouts from regional latent beliefs, while graph-temporal ADMM optimizes regional interventions, enforces shared-resource feasibility through projection, and evaluates temporal specifications under the learned model. EpiMind reduces admission RMSE by 29% relative to graph-free dynamics modeling, plans within 1-5% of the best feasible constant policy with guaranteed shared-budget feasibility, and outperforms all deployable baselines across three resource budgets in real-context evaluation. These results demonstrate that graph-structured policy imagination with explicit constrained coordination supports effective epidemic interventions from learned dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpiMind 用图世界模型 (graph world model) 做跨区域流行病策略规划：图分解循环状态空间模型从各区域隐状态生成带策略条件的联合 rollout，图-时间 ADMM 再解区域干预并用投影保证共享资源逐期可行。相对无图动力学建模 admission RMSE 降低 29%，规划结果落在最优可行常数策略的 1–5% 以内且共享预算始终可行，并在三种资源预算的真实情境评估中胜过全部可部署基线。
Motivation: 跨区域流行病干预要同时处理人口流动带来的外溢和有限资源的分配，现有方法要么缺少动作条件化的耦合动力学模型，要么无法保证每个时段的可行性。
Method: EpiMind 由两部分组成：图分解循环状态空间模型 (graph-factored recurrent state-space model) 从区域隐信念生成联合的、策略条件化的 rollout；图-时间 ADMM (graph-temporal ADMM) 优化各区域干预，通过投影强制共享资源可行，并在学到的模型上评估时序规格 (temporal specifications)。
Result: 相对无图 (graph-free) 动力学建模，admission RMSE 降低 29%；规划解在最优可行常数策略的 1–5% 以内且保证共享预算可行；在三种资源预算下的真实情境评估中优于所有可部署基线。
Conclusion: 带显式约束协调的图结构策略想象 (policy imagination) 能基于学到的动力学支持有效的流行病干预，同时保住逐期资源可行性。

papers.title: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify the top-ranked sycophancy feature from paired sycophantic and independent responses, then validate its behavioral influence through inference steering. We subsequently inject the selected feature during supervised fine-tuning on sycophantic targets. Positive injection reduces learned sycophancy after removal (by 62.0% relative to ordinary fine-tuning in 35B-A3B), whereas modest negative injection increases it. Unexpectedly, these reductions in sycophancy do not consistently improve direct refusal of harmful requests, motivating a narrower evaluation of the same harmful intents under user pressure. In this setting, ordinary fine-tuning on sycophantic responses substantially weakens refusal, while selected checkpoints trained with positive injection recover part of the loss, including approximately 95% in 35B-A3B. These findings show that persistent sycophancy reduction does not guarantee stronger direct refusal, while identifying recovery under user pressure as a distinct, conditional benefit of training intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用补偿性特征注入 (compensatory feature injection, CFI) 在 SFT 中压制谄媚 (sycophancy) 特征，谄媚度显著下降但直接拒绝能力并未随之增强；真正的收益出现在用户施压场景，35B-A3B 上正向注入的检查点恢复了约 95% 的拒绝损失。结论是谄媚削减不等于更强拒绝，收益只在压力条件下成立。
Motivation: 过度讨好用户可能削弱语言模型已有的拒绝能力，但减少谄媚能否在安全训练覆盖之外提升拒绝，此前缺少机制层面的检验路径。
Method: 在三个 Qwen3.5 base 模型上，用 sparse autoencoder (SAE) 从谄媚与独立回答配对中定位排名最高的谄媚特征，经推理 steering 验证其行为影响；随后在谄媚目标上做监督微调并注入该特征（正向/负向），再把同一批有害意图放到用户施压条件下重测。
Result: 正向注入使谄媚在移除后比普通微调降低 62.0%（35B-A3B），适度负向注入反而增加谄媚；谄媚下降并未一致改善对有害请求的直接拒绝；在用户施压设置下，普通谄媚微调大幅削弱拒绝，而正向注入检查点恢复了部分损失，35B-A3B 中约 95%。
Conclusion: 持续的谄媚削减不保证更强的直接拒绝，用户压力下的拒绝恢复才是训练干预的独立、条件性收益。

papers.title: Learning the Robustness Mechanism with Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose a distributionally robust learning framework where parameters defining the robustness mechanism are learned from held-out data instead of extensively tuned. Using bilevel optimization with both upper and lower level minimax problems, we create two instances of our framework to tackle setups with and without group labels in the training set. Theoretically, we provide sample complexity analysis for our robustness mechanism learning paradigm, showing that it achieves generalization guarantees comparable to exhaustive grid search while being more computationally efficient. Empirically, we evaluate our framework under a challenging setup when both intra-group and inter-group test distribution shifts occur at the same time, thereby demonstrating the efficacy and scalability of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分布鲁棒学习框架：把鲁棒性机制的参数（如不确定性集半径）从人工网格搜索改为用 held-out 数据通过双层优化学出来，上下层都是 minimax 问题，并给出有无 group label 两个实例。理论上其样本复杂度带来的泛化保证与穷举网格搜索相当但计算更省，同时组内与组间测试分布偏移同时发生时也有效且可扩展。
Motivation: 分布鲁棒学习中鲁棒性机制的参数通常靠大规模网格搜索调，代价高且依赖验证集；组内与组间偏移同时出现的设定下更难手调。
Method: 双层优化：上层在 held-out 数据上优化鲁棒机制参数，下层解 minimax 鲁棒训练问题；按训练集是否带 group label 构造两个实例，并给出该范式的样本复杂度分析。
Result: 样本复杂度分析显示泛化保证与穷举网格搜索相当而计算效率更高；在组内与组间测试分布偏移同时发生的挑战性设定下评估，展示了方法的有效性与可扩展性。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性机制的参数可以作为可学对象用双层 minimax 优化得到，在同等泛化保证下替代昂贵的网格搜索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continuous Context Management
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents commonly retain their complete interaction history until compaction is triggered at a predefined threshold. We study Continuous Context Management (CCM), which performs compaction at every turn to prevent interaction history from accumulating in the active prompt. At each turn, a CCM agent emits an updated memory together with an environment action; its next prompt contains the original task, retained memory, and newest observation rather than the complete transcript. We first evaluate CCM without fine-tuning on TerminalBench-2 using Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, GLM-5, and Kimi K3. CCM substantially reduces cumulative input usage and active-prompt size, although it lowers task success for most models while preserving performance for Kimi K3. We use GRPO with privileged full-history distillation to improve CCM in open-weight models. A frozen copy of the student's initial model scores each sampled student action under the complete history reconstructed from that student's rollout, providing dense action-token supervision without a separate teacher rollout or reference solution. On WebShop, this objective substantially improves CCM over GRPO at both evaluated model scales and surpasses full-history GRPO for Qwen3-4B-Instruct, though not for Qwen3-8B. On Endless Terminals, the augmented method provides a modest improvement over GRPO, with both CCM policies outperforming the untrained full-history baseline. These results demonstrate that CCM is a viable inference paradigm for agents operating with substantially reduced retained context and that its performance can be improved through reinforcement learning with privileged full-history distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Continuous Context Management (CCM)：LLM agent 每轮都做压缩，只保留任务、记忆与最新观测而非完整对话史。免微调在 TerminalBench-2 上 CCM 大幅降低累计输入用量与 active-prompt 体积，但多数模型任务成功率下降，仅 Kimi K3 保持性能；用带特权全历史蒸馏的 GRPO 训练后，WebShop 上超过全历史 GRPO（Qwen3-4B-Instruct 成立、Qwen3-8B 不成立）。
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 通常把完整交互史留到阈值才压缩，导致 active prompt 随轮次持续膨胀、输入开销高；需要一种每轮都在压缩、且能靠 RL 补回成功率的上下文范式。
Method: CCM 每轮让 agent 同时输出更新后的 memory 与环境动作，下一 prompt 只含原任务、保留记忆与最新观测。免微调评测用 Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Opus 4.6、GLM-5、Kimi K3 跑 TerminalBench-2；再用 GRPO 加特权全历史蒸馏：冻结的学生初始模型副本在该学生 rollout 重建的完整历史上为每个采样动作打分，产生稠密 action-token 监督，无需独立 teacher rollout 或参考解。
Result: TerminalBench-2 免微调：CCM 显著降低累计输入用量与 active-prompt 大小，但多数模型任务成功率下降，Kimi K3 性能保持。WebShop：该目标在两个评测规模上都明显优于 GRPO，并在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 上超过全历史 GRPO（Qwen3-8B 未超过）。Endless Terminals：增强方法相对 GRPO 有温和提升，且两种 CCM 策略都优于未训练的全历史基线。
Conclusion: CCM 是可行的 agent 推理范式：以大幅缩减的保留上下文运行，其成功率损失可用带特权全历史蒸馏的强化学习补回，且在较小模型上可追平甚至超过全历史训练。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: CCM 是可行的 agent 推理范式：以大幅缩减的保留上下文运行，其成功率损失可用带特权全历史蒸馏的强化学习补回，且在较小模型上可追平甚至超过全历史训练。

papers.title: Learning to Reason with Persistent Object States for Video Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Video segmentation models maintain object identities by carrying instance information across frames. Under prolonged occlusion, reappearance, or interactions between similar instances, however, an unreliable update can overwrite a valid history and cause persistent identity drift. We introduce POSReasoner, a trainable, plug-and-play framework that explicitly decides when an observation should change an object's state. Each persistent state records identity, confidence, and absence history. A sparse state-observation graph supports Propose-Verify reasoning: provisional associations are revisited using object history, predicted presence, and competition among identities. The verified decisions determine whether to retain, update, reactivate, or suppress each state, while a learned gate controls the evidence written back to memory. Only verified transitions update the persistent state used in subsequent frames. POSReasoner uses standard video annotations and keeps the base model frozen, enabling integration with diverse VOS and VIS architectures. Experiments across long-term VOS and VIS benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with the largest gains under occlusion and object reappearance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POSReasoner 用可训练的持久状态与 Propose-Verify 推理，显式判定观测何时才应改写目标状态：只有通过验证的转移（保留、更新、重激活、抑制）才写回记忆，未验证的观测不能覆盖有效历史。在长期 VOS/VIS 基准上相对强基线一致提升，遮挡与目标重现场景下增益最大。
Motivation: 长期遮挡、重现以及相似实例交互下，视频分割靠跨帧携带实例信息，一次不可靠更新会覆盖有效历史并造成持续的身份漂移。
Method: POSReasoner 是可训练、即插即用的框架：每个持久状态记录身份、置信度与缺席历史；稀疏 state-observation 图上做 Propose-Verify 推理，用目标历史、预测存在性与身份间竞争复核临时关联；学习到的门控控制写回记忆的证据，且只让通过验证的转移更新后续帧所用状态。训练只用标准视频标注，基线模型保持冻结，可接入不同 VOS 与 VIS 架构。
Result: 在长期 VOS 与 VIS 基准上的实验相对强基线取得一致提升，其中遮挡与目标重现条件下增益最大。
Conclusion: 把「观测是否该改状态」做成显式、可学习的验证决策，并只让验证过的转移写回持久状态，能在冻结基线模型的前提下缓解长期遮挡下的身份漂移。

papers.title: Optimal Networks for Agentic Information Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: We study information aggregation in the networked learning model introduced by Kearns, Roth, and Ryu (SODA 2026). There is a fixed distribution over $d$ features and a common label. Agents learn in topological order on a directed acyclic graph. Each observes a subset of the features and its parents' predictions, fits a linear predictor to minimize mean squared error, and passes only its prediction forward. The global predictor is the best linear predictor using all features. Kearns, Roth, and Ryu show that the output agent's error approaches the global predictor's error along sufficiently deep paths with suitable feature coverage, while insufficient depth can prevent aggregation even in large networks. In contrast to their main focus on a given graph and feature allocation, we consider the limits of the model under two settings. In the adaptive designer setting, a designer chooses the graph, feature allocation, and output agent knowing the distribution. In the oblivious designer setting, the designer fixes all three before an adversary chooses the distribution. Each agent observes one feature and receives predictions from a limited number of parents. We call the aggregation exact when the output agent matches the global predictor exactly. For $d\ge3$, we show that no finite depth guarantees exact aggregation for every distribution with one parent per agent, even when the designer knows the distribution. In contrast, two parents per agent suffice for exact aggregation even in the oblivious designer setting. A fixed graph, feature allocation, and output agent achieve this for every distribution at depth $O(d\log d)$. Knowing the distribution reduces the depth to $O(d)$. Both constructions use $O(d^2)$ agents, with a very large constant for two parents. We show the bounds on the depth and number of agents are all optimal up to constant factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Kearns 等人 (SODA 2026) 的网络化学习模型里，每个 agent 沿 DAG 拓扑序只看自己那份特征和父节点预测、拟合线性 MSE 预测器并只往下传预测。结果是：每个 agent 只有一个父节点时，即使设计者知道分布，d≥3 也不存在任何有限深度能对所有分布做到精确聚合；每个 agent 两个父节点就够， oblivious 设计者下深度 O(d log d)、adaptive（知道分布）下降到 O(d)，两者都用 O(d^2) 个 agent，且深度与 agent 数的界在常数因子内最优。
Motivation: Kearns 等人只刻画给定图与特征分配下沿足够深路径的渐近逼近，没有回答设计者能主动选图时的极限：深度不够就根本无法聚合，那么精确聚合（exact aggregation）到底需要多深、多少节点、几个父节点。
Method: 设定为固定 d 维特征分布与共同标签，agent 在有向无分环图上按拓扑序学习，各看一个特征与有限个父节点预测，拟合最小化均方误差的线性预测器并只传预测；比较 adaptive designer（知道分布后选图、特征分配与输出 agent）与 oblivious designer（先固定三者、再由对手选分布）两种博弈设定，目标是让输出 agent 精确复现使用全部特征的全局最优线性预测器。
Result: 对 d≥3，每个 agent 一个父节点时不存在任何有限深度能对所有分布保证精确聚合，adaptive designer 也不例外；每个 agent 两个父节点即可在 oblivious 设计者下精确聚合，固定图、特征分配与输出 agent 对所有分布深度为 O(d log d)，知道分布时降为 O(d)；两种构造都用 O(d^2) 个 agent（双父节点构造的常数极大），且深度与 agent 数的界在常数因子意义下全部最优。
Conclusion: 精确聚合的门槛是每个 agent 两个父节点：单父节点在 d≥3 时原则上做不到，双父节点则在最不利的 oblivious 设定下也能以 O(d log d) 深度、O(d^2) 规模实现，而知道分布只能把深度从 O(d log d) 压到 O(d)。

papers.title: Look Before You Judge: Training-Free Region Mining for Grounded and Explainable Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练框架 Look Before You Judge，把可解释深伪检测改写为顺序取证：先用 MLLM 解码器到视觉的注意力在原图与高斯模糊图之间的差异定位候选证据区域，再逐区检查并结合全局上下文给出判定。在五个开源 MLLM、TriDF 与 MMTD-Set 上，检测准确率最高提升 12.8%，CHAIR 最高降 33.4%，幻觉率最高降 21.3%。
Motivation: MLLM 给出的深伪判定解释未必真的锚定在图像证据上，可能只是从语言先验编出的合理伪影描述；现有 grounding 干预作用于整图，抓不住细微、空间局部、依赖具体图像的取证痕迹。
Method: 免训练、无需操纵掩码与外部取证模型、不更新参数：对比原图与高斯模糊对应图的 decoder-to-visual 注意力，筛出图像特有的候选证据区域；逐个区域检查后把局部证据与全局图像上下文整合再判定，直接套用现成 MLLM。
Result: 在五个开源 MLLM 上、TriDF 与 MMTD-Set 数据集上，检测准确率最高提升 12.8%，CHAIR 最高降低 33.4%，幻觉率最高降低 21.3%，并优于有代表性的免训练解码与注意力方法。
Conclusion: 先定位再判定的顺序取证能让 MLLM 的深伪解释更贴合图像证据，同时提高准确率并压低幻觉，且无需训练即可套到现成模型上。
