papers.title: ARISE: Adapting to Evolving Capability Gaps in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: As a long-horizon agent improves through experience, previously observed weaknesses may recede while new limitations emerge, continually changing what it still needs to learn. Yet the learning process often remains tied to a static view of these needs: fixed behavioral criteria and training priorities can become misaligned with evolving agent capabilities, while sparse task-level feedback makes such misalignment more difficult to detect. Even when capability gaps are identified, rollouts from the current policy may repeatedly reproduce the same failures rather than explore better alternatives. To address this, we introduce Adaptive Rubric-Skill Co-Evolution (ARISE), a reinforcement learning framework that uses rollout evidence to continually adapt evaluation criteria, exploration guidance, and training priorities. Rubrics evolve to reward partial behavioral progress, while their paired skills are refined and selectively activated to guide exploration toward unresolved weaknesses. Alongside this co-evolution, capability-based adaptive sampling prioritizes tasks that target behaviors needing further improvement. Experiments on two challenging long-horizon agent benchmarks, SkillsBench and Terminal-Bench, demonstrate that ARISE successfully enhances both overall task performance and training efficiency. The project page is at https://foundation-model-research.github.io/ARISE .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARISE 让长程智能体的评估 rubric、配对技能与训练优先级随能力缺口共同演化：rubric 奖励部分行为进展，技能被细化并选择性激活以引导探索，能力自适应采样优先抽取仍需改进的任务。在 SkillsBench 与 Terminal-Bench 两个长程智能体基准上，ARISE 同时提升整体任务性能与训练效率。
Motivation: 长程智能体训练中，旧弱点消退、新短板出现，但固定的行为标准与训练优先级与能力脱节；稀疏的任务级反馈使这种错配难以被发现，且当前策略的 rollout 会反复复现同样的失败而非探索更优解。
Method: ARISE（Adaptive Rubric-Skill Co-Evolution）用 rollout 证据持续调整三者：rubric 演化以奖励部分行为进展，配对技能被细化并选择性激活以引导探索指向未解决的弱点，能力自适应采样 (capability-based adaptive sampling) 优先选择针对待改进行为的任务。
Result: 在 SkillsBench 与 Terminal-Bench 两个具挑战性的长程智能体基准上，ARISE 同时提升了整体任务性能与训练效率。
Conclusion: 把评估标准、探索引导和训练优先级与智能体能力一起共同演化，可以在长程智能体 RL 中同时改善任务表现和训练效率。

papers.title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image. However, multi-reference image generation remains challenging: models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which multiple subjects appear unnaturally pasted. Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation models, reasoning models, and a harness, which is an executable program that specifies how reference images are interpreted, how generation is performed, how outputs are diagnosed, and how the final image is selected. In multi-reference generation, however, references play different roles and outputs must satisfy many criteria at once, such as fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image, so many parts of the harness could be improved, from how references are processed to how outputs are diagnosed. This makes it hard to predict which changes will improve performance and by how much, and good harnesses difficult to design by hand; indeed, human-written harnesses vary widely in performance. We therefore propose AutoRef, which optimizes the harness automatically while keeping both models frozen: a coding agent iteratively rewrites the harness code. AutoRef separates the tasks whose feedback informs proposals from the tasks used to select candidates, and continues the search from a beam of the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks. Using this procedure, we discover AutoRef-Harness, which improves the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B from 5.72 to 7.37 on held-out four-reference tasks of the MultiBanana benchmark, matching or exceeding proprietary models including Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5. Without re-optimization, the same harness also improves results when the generator, number of references, benchmark, evaluator, or reasoning model differs from those used in the search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoRef 用一个 coding agent 迭代重写多参考图像生成 agent 的 harness 代码，在生成模型与推理模型都冻结的前提下自动优化 harness，并把用于产生反馈的任务与用于筛选候选的任务分开、从 selection 任务上的 top-ranked beam 续搜。由此得到的 AutoRef-Harness 把 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 在 MultiBanana 四参考 held-out 任务上的得分从 5.72 提到 7.37，匹配或超过 Nano Banana Pro、GPT-Image-1.5 等闭源模型，且换生成器、参考数、benchmark、evaluator 或推理模型后无需重优化仍有效。
Motivation: 多参考图像生成中模型会遗漏或重复参考主体、或把主体生硬拼贴；harness 决定参考如何解析、生成如何执行、输出如何诊断与选择，可改进点多到难以靠手写预测哪处改动有效，而人写的 harness 性能差异很大。
Method: AutoRef 冻结图像生成模型与推理模型，由 coding agent 迭代改写 harness 程序；将任务分为提供反馈指导提案的 tasks 与用于筛选候选的 selection tasks，并从 selection 任务上排名靠前的 harness beam 继续搜索。
Result: 在 MultiBanana benchmark 的 held-out 四参考任务上，FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 得分由 5.72 提升至 7.37，匹配或超过 Nano Banana Pro 与 GPT-Image-1.5；同一 harness 在生成器、参考数量、benchmark、evaluator 或推理模型与搜索时不同的设定下无需重新优化仍带来提升。
Conclusion: harness 可以在模型冻结的条件下被自动优化，且在搜索任务上学到的 harness 能跨生成器、参考数、benchmark、evaluator 与推理模型泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Let the Neurons Die: Exploiting ReLU-Induced Model Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Rectified linear unit (ReLU) networks can suffer from dying neurons, where units with persistently negative pre-activations produce zero outputs, blocking gradients through their activations. To exploit this failure mode, we present three training-time availability attacks based on data ordering and poisoning. We begin with the basic dynamic data-ordering attack (DOA), which greedily constructs a training prefix by selecting the next example that minimizes the target layer's post-update weight sum, aiming to push ReLU units toward negative pre-activations without modifying training samples or labels. We then develop two poisoning attacks, IG-DOA and IG-SKA, which use gradient inversion to synthesize class-conditioned samples by matching reference gradients in adverse model states constructed through data ordering or soft knockout, respectively. Soft knockout rearranges weights across adjacent layers to concentrate negative contributions. On a fully connected ReLU network trained on MNIST, ordering 100 of 60,000 training examples reduces test accuracy from 96% to 95% after only five epochs. Adding 200 poisoned samples from a single class reduces test accuracy to approximately 86-88% after five epochs in most evaluated conditions, compared with approximately 96% under clean training. These results demonstrate that ReLU-targeted data ordering and poisoning can impair learning without directly modifying the victim model's parameters.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4Good) Workshop @ ICML 2026 in Seoul, South Korea; Presented as a poster on July 10, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 ReLU 网络的 dying neuron 失效模式，提出三种训练期可用性攻击：动态数据排序攻击 (DOA) 贪心挑选使目标层更新后权重和最小的样本，把 ReLU 单元推向负 pre-activation；再用梯度反演 (gradient inversion) 合成类条件毒样本，得到 IG-DOA 与 IG-SKA（配 soft knockout 重排相邻层权重）。在 MNIST 全连接 ReLU 网络上，仅重排 60,000 训练样本中的 100 个，5 个 epoch 后测试准确率从 96% 降到 95%；再加 200 个单类毒样本，多数条件下 5 个 epoch 后降到约 86–88%（干净训练约 96%）。
Motivation: ReLU 的 dying neuron 本是训练失效模式，但现有攻击研究未把它当作可被数据侧操纵的杠杆；需要在不改动受害者模型参数与标签的前提下破坏其学习。
Method: 三种训练期攻击：DOA 用贪心数据排序构造训练前缀，选下一个使目标层 post-update weight sum 最小的样本；IG-DOA 与 IG-SKA 用梯度反演匹配参考梯度、合成类条件毒样本，参考梯度分别由数据排序或 soft knockout（跨相邻层重排权重以集中负贡献）构造的不利模型状态产生。
Result: 在 MNIST 上训练的全连接 ReLU 网络：重排 60,000 个训练样本中的 100 个，仅 5 个 epoch 后测试准确率由 96% 降至 95%；再加入 200 个来自单一类别的毒样本，多数评估条件下 5 个 epoch 后测试准确率降至约 86–88%，而干净训练约 96%。
Conclusion: 仅靠数据排序与毒样本合成即可在不直接修改受害者模型参数的情况下损害 ReLU 网络学习，说明 dying neuron 可被主动利用为训练期可用性攻击面。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GeoGAE: Scalable Graph-Level Autoencoding via Hyperball Cloud Representations
papers.abstract_en: Embedding structured objects into Euclidean spaces has enabled a wide range of successful machine learning applications. Such objects include words, documents, image patches, time series, and graph nodes. In contrast, embedding entire graphs remains a challenging problem. Existing methods either sustain the original order of the graph nodes or match the output nodes to the input ones, both of which create scalability issues. In this work, we propose a graph representation as a cloud of hyperballs, which allows us to define a specific, typically unique, node ordering. Based on this representation, we propose GeoGAE, an autoencoder, in which the Transformer encoder translates a hyperball cloud into a graph-level embedding, and the Transformer decoder translates the graph-level embedding back into the graph. This formulation enables the model to capture both the global graph structure and local relational patterns. We evaluate our method on multiple graph datasets, spanning various domains. The results demonstrate effectiveness of our method in encoding and reconstructing graphs from their embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoGAE 用超球云 (hyperball cloud) 表示整张图，从而定义出通常唯一的节点顺序，Transformer 编码器把超球云压成图级嵌入，解码器再还原成图。在多个跨领域图数据集上验证了图的编码与重构有效性。
Motivation: 整图嵌入仍是难题：现有方法要么保留原节点顺序、要么把输出节点与输入节点对齐，两者都带来可扩展性问题。
Method: 提出超球云图表示以获得特定且通常唯一的节点顺序；GeoGAE 自编码器中 Transformer 编码器将超球云转为图级嵌入，Transformer 解码器再将该嵌入译回图，以同时刻画全局图结构与局部关系模式。
Result: 在覆盖多个领域的多个图数据集上评估，结果表明该方法在从嵌入编码与重构图方面有效；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 以超球云加唯一节点顺序的自编码表述，可让整图嵌入同时保留全局结构与局部关系并保持可扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Epistemic Value Functions for Optimistic Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Principled exploration in reinforcement learning requires an agent to quantify its epistemic uncertainty and act to resolve it. Uncertainty over the value function provides a natural signal for exploration, yet existing deep approximations remain brittle and perform inconsistently. The central challenge is therefore to scale these ideas robustly. We conduct a systematic empirical study of how epistemic uncertainty is represented, propagated, and optimized in deep epistemic value functions, and uncover distinct failure modes along each of these axes. These findings motivate DEVOTE, a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm that controls how uncertainty generalizes beyond observed data, stabilizes its temporal propagation, and preserves adaptation to the resulting non-stationary exploration objective. Across reward-free exploration and challenging continuous-control tasks, DEVOTE reaches novel states more effectively and achieves higher task return than strong model-free and model-based exploration baselines. These results provide evidence that deep epistemic value functions are a promising path toward scalable, principled exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文系统研究深度认知价值函数中认知不确定性的表示、传播与优化三条轴上的失效模式，并据此提出 model-free 强化学习算法 DEVOTE：控制不确定性在观测数据之外的泛化、稳定其时序传播，并保持对由此产生的非平稳探索目标的适应。在 reward-free exploration 与高难连续控制任务上，DEVOTE 比较强的 model-free 与 model-based 探索基线更快到达新状态并取得更高任务回报。
Motivation: 价值函数上的认知不确定性是原则性探索的自然信号，但现有深度近似脆弱、表现不一致，核心难题是如何把这些想法稳健地扩展到大规模深度设定。
Method: 先对深度认知价值函数中不确定性的表示、传播与优化做系统实证研究，沿三条轴各找出不同失效模式；再据此设计 model-free 算法 DEVOTE，分别约束不确定性超出已观测数据时的泛化方式、稳定其时序传播，并维持对非平稳探索目标的适应能力。
Result: 在 reward-free exploration 与具有挑战性的连续控制任务上，DEVOTE 比较强的 model-free 与 model-based 探索基线更有效地到达新状态，并取得更高任务回报；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为深度认知价值函数是通向可扩展、原则性探索的一条有前景的路径，前提是同时管住不确定性的泛化、时序传播与对非平稳目标的适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Token Scale: Chunk-Level Sparse Autoencoders for Reliable Semantic Feature Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose features that help us understand and steer language models, but faithful reconstruction does not guarantee informative concepts. Token-level objectives reward lexical and formatting details alongside semantic content, all competing for a limited sparse budget. We introduce a family of chunk-level SAEs that encode mean-pooled activations over chunks, each a contiguous span of tokens: Mean-Chunk reconstructs the observed chunk, Cross-Chunk predicts an independently processed neighbor, and Joint-Chunk combines both targets. These designs separate the effect of a larger observation unit from that of predicting information shared across passages. With matched training data, chunk-level SAEs remain powerful interpretability tools while learning reliable semantic features that capture high-level concepts and respond selectively to relevant content. Their strengths are complementary: Mean-Chunk improves high-level feature discovery, reasoning detection beyond surface cues, and steering; Cross-Chunk leads document retrieval and classification transfer while producing selective, persistent features. Changing what an SAE sees and predicts yields reliable semantic features for more meaningful tasks. We demonstrate their practical value through gains across downstream tasks such as retrieval, reasoning detection, and steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SAE 的重建单元从 token 换成连续 chunk，提出 Mean-Chunk（重建均值池化后的 chunk）、Cross-Chunk（预测独立处理的邻近 chunk）与 Joint-Chunk（两者结合）三种目标，以分离“更大观察单元”与“跨段落预测共享信息”各自的作用。在检索、推理检测与 steering 等下游任务上均带来增益：Mean-Chunk 擅长高层特征发现与超越表面线索的推理检测，Cross-Chunk 在文档检索与分类迁移上领先并产出选择性、持久的特征。
Motivation: token 级 SAE 目标会把词法与格式细节和语义内容一起塞进有限的稀疏预算，忠实重建并不等于学到有信息量的概念。
Method: 对连续 token span（chunk）的均值池化激活做编码，训练三种目标：Mean-Chunk 重建该 chunk，Cross-Chunk 预测一个独立处理的邻居 chunk，Joint-Chunk 同时用两个目标；三者使用匹配的训练数据，从而区分观察单元变大与跨段落预测的贡献。
Result: 在匹配训练数据下，chunk 级 SAE 仍是有效的可解释性工具，并学到能捕捉高层概念、对相关内容选择性响应的可靠语义特征；下游任务上 Mean-Chunk 改善高层特征发现、超越表面线索的推理检测与 steering，Cross-Chunk 在文档检索和分类迁移上领先且产出选择性、持久的特征。
Conclusion: 改变 SAE 的观察对象与预测目标本身就能产出更可靠的语义特征，且三种目标的强项互补，应按下游任务（检索选 Cross-Chunk，推理检测与 steering 选 Mean-Chunk）来选目标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model with dense feedback from a stronger teacher on student-generated trajectories. Yet standard OPD weights token-level distillation terms uniformly, implicitly treating local teacher preference as a proxy for correction utility. A decision's task value, however, depends on how the student completes the subsequent reasoning. This mismatch can cause imitation to suppress viable student strategies or reinforce paths the student cannot reliably execute. Verified trajectory outcomes provide complementary evidence about continuation quality, but do not directly identify the utility of individual decisions. We introduce Reward-Aligned Reweighting for On-Policy Distillation (R$^{2}$-OPD), which uses outcome agreement and the magnitude of teacher--student disagreement to continuously reallocate teacher supervision. It gives reward-aligned corrections greater relative influence while retaining dense feedback, moving beyond uniform imitation and hard filtering. Our analysis formalizes the mismatch between local teacher preference and student continuation value and establishes sufficient conditions for reallocation to improve first-order task progress over uniform OPD. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, R$^{2}$-OPD achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared training methods in both cross-size and same-size distillation. It outperforms standard OPD on all seven benchmarks, with average gains of 3.5 and 2.4 percentage points for 1.7B and 4B students, respectively. An extension to code generation yields an average gain of 1.6 percentage points over standard OPD. These results highlight outcome-guided supervision allocation as an effective way to translate dense teacher feedback into stronger student performance across model scales and task domains.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: MechBench: Can AI Scientific Agents Discover Mechanisms Beyond Phenomenal Laws?
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires not only recovering mathematical laws that describe observable behavior, but also identifying the mechanisms that generate them. Existing benchmarks for symbolic regression and scientific agents primarily evaluate phenomenal-law recovery, leaving mechanism discovery largely untested. We introduce MechBench, a benchmark that explicitly separates these two capabilities. Each task is defined by a mechanistic model, a structured set of scientifically meaningful relations whose joint consequences entail an observable phenomenal law, while agents receive only observational data and scientific context. We evaluate mechanism recovery through mechanism probes, which query internal scientific consequences that cannot be inferred from the phenomenal law alone. To reduce reliance on memorized textbook mechanisms, we construct unfamiliar variants through controlled, scientifically interpretable mutations of canonical mechanisms, and screen for mechanistic indistinguishability to exclude ambiguous instances admitting comparable competing mechanisms. Experiments across representative scientific agents reveal a substantial phenomenal--mechanism recovery gap: for Codex with GPT-5.6-sol, phenomenal-law accuracy reaches 35.00% on the Core-set while mechanism accuracy is only 13.75%, with mechanism recovery failing in 64.29% of cases where the phenomenal law is correctly recovered. The gap widens as mechanisms become increasingly mutated, and even providing the correct phenomenal law leaves mechanism recovery below 50%. These results reveal a substantial generalization gap in mechanistic reasoning and establish mechanism discovery as a distinct challenge beyond recovering observable scientific laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MechBench 把科学发现拆成现象规律恢复与机制发现两层，任务只给观测数据和科学背景，用机制探针 (mechanism probes) 查询无法从现象规律反推的内部后果，并用可控变异构造陌生机制、筛除可被竞争机制解释的歧义样本。Codex + GPT-5.6-sol 在 Core-set 上现象规律准确率 35.00%，机制准确率仅 13.75%，且在现象规律答对的案例中有 64.29% 机制恢复失败；即便直接给出正确现象规律，机制恢复仍低于 50%。
Motivation: 符号回归与科学 agent 基准几乎只考现象规律恢复，机制发现这一层能力基本未被测试，无法区分模型是记住了教科书机制还是真的做了机制推理。
Method: 每个任务由一个机理模型定义：一组科学上有意义的关系，其联合后果蕴含可观测的现象规律，agent 只拿到观测数据与科学背景；用机制探针查询仅凭现象规律无法推出的内部科学后果来判定机制恢复；对经典机制做科学可解释的受控变异生成陌生变体，并做机制不可区分性筛选以排除存在可比竞争机制的歧义样本。
Result: Codex + GPT-5.6-sol 在 Core-set 上现象规律准确率 35.00%，机制准确率 13.75%；现象规律答对的案例中 64.29% 机制恢复失败。机制变异程度越大，现象—机制差距越宽；即使提供正确现象规律，机制恢复准确率仍低于 50%。
Conclusion: 机制发现是独立于可观测规律恢复的挑战，现有科学 agent 在机制推理上存在显著泛化缺口，而非仅缺现象层面的拟合能力。

papers.title: One Proposal for Every Margin: Zero-Shot Amortized Sequential Importance Sampling for Binary Matrices
papers.abstract_en: In ecology, psychometrics, and the analysis of social and financial networks, binary matrices are often analyzed conditional on their observed row and column sums, which restricts the problem to a finite sample space of matrices with the same margins. Two fundamental problems are to count this space and to sample uniformly from it. Sequential importance sampling (SIS) addresses both with independent weighted samples and an unbiased count estimator, but its efficiency depends critically on the proposal distribution. Existing proposals are analytically designed, and their accuracy can vary substantially with the margins. We show that the ideal SIS proposal, under which every weight equals the count and the variance vanishes, is exactly the policy of a generative flow network (GFlowNet) with unit reward on every matrix that has the given margins. We therefore propose MarginFlow, a framework that turns the design of the proposal into a learning problem and amortizes it across margins by exploiting their self-similarity. Every partial matrix is itself an instance with reduced margins, so one set transformer that reads the remaining margins serves every margin. We train MarginFlow on a pool of 1904 margins and evaluate it zero-shot on 1190 held-out margins, synthetic and real, from $3\times3$ to $870\times6$. On 1187 of the 1190 margins it matches or beats the best of 31 analytically designed configurations, chosen post hoc for each margin, and its median effective sample fraction is 99.8%. On the 56 margins where that best loses more than one nat of effective sample size, MarginFlow wins every one and raises the median effective sample fraction from 10.3% to 94.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MarginFlow 把给定行和列边际 (margins) 的二元矩阵计数与均匀采样问题中 SIS 提案分布的设计转成学习问题：最优 SIS 提案恰是单位奖励下 GFlowNet 的策略，一个读取剩余 margins 的 set transformer 可跨所有 margins 复用。在 1904 个 margins 上训练后对 1190 个 held-out margins 零样本评测，1187 个上匹配或超过事后挑选的 31 种解析配置中最好的一种，中位有效样本分数 99.8%；在最优解析配置损失超过 1 nat 的 56 个 margins 上全胜，中位数从 10.3% 提到 94.1%。
Motivation: 给定行和列和的二元矩阵空间既要计数又要均匀采样，SIS 的效率几乎完全取决于提案分布，而现有提案是解析设计的，精度随 margins 变化很大。
Method: 证明理想 SIS 提案（每个权重等于计数、方差为零）正是单位奖励下生成流网络 (GFlowNet) 的策略；据此提出 MarginFlow，用一个读取剩余 margins 的 set transformer 处理任意部分矩阵（其本身是 margins 缩小的实例），把提案设计变成可跨 margins 摊销 (amortized) 的学习问题，在 1904 个 margins 池上训练。
Result: 零样本评测 1190 个 held-out margins（合成与真实，尺寸 3×3 到 870×6）：1187 个上匹配或超过 31 种解析配置中事后逐 margins 挑选的最优者，中位有效样本分数 (effective sample fraction) 99.8%；在最优解析配置损失超过 1 nat 有效样本量的 56 个 margins 上，MarginFlow 全部获胜，中位有效样本分数从 10.3% 提升到 94.1%。
Conclusion: SIS 提案分布可以作为 GFlowNet 策略来学并跨 margins 摊销，一个 set transformer 即可服务所有 margins，在解析提案失效的难 margins 上带来最大收益。

papers.title: Improving Generative Model Self-Training with Geometrically Modified Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Self-training generative models - the continued improvement of a model using its own outputs - is becoming increasingly important as high-quality training data becomes scarce. However, naively finetuning on model-generated samples leads to degradation through model collapse and the model autophagy disorder. Negative-guidance self-training methods turn this degradation into a useful signal, using a model finetuned on its own outputs to guide the original model toward improved generation. Existing methods, however, take the negative signal in standard model outputs as given. We instead ask whether this signal can be explicitly strengthened. We introduce Geometrically Modified Outputs (GMOs), which reweight the singular values of the generator's input-output Jacobian to increase the influence of its leading singular directions. This geometric modification amplifies the mode-seeking behavior and distortions of standard outputs, providing a stronger and more targeted negative signal for self-training. Across a range of one-step generative models, GMOs consistently improve the performance of negative-guidance methods, including Neon and SIMS, compared with using standard model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Geometrically Modified Outputs (GMOs)：对生成器输入-输出 Jacobian 的奇异值重加权、放大主奇异方向，从而放大标准输出的 mode-seeking 行为与失真，为负引导自训练 (negative-guidance self-training) 提供更强的负信号。在一系列 one-step 生成模型上，GMO 相比直接用标准模型输出，一致提升了 Neon、SIMS 等负引导方法的性能。
Motivation: 高质量训练数据趋稀缺时，直接在模型自身输出上微调会引发 model collapse 与 model autophagy disorder；现有负引导自训练方法把标准输出中的负信号当作既定输入，缺少放大该信号的手段。
Method: GMO 对生成器输入-输出 Jacobian 的奇异值重加权以增强主奇异方向的影响，几何上放大标准输出的 mode-seeking 与失真，作为更强、更定向的负信号注入负引导自训练流程；在多种 one-step 生成模型上与 Neon、SIMS 等负引导方法结合检验。
Result: 在一系列 one-step 生成模型上，GMO 相比使用标准模型输出，一致改善了负引导方法（包括 Neon 和SIMS）的性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 负信号可以被显式几何放大：重加权 Jacobian 奇异值放大标准输出的失真后，负引导自训练在 one-step 生成模型上稳定受益。

papers.title: ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA, a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReVA 是面向遥感视频问答的新基准：2,438 段无人机视频、覆盖全球 18 城共 580K 帧，配 22K 高质量问答对、覆盖 11 类 QA 任务，用半自动标注流水线（Text LLM/MLLM 生成加人工核验）产出。在 ReVA 上评测 23 个闭源与开源 Video LLM，暴露出现有模型在时空与场景中心推理上的根本局限。
Motivation: 现有遥感多模态推理基准依赖模板化问题导致题目重复，且只用静态图像，无法覆盖无人机视频的时序性，遥感视频推理的系统性评测基本空白。
Method: 构建 ReVA 数据集：2,438 段无人机视频、18 城、580K 帧、22K QA 对、11 类任务；标注采用半自动流水线，由 Text LLM 与 MLLM 生成问答再经人工核验；随后评测 23 个专有与开源 Video LLM。
Result: 数据规模为 2,438 段无人机视频、18 座城市、580K 帧、22K QA 对、11 类任务；共评测 23 个专有与开源 Video LLM，暴露其在时空与场景中心推理上的根本局限。
Conclusion: 遥感视频问答需要专门的场景中心、时序推理基准，ReVA 被定位为通向真实部署中遥感视频理解评测的关键基准。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$ regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and diverse teacher-student settings, with average gains of +1.59 points in Avg@16. Remarkably, through Pass@k evaluations up to k=64, we found that LSPD better preserves policy diversity by achieving stronger performance as k grows. Its fully off-policy variant achieves comparable performance to vanilla OPD using only the first 25% of rollout batches. Together, these results provide an RL perspective on OPD that offers both a principled interpretation and a practical route toward more effective and rollout-efficient language model distillation.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables, code available at https://github.com/UNCSciML/LSPD

papers.title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SolveEdit 提出以场景变换为形式的视觉问题求解基准：给定图像与目标，模型需推断合法变换并执行，同时保护无关内容。基准含 2,728 个案例，用 atomic transition contracts 定义必需与受保护条件，SolveScore 在无单一参考输出下同时度量完成度与意外改动；最强被测模型仅得 57.0% SolveScore。两阶段视觉规划器 SolveEdit-Plan 先实例化变换再生成，在匹配的单次生成评测下平均提升 9.1 分，GPT-Image-2 从 57.0% 升至 71.6%。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评测感知、生成或已显式指定的变换，目标驱动的视觉问题求解（推断要改什么并执行、不破坏无关内容）被系统性忽略。
Method: 构建 SolveEdit 基准（2,728 个案例），每例给图像与目标，要求模型从请求、场景或视觉规则推断变换；用 atomic transition contracts 标注必需条件与受保护条件，SolveScore 据此度量完成度与意外改动，无需单一参考输出。另提出两阶段规划器 SolveEdit-Plan：先实例化变换再交给生成器执行。
Result: 基准含 2,728 个案例；最强被测模型 SolveScore 仅 57.0%。在匹配的单次生成评测下，SolveEdit-Plan 平均提升 9.1 分（跨三个被测生成器），其中 GPT-Image-2 从 57.0% 提到 71.6%，编辑器本身不作修改。
Conclusion: 目标驱动的视觉问题求解对当前生成模型仍然困难（最强仅 57.0%），而先规划变换再生成的两阶段分解能在不改编辑器的前提下显著提高完成度并抑制无关改动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Latent Modeling for Supervised Multimodal Information Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal prediction relies on diverse forms of evidence: information repeated across modalities, cues specific to a single source, and complex cross-modal dependencies that emerge only when inputs are considered together. While recent methods promote richer interactions, they lack a principled way to isolate these target-relative contributions within learned continuous representations. We introduce a framework that applies contrastive or masked objectives at intermediate layers, coupled with source-wise invertible normalizing flows and a supervised, low-rank latent variable model. This architecture explicitly factorizes the joint distribution into shared task-relevant variation, modality-specific predictive variation, and task-irrelevant dependence. Drawing connections to prior multimodal learning assumptions, our approach evaluates how modalities independently and jointly contribute to the target. Ultimately, this framework unites intermediate representation learning with structured likelihood-based guidance, offering a practical latent-variable lens for characterizing continuous multimodal interactions. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across diverse multimodal benchmarks, showing robust improvements in predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出监督式多模态信息分解框架：在中间层施加对比或掩码目标，配合逐源可逆归一化流与低秩潜变量模型，把联合分布显式分解为共享任务相关变异、模态特异预测变异和任务无关依赖。在多个多模态基准上预测性能有稳健提升。
Motivation: 现有方法虽促进更丰富的模态交互，却缺少原则性手段在学习到的连续表示中隔离出相对于目标的各类贡献（共享、模态特异、跨模态依赖）。
Method: 中间层应用对比或掩码目标 (contrastive/masked objectives)，结合逐源可逆归一化流 (source-wise invertible normalizing flows) 与有监督低秩潜变量模型，将联合分布显式因子化为共享任务相关变异、模态特异预测变异、任务无关依赖，并据此评估各模态独立与联合对目标的贡献。
Result: 在多个多模态基准上展示方法有效性，预测性能获得稳健提升（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把中间表示学习与基于结构化似然的指导统一起来，可用潜变量视角刻画连续多模态交互并量化模态贡献。

papers.title: SRHarness: A Harness for Agentic Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Recent agentic symbolic regression approaches increasingly rely on large language models to analyze data, select scientific operations, and refine hypotheses over long search trajectories. In such systems, performance depends not only on the underlying model and search strategy, but also on the runtime infrastructure that supports scientific search. We introduce SRHarness, a domain-specific harness for agentic symbolic regression built around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions that provide a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management that coordinates continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRBench, SRHarness consistently improves both numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones. With DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731, it achieves 93.69% symbolic accuracy on LSR-Transform, compared with 62.16% for SR-Scientist, and retains 72.97% accuracy on an anonymized variant that removes scientific descriptions and variable semantics, versus 39.64% for SR-Scientist. Under the same DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 backbone, SRHarness also substantially outperforms Codex (72.97% vs. 20.72%) and reaches performance comparable to Codex with GPT-5.5, while simply providing Codex with the same scientific tools does not reproduce this advantage. These results show that effective agentic symbolic regression depends not only on models or tools, but also on structured runtime support for organizing scientific actions, accumulated hypotheses, and long-horizon search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRHarness 为 agentic 符号回归提供领域专用运行时：可组合的科学动作、持久化科学状态与轨迹生命周期管理。在 LLM-SRBench 上，同一 DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 骨干下 LSR-Transform 符号准确率 93.69%（SR-Scientist 62.16%），匿名变体 72.97%（39.64%），Codex 20.72%。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的符号回归依赖长搜索轨迹，性能不只取决于模型与搜索策略，还取决于支撑科学搜索的运行时基础设施；缺少结构化运行时会让已评估假设与长程搜索组织不起来。
Method: SRHarness 含三个机制：composable scientific actions 为原始量、变换量与候选派生量提供统一接口；persistent scientific state 保留已评估假设并暴露紧凑的模型侧视图；trajectory lifecycle management 协调 continuation、branching、restart 与 termination。评测在 LLM-SRBench 上进行，匹配 LLM 骨干对比。
Result: 在 LLM-SRBench 上，同一 DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731 骨干下 SRHarness 在 LSR-Transform 取得 93.69% 符号准确率（SR-Scientist 62.16%），在移除科学描述与变量语义的匿名变体上保持 72.97%（SR-Scientist 39.64%）；同骨干下 Codex 为 20.72%，SRHarness 达到与 GPT-5.5 骨干的 Codex 相当的水平，而仅给 Codex 提供相同科学工具并不能复现该优势。
Conclusion: agentic 符号回归的有效性不只取决于模型或工具，还取决于组织科学动作、累积假设与长程搜索的结构化运行时支持。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Conditional Diffusion Model for Rare Event Synthesis and Diagnosis for the Water-Gas Shift Reaction
papers.abstract_en: As the world moves towards sustainable energy sources, hydrogen (H2) can be treated as an eco-friendly alternative to fossil fuels due to its high energy density and zero carbon emissions. The water-gas shift (WGS) reaction is a widely used industrial process for hydrogen production by converting carbon monoxide and steam into hydrogen and carbon dioxide. However, occurrences like severe fouling, catalyst deterioration, and thermal runaway can hamper the reaction kinetics/process safety and decrease the yield of H2. These incidents are rare, and gathering process data under such abnormal conditions is challenging. In this work, we propose a physics-guided conditional diffusion model to generate realistic rare-event trajectories for the WGS reaction. The proposed model integrates a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (CDDPM) with governing laws of the reaction to generate physically consistent process trajectories. The conditioning features allow the model to produce high-quality synthetic profiles for rare-event domains that are typically beyond the training regimes. The generated rare-event trajectories then augment the raw dataset for a balanced distribution between normal and abnormal conditions. We further propose a hazard score to assess the risk severity of the operating condition based on the operating trajectory. Deep learning models are trained with the augmented dataset to diagnose the health status of the reaction. Simulation results show that the proposed physics-guided diffusion model outperforms data-driven models in terms of the quality of synthetic data and diagnosis performance for rare events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对水气变换 (WGS) 反应中结焦、催化剂失活、飞温等罕见异常轨迹难以采集的问题，提出物理引导的条件扩散模型 (CDDPM)，把反应控制方程嵌入条件去噪过程生成物理一致的稀有事件轨迹，再用其增广数据集训练诊断模型并给出风险严重度 hazard score。仿真结果显示该模型在合成数据质量与罕见事件诊断性能上优于纯数据驱动模型。
Motivation: WGS 反应的严重异常事件发生稀少，正常工况数据远多于异常工况，难以采集到覆盖异常域的过程数据，导致诊断模型训练分布失衡。
Method: 将条件去噪扩散概率模型 (CDDPM) 与反应控制方程结合，用条件特征生成训练分布之外的罕见事件轨迹；生成轨迹增广原始数据集以平衡正常/异常分布，并提出基于运行轨迹的 hazard score 评估工况风险严重度，再用深度学习模型在增广数据上训练健康状态诊断。
Result: 仿真结果表明，物理引导扩散模型在合成数据质量与罕见事件诊断性能上均优于数据驱动模型；摘要给出的定量指标为 29 页、18 幅图的篇幅信息。
Conclusion: 把反应物理嵌入条件扩散并用生成轨迹做类别增广，可以在罕见异常样本稀缺时同时改善合成轨迹质量与异常诊断表现。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把反应物理嵌入条件扩散并用生成轨迹做类别增广，可以在罕见异常样本稀缺时同时改善合成轨迹质量与异常诊断表现。

papers.title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sprout 把长视频理解的离线建记忆改为边推理边建记忆：agent 以低帧率逐段看视频，当前问题可答即停，每段存成时间树的粗节点，再以高帧率回看关键区间细化；段落转成文本后从上下文历史中移除视频输入，记忆树与问答记录跨问题累积。在三个模型的多个基准上，相对代表性离线记忆方法精度持平或提升，且无需前置建记忆阶段、每题上下文开销更低。
Motivation: 长视频理解受 MLLM 上下文长度限制，现有 build-then-reason 管线离线为整段视频建记忆：问题少时建记忆成本远超答题本身，问题多时记忆不再更新，答题中学到的信息无法传给下一题。
Method: Sprout 是 agentic 框架：低帧率逐段观看并在当前问题可答时停止，每段记为时间树 (temporal tree) 的粗节点，再以高帧率回看关键区间细化节点；段落转为文本后从上下文历史移除视频输入，原始视频仍可经 video tools 访问；记忆树与历史问答记录跨问题持久，形成在线动态记忆。
Result: 用文本记忆替代累积的视频输入可显著降低上下文占用同时保持精度，部分设置下还有小幅提升；在三个模型上的多个基准中，相对代表性离线记忆方法精度持平或提升，且没有前置构建阶段、每题上下文成本更低。
Conclusion: 记忆应当边答题边建并被每道题持续更新，而不是一次性离线构建后当静态源；文本化记忆加可回溯视频工具足以支撑这一在线过程。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自回归视频生成的少步蒸馏不再依赖双向 diffusion teacher 与在线 fake-score 模型，改为在冻结的自监督视频表征空间上直接对参考视频最小化 MMD，从而学出 rollout 分布。与 Self-Forcing 同架构同初始化的 1.3B 模型 VBench Total 从 83.80 提到 84.64 且保持 17 FPS，去掉打分模型后还可在八张 H200 上做 14B 后训练。
Motivation: DMD 类少步蒸馏需要一个双向 diffusion teacher 和一个在线 fake-score 模型，训练开销大且难以在没有目标专用 teacher 的情况下引入新风格与概念。
Method: 在冻结的自监督视频表征空间上最小化参考视频与 rollout 之间的 MMD，用 Nyström–Monte Carlo 混合估计器权衡近似偏差与采样方差，并以 memory-efficient replay 与 gradient subsampling 让目标可训练；后训练阶段不使用任何 score 模型。
Result: 与 Self-Forcing 相同架构和初始化的 1.3B 模型 VBench Total 由 83.80 升至 84.64，同时保持 17 FPS；去掉辅助 score 模型后可在八张 H200 GPU 上完成 14B 后训练。
Conclusion: 直接从参考视频匹配 rollout 分布可以替代 score-based 蒸馏，在保住推理速度的同时提升 VBench 总分，并让无目标专用 diffusion teacher 的风格、语义概念与空间先验学习成为可能。

papers.title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection
papers.abstract_en: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AHMAD 用共享编码器-解码器加轻量任务特定投影头，把语义分割、实例分割、深度估计、关键点检测与目标检测五个视觉任务统一进一个框架，并对高开销的 top-down 关键点检测引入知识蒸馏，使其只需整图一次前向。多任务训练带来互补增益：COCO-val panoptic PQ 达 53.1、semantic segmentation mIoU 达 66.5，均为 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 通用多任务视觉模型要同时处理稠密与稀疏预测，而各任务输出结构差异大，难以在一个框架内兼顾精度与效率；top-down 关键点检测还需多次前向，计算开销高。
Method: 共享 encoder-decoder 加多个轻量任务特定 projector，统一承载五个任务；对 top-down 关键点检测采用 knowledge distillation，把多次前向压缩为整图单次前向。
Result: COCO-val panoptic segmentation PQ 53.1、semantic segmentation mIoU 66.5，摘要称达到 state-of-the-art；关键点检测经蒸馏后由多次前向变为整图单次前向，效率大幅提升。
Conclusion: 轻量共享结构加任务特定投影头足以支撑五个视觉任务的通用多任务学习，且任务间存在互补增益；蒸馏可消除 top-down 关键点检测的多次前向开销。

papers.title: Who Is Left of Whom? Tracing Spatial Evidence and Role Binding in Relative-Position Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: High instance-level accuracy can mask inconsistencies in spatial reasoning when objects exchange positions or their roles are reversed in the query. The internal representations supporting relative-position reasoning remain poorly understood. We investigate two complementary components of this process: tracking object locations in the input and representing their query roles. Across three VLMs with visual or textual inputs and their language-model backbones, activation patching reveals a staged progression from early-layer source representations through intermediate-layer query-object representations to late-layer answer states. Targeted interventions further establish causal links along this progression: manipulating source-side representations shifts location information at query-object mentions and ultimately alters relation predictions. Beyond object-location information, we also identify a stable query-side direction associated with the roles of the two objects in the comparison. Steering along directions estimated on synthetic scenes generalizes to natural-image benchmarks, improving accuracy and both forms of paired consistency in most settings without retraining. Our findings reveal complementary components of relational reasoning across visual and textual settings and show how targeted interventions can improve the consistency of models' behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用 activation patching 与定向干预追踪 VLM 相对位置推理的内部机制，发现从早期层源表示、到中间层 query-object 表示、再到晚期层答案状态的分阶段推进，并识别出与比较中两物体角色绑定相关的稳定 query 侧方向。沿合成场景估计的方向做 steering，可在多数设置下在不重训的情况下同时提升准确率与两种成对一致性，并可迁移到自然图像基准。
Motivation: VLM 在物体交换位置或查询中角色互换时会出现实例级准确率掩盖的空间推理不一致，而支撑相对位置推理的内部表示机制仍不清楚。
Method: 在三个接受视觉或文本输入的 VLM 及其语言模型骨干上做 activation patching，定位源表示、query-object 表示与答案状态的层级推进；再做定向干预验证因果链，并在合成场景上估计 query 侧角色方向后沿该方向 steering。
Result: 干预源侧表示会移动 query-object 提及处的位置信息并最终改变关系预测；沿合成场景估计的方向 steering 可泛化到自然图像基准，在多数设置下在不重训的前提下提升准确率与两种成对一致性。
Conclusion: 相对位置推理由可分离的物体位置追踪与查询角色绑定两个互补成分支撑，针对识别出的表示方向做定向干预即可改善模型行为的一致性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Universal Approximation of Measure-to-Measure Operators by Pushforwards
papers.abstract_en: Many learning tasks map an input distribution to an output distribution. A natural way to model such an operator is to transform each input sample using a continuous function that may depend on the entire input distribution, and then take the distribution of the transformed samples. This defines a measure-dependent pushforward model and includes measure-theoretic formulations of transformers. We ask when such models can approximate arbitrary continuous operators between spaces of probability measures. We first show that universal approximation fails when atomic inputs are allowed: some continuous measure-to-measure operators that split or redistribute atomic mass cannot be approximated arbitrarily well by deterministic pushforward models. We then introduce the uniform level set condition, which requires a continuous measure-dependent scalarization whose shrinking level set neighborhoods carry uniformly vanishing mass over the input family. This condition is satisfied, in particular, by compact families of absolutely continuous measures. On every compact family satisfying this condition, we prove that any continuous measure-to-measure operator with outputs of finite $p$-th moment can be uniformly approximated, in the $p$-Wasserstein distance, by continuous measure-dependent pushforwards. Combining our theorem with existing approximation results for measure-dependent in-context maps yields universal approximation by measure-theoretic transformers. We also extend the framework to continuously-varying source measures, yielding a corresponding universality result for a class of pushforward models that are closely aligned with cross-attention architectures.
papers.comment: 31 pages (9 main text, 19 appendix, and 3 references pages)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明度量到度量算子的 pushforward 模型何时能做万有逼近：允许原子输入时万有逼近失败，因为劈裂或重分配原子质量的连续算子无法被确定性 pushforwards 任意逼近；引入 uniform level set condition 后，在满足该条件的紧致族上，任何输出有限 p 阶矩的连续算子都能在 p-Wasserstein 距离下被连续的 measure-dependent pushforwards 一致逼近。
Motivation: 许多学习任务是分布到分布的映射，但 pushforward 类模型能否逼近任意连续的概率测度间算子此前缺少充要条件，尤其原子输入下何时失效并不清楚。
Method: 先构造反例说明允许原子输入时确定性 pushforwards 无法逼近劈裂/重分配原子质量的算子；再提出 uniform level set condition（存在连续的 measure-dependent 标量化，其收缩水平集邻域在输入族上一致携带消失质量），并结合已有的 measure-dependent in-context maps 逼近结果与 cross-attention 对齐的连续变源测度推广。
Result: 在满足 uniform level set condition 的紧致测度族上（含绝对连续测度的紧致族），任何输出有限 p 阶矩的连续 measure-to-measure 算子可在 p-Wasserstein 距离下被一致逼近；结合已有结果得到 measure-theoretic transformers 的万有逼近；原子输入情形给出万有逼近失败的否定结论。
Conclusion: pushforward 类模型的万有逼近取决于输入测度族是否排除原子劈裂，uniform level set condition（绝对连续紧致族满足）是可验证的充分条件，并可推广到与 cross-attention 架构对齐的变源测度情形。

summary_sections.result: 在满足 uniform level set condition 的紧致测度族上（含绝对连续测度的紧致族），任何输出有限 p 阶矩的连续 measure-to-measure 算子可在 p-Wasserstein 距离下被一致逼近；结合已有结果得到 measure-theoretic transformers 的万有逼近；原子输入情形给出万有逼近失败的否定结论。
summary_sections.conclusion: pushforward 类模型的万有逼近取决于输入测度族是否排除原子劈裂，uniform level set condition（绝对连续紧致族满足）是可验证的充分条件，并可推广到与 cross-attention 架构对齐的变源测度情形。

papers.title: TopoEP: Topology-Aware Load Balancing for Expert-Parallel MoE Training
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic routing creates severe load imbalance in large-scale expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training, turning GPUs that host hot experts into stragglers. As each MoE layer waits for its slowest rank, these stragglers prolong the expert-parallel stage and reduce overall training efficiency. Existing expert-parallelism load-balancing (EPLB) systems commonly compute load-balancing plans on the CPU, incurring device--host data transfers and cross-rank synchronization that make scheduling at every layer and microbatch expensive. Their planning formulations also overlook the hierarchical communication costs of modern scale-up and scale-out GPU clusters. We present \textit{TopoEP}, a GPU-native, topology-aware load-balancing system for large-scale MoE training. At each MoE layer and training microbatch, \textit{TopoEP} converts the current routing result into hot-expert replication and token-rerouting decisions and executes the resulting plan without data-dependent host synchronization, reducing critical-path overhead. To generate these decisions, \textit{TopoEP} uses a deterministic GPU solver that performs inter-node placement followed by intra-node refinement, allowing all ranks to independently produce bitwise-identical plans. On a 32-GPU NVIDIA H800 cluster, integrating \textit{TopoEP} with Megatron-LM improves end-to-end training throughput by 6.2\%--11.4\% across three representative MoE models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoEP 是面向大规模专家并行 MoE 训练的 GPU 原生、拓扑感知负载均衡系统：在每个 MoE 层和训练 microbatch 上把当前路由结果转成热专家复制与 token 重路由决策，并由确定性 GPU 求解器（先跨节点放置、再节点内细化）生成各 rank 位级一致的计划，全程无需依赖数据的主机同步。在 32 卡 NVIDIA H800 集群上与 Megatron-LM 集成，三个代表性 MoE 模型的端到端训练吞吐提升 6.2%–11.4%。
Motivation: 动态路由造成专家并行负载不均，持有热专家的 GPU 成为拖后者，而每层都要等最慢 rank；现有 EPLB 在 CPU 上算计划带来设备-主机传输与跨 rank 同步，且规划时忽略了 scale-up/scale-out 集群的分层通信代价。
Method: 在每层每 microbatch 把路由结果转成热专家复制与 token 重路由决策，直接在 GPU 上执行、不做数据依赖的主机同步；决策由确定性 GPU 求解器生成，先做 inter-node placement 再做 intra-node refinement，使所有 rank 独立产出 bitwise-identical 的计划。
Result: 在 32-GPU NVIDIA H800 集群上与 Megatron-LM 集成，三个代表性 MoE 模型的端到端训练吞吐提升 6.2%–11.4%。
Conclusion: 把负载均衡计划的生成与执行整体搬到 GPU 并显式纳入集群分层通信代价，可在不引入主机同步的前提下缩短专家并行关键路径、提高大规模 MoE 训练效率。

papers.title: Analog Computing revisited: A fully analog and minimalistic Damage Detector for Ultrasonic Testing enabling Material-Integrated Structural Health Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasonic Testing (UT) is commonly used to detect damage in structures, e.g., metal plates. A sensor acquires Ultrasonic waves, e.g., by using PZT transducers. The time-resolved sensor signal must be processed with analog electronics, e.g., amplified and filtered. Commonly a digitalization follows using an Analog-to-Digital converter, finally processing the digital sensor signal, applying digital signal processing, feature extraction, and Machine Learning by using powerful microprocessor systems. The disadvantages of digital processing systems are their high number of transistors (microchip area), energy consumption, state-dependent processing and therefore sensitivity to energy supply interruption. Beyond silicon electronics, printed organic electronics gains interest. But printed electronics is still limited to low transistor and electronic component counts (typically 100). We will investigate and demonstrate a fully analog signal processing and feature extraction system consisting of an analog Hilbert transform deriving the signal envelope, simple analog arithmetic calculations for feature extraction, and finally damage classification and regression using an analog Artificial Neural Network. We expect a full damage detection system with less than 100 transistors. We will test our damage detection system with PZT transducer signals from Steel plates with circular defects. The focus of this work is the analog computation of the signal envelope (using all-pass filter networks for approximation of the Hilbert transform) and the analog feature extraction as well as the prediction of damage, forming an analog computer which can perform in-sensor computation, computing without a digital computer.
papers.comment: NDTonline, International Online Conference on Nondestructive Testing 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出全模拟、少于 100 晶体管的超声无损检测 (UT) 损伤探测器：用全通滤波网络近似 Hilbert 变换取包络，模拟算术做特征提取，再由模拟 ANN 完成损伤分类与回归，实现传感器内计算。测试对象为带圆形缺陷钢板的 PZT 信号。
Motivation: 数字处理链依赖 ADC、微处理器与大量晶体管，功耗高且断电即失效；而印刷有机电子的元件数通常限于约 100，难以承载常规数字管线。
Method: 模拟 Hilbert 变换（全通滤波网络近似）提取信号包络，配合简单模拟算术做特征提取，末端用模拟人工神经网络 (analog ANN) 做损伤分类与回归，整体构成无需数字计算机的模拟计算机，目标整机少于 100 晶体管。
Result: 系统以 PZT 换能器采集的含圆形缺陷钢板信号为测试对象；设计目标为完整损伤探测系统少于 100 晶体管，印刷电子典型元件数上限约 100。
Conclusion: 超声损伤探测可脱离数字计算，用少于 100 晶体管的纯模拟链在传感器内完成包络、特征与损伤预测，适配材料集成的结构健康监测。

papers.title: Spontaneous Context Restoration: How Language Models Recover from Corrupted Inputs
papers.abstract_en: Language models sometimes produce correct outputs even when their inputs are corrupted by deletion, replacement, or misspelling. We study the internal processes accompanying this behavior, which we call context restoration, in controlled attention-only transformers and five pretrained LLMs (1B-32B parameters) across arithmetic, reading comprehension, and multiple-choice reasoning tasks. In the attention-only transformers, restoration emerges spontaneously despite training exclusively on clean sequences, without corruption training or an explicit denoising objective. We find that context restoration follows a two-phase process: early layers localize effects associated with repair at corrupted positions, while later layers accumulate these effects at uncorrupted positions through the residual stream and ultimately concentrate them at the output position. Repair outcome is predictable from hidden states: cosine alignment with the clean state is highly predictive in attention-only models, while linear probes recover additional information in pretrained LLMs. A linear probe using only the corrupted prompt's first-block hidden state predicts failure with mean ROC-AUC 0.78. This enables failure triage under matched or even partially shifted deployment conditions and may reduce unnecessary verification or computation. Failed examples also show substantially greater nonlinearity along corruption directions. Moderate-corruption finetuning increases corruption tolerance while simultaneously reducing displacement-normalized linearization error, associating improved robustness with a more nearly linear response to corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究语言模型在输入被删除、替换或拼写错误污染后仍给出正确输出的“上下文恢复”现象：在仅注意力 (attention-only) 变换器中该能力自发涌现，且遵循两阶段过程——早期层在被污染位置定位修复相关效应，后期层经残差流把这些效应累积到未污染位置并最终集中到输出位置。用被污染 prompt 首块 hidden state 的线性探针预测失败，mean ROC-AUC 0.78；中等污染微调在提高污染容忍度的同时降低 displacement-normalized linearization error。
Motivation: 语言模型在输入被污染时仍可能给出正确输出，但其内部机制与失败可预测性未知；理解这一点关系到部署中是否需要额外验证或计算。
Method: 在受控的 attention-only 变换器与五个预训练 LLM（1B–32B 参数）上，跨算术、阅读理解、多选推理任务研究 context restoration；用 hidden state 与 clean state 的余弦对齐度、线性探针 (linear probe) 预测修复结果，并考察沿污染方向的非线性与中等污染微调。
Result: 仅用被污染 prompt 首块 hidden state 的线性探针预测失败，mean ROC-AUC 0.78；余弦对齐在 attention-only 模型中高度具预测力，线性探针在预训练 LLM 中恢复额外信息；失败样本沿污染方向的非线性显著更大；中等污染微调提高污染容忍度并降低 displacement-normalized linearization error。
Conclusion: context restoration 是无需污染训练或显式去噪目标即可自发涌现的两阶段过程，且修复成败可由 hidden state 线性预测，从而支持在匹配乃至部分偏移的部署条件下做失败分诊、减少不必要验证。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace
papers.abstract_en: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label efficient. Across datasets, encoder alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace predicts CER within every method. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines; full fine-tuning achieves the lowest mean CER and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results show that the value of pixel reconstruction depends on where discriminative signal lies in the input.
papers.comment: Accepted at 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 手写文本识别 (HTR) 的自监督预训练中，像素重建类方法优于对比学习类，作者把原因归到判别信号在像素空间的分布：HTR 的判别信息集中在高方差方向、低方差方向几乎没有。由此推出并检验的预测是，保留高方差像素内容的目标迁移最好——在六个手写基准、五种语言、统一编码器与评测协议下，pixel-grounded MIM 在全标签下每个基准、两种 frozen probe 上 CER 都最低，且是唯一能从真实手写预训练中获益的一族。
Motivation: 自然图像分类里对比式 SSL 常胜过像素重建，但 HTR 上结论相反；这一反常缺少统一解释，也未说明哪些 SSL 目标该被选用于文字识别。
Method: 从三族共六个 SSL 方法（pixel-grounded MIM、JEPA、contrastive）做对照，匹配 encoder、数据与评测协议，在五种语言的六个手写基准上测试；用表示与高方差像素子空间的对齐度作为跨数据集的解释变量，并加设 frozen probe、逐位置字符信息探针与带预训练 LLM decoder 的组合评测。
Result: 全标签下 pixel-grounded SSL 在每个基准、两种 frozen probe 上取得最低 CER；只有这一族能从真实手写预训练中获益，且更 label efficient；跨数据集看，表示与高方差像素子空间的对齐度在每个方法内部都能预测 CER；配预训练 LLM decoder 时 frozen pixel-grounded encoder 与全微调监督基线相当，全微调取得最低平均 CER 并在每个基准上排名第一或第二。
Conclusion: 像素重建的价值取决于判别信号在输入中的位置，因此 HTR 这类高方差方向承载判别信息的任务应优先选 pixel-grounded 重建目标，而非照搬自然图像的对比式 SSL。

papers.title: Why Deterministic PRM Guidance Underperforms in Discrete Diffusion Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) expose a denoised solution at every step, which makes process reward model (PRM) guidance look like a way to spend compute at test time. We show that once denoising, PRM scoring, and outcome reward model (ORM) scoring are charged in the same budget of forward passes, its deterministic form loses to a much simpler baseline. Our PRMs score intermediate denoising states and are trained on the correctness of the final answer. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B with 8 candidates per GSM8K problem, keeping the candidate with the highest PRM score at every scoring step reaches 65.18%, while independent sampling plus an ORM reranker trained for the task reaches 75.13%. The gap grows to 12.69 percentage points (pp) with 32 candidates, and is 9.85 pp on MATH and 12.16 pp on MBPP. We trace it to two separable failures. First, guidance prunes on a weak signal: on GSM8K, PRM ROC-AUC falls from 0.77 to 0.54 as the mask ratio rises, a decay that persists when states are relabeled with fresh rollouts, and pruning lowers the best accuracy reachable from the candidate pool from 81.05% for independent samples to 67.30%. Second, on GSM8K and MATH, the PRM is a poor final judge: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler at the same budget restores that ceiling to 77.89%, yet selecting with the PRM gives 65.48%, on par with deterministic guidance, while a PRM retrained on final states matches the ORM on identical candidates. MBPP separates the two: there the PRM reaches 65.47% when reranking finished programs, on par with the ORM, but 50.88% when it guides denoising. The results point to two targets for dLLM guidance: keep correct partial solutions alive through early denoising, and leave the final choice to a verifier trained on final states. We release the corpus of denoising states with outcome labels and evaluation toolkit for reproducible comparisons at matched compute.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在离散扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 推理中，把去噪、PRM 打分与 ORM 打分放进同一前向传播预算后，确定性 PRM 引导反而输给独立采样加 ORM 重排：GSM8K 上 8 个候选时 65.18% 对 75.13%，32 个候选时差距扩到 12.69pp。作者把失败拆成两半——PRM 在高 mask ratio 下信号变弱（ROC-AUC 从 0.77 掉到 0.54）且不擅长做最终裁决，因此建议早期去噪只保证正确部分解存活、最终选择交给在最终状态上训练的验证器。
Motivation: dLLM 每步都暴露去噪解，看似可用 PRM 做测试时算力分配，但在统一前向传播预算下其确定性形式是否真优于简单基线缺乏受控比较，且失败来源未被分离。
Method: PRM 对中间去噪状态打分、以最终答案正确性训练；在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上与独立采样加 ORM 重排在相同前向传播预算下对比，覆盖 GSM8K、MATH、MBPP；用 ROC-AUC 随 mask ratio 的变化、候选池可达最佳精度、以及顺序蒙特卡洛 (SMC) 采样器在同预算下的表现来分离两个失败模式，并发布带结果标签的去噪状态语料与评测工具。
Result: GSM8K 8 候选：每步保留最高 PRM 分 65.18%，独立采样加 ORM 重排 75.13%；32 候选差距 12.69pp，MATH 差 9.85pp，MBPP 差 12.16pp。GSM8K 上 PRM ROC-AUC 随 mask ratio 从 0.77 降至 0.54（用新 rollout 重标注后仍存在），剪枝使候选池最佳可达精度从 81.05% 降到 67.30%。同预算 SMC 把该上限恢复到 77.89%，但用 PRM 选择只有 65.48%，与确定性引导持平；在最终状态上重训的 PRM 与 ORM 打平。MBPP 上 PRM 重排成品程序达 65.47%（与 ORM 持平），引导去噪则只有 50.88%。
Conclusion: dLLM 引导应瞄准两件事：早期去噪保住正确的部分解，最终裁决交给在最终状态上训练的验证器；确定性 PRM 引导在匹配算力下不敌独立采样加重排。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CATok 把机器人动作 tokenization 从压缩问题改写为因果结构化的生成过程：用条件退火 (conditional annealing) 逐步退火 flow matching，每个 token 只以前序 token 为条件、编码特定噪声水平下的残差重建信号，形成由粗到细的因果 token 空间。在三个仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务上，它在重建保真-压缩权衡和推理效率上持续超过现有 tokenization 方法，并提升 VLA 任务成功率与训练效率。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 动作 tokenizer 把 tokenization 当压缩问题，得到的表示与自回归 backbone 的生成语义不对齐，导致高层语义推理与底层运动执行耦合。
Method: CATok 用条件退火从 flow matching 过程中逐个抽取动作 token，每个 token 条件于全部前序 token 并编码特定噪声水平的残差重建信号；解码端用基于 Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) 的 token-conditioned flow-matching decoder 从离散 token 重建连续动作块，离散瓶颈天然实现 knowledge insulation，无需显式 attention masking。
Result: 在三个仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务上，CATok 在重建保真-压缩权衡与推理效率两方面持续优于现有 tokenization 方法，并提高 VLA 任务成功率和训练效率。
Conclusion: 把 tokenization 建模为因果生成而非压缩，可让离散动作 token 的生成语义与自回归建模对齐，成为纯自回归 VLA 系统的高性能可扩展基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An analysis of Mirror-Descent Soft Actor-Critic
papers.abstract_en: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is widely used for entropy-regularised reinforcement learning with continuous action spaces, and practical implementations perform only a few actor steps towards an evolving target. In this work, we prove convergence guarantees when the target policy arises from policy mirror descent and compare it with the classical Gibbs target. We derive sufficient conditions for the strong convexity and smoothness of the actor objective, characterised by the curvature of the $Q$-function estimate through the Legendre differential operator, and establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{-\frac{1}{5}}\right)$ best-iterate finite-time convergence rate up to actor and critic approximation errors. Moreover, the mirror-descent step size $λ$ directly controls the target drift and hence actor tracking error, whereas the analogous Gibbs bound contains a non-vanishing tracking term.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Soft Actor-Critic 的 mirror-descent 目标策略给出收敛保证：用 Legendre 微分算子刻画 Q 函数曲率，证明 actor 目标强凸与光滑的充分条件，得到 O(N^{-1/5}) 的 best-iterate 有限时间收敛率（含 actor/critic 近似误差），且步长 λ 直接控制目标漂移与跟踪误差，而 Gibbs 目标的对应界含不消失的跟踪项。
Motivation: 实践中 SAC 只对不断演化的目标策略走少数几步 actor 更新，但 mirror-descent 目标相对经典 Gibbs 目标何时收敛、跟踪误差如何随步长变化，此前缺少理论刻画。
Method: 将目标策略取为 policy mirror descent 的输出并与 Gibbs 目标对比；用 Legendre 微分算子通过 Q 函数估计的曲率推导 actor 目标强凸与光滑的充分条件，据此分析带近似误差的有限时间收敛。
Result: 得到 best-iterate 有限时间收敛率 O(N^{-1/5})，误差项包含 actor 与 critic 近似误差；mirror-descent 步长 λ 直接控制目标漂移与 actor 跟踪误差，而 Gibbs 对应的界带有不消失的跟踪项。
Conclusion: mirror-descent 目标使 SAC 的跟踪误差随步长可控并可消失，而 Gibbs 目标在同类分析下留下不消失的跟踪项。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tetra: Serving Leech-Lattice Quantized LLMs at 2.7 Bits per Parameter
papers.abstract_en: Leech-lattice quantization gives good quality at two bits per weight, but its codebooks hold more than 10^14 points, too many for a lookup table. Our earlier kernel expanded the codes at load time and read 4.804 bits per weight from GPU memory for 2 bits of code. We present Tetra, a new codebook on the same lattice. A 24-weight block still takes 48 bits, most of which index a 64-state trellis of the Golay code and one shared 16 KiB table. The kernel decodes a block with six table loads and two small lookups inside the matrix-vector product, and reads 2.148 bits per weight. For full models, we retrain one scale per matrix row, store the matrices that lose the most as 4-bit integers, and pay for them with 4-bit embedding tables. Our Qwen3-4B, 8B and 14B files hold 2.73, 2.70 and 2.73 bits per parameter over the whole model. They score 63.37, 69.58 and 75.66 on the full MMLU test set, 4.76, 4.21 and 2.46 points below 4-bit AWQ at 5.3 to 6.0 bits per parameter. They generate 113.8, 95.0 and 57.2 tokens per second in our engine. On GSM8K, through the served kernel, they lose 9.63, 4.62 and 3.26 points to FP16. At 4B our file scores 23.6 points above llama.cpp's IQ2_XXS (2.48 bits per parameter). Every number we measured for a table or figure comes from one NVIDIA L40S GPU. We preregistered the main experiments.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Code, measurement logs and preregistrations: https://github.com/pjmalandrino/llvq
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tetra 用 Golay 码 64 状态 trellis 加一张共享 16 KiB 表，在矩阵向量乘内以六次表加载解码 24 权重块，把 leech-lattice 量化 LLM 的读取量从 4.804 bits/weight 降到 2.148 bits/weight。Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 整模型分别压到 2.73/2.70/2.73 bits per parameter，MMLU 63.37/69.58/75.66，仅比 5.3–6.0 bits 的 4-bit AWQ 低 4.76/4.21/2.46 分。
Motivation: leech-lattice 量化在 2 bits/weight 下质量好，但码本超过 10^14 个点无法做成查找表；此前的加载期展开内核仍要从 GPU 显存读 4.804 bits/weight，存储与带宽收益被抵消。
Method: Tetra 在同一 lattice 上换新码本：24 权重块占 48 bits，大部分索引 Golay 码的 64 状态 trellis 与一张共享 16 KiB 表，解码在矩阵向量乘内部完成，仅需六次表加载加两次小查找。整模型层面每矩阵行重训一个 scale，损失最大的矩阵存为 4-bit 整数，并用 4-bit embedding 表补偿；全部测量在单张 NVIDIA L40S 上完成，主实验做了 preregistration。
Result: 读取量 4.804 → 2.148 bits per weight。Qwen3-4B/8B/14B 整模型 2.73/2.70/2.73 bits per parameter，MMLU 全集 63.37/69.58/75.66，比 4-bit AWQ（5.3–6.0 bits/parameter）低 4.76/4.21/2.46 分；吞吐 113.8/95.0/57.2 tokens per second。GSM8K 经服务内核比 FP16 低 9.63/4.62/3.26 分；4B 上比 llama.cpp IQ2_XXS（2.48 bits/parameter）高 23.6 分。
Conclusion: 把 leech-lattice 码本改成 trellis 加共享小表的在线解码，可在 2.7 bits per parameter 的整模型存储下把质量损失压到 4-bit AWQ 的几分以内，并在自研引擎里保持可用吞吐。

papers.title: W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change
papers.abstract_en: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement. Overall, change across a video can supervise a visual encoder whose representations remain useful at either image or video granularity. Code is available at~\href{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: W2Rep 是一个掩码特征预测 (masked feature-prediction) 自监督框架：源图像单独编码后参与对同一或另一时刻的预测，预测器以可见视频上下文、查询位置以及源-目标之间的带符号时间间隔为条件。跨帧目标让图像路径学到跨时间仍有效的特征、视频路径必须补上源图缺失的证据；在多种模型规模与下游任务的比较协议下，冻结与微调识别均提升，且联合视频编码相对逐帧聚合还有额外增益。
Motivation: 图像自监督只从单一时刻学空间结构，视频方法又把时间关系学进多帧联合表示里；缺少一种用场景变化来改进单图特征、同时不牺牲视频表示能力的自监督信号。
Method: 掩码特征预测框架：源图像独立编码并参与对同一或另一时刻目标的预测；预测器条件包括可见视频上下文、查询位置、源与目标之间的带符号时间间隔 (signed time interval)。跨帧目标承担双重角色——图像路径学跨时间有效的特征，视频路径须收集源图缺失的证据；并做受控实验检验增益是否依赖直接更新源图特征以及同时使用视频上下文与时间位移。
Result: 在所比较的模型规模与下游任务下，W2Rep 在其比较协议中同时提升冻结 (frozen) 与微调 (fine-tuned) 识别；联合视频编码相对逐帧聚合 (frame-wise aggregation) 带来进一步增益。受控实验显示这些增益依赖于直接更新源图像特征，并依赖同时使用视频上下文与时间位移。
Conclusion: 视频中的跨时刻变化可以直接监督一个在图像粒度与视频粒度都保持有用的视觉编码器，且该收益需要源图特征被更新、以及上下文与时间位移两者齐备。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: W2Rep 是一个掩码特征预测 (masked feature-prediction) 自监督框架：源图像单独编码后参与对同一或另一时刻的预测，预测器以可见视频上下文、查询位置以及源-目标之间的带符号时间间隔为条件。跨帧目标让图像路径学到跨时间仍有效的特征、视频路径必须补上源图缺失的证据；在多种模型规模与下游任务的比较协议下，冻结与微调识别均提升，且联合视频编码相对逐帧聚合还有额外增益。
summary_sections.motivation: 图像自监督只从单一时刻学空间结构，视频方法又把时间关系学进多帧联合表示里；缺少一种用场景变化来改进单图特征、同时不牺牲视频表示能力的自监督信号。
summary_sections.method: 掩码特征预测框架：源图像独立编码并参与对同一或另一时刻目标的预测；预测器条件包括可见视频上下文、查询位置、源与目标之间的带符号时间间隔 (signed time interval)。跨帧目标承担双重角色——图像路径学跨时间有效的特征，视频路径须收集源图缺失的证据；并做受控实验检验增益是否依赖直接更新源图特征以及同时使用视频上下文与时间位移。
summary_sections.result: 在所比较的模型规模与下游任务下，W2Rep 在其比较协议中同时提升冻结 (frozen) 与微调 (fine-tuned) 识别；联合视频编码相对逐帧聚合 (frame-wise aggregation) 带来进一步增益。受控实验显示这些增益依赖于直接更新源图像特征，并依赖同时使用视频上下文与时间位移。

papers.title: A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations): A Visual-Symbolic Framework for Virtual Humans
papers.abstract_en: Creating believable vh requires the coherent integration of perception, reasoning, and action mediated by language. A central challenge is to combine these components into a control loop grounded in interactive 3D environments. To this end, we present A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations), a visual-symbolic framework for language-driven vh that leverages a pretrained vlm with tool calling to unify perception, reasoning, and action within a single control loop. A.D.A.M.O. maintains a dual visual-symbolic world model that combines egocentric visual input and synchronized symbolic state to support grounded task-oriented behavior from natural language prompts. To support diagnostic evaluation, we introduce a controlled task suite organized by a cd taxonomy that breaks down spatial tasks into procedural and linguistic complexity. Experiments in controlled scenes show that semantic labeling strongly influences task completion and failure modes, reducing perceptual ambiguity while shifting failures toward downstream execution, whereas reasoning errors remain comparatively rare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: A.D.A.M.O. 用预训练 VLM 加 tool calling 把感知、推理、动作收进单一控制循环，并维护以自我中心视觉加同步符号状态构成的双视觉-符号世界模型，以自然语言指令驱动虚拟人类。在按 CD taxonomy 组织的受控任务套件上，语义标注强烈影响任务完成与失败模式：它降低感知歧义，同时把失败推向下游执行环节，推理错误相对少见。
Motivation: 让虚拟人类可信需要把感知、推理、动作经语言连成一个绑定在交互式 3D 环境中的控制回路，而空间任务的程序与语言复杂度此前缺少可诊断的分解评测。
Method: 提出视觉-符号框架 A.D.A.M.O.：以带 tool calling 的预训练 VLM 统一感知、推理与动作，世界模型并行维护自我中心视觉输入与同步符号状态；配套引入按 CD taxonomy 组织的受控任务套件，把空间任务按程序复杂度与语言复杂度分层。
Result: 受控场景实验显示语义标注强烈影响任务完成率与失败模式：感知歧义减少，失败转移到下游执行，推理错误相对罕见。
Conclusion: 语言驱动虚拟人类的瓶颈主要在感知标注与下游执行而非推理；用分层任务套件可以把失败模式按环节归因。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLIMB: A Clinical Multimorbidity Benchmark for Diagnosing Co-occurring Conditions through Multiturn Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Patients often have several co-occurring clinical conditions, and the findings needed to identify and disambiguate them emerge over the course of a consultation. Evaluating clinical reasoning in this setting requires both multi-turn interaction and multi-label diagnosis. We introduce CLIMB, a benchmark in which a doctor model interviews a simulated patient to recover a ground truth set of co-occurring clinical conditions. Cases are synthesized from clinical decision algorithms and diagnostic datasets, grounding multimorbid presentations in structured clinical knowledge. Across six frontier and open models, none recovers the exact set of conditions in more than 10% of interactive cases. Diagnostic performance declines when conditions co-occur, even when models receive the full clinical record and the true number of conditions. Interaction reduces performance further. In controlled experiments, models behave like single-hypothesis trackers: they anchor on the diagnosis suggested by the opening findings, keep questioning around it, and recover a second condition mainly when a finding in view points to it. Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLIMB-8340.
papers.comment: 52 pages (9 main text), 23 figures, 22 tables. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIMB 是一个多轮对话临床多病共存诊断基准：医生模型访谈模拟病人，从临床决策算法与诊断数据集合成的病例中恢复真实共病集合。六个前沿与开源模型中，没有一个在超过 10% 的交互式病例里完整命中真实病种集合；共病越多表现越差，即使给出完整病历与真实病种数也如此，而多轮交互会进一步拉低成绩。
Motivation: 真实问诊中多个共病的鉴别信息随对话逐步浮现，现有临床推理评测缺少同时覆盖多轮交互与多标签诊断的场景，无法暴露模型在共病下的推理缺陷。
Method: 构建 CLIMB 基准：病例由临床决策算法与诊断数据集合成，使多病表现有结构化临床知识支撑；评测时医生模型对模拟病人做多轮访谈以恢复真实共病集合，并在受控实验中检验模型的假设跟踪行为，另给出单假设跟踪 (single-hypothesis tracking) 的理论参考模型。
Result: 在六个前沿与开源模型上，没有任何模型在超过 10% 的交互式病例中完整恢复真实病种集合；病种共存时诊断表现下降，即使模型拿到完整临床记录和真实病种数仍如此，交互进一步降低表现；追问补不全病种集合，反而增加错误诊断。
Conclusion: 前沿模型在多病共存诊断中表现为单假设跟踪者：锚定开场发现提示的诊断、围绕它继续追问，只有当视野内出现指向第二病种的发现才补上第二个病种，因此多轮交互在该基准上是净损失而非信息增益。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss--compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around $10^{22}$ FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated. Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统比较 encoder-free 与 encoder-based MLLM 的 scaling law，发现去掉视觉编码器会把多模态目标的 compute-optimal 配比推向更大模型，而文本目标配比几乎不变；encoder-free 在小规模落后，但被预测在约 10^22 FLOPs 处追平，且语言模型会通过视觉 token 双向交互、前移视觉处理层与更集中的专家路由接管视觉编码器的角色。
Motivation: encoder-free MLLM 直接从原始像素学视觉表征、架构更统一，但其 scaling 行为此前没有被系统刻画，无法判断预训练视觉先验的优势能维持多久。
Method: 在相同预算下对比 encoder-free 与 encoder-based 两条路线的 scaling law，分别拟合文本目标与多模态目标的 loss–compute frontier，并追踪训练中视觉 token 的双向交互、视觉处理所在层深与专家路由集中度随 compute 的变化。
Result: 三条发现：encoder-free 使多模态目标的 compute-optimal 分配偏向更大模型、文本目标几乎不变；两者在文本目标上 frontier 几乎重合，在多模态目标上 encoder-free 小规模落后但预测在约 10^22 FLOPs 追平；无视觉编码器时视觉 token 双向交互随 compute 增大愈发有益，视觉处理前移到更早层，视觉 token 的专家路由更集中。
Conclusion: 预训练编码器提供的视觉先验优势随规模递减，encoder-free 架构在实际预训练预算内是有前景的多模态预训练方向。

papers.title: AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain--Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. Across 14 EEG datasets spanning motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging, we evaluate AutoBCI with six LLMs, including Opus 5.5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, and compare the architectures selected by the search procedure against ten baselines: six conventional EEG models and four foundation models. The architecture discovered by AutoBCI with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves 64.16% average test balanced accuracy (bAcc), compared with 63.87% for REVE, the strongest baseline on this metric. Using ten observed epochs, PEEK reduces mean absolute error in predicting average validation bAcc from 2.20 to 1.36 percentage points, a 38.1% reduction relative to the best-observed-score baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoBCI 用 Designer Agent 的 Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD) 跨任务搜索 EEG 解码架构，再由 Forecaster Agent 的 Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK) 用架构代码、训练协议与早期学习曲线预测满预算验证性能并挑选候选。在 14 个 EEG 数据集上用 Claude Opus 5.5 搜到的架构平均测试 balanced accuracy 达 64.16%，超过最强基线 REVE 的 63.87%；PEEK 用 10 个观测 epoch 把验证 bAcc 预测的 MAE 从 2.20 降到 1.36 个百分点，相对降幅 38.1%。
Motivation: EEG 解码架构需跨运动想象、情绪识别、睡眠分期等多种任务保持性能，人工设计困难；而全预算训练每个候选代价高，需要在早期就判断候选是否值得继续训练。
Method: agentic 框架含两个组件：Designer Agent 执行 PGAD，通过跨多个 EEG 任务的训练与验证生成并精化架构；Forecaster Agent 执行 PEEK，输入架构代码、训练协议与早期学习曲线，预测满预算验证性能并挑选候选继续训练。评测用六个 LLM（含 Opus 5.5 与 GPT 5.6 Sol），对比十个基线（六个常规 EEG 模型与四个 foundation model）。
Result: 在 14 个 EEG 数据集上，AutoBCI + Claude Opus 5.5 搜到的架构平均测试 bAcc 64.16%，REVE（最强基线）为 63.87%。PEEK 用 10 个观测 epoch 预测平均验证 bAcc 的 MAE 从 2.20 降到 1.36 个百分点，相对 best-observed-score 基线降低 38.1%。
Conclusion: 让 LLM agent 同时做架构搜索与早期性能预测，可以在跨任务 EEG 解码上选出略优于最强常规基线的架构，并显著降低候选筛选所需的训练预算。
Relevance: 0
