papers.title: Manifold-Stable Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. TL;DR: MSFM 把流匹配 (flow matching) 的生成动力学拆成可学习的切向输运与规定的法向收缩 (prescribed normal contraction)，从而允许从任意环境先验出发并保证流形不变性与有限时间内的横向收敛。椭圆实验的终端离流形误差量级 10^-6，Push-T 成功率 74%→82%，Robomimic Square 60%→72% 且旋转流形偏差从 10^-2 降到 10^-7。
Motivation: 几何 FM 变体通常假设先验支撑在数据流形上，需要往往不可得的几何知识；缺少该知识时低回归误差并不保证流形贴合，而贴合关系到生成样本是否落在有效构型并影响任务表现。
Method: MSFM 用非线性动力学中的收缩理论 (contraction theory)，把学到的切向输运与规定的法向收缩结合：已知流形用解析投影算子，未知几何用 PCA 估计的局部仿射代理；训练损失分解为可学习的切向项与法向残差，并推导一族兼容的概率路径。
Result: 椭圆实验终端离流形误差均值量级 10^-6；Push-T 机器人实验成功率从 74% 提到 82%；Robomimic Square 任务成功率从 60% 提到 72%，旋转流形偏差从 10^-2 量级降到 10^-7；终端几何误差由所选数值容差控制。

papers.title: From internal representations to model improvement through prediction errors
papers.abstract_en: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model's own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model's internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model's current state to guide which images are labeled next.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Supplementary Information is provided as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标注预算有限的主动学习场景下，把目标检测器自身的内部特征与其预测错误及错误对性能的预期影响挂钩，用模型当前状态决定下一批标注图像，全程不使用候选图像的标签。在两个数据集、两组随机种子共 16 个条件下，加入内部特征有 15 个条件改善了错误识别；按轮次平均，四种设置全部优于仅用特征稀有度的选择，在六种方法中排进前两。
Motivation: 数据选择依赖外部模型特征或 VLM 场景描述，这些信号不反映被改进模型自身的变化；而仅凭特征稀有度又无法识别真正影响性能的错误。
Method: 将目标模型的内部特征与预测错误及其对性能的预期影响关联，在不使用候选图像标签的条件下选择图像进行标注与重训练；评测用一个 object detector，在两个数据集、两对随机种子上进行，并与仅基于特征稀有度的选择及另外几种方法对比。
Result: 加入内部特征在 16 个条件中的 15 个改善了预测错误识别；按连续标注轮次平均，四种评估设置下均优于仅用特征稀有度的选择，在六种方法中排进前两；固定其他条件时重训练后性能仍高于稀有度选择，尽管后者收集到更多错误；重训练更久时该方法在六种方法中排第一。
Conclusion: 把模型内部特征与其错误及性能影响联系起来，可以让模型当前状态指导下一步标注哪些图像，从而比稀有度驱动的选择更有效地提升性能。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: NeuronSifter: Intervention Planning in CNS Microenvironments
papers.abstract_en: Prioritizing central nervous system (CNS) interventions requires predicting how a dose, route, and schedule act on a partially observed microenvironment, then choosing the measurement that would change the decision. Action-conditioned predictors reduce a regimen to an identity token or a scalar exposure, discarding where and when the target is engaged; handing a point estimate to a separate planner then discards the joint uncertainty that makes a measurement worth running. We therefore treat decision quality as a property of the intervention interface, not of controller placement. NeuronSifter compiles regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields with support masks, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss, assimilating typed outcomes into the same posterior. In a declared synthetic Alzheimer's disease (AD) evaluation over 64 paired scenario blocks, occupancy conditioning lowers trajectory continuous ranked probability score from 0.165 to 0.110 and raises intervention ordering accuracy from 0.760 to 0.880, and every paired benchmark contrast remains separated after Holm correction. Decision-directed acquisition attains terminal risk 0.160 against 0.166 for a matched numerical Bayesian experimental design planner, and reaches the target risk at 0.796 $[0.732,0.873]$ of an earlier design control's cost, while the corresponding ratio against the matched planner, 0.963 $[0.907,1.025]$, is not separated from equality; point-state and dependence-ablated interfaces instead raise risk to 0.220 and 0.199, and a full-posterior external controller ties exactly. Published AD trials supply a separate retrospective endpoint bridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuronSifter 把 CNS 干预方案编译成带支撑掩码的状态条件靶点占据场，用占据条件扩散算子在微环境动力学中传播，并按预期干预损失下降选择测量、把分类型结果同化回同一后验。在 64 个配对场景块的合成阿尔茨海默病评估中，占据条件把轨迹 CRPS 从 0.165 降到 0.110、干预排序准确率从 0.760 升到 0.880；决策导向采集的终末风险 0.160，对点状态与去依赖接口则升到 0.220 和 0.199。
Motivation: 动作条件预测器把方案压成身份 token 或标量暴露，丢掉靶点在何处、何时被占据；再把点估计交给独立规划器，又丢掉了决定一次测量是否值得的联合不确定性。
Method: 将方案编译为状态条件靶点占据场并附支撑掩码，经占据条件扩散算子 (occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator) 在微环境动力学中传播；按对干预损失的预期下降选择测量 (decision-directed acquisition)，并把分类型结果同化进同一后验。评估为声明的合成阿尔茨海默病设定，64 个配对场景块，对照匹配的数值贝叶斯实验设计规划器与去依赖/点状态接口，配对对比经 Holm 校正。
Result: 占据条件使轨迹 CRPS 从 0.165 降至 0.110，干预排序准确率从 0.760 升至 0.880，全部配对对比经 Holm 校正后仍分离。决策导向采集终末风险 0.160，匹配的数值贝叶斯实验设计规划器为 0.166；以早期设计对照成本的 0.796 [0.732, 0.873] 达到目标风险，而对匹配规划器的比值 0.963 [0.907, 1.025] 与无差异不可分。点状态与去依赖接口使风险升至 0.220 与 0.199，全后验外部控制器完全打平。
Conclusion: 决策质量取决于干预接口本身而非控制器放置：保留占据的联合后验并让采集直接面向干预损失，才能在合成 AD 设定下压低风险，而点估计或去依赖的接口会把风险推高。

papers.title: DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON BIOMETRICS, BEHAVIOR, AND IDENTITY SCIENCE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiMoP 用掩码加扩散的方式学关节运动分布而非回归确定坐标，并配一个帧级伪分类器在无手工标注下给出序列一致、时间连贯的伪标签，从而同时覆盖弱、中、强运动。在 NTU RGB+D 60/120 与 PKUMMD 上达到 state-of-the-art，NTU RGB+D 120 跨被试协议比先前工作高 1.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有骨架动作识别方法多聚焦强运动，且常以确定性坐标回归方式建模，弱到中等幅度的动作学不到。
Method: 对关节做掩码并逐步加噪，再以可见关节为条件去噪，通过可控的加噪-解噪过程学习运动分布；同时训练一个伪帧分类器，产生序列一致且时间连贯的伪标签，把生成式扩散学习与判别能力结合。
Result: 在 NTU RGB+D 60、NTU RGB+D 120 与 PKUMMD 上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，其中 NTU RGB+D 120 跨被试 (cross-subject) 协议较先前工作提升 1.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 显式建模关节运动分布并叠加无标注的帧级伪分类，可让骨架动作识别同时兼顾弱、中、强动态并刷新三个基准的最优表现。

papers.title: Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale routing problems are difficult to solve efficiently as their search spaces grow rapidly with problem size. Existing approaches primarily improve the optimization procedure itself, often at increasing computational cost. We instead shift the focus to a useful initialization that can be refined into a high-quality solution with limited downstream refinement. We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space. Extensive experiments on Traveling Salesman Problems (TSPs), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs), Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Windows (VRPTWs), and Prize-Collecting Traveling Salesman Problems (PCTSPs) demonstrate that Just Initialize achieves high-quality solutions comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods while substantially reducing computational cost across instances ranging from 1K to 100K nodes, including an average speedup of approximately 70$\times$, sub-second runtimes on 10K-node instances, and runtimes within tens of seconds on 100K-node instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Just Initialize 是一个免训练、与求解器无关的大规模路径优化初始化组件：把大规模路径实例压缩到紧凑代理空间 (surrogate space) 求解全局路径结构，再映射回原空间作为易优化起点。在 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP 上，1K–100K 节点实例达到与 SOTA 相当或更优的解质量，平均加速约 70×，10K 节点亚秒级、100K 节点数十秒内出解。
Motivation: 大规模路径问题搜索空间随规模急剧膨胀，现有方法主要改进优化过程本身，代价是计算成本不断上升；作者把改进点前移到初始化，让少量下游 refinement 即可得到高质量解。
Method: 三步流水线：将大规模路径实例压缩到紧凑代理空间，在代理空间上优化全局路径结构，再把结果恢复为原空间中可被下游求解器继续优化的起点；组件免训练且与具体求解器解耦。
Result: 在 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP 上，1K 到 100K 节点实例的解质量与 SOTA 方法相当或更优，同时显著降低计算成本：平均加速约 70×，10K 节点实例运行时间亚秒级，100K 节点实例运行时间在数十秒内。
Conclusion: 把优化预算从求解过程前移到初始化，可以在大规模路径问题上以低得多的计算成本换取相当或更好的解质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 三步流水线：将大规模路径实例压缩到紧凑代理空间，在代理空间上优化全局路径结构，再把结果恢复为原空间中可被下游求解器继续优化的起点；组件免训练且与具体求解器解耦。
summary_sections.result: 在 TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP 上，1K 到 100K 节点实例的解质量与 SOTA 方法相当或更优，同时显著降低计算成本：平均加速约 70×，10K 节点实例运行时间亚秒级，100K 节点实例运行时间在数十秒内。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把优化预算从求解过程前移到初始化，可以在大规模路径问题上以低得多的计算成本换取相当或更好的解质量。

papers.title: Riccati State Space Models: Non-iterative Parallelization for Nonlinear Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: State space models (SSMs) achieve efficient sequence processing because their affine state updates are closed under composition and can therefore be evaluated with an associative parallel scan. Nonlinear recurrent models can provide richer, state-dependent dynamics, but generally lose this compositional structure: parallel evaluation then requires iterative methods that repeatedly linearize and scan the recurrence. We ask, what state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can be designed to remain exactly composable? We answer by introducing RiccatiSSM, a nonlinear SSM, in which each state dimension follows an input-conditioned Riccati differential equation. Its quadratic state dependence makes the local Jacobian explicitly state-dependent, while its exact per-step flow under piecewise-constant inputs is a Möbius transformation. Since Möbius maps are closed under composition and compose through $2\times 2$ matrix multiplication, the complete nonlinear state trajectory can be evaluated exactly with a single associative parallel scan, without iterative linearization. We further derive a constrained parameterization that ensures bounded, contractive dynamics, and avoids poles in the fractional-linear state update. Across long-sequence classification, regression, and forecasting tasks, RiccatiSSM achieves competitive predictive performance while reducing runtime by $22{-}33\%$ compared to the nonlinear LrcSSM under matched architectures. These results demonstrate that state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can retain exact composability and be evaluated efficiently within a single parallel scan.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RiccatiSSM 让每个状态维度服从输入条件化的 Riccati 微分方程，其分段常数输入下的单步精确流是 Möbius 变换，而 Möbius 映射在复合下封闭、可由 2×2 矩阵乘法组合，因此整条非线性状态轨迹能用一次 associative parallel scan 精确求值，无需迭代线性化。在长序列分类、回归与 forecasting 任务上性能具竞争力，相比同架构的非线性 LrcSSM 运行时间降低 22–33%。
Motivation: SSM 的仿射状态更新因复合封闭可用并行扫描，但非线性循环模型虽有更丰富的状态依赖动力学，却丢失该结构，并行求值只能靠反复线性化再扫描的迭代方法。
Method: 提出 RiccatiSSM：每个状态维度由输入条件化的 Riccati 微分方程驱动，二次状态依赖使局部 Jacobian 显式依赖状态，分段常数输入下的精确流为 Möbius 变换，经 2×2 矩阵乘法复合后用单次 associative parallel scan 求整条轨迹；另给出受约束参数化以保证有界、收缩动力学并避开分数线性更新中的极点。
Result: 在长序列分类、回归与 forecasting 任务上预测性能具竞争力，匹配架构下相比非线性 LrcSSM 运行时间减少 22–33%。
Conclusion: 状态依赖的非线性动力学可以保持精确可复合性，并在单次并行扫描内高效求值；关键在于选一个复合封闭的非线性流（此处为 Möbius/Riccati）。

papers.title: SOLO: Pretraining Billion-Parameter Language Models with Shared-Output Local Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are trained with backpropagation, whose global gradient coordinates all layers but forces each to hold its activations and wait for the gradient to pass back through every deeper layer. Conventional local learning removes this update locking by training each module to predict the target through its own readout, but has not scaled to billion-parameter pretraining. We identify these private readouts as a key weakness, since they leave each module without information from deeper modules. We propose Shared-Output LOcal learning (SOLO), which replaces them with a shared, read-only copy of the final module's readout, the only one trained on the output of the whole network. Taken from the previous step, the copy transmits information from the final module without passing gradients between modules or reintroducing update locking. SOLO approaches backpropagation on Transformers of 340M to 2B parameters pretrained on 15B tokens, staying within one point in average zero-shot accuracy with a perplexity gap that narrows with scale. Readout ablations attribute SOLO's improvement over private readouts to sharing. Without update locking, each of p pipeline stages holds activations for O(1) micro-batches instead of O(p). The freed memory permits larger micro-batches, which reach up to 1.44x the best measured throughput of pipeline backpropagation on the same partition. To our knowledge, SOLO is the first local learning method to show such memory and throughput gains in billion-parameter language-model pretraining. Local learning thus becomes a practical alternative to backpropagation for large-scale pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOLO 用上一步的最终模块 readout 只读副本替换各模块的私有 readout，在不跨模块传梯度、不引入 update locking 的前提下把深层信息带回浅层。在 340M–2B 参数、15B token 的 Transformer 预训练上，零样本平均准确率与反向传播差距在 1 个点以内且随规模缩小，流水线显存从 O(p) 降到 O(1) micro-batch，吞吐最高达同划分流水线反向传播实测最佳的 1.44 倍。
Motivation: 反向传播的全局梯度让每层锁住激活并等待更深层的梯度回传；常规 local learning 虽解除锁步，但各模块私有 readout 拿不到更深模块的信息，一直没能扩展到十亿参数预训练。
Method: SOLO (Shared-Output LOcal learning) 把每个模块的私有 readout 换成最终模块 readout 的共享只读副本，该副本取自上一步、只在全网络输出上训练，从而在不传梯度、不恢复 update locking 的情况下传递深层信息；用 readout 消融把改进归因于共享本身。
Result: 在 340M 到 2B 参数、预训练 15B token 的 Transformer 上，SOLO 的平均零样本准确率与反向传播相差不到 1 个点，困惑度差距随规模增大而收窄；readout 消融显示相对私有 readout 的提升来自共享。无 update locking 时每个流水线 stage 只需为 O(1) 个 micro-batch 保留激活而非 O(p)，释放的显存支持更大 micro-batch，吞吐最高达到同划分流水线反向传播实测最佳的 1.44 倍。
Conclusion: 作者称 SOLO 是首个在十亿参数语言模型预训练中同时给出显存与吞吐收益的 local learning 方法，据此认为 local learning 已可作为大规模预训练中反向传播的实际替代。

papers.title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RTP 让世界-动作模型把预测的视觉未来当作持续的动作条件，在执行反馈推翻部分预测后就地修订而非整段重规划：修订桥 (revision bridge) 从视觉生成中途保存的状态恢复并按当前观测改写后续，自适应策略在保留、桥修订、从新噪声重新规划三者间选择。RoboMME 与 RMBench 上任务平均成功率分别为 48.6% 和 84.8%，配对比较支持学习式续写。
Motivation: 执行反馈常使视觉未来预测的局部失效，但其任务结构仍然可用；整段重生成会丢掉这部分结构，闭环机器人控制需要在保留结构的前提下局部修订。
Method: 提出 Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP)：视觉未来作为持久动作条件，学习式 revision bridge 从视觉生成的中间检查点恢复并适配续写，视觉与动作监督把修订接到后续控制；time-aware history 提供已观测证据，自适应策略在保留、桥修订、新噪声重规划之间选择后再解码下一动作。
Result: 在 RoboMME 与 RMBench 上任务平均成功率分别为 48.6% 与 84.8%；配对比较支持学习式续写 (learned continuation)，估计的 checkpoint-source 与 action-prefix 效应为正但精度较低。
Conclusion: 反馈驱动的视觉计划修订能把局部失效的预测接到闭环任务表现上，学习式续写是其中被配对比较支持的成分。

papers.title: An integrated geometric quantification and shape analysis framework for axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer patients
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology is important for assessing axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer. However, surfaces reconstructed from computed tomography (CT) segmentation may contain geometric and topological defects that compromise subsequent analysis, while conventional shape descriptors predominantly characterize global morphology. To address these issues, we developed an integrated framework combining topology-aware surface processing with multi-resolution spherical harmonic (SH) analysis of CT-derived axillary lymph nodes. The processing pipeline produced topology-valid genus-0 surfaces with improved mesh quality, which were then represented at multiple SH degrees and characterized using 20 predefined geometric feature families. Geometric fidelity increased with SH degree, whereas predictive performance peaked at intermediate resolutions. Preferred SH degree also differed across feature families. A family-specific mixed-resolution model achieved an AUC of 0.918, compared with 0.884 for the conventional PyRadiomics Shape14 baseline, corresponding to an improvement of 0.0344. Controlled perturbation experiments showed that higher SH degrees transmitted more fine-scale geometric variation and yielded lower stability of curvature-based predictions. Representative geometric descriptors provided interpretable characterization of metastasis-associated surface morphology. Independent validation further supported the framework's transportability: label-free replication in a multicenter lymph node cohort reproduced the family-specific resolution effects, while a labeled LIDC-IDRI lung-nodule experiment reproduced the resolution-dependent relationship between SH degree and predictive performance. Altogether, the framework provides a topology-valid basis for quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology and metastasis-associated imaging phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出拓扑感知表面处理加多分辨率球谐 (spherical harmonic, SH) 分析的框架，从 CT 分割的腋窝淋巴结重建 genus-0 有效曲面，用 20 个几何特征族刻画转移相关形态。按特征族分别选取 SH 阶数的混合分辨率模型 AUC 达 0.918，高于 PyRadiomics Shape14 基线的 0.884（提升 0.0344）；SH 阶数越高几何保真越好，但曲率类预测稳定性下降，故分辨率应按特征族在中等阶数处取折中。
Motivation: CT 分割重建的淋巴结表面常带几何与拓扑缺陷，会破坏后续分析；而传统形状描述子主要刻画全局形态，缺少多尺度的局部表面刻画能力。
Method: 先做拓扑感知表面处理得到 genus-0、网格质量改善的曲面，再做多分辨率球谐 (SH) 表示，提取 20 个预定义几何特征族；用按特征族区分 SH 阶数的混合分辨率模型预测腋窝淋巴结转移，并配合受控扰动实验检验曲率类预测的稳定性。
Result: 家族特定混合分辨率模型 AUC 0.918，PyRadiomics Shape14 基线 0.884，提升 0.0344。几何保真度随 SH 阶数升高而提升，但预测性能在中等分辨率处达峰，且最优 SH 阶数因特征族而异；受控扰动实验显示更高 SH 阶数传递更多细尺度几何变化、曲率类预测稳定性更低。无标签的多中心淋巴结队列复现了特征族特定的分辨率效应，带标签的 LIDC-IDRI 肺结节实验复现了 SH 阶数与预测性能的分辨率依赖关系。
Conclusion: 拓扑有效的多分辨率 SH 表示可作为量化淋巴结形态与转移影像表型的基础，分辨率选择须按特征族在几何保真与预测稳定性之间折中，且该框架在跨队列、跨器官设置下可迁移。

papers.title: Building Transformation Layers for Riemannian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recently, deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have garnered significant attention across various machine learning applications. One recent focus is the generalization of Euclidean fully connected (FC) and convolutional layers to non-Euclidean geometries. However, previous approaches typically focus on a few selected manifolds and rely on specific properties of the target manifold. In contrast, this work proposes a framework for constructing FC and convolutional layers over computationally tractable Riemannian spaces. This framework incorporates several previous FC layers across different geometries as special cases and is instantiated on ten representative manifolds, including three hyperbolic models, five geometries of the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold, and two Grassmannian perspectives. Experiments on different manifolds demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of our approach. Code can be found at https://github.com/GitZH-Chen/RieTrans.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) frequently reuses rollouts across multiple policy updates, increasing the mismatch between the current policy and the data-generating policy. We identify a sign-dependent gradient starvation problem in clipped policy optimization: clipping suppresses under-generated positive responses at the low-importance-weight tail while permitting severely over-generated negative responses to dominate the high-weight tail. To address this, we propose ReSPO (Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization), which replaces clipping with a smooth, two-branch sequence-level kernel derived from an $α$-divergence variational objective and an exponential variance-control tilt. The positive branch preserves a nonzero gradient weight for under-generated positive responses, while the negative branch suppresses heavily over-generated negative responses. We demonstrate that ReSPO effectively learns from long positive reasoning trajectories during early training, even when accumulated policy drift relegates them to the low-importance-weight tail. On dense and MoE Qwen3 models, ReSPO accelerates early optimization, improves final training scores, and achieves higher held-out benchmark performance under a rollout reuse, validating our approach on importance-weight tail control in off-policy learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSPO 指出 RLVR 中裁剪式策略优化存在符号相关的梯度饥饿：低重要性权重尾部的欠生成正响应被裁掉，而高权重尾部的严重过生成负响应反而主导梯度。它用 α-散度变分目标导出的双分支平滑序列级核替换裁剪，正分支保留欠生成正响应的非零梯度权重，负分支压制过生成负响应。
Motivation: RLVR 复用 rollout 做多次策略更新，当前策略与数据生成策略的偏移不断累积，裁剪机制按符号不对称地饿死正样本梯度，使早期训练学不动长正向推理轨迹。
Method: 以 α-散度变分目标加指数方差控制倾斜 (exponential variance-control tilt) 推出平滑的双分支序列级核，替代 PPO 式裁剪：正分支在低重要性权重尾部保留非零梯度权重，负分支在高权重尾部压制严重过生成的负响应。
Result: 在 dense 与 MoE 的 Qwen3 模型上，ReSPO 在 rollout 复用设定下加快早期优化、提高最终训练分数，并取得更高的 held-out benchmark 性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: off-policy 学习中重要性权重尾部需要按响应符号区别控制，用平滑双分支核替代裁剪即可在累积策略漂移下仍学到低权重尾部的长正向推理轨迹。

papers.title: Multi-Task Learning of Conditional Mean Operators: applications to dynamical systems and uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract_en: Estimating conditional statistics and learning representations of a population of conditional distributions are central problems in many data-driven applications, including uncertainty quantification and dynamical systems analysis. Conditional mean operators (CMOs), a class of linear operators between function spaces, resolve these objectives by providing access to a broad class of conditional statistics. However, existing methods typically estimate each CMO independently or constrain it to prespecified function spaces, thereby preventing the exploitation of shared structure across related distributions. In this work, we posit that related CMOs share finite-dimensional input and output function spaces, and are specialized for each task with a linear operator mapping these spaces. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce MTL-CMO, a multi-task framework that jointly learns shared function spaces and task-specific operators across multiple datasets. We further introduce T-CMO, a transfer learning method that reuses the shared spaces to estimate, in closed form, the operator of a new conditional distribution. We establish statistical guarantees quantifying the benefits of jointly learning the shared function spaces. Our experiments demonstrate that learning shared function spaces improves uncertainty quantification across a broad range of conditional distributions and, when applied to Langevin and plasma dynamics, yields compact representations of complex dynamics that retain physically meaningful information and enable parameter identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MTL-CMO：把多个相关条件分布的条件平均算子 (CMO) 分解为共享的有限维输入/输出函数空间加任务专属线性算子，联合学习而非逐个估计。T-CMO 进一步以闭式复用共享空间估计新条件分布的算子；联合学习共享空间带来可量化的统计增益，并在 Langevin 与等离子体动力学上给出保留物理信息的紧凑表示与参数辨识能力。
Motivation: 现有 CMO 方法要么逐个独立估计、要么被限定在预设函数空间上，无法利用相关分布之间的共享结构，限制了不确定性量化与动力系统表示学习。
Method: MTL-CMO 假设相关 CMO 共享有限维输入与输出函数空间，各任务由映射这些空间的线性算子特化，在多数据集上联合学习共享空间与任务专属算子；T-CMO 复用共享空间，以闭式估计新条件分布的算子；并给出量化联合学习收益的统计保证。
Result: 实验显示学习共享函数空间在广泛的条件分布上改善不确定性量化；应用于 Langevin 与 plasma dynamics 时，得到保留物理意义信息的紧凑动力学表示并支持参数辨识。
Conclusion: 相关条件分布的 CMO 确实共享低维函数空间，联合学习这一共享结构既能提升不确定性量化，也能产生可用于参数辨识的动力系统表示。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: A Reduced-Order Coupled Oscillator Model for the Emergence of Episodic Convection
papers.abstract_en: Extreme precipitation is a societal concern, and understanding tropical moist convection is increasingly important in a warming climate. Climate simulations show that, under hothouse Earth, convection can transition from quasi-steady precipitation to an episodic regime characterized by intense rainfall bursts separated by dry intervals, although the mechanisms governing this transition remain debated. Here we develop a reduced-order framework that represents tropical convection through column-integrated moisture (q) and thermal stratification (Delta), rather than bulk measures of convective instability. Analysis of cloud-resolving model (CRM) simulations shows that these variables evolve together: during dry periods, surface fluxes recharge moisture, while radiative and dynamical processes erode stratification generated by previous convection. We couple this evolution to the nonlinear moisture dependence of tropical precipitation (P), whereby rainfall increases sharply above a critical moisture threshold. A third prognostic variable, C, represents convective persistence, allowing convection to continue below its onset threshold and thereby producing hysteresis. With parameters constrained by CRM output, the model reproduces the evolution of q, Delta, and P in both regimes, representing quasi-steady convection as stable, noise-driven oscillations and episodic convection as an unstable, self-sustained limit cycle. Linear stability analysis shows that the transition depends on moisture-recharge and stratification-adjustment timescales, thermal-moisture sensitivity, and convective persistence. Because radiative and dynamical processes enter through their effects on thermal stratification, the framework is not tied to a specific mechanism, providing a unified dynamical link between moisture-threshold precipitation behavior and the emergence of episodic convection under warming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用柱积分水汽 q、热力层结 Δ 和对流持续性 C 三个变量构建热带对流降阶耦合振子模型，把降水 P 的非线性水汽阈值与滞后 (hysteresis) 接入，准稳态对流表现为稳定噪声驱动振荡，阵发对流表现为不稳定自持极限环。转变由水汽补充与层结调整时间尺度、热-湿敏感性及对流持续性共同决定，参数由云分辨模式 (CRM) 输出约束后可在两种状态下重现 q、Δ、P 的演化。
Motivation: hothouse Earth 下热带对流可能从准稳态降水转为强降雨爆发夹干燥间歇的阵发态，但控制该转变的机制仍有争议；用对流不稳定的整体量难以刻画这一转变。
Method: 以柱积分水汽 q 与热力层结 Δ 代替整体对流不稳定度，耦合降水 P 对水汽的非线性阈值依赖；加入第三个预报量 C 表示对流持续性，使对流可在起始阈值以下继续从而产生滞后。参数由 CRM 模拟输出约束，并做线性稳定性分析。
Result: 模型在两种状态下均重现 CRM 中 q、Δ、P 的演化：准稳态对流对应稳定、噪声驱动的振荡，阵发对流对应不稳定的自持极限环。线性稳定性分析给出转变取决于水汽补充与层结调整时间尺度、热-湿敏感性和对流持续性。
Conclusion: 辐射与动力过程通过影响热力层结进入模型，因此该框架不绑定于某一具体机制，把水汽阈值降水行为与增暖下阵发对流的出现统一到同一动力学链条上。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出通用异步 LLM agent 框架：用户或 agent 自行定义可重叠内存状态的推理 coroutine，使模型在思考或执行任务时仍能接收新输入。Qwen 3.x 无需任务专用训练即可异步处理流式视频理解、电子游戏与监控三类并发场景。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 遵循 read-think-reply 的顺序循环，而语音助手、具身 agent、监控系统等真实场景需要边思考边接收新输入，目前只能靠语音、视频流、VLA、异步工具调用等各自专用架构分别解决。
Method: 从各类异步任务中归纳出通用异步 agent 抽象，开发允许定义推理 coroutine 且内存状态可重叠的异步 LLM 框架，由用户或 agent 自行指定并发类型；在 Qwen 3.x 上做无任务专用训练的展示。
Result: 展示 Qwen 3.x 在不进行任务专用训练的情况下支持异步运行，覆盖流式视频理解、电子游戏与监控三类场景。
Conclusion: 并发能力可以做成通用框架层的抽象而非逐任务专用架构，通用 LLM 本身已具备异步操作能力。

papers.title: Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 frontier learning：用程序化生成器在线持续产出难度贴合模型当前能力边缘的训练题，把生成器的任务参数当作搜索空间，用 regret 信号在难度前沿上做优先级与探索。在多个推理任务与模型族上，相对固定题池基线 consistently 取得更高的相对增益。
Motivation: RL 后训练（GRPO）依赖 rollout 中成功与失败混合产生的学习信号，固定题池中有效题目会随模型变强而迅速失效，限制了持续提升。
Method: 开放式的后训练流程：程序化生成器在线产生训练问题，将生成器的任务特定参数作为搜索空间，用 regret 信号优先探索前沿难度级别，把训练集中在模型演化中的能力边缘。
Result: 在多个推理任务与多个模型族上，相对固定题池 (fixed-pool) 基线 consistently 取得更高的相对增益；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 有效后训练不仅要选好题目，还要在能力边缘持续生成题目。

papers.title: Semantic Prefix Oracles for LLM Decoding: Contracts and Differential Validation
papers.abstract_en: Constrained decoding can enforce regular or context-free output formats, but many program-generation failures are semantic: scope, typing, and declaration effects depend on context. We present semantic grammar specifications, a declarative formalism that attaches such constraints to a context-free surface and executes them during Earley descent. Our implementation enforces \emph{safe pruning}: it rejects only prefixes whose semantic contradictions cannot be repaired by any continuation. A separate, grammar-dependent, \emph{dead-end freedom} property guarantees the existence of a realizable witness for each remaining branch. We give simple sufficient conditions based on surface productivity, type coverage, and left-to-right constraint flow. Our finite-lambda, core ML, and C-like fragments satisfy them, while the STLC instance used in our experiments does not: plain STLC can violate type coverage, and we show how restricting its type universe recovers it. A tokenizer-lifting lemma carries character-level witnesses to token sequences under an explicit vocabulary-coverage hypothesis. We validate the implementation differentially against production compilers (\texttt{ocamlc}, \texttt{cc}). Across every prefix of 65 compiler-valid programs we observe zero false prunes. The semantic oracle localizes 25/30 invalid programs mid-stream, against 0/30 for a syntax-only oracle, and agrees on 42/42 recursion probes. A twelve-model generation study, including a matched semantic-versus-syntactic ablation for nine models, finds nonnegative observed semantic-minus-syntactic point estimates for every model-language pair, with maxima of $+15.2$ points on STLC task correctness and $+14.3$ points on ML validity.

Result: 65 个编译器合法程序的每个前缀上零误剪；语义 oracle 中途定位 25/30 个非法程序，语法-only oracle 为 0/30；42/42 个递归探针一致。十二模型生成研究（其中九个模型有语义对语法的配对消融）中每个模型-语言对的语义减语法点估计均非负，STLC 任务正确率最高 +15.2 点，ML 合法性最高 +14.3 点。finite-lambda、core ML、C-like 片段满足充分条件，实验所用 STLC 实例不满足（可经限制类型全集恢复）。

papers.title: Automated Species Identification in Camera Trap Images for Wildlife Conservation
papers.abstract_en: Wildlife conservation involves protecting, preserving, and managing wildlife species and their habitats. With today's rapid pace of human development, climate change, and other unsustainable practices, the need for wildlife conservation has heightened. Despite significant progress in species identification using deep-learning models, significant challenges still remain in effectively detecting small animals in low-contrast trap images due to limited feature extraction capabilities. This thesis presents a novel end-to-end framework integrating a self-attention mechanism to address these limitations. The proposed architecture involves a Swin-BiFPN backbone integrated in a Faster RCNN detection network, coupled with a visual semantic extraction module driven by the LLaVA v1.5 (13B) multimodal large language model. The detection framework, capable of extracting crucial features in challenging trap images, demonstrates consistently high results and robust generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the visual semantic extraction module provides zero-shot detection capability, as well as providing valuable insights and emergent cues of the animal's behavior, further supporting the conservation effort. The MLLM evaluation was conducted using both traditional NLP metrics (precision, recall, F1, and SBERT similarity) and subjective scoring by LLM-based judges (GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0), across five MLLMs, demonstrating the model's strong performance in visual description generation. The proposed framework improves detection accuracy across low-contrast trap images and small animals while also demonstrating zero-shot detection capability leveraging the MLLM.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对相机陷阱图像中小体型、低对比度动物检测难，提出端到端框架：Swin-BiFPN 主干接入 Faster R-CNN，再接由 LLaVA v1.5 (13B) 驱动的视觉语义抽取模块。该模块同时给出零样本检测能力与动物行为线索描述，检测精度在低对比度与小动物场景下得到提升。
Motivation: 深度学习物种识别在相机陷阱图像中仍难以有效检测小动物与低对比度目标，受限于特征提取能力不足。
Method: Swin-BiFPN 主干 + Faster R-CNN 检测网络，配合自注意力机制；后接由 LLaVA v1.5 (13B) 多模态大模型驱动的视觉语义抽取模块，提供零样本检测与行为描述。MLLM 评测用 precision、recall、F1、SBERT 相似度，并由 GPT-4.1 与 GROK 3.0 作为 LLM 评审做主观打分，覆盖五个 MLLM。
Result: 检测框架在低对比度相机陷阱图像与小动物上提升检测精度，并展示零样本检测能力；MLLM 视觉描述生成在五个 MLLM 上经 NLP 指标与 LLM 评审评估表现强。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把检测网络与 MLLM 语义抽取串联，可在相机陷阱场景同时获得难目标检测与可解释的动物行为描述，支撑保护工作。

papers.title: Convex Optimization Is Free When Accuracy Is Expensive
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies convex optimization when the gradient cannot be evaluated exactly, but only approximated by a hierarchy of algorithms whose compute grows like $δ^{-γ}$ in the accuracy $δ$. When $γ>2$, falling into the Harder-Than-Monte-Carlo (HTMC) regime, the price of accuracy outruns the variance reduction that Monte Carlo would buy and we show that minimizing a loss function costs no more, up to a factor depending only on $γ$, than a single evaluation of its gradient at the accuracy the problem demands. A randomized multilevel oracle replaces the deterministic approximation of accuracy $δ$ by an unbiased estimator of it, whose variance $σ^2$ becomes a second, independently priced dial: the cost of one call drops from $δ^{-γ}$ to $δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}$. Plain inexact gradient descent driven by that oracle reaches loss $\varepsilon$ at expected compute $Θ(\varepsilon^{-γ})$ in the convex case, against $Θ(\varepsilon^{-(γ+1)})$ for the same method run at a fixed accuracy: randomization buys a full power of $\varepsilon$. Under $μ$-strong convexity the exponent halves, to $\varepsilon^{-γ/2}$, because the iterates settle at a noise floor and the bias budget relaxes accordingly. Both bounds are independent of the step size, and hence of the smoothness constant, and we show that the cost is a functional of the underlying gradient flow rather than of any discretization of it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当梯度只能用代价随精度 δ 增长为 δ^{-γ} 的层级算法近似且 γ>2（Harder-Than-Monte-Carlo 区间）时，随机多层 oracle（randomized multilevel oracle）把一次梯度调用代价从 δ^{-γ} 降到 δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}，使凸优化总代价不超过单次目标梯度求值（差一个只依赖 γ 的因子）。用该 oracle 驱动的非精确梯度下降在凸情形达损失 ε 的期望计算量为 Θ(ε^{-γ})，比固定精度同法的 Θ(ε^{-(γ+1)}) 省下整整一个 ε 幂次；μ-强凸时指数减半到 ε^{-γ/2}。
Motivation: 梯度无法精确求值、只能用计算量随精度 δ^{-γ} 增长的层级算法近似时，γ>2 的 HTMC 区间里追求高精度的代价超过 Monte Carlo 能换来的方差缩减，常规非精确梯度下降代价被精度需求压垮。
Method: 构造 randomized multilevel oracle：用精度 δ 的无偏估计量替代确定性 δ 近似，把方差 σ² 作为独立可调的代价旋钮；其上跑朴素非精确梯度下降 (inexact gradient descent)，并对凸与 μ-强凸分别给出计算复杂度界，证明代价是底层梯度流的泛函而非任何离散化。
Result: 一次 oracle 调用代价由 δ^{-γ} 降至 δ^{2-γ}σ^{-2}；凸情形达损失 ε 的期望计算量 Θ(ε^{-γ})，对照固定精度同法的 Θ(ε^{-(γ+1)})，省下一个 ε 幂次；μ-强凸时指数减半为 ε^{-γ/2}（迭代停在噪声地板、偏差预算相应放松）。两个界均与步长无关，因而与光滑常数无关；总代价不超过在所需精度处单次梯度求值，差一个只依赖 γ 的因子。
Conclusion: 在 γ>2 的 HTMC 区间，随机化多层求值让凸优化的精度代价与单次梯度求值同阶，随机化买下整整一个 ε 幂次；代价由梯度流本身决定，与离散化和步长无关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting
papers.abstract_en: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/StaMina/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StaMina 用状态维护 (State Maintenance) 做连续视频计数：以状态条件化更新区分新观测与新对象/已完成事件，可微递归在计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移。在 SVCBench 的前缀回放与持续流式设定下，4B/8B 模型分别达到 41.9/36.4 与 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy，8B 相对 Counting-SFT 同查询提升 10.9/3.2 分。
Motivation: 连续视频计数要区分新观测与新对象或已完成事件，而计数状态如何跨帧维护、如何在部分视频重叠与留出标注组下迁移，是该任务的核心难点。
Method: StaMina 以状态条件化更新维护计数状态：递归视觉上下文负责识别，学习到的转移维护可见性、持久身份与已完成事件记录；可微递归在计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移，可见性与关联目标训练对象分支；多源流程组织 39.8K 空间查询与互补事件标注构成计数轨迹。
Result: 在 SVCBench 上，前缀回放 (Full) 与持续流式 (Stream) 下 4B/8B 模型的 Gaussian Precision Accuracy 分别为 41.9/36.4 与 44.9/38.2；8B 在同查询上比 Counting-SFT 高 10.9/3.2 分；匹配图比较用于分离阶段条件化与轨迹监督的作用。
Conclusion: 把计数建模为带合法路径约束的状态维护问题，并用轨迹监督训练事件转移，可在部分重叠与流式视频上提升连续计数精度。

papers.title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

papers.title: Self-Adapting Group of Experts for Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent's response depends on its model's capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents' initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Adapting Group of Experts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor's reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents' original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是一个免训练的多智能体推理框架：用初始回答的答案一致性、前缀一致性和互评选出策略供体，把供体的推理策略迁移到其他 agent 而保留各自角色，再让回答在按评分定向的稀疏 DAG 上流动。在多个 agent backbone 与推理 benchmark 上，SAGE 平均准确率高于所评测的基线。
Motivation: 现有框架只通过改写输入 context 来调节协作，system prompt 固定不变，即使问题需要不同技能也无法切换推理策略。
Method: 训练-free 的 SAGE：以 answer agreement、prefix consistency、reciprocal peer review 三项信号选择 strategy donor；迁移只用各 agent 原有 system prompt，不接触题目与已生成解答；适配后按评分高低在动态稀疏有向无环图 (DAG) 上路由回答。
Result: 在多个 agent backbone 和推理 benchmark 上，SAGE 的平均准确率高于所评测的基线；代码开源在 github.com/atifquamar07/sage。
Conclusion: 初始回答足以识别更合适的推理策略并跨 agent 迁移，无需训练、也不必让 agent 看到问题本身。

papers.title: GLAD: Global-Local Adaptive Detector for Robust Speech Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-based speech synthesis have enabled highly realistic speech, increasing the importance of speech deepfake detection (SDD) in preventing misuse. While mainstream Self-Supervised Learning (SSL)-based detectors achieve strong performance, they suffer from poor generalization to unseen domains and often overlook fine-grained signal artifacts due to a bias towards global semantic consistency. In this paper, we conduct the first detailed empirical and visual analysis to validate these limitations explicitly. Our investigation reveals two critical architectural vulnerabilities: (1) a systemic failure to capture localized spoofing traces, and (2) a severe lack of adaptability to domain-driven shifts in SSL layer importance, rendering static aggregation strategies prone to overfitting. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose the Global-Local Adaptive Detector (GLAD). Specifically, to capture localized forgeries, GLAD employs a Hierarchical Global-Local (HGL) backbone that explicitly bridges the granularity gap by fusing global linguistic and acoustic features with fine-grained local signal details. To counter layer importance shifts in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, we introduce a Hierarchical Adaptive Gating (HAG) mechanism that dynamically recalibrates layer-wise focus in a sample-specific manner. Finally, to address shortcut learning induced by environmental biases, we introduce SaniBoost, a composite data augmentation strategy for robust signal standardization and noise sanitization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GLAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on unseen domain cases.The code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLAD 针对 SSL 语音深伪检测 (SDD) 的两大架构缺陷——抓不住局部伪造痕迹、SSL 层权重在域偏移下失配——提出分层全局-局部骨干 (HGL) 融合全局语言声学特征与细粒度局部信号，配合样本自适应的分层门控 (HAG) 重标定层权重，并用 SaniBoost 数据增强抑制环境偏置带来的捷径学习。实验显示 GLAD 显著优于 SOTA，尤其在未见域场景。
Motivation: SSL-based 检测器泛化到未见域差，且偏向全局语义一致性而忽略细粒度信号痕迹；静态层聚合策略在域偏移下易过拟合。
Method: GLAD 三组件：HGL 骨干融合全局语言/声学特征与局部信号细节；HAG 机制按样本动态重标定 SSL 层权重以应对 OOD 层重要性偏移；SaniBoost 复合数据增强做信号标准化与噪声净化，抑制环境偏置引发的捷径学习。
Result: 大量实验表明 GLAD 显著优于 SOTA 方法，在未见域 (unseen domain) 案例上优势尤为突出；另做了首次详细的实证与可视化分析来验证上述两项架构缺陷。
Conclusion: 同时建模局部伪造痕迹与样本自适应层权重、并清洗环境噪声，是提升语音深伪检测跨域鲁棒性的有效路径；代码将于论文发表时释出。

papers.title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.
papers.comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSRON 把多光谱卫星图像的光谱超分辨率 (spectral super-resolution) 建成算子学习问题，用 Deep Operator Network 学 downsampled 光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射，在 Sentinel-2A-like 多光谱到 EMIT 图像的训练设定下，全部指标上优于基线模型，并能零样本预测训练中未见的波段。
Motivation: 多光谱到高光谱的光谱超分辨率本质上是 ill-posed 问题，直接回归难以给出连续光谱；若能低成本获得高时空分辨率高光谱影像，高光谱遥感的适用面会大幅扩展。
Method: 将光谱超分辨率表述为 operator learning 问题，提出 SSRON（Deep Operator Network），学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射；训练数据为 Sentinel-2A-like 多光谱影像到 EMIT 图像的配对。
Result: 在与基线模型的比较中 SSRON 在所有指标上均取得更优表现；模型展示零样本光谱超分辨率能力，可预测训练期间未见的波段；连续输出形式使其有望估计比传感器原生更细波长间隔的光谱。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SSRON 的结果确立了 operator learning 作为光谱超分辨率的一个有前景的方向，连续输出还带来超越原生波段间隔的估计潜力。

papers.title: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs with human performance across three demographic groups, where the best-performing model surpasses human averages overall, but most still fall markedly short in metacognition and self-awareness. Finally, we show that awareness is a distinct capability: progress in language modeling or reasoning does not necessarily translate into improved cognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AwarenessBench 是首个覆盖元认知、自我意识、社会意识、情境意识四个维度、15 项认知功能、14,381 个样本的语言模型认知能力基准，评测 18 个前沿模型。所有模型都稳定超过随机基线且更强的模型表现更好；最佳模型总体超过人类平均水平，但在元认知与自我意识上多数仍明显落后，并证明“意识”是独立能力——语言建模或推理的进步不必然转化为认知提升。
Motivation: 语言模型已表现出类意识行为，但缺少统一、系统的认知能力评测标准，无法判断模型在哪些认知维度接近或落后于人类。
Method: 构建四维度（元认知、自我意识、社会意识、情境意识）、15 项认知功能、14,381 个样本的基准，评测 18 个前沿语言模型，并与三个人口统计群体的人类表现对照，同时检验认知能力与语言建模、推理能力的独立性。
Result: 18 个前沿模型全部稳定超过随机基线，更先进的模型表现更好；最佳模型总体超过人类平均水平，但在元认知与自我意识上多数模型仍明显落后；跨三个人口统计群体的人类对比显示认知进展与语言建模或推理进展不必然同步。
Conclusion: 意识/认知是与语言建模、推理相区分的独立能力，仅靠通用能力提升不会自动补齐元认知与自我意识短板。

papers.title: "Nothing to See Here'': Unintended Disclosure through Revision Traces of LLM Deliverables
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users draft content for third-party recipients. During private drafting, the user or the model may introduce an item and later remove or replace it. The model may remove the item from the intended content but reveal it again when stating the edit. We call such statements revision traces. For example, after a user removes the password before sharing a configuration file, the model may delete it but leave a comment saying, "Removed the password 'No****4!' as requested." A third-party recipient who sees only the delivered file can therefore recover the withdrawn password from the comment. In an in-the-wild analysis of three public conversation corpora, we identify 26,753 revision requests, of which 2,363 (8.8%) leave revision traces. We study them in greater depth under controlled conditions by introducing RevLeakBench, a benchmark of 100 tasks across five scenarios with a conversation track and an agent track. We measure trace occurrence, withdrawn-item recovery, trace position, and required-content retention. Across six models, about half of the deliverables in both tracks state the edit after a revocation, and a reader that sees only the deliverable can recover the withdrawn item from about 13% of them. Telling the model that its entire reply will be forwarded to the recipient still leaves revision traces in 36.4% of the deliverables. We compare prompt defenses and a delivery boundary, and propose an output-side filter that sharply reduces recovery with little loss of required content. We believe our work can benefit efforts to understand and mitigate unintended disclosure in LLM interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在按用户要求删除敏感项后，常在编辑说明里把该项重新泄露出去（revision trace）。三个公开对话语料中 26,753 条撤回请求有 2,363 条（8.8%）留下痕迹；在 RevLeakBench（100 任务、5 场景、双 track、6 模型）上约一半交付物会陈述编辑，仅看交付物的读者可从中恢复被撤回项约 13%，即使告知模型整段回复会转发给收件人仍有 36.4% 留痕。作者提出的输出侧过滤器可大幅降低恢复率且对必需内容损失很小。
Motivation: LLM 起草的交付物会发给第三方，而模型在执行删除或替换时可能在编辑说明中重新披露已撤回的项，接收方仅凭交付文件即可恢复密码等敏感内容，这一泄露路径此前缺乏系统刻画与评测。
Method: 先在三个公开对话语料中做 in-the-wild 分析，识别 revision 请求并统计留痕；再提出 RevLeakBench，含 100 个任务、5 类场景，每任务设 conversation track 与 agent track，度量痕迹出现、撤回项恢复、痕迹位置与必需内容保留；比较 prompt 防御与 delivery boundary，并提出输出侧过滤器。
Result: 三个公开语料中识别出 26,753 条 revision 请求，其中 2,363 条（8.8%）留下 revision traces。RevLeakBench 上跨 6 个模型，两个 track 中约一半交付物在撤回后仍陈述编辑，仅见交付物的读者可从中恢复被撤回项约 13%。告知模型整段回复将被转发给收件人后，仍有 36.4% 的交付物留痕。
Conclusion: revision trace 是 LLM 交付物的系统性非预期披露渠道，转发警告这类 prompt 防御不足以消除；输出侧过滤器能在几乎不损失必需内容的前提下大幅压低恢复率。

papers.title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiMoGen 用统一的 masked discrete diffusion 同时做文本生成动作 (text-to-motion) 与动作描述 (motion-to-text)，以双向迭代预测替代自回归的固定生成顺序。训练上先用 Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training 的掩码预训练建立跨模态对应，再做监督微调；推理早期用 Generation-Aware Self-Correction 修正不可靠 token。在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上两项任务均取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 自回归统一模型的固定生成顺序不适配语言与动作之间的双向依赖，早期预测错误会作为固定上下文留存，损害时序一致性与跨模态一致性。
Method: 统一 masked discrete diffusion 框架，通过迭代双向预测建模序列；两阶段训练 Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training：掩码预训练先在成对 motion-text 序列上建立跨模态对应，再以监督微调专化双向生成；Generation-Aware Self-Correction 在训练中让模型接触自身预测，并在采样早期步做 correction pass 修订不可靠提交的 token。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上，text-to-motion 与 motion-to-text 两项任务均取得有竞争力的表现，验证两阶段训练与自纠错设计的有效性。
Conclusion: masked discrete diffusion 加两阶段解耦训练与生成感知自纠错，可作为替代自回归的双向 motion-text 统一建模方案。

papers.title: Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR)，把每个解剖视角的 D 张切片先压成 M<<D 个互补 2D 分量再送入冻结的 2D foundation model，绕开逐片编码后融合的做法。分量由 uncentered-PCA 基底加多尺度空间描述子残差构成，仅从训练体数据估计、无需诊断标签与梯度优化。在 ADNI、OASIS、ABIDE 上，冻结编码器设置下 MVR 相对所评估的 2D-to-3D 适配方法与简单输入降维基线取得整体强表现，并能从 ADNI 强泛化到 AIBL。
Motivation: 2D foundation model 用于脑结构 MRI 体数据时存在 2D 编码器与 3D 体输入的错配；现有方法多为逐片独立编码后再融合特征，切片间的体信息在编码前就已丢失。
Method: MVR 采用 reduce-then-encode：先将每个解剖视角的 D 张切片压缩为 M<<D 个互补 2D 分量，其中基底分量由原始 through-plane 强度做 uncentered-PCA 得到，残差细节分量由多尺度空间描述子构造；降维仅从训练体数据估计，不使用诊断标签、不做梯度优化，估计后固定。各分量由共享的冻结 2D foundation model 独立处理，再拼接做 linear probing。
Result: 在 ADNI、OASIS、ABIDE 三个数据集上，冻结编码器设置下 MVR 相对所评估的 2D-to-3D 适配方法与简单输入降维基线取得整体强表现；并能从 ADNI 强泛化到 AIBL。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 先降维再编码可以在不微调 2D foundation model 的前提下弥合 2D 编码器与 3D 体数据的错配，且降维参数无需标签或梯度训练即可固定使用。

papers.title: Persistent Partners Raise Prices Among Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: When pricing agents meet repeatedly on a platform, the platform decides who faces whom. We ask whether that choice moves the prices the agents learn, and whether a rise comes with learned punishment. In a pre-registered randomised experiment in the Bertrand duopoly of Calvano et al., each agent's price is set by a tabular Q-learning module, not by the small language model attached to it, and we randomise whether each agent keeps its partner, sees its rival's prices and can send messages. Keeping the same partner raises the level of profits, averaged over training, by 0.27 of the gap between competitive and monopoly profit (95% CI 0.20 to 0.35, all twenty paired runs positive), our registered primary result, and the resting price by 0.17 of the Nash-to-monopoly range (post hoc). A plain tabular learner reproduces the effect in all 25 further blocks, and there one permanent partner raises the level more than about three do (+0.23 against +0.05, exploratory). Where rival prices are hidden, the price-setting module cannot see a cut, so cannot punish it, yet the resting price rises as much and the rise lasts to the end of training, while with visible rivals it shrinks with longer training (post hoc). Where the rival is visible, a static best responder accounts for a third to a half of what a forced-deviation probe reads as punishment, on the starts where the rival can see the cut, and net of it the registered test of learned punishment is inconclusive. A test that looks only for punishment would thus miss the rise where the rival is hidden, while a check for profitable deviations flags most of those prices (post hoc). In an exploratory extension, untrained Qwen2.5 7B and 14B models under one prompt show the effect when the rival's price is left out of the prompt and inconsistently when it is shown, the 7B result replicating on fresh blocks, while two other model families show none.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered on OSF (https://osf.io/98bx5, under embargo). Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Calvano et al. 的 Bertrand 双人博弈中，用表格 Q-learning 定价并随机分配是否保留同一对手：固定伙伴使利润水平相对竞争—垄断差距上升 0.27（95% CI 0.20–0.35，20 组配对运行全部为正），静止价格上升 0.17 个 Nash—垄断区间。对手价格不可见时价格模块看不到降价、无法惩罚，静止价格仍同样上升且持续到训练结束；只检测惩罚的检验会漏掉这一情形。
Motivation: 平台决定定价代理反复相遇的对象，但配对结构是否推高学习到的价格、价格上涨是否必然伴随习得性惩罚，此前缺少预注册的因果检验。
Method: 预注册随机实验，基于 Calvano et al. 的 Bertrand 双头市场，每个代理的价格由表格 Q-learning 模块设定（非附带的小语言模型）；随机操纵是否保留同一对手、是否可见对手价格、是否可发消息；用强制偏离探针 (forced-deviation probe) 读取惩罚，并以静态最优反应者作对照。
Result: 保留同一伙伴使训练平均利润水平上升 0.27 个竞争—垄断差距（95% CI 0.20–0.35，20 组配对运行全正，注册主结果），静止价格上升 0.17 个 Nash—垄断区间（事后分析）。纯表格学习器在另外 25 个 block 全部复现该效应；单一永久伙伴比约三个伙伴抬升更多（+0.23 对 +0.05，探索性）。对手价格隐藏时静止价格上升幅度相同且持续到训练结束，可见时随训练变长而收窄（事后）。对手可见时静态最优反应者解释强制偏离探针所读惩罚的三分之一到一半；扣除后注册的习得性惩罚检验结论不确定。探索性扩展中，未训练的 Qwen2.5 7B 与 14B 在提示中去掉对手价格时复现该效应、给出对手价格时不一致（7B 在新 block 上复现），另两个模型家族无此效应。
Conclusion: 价格上涨不必由习得性惩罚驱动：对手不可见、无法惩罚时价格照样升且持久，因此只查惩罚的检验会漏判，改用有利偏离检查能标记其中大部分价格。

papers.title: Structural Alignment for Reliable Industrial AI: Bridging Physical Reality, Data, Models, and Human Intent
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed in critical industrial domains, including healthcare, energy grids, subsurface exploration, where failures can have severe consequences for human safety, system stability, and economic outcomes. Yet AI is still evaluated primarily through benchmark accuracy, a model-centric metric that fails to capture the structural complexity and risks of real-world deployment. We propose a framework that views industrial AI reliability as a problem of structural alignment across four interacting worlds: physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive. These worlds are connected through two interfaces: digitalization, linking physical reality to computational representations, and goal encoding, translating human cognition to the machine objectives. Together, they define the space of admissible solutions. We characterize the solution space through four attributes: existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability and show how mismatches arise at interfaces and propagate across worlds to produce reliability failures. Applications to healthcare, energy grids, and subsurface exploration illustrate that although dominant failure modes differ across domains, for example, interpretability in healthcare, robustness in energy grids, and non-uniqueness in subsurface exploration, all originate from a shared structural mechanism. By shifting the focus from model-centric evaluation to system-level alignment, this framework offers a principled foundation for assessing and governing reliability in industrial AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把工业 AI 可靠性视为物理、表征、机器、人类认知四个世界之间的结构对齐问题，由数字化与目标编码两个接口连接，并用存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性四个属性刻画解空间。医疗、电网、地下勘探三个领域的主导失效模式不同，但都源自同一结构机制：接口处的错配跨世界传播。
Motivation: 工业 AI 部署在医疗、电网、地下勘探等失效后果严重的领域，但可靠性评估仍以 benchmark accuracy 这一模型中心指标为主，无法刻画真实部署的结构复杂性与风险。
Method: 提出四世界结构对齐框架：数字化接口连接物理现实与计算表征，目标编码接口把人类认知翻译为机器目标，两者共同界定可容许解空间；以存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性四个属性刻画解空间，并分析接口错配如何跨世界传播为可靠性失效。
Result: 在医疗、电网、地下勘探三个应用领域中，主导失效模式分别为可解释性、鲁棒性、非唯一性，但三者被归为同一共享结构机制的产物；框架本身以概念与应用示例形式呈现。
Conclusion: 工业 AI 的可靠性失效是系统级结构对齐问题而非模型精度问题，评估与治理应从模型中心转向系统级对齐。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Token Compression for Video Large Language Models: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by long videos. Recent video token compression methods increasingly introduce sophisticated strategies for token selection, pruning, and merging. This raises a fundamental question: how much of compression performance can be obtained by simply preserving the structure encoded in the visual representations? We investigate this question with SimpleCluster, a simple and training-free baseline that performs position-aware cross-frame clustering in the visual feature space and represents each cluster using the mean of its original visual features. Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SimpleCluster：一种免训练的视频视觉 token 压缩基线，在视觉特征空间做位置感知的跨帧聚类，用每簇原始特征均值代表该簇。在四个视频理解 benchmark、三个 Video LLM 上，它在很宽的 token 保留比例范围内达到与近期压缩方法相当或更优的性能，在极低保留率（如 1%）下尤其稳健；下游表现与原始特征分布的保持程度（尤其是全局覆盖）一致相关。
Motivation: 长视频推理被大量视觉 token 拖慢，而近期压缩方法不断加复杂的选点、剪枝、合并策略；作者追问仅保留视觉表征中的结构能拿到多少压缩性能。
Method: SimpleCluster 在视觉特征空间做位置感知的跨帧聚类 (position-aware cross-frame clustering)，每个簇用其原始视觉特征的均值代表；免训练，无需微调。评测覆盖四个视频理解 benchmark 和三个代表性 Video LLM，并从局部逼近保真度 (local approximation fidelity) 与全局覆盖 (global coverage) 两个角度分析不同压缩方法保留的特征空间。
Result: 在四个视频理解 benchmark、三个 Video LLM 上，SimpleCluster 在很宽的 token 保留比例范围内相对近期压缩方法达到相当或更优的性能，在极低保留率（如 1%）下稳健性尤其突出；分析显示更强的下游表现始终对应更好的原始视觉特征分布保持，尤其是全局覆盖。
Conclusion: 在高 token 预算受限的场景下，视频 token 压缩应把保持原始视觉特征分布（尤其全局覆盖）当作核心设计考量，简单的位置感知跨帧聚类加均值代表已足以构成强基线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Hidden Ratio in Adam: Stable Structure, Compression, and Sign Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Adam is the default optimizer for training modern deep neural networks, yet its adaptive behavior remains poorly understood due to the complex interaction between its first- and second-moment exponential moving averages (EMAs). We study Adam in the tied-$β$ regime, where the two EMA decay rates are equal, and show that its adaptive dynamics can be expressed through a transformed ratio with approximately scale-stable behavior. Empirically, this transformed ratio exhibits a stable, heavy-tailed distribution across tasks, model scales, and training stages, in contrast to the variability of raw moment magnitudes. This empirical stability has both practical and conceptual consequences. First, we derive a recurrence for the transformed ratio, yielding a reparameterization of Adam that replaces the second moment with a compressible state. Leveraging its stable distribution, we show that a fixed 4-bit codebook is sufficient in our experiments to store this state without auxiliary scaling, achieving performance competitive with full-precision Adam. Second, the transformed ratio view clarifies Adam's connection to sign-based methods: Adam reduces to sign-based momentum modulated by the transformed ratio, and replacing it with a constant recovers Signum as a limiting case. This perspective further provides a simple rule for transferring learning rates between the two methods. Together, these results suggest that tied-$β$ Adam admits a simple and approximately stable ratio structure underlying its adaptive behavior and demonstrate its utility for both analysis and efficient implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 tied-β（两个 EMA 衰减率相等）条件下，Adam 的自适应动力学可写成一个近似尺度稳定的变换比值，该比值在不同任务、模型规模与训练阶段上呈稳定重尾分布。由此得到的重参数化把二阶矩换成可压缩状态，实验中固定 4-bit codebook 即可存储且无需辅助缩放，性能与全精度 Adam 相当；同时该视角表明 Adam 等于被该比值调制的 sign-based momentum，比值取常数即退化为 Signum。
Motivation: Adam 的一阶与二阶矩 EMA 相互耦合，其自适应行为长期缺乏清晰解释，也难以据此做压缩或与 sign 类方法建立联系。
Method: 限定 tied-β 状态推导变换比值的递推式，给出 Adam 的重参数化，用该比值的稳定分布设计固定 4-bit codebook 存储压缩状态；再从比值视角把 Adam 改写为被比值调制的 sign-based momentum，并以取常数的极限情形联系 Signum，导出两者间迁移学习率的规则。
Result: 变换比值在跨任务、跨模型规模、跨训练阶段上呈稳定重尾分布，而原始矩幅值变化大；实验中固定 4-bit codebook 存储压缩状态、不加辅助缩放，性能与全精度 Adam 竞争；Signum 作为比值取常数的极限情形被恢复。
Conclusion: tied-β Adam 的自适应行为背后存在一个简单且近似稳定的比值结构，这一结构既可用于分析 Adam 与 sign 类方法的关系，也可用于更高效的实现。

papers.title: Inductive Feedback for Mixed-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Verbal feedback can identify errors and prescribe corrections, providing rich supervision for language-model post-training even when reliable programmatic verifiers are unavailable. Such feedback, often generated by a capable model, can be used to condition the teacher in on-policy distillation, which trains the student to match the teacher's predictions on student-generated rollouts. However, this approach can transfer teacher preferences that the feedback did not motivate, while leaving much of the feedback's guidance unused. We find that both problems come from the standard on-policy distillation objective, specifically the divergence it minimizes and the distribution it uses as its target. Our proposed method addresses both limitations. First, to isolate the information conveyed by the feedback from the teacher's inherent preferences, we treat verbal feedback as evidence for or against the hypothesis that a particular token comes next at a given prefix. We then adopt a probabilistic confirmation framework which uniquely determines an ordering over the vocabulary based on the teacher's predictions before and after it receives feedback. Using a confirmation score consistent with this ordering, we construct a target distribution within a trust region of the student. Second, to learn from guidance that student rollouts can leave unused, we derive a simple shared-rollout estimator of a symmetric divergence between the student and target distributions over rollouts, reusing student and feedback-conditioned teacher rollouts in both directions through importance weighting. Empirical evaluations show that our method outperforms the common on-policy distillation recipe and a recent contrastive variant on knowledge-based and agentic benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向混合策略蒸馏 (mixed-policy distillation) 的归纳反馈方法：把语言反馈当作 token 是否接续的证据，用概率确认框架在词表上定序并构造学生信任域内的目标分布，再用共享 rollout 的重要性加权估计对称散度。在知识类与 agentic 基准上超过常用 on-policy distillation 配方及其近期对比变体。
Motivation: 用语言反馈条件化教师做 on-policy distillation 时，会迁移反馈并未要求的教师偏好，同时反馈中的指导又大量未被利用；问题出在标准目标所最小化的散度及其目标分布。
Method: 把 verbal feedback 视为「某前缀后接某 token」假设的正反证据，采用概率确认框架，依据教师收到反馈前后的预测唯一确定词表上的排序，并用与该排序一致的确认分数在学生信任域内构造目标分布；再推导共享 rollout 的对称散度估计量，用重要性加权在双向复用学生 rollout 与反馈条件化的教师 rollout。
Result: 在知识类 (knowledge-based) 与 agentic 基准上，该方法优于常用 on-policy distillation 配方和一个近期的对比 (contrastive) 变体。
Conclusion: on-policy 蒸馏的两个缺陷源于所用散度与目标分布，改用反馈诱导的确认排序目标加共享 rollout 对称散度估计即可同时隔离反馈信息并利用未被 rollout 覆盖的指导。

papers.title: MCP Error Messages Written for Developers Hurt the Most Capable Agents Most
papers.abstract_en: Many Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers wrap web APIs built for human developers, and their error messages tell the reader to run a command, edit a configuration, open a web page or wait. Many agents that read them can only call the server's tools. In 150 widely used MCP servers, 949 of 3,001 error messages tell the caller what to do next, and half of these steps depend on something the server cannot see about the caller. On credential errors, 62 of 67 steps ask for a terminal command, a configuration change or a web page; on rate limits, 20 of 30 say to wait and retry without naming the call to repeat. We tested five OpenAI models that act only through the tools of Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard tasks, and the agents did what the step said. On expired credentials, a terminal command in the step left 45% of tasks recovered, and the loss it caused grew from 18 points for GPT-5.5 to 69 for GPT-6 Astra. On a rate limit, GitHub's "Wait before retrying." left 6%. We tested two remedies. For MCP developers, naming a server tool in the step raised recovery on expired credentials to 84%, with the login tool in place of the command, and on a rate limit to 88%, with the call to repeat in place of the bare wait. For agent developers, deleting the step with a one-sentence prompt before the model reads it raised recovery on expired credentials to 82%.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Systems and Software. Data and code: https://github.com/WenJing95/tool-error-text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MCP 服务器的报错文案按人类开发者习惯写，让 agent 去跑终端命令、改配置或开网页，而 agent 只能调用服务器工具，于是照做并失败。在 150 个常用 MCP 服务器的 3,001 条报错中 949 条给出下一步指令、半数依赖服务器看不到的调用方状态；五个 OpenAI 模型在过期凭证场景下按指令执行后恢复率仅 45%，损失从 GPT-5.5 的 18 分扩大到 GPT-6 Astra 的 69 分，越强的 agent 受害越大。把指令改成点名服务器工具可把恢复率提到 84%（凭证）与 88%（限流），agent 侧在模型读到之前删掉该指令并加一句提示可提到 82%。
Motivation: MCP 报错文案面向人类开发者撰写，但读它的 agent 只能调用服务器工具，指令与能力错配导致 agent 忠实执行不可行步骤，且能力越强损失越大。
Method: 先在 150 个广泛使用的 MCP 服务器上统计 3,001 条报错中的下一步指令及其对调用方隐藏状态的依赖；再用五个仅通过 Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard 任务工具行动的 OpenAI 模型测试 agent 对指令的执行；最后检验两类补救：开发者侧把指令改为点名服务器工具，agent 侧在模型读到之前删除指令并加一句提示。
Result: 3,001 条报错中 949 条给出下一步指令，约半数依赖服务器看不到的调用方信息；凭证类 67 条指令中 62 条要求终端命令、改配置或开网页，限流类 30 条中 20 条只说等待重试而不点名要重复的调用。过期凭证下指令含终端命令时任务恢复率 45%，造成的损失从 GPT-5.5 的 18 分升到 GPT-6 Astra 的 69 分；限流下 GitHub 的 "Wait before retrying." 只留 6%。指令点名服务器工具后凭证恢复率 84%（用 login 工具替代命令）、限流 88%（点名重复调用替代裸等待）；agent 侧删除指令加一句提示后凭证恢复率 82%。
Conclusion: 面向人类的报错文案会系统性伤害最强的 agent，因为它们最忠实执行不可行指令；把指令改写为可调用的服务器工具，或在模型读到前删掉指令，都能大幅恢复成功率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: MCP 服务器的报错文案按人类开发者习惯写，让 agent 去跑终端命令、改配置或开网页，而 agent 只能调用服务器工具，于是照做并失败。在 150 个常用 MCP 服务器的 3,001 条报错中 949 条给出下一步指令、半数依赖服务器看不到的调用方状态；五个 OpenAI 模型在过期凭证场景下按指令执行后恢复率仅 45%，损失从 GPT-5.5 的 18 分扩大到 GPT-6 Astra 的 69 分，越强的 agent 受害越大。把指令改成点名服务器工具可把恢复率提到 84%（凭证）与 88%（限流），agent 侧在模型读到之前删掉该指令并加一句提示可提到 82%。

summary_sections.method: 先在 150 个广泛使用的 MCP 服务器上统计 3,001 条报错中的下一步指令及其对调用方隐藏状态的依赖；再用五个仅通过 Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard 任务工具行动的 OpenAI 模型测试 agent 对指令的执行；最后检验两类补救：开发者侧把指令改为点名服务器工具，agent 侧在模型读到之前删除指令并加一句提示。
summary_sections.result: 3,001 条报错中 949 条给出下一步指令，约半数依赖服务器看不到的调用方信息；凭证类 67 条指令中 62 条要求终端命令、改配置或开网页，限流类 30 条中 20 条只说等待重试而不点名要重复的调用。过期凭证下指令含终端命令时任务恢复率 45%，造成的损失从 GPT-5.5 的 18 分升到 GPT-6 Astra 的 69 分；限流下 GitHub 的 "Wait before retrying." 只留 6%。指令点名服务器工具后凭证恢复率 84%（用 login 工具替代命令）、限流 88%（点名重复调用替代裸等待）；agent 侧删除指令加一句提示后凭证恢复率 82%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 面向人类的报错文案会系统性伤害最强的 agent，因为它们最忠实执行不可行指令；把指令改写为可调用的服务器工具，或在模型读到前删掉指令，都能大幅恢复成功率。

papers.title: Identifying Neural Source Dynamics from Unknown Local Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) records mixtures of brain-source activity. Even with a known anatomical forward model, experiments that excite only part of the source-state space leave the dynamics unidentified, and repetition cannot resolve the ambiguity. We show that unknown local mechanism changes can supply the missing information. We consider linear dynamics among fixed anatomical sources with known source-state initialization patterns. Changing one source's update rule for one transition leaves a rank-one, source-specific signature in subsequent EEG: subtracting matched baseline responses isolates it, and the forward model identifies the source and calibrates its response history. Combining these histories with initialization responses recovers source interactions without baseline reachability and without first identifying the intervention coefficients. We establish sufficient recovery conditions, a direct estimator, and a noise-sensitivity bound conditional on correct source labels. Simulated EEG on anatomy derived from magnetic resonance imaging confirms the information gain: with baseline excitation confined to four of twelve source coordinates, eight unknown changes recover all dynamics in 32/32 systems, whereas baseline realization, baseline regression through an invertible forward model, and changes that leave the tested states unexposed all fail, and explicitly constructed alternative dynamics reproduce every baseline mean. Where baseline information suffices, direct reconstruction is also more reliable than a matched-information spectral estimator. Nonlocal changes and forward-model error limit accuracy even when source labels are correct.
papers.comment: 11 pages main text, 52 pages total including references and appendices; 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在已知解剖前向模型下，用未知的局部机制改变（单个源的单步更新规则变化）作为额外信息源，从 EEG 中识别线性源动力学：减去匹配基线响应可分离出秩一、源特异的签名，前向模型定位该源并标定其响应历史，再与初始化响应结合恢复源间相互作用。模拟 EEG（MRI 解剖，12 个源坐标中基线仅激发 4 个）显示 8 个未知改变在 32/32 个系统上恢复全部动力学，而基线实现、经可逆前向模型的基线回归以及不暴露被测状态的改变均失败。
Motivation: 即使解剖前向模型已知，只激发部分源状态空间的实验也无法识别源动力学，重复实验不能消除该歧义。
Method: 假设源间线性动力学与已知的源状态初始化模式；对单个源的单次转移改变其更新规则，产生秩一源特异签名，用匹配基线响应相减分离，前向模型定位源并标定响应历史，结合初始化响应恢复源相互作用；给出充分恢复条件、直接估计器以及在源标签正确条件下的噪声敏感性界。
Result: 在 MRI 派生解剖的模拟 EEG 上，基线激发限于 12 个源坐标中的 4 个时，8 个未知改变在 32/32 个系统中恢复全部动力学；基线实现、经可逆前向模型的基线回归、以及使被测状态未暴露的改变均失败，且显式构造的替代动力学可复现每个基线均值。在基线信息已充分处，直接重建也比匹配信息的谱估计器 (spectral estimator) 更可靠。
Conclusion: 未知的局部机制改变可补足基线不可达带来的信息缺口，从而识别源动力学；但非局部改变与前向模型误差即使在源标签正确时仍限制精度。

papers.title: Multilinguality in Hybrid Attention LLMs
papers.abstract_en: In response to the growing demand for long sequences in agentic and reasoning use cases, many state-of-the-art LLMs combine multiple variants of attention to mitigate the quadratic complexity of traditional softmax attention. These hybrid attention LLMs aim to balance the strengths and limitations of full attention and alternatives based on recurrence. This work presents a first study of how hybrid attention impacts the multilinguality of LLMs. Beyond the impact on long sequences in poorly tokenized languages, our study is motivated by the possibility that the inductive biases of the recurrent state alter linguistic processing. Our interpretability analysis confirms this, showing that cross-lingual representations in hybrid models develop in patterns tied to the ordering of recurrent and full-attention layers. Across diverse models, we notably observe a pronounced spike in cross-lingual alignment around the first full-attention layer. These findings lead us to question the conventional ordering of attention layers. In distillation experiments on multilingual data, all alternative layer orderings outperform the standard throughout training, learning up to 2.5X faster. These stark, replicable results prompt our theory that multilingual models would benefit from starting with a full-attention layer rather than recurrent layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 混合注意力 LLM（full attention + recurrent）中，跨语言表征的形成模式取决于循环层与全注意力层的排列顺序，且在第一个 full-attention 层附近出现明显的跨语言对齐峰值。多语言蒸馏实验里，所有替代层序在整个训练过程中都优于标准序，最高快 2.5 倍学习，作者据此提出多语言模型应以 full-attention 层开头而非 recurrent 层。
Motivation: 长序列需求推动 LLM 采用混合注意力以规避 softmax 的二次复杂度，但循环状态的归纳偏置可能改变语言处理方式，而混合注意力对多语言能力的影响此前没有研究。
Method: 对多个混合注意力模型做可解释性分析，考察跨语言表征随循环层与全注意力层排列的变化；随后在多语言数据上做蒸馏实验，对比标准层序与多种替代层序的训练过程。
Result: 跨语言对齐在第一个 full-attention 层附近出现显著峰值，且该模式与层序绑定；多语言蒸馏中所有替代层序全程优于标准层序，最高学习速度达 2.5 倍。
Conclusion: 多语言混合注意力模型应以 full-attention 层起始而非 recurrent 层，层序是影响跨语言对齐的可设计变量。
