papers.title: First Learn, Then Memorize: The Spectral Bias of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models trained on a finite dataset first learn to generate novel, high-quality samples and only much later collapse onto their training set. We identify the mechanism behind this separation of timescales and the object that probes it. The training dynamics of the score function are governed---exactly, and at any width---by the Gram matrix of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluated on the noisy training data, so the timescales of generalization and of memorization must be encoded in its spectrum. We show that they are, and that the structure responsible has no analogue in standard kernel settings. The use of multiple noise realizations per sample ($m$ noised copies at a fixed noise level) in the score-matching loss is what restructures the Gram matrix spectrum into two distinct parts. The first, of large eigenvalues, carries the global features of the target distribution and is present already for $m=1$. The second, which the repeated noising creates, consists of the smallest eigenvalues and is supported on eigenvectors aligned with the sample-specific noise directions; it sets a memorization timescale parametrically larger in the training set size $n$. We establish this picture on two fronts. Analytically, we solve the spectrum in the lazy high-dimensional limit for both linear ($n \asymp d$) and polynomial ($n \asymp d^k$) sample complexities, and prove through a bias--variance decomposition that the first bulk minimizes the approximation error while the second drives the error associated with memorization. Empirically, we show the same two-bulk structure in Convolutional NTKs on CelebA and in finite-width U-Nets trained well beyond the lazy regime, and we make the link causal: truncating the Gram matrix at rank $r$ tunes the generalization--memorization transition, and an $L_2$ penalty targeting the second bulk suppresses memorization in feature-learning U-Nets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型先生成新样本、很久之后才塌缩到训练集，其分数函数训练动力学在任意宽度下由加噪训练数据上的 NTK Gram 矩阵精确刻画，泛化与记忆的时间尺度编码在其谱中。对每个样本用 m 个噪声实现的 score-matching 损失把谱劈成两块：大特征值块承载目标分布全局特征（m=1 即存在），重复加噪新造出的最小特征值块支撑在与样本噪声方向对齐的特征向量上，其记忆时间尺度随训练集大小 n 参数级增大。按秩 r 截断 Gram 矩阵可调泛化-记忆转变，针对第二块的 L2 惩罚在 feature-learning U-Net 中抑制记忆。
Motivation: 扩散模型在有限数据上先泛化后记忆这一时间尺度分离的机制不明；标准 kernel 情形没有对应结构，需要找出探测该分离的对象及其谱来源。
Method: 证明 score-matching 训练动力学由加噪数据上 NTK 的 Gram 矩阵精确决定；在 lazy 高维极限下解析求解线性（n≈d）与多项式（n≈d^k）样本复杂度两种情形的谱，并用 bias–variance 分解证明两块谱分别对应近似误差与记忆误差；经验上在 CelebA 的 Convolutional NTK 与远超 lazy 区间的有限宽度 U-Net 上检验，并通过按秩截断 Gram 矩阵与针对第二块的 L2 惩罚做因果干预。
Result: 解析上求得 lazy 高维极限下线性 (n≈d) 与多项式 (n≈d^k) 样本复杂度的谱，bias–variance 分解表明第一块最小化近似误差、第二块驱动记忆误差；经验上在 CelebA 的 Convolutional NTK 与有限宽度 U-Net 中复现两块结构，按秩 r 截断可调泛化–记忆转变，L2 惩罚在 feature-learning U-Net 中抑制记忆。
Conclusion: 扩散模型的泛化-记忆分离由重复加噪在 NTK Gram 谱中造出的第二块小特征值决定，记忆时间尺度随 n 参数级增大，且可通过谱截断或针对该块的 L2 惩罚主动调控。

papers.title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P2P-T 提出从人类演示直接学工具操作的对象中心框架：先预训练 object-centric world model 提取稳定 pose prior，再把它注入 pose-aware 低层策略，配合基础模型驱动的自动数据处理管线，完全绕开人机对齐数据。在复杂真实工具操作任务上，执行性能较此前 SOTA 提升 73%，且每任务只需极少微调。
Motivation: 真实机器人数据稀缺是操作能力扩展的主要瓶颈；依赖人机配对数据做域对齐的方法计算开销大，且现有大规模预训练模型在需要精细控制的复杂工具操作上仍然失效。
Method: 两阶段：先预训练 object-centric world model 抽取稳定 pose prior，再将该 prior 融入 pose-aware 的低层策略；用现代基础模型支撑的自动数据处理管线直接从人类演示构造训练数据，无需人机对齐数据，每任务做最小微调。
Result: 在当前标准大规模预训练模型无法胜任的复杂真实工具操作任务上，执行性能较此前 SOTA 提升 73%，并大幅降低整体训练开销。
Conclusion: 以对象中心的 pose prior 加自动数据管线，可以从纯人类演示中学到精细工具操作，绕开人机配对数据这一前提。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A decision-support system applied to Law: Reasoning and explainability of the decision
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of the digital transition brought an increasing need to control the processing of digital information, including in Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). At the EU level, in recent years, many regulations have emerged to control data processing and exchange. Texts other than the GDPR, such as the ''Law Enforcement Directive (LED)'', appeared to regulate specifically how Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) could process data. A formal representation of these regulations can be part of decision systems that support LEAs in processing data in compliance with the regulations. Although many new formalisms have emerged to represent legal norms and rules, few are provided with a reasoning mechanism. Furthermore, systems used in decision-making processes in critical contexts such as medical diagnoses or legal decisions cannot be fully automated, and the explainability of their results is essential to ensure user confidence in decisions. This explainability aspect, while crucial, is lacking in most modern approaches that rely on machine learning. This paper describes a framework to operate formal rules from regulations, by focusing on explainability of the decision. After describing the general architecture of the proposed decision support framework, the paper showcases how symbolic AI and the SPARQL query language can support legal reasoning. It then describes an algorithm to generate a justification for the reasoning results, and outlines the procedure to be followed when the reasoning does not lead to a satisfactory conclusion. We notably focus on a method based on decision trees to determine what additional information to request from the user.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向执法机构 (LEA) 数据合规决策的支持框架：用符号 AI 与 SPARQL 对法规形式化规则做法律推理，并生成推理结果的 justification；当推理无法得出满意结论时，用基于决策树的方法确定还需向用户索取哪些补充信息。
Motivation: 医疗诊断、法律判决等关键决策不能全自动化，结果可解释性是用户信任的前提，而多数依赖机器学习的现代方法缺乏可解释性；同时许多法律规范形式化体系没有配套推理机制。
Method: 提出一个操作法规形式化规则的决策支持框架：给出总体架构，用符号 AI 与 SPARQL 查询语言执行法律推理，设计算法为推理结果生成 justification，并描述推理未得出满意结论时的处理流程，其中用基于决策树的方法决定向用户追问哪些额外信息。
Result: 论文描述框架架构、SPARQL 法律推理示例、justification 生成算法与决策树补充信息询问方法；摘要中无定量实验指标。
Conclusion: 法规形式化规则配合符号推理与显式 justification，可在不全自动化关键决策的前提下支撑合规判断，并在推理不充分时主动向用户补问信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ego-Forge 是无 caption、无几何注意力偏置的 exo-to-egocentric 视频生成框架：用 Dynamic Captioning 从模型隐状态直接生成条件 token 并随扩散步数与网络深度自适应，替代外部文本条件，仅保留轻量深度先验。训练规模扩大一个数量级并用尽全部 exocentric 视角后，在 Ego-Exo4D 上达到 SOTA、端到端更快、推理无需外部标注，并可泛化到野外场景。
Motivation: exo-to-egocentric 生成需跨大视角转移外观并幻觉从未被第三人称相机看到的内容；现有方法要么要求真值初始 ego 帧或多同步视角，要么局限于类别特定场景，EgoX 还需人工 caption 且几何引导注意力偏置会传播重建误差、压制文本与视觉上下文。
Method: 提出 Ego-Forge：Dynamic Captioning 从模型隐状态派生条件 token，按扩散 timestep 与网络深度自适应，取代外部文本条件；训练规模扩大一个数量级并使用全部可用 exocentric 视角，隐式学习跨视角对应，去掉几何引导注意力，仅保留轻量深度先验 (lightweight depth prior)。
Result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，端到端运行更快，推理不需任何外部标注；可泛化到野外场景，包括过度依赖几何会阻断外观推断的情形。
Conclusion: 去掉外部 caption 与几何注意力偏置、改用隐状态派生条件并扩大训练规模，足以学到跨视角对应，同时保住 SOTA、速度与野外泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Planarian: Managing Agent State with Statepoints
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents solve complex tasks by iteratively changing files, invoking local tools, and interacting with remote services, which modifies state across their local environment and remote services. Today, agents and users must manage these changes explicitly, whether reverting exploratory actions or recovering from erroneous ones. Doing so safely requires coordinated actions, yet current agent harnesses lack unified abstractions and mechanisms for managing local and remote state consistently and efficiently. We describe Planarian, an agent runtime with state management that enables agents and users to recover from erroneous actions and explore alternative executions over consistent local and remote environment state. Planarian introduces the abstraction of agent statepoints, which are consistent, restorable point-in-time versions of the environment state. Planarian exposes three state-management primitives to agents and users: (i) snapshot creates a new statepoint spanning local and remote state without requiring external services to support checkpoints: it relies on efficient incremental process and file system snapshotting to capture local sandboxed state, and transparently records compensating actions to undo remote state changes; (ii) rollback restores the environment to a previous statepoint by reverting to a prior local checkpoint and replaying compensating actions for remote state changes; and (iii) fork creates multiple isolated branches from a statepoint, enabling the agent to explore alternatives in parallel. We show that Planarian enables agents to undo mistakes and explore alternatives in parallel, improving task quality by up to 15x, and allows users to recover from erroneous actions with only 3% overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Planarian 是带状态管理的 LLM agent 运行时，提出 statepoint 抽象：用增量进程与文件系统快照捕获本地沙箱状态、透明记录补偿动作 (compensating actions) 来撤销远程状态，从而提供 snapshot、rollback、fork 三个原语。它让 agent 撤销错误并并行探索备选执行，任务质量最高提升 15 倍，用户从错误动作恢复的开销仅 3%。
Motivation: LLM agent 反复改文件、调本地工具、访问远程服务，状态分散在本地与远端；回滚探索动作或从错误中恢复需要跨两侧协调，而现有 agent harness 缺少统一的本地/远程状态管理抽象与机制。
Method: 引入 agent statepoint（环境状态的一致、可恢复的时点版本）与三个原语：snapshot 用高效增量进程与文件系统快照捕获本地沙箱状态、并透明记录补偿动作以撤销远程状态改动，不要求外部服务支持 checkpoint；rollback 回退到先前本地 checkpoint 并重放远程补偿动作；fork 从一个 statepoint 分出多个隔离分支并行探索。
Result: 在任务执行上，Planarian 使 agent 能撤销错误并并行探索备选方案，任务质量最高提升 15 倍；用户从错误动作恢复的开销为 3%。
Conclusion: 把本地与远程状态统一进可快照、可回滚、可分叉的 statepoint，agent 才能在一致的环境状态上安全纠错与并行试错，且恢复代价可控制在个位数百分比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Temporal Link Predictors Need Learned Memory? A Smoothed-Count Baseline with a Handful of Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Many temporal link predictors summarize past interactions through learned node representations. We examine whether simple counts of recurring interaction patterns can provide competitive predictions without learning these representations. We propose a temporal link predictor based on statistical language modelling. It pools transition and co-occurrence counts across sources to predict links that a source has never formed. We smooth sparse estimates using destination frequencies or Kneser-Ney continuation counts. A shared log-linear rule combines these estimates with popularity, source history, and recency, without node embeddings. In our main evaluation, the model achieves the highest MRR among the compared methods on 7 out of 16 datasets from TGB and TGB-Seq. It also outperforms EdgeBank and Base3 on all 16 datasets and the heuristic family on 14. These gains extend to datasets designed to limit repeated edges. With only 9--13 learned parameters, our model provides a simple and competitive baseline for evaluating future neural temporal link predictors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时序链路预测 (temporal link prediction) 不必依赖可学习节点表示：用统计语言建模对转移与共现计数做跨源池化，配合目的地频率或 Kneser-Ney continuation 平滑，再由一条共享 log-linear 规则融合流行度、源历史与新近度，仅 9–13 个可学习参数即可竞争。在 TGB 与 TGB-Seq 的 16 个数据集上，该模型在 7 个上取得对比方法中最高 MRR，并在全部 16 个上超过 EdgeBank 与 Base3、在 14 个上超过启发式方法族。
Motivation: 时序链路预测普遍靠学习节点表示来概括历史交互，但这类模型复杂且难以归因；作者要检验仅靠重复交互模式的简单计数能否给出有竞争力的预测，从而为后续神经时序链路预测器提供一个可对照的基线。
Method: 提出基于统计语言建模的时序链路预测器：跨源池化转移与共现计数以预测源从未形成过的链路；稀疏估计用目的地频率或 Kneser-Ney continuation counts 平滑；再用一条共享 log-linear 规则把平滑估计与流行度 (popularity)、源历史 (source history)、新近度 (recency) 组合，全程不使用节点嵌入 (node embeddings)。
Result: 在 TGB 与 TGB-Seq 共 16 个数据集的主评估中，该模型在 7 个数据集上取得对比方法中最高 MRR；在全部 16 个数据集上超过 EdgeBank 与 Base3，在 14 个上超过启发式方法族；在专门设计以限制重复边的数据集上这些优势依然成立。模型仅有 9–13 个可学习参数。
Conclusion: 带平滑的计数模型加一条共享 log-linear 规则，用 9–13 个参数就能成为评估未来神经时序链路预测器的简单且有竞争力的基线，说明学习节点表示并非时序链路预测取得竞争力的必要条件。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: d-OPD: Future-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) typically generate text autoregressively (AR), predicting one token at a time. Block diffusion language models (dLLMs) instead generate blocks sequentially while denoising multiple tokens in parallel within each block, offering a promising way to accelerate generation. Rather than training such models from scratch, recent work adapts strong pretrained AR models into block dLLMs through distillation. On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely used for LLM training because it supervises the student on states generated by its current policy, rather than only on fixed offline trajectories. By training on the states the student actually visits, it reduces the mismatch between training and generation and can provide more relevant supervision as the student evolves. Recent work has extended this idea to AR-to-block-diffusion conversion. However, this setting introduces a fundamental mismatch in supervision: the block-diffusion student and the causal AR teacher condition on different information at the same training state. The student predicts from the entire partially denoised block, including visible future context, whereas the standard AR teacher target is defined only from the causal prefix. As a result, the teacher distribution used for distillation is not fully aligned with the information available to the student. We therefore introduce d-OPD, a future-aware on-policy distillation method that corrects the AR teacher distribution to better align with the student-visible state by incorporating visible future information within each block, providing supervision that better matches the information used by the student. Across Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B, d-OPD improves the six-benchmark average by up to $4.0$ points over OPDLM and reduces training time by $1.35$-$1.58\times$. The code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/d-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: d-OPD 指出 AR 教师到 block diffusion 学生的 on-policy 蒸馏存在监督错配：学生从含可见未来上下文的整块去噪状态预测，而标准 AR 教师目标只由因果前缀定义。方法把教师分布按块内可见未来信息做校正，使监督对齐学生可见状态；在 Qwen3 0.6B–8B 上六基准平均分比 OPDLM 最多高 4.0 点，训练时间缩短 1.35–1.58 倍。
Motivation: 把预训练 AR 模型蒸馏成 block dLLM 时，教师与学生在同一训练状态上条件信息不同，教师分布与学生可见状态不对齐，监督信号因此失真。
Method: d-OPD 是 future-aware on-policy 蒸馏：在学生当前策略生成的状态上，把 AR 教师的目标分布按块内可见未来上下文校正，使其与学生可见状态对齐，再用于监督 block diffusion 学生。
Result: 在 Qwen3 系列 0.6B 到 8B 模型上，d-OPD 相比 OPDLM 将六基准平均分最多提升 4.0 点，同时训练时间减少 1.35–1.58 倍。
Conclusion: AR 教师目标必须按学生可见的块内未来信息校正，才能让 on-policy 蒸馏在 AR 到 block diffusion 转换中给出对齐的监督，且同时缩短训练时间。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: AR 教师目标必须按学生可见的块内未来信息校正，才能让 on-policy 蒸馏在 AR 到 block diffusion 转换中给出对齐的监督，且同时缩短训练时间。

papers.title: Do Coding Agents Reuse Existing Code or Reinvent the Wheel?
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: \emph{do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel?} The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised. Thus, we present \textbf{RepoReuse}, a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns. It is built by a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories. Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy. An audit over 3{,}000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, reuse their own history less even when it is fully in the workspace, and leave duplicated logic in 50.8\% of task chains by turn~5---all while pass rates barely move. Such deficiencies are invisible to pass rates, underscoring the need to evaluate code generation beyond functional correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepoReuse 是一个多轮代码复用审计基准：需求逐轮揭示、工作区跨轮累积，用 AST 依赖图、引导式证据收集与执行验证的任务合成自动构建。对 3,000 轮的审计显示，编码智能体逐渐停止检索仓库既有代码、即使历史完全在工作区也更少复用自己的历史，到第 5 轮已有 50.8% 的任务链留下重复逻辑，而 pass rate 几乎不变。
Motivation: 现有评估几乎只看功能正确性，无法回答智能体是在复用仓库既有代码还是重复造轮子；重复实现意味着同一处修复要做两遍，而智能体产码速度远超人工审计，冗余会在无人监督下累积。
Method: 提出多轮基准 RepoReuse：需求逐轮揭示、工作区跨轮累积；构建流程为全自动管线，结合 AST 依赖图 (AST-based dependency graphs)、引导式证据收集 (guided evidence collection) 与执行验证的任务合成 (execution-verified task synthesis)，可扩展到新仓库。除 pass rate 外还度量复用率 (reuse rate)、召回率 (recall) 与跨轮结构冗余 (cross-turn structural redundancy)。
Result: 对 3,000 轮的审计显示：智能体逐步停止探索仓库中的相关代码，即使自己的历史完全在工作区也更少复用；到第 5 轮时 50.8% 的任务链留下重复逻辑，而 pass rate 几乎不动。
Conclusion: 仅凭 pass rate 会掩盖复用退化与结构冗余，代码生成评估必须超出功能正确性，加入复用率与跨轮冗余这类审计指标。

papers.title: Don't Inoculate Everything: Stratified Inoculation Prompting Narrows Backdoor Triggers and Preserves Desired Traits
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning can teach language models undesired behaviours alongside desired ones. Inoculation prompting (IP) aims to limit unwanted generalisation by requesting the undesired behaviour during training and removing the request at inference. However, undesired behaviour can still appear under unrelated prompts. IP can also hinder learning of the desired behaviour. We address these limitations in settings where both behaviours co-occur in most training examples, so filtering out examples with undesired behaviour leaves only a small clean subset. We introduce stratified inoculation prompting (SIP). SIP leverages a small clean subset to demonstrate that desired behaviour should persist without the undesired one across different contexts. SIP oversamples these clean examples under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest. SIP substantially reduces expression of undesired behaviour while preserving more of the desired behaviour than IP. These gains persist even when we extend IP to oversample the same clean subset at the same rate as SIP. Moreover, SIP yields lower emergent misalignment rates in all harmful-advice setups we tested. SIP can be further extended to limit the undesired behaviour even under prompts that explicitly request it. We introduce backdoor dilution, which weakens expression under the inoculation prompt, and password-locked inoculation, which concentrates elicitation on a designated password. Taken together, our findings show that changing the training contexts for a small clean subset can significantly improve selective generalisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对监督微调中期望行为与非期望行为在多数训练样本里共存、过滤后干净子集极小的场景，提出分层接种提示 (stratified inoculation prompting, SIP)：用小干净子集在多种非诱发提示下示范期望行为应独立保留，并对这批样本过采样、其余样本做接种。SIP 显著降低非期望行为表达且比 IP 保留更多期望行为，在所有测试的有害建议设置中 emergent misalignment 更低。
Motivation: 监督微调会连带教出非期望行为；接种提示 (IP) 虽限制其泛化，但仍会在无关提示下出现，且妨碍期望行为学习。当两种行为在多数训练样本中共存时，过滤非期望样本后只剩很小的干净子集，IP 难以处理。
Method: SIP 用小干净子集在多种非诱发提示 (non-eliciting prompts) 下示范期望行为应在没有非期望行为时保持，对这批干净样本过采样，其余样本照常接种。扩展项包括 backdoor dilution（削弱接种提示下的表达）与 password-locked inoculation（把诱发集中到指定 password）。
Result: SIP 比 IP 更大幅降低非期望行为表达并保留更多期望行为；即使把 IP 扩展为以相同速率过采样同一干净子集，优势仍在。在所有测试的有害建议 (harmful-advice) 设置中 SIP 的 emergent misalignment 率都更低。
Conclusion: 改变小干净子集的训练上下文即可显著改善选择性泛化；backdoor dilution 与 password-locked inoculation 可进一步把非期望行为限制到显式请求它的提示内。

papers.title: Isotonic surrogate modeling for computer experiments with many input variables
papers.abstract_en: Virtual simulators are widely used for studying complex physical phenomena, from particle collisions to rocket propulsion. Such "computer experiments" can be highly time-intensive, and a Bayesian surrogate model can be used for efficient emulation with reliable uncertainty quantification. To train accurate surrogates with a limited sample size $n$, recent work has explored the incorporation of monotonicity (or isotonicity) information, which can often be elicited from physical systems. In practical applications with many input variables, however, existing Bayesian isotonic models can face statistical and computational limitations, which may result in worse performance compared to models that do not incorporate isotonicity. We propose a new transformed additive isotonic model (TAIM), which aims to tame this "curse-of-dimensionality". TAIM makes use of a flexible transformed additive isotonic modeling framework, which leverages a data-estimated link transformation and a monotone basis model with spike-and-slab priors on basis weights. Prediction-wise, TAIM achieves (up to log factors) a posterior contraction rate of $O(n^{-1/3})$ when the true black-box function is in a transformed additive isotonic form with mild smoothness conditions. Such a rate does not depend on the input dimension $d$ for terms involving $n$, which softens the effect of dimensionality on posterior predictions. Computation-wise, TAIM allows for efficient posterior inference via a carefully designed Gibbs sampler, where each sampling iteration requires only linear work in $d$. We further present an extension of TAIM that can model potential deviations from transformed additivity. Numerical experiments and two applications show the effectiveness of TAIM for isotonic surrogate modeling with many input variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出变换加性等距模型 (TAIM)：用数据估计的 link 变换加单调基函数展开，基权重上放 spike-and-slab 先验，配合每次迭代对输入维度 d 只需线性计算量的 Gibbs 采样器，缓解高维输入下贝叶斯等距代理模型的维数灾难。当真实黑箱函数满足变换加性等距形式时，后验收缩率达 O(n^{-1/3})（至多差 log 因子），且 n 的幂次不依赖输入维度 d。
Motivation: 虚拟仿真器这类 computer experiment 计算昂贵，需小样本贝叶斯代理做高效仿真与不确定性量化；但输入变量很多时，已有贝叶斯等距模型在统计与计算上受限，甚至可能不如不加等距信息的模型。
Method: TAIM 采用变换加性等距建模框架：数据估计的 link 变换 + 单调基模型 (monotone basis model)，基权重上施加 spike-and-slab 先验；用专门设计的 Gibbs 采样器做后验推断，每次迭代对 d 只需线性工作量；另给出可刻画偏离变换加性情形的扩展版本。
Result: 在真实函数属变换加性等距形式且光滑性温和时，后验收缩率为 O(n^{-1/3})（至多差 log 因子），且涉及 n 的项不依赖输入维度 d；Gibbs 采样每次迭代仅需对 d 线性工作量；摘要称数值实验与两个应用展示了 TAIM 的有效性。
Conclusion: 把等距性放进变换加性结构并配 spike-and-slab 稀疏先验，可在高维输入下让后验收缩率摆脱对 d 的依赖，同时保持线性复杂度的后验推断。

papers.title: Fiona: Accelerating FHE Inference with Packing-Aware Ternary Weights
papers.abstract_en: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables neural network inference directly on encrypted inputs, but it remains orders of magnitude slower than plaintext in- ference. Applying the server's plaintext weights to encrypted activations involves plaintext-ciphertext multiplications (PMult) and accounts for more than half of inference time in recent systems. Ternary quantization can replace these multipli- cations with additions and subtractions, but the savings rarely materialize under packed execution. A single PMult applies a weight group fixed by the packing layout and can be avoided only when all its weights share the same ternary value. Ternarizing all groups, however, largely degrades accuracy. We present FIONA, an offline optimizer that selectively ternarizes weights within a given packing layout based on the estimated effect of ternary conversion on the model's performance. FIONA encourages a shared ternary value within each weight group and retains full-precision weights for sensitive groups, so ternar- ized and full-precision paths coexist within a layer. It then compiles these hybrid operators exactly, applying common scaling factors once to accumulated inputs and reusing sums across outputs. Weight ternarization can also narrow the input ranges of downstream polynomials. FIONA fits lower-degree replacements under a cumulative accuracy budget, reducing multiplicative depth and bootstrapping. On VGG11, ViT, and BERT, FIONA reduces PMult operations by 53.4-79.5% and accelerates end-to-end encrypted inference by 2.38x, 1.68x, and 1.84x, re- spectively, with less than 1% accuracy loss across all three models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIONA 是面向全同态加密 (FHE) 推理的离线优化器：在给定 packing 布局下按对模型性能的估计影响选择性地把权重量化为三值，让同一层内三值路径与全精度路径共存，并在累积精度预算下拟合低阶多项式替代以降低乘法深度。在 VGG11、ViT、BERT 上 PMult 操作减少 53.4–79.5%，端到端加密推理分别加速 2.38x、1.68x、1.84x，三个模型精度损失均低于 1%。
Motivation: FHE 上的神经网络推理比明文慢几个数量级，其中明文权重乘密文激活的 PMult 占近期系统推理时间的一半以上；三值量化本可用加减法替代这些乘法，但在 packed 执行下收益难以兑现，而全组三值化又会大幅掉精度。
Method: FIONA 作为离线优化器，在固定 packing 布局内按三值转换对模型性能的估计影响选择性三值化权重：鼓励每个权重组共享同一三值、对敏感组保留全精度，使两类路径在层内共存；随后精确编译这些混合算子，把公共缩放因子只施加一次到累加输入并在输出间复用求和；再利用权重量化收窄下游多项式输入范围，在累积精度预算下拟合低阶替代以减少乘法深度与 bootstrapping 次数。
Result: 在 VGG11、ViT、BERT 上，PMult 操作减少 53.4–79.5%，端到端加密推理分别加速 2.38x、1.68x、1.84x，三个模型的精度损失均低于 1%。
Conclusion: packing 感知的选择性三值化加混合精度编译，可以在几乎不掉精度的前提下把 FHE 推理的 PMult 开销和乘法深度同时压下来，即三值化的收益要在 packing 布局层面按组分配而不是全组统一施加。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interference Beyond Geometry in Concept Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Interference is commonly treated as geometric overlap between learned features. We introduce effective interference, which combines feature geometry and code statistics to capture realized interactions, distinguishing constructive from destructive interference and frequent weak interactions from rare strong ones. Under local fixed-support assumptions, we characterize how architectural constraints shape interference through four mechanisms: feature orthogonalization, bias compensation, gain adaptation, and encoder-decoder separation. Experiments with sparse autoencoders show that constrained architectures selectively reduce overlap among co-active features, while bias, gain, and encoder freedom allow constructive cross-contributions to remain. Together, these results show that interference in learned representations depends not only on feature geometry, but also on how features are used and on the architecture that produces their codes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 effective interference，把特征几何与码字统计结合来度量学习表征中的实际干扰，区分建设性与破坏性干扰、以及高频弱交互与低频强交互。在局部固定支撑假设下刻画出四条架构机制：特征正交化、偏置补偿、增益自适应、编码器-解码器分离；稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 实验显示受约束架构选择性降低共激活特征间的重叠，而偏置、增益与编码器自由度让建设性跨贡献得以保留。
Motivation: 干扰通常被当作学习特征间的几何重叠，但几何重叠不等于实际发生的交互，无法区分建设性与破坏性干扰，也区分不了高频弱交互与低频强交互。
Method: 定义结合特征几何与码字统计的 effective interference；在局部固定支撑 (local fixed-support) 假设下推导架构约束塑造干扰的四条机制——特征正交化、偏置补偿、增益自适应、编码器-解码器分离；用稀疏自编码器做实验检验。
Result: 稀疏自编码器实验中，受约束架构选择性降低共激活 (co-active) 特征间的重叠，而偏置、增益与编码器自由度使建设性跨贡献保留下来。
Conclusion: 学习表征中的干扰不只取决于特征几何，还取决于特征如何被使用以及产生这些码的架构；架构设计可在压低破坏性重叠的同时保留建设性交互。

papers.title: Jailbreaks for Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification in Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model's effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U's improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 times more LRM-dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对黑盒大推理模型 (LRM) 的不确定性量化 (UQ)，提出越狱式技术 J4U：用 prompt 级松弛算子近似更强 KL 正则下的最优策略，从而放宽对齐后被压缩的输出分布。在 3 个数据集、4 个 LRM（含一个闭源生产模型）上，J4U 相对重复采样的改进在最多 6 倍于最强黑盒 UQ 基线的 LRM-数据集-指标组合上具统计显著性，平均 ECE 降幅最高可达基线的 5 倍。
Motivation: RL 对齐使 LRM 系统性过度自信，而生产环境拿不到 logits，现有黑盒 UQ 方法（paraphrase 自洽、置信度 verbalization）相对简单重复采样几乎无提升，因为对齐压制了有用的输出多样性。
Method: 引入 prompt 级松弛算子 (relaxation operators)，近似用更强 KL 正则参数得到的最优策略（更接近 reference model），从而扩大模型有效输出分布；由此提出从越狱技术改造而来的 J4U，并在理论上证明松弛改善校准 (calibration)。
Result: 在 3 个数据集、4 个 LRM（含闭源生产模型）上，J4U 相对重复采样的改进在最多 6 倍于所评测的最强黑盒 UQ SOTA 基线的 LRM-数据集-指标设置中具统计显著性，平均 ECE 降幅最高可达 5 倍。
Conclusion: 对齐抑制了输出多样性，因此黑盒 UQ 需要主动放宽输出分布；J4U 可作为黑盒 LRM 部署中的实用 UQ 工具。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quasi Linear Kernel Attention with Infinite Capacity
papers.abstract_en: The evaluation cost of transformers with softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Kernel attention addresses this by replacing softmax with a more general kernel function. In this paper, we aim to identify kernels that retain the expressivity of attention while enabling quasi linear computation. To quantify expressivity, we introduce a capacity for each kernel, measuring the maximum sequence length for which the attention matrix can approximate the identity. A higher capacity thus indicates greater expressivity. We show that expressive kernels like softmax, Gauss, and Laplace have infinite capacity. In contrast, common quasi linear kernels, such as those derived from finite dimensional feature maps, exhibit finite capacity. As a solution, we propose additive kernels constructed from univariate spline and polynomial exponential kernels. We prove that these maintain infinite capacity while allowing quasi linear computation via sorting. Finally, we implement additive sorting kernels efficiently and benchmark them against modern softmax backends, demonstrating advantages for long sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出核容量 (kernel capacity) 概念衡量注意力表达力——即注意力矩阵能逼近单位阵的最大序列长度——证明 softmax、Gauss、Laplace 等表达力强的核具有无限容量，而有限维特征映射导出的准线性核只有有限容量。作者构造由一元样条与多项式指数核相加而成的 additive kernel，证明其既保持无限容量又能经排序实现准线性计算，实现为 additive sorting kernels 并与现代 softmax 后端基准对比，在长序列上展现优势。
Motivation: softmax 注意力的求值代价随序列长度平方增长；换成准线性核通常要牺牲表达力，因为有限维特征映射给出的核容量有限，逼近不了长序列上的单位阵。
Method: 定义每个核的容量为注意力矩阵可逼近 identity 的最大序列长度，据此刻画 softmax/Gauss/Laplace 的无限容量与有限维特征映射核的有限容量；构造由一元样条核与多项式指数核相加得到的 additive kernels，证明其无限容量且可通过 sorting 实现准线性计算，并高效实现为 additive sorting kernels。
Result: 证明 softmax、Gauss、Laplace 具有无限容量，有限维特征映射导出的准线性核容量有限；所提 additive kernels 被证明保持无限容量并支持 sorting 型准线性计算；实现后与现代 softmax 后端基准对比，在长序列上展现优势。
Conclusion: 容量这一判据把「准线性」与「表达力」的取舍说清：无限容量与准线性计算可以同时达到，additive sorting kernels 是达成该组合的具体构造。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
papers.abstract_en: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by matching generated and empirical samples while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI achieves lower average density and score MAE than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over its closest competitors. Program-space fine-tuning further reduces generation MMD by 84%. By turning empirical data into explicit, reusable programs, PRODiGI introduces a new direction for fast, interpretable tabular generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRODiGI 是一个预训练的 data-to-program 模型，单次前向传播即从有限样本直接推断出显式、可执行的生成程序：模板预测加非自回归参数解码，推断出的程序可独立于模型做采样、密度与 score 评估。实验中其平均密度与 score MAE 低于现有预训练模型并相对最近竞品有多倍加速，program-space fine-tuning 进一步把生成 MMD 降低 84%。
Motivation: 从有限样本估计概率密度通常要做逐数据集的模型拟合，既慢又不透明，缺少可复用、可检查的显式对象。
Method: 在合成数据集及其 ground-truth 程序对上预训练，用模板预测 (template prediction) 加非自回归程序参数解码，覆盖多种生成族与数据维度；再提出 program-space fine-tuning，只通过匹配生成样本与经验样本来微调可微的程序参数，模型参数保持不变。
Result: PRODiGI 的平均密度 MAE 与 score MAE 低于现有预训练模型，并相对最近竞品取得 multi-fold 加速；program-space fine-tuning 使生成 MMD 进一步下降 84%。
Conclusion: 把经验数据转成显式、可复用的生成程序，可为表格生成建模提供快速且可解释的新路径，且程序脱离预训练模型仍可独立使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. This routing decides which specialist teaches, but not how strongly its feedback moves the shared student. In Qwen3.5 models at three sizes, we find that MOPD's student does not beat one taught by the best single specialist and gains little of the mathematics specialist's advantage. The feedback is unbalanced: instruction-following feedback is several times more spread out than mathematics feedback and dominates the student's updates. We propose Domain-Normalized MOPD (DN-MOPD), which keeps the routing and rescales each domain's feedback by its measured spread. On six public benchmarks, DN-MOPD improves the average score over MOPD at every size, across three random seeds and under two answer-length limits, and recovers most of the lost mathematics gain. Controls with fixed domain weights show that the gain comes mainly from turning down instruction-following feedback rather than turning up mathematics alone, and that fixed weights close to those DN-MOPD measures perform comparably. Combining specialists therefore requires deciding not only which one teaches, but also how strongly its feedback counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多教师在线蒸馏 (MOPD) 只决定哪位专家授课，不决定其反馈权重多大，导致指令遵循反馈的离散度是数学反馈的数倍并主导学生更新，学生成绩不敌最佳单一专家。按各域反馈实测离散度做重标定的 DN-MOPD，在 Qwen3.5 三种规模、三个随机种子、两种答案长度限制下，六个公开基准的平均分均高于 MOPD，并收回大部分丢失的数学增益。
Motivation: RL 把一个语言模型拆成数学、代码、指令遵循等专长模型，但用户需要单一全能模型；MOPD 的按域路由无法控制各域反馈对共享学生的更新强度，反馈失衡使合并没有收益。
Method: 保留 MOPD 的按 prompt 域路由，测量每个域反馈的离散度 (spread)，按离散度对各域反馈重标定，得到 Domain-Normalized MOPD (DN-MOPD)；在 Qwen3.5 三种模型规模上训练，配固定域权重的对照实验以定位增益来源。
Result: MOPD 学生在 Qwen3.5 三种规模上不优于最佳单一专家教学的学生，且几乎得不到数学专家的增益；指令遵循反馈的离散度是数学反馈的数倍并主导更新。DN-MOPD 在六个公开基准上的平均分在每个规模、三个随机种子、两种答案长度限制下均超过 MOPD，收回大部分丢失的数学增益；固定域权重对照显示增益主要来自调低指令遵循反馈，且接近 DN-MOPD 所测权重的固定权重表现相当。
Conclusion: 合并多位专家不仅要决定谁来教，还要决定其反馈计多大权重；按反馈离散度归一化即可恢复被失衡更新吞掉的专家增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
papers.abstract_en:
The appearance of Jev marked the era of System One Models, foundation models that return structured decisions with probability distributions rather than text. Aside from low cost and great speed, Jev's central promise is that these probabilities are calibrated: such claim is not backed by any public test and available external benchmarks evaluate confidence calibration, not whether every returned option probability has the right numerical meaning. To tackle this issue, we introduce Sys1Cal-v1, a dataset of True/False questions about a proposition $A$ for which the exact probability $P(A)$ is known by construction. Each item is queried through the three Jev primitives - Noul, Choice and Score - and evaluated by total variation distance from the ground-truth distribution, which can be used to estimate a soft accuracy of System One Models. We showcase the utility of Sys1Cal-v1 as a benchmark dataset by evaluating Jev and SemIf, an open-source Choice-style baseline. In this work, however, we focus even more deeply on Jev, by studying the calibration of its Score and Choice answers. In particular, we discover a peculiar behaviour that can be explained by assuming that Jev suppresses a third truth value, going beyond True and False. In other words, in 	exttt{Choice} answers, $P(A)$ and $P(
eg A)$ are presented as if $P(A)+P(
eg A)=1$, while a term $P(U)
eq0$ is missing in the sum. Recovering $P(U)$ leads to an improvement of median soft accuracy in 	exttt{Choice} answers from $0.771$ to $0.978$, suggesting that, even in binary decisions, Jev wants to answer with a third option:``I don't know''.

papers.title: Generative Uncertainty as a Self-supervised Signal for Semantic Similarity Learning
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 T2V diffusion 模型的生成不确定性作自监督信号学视频语义相似度：对通用概念多次生成保持一致的特征保留，对生成噪声/不确定的特征丢弃，在 VideoMAE 与 V-JEPA 嵌入上学出一个 mask。在三类任务上，学到的特征子空间一致优于原始预训练特征与基线特征选择方法。
Motivation: 视频语义相似度的定义与人工标注既困难又昂贵，因为视频的时空结构复杂；而 OOD 检测、视频检索等任务都需要可靠的相似度表示。
Method: 利用 T2V diffusion 模型对熟悉概念输出一致、对专业概念方差与不确定性高的行为，用纯生成数据在预训练表征（VideoMAE、V-JEPA）上学习一个 mask，保留跨代一致的通用概念特征、丢弃与生成噪声或不确定性相关的特征，无需人工标注。
Result: 在三个关键任务（含 OOD 检测与视频检索）上，所学特征子空间一致优于原始预训练特征和基线特征选择方法。
Conclusion: 生成不确定性可以替代人工标注作为语义相似度的学习信号，通过筛选预训练视频表征中的稳定特征子空间来提升下游任务。

papers.title: NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuronDiscover 把「真实机制变化」与「计算孪生误差」在稀疏观测下同签名的问题形式化为 twin confounding，用共享的 World Action Model (WAM) 联合生成预测、干预与观测设计，经独立裁决的结果修订 MIOY 图并编译成带 discrepancy 校正接受界的可执行程序。在 16 次实验、32 个源单元的匹配预算下，每世界解析 4.0 条关系（最强基线 3.4、去掉图修订 3.2），5% false support、82% scope accuracy。
Motivation: 神经元微环境里溶质输运与神经元响应存在互相竞争的机制解释，而预测精度无法裁决：真实机制改变与孪生模型误差在稀疏观测中留下相同签名，需要能主动区分二者的实验设计。
Method: Agent-in-Twin 框架：机制奠基的 World Action Model (WAM) 统一耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计；独立裁决的结果修订带作用域的 Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) 图，图中被支持的关系编译为携带 discrepancy 校正接受界的可执行程序；采用联合 mechanism--discrepancy acquisition。
Result: 在模拟脑液示踪剂输运世界（由独立冻结的更细网格参考求解器裁决）与 donor-disjoint 的皮层神经元 current-clamp 公开记录上，匹配预算 16 次实验/32 源单元时每世界解析 4.0 条关系，对最强基线 3.4、无图修订 3.2，false support 5%、scope accuracy 82%；联合 mechanism--discrepancy acquisition 解析 3.8 条对 plug-in expected information gain 的 2.9；discrepancy 校正验证把已接受程序失败率从 15% 降到 9%（60% 接受覆盖）；迁移到记录上为 1.94 对 1.53 条/世界。
Conclusion: 把机制与孪生误差放进同一信念并让实验设计同时针对二者，能在固定预算下解析更多机制关系并降低错误接受；正确性只在声明的模型世界与存档记录内裁决。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TMCS 把组合化学问题求解形式化为可解释的工具增强多智能体工作流：任务层用专用 agent 调用外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆与结构化反思迭代修正方案，工作流层把生成、理解、编辑、描述、优化串成闭环。在多类化学任务上，TMCS 对开源与闭源基座模型均一致提升化学推理并达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有工具增强化学 agent 能做规划与调工具，但缺少把性质驱动的分子优化与工作流级组合统一起来的闭环，难以处理带定量约束的分子修饰、候选验证与失败后的系统性修订。
Method: 任务层：专用 agent 结合外部工具、few-shot 轨迹记忆 (trajectory memory) 与结构化反思 (structured reflection) 迭代精化解答；工作流层：将 generation、understanding、editing、description、optimization 串成闭环 pipeline，形成可解释的工具增强工作流。
Result: 在多类化学任务上的评测显示，TMCS 在开源与闭源基座模型上均一致增强化学推理，并取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 把化学求解拆成任务级反思循环与工作流级闭环组合，可在不同基座模型上通用地提升组合化学问题的推理表现。

papers.title: Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular datasets in comparison with established AutoML heuristics, (ii) cross-domain evaluation across tabular and time series datasets, and (iii) a practical deployment scenario using smaller local models. The results show consistent advantages for LLM-based task type identification, with increasing difficulty in heterogeneous and resource-constrained settings. LLM-based approaches outperform AutoGluon in the tabular setting, reaching 0.98 F1 macro compared to 0.93. In the cross-domain setting, the best model achieves 0.90 F1 macro, while smaller locally deployable models reach 0.75, indicating a trade-off between deployment feasibility and accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Automated Machine Learning (AutoML 26), September 2026, Ljubljana, Slovenia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 仅凭数据集级信息与目标特征自动判定 ML 任务类型（数据域 + 预测任务），并发布 625 个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准。表格场景下 LLM 超过 AutoGluon，F1 macro 0.98 对 0.93；跨域最好 0.90，本地小模型 0.75，显示部署可行性与精度的取舍。
Motivation: ML 任务类型通常靠人工指定，阻碍自动化流水线构建；需要在只给目标特征的条件下自动推断数据域与下游预测任务。
Method: 提出 LLM-based 系统，从数据集级信息推断数据域与任务类型；发布含 625 个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准，并在三种设定下评测：与既有 AutoML heuristics 对比的表格场景、表格与时间序列的跨域评测、以及使用更小本地模型的实际部署场景。
Result: 表格场景 LLM 达 0.98 F1 macro，AutoGluon 为 0.93；跨域设定最好模型 0.90 F1 macro，更小的本地可部署模型 0.75；基准含 625 个数据集，困难度在异构与资源受限设定下上升。
Conclusion: LLM 做任务类型识别在表格与跨域设定下一致优于 AutoML 启发式，但在异构与资源受限场景更难，本地小模型换来部署可行性但牺牲精度。

papers.title: Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Algorithm Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Algorithm Distillation (AD) has demonstrated the remarkable ability of Transformers to perform in-context reinforcement learning without explicit weight updates. However, capturing long-term learning progress necessitates expansive context windows, which incur prohibitive memory costs and limit scalability in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address this bottleneck, we propose Recurrent Algorithm Distillation (RAD). RAD employs a dual-component architecture: a Compression Transformer that distills extended interaction histories into compact latent tokens, and an AD Transformer that auto-regressively generates actions using a hybrid context of these compressed memories and recent transitions. By maintaining a fixed-size latent buffer, RAD decouples the effective history length from computational complexity, functionally providing the model with a long-horizon memory. Empirical evaluations across diverse environments demonstrate that RAD matches the asymptotic performance of standard AD with significantly reduced context window sizes, offering a scalable solution for efficient in-context decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Recurrent Algorithm Distillation (RAD)，用 Compression Transformer 把长交互历史蒸馏成固定大小的 latent token，再由 AD Transformer 混合压缩记忆与近期 transition 自回归生成动作，从而把有效历史长度与计算复杂度解耦。在多种环境上 RAD 以显著更小的 context window 追平标准 AD 的渐近性能。
Motivation: Algorithm Distillation 依赖超长 context window 来捕捉长期学习进展，显存开销在复杂长时程任务中不可承受，限制了 in-context RL 的可扩展性。
Method: 双组件架构：Compression Transformer 将扩展交互历史蒸馏为紧凑 latent tokens，AD Transformer 用这些压缩记忆加近期 transitions 的混合上下文自回归生成动作；固定大小的 latent buffer 使历史长度与计算量解耦。
Result: 在多种环境上的实证评估中，RAD 以显著更小的 context window 匹配标准 AD 的渐近性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 固定容量的压缩记忆足以替代超长上下文，为高效 in-context 决策提供可扩展方案。

papers.title: Reverse Sequential Proportional Approval Voting Rule: Proportionality and Approximation Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: We study the Reverse Sequential Proportional Approval Voting Rule (RevSeqPAV) in approval-based committee elections. Despite its historical prominence and practical use, its properties and guarantees are much less understood than those of Sequential PAV. We analyze it along two dimensions: proportional representation (measured by Extended Justified Representation, its approximations, and proportionality degree) and approximation of the maximum PAV score of instances. We first establish strong negative results for general, unrestricted election instances and then identify settings in which the rule provides meaningful fairness and optimization guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究审批制委员会选举中的逆序序贯 PAV 规则 (RevSeqPAV)，沿比例代表性与 PAV 分数近似两条线分析：先对一般无限制实例给出强负面结果，再刻画其能给出有意义公平性与优化保证的具体设定。
Motivation: RevSeqPAV 历史上地位突出且有实际使用，但其性质与保证远不如 Sequential PAV 被理解，比例性与近似比都缺少系统刻画。
Method: 以 Extended Justified Representation 及其近似、proportionality degree 度量比例代表性，同时考察对实例最大 PAV 分数的近似；先在一般无限制选举实例上建立负面结果，再识别可获保证的设定。
Result: 在一般无限制选举实例上得到强负面结果，并识别出 RevSeqPAV 提供有意义比例性与优化保证的设定；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: RevSeqPAV 的保证是条件性的：一般实例上比例性与近似比不成立，只有在特定设定下才具备可用的公平与优化保证。

papers.title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero
papers.abstract_en: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MetaBBO 的算法设计循环当成编码任务，用双 agent（task agent 演化 MetaBBO 代码库、hyper agent 递归改写两个 agent 自身）实现开放式自我改进，从朴素模板自动长出超越最新人工 MetaBBO 基线的变体，并能快速适配不同优化领域。
Motivation: MetaBBO 的双层设计流程目前靠人工逐案定制，带有主观性，限制了性能上界与实际可用性。
Method: 提出双 agent 框架：task agent 通过代码演化持续改进目标 MetaBBO 方法的代码库，hyper agent 逐步修改 task agent 与自身以产生开放式设计行为；演化后的代码库被评测，执行中的全部信息反馈给两个 agent 做递归自指改进。
Result: 从朴素 MetaBBO 模板出发自动完成设计演化，找到的变体优于最新人工 MetaBBO 基线；实验显示框架可跨不同优化领域快速适配，并有解释性分析揭示开放式过程中涌现的设计原则。
Conclusion: 复杂的学习辅助优化算法的设计本身可以被自动化，且由 agent 驱动的开放式演化能超过人工定制的 MetaBBO 上界。

papers.title: Weighting Schedules Govern What and When Score-Based Generative Models Learn from Multimodal Data
papers.abstract_en: Score-based generative models generate new samples by integrating a time-dependent drift that carries Gaussian noise onto the target distribution. In practice this drift is modeled by a neural network, trained on a loss integrated over time $t$ with a weighting schedule $w(t)$. Along the backward dynamics, and for multi-modal distributions, trajectories commit to modes of the target within a narrow time window, the \textit{speciation time}. In this work, focusing on high-dimensional data, we decompose the integrated loss into its single-time contributions and analyze each at fixed signal-to-noise ratio $Λ(t)$: we show that $Λ(t)$ sets the rate at which each feature of a multimodal target - the mode directions and their relative weights - is acquired during training. Crucially, at high $Λ(t)$ all mode directions are acquired together, on a single timescale insensitive to their amplitudes, while the relative weights are not learned at all. Only near the speciation time, where $Λ(t)$ becomes of order one, do all features become learnable, each on its own timescale: the weights are acquired jointly with the directions, and the directions at rates set by their relative amplitudes. For models trained on time-integrated objectives, the learning dynamics is then governed by how much of the weighting effectively sits near the speciation time, which provides insights on $w(t)$ design choices. These results follow from an exact high-dimensional analysis of the training dynamics of unbalanced and hierarchical Gaussian mixtures. Numerical experiments on image and human genome haplotype generation recover the predicted hierarchy of learning timescales in more complex settings.
papers.comment: Main text : 9 pages / 5 figures Supplemental : 21 pages / 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高维 score-based 生成模型中，训练损失的时间权重调度 w(t) 决定多模态目标的哪些特征在何时被学到：高信噪比 Λ(t) 阶段所有模态方向以同一时间尺度被获取、相对权重完全学不到，只有在 speciation time 附近 Λ(t) 降到 O(1) 时权重才与方向一起可学。结论是 w(t) 的设计应把有效权重压在 speciation time 附近。
Motivation: 多模态分布上，反向轨迹在很窄的时间窗（speciation time）内才锁定到某个模态，但积分损失把所有时刻混在一起，无法解释各特征（模态方向 vs 相对权重）的学习先后与快慢。
Method: 把时间积分损失分解为单时刻贡献，在固定信噪比 Λ(t) 下逐点分析；对不平衡与分层高斯混合 (unbalanced and hierarchical Gaussian mixtures) 给出训练动力学的精确高维解析，并在图像与人类基因组单倍型 (haplotype) 生成上做数值实验验证。
Result: 高 Λ(t) 时全部模态方向以对幅度不敏感的单一时间尺度被获取，相对权重完全不被学习；Λ(t) 在 speciation time 附近降到 O(1) 时所有特征变得可学，权重与方向联合获取、方向的学习速率由相对幅度决定；图像与人类基因组单倍型生成的数值实验复现了预测的学习时间尺度层级。
Conclusion: 时间积分目标下学习动力学由 w(t) 落在 speciation time 附近的权重份额决定，因此 w(t) 的设计选择应围绕该时间窗安排。

papers.title: Teacher-Student Gaps Are Not Enough: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense teacher supervision. Recent work on OPD for multi-turn autonomous agents often treats large teacher-student token-level distributional gaps as promising intervention points, linking larger gaps to a greater need for correction. Yet, our empirical analysis reveals a supervision-benefit mismatch: large gaps can be benign, while small gaps can be outcome-critical. Teacher-student gaps capture differences at the current turn, whereas the benefit of teacher guidance depends on how the current student interacts with the environment afterward. The student may still succeed despite choosing an action that differs from the teacher's, while a teacher-preferred action may lead to a state from which the student cannot complete the task. Local gaps alone are therefore not enough to determine whether teacher guidance benefits the current student. Effective supervision should instead emphasize guidance that the current student can translate into better final task outcomes. Accordingly, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD), which applies trajectory-relative weighting to teacher supervision and calibrates these weights using final task outcomes from paired student continuations. This calibration selectively strengthens supervision on the student's original trajectories at turns where teacher guidance benefits the current student. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, OG-OPD consistently outperforms baselines under diverse settings. It improves task success rates by 3.6-17.7 percentage points over vanilla OPD and by up to 7.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮自主智能体的 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 里，token 级师生分布差距大不等于该干预：大差距可能无害，小差距可能决定成败，因为教师指导的价值取决于学生拿到该动作后与环境的后续交互。提出 OG-OPD，用配对的学生续跑最终结果校准轨迹相对权重，只在教师指导确实能改善最终结果的轮次上加强监督。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上任务成功率比 vanilla OPD 提升 3.6–17.7 个百分点，比最强基线最多高 7.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 把大的师生 token 级分布差距当作优先干预点，但经验分析显示监督收益与差距错配：大差距可能良性，小差距可能对最终结果关键，局部差距本身无法判断教师指导是否对当前学生有益。
Method: 提出 Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD)：对教师监督施加轨迹相对权重 (trajectory-relative weighting)，并用配对的学生续跑 (paired student continuations) 的最终任务结果来校准这些权重，从而在学生原始轨迹上选择性加强那些教师指导确实带来更好最终结果的轮次的监督。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 三个多轮智能体环境、多种设置下，OG-OPD 一致优于基线：任务成功率比 vanilla OPD 提升 3.6–17.7 个百分点，比最强基线最多提升 7.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 决定是否该给教师监督加权的应是该指导能否转化为更好的最终任务结果，而不是当前轮次的师生分布差距大小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions
papers.abstract_en: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with stated evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, that function includes more than a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for generative systems, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy measures capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. A four-level diagnostic framework classifies failures as component, operational-loop, agentic-conduct, or network and governance failures. Test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV), sequential monitoring, and FRACAS create and refresh evidence. SMART provides statistical guidance for measurement, analysis, assessment, and test planning; the NIST AI Risk Management Framework provides organizational guidance for governance, evaluation, monitoring, and mitigation. Three cases illustrate the program: adversarial testing of a convolutional neural network, perception-error propagation, and autonomous-vehicle disengagements. Established reliability engineering provides a usable foundation; new measurements and safety guardrails are still needed as these systems are self-evolving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把传统可靠性工程整套方法迁移到 AI 系统：以失效定义与运行包线为起点，用 FMEA、加速试验、现场监测和可靠性增长建立证据链，并提出四层失效诊断框架（component、operational-loop、agentic-conduct、network 与 governance）。结论是成熟可靠性工程可直接作为可用基础，但系统自演化仍需新的度量与安全护栏。
Motivation: 平均基准准确率只度量能力，无法支撑“在给定期限与运行条件下有证据地可靠履行功能”这一主张；随着系统自主性上升，检索、记忆、工具使用、权限、人机监督乃至生成式系统的推理过程都必须一致且安全。
Method: 将失效定义、运行包线、FMEA、加速试验 (accelerated testing)、现场监测与可靠性增长 (reliability growth) 适配到 AI 系统；提出四层失效诊断框架；用 TEVV、序贯监测 (sequential monitoring) 与 FRACAS 生成并刷新证据，SMART 提供测量与试验规划的统计指导，NIST AI Risk Management Framework 提供治理侧组织指导。
Result: 以三个案例说明该体系：对卷积神经网络 (CNN) 的对抗测试、感知误差传播、自动驾驶脱离 (disengagement)。摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 已有的可靠性工程为 AI 系统提供了可用基础，但面对自演化系统仍需开发新的度量方法与安全护栏。

summary_sections.motivation: 平均基准准确率只度量能力，无法支撑“在给定期限与运行条件下有证据地可靠履行功能”这一主张；随着系统自主性上升，检索、记忆、工具使用、权限、人机监督乃至生成式系统的推理过程都必须一致且安全。
summary_sections.method: 将失效定义、运行包线、FMEA、加速试验 (accelerated testing)、现场监测与可靠性增长 (reliability growth) 适配到 AI 系统；提出四层失效诊断框架；用 TEVV、序贯监测 (sequential monitoring) 与 FRACAS 生成并刷新证据，SMART 提供测量与试验规划的统计指导，NIST AI Risk Management Framework 提供治理侧组织指导。
summary_sections.result: 以三个案例说明该体系：对卷积神经网络 (CNN) 的对抗测试、感知误差传播、自动驾驶脱离 (disengagement)。摘要未给出定量指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 已有的可靠性工程为 AI 系统提供了可用基础，但面对自演化系统仍需开发新的度量方法与安全护栏。

papers.title: Collaborative Principle Evolution via Evidence Transfer for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents promise to automate scientific discovery, yet exploring the vast hypothesis space remains costly. Existing principle-evolution methods accelerate this loop, but operate sequentially, which caps exploration breadth and wastes wall-clock time on challenging problems. To address this, we formulate collaborative scientific discovery as evidence transfer between parallel principle-evolution branches. We present COEVOLVE, which realizes this transfer through a coordination core over parallel branches. By integrating value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, COEVOLVE enables branches to collaborate through shared measurements while keeping their principle posteriors separate. Across six scientific-discovery tasks under a matched evaluation budget, COEVOLVE attains a mean solution quality of 66.5% versus 57.0% for single-branch principle evolution, with a 1.80x mean wall-clock speedup on the GPT-5.6-Terra backbone; on five auto-research tasks delegated to an autonomous research harness, it is the only arm whose mean stays above the published SOTA anchor on every task. These results establish when evidence sharing accelerates parallel discovery and when transfer safeguards are necessary to limit negative or inert transfers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COEVOLVE 把 LLM 科学发现的 principle evolution 从串行改成并行分支协作，用协调核心在分支间传递证据：value-of-information 门控路由决定何时共享，context-discounted likelihood injection 注入共享测量，同时保持各分支的 principle 后验独立。在六个科学发现任务、匹配评估预算下，平均解题质量 66.5% 对单分支 57.0%，GPT-5.6-Terra 骨干上平均墙钟加速 1.80x。
Motivation: 现有 principle-evolution 方法串行运行，探索广度受限，难题上白白浪费墙钟时间；把科学发现形式化为并行分支间的证据传递可同时拓宽探索并提速。
Method: 提出 COEVOLVE：以一个 coordination core 协调并行 principle-evolution 分支，通过 value-of-information-gated routing 与 context-discounted likelihood injection 在分支间共享测量证据，同时让各分支的 principle posterior 保持分离；在六个科学发现任务上以匹配评估预算评测，并在五个 auto-research 任务上交给自主研究 harness 执行。
Result: 六个科学发现任务、匹配预算下平均解题质量 66.5%，对比单分支 principle evolution 的 57.0%；GPT-5.6-Terra 骨干上平均墙钟加速 1.80x。五个交给自主研究 harness 的 auto-research 任务中，COEVOLVE 是唯一在每个任务上平均值都高于已发表 SOTA 锚点的方法。
Conclusion: 证据共享能加速并行发现，但需要传递防护（门控路由与后验分离）来限制负向或无效传递；COEVOLVE 给出了何时共享、何时设防的判定结果。

papers.title: When Should a Satellite Estimate Be Changed? Stress-Testing Neural Corrections for Evapotranspiration
papers.abstract_en: Neural residuals can improve satellite evapotranspiration (ET) estimates, but selectors must predict when a correction helps and reject unsupported inputs. We evaluate ten-member models on 16,366 flux-tower observations from 151 stations paired with OpenET, across nine rolling years and five spatial folds. At one held-out station, Gain accepted corrections on all 32 physically invalid records: it predicted a mean benefit of 0.83 mm/day, but the corrections increased mean absolute error by 21.6 mm/day versus OpenET. On spatially held-out unit errors, SupportGain reduced station-macro MAE versus Gain by 0.148 mm/day under wind x3.6 (simultaneous 95% interval, 0.070 to 0.226), with 9.3% acceptance versus Gain's 51.8%; on clean inputs, its 0.006 mm/day advantage had an interval that includes zero. These fault analyses are exploratory; none of 40 preplanned temporal comparisons passed Holm correction, while a separate predeclared cropland contrast found 0.041 mm/day lower station-macro MAE with crop-only training (95% interval, 0.009 to 0.079).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对卫星蒸散发 (ET) 修正的神经残差何时该被采纳，作者用通量塔观测压力测试选择器：Gain 在一个留出站点上对全部 32 条物理无效记录照单全收，预测平均收益 0.83 mm/day，实际却使 MAE 相对 OpenET 恶化 21.6 mm/day。带支持度门控的 SupportGain 在风速 ×3.6 的空间留出单元误差上把站点宏 MAE 比 Gain 降低 0.148 mm/day（95% 区间 0.070–0.226），接受率仅 9.3% 对 51.8%；干净输入上 0.006 mm/day 的优势区间含零。
Motivation: 神经残差能改进卫星 ET 估计，但选择器必须判断修正何时有益并拒绝不受支持的输入；现有评估缺少对物理无效输入与分布外单元的压力测试。
Method: 在 151 个站点、16,366 条通量塔观测与 OpenET 配对的数据上评估十个成员的模型，跨九个滚动年份与五个空间折；比较 Gain 与加入支持度门控的 SupportGain，用站点宏 MAE、接受率与同时 95% 区间度量，并以 Holm 校正检验 40 项预设时间对比，另设一项预声明的作物对比。
Result: Gain 在一个留出站点对 32 条物理无效记录全部接受，预测平均收益 0.83 mm/day，实际使 MAE 相对 OpenET 增加 21.6 mm/day。风速 ×3.6 的空间留出单元误差上 SupportGain 站点宏 MAE 比 Gain 低 0.148 mm/day（同时 95% 区间 0.070–0.226），接受率 9.3% 对 Gain 的 51.8%；干净输入上优势 0.006 mm/day，区间含零。40 项预设时间对比无一通过 Holm 校正；预声明的作物对比显示仅用作物训练使站点宏 MAE 低 0.041 mm/day（95% 区间 0.009–0.079）。
Conclusion: 选择器必须先拒绝物理无效与不受支持的输入，否则会把平均收益预测成实际误差恶化；作者将这些故障分析定位为探索性结果。

papers.title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoGSW4RLD 把动作条件视频世界模型的多相机 rollout 前馈提升为统一、可按时间查询的度量 4D Gaussian 场，两阶段架构先融合跨视角证据与机器人关节几何/运动学构建初始场，再细化几何外观并严格保持初始时间位移。在 256 个 held-out DROID episodes 上，相对逐相机重建加标定合并，novel-view PSNR 提升 2.15 dB、深度 AbsRel 降低 47%、机器人位姿误差降低 61%，并可迁移到动作条件 Cosmos 3 rollout。
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型的输出只是彼此分离的多路视频集合，无法跨视角、跨时间查询共享度量场景；逐相机独立重建再合并无法强制跨视角一致性，尤其在移动机器人载相机与固定外部视角混合时失效。
Method: 两阶段前馈架构：Stage 1 融合跨视角证据与机器人特有的关节几何 (articulated geometry) 和运动学，联合构建度量 4D Gaussian 场；Stage 2 细化该场的几何与外观，同时严格保留初始时间位移。框架直接重建既有世界模型生成的视觉未来，而非学习独立的几何转移模型。
Result: 在 256 个 held-out DROID episodes 上，相对逐相机重建加标定合并基线：novel-view PSNR 提升 2.15 dB，深度 AbsRel 降低 47%，机器人位移误差降低 61%；增益同样延伸到动作条件 Cosmos 3 rollout。
Conclusion: 预测出的视频未来可以被成功转译为一致、可空间查询的 4D 度量表示，跨视角一致性须在重建阶段联合强制而非事后合并。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment. While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigate sparse rewards using hindsight information, their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step, defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget. However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments. To bridge this gap, we present Pivot-Aware Internalized Visual On-Policy Training (PIVOT), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives. At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped. Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (+8% over SFT+GRPO baseline and +5% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B (+12% over SFT+GRPO baseline).
papers.comment: 11 pages for the main paper, 20 pages for the supplementary
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIVOT 把多轮 VLM agent 训练中的 pivot 步（最后一个可挽回动作、剩余步数已耗尽）定位与状态恢复内化进 token 级参数更新，从而在 RL 训练中免去环境回滚。它用 Analyzer 从视觉轨迹拼图与动作日志定位 pivot 并诊断失败模式，detached Teacher 在该特权语境下重打分失败 token，Student 联合优化 GRPO 与置信度门控的 OPD 目标，测试时剥离 Teacher 与 Analyzer。在五个多轮 VLM agent 基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 总体准确率 0.90，比 SFT+GRPO 基线高 8%、比先前 SOTA 高 5%；Qwen3-VL-2B 达 0.92，比 SFT+GRPO 高 12%。
Motivation: RLVR 用 GRPO 训练多轮 VLM agent 时，全组失败会带来零梯度沉默，且奖励只能粗粒度地归到整个 episode；OPD/OPSD 虽用 hindsight 信息缓解稀疏奖励，但其增益机制不清，而反事实回滚探针显示增益主要来自 pivot 步的物理状态回滚，这在真实环境中代价过高且不可行。
Method: 先做受控反事实回滚探针 (counterfactual rollback probes)，跨五个多轮 VLM agent 基准把 OPSD/OPD 的增益归因到 pivot 步的物理状态回滚；再提出 PIVOT，把 pivot 定位与状态恢复内化进 token 级参数更新：Analyzer 分支非侵入式地从视觉轨迹拼图与动作日志定位 pivot 并诊断失败模式，detached Teacher 在该特权诊断语境下重打分失败 token，Student 联合优化 GRPO 与置信度门控的 OPD 目标，训练期不做环境回滚、测试期不需额外技能提示。
Result: 五个多轮 VLM agent 任务（覆盖认知网格谜题、3D 具身控制与导航、生成式推理）上，PIVOT 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上总体准确率 0.90，较 SFT+GRPO 基线 +8%、较先前 SOTA +5%；在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上达 0.92，较 SFT+GRPO 基线 +12%。反事实回滚探针显示 OPSD/OPD 的性能增益主要由 pivot 步的物理状态回滚驱动。
Conclusion: OPD/OPSD 的增益本质上来自 pivot 步的状态回滚，而把 pivot 定位与恢复内化进 token 级更新即可在不回滚环境、不加测试期提示的情况下复现该增益，并在两类 VLM 上超过 SFT+GRPO 与先前 SOTA。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: PIVOT 把多轮 VLM agent 训练中的 pivot 步（最后一个可挽回动作、剩余步数已耗尽）定位与状态恢复内化进 token 级参数更新，从而在 RL 训练中免去环境回滚。它用 Analyzer 从视觉轨迹拼图与动作日志定位 pivot 并诊断失败模式，detached Teacher 在该特权语境下重打分失败 token，Student 联合优化 GRPO 与置信度门控的 OPD 目标，测试时剥离 Teacher 与 Analyzer。在五个多轮 VLM agent 基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 总体准确率 0.90，比 SFT+GRPO 基线高 8%、比先前 SOTA 高 5%；Qwen3-VL-2B 达 0.92，比 SFT+GRPO 高 12%。

summary_sections.method: 先做受控反事实回滚探针 (counterfactual rollback probes)，跨五个多轮 VLM agent 基准把 OPSD/OPD 的增益归因到 pivot 步的物理状态回滚；再提出 PIVOT，把 pivot 定位与状态恢复内化进 token 级参数更新：Analyzer 分支非侵入式地从视觉轨迹拼图与动作日志定位 pivot 并诊断失败模式，detached Teacher 在该特权诊断语境下重打分失败 token，Student 联合优化 GRPO 与置信度门控的 OPD 目标，训练期不做环境回滚、测试期不需额外技能提示。
summary_sections.result: 五个多轮 VLM agent 任务（覆盖认知网格谜题、3D 具身控制与导航、生成式推理）上，PIVOT 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上总体准确率 0.90，较 SFT+GRPO 基线 +8%、较先前 SOTA +5%；在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上达 0.92，较 SFT+GRPO 基线 +12%。反事实回滚探针显示 OPSD/OPD 的性能增益主要由 pivot 步的物理状态回滚驱动。
summary_sections.conclusion: OPD/OPSD 的增益本质上来自 pivot 步的状态回滚，而把 pivot 定位与恢复内化进 token 级更新即可在不回滚环境、不加测试期提示的情况下复现该增益，并在两类 VLM 上超过 SFT+GRPO 与先前 SOTA。

papers.title: Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨模型族测量话题显著性 (topic saliency) 迁移的方法，追踪后训练阶段哪些话题被放大或边缘化。在气候变化话语的案例研究中显示同质化压缩了解决方案的多样性，且测试的干预表明专用模型有助于保留更广的观点谱。
Motivation: 模型层面的研究难以定位生成式同质化 (generative monoculture) 中究竟哪些具体话题或观点被边缘化或放大，缺少可跨模型族比较的显著性度量。
Method: 引入跨模型族测量话题显著性迁移的方法，追踪后训练过程中话题获得或失去显著性的变化；以气候变化话语为案例，并测试对抗同质化的干预（含专用模型）。
Result: 案例研究显示同质化影响不同模型对多样化解决方案的表征；干预测试显示专用模型有助于保留更广的观点范围。
Conclusion: 监测话题显著性可诊断同质化风险，专用模型是缓解观点收窄的一种有效干预。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training-Free Clinical Reasoning through Medical Ontologies and Cognitive Mapping: A Symbolic-Probabilistic Knowledge Graph Framework
papers.abstract_en: Most clinical prediction systems learn patient-variable-outcome associations; we investigate a training-free diagnostic paradigm mapping patient observations to explicit medical knowledge. CKG Reasoner integrates candidate-specific Evidence Feature Nodes, patient-reference matching, a bounded Information Gate, knowledge-weighted evidence accumulation, disease similarity, and decisive clinical rules. Missing-aware normalization and coverage auditing distinguish absent from unavailable evidence. Candidate ranking is separate from outcome-label-independent K-means clustering, which uses four derived evidence coordinates (evidence strength, relative magnitude, directional similarity, and evidence completeness), not raw predictors or targets, to derive cohort-level assignments. Across six retrospective cohorts - four dengue (N = 1000, 1523, 989, 1018), malaria (N = 2190), and influenza (N = 4569) - a uniform, label-free, cohort-fitted K = 2 protocol yielded positive-class F1 scores of 0.996, 0.634, 0.936, 0.917, 0.695, and 0.842, and all-record accuracies of 0.996, 0.558, 0.914, 0.893, 0.707, and 0.906, respectively, with full partition-decision coverage using the frozen package and disease-specific knowledge representations. Neither scoring nor clustering uses outcome labels. Logistic regression provides a supervised baseline. Influenza incorporates confirmatory molecular PCR and is not independent pre-test prediction. Results characterize knowledge-grounded evidence separation, auditability, and sensitivity, not prospective clinical validity or comparative superiority. FOL/LLM-based clinical explanation remains unevaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CKG Reasoner 用医学本体与符号-概率知识图谱做免训练诊断推理，把患者观测映射到显式知识并给出候选疾病排序，评分与 K=2 聚类全程不使用结局标签。在六个回顾性队列（登革热 N=1000/1523/989/1018、疟疾 N=2190、流感 N=4569）上正类 F1 为 0.996、0.634、0.936、0.917、0.695、0.842。
Motivation: 多数临床预测系统靠学习患者-变量-结局关联，需要训练且可解释性差；本文转向把观测直接映射到显式医学知识的免训练范式。
Method: CKG Reasoner 集成候选专属 Evidence Feature Node、患者参考匹配、有界 Information Gate、知识加权证据累积、疾病相似度与决定性临床规则；Missing-aware 归一化与 coverage 审计区分证据缺失与不可得。候选排序与结局标签无关的 K-means 聚类分离，聚类只用四个派生证据坐标（证据强度、相对量级、方向相似度、证据完备度），采用统一的标签无关、队列拟合 K=2 协议，逻辑回归作监督基线。
Result: 六个队列正类 F1 依次为 0.996、0.634、0.936、0.917、0.695、0.842，全记录准确率依次为 0.996、0.558、0.914、0.893、0.707、0.906，冻结包下分区决策全覆盖；评分与聚类均不使用结局标签。流感队列含确诊分子 PCR，不属独立的验前预测。
Conclusion: 结果刻画的是知识驱动的证据分离、可审计性与敏感性，而非前瞻性临床有效性或相对优势；FOL/LLM 临床解释仍未评估。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining a language model takes enormous compute, and the right optimizer can save a good part of it. Muon's spectral step gives a stronger direction than a sign step, but it is expensive. Every step runs Newton-Schulz iterations on the full matrix and, in distributed training, an extra all-reduce. Sign steps, as in Lion and Signum, are cheap and stay local to each device. We propose LionMuon, which takes one Muon step every $P$ iterations and Lion steps in between, with a single dual-EMA momentum buffer shared by both. Muon's compute and communication are paid once per $P$ steps, and the optimizer state is half of AdamW's. A single-EMA variant, SignMuon, already improves on Muon. We prove complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise in which the period sets an interpolation between Muon's and Lion's smoothness and noise constants, and which say when LionMuon is faster than both. On 124M and 355M models trained on FineWeb, LionMuon with $P=2$ and $P=5$ reaches a lower loss than Muon, AdamW, Lion and Signum at the same number of tokens. Under 4-GPU data-parallel training it reaches Muon's final loss with a third less wall-clock on PCIe, and it beats the communication-efficient Muon variants Dion and MuonBP on loss at no more exposed communication, while keeping the exact gradient. Code: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/lion-muon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LionMuon 把昂贵的 Muon 谱步与廉价的本地 Lion 符号步交替执行，每 P 次迭代只跑一次 Newton-Schulz 与 all-reduce，两个步共享一份 dual-EMA 动量缓冲。在 FineWeb 上训练 124M 与 355M 模型时，P=2 与 P=5 在相同 token 数下取得比 Muon、AdamW、Lion、Signum 更低的 loss；4 卡数据并行下用约少三分之一的墙钟时间达到 Muon 的最终 loss。
Motivation: 语言模型预训练开销巨大，Muon 的谱步每步都要在全矩阵上跑 Newton-Schulz 迭代并在分布式训练中额外做一次 all-reduce，代价高；而 Lion/Signum 的符号步便宜且只留在本设备。
Method: 每 P 次迭代执行一次 Muon 谱步，其间插入 Lion 符号步，两者共用一份 dual-EMA 动量缓冲；另有单 EMA 变体 SignMuon。作者在重尾噪声下证明复杂度界，其中周期 P 决定 Muon 与 Lion 的平滑度与噪声常数之间的插值，并给出 LionMuon 快于两者各自的条件。
Result: 在 FineWeb 上训练的 124M 与 355M 模型中，P=2 与 P=5 在相同 token 数下的 loss 低于 Muon、AdamW、Lion 和 Signum。4-GPU 数据并行下，在 PCIe 上以约少三分之一的墙钟时间达到 Muon 的最终 loss；在不超过已暴露通信量的前提下，loss 优于通信高效变体 Dion 与 MuonBP，且保持精确梯度。优化器状态为 AdamW 的一半。
Conclusion: 按周期把谱步与符号步混合，可以在不牺牲最终 loss 的前提下同时省计算、通信与优化器状态；重尾噪声下的复杂度界给出了它快于 Muon 与 Lion 各自的条件。
