papers.title: AbGaze: Attentive Geometric Representation Learning for End-to-End Antibody Design
papers.abstract_en: Computational antibody design requires representations that capture the geometric patterns underlying antigen--antibody interactions, yet existing approaches often rely on scalar distances or surface-intrinsic features, leaving cross-molecular geometry largely implicit. We present AbGaze, an end-to-end antibody design framework based on attentive geometric representation learning, which encodes distance, spatial direction, and surface-normal orientation of antigen surfaces relative to antibody-residue local frames, and adaptively aggregates these geometric interactions according to their interfacial context. The learned interaction representation is shared across multi-CDR co-design, complex structure prediction, and affinity optimization, with local-frame geometric supervision further constraining the representation. AbGaze outperforms prior methods across all three tasks: relative to the second-best method, it improves amino-acid recovery by 7.1% and reduces structural error by 14.9% on average over the six CDRs, improves interface docking quality (DockQ) by 6.6%, and raises the affinity improvement rate (IMP) by 32.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AbGaze 用注意力式几何表示学习，把抗原表面相对抗体残基局部坐标系的距离、空间方向与法向朝向编码为界面几何交互，并按界面语境自适应聚合，同一表示共享给多 CDR 协同设计、复合结构预测与亲和力优化三项任务。相对次优方法，六条 CDR 平均氨基酸恢复率提升 7.1%、结构误差降低 14.9%，DockQ 提升 6.6%，亲和力提升率 (IMP) 提升 32.5%。
Motivation: 计算抗体设计的表示多依赖标量距离或表面内在特征，跨分子几何关系基本是隐式的，难以刻画抗原-抗体界面的方向性模式。
Method: 端到端框架 AbGaze：以抗体残基局部坐标系 (local frame) 为参照，编码抗原表面的距离、空间方向与表面法向三类几何量，按界面语境自适应聚合为交互表示；该表示在多 CDR 协同设计、复合结构预测、亲和力优化三任务间共享，并由局部坐标系几何监督约束。
Result: 相对次优方法：六条 CDR 平均氨基酸恢复率提高 7.1%，结构误差降低 14.9%；界面对接质量 DockQ 提升 6.6%；亲和力提升率 (IMP) 提高 32.5%。三项任务上均超过已有方法。
Conclusion: 把跨分子几何显式编码进共享的注意力式界面表示，可同时改善抗体设计的序列、结构与亲和力三类目标。

papers.title: Simulation-Based Inference for Plate Reverb System Identification
papers.abstract_en: We address Task A of the 1st DAFx Parameter Estimation Challenge, which aims to retrieve the physical parameters of a plate model from an impulse response. To do so, we use the Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) framework, in which we train a neural network to estimate a density over plate parameters given an impulse response, using a dataset generated by the simulator. Inference for a new impulse response then requires only a forward pass through the network, without involving the simulator. For each test observation, we fine-tune a specific network: additional simulation rounds are performed by sampling parameters from the current estimated distribution, simulating the corresponding impulse responses, and fine-tuning to produce the specialized network.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 29th Int. Conf. Digital Audio Effects (DAFx26), Cambridge, MA, USA, 1-4 Sept. 2026 (Parameter Estimation Challenge, Task A)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 DAFx26 参数估计挑战 Task A，用基于模拟的推断 (Simulation-Based Inference, SBI) 从脉冲响应反演板模型物理参数：训练神经网络直接输出参数后验密度，新观测只需一次前向传播、不再调用模拟器，并对每条测试观测做多轮迭代微调得到专用网络。
Motivation: 从脉冲响应反演板模型物理参数属于昂贵模拟器下的逆问题，传统方法每条新观测都要反复调用模拟器做优化，代价高。
Method: 采用 SBI 框架：用模拟器生成数据集，训练神经网络估计给定脉冲响应的板参数密度；对每条测试观测从当前估计分布采样参数、模拟对应脉冲响应，追加模拟轮次并微调出该观测专用网络。
Result: 提交对象为 DAFx26 Parameter Estimation Challenge Task A 的解法：推理阶段新脉冲响应只需网络一次前向传播，无需涉及模拟器；每条测试观测通过追加模拟轮次与微调得到专用网络。
Conclusion: SBI 可把板参数反演的在线代价从反复调用模拟器降为单次网络前向，而专用化靠按观测迭代微调实现。

papers.title: Beyond Saying Less: Fine-Grained Alignment for Informative and Faithful Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Object hallucination remains a major challenge for large vision-language models. While off-policy preference optimization proves to be an effective solution, on-policy reinforcement learning provides a more promising direction as it directly targets a model's current failure modes. However, we find that without fine-grained reward formulation and allocation, on-policy optimization often falls into an easy shortcut: reducing hallucinations merely by saying less---making fewer valid claims. To comprehensively resolve this, we propose a fine-grained alignment framework that couples dense reward signals at the data level with precise credit assignment at the algorithmic level. Specifically, we first construct the Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) dataset to address sparse annotations that prevent valid object claims from being verified and rewarded. DOPA exhaustively annotates the deterministic presence and absence of every concept across an expanded vocabulary, significantly increasing the density of reliable reward signals during on-policy rollouts. Second, we propose Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO) to prevent response-level shared advantages from allowing local hallucinations to compromise all other valid outputs within the same response. By assigning credit to each subsentence independently based on its object claims, SCAPO can precisely reinforce faithful generations and penalize hallucinations. Furthermore, we leverage the resulting faithful image descriptions as auxiliary context to transfer generative gains to discriminative tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces highly informative, faithful descriptions in generative tasks while yielding clear performance gains on discriminative evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视觉语言模型靠少说话来规避物体幻觉的捷径，提出细粒度对齐框架：用 DOPA 数据集稠密标注概念的存在与不存在，为 on-policy rollout 提供可靠稠密奖励，再用 SCAPO 按子句独立分配信用。实验显示生成任务描述既信息丰富又忠实，判别任务也获得清晰的性能提升。
Motivation: on-policy 强化学习若缺少细粒度奖励设计与分配，会走捷径——靠减少有效声明来降低幻觉，使模型输出信息量不足。
Method: 构建 Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) 数据集，在扩展词表上穷尽标注每个概念的确定存在与不存在，解决稀疏标注导致有效物体声明无法被验证和奖励的问题；提出 Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO)，按每个子句的物体声明独立分配信用，取代 response 级共享优势；并把得到的忠实图像描述作为辅助上下文，把生成能力迁移到判别任务。
Result: 实验表明该方法在生成任务中产出信息丰富且忠实的描述，并在判别评测上取得清晰的性能提升。
Conclusion: 数据层的稠密奖励与算法层的精确信用分配耦合，才能同时消除物体幻觉与“少说话”捷径，并把生成侧的忠实性收益传导到判别任务。

papers.title: Scaffold Then Internalize: Representation Injection for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer's hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders. In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder's space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce \textit{REPresentation Injection} (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over $43.5\times$. Code will be available at https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 REPI（REPresentation Injection）：把预训练视觉编码器的表征投影后注入 diffusion transformer，让其直接参与去噪，而非像 REPA 那样把扩散表征投回编码器空间。采用 scaffold-to-internalization 策略，编码器表征先作临时脚手架再被逐步内化。仅 160K 训练步的 REPI + REPA 即可匹配训练 7M 步的 vanilla SiT，加速超过 43.5×。
Motivation: REPA 类方法只做单向的扩散表征对齐，编码器信息未直接参与去噪过程，训练加速仍有空间。
Method: REPI 训练框架：将预训练视觉编码器表征投影后注入 diffusion transformer 的隐状态，使其参与去噪；按 scaffold-to-internalization 策略先作为临时脚手架、再逐步内化。与 REPA 组合使用。
Result: 在多种 backbone 上 REPI 优于 REPA，且与 REPA 高度互补，两者结合的增益超过任一单独使用；仅 160K 训练步的 REPI + REPA 匹配 vanilla SiT 训练 7M 步的效果，加速超过 43.5×。
Conclusion: 把编码器表征注入而非对齐，是 REPA 的有效互补方向，脚手架到内化的训练策略可大幅压缩 diffusion transformer 的训练步数。

papers.title: Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在视觉-语言模型上对窄多模态任务做微调即可诱发涌现性失准 (emergent misalignment)，且这种失准会迁移到与训练任务无关的能力上：错误观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、易受视觉越狱以及高风险智能体行为。跨 15 个商业与开源模型，该现象不依赖训练数据的表面有害性，而对训练-评测的模态对齐方式敏感，可用 prompt inoculation、良性继续训练与激活级引导部分缓解。
Motivation: 此前的涌现性失准几乎只在纯文本任务中被研究，多模态模型是否会因窄任务微调而出现跨任务的广泛有害行为尚不清楚。
Method: 在三类窄多模态任务上微调诱发 EM：针对脆弱代码、随意使用家居物品、对普通场景的阴谋论式解读；覆盖 15 个不同规模的商业与开源模型，比较监督微调与偏好优化两条路径，并测试 prompt inoculation、良性继续训练、激活级引导 (activation-level steering) 等缓解手段。
Result: 在 15 个商业与开源模型上，窄多模态微调诱发了连贯且广泛失准、可迁移到无关任务的行为，涵盖错误观点、视觉事实不诚实、不安全图像生成、视觉越狱脆弱性与高风险智能体动作；EM 不依赖训练数据的表面有害性，但对训练-评测模态对齐敏感，可由监督微调与偏好优化产生并经中间推理传播，三种缓解策略只能部分降低 EM。
Conclusion: 多模态 EM 表现为行为偏移而非通用能力丧失，把纯文本中已知的窄任务微调失准风险扩展到了视觉模态。

papers.title: EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoIn 把「演化 harness」与「内化到模型」接起来：先从执行轨迹中演化并临时挂载验证新的决策流程，用它生成更好的推理轨迹，再改写成不依赖 harness 指令的自包含推理，最后在改写轨迹上微调模型，使决策能力在推理时脱离演化后的 harness 仍然保留。在多个基准上域内 pass rate 提升 10.9 个百分点、域外提升 9.2 个百分点，且在另一模型族上也有一致改善。
Motivation: 现有「联合演化 harness 与模型」的工作把新工具、新决策流程和模型适配混在一个笼统的 agent improvement 概念里，无法回答决策流程本身如何被改进并固化。
Method: EvoIn 四步：分析 agent 执行轨迹，演化新决策流程并在 harness 中临时实例化以验证；用已验证流程引导 agent 生成改进推理轨迹；把这些轨迹改写为自包含形式，去掉对 harness 指令的显式引用、把决策逻辑表达为模型自身推理；最后在改写轨迹上微调模型完成内化。
Result: 在多个多样基准上，域内 pass rate 提升 10.9 个百分点，域外提升 9.2 个百分点；内化的决策流程可泛化到未见任务；案例研究显示 agent 会先决定如何解题再动手（如先查文档长度再选择通读或搜索）；在另一个模型族上也有一致改善。
Conclusion: 把演化出的决策流程改写成自包含推理再微调，可以让改进的决策能力在推理时不再依赖演化后的 harness，并跨任务、跨模型族泛化。

papers.title: Domain-adaptive Zero-Shot Image Enhancement via Locality-Constrained Diffusion Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have shown remarkable performance in unconditional image generation. In order to generate images with desired semantics, recent works have restricted the solution space by using guidance constraints in the diffusion sampling process. However, for image enhancement across different domains, these methods struggle to balance two main requirements: looking realistic in the target domain (photorealistic images) and preserving relevant features of the source domain, e.g., low-quality renderings or art paintings. Here, small local changes can alter the fidelity of the image completely, while large changes in other regions might be insignificant. We introduce LocDiff, a locality-constrained guidance method for image enhancement, which serves as a zero-shot extension to pre-trained diffusion models, ensuring the preservation of critical features during domain adaptation. In this way, we retain important local features, while allowing less critical regions to remain unconstrained and not interfere with the guidance process for relevant regions. We evaluate our method on two different domain-shift tasks: For art-to-photo translation, we apply the method in a fully zero-shot setting, preserving facial identity from paintings while generating photorealistic details. For enhancing low-quality fetal ultrasound renderings, we demonstrate zero-shot inference with auxiliary prior alignment. Here, the objective is to artificially add high-resolution characteristics and produce photorealistic ultrasound renderings, a target domain for which no ground truth distribution exists. Our experimental results demonstrate that LocDiff achieves favorable realism-faithfulness trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art methods, enabling controllable cross-domain enhancement.
papers.comment: Accepted manuscript. The final version is published in Computers & Graphics

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LocDiff 是对预训练扩散模型的零样本图像增强扩展，用局部性约束的引导 (locality-constrained guidance) 只在关键区域施加引导、让次要区域不受约束，从而在域迁移中保住源域关键特征。在艺术画转照片与低质量胎儿超声渲染两个任务上，它相对现有方法取得更有利的真实感-保真度权衡。
Motivation: 扩散引导在跨域图像增强中难以同时满足目标域真实感与源域特征保真：局部小改动可能彻底破坏保真度，而另一些区域的大改动无关紧要，统一的引导约束无法区分这两类区域。
Method: LocDiff 作为预训练 DDPM 的零样本扩展，在采样过程中施加局部性约束引导，只约束关键区域、放开次要区域。艺术画转照片任务完全零样本，保留画中人脸身份同时生成真实感细节；胎儿超声渲染任务做零样本推理加辅助先验对齐 (auxiliary prior alignment)，向无真值分布的目标域人造高分辨率特征。
Result: 在艺术画转照片与低质量胎儿超声渲染两个域偏移任务上，LocDiff 相对 state-of-the-art 方法取得更有利的真实感-保真度权衡，并支持可控的跨域增强。
Conclusion: 把引导约束按局部重要性分配，可以在零样本域适配中同时保住关键局部特征并生成目标域真实感细节，包括没有真值分布的目标域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $λ$-JEPA Spectral Anti-Collapse Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of $λ$-balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) $λ$-balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces $λ$-balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations' ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose $λ$-JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, $λ$-JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SACReg 把防坍缩正则直接加在 backbone 而非 projection head 上，通过诱导 λ-balance（各层权重矩阵的相对尺度平衡）阻止表征维度坍缩；两层线性网络中证明 λ-balance 可防坍缩且该正则能诱导它，非线性情形同样抗坍缩。在 ImageNet100 上提升表征有效秩，λ-JEPA 在 ImageNet-1k 分类与八个下游数据集的 linear-probe 平均迁移上超过 LeJEPA 和 VISReg，在 Something-Something-v2 与 Kinetics-400 上超过 LeVJEPA 和 V-JEPA 2。
Motivation: 联合嵌入自监督学习的防坍缩目标通常作用在 projection head 之后，而下游任务用的是 projector 之前的 backbone 表征；这种错配可能让 backbone 仍保持低有效秩，限制下游迁移。
Method: 提出谱防坍缩正则 SACReg，由 λ-balance 分析导出，直接施加于 backbone；两层线性网络中证明 (i) λ-balance 防坍缩、(ii) 该正则诱导 λ-balance，非线性情形同样抗坍缩。将其接入 JEPA 得到 λ-JEPA，并扩展到视频自监督学习。
Result: 在 ImageNet100 的 realistic 架构上经验性提升表征秩；λ-JEPA 在 ImageNet-1k 分类和八个下游图像数据集的 linear-probe 平均迁移性能上超过 LeJEPA 与 VISReg；在视频自监督学习上，于 Something-Something-v2 与 Kinetics-400 上超过 LeVJEPA 与 V-JEPA 2。
Conclusion: 把防坍缩约束从 projector 移到 backbone、以 λ-balance 为判据，可以在图像与视频自监督学习中同时获得更高表征秩和更好的下游迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: An argument can be surprising coming from a particular speaker without being a bad argument. Do AI evaluators keep these judgments apart? Two preregistered descriptive studies and a later Jev supplement collected 2,976 usable evaluations of six fixed texts about US AI policy, Germany's debt brake and Swiss nuclear energy. Each text was presented under several source attributions. The key comparison asks whether the gap between two sources changes when the argument changes. On Sol, for example, a national-security argument received mean ratings of 0.359 under CODEPINK and 0.639 under College Republicans; a civil-rights argument received 0.742 and 0.721. A constant preference for one source cannot explain that pattern. Related interactions appeared across topics and recent model configurations, including those with reasoning enabled, while several comparisons yielded small effects. The later European Jev supplement yielded five interactions below the adopted absolute reference of 0.05; its distinct rubric and interrupted collection limit comparison with the chat systems. Some written evaluations explicitly invoked a mismatch between a source and its attributed position. Taken together, the numerical and verbal evidence supports source-position coherence as a plausible explanation, alongside competing accounts involving credibility, authenticity and interpretation of the task. The paper develops this inference through controlled comparisons, reports conditional post hoc p-values in an appendix, and documents the human decisions and delegated checks behind an AI-conducted study.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Preregistrations, materials and code available on GitHub. Preprint; not yet peer reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两项预注册描述性研究加后续 Jev 补充，共收集 2,976 条对六篇固定文本的可用评价，检验 AI 评价者是否会把「说话者可疑」与「论证糟糕」分开判断。结果显示来源偏好无法解释的交互：同一来源差异随论证类型翻转（如 Sol 上国家安全论证 0.359 对 0.639，民权论证 0.742 对 0.721），支持 source-position coherence 作为可行解释。
Motivation: AI 评价者可能把对来源的固有偏好混入对论证质量的判断，需要区分恒定来源偏好与随论证变化的来源-立场一致性这两种机制。
Method: 两项预注册描述性研究加一个后续 Jev 补充，六篇固定文本（美国 AI 政策、德国债务刹车、瑞士核能）各在多个来源署名下呈现，核心比较是来源差距是否随论证改变；涵盖多个话题与近期模型配置（含开启 reasoning），并记录人工决策与委托检查。
Result: 共 2,976 条可用评价；Sol 上国家安全论证均值 0.359（CODEPINK）对 0.639（College Republicans），民权论证 0.742 对 0.721；多个话题与模型配置出现类似交互，若干比较效应量较小；Jev 补充得到五个低于 0.05 绝对参考值的交互，其独立评分标准与中断收集限制了与 chat 系统的比较；部分书面评价明确援引来源与所署立场的不匹配。
Conclusion: 数值与言语证据共同支持 source-position coherence 是可行解释，但与可信度、真实性、任务理解等竞争解释并存；条件性事后 p 值置于附录。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Textual User Taste: Natural-Language User Context for Foundation-Model Recommender System at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Foundation model recommender systems require user context that can be consumed by large language models, reasoned over, and refined through natural-language interaction. Traditional behavioral embedding vectors remain highly effective for retrieval and ranking, but they are opaque to users and not natively expressed for language model workflows. We present Textual User Taste, a system that generates structured natural-language taste profiles from listening behavior, interaction signals, content metadata, and optional user feedback, and deploys them to millions of Spotify users. We describe the end-to-end production lifecycle required to generate, evaluate, optimize, and maintain these representations at industrial scale, including prompt development and compression, user steering, and integration with downstream personalization systems. Because no unique ground-truth taste profile exists, we introduce a multi-faceted evaluation framework to evaluate taste profiles as a production representation: they carry user-specific predictive signal independently, and when integrated with behavioral embeddings, improve MRR by 0.6% for future-track prediction and NDCG@7 by 2.2% for search ranking. Our evaluation also reveals that taste profiles support positive natural-language steering, while exposing important limitations, including challenges with negation and short-term temporal adaptation. These findings position taste profiles not as replacements for behavioral embeddings, but as an interpretable and steerable interface between evolving user context and foundation-model recommender systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Textual User Taste 把收听行为、交互信号与内容元数据转成结构化自然语言口味画像，并部署到数百万 Spotify 用户；画像自带预测信号，与行为 embedding 拼接后 future-track 预测 MRR 提升 0.6%、搜索排序 NDCG@7 提升 2.2%，且支持自然语言 steering，但在否定与短期时序适应上仍失败。
Motivation: 行为 embedding 向量对用户不透明、也不适配 LLM 工作流，而基础模型推荐系统需要可被语言模型推理和交互修正的用户上下文。
Method: 从收听行为、交互信号、内容元数据与可选用户反馈生成结构化自然语言 taste profile，覆盖 prompt 开发与压缩、用户 steering、下游个性化系统集成的端到端生产生命周期；因无唯一 ground truth，设计多面评估框架，既测画像独立预测信号，也测与行为 embedding 结合后的增益。
Result: 与行为 embedding 结合后 future-track 预测 MRR 提升 0.6%，搜索排序 NDCG@7 提升 2.2%；画像单独携带用户特异的预测信号，并支持正向自然语言 steering；同时暴露否定处理与短期时序适应方面的挑战。
Conclusion: taste profile 不是行为 embedding 的替代品，而是演化用户上下文与基础模型推荐系统之间可解释、可 steering 的接口。

papers.title: Evaluating Hierarchy-Aware Deep Learning for the Recognition of Tironian Notes
papers.abstract_en: Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory. Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers. Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce. However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs. This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition. We use the Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes. We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, Shifted Window Transformer (Swin), and Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers with Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network (HD-CNN)-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering. The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain. The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation. On Vergilius Turonensis, HD-CNN achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43%, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09%. Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 ICDAR Workshop on Computational Paleography (IWCP). 25 pages, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Tironian notes（提罗速记）符号类多、字形高度相似且训练数据稀缺的问题，用 SNT 的层级组织做粗到细识别：对比 flat ResNet18/ConvNeXt/Swin/ViT 与 HD-CNN 式 coarse-to-fine 及层级感知路由模型。在 Vergilius Turonensis 上，未做域适应时 HD-CNN Top-1 最高 45.43%，而少量样本适应后 flat 分类反超至 82.09%，即层级结构的收益取决于是否做域适应。
Motivation: Tironian notes 类集大、笔画细微差异难分，人工识读费时；标准 flat 分类器不利用相关符号间的视觉与结构关系，且真实训练数据稀缺。
Method: 以 Martin Hellmann 的 Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) 提供的理想化字形与层级组织为结构来源，比较 flat ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT 与 HD-CNN 式 coarse-to-fine 模型，以及基于 visual class cleaning 和 similarity-based re-clustering 的层级感知路由模型；在手写样本与 Vergilius Turonensis 手稿域样本上评测，含不做适应与有限 few-shot 域适应两种设置。
Result: 在 Vergilius Turonensis 上，未适应时 HD-CNN 取得最佳 Top-1 45.43%；few-shot 适应后 flat 分类取得最佳 Top-1 82.09%。flat 与层级模型的相对表现取决于是否做适应。
Conclusion: 层级结构能支撑 Tironian notes 识别，尤其在未适应条件下；一旦做 few-shot 手稿域适应，flat 分类反而更优。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Multi-Attractor GNNs: Set-Valued Expressivity Beyond Unique Equilibria
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent and equilibrium graph neural networks (GNNs) often enforce a unique fixed point or use one training target per graph. Yet many combinatorial and scientific problems admit multiple valid solutions, with no preferred one. A designated target can then impose an arbitrary selection rule. For tasks invariant to node relabeling, a symmetric graph may have a symmetric solution set but no symmetric solution. We show that multiple equilibria enable one weight-tied message-passing GNN to represent set-valued equivariant maps: different initializations approach different valid solutions. Under stated regularity assumptions, we first construct globally Lipschitz, permutation-equivariant dynamics that converge almost surely to valid solutions and reach every solution branch with positive probability. We then establish approximate realization by recurrent message passing with continuous component maps, with arbitrarily small update and limiting errors and arbitrarily high probability. This goes beyond standard universality arguments: although message passing alone cannot distinguish symmetric nodes, the evolving state keeps nodes distinguishable at every finite step without auxiliary node identifiers. Such dynamics can be learned without solution labels using problem-specific energies. On Ising ground states, structural module detection in protein graphs, and chemical reaction steady states, the learned updates produce multiple high-quality predictions with high numerical convergence rates. They achieve better average solution quality than the tested unique-equilibrium, single-target, and feedforward baselines, while remaining competitive with much larger diffusion-based solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明权重共享的消息传递 GNN 借助多平衡态可表示集合值等变映射：不同初始化收敛到不同合法解，且以正概率到达每个解分支。在 Ising 基态、蛋白图结构模块检测与化学反应稳态上，学到的更新产生多个高质量预测，平均解质量优于唯一平衡态、单目标与前馈基线，并与更大的扩散式求解器相当。
Motivation: 组合与科学问题常有多个同等合法的解，而唯一固定点或每图单一训练目标会强加任意选择规则；对节点重命名不变的任务里，对称图可能只有对称解集而无对称解。
Method: 在给定正则性假设下构造全局 Lipschitz、置换等变的动力学，几乎必然收敛到合法解；再用连续分量映射的递归消息传递做近似实现，更新与极限误差任意小、成功概率任意高。学习阶段无需解标签，用问题特定能量驱动；演化状态在每个有限步保持节点可区分，无需辅助节点标识。
Result: 在 Ising 基态、蛋白图结构模块检测、化学反应稳态三个任务上，学到的更新产出多个高质量预测且数值收敛率高；平均解质量优于所测试的唯一平衡态、单目标与前馈基线，同时与规模大得多的基于扩散的求解器保持竞争力。

papers.title: eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: eval-unlearn 是一个开源 Python 库，把 T2I 扩散模型概念遗忘 (concept unlearning) 的评测统一到同一套可复现框架下：集成 12 种已发表遗忘技术与 9 个互补指标，并在 HuggingFace 上发布 nudity 概念擦除排行榜。跨方法比较暴露出在异构评测下被掩盖的准确性-生成质量权衡。
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘技术的实验条件高度异构，方法之间难以做有原则的横向比较，评测版图碎片化。
Method: eval-unlearn 以插件架构让第三方技术与指标自注册，集成 12 种遗忘技术（涵盖 fine-tuning、closed-form model editing、inference-time intervention 三类）与 9 个指标（覆盖擦除有效性、对抗鲁棒性、生成质量、概念保留），并提供流式分批 pipeline 评测标准 NSFW 概念与任意通用概念；另发布 HuggingFace 排行榜与实时交互评测工具，MIT 许可。
Result: 在 nudity 概念擦除案例上对全部 12 种技术做统一比较，暴露出在异构评测下被掩盖的显著 accuracy-quality 权衡；框架含 12 种遗忘技术、9 个评测指标，代码与文档以 MIT 许可发布。
Conclusion: 统一、可复现的评测框架能揭示异构评测所掩盖的权衡，使 T2I 概念遗忘方法可被公平横向比较。

papers.title: SpikeCredit: Temporal Credit Carrier for Reinforcement Learning with Sparse Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse rewards is challenging because delayed outcomes provide little guidance about which intermediate computations caused success or failure. We argue that reliable credit assignment requires policy dynamics that preserve and expose credit-relevant information over time, a role we formalize as Temporal Credit Carriers (TCCs) and that spiking neural networks (SNNs) naturally fulfill through graded membrane traces and event-driven spikes. Based on this hypothesis, we propose SpikeCredit, an SNN-based framework for RL with sparse rewards that first performs task-adaptive TCC selection and then closes the loop between a fast TCC-reading pathway, where self-motion feedback constraint uses local behavior-grounded cues to constrain transition-level credit recovery, and a slow TCC-writing pathway, where credit-targeted trace alignment feeds recovered credit back into the actor to make future TCC dynamics more credit-readable. Across sparse-reward MuJoCo tasks, SpikeCredit improves Last10 return over sparse SNN baselines by +1169% on Ant, +953% on Hopper, +723% on Swimmer, and +1781% on Walker2d, and exceeds the dense-reward baseline on Swimmer by +113%. Mechanistic analyses further show substantially stronger alignment with dense rewards than the sparse SNN baseline. These results position spiking dynamics as credit-preserving substrates for sparse-reward RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpikeCredit 把脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 的分级膜电位痕迹与事件驱动放电形式化为 Temporal Credit Carrier (TCC)，用于稀疏奖励强化学习的时序信用分配：先做任务自适应 TCC 选择，再用快读通路（自运动反馈约束恢复转移级信用）与慢写通路（credit-targeted trace alignment 把信用回灌 actor）闭环。在稀疏奖励 MuJoCo 任务上，Last10 return 相对稀疏 SNN 基线在 Ant 提升 1169%、Hopper 953%、Swimmer 723%、Walker2d 1781%，Swimmer 上还超过密集奖励基线 113%。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励 RL 中延迟结果几乎不提供中间决策的归因信号，需要能随时间保存并暴露信用相关信息的机制。
Method: 将 TCC 假设落到 SNN 上：任务自适应 TCC 选择，快通路用基于局部行为线索的自运动反馈约束做转移级信用恢复，慢通路用 credit-targeted trace alignment 把恢复的信用反馈给 actor，使后续 TCC 动态更易读出。
Result: 稀疏奖励 MuJoCo 上 Last10 return 相对稀疏 SNN 基线：Ant +1169%、Hopper +953%、Swimmer +723%、Walker2d +1781%；Swimmer 上比密集奖励基线高 +113%。机制分析显示与密集奖励的对齐显著强于稀疏 SNN 基线。
Conclusion: 脉冲动态可作为稀疏奖励 RL 的信用保存基底，读写双通路闭环让转移级信用既可恢复又可回灌策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WavePP: High-Throughput Pipeline Parallel LLM Prefill under Prefix Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline parallelism can improve prefill throughput by processing multiple request chunks concurrently across different stages of the model. However, keeping the pipeline fully utilized requires efficient scheduling and request preparation. In systems where stages retain and evict cache state independently, a local cache hit does not guarantee that the same prefix can be reused across the pipeline. Here, coordination overhead can impede request admission cadence and thus reduce overall throughput. In this paper, we present WavePP, a prefill runtime built on top of TensorRT-LLM that addresses these challenges by overlapping request admission with pipeline execution. WavePP asynchronously finds a prefix that can be reused across all stages, protects the cached state, and reserves space for the remaining input while earlier requests continue to execute. It subsequently plans the chunk sizes of each request dynamically to maximize pipeline fill. Each stage then completes the local preparation before executing the request. In the same system and pipeline topology, WavePP improves TensorRT-LLM's prefill throughput in 37 of 40 tested settings on GLM 5.2 and MiniMax M2.7. At concurrency 128 with high cache reuse, these changes increase throughput by factors of 2.91 and 2.02, respectively. Across 28 Kimi K3 settings, WavePP also has the highest measured throughput in all 18 settings at concurrency eight or higher, compared with tensor/expert-parallel and pipeline-parallel baselines from TRT-LLM, SGLang, and vLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WavePP 是构建在 TensorRT-LLM 之上的 LLM prefill 运行时，把请求准入与流水线执行重叠：异步寻找全流水线各 stage 都可复用的前缀并保护其缓存状态，同时为剩余输入预留空间，再动态规划每个请求的 chunk 大小以最大化流水线填充。在相同系统与流水线拓扑下，GLM 5.2 与 MiniMax M2.7 的 40 组设置中 37 组提升 TensorRT-LLM 的 prefill 吞吐，并发 128 且缓存复用高时分别达到 2.91 倍与 2.02 倍。
Motivation: 各 stage 独立保留与淘汰缓存时，本地 cache hit 不等于同一前缀能在整条流水线上复用，协调开销拖慢请求准入节奏，进而拉低 prefill 整体吞吐。
Method: WavePP 建立在 TensorRT-LLM 之上：异步搜索全 stage 可复用的前缀并保护缓存状态、为剩余输入预留空间，同时先前请求继续执行；随后按请求动态规划 chunk 大小以最大化 pipeline fill，各 stage 在执行前完成本地准备。
Result: 在相同系统与流水线拓扑下，GLM 5.2 与 MiniMax M2.7 共 40 组测试设置中 37 组提升 TensorRT-LLM 的 prefill 吞吐；并发 128 且高缓存复用时吞吐分别提升 2.91 倍与 2.02 倍。在 Kimi K3 的 28 组设置中，并发 8 及以上的 18 组设置里 WavePP 的实测吞吐全部最高，对比对象为 TRT-LLM、SGLang、vLLM 的 tensor/expert-parallel 与 pipeline-parallel 基线。
Conclusion: 把请求准入与流水线执行重叠、并跨 stage 协调前缀复用，可以在高缓存复用与高并发下显著抬高 LLM prefill 吞吐。

papers.title: Imprint Reader: From Weight-Update Readout to Behavioral Intervention
papers.abstract_en: As language models take a growing role in AI development, a natural aspiration is for them to reflect on their own learning process, as humans do, and use that reflection to improve themselves. At the same time, these models have an advantage that human learners lack, since training leaves parameter-level traces that can, in principle, be inspected directly. However, current models cannot decode these traces into an explicit account of what they have learned. To this end, we introduce the \textit{Imprint Reader}, a model trained with \textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT) to describe frozen weight updates. SMaRT mounts each update onto the Reader and uses an anchor-free meta-query to elicit a natural-language description, while no-change and random-perturbation controls discourage unsupported claims. On held-out updates, the joint Reader reaches judge-based Pass@100 of $2\%$ for knowledge and $16\%$ for behavior. These results demonstrate the feasibility of natural-language readout while pointing to reliability across updates as the next step. Beyond free-form generation, the Reader provides a differentiable proxy for the gap between a specified target behavior and a candidate weight update. Its coordinate-aligned gradients support intervention through MetaEdit. At a $0.5\%$ pruning rate, Reader-guided selection raises measured harmful-prompt refusal from $57.9\%$ to $64.1\%$ under a safety-maintenance target. Using behavior descriptions without target-task training data, MetaEdit increases the frequency of backtracking and sub-goal expressions in mathematical reasoning traces and raises BFCL Overall from $41.69\%$ to $44.60\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Imprint Reader：用 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning (SMaRT) 训练模型把冻结的权重更新读成自然语言描述，并以可微代理驱动 MetaEdit 干预。在留出更新上 joint Reader 的 judge-based Pass@100 为知识 2%、行为 16%；0.5% 剪枝率下有害提示拒答率从 57.9% 升到 64.1%，BFCL Overall 从 41.69% 升到 44.60%。
Motivation: 语言模型训练会在参数上留下可直接检视的痕迹，但现有模型无法把这些痕迹解码成对所学内容的显式说明，自我反思缺少可读的依据。
Method: SMaRT 把每个冻结权重更新 mount 到 Reader 上，用 anchor-free meta-query 生成自然语言描述，并加入 no-change 与 random-perturbation 对照抑制无据断言；Reader 同时输出指定目标行为与候选权重更新之间差距的可微代理，其坐标对齐梯度经 MetaEdit 实施干预。
Result: 在留出更新上 joint Reader 的 judge-based Pass@100 为知识 2%、行为 16%。0.5% 剪枝率下 Reader 引导的选择在 safety-maintenance 目标中把有害提示拒答率从 57.9% 提到 64.1%。MetaEdit 不用目标任务训练数据、仅凭行为描述提高数学推理轨迹中 backtracking 与 sub-goal 表达频率，并把 BFCL Overall 从 41.69% 提到 44.60%。
Conclusion: 自然语言读出权重更新是可行的，但跨更新的可靠性仍是下一步；可微的行为差距代理足以支撑无需目标任务训练数据的权重干预。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: SMaRT 把每个冻结权重更新 mount 到 Reader 上，用 anchor-free meta-query 生成自然语言描述，并加入 no-change 与 random-perturbation 对照抑制无据断言；Reader 同时输出指定目标行为与候选权重更新之间差距的可微代理，其坐标对齐梯度经 MetaEdit 实施干预。
summary_sections.result: 在留出更新上 joint Reader 的 judge-based Pass@100 为知识 2%、行为 16%。0.5% 剪枝率下 Reader 引导的选择在 safety-maintenance 目标中把有害提示拒答率从 57.9% 提到 64.1%。MetaEdit 不用目标任务训练数据、仅凭行为描述提高数学推理轨迹中 backtracking 与 sub-goal 表达频率，并把 BFCL Overall 从 41.69% 提到 44.60%。

papers.title: Latency and accuracy tradeoffs in Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks are attractive for low-power speech command recognition, yet their latency has received far less attention than their energy efficiency, and their multi-timestep execution is widely assumed to make them slower than quantized neural networks. This paper challenges the assumption that more local timesteps necessarily imply higher network latency. By overlapping computation across adjacent layers at the timestep level, SNNs may complete execution in less time than comparable bit-serial QNNs. However, this overlap relies on spikes firing on incomplete inputs, and a spike once generated cannot be withdrawn, so its error persists and reduces accuracy. Waiting for more input before firing would seem to improve accuracy at the cost of reduced overlap. Yet we find and prove that this intuition fails at some layers, where even a small increase in waiting can change spike timing and downstream computation, making the network both slower and less accurate. We therefore propose a Pipeline Delay Search method which selects each layer's delay by balancing task-level accuracy gains against added network latency. We then adapt the selected configurations through spike-based quantization-aware training and bounded tuning of firing thresholds and initial membrane potentials. Together, these steps form Falcon, a framework for Fine-grained Analysis of Latency and Controlled firing which systematically analyzes and optimizes SNN latency under a spatial analog compute-in-memory mapping with shared digital engines. We evaluate Falcon on GSCV2 and SSC, achieving competitive accuracies of 96.31 and 83.02 at modeled network-core latencies of 119.64 and 124.00us, respectively. Together, our analysis and results show that SNNs can compute more yet finish faster, and wait longer yet predict worse, highlighting why Falcon matters for both latency and accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Falcon 针对脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 在空间模拟存内计算映射下的延迟-精度权衡：通过层间时间步重叠让 SNN 比同位宽 bit-serial QNN 更快完成，但证明在部分层多等待输入会同时变慢且变差。提出 Pipeline Delay Search 逐层选延迟，再用 spike-based QAT 与阈值/膜电位有界微调适配，在 GSCV2 与 SSC 上以 119.64us 和 124.00us 的建模网络核延迟达到 96.31 与 83.02 准确率。
Motivation: SNN 的低功耗优势被广泛讨论，但其延迟被默认因多时间步执行而慢于量化神经网络 (QNN)；层间重叠依赖不完整输入上发放的 spike，而 spike 不可撤回，误差会累积，如何在重叠带来的延迟收益与等待带来的精度收益之间取舍是缺口。
Method: Falcon (Fine-grained Analysis of Latency and Controlled firing)：先在时间步粒度做相邻层计算重叠，再用 Pipeline Delay Search 按任务级精度增益对新增网络延迟的平衡为每层选 delay，随后以 spike-based quantization-aware training 并对发放阈值与初始膜电位做有界微调来适配所选配置；分析与优化在共享数字引擎的空间模拟存内计算 (spatial analog compute-in-memory) 映射下进行。
Result: 在 GSCV2 上准确率 96.31、建模网络核延迟 119.64us；在 SSC 上准确率 83.02、延迟 124.00us，摘要称达到有竞争力的精度。作者并证明在某些层即使很小的等待增量也会改变 spike 时序与下游计算，使网络同时更慢且更不准。
Conclusion: SNN 可以算得更多却结束得更快、等待更久却预测更差，因此逐层延迟搜索加量化感知训练是同时控制 SNN 延迟与精度的必要手段，而非默认多时间步必然更慢。

papers.title: On-Policy or Off-Policy Learning? A Systematic Study of Distillation Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: On-policy learning has been argued to reduce catastrophic forgetting, produce sparser parameter updates, and improve generalisation. However, existing comparisons between supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning vary many factors simultaneously, making the contribution of rollout policy difficult to isolate. We study the effect of rollout policy in a controlled strong-to-weak distillation setting, by independently varying rollout policy, token-level KL direction, and learning rate across the Llama3 and Qwen2.5 model families and reasoning tasks spanning scientific, medical, and arithmetic domains. Our analysis reveals a nuanced picture of distillation dynamics in which rollout policy does not necessarily play a central role. Instead, token-level KL direction more clearly shapes task performance and output coverage, while learning rate governs forgetting and update sparsity. Analysis of KL gradients and experiments along a continuous student-teacher rollout-policy spectrum explain this pattern: forward KL is remarkably robust to rollout policy, with its performance stable and strong despite changes to the rollout policy, whereas reverse KL is substantially more sensitive and favours student-generated rollouts. On-policy data nevertheless improves generalisation to harder variants of the Countdown arithmetic task under both KL directions, although this advantage does not reliably persist after subsequent RLVR. Our broader conclusions remain robust to removing gradient clipping, using sampled KL estimators, and training on tasks requiring longer reasoning chains. Overall, our results challenge the view that on-policy rollouts are inherently preferable and show that their value depends critically on the objective, evaluation setting, and optimisation hyperparameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在强到弱蒸馏的受控实验中，rollout policy（on-policy vs off-policy）并非主导因素：token 级 KL 方向更决定任务表现与输出覆盖，学习率决定遗忘与更新稀疏度。forward KL 对 rollout policy 鲁棒，reverse KL 则明显偏好 student 生成的 rollout；on-policy 数据在 Countdown 算术的更难变体上提升泛化，但该优势在后续 RLVR 后不可靠地保留。
Motivation: 现有 SFT 与 RL 的对比同时改变多个因素，rollout policy 的独立贡献难以分离，而 on-policy 能减少灾难性遗忘、带来更稀疏更新的说法缺乏受控检验。
Method: 在 Llama3 与 Qwen2.5 模型族上做受控强到弱蒸馏，独立变化 rollout policy、token 级 KL 方向（forward/reverse）与学习率，任务覆盖科学、医学、算术推理；辅以 KL 梯度分析与连续 student-teacher rollout-policy 谱上的实验，并做去除梯度裁剪、改用 sampled KL 估计器、更长推理链任务的稳健性检验。
Result: forward KL 在 rollout policy 变化下表现稳定且强，reverse KL 对 rollout policy 敏感并偏向 student-generated rollouts；on-policy 数据在 Countdown 算术更难变体上提升泛化（两种 KL 方向皆然），但该优势在后续 RLVR 后不可靠保持；学习率主导遗忘与更新稀疏度，token 级 KL 方向主导任务表现与输出覆盖；结论对去除梯度裁剪、sampled KL 估计器与更长推理链任务稳健。
Conclusion: on-policy rollout 并非天然更优，其价值取决于目标函数（KL 方向）、评估设置与优化超参数；评估蒸馏策略时应把 rollout policy 与 KL 方向、学习率分开考察。

papers.title: AIM-ZO: Activation-Informed Subspace Maintenance for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a memory-efficient alternative for LLM fine-tuning by estimating updates only from forward evaluations of perturbed parameters, without backpropagation or activation storage. However, in billion-parameter LLMs, isotropic perturbations often waste many forward evaluations on weakly informative directions. To make these evaluations more informative, existing ZO methods restrict perturbations to low-dimensional subspaces. Yet the quality of these subspaces is critical: overly compressed or poorly maintained spaces can miss useful update directions. To obtain a high-quality subspace for ZO updates, this paper proposes AIM-ZO, a ZO fine-tuning method based on Activation-Informed Subspace Maintenance. AIM-ZO uses forward activations as local directional information and continuously integrates them into a broad, evolving subspace over training. To access broader gradient-relevant structure while keeping individual perturbations low-dimensional, AIM-ZO activates only a smaller set of shared and sampled directions, decoupling the maintained width from the active width. We evaluate AIM-ZO across 5 LLMs and 11 downstream tasks under matched forward-evaluation budgets; its six-task average exceeds the strongest fully evaluated ZO baseline by 1.26 percentage points on OPT-2.7B and MeZO by 2.85 percentage points on OPT-30B. Our code is available at https://github.com/EkkoXy/AIM-ZO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIM-ZO 用前向激活作为局部方向信息，持续把它们并入一个宽的演化子空间，同时只激活其中较少的共享与采样方向，把子空间宽度与实际扰动宽度解耦。在匹配前向评估预算下，跨 5 个 LLM、11 个下游任务，六任务平均在 OPT-2.7B 上比最强的完整评估 ZO 基线高 1.26 个百分点，在 OPT-30B 上比 MeZO 高 2.85 个百分点。
Motivation: 十亿参数 LLM 上零阶 (ZO) 优化的各向同性扰动把大量前向评估浪费在弱信息方向；而已有 ZO 方法把扰动限制在低维子空间，子空间过度压缩或维护不当会漏掉有用更新方向。
Method: AIM-ZO 以零阶微调为框架，用前向激活作为局部方向信息，在训练过程中持续整合进一个宽且不断演化的子空间；通过只激活较少的共享与采样方向，使维护宽度与激活宽度解耦，从而在保持单次扰动低维的同时覆盖更广的梯度相关结构。
Result: 在匹配前向评估预算下跨 5 个 LLM 与 11 个下游任务评测：六任务平均在 OPT-2.7B 上超过最强的完整评估 ZO 基线 1.26 个百分点，在 OPT-30B 上超过 MeZO 2.85 个百分点。
Conclusion: 用前向激活持续维护一个宽而低维激活的子空间，可以在相同前向评估预算下提升 ZO LLM 微调的下游表现，且代码已开源。

papers.title: Towards Reliable AI Data Scientists: Data Agents with Workflow Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for data-intensive work, yet reliable data analysis requires more than general-purpose reasoning and ad hoc tool augmentation. Data Agents, equipped with workflow harnesses, offer a promising paradigm for automating the end-to-end data science lifecycle. This paper examines Data Agents from a harness-centric perspective. First, we introduce a taxonomy of Data Agents and associated data environments, organizing the literature around five functional stages: perception, planning, execution, verification, and repair. Second, we analyze the key technical routes within each stage, identifying 15 distinct approaches ranging from data structure probing to data state reconstruction. Third, we identify four open reliability problems: inactive semantic calibration, missing clarification, missing experience transfer, and the missing verification-repair repository. These problems explain why silent failures can persist even when individual components function correctly, highlighting the need for rigorous workflow harnesses and shared reliability resources. Finally, we summarize the horizontal task families of Data Agents, examine their vertical application settings, and benchmarks for evaluation, while maintaining a companion repository at https://github.com/DEEP-PolyU/Awesome-Data-Agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 workflow harness 视角梳理 LLM Data Agent：按感知、规划、执行、验证、修复五个功能阶段建立分类法，归纳 15 条技术路线，并指出四个可靠性缺口（inactive semantic calibration、missing clarification、missing experience transfer、missing verification-repair repository），认为正是这些缺口使单个组件正常时仍出现 silent failure。
Motivation: LLM agent 已被用于数据密集型工作，但通用推理加临时工具拼装不足以保证可靠的数据分析，silent failure 会在组件各自正确时仍然持续。
Method: 以 harness 为中心对 Data Agent 文献做分类与技术路线分析：按五阶段组织 agent 与数据环境，逐阶段梳理 15 种方法（从 data structure probing 到 data state reconstruction），再归纳任务族、垂直场景与评测 benchmark，并维护 Awesome-Data-Agents 仓库。
Result: 产出为分类与问题清单：5 个功能阶段、15 条技术路线、4 个开放可靠性问题，以及任务族、应用场景与 benchmark 的梳理。
Conclusion: Data Agent 的可靠性问题源于工作流层面的 harness 与共享可靠性资源缺失，而非单个组件能力，需要严格的 workflow harness 和公共 verification-repair 资源。

papers.title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spatial Grafting 把冻结的空间重建特征绑定为以机器人为原点的度量空间 token，经 cross-attention 注入 flow-matching 动作专家，不改动宿主感知通路。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上嫁接后的 π0.5 干净/随机化场景分别达 94.0% 和 92.4%，超过 3D 条件策略 WAM4D 的 93.8% 和 89.9%；长时程 BEHAVIOR-1K 六项任务中五项超过 2025 挑战赛冠军，Q-score 最多高 0.47。
Motivation: 预训练机器人操作策略（VLA、WAM）把与交互相关的度量几何隐式化，而空间重建特征只描述局部形状、不说明相对机器人的位置；如何把这些几何特征交给预训练策略尚无定论。
Method: 提出轻量空间模块 Spatial Grafting：构造度量化、机器人相对的空间 token，通过 cross-attention 注入 flow-matching 动作专家，宿主感知通路与预训练权重保持冻结；同一套嫁接架构不做逐宿主重设计，覆盖两个 VLA、两个 WAM、四个仿真基准与三个单/双臂实机平台。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 双臂操作上嫁接提升全部宿主：π0.5 干净场景 +11.3% 至 94.0%，随机化场景 +15.6% 至 92.4%，均高于 WAM4D 的 93.8% 与 89.9%。BEHAVIOR-1K 双臂移动操作（按平均任务进度评分）六项任务中五项超过 2025 挑战赛冠军，Q-score 最多高出 0.47，并在双方共同报告的三项任务上平均超过地图条件空间策略。
Conclusion: 把重建几何以机器人相对度量 token 的形式嫁接到冻结的 flow-matching 动作专家，即可在不重训宿主的前提下跨 VLA/WAM 与仿真/实机提升操作成功率，且时程越长优势越大。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
papers.abstract_en: When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnswerMap 是一种免训练、黑盒的 VLM 视觉 rationale：把图像切成 K 行 K 列条带，逐条以 yes/no 相关性问题问冻结模型，行与列的 yes 后验做外积得到查询条件下的空间图，再在其上定义固定读出 R（期望、最大值等）直接产出定位等连续输出。在 4 个模型、3 种查询分布上，地图与模型自指位置的 AUC 为 0.85（attention 为 0.38），删除地图区域翻转 53% 的正确答案（attention 为 19%）。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 可解释性工具要么用模态不匹配的文本 rationale，要么依赖读出层过早、需要白盒访问的内部信号，且连续输出任务被迫绕道离散文本 token。
Method: 训练-free、任务无关的黑盒构造：图像切成 K 行与 K 列条带，每条单独与查询一起以 yes/no 相关性问题输入冻结模型，行、列 yes 后验取外积得空间图；在图上定义固定读出 R（如期望、最大值）导出连续输出。用两类检验验证忠实性：与模型自身生成的点比对，以及删除地图区域。
Result: 在 4 个模型、3 种查询分布上：地图与模型自指点的一致性 AUC 0.85，attention 为 0.38；删除地图区域使 53% 的正确答案被翻转，attention 只有 19%。三个读出的效用：最大值可在不生成的情况下标记幻觉物体；期望值在模型自身指点失败时仍正确定位；top-mass 区域裁剪回喂可修复模型一半的错误答案。
Conclusion: 从答案后验外积得到的空间图比 attention 更忠实于模型最终输出，并可作为绕开离散文本 token 的通用输出接口用于视觉任务。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model
papers.abstract_en: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for modern industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD). However, existing autoregressive SVG generation models are predominantly tailored for artistic creation and struggle to maintain the rigorous geometric fidelity and cross-view spatial alignment required for engineering drawings. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{DrawingsDreamer}, a unified Large Language Model (LLM)-driven framework for multi-view vector-based engineering drawings generation. By formulating the generation of multi-view engineering drawings purely as a sequence modeling task, we eliminate the need of raster image encoders. We propose a Streamlined Representation utilizing hierarchical postfix tokenization, which guides the model to establish local geometric coordinates before assigning semantic boundaries. Optimized via a progressive task-aware curriculum schedule, \textbf{DrawingsDreamer} effectively transitions from localized structural repair to macroscopic generation in a unified model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model achieves strong performance in both geometric fidelity and syntactic accuracy across diverse conditional and unconditional generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrawingsDreamer 把多视图工程图纸的 SVG 生成统一为纯序列建模任务，用分层后缀 tokenization 的 Streamlined Representation 先定局部几何坐标再赋语义边界，并以渐进式任务感知课程从局部结构修复过渡到宏观生成，从而免去光栅图像编码器。该模型在多种条件与无条件生成任务上同时取得较强的几何保真度与语法准确性。
Motivation: 现有自回归 SVG 生成模型主要面向艺术创作，难以满足工程图纸所需的严格几何精度与跨视图空间对齐，而工业 CAD 又依赖这类矢量图纸。
Method: 以 LLM 驱动的统一框架把多视图工程图纸生成表述为序列建模，不使用光栅图像编码器；提出 Streamlined Representation（分层后缀 tokenization），先建立局部几何坐标再分配语义边界；训练采用渐进式任务感知课程 (progressive task-aware curriculum schedule)，从局部结构修复过渡到宏观生成。
Result: 在多种条件与无条件生成任务上，统一模型在几何保真度 (geometric fidelity) 与语法准确性 (syntactic accuracy) 两方面均取得较强表现。
Conclusion: 纯序列建模配合分层后缀表示与渐进课程，可以在单一模型内同时覆盖工程图纸的局部修复与宏观生成，并守住几何与语法质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Disentangling Lung-Cancer CT/LDCT AI: A Systematic Evidence Map of Clinical Tasks, Evidence Chains, and Translational Gaps
papers.abstract_en: Artificial-intelligence studies using computed tomography (CT) for lung cancer are often broadly labelled "prediction" despite addressing clinically distinct tasks. We systematically mapped CT/low-dose CT (LDCT)-centered lung-cancer AI using five-database retrieval, full-text eligibility assessment, role-aware modality/omics extraction, clinical-task classification, and a Multi-Tier Evidence Graph (MTEG). The final corpus comprised 293 studies (2016-2026): 230 Detection, 8 future Risk-prediction, and 55 Other studies. Clinical variables (96.2%), 3D CT/LDCT (73.0%), and radiomics (63.5%) predominated, whereas external validation (29.0%), calibration (20.5%), decision-curve analysis (13.0%), longitudinal CT (17.7%), and saliency/attribution XAI (21.5%) were less frequent. The MTEG comprised 377 nodes and 3,444 edges; only 31 studies (10.6%) completed the six-tier substantive evidence chain, with greatest attrition at reasoning/explanation. Overall, the literature is detection-dominated, genuine future risk prediction remains uncommon, and complete translational evidence chains are rare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 2016–2026 年 CT/LDCT 肺癌 AI 文献做系统证据图谱：五个数据库检索、全文资格评估、按角色抽取模态/组学、临床任务分类并构建 Multi-Tier Evidence Graph (MTEG)。293 篇研究中 230 篇是 Detection、仅 8 篇为未来风险预测，只有 31 篇（10.6%）走完六层实质证据链，最大流失在推理/解释层。
Motivation: 肺癌 CT AI 研究普遍被笼统标为 prediction，但实际对应临床上截然不同的任务，且转化证据链是否完整缺乏系统梳理。
Method: 五数据库检索加全文资格评估，做角色感知的模态/组学抽取与临床任务分类，再构建含 377 节点、3,444 条边的 Multi-Tier Evidence Graph (MTEG) 追踪证据链逐层流失。
Result: 最终语料 293 篇（2016–2026）：Detection 230、未来风险预测 8、Other 55；临床变量 96.2%、3D CT/LDCT 73.0%、radiomics 63.5%；外部验证 29.0%、校准 20.5%、决策曲线分析 13.0%、纵向 CT 17.7%、saliency/attribution XAI 21.5%；MTEG 377 节点、3,444 边，仅 31 篇（10.6%）完成六层证据链，流失最大处在 reasoning/explanation。
Conclusion: 该文献以检测为主导，真正的未来风险预测罕见，完整转化证据链稀缺。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Scaling: How Model Capabilities Shape the Returns to Computation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents improve solutions through sustained interaction, execution, and task feedback. Scaling studies relate performance to resources and capabilities, yet how existing capabilities shape returns to extended interaction remains less understood. To address this gap, we analyze AutoLab and EdgeBench, two long-horizon benchmarks. We find that starting performance and subsequent growth are associated with different capabilities: within a task category, similar early scores can precede different later gains. To formalize this finding, we model capability-time scaling with category-specific logistic power laws shared across models. Fitted to early trajectories, these curves extrapolate the observed models' category-average scores to later computation. However, rising average scores mask narrowing improvement opportunities: later gains concentrate among fewer improving models. High final scores and continued improvement also have distinct capability profiles. Predicted mean gains estimate each model's fraction of improving tasks; averaging these estimates forecasts the average share of improving models. These uneven returns motivate deciding whether a specific run should continue. We therefore derive a continuation policy to save time and compute with limited score loss. The policy conditions growth predictions on the run's observed progress and weighs immediate and delayed gains against computation costs. In replay with training and price calibration based on other models' histories, the policy saves roughly one-third of full-run time, with relative score losses of 2.4% on AutoLab individual runs and 3.3% on EdgeBench published mean curves. Our repository is available at https://github.com/Chihaya-Anon-chan/long-horizon-scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文分析 AutoLab 与 EdgeBench 两个长时程 agent 基准，用按任务类别共享、跨模型统一的 logistic 幂律刻画能力-时间扩展：早期轨迹即可外推后期类别平均分，但平均分上升掩盖了改进机会收窄——后期增益集中在越来越少的模型上。据此导出的续跑策略按单次运行的已观测进展条件化增长预测，并权衡即时/延迟收益与算力成本，在回放实验中省下约三分之一完整运行时间，相对分数损失在 AutoLab 单次运行为 2.4%、EdgeBench 已发布平均曲线为 3.3%。
Motivation: 现有 scaling 研究把性能与资源、能力关联，但既有能力如何塑造延长交互带来的回报仍不清楚；且平均分上升会掩盖后期可改进空间在收窄，导致无法判断某次运行是否值得继续。
Method: 分析 AutoLab 与 EdgeBench 两个长时程基准，建立按任务类别共享、跨模型统一的 logistic 幂律形式的能力-时间扩展曲线，用早期轨迹拟合后外推后期计算下的类别平均分；再用预测的平均增益估计每个模型的改进任务占比，并据此推导续跑策略，该策略以单次运行的已观测进展条件化增长预测、权衡即时与延迟收益对算力成本。
Result: 回放实验中（训练与价格校准基于其他模型的历史），续跑策略节省约三分之一完整运行时间，相对分数损失为 AutoLab 单次运行 2.4%、EdgeBench 已发布平均曲线 3.3%；同一任务类别内相近的早期分数可对应截然不同的后期增益，高最终分与持续改进对应不同的能力画像。
Conclusion: 长时程扩展的回报不均匀且可预测：早期轨迹足以外推后期表现，而按单次运行进展条件化的续跑策略能在损失很小分数的前提下省下大量时间与算力。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: 分析 AutoLab 与 EdgeBench 两个长时程基准，建立按任务类别共享、跨模型统一的 logistic 幂律形式的能力-时间扩展曲线，用早期轨迹拟合后外推后期计算下的类别平均分；再用预测的平均增益估计每个模型的改进任务占比，并据此推导续跑策略，该策略以单次运行的已观测进展条件化增长预测、权衡即时与延迟收益对算力成本。
summary_sections.result: 回放实验中（训练与价格校准基于其他模型的历史），续跑策略节省约三分之一完整运行时间，相对分数损失为 AutoLab 单次运行 2.4%、EdgeBench 已发布平均曲线 3.3%；同一任务类别内相近的早期分数可对应截然不同的后期增益，高最终分与持续改进对应不同的能力画像。
summary_sections.conclusion: 长时程扩展的回报不均匀且可预测：早期轨迹足以外推后期表现，而按单次运行进展条件化的续跑策略能在损失很小分数的前提下省下大量时间与算力。

papers.title: EP-Mem: Elastic Privacy Memory for Social Relationship-Aware LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents face critical privacy risks when acting as delegates in human-agent-human communication. To prevent such breaches, agents must understand users' social relationships and adhere to context-dependent social information disclosure boundaries. Current studies on agent memory privacy focus on instantaneous interactions, leaving the long-term relational disclosure problem unexplored. In this paper, we propose EP-Mem, an Elastic Privacy Memory architecture that reframes privacy as user-owned boundary control across social roles. EP-Mem introduces (1) token-level memory driven by user-configurable a privacy policy that stratifies persons and events, combining domain-level default circulation rules with fact-level whitelist/blacklist exceptions; and (2) a pluggable sidecar with a privacy engine that aligns disclosure controls with memory across summary, detail, and boundary granularities, enforced throughout generation, storage, and retrieval. We construct EP-Bench, to our knowledge the first long-term multi-party benchmark with cross-session correlated events for policy-conditioned relational disclosure. Experiments show that EP-Mem achieves 94.0% privacy classification accuracy, improves disclosure-permission judgment from 22% to 68%, and reduces privacy leakage by 75.6%, while maintaining retrieval performance and cross-benchmark generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EP-Mem 把 LLM agent 的隐私问题重构为用户拥有的社交关系边界控制，用 token 级记忆加可插拔隐私 sidecar 在生成、存储、检索全链路执行披露规则。在自建的长期多方基准 EP-Bench 上，隐私分类准确率达 94.0%，披露许可判断从 22% 提升到 68%，隐私泄露下降 75.6%，同时保持检索性能与跨基准泛化。
Motivation: LLM agent 作为人-机-人通信代理时会越过社交关系的语境化披露边界；现有 agent 记忆隐私研究只处理单次瞬时交互，长期关系型披露问题尚无方案。
Method: EP-Mem 含两部分：token 级记忆由用户可配置隐私策略驱动，该策略对人和事件分层，结合领域级默认流通规则与事实级白名单/黑名单例外；可插拔 sidecar 内置隐私引擎，在 summary、detail、boundary 三种粒度上对齐披露控制与记忆，并贯穿生成、存储、检索执行。评测用自建 EP-Bench——据作者所知首个含跨会话关联事件的长期多方基准，用于策略条件化的关系披露。
Result: 在 EP-Bench 上 EP-Mem 隐私分类准确率 94.0%，披露许可判断从 22% 提高到 68%，隐私泄露减少 75.6%，并保持检索性能与跨基准泛化。
Conclusion: 把隐私当作用户可控的社交边界并贯穿记忆全生命周期执行，能在长期多方交互中大幅压低泄露，同时不牺牲检索与泛化。

papers.title: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. Experiments show that Braco forms the favorable empirical accuracy-efficiency frontier under $23\times$--$64\times$ compression and remains competitive at $144\times$, reaching 95.2% accuracy while reducing prefill FLOPs by 84.2%--86.7% relative to the uncompressed upper bound. Against prior methods, Braco matches or improves accuracy while achieving up to approximately 36% end-to-end speedup and using $16.6\times$/$78.8\times$ lower compressor latency/FLOPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Braco 把视觉 token 压缩拆成基变换与结构截断（可压缩性）和坐标组织（可学习性）两个统一泛函目标，据此设计四步轻量 coder：变换基截断、输入无关的基-坐标嵌入、预算相关的正交重参数化，以及轻量池化得到的学习式空间残差 token。在 23×–64× 压缩下形成最优精度-效率前沿，144× 时仍达 95.2% 精度、prefill FLOPs 相对未压缩上界降 84.2%–86.7%，端到端最高约 36% 加速。
Motivation: 极端压缩预算下 token 剪枝会破坏视觉 grounding，而学习式 resampler 又增加参数量、注意力开销与训练复杂度，两者都难以同时满足效率与对齐。
Method: 以 token parameterization 视角形式化 compressibility 与 learnability 两个耦合目标为统一泛函；Braco 四步 coder 依次做 transform-basis truncation、输入无关 basis-coordinate embeddings、budget-dependent 正交重参数化，再叠加轻量池化的 learned spatial residual tokens。
Result: 在 23×–64× 压缩区间形成经验精度-效率前沿，144× 时精度 95.2%，prefill FLOPs 相对未压缩上界减少 84.2%–86.7%；对比既有方法精度持平或更优，端到端最高约 36% 加速，压缩器延迟/FLOPs 分别低 16.6×/78.8×。
Conclusion: 把压缩拆成可压缩性与可学习性两个目标并联合优化，可以在极端预算下保住视觉 grounding，同时把压缩器本身做轻。

papers.title: Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/TD-LTTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling (TD-LTTS)：在推理时优化一段短的隐状态前缀，并把视觉侧反馈路由到对图像敏感的 token、把推理反馈路由到高熵 token，两类都不选中的 token 由 anchor 正则约束。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 InternVL3.5-8B 的感知与推理基准上，相对 CoT 分别提升宏平均准确率 +2.57 与 +1.51，并在相同解码候选预算下超过输出空间的 test-time scaling 基线。
Motivation: 现有 latent test-time scaling 对所有可编辑隐 token 施加同一个标量奖励，忽略多模态生成中 token 角色差异：有的对视觉证据敏感，有的对应不确定的推理决策。
Method: 从初始生成轨迹出发，优化一段短的隐状态前缀 (hidden-state prefix)；用双路路由把感知侧视觉反馈导向图像敏感 token、把推理反馈导向高熵 token，未被任一路选中的 token 由 anchor 正则器约束，全程在隐空间而非输出空间做 refinement。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上宏平均准确率相对 CoT 提升 +2.57，在 InternVL3.5-8B 上提升 +1.51；覆盖感知与推理两类基准，并在匹配的解码候选预算下优于强输出空间 test-time scaling 基线。
Conclusion: 按 token 角色拆分隐状态 refinement 的反馈路由，能在固定候选预算下比全局标量奖励和输出空间 test-time scaling 更有效地提升多模态大模型推理准确率。

papers.title: Generative AI-Based Data Augmentation for Oral Lesion Classification: The PhotoMOCI Dataset and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets. To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology. Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers. Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs). Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance. Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively. Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出口腔癌图像分类的合成数据增强筛选机制 Synthetic Image Filter (SIF)，用 Synthetic Proxy Classifier 与 Synthetic Image Detector 两个辅助模型只保留既真实又代表目标类的生成样本。在 PhotoMOCI 与 KOCD 上，SIF 筛选后的最佳设置对传统增强的准确率提升在所有情形下均为正：ResNet50 与 ViT 分别 +1.73%/+2.35%（PhotoMOCI）和 +2.38%/+2.08%（KOCD）。
Motivation: 口腔癌摄影筛查缺少高质量标注数据集，而直接用生成式 AI（GAN、Diffusion Models）做数据增强反而可能拉低分类器性能。
Method: 发布 PhotoMOCI 数据集并做多分类器增强基准，对比传统增强与 GAN、Diffusion Models；提出 SIF，用 Synthetic Proxy Classifier 保证样本代表目标类、用 Synthetic Image Detector 保证样本真实，只保留高价值合成图参与训练。
Result: SIF 筛选后的最佳设置在所有评估数据集与分类器上均提升准确率：PhotoMOCI 上 ResNet50 +1.73%、ViT +2.35%；KOCD 上 ResNet50 +2.38%、ViT +2.08%。直接套用生成式增强可能带来性能下降。
Conclusion: 合成增强必须同时校验真实性和类判别特征代表性，才能过滤掉训练中误导分类器的样本并稳定带来准确率增益。

papers.title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SignFLIP 用对称架构加阶段式训练把文本到手语的翻译 (SLT) 与手语到文本的生成 (SLG) 统一进一个 LLM 框架：先做 pre-alignment 塑造共享表示，SLT 训练后的表示再反哺 SLG。在多个基准上，该统一模型相对任务专用模型在翻译与生成两侧都具竞争力，并可迁移到手语识别 (SLR)。
Motivation: SLT 与 SLG 被当作孤立任务建模，或只在有限数据集上验证，文本与手语两种模态之间的双向对齐学不充分。
Method: 以 LLM 为中心的对称架构，配合基于大规模数据的阶段式训练策略：先 pre-alignment 建立共享 sign–text 表示，再依次做 SLT，SLT 适配后的表示继续用于 SLG，实现文本与手语的双向映射。
Result: 在多个基准上，SignFLIP 在翻译与生成两类任务上相对任务专用模型 (task-specific models) 表现具竞争力，并对任务外的手语识别 (sign language recognition) 表现出强迁移能力。
Conclusion: 翻译与生成不必分开建模：共享的对称表示配合阶段式训练即可同时覆盖双向任务，并把能力带到手语识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs
papers.abstract_en: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TANGO 为 masked-diffusion 语言模型设计 token 对水印：用密钥把词表切成颜色类，新 token 的偏置颜色由密钥与邻近已解码 token 的颜色共同决定，使偏好颜色随位置变化。在两个 masked-diffusion 模型上，它几乎检出全部未编辑水印文本与大部分编辑文本，且针对固定 green list 的词频伪造攻击失效。
Motivation: 现有文本水印默认自左向右生成，token 依赖前文上下文，而 diffusion 模型中前文可能仍被 mask；固定 green list 虽无需上下文，却在所有位置偏好同一批 token，导致词频可被攻击者比对并伪造出能通过检测的文本。
Method: TANGO 用密钥将词表划分为颜色类 (color classes)，新 token 被偏向由密钥与邻近已解码 token 颜色共同决定的颜色，水印因此嵌入 token 对；检测只需文本与密钥，不依赖任何 unmasking 顺序。
Result: 在两个 masked-diffusion 模型上，TANGO 检出几乎全部未编辑水印文本与大部分编辑文本；针对固定 green list 的词频攻击对其失效，token 分布比固定 green list 更接近未加水印文本。
Conclusion: 把水印键控到邻近已解码 token 而非固定 green list，可在不假设生成顺序的前提下同时保住检测率并抵御词频伪造攻击。

papers.title: Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Pretraining for Relational Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Relational deep learning models database rows and foreign-key links as a heterogeneous graph for prediction from record attributes and relational context. These graphs contain two distinct temporal signals: record age changes with the prediction cutoff, while intervals between observed records remain fixed. Prior work often treats time as a single signal or studies temporal representation and pretraining separately. We investigate how explicitly encoding both signals affects temporal pretraining for downstream tasks. Our framework combines Multi-scale Time Encoding, which captures record age using learnable time scales and type-specific projections, with Rotary Time Encoding, which represents signed inter-record intervals through rotary transformations during graph propagation. We pair these encodings with three self-supervised objectives: historical relation recovery, horizon-aware future relation activity prediction, and temporal subgraph contrast. All inputs respect their observation cutoffs. Pretraining proceeds in two stages: subgraph contrast first learns neighborhood representations, followed by refinement through either relation recovery or future activity prediction. We evaluate on five RelBench datasets across 11 classification and regression tasks using heterogeneous GNN and graph Transformer backbones. With both encodings, the best evaluated staged schedules improve over supervised training with the same encodings by 3.02% and 1.06% on the two backbones, respectively, and over controls without pretraining or either encoding by 3.24% and 2.37%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向关系深度学习 (relational deep learning) 的时序异构图预训练：把记录年龄与记录间间隔两种时间信号分别用 Multi-scale Time Encoding 和 Rotary Time Encoding 编码，配合三个自监督目标做两阶段预训练。在 RelBench 五个数据集的 11 个分类与回归任务上，两种编码齐备时最优分阶段调度相对同编码监督训练在两种 backbone 上分别提升 3.02% 与 1.06%，相对无预训练或缺任一编码的对照提升 3.24% 与 2.37%。
Motivation: 关系深度学习把数据库行与外键连成异构图，图中同时存在随预测截止时间变化的记录年龄和固定不变的记录间间隔；既往工作把时间当作单一信号，或把时序表示与预训练分开研究。
Method: Multi-scale Time Encoding 用可学习时间尺度与按类型投影捕捉记录年龄，Rotary Time Encoding 用 rotary 变换在图传播中表示带符号的记录间间隔；配三个自监督目标——历史关系恢复、horizon 感知的未来关系活跃度预测、时序子图对比，全部输入遵守观测截止时间。预训练分两阶段：先子图对比学邻域表示，再由关系恢复或未来活跃度预测精调，backbone 用异构 GNN 与 graph Transformer。
Result: 在 RelBench 五个数据集、11 个分类与回归任务上，两种编码齐备时最优分阶段调度相对同编码监督训练在两种 backbone 上分别提升 3.02% 与 1.06%，相对无预训练或缺任一编码的对照分别提升 3.24% 与 2.37%。
Conclusion: 把记录年龄与记录间间隔作为两个独立信号显式编码，并与自监督预训练结合，能在 RelBench 下游任务上稳定优于同编码的监督训练与无预训练对照。

papers.title: A Hierarchy of Entropy-Shapley Games for Multivariate Predictive Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Modern probabilistic machine learning models increasingly produce multivariate outputs with complex dependence structure, from multi-step time-series forecasts to sample path predictions. Understanding which input features drive the predictive uncertainty is important for risk-aware decisions, model diagnostics, and deciding whether the uncertainty should be mitigated or hedged against. This attribution problem requires a choice of how dependencies between output components are treated. Existing approaches reduce the output to a scalar through aggregation or projection before attribution, thereby obscuring whether features affect marginal uncertainty, dependence structure, or both, while component-wise analyses can miss dependence effects entirely. We close this gap by introducing a hierarchy of three entropy-based Shapley games that make this output-side choice explicit for any ordered multivariate outcome, ranging from per-component marginal entropy to fully joint entropy. The hierarchy isolates a cross-component attribution term that captures how each feature shifts the dependence between output components, a quantity invisible to component-wise methods. We establish a chain-rule decomposition of the joint attribution and characterize the cross-component term through conditional total correlation, providing both closed-form and sample-based estimators. Finally, we demonstrate how the framework captures differences in learned joint structure across probabilistic models from distributional regression to a zero-shot time series foundation model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三层基于熵的 Shapley 博弈层级，把多变量预测不确定性的归因选择显式化：从逐分量边缘熵到完全联合熵，并分离出刻画特征如何改变输出分量间依赖结构的跨分量归因项。该跨分量项可用条件 total correlation 刻画，联合归因满足链式法则分解，且给出闭式与基于样本的两类估计量。
Motivation: 多变量输出的不确定性归因要么先用聚合/投影压成标量，掩盖特征影响的是边缘不确定性还是依赖结构；要么逐分量分析，完全漏掉依赖效应。
Method: 构建三个基于熵的 Shapley 博弈组成的层级，适用于任意有序多变量结果；建立联合归因的链式法则分解，用条件 total correlation 刻画跨分量项，并给出闭式与样本估计量；在从 distributional regression 到零样本时间序列 foundation model 的多类概率模型上展示学到的联合结构差异。
Result: 给出联合归因的链式法则分解与跨分量项的条件 total correlation 刻画，配套闭式和基于样本的估计量；在 distributional regression 到零样本时间序列 foundation model 的对比中展示不同概率模型学到的联合结构差异。
Conclusion: 多变量预测不确定性的归因必须显式选择输出侧依赖处理方式，跨分量归因项是逐分量方法看不见的独立信息。

papers.title: ASCT: Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Terminal utility evaluates a complete agentic workflow, but learning requires credit for the decisions within it. We introduce Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees (ASCT), a framework that turns training-time multi-step search into local action credit. At actor-visited states, an auxiliary tree evaluates alternative legal actions from the same recoverable prefix. Its action-value table is centered by the frozen actor's probabilities and supplies credit for PPO on actor-sampled trajectories. This protocol connects counterfactual evaluation to policy learning while deploying the actor alone. Uniform, UCT, and cost-aware AgentUCT instantiate the framework. On HotpotQA agentic retrieval-augmented generation, all three improve mean held-out utility over trajectory-return PPO and workflow-adapted VinePPO. Across three seeds, ASCT-AgentUCT reaches 0.6187 utility versus 0.5939 for VinePPO, with gains in answer F1 and execution cost, and uses 50.3% fewer recorded auxiliary Qwen tokens. Transfer and component-description studies examine the learned policies beyond the training setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASCT 把训练期多步搜索转成对智能体动作的局部信用分配：在 actor 访问过的状态上用反事实树评估同一可恢复前缀下的其他合法动作，其动作价值表按冻结 actor 的概率做中心化，再为 PPO 提供信用。在 HotpotQA 智能体 RAG 上，ASCT-AgentUCT 三种 seed 平均效用 0.6187，高于 VinePPO 的 0.5939，且辅助 Qwen token 记录量少 50.3%。
Motivation: 终端效用只评价完整工作流，无法把功劳/过错归到工作流内部的具体决策上，导致多步智能体策略的信用分配困难。
Method: 在 actor 访问过的状态上，从同一可恢复前缀展开辅助反事实树评估其他合法动作，动作价值表以冻结 actor 的概率为中心化，为 actor 采样轨迹上的 PPO 提供信用；框架实例化为 Uniform、UCT 与 cost-aware AgentUCT 三种搜索策略，部署时只用 actor。
Result: 在 HotpotQA 智能体检索增强生成 (RAG) 上，三种实例化都比 trajectory-return PPO 与 workflow-adapted VinePPO 提升平均留出效用；三个 seed 下 ASCT-AgentUCT 效用 0.6187 对 VinePPO 0.5939，答案 F1 与执行成本同时改善，记录的辅助 Qwen token 少 50.3%。
Conclusion: 把反事实评估接到策略学习上，可以在只部署 actor 的同时用更少的辅助 token 换来更高的工作流效用与更低的执行成本。
