papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Cardiac Model Personalisation from Ultrafast Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac model personalisation requires inferring mechanical parameters that are not directly measurable in vivo. Ultrafast ultrasound shear wave elastography (SWE) enables non-invasive tracking of myocardial stiffness dynamics over the cardiac cycle, providing a target for personalisation. However, mapping these observations to subject specific model parameters remains ill-posed, as multiple parameter sets can reproduce the same stiffness dynamics. We formulate SWE-informed personalisation as a statistical inference problem using simulation-based inference (SBI). Using a subject-adapted 0D cardiovascular model and neural posterior estimation, we estimate model-conditional posterior distributions over active stiffness scale k0, contraction rate kATP, and relaxation rate kSR, conditioned on SWE-derived curve features and subject specific context. Among six healthy volunteers, four passed objective prior-support diagnostics and were retained for quantitative posterior analysis. Curve-level RMSE against the observed SWE target decreased from 12.61 $\pm$ 5.55 kPa for the prior predictive median to 1.14 $\pm$ 0.38 kPa for the posterior predictive median, an 89.7 $\pm$ 4.2% reduction. Posterior analysis revealed parameter-specific uncertainty, k0-kATP compensation, weaker constraint of kSR, and the importance of prior-predictive diagnostics for assessing whether each subject is represented within the modelled SWE feature space. These results support SBI for uncertainty aware SWE-based personalisation, while identifying prior support and forward-model adequacy as key diagnostics.
papers.journal_ref: Statistical Atlases and Computational Modelling of the Heart (STACOM), MICCAI 2026., Sep 2026, Strasbourg, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把超声剪切波弹性成像 (SWE) 心肌硬度曲线到 0D 心血管模型参数的映射写成 simulation-based inference (SBI) 推断问题，用神经后验估计给出参数后验分布而非单点解。6 名健康志愿者中 4 名通过先验支持诊断，曲线级 RMSE 从先验预测中位数 12.61 ± 5.55 kPa 降到后验预测中位数 1.14 ± 0.38 kPa，降幅 89.7 ± 4.2%。
Motivation: 心肌力学参数无法在体直接测量，SWE 观测到的硬度动态到模型参数的映射是不适定的：多组参数可复现同一硬度曲线，点估计无法表达这种不确定性。
Method: 以受试者适配的 0D 心血管模型为前向模型，用 neural posterior estimation 做 SBI，条件是 SWE 曲线特征与受试者上下文，估计主动硬度尺度 k0、收缩率 kATP、松弛率 kSR 的模型条件后验分布；用先验预测诊断筛选受试者。
Result: 6 名健康志愿者中 4 名通过客观先验支持诊断并进入定量后验分析；曲线级 RMSE 对 SWE 观测目标从 12.61 ± 5.55 kPa（先验预测中位数）降至 1.14 ± 0.38 kPa（后验预测中位数），降低 89.7 ± 4.2%。后验显示参数特异的不确定性：k0-kATP 存在补偿，kSR 约束更弱。

papers.title: Adversarial Consistency-Guided Representation Learning for Multi-view Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view clustering aims to capture cross-view consistency while exploiting view-specific information. However, shared representations learned to capture cross-view consistency may still retain view-identifying information, potentially compromising the consistency of cross-view clustering structures. To address this issue, we propose ACGRL, an adversarial consistency-guided representation learning framework for multi-view clustering. ACGRL employs a gradient-reversal view discriminator to reduce view identifiability and obtain invariant reference representations. These representations are then frozen to provide fixed references for disentangling view-specific information from cross-view common information in the subsequent learning stage. The fixed reference representations are concatenated with the learned view-specific representations for reconstruction and clustering, with cross-view cluster alignment encouraging consistent clustering assignments. Experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior clustering performance of ACGRL compared with representative multi-view clustering methods.

TL;DR: 多视图聚类中，为捕捉跨视图一致性而学的共享表示仍残留视图可识别信息，会破坏跨视图聚类结构的一致性。ACGRL 用梯度反转 (gradient reversal) 视图判别器压低视图可识别性、得到不变参考表示并将其冻结，再与学到的视图特定表示拼接做重建与聚类，配合跨视图簇对齐约束。在四个基准数据集上，其聚类性能优于代表性多视图聚类方法。

Method: ACGRL 框架：梯度反转视图判别器降低视图可识别性以获得不变参考表示；将该参考表示冻结，作为后续阶段解耦视图特定信息与跨视图公共信息的固定参照；冻结的参考表示与学到的视图特定表示拼接后用于重建与聚类，并加入跨视图簇对齐 (cross-view cluster alignment) 以鼓励一致的聚类分配。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验中，ACGRL 的聚类性能优于代表性多视图聚类方法（摘要未列出具体指标数值）。

papers.title: From UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-T: Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands. We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of 0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024^2 analysis (21.8x speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient knowledge transfer.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2027)

papers.title: From Normative Frameworks to Alignment Data: Constructing and Evaluating SFT and Preference Data
papers.abstract_en: Aligning language models with a specified normative framework requires translating abstract principles into concrete examples and preference signals from which models can learn. We present an expert-driven methodology for constructing such alignment data and apply it to a normative framework grounded in Islamic ethical, theological, and jurisprudential traditions. Over approximately one year, seven domain experts systematically probed language models to identify alignment deficiencies, curated desired responses, and constructed preference pairs from model outputs and expert judgments. The resulting Arabic-English datasets contain approximately 2.8K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples and 5.4K preference pairs spanning a broad range of normative domains. We evaluate the datasets through controlled post-training experiments comparing a Baseline model with models incorporating the curated SFT data alone and both the SFT and preference data. In blind expert evaluation on 150 separately constructed prompts, the model trained with the curated SFT data was preferred over the Baseline in 51.3% of assessor judgments, compared with 14.4% in the opposite direction (p < .001 at the prompt level). Adding the preference data resulted in a smaller difference, with the model trained with both datasets preferred over the SFT model in 28.0% of judgments versus 20.9% in the opposite direction; this difference was not statistically significant at the prompt level (p = .166). Standard Arabic and English benchmarks show no broad degradation in general-purpose capabilities. These results demonstrate how expert-defined normative principles can be systematically operationalized into alignment data and evaluated through controlled model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由领域专家驱动的对齐数据构建方法：把规范性原则（伊斯兰伦理、教义与教法学）系统转成 SFT 样本与偏好对，并用受控后训练实验检验其效果。在 150 条盲评 prompt 上，含策展 SFT 数据的模型以 51.3% 对 14.4% 胜过 Baseline（prompt 级 p < .001）；再加偏好数据后优势缩小为 28.0% 对 20.9%，prompt 级不显著（p = .166）。
Motivation: 把抽象规范性原则转成模型可学的具体样本与偏好信号缺少系统方法，尤其在非西方伦理传统上。
Method: 七位领域专家历时约一年系统探测语言模型以定位对齐缺陷，人工撰写期望回复，并基于模型输出与专家判断构造偏好对，产出阿拉伯语-英语数据集：约 2.8K SFT 样本与 5.4K 偏好对。评估采用受控后训练，对比 Baseline、仅加 SFT、SFT 加偏好三种设置。
Result: 150 条独立构造 prompt 的盲评中，SFT 模型胜 Baseline 为 51.3% 对 14.4%（prompt 级 p < .001）；SFT+偏好模型对 SFT 模型为 28.0% 对 20.9%（p = .166，不显著）。标准阿拉伯语与英语基准显示通用能力无广泛退化。
Conclusion: 专家定义的规范性原则可被系统化落地为对齐数据并用受控训练检验；SFT 数据带来显著提升，追加偏好数据的增益在 prompt 级不显著。

papers.title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCAT 是带结构化循环记忆的语言条件机器人操作策略：Mamba-2 与一层因果注意力构成记忆体，flow-matching Transformer 解码器在每个 block 内用独立 cross-attention 读取当前与历史表征。LIBERO 平均成功率 95.3%，RMBench 62.4%，九项任务中六项最优或并列最优；三项真机任务（空间回忆、事件计数、间隔计时）最佳变体平均 66.7%，最强短历史基线仅 8.3%。消融显示观测编码器与逐 block 记忆条件缺一不可，且计时/计数上 additive 更新最好、空间回忆上 delta-rule 最好。
Motivation: 依赖记忆的操作要求机器人用当前传感器已拿不到的信息决策（早期视觉线索、任务进度、重复事件计数、流逝时间），而短历史策略在这些任务上失效。
Method: 指令条件编码器从当前观测提特征；循环记忆用 Mamba-2 层加一层因果注意力整合观测流；flow-matching Transformer 解码器在每个 block 内以独立 cross-attention 分别读取当前与历史表征。在 LIBERO、RMBench 与三项真机任务上做受控消融，比较不同序列更新规则（additive、delta-rule）作为机器人记忆的表现。
Result: LIBERO 平均成功率 95.3%，RMBench 62.4%，九项任务中六项取得最优或并列最优；三项真机任务（空间回忆、事件计数、间隔计时）最佳 ReCAT 变体平均成功率 66.7%，最强短历史基线 8.3%。消融表明观测编码器与逐 block 记忆条件对这一性能必需；additive 更新在计数与计时上观测成功率最高，delta-rule 更新在空间回忆上最高。
Conclusion: 结构化循环记忆加逐 block 历史条件能让语言条件策略在传感器已失效的信息上做决策，而序列建模中的高效更新规则在机器人记忆里表现分工不同，需按任务类型选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Alignment Games: A Framework for Conceptual Repair in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: The meaning of a concept in use is shaped by the situation, task, goals, and prior knowledge. For example, a request to make a poster "visually appealing for a five-year-old" might evoke bright colors and cartoon imagery for one collaborator, but less text, bold shapes, and visual simplicity for another. We call such task-relevant differences conceptual misalignment. We introduce Alignment Games, a framework for making these differences visible and repairable during human-AI interaction. Drawing on theories of situated conceptualization, we characterize task-specific conceptual frames in terms of relevant attributes, values, relations, constraints, and priorities. We then define alignment moves that intervene on the situation, the reasoning used to interpret it, or the resulting frame. Through examples from educational content generation, creative coding, and argumentative writing, we show how these moves can be composed into repair sequences and derive design principles for supporting task-sufficient conceptual alignment at runtime.

papers.title: GAC-PINN: Geometry-Adaptive and Constraint-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: For systems with steep gradients, sharp interfaces, or severe spatio-temporal coupling, Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) suffer from spectral bias, geometric inflexibility, and boundary constraint conflicts, which undermine accuracy and convergence. To overcome these issues, we propose a geometry-adaptive and constraint-enhanced PINN (GAC-PINN). The framework comprises four components: a gradient-driven adaptive grid mapping (AGM) for diffeomorphic point concentration with Jacobian regularization, an adaptive bandwidth hard-constraint ansatz with spatially-varying boundary transition widths, a Gaussian Fourier feature mapping as a spectral preconditioner to further enhance high-wavenumber representation, and an operator-aware router that automatically selects the appropriate hard-constraint construction based on whether the governing PDE contains temporal derivatives. An AGM callback mechanism and a three-stage training strategy ensure stable coordination. Benchmarks including the viscous Burgers equation, a sharp-peaked 2D Poisson problem, and the Allen-Cahn phase-transition equation show that GAC-PINN attains relative (L^2) errors of ((1.747\pm 0.450)\times 10^{-4}), ((2.868\pm 0.947)\times 10^{-5}), and ((1.756 \pm 0.712)\times 10^{-3}), respectively, consistently outperforming the baselines. Ablation studies further reveal that AGM alone yields a substantially lower error than residual-based adaptive refinement (RAR), while RAR becomes beneficial only when combined with FFM, demonstrating a context-dependent module interaction. Convergence analysis verifies rapid error reduction and saturation with increasing resolution, establishing a practical adaptive framework for high-fidelity simulation of problems with localized sharp features in applied mechanics and computational physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAC-PINN 用梯度驱动的自适应网格映射 (AGM)、带空间变化边界过渡宽度的硬约束 ansatz、Gaussian Fourier 特征映射 (FFM) 与按 PDE 是否含时间项选约束构造的 operator-aware router，缓解陡梯度与尖锐界面问题的谱偏置和边界约束冲突。在 viscous Burgers、尖峰 2D Poisson 与 Allen-Cahn 上相对 L2 误差分别达 (1.747±0.450)×10⁻⁴、(2.868±0.947)×10⁻⁵、(1.756±0.712)×10⁻³，一致优于基线；消融显示 AGM 单独使用误差显著低于 RAR，RAR 只有与 FFM 组合才有利。
Motivation: 对具有陡梯度、尖锐界面或强时空耦合的 PDE，PINN 存在谱偏置、几何不灵活与边界约束冲突，导致精度与收敛受损。
Method: 四个组件：梯度驱动的自适应网格映射 (AGM) 做微分同胚点加密并加 Jacobian 正则；带空间变化边界过渡宽度的自适应带宽硬约束 ansatz；Gaussian Fourier 特征映射 (FFM) 作谱预条件器增强高波数表示；operator-aware router 依控制 PDE 是否含时间导数选择硬约束构造。另有 AGM 回调机制与三阶段训练策略协调各模块。
Result: viscous Burgers 相对 L2 误差 (1.747±0.450)×10⁻⁴，尖峰 2D Poisson (2.868±0.947)×10⁻⁵，Allen-Cahn (1.756±0.712)×10⁻³，一致优于基线。消融显示 AGM 单独误差远低于 residual-based adaptive refinement (RAR)，RAR 仅与 FFM 组合时才有利；收敛分析显示误差快速下降并在分辨率提高后趋于饱和。
Conclusion: AGM、硬约束 ansatz 与 FFM 的作用是上下文相关的，需按模块组合而非单独叠加来配置；该框架面向应用力学与计算物理中含局部尖锐特征问题的高保真仿真。

papers.title: CarveMix-RC: Addressing Rare-Class Imbalance Through Lesion-Aware Synthetic Augmentation for Brain Metastasis Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of post-treatment brain metastases is essential for treatment planning, longitudinal disease monitoring, and quantitative assessment of therapeutic response. The BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 challenge introduces a clinically relevant segmentation problem involving four anatomically distinct tumor subregions: non-enhancing tumor core (NETC), surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity (SNFH), enhancing tumor (ET), and the resection cavity (RC). Among these, RC segmentation is particularly challenging because of its low prevalence, heterogeneous postoperative appearance, and lesion-wise evaluation protocol, leading conventional segmentation networks to prioritize dominant tumor classes during optimization. The proposed nnU-Net-based framework explicitly addresses RC segmentation through four complementary components: (i) RC-weighted Dice and Cross-Entropy optimization to alleviate class imbalance, (ii) anatomically consistent cavity augmentation to increase the diversity of postoperative cavity appearances, (iii) a residual encoder architecture for enhanced multi-scale feature learning, and (iv) lesion-aware morphological post-processing to suppress false-positive cavity predictions while preserving anatomically plausible structures. The framework is evaluated on the BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 online validation benchmark. Among the evaluated configurations, the ensemble model (Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix) achieves the best performance, with lesion-wise Dice scores of 0.732, 0.752, 0.708, and 0.575 and corresponding NSD scores of 0.794, 0.798, 0.727, and 0.474 for ET, TC, WT, and RC, respectively. These experimental results show that integrating RC-aware optimization, anatomically consistent augmentation, and lesion-aware post-processing provides an effective strategy for improving rare resection cavity segmentation in post-treatment brain metastases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 中低发生率的切除腔 (RC) 分割，提出基于 nnU-Net 的 CarveMix-RC 框架，用 RC 加权 Dice+CE、解剖一致的空腔增强、残差编码器与病灶感知形态学后处理共同压制类别不平衡。在线验证集上集成模型 RC 的 lesion-wise Dice 达 0.575、NSD 0.474，ET/TC/WT 的 Dice 分别为 0.732/0.752/0.708。
Motivation: 术后 RC 在四类子区域中占比低、外观异质，且按病灶级 (lesion-wise) 评测，常规分割网络在优化时会偏向主导肿瘤类，导致 RC 漏检与假阳性。
Method: 以 nnU-Net 为基座，加入四个组件：RC 加权的 Dice 与 Cross-Entropy 损失缓解类别不平衡；解剖一致的空腔增强 (anatomically consistent cavity augmentation) 扩充术后腔外观；残差编码器 (residual encoder) 提升多尺度特征学习；病灶感知形态学后处理抑制假阳性空腔预测。最优配置为 Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix 的集成。
Result: 在 BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 在线验证基准上，集成模型的 lesion-wise Dice 为 ET 0.732、TC 0.752、WT 0.708、RC 0.575，对应 NSD 为 0.794、0.798、0.727、0.474。
Conclusion: 把 RC 加权优化、解剖一致增强与病灶感知后处理整合进 nnU-Net，是改善术后罕见切除腔分割的有效策略；RC 仍是四类中分数最低的一类 (Dice 0.575、NSD 0.474)。

papers.title: ConRAG: Lightweight inference of multi-hop relations
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how two entities are connected often requires tracing multi-hop relations across documents to identify intermediate entities and supporting evidence that explain a connection. This is a task that appears frequently in scientific research and other knowledge-intensive analyses. We formalise this setting as multi-hop relation inference: given two known endpoint entities, we aim to recover the bridge entities and evidence-grounded reasoning chains that connect them across a document corpus, and to generate an explanation grounded in the retrieved evidence. Existing multi-hop RAG systems typically seek an unknown answer entity rather than explicitly recovering the connection between two known endpoints and graph-based approaches often rely on costly LLM-extracted knowledge graphs that limit scalability to large document collections. We introduce ConRAG, which builds a lightweight entity-document graph from entity co-occurrence and LLM-based entity filtering. Its connective retrieval infers and semantically ranks paths between two endpoints. On MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA, ConRAG consistently improves bridge entity and reasoning chain recovery over strong RAG baselines, while reducing graph-indexing token cost by up to roughly 1.5 orders of magnitude. Our results show that endpoint-constrained path retrieval provides an effective and index-efficient approach to evidence-grounded relation discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConRAG 把「给定两个已知端点实体、恢复中间桥接实体与证据链」形式化为 multi-hop relation inference，用实体共现加 LLM 过滤构建轻量实体-文档图，再对两端点间的路径做语义排序检索。在 MuSiQue 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 上，桥接实体与推理链恢复一致优于强 RAG 基线，同时图索引 token 成本最多降低约 1.5 个数量级。
Motivation: 现有 multi-hop RAG 目标是找未知答案实体，而非显式恢复两个已知端点之间的连接；图方法又依赖 LLM 抽取的昂贵知识图谱，难以扩展到大规模文档集合。
Method: ConRAG 从实体共现加 LLM 实体过滤构建轻量实体-文档图，connective retrieval 在两个端点之间推断并对路径做语义排序，最终生成以检索证据为依据的解释。
Result: 在 MuSiQue 和 2WikiMultiHopQA 上，桥接实体与推理链恢复一致优于强 RAG 基线；图索引 token 成本最多降低约 1.5 个数量级 (orders of magnitude)。
Conclusion: 端点约束的路径检索是证据支撑关系发现的有效且索引高效的做法，避免了昂贵的 LLM 知识图谱抽取。

papers.title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
authors: Zeke Xie (1) ((1) The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract_en: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assume that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G$^3$-LoRA (Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G$^3$-LoRA 针对奖励加权视频后训练中不同数据类别更新不兼容的问题：先探测各类别梯度、剔除共享全局方向，再按残余梯度相容性聚类并训练分组 LoRA 专家，最后权重合并加 on-policy 蒸馏成单一 adapter。在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers 上合并后的分组 adapter 在 VBench2.0 评测中优于基座、联合奖励加权 LoRA 及随机/语义/原始梯度划分基线，CogVideoX-2B 上分组避免了联合训练的负迁移。
Motivation: 奖励加权后训练默认所有数据类别产生兼容的更新，但当类别对应不同技能、领域或评测维度时该假设脆弱，共享 LoRA 训练会把能力平均掉。
Method: 以 VBench2.0 维度划分数据桶、外部多模态奖励管线赋样本权重；探测类别级梯度并去除共享全局更新方向，按残余梯度相容性聚类，训练分组 LoRA 专家，再权重合并并从专家做 on-policy 蒸馏。理论视角是把奖励加权 flow matching 视作速度场回归：不兼容的奖励维度在重叠含噪潜空间区域偏好不同去噪方向。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers 上，合并的分组 adapter 在匹配的 VBench2.0 评测中优于基座模型、联合奖励加权 LoRA 基线，以及同管线下的随机、语义、原始梯度三种划分；独立评估器结论一致。CogVideoX-2B 上分组避免了联合训练的负迁移。增益不均匀：合并压缩了最大的专家增益，蒸馏只恢复部分损失，camera motion 与若干 local-quality 维度仍具挑战。
Conclusion: 梯度相容性可作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的实用诊断指标；合并会牺牲部分专家增益，蒸馏只能部分弥补。

summary_sections.motivation: 奖励加权后训练默认所有数据类别产生兼容的更新，但当类别对应不同技能、领域或评测维度时该假设脆弱，共享 LoRA 训练会把能力平均掉。
summary_sections.method: 以 VBench2.0 维度划分数据桶、外部多模态奖励管线赋样本权重；探测类别级梯度并去除共享全局更新方向，按残余梯度相容性聚类，训练分组 LoRA 专家，再权重合并并从专家做 on-policy 蒸馏。理论视角是把奖励加权 flow matching 视作速度场回归：不兼容的奖励维度在重叠含噪潜空间区域偏好不同去噪方向。
summary_sections.result: 在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers 上，合并的分组 adapter 在匹配的 VBench2.0 评测中优于基座模型、联合奖励加权 LoRA 基线，以及同管线下的随机、语义、原始梯度三种划分；独立评估器结论一致。CogVideoX-2B 上分组避免了联合训练的负迁移。增益不均匀：合并压缩了最大的专家增益，蒸馏只恢复部分损失，camera motion 与若干 local-quality 维度仍具挑战。
summary_sections.conclusion: 梯度相容性可作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的实用诊断指标；合并会牺牲部分专家增益，蒸馏只能部分弥补。

papers.title: Beneath the Tokens: A Performance Engineering Study of Multi-Token Prediction in GPU-Accelerated LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language model inference repeatedly invokes the target model to generate one token at a time, making generation sensitive to GPU memory movement and sequential execution. This study evaluates two-token multi-token prediction (MTP) against autoregressive decoding in a controlled single-request deployment on an NVIDIA A10G GPU. A 360-request benchmark covered plain-text, reasoning-intensive, and tool-calling workloads, while runtime telemetry, Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler, and selected Nsight Compute measurements were used to explain the observed performance. MTP increased output throughput by \(1.91\times\) to \(2.19\times\) across all prompts and reduced time to first output by 10.0--14.2\%. Median mean acceptance length ranged from 2.370 to 2.595 tokens per verification iteration. Profiling showed that MTP introduced a longer and more complex execution path, including proposal, sampling, attention, gathering, and reduction operations. However, it required 56.4--78.1\% fewer executions of the selected repeating CUDA Graph per generated token. The dominant MTP GEMM kernel was not faster than the dominant autoregressive GEMV kernel, and selected instances of both approached the A10G memory-bandwidth limit. These results show that MTP improved inference through amortization: greater token progress reduced repeated GPU execution sufficiently to outweigh the additional speculative-execution cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NVIDIA A10G 单请求部署上，两 token 的 multi-token prediction (MTP) 相对自回归解码把输出吞吐提高 1.91×–2.19×、首 token 延迟降低 10.0–14.2%，原因是每次生成 token 所需的选定 CUDA Graph 执行次数减少 56.4–78.1%，摊销收益超过额外的投机执行开销。作者的结论是 MTP 的加速来自执行摊销而非单个 kernel 变快。
Motivation: 自回归 LLM 推理逐 token 调用模型，对 GPU 显存搬运和串行执行高度敏感；需要弄清 MTP 的收益究竟来自哪里，而非只看端到端加速比。
Method: 在 NVIDIA A10G 上做受控单请求部署，对比两 token MTP 与自回归解码；360 个请求覆盖纯文本、推理密集与 tool-calling 三类负载，用运行时遥测、Nsight Systems、PyTorch Profiler 与部分 Nsight Compute 测量解释性能来源。
Result: MTP 在全部 prompt 上输出吞吐提升 1.91×–2.19×，首输出时间下降 10.0–14.2%；每次验证迭代的 median mean acceptance length 为 2.370–2.595 tokens；每生成 token 所需选定重复 CUDA Graph 执行次数减少 56.4–78.1%。MTP 主导 GEMM kernel 并不比自回归主导 GEMV kernel 快，两者的部分实例都接近 A10G 显存带宽上限。
Conclusion: MTP 的加速机制是摊销：单次推进的 token 增多，减少的重复 GPU 执行足以抵消投机执行的额外成本，而非单 kernel 提速。

papers.title: 5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding
papers.abstract_en: Transforming raw data into queryable knowledge requires both early extraction of reusable information and explicit types, relations, and applicability conditions for particular tasks. If indexing selects content too early around a single business schema, later tasks may be unable to use information that was omitted. If the index retains only open-ended text, however, rule-based reasoning lacks checkable premises. We propose 5W1H+Which, a semantic indexing design that separates content extraction from ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize source-grounded content units; Which points to versioned ontology elements and records mapping relations, scope, and validation status. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles are not merely retrieval labels: together, they constrain the contexts in which facts, bindings, and rules apply. Unbound content remains searchable, while bound content enters a formal reasoning path only after premise checks. The method further distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and uses dependency records to support binding revalidation and the maintenance of derived conclusions. A worked example of migration from an on-premises server to a cloud environment illustrates the different treatment of world-state changes, ontology-version changes, and changes in rule applicability. We formulate three groups of falsifiable hypotheses concerning cross-task evidence coverage, control of contextual misuse, and incremental update cost. The planned evaluation includes a strong typed fact-graph baseline with the same evidence, temporal information, and budget, to test whether benefits arise from 5W1H organization, deferred binding, or additional information and engineering effort. The contribution is a testable indexing mechanism, not a claim to a new universal ontology or a demonstrated performance advantage.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Preprint of a proposed indexing method with falsifiable hypotheses; not empirically validated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 5W1H+Which 语义索引设计，把内容抽取与本体绑定 (ontology binding) 分离：5W1H 组织有来源依据的内容单元，Which 指向带版本的本体元素并记录映射关系、适用范围与验证状态，时间/地点/系统环境/参与者角色共同约束事实与规则的适用上下文。未绑定内容仍可检索，绑定内容须通过前提检查才进入形式推理路径；论文给出三组可证伪假设与迁移工作示例，明确声明尚未做实证验证。
Motivation: 过早按单一业务 schema 索引会丢掉后续任务需要的信息，而只存开放文本又让规则推理缺少可检查的前提；两种极端都损害索引的可复用性与可审计性。
Method: 5W1H 组织源依据内容单元，Which 指向版本化本体并记录 mapping relations、scope、validation status；区分 business valid time、system knowledge time 与 operational traces，用 dependency records 支持绑定重验证与派生结论维护。给出本地服务器迁移到云环境的工作示例，并设计三组可证伪假设，计划与同证据、同时序信息、同预算的 typed fact-graph 基线对比。
Result: 论文给出三组可证伪假设，分别针对跨任务证据覆盖、上下文误用控制与增量更新成本；计划中的评估以同证据、同时序信息、同预算的 typed fact-graph 基线拆分收益来源（5W1H 组织、延迟绑定、额外信息与工程投入）。arXiv comment 明确标注该预印本尚未做实证验证，贡献是可测试的索引机制而非已证实的性能优势。
Conclusion: 内容抽取与本体绑定应当解耦，让未绑定内容保持可检索、绑定内容先过前提检查再进推理路径；其性能收益目前只是待检验假设，不是已成立的结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Research-Native by Construction: Minimal Nodes, Re-verifiable Workflows, and Compounding Memory for Long-Horizon Scientific Agents
papers.abstract_en: We describe AfS (Agent for Science), a platform built for long-horizon scientific work, where a project runs for tens of hours across dozens of agent runs with a human present only occasionally. Most agents for science are general coding agents with a skills folder attached, and they inherit that lineage's failure mode: under pressure to finish, they fabricate, skip, or smooth over. Our design rests on one claim: most of the credibility of machine-made research can be moved from asking the model to behave to making the non-compliant state unrepresentable. We encode research discipline as mechanically enforced laws (commitment before measurement; unforgeable freezing; reports are not facts; evidence persists but verdicts do not; negative results are first-class; mechanical questions to the framework and semantic judgment to the model), organized around three time horizons: a minimal set of research nodes within a run, an inquiry contract with frozen closure conditions and a hash-chained artifact ledger within a project, and a two-tier knowledge base with promotion by rewriting across projects. This is a system description written under one rule: each mechanism appears in exactly one place, with the invariant it enforces, the failure it prevents, the way it is realized, and the cost it imposes. It covers the node contract, the write-path gates, the two-tier memory, and the runtime substrate. Three traces walk real failure attempts through the mechanisms that catch them, and two closed campaigns are included as worked illustrations rather than as an evaluation. We report no benchmark: a process-integrity suite that would support quantitative comparison is under construction, and what we can measure today is only the operating cost of the machinery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AfS 是面向长时程科学研究的智能体平台，把研究纪律写成机制上强制执行的法则（先承诺后测量、不可伪造的冻结、报告不等于事实、证据保留而结论可废止、负结果一等公民），使不合规状态在系统里无法表示，而不是靠模型自觉。全文是系统描述：三条 trace 演示机制如何拦截真实失败尝试，两个已关闭 campaign 作为示例而非评估，作者明确不报告 benchmark。
Motivation: 通用编码型科研智能体在交付压力下会编造、跳过或掩盖步骤；长时程项目（数十小时、几十次 agent 运行、人类偶尔在场）里靠提示词约束行为不可靠，需要把可信度从“要求模型守规矩”转移到“让不守规矩的状态无法表示”。
Method: 按三个时间尺度组织机制：单次运行内的最小研究节点契约 (node contract)、项目内的询问契约 (inquiry contract) 含冻结的关闭条件与哈希链式工件账本 (hash-chained artifact ledger)、跨项目的两层知识库 (two-tier knowledge base) 靠重写晋升 (promotion by rewriting)。配套写路径门控 (write-path gates) 与运行时基底；机械性问题交给框架、语义判断交给模型。
Result: 三条 trace 走查真实失败尝试及其被拦截的机制，两个已关闭 campaign 作为工作示例而非评估；作者明确不报告 benchmark，可测的只有机制本身的运行开销，支撑定量对比的流程完整性测试套件 (process-integrity suite) 仍在建设中。
Conclusion: 机器生成研究的可信度可以通过机制设计而非行为要求来承载，代价是引入运行开销；定量评估要等流程完整性测试套件建成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Subgroup Rank-1 Lattice for Practical High-dimensional Black-box Integral Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating integrals of black-box, high-dimensional functions, from expectations and kernel mean embeddings to the softmax kernel in self-attention, is a basic subroutine in machine learning. Rank-1 lattice rules suit this setting: they query the integrand only at a fixed point set and need no gradients. When the $n$ points serve as a design matrix $X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ for a feature map, however, computing $Ψ(X)^\top v$ or $Ψ(X)w$ for an elementwise nonlinearity $Ψ$ costs $O(nd)$ time and memory for any standard quasi-Monte Carlo point set. We study subgroup rank-1 lattices, whose Korobov generator $(1,t,\dots,t^{d-1})$ uses a scalar $t$ of fixed multiplicative order $m$. Splitting $\mathbb{F}_n^\times$ into cosets of $\langle t\rangle$ reduces both maps to short cyclic correlations evaluated by FFT, giving exact results for arbitrary $Ψ$ in $O(n\log m)$ time and $O(n)$ memory, without forming $X$. Since fixing $m$ falls outside classical component-by-component theory, we prove convergence directly: via resultants with the cyclotomic polynomial $Φ_m$, the squared worst-case error in the Korobov space decays as $O(n^{-(α-1)/(m-1)})$ for prime $m\ge d+1$, and this threshold is exact. Using the splitting of $n$ in $\mathbb{Q}(ζ_m)$, averaging over the $m-1$ admissible generators improves the constant by a factor $Θ(m-1)$. Empirically, the subgroup lattice beats Gaussian and orthogonal random features and scrambled Sobol' and Halton points in 49 of 54 synthetic kernel-estimation settings and all 45 softmax-attention settings on nine real datasets, and builds a sample set with $d=2048$, $n\approx4.1\times10^7$ in 2.3 ms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出子群 rank-1 lattice：Korobov 生成元 (1,t,…,t^{d-1}) 取固定乘法阶 m，按 ⟨t⟩ 陪集拆分 F_n^× 后，任意逐元素非线性 Ψ 下的 Ψ(X)^T v 与 Ψ(X)w 都化为 FFT 短循环相关，在不构造 X 的前提下以 O(n log m) 时间、O(n) 内存精确计算。在 54 个合成核估计设置中 49 个胜过 Gaussian/正交随机特征与 scrambled Sobol'/Halton，45 个 softmax-attention 设置全部胜出。
Motivation: 把 n 个 QMC 点当作特征映射的设计矩阵 X∈R^{n×d} 时，任何标准 QMC 点集算 Ψ(X)^T v 或 Ψ(X)w 都要 O(nd) 时间与内存，高维黑箱积分作为 ML 基本子程序代价过高。
Method: 用固定乘法阶 m 的 Korobov 生成元构造子群 rank-1 lattice，将 F_n^× 按 ⟨t⟩ 陪集拆分，把两个映射化为 FFT 求值的短循环相关；收敛性不走经典逐分量 (component-by-component) 理论，而是用与分圆多项式 Φ_m 的结式 (resultant) 直接证明，并在 Q(ζ_m) 中按 n 的分解对 m−1 个可容许生成元取平均改进常数。
Result: 平方最坏情形误差在 Korobov 空间中按 O(n^{-(α-1)/(m-1)}) 衰减（素数 m≥d+1），且该阈值是精确的；对 m−1 个可容许生成元平均使常数改进 Θ(m−1) 倍。合成核估计 54 个设置中 49 个胜过 Gaussian 与正交随机特征、scrambled Sobol' 与 Halton；九个真实数据集上 45 个 softmax-attention 设置全部胜出；d=2048、n≈4.1×10^7 的样本集构建耗时 2.3 ms。
Conclusion: 固定阶子群结构能把高维黑箱积分的逐点非线性映射降到 O(n log m) 且不损失精度，m≥d+1 的阈值不可再放松；该方法在核估计与 softmax 注意力两类任务上都优于标准 QMC 点集与随机特征。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 用固定乘法阶 m 的 Korobov 生成元构造子群 rank-1 lattice，将 F_n^× 按 ⟨t⟩ 陪集拆分，把两个映射化为 FFT 求值的短循环相关；收敛性不走经典逐分量 (component-by-component) 理论，而是用与分圆多项式 Φ_m 的结式 (resultant) 直接证明，并在 Q(ζ_m) 中按 n 的分解对 m−1 个可容许生成元取平均改进常数。
summary_sections.result: 平方最坏情形误差在 Korobov 空间中按 O(n^{-(α-1)/(m-1)}) 衰减（素数 m≥d+1），且该阈值是精确的；对 m−1 个可容许生成元平均使常数改进 Θ(m−1) 倍。合成核估计 54 个设置中 49 个胜过 Gaussian 与正交随机特征、scrambled Sobol' 与 Halton；九个真实数据集上 45 个 softmax-attention 设置全部胜出；d=2048、n≈4.1×10^7 的样本集构建耗时 2.3 ms。
summary_sections.conclusion: 固定阶子群结构能把高维黑箱积分的逐点非线性映射降到 O(n log m) 且不损失精度，m≥d+1 的阈值不可再放松；该方法在核估计与 softmax 注意力两类任务上都优于标准 QMC 点集与随机特征。

papers.title: ProtoSeam: Lifting Classifier Training with Latent Gaussian Mixture Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a lifted reformulation of supervised classification that improves the final accuracy of standard classifiers without changing the architecture at inference time. A network $N=N_2\circ N_1$ is split at a single semantic interface and one learnable prototype per class is inserted there. Training combines a quadratic consensus penalty that pulls $N_1(x)$ toward the prototype of its class with a classification loss of $N_2$ evaluated on samples drawn around the prototypes, whereat no gradient crosses the interface. At inference the prototypes are discarded and the unmodified network $N_2\circ N_1$ is used. Across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet with ResNet and vision transformer backbones, lifted training improves test accuracy by up to five percentage points over variants without lifting under a shared tuning protocol. Moreover, we provide theoretical justification of those results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoSeam 把分类网络 N=N2∘N1 在单一语义接口处切开，每类插入一个可学习原型：训练时用二次一致性惩罚把 N1(x) 拉向所属类原型，并在原型附近采样训练 N2 的分类损失，梯度不跨接口；推理时丢弃原型、直接用原网络。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 上配合 ResNet 与 ViT 主干，同一调参协议下相对无 lifting 变体测试精度最多提升 5 个百分点。
Motivation: 标准分类器的中间表示缺少显式类结构约束，想提升精度往往要改推理期架构或增加开销；目标是在推理期完全不动网络的前提下抬高最终测试精度。
Method: 将 N=N2∘N1 在单个语义接口处拆分并为每类插入一个可学习原型；训练由两部分组成——把 N1(x) 拉向其类原型的二次一致性惩罚 (quadratic consensus penalty)，以及在原型周围采样样本上计算的 N2 分类损失，且梯度不跨过接口；推理时丢弃原型，使用未修改的 N2∘N1。作者另给出理论论证。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet 上，配合 ResNet 与 vision transformer 主干、共享调参协议，lifted training 相比不带 lifting 的变体测试精度最多提升 5 个百分点 (up to five percentage points)。
Conclusion: 在推理期架构不变的约束下，靠接口处的原型与不跨接口的训练重构即可提升标准分类器的最终精度，且该效果有理论解释支撑。

papers.title: QAM: Quadratic-Accurate Checkpoint Merging via Sequential Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Saved checkpoints record states along a training trajectory, but generally do not determine the updates at states that would be visited under a different schedule. We study how accurately these checkpoints can reconstruct the endpoint of a sequential reference with prescribed update strengths. Under a common local transition model, two checkpoint-index moment conditions characterize all convex merges that agree with this reference through second order. We then prove an information limit that for nondegenerate profiles, no algorithm using only a fixed-length gradient-descent (GD) history with step size $h$ can achieve $o(h^3)$ endpoint error uniformly over a fixed class of smooth, strongly convex losses. The lower bound follows from two losses with identical GD checkpoint histories but sequential reference endpoints separated by $Ω(h^3)$. \textbf{Quadratic-Accurate Merging} (QAM) achieves a matching uniform $O(h^3)$ endpoint error bound. Its explicit coefficients also define the unique profile-dependent merge that exactly matches the sequential GD reference across all fixed quadratic objectives. Across two public Adam checkpoint trajectories (SmolLM3-3B and OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B), three windows and three profiles per model, and 15 tasks, QAM shows mixed results for short windows and broader advantages over \textbf{Warmup-Stable and Merge} (WSM) for longer windows. Matched-moment GSM8K diagnostics further show that local consistency alone does not fully determine downstream scores. These results characterize the reconstruction limits of saved histories, provide a coefficient rule that attains the optimal rate, and assess its practical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QAM 证明只用固定长度梯度下降历史无法把端点误差压到 o(h³)，并给出达到匹配 O(h³) 上界的合并系数规则。在 SmolLM3-3B 与 OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B 两条 Adam checkpoint 轨迹、每模型 3 个窗口 × 3 种 profile、共 15 个任务上，短窗口结果混合，长窗口相对 WSM 优势更广。
Motivation: 保存的 checkpoint 记录的是某条训练轨迹上的状态，却不能决定换调度后会访问的状态的更新；需要刻画仅凭固定长度历史能多准地重建顺序参考的端点。
Method: 在统一局部转移模型下用两个 checkpoint 索引矩条件刻画所有二阶一致的凸合并；构造两个 GD checkpoint 历史相同、顺序参考端点相差 Ω(h³) 的损失给出信息下界；QAM 的显式系数给出唯一随 profile 变化、在所有固定二次目标上精确匹配顺序 GD 参考的合并。
Result: 下界为非退化 profile 下任何仅用步长 h 的固定长度 GD 历史的算法都无法一致达到 o(h³)；QAM 达到匹配的统一 O(h³) 端点误差界。在两条公开 Adam checkpoint 轨迹（SmolLM3-3B、OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B）、每模型 3 个窗口与 3 种 profile、共 15 个任务上，短窗口结果混合，长窗口相对 WSM（Warmup-Stable and Merge）优势更广；GSM8K 上匹配矩诊断显示局部一致性本身不足以决定下游分数。
Conclusion: 保存历史的重建精度存在 Ω(h³) 的硬下界，QAM 的系数规则达到该最优速率；但局部二阶一致性并不完全决定下游表现，其实用价值随窗口变长而更明显。

papers.title: EdgeCraft: Automated Model Crafting for Edge IoT
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) increasingly powers Internet of Things (IoT) applications at the edge. Yet producing a deployable edge ML artifact for a specific scenario requires navigating a huge search space spanning data representation, model design, training on domain-specific data, and runtime customization. This workflow is fragmented and difficult to scale across diverse edge applications. We present EdgeCraft, an LLM-driven system that turns high-level intent into deployable edge ML artifacts. Building such a system raises two challenges: (1) How can an LLM be guided to find high-quality solutions that meet dynamic SLOs for task quality, latency, and energy? (2) How can trustworthy target-device verification be obtained at low cost? EdgeCraft addresses these challenges with two designs. (1) A constraint-aware synthesis tree explores alternative candidates and uses measured SLO gaps to guide each improvement. (2) A multi-fidelity verifier progressively combines low-cost checks with full target-device verification to reduce verification cost while preserving reliable verification results. It also records verified failures for reuse, avoiding repeated device work. To support concurrency, EdgeCraft provides a multi-tenant runtime that runs cloud training and target-device verification in parallel while isolating requests. Across 50 public tasks, EdgeCraft exceeds the task-specific Reference in best-observed quality on 40 tasks and finds an SLO-feasible artifact on 45, with the two outcomes overlapping on 38 tasks. Moreover, EdgeCraft achieves competitive performance on our self-collected SEN dataset, suggesting its generalizability to real-world IoT sensing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EdgeCraft 是一个由 LLM 驱动的边缘 ML 制品自动生成系统，用约束感知合成树 (constraint-aware synthesis tree) 以实测 SLO 差距引导候选改进，再用多保真验证器 (multi-fidelity verifier) 逐级组合低成本检查与真机验证。在 50 个公开任务上，它在 40 个任务的最佳观测质量超过任务专用 Reference，45 个任务找到 SLO 可行制品，两者重叠 38 个。
Motivation: 为特定边缘场景产出可部署 ML 制品要在数据表示、模型设计、领域训练与运行时定制的巨大搜索空间里导航，流程碎片化且难以跨多样边缘应用扩展。
Method: 两个核心设计：约束感知合成树探索候选并用实测 SLO 差距（任务质量、延迟、能耗）引导每步改进；多保真验证器渐进合并低成本检查与完整目标设备验证，并记录已验证失败以复用。配套多租户运行时并行执行云端训练与设备验证并隔离请求。
Result: 在 50 个公开任务上，最佳观测质量超过任务专用 Reference 的有 40 个，找到 SLO 可行制品的有 45 个，两项结果重叠 38 个；在自采 SEN 数据集上取得有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 把 SLO 差距作为搜索引导、把验证成本分级，可以让 LLM 系统规模化产出满足动态 SLO 的边缘 ML 制品，并可推广到真实 IoT 传感任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Re-Draft: A Variational Stackelberg Game for Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models offer the ability to re-draft, revisiting and correcting earlier tokens throughout generation. This capability depends on the forward corruption process that defines what the denoiser learns to correct. Masked diffusion models fix tokens once they are unmasked, while uniform diffusion permits revisions but relies on uniformly random token substitutions. We instead learn which substitutions are most useful for training the denoiser to re-draft. We introduce Variational Stackelberg Discrete Diffusion (VSDD), a framework for learning a semantically aware corruption process. VSDD formulates training as a leader-follower game: the leader defines a Markovian corruption process parameterized by the denoiser's token embeddings, while the follower optimizes a variational denoising objective with the corruption process held fixed. The leader rewards corruptions based on how much the denoiser improves after learning from them, rather than on how easily the current denoiser can reconstruct them. We measure this improvement under a fixed reference corruption process, approximate the follower's response with a one-step gradient update, and optimize the leader using a score-function estimator. We evaluate VSDD across molecular, text, and playlist generation. VSDD substantially improves molecular validity over uniform and masked diffusion, reduces text perplexity relative to uniform diffusion while remaining competitive with masked diffusion, and achieves sizable improvements in offline playlist recommendation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Variational Stackelberg Discrete Diffusion (VSDD)，把离散扩散的前向破坏过程学成语义感知的：leader 用去噪器的 token embedding 参数化 Markov 破坏过程，按「去噪器从该破坏中学到多少改进」而非「当前去噪器多容易重建它」给奖励，follower 在破坏固定时优化变分去噪目标。在分子、文本、playlist 生成三类任务上，分子有效性显著优于 uniform 与 masked diffusion，文本困惑度低于 uniform diffusion 且与 masked diffusion 相当，离线 playlist 推荐指标有可观提升。
Motivation: masked diffusion 一旦 token 解掩码 就固定不再改，uniform diffusion 允许修订但依赖均匀随机替换，两者都没有回答哪些 token 替换最值得用来训练去噪器做 re-draft。
Method: VSDD 把训练写成 leader-follower 博弈：leader 定义由去噪器 token embedding 参数化的 Markov 破坏过程，follower 在破坏过程固定下优化变分去噪目标。改进量在固定参考破坏过程下度量，follower 响应用一步梯度更新近似，leader 用 score-function estimator 优化。
Result: 在分子、文本、playlist 生成上评估：分子有效性相对 uniform diffusion 与 masked diffusion 均有显著提升；文本困惑度相对 uniform diffusion 下降、与 masked diffusion 保持竞争力；离线 playlist 推荐指标获得可观提升。
Conclusion: 按「去噪器学习后的改进」而非重建难度来选择 token 替换，可以把离散扩散的破坏过程学成语义感知的，从而支持生成过程中持续 re-draft。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Small transformers track Bayesian evidence for latent common causes via a context-invariant mechanism
papers.abstract_en: We present an in-depth investigation of how a form of Bayesian reasoning about common causes can emerge as a cross-contextual generalization in small, tractable transformers. Incrementing on recent work, our set-up (i) disentangles causal mechanisms in the model from the causal structure of the true data-generating process, (ii) orients more towards natural language prediction by considering inference of latent common causes, and (iii) considers whether and how Bayesian evidence accumulation for latent common causes can be implemented in representations and mechanisms that allow for cross-context generalization to novel test cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在小型可解析 transformer 中检验贝叶斯共同原因推断能否作为跨情境泛化涌现：设置把模型内部因果机制与真实数据生成过程的因果结构解耦，并考察潜共同原因的贝叶斯证据累积能否由支持跨情境泛化的表征与机制实现。
Motivation: 近期工作显示 transformer 可做某种贝叶斯推理，但模型机制与真实因果结构常被混同，且缺少对新测试情境的跨情境泛化考察；本文面向自然语言预测中的潜共同原因推断补上这一环。
Method: 在小型可解析 transformer 上构造受控设置：(i) 分离模型的因果机制与真实数据生成过程的因果结构，(ii) 以自然语言预测为取向推断潜共同原因，(iii) 检验贝叶斯证据累积能否由允许跨情境泛化的表征与机制承载。
Result: 这是一项机制性研究设置的提出与考察，摘要给出的是定性主张：贝叶斯关于共同原因的推理可作为跨情境泛化在小型 transformer 中涌现，并可由面向新测试案例的表征与机制实现。
Conclusion: 作者主张小型 transformer 中对潜共同原因的贝叶斯证据累积可以是一种跨情境不变的机制，而非绑定于训练时的特定因果结构。

papers.title: FONDANT: Strong and Best-Effort Planning via Antichains
papers.abstract_en: A classical solution concept in fully observable nondeterministic (FOND) planning, is the strong policy (aka winning strategy in the closely related area of reactive synthesis), i.e., such a policy ensures that the goal is reached in an adversarial environment. When strong policies are not available or there is no evidence that the environment is adversarial, one can resort to best-effort policies, which always exist, and which follow the classic decision-theoretic principle that an agent should not use a dominated strategy. A typical positional best-effort policy works as follows: from every state, it follows a strong policy if one exists from that state (such states are called ``strong-winning''), else a weak policy if one exists from that state (``weak-winning''), and else is unconstrained (``losing''). In this work, we introduce a sound and complete planner for both best-effort planning and strong planning. The algorithm that underpins the planner is quite simple: it represents certain sets of states, such as the winning regions, by their $\subseteq$-minimal elements. The algorithm returns uniform policies, i.e., it returns a policy $π_t$ that is a strong solution starting in every strong-winning state, and it returns a policy $π_w$ that is a weak solution starting in every weak-winning state, and it provides a certificate for the set of losing states. We implemented the algorithm with some simple optimizations (calling it FONDANT), and evaluated it on a benchmark set consisting of the instances that were used in the evaluation of leading strong planners PR2 and FOND-SAT, and the best-effort planner BeSyftP. On coverage, our implementation is at least as good on all domains, and outperforms on some domains; and on wall time, it is slower on small and medium-sized instances, and outperforms on larger instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FONDANT 是一个同时求解 best-effort 与 strong 策略的 FOND 规划器，用 ⊆-极小元（antichain）表示获胜区域等状态集合，输出统一策略 π_t、π_w 并给出 losing 状态的证书。在 PR2、FOND-SAT、BeSyftP 的基准实例上，覆盖率在所有域上至少持平、部分域更优；墙钟时间在中小实例上更慢、在更大实例上反超。
Motivation: FOND 规划中 strong 策略可能不存在或没有证据表明环境是对抗性的，此时需要 best-effort 策略；现有工具分散在 strong 规划器与 best-effort 规划器两侧，缺少一个统一且带证书的求解器。
Method: 用 antichain（⊆-极小元）表示 winning region 等状态集合，据此构造 sound and complete 的规划算法，返回在所有 strong-winning 状态起始均为 strong 解的统一策略 π_t、在所有 weak-winning 状态起始均为 weak 解的 π_w，并为 losing 状态集提供证书；实现中加入若干简单优化，命名为 FONDANT。
Result: 在由 leading strong planners PR2 与 FOND-SAT 以及 best-effort planner BeSyftP 的评估实例构成的基准集上：覆盖率在所有域上至少与这些规划器持平，并在部分域上超过；墙钟时间在小、中型实例上更慢，但在更大实例上超过它们。
Conclusion: 用 antichain 表示状态集合足以支撑一个同时覆盖 strong 与 best-effort 的完备规划器，其代价是小中规模实例偏慢、规模变大后时间上占优。

papers.title: PEARL: Adaptive Prefill-Decode Execution with Elasticity for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn rollout dominates the cost of agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Asynchronous execution and elastic GPU resources can accelerate this stage, but adding rollout replicas yields diminishing returns while training GPUs remain idle between updates. We observe that effective resource use also depends on the prefill--decode (PD) configuration. Both the choice between colocation and disaggregation and the optimal PD ratio vary with the workload, making resource scaling and PD configuration interdependent. Exploiting this opportunity requires selecting effective configurations and realizing their benefits within transient resource-availability windows despite reconfiguration costs. We present PEARL, an asynchronous agentic RL system that coordinates external resource elasticity, temporary reuse of idle training GPUs, and adaptive PD execution. PEARL maintains a unified GPU--worker--role state and uses runtime profiles to predict rollout batch completion time, accounting for environment-induced reductions in decode concurrency. It selects the PD mode and ratio under the current GPU budget and translates each decision into an incremental transition plan that minimizes worker and role changes. Cost-aware switching and borrowing policies suppress transitions with insufficient expected benefit while ensuring timely return of training GPUs. Our evaluation show that PEARL achieves $2.17$--$2.79\times$ the throughput of fixed-resource ROLL across different LLMs. Compared with RLBoost+, throughput improves by up to approximately 26.9\% for Qwen3-8B and 36.3\% for Qwen3-30B-A3B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEARL 是面向 agentic 强化学习多轮 rollout 的异步执行系统，把外部 GPU 资源弹性、训练 GPU 空闲借用与 prefill-decode (PD) 配置统一调度：用运行时 profile 预测 rollout batch 完成时间，在当前 GPU 预算下选 PD 模式与比例，并生成最小 worker/角色改动的增量迁移计划，配合成本感知的切换与借用策略。在不同 LLM 上吞吐达到固定资源 ROLL 的 2.17–2.79×，相对 RLBoost+ 最高提升约 26.9%（Qwen3-8B）与 36.3%（Qwen3-30B-A3B）。
Motivation: agentic RL 的成本由多轮 rollout 主导，异步执行与弹性 GPU 能加速，但继续加 rollout 副本收益递减，且训练 GPU 在更新间隙空闲；同时 PD 的 colocation/disaggregation 选择与最优 PD 比随负载变化，资源扩展与 PD 配置相互耦合，而重配置本身有成本。
Method: PEARL 维护统一的 GPU–worker–role 状态，用运行时 profile 预测 rollout batch 完成时间（计入环境导致的 decode 并发下降），在当前 GPU 预算下选择 PD 模式与比例，并把每个决策转成最小化 worker 与角色变更的增量迁移计划；成本感知的切换与借用策略抑制预期收益不足的迁移，并保证训练 GPU 及时归还。
Result: 在不同 LLM 上，PEARL 吞吐为固定资源 ROLL 的 2.17–2.79×；相比 RLBoost+，吞吐最高提升约 26.9%（Qwen3-8B）与 36.3%（Qwen3-30B-A3B）。
Conclusion: 资源弹性、训练 GPU 空闲借用与 PD 配置必须联合决策，才能在短暂的资源可用窗口内兑现收益，同时靠成本感知策略压住重配置开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coordinated Lane-Level Variable Speed Limits and Ramp Metering for Successive Weaving Segments Considering Merging/Diverging Risks: A Hybrid Model Predictive Control and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Successive weaving segments (SWSs) on urban expressways are bottlenecks prone to recurrent congestion and collisions, requiring fine-grained active traffic management (ATM). Existing approaches struggle to balance the adaptive performance of data-driven optimization with the resilience and transferability of model-based control. We propose a hybrid framework to coordinate lane-level variable speed limits (VSLs) and ramp metering across SWSs. First, we reconstruct L-METANET, a lane-level macroscopic traffic flow model that captures free and forced lane changes. Second, we combine XGBoost-SHAP with a random-parameters binary logit (RPBL) model to derive analytical equations for merging and diverging collision risks and formulate system cost and reward functions. Third, we develop MPC-STMAPPO, a hierarchical controller integrating model predictive control (MPC) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Its upper MPC layer uses L-METANET for long-horizon rolling optimization and generates baseline commands; its lower spatiotemporal MAPPO (ST-MAPPO) layer, enhanced with Mamba cells and graph attention, produces residual actions for short-horizon adjustment. Real-world experiments on the 18-km Eastern Expressway in Changchun, China, show that L-METANET accurately reproduces lane-changing-induced flow redistribution and capacity drops, with state evolution aligned with ground truth. XGBoost-SHAP-RPBL achieves AUCs above 0.80 in most tasks, outperforming conventional logit models. MPC-STMAPPO converges faster and performs better across multiple metrics than MPC- and MARL-based baselines. Under randomly fluctuating demand, it also significantly outperforms pure MARL in generalization, demonstrating strong potential for industrial deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向城市快速路连续交织段 (SWS) 的车道级 VSL 与匝道信号协调控制：用 L-METANET 宏观模型加 XGBoost-SHAP 与随机参数二元 logit 刻画合流/分流碰撞风险，再以 MPC-STMAPPO 分层控制器（上层 MPC 长时域滚动优化、下层 Mamba+图注意力的 ST-MAPPO 输出残差动作）生成指令。长春 18 km 东快速路实测中，风险模型多数任务 AUC 超过 0.80，控制器在多指标上快于并优于 MPC 与 MARL 基线，需求随机波动下泛化显著强于纯 MARL。
Motivation: 连续交织段是常发拥堵与碰撞瓶颈，现有方法难以兼顾数据驱动优化的自适应性与基于模型控制的鲁棒性和可迁移性，且需要车道级、合流/分流风险感知的细粒度主动交通管理。
Method: 重建车道级宏观车流模型 L-METANET，显式刻画自由换道与强制换道；用 XGBoost-SHAP 结合随机参数二元 logit (RPBL) 推出合流/分流碰撞风险解析式，并据此构造系统代价与奖励函数；提出分层控制器 MPC-STMAPPO，上层用 L-METANET 做长时域滚动优化给出基线指令，下层 ST-MAPPO（Mamba 单元 + 图注意力）输出短时域残差动作。
Result: 在长春 18 km 东快速路真实实验中，L-METANET 准确复现换道引起的流量再分布与通行能力下降，状态演化与 ground truth 对齐；XGBoost-SHAP-RPBL 在多数任务上 AUC 高于 0.80，优于传统 logit 模型；MPC-STMAPPO 收敛更快且在多个指标上优于 MPC 基线与 MARL 基线，在随机波动需求下泛化能力显著优于纯 MARL。
Conclusion: 把基于模型的长时域滚动优化与数据驱动的短时域残差强化学习分层耦合，可在连续交织段同时拿到自适应性与鲁棒性，作者据此认为该方案具备工业部署潜力。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: From Migration to Calibration: Preserving Agent Capabilities across Models, Jurisdictions, and Scale
papers.abstract_en: Agents need calibration when deployment conditions change: replacing a driving model, including a foundation-to-post-trained transition; crossing jurisdictions; or scaling across heterogeneous markets and sources. Interface compatibility alone does not establish capability retention or target-contract satisfaction. We formulate agent calibration as constrained behavioral adaptation across three interacting layers: information preservation, harness adaptation, and user acceptance; the layers apply to every scenario, not one-to-one to the three. The basic objective is non-degradation on prespecified capability measures while satisfying target requirements; aggregate improvement is stronger. Information calibration preserves independently validated source content still applicable to the target task. Harness calibration aligns observable artifacts at semantic checkpoints and repairs them through iteration, tool substitution, or local replanning within explicit budgets. User calibration enforces recipient-specific output contracts: templates, schemas, and section-level preferences. A global e-commerce example shows how shared standards coexist with site- and market-specific adapters and validation. We distinguish trainable policies from frozen-backbone configuration or controller optimization, and evidence verification from relative judgment and DPO/GRPO optimization. Recent harness-transfer and judge-validity studies motivate target-native execution records, separate audits of task validity and near-tie ranking, and matched target-native optimization controls. We propose held-out evaluations for model changes, cross-border adaptation, and scale, including a factorial test of source evidence and checkpoint repair and group-level reporting to prevent aggregate gains from masking local failures. This is a methodological proposal; implementation and empirical validation remain future work.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Methodological proposal: three-layer agent calibration framework; no empirical results reported
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 agent 迁移（换驱动模型、跨司法辖区、跨市场扩展）形式化为三层受约束行为适配：信息保持、harness 适配、用户契约满足，目标是在预设能力度量上不退化，聚合提升是更强要求。摘要明确这是方法学提案，实现与实证验证留作后续工作。
Motivation: 接口兼容不等于能力保持或满足目标契约：换模型（含 foundation 到 post-trained）、跨辖区、跨异构市场扩展时，agent 的可观测产物与输出契约容易失配。
Method: 提出三层 agent calibration 框架：信息校准保留经独立验证且仍适用于目标任务的源内容；harness 校准在语义检查点对齐可观测产物，通过迭代、工具替换或局部重规划在显式预算内修复；用户校准强制模板、schema 与章节级偏好的接收方输出契约。区分可训练策略与冻结 backbone 的配置/控制器优化，区分证据验证与相对判断及 DPO/GRPO 优化，并提出针对模型变更、跨境适配与规模的 held-out 评估，含源证据与检查点修复的因子实验及分组报告。
Result: 给出一个全球电商示例，说明共享标准如何与站点/市场专用 adapter 及校验共存；摘要自述为方法学提案，无实证结果，实现与实证验证为未来工作。
Conclusion: agent 迁移应按信息、harness、用户三层分别设约束与检查点，并用分组报告防止聚合提升掩盖局部失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable. To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench, a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video. Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics. Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests. A task is resolved when the output passes every test. The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief's explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors. We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments. Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft. We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at https://timelinebench.tensortest.com.
papers.comment: Preprint, under review. 9 pages main text, 27 pages total; 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://timelinebench.tensortest.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Timeline-Bench 提出 56 项真实视频剪辑任务，要求 agent 把原始素材做成成片，用含 2,582 次盲评校准的质量测试判定通过。16 个前沿模型+编码 agent 组合中最好的 GPT-6 Astra in Codex（带编辑指导）也只解出 15/56（26.8%），平均 14.0%；771 次失败运行中 562 次仅败在质量测试，且 83.5% 的盲评偏好参考剪辑。
Motivation: 长程专业工作的 agent 评测很少要求交付真正可用的创意成品，现有基准无法衡量成片质量这一关。
Method: 每项任务提供 brief、源素材、容器和一组测试，全部测试通过才算解决；测试覆盖交付格式、内容与 brief 显式要求，并含一项由 43 名视频剪辑师 2,582 次盲评校准的质量测试。评测 16 个前沿模型搭配 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等编码 agent harness 的组合。
Result: 最佳 GPT-6 Astra in Codex（配 curated editorial guidance）解出 56 项中的 15 项（26.8%），平均 agent 解决率 14.0%；人类剪辑师在 83.5% 的判断中偏好参考剪辑；771 次未解决运行中 562 次仅因质量测试失败。
Conclusion: 当前 agent 能按格式和 brief 交付，但过不了质量关：它们靠静帧和文字稿感知素材、只查渲染缺陷而不查剪辑功力。任务、verifier 与逐次运行结果已公开。

papers.title: CacheRepair: Learning to Repair Cross-Chunk Context in RAG for KV Cache Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Multi-document retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires a language model to process multiple retrieved text chunks before answering a question. Precomputing each chunk's KV cache independently and concatenating the caches when the chunks are retrieved can accelerate this step. However, the assembled cache lacks cross-chunk attention information, reducing answer quality. Selective recomputation methods recover the missing cross-chunk context by rerunning the target LLM on selected tokens, incurring substantial online computation. We introduce CacheRepair, a lightweight network that learns the difference between independently computed KV caches and those produced by processing the chunks together. The network combines compressed KV features with token embeddings and uses attention that is bidirectional within each chunk and flows from earlier to later chunks. Each repair block receives the compressed cache features, and the predicted residual is added to every document token's cache. Each repair network is trained for a specific frozen target LLM on a generic retrieval corpus and reused across downstream datasets. Our analysis shows that repair reduces KV errors both near chunk boundaries and throughout chunk interiors. Evaluation across three target LLMs and four downstream datasets places CacheRepair on the measured answer-quality-latency Pareto frontier in eleven of twelve model-dataset combinations. Reported time to first token (TTFT) includes online cache transfer and repair. Across all twelve combinations, the largest repairers achieve 1.69-4.61$\times$ speedups in median TTFT over full prefill and improve mean F1 by 2.1-26.1 percentage points over direct cache reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CacheRepair 用一个轻量网络学习「各 chunk 独立算出的 KV cache」与「把 chunks 一起处理得到的 cache」之差，把预测残差加回每个文档 token 的 cache，从而在不重跑目标 LLM 的情况下补回跨 chunk 注意力信息。在三个目标 LLM × 四个下游数据集的 12 组组合中，最大修复器相对 full prefill 的中位 TTFT 加速 1.69–4.61×，相对直接复用 cache 的 mean F1 提升 2.1–26.1 个百分点，且在 12 组中的 11 组位于答案质量–延迟 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: 多文档 RAG 里逐 chunk 预计算 KV cache 再拼接会丢失跨 chunk 注意力，直接降低答案质量；已有的 selective recomputation 要在在线阶段重跑目标 LLM 的选定 token，带来大量在线计算。
Method: CacheRepair 是一个按特定冻结目标 LLM 训练、可跨下游数据集复用的轻量修复网络：把压缩后的 KV 特征与 token embedding 结合，注意力在 chunk 内为双向、在 chunk 间从早到晚流动；每个 repair block 接收压缩 cache 特征，预测的残差加到每个文档 token 的 cache 上。训练语料是一个通用检索语料。
Result: 在三个目标 LLM 与四个下游数据集共 12 组模型-数据集组合中，CacheRepair 有 11 组落在实测的答案质量–延迟 Pareto 前沿上；12 组全部中，最大修复器相对 full prefill 的中位 TTFT（含在线 cache 传输与修复）加速 1.69–4.61×，相对直接复用 cache 的 mean F1 提升 2.1–26.1 个百分点。分析显示修复同时降低 chunk 边界附近与 chunk 内部的 KV 误差。
Conclusion: 用一个按目标 LLM 定制、可跨数据集复用的残差修复网络替代在线重算，就能在保住答案质量的同时把多文档 RAG 的 TTFT 压到接近甚至优于 full prefill 的水平。

papers.title: FlexiWorld: Learning and Planning via Flexible Action Chunks Across Multiple Time Scales
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models predict future states for goal-directed planning using action chunks spanning multiple primitive steps. Existing methods typically use fixed-length chunks and either omit goal-conditioned action generation or limit their supervision to short goal spans. We introduce FlexiWorld, a JEPA-based world model that combines mixed-span goal supervision with variable-length action chunks to improve long-horizon control. During training, we sample varying goal spans and randomly partition the actions into variable-length chunks. We jointly train the world model with a causal action encoder that embeds variable-length chunks and an autoregressive actor that generates primitive actions sequentially. Student Forcing reduces exposure bias by training on generated action prefixes. For planning, Actor-Residual Cross-Entropy Method (ARCEM) combines action-residual search with within-chunk autoregressive feedback and chunk-boundary latent prediction. Across four benchmarks and goal distances, FlexiWorld with ARCEM achieves 89.29% mean success, compared with 83.98% for the strongest baseline. PushT ablations show improved direct control from mixed-span supervision, variable-length chunks, and Student Forcing. Without retraining, FlexiWorld supports different planning chunk lengths: longer chunks accelerate ARCEM by approximately $1.3\times$ on average while maintaining comparable average success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexiWorld 是基于 JEPA 的潜空间世界模型，用混合目标跨度监督加可变长度动作块 (variable-length action chunks) 支持长时程目标导向控制：训练时随机采样目标跨度并随机切分动作块，配合因果动作编码器与自回归 actor，Student Forcing 用生成的动作前缀训练以缓解曝光偏差。规划用 Actor-Residual Cross-Entropy Method (ARCEM)，在四个基准与目标距离上平均成功率 89.29%，强基线为 83.98%；不重训即可换规划块长，更长的块让 ARCEM 平均加速约 1.3× 且成功率相当。
Motivation: 现有潜空间世界模型的动作块长度固定，且要么不做目标条件动作生成、要么监督只覆盖很短的目标跨度，长时程控制因此受限。
Method: JEPA 世界模型 + 混合跨度目标监督：训练时采样不同目标跨度并把动作随机划分为变长块；联合训练因果动作编码器（嵌入变长块）与自回归 actor（逐步生成 primitive action），Student Forcing 用模型生成的动作前缀训练以降低曝光偏差。规划阶段用 ARCEM，结合 action-residual 搜索、块内自回归反馈与块边界的 latent prediction。
Result: 在四个基准与目标距离上，FlexiWorld + ARCEM 平均成功率 89.29%，最强基线 83.98%。PushT 消融显示混合跨度监督、变长动作块与 Student Forcing 各自提升直接控制能力。不重训切换规划块长时，更长的块使 ARCEM 平均加速约 1.3×，同时保持相当的平均成功率。
Conclusion: 把目标监督跨度与动作块长度解耦并配合 ARCEM 规划，可在不重训的前提下同时提高长时程控制成功率并允许按需调节规划速度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored. We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame. PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking. We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation. We further construct PCVE-RigidBench, a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/Hammour-steak/VideoPhysEdit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把物理反事实视频编辑 (PCVE) 形式化为：给定源视频、物理编辑与执行帧，生成编辑后下游运动与交互的反事实视频。VideoPhysEdit 用可仿真复现观测运动的刚体物理场景重建，把编辑当作干预施加，再用仿真轨迹引导无训练的视频生成。在自建 PCVE-RigidBench 上其 Physical Edit Score 为 0.376，是对比方法中唯一为正的分数。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑只处理编辑的视觉后果（阴影、遮挡），编辑引起的后续运动与交互变化基本未被处理；同时缺少成对的事实/反事实数据与专用评测指标。
Method: 提出无训练 (training-free) 管线 VideoPhysEdit：先做刚体物理场景重建，恢复能在仿真中复现观测运动与交互的场景，再把物理编辑作为干预施加，用仿真得到的轨迹引导反事实视频生成；并构建合成基准 PCVE-RigidBench（含成对源/反事实目标视频与物理 ground truth）和新指标 Physical Edit Score。
Result: 在 PCVE-RigidBench 上，VideoPhysEdit 的 Physical Edit Score 为 0.376，是所比较方法中唯一为正的分数，物理编辑准确率显著高于开源方法与商业模型，同时保持有竞争力的视觉保真度；真实视频上的定性对比显示其能更好地呈现编辑诱导的下游运动与交互。
Conclusion: 把物理推理显式化为可仿真复现的场景重建加干预式编辑，是让视频编辑产生可信下游运动与交互的一条可行路径，且无需训练即可迁移到真实场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CTP-FL: Common-Trajectory Gradient Prediction for Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Communication-efficient federated optimization commonly spends several gradient evaluations between server updates. Existing local-update methods use this computation to advance an independent model on each client. Under heterogeneous data, however, these models evaluate gradients at different locations, making the aggregated update difficult to interpret as a gradient of the global objective. We study an alternative use of the same computation budget: \emph{evaluate the global objective along a shared, predicted path}. We propose Common-Trajectory Predictive Federated Learning (\texttt{CTP-FL}). At each round, all clients construct the same sequence of query points from the current global model and the previous aggregated direction, evaluate $K$ stochastic gradients along this sequence, and upload their average. The server then performs a single global update. Thus, \texttt{CTP-FL} uses $K$ mini-batch gradients per client and one model-sized vector in each communication direction, matching the per-round computation and communication of full-participation FedAvg-M. Shared query points make the aggregated direction an unbiased estimator of the average \emph{global} gradient along the predicted path. The remaining discrepancy from the gradient at the current model is controlled by the path length, without assuming bounded client-gradient dissimilarity or bounded gradients. For smooth non-convex objectives, we establish an $\mathcal{O}\!\left( \sqrt{LΔσ^2/(NKR)}+LΔ/R \right)$ average-stationarity bound under full participation. The analysis isolates a testable trade-off: extending the prediction path provides more forward-looking gradient information but increases its displacement bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CTP-FL 让所有客户端沿同一条由当前全局模型与上一轮聚合方向预测出的共享路径评估 K 个随机梯度并上传均值，服务器只做一次全局更新。共享查询点使聚合方向成为沿预测路径的全局梯度无偏估计，剩余偏差由路径长度控制，无需假设客户端梯度差异或梯度有界。在光滑非凸、全参与下给出 O(√(LΔσ²/(NKR)) + LΔ/R) 的平均平稳性界，揭示路径越长前瞻信息越多但位移偏差越大这一可检验的权衡。
Motivation: 通信高效联邦优化通常在两次服务器更新之间做多次梯度计算，但异构数据下各客户端本地模型落在不同位置，聚合更新难以解释为全局目标的梯度。
Method: CTP-FL：每轮所有客户端从当前全局模型与上一轮聚合方向构造相同查询点序列，沿该序列评估 K 个随机梯度并上传均值，服务器执行一次全局更新；每客户端 K 次 mini-batch 梯度、每个通信方向一个模型大小向量，与全参与 FedAvg-M 的每轮计算与通信量一致。
Result: 共享查询点使聚合方向成为沿预测路径的平均全局梯度的无偏估计；对光滑非凸目标在全参与下建立 O(√(LΔσ²/(NKR)) + LΔ/R) 的平均平稳性界，偏差项由路径长度控制且不依赖有界客户端梯度差异或有界梯度；分析隔离出延长预测路径带来更多前瞻梯度信息但增大位移偏差的权衡。
Conclusion: 把本地计算预算改用于沿共享预测路径评估全局目标，可在不加梯度差异有界假设下给出可解释的聚合方向与收敛界，路径长度是信息量与位移偏差之间的可调旋钮。

papers.title: Explaining Hyperbolic Neural Networks via Geometry-Aware Relevance Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic neural networks introduce geometric operations that require explicit treatment in relevance propagation. Equivalent geometric realizations can produce different feature attributions, even when local relevance is conserved. We study this problem through Geometric Representation Invariance (GRI), a specialization of Implementation Invariance, and zero-curvature consistency, which requires identity relevance propagation when a geometric module approaches the identity. We propose LRP-radial-all for origin-centered radial modules, treating geometric scaling as modulation and assigning relevance entirely to the signal branch. The rule conserves relevance, is invariant to equivalent radial factorizations, and satisfies zero-curvature consistency, yielding GRI for a specified Poincaré-Lorentz logarithmic-map construction. In contrast, a conservative LRP-half baseline can violate both consistency criteria. Experiments on hyperbolic MNIST, sEEG, and CIFAR-10 classifiers assess attribution fidelity, qualitative explanations, and runtime. LRP-radial-all achieves competitive attribution fidelity across datasets with runtime comparable to Gradient$\times$Input and substantially lower than Integrated Gradients. These findings motivate geometry-aware propagation rules that distinguish relevance conservation from consistency across equivalent computations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 双曲神经网络中，等价的几何实现会给出不同的特征归因，即使局部相关性守恒。论文提出 LRP-radial-all：把原点中心径向模块的几何缩放视为调制，相关性全部归给信号分支，从而在守恒之外还满足零曲率一致性并获得指定 Poincaré-Lorentz 对数映射构造下的几何表示不变性 (GRI)；保守的 LRP-half 基线会同时违反这两条一致性判据。
Motivation: 双曲几何运算在相关性传播 (LRP) 中需要显式处理：等价的几何实现即使局部相关性守恒也会产生不同归因，说明仅有守恒不足以保证解释稳定。
Method: 把 Implementation Invariance 特化为几何表示不变性 (GRI)，并提出零曲率一致性要求（几何模块趋近恒等时相关性传播退化为恒等）；据此设计 LRP-radial-all，将径向缩放作为调制、相关性全部分配给信号分支，对照保守的 LRP-half 基线。
Result: 在 hyperbolic MNIST、sEEG、CIFAR-10 分类器上评估归因保真度、定性解释与运行时：LRP-radial-all 在各数据集上取得有竞争力的归因保真度，运行时与 Gradient×Input 相当、显著低于 Integrated Gradients；LRP-half 会同时违反 GRI 与零曲率一致性。
Conclusion: 相关性守恒与跨等价计算的一致性是两个不同要求，几何感知的传播规则需要把二者分开处理，径向模块应把相关性全部归给信号分支。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Multimodal Autonomic Sensing Framework for Objective Assessment of Patient Responses to Dental Pulp Stimulation
papers.abstract_en: Patient responses to dental pulp testing, ranging from no sensation to intense pain, provide important information for assessing pulp status in endodontic diagnosis. However, pain is a subjective sensory and emotional experience that varies considerably across individuals and can be difficult to communicate. We investigated whether complementary autonomic signals could support objective assessment of responses during dental examination. Forty-nine patients underwent cold pulp testing, yielding no-response, mild-response, and intense-response conditions. The framework integrated ECG-derived skin nerve activity (SKNA) and R-R intervals (RRI), together with electrodermal activity (EDA), using temporal convolutional network encoders with attention-based mid-level fusion. Individual baseline signals and subject-level covariates, including anxiety scores and biological sex, were also incorporated. The framework achieved 80.2% balanced accuracy, 75.2% sensitivity, and 85.2% specificity for binary classification of no response versus mild or intense response. For three-class classification, it achieved 60.0% balanced accuracy and a 58.8% macro-averaged F1 score. Ablation and attention-weight analyses indicated that EDA contributed most strongly to model performance, followed by RRI, while SKNA improved balanced accuracy by approximately five percentage points. Age was significantly associated with model performance. These findings support the feasibility of multimodal autonomic sensing for objective, non-invasive assessment of responses to dental pulp stimulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ECG 提取的皮肤神经活动 (SKNA)、R-R 间期 (RRI) 与 EDA，经时序卷积网络编码器加注意力中层融合，客观分级牙髓冷刺激反应。49 名患者上二分类无反应 vs 轻/强反应 balanced accuracy 80.2%，三分类 60.0%；EDA 贡献最大，SKNA 约带来 5 个百分点的 balanced accuracy 提升。
Motivation: 牙髓测试的疼痛是主观体验，个体差异大且难以言传，临床上缺少客观、非侵入的反应分级手段。
Method: 融合 ECG 派生的 SKNA 与 RRI、EDA 三路信号，用时序卷积网络 (TCN) 编码器加基于注意力的中层融合；同时纳入个体基线信号与被试层协变量（焦虑评分、生理性别），并做消融与注意力权重分析。
Result: 49 名患者接受冷牙髓测试，分无反应/轻反应/强反应三种条件。二分类（无反应 vs 轻或强反应）balanced accuracy 80.2%、sensitivity 75.2%、specificity 85.2%；三分类 balanced accuracy 60.0%、macro-averaged F1 58.8%。消融显示 EDA 贡献最强，其次 RRI，SKNA 使 balanced accuracy 提升约 5 个百分点；年龄与模型表现显著相关。
Conclusion: 多模态自主神经信号可在牙髓刺激下做客观、非侵入的反应评估，EDA 是主要信息来源，年龄会显著影响模型表现。

papers.title: Style-Driven Data Synthesis and Degradation-Aware Enhancement for Ultrasound Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Low-cost handheld ultrasound devices can be widely deployed compared to professional hospital ultrasound machines. However, their images suffer from compound degradation that can mislead clinical judgment. Motivated by this observation, mapping handheld low-quality (LQ) to hospital high-quality (HQ) images has been considered a valuable research question. Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ-HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ-HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ-to-LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ-to-HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix. Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对手持超声与医院超声之间缺乏像素对齐 LQ-HQ 图像对的问题，提出两阶段框架：先用循环一致风格迁移从未对齐真实对学出 HQ→LQ 映射并合成像素对齐数据，再用 Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) LoRA 微调基于 PiISA-SR 的增强模型。在 USenhance2023 上 FID 相对最强基线改善 16.7%。
Motivation: 手持超声成本低易普及，但图像存在复合退化、可能误导临床判断；而真实 LQ-HQ 扫描在不同时间获取、永远无法像素对齐，使监督训练所需的配对数据难以获得。
Method: 两阶段：第一阶段在未对齐的真实 LQ-HQ 对上训练循环一致 (cycle-consistent) 风格迁移模型，得到 HQ→LQ 生成器，把真实 HQ 图转成像素对齐的 LQ 图；第二阶段基于 PiSA-SR 框架，用 Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 插入退化条件校正矩阵，在合成对上微调 LQ→HQ 模型。
Result: 在 USenhance2023 数据集上，FID 相对最强基线改善 16.7%，其余指标显示输出与真实 HQ 分布对齐良好。
Conclusion: 先合成像素对齐退化数据、再以退化条件 LoRA 微调，可在无真实配对的情况下把 LQ 超声拉向 HQ 分布。
Relevance: 4
