papers.title: Tool Mediation Alters Refusal Mechanisms in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with access to external tools, yet harmful tool-mediated interactions are less likely to be refused when compared to regular conversational ones. As this change in refusal behavior remains underexplored, we investigate its underlying mechanisms across a diverse set of open-weight language models. We find that information about the harmfulness of a request remains strongly encoded in the model's representations and transfers across conversational and tool-mediated inputs. Evidence from representation geometry and neuron-level analysis further indicates that the two interaction modes systematically distribute harm-related computation differently. Crucially, while conversational inputs can be refused at relatively low levels of perceived harmfulness, tool-mediated inputs remain permissive until harmfulness crosses a substantially higher effective refusal threshold. Moreover, tool-mediated refusal is also more brittle: progressively weakening the refusal computation disrupts tool-mediated refusal at lower intervention strengths than conversational refusal, even when benign capabilities remain intact. Together, our findings indicate that tool mediation does not simply reduce the internal perception of harm, but instead impacts its conversion into refusal. Overall, this suggests tool-mediated environments may intrinsically reduce robustness of models to harmful requests, and that conventional safety evaluations may not fully transfer to LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具中介使 LLM 对有害请求更少拒绝，但并非因为模型感知到的危害降低：危害信息在表征中仍强编码且跨对话与工具两种输入迁移，改变的是危害到拒绝的转换——工具输入要到更高的有效拒绝阈值才拒绝，且拒绝计算更脆弱，更弱的干预即可破坏。
Motivation: 带外部工具的 LLM 中，工具中介的有害交互比普通对话更少被拒绝，这一拒绝行为变化的内部机制研究不足，且可能使常规安全评测无法迁移到 LLM agent。
Method: 在一组开源权重 (open-weight) 语言模型上，对比对话式与工具中介两类输入，结合表征几何 (representation geometry) 与神经元层面分析定位危害相关计算的分布，并通过逐步削弱拒绝计算来测试拒绝的稳健性。
Result: 危害性信息在模型表征中仍强编码并跨对话与工具输入迁移；两种交互模式系统性地以不同方式分布危害相关计算；对话输入在较低感知危害水平即可拒绝，工具输入需危害超过明显更高的有效拒绝阈值才转为允许；逐步削弱拒绝计算时，工具中介拒绝在比对话拒绝更低的干预强度下即被破坏，而良性能力保持完好。
Conclusion: 工具中介不降低模型对危害的内部感知，而是改变危害向拒绝的转换，因此工具中介环境可能内在降低模型对有害请求的稳健性，常规安全评测对 LLM agent 不完全适用。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 工具中介使 LLM 对有害请求更少拒绝，但并非因为模型感知到的危害降低：危害信息在表征中仍强编码且跨对话与工具两种输入迁移，改变的是危害到拒绝的转换——工具输入要到更高的有效拒绝阈值才拒绝，且拒绝计算更脆弱，更弱的干预即可破坏。
summary_sections.motivation: 带外部工具的 LLM 中，工具中介的有害交互比普通对话更少被拒绝，这一拒绝行为变化的内部机制研究不足，且可能使常规安全评测无法迁移到 LLM agent。
summary_sections.method: 在一组开源权重 (open-weight) 语言模型上，对比对话式与工具中介两类输入，结合表征几何 (representation geometry) 与神经元层面分析定位危害相关计算的分布，并通过逐步削弱拒绝计算来测试拒绝的稳健性。
summary_sections.result: 危害性信息在模型表征中仍强编码并跨对话与工具输入迁移；两种交互模式系统性地以不同方式分布危害相关计算；对话输入在较低感知危害水平即可拒绝，工具输入需危害超过明显更高的有效拒绝阈值才转为允许；逐步削弱拒绝计算时，工具中介拒绝在比对话拒绝更低的干预强度下即被破坏，而良性能力保持完好。
summary_sections.conclusion: 工具中介不降低模型对危害的内部感知，而是改变危害向拒绝的转换，因此工具中介环境可能内在降低模型对有害请求的稳健性，常规安全评测对 LLM agent 不完全适用。

papers.title: DuplexCadence: Exact State and Execution from a Speech Model's Declared Timelines
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech models support streaming interaction that listens and speaks at the same time. Serving them is governed by a strict, repeating deadline: conversation advances on a one-second cadence, and every second of input must be turned into a second of speech before the next second arrives. Because stages within a session run in strict sequence, per-invocation overhead cannot be batched away. Profiling reveals that the autoregressive stages of a duplex second already fit within the period, whereas the token-to-audio synthesis tail is what causes overruns. This tail stage suffers from orchestration slack where the GPU is left waiting as thousands of tiny, regular operations are issued one by one, while also wasting substantial memory by over-provisioning state at static implementation constants. Existing remedies, such as graph recording and demand-sized allocation, fail because streaming state dynamics violate their prerequisites. The root cause is that the runtime lacks the model's native clocks: the per-region counters that govern advancement rates and retention policies. We propose DuplexCadence, which explicitly declares native clocks to the runtime and derives two mutually enabling rules: demand-sized state allocation at a stable address, and exact-shape graph replay without padding. The former eliminates idle memory and stabilizes tensor pointers, while the latter removes orchestration slack without padding overhead. Evaluated on four released models across three decoder architectures with bit-for-bit identical output, DuplexCadence reaches $2.85\times$ the stock runtime's speed at $38.8\%$ lower peak memory. On the live duplex path, mean SPEAK time falls from $14\%$ over the one-second cadence to $2\%$ under it, enabling models to reliably keep up with interactive speech while markedly expanding multi-
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuplexCadence 把全双工语音模型自带的 per-region 时钟（native clocks）显式声明给运行时，据此推出两条规则：稳定地址上的按需状态分配，以及无 padding 的 exact-shape 图重放。在四个已发布模型、三种 decoder 架构上输出逐位一致，速度达到原生运行时的 2.85 倍、峰值内存低 38.8%，live duplex 路径上平均 SPEAK 时间从超出 1 秒节奏 14% 变为低于节奏 2%。
Motivation: 全双工语音模型按 1 秒节奏推进，每秒输入必须在下一秒到来前变成一秒语音，且会话内各阶段严格串行，单次调用开销无法靠批处理摊掉。token-to-audio 合成尾部既有 GPU 空等的 orchestration slack，又有静态常量导致的状态过度分配，而 graph recording 与 demand-sized allocation 因流式状态动态不满足前提而失效。
Method: Profiling 定位瓶颈在 token-to-audio synthesis 尾部而非自回归阶段；根因是运行时缺少模型原生时钟（决定推进速率与保留策略的 per-region 计数器）。据此声明 native clocks，并导出两条互相使能的规则：稳定地址上的按需状态分配（消除空闲内存、稳定 tensor 指针），以及 exact-shape 图重放（去掉 orchestration slack 且无 padding 开销）。
Result: 在四个已发布模型、三种 decoder 架构上评估，输出与原生运行时逐位相同（bit-for-bit identical）；速度为原生运行时的 2.85 倍，峰值内存低 38.8%。live duplex 路径上平均 SPEAK 时间从超出 1 秒节奏 14% 降到低于节奏 2%。
Conclusion: 让运行时拿到模型的 native clocks，可以同时解决流式状态的内存过度分配与小算子逐个下发造成的调度空转，使全双工模型可靠跟上 1 秒交互节奏。

papers.title: SymbolicArena: A Unified Infrastructure for Benchmark Distillation and Dynamic Evaluation in Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks concise and interpretable mathematical expressions from data for scientific equation discovery. Existing SR benchmarks face a tradeoff between evaluation cost and benchmark validity. Repeated evaluation of large task pools is expensive, and compact benchmarks lack systematic evidence of preserved task diversity and algorithm discriminability. SymbolicArena provides a unified infrastructure for benchmark distillation and dynamic evaluation. The framework standardizes 664 heterogeneous tasks with executable ground truth expressions and distills the Full Task Set into Core50, a validated benchmark of 50 tasks. The distillation process preserves task coverage and algorithm discrimination under explicit balance constraints. SymbolicArena applies a unified execution protocol to heterogeneous SR algorithms and produces comparable outputs and search trajectories. Multi Axis Evaluation characterizes numerical quality, symbolic quality, and search behavior. Core50 reduces evaluation workload by 92.5% and maintains agreement with Full Task Set evaluations. Experiments show that SymbolicArena achieves 72.6% to 86.7% lower approximation error than alternative selectors, further supporting its fidelity to the Full Task Set. Evaluation reveals a substantial gap between numerical fitting and symbolic recovery across current SR methods, suggesting that reliable equation recovery remains an open challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SymbolicArena 把 664 个异构符号回归 (SR) 任务蒸馏成 50 个任务的 Core50，在显式平衡约束下保持任务覆盖与算法区分度，评估工作量降低 92.5% 且与全任务集评估一致。其蒸馏选择器的近似误差比其他选择器低 72.6%–86.7%；同时揭示当前 SR 方法在数值拟合与符号恢复之间存在明显差距。
Motivation: SR 基准在评估成本与有效性之间取舍：大任务池反复评估昂贵，紧凑基准又缺乏任务多样性与算法区分度得以保留的系统证据。
Method: 统一基础设施标准化 664 个带可执行真实表达式的异构任务，在显式平衡约束下把 Full Task Set 蒸馏为 Core50；用统一执行协议运行异构 SR 算法，产出可比较的输出与搜索轨迹，并以 Multi Axis Evaluation 刻画数值质量、符号质量与搜索行为三个轴。
Result: Core50 将评估工作量降低 92.5%，并与 Full Task Set 评估保持一致；蒸馏选择器的近似误差比其他选择器低 72.6%–86.7%；评估显示当前 SR 方法的数值拟合与符号恢复之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 在平衡约束下蒸馏出的 50 任务子集足以替代 664 任务全集做可信 SR 比较，但可靠的方程恢复对现有 SR 方法仍是未解难题。

papers.title: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. Together, these optimizations deliver up to 30x end-to-end speedup and 20% lower memory: a 5-second 1344x768 video with audio is generated 3.5x faster than real time on an 8xGB200 node, and in under a minute fully memory-resident on a single DGX Spark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向视频扩散模型 MiniMax-H3（33B 参数）的全栈推理加速：跨分辨率两阶段调度器用早期低分辨率建全局布局、后期高分辨率精修细节，中间用学习的 latent-to-latent 映射替代 VAE 解码-重编码；再叠加 RSI 循环搜索算子融合与内存布局。端到端最高 30x 加速、内存降 20%，8xGB200 上 5 秒 1344x768 带音频视频生成速度为实时的 3.5 倍，单台 DGX Spark 上一分钟内全内存驻留。
Motivation: MiniMax-H3 的 33B 参数与多步迭代去噪带来沉重计算开销：云端（NVIDIA-GB200）受生成延迟制约，边缘设备（DGX-Spark）受严格内存限制，跨云到边的硬件瓶颈不同，需要同时优化算法与算子。
Method: 算法侧提出 cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler，利用扩散的分步特性：早期低分辨率步快速建立全局布局，后期高分辨率步精修局部与感知细节，两阶段由学习得到的 latent-to-latent mapping 模块衔接，完全省去分辨率转换时开销大的 VAE decode-reencode 循环；算子侧部署 Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) 循环，搜索 kernel fusion 与内存布局，评估时同时看 latency 与数值一致性 (numerical agreement)。
Result: 端到端最高 30x 加速、内存占用降低 20%；在 8xGB200 节点上，一段 5 秒 1344x768 带音频视频的生成速度达到实时的 3.5 倍；在单台 DGX Spark 上不到一分钟即可完全内存驻留地生成。
Conclusion: 把跨分辨率调度与 RSI 算子搜索放进同一条全栈流水线，可以让生产级视频扩散模型在云端降延迟、在边缘满足内存约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Using Context Is Not Enough: Test-Time Training for Personalized Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models (LLMs) with human preferences, yet most pipelines learn a single reward model that overlooks individual differences in preferences. Personalized reward models (PRMs) address this by conditioning rewards on user-specific feedback, most commonly through in-context learning (ICL), where a user's historical comparisons are supplied as contextual preference pairs. However, we identify a key limitation of ICL-based PRMs: they fail to capture the preference relations conveyed by contextual pairs. To address this, we propose Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT), which explicitly encodes these relations into user-specific fast weights for personalized reward prediction. P-TTT introduces sequence-level update and apply operations to match the response-level granularity of preference feedback, together with a preference-aligned objective that directly uses pairwise preference relations to guide fast-weight adaptation. Notably, P-TTT is simple to implement and computationally efficient, updating fast weights within a single forward pass without inference-time backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that P-TTT more effectively captures historical preference relations and outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对个性化奖励模型 (PRM) 中 in-context learning 无法真正捕捉上下文偏好对所含偏好关系的问题，提出 P-TTT：把关系显式编码为用户专属 fast weights，并用序列级 update/apply 操作与偏好对齐目标在单次前向内完成适配。实验显示 P-TTT 更好捕捉历史偏好关系，并以较大差距超过现有最优方法。
Motivation: RLHF 常用单一奖励模型，忽略个体偏好差异；现有基于 ICL 的 PRM 把用户历史比较作为上下文偏好对输入，却无法捕捉这些上下文对所传达的偏好关系。
Method: P-TTT 将偏好关系显式编码进用户专属 fast weights：引入序列级 update 与 apply 操作以匹配偏好反馈的 response 级粒度，并设计偏好对齐目标，直接用 pairwise preference 关系引导 fast-weight 适配；适配在单次前向传播内完成，推理时不需反向传播。
Result: 实验表明 P-TTT 比基于 ICL 的方法更有效地捕捉历史偏好关系，并以较大差距优于 state-of-the-art 方法；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 仅靠上下文提供偏好对不足以做个性化奖励预测，把偏好关系写进可快速适配的权重（且不增加推理期反向传播开销）才是更有效的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A mechanistic study of language model introspection
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can sometimes report perturbations to their internal activations---even when the input provides no evidence that an intervention occurred. How do models detect and localize such internal changes? We study this question using a controlled task that keeps the input text fixed. We either inject a concept vector into the hidden state at one of ten token positions or apply no intervention. The model is asked to identify the perturbed position or report that no intervention occurred. Across three model families, we identify two small groups of attention heads with distinct roles in introspective reporting. Middle-layer gate heads influence whether the model reports a change, while router heads in a later layer help select the position to report. Interventions on gate heads can suppress position reports even when router heads supply location information. We further examine why reporting accuracy varies across concepts. Concept vectors that are localized more accurately produce stronger attention-score and output responses in gate heads, which is associated with better alignment of the induced key and value changes in their QK and OV computations. Together, these findings identify attention-head mechanisms supporting introspective detection and localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在输入文本固定、仅向十个 token 位置之一注入 concept vector 的受控任务中，模型靠两组注意力头报告内部扰动：中层 gate heads 决定是否报告变化，更晚层的 router heads 决定报告哪个位置；干预 gate heads 会在 router 已给出位置信息时仍压制位置报告。定位更准的 concept vector 在 gate heads 上引发更强的 attention-score 与输出响应，且其诱导的 key/value 变化在 QK 与 OV 计算中对齐更好。
Motivation: LLM 有时会报告内部激活被扰动，而输入文本毫无证据，模型如何检测并定位这类内部变化本身机制不明，需要在输入固定、干预可控的条件下拆解。
Method: 构造输入文本固定的受控任务：在十个 token 位置之一注入 concept vector 或不干预，让模型指出被扰动位置或报告未发生干预；跨三个模型家族定位承担内省报告的注意力头，并对 gate heads 做干预实验，再按 concept 比较 attention-score、输出响应与 QK/OV 中 key/value 变化的对齐程度。
Result: 识别出两组小型注意力头：中层 gate heads 影响模型是否报告变化，更晚层 router heads 帮助选择所报告的位置；对 gate heads 的干预可在 router heads 已提供位置信息时压制位置报告。定位更准的 concept vector 在 gate heads 上产生更强的 attention-score 与输出响应，并伴随诱导的 key/value 变化在 QK 与 OV 计算中更好对齐，这与更高的报告准确率相关。
Conclusion: 内省报告由分工明确的注意力头机制支撑：gate heads 管检测、router heads 管定位，报告准确率随 concept 在 gate heads 上的可定位性与 QK/OV 对齐程度而变化。

papers.title: DoAtlas-2: A Foundation for Self-Evolving Causal Biomedical Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DoAtlas-2, a foundation for self-evolving causal biomedical discovery that organizes knowledge around causal mechanisms and advances through external evidence from human populations. DoAtlas-2 integrates 771 research resources covering more than 720,000 participants in 48 countries, from longitudinal clinical phenotypes, medical imaging, and continuous physiological signals to eight molecular layers, together with an evidence network of approximately 4.7 million literature-derived records over 93,566 concepts and 149,383 candidate causal relations. DoAtlas-2 autonomously formulates research questions from evidence gaps and unresolved mechanisms, prespecifies their causal designs, and generates validated analyses. Supporting, challenging, and unresolved results continuously revise mechanistic interpretations, the causal evidence state, and the discovery frontier, so that DoAtlas-2 self-evolves within a closed loop of hypothesis generation, empirical testing, and renewed discovery. DoAtlas-2 has systematically evaluated 2,031 research questions. In the Human Phenotype Project (HPP), it formulated 4,014 candidate pathway questions across vascular, early-glycemic, and hepatic-metabolic systems, and screening of the first 1,079 yielded statistical support for 756. Representative studies identify blood pressure as a convergence node linking adiposity, hepatic, and lipid phenotypes to vascular outcomes, and show that an adiposity-inflammation-blood-pressure pathway is largely attenuated by joint adjustment for body mass index (BMI) and smoking. The discovered vascular network constitutes a completely interpretable predictive foundation, admitting exact attribution of every prediction and closed-form mediation effects. DoAtlas-2 thereby unifies causal mechanism discovery, population-evidence testing, and interpretable prediction within one continuously evolving foundation.
papers.comment: Technical report. 185 pages, 5 figures. Yulong Li, Rong Xia and Yuxuan Zhang contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Eran Segal, Imran Razzak
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DoAtlas-2 把 771 项研究资源、约 470 万条文献证据网络组织成以因果机制为索引的自演化生物医学发现底座，自主提出问题、预设因果设计并生成经验证的分析，结果再回写机制解释与发现前沿形成闭环。已系统评估 2,031 个研究问题；在 Human Phenotype Project 中筛出的前 1,079 个通路问题有 756 个获得统计支持，并识别出血压是脂肪、肝脏与脂质表型连接血管结局的汇聚节点。
Motivation: 生物医学证据分散在纵向表型、影像、生理信号与八类分子层中，机制解释与预测模型彼此割裂，缺少能从证据缺口自主提出问题并闭环检验的系统。
Method: 整合 771 项研究资源（覆盖 48 国 72 万余参与者）与约 470 万条文献衍生记录（93,566 个概念、149,383 条候选因果关系）；从证据缺口自主生成研究问题、预设因果设计并产出经验证的分析，用支持/挑战/未决结果持续修订机制解释与因果证据状态，形成假设-检验-再发现的闭环。
Result: 系统评估 2,031 个研究问题；在 HPP 中提出 4,014 个候选通路问题（血管、早期血糖、肝脏代谢系统），筛查前 1,079 个后 756 个获得统计支持。代表性结果：血压是连接肥胖、肝脏与脂质表型到血管结局的汇聚节点；肥胖-炎症-血压通路在同时校正 BMI 与吸烟后基本被削弱。血管网络作为完全可解释的预测基础，支持对每次预测的精确归因与闭式中介效应。
Conclusion: 因果机制发现、群体证据检验与可解释预测可以在一个持续演化的底座内统一，且预测可做到逐条归因与闭式中介效应。

papers.title: DRIFT: Disentangled Responsive-Invariant Flow Transport for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cellular responses to perturbations is a central problem in cellular biology, with broad applications in systems biology and drug discovery. This task is challenging because cellular responses can be complex and cell-state dependent, intrinsic cell-to-cell variability can be confounded with perturbation effects, and destructive single-cell RNA sequencing precludes paired measurements of the same cell before and after treatment. Flow matching transports control cells to perturbed states flexibly, but acting on the full cell state can confound perturbation effects with pre-existing cell-to-cell variability. Disentangled approaches separate responsive from invariant components, but model perturbations through prescribed mechanisms, such as latent shifts or graph edits, limiting their flexibility. We address both limitations in a unified framework. A variational encoder disentangles each cell into an invariant block, capturing state unaffected by the perturbation, and a responsive block, capturing state it changes, through conditional priors and an information-theoretic invariance constraint. Conditional flow matching transports only the responsive block, conditioned on the perturbation and invariant state, yielding a flexible, data-driven model of perturbation effects without confounding pre-existing variability. Across several benchmarks, our method outperforms the strongest published method in settings involving combinatorial and unseen perturbation prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRIFT 用变式编码器把单细胞拆成不变块与响应块，只对响应块做条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching)，从而把扰动效应与细胞间本征变异分开。在组合扰动与未见扰动预测设置上超过最强已发表方法。
Motivation: 单细胞扰动预测中，破坏性 scRNA-seq 无法配对同一细胞的处理前后，细胞间变异易与扰动效应混淆；现有解耦方法又把扰动写死为潜变量平移或图编辑，灵活性受限。
Method: 变式编码器通过条件先验与信息论不变性约束，把每个细胞解耦为不变块与响应块；条件流匹配只传输响应块，以扰动和不变状态为条件，数据驱动地建模扰动效应。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上，该方法在组合 (combinatorial) 与未见 (unseen) 扰动预测设置中超过最强已发表方法。
Conclusion: 只对响应块做流传输、把不变块作为条件，可以在不混淆本征变异的前提下灵活学习扰动效应，优势集中在组合与未见扰动场景。

papers.title: E3J: An Efficient and Open-Source Backend for Euclidean Equivariant Operations on GPU and TPU
papers.abstract_en: We present e3j, a fast Euclid-equivariance backend for geometric deep learning applications with JAX bindings for GPU and TPU. Leveraging both optimized CUDA and Pallas kernels and algorithmic improvements, the library achieves state-of-the-art throughput and runtime on both forward and backward paths. On a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) use case, it outperforms established backends, measuring up to 34% speed-up over cuEquivariance on water box NPT simulation using MACE, while remaining fully open source. E3j achieves over 80% efficiency over the H100 maximum memory bandwidth on tensor product operations, and in many cases more than doubles throughput of message passing convolutions forward compared to previously available backends. In addition, with the release of dedicated Pallas TPU kernel, e3j opens the possibility of large scale equivariant deep learning workloads on TPU architectures, which has so far been difficult to achieve. Our benchmarks show that e3j also achieves over 80% of a TPUv6e memory bandwidth, up to one order of magnitude more than e3nn-jax. The library is available on GitHub, PyPI and is released under an open source Apache 2.0 license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: e3j 是面向 GPU/TPU 的开源 Euclidean 等变算子后端，用优化的 CUDA 与 Pallas kernel 加算法改进提升前向与反向吞吐。在 MLIP 场景中比 cuEquivariance 最高快 34%，张量积算子达到 H100 峰值内存带宽 80% 以上，TPUv6e 上达其带宽 80% 以上、较 e3nn-jax 最高快一个数量级。
Motivation: 几何深度学习的等变算子（张量积、消息传递卷积）在 GPU 上带宽利用率低，TPU 上更缺少可用 kernel，限制了大规模等变模型训练。
Method: e3j 提供 JAX 绑定的 Euclidean 等变算子后端，结合优化 CUDA kernel 与 Pallas TPU kernel，并做算法层改进，覆盖前向与反向路径；以 MLIP（MACE、水盒 NPT 模拟）为用例，Apache 2.0 开源发布于 GitHub 与 PyPI。
Result: 水盒 NPT 模拟（MACE）上较 cuEquivariance 最高提速 34%；张量积算子在 H100 上超过峰值内存带宽的 80%；消息传递卷积前向吞吐在多数情况下较既有后端翻倍以上；TPUv6e 上超过其内存带宽的 80%，较 e3nn-jax 最高快约一个数量级。
Conclusion: 等变算子的性能瓶颈可通过专用 GPU/TPU kernel 与算法改进同时缓解，且该后端可完全开源复现，并首次使 TPU 上的大规模等变深度学习成为可能。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SpikeLite: Lightweight Spiking Neural Networks for Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient paradigm for time-series forecasting through spike-driven computation. However, recent SNN forecasters often pursue higher accuracy through increasingly complex attention mechanisms, or specialized neuronal dynamics, weakening the lightweight motivation of SNNs. We introduce SpikeLite, a spiking forecasting framework built around two modules: a Frequency-Selective Spiking Encoder (FSSE) for frequency-sensitive temporal encoding and a Sparse Spiking Channel Attention (SSCA) module for selective cross-channel interaction. FSSE exploits the low-pass filtering behavior of LIF dynamics to reorganize each input sequence into frequency-sensitive components while collectively preserving the input at the decomposition stage. SSCA then learns a binary mask from encoded channel representations and uses it to selectively exchange information within spike-driven self-attention, retaining informative cross-channel interactions while suppressing redundant ones. When explicit channel interaction is unnecessary, SpikeLite uses the lighter FSSE-only channel-independent path. Experiments under the SeqSNN and SpikF protocols cover four standard multivariate and eight long-term forecasting benchmarks. SpikeLite achieves the best aggregate performance under both protocols, with an average $R^2$ of 0.790 and RSE of 0.440, and lowest average MSE/MAE of 0.343/0.345 in long-term forecasting. Moreover, evaluation on the ECL dataset shows that SpikeLite achieves the lowest reported energy consumption, further demonstrating its potential for energy-efficient time-series forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpikeLite 用频率选择性脉冲编码器 (FSSE) 借 LIF 低通行为把序列重组成频率敏感分量，再用稀疏脉冲通道注意力 (SSCA) 学二值掩码做选择性跨通道交互，通道无关时退回仅 FSSE 的轻量路径。在 SeqSNN 与 SpikF 协议的 4 个多变量与 8 个长期预报基准上取得两协议最佳综合性能，长期预报平均 MSE/MAE 0.343/0.345，ECL 上报告最低能耗。
Motivation: 现有 SNN 时序预报模型为追精度不断堆叠复杂注意力与专用神经元动力学，反而削弱了 SNN 本应具备的轻量与低能耗优势。
Method: FSSE 利用 LIF 动力学的低通滤波特性，在分解阶段重组输入序列并整体保留输入，得到频率敏感的时间编码；SSCA 从编码后的通道表示学一个二值掩码，在脉冲驱动自注意力中选择性交换信息、抑制冗余通道；显式通道交互不必要时切换到仅 FSSE 的 channel-independent 路径。评测遵循 SeqSNN 与 SpikF 两套协议。
Result: 在 SeqSNN 与 SpikF 两协议下均取得最佳综合表现，平均 R² 为 0.790、RSE 为 0.440；长期预报基准上平均 MSE/MAE 最低，为 0.343/0.345；评测覆盖 4 个多变量与 8 个长期预报基准，ECL 数据集上取得已报告中最低的能耗。
Conclusion: 把频率选择编码与稀疏通道选择结合，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下把 SNN 时序预报器保持在轻量、低能耗的定位上，长期预报与能耗两个方向同时占优。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.conclusion: 把频率选择编码与稀疏通道选择结合，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下把 SNN 时序预报器保持在轻量、低能耗的定位上，长期预报与能耗两个方向同时占优。

papers.title: DF-CBM: Region-Aware Concept Bottleneck Models for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detection methods have become increasingly effective yet most provide limited insight into the evidence behind their predictions. However, in forensic settings users also need to know which manipulation cues support the decision and where they appear. Existing explainability methods only partially address this need since localization-based approaches lack semantic descriptions while language-based explanation methods are only weakly grounded in visual evidence. In this work, we propose DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM builds a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from textual artifact annotations and links each concept to plausible facial and boundary regions. It then predicts these concepts from visual features using a concept-specific masked attention mechanism guided by parsed facial masks and the final real/fake decision is made from the predicted concept bottleneck. Our experiments show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Finally, qualitative results and intervention analyses demonstrate that DF-CBM provides spatially grounded concept evidence and enables counterfactual explanations of how individual manipulation concepts influence the final prediction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DF-CBM 把深伪检测的判据显式建模为可解释的概念瓶颈：从文本工件标注构建操纵相关概念词表，将每个概念绑定到人脸与边界区域，再用受解析人脸掩码引导的概念专属掩码注意力从视觉特征预测概念，最终 real/fake 决策由概念瓶颈给出。实验显示它在概念预测与深伪分类上超过概念类基线，同时与 SOTA 黑盒检测器保持竞争力，并支持空间落地的概念证据与反事实解释。
Motivation: 现有深伪检测多为黑盒，取证场景需要知道支持判定的操纵线索是什么、出现在哪里；而定位类可解释方法缺语义描述，语言类解释方法又与视觉证据弱绑定。
Method: DF-CBM 从文本工件标注构建紧凑的操纵相关概念词表，把每个概念关联到人脸与边界区域；用解析人脸掩码引导的概念专属掩码注意力 (concept-specific masked attention) 从视觉特征预测概念，real/fake 判定由预测出的概念瓶颈做出。
Result: 在概念预测与深伪分类上优于概念类基线，同时与 SOTA 黑盒检测器保持竞争力；定性结果与干预分析显示其提供空间落地的概念证据，并能给出单个操纵概念如何影响最终预测的反事实解释。
Conclusion: 把概念瓶颈与人脸区域先验结合，可以在不牺牲检测竞争力的前提下给出可干预、可反事实的取证级解释；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Advancing Video-Text Pretraining with Multi-View Captions
papers.abstract_en: Video-text pretraining has achieved remarkable progress through the scaling of models and datasets, yet the quality of language supervision remains underexplored. Existing web-scale datasets often provide only a single sparse caption per video that fails to capture rich spatiotemporal semantics, while directly using captioning models can generate noisy descriptions. We propose a large-scale multimodal large language model-based supervision generation framework that improves supervision diversity, fidelity, and semantic coverage. Starting from 10 million videos, our approach generates multi-view captions (MVC) through complementary summary and detailed captions, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive caption generation. To effectively exploit supervision at different granularities, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views. We pretrain video-text models using the resulting supervision corpus and evaluate them across standard, fine-grained and detailed text-to-video retrieval benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance while using smaller pretraining corpora than existing methods, demonstrating the importance of rich and complementary textual supervision for video-text pretraining. Project page: https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于多模态大语言模型的多视角描述 (multi-view captions, MVC) 生成框架，从 1000 万条视频出发，用摘要式与细节式互补描述、基于推理的精炼和语义正例描述扩充监督语料，并以粒度感知文本表示（摘要与细节视图各用独立 CLS token）预训练视频-文本模型。在标准、细粒度与详细文本到视频检索基准上，零样本与微调性能一致提升，且所用预训练语料规模小于现有方法。
Motivation: 网络规模视频-文本数据集通常每条视频只有一句稀疏描述，覆盖不了丰富的时空语义，而直接调用描述生成模型又会引入噪声，语言监督质量这一环节长期被忽视。
Method: 以 1000 万条视频为起点，用 MLLM 生成多视角描述：互补的摘要式与细节式 caption、基于推理的精炼 (reasoning-based refinement)、以及语义正例 caption 生成；再引入粒度感知文本表示，为摘要视图与细节视图分别设置独立 CLS token，最后用该监督语料预训练视频-文本模型。
Result: 在标准、细粒度与详细文本到视频检索基准上，零样本与微调设置的性能均一致提升，且使用的预训练语料比现有方法更小；监督语料由 1000 万条视频生成。
Conclusion: 丰富且互补的文本监督比单纯扩大模型与数据规模更能推动视频-文本预训练，多视角描述可在更小语料下同时提高检索的零样本与微调表现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Can Generative AI Automate Data Extraction for Meta-Analysis? A Case Study on Intercropping Research
papers.abstract_en: Meta-analysis is the synthesis of information from multiple sources to arrive at an overarching conclusion. There is a large need for meta-analysis in agricultural research to synthesize what is known and analyze overarching patterns. Extracting data from published literature is, however, labor-intensive, time-consuming, and tedious, and is impeded by a lack of standardization in research design, units of measurement, and terminology. These challenges are particularly evident in the domain of crop species mixtures, also called intercropping. With the growing capabilities of LLMs, many recent attempts have focused on building systems and tools to automate data collection, yet rigorous assessment against human-labeled ground truth is often missing. In this research, we evaluate three LLM-based approaches---direct zero-shot prompting, a staged workflow, and a multi-agent system---with six open-weight models to extract data from the intercropping literature. The results are evaluated against the manually curated ground truth and through a downstream statistical analysis. Overall, direct zero-shot prompting is the strongest and most consistent approach, achieving the highest mean similarity-adjusted F1 of 0.577, although none of the approaches is close to fully accurate. In the downstream analysis, most model--approach combinations recover the direction of the relationship between the predictor and outcome variables, but do not estimate its magnitude accurately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用三种 LLM 抽取路线（直接 zero-shot、分阶段 workflow、multi-agent）配合六个开源权重模型，从间作 (intercropping) 文献中自动抽取 meta-analysis 数据，并与人工整理的 ground truth 及下游统计分析对照。直接 zero-shot prompting 最强且最稳，mean similarity-adjusted F1 达 0.577，但没有一种路线接近完全准确；下游分析中多数模型-路线组合能恢复预测变量与结果变量关系的方向，却估不准其量值。
Motivation: 农业 meta-analysis 需要从文献中大量抽取数据，但研究设计、单位与术语缺乏标准化，人工抽取费时费力；现有 LLM 自动化工具又普遍缺少与人工标注 ground truth 的严格对照。
Method: 评估三种 LLM 方法——直接 zero-shot prompting、分阶段 workflow、multi-agent system——在六个 open-weight 模型上从间作文献抽取数据；对照人工整理的 ground truth 打分，并做一次下游统计分析检验抽取结果的可用性。
Result: 直接 zero-shot prompting 表现最强且最一致，mean similarity-adjusted F1 最高为 0.577，但三种方法都远未达到完全准确；下游分析中大多数模型-方法组合能恢复预测变量与结果变量之间关系的方向，但不能准确估计其量值。
Conclusion: 在间作文献抽取上，更复杂的分阶段或多智能体编排并未胜过直接 zero-shot prompting；LLM 抽取可用于判断关系方向，但当前精度不足以支撑量值层面的 meta-analysis 汇总。

papers.title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
authors: Brent ByungHoon Kang (1) ((1) Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST))
papers.abstract_en: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的工具调用在 schema 合法且文本不变时，因宿主侧实现更换而改变安全效果，作者称之为 schema-epoch drift，并提出 formation-consistent dispatch (FCD) 把实现分析与执行权限绑定。在 32 个官方 release 的四个 profile 与预注册对照中，FCD 完成 3 个效果仍私有的待决调用、拦截 3 个效果变公开的调用，而精确 pinning 全拦 6 个、release 级放行全放 6 个但产生 3 个公开效果。
Motivation: 标准 dispatch 不记录 descriptor 与 handler 的关系，schema-valid 且未改动的调用在 rollout、重连或延迟批准时可能获得不同的安全效果，现有放行/拒绝策略只能全放或全拦。
Method: FCD 由 reviewed profile 从官方源码生成声明作用域内效果的 provenance-bound 过近似；在 closed-target 批准策略下，verifier 把每个成型调用作用到摘要上，仅当效果符合该调用的 security contract 时捕获后继状态；用原子准入 (atomic admission) 与 final-hop fence 把该判定保持到效果层，源码精确匹配优先，被捕获的后继仅在源码退役后才生效。
Result: 四个 profile 覆盖 32 个官方 release，其中 29 个无需 release 特定改动、3 个需要升级处理；冻结的 16-release 扩展集与独立 source oracle 一致。预注册 stock 对照中，FCD 完成全部 3 个效果仍私有的待决调用并拦截全部 3 个效果变公开的调用；精确 pinning 与 release 级拒绝拦下全部 6 个调用，release 级放行放行全部 6 个但产生 3 个公开效果。另有生命周期实验证明 formation 捕获的证书可跨源码退役传递。
Conclusion: 把调用成型时的效果判定绑定到执行权限，可以在不全拦的前提下按效果放行或拦截；同一安全证书在源码退役后仍可约束新成型的调用而不扩大原待决调用的权限。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Modeling for Stochastic Discount Factor Portfolios
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study portfolio optimization under the stochastic discount factor (SDF) framework by learning market state representations that capture the underlying risk structures of financial data. This is challenging due to several factors: financial markets exhibit non-stationary dynamics with shifting regimes, multimodal inputs such as price and news data often contain stochastic noise, and existing diffusion-based approaches, while effective for modeling stochastic dynamics, rely on assumptions such as isotropic Gaussian noise that fail to capture the state-dependent nature of financial uncertainty. To address these challenges, we introduce RADAR, a retrieval-augmented diffusion framework that learns market representations by conditioning on similar historical regimes. RADAR leverages retrieval to construct context-dependent noise distributions, applies conditional diffusion to denoise multimodal representations, and initializes the diffusion process using empirical statistics to reflect state-dependent uncertainty. Experiments show that RADAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on key risk-adjusted metrics while producing economically meaningful signals on asset returns and correlations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SDF 框架下做组合优化，提出检索增强扩散框架 RADAR：按相似历史行情 regime 检索构造依赖上下文的噪声分布，用条件扩散去噪多模态市场表征，并以经验统计量初始化扩散过程以反映状态依赖的不确定性。在关键风险调整指标上达到 state-of-the-art，并产出对资产收益与相关性有经济含义的信号。
Motivation: 金融市场非平稳、regime 切换，价格与新闻等多模态输入含随机噪声，而现有扩散方法依赖各向同性高斯噪声假设，刻画不了状态依赖的金融不确定性。
Method: RADAR 检索相似历史 regime 来构造 context-dependent 噪声分布，用 conditional diffusion 去噪多模态市场表征，并用经验统计量初始化扩散过程；表征学习服务于 SDF 框架下的组合优化。

papers.title: GraphHCA: Closed-Form Hindsight Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) has advanced large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly extending to agentic tasks, where sparse terminal rewards make step-level credit assignment essential. Existing methods assign credit from what follows an action in sampled rollouts, but do not explicitly capture its retrospective relation to the realized outcome. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) instead attributes credit through the ratio of hindsight to behavior-policy probabilities, but estimating the hindsight distribution requires an auxiliary model or an extra pass. To address this estimation bottleneck, we propose GraphHCA, a model-free realization of HCA that eliminates explicit hindsight-distribution estimation. For terminal-goal tasks with deterministic transitions, Bayes' rule reduces the hindsight ratio to a ratio of behavior-policy success probabilities at consecutive states. Taking logs yields a state-wise success potential, whose increment across a transition provides step-level credit. GraphHCA estimates this potential from pooled rollouts through a discounted recursion on the induced transition graph, which admits a unique fixed point on any directed graph. The resulting step-level signal is combined with the trajectory-level advantage, requiring neither a learned hindsight model nor an extra forward pass and recovering GRPO when the step-level weight is zero. Among all compared baselines, GraphHCA achieves state-of-the-art results on ALFWorld and WebShop at both LLM scales, and on Sokoban with a vision-language agent. For example, on ALFWorld it improves overall success rate by up to 24.6 points over GRPO and by up to 4.7 points over the strongest step-level baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphHCA 用贝叶斯规则把 hindsight credit assignment 的后验/行为策略概率比化简为相邻状态行为策略成功概率之比，取对数得到状态级成功势，其跨转移的增量即步级信用；该势在诱导转移图上用折扣递归估计，任意有向图上唯一不动点，无需后验模型或额外前向传播，步级权重为零时退化为 GRPO。在 ALFWorld 上整体成功率较 GRPO 最多提升 24.6 点、较最强步级基线最多提升 4.7 点。
Motivation: LLM 智能体的分组 RL 只有稀疏终端奖励，步级信用分配关键；现有方法只看动作之后发生了什么，而 HCA 需要额外模型或一次额外前向传播来估计后验分布。
Method: 对确定性转移的终端目标任务，用贝叶斯规则把 hindsight 比率化为相邻状态行为策略成功概率之比，取对数得状态级成功势，其转移增量作步级信用；势由汇总 rollout 在诱导转移图上的折扣递归估计（任意有向图唯一不动点），再与轨迹级 advantage 组合，步级权重为零时还原 GRPO。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个 LLM 规模上、以及视觉-语言智能体的 Sokoban 上均取得所比较基线中的最好结果；ALFWorld 整体成功率较 GRPO 最多提升 24.6 点，较最强步级基线最多提升 4.7 点。
Conclusion: 免模型的图上折扣递归足以替代显式后验分布估计，给出可与轨迹级 advantage 组合的步级信用信号，并在长程智能体任务上超过现有步级方法。

papers.title: Continuous Variational Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Biological machine learning was long bottlenecked by the ability to synthesize designed DNA. Variational synthesis models control chemical reactions to physically manufacture quadrillions of designed sequences in DNA. However, training these generative models is challenging: constraints on chemical synthesis can force many parameters into a discrete space, limiting the ability to pre-train and fine-tune. In this article we train ``free'' variational synthesis models using stochastic gradient descent in continuous space, and then discretize with post-training quantization to impose hardware and wetware constraints. This enables variational synthesis models to satisfy stringent reward criteria, while still synthesizing diverse designs, achieving a strictly dominating quality-diversity Pareto frontier. We demonstrate by training variational synthesis models of enzymes, peptides, antibody CDRH3s, and regulatory DNA elements. In silico performance is maintained in vitro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出连续变分合成 (variational synthesis) 训练范式：先在连续空间用 SGD 训练自由模型，再用训练后量化 (post-training quantization) 离散化以满足硬件与湿实验约束，从而绕开化学合成约束把参数逼进离散空间、难以预训练与微调的问题。在酶、肽、抗体 CDRH3 与调控 DNA 元件上训练，得到严格占优的质量-多样性 Pareto 前沿，且 in silico 性能在体外实验中得以保持。
Motivation: 变分合成模型要控制化学反应、物理制造千万亿级设计序列，但合成约束迫使大量参数落入离散空间，使预训练与微调受限，训练这类生成模型因此困难。
Method: 先在连续空间用随机梯度下降训练“自由”变分合成模型，随后用训练后量化施加硬件与湿件 (wetware) 约束完成离散化；训练对象覆盖酶、肽、抗体 CDRH3s 和调控 DNA 元件。
Result: 模型在满足严格奖励标准的同时仍合成多样化设计，达成严格占优 (strictly dominating) 的质量-多样性 Pareto 前沿；在酶、肽、抗体 CDRH3s、调控 DNA 元件四类对象上训练，in silico 性能在体外 (in vitro) 得以保持。
Conclusion: 连续训练加训练后量化可以让变分合成模型同时满足严苛合成约束与多样性要求，且计算性能可迁移到湿实验。

papers.title: Cross-Rollout Bellman Closure for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning such as GRPO trains LLM agents by comparing rollouts sampled for each task, without a learned critic. In long-horizon settings, these rollouts revisit shared anchor states, offering cross-rollout evidence for step-level credit. Ideally, step-level credit should incorporate evidence beyond the realized suffixes observed at an anchor while aggregating alternative continuations according to their empirical frequencies. Visit-local averaging pools realized suffix returns at shared anchors and respects observed frequencies, but does not recursively propagate evidence across rollouts, whereas shortest-path estimators have global reach but allow a rarely observed route to dominate an anchor's value. We introduce Cross-Rollout Bellman Closure (CRBC), which merges each rollout group into a finite empirical process with absorbing success and failure boundaries and evaluates its behavior-policy Bellman fixed point with one linear solve. This fixed point uses the same empirical action and transition frequencies to propagate evidence through shared anchors and aggregate alternative continuations. Backing up the resulting state values through observed transitions yields action values, whose gain over the corresponding state value provides step-level credit. A corresponding finite-depth family recovers visit-local return averaging at zero depth and converges to the exact closure as depth increases. The normalized closure credit is combined with the trajectory-level group advantage for policy optimization, without additional environment rollouts. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Sokoban benchmarks with multiple model scales, CRBC consistently improves final performance and learning efficiency. For example, CRBC outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.59 percentage points on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRBC 把同一任务的多条 rollout 合并成带吸收成功/失败边界的有限经验过程，用一次线性求解得到行为策略 Bellman 不动点，再经状态值回溯出动作值，其相对状态值的增益即步级 credit，与轨迹级 group advantage 结合做策略优化且不需额外环境 rollout。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Sokoban 多个模型规模上一致提升最终性能与学习效率，ALFWorld 上 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 比最强评估基线高 5.59 个百分点。
Motivation: GRPO 这类无 critic 的分组 RL 在长程任务中 rollout 会反复经过共享锚状态，但 visit-local 平均只池化已实现后缀、不跨 rollout 递归传播证据，最短路估计虽有全局性却让罕见路径主导锚状态价值。
Method: CRBC 将每个 rollout 组并成带吸收成功/失败边界的有限经验过程，用一次线性求解求行为策略 Bellman 不动点，用同一套经验动作与转移频率跨锚传播证据；再经观测转移回溯状态值得动作值，动作值减状态值给出步级 credit。配套有限深度族在深度为 0 时退化为 visit-local 回报平均、随深度增大收敛到精确闭包；归一化闭包 credit 与轨迹级 group advantage 合并，无需额外环境 rollout。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Sokoban 三个基准、多个模型规模上，CRBC 一致提升最终性能与学习效率；例如在 ALFWorld 上用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 时比最强评估基线高 5.59 个百分点。
Conclusion: 跨 rollout 的 Bellman 闭包能同时实现证据的递归传播与按经验频率聚合替代延续，从而在不增加环境交互的前提下改进长程 LLM agent 的步级 credit 与训练效率。

papers.title: Propagate, Then Sharpen: Post-Hoc Refinement of Frozen Node Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: We study post-hoc refinement of frozen node classifiers: given only the graph $G$ and class distributions $Q$ predicted by a frozen model, can we improve accuracy without access to node features, model parameters, or gradients? APPNP answers this by propagating logits with a restart towards the initial predictions, minimizing the anchored Dirichlet energy. Instead, we consider the Potts energy, and decompose it into a Dirichlet term, which penalizes disagreement between neighbouring nodes, and a Gini term, which penalizes indecision within each node. This decomposition motivates Propagate, Then Sharpen (PtS), which alternates between propagation of class probabilities and node-wise, mass-preserving sharpening, with only one additional hyperparameter selected using labelled validation nodes. Across nine homophilic graphs, with a frozen MLP backbone, PtS improves mean test accuracy over independently tuned APPNP by $1.71$ percentage points on clean inputs and $3.90$ under severe Gaussian feature corruption. Gains over APPNP become smaller, but remain positive with frozen GCN and GraphSAGE backbones. Sharpening also removes most of the accuracy loss of deep propagation: on clean inputs without restart, accuracy falls by $2.2$ points between $2$ and $100$ propagation steps under PtS, compared with $33.8$ for APPNP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有图结构和冻结分类器输出的类别分布、拿不到特征与梯度的条件下，PtS 用 Potts 能量分解（Dirichlet 项惩罚邻居分歧、Gini 项惩罚节点内部犹豫）交替做概率传播与保质量 sharpening，比独立调参的 APPNP 更准。九个同质图上冻结 MLP 骨干时干净输入平均测试精度高 1.71 个百分点、严重高斯特征损坏下高 3.90 个百分点；无 restart 的深传播中，2 到 100 步的精度下降 PtS 仅 2.2 点而 APPNP 为 33.8 点。
Motivation: APPNP 通过带 restart 的 logit 传播最小化 anchored Dirichlet 能量，但只惩罚邻居间分歧、不惩罚节点自身类别分布的犹豫，深传播时精度大幅退化；且现有后处理方法需要特征或模型内部信息。
Method: 把 Potts 能量分解为 Dirichlet 项（邻居分歧）与 Gini 项（节点内不确定性），据此提出 Propagate, Then Sharpen (PtS)：交替执行类别概率传播与节点级保质量 sharpening，仅新增一个超参数，用带标签的验证节点选择；输入只有图 G 与冻结模型输出的分布 Q。
Result: 九个同质图、冻结 MLP 骨干下，PtS 相对独立调参的 APPNP 平均测试精度提升 1.71 个百分点（干净输入）与 3.90 个百分点（严重高斯特征损坏）；换成冻结 GCN 与 GraphSAGE 骨干时增益变小但仍为正。无 restart 的深传播中，2 到 100 步之间精度下降 PtS 为 2.2 点、APPNP 为 33.8 点。
Conclusion: 后处理阶段同时惩罚邻居分歧与节点内犹豫，可以在不接触特征、参数或梯度的前提下提升冻结节点分类器精度，并基本消除深传播带来的精度损失。

summary_sections.result: 九个同质图、冻结 MLP 骨干下，PtS 相对独立调参的 APPNP 平均测试精度提升 1.71 个百分点（干净输入）与 3.90 个百分点（严重高斯特征损坏）；换成冻结 GCN 与 GraphSAGE 骨干时增益变小但仍为正。无 restart 的深传播中，2 到 100 步之间精度下降 PtS 为 2.2 点、APPNP 为 33.8 点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 后处理阶段同时惩罚邻居分歧与节点内犹豫，可以在不接触特征、参数或梯度的前提下提升冻结节点分类器精度，并基本消除深传播带来的精度损失。

papers.title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving rely heavily on successful expert demonstrations, leaving model-specific failures underexploited. Learning from these failures is hindered by unreliable diagnoses, poorly matched correction targets, and coarse rewards. We propose RefineDrive, a failure-guided post-training framework that learns from self-generated failures through targeted supervision and safety-aware reinforcement learning. Reliable Diagnosis derives structured, verifiable feedback on collisions and drivable-area violations directly from simulator states. Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval searches a clustered human trajectory bank for nearby corrections that satisfy hard-safety constraints in the current scene, prioritizing preservation of the failed prediction's motion pattern. Conditioned on the driving context and failed trajectory, Correction SFT learns to generate the diagnosis followed by the retrieved correction as a training-only auxiliary task. We then apply GRPO with a Safety-Layered Reward that strictly prioritizes hard-safe trajectories, retains continuous safety feedback for both unsafe and hard-safe trajectories, and rewards driving progress only after hard safety is satisfied. At inference, the policy directly predicts trajectories from the driving context without an explicit diagnosis or repair stage. On NAVSIM v1, RefineDrive improves the 4B base SFT policy from 87.7 to 91.7 PDMS. Using the same checkpoint without additional training, RefineDrive achieves 89.4 EPDMS on the original NAVTEST scenes evaluated with NAVSIM v2 extended metrics. Controlled ablations support the benefits of structured diagnosis supervision, retrieved corrections, and safety-layered optimization for direct planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefineDrive 是面向自动驾驶 Vision-Language-Action 模型的失败引导后训练框架：从仿真状态自动生成可验证的碰撞与可行驶区域违规诊断，检索满足硬安全约束的最小修正轨迹，先做 Correction SFT 再用带 Safety-Layered Reward 的 GRPO 训练。在 NAVSIM v1 上把 4B base SFT 策略的 PDMS 从 87.7 提到 91.7，同一 checkpoint 不再训练在 NAVTEST 原始场景按 NAVSIM v2 扩展指标得 89.4 EPDMS。
Motivation: VLA 驾驶模型高度依赖成功专家示范，模型自身的失败样本未被利用；而利用失败受制于诊断不可靠、修正目标不匹配与奖励过粗。
Method: 三个组件串联：Reliable Diagnosis 直接从仿真状态产出结构化、可验证的碰撞与可行驶区域违规反馈；Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval 在聚类后的人类轨迹库中检索满足当前场景硬安全约束、且保留失败预测运动模式的邻近修正；Correction SFT 以驾驶上下文与失败轨迹为条件生成诊断加修正作为仅训练期辅助任务，随后用 GRPO 配合 Safety-Layered Reward（硬安全轨迹优先、对不安全与硬安全轨迹都保留连续安全反馈、仅在硬安全满足后才奖励行驶进展）。推理时策略直接从上下文预测轨迹，不需显式诊断或修复阶段。
Result: NAVSIM v1 上 4B base SFT 策略 PDMS 由 87.7 提升至 91.7；同一 checkpoint 不额外训练，在 NAVTEST 原始场景按 NAVSIM v2 扩展指标取得 89.4 EPDMS；受控消融支持结构化诊断监督、检索式修正与安全分层优化对直接规划的贡献。
Conclusion: 把自生成失败转成可验证诊断加硬安全约束下的最小修正，再以安全分层奖励做后训练，可在不改推理流程的前提下提升 VLA 驾驶策略的直接规划表现。

papers.title: What Drives Citations in Production Large Language Models? An Observational Multi-Method Study of Two Million AI Citations Across Ten Thousand Web Pages
papers.abstract_en: Production large language models retrieve and cite web pages alongside generated answers, yet the page-level features that predict citation frequency remain poorly characterised. We present an observational study of approximately 2 million LLM citations from four commercial engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini) over six months, joined to 10,000 crawled pages from nineteen B2B SaaS workspaces. Sixty-plus features are tested using a nine-method consensus framework combining mixed-effects regression with domain fixed effects, FDR correction, stability-selection Lasso, double machine learning, generalised additive models, and temporal hold-out replication. Four findings survive all checks. First, prompt-content alignment (Jaccard overlap between page tokens and the full workspace prompt corpus, including non-citing prompts) is the dominant page-level predictor (beta = +0.37, 95% CI [+0.33, +0.41], q ~ 10^-73). Second, the standard AEO checklist (FAQ blocks, structured data, Core Web Vitals) shows positive effects in pooled data that reverse or collapse to zero once domain fixed effects are applied: Simpson's paradox with practical consequences for the AEO literature. Third, domain-level AI authority exceeds the strongest non-alignment page-level feature by a factor of six in mean absolute SHAP value. We release the analytic pipeline as a methodological contribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对四个商业引擎（ChatGPT、Claude、Google AI、Gemini）六个月约 200 万条 LLM 引用与 10,000 个网页的观测研究显示，prompt-content 对齐度（页面 token 与整个 workspace prompt 语料的 Jaccard 重叠）是页面级引用频率的主导预测因子（beta = +0.37）。加入 domain 固定效应后，标准 AEO 清单（FAQ、结构化数据、Core Web Vitals）的正效应反转或归零，呈 Simpson 悖论。
Motivation: 生产级 LLM 检索并引用网页，但哪些页面级特征预测引用频率缺乏可靠刻画；既有 AEO 文献的结论可能被跨 domain 混杂所污染。
Method: 观测性研究：约 200 万条 LLM 引用关联到 19 个 B2B SaaS workspace 的 10,000 个抓取页面，测试 60+ 特征；用九方法共识框架，包括 mixed-effects regression（domain 固定效应）、FDR 校正、stability-selection Lasso、double machine learning、GAM 与 temporal hold-out 复现，并报告 SHAP 值。
Result: prompt-content 对齐为最强页面级预测因子，beta = +0.37，95% CI [+0.33, +0.41]，q ≈ 10^-73；AEO 清单在合并数据中为正、加 domain 固定效应后反转或归零（Simpson 悖论）；domain 级 AI authority 的平均绝对 SHAP 值是最强非对齐页面级特征的 6 倍。四项发现通过全部稳健性检验。
Conclusion: 引用由 prompt 与页面内容的对齐及 domain 级 AI 权威主导，而非 FAQ/结构化数据等传统 AEO 清单；AEO 文献的正效应在控制 domain 混杂后不成立。作者同时开源分析管线作为方法学贡献。

papers.title: ReCo: When to Relocate Sensor Kits under Deployment Constraints -- A NILM Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Many sensing tasks obtain training labels only by deploying instruments in the field. With a limited number of sensor kits, a collection deadline, and measurement downtime at every move, the collector must repeatedly decide whether to stay at the current site or relocate. We study this decision in non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), which estimates the power drawn by individual appliances from a home's main meter and is trained on data from homes temporarily fitted with appliance-level sub-meters. In NILM, appliance usage varies with the appliance, season and climate, and the value of new data depends on how diverse the combinations of target operation and background load are. To address this, we propose a constraint-based relocation framework and instantiate it for NILM as ReCo (Relocation by Coverage gain). ReCo counts new operating regimes in a joint target-background feature space, forecasts each home's future gain from the data collected so far, and each night weighs the gain of staying against the gain of moving elsewhere after the downtime. In replayed deployments on the Plegma dataset under two kit counts and two downtime costs, ReCo outperforms fixed-dwell and count-based schedules and a threshold rule using the same metric in every setting. Its advantage is not explained by collecting more days alone and reflects allocating the days to more valuable homes and periods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCo 把 NILM 标签采集的驻留/迁移决策形式化为覆盖增益问题：在目标-背景联合特征空间里数新工况，逐夜比较原地驻留与迁移（扣除搬迁停机）的预期增益。在 Plegma 数据集的回放部署中，两种传感器套件数量与两种停机成本共四个设定下，ReCo 均优于固定驻留、按计数调度和同指标阈值规则，且优势来自把采集天数分配到更有价值的家庭与时段而非单纯多采。
Motivation: NILM 训练标签只能靠临时加装子表获得，套件数量有限、有采集截止期、每次搬迁都有停机；采集者必须反复决定原地驻留还是迁移，而数据价值取决于目标工况与背景负载组合的多样性。
Method: 提出基于约束的迁移框架并实例化为 ReCo (Relocation by Coverage gain)：在目标-背景联合特征空间统计新出现的运行工况，用已采集数据预测每个家庭未来的增益，每夜在扣除搬迁停机后比较驻留增益与迁移增益。
Result: 在 Plegma 数据集的回放部署 (replayed deployments) 中，两种 kit 数量与两种 downtime 成本共四个设定下，ReCo 全部优于 fixed-dwell、count-based 调度和使用同一指标的阈值规则；其优势不能仅由采集更多天数解释。
Conclusion: NILM 的标签采集调度应按覆盖增益而非驻留时长或天数分配，把有限采集日投到目标-背景组合更多样的家庭与时段上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Interrelating Fruchterman-Reingold Graph Visualization and Agglomerative Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Graph visualization methods and agglomerative clustering have been frequently considered in data analysis and pattern recognition. Because these approaches are interrelated and complementary, it is of particular interest to investigate their associations. In this work, we study the possible relationship between the Fruchterman-Reingold graph visualization method and four types of agglomerative clustering adopting single- and complete-linkage, average, and Ward's linkage criteria. Three types of datasets have been considered in 2 and 10 dimensions, as well as the PCA projection of the latter to two dimensions. The results obtained suggest that the relationship between the methods considered did not vary much for the three types of data mentioned above. At the same time, the agglomerative methods tended to yield results that are mostly similar to each other, while presenting moderate similarity with the original data. The Fruchterman-Reingold visualization resulted similar to the original data, but exhibited relatively smaller similarity to the agglomerative methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文考察 Fruchterman-Reingold (FR) 图布局与四种层次聚类（single-linkage、complete-linkage、average linkage、Ward's linkage）之间的对应关系，在 2 维、10 维及 10 维 PCA 降维到 2 维的三类数据集上比较。结果表明三类数据下方法间关系基本不变：四种聚类彼此高度相似、与原始数据仅中等相似，FR 布局与原始数据相似但与聚类方法相似度相对更低。
Motivation: 图可视化与层次聚类在数据分析中常被互补使用，但两者之间的关联缺乏系统考察，不清楚 FR 布局结果能否代表或替代聚类结构。
Method: 在三类数据集（2 维、10 维、以及 10 维数据的 PCA 二维投影）上并行运行 Fruchterman-Reingold 图可视化与采用 single-linkage、complete-linkage、average linkage、Ward's linkage 四种连接准则的层次聚类，比较它们与原始数据及彼此之间的相似度。
Result: 三类数据集上方法间关系基本一致；四种层次聚类结果彼此大多相似，与原始数据呈中等相似；FR 可视化与原始数据相似，但与各聚类方法的相似度相对更小。
Conclusion: FR 图布局与层次聚类刻画的是数据中不同侧面的结构：聚类之间高度冗余，而 FR 布局更贴近原始数据、与聚类结果差异明显，二者不能互相替代。

papers.title: Not All Rollouts Are Worth Learning: On Trajectory Valuation for Post-Training Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of trajectory valuation in reinforcement learning: how to identify and mitigate detrimental trajectories during online training. Unlike classification, where data valuation relies on fixed training and validation sets, reinforcement learning involves dynamically generated trajectories without explicit validation signals, making conventional influence-based methods inapplicable. We propose Dynamic Trajectory Valuation (DTV), a simple and efficient framework that estimates trajectory utility at the mini-batch level and filters detrimental trajectories based solely on gradient information. By operating at the optimization level, DTV integrates seamlessly with existing reinforcement learning pipelines with minimal overhead. Extensive experiments across diverse settings, including PPO, GRPO, and DPO, demonstrate that DTV consistently improves performance, enhances data efficiency, and stabilizes optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dynamic Trajectory Valuation (DTV)，在 mini-batch 层面仅用梯度信息估计轨迹效用并过滤有害轨迹，可直接嵌入现有 RL 训练管线。在 PPO、GRPO、DPO 等多种设置下，DTV 持续提升性能、提高数据效率并稳定优化。
Motivation: 强化学习在线训练中轨迹是动态生成且没有显式验证信号，分类任务里依赖固定训练/验证集的数据估值与 influence 类方法因此无法直接适用，有害轨迹难以识别和抑制。
Method: DTV 在 mini-batch 层面估计轨迹效用，仅依据梯度信息过滤有害轨迹；在优化层面运作，可与现有强化学习管线集成且开销极小。
Result: 在 PPO、GRPO、DPO 等多样设置下的大量实验中，DTV 一致地提升性能、增强数据效率并稳定优化过程。

papers.title: Echoes of Deeds: Moral History Can Shape and Steer LLM Behavioral Choices
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) morality typically consider decisions in isolation, thus overlooking whether an individual's unrelated prior conduct influences the model's subsequent choices. This leaves open the question of whether, and to what extent, moral history shapes LLM decisional behaviors. Prior work on human moral decision-making shows that past behavior can influence subsequent moral choices. Building on this observation, we investigate whether analogous effects emerge in LLMs in two complementary ways: at the behavioral level, through the model's observable responses, and at the representation level, through its latent internal representations. We introduce MoralLedger, a framework for studying how an actor's moral history shapes actions for LLMs' behaviors under a fixed decision context. At the behavioral level, we find that prior moral histories systematically alter subsequent choices as a function of their valence and intensity. At the internal representation level, these histories induce a linearly recoverable direction in the residual stream that generalizes to held-out examples. Intervening along this direction on neutral-history prompts produces two-sided intensity-dependent changes in subsequent choices, with effects that are stronger than those induced by prompting alone or by favorable-nonmoral direction. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a latent representation of an actor's prior moral conduct can provide signed inference-time control over a moral decision. Our MoralLedger extends moral evaluation beyond static dilemmas, establishing moral history as both a source of behavioral sensitivity and a causal target for auditing and controlling moral behavior in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MoralLedger 框架，在固定决策情境下考察 LLM 对同一行为者既往道德史的响应：行为层面，后续选择随道德史的效价 (valence) 与强度系统性改变；表征层面，道德史在 residual stream 中诱导出可线性恢复、且能泛化到留出样本的方向，沿该方向干预中性历史提示可产生双向、随强度变化的选择改变，效应强于单纯提示或 favorable-nonmoral 方向。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 道德评测只孤立地评估单次决策，忽略个体先前的无关行为是否影响模型后续选择，因而道德史是否以及在多大程度上塑造 LLM 决策行为仍是空白。
Method: MoralLedger 在固定决策情境下分两条线研究：行为层面记录模型对不同效价与强度道德史的可观测回应；表征层面从 residual stream 中线性解码道德史方向，并在中性历史提示上沿该方向做推理时干预，与单纯提示和 favorable-nonmoral 方向对照。
Result: 先前道德史按其效价与强度系统性改变后续选择；这些历史在 residual stream 中诱导出可线性恢复、能泛化到留出样本的方向；沿该方向干预产生双向、随强度变化的改变，效应强于仅用提示或 favorable-nonmoral 方向。
Conclusion: 行为者先前道德行为的潜在表征可为 LLM 道德决策提供带符号的推理时控制，道德史既是行为敏感性的来源，也是审计与控制 LLM 道德行为的因果靶点；据作者所知这是首次此类演示。

papers.title: Depot-Closed Multi-Component Construction for Neural Vehicle Routing
papers.abstract_en: Most neural constructive solvers for the vehicle routing problem (VRP) use route-by-route construction, extending one route until completion before starting the next. This commits route membership early and hinders global coordination across routes. We propose multi-component construction, which maintains many route components simultaneously and merges them in an arbitrary order. This removes the depot-return cue that route-by-route construction obtains from the remaining capacity; to compensate, we introduce an interpretation in which every component is treated as an implicitly depot-closed route. Under this depot-closed interpretation, every intermediate state of standard CVRP construction is a complete feasible solution, and the exact cost reduction of a merge is the Clarke-Wright saving. The neural policy combines this CW-saving signal with the evolving component state to learn what to connect and when to connect. A policy trained only on CVRP100 outperforms the reported results of representative neural solvers on CVRP100-500 with greedy inference and, reused for ruin-and-reconstruct, performs strongly at all evaluated sizes up to CVRP1000. In a zero-shot Constraint Tightness evaluation with capacities from $C=10$ to $500$, it outperforms the reported neural solvers at every capacity. Controlled analyses show that robustness persists without CW grounding and point to learned route-closing behavior as a plausible contributor to the tight-regime degradation of learned route-by-route solvers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 depot-closed 多分量构造：VRP 解码时同时维护多个路径分量并按任意顺序合并，每个中间态都被解释为隐式回库闭合的完整可行解，合并的精确代价下降等于 Clarke-Wright saving。只在 CVRP100 上训练的策略在 CVRP100-500 贪心推理下超过代表性神经求解器的已报告结果，容量 C=10 到 500 的零样本紧约束评估中每个容量点都更优。
Motivation: 神经构造式 VRP 求解器普遍逐条路径构造，过早锁定路径归属、难以跨路径全局协调；且逐条构造依赖剩余容量给出的回库提示，多分量同时构造会失去这一线索。
Method: 多分量构造同时维护多个 route component 并任意顺序合并，用 depot-closed 解释补回回库线索：中间态即完整可行解，合并代价下降恰为 Clarke-Wright saving；神经策略把 CW-saving 信号与演化中的分量状态结合作为连接决策依据，并复用于 ruin-and-reconstruct。
Result: 仅在 CVRP100 上训练，贪心推理在 CVRP100-500 上超过代表性神经求解器的已报告结果；复用于 ruin-and-reconstruct 时在评估到的 CVRP1000 各规模均表现强劲；零样本 Constraint Tightness 评估中容量从 C=10 到 500 的每个取值都优于已报告的神经求解器；受控分析显示去掉 CW grounding 后鲁棒性仍在。
Conclusion: 逐条构造的回库提示可以由 depot-closed 解释与 CW-saving 信号替代，学到的 route-closing 行为是逐条构造求解器在紧约束下退化的一个可能来源。

papers.title: TempoKV: Timely Staging of LLM KV Caches for Memory-Semantic Flash
papers.abstract_en: Reusable prefix key-value (KV) caches can outgrow GPU memory in large language model (LLM) serving. A memory-semantic flash hierarchy offers SSD-backed capacity with a limited fast tier, but a logical KV hit is not necessarily ready for GPU retrieval. Demand staging exposes SSD latency, whereas immediate staging can reserve fast-tier capacity long before retrieval begins. We present TempoKV, a timing-aware resource-commitment layer that separates early knowledge of reuse from the acquisition of staging resources. It records reusable-KV hits as metadata-only claims and requests commitment when the runtime-estimated time until retrieval falls to the storage-estimated time needed to make KV resident and protected against eviction. These estimates adapt to runtime progress and staging state, while commitment remains subject to available protected capacity. We implement TempoKV in vLLM and LMCache on an SSD-backed CXL memory device without changing request scheduling. Across two models and three prefix cache ratios, TempoKV reduces protected fast-tier byte-time per request by 63-91% versus immediate staging while retaining much of the serving benefit of advance staging. In a fast-tier capacity sweep, output throughput and p95 time to first token (TTFT) remain nearly unchanged as capacity decreases from 100 to 25 GiB. Compared with unmodified LMCache's Device-DAX L1 configuration, TempoKV reduces p95 TTFT by up to 48.0% and increases output throughput by up to 27.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TempoKV 把可复用 KV cache 的命中先记为仅元数据的 claim，等到运行时估计的距检索时间降到存储侧估计的驻留所需时间才提交快速层资源，在 vLLM+LMCache 与 SSD 后端 CXL 内存上实现。相对 immediate staging，每请求受保护快速层 byte-time 降低 63–91%；快速层容量从 100 降到 25 GiB 时输出吞吐与 p95 TTFT 基本不变，相对未修改 LMCache 的 Device-DAX L1 配置 p95 TTFT 最多降 48.0%、输出吞吐最多升 27.8%。
Motivation: LLM serving 中可复用 prefix KV cache 会超出 GPU 显存，memory-semantic flash 层级里逻辑命中不等于 GPU 可取：按需 staging 暴露 SSD 延迟，立即 staging 又过早长期占用有限快速层容量。
Method: 在 vLLM 与 LMCache 上实现 timing-aware 资源提交层，把复用知识与 staging 资源获取解耦：命中先记为 metadata-only claim，当运行时估计的距检索时间降至存储侧估计的驻留并防驱逐所需时间时才请求提交，估计随运行进度与 staging 状态自适应，且提交受可用受保护容量约束；不改动请求调度，硬件为 SSD 后端 CXL 内存设备。
Result: 在两个模型与三种 prefix cache 比例下，相对 immediate staging 每请求受保护快速层 byte-time 降低 63–91%，同时保留 advance staging 的大部分 serving 收益；快速层容量扫描中容量从 100 GiB 降到 25 GiB 时输出吞吐与 p95 TTFT 几乎不变；相对未修改 LMCache 的 Device-DAX L1 配置，p95 TTFT 最多降低 48.0%，输出吞吐最多提高 27.8%。
Conclusion: 把复用的提前知晓与 staging 资源的获取时机分开，按预计检索时间触发提交，就能在大幅压缩快速层占用时间的同时保住延迟与吞吐收益，使快速层容量缩减到 25 GiB 仍不明显劣化服务性能。

papers.title: Beyond Gradient Flow: Identifiability and Recovery from Distribution Snapshots
papers.abstract_en:
Inferring dynamics from snapshots of evolving distributions is fundamentally underdetermined: the Fokker-Planck equation constrains the drift $F$ only through its score-weighted divergence $
abla\cdot F+F\cdot
abla\logρ$, leaving a $ρ$-solenoidal gauge invisible to any single-time constraint. Time-indexed transport formulations cannot resolve this ambiguity: every admissible marginal path admits a curl-free explanation, minimum-action reconstruction selects it, and marginal fit alone cannot distinguish dynamically inequivalent explanations. Requiring one autonomous field to explain several marginals instead makes part of the hidden circulation visible as $
abla\logρ$ changes across marginals. Separating instantaneous Fokker-Planck source constraints from the snapshot experiment, we show that the source constraints identify the field modulo the kernel of a stacked score-weighted divergence operator. For generic Gaussian shape variation, source constraints at $K\ge m$ time points in intrinsic dimension $m$ eliminate every polynomial gauge direction, whereas finitely many density snapshots alone admit aliasing; we give the obstruction explicitly. At a Gaussian anchor, for Sobolev smoothness $s$ and $n$ samples per time point, we derive a conditional lower rate $(nK)^{-2s/(2s+m+1)}$ for the tangent snapshot experiment, with a matching upper rate in a degreewise benchmark. Strong-form fitting is non-orthogonal to score error and cannot be repaired by spectral filtering. Instead, we estimate using smooth test functions while retaining the known diffusion term, and derive a finite-sample bound that separates sampling error from fixed-grid quadrature bias. Planted-circulation experiments confirm the predicted gauge contraction and expose a design tension between cross-slice information and covariance-aware whitening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从分布快照反演动力学在单时刻约束下不可辨识：Fokker-Planck 只通过 score 加权散度约束漂移 F，ρ-solenoidal 规范自由度对任何单时刻约束都不可见。要求同一个自治场解释多个边缘分布后，源约束在 K≥m 个时刻（内蕴维数 m）可消除全部多项式规范方向，而有限个密度快照本身存在混叠；作者据此给出基于光滑测试函数的估计量并推导有限样本界。
Motivation: 从演化分布的快照反演漂移场本质上欠定：时间索引的输运表述对每条可行边缘路径都给出无旋解释，最小作用量重构会选中它，仅凭边缘拟合无法区分动力学上不等价的解释。
Method: 把瞬时 Fokker-Planck 源约束与快照实验分离，证明源约束在堆叠的 score 加权散度算子的核意义下辨识场；在 Gaussian anchor 处对 Sobolev 光滑度 s、每时刻 n 个样本推导切向快照实验的条件下界速率，并在逐阶 (degreewise) 基准中给出匹配上界；估计时改用光滑测试函数并保留已知扩散项，把采样误差与固定网格求积偏差分开。
Result: 对一般 Gaussian 形状变化，K≥m 个时刻的源约束消除所有多项式规范方向，而有限密度快照单独存在混叠并给出显式阻碍；Gaussian anchor 处切向快照实验的条件下界速率为 (nK)^{-2s/(2s+m+1)}，逐阶基准中有匹配上界；强形式拟合与 score 误差非正交且无法用谱滤波修复；planted-circulation 实验确认了预测的规范收缩，并暴露跨切片信息与协方差感知白化之间的设计张力。
Conclusion: 多时刻源约束（而非更多单时刻快照或最小作用量选择）才是消除规范自由度的关键，估计应走保留扩散项的光滑测试函数路线；跨切片信息量与协方差白化之间存在需要权衡的设计张力。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 从分布快照反演动力学在单时刻约束下不可辨识：Fokker-Planck 只通过 score 加权散度约束漂移 F，ρ-solenoidal 规范自由度对任何单时刻约束都不可见。要求同一个自治场解释多个边缘分布后，源约束在 K≥m 个时刻（内蕴维数 m）可消除全部多项式规范方向，而有限个密度快照本身存在混叠；作者据此给出基于光滑测试函数的估计量并推导有限样本界。

summary_sections.method: 把瞬时 Fokker-Planck 源约束与快照实验分离，证明源约束在堆叠的 score 加权散度算子的核意义下辨识场；在 Gaussian anchor 处对 Sobolev 光滑度 s、每时刻 n 个样本推导切向快照实验的条件下界速率，并在逐阶 (degreewise) 基准中给出匹配上界；估计时改用光滑测试函数并保留已知扩散项，把采样误差与固定网格求积偏差分开。
summary_sections.result: 对一般 Gaussian 形状变化，K≥m 个时刻的源约束消除所有多项式规范方向，而有限密度快照单独存在混叠并给出显式阻碍；Gaussian anchor 处切向快照实验的条件下界速率为 (nK)^{-2s/(2s+m+1)}，逐阶基准中有匹配上界；强形式拟合与 score 误差非正交且无法用谱滤波修复；planted-circulation 实验确认了预测的规范收缩，并暴露跨切片信息与协方差感知白化之间的设计张力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多时刻源约束（而非更多单时刻快照或最小作用量选择）才是消除规范自由度的关键，估计应走保留扩散项的光滑测试函数路线；跨切片信息量与协方差白化之间存在需要权衡的设计张力。

papers.title: Towards Generalizable 3D Anomaly Detection via Relational Inconsistency Modeling
papers.abstract_en: 3D anomaly detection (3DAD) aims to identify defective regions in point cloud data, serving as a critical component in industrial inspection systems. Existing methods are normality-centered -- learning the distribution of normal samples and treating deviations as anomalies -- without explicitly modeling what constitutes a defect. This leads to ambiguous decision boundaries with increased false positives and negatives, particularly in unified and cross-domain settings where diverse normal distributions further blur the boundaries. We propose a relational inconsistency modeling framework that characterizes defects as violations of geometric consistency among neighboring structures. Our approach learns category-agnostic defect cues through pseudo-anomalies designed as controlled relational violations, instantiated by two key modules: Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) for encoding geometric relationships among local regions, and Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) for identifying regions that are relationally incompatible within their structural peer group. Extensive experiments on Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD demonstrate consistent improvements over prior state-of-the-art methods in both in-domain and cross-domain settings, validating the effectiveness of learning an explicit, relation-based defect criterion for 3D anomaly detection. Project page: https://visualsciencelab-khu.github.io/GRIM_project/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D 点云异常检测的 GRIM 框架把缺陷定义为邻近结构间几何一致性的违背，而非对正常分布的偏离：用受控关系违背构造的伪异常学习类别无关的缺陷线索，由 Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) 编码局部区域几何关系、Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) 在结构同类组内找出关系不兼容区域。在 Anomaly-ShapeNet 与 Real3D-AD 上，域内与跨域设定均一致优于既有 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 3DAD 方法只学正常样本分布、把偏离当异常，缺陷本身没有显式定义，导致决策边界模糊、假阳与假阴增多；统一与跨域设定下多样正常分布进一步加剧边界模糊。
Method: 提出关系不一致建模框架：以受控关系违背生成伪异常作为监督，训练类别无关的缺陷线索；两个模块分别是编码局部区域几何关系的 Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR)，以及在结构 peer group 内识别关系不兼容区域的 Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM)。
Result: 在 Anomaly-ShapeNet 与 Real3D-AD 上，域内 (in-domain) 与跨域 (cross-domain) 设定均一致优于先前 SOTA 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把缺陷显式建成基于关系的判据，比只学正常分布更能给出清晰决策边界，因而在统一与跨域 3DAD 中都稳定提升。

papers.title: TIDE: Teacher-Student Transition via Informative Distillation and Exploration for Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Effective multi-turn agents require interaction strategies that coordinate information gathering, actions, and feedback over long horizons. GRPO is a reinforcement learning algorithm used to train these agents, but sparse trajectory-level rewards limit early exploration in small models. Recent methods augment RL with on-policy distillation (OPD) from a stronger teacher. However, a fixed mixture assumes that teacher guidance and reward optimization should retain a constant relative role throughout training and across interaction turns. This assumption can fail at two scales. Globally, as training progresses, maintaining strong distillation pressure can constrain the model from moving beyond the teacher's capabilities. Locally, teacher--student disagreement identifies where the student departs from the teacher, but cannot tell whether that departure is exploration supported by better outcomes or low-quality policy drift. Our methodological insight is that teacher guidance and reward optimization should be dynamically rebalanced over training and jointly allocated across turns. We instantiate this insight in \tide. Globally, \tide uses the measured disagreement trend as a practical schedule signal, advancing an OPD-to-RL handoff when discrepancy reduction becomes slow but remains positive and progressively increasing the relative weight of RL. Locally, \tide jointly modulates teacher-guided and reward-driven updates: relative action value and disagreement prioritize the OPD signal, whereas relative action value supplies the RL advantage and normalized disagreement reweights it across turns. Coupled with the global handoff, \tide allocates stronger teacher guidance early and gives reward-driven updates greater relative weight later in training. Experiments across multiple benchmarks, student scales, and controlled ablations support the effectiveness of TIDE's adaptive OPD--RL coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIDE 把多轮 agent 强化学习里的 on-policy distillation (OPD) 与 GRPO 奖励优化做动态再平衡：全局上用测得的师生分歧趋势做调度信号，在分歧下降变慢但仍为正时推进 OPD→RL 交接并逐步提高 RL 权重，局部上按 relative action value 与 normalized disagreement 在各轮次间分配两种信号。跨多个 benchmark、学生规模与受控消融的实验支持这种自适应 OPD–RL 协调的有效性。
Motivation: GRPO 的稀疏轨迹级奖励限制小模型早期探索；现有 OPD 混合方法固定蒸馏与奖励的相对权重，全局上强蒸馏压力会把学生限制在老师能力之内，局部上师生分歧无法区分有益探索与低质量漂移。
Method: 全局调度以分歧下降速度为信号：discrepancy reduction 变慢但仍为正时触发 OPD→RL 交接，并逐步增大 RL 相对权重；局部上联合调制两类更新——relative action value 与 disagreement 决定 OPD 信号强度，relative action value 提供 RL advantage、normalized disagreement 在各轮次间对其重加权。
Result: 在多个 benchmark、多个学生规模以及受控消融 (controlled ablations) 上的实验支持 TIDE 自适应 OPD–RL 协调的有效性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 老师指导与奖励优化的相对权重应随训练进程全局再平衡、并在轮次间联合分配，早期偏老师指导、后期偏奖励驱动更新。

papers.title: Universality and Generalization of Causal Transformers Across Context Lengths
papers.abstract_en: Long contexts are central to modern transformer systems, but most expressivity results choose a different network for each fixed sequence length. We study whether one masked transformer can approximate causal token-to-token maps uniformly over sequences of arbitrary length sampling a fixed normalized horizon. To relate sampling resolutions, we model tokens by $α$-Hölder sequences or, more generally, a common modulus of continuity. Our notion of continuity across resolutions characterizes the causal families admitting uniform approximation on these compact input classes by a single transformer with length-independent parameters. The result extends to the infinite-length mean-field limit, where tokens form continuous curves and masked attention becomes a causal time integral. For bounded regression with target maps satisfying a $β$-smooth stability condition defined using regular test functions, quantitative approximation yields a generalization bound: exact empirical risk minimization over suitably sized bounded-weight transformers gives root mean-square prediction error $O((\log\log N/\log N)^{β/(d+2)})$ from $N$ iid labeled sequences. The bound holds at fixed confidence on the same sampling distribution, with $d$ the token dimension and no maximum-length factor. Finally, experiments on physical time series support the Hölder-regular token model at observed scales, with dataset-dependent fitted exponents, whereas text input embeddings provide a contrasting case. Native and dense sampling, shuffled controls, and refinement checks delimit this empirical regularity regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明单个带掩码的因果 Transformer 可在长度无关参数下，对任意长度序列上的因果 token-to-token 映射做一致逼近：把 token 建模为 α-Hölder 序列或统一连续模，跨采样分辨率的连续性刻画了这类可一致逼近的因果族，并推广到掩码注意力退化为因果时间积分的无穷长度 mean-field 极限。在 β-光滑稳定性条件下，对 N 条 iid 标注序列做精确 ERM 得到均方根预测误差 O((log log N / log N)^{β/(d+2)})，且界中没有最大长度因子。
Motivation: 现有 transformer expressivity 结果大多针对每个固定序列长度单独选网络，无法回答一个模型能否跨任意长度统一逼近；带长度因子的泛化界也无法支撑长序列部署。
Method: 以 α-Hölder 序列（或公共连续模）建模 token，定义跨采样分辨率的连续性以刻画可被单一长度无关参数 transformer 一致逼近的因果族；对满足用正则测试函数定义的 β-光滑稳定性条件的目标映射做有界回归，通过精确经验风险最小化（ERM）在适当规模的有界权重 transformer 类上导出定量逼近与泛化界；再用物理时间序列实验检验 Hölder 正则 token 模型。
Result: 泛化界为根均方预测误差 O((log log N / log N)^{β/(d+2)})，来自 N 条 iid 标注序列，固定置信度、同一采样分布，d 为 token 维度，且不含最大长度因子；结果延伸到无穷长度 mean-field 极限。物理时间序列实验在观测尺度上支持 Hölder 正则 token 模型，拟合指数依数据集而异，而文本输入 embedding 呈现对比情形；native/dense 采样、shuffled 对照与 refinement 检查界定了该经验正则区间。
Conclusion: 跨分辨率的连续性条件足以让单个长度无关参数的掩码 transformer 统一处理任意长度因果映射，且泛化误差不随最大长度恶化；Hölder token 假设在物理时间序列的观测尺度上成立，但对文本 embedding 不成立。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Perceptual Quality Loss or Loss of Perceptual Quality?
authors: Maurício do V. M. da Costa
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary deep speech enhancement (SE) models are often trained with specific auxiliary terms in the loss function as a way to improve their performance in terms of perceptual metrics. Nevertheless, a higher score on a perceptual metric does not necessarily correlate with an improved listening experience. Through objective and subjective experiments, we assess the performance of SE models trained with two different types of auxiliary PESQ loss terms. The numerical evaluation on a suite of standard metrics suggests that, while models optimized for PESQ naturally obtain higher PESQ scores in the test set, for most other metrics the scores do not significantly change. In some cases, the PESQ loss even results in worse PESQ scores on mismatched data. A formal listening experiment reveals that the models without a PESQ loss were generally preferred over models that include it, across all settings. Finally, we analyze the relative importance of PESQ in the composite metrics CSIG, CBAK and COVL, and find that PESQ dominates all of them. Our study highlights the perils of over-reliance on PESQ and stresses the importance of a complete evaluation procedure for SE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语音增强 (SE) 模型加 PESQ 辅助损失只抬高测试集上的 PESQ 分数，其他客观指标基本不变，且在失配数据上反而可能让 PESQ 变差；正式听音实验中不带 PESQ 损失的模型在所有设置下都被更偏好。作者据此指出 PESQ 主导了 CSIG、CBAK、COVL 三个复合指标，单靠它们评估 SE 会过度依赖 PESQ。
Motivation: SE 训练普遍用 PESQ 类辅助损失刷感知指标，但指标分数升高不等于听感变好，而复合指标又被 PESQ 主导，导致评估体系可能系统性误导模型选择。
Method: 用两类不同的辅助 PESQ 损失项训练 SE 模型，做客观指标套件评测与正式听音实验，并分解复合指标 CSIG、CBAK、COVL 中 PESQ 的相对权重。
Result: 以 PESQ 优化的模型在测试集上 PESQ 更高，但多数其他指标无显著变化；部分情况下 PESQ 损失在失配 (mismatched) 数据上给出更差的 PESQ；听音实验中无 PESQ 损失的模型在所有设置下被普遍偏好；分析发现 PESQ 主导 CSIG、CBAK、COVL 全部三个复合指标。
Conclusion: 对 PESQ 的过度依赖有害，SE 必须采用包含主观听音的完整评估流程，而不能只看 PESQ 及其主导的复合指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models must preserve the visual state of the world over time, but existing evaluation protocols often rely on generated histories, video reference, or selected revisit viewpoints that can confound the assessment of a model's true memory capability. To address this, we introduce OPIS, an input-grounded benchmark that strictly anchors the assessment to a fixed set of object instances from the initial observation for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models. The OPIS dataset comprises 500 cases across real-world, embodied-robotic, and game-world domains, providing dense object-level annotations for 12,672 rigid, articulated, and deformable instances. Our object-centric evaluator combines association and explicit visibility reasoning to hierarchically measure Object (O) Presence (P), Identity (I), and Structure (S), utilizing static or dynamic evaluation tracks based on object kinematics. Across eight image-to-video or camera-conditioned world models, our proposed OPIS scores range from 48.65 to 56.01. As the reference inventory grows from less than 20 to more than 40 objects, the Presence, Identity, and Structure scores show an overall decline, with the average Identity score falling from 40.22 to 23.11. The results demonstrate that preserving the particular object instances in the input is considerably harder than generating plausible visual elements.
