papers.title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
papers.abstract_en: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
papers.comment: The last two authors contributed equally as co-advisors. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMPIRIC 让机器人通过实验学习残差世界模型：在物理引擎之上用代码补出缺失机制（新力、约束、隐状态），再用贝叶斯推断从含噪观测估计其参数与状态，预测失败时修正假设。在五个仿真域上学到可解释可复用的模型，比全部三个基线用更少交互解决更多任务；实体机器人上学到风力与多米诺骨牌质量以完成操作任务。
Motivation: 物理引擎只覆盖运动与接触，会整段缺失胶水固化、水加热、风等机制，机器人无法从零试错补齐这些机制并据此规划。
Method: EMPIRIC 学习残差世界模型：以物理引擎为底座，用生成的代码引入新力、约束与隐状态；贝叶斯推断从含噪观测估计这些程序的参数与状态，模型用于预测动作结果、选择信息量大的实验，并在预测失败时修正假设。
Result: 在五个仿真域上学到可解释、可复用的模型，解决的任务多于全部三个基线且环境交互更少；在实体机器人上学习风力与多米诺骨牌质量，完成一项操作任务。
Conclusion: 把物理引擎与可执行的残差机制代码加贝叶斯参数/状态推断结合，机器人能用更少实验补齐缺失物理并完成规划。

papers.title: LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEGAU 把类别级 6D 位姿估计与重建耦合：以类别条件的 Semantic Gaussian Field 作为结构先验，参与多模态特征融合并为局部位姿推理提供全局引导，联合解码 NOCS 对应、位姿与尺寸。在合成与真实基准的单模型多类别设定下最高提升 22%（SOPE），并向真实数据迁移保持竞争力。
Motivation: 单张 RGB-D 的类别级 6D 位姿本质上欠约束：部分可见几何必须结合规范物体结构才能确定稳定位姿，而重建常被当作脱节的辅助任务。
Method: 以类别文本 embedding 为条件，用 transformer 融合模块整合视觉、几何与类别线索，联合解码 NOCS map、位姿与尺寸以及基于 Gaussian 的物体表示；Semantic Gaussian Field 作为类别条件结构先验进入特征融合。
Result: 在合成与真实基准的单模型多类别设定下最高提升 22%（SOPE），并向真实世界数据迁移表现有竞争力。
Conclusion: 在统一表示中联合学习规范对应、物体形状与位姿对齐，优于把重建当辅助任务的做法。

papers.title: BA-DPO: Bias-Adjusted Direct Preference Optimization for Language Model Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based alignment methods such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) use pairwise preferences labeled by human annotators to fine-tune language models. However, annotators carry systematic biases toward some attributes: a name that signals a gender or an ethnicity, a persona, a language variety, a formatting convention, or length. If not properly addressed, these systematic biases can be absorbed and amplified during alignment. Existing methods address length bias or annotator disagreement, but fail to eliminate biases toward arbitrary attributes. To address this limitation, we propose Bias-Adjusted DPO (BA-DPO), a generalization of DPO that adds one bias parameter per annotator toward responses carrying a declared attribute. We prove that the objective is convex in the bias parameters and that the votes identify each annotator's bias up to a shared constant. The remaining constant is what fixes the aligned model's attribute rate: by default the rate of the reference model, or a target rate, which we use to bring a biased policy to statistical parity. On a corpus with planted biases, DPO drives the attribute from a balanced start to probability 0.96 and BA-DPO removes 81 to 95\% of that shift; on MultiPref with real annotators it removes about half of DPO's lengthening. Both hold at 0.5B with full fine-tuning and at 8B with LoRA, at no higher KL than DPO and no loss in judged quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BA-DPO 在 DPO 目标上为每位标注者、每个声明属性各加一个偏置参数，把属性率钉在参考模型默认值或目标值上，从而把带偏策略拉回统计均等 (statistical parity)。在植入偏置的语料上 DPO 把属性概率从均衡推到 0.96，BA-DPO 消除该偏移的 81–95%；MultiPref 真实标注者上消除 DPO 长度膨胀的约一半，且 KL 不高于 DPO、判定质量不降。
Motivation: 标注者对性别、族裔、人设、语言变体、格式、长度等任意属性存在系统性偏置，会在对齐中被吸收放大；现有方法只处理长度偏置或标注分歧，无法消除对任意属性的偏置。
Method: BA-DPO 是 DPO 的推广：为每位标注者针对携带声明属性的回答各加一个偏置参数，与成对偏好共同优化；证明目标对偏置参数凸、投票可在共享常数意义下识别各标注者偏置，剩余常数用于把对齐模型的属性率定为参考模型默认率或目标率（用于统计均等）。训练覆盖 0.5B 全量微调与 8B LoRA。
Result: 植入偏置语料上，DPO 将属性概率从均衡起点推到 0.96，BA-DPO 消除该偏移的 81–95%；MultiPref 真实标注者上消除 DPO 引发的长度膨胀约一半。两个结果在 0.5B 全量微调与 8B LoRA 下均成立，KL 不高于 DPO，判定质量无损失。
Conclusion: 把每位标注者对每个声明属性的偏置显式参数化并用目标属性率固定剩余常数，可以在不增加 KL、不损失质量的前提下消除 DPO 对任意属性的偏置吸收与放大。

papers.title: Mixed-Prior Decision Risk for Open-Set Recognition
papers.abstract_en: In open-set recognition (OSR), a probe must either be identified as one of the known gallery classes or rejected as unknown, so three error types coexist: false acceptance, false rejection, and misidentification. An uncertainty score for selective recognition should rank probes by the risk of the decision the system has made. Bayesian gallery-aware models such as Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) summarize the posterior over known and unknown classes by Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence components and map them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator. We show that the KL summary is not generally monotone in decision risk: linear fusion of the KL components tuned on validation data yields negative filtering quality on several benchmarks. We propose MPRisk, a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that keeps the same Bayesian posterior but directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision: false-acceptance, misidentification, and false-rejection risks, plus a non-specificity penalty for rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component. Four nonnegative weights tuned on a validation set suffice for ranking; no nonlinear supervised model is required. Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, MPRisk achieves the best or tied-best Prediction Rejection Ratio at every operating point on the image and audio benchmarks and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks (up to $+0.19$ PRR) at comparable or lower runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开放集识别 (OSR) 中，HolUE 用 KL 散度分量经有监督非线性校准器映射为不确定性分数，但该 KL 摘要对决策风险并不单调，验证集上调的线性融合在多个基准上出现负过滤质量。MPRisk 保留同一贝叶斯后验，改为直接对所选决策对应的错误事件打分（误接收、错分、误拒，外加拒绝的非特异性惩罚），未知身份用连续分量建模，只需验证集调四个非负权重。在图像、音频、文本九个基准上，MPRisk 在图像与音频全部工作点、文本多数工作点取得最好或并列最好的 Prediction Rejection Ratio，五个基准上相对 HolUE 有 bootstrap 确认的增益（最高 +0.19 PRR），运行时间相当或更低。
Motivation: 选择性识别需要按已做决策的风险给探针排序，但现有 Bayesian gallery-aware 模型把后验压成 KL 分量再交给有监督非线性校准器，该摘要与决策风险不单调，导致验证集上调出的融合在部分基准上过滤质量为负。
Method: MPRisk 沿用 HolUE 的贝叶斯后验，把未知身份建模为连续分量，直接对误接收、错分、误拒三类错误事件加拒绝的非特异性惩罚打分；四个非负权重在验证集上调节即可排序，无需非线性有监督模型。
Result: 在九个图像、音频、文本基准上，MPRisk 于图像与音频的每个工作点、文本的多数工作点取得最好或并列最好的 Prediction Rejection Ratio (PRR)；五个基准上相对 HolUE 有 bootstrap 确认的增益，最高 +0.19 PRR，运行时间相当或更低。对照结论是验证集调的 KL 分量线性融合在若干基准上过滤质量为负。
Conclusion: 不确定性分数应直接对所选决策的错误事件风险打分，而不是依赖对决策风险不单调的 KL 摘要；四个非负权重的线性打分已足够排序，无需非线性校准器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph-Based Learning for Multi-Horizon Martian Atmospheric Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Martian weather forecasting is important for future exploration, but atmospheric behaviour on Mars combines spatial, temporal, vertical, and dust-driven processes in ways that challenge current modelling and forecasting approaches. This paper introduces MaGMA (Martian Graph-based Multi-horizon Atmospheric Forecasting), a graph-based data engineering framework that transforms OpenMARS reanalysis fields into structured learning objects for Martian atmospheric forecasting. Local atmospheric patches are represented as graph nodes and linked through spatial neighbourhoods, temporal continuity, longer temporal dependencies, and dynamically similar atmospheric states. The model integrates recent atmospheric history, engineered physical descriptors, and vertical atmospheric information to support forecasting across multiple horizons. We evaluate MaGMA across five unseen Martian years, including regular years and a global dust storm year. In regular years, the model achieves overall R^2 values of approximately 0.73-0.85. For dust-column forecasting, it outperforms classical and deep temporal baselines in most year-horizon comparisons. During the global dust storm year, dust-column prediction remains strong at shorter horizons, with R^2 above 0.8 for the first two horizons, while broader multivariate performance declines. The results show that graph-based data engineering can create reusable and diagnostically useful representations for planetary atmospheric forecasting, while highlighting the need for better learning under rare extreme regimes and improved use of vertical atmospheric structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaGMA 把 OpenMARS 再分析场切成局部大气 patch 并构图，用空间邻域、时间连续性、长程时间依赖与动态相似状态四类边连接节点，做火星多时效大气预报。在五个未见火星年（含全球沙尘暴年）上，常年整体 R² 约 0.73–0.85，沙尘柱在前两个时效 R² 超过 0.8，但沙尘暴年多变量表现下滑。
Motivation: 火星大气耦合空间、时间、垂直与沙尘驱动过程，现有建模与预报方式难以同时处理这些多尺度结构，且缺少可复用的学习表示。
Method: 提出图数据工程框架 MaGMA：将 OpenMARS 再分析场转为图节点（局部大气 patch），边由空间邻域、时间连续、长程时间依赖与动态相似大气状态构成；模型融合近期大气历史、人工设计的物理描述子与垂直大气信息，支持多时效预报。
Result: 在五个未见火星年评估（含常年与全球沙尘暴年）：常年整体 R² 约 0.73–0.85；沙尘柱预报在多数年份-时效对比中优于经典与深度时序基线；沙尘暴年沙尘柱前两个时效 R² 高于 0.8，更广的多变量表现下降。
Conclusion: 图数据工程能为行星大气预报生成可复用且可诊断的表示，但稀有极端 regime 下的学习与垂直大气结构的利用仍需改进。

papers.title: GUIDE-FBO: Guidance via Uncertainty Intervention and Distributional Exchange for Federated Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Federated Bayesian Optimization (FBO) enables distributed agents to collaboratively optimize expensive black-box objectives without sharing raw local observations. However, effective knowledge transfer remains challenging under communication constraints and task heterogeneity. We propose GUIDE-FBO, in which agents exchange compact distributions over the locations of their respective optima inferred from local Gaussian process (GP) posteriors, rather than raw observations, query points, or surrogate parameters. The server merges and reweights these distributional components before returning a subset to each agent. Each agent then constructs a Federated Interventional GP (FI-GP), which preserves the local posterior mean and spatially rescales its covariance for local decision making. For the upper confidence bound (UCB) instantiation, GUIDE-UCB, we prove that any bounded FI-GP uncertainty intervention preserves the leading-order cumulative regret rate of standard GP-UCB. When the transferred distributions place greater support near an optimum than in a suboptimal region, selecting the latter requires greater local posterior uncertainty. Experiments on 12 synthetic benchmarks and three real-world optimization tasks show that GUIDE-FBO remains effective across settings ranging from homogeneous to severely heterogeneous. Ablation results highlight the importance of spatially localized uncertainty intervention, while the communication analysis shows that GUIDE-FBO exchanges only compact distributional messages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUIDE-FBO 让联邦中的各智能体只交换各自最优点位置的紧凑分布（由本地 GP 后验推断），服务器合并重加权后回传子集，各智能体据此构造保持后验均值、空间重标定协方差的 Federated Interventional GP (FI-GP)。对 UCB 实例 GUIDE-UCB 证明：任何有界的 FI-GP 不确定性干预都保持标准 GP-UCB 的首阶累积遗憾率；当迁移分布对最优区域支撑更强时，选次优点需要更大的本地后验不确定性。
Motivation: 联邦贝叶斯优化中，通信受限与任务异构使有效知识迁移困难：直接共享原始观测、查询点或代理参数既费带宽又难适配异构任务。
Method: 各智能体从本地 Gaussian process 后验推断最优点位置的分布并交换，而非原始观测或代理参数；服务器对这些分布分量合并与重加权后返回子集；每个智能体据此构造 FI-GP，保留本地后验均值并对协方差做空间重标定，用于本地决策；UCB 实例为 GUIDE-UCB，并给出遗憾率保持的理论证明。
Result: 在 12 个合成基准与 3 个真实优化任务上，GUIDE-FBO 从同构到严重异构设置均保持有效；消融结果凸显空间局部化不确定性干预的重要性；通信分析显示其只交换紧凑分布消息。理论上，任何有界的 FI-GP 不确定性干预保持标准 GP-UCB 的首阶累积遗憾率。
Conclusion: 以最优点位置分布而非原始数据做联邦迁移，配合空间局部的不确定性干预，可在通信受限和任务异构下维持 GP-UCB 级别的遗憾率。

papers.title: Persona Following Is Not Selective Control: The Neutrality Gap in LLM User Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Persona prompting is widely used to construct user simulations with large language models (LLMs), yet it relies on a largely untested assumption: specifying one user attribute should change that attribute alone. We test this assumption and identify a systematic failure of selective control: across all eight black-box LLMs we audit, changing a target attribute also shifts responses on unspecified, non-target attributes. For example, describing a user as more risk-seeking shifts color choices, even though the prompt never mentions color; we term this cross-attribute influence. Semantic, contextual, and internal analyses collectively suggest that models treat a persona prompt as evidence about the user and extend the inferred profile to unspecified preferences, a process we call trait-conditioned completion. We next ask whether explicitly specifying non-target attributes restores selective control. When a non-target attribute is assigned a clear direction, models generally follow the declaration and suppress the target attribute's influence. However, when the same attribute is declared neutral, the target continues to affect choices across all five open-weight checkpoints, even when the model correctly reports the declared state. This disparity, the neutrality gap, demonstrates that successful persona following does not imply selective persona control, which additionally requires keeping non-target attributes stable. We operationalize this distinction with a three-state diagnostic that leaves the non-target attribute unspecified or declares it directional or neutral; because directional tests can be passed by simply following the stated persona, the neutral state reveals failures they miss. In a post hoc analysis of independent items, neutral declarations leave 51-81% of items target-sensitive, against at most 1 of 320 item-pole comparisons under directional ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 审计八个黑盒 LLM 的 persona following，发现指定单一用户属性会连带改变未指定属性（cross-attribute influence），因为模型把 persona 当作用户证据并外推到未声明偏好（trait-conditioned completion）。显式给出非目标属性方向时模型服从声明并压制目标影响，但声明为 neutral 时目标属性仍影响选择：五个开源 checkpoint 上 51–81% 的条目仍对目标敏感，而方向性声明下 320 个条目-极性对比中至多 1 个失败。
Motivation: 用 persona prompting 构造 LLM 用户模拟依赖一个未经检验的假设：指定一个用户属性只改变该属性本身。若该假设不成立，persona 模拟出的用户反应就不能当作可控的单变量操纵。
Method: 对八个黑盒 LLM 做选择性控制审计，配合语义、上下文与内部表征分析解释机制；提出三态诊断（three-state diagnostic），把非目标属性分别留空、声明方向或声明中性，用以区分“照读声明”与真正的选择性控制。
Result: 八个被审计的黑盒 LLM 全部出现跨属性影响：描述用户更 risk-seeking 会改变颜色选择，尽管 prompt 未提颜色。方向性声明下模型通常服从并压制目标属性影响；中性声明下目标属性仍影响选择，五个开源 checkpoint 皆如此，即使模型能正确报告所声明状态。事后分析中，中性声明使 51–81% 的条目仍对目标敏感，方向性声明下 320 个条目-极性对比至多 1 个失败。
Conclusion: 成功的 persona following 不等于选择性 persona 控制：方向性测试可被“照读声明”蒙混过关，只有中性状态能暴露这些失败，评估用户模拟时必须检验非目标属性是否保持稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: THEIA: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Vision-Language Analysis of Layout
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes THEIA, a novel dataset containing thousands of layout images paired with question-answer conversations, along with a benchmark that employs a fine-tuned vision-language model (VLM) to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling designers to interact with and query physical layouts as intuitive, meaningful entities. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across five realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed fine-tuned VLM outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose VLMs by a significant margin (up to 73%), highlighting a fundamental gap between general-purpose multimodal reasoning and domain-specific layout understanding.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, to be published in NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: THEIA 提出面向模拟集成电路版图的多模态数据集与基准：数千张 GDSII 版图图像配对问答对话，用微调后的视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 让设计者直接查询物理版图。在覆盖数千个模拟设计的五项真实任务上，微调 VLM 比通用 VLM 最高高出 73%，显示通用多模态推理与领域版图理解之间存在根本差距。
Motivation: 模拟 IC 设计正从人工与算法方案转向自动化智能化，但 GDSII 中的几何与寄生信息难以用自然语言查询，通用 VLM 缺乏版图领域理解。
Method: 构建 THEIA 数据集：数千张 GDSII 版图图像与问答对话配对；基准上微调一个视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 来解析并回答关于模拟电路物理版图的问题，评测覆盖五项真实任务。
Result: 在数千个模拟设计、五项真实任务上，微调 VLM 相比最先进的通用 VLM 最高提升 73%。
Conclusion: 领域微调能显著弥合通用多模态推理与模拟电路版图理解之间的差距，VLM 可作为设计者查询 GDSII 版图的接口。

papers.title: Recommendation Ranking Off-Policy Evaluation under Ranking-Dependent Examination via Examination-Relevance Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy evaluation, which estimates evaluation policy performance from logged data, is key for recommender ranking policies. However, logged clicks cannot distinguish unexamined items from examined non-clicks, causing bias in existing estimators when the assumed examination structures fail. We propose two estimators based on the decomposition of clicks into examination and relevance. First, the latent-examination independent inverse propensity score (LE-IIPS) estimator corrects the IIPS bias using policy examination probability ratios. Second, the examination-decomposed doubly robust (ED-DR) estimator extends LE-IIPS to a doubly robust framework. ED-DR is unbiased if the examination probabilities are correct regardless of relevance accuracy, or under ranking-independent examination, even if both model estimates are inaccurate. Experiments show that ED-DR achieves a lower MSE than existing methods with large sample sizes, especially when the examination depends on ranking. We also highlight its limitations under small samples or cascade user behavior conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐系统排序策略的离线评估 (off-policy evaluation) 中，点击日志无法区分「未被浏览」与「浏览了但不点」，当假设的 examination 结构失效时既有估计量有偏。作者把点击分解为 examination 与 relevance 两部分，提出 LE-IIPS 与 ED-DR；ED-DR 在 examination 概率正确时无偏（不论 relevance 是否准确），或在 examination 与排序无关时即使两个模型都不准也无偏。大样本下 ED-DR 的 MSE 低于现有方法，examination 依赖排序时优势最明显。
Motivation: 日志点击无法区分未浏览与浏览未点击，当真实 examination 结构与估计器假设不符时，现有 OPE 估计量产生偏差，无法可靠评估新的排序策略。
Method: 把点击分解为 examination 与 relevance：LE-IIPS 用策略间 examination 概率比修正 IIPS 的偏差；ED-DR 将 LE-IIPS 扩展到 doubly robust 框架。
Result: ED-DR 在大样本下 MSE 低于现有方法，尤其在 examination 依赖 ranking 时；其无偏性条件为 examination 概率正确（不论 relevance 准确性）或 ranking-independent examination（即使两个模型都不准）。摘要同时指出小样本与 cascade 用户行为条件下存在局限。
Conclusion: 显式分解 examination 与 relevance 能在 examination 结构失配时降低 OPE 偏差，但小样本和 cascade 行为下优势不成立。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
papers.abstract_en: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JRDB-AVR 把具身视觉推理评测从「只看最终答案」改成「答案 + 支撑证据」双重打分：智能体在有限视野下按时间戳与视角主动请求有界观测，回答由结构化问题生成引擎从真实 JRDB 机器人数据派生的多环境问题。实验显示现有基线的答案准确率与证据准确率之间存在显著落差，即 VLM 可以在未观测到相关物体、时刻或视角的情况下给出正确答案。
Motivation: 现有视觉推理基准多评测被动观测与最终答案，无法区分「答对」与「真的看到了证据」；具身场景中证据分散在时间、视角与交互物体上，有限视野使这一漏洞更严重。
Method: 从真实 JRDB 机器人数据构建基准，用结构化问题生成引擎 (structured question-generation engine) 产生涵盖时间搜索、视角选择与面向人的组合推理的多环境问题；评测同时约束按时间戳与视角的有界观测请求，并对最终答案与支撑视觉证据分别打分。配套提出参考方法 JRDB-AVR-Agent，维护显式的、以观测为依据的图结构世界模型 (observation-grounded graph-based world model) 并通过求解作答。
Result: 实验揭示现有基线中答案准确率与证据准确率之间存在显著落差 (substantial gap)，表明当前 VLM 能给出缺乏证据支撑的正确答案。
Conclusion: 对具身视觉推理必须做主动的、证据感知的评测，仅凭最终答案会高估 VLM 的真实推理能力；代码与基准已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PEAR: Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch for Industrial Search Systems
papers.abstract_en: AutoResearch improves systems through iterative experimentation: agents propose candidate modifications, evaluate them, and use the results to guide subsequent exploration. Applying this paradigm to industrial search presents two challenges. (1) Common AutoResearch approaches follow a keep-if-better rule, retaining the highest-scoring candidate for subsequent experiments. Under non-stationary traffic, transient gains may be mistaken for persistent improvements, impairing reliable accumulation of search knowledge. (2) Candidate modifications can be evaluated at multiple fidelity levels, from low-cost proxies to online validation, differing in cost, objective alignment, and statistical reliability. Existing methods rely on individual signals or task-specific procedures, lacking a unified basis for using evidence across levels to guide search. We introduce Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch (PEAR) with two complementary components. Evidence-driven AutoResearch maintains an independent, hypothesis-guided research state for each strategy task within a predefined objective and intervention scope. Each state evolves through a Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update transition that links experimentation to context-aware evidence interpretation and hypothesis revision. Confidence-Gated Verifier Ladder organizes evaluation into four levels of increasing fidelity: Offline Replay, Shadow-Traffic Evaluation, Rapid Online Evaluation, and Decision-Grade Online Evaluation. A unified confidence-based gate promotes candidates only when evidence supports a statistically significant positive effect, enabling broad low-cost exploration while reserving costly online experiments for promoted candidates. In a real-world industrial search system, strategies optimized with PEAR significantly increased Main Order/DAU by 2.7336% and 3.2957% relative to their respective baselines in two A/B experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEAR 把工业搜索的 AutoResearch 改成证据驱动的假设循环：每个策略任务维护独立研究状态，按 Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update 迭代，并用统一置信度门控在四级保真度阶梯（Offline Replay → Shadow-Traffic → Rapid Online → Decision-Grade Online）上逐级晋升候选，只有统计显著为正才晋级。在真实工业搜索系统的两组 A/B 实验中，Main Order/DAU 相对各自基线分别提升 2.7336% 与 3.2957%。
Motivation: keep-if-better 规则在流量非平稳时会把瞬时增益当成持久改进，损害搜索知识的可靠累积；而候选修改可在低成本代理到在线验证的多个保真度上评估，现有方法只用单一信号或任务专用流程，缺少跨层级统一的证据使用依据。
Method: 两个组件：Evidence-driven AutoResearch 在预定义目标与干预范围内为每个策略任务维护独立、假设引导的研究状态，通过 Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update 转移把实验与上下文相关的证据解释、假设修订绑定；Confidence-Gated Verifier Ladder 把评估组织为四级递增保真度（Offline Replay、Shadow-Traffic Evaluation、Rapid Online Evaluation、Decision-Grade Online Evaluation），用统一的基于置信度的门控仅在证据支持统计显著正效应时晋升候选，让广泛低成本探索与昂贵在线实验分离。
Result: 在真实工业搜索系统中，PEAR 优化的策略在两组 A/B 实验里 Main Order/DAU 相对各自基线分别显著提升 2.7336% 与 3.2957%。
Conclusion: 以假设驱动的研究状态加置信度门控的多保真度晋升，能在非平稳工业流量下把低成本探索与统计显著的在线验证衔接起来，从而可靠累积搜索知识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast Learning Rate Transfer in Shallow Linear Networks at Growing Training Horizons
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter transfer across model width can substantially reduce the cost of tuning large neural networks, but its behavior when the training horizon grows with width is not fully understood. Building on the framework of fast hyperparameter transfer (Ghosh et al., 2026), which formalizes when transfer is effective, we investigate conditions that ensure fast transfer in the growing-horizon regime. Specifically, we study learning-rate transfer in a shallow linear network with a single trainable hidden matrix, trained by full-batch gradient descent. Under additional spectral assumptions, our main results are threefold. (i) We prove fast learning-rate transfer as $n,T\to\infty$ whenever $T=o(\sqrt{n})$. (ii) We characterize the transfer rates through the finite-width perturbation scale, the first-order sensitivities of the loss and its learning-rate derivative to finite-width perturbations, and the local loss curvature. (iii) We derive limiting distributions for the optimal learning rate and optimized loss, governed by fluctuations associated with the extreme eigenvalues of the data Gram matrix. These results clarify how spectral structure and local loss sensitivities govern learning-rate transfer at growing horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在宽度 n 与训练时长 T 同时增长的 regime 下，浅层线性网络（单个可训练隐藏矩阵、全批量梯度下降）中学习率可跨宽度快速迁移：只要 T=o(√n) 即可证明 fast transfer，且最优学习率与优化后损失的极限分布由数据 Gram 矩阵的极端特征值波动支配。
Motivation: 超参数跨模型宽度迁移能大幅降低大网络调参成本，但训练时长随宽度增长时迁移何时仍有效尚不清楚，现有 fast hyperparameter transfer 框架未覆盖 growing-horizon regime。
Method: 基于 Ghosh et al. (2026) 的 fast hyperparameter transfer 框架，研究浅层线性网络（单隐藏可训练矩阵、全批量梯度下降）的学习率迁移，附加谱假设；用有限宽度扰动尺度、损失及其学习率一阶敏感度、局部损失曲率刻画迁移速率。
Result: 证明当 T=o(√n) 时 n,T→∞ 下 fast learning-rate transfer 成立；给出由有限宽度扰动尺度、损失与学习率导数的一阶敏感度、局部曲率决定的迁移速率刻画；导出最优学习率与优化损失的极限分布，其波动由数据 Gram 矩阵极端特征值决定。
Conclusion: 学习率跨宽度迁移在 growing-horizon 下的成败由谱结构与局部损失敏感度共同决定，训练时长相对宽度的次平方根增长是保证 fast transfer 的条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VEX-Bench: Benchmarking Verification Complexity of LLM-Generated Misinformation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have made misinformation inexpensive to produce but not to verify, creating a growing asymmetry in the information ecosystem. Under tight time, labor, and budget constraints, media organizations, platforms, and fact-checkers rely on screening to prioritize which content to verify. We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods. Verification complexity is assessed along multiple dimensions derived from journalistic and fact-checking practices, capturing checkability, harm potential, source credibility signals, imposter legitimacy, and expected verification effort. We define the VEX score as an integrated measure combining elicitation yield and verification complexity to quantify how generated content consumes limited verification capacity. We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles. We employ an LLM-as-judge for scalable evaluation and validate it using content-analysis methodology, including ordinal Krippendorff $α$ for inter-annotator reliability, complemented by fact-checking agents for verification. Our findings show that no single method dominates all dimensions, underscoring the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. LLMs can generate high-VEX misinformation at 3$\times$ to 169$\times$ lower cost than agent-based verification. Such content is often prioritized during screening, consuming scarce verification resources and introducing a systematic risk of misallocation in resource-constrained verification systems. The code is publicly available in our \href{https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench}{GitHub repository}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VEX-Bench 是评测 LLM 生成虚假信息核查复杂度的统一基准，用 VEX 分数把引出率与核查复杂度合成，量化内容对有限核查容量的消耗。基准覆盖 2 类虚假信息、6 个高风险领域、60 个真实话题，评测 7 个前沿 LLM 与 7 种生成方法共 5,880 篇文章；LLM 生成高 VEX 内容的成本比基于 agent 的核查低 3 倍到 169 倍，且这类内容常在筛查中被优先送核，挤占稀缺核查资源。
Motivation: LLM 让虚假信息生产变得廉价而核查依然昂贵，媒体、平台与事实核查者在时间、人力与预算约束下只能靠筛查决定核查顺序，缺少衡量生成内容消耗核查容量的统一评测。
Method: 从新闻与事实核查实践导出多维核查复杂度（checkability、harm potential、source credibility signals、imposter legitimacy、expected verification effort），定义结合 elicitation yield 与核查复杂度的 VEX 分数；用 LLM-as-judge 做规模化评测，并以内容分析方法验证，包括 ordinal Krippendorff α 衡量标注者间信度，辅以 fact-checking agents 做核查。
Result: 基准含 2 类虚假信息、6 个高风险领域、60 个真实话题，评测 7 个前沿 LLM 与 7 种生成方法，产出 5,880 篇文章；没有任何单一生成方法在所有维度上占优；LLM 生成高 VEX 虚假信息的成本比 agent 式核查低 3 倍至 169 倍。
Conclusion: 虚假信息的核查复杂度必须多维评估，且高 VEX 内容会系统性挤占受限核查体系的资源、带来错配风险。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present WebPageBench, an open framework for evaluating web agents in which every task is verified from the interface's own event log. Six instrumented mock sites with brand identifiers removed (a marketplace, a bookstore, a grocery service, rail ticketing, hotel search and a document cabinet) emit typed events with parameters as a user or an agent acts. A task declares the events it requires, and success is decided by matching them, with no judge model and no scraping of rendered pages. The same instrumentation supports controlled UI variation: one configuration switch re-renders a task through a different implementation of a single control while the prompt and the success conditions stay completely identical, so sensitivity to interface form can be measured under a fixed task specification. The WebPageBench release consists of three components: 152 tasks, divided into 65 canonical scenarios and 87 control variants across light/dark UI-modes; a common runner evaluated with six browser/DOM harness configurations and five screenshot-only GUI-agent families; and a public leaderboard of 24 model-harness pairs. On the public 152-task leaderboard the gap between what agents declare finished and what the log confirms reaches 41 points (one configuration declares every task finished and satisfies the conditions on 59%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebPageBench 用被测网站自身的事件日志判定 web agent 任务成败，任务声明所需事件并按事件匹配判定，不依赖 judge model 也不抓取渲染页面。同一套插桩支持只换单个控件实现、prompt 与成功条件完全不变的受控 UI 变体，从而在固定任务规格下度量界面形式敏感性。公开 152 任务榜上，agent 自称完成与日志确认之间的差距最高达 41 个百分点，有一个配置自称全部完成而实际只满足 59% 的条件。
Motivation: web agent 评测常靠 judge model 或页面抓取判定成功，结果易受评判模型与页面渲染噪声影响，且难以把任务规格固定住来单独度量界面形式带来的敏感性。
Method: 构建六个去除品牌标识的插桩 mock 站点（marketplace、bookstore、grocery、rail ticketing、hotel search、document cabinet），在用户或 agent 操作时发出带参数的 typed events；任务声明所需事件并按事件匹配判定成功。发布三部分：152 个任务（65 个 canonical 场景 + 87 个 light/dark 控件变体）、一个统一 runner（六种 browser/DOM harness 配置与五个 screenshot-only GUI-agent 家族）、以及 24 个 model-harness 组合的公开 leaderboard。

papers.title: AutoDataBench: Can Agents Write the Data That Feeds the Self-Improvement Loop?
papers.abstract_en: Recent gains in language model capability have come more from data than from architecture. Frontier labs and data companies produce verifiable agentic tasks, which supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning then turn into capability.This production line still rests on human labour and on human-in-the-loop collaboration. Automating task creation would let data production scale with compute rather than with expert headcount, would extend to more domains, and would enable a key step in recursive self-improvement (RSI). Current evaluations of an agent's ability to write such tasks measure how a model performs after training on what the agent produced. That does not match common practice in the data industry, where data is delivered sample by sample and each sample is accepted against a set of criteria rather than put straight into training. No existing evaluation asks whether an individual task meets the acceptance criteria of a data pipeline. We therefore introduce AutoDataBench. Given an original benchmark task and a record of the target model attempting it, an agent must write a new task for the same suite that meets practical acceptance standards on validity, novelty, difficulty and behavioural coverage. Across three benchmarks of executable agent tasks, no agent we evaluate scores above 20 out of 100 at the default time budget of 45 minutes. Giving the strongest agent four times as long improves its score substantially, while the cost of one usable task stays almost unchanged. Current agents can write training tasks of the required quality, but not efficiently. AutoDataBench provides a direct measure of an agent's capacity for autonomous data synthesis: one artifact at a time, judged against the criteria a production pipeline would apply, and without a training run. Code and data are available at https://github.com/StarDewXXX/AutoDataBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoDataBench 把「agent 能否写出可喂给自我改进循环的训练任务」改成逐样本验收：给定原始 benchmark 任务与目标模型的作答记录，agent 需为同一套件新写一个任务，同时满足 validity、novelty、difficulty、behavioural coverage 四条验收标准，且无需跑训练。在三个可执行 agent 任务 benchmark 上，默认 45 分钟预算内没有任何 agent 得分超过 20/100；把最强 agent 的时间放大四倍分数显著上升，而单个可用任务的成本几乎不变。
Motivation: 现有评测靠「用 agent 生成的数据训练后再测模型」来间接衡量任务生成能力，与数据行业逐样本验收的实际流程不符；没有评测直接问单个任务是否满足数据管线的验收标准，自动化任务生产因此无法随算力扩展。
Method: 输入为原始 benchmark 任务加目标模型尝试该任务的记录，agent 为同一 suite 生成新任务；按 validity、novelty、difficulty、behavioural coverage 四项验收标准逐样本打分，不进行任何训练；评测覆盖三个可执行 agent 任务 benchmark，默认时间预算 45 分钟，并测试延长预算的影响。
Result: 三个 benchmark 上默认 45 分钟预算下所有被评 agent 得分均不超过 20/100；给最强 agent 四倍时长后分数显著提升，而产出一个可用任务的成本几乎不变。
Conclusion: 当前 agent 已能写出达到质量要求的训练任务，但效率不足；AutoDataBench 提供了不依赖训练运行、逐样本按生产管线标准衡量 agent 自主数据合成能力的直接指标，代码与数据已开源。

papers.title: Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Proxy2World 是一个可控世界模型：只用普通带位姿的 RGBD 视频训练，不依赖人工构造的 proxy-video 配对数据，通过跨模态 flow matching 同时学深度条件 RGB 生成与 RGBD 联合生成。推理时用 proxy-camera 混合去噪，让生成画面既跟随 proxy 结构又保持自然细节；在自建 ProxyBench 上，它在结构遵循与视觉质量的平衡上优于 camera-controlled 与 geometry-conditioned 方法。
Motivation: 轻量场景 proxy 能控制布局与运动，但合适的 proxy 并不唯一，导致大规模自动构造配对 proxy-video 训练数据很困难。
Method: 模型从普通 posed RGBD 视频中通过 cross-modal flow matching 联合学习深度条件 RGB 生成与 RGBD 联合生成两个任务；推理阶段采用 proxy-camera 混合去噪 (hybrid denoising)，以 proxy 结构为约束同时生成细节。评测用作者提出的 ProxyBench，覆盖多样场景、相机轨迹与主体运动。
Result: 在 ProxyBench 上，Proxy2World 在结构遵循 (structural adherence) 与视觉质量之间取得优于 camera-controlled 和 geometry-conditioned 方法的平衡，证据来自定量指标、VLM 评估、人工评测与多组定性结果。
Conclusion: 不依赖人工 proxy-video 配对、仅从普通 posed RGBD 视频即可学到可控世界生成能力，且联合 RGB/RGBD 学习加混合去噪是实现结构遵循与画质兼顾的有效路径。

papers.title: Detection of Adversarial Attacks on Super-Resolvers Using Spectral Features
papers.abstract_en: The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models. In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights. More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks. We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios. Our proposed detector out-performs the comparison detectors in most of these scenarios and indicates that high-frequency features are most informative for detecting AdvSR attacks across SR architectures.
papers.comment: To be published in the 2026 Asilomar Conference on Signals, Systems, and Computers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对超分辨率 (super-resolution) 模型权重中被植入的对抗攻击 (AdvSR)，提出以径向平均功率谱密度 (radially-averaged power spectral density) 为特征训练 XGBoost 检测器。在训练内与跨架构场景下对比基于幅度和相位的 Fourier 谱检测器，所提方法在多数场景中更优，并显示高频特征对跨 SR 架构检测 AdvSR 攻击最有信息量。
Motivation: 深度学习模型进入图像预处理管线后，模型权重本身成为针对下游任务的对抗攻击面，而如何在预处理模型内部检测对抗行为基本未被探索。
Method: 从超分辨率网络权重提取径向平均功率谱密度作为判别特征，训练 XGBoost 二分类检测器；与基于 Fourier 幅度谱和相位谱的检测器对比，覆盖多种训练场景与跨架构 (cross-architecture) 场景。
Result: 所提检测器在多数训练与跨架构场景中优于幅度、相位两类 Fourier 谱基线检测器；分析表明高频特征对检测跨 SR 架构的 AdvSR 攻击最有信息量。
Conclusion: 权重的频谱特征足以识别嵌入超分辨率模型的对抗攻击，且高频成分是跨架构泛化的关键判别依据。

papers.title: Addressing Spatial Indistinguishability in Spatiotemporal Prediction via Optimal Transport-Guided Masking
papers.abstract_en: Spatiotemporal prediction aims to learn discriminative representations from correlated temporal signals over spatial structures for accurate future inference. A central challenge is \emph{spatial indistinguishability}: different nodes may share similar historical patterns yet evolve toward divergent futures, severely degrading forecasting performance in real-world sensor networks. Existing embedding-based and graph neural network (GNN)-based approaches can partially detect such ambiguous nodes but rely on historical similarity, struggling to capture \emph{future behavioral divergence}. We propose \textbf{STOT} (\textbf{S}patio\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{O}ptimal \textbf{T}ransport), a self-supervised framework that resolves spatiotemporal ambiguity via structured masking guided by optimal transport. Our key idea treats indistinguishability as a \emph{disambiguation} problem: future states are inferred by exploiting concurrent spatial correlations and their time-varying similarity. We design a similarity-aware metric for dynamic inter-node relationships and an optimal transport-based masking strategy to emphasize ambiguous positions during pre-training. A batch consistency constraint preserves semantic coherence, while a random-walk masking mechanism promotes structured context exploration. Experiments on six real-world datasets show that STOT performs competitively with state-of-the-art baselines on the evaluated benchmarks and improved interpretability through transport-plan visualizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STOT 把时空预测中的空间不可区分性（相似历史走向不同未来）重构为消歧问题，用最优传输 (optimal transport) 引导的结构化掩码在自监督预训练中重点遮蔽歧义节点位置。在六个真实传感器网络数据集上，STOT 与最先进基线表现相当，并通过传输计划可视化提升可解释性。
Motivation: 传感器网络中不同节点历史模式相似却走向分歧未来，现有基于 embedding 和 GNN 的方法只依赖历史相似度，难以捕捉未来行为分歧，导致预测性能严重下降。
Method: 提出自监督框架 STOT：设计面向动态节点间关系的相似性度量，用基于最优传输的掩码策略在预训练中强调歧义位置；加入 batch consistency 约束保持语义连贯，并用 random-walk 掩码促进结构化上下文探索。
Result: 在六个真实世界数据集上，STOT 在所评估的基准上与最先进基线 (state-of-the-art baselines) 表现相当，并通过传输计划 (transport plan) 可视化改善可解释性。
Conclusion: 把空间不可区分性当作消歧问题、用最优传输引导预训练掩码，可在真实传感器网络时空预测上达到 SOTA 级竞争力并带来可解释的传输计划。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Verifying the Linear Representation Hypothesis: How Interpretable Are Vision SAEs?
papers.abstract_en: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables, preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 NLP 中的 Autointerpretability Score (AIS) 迁移到视觉 SAE 概念评估，并用专门的用户研究验证其与人类判断的一致性。结果显示既有 SAE 可解释性指标之间以及它们与 AIS 均不相关，说明任何单一的 reference-free 指标（无论是否基于线性表征假设 LRH）都不足以验证视觉 SAE 的可解释性。
Motivation: SAE 的采纳建立在线性表征假设 (LRH) 之上，但当前框架只用稀疏度、字典一致性等代理指标评估可解释性，隐含假设这些代理反映人类感知对齐，这一假设本身未经检验。
Method: 将此前在 NLP 中被证明与人类判断对齐的 Autointerpretability Score (AIS) 适配到视觉任务，并通过专门的用户研究 (user study) 验证该适配方法；随后用标准可解释性指标与适配后的 AIS 双路评估 SAE 概念质量。
Result: 既有 SAE 可解释性指标之间互不相关，且均与 AIS 不相关；论文据此给出经用户研究验证的评估证据，表明度量视觉 SAE 概念可解释性比代理指标所暗示的更困难。
Conclusion: 没有任何单一的 reference-free 指标足以验证视觉 SAE 的可解释性，解释方法的设计与评估需要更可验证、锚定 ground truth 的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Environmental requirements for the use of social information by artificial life agents using evolved plastic artificial neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Evolved Plastic Artificial Neural Networks (EPANNs) consist of two principal processes, the first, evolution, and the second, development and in-life learning. In the context of the origins of social = learning, very few studies have been carried out using ALIFE models based on EPANN requirements. Studies in this field have usually involved an imitative teacher/pupil relationship. This, however, ignores the possibility that the observed behaviour is a consequence of social information cues rather than direct imitation or teaching. Starting with the first of the EPANN processes (evolution), a series of experiments was undertaken using artificial neural network (ANN) based agents in a variety of foraging environments to examine under what minimal environmental conditions the use of social information might have evolved, as measured by the number of generations taken to meet a specified fitness criterion. NEAT (Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies) was the ANN used as its evolutionary algorithm would evolve a network's topology as well its weights. Unintentionally, in the experiment there was a simple network topology based on the location of the nearest food item which enabled agents to swiftly meet the fitness criterion. With this topology, additional information, social or otherwise, was not required and could have proved to be a hindrance. However, this does indicate that for the use of social information to have evolved, it would require a greater degree of complexity in the environment to do so.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 NEAT 进化塑性人工神经网络 (EPANN) 智能体在多种觅食环境中检验社会信息利用所需的最小环境条件，以达到适应度标准所需世代数衡量。实验中意外出现的基于最近食物位置的简单网络拓扑让智能体迅速达标，此时额外的社会信息并无必要、甚至可能成为阻碍；作者据此推断，社会信息要得以进化，环境必须具备更高的复杂度。
Motivation: 既往 ALIFE 中基于 EPANN 的社会性学习研究极少，且多采用模仿式师生关系，忽略了观察到的行为可能源自社会信息线索而非直接模仿或教学。
Method: 从 EPANN 两个过程中的进化阶段入手，用 NEAT（Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies，同时进化网络拓扑与权重）驱动 ANN 智能体，在多种觅食环境中做一系列实验，以达到指定适应度标准所需世代数作为社会信息是否被利用的度量。
Result: 实验中意外演化出基于最近食物位置的简单网络拓扑，使智能体迅速达到适应度标准；在该拓扑下额外信息（社会的或其他的）不再需要，且可能构成阻碍。
Conclusion: 社会信息的进化利用需要比本实验更复杂的环境；当环境存在足够直接的线索解时，社会信息不会被选择甚至有害。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TermJudge: A Document-Level Metric Judging, Not Counting, Terminology in Machine Translation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Existing automatic metrics for evaluating terminological use in machine translation (MT) penalise any divergence from a fixed reference, conflating translation errors with the valid terminological variation that human translators routinely produce. We introduce TermJudge, a document-level terminology metric that assigns an interpretable verdict to every term occurrence: glossary-conforming occurrences are settled deterministically, while divergences are assessed under a two-step LLM-as-judge procedure using the full document context: the first detects and labels terminology errors; the second sorts valid document-level variations from inconsistencies. Validated against expert error annotations and document-level human MQM scores, TermJudge ranks first in both system- and segment-level meta-evaluation, ahead of glossary-conformity and quality-estimation baselines. When applied to eight systems translating academic documents, under two prompting conditions, we observe that glossary injection improves terminology translation in all paired comparisons, by removing genuine errors rather than valid variation. TermJudge is released as open-source code.
papers.journal_ref: WMT 2026 - The Eleventh Conference in Machine Translation 2026, Oct 2026, Budapest, Hungary
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TermJudge 是文档级机器翻译术语评测指标：对每个术语给出可解释判定，符合术语表的直接确定性通过，偏离的用两步 LLM-as-judge 结合全文上下文区分真实术语错误与合法变体。在系统级与片段级元评测中均排名第一，超过术语表一致性与 QE 基线；用于八个翻译学术文档的系统时，术语表注入在所有配对比较中都改善术语翻译，且改善来自消除真实错误而非压制合法变体。
Motivation: 现有自动术语评测指标惩罚对固定参考译文的任何偏离，把翻译错误与人类译者常产生的合法术语变体混为一谈。
Method: TermJudge 为文档级术语指标：符合术语表的出现确定性判定，偏离的用两步 LLM-as-judge（第一步检测并标注术语错误，第二步区分文档级合法变体与前后不一致）并使用全文上下文；以专家错误标注和文档级人工 MQM 分数做验证。
Result: 在系统级与片段级元评测中均排名第一，领先于 glossary-conformity 与 quality-estimation 基线；应用于八个翻译学术文档的系统、两种 prompting 条件时，glossary injection 在所有配对比较中都改善术语翻译，靠消除真实错误而非合法变体。
Conclusion: 文档级、区分错误与合法变体的判定式术语评测优于按偏离计数的指标，且术语表注入的收益来自真正纠错；代码开源。

papers.title: Automated feature engineering, AutoML, and decision-focused learning for improved energy consumption forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The rising cost and demand for energy, together with environmental sustainability goals, create major challenges for energy management. Energy Consumption Forecasting (ECF) supports planning by predicting future consumption, but Machine Learning (ML) models for ECF often depend on expert-driven Feature Engineering (FE). This thesis addresses that dependence through three contributions. First, it establishes and evaluates a comprehensive FE pipeline for ECF and investigates domain-specific features. Second, it introduces AutoEnergy, a domain-tailored automated FE algorithm that generates interpretable features from timestamps and lagged consumption and integrates with AutoML for end-to-end ECF modelling. Across eighteen real-world energy datasets spanning residential, commercial, industrial, renewable, and grid domains, AutoEnergy reduces forecasting error by 19.52%-84.72% relative to baseline AutoML and established automated FE methods, while running 1.31-4.41 times faster, with gains varying by dataset. Third, AutoEnergy is integrated with Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) for a Battery Energy Storage System problem, jointly forecasting electricity prices and demand while optimising charging and discharging decisions. On a real-world UK property dataset, this approach reduces operating costs by 22.9%-56.5% compared with the same DFL models without automated FE. Overall, the results show that domain-specific automated FE can reduce reliance on manual feature design, improve forecasting accuracy, and translate predictive gains into measurable operational benefits in energy management.
papers.comment: PhD thesis, School of Computer Science, University of Nottingha, United Kingdom
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoEnergy 是面向能耗预测 (ECF) 的领域定制自动特征工程算法，从时间戳与滞后用电量生成可解释特征并接入 AutoML 端到端建模。在 18 个真实能源数据集上，相对基线 AutoML 与已有自动 FE 方法，预测误差降低 19.52%–84.72%，运行快 1.31–4.41 倍；与决策聚焦学习 (DFL) 结合后，英国某物业的储能运行成本下降 22.9%–56.5%。
Motivation: 能耗预测的机器学习模型长期依赖专家手工特征工程，费时且难以迁移到住宅、商业、工业、可再生与电网等不同数据集。
Method: 三部分贡献：建立并评估 ECF 特征工程流水线并考察领域特定特征；提出 AutoEnergy，从时间戳与滞后消费量生成可解释特征，与 AutoML 集成做端到端建模；再把 AutoEnergy 接入 Decision-Focused Learning，对电池储能系统联合预测电价与需求并优化充放电决策。
Result: 在 18 个覆盖住宅、商业、工业、可再生与电网的真实数据集上，AutoEnergy 相对基线 AutoML 和已有自动 FE 方法降低预测误差 19.52%–84.72%，速度快 1.31–4.41 倍，增益随数据集变化。在真实英国物业数据集上，AutoEnergy + DFL 相对不含自动 FE 的同一 DFL 模型降低运行成本 22.9%–56.5%。
Conclusion: 领域定制的自动特征工程可减少对人工特征设计的依赖、提高预测精度，并把预测增益转化为能源管理中可度量的运行成本收益。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Price Stability in the European Union: A Systemic Approach Using Random Matrix Theory
papers.abstract_en: Price stability remains a pillar in monetary policy practices and carries a special importance within monetary unions. Mainstream economics tried to leverage price stability using price indices and several metrics to shed light on specific dynamics and optimal macroeconomic levels. The wide availability of data led researchers to consider the study of systems using Random Matrix Theory, based on inner correlation patterns. This aims to enhance the multivariate analysis by removing noisy patterns from the signal and improve data quality for further inferences. This work considers the collection of monthly inflation indices in the Eurozone as a \textit{system} of prices to analyze its eigenvalues' statistical and asymptotic properties and uncover inner country-level insights. Results confirm the system cannot assumed to be randomly generated, and the data exhibit noise-dominated patterns, due to small and persistent variations at the country-level. The latter make the inter-country correlations more dynamic and the separation of the signal from the noise quiet difficult. Findings identified two countries as distorting inflation dynamics besides three other distinct, regional-based groups of countries. Variability sources might stem from economic episodes fueling inflation spikes in some countries, as well as methodological aspects used to ensure data quality and representativeness in the European Union. Despite being complex, the system demonstrates a certain stability, in terms of self-organization; while large monthly fluctuations cannot be considered as rare events, but part of the data-generating process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把欧元区各国月度通胀指数当作一个价格系统，用随机矩阵理论 (RMT) 分析其相关矩阵特征值的统计与渐近性质，以从信号中剔除噪声。结果确认该系统不能视为随机生成，数据呈噪声主导模式，识别出两个扭曲通胀动态的国家和三个区域性国家组；系统在自组织意义上保持一定稳定，大幅月度波动是数据生成过程的常态而非罕见事件。
Motivation: 主流经济学依赖价格指数做单变量分析，难以刻画货币联盟内多国价格的联合动态；数据量增大后需要从相关矩阵中分离信号与噪声，以支撑后续推断。
Method: 收集欧元区月度通胀指数作为价格系统，计算国家间相关矩阵并分析其特征值的统计与渐近性质，用 RMT 剔除噪声主导的模式，再从残余结构中提取国家层面与区域性分组信息。
Result: 系统不能被假定为随机生成；数据呈噪声主导模式，源于国家层面小幅而持续的变化，使国家间相关更动态、信号与噪声分离相当困难；识别出两个扭曲通胀动态的国家以及另外三个区域性国家组；大幅月度波动被视为数据生成过程的一部分而非罕见事件。
Conclusion: 欧元区通胀系统虽复杂却表现出自组织意义上的稳定，但噪声主导与动态相关使信号-噪声分离困难，通胀波动需按数据生成过程的常态来理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sub-Model Short-Term Memory Convolutions for Keyword Spotting Systems on Device
papers.abstract_en: Keyword Spotting (KWS) is becoming increasingly important as voice-controlled devices grow more widespread. While voice interaction with smartphones and smart TVs is already common, deploying KWS on heavily resource-constrained edge devices such as wearables remains challenging. These systems must meet high accuracy requirements while operating under strict constraints on computational power, memory footprint, and real-time latency. In this work, we present an application of the STMC (Short-Term Memory Convolutions) framework to adapt a modular CNN model for online, LSTM-like inference. Our approach reduces power consumption and redundant computations while maintaining the stability and simplicity of training CNNs. We achieve up to 82% and 46% MCPS reduction compared to equivalently frequent standard CNN execution and vanilla STMC, respectively. The best configuration achieves 93.8% accuracy on the 11-class Google Speech Commands task and 97.1% on the same task with zero-padded data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 STMC（Short-Term Memory Convolutions）框架套到模块化 CNN 上，使其支持在线、类 LSTM 的增量推理，从而在可穿戴等重度受限设备上省电并去掉冗余计算。相比同等频率的标准 CNN 执行和 vanilla STMC，MCPS 分别最多降低 82% 和 46%；最佳配置在 11 类 Google Speech Commands 上达到 93.8% 准确率，zero-padded 数据上 97.1%。
Motivation: 语音唤醒关键词识别 (KWS) 要在可穿戴等算力、内存、实时延迟都极紧的边缘设备上同时满足高准确率，而直接跑 CNN 或 LSTM 在这类设备上代价过高。
Method: 将 STMC 框架应用于模块化 CNN 模型，使其转为在线、LSTM 式的逐步推理，同时保留 CNN 训练的稳定性与简洁性；评测任务为 11 类 Google Speech Commands，含 zero-padded 数据变体。
Result: MCPS 相比同等频率的标准 CNN 执行最多降低 82%，相比 vanilla STMC 最多降低 46%；最佳配置在 11 类 Google Speech Commands 上准确率 93.8%，同一任务加 zero-padded 数据后 97.1%。
Conclusion: STMC 改造能让模块化 CNN 在保持训练简单的同时做在线增量推理，以更少的计算与功耗换取有竞争力的 KWS 准确率，适合资源受限的边缘设备。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Act under Visual Interruptions with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but they are typically developed and evaluated with all camera streams available throughout task execution. When a camera stops delivering frames during task execution, the policy must continue acting without access to subsequent observations from the missing view. Despite its practical importance, how such interruptions affect closed-loop manipulation remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this problem, we introduce MAIL-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates visual interruptions with VLA models. By interrupting different cameras at multiple stages of each policy's successful reference trajectory, MAIL-Bench measures how well policies retain their capabilities when visual inputs become unavailable. Building on this benchmark, we propose MINT, which first trains VLA policies to remain functional under missing visual inputs. At inference time, MINT selectively supplements missing observations using optical-flow extrapolation or an action-conditioned world model, and withdraws predicted views when they become unreliable. Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出视觉中断基准 MAIL-Bench 与方法 MINT：在相机掉帧时先训练 VLA 策略在缺失视觉下仍可用，推理时用光流外推或 action-conditioned world model 补齐缺失视角，并在预测不可靠时撤回。在 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 上 MINT 相对原模型显著提升相机丢失下的任务成功率，并在 AgiBot G2 上完成真机部署。
Motivation: VLA 策略默认全程拥有全部相机流，而实际执行中某路相机会停止供帧；这种视觉中断如何影响闭环操作此前理解不足，缺少统一评测。
Method: MAIL-Bench 在每条成功参考轨迹的多个阶段中断不同相机，度量策略在视觉输入缺失时的能力保持；MINT 先对缺失视觉下的 VLA 策略做训练，推理时选择性地用光流外推或 action-conditioned world model 补充缺失观测，并在预测不可靠时撤回预测视角。
Result: 在 π0.5 与 GR00T N1.5 上，MINT 相对原模型显著提高相机丢失下的任务成功率；在 AgiBot G2 上进一步展示了相机丢失时的真机部署。
Conclusion: 相机中断下的闭环操作需要训练与推理两段式处理：先让策略在缺失视觉下可用，再用可撤回的外推或世界模型补观测，比直接沿用全视角 VLA 更能保住成功率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视觉 token 压缩引入的对抗风险定义为压缩特有失败 (CSF)：同一对抗样本在全 token 推理下正确、压缩后失败。据此提出 CIRA 攻击，在视觉编码器白盒、无需下游问题/标签、不接触语言模型与压缩预算的条件下优化图像扰动，跨 12 个数据集-压缩器组合、4 档预算平均 CSFR 达 20.35%，而全 token 攻击成功率仅 6.92%。
Motivation: 聚合鲁棒性指标无法区分某次对抗失败是压缩诱发还是原模型固有，压缩引入的风险因此难以归因和度量。
Method: 先定义 CSF 并在受控诊断队列中用反事实分析保留集分配对压缩正确性的影响；再提出 CIRA，在 vision-encoder 白盒设定下通过编码器侧目标跨候选压缩预算操纵 token 优先级并保留被移位证据，不使用下游问题或标签、不访问语言模型、部署的压缩器或确切压缩预算。
Result: 在 12 个数据集-压缩器设置、4 档预算下 CIRA 平均 CSFR 20.35%，全 token 攻击成功率限制在 6.92%，在更多 LVLM 家族上行为相似；反事实显示保留集分配因果地改变压缩正确性，且恢复与被移位证据的表征漂移呈负相关；cross-view selection-stabilization 防御大幅抑制 CIRA，但 Adaptive CIRA 部分恢复其效果。
Conclusion: 压缩特有失败在受限访问条件下依然存在，风险归因需要成对评估全 token 与压缩推理，而非只看聚合鲁棒性数字。

papers.title: Simulation-Based Quantum System Inference with Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Models of quantum systems faithfully map system parameters to observations, but the inverse problem of parameter inference from measurement data presents a fundamental challenge: computationally intractable likelihoods due to an exponentially large Hilbert space. Here, we introduce simulation-based quantum system inference, a unified, likelihood-free framework that learns parameter posteriors directly from classical simulation data. The central idea is to pair polynomial-cost classical simulators, such as Pauli propagation and tensor networks, with normalizing flows or other neural density estimators for accurate, reusable inference. A single model, trained once, maps any new measurement record to its posterior in one forward pass---turning per-experiment inference into a fixed, up-front cost. We numerically demonstrate the framework's versatility across Pauli noise learning, quantum error mitigation, quantum state tomography, and Hamiltonian learning, with examples involving 81-qubit shallow circuits and 735-parameter inference. In each case, the approach yields accurate estimates of identifiable parameters, while posterior uncertainty provides additional diagnostics of non-identifiability and indicates where further characterization is needed. Our framework reduces data-acquisition requirements in quantum experiments and accelerates parameter inference, providing a practical route to characterizing and improving large-scale quantum systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 simulation-based quantum system inference：用 Pauli propagation、tensor network 等多项式代价经典模拟器生成数据，配 normalizing flow 等神经密度估计器直接学习参数后验，一次前向即得任意新测量记录的后验。在 Pauli noise learning、量子误差缓解、量子态层析、Hamiltonian learning 上数值演示，含 81-qubit 浅电路与 735 参数推断，可辨识参数估计准确，后验不确定性还能诊断不可辨识性。
Motivation: 量子系统参数推断的似然因 Hilbert 空间指数大而计算上不可行，逐实验重复推断代价高。
Method: 以多项式代价经典模拟器（Pauli propagation、tensor networks）配对 normalizing flow 等神经密度估计器，从经典模拟数据直接学习参数后验；单一模型训练一次后对任意新测量记录单次前向输出后验，把逐实验推断变成一次性前置成本。
Result: 数值演示覆盖 Pauli noise learning、quantum error mitigation、quantum state tomography、Hamiltonian learning 四类任务，规模达 81-qubit 浅电路与 735 参数推断；各任务给出可辨识参数的准确估计，后验不确定性诊断不可辨识性并指出还需进一步表征之处。
Conclusion: 似然自由的后验学习可把量子实验的参数推断变成可复用的固定成本，降低数据采集需求并加速大规模量子系统的表征与改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From One-Shot Generation to Incremental Music Composition: Adapting a General-Purpose Instruction LLM for Persistent Symbolic Editing
papers.abstract_en: Most music-generation systems are still framed and evaluated primarily as producers of complete outputs, whereas composition often proceeds through successive revisions to a shared musical artifact. This paper studies a different use of a general-purpose instruction-following large language model: not as a one-shot music generator, but as a reusable operator over an evolving symbolic score. We formulate incremental composition as a sequence of operation-aware state transitions over persistent ABC notation, with explicit requirements on what each operation may change and what it must preserve. The interaction includes two artifact-initialization variants and three editing operations -- chord addition, inpainting, and transposition. We instantiate the formulation by adapting Llama 3.1 8B Instruct with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on 496,038 operation-aware dialogue records derived from Irish traditional music. The comparison with the unadapted model is used to test the feasibility of learning this interaction contract, not to claim novelty for fine-tuning itself. Across 500 dialogues per model (1,750 attempted output states), checker admission rises from 29.37% to 99.37%, while compliance conditional on admission rises from 0.7205 to 0.9798. Strict eligibility for reference-relative musical-feature analysis increases from 14 to 1,548 outputs, and Longest Common Subsequence analysis does not show a systematic increase in high-overlap sequences relative to held-out baselines under the specified protocol. The results support the technical feasibility of persistent, operation-aware symbolic editing with a general-purpose instruction LLM. They do not establish superior musical quality or human-AI co-creativity, which remain questions for musician-centered evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把通用指令 LLM 从一次性音乐生成器改造成对持久 ABC 乐谱的可复用编辑算子：将增量作曲形式化为带变更/保持约束的操作感知状态转移，用 LoRA 在 496,038 条操作感知对话记录上微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct。每模型 500 次对话（共 1,750 个尝试输出状态）中，checker 通过率从 29.37% 升到 99.37%，通过后的合规率从 0.7205 升到 0.9798。
Motivation: 现有音乐生成系统被当作一次性产出完整作品的生成器来设计和评测，而真实作曲是围绕同一份乐谱反复修订，LLM 缺少可持久编辑的交互契约。
Method: 把增量作曲形式化为持久 ABC 记号上的操作感知状态转移，规定每个操作允许改动与必须保持的内容；含两种乐件初始化变体与三种编辑操作（chord addition、inpainting、transposition）；用 LoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，训练数据为 496,038 条由 Irish traditional music 派生的操作感知对话记录，并与未微调模型对照。
Result: 每模型 500 次对话、共 1,750 个尝试输出状态下，checker admission 从 29.37% 升至 99.37%，admission 条件下的 compliance 从 0.7205 升至 0.9798；可进入参考相对音乐特征分析的严格合格输出从 14 个增至 1,548 个；在该协议下 LCS 分析相对 held-out 基线未显示高重叠序列的系统性增加。
Conclusion: 通用指令 LLM 经 LoRA 适配后在技术上可行地支持持久、操作感知的符号乐谱编辑；结果不构成音乐质量更优或人机共创的证据，后者需由面向音乐人的评测回答。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Composable Decoding on the Probability Simplex: Theory and Implementation
papers.abstract_en: Decoding for large language models is typically treated as a collection of isolated sampling strategies, with limited theoretical understanding of the behaviours they induce and how their underlying objectives relate. We formulate decoding as an optimisation problem over next-token distributions on the probability simplex, balancing expected model score against regularisation under support constraints. This view recovers familiar decoding methods through choices of regularisers and support constraints; more importantly, it enables new decoders to be constructed by composing distributional preferences within a single optimisation problem without external rewards, learned critics, or model parameter updates. We introduce CompoSimplex, a library with configurable support rules, regularisation primitives, and simplex solvers for constructing and evaluating compositional decoders. We evaluate standard samplers, individual regularisers, and compositions across multiple models and reasoning tasks. Our results show that compositions can realise trade-offs between single-sample quality, multi-sample quality, and diversity that are not attained by individual decoding objectives.

Motivation: 现有解码被当作彼此孤立的采样策略集合，其诱导行为缺少理论刻画，各目标之间的关系也不清楚，难以系统构造兼顾质量与多样性的新解码器。

Conclusion: 解码可作为单纯形上的统一优化问题来设计，组合分布偏好是在不引入外部奖励或模型更新的前提下扩展解码器的可行路径。

papers.title: MaPP: A Unified Marginalized Posterior-Predictive Framework for Data-Efficient RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models but incurs substantial costs from rollouts and policy updates. Online prompt selection improves efficiency by using per-prompt Bayesian posteriors to predict difficulty and prioritize informative prompts. However, existing methods overlook how reliably learning signals are extracted from sampled responses. In GRPO, a response's advantage depends on both its own outcome and the randomly sampled outcomes of its peers through group normalization. Our theoretical and experimental analyses show that uncertainty in group composition introduces composition noise, a non-vanishing variance component that imposes an irreducible lower bound on gradient estimation error and impairs downstream prompt selection. We propose MaPP (Marginalized Posterior-Predictive), a unified framework for data-efficient RLVR that denoises response-level advantage estimation and improves prompt selection using a shared Beta posterior. For each response, MaPP replaces the standard group-relative advantage with a composition-invariant intrinsic advantage through closed-form Beta-Binomial marginalization. The resulting posterior-predictive estimator has an error that provably diminishes as the posterior concentrates. Using the same posterior, MaPP derives an uncertainty-aware prompt selection score to improve data efficiency without additional rollout cost. Experiments on mathematics, planning, and visual geometry across five model backbones show that MaPP consistently outperforms GRPO and strong selection baselines, achieving up to +2.45 average accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline under the same rollout budget and setting a new state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaPP 指出 GRPO 的组内归一化让优势估计依赖随机抽到的同伴结果，产生不随组增大消失的 composition noise，给梯度估计误差设下不可约下界并拖累基于后验的 prompt 选择。它用共享 Beta 后验做 Beta-Binomial 闭式边缘化，把组相对优势换成与组构成无关的 intrinsic advantage，同一后验再给出不确定性感知的 prompt 选择分数。在数学、规划与视觉几何三类任务、五个模型骨干上，同等 rollout 预算下比最强基线平均准确率最多提升 +2.45。
Motivation: RLVR 的 rollout 与策略更新开销大，在线 prompt 选择靠逐 prompt 后验预测难度来省数据，但现有方法忽略了从采样响应中提取学习信号的可靠性：GRPO 的优势同时取决于自身结果与随机同伴结果，组构成噪声给梯度估计误差设下不可约下界。
Method: MaPP（Marginalized Posterior-Predictive）用一个共享 Beta 后验同时服务两件事：对每个响应做 Beta-Binomial 闭式边缘化，把标准组相对优势替换为组构成不变的 intrinsic advantage，得到误差随后验集中而衰减的 posterior-predictive 估计器；再由同一后验导出不确定性感知的 prompt 选择分数，不增加额外 rollout。
Result: 在数学、规划、视觉几何三类任务与五个模型骨干上，MaPP 一致优于 GRPO 与强 prompt 选择基线，在相同 rollout 预算下相对最强基线平均准确率最多提升 +2.45，并刷新该设置下的 state of the art。
Conclusion: 组构成噪声是 GRPO 优势估计的不可约误差源，用共享 Beta 后验做边缘化可同时去噪优势与改进 prompt 选择，在不加 rollout 成本的前提下提高 RLVR 数据效率。

papers.title: Nürnberg NLP at ChildSafeAds 2026: Structurally Dissimilar Voter Ensembles under Four Levels of Data Access
papers.abstract_en: We describe the Nürnberg NLP system for ChildSafeAds 2026. The shared task asks what a monitoring system for commercial content in child-facing YouTube videos can achieve at a given level of data access. We answer with per-subtask ensembles of nine voters, organised into three branches that differ in backbone, adaptation method and class scope. Selection rests on channel-disjoint cross-validation, with the development set as a transfer check. The system wins two of the three subtasks. Its product-category score (ST2, 0.8243) and its compliance-flag score (ST3, 0.6530) are the best of the 22 final entries, and it places third on the task mean (0.7079). We further compare four access levels and report the cost at test-set scale.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ChildSafeAds 2026 Shared Task @ NLLP Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (1st place in 2 of 3 subtasks)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChildSafeAds 2026 共享任务中，Nürnberg NLP 用九个 voter、按 backbone/适应方法/类别范围分成三分支的结构异质集成，在四级数据访问下做儿童向 YouTube 商业内容监控。系统拿下 3 个子任务中的 2 个第一：ST2 商品类别 0.8243、ST3 合规标记 0.6530 均为 22 支最终队伍最高，任务均值 0.7079 排第三。
Motivation: 儿童向 YouTube 视频的商业内容监控需要回答：在给定数据访问级别下系统能达到什么水平，且训练数据按频道划分时不能靠频道泄漏刷分。
Method: 每个子任务用九个 voter 的集成，组织为三个分支，分支间在 backbone、适应方法和类别范围上互异；voter 选择依赖 channel-disjoint 交叉验证，并用开发集作迁移检查；同时比较四种数据访问级别并统计测试集规模下的开销。
Result: ST2 商品类别得分 0.8243、ST3 合规标记得分 0.6530，均为 22 支最终队伍中最高；任务均值 0.7079 排第三；3 个子任务中赢得 2 个；并给出四种数据访问级别的对比与测试集规模下的成本。
Conclusion: 结构异质的 voter 集成配合频道不相交交叉验证，能在受限数据访问下把儿童商业内容监控推到共享任务领先水平，且该系统在 2/3 子任务上取得第一。

papers.title: ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Multi-reward policy optimization requires a joint update that reflects both the learning signals and the intended relationships among objectives. We introduce Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG), which constructs a separate clipped policy objective for each reward and reconciles the resulting gradients into one policy update. For compatible gradients, a cosine-dependent interpolation coordinates their contributions through a partially normalized reference while preserving the norm of their sum. We characterize this update as the unique solution of a spherical directional compromise. For conflicting gradients, projection follows the task's priorities. We evaluate the same compatible rule in helpfulness--safety alignment and correctness--cost optimization for mathematical reasoning. ORPG substantially improves average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest external baseline on each axis. In mathematics, it achieves the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume among the compared methods, with more accurate and shorter responses than the initial policy. Component comparisons and training dynamics show the larger contribution of compatible coordination and a complementary benefit from conflict handling. These results support gradient reconciliation for objectives with equal standing and for objectives with an explicit priority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORPG 为每个奖励各建一个 clipped policy objective，再把梯度调和成单次策略更新：梯度相容时用依赖余弦的插值在部分归一化参考下协调贡献并保持和的范数，冲突时按任务优先级做投影。在 helpfulness–safety 对齐与数学推理的 correctness–cost 优化中，它在每个轴上都显著提升 Useful 与 Harmless 平均分，并取得最高平均满预算精度与三预算 hypervolume。
Motivation: 多奖励策略优化需要一次联合更新同时反映学习信号与各目标之间预设的关系，而把多个奖励简单加权难以区分相容与冲突两种情形。
Method: ORPG（Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient）对每个 reward 单独构造 clipped policy objective；相容梯度用 cosine-dependent 插值在 partially normalized reference 上协调并保持和的范数，该更新被刻画为球面方向折衷 (spherical directional compromise) 的唯一解；冲突梯度则按任务优先级投影。
Result: 在 helpfulness–safety 对齐与数学推理 correctness–cost 两个设置中，ORPG 在每个轴上都显著优于最强外部基线的平均 Useful 与 Harmless 分数；在数学上取得所比较方法中最高的平均满预算精度与三预算 hypervolume，输出比初始策略更准且更短。组件对比与训练动态显示相容协调贡献更大，冲突处理带来互补收益。
Conclusion: 梯度调和同时适用于地位对等的目标和带显式优先级的目标，其中相容协调是主要增益来源，冲突处理提供补充。

papers.title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActionUNet 用轻量时序 U-Net 在时序对齐的动作特征空间融合多尺度结构先验，弥合语义与细粒度执行的尺度差，再用带二阶平滑约束的条件 SIREN 作连续动作解码器抑制高频抖动。在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus 与真机困难评测上，π0.5 成功率分别绝对提升 9.8%、6.1%、11.4%，并可迁移到回归式 OpenVLA-OFT 骨干。
Motivation: VLA 模型把粗粒度多模态语义映射到物理动作，语义与细粒度时序执行难以对齐，导致在杂乱环境中泛化与鲁棒性不足；多尺度建模又会破坏微观时序连续性、引发机械振荡。
Method: 在时序对齐的动作特征空间内构建轻量 temporal U-Net 融合层级结构先验；随后用 conditional SIREN 作为连续动作解码器，加入显式二阶平滑约束保证时序连续性、抑制高频运动抖动；作为对预训练 VLA 模型的低开销微调框架。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus 基准及真机困难评测上，ActionUNet 使 π0.5 成功率分别绝对提升 9.8%、6.1%、11.4%；同一微调策略可推广到回归式骨干 OpenVLA-OFT。
Conclusion: 多尺度融合加连续平滑解码能在保持基础 VLA 泛化与操作鲁棒性的同时减少机械执行失败，是一种计算开销很小的微调策略。

papers.title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/}{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Simple-WAM 把推理时的未来预测简化为对全噪声视频 token 的一次前向，并把训练时的噪声调度改成匹配该推理行为。受控对比显示，动作专家一旦不再以未来表征为条件，环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三条轴上都一致退化，而差距几乎全部来自第一个去噪步——收益来自“准备”未来而非“生成”未来。
Motivation: 视频去噪推理开销大，于是 Latent WAMs 在推理时直接丢弃未来预测以加速；但这样是否丢掉了当初促使人们引入 WAM 的泛化能力，此前没有受控证据。
Method: 在匹配的 backbone、训练数据与训练预算下做受控对比，比较显式 WAM（每个 action chunk 都去噪出干净未来帧）与 Latent WAM（推理时丢弃未来），沿环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三轴评估；再做归因分析定位差距来源，并据此提出 Simple-WAM：未来建模退化为对全噪声视频 token 的单次前向，训练期噪声调度随之适配。
Result: Latent WAM 在分布内任务上与显式 WAM 打平，但在环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三条轴上均一致退化；归因分析表明差距几乎完全来自第一个去噪步。Simple-WAM 在仿真与真实任务上同时取得领先显式 WAM 的泛化性能和与 Latent WAM 相当的效率。
Conclusion: 推理时生成干净未来帧并非必要，但让动作专家在推理时以某种未来表征为条件是必要的：保留第一步的“准备”即可保住泛化，同时省下去噪开销。
Relevance: 0
