papers.title: One Sensor, Whole Body - 3D Body Pose from a Single Consumer Earbud IMU
papers.abstract_en: Consumer earbuds already stream inertial motion data from the head, one of the most widely worn sensor locations on the body. We ask how much of the 3D body pose a single such head IMU can recover, and whether adding more consumer sensors actually helps. We build a multimodal capture pipeline that records four-view RGB-D video together with an AirPods head IMU and two Striv insole IMUs, synchronize the streams post-hoc, and generate pseudo-ground-truth with SAM 3D Body, yielding a 35-take single-subject benchmark spanning gait, turning, vertical, everyday, and clinically inspired motions. Adapting two recurrent model families (IMUPoser and MobilePoser), we show that one head IMU recovers lower-body pose at 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE and per-foot ground contact at 0.809 macro-F1, and that a causal variant retains most of this accuracy at streaming latency. In paired per-take significance tests across both families, adding the consumer foot IMUs never significantly improves pose and significantly degrades it in two of four model-split combinations; a mounting-bias probe and feet-only ablation identify insole orientation quality, not foot placement, as the mechanism. Extending the output to a 20-joint full-body skeleton maps the boundary: gross distal-arm motion is partially recoverable from the head alone, proximal upper-body pose is not, and staged fine-tuning recovers the leg accuracy that naive joint training sacrifices to multi-task dilution. For learned pose from consumer wearables, sensor reliability, not sensor count, is the binding constraint here. For the devices tested, the earbud is its sweet spot. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 6th International Workshop on Human-centric Multimedia Analysis (HUMA '26), ACM Multimedia 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Code: https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单个消费级耳机头部 IMU 即可恢复下肢 3D 姿态：在 35 段单被试基准上达到 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE、足地接触 macro-F1 0.809，且加入足部 IMU 从未显著改善姿态、反而在四种模型-划分组合中的两种显著变差。作者判定约束是传感器可靠性而非数量，对所测设备而言耳机即甜点。
Motivation: 消费可穿戴已能持续输出头部惯性数据，但单个头部 IMU 能恢复多少 3D 姿态、再加更多消费传感器是否真有增益，此前缺少带伪真值的受控基准。
Method: 搭建多模态采集管线：四视角 RGB-D 视频 + AirPods 头部 IMU + 两只 Striv 鞋垫 IMU，事后同步，用 SAM 3D Body 生成伪真值，构成覆盖步态、转身、垂直动作、日常与临床启发动作的 35 段单被试基准；适配 IMUPoser 与 MobilePoser 两个循环模型族，做逐段配对显著性检验、安装偏差探针与仅足部消融，并扩展到 20 关节全身骨架与分阶段微调。
Result: 单头部 IMU 下肢 rigid-MPJPE 79.0 mm、每足地面接触 macro-F1 0.809，因果变体在流式延迟下保留大部分精度；加入消费足部 IMU 在两个模型族的配对逐段检验中从未显著改善姿态，并在四种模型-划分组合中的两种显著变差；机制指向鞋垫朝向质量而非足部放置；20 关节输出中远端手臂粗大动作可部分恢复、近端上肢不可，分阶段微调找回朴素联合训练因多任务稀释损失的腿部精度。
Conclusion: 对消费可穿戴的学习式姿态估计，绑定约束是传感器可靠性而非传感器数量；对所测设备，耳机是单传感器的甜点位置。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SPIDER: Multi-Layer Semantic Token Pruning and Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose \textbf{SPIDER}, a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer \underline{\textbf{S}}emantic visual token \underline{\textbf{P}}run\underline{\textbf{I}}ng with an a\underline{\textbf{D}}aptive sub-lay\underline{\textbf{ER}} skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by $79\%$ while maintaining 96$\%$ of the baseline performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPIDER 是一个免训练的多模态大模型 (MLLM) 推理加速框架，同时处理数据冗余与计算冗余：从视觉编码器中间层剪枝语义视觉 token（中层 token 携带更细的物体级信息，深层会将其抽象掉），并按 LLM 解码层中 Attention 与 FFN 的差异化贡献自适应跳过子层。在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上 FLOPs 降低 79% 同时保持基线性能的 96%。
Motivation: MLLM 的效率瓶颈来自两个耦合来源：视觉 token 的数据冗余与解码器的计算冗余；现有方法只在视觉编码器输出处剪 token 或按整块重要性剪解码层，层间表征漂移与层内分布差异未被利用。
Method: SPIDER 为免训练 (training-free) 框架，含两部分：多层语义视觉 token 剪枝 (Multi-Layer Semantic visual token Pruning)，从视觉编码器中间层而非仅末层挑选 token；以及自适应子层跳过 (Adaptive sub-Layer skipping)，依据 Attention 与 FFN 在不同 LLM 解码层中的差异化贡献决定跳过哪些子层。
Result: 在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上 FLOPs 降低 79%、保持基线性能的 96%；摘要称 SPIDER 在多种 MLLM 架构与 token 缩减比例下均保持强性能。
Conclusion: 把剪枝位置前移到视觉编码器中间层、并按层差异化调度 Attention/FFN 子层，可在免训练前提下同时削减数据与计算冗余而不显著掉点。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Inspector: Conversational and Lightweight Analyzer of Analog Circuit Layouts Using LLM and CNNs
papers.abstract_en: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines fine-tuned LLMs and CNNs to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling a conversational interface between the tool and the designers. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across four realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose massive VLMs by a significant margin (up to 81%), thus providing a lightweight solution to the problem of GDSII analysis.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, to be published in ICLAD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Inspector：用微调 LLM 与 CNN 组合分析模拟电路版图 GDSII 文件，给设计者一个对话式分析接口。在数千个模拟设计上的四项真实任务中，比通用大规模 VLM 最高高出 81%，且更轻量。
Motivation: 模拟 IC 版图分析依赖人工与算法流程，GDSII 里承载的几何与寄生信息难以被通用多模态模型直接理解。
Method: 微调 LLM 与 CNN 结合的框架，输入为模拟电路 GDSII 文件，输出对话式分析结果，面向四项真实分析任务。
Result: 在数千个模拟设计、四项真实任务上，相比 SOTA 通用大规模 VLM 提升最高达 81%。
Conclusion: 专用微调的轻量 LLM+CNN 方案在 GDSII 版图分析上显著胜过通用 VLM，可作为 CAD 中的对话式分析工具。

papers.title: Teach to Learn: Hint Annealing for Self-improving LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves language-model reasoning by comparing verified rewards among multiple solution rollouts for each query. However, difficult training queries can yield only incorrect rollouts, leaving GRPO with no reward contrast or learning signal. Prior hint-based methods construct auxiliary hints from solution evidence and use them to re-solve failed queries, recovering learning signal. Yet the resulting trajectories are typically treated as ordinary solution trajectories despite being generated under an assisted condition unavailable at evaluation. We discover hinted reward shift: recovered reward contrast can concentrate policy updates on hinted trajectories, limiting improvement without hints. This also creates a trade-off: increasing hinted trajectories can accelerate early learning but intensify reward shift later. To address this problem, we propose HATCH (Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching), an online single-policy framework that learns from both generating and using its own hints to improve reasoning without assistance. To mitigate hinted reward shift, we introduce online weighting to anneal the contribution of hinted trajectories. However, learning to generate hints can conflict with improving query solving. We therefore use gradient projection to remove the opposing component of hint-generation updates. Together, these designs support self-improvement by enabling the policy to create learning opportunities for itself and turn them into stronger reasoning without hints. We evaluate our method on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and outperform state-of-the-art methods by 1.02 pp on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, 2.84 pp on Qwen3-1.7B, and 4.32 pp on Qwen3-8B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HATCH 把「生成提示」和「用提示解题」放进同一个在线单策略里训练，并用在线权重退火压低 hinted reward shift、用梯度投影去掉与解题方向相反的提示生成分量，使策略在无提示评估下自我提升。在数学推理基准上比现有最优方法分别高出 1.02 pp（Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct）、2.84 pp（Qwen3-1.7B）和 4.32 pp（Qwen3-8B）。
Motivation: GRPO 在困难查询上可能所有 rollout 都错，拿不到奖励对比与学习信号；已有 hint 方法恢复了信号，却把在辅助条件下生成的轨迹当普通轨迹训练，导致策略过度依赖提示、离开提示就不提升。
Method: HATCH（Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching）为在线单策略框架：用自身生成的 hint 重解失败查询以恢复奖励对比，用 online weighting 对 hinted 轨迹的贡献做退火以缓解 hinted reward shift，再用 gradient projection 移除与查询解题相冲突的提示生成更新分量。
Result: 在数学推理基准上超出 state-of-the-art 方法：Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上 1.02 pp，Qwen3-1.7B 上 2.84 pp，Qwen3-8B 上 4.32 pp。摘要另给出定性权衡：hinted 轨迹占比上升会加速早期学习、但在后期加剧 reward shift。
Conclusion: 让策略自己制造学习机会并把它们转成无提示的更强推理是可行的，前提是同时退火 hinted 轨迹权重并投影掉冲突的提示生成梯度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在数学推理基准上超出 state-of-the-art 方法：Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 上 1.02 pp，Qwen3-1.7B 上 2.84 pp，Qwen3-8B 上 4.32 pp。摘要另给出定性权衡：hinted 轨迹占比上升会加速早期学习、但在后期加剧 reward shift。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让策略自己制造学习机会并把它们转成无提示的更强推理是可行的，前提是同时退火 hinted 轨迹权重并投影掉冲突的提示生成梯度。

papers.title: Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based Web agents can autonomously complete user tasks, yet deceptive interfaces can steer them toward outcomes that conflict with users' interests. Existing defenses primarily intervene on agent behavior through blocking, guidance, or replanning. We identify a distinct failure mode: a task-valid action can still realize an unauthorized consequence because of the current Web state. This motivates treating task-relevant Web state itself as a runtime control target. We introduce Veer, an agent-side runtime defense that leaves task planning to the base agent and intervenes on Web state when a proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. Before modifying the live environment, Veer constructs a prospective intervention trajectory toward a safe task-relevant state and executes it with runtime grounding and verification. Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings, exceeding the next-best defense by 15.9 and 25.0 percentage points on TrickyArena-Single and TrickyArena-Multi, respectively, while reducing dark-pattern success on WebDecept to 0.3%. These gains persist across dark-pattern types and all 12 agent, model, and benchmark configurations. Ablations show that active state intervention provides the largest gain, while prospective rollout and temporal evidence contribute additional improvements. These results establish task-relevant Web state as an effective runtime control target for protecting Web agents from deceptive outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Veer 把欺骗性网页界面下的防御点从 agent 行为转到 Web 状态本身：当拟执行动作会导致未授权后果时，先构造一条通向安全任务相关状态的前瞻干预轨迹并经运行时 grounding 与验证后再执行，任务规划仍交给基座 agent。在 TrickyArena 与 WebDecept 上，Veer 在三种评测设置中均取得最高安全任务完成率，TrickyArena-Single 与 TrickyArena-Multi 上分别领先次优防御 15.9 和 25.0 个百分点，WebDecept 上 dark-pattern 成功率降到 0.3%。
Motivation: 现有 Web agent 防御只在行为层做拦截、引导或重规划，但一个任务合法的动作仍可能因当前 Web 状态而产生未授权后果，行为层干预抓不住这类失败模式。
Method: Veer 是 agent 侧运行时防御：保留基座 agent 的任务规划，检测拟议动作是否会触发未授权后果，若有则先构造面向安全任务相关状态的前瞻干预轨迹 (prospective intervention trajectory)，再以运行时 grounding 与验证执行该轨迹，之后才改动真实环境。
Result: 在 TrickyArena 与 WebDecept 上，Veer 在全部三种评测设置中安全任务完成率最高：TrickyArena-Single 领先次优防御 15.9 个百分点，TrickyArena-Multi 领先 25.0 个百分点，WebDecept 上 dark-pattern 成功率降至 0.3%；该优势跨 dark-pattern 类型与全部 12 种 agent、模型、benchmark 组合保持。消融显示主动状态干预贡献最大增益，前瞻 rollout 与时间证据 (temporal evidence) 提供额外提升。
Conclusion: 任务相关 Web 状态本身可作为有效的运行时控制目标，用主动状态干预而非仅约束 agent 行为来保护 Web agent 免受欺骗性后果。

papers.title: APEX-Voice: Can Voice Agents Complete Professional Workflows Through Full-Duplex Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex voice agents can now listen, speak, use tools, and act during spoken interactions, but fluent dialogue does not guarantee correct completion of delegated professional workflows. We introduce APEX-Voice, a benchmark of 120 interactive professional workflows spanning ten work archetypes such as form completion, corporate negotiation, coordination, consulting, and interviewing. Each workflow executes in a stateful Voice Workbench environment with task-specific knowledge, typed tools, gold-annotated final work artifact, authorization constraints, and a user simulation policy backed by validated, pre-compiled speech realizations. We evaluate both artifact field accuracy and end-to-end workflow success, which requires the correct terminal state, valid process, completed actions, and a valid final artifact. Across five frontier real-time voice agents-GPT-Live-1, Gemini-3.8-Live, Grok-Voice-Think-2.0, Step-Audio3, and GPT-realtime-2.1, none exceeds 25% Pass@1, and the best Reliable@3 is only 10.8%. Moreover, stateful coordination is the dominant failure point across systems, while success decreases further on workflows requiring greater knowledge retrieval and mid-speech corrections. Overall, APEX-Voice is the first benchmark for evaluating whether voice agents can translate conversational competence into dependable professional work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEX-Voice 是一个含 120 个交互式职业工作流的基准，用带状态的 Voice Workbench 环境（任务知识、类型化工具、金标准工件、授权约束、用户模拟策略）检验全双工语音代理能否把流畅对话转化为可靠的任务完成。五个前沿实时语音代理无一 Pass@1 超过 25%，最佳 Reliable@3 仅 10.8%，状态化协调是主要失败点。
Motivation: 全双工语音代理已能边听边说、调用工具并执行动作，但对话流畅不等于能正确完成被委托的职业工作流，此前缺少衡量这一转化的基准。
Method: 构建 120 个覆盖表单填写、企业谈判、协调、咨询、面试等十类工作原型的工作流，每个在带状态的 Voice Workbench 中执行，配备任务专属知识、类型化工具、金标准最终工件、授权约束与基于预编译语音实现的用户模拟策略；评测工件字段准确率与端到端工作流成功率（要求正确的终态、有效过程、完成动作与有效最终工件）。
Result: 在 GPT-Live-1、Gemini-3.8-Live、Grok-Voice-Think-2.0、Step-Audio3、GPT-realtime-2.1 五个前沿实时语音代理上，无一 Pass@1 超过 25%，最佳 Reliable@3 仅 10.8%；状态化协调 (stateful coordination) 是各系统的主导失败点，且需要更多知识检索与语音中途修正的工作流成功率进一步下降。
Conclusion: 对话能力尚不能可靠转化为职业工作完成能力，状态化协调是当前语音代理的瓶颈，知识检索与中途修正需求越高成功率越低。

papers.title: Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Long visual token sequences often account for a substantial fraction of the computational overhead in multimodal large language models~(MLLMs). Existing approaches reduce this cost by pruning redundant visual tokens, but permanently discard visual evidence that may become useful in subsequent layers. We instead ask whether all visual tokens can be preserved while reducing the cost of repeatedly evolving the representations through the Transformer. To answer this question, we perform low-rank interventions on visual-to-text information flow. We find that, after visual-to-text attention is blocked, restoring only a few directions recovers most of the lost accuracy, suggesting the relevant visual influence is concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. We further observe strong predictability in layer-specific visual states: lightweight MLPs approximate them with high cosine similarity and low reconstruction error. Motivated by these findings, we propose $δ$-Vision, which replaces repeated Transformer evolution of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that construct layer-wise visual memories while preserving all visual tokens for text retrieval. Across image and video benchmarks, $δ$-Vision achieves higher accuracy than visual token pruning baselines at comparable or lower computation, while delivering competitive inference efficiency without discarding visual tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: δ-Vision 不再剪掉视觉 token，而是用轻量低秩 adapter 直接构造逐层视觉记忆，替代 Transformer 对视觉 token 的反复演化。阻断视觉到文本注意力后只恢复少数方向即可挽回大部分精度，说明视觉影响集中在低维子空间；在图像与视频基准上，它以相当或更低的计算量取得高于视觉 token 剪枝基线的准确率。
Motivation: MLLM 中长视觉 token 序列占了大量计算开销，现有剪枝做法永久丢弃后续层可能还要用到的视觉证据。
Method: 对视觉到文本信息流做低秩干预：先阻断视觉到文本注意力，再恢复少数方向；用轻量 MLP 以高余弦相似度、低重建误差逼近逐层视觉状态，据此以低秩 adapter 构造 layer-wise visual memory，同时保留全部视觉 token 供文本检索。
Result: 在图像与视频基准上，δ-Vision 准确率高于视觉 token 剪枝基线，计算量相当或更低，推理效率有竞争力且不丢弃视觉 token；阻断视觉到文本注意力后仅恢复少数方向即可恢复大部分损失的精度。
Conclusion: 视觉对文本的影响集中在低维子空间，因此可以用低秩逐层视觉记忆替代反复的 Transformer 演化，而不必剪枝视觉 token。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Action-Space Shaping for LLM Agents: Measuring and Mitigating Tool-Schema Bias
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on tool-use agentic tasks when given a fixed tool schema. Yet a tool schema is not the action space of an agent; it is merely one interface representation of it. The same executable action can be exposed through many different, functionally equivalent tool definitions, and an agent that has truly learned a task should behave consistently across them. We show that current agents often do not, a phenomenon we term schema bias. To study this systematically, we introduce an executable transformation framework that rewrites a native tool schema using nine operators, including merging and splitting tools, altering how a single tool is expressed, and distributing one action across several dependent calls. The tasks, executable actions, and reachable states remain fixed, so any change in success is attributable to the interface alone. Evaluating eleven LLMs, including two closed models, on up to 32 schema variants, we ask how large schema bias is, how it manifests, whether the difficulty of a schema variant can be predicted without a full evaluation, and whether training removes it. We find that schema bias is substantial even for the newest models: success rates range from complete failure to 97% depending solely on the schema. To reliably estimate schema difficulty, it requires running a small sample of the target queries. Training repairs a schema variant only when that variant appears in the training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可执行的 schema 变换框架，用 9 种算子（合并/拆分工具、改换单工具表达、把一个动作分布到多个依赖调用）重写工具 schema，任务、动作与可达状态不变，从而把成功率变化完全归因于接口。评测 11 个 LLM（含 2 个闭源模型）最多 32 个 schema 变体，成功率仅因 schema 不同就从完全失败到 97%。
Motivation: 工具 schema 只是智能体动作空间的一种接口表示，功能等价的不同 schema 会让同一任务的成功率大幅波动（schema bias），而现有评测固定单一 schema，无法区分能力差异与接口差异。
Method: 构建可执行变换框架，用 9 类算子重写原生工具 schema，保持任务、可执行动作与可达状态不变；在最多 32 个 schema 变体上评测 11 个 LLM（含 2 个闭源模型），并考察 schema 难度的低成本预测与训练能否消除偏差。
Result: 成功率仅随 schema 变化即从完全失败到 97%；可靠估计某个 schema 变体的难度需要在目标 query 上跑一小部分样本；训练只修复出现在训练数据中的那个 schema 变体。
Conclusion: schema bias 在最新模型上依然显著，且训练只泛化到见过的 schema 变体，因此接口表示本身是智能体评测与训练中必须控制的变量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: See it, Say it, Sorted: Mechanistic Diagnosis and Parameter-Space Mitigation of Emergent Misalignment in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens. Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0%; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B--20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety: the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero. Code: https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 的涌现式错位 (emergent misalignment, EM) 做二阶几何诊断：方向性 Hessian 曲率集中在语义 pivot token 上，harmful-safe 差距主要因 safe 梯度重叠下降而拉大；据此把经验有害梯度子空间从参数更新中正交投影掉。在 Qwen2.5-14B-IT 上自由生成 EM 最多被抑制 80.0%，且同一子空间在行为 EM 近零的模型里仍可测可操控，说明行为安全是假象。
Motivation: 窄域微调会跨域触发灾难性安全失效，而已有静态分析没有刻画训练动态，现有防御靠启发式且损害通用能力。
Method: 跟踪训练轨迹做动态二阶几何分析：方向性 Hessian 曲率定位语义 pivot token，Grassmannian 投影分解 harmful-safe 差距来源；再提出参数级 Geometric Mitigation Framework，把经验有害梯度子空间从参数更新中正交投影掉。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-14B-IT 上该防御最多抑制 80.0% 的自由生成 EM；在四个开源指令模型家族 (3B–20B) 中另外三个（单层行为 EM 已近零）上，teacher-forced 评测显示同一有害子空间控制冻结 EM 回应的条件支撑。
Conclusion: EM 由一个可测可操控的有害梯度子空间驱动，行为 EM 接近零并不等于该子空间消失，因此防御应针对参数空间而非行为表现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 对 LLM 的涌现式错位 (emergent misalignment, EM) 做二阶几何诊断：方向性 Hessian 曲率集中在语义 pivot token 上，harmful-safe 差距主要因 safe 梯度重叠下降而拉大；据此把经验有害梯度子空间从参数更新中正交投影掉。在 Qwen2.5-14B-IT 上自由生成 EM 最多被抑制 80.0%，且同一子空间在行为 EM 近零的模型里仍可测可操控，说明行为安全是假象。

papers.title: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboFL 把各客户端本地训练的 LoRA 适配器直接装成服务端 MoE 的专家分支，用先验感知的 token 路由取代朴素聚合，避免不相容更新纠缠。在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 与真实 Franka 机械臂上，结构化专家装配比集中式 PEFT InternVLA-A1 在 Franka 上高 12.23%，同时每轮客户端通信量比基于 MoE 的联邦 VLA 基线最多减少 86.81%。
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作与世界-动作模型受制于稀缺、机构割裂且任务异构的物理交互数据；直接联邦聚合参数高效微调适配器会纠缠不相容更新，而把 MoE 路由引入联邦聚合又会稀释专精并使专家选择不稳。
Method: 提出 MoSAIC（Mixture of Slotted Adapters）：把本地训练的 LoRA 适配器直接安装为服务端 MoE 的专家分支，服务端 router 在这些先验分支上学 token 分配并联合精调路由与专家参数；Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) 对齐模型三条路径的路由，Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) 把完整专家更新压成一个紧凑全局适配器用于个性化重分发。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 与真实 Franka 机械臂上，RoboFL 的结构化专家装配超过集中式 PEFT InternVLA-A1，Franka 机械臂上高出 12.23%；相对基于 MoE 的联邦 VLA 基线，每轮客户端通信量最多减少 86.81%。

papers.title: Semantic Uncertainty Quantification Needs Factual Equivalence
papers.abstract_en: Semantic uncertainty quantification for large language models rests on a common template: sample several answers, measure how much they agree, and treat disagreement as uncertainty. We first formalize this template as two separate roles: an operator that compares two answers, and an aggregator that combines all pairwise comparisons into a scalar. Existing methods differ almost entirely in how they aggregate, while taking the operator off the shelf, typically an NLI model or a generic sentence encoder. We show that this reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ: they do not accurately measure factual equivalence of multiple answers to the same question. We resolve this with a deliberately simple recipe: a single encoder trained contrastively to isolate the targeted fact, utilizing synthetic data generated by an LLM and dataset both disjoint from all evaluation settings. Integrating the resulting operator into existing methods improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model dataset combinations across language and vision-language models. The best variant reaches 0.76 mean AUROC against 0.68 for the strongest baseline, while replacing the quadratic cross-encoder comparisons of entailment-based operators with one encoder pass per answer. The uniformity of the improvement supports the view that the operator, not the aggregator, is the limiting factor. The same operator also improves single generation token-level estimators: the norm it assigns to each token measures how much that token bears on the answer, and reweighting token log-likelihoods accordingly sharpens the estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语义不确定性量化 (semantic UQ) 的瓶颈在比较算子而非聚合方式：现成 NLI 模型或通用句向量编码器测不准同一问题多个答案的事实等价性。用 LLM 合成数据（与全部评测设置不相交）对比训练单个编码器来隔离目标事实，接入现有方法后在 126 个评测设置中的 120 个 (95%) 改善，最佳变体 mean AUROC 0.76 对最强基线 0.68，且每个答案只需一次编码器前向。
Motivation: 语义 UQ 通模板是采样多个答案、量一致性、把分歧当不确定性，但算子被直接拿现成的 NLI 模型或通用句编码器用，无法准确度量多答案的事实等价性，成为整条管线的主瓶颈。
Method: 把模板拆成比较算子与聚合器两个角色；训练单个对比学习编码器作为算子，用 LLM 生成的合成数据且与所有评测设置不相交；该算子替换 entailment 类算子的二次型 cross-encoder 两两比较，每个答案只过一次编码器；同一算子还用于单次生成的 token 级估计器，按其赋予每个 token 的范数重加权 token 对数似然。
Result: 接入现有方法后在 126 个评测设置中的 120 个 (95%) 改善，覆盖 18 个模型-数据集组合，横跨语言与视觉语言模型；最佳变体 mean AUROC 0.76，最强基线 0.68；相比 entailment 算子把二次型两两比较换成每答案一次编码器前向。
Conclusion: 改善的普遍性支持算子而非聚合器是语义 UQ 的限制因素；同一算子还能通过按 token 范数重加权对数似然来锐化单次生成的 token 级估计。

papers.title: Safe Greenhouse Climate Control Using Lagrangian-Constrained PPO with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Greenhouse climate control balances economic return with maintaining temperature, humidity and CO2 within crop-adapted growth ranges. Conventional reinforcement learning (RL) greenhouse controllers use fixed reward penalties to limit climate constraint violations, yet such heuristic penalties cannot explicitly constrain long-term cumulative violations. Poorly tuned weights either lead to overly conservative policies and lower yields, or fail to suppress persistent climate deviations that harm photosynthesis and induce crop diseases. To address this issue, we formulate greenhouse climate regulation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and use a Lagrangian safe RL framework RCPO-PPO to separate economic optimization and cumulative safety constraints, enabling adaptive penalty adjustment without manual tuning. To handle strong nonlinear, time-varying coupling between greenhouse microclimate and crop growth, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) as policy and value approximators for improved nonlinear representation. Sinusoidal cyclic time features are embedded in observations to capture diurnal environmental periodicity. Simulations use a classic winter lettuce greenhouse model driven by 40-day real weather disturbances. Compared with vanilla penalty-based PPO, our method cuts cumulative climate violations by 18.65% and raises lettuce economic profit by 2.91%, keeping violations stable near the safety threshold. This decoupled CMDP optimization with KAN-based policy representation mitigates long-term climate risks and boosts planting profits, offering a constraint-aware control strategy for precision greenhouse cultivation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把温室气候调控写成约束马尔可夫决策过程 (CMDP)，用 Lagrangian 安全 RL 框架 RCPO-PPO 把经济目标与累积安全约束解耦，惩罚权重自适应调整而无需手调，并用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 替换 MLP 作策略与价值函数逼近器。在由 40 天真实天气扰动驱动的冬季温室生菜模型仿真中，相比 vanilla penalty-based PPO，累积气候违规下降 18.65%，生菜经济利润提高 2.91%，违规量稳定在安全阈值附近。
Motivation: 传统 RL 温室控制器用固定奖励惩罚限制违规，无法显式约束长期累积违规：权重调得过严则策略保守、产量下降，调得过松则持续偏离损害光合作用并诱发病害。
Method: 将温室气候调控建模为 CMDP，采用 RCPO-PPO 框架分离经济优化与累积安全约束，实现惩罚自适应调整；以 KAN 替代 MLP 作为策略与价值逼近器以增强非线性表示，并在观测中嵌入正弦周期时间特征捕捉昼夜环境周期性。
Result: 在由 40 天真实天气扰动驱动的冬季温室生菜模型仿真中，相比 vanilla penalty-based PPO，累积气候违规减少 18.65%，生菜经济利润提升 2.91%，违规量保持在安全阈值附近稳定。
Conclusion: 解耦的 CMDP 优化配合 KAN 策略表示能在压低长期气候风险的同时提高种植利润，为精准温室栽培提供约束感知的控制策略。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Cyclostationary Phase Conditioning for Medical Time Series Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Many physiological time series, such as cardiac and brain recordings, exhibit cyclostationarity: their statistics vary periodically with an underlying cycle phase. Corruption from motion, poor contact, and physiological interference obscures morphology needed for diagnosis, making signal restoration essential. Existing diffusion approaches condition on corrupted observations alone and must learn cyclic structure implicitly. We instead propose two inductive biases which encode cyclostationarity: a shift-covariant wavelet representation and dense per-sample phase conditioning inferred from the corrupted input. We further introduce a training-free cyclostationarity index that quantifies phase structure and predicts when phase conditioning will help. Finally, we propose antithetic coupling of reverse trajectories to reduce sampling variance while achieving comparable performance with fivefold fewer network evaluations. Across modalities, our results show that explicitly encoding measurable cyclic structure improves physiological time-series restoration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生理时间序列（心电、脑电）修复中的扩散模型，提出两条编码循环平稳性 (cyclostationarity) 的归纳偏置：移位协变小波表示，以及从含噪输入推断的逐样本稠密相位条件；另提出免训练的循环平稳指数来预测相位条件何时有效，并用反向轨迹的对偶耦合 (antithetic coupling) 降低采样方差。结果显示显式编码可测的循环结构能改善多模态生理时间序列修复，且对偶耦合在五分之一网络评估次数下取得相当性能。
Motivation: 生理信号受运动、接触不良与生理干扰污染，诊断所需的形态被掩盖；现有扩散方法只以含噪观测为条件，必须隐式学习周期结构，修复效果受限。
Method: 两条归纳偏置：移位协变小波表示 (shift-covariant wavelet representation) 与从含噪输入推断的稠密逐样本相位条件 (per-sample phase conditioning)；另引入免训练的循环平稳指数 (cyclostationarity index) 量化相位结构并预测相位条件的收益时机；采样端用反向轨迹的对偶耦合降低方差。
Result: 跨模态结果显示显式编码可测循环结构改善生理时间序列修复；对偶耦合在达到相当性能的同时把网络评估次数减少到五分之一 (fivefold fewer network evaluations)。
Conclusion: 循环平稳性作为显式归纳偏置优于让扩散模型隐式学习周期结构，且相位条件的收益可用免训练指数预先判定，采样可用对偶耦合降本。

papers.title: JevVibe: Efficient Classification-Guided Secure Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate functionally correct code that still contains security weaknesses, motivating repair pipelines that first diagnose a weakness type before deciding how to fix it. The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) provides a standardized vocabulary for such diagnoses, but asking an autoregressive language model to generate a CWE label and extracting it from the response raises questions about output validity, speed, and cost, as well as accuracy. We evaluate Jev, a decision model that instead selects directly from a declared set of candidates and returns a probability for each, against six open-weight autoregressive models and a frontier proprietary model, GPT-5.6-Sol, on a controlled 50-way CWE classification task over 1,916 CyberSecEval benchmark examples. Jev outperforms all six open-weight baselines on every classification and ranking metric, while its comparison with GPT-5.6-Sol depends on the metric: GPT-5.6-Sol achieves higher Top-1 accuracy and Macro-F1, whereas Jev achieves higher Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy and a nearly identical MRR, at $6.27\times$ lower median API latency and $55.9\times$ lower estimated API cost. We further build JevVibe, a diagnosis-guided repair agent that uses predicted CWE labels to repair code generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. With Jev providing the diagnosis, the agent increases the detector-measured security pass rate from 63.5% before repair to 70.7%, compared with 66.1% for LLM-guided repair. These results show that JevVibe is effective at improving the security of generated code, with Jev providing reliable and efficient CWE classification.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: ALICE: In-context, Zero-shot, Mutual Information Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating mutual information (MI) from samples is a central objective in a variety of scientific fields. Modern neural estimators are accurate in the large-data regime, but they fall short when data is scarce, and each must be fit anew for every distribution under study. Current estimators are moreover tied to specific data types. These constraints limit their adoption in many applications where per-distribution training is impractical and sample sizes are small. We present ALICE, a foundation model that removes per-distribution training, while achieving competitive estimation accuracy. Trained exclusively on a broad family of synthetic distributions, ALICE acts as an in-context estimator of rectified-flow velocity fields: conditioned on samples of an unseen distribution, it estimates that distribution's velocity field without any explicit training. MI is then obtained through a fixed identity that integrates the squared difference between the joint and conditional fields. We validate ALICE on a standard, challenging benchmark and apply it in three domains, biology, genetics, and neuroscience, whose data the model has never seen. For the first time, we show that a single model closes the gap with neural estimators trained separately for each distribution, while natively supporting different data dimensionality and sample cardinality, enabling zero-shot MI analysis across scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALICE 是一个互信息 (MI) 基础模型：在合成分布族上训练一次，面对未见过的分布时以 in-context 方式直接估计 rectified-flow 速度场，再经固定恒等式积分联合与条件速度场平方差得到 MI，无需逐分布再训练。作者称单一模型首次追平逐分布单独训练的神经估计器，并原生支持不同数据维度与样本量，实现跨领域的 zero-shot MI 分析。
Motivation: 现有神经 MI 估计器在小样本下失效，且每个分布都要重新训练一次、还绑定特定数据类型，导致在样本少、逐分布训练不可行的应用中难以采用。
Method: ALICE 作为 foundation model 仅在一大族合成分布上训练；给定未见分布的样本，in-context 估计该分布的 rectified-flow 速度场，MI 由一个固定恒等式给出，该式对联合场与条件场之差的平方做积分。
Result: 在一个标准且困难的 benchmark 上验证，并应用于生物学、遗传学、神经科学三个模型从未见过的数据领域；作者报告单一模型与逐分布单独训练的神经估计器差距被拉平，并同时支持不同数据维度与样本基数。
Conclusion: 把逐分布训练换成合成分布上训练一次的 in-context rectified-flow 速度场估计，可以在小样本、跨数据类型场景下做 zero-shot MI 分析。

papers.title: ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, and Audit checks whether the Lean proof follows it. Across tasks, SOptLib accumulates verified mathematics and construction experience: reusable results are extracted, generalized, and verified, while modeling decisions and failed proof routes are recorded. Later tasks retrieve these results and records and contribute new developments, forming a cycle of construction, accumulation, and reuse. On fifteen textbook and research-paper tasks, ProofLoom obtains mean human ratings of 6.3/7 and 6.4/7, compared with 4.9/7 and 5.0/7 for the strongest of six baselines. Across 33 developments, it produces 490,693 lines of algorithm-local Lean code with no sorry. The formalizations also expose 28 incorrect formulas, proof gaps, and algorithm-analysis mismatches in published sources across 22 developments, each with checked evidence.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 5 figures. Code and supplementary materials: https://github.com/Trace231/ProofLoom
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProofLoom 是一个全自动 LLM-agent 系统，用开放 proof obligation 驱动 Lean 中研究级随机优化的模型与领域理论构建，由独立 Judge 拒绝无据假设与弱化结论，Planner 与 Audit 校验证明是否忠实于原文论证。在 15 个教科书与论文任务上人类评分均值 6.3/7 与 6.4/7，对比六个基线中最强者的 4.9/7 与 5.0/7；33 个 development 产出 490,693 行无 sorry 的算法局部 Lean 代码，并在 22 个 development 中暴露已发表来源的 28 处错误公式、证明缺口与算法分析不一致。
Motivation: 在 Lean 中形式化研究级随机优化需要同时给出算法模型和连接基础库与收敛证明的领域理论，而为恢复可证性修改模型会改变数学命题本身，缺少机制约束这种漂移。
Method: ProofLoom 给定已发表算法、目标定理与源证明，以开放 proof obligation 驱动定义、接口、引理与证明计划的构造；Signature contracts 记录模型修订的证据与义务，独立 Judge 拒绝无支撑假设与弱化结论，Planner 把原文论证展开为中间命题，Audit 检查 Lean 证明是否遵循该论证；SOptLib 累积可复用结果、建模决策与失败证明路径，供后续任务检索与再开发。
Result: 在 15 个教科书与研究论文任务上人类评分均值 6.3/7 与 6.4/7，最强的六个基线之一为 4.9/7 与 5.0/7；跨 33 个 development 产出 490,693 行算法局部 Lean 代码且无 sorry；在 22 个 development 中暴露已发表来源的 28 处错误公式、证明缺口与算法分析不匹配，每处附核查证据。
Conclusion: 以 proof obligation 加独立审查来约束模型修订，可以让自动形式化在保持命题忠实的同时累积可复用的已验证数学，并反过来审计已发表文献的正确性。

papers.title: AX is the New AEO
papers.abstract_en: In 2023, AI models answered from training data and hallucinated when it ran out, and businesses were told to seed that knowledge. Models' training knowledge has since given way to live web search, and the advice followed it there: answer-engine optimization, or AEO, now tells businesses to scatter breadcrumbs across forum threads, listicles, and off-site citations, so AI engines are likelier to surface and recommend them. But being surfaced is no longer enough: an agent opens the results and reads them before deciding, and one buyer question sends it through several rounds of search and fetch. What decides the outcome at this drill-down step is whether the agent can fetch and read the business's own site: agent experience (AX). We argue that AX is the new AEO. We run 37,927 agent journeys, each a buyer question about a business, across four independent harnesses over 1,056 real businesses, matched on fame, prior model knowledge, and two AEO proxies, then split based on their AX level. Only 7-10% of the finished answer comes from the model's training knowledge, whether or not the site is readable. Agent-ready businesses have answers built from their own pages 78% of the time against 56% and are clearly recommended 1.9x more often, while every grounded answer about a not-agent-ready business costs the agent 64% more. Holding business, harness, and question fixed, answers built from the site are 41% more accurate. The dominant failure is not fabrication but omission: web-built answers are 3.7x more likely to contain none of the facts the buyer asked for. Baselines differ sharply across the four harnesses, with clear-recommendation rates varying sevenfold from stack to stack, yet the effect holds in every one. In the agentic web era, being readable beats being talked about, and improving a site's AX is the strongest lever a business has.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用 37,927 次 agent 旅程、1,056 家真实企业、四套独立 harness 对比 agent-ready 与非 agent-ready 网站，证明在 agentic search 中站点可读性 (AX) 取代外链声量 (AEO) 成为决定性因素：可读站点的答案 78% 由自身页面构成（对照 56%），被明确推荐频率高 1.9 倍，且答案准确率高 41%。
Motivation: AEO 假设只要被 AI 引擎提及即可，但 agent 会点开结果逐层抓取阅读；企业把预算花在论坛与外链上，却可能因站点不可被 agent 读取而在 drill-down 阶段被丢弃。
Method: 运行 37,927 条 agent 旅程（每条为针对某企业的买家问题），跨四套独立 harness、覆盖 1,056 家真实企业；企业在 fame、既有模型知识与两个 AEO 代理指标上配对，再按 AX 水平分组对比。
Result: 训练知识只贡献最终答案的 7–10%（无论站点是否可读）；agent-ready 企业答案 78% 由自身页面构成 vs 56%，被明确推荐多 1.9 倍，非 agent-ready 企业每条 grounded answer 让 agent 成本高 64%；固定企业、harness 与问题后，基于站点的答案准确率高 41%；主要失败是遗漏而非捏造——web 构建的答案含买家所问全部事实缺失的概率高 3.7 倍；四套 harness 的 clear-recommendation 率相差七倍，但效应在每套中都成立。
Conclusion: 在 agentic web 中，站点可读性胜过外部声量，提升 AX 是企业最强的杠杆；失败模式的主导形式是事实遗漏而非幻觉。

papers.title: VD-DeepStack: Bridging Visual Comparison and Language Reasoning for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot visual anomaly detection is fundamentally a visual comparison task, requiring fine-grained inspection of a query against normal references. Many recent methods based on large vision-language models (LVLMs) emphasize comparative reasoning through language chain-of-thought. Yet discrete, abstract descriptions may underrepresent dense, fine-grained visual differences, leaving a gap between visual comparison and its expression in language. To address this gap, we propose Visual Difference DeepStack (VD-DeepStack), which explicitly conditions language reasoning on query-reference visual differences. Specifically, we fuse DINO features with the LVLM visual hierarchy to strengthen fine-grained representations, then construct dense difference evidence from residuals between query features and softly matched reference features. The difference-evidence path injects spatially weighted difference vectors into query-image states at multiple decoder depths, while an auxiliary visual-context path provides fine-grained appearance information to support their interpretation. Experiments on 4 industrial and 2 medical anomaly benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements in few-shot anomaly detection over baselines relying on textual comparative reasoning. These results support mitigating the visual comparison-reasoning gap through the joint design of comparison representations and their integration into the decoder. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VD-DeepStack 把查询-参考图像的视觉差异直接注入 LVLM 解码器的多层状态，让少样本异常检测的语言推理建立在稠密视觉比较而非离散文字描述上。在 4 个工业与 2 个医学异常基准上，相比依赖文本比较推理的基线有显著提升。
Motivation: 少样本异常检测本质是细粒度视觉比较，但现有 LVLM 方法用语言 chain-of-thought 表达比较，离散抽象的描述无法承载稠密的细粒度视觉差异，造成视觉比较与其语言表达之间的断层。
Method: 将 DINO 特征与 LVLM 视觉层级融合以强化细粒度表征；用查询特征与软匹配 (soft matching) 参考特征之间的残差构造稠密差异证据；差异证据路径在多个解码器深度把空间加权差异向量注入查询图像状态，另设辅助视觉上下文路径提供细粒度外观信息以支撑解读。
Result: 在 4 个工业异常基准与 2 个医学异常基准的少样本异常检测上，相比依赖文本比较推理的基线取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 缓解视觉比较-推理断层需要联合设计比较表征本身及其注入解码器的方式，而不只是改进语言推理提示；代码将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Proactive Dialogue Policy Optimization via Cognitive-State Transition
papers.abstract_en: Proactive dialogue requires agents to continually adapt their policies to user feedback while progressing toward task objectives over multiple turns. To move beyond imitation learning on static datasets, recent approaches use user simulators to collect interactive data for policy optimization. However, many simulators do not explicitly model the evolution of user cognition, limiting the consistency and state dependence of feedback across turns. Moreover, representing each action only by a high-level strategy label overlooks the large utterance space and cannot distinguish alternative realizations of the same strategy. To this end, we jointly design a $\textbf{Cog}$nitive User $\textbf{Sim}$ulator $\textbf{(Cog-Sim)}$ and $\textbf{C}$ognitive-$\textbf{S}$tate $\textbf{T}$ransition--Driven $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{O}$ptimization $\textbf{(CSTPO)}$. Cog-Sim maintains the user's cognitive and affective states and generates responses through constrained state transitions across turns, so feedback depends on both the realized utterance and the user's current state. CSTPO organizes each action as a hierarchical strategy--utterance representation: a high-level strategy label constrains utterance sampling, and utterances are optimized within each label. Sparse complete-branch sampling reuses shared dialogue prefixes and estimates separate strategy-level and utterance-level advantages, enabling fine-grained optimization at both levels. Across three tasks, Cog-Sim exhibits monotonic dose--response relationships and is preferred over prompt-based simulators for naturalness. CSTPO improves Qwen3-14B's performance to a level comparable to that of GPT-5.5-based planning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Cog-Sim 认知用户模拟器与 CSTPO 策略优化：模拟器维护用户认知与情感状态并用受约束的状态转移生成回复，使反馈同时依赖实际话语与当前状态；CSTPO 把动作组织成策略-话语两层表示，用稀疏完整分支采样复用共享前缀并分别估计策略级与话语级优势。在三个任务上 Cog-Sim 呈现单调的剂量-反应关系且在自然度上优于基于 prompt 的模拟器，CSTPO 把 Qwen3-14B 提升到与 GPT-5.5 规划方法相当的水平。
Motivation: 主动对话中用模拟器收集交互数据做策略优化时，多数模拟器不显式建模用户认知演化，导致跨轮反馈的一致性与状态依赖不足；同时只用高层策略标签表示动作会忽略庞大的话语空间，无法区分同一策略的不同实现。
Method: Cog-Sim 维护用户的认知与情感状态，通过跨轮受约束的状态转移生成回复，使反馈取决于实际话语与当前状态；CSTPO 采用层级策略-话语表示，高层策略标签约束话语采样、话语在标签内优化，稀疏完整分支采样 (sparse complete-branch sampling) 复用共享对话前缀，分别估计策略级与话语级优势以做两层细粒度优化。
Result: 在三个任务上 Cog-Sim 呈现单调的剂量-反应 (dose-response) 关系，且在自然度上优于基于 prompt 的模拟器；CSTPO 将 Qwen3-14B 的性能提升到与基于 GPT-5.5 的规划方法相当的水平。
Conclusion: 显式建模用户认知状态转移并把策略与话语分层优化，能让模拟器反馈具备状态依赖性，并使较小的开源模型逼近 GPT-5.5 规划方法的对话表现。

papers.title: Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step. In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy. Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen. This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks. Compared with QGF, AGF runs $3.6\times$ faster per guidance step with $7.0\times$ fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF)，把流策略的 critic guidance 写成确定性最优控制问题，用 costate 承载终端 critic 梯度并回归到轻量 guidance network，VLA 与 critic 全程冻结。在 LIBERO、RoboCasa、LIBERO-Pro 上一致提升预训练 VLA，单个 guidance 强度跨任务部署时最稳健；较 QGF 每步快 3.6×、参数少 7.0×，性能相当甚至更好。
Motivation: 流式 VLA 策略靠行为克隆训练，不显式优化长期任务回报；现有 critic guidance 需对采样器一步代理求导并在每个流步反传 critic ensemble，训练内存与吞吐开销大。
Method: 把 critic-guided flow generation 形式化为确定性最优控制，最优 guidance 即把终端 critic 梯度带回剩余流的 costate；用 guidance network 回归该 costate，VLA 与 critic 保持冻结。推理时每步只需一次 guidance network 前向，无需 critic ensemble、反向传播或 adjoint 计算。
Result: 在 LIBERO、RoboCasa、LIBERO-Pro 上一致提升预训练 VLA，与 critic-guidance 及 policy fine-tuning 基线相当，且在跨任务部署单一 guidance 强度时最稳健。相比 QGF，每个 guidance 步快 3.6×、参数少 7.0×，性能相当甚至更好。
Conclusion: critic guidance 可以做到 trajectory-aware 且轻量：把 costate 回归进一个前向网络，就能在保留预训练 VLA 的同时拿到有竞争力的回报提升与更好的训练/推理扩展性。

papers.title: Resolution as a First-Class Decision: Task-Conditioned Routing for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The inference efficiency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is severely constrained by massive visual token sequences induced by high-resolution inputs, with computational cost scaling quadratically. Existing approaches primarily focus on downstream token compression, while overlooking a fundamental upstream inefficiency: input resolution is treated as a static, task-agnostic hyperparameter. We propose Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR), which formulates visual compression as a task-conditioned decision and employs a lightweight cross-modal router that conditions backbone visual representations on textual semantics via feature-wise modulation and cross-attention to predict the minimal sufficient compression level per query. To support this, we curate a dataset of 500k samples across 12 task categories, labeled via a teacher-oracle pipeline to approximate Pareto-optimal compression scales. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures show that TCRR achieves a superior efficiency frontier, specifically reducing visual FLOPs by 40.9% and latency by 53.7% on Qwen3-VL-8B while preserving competitive performance. Further analysis of scaling behavior confirms that dynamically routing visual compression enables optimal resource allocation without modifying the MLLM backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TCRR 把视觉分辨率从静态超参改成按查询任务动态选择的决策：轻量跨模态路由器用特征级调制与 cross-attention 让文本语义调制骨干视觉表征，预测每条查询所需的最小充分压缩级别。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上视觉 FLOPs 降低 40.9%、延迟降低 53.7%，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 高分辨率输入产生海量视觉 token，计算量随序列长度二次增长；现有方法只在下游压缩 token，却把输入分辨率当作与任务无关的静态超参，造成上游浪费。
Method: 提出 Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR)：轻量跨模态路由器以文本语义为条件，通过 feature-wise modulation 与 cross-attention 调制骨干视觉表征，预测每条查询的最小充分压缩级别；并构建 500k 样本、覆盖 12 个任务类别的数据集，用 teacher-oracle 流程标注以逼近 Pareto 最优压缩尺度。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上视觉 FLOPs 降低 40.9%、延迟降低 53.7%，同时保持有竞争力的性能；跨多种架构的实验显示 TCRR 取得更优的效率前沿，scaling 分析确认动态路由可在不修改 MLLM 骨干的前提下实现最优资源分配。
Conclusion: 把分辨率当作按任务条件化的决策来做视觉压缩，可以在不改动骨干的前提下同时改善效率前沿与资源分配。

papers.title: XMatch: Enhancing Covariate-Aware Time Series Forecasting through Tree-Structured Exogenous Matching
papers.abstract_en: Future exogenous variables provide valuable information for forecasting endogenous time series. Existing covariate-aware methods primarily learn the direct influence of exogenous variables on endogenous variables. However, these effects can be complex and change with the pattern of the exogenous variables, making them difficult to capture. Beyond this perspective, we observe that a given exogenous pattern often co-occurs with only a small set of endogenous response patterns. These associations motivate a strategy that matches future and historical exogenous patterns and uses the corresponding endogenous patterns to enhance forecasting. However, in real-world forecasting scenarios with multiple exogenous variables, each exogenous variable provides a distinct dimension for matching, creating a dilemma for this strategy between precise matching and sufficient historical support. To bridge this gap, we propose XMatch (EXogenous MATCHing), a covariate-aware forecasting model that realizes the aforementioned strategy through a tree-structured matching process that adaptively adjusts the number of exogenous variables used as matching conditions. Specifically, we first introduce the ProtoTree Creator, which organizes historical correspondences between exogenous and endogenous patterns into a ProtoTree, whose deeper levels incorporate additional exogenous variables for matching. For forecasting, we then design the ProtoTree Matcher, which uses future exogenous variables to query the ProtoTree and adaptively determines how many exogenous variables to use for matching based on exogenous pattern similarity and historical support. Finally, the matched endogenous patterns are used as explicit historical evidence to enhance forecasting. Extensive experiments on 12 real-world datasets demonstrate that XMatch outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XMatch 把协变量感知时序预报转成外生模式匹配：用 ProtoTree Creator 把历史外生-内生模式对应关系组织成树，越深层纳入越多外生变量作匹配条件，ProtoTree Matcher 再按外生模式相似度与历史支持度自适应决定用几个外生变量，匹配到的内生模式作为显式历史证据增强预报。在 12 个真实数据集上超过 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 现有协变量感知方法只学外生变量对内生变量的直接影响，而这种影响随外生模式变化、难以捕捉；多外生变量场景下精确匹配与足够历史支持互相矛盾。
Method: XMatch 由 ProtoTree Creator 与 ProtoTree Matcher 组成：前者把历史外生-内生模式对应组织成树，深层逐步加入更多外生变量作匹配条件；后者用未来外生变量查询该树，按外生模式相似度与历史支持度自适应决定匹配条件数量，再把匹配到的内生模式作为显式历史证据送入预报。
Result: 在 12 个真实数据集上的大量实验中，XMatch 优于 SOTA 基线。
Conclusion: 把外生-内生关联当作模式匹配而非直接影响来建模，并自适应选择匹配条件数量，可提升协变量感知时序预报效果。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaoTex 是基于扩散的原生 3D 材质生成模型，用数据构建 agent 造高频纹理资产补数据缺口，配合多层特征融合 (MLFF) 与 latent-to-pixel 损失过渡来保住文字、图案等细节，并通过可学习视角嵌入扩展到多视图输入。实验显示其在单视图与多视图设定下对纹理细节的保持显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成模型几何准确但难以重建精细纹理，公开数据集又缺少高频纹理资产，文字与图案类细节恢复尤其差。
Method: 四个组件：数据构建 agent 生成高频纹理 3D 资产用于训练；MLFF 模块自适应融合条件输入的局部与全局特征；采用 latent-to-pixel 空间损失过渡缓解 VAE 重建误差；引入可学习 viewpoint embeddings 扩展到多视图输入。
Result: 在单视图与多视图两种设定下，纹理细节保持均显著优于现有方法；训练用高频纹理数据显著提升对文字、图案等困难细节的恢复能力。

papers.title: Don't Forget! Decomposing the Training Dynamics of Memorization in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Pythia 系列模型上把记忆化序列的损失轨迹按训练过程与模型参数分解，发现重复序列的背诵 (recitation) 与稀有序列的回忆 (recollection) 都以序列级梯度对齐为特征，而背诵因与其他训练信号错位而更易被遗忘，解释了这类样本为何需要更高重复度。分解式记忆化预测优于交叉熵基线，且在更大模型与训练早期提升更明显；对少量高影响参数做干预即可在最终模型中消融记忆化。
Motivation: 记忆化被用来解释语言模型如何拟合训练分布的尾部，但其训练动态尚不清楚，缺少可预测、可干预的机制刻画。
Method: 在 Pythia 家族上按训练过程与模型参数分解被记忆序列的损失轨迹，区分重复训练序列的 recitation 与稀有序列的 recollection，考察序列级梯度对齐与层级参与，并用该分解做记忆化预测与参数干预。
Result: recitation 与 recollection 均以序列级梯度对齐为特征，recitation 因与其他训练影响错位而发生遗忘；较低层模型参数在记忆化与遗忘中参与度最高；预测记忆化时该分解优于交叉熵基线，在更大模型和训练早期改进尤其明显；对少量高影响参数的干预可在最终模型中消融记忆化。
Conclusion: 记忆化由序列级梯度对齐驱动、由低层参数承载，因此既可在训练早期预测，也可通过干预少数高影响参数直接消除。

papers.title: JazzSAMBA: A Synchronous and Asynchronous Multi-take Band Audio Dataset of Jazz Standards for Live Music Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has made strong progress on music tasks, both as assistive tools and as creative partners. However, most systems train on multitrack corpora that emphasize pop and rock. Jazz, with improvisation at the core of its practice, still lacks a well-annotated corpus of clean per-stem combo recordings on standards. We introduce JazzSAMBA (Jazz Synchronous and Asynchronous Multi-take Band Audio) to fill this gap: the first originally recorded jazz-combo multitrack dataset of standards with asynchronous (overdubbed) and synchronous (live ensemble) protocols, preferred and alternate takes chosen by the musicians, and timed annotations for bars, chords, sections, and soloists. JazzSAMBA covers 76 standards by eight musicians on drums, bass, piano, trumpet, and saxophone, with per-stem audio, mixtures, and MIDI. It can support chart-conditioned accompaniment, combo source separation, and form-aware music information retrieval. We demonstrate the dataset on two tasks: a jazz combo source-separation baseline and a chart-conditioned accompaniment ablation. The dataset, code, and samples are linked from the project demo page.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027; 5 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JazzSAMBA 是首个原录爵士组合多轨数据集，含同步（现场合奏）与异步（overdub）两种录制协议、乐手自选的首选与备选 take，以及小节、和弦、段落、独奏者的计时标注。数据集覆盖 76 首 standards、8 名乐手（鼓、贝斯、钢琴、小号、萨克斯），提供 per-stem 音频、混音与 MIDI，并以爵士组合源分离基线和 chart 条件伴奏消融两个任务示范其用途。
Motivation: 音乐 ML 多在强调流行与摇滚的多轨语料上训练，即兴为核心的爵士缺少干净的 per-stem 组合录音与标注语料，chart 条件伴奏、组合源分离、form-aware MIR 等任务无数据可用。
Method: 原录爵士组合多轨数据集 JazzSAMBA：同步与异步（overdub）录制协议、乐手选定的首选与备选 take、小节/和弦/段落/独奏者计时标注，per-stem 音频加混音与 MIDI；用两个任务示范——爵士组合源分离基线与 chart 条件伴奏消融。
Result: 数据集覆盖 76 首 standards、8 名乐手（鼓、贝斯、钢琴、小号、萨克斯），含 per-stem 音频、混音与 MIDI；示范任务为源分离基线与 chart 条件伴奏消融，数据集、代码与样本在项目 demo 页发布。
Conclusion: 爵士即兴场景需要同步/异步多 take 与 form 级标注的专用语料，JazzSAMBA 按此规格发布并支撑 chart 条件伴奏、组合源分离与 form-aware MIR。

papers.title: PDEU-Bench: Benchmarking the Personalized Planning Lifecycle of Tool-Calling LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from tool-calling systems that execute isolated instructions into task-oriented agents that pursue user goals through sustained, multi-step interactions. However, existing benchmarks for personalized tool use largely assess isolated calls or reactive execution, leaving unclear whether agents can formulate, execute, and revise an explicit plan while preserving user preferences throughout long-term interaction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{PDEU-Bench} (\textbf{P}ersonalized plan \textbf{D}efinition, plan \textbf{E}xecution, and plan \textbf{U}pdate \textbf{Bench}mark), a benchmark for evaluating the complete planning lifecycle of personalized tool-using agents. PDEU-Bench comprises 214 long-horizon interaction tasks spanning 12 everyday domains and 94 tools, with stage-specific assessments of preference adherence and plan quality. Extensive evaluations of 15 representative open-source and closed-source LLMs reveal a pronounced gap between local tool execution and dynamic planning: LLMs can often instantiate preferences in individual calls, yet struggle to construct coherent plan definition and plan update. We further evaluate mainstream personalization and memory-augmentation methods. Although these methods improve particular stages, none of the evaluated methods reliably propagates user preferences throughout the complete lifecycle, and their gains frequently fail to transfer to subsequent execution. Fine-grained error analysis further reveals that preference omissions and conflicts persist throughout the planning lifecycle, highlighting the need for future research to parameterize LLMs with preference-aware information retrieval and memory capabilities. We provide the relevant code and data in the appendix to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDEU-Bench 把工具调用 LLM agent 的个性化规划拆成 plan Definition、Execution、Update 三阶段，用 214 个长程交互任务、12 个日常领域、94 个工具分阶段评测偏好遵循与计划质量。对 15 个开源与闭源 LLM 的评测显示：单次调用里常能落实偏好，但连贯的计划定义与计划更新普遍吃力；主流个性化与记忆增强方法只改善个别阶段，增益常无法传递到后续执行。
Motivation: 现有个性化工具使用基准多评测孤立调用或被动执行，无法判断 agent 能否在长程交互中制定、执行并修订显式计划，同时全程保持用户偏好。
Method: 提出 PDEU-Bench，覆盖 plan Definition、Execution、Update 全生命周期，含 214 个长程交互任务、12 个日常领域、94 个工具，按阶段分别评估偏好遵循度与计划质量；评测 15 个代表性开源与闭源 LLM，并测试主流个性化与记忆增强方法，附细粒度错误分析。
Result: 15 个 LLM 在局部工具执行与动态规划之间差距明显：单次调用常能实例化偏好，但计划定义与计划更新难以保持连贯；个性化与记忆增强方法虽改善特定阶段，却无一能可靠地把偏好贯穿完整生命周期，增益常无法迁移到后续执行；错误分析显示偏好遗漏与冲突贯穿整个规划生命周期。
Conclusion: 现有方法无法让偏好在规划全生命周期中稳定传递，作者主张用偏好感知的信息检索与记忆能力来参数化 LLM，代码与数据随附录提供。

papers.title: Sample What You Say: Aligning Language Models to Sample the Distributions They State
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group's empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model's distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout's advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group's outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指令微调后的语言模型能正确说出目标分布却不会从中采样，GRPO 按组打分会让组内所有 rollout 拿到相同奖励、组内中心化后优势全为零而失去学习信号。作者提出 witness advantage：用最大均值差异 (MMD) 的 witness 函数从组内结果计数的闭式形式算出每个 rollout 的优势，欠产出的结果给正奖励、过产出的给负惩罚。在未见过的目标分布上训练显著缩小了与目标的总变差距离，同时基本保住模型的通用能力。
Motivation: 语言模型被用来从指定分布采样（模拟问卷受访者、生成合成数据），但会说不会采；prompt 与解码调整只能部分缓解，而直接用 GRPO 会因组级奖励导致优势全零、无梯度信号。
Method: 在 GRPO 中把奖励换成 witness advantage：对每组 rollout 的经验分布与目标分布算 MMD，其 witness 函数度量每个结果被过度或不足产出的程度，每个 rollout 的优势估计其结果处的负 witness，由组内结果计数闭式计算，作为 GRPO 的逐 rollout 奖励。
Result: 在未见过的目标分布 (unseen target distributions) 上，用 witness advantage 训练显著降低了模型分布与目标分布之间的总变差距离 (total variation distance)，同时基本保留模型的通用能力 (general capabilities)。
Conclusion: 把分布匹配拆成逐样本的 witness 信号，就能让组级奖励的 RLHF 方法从「会说不会采」变成能对齐自己陈述的分布，且不以牺牲通用能力为代价。

papers.title: Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding
papers.abstract_en: An auditor who checks whether a system's weights are frozen is checking the wrong thing. Our stationarity dichotomy says that iterative self-modification hits strict diminishing returns whenever the agent's reachable set of edits stays fixed, and can escape only if that set expands. Rewriting scaffolding (tools, verifiers, decomposition) expands what an agent reaches without touching a weight, so frozen weights buy an eventual ceiling but no stationarity along the way. The criterion also separates three regimes usually merged: search within a fixed class, test-time training that raises the ceiling itself, and scaffold rewriting between them. Audit the scaffold, not the checkpoint. The same ceiling binds sideways. Best-of-$k$ orchestration realizes the best worker's ceiling exactly: width buys rate, not budget. Re-consulting a fixed pool has a horizon computable in advance, decided by the pool alone, and the one arrangement that would beat it, a weighted vote, needs diversity real workers lack: on 30 same-family workers the failure overlap sits at its maximum, and a majority fails 23/55 (42%) of tasks. We obtain the criterion by reading refinement as gradient boosting on the residual error between draft and target, a patch or git diff, and then measuring where that reading breaks: patches compose instead of standing beside each other to be voted on, and failures overlap. What we measure is saturation. Per-round improvement decays toward zero on SWE-bench, and churn decays geometrically across 401 production sessions, a shape shared with a pre-AI human baseline that establishes the regime without identifying its cause. Both breaks are engineering choices rather than laws about code, so together they specify a harness worth building.

papers.title: Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via Hierarchical Sequential Cross-Attention over Chemical and Protein Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Predicting Drug-Target Interactions~(DTIs) is a central task in computational drug discovery, with direct applications in virtual screening, drug repurposing, and therapeutic candidate prioritization. Although recent deep learning methods have improved DTI prediction, many sequence-based models still process drugs and proteins independently and only combine their representations at a late prediction stage. This limits their ability to explicitly model cross-molecular dependencies between chemical substructures and protein sequence regions. In this paper, we propose a sequence-only DTI prediction architecture that combines two pre-trained language models, ChemBERTa for drug SMILES strings and ESM-2 for protein amino acid sequences, with a hierarchical interaction module. The proposed model first extracts contextual representations using pre-trained encoders, then applies 1D convolutional layers to condense local sequence patterns, followed by a sequential bidirectional cross-attention mechanism inspired by the induced-fit view of molecular recognition. Finally, attention-based pooling constructs fixed-size interaction-aware vectors for binary prediction. Experiments on BIOSNAP, Davis, and BindingDB show that the proposed model achieves the best performance on BIOSNAP, matches the best AUROC on Davis, and remains competitive on BindingDB while using only 25.2 million trainable parameters. Ablation results confirm the contribution of both the CNN and cross-attention modules, and cold-start experiments indicate promising generalization to unseen proteins and drugs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出仅用序列的 DTI 预测架构：ChemBERTa 编码 SMILES、ESM-2 编码蛋白序列，经 1D 卷积压缩局部模式后做层级式双向交叉注意力（sequential bidirectional cross-attention），再用注意力池化输出二分类。在 BIOSNAP 上取得最佳性能、Davis 上追平最佳 AUROC、BindingDB 上保持竞争力，仅 2520 万可训练参数；消融确认 CNN 与交叉注意力模块均有贡献，cold-start 实验显示对未见蛋白与药物有推广潜力。
Motivation: 多数序列型 DTI 模型独立处理药物与蛋白，只在预测末端拼接表示，无法显式建模化学子结构与蛋白序列区域之间的跨分子依赖。
Method: 预训练编码器 ChemBERTa（SMILES）与 ESM-2（氨基酸序列）提取上下文表示，接 1D 卷积层压缩局部序列模式，再用受分子识别 induced-fit 观点启发的层级式双向交叉注意力建模交互，最后以注意力池化得到定长交互感知向量做二分类。
Result: 在 BIOSNAP、Davis、BindingDB 三个数据集上：BIOSNAP 取得最佳性能，Davis 追平最佳 AUROC，BindingDB 保持竞争力；可训练参数仅 25.2M。消融显示 CNN 与 cross-attention 模块均有贡献，cold-start 实验对未见蛋白与药物表现出有前景的泛化。
Conclusion: 把跨分子依赖放进序列内部的层级交叉注意力，可在极少参数下达到有竞争力的 DTI 预测，并对冷启动场景具备泛化能力。

papers.title: RISE: Red-teaming via Iterative Strategy Evolution for Modern Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: On modern production text-to-image systems, successful policy violations are rare, and previously effective human-written seeds are often patched out. Current automated red-teamers are poorly matched to this regime in two ways: unreliable success measurement and poor exploration. First, we find that judges widely used in prior T2I red-teaming work are unreliable under vague unsafe-content targets: they either miss true violations or reward benign borderline images on hardened APIs. We therefore define strict category-specific success criteria and calibrate strong VLM judges against human labels. Second, we show that broadly used prompt-modification pipelines do not solve the exploration problem: on harder guardrail settings they remain tied to seed prompts, fail to transfer, or cannot bootstrap positive examples. We introduce RISE, which evolves reusable strategies used to generate prompts rather than rewriting them one by one. The best discovered strategies are then reused to generate attacks across new scenarios. On DALL-E 3, Nano Banana 2 (Google) and GPT-Image-2, RISE reaches up to 13% human-verified ASR; under the same calibrated evaluation, prior methods with reported ASR as high as roughly 30% fall to near zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RISE 针对现代生产级文生图系统中违规成功率低、旧种子被修补的问题，改为演化可复用的攻击生成策略而非逐条改写 prompt，并用按类别定义的严格成功标准加人工标注校准的 VLM judge 评估。在 DALL-E 3、Nano Banana 2 (Google) 与 GPT-Image-2 上达到最高 13% 的人工核实 ASR，而在同一校准评估下，先前自报高达约 30% 的方法跌至接近零。
Motivation: 生产级 T2I 系统里成功违规罕见、旧的人写种子常被修补下线，现有自动红队方法在两处失配：judge 在模糊不安全目标下不可靠，prompt 改写管线又难以探索新攻击空间。
Method: RISE 演化用于生成 prompt 的可复用策略而非逐条改写 prompt，最优策略再跨新场景复用生成攻击；评估侧定义按类别区分的严格成功标准，并把强 VLM judge 对人工标注做校准。
Result: 在 DALL-E 3、Nano Banana 2 (Google) 与 GPT-Image-2 上，RISE 达到最高 13% 的人工核实 ASR；同一校准评估下，先前报告 ASR 高达约 30% 的方法跌至接近零。
Conclusion: 在硬化后的 T2I guardrail 上，演化可复用攻击策略加校准 judge 才能得到可信的攻击成功率，旧方法的高 ASR 多半来自不可靠评估。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Depth-Averaged Avalanche Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of avalanche motion is essential for hazard assessment in mountainous terrain. This study develops and evaluates a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for the Savage-Hutter model of depth-averaged granular flow, progressing from 1D analytical verification to 2D experimental validation. First, three 1D problems of increasing complexity were verified against the analytical solution: height prediction with prescribed velocity, velocity prediction with prescribed height, and coupled prediction of both fields using the conservative formulation. The decoupled tests accurately reconstructed the spatio-temporal evolution of each field when the other was prescribed. The coupled formulation learned both fields without prescribed data, achieving mean height and velocity RMSEs of 0.043 and 0.079 in non-dimensional units. A hyperparameter sensitivity study evaluated the effects of network depth, width, collocation density, learning rate, and epochs. The framework was then extended to 2D and validated against laboratory experiments of a cylindrical granular pile collapsing on an inclined plane, with TITAN2D providing numerical comparisons. Purely physics-based training converged to the trivial zero solution; augmenting the loss with 10 sparse training points from final deposit profiles produced a physics-informed, data-assisted hybrid framework. Peak flow depth, depth-averaged velocity, RMSE, and wetted-area IoU evaluated global and local agreement. Global height RMSE ranged from 2.7 to 6.7 mm across four experimental cases, while mean wetted-area IoU ranged from 69 to 81 %, demonstrating consistent performance across variations in pile mass and slope angle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 求解深度平均雪崩流动的 Savage-Hutter 模型，从 1D 解析验证推进到 2D 实验验证。纯物理训练在 2D 坍塌实验上收敛到平凡零解，加入 10 个来自最终堆积剖面的稀疏训练点后形成物理引导、数据辅助的混合框架，四个实验工况的全局高度 RMSE 为 2.7–6.7 mm、湿面积 IoU 为 69–81%。
Motivation: 雪崩运动预测是山地灾害评估的关键，但 Savage-Hutter 深度平均方程非线性强、存在激波，传统数值求解需要网格与耗散处理；PINN 在该类多相流上的可解性与数据需求尚不清楚。
Method: 针对 Savage-Hutter 深度平均颗粒流构建 PINN：先在 1D 上做三步验证（给定速度预测高度、给定高度预测速度、保守格式下耦合预测两场），再做网络深度、宽度、配点密度、学习率与 epoch 的超参敏感性研究；随后扩展到 2D，以圆柱颗粒堆在斜面上坍塌的实验室数据验证，用 TITAN2D 提供数值对照，损失中加入 10 个来自最终堆积剖面的稀疏数据点。
Result: 1D 耦合保守格式在无给定数据下同时学到两场，无量纲单位下高度与速度 RMSE 分别为 0.043 与 0.079；2D 纯物理训练收敛到平凡零解，加入 10 个稀疏点后，四个实验工况（改变堆体质量与坡角）的全局高度 RMSE 为 2.7–6.7 mm，平均湿面积 IoU 为 69–81%，并用峰值流深、深度平均速度、RMSE 与湿面积 IoU 评估全局与局部一致性。
Conclusion: PINN 可以在无数据条件下解 1D Savage-Hutter 耦合问题，但 2D 坍塌问题必须用极少量最终堆积剖面数据点打破零解退化，物理加稀疏数据的混合训练在不同堆体质量与坡角下表现一致。

papers.title: Muon Sublates the Edge of Stability in LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Muon is increasingly used for language-model pretraining, yet its large-step dynamics are not captured by the classical edge-of-stability (EoS) picture of gradient descent (GD). In GD, loss neutrality, equal-magnitude update reversal, and marginal stability meet at a single learning-rate-dependent edge. We show that Muon breaks this coupling. For stochastic no-momentum Muon, we derive a coherence-corrected conditional loss-neutral boundary $2ρ_b/η$, while temporal alignment follows a separate geometry. Controlled experiments show that loss balance and temporal alignment respond differently to learning rate and batch size. Across our language model experiments, the 130M Llama-like LLM runs exhibit loss-boundary tracking with weak negative alignment, whereas the studied 1B LLM configuration shows stronger partial cancellation; in both settings, directions remain far from coherent reversal while training continues to improve. These results support a split EoS picture for Muon: a stochastic loss-neutral edge survives, but it is not accompanied by a universal temporal-direction signature. The source code for reproducing the experiments can be found in https://github.com/cyzebra/Muon-Sublates-the-Edge-of-Stability-in-LLM-Pretraining
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Muon 在 LLM 预训练中打破了梯度下降 (GD) 的经典 edge-of-stability (EoS) 耦合：损失中性、等幅方向反转与边际稳定在 GD 中交于同一学习率相关边界，而 Muon 下三者分裂。作者推导出随机无动量 Muon 的相干性修正条件损失中性边界 2ρ_b/η，时间对齐 (temporal alignment) 则服从另一套几何；130M Llama-like 与 1B LLM 实验中方向始终远未达到相干反转，训练却持续改善。
Motivation: 经典 EoS 图像把损失中性、等幅更新反转和边际稳定绑定在同一条学习率边界上，但 Muon 的大步长动力学不服从该图像，需要新的判定条件来解释其训练为何在方向未反转时仍能推进。
Method: 对随机无动量 Muon 推导相干性修正的条件损失中性边界 2ρ_b/η，并把时间对齐从该边界中解耦为独立几何；辅以受控实验分别改变学习率与 batch size，观察损失平衡与时间对齐的响应，再在 130M Llama-like 与 1B LLM 配置上做语言模型训练检验。
Result: 受控实验显示损失平衡与时间对齐对学习率和 batch size 的响应不同；130M Llama-like LLM 表现出损失边界跟踪加弱负对齐，1B LLM 配置则呈更强的部分抵消 (partial cancellation)；两种设置下方向都远未相干反转而训练损失持续下降。
Conclusion: Muon 支持一个分裂的 EoS 图像：随机损失中性边界依然存在，但不再伴随普适的时间方向签名，因此不能用 GD 的单一 EoS 边界判断 Muon 训练的稳定性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 经典 EoS 图像把损失中性、等幅更新反转和边际稳定绑定在同一条学习率边界上，但 Muon 的大步长动力学不服从该图像，需要新的判定条件来解释其训练为何在方向未反转时仍能推进。
summary_sections.method: 对随机无动量 Muon 推导相干性修正的条件损失中性边界 2ρ_b/η，并把时间对齐从该边界中解耦为独立几何；辅以受控实验分别改变学习率与 batch size，观察损失平衡与时间对齐的响应，再在 130M Llama-like 与 1B LLM 配置上做语言模型训练检验。
summary_sections.result: 受控实验显示损失平衡与时间对齐对学习率和 batch size 的响应不同；130M Llama-like LLM 表现出损失边界跟踪加弱负对齐，1B LLM 配置则呈更强的部分抵消 (partial cancellation)；两种设置下方向都远未相干反转而训练损失持续下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: Muon 支持一个分裂的 EoS 图像：随机损失中性边界依然存在，但不再伴随普适的时间方向签名，因此不能用 GD 的单一 EoS 边界判断 Muon 训练的稳定性。

papers.title: DGF-Bench: A Benchmark for Simulating and Auditing Deception Against Multi-Agent Governance Boards
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents can review enterprise projects as governance boards do: they read the evidence, apply written rules and decide whether the project may proceed. Part of that evidence comes from suppliers and project members with a stake in the decision. DGF-Bench is a benchmark in which a board of agents (specialist gates and a General gate that consolidates their decisions) reviews synthetic dossiers while an attacker plants deceptive content in evidence the organization does not vouch for. Dossiers are generated from canonical facts under 61 executable rules, with 42 authoritative records and 32 narrative documents; every gate is certified decidable from those records. Attacks never change an authoritative value, so an attacked dossier keeps the reference decisions of its clean copy. A success is attributable only when the agent receives the injection and takes the exact injected action, which it does not take on the paired clean dossier; the DGF score is the share of applicable fixed attacks a model blocks. Reading documents and records themselves, five of six models were outcome-strict (disposition, findings, actions and authorization all correct) on 82 to 85 of 85 gates. Over 2,622 attacked gate runs, seven direct-order, false-data and false-authority attacks obtained one attributable success against these five, whereas task-aligned attacks imitating the organization's own process passed against four of them: a record note citing a fake review procedure lowered GPT-6 Luna Pro from 34 to 6 outcome-strict gates and DeepSeek V4 Pro from 33 to 7. DGF scores ranged from 96.2 to 26.9, and a policy-aware adaptive attacker writing in records succeeded against five of six models. The approval tool executed no forged approval, yet deceived agents submitted approvals that the rules forbid. The open-source package dgf-bench computes the DGF score with one command.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://www.dgfbench.com/ ; code: https://github.com/jeremy1392/DGF-Bench ; package: https://pypi.org/project/dgf-bench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DGF-Bench 让一组治理门控 agent（专业 gate + 汇总 General gate）按 61 条可执行规则审查合成卷宗，攻击者只在组织不背书的材料里植入欺骗内容。五个模型在干净卷宗上 85 个 gate 中有 82–85 个 outcome-strict，但任务对齐的攻击（如伪造审查流程的记录备注）使其掉到 6 和 7 个；DGF 分数跨度 96.2 到 26.9，策略感知的自适应攻击者对六个模型中的五个成功。
Motivation: 工具型 LM agent 已被当作治理审查者使用，但其决策所依赖的证据部分来自有利害关系的供应商与项目成员，缺少可归因地度量 agent 能否挡住植入欺骗的标准化评测。
Method: 从规范事实生成卷宗，含 61 条可执行规则、42 条权威记录与 32 份叙述性文档，每个 gate 均可由记录判定；攻击不改动权威值，使受攻击卷宗保留配对干净卷宗的参考决策。成功定义为 agent 收到注入并执行了注入动作、且在配对干净卷宗上不执行该动作，DGF 分数即被拦截的适用固定攻击占比。
Result: 五个模型在 85 个 gate 中有 82–85 个 outcome-strict；2,622 次受攻击 gate 运行中，七类直接命令、虚假数据、虚假权威攻击对这五个模型仅各取得一次可归因成功，而模仿组织自身流程的任务对齐攻击对四个模型通过：伪造审查流程的记录备注使 GPT-6 Luna Pro 从 34 个 outcome-strict gate 降到 6，DeepSeek V4 Pro 从 33 降到 7。DGF 分数区间 96.2 至 26.9，策略感知自适应攻击者（在记录中写作）对六个模型中的五个成功；审批工具未执行任何伪造审批，但被欺骗的 agent 提交了规则禁止的审批。
Conclusion: 直接注入易被挡，而模仿组织自身流程的任务对齐欺骗能大幅击穿治理门控 agent；DGF 分数与配对干净对照把成功归因到具体注入，开源包 dgf-bench 一条命令即可计算。

papers.title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose *Action Upcycling*, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2--1.7$\times$ with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Action Upcycling 是一种免训练的机器人策略加速算法：策略每次预测一整块未来动作却只执行前缀，被丢弃的后缀只要动作速度保持平滑就仍接近重规划后的版本，因此把执行时延延长到速度开始波动处即可复用这些动作。在仿真与真实操作任务、多种 VLA 及一个 WAM 上，策略调用次数减少 1.2–1.7 倍且成功率不下降。
Motivation: chunked 策略的执行时延 (execution horizon) 在反应性与效率之间取舍：前缀短则反应快但需频繁调用模型；现有 test-time 自适应选时延的方法要么读模型内部信号（需按架构逐个设计），要么额外采样（增加开销）。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 算法：不读模型内部、不额外采样，直接复用策略本会丢弃的后缀动作；以动作速度是否平滑作为准则，把执行时延延伸到速度开始波动的临界点。
Result: 在仿真与真实操作任务上，跨多个 Vision-Language-Action Model (VLA) 以及一个 World Action Model (WAM)，策略调用次数减少 1.2–1.7 倍，成功率无下降；开销可忽略，且与 few-step sampling、streaming action decoding 等加速方法正交。
Conclusion: 被丢弃的 chunk 后缀在动作速度平滑时可安全复用，因此延长执行时延是与采样加速正交的一条新的策略加速轴，适用于任意 chunked 策略。
