papers.title: SincDPNet: Interpretable Raw-Waveform Bathroom Activity Recognition for Assistive Living
papers.abstract_en: Bathroom acoustic-event recognition can support ambient assisted living in settings where continuous video monitoring is undesirable. However, practical deployment requires models that are compact, interpretable, and robust to changes in the recording environment. This work introduces \dataset{}, a seven-class bathroom acoustic-event dataset containing 21{,}387 annotated clips recorded across five environments, and proposes SincDPNet, a compact raw-waveform classifier with a learnable sinc filter bank followed by a depthwise-separable convolutional body. Each sinc filter is controlled by two frequency parameters, allowing the learned passbands to be inspected directly in hertz while keeping the front end small. To reduce room-specific leakage, recording sessions and environments are separated before overlapping windows are assigned to the training, validation, and test partitions. We further use multi-objective Bayesian optimization as a design tool to examine the validation performance--model-size trade-off across 24 configurations. The selected designs span different operating points: the best-performing model achieves 80.2\% accuracy and 0.760 macro-F1 with 14{,}040 parameters, while the compact $N_f=25$ configuration uses only 2{,}848 parameters and achieves 75.7\% accuracy, 0.661 macro-F1, and 0.716 MCC on the held-out environment. Analysis of the learned filters and confusion patterns shows that spectral overlap contributes to confusion among water-related events, while the \textit{Door}/\textit{Walker/Crutch} errors also reflect similarities in their transient temporal structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SincDPNet 用可学习 sinc 滤波器组加深度可分离卷积做原始波形的浴室声学事件识别，每个 sinc 滤波器只由两个频率参数控制，通带可直接以 Hz 查看。在跨环境划分的七类数据集上，最佳模型 80.2% accuracy、0.760 macro-F1（14,040 参数），最紧凑的 Nf=25 配置仅 2,848 参数仍达 75.7% accuracy、0.661 macro-F1、0.716 MCC；水相关事件的谱重叠与 Door/Walker/Crutch 的瞬态相似是主要混淆来源。
Motivation: 辅助生活场景中连续视频监控不可接受，声学事件识别需要模型紧凑、可解释且对录音环境变化鲁棒；按窗口随机划分会让同一房间泄漏到训练与测试，掩盖跨环境性能。
Method: 提出七类浴室声学事件数据集（21,387 段标注音频，覆盖五个环境），先按录音 session 与环境划分再分配重叠窗口到训练/验证/测试；模型为可学习 sinc 滤波器组（每滤波器两个频率参数）接深度可分离卷积主体；用多目标贝叶斯优化在 24 个配置上权衡验证性能与模型规模。
Result: 最佳模型 80.2% accuracy、0.760 macro-F1、14,040 参数；Nf=25 紧凑配置在 held-out 环境上 75.7% accuracy、0.661 macro-F1、0.716 MCC、2,848 参数；贝叶斯优化扫描 24 个配置；混淆分析显示水相关事件因谱重叠混淆，Door/Walker/Crutch 错误源于瞬态时间结构相似。
Conclusion: sinc 前端加深度可分离卷积能在跨环境划分下以数千参数换取可用精度，性能-规模权衡由多目标贝叶斯优化显式给出多个操作点；混淆集中在谱重叠与瞬态相似的事件对上。

papers.title: ReSight-SMC: Two-Stage Power Sampling via Island SMC with Visual Scouts
papers.abstract_en: Power sampling has emerged as a training-free approach to LLM reasoning, eliciting capabilities comparable to reinforcement learning by sharpening the model distribution over complete responses. Despite this success, power sampling remains underexplored in large vision-language models (LVLMs). We transfer Power-SMC to LVLM decoding by defining a sequence-power target conditioned on both the image and the prompt. This direct transfer provides a strong training-free baseline, but leaves two aspects of finite-particle multimodal inference unaddressed. At the particle level, global resampling can collapse genealogies, while particle-based power sampling does not diversify trajectories through distinct visual cues in multimodal decoding, limiting exploration under a finite particle budget. At the answer level, sequence-level sharpening makes distinct reasoning trajectories compete even when they support the same answer. We introduce ReSight-SMC, a verifier-free two-stage power sampler for LVLM inference. Its first stage uses ancestry-isolated SMC islands to preserve independent trajectory families and routes a bounded set of prefix-conditioned visual scouts to prefix-relevant image regions while discouraging redundant overlap. Each scout temporarily increases attention to the image tokens and emphasizes its routed region. Exact importance correction preserves the base LVLM sequence-power target. The second stage aggregates terminal importance mass by canonical answer, powers the answer marginal, and samples an answer together with a supporting trajectory. Across four LVLM backbones and five benchmarks, ReSight-SMC achieves stronger aggregate performance than Power-SMC over both the reasoning and perception benchmark groups. Without post-training, it remains competitive in aggregate with backbone-matched models trained using reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSight-SMC 把 Power-SMC 迁移到大视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 推理，用岛屿化 SMC 保留独立轨迹谱系、用前缀条件的 visual scout 把注意力路由到图像相关区域，再按 canonical answer 聚合重要性质量后联合采样答案与支撑轨迹。在四个 LVLM 主干和五个基准上，其推理与感知两组的聚合表现均强于 Power-SMC，且免训练下与用强化学习训练的同主干模型聚合表现相当。
Motivation: Power-SMC 这类免训练推理采样在 LLM 上已见效，但迁到 LVLM 时有两个缺口：全局重采样会压垮粒子谱系，且粒子无法通过不同视觉线索分化轨迹；同时序列级锐化让支持同一答案的不同推理轨迹互相竞争。
Method: 两阶段免验证器采样器：第一阶段用 ancestry-isolated SMC islands 维持独立轨迹家族，把有界的前缀条件 visual scout 路由到与前缀相关的图像区域并抑制冗余重叠，每个 scout 临时提高对 image token 的注意力并强调所路由区域，同时用精确重要性校正保持原 LVLM 序列幂目标；第二阶段按 canonical answer 汇总终端重要性质量，对答案边缘分布做 power，再连同支撑轨迹一起采样答案。
Result: 在四个 LVLM 主干与五个基准上，ReSight-SMC 在推理与感知两个基准组上的聚合表现均强于 Power-SMC；不做后训练时，其聚合表现与用强化学习训练的同主干模型相当。
Conclusion: 免训练的两阶段幂采样——先用岛屿化 SMC 加视觉 scout 分化轨迹，再按答案聚合重要性质量——能在 LVLM 上同时改善推理与感知，并逼近 RL 训练的同主干水平。

summary_sections.motivation: Power-SMC 这类免训练推理采样在 LLM 上已见效，但迁到 LVLM 时有两个缺口：全局重采样会压垮粒子谱系，且粒子无法通过不同视觉线索分化轨迹；同时序列级锐化让支持同一答案的不同推理轨迹互相竞争。
summary_sections.method: 两阶段免验证器采样器：第一阶段用 ancestry-isolated SMC islands 维持独立轨迹家族，把有界的前缀条件 visual scout 路由到与前缀相关的图像区域并抑制冗余重叠，每个 scout 临时提高对 image token 的注意力并强调所路由区域，同时用精确重要性校正保持原 LVLM 序列幂目标；第二阶段按 canonical answer 汇总终端重要性质量，对答案边缘分布做 power，再连同支撑轨迹一起采样答案。
summary_sections.result: 在四个 LVLM 主干与五个基准上，ReSight-SMC 在推理与感知两个基准组上的聚合表现均强于 Power-SMC；不做后训练时，其聚合表现与用强化学习训练的同主干模型相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 免训练的两阶段幂采样——先用岛屿化 SMC 加视觉 scout 分化轨迹，再按答案聚合重要性质量——能在 LVLM 上同时改善推理与感知，并逼近 RL 训练的同主干水平。

papers.title: Reference-Tail Trust:Certified Probability Floors for Learned Updates Inside a Deployed Network
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) need to exploit improved message passing without surrendering control over predictions already trusted in deployment. We introduce Reference-Tail Trust (RTT), a framework that admits learned updates inside a frozen GNN and certifies the prediction actually served. RTT couples graph-based proposal states with a constrained internal optimizer: each displacement is charged for its worst-case terminal cross-entropy increase through the incumbent's remaining message-passing layers. A trajectory-validated tube and an independent checker enforce per-node probability floors, $p^{\mathrm{s}}_{ic} \ge e^{-H_{\mathrm{row}}} p^{\mathrm{r}}_{ic}$, and a call-level budget, $\sum_i w_i D_\infty(p^{\mathrm{r}}_i \| p^{\mathrm{s}}_i) \le H^+$, uniformly over labels. Calls whose adapted outputs pass certification require no separate full incumbent rollout; failed certificates trigger whole-call fallback. We derive the exact probability-floor frontier by water-filling, characterize architecture-constrained efficiency, and establish conditions under which internal propagation exploits evidence unavailable to restricted output correctors. In the reported ogbn-arxiv audit, RTT achieves $6.5\times 10^{-3}$ nats of mean gain per call, with a one-sided 95% regression-rate upper bound of 0.95% and a 95% negative-flip upper bound of 0.51% on the uninspected part of the reserved node population. Its mean gain is 61% of a cross-fitted posterior-based frontier estimate and exceeds the strongest matched one-pass corrector by $+0.9\times 10^{-3}$ nats. Reported experiments span eight proposals, six graph-incumbent families, structural and temporal graph shifts, and molecular prediction, with additional image and tabular evaluations. RTT makes GNN adaptation a budgeted, certifiable inference decision rather than an unconditional model replacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Reference-Tail Trust (RTT)，在冻结的 GNN 内部用受约束优化器注入学习更新，并对实际对外输出做认证：每个位移按其经剩余消息传递层的最坏情况交叉熵增量计费，配合轨迹验证管道与独立检查器强制逐节点概率下界和调用级 D∞ 预算，证书失败则整调用回退。在 ogbn-arxiv 审计中每次调用平均增益 6.5×10⁻³ nats，未检出部分的单侧 95% 回归率上界 0.95%、负翻转上界 0.51%，增益为交叉拟合后验前沿估计的 61%，比最强匹配单遍修正器高 +0.9×10⁻³ nats。
Motivation: 部署中的 GNN 需要吸收改进的消息传递而不放弃对已受信预测的控制，直接替换模型会失去可认证性；学习式修正只能在输出端修补，无法利用内部传播带来的证据。
Method: RTT 将图基提议状态与受约束内部优化器耦合：每个位移按其经在位模型剩余消息传递层的最坏情况终端交叉熵增量计费；轨迹验证管道与独立检查器强制逐节点概率下界 p^s_ic ≥ e^{-H_row} p^r_ic 与调用级预算 Σ_i w_i D_∞(p^r_i‖p^s_i) ≤ H⁺，对所有标签一致成立；通过 water-filling 导出精确概率下界前沿，并刻画架构约束下的效率。
Result: ogbn-arxiv 审计：每次调用平均增益 6.5×10⁻³ nats，未检出的保留节点人群上单侧 95% 回归率上界 0.95%、95% 负翻转上界 0.51%；平均增益为交叉拟合后验前沿估计的 61%，比最强匹配单遍修正器高 +0.9×10⁻³ nats。实验覆盖八个提议、六类图在位模型、结构与时序图偏移、分子预测，另有图像与表格评测。
Conclusion: 通过认证的调用无需单独的完整在位模型 rollout，失败证书触发整调用回退；RTT 把 GNN 适配变成一个有预算、可认证的推理决策，而非无条件的模型替换。

papers.title: Dual-Stream Simultaneous Translation via 2D Grid Attention
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous machine translation must generate target tokens before the source input is complete. Existing approaches address this through post-hoc read-write policies, leaving the attention mechanism unaware of bidirectional stream dependencies. We propose a dual-stream attention framework that represents source and target streams as a two-dimensional grid of hidden states and models their interaction through four structurally distinct attention types merged via joint QK Softmax normalization. Two approximations---broadcast and Hadamard---reduce the per-layer complexity from O(X^2Y+XY^2) to O(X^2+Y^2+XY) with provably decaying error. Training uses a self-guided loop: a per-cell loss heatmap drives dynamic-programming path recovery, which generates read/write decision supervision labels without external alignment. An incremental KV cache with anchored rotary position embeddings enables efficient streaming inference. On Chinese-to-English simultaneous translation, the proposed model outperforms the Wait-k baseline by +5.66 BLEURT and +10.36 COMET at comparable latency, and surpasses the non-streaming reference on COMET at a fraction of the response delay.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing. 12 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双流同传注意力框架：把源/目标序列表示为二维隐状态网格，用四种结构不同、经联合 QK Softmax 归一化的注意力建模双向流依赖，并以广播与 Hadamard 两种近似把单层复杂度从 O(X^2Y+XY^2) 降到 O(X^2+Y^2+XY)。中英同传上在相近延迟下比 Wait-k 基线高 +5.66 BLEURT、+10.36 COMET，且 COMET 超过非流式参考模型而响应延迟只占其一小部分。
Motivation: 现有同传靠事后 (post-hoc) 读写策略决定何时消费源 token，注意力机制本身对源目标双向流依赖无感知，读写决策与表征学习被割裂。
Method: 双流注意力把源与目标隐状态排成二维网格，用四类结构不同的注意力交互并以联合 QK Softmax 归一化合并；广播与 Hadamard 近似给出复杂度 O(X^2+Y^2+XY) 且误差可证衰减。训练用自引导循环：逐格损失热图驱动动态规划路径恢复，自动生成读写决策监督标签而无需外部对齐；推理用带锚定 rotary 位置编码的增量 KV cache 支持流式解码。
Result: 中英同传上，相较 Wait-k 基线在相近延迟下 BLEURT 提升 +5.66、COMET 提升 +10.36；COMET 超过非流式参考模型，而响应延迟只是其一小部分。复杂度由 O(X^2Y+XY^2) 降至 O(X^2+Y^2+XY)，近似误差可证衰减。
Conclusion: 把读写决策内化进注意力结构并用自生成监督训练，可以在不牺牲延迟的前提下同时抬高同传质量，甚至胜过非流式参考。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FILIGREE3D: Scaling Sparse Latent Flow Matching for Ultra-High-Resolution Image-to-3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Scaling image-to-3D generation to ultra-high resolutions requires controlling rapidly growing computational costs without sacrificing fine geometric detail. We present \textbf{Filigree3D}, a sparse latent flow-matching framework that generates 3D geometry from a single image at voxel resolutions up to $2048^3$, with straightforward extensibility to $4096^3$. To make training tractable, we introduce Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling, which combines spatial bounding with alternating local-global attention to constrain token growth while preserving both fine-scale details and long-range structural context. To enhance detail reconstruction, we curate training samples based on their high-resolution geometric gains and inject multi-scale image features into a sparse 3D DiT, effectively coupling structural semantics with fine-grained visual cues. Furthermore, a visibility-aware voxel regularization strategy improves robustness against sparse perturbations and facilitates the completion of unobserved geometry. Under our default configuration, Filigree3D maintains peak GPU memory consumption within practical limits for contemporary hardware, enabling the generation of highly intricate 3D geometry in approximately one minute. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields substantial improvements in overall geometric fidelity and fine-detail preservation compared to existing baselines, validating practical, detail-preserving 3D generation at unprecedented resolutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Filigree3D 把单图到 3D 生成推进到 2048³ 体素分辨率（可扩展至 4096³）：用 Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling（空间包围盒 + 局部/全局交替注意力）压住 token 增长，再以高分辨率几何增益筛选训练样本、把多尺度图像特征注入稀疏 3D DiT，并用可见性感知体素正则补全未观测几何。生成一份精细 3D 几何约需一分钟，峰值显存保持在当代硬件可承受范围内。
Motivation: 单图到 3D 生成在体素分辨率升高时计算成本急剧膨胀，要在保住细粒度几何细节的同时把训练与推理开销压到可用范围。
Method: 稀疏 latent flow matching 框架：Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling 用空间包围盒加局部-全局交替注意力限制 token 增长；按高分辨率几何增益筛选训练样本，并把多尺度图像特征注入 sparse 3D DiT；再加可见性感知体素正则以抵抗稀疏扰动并补全未观测几何。
Result: 体素分辨率最高 2048³，可直接扩展到 4096³；默认配置下峰值 GPU 显存保持在当代硬件实用范围内，生成高度精细的 3D 几何约需一分钟；实验显示相对现有基线在整体几何保真度与细节保留上均有大幅改进。
Conclusion: 稀疏 latent flow matching 配合结构感知的 token 扩展策略，可以在 2048³ 级别实现兼顾细节与工程可行性的实用单图 3D 生成。

papers.title: ColNanoVDR: Document-Free Query Distillation for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Multi-vector retrievers built on vision-language models lead visual document retrieval (VDR), but they run a multi-billion-parameter query encoder on every search. Distilling this encoder into a small student that queries the teacher's existing index would remove the bottleneck. The standard recipe, however, matches the teacher's MaxSim scores and so requires encoding and caching every training page, which can reach terabytes of page tokens. NanoVDR avoids pages entirely by training on the teacher's query embeddings alone, but only for single-vector retrievers. We present ColNanoVDR, to our knowledge the first framework to bring this document-free distillation to multi-vector VDR. Its objective, OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights), aligns the student's query tokens with the teacher's by entropic optimal transport, with a learned weight for each student token, and needs no correspondence between the two tokenizations. We prove that the resulting alignment cost bounds the MaxSim score difference on every page. Distilled from five state-of-the-art teachers, the 149M text-only students retain about 95% of their teachers' NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1-v3 while encoding queries up to 26x faster. Under identical training, OTW matches score distillation while encoding no page and reading 12.6x less cached teacher data.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR ; Models: https://huggingface.co/nanovdr
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ColNanoVDR 把视觉文档检索 (VDR) 中多向量检索器的查询编码器蒸馏成 149M 小模型，且完全不编码页面：用带学习权重的熵最优传输 (OTW) 对齐学生与教师的查询 token，无需两套分词的对应关系。从五个 SOTA 教师蒸馏后，学生在 ViDoRe v1-v3 保留约 95% 的 NDCG@5，查询编码快至 26 倍，训练时读取的缓存教师数据少 12.6 倍。
Motivation: 多向量 VDR 检索器每次搜索都要跑数十亿参数的查询编码器；而标准蒸馏需匹配教师 MaxSim 分数，必须编码并缓存每个训练页面，页面 token 可达 TB 级。
Method: 提出 ColNanoVDR：目标函数 OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights) 用熵最优传输对齐学生查询 token 与教师查询 token，为每个学生 token 学一个权重，不要求两套 tokenization 对应；仅用教师查询嵌入训练，不编码任何页面。并证明该对齐代价可界定任意页面上的 MaxSim 分数差。
Result: 从五个 state-of-the-art 教师蒸馏出的 149M 纯文本学生，在 ViDoRe v1-v3 上保留约 95% 教师 NDCG@5，查询编码快至 26 倍；相同训练设置下 OTW 与分数蒸馏 (score distillation) 打平，同时编码零页面、读取的缓存教师数据少 12.6 倍。
Conclusion: 文档无关蒸馏可以搬到多向量 VDR：只要用最优传输对齐查询 token 并给出 MaxSim 差的界，就能在不碰页面的前提下保住教师绝大部分检索质量与大幅提速。

summary_sections.method: 提出 ColNanoVDR：目标函数 OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights) 用熵最优传输对齐学生查询 token 与教师查询 token，为每个学生 token 学一个权重，不要求两套 tokenization 对应；仅用教师查询嵌入训练，不编码任何页面。并证明该对齐代价可界定任意页面上的 MaxSim 分数差。
summary_sections.result: 从五个 state-of-the-art 教师蒸馏出的 149M 纯文本学生，在 ViDoRe v1-v3 上保留约 95% 教师 NDCG@5，查询编码快至 26 倍；相同训练设置下 OTW 与分数蒸馏 (score distillation) 打平，同时编码零页面、读取的缓存教师数据少 12.6 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 文档无关蒸馏可以搬到多向量 VDR：只要用最优传输对齐查询 token 并给出 MaxSim 差的界，就能在不碰页面的前提下保住教师绝大部分检索质量与大幅提速。

papers.title: Role-Guided MOE for Encoder-Level Pathology Representation Learning in WSI Classification
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide image classification is a fundamental task in computational pathology, where patch representation quality directly affects downstream aggregation and slide-level discriminability. Pathology foundation models are widely adopted as frozen feature extractors for WSI classification; however, their fixed encoders may produce representations insufficiently adapted to target-specific tissue patterns and discriminative cues. Fine-tuning can improve target adaptation, but introduces a trade-off between pathology-specific representation capacity and adaptation efficiency, particularly in data-scarce settings. To address this, we propose a pathology role-guided mixture-of-experts feed-forward network (MoE-FFN) framework for efficient encoder-level representation learning. We design a two-stage training paradigm to establish and adapt pathology-aware expert specialization. In source-domain expert initialization, pathology-specific priors are distilled from a frozen Virchow2 teacher into a lightweight DINOv2-small student, while role prototypes serve as weak pathological anchors to encourage distinct expert functions. MoE-FFN blocks are introduced into selected high-level transformer layers to provide transformation diversity for heterogeneous pathological patterns. In target-domain adaptation, the initialized experts are refined through asymmetric prototype-guided optimization, enhancing task-relevant positive evidence and separating confusable hard negatives. The resulting encoder extracts offline patch representations that can be directly integrated with standard MIL aggregators. Experiments on the public BRACS dataset and a private PAROTID WSI dataset across five representative backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出病理角色引导的 MoE-FFN 编码器级表示学习框架：先从冻结的 Virchow2 教师向 DINOv2-small 学生蒸馏病理先验并用角色原型锚定专家分工，再以非对称原型引导优化在目标域细化专家。在 BRACS 与私有 PAROTID WSI 数据集、五种代表性骨干上，相对最强基线取得一致提升，输出的离线 patch 表征可直接接入标准 MIL 聚合器。
Motivation: 病理基础模型作为冻结特征提取器时，固定编码器难以适配目标域的组织模式与判别线索；而全量微调在数据稀缺场景下又在病理特异表示能力与适配效率之间取舍困难。
Method: 两阶段训练：源域专家初始化阶段把冻结 Virchow2 教师的病理先验蒸馏进轻量 DINOv2-small 学生，并以角色原型 (role prototypes) 作为弱病理锚点促使专家功能分化，在选定的高层 transformer 层插入 MoE-FFN 块提供异质病理模式的变换多样性；目标域适配阶段用非对称原型引导优化 (asymmetric prototype-guided optimization) 细化专家，增强任务相关正证据并分离混淆的难负例。
Result: 在公开 BRACS 数据集与私有 PAROTID WSI 数据集上，跨五种代表性骨干均相对最强基线取得一致提升；编码器输出的离线 patch 表征可直接与标准 MIL 聚合器集成。
Conclusion: 以角色引导的专家分工加两阶段蒸馏-适配，可以在数据稀缺下兼顾病理特异表示能力与适配效率，无需对整编码器全量微调。

papers.title: DeShortcut-Align: Decoupling Spurious Shortcuts for Robust Safety Alignment in Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment of large reasoning models (LRMs) via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) often yields near-perfect safety scores, yet this apparent success comes at the cost of severe over-refusal and degraded general capabilities. Through systematic empirical analysis, we find that these failures are closely associated with the learning of spurious shortcuts rather than robust intent-sensitive safety evaluation. Specifically, we identify two dominant shortcuts: formatting shortcuts, where refusal behaviors are overly bound to structural prompt templates that frequently appear in safety alignment corpora; and lexical shortcuts, where sensitive keywords reflexively trigger refusals on benign queries. To mitigate reliance on these shortcuts, we propose DeShortcut-Align, a shortcut-decoupling alignment framework that reduces dependence on superficial cues. DeShortcut-Align operates across three coordinated stages: (1) Refusal Sensitivity Attribution, which masks input tokens to quantify their impact on the final refusal response distribution; (2) Attribution-Guided Contrastive Augmentation, which constructs benign contrastive samples using high-sensitivity tokens to mitigate lexical shortcuts; and (3) Counterfactual Consistency Regularization, which constructs template-ablated states via attention blinding to enforce decision consistency across SFT and RL, mitigating formatting shortcut dependence. Experiments on 7B and 14B models demonstrate that DeShortcut-Align significantly improves robustness against template-stripping bypass attacks (reducing performance drops by up to 72%), substantially reduces over-refusal by over 58%, and better preserves general-purpose reasoning capabilities, thereby mitigating the alignment tax commonly observed in safety training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeShortcut-Align 把大推理模型安全对齐中的失效归因于两类虚假捷径：绑定提示模板的 formatting shortcut 与敏感词触发拒绝的 lexical shortcut。框架分三步解耦——拒绝敏感度归因、归因引导的对比增广、反事实一致性正则——在 7B 与 14B 模型上使模板剥离绕过攻击的性能下降最多减少 72%，过度拒绝降低超过 58%。
Motivation: SFT 与 RL 安全对齐常拿到近乎满分的安全分数，但代价是严重过度拒绝与通用能力下降；作者发现这源于模型学到表面捷径而非真正按意图判断安全性。
Method: 三阶段框架：Refusal Sensitivity Attribution 通过遮蔽输入 token 量化其对最终拒绝响应分布的影响；Attribution-Guided Contrastive Augmentation 用高敏感 token 构造良性对比样本以削弱 lexical shortcut；Counterfactual Consistency Regularization 用 attention blinding 构造去模板状态，在 SFT 与 RL 中强制决策一致性以削弱 formatting shortcut。
Result: 在 7B 和 14B 模型上，模板剥离绕过攻击 (template-stripping bypass) 的性能下降最多减少 72%，过度拒绝 (over-refusal) 降低超过 58%，并更好地保留通用推理能力。
Conclusion: 安全对齐的过度拒绝与能力损失主要来自表面捷径，把归因、对比增广与反事实一致性联合起来可同时提升鲁棒性并缓解 alignment tax。

papers.title: LVMT: Video Mask Transformer for Long-term Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Existing online video segmentation methods struggle to track objects in long, complex videos with long-term occlusions. We hypothesize that this limitation is caused by (i) the inability of their temporal propagation mechanism to adaptively select the object information that is propagated across time, and (ii) their inability to be trained on long videos due to memory requirements and vanishing gradients. To address the first limitation, we propose to use a lightweight GRU-based temporal propagation module that can learn to select which information it keeps in memory and propagates across time. Second, to allow training on long videos, we introduce Truncated Query Propagation (TQP), a training strategy in which the model processes a video in chunks of frames, where information about tracked objects is propagated between chunks but backpropagation is only conducted in individual chunks, enabling longer temporal supervision without out-of-memory issues, inference overhead, or vanishing gradients. The resulting model is called the Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT). Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that LVMT sets a new state of the art across a range of video segmentation tasks, while retaining the speed of the highly efficient model it is based on, making it 10X faster than the prior state of the art. Code: https://www.tue-mps.org/lvmt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LVMT 用轻量 GRU 时序传播模块让模型自行选择跨帧保留的目标信息，并提出 Truncated Query Propagation (TQP)：视频按帧块分段处理、目标信息跨块传播但反传只在单块内进行，从而在长视频上训练而不爆显存、不引入推理开销、不出现梯度消失。在六个视频分割基准上达到新 SOTA，同时比先前 SOTA 快 10X。
Motivation: 在线视频分割在长而复杂、含长期遮挡的视频上跟踪失败，原因有二：时序传播机制无法自适应选择要跨时间传递的目标信息，以及长视频训练受显存和梯度消失限制。
Method: 提出 GRU-based 时序传播模块，学习在记忆中保留哪些目标信息并跨时间传播；训练策略 Truncated Query Propagation (TQP) 把视频切成帧块，块间传播目标信息、反传只在单块内做，实现更长时序监督且无 OOM、无推理开销、无梯度消失；最终模型为 Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT)。
Result: 在六个基准上的大量实验显示 LVMT 在一系列视频分割任务上取得新 SOTA，同时保持其基础模型的高效率，比先前 SOTA 快 10X。
Conclusion: 自适应选择传播内容加上分块截断反传，可以在不牺牲速度的前提下把在线视频分割推到长视频与长期遮挡场景。

papers.title: ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at https://echo-wam.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECHO 是只用腕部相机的 latent world action model，把腕部事件流编码成紧凑运动表征，用 hindsight 模块把历史事件流保留为可寻址的离屏上下文，用 outlook 模块的可学习事件预见查询 (event foresight queries) 预测未来动作对应的事件窗口。在腕部 RLBench 任务上，正常光照下比 RGB 与 RGB+event 基线分别高 20.6 和 12.0 个百分点，严重曝光骤降下高 14.6 和 11.3 个百分点，并超过使用第三人称相机的 RGB 参考。
Motivation: RGB 策略在极端曝光下观测退化；事件相机虽有高动态范围，但观测强依赖相机位置：固定相机漏掉静态场景内容，腕部相机会让先前访问过的区域离开视野。
Method: ECHO 用预训练事件编码器解释帧间视觉特征变化，hindsight 模块以过去事件流保存夹爪轨迹作为离屏上下文，outlook 模块引入由未来事件窗口监督的可学习 event foresight queries 来预判场景变化，为策略推理提供时空上下文。
Result: 腕部 RLBench 任务上，正常光照下 ECHO 比 RGB 基线高 20.6 个百分点、比 RGB+event 基线高 12.0 个百分点；严重曝光骤降下分别高 14.6 和 11.3 个百分点，且超过使用第三人称相机的 RGB 参考。真实世界腕部事件相机实验中，在名义与严重黑暗光照下的多个任务上均优于 RGB-only 与 RGB+event 基线。
Conclusion: 只靠腕部事件相机也能通过补回离屏历史与预判未来事件窗口，把操作策略做到在极端曝光下仍优于 RGB 与 RGB+event 方案，无需第三人称相机。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction and Conditional Coverage for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) provide predictive distributions for regression, but their prediction regions can exhibit undercoverage or overcoverage even when point predictions are accurate. We introduce C-USIM (Conditionally-Uniformized Score Integration Method), a lightweight application of highest predictive density split conformal prediction that accommodates multimodal predictions. Given calibration and test outputs, it requires no additional training or model inference. It provides finite-sample marginal validity under our assumptions. We bound conditional-marginal coverage gaps using distribution-estimation error and score discreteness, and examine coverage heterogeneity through percentile rank-score plots. Experiments with TabPFN and TabICL show improved marginal coverage accuracy and lower average conditional and group coverage errors. Under a fixed data budget, allocating more observations to calibration can reduce marginal coverage error despite less accurate point predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对表格基础模型 (tabular foundation model) 预测区间欠覆盖/过覆盖问题，提出 C-USIM（条件均匀化分数积分方法），把最高预测密度 split conformal prediction 扩展到多峰预测，仅用校准与测试输出、无需额外训练或模型推理。在 TabPFN 与 TabICL 上实验显示边际覆盖精度提高、平均条件与分组覆盖误差降低；固定数据预算下，把更多观测分给校准可降低边际覆盖误差，即便点预测变差。
Motivation: 表格基础模型给出的回归预测分布即使点预测准确，其预测区间也可能欠覆盖或过覆盖，且多峰预测让常规 conformal 方法难以给出可靠区间。
Method: C-USIM 是最高预测密度 split conformal prediction 的轻量应用，通过条件均匀化分数积分 (Conditionally-Uniformized Score Integration Method) 容纳多峰预测；只需校准集与测试输出，无需额外训练或模型推理。理论上给出有限样本边际有效性（在假设下），并用分布估计误差与分数离散度界定条件-边际覆盖差距，用 percentile rank-score 图检查覆盖异质性。
Result: 在 TabPFN 与 TabICL 上实验：边际覆盖精度提高，平均条件覆盖误差与分组覆盖误差降低。固定数据预算下，把更多观测分配给校准可降低边际覆盖误差，即使点预测精度下降。
Conclusion: C-USIM 让表格基础模型的 conformal 区间在多峰预测下仍具有限样本边际有效性，且校准集与建模数据的预算分配应偏向校准以换取更好的覆盖。

papers.title: Fewer Assumptions by Design: A Reusable Skill for LLM-Assisted Verus Verification
authors: Andrada-Livia Antoneac (Alexandru Ioan Cuza University of Iaşi
Dorel Lucanu (Alexandru Ioan Cuza University of Iaşi)
Dragoş Teodor Gavriluţ (Alexandru Ioan Cuza University of Iaşi
papers.abstract_en: LLM-assisted Verus verification is a less tedious method to verify Rust implementations, but paired with self-referential structures, e.g., Doubly Linked Lists (DLLs)—notoriously difficult to formalise for verification—it becomes a substantially more demanding verification task. Moreover, a specification weakness can arise when verification relies on unproven or invalidated assumptions, such as axiomatic lemmas and assume statements. We investigate whether LLM agents can synthesize strong DLL specifications while minimizing these trusted base. The analysis follows three different approaches: manual verification, property-specific verification, and a defined skill for the specific case of DLLs and certain properties of this type of data structure. The skill encodes domain knowledge and a task-decomposition strategy. We show that an LLM agent equipped with a carefully designed verification skill can generate strong, low-trust specifications for DLLs in Verus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Rust 双向链表 (DLL) 在 Verus 中难以形式化、且验证易依赖未证明假设的问题，提出一个编码领域知识与任务分解策略的可复用验证 skill，让 LLM agent 合成强而低信任基 (low-trust) 的 DLL 规格。对比手工验证、按性质验证与该 skill 三条路线，配备 skill 的 agent 能生成强且少依赖 axiomatic lemma 与 assume 语句的 Verus 规格。
Motivation: LLM 辅助 Verus 验证 Rust 实现时，自引用结构 (如 DLL) 极难形式化；若验证依赖未证明或已失效的假设 (axiomatic lemma、assume 语句)，规格会存在信任基过大的弱点。
Method: 沿三条路线对比：手工验证、针对特定性质的验证 (property-specific verification)，以及为 DLL 及其典型性质定义的一个可复用 skill；该 skill 编码领域知识与任务分解策略，交给 LLM agent 在 Verus 中合成 DLL 规格。
Result: 配备精心设计的验证 skill 的 LLM agent 能为 DLL 生成强且低信任基的 Verus 规格，即在减少对 axiomatic lemma 与 assume 等未证明假设依赖的同时保持规格强度；摘要以定性论证呈现三条路线的对比。
Conclusion: 把领域知识与任务分解固化成 skill，是降低 LLM 辅助验证中可信基、缓解规格因未证假设而失效的可行路径，尤其适用于 DLL 这类自引用结构。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SubRot: Signed Gradient Subspace Calibration for VLM Rotation Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but preserving multimodal capabilities at low bit widths remains challenging. Existing methods rely on modality- or token-level gradient statistics, which are susceptible to cross-sample variations in visual-to-textual token ratios and the positions of visual information, limiting statistical stability. Moreover, overly coarse aggregation through absolute values and averaging discards gradient signs and channel-wise differences, limiting the separation of modality-specific sensitivities. In contrast, the channel space provides a shared coordinate system across samples, making it a more natural basis for capturing stable task-sensitive structures. We therefore propose SubRot, a signed gradient subspace calibration method for VLM rotation quantization. Through eigendecomposition of the empirical Fisher matrix of activation gradients, SubRot identifies a sensitive channel subspace with three properties: cross-sample stability, clear sensitivity separation, and consistent signed effects on the autoregressive loss along certain directions. Guided by a local Taylor expansion, SubRot combines signed first-order guidance along sign-stable directions with second-order constraints along the remaining sensitive directions, while retaining MSE for overall reconstruction quality. This objective steers quantization errors toward loss-decreasing directions while controlling their magnitude. Experiments on five VLMs across five benchmarks show consistent average-score improvements over FlatQuant under W4A6 and W4A4, reaching 1.4 percentage points on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. Under W4A4, average accuracy degradation from FP16 remains within 1.4 percentage points across all evaluated models, while LLaVA-v1.5-13B exceeds its FP16 average score by 0.4 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SubRot 针对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 旋转量化提出带符号梯度子空间校准：对激活梯度的经验 Fisher 矩阵做特征分解，找出跨样本稳定、敏感度可分且对自回归损失有符号一致影响的通道子空间，再用局部 Taylor 展开把一阶带符号引导与二阶约束组合，使量化误差偏向降低损失的方向。在五个 VLM、五个 benchmark 上，W4A6 与 W4A4 相对 FlatQuant 平均分一致提升，LLaVA-NeXT-7B 达 1.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 量化校准依赖模态级或 token 级梯度统计，受视觉-文本 token 比例与视觉信息位置的跨样本变化影响，统计不稳定；用绝对值与平均做粗粒度聚合又丢掉梯度符号与通道差异，难以区分模态敏感度。
Method: SubRot 对激活梯度的经验 Fisher 矩阵做特征分解，选出具备跨样本稳定性、敏感度分离与符号一致效应的敏感通道子空间；在局部 Taylor 展开指导下，对符号稳定方向施加带符号一阶引导，对其余敏感方向施加二阶约束，同时保留 MSE 项保证整体重建质量，从而把量化误差导向使损失下降的方向并控制其幅度。
Result: 在五个 VLM、五个 benchmark 上，W4A6 与 W4A4 两种设置下平均分均一致优于 FlatQuant，LLaVA-NeXT-7B 提升达 1.4 个百分点；W4A4 下所有被评估模型相对 FP16 的平均精度损失保持在 1.4 个百分点以内，其中 LLaVA-v1.5-13B 的平均分反超 FP16 0.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 通道空间是比模态/token 级统计更稳定的敏感度坐标系，把带符号一阶引导与二阶约束放进旋转量化目标，可以在 W4A4 这样的低比特设置下把 VLM 多模态能力损失压到 1.4 个百分点以内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Readout, Many Repairs: Diffusion-Guided Hierarchical Search for Tool-Agent Repair
papers.abstract_en: Tool agents use large language models to act through external tools, yet successfully executed calls can still leave user requests unfulfilled. Tool-agent repair seeks alternative call sequences that execute successfully and fulfill the original requests. However, repair requires exploring both operation choices and their concrete realizations, making complete-sequence regeneration costly. Moreover, regeneration repeats operation selection even when failure arises from how those operations are realized. The resulting challenge is to reduce this repetition while preserving exploration of alternative operations and realizations. Therefore, we formulate repair as hierarchical search over operation supports, which we introduce as sets of permitted operation types that define reusable search regions for concrete tool-call sequences. We propose ReCommit, a training-free, diffusion-guided framework for improving tool-agent failure recovery while reducing repair computation. ReCommit amortizes operation-level proposal computation across repair trials by reusing operation-type scores from a single parallel readout of a masked diffusion language model. These scores guide search across supports, while realization search explores alternative entity bindings, arguments, and action composition within each support. Experiments on real failures across four enterprise services in the Agent-Diff benchmark show 75.9\% and 63.2\% relative recovery gains with 61.3\% and 51.3\% reductions in mean full-budget repair time at repair budgets $B=3$ and $B=13$, respectively, over the strongest evaluated 8B comparison method. ReCommit achieves a favorable recovery--cost trade-off, including in comparisons with the evaluated 32B models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCommit 把工具智能体修复形式化为在 operation support（允许的操作类型集合）上的分层搜索，用掩码扩散语言模型的一次并行 readout 复用操作类型分数，摊薄多次修复尝试的提议计算。在 Agent-Diff 上四个企业服务的真实失败中，相对最强 8B 对比方法在 B=3 与 B=13 下分别取得 75.9% 与 63.2% 的相对恢复率提升，同时平均全预算修复时间下降 61.3% 与 51.3%。
Motivation: 工具调用执行成功但用户请求仍未满足时，整段序列重新生成代价高，且会重复做操作选择，即使失败其实出在操作的具体实现上。
Method: ReCommit 是 training-free、diffusion-guided 的修复框架：把修复写成 operation support 上的分层搜索，用掩码扩散语言模型单次并行 readout 得到操作类型分数并在各 support 间复用，support 内再做 realization search，搜索实体绑定、参数与动作组合。
Result: Agent-Diff 四个企业服务真实失败上，相对最强评估的 8B 对比方法：B=3 时相对恢复增益 75.9%、平均全预算修复时间减少 61.3%；B=13 时相对恢复增益 63.2%、修复时间减少 51.3%；与所评估的 32B 模型比较也呈现有利的恢复-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 把操作选择与具体实现拆成两层并摊薄操作级提议计算，可在降低修复计算量的同时提高工具智能体失败恢复率，且该权衡对 32B 级模型也成立。

papers.title: SPOC-Net: Single-Primitive Online Composition Network for GNSS Jamming Set Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Reliable positioning, navigation, and timing support intelligent transportation, autonomous systems, and space-air-ground integrated networks. However, global navigation satellite system (GNSS) jamming recognizers that treat each mixture as a separate class are difficult to extend to new combinations. Therefore, this paper proposes SPOC-Net, which decomposes the recognition problem into identifying a set of basic jamming components. Multi-resolution time-frequency features and learned component queries provide evidence for each component type. A high-resolution branch estimates the number of active types, and a structured decoder combines this estimate with component evidence to select a valid set. For training, measured single-component records are the only physical samples used in gradient optimization. Their associated clean in-phase and quadrature (IQ) sequences are combined on demand during training to produce labeled mixtures with different relative powers and jamming-to-noise ratios. Separate measured mixtures from ten training-listed compositions support model selection and decoder calibration; six other compositions are reserved for final testing. Evaluation on 14,220 independently generated, conductively combined, and recorded radio frequency mixtures yields 80.69% exact-set accuracy and a 92.84% micro-averaged F1 score. On combinations excluded from model development, SPOC-Net achieves 80.89% exact-set accuracy, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 18.77 percentage points under the reported protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPOC-Net 把 GNSS 干扰识别从「整套混合当一个类」改写为「识别一组基本干扰分量的集合」：多分辨率时频特征与可学习分量 query 提供各分量证据，高分辨率分支先估计活跃分量数，结构化 decoder 再据此选出合法集合。训练只用实测单分量记录的干净 IQ 按需合成不同相对功率与干噪比 (JNR) 的带标签混合。在 14,220 个独立生成并录制的射频混合上取得 80.69% exact-set accuracy 与 92.84% micro-F1；对未参与模型开发的组合，exact-set accuracy 80.89%，超出最强对比方法 18.77 个百分点。
Motivation: 把每种干扰混合当作独立类别的 GNSS 干扰识别器无法外推到未见过的分量组合，类别数随组合爆炸，新组合需要重新标注与重训。
Method: 将识别分解为基本干扰分量集合的判定：多分辨率时频特征与学习得到的 component query 为每类分量提供证据；一个高分辨率分支估计活跃分量数量，结构化 decoder 结合该估计与分量证据选出合法集合。梯度优化只用实测单分量记录，其干净 IQ 序列在训练时按需合成不同相对功率与 JNR 的带标签混合；另有十个训练列表内组合的实测混合用于模型选择与 decoder 校准，六个组合留作最终测试。
Result: 在 14,220 个独立生成、传导合成并录制的射频混合上，exact-set accuracy 80.69%，micro-averaged F1 92.84%。在未参与模型开发的组合上 exact-set accuracy 80.89%，在所报告协议下超出最强对比方法 18.77 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把干扰识别拆成「先估数量、再选集合」的组合式结构，可以在只用单分量实测样本训练的条件下，泛化到训练列表之外的干扰组合。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: P4Q: Co-designing Token Pruning and Quantization for Vision-Language Model Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal applications, yet their substantial computational and memory costs hinder efficient deployment. Visual token pruning and post-training quantization reduce inference overhead along two complementary dimensions, namely sequence length and numerical precision. Existing workflows typically optimize these techniques independently or apply them sequentially. Their distinct optimization objectives leave critical interactions unaddressed and constrain the achievable compression performance. We revisit these designs and present P4Q, a practical co-design framework that jointly optimizes visual token pruning and low-bit quantization for efficient VLM inference. First, P4Q introduces a quantization-aware visual token selection strategy before the LLM. It applies fake quantization to copies of the features produced by the projector and selects visual tokens using statistics computed from these fake-quantized features, thereby conditioning the selector's feature-based decisions on simulated low-bit perturbations. Second, P4Q introduces a pruning-aware quantization calibration strategy. It uses the same selection strategy as pruning to calibrate the quantized model on the retained-token distribution, thereby aligning the calibration process with the pruned execution path used during deployment. By coupling these two components, P4Q achieves substantial inference speedups while maintaining comparable task performance, resulting in a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off than independently optimized pipelines. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT, P4Q achieves an average end-to-end inference speedup of 2.8x across eight distinct test sets, while retaining higher accuracy than prior compression and quantization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P4Q 把视觉 token 剪枝与低比特量化联合设计：在 LLM 之前对 projector 输出特征做 fake quantization 并据此选 token，再用同一选择策略在保留 token 分布上做剪枝感知的量化校准。在 LLaVA-NeXT 上跨八个测试集取得平均 2.8x 端到端推理加速，且准确率高于此前的压缩与量化方法。
Motivation: 视觉 token 剪枝与训练后量化分别压缩序列长度和数值精度，但现有流程各自优化或顺序执行，两者优化目标不同导致关键交互被忽略，压缩性能受限。
Method: P4Q 含两个耦合组件：一是 LLM 前的量化感知 token 选择，对 projector 输出特征的副本施加 fake quantization，用这些受低比特扰动的特征统计量选 token；二是剪枝感知的量化校准，用同一选择策略在保留 token 分布上校准量化模型，使校准与部署时的剪枝执行路径对齐。
Result: 在 LLaVA-NeXT 上，P4Q 跨八个不同测试集取得平均 2.8x 端到端推理加速，同时准确率高于此前的压缩与量化方法，效率-精度权衡优于独立优化的流水线。
Conclusion: 把 token 剪枝与低比特量化耦合优化，比分别优化或顺序执行更能同时保住任务性能并拿到推理加速。

papers.title: From Attention Sensitivity to Layer Role: Revisiting Mixed-Precision Quantization of Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Most post-training quantization pipelines fit each weight matrix to its pretrained counterpart, one matrix at a time. Whether that proxy tracks what an attention block actually computes, or how errors in the Q, K and V projections compound inside the softmax, is rarely checked. We write the objective on the attention output instead, over all three projections at once, and reuse it throughout the pipeline. JAB defines one scalar loss over the joint Q, K, V weights of a block, evaluated against the block's real causally-masked attention output, and uses it twice: to fit the quantized weights (GPTQ warm start, then STE with learnable scales), and to score the block for a multiple-choice knapsack allocation. On attention-only quantization of Mistral-7B this works. At 3 bits JAB recovers 77-90% of the gap between uniform GPTQ and full precision, and its sensitivity estimate tracks an oracle costing 73 forward passes to within a fraction of a point. It stops working once MLP layers enter the allocation. A role-aware offset rule needing no sensitivity estimate at all beats JAB on GPT-2's MLP and on the full Mistral-7B model: with a 3-bit floor it quantizes 96.4% of the weights to 4.5 bits per parameter at 6.933 perplexity, within 4.4% of full precision (6.643) at 3.56x compression, against 7.158 for JAB at the same budget. Which matrix a weight sits in matters more than any sensitivity estimate we computed. Two things came out sideways. Block-local reconstruction is an unreliable proxy for end-to-end perplexity: one run improved a block's own objective 4.6x while perplexity rose 32x, which is why every allocation here is validated end-to-end. And on attention-only quantization, fine-tuning moved weights farther from their pretrained values while pulling attention outputs closer, with net gains. Post-training seems to recover attention behavior, not weights.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Nafiseh HosseinpourFardi and Negar Alihadi contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 JAB：把量化目标写在注意力输出上、一次覆盖一个 block 的联合 Q/K/V 权重，并用同一标量损失既拟合权重又做多选背包 (knapsack) 位宽分配。3 bit 下 JAB 在 Mistral-7B 注意力量化上追回均匀 GPTQ 与全精度差距的 77-90%，但一旦 MLP 进入分配就失效；无需敏感度估计的 role-aware offset 规则在 GPT-2 MLP 与完整 Mistral-7B 上反超 JAB。
Motivation: 主流 PTQ 流水线逐个权重矩阵去拟合预训练副本，从不检验该代理是否对应注意力块真正计算的内容，也不检验 Q、K、V 投影误差在 softmax 内如何复合。
Method: JAB 定义一个作用于 block 联合 Q/K/V 权重的标量损失，以该块真实的 causal-mask 注意力输出为参照，并在流水线中复用两次：先 GPTQ 热启、再 STE 配可学习 scale 拟合量化权重，同时为多选背包位宽分配打分。另提出完全不需要敏感度估计的 role-aware offset 规则。
Result: Mistral-7B 注意力量化 3 bit 下 JAB 追回均匀 GPTQ 与全精度差距的 77-90%，其敏感度估计与代价 73 次前向的 oracle 相差不到一个百分点。加入 MLP 后 JAB 失效：3-bit floor 下 role-aware 规则把 96.4% 权重量化到每参数 4.5 bit，困惑度 6.933，距全精度 6.643 仅 4.4%，压缩比 3.56x，同预算下 JAB 为 7.158。块内重建是不可靠代理：某次运行把块自身目标改善 4.6 倍而困惑度恶化 32 倍。
Conclusion: 权重落在哪个矩阵比任何敏感度估计都更决定量化分配，因此所有分配都必须端到端验证；块局部重建不能代表端到端困惑度。注意力-only 量化中微调把权重推离预训练值却让注意力输出更接近，净收益为正，说明 PTQ 恢复的是注意力行为而非权重本身。

papers.title: On the Limits of Metacognitive Monitoring in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reliable decisions depend on recognizing when an answer may be wrong. In biological cognition, metacognitive monitoring can dissociate from task performance, raising the question of how closely solving and judging are linked in language models. Here we study the confidence reports of four frontier models across 15 benchmarks. High task accuracy can coexist with weak error discrimination: a model solves 97% of competition mathematics problems while its answer-time confidence ranks correct answers above errors barely better than chance. Confidence separates correct answers from errors more effectively on questions solved by a separate reference model, while review brings limited improvement on reference-hard questions. Aggregate discrimination also rewards ranking correct answers on easy questions above errors on hard ones, which question-only forecasts already do well. Cross-evaluation helps most where the evaluator answered correctly, and errors shared by the two models usually retain high confidence. Hard questions and shared errors remain difficult targets for prompted self-review and peer oversight, even in models with strong problem-solving performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 15 个基准上考察四个前沿模型的置信度报告，发现任务准确率高不等于误差辨别力强：某模型竞赛数学题解出 97%，但作答时置信度把正确答案排在错误答案之上的能力仅略好于随机。置信度在参考模型能解出的题上区分度更好，而难题与两模型共享的错误即使经过提示式自审和同伴监督仍保持高置信，是难以覆盖的目标。
Motivation: 可靠决策取决于识别答案何时可能出错；生物认知中元认知监控可与任务表现分离，需要检验语言模型的解题与自我评判耦合程度。
Method: 对四个前沿模型在 15 个基准上收集置信度报告，比较作答时置信度对正确与错误答案的排序区分度，并考察以单独参考模型的作答情况为条件的交叉评估、提示式自审 (prompted self-review) 与同伴监督 (peer oversight)，同时用仅看题目的预测 (question-only forecasts) 作对照。
Result: 某模型竞赛数学题准确率达 97%，但置信度区分正确与错误仅略好于随机；置信度在参考模型答对的题上区分更有效，参考模型答错的题上自审改进有限；聚合区分度指标会奖励把简单题的正确答案排在难题的错误之上，而仅看题目的预测已能很好做到这一点；交叉评估在评估者自己答对的题上帮助最大，两模型共享的错误通常仍保持高置信。
Conclusion: 解题能力与元认知监控在前沿 LLM 中可以大幅脱节：难题和共享错误是提示式自审与同伴监督的持续盲区，即便模型解题性能很强，聚合区分度指标也会被题目难度混淆。

papers.title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWiM 把 MLLM 自己重访同图同查询时产生的推理轨迹与定位提议当作 working memory，按分割质量筛选 rollout 构造记忆条件教师，在学生轨迹上给 token 级分布监督，学生推理时只看原图与查询。on-policy 自蒸馏与基于结果的强化学习联合优化，使模型在有无 working memory 时都能提升推理分割能力，在推理分割基准上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: MLLM 做推理分割时每次生成的推理链与定位提议被丢弃，重访同一图像-查询本可复用的自我引导信息没有被固化进骨干模型。
Method: SWiM（Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory）框架：按分割质量筛选 rollouts 构造 working memory，用以记忆为条件的模型作教师，在学生自生成轨迹上提供 token 级分布监督，学生仅接收原图与查询；训练上联合优化 on-policy 自蒸馏与基于结果的强化学习。
Result: 在推理分割基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，验证 working memory 蒸馏有效；模型在推理时带或不带 working memory 均可受益。
Conclusion: 把重访先前尝试得到的引导蒸馏进骨干，可让推理分割在不依赖推理期记忆的情况下也保持提升，working memory 是可转移的自我监督信号。

papers.title: When Text Matters: Design Principles for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning has been widely studied as a practical approach to reducing the computational cost of large vision-language models. However, it struggles to preserve essential visual information, which can lead to substantial performance degradation. In particular, image-based token selection can overlook task-relevant details, while text-guided token selection may fail to capture the text--visual relationships needed for complex reasoning. We find that applying textual guidance too early can limit its ability to identify answer-relevant visual regions, whereas text-to-visual attention becomes more informative at intermediate decoder depths. This finding motivates our training-free method, which separates early vision-guided pruning from deferred text-guided reselection. We first prune visual tokens using vision-encoder attention, retain additional candidates until the decoder midpoint, and then use text-to-visual attention to determine the final visual-token set. Across eight benchmarks and three models, our method outperforms the best-performing baselines by an average of 11.10 and 16.84 percentage points in performance recovery at 80% and 90% pruning, respectively, with comparable or lower LLM-prefill latency than most baselines. papers.title: Attention-based Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck for Robust Multi-Agent Communication under Variable Bandwidth
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based multi-agent communication under limited bandwidth does not only require deciding what to communicate, but also structuring messages so that partial transmissions remain useful. We study this problem under prefix truncation, where only the first part of each message is received. To address it, we propose \textbf{AH-VIB}, an attention-based autoregressive variational communication model that combines a variational information bottleneck (VIB) with sequential message generation and a hierarchical robustness loss. We evaluate AH-VIB on a custom cooperative object-inspection and occupancy-mapping task, where agents equipped with a limited field-of-view sensor coordinate to scan inspection objects in an occupancy-grid world, under variable and fixed bandwidth conditions, and compare it against MADDPG, CommNet, a flat VIB baseline, and an autoregressive MLP ablation. AH-VIB achieves competitive mean return while improving performance reliability under the most constrained bandwidth conditions. These results indicate that AH-VIB improves the reliability and graceful degradation of learned communication under bandwidth constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带宽受限且消息会被前缀截断 (prefix truncation) 的多智能体通信中，AH-VIB 用注意力自回归生成消息并配合分层鲁棒损失，使截断后残留的前缀仍携带可用信息。在自建的协作物体巡检与占据栅格建图任务上，AH-VIB 平均回报有竞争力，且在最紧张带宽条件下性能可靠性更好、退化更平缓。
Motivation: 带宽受限下学习式多智能体通信不仅要决定传什么，还要让消息结构在只收到前半段时仍然可用；现有方法在前缀截断下部分传输会失效。
Method: 提出 AH-VIB：把变分信息瓶颈 (VIB) 与自回归消息生成结合的注意力式通信模型，并加入分层鲁棒损失 (hierarchical robustness loss)，在固定与可变带宽两种条件下训练与测试。
Result: 在自建的协作物体巡检与占据栅格 (occupancy-grid) 任务上，对比 MADDPG、CommNet、flat VIB 基线与自回归 MLP 消融：AH-VIB 取得有竞争力的平均回报 (mean return)，并在最受限的带宽条件下提升性能可靠性。
Conclusion: 把消息按自回归前缀组织并用 VIB 加分层鲁棒损失约束，能让学习式通信在带宽约束下实现更可靠的优雅退化 (graceful degradation)。

papers.title: Beyond Verbalized Confidence: Calibrating Reasoners with Differentiable Readouts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models to produce correct answers, but does not ensure that their stated confidence is calibrated. The resulting models are systematically overconfident. Recent methods train calibration inside the RLVR loop by having the model state a numerical confidence alongside its answer, but they all obtain the confidence by sampling it as text. This choice imposes two costs: a sampled confidence introduces variance and in practice collapses to a handful of distinct values, and sampling makes the confidence non-differentiable, forcing the calibration loss through a scalar reward. We propose CREDO (Confidence REaDOut) to replace sampling with a deterministic readout. While RLVR optimizes correctness, CREDO reads the confidence from a dedicated token pair in the model's output distribution and trains it by differentiable regression. CREDO further turns the trained confidence into a signal for accuracy, weighting rollouts by how far confidence and outcome disagree, so that accuracy and calibration improve together. Across mathematical and code reasoning, CREDO attains the best accuracy and calibration, and the gains extend to abstention and selective prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CREDO 用输出分布中一对专用 token 的确定性读出 (deterministic readout) 取代文本采样置信度，通过可微回归直接训练置信度，并按置信度与结果的分歧程度给 rollout 加权，使准确率与校准同时提升。在数学与代码推理上取得最佳准确率与校准，收益延伸到弃答与选择性预测。
Motivation: RLVR 训出的推理模型系统性过度自信；现有在 RLVR 环节内做校准的方法都以文本采样置信度，采样带来方差、实际塌缩到少数几个取值，且不可微，迫使校准损失只能走标量奖励。
Method: CREDO (Confidence REaDOut)：从模型输出分布中一对专用 token 读出置信度，用可微回归训练；再把训练好的置信度转成准确率信号，按置信度与实际结果的分歧给 rollout 加权，让准确率与校准联合优化。
Result: 在数学与代码推理上取得最佳准确率与校准，收益延伸到弃答 (abstention) 与选择性预测 (selective prediction)。
Conclusion: 把置信度从采样文本改为可微读出，能让 RLVR 推理模型的准确率与校准一起改善，而不必把校准损失压进标量奖励。

papers.title: AUV-Bench: Aesthetic Understanding and Generation Evaluation for User Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used for evaluating and generating user interfaces (UIs), often producing seemingly reasonable aesthetic judgments and visually plausible pages. However, under professional design scrutiny, their behavior can differ substantially from that of human designers. In professional design practice, designers rely on a systematic set of aesthetic principles that consistently guide judgment, diagnosis, repair, and creation. A coherent aesthetic capability should therefore connect aesthetic judgment with design actions. Existing evaluations, however, typically assess these abilities in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether task-level success reflects a shared aesthetic understanding or merely fragmented task-specific competence. To address this gap, we introduce AUV-Bench, developed in collaboration with professional UI designers around 1,395 executable web interfaces and four tasks: aesthetic scoring, diagnosis, repair, and text-to-UI generation. The tasks share a pool of UIs and aesthetic principles, with diagnosis and repair further aligned on 660 controlled-degradation instances to enable instance-level analysis of judgment and action. Evaluation of 12 models reveals a capability imbalance: models show moderate agreement with professional designers in holistic aesthetic scoring, yet exact diagnosis-chain success peaks at only 24.7%. On the aligned diagnosis-repair cases, correct judgments and successful repairs do not consistently coincide, exposing a Judgment-Action Gap between identifying aesthetic problems and successfully acting on them. In open-ended generation, even leading models achieve only moderate aesthetic quality under human-calibrated evaluation. Overall, current models exhibit partial aesthetic competence, but still lack the fine-grained understanding and judgment-action coherence required for reliable UI design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AUV-Bench 用 1,395 个可执行网页界面和四类任务（美学打分、诊断、修复、文生 UI）把 UI 美学判断与设计动作放进同一套评测，12 个模型显示整体打分与专业设计师中等一致，但精确诊断链成功率最高仅 24.7%，且判断正确与修复成功并不一致，暴露出 Judgment-Action Gap。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型给出的 UI 美学判断和生成页面看似合理，但现有评测把判断与设计动作分开考，无法判断任务成功来自共享的美学理解还是碎片化的任务技巧。
Method: 与专业 UI 设计师合作构建 AUV-Bench：围绕 1,395 个可执行 web 界面设计四项共享同一 UI 池与美学原则的任务（aesthetic scoring、diagnosis、repair、text-to-UI generation），其中诊断与修复在 660 个受控退化实例上对齐，支持实例级的判断-动作分析；对 12 个模型评测，开放式生成采用 human-calibrated 评估。
Result: 12 个模型中，整体美学打分与专业设计师中等一致，但精确诊断链 (exact diagnosis-chain) 成功率峰值仅 24.7%；在对齐的诊断-修复案例上，正确判断与成功修复并不一致；开放式生成中即便是领先模型，在 human-calibrated 评估下美学质量也仅为中等。
Conclusion: 当前模型只具备部分美学能力，缺少细粒度理解与判断-动作一致性，尚不足以支撑可靠的 UI 设计。

papers.title: EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviSplat 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 中保留各视角的独立观测特征作为证据，等文本查询到来时再按查询相关性与该高斯被观测的频次、明确性加权聚合，避免查询前压缩丢掉后续查询依赖的线索。在多个数据集与评测协议上达到 state-of-the-art，支持把多视角证据保留到查询时刻再聚合的做法。
Motivation: 开放词汇 3D 分割中，现有方法在查询未知前就把多视角 masked crop 压进语言特征或紧凑描述符，而同一物体各视角信息量不等，部分视角含不完整或误导线索，提前合并会压掉后续查询所依赖的证据。
Method: EviSplat 在 class-agnostic 3D instance（涵盖物体、部件、背景区域）内保留各观测特征；为每个 Gaussian 学习一个分布，描述其观测支持哪些视觉外观；给定文本查询时先用最相关观测给 instance 打分，再结合 instance 级相关性与局部受支持证据、按该 Gaussian 被观测的频次与无歧义程度加权算出每个 Gaussian 的分数。
Result: 在多个数据集与评测协议上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，验证保留多视角证据并在查询时按查询聚合的收益。
Conclusion: 查询前压缩多视角观测会损失查询相关线索；把证据保留到查询时刻、按查询相关性与观测明确性加权聚合，是开放词汇 3D 分割更有效的设计。

papers.title: Learning High-Risk High-Precision Motion Control
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms for movement control are typically evaluated and benchmarked on sequential decision tasks where imprecise actions may be corrected with later actions, thus allowing high returns with noisy actions. In contrast, we focus on an under-researched class of high-risk, high-precision motion control problems where actions carry irreversible outcomes, driving sharp peaks and ridges to plague the state-action reward landscape. Using computational pool as a representative example of such problems, we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples. We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.
papers.journal_ref: MIG '22: Proceedings of the 15th ACM SIGGRAPH Conference on Motion, Interaction and Games, Article 9, pp. 1-10 (2022)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT)，在高风险、动作不可逆的高精度运动控制上改进 advantage-weighted regression (AWR)：只用 elite 样本做策略优化、采用 mixture-of-experts (MoE) 策略按状态切换奖励模态，再加距离正则与学习课程鼓励先探索多样策略。以计算台球 (computational pool) 为例，学到物理真实的击球动作，展现高动作精度并为同一球型发现多种击球策略。
Motivation: DRL 运动控制的基准多是后续动作可纠错的序列任务，带噪动作也能拿高回报；而动作结果不可逆的高精度控制问题研究不足，其状态-动作奖励面布满尖峰与脊线，常规策略优化难以收敛到稀有的高回报动作。
Method: SCOOT 基于 advantage-weighted regression (AWR)，做三处修改：只用 elite 样本做策略优化以贴住稀有高回报动作；用 mixture-of-experts (MoE) 策略按状态在不同奖励模态间切换；加入距离正则项与学习课程，先鼓励探索多样策略再收敛到最优样本。任务为物理真实的台球击球。
Result: 在计算台球上学到物理真实的击球，展现高动作精度，并为给定球型发现多种击球策略；摘要以定性展示为主，未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 在动作不可逆的高精度控制中，用 elite 样本加 MoE 策略与探索课程能绕开奖励面的尖峰脊线，学到高精度且多策略的解。

papers.title: From Soft Targets to Reward Signals: How Assignment and Reward Objectives Interact
papers.abstract_en: Soft preference targets specify supervision strength, and reward objectives convert that strength into learned reward signals. A central design question remains: how does assigning a fixed set of preference strengths to different response pairs change the rewards produced by different objectives? We introduce assignment geometry to study this interaction. Mean-matched smoothing controls target dispersion, while within-stratum reassignment changes correspondence and preserves the complete target distribution. Across five reward objectives, intact correspondence retains the largest clean preference margins among the compared soft targets within a common accuracy-equivalence budget. Attenuation orderings change with the reward objective, revealing different responses to the same target assignments. Independent reassignments and a related source construction reproduce the retention direction. An attenuation-retention profile compares these combinations through margin magnitude, edit response, and accuracy. Against independently calibrated scaling, APLOT uniform targets deliver additional attenuation on both aggregate and presentation edits. These findings establish a joint design space in which target placement and reward objective shape reward properties beyond preference accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在偏好学习中把「软目标如何分配到响应对」与「用哪个 reward objective」当作联合设计空间：用 assignment geometry 控制目标离散度与对应关系，发现 intact correspondence 在共同 accuracy-equivalence 预算下保留最大的 clean preference margin，而衰减排序随 reward objective 改变。APLOT uniform targets 相对独立校准的 scaling 在 aggregate 与 presentation edits 上都带来额外衰减。
Motivation: 软偏好目标决定监督强度，reward objective 决定该强度如何转成学到的奖励信号；但把固定的偏好强度集合分配到不同响应对时，不同 objective 产出的奖励会如何变化，是一个尚未厘清的中心设计问题。
Method: 提出 assignment geometry 框架：用 mean-matched smoothing 控制目标离散度，用 within-stratum reassignment 改变对应关系同时保持完整目标分布不变；在五个 reward objective 上比较，并用独立重分配与相关 source construction 复现衰减方向，通过 margin magnitude、edit response、accuracy 构造 attenuation-retention profile。
Result: 在五个 reward objective 中，intact correspondence 在共同 accuracy-equivalence 预算下于所比较的软目标里保留最大的 clean preference margin；衰减排序随 reward objective 改变，说明不同 objective 对同一目标分配响应不同；独立重分配与相关 source construction 复现了该保留方向；APLOT uniform targets 相对独立校准的 scaling 在 aggregate 与 presentation 两类 edit 上都产生额外衰减。
Conclusion: 目标放置与 reward objective 共同决定奖励性质，其影响超出偏好准确率本身；评估软目标时应联合考察目标分配与 objective 选择，而非只看 accuracy。

papers.title: When Sparse Reward Meets Dense Distillation: Training Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides a sparse post-training signal: a single binary outcome evaluates the entire rollout, and every token receives the same sequence-level advantage regardless of its individual contribution. To complement this sparse supervision, a growing family of methods adds a scalar-weighted teacher KL term to the policy-gradient objective, providing dense token-level guidance that may be unreliable at some positions. Despite the benefits of combining these signals, their interaction during optimization can destabilize joint training. To understand how this instability develops, we study the learning dynamics of hybrid reward--distillation training through a neural tangent kernel (NTK) analysis. We introduce the cross-signal NTK $K_{DR}(n)$, a token-level statistic that measures the alignment between reward and distillation gradients at position n. Through this analysis, we identify two failure modes: 1 Magnitude drowning, where the reward gradient exceeds the distillation gradient by orders of magnitude, so that even weak directional conflict can cause the distillation loss to rise despite its explicit inclusion in the training objective; and 2 Localized directional conflict, where the sequence-level advantage and the teacher's position-specific distribution induce opposing updates at the same token ($K_{DR}(n)\!<\!0$). The severity of these effects depends on the optimization regime: the gradient-norm ratio $κ\!=\!\|\nabla\mathcal{L}_R\|/\|\nabla\mathcal{L}_D\|$ varies by roughly an order of magnitude across tasks, and our experiments reveal an empirical threshold beyond which naive mixing can lead to persistent training collapse. Motivated by these findings, we introduce the M3 family, which combines magnitude normalization with three strategies...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RLVR 稀疏奖励与标量加权 teacher KL 蒸馏混合训练中，用神经正切核 (NTK) 分析给出失稳机制：提出跨信号 NTK 统计量 K_DR(n) 度量同一 token 上奖励梯度与蒸馏梯度的对齐，识别出量级淹没（奖励梯度高出若干数量级，即使方向冲突很弱也使蒸馏损失上升）与局部方向冲突（序列级 advantage 与 teacher 逐位置分布在同 token 上给出相反更新，K_DR(n)<0）两种失效模式。梯度范数比 κ=‖∇L_R‖/‖∇L_D‖ 在不同任务间相差约一个数量级，实验显示存在经验阈值，越过它朴素混合会导致持续训练崩溃；据此提出 M3 家族，把量级归一化与三种策略结合。
Motivation: RLVR 只给整条 rollout 一个二值结果、所有 token 共享同一序列级 advantage，监督极稀疏；补上的 teacher KL 项虽提供 token 级稠密引导，但两者在联合优化中的相互作用会破坏训练稳定性，缺少对失稳如何发生的机理刻画。
Method: 对混合 reward–distillation 训练做 NTK 分析，引入 token 级跨信号 NTK K_DR(n) 度量位置 n 处奖励梯度与蒸馏梯度的对齐；由此分解出量级淹没与局部方向冲突两种失效模式，并以梯度范数比 κ=‖∇L_R‖/‖∇L_D‖ 刻画优化体制；最后提出 M3 家族，将量级归一化 (magnitude normalization) 与三种策略组合以缓解上述失效。
Result: κ 在不同任务间相差约一个数量级；实验揭示一个经验阈值，越过该阈值后朴素混合奖励与蒸馏信号会导致持续的训练崩溃 (persistent training collapse)；K_DR(n)<0 被用作局部方向冲突的判据，量级淹没下蒸馏损失即使被显式写进训练目标也会上升。
Conclusion: 混合稀疏奖励与稠密蒸馏的失稳可由梯度量级比与逐 token 方向对齐解释，且存在可判定的阈值；把量级归一化纳入优化（M3 家族）是对抗量级淹没与方向冲突的直接手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can We Trust the Teacher? Decoupled Credit Direction-Magnitude for Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: RLVR provides reliable trajectory-level credit, while OPSD offers dense supervision for token-level credit. This exposes a fundamental coupling when updating step-level credit direction and magnitude with teacher supervision, preventing steps from receiving reliable credit directions and contribution magnitudes, while making both vulnerable to teacher judgment errors and preference variance, as supported by our theoretical analysis. To separate credit direction from its contribution magnitude, we introduce \textit{Decoupled Credit Self-Distillation (DCSD)}, which theoretically decouples credit direction and magnitude into two reliable signals and uses them to calibrate privileged teacher supervision. Specifically, we design belief-margin probing to determine credit direction and marginal information gain to quantify credit magnitude, enabling step-to-token credit assignment for policy optimization. Across 11 benchmarks, DCSD achieves the best overall scores against GRPO, OPSD, RLSD, and RLCSD. Compared with base models, DCSD improves the overall score by 8.45 points on mathematical reasoning and 7.01 points on multimodal reasoning, while correcting the credit direction for 6\% of tokens and yielding a 1.5$\times$ reduction in token credit magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RLVR 与 OPSD 的自蒸馏中，步级 credit 的方向与幅度被耦合，导致教师判断误差和偏好方差同时污染两者。DCSD 用 belief-margin probing 定方向、用 marginal information gain 定幅度，把二者解耦后再校准特权教师监督；11 个基准上整体分优于 GRPO、OPSD、RLSD、RLCSD，数学推理整体分 +8.45、多模态推理 +7.01，纠正 6% token 的 credit 方向并使 token credit 幅度降 1.5×。
Motivation: RLVR 只给轨迹级 credit、OPSD 给 token 级稠密监督，但步级 credit 的方向与幅度在教师监督下相互耦合，使两者都不可靠且易受教师判断误差与偏好方差影响。
Method: 提出 Decoupled Credit Self-Distillation (DCSD)：用 belief-margin probing 判定 credit 方向，用 marginal information gain 量化 credit 幅度，把两个信号解耦后用于校准特权教师监督，并实现 step-to-token credit assignment 供策略优化；解耦的可靠性有理论分析支撑。
Result: 在 11 个基准上 DCSD 取得最佳整体分，对比 GRPO、OPSD、RLSD、RLCSD；相对 base model，数学推理整体分提升 8.45 点，多模态推理提升 7.01 点；纠正 6% token 的 credit 方向，token credit 幅度降低 1.5×。
Conclusion: 把 credit 方向与幅度解耦成两个可靠信号再校准教师监督，能在数学与多模态推理上同时改善策略优化的 credit 质量与整体得分。

papers.title: Context-dependent time-series prediction via HyperReservoirs
papers.abstract_en: Time series prediction is a common application of reservoir computing. When the training and testing time series data contains multiple dynamical regimes, because an underlying parameter is changing, or the data in fact consists of multiple distinct systems, simple application of the reservoir computing principle produces high prediction errors. Here, we propose a HyperReservoir as an extended model of reservoir computing especially designed for such cases. The HyperReservoir combines a main reservoir with a smaller context reservoir, where the latter modulates the output weights of the former. This structure resembles the hypernetworks from deep neural network literature. However, in contrast, HyperReservoirs retain the simple training via linear regression of standard reservoir computing. We compare the proposed architecture with a conventional ESN, in which context acts at the input, and a full-matrix Conceptor, in which context modulates the reservoir state space. We evaluate all three models on time-series prediction tasks based on Lorenz and Rössler systems, including for varying bifurcation parameters and time sampling scales. We find that the HyperReservoir achieves the lowest mean test error in all three tasks, and particularly outperforms conceptors on data that is sampled from the same attractor but at different time scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HyperReservoir：用一个较小的 context reservoir 调制主 reservoir 的输出权重，使标准 reservoir computing 在多动力学机制、参数时变的序列上仍保持线性回归训练。在 Lorenz 与 Rössler 系统的三项预测任务（含分岔参数变化与不同时间采样尺度）上，HyperReservoir 平均测试误差均为三者最低，尤其在同吸引子、不同时间采样尺度的数据上明显优于 full-matrix Conceptor。
Motivation: 当训练与测试序列跨越多个动力学机制、底层参数变化或数据实为多个系统时，直接套用标准 reservoir computing 会产生很高的预测误差。
Method: HyperReservoir 由主 reservoir 加一个更小的 context reservoir 组成，后者调制前者的输出权重（结构类似 hypernetwork），但训练仍只用标准 reservoir computing 的线性回归。对比对象为 context 作用于输入的常规 ESN，以及 context 调制 reservoir 状态空间的 full-matrix Conceptor。
Result: 在基于 Lorenz 与 Rössler 系统的三项时间序列预测任务上（含变化的分岔参数与不同时间采样尺度），HyperReservoir 在全部三项任务中取得最低平均测试误差；在同吸引子但不同时间采样尺度的数据上尤其优于 conceptors。
Conclusion: 把 context 信息用于调制输出权重而非输入或状态空间，可在保留线性回归训练简单性的同时，最有效地应对多机制与时标变化的序列预测。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把 context 信息用于调制输出权重而非输入或状态空间，可在保留线性回归训练简单性的同时，最有效地应对多机制与时标变化的序列预测。

papers.title: ORAV: Benchmarking Audio-Video Generation from Multimodal Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Audio-video generation using heterogeneous multimodal references has emerged as a new challenge, requiring both compositional control over generation and grounded understanding of multimodal context. In this paper, we introduce ORAV Bench for Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation, comprising 380 task instances with 2-10 references, 9 semantic roles, and 30 role compositions. Instructions specify the relationships among references; the media supply the identities, dynamics, and audio characteristics to be realized. To evaluate these open-ended outputs, we develop a reference-aware pairwise protocol that prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares the intended contribution of each reference, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders. On held-out instances, it achieves 86.08% effective agreement with human judgments. Across 5 frontier systems, overall rankings conceal distinct strengths across reference compositions. A recurring failure is to reproduce unintended source content in place of the requested result, despite closely resembling a reference. Reproducible pointwise diagnostics of quality, reference affinity, and speech reveal distinct dimensions of model behavior. ORAV thus offers a benchmark for tracking progress toward controllable, compositional, and reference-faithful audio-video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORAV Bench 提出面向多模态参考的音视频生成基准，含 380 个任务实例、每例 2–10 个参考、9 种语义角色与 30 种角色组合，并配参考感知的成对评测协议。该协议在留出实例上与人类判断达成 86.08% 有效一致；对 5 个前沿系统的评测显示总体排名会掩盖各参考组合下的差异，常见失败是复现参考中未被要求的源内容。
Motivation: 用异构多模态参考做音视频生成需要同时实现组合控制与对上下文的落地理解，而开放式输出缺少能逐参考核对贡献、可复现的评测手段。
Method: 构建 ORAV Bench（380 个任务实例，2–10 个参考，9 种语义角色，30 种角色组合），指令规定参考间关系，媒体提供身份、动态与音频特征；评测用参考感知成对协议，准备视觉与听觉证据、比较每个参考的预期贡献，并在两种呈现顺序下核对总体判定，另给出质量、参考亲和度与语音的逐点诊断。
Result: 协议在留出实例上与人类判断有效一致率 86.08%；在 5 个前沿系统上，总体排名掩盖了不同参考组合下的各自优势，并反复出现复现未被要求的参考源内容这一失败模式。
Conclusion: 可控、可组合、忠于参考的音视频生成需要用逐参考核对且顺序稳健的评测来跟踪进展，总体单一排名不足以刻画模型行为。

papers.title: QiYao-M: Multimodal Time Series Foundation Model with Role-Aware Modeling of Endogenous and Exogenous Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Existing multimodal time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically model heterogeneous modalities through largely shared mechanisms, overlooking the distinct forecasting roles of endogenous and exogenous modalities. In this work, we propose QiYao-M, a role-aware multimodal TSFM that models the two types of modalities separately. For endogenous modalities, to capture how they evolve along with the underlying temporal dynamics, we introduce an Endo-Multimodal Predictor and Endo-Multimodal Supervision to explicitly learn their evolution from history to the future. For exogenous modalities, to generalize across domains and across various modality types and numbers under the scarcity of exo-multimodal pretraining data, we propose an Exo-Multimodal Retrieval Enhancer that enables rapid downstream adaptation without updating the TSFM parameters. We further introduce Endo-Modality Proxy Training to train this retrieval module without exogenous multimodal pretraining data. Extensive experiments across unimodal and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate strong forecasting performance in scenarios both with and without exogenous modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QiYao-M 把多模态时间序列里的内生 (endogenous) 与外生 (exogenous) 模态分开建模：内生模态用 Endo-Multimodal Predictor 与 Endo-Multimodal Supervision 显式学习从历史到未来的演化，外生模态用 Exo-Multimodal Retrieval Enhancer 在不更新 TSFM 参数的前提下快速适配下游。在单模态与多模态基准上，含外生与不含外生两种场景都取得强预测表现。
Motivation: 现有大多模态时间序列基础模型用基本共享的机制处理异质模态，忽略了内生与外生模态在预测中扮演的不同角色，且外生多模态预训练数据稀缺，难以跨领域、跨模态类型与数量泛化。
Method: 内生侧引入 Endo-Multimodal Predictor 与 Endo-Multimodal Supervision，显式学习内生模态从历史到未来的演化；外生侧提出 Exo-Multimodal Retrieval Enhancer，推理时检索增强、不更新 TSFM 参数即可适配下游；检索模块用 Endo-Modality Proxy Training 在没有外生多模态预训练数据的条件下训练。
Result: 在单模态与多模态基准上的大量实验显示，含外生模态与不含外生模态两种场景均取得强预测性能。
Conclusion: 按内生/外生角色分开建模，并用代理训练的检索增强替代外生多模态预训练，可以在数据稀缺下同时覆盖有无外生模态的预测场景。

papers.title: Nociception as a Control Primitive: Afferent Channels and Nociceptive Memory for Agents Deployed in One Body
papers.abstract_en: An agent deployed in a single body cannot learn how fast that body wears, because every trial that would reveal its wear resistance wears the body it would protect. We study this \emph{epoch-one} setting, in which the parameters of a fixed-weight policy are set before the body is drawn and never updated in life. The agent carries a load-gated nociceptive channel and a memory that retains what was felt. We prove that felt cost moves the allocation to the best-\emph{paid} work not yet felt rather than the gentlest, that an agent without retention never sees the felt-cost constraint bind, and that the channel pays only where the threat is individually unpredictable, cheap to avoid and expensive to ignore. We measure per body, setting the agent with channel and memory against the same individual without them, where neither carries a schedule learned across lives. On $2{,}000$ simulated floor-layer knees, with wear anchored to published loss rates, feeling, retaining and substituting extends the working life from age $55.2$ to $59.6$ and raises career output from $33.7$ to $36.1$. $69.3\%$ of bodies gain and \textbf{none lose}. A body that feels but retains nothing past the day gains one of the $+4.4$ years, and retention carries the rest. A population-trained agent gains $+0.65$ years from the same channel at $-0.54$ output. The difference is what a species prior already supplies, and a single body has none. The two are related by an identity, the ablation mean reporting $(1-χ)$ of the per-body value with $χ$ the share a blind schedule already captures, so we report both. Where the regime map predicts value, a care robot sextuples its certified service life and a field-anchored fleet writes off $0.15$ of its machines instead of $0.55$. Where it predicts none, a rover gains little over blind caution, so the map holds in both directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定权重、单次身体的 epoch-one 设定下，带负载门控伤害感受通道 (load-gated nociceptive channel) 与保留所感记忆的智能体，会把资源分配到尚未被感受过的最高报酬工作而非最温和的工作。2000 个模拟铺地工膝关节上，感受+保留+替代把工作年限从 55.2 提到 59.6、职业产出从 33.7 提到 36.1，69.3% 的身体获益且无一受损；只感受不跨日保留只拿到 +4.4 年中的一部分，其余来自记忆。
Motivation: 单身体智能体无法通过试错学习自身磨损速度，因为每次揭示耐磨性的试验都在消耗它本要保护的那个身体；跨生命学习的调度对它不可用。
Method: 设定固定权重策略在身体抽样前定好、终生不更新；智能体携带负载门控伤害感受通道与保留所感的记忆，与同个体但无通道无记忆的对照逐身体比较，双方都不用跨生命学到的调度。磨损锚定到已发表的损失率，用一个 regime map 预测通道何时有价值，并以恒等式把逐身体价值与盲调度已捕获的份额 (1-χ) 关联起来。
Result: 2000 个模拟铺地工膝关节上，感受、保留与替代使工作年限 55.2 → 59.6、职业产出 33.7 → 36.1，69.3% 的身体获益且 none lose；只感受不跨日保留仅得到 +4.4 年中的一部分，其余由记忆承担。群体训练的智能体从同一通道只获 +0.65 年且产出 -0.54。regime map 预测有价值处：护理机器人认证服务寿命翻六倍 (sextuples)，现场锚定机队报废 0.15 而非 0.55 的机器；预测无价值处：rover 相对盲目谨慎几乎无增益。
Conclusion: 伤害感受作为控制原语的价值来自记忆而非感受本身，且只在威胁个体不可预测、规避便宜、忽视昂贵时才回本；群体训练智能体的增益可由物种先验解释，单身体没有这个先验。regime map 在有值与无值两个方向都成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DivOPD: Spread Wide, Look Close for Asynchronous On-Policy Distillation of Multi-turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student agents through teacher supervision on their own interactions with an environment. However, in asynchronous multi-turn training, arrival-order batching can allow a few early or long rollouts to dominate learner updates while other valid rollouts become stale before being used, wasting already-generated experience. To address this problem, we introduce DivOPD, a simple learner-side batch-selection method that spreads a fixed turn budget across more rollouts and, within each rollout, prioritizes turns with larger cumulative teacher-student disagreement. Turns without usable teacher feedback are excluded. The per-turn loss and optimizer remain fixed; selection only changes which student-visited turns receive training weight. For no-progress rollouts, an optional extension briefly hands control to the teacher before returning it to the student. Across six teacher-student settings on the simulated ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop benchmarks, with 1.5B-7B students, DivOPD raises cross-setting mean peak success rate from 77.4 to 84.4 and mean success over the last five evaluations from 71.5 to 78.6. It reaches all reported setting-specific targets with geometric-mean speedups of 1.84x in training tokens and 1.87x in learner GPU time relative to vanilla OPD. Teacher intervention further raises this last-five mean to 82.4 while retaining about 1.7x learner-GPU speedup over vanilla OPD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HanyangWang0418-oss/DivOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DivOPD 是面向多轮智能体异步 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 的学习端批选择方法：在固定轮次预算下把训练摊到更多 rollout，并在单个 rollout 内优先选师生累计分歧更大的 turn，无可用教师反馈的 turn 直接排除，损失与优化器保持不变。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 六组师生设定（1.5B–7B 学生）上，跨设定平均峰值成功率从 77.4 升到 84.4，最后五次评估均值从 71.5 升到 78.6，训练 token 与学习者 GPU 时间几何平均加速 1.84x 与 1.87x。
Motivation: 异步多轮训练中按到达顺序组批会让少数早到或超长 rollout 主导更新，其余有效 rollout 在被用到之前已过期，浪费已生成的经验。
Method: 学习端批选择：固定 turn 预算摊到更多 rollout，rollout 内按师生累计分歧 (cumulative teacher-student disagreement) 排序优先选 turn，排除无可用教师反馈的 turn；per-turn 损失与优化器不变，只改变哪些 student 访问过的 turn 获得训练权重。可选扩展对无进展 rollout 短暂交权给教师再交还学生 (teacher intervention)。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 六组师生设定、1.5B–7B 学生上：跨设定平均峰值成功率 77.4 → 84.4，最后五次评估平均成功率 71.5 → 78.6；达到全部设定特定目标，相对 vanilla OPD 的训练 token 几何平均加速 1.84x、学习者 GPU 时间 1.87x。加入 teacher intervention 后最后五次均值进一步升到 82.4，同时保留约 1.7x 学习者 GPU 加速。
Conclusion: 在异步 OPD 中按师生分歧选择训练 turn 并摊开 rollout 预算，可以在不改损失与优化器的前提下同时提高多轮智能体成功率与训练效率；对无进展 rollout 交权给教师还能再抬一档。
Relevance: 2
