papers.title: MW-Nowcast: Six-hour ensemble nowcasting of extreme precipitation
papers.abstract_en: Extending reliable nowcasting of extreme precipitation could provide critical additional time for warnings and emergency response during high-impact events such as flash floods. Radar-based generative machine-learning models have enabled skilful hyperlocal precipitation nowcasting, but accurate prediction of intense precipitation remains confined to the first few hours. Because storm-scale structure is predictable for longer than individual cells, a natural strategy is to predict that structure while generatively modelling only the uncertain local growth, decay, reorganisation and initiation of storms. Here we present Microsoft Weather Nowcast (MW-Nowcast), a six-hour ensemble radar nowcasting model that jointly learns a deterministic predictor to capture organised precipitation structure shared across ensemble members, and a generator to produce diverse local residuals around this shared prediction. Across independent test data from the United States, Europe and China, MW-Nowcast achieves higher detection skill than leading methods for heavy and extreme precipitation throughout the 6 h horizon. For the most intense rainfall, MW-Nowcast doubles the available warning time across all three regions, delivering 6 h forecasts with skill previously limited to 3 h for the leading generative baseline. A cost-loss decision analysis shows that MW-Nowcast retains substantial value for a broad range of applications even at 4-6 h, where alternative methods offer little benefit. These additional hours can give forecasters and emergency managers the time to warn and act before extreme rainfall strikes, helping to protect lives and property.

papers.title: Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression
papers.abstract_en: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TALF 把属性变换直接作用在学到的空间表示上，使特征与编码目标在变换域对齐，从而精确表示光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项且 Taylor 余项有界。集成进带显式系数预测与条件残差熵模型的变换域编码器后，在三个基准数据集与多种变换基上，率失真性能优于传统与学习型基线。
Motivation: 变换域点云属性压缩中，把空间表示映射到变换域这一已知基变换常留给网络隐式学习，导致学到的上下文与编码目标不对齐。
Method: 提出 Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF)：对学到的空间表示施加属性变换，显式对齐编码目标；集成进变换域属性 codec，含显式系数预测、条件残差熵建模，统一在 coefficient-domain 率失真目标下优化，并保留显式量化步长控制。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 数据集、多种变换基上，TALF 的率失真性能优于传统与学习型基线；理论分析表明所得特征精确表示光滑非线性模型的一阶预测项，Taylor 余项有界。
Conclusion: 把基变换显式做进网络而非让其隐式学习，可让学到的特征直接充当变换域的一阶预测项，从而提升变换域点云属性压缩的率失真效率。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Semantic Mapping in Urban Environments via Observation Calibration and Policy Dependence Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Semantic mapping is fundamental to embodied navigation, yet existing methods are developed for indoor environments, where objects exhibit relatively limited scale variation and are observed from a restricted range of viewpoints. Urban environments pose substantially greater challenges: agents must map objects ranging from pedestrians to buildings while navigating large spaces with highly diverse viewing distances. These conditions introduce two key difficulties that existing datasets and methods fail to cover. First, object scale and observation distance can be severely mismatched. For example, small objects may be viewed from far away, whereas large objects may be observed at extremely close range, resulting in unreliable observation likelihoods. Second, objects with substantially different sizes and geometries require distinct mapping behaviors, which are difficult to capture with a single shared value estimator. To investigate these challenges, we introduce a large-scale urban semantic mapping dataset featuring realistic city layouts, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level annotations spanning multiple object scales. We then propose a category-aware likelihood calibration policy that identifies and alleviates unreliable observations according to object category and viewing distance. Because the calibration and motion policies are optimized toward the same mapping objective, they may learn redundant shortcuts and become excessively coupled. We therefore introduce a mutual-information (MI) regularizer that penalizes their estimated representation dependence and encourages complementary behaviors. To better model heterogeneous mapping strategies across object scales, we further employ category-wise value estimators. We formulate their joint optimization as a Pareto optimization problem to mitigate conflicting gradients across categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向城市环境的语义映射 (semantic mapping) 提出三件套：按物体类别与观测距离校准观测似然的 category-aware likelihood calibration、用互信息正则惩罚校准策略与运动策略表征依赖的 MI regularizer、以及按类别拆分并按 Pareto 优化的价值估计器。动机是城市中物体尺度与观测距离严重错配会让观测似然不可靠，且单一共享价值估计器无法表达不同尺度物体的差异化映射行为。
Motivation: 现有语义映射方法面向室内，物体尺度变化小、视角受限；城市中行人到建筑的尺度跨度大、观测距离多样，导致尺度-距离错配使观测似然不可靠，且单一共享价值估计器难以刻画不同尺度物体所需的差异化映射行为。
Method: 先构建大规模城市语义映射数据集（真实城市布局、高保真渲染、跨多物体尺度的实例级标注）；再用 category-aware likelihood calibration 按物体类别与观测距离识别并缓解不可靠观测；引入互信息 (MI) 正则惩罚校准策略与运动策略的表征依赖以避免冗余捷径；最后用 category-wise value estimators 并把联合优化形式化为 Pareto 优化以缓解跨类别梯度冲突。
Result: 提出并构建了带实例级多尺度标注的城市语义映射数据集，以及似然校准、MI 依赖正则与 Pareto 化的类别价值估计器这一整套方法；摘要给出的是方法与数据集的提出本身。
Conclusion: 城市语义映射需要按类别与观测距离分别校准观测可靠性，并把校准与运动策略的耦合用互信息约束解开、把跨类别价值冲突交给 Pareto 优化处理，而不是沿用室内那套单一共享估计器。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对块扩散草稿器 (block diffusion drafter) 训练目标与推理时序列级块验证不匹配的问题，提出直接由块验证接受规则推导的 BV loss，以最大化草稿序列的期望接受长度。在 math、code、chat 基准上，对 DFlash 与 DSpark、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B，每次验证调用的平均接受 token 数比交叉熵训练高 13.0–21.0%，且不改动推理流程。
Motivation: 扩散式草稿器已能并行提出多个 token，序列级起草与验证也在演进，但训练目标仍停留在 token 级验证，导致训练优化目标与推理时的块验证机制错位。
Method: BV loss 直接从 block verification 的接受规则推导，把 drafter 训练目标与推理时序列级验证机制对齐，优化对象是整段草稿的期望接受长度而非逐 token 独立损失；推理流程保持不变。
Result: 在 math、code、chat 基准上，BV loss 相对交叉熵训练使 DFlash 与 DSpark（配 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B）每次验证调用的平均接受 token 数提升 13.0–21.0%；同时优于 TV loss 与 LK loss 这类 tokenwise 接受目标，收益在 token verification 与 greedy decoding 下同样成立。
Conclusion: 块扩散草稿器应以与序列级验证对齐的目标训练，而不是逐 token 独立优化；该对齐带来的接受长度收益不依赖于改动推理过程。

papers.title: Structured Neural SDEs for Functional Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Neural Stochastic Differential Equations (Neural SDEs) provide flexible continuous-time generative models, but generic neural drift and diffusion networks are costly to simulate on long horizons and can give unstable gradients when the training signal is a path functional rather than a pointwise observation. We introduce SLiSDE, a family of Neural SDE models built from structured linear stochastic layers. Parallel-in-time simulation is obtained at the layer level, while expressivity is recovered by gated in-flow stacking: previous-layer paths modulate the next layer's latent flow through learned gates. For functional calibration tasks in which rare paths dominate the loss, we add an optional Girsanov tilt that acts as a learned importance sampler with an exact likelihood-ratio correction. We prove well-posedness, a discretisation error bound, validity of the change of measure, and a universality result: the terminal laws of the gated stack are dense in the space of square-integrable laws. Experiments on functional calibration benchmarks show that the structured model outperforms fully neural SDE baselines while retaining parallel-time simulation and stable importance weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SLiSDE：用结构化线性随机层替代通用神经漂移/扩散网络，靠 gated in-flow stacking 恢复表达力，并在稀有路径主导损失的功能校准任务上加 Girsanov tilt 作为带精确似然比修正的学习型重要性采样。在功能校准基准上，该结构化模型优于 fully neural SDE 基线，同时保持并行时间模拟与稳定的重要性权重。
Motivation: 通用神经漂移与扩散网络在长时域上模拟代价高，且当训练信号是路径泛函而非逐点观测时梯度不稳定；稀有路径主导损失的功能校准任务尤其受影响。
Method: SLiSDE 由结构化线性随机层构成，在层内实现 parallel-in-time 模拟；用 gated in-flow stacking 让前一层路径经学习门控调制下一层潜流以恢复表达力；对稀有路径主导的任务加入可选 Girsanov tilt，作为带精确似然比修正的学习型重要性采样。理论上证明 well-posedness、离散化误差界、测度变换有效性，以及 gated stack 终端分布在平方可积分布空间中的稠密性 (universality)。
Result: 在功能校准基准 (functional calibration benchmarks) 上，结构化模型优于 fully neural SDE 基线，并同时保持并行时间模拟与稳定的重要性权重；摘要给出四类理论结果（well-posedness、离散化误差界、测度变换有效性、universality 稠密性），未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 结构化线性随机层加门控堆叠可以在长时域上以并行模拟取得可用表达力，配合 Girsanov tilt 解决路径泛函损失下的梯度与重要性权重问题。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: SLiSDE 由结构化线性随机层构成，在层内实现 parallel-in-time 模拟；用 gated in-flow stacking 让前一层路径经学习门控调制下一层潜流以恢复表达力；对稀有路径主导的任务加入可选 Girsanov tilt，作为带精确似然比修正的学习型重要性采样。理论上证明 well-posedness、离散化误差界、测度变换有效性，以及 gated stack 终端分布在平方可积分布空间中的稠密性 (universality)。
summary_sections.result: 在功能校准基准 (functional calibration benchmarks) 上，结构化模型优于 fully neural SDE 基线，并同时保持并行时间模拟与稳定的重要性权重；摘要给出四类理论结果（well-posedness、离散化误差界、测度变换有效性、universality 稠密性），未给出具体数值指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结构化线性随机层加门控堆叠可以在长时域上以并行模拟取得可用表达力，配合 Girsanov tilt 解决路径泛函损失下的梯度与重要性权重问题。

papers.title: Simulating Respondents, Not Single Questions: Coherent Survey Generation with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate response distributions in social surveys. Prior work has achieved accurate population-level simulation for individual questions. Real questionnaires, however, ask each respondent a sequence of related questions. A simulated respondent should show coherent preferences across the whole questionnaire, not merely accurate distributions for isolated items. Existing single-item methods cannot accurately reproduce how the same person answers a complete survey. We propose FullRespondent-LLM (FR-LLM), which fine-tunes two specialized LLMs: a marginal model for each item's response distribution and a respondent-level autoregressive model for dependencies across answers. Marginal-Constrained Joint Projection (MCJP) then projects the autoregressive joint distribution onto the set satisfying the item-level marginals learned by the first model. This yields complete questionnaires with realistic cross-item relationships while retaining strong item-level accuracy. On two real-world social survey datasets, FR-LLM more accurately reproduces multi-question response patterns, maintains competitive single-item accuracy, and generalizes better to unseen populations and questions. In a small commercial-survey dataset, we use simulated responses to make pricing and stocking decisions; FR-LLM achieves the highest realized profit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FullRespondent-LLM (FR-LLM)，微调两个专用 LLM——逐题边际分布模型与受访者级自回归模型，再用 Marginal-Constrained Joint Projection (MCJP) 把联合分布投影到满足逐题边际约束的集合，从而生成整份问卷而非孤立题目。在两个真实社会调查数据集上，FR-LLM 更准确复现跨题作答模式、保持有竞争力的单题精度，并对未见人群与题目泛化更好；在小型商业调查数据集上用模拟回答做定价与库存决策，实现利润最高。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 调查模拟只做单题层面的总体分布对齐，无法复现同一受访者在整份问卷上的连贯偏好，而真实问卷是同一人连续回答一组相关问题。
Method: FR-LLM 微调两个专用 LLM：一个建模每题的边际响应分布，另一个是受访者级自回归模型捕捉跨题依赖；随后用 Marginal-Constrained Joint Projection (MCJP) 将自回归联合分布投影到满足第一模型学到的逐题边际约束的集合上，生成完整问卷。
Result: 在两个真实社会调查数据集上，FR-LLM 更准确复现多题作答模式，单题精度保持竞争力，并对未见人群和未见题目泛化更好；在小型商业调查数据集上以模拟回答支持定价与库存决策，FR-LLM 获得最高实现利润。
Conclusion: 整份问卷的连贯性要靠联合分布与逐题边际约束同时满足才能保住，单题分布对齐不足以复现真实受访者的跨题依赖。

papers.title: WM-VLM: Probing Internal World Models for Interleaved Visual-Textual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Humans often solve spatial problems by mentally simulating visual transformations. In contrast, conventional vision-language models (VLMs) reason primarily through language. We investigate whether VLMs can solve spatial problems by reasoning with both text and generated visual states. To this end, we introduce WM-VLM, which equips a pretrained VLM with a lightweight world model branch for generating intermediate visual states. Our two-stage training first teaches the model to generate the next visual state and then to use that state for reasoning. We programmatically construct spatial reasoning tasks with verifiable intermediate visual states. These tasks allow us to evaluate how well the model generates visual states and how much it relies on them to answer the question. On 2D and 3D mental rotation tasks, WM-VLM consistently outperforms the supervised fine-tuned backbone, with gains of up to 39.25 percentage points. Ablations suggest that these gains depend on the generated visual states, as removing or corrupting them sharply reduces performance. Together, these results suggest that internal world models offer a promising path toward VLMs that reason in both language and visual space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WM-VLM 给预训练 VLM 外挂一个轻量 world model 分支生成中间视觉状态，两阶段训练先学生成下一视觉状态、再学用该状态推理。在程序化构造、中间状态可验证的 2D 与 3D 心理旋转任务上，它一致优于监督微调的 backbone，最高提升 39.25 个百分点；消融显示移除或破坏生成的视觉状态会使性能骤降。
Motivation: VLM 解空间问题时几乎全靠语言链推理，缺少人类那种在脑中模拟视觉变换的中间表征，导致空间推理受限。
Method: 在预训练 VLM 上加轻量 world model 分支生成中间视觉状态；两阶段训练：先学生成下一视觉状态，再学用该状态回答问题。任务由程序化方式构造，中间视觉状态可验证，从而可分别度量状态生成质量与模型对状态的依赖程度。
Result: 在 2D 与 3D mental rotation 任务上一致超过 supervised fine-tuned backbone，最高增益达 39.25 个百分点；消融中移除或破坏生成的视觉状态后性能急剧下降。
Conclusion: 内部 world model 让 VLM 同时在语言与视觉空间中推理是一条可行路径，且性能增益确实依赖生成的视觉状态而非纯语言链。

papers.title: Gaussian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian neural networks (GaNNs) are proposed as a novel regularization mechanism for neural networks. From a Bayesian perspective standard regularization techniques can be viewed as imposing priors over weight-space. Assuming priors over activation-space remains a largely unexplored possibility. GaNNs assume such priors. They do this by treating activities from earlier layers like signals with Gaussian noise and predicting the properties of the noise distribution using an additional unsupervised loss. While training, the unsupervised loss acts as a penalty on unexpected activities, allowing greater weight updates in less surprising directions. The paper demonstrates the superiority of Gaussian neural networks over standard neural networks on a variety of classification and regression tasks. We also investigate the ability of GaNNs to quantify uncertainty.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Extended abstract and poster to be presented at ICONIP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gaussian neural networks (GaNN)，把前层激活当作带高斯噪声的信号，用额外的无监督损失在线预测噪声分布性质，训练时该损失对“意外”激活施加惩罚，使权重更新在不意外的方向上更大。作者称其在多种分类与回归任务上优于标准神经网络，并考察了不确定性量化能力。
Motivation: 从贝叶斯视角看，标准正则化等价于在权重空间加先验，而激活空间上的先验基本未被探索；GaNN 要补上这一空白，作为新的正则化机制。
Method: 把前层活动视作含高斯噪声的信号，用一个额外的无监督损失预测噪声分布的性质；训练中该损失作为对意外活动的惩罚，允许在不意外方向上做更大的权重更新。
Result: 在多种分类与回归任务上，GaNN 被作者演示优于标准神经网络；同时研究了 GaNN 的不确定性量化能力（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 在激活空间而非仅权重空间施加先验，可作为一种有效的正则化手段，并可用于不确定性量化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Residual Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Under a shared-factor model, the conditional law of the next image patch factors into a posterior over the shared scene factor and a residual kernel given that factor. A sufficient statistic of the past replaces the raw past in the posterior and does not replace the kernel. The conditional entropy splits into residual entropy, which no observation of the factor can remove, and a posterior term, which a better representation of the past can remove. Next-embedding prediction is a directional likelihood on a shallow map, so the fiber of that map is unidentified and a constant embedding remains a minimizer. The same split is an equality in a scalar Gaussian model, evaluated in closed form.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享因子模型下，把下一图像块的条件分布分解为共享场景因子的后验与给定该因子的残差核，用充分统计量替代原始历史进入后验但不进入核。条件熵随之拆成残差熵（任何对因子的观测都去不掉）与后验项（更好的历史表示可以去掉），并指出下一 embedding 预测是浅映射上的方向性似然，其纤维不可辨识、常数 embedding 仍是极小点。
Motivation: 下一图像块预测中，历史表示的改进到底能压掉多少不确定性、哪部分根本压不掉，缺少可分解的理论刻画；同时 next-embedding 目标存在不可辨识的退化解。
Method: 在共享因子模型下做条件分布分解：充分统计量替代原始历史进入后验、不进入残差核；对条件熵做残差熵与后验项的拆分；分析 next-embedding 预测作为浅映射上方向性似然的纤维不可辨识性，并在标量高斯模型中给出闭式等式验证。
Result: 条件熵精确拆分为不可约的残差熵与可由更好历史表示消除的后验项；该拆分在标量高斯模型中以闭式等式成立；next-embedding 预测的纤维不可辨识，常数 embedding 是一个极小点。
Conclusion: 历史表示的改进只能消除后验项那部分不确定性，残差熵不可约；要避免常数 embedding 退化解，需要处理浅映射纤维带来的不可辨识性。

papers.title: Accelerator Choice Is Not Enough: AlphaFold2 Inference on Cloud TPUs
papers.abstract_en: AlphaFold2 is written in JAX, so the same inference code compiles and runs unchanged on CPUs, GPUs and Google Cloud TPUs. That portability makes the accelerator look like the main decision a user has to make. We show that it is not. Running one AlphaFold2 inference workload across a Colab CPU runtime, an NVIDIA T4 GPU and a dedicated eight-chip Cloud TPU v5e slice, we find a large hardware advantage for the TPU, 0.47 s per call in steady state on a single chip against 13.1 s on the T4 in the same measurement campaign, and three ways in which the software layer decides how much of it a user actually gets. The default execution path uses one chip of the eight, and at list prices the idle capacity makes the slice cost about as much per prediction as the GPU. Batching with jax.vmap never exceeds single-query throughput, while mapping queries across chips with jax.pmap gives eight chips 6.5-7.9x the throughput of one on a matched grid; automatic sharding leaves the per-chip footprint unchanged, consistent with replication, most plausibly because AlphaFold2 carries no sharding annotations. Our retained trace analysis of a first call at a new input shape reports about three quarters of the traced span in JAX tracing and compilation rather than execution. Reruns five weeks later reproduced neither cloud baseline, the GPU one off by roughly a factor of two, so the hardware ratio above is specific to one campaign.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/lorenzopazienza/alphafold-tpu-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlphaFold2 的 JAX 推理代码在 CPU/GPU/Cloud TPU 上可原样运行，但加速器选择本身不决定实际收益：单芯片 TPU v5e 稳态每次调用 0.47 s，T4 为 13.1 s，而默认路径只用八芯片 slice 中的一片，按标价算每预测成本与 GPU 相当。用 jax.pmap 跨芯片映射查询可让八芯片达到单芯片 6.5–7.9 倍吞吐，jax.vmap 批处理则始终不超过单查询吞吐。
Motivation: JAX 的可移植性让用户误以为选加速器就是主要决策，但软件层（默认执行路径、批处理与跨芯片映射、自动分片）决定了用户实际拿到多少硬件优势，且云基线复现不稳定。
Method: 在同一测量活动中跑同一 AlphaFold2 推理负载，对比 Colab CPU、NVIDIA T4 与专用八芯片 Cloud TPU v5e slice；分别考察默认路径、jax.vmap 批处理、jax.pmap 跨芯片映射与自动分片行为，并对新输入形状的首次调用做保留 trace 分析。
Result: 单芯片 TPU v5e 稳态每次调用 0.47 s，T4 为 13.1 s；默认路径只用八芯片中的一片，按标价该 slice 每预测成本与 GPU 相当；jax.pmap 让八芯片达到单芯片 6.5–7.9 倍吞吐，jax.vmap 从不超过单查询吞吐，自动分片使每芯片占用不变（符合复制，可能因 AlphaFold2 无 sharding 标注）；首次调用 trace 约四分之三耗在 JAX tracing 与编译而非执行；五周后重跑两个云基线均未复现，GPU 基线偏差约 2 倍。
Conclusion: 硬件比值只属于单次测量活动，要拿到 TPU 的算力优势必须同时改执行路径与跨芯片映射，仅换加速器不够。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: AlphaFold2 的 JAX 推理代码在 CPU/GPU/Cloud TPU 上可原样运行，但加速器选择本身不决定实际收益：单芯片 TPU v5e 稳态每次调用 0.47 s，T4 为 13.1 s，而默认路径只用八芯片 slice 中的一片，按标价算每预测成本与 GPU 相当。用 jax.pmap 跨芯片映射查询可让八芯片达到单芯片 6.5–7.9 倍吞吐，jax.vmap 批处理则始终不超过单查询吞吐。

summary_sections.method: 在同一测量活动中跑同一 AlphaFold2 推理负载，对比 Colab CPU、NVIDIA T4 与专用八芯片 Cloud TPU v5e slice；分别考察默认路径、jax.vmap 批处理、jax.pmap 跨芯片映射与自动分片行为，并对新输入形状的首次调用做保留 trace 分析。
summary_sections.result: 单芯片 TPU v5e 稳态每次调用 0.47 s，T4 为 13.1 s；默认路径只用八芯片中的一片，按标价该 slice 每预测成本与 GPU 相当；jax.pmap 让八芯片达到单芯片 6.5–7.9 倍吞吐，jax.vmap 从不超过单查询吞吐，自动分片使每芯片占用不变（符合复制，可能因 AlphaFold2 无 sharding 标注）；首次调用 trace 约四分之三耗在 JAX tracing 与编译而非执行；五周后重跑两个云基线均未复现，GPU 基线偏差约 2 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 硬件比值只属于单次测量活动，要拿到 TPU 的算力优势必须同时改执行路径与跨芯片映射，仅换加速器不够。

papers.title: ESTHER: Egocentric Stereo Hand Estimation and Reconstruction in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Human dexterity is guided by two eyes watching two hands: binocular vision supplies the metric 3D structure that fine-grained manipulation consumes. Egocentric stereo is therefore the natural perceptual interface for robots, AR, and VR-yet metric 3D hand reconstruction from this very signal still has neither an end-to-end model nor an in-the-wild benchmark. We propose ESTHER, a model whose stereo geometry, temporal reasoning, and output representation are designed for wearable egocentric stereo. It is trained on pseudo-labels from a calibrated labeling pipeline and in turn assembles our benchmark ESTHER3D, an egocentric stereo hand dataset pairing a large in-the-wild training set of model-generated labels with a motion capture test set of true metric ground truth. Experiments show state-of-the-art accu?racy, superior external generalization, and robustness to the missing views, dropped frames, and lighting and motion blur extremes of real egocentric capture that break existing meth?ods. This robustness runs deeper than graceful degradation: stereo guidance teaches the model to bind apparent hand scale to metric depth, so it not only adapts to different stereo rigs and modalities with minimal fine-tuning, but more strikingly preserves true metric scale even after collapsing to a single monocular view.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ESTHER 提出首个面向可穿戴双目 egocentric 的端到端手部度量 3D 重建模型，用标定伪标签流水线训练并构建 ESTHER3D 数据集（野外训练集 + 动捕度量真值测试集）。实验达到 SOTA 精度与更强外部泛化，且在缺视角、丢帧、光照与运动模糊极端条件下保持稳健；双目监督让模型把表观手尺度绑定到度量深度，退化为单目视图后仍保留真实度量尺度。
Motivation: 双目视觉本可提供精细操作所需的度量 3D 结构，但 egocentric stereo 信号的度量 3D 手部重建既无端到端模型，也缺少野外 (in-the-wild) 基准。
Method: ESTHER 模型针对可穿戴 egocentric stereo 设计立体几何、时序推理与输出表示；用标定的伪标签流水线 (calibrated labeling pipeline) 训练，并据此组装 ESTHER3D 数据集——大野外训练集配模型生成标签，测试集为动捕 (motion capture) 度量真值。
Result: 实验显示 SOTA 精度、更优外部泛化，以及对真实 egocentric 采集中的缺视角、丢帧、光照与运动模糊极端条件的稳健性，这些条件会破坏现有方法；模型经最少微调即可适配不同立体装置与模态，且在退化为单目视图后仍保留真实度量尺度。
Conclusion: 双目引导不只是优雅降级，而是让模型学到表观尺度到度量深度的绑定，因此度量尺度可在单目退化下延续。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Polylogarithmic Nash Regret in Matrix Games with Bandit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study Nash regret minimization in unknown finite matrix games with bandit payoff feedback and observed opponent actions. We develop Optimistic Payoff Balancing (OPB), which achieves instance-dependent $\mathcal{O}(\log^2 T)$ Nash regret against arbitrary adaptive opponents, including games with nonunique equilibria. This resolves the open problem posed by Maiti et al. (2025), extending their polylogarithmic guarantee under bandit feedback from $2\times2$ games to arbitrary finite dimensions. To handle nonunique equilibria, we construct a reference strategy that leaves room for local adjustments. We order independent payoff differences by estimation accuracy and scale these adjustments by uncertainty, allowing the learner to exploit the opponent's imbalance to offset estimation costs. Our result thus shows that observing opponent actions suffices for polylogarithmic Nash regret in general finite matrix games.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带 bandit 收益反馈且能观测对手动作的未知有限矩阵博弈中，提出 Optimistic Payoff Balancing (OPB)，对任意自适应对手取得实例相关的 O(log²T) Nash regret，即使均衡不唯一。这把 Maiti et al. (2025) 的多项式对数保证从 2×2 博弈推广到任意有限维度。
Motivation: bandit 反馈下一般有限矩阵博弈的多项式对数 Nash regret 此前只在 2×2 情形成立，且非唯一均衡会破坏参考策略的构造，是 Maiti et al. (2025) 留下的公开问题。
Method: OPB 构造一个为局部调整留出空间的参考策略；按估计精度对独立收益差排序，再用不确定性缩放这些调整，使学习者利用对手的不平衡来抵消估计代价。
Result: 对任意自适应对手取得实例相关的 O(log²T) Nash regret，覆盖任意有限维度与非唯一均衡的博弈；结论为观测对手动作即足以在一般有限矩阵博弈中实现多项式对数 Nash regret。
Conclusion: 观测对手动作这一额外信息足以把 bandit 反馈下有限矩阵博弈的 Nash regret 从线性量级压到多项式对数，非唯一均衡不再是障碍。

papers.title: UniOPSD: Unifying Outcome and Hindsight Feedback for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach to training language model agents, but sparse and delayed outcome rewards provide limited guidance for credit assignment across long interaction sequences. Recent work on on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers complementary supervision by evaluating a policy's sampled responses under privileged training-time context. However, our diagnostics show that positive average agreement between outcome and hindsight feedback coexists with substantial local disagreement, raising the question of how to allocate influence between them at each decision. We introduce UniOPSD (Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation), which unifies these feedback sources through adaptive local credit arbitration. UniOPSD constructs comparable credit estimates from environmental returns and successful-peer hindsight at shared interaction anchors. Historical agreement determines the global mixing level, while current signal availability and relative precision adjust each source's influence at individual decisions. The episode-level outcome contribution is retained, and bounded token modulation refines the fused step credit for policy optimization. With Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, UniOPSD achieves ALFWorld success rates of $82.8\%$ and $83.6\%$, WebShop success rates of $75.0\%$ and $82.0\%$, and Search-QA aggregate accuracies of $45.3\%$ and $49.8\%$, respectively. On 3B WebShop, UniOPSD improves over SDAR by $7.0$ percentage points. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/Uniopsd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniOPSD 把环境回报 (outcome reward) 与成功同伴的 hindsight 反馈在共享交互锚点上构造成可比的 credit 估计，用历史一致性决定全局混合比例，再按当前信号可用性与相对精度逐决策调节各来源权重，并保留 episode 级回报、加有界 token 调制。在 Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct 上，ALFWorld 成功率达 82.8% 与 83.6%，WebShop 达 75.0% 与 82.0%，Search-QA 聚合准确率 45.3% 与 49.8%；3B WebShop 上比 SDAR 高 7.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 长交互序列上 outcome reward 稀疏且延迟，难以做细粒度 credit assignment；而 OPSD 的 hindsight 反馈虽与 outcome 平均一致，却存在大量局部不一致，如何在每个决策上分配两者影响力是未解问题。
Method: UniOPSD (Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation) 在共享交互锚点上从环境回报与成功同伴 hindsight 构造可比 credit 估计：历史一致性决定全局混合水平，当前信号可用性与相对精度在单个决策上调节各来源影响；保留 episode 级 outcome 贡献，并用有界 token 调制 (bounded token modulation) 修正融合后的步级 credit 用于策略优化。
Result: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 与 7B-Instruct 上：ALFWorld 成功率 82.8% / 83.6%，WebShop 成功率 75.0% / 82.0%，Search-QA 聚合准确率 45.3% / 49.8%；3B WebShop 上比 SDAR 提升 7.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: outcome 与 hindsight 反馈的平均一致性掩盖了局部冲突，按信号可用性与相对精度做自适应局部仲裁即可把两者统一进同一 credit 信号，并在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 上取得上述成功率与准确率。

papers.title: From Perception to Integration: Revisiting the Internal Dynamics of Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer simple visual questions, but often struggle when one question requires several visual judgments. We study this gap with controlled tasks for feature binding, numerosity, spatial relations, and amodal completion, together with a Composite task that combines them. Matched counterfactual image pairs isolate changes in the visual evidence needed to answer. Across four models, direct answers, hidden-state readouts, and state interventions show that the individual judgments can be made without explicit reasoning and that intervening on the corresponding states can affect the answer. During reasoning, the Composite answer becomes decodable from hidden states and usable from shortened traces, often before the model stops on its own. We train a small detector to predict this readiness and stop reasoning at that point. On MMStar and RealWorldQA, this reduces mean reasoning tokens by 79.1% and 74.5%, while average accuracy rises by 3.13 and 3.30 percentage points, respectively. These findings connect the internal development of answer readiness to a practical rule for allocating reasoning computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用受控视觉任务与匹配反事实图像对追踪 VLM 推理中答案就绪态的内部形成：单个视觉判断无需显式推理即可做出，而 Composite 答案在推理过程中逐渐从隐状态变得可解码、可从截短轨迹读出，且常早于模型自行停止。据此训练小型检测器预测就绪时刻并提前截断推理，在 MMStar 与 RealWorldQA 上平均推理 token 分别减少 79.1% 与 74.5%，平均准确率反升 3.13 与 3.30 个百分点。
Motivation: VLM 能答简单视觉问题，但一道题需要多次视觉判断时表现下滑；推理过程内部何时已形成可用答案、何时该停止计算，此前缺少可观测的判据。
Method: 构造 feature binding、numerosity、spatial relations、amodal completion 四类受控任务及组合它们的 Composite 任务，并用匹配反事实图像对隔离答题所需的视觉证据变化；在四个模型上结合直接作答、隐状态读出 (hidden-state readout) 与状态干预 (state intervention) 定位答案就绪态，再训练一个小型检测器预测就绪时刻以触发提前停止推理。
Result: 四个模型上单个判断可不经显式推理完成，干预对应状态会影响答案；Composite 答案在推理中变得可解码并可从截短轨迹使用，且常早于模型自行停止。用检测器提前停止后，MMStar 平均推理 token 减少 79.1%、平均准确率提高 3.13 个百分点，RealWorldQA 分别减少 74.5%、提高 3.30 个百分点。
Conclusion: 答案就绪态在推理内部的形成时刻可以被预测，据此分配推理计算能在大幅削减 token 的同时提高准确率，即更早停止而非跑满轨迹更优。

papers.title: ControlTrace: Recovering Control Fields for Hidden-Content Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Spatially conditioned diffusion models can embed words and contours in natural-looking images, but vision-language models (VLMs) may fail to recognize the hidden content. Transformation-based recovery depends on parameter and view selection. To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition, we construct FreqBlind, a 6,000-image benchmark spanning contours, real words and non-words across three conditioning strengths. The evaluated transformation-based methods show limited recognition of contour patterns and weakly conditioned hidden content. To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace to recover the grayscale control field used during generation. An 8.4M-parameter U-Net predicts this field from the carrier image, and a VLM then identifies its content. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, ControlTrace achieves 60.2% open-ended contour recognition accuracy across the three conditioning strengths, exceeding the best of the three evaluated prior methods by 26.9 percentage points. On an A100 GPU, the complete pipeline adds only 7.4 ms (5.3%) to direct VLM inference. Recovered fields have lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformation views. Across four evaluated VLMs, ControlTrace retains its overall contour recognition advantage. Recognition remains stable under the tested JPEG compression, Gaussian noise and downsampling. These results support control-field recovery for hidden-content recognition in the evaluated setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ControlTrace 从空间条件扩散模型生成的载体图中直接回归出生成时使用的灰度控制场，再交给 VLM 识别其中隐藏的轮廓与文字。在自建的 6,000 张 FreqBlind 基准上，配 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 时三档条件强度的开放轮廓识别准确率达 60.2%，比被评估的三种既有变换式方法中最好的高 26.9 个百分点，A100 上全流程仅增加 7.4 ms（5.3%）。
Motivation: 空间条件扩散模型能把文字和轮廓藏进自然图像，但 VLM 识别不出；现有基于图像变换的恢复依赖参数与视角选择，对轮廓和弱条件隐藏内容识别能力有限。
Method: 提出 ControlTrace：用一个 8.4M 参数的 U-Net 从载体图像预测生成时的灰度控制场，再由 VLM 读取该场识别内容；并构建 FreqBlind 基准，含 6,000 张图，覆盖轮廓、真实词与非词三类内容及三档条件强度。
Result: 配 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 时开放轮廓识别准确率 60.2%（跨三档条件强度），超被评估三种既有方法中最佳者 26.9 个百分点；A100 上全流程相对直接 VLM 推理仅增 7.4 ms（5.3%）；恢复场的像素误差更低、结构相似度高于被评估的变换视角；在四个被评估 VLM 上均保持轮廓识别总体优势，且在所测 JPEG 压缩、高斯噪声与下采样下识别稳定。
Conclusion: 在所评估设定下，直接恢复生成时的控制场比基于变换的恢复更适合隐藏内容识别，且开销接近可忽略。

papers.title: On Temporal Binding in Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning about temporal structure of audio recordings requires Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) to associate sound events with their temporal position. Understanding the underlying mechanisms is a first step toward diagnosing failures and identifying model components that may need improvement. Using mechanistic interpretability, we investigate how temporal information is represented and bound to sound events in three open-source LALMs. We find that across all three, event-specific location becomes concentrated in event name representations at intermediate modality integration layers. These representations encode coarse event position along a low-dimensional, curved relative time trajectory. Steering event name representations along this trajectory systematically shifts before/after beliefs, providing evidence that these representations contribute to coarse temporal reasoning. In contrast, the same interventions do not reliably shift predicted onset timestamps, suggesting that coarse temporal reasoning and precise metric event localization rely on distinct mechanisms.
papers.comment: Repository: https://github.com/OptimusPrimus/icassp2027_temporal_binding This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 检验三个开源大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 如何把声音事件与时间位置绑定：事件的具体位置在中间模态融合层集中到事件名表示上，并沿一条低维弯曲的相对时间轨迹编码粗粒度位置。沿该轨迹引导 (steering) 事件名表示会系统性移动模型的 before/after 判断，但同样干预不能可靠移动预测的 onset 时间戳，说明粗粒度时间推理与精确度量定位依赖不同机制。
Motivation: LALM 对音频时间结构的推理会失败，但其内部如何把时间信息绑定到事件上尚不清楚；先定位承载该信息的模型组件，才能诊断失败并指出需要改进的部件。
Method: 在三个开源 LALM 上做机制可解释性分析：追踪事件位置信息在各层的分布，识别其在中间模态融合层向事件名表示的集中，并对这些表示沿学到的相对时间轨迹做干预 (steering)，观察 before/after 判断与 onset 时间戳预测的变化。
Result: 三个模型一致显示事件位置在中间模态融合层集中于事件名表示，且沿低维弯曲相对时间轨迹编码粗粒度位置；沿轨迹的干预系统性改变 before/after 信念，但对预测的 onset 时间戳无可靠影响。
Conclusion: 事件名表示是粗粒度时间推理的因果载体，而精确的度量级事件定位由另一套机制负责，两者应分开诊断与改进。

papers.title: SIPO: Selective-Inference Policy Optimization for Tree-Structured Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Tree-structured reinforcement learning trains search agents by comparing alternative continuations and propagating terminal rewards to intermediate decisions. Adaptive expansion, however, creates a statistical asymmetry: an incumbent is selected using its own generation statistic, whereas fresh siblings are sampled after selection. When that statistic is associated with return, branch values can reflect selection history as well as continuation quality, even for a shared parent. We propose Selective-Inference Policy Optimization (\SIPO{}), which incorporates this distinction into tree-based credit estimation. Its scale-free branch criterion keeps generation scores and sibling penalties on a consistent relative scale; exchangeable branching supplies multiple fresh continuations from each selected parent; and order-statistic correction adjusts retained incumbent values using selection rank and the estimated score--outcome association. These mechanisms preserve the leaf budget and the host policy optimisation objective. Across seven QA benchmarks using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, \SIPO{} achieves the highest reported multi-hop and single-hop averages among the compared methods. On Qwen3-8B, it improves these averages over AT\textsuperscript{2}PO by $1.31$ and $1.07$ percentage points, respectively, and ranks first on six of seven benchmarks. Component ablations evaluate the individual and combined changes, while early-training paired diagnostics show a selected--fresh value gap alongside a near-zero fresh--fresh reference. Together, these results support accounting for selection history when constructing and evaluating search-agent rollouts. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SIPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIPO 针对树结构 agentic RL 中自适应扩展带来的选择偏差：被保留的 incumbent 用自身生成统计量选出，而新采样的 sibling 在选择之后才产生，导致分支价值混入选择历史。它用无量纲分支准则、可交换分支 (exchangeable branching) 和基于选择秩的 order-statistic 校正来修正信用估计，在 7 个 QA benchmark 上于 Qwen3-8B 上把多跳与单跳平均分比 AT2PO 分别提高 1.31 和 1.07 个百分点。
Motivation: 树搜索式 RL 里自适应扩展造成统计不对称：incumbent 依自身生成统计量被选中，fresh sibling 则在选择后采样；当该统计量与回报相关，同一父节点下的分支价值会同时反映选择历史与延续质量，信用估计因此有偏。
Method: SIPO 把这一区分纳入树上信用估计：无量纲分支准则把生成分数与 sibling 惩罚放在一致的相对尺度上；可交换分支为每个被选父节点提供多条 fresh 延续；order-statistic 校正按选择秩与估计的分数-结果关联调整保留的 incumbent 价值，同时保持 leaf 预算与宿主策略优化目标不变。
Result: 在 7 个 QA benchmark、Qwen3-4B/Qwen3-8B/Qwen2.5-7B 上，SIPO 取得所比方法中最高的多跳与单跳平均分；Qwen3-8B 上相对 AT2PO 分别提升 1.31 和 1.07 个百分点，并在 7 个 benchmark 中的 6 个排第一。组件消融评估单项与组合改动，早期训练的配对诊断显示 selected–fresh 存在价值差而 fresh–fresh 参考接近零。
Conclusion: 构建与评估 search-agent rollout 时必须计入选择历史，否则分支价值会被选择过程污染；SIPO 的三项机制在保持 leaf 预算与宿主目标的前提下修正这一偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Attested Federated Learning: Securing Collaborative Anomaly Detection in Critical Water Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables industrial operators to train shared intrusion detection models without disclosing proprietary operational telemetry. However, existing defenses operate strictly in update space, leaving aggregators blind to data poisoning; model updates derived from fabricated telemetry remain indistinguishable from honest contributions. We repurpose cyber-physical process invariants, such as conservation laws and actuator couplings, from runtime detection heuristics into a verifiable admission requirement for federated updates, mined automatically from clean operational data. We evaluate this admission gate across two physical water testbeds (SWaT, WADI) and a distribution benchmark (BATADAL), testing seven aggregation rules against telemetry fabrication, exposure-only replay poisoning, and an invariant-aware adaptive adversary. Across three testbeds the mined invariants reject none of 100 honest shards and all naively fabricated ones, including optimised perturbations that FoolsGold admits in full. On real telemetry, five mined invariants detect 12 of SWaT's 35 attacks, while nine invariants detect 20, with no honest shard rejected. With nine rules, the physics gate recovers 69--100% of the targeted-attack recall lost to replay poisoning, and 54--100% of that lost to fabricated telemetry, across five standard aggregators. To reconcile physical admission control with federated data privacy, we show invariant compliance using zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) to allow clients to prove batch adherence without revealing operational telemetry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把物理过程不变量（守恒律、执行器耦合）从运行时检测改造成联邦更新的准入门槛，自动从干净运行数据中挖掘不变量，只有通过校验的客户端更新才参与聚合。在 SWaT、WADI、BATADAL 三个测试床上，挖掘出的不变量拒绝 0 个诚实分片、全部拒绝伪造遥测（含 FoldsGold 全盘放行的优化扰动），并用 zk-SNARKs 让客户端证明合规而不泄露遥测。
Motivation: 联邦入侵检测的现有防御只在更新空间操作，聚合器看不到数据投毒：由伪造遥测产生的模型更新与诚实贡献无法区分，关键水基础设施的协作训练因此暴露在投毒风险下。
Method: 从干净运行数据自动挖掘网络物理过程不变量（守恒律、执行器耦合），将其作为联邦更新的可验证准入门槛；在 SWaT、WADI 两个物理水测试床与 BATADAL 分布基准上测试七条聚合规则，对抗遥测伪造、仅暴露重放投毒与不变量感知的自适应对手；用 zk-SNARKs 证明批次合规而不泄露遥测。
Result: 三个测试床上挖掘不变量拒绝 0/100 个诚实分片、拒绝全部朴素伪造更新（含 FoldsGold 完全放行的优化扰动）；真实遥测上 5 条不变量检出 SWaT 35 次攻击中的 12 次，9 条不变量检出 20 次，且无诚实分片被拒；在五个标准聚合器上，物理门恢复因重放投毒损失的目标攻击召回率的 69–100%，因伪造遥测损失的 54–100%。
Conclusion: 把物理不变量作为联邦更新的准入条件，可以在不暴露运行遥测的前提下（配合 zk-SNARKs）让聚合器抵御数据投毒，恢复被投毒攻击压低的目标召回率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Separating personal from population gains when calibrating EEG foundation models for new users
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly adapted to individual users, but an apparent personalization gain can simply reflect a stronger population model. This distinction matters for brain-computer interfaces, where every new user must be calibrated. We evaluated personal adaptation of three frozen EEG foundation models (CBraMod, REVE and LaBraM) in 235 held-out subjects from three motor-imagery datasets, comparing each subject's adapter with the population model and with adapters fitted to other subjects. Using all first-half session labels, personal adapters improved mean balanced accuracy over the population model by 1.5-5.4 percentage points and outperformed exchanged adapters by 2.3-7.3 points in all nine model-dataset combinations. The size of this benefit depended on population training: with four times the original budget, median gains remained positive (1.0-2.0 points) but were smaller for every model, and no population model reached a confirmed plateau. Acquiring the benefit cheaply was unreliable: few-label calibration was consistently non-negative on only one dataset, and in CBraMod neither unlabeled context nor meta-learned initialization outperformed matched controls. Personalization should therefore be evaluated against both a population reference and exchanged parameters, across population-training budgets.
papers.comment: 59 pages, 19 figures (6 main, 13 supplementary), 33 tables (3 main, 30 supplementary). Includes supplementary information and source data. Code: https://github.com/gaivrt/eeg-personal-population-benefit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 235 名留出被试、三个运动想象 (motor imagery) 数据集上评估三个冻结 EEG 基础模型 (CBraMod、REVE、LaBraM) 的个性化适配器：个人适配器相对群体模型的平均平衡准确率提升 1.5–5.4 个百分点，相对交换适配器提升 2.3–7.3 个百分点，九个模型-数据集组合全部成立。但群体训练预算扩到 4 倍后中位增益缩到 1.0–2.0 点，少标签校准与无标签上下文/meta 学习初始化都不可靠，因此个性化必须同时对照群体参考与交换参数、并在多个群体训练预算下评估。
Motivation: EEG 基础模型面向新用户做适配时，表面上的个性化增益可能只是群体模型本身更强，BCI 每个新用户又都必须校准，缺少把个人收益与群体收益分开的评估协议。
Method: 对三个冻结 EEG 基础模型 (CBraMod、REVE、LaBraM) 各训练个人适配器，在三个运动想象数据集的 235 名留出被试上，用全部前半段 session 标签，同时对比群体模型、其他被试的适配器 (exchanged adapters)，并改变群体训练预算 (含 4 倍原始预算)；另测试少标签校准、无标签上下文与 meta 学习初始化相对匹配对照。

papers.title: STRIDE: Automated Evaluation of Text-to-Trajectory Alignment across Diverse Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Language-conditioned trajectory generation is here, but its evaluation has not kept pace. Existing pedestrian trajectory metrics compare trajectories with real-world human data. This does not scale to text-to-trajectory generation across diverse contexts, as collecting human trajectories for every scenario is costly and infeasible. Moreover, pedestrian behavior is heterogeneous and context-dependent, with no single metric as the correct answer, and current evaluation frameworks are not transferable to this domain. These challenges make scalable, reliable evaluation difficult. We introduce STRIDE, the first framework for evaluating context alignment between scenario descriptions and pedestrian trajectories. STRIDE addresses these challenges through three design choices. First, we derive our VRDST evaluation protocol from sociological theories to define a complete evaluation space. Second, it decomposes high-level context into scenario-adaptive behavioral questions. Third, every question is resolved against a deterministic measurement tool library that yields reproducible answers. Together, STRIDE enables complete, verifiable, automated, and scalable evaluation across diverse contexts without requiring human trajectory data. We instantiate STRIDE in the crowd domain as STRIDE-Bench, comprising 1K scenarios, 6K behavioral questions, and 11K measurements with calibrated expected answers across 30 real-world maps. Comprehensive human validations show that STRIDE-Bench is consistent with human behavior and judgment, achieving 80% human agreement. We further evaluate several text-to-trajectory models, finding limited context-alignment capability and persistent challenges in fine-grained context conditioning. We believe that the STRIDE framework provides a first step toward principled evaluation of context-aligned pedestrian trajectory generation.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2027, Evaluations & Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIDE 提出首个对齐场景文本与行人轨迹的自动评测框架，用社会学理论导出的 VRDST 协议定义完整评测空间，把高层语境拆成场景自适应行为问题，并逐题用确定性测量工具库给出可复现答案，无需真实人类轨迹。实例化为 STRIDE-Bench（1K 场景、6K 行为问题、11K 测量、30 张真实地图），人工验证一致率 80%；被测文本到轨迹模型的语境对齐能力有限，细粒度语境条件化仍是难题。
Motivation: 现有轨迹指标都拿真实人类数据做参照，无法扩展到多样语境下的文本到轨迹生成，因为逐场景采集人类轨迹成本过高且不可行；行人行为异质且依赖语境，没有单一指标可当正确答案，现有评测框架也不可迁移到该领域。
Method: STRIDE 含三项设计：从社会学理论导出 VRDST 评测协议以定义完整评测空间；把高层语境分解为场景自适应的行为问题；每题由确定性测量工具库 (deterministic measurement tool library) 判定，答案可复现。在人群领域实例化为 STRIDE-Bench，覆盖 30 张真实地图，并做人工验证与对若干文本到轨迹模型的评测。
Result: STRIDE-Bench 含 1K 场景、6K 行为问题、11K 带校准期望答案的测量，覆盖 30 张真实地图；人工验证显示与人类行为和判断一致，人类一致率 80%。对若干文本到轨迹模型的评测发现其语境对齐能力有限，细粒度语境条件化存在持续挑战。
Conclusion: 不依赖人类轨迹数据即可做到完整、可验证、自动且可扩展的语境对齐评测；当前文本到轨迹生成模型尚未掌握细粒度语境条件化，STRIDE 被定位为该方向原则性评测的第一步。

papers.title: InfiMed2: A Generalist Medical Multimodal Foundation Model from Contextual Evidence and Stability-Aware Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Recent medical multimodal models have benefited from larger corpora, broader modality coverage, and stronger reasoning-oriented training, yet effective data design across continued pretraining (CPT) and post-training remains challenging. Medical sources vary substantially in structure, granularity, and information density, and their utility shifts as training progresses from broad knowledge acquisition to late-stage consolidation. Meanwhile, post-training is often dominated by short-form visual question answering, providing limited supervision for informative and answer-consistent explanations. We introduce InfiMed2, a family of 4B and 27B generalist medical multimodal foundation models built around stage-aware data design. We curate a 55.68B-token corpus that combines broad clinical knowledge with context-rich biomedical visual evidence through source-specific processing. Our CPT pipeline first adapts the vision encoder, then builds broad medical knowledge, and finally transitions to an evidence-focused data mixture during learning-rate decay. For supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we regenerate visual question-answering responses using answer stability, answer-masked reconstruction, and correctness-constrained selection to produce more informative and answer-consistent supervision. The 4B model is further optimized with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Across five medical multimodal benchmarks, InfiMed2-4B achieves 66.73% mean accuracy after RLVR, surpassing the larger Qwen3.5-9B, while InfiMed2-27B reaches 73.72%, the highest among the evaluated open-weight models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfiMed2 是 4B 与 27B 两个规格的通用医学多模态基础模型，靠分阶段数据设计组织 CPT 与后训练：先适配视觉编码器、再建广博医学知识、在学习率衰减期切到以证据为主的数据混合；SFT 阶段用答案稳定性、答案掩码重建与正确性约束筛选重生成 VQA 回答。在五个医学多模态基准上，InfiMed2-4B 经 RLVR 后平均准确率 66.73%，超过更大的 Qwen3.5-9B，InfiMed2-27B 达 73.72%，为所评估开源权重模型中最高。
Motivation: 医学多源数据在结构、粒度与信息密度上差异大，且效用随训练从广博知识获取推进到后期巩固而变化；后训练又被短式 VQA 主导，对信息量足、与答案一致的解释监督不足。
Method: 构建 55.68B token 语料，按来源分别处理以兼顾广博临床知识与富含上下文的生物医学视觉证据；CPT 先适配 vision encoder，再建立广博医学知识，最后在 learning-rate decay 期转入以证据为中心的数据混合；SFT 用 answer stability、answer-masked reconstruction 与 correctness-constrained selection 重新生成 VQA 回答；4B 模型再用 RLVR 优化。
Result: 在五个医学多模态基准上，InfiMed2-4B 经 RLVR 后平均准确率 66.73%，超过 Qwen3.5-9B；InfiMed2-27B 达 73.72%，为所评估开源权重模型中最高。语料规模 55.68B token，模型规格为 4B 与 27B。
Conclusion: 按训练阶段设计数据（CPT 从广博知识过渡到证据聚焦混合，SFT 用稳定性与正确性约束的重生成监督）能让 4B 医学多模态模型在五个基准上胜过更大的 9B 模型，27B 则登顶开源权重模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Physics-Guided Spectral Distillation for Underwater Image Enhancement on Resource-Constrained Devices
papers.abstract_en: Underwater image enhancement is crucial for improving visual perception in marine applications. Existing underwater image enhancement studies mainly focus on enhancement quality and visual fidelity, while rarely considering real-time deployment capability, which is essential for resource-constrained underwater robots. To this end, we introduce a physics-guided spectral distillation (PSD) method, which reduces model capacity for real-time applications while maintaining the high performance of underwater image enhancement models. To decompose the outputs of teacher and student models, PSD adopts a multilevel Haar discrete wavelet transform. It transfers low-frequency color and illumination information as well as high-frequency structural details through band-specific objectives. Moreover, the distillation process of PSD is degradation-aware. We estimate degradation-aware weights through a physical head and combine them with ground-truth-guided reliability masks to selectively retain valuable teacher guidance. Experiments on the UIEB, LSUI, and EUVP datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Furthermore, we demonstrate the benefits of enhanced images for downstream perception tasks, including object detection. Deployment on a self-developed ROV further demonstrates its practical applicability in real-world underwater scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向水下机器人实时部署的物理引导谱蒸馏 (PSD)，用多层 Haar 离散小波变换把教师输出分解为低频颜色光照与高频结构细节，按频带分别蒸馏给学生模型，并用物理头估计的退化感知权重与真值引导的可靠性掩码筛选有价值的教师指导。在 UIEB、LSUI、EUVP 上验证有效，且在自研 ROV 上完成真实水下场景部署。
Motivation: 现有水下图像增强研究主要追求增强质量与视觉保真，很少考虑实时部署能力，而资源受限水下机器人恰恰需要在保住性能的同时压缩模型容量。
Method: PSD 对教师与学生输出做多层 Haar 离散小波变换 (multilevel Haar DWT) 分解，通过频带专属目标分别迁移低频颜色/光照信息与高频结构细节；蒸馏过程为 degradation-aware，由 physical head 估计退化感知权重，再与 ground-truth-guided reliability mask 结合，选择性保留有价值的教师指导，从而在降低模型容量的同时维持增强性能。
Result: 在 UIEB、LSUI、EUVP 三个数据集上实验验证了方法有效性；展示增强图像对下游感知任务（含 object detection）的收益；在自研 ROV 上部署，证明真实水下场景中的实际可用性。
Conclusion: 把频带分解的谱蒸馏与退化感知权重、可靠性掩码结合，可以在压缩水下增强模型容量、支撑实时部署的同时保住增强质量，并把收益传递到下游目标检测与实机 ROV 场景。

papers.title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D²-VLA 在预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口上同时做双记忆与双频控制：块状因果 KV 缓存增量编码观测，为 VLM 与 action expert 分设历史 KV 读视图，周期 VLM 更新之间用 gated adapter 注入新视觉特征并保留短 fast-memory 队列做动作重规划。在十任务基准 DOMINO-Long 上完整任务成功率 60.0%（π₀.₅ 为 35.4%，PUMA 为 20.6%），DOMINO 上 29.3%（对比 9.6% 与 17.2%）。
Motivation: 长时程操作要求机器人记住已不在视野内的线索并同时响应移动物体，而现有 VLA 策略多依赖最新观测，刷新视觉上下文还需再跑一次代价高昂的 VLM。
Method: 在预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口上做块状因果 KV 缓存增量编码，按不同时间注意力模式为 VLM 和 action expert 构造分开的历史 KV 读视图；周期性 VLM 更新之间由 gated adapter 把新视觉特征并入最新的历史条件 KV 块，并用短 fast-memory 队列支持 action replanning。

papers.title: Finite-Time Concentration and Convergence Rates for Projected Two-Time-Scale Stochastic Approximation with Markov Noise
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-time concentration and convergence rates for projected two-time-scale stochastic approximation driven by a controlled Markov chain. The averaged fast map is contractive, while the slow iterate is projected onto a compact convex polyhedron. The associated projected ordinary differential equation may have a discontinuous vector field at the boundary, preventing a direct application of standard analyses based on Lipschitz vector fields. Using the Skorokhod map, we establish explicit high-probability bounds for tracking the moving fast equilibrium and the projected slow dynamics. These bounds separate martingale fluctuations, Markov-noise residuals, and the bias due to time-scale separation. A Lipschitz Lyapunov function satisfying a uniform decrease condition over fixed time intervals yields almost-sure convergence, with explicit last-iterate rates when the decrease admits a power lower bound. Under uniform Lyapunov contraction, polynomial step sizes yield joint fast-tracking and slow Lyapunov-error exponents arbitrarily close to $1/3$. Under the additional assumption that the reduced slow update map is a Euclidean contraction, logarithmically separated step sizes improve the joint rate to $O(n^{-1/2}\log n)$ almost surely, including for boundary equilibria. The same rate holds under a distinct geometric condition involving a strictly attracting face of a box and a fast equilibrium that is constant on that face. An actor-critic application achieves an almost-sure value-gap rate of $O(n^{-1}\log n)$ relative to the optimum within the constrained policy class. Further applications include projected TD(0) and projected stochastic gradient descent. We also extend the analysis to projection of the fast recursion under Euclidean contractivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受控 Markov 链驱动的投影双时间尺度随机逼近 (projected two-time-scale stochastic approximation) 上，用 Skorokhod map 处理投影 ODE 边界处不连续向量场，得到跟踪快平衡与投影慢动力学的显式高概率界，误差分解为鞅波动、Markov 噪声残差与时间尺度分离偏差。在均匀 Lyapunov 收缩下，多项式步长给出联合指数任意接近 1/3；若约化慢更新映射是欧氏收缩，对数分离步长把联合速率改进到几乎必然 O(n^{-1/2} log n)（含边界平衡），actor-critic 应用给出相对约束策略类最优值的值隙速率 O(n^{-1} log n)。
Motivation: 投影 ODE 在边界上向量场可能不连续，标准基于 Lipschitz 向量场的分析无法直接套用，双时间尺度下跟踪快平衡与慢投影动力学的有限时高概率误差界因此缺失。
Method: 用 Skorokhod map 刻画投影慢动力学，建立跟踪快平衡与慢迭代的显式高概率界，并把误差拆成鞅波动、Markov 噪声残差与时间尺度分离偏差；要求快映射平均后收缩、慢迭代投影到紧凸多面体，配合满足固定时间区间上一致下降条件的 Lipschitz Lyapunov 函数导出几乎必然收敛与末迭代速率。
Result: 均匀 Lyapunov 收缩下，多项式步长给出联合快跟踪与慢 Lyapunov 误差指数任意接近 1/3；若约化慢更新映射是欧氏收缩，对数分离步长把联合速率提升到几乎必然 O(n^{-1/2} log n)（含边界平衡），在盒的严格吸引面且快平衡在该面上为常数这一几何条件下同样成立。actor-critic 应用得到相对约束策略类最优值的几乎必然值隙速率 O(n^{-1} log n)；应用还包括 projected TD(0) 与 projected SGD，并扩展到快递归本身做投影的情形。
Conclusion: 边界不连续性可用 Skorokhod map 绕开，双时间尺度投影随机逼近在额外收缩条件下可达到接近 n^{-1/2}（乃至 actor-critic 的 n^{-1}）的几乎必然末迭代速率。

papers.title: CoSec: Benchmarking Agent Security in Communities
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents operate in persistent collaborative environments involving multiple users, communities, memories, files, and tools. Community boundaries may remain fixed or evolve with changes in membership, roles, composition, and relationships. Agents must complete legitimate tasks and prevent unauthorized disclosure of protected information. Existing evaluations do not fully examine these risks in agent systems. We introduce \textbf{CoSec}, an executable benchmark for evaluating privacy and authorization enforcement in LLM agent systems operating within and across communities. CoSec contains 208 canonical scenarios spanning fixed and evolving boundaries, protected information belonging to the agent owner or other participants, and attacks through dialogue, environmental content, persistent memory, and composed workflows. CoSec executes complete agent systems with persistent sessions, memory, files and tools. It verifies information flows against the active authorization state using execution traces and artifacts. Across harness and model configurations, agents frequently complete benign tasks but violate privacy and authorization boundaries. Privacy behavior varies across harnesses, attack surfaces, and community states, revealing how memory, files, tools, and workflows can carry protected information beyond its authorized scope. These findings show that task utility does not imply privacy or authorization compliance and that authorization in community settings remains an unresolved security challenge for persistent LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoSec 是一个可执行的 LLM agent 安全基准，含 208 个覆盖固定与演化社区边界的场景，通过执行完整 agent 系统并比对执行轨迹与当前授权状态来核验信息流。跨 harness 与模型配置，agent 常能完成良性任务却越过隐私与授权边界，说明任务效用不等于隐私合规。
Motivation: LLM agent 在持久社区环境中共享记忆、文件与工具，现有评测未充分检验跨社区的隐私泄露与越权风险。
Method: 构建可执行基准 CoSec：208 个典型场景覆盖固定/演化边界、属于 agent 主人或其他参与者的受保护信息，以及经对话、环境内容、持久记忆与组合工作流的攻击；执行带持久会话、记忆、文件和工具的完整 agent 系统，用执行轨迹与产物对照活跃授权状态核验信息流。
Result: 跨 harness 与模型配置，agent 频繁完成良性任务但违反隐私与授权边界；隐私行为随 harness、攻击面与社区状态变化，显示记忆、文件、工具与工作流可把受保护信息带出授权范围。
Conclusion: 任务效用不代表隐私或授权合规，社区场景下对持久 LLM agent 的授权仍是未解决的安全难题。

papers.title: Instance-Adaptive Prompts as Context for Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Longer histories can improve time-series foundation models (TSFMs), but require substantially higher inference cost. We therefore ask whether contextual information can be provided more efficiently through a compact set of learned token embeddings. We introduce PaCTS, which generates a small set of instance-adaptive latent prompts in the form of continuous embedding tokens conditioned on the visible context. These prompts serve as compact context surrogates for frozen TSFMs. PaCTS constructs them from instance-specific global statistics and further refines them with segment-level temporal information, capturing both global characteristics and local temporal variations. The prompt module is jointly trained and deployed across heterogeneous time series with the frozen backbone. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of prompts as context, consistently improving forecasting across context lengths and model architectures. With a shorter input context, PaCTS can outperform the same frozen backbone using double context while requiring substantially less inference computation. Compared with weight-space adaptation methods, PaCTS achieves stronger improvements and better out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaCTS 用一个轻量 prompt 模块为冻结的时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 生成少量实例自适应连续 embedding token，替代更长的历史输入作为上下文。在多种上下文长度与模型架构上一致提升预测效果：较短输入下即可超过同一冻结骨干使用双倍上下文的精度，且推理计算量显著更低，相对权重空间自适应方法改进更大、分布外泛化更好。
Motivation: 更长历史能提升 TSFM 预测，但推理成本大幅上升；需要一种比堆输入更省算力的上下文供给方式。
Method: PaCTS 由实例级全局统计量构造 latent prompts，再用分段级时序信息细化，兼顾全局特征与局部时序变化；prompt 模块与冻结骨干联合训练，并跨异构时间序列统一部署。
Result: 在不同上下文长度与模型架构上一致改善预测；短输入 PaCTS 超过同一冻结骨干用双倍上下文的表现，推理计算量显著更少；相对权重空间自适应方法改进更强、分布外泛化更好。
Conclusion: 学到的连续 prompt 可作为冻结 TSFM 的紧凑上下文替身，用更少算力换取不降反升的预测效果，且比改权重更抗分布偏移。

papers.title: BEHAVE: Functional Behavior Modeling Enables Self-Improving Agents for Hardware Design and Verification
papers.abstract_en: Developing agents for hardware design and verification requires reliable correctness feedback. As a hardware specification may permit correct implementations with different latencies, matching design and reference outputs cycle by cycle can reject valid designs. To address this, we introduce BEHAVE, an agentic framework for multi-turn joint hardware design and verification through functional behavior modeling. We define Behavior IR to express task functionality as executable behavior models without prescribing implementation timing beyond the specification. The agent iteratively develops a register-transfer-level (RTL) design and a behavior model as the design's verification reference. Our evaluator, BEHAVE-Sim, checks both artifacts separately against a hidden golden behavior model using input stimuli generated by random sampling and solver-guided search. BEHAVE thus supports power, performance, and area (PPA) exploration across task-permitted latencies and microarchitectures. During training, the same evaluator provides verifiable reinforcement learning (RL) rewards from specification-behavior pairs without reference RTL. For self-improvement, the agent continually searches for high-level implementations relevant to its capability gaps, constructs and checks specification-behavior pairs, and trains on the expanded task pool. We release BEHAVE-Train and BEHAVE-Eval with 600 human-reviewed specification-behavior pairs for realistic hardware workloads. Starting from 60 seed tasks and acquiring 100 new tasks, self-improvement raises Qwen3.8-27B's RTL pass@1 on BEHAVE-Eval from 55.0% to 75.0%, reaching performance comparable to RL using a 540-task pool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEHAVE 用可执行的 Behavior IR 表达规格功能而不锁定时序，让 agent 同时迭代 RTL 设计与行为模型，并由 BEHAVE-Sim 对照隐藏 golden 行为模型分别校验两者。自改进训练使 Qwen3.8-27B 在 BEHAVE-Eval 上 RTL pass@1 从 55.0% 升到 75.0%，接近用 540 任务池做 RL 的水平。
Motivation: 硬件规格常允许多种正确时延的实现，逐周期比对设计与参考输出会误拒合法设计，导致设计与验证 agent 缺少可靠正确性反馈。
Method: 定义 Behavior IR 把任务功能写成可执行行为模型、不规定超出规格的实现时序；BEHAVE-Sim 用随机采样与求解器引导搜索生成输入激励，分别校验 RTL 与行为模型对隐藏 golden 行为模型的一致性；同一评估器从规格-行为对（无需参考 RTL）给出可验证 RL 奖励，agent 再针对能力缺口搜索高层实现、构造并检查规格-行为对并扩充任务池训练。
Result: 发布 BEHAVE-Train 与 BEHAVE-Eval，含 600 对人工审核的规格-行为对；从 60 个种子任务出发新增 100 个任务后，Qwen3.8-27B 在 BEHAVE-Eval 上 RTL pass@1 由 55.0% 提升到 75.0%，性能与使用 540 任务池的 RL 相当。
Conclusion: 以行为模型而非逐周期参考输出做正确性反馈，可让 agent 在任务允许的时延与微架构空间内做 PPA 探索，并通过自建规格-行为对实现自我改进。

papers.title: Projective Normal Fields: A Convex Optimization Method for Constructing Smooth UDFs
papers.abstract_en: Constructing a smooth approximation of an unsigned distance field (UDF) from a raw point cloud is challenging because the input provides neither surface connectivity nor consistently oriented normals. Methods that directly learn a scalar UDF must also handle its non-differentiability on the zero level set and weak supervision away from the samples, which can lead to unstable optimization and spatial artifacts. We introduce Projective Normal Fields (PNFs), an orientation-free representation and convex optimization framework for estimating bidirectional normals from point positions alone. Each normal axis is encoded by a rank-one projector, which is invariant to normal reversal. We relax the non-convex set of hard projectors to its convex hull: the symmetric positive-semidefinite matrices with unit trace. Each soft tensor defines a local quadratic distance model and retains the relative weights of candidate normal axes. We estimate a coherent PNF by combining local tangent-plane fitting, soft-PCA anchoring, and overlap regularization on a fixed neighborhood graph. With positive anchoring weights, the objective is strongly convex and admits a unique global minimizer. Principal eigenvectors provide bidirectional normals, while the corresponding eigengaps provide spectral confidence indicators. We use these indicators to select and weight directional sources for heat diffusion, followed by Poisson integration to construct a regularized UDF approximation. By separating local geometry estimation from scalar-field construction, PNF avoids directly fitting the non-differentiable UDF. Experiments demonstrate reduced sensitivity to neighborhood size, competitive reconstruction under noise and outliers, and improved accuracy near non-manifold junctions. The project page is available at https://anonymous17777367.github.io/PNF-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Projective Normal Fields (PNF)：用秩一投影子编码每个法向轴（对法向翻转不变），把硬投影子集合松弛到单位迹对称半正定矩阵的凸包上，从而在点云上以强凸目标估计双向法向，再经热扩散与 Poisson 积分构造平滑 UDF。正锚定权重下目标强凸且有唯一全局极小；实验显示对邻域尺寸敏感性降低，在噪声与外点下重建具竞争力，并改善非流形交汇处精度。
Motivation: 从无连接、无一致法向的原始点云构造平滑 UDF 很难：直接学标量 UDF 要面对零水平集不可微与远离采样点监督弱的问题，导致优化不稳与空间伪影。
Method: PNF 用秩一 projector 编码法向轴（对法向反转不变），将非凸的硬 projector 集合松弛到其凸包——单位迹对称半正定矩阵；每个软张量定义局部二次距离模型。估计时结合局部切平面拟合、soft-PCA 锚定与固定邻域图上的 overlap 正则；正锚定权重下目标强凸、有唯一全局极小。取主特征向量得双向法向，eigengap 作为谱置信度，用其选择并加权方向源做热扩散，再 Poisson 积分得到正则化 UDF。
Result: 实验显示对邻域尺寸的敏感性降低，在噪声与外点条件下重建具竞争力，并在非流形交汇 (non-manifold junctions) 附近精度提升；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把局部几何估计与标量场构造分开，用凸优化估计法向即可绕开直接拟合不可微 UDF 的不稳定，同时以 eigengap 提供可置信度加权的法向来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoHuB 提出一个自我中心视觉 (egocentric visual observation) 下的多人形机器人协作仿真基准，含 10 项任务（8 项双人形、2 项三人形），并配套多操作者 VR 遥操作采集的同步演示。用代表性视觉运动策略 (visuomotor policy) 做实验，揭示不同协同感知与控制形式上仍存在明显挑战。
Motivation: 现有人形机器人基准基本只测单人形技能，缺少在自我中心视觉观测下对多人形协作的评测，而人类环境中的大量物理任务需要伙伴协助或共同操纵物体。
Method: 构建 CoHuB 仿真基准，覆盖 10 项任务、8 项双人形与 2 项三人形，包含多种协作模式；用多操作者 VR 遥操作流水线采集同步演示，每个操作者从自己的视角控制一个人形；再以代表性 visuomotor 策略做实验。
Result: CoHuB 提供 10 项任务（8 项双人形、2 项三人形）与同步演示数据；实验显示各类协同感知与控制形式均存在 substantial challenges。
Conclusion: 多人形协作在自我中心视觉下尚未被现有基准覆盖，CoHuB 被定位为开发与评测此类协作策略的基础平台。

papers.title: When VLMs Trust Context: Evaluating Scene Text Recognition under Misleading Context
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can read text in natural scenes, but their predictions may be influenced by the surrounding context. When the printed text conflicts with what the scene suggests, a model may return a more plausible word instead of the shown text. We introduce SceneFaith, a benchmark of 781 generated scene images for studying this behavior. Each output is classified as Literal, Canonical, or Other, separating faithful transcription from context-consistent rewriting and ordinary recognition errors. Across 15 models from seven families, all models show rewriting on clear images, with rates ranging from 8.45\% to 58.51\%. Controlled experiments further show that surrounding context matters: removing surrounding scene information reduces rewriting and improves literal accuracy, while changing the scene around the same text patch can also change model outputs. Moreover, weakening the target text with blur increases rewriting. These results show that reliable scene-text recognition requires VLMs to balance visual character evidence with contextual information, preserving clear text while using context mainly when the visual evidence is uncertain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SceneFaith 用 781 张生成场景图评测 VLM 的场景文字识别忠实性，把输出分为 Literal、Canonical、Other 三类。15 个模型（来自 7 个家族）在清晰图上全部出现改写，改写率 8.45%–58.51%；去掉周边场景信息会降低改写并提高字面准确率，模糊目标文字则提高改写。
Motivation: VLM 读场景文字时会用场景语境覆盖视觉字面证据，把印出的字改成更“合理”的词，这种忠实转写与语境改写的混淆此前缺少可量化的评测基准。
Method: 构建 SceneFaith：781 张生成场景图，每个输出按 Literal / Canonical / Other 三分类，区分忠实转写、语境一致改写与普通识别错误；在 7 个家族的 15 个模型上评测，并做受控干预（移除周边场景、替换同一文字块周围的场景、模糊目标文字）。
Result: 15 个模型在清晰图上改写率介于 8.45% 到 58.51%；移除周边场景信息降低改写并提高字面准确率，改变同一文字块周围的场景会改变模型输出，模糊目标文字会提高改写率。
Conclusion: 可靠的场景文字识别要求 VLM 在视觉字符证据与语境之间做权衡：清晰文字保持字面转写，仅在视觉证据不确定时才借助语境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Applying Language Models in medical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: The use and applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical research and clinical practice has received increasing attention in the literature over recent years. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has expanded discussions in regards to applications of AI within healthcare. While traditional deep learning based AI applications in medicine have often focused on specific and defined tasks, LLMs offer broader capabilities and flexibility in working with available data,. At the same time of writing, the integration of LLMs into medical settings raises important questions regarding their reliability, accuracy, transparency, safety, and appropriate role in a medical setting. This text presents and discusses recent talks and articles concerning the application of LLMs in medicine, with particular emphasis on their potential utility in research and clinical practice. It considers both the opportunities offered by these technologies and the challenges associated with their implementation, aiming to provide a perspective on the current and emerging role of LLMs within the medical field.
papers.comment: 7 pages, aimed to be a blogpost of the current state of the medical LLM field
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 7 页的博客式综述，梳理 LLM 在医学研究与临床实践中的应用现状，核心论点是 LLM 相比传统任务专用的深度学习模型提供更宽的能力面与数据灵活性，但其在医疗场景的部署同时受可靠性、准确性、透明度与安全性问题约束。作者的取向是把 LLM 定位为需逐项审视这些属性后再谈角色的技术，而非直接可用的临床工具。
Motivation: 传统医学 AI 深度学习应用局限于单一明确任务，LLM 带来跨任务灵活性，但医疗场景对可靠性、准确性、透明度与安全性的要求尚未在文献中被系统讨论清楚。
Method: 以近期学术报告与已发表文章为素材做观点性综述，围绕研究与临床实践两条线索组织 LLM 的应用机会与实施挑战，输出对当前及新兴角色的定位判断。
Result: 给出的是定性论断：LLM 相对任务专用深度学习模型具备更广的能力范围与数据处理灵活性；其进入医疗场景同时提出可靠性、准确性、透明度、安全性以及在医疗中恰当角色四类问题。
Conclusion: LLM 在医学中的价值取决于能否逐项回应可靠性、准确性、透明度与安全性，其角色应按这些属性被界定，而非按能力面直接推定。

papers.title: Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs
papers.abstract_en: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对法语 PDF 文档问答（同时评测答案与支撑页面），在 BM25 基线上叠加稠密检索、rank fusion、reranking 与 query decomposition 构成五变体 RAG 对比。595 道挑战题上完整系统 MRR@10 达 0.4450、Recall@10 达 0.4013，均高于 BM25 的 0.3430 与 0.2994；但单独稠密检索与简单词法-稠密融合反而不如 BM25，页面检索指标多数仍低于匿名总体均值，说明改进空间在准确选页而非语义检索本身。
Motivation: 法语 PDF 文档问答中答案与其支撑页面需同时被评测，而 BM25 基线在页面定位上表现有限，需要弄清各类检索增强组件各自带来多少收益。
Method: 在 BM25 基线上依次加入 dense retrieval、rank fusion、reranking、query decomposition，构成五个系统变体，在 595 道法语 PDF 挑战题上以 MRR@10 与 Recall@10 评测答案与页面检索，并对照匿名总体均值。
Result: 完整系统在 595 题上取得 MRR@10 0.4450、Recall@10 0.4013，对比 BM25 的 0.3430 与 0.2994；单独稠密检索与简单词法-稠密融合均低于 BM25；reranking 提升混合系统，query decomposition 带来最大进一步增益，同时延迟更高、检出的输出瑕疵更多；完整系统在两项答案指标上略高于匿名总体均值，在多数页面检索指标上低于该均值。
Conclusion: 在该设定下，主要改进机会是准确的页面选择，而非孤立的语义检索；query decomposition 收益最大但以更高延迟和更多输出瑕疵为代价。

papers.title: Before the Token Commits: Trajectory-Level Benchmarking of Visual Hallucinations in Diffusion VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal diffusion language models generate responses by iteratively unmasking tokens, making each answer the endpoint of a multi-step trajectory rather than an immediate commitment. Hallucination benchmarks built for autoregressive models evaluate only the final output, and therefore cannot determine whether an unsupported claim in diffusion VLMs appears late or has already stabilized before any answer token is revealed. We introduce DynaHall, a trajectory-level benchmark of annotation-backed binary visual propositions covering object existence, counting, attributes, and relations, with controlled hard negatives graded by visual prior. DynaHall is paired with a commitment-aware protocol that records the intermediate answer tendency at every unmasking step alongside the committed output. Across five diffusion VLMs from three architecture families, visual hallucination is settled before commitment: an unsupported answer is already the preferred state while the answer position is still masked, and later unmasking steps rarely reverse it, so the failure is not introduced at the write step. This holds across decoding schedules, answer formats, and open-ended generation. DynaHall also exposes failures hidden by final-output metrics, including counting and relation collapse, prior-driven false positives, and attribute errors whose direction changes by type. Guided by this diagnosis, PGS (Pre-commitment Gradient Steering) edits still-masked answer states to reduce false positives, bringing the affirmation rate close to balance, and transfers to another architecture without degrading general ability. DynaHall and PGS suggest that hallucination should be measured and mitigated along the generation trajectory of diffusion VLMs, not only at the final answer.

Motivation: 面向自回归模型的幻觉基准只看最终输出，无法判断扩散 VLM 的无据主张是写入时引入还是在任何答案 token 显露前就已定型。
Method: DynaHall 收录带标注的二元视觉命题（物体存在、计数、属性、关系），含按视觉先验分级的受控 hard negatives；配套协议在每个 unmasking 步记录中间答案倾向与最终提交输出，并在 mask 状态上施加 PGS (Pre-commitment Gradient Steering) 编辑。
Result: 在三个架构家族的五个扩散 VLM 上，无据答案在答案位置仍被 mask 时即为偏好状态，后续 unmasking 步很少逆转，且跨解码调度、答案格式与开放式生成均成立；DynaHall 还暴露计数与关系坍缩、先验驱动假阳性、以及方向随类型变化的属性错误。PGS 使肯定率接近平衡，并迁移到另一架构时不损害通用能力。

papers.title: When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety
papers.abstract_en: Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一评测设置下对比行为式安全对齐与表征工程：控制侧 DPO 总体最强但会在后续良性微调后退化，表征 steering 仅在低数据、尤其是高质量对比数据下有竞争力；监测侧专用文本 monitor 检测精度最高，表征 probe 以显著更低的边际成本保持竞争力。monitor 引导的干预能挽回 DPO 良性微调后丢失的大部分安全性，且几乎不增加过度拒答。
Motivation: 行为式对齐、文本 monitor 与表征工程常在不同设置下评测，相对优劣不清，无法判断表征读写何时真正补充行为式安全机制。
Method: 做两条轨道的 matched evaluation：控制侧在 robustness、practicality、granularity 三维度比较 DPO 与三种 representation steering 方法；监测侧比较 representation probe 与 fine-tuned、open-weight 文本 monitor，覆盖 full-response detection、early detection 与计算成本；最后测试 monitor 引导的干预对 DPO 良性微调后安全退化的修复。
Result: DPO 提供最强的总体控制，且随训练数据增加总体变强，但后续良性微调会使其安全性退化；representation steering 主要在低数据设置下有竞争力，尤其依赖高质量对比数据；专用文本 monitor 达到最强的总体检测精度，representation probe 以显著更低的边际成本保持竞争力；monitor 引导的干预挽回了 DPO 良性微调后丢失的大部分安全性，且几乎不增加额外过度拒答。
Conclusion: 表征工程总体上不能替代行为式安全机制，但在特定条件下（低数据 steering、低成本监测、微调后修复）提供实用优势，并可作为行为式 safeguard 的补充。

papers.title: LongPuzzleBench: Evaluating GUI Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents need long-horizon visual reasoning: they must interpret a changing interface while keeping a multi-step plan viable as earlier actions constrain later ones. Existing benchmarks evaluate grounding, computer use, and game play, but rarely test whether agents stay coherent across long chains of coupled decisions. Long-horizon visual puzzles expose this capability directly: a legal move that looks like progress can make the puzzle unsolvable, and the loss shows only several moves later. We introduce LongPuzzleBench, 114 levels in six puzzle games played through native GUI actions, where one objective can take a human over a thousand actions on persistent boards and dead ends go unannounced. With Native GUI Actions alone, the strongest agents solve most objectives, but success falls sharply on harder, longer boards: seven of ten general-purpose agents solve nothing harder than Medium, and none completes Bolt Unscrew Hard, which a human solves along with every other objective. Code Execution CUA does not close this gap, and its scores mix visual solving with algorithmic search. Controlled diagnostics trace these failures to one limitation that neither rules, state hints, nor failure memory removes: agents judge each move by the visible progress it makes, not by the future options it leaves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LongPuzzleBench 用 114 关、六款原生 GUI 操作的长时程视觉谜题评测 GUI agent 的连贯决策能力：单个目标在持久棋盘上可需人类上千步操作，且死路不提示。十个通用 agent 中七个连 Medium 都过不去，无一完成 Bolt Unscrew Hard；受控诊断把失败归因于按当前可见进展而非保留未来选项来评判每步，规则、状态提示与失败记忆都消不掉这一局限。
Motivation: 现有 GUI 基准测 grounding、computer use 与游戏，却很少检验 agent 能否在长链耦合决策中保持连贯——一步看似进展的合法走法可能让谜题数步之后才暴露无解。
Method: 构建 LongPuzzleBench：六款谜题游戏共 114 关，通过原生 GUI 动作 (Native GUI Actions) 操作持久棋盘，死路不预告；评测含通用 agent 与 Code Execution CUA，并设计受控诊断 (controlled diagnostics) 分离视觉解题与算法搜索。
Result: 最强 agent 在 Native GUI Actions 下可解多数目标，但难度与时长上升后成功率骤降：十个通用 agent 中七个解不过 Medium，无一完成 Bolt Unscrew Hard（人类可解该关及其余全部目标），单目标最长需人类上千步操作；Code Execution CUA 未缩小差距，其分数混杂视觉解题与算法搜索。诊断显示规则、状态提示、失败记忆三种干预都无法消除该局限。
Conclusion: 长时程 GUI 谜题失败的根因是 agent 按可见进展而非保留的未来选项评估每步，加规则或记忆类补丁不足以修复；评测应转向这类耦合决策的连贯性。
Relevance: 0
