papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 SAM 3D Body 作为跨模态教师，从单帧 RGB 免训练生成 70 关节、18,439 顶点的 MHR 网格真值，监督 StudentPoseFormer 从极稀疏毫米波雷达点云（均值约 6.5 点/帧、约 28% 空帧）直接输出逐帧全身 3D mesh 与逐关节不确定性。在 MM-Fi（同 TI IWR6843、跨被试）上 12 关节 MPJPE 达 7.45 cm，点积累 (k=3)、Doppler、速度损失分别贡献 -0.34、-0.85、-0.27 cm。
Motivation: 商用单芯片毫米波雷达点云极度稀疏，既有工作只能做身体部位关键点或离散动作分类，且全身 mesh 标注成本高，无法做到逐帧、公制、带不确定性的全身重建。
Method: 教师端用 mesh foundation model SAM 3D Body 从单帧 RGB 零训练产出 MHR 网格真值，配多阶段质量管线（置信度门控、深度校验、时间平滑、骨长一致性、坏帧剔除）；学生端 StudentPoseFormer 用 set encoding + masked attention pooling、时序 Transformer 与 CVAE 多假设头，同时输出位姿均值与逐关节方差，并做信息源消融。
Result: MM-Fi 跨被试全配置 12 关节 MPJPE 7.45 cm；消融显示点积累 k=3 降 0.34 cm、Doppler 降 0.85 cm（快速动作手腕处降 2 cm）、速度损失降 0.27 cm。自建同步雷达+RGB-D 语料（block 级留出）端到端 21.47 cm，逐关节从髋 4.8 cm 到腕 34.7 cm；约 30k 多样样本可改进到 15 cm，scaling law 表明样本多样性而非数量是瓶颈。
Conclusion: 雷达-only 部署（无相机、无图像）即可做全身逐帧 mesh 重建，误差受物理信息量限制，提升空间取决于样本多样性；教师真值与逐关节不确定性让模型能如实报告雷达看不见的位置。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Reconstruction Loss in Post-Training Quantization: Balanced Fitting for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large vision-language models (LVLMs), but is typically calibrated on a small set while expected to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Although recent PTQ methods for LVLMs incorporate sensitivity signals, they still minimize reconstruction loss with respect to the full-precision model, potentially over-preserving FP behavior and calibration-specific bias. Rather than treating quantization solely as an error to be minimized, we observe that it can also provide beneficial regularization for certain layers and modalities. Motivated by this observation, we propose Balanced Fitting, a quantization effect-based framework that balances precision and regularization beyond reconstruction-based optimization. By measuring layer- and component-wise quantization effects for weights, vision activations, and text activations, Balanced Fitting combines fine-grained fitting for sensitive components with coarser fitting to exploit potential regularization benefits. Experiments on multiple LVLMs show that our method consistently outperforms prior PTQ approaches under both weight-only and weight-activation quantization, while lower reconstruction loss does not reliably translate into better downstream performance. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/BFQ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Balanced Fitting 把 LVLM 的后训练量化 (PTQ) 从最小化重建损失改为按量化效应分配拟合精度：对敏感的权重、视觉激活、文本激活分量做细粒度拟合，对可从量化正则中获益的分量做粗粒度拟合。在多个 LVLM 上，该方法在 weight-only 与 weight-activation 两种量化设置下均稳定优于既有 PTQ 方法，且重建损失更低并不等于下游性能更好。
Motivation: LVLM 的 PTQ 通常只在小校准集上标定却要泛化到多样下游任务；现有方法仍以全精度模型为基准最小化重建损失，容易过度保留 FP 行为与校准集特有偏差。
Method: 提出量化效应驱动的 Balanced Fitting 框架：逐层、逐分量测量权重、视觉激活与文本激活的量化效应，据此对敏感分量做细粒度拟合、对可受益于正则化的分量做粗粒度拟合，从而在精度与正则化之间平衡，而非单纯最小化重建误差。
Result: 在多个 LVLM 上，Balanced Fitting 在 weight-only 与 weight-activation 两种量化模式下均一致优于先前 PTQ 方法；同时观察到更低的重建损失并不能可靠转化为更好的下游性能。
Conclusion: 量化不应只当作需要最小化的误差，对某些层和模态它本身是有益的正则化；PTQ 的优化目标应从重建损失转向按量化效应平衡拟合。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: Balanced Fitting 把 LVLM 的后训练量化 (PTQ) 从最小化重建损失改为按量化效应分配拟合精度：对敏感的权重、视觉激活、文本激活分量做细粒度拟合，对可从量化正则中获益的分量做粗粒度拟合。在多个 LVLM 上，该方法在 weight-only 与 weight-activation 两种量化设置下均稳定优于既有 PTQ 方法，且重建损失更低并不等于下游性能更好。
summary_sections.motivation: LVLM 的 PTQ 通常只在小校准集上标定却要泛化到多样下游任务；现有方法仍以全精度模型为基准最小化重建损失，容易过度保留 FP 行为与校准集特有偏差。

summary_sections.conclusion: 量化不应只当作需要最小化的误差，对某些层和模态它本身是有益的正则化；PTQ 的优化目标应从重建损失转向按量化效应平衡拟合。

papers.title: WeaveData: A Multimodal Data Analysis System with Self-Critiquing and Self-Evolving LLM Plans
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal data analysis, which answers questions over relational tables, text, and images, has attracted growing attention in the data management community. Large language models (LLMs) enable such analysis in natural language by generating analysis plans over relational and semantic operators. However, LLM-generated plans are error-prone: a plan may silently compute something other than what was asked, fail during execution, or return a result that misses the question. This paper presents WeaveData, a multimodal data analysis system with self-critiquing and self-evolving LLM plans. First, WeaveData generates a typed logical plan for each question and critiques it step by step before execution, and it checks the executed result against the question afterwards. Second, WeaveData evolves a plan that fails or misses the question: it diagnoses the failure with the actual data, reuses the results that remain valid, and accumulates planning experience for later questions. Third, WeaveData grounds planning in a metadata knowledge graph of all modalities, clarifies ambiguous questions with the user, and backs every model judgment with evidence in an interactive notebook. We demonstrate WeaveData on two public multimodal datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeaveData 是面向关系表、文本、图像多模态数据分析的 LLM 计划系统：为每个问题生成带类型的逻辑计划，执行前逐步自我批判、执行后用结果回查问题，失败或答非所问的计划则用真实数据诊断、复用仍有效的中间结果并沉淀规划经验。计划全程锚定多模态元数据知识图谱，歧义问题向用户澄清，每个模型判断在交互式 notebook 中附证据；在两个公开多模态数据集上演示。
Motivation: LLM 生成的分析计划容易出错：可能静默计算成别的东西、执行失败，或返回答非所问的结果，多模态（表+文本+图像）场景下这类错误更难被发现。
Method: 三段机制：为每个问题生成 typed logical plan 并在执行前逐步 critique，执行后把结果与原问题对照检查；对失败或漏答的计划用实际数据诊断、复用仍然有效的结果、累积 planning experience 供后续问题使用；规划锚定覆盖全部模态的 metadata knowledge graph，歧义问题向用户澄清，模型判断在 interactive notebook 中给出证据。
Result: 在两个公开多模态数据集上演示 WeaveData；摘要给出的是系统机制与演示设定，无准确率等定量指标。
Conclusion: 把批判、进化与证据 grounding 组成闭环，可以让 LLM 多模态分析计划在执行前后都被校验并从失败中积累经验。

papers.title: PanoVLN: Towards Effective Panoramic Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced vision-and-language navigation (VLN), enabling models to predict navigation actions from visual observations and language instructions. In this work, we explore VLN with panoramic observations and introduce PanoVLN. The motivation is straightforward: more complete visual context should enable better-informed navigation decisions. For example, a panorama can reveal a passage outside a perspective camera's field of view, allowing the model to identify the intended route without additional exploration. However, we find that simply replacing perspective images with panoramas yields only limited gains. Our diagnosis suggests that fully exploiting wider visibility requires modifications to action prediction, training supervision, and visual representation. First, wider visibility supports longer-horizon action planning. We make the model predict longer action sequences, enabling larger turns and subsequent movement from a single panorama. Specifically, we introduce a confidence-guided execution (CGE) strategy that dynamically determines how many predicted actions to execute before replanning. Second, wider visibility also brings more complex route choices. We therefore construct training routes with frequent branching points and clear instructions to provide targeted supervision for route selection. Third, panoramic navigation requires understanding spatial relationships across viewing directions, beyond recognizing individual landmarks. We combine semantic and geometric features from RGB panoramas to capture both scene content and spatial layout without adding visual tokens. With a 4B backbone and RGB-only input, PanoVLN surpasses the previous SOTA by 11.9% and 8.7% in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen. Real-world experiments on a quadruped further demonstrate faster navigation with fewer pauses than prior VLN methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PanoVLN 把全景视觉引入 vision-and-language navigation，发现直接把透视图换成全景收益有限，必须同时改动作预测、训练监督与视觉表征：用置信度引导执行 (CGE) 决定执行多少步再重规划，构造多分叉训练路线，并融合 RGB 全景的语义与几何特征且不增加 visual token。4B backbone、纯 RGB 输入下，R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE Val-Unseen 成功率较先前 SOTA 分别高 11.9% 与 8.7%，四足机器人实机上更快且停顿更少。
Motivation: 全景视野本可直接揭示视野外通道、减少额外探索，但简单替换透视图为全景只带来有限提升，说明更宽可见性必须配套改动动作预测、监督信号与视觉表征才能兑现。
Method: 三处改动：一是预测更长动作序列以支持大转弯与后续移动，并引入 confidence-guided execution (CGE) 动态决定执行多少预测动作再重规划；二是构造含频繁分叉点与清晰指令的训练路线，针对性监督路线选择；三是融合 RGB 全景的语义与几何特征以同时刻画场景内容与空间布局，且不增加 visual token。
Result: 在 4B backbone、RGB-only 输入下，PanoVLN 在 R2R-CE Val-Unseen 成功率超过先前 SOTA 11.9%，在 RxR-CE Val-Unseen 超过 8.7%；四足机器人实机实验显示比既有 VLN 方法导航更快、停顿更少。
Conclusion: 全景 VLN 的收益来自动作序列长度、路线分叉监督与跨方向空间表征的联合改造，而非单纯更换视角输入。

papers.title: Statistical Benefits of Fine-Tuning from Pretrained Initialization in Diagonal Linear Networks
papers.abstract_en: Adapting pretrained models to downstream tasks with limited data has become a central paradigm in modern deep learning. Yet, despite its widespread practical success, how fine-tuning leverages information from pretraining remains poorly understood theoretically. We study fine-tuning from pretrained weights through the lens of sparse linear regression and two-layer diagonal linear networks. In our setting, pretraining provides information through the support (and signs) of the initialization predictor, which may contain coordinates relevant to the downstream task. We show how pretrained information reshapes the implicit bias and training dynamics, and can thereby reduce the sample complexity of recovering the target parameters and support. In particular, for a clean initialization with correctly inherited signs, we show that the required sample size is comparable to that of a weighted Lasso estimator that explicitly exploits the pretrained support through a suitably chosen regularizer. Our results thus show how information encoded in pretrained weights can be implicitly exploited by gradient-based fine-tuning, reducing the amount of data needed to recover a downstream task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两层对角线性网络的稀疏线性回归框架下，预训练权重通过初始化预测的支撑集与符号向下游传递信息，重塑隐式偏置与训练动力学，从而降低恢复目标参数与支撑所需的样本复杂度。当初始化干净且符号继承正确时，微调所需样本量可与显式利用预训练支撑的加权 Lasso 相当。
Motivation: 微调如何利用预训练信息在理论上仍不清楚，需要刻画预训练初始化对隐式偏置、训练动力学与下游样本复杂度的具体影响。
Method: 以稀疏线性回归和两层对角线性网络 (diagonal linear networks) 为模型，分析从预训练权重出发的梯度微调：预训练信息体现为初始化预测的支撑与符号，考察其如何重塑隐式偏置与训练动力学，并与显式利用预训练支撑的加权 Lasso 估计量对比。
Result: 预训练信息可降低恢复目标参数与支撑的样本复杂度；在初始化干净且符号正确继承的条件下，所需样本量与加权 Lasso 估计量相当。
Conclusion: 梯度微调能隐式利用预训练权重中编码的信息，从而减少恢复下游任务所需的数据量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Unifying Framework of Concept-based Explainable AI with Completeness Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based explanations describe neural network predictions through human-understandable properties of inputs called concepts. The field encompasses approaches that differ in how they define and represent concepts and connect them to model predictions. We introduce a theoretical framework that describes these approaches in a common mathematical language and supports a shared analysis of their properties. For concept discovery, which identifies concepts automatically within a latent space of a trained model, we employ a concept autoencoder view. An encoder extracts concept representations from the model's latent space, and a decoder uses them to reconstruct the original latent representation. The autoencoder's reconstruction error measures how accurately its decoder recovers the original latent representation. We revisit model completeness: how well the concepts can reproduce the model's outputs. We show that model incompleteness of the concepts can be bounded by the autoencoder's reconstruction error. The autoencoder view also provides a common way to define individual concept attributions, which measure each concept's contribution to a prediction. We establish when these attributions sum to the model's prediction, and bound the discrepancy otherwise, thus providing attribution completeness guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个统一的概念可解释 XAI 理论框架，用 concept autoencoder 视角把概念发现方法写进同一套数学语言：encoder 从模型 latent space 抽概念表示，decoder 重建原 latent 表示。核心结论是概念的 model incompleteness 可由 autoencoder 重建误差界定，并给出 individual concept attributions 何时对预测求和成立、否则偏差多大的 attribution completeness 保证。
Motivation: 概念可解释性领域在概念的定义、表示与和预测的连接方式上各成体系，缺少共同语言；概念是否完整复现模型输出、各概念归因是否加和一致也缺少可证的界。
Method: 以 concept autoencoder 视角描述概念发现：encoder 从已训练模型的 latent space 提取概念表示，decoder 用其重建原 latent 表示，重建误差作为度量；在此统一语言下重新定义 model completeness 与 individual concept attributions，并推导加和成立的条件与偏差界。
Result: 证明概念的 model incompleteness 可由 autoencoder 重建误差界定；确定 individual concept attributions 求和等于模型预测的条件，并在不满足时给出偏差的界，从而提供 attribution completeness 保证。
Conclusion: 概念可解释方法的完整性问题可以统一归约为 autoencoder 重建误差的界，归因加和性因此成为可证明的性质而非经验现象。

papers.title: CoDrive: Cross-Vehicle World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Trajectory Control for Cooperative Driving
papers.abstract_en: Real-world driving is inherently multi-agent, yet most existing driving world models generate observations from a single ego vehicle. Independently extending them to multiple vehicles does not ensure that different agents observe a consistent shared world. We present CoDrive, a cross-vehicle, multi-view driving video generation framework that jointly generates observations of vehicles sharing the same dynamic scene with precise camera-trajectory control. CoDrive interleaves local self-attention, which models spatiotemporal dependencies among the views of each vehicle, with global self-attention, which enables information exchange and consistency modeling across vehicles. To explicitly encode their spatial relationships, all camera trajectories are represented in a shared world coordinate system and injected into the attention layers through projective relative positional encoding. We further adopt a progressive mixed-task training strategy that combines large-scale real-world single-agent data with synthetic cross-agent interaction data, allowing the model to benefit from real-world appearance distributions while learning cross-agent consistency from simulation. For systematic evaluation, we introduce CoDrive-Bench, a benchmark covering real and synthetic multi-vehicle scenarios and evaluating trajectory controllability, scene geometry consistency, and instance-level consistency. Experiments show that CoDrive improves trajectory controllability and cross-agent geometric and instance consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDrive 是跨车多视角驾驶视频生成框架：局部自注意力建模单车各视角时空依赖，全局自注意力做跨车一致性，所有相机轨迹统一到世界坐标系并以投影相对位置编码注入注意力层。在自建 CoDrive-Bench（真实与合成多车场景）上，CoDrive 提升轨迹可控性与跨车几何、实例一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型只从单一自车生成观测，简单扩展到多车并不能保证不同智能体看到同一个一致的共享世界。
Method: 交错使用局部自注意力（单车多视角时空依赖）与全局自注意力（跨车信息交换与一致性建模）；所有相机轨迹表示在共享世界坐标系中，经 projective relative positional encoding 注入注意力层；采用渐进式混合任务训练，把大规模真实单智能体数据与合成跨智能体交互数据结合。
Result: 提出 CoDrive-Bench，覆盖真实与合成多车场景，评估轨迹可控性、场景几何一致性与实例级一致性；实验显示 CoDrive 提升轨迹可控性与跨车几何、实例一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。
Conclusion: 跨车一致性必须靠共享世界坐标系下的轨迹编码与跨车注意力显式建模，混合真实外观数据与合成交互数据可同时保住真实感与一致性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: CoDrive 是跨车多视角驾驶视频生成框架：局部自注意力建模单车各视角时空依赖，全局自注意力做跨车一致性，所有相机轨迹统一到世界坐标系并以投影相对位置编码注入注意力层。在自建 CoDrive-Bench（真实与合成多车场景）上，CoDrive 提升轨迹可控性与跨车几何、实例一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。

summary_sections.method: 交错使用局部自注意力（单车多视角时空依赖）与全局自注意力（跨车信息交换与一致性建模）；所有相机轨迹表示在共享世界坐标系中，经 projective relative positional encoding 注入注意力层；采用渐进式混合任务训练，把大规模真实单智能体数据与合成跨智能体交互数据结合。
summary_sections.result: 提出 CoDrive-Bench，覆盖真实与合成多车场景，评估轨迹可控性、场景几何一致性与实例级一致性；实验显示 CoDrive 提升轨迹可控性与跨车几何、实例一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨车一致性必须靠共享世界坐标系下的轨迹编码与跨车注意力显式建模，混合真实外观数据与合成交互数据可同时保住真实感与一致性。

papers.title: No Pain, More Gain: Iterative Merging for Effective Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) combines independently developed domain teachers into a single student by distilling their predictions on student-generated samples. We study a setting where teachers share a reference model but undergo different post-training procedures, and find that MOPD can struggle to recover some teacher capabilities. Because distillation occurs on student-generated prefixes, the student initialization can strongly affect subsequent recovery. However, initial benchmark performance is not a reliable predictor of a good MOPD initialization. For example, merge initialization can start below SFT warm-up yet finish higher after MOPD. We further find that effective merging depends on both the relative teacher contributions and the overall merge scale, with some strong configurations lying outside the simplex of convex parameter averaging. Thus, selecting a good merge initialization requires evaluating not only its immediate performance but also the learning it enables under MOPD, making one-shot coefficient search difficult. We propose Iterative Merging for MOPD (IM-MOPD), which starts from a uniform merge and progressively adds task-vector increments for under-recovered domains during distillation. In a 5-domain setting, IM-MOPD achieves higher average normalized recovery than MOPD with either uniform merge initialization or SFT warm-up, showing that effective teacher contributions can be determined progressively during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多教师在策略蒸馏 (MOPD) 中，初始化的好坏不能靠初始 benchmark 分数判断——merge 初始化可能起点低于 SFT warm-up、MOPD 之后反而更高。提出 IM-MOPD：从均匀合并出发，在蒸馏过程中逐步为恢复不足的领域加入 task-vector 增量，5 领域设定下平均归一化恢复率高于用均匀合并或 SFT warm-up 初始化的 MOPD。
Motivation: MOPD 在学生自己生成的 prefix 上做蒸馏，学生初始化强烈影响后续恢复，而初始 benchmark 表现无法预测好的初始化，一次性系数搜索因此难以奏效。
Method: IM-MOPD 从均匀合并出发，在蒸馏过程中针对恢复不足的领域逐步叠加 task-vector 增量；有效教师贡献由相对教师占比与整体 merge scale 共同决定，部分强配置落在凸参数平均的单纯形之外。
Result: 在 5 领域设定下，IM-MOPD 的平均归一化恢复 (average normalized recovery) 高于以均匀合并初始化或 SFT warm-up 初始化的 MOPD；merge 初始化可起点低于 SFT warm-up 而 MOPD 结束时更高。
Conclusion: 有效的教师贡献可以在训练过程中逐步确定，初始化选择应看它在 MOPD 下能带来的学习而非即时性能，一次性系数搜索因此不可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimizing and Securing the Modern Watermarking Channel for Images
papers.abstract_en: To comply with recent regulations requiring traceable generated content, modern watermarking has adopted multi-bit post-hoc watermarking schemes. These modern designs rest on an encoder-decoder pair implemented as deep neural networks. These models are usually treated as pure black-boxes trained end-to-end, with the noise of the watermarking channel modeled through a fixed set of geometric and valuemetric transforms applied to watermarked images. We argue that this purely empirical approach leads to unquestioned design flaws and a lack of theoretical performance guarantees. This work proposes a general theoretical model of modern post-hoc watermarking schemes grounded in a statistical analysis of the outputs of the encoder/decoder pair. We show that these deep neural networks implicitly define a watermarking channel modeled as parallel AWGN channels, with messages transmitted using BPSK modulation. This imposes a binary alphabet, greatly limiting the capacity of these watermarking systems. Another fatal flaw is their lack of a secret key, making them intrinsically insecure. We make this notion of watermarking security precise for post-hoc schemes by linking it to the possibility of estimating the secret key under a given statistical model of the decoder's output. By putting together the results from this theoretical analysis, we introduce SNW: a novel post-hoc watermarking system that significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines in terms of capacity while also providing strong security guarantees. Notably, it does not depend on a fixed codebook or binary alphabet, allowing it to reach a rate close to Shannon capacity through the use of capacity-achieving error-correcting codes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把图像多比特后处理水印 (post-hoc watermarking) 的编码器/解码器对当作统计对象建模，证明深度网络隐式定义了并联 AWGN 信道、用 BPSK 调制，因而字母表被限制为二元、容量受限且无密钥而不安全。据此提出 SNW：不依赖固定码本或二元字母表，用逼近 Shannon 容量的纠错码达到接近容量的速率，并给出可由解码器输出统计估计密钥来定义的安全性。
Motivation: 现代水印为满足可追溯生成内容的监管要求转向多比特方案，却把编码器/解码器当纯黑盒端到端训练、把信道噪声写成固定几何与值度变换，导致设计缺陷无人质疑且缺少理论性能保证。
Method: 对编码器/解码器对的输出做统计分析，建立通用的后处理水印理论模型：把隐式水印信道刻画为并联 AWGN 信道加 BPSK 调制；把安全性精确为在给定解码器输出统计模型下能否估计密钥；再据此设计 SNW 系统，用容量逼近纠错码取代固定码本与二元字母表。
Result: 理论上证明现有深度网络水印隐式采用并联 AWGN 信道与 BPSK，强制二元字母表从而大幅限制容量，且缺少密钥、内在不安全；SNW 在容量上显著优于现有 state-of-the-art 基线，并提供强安全保证，速率接近 Shannon 容量。
Conclusion: 把水印当作显式通信信道来建模，可以同时解除二元字母表带来的容量上限并补上密钥安全；SNW 说明容量与安全性可以靠容量逼近纠错码和密钥化设计一起拿到。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Emotion Concepts Generalize Across Sources, Modalities, and Architectures in Vision-Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies suggest that large language models encode emotion concepts as structured internal representations, but most existing work focuses on text and a single architecture. Therefore, we ask, do emotion concepts generalize across sources, modalities, and architectures in vision--language models (VLMs)? To address this, we construct CMES (Cross-Modal Emotion Stimuli), a multi-source collection of emotion-conditioned stories, real facial expressions, synthetic portraits, and synthetic emotion-evoking scenes. For each stimulus source, we extract a separate set of six Ekman emotion vectors from each of three VLMs. We report four main findings as follows: 1) Image-derived emotion vectors form a low-dimensional geometry similar to that of text-derived vectors. Valence is relatively stable across sources, while arousal varies more. 2) Text- and image-derived emotion vectors have modest cosine similarity but still show held-out cross-modal correspondence. Text-derived vectors can also steer image interpretation. 3) Cross-architecture correspondence remains even when native cosine is near zero. Transformations estimated from generic ImageNet activations recover both correspondence and causal transfer without using the six emotion vectors or their labels. 4) After aligning representations across architectures, we construct a shared emotion subspace that preserves affective geometry and selective steering effects. The corresponding consensus emotion vectors also generalize to a held-out fourth architecture at two model sizes. These results suggest that emotion representations can share relational structure and causal effects across sources, modalities, and architectures, even when individual vector directions differ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建跨模态情绪刺激集 CMES（故事、真实人脸、合成肖像、合成场景），从三个 VLM 各提六维 Ekman 情绪向量，证明情绪概念的 relational structure 与因果 steering 可跨来源、模态、架构泛化：图像与文本向量呈低维相似几何，跨架构对齐后共识向量还能迁移到未见过的第四个架构（两种规模）。
Motivation: 现有工作多在纯文本、单一架构上讨论 LLM 的情绪概念结构，缺少情绪表征能否跨来源、跨模态、跨 VLM 架构保持一致的检验。
Method: 构建 CMES 多源情绪刺激集（情绪条件故事、真实面部表情、合成肖像、合成情绪场景），对每种来源从三个 VLM 分别提取六维 Ekman 情绪向量；用 ImageNet 通用激活估计的变换恢复跨架构对应与因果迁移，再对齐表征构建共享情绪子空间。
Result: 图像派生向量与文本派生向量形成相似的低维几何，valence 跨来源相对稳定而 arousal 变异更大；文本与图像向量原生 cosine 相似度仅为 modest，但仍存在 held-out 跨模态对应，且文本向量可引导图像解读；跨架构对应在原生 cosine 接近零时依然存在，基于 ImageNet 激活的变换无需六个情绪向量或其标签即可恢复对应与因果迁移；对齐后构建的共识情绪向量泛化到未见过的第四个架构的两种模型规模。
Conclusion: 情绪表征的共享点是关系结构与因果效应而非单个向量方向，因此跨架构对齐后可得到跨来源、模态、架构通用的情绪子空间与共识向量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive Dual Smoothing for Column Generation
papers.abstract_en: Solving large-scale linear programs efficiently is an important challenge in many optimization settings. A key technique is column generation, which alternates between solving the master problem over a restricted subset of the variables, and using a pricing subproblem to identify new variables to add. The pricing subproblem is guided by the dual solution of the current restricted master problem, but oscillations in these dual solutions can substantially slow convergence. Dual stabilization methods address this issue. Dual smoothing is a common stabilization method, which guides the pricing subproblem using a combination of the current dual solution and duals from previous iterations. However, while past dual solutions can stabilize the dual trajectory, they do not necessarily guide pricing towards useful new variables. We therefore introduce predictive dual smoothing, which instead combines the current dual solution with a learned prediction of future duals to steer pricing towards variables that are more useful in subsequent iterations. The predictor is trained offline using supervision extracted from standard column generation trajectories and is used only to modify the pricing subproblem's objective function, while exact reduced-cost checks and fallback pricing with the unsmoothed duals preserve correctness. Experiments on cutting stock and generalized assignment problems show that predictive dual smoothing substantially reduces generated columns and wall-clock time relative to standard column generation and existing classical and learned stabilization methods. These gains extend to out-of-distribution instance sizes, and predictive smoothing provides further improvements when combined with strong classical stabilization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 列生成 (column generation) 中对偶解振荡拖慢收敛，提出预测式对偶平滑：用离线训练的预测器给出未来对偶解，与当前对偶组合来引导定价子问题目标。切割下料与广义分配问题实验显示，生成列数和墙钟时间相对标准列生成及已有经典/学习型稳定化方法大幅下降，且能迁移到分布外实例规模。
Motivation: 列生成的定价子问题由受限主问题的对偶解引导，对偶轨迹振荡会显著拖慢收敛；经典对偶平滑虽用历史对偶稳定轨迹，却未必把定价导向有用的新变量。
Method: 提出 predictive dual smoothing：预测器离线训练，监督信号取自标准列生成轨迹，仅用于修改定价子问题目标函数；精确 reduced-cost 检查与用未平滑对偶的 fallback pricing 保证正确性。
Result: 在 cutting stock 与 generalized assignment 问题上，相对标准列生成、经典稳定化与已有学习型稳定化方法，生成列数与墙钟时间均显著下降；收益可迁移到分布外实例规模，并与强经典稳定化叠加带来进一步改进。
Conclusion: 用可学习的未来对偶预测替代历史对偶做平滑，能在保持列生成正确性的同时更快收敛，且与经典稳定化互补。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Token Alignment: Event Completion for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge between language models through teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. With different tokenizers, a single teacher token may require multiple student tokens to generate, creating intermediate states where the event is entered but not yet completed. Existing cross-tokenizer methods align tokens or text spans to construct comparable prediction targets. We study a complementary problem after partial generation: once the student produces a prefix of a teacher token, multiple next tokens may complete the same remaining bytes, but the teacher only specifies the required completion rather than how probability should be divided among these valid continuations. We introduce Event-Set Completion Distillation (ESCD), which complements cross-tokenizer probability alignment with completion-set supervision. ESCD aggregates prefix-related teacher events and supervises the total probability of byte-compatible one-step student completions, avoiding tokenizer-dependent probability splits among individual tokens. The method reuses student trajectories and predictions, requiring neither additional rollouts nor changes to the student vocabulary. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in mathematics, code, and scientific reasoning across model families and tokenizers, extending to large-scale MoE distillation from a 1T teacher to a 35B student. Local analyses show that retaining completion sets better matches the reference supervision, while one-step completion covers over 99% of observed compatible teacher mass after partial event entry in the studied tokenizer pairs. These findings support event entry and event completion as complementary supervision targets for cross-tokenizer knowledge transfer. Code will be released on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy 蒸馏中，教师一个 token 可能对应学生多个 token，学生已进入事件但尚未完成时，教师只规定必须完成的字节而不规定概率如何在多个合法续写间分配。ESCD 聚合与前缀相关的教师事件，对字节兼容的学生一步完成 (one-step completion) 的总概率做监督，避开 tokenizer 依赖的概率切分；在数学、代码与科学推理上跨模型族与 tokenizer 一致提升，并可从 1T 教师蒸馏到 35B MoE 学生。
Motivation: 跨 tokenizer OPD 里教师 token 与学生 token 不是一对多对齐，部分生成后存在“事件已进入未完成”的中间态；现有方法只对齐 token 或文本 span，无法处理教师对多个合法续写只给完成要求、不给概率分配的问题。
Method: 提出 Event-Set Completion Distillation (ESCD)：聚合与前缀相关的教师事件，监督字节兼容的一步学生完成的总概率，避免对单个 token 做 tokenizer 依赖的概率切分；复用学生轨迹与预测，不需要额外 rollout，也不改学生词表。
Result: 在数学、代码、科学推理上跨模型族与 tokenizer 一致提升，并扩展到从 1T 教师到 35B 学生的大规模 MoE 蒸馏；局部分析显示保留 completion set 更贴近参考监督，且在所研究的 tokenizer 对中，部分事件进入后一步完成覆盖超过 99% 的观测到的兼容教师质量。
Conclusion: 事件进入 (event entry) 与事件完成 (event completion) 应作为跨 tokenizer 知识迁移的互补监督目标，按完成集合而非单 token 分配概率。

papers.title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeLMRoute 把 LLM 路由拆成三段：先用决策模型对查询抽取与候选无关、可解释的语义证据（如推理需求、外部知识使用）并保留为概率分布，再由轻量监督路由器估计候选模型性能，最后才施加部署目标。在 LLMRouterBench（15 数据集、20 候选模型、11,481 条查询）上平均准确率 72.08%±0.45，分组五折 out-of-fold 达 72.64%，高于最强固定候选的 69.23%。
Motivation: 现有路由直接从查询嵌入、模型表示、偏好数据或聚类学决策，路由所用表示很少明确说明查询到底需要什么，性能导向与成本感知目标也难以共用同一表示。
Method: 三段解耦：决策模型针对一组与候选无关的可解释问题（推理需求、外部知识等）给出判断并保留为概率分布，形成概率语义状态；轻量监督路由器据此估计候选模型性能；性能估计之后再施加路由目标，使同一语义状态同时支撑性能导向与成本感知决策。
Result: LLMRouterBench（15 数据集、20 候选模型、11,481 查询）上平均准确率 72.08%±0.45，分组五折 out-of-fold 72.64%，最强固定候选为 69.23%；该表示在语义、稠密、词法与领域级表示中平均性能最高。在单独的 13 模型性能-成本设定中，五个分组 split 全部提升，平均 PerfGain 2.66%。
Conclusion: 把候选无关的概率语义证据与性能估计、部署目标分开，可以在同一表示下同时支撑性能导向和成本感知的 LLM 路由，并超过最强固定候选。

papers.title: From Human Narrative to Harmonic Structure: A Human-Centered Investigation of Algorithmic Music Generation through the Chord Wheel Diagram
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AI-based music generation can produce compositions that satisfy formal requirements of tonality and musical coherence. However, whether musical expression can be described by mathematical properties alone remains a fundamental question. Human composers operate within personal and cultural contexts that influence harmonic decisions and deliberate departures from established patterns. This study investigates six narrative-driven popular songs by Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash, and Ritchie Valens. Original human harmonies are compared with outputs of an explainable computational harmonizer operating on the same melodies without access to the original chord progressions. We examine harmonic vocabulary, functional persistence, repetition, non-diatonic events, and tension-resolution patterns using Chord Wheel Diagrams and BPMN-based representations. Results show that high melody-chord compatibility does not necessarily imply preservation of the original human harmonic decision pattern. Some generated harmonizations retain the economical structure of the reference, while others alter harmonic diversity or suppress distinctive events while remaining compatible with the melody. Rather than quantifying artistic quality, the study introduces narrative-conditioned harmonic structure as a complementary perspective for computational music analysis. The findings suggest that generative systems may benefit from modeling not only harmonic correctness, but also structural identity, context, and human compositional intention.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, link to GIT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash、Ritchie Valens 六首叙事驱动流行歌，用可解释的计算和声器在不给原和弦进行的前提下重配和声，再用 Chord Wheel Diagram 与 BPMM 表示对比原人声和声。发现旋律-和声高兼容并不等于保留原有人为和声决策模式：有的生成方案保留了参考的经济结构，有的改变和声多样性或压制特色非调内事件，却仍与旋律兼容。
Motivation: 现有 AI 音乐生成能满足调性与连贯的形式要求，但和声表达能否仅由数学性质描述仍是根本问题；人类作曲者会在个人与文化语境中刻意偏离既定模式，而这一层结构身份未被建模。
Method: 选取六首叙事驱动流行歌，用可解释的计算和声器 (explainable computational harmonizer) 在仅给旋律、不提供原和弦进行的条件下生成配和声；以 Chord Wheel Diagram 与 BPMN 表示，从和声词汇、功能持续性、重复、非调内事件、张力-解决模式五个维度对比原人声和声与生成结果。
Result: 六首歌的对比显示：高旋律-和声兼容度不必然保留原人声和声决策模式；部分生成配和声保留参考的经济结构，另一些在保持旋律兼容的同时改变和声多样性或压制标志性事件。研究明确不以量化艺术质量为目标。
Conclusion: 生成式音乐系统除保证和声正确性外，还需建模结构身份、语境与人类创作意图；叙事条件下的和声结构可作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。

papers.title: SurgGMF: Fully Causal Gaussian Motion Forecasting for Anticipatory Surgical Scene Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic surgical scene modeling is essential for robotic perception, simulation, and decision support. Although existing neural rendering methods enable efficient reconstruction and rendering of deformable surgical scenes, they remain primarily focused on observed-frame reconstruction rather than forecasting future scene states. To this end, we present SurgGMF, a fully causal Gaussian motion forecasting framework for anticipatory surgical scene rendering. Rather than predicting future RGB images directly, SurgGMF forecasts future Gaussian motion states represented by position, scale, and rotation residuals (X/S/R) from historical Gaussian motion fields. To prevent target leakage, we introduce a full-causal-last rendering protocol, where future Gaussian states are rendered without accessing target-frame Gaussian attributes while preserving causal appearance propagation. We evaluate SurgGMF on 12 EndoNeRF and StereoMIS video slices using neural temporal learners and classical dynamics baselines under a unified forecasting protocol. Learned Gaussian motion forecasting consistently outperforms classical dynamics baselines in render space, demonstrating gains beyond hand-crafted state extrapolation. Latency analysis further reveals an accuracy--efficiency trade-off: under the current implementations, TKAN achieves the highest accuracy, whereas GRU and LSTM provide more favorable module-level latency profiles. These results establish SurgGMF as a reproducible framework for causal Gaussian motion forecasting and advance surgical Gaussian representations from retrospective reconstruction toward predictive scene modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SurgGMF 把手术场景的高斯表示从
Motivation: 现有神经渲染方法只重建已观测帧，无法预测未来场景状态，限制了机器人感知、仿真与决策支持中的预判能力。
Method: 从历史 Gaussian motion field 预测未来高斯的位置/尺度/旋转残差 (X/S/R)，采用 full-causal-last 渲染协议避免目标帧属性泄漏，同时保留因果外观传播；用神经时序模型 (TKAN、GRU、LSTM) 与经典动力学基线在统一预报协议下对比。
Result: 在 12 个 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 视频切片上，学习式高斯运动预报在渲染空间上一致优于经典动力学基线；延迟分析显示精度-效率权衡：TKAN 精度最高，GRU 与 LSTM 的模块级延迟更优。
Conclusion: 因果高斯运动预报可把手术高斯表示从回顾性重建推向预测式场景建模，且学习式预报超越手工状态外推，但需在精度与延迟间按实现取舍。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Visual Generators Need from Teachers: Rethinking Representation Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment speeds up diffusion transformer training by pulling an intermediate block of the model (student) toward features of a frozen pretrained encoder (teacher). Which teacher layer to align, and for how long, is still set by convention, and each alternative costs a training run. We find that alignment helps where the student cannot linearly recover the teacher's features, not where it already resembles them. Since a deep teacher layer is largely predictable from the one below, we isolate what each layer adds, its increment, and measure how much of it an unaligned student recovers. The student fills the teacher's hierarchy from the bottom up and stalls near the top, which we call hierarchy filling: even after 400K steps it recovers almost none of the deepest. The recoverability gap is the unrecovered share of an increment, read from one unaligned checkpoint. In short runs that each align one teacher layer at one block, the gap nearly reproduces their ranking by FID improvement, and CKA, a measure of feature similarity, largely reverses it. Representation Alignment and Recoverability Estimation (RARE) picks the teacher layer with the largest gap before training. During training, it tracks each token's remaining distance to that layer, the online counterpart of the gap, weights tokens by it, and phases out the loss once the average distance stops falling. With SiT-B/2 on ImageNet $256\times256$, RARE reaches an FID of 18.02 without guidance and 4.46 with it, ahead of seven alignment baselines including REPA, iREPA and HASTE. It also trains in 14% fewer GPU-hours than iREPA. Its FID stays below iREPA's across model scales, teachers, datasets and backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RARE 用「可恢复性差距」(recoverability gap) 替代约定俗成的教师层选择：差距是学生从单个未对齐 checkpoint 中未能恢复的增量份额，据此在训练前选教师层，训练中按每个 token 到该层的剩余距离加权并在平均距离不再下降时退火损失。在 SiT-B/2、ImageNet 256×256 上无 guidance FID 18.02、有 guidance 4.46，超过含 REPA、iREPA、HASTE 在内的七个对齐基线，GPU-hours 比 iREPA 少 14%。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 的表征对齐中，选哪一层教师、对齐多久仍靠约定，而每种替代方案都要重跑一次训练；CKA 这类特征相似度给出的排序与 FID 提升排序基本相反。
Method: 把深层教师特征分解为相对下一层的增量，度量未对齐学生能恢复多少，得到可恢复性差距；RARE 据此在训练前选差距最大的教师层，训练中追踪每个 token 到该层的剩余距离并据此加权 token，当平均距离停止下降时逐步退火对齐损失。
Result: 学生自下而上填充教师层级并在顶部附近停滞，400K 步后对最深层增量几乎恢复不到；单层单 block 的短跑中，可恢复性差距几乎复现各层按 FID 改善的排序，而 CKA 大体反转该排序。SiT-B/2 在 ImageNet 256×256 上 FID 18.02（无 guidance）与 4.46（有 guidance），领先七个对齐基线（含 REPA、iREPA、HASTE），GPU-hours 比 iREPA 少 14%，且在不同模型规模、教师、数据集和 backbone 上 FID 均低于 iREPA。
Conclusion: 对齐应施加在学生线性不可恢复的教师增量上，可恢复性差距可从单个未对齐 checkpoint 读出并替代逐层试跑的约定式选择。

summary_sections.result: 学生自下而上填充教师层级并在顶部附近停滞，400K 步后对最深层增量几乎恢复不到；单层单 block 的短跑中，可恢复性差距几乎复现各层按 FID 改善的排序，而 CKA 大体反转该排序。SiT-B/2 在 ImageNet 256×256 上 FID 18.02（无 guidance）与 4.46（有 guidance），领先七个对齐基线（含 REPA、iREPA、HASTE），GPU-hours 比 iREPA 少 14%，且在不同模型规模、教师、数据集和 backbone 上 FID 均低于 iREPA。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对齐应施加在学生线性不可恢复的教师增量上，可恢复性差距可从单个未对齐 checkpoint 读出并替代逐层试跑的约定式选择。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Analysis of Next-Token Prediction under Markovian Data
papers.abstract_en: We develop an information-theoretic framework for generalization in next-token prediction under temporally dependent data. We consider independent trajectories generated by finite-memory Markov processes and distinguish algorithmic dependence, quantified by mutual information, from temporal dependence, characterized by mixing. For cross-entropy loss, we derive an expected generalization bound using the Donsker--Varadhan variational representation and a McDiarmid-type concentration inequality for Markov chains. A refinement captures the joint effect of context length and temporal mixing through the mixing properties of the history-state process. We then extend the bound through a rate--distortion formulation, replacing mutual information with the minimum information rate required to represent the learned model within a prescribed distortion in the generalization gap, yielding informative guarantees for deterministic algorithms over continuous hypothesis spaces. For margin-based prediction, we derive explicit bounds for linear and self-attention next-token predictors via noisy low-dimensional compression, revealing the roles of context length, model complexity, sample size, margin, and temporal mixing. Experiments on TinyStories and ETTh2 show that longer contexts can reduce both training and test losses, but typically reduce training loss more, enlarging the generalization gap. A complementary ETTh2 analysis identifies an effective predictive-memory scale near 24 hours, with no statistically supported improvement beyond this scale, offering a plausible explanation for test-performance saturation at larger contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限记忆 Markov 过程生成的独立轨迹上，为时序依赖数据的 next-token prediction 建立信息论泛化框架：用互信息刻画算法依赖、用 mixing 刻画时间依赖，交叉熵损失下经 Donsker–Varadhan 变分表示与 Markov 链 McDiarmid 型集中不等式导出泛化界，并以 rate–distortion 用最小信息率替换互信息。TinyStories 与 ETTh2 实验显示更长上下文同时降低训练与测试损失但更大幅度压低训练损失，从而拉大泛化间隙；ETTh2 的有效预测记忆尺度约 24 小时，超过该尺度无统计支持的改进。
Motivation: 标准泛化理论假设样本独立，而语言与时序数据的样本由时间依赖过程生成，算法依赖（互信息）与时间依赖（mixing）混在一起，导致对确定性算法与连续假设空间的泛化保证失效或过松。
Method: 在有限记忆 Markov 过程的独立轨迹设定下，对交叉熵损失用 Donsker–Varadhan 变分表示加 Markov 链 McDiarmid 型集中不等式导出期望泛化界，并用 history-state 过程的 mixing 性质细化出上下文长度与时间混合的联合效应；再以 rate–distortion 形式把互信息替换为在给定泛化间隙失真下表示学习模型所需的最小信息率，覆盖连续假设空间上的确定性算法；对 margin 损失，经含噪低维压缩给出线性与 self-attention 两类 next-token 预测器的显式界。
Result: TinyStories 与 ETTh2 上，更长上下文同时降低训练与测试损失，但训练损失下降更多，泛化间隙随之扩大；ETTh2 的互补分析给出约 24 小时的有效预测记忆尺度，超过该尺度没有统计支持的改进，可解释更大上下文下测试性能饱和。界中显式出现上下文长度、模型复杂度、样本量、margin 与 temporal mixing 五个量。
Conclusion: 时序依赖数据的泛化应把算法依赖与 mixing 分开处理，rate–distortion 版本对确定性算法与连续空间给出可操作保证；上下文收益存在由数据有效记忆决定的上限，盲目加长上下文主要扩大而非缩小泛化间隙。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Edge-Level Automorphism in GNNs: A Quantitative Framework and Effective Designs For Link Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for learning node and link embeddings through permutation-equivariant aggregation. However, standard GNNs collapse automorphic nodes, i.e., those with identical structural roles (or orbits) into indistinguishable representations, leading to the node automorphism problem. This collapse limits their expressive power and degrades link prediction performance. Existing approaches to characterize GNN expressiveness rely primarily on Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) analyses, but these methods are typically qualitative and often misaligned with empirical results. To address this gap, we begin by introducing a novel quantitative framework to assess GNN expressiveness for link prediction. We first formalize edge-level automorphism through edge orbits, which capture the set of structural role pairs for nodes that share a link. Then, we introduce the edge automorphism ratio (EAR), a scalar metric that quantifies a GNN's ability to distinguish links in a given graph. We empirically demonstrate that EAR correlates strongly with performance, validating its practical benefit. Building on this insight, we design EDGE-ORBIT EQUIVARIANT GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK (EO-GNN), a GNN architecture that addresses automorphism collapse while preserving equivariance and incurring minimal computational overhead. EO-GNN accomplishes this through two core designs combined with WL-based node hashes: (i) automorphism-aware dropouts and (ii) subgraph orbit-biased aggregation. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real graphs show improvements of up to 42.36% and 28.44%, respectively, in predicting links in scenarios with high automorphism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 GNN 把结构角色相同（同 orbit）的节点压成不可区分表示、损害链路预测的问题，提出边级自同构的定量刻画：edge orbit 与标量指标 edge automorphism ratio (EAR)，并据此设计 EO-GNN（automorphism-aware dropout + subgraph orbit-biased aggregation + WL node hash）。EAR 与链路预测性能强相关；在合成图与真实图上，高自同构场景下链路预测分别提升最高 42.36% 与 28.44%。
Motivation: 标准 GNN 的置换等变聚合会把 automorphic 节点折叠为相同表示（node automorphism problem），限制表达力并拖累链路预测；而已有 WL 分析多为定性、且常与实证结果不一致。
Method: 先形式化 edge-level automorphism（edge orbits，刻画共享连边的节点对的结构角色），提出标量指标 EAR 度量 GNN 区分图中连边的能力；再提出 EO-GNN，用 automorphism-aware dropouts 与 subgraph orbit-biased aggregation 两项设计配合 WL-based node hashes，在保持等变性的同时以极小计算开销缓解折叠。
Result: EAR 与链路预测性能强相关（实证验证其实际指示作用）；EO-GNN 在合成图与真实图上的评测中，高自同构场景下链路预测提升分别最高达 42.36% 与 28.44%。
Conclusion: GNN 的链路预测能力可以用 EAR 这类标量指标定量刻画并预测，而针对 edge orbit 设计的等变架构能在高自同构图上切实缓解表示折叠、提升预测。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Dynamic Flow, Static Graph: KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Serving on Mobile NPUs
papers.abstract_en: On-device large language model (LLM) serving is a cornerstone of local-first personal intelligence, offering users data sovereignty, strong privacy guarantees, and freedom from cloud API latency and cost. Although KV caching is widely used to reduce latency in long-context inference, existing designs were primarily optimized for cloud GPUs with dynamic execution environments and abundant memory bandwidth. These architectural assumptions do not hold on mobile NPUs, where computation graphs must be statically compiled and both memory capacity and I/O bandwidth are severely constrained. In this work, we present a compute-storage co-design for mobile-centric prefix and non-prefix KV reuse. We first propose an intra-graph mechanism that maps selective KV recomputation onto static NPU graphs, reconciling algorithmic dynamicity with NPU staticity. We further develop an inter-graph scheduler to optimize chunk merging and minimize padding with dynamic programming. To address mobile bandwidth limitations, we introduce a hierarchical KV manager featuring a tree-hash-semantic hybrid structure, along with cost-aware prefetching and eviction policies. We also build a two-dimensional pipeline that overlaps KV loading, rerotation, and storage with NPU execution, hiding data-movement latency. Experiments across representative on-device workloads and LLMs show that our design reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) by $40-60\%$ compared with no reuse and prefix-only caching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向移动 NPU 的端侧 LLM 服务，提出计算-存储协同的 KV cache 复用设计：把选择性 KV 重计算映射到静态 NPU 图内，用动态规划做跨图 chunk 合并与 padding 最小化，并以树-哈希-语义混合的分层 KV 管理配合代价感知预取/淘汰和二维流水线隐藏搬运延迟。在代表性端侧负载与 LLM 上，相比无复用与仅前缀缓存，TTFT 降低 40–60%。
Motivation: KV cache 设计原本面向云 GPU：动态执行环境、充足内存带宽；而移动 NPU 要求静态编译计算图，内存容量与 I/O 带宽都严重受限，长上下文推理的延迟收益因此难以搬到端侧。
Method: 四个组件：图内 (intra-graph) 机制把选择性 KV 重计算落到静态 NPU 图上；图间 (inter-graph) 调度器用动态规划优化 chunk 合并并最小化 padding；分层 KV 管理器采用 tree-hash-semantic 混合结构，配代价感知的预取与淘汰策略；二维流水线把 KV 加载、rerotation、存储与 NPU 执行重叠。
Result: 在代表性端侧工作负载与 LLM 上，相比 no reuse 与 prefix-only caching 两种基线，time-to-first-token (TTFT) 降低 40–60%。
Conclusion: 端侧 KV 复用要同时解决静态图与动态算法的冲突、padding 开销和带宽瓶颈，计算-存储协同设计能在移动 NPU 上把首 token 延迟显著压下来。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Geometry as Address: Routing Attention to Visual Memory for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation requires recovering previously observed content from an ever-growing visual history. Existing approaches either search historical context implicitly or reconstruct it into persistent 3D memory, facing inefficient memory access or accumulated geometric errors. Our key insight is that geometry need not explain the scene--it only needs to determine where visual memory should be read from, while attention decides what should be recovered. Based on this insight, we introduce GEAR, a Geometry-Enabled Attention Routing framework that uses geometry as an explicit token-level address for visual memory. Rather than fusing historical observations into a persistent global 3D representation, GEAR retains them as frame latents and uses per-frame geometry only to establish token-level correspondences with target views, thereby avoiding persistent error accumulation from global fusion. Guided by these correspondences, Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) selectively injects geometrically matched historical features into noisy target patches during denoising. We further introduce an Invisible Octree to accumulate visibility evidence and reject geometrically plausible but occluded correspondences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEAR achieves state-of-the-art visual quality, precise camera control, and revisit consistency, enabling minute-long video generation along challenging trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEAR 把几何当作视觉记忆的 token 级地址而非场景表示：历史观测保留为 frame latents，仅用逐帧几何建立与目标视角的对应关系，再由 Geometric Correspondence Attention 在去噪时注入匹配的历史特征，并用 Invisible Octree 累积可见性证据剔除被遮挡的伪对应。摘要称其达到 SOTA 视觉质量、精确相机控制与 revisit 一致性，可沿挑战性轨迹生成分钟级视频。
Motivation: 长时程相机可控视频生成要从不断增长的视觉历史中恢复已见内容：隐式搜索历史效率低，重建为持久 3D 记忆则累积几何误差。
Method: GEAR（Geometry-Enabled Attention Routing）不融合出全局 3D 表示，历史观测保留为 frame latents，逐帧几何只用于建立与目标视角的 token 级对应；Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) 在去噪过程中把几何匹配的历史特征选择性注入含噪目标 patch；Invisible Octree 累积可见性证据，拒绝几何上合理但实际被遮挡的对应。
Result: 摘要报告 GEAR 达到 state-of-the-art 的视觉质量、精确的相机控制与 revisit 一致性，并支持沿挑战性轨迹的分钟级 (minute-long) 视频生成；未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 几何只需决定从哪里读取视觉记忆、由 attention 决定恢复什么，把持久 3D 融合换成地址式读取即可避免全局融合的误差累积并支撑长时程相机可控生成。

papers.title: DBCF: Dual-Branch Complementary Fusion of Foundation Models for Generalized Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: As image generation and editing technologies have progressed substantially, facial forgeries pose significant challenges to privacy and public safety. Due to limited ability to capture forgery cues, existing small-scale forgery detection models often struggle to generalize across various domains and unseen manipulations. To address this limitation, researchers have turned to large-scale foundation models, which can provide richer representations and better generalization. Nevertheless, relying on a single foundation model alone remains insufficient for effective forgery detection. While models like CLIP offer robust global semantic cues, they lack the capacity to capture detailed local facial features. In contrast, DINO excels at capturing local structural features of faces, but provides weaker global semantic context. To fully utilize the synergies among multiple foundation models, we propose a hierarchical multi-granular framework that integrates complementary pretrained representations. Specifically, a Global Context Branch (GCB) based on CLIP captures holistic semantic cues, while a Fine-grained Cue Branch (FCB) built on DINOv3 captures localized structural irregularities. In addition, we design a feature fusion module that enables parameter-efficient adaptation of the frozen foundation backbones by adaptively extracting and integrating complementary features from the two models. By jointly leveraging global context and fine-grained cues, our method learns more comprehensive forgery representations and achieves strong cross-manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the benefit of the proposed design, particularly under cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings.

papers.title: Quality Determines Direction, Length Shapes Magnitude: Length Control for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) changes not only what language models say, but also how much they say, often increasing response length at the cost of token efficiency. Controlling this length growth is particularly challenging in open-ended RL because (i) response length is entangled with quality, (ii) open-ended tasks lack a natural success boundary for deciding when efficiency should be prioritized, and (iii) dense, graded rewards often yield small within-group quality margins, making quality-induced advantages especially sensitive to reward-level length shaping, which can perturb their magnitudes and even reverse their signs. We therefore adopt an asymmetric principle: quality should determine the direction of reinforcement, while length should only shape its magnitude. We instantiate this principle with Quality-Gated Length Advantage Shaping (QGLAS), which first computes advantages from quality rewards alone, then adds bounded bonuses only to shorter positive-advantage responses, leaving all other advantages unchanged. The bonus strength is further adapted to within-group quality separation, allowing conciseness to matter more when quality-favored responses are similar and less when their quality differences are clear. Across different model families, open-ended benchmarks, and reward sources, QGLAS consistently achieves a stronger quality--length trade-off than representative baselines. At approximately 30% compression, QGLAS retains 98.4--102.0% of the macro-average quality gains achieved by quality-only RL over the base model, compared with 68.3--75.5% for these baselines at comparable compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 QGLAS（Quality-Gated Length Advantage Shaping）：优势只由质量奖励决定方向，长度仅通过有界加成调节幅度，且只加给正优势的短回复。约 30% 压缩下保留 98.4–102.0% 的宏平均质量增益，基线仅 68.3–75.5%。
Motivation: 开放式 RL 中回复长度与质量纠缠，任务缺少天然成功边界，稠密分级奖励组内质量差距小，长度塑形易扰动甚至反转优势符号。
Method: QGLAS 先仅用质量奖励计算优势，再只对正优势的更短回复加有界长度加成，其余优势不变；加成强度随组内质量分离度自适应。
Result: 在不同模型族、开放式基准与奖励来源上，约 30% 压缩时 QGLAS 保留 98.4–102.0% 的宏平均质量增益（相对基线模型的质量-only RL），同等压缩下代表性基线仅 68.3–75.5%。
Conclusion: 质量决定强化方向、长度只调幅度的非对称设计，能在压缩回复的同时基本保住质量-only RL 的增益。

papers.title: From Pixel Generation to Topological Inference: Structural Dual Super-Resolution for Trustworthy Cross-Physical-Domain Trabecular Morphology Learning
papers.abstract_en: Clinical CT and UHRCT cannot resolve individual trabeculae, whereas synchrotron radiation microCT (SRμCT) provides 3.2μm high-resolution references but is not applicable for in vivo imaging. The two domains differ by 31.25x in resolution, are only coarsely paired, and have drastically different data volumes. Moreover, clinical UHRCT suffers from severe partial volume effects, strong noise, and beam hardening/scatter artifacts, while SRμCT is nearly free. Existing super-resolution networks and pretrained-prior methods underperform because they target pixel generation--diverse details and SSIM/PSNR--and do not explicitly model these physical differences. This indicates that 32x super-resolution via pixel generation is intrinsically ill-posed. We propose a paradigm shift from pixel generation to topological inference: deterministically predicting invariant microstructures from macro-scale low-resolution inputs, evaluated by morphological parameters. We realize this paradigm via structural dual super-resolution, coupling forward physical degradation (micro-to-macro) with inverse structural inference (macro-to-micro) through structural duality constraints. The method is an end-to-end, few-shot, compact structural dual network (SDN), comprising a bidirectional modeling network for forward degradation and inverse reconstruction, a pyramid structural consistency discriminator, and four structural duality constraints. On the testset, SDN achieves morphological parameters largely consistent with SRμCT across 7 metrics, enabling clinical UHRCT with micro-imaging-level morphological quantification, with SSIM reaching 0.8. Trained on 3.2μm SSRF data, the model generalizes well to 3.25μm BSRF data from an independent source, validating cross-source generalization and confirming that the designed network achieves trustworthy structural inference rather than pixel generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 CT 骨小梁超分辨从像素生成改为拓扑推断：用结构双超分辨网络 (SDN) 联合前向物理退化与反向结构推断，通过结构一致性判别器和四条结构对偶约束，从临床 UHRCT 直接预测不随成像变化的骨小梁形态参数。测试集上 7 项形态指标与 SRμCT 参考基本一致，SSIM 达到 0.8，并在 3.25μm BSRF 独立源数据上验证跨源泛化。
Motivation: 临床 CT/UHRCT 分辨率不足以分辨单根骨小梁，与 3.2μm SRμCT 参考相差 31.25 倍，且仅粗配对、数据量悬殊；UHRCT 还有严重部分容积效应、噪声与束硬化/散射伪影，而面向 SSIM/PSNR 的像素生成式超分辨在 32 倍放大下本质上病态。
Method: 提出结构双超分辨：前向物理退化（微→宏）与反向结构推断（宏→微）通过结构对偶约束耦合，实现为端到端、少样本、紧凑的结构双网络 (SDN)，含双向建模网络、金字塔结构一致性判别器和四条结构对偶约束，评价改用形态参数而非像素指标。
Result: 在测试集上 SDN 的形态参数与 SRμCT 在 7 项指标上基本一致，SSIM 达到 0.8；模型在 3.2μm SSRF 数据上训练后，可良好泛化到独立来源的 3.25μm BSRF 数据。
Conclusion: 32 倍超分辨应从像素生成转向对不变微结构的确定性拓扑推断，让临床 UHRCT 获得微成像级形态量化与可信结构推断。

papers.title: PDE-JEPA: Predictive Representation Learning of Latent Dynamics Modeling for Parametric PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Physical trajectories contain more than snapshots of a system: they also reveal how its states evolve under governing conditions. However, representation learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) has largely relied on reconstruction-based objectives that emphasize recovering observed physical fields. In this paper, we investigate predictive representation pretraining as an alternative to reconstruction-based learning. We find that predictive representations preserve rich physical information, yet this advantage alone does not ensure accurate field evolution. Based on these observations, we introduce PDE-JEPA for parametric PDE dynamics. Specifically, we first train an encoder using a masked-latent prediction to capture the underlying regularities of PDE dynamics. To explicitly adapt the pretrained representation toward a more dynamics-aligned state space, we then introduce a geometry projector that aligns latent trajectory geometry with the evolution geometry of physical fields. Finally, building on this geometry-aligned latent space, we further develop a physics-structured latent predictor that decomposes the dynamics into parameter-independent evolution and parameter-dependent response components. Extensive experiments on nine widely used PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by an average of 33.4\% in-distribution, while achieving an average improvement of 51.4\% when extrapolating to unseen governing parameters. The project page is available \href{https://tanpig-x.github.io/PDE-JEPA/}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDE-JEPA 用预测式表征预训练替代重建目标来学习参数化 PDE 的潜在动力学：掩码-潜在预测训练编码器，几何投影器 (geometry projector) 把潜在轨迹几何对齐到物理场的演化几何，物理结构化潜在预测器把动力学拆成与参数无关的演化和与参数相关的响应两部分。在九个常用 PDE 基准上，分布内平均比现有 SOTA 高 33.4%，外推到未见控制参数时平均提升 51.4%。
Motivation: 参数化 PDE 的表征学习长期依赖重建式目标，只强调恢复观测到的物理场；作者发现预测式表征虽保留丰富物理信息，但仅凭这一点并不能保证场演化的准确性。
Method: 三阶段：先用掩码-潜在预测 (masked-latent prediction) 训练编码器以捕捉 PDE 动力学的底层规律；再引入 geometry projector 将潜在轨迹几何与物理场演化几何对齐，把预训练表征拉向更贴合动力学的状态空间；最后在几何对齐的潜在空间上训练 physics-structured latent predictor，把动力学分解为参数无关演化与参数相关响应两个分量。
Result: 在九个广泛使用的 PDE 基准上，框架平均比现有 state-of-the-art 方法高 33.4%（分布内），外推到未见控制参数时平均提升 51.4%。
Conclusion: 对参数化 PDE，预测式表征预训练加上几何对齐与参数分解的潜在预测器，比重建式学习更能支撑准确的场演化预测，且在未见参数外推上优势更大。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents
papers.abstract_en: Practical deployment of large language model (LLM) agents requires strong task performance at affordable inference cost. For long-horizon agentic tasks, this performance-cost trade-off can be improved through within-task large-small model collaboration, as smaller models can handle some stages even when they cannot solve the full task. In this paper, we introduce RSI-router, a routing framework that constructs subtask-level model assignments and model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement over accumulated experience. Each iteration consists of four stages: Subtask Mining derives subtask definitions and identification rules from training trajectories; Routing Strategy Evolution proposes and evaluates diverse model assignments; Model-Specific Skill Evolution compares routed and large-model-only trajectories to diagnose failures and develop reusable execution skills; and Pareto-Optimal Router Selection updates the Pareto population using historical and newly generated routers while retaining dominated routers as experience for subsequent evolution. Routing between DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.5-9B, RSI-router consistently surpasses the DeepSeek-only baseline at roughly half the inference cost (48.3%) across five agentic benchmarks. In particular, on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, it cuts inference cost by 74.7-82.2% while simultaneously improving performance; on Terminal-Bench 2.0, it achieves a 16.7% relative performance gain at 18.0% lower cost. Moreover, RSI-router establishes a stronger performance--cost Pareto frontier than 9 routing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSI-Router 用递归自改进在子任务粒度上同时演化大小模型路由与模型专属技能，在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与 Qwen3.5-9B 之间分配子任务。五个 agentic benchmark 上它以约一半推理成本（48.3%）稳定超过 DeepSeek-only 基线，ALFWorld/ScienceWorld/WebShop 上成本降 74.7–82.2% 且性能同时提升。
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 部署要在任务性能与推理成本之间取舍；小模型虽解不了整任务，却可能胜任其中若干阶段，但缺少在子任务粒度上决定谁做哪一步并沉淀可复用技能的机制。
Method: RSI-Router 每轮递归自改进含四阶段：Subtask Mining 从训练轨迹抽取子任务定义与识别规则；Routing Strategy Evolution 提出并评估多种模型分配；Model-Specific Skill Evolution 对比路由轨迹与纯大模型轨迹诊断失败并生成可复用执行技能；Pareto-Optimal Router Selection 用历史与新生成路由器更新 Pareto 种群，保留被支配路由器作为后续演化的经验。
Result: 在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与 Qwen3.5-9B 之间路由，五个 agentic benchmark 上以约 48.3% 的推理成本稳定超过 DeepSeek-only 基线；ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上推理成本下降 74.7–82.2% 且性能同时提升；Terminal-Bench 2.0 上相对性能增益 16.7%、成本降低 18.0%；性能-成本 Pareto 前沿强于 9 种路由方法。
Conclusion: 子任务级路由加模型专属技能的共同演化，能在长程 agent 上同时压低推理成本并抬高性能，形成优于现有路由方法的性能-成本 Pareto 前沿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Propagation Geometry from Message-Passing Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Learning local geometry enables graph neural networks (GNNs) to adapt how they compare and integrate neighborhood information. However, estimating geometry from aggregated representations can overlook variation among individual messages and dependencies across feature dimensions. We propose GeoF, a recurrent framework that jointly evolves node features and propagation geometry through message-passing feedback. Each node maintains a local symmetric positive-definite geometry, initialized from a structure-aware prototype atlas and parameterized in block log-triangular coordinates. At each step, the geometry determines neighborhood weights, while triangular frame transport maps transformed source messages into the target node's local coordinates before aggregation. Weighted second-order statistics of residuals between aligned messages and the transformed target state capture directional variation and within-block dependencies, yielding a geometric update target. A shared controller learns complementary corrections through task supervision. A bounded log-triangular update combines these corrections, the target, and the previous geometric state while preserving positive definiteness. The geometry governs subsequent propagation, closing the feedback loop. With parameters shared across recurrent steps, task-specific readouts support node classification, link prediction, and graph classification. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that GeoF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art GNN baselines.

Motivation: 从聚合后的表示估计局部几何会丢掉单条消息之间的差异和特征维度间的依赖，导致邻域比较与整合方式不够精细。
Method: 每个节点持有一个对称正定几何，由 structure-aware prototype atlas 初始化并以 block log-triangular 坐标参数化；每步用三角 frame transport 对齐消息，以对齐消息与目标状态残差的加权二阶统计量构造几何更新目标，共享 controller 学任务监督的修正项，再用有界的 log-triangular 更新合并修正、目标与旧几何并保持正定，参数跨递归步共享，配任务专用 readout。

papers.title: FromPitch2Board: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Football Management
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agent benchmarks typically report how far an agent progresses, but do not identify whether its performance comes from the foundation model, scaffold, responsibility scope, match-control granularity, or horizon. We introduce FromPitch2Board, a deterministic football-management benchmark that studies five configurable factors through controlled comparisons on a single simulator, using paired seeds and a frozen calibration. We evaluate four foundation models and four agent scaffolds. In the Model Track, Coach points Z-scores span 0.19, while Manager points Z-scores span 0.68, with GPT-5.6 showing a sharp rise in passivity under responsibility expansion. Its responsibility ladder rises from 46.1 to 58.1 points with recruitment, then falls to 46.8 under full management, localizing the regression to the final responsibility boundary. Across that boundary, its skipped-decision rate rises from 1.1% to 57.9%. Within the Flash-Pro pair crossed across every scaffold, scaffold choice changes Manager points Z-scores by up to 0.48 relative to the fixed stateless scaffold. The 3Y cohort shows a directional reversal in mean ranking between years one and three, while a selected Claude Code+Pro configuration peaks in year three and remains below that peak, showing that responsibility scope and horizon expose behavior changes that a single headline score conceals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FromPitch2Board 是一个确定性足球管理基准，用单一模拟器、配对随机种子与冻结校准做受控对比，拆解基础模型、scaffold、职责范围、临场指挥粒度与时间跨度五个因素对长程 agent 表现的贡献。GPT-5.6 在职责扩张下被动性骤增：职责阶梯从含引援的 58.1 分跌到全面管理的 46.8 分，跨过该边界时跳过决策率从 1.1% 升到 57.9%。
Motivation: 长程 agent 基准通常只报推进进度，无法区分成绩来自基础模型、scaffold、职责范围、指挥粒度还是时间跨度，单一头条分数掩盖了行为变化。
Method: 在单一确定性足球管理模拟器上做受控对比，用配对种子与冻结校准研究五个可配置因素；评估四个基础模型与四种 agent scaffold，分 Model Track 与含 Flash-Pro 配对的设置，并跟踪 3Y 队列第一到第三年的排名。
Result: Model Track 中 Coach points Z-score 跨度 0.19，Manager points Z-score 跨度 0.68；GPT-5.6 职责阶梯 46.1 → 58.1（加引援）→ 46.8（全面管理），跨该边界跳过决策率 1.1% → 57.9%；Flash-Pro 配对在各 scaffold 上使 Manager points Z-score 相对固定 stateless scaffold 变化最多 0.48；3Y 队列第一年到第三年平均排名方向反转，选中的 Claude Code+Pro 配置在第三年达峰后回落至峰值以下。
Conclusion: 职责范围与时间跨度会暴露单一头条分数掩盖的行为变化，长程基准必须把基础模型、scaffold 与职责边界拆开做受控归因。

papers.title: ResonAct: Streaming Metrics for Runtime Diagnosis and Self-Healing in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate enterprise workflows involving multiple specialized agents, external tools, and long-running task execution. Failures may arise from tool degradation, context propagation errors, coordination breakdowns, or repeated agent interactions that prevent task completion. While existing observability frameworks provide traces and logs, diagnosis and remediation are largely performed after execution completes, limiting opportunities for recovery during runtime. We present ResonAct, a runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer that continuously derives task progress, context health, and tool reliability metrics. These metrics serve as runtime control signals for detecting anomalous execution patterns and localizing root causes using a structured failure model. Based on the diagnosed failure, ResonAct dynamically selects remediation policies and performs actions. The framework operates as an external control plane, enabling intervention without modifying application agents or orchestration logic. We evaluate ResonAct across enterprise workflow scenarios and AppWorld benchmarks. The results show that the streaming metric-based analysis identifies execution degradations and localizes faults. Furthermore, policy-driven remediation improves task completion rates by up to 10.00 percentage points, with detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91%, recall from 63.09% to 100%, recovery rates from 10.48% to 46.67%, and runtime overhead ranging from $-0.25%$ to 14.12% across the evaluated configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResonAct 是面向多智能体系统 (MAS) 的运行时自愈控制面：把执行轨迹、智能体交互与工具调用流入流式分析层，持续产出任务进度、上下文健康度、工具可靠性三类指标，作为异常检测与根因定位的控制信号，再按结构化故障模型动态选择修复策略。在企业工作流场景与 AppWorld 基准上，策略驱动修复使任务完成率最多提升 10.00 个百分点，检测精度 70.59%–82.91%、召回 63.09%–100%、恢复率 10.48%–46.67%、运行时开销 −0.25%–14.12%。
Motivation: 现有可观测性框架只提供 traces 与 logs，诊断和修复基本在执行结束后进行，运行时几乎没有恢复机会；而 MAS 的故障来自工具退化、上下文传播错误、协调崩溃与反复交互，需要在执行过程中就被发现和处置。
Method: 外部控制面 (external control plane) 架构，不修改应用智能体与编排逻辑：流式分析层摄取执行轨迹、智能体交互、工具调用，持续派生 task progress、context health、tool reliability 指标；用结构化故障模型 (structured failure model) 做异常模式检测与根因定位，再按诊断出的故障动态选择 remediation policy 执行动作。
Result: 在企业工作流场景与 AppWorld 基准上评估：策略驱动的修复使任务完成率最多提升 10.00 个百分点；检测精度 70.59%–82.91%，召回 63.09%–100%，恢复率 10.48%–46.67%，运行时开销在 −0.25% 到 14.12% 之间（跨所评估配置）。
Conclusion: 把流式运行指标当作控制信号、配合策略化修复，可以在不改动 MAS 应用本身的前提下于执行期间完成故障定位与恢复，且开销可控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. This rollout construction supports both supervised training (TR) and distribution matching (TR-DMD). On 120-second motion generation from HumanML3D test prompts, TR and TR-DMD achieve state-of-the-art FID AUC within their respective non-DMD and DMD comparison groups. Supervised TR reduces FID AUC by 40.9% and FID degradation slope by 55.3% relative to matched post-training without replay.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Triangular Resampling (TR)，一种针对运动扩散模型长时程误差累积的后训练方法：基于 FloodDiffusion 的三角去噪调度，对部分去噪的活跃窗口状态做多步回放训练，并用真值 clamping 抑制漂移。在 HumanML3D 测试提示的 120 秒运动生成上，TR 相对同设置无回放的后训练把 FID AUC 降低 40.9%、FID 退化斜率降低 55.3%。
Motivation: 运动扩散模型长时程 rollout 中，训练窗口来自真值而推理状态是模型生成的，两者不匹配；只替换已完成的运动历史无法解决活跃窗口内部分去噪状态的偏差，导致误差随生成时长累积。
Method: TR 延展 rollout-based training 到部分去噪状态：每个回放样本抽取一个去噪阈值（在 latent 位置与回放更新间共享），无梯度地回放多步三角去噪；更新后低于阈值的状态替换为噪声匹配的真值，达到或高于阈值的保留模型预测，再把该 latent 窗口送入标准训练更新。该构造同时支持监督训练 (TR) 与分布匹配 (TR-DMD)。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 测试提示的 120 秒运动生成上，TR 与 TR-DMD 分别在其非 DMD 与 DMD 对比组内取得 state-of-the-art FID AUC；相对匹配的无回放后训练，监督 TR 使 FID AUC 降低 40.9%，FID 退化斜率降低 55.3%。
Conclusion: 长时程运动扩散的误差累积主要来自真值训练窗口与生成推理状态的不匹配，把回放训练扩展到部分去噪状态并用真值 clamping 限漂移即可显著压低 FID 随时长的退化。

papers.title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
papers.abstract_en: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在机器人稳定控制 (stabilization control) 的 RL 奖励设计中，理论与实证共同表明：策略梯度无需一阶（速度）奖励项即可解稳定任务，加入这类项反而随其尺度增大引入严重敏感性；而奖励必须在目标相关坐标上做到零阶（位置/构型）完备，一阶状态在低耗散假设下仍须保留在策略观测中。
Motivation: 机器人 RL 的奖励塑形长期沿用经典最优控制与轨迹优化的启发式做法，不区分控制目标的内在奖励项与纯数值正则项，导致超参调节脆弱、难以判断奖励到底需要包含哪些量。
Method: 围绕稳定控制问题，按零阶（构型）与一阶（速度）信息对奖励项分类，对策略梯度方法给出理论刻画并辅以实证检验，判定奖励必需项与观测必需项的边界（低耗散假设）。
Result: 理论与实证均显示：不含一阶奖励项时策略梯度仍可成功求解稳定任务；一阶项尺度增大时会引入严重敏感性；奖励须在目标相关坐标上零阶完备，一阶状态在低耗散假设下仍是策略观测的必要成分。
Conclusion: 奖励设计应只保留目标相关的零阶项并保证其完备，速度信息放在观测而非奖励里；把一阶项当正则器加进去会以超参敏感性为代价换不来必要收益。

summary_sections.method: 围绕稳定控制问题，按零阶（构型）与一阶（速度）信息对奖励项分类，对策略梯度方法给出理论刻画并辅以实证检验，判定奖励必需项与观测必需项的边界（低耗散假设）。
summary_sections.result: 理论与实证均显示：不含一阶奖励项时策略梯度仍可成功求解稳定任务；一阶项尺度增大时会引入严重敏感性；奖励须在目标相关坐标上零阶完备，一阶状态在低耗散假设下仍是策略观测的必要成分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 奖励设计应只保留目标相关的零阶项并保证其完备，速度信息放在观测而非奖励里；把一阶项当正则器加进去会以超参敏感性为代价换不来必要收益。

papers.title: Predicting Delayed Train Trajectories on the Dutch Railway Network: Explainable AI Evaluation of Topological, Operational and Weather Features with Tree Based Ensemble Methods
papers.abstract_en: The reliable prediction of passenger train delays is a critical component of railway management. While contemporary research frequently attempts to maximize absolute accuracy by deploying opaque deep learning architectures, the underlying data mechanics driving longitudinal predictive decay remain underexplored. Consequently, this study provides an explainable temporal robustness analysis of network-wide railway delay prediction. Focusing on the Dutch railway network, this research utilizes interpretable tree-based ensembles to integrate granular topological, environmental, and operational features. The overarching finding establishes that while feature-rich tree-based models improve simultaneous (within-month) prediction, predictive performance systematically degrades when evaluated across non-simultaneous (future) months. Furthermore, multi-horizon SHAP and dispersion analyses explicitly link this degradation to environmental feature volatility and instability within the statistical target definition. Ultimately, this thesis demonstrates that richer feature sets alone are insufficient to resolve long-term forecasting constraints, underscoring the necessity to transition toward dynamic, season-aware architectures anchored by absolute operational boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在荷兰铁路网上用可解释树集成做列车晚点预测，发现特征丰富的模型只提升同月（within-month）预测，跨到未来月份时性能系统性下降；多时效 SHAP 与离散度分析把下降归因于环境特征波动和统计目标定义不稳定，结论是仅堆特征不足以解决长期约束，需转向以绝对运营边界为锚的动态、季节感知架构。
Motivation: 现有研究多用不透明深度模型追求绝对精度，却未解释驱动纵向预测衰减 (longitudinal predictive decay) 的数据机制，跨月份的长期预测约束因此未被解决。
Method: 面向全网晚点预测做可解释的时间稳健性分析，用基于树的集成模型融合细粒度拓扑、环境（含天气）与运营特征，并以多时效 SHAP 和离散度 (dispersion) 分析归因性能变化。
Result: 特征丰富的树模型改善同月预测，但在非同月（未来）月份评估时性能系统性退化；该退化被显式关联到环境特征波动与统计目标定义的不稳定。
Conclusion: 更丰富的特征集本身不足以解决长期预测约束，模型需转向以绝对运营边界为锚的动态、季节感知 (season-aware) 架构。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Using LLMs to Detect LLM-Generated Texts: A Cross-Generation Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Automated detection of LLM-generated texts (LGTs) is critical, yet dedicated detectors often struggle to generalize across domains and models. While general-purpose LLMs offer flexible zero-shot authorship classification with explanatory rationale, their detection behavior, especially regarding self-detection versus cross-detection across model generations, remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate 15 LLMs spanning three model generations as both generators and detectors. Using a benchmark of 1,000 human-written texts and 15,000 LGTs (1,000 per model), we collected over 233,000 binary classifications alongside natural-language explanations. Our results reveal that detection efficacy is primarily driven by detector capability rather than generator provenance, although outputs from newer generators remain notably harder to detect. Crucially, statistical comparisons show no systematic advantage or disadvantage for self-detection across models. Error analysis further exposes generational bias shifts: first-generation detectors under-detect LGTs (high false-negative rates), second-generation detectors over-flag human texts (high false-positive rates), and the latest models achieve balanced trade-offs. Finally, we highlight significant inconsistencies in how different LLMs apply textual cues to justify their decisions. Code: https://github.com/hyyuan/detect-llm-generated-texts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统评测 15 个跨三代 LLM 作为生成器与检测器的零样本 AI 文本检测行为，基于 1,000 篇人写文本与 15,000 篇生成文本收集逾 233,000 次带自然语言解释的二分类。检测效能主要由检测器能力决定而非生成器来源，且不存在系统性的自检优势或劣势；但新一代生成器的输出仍更难检出，且各代检测器的错误偏向从漏检（高 FPN）逐步转为误报（高 FPR），最新模型才达到均衡。
Motivation: 专用检测器跨域跨模型泛化差，而通用 LLM 的零样本作者分类虽可给出解释，其自检与跨代检测行为此前缺乏系统认识。
Method: 选取跨三个模型世代的 15 个 LLM，同时充当生成器与检测器，做零样本二分类并收集自然语言解释；用 1,000 篇人写文本与每模型 1,000 篇（共 15,000 篇）生成文本构成基准，进行统计比较与错误分析。
Result: 共收集逾 233,000 次二分类及解释；检测效能主要由检测器能力驱动而非生成器来源，但更新一代生成器的输出仍明显更难检测；统计比较显示自检相对跨检无系统性优劣；错误分析显示第一代检测器漏检率高（高 FNR）、第二代误报率高（高 FPR）、最新模型达到均衡权衡；不同 LLM 用于论证判定的文本线索存在显著不一致。
Conclusion: LLM 自检测既无系统性优势也无系统性劣势，检测成败取决于检测器能力与代际，且各模型给出的判定理由彼此不一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to post-train stochastic diffusion and flow policies for text-to-image (T2I) generation. However, reward-maximizing RL causes policy mode collapse even under reference KL or entropy regularization, reducing the policy to a single high-reward mode. In T2I, this produces similar images and reward hacking. When extended to vision-language-action (VLA) models, the same collapse removes alternative successful strategies and weakens task and scene generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (Uni-TMPO), a unified RL post-training framework for diffusion and flow policies. First, Uni-TMPO converts standardized rewards into a target distribution within each trajectory group and derives the policy distribution from trajectory log probabilities. Then, forward Kullback-Leibler optimization matches the two distributions instead of maximizing expected reward. A progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler efficiently constructs T2I trajectories. Within the unified framework, feedback-conditioned sampling uses updated observations to construct VLA trajectories. Extensive experiments show that Uni-TMPO achieves higher T2I rewards and VLA ID success rates than the strongest baselines. More importantly, it achieves the best T2I reward-diversity-efficiency trade-off and VLA generalization to held-out tasks and scenes, while real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies when the higher-reward target is blocked.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Uni-TMPO 用前向 KL 把奖励最大化改写成轨迹组内目标分布匹配，避免扩散/流策略在 T2I 与 VLA 后训练中塌到单一高奖励模式。它在 T2I 上取得更好的奖励-多样性-效率权衡，在 VLA 上提高 ID 成功率与留出任务/场景泛化，真机实验显示高奖励目标被挡时多条备选动作策略有价值。
Motivation: 奖励最大化 RL 即便加 reference KL 或熵正则仍会让策略模式坍缩：T2I 图像趋同并出现 reward hacking，VLA 则丢失可行的替代成功策略，任务与场景泛化变弱。
Method: Uni-TMPO 是面向扩散与流策略的统一 RL 后训练框架：先把标准化奖励在每个轨迹组内转成目标分布，再从轨迹 log probability 导出策略分布，用前向 KL 优化匹配两者而非最大化期望奖励。T2I 侧用 progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler 构造轨迹，VLA 侧用 feedback-conditioned sampling 以更新后的观测构造轨迹。
Result: 实验显示 Uni-TMPO 的 T2I 奖励与 VLA ID 成功率高于最强基线，并取得最佳的 T2I 奖励-多样性-效率权衡以及对留出任务和场景的最佳 VLA 泛化；真机评测中，当更高奖励目标被阻挡时，多条动作策略体现价值。
Conclusion: 把奖励最大化换成轨迹组内的目标分布匹配，可以在不牺牲奖励的前提下保住策略多样性，从而同时改善 T2I 生成多样性与 VLA 的任务/场景泛化。
Relevance: 0
