papers.title: VCN-Bench: A Video-Contextualized Navigation Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning over Prior Visual Experience
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether spatial understanding can be carried forward to guide sequential interactions. Existing spatial-reasoning benchmarks typically terminate at offline predictions, while navigation benchmarks evaluate spatial reasoning as part of instruction following and exploration. We introduce VCN-Bench, a \textbf{V}ideo-\textbf{C}ontextualized \textbf{N}avigation benchmark for probing closed-loop spatial reasoning over prior visual experience in MLLMs. Given a prior video covering both the initial location and destination, the agent is tasked with reasoning out the instruction-specified target and navigating toward it with the inferred spatial context. Built on Matterport3D, VCN-Bench contains five instruction types, 100k training episodes, and 1,250 evaluation episodes. Navigation serves as the primary evaluation, while diagnostic goal identification helps distinguish destination-resolution errors from subsequent navigation failures. We further propose MV-DualVLN, a planning-oriented baseline that jointly leverages prior video and in-episode observations. Experiments reveal limited navigation performance, a substantial destination-resolution-to-navigation gap, and frequent navigation failures even after correct destination identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCN-Bench 把先验视频（覆盖起点与目的地）作为上下文，考察 MLLM 在闭环导航中能否把视觉经验转化为空间推理并指导连续交互。基于 Matterport3D 构建，含 5 种指令类型、100k 训练回合与 1,250 评估回合，配诊断式目标识别以区分目的地解析错误与导航失败。实验显示导航性能有限，且存在显著的“目的地解析—导航”落差：即便正确识别目的地，导航仍频繁失败。
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准止于离线预测，导航基准又把空间推理混入指令跟随与探索，无法判断空间理解能否被带入并指导序贯交互。
Method: 提供一段覆盖初始位置与目的地的先验视频，要求智能体推理出指令指定目标并导航前往；以导航为主评估，辅以诊断式目标识别区分目的地解析错误与后续导航失败；并提出规划导向基线 MV-DualVLN，联合利用先验视频与回合内观测。
Result: 基准基于 Matterport3D，含 5 种指令类型、100k 训练回合与 1,250 评估回合；实验揭示导航性能有限、目的地解析到导航之间存在显著落差，且在正确识别目的地后仍频繁出现导航失败。
Conclusion: 在先验视觉经验之上做闭环空间推理仍未被 MLLM 掌握：能解析目的地不等于能导航到位，目的地解析与后续导航是两个应分开诊断的失败环节。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Jailbreak Context Lingers: Divergent Safety Routing and Its Cross-Task Predictability in Tool Agents
papers.abstract_en: As large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, post-jailbreak safety feedback is often assumed to serve as a reliable safeguard; however, how lingering jailbreak context shapes subsequent agent behavior remains largely unexplored. To systematically examine this dynamic, we introduce a paired continuation framework across 192 parent tasks spanning 42 domains, evaluating 12,148 analyzed continuation pairs (curated from a 12,288-pair initially design) across eight diverse agents. We find that identical safety feedback induces sharply model-dependent behavioral routing rather than uniform protection: redirecting unsafe trajectories toward legitimate completion (\emph{rescue}), sustaining unauthorized execution (\emph{persistent unsafe}), or triggering over-refusal on benign tasks (\emph{collateral loss}). Through layer-wise activation patching, we discover a shared \emph{late-commit pattern} where causal intervention effects surge sharply near the final layers (relative depths of 0.958--0.984) despite an over 30-fold variation in peak magnitude across architectures. Crucially, critical-layer representations correlate with macroscopic routing outcomes, and intervening at these layers causally alters concrete next-step tool actions. Building on this causal foundation, we test whether localized intervention-derived features can serve as predictive proxies for full-trajectory routing outcomes on unseen parent tasks under leave-one-parent-task-out evaluation, finding that they provide viable predictive signals in responsive agents with peak ROC AUCs reaching 0.675 for \emph{rescue}, 0.777 for \emph{collateral loss}, and 0.702 for \emph{persistent unsafe}. These findings establish a mechanistic lens and a predictive baseline for anticipating the safety and utility trade-offs of post-jailbreak feedback in autonomous agents.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 17 tabels, ICLR 2027 Under Review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在工具代理中，同一段越狱后安全反馈并不产生一致保护，而是把后续行为分流为 rescue、persistent unsafe、collateral loss 三种路由，且强烈依赖模型。层间激活修补 (layer-wise activation patching) 定位到共享的 late-commit 模式：因果干预效应在最后几层（相对深度 0.958–0.984）骤增，峰值幅度跨架构相差 30 倍以上；用这些关键层特征在留一父任务评估下可预测未见任务的路由，ROC AUC 最高分别为 0.675（rescue）、0.777（collateral loss）、0.702（persistent unsafe）。
Motivation: 工具代理被假定在越狱后能靠安全反馈可靠纠偏，但残留的越狱上下文如何塑造后续行为尚不清楚，缺少可预测其安全-效用权衡的机制性依据。
Method: 提出 paired continuation 框架，覆盖 192 个父任务、42 个领域、8 个代理，分析 12,148 个 continuation 对（初始设计 12,288 对）；用 layer-wise activation patching 做因果干预定位关键层，再以干预导出的局部特征作为路由预测代理，采用 leave-one-parent-task-out 评估。
Result: 识别出三类路由：rescue、persistent unsafe、collateral loss；因果干预效应在相对深度 0.958–0.984 的最后几层骤增，峰值幅度跨架构变化超过 30 倍；关键层表征与宏观路由相关并能因果改变下一步工具动作。预测代理在 responsive agents 上的峰值 ROC AUC 为 rescue 0.675、collateral loss 0.777、persistent unsafe 0.702。
Conclusion: 越狱后安全反馈的效果是模型依赖的分流而非统一保护，关键层的局部干预特征可作为预测未见任务上安全-效用权衡的基线信号。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
papers.abstract_en: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 表征的物体状态读出在自然轨迹上准确，并不等于它真的随目标物理状态变化而响应。作者用物理验证的观测把目标坐标与机器人上下文交叉组合，把预测准确率、目标状态响应性、上下文稳定性三者分开评测，发现固定表征-读出对上高自然准确率可以与很弱的受控响应性并存。
Motivation: 自然观测中物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡与任务进度共同变化，上下文线索即可贡献预测，导致解码准确率虚高而无法说明读出对目标状态变化是否忠实。
Method: 提出一个评测框架，用目标坐标与机器人上下文交叉组合的物理验证观测，分离预测准确率、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性；对表征、读出、训练数据做比较与干预，并在基于初始状态误差与物理变量的失败预测器上加入响应性与上下文敏感性特征。
Result: 固定表征-读出对上，高自然轨迹准确率与弱受控目标状态响应性可以并存；表征、读出与训练数据的比较和干预显示三者提供彼此不同的诊断信息；在新的初始条件上，加入响应性与上下文敏感性后失败预测误差相对指定基线下降，同观测受控 MAE 同样具有信息量。
Conclusion: 自然预测准确率不足以证明读出对目标状态忠实，应把目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性同准确率一起评测，并考察它们与实际策略行为和任务结果的关系。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AgentPerfBench: A Benchmarking and Evaluation Suite for Inference Performance of Agentic LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The optimization of LLM serving engines, such as vLLM and SGLang, is largely benchmark-driven: optimizations, scheduling policies, hardware and system designs are all selected based on representative workloads. However, a significant mismatch has emerged in the agentic era. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on simple single-turn chatbot workloads. LLM applications are increasingly agentic: coding agents, terminal execution systems, and tool-use agents issue multi-turn requests with growing context lengths. We introduce AgentPerfBench, a benchmark suite for agentic inference. It uses real traces from agentic benchmarks, such as SWE-Bench and TerminalBench, alongside standard chat baselines. This enables benchmarking of models on multi-turn tasks involving tool calling, skill utilization, and increasing context lengths. AgentPerfBench also samples from empirical distributions of input length, output length, and turn count derived from the real traces, generating representative synthetic profiles for cheap and accurate measurements on new hardware. In addition, we further find that several existing benchmarks fail to accurately reflect real hardware performance for two key reasons: 1) they do not account for realistic context-length growth, and 2) they measure inference performance without operating at hardware saturation. We discuss these issues in detail and provide rich kernel-level Nsight Compute (NCU) traces to construct a new multi-dimensional roofline model that captures hardware-system limitations in both memory bandwidth and memory capacity footprint. The benchmarking suite then includes automated scripts to identify potential bottleneck conditions on emerging hardware when evaluated with diverse agentic traces. Together, these contributions quantify the chat-to-agentic gap in current inference benchmarks and characterise per-kernel GPU resource utilisation via roofline analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentPerfBench 用 SWE-Bench、TerminalBench 等真实 agentic 轨迹构建多轮推理基准，按输入长度、输出长度、轮数的经验分布采样生成合成 profile，以便在新硬件上低成本测量。它指出现有单轮 chat 基准失真的两个原因——不刻画真实上下文增长、未在硬件饱和点测量——并用 Nsight Compute 的 kernel 级 trace 构建同时刻画内存带宽与内存容量的多维 roofline 模型，量化 chat 到 agentic 的差距。
Motivation: vLLM、SGLang 等推理引擎的优化与调度决策依赖基准，但现有基准以单轮 chat 负载为主，而实际应用正变为多轮、上下文持续增长的 agent 负载，导致基准与真实硬件表现脱节。
Method: 从 SWE-Bench、TerminalBench 等 agentic 基准的真实轨迹出发，覆盖工具调用、技能使用与增长的上下文长度，并叠加标准 chat 基线；从输入长度、输出长度、轮数的经验分布采样生成代表性合成 profile；同时采集 kernel 级 Nsight Compute (NCU) trace，构建同时考虑内存带宽与内存容量占用的多维 roofline 模型，并附自动化脚本在新兴硬件上定位瓶颈条件。
Result: 量化了当前推理基准中 chat 与 agentic 负载之间的差距，并通过 roofline 分析给出逐 kernel 的 GPU 资源利用率刻画；识别出现有基准失真的两个原因：未考虑真实上下文长度增长、未在硬件饱和状态下测量推理性能。
Conclusion: agentic 推理基准必须同时刻画上下文增长并在硬件饱和点测量，否则会误导推理引擎的优化、调度与硬件选型决策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: V-Gym: Enhancing Agentic Visual Reasoning via Skill-Data Co-Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Advances in multimodal understanding, reasoning, and tool use enable agents to tackle increasingly complex visual reasoning tasks. By distilling past execution experience into reusable skills, agents can transfer lessons from both successes and failures into future reasoning, reducing repeated errors and improving capabilities. However, limited experience may produce unreliable, poorly generalizable skills, while static datasets may lack the targeted and diverse practice needed for refinement. To address this gap, we introduce V-Gym, an autonomous framework that iteratively co-evolves procedural skills and multimodal practice data from execution trajectories. During skill evolution, V-Gym analyzes trajectories to distill and refine hierarchical skills, updating procedural guidance and applicability conditions while retaining an update only if it improves validation performance. During data evolution, V-Gym selects generation seeds by balancing data utility and exploration, then translates trajectory-identified bottlenecks into diverse, targeted practice data that expand the data bank after quality checks. The resulting practice outcomes feed back into subsequent skill updates, closing the loop for continual skill refinement. Experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks show substantial improvements over baselines with multiple backbone models. Its evolved skills generalize across domains and models, while evolved data support more effective skill refinement, enabling autonomous diagnosis, targeted practice, and continual self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-Gym 让智能体的程序性技能与多模态练习数据从执行轨迹中共同演化：技能侧蒸馏并按验证性能增益决定是否保留更新，数据侧按效用与探索的平衡选种子、把轨迹瓶颈转成定向练习数据，实践结果再回灌技能更新形成闭环。在多个多模态推理基准上相对基线有显著提升，且演化出的技能可跨领域、跨 backbone 泛化。
Motivation: 有限经验蒸馏出的技能不可靠、泛化差，而静态数据集缺少针对瓶颈的定向与多样化练习，技能改进因此停滞。
Method: V-Gym 是闭环框架：技能演化分析执行轨迹，蒸馏分层技能并更新操作指引与适用条件，仅当验证性能提升才保留；数据演化按数据效用与探索的平衡选择生成种子，把轨迹识别的瓶颈翻译成多样化定向练习数据，经质量检查后扩充数据银行，实践结果反馈到下一轮技能更新。
Result: 在多样的多模态推理基准上，相对基线在多个 backbone 模型上取得显著提升；演化技能跨领域与跨模型泛化，演化数据支持更有效的技能精炼。
Conclusion: 技能与数据的协同演化使智能体能够自主诊断、定向练习并持续自我改进，而非依赖一次性经验蒸馏。

papers.title: SOLAR: A State-Driven Online Learning Rate Scheduler for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Learning-rate (LR) scheduling plays a central role in large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet current practice still relies heavily on hand-crafted heuristics such as Warmup-Cosine-Decay and Warmup-Stable-Decay. Because these schedules are fixed in advance, they cannot adapt to evolving optimization dynamics. Online learned scheduling within the Learning to Optimize (L2O) framework offers a dynamic alternative, but remains brittle at LLM scale due to noisy signals, delayed feedback, and the risk of catastrophic divergence. We propose SOLAR (State-driven Online Learning rAte scheduleR), a stabilized framework for reliable online LR adaptation. SOLAR uses a base schedule as a reference and learns bounded, state-dependent residual corrections for individual parameter groups. Each correction re-anchors to the base at every step, allowing the policy to adapt the LR without relearning the warmup-decay profile. A lightweight state representation and progress-aware reward guide online learning, while a Circuit-Breaker restores training after rare unsafe actions. Across autoregressive language-model pretraining, SOLAR improves final perplexity over tuned static schedules and automatic LR tuners for dense models from 60M to 1B, AdamW and Muon, and two MoE settings up to 3B. Matched 130M controls show that adding base anchoring and action bounds improves a global PPO controller from 27.09 to 23.74 final PPL, while group-wise control reaches 22.87 on the same two seeds. A residual policy trained on a 60M proxy can also be frozen and reused at larger dense scales without target PPO updates, remaining effective across a fourfold base-LR range. These results establish SOLAR as a practical learned LR controller for LLM pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOLAR 是面向 LLM 预训练的在线学习率调度器：以固定 base schedule 为锚，按参数组学习有界的状态相关残差修正，每步重新锚定，并用轻量状态表征、progress-aware reward 与 Circuit-Breaker 保证稳定。在 60M–1B dense（AdamW 与 Muon）及至 3B 的 MoE 上，其最终困惑度优于调好的静态调度与自动 LR 调节器；130M 对照中全局 PPO 控制器 PPL 从 27.09 降到 23.74，分组控制同两种子达 22.87。
Motivation: Warmup-Cosine-Decay、Warmup-Stable-Decay 等手工调度预先固定，无法跟随优化动态变化；而 L2O 框架内的在线学习率调度在 LLM 规模上因信号噪声、延迟反馈与灾难性发散风险而脆弱。
Method: SOLAR 以 base schedule 为参考，学习按参数组的有界状态相关残差修正，每步 re-anchor 到 base；配轻量状态表征与 progress-aware reward 做在线学习，Circuit-Breaker 在罕见不安全动作后恢复训练。训练用 PPO，含全局控制器与分组控制两种形式，并测试 60M proxy 上训练的残差策略冻结后迁移到更大 dense 规模。
Result: 在 60M 到 1B dense 模型（AdamW 与 Muon）及两种至 3B 的 MoE 设置上，最终 perplexity 优于调好的静态调度与自动 LR 调节器。Matched 130M 对照中，加入 base anchoring 与 action bounds 使全局 PPO 控制器最终 PPL 从 27.09 降至 23.74，分组控制在同两种子上达 22.87。60M proxy 上训练的残差策略冻结后可直接用于更大 dense 规模、无需目标端 PPO 更新，并在四倍 base-LR 范围内保持有效。
Conclusion: 以固定调度为锚的有界分组残差修正，能把在线学习率控制从脆弱的 L2O 变成 LLM 预训练中实用且可跨规模复用的控制器。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: Warmup-Cosine-Decay、Warmup-Stable-Decay 等手工调度预先固定，无法跟随优化动态变化；而 L2O 框架内的在线学习率调度在 LLM 规模上因信号噪声、延迟反馈与灾难性发散风险而脆弱。
summary_sections.method: SOLAR 以 base schedule 为参考，学习按参数组的有界状态相关残差修正，每步 re-anchor 到 base；配轻量状态表征与 progress-aware reward 做在线学习，Circuit-Breaker 在罕见不安全动作后恢复训练。训练用 PPO，含全局控制器与分组控制两种形式，并测试 60M proxy 上训练的残差策略冻结后迁移到更大 dense 规模。
summary_sections.result: 在 60M 到 1B dense 模型（AdamW 与 Muon）及两种至 3B 的 MoE 设置上，最终 perplexity 优于调好的静态调度与自动 LR 调节器。Matched 130M 对照中，加入 base anchoring 与 action bounds 使全局 PPO 控制器最终 PPL 从 27.09 降至 23.74，分组控制在同两种子上达 22.87。60M proxy 上训练的残差策略冻结后可直接用于更大 dense 规模、无需目标端 PPO 更新，并在四倍 base-LR 范围内保持有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以固定调度为锚的有界分组残差修正，能把在线学习率控制从脆弱的 L2O 变成 LLM 预训练中实用且可跨规模复用的控制器。

papers.title: QuantForge: Discovering Residual Decompositions for MXFP4 Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Four-bit post-training quantization can reduce the memory demands of large language models, but preserving accuracy under strict MXFP4 W4A4 requires coordinating several design choices. Coordinate transforms change block-encoding errors, which in turn affect the residuals propagated through the network. The useful algorithmic decomposition is therefore not fully known before search. LLM-driven program evolution offers a way to explore these choices, but performance scores alone do not explain which design should change next. We introduce QuantForge, a PTQ discovery system that records competing explanations, selects controls that distinguish them, and checks that successor code implements the resulting conclusions. This residual compilation guides program revisions while retaining useful programs even when their original explanations are rejected. Remeasuring the revised program reveals the next error to address. This process discovers HiRes, a fixed MXFP4 quantizer that shapes coordinates, refines legal code assignments, and recovers errors along attention and MLP paths. Each stage acts on residuals measured after the preceding stage has executed. Across seven tasks, HiRes achieves the lowest seven-model Robust Fit (0.09300) and the lowest quantized Fit-7 at 32B. In matched-budget comparisons of LLM-driven program evolution, each with 240 evaluator calls, QuantForge reaches a held-out transfer target in six of eight runs, compared with three each for textual memory and reflection memory, and one for score-only evolution, despite evaluating fewer new programs. These results show that QuantForge improves the discovery of transferable PTQ algorithms by turning controlled evidence into subsequent program changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuantForge 是一个用 LLM 驱动程序进化来搜索 MXFP4 W4A4 后训练量化 (PTQ) 算法的发现系统：它记录相互竞争的解释、挑选能区分这些解释的控制实验，并校验后继代码是否实现了所得结论（residual compilation）。由此发现的固定量化器 HiRes 依次整形坐标、细化合法码分配、沿 attention 与 MLP 路径恢复误差，每一步都作用于前一步执行后实测的残差；在七任务上取得最低的七模型 Robust Fit（0.09300）与 32B 上最低的 quantized Fit-7。
Motivation: 严格 MXFP4 W4A4 下四比特 PTQ 需要同时协调坐标变换、码分配等多个设计选择，坐标变换改变块编码误差并影响网络中传播的残差，因此有用的算法分解在搜索前并不已知；而单纯依赖性能分数的 LLM 程序进化无法解释下一步该改什么。
Method: QuantForge 记录相互竞争的解释，选择能区分它们的控制实验，并检查后继代码是否实现了由此得出的结论（residual compilation），保留即使原解释被推翻仍有用的程序，再通过重测修订后程序定位下一个待处理误差。产出的 HiRes 是固定 MXFP4 量化器，分阶段整形坐标、细化合法码分配、沿 attention 与 MLP 路径恢复误差，每阶段作用于前一阶段执行后的实测残差。
Result: 在七个任务上，HiRes 取得最低的七模型 Robust Fit（0.09300）以及 32B 规模上最低的 quantized Fit-7。在等预算（各 240 次 evaluator 调用）的 LLM 驱动程序进化对比中，QuantForge 在 8 次运行中有 6 次达到 held-out 迁移目标，textual memory 与 reflection memory 各 3 次，score-only evolution 1 次，且评估的新程序更少。
Conclusion: 把受控证据（区分性实验）直接转化为后续程序修改，比只看分数或依赖记忆的进化更能发现可迁移的 PTQ 算法；HiRes 证明按残差分阶段作用的固定 MXFP4 量化器是该流程的可交付产物。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Preference to Reciprocity: Decentralized Matching with Empirically Grounded LLM-agent Based Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Bipartite matching is a fundamental problem in game theory and market design. Classical approaches such as Gale--Shapley assume complete preferences and centralized computation, whereas many real-world matching processes are decentralized, asynchronous, and shaped by sequential interaction under limited information. We propose a dynamic bipartite matching framework that combines large language model (LLM) agents with contextual bandits. In a simulated Chinese marriage market, economically grounded LLM agents evaluate locally encountered candidates, while agent-specific Logistic-UCB models learn reciprocal acceptance from realized proposal outcomes. The mechanism therefore separates two decisions---\emph{whom do I like?} and \emph{who is likely to like me back?}---without requiring ex ante market-wide preference rankings. We first validate LLM-induced mate preferences against the empirical conditional-logit reference across multiple LLM backbones. In the $50\times50$ matching experiment, Bandit-UCB achieves the highest mean mutual welfare (56.01 versus 54.87 for Gale--Shapley), a smaller gender rank gap than the classical baselines, and the fewest blocking pairs among the LLM-ABM policies. Learned acceptance models show economically interpretable gender-differentiated associations, while counterfactual setups reveal no systematic unilateral advantage from prior search knowledge. Overall, these results support the advantages of decentralized matching with LLM-based behavioral modeling and online learning under incomplete information for economic simulation and computational social science research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Gale-Shapley 的集中式完全偏好假设换成去中心化序贯匹配：经济动机的 LLM agent 只评估局部遇到的对象，各自用 Logistic-UCB 从已实现的提议结果中学习互惠接受概率，把「我喜欢谁」与「谁可能也接受我」两个决策分开。在 50×50 模拟中国婚姻市场中，Bandit-UCB 的平均互惠福利 56.01，高于 Gale-Shapley 的 54.87，性别排名差距更小，且在 LLM-ABM 策略中阻塞对最少。
Motivation: Gale-Shapley 等经典匹配要求完整的市场级偏好排序与集中计算，而现实匹配是去中心化、异步、信息受限的序贯过程，无法事前获得全市场偏好。
Method: 提出 LLM agent 与 contextual bandit 结合的动态二部匹配框架：经济动机的 LLM agent 评估局部遇到的候选者，每个 agent 用 Logistic-UCB 从已实现的提议结果学习互惠接受度；先用多个 LLM backbone 将 LLM 诱导的择偶偏好与经验 conditional-logit 参考对照验证，再在 50×50 匹配实验中与 Gale-Shapley 等基线比较，并做反事实设定。
Result: 50×50 匹配实验中 Bandit-UCB 平均互惠福利 56.01，Gale-Shapley 为 54.87；性别排名差距小于经典基线，且在 LLM-ABM 策略中阻塞对最少。学习到的接受模型呈现经济上可解释的性别差异化关联，反事实设定显示先验搜索知识不带来系统性单边优势。
Conclusion: 在信息不完整的经济模拟中，去中心化匹配配合 LLM 行为建模与在线学习，比要求完全偏好的集中式规则取得更高互惠福利与更少阻塞对，适用于计算社会科学研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fair Fact-Checking: Closing the Cross-Lingual Gap in LLM Factual Judgement with RoSh
papers.abstract_en: Misinformation on social media remains a critical problem, and more and more people settle it by asking a language model instead of a fact checker. Whether models judge such claims reliably is debated; whether they judge them equally well in every language people ask in has gone almost unasked. We test eight models from five families, 3B to 70B, on 1,500 encyclopedic factual claims that exist in identical form in eight languages. English is judged better than every other language on every model, and the gap is widest on the smallest ones, where Llama-3B on Arabic is no better than guessing. Existing remedies retrain on more multilingual data or fit an unconstrained map between language representations, and neither asks whether the model already holds the answer and simply fails to say it. It largely does: a linear probe recovers the truth from the very activations the model fails to express. We propose RoSh, a per-language shift and rotation of the residual stream, computed in closed form at three layers, with no training and no weight modified. It improves every model and closes 75% of the gap on average, helping most where the model was worst: Arabic on Llama-3B goes from chance to nearly the English level, and a fifth fewer of the claims answered correctly in English are lost in translation. What remains is no longer a read-out failure: afterwards the head recovers as much of what is encoded outside English as it does in English. An unconstrained map fitted on the same pairs falls below the untouched baseline, so the orthogonality constraint is doing the work, and every model clears a scrambled-correspondence control and ten further controls. On the two benchmarks of the closest inference-time method, latent-space intervention, run with its own data and metric code, RoSh's gains are five to thirteen times larger.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoSh 对残差流做逐语言的平移与旋转（闭式解、三层、不训练不改权重），把 LLM 跨语言事实判断差距平均缩小 75%；Llama-3B 阿拉伯语从随机水平升到接近英语，英语答对而翻译后丢失的 claim 少了五分之一。
Motivation: 用户越来越多地直接问 LLM 判断事实而非查事实核查者，但模型在不同语言上判断是否同样可靠几乎无人检验；已有补救（多语言再训练或无约束表示映射）不追问模型是否本已知道答案却说不出。
Method: 在 8 个模型家族（5 个家族、3B–70B）上测试 1,500 条在八种语言中形式完全相同的百科事实 claim；用线性探针 (linear probe) 从激活中恢复真值，再提出 RoSh：在三层上以闭式解计算逐语言的残差流平移与旋转，带正交约束，不训练、不修改权重；对照无约束映射、打乱对应控制与另外十项控制，并在 latent-space intervention 的两个基准上用其自带数据与指标代码复现比较。
Result: 英语在每个模型上都优于其他所有语言，且差距在最小模型上最宽（Llama-3B 阿拉伯语不优于瞎猜）；RoSh 平均缩小 75% 的差距，Llama-3B 阿拉伯语从随机升至接近英语水平，英语答对而翻译丢失的 claim 减少五分之一；修正后 head 在非英语上恢复的编码量与英语相当；同数据上无约束映射低于未改动基线；RoSh 在最近的推理时方法 latent-space intervention 的两个基准上增益为其 5–13 倍。
Conclusion: 跨语言事实判断差距主要是读出 (read-out) 失败而非知识缺失，正交约束的闭式残差流变换即可大幅弥合；修正后残余误差不再是读出问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given recalled context, approximated by negative diffusion prediction loss, and uses it to train a retriever that remains future-blind at inference. The retriever learns cue-specific relevance and automatically determines which available retrieval cues, such as time, pose, vision, and audio, to trust for each query when selecting memories. Across three complementary settings, FAR outperforms hand-designed recall even with the same retrieval cues, automatically adapts which available cues to trust, and recalls the right history as the world changes. Together, these results establish FAR as a flexible, principled approach to episodic memory access in world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Future-Aware Recall (FAR)：用「给定召回上下文对已实现未来的条件对数似然」（以负 diffusion 预测损失近似）作为预测效用监督，训练一个推理时对未来盲的检索器，并让它按查询自适应地在 time、pose、vision、audio 等线索间分配信任。在三个互补设定中，FAR 即使用相同检索线索也胜过手工设计的召回规则，并能随世界变化召回正确历史。
Motivation: 世界模型预测依赖很久以前见过的观测，而记忆不断累积时，固定准则（新近度、位姿重叠、视觉相似度）在不同环境和查询下并不可靠，难以判断哪些记忆对当前预测有用、该信哪条检索线索。
Method: FAR 以未来感知的预测监督学习情景召回：训练阶段用「已实现未来在召回上下文下的条件对数似然」度量预测效用，并用负 diffusion 预测损失近似该似然，据此训练检索器；推理阶段检索器保持未来盲，学习各线索的专属相关性并自动决定对 time、pose、vision、audio 等可用线索的信任权重。
Result: 在三个互补设定中，FAR 即使使用与手工设计召回相同的检索线索仍然胜出；它能自动调整信任哪些可用线索，并在世界变化时召回正确的历史。
Conclusion: 情景记忆访问不必依赖固定启发式：用未来预测效用做监督、推理时保持未来盲的多线索检索，可以在世界模型中灵活且有原则地选出对当前预测真正有用的记忆。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: FestDPO: Few-step Generator Alignment with Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Few-step generative models can generate high-fidelity samples within a few function evaluations. Despite this efficiency, generated samples may not exhibit desirable properties. When these properties are difficult to encode as an explicit reward function, direct preference optimization (DPO) can align generative models using pairwise preference feedback without training a separate reward model. However, extending DPO to few-step generative models is challenging because few-step generative models are generally implicit, making the likelihood evaluation required by DPO intractable. To address this challenge, we introduce Few-step DPO (FestDPO), an extension of DPO for few-step generative models that leverages nonparametric likelihood estimation from empirical samples. By exploiting the fast sampling capabilities of few-step generative models, our approach makes sample-based approximation of DPO loss computationally feasible. Furthermore, the sample-based formulation makes FestDPO agnostic to the model family and sampling procedure. Our toy experiment demonstrates that FestDPO matches the reward-tilted target distribution across four few-step generators. For real-world tasks, we evaluate FestDPO in two domains: text-to-image generation and protein backbone generation. In text-to-image generation, FestDPO outperforms preference optimization baselines in both win rates against the base models and human evaluation scores. In protein backbone generation, it achieves a higher $β$-sheet fraction and better structural designability than the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FestDPO 把 DPO 扩展到似然不可解的 few-step 隐式生成器：用经验样本做非参数似然估计，借 few-step 采样快的优势让 DPO 损失的样本近似在计算上可行。在文生图与蛋白质骨架生成两个域上，它相对偏好优化基线取得更高的对基模型胜率与人类评分，以及更高的 β-sheet 占比和更好的结构可设计性。
Motivation: DPO 需要评估生成模型似然，而 few-step 生成器一般是隐式模型，似然不可解，导致偏好对齐无法直接套用。
Method: 提出 FestDPO（Few-step DPO）：用经验样本做非参数似然估计，把 DPO 损失改写为样本近似形式，借助 few-step 生成器的快速采样使其计算可行；该样本化形式对模型族与采样过程均不敏感。
Result: toy 实验中 FestDPO 在四个 few-step 生成器上匹配 reward-tilted 目标分布；文生图任务上相对偏好优化基线在对基模型胜率与人类评估分数两方面均更高；蛋白质骨架生成上取得更高 β-sheet 占比与更好的 structural designability。
Conclusion: 样本化的非参数似然估计足以让 DPO 用于隐式 few-step 生成器，且因不依赖具体模型族与采样过程而可跨生成器复用。

papers.title: Evidence-Aligned Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual understanding requires models to recognize small details within complex images. Multimodal on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this challenge by using a teacher conditioned on evidence-centered crops to supervise a student conditioned on original images along student-generated trajectories. Ideally, teacher corrections, the distributional changes from the student toward the privileged teacher, should be driven by task-relevant visual evidence. However, the designs that make the teacher effective also introduce other interference. Using a lagged or frozen teacher improves training stability but introduces a model-state gap from the evolving student, while cropping enhances task-relevant evidence but also loses the visual context. These two sources of interference make the teacher corrections not purely rely on the visual evidence. We introduce Evidence-Aligned multimodal on-policy self-Distillation (EAD), which retains the crop-conditioned teacher as the target but constructs a separate evidence reference for weighting the corrections. To exclude the effect of lagged model-state from this reference, EAD measures prediction changes using the current student. To avoid crop-induced context changes, EAD masks the evidence region in the original image while preserving the other visual context. The change from the student's masked-image prediction to its original-image prediction provides a controlled reference for the direction in which the visual evidence shifts the student's prediction. EAD weights each teacher correction by its cosine alignment with the reference, i.e., retaining aligned corrections and downweighting the rest. Retaining only 6\% of the supervision mass of dense OPSD, EAD consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EAD 针对多模态 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 中教师修正被滞后模型状态与裁剪丢上下文污染的问题，构造证据对齐参考：用当前学生在遮蔽证据区域图像与原图上的预测变化作为方向参考，按余弦对齐度对教师修正加权，只保留对齐部分。仅保留稠密 OPSD 6% 的监督质量，EAD 一致超过此前 SOTA。
Motivation: 裁剪条件教师虽能聚焦任务相关证据，但滞后/冻结教师带来模型状态差、裁剪丢失视觉上下文，两者使教师修正不再纯粹由视觉证据驱动，监督信号被干扰稀释。
Method: 保留裁剪条件教师作为修正来源，另建独立证据参考：用当前学生（排除滞后状态）在原图遮蔽证据区域后的预测与原图预测之差给出证据改变预测的受控方向；按教师修正与该参考的余弦对齐度加权，保留对齐修正、降权其余。
Result: 仅保留稠密 OPSD 6% 的监督质量，EAD 一致优于此前 state-of-the-art 方法（细粒度视觉理解任务）。
Conclusion: 教师修正应按其与视觉证据方向的对齐度筛选，只用对齐部分即可在大幅削减监督量的同时稳定超过既有 OPSD 方法。

papers.title: Hierarchical Clustering and Signal Denoising on Digraphs
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a representation of a digraph (directed graph) as a Hermitian matrix derived from its adjacency matrix. This representation characterizes both the connectivity and the edge orientation of the digraph. Based on the spectral decomposition of the Hermitian matrix, a digraph clustering algorithm with $k$-means is introduced to produce a partition on the graph. Applying this algorithm (bottom-up) recursively to a digraph with partially labeled vertices yields a spectral hierarchical digraph clustering (\myproj) algorithm that produces consistent nested partitions of the digraph, or equivalently, a tree structure. Furthermore, based on the in-degree and out-degree of each cluster in the digraph clustering, a pair of hierarchical interval partitions (filtrations) can be derived in a top-down manner to produce a pair of nested knot sequences. These knot sequences facilitate the construction of multilevel spline quasi-interpolants, enabling a noisy graph signal to be decomposed into a coarse approximation and inter-level details, followed by adaptive thresholding and reconstruction. Experiments on synthetic and real-world digraphs demonstrate the superiority of our {\myproj} algorithm for digraph clustering across diverse graph structural properties (homophily and heterophily) and supervision settings. Moreover, experiments on digraph signal processing using multilevel spline quasi-interpolants further demonstrate the effectiveness of signal recovery on digraphs in terms of RMSE and SNR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把有向图的邻接矩阵转成同时刻画连通性与边方向的 Hermitian 矩阵，基于其谱分解做 k-means 聚类，并自底向上递归得到一致的嵌套划分（谱层次有向图聚类）；再由各簇的入度/出度自顶向下生成一对层次区间 filtration 与嵌套结点序列，构造多层 spline 拟插值，把含噪图信号分解为粗逼近与层间细节后做自适应阈值重构。合成与真实有向图实验显示该聚类算法在同配/异配结构与不同监督设定下均占优，信号恢复在 RMSE 与 SNR 上有效。
Motivation: 有向图的边方向难以在传统无向谱聚类中保留，且图信号去噪需要能随结构自适应的多层分解工具。
Method: 以邻接矩阵构造 Hermitian 表示并做谱分解，配合 k-means 得到划分；自底向上递归处理含部分标注顶点的图得到层次树结构；由簇的 in-degree/out-degree 自顶向下导出一对 hierarchical interval partitions（filtrations）与嵌套结点序列，构造 multilevel spline quasi-interpolants，对图信号做分解、自适应阈值与重构。
Result: 在合成与真实有向图上，SHDC 算法在多样图结构（homophily 与 heterophily）及不同监督设定下展现聚类优势；digraph 信号处理实验以 RMSE 与 SNR 衡量，多层 spline 拟插值重构有效恢复含噪图信号。
Conclusion: 用 Hermitian 谱表示保留边方向，再以入度/出度驱动的 filtration 构造多层拟插值，可同时支撑有向图层次聚类与图信号去噪。

papers.title: Two-Timescale Fine-tuning Provably Learns New Features for Two-Layer ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning pre-trained models on specialized tasks with scarce data is central to modern deep learning. Despite its empirical success, theoretical understanding of fine-tuning remains limited. We introduce a Gaussian multi-index setting to study fine-tuning from pre-trained weights, where the teacher network has $m+1$ features, $m$ of which are learned during pre-training and one of which must be learned during fine-tuning. For two-layer ReLU networks, we show that two-timescale training, i.e., updating the outer weights infinitely faster than the hidden ones, learns the new task-specific feature while preserving the pre-trained ones in the model representation. Moreover, only $\mathcal{O}(d)$ fine-tuning samples are required for this recovery, independently of the number of pre-trained features. In contrast, with random initialization, the same number of samples is insufficient to recover the target parameters. Our results therefore demonstrate that pre-training can induce an implicit bias with a clear statistical advantage over random initialization, enabling feature learning from scarce fine-tuning data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Gaussian multi-index 设定下证明：两层 ReLU 网络做 two-timescale fine-tuning（外层权重更新远快于隐层权重）能学到教师网络中微调阶段才出现的那个新任务特征，同时保留预训练已学到的 m 个特征。恢复该特征只需 O(d) 个微调样本，且与预训练特征数 m 无关；同样样本量下随机初始化无法恢复目标参数。
Motivation: 微调在数据稀缺任务上经验上很成功，但其理论机制不清：预训练权重究竟如何带来统计优势、需要多少样本才能学到新特征，缺少可证明的刻画。
Method: 构造 Gaussian multi-index 设定，教师网络含 m+1 个特征（m 个在预训练阶段学到，1 个需在微调阶段学到）；对两层 ReLU 网络分析 two-timescale 训练动力学，即外层权重更新速度远快于隐层权重，并与随机初始化在同等样本量下对比。
Result: two-timescale 训练可恢复新的任务特定特征并保留预训练特征，所需微调样本量为 O(d)，与预训练特征数 m 无关；相同样本量下随机初始化不足以恢复目标参数。
Conclusion: 预训练诱导了一种隐式偏置 (implicit bias)，在稀缺微调数据下相对随机初始化具有明确的统计优势，使特征学习成为可能。

papers.title: On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at the IROS 2026 workshop: Deformable Objects Manipulation: Research Foundations, Reproducibility and Real-World Challenges
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 可微物理优化在 MPM 材料操作仿真中的梯度数值不可靠：GPU many-to-one 求和因线程调度顺序不确定，会改变长时程梯度并使某个参数梯度相对确定性参考发生符号反转；同时重复运行的损失波动随 rollout 变长增长远快于参数扰动引起的损失变化，使有限差分检查失效。作者据此要求可复现的累加顺序、把扰动损失变化与重复运行波动对比的有限差分验证，以及显式报告目标函数构造。
Motivation: 机器人材料操作的系统辨识与轨迹优化依赖穿过长时程、富接触仿真 rollout 的梯度，但这些梯度的数值可靠性此前缺少受控检验，而符号翻转或噪声淹没会直接让优化解不可信。
Method: 在两个由弹塑性与颗粒材料操作导出的 Material Point Method (MPM) 系统辨识 benchmark 上，受控检验三类效应：GPU many-to-one 求和的线程调度顺序、长时程下有限差分检查与重复运行损失波动的量级对比、观测与损失定义对优化行为及独立指标所偏好解的影响。
Result: 线程调度相关的 GPU 求和顺序改变了长时程梯度，并使一个参数梯度相对确定性参考符号反转；rollout 变长时重复运行损失变化增长远快于被检验参数扰动引起的损失变化，有限差分检查因此更不可靠；观测与损失定义改变了优化行为以及独立指标偏好的解。

papers.title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Codoku 是可按需再生成的程序推理基准：把部分程序的类型化空格填满以同时满足控制流图、执行路径等全局静态与动态约束，因部分程序无法执行且合法填充在指数空间中稀疏，工具调用与穷举都替代不了程序推理。在固定工具预算的 coding agent 上评测五个前沿模型共 300 道题，开源模型在小题即受挫，闭源模型在大题上也只解出约一半。
Motivation: 现有程序推理基准依赖两个前提：agent 可以直接执行程序拿到答案，且固定题集来自既有程序、易污染而更新昂贵。coding agent 打破了这两点。
Method: 通过 semantic reification 从零合成谜题，按需生成可控复杂度的新题并附带保证可解的 witness；任务要求填入类型化单元格以满足规定的控制流图与执行路径等全局约束；评测设置为固定工具预算内可任意用工具的 coding agent。
Result: 在 300 道谜题上评测五个前沿模型：小尺寸谜题已让 open-weight 模型受挫，proprietary 模型在大尺寸谜题上也只解出约一半（about half）。
Conclusion: Codoku 作为可再生测试台，用可按需出题且带可解性保证的方式跟踪 coding agent 的程序推理能力，避免执行捷径与题集污染。

papers.title: CapField-OPD: Learning Continuous Capability Fields via Joint-Anchored Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward-specialized post-training produces strong experts for flow-based generative models, while multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates their capabilities into a single student. Existing methods, however, route each prompt to a single teacher according to its semantic category, implicitly binding the desired capability to prompt content. This coupling makes capability invocation vulnerable to prompt perturbations and prevents users from explicitly adjusting the strength of the desired capability at inference time. In this work, we introduce CapField-OPD, an OPD framework that integrates multiple teachers into a continuous capability field through explicit capability coordinates. We use teacher models as anchors to construct this field, with the coordinates determining how their outputs are combined. Each capability configuration thus receives a unique supervision target, and capability control no longer depends on prompt semantics. Since the training anchors may not be optimal at inference time, we further profile the learned field on a small calibration set. The coordinate with the highest mean reward serves as the recommended default, while coordinates that are frequently optimal offer a promising candidate set for test-time scaling. Extensive experiments on compositional generation, text rendering, and visual aesthetics demonstrate that CapField-OPD consolidates multiple specialized teachers into a single student while preserving or surpassing their performance, reliably invokes the desired capabilities under semantics-preserving prompt variations, and supports continuous capability control and coordinate-based test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CapField-OPD 把多个奖励后训练的 flow 模型教师经由显式能力坐标 (capability coordinates) 融合成连续能力场，学生按坐标而非 prompt 语义调用能力。在组合生成、文字渲染与视觉美学实验中，它在语义保持的 prompt 扰动下仍可靠调用目标能力，并支持连续能力控制与基于坐标的 test-time scaling。
Motivation: 现有 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 按语义类别把 prompt 路由到单一教师，能力被绑定在 prompt 内容上，易受 prompt 扰动影响，且推理时无法显式调节能力强度。
Method: 以各教师模型为锚点 (anchors) 构造连续能力场，坐标决定教师输出如何组合，每个能力配置得到唯一监督目标；训练锚点可能非推理最优，故在小规模校准集上 profile 该场，取平均奖励最高的坐标作为推荐默认值。
Result: 在组合生成、文字渲染、视觉美学三类任务上，CapField-OPD 把多个专门化教师整合进单一学生，保持或超越其性能，并在语义保持的 prompt 变化下可靠调用目标能力，支持连续能力控制与坐标式 test-time scaling；频繁最优的坐标构成候选集。
Conclusion: 把能力从 prompt 语义中解耦、用坐标显式索引，可以让多教师蒸馏出的单一学生既稳定调用能力又可在推理时连续调节强度。

papers.title: Minimax Last-Iterate Convergence in Matrix Games with Observed Actions
papers.abstract_en: We study last-iterate convergence in unknown two-player zero-sum matrix games with bandit payoff feedback and observed opponent actions. For games with $d$ actions per player, we develop an algorithm achieving a duality gap of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{d/t})$ with high probability, simultaneously at every round $t$. This improves the dimension dependence of the best previously known guarantee by a factor of $d^{3/2}$. The rate matches a standard bandit lower bound, establishing minimax optimality in both the number of actions and the number of rounds, up to logarithmic factors. The algorithm is computationally efficient, requiring only $\mathcal{O}(d)$ time and memory per round. Our technical contribution is a joint design of adaptive averaging and corrected exponential weights that absorbs estimation variance, together with a potential argument that bounds phase durations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有 bandit 收益反馈、且能观察对手动作的两人零和矩阵博弈中，给出一个末次迭代 (last-iterate) 收敛算法：每轮以高概率同时把 duality gap 压到 Õ(√(d/t))，且每轮只需 O(d) 时间与内存。该速率匹配 bandit 下界，在动作数与轮数上均 minimax 最优（差对数因子），并把已知最优保证的维数依赖改进了 d^{3/2} 倍。
Motivation: 未知收益矩阵的 bandit 博弈中，此前最好的末次迭代保证维数依赖过松，且需要在每一轮同时成立的高概率界，而非仅期望意义或单轮结论。
Method: 联合设计 adaptive averaging 与 corrected exponential weights 以吸收收益估计方差，再用一个 potential 论证界定各 phase 的持续时间；算法每轮只需 O(d) 时间与内存。
Result: d 个动作、t 轮下 duality gap 为 Õ(√(d/t))，高概率且对每个轮次 t 同时成立；相对已知最优保证改进 d^{3/2} 倍维数依赖；匹配 bandit 下界，动作数与轮数上 minimax 最优（至多差对数因子）；每轮复杂度 O(d) 时间与内存。
Conclusion: bandit 反馈加对手动作可观测时，末次迭代收敛可以同时做到 minimax 最优速率与线性每轮开销，关键在于让自适应平均与修正指数权重共同吸收估计方差。

papers.title: A General Harness for Protein Foundation Model Fitness Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate fitness prediction is central to protein engineering and understanding sequence-function relationships. With advances in deep learning, protein foundation models (PFMs) have become widely used for this task. Recent analyses, however, show that these models share preferences reflecting their training corpora, while unreliable inputs can further distort fitness predictions. Family-specific evolutionary evidence and structural context can help address these limitations by providing complementary constraints on model scores, motivating VenusREM-Harness (VRH), a general, model-agnostic, training-free Retrieval-Enhanced Mutation harness. It fuses frozen model scores with multiple sequence alignment (MSA) evidence according to model uncertainty, then applies gated background correction and score shrinkage based on structural confidence and solvent exposure. Across 1,211 assays and 3.1 million measured variants from ProteinGym, VenusMutHub, and the newly curated viral benchmark VenusViroHub, all 71 configurations improve Spearman correlation on all 3 benchmarks by 0.073 on average, with broad gains across 5 metrics. Extended analyses relate retrieval gains to model-MSA preference differences, assess domain-level gains and immune-escape cases, and quantify computational speedups. Built with VRH, VenusREM2 is the first to rank highest in all function, taxon, MSA-depth, and mutation-depth categories, with a ProteinGym Average Spearman of 0.556, 0.038 above the prior best.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VenusREM-Harness (VRH)，一个与模型无关、免训练的检索增强突变框架：按模型不确定性把冻结的蛋白基础模型分数与 MSA 进化证据融合，再用结构置信度与溶剂可及性做门控背景校正和分数收缩。在 ProteinGym、VenusMutHub 与新整理的病毒基准 VenusViroHub 共 1,211 个 assay、310 万个实测突变上，71 种配置在三个基准上平均提升 Spearman 相关 0.073；基于 VRH 构建的 VenusREM2 首次在功能、类群、MSA 深度与突变深度全部类别中排名第一，ProteinGym 平均 Spearman 0.556，比此前最优高 0.038。
Motivation: 蛋白基础模型 (PFM) 的 fitness 预测存在共享偏好（反映训练语料），且不可靠输入会进一步扭曲分数；单一模型分数缺少家族进化证据与结构上下文的互补约束。
Method: VRH 是 model-agnostic、training-free 的 Retrieval-Enhanced Mutation harness：按模型不确定性融合冻结模型分数与多序列比对 (MSA) 证据，随后基于结构置信度与溶剂可及性执行门控背景校正 (gated background correction) 与分数收缩 (score shrinkage)；在其上构建 VenusREM2。
Result: 在 1,211 个 assay、310 万个实测突变上，71 种配置在 ProteinGym、VenusMutHub、VenusViroHub 三个基准上 Spearman 平均提升 0.073，且在 5 项指标上普遍获益；VenusREM2 的 ProteinGym Average Spearman 为 0.556，比此前最优高 0.038，并在功能、类群、MSA 深度、突变深度全部类别中排名第一；扩展分析还量化了计算加速。
Conclusion: 把冻结 PFM 分数与进化/结构证据按不确定性加权融合，可在不重训模型的前提下系统性提高突变 fitness 排序，且该收益跨基准、跨指标与各子类别一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniTide: Co-Designing Algorithms and Systems for Efficient On-Device Omni-LLM Streaming
papers.abstract_en: On-device streaming omni-modal inference safeguards user privacy and eliminates prohibitive per-token API costs, but faces a critical bottleneck: the continuous influx of multimodal data rapidly exhausts constrained memory and compute budgets via monotonic KV cache growth. Existing sparse attention methods fall short, either incurring prohibitive online estimation latency or destroying interleaved cross-modal context, while failing to resolve physical memory fragmentation. We present OmniTide, the first algorithm-system co-design tailored for efficient on-device streaming omni-modal inference. Driven by the observation of modality-aware structural sparsity, OmniTide adopts a unit-based abstraction with two components: (1) At the algorithm level, OmniPick logically retains critical multimodal context based on unit boundaries and modality importance to preserve task accuracy; (2) At the system level, OmniPage physically partitions the cache by retention likelihood and dynamically compacts surviving sparse tokens, minimizing both memory fragmentation and data-movement overhead. Extensive evaluations across three streaming benchmarks and two consumer-device architectures show that OmniTide achieves up to $12.72\times$ kernel speedups and $2.40\times$ lower stream-loop latency. On StreamingBench, it improves accuracy by up to 18.0 percentage points over sliding-window baselines at comparable session cost. OmniPage further reduces the physical KV span by up to 26.7% relative to native logical eviction, unlocking real-time, infinite-context streaming on edge devices.

papers.title: Revitalizing Medical Time Series with Vision-Informed Retrieval: A Vision-Language Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Medical time series (MedTS) underpin many clinical classification tasks, yet existing methods usually represent them only as numerical sequences and underuse the morphology that is explicit in waveform inspection. To bridge this gap, we introduce Vision-Informed Retrieval (ViRe), which uses a frozen VLM-derived waveform representation as a morphology-aware Query to guide retrieval from raw numerical MedTS features. Specifically, a Vision Query is extracted using pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to obtain morphology-aware priors from waveform plots. A tailored attention-based cross-modal retrieval mechanism then uses the Vision Query to select morphology-relevant temporal and channel evidence from the numerical representation. ViRe demonstrates strong effectiveness against ten established baselines, yielding an overall 6.42% relative improvement over the previous state of the art across six public benchmarks. Code, training scripts, and reproducibility materials are publicly available in the GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Levi-Ackman/ViRe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViRe 用冻结 VLM 从波形图提取形态感知的 Vision Query，作为跨模态检索的查询去引导原始数值医学时间序列表示，从而把波形目检中的形态信息补回只当数值序列处理的 MedTS 表示。在六个公开基准上相对此前 SOTA 总体提升 6.42%，对比十个已有基线。
Motivation: 医学时间序列分类现有方法只把数据当数值序列表示，浪费了波形目检中显式的形态信息，临床分类精度受限。
Method: ViRe 先用预训练视觉语言模型 (VLM) 从波形图中抽取形态先验作为 Vision Query，再用定制的基于注意力的跨模态检索机制，让该 Query 从数值表示中选择与形态相关的时序与通道证据；VLM 保持冻结。
Result: 在六个公开基准上相对此前 state of the art 总体提升 6.42%，对比十个已有基线；代码、训练脚本与复现材料已在 GitHub 公开。
Conclusion: 把波形形态作为视觉先验注入检索，可以补足纯数值 MedTS 表示的形态盲区并带来跨基准一致的分类收益。

papers.title: DirectUV: Image-Conditioned UV Texture Generation with Surface-Aware Positional Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality UV textures for 3D meshes remains challenging. Multi-view projection pipelines suffer from occlusion and view inconsistency, and recent methods that generate textures directly in UV space still rely on auxiliary modules to supply 3D information, leaving the attention mechanism tied to UV-grid positions rather than to the underlying surface geometry. This mismatch limits coherence across seams and disconnected UV islands. We propose DirectUV, an image-conditioned UV texture diffusion framework that operates in the latent UV space of a pretrained image VAE, in which a Diffusion Transformer denoises the UV latent given a single input image and a coarse UV map. At its core, Surface-Aware Positional Encoding (SAPE) replaces the standard 2D-grid positional encoding with encodings derived from per-token 3D surface coordinates obtained via UV-to-surface correspondence. As positional encodings define the distance metric used by attention, SAPE enables tokens to interact according to 3D positional proximity derived from surface correspondence rather than UV-grid distance, restoring coherence across seams and disconnected islands. A multi-level extension further assigns different attention heads to progressively finer subdivisions of the same latent UV patch, allowing the model to reason about surface structure at multiple granularities. Experiments show that DirectUV produces sharper and more globally consistent textures than other baselines, with the largest improvements in occluded and view-unseen regions where projection-based methods leave gaps or stretched textures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DirectUV 在预训练图像 VAE 的 latent UV 空间里用 Diffusion Transformer 直接生成 3D mesh 的 UV 纹理，用 Surface-Aware Positional Encoding (SAPE) 把注意力的位置度量从 UV 网格距离换成由 UV-to-surface 对应得到的 3D 表面坐标距离。这样 token 按表面邻近度交互，跨 UV 缝合线与不连通 island 的纹理恢复一致；实验显示其纹理比各基线更锐利、全局更一致，遮挡区与视角未见区提升最大。
Motivation: 多视角投影管线受遮挡与视角不一致困扰，直接在 UV 空间生成的方法仍依赖辅助模块补 3D 信息，注意力被绑在 UV 网格位置而非真实表面几何上，导致缝合线与不连通 UV island 处不连贯。
Method: 图像条件的 UV 纹理扩散框架：在预训练图像 VAE 的 latent UV 空间中，由 Diffusion Transformer 以单张输入图像和粗 UV map 为条件去噪 UV latent；SAPE 用 UV-to-surface 对应得到的每 token 3D 表面坐标替代标准 2D 网格位置编码，另有多层级扩展把不同注意力头分配到同一 latent UV patch 的逐级细分上，让模型在多个粒度上推理表面结构。
Result: 实验显示 DirectUV 比其他基线生成更锐利、全局更一致的纹理，最大提升出现在遮挡区域与视角未见区域——投影式方法在这些位置留下空洞或拉伸纹理。
Conclusion: 把注意力的位置度量建立在 3D 表面坐标而非 UV 网格坐标上，可恢复跨缝合线与不连通 island 的纹理一致性，遮挡与未见视角是收益最大的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Can Attention Heads Be Statically Defined?
papers.abstract_en: Some attention heads learn similar patterns across inputs. Reusing these patterns could reduce training cost by avoiding repeated query-key score computation and softmax. Through controlled pretraining comparisons, we identify Selective Attention Freezing (SAF), which selects heads with low attention-pattern variance and replaces their attention weights with fitted post-softmax means halfway through training. We represent these fixed patterns with absolute-position and relative-distance preferences, reducing storage from quadratic to linear in sequence length. A fused kernel reconstructs the patterns and executes ordinary-attention and replaced heads together. At matched training-token budgets, replacing 25% of attention heads gives 1.056x faster post-replacement optimiser updates at 124M parameters and 4K context, with a 0.77% perplexity increase. At 1B and 8K context, post-replacement updates are 1.068x faster on four GPUs including communication, with a 0.51% perplexity increase. The resulting models also accelerate long-input finetuning and causal prefill. After associative-recall adaptation, the 124M model with 25% replacement generalises to more key-value pairs at a fixed length better than ordinary attention and two pruning controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Selective Attention Freezing (SAF)：训练中途把注意力模式方差低的注意力头替换为拟合的 post-softmax 均值，用绝对位置与相对距离偏好表示，使存储从序列长度平方降为线性。在匹配训练 token 预算下，替换 25% 头在 124M/4K 上让更新加速 1.056x、困惑度仅升 0.77%，在 1B/8K 四卡上加速 1.068x、困惑度升 0.51%。
Motivation: 许多注意力头在不同输入上学到相似模式，重复计算 query-key 分数与 softmax 浪费训练算力；但哪些头可以被静态固定缺少可操作的判定与压缩表示。
Method: 通过受控预训练对比识别 SAF：挑选注意力模式方差低的头，在训练进行到一半时用拟合的 post-softmax 均值替换其注意力权重；固定模式以绝对位置与相对距离偏好编码（存储由平方降为线性），并用 fused kernel 同时重建这些模式、与普通注意力头一起执行。
Result: 匹配训练 token 预算下，替换 25% 注意力头：124M 参数、4K 上下文时替换后优化器更新加速 1.056x，困惑度上升 0.77%；1B 参数、8K 上下文时含通信在四 GPU 上更新加速 1.068x，困惑度上升 0.51%。所得模型还加速长输入微调与 causal prefill；经 associative-recall 适应后，124M 模型在固定长度下对更多 key-value 对的泛化优于普通注意力与两个 pruning 对照。
Conclusion: 注意力头能否静态定义可由注意力模式方差判定：固定低方差头并以位置偏好压缩表示，能在几乎不损困惑度的前提下加速训练与长输入推理，并保持 associative-recall 泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Harness evolution improves LLM agents by learning from execution trajectories, but existing experience- and skill-based methods are less effective on long-horizon tasks. As interactions grow, useful evidence can be buried by redundant or outdated context, making context management itself a key bottleneck. We introduce ContextEvo, a framework that learns a context policy from long-horizon trajectories. ContextEvo reconstructs the model-visible context at key decision points, identifies context-related failures, and applies targeted policy updates. Starting from the open-source Pi-agent harness, ContextEvo improves performance across three long-horizon task benchmarks, achieving results comparable to or better than several prominent agent harnesses, including Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. Additional analyses show that fixed or locally evolved context strategies can fall short under long-horizon information pressure, while our methods adapt to the information demands of each environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContextEvo 从长程执行轨迹中学习上下文管理策略：在关键决策点重建模型可见上下文、定位与上下文相关的失败并做定向策略更新。基于开源 Pi-agent harness，在三个长程任务基准上达到与 Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw 等主流 harness 相当或更好的结果。
Motivation: 长程任务中交互变长后，有用证据被冗余或过时上下文淹没，上下文管理本身成为瓶颈，而现有基于经验或技能的 harness 进化方法在长程任务上效果下降。
Method: ContextEvo 框架：在关键决策点重建模型可见上下文，识别 context-related failures，据此对上下文策略做定向更新；起点为开源 Pi-agent harness，从长程轨迹中学习策略。
Result: 在三个长程任务基准上性能提升，达到或优于 Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw 等多个知名 agent harness；附加分析显示固定或局部演化的上下文策略在长程信息压力下会失效，而该方法能适应各环境的信息需求。
Conclusion: 上下文管理策略值得作为独立对象来进化，而非只进化技能或经验；固定与局部演化的策略不足以应对长程信息压力。

papers.title: SEmoEdit: Probing and Harnessing the Editability of Pre-trained Speech Flows
papers.abstract_en: Existing training-based speech emotion editing methods often require substantial task-specific training and can be unstable. This motivates us to investigate whether the pretrained generative dynamics of large-scale text-to-speech (TTS) models can be directly manipulated for training-free emotion editing. To answer this question, we probe the editability of pretrained flow-matching and hybrid TTS models by constructing a controlled test set and systematically diagnosing editing effects along the generative trajectory. Our analysis reveals that pretrained TTS models are substantially editable in emotion, but such editability is architecture- and trajectory-dependent and can be disrupted by early flow-matching steps, while cross-speaker emotion transport carries additional acoustic attributes beyond emotion. To address these limitations, we propose SEmoEdit, the first training-free framework that formulates emotion editing as dynamic velocity transport between source and target emotions, enabling robust, flow-based speech emotion editing directly within pretrained TTS models. SEmoEdit unifies three core operations: emotion replacement, emotion erasure, and continuous emotion interpolation, requiring neither parameter updates nor task-specific optimization. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce SEmoEditBench, a dataset comprising 600 editing cases, and conduct extensive experiments across state-of-the-art (SOTA) models and backbones. Our results show that SEmoEdit is highly effective and broadly applicable, outperforming existing training-based and activation-steering methods. Ultimately, this work reveals that pretrained speech flows possess rich, latent emotion-editing capabilities, providing useful guidance for real applications. Code, benchmark, and Audio samples are available at https://github.com/imxtx/SEmoEdit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEmoEdit 把语音情感编辑表述为预训练 TTS flow-matching 轨迹上源情感与目标情感之间的动态速度传输 (dynamic velocity transport)，无需参数更新或任务特定优化即可完成情感替换、擦除与连续插值。诊断显示预训练 TTS 的情感可编辑性依赖架构与轨迹、且会被早期 flow-matching 步骤破坏；在 600 个编辑案例的 SEmoEditBench 上，该方法优于现有基于训练与 activation-steering 的方法。
Motivation: 现有基于训练的语音情感编辑需要大量任务特定训练且不稳定；预训练 TTS 的生成动力学能否被直接操控以实现免训练编辑此前缺少系统诊断。
Method: 先构建受控测试集，沿生成轨迹系统诊断 flow-matching 与混合 TTS 模型的编辑效应，定位可编辑性对架构与轨迹的依赖；再提出 SEmoEdit，将情感编辑建模为源/目标情感间的动态速度传输，统一情感替换、擦除与连续插值三种操作，不更新参数也不做任务特定优化。
Result: 引入 SEmoEditBench，含 600 个编辑案例，并在多个 SOTA 模型与 backbone 上做实验；结果显示 SEmoEdit 优于现有基于训练的方法和 activation-steering 方法。诊断发现预训练 TTS 在情感上高度可编辑，但可编辑性依赖架构与轨迹、会被早期 flow-matching 步骤破坏，且跨说话人情感迁移会带入情感之外的声学属性。
Conclusion: 预训练语音 flow 蕴含可直接操控的潜在情感编辑能力，免训练的速度传输式编辑即可达到优于训练式方案的效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nereus: Adaptive Parallelism for LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models (LLMs) coordinates multiple models across generation, inference, and training on GPU clusters. Several factors may change during a run, including resource availability, sequence length, memory pressure, and stage bottlenecks. As a consequence, an execution plan that was initially suitable can then become slow or even infeasible over time. However, adapting a job whose models share GPUs entails significant challenges: deciding whether a new plan is worth the transition cost, reusing the job's distributed state, and coordinating GPU transfers across models and stages. Nereus targets these challenges as a cost-aware runtime that adapts RL post-training jobs into efficient execution plans. Its low-overhead controller selects a memory-feasible global plan and admits the transition using a cost model calibrated against the running job. To estimate and execute a transition, Nereus represents the distributed state of each replica of a model-stage (one model in one stage) as an Elastic Model Unit. It then employs a global transition graph to order the transformations and GPU transfers of these units. In a trace built from real data, online TP/PP adaptation reduces average step latency by 27.7% relative to the initial fixed TP/PP layout with DP scaling. In a 1,000-step run reaching 1,024 GPUs, six transitions consume 0.079% of total run time. Nereus improves end-to-end 8B PPO throughput by 2.14--7.27$\times$ over OpenRLHF and by 1.10--1.47$\times$ over Verl across diverse clusters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nereus 是面向 LLM 强化学习后训练的成本感知运行时，在资源、序列长度、显存压力与阶段瓶颈变化时在线切换执行计划：用对运行中作业标定的成本模型判定切换是否划算，把每个 model-stage 副本的分布式状态抽象为 Elastic Model Unit，再用全局转移图排序状态迁移与 GPU 传输。在真实数据构建的 trace 上，在线 TP/PP 自适应使平均 step latency 相对固定 TP/PP + DP 扩展下降 27.7%；1000 步扩到 1024 GPU 的运行中六次切换只占总运行时间 0.079%。
Motivation: LLM RL 后训练横跨生成、推理、训练三类阶段并共享 GPU，运行中资源可用性、序列长度、显存压力和阶段瓶颈会变化，初始执行计划会变慢甚至不可行；而共享 GPU 下切换计划要付迁移成本、复用分布式状态并协调跨模型与跨阶段的 GPU 搬运。
Method: 低成本 controller 选出显存可行的全局计划，并用针对运行中作业标定的成本模型决定是否接纳切换；把每个 model-stage（某阶段中的某个模型）的每个副本的分布式状态表示为 Elastic Model Unit，再用全局转移图 (global transition graph) 排序这些单元的变换与 GPU 传输。
Result: 在由真实数据构建的 trace 上，在线 TP/PP 自适应相比初始固定 TP/PP 布局加 DP scaling，平均 step latency 降低 27.7%；一次 1,000 步、扩到 1,024 GPU 的运行中六次切换仅消耗总运行时间的 0.079%；端到端 8B PPO 吞吐相对 OpenRLHF 提升 2.14–7.27×，相对 Verl 提升 1.10–1.47×，覆盖多种集群。
Conclusion: 把切换决策交给按运行中作业标定的成本模型、把分布式状态打包成可迁移单元并用全局转移图排序，可以让 RL 后训练作业在集群条件变化时持续自适应，且切换开销可忽略、吞吐显著高于 OpenRLHF 与 Verl。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Universal Dynamic Portfolios
papers.abstract_en: Cover's Universal Portfolio (Cover, 1991) matches the performance of the best constant rebalanced portfolio in hindsight. We generalize this framework to compete with an arbitrary comparator sequence $\mathbf{u}_1,\ldots,\mathbf{u}_T$, leading to a dynamic regret minimization problem for the log loss where existing methods break down due to potentially unbounded gradients. The log loss is exp-concave, a curvature property that classically yields fast rates for static regret, yet we show that this advantage generally disappears in the dynamic setting. In particular, a linear-loss-type $\sqrt{TP_T}$ dependence is unavoidable, where $P_T=\sum_{t=2}^T\lVert\mathbf{u}_t-\mathbf{u}_{t-1}\rVert_1$ is the standard path length. This limitation stems from the coarse nature of $P_T$, which obscures finer spatial and temporal structure of the comparator sequence. We therefore introduce two structure-aware measures---the Jensen-Shannon distance for spatial structure and the JS$^q$-path length for temporal structure---under which faster rates are attainable when the comparator sequence has favorable structure. To achieve sharp bounds for both measures simultaneously, we develop Universal Dynamic Portfolio, a parameter-free method that combines a new Dirichlet Hedge algorithm with a fixed-share update, while retaining a near-optimal $P_T$ guarantee in the worst case. Finally, under an additional bounded-gradient assumption, we show that OPS admits the faster $T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3}$ dynamic regret rate over all comparator sequences. We attain this rate with a tractable proper algorithm that applies more broadly to general online exp-concave optimization over arbitrary compact convex domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Cover 通用投资组合 (Universal Portfolio) 推广到与任意比较序列竞争的动态遗憾 (dynamic regret) 问题，证明 log loss 下 √(T·P_T) 的路径长度依赖不可避免，并提出参数无关的 Universal Dynamic Portfolio：新 Dirichlet Hedge 加 fixed-share 更新，同时对 Jensen-Shannon 空间结构与 JS^q 时间结构取得更快速率且保留近最优 P_T 保证。
Motivation: log loss 虽是 exp-concave、静态遗憾下有快速率，但动态设定下现有方法因梯度可能无界而失效，且经典曲率优势消失；标准路径长度 P_T 过粗，掩盖了比较序列更细的时空结构。
Method: 先证明线性损失型 √(T·P_T) 依赖不可避免；再引入两个结构感知度量——Jensen-Shannon 距离刻画空间结构、JS^q-path length 刻画时间结构；据此设计参数无关的 Universal Dynamic Portfolio，结合新 Dirichlet Hedge 算法与 fixed-share 更新，并推广到任意紧凸域上的一般在线 exp-concave 优化。
Result: 证明动态 log loss 下 √(T·P_T)（P_T=Σ‖u_t−u_{t−1}‖₁）依赖不可避免；在附加有界梯度假设下，OPS 对所有比较序列达到 T^{1/3}P_T^{2/3} 的动态遗憾速率；所提算法在最坏情形仍保留近最优 P_T 保证。
Conclusion: 标准路径长度 P_T 是动态 log loss 下的粗粒度瓶颈，改用 Jensen-Shannon 与 JS^q 结构度量可在比较序列结构有利时取得更快速率，且该结论可推广到一般在线 exp-concave 优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Schrödinger bridges provide an entropy-regularized framework and a principled solution for unpaired domain translation. In practice, a pretrained bridge may need to be adapted to human preferences or physical constraints through a reward a problem closely related to reward tilting in diffusion models but underexplored for Schrödinger bridges. We introduce Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM), a post-training method for fine-tuning a learned bridge $P$ between source $p_0$ and target $p_1$ toward a reward-tilted target $p_1^r\propto p_1e^r$, while preserving source $p_0$. We formulate this adaptation as alternating optimization initialized from $P$, provide theoretical justification, and derive a practical algorithm based on Adjoint Matching. We evaluate TSBM on unpaired image-to-image translation targeting digit properties in MNIST and facial attributes in CelebA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tilted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (TSBM)：把已训练好的 Schrödinger bridge 按奖励倾斜目标 p1^r ∝ p1·e^r 做后训练微调，同时保持源分布 p0 不变。方法写成交替优化并给出理论依据，实际算法基于 Adjoint Matching，在 MNIST 数字属性与 CelebA 人脸属性的非成对图像翻译上验证。
Motivation: 预训练 Schrödinger bridge 需要按人类偏好或物理约束（奖励）适配，这一 reward tilting 问题在 diffusion model 中已有研究，但在 Schrödinger bridge 上几乎未被探索。
Method: 以已学到的 bridge P 为初值，将适配形式化为交替优化，目标是把目标分布倾斜为 p1^r ∝ p1·e^r 同时保留源分布 p0；给出理论论证，并基于 Adjoint Matching 推导出可实现的算法。
Result: 在 MNIST 数字属性与 CelebA 人脸属性的非成对图像到图像翻译 (unpaired image-to-image translation) 上评估 TSBM，任务是把 bridge 微调到指定属性奖励。
Conclusion: Schrödinger bridge 可以在保持源分布的前提下，通过基于 Adjoint Matching 的交替优化向奖励倾斜的目标分布做后训练适配。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Backdoor as Probe: Test-Time Adversarial Defense for CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adversarial defense improves the robustness of vision-language foundation models such as CLIP without retraining. However, adversarial activation shifts are typically treated as distortions to suppress, rather than signals to exploit. We turn these shifts into defense signals by repurposing the trigger-to-target mechanism of backdoors. The key is to implant a defender-controlled backdoor as a probe that is weakly activated by clean inputs but strongly activated by adversarial shifts. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Backdoor as Probe} (BaP), a test-time adversarial defense for CLIP. BaP constructs the probe through a closed-form model edit to a selected MLP layer. It projects the average adversarial activation shift and a defender-specified semantic direction onto the layer's low-energy input and output activation subspaces to obtain the trigger and target directions, respectively. At inference time, adversarial inputs produce measurable responses along the target direction for detection. BaP then selectively rectifies detected inputs by optimizing a small perturbation that steers their representations away from adversarial shifts and toward the clean subspace. Experiments across 16 benchmarks show that BaP improves average robust accuracy from 1.0\% to 52.3\% while retaining clean accuracy, achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods with up to a \(5.7\times\) inference speedup. BaP further shows the generalization to adversarial attacks on large vision-language models. Project page: https://robin-wzq.github.io/Backdoor-as-Probe/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BaP 把后门的触发-目标机制反用作 CLIP 的测试时对抗防御探针：植入一个干净输入弱激活、对抗偏移强激活的防御者可控后门，检测到对抗输入后再用小扰动优化把表征推回干净子空间。在 16 个 benchmark 上平均鲁棒精度从 1.0% 提到 52.3%，同时保持干净精度，推理最高加速 5.7×。
Motivation: 测试时对抗防御通常把对抗激活偏移当作需要压制的失真，浪费了本可作为检测信号的信息；现有方法在不重训的前提下难以兼顾鲁棒性、干净精度与推理开销。
Method: 对选定 MLP 层做闭式模型编辑 (closed-form model edit) 构造探针：把平均对抗激活偏移与防御者指定的语义方向分别投影到该层的低能量输入/输出激活子空间，得到 trigger 方向与 target 方向；推理时沿 target 方向测量响应做检测，再对检出输入优化一个小扰动，使其表征离开对抗偏移、回到干净子空间。
Result: 在 16 个 benchmark 上，平均鲁棒精度由 1.0% 提升至 52.3%，同时保留干净精度；相对 SOTA 方法性能相当，推理最高获得 5.7× 加速；并展示了对大型视觉-语言模型上对抗攻击的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 对抗激活偏移可以被主动利用而非单纯压制：用闭式编辑植入的后门探针能在测试时检测并选择性修复对抗输入，以接近 SOTA 的鲁棒性和显著更低的推理成本实现 CLIP 防御。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 对选定 MLP 层做闭式模型编辑 (closed-form model edit) 构造探针：把平均对抗激活偏移与防御者指定的语义方向分别投影到该层的低能量输入/输出激活子空间，得到 trigger 方向与 target 方向；推理时沿 target 方向测量响应做检测，再对检出输入优化一个小扰动，使其表征离开对抗偏移、回到干净子空间。
summary_sections.result: 在 16 个 benchmark 上，平均鲁棒精度由 1.0% 提升至 52.3%，同时保留干净精度；相对 SOTA 方法性能相当，推理最高获得 5.7× 加速；并展示了对大型视觉-语言模型上对抗攻击的泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对抗激活偏移可以被主动利用而非单纯压制：用闭式编辑植入的后门探针能在测试时检测并选择性修复对抗输入，以接近 SOTA 的鲁棒性和显著更低的推理成本实现 CLIP 防御。

papers.title: Uniform Race: Parameter-Free Approximate Rejection Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We study approximate sampling: given $N$ independent samples from a proposal distribution $μ$, the goal is to select one whose distribution is close to a target $π$ specified only up to a normalizing constant. Block and Polyanskiy (2023) provide finite budget error bounds for approximate rejection sampling (RS) as a function of the acceptance threshold $M$. The threshold $M$ giving the smallest bound, however, depends on properties of $(π,μ)$ that are typically unavailable from the observed sample. This raises a natural question: Can one attain the best RS guarantee without taking $M$ as input? We answer affirmatively by proposing a parameter-free sampling algorithm called uniform race (UR), based on importance weights, which are ratios of target to proposal probabilities (or densities). It divides each observed weight by an independent uniform random variable to form a score and returns the candidate with the largest score. For every budget $N$, its total variation error satisfies the RS upper bound for every fixed threshold $M$ simultaneously, thereby achieving the best such bound in hindsight. We also characterize its output distribution conditional on the largest score, identifying when it is exactly the target $π$. Uniform race has no larger total variation error than a natural budget-calibrated RS derived from Rohatgi et al. (2025) and sampling importance resampling (SIR). In particular, we exhibit instances where UR's error is exponentially smaller in $N$ than that of either baseline. Furthermore, we establish conditions under which attaining this RS guarantee for every $(π,μ)$ uniquely determines the selection probabilities as those of UR. Finally, test-time scaling experiments on LLM math-reasoning tasks corroborate the theoretical comparisons and demonstrate that UR remains competitive in ground-truth accuracy without requiring threshold selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免参数的近似采样算法 uniform race (UR)：把重要性权重（目标与提议分布之比）除以独立均匀随机变量得到分数，返回分数最大的候选。对每个预算 N，其总变差误差同时满足所有固定拒绝采样阈值 M 的上界，从而事后达到最优 RS 保证；在 LLM 数学推理的 test-time scaling 实验中无需选阈值仍保持有竞争力的 ground-truth accuracy。
Motivation: Block 与 Polyanskiy (2023) 给出近似拒绝采样 (RS) 随阈值 M 变化的有限预算误差界，但最优 M 依赖 (π, μ) 的性质，而这些性质通常无法从观测样本得到，导致无法直接取到最好的保证。
Method: UR 基于重要性权重（目标与提议概率/密度之比），将每个权重除以一个独立均匀随机变量构成分数并取最大者输出；分析其在最大分数条件下的输出分布并刻画何时恰为 π；与基于 Rohatgi et al. (2025) 和 sampling importance resampling (SIR) 的预算校准 RS 比较，并在 LLM 数学推理任务上做 test-time scaling 实验。
Result: 对每个预算 N，UR 的总变差误差同时满足每个固定阈值 M 的 RS 上界，事后达到最优该类界；其误差不高于预算校准 RS 与 SIR，并存在实例使 UR 的误差随 N 呈指数级更小；建立的条件表明对每个 (π, μ) 达到该 RS 保证会唯一确定 UR 的选择概率；LLM 数学推理实验中 UR 在不选阈值的情况下保持有竞争力的 ground-truth accuracy。
Conclusion: 在重要性权重上加均匀竞争即可免去阈值选择而不牺牲 RS 保证，且该选择规则在所述条件下被最优性唯一确定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Correction-space Cross-variate Interaction for Test-time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) is a promising paradigm for handling distribution shift in time-series forecasting (TSF), where models adapt at inference time, often leveraging delayed observed data to refine predictions. In the multivariate setting, distribution shifts often exhibit cross-variate dependencies, yet existing TSF-TTA methods adapt each variate independently and ignore this cross-variate structure. Exploiting such structure motivates cross-variate interaction, but coupling variates through backbone predictions introduces direct pathways for mixing uncorrected errors across variates, a concern under the delayed supervision of TSF-TTA. We identify the \emph{interaction space} as a key design choice, and show that acting on adapter corrections that refine backbone outputs, the \emph{correction space}, rather than on the predictions themselves, avoids directly propagating backbone errors across variates. We build on this to propose \textsc{CoRe} (\textsc{Co}rrection-space Interaction \textsc{Re}finement), realizing correction-space interaction through (i) Shared-anchor Correction Refinement (SCR), which combines each variate's correction with a shared anchor through a parameter-efficient bottleneck, and (ii) input-conditioned spectral gating, which adaptively modulates the refinement from the current input window. Across seven backbones, six datasets, and four prediction horizons, \textsc{CoRe} reduces MSE by 25.82\% on average over backbones and 10.57\% over the state-of-the-art TSF-TTA method, with stronger gains at medium-to-long horizons and modest computational overhead. Data and code are available at: https://github.com/yyddou/CoReTTA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多变量时间序列预测的测试时适应 (TTA) 中，各变量独立适应会忽略分布偏移的跨变量依赖，而直接耦合 backbone 预测又会把未修正的误差在变量间传播。CoRe 把跨变量交互放到 adapter 的修正空间 (correction space) 而非预测本身，用共享锚点修正精炼 (SCR) 加输入条件谱门控实现。在七个 backbone、六个数据集、四个预测步长上，MSE 相对 backbone 平均降 25.82%，相对 SOTA TSF-TTA 方法降 10.57%，中长步长增益更强。
Motivation: 多变量 TSF 的分布偏移带有跨变量依赖，但现有 TSF-TTA 方法逐变量独立适应；若直接在预测上耦合变量，又会在延迟监督下把未修正的 backbone 误差直接混入其他变量。
Method: 提出 CoRe (Correction-space Interaction Refinement)：识别 interaction space 为关键设计选择，在 adapter 修正（refine backbone 输出的量）上做跨变量交互。组件包括 Shared-anchor Correction Refinement (SCR)，经参数高效 bottleneck 把各变量修正与共享锚点结合；以及 input-conditioned spectral gating，按当前输入窗口调制精炼强度。
Result: 在七个 backbone、六个数据集、四个预测步长上，CoRe 相对 backbone 平均降低 MSE 25.82%，相对 SOTA TSF-TTA 方法降低 10.57%；中长步长增益更强，计算开销仅为 modest。
Conclusion: 跨变量交互应作用在修正空间而非预测空间，这样既能利用跨变量结构又不直接传播 backbone 误差；CoRe 的数据与代码在 github.com/yyddou/CoReTTA 开源。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: MechReasoner: A Simulator and Benchmark for Mechanistic Reasoning in Qualitative Physics
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces MechReasoner, a mechanistic qualitative simulator grounded in confluence-based qualitative physics, together with a benchmark for mechanistic inference. Current large language models (LLMs) generate fluent mechanistic descriptions that do not reliably follow from underlying structural and causal constraints. The benchmark tests whether answers preserve simulator-licensed ambiguity, quantified claims, episode-graph transition evidence, repairs, and trace-support judgments. Its 1,120 items are generated deterministically from admissible interpretation sets, component states, scenario restrictions, confluence constraints, and derivation steps across 18 catalog mechanisms and six task families. Each mechanism undergoes converter checks of structure and topology and behavioral checks against quantitative simulations. GPT-5.5 accuracy decreases as family-specific mechanistic complexity increases, from 76.1% in the lowest-complexity bucket (B1) to 38.0% in the highest-complexity bucket (B4). The negative association remains after controls for rendered-prompt and expected-answer length. These results show that qualitative simulators can support auditable NLP benchmarks for mechanistic inference.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables, and 2 algorithms; includes supplementary material. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/idiap/mech-reasoner
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MechReasoner：一个基于 confluence 定性物理的机理定性模拟器，以及配套的机理推理基准，用来检验 LLM 的机制性描述是否真的由结构与因果约束推出。基准 1,120 个条目由可容许解释集、组件状态、场景限制、confluence 约束与推导步骤确定性生成，覆盖 18 个目录机制与六类任务；GPT-5.5 准确率随机制复杂度升高从 B1 的 76.1% 降到 B4 的 38.0%，控制提示长度与期望答案长度后负相关仍在。
Motivation: LLM 能写出流畅的机理描述，但这些描述并不可靠地由底层结构与因果约束推出，缺少可审计的评测手段来判定其是否符合定性物理的推理规则。
Method: MechReasoner 作为 confluence-based 定性物理的机理模拟器，为基准提供 simulator-licensed 的歧义、量化断言、episode-graph 转移证据、修复 (repairs) 与 trace-support 判定；1,120 个条目从可容许解释集、组件状态、场景限制、confluence 约束和推导步骤确定性生成，分属 18 个目录机制与六类任务族。每个机制先过结构与拓扑的 converter 检查，再对照定量模拟做行为检查。
Result: GPT-5.5 准确率随任务族机制复杂度递减：最低复杂度桶 B1 为 76.1%，最高复杂度桶 B4 为 38.0%；在控制渲染提示长度与期望答案长度后，这一负相关仍然成立。基准规模为 1,120 个条目、18 个目录机制、六个任务族。
Conclusion: 定性模拟器可以支撑可审计的 NLP 机理推理基准，且 LLM 的机理推理可靠性随机制复杂度上升而显著下降，长度因素不足以解释该下降。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Persistent State for Auditable Mixture-of-Experts Routing
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models repeatedly route tokens to sparse subsets of experts, but conventional routers expose no routing-specific record of how cross-layer influences accumulate. We introduce Scratchpad-Augmented Mixture-of-Experts (SA-MoE), which gives each router access to a low-dimensional persistent state that is not provided to the experts. Learned layerwise writes update this state, and their realized post-update changes exactly decompose the state-mediated contribution to any later routing margin, forming a routing ledger. Across sparsely upcycled SmolLM2- and Gemma-based models and three independent training seeds per architecture, this pathway adds less than 1% analytical forward compute and is strongly used by trained routers: local removal of its router contribution changes the selected Top-2 expert set in 87.6% and 69.9% of decisions, respectively. Relative to a matched latest-write-only control, persistent accumulation increases long-horizon future-routing accessibility by 19.4 and 12.2 percentage points, with positive effects in every seed. More than 90% of absolute ledger contribution comes from non-recent writes in both families, and full-forward suppression of ledger-selected writes changes later routing and output distributions. The ledger is an exact provenance object for the persistent-state pathway, not a complete causal explanation of routing. Sensitivity-aware scores better predict full-forward intervention effects, and post-hoc methods recover related cross-layer attribution without architectural modification. SA-MoE instead makes one routing-specific computational history explicit and directly inspectable within the model's natural forward computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Scratchpad-Augmented Mixture-of-Experts (SA-MoE)：给每个 router 一个不喂给 expert 的低维持久状态，由逐层学习的写入更新，其写后变化可精确分解为对后续 routing margin 的贡献，形成可审计的 routing ledger。在稀疏上采样的 SmolLM2 与 Gemma 模型、每架构 3 个训练种子上，该通路前向计算开销不到 1%，且被训练后的 router 强烈使用：局部移除其贡献会改变 87.6% 与 69.9% 的 Top-2 专家选择。
Motivation: 常规 MoE router 不留下任何 routing 专属记录，无法说明跨层影响如何累积，路由决策因而不可审计。
Method: SA-MoE 为每个 router 附加低维持久状态（不提供给 experts），用学习到的逐层写入更新；写入的实现后变化精确分解为状态介导的贡献，构成 routing ledger。在稀疏上采样 (sparsely upcycled) 的 SmolLM2 与 Gemma 模型上训练，每架构 3 个独立种子，并与 matched latest-write-only 对照比较，另做 full-forward 抑制写入的干预。
Result: 通路增加不到 1% 的解析前向计算；局部移除 ledger 贡献改变 Top-2 专家选择的比例为 87.6%（SmolLM2 系）与 69.9%（Gemma 系）。相对 latest-write-only 对照，持久累积使 long-horizon future-routing accessibility 提升 19.4 与 12.2 个百分点，且每个种子上均为正。两个家族中超过 90% 的绝对 ledger 贡献来自非近期写入；抑制 ledger 选中的写入会改变后续 routing 与输出分布；sensitivity-aware 打分能更好预测 full-forward 干预效应。
Conclusion: 持久累积让一条 routing 专属的计算历史在模型原生前向计算中显式、可直接检查，构成精确的 provenance 对象；作者明确它不是对 routing 的完整因果解释，post-hoc 方法也能在不改架构的情况下恢复相关跨层归因。
Relevance: 2
