summary_sections.result: 通路增加不到 1% 的解析前向计算；局部移除 ledger 贡献改变 Top-2 专家选择的比例为 87.6%（SmolLM2 系）与 69.9%（Gemma 系）。相对 latest-write-only 对照，持久累积使 long-horizon future-routing accessibility 提升 19.4 与 12.2 个百分点，且每个种子上均为正。两个家族中超过 90% 的绝对 ledger 贡献来自非近期写入；抑制 ledger 选中的写入会改变后续 routing 与输出分布；sensitivity-aware 打分能更好预测 full-forward 干预效应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 持久累积让一条 routing 专属的计算历史在模型原生前向计算中显式、可直接检查，构成精确的 provenance 对象；作者明确它不是对 routing 的完整因果解释，post-hoc 方法也能在不改架构的情况下恢复相关跨层归因。

papers.title: GenMem: Generative Symbolic Memory for Self-Evolving Harness
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory supports the self-evolution of LLM agents by retaining experience and skills across tasks and enabling their retrieval, reuse, and revision in subsequent long-horizon decision-making. Yet existing memory management approaches remain limited to discriminative retrieval and to address the sparse, hierarchical, and highly redundant structure of reusable experience: only a small, task-dependent subset of trajectories and memories warrants retention, retrieval, or revision. Learning these operations is further complicated by sparse, delayed, and indirect task-level feedback, with weak supervision across the memory lifecycle. Moreover, continual memory evolution introduces an architectural tension as addressing invariance: stored experience is perpetually revised, yet the addressing interface consumed by learned retrieval policies must remain stable. To address, we present GenMem, which reformulates memory management as generative symbolic addressing. Its core mechanism is the Symbolic Identifier (SID), a multi-level discrete token tuple drawn from a Cartesian-product address space that factorizes a million-scale sparse memory space using fewer than one hundred discrete symbols. Instead of generating ever-changing raw content, the memory agent learns to generate SIDs, while memory evolution rewrites the payload at a fixed address without shifting the address itself. Architecturally, GenMem couples a MemRetriever and a MemEvolver within a multi-agent harness, trained via GRPO with dense process and outcome rewards with two-channels optimization. Under offline memory evolution, experiments spanning ALFWorld, WebShop, multi-hop QA, medical reasoning, and deep research evaluate GenMem against strong memory-augmented baselines...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenMem 把 LLM agent 的记忆管理改写成生成式符号寻址：用笛卡尔积地址空间上的多层离散 Symbolic Identifier (SID)，以不到 100 个离散符号分解百万级稀疏记忆空间，记忆演化只改写固定地址上的 payload 而不移动地址。MemRetriever 与 MemEvolver 在 multi-agent harness 中用 GRPO 配稠密过程与结果奖励训练，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、multi-hop QA、medical reasoning 与 deep research 上对照强记忆增强基线。
Motivation: 可复用经验呈稀疏、分层、高冗余结构，只有少量轨迹需要保留、检索或修订；任务级反馈稀疏延迟且监督弱，同时被修订的经验与必须稳定的检索寻址接口之间存在架构张力。
Method: 以生成式符号寻址替代判别式检索：记忆 agent 学习生成 SID（多层离散 token 元组，来自笛卡尔积地址空间），地址固定而 payload 可重写；架构上将 MemRetriever 与 MemEvolver 耦合进 multi-agent harness，用 GRPO 加稠密过程奖励与结果奖励做 two-channels optimization，采用 offline memory evolution。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、multi-hop QA、medical reasoning 和 deep research 上，与强 memory-augmented 基线对比评估 GenMem；地址空间以少于 100 个离散符号分解百万级稀疏记忆空间。
Conclusion: 记忆演化与检索寻址的稳定性冲突可以通过固定地址、只重写 payload 的符号化寻址来化解，记忆管理可被重构为生成式符号寻址问题。

papers.title: Long Time No See: Benchmarking VLMs for Out-of-Sight Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Real-world AI systems must reason about objects that are no longer visible: an AR assistant guiding a user back to an object used earlier, a household robot retrieving an item someone put away. This requires not just recalling where an object was last seen, but updating its state when it is moved and retaining that update once it leaves view. We refer to this as out-of-sight spatiotemporal reasoning. We introduce Beyond3D, the first VQA benchmark to isolate this ability in dynamic egocentric video: every query targets an object that has been relocated and has since left the field of view. We create our questions from HD-EPIC annotations, building a visibility track for each dynamic object from its 3D position, the camera pose, and the scene geometry to understand at each moment whether it is visible, occluded, or out of view. Beyond3D comprises 9,000 questions in eight types over 135 videos from nine participants, organized as one reasoning chain: visual grounding (is the target observable now), temporal grounding (when it was last visible and last placed), scene localization (which fixture anchors that location), and 3D spatial perception (where it lies relative to the current viewpoint or another object in the scene). We benchmark nine general-purpose and spatially specialized VLMs. The best model reaches 42.2% against 29.7% chance and text-only baselines reaching 31.9%, with the largest failures in recovering when an object was last visible, showing that tracking object movement out of sight remains far from solved for current VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Beyond3D：首个隔离动态第一人称视频中“视线外时空推理”能力的 VQA 基准，每个问题都针对已被移动且离开视野的物体，把推理拆成视觉定位、时间定位、场景定位与 3D 空间感知四环。评测 9 个通用与空间专用 VLM，最佳模型仅 42.2%（随机 29.7%，纯文本基线 31.9%），最大失败点是恢复物体最后一次被看到的时刻。
Motivation: AR 助手与家用机器人需要在物体被移走并离开视野后仍更新并记住其位置，而现有 VQA 基准无法单独度量这种 out-of-sight spatiotemporal reasoning 能力。
Method: 基于 HD-EPIC 标注，用物体 3D 位置、相机位姿与场景几何为每个动态物体构建可见性轨迹，逐时刻判定 visible / occluded / out of view，据此生成问题；基准含 9,000 道问题、8 种类型、135 段视频、9 名参与者，评测 9 个通用与空间专用 VLM。
Result: 最佳模型准确率 42.2%，随机水平 29.7%，纯文本基线 31.9%；最突出的失败发生在“物体最后一次被看到的时刻”这一环。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 追踪物体移出视野后的位置更新仍远未解决，时间定位（何时最后可见）是最薄弱的一环。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DisKO: Deep Koopman Learning in Distribution Space from Unpaired Snapshots
papers.abstract_en: Many complex systems are observed only through temporally unpaired distribution snapshots, making trajectory-based dynamical learning difficult without additional assumptions. We therefore formulate the problem directly in distribution space, treating the distribution itself as the dynamical state. The challenge is that distribution space is infinite-dimensional, making compact and approximately closed representations difficult to learn from finite snapshots. We introduce DisKO, which extends deep Koopman learning to distribution dynamics by jointly learning predictive distributional observables, a finite-dimensional Koopman representation, and a generative map back to the full distribution. Across seven diverse benchmarks, DisKO achieves state-of-the-art extrapolation performance, with substantially slower error accumulation on long-horizon prediction tasks. DisKO further recovers leading Koopman eigenvalues and eigenfunctions on systems with analytic spectra, revealing meaningful dynamical structure in the learned representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DisKO 把分布本身当作动力学状态，在分布空间做深度 Koopman 学习，联合学习预测性分布观测量、有限维 Koopman 表示以及回到完整分布的生成映射，用于只有时间上未配对分布快照的系统。在七个基准上取得 SOTA 外推性能，长时预测误差累积明显更慢，并在有解析谱的系统上复原出主导 Koopman 特征值与特征函数。
Motivation: 许多复杂系统只能观测到时间上未配对的分布快照，缺少轨迹就难以做基于轨迹的动力学学习；而分布空间是无穷维的，从有限快照中学到紧致且近似封闭的表示很困难。
Method: 把分布本身作为动力学状态，将深度 Koopman 学习扩展到分布动力学：联合学习预测性分布观测量、有限维 Koopman 表示，以及一个生成映射把低维表示还原回完整分布。
Result: 在七个不同基准上达到 SOTA 外推性能，长时预测任务上误差累积显著更慢；在具有解析谱的系统上复原出主导 Koopman 特征值与特征函数，显示学到的表示含真实动力学结构。
Conclusion: 把分布直接当作状态并在分布空间做 Koopman 建模，可以在未配对快照设定下学到紧致、近似封闭且保留真实谱结构的动力学表示。

papers.title: CLAD: Constrained Abstract Domain for Neural Network Verification
papers.abstract_en: Neural network verification (NNV) formally verifies that a network satisfies a specified property for all inputs within a defined region. Modern NNV tools employ abstract domains to compute a sound over-approximation of the network's behavior from the given input region, thus the tightness of these abstractions essentially determines efficiency. A long line of increasingly precise domains has been developed, but they all describe the valid input region in the same restrictive way, e.g., an Lp-norm ball. A practical input region is rarely a simple Lp ball, but rather a combination Lp ball with additional constraints. Verifying a network over such a region with existing abstraction produces a loose over-approximation, which results in either failing to verify a property or spurious counterexamples. We introduce Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain (CLAD), a new abstract domain that computes a sound over-approximation of neural networks over input regions defined by a combination of convex constraints. CLAD propagates these constraints and tightens bounds over the true feasible region. However, bounding a neuron over the intersection of these constraints has no closed-form solution, so CLAD relaxes each constraint into the objective with a Lagrange multiplier and solves the resulting max-min problem with a projected primal-dual method, alternating a projected gradient step on the input with a multiplier update. CLAD supports any convex constraint with a subgradient, e.g., from automatic differentiation. We evaluate CLAD on 1,944 instances across four convolutional networks with motion-blur structured perturbations with halfspace or L2-ball constraints. On standard unconstrained Linf property, CLAD verifies as many instances as GCPCROWN at a similar runtime. On constrained properties, CLAD verifies 60\% more instances than GCPCROWN on L2-ball properties, and 22% more in total.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAD 是一个面向神经网络验证的抽象域，把输入区域从单一 Lp 球推广到凸约束交集，用带 Lagrange 乘子的 max-min 松弛加投影原始-对偶方法求紧界。在 1,944 个含运动模糊结构化扰动的实例上，约束性质下比 GCPCROWN 多验证 60%（L2-ball）与 22%（总计），无约束 Linf 上持平。
Motivation: 现有抽象域都把输入区域写成 Lp 球，而实际输入区域常是 Lp 球加额外约束；在真实可行域上做松弛会得到过松的过近似，导致性质验证失败或出现虚假反例。
Method: CLAD（Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain）在凸约束交集上逐神经元求界，无闭式解时把每个约束用 Lagrange 乘子并入目标，解 max-min 问题：对输入做投影梯度步、交替更新乘子（投影原始-对偶法）。支持任意带次梯度的凸约束，约束可由自动微分给出。
Result: 在 4 个卷积网络、1,944 个实例、含运动模糊结构化扰动（halfspace 或 L2-ball 约束）上评测：标准无约束 Linf 性质下与 GCPCROWN 验证实例数相同、运行时相当；约束性质下 L2-ball 上多验证 60%，总计多验证 22%。
Conclusion: 把输入区域的真实凸约束显式传播进抽象域，可以在不损失无约束性能的前提下显著提升约束区域上的验证能力。

papers.title: Evaluating Dynamical Fidelity through Predictive Structure in Physical Representations
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning models for physical systems are currently evaluated primarily through errors between predicted and reference states and, increasingly, through tests of physical consistency. These metrics assess whether predictions are accurate and satisfy selected physical requirements, but provide limited insight into whether learned trajectories reproduce the underlying dynamics. Domain experts examine such relationships through physical representations that expose relevant processes, interactions, and responses, but these analyses are often separated from typical machine-learning evaluation. We introduce a practical framework for evaluating dynamical fidelity through predictive structure in physical representation spaces. Experts define the representations, while reference trajectories determine which relationships are predictive and retained as evaluation tests. We demonstrate the approach in atmospheric forecasting using ERA5 representations of planetary-wave activity and Northern Annular Mode evolution, and evaluate Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and FengWu. The models exhibit distinct departures from reference predictive structure that are not reflected by conventional forecast errors. The framework thereby turns domain-expert representations into systematic tests of learned physical dynamics without prescribing the relationships in advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套评估物理系统机器学习模型动力学保真度的框架：由领域专家定义物理表示空间，再由参考轨迹决定哪些关系具有预测性并保留为评测项。在 ERA5 的行星波活动与北极涛动 (NAM) 演化表示上评测 Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、FengWu，三个模型都表现出常规预报误差反映不出的、各自不同的预测结构偏离。
Motivation: 现有 ML 物理模型评测只看预测与参考状态的误差和物理一致性，无法判断学到的轨迹是否复现真实动力学；专家的物理表示分析又与常规评测脱节。
Method: 专家定义物理表示（ERA5 的行星波活动与 NAM 演化），参考轨迹自动确定其中哪些关系具预测性并保留为评测测试，据此系统化检验学到的动力学，且不预先规定关系。
Result: 在大气预报上演示该框架，评测对象为 Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、FengWu；三个模型呈现各自不同的、常规预报误差未反映的预测结构偏离。
Conclusion: 常规预报误差不足以刻画学到的动力学，需把领域专家的物理表示转成系统化测试；该框架不预先规定要检验的关系。

papers.title: BMND: Direct Poisson Denoising by N-Dimensional Block Matching and Collaborative Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Poisson denoising of scientific data requires methods that account for signal-dependent noise while accommodating different data dimensionalities and preserving quantitative intensity information. We present BMND, a dimension-independent extension of block matching and collaborative filtering for Gaussian and Poisson observations. Building on the two-stage structure of BM3D and BM4D, BMND processes Poisson data directly, without a variance-stabilizing transform, by combining noise-aware patch matching with propagation of signal-dependent noise variances through collaborative filtering and aggregation. A dimension-independent reference-patch traversal scheme supports arrays with an arbitrary number of axes. An optional aggregation-aware mass conservation preserves the observed total intensity after weighted overlap-add. We evaluate the framework on one-dimensional physiological signals, two-dimensional images, and three-dimensional volumes, using controlled noise experiments and measured fluorescence microscopy acquisitions. The experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality from noise-aware matching and Wiener filtering, while low-count phantom experiments show reduced denoising-induced intensity loss through mass conservation. The framework provides a unified, non-learning-based approach to denoising across arbitrary data dimensions and is released as an open-source library.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BMND 把 BM3D/BM4D 的两阶段块匹配与协同滤波推广到任意维数组，直接对 Poisson 观测去噪而不做方差稳定化变换：噪声感知的块匹配加上信号相关噪声方差在协同滤波与聚合中的传播，可选的质量守恒聚合在加权重叠相加后保持观测总强度。在一维生理信号、二维图像与三维体积的受控噪声实验和实测荧光显微数据上，噪声感知匹配与 Wiener 滤波提升了重建质量，低计数模体实验显示质量守恒减少了去噪导致的强度损失。
Motivation: 科学数据的 Poisson 噪声信号相关，且数据维度从一维信号到三维体不等；现有块匹配类方法依赖高斯假设或方差稳定化变换，会破坏定量强度信息。
Method: BMND 延续 BM3D/BM4D 的两阶段结构：噪声感知 patch 匹配，随后在协同滤波与聚合中传播信号相关噪声方差，直接处理 Poisson 数据；用维度无关的参考块遍历方案支持任意轴数的数组，并提供可选的聚合感知质量守恒，使加权重叠相加后总强度等于观测值。非学习式，作为开源库发布。
Result: 在一维生理信号、二维图像、三维体积上的受控噪声实验与实测荧光显微采集中，噪声感知匹配与 Wiener 滤波带来更好的重建质量；低计数模体实验中，质量守恒降低了去噪引起的强度损失。
Conclusion: 不做方差稳定化变换、把信号相关噪声方差一路带进滤波与聚合，可以在任意维度上统一处理 Gaussian 与 Poisson 去噪，同时保住定量强度；质量守恒是低计数场景下减少强度偏差的关键开关。

papers.title: Does Native 3D Texture Generation Necessarily Require 3D Assets for Training?
papers.abstract_en: Native 3D texture generation synthesizes colors directly in 3D space for a given geometry, conditioned on multi-view reference images. It is generally believed that training such models requires large-scale, high-quality real 3D asset data, whose acquisition remains a long-standing and challenging problem. In this work, we propose Tex-Zero, demonstrating that a high-fidelity native 3D texture generation framework can be trained without 3D assets. Our key observation is that only high-quality and fine-grained color information is essential for 3D texture training, while the required geometric information is less critical and can be manually constructed rather than obtained from real 3D assets. This finding makes it possible to transform abundant, high-quality 2D images into effective training samples for 3D texture generation. Specifically, we convert high-quality 2D images into 3D training samples by representing each image as a plane in 3D space and applying patch-wise random rotations and aggregation to construct complex geometric structures. Using these constructed image data, we train the Tex-Zero VAE, which can reconstruct real 3D assets with high quality despite never observing them during training. Building upon the Tex-Zero VAE, we train the Tex-Zero DiT also exclusively on the constructed image data, where the conditioning 2D multi-view images are transformed into planes in 3D space and also encoded by the Tex-Zero VAE, thereby reducing the representation gap and improving generation quality. Extensive experiments show that Tex-Zero generates high-fidelity 3D textures with fine-grained details solely using images as training data, offering a promising perspective on the data paradigm for scaling 3D texture generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tex-Zero 证明原生 3D 纹理生成不必依赖真实 3D 资产训练：把高质量 2D 图像表示为 3D 空间中的平面，经 patch 级随机旋转与聚合构造几何样本，训练 VAE 与 DiT。仅用图像训练即可生成细节精细的高保真 3D 纹理，且 VAE 能重建训练中从未见过的真实 3D 资产。
Motivation: 原生 3D 纹理生成长期被认定需要大规模高质量真实 3D 资产，而这类数据获取困难，构成该方向的数据瓶颈。
Method: 核心观察是纹理训练只需高质量细粒度颜色信息，几何可人工构造。将 2D 图像表示为 3D 平面并施加 patch 级随机旋转与聚合，构造复杂几何结构的训练样本；据此训练 Tex-Zero VAE，再在其之上仅用构造数据训练 Tex-Zero DiT，条件多视角图像同样转为平面并由同一 VAE 编码以缩小表示差距。
Result: 仅用图像作为训练数据，Tex-Zero 生成带细粒度细节的高保真 3D 纹理；Tex-Zero VAE 尽管训练中从未观察真实 3D 资产，仍能高质量重建它们。
Conclusion: 3D 纹理生成的数据范式可以从依赖 3D 资产转向用海量 2D 图像构造训练样本，为扩展该方向提供新路径。

papers.title: LLMs for Executable Multi-Agent System Specification Generation
papers.abstract_en: MAS specifications express the effects of the actions of the agents and their environment, as well as other temporal phenomena, such as the intervals during which an agent may perform an action. The specification of a MAS should also be executable in order to allow for run-time monitoring. Constructing the specification of a MAS requires formal language expertise, while machine learning techniques depend on labelled data which are rarely available. To address these issues, we propose `genRTEC', a method that leverages pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate executable MAS specifications, in the language of the `Run-Time Event Calculus' (RTEC), from natural language descriptions. genRTEC constructs MAS specifications with complex hierarchical and cyclic dependencies based only on short natural language descriptions of the concepts involved. We present an extensive empirical evaluation of genRTEC, spanning various MAS specifications, including both a qualitative and a quantitative assessment. Our results demonstrate that genRTEC constructs executable MAS specifications of high predictive accuracy without compromising reasoning efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 genRTEC，用预训练 LLM 从简短自然语言描述直接生成可执行的多智能体系统 (MAS) 规格，输出语言为 Run-Time Event Calculus (RTEC)，可支持运行时监控。生成的规格含复杂的层级与循环依赖，作者称其预测准确率高且不牺牲推理效率。
Motivation: MAS 规格刻画智能体及其环境动作的时序效果，必须可执行才能做运行时监控，但编写它需要形式化语言专长；机器学习路线又依赖稀缺的标注数据。
Method: genRTEC 以预训练 LLM 为生成器，输入概念的简短自然语言描述，输出 RTEC 语言的可执行 MAS 规格，能构造带层级与循环依赖的结构；作者对多类 MAS 规格做了定性与定量的实证评估。
Result: 在覆盖多种 MAS 规格的实证评估（含定性与定量两部分）中，genRTEC 生成的可执行规格具备高预测准确率，同时保持推理效率。
Conclusion: LLM 可以在缺少标注数据的条件下，把自然语言直接转成可执行且推理高效的 RTEC 规格，从而绕开形式化语言专家与标注数据两重瓶颈。

papers.title: Learning Regional Snow Water Equivalent and Snow Height Variations from Sentinel-1 InSAR Acquisitions
papers.abstract_en: Managing water resources in mountainous regions depends heavily on reliable Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) and Snow Height (HS) data, yet these variables remain difficult to track at scale. This study evaluates three machine learning architectures (XGBoost, U-Net and SegFormer) for the joint estimation of SWE and HS variations from Sentinel-1 InSAR data over the Italian Alps, using the IT-SNOW reanalysis as reference. SegFormer achieves the best results on both targets, with an MAE of 10.391 cm for HS and 27.113 mm w.e. for SWE and the lowest variability across initializations. A feature sensitivity analysis shows that including all available features does not guarantee the lowest error, with model- and task-specific sensitivities. Spatial metrics (R2, Pearson's r) separate the three architectures far more clearly than mean error (MAE, RMSE) does, and decomposing the error per window attributes most of it to a systematic offset in the estimated mean variation rather than to the spatial pattern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 XGBoost、U-Net、SegFormer 三种架构从 Sentinel-1 InSAR 干涉数据联合反演意大利阿尔卑斯山的雪水当量 (SWE) 与雪高 (HS) 变化，以 IT-SNOW 再分析为参考。SegFormer 在两个目标上均最优，HS 的 MAE 为 10.391 cm、SWE 为 27.113 mm w.e.，且多次初始化间波动最小；空间指标 (R²、Pearson's r) 比平均误差更能区分三种架构，误差分解显示大部分误差来自估计均值变化的系统性偏移而非空间格局。
Motivation: 山区水资源管理依赖可靠的 SWE 与 HS 数据，但这两个变量难以在大范围上持续跟踪；InSAR 提供了新的观测途径，需要判断哪种学习架构能从中有效反演雪变量变化。
Method: 在意大利阿尔卑斯山的 Sentinel-1 InSAR 获取数据上，对比 XGBoost、U-Net、SegFormer 三种架构做 SWE 与 HS 变化的联合估计，以 IT-SNOW 再分析作为参考标签；另做特征敏感性分析，并按窗口分解误差来源。
Result: SegFormer 在两个目标上均取得最佳结果：HS 的 MAE 为 10.391 cm，SWE 的 MAE 为 27.113 mm w.e.，且在不同初始化间变异最低。特征敏感性分析显示加入全部特征并不保证误差最低，敏感性因模型和任务而异。空间指标 (R²、Pearson's r) 对三种架构的区分度远高于 MAE、RMSE；按窗口分解后，大部分误差归因于估计均值变化的系统性偏移，而非空间格局误差。
Conclusion: SegFormer 是从 Sentinel-1 InSAR 联合反演 SWE 与 HS 变化的首选架构；评估这类模型时应以空间指标为主并单独处理均值系统偏移，且特征并非越多越好。

papers.title: Probabilistic Geodesic Flow Matching on Location-Scale Families
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching (FM) has recently emerged as a promising framework for generative modeling due to its conceptual simplicity and strong empirical performance. In FM, samples are transported along a vector field parameterized by a neural network, inducing a probability path that evolves from a simple noise distribution to the target data distribution, governed by an ordinary differential equation (ODE). However, existing FM approaches predominantly rely on probability paths derived from optimal transport (OT) between Gaussian distributions, which may be suboptimal for capturing complex data with inhomogeneous structures such as heavy tail or sharp contrast. In this work, we generalize FM to the broader class of location-scale families for handling data inhomogeneity and introduce a novel class of probability paths defined as geodesics on the manifold of probability distributions. We name this approach probabilistic geodesic flow matching to distinguish it from prior geodesic (Riemannian) FM methods defined in input space. We argue that Euclidean OT-based paths are not necessarily optimal in probability space and may limit modeling flexibility. Through synthetic benchmarks and scientific datasets at different scales, we demonstrate that the proposed method more effectively captures complex distributions, leading to improved or comparable performance compared with SOTA geometry-motivated generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 flow matching 从高斯推广到 location-scale 族，并在概率分布流形上定义测地线作为概率路径，提出 probabilistic geodesic flow matching，用于处理重尾、强对比等非均匀结构数据。合成基准与多尺度科学数据集上，该方法比 SOTA 几何驱动生成模型取得更优或相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有 FM 的概率路径多由高斯间的最优传输 (OT) 导出，对重尾、锐利对比等非均匀结构数据可能次优；且欧氏 OT 路径在概率空间中未必最优，限制了建模灵活性。
Method: 将 FM 推广到更广的 location-scale 族以处理数据非均匀性，并在概率分布流形上定义一类新的测地线概率路径，命名为 probabilistic geodesic flow matching，以区别于在输入空间定义的既有 geodesic (Riemannian) FM 方法；论证欧氏 OT 路径在概率空间中不必然最优。
Result: 在合成基准与不同尺度的科学数据集上，所提方法更有效地捕捉复杂分布，相比 SOTA 几何驱动生成模型取得改进或相当的性能。
Conclusion: 概率空间中的测地线路径比基于欧氏 OT 的路径更能灵活刻画非均匀数据分布，是 flow matching 的一条可行推广方向。

papers.title: Beyond Site Agreement: Re-estimation for Brain Network Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-site out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) often relies on learning task-discriminative representations from full-scan functional connectivity (FC) graphs and promoting invariance across source sites. However, FC graphs are estimated from finite, temporally correlated blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) sequences. Cross-site agreement therefore does not necessarily imply that predictive evidence remains supported under FC re-estimation within the same scan. In this paper, we propose Brain Network Re-estimation-Informed OOD Learning (BRIO), a framework that uses within-scan FC re-estimation to guide cross-site alignment. BRIO maps fullscan graphs and their re-estimates into consistently indexed connectome factors, enabling comparisons of their predictive contributions. It assesses re-estimation support from changes in these contributions relative to within-class subject variability and class separation. For each source-site pair and class, this task-calibrated support from both sites is combined with predictive relevance to form pairwise qualifications, which determine relative factor weights and overall alignment strength. Leave-one-site-out experiments on four real-world datasets (ABIDE, REST-metaMDD, SRPBS, and ABCD) show that BRIO consistently outperforms competitive baselines, with relative improvements of up to 3.8% in accuracy. These gains also persist under an alternative brain parcellation on ABIDE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRIO 用同一扫描内的 FC 重估 (within-scan functional connectivity re-estimation) 来校准跨站点对齐强度：把全扫描图与其重估映射到一致索引的 connectome factors，比较其预测贡献变化，再按站点对与类别生成 pairwise qualifications 决定因子权重与对齐强度。在 ABIDE、REST-metaMDD、SRPBS、ABD 四个数据集的 leave-one-site-out 实验中一致优于竞争基线，准确率相对提升最高 3.8%。
Motivation: rs-fMRI 跨站点 OOD 泛化依赖从有限、时间相关的 BOLD 序列估计的 FC 图学习不变表征，但跨站点一致并不保证预测证据在同一扫描内 FC 重估下仍然成立。
Method: 提出 Brain Network Re-estimation-Informed OOD Learning (BRIO)：将全扫描 FC 图与其重估映射为一致索引的 connectome factors，用预测贡献相对类内个体变异与类别分离的变化评估重估支持度，再对每个源站点对与类别把两站点的任务校准支持度和预测相关性合成 pairwise qualifications，据此确定相对因子权重与整体对齐强度。
Result: 在四个真实数据集 ABIDE、REST-metaMDD、SRPBS、ABCD 上的 leave-one-site-out 实验中，BRIO 一致优于竞争基线，准确率相对提升最高 3.8%；在 ABIDE 上换用另一种脑分区后增益仍然保持。
Conclusion: 跨站点对齐强度应由 FC 重估下的预测证据支持度来校准，而不是默认站点间一致即代表可泛化证据。

papers.title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAMACHINE 是免训练的 World Action Model 推理加速框架，通过在闭环重规划、去噪步和 Transformer 层三个层面保留并自适应复用推理状态来缩短观测到动作的延迟。在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上评测三种 WAM 架构，观测到动作延迟加速 1.47–3.05×，每次重规划 GPU 推理时间加速 2.23–3.27×，同时保住原生任务成功率的 96.69–99.54%。
Motivation: WAM 用扩散或流式迭代推理联合建模动作与环境动力学，去噪延迟大；直接复用先前推理状态会因规划上下文、观测和中间表示变化而迅速失效，加速与准确性难以兼得。
Method: WAMACHINE 免训练，含三个组件：跨闭环重规划的 Trajectory Remapping，把上一次重规划的状态重映射为下一次初始化；跨去噪步的 Observation Rebinding，在动作执行期间做预判推理，一致性检查通过后把保留的去噪状态重新绑定到真实观测继续；跨层的 Residual Rescaling，选择性重缩放保留的层状态，探针检查失败时用中间层全计算刷新。
Result: 在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上评测三种代表性 WAM 架构：观测到动作延迟加速 1.47–3.05×，每次重规划 GPU 推理时间加速 2.23–3.27×，任务成功率保持原生 WAM 的 96.69–99.54%。
Conclusion: 推理状态应按上下文变化自适应地保留与刷新，而非原样复用，即可在闭环机器人控制中同时拿到数倍延迟下降和接近原生的成功率。

papers.title: WorldAttention: An Efficient Attention Architecture for Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldAttention 用混合稀疏注意力 (HSA) 与分层 KV 缓存 (HKV) 替代滑窗机制，在文本条件交互式视频世界模型中保留全历史上下文同时压住计算与显存开销。HSA 把线性全局注意力与 head 自适应稀疏注意力结合，HKV 把历史 KV 对按语义索引分页放进多层存储。在 VBench-Long 与 InterVBench 上主体一致性分别达 0.9472 与 0.9668，一致超过既有 SOTA。
Motivation: 文本条件交互式视频世界模型要低延迟长时生成，滑窗机制省算力却丢历史上下文，削弱长程交互能力；全历史缓存则因注意力二次复杂度与 KV cache 线性增长导致算力与显存不可承受。
Method: 提出系统导向的注意力架构 WorldAttention：一是 Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA)，用线性全局注意力加 head 自适应稀疏注意力；二是 Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV)，把历史 KV 对按语义索引分页组织进多层存储，实现细粒度检索与受控的 GPU 常驻；两者由定制 kernel 支撑，把理论效率转成实际性能。
Result: 在 VBench-Long 上主体一致性 (subject consistency) 得分 0.9472，在 InterVBench 上 0.9668，两项均一致超过此前 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 把注意力 kernel 与 KV 缓存层级一起做系统级协同设计，可以在不牺牲历史上下文的前提下让长时交互视频世界模型保持高效率。

papers.title: PMOPD: Task Ordering, Cycling, and Parameter-Update Subspace Protection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) has emerged as a popular post-training paradigm for integrating specialized capabilities in frontier language models. Existing OPD research has primarily focused on optimizing single-task distillation through objective design, distillation scope, and teacher signal construction, whereas MOPD must aggregate multiple capabilities in shared parameters and address the resulting capability seesaw, in which improving one domain suppresses capabilities acquired from another. Inspired by the distinctive update geometry of OPD, we find that parameter updates from different tasks rapidly concentrate in their respective low-dimensional subspaces during MOPD, providing a direct geometric basis for identifying and controlling cross-task interference. We therefore propose PMOPD (Projection-based Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation), which constructs subspace memories from the cumulative parameter displacements of different tasks and projects both gradients and optimizer updates to remove components that interfere with protected task directions. We further develop a lightweight conflict probe to characterize task interactions and guide task ordering, together with a cycling strategy that balances subspace estimation and timely task revisitation. Experiments on representative Code, Reason, and Math tasks show that PMOPD improves every evaluated capability over MOPD, raising the average score across the three tasks by 2.54 points on Qwen2.5-7B and 2.09 points on Llama-3.1-8B. These consistent gains establish geometry-aware optimization as an effective and transferable approach to balanced multi-teacher distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PMOPD 针对多教师在线策略蒸馏 (MOPD) 中的能力跷跷板问题，利用不同任务的参数更新迅速收敛到各自低维子空间这一几何事实，用子空间记忆投影梯度与优化器更新以剔除干扰受保护任务方向的分量，再配合冲突探针决定任务顺序与循环重访策略。在 Qwen2.5-7B 与 Llama-3.1-8B 的 Code、Reason、Math 三任务上，PMOPD 相对 MOPD 平均分分别提升 2.54 与 2.09 分，且每项能力均有改善。
Motivation: 多教师蒸馏要在共享参数里同时聚合多种能力，会出现能力跷跷板：提升一个领域会压制已学到的其他能力，而已有 OPD 研究主要针对单任务蒸馏的目标设计与教师信号构造。
Method: PMOPD 从各任务累计参数位移构建子空间记忆 (subspace memories)，把梯度与优化器更新投影到该子空间之外，剔除与受保护任务方向冲突的分量；另加轻量冲突探针 (conflict probe) 刻画任务间相互作用并指导任务排序，以及在子空间估计与及时任务重访之间权衡的循环 (cycling) 策略。
Result: 在 Code、Reason、Math 三类任务上，PMOPD 相对 MOPD 提升了每一项被评估能力：三任务平均分在 Qwen2.5-7B 上提高 2.54 分，在 Llama-3.1-8B 上提高 2.09 分。
Conclusion: 几何感知优化是实现均衡多教师蒸馏有效且可迁移的途径，参数更新的低维子空间结构可直接用于识别与控制跨任务干扰。

papers.title: Shaping Persistent Representations from Independent Interactions
papers.abstract_en: World models learn environment dynamics from interaction experience. These dynamics depend on the current state and actions, as well as on properties that persist across interactions. Yet standard predictive training can reduce error using local evidence alone, without organizing persistent information into reusable context. We introduce SPRII, a training principle that uses relations between interactions as weak supervision for persistent context while retaining the learner's native objective. For example, different trajectories of the same system share persistent properties even when their states and actions differ. SPRII uses such relations to guide context learning without numerical property labels. Two composable components encourage contexts from related interactions to agree (Align) and use one interaction's context to predict another's future (Cross). Our analysis distinguishes three linked questions: what persistent information is accessible in the learned context (Formation), how that context influences a fixed predictor (Use), and whether it reduces task error (Value). Success at one stage does not guarantee success at the next. Controlled experiments show that more reliable relations improve representation organization, but adding a shared-property constraint can reduce access to a property that remains shared. Context substitutions change predictions at fixed model weights, while the benefit from history depends on prediction horizon and readout. Evaluations span thirteen settings, including controlled physical systems, public dynamics tasks, robotic and tactile data, and partner interaction, across multiple learner families. Relative to the corresponding baselines, SPRII yields average gains of over 10% in downstream task performance and over 15% in persistent-property readout. The project page is available at https://persistent-learning-review.netlify.app/interactive.html.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPRII 把不同交互之间的关系当作持久属性的弱监督，在保留学习器原生预测目标的同时训练可复用的持久上下文，由 Align（相关交互的上下文应一致）与 Cross（用一个交互的上下文预测另一个交互的未来）两个可组合部件构成。在涵盖受控物理系统、公开动力学任务、机器人与触觉数据、伙伴交互的十三个设置、多个学习器家族上，相对对应基线平均带来下游任务性能 10% 以上、持久属性读出 15% 以上的提升。
Motivation: 标准预测训练只靠局部证据就能降误差，不会把跨交互持久的信息组织成可复用的上下文，世界模型因此难以把状态/动作之外的持久属性学进表示。
Method: 提出训练原则 SPRII：用交互之间的关系（如同一系统的不同轨迹共享持久属性）作弱监督，无需数值属性标签，同时保留学习器原生目标；两个可组合部件 Align 鼓励相关交互的上下文一致、Cross 用一个交互的上下文预测另一个的未来。分析把问题拆成 Formation（持久信息是否进入上下文）、Use（上下文如何影响固定预测器）、Value（是否降低任务误差）三级。
Result: 在十三个设置（受控物理系统、公开动力学任务、机器人与触觉数据、伙伴交互）跨多个学习器家族上，相对对应基线 SPRII 平均下游任务性能提升超过 10%、持久属性读出提升超过 15%。受控实验显示更可靠的关系改善表示组织，但加入共享属性约束反而可能降低对仍共享的属性的可访问性；上下文替换在固定模型权重下改变预测，历史的收益取决于预测时程与读出方式。
Conclusion: 持久上下文要靠交互间关系来组织，且 Formation、Use、Value 三级各自独立——一级成功不保证下一级成功，共享属性约束可能在提升一致性的同时损害属性可访问性。

papers.title: After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文检验「修复失败经验后，它是否成为更好的记忆」：把同一失败源任务在修复前后分别迁移到固定目标任务，并与独立执行对照，共 3,300 次运行，覆盖 ThinkingBox 与 APEX 各 100 对任务、11 种条件。ThinkingBox 上 Full/Skill/Hybrid 修正增益为 44/29/32 个百分点，修正后表现比独立执行高 25/22/18 点，但任务族层面推断减弱；作者结论是修复经验的价值与复用它的价值不同，记忆更新需要同时有前版本参照和全新启动参照。
Motivation: 智能体记忆系统默认「修好一次失败，经验就更适合下次复用」，但修复带来的表面增益可能来自原本更差的未修正基线，而非真正更好的修正后记忆，缺少前版本与全新启动的双重参照就无法区分。
Method: 将同一失败源任务在被接受的修复前后分别迁移到固定目标任务，并与独立执行并列对照；实验为 3,300 次运行，覆盖 100 对 ThinkingBox 与 100 对 APEX（各含/不含源状态继承两种模式），共 11 种条件；另用行动证据把工作流增益与可复用义务、约定冲突与源局部选择对应起来。
Result: ThinkingBox 的 Full/Skill/Hybrid 修正增益分别为 44/29/32 个百分点，修正后表现比独立执行高 25/22/18 点，但任务族层面推断减弱；Full 相对 Skill 多出的 15 点修正差距中有 12 点来自更差的未修正表现而非更好的修正记忆；Full 的 46 次向上跃迁中仅 22 次恢复到观测到的基线成功水平。APEX 两种模式均未建立可比的总体修正收益；Text APEX 被接受的执行达 52%，其摘要为 40%，但无稳健的全局/组级优势，也未确立相对独立执行的优势。更小的交接减少输入但增加调用次数。
Conclusion: 修复经验的价值与复用它的价值是两回事：评估记忆更新必须同时给出前版本参照和全新启动参照，否则修正增益会被未修正基线的差异冒充。

papers.title: When local gains fail to transfer: Frozen Earth-observation embeddings across wildfires
papers.abstract_en: Frozen Earth-observation embeddings are judged almost entirely by spatially blocked cross-validation inside one study region. We show that this number does not predict accuracy in a new region; we show why; and we show the one setting in which such a model does keep working, using a protocol that needs only a linear probe and labels one already has. The testbed is wildfire, with Copernicus burned-area maps of six fires in Greece and Spain and descriptors from the year before each fire, comparing TESSERA and AlphaEarth with ESA WorldCover classes and annual Sentinel-2 index summaries. Inside a fire, the embeddings identify the burned land 0.05 to 0.13 ROC AUC better than the index summaries, and repeated fold allocations, spatial buffers, a block bootstrap, and gradient-boosted trees leave that margin unchanged. On a fire in another region, they lose 0.15 to 0.18 AUC, and the index summaries lose 0.06, so the three end within a few hundredths of each other. The representation is not the cause. Eight labelled blocks from the new region restore the embedding advantage and give a higher AUC than 59,000 labelled pixels from other regions, and the weight vector fitted in one region is nearly orthogonal to the vector fitted in the others, so the part that carries across regions is small and low-dimensional. Forecasting within a region is a different matter. Fitted on a fire that burned in 2023 and applied to a fire twelve kilometres away that burned in 2024, where nothing used postdates the target fire, TESSERA reaches 0.772 AUC and loses 0.04 against a classifier fitted inside the 2024 fire, while classifiers fitted in other regions lose 0.09 to 0.18. A region with one mapped fire can therefore forecast susceptibility for later fires there; a region without one cannot borrow a model from elsewhere, and every evaluation of a frozen embedding should report a held-out region.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结的地球观测 embedding（TESSERA、AlphaEarth）在单个研究区内的空间分块交叉验证高估了跨区迁移能力：同一场火内比 Sentinel-2 指数摘要高 0.05–0.13 ROC AUC，换到另一区域的火场就丢 0.15–0.18 AUC，指数摘要只丢 0.06，三者最终相差不到百分之几。真正可迁移的设定是同区域内的后续火：用 2023 年烧过的火拟合、外推到 12 公里外 2024 年的火，TESSERA 达 0.772 AUC、只比区内拟合低 0.04，而跨区拟合的分类器低 0.09–0.18。作者的硬性要求是：任何冻结 embedding 的评测都必须报告 held-out region。
Motivation: 冻结 EO embedding 的评测几乎全靠单一研究区内的空间分块交叉验证，这个数字无法预测新区域的精度，导致跨区迁移能力被系统性高估。
Method: 以野火为试验床：用 Copernicus 过火面积图覆盖希腊与西班牙六场火，输入为每场火前一年的描述子，比较 TESSERA、AlphaEarth 与 ESA WorldCover 类别、Sentinel-2 年度指数摘要；用线性探针 (linear probe) 加重复折划分、空间缓冲、block bootstrap、梯度提升树检验差距稳健性，并比较跨区拟合权重向量的方向。
Result: 同一场火内 embedding 比指数摘要高 0.05–0.13 ROC AUC，各种重采样下该差距不变；换到另一区域的火，embedding 掉 0.15–0.18 AUC、指数摘要掉 0.06，三者收敛到相差百分之几。新区域仅 8 个标注 block 即可恢复 embedding 优势，且 AUC 高于来自其他区域的 59,000 个标注像素；跨区拟合的权重向量与本区拟合的近乎正交。2023 年火拟合、外推到 12 公里外 2024 年火（特征均不晚于目标火），TESSERA 0.772 AUC、比区内拟合低 0.04，跨区分类器低 0.09–0.18。
Conclusion: 区内空间分块验证的分数不能预测跨区精度，可跨区迁移的成分小而低维；有一个已制图过火区的区域可以为后续火预报易燃性，没有的区域不能从别处借模型，因此冻结 embedding 的评测必须报告 held-out region。

papers.title: The Low-Rank Structure of VLA Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet how RL reshapes these policies remains poorly understood. We find that RL across widely used flow-based VLA models, including $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T~N1.5/N1.6, on LIBERO, ManiSkill, MetaWorld, and CALVIN induces substantially lower-rank parameter updates that are highly concentrated in the action expert's Timestep Modules, a small and previously overlooked component. Through systematic module-replacement experiments, we further show that these modules capture a disproportionate share of the performance gains from RL. We then characterize what is encoded in these Timestep Modules. First, we show that RL specializes them to the discrete denoising timesteps used during rollouts, and that this discrete-timestep training underlies the low-rank updates. Second, we find that among their outputs, the shift vector changes most distinctly under RL, and through probing, we show that shift update directions strongly predict task success (ROC-AUC up to $99.6\%$). Third, we find that the geometry of shift updates reflects task relationships, as their pairwise similarity correlates with cross-task transfer patterns. Building on these findings, we show that steering along shift update directions further improves RL-trained policies without additional RL training. Overall, we provide a systematic understanding of how RL reshapes VLA policies by studying how learned signals are encoded in parameter space, offering insights into more efficient and interpretable VLA post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RL 后训练视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型时，参数更新呈低秩且高度集中在 action expert 的 Timestep Modules 这一小组件上；沿 shift 更新方向做 steering 可在不再跑 RL 的情况下进一步提升已训练策略。
Motivation: RL 如何重塑 VLA 策略的内部机制长期不清楚，更新发生在参数空间何处、编码了什么信号都缺乏系统解释，难以指导更高效的后训练。
Method: 在 flow-based VLA 模型（π0.5、GR00T N1.5/N1.6）上于 LIBERO、ManiSkill、MetaWorld、CALVIN 做 RL，分析参数更新的秩与模块分布；用 module-replacement 实验定位性能增益来源，用 probing 预测任务成功并检验 shift 更新方向的跨任务迁移关系。
Result: RL 更新显著低秩且集中于 Timestep Modules；module-replacement 显示这些模块承担了不成比例的 RL 性能增益；probe 用 shift 更新方向预测任务成功的 ROC-AUC 最高达 99.6%；shift 更新的成对相似性与跨任务迁移模式相关；沿 shift 更新方向 steering 在不追加 RL 训练下进一步提升策略。
Conclusion: RL 对 VLA 的改造可从参数空间中低秩、模块集中的信号编码来理解，Timestep Modules 的 shift 更新方向既是性能增益的主要载体，也是可直接用于 steering 的可解释控制轴。

papers.title: Summarize Before Grounding: Query-Guided Chunk Condensation for Long-Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the video interval corresponding to a language query. Recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) show great potential in solving such a multi-modal reasoning task. However, long videos often contain large amounts of redundant information that disturbs LVLMs to mine query-relevant evidence. Instead of dense frame sampling which incurs prohibitive training memory, previous reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) works typically utilize sparse sampling, which makes training feasible but may miss critical evidence. In this paper, we propose a ``summarize before grounding'' framework (named ``SumGround'') for long-video temporal grounding. The key of SumGround is to perform query-guided chunk condensation to aggregate and retrieve query-relevant evidence. Specifically, we split the video into several chunks and perform two-level chunk condensation. First, we introduce query-guided latent summaries, which is represented as KV states of query-guided prompts, to compress redundant visual tokens into compact query-relevant chunk summaries. Furthermore, we design an associative summary retrieval scheme to rank and select chunk summaries that are most likely to contain the event interval. Both query-guided latent summary and associative summary retrieval schemes are enabled by RLVR. To reduce memory consumption, we propose a length-aware gradient gating module to selectively stop gradient back-propagated to visual tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SumGround performs favorably against previous state-of-the-art methods across multiple downstream datasets, with remarkable gains on long videos.

papers.title: Temporal Modelling for Burn Scars on Sentinel-3
papers.abstract_en: Rapid and accurate burn scar delineation from satellite imagery is essential for post-fire damage assessment. Sentinel-3 OLCI, with daily revisit and 21 spectral bands, suits rapid mapping, yet most pipelines treat acquisitions independently, leaving the pre/post-fire change signal unexploited. We present a dataset of 246 wildfire activations (2016-2025) from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, with Sentinel-3 OLCI temporally paired acquisitions. We benchmark spatial and temporal (ConvLSTM-augmented) variants of three backbones (U-Net, SegFormer, ConvNeXt-UPerNet) under two input modes and spectral configurations. Temporal modeling improves segmentation only when pre-fire frames are included, and a 5-band subset matches the full 21-band OLCI configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Sentinel-3 OLCI 烧痕 (burn scar) 快速勾绘，构建 2016–2025 年 246 起 CEMS 山火激活的时序配对数据集，并在 U-Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt-UPerNet 三个骨干上对比空间与 ConvLSTM 增强的时序变体。时序建模只有在输入包含火前帧时才提升分割，且 5 波段子集即可匹配全部 21 波段 OLCI 配置。
Motivation: 现有烧痕制图流水线把每次卫星过境当作独立影像处理，浪费了火前/火后变化信号；Sentinel-3 OLCI 虽有每日重访与 21 个波段，这一时序信息仍未被利用。
Method: 发布含 246 起 CEMS 山火激活（2016–2025）及 Sentinel-3 OLCI 时序配对影像的数据集；在 U-Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt-UPerNet 三个骨干上分别实现空间与 ConvLSTM 增强的时序变体，并在两种输入模式与多种波段配置下做基准对比。
Result: 时序建模仅在输入包含火前帧时改善分割；5 波段子集在分割表现上匹配完整 21 波段 OLCI 配置。
Conclusion: 烧痕分割的时序增益来自火前参考帧而非单纯多帧堆叠，且 OLCI 的 21 波段对烧痕任务存在可压缩到 5 波段的冗余。

papers.title: Nonnegative DAG Learning via Concomitant Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) with nonnegative edge weights from observational data. We propose the Nonnegative and Concomitant (NoCo) DAG estimator, which jointly recovers the weighted graph structure and the exogenous noise variances in the linear structural equation model for the observations. Different from prior art, this noise-adaptive formulation blends a smoothed concomitant lasso criterion with a simpler log-determinant acyclicity constraint that exploits nonnegativity and yields a more benign optimization landscape. Specifically, nonnegative weights allow us to impose acyclicity directly on the adjacency matrix without elementwise squaring of its entries, thus avoiding the well-documented degeneracy of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. Computationally, we develop a method of multipliers' algorithm that accommodates both homoscedastic and heteroscedastic noise profiles. Within each iteration, we use block successive convex approximation to minimize the augmented Lagrangian, alternating between proximal gradient steps for the adjacency matrix and closed-form updates for the noise scales. Simulated experiments demonstrate NoCo's improved structural and edge-weight recovery relative to competing methods in a variety of settings, highlighting the benefits of exploiting nonnegativity along with noise adaptivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NoCo 估计器，从观测数据中联合恢复线性结构方程模型的非负加权 DAG 与外生噪声方差：用平滑的 concomitant lasso 判据做噪声自适应，配合利用非负性的 log-determinant 无环约束，避免逐元素平方带来的 KKT 退化。模拟实验显示 NoCo 在多种设定下结构与边权恢复均优于对比方法。
Motivation: 非负加权 DAG 学习中，常用无环约束需对邻接矩阵逐元素平方，导致 KKT 条件退化、优化景观变差；同时外生噪声方差通常被当作已知或同方差处理，限制了异方差数据下的恢复质量。
Method: NoCo 在线性结构方程模型下联合估计加权图结构与噪声方差：判据为平滑 concomitant lasso 与利用非负性的 log-determinant 无环约束之和；优化用 method of multipliers 算法，每轮迭代内以 block successive convex approximation 最小化增广 Lagrangian，在邻接矩阵的近端梯度步与噪声尺度的闭式更新之间交替，兼容同方差与异方差噪声。
Result: 在多种模拟设定下，NoCo 的结构恢复与边权恢复均优于对比方法，收益来自同时利用非负性与噪声自适应。
Conclusion: 非负性使无环约束可直接施加于邻接矩阵而无需逐元素平方，配合 concomitant 噪声估计，可改善 DAG 结构与边权的恢复并给出更良性的优化景观。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Weighted Bellman Residual Minimization for $Q^*$ Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy evaluation is a foundational component of offline reinforcement learning, aiming to assess and optimize policy performance using pre-collected datasets. However, such datasets often suffer from pronounced challenges, including distribution shift, $Q$-value overestimation, and low sample utilization efficiency. To address these issues, this paper introduces a weighted Bellman residual minimization framework that incorporates density ratio weighting by effectively integrating expert demonstrations with behavioral data. The proposed weighting scheme departs from the conventional completeness assumption commonly imposed in the theoretical analysis of deep reinforcement learning. We establish a sharp convergence rate for density ratio estimation and derive the convergence rate for the excess risk of resulting deep $Q^*$ estimator. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that, compared to existing methods, our method achieves significant improvements in numerical performance and policy generalization, providing specific guidance for the rational utilization of expert demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对离线强化学习的策略评估 (off-policy evaluation)，提出加权 Bellman 残差最小化框架，用密度比加权把专家示范与行为数据结合，并摆脱深度强化学习理论分析中常用的 completeness 假设。理论上给出密度比估计的尖锐收敛率与深度 Q* 估计器超额风险的收敛率，实验上在数值性能与策略泛化上相对现有方法显著提升。
Motivation: 离线策略评估所用的预采集数据集存在分布偏移、Q 值高估计和样本利用效率低三重问题，而常规理论分析依赖 completeness 假设，限制了方法的适用性。
Method: 提出加权 Bellman 残差最小化框架，以密度比加权整合专家示范与行为数据；该加权方案不依赖常规 completeness 假设，并配套推导密度比估计与深度 Q* 估计器的收敛率。
Result: 建立密度比估计的尖锐收敛率，并推导所得深度 Q* 估计器超额风险的收敛率；实验中相对现有方法在数值性能与策略泛化上均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 密度比加权的 Bellman 残差最小化可在不依赖 completeness 假设的前提下改善离线策略评估，并给出专家示范的合理使用方式。

papers.title: TULIP: Targeted LLM Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-Input
papers.abstract_en: Representation-level unlearning intervenes on the intermediate hidden states of LLMs. Although knowledge is distributed across layers, existing methods operate at a single fixed layer for the entire forget set. We ask whether such a fixed layer is sufficient. To answer this, we design a hijacking experiment that grafts hidden states of the target model into an oracle trained only on the retain set. The oracle cannot produce the forget answer on its own, yet it produces the answer from the grafted state. Thus, the answer is formed at an intermediate layer and merely read out afterward, so unlearning should focus on formation, not readout. Moreover, the layer where formation ends varies widely across inputs. Motivated by these findings, we propose Targeted Unlearning at Layers Identified Per-input (TULIP). For each input, TULIP uses the logit lens to locate the formation-readout boundary and removes the hidden state's alignment with the forget answer's unembedding vector there. TULIP consistently outperforms output- and representation-level baselines on TOFU, PISTOL, and WMDP across Llama, Qwen, and Zephyr models. It also remains robust to paraphrase and quantization attacks. Beyond standalone use, its per-input layer selection serves as a plug-and-play component that further improves existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TULIP 针对 LLM 表征级遗忘 (representation-level unlearning) 固定单层操作的问题，用 logit lens 逐输入定位“形成-读出边界”，只在该层移除隐状态与遗忘答案 unembedding 向量的对齐。在 TOFU、PISTOL、WMDP 上跨 Llama、Qwen、Zephyr 一致优于输出级与表征级基线，并对 paraphrase 与 quantization 攻击保持稳健。
Motivation: 知识分布在各层，但现有表征级遗忘方法对整个 forget set 固定同一层操作；hijacking 实验证明答案在中间层形成、之后仅被读出，且形成结束的层随输入差异很大，固定层会错过真正的形成位置。
Method: 先做 hijacking 实验：把目标模型的隐状态嫁接到只用 retain set 训练的 oracle，oracle 自身给不出遗忘答案却能从嫁接状态产出该答案。TULIP 随后对每个输入用 logit lens 定位 formation-readout boundary，并在该层移除隐状态与遗忘答案 unembedding 向量的对齐；逐输入层选择还可作为即插即用组件叠加到既有方法上。
Result: 在 TOFU、PISTOL、WMDP 上，跨 Llama、Qwen、Zephyr 模型一致优于输出级与表征级基线；对 paraphrase 攻击与 quantization 攻击保持稳健；作为即插即用组件进一步提升既有方法。
Conclusion: 遗忘应作用于答案的形成层而非读出层，且形成边界逐输入变化，因此按输入选层比固定单层更有效，并可作为通用增强模块。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Model Knows When to Stop: Training-Free Early Stopping for Long-Context Reading
papers.abstract_en: Language models often process long inputs sequentially in chunks, but continuing to read after sufficient evidence has been acquired wastes computation. Existing stopping mechanisms either learn sufficiency from internal activations or train an exit gate, while a simpler alternative asks the model whether it has read enough. We introduce Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS), a training-free stopping rule that measures rather than asks. After each chunk, it probes the frozen model's current answer state and stops when that state is both confident and stable. The rule requires only output-side generation and token log probabilities, has no trained components, and uses one shared configuration across models and benchmarks. Because a stopping policy can save computation simply by stopping too early, we evaluate the stopping decision itself using evidence position where available. On the full LongBench-v2 with two frontier models, ACS is the only stopping policy that matches or exceeds full-reading accuracy. Furthermore, across 250 S-NIAH questions, the premature stopping rate for ACS across five models from two families ranges from 0% to 12%, compared to 8.4% to 45.6% for the verbalized gate. Taken together, ACS reveals that by properly utilizing the output signals of frozen models, we can achieve favorable behaviors like adaptive stopping without the need for additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS)：每读完一个 chunk 就探测冻结模型当前答案状态，当该状态同时高置信且稳定时停止阅读，只用输出端生成与 token log 概率，跨模型与基准共用一套配置。在完整 LongBench-v2 上两个前沿模型中，ACS 是唯一匹配或超过全读准确率的停止策略；250 道 S-NIAH 问题上五个模型的过早停止率为 0%–12%，而 verbalized gate 为 8.4%–45.6%。
Motivation: 长输入分块顺序读取时，证据已足够仍继续读会浪费计算；现有停止机制要么从内部激活学充分性，要么训练退出门控，而仅靠问模型“读够了没有”可能过早停止、虚增节省。
Method: ACS 是免训练停止规则，每 chunk 结束后用输出侧生成与 token log 概率探测冻结模型的当前答案状态，判定其同时 confident 与 stable 才停；无任何训练组件，一套共享配置用于所有模型与基准。评估以 evidence position（在可用时）检验停止决策本身，防止靠过早停止刷节省。
Result: 在完整 LongBench-v2 上、两个前沿模型下，ACS 是唯一匹配或超过全读准确率的停止策略；在 250 道 S-NIAH 问题上，ACS 覆盖两个模型家族的五个模型，过早停止率区间为 0%–12%，verbalized gate 为 8.4%–45.6%。
Conclusion: 只要正确利用冻结模型的输出信号，就能在不加训练的情况下实现自适应停止，且过早停止率远低于语言化门控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Intermediate Renders for Image-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is increasingly used to post-train vision-language models for image-to-code generation, such as generating SVG code from a reference image, by optimizing rewards computed from the final rendered output. However, relying on a single terminal reward provides sparse feedback that is poorly aligned with the contribution of individual tokens. A generated program may contain operations that accurately reproduce some parts of the target image alongside others that introduce errors, yet all tokens are trained from the same final outcome. We observe that many intermediate code prefixes are not only executable, but already produce meaningful partial renders that reflect progress toward the target. This property provides a natural source of denser supervision during generation. Based on this observation, we introduce IR4RL, an RL framework with a token-level render-progress reward that turns changes between intermediate renders into localized feedback for the generated sequence. We evaluate our approach on Image-to-SVG and Image-to-TikZ generation. Across both tasks, our method improves over supervised fine-tuning and standard GRPO, yielding new state-of-the-art open-source models. This shows that intermediate rendering provides a simple and effective source of process supervision for RL post-training of image-to-code models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IR4RL 用中间渲染进度做 token 级奖励，把相邻中间渲染之间的变化转成对生成序列的局部反馈，替代只看最终渲染的稀疏终端奖励。在 Image-to-SVG 与 Image-to-TikZ 两个任务上均优于监督微调与标准 GRPO，得到新的开源 SOTA 模型。
Motivation: 图像到代码的 RL 后训练只用最终渲染算奖励，反馈稀疏且与单个 token 的贡献不对齐：程序里正确复现部分目标图像的操作与引入误差的操作被同一个最终结果同等对待。
Method: IR4RL 是一个 RL 框架，核心是 token 级 render-progress reward——利用许多中间代码前缀本身可执行、且已产生有意义的部分渲染这一性质，把相邻中间渲染之间的变化转成对生成序列的局部反馈，用于图像到代码模型的 RL 后训练。
Result: 在 Image-to-SVG 与 Image-to-TikZ 生成两个任务上，该方法均优于监督微调 (SFT) 与标准 GRPO，并产出新的 state-of-the-art 开源模型。
Conclusion: 中间渲染是图像到代码模型 RL 后训练中简单有效的过程监督 (process supervision) 来源，比单一终端奖励提供更稠密、更对齐 token 贡献的反馈。

papers.title: AgentWare: Automating the Lifecycle of Agentic Applications across the Edge-to-Cloud Continuum
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLM-enabled agentic applications across the Edge-to-Cloud continuum remains challenging due to hardware heterogeneity, deployment complexity, limited observability, and the lack of systematic evaluation methods. Existing solutions address agent development, observability, or benchmarking separately, offering limited support for the full lifecycle of distributed agentic applications. This paper presents AgentWare, an AgenticOps framework that automates the provisioning, deployment, observability, and evaluation of agentic applications across Edge-to-Cloud infrastructures. AgentWare introduces an end-to-end lifecycle pipeline that automatically prepares heterogeneous execution environments, transforms user-defined agent implementations into distributed applications, deploys agent components across the continuum, and performs unified collection of execution traces, infrastructure telemetry, and evaluation metrics. The framework further supports automated semantic evaluation through LLM-as-a-Judge workflows and generates reproducible reports covering correctness, performance, resource utilization, and energy consumption. We demonstrate the applicability of AgentWare through a distributed book assistant agent deployed across real Edge-to-Cloud infrastructure under multiple deployment and model configurations. The results show that AgentWare enables systematic experimentation and evaluation of distributed agentic applications while significantly reducing the manual effort required for deployment, instrumentation, and analysis.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 17th International Conference on Cloud Computing Technology and Science (IEEE CloudCom 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentWare 是一个 AgenticOps 框架，把 LLM 智能体应用在 Edge-to-Cloud 连续体上的供给、部署、可观测性与评测串成端到端流水线：自动准备异构执行环境、把用户定义的 agent 改写为分布式应用、跨节点部署组件，并统一采集执行 trace、基础设施遥测与评测指标。用 LLM-as-a-Judge 做语义评测并生成可复现报告，覆盖正确性、性能、资源利用率与能耗；在真实 Edge-to-Cloud 基础设施上部署的分布式 book assistant 多配置演示表明，该框架支持系统化实验并显著降低部署、埋点与分析的人工投入。
Motivation: 跨 Edge-to-Cloud 部署 LLM 智能体应用受硬件异构、部署复杂、可观测性差和缺乏系统化评测方法制约；现有方案只分别覆盖 agent 开发、可观测性或 benchmark，缺少对分布式智能体应用全生命周期的支持。
Method: 端到端生命周期流水线：自动准备异构执行环境，将用户定义的 agent 实现变换为分布式应用，跨连续体部署各组件，并统一采集执行 trace、基础设施遥测与评测指标；语义评测用 LLM-as-a-Judge 工作流，产出覆盖正确性、性能、资源利用率与能耗的可复现报告。
Result: 在真实 Edge-to-Cloud 基础设施上以分布式 book assistant agent 在多种部署与模型配置下演示适用性；结果显示 AgentWare 支持分布式智能体应用的系统化实验与评测，同时显著减少部署、埋点与分析所需人工投入。
Conclusion: 把供给、部署、可观测与评测统一到一个 AgenticOps 框架内，可以在异构 Edge-to-Cloud 环境上对分布式 LLM 智能体应用做可复现的系统化实验，并压低人工操作成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Compute Time Scaling with Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose Tiny Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization (\ours{}), a general neural method for combinatorial optimization that scales both depth (how often we recursively invoke our network) and width (how much we sample in parallel). Both are fundamental for combinatorial optimization: hard instances demand a large amount of compute, while a small network is essential to avoid overfitting and capture the algorithmic essence of optimization. In particular, our method consists of a graph-aware tiny recursive model that iterates on a latent state with adaptive halting and needs only a lightweight problem-specific decoder. Compared with previous heatmap-based general neural solvers, it achieves a better balance between solution quality and inference speed on both the Traveling Salesman Problem~(TSP) and the Maximum Independent Set~(MIS) problem, and remains competitive with hybrid methods that combine neural components with heuristics specific to each problem. With the same backbone architecture for both tasks, \ours{} outperforms every diffusion-based solver on TSP from 500 to 10,000 cities at a lower inference cost, and on the standard Erdős--Rényi-[700-800] MIS benchmark it surpasses all neural solvers except those that only work well on MIS. We then explore self-relabeling for self-supervised training. We periodically replace the current set of training labels with the model's own better solutions, as an alternative training signal. Self-relabeling can, while forgoing supervision from near-optimal solutions, still result in on-par quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tiny Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization (TROM-CO)：图感知的极小递归网络以自适应停机 (adaptive halting) 迭代隐状态，同时扩展深度与并行采样宽度，只需轻量的问题专用解码器。在 TSP 500–10,000 城市上以更低推理成本胜过所有 diffusion-based solver，MIS Erdős–Rényi-[700-800] 上除专做 MIS 的方法外胜过全部 neural solver；自监督 self-relabeling 用模型自身更优解替换标签，质量与近最优监督持平。
Motivation: 组合优化的困难实例需要大量计算，而大网络易过拟合、难以抽出算法本质；已有 heatmap 类通用神经求解器在解质量与推理速度之间失衡。
Method: 图感知 tiny recursive model 迭代隐状态并带 adaptive halting，配轻量问题专用解码器；深度（递归调用次数）与宽度（并行采样量）同时扩展，同一 backbone 用于 TSP 与 MIS 两个任务；训练侧引入 self-relabeling，周期性用模型自身更优解替换训练标签作为自监督信号。
Result: 与 heatmap 类通用神经求解器相比，在 TSP 与 MIS 上取得解质量与推理速度的更好平衡，并与神经+问题专用启发式的混合方法保持竞争力；同一 backbone 下在 TSP 500 至 10,000 城市上以更低推理成本胜过每个 diffusion-based solver；在标准 Erdős–Rényi-[700-800] MIS 基准上超过除仅擅长 MIS 之外的所有 neural solver；self-relabeling 在放弃近最优解监督的情况下仍得到 on-par 质量。
Conclusion: 递归模型的深度与宽度扩展加自适应停机，能在更低推理成本下把通用神经求解器推到与混合方法相当的水平；标签可用模型自身更优解自举替代近最优监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-game Toxic Detection: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: In-game toxic language has emerged as a critical concern in the gaming industry and community. While several frameworks and models for online game toxicity analysis have been proposed, detecting toxicity in player chat utterances remains a formidable challenge: stemming not only from the extremely short length of such utterances but also from the heavy reliance on game slang, abbreviations, and domain-specific jargon, which generic language models are poorly suited to recognize. This paper presents a shared task for in-game toxic language detection built upon real-world in-game chat data, and proposes the best-preforming model for the toxic language slot filling: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals (BRAR). Experimental results demonstrate that BRAR effectively captures the global context and outperforms the existing baselines on slot filling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对游戏内聊天毒性检测中语句极短、充满游戏俚语与缩写的难题，提出 BRAR（Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals）：双向表征加注意力残差来捕捉全局上下文，用于该 shared task 的 toxic language slot filling 槽位填充槽位。实验显示 BRAR 在 slot filling 上超过现有基线。
Motivation: 游戏内玩家聊天语句极短且高度依赖俚语、缩写和领域黑话，通用语言模型难以识别，导致在线游戏毒性分析困难。
Method: 构建基于真实游戏内聊天数据的毒性检测 shared task，并提出 BRAR 模型，用双向表征结合注意力残差 (attention residuals) 捕捉全局上下文，完成 toxic language slot filling。
Result: 实验结果表明 BRAR 在 slot filling 任务上优于现有基线 (existing baselines)，有效捕捉全局上下文；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 双向表征加注意力残差能有效处理游戏俚语与短语句的毒性槽位填充，在该 shared task 上是最优模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpeechCritic: Learning a Diagnostic Speech Judge from Limited Human Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Human speech conveys rich perceptual information, such as emotion and speaker identity, yet most automatic speech quality judges reduce it to a single naturalness score. We study diagnostic speech judges: given two candidates, a diagnostic judge decides which is better, along which perceptual dimensions (e.g., timbre, emotion, timing) they differ, and which audible cues support its decision. Learning such judges is challenging: expert annotation is costly, and simply prompting a frontier audio-language model to produce labels is unreliable: our probing reveals substantial errors and unstable instruction following. We introduce SpeechCritic, which learns a diagnostic judge in a reference-conditioned cross-lingual setting from only about 300 human-labeled comparisons. Rather than replacing the frontier model, SpeechCritic calibrates it with these labels: for each dimension, it selects the acoustic measurements that agree with human judgments, maps them to A/Tie/B probabilities, and passes these to the model as non-binding hints alongside the audio. Compared with the same model labeling without hints, this raises dimension-level agreement with humans by 6.3 points and cuts the mismatch with human Tie rates by 10.4 points. We then train a 7B judge on this supervision and find that different training signals shape different judge behaviors: SFT establishes the task, OPD transfers the teacher's dimension-level strengths and weaknesses, and RL helps most on clear-cut comparisons where human raters agree. Notably, human listeners also find that RL makes rationales cite more specific, localized acoustic cues, although it never directly rewards rationale text. Finally, we show that the pipeline is language-pair agnostic by instantiating it on both English-Japanese and English-Spanish. Together, these results demonstrate a path from limited human preferences to a diagnostic speech judge.

papers.title: Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Temporal video grounding is a key capability of advanced \emph{Multimodal Large Language Models} (MLLMs) for the thorough understanding of video events, which is however often limited by repeated actions and visually similar contexts in long videos. In this paper, we study this issue from the perspective of \emph{On-policy distillation} (OPD) and propose a new training regime for MLLMs termed \emph{Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation} (CAPD). In particular, OPD is a viable solution for MLLMs via providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. But its next-token based teacher-student distillation is hard to identify the specific video segments supporting each predicted timestamp, which is critical for temporal grounding. In this case, CAPD measures how masking each temporal group changes the teacher's output distribution. The resulting counterfactual influence calibrates the teacher's attention and weights token-level distillation, allowing the student to learn the temporal evidence that affects boundary prediction. To validate CAPD, we trained it on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using only 2,500 samples for one epoch, and evaluated it on the TimeLens and multiple general video benchmarks. Experimental results show that CAPD improves average recall by 12.0\% relative to GRPO on TimeLens while preserving general video understanding, achieving comparable accuracy to the base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MLLM 时序视频定位 (temporal video grounding) 中重复动作与相似场景导致的边界误判，提出反事实注意力策略蒸馏 (CAPD)：用遮蔽各时间组后教师输出分布的变化量校准教师注意力，再据此加权 token 级 on-policy 蒸馏，让学生学到支撑预测时间戳的时序证据。仅用 2,500 条样本训练一个 epoch，在 TimeLens 上平均召回率相对 GRPO 提升 12.0%，同时保持通用视频理解能力。
Motivation: 长视频中重复动作与视觉相似上下文使时序定位易混淆；现有 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的 next-token 蒸馏难以定位支撑每个预测时间戳的具体视频片段。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation (CAPD)：在学生生成轨迹上做 on-policy 蒸馏，遮蔽每个时间组并测量教师输出分布的变化，得到反事实影响量以校准教师注意力并加权 token 级蒸馏；在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上用 2,500 条样本训练一个 epoch。
Result: 在 TimeLens 上 CAPD 平均召回率相对 GRPO 提升 12.0%，并在多个通用视频 benchmark 上保持与 base model 相当的准确度。
Conclusion: 用反事实遮蔽定位时序证据并据此加权蒸馏，能让小样本训练的 MLLM 提升时序定位召回率而不牺牲通用视频理解。

papers.title: GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior
papers.abstract_en: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. Experimental results show that GenNVS performs favorably against recent methods in both visual quality and geometric accuracy, while naturally supporting flexible scene editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenNVS 用解耦的 3D 先验做单图新视角合成 (novel view synthesis)：前景与背景分别用 3D Gaussian Splatting 建模，经由由粗到细的几何优化对齐成统一 3D 场景，再通过 Dual-Stream Masking 机制以渲染有效性掩码与几何感知 warping 共同条件化视频扩散模型。实验显示其在视觉质量与几何精度上相对近期方法表现有利，并天然支持灵活的场景编辑。
Motivation: 单图新视角合成中底层 3D 几何高度歧义，现有基于扩散的方法虽能生成合理结果，却难以保持前景物体的几何结构与空间一致性。
Method: GenNVS 将前景物体与背景分别用 3D Gaussian Splatting 建模，通过由粗到细的几何优化过程对齐二者形成统一 3D 场景；该场景经提出的 Dual-Stream Masking 机制条件化视频扩散模型，联合利用渲染的有效性掩码 (validity masks) 与几何感知 warping 引导合成。
Result: 实验结果表明 GenNVS 在视觉质量与几何精度两方面相对近期方法表现有利，并天然支持灵活的场景编辑；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把解耦的 3D 先验与掩码加 warping 的双流条件化结合，可以在单图新视角合成中同时改善几何一致性并保留场景编辑能力。

papers.title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Informative Path Planning in Aquatic Environmental Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Informative Path Planning for scalar field reconstruction uses predictive uncertainty to direct sensing vehicles toward maximally informative locations. Gaussian Processes provide this signal but their stationary isotropic kernels are misspecified for non-homogeneous phenomena such as oil spills, producing miscalibrated estimates that degrade planning. We investigate whether replacing the Gaussian Process with a well-calibrated Deep Ensemble improves path planning outcomes, and whether uncertainty quality interacts with the choice of planning algorithm. Five strategies ($ε$-Greedy, Value Greedy, Uncertainty Greedy, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and Receding Horizon Orienteering) share a common Deep Ensemble backbone trained on physics-based oil spill simulations. On held-out stochastic spill scenarios, the Deep Ensemble reduces normalised reconstruction error by $83\%$ relative to the Gaussian Process baseline. Crucially, well-calibrated uncertainty amplifies the importance of the planning strategy: the performance gap between algorithms is negligible under miscalibrated models but becomes substantial under the ensemble, where multi-step lookahead planners outperform greedy selection by up to $32\%$ in reconstruction error and achieve IoU above $0.85$. Monte Carlo Tree Search is the recommended planner, matching Orienteering in reconstruction quality at an order-of-magnitude lower computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在水环境监测的信息化路径规划 (Informative Path Planning) 中，用在物理驱动溢油仿真上训练的 Deep Ensemble 替换高斯过程 (GP) 作为不确定性来源，归一化重建误差相对 GP 基线下降 83%。不确定性校准好之后规划算法之间的差距才显现：多步前瞻规划比贪心选择的重建误差最多好 32%，IoU 超过 0.85。作者推荐 Monte Carlo Tree Search，其重建质量与 Receding Horizon Orienteering 相当而计算成本低一个数量级。
Motivation: GP 的平稳各向同性核对溢油这类非均匀现象设定错误，导致不确定性失准、路径规划变差；且不确定性失准时算法之间的差异被掩盖，无法判断该选哪种规划器。
Method: 以 Deep Ensemble 为五种规划策略（ε-Greedy、Value Greedy、Uncertainty Greedy、Monte Carlo Tree Search、Receding Horizon Orienteering）的共同预测骨干，训练数据来自基于物理的溢油仿真；在留出的随机溢油场景上比较，并对照 GP 基线。
Result: Deep Ensemble 相对 GP 基线把归一化重建误差降低 83%；在失准模型下各算法差距可忽略，而在 ensemble 下多步前瞻规划比贪心选择的重建误差最多好 32%，IoU 高于 0.85；MCTS 与 Orienteering 重建质量相当，计算成本低一个数量级。
Conclusion: 不确定性质量会放大规划算法选择的影响，因此先校准预测不确定性再比规划器才有意义；MCTS 是推荐规划器。

papers.title: Diffusion Subgoal Planning for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-directed policies from reward-free data, but in long-horizon tasks, goal-conditioned value functions often provide unstable guidance due to sparse rewards and discounting. Hierarchical methods partially mitigate this issue via subgoal decomposition; however, high-level decision-making still relies on noise-sensitive value estimates, leading to unstable behavior in complex environments. We address this limitation by proposing \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{S}ubgoal \textbf{P}lanning (\textbf{DSP}), a diffusion-based framework for high-level subgoal generation. DSP casts high-level planning as guided generative inference over goal-conditioned subgoals and learns both conditional and unconditional flows, enabling classifier-free guidance to introduce a goal-directed bias at inference time. By removing explicit value-based guidance from high-level planning, DSP generates reachable and goal-directed subgoals through a generative model while retaining hierarchical execution. Experiments on offline GCRL benchmarks demonstrate that DSP outperforms prior methods on a range of navigation and manipulation tasks, with particularly strong performance in maze environments that require multi-step subgoal planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion Subgoal Planning (DSP)，把离线目标条件强化学习的高层规划改写为在目标条件子目标上的引导式生成推断，同时学习条件流与无条件流以在推理时用 classifier-free guidance 注入目标导向偏置，从而去掉显式价值引导。在离线 GCRL 基准的导航与操作任务上超过先前方法，其中需要多步子目标规划的 maze 环境提升最明显。
Motivation: 长时程离线目标条件强化学习中，稀疏奖励与折扣使目标条件价值函数给出不稳定引导，分层方法的高层决策仍依赖对噪声敏感的价值估计，导致复杂环境中行为不稳。
Method: DSP 用扩散模型做高层子目标生成，将规划建模为目标条件子目标上的引导生成推断；同时学习条件流与无条件流，推理时用 classifier-free guidance 施加目标导向偏置，保留分层执行但移除显式价值引导。
Result: 在离线 GCRL 基准上，DSP 在一系列导航与操作任务中超过先前方法，在需要多步子目标规划的 maze 环境中表现尤其强。
Conclusion: 用生成模型替代价值引导来产生可达且目标导向的子目标，可以稳定长时程离线 GCRL 的高层规划，多步子目标场景收益最大。

papers.title: Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can. Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在推理轨迹的固定点插入一句第一人称的自信或怀疑表述，测得模型的委派 (delegation) 决策高度敏感：怀疑使调用工具的比例上升、自信使其下降，中位摆幅 20.6 个百分点，更大的供应商托管模型达 53–70 个百分点。但这种响应几乎不对准真实能力——中位仅 42% 的翻转是 well-targeted，比随机选择基线只高 2 个百分点。作者据此建议把 Nudgeability 作为免后训练的自反思评测面。
Motivation: 带工具调用的推理模型要在推理时决定独立作答还是委派，自反思机制必须回答信号如何改变后续动作这一因果问题，而现有评测难以把这一作用单独隔离出来。
Method: 在其余完全相同的推理轨迹的固定点插入单句第一人称自信或怀疑表述，让模型继续推理并选择直接回答或调用工具；比较这些反事实续写得到反思信号对委派的因果效应，即 Nudgeability，沿 sensitivity（自信/怀疑改变委派率的强度）与 targeting（能否对不可解题增加委派、对可解题减少委派）两个维度度量。
Result: 在 Qwen、Gemma、GLM 三个家族共九个中小规模开源权重推理模型与两个任务上，模型一致敏感：怀疑提高委派、自信降低委派，中位自信到怀疑的摆幅为 20.6 个百分点，较大的供应商托管模型为 53 到 70 个百分点；targeting 上中位 42% 的诱导翻转是 well-targeted，仅比随机选择基线高 2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 自信语言是控制委派行为的强操纵面，但当前模型只在很弱的程度上按自身真实能力使用它；Nudgeability 提供了一种免后训练的评测方式，可在内生自反思机制成熟时同时度量敏感性与对准性。

papers.title: PersonaManifold: Revealing and Exploiting Curved Geometry in LLM Persona Representations
papers.abstract_en: Controlling persona in large language models (LLMs) at inference time is important for role-playing, personalized dialogue, and social simulation. Recent methods extract persona vectors from the model's activation space and apply Euclidean operations---addition, scaling, and linear interpolation---under the linear representation hypothesis. However, these methods themselves report systematic failures: non-orthogonal trait dimensions, asymmetric ceiling and resistance effects, and significant deviations in multi-trait composition, suggesting that the linear isotropic assumption does not hold. We propose PersonaManifold, a framework that models persona representations as points on a curved, low-dimensional Riemannian submanifold in activation space. We estimate the manifold's intrinsic geometry---local metric tensors, geodesic distances, and Ollivier-Ricci curvature---and introduce geodesic steering, which interpolates between personas along manifold geodesics rather than Euclidean straight lines. We also propose the Behavioral Similarity Triplet (BST) benchmark, which automatically generates situational questions grounded in six established psychological constructs and defines persona similarity through behavioral responses rather than self-report questionnaires. Experiments on three open-source LLMs show that persona activations form a manifold with heterogeneous curvature, geodesic distance predicts behavioral similarity more accurately than Euclidean alternatives with independent contributions from anisotropy and curvature, and geodesic steering produces more coherent intermediate personas on both our BST benchmark and external evaluations, with the advantage concentrated in high-deviation regions where the manifold deviates most from flatness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PersonaManifold 把 LLM 激活空间中的人设表示建为弯曲的低维 Riemannian 子流形，估计局部度量张量、测地距离与 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率，用沿测地线的 geodesic steering 取代欧氏加法与线性插值。在三个开源 LLM 上，测地距离比欧氏度量更能预测行为相似度，且各向异性与曲率有独立贡献；生成的中间人设在 BST 与外部评测上更连贯，优势集中在流形偏离平坦最明显的高偏差区域。
Motivation: 现有 persona 向量方法在激活空间做欧氏加法、缩放与线性插值，但其自身报告了非正交特质维度、天花板与阻力效应不对称、多特质组合显著偏离等问题，说明线性各向同性假设不成立。
Method: 把 persona 表示当作弯曲低维 Riemannian 子流形上的点，估计局部度量张量、测地距离与 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率，并提出 geodesic steering：沿流形测地线而非欧氏直线在人设间插值。同时提出 Behavioral Similarity Triplet (BST) 基准，基于六个成熟心理学构念自动生成情境问题，用行为反应而非自陈问卷定义人设相似度。
Result: 在三个开源 LLM 上，persona 激活构成具有异质曲率的流形；测地距离比欧氏替代方案更准确地预测行为相似度，各向异性与曲率各自有独立贡献；geodesic steering 在 BST 及外部评测上产生更连贯的中间人设，优势集中在流形偏离平坦程度最高的高偏差区域。
Conclusion: 人设表示的真实几何是弯曲而非平坦的，沿测地线操控人设优于欧氏线性运算，且收益在流形最不平坦处最明显。
