papers.title: Distribution-Conditioned Task Routing for Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient adaptation enables continual learners to acquire task-specific knowledge through compact model updates while maintaining strong within-task performance. However, class-incremental inference requires each input to be classified among all classes seen so far without access to its task identity. For learners equipped with task-specific parameter-efficient modules, this introduces a critical task-routing challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting. We study post-hoc task routing without retraining the learner or introducing a separately trained router. Such training-free inference-time calibration remains comparatively underexplored in parameter-efficient class-incremental learning. We identify three sources of routing error (feature-level, task-level, and class-level misalignment) and propose Feature Distribution Calibration (FDC). Its three components address these misalignments: Task Subspace Filtering (TSF) suppresses feature components outside each task's principal subspace, Residual Likelihood Calibration (RLC) evaluates the typicality of its subspace residual, and Prototype Affinity Calibration (PAC) measures compatibility with the task's class prototypes. Experiments demonstrate plug-and-play applicability to eight parameter-efficient class-incremental methods using a shared encoder. With one component configuration selected per method across all five benchmarks, FDC improves final accuracy in all 40 method-dataset pairs by 4.39 percentage points on average. Enabling all components improves 35 of the 40 pairs, with an average gain of 4.45 points. When applied to a simple baseline, FDC achieves strong overall performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在参数高效类增量学习中，推理时没有任务身份，任务路由错误独立于灾难性遗忘存在。Feature Distribution Calibration (FDC) 以免训练的推理时校准同时纠正特征、任务、类三层错位：TSF 滤掉任务主子空间外的成分，RLC 校准子空间残差似然，PAC 度量与类原型的亲和性。在五个基准、八个参数高效类增量方法共 40 个方法-数据集组合上，单一组件配置使最终准确率平均提升 4.39 个百分点，全部组件启用时 40 组中 35 组提升、平均 4.45 个百分点。
Motivation: 带任务专属参数高效模块的学习器在类增量推理时必须在全部已见类上分类却拿不到任务身份，形成超越灾难性遗忘的任务路由难题；免训练的推理时校准在参数高效类增量学习中仍少有人做。
Method: 提出 Feature Distribution Calibration (FDC)，识别特征级、任务级、类级三类路由错误并各设一个组件：Task Subspace Filtering (TSF) 抑制任务主子空间之外的特征成分，Residual Likelihood Calibration (RLC) 评估子空间残差的典型性，Prototype Affinity Calibration (PAC) 度量与任务类原型的兼容度；不重训学习器也不训练独立路由器，每个方法在全部五个基准上只选一次组件配置。
Result: 在共享编码器下即插即用于八个参数高效类增量方法，覆盖五个基准共 40 个方法-数据集组合：单一配置下 40 组最终准确率全部提升，平均 +4.39 个百分点；启用全部组件时 40 组中 35 组提升，平均 +4.45 个百分点；套用到一个简单基线上也取得强的整体表现。
Conclusion: 免训练的推理时分布校准足以在参数高效类增量学习中同时缓解三类路由错误，且一套配置可跨方法跨数据集通用，无需为每个组合重新调参。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SubjectAnchor: Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video for Multi-Shot Storytelling
papers.abstract_en: We present SubjectAnchor, a Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video paradigm for multi-shot storytelling in which the current shot is generated by conditioning on explicit visual memories extracted from previous shots. The objective is to preserve subject identity and scene consistency across cuts while retaining the controllability of shot-wise prompting. Built on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, SubjectAnchor contains three key components: subject-related memory construction, subject-aware temporal rotary position encoding, and memory-aware attention partition. For each target shot, the method constructs a compact memory bank by tracing each required subject to its historical appearance and retrieving the most relevant precomputed keyframes. These memory frames are encoded into the model input as explicit visual conditions, while different subjects are assigned to separated negative temporal slots to reduce identity interference. In addition, memory-aware attention partition regulates the interaction between memory tokens and generated content within a shared backbone. This formulation preserves the appearance anchoring of explicit visual memory while remaining compatible with script-driven shot-by-shot generation. Experiments show that SubjectAnchor improves cross-shot identity consistency over representative memory-based and holistic baselines while maintaining competitive visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SubjectAnchor 把多镜头故事生成改成「显式视觉记忆到视频」范式：为每个目标镜头检索该主体历史关键帧构成紧凑记忆库，用主体感知的时间 RoPE 与记忆感知注意力划分把记忆 token 注入共享骨干，并给不同主体分配分离的负时间槽以减少身份干扰。在 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 上的实验显示，跨镜头身份一致性优于代表性记忆式与整体式基线，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。
Motivation: 多镜头叙事生成在镜头切换处容易丢失主体身份与场景一致性，而逐镜头提示的可控性又要求每镜独立生成，两者存在冲突。
Method: 基于 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，包含三个组件：主体相关记忆构建（追踪每个所需主体的历史外观并检索最相关预计算关键帧，编码为显式视觉条件）、主体感知的时间旋转位置编码（subject-aware temporal RoPE，不同主体分配到分离的负时间槽）、以及记忆感知注意力划分（memory-aware attention partition，在共享骨干内调节记忆 token 与生成内容的交互）。
Result: 实验表明 SubjectAnchor 在跨镜头身份一致性上优于代表性记忆式与整体式 (holistic) 基线，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 显式视觉记忆加主体分离的时间槽与注意力划分，可以在保留逐镜头脚本可控性的同时锚定主体外观，缓解镜头切换处的身份漂移。

summary_sections.method: 基于 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，包含三个组件：主体相关记忆构建（追踪每个所需主体的历史外观并检索最相关预计算关键帧，编码为显式视觉条件）、主体感知的时间旋转位置编码（subject-aware temporal RoPE，不同主体分配到分离的负时间槽）、以及记忆感知注意力划分（memory-aware attention partition，在共享骨干内调节记忆 token 与生成内容的交互）。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明 SubjectAnchor 在跨镜头身份一致性上优于代表性记忆式与整体式 (holistic) 基线，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式视觉记忆加主体分离的时间槽与注意力划分，可以在保留逐镜头脚本可控性的同时锚定主体外观，缓解镜头切换处的身份漂移。

papers.title: Can Attack Difficulty Be Characterized Before Optimization? A Study of Pre-optimization Difficulty in Person-Vanishing Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks against object detectors are traditionally studied from an optimization perspective, where attack difficulty is regarded as an outcome observed only after adversarial optimization. This raises a fundamental question: \emph{can the relative attack difficulty of different inputs be characterized before optimization begins?} In this paper, we investigate this question for person-vanishing attacks by introducing the concept of pre-optimization attack difficulty, which captures intrinsic differences in optimization effort across input images. To estimate this latent difficulty before optimization, we propose Quad-CLEVER, an efficient geometry-based estimator derived from a quadratic approximation of the local person-vanishing margin along the most attack-relevant direction. Extensive experiments across multiple attack algorithms demonstrate that Quad-CLEVER consistently correlates with the observed optimization cost, providing empirical evidence that attack difficulty exhibits a predictable pre-optimization structure. Building upon this finding, we further propose a difficulty-aware attack framework that leverages the estimated difficulty to adaptively allocate optimization budgets for a base attack under a fixed computational budget. On BDD100K, the proposed framework improves the image-level attack success rate by up to 5.78$\%$ while reducing the average optimization cost by up to 11.42 iterations. On the more challenging EventPed dataset, it saves 2.25 optimization iterations while maintaining comparable attack performance. These results demonstrate that attack difficulty can be meaningfully estimated before optimization and that exploiting such estimates enables more computationally efficient adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对行人消失型对抗攻击 (person-vanishing attack)，提出 Quad-CLEVER：用最攻击相关方向上局部消失裕度的二次近似，在优化开始前估计单张图像的攻击难度。该估计与实际优化代价稳定相关；据此自适应分配固定计算预算，BDD100K 上图像级攻击成功率最多提升 5.78%、平均优化代价最多减少 11.42 次迭代，EventPed 上省 2.25 次迭代且性能相当。
Motivation: 对抗攻击难度传统上只能在优化结束后观察，无法在开始前判断不同输入的相对难度，导致固定预算下算力在易样本上浪费。
Method: 提出 Quad-CLEVER 几何估计器：沿最攻击相关方向对局部 person-vanishing margin 做二次近似，得到优化前的难度估计；再构建难度感知攻击框架，在固定计算预算下按估计难度自适应分配优化预算给基础攻击算法。
Result: Quad-CLEVER 与实测优化代价在多种攻击算法上持续相关。在 BDD100K 上，该框架图像级攻击成功率最多提升 5.78%，平均优化代价最多减少 11.42 次迭代；在更难的 EventPed 上节省 2.25 次迭代且攻击性能相当。
Conclusion: 攻击难度在优化前就具有可预测结构，利用该估计可在固定预算下做更省算力的对抗攻击。

papers.title: Scalable GNN-based Knowledge Graph Representation Learning with Efficient Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at representation learning on Knowledge Graphs (KGs), achieving stateof-the-art performance on tasks like link prediction or entity classification. However, their high computational complexity, inherent to their user-defined message passing (MP) algorithm, still prohibits their widespread adoption, especially for large KGs. Current efforts to mitigate the scalability bottlenecks of GNNs on KGs, such as subgraph sampling, are often task- and model-specific, and do not reliably guarantee lossless (if applicable) runtime/space reductions. To address this, we extend Relational Sparse Matrix Multiplication (RSPMM), originally designed to losslessly lower the space complexity of composition-based MP with pointwise composition functions, to support more expressive functions (e.g., 2x2 block-diagonal matrix multiplication, Givens rotation, circular correlation). Our method delivers significant task-independent reductions in runtime and space for current GNNs on KGs and facilitates efficient re-implementations of GNNs that maintain near state-of-the-art performance on challenging KG tasks, for a fraction of computational costs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Posters and Demos Track of the International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把关系稀疏矩阵乘 (RSPMM) 从点式组合函数扩展到更表达力的组合（2x2 块对角矩阵乘、Givens 旋转、循环相关），为 KG 上的 GNN 消息传递带来与任务无关的运行时间和空间的显著削减，并支撑出以极小计算代价维持接近 SOTA 的 GNN 重实现。
Motivation: GNN 在知识图谱上做链接预测、实体分类已达 SOTA，但用户自定义消息传递的高计算复杂度阻碍其在大 KG 上的普及；现有缓解手段（如子图采样）任务与模型绑定，且不能可靠保证无损的运行时/空间削减。
Method: 扩展 Relational Sparse Matrix Multiplication (RSPMM)：原设计用于以点式组合函数无损降低组合式消息传递的空间复杂度，现支持更表达力的函数，包括 2x2 块对角矩阵乘、Givens 旋转与循环相关。
Result: 方法为当前 KG 上的 GNN 带来显著且任务无关的运行时与空间削减，并促成在具挑战性的 KG 任务上以极小计算代价维持接近 state-of-the-art 性能的高效重实现；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把消息传递下沉到关系稀疏矩阵乘的层面做无损改写，是让 KG 上 GNN 可扩展而不牺牲任务性能的路径，且不依赖特定任务或模型。

papers.title: QAMM: Adjoint MeanFlow Matching for Few-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Flow policies can model rich action distributions, but their iterative sampling limits decision speed. Adjoint matching uses the critic's action gradient to improve a flow policy without backpropagating through its sampling trajectory, yet its supervision is defined for instantaneous velocities. We propose QAMM, a method that turns the critic-derived adjoint signal into supervision for MeanFlow's average velocity. The resulting policy learns finite-interval transport directly and generates actions with few network evaluations. We derive the adjoint MeanFlow target, specify its gradient boundaries, and train it with an offline actor-critic. On ten HumanoidMaze tasks, QAMM produces effective two-call policies and achieves competitive performance against strong flow-policy baselines. These results show that adjoint-based Q optimization can be combined with average-velocity learning to obtain expressive offline policies with few-step action generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QAMM 把 critic 动作梯度导出的 adjoint 信号改写成对 MeanFlow 平均速度 (average velocity) 的监督，使流策略直接学习有限区间传输，只需两次网络调用即可生成动作。在十个 HumanoidMaze 任务上，这种两调用 (two-call) 策略相对强流策略基线取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 流策略动作分布丰富但迭代采样拖慢决策；adjoint matching 虽免去对采样轨迹的反传，其监督却定义在瞬时速度上，无法直接约束平均速度。
Method: 推导 adjoint MeanFlow 目标并明确其梯度边界，将 critic 导出的 adjoint 信号转为平均速度监督，配合 offline actor-critic 训练，得到少步生成的流策略。
Result: 在十个 HumanoidMaze 任务上，QAMM 产出有效的两调用 (two-call) 策略，性能相对强流策略基线 (strong flow-policy baselines) 有竞争力。
Conclusion: adjoint 基的 Q 优化可以与平均速度学习结合，在保持表达力的同时实现少步动作生成的离线策略。

papers.title: ConCAD: Constraint-Aware Image-to-CAD Generation with Dual-Granularity Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-CAD generation seeks executable parametric programs that recover both the geometry and design intent of a reference object. Existing systems are commonly evaluated by validity and shape overlap, although two solids with similar volume can encode different CAD relations. We introduce ConCAD, a constraint-aware image-to-CAD framework optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rewards at two complementary granularities: a code-level constraint reward and an execution-level geometric reward. This complementary design disambiguates structurally distinct yet volumetrically similar shapes while ensuring valid 3D geometry. To verify that these rewards recover geometry and design intent, we introduce a B-rep geometric constraint satisfaction rate (G-CSR), which analytically extracts and evaluates geometric constraints from boundary representations. Experiments on the DeepCAD and Zero2CAD demonstrate that ConCAD achieves the best IoU and Chamfer Distance over competitive baselines, while also outperforming them on G-CSR, validating its superior recovery of both geometric fidelity and parametric design intent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConCAD 用 GRPO 同时优化代码级约束奖励与执行级几何奖励，把体积相近但 CAD 约束关系不同的形状区分开，并提出从 B-rep 解析提取约束的评测指标 G-CSR。在 DeepCAD 与 Zero2CAD 上，它在 IoU、Chamfer Distance 和 G-CSR 上均取得相对竞争基线的最佳结果。
Motivation: image-to-CAD 现有系统多用体积重合度 (IoU) 与形状重叠评测，而体积相同的两个实体可能编码完全不同的 CAD 约束关系，几何保真与设计意图的恢复无法被区分。
Method: ConCAD 用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 训练 image-to-CAD 生成，奖励分两级：代码级约束奖励 (code-level constraint reward) 与执行级几何奖励 (execution-level geometric reward)；并提出 G-CSR，从边界表示 (B-rep) 解析提取几何约束后计算满足率。
Result: 在 DeepCAD 与 Zero2CAD 上，ConCAD 在 IoU 与 Chamfer Distance 上取得相对竞争基线的最佳值，并在 G-CSR 上同样领先。
Conclusion: 双粒度奖励（约束 + 几何）能同时保证 3D 几何有效并更好恢复参数化设计意图，G-CSR 可作为体积类指标之外的约束恢复评测。

papers.title: LLN: Learnable Lens Networks for Parameter-Efficient Long-Horizon Dynamical Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Explicit residual connections of the form (x+f(x)), often combined with normalization layers, have become a standard strategy for training very deep neural networks. However, residual addition primarily provides an algebraic shortcut for gradient propagation, while leaving the evolution of feature geometry across layers largely unconstrained. We introduce Learnable Lens Networks (LLN), a physics-inspired architecture that replaces direct feature-space residual accumulation with learnable optical transport in an augmented position-angle phase space. Each layer alternates between free propagation, which provides an implicit transport path, and a learnable lens field that performs nonlinear trajectory transformation and focusing. Theoretically, we establish that LLN transport is globally invertible and volume-preserving for any differentiable lens field, with the implemented coordinate-wise Gaussian transport further satisfying symplecticity. Importantly, these structural constraints do not limit expressivity: with unrestricted embeddings and readouts, LLN retain universal approximation of continuous end-to-end maps. Experiments across diverse dynamical systems demonstrate that LLN improves long-horizon prediction while using substantially fewer parameters than same-depth comparators. Further analysis reveals stable depth-wise gradient transport and interpretable learned dynamics under the coupled propagation and refraction design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLN 用可学习光学传输替代 (x+f(x)) 式残差累加：每层在自由传播与可学习透镜场之间交替，在增广的 position-angle 相空间中做非线性轨迹变换与聚焦。理论上该传输对任意可微透镜场全局可逆且保体积，实现的逐坐标 Gaussian transport 还满足辛性 (symplecticity)，同时在无限制嵌入与读出下保持对连续端到端映射的万有逼近能力。在多种动力系统上 LLN 以显著更少的参数改善长时程预测。
Motivation: 显式残差连接只给梯度传播提供代数捷径，特征几何跨层演化基本不受约束，深层网络在长时程动力预测上参数开销大。
Method: 提出 Learnable Lens Networks (LLN)：每层交替执行自由传播（隐式传输路径）与可学习透镜场（非线性轨迹变换与聚焦），在增广 position-angle 相空间中取代特征空间残差累加；实现采用逐坐标 Gaussian transport，并给出可逆、保体积、辛性与万有逼近的理论刻画。
Result: 在多种动力系统实验中，LLN 在参数量显著少于同深度对比模型的条件下改善长时程预测；进一步分析显示深度方向梯度传输稳定，耦合传播与折射设计下学到的动力学可解释。
Conclusion: 以物理启发的可学习透镜传输替代残差累加，可以在保持万有逼近的同时兼顾全局可逆、保体积与辛结构，并以更少参数换取更好的长时程动力预测。

papers.title: PowerBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Retrieval and Reasoning in Power Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents offer new opportunities for automated analysis in industry. However, rigorous evaluation of such agents-for example, within power system scenarios-remains hindered: real operational data are confidential, and existing public resources fail to fully capture the chained dependencies and heterogeneous evidence. To address this gap, we propose PowerBench, comprising (1) a generation framework that derives interconnected heterogeneous operational data through a common dependency chain, and (2) a synthetic dataset generated by this framework. The dataset covers 761 devices across 100 device types, with 13.35 million hourly telemetry records spanning two years and 24,939 operational documents. Building on this dataset, we construct 300 questions across three task families that evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to complete analysis tasks that require autonomous evidence retrieval and reasoning across interconnected and heterogeneous data under restricted tool calls and time budgets. Results demonstrate that the evaluated frontier LLMs remain challenged on these tasks: the best model reaches only 74.2% joint accuracy. Our trace analysis further reveals that model performance varies across evidence discovery, content retrieval, tool use, reasoning over evidence, and answer submission. These findings provide detailed insights for evaluating LLM agents and guiding their reliable deployment in industry. The framework, dataset, and benchmark tasks are available at https://github.com/open-compass/PowerBench.

papers.title: M3OS: A Monte Carlo Graph Search-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM System for Evidence-Traced Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Small-molecule optimization integrates medicinal-chemistry reasoning and computational evidence through iterative, multi-objective decisions. When large language models (LLMs) reason over optimization histories stored primarily in conversational context, they must recover candidate identities, prior evaluations, and task constraints to guide subsequent decisions. We present M3OS, a multi-agent LLM system that decouples molecular-design reasoning from optimization-state management through Monte Carlo graph search. A persistent graph links evaluated candidates, parent-child transformations and evaluation evidence, while rewards and visit statistics guide LLM-assisted parent selection. Two branches combine tool-driven candidate generation with knowledge- and case-guided medicinal-chemistry editing. An execution harness controls graph updates through structured output extraction, molecular validation and task-bound evaluation. Agents receive role-specific contexts, while the graph preserves optimization trajectories beyond their active contexts. Across three molecular optimization benchmarks, M3OS achieves higher success rates than baselines, supporting the integration of persistent search state, specialized agents and controlled execution for multi-constraint optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M3OS 用 Monte Carlo graph search 把小分子优化的推理与状态管理解耦：持久图记录已评估候选、父子变换与评估证据，奖励和访问统计引导 LLM 选父本，工具生成与知识/案例引导的药化编辑两条分支产出候选。在三个分子优化基准上成功率高于基线。
Motivation: LLM 在对话上下文里回顾优化历史时必须重建候选身份、既往评估与任务约束，长程优化轨迹随上下文丢失，多目标决策因此不稳。
Method: 持久图保存候选、变换与评估证据，用奖励与访问统计做 Monte Carlo 式父本选择；两条分支分别做工具驱动候选生成和知识/案例引导的药化编辑；执行框架 (execution harness) 通过结构化输出抽取、分子验证与任务绑定评估控制图更新，各 agent 拿到角色专属上下文。
Result: 在三个分子优化基准上，M3OS 的成功率高于所比较的基线。
Conclusion: 持久搜索状态、专职 agent 与受控执行三者结合，可支撑多约束分子优化的成功率提升。

papers.title: HPMD: A Historical Persian Manuscript Dataset for Word Spotting with Line-Level Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Large collections of historical Persian manuscripts have been digitized, but searching them is still slow and mostly manual. Historians usually want to find where a specific name, date, event, or topic appears, which is a word spotting problem. Progress on this task is limited by two things. First, there is almost no public dataset of historical Persian handwriting; the only notable resource, OpenITI MAKHZAN, contains a relatively small Persian portion. Second, word spotting models usually need word-level bounding boxes, which are very expensive to annotate. In this paper we introduce a new dataset of 223 pages, 3,678 lines, 37,631 words, and 130,630 characters, collected from diverse historical Persian books of poetry and prose and annotated at the region, line, and text level. We also propose a baseline that is trained only with line-level annotations but returns word-level locations. A fine-tuned line detector finds text lines, and a fine-tuned CRNN recognizer trained with CTC produces a frame-by-character posterior matrix for each line. Instead of decoding the most probable character at each frame, the query is scored directly against this matrix, so visually similar characters in Persian such as be and pe no longer cause hard failures. The frame alignment also gives the horizontal position of the word inside the line. On the test set, the fine-tuned line detector reaches an F1 of 0.892, and posterior-based search raises the word spotting F1 from 0.487 to 0.558 compared with exact matching on the decoded text, with the decision threshold selected on a held-out validation set. A PHOC attribute-embedding baseline that additionally receives oracle word boundaries at test time reaches an F1 of 0.449, below the proposed method. We also report a distributional analysis of the dataset, a taxonomy of retrieval errors, and a per-conditionbreakdown of performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HPMD 提供 223 页、3,678 行、37,631 词、130,630 字符的历史波斯手抄本数据集，含 region/line/text 三级标注。基线只用行级标注即输出词级位置：行检测器 F1 0.892，基于 CTC 后验矩阵直接打分的检索把词级 word spotting F1 从精确匹配的 0.487 提到 0.558，且高于拿到 oracle 词边界的 PHOC 属性嵌入基线 0.449。
Motivation: 历史波斯手写检索受限于两点：几乎没有公开数据集（仅 OpenITI MAKHZAN 的波斯语部分较小），而 word spotting 模型通常依赖成本很高的词级 bounding box 标注。
Method: 先用微调行检测器定位文本行，再用 CTC 训练的微调 CRNN 识别器为每行产出逐帧字符后验矩阵；查询不走逐帧解码，而是直接与后验矩阵打分，帧对齐同时给出词在行内的水平位置，决策阈值在独立验证集上选定。
Result: 测试集上行检测器 F1 0.892；后验检索把 word spotting F1 从解码文本精确匹配的 0.487 提升到 0.558；额外获得 oracle 词边界的 PHOC 属性嵌入基线 F1 为 0.449，低于所提方法。
Conclusion: 只用行级标注即可得到词级定位与检索，且直接对字符后验打分比解码后精确匹配更稳，可规避波斯语中 be 与 pe 等形近字符导致的硬失败。

papers.title: When Less Data Favors Smaller Teachers: Rethinking Teacher Capacity and Data Selection for Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Data pruning reduces the training cost of knowledge distillation (KD). However, the preferred teacher capacity changes with the data budget: smaller teachers can outperform larger ones when limited training data are available. Understanding what drives this shift is important not only for teacher choice but also for identifying which samples are useful for distillation. We analyze teacher supervision by decomposing it into relational ordering---the ranking of classes---and score geometry---the magnitudes and margins of class probabilities---and show that the small-teacher advantage in the low-data regime arises not only from score geometry but also from relational ordering. Beyond understanding teacher capacity, our analysis reveals two properties of effective subsets: samples should match the difficulty appropriate for the available budget, and their relational signals should be diverse rather than redundant. Based on these findings, we propose DVA (Difficulty- and Volume-Aware data selection for KD), a training-dynamics-free method, which uses a small teacher as a proxy for budget-aware difficulty filtering and class-conditional relational volume maximization. Despite requiring no training dynamics statistics, our method remains competitive with training-dynamics-based methods while consistently outperforming training-dynamics-free baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在知识蒸馏 (KD) 的数据剪枝场景下，低数据预算时小教师反而优于大教师，因为教师监督可分解为关系排序 (relational ordering) 与分数几何 (score geometry)，小教师优势两者皆有贡献。据此提出免训练动态的 DVA 选择法，用小教师做预算感知难度过滤与类条件关系体积最大化，无需训练动态统计量仍与该类方法竞争，并持续优于免训练动态基线。
Motivation: 数据剪枝能降低 KD 训练成本，但教师容量偏好随数据预算变化：低预算下更优的教师变小，且哪些样本适合蒸馏缺乏可解释的判据。
Method: 把教师监督分解为关系排序（类别排名）与分数几何（概率幅值与间隔）两部分，分析小教师在低数据下的优势来源；据此提出 DVA（Difficulty- and Volume-Aware data selection for KD），以小教师作为代理做预算感知难度过滤与类条件关系体积最大化，不依赖训练动态统计量。
Result: 小教师在低数据预算下可胜过大教师，其优势同时来自分数几何与关系排序；有效子集需满足难度与预算匹配、关系信号多样而非冗余。DVA 无需训练动态统计量即与基于训练动态的方法保持竞争，并持续优于免训练动态基线。
Conclusion: 教师容量选择应随数据预算调整，蒸馏子集的挑选标准是难度匹配预算加上关系信号多样性；DVA 用小教师代理即可同时满足这两条而免去训练动态统计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FlexLoop: Depth-Elastic Looped Policies for Adaptive Test-Time Computation in Deep RL
papers.abstract_en: Looped architectures scale computation by reusing the same parameters across recurrent steps, and recent work shows that they substantially improve deep reinforcement learning policies on long-horizon tasks. Since recurrent depth directly controls computation, one may expect looped policies to naturally support elastic inference across recurrent depths. Surprisingly, we find that pretrained looped policies exhibit severe recurrent-depth specialization: reliable decisions are concentrated near the full trained depth, tying deployment computation to this depth even when less computation may suffice. Achieving depth elasticity, i.e., reliable decisions across recurrent depths with adaptive computation at deployment, therefore remains a key challenge. To address this, we propose FlexLoop, a novel post-training framework that converts pretrained fixed-depth looped policies into depth-elastic policies. FlexLoop keeps training on the original RL objective to preserve full-depth capability while performing adjacent-depth policy distillation to progressively transfer decision quality from deeper to shallower recurrent steps. The resulting policy supports reliable inference across recurrent depths and enables state-wise adaptive inference through recurrent-depth consistency. Experiments on $30$ online and offline long-horizon goal-conditioned environments show that FlexLoop preserves full-depth performance while making shallower depths effective. Keeping competitive performance, FlexLoop reduces average recurrent depth by up to $\bf{43\%}$ and achieves up to $\bf{1.34\times}$ wall-clock speedup in a stress test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexLoop 把预训练的固定深度循环策略 (looped policy) 转成深度弹性策略：保留原 RL 目标继续训练以守住全深度能力，同时做相邻深度策略蒸馏，把决策质量从深层逐步传到浅层。在 30 个在线与离线长时程目标条件环境中，平均循环深度最多降 43%，压力测试下墙钟加速最高 1.34×，且全深度性能保持。
Motivation: 循环架构本应凭循环深度天然支持弹性推理，但预训练循环策略出现严重的深度特化：可靠决策集中在训练全深度附近，部署计算量被这个深度锁死，即使更少计算已够用。
Method: 后训练框架 FlexLoop：在原 RL 目标上继续训练以保留全深度能力，同时执行相邻深度策略蒸馏 (adjacent-depth policy distillation)，把深层的决策质量逐级转移到更浅的循环步；推理时靠循环深度一致性 (recurrent-depth consistency) 做逐状态的自适应深度推断。
Result: 在 30 个在线与离线长时程目标条件环境中，FlexLoop 保持全深度性能同时让浅层深度变得可用；平均循环深度最多减少 43%，压力测试下最高取得 1.34× 墙钟加速，并保持竞争力性能。
Conclusion: 深度特化是循环策略做弹性推理的真正障碍，而「原 RL 目标 + 相邻深度蒸馏」的后训练组合能在不牺牲全深度能力的前提下把计算量压下去。

papers.title: PACER: Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing for Radiology Report Generation under Incomplete Clinical Context
papers.abstract_en: Radiology report generation (RRG) increasingly incorporates heterogeneous clinical evidence, such as multi-view radiographs and previous reports, whose availability varies across examinations. However, accommodating different input combinations does not ensure effective evidence use: generated reports may still omit or inaccurately describe clinically relevant findings. To address this problem, we propose PACER, a Progressive Availability-Conditioned Evidence Routing framework for structured incomplete-context RRG that follows a Refine-Calibrate-Commit pipeline. It first refines observed visual representations through endpoint-preserving patchwise routing across frozen encoder depths, incorporating complementary cues while retaining the pretrained terminal representation. It then calibrates the language-model prefix according to the observed evidence and availability state, adapting the shared generator's conditioning as the available source set changes. Finally, it generates polarity-structured clinical commitments before the report in the same autoregressive trajectory, providing structured clinical context for subsequent generation. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art clinical efficacy across all four MIMIC-RG4 settings and strong MIMIC-CXR performance, while maintaining competitive language-generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACER 针对放射报告生成中临床证据（多视角胸片、既往报告）可得性不齐的问题，按 Refine-Calibrate-Commit 流水线做可用性条件化的证据路由：先在冻结编码器各深度做端点保持的 patch 级路由精炼视觉表征，再按观测证据与可用性状态校准语言模型前缀，最后在同一自回归轨迹中先生成极性结构化的临床承诺再写报告。在 MIMIC-RG4 全部四种可用性设置上取得 state-of-the-art 临床疗效，MIMIC-CXR 表现强劲，语言生成质量保持竞争力。
Motivation: 放射报告生成的输入证据组合随检查而异，但仅容忍不同输入组合并不保证证据被有效使用，生成报告仍会遗漏或错误描述临床相关发现。
Method: PACER 采用 Refine-Calibrate-Commit 三段式框架：endpoint-preserving patchwise routing 在冻结编码器深度间融合互补线索并保留预训练终端表征；按观测证据与 availability state 校准共享生成器的语言模型前缀；在生成报告前的同一自回归轨迹中先产出 polarity-structured clinical commitments 作为结构化临床上下文。
Result: 在 MIMIC-RG4 的全部四种（four）可用性设置上达到 state-of-the-art 临床疗效，并在 MIMIC-CXR 上取得强劲表现，同时语言生成质量保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 在不改动共享生成器主体的前提下，按可用性状态路由证据并先给出结构化临床承诺，可在证据不全的放射报告生成中同时保住临床疗效与语言质量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARS 用通用 VLM 做零训练的机器人进度奖励建模：子代理先提议任务相关事件时间线，主代理验证并修订后再逐帧估计进度，还能审计外部奖励模型的输出。在 27B VLM 上，语义错配基准显示多个奖励基线会把错误物体操作误判为进度，ARS 显著抑制这类伪进度并在仿真策略学习中胜过基线。
Motivation: 进度奖励估计需区分真正的状态变化与失败尝试、任务无关动作，而现有奖励模型在简单抓放场景里就会把错误物体操作当成进度，导致下游策略学习被误导。
Method: ARS 是面向进度奖励建模的推理框架，不额外训练奖励模型：给定离线轨迹与任务指令，子代理提议任务相关事件时间线，主代理验证并修订后估计逐帧进度；可选接入终局结果标签与视觉参考，并可审计外部奖励模型的进度估计。评测用 27B VLM，覆盖受控语义错配基准与仿真、真机上的下游策略学习。
Result: 在受控语义错配基准上，多个被评估的奖励基线即使在简单 pick-and-place 场景也对错误物体操作赋予伪进度，ARS 更好地抑制这类错误，并在仿真策略学习中优于这些基线；在全尺寸工业洗衣机装配线实验室复现在真机多螺钉拧紧任务上，ARS 支持从混合质量离线经验做长时程策略学习。
Conclusion: 结构化的推理与验证能提升通用 VLM 在机器人奖励建模上的可用性，无需额外奖励模型训练即可支撑仿真与真机的策略学习。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Does an Image Determine the Answer? Benchmarking Visual Answerability across Charts and Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Reliable visual question answering requires correct answers when evidence is sufficient and abstention when it is not. We introduce a benchmark that connects complete-question evaluation with explicit evidence for its labels across PlotQA charts, CLEVR rendered scenes, and GQA photographs. Each question groups original and edited images, presented independently; success requires every supported answer and every required abstention to be correct. For chart missing-information labels, executable witnesses establish that admissible complete charts give different answers but identical pixels after masking. Scene labels follow source programs and edits, with a residual-cue analysis for photographs. Across 72,000 responses from six model configurations, the highest observed complete task success rates are 57.0%, 43.5%, and 33.7%, respectively. On charts, the strongest configuration achieves 96.2% per-view decision accuracy, yet 265 of its 835 groups with every decision correct still contain incorrect answers. Evaluating supported answers and necessary abstentions together exposes failures that answerability decisions alone conceal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出视觉问答 (VQA) 可答性基准，把完整问题评测与标签的显式证据绑定：每题配原图与编辑图并独立呈现，答对全部受支持答案且答对全部必要弃答才算成功。在 PlotQA 图表、CLEVR 场景、GQA 照片上跑 72,000 条响应、六种模型配置，最高完整任务成功率仅 57.0%、43.5%、33.7%；图表上最强配置单视角决策准确率 96.2%，但 835 个决策全对的组里仍有 265 个含错误答案。
Motivation: VQA 模型在证据不足时应弃答，但只评可答性决策会掩盖受支持答案答错的情况，且图表缺信息标签缺少可核验的证据形式。
Method: 基准把每题的原图与编辑图分组独立呈现，成功要求所有受支持答案与所有必要弃答同时正确；图表缺信息标签用可执行 witness（executable complete charts 像素经掩码后相同却给出不同答案），场景标签溯源到生成程序与编辑，并对照片做残余线索 (residual-cue) 分析。
Result: 在 PlotQA、CLEVR、GQA 三类上共 72,000 条响应、六种模型配置，最高完整任务成功率分别为 57.0%、43.5%、33.7%。图表上最强配置单视角决策准确率 96.2%，但其 835 个决策全对的组中有 265 个仍含错误答案。
Conclusion: 把受支持答案与必要弃答放在一起评测，会暴露仅看可答性决策时被隐藏的失败；决策准确率高不等于完整任务成功。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SentZero: An Enhanced Sentence-Centric Vision-Language Pretraining for Multi-Task Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language (VL) pretraining using paired chest X-ray (CXR) images and radiology reports has shown strong potential for medical image understanding. However, existing methods often remain dependent on task-specific finetuning because radiology reports are lengthy, clinically dense, and difficult to align with simple zero-shot prompts. Recent sentence-level approaches partially address this limitation using clinical phrases extracted by large language models (LLMs), but they largely overlook the intrinsic characteristics of radiology discourse. In particular, limited positive-pair diversity constrains further gains, while clinically equivalent sentences frequently recur across patients, creating false negatives in contrastive learning. To address these issues, we propose SentZero, an enhanced sentence-centric VL pretraining framework for zero-shot, multi-task CXR analysis. SentZero introduces LLM-based abstract-level sentence structuring and mapping to expand positive-pair diversity, together with an additional loss term to mitigate false negatives. We further introduce sentence-conditioned residual modulation of visual embeddings, enabling visual features to adapt to the semantic characteristics of each input sentence. Across diverse downstream tasks and datasets, SentZero improves zero-shot generalization and outperforms prior multi-task zero-shot methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SentZero 针对胸片 (CXR) 与放射报告的句子级对比预训练，用 LLM 做摘要级句子结构化与映射扩充正样本对多样性，并加一项损失抑制跨患者同义句造成的假阴性，再以句子条件残差调制视觉嵌入。在多个下游任务与数据集上提升零样本泛化，优于先前的多任务零样本方法。
Motivation: 放射报告冗长、临床信息密集，难以与简单零样本提示对齐，导致现有 VL 预训练仍依赖任务特定微调；句子级方法又受限于正样本对多样性不足，且跨患者重复的临床等价句在对比学习中形成假阴性。
Method: SentZero 是句子中心的 VL 预训练框架：用 LLM 对报告做摘要级句子结构化与映射以扩大正样本对，加入额外损失项缓解假阴性，并对视觉嵌入做句子条件的残差调制 (sentence-conditioned residual modulation)，使视觉特征随输入句子语义变化。
Result: 在多样下游任务与数据集上，SentZero 改善零样本泛化，并在多任务零样本设定中优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 把放射话语的句子结构与假阴性问题显式纳入对比预训练，可在不依赖任务微调的前提下提升胸片多任务零样本分析表现。

papers.title: Learn Here, Move Less Elsewhere: Input-Conditioned Plasticity from Retained-Domain Activation Atlases
papers.abstract_en: Task-specific fine-tuning can rewrite a language model's answers beyond the training task, complicating updates that must preserve existing behavior. We introduce ATLAS, which turns retained-domain representations into an input-dependent rule for task adaptation. An activation atlas supplies local reference centers and directional filters to a shared low-rank residual. Target supervision learns the residual, while retained geometry shapes its action throughout training and inference. On Qwen3-8B, ATLAS achieves lower mean retained-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence than all seven published baselines at shared coding-performance requirements, with consistent advantages across multiple training seeds. Structural comparisons identify the contributions of retained reference states and directional conditioning, and answer-level analyses show fewer rewritten mathematical answers and more stable commonsense choices. Experiments spanning five backbones and two retained domains further demonstrate coding gains with reduced retained-output movement. With compact storage and modest decoding overhead, ATLAS provides a practical mechanism for acquiring specialized skills while maintaining continuity in existing responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATLAS 把保留域 (retained domain) 的激活图谱 (activation atlas) 转成随输入变化的适配规则：以局部参考中心和方向滤波器约束共享低秩残差，目标任务监督学残差、保留域几何全程约束其作用。在 Qwen3-8B 上，ATLAS 在相同编码性能要求下对全部七个已发表基线取得更低的保留输出 KL 散度，且跨多个训练种子一致。
Motivation: 任务微调会改写语言模型在训练任务之外的回答，使「更新模型同时保住既有行为」变得困难；需要一种按输入决定改动幅度的适配机制。
Method: ATLAS 用 activation atlas 提供局部参考中心与方向滤波器，作用于一个共享低秩残差 (low-rank residual)；目标任务的监督信号学习该残差，保留域几何在训练与推理全程塑造其作用；并做结构消融比较保留参考状态与方向条件化的贡献，以及答案层面的改写分析。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，ATLAS 在共享编码性能要求下对全部七个已发表基线取得更低的平均保留输出 KL 散度，且跨多个训练种子优势一致；答案层面分析显示被改写的数学答案更少、常识选择更稳定；实验覆盖五个 backbone 与两个保留域，在编码能力提升的同时减少保留输出位移，存储紧凑、解码开销适度。
Conclusion: 用保留域激活几何按输入约束低秩残差的作用，可以在获取专项技能的同时维持既有回答的连续性，且代价可控。

summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，ATLAS 在共享编码性能要求下对全部七个已发表基线取得更低的平均保留输出 KL 散度，且跨多个训练种子优势一致；答案层面分析显示被改写的数学答案更少、常识选择更稳定；实验覆盖五个 backbone 与两个保留域，在编码能力提升的同时减少保留输出位移，存储紧凑、解码开销适度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用保留域激活几何按输入约束低秩残差的作用，可以在获取专项技能的同时维持既有回答的连续性，且代价可控。

papers.title: Causal Routing for Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: LLMs cannot forget the way we delete a file. Strangely, we are asked to remove something that was never put anywhere in particular. What the model took from a piece of text is now smeared across billions of weights. Existing methods rewrite all of them to change one thing, and none of them say which part produced that change. To address this, we introduce Causal Routing for Unlearning (CRU) by asking where the concept is expressed in the model and suppressing only that part. One untrained forward pass over the forget set ranks neurons by how their activations vary. Then, small routing modules on those neurons gate and suppress only the concepts that need to be forgotten. In CRU, the base model is frozen, and any change in behavior is caused only by the gated neurons; hence, why the routing is causal. Due to our parameter efficiency (only ~0.01% as many parameters as the base model), unlearning a concept costs 14 GiB, whereas the baselines require 71 GiB. On TOFU, CRU is indistinguishable from the retained model (p > 0.05, KS test) and is never Pareto-dominated, whereas every compared baseline matches its forgetting on the larger-forget batches only by collapsing utility. On RWKU, it achieves an adversarial-probe recall of 0.052, compared to 0.250 for the strongest baseline, meaning the knowledge is gone, not merely harder to reach. Thus, deciding on the intervention at query time, rather than fixing it beforehand, is the axis along which we argue that unlearning should proceed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRU 用一次未训练的前向传播按激活变化给神经元排序，只在这些神经元上挂小型 routing 模块做门控抑制，基座模型全程冻结，行为变化只能来自被门控的神经元，因此因果可归因。参数量约为基座的 0.01%，遗忘一个概念耗 14 GiB 而基线需 71 GiB；在 TOFU 上与保留模型不可区分（p > 0.05，KS 检验）且从不被 Pareto 支配，在 RWKU 上对抗探针召回 0.052 对最强基线 0.250。
Motivation: LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 现有方法整体重写全部权重，既不指出是哪部分权重产生了改变，也难以在遗忘与保留效用之间取舍，且显存开销大。
Method: Causal Routing for Unlearning (CRU)：对 forget set 做一次未训练前向传播，按激活变化幅度给神经元排序，只在这些神经元上加小型 routing 模块做门控抑制；基座冻结，参数量约为基座的 0.01%，干预在 query time 决定。评测用 TOFU 与 RWKU，含 KS 检验与对抗探针。
Result: 遗忘单个概念耗 14 GiB，基线需 71 GiB；参数量约为基座的 0.01%。TOFU 上与保留模型不可区分（p > 0.05，KS 检验）且从不被 Pareto 支配，而每个对比基线只在更大 forget 批次上以效用崩溃换取同等遗忘。RWKU 上对抗探针召回 0.052，最强基线为 0.250。
Conclusion: 遗忘应在 query time 决定干预位置而非事先固定；只抑制表达该概念的神经元，可以在远低于基线的显存下把知识真正移除而非仅仅更难触及。

papers.title: Deep kernel hedging
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a deep kernel hedging framework that combines the flexibility of deep learning with the structural inductive bias of kernel methods. The hedging functional is restricted to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space whose kernel is parameterized through a neural network embedding of the input features. The framework minimizes a regularized empirical risk under convex loss functions and can accommodate path-dependent information through truncated time-augmented signature features. We derive a generalized representer theorem for the joint hedging problem, reducing the empirical optimization to a finite-dimensional problem. To further reduce the computational cost associated with large kernel matrices, we develop a scalable random Fourier feature approximation and establish convergence guarantees. The random Fourier parameters are sampled once and remain fixed throughout training, while the deep kernel adapts to market data through the learned neural representation. We evaluate the performance of the proposed deep kernel approach on both synthetic and real data and compare it with standard kernel methods and classical deep hedging architectures. Numerical results indicate competitive and robust hedging performance, particularly in low-data regimes, which highlights the benefits of combining expressive neural representations with the inductive bias of kernel methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 deep kernel hedging：把对冲泛函限制在由神经网络参数化核的 RKHS 中，用广义 representer 定理把经验风险最小化化为有限维问题，再用固定采样的随机 Fourier 特征近似降低大核矩阵开销。在合成与真实数据上对比标准核方法与经典 deep hedging 架构，数值结果在低数据 regime 下表现出有竞争力且稳健的对冲性能。
Motivation: deep hedging 缺少核方法的结构归纳偏置，而纯核方法在高维特征与路径依赖信息下表达力和计算规模受限。
Method: 对冲泛函限制在 RKHS，核由输入特征的神经网络嵌入参数化；在凸损失下最小化正则化经验风险，并通过截断的 time-augmented signature features 纳入路径依赖信息；推导联合对冲问题的广义 representer 定理化为有限维优化，再用随机 Fourier 特征近似（参数一次采样、训练中固定）降低大核矩阵开销并给出收敛保证。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据上与标准核方法及经典 deep hedging 架构对比，数值结果显示对冲表现有竞争力且稳健，尤其在低数据 regime 下。
Conclusion: 把表达性强的神经表示与核方法的归纳偏置结合，在数据稀缺时对冲效果更好，且随机 Fourier 近似可控制大核矩阵的计算成本。

papers.title: VL-AcneSeg: A Vision-Language Framework for Region-Aware Acne Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Acne assessment is crucial for clinical decision-making, yet traditional grading and counting are subjective and fail to account for lesion size. While area-based assessment has emerged as a promising alternative, acne segmentation has continued to rely on general-purpose architectures. To address this gap, we propose VL-AcneSeg, a multimodal framework for acne lesion segmentation that leverages CLIP and region-level text prompts to incorporate spatial priors, enabling lesions to be localized across the whole face. Because region-level prompts indicate which facial areas contain lesions, we report a single global prompt, which requires no such information, as our primary setting. On our internal clinical dataset, VL-AcneSeg achieves a Dice score of 0.5082 and an IoU of 0.3407 under this protocol, the highest among all compared methods, including recent vision-language segmentation methods that are themselves given region-level prompts; region-level prompting raises these to 0.5296 and 0.3602. Moreover, lesion area measurements derived from our segmentation correlate with IGA scores at a level comparable to expert annotations (Pearson r = 0.719 versus 0.658). Notably, our framework maintains consistent performance across external validation datasets, performing reliably even on uncontrolled smartphone images without requiring additional training or fine-tuning. By pairing a protocol that requires no lesion-location information with area-based severity estimation, this work provides a foundation for objective acne assessment outside the clinic. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/sukjuoh/VL-AcneSeg
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VL-AcneSeg 用 CLIP 加区域级文本提示 (region-level text prompts) 把面部空间先验引入痤疮病灶分割，在只需单一全局提示（不提供病灶位置信息）的主协议下，内部临床数据集上 Dice 0.5082、IoU 0.3407，为所比较方法中最高；加入区域提示后升至 0.5296 与 0.3602。
Motivation: 痤疮分级与计数主观且不考虑病灶面积，面积化评估需要分割，但现有分割仍依赖通用架构，缺少面向面部区域的空间先验。
Method: 多模态框架 VL-AcneSeg：以 CLIP 为骨干，配合区域级文本提示注入空间先验以定位全脸病灶；主协议只用单一全局提示（不提供病灶位置信息），区域提示作为对照设置；分割结果再换算病灶面积与 IGA 评分关联。
Result: 内部临床数据集主协议（全局提示）Dice 0.5082、IoU 0.3407，为所有对比方法（含本身获得区域提示的视觉-语言分割方法）中最高；区域提示下 Dice 0.5296、IoU 0.3602；由分割导出的病灶面积与 IGA 评分的 Pearson r = 0.719，专家标注为 0.658；在外部验证集（含无受控智能手机图像）上无需额外训练或微调即保持一致性能。
Conclusion: 无需病灶位置信息的全局提示协议加上面积化严重度估计，足以支撑诊室外的客观痤疮评估，且跨数据集与拍摄条件稳定。

papers.title: Precise Editing and Flexible Referencing for Interactable Worlds
papers.abstract_en: We present EditWorld, a video world model for precise editing and flexible referencing in interactable worlds. Existing video world models primarily focus on navigation, letting users explore generated worlds but offering limited control over how existing world content is modified. EditWorld extends world modeling from exploration to precise modification by streaming editing instructions and reference images during autoregressive generation. To support these capabilities, EditWorld introduces Gated Causal Attention for temporally varying editing conditions and reference images, together with a Sparse Context mechanism that maintains a bounded historical context for long-horizon inference. We further adopt joint autoregressive and bidirectional training with annealed self-resampling, and construct a dedicated data synthesis and annotation pipeline that provides supervision for world editing. We also present WBench-Editing to systematically evaluate streaming world editing capabilities. EditWorld achieves the best overall performance on WBench-Editing with an overall score of 73.8 and an editing score of 80.0, substantially outperforming existing methods on editing-related metrics. https://github.com/leoisufa/EditWorld
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EditWorld 把视频世界模型从只能导航扩展到可在自回归生成过程中流式接收编辑指令与参考图像做精确修改，用 Gated Causal Attention 处理时变编辑条件、Sparse Context 维持有界历史上下文以支持长时程推理，并配一套数据合成与标注管线提供世界编辑监督。在自建的 WBench-Editing 基准上取得总体分 73.8、编辑分 80.0，在编辑相关指标上大幅超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要面向导航与探索，用户能逛生成的世界，却几乎无法控制已有世界内容如何被修改。
Method: 在自回归生成中流式注入编辑指令与参考图像；Gated Causal Attention 对时变编辑条件与参考图做门控，Sparse Context 机制为长时程推理维持有界历史上下文；训练采用自回归与双向联合训练加退火式自重采样 (annealed self-resampling)，并构建专用数据合成与标注管线提供监督。
Result: 在自建 WBench-Editing 基准上总体分 73.8、编辑分 80.0，取得最佳总体表现，并在编辑相关指标上大幅超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 把世界建模从探索推进到精确修改是可行的，流式编辑条件加受控历史上下文是支撑可交互世界编辑的路径，WBench-Editing 被作为该能力的系统评测基准。

papers.title: Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models point toward general-purpose robotic intelligence by unifying perception, instruction, and control. Despite impressive progress, existing VLA models often adapt poorly due to \emph{tri-modal misalignment} among vision, language, and action, which weakens action grounding and hurts generalization and fine-tuning efficiency. In this work, we present Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT), a novel framework that explicitly enforces tri-modal alignment through a dedicated alignment loss, bridging the representational gap across modalities and enhancing task adaptation. While prior research has predominantly emphasized bi-modal vision--language alignment, we systematically formalize and study tri-modal alignment in VLA models, and provide both ablations and analysis to isolate its role in improving adaptation and robustness. To further accelerate deployment, we adopt a flow-matching objective, enabling substantially fewer inference steps than diffusion-based policies while maintaining accuracy. Theoretically, we establish a quantitative connection between the tri-modal alignment gap and the optimization tightness of flow matching; empirically, experiments on the extensive benchmark show that AGFT achieves superior success rates and lower inference latency compared to SOTA baselines, underscoring tri-modal alignment as a key ingredient for scaling robust VLA manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AGFT 用专门的三模态对齐损失 (tri-modal alignment loss) 强制视觉、语言、动作表征对齐，并把 flow matching 目标接入 VLA 策略学习，使推理步数远少于 diffusion 策略而保持精度。在大规模基准上，AGFT 相对 SOTA 基线取得更高成功率与更低推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型存在视觉-语言-动作三模态错位 (tri-modal misalignment)，削弱动作 grounding，导致泛化与微调效率差；此前工作主要只处理视觉-语言双模态对齐。
Method: 提出 Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT)：加入专门的对齐损失桥接三模态表征差距，形式化研究三模态对齐并做消融分析以分离其作用；训练采用 flow matching 目标替代 diffusion 策略以减少推理步数；理论上建立三模态对齐间隙与 flow matching 优化紧度之间的定量联系。
Result: 在大规模基准上，AGFT 相对 SOTA 基线取得更高成功率和更低推理延迟；flow matching 使推理步数显著少于 diffusion 策略且保持精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 三模态对齐是扩展鲁棒 VLA 操作的关键要素，且可与 flow matching 结合在保持精度的同时降低推理延迟。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出 Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT)：加入专门的对齐损失桥接三模态表征差距，形式化研究三模态对齐并做消融分析以分离其作用；训练采用 flow matching 目标替代 diffusion 策略以减少推理步数；理论上建立三模态对齐间隙与 flow matching 优化紧度之间的定量联系。
summary_sections.result: 在大规模基准上，AGFT 相对 SOTA 基线取得更高成功率和更低推理延迟；flow matching 使推理步数显著少于 diffusion 策略且保持精度；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 三模态对齐是扩展鲁棒 VLA 操作的关键要素，且可与 flow matching 结合在保持精度的同时降低推理延迟。

papers.title: PhysioTRACE: Provenance-Aware Stress Tests for Physiological Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Physiological foundation models encode how a signal was recorded alongside the physiology it reflects. When recording conditions are associated with diagnosis, this acquisition provenance can become a shortcut, yet the usual evidence, shifted transfer and provenance decodability, does not show whether a predictor uses it. We introduce PhysioTRACE, a four-axis behavioral audit for frozen encoders that separates what a probe can decode from what a fixed task head relies on. Recover scores how decodable provenance is; Stress reverses only the provenance-target association on the same held-out records; Intervene removes a train-localized provenance component; and Verify certifies that removal only if it beats matched random projections within a declared utility margin. Each audit thus ends in one of three verdicts: no reliance, or reliance with the remedy certified or refused. Across EEG and ECG, five training objectives, and five frozen foundation models, the relation between Recover's calibrated score and out-of-distribution utility changes sign between datasets, so neither can stand in for a reliance test. On paired EEG views where the shortcut is known by construction, the audit detects it (the exposed head loses about 0.2 AUROC when the association is reversed, while a control head is unaffected) and certifies removal of a rank-two component that restores control-level behavior without measurable utility loss, for both encoder objectives tested. On real ECG device metadata it returns all three verdicts: it certifies a remedy that removes 91% of one model's excess vulnerability, finds no reliance where device and diagnosis are barely associated, and refuses the remedy for a second model whose localized direction also carries task signal. Robustness to how inputs were recorded therefore needs a behavioral test, and PhysioTRACE provides one that can pass, fail, or refuse a remedy.
papers.comment: Main text: 10 pages, 4 figures. Appendix: 31 pages with full protocol details, per-seed results, and sensitivity analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysioTRACE 给冻结的生理基础模型编码器做四轴行为审计，把「探针能解码出多少采集来源」与「固定任务头是否真的依赖来源捷径」分开，并以 Recover、Stress、Intervene、Verify 四步给出无依赖、修复获认证或修复被拒绝三种裁决。在 EEG 与 ECG、五种训练目标、五个冻结模型上，Recover 校准分与分布外效用的关联在两个数据集间变号；已知捷径的配对 EEG 上暴露头在关联反转后 AUROC 掉约 0.2 而对照头不受影响，认证移除一个秩二分量即恢复对照水平且无可测效用损失；真实 ECG 设备元数据上认证移除某模型 91% 的超额脆弱性、在设备与诊断弱关联处判无依赖、并因第二模型的定位方向同时携带任务信号而拒绝修复。
Motivation: 生理基础模型会把信号的采集条件（provenance）与生理内容一起编码，当采集条件与诊断相关时就形成捷径；而常用的证据——分布外迁移下降与来源可解码性——只能说明来源可被探针读出，不能说明预测器在用它。
Method: 对冻结编码器做四轴行为审计：Recover 度量来源的可解码程度；Stress 在同一批留出记录上仅反转来源与目标的关联；Intervene 移除训练阶段定位到的来源分量；Verify 要求该移除优于匹配的随机投影且落在声明的效用裕度内才认证。审计在 EEG 与 ECG、五种训练目标、五个冻结基础模型上运行，每步输出三种裁决之一。
Result: Recover 校准分与分布外效用的关联在 EEG 与 ECG 之间变号，二者都不能替代依赖性检验。配对 EEG 视图（捷径按构造已知）中，关联反转后暴露头 AUROC 下降约 0.2 而对照头不受影响，审计认证移除一个秩二分量即可恢复对照水平且无可测效用损失，两个被测编码器目标均如此。真实 ECG 设备元数据上返回全部三种裁决：认证移除某模型 91% 的超额脆弱性，在设备与诊断基本无关处判无依赖，对第二个模型因定位方向同时携带任务信号而拒绝修复。
Conclusion: 输入录制方式的稳健性必须用行为测试判定，而不是靠可解码性或迁移证据；PhysioTRACE 提供了一个可通过、可失败、也可拒绝修复方案的测试。

papers.title: CoDeL: Co-Evolutionary Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM-based Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly rely on external tools and content, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI). This threat has motivated a wide range of defenses, among which training-based defenses are often regarded as most reliable. However, existing training-based defenses are typically optimized on a static distribution of explicit injections. They learn surface-form cues rather than the boundary between serving the user and obeying an injected objective, and therefore fail when malicious intent is folded into a plausible workflow and deferred for several turns. We present CoDeL, a defense that hardens agent against an attack distribution it reshapes as it trains. The defender is updated each round via LoRA-based GDPO under a decoupled reward over safety, task progress, and format compliance, so refusing injections and completing the user's task jointly define fitness. To keep supplying it with the failures worth learning from, a co-evolving prober searches over injection rounds, attack methods, and payloads for injections that still penetrate the current defender, guided jointly by attack success and attack latency so that it preferentially mines breaches the defender notices too late. Each defender update invalidates part of the attack population and forces the next round onto a new frontier, turning the defender's own failures into a moving curriculum. Extensive experiments on three IPI benchmarks, nine baselines, and two base models show that CoDeL reduces attack success rate (ASR) by 88.5% and outperforms other baselines largely (+38.0%). Codes are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDeL 针对 LLM agent 的间接提示注入 (indirect prompt injection)，用共同进化的防御把攻击分布随训练一起重塑：每轮以 LoRA 上的 GDPO 配合安全、任务进度、格式合规三项解耦奖励更新防御器，同时由 prober 在注入轮次、攻击方式与载荷上搜索仍能穿透当前防御器的注入。在三个 IPI benchmark、九个基线、两个基座模型上，ASR 相对下降 88.5%，比其他基线高出 38.0%。
Motivation: 现有基于训练的 IPI 防御在静态的显式注入分布上优化，学到的是表层形式线索，而非服务用户与服从注入目标之间的边界，因此在恶意意图被折入合理工作流并延迟数轮时失效。
Method: 防御器每轮用 LoRA-based GDPO 更新，奖励在 safety、task progress、format compliance 上解耦，使拒绝注入与完成用户任务共同构成 fitness；共同进化的 prober 在注入轮次、攻击方法与载荷上搜索仍能穿透当前防御器的注入，由 attack success 与 attack latency 联合引导，优先挖掘防御器察觉过晚的突破。
Result: 在三个 IPI benchmark、九个基线、两个基座模型上的实验中，CoDeL 使攻击成功率 (ASR) 降低 88.5%，并大幅领先其他基线 38.0%。
Conclusion: 把防御器自身的失败当作移动课程、让攻击分布随训练共同进化，可以在合理工作流与延迟注入下同时保住拒绝注入和任务完成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?
papers.abstract_en: Does structured mathematical knowledge help LLMs prove theorems in Lean 4? If so, for which models, and does the answer vary by problem? Formal libraries such as Mathlib encode 285,000+ verified theorems with syntactic dependencies, but the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery (analogies, generalizations, cross-domain bridges) remains implicit. We introduce MathAgent, which builds this layer as a knowledge graph, MathKG, and uses it to augment LLM theorem provers. MathKG connects 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions by 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred via LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. We run a controlled ablation across four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) and five models: Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, on miniF2F, plus PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. (i) Specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, and a specialized 8B model beats a $4\times$ larger general one by 29-35 points, while no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. (ii) Augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, with the specialized model gaining more relative to its general base at every scale. (iii) Yet the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, a complementarity effect that strengthens on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). These results motivate adaptive strategies that select augmentation by model capability and problem. Code, data, and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MathAgent：用 LLM 关系抽取把 Mathlib 的语义知识建成知识图谱 MathKG，再作为上下文增强 Lean 4 定理证明器。受控消融显示 Lean 微调带来 33–38 个百分点的解题率提升，而任何增强模式都不超过 3 个百分点；知识图谱上下文帮助小模型却损害大模型，但按题选最优模式的 oracle 比无增强多解 6%–58%。
Motivation: Mathlib 有 285,000+ 条带语法依赖的已验证定理，但数学家依赖的语义层（类比、推广、跨领域桥梁）仍是隐式的，LLM 证明器无法利用；结构化知识到底在何种模型与题目上有用尚无受控答案。
Method: 构建 MathKG：以已验证 Mathlib 声明为锚，用 LLM 关系抽取连接 364 条定理与定义、产生 9,434 条带类型语义边；在四种增强模式（无上下文、知识图谱上下文、Mathlib 检索、两者兼用）上做受控消融，覆盖五个模型：Qwen3-8B/32B、其 Lean 专用衍生版 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B、Claude Sonnet 4.6，主测 miniF2F，Sonnet 另测 PutnamBench 与 MathOlympiadBench。
Result: Lean 微调在每种模式下都提升 33–38 个百分点解题率；专用 8B 模型比大 4 倍的通用模型高 29–35 个百分点；任何增强模式对解题率的提升都不超过 3 个百分点。知识图谱上下文帮助小模型但损害大模型，专用模型在各规模上相对其通用基座增益更大。按题选最优模式的 oracle 比无增强证明器多解 6%–58%，在更难的 PutnamBench 上多解 32%。
Conclusion: 结构化知识增强的作用由模型能力与题目共同决定：应按模型规模与题目自适应选择增强模式，而非统一施加；专用化本身远强于任何增强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Escaping Local Views: Discovering Latent Concepts for Interpretable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Efficient cooperation is challenging due to the usual partial observability of each agent in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Recurrent networks encode local interaction histories, but their hidden representations provide limited insight into the information underlying individual decisions. To address these challenges, we propose a novel interpretable framework, called escaping local views (ELV), which introduces semantically structured latent concepts to render policy decisions transparent. Specifically, each agent extracts low-dimensional semantic concepts from its local observation and action-observation trajectory. These concepts are jointly encoded into a contextual latent variable via a variational autoencoder (VAE), which builds a bridge between local views and global semantics. To explicitly model the decision of each agent, we employ a dual-path attention mechanism in which one module estimates the salience of individual concepts relative to the global context, while the other captures higher-order cooperative patterns with pairwise concept interactions. Furthermore, we incorporate a concept prediction module that derives an intrinsic reward from next-concept prediction errors, which incentivizes agents to explore regions of semantic novelty. Experiments in multiple environments verify that ELV not only achieves competitive performance but also explicitly provides how agents reason about their decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多智能体强化学习可解释框架 ELV：每个智能体从局部观测与动作-观测轨迹中抽取低维语义概念，经 VAE 联合成上下文隐变量，再用双路注意力与概念预测内在奖励驱动策略。在多个环境中取得竞争性表现，并显式给出智能体的决策推理过程。
Motivation: 多智能体合作中各智能体只能局部观测，循环网络的隐表示难以解释单个决策背后的信息，合作效率与可解释性同时受限。
Method: ELV 从局部观测和动作-观测轨迹提取低维语义概念，用变分自编码器 (VAE) 将其编码为连接局部视角与全局语义的上下文隐变量；双路注意力一路估计各概念相对全局上下文的显著性，另一路建模概念两两交互的高阶合作模式；概念预测模块以下一概念预测误差构造内在奖励，激励探索语义新颖区域。
Result: 在多个环境中实验验证 ELV 取得竞争性表现，并显式展示智能体如何推理其决策。
Conclusion: 把局部观测映射为结构化语义概念并显式建模概念间交互，可以在保持合作性能的同时让多智能体策略决策透明。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: ELV 从局部观测和动作-观测轨迹提取低维语义概念，用变分自编码器 (VAE) 将其编码为连接局部视角与全局语义的上下文隐变量；双路注意力一路估计各概念相对全局上下文的显著性，另一路建模概念两两交互的高阶合作模式；概念预测模块以下一概念预测误差构造内在奖励，激励探索语义新颖区域。
summary_sections.result: 在多个环境中实验验证 ELV 取得竞争性表现，并显式展示智能体如何推理其决策。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把局部观测映射为结构化语义概念并显式建模概念间交互，可以在保持合作性能的同时让多智能体策略决策透明。

papers.title: Understanding Generalization Requires Universal Induction
papers.abstract_en: Classical statistical theory is insufficient to explain the successes of general-purpose AI models, because it depends on handcrafted inductive biases that it cannot justify. No Free Lunch (NFL) theorems force any learner that beats chance on some environments to underperform on others. We might hope that past experience informs which environments to expect, but NFL applies equally to meta-learning. Thus, any method that makes meaningful predictions necessarily begins with an inductive bias external to the data. Choosing to bias toward short programs yields Solomonoff induction (SI), whose performance is competitive against all computable learners - albeit up to "constants" that become large when comparing against specialized methods that exploit background information. We therefore relativize SI to an information vantage point, biasing toward short programs with access to all preexisting information. This reframes the inductive bias: instead of seeking some absolute notion of simplicity, we favor accessibility with respect to our vantage point. An algorithm can only outpredict the relativized SI to the extent that its code contains additional information about the data, and no algorithm can generate such information. While SI is incomputable and hence not a practical algorithm, it provides a formal optimum for inference in the limit of infinite compute, and there is evidence to suggest that frontier AI systems roughly approximate it. Thus, the only known answer to meta-NFL is rooted in algorithmic information theory, which we should expect to play a fundamental role in explaining the generalization behavior of modern (and future) AI systems.
papers.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证经典统计学习理论无法解释通用 AI 的泛化，因为 No Free Lunch 定理连元学习也一并否决，任何超越随机的预测都必须携带数据之外的归纳偏置。作者把 Solomonoff induction (SI) 相对化到一个信息视角 (information vantage point)：偏置朝向能访问全部既有信息的短程序，于是任何算法只有在其代码含有关于数据的额外信息时才能胜过该相对化 SI，而这种信息无法凭空生成。
Motivation: 经典统计理论依赖无法自证的手工归纳偏置，NFL 定理又说明在某些环境上胜出必在另一些环境上落后，连用过往经验指导元学习也逃不掉，通用模型为何成功因此缺少形式化解释。
Method: 以算法信息论为框架：先由 NFL 与 meta-NFL 排除纯数据驱动的偏置来源，再取短程序偏置得到 Solomonoff induction，随后将其相对化为对可访问全部既有信息的短程序的偏置，把“简单性”重述为相对于视角的可访问性。
Result: SI 的性能对一切可计算学习者具有竞争力，但比较专用方法时“常数”会变得很大；SI 本身不可计算，只能作为无限算力下推断的形式最优解，且有证据表明前沿 AI 系统大致逼近它。
Conclusion: meta-NFL 唯一已知的答案植根于算法信息论，该理论应在解释现代与未来 AI 系统泛化行为中扮演基础角色。

papers.title: ZonoGPT: Towards An Abstract Domain for Verifying Large GPT Models
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models are widely used for reasoning, coding, and multimodal agentic tasks. To provide formal assurance of desirable behaviors, such as robustness, safety, and fairness, neural network verification techniques prove required properties and provide auditable guarantees before deployment. However, prior work remains limited to small or restricted Transformers, and maintaining precision across deep models remains challenging. In this work, we introduce ZonoGPT, an abstract domain for verifying large transformers that maintains a space complexity independent of network depth. ZonoGPT uses a structured zonotope and a generator reduction mechanism to efficiently preserve correlations. To maintain precision, it introduces block-specific fused transformations for Attention and LayerNorm that retain feature relations, along with an affine transform for GELU that preserves generator relations. These mechanisms enable \tool{} to be the first approach to verify standard architectures, scaling to official HuggingFace models up to GPT-2 Medium (24 blocks, 300M+ parameters) and successfully verifying 1,339 instances across text and vision tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZonoGPT 是一个用于验证大型 Transformer 的抽象域 (abstract domain)，空间复杂度与网络深度无关，靠结构化 zonotope 与 generator reduction 保持相关性，并用 Attention/LayerNorm 的 block 级融合变换和 GELU 的仿射变换维持精度。它是首个能验证标准架构的方法，扩展到官方 HuggingFace 的 GPT-2 Medium（24 blocks、300M+ 参数），在文本与视觉任务上成功验证 1,339 个实例。
Motivation: 现有神经网络验证方法只能处理小型或受限 Transformer，且在深层模型上难以同时保持精度与可扩展性，无法为部署前的鲁棒性、安全性、公平性提供可审计保证。
Method: 提出结构化 zonotope 加 generator reduction 机制以高效保留相关性；为 Attention 与 LayerNorm 引入 block-specific fused transformations 保留特征关系，为 GELU 引入仿射变换保留 generator 关系；空间复杂度与网络深度无关。
Result: 首个可验证标准架构的验证方法，扩展到官方 HuggingFace 模型 GPT-2 Medium（24 blocks、300M+ 参数），在文本与视觉任务上成功验证 1,339 个实例。
Conclusion: 通过深度无关的空间复杂度与保留相关性的变换设计，大型标准 Transformer 的形式化验证是可行的，可给出部署前的可审计保证。

papers.title: SPACE-LoRA: Allocating Activation-Subspace Protection for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: This study addresses the catastrophic forgetting problem that occurs when sequentially learning successive tasks using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) from a lifelong learning perspective. While existing approaches have primarily constrained parameter updates or learning subspaces to reduce interference with past knowledge, they have not fully considered additive interference. This occurs when a newly added residual adapter on top of a fixed past model generates non-zero responses along input directions important for old tasks, thereby altering previous predictions. To this end, we propose Subspace Protection with Allocated Capacity for Efficient Continual Adaptation (SPACE-LoRA). SPACE-LoRA directly suppresses the responses of the new residual branch along input activation directions that are important for old tasks and adaptively determines the protection coverage for each module based on past-task sensitivity estimated via a common Fisher sensitivity-based coverage target. Under a fixed LoRA rank, this approach adaptively adjusts module-specific protection coverage while suppressing interference along input directions sensitive to old tasks. We assess the effectiveness of activation-subspace protection in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and examine the role of sensitivity-guided protection in continual learning across diverse tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPACE-LoRA-7864.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPACE-LoRA 针对 LoRA 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，指出新增残差适配器会在旧任务重要的输入激活方向上产生非零响应（加性干扰），从而改变旧预测。它直接压制新分支在这些方向上的响应，并用基于 Fisher 敏感度的统一覆盖目标为每个模块自适应分配保护范围，在固定 LoRA rank 下调节各模块的保护覆盖。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要约束参数更新或学习子空间以减少对旧知识的干扰，但未充分处理加性干扰：叠加在固定旧模型之上的新残差适配器会在旧任务重要的输入方向上产生非零响应，改变原有预测。
Method: SPACE-LoRA（Subspace Protection with Allocated Capacity for Efficient Continual Adaptation）直接抑制新增残差分支在旧任务重要输入激活方向上的响应；保护覆盖范围按模块自适应确定，依据基于统一 Fisher 敏感度的覆盖目标估计各模块的过去任务敏感度，在固定 LoRA rank 下分配模块级保护容量。
Result: 在多样任务上评估激活子空间保护对缓解灾难性遗忘的作用，以及敏感度引导的保护在持续学习中的角色；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 在固定 LoRA rank 下，按各模块过去任务的 Fisher 敏感度自适应分配激活子空间保护覆盖，可抑制新适配器的加性干扰，从而缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: Modeling Whole-Slide Images as Dynamic Tumor Microenvironment Fields
papers.abstract_en: Due to the gigapixel-scale nature of whole-slide images (WSIs), weakly supervised WSI analysis is commonly formulated as a multiple instance learning (MIL) problem, where patch-level features are aggregated into slide-level representations. However, diagnostic and prognostic evidence often arises from spatially coherent tumor microenvironment regions and their interactions, rather than isolated patches alone. Existing patch-level or static region-based methods usually overlook how tissue regions should be adaptively formed and subsequently evolved through microenvironment interactions across heterogeneous boundaries. In this paper, we propose Concept-Guided Tumor Microenvironment Evolution (TMEvolve), a reaction-diffusion-inspired framework that models WSIs as latent tumor microenvironment fields over discrete patch graphs. TMEvolve instantiates this view as a learnable graph-discretized evolution process over patch neighborhoods. It first forms adaptive soft tissue regions as coherent microenvironment units, then performs pseudo-time evolution through two complementary local dynamics: intra-region diffusion, which stabilizes latent states within coherent tissue compartments, and concept-guided boundary flux, which propagates visual feature signals and language-derived concept signals across heterogeneous region interfaces. The evolved microenvironment regions are finally aggregated for slide-level prediction. We evaluate TMEvolve on six datasets across three weakly supervised WSI tasks: survival prediction, gene expression prediction, and histological subtype classification. TMEvolve consistently improves over representative MIL methods, pathology foundation models, and concept-guided baselines. Ablation studies and visualizations further support the effectiveness and interpretability of TMEvolve, highlighting the value of dynamic region modeling and boundary interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TMEvolve 把全切片图像 (WSI) 建模成离散 patch 图上的潜在肿瘤微环境场，先自适应聚出软组织区域，再用区域内扩散与概念引导的边界通量做伪时间演化，最后聚合做切片级预测。在六个数据集的三项弱监督 WSI 任务（生存、基因表达、组织学亚型分类）上一致优于代表性 MIL 方法、病理基础模型与概念引导基线。
Motivation: WSI 吉像素尺度使弱监督分析退化为 MIL，但诊断与预后证据来自空间连贯的微环境区域及其跨边界相互作用；现有 patch 级或静态区域方法忽略区域如何自适应形成、并随微环境相互作用演化。
Method: 提出 Concept-Guided Tumor Microenvironment Evolution (TMEvolve)，反应-扩散启发的框架：在 patch 邻域图上做可学习的图离散演化，先形成自适应软组织区域，再执行两条局部动力学——区域内扩散 (intra-region diffusion) 稳定连贯组织区内的潜在状态，概念引导边界通量 (concept-guided boundary flux) 跨异质区域界面传播视觉特征与语言导出的概念信号，演化后聚合做切片级预测。
Result: 在六个数据集、三项弱监督 WSI 任务（生存预测、基因表达预测、组织学亚型分类）上一致优于代表性 MIL 方法、病理基础模型与概念引导基线；消融实验与可视化支持其有效性与可解释性。
Conclusion: 动态区域建模加边界相互作用是 WSI 弱监督预测的关键，反应-扩散式的伪时间演化能同时提升性能与可解释性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CORTEX: Learning to Share and Specialize in Dense Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are trained on heterogeneous data mixtures, where different knowledge domains require both shared knowledge and specialization. Existing modular approaches typically impose explicit components or discover modules through interpretability analysis after training. In this work, we propose CORTEX, a learning dynamics-inspired framework that learns internal modularization within dense language models. CORTEX partitions trainable matrices into parameter groups and learns module assignments from domain-conditioned gradient and cross-domain gradient similarity. We introduce the selective lesion score and module-domain mutual information to characterize the target-domain lesion effects and alignment, and analyze how module assignment affects the trade-off between assignment bias and update magnitude. Experiments with 160M, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-32B backbone models show that CORTEX achieves the highest synthetic-domain exact match and largest average perplexity reduction, while remaining competitive on real-domain evaluations and forming identifiable modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORTEX 在稠密语言模型内部学出模块化：把可训练矩阵切成参数组，用域条件梯度与跨域梯度相似度决定模块归属，并以 selective lesion score 和 module-domain mutual information 刻画模块与域的对应。在 160M、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B 上，它取得最高的合成域 exact match 与最大的平均困惑度下降，同时在真实域评测中保持竞争力并形成可识别模块。
Motivation: 稠密 LLM 在异构数据上训练时需要共享知识与域特化，但现有模块化方案要么依赖显式组件，要么靠训练后的可解释性分析事后发现模块，缺少在训练中直接学出内部模块的机制。
Method: CORTEX 把可训练矩阵划分为参数组，依据域条件梯度与跨域梯度相似度学习模块分配；引入 selective lesion score 与 module-domain mutual information 度量目标域的 lesion 效应与对齐程度，并分析模块分配在 assignment bias 与 update magnitude 之间的权衡。
Result: 在 160M、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B 三种骨干模型上，CORTEX 取得最高的合成域 exact match 和最大的平均 perplexity reduction，在真实域评测上保持竞争力，并形成可识别的模块。
Conclusion: 学习动态驱动的内部模块化可以在不加显式组件的前提下，让稠密语言模型同时获得共享与特化，并产出可识别的模块结构。

papers.title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of large language model (LLM) post-training for transferring the reasoning capability of a strong teacher LLM to a weaker student LLM. OPD trains the student by minimizing the reverse KL divergence between the teacher and the student via rollouts generated by the student's policy. However, estimating the gradient of the reverse KL divergence in OPD remains a challenge. Using only the sampled token from the student-generated rollout is computationally cheap but provides limited distributional supervision, which will degrade accuracy. In addition, using the full vocabulary provides complete distributional supervision but is computationally expensive. Therefore, recent works propose Top-$k$ OPD (TK-OPD) that use selected top-$k$ tokens, which provides richer distributional supervision than sampled-token estimation at substantially lower computational cost than full-vocabulary estimation. Unfortunately, using only the selected top-$k$ tokens induces bias, leading to accuracy degradation, as the probability mass outside the selected top-$k$ tokens is discarded. To address the bias of TK-OPD, we propose Tail-Corrected Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD). It preserves the advantages of TK-OPD, including rich distributional supervision and low computational cost, while providing an unbiased estimator of the gradient of the reverse KL divergence. The key insight of TT-OPD is to use not only the selected top-$k$ tokens, but also the sampled token from the student-generated rollout, thereby recovering the discarded probability mass in expectation, avoiding the bias. Experimental results demonstrate that TT-OPD significantly outperforms other tested OPD variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Top-k on-policy distillation (TK-OPD) 因丢弃 top-k 之外的概率质量而使 reverse KL 梯度估计有偏、精度下降；TT-OPD 在选中的 top-k token 之外再加入学生 rollout 中实际采样的 token，期望上恢复被丢弃的质量，从而得到无偏估计器，同时保留 TK-OPD 的分布监督与低计算成本。实验中 TT-OPD 显著优于所测试的其他 OPD 变体。
Motivation: OPD 用学生 rollout 上的 reverse KL 把强教师推理能力蒸馏给弱学生，但其梯度估计两难：只用采样 token 便宜却监督信号稀疏、掉精度；用全词表监督完整却计算昂贵。
Method: 提出 Tail-Corrected Top-k On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD)：在 TK-OPD 选中的 top-k token 基础上，额外纳入学生生成 rollout 中采样到的 token，期望意义上补回被丢弃的概率质量，构造 reverse KL 梯度的无偏估计。
Result: 实验结果显示 TT-OPD 显著优于其他被测试的 OPD 变体；相对 TK-OPD 消除因丢弃 top-k 之外概率质量导致的估计偏差与精度下降，同时保持比全词表估计低得多的计算成本。
Conclusion: top-k 截断带来的偏差可以用采样 token 做尾部修正来消除，因此分布监督的丰富度与计算开销不必在 OPD 中二选一。

papers.title: Livin' on a Prior: Likelihood Score Approximation for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have found great success as data-driven methods of solving inverse problems. Two popular approaches work either by combining a pretrained generative prior with a known degradation model, or by training a conditional generative model directly from paired data. We target a setting that spans both regimes: unknown degradations can be learned from few paired examples, while known degradations can be learned from self-generated samples. We introduce Likelihood Score Approximation (LSA), a generative framework that keeps a pretrained unconditional model fixed and learns an observation-conditioned model that approximates the likelihood score from paired samples. Within a conditional stochastic-interpolant framework, LSA can be trained in either score or velocity coordinates, independently of the unconditional model's native parameterization, and supports both deterministic and stochastic sampling. We further show empirically that the prior model can be swapped post-training while keeping the same LSA model. Across speech and image inverse problems, LSA operates effectively even at roughly 0.01% of the full training dataset. On the ImageNet-256 benchmark it achieves competitive or better restoration quality than strong posterior-sampling baselines while requiring up to several orders of magnitude fewer network evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Likelihood Score Approximation (LSA)：冻结预训练无条件生成先验，仅从少量成对样本学一个观测条件模型来近似似然分数，从而把「已知退化用自生成样本、未知退化用少量配对数据」两种逆问题求解范式统一起来。在语音与图像逆问题上，LSA 用约 0.01% 的完整训练数据即可有效工作，在 ImageNet-256 上达到与强后验采样基线相当或更好的复原质量，同时网络评估次数减少最多几个数量级。
Motivation: 生成式逆问题求解分两条路：预训练先验加已知退化模型，或用成对数据直接训条件生成模型；前者要求退化已知，后者要求大量配对数据，覆盖「退化未知且配对样本极少」的中间场景的方法缺失。
Method: LSA 冻结预训练无条件模型，只训练一个观测条件模型去近似似然分数 (likelihood score)；训练置于条件随机插值 (conditional stochastic-interpolant) 框架内，可在 score 或 velocity 坐标下进行，与无条件模型自身的参数化无关，并支持确定性与随机两种采样方式。训练后可替换先验模型而复用同一个 LSA 模型。
Result: 在语音与图像逆问题上，LSA 在约为完整训练数据集 0.01% 的数据量下仍有效运行；在 ImageNet-256 基准上，复原质量与强后验采样 (posterior-sampling) 基线相当或更好，而网络评估次数 (network evaluations) 减少最多达几个数量级。
Conclusion: 只学观测条件的似然分数、把先验保持冻结，可以在极少配对数据下达到有竞争力的逆问题复原质量，并大幅降低采样成本；先验模型还能在训练后更换而无需重训 LSA。

papers.title: Social Circuits behind Multi-agent Echo Chambers
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents exchange messages to combine evidence, but their communication can also create echo chambers that reinforce shared errors. However, overall task performance does not explain how a message changes the receiving agent's internal activations and affects its decision. In this work, we introduce Social Circuits, a framework for tracing message effects through receiver activations. We compare the receiver's answers before and after changing a message. Then, we restore selected activations recorded under the original message to determine how much of the message effect these activations reproduce. Based on Social Circuits, we propose Circuit-Guided Deliberation (CGD), which learns to select useful messages using receiver activation changes. We establish when activation replacement preserves receiver decisions and bound the gap between CGD's task performance and the best achievable through message selection. Experiments show that receiver activation changes explain the message effects and guide message selection that improves the task performance. Across three models and four datasets, CGD achieves the highest or joint-highest average accuracy in our main comparisons while generating fewer tokens than multi-agent baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Social Circuits 框架，通过替换接收方在原消息下记录的激活来追踪单条消息如何改变多智能体语言模型的内部状态与决策，并据此提出 Circuit-Guided Deliberation (CGD)：用激活变化挑选有用消息。在三个模型、四个数据集上，CGD 在主对比中取得最高或并列最高的平均准确率，同时生成的 token 少于多智能体基线。
Motivation: 多智能体语言模型靠交换消息整合证据，但消息也可能制造强化共同错误的回音室；整体任务表现无法解释一条消息如何改变接收方内部激活并影响其决策。
Method: Social Circuits 先比较接收方在消息改动前后的回答，再把原消息下记录的部分激活恢复回去，衡量这些激活复现了多少消息效应；CGD 用接收方的激活变化学习选择有用消息。作者给出激活替换保持接收方决策的条件，并给出 CGD 任务表现与消息选择所能达到的最优值之间的差距上界。
Result: 实验显示接收方激活变化能解释消息效应并指导消息选择、从而提升任务表现；在三个模型、四个数据集上，CGD 在主对比中取得最高或并列最高平均准确率，且生成的 token 少于多智能体基线。
Conclusion: 消息对多智能体的作用可由接收方激活变化刻画，用它来选消息能在更少 token 下提高任务准确率。

papers.title: Making LLMs Truly Forget: Deep Unlearning by Searching, Selecting, and Severing Knowledge Paths
papers.abstract_en: While an unlearned language model may no longer recall a fact directly, the fact often remains recoverable through multi-hop reasoning over related knowledge. Most existing unlearning techniques overlook this vulnerability, targeting facts in isolation while leaving their supporting knowledge intact. To achieve true forgetting, we propose a general deep unlearning framework compatible with existing unlearning algorithms. Our approach adaptively explores both explicit responses and latent internal representations to discover valid reasoning paths, compiles them into a confidence-aware supporting subgraph, and we apply a graph minimum cut to sever all recovery paths while preserving unrelated knowledge. To rigorously evaluate deep unlearning, we introduce a model-specific pipeline that extracts and completes knowledge graphs from raw text, filtering them by calibrated model confidence to reflect what the model genuinely retains. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that selectively unlearning supporting knowledge yields substantially deeper forgetting than superficial methods while preserving model utility, highlighting that genuine unlearning requires breaking the relational structures that enable factual reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出通用深度遗忘 (deep unlearning) 框架：自适应搜索显式回答与潜在内部表征中的多跳推理路径，编译成带置信度的知识子图，再用图最小割切断全部事实恢复路径，同时保留无关知识。配套提出从原始文本抽取并补全知识图谱、按校准置信度过滤的评测管线；实验显示选择性遗忘支撑知识比表面方法遗忘更深且保持模型效用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 遗忘方法逐条针对目标事实，却留下其支撑知识，事实仍可通过多跳推理被恢复，遗忘并不彻底。
Method: 框架兼容既有遗忘算法：自适应探索显式回答与潜在内部表征以发现有效推理路径，将其编译为置信度感知的支撑子图 (confidence-aware supporting subgraph)，再施加图最小割 (graph minimum cut) 切断所有恢复路径；评测侧提出从原始文本抽取并补全知识图谱、按校准模型置信度过滤的模型专属管线。
Result: 选择性遗忘支撑知识比表面遗忘方法产生显著更深的遗忘，同时保持模型效用；评测管线输出反映模型真实保留内容的知识图谱。
Conclusion: 真正的遗忘必须切断使事实可被重构的关系结构，而非只抹掉事实本身。
Relevance: 2
