papers.title: When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自动驾驶基准分数被当作优化目标后，分数增益不再自动等于驾驶能力提升：作者把打分过程拆成执行、测量、子分映射与聚合四段，受控干预显示大量真实行为变化因区分被省略、阈值化或在请求动作与实际执行动作之间被削弱而几乎得不到分数响应，闭环比较中优化增益还会在执行接口改变时反转。结论是度量在被优化时的有效性取决于它保留了哪些行为区分，以及优化后的行为如何被执行并作为反馈返回。
Motivation: 驾驶基准分数正从评测工具变成优化目标，但分数增益在分数本身被优化后是否仍是驾驶改进的可靠证据并不清楚。
Method: 把打分过程分解为 execution、measurement、subscore mapping、aggregation 四个环节，用受控干预 (controlled interventions) 观察打分对驾驶行为变化的响应，并做闭环比较检验增益在重复执行与重规划下是否保持。
Result: 受控干预中出现大量行为变化却几乎无分数响应，原因是区分在请求动作与执行动作之间被省略、阈值化或削弱；闭环比较显示优化增益在执行接口改变时发生反转。
Conclusion: 度量在被优化时要同时看打分过程测了什么以及被优化的行为如何被执行，否则分数增益不能作为驾驶改进的证据。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 把打分过程分解为 execution、measurement、subscore mapping、aggregation 四个环节，用受控干预 (controlled interventions) 观察打分对驾驶行为变化的响应，并做闭环比较检验增益在重复执行与重规划下是否保持。
summary_sections.result: 受控干预中出现大量行为变化却几乎无分数响应，原因是区分在请求动作与执行动作之间被省略、阈值化或削弱；闭环比较显示优化增益在执行接口改变时发生反转。
summary_sections.conclusion: 度量在被优化时要同时看打分过程测了什么以及被优化的行为如何被执行，否则分数增益不能作为驾驶改进的证据。

papers.title: Clinical Trajectory Alignment for Medical Vision-Language Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language pre-training largely follows a visit-level image-report matching paradigm, aligning paired images and reports at individual visits. While effective for static cross-modal correspondence, this paradigm provides limited supervision for longitudinal clinical change, such as whether abnormalities improve, remain stable, or worsen over time. Learning such change is challenging because temporal semantics are implicit in free-text reports, and different abnormalities within the same patient may evolve asynchronously or even in opposite directions. We propose MedCTA, which reframes medical vision-language pre-training from visit-level cross-modal matching to learning clinical change. Rather than compressing a patient history into a single temporal representation, MedCTA models clinical change at two complementary scopes. At the abnormality scope, clinically grounded queries construct abnormality-conditioned visual and textual trajectories to capture heterogeneous abnormality evolution. At the patient-course scope, global image and report sequences are modeled to capture overall clinical progression beyond any individual abnormality. Structured trend supervision is extracted from longitudinal reports by an offline LLM parser, removing the need for manual temporal annotations. Combined with static image-report alignment, MedCTA learns representations that preserve visit-level cross-modal correspondence while encoding longitudinal change semantics. Experiments on temporal image classification, image-text retrieval, and zero-shot classification show consistent gains over strong medical vision-language baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedCTA 把医学视觉-语言预训练从单次就诊的图文匹配重构为学习临床变化：在异常层面用临床查询构造异常条件化的视觉与文本轨迹，在患者病程层面建模全局图像与报告序列，并用离线 LLM 解析器从纵向报告中抽取结构化趋势监督。在时序图像分类、图文检索与零样本分类上相对强医学视觉-语言基线取得一致增益。
Motivation: 就诊级图文匹配只对静态跨模态对应有效，对纵向临床变化（好转、稳定、恶化）监督不足；而同一患者不同异常可能异步甚至反向演化，时间语义又隐含在自由文本报告中。
Method: MedCTA 设计两个互补尺度：异常层面用 clinically grounded queries 构造异常条件化的视觉与文本轨迹，患者病程层面建模全局图像与报告序列；趋势监督由离线 LLM 解析器从纵向报告抽取，无需人工时间标注，并与静态图文对齐联合训练。
Result: 在时序图像分类、图文检索和零样本分类三类实验中，相对强医学视觉-语言基线取得一致增益（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把医学视觉-语言预训练的目标从就诊级对应改为学习纵向临床变化，可在保留静态图文对应的同时编码时间变化语义。

papers.title: Remember by Asking: Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for language agents to maintain coherent and effective behavior over extended, multi-session interactions. Existing memory systems mainly use retrieval at read time, while write-time memory formation still relies on direct extraction or compression. However, when future information needs are unknown, compressing an entire interaction in one pass can overlook locally important details that may matter later. To this end, we introduce RIME, a retrieval-induced memory framework that shifts memory construction from monolithic compression toward evidence-centered integration. RIME uses generic self-questions to retrieve focused dialogue evidence and grounds memory formation in both the retrieved evidence and relevant historical memories, which are jointly reconciled into an evolving memory bank with temporal and provenance information. At inference time, compressed memory serves as the primary rather than the sole source of evidence: when it cannot support an answer, RIME retrieves relevant source dialogue together with its local context to recover information omitted during memory formation, without resorting to full-history processing. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GPT-5.6 Sol show that RIME consistently achieves the best performance across all three quality metrics among the compared methods, while requiring substantially fewer query-time LLM tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIME 把 LLM agent 的长期记忆构建从一次性整体压缩改为检索驱动的证据中心整合：用自提问检索对话证据，与历史记忆共同归并进带时间与来源信息的记忆库；推理时压缩记忆只作主要证据，答不上来再取回源对话及其局部上下文。在 LoCoMo 上用 Qwen3-235B-A22B 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 的实验中，RIME 在三项质量指标上均优于对比方法，且查询时 LLM token 显著更少。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统只在读取时检索，写入时靠一次性抽取或压缩；未来信息需求未知时，整段交互的单遍压缩会漏掉事后重要的局部细节。
Method: RIME（Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution）在写入阶段用通用自提问 (self-questions) 检索聚焦的对话证据，将记忆形成同时建立在检索证据与相关历史记忆之上，二者共同归并成带时间与来源 (provenance) 信息的演化记忆库；推理阶段压缩记忆作为主要而非唯一证据来源，不足时检索源对话及其局部上下文补回遗漏信息，避免全历史处理。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 上以 Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 做实验，RIME 在所比较方法中于全部三项质量指标上均取得最佳表现，同时查询时所需 LLM token 显著减少。
Conclusion: 把记忆构建从单遍压缩转为检索诱导的证据整合，并在推理时允许回查源对话，可以在更少查询 token 下提升多会话对话记忆质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Admissible Diffusion for Multimodal Interventional Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Generating a plausible clinical trajectory does not establish what would happen under a different treatment. We present ADMIT, a framework combining irregular multimodal representations, treatment-conditioned latent diffusion and explicit constraints on generated states or actions. We formulate its interventional target through sequential g-computation and distinguish causal assumptions from constraint satisfaction. Its admissibility mechanism translates physiological prior knowledge into explicit constraints on generated states and proposed actions. Treatment-exposure dynamics condition latent transitions, while state projection or action gating applies the constraints during rollout so that they influence subsequent trajectory generation. In our preliminary experiments, multimodal inputs improved supervised hidden-state recovery and reduced treatment-contrast error. In a simulated dosing-schedule experiment with leak-free history encoding, ADMIT predicted most of the tumor-volume change caused by redistributing a fixed total dose. An exposure input improved these predictions around a temporary dose reduction whether or not the assumed clearance rate was correct, but reduced the predicted size of a dose effect, and a deterministic recurrent baseline matched ADMIT's average predictions. Exposure projection reduced constraint violations, although enforcement remained incomplete. Semi-synthetic experiments using eICU context illustrated treatment-response generation under fixed and adaptive policies. Observational examples further characterize model treatment sensitivity. ADMIT provides a framework for testing whether complementary observations and physiological restrictions improve intervention trajectories, with representation recovery, effect accuracy and rule enforcement assessed separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADMIT 把不规则多模态临床表征、治疗条件化的 latent diffusion 与生理先验显式约束（状态投影/动作门控）组合起来，经 sequential g-formulation 定义干预目标，用于生成给定另一治疗方案下的临床轨迹。初步实验中多模态输入改善了隐状态恢复并降低 treatment-contrast error，但确定性 recurrent 基线在平均预测上与 ADMIT 持平，且约束执行仍不完整。
Motivation: 生成一条看似合理的临床轨迹并不等于回答换一种治疗会发生什么；干预轨迹生成需要把因果假设与约束满足分开，并让生理先验真正约束 rollout 中的后续生成。
Method: ADMIT 用 sequential g-formulation 归因干预目标，区分因果假设与约束满足；治疗暴露动态条件化 latent 转移，rollout 时通过 state projection 或 action gating 施加对生成状态与动作的显式约束，使其影响后续轨迹生成。
Result: 初步实验中多模态输入改善了监督隐状态恢复并降低 treatment-contrast error；在带 leak-free history encoding 的模拟给药时序实验中，ADMIT 预测了重新分配固定总剂量所造成肿瘤体积变化的大部分；暴露输入在临时减量附近改善预测（无论假设的 clearance rate 是否正确），但会缩小剂量效应的预测幅度，且确定性 recurrent 基线的平均预测与 ADMIT 相当；exposure projection 减少了约束违反但执行仍不完整；并有基于 eICU context 的 semi-synthetic 实验展示固定与自适应策略下的治疗响应生成。
Conclusion: 作者把 ADMIT 定位为一个检验框架：分别评估表示恢复、效应精度与规则执行，以判断互补观测与生理限制是否真的改善干预轨迹，而非宣称已优于基线。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Harmonizing Spectral Evolution in Conditional Flow Matching for TTS
authors: Isha Pandey Varad Deshpande Abhijat Bharadwaj Ganesh Ramakrishnan
papers.abstract_en: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) models for text-to-speech (TTS) suffer from incoherent frequency evolution during inference. While similar spectral imbalances are addressed in diffusion models for other domains, those generic solutions fail to generalize to the inherently uncoordinated acoustic dynamics of CFM. We demonstrate that this issue can be effectively mitigated by introducing a novel training-free frequency-selective boosting strategy. Using the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), our method dynamically modulates mel-spectrogram sub-bands during ODE integration, synchronizing spectral development by penalizing aggressive low-frequency growth and boosting lagging high-frequency details. Validated across diverse architectures (Matcha-TTS, F5-TTS, IndicF5), our approach reduces the required Number of Function Evaluations (NFE) from 32 to 26 and improves Frechet Audio Distance (FAD) by up to 61%, all without compromising mean opinion scores, speaker similarity, and speech intelligibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) 文本转语音 (TTS) 推理中频率演化不协调，提出训练无关的频率选择性增强策略：用 Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) 在 ODE 积分过程中动态调制 mel 频谱子带，抑制过快的低频增长、提升滞后的高频细节。在 Matcha-TTS、F5-TTS、IndicF5 上将所需 Number of Function Evaluations (NFE) 从 32 降到 26，Frechet Audio Distance (FAD) 最多改善 61%，且不损害 MOS、说话人相似度与可懂度。
Motivation: CFM TTS 推理时频谱演化不连贯；扩散模型中针对其他域的通用频谱平衡方案无法迁移到 CFM 固有的不协调声学动态上。
Method: 训练无关的频率选择性增强：以 Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) 分解 mel 频谱子带，在 ODE 积分中动态调制，惩罚激进的低频增长并增强滞后的高频细节，跨 Matcha-TTS、F5-TTS、IndicF5 三种架构验证。
Result: NFE 需求从 32 降至 26；Frechet Audio Distance (FAD) 最多改善 61%；mean opinion scores、说话人相似度与语音可懂度均未受损。
Conclusion: 在 ODE 积分中按子带做频率选择性调制可在不牺牲主观质量与可懂度的前提下降低 CFM TTS 的推理成本并改善频谱协调性。

papers.title: HUMAN-TCI: Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network with Torso-Centered Interaction for Text-to-Motion Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Accurate retrieval of human motions is a crucial first step in text-guided human motion modeling and synthesis, as it selects semantically relevant sequences from large datasets and provides grounded references for downstream tasks. Retrieving motions from natural language descriptions remains challenging because sentences can describe multiple actions, overlapping movements, and intricate dependencies between body parts. Existing methods often focus on simple, single-action descriptions and typically process body parts independently or by merely concatenating features, without explicitly modeling how torso movements influence other parts. In addition, their processing pipelines often rely on computationally heavy models, introducing considerable overhead, particularly when modeling longer or more complex motion sequences. This limits learning discriminative motion-pattern representations, reducing retrieval accuracy, interpretability, and efficiency in practical applications. To address these limitations, we propose HUMAN-TCI, a Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network for text-guided human motion retrieval. HUMAN-TCI employs a three-stream architecture that separately models upper-body, lower-body, and torso motions while explicitly capturing their interactions, allowing torso-related movements to influence the positioning and dynamics of other body parts. By incorporating tailored torso attention, our model effectively recognizes complex human motion patterns, captures fine-grained motion relationships and handles complex multi-action descriptions. Our framework supports retrieval for both simple, single-action sentences and long, compositional descriptions containing sequential or overlapping actions without relying on complex models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HUMAN-TCI 用三分流层级网络分别建模上身、下身与躯干动作，并通过躯干注意力显式耦合三者，使躯干运动影响其他部位的定位与动态。它同时支持单动作短句与含顺序/重叠动作的长组合描述检索，且不依赖计算量大的模型。
Motivation: 文本到动作检索需处理一句多动作、动作重叠与身体部位间复杂依赖，而现有方法多按部位独立处理或简单拼接特征，未显式建模躯干对其他部位的影响，且流程依赖计算开销大的模型，限制了长序列上的判别性表示学习。
Method: 提出 HUMAN-TCI：三分流架构分别处理 upper-body、lower-body、torso 动作，配合定制的 torso attention 显式捕获三者交互，层级式多流运动感知网络用于文本引导的动作检索，覆盖单动作句与长组合描述。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性能力主张：模型能识别复杂动作模式、捕获细粒度动作关系、处理多动作长描述，并在不依赖复杂模型的前提下支持单动作与组合描述两类检索。
Conclusion: 把躯干作为独立且与其他部位交互的建模对象，可在不引入重型模型的前提下支撑从简单到组合描述的文本到动作检索。

papers.title: AgentHop: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agentic Multi-Hop Scientific Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources. Due to this complexity, agentic task failures arise from various sources, and pinpointing these failure causes is essential to diagnose and improve agentic systems. Existing benchmarks, however, tend to focus on a single leaderboard score, leaving the underlying failure modes opaque. To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints. AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management. Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprints: GPT models commit early, Anthropic and GLM checkpoints verify before committing, DeepSeek and Kimi over-search, and Gemini-3 Pro stays balanced. Decomposed axes further expose within-family structure: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 land within one accuracy point yet diverge on retrieval-versus-synthesis emphasis, with Opus retrieving more and Sonnet synthesizing better. We release the full benchmark set and the harness to support diagnostic agent benchmarking.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentHop 把 agentic 多跳科学问答的单一准确率拆成检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四个轴，在 1,011 道多选题与固定 token/轮次/工具调用预算的七工具沙盒中诊断 19 个模型的失败来源。结果显示行为按模型家族聚类：GPT 早承诺、Anthropic 与 GLM 先验证再承诺、DeepSeek 与 Kimi 过度搜索、Gemini-3 Pro 保持均衡；Claude Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 准确率差距在 1 个百分点内，但 Opus 检索更多、Sonnet 综合更好。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 基准只给一个榜单分数，把多步交互中的失败来源混在一起，无法定位是检索、综合、工具调用还是资源管理出了问题。
Method: 构建 1,011 道多选科学问答题，配一个受控七工具沙盒，并固定 token、交互轮次与工具调用预算；把单一准确率沿检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四个轴分解，在 19 个模型上比较各轴表现与工具调用签名。
Result: 19 个模型的行为按家族聚类，工具调用签名呈现家族指纹：GPT 早承诺，Anthropic 与 GLM 先验证再承诺，DeepSeek 与 Kimi 过度搜索，Gemini-3 Pro 均衡。Claude Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 准确率相差不到 1 个百分点，但在检索与综合侧重上分化：Opus 检索更多，Sonnet 综合更好。
Conclusion: 单一准确率会掩盖家族内与家族间的失败结构，按四个轴分解并配合工具调用签名才能诊断 agentic 系统；作者公开完整基准与 harness 以支持此类诊断评测。

papers.title: LLMs as Adaptive Meta-Solvers: Strategy-Diverse RL for Industrial-Scale Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Scaling LLM-based optimization from textbook-scale instances to real-world, industrial tasks remains a critical open challenge. Existing approaches are predominantly evaluated on small, self-contained textual problems and often commit to a solver-integrated paradigm, limiting their ability to handle the scale and structural diversity of practical optimization workloads. In this work, we propose a practical framework for training open-source LLMs to tackle real-world, industrial-scale optimization. We first show empirically that solver-integrated reasoning, exact combinatorial algorithm, and heuristic search exhibit complementary strengths across different problem structures and scales. Motivated by this, we introduce Strategy-Diverse Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), which trains LLMs as adaptive optimization meta-solvers. SDRL leverages this complementarity through a correctness-gated hierarchical diversity reward that promotes robust exploration across varying strategies and within each strategy, effectively preventing premature strategy collapse. We further introduce a mixed-format training scheme that jointly supports both self-contained textual problems and file-grounded instances. Across comprehensive evaluations, our framework outperforms existing fine-tuned methods and frontier models including DeepSeek-V4-Pro and GPT-5.5, both on average across benchmarks and on industrial-scale optimization tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SDRL（Strategy-Diverse Reinforcement Learning），用正确性门控的层级多样性奖励训练开源 LLM 做工业规模优化的自适应元求解器，抑制策略过早坍缩。在综合评测中平均与工业级任务上均超过现有微调方法及 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GPT-5.5。
Motivation: LLM 优化研究多停留在小规模、自包含的文本题目，并绑定单一求解器范式，难以覆盖真实工业优化的规模与结构多样性。
Method: 先实证展示 solver-integrated reasoning、exact combinatorial algorithm、heuristic search 在不同问题结构与规模上互补；据此提出 SDRL，用 correctness-gated hierarchical diversity reward 同时在策略间与策略内促进探索，并用 mixed-format training 同时支持自包含文本题与 file-grounded 实例。
Result: 在综合评测中，该框架在各基准平均以及工业规模优化任务上均优于现有微调方法和前沿模型，包括 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 与 GPT-5.5。
Conclusion: 把多种求解策略的互补性直接写进奖励、并混合文本与文件两种输入格式，可让开源 LLM 成为跨规模的优化元求解器。

papers.title: Q-learning Penalized Transformer for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of safe offline reinforcement learning, which involves training a policy to satisfy safety constraints using an offline dataset. This problem is inherently challenging as it requires balancing three highly interconnected and competing objectives: satisfying safety constraints, maximizing rewards, and adhering to the behavior regularization imposed by the offline dataset. To tackle this trilogy challenge, we propose Q-learning Penalized Transformer policy (QPT), a \emph{training--inference consistent} framework that bridges conditional sequence modeling with constraint-aware value estimation. QPT trains a Transformer policy that generates actions conditioned on trajectory context and target return/cost, retaining strong behavior regularization. To inject explicit safety semantics during learning, we augment sequence-model training with a Q-shaped penalty using learned reward and cost Q-functions to favor high return under low constraint violation. At inference, the same Q-functions enforce the cost threshold and choose the highest-reward feasible action, closing the loop between training and deployment. We provide a principled analysis under stylized near-deterministic CMDPs, characterizing how Q-penalized conditional generation improve safety and performance. Empirically, QPT consistently outperforms strong safe offline RL baselines across 38 tasks on the DSRL benchmark, and exhibits robust zero-shot adaptation to different constraint thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Q-learning Penalized Transformer (QPT)，把条件序列建模与约束感知的价值估计打通：训练时用学到的 reward/cost Q 函数给 Transformer 策略加 Q 形惩罚，推理时用同一组 Q 函数强制成本阈值并选最高回报的可行动作，实现训练-推理一致。在 DSRL 基准 38 个任务上持续优于强安全离线 RL 基线，并对不同约束阈值展现零样本适应。
Motivation: 安全离线 RL 要同时平衡满足安全约束、最大化回报、服从离线数据的行为正则三个相互竞争的目标，且训练与部署常不一致。
Method: QPT 训练一个以轨迹上下文和目标 return/cost 为条件的 Transformer 策略；在序列建模损失上叠加由学到的 reward Q 函数与 cost Q 函数构成的 Q 形惩罚，偏好高回报且低约束违反；推理时复用同一 Q 函数强制成本阈值并选取最高回报的可行动作。作者在近确定性 CMDP 的风格化设定下给出理论分析。
Result: 在 DSRL 基准的 38 个任务上持续优于强安全离线 RL 基线，并对不同约束阈值展现鲁棒的零样本适应；理论刻画了 Q 惩罚条件生成如何提升安全性与性能。
Conclusion: 用同一组 Q 函数同时做训练惩罚与推理约束，可以在离线数据下把安全、回报与行为正则统一到一个训练-推理一致的框架里。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Cue-Grounded Topic Segmentation of Spoken Documents
papers.abstract_en: Topic segmentation structures spoken documents into coherent sections, facilitating navigation and downstream understanding. The appropriate granularity can vary substantially, ranging from broad thematic shifts to fine-grained subtopics. Existing LLM-based segmenters, however, often struggle to adapt to this variation, causing them to either merge distinct subtopics or over-segment coherent themes. To address this, we introduce Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS), a training-free framework that operates without any task-specific supervision. CGS first identifies phrases that explicitly signal the start of a new topic and uses their sentence positions as segment boundaries. When such cues are insufficient, it falls back to semantic segmentation, guided by the document structure inferred during cue extraction. Across six benchmarks and six LLM backbones, CGS consistently outperforms existing baselines, remains robust to noisy ASR transcripts, and achieves these gains with low API cost on proprietary models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本、免训练的话题切分框架 Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS)：先抽取显式标示新话题开始的线索短语并以其句子位置作边界，线索不足时回退到由线索抽取阶段推断出的文档结构所引导的语义切分。在六个基准、六种 LLM backbone 上 CGS 一致优于现有基线，且对含噪 ASR 转写稳健、在闭源模型上 API 成本低。
Motivation: 口语文档的话题粒度差异大（从宏观主题切换到细粒度子话题），现有基于 LLM 的切分器难以自适应这种变化，会合并不同子话题或对连贯主题过度切分。
Method: CGS 是 training-free 框架，无需任何任务特定监督：第一步识别显式标示新话题开始的短语，用其句子位置作为切分边界；当这类线索不足时回退到语义切分，语义切分由线索抽取过程中推断出的文档结构引导。
Result: 在六个基准、六种 LLM backbone 上 CGS 一致优于现有基线；对含噪 ASR 转写保持稳健；在闭源模型上以低 API 成本取得这些增益。
Conclusion: 以显式话题线索为主、文档结构引导的语义切分为辅的免训练路线，可以在不微调的前提下跨基准与跨 backbone 稳定改进口语文档话题切分，并兼顾噪声鲁棒性与成本。

papers.title: On the Relation Between Interval Regret and Dynamic Regret
papers.abstract_en: Non-stationary online learning has attracted much attention in recent years, as static regret is insufficient to guide algorithm design in changing environments. To address this limitation, interval regret and dynamic regret have been introduced as two representative performance metrics that strengthen static regret in complementary directions. Interval regret requires an online algorithm to achieve competitive static regret over every local time interval, whereas dynamic regret evaluates performance against an arbitrary sequence of time-varying comparators. Despite their importance, the relation between these metrics has long remained unclear. Prior work has often regarded interval regret as the stronger notion, based on the intuition that local guarantees should naturally induce global guarantees. Consequently, it is widely conjectured that an algorithm with optimal interval regret should automatically attain optimal dynamic regret. In this paper, we first establish a negative result that refutes this intuition of a metric-level implication. Specifically, for both convex and curved functions (including exp-concave and strongly convex functions), we show that there exist instances in which an algorithm with optimal interval regret nevertheless fails to achieve optimal dynamic regret. We then show how to leverage local adaptivity to obtain optimal dynamic regret. In particular, optimal dynamic regret can be attained by invoking an interval regret minimization process over an enlarged Euclidean ball containing the original convex feasible domain and using a suitable domain-converted surrogate loss. This reduction applies to both convex and curved functions. As a byproduct, we obtain the first proper and efficient algorithm with optimal dynamic regret for exp-concave functions, improving prior results while significantly simplifying the analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线学习中「interval regret 最优即自动蕴含 dynamic regret 最优」的普遍猜想被否定：对凸函数与曲率函数（exp-concave、strongly convex），存在最优 interval regret 的算法却拿不到最优 dynamic regret。作者随后给出正面构造——把区间 regret 最小化过程放到包含原凸可行域的放大欧氏球上、配合域转换的替代损失，即可得到最优 dynamic regret。
Motivation: 非平稳在线学习里 static regret 不足以指导算法设计，interval regret 与 dynamic regret 是两个互补的强化指标，但二者关系长期不清；此前普遍认为局部（区间）保证自然导出全局保证。
Method: 先构造反例证明指标层面的蕴含关系不成立（覆盖凸函数与 exp-concave、strongly convex 等曲率函数）；再用局部自适庞性做归约：在包含原凸可行域的放大欧氏球上运行 interval regret 最小化，并使用域转换的替代损失 (domain-converted surrogate loss)。
Result: 证明存在实例使 interval regret 最优的算法仍无法达到最优 dynamic regret，凸与曲率函数两类均成立；该归约对两类函数都给出最优 dynamic regret，并作为副产物得到首个针对 exp-concave 函数的恰当且高效的最优 dynamic regret 算法，改进已有结果并显著简化分析。

papers.title: Coding Agent Memory Post-training: Unlocking the Memory Potential of Pre-trained File Operations for Long-Horizon Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks whose interaction histories exceed the model's active context. Recent work has begun to use reinforcement learning to make memory control part of the policy, often relying on predefined memory tools within domain-specific training environments of relatively short horizons. This setup ties learned memory behavior to environment-specific interfaces that lie outside the base model's pre-training and must be learned from scratch, so even after post-training, agents struggle to use memory in long-horizon tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce Coding Agent Memory Gym (CAMG), a suite of long-horizon agentic-RL environments spanning Shop, Coding, DeepResearch, and AutoResearch. Alongside each environment's native task interface, CAMG provides executable shell access and an episode-persistent workspace, enabling agents to create, revise, search, and reuse files as memory throughout an episode. We also introduce CAMG-RL, which trains a single policy jointly across all four environments with fully asynchronous PPO, learning this file-based memory behavior directly from downstream task reward, and we train CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B from Qwen3.5 models of matching size. On SWE-bench Verified and MLE-bench Lite, CAMG-RL-4B and CAMG-RL-9B are competitive with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Coding Agent Memory Gym (CAMG)：四个长程 agent 环境（Shop、Coding、DeepResearch、AutoResearch）配可执行 shell 与跨 episode 持久 workspace，让 agent 用文件系统当记忆；再用全异步 PPO 从下游任务奖励直接学文件记忆行为，训练 CAMG-RL-4B/9B。在 SWE-bench Verified 与 MLE-bench Lite 上，两者分别与 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有用 RL 让记忆控制进入策略的做法依赖预定义记忆工具和短程领域训练环境，学到的记忆行为绑定在模型预训练之外的接口上，后训练后 agent 在长程任务中仍用不好记忆。
Method: CAMG 在原生任务接口之外提供可执行 shell 访问与 episode 持久 workspace，支持创建、修改、检索、复用文件作为记忆；CAMG-RL 用全异步 PPO 在四个环境上联合训练单一策略，从下游任务奖励学习文件记忆行为，基于同规模 Qwen3.5 训练出 CAMG-RL-4B 与 CAMG-RL-9B。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 MLE-bench Lite 上，CAMG-RL-4B 与 CAMG-RL-9B 分别与 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 和 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 竞争力相当（4B/9B 对 35B/122B 激活规模的 MoE 模型）。
Conclusion: 把文件操作当作记忆并用下游奖励直接强化学习，能让小得多的模型在长程任务上达到大模型的竞争水平，记忆能力可从预训练的文件操作中释放而非另学工具接口。

papers.title: MegaGraph: Towards Efficient Training of Large-Scale Graph Transformers with Automated Hybrid Parallelism
papers.abstract_en: Graph Transformers (GTs) offer superior representation capabilities by overcoming the depth limitations and over-smoothing issues of traditional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). However, scaling GTs to large graphs poses critical bottlenecks. Specifically, the attention score matrix and its associated topology-aware bias matrix jointly incur significant per-layer memory overhead, and heavy graph embedding layers result in severe workload imbalances. These characteristics are unique to GT training and are not addressed by parallelism techniques designed for either conventional GNNs or Transformers, making a dedicated solution necessary. This paper introduces MegaGraph, the first automated hybrid parallelism framework designed for efficient GT training. MegaGraph designs three specialized strategies, namely graph-aware context parallelism, heterogeneous pipeline parallelism, and hybrid data parallelism, to support efficient training on large-scale graphs. However, coordinating these three parallelism strategies yields an exponentially large configuration space. To address this complexity, an automatic search engine leverages precise cost models via a Profile - Model - Search workflow to identify the optimal parallelism configuration. Evaluations demonstrate that MegaGraph enables training on large-scale graphs where state-of-the-art baselines fail due to out-of-memory (OOM) errors. The framework reduces per-device peak memory by up to 77.8\% and achieves up to 4.51$\times$ training speedup while maintaining model accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MegaGraph 是首个面向大规模图 Transformer (GT) 训练的自动混合并行框架，用图感知上下文并行、异构流水线并行与混合数据并行三种策略分摊注意力分数矩阵和拓扑感知偏置矩阵的每层显存开销，并由 Profile-Model-Search 工作流的代价模型自动搜索并行配置。评测中它让 SOTA 基线因 OOM 失败的大图训练得以运行，每设备峰值显存最多降 77.8%，训练加速最高 4.51×，同时保持模型精度。
Motivation: GT 训练中注意力分数矩阵与拓扑感知偏置矩阵带来巨额每层显存开销，加上重型图嵌入层造成负载不均；面向常规 GNN 或 Transformer 的并行技术都处理不了这些 GT 特有问题，大规模图上直接 OOM。
Method: 提出 MegaGraph 自动混合并行框架，含三种专用策略：graph-aware context parallelism、heterogeneous pipeline parallelism、hybrid data parallelism；三者组合的配置空间指数级膨胀，故用自动搜索引擎按 Profile - Model - Search 工作流构建精确代价模型，选出最优并行配置。
Result: 在评测中，MegaGraph 支持了 SOTA 基线因 OOM 无法完成的大规模图训练；每设备峰值显存最多降低 77.8%，训练加速最高达 4.51×，并保持模型精度。
Conclusion: GT 大规模训练的显存与负载失衡需由专用混合并行加自动配置搜索共同解决，代价模型驱动的搜索可在不损失精度的前提下换取数量级的显存与速度收益。

papers.title: Beyond End-to-End Black Box Mapping: An Intentional Agent Framework for Cognitive-driven Facial Reaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic human-like facial reaction generation (FRG) is essential for building intelligent systems that can engage in human-computer interaction (HCI). While diverse and context-appropriate facial reactions can reflect latent appraisal and affective processes in human interaction, most existing FRG methods rely on end-to-end architectures that directly map speaker behaviours to listener expressions without an explicit intermediate internal state. We reformulate FRG as generation mediated by a structured internal-state process and propose the \textbf{Intentional Agent}, which shifts FRG from direct stimulus-response mapping to stimulus-grounded generation through explicit intermediate states. To represent temporal internal-state evolution, we propose an internal dynamics model that integrates emotional drives with an iterative Inner Thought Flow (ITF) within a structured intermediate state used for subsequent generation. This state can continue to update during conversational silences. Furthermore, to bridge abstract internal states with physiological actions, we formulate FRG as a downstream affective mapping from this latent thought flow to facial expressions. Experiments on the REACT 2025 dataset show an FRDist of 72.39 and an FRDiv of 0.5057; perceptual plausibility is evaluated separately through blinded human ratings. A blinded human evaluation of 96 reactions found no significant difference in mean score between Full and ground truth ($5.527$ vs.\ $5.195$, $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=.076$), while Full significantly outperformed Event-Triggered and Heuristic-Only (both $p_{\mathrm{Holm}}<.001$). The Reaction Quality Scorer (RQS) correlated strongly with human judgements (Pearson $r=.855$; Spearman $ρ=.821$, both $p<.05$), supporting its use as an automatic metric. These results underscore the immense potential of endogenous dynamics in building highly autonomous, human-like agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人脸反应生成 (FRG) 从说话人行为到听者表情的端到端黑箱映射，重构为由显式中间状态介导的生成：Intentional Agent 用情绪驱动加迭代 Inner Thought Flow (ITF) 建模内部状态演化，再把该状态作为情感映射输出面部表情。在 REACT 2025 上 FRDist 72.39、FRDiv 0.5057；96 个反应的盲评中 Full 与 ground truth 均分无显著差异（5.527 vs 5.195，p_Holm=.076），且显著优于 Event-Triggered 与 Heuristic-Only（p_Holm<.001）。
Motivation: 现有 FRG 多为端到端架构，直接把说话人行为映射到听者表情，缺少显式的中间内部状态，难以表达交互中的评估与情绪过程。
Method: 提出 Intentional Agent：内部动力学模型把情绪驱动与迭代 Inner Thought Flow (ITF) 融合进结构化中间状态，该状态在对话沉默期仍可继续更新；再把 FRG 形式化为从潜在思维流到面部表情的下游情感映射。评价用 REACT 2025 数据集，配 Reaction Quality Scorer (RQS) 自动指标与盲测人工评分。
Result: REACT 2025 上 FRDist 72.39、FRDiv 0.5057。96 个反应的盲评中 Full 与 ground truth 均分 5.527 vs 5.195（p_Holm=.076，无显著差异），Full 显著优于 Event-Triggered 与 Heuristic-Only（两者 p_Holm<.001）。RQS 与人工判断强相关：Pearson r=.855、Spearman ρ=.821（均 p<.05）。
Conclusion: 显式中间状态加内生动力学可让 FRG 逼近真人反应水平，且 RQS 可作为可靠的自动指标替代人工评分。

papers.title: OSPD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Persona-Consistent Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining persona consistency across multi-turn dialogues remains a core challenge for role-playing language models. Off-policy distillation from external teachers incurs distribution mismatch that compounds across dialogue turns, while reinforcement learning struggles with reward ambiguity inherent in subjective persona fidelity. We propose OSPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework where the same model serves as both teacher and student under asymmetric information: the teacher receives a complete character profile while the student sees only a brief summary, and the student generates trajectories from its own policy. We find that teacher confidence in role-playing dialogue exhibits a bimodal structure---sharply peaked at character-critical tokens yet diffuse at generic utterances---and introduce role-aware divergence switching to match this structure. A progressive trait masking curriculum further forces staged internalization of character knowledge along semantic dimensions. Experiments on CharacterBench, CharacterEval, and SocialBench show that OSPD substantially improves persona consistency over supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn RL baselines, without requiring any external teacher or reward model.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, including references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OSPD 用同一模型在非对称信息下做同策略自蒸馏 (on-policy self-distillation)：教师看完整角色档案、学生只看摘要，学生从自身策略生成轨迹。教师置信度在角色关键 token 上尖峰、在通用话语上弥散，据此做角色感知散度切换 (role-aware divergence switching)，再加渐进特质掩码课程；在 CharacterBench、CharacterEval、SocialBench 上一致性优于 SFT 与多轮 RL 基线，且不需外部教师或奖励模型。
Motivation: 角色扮演多轮对话中人格一致性难维持：离策略蒸馏的分布失配随对话轮次累积，强化学习又受主观人格保真度的奖励歧义困扰。
Method: 同一模型兼任教师与学生，教师输入完整角色档案、学生输入简要摘要，学生按自身策略采样轨迹；依据教师置信度的双峰结构做角色感知散度切换，并用沿语义维度的渐进特质掩码课程 (progressive trait masking curriculum) 分阶段内化角色知识。
Result: 在 CharacterBench、CharacterEval、SocialBench 上，OSPD 相对监督微调 (SFT) 与多轮 RL 基线显著提升人格一致性，且无需外部教师或奖励模型；教师置信度呈双峰结构——角色关键 token 处尖峰、通用话语处弥散。
Conclusion: 在非对称信息下的同策略自蒸馏可绕开外部教师与奖励模型，用匹配置信度结构的散度切换解决人格一致性问题。

papers.title: PROACT-Agent: Progressive Runtime Oversight and Active Circuit-breaking for Real-Time Safety
papers.abstract_en: The transition from Large Language Models (LLMs) to agents shifts safety stakes from toxic text to irreversible environmental harm. While current defenses remain largely retrospective, proactive runtime intervention is bottlenecked by the lack of large-scale, causally-consistent data. We propose PROACT-Agent, a framework for synthesizing high-fidelity trajectories to enable real-time guardrails. We identify a critical "safety drift" in prior benchmarks, where lenient annotation paradigms fail to enforce temporal consistency. PROACT-Agent addresses this through: (1) Progressive Trajectory Unrolling to reveal risks hidden in long-context interactions; (2) Reasoning-Augmented Causal Rectification to enforce monotonic causal consistency; and (3) Culturally-Aware Data Localization for cross-border robustness. We introduce PROACT-Bench, a bilingual safety benchmark with 155,780 states labeled through multi-model adjudication. Evaluating updated context before the next LLM inference, the trained guard achieves 91.46% unsafe-class F1 and 90.63% exact-boundary detection under complete source holdout. In AgentDojo, it reduces non-DoS targeted attack success from 20.82% to 0.40%.

papers.title: Mathematics for and by human cognition: A resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving
papers.abstract_en: Human cognitive constraints are generally viewed as limiting factors in problem-solving. We argue that these constraints can instead play a critical role in driving advances in mathematics and beyond. We propose a theory of mathematical abstraction as a resource-rational search for bottlenecks in problem-solving. Bottlenecks arising from cognitive constraints create pressure to restructure existing knowledge, potentially giving rise to novel formalisms with applications beyond the problems that originally motivated them. Drawing on episodes from the history of mathematics, we illustrate how such bottlenecks can drive the development of novel abstractions and examine how cognitive constraints and affective responses shape this process. Finally, we discuss the implications of this account for machine mathematical discovery and argue that incorporating human-like constraints may facilitate the discovery of useful mathematical abstractions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把数学抽象视为对解题瓶颈的资源理性搜索 (resource-rational search)：认知约束制造瓶颈，迫使既有知识重组，进而产生超出原问题的新形式体系。作者用数学史案例说明这一机制，并主张给机器发现系统加入类似人类的约束，可能促进有用的数学抽象被发现。
Motivation: 认知约束通常被当作解题的限制因素，本文要反过来论证它是推动数学乃至更广领域前进的驱动力，并为机器数学发现提供可操作的设计方向。
Method: 构建一个把数学抽象建模为资源理性搜索瓶颈的理论，援引数学史上的若干案例作说明，并讨论认知约束与情感反应 (affective responses) 如何塑造该过程，最后把这一解释延伸到机器数学发现。
Result: 给出一个理论性说明与历史案例论证，核心命题是认知约束产生的瓶颈会驱动新抽象的产生；对机器发现的主张是加入类人约束可能有助于发现有用的数学抽象。
Conclusion: 人类认知约束不是纯粹的障碍，而是数学抽象产生的压力来源；机器数学发现若引入类似约束，可能更容易产出有用的抽象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MASCIT: A Mask-Aware State Space Classifier for Naturally Irregular Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Naturally irregular time series combine asynchronous observations, missing values, unequal lengths, and nonuniform sampling, while dense adapters can discard temporal structure. We propose a mask-aware state space classifier for irregular time series (MASCIT), which supplies observation masks to the encoder and excludes invalid steps from gated temporal aggregation. Across 34 irregular time series datasets, MASCIT yielded the strongest aggregate point estimate and was the only evaluated neural model with three-seed results on every dataset. MASCIT retained the lowest point rank across six overlapping irregularity indicators, while factorial ablations favored partial over full selectivity. These results support selective state space models as effective, executable backbones for naturally irregular time series classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASCIT 把观测掩码 (observation mask) 直接喂给状态空间编码器，并在门控时间聚合中剔除无效时间步，用于天然不规则时间序列分类。在 34 个不规则时间序列数据集上取得最强综合点估计，且是唯一在全部数据集上都有三种子结果的被评估神经模型。
Motivation: 天然不规则时间序列同时包含异步观测、缺失值、不等长与非均匀采样，稠密适配器 (dense adapter) 会丢掉时间结构，需要能显式处理无效时间步的骨干。
Method: MASCIT 为状态空间编码器提供观测掩码，并在门控时间聚合 (gated temporal aggregation) 中排除无效步；另做因子消融 (factorial ablations) 比较选择性 (selectivity) 的部分与完全设定。
Result: 在 34 个不规则时间序列数据集上，MASCIT 的综合点估计最强，且是唯一在每个数据集上都有三种子结果的被评估神经模型；在六个重叠的不规则性指标 (irregularity indicators) 上保持最低点秩 (point rank)；因子消融支持部分选择性优于完全选择性。
Conclusion: 选择性状态空间模型 (selective state space model) 可作为天然不规则时间序列分类的有效且可执行的骨干，部分选择性是更受支持的配置。

papers.title: Distilling Visual Reasoning into Text Space
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong promise for multimodal reasoning, yet often struggle with tasks requiring concepts beyond what is directly observable in the input image. Existing methods generate intermediate images or latent visual tokens to guide reasoning, but these representations can introduce errors and increasingly interfere with textual reasoning as reasoning progresses. We propose Visual-to-Text Chain-of-Thought Distillation (V2T), a framework that enables LVLMs to internalize visual reasoning without generating intermediate visual representations at inference time. V2T first trains a teacher LVLM using interleaved visual and textual chains of thought, and then uses knowledge distillation to train a student LVLM using the teacher's logits and cross-entropy supervision from ground-truth textual reasoning. When reasoning images can be mapped to the original image, V2T can additionally distill the teacher's attention to corresponding regions, while ground-truth bounding boxes can further guide a subsequent reinforcement learning stage. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that V2T consistently outperforms the teacher and existing baselines, improving average accuracy by 14.3% on a held-out set and 2.7% on the broader visual evaluation suite. Moreover, lightweight SFT and substantially reduced RL make V2T up to 42x faster to train than state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Visual-to-Text Chain-of-Thought Distillation (V2T)，把 LVLM 的视觉推理蒸馏进文本空间，推理时不再生成中间图像或视觉 token。在多个多模态推理基准上平均准确率相对 held-out 集提升 14.3%、更广的视觉评测集提升 2.7%，训练比 SOTA 基线快至多 42 倍。
Motivation: LVLM 在需要图像之外概念的推理上表现弱，现有方法靠生成中间图像或潜在视觉 token 引导推理，这些表示会引入误差并随推理推进干扰文本推理。
Method: V2T 两阶段：先用图文交错的 chain-of-thought 训练 teacher LVLM，再用知识蒸馏以 teacher 的 logits 加上真实文本推理的交叉熵监督训练 student；当推理图像可映射回原图时额外蒸馏 teacher 对相应区域的注意力，真实 bounding box 可进一步指导后续强化学习阶段。
Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上 V2T 稳定超过 teacher 与现有基线：held-out 集平均准确率提升 14.3%，更广的视觉评测集提升 2.7%；配合轻量 SFT 与大幅缩减的 RL，训练比 SOTA 基线快至多 42 倍。
Conclusion: 视觉推理可以蒸馏进文本空间，从而在推理时省去中间视觉表示，同时拿到更高准确率与大幅更低的训练成本。

papers.title: Unlocking Few-Step Diffusion for Faithful Previews
papers.abstract_en: Sampling latency compounds in diffusion workflows, where users generate and discard many candidates before keeping one. Surprisingly, the poor outputs of standard few-step samplers do not reflect a lack of reconstruction capacity: by optimizing only the initial noise, frozen 3-4-step samplers can closely reproduce their corresponding full-step outputs. Building on this finding, we learn corrections to the initial noise and denoising updates using endpoint supervision, improving correspondence with full-step outputs generated from the same noise and prompt. The resulting previews allow users to screen candidates cheaply and reserve full-step generation for promising ones. Input correction also transfers across sampling budgets without retraining. Experiments show substantial improvements in reference fidelity, including 53-78% lower reconstruction MSE than retrained LD3 on unconditional benchmarks, alongside improved ranking preservation and candidate selection on SD1.5, SDXL, and FLUX.1-dev.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散生成中用户反复试错再保留一个结果，本文发现 3–4 步少步采样器只要优化初始噪声就能高度复现全步输出，说明差输出不是重建能力不足。基于此用端点监督 (endpoint supervision) 学习对初始噪声与去噪更新的修正，得到可廉价筛选候选的预览：无条件基准上重建 MSE 比重训的 LD3 低 53–78%，并在 SD1.5、SDXL、FLUX.1-dev 上改善排序保持与候选选择。
Motivation: 扩散工作流里采样延迟被放大：用户要生成并丢弃大量候选才保留一个，而标准少步采样器输出差被误认为重建能力不足，导致筛选只能靠昂贵的全步生成。
Method: 先只优化初始噪声，验证冻结的 3–4 步采样器可复现对应全步输出；再用端点监督学习对初始噪声与去噪更新的修正，使少步输出与同噪声同 prompt 的全步输出对齐，输入修正可跨采样预算迁移而无需重训。
Result: 无条件基准上重建 MSE 比 retrained LD3 低 53–78%；在 SD1.5、SDXL、FLUX.1-dev 上排序保持 (ranking preservation) 与候选选择均改善。
Conclusion: 少步采样器的低质量输出源于初始噪声与更新的偏差而非容量不足，修正输入即可用作可信预览，把全步生成留给有希望的候选，且输入修正可跨采样预算复用。

papers.title: Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging the strong generative capabilities and stable training dynamics of diffusion models, diffusion-based recommender systems (RSs) have recently emerged as a novel recommendation paradigm, attracting increasing attention from both academia and industry. However, despite the rapid growth of diffusion-based RSs, a critical issue has emerged: the lack of a unified and systematic quantitative evaluation benchmark, which often results in irreproducible experimental results and unfair comparisons across studies due to inconsistent data processing, training configurations, inference procedures, and evaluation protocols. To address this challenge, we propose Eval4DiRec, the first unified and open-source evaluation framework specifically designed for diffusion-based RSs. Eval4DiRec supports 14 representative diffusion-based RS models across five different recommendation scenarios, providing consistent and reproducible experimental settings to systematically assess their performance. Built upon this framework, we conduct extensive empirical studies to benchmark these models under unified protocols. The results highlight the strong potential of diffusion models for recommendation while also revealing key factors and practical challenges that substantially affect their performance, thereby establishing a solid foundation to facilitate fair evaluation and guide future research in this promising field. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/Eval4DiRec.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data (TKDD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Eval4DiRec 提出首个面向扩散推荐系统 (diffusion-based RS) 的统一开源评测框架，在一致的数据处理、训练配置、推理流程与评测协议下系统评估 14 个代表性扩散推荐模型、覆盖五种推荐场景。统一协议下的实证研究既显示扩散模型在推荐上的强潜力，也暴露出显著影响性能的关键因素与实际挑战。
Motivation: 扩散推荐系统增长迅速，但各研究的数据处理、训练配置、推理流程与评测协议不一致，导致实验不可复现、跨研究比较不公平，缺少统一的定量评测基准。
Method: 构建统一开源评测框架 Eval4DiRec，对 14 个代表性扩散推荐模型在五种推荐场景下施加一致且可复现的实验设置，并在此框架上按统一协议开展系统性实证研究进行基准测试；代码与数据在 GitHub 开源。
Result: 框架支持 14 个代表性扩散推荐模型、覆盖 5 种推荐场景；统一协议下的实证基准显示扩散模型在推荐上具有强潜力，同时揭示了显著影响其性能的关键因素与实际挑战。
Conclusion: 统一评测协议是让扩散推荐结果可复现、可公平比较的前提，该框架为该领域的公平评测与后续研究提供基准。

summary_sections.motivation: 扩散推荐系统增长迅速，但各研究的数据处理、训练配置、推理流程与评测协议不一致，导致实验不可复现、跨研究比较不公平，缺少统一的定量评测基准。
summary_sections.method: 构建统一开源评测框架 Eval4DiRec，对 14 个代表性扩散推荐模型在五种推荐场景下施加一致且可复现的实验设置，并在此框架上按统一协议开展系统性实证研究进行基准测试；代码与数据在 GitHub 开源。
summary_sections.result: 框架支持 14 个代表性扩散推荐模型、覆盖 5 种推荐场景；统一协议下的实证基准显示扩散模型在推荐上具有强潜力，同时揭示了显著影响其性能的关键因素与实际挑战。
summary_sections.conclusion: 统一评测协议是让扩散推荐结果可复现、可公平比较的前提，该框架为该领域的公平评测与后续研究提供基准。

papers.title: GeoCFM: Positive-Only Conditional Flow Matching for Mineral Occurrence Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Critical mineral discovery is a positive-only problem: deposits are observed as sparse locations, while unlabeled regions are not reliable negatives, and similar geophysical signatures can arise from different subsurface states. We therefore model mineral targeting as learning a conditional spatial distribution over occurrence locations, $π(p\mid d)$, given geo-images $d$, rather than predicting a deterministic per-pixel score map. We introduce GeoCFM, a conditional flow-matching model that generates mineral occurrence point sets conditioned on multi-channel geo-images; GeoCFM learns a point-wise transport field in $\mathbb{R}^2$, using UNet features with point-conditioned velocity prediction to bridge dense rasters and sparse supervision without pseudo-negatives. On a synthetic magnetics--geochemistry benchmark with latent activation and on USGS Earth MRI data with a spatially disjoint tile split, GeoCFM improves geometric agreement with observed occurrences over score-map and non-conditional baselines, while representing epistemic uncertainty through conditional sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoCFM 把矿产找矿建模为给定多通道地球物理图像的条件空间分布 π(p|d)，用条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 在 R² 上生成矿产出现点集，无需伪负样本。在含隐层激活的合成磁法-地球化学基准与 USGS Earth MRI 空间不相交切分上，其与观测出现点的几何一致性优于打分图和非条件基线，并通过条件采样表达认知不确定性。
Motivation: 矿产发现是纯正例问题：矿床只是稀疏位置，未标注区域不是可靠负样本，不同地下状态可产生相似地球物理响应，逐像素打分图无法表达这种不确定性。
Method: GeoCFM 用 UNet 提取多通道 geo-image 特征，以点条件速度预测 (point-conditioned velocity prediction) 学习 R² 中的逐点传输场，通过流匹配把稠密栅格与稀疏监督桥接，直接生成条件点集而无需伪负样本。
Result: 在合成 magnetics–geochemistry 基准（含 latent activation）与 USGS Earth MRI 数据（空间不相交 tile split）上，GeoCFM 对观测出现点的几何一致性优于 score-map 基线与非条件基线，并可用条件采样表示 epistemic uncertainty。
Conclusion: 把找矿当作条件点过程生成而非逐像素打分，能在纯正例、无可靠负样本的设定下更贴合观测矿点并保留不确定性。

papers.title: SkillFocus: Evolving Agent Skills via Capability Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Agent skill evolution seeks to improve reusable procedural guidance for large language model (LLM) agents through iterative revision. Existing methods base each revision mainly on execution trajectories or feedback, leaving recurring behavioral requirements across tasks implicit and tying revision to the behavior of the current skill. We introduce SkillFocus, which decomposes recurring task requirements into a capability space that remains fixed as the skill evolves, separating what tasks require from how the current skill behaves. SkillFocus maps current task outcomes to this space to identify the capability that leaves the most tasks unresolved, then uses that capability to determine what to revise and which evidence to use. Across four benchmarks spanning heterogeneous tasks, SkillFocus achieves the best held-out accuracy on all four, outperforming the strongest competing result by 5.7 points on average while using 24\% fewer evolution tokens on average than the closest iterative baseline. Controlled studies further show that capabilities derived from recurring task requirements outperform task-semantic and execution-derived alternatives, while randomizing task--capability assignments reduces final accuracy by up to 20.2 points. Matching evidence to the selected capability increases candidate gain by 4.4 points under prioritized revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillFocus 把跨任务反复出现的行为要求分解成一个固定的能力空间 (capability space)，与技能本身的演化解耦：先将当前任务结果映射到该空间、找出让最多任务未解决的能力，再据此决定改什么、用哪些证据。在四个异构任务基准上，它在全部四个上取得最佳 held-out accuracy，平均比最强竞争结果高 5.7 点，同时平均少用 24% 的演化 token。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 技能演化方法每次修订主要依赖执行轨迹或反馈，把跨任务反复出现的行为要求留作隐含信息，且修订被当前技能的行为绑死，难以定位真正卡住多数任务的能力缺口。
Method: SkillFocus 将反复出现的任务要求分解为固定的能力空间，把当前任务结果映射到该空间以选出未解决任务最多的能力，再用该能力决定修订目标与证据选择（capability-matched evidence）；对照实验比较能力来源（recurring task requirements vs. task-semantic vs. execution-derived）并做随机 task–capability 打乱。
Result: 在四个异构任务基准上，SkillFocus 在全部四个上 held-out accuracy 最佳，平均比最强竞争结果高 5.7 点，平均比最接近的迭代基线少用 24% evolution tokens；由反复任务要求导出的能力优于 task-semantic 与 execution-derived 两种替代来源；随机打乱 task–capability 对应使最终 accuracy 最多下降 20.2 点；在 prioritized revision 下按能力匹配证据使 candidate gain 提高 4.4 点。
Conclusion: 把“任务需要什么”与“当前技能怎么做”分开、并围绕固定能力空间组织修订，比依赖轨迹反馈的迭代修订更有效且更省 token；能力来源与证据匹配方式是决定最终精度的关键。

papers.title: HyperDAM: Hyperspectral Distractor-Aware Memory with Amodal Expansion for SAM 3 Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral video provides material cues that can disambiguate targets with similar false-color appearance, yet foundation-model trackers update memory primarily from spatial and appearance evidence. We present HyperDAM, a DAM4SAM3-based hyperspectral tracker with three principal contributions. First, HOTC2026-Modal adds human-verified frame-wise modal masks and mask-tight boxes to all 481 organizer-provided HOTC 2026 videos. Second, a frame-zero-calibrated HSI gate rejects spectrally inconsistent updates to the distractor-resolving memory (DRM) without altering the current prediction. Third, a causal spatiotemporal expander adds outward-only amodal corrections from frozen SAM features. Static-scene recovery and empty-mask RTS smoothing address target switches and full occlusion. Model selection prioritizes cross-domain robustness over leaderboard-specific optimization. The final system ranked second in HOTC 2026, achieving 68.0093% AUC and 87.7703% DP@20 in the organizer's private evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperDAM 是基于 DAM4SAM3 的高光谱视频跟踪器，用光谱一致性门控 (HSI gate) 拒绝对干扰物分辨记忆 (DRM) 的错误更新，并用因果时空扩展器从冻结 SAM 特征做仅向外的 amodal 修正。在 HOTC 2026 私有评测中排名第二，AUC 68.0093%、DP@20 87.7703%。
Motivation: 高光谱视频含可区分目标与相似假彩色干扰物的材质线索，但基础模型跟踪器的记忆更新主要依赖空间与外观证据，容易在干扰物和完全遮挡下切换目标。
Method: 三项组成：HOTC2026-Modal 为全部 481 段主办方视频补充人工核验的逐帧模态掩码与紧掩码框；frame-zero 校准的 HSI gate 在不改动当前预测的前提下拒绝光谱不一致的 DRM 更新；因果时空扩展器从冻结 SAM 特征加入仅向外的 amodal 修正，另配静态场景恢复与空掩码 RTS 平滑处理目标切换和完全遮挡，模型选择优先跨域鲁棒而非刷榜。
Result: 在 HOTC 2026 主办方私有评测中排名第二，AUC 68.0093%，DP@20 87.7703%；数据侧为全部 481 段主办方视频提供逐帧模态掩码与 mask-tight boxes。
Conclusion: 把光谱证据接入记忆更新而非当前预测，配合 amodal 向外修正与遮挡平滑，可在跨域高光谱跟踪竞赛中取得第二名；作者明确以跨域鲁棒性优先于榜单特化。

papers.title: Org-Agent: Beyond Personal Assistants Towards Organizational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents serving organizations must coordinate requests from multiple users while using knowledge distributed across their interactions. We identify two complementary capabilities for this setting, namely cross-user interaction and decision-making, as well as cross-user memory and knowledge use. Both capabilities are governed by organizational constraints across three aspects: user identity, authority, and access permissions; the attribution and temporal validity of information; and rules for resolving conflicting requirements across users and completion requirements for joint decisions. These constraints shape what information or decisions must be obtained before an action can proceed and what conditions must be satisfied during its execution. Motivated by this, we introduce Org-Agent, a unified constraint-centric reasoning framework that organizes task execution in three stages. Specifically, Org-Agent decomposes a task into atomic subtasks and constructs a task dependency graph whose edges encode the dependencies among them. Building on this graph, it schedules the subtasks in dependency order through topological sorting. It then executes each subtask while accounting for the task's constraints, supported by evidence-acquisition and memory-management tools. Experiments on MUSES-Bench and GroupMemBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Org-Agent on both capabilities, and ablations further support the contributions of dependency modeling and tool use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Org-Agent 把组织级 LLM agent 的执行改写成约束中心的三阶段流程：先将任务拆成原子子任务并构建带依赖边的任务依赖图，再按拓扑序调度，最后在证据获取与记忆管理工具支持下带约束执行。在 MUSES-Bench 与 GroupMemBench 上验证了跨用户交互决策与跨用户记忆知识两类能力，消融支持依赖建模与工具使用的贡献。
Motivation: 服务组织的 agent 需同时协调多用户请求并利用分散在交互中的知识，但用户身份权限、信息时效归属、冲突消解与联合决策完成条件这类组织约束决定了动作能否发起与执行，通用个人助手框架没有统一处理这些约束。
Method: Org-Agent 分三阶段：把任务分解为原子子任务并构建编码依赖关系的任务依赖图；按拓扑排序以依赖顺序调度子任务；执行时结合约束，配以 evidence-acquisition 与 memory-management 工具。
Result: 在 MUSES-Bench 与 GroupMemBench 上的实验展示了 Org-Agent 在跨用户交互决策与跨用户记忆知识两类能力上的有效性，消融实验进一步支持依赖建模与工具使用的贡献。
Conclusion: 把组织约束显式建模为任务依赖图并按依赖序执行，是让 LLM agent 同时做好跨用户协作与跨用户知识利用的可行路径。

papers.title: P2P: Cross-View Population Denoising for Unpaired Single-Cell Perturbation Response Prediction
papers.abstract_en: AIVC (AI Virtual Cell) is a learned simulator of cellular behavior across conditions. Predicting how a cell population responds transcriptionally to a genetic perturbation is a core task. Perturb-seq records that response by destructive sequencing, so a control cell and a perturbed cell are never observed as a pair, and cells under one condition remain heterogeneous and noisy. Regression on individual cells absorbs sampling variation into the estimated effect, whereas interpretation requires the reproducible population effect. P2P (Perturbation-to-Perturbation) takes a stochastic cell-set view as its supervision unit. Two views drawn from the same condition share a reproducible population effect and differ by view-specific variation. A permutation-invariant set encoder summarizes the control population, a structured encoder represents perturbation tokens, cellular context, dose, and combination interactions, and a gate blends empirical condition-effect memory with a neural residual. A heteroscedastic head predicts the population mean and gene-wise response variance. Under one protocol and five seeds, P2P attains the lowest expression RMSE and the highest Effect Pearson, DEG F1, and DEG average precision on each of Adamson, Norman, Replogle K562, and Replogle RPE1 relative to GenePert, LinearPert, SLIM, Scouter, and scPILOT. On Replogle K562, Effect Pearson rises from 0.643 to 0.702 and DEG F1 rises from 0.067 to 0.178 relative to Scouter, the strongest baseline on both metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P2P 把同一条件下的两个随机细胞集视图当作监督单元，用置换不变集合编码器概括对照群体、结构化编码器表示扰动 token 与剂量，并以门控混合经验条件效应记忆与神经残差，异方差头同时预测群体均值与基因响应方差。在 Adamson、Norman、Replogle K562、Replogle RPE1 四个 Perturb-seq 数据集上，单协议五种子下其表达 RMSE 最低、Effect Pearson、DEG F1 与 DEG 平均精度最高；Replogle K562 上相对最强基线 Scouter，Effect Pearson 从 0.643 升到 0.702，DEG F1 从 0.067 升到 0.178。
Motivation: Perturb-seq 是破坏性测序，对照细胞与扰动细胞永远不成对，且同条件细胞高度异质有噪声；对单细胞做回归会把采样波动吸收进效应估计，而下游解释需要可复现的群体效应。
Method: P2P 以随机细胞集视图 (stochastic cell-set view) 为监督单位：同条件两个视图共享可复现群体效应、差异只来自视图特有变异。置换不变集合编码器汇总对照群体，结构化编码器编码扰动 token、细胞上下文、剂量与组合互作，门控把经验条件效应记忆与神经残差混合，异方差预测头输出群体均值与逐基因响应方差。
Result: 在单协议、五个种子下，P2P 在 Adamson、Norman、Replogle K562、Replogle RPE1 四个数据集上均取得最低表达 RMSE 与最高 Effect Pearson、DEG F1、DEG 平均精度，对比 GenePert、LinearPert、SLIM、Scouter、scPILOT。Replogle K562 上相对 Scouter（两项指标上最强基线），Effect Pearson 由 0.643 升至 0.702，DEG F1 由 0.067 升至 0.178。

papers.title: VastMAT: A Large-Scale Multi-Category Benchmark for Multi-Animal Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) supports the study of animal movement, behavior, and group interactions. However, general multi-object tracking (MOT) benchmarks primarily focus on pedestrians and vehicles, whereas dedicated MAT benchmarks remain limited in jointly supporting broad animal coverage, large-scale video data, and extensive within-video multi-instance association. To address this gap, we introduce VastMAT, which has four key characteristics: (1) Large scale. It comprises 2,947 videos with 1,002,562 annotated frames, totaling 27.85 hours. (2) Broad category coverage. These videos cover 337 animal categories with diverse morphologies and motion patterns. (3) Extensive instance annotations. It provides 3,663,248 bounding boxes and 22,883 identity trajectories---to our knowledge, the largest numbers of both among dedicated MAT benchmarks. (4) High-quality annotations. To ensure reliability, annotations undergo iterative expert review and correction, and quality is assessed through an independent reannotation audit. To systematically assess tracking performance and cross-category generalization, we establish Seen-category and category-disjoint Unseen-category protocols, and evaluate eight representative MOT methods under both protocols. Under these protocols, the highest baseline HOTA scores are 66.37\% and 52.90\%, respectively, highlighting the challenge of tracking unseen animals. To address the low-overlap association challenge revealed by our analysis, we propose Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA), a lightweight module that adaptively combines IoU with center similarity normalized by the boxes' own scales. Without additional training, CDA improves TrackTrack's HOTA by 1.58 and 1.31 percentage points under the two protocols, respectively. To facilitate further MAT research, we will publicly release our benchmark and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VastMAT 是面向多动物跟踪 (MAT) 的大规模基准：2,947 段视频、1,002,562 帧、27.85 小时、337 个动物类别、3,663,248 个框与 22,883 条身份轨迹，并设 Seen 与类别不相交的 Unseen 两套协议。八个 MOT 基线在两套协议下最高 HOTA 分别为 66.37% 与 52.90%，说明未见动物更难；免训练的 Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA) 把 TrackTrack 的 HOTA 再抬 1.58 与 1.31 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 MOT 基准集中在行人与车辆，专用 MAT 基准在动物覆盖广度、视频规模和同视频多实例关联三方面同时受限，跨类别泛化难以系统评估。
Method: 构建含 337 类动物的视频基准，标注经迭代专家复核并由独立重标注审计质检；设 Seen-category 与类别不相交的 Unseen-category 协议，评测八个代表性 MOT 方法；另提出轻量模块 CDA，把 IoU 与按框自身尺度归一化的中心相似度自适应结合，无需额外训练。
Result: 基准含 2,947 段视频、1,002,562 帧、27.85 小时、337 类、3,663,248 个边界框、22,883 条身份轨迹。八个基线在 Seen 与 Unseen 协议下最高 HOTA 分别为 66.37% 与 52.90%。CDA 免训练使 TrackTrack 的 HOTA 在两套协议下分别提升 1.58 与 1.31 个百分点。
Conclusion: 未见类别的动物跟踪显著更难，而低重叠关联是可攻的瓶颈：把中心相似度按框尺度归一化后与 IoU 融合，无需训练即可带来稳定增益；基准与代码将公开。

papers.title: CAR-VLA: Complexity-Aware and Risk-Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Existing adaptive reasoning methods for driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on whether to reason, overlooking how reasoning should differ across driving situations. Our key insight is that while scene complexity informs reasoning depth, dynamic risk is equally critical for deciding how to reason in time-critical situations. We therefore propose CAR-VLA, a unified driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus. CAR-VLA maps four complexity--risk categories to three reasoning modes: \textit{Fast Intuition} for direct trajectory generation in simple low-risk scenes, \textit{Slow Thinking} for deliberate reasoning in complex low-risk scenes, and \textit{Reflex Response} for compact, hazard-focused reasoning in high-risk scenes regardless of complexity. Rather than merely shortening deliberation, Reflex Response centers reasoning on the most critical hazard and the immediate safe response. We train CAR-VLA through progressive supervised learning that links scene assessment, reasoning-mode selection, and trajectory generation, followed by reasoning-augmented reinforcement learning to improve driving quality and reasoning behavior. Experiments on NAVSIM v1(91.1 PDMS), NAVSIM v2(90.3 EPDMS), and Navhard(35.0 EPDMS) demonstrate competitive driving performance. Qualitative comparisons on navtest and in-house high-risk scenarios further illustrate risk-aware reasoning and hazard-responsive trajectory generation. The code for this paper will be released publicly at: https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAR-VLA 把场景复杂度与动态风险联合映射到三种推理模式：简单低风险走 Fast Intuition 直接生成轨迹，复杂低风险走 Slow Thinking 深思，高风险一律走 Reflex Response 做紧凑的危险聚焦推理。在 NAVSIM v1 取得 91.1 PDMS、NAVSIM v2 90.3 EPDMS、Navhard 35.0 EPDMS，显示风险自适应推理在时间紧迫场景下仍保持竞争力的驾驶表现。
Motivation: 现有驾驶 VLA 的自适应推理只决定要不要推理，不决定在不同驾驶情境下该怎么推理；而时间紧迫场景里动态风险与场景复杂度同等关键。
Method: CAR-VLA 将四个复杂度-风险类别映射到三种推理模式（Fast Intuition / Slow Thinking / Reflex Response），训练分两阶段：先用渐进式监督学习串联场景评估、推理模式选择与轨迹生成，再用推理增强的强化学习提升驾驶质量与推理行为。
Result: NAVSIM v1 91.1 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 90.3 EPDMS，Navhard 35.0 EPDMS；另在 navtest 与内部高风险场景上做定性对比，展示风险感知推理与危险响应式轨迹生成。
Conclusion: 同时以复杂度和动态风险决定推理的深度、紧迫度与焦点，能让驾驶 VLA 在高风险场景把推理收敛到最关键危险与即时安全响应，而非一味缩短思考。

papers.title: Look Before You Select: Rethinking Vocabulary Sparsification in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) uses teacher correction on student-generated responses. Full-vocabulary correction can provide important corrections even for tokens that the student assigns low probability, but backpropagating through all token logits becomes memory-intensive for long sequences. Existing memory-saving approaches estimate corrections from sampled tokens or restrict supervision to the student's TopK tokens, introducing sampling noise or changing the full-vocabulary correction. We introduce \textbf{SparseOPD}, which uses full-vocabulary teacher correction to determine which corrections matter before selecting the token logits to differentiate. SparseOPD first constructs the full-vocabulary correction without retaining its backward graph, then selects tokens by correction magnitude rather than student probability. Signed residual compensation preserves the total promoting and suppressing correction mass, while correction-aware budget allocation distributes the sparse support across positions. Finally, the update backpropagates only through the selected token logits. Across six task--scale settings spanning mathematics, chemistry QA, and multimodal reasoning, SparseOPD outperforms Sampled Token and TopK in task-average accuracy and matches or exceeds Full Vocabulary. Gradient cosine similarity reaches 99\% on 4B mathematics, while 8K full-parameter profiling shows 70.5\% lower backward memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparseOPD 在 on-policy distillation 中先无梯度地构造全词表教师修正，再按修正幅度而非学生概率挑选要反传的 token logits，从而在保留全词表修正语义的同时降低显存。在数学、化学 QA 与多模态推理六个任务-规模设置上，其任务平均准确率超过 Sampled Token 与 TopK，并持平或超过 Full Vocabulary；4B 数学设置梯度余弦相似度达 99%，8K 全参数 profiling 显示反向显存降低 70.5%。
Motivation: OPD 的全词表修正即使对低概率 token 也含重要纠正，但对全部 logits 反传在长序列上显存开销过大；现有省显存做法要么用采样 token 估计引入噪声，要么只监督 TopK，改变了全词表修正本身。
Method: 先构造全词表教师修正但不保留其 backward graph，再按修正幅度（而非学生概率）选择 token；用 signed residual compensation 保持促进与抑制修正总量守恒，用 correction-aware budget allocation 在各位置分配稀疏支撑，最后只对选中 logits 反传。
Result: 在覆盖数学、化学 QA、多模态推理的六个任务-规模设置上，任务平均准确率高于 Sampled Token 与 TopK，并持平或超过 Full Vocabulary；4B 数学设置梯度余弦相似度达 99%，8K 全参数 profiling 中反向显存降低 70.5%。
Conclusion: 按修正幅度而非学生概率挑选稀疏支撑，可以在不牺牲全词表修正效果的前提下把 OPD 的反向显存压下来。

papers.title: Just-In-Time Agent Memory with Runtime Agentic Research
papers.abstract_en: Memory is critical for AI agents. Many existing agent-memory systems follow an Ahead-of-Time (AOT) design, constructing memory before a specific request arrives. While this reduces online serving cost, such request-agnostic memory construction can discard fine-grained information that later becomes important. To address this limitation, we propose Just-In-Time Agent Memory (JAM), a trainable framework for query-conditioned context construction at runtime. A Memorizer preserves complete raw histories in a hierarchical page-store with compact navigational summaries, while a Researcher iteratively retrieves, inspects, and integrates evidence for each request. To train these memory-use behaviors, we introduce Memory-Gym, an evidence-grounded data synthesis pipeline covering nine task types across six domains, and optimize the Researcher through verified-trajectory supervised fine-tuning followed by Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of JAM across a variety of benchmarks on agent memory and long-context processing, where it achieves stronger task performance than AOT-style memory systems while remaining substantially more efficient than prior trained agentic memory approaches. To support reproducibility and future research, we release our anonymized source code at https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/general-agentic-memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 JAM（Just-In-Time Agent Memory）：不在请求到来前预建记忆，而是在运行时按查询条件构造上下文，由 Memorizer 用分层 page-store 保存完整原始历史加紧凑导航摘要，Researcher 针对每个请求迭代检索、查阅并整合证据。在 agent memory 与长上下文处理的多项基准上，JAM 的任务表现强于 AOT 式记忆系统，同时比此前的 trained agentic memory 方法显著更省。
Motivation: AOT 式 agent 记忆在请求到来前构造记忆，请求无关的取舍会丢掉事后才变得关键的细粒度信息，而在线服务成本又限制了按需重建。
Method: JAM 是可训练的运行时查询条件化上下文构造框架：Memorizer 以分层 page-store 保存完整原始历史并配紧凑导航摘要；Researcher 迭代检索、查阅、整合证据。训练用 Memory-Gym（覆盖六个领域、九类任务的证据锚定数据合成流水线），先做 verified-trajectory 监督微调，再用 Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization 优化 Researcher。
Result: 在 agent memory 与长上下文处理的多项基准上，JAM 任务表现优于 AOT 式记忆系统，且比此前 trained agentic memory 方法效率高得多；Memory-Gym 合成数据覆盖 6 个领域、9 类任务。
Conclusion: 把记忆构造推迟到请求时刻并用 RL 训练检索整合行为，可以在不牺牲效率的前提下超过预建式记忆；作者已开源代码以支持复现。

papers.title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboIRG-Bench 把机器人指令中的隐式指代 (Implicit Referential Grounding, IRG) 拆成 direct、reasoning-mediated、spatial、contextual 四类挑战，用 11 个任务派生的 40 个变体系统评测各类 VLA 的记忆机制。结果显示在显式指令下表现好的模型，一旦需要从上下文恢复同一任务信息就急剧退化，reasoning-mediated 与 spatial 指代最难；换用更强的外部 VLM 也不能消除该差距，且在 Franka Research 3 实机上同样表现为指代对象错误与下游执行失败。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 基准都假设任务相关信息在指令中被显式给出，而真实人类指令常以隐式方式指代物体、数量与关系，机器人必须从语言与感知上下文中恢复目标，这一能力此前缺少系统评测。
Method: 基于 RoboMME 构建 RoboIRG-Bench，含 11 个任务派生的 40 个变体，覆盖 direct、reasoning-mediated、spatial、contextual 四类指代挑战；评测覆盖采用不同记忆机制的代表性 VLA 模型，并在 Franka Research 3 机械臂上做真实操作验证。
Result: 显式指令下表现良好的 VLA 在需要从上下文恢复信息时性能急剧下降，形成明显的 referential robustness gap；reasoning-mediated 与 spatial 指代尤其困难；使用外部 VLM 的模型鲁棒性更强但仍有显著失败，且把外部 VLM 换成更强模型也无法消除差距；该 gap 在 Franka Research 3 实机操作中持续存在，表现为指代对象错误与下游执行失败。
Conclusion: IRG 是机器人指令跟随中一个独立且研究不足的能力，可靠 VLA 必须同时稳健地整合语言、感知、推理与动作，单纯提升外部 VLM 强度不足以弥补该差距。

papers.title: Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Video and audio are perceived together, yet most generative models treat them in isolation. We examine methods that model the two modalities jointly, generate one from the other, or edit them in a coupled manner, organized around a single question: how is the output kept coherent across modalities in time and semantics? A unified formulation casts joint generation, cross-modal generation, and joint editing as three problems defined on a single distribution over audio-visual pairs, and a taxonomy compares methods along five design axes. To our knowledge, this is the first overview to systematically taxonomize joint audio-visual editing, which we map as nine edit categories spanning 28 edit types. We describe methods, datasets, and metrics for each setting and close with the open problems we view as most consequential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视频-音频的联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑统一写成同一个音视频对分布上的三个问题，并按五个设计轴建立方法分类体系；据作者所知是首个系统整理联合音视频编辑的综述，将编辑划分为 9 类、覆盖 28 种编辑类型。
Motivation: 视频与音频在感知上同步，但多数生成模型各自独立处理两种模态，跨模态在时间与语义上的一致性缺少统一的问题定义与可比较的分类框架。
Method: 以单一音视频对分布统一形式化联合生成、跨模态生成、联合编辑三类任务，沿五个设计轴比较方法，并按类别梳理各设定下的方法、数据集与度量。
Result: 给出 9 类编辑、28 种编辑类型的分类映射；据作者所知为首个系统 taxonomize 联合音视频编辑的综述，全文 36 页、含 3 图 15 表。
Conclusion: 跨模态时间与语义一致性是组织音视频生成与编辑方法的核心问题，统一形式化加五轴分类可作为该领域的比较基准与开放问题清单。

papers.title: DPS: Dual-Mode Precision LLM Serving with Semi-Unified Memory
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM serving systems virtualize and optimize KV-cache memory, but treat model-weight memory as fixed throughout execution. Recent work on multi-precision model representations challenges this design by allowing a single stored model to support both full-accuracy and lower-precision execution, making the effective weight footprint runtime-dependent. This creates an opportunity under bursty workloads, where temporary spikes in KV-cache demand often determine throughput and SLO compliance. We present DPS, a dual-precision LLM serving system that turns weight memory into an elastic resource: under normal load, DPS serves the full-accuracy model; under KV pressure, it switches to a nested, lower-precision variant and repurposes unused weight memory for KV cache blocks. DPS is built on Semi-Unified Memory (SUM), which partitions the weight region into a persistent lower-precision sub-region and a shared region that alternates between residual weight tensors and KV-cache blocks, preserving compatibility with paged KV-cache management. We implement DPS on top of vLLM and evaluate it across both dense and MoE models and various production workload traces. Our results show that \sysname improves sustained throughput by $2.1$--$3.3\times$ and effective pass@1 by up to $+41$\,pp over Static FP16, while preserving FP16-class accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DPS 把 LLM 权重内存变成弹性资源：常态负载跑全精度模型，KV-cache 压力上来时切到嵌套的低精度变体，腾出的权重内存转给 KV 块。在 vLLM 上对 dense 与 MoE 模型及多种生产负载 trace 的评测中，相对 Static FP16 持续吞吐提升 2.1–3.3×，有效 pass@1 最多 +41 pp，同时保持 FP16 级精度。
Motivation: 现有 LLM serving 系统只虚拟化优化 KV-cache 内存，把模型权重内存当作执行期固定不变；而突发负载下 KV-cache 需求的临时尖峰往往决定吞吐与 SLO 达标。
Method: 基于多精度模型表示（单一存储模型同时支持全精度与低精度执行），提出 Semi-Unified Memory (SUM)：把权重区划为常驻低精度子区与共享区，共享区在残差权重张量和 KV-cache 块之间交替，保持与 paged KV-cache 管理的兼容；系统在 vLLM 之上实现。
Result: 在 dense 与 MoE 模型及多种生产负载 trace 上，相对 Static FP16 持续吞吐提升 2.1–3.3×，有效 pass@1 最多 +41 pp，并保持 FP16 级精度。
Conclusion: 在 KV 压力下用低精度变体换回权重内存，可以在不牺牲 FP16 级精度的前提下同时抬高 LLM serving 的吞吐与有效 pass@1。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major release PRs containing 1000+ lines of new code from diverse GitHub repositories as the primary source for synthesizing challenging task-level data. Additionally, we introduce Multi-Task Chaining, which chains multiple generated tasks into a single more challenging task, enabling the synthesis of tasks with frontier-level difficulty. For rejection sampling finetuning, we combine strong teacher model with diverse harnesses to generate trajectories on our synthesized tasks and conduct supervised finetuning on base model with rejection sampled trajectories. For reinforcement learning, cold-started model performs real-world execution through harnesses in independent sandboxes during rollout process, effectively facilitating the acquisition of genuine ultra-long-horizon execution capability. We further propose a novel reward strategy, Later Stage Bonus Reward, which explicitly encourages model to perform meaningful maneuvers during later stages of execution. Through extensive evaluation on 5 benchmarks containing ultra-long-horizon tasks, Marathoner achieves consistent and substantial performance improvements over base model and even surpasses performance of strong proprietary model. Further analysis shows that Marathoner can consistently work for 10+ hours and conduct 1000+ tool calls on highly challenging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Marathoner 是一个面向超长时程 (ultra-long-horizon) 执行的自主智能体模型，用「任务合成—拒绝采样微调—强化学习」三段后训练管线把长期坚持能力注入基座模型：从 GitHub 上 1000+ 行新增代码的发布 PR 合成任务，用 Multi-Task Chaining 串成前沿难度任务，并以 Later Stage Bonus Reward 显式奖励执行后期的有效动作。在 5 个含超长时程任务的 benchmark 上一致大幅超过基座模型并超过某强闭源模型，可连续工作 10+ 小时、执行 1000+ 次工具调用。
Motivation: 人类能为一个目标连续工作数月数年，而现有模型难以维持超长时程的自主执行；需要一种后训练手段把这种能力真正注入基座模型，而不是靠单轮任务表现。
Method: 后训练管线含三部分：Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis 从多样 GitHub 仓库中 1000+ 行新代码的 major release PR 合成任务级数据，再用 Multi-Task Chaining 把多个生成任务链成单个更难任务；拒绝采样微调用强教师模型配合多种 harness 生成轨迹，对采样后的轨迹做监督微调；强化学习阶段冷启动模型在独立 sandbox 中通过 harness 做真实世界 rollout，并采用 Later Stage Bonus Reward 鼓励后期阶段的有效操作。
Result: 在 5 个含超长时程任务的 benchmark 上，Marathoner 相对基座模型取得一致且显著的性能提升，并超过某强闭源模型；进一步分析显示模型可在高难度任务上连续工作 10+ 小时、完成 1000+ 次工具调用。
Conclusion: 任务级合成加多任务链接、拒绝采样微调与带后期奖励的沙箱 RL 这条组合管线，能把超长时程自主执行能力灌进基座模型，使其在长时程任务上稳定跑赢强闭源模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Before Agents Act: Assurance-Aware Semantic Scheduling for Evidence Acquisition in Distributed Systems
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents can initiate consequential infrastructure changes, yet evidence required for admission may expire while other checks run or depend on a shared fault domain. We formulate evidence acquisition as joint witness selection and scheduling under quorum, diversity, freshness, deadline, and resource constraints. Assurance-Aware Semantic Scheduling (AAS) combines integer-program selection, dispatch-aware temporal scheduling, bounded diagnostic expansion, and receipt-aware repair. Formal results state the assumptions needed for dispatch-time freshness and finite diagnostic expansion. In three generated infrastructure workloads, AAS produces 1,075/1,200 valid candidates versus 647/1,200 for constraint-aware forward scheduling; stale candidates fall from 440 to 12. Paired sensitivity studies reuse the same instances and operation latency draws across parameter settings. A corrected timeout intervention finds 18/20 admissions with repair or full resynthesis versus 0/20 for a static plan, with lower committed cost when receipts are reused. On 20 constructed cases requiring a certified decomposition cut, refinement recovers an oracle-matching feasible plan every time. These are controlled simulation results; the bounded oracle shares a temporal search component, and transfer to deployed systems remains untested.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Extended manuscript with formal proofs and operation catalogue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AAS 把工具型 agent 的证据获取建模为带 quorum、多样性、新鲜度、截止期与资源约束的联合见证选择与调度问题，用整数规划选证据、按派发时序调度、有界诊断扩展加回执感知修复。在三个生成式基础设施负载上，1200 个候选中有效候选 1,075 对约束感知前向调度的 647，过期候选从 440 降到 12；超时干预下修复或完全重合成达成 18/20 次准入，静态计划为 0/20。
Motivation: 工具型 agent 可发起高后果的基础设施变更，而准入所需证据会在其他检查运行期间过期，或依赖同一故障域，导致计划失效或准入失败。
Method: AAS 组合整数规划 (integer-program) 的见证选择、派发感知的时序调度、有界诊断扩展 (bounded diagnostic expansion) 与回执感知修复 (receipt-aware repair)；形式化结果给出派发时新鲜度与诊断扩展有界所需的假设，并在配对敏感性研究中复用同一批实例与操作时延抽样。
Result: 三个生成式基础设施负载上，AAS 产出 1,075/1,200 有效候选，约束感知前向调度为 647/1,200，过期候选从 440 降至 12；修正后的超时干预中，修复或完全重合成达成 18/20 次准入，静态计划 0/20，复用回执时已提交成本更低；20 个需要认证分解割的构造案例上，refinement 每次都恢复与 oracle 匹配的可行计划。
Conclusion: 把证据获取当作受约束的联合选择与调度问题并配合修复，可在受控仿真中大幅减少过期证据并提高准入成功率；作者明确这些是受控仿真结果，有界 oracle 共享时序搜索组件，向部署系统的迁移尚未检验。

summary_sections.motivation: 工具型 agent 可发起高后果的基础设施变更，而准入所需证据会在其他检查运行期间过期，或依赖同一故障域，导致计划失效或准入失败。
