papers.title: LRC-JEPA: Disentangling Dynamics and Residual Context for Efficient World Models
papers.abstract_en: Compact JEPA world models enable efficient latent-space planning, but low-dimensional representation trained under reward-free self-supervision must encode both action-conditioned dynamics and predictable visual context. This competition can entangle controllable state with high-rank nuisance appearance and degrade planning as scenes become more complex. We introduce LRC-JEPA, a lightweight end-to-end world model that routes information into a compact predictive latent $\mathbf{z}$ and learned-query residual-context embeddings $\mathbf{u}$. Only $\mathbf{z}$ is propagated by the dynamics model and used for planning, while $\mathbf{u}$ captures temporally persistent information for cross-attention reconstruction; a differentiable residual connection encourages the latent to retain complementary dynamic content. Under explicit assumptions, we show that the resulting representation is sufficient, minimal, nuisance-invariant, and disentangled. Across four simulated control environments, LRC-JEPA improves average planning success over a parameter-matched JEPA baseline by 9 percentage points and matches or exceeds substantially larger pretrained models. On the real-world Bridge-v2 set, its 5.5M-parameter active encoder outperforms DINO-WM (22.1M) and V-JEPA2 (303.9M) encoders while also enabling faster planning. Physical-state probes, reconstruction interventions, and ablations confirm the effectiveness of LRC-JEPA's representation disentanglement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LRC-JEPA 把 JEPA 世界模型的潜变量拆成由动力学模型传播、用于规划的紧凑预测潜码 z，以及经可微残差连接与交叉注意力承载持久视觉上下文的残差上下文嵌入 u，使表示在显式假设下充分、最小、抗噪且解耦。四个模拟控制环境上平均规划成功率比参数匹配的 JEPA 基线高 9 个百分点，5.5M 参数的主动编码器在真实 Bridge-v2 上超过 DINO-WM（22.1M）与 V-JEPA2（303.9M）编码器且规划更快。
Motivation: 无奖励自监督训练的低维表示必须同时编码动作条件动力学与可预测视觉上下文，二者竞争会把可控状态与高秩干扰外观纠缠，场景变复杂时规划退化。
Method: 端到端轻量世界模型 LRC-JEPA 将信息分流到紧凑预测潜码 z 与可学习查询的残差上下文嵌入 u：仅 z 由动力学模型传播并用于规划，u 通过交叉注意力供重建；可微残差连接促使潜码保留互补动态内容，并在显式假设下给出充分、最小、抗干扰、解耦的表示性质。
Result: 四个模拟控制环境中，平均规划成功率较参数匹配的 JEPA 基线提升 9 个百分点，并匹配或超过规模大得多的预训练模型；真实 Bridge-v2 上，5.5M 参数主动编码器优于 DINO-WM（22.1M）与 V-JEPA2（303.9M）编码器，同时规划更快；物理状态探针、重建干预与消融确认表示解耦有效。
Conclusion: 把持久外观上下文从规划用潜码中分离出去，可在更小参数量下同时保住表示解耦与规划成功率，且规划速度更快。

papers.title: ABC-Align: Prediction-Powered Alignment with Adaptive Bias Control
papers.abstract_en: Language model post-training is often bottlenecked by the need for human-collected preference data, which is expensive and difficult to scale. Reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) style approaches that leverage pseudo labels offer an abundant alternative but introduce systematic biases that degrade downstream alignment. Recent general-purpose semi-supervised methods correct for teacher bias using a small set of human-labeled examples, but suffer from high variance especially when human annotations are scarce. To this end, we propose ABC-Align, leveraging abundant pseudo label signal to minimize variance and applying a lightweight, adaptive correction grounded in the human-labeled subset. The correction strength is tuned automatically during training using plug-in estimates of the relevant bias--variance quantities. On LLM alignment with RLHF, DPO, and GRPO where human feedback is scarce, we empirically demonstrate that ABC-Align achieves superior performance over prior semi-supervised baselines in a series of experiments on an increasing scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/SewoongLab/abc-align .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABC-Align 用大量伪标签压低方差，再用少量人工标注子集做自适应偏差校正，校正强度在训练中由 plug-in 估计的偏差-方差量自动调节。在人工反馈稀缺的 RLHF、DPO、GRPO 对齐设置中，随规模递增的一系列实验里其表现优于既有半监督基线。
Motivation: RLAIF 式伪标签方案引入系统性偏差会损害下游对齐，而现有通用半监督方法在人工标注稀缺时方差过高。
Method: 利用丰富的伪标签信号最小化方差，叠加一个基于人工标注子集的轻量自适应校正；校正强度在训练过程中用 plug-in 估计的偏差-方差量自动调参，应用于 RLHF、DPO、GRPO 三种对齐流程。
Result: 在人工反馈稀缺的 LLM 对齐实验中，ABC-Align 在一系列递增规模的实验上均优于先前的半监督基线；代码发布于 github.com/SewoongLab/abc-align。
Conclusion: 伪标签降方差加人工子集的自适应偏差校正，可以在人工标注稀缺时提升 LLM 对齐效果。

papers.title: Emergence, Not Bandwidth: Physical Coupling and the Limits of Learned Multi-Agent Communication
papers.abstract_en: Rate-limited multi-agent teams raise three questions the emergent-communication literature has answered only empirically: what an optimal message should encode, what compression costs over a horizon, and when a learned protocol is unique enough for a teammate to read. We answer them for rate-limited Dec-POMDPs, then measure how far reinforcement learning falls short of the optimum. Our theorems fix what is achievable independently of any learner, so a gap between an engineered and a learned sender at the same bit budget is an optimization fact, not an information-theoretic one. We instantiate this on three MuJoCo arenas spanning zero, partial and rigid physical coupling, charging every condition exactly 2 bits per decision, and create the discriminating regime by closing a physical side channel within one arena, holding bodies, task and reward fixed. Communication value is governed by coupling: under rigid coupling through a shared object, no channel beats silence (+0.001 +/- 0.001, p = 0.982, n = 25), since proprioception already carries that information; without coupling, every condition solves the task; under partial coupling, the engineered 2-bit sender reaches an interquartile mean of 1.000 but the learned one reaches 0.482, indistinguishable from silence (p = 0.400, n = 25). With a shared alphabet, bandwidth cannot explain the gap. Warm-starting from an engineered receiver localizes the failure: the same channel reaches 0.857 versus 0.562 cold-started (p < 0.001), so it is neither representational nor one of maintenance; reinforcement learning fails to discover the protocol. Cross-play shows learned protocols are individually meaningful but mutually unintelligible: self-play 0.980 collapses to 0.144 across seeds, and our best constructed alignment leaves at least 77% of that gap. All headline results use 25 seeds per arena and seven published baselines at matched rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在速率受限的 Dec-POMDP 中，通信价值由智能体间的物理耦合决定而非带宽：刚性耦合下任何信道都不如沉默（+0.001±0.001，p=0.982），无耦合下所有条件都能解题，只有部分耦合时才需要通信。此时工程设计的 2-bit 发送者达到 1.000 的四分位均值而学习出的发送者只有 0.482（与沉默无异，p=0.400），且跨种子 cross-play 从自博弈 0.980 崩到 0.144。
Motivation: 速率受限多智能体团队的三个问题——最优消息应编码什么、压缩在时域上的代价、学到的协议是否唯一到可被队友解读——此前只有经验性回答，缺少与学习器无关的理论上限。
Method: 对速率受限 Dec-POMDP 给出与学习器无关的最优性定理，再量化强化学习与该上限的差距；在三个 MuJoCo 场景（零、部分、刚性物理耦合）中统一按每决策 2 bits 计费，并在同一场景内关闭物理侧信道、固定身体/任务/奖励构造判别性条件；用工程接收者热启动定位失败环节，并做跨种子 cross-play，全部头条结果 25 seeds、匹配速率下 7 个已发表基线。
Result: 刚性耦合下无信道优于沉默（+0.001±0.001，p=0.982，n=25）；无耦合下所有条件解题；部分耦合下工程 2-bit 发送者四分位均值 1.000、学习发送者 0.482（与沉默无异，p=0.400，n=25）。同一信道热启动接收者达 0.857、冷启动 0.562（p<0.001），排除表征与维护失败。cross-play 自博弈 0.980 跨种子塌到 0.144，最佳构造对齐仍留下至少 77% 的差距。
Conclusion: 同一位宽下的工程与学习发送者之差是优化事实而非信息论事实：强化学习发现不了该协议，且学到的协议各自有意义却跨种子互不可读。

papers.title: PersMem: Internalizing Personality into Dual-Pathway Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The profile of a role-playing agent usually depends on the pre-defined personality in a system prompt, whereas its memory processing pipeline, including prioritisation of stored memories and subsequent retrieval, remains independent of this personality. This separation causes the agent's memory processing to be inconsistent with the pre-defined personality, and makes it difficult to validate whether agent behaviours follow this personality. In this paper, we propose Personality-Integrated Memory (PersMem), which integrates personality into the agent's memory processing pipeline, making it consistently personality-dependent. PersMem processes memory using four steps, where the personality is mapped to operation-specific parameters controlling: (i) affective appraisal annotating emotion states of the user input; (ii) retention of previously stored memories along with the current input; (iii) passive affect-driven memory retrieval exploring memories similar to user input in semantics and personality-guided emotions; and (iv) active goal-driven memory retrieval that refines and selects passively retrieved memories for the reply. Consequently, consistency with the pre-defined personality can be examined by inspecting memory-processing traces during human-agent interactions. We evaluate these personality-dependent differences in attachment and Big Five settings. PersMem exceeds the chance baseline for four-way attachment classification by 23.1 percentage points. In Big Five dialogue comparisons, PersMem achieves 67.5% accuracy, 6.7 percentage points above a baseline using uniformly sampled memories. On CoSER, PersMem achieves an average score of 66.13, with scores of 69.33 for Character Fidelity and 84.33 for Storyline Quality. Together, these results show that PersMem produces distinguishable personality-related memory-processing patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PersMem 把人格从 system prompt 下沉进角色扮演 agent 的记忆流水线，用人格映射出的参数控制情感评估、记忆保留、被动情感检索与主动目标检索四步，使记忆处理痕迹本身可检验人格一致性。在四分类依恋类型判定上超随机基线 23.1 个百分点，Big Five 对话判定准确率 67.5%（比均匀采样记忆基线高 6.7 个百分点），CoSER 平均 66.13（Character Fidelity 69.33、Storyline Quality 84.33）。
Motivation: 角色扮演 agent 的人格只写在 system prompt 里，而记忆的优先级与检索管线与人格脱节，导致记忆处理与既定人格不一致，也难以验证行为是否真的遵循该人格。
Method: 提出 Personality-Integrated Memory (PersMem)，把人格映射为各操作的专用参数，驱动四步记忆处理：情感评估标注用户输入情绪状态、保留既有记忆与当前输入、被动情感驱动检索（语义相似 + 人格引导的情绪相似）、主动目标驱动检索对被动结果做精炼与选择。
Result: 四分类依恋类型判定超随机基线 23.1 个百分点；Big Five 对话比较准确率 67.5%，比均匀采样记忆基线高 6.7 个百分点；CoSER 平均分 66.13，其中 Character Fidelity 69.33、Storyline Quality 84.33。
Conclusion: 把人格接入记忆处理各环节后，agent 会产生可区分、可通过记忆处理痕迹审查的人格相关记忆模式，从而让既定人格的一致性变得可验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) specializes pretrained video diffusion models through teacher supervision along the student's own generation trajectory. Although large video models are natural teachers, developing specialized video experts can require costly video data and training, while querying them incurs substantially higher latency than querying image experts. More readily available and cheaper to query, image experts offer a cost-effective alternative, particularly for largely temporal-agnostic capabilities such as aesthetics and OCR that admit frame-level supervision. However, heterogeneous image and video latent spaces prevent direct supervision of intermediate student states, while image experts lack cross-frame motion supervision, making temporal consistency vulnerable to frame-level improvements. In this paper, we propose MILD, a Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation framework that transfers specialized image expertise while preserving pretrained video dynamics. MILD uses a learnable linear connector that aligns student latent states and predicted updates with those of image experts, enabling supervision transfer across heterogeneous latent spaces. We further constrain image-guided corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to preserve video dynamics and incorporate an optical-flow-based motion reward to improve motion quality and temporal consistency. Across specialized image experts and multiple video-student backbones, our method consistently outperforms video-teacher OPD baselines, with further studies demonstrating effective transfer across connector designs and heterogeneous architectures. These results establish image-to-video distillation as an effective route to improving video generation by drawing on the diverse and evolving capabilities of the image-generation ecosystem.

papers.title: Spexis: Speculative Lookahead Scheduling for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Spexis is a multi-GPU LLM inference framework that improves the efficiency of pipeline and tensor parallelism through speculative parallelism. Rather than using speculative decoding only to accelerate token generation, Spexis runs speculation in parallel with normal execution, introducing a new parallelism axis without increasing KV-cache memory usage. This improves memory efficiency and helps mitigate the bottlenecks of multi-GPU inference. Spexis further uses lookahead scheduling to predict speculation quality and future memory pressure, allowing it to reduce wasted speculation, KV-cache eviction, and recomputation. Built on top of vLLM, Spexis largely improves serving performance across a range of GPU configurations, achieving speedups of up to 34% over a baseline that uses the optimal combination of pipeline and tensor parallelism. Spexis's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mlsys-seo/spexis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spexis 把 speculative decoding 从解码加速手段改造成与正常执行并行的第三条并行轴，在不增加 KV-cache 内存的前提下提升多 GPU LLM 推理效率，并用 lookahead scheduling 预测推测质量与未来内存压力，减少无效推测、KV-cache 驱逐与重计算。在多种 GPU 配置上相对采用最优 pipeline+tensor 并行组合的基线最高加速 34%。
Motivation: 多 GPU LLM 推理中 pipeline 与 tensor 并行的组合已接近最优，KV-cache 内存压力导致驱逐与重计算，进一步提效缺少新的并行维度。
Method: 基于 vLLM 构建，把推测执行与正常执行并行运行，引入不增加 KV-cache 占用的新并行轴；lookahead scheduling 预测每次推测的质量与后续内存压力，据此调度以削减浪费的推测、KV-cache eviction 与 recomputation。
Result: 在一系列 GPU 配置上相对使用最优 pipeline+tensor 并行组合的基线取得最高 34% 的 serving 加速；源码已公开于 github.com/mlsys-seo/spexis。
Conclusion: 把 speculative decoding 用作与常规执行并行的并行轴，配合前瞻式调度，可在不扩 KV-cache 的情况下缓解多 GPU 推理瓶颈。

papers.title: Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OIC-GS 是面向 VR 的全向 Gaussian Splatting 编码器，用分层 HEALPix 球面网格锚定高斯原语以省去坐标编码，并在球面率失真目标下让率失真收益不足、量化不透明度归零的原语自动删除，从而自适应调节原语密度与细节层级。首个视口只需解码 52% 码流即达最终质量并以 1,270 FPS 渲染；在 100 图全向基准上 WS-PSNR BD-rate 相对 GaussianImage++ 降低 49.6%、相对 SGI 降低 68.6%。
Motivation: 学习型图像编码器 (LIC) 重建质量高但 VR 解码太慢，GS 编码器渲染快却质量落后，且原语分配时不考虑每个原语的编码代价。
Method: OIC-GS 采用分层 HEALPix 原语网格，高斯原语锚定在预定义球面位置以消除显式坐标编码，细层级细化粗层级祖先以支持由粗到细分层传输与视口选择解码；对量化原语引入轻量熵模型，并在球面率失真 (spherical rate-distortion) 目标下联合优化，量化不透明度为零的原语被自动移除，无需固定原语预算。
Result: 首个视口仅解码 52% 码流即达最终质量，渲染速度 1,270 FPS；在 100 图全向基准上超过全部被评估的 GS 编码器，WS-PSNR BD-rate 相对 GaussianImage++ 降低 49.6%，相对使用学习熵模型的 SGI 降低 68.6%。
Conclusion: 把原语分配与编码代价放进同一个球面率失真优化里，可以在不设固定原语预算的前提下同时提高全向 GS 的重建质量与视口解码效率，单码流即可支持全球、视口相关与渐进解码。

papers.title: When Harness Beats Scale, and When Reading Beats Both
papers.abstract_en: We describe our system for DocSem, the document-grounded quantitative reasoning shared task at DocInsights 2026, and analyze why it succeeded on labeled data and failed on the test set. The pipeline pairs hybrid block retrieval with Program-of-Thoughts (PoT) generation executed in a sandboxed interpreter, self-consistency sampling, and entity enrichment from chunk-level knowledge graphs. On our held-out split, application architecture moved the metrics far more than model scale did: PoT added 0.282 joint accuracy to a compact 7B model but at most 0.005 to a 72B model, and a 27B model with the full harness matched the 72B (0.884 vs.\ 0.873) at roughly 2.7$\times$ fewer parameters and a quarter of the CO$_2$. We read this through a distinction between world knowledge, which scales steeply with parameters, and language knowledge, which scales gently, and show that structured-output training makes a compact model harness-ready rather than merely small. On the raster, watermarked test PDFs the same system collapsed to 13.58\% joint (rank 149 of 163); a controlled re-rendering of the validation set reproduces the OCR half of the collapse while bounding what the simulation misses. Auditing the physical nature of evaluation inputs precedes architecture, and the leaderboard's bimodality is consistent with reading quality, not reasoning, having separated the field.
papers.comment: Accepted at the DocInsights 2026 Workshop co-located with EMNLP 2026. System description paper for the DocSem document-grounded quantitative reasoning shared task. 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables, 5 appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocSem 文档级定量推理任务上，混合块检索 + Program-of-Thoughts (PoT) 沙箱执行 + self-consistency + 知识图谱实体增强的完整 harness，对小模型的增益远大于换大模型：PoT 给 7B 模型加 0.282 joint accuracy，给 72B 模型最多只加 0.005；27B 配全 harness 达 0.884，反超 72B 的 0.873，参数少约 2.7 倍、CO2 只有四分之一。但在带水印的光栅化测试 PDF 上同一系统塌到 13.58% joint（163 队中第 149），作者主张先审计评测输入的物理可读性再谈架构。
Motivation: 文档级定量推理系统在标注数据上成功、在测试集上失败，需要解释差距来源：究竟是模型规模不够，还是评测输入的物理可读性（扫描/水印 PDF 的 OCR）被忽略了。
Method: 流水线为混合块检索 (hybrid block retrieval) + Program-of-Thoughts (PoT) 生成并在沙箱解释器中执行 + self-consistency 采样 + 基于 chunk 级知识图谱的实体增强；分析框架区分随参数陡增的 world knowledge 与增长平缓的 language knowledge，并用 structured-output 训练让紧凑模型变为 harness-ready。
Result: held-out split 上 PoT 为 7B 模型带来 +0.282 joint accuracy，为 72B 模型最多 +0.005；27B + 全 harness 达 0.884 vs 72B 的 0.873，参数少约 2.7 倍、CO2 约为四分之一。光栅化带水印测试 PDF 上塌至 13.58% joint、排名 149/163；对验证集的受控重渲染复现了塌陷中的 OCR 部分。
Conclusion: 在该任务上应用架构的边际收益超过模型规模，而测试集塌陷由读取质量而非推理能力造成，因此审计评测输入的物理性质应先于架构设计；leaderboard 的双峰分布与这一读取质量解释一致。

papers.title: SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyncRA 通过在单个视频内部对比中间层音频-视觉表征，对齐同时刻、拉开错位时刻，从而强化 omni-modal 模型的时序对应 (temporal correspondence)。监督直接来自输入自带的时间戳，无需额外标注、推理不变；在 4 个开源 omni-modal 模型 × 5 个公开视频基准的全部组合上均超过 answer-only 微调。
Motivation: omni-modal 模型听得见也看得见，却难以把同一时刻的声音与画面对上，会把口述线索配到错误的视觉场景，给出基于错误音画配对的貌似合理答案。
Method: SyncRA (Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment)：在每个视频内部对中间层 audio-visual 表征做对比学习，拉近匹配时刻、推开错位时刻，在共享全局语境下捕捉局部时序对应；监督信号直接由输入时间戳产生，无需额外标注，推理阶段保持不变。
Result: 在 4 个不同规模与架构的开源 omni-modal 模型、5 个公开视频基准的全部 model-benchmark 组合上，SyncRA 一致优于 answer-only 微调；在受控时序交换 (controlled temporal swaps) 评测中显著提升了跟踪音画配对变化的能力。
Conclusion: 轻量且有针对性的监督即可有效强化音画时序对应，并转化为音频-视觉问答 (AVQA) 上的广泛提升。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: CoeF-SFL: Preserving Collaborative Server-Client Learning with Enhanced Communication Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Split Federated Learning (SFL) enables resource-constrained clients to participate in collaborative training, but vanilla SFL exchanges smashed data and gradients at every batch, which incurs significant communication overhead. Recent methods reduce this overhead with an auxiliary network at the client-side cut layer. However, we identify that this approach makes the client optimize a local objective that differs from the end-to-end objective, which fundamentally limits the collaborative training between the client and the server. We propose Compensated Feedback based SFL (CoeF-SFL), a communication-efficient framework that retains the end-to-end objective without any auxiliary network. In CoeF-SFL, the client and the server exchange the smashed data and the gradients once per round and reuse them during local training. Since this reuse makes the gradients stale on the client side, we compensate them with a curvature-based correction in the activation space and develop two variants. CoeF-D approximates the Hessian with a diagonal gradient outer product, while CoeF-J exploits the tractable Jacobian-based Hessian of a surrogate loss that upper-bounds the true loss. We provide the theoretical background of each method, characterizing its compensation. Across vision and language tasks, model capacities, cut layers, and data distributions, CoeF-SFL significantly outperforms auxiliary-network-based methods under the same communication frequency, and the improvement is most substantial on vision tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CoeF-SFL-2686/README.md
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoeF-SFL 在 Split Federated Learning 中把 smashed data 与梯度改为每轮只交换一次并在本地复用，用激活空间上的曲率补偿修正复用带来的梯度陈旧问题，从而在不引入客户端辅助网络的前提下保住端到端目标。在视觉与语言任务、不同模型容量、cut layer 与数据分布下，同通信频率时显著优于基于辅助网络的方法，且视觉任务上提升最大。
Motivation: vanilla SFL 每个 batch 都要传 smashed data 与梯度，通信开销大；用客户端辅助网络降开销会让客户端优化偏离端到端目标，从根本上限制客户端与服务器的协同训练。
Method: 客户端与服务器每轮只交换一次 smashed data 与梯度并在本地训练中复用；针对复用导致的梯度陈旧，在激活空间做基于曲率的补偿，给出两个变体：CoeF-D 用梯度外积近似 Hessian 对角，CoeF-J 用可处理的基于 Jacobian 的代理损失 Hessian（该代理损失上界真实损失），并分别给出理论刻画。
Result: 在视觉与语言任务、多种模型容量、cut layer 与数据分布下，同通信频率时 CoeF-SFL 显著优于基于辅助网络的方法，视觉任务上提升最明显。
Conclusion: 不靠辅助网络、改用每轮一次通信加曲率补偿，就能同时保住端到端目标与通信效率，且该补偿在视觉任务上收益最大。

papers.title: Improving Large Language Models for Code through Runtime Program-State Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models receive limited explicit training in reasoning about runtime program states. We study whether training models to reason about runtime program states improves downstream software-engineering capabilities. We introduce two complementary program-state reasoning tasks. Buggy input-output reasoning requires a model to generate a concrete input that exposes a behavioral difference between a buggy program and a hidden correct implementation and to predict the resulting execution behavior. Precondition-postcondition reasoning requires an agent to symbolically characterize a bug-triggering precondition, predict the expected postcondition, explain their causal connection, and instantiate this reasoning as an executable regression test. By incorporating these two tasks into a staged post-training pipeline, we develop Comet-9B, a 9B language model based on Qwen3.5-9B Base. We evaluate the resulting checkpoints on repository-level patch generation, regression-test generation, and security PoC generation. Adding both program-state reasoning tasks to supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on issue resolution improves success rates by 7.25 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro and 9.70 points on SWT-Bench Verified. Sequential reinforcement learning on the two tasks yields further gains of 7.25, 26.79, and 4.67 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro, SWT-Bench Verified, and CyberGym, respectively. Despite having only 9B parameters, Comet-9B achieves a score comparable to the reported GPT-5.2 result on SWE-bench Pro and matches the reported success rate of a GPT-4o-based agent on SWT-Bench Verified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Comet-9B（基于 Qwen3.5-9B Base）通过在分阶段后训练中加入两项运行时程序状态推理任务——buggy input-output reasoning 与 precondition-postcondition reasoning——提升仓库级补丁生成等软件工程能力。在 SFT 中加入两任务使 SWE-bench Pro 成功率提升 7.25 个百分点、SWT-Bench Verified 提升 9.70 个百分点；再做顺序强化学习又分别带来 7.25、26.79、4.67 个百分点的提升。
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理运行时程序状态方面缺少显式训练，而这是仓库级补丁生成、回归测试生成与安全 PoC 生成等软件工程能力的底层环节。
Method: 提出两项互补任务：buggy input-output reasoning 要求生成能暴露 buggy 程序与隐藏正确实现行为差异的具体输入并预测执行行为；precondition-postcondition reasoning 要求符号化刻画触发 bug 的前置条件、预测后置条件、解释因果并实例化为可执行回归测试。两项任务进入分阶段后训练管线（SFT + 顺序强化学习），产出基于 Qwen3.5-9B Base 的 9B 模型 Comet-9B。
Result: 在 issue resolution 的 SFT 中加入两项程序状态推理任务，SWE-bench Pro 成功率 +7.25 个百分点、SWT-Bench Verified +9.70 个百分点；在此之上对两任务做顺序强化学习，SWE-bench Pro +7.25、SWT-Bench Verified +26.79、CyberGym +4.67 个百分点。仅 9B 参数的 Comet-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上取得与已报告 GPT-5.2 相当的分数，并在 SWT-Bench Verified 上匹配已报告的 GPT-4o-based agent 成功率。
Conclusion: 显式训练模型推理运行时程序状态（生成暴露差异的输入、符号化前后置条件并落成可执行回归测试）能实质提升仓库级补丁、回归测试与安全 PoC 生成，且 9B 模型经该后训练可达到更大闭源模型的报告水平。

papers.title: FORGE: Form-Optimal Routing of Grounded Evidence for Frozen LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: In agentic AI systems, frozen foundation models are increasingly deployed as closed-weight API endpoints, making downstream adaptation possible only through the inputs and inference procedures surrounding the model. As a result, for each input query, two coupled decisions largely determine both answer quality and token cost: what evidence to provide and how much reasoning budget to allocate. Fixed defaults along these axes are often suboptimal, misallocating support form or reasoning depth on roughly 80% of queries in our analysis. To address this challenge, we propose FORGE, a unified framework for adapting frozen models through per-query routing over a joint action space that spans both support form and thinking depth. Under an entropy-regularized, cost-aware utility objective, we derive a closed-form Boltzmann routing target and instantiate the policy as a lightweight 269K-parameter factorized router. The routing policy is trained around the frozen host, without any weight access, through a three-stage pipeline: offline arm enumeration, supervised Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation from the Boltzmann target, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refinement with host feedback. Across 5 knowledge-intensive benchmarks and 8 frozen backbones ranging from 7B to 671B parameters, FORGE improves accuracy at 42-45% lower token cost on both main hosts, transfers zero-shot across hosts at lower token cost, and composes with intrinsic thinking budgets where available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORGE 针对冻结闭源 LLM 的每查询决策，把「给什么形式的证据」与「分配多少思考预算」放进同一动作空间做路由：在熵正则、成本感知的效用目标下推出闭式 Boltzmann 路由目标，用 269K 参数的分解式 router 经三阶段训练。在 5 个知识密集 benchmark、8 个 7B–671B 冻结 backbone 上，以低 42–45% token 成本提升准确率。
Motivation: 冻结 foundation model 只能通过输入与推理过程适配，而证据形式与推理深度的固定默认值在作者分析中约 80% 的查询上错配支持形式或思考深度，同时损害答案质量与 token 成本。
Method: 在覆盖 support form 与 thinking depth 的联合动作空间上做每查询路由，目标为熵正则、成本感知的效用，推出闭式 Boltzmann 路由目标；策略是 269K 参数的 factorized router，围绕冻结宿主、不访问权重，经三阶段训练：offline arm enumeration、对 Boltzmann 目标的监督 KL 蒸馏、以及用宿主反馈的 GRPO 微调。
Result: 在 5 个知识密集 benchmark、8 个 7B 至 671B 冻结 backbone 上，FORGE 在两个主宿主上以低 42–45% 的 token 成本提升准确率；可跨宿主零样本迁移且 token 成本更低，并能与模型自带的 thinking budget 叠加使用。作者分析中固定默认值约 80% 的查询支持形式或思考深度错配。
Conclusion: 对冻结 LLM，把证据形式与推理深度作为联合每查询路由问题、用熵正则成本感知目标加轻量 router 训练，可在降 token 成本的同时提高准确率，并跨宿主零样本迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control
papers.abstract_en: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.
papers.comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: https://www.taekyung.me/pss
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSS 把视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的物理事件预测接到基于备份的安全滤波上：VLM 预测事件及其时刻或直接预测物体位移，显式运动模型转成轨迹，split conformal prediction 联合校准位置误差并转成占据区域，再据此推导输入仿射约束以最小修改名义控制且保持备份可行。MuJoCo 中 Unitree Go1 面对坠落支架、冲击致支撑丢失与接触传播时，安全回合率 99.3%，而只用当前几何障碍的 Backup CBF 基线为 43.3%。
Motivation: 物理交互会产生当前几何视野里看不出来的未来危险，只依赖现有障碍几何的安全滤波（如 Backup CBF）无法覆盖这类由事件驱动的 hazard。
Method: PSS 流水线：VLM 预测物理事件与时间或直接预测物体位移；显式运动模型把事件假设转为物体轨迹；split conformal prediction 跨指定物体、观测时刻与未来时刻联合校准位置误差，几何形状界把位置区域转为预测占据；再对规定备份机动评估该占据，推导输入仿射约束，在机器人动力学与输入限制下最小修改名义输入并保持备份可行。
Result: MuJoCo 实验用 Unitree Go1，场景为坠落支架、冲击驱动的支撑丢失与接触传播；PSS 安全回合率 99.3%，Backup Control Barrier Function 基线（仅用当前障碍几何）为 43.3%。
Conclusion: 把视觉物理推理经校准的占据预测接入备份安全滤波，可在事件驱动危险下保持备份可行，安全回合率远高于只看当前几何的 Backup CBF。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: FAST-Brain: A Flow-Aligned Spatio-Temporal Surrogate Brain Model
papers.abstract_en: Modeling resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data is crucial for understanding brain-wide neural activity. However, traditional methods struggle to capture complex temporal dynamics over long horizons, to account for the brain's anatomical spatial structure, and to model high-dimensional ambient signals that lie on a low-dimensional intrinsic subspace. We propose FAST-Brain, a unified flow-aligned spatio-temporal surrogate brain model that addresses all three challenges. At its core is a flow-aligned generative framework that directly predicts the clean blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal, paired with a graph convolutional network that captures spatial structural constraints and a Transformer that models long-range temporal dependencies. Theoretically, we show that under a low-dimensional subspace assumption, the approximation error of our model scales with the intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension, which justifies our direct modeling of the BOLD signal. Extensive experiments on synthetic and Human Connectome Project datasets demonstrate that FAST-Brain achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering functional connectivity, effective connectivity, and the implicit low-dimensional signal subspace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAST-Brain 用 flow-aligned 生成框架直接预测干净 BOLD 信号，配 GCN 施加脑区空间结构约束、Transformer 建模长程时间依赖，在低维子空间假设下证明逼近误差随内在维度而非环境维度标度。在合成数据与 Human Connectome Project 上，功能连接、有效连接与隐式低维子空间恢复均达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: rs-fMRI 建模的三个难点同时存在：长时间跨度上的复杂时间动力学、脑解剖空间结构约束，以及高维环境信号实际位于低维内在子空间，传统方法难以一并处理。
Method: 核心是 flow-aligned 生成框架，直接预测干净 BOLD 信号而非去噪后的近似；空间上用 graph convolutional network 编码解剖结构约束，时间上用 Transformer 捕捉长程依赖；理论上在低维子空间假设下给出逼近误差标度分析。
Result: 在合成数据与 Human Connectome Project 数据集上，恢复功能连接 (functional connectivity)、有效连接 (effective connectivity) 与隐式低维信号子空间均达到 state-of-the-art；理论结果给出逼近误差随内在维度而非环境维度标度。
Conclusion: 直接对 BOLD 信号建模是合理的：只要信号落在低维内在子空间，模型复杂度由内在维度决定，空间图结构与长程时间依赖需同时建模才能恢复连接与子空间。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SemRD-V2X: Closure-Guided Communication with Bounded Inference for Cooperative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cooperative perception improves 3-D detection by sharing intermediate features, but dense remote features may repeat context that the ego agent can infer locally. Most communication-efficient designs optimize masks or codes empirically, leaving a more basic question open: which remote evidence is indispensable given the receiver's own observation? We introduce a closure-fidelity perspective on ego conditioned remote perception. Under a finite deductive abstraction and explicit conditions, its rate--distortion function decomposes over an irredundant core, and the exact zero-distortion rate becomes $P_A H(π_A)$. This analysis suggests a concrete design principle: transmit compact evidence and recover derivable context with bounded receiver-side inference. Guided by this principle, SemRD-V2X is an operational neural proxy that combines exact-budget BEV support selection, pointwise channel compression, and masked shared-weight reconstruction before standard fusion. Experiments on simulated V2XSet and real-world DAIR-V2X validate the resulting design. In a controlled five-run V2XSet comparison against a locally reproduced V2X-ViT-v1 baseline on one Tesla V100, SemRD-V2X reduces the analytical feature payload by $26.6\times$ while improving AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by 4.13/8.57 points, with 3.81\% additional mean compute latency. These results position closure fidelity as both an analytical lens and an actionable design principle for communication-efficient cooperative perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemRD-V2X 把「接收方能本地推导的上下文不该再传」形式化为 closure-fidelity 视角：在有限演绎抽象与显式条件下，率失真函数在不可约核心上分解，零失真率恰为 P_A H(π_A)。据此设计的协作感知管线在 V2XSet 上相对本地复现的 V2X-ViT-v1 基线把特征载荷压低 26.6×，AP@0.5/AP@0.7 反升 4.13/8.57 点，平均计算时延仅增 3.81%。
Motivation: V2X 中间特征共享里，稠密远端特征大量重复 ego 本可本地推断的上下文；现有通信高效方案多为经验性地优化 mask 或 code，缺少「给定接收方观测，哪些远端证据不可省」的判据。
Method: 先给出 ego 条件远端感知的 closure-fidelity 率失真分解（零失真率 P_A H(π_A)），再据此实现 SemRD-V2X：精确预算的 BEV support 选择 + pointwise 通道压缩 + masked 共享权重重建，最后接标准融合；在模拟 V2XSet 与真实 DAIR-V2X 上验证。
Result: 在单张 Tesla V100 上对 V2XSet 做受控五次运行、对比本地复现的 V2X-ViT-v1：分析特征载荷降低 26.6×，AP@0.5 提升 4.13 点、AP@0.7 提升 8.57 点，额外平均计算时延 3.81%。
Conclusion: closure fidelity 既是分析透镜也是可执行设计原则：只传紧凑证据、把可推导上下文交给接收端有界推理，可在压缩通信的同时提高 3-D 检测精度。

papers.title: Fuzzy Distribution Modeling for Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Causality Preservation
authors: Dimitris K. Iakovidis (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science and Biomedical Informatics
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular data generation provides an effective alternative for the training of machine learning models when real-world data is limited or inaccessible. However, the heterogeneous, non-smooth, and incomplete nature of tabular data poses fundamental challenges to conventional probabilistic and deep generative models, where their interpretability remains limited. This paper proposes a novel fuzzy distribution modeling methodology for synthetic tabular data generation based on fuzzy sets theory. Feature distributions are represented using fuzzy sets and feature dependencies are modeled through Fuzzy Cognitive Maps, resulting in a low-parameter, and an interpretable data representation. Synthetic samples are generated by sampling fuzzy concepts rather than raw values, enabling native support for mixed data types, missing values, and domain constraints. The methodology further supports linguistic queries and IF-THEN reasoning, facilitating transparent simulation of decision-making processes. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance with respect to utility, fidelity and privacy compared to state-of-the-art methods, while offering substantially improved interpretability. These results establish fuzzy distribution modeling as a principled and effective approach for synthetic tabular data generation in fuzzy systems and decision support applications.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Published in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Fuzzy Systems (FUZZ-IEEE), Maastricht, the Netherlands
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 2026 IEEE Int. Conf. on Fuzzy Systems (FUZZ-IEEE), pp. 1-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于模糊集理论的表格数据分布建模方法：用模糊集表示特征分布、用 Fuzzy Cognitive Maps 建模特征依赖，采样模糊概念而非原始值生成合成样本。在基准数据集上，utility、fidelity、privacy 与最先进方法相当，同时可解释性显著提升，并原生支持混合类型、缺失值与领域约束。
Motivation: 真实表格数据受限或不可得时需合成数据，但表格数据异构、非光滑、不完整，传统概率与深度生成模型处理困难且可解释性有限。
Method: 用模糊集表示各特征分布，用 Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCM) 建模特征间依赖，得到低参数、可解释的表示；生成时对模糊概念而非原始值采样，并支持语言查询与 IF-THEN 推理。
Result: 在基准数据集上的实验显示，utility、fidelity、privacy 三项指标与 state-of-the-art 方法相比具有竞争力，同时可解释性有实质性提升。
Conclusion: 模糊分布建模是合成表格数据生成的一种有原则且有效的方法，适用于模糊系统与决策支持场景。

papers.title: Commutator Memory: Sparse, Path-Local Reading and Steering in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Gradient updates on different data generally do not commute: training a language model on two data sources in opposite orders gives different weights, even with the same data and total exposure. Loss or benchmark deltas show that the models differ, not where. We ask whether this path dependence leaves a parametric training-history memory: a weight component that flips sign when the two sources are swapped, is localized in output space, changes the held-out loss gap between the two orders under targeted interventions, and reveals which trained model came from which order. For one small SGD step of size $η$ on each of sources $A$ and $B$, the weight difference $θ_{AB}-θ_{BA}$ is, to leading order, $η^2 b_{AB}$, where $b_{AB}=H_Bg_A-H_Ag_B$ is the Lie bracket of the two gradient fields at the base model. We define commutator memory by projecting the bracket through the logits into one score per vocabulary token; the scores sum to the bracket's prediction of the gap. The scores are localized: on three models, the same readout of the measured $θ_{AB}-θ_{BA}$, or of a bracket from disjoint batches, shares 82-99% of the original top-20 tokens, versus 35-49% for norm-matched random directions. They are causally actionable: in Qwen-3-4B SFT, downweighting the ten tokens with the largest predicted share of the gap closes a median 32% of the measured gap, while frequency-matched tokens with near-zero scores have almost no effect. The weights themselves carry the component: projecting the difference between the two trained models onto $b_{AB}$ identifies which came from which order in 92% of cases across four LLMs (chance 50%). Controlled tests also cover matched-batch DPO, a frozen-rollout GRPO-style objective, and an AdamW endpoint check. The memory is defined per source pair, not per example, and its projection on $b_{AB}$ decays with further training.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 44 pages, 10 figures, 25 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语言模型在两个数据源上按不同顺序训练，权重差 θ_AB−θ_BA 在一阶近似下等于 η² 倍的梯度场 Lie bracket b_AB=H_B g_A−H_A g_B；把它经 logits 投影成逐词表 token 的分数，就得到可定位、可因果操作的训练路径记忆。三个模型上该读出共享原 top-20 token 的 82–99%（范数匹配随机方向仅 35–49%）；Qwen-3-4B SFT 中压低预测份额最大的十个 token 可关闭中位 32% 的实测 gap；把两模型之差投影到 b_AB 上可在四个 LLM 上以 92% 准确率判出训练顺序（随机 50%）。
Motivation: 不同数据顺序训练出的模型 loss/benchmark 差异只能说明两者不同，无法指出差异在参数空间的哪里、由哪些 token 承载，也无法反推训练顺序。
Method: 对数据源 A、B 各做一步步长 η 的 SGD，把权重差展开为 η² b_AB，其中 b_AB=H_B g_A−H_A g_B 是两个梯度场的 Lie bracket；再把该 bracket 经 logits 投影为逐 token 分数（分数之和等于 bracket 预测的 gap），并用同一读出作用于实测 θ_AB−θ_BA 或来自不相交 batch 的 bracket。受控测试覆盖 matched-batch DPO、frozen-rollout 的 GRPO 式目标与 AdamW 端点检查。
Result: 三个模型上，实测 θ_AB−θ_BA 或不相交 batch bracket 的同一读出共享原 top-20 token 的 82–99%，范数匹配随机方向仅 35–49%。Qwen-3-4B SFT 中下调预测 gap 份额最大的十个 token 关闭实测 gap 的中位 32%，而频率匹配、分数近零的 token 几乎无效。把两模型之差投影到 b_AB 上可在四个 LLM 上以 92% 识别训练顺序（chance 50%）。
Conclusion: 训练路径依赖在权重中留下按数据源对定义、可经 Lie bracket 读出的参数化记忆：它在输出空间局部化、可被定向干预因果改变，并随继续训练而衰减；记忆按 source pair 而非按样本定义。

papers.title: SAIL: Spatial Audio Intelligence with Large Language Models via Disentangled Acoustic-Spatial Encoding and Dual-Stream Q-Former
papers.abstract_en: Spatial audio large language models (LLMs) enable embodied agents, wearable assistants, and immersive systems to recognize sound events, localize sources, and reason about their spatial relationships. However, existing spatial audio LLMs often rely on early fusion of acoustic and spatial features and source-agnostic token representations. These designs make it difficult to preserve the correspondence between individual sound events and their spatial attributes, particularly in multi-source scenes. To address this limitation, we propose SAIL, a Spatial Audio Intelligence framework with LLMs that preserves acoustic-spatial structure and source-level correspondence from audio encoding to LLM alignment. SAIL introduces a Disentangled Spatial Audio Transformer that represents Mel-spectrogram and interaural phase difference features as separate acoustic and spatial streams. Source-discriminative task queries further learn event, direction, and distance information for each source. A Dual-Stream Q-Former then aligns the two streams with the LLM using acoustic and spatial queries organized by source slots. Compared with the early-fusion baseline, SAIL achieves consistent improvements in dual-source sound event detection, direction and distance estimation, and spatial reasoning. These results demonstrate the importance of structured, source-discriminative audio representations for multi-source spatial understanding and reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAIL 把声学特征（Mel 谱）与空间特征（耳间相位差 IPD）拆成两条独立流，用源判别任务查询分别学每个声源的事件、方向与距离，再由 Dual-Stream Q-Former 按源槽位与 LLM 对齐。相比早期融合基线，它在双声源事件检测、方向与距离估计以及空间推理上一致提升。
Motivation: 现有空间音频 LLM 采用声学与空间特征的早期融合和源无关 token，多源场景下难以保持单个声源与其空间属性的对应关系。
Method: Disentangled Spatial Audio Transformer 将 Mel 谱与 interaural phase difference 编码为分离的声学流和空间流；源判别任务查询 (source-discriminative task queries) 逐源学习事件、方向、距离；Dual-Stream Q-Former 用按源槽位组织的声学与空间 query 把两流对齐到 LLM。
Result: 与早期融合基线相比，SAIL 在双声源 (dual-source) 的声音事件检测、方向与距离估计、空间推理上均取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 结构化、源判别式的音频表征对多源空间理解与推理重要，早期融合与源无关 token 会丢失声源与其空间属性的对应。

papers.title: E-WAVE: Event-based Continuous Optical Flow via Warping-Aligned Visual Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Temporally dense optical flow is essential for dynamic perception in immersive VR/AR systems, where rapid head, hand, and object motion must be continuously captured and tracked. Existing frame-based optical flow estimation methods are constrained by the tradeoff between temporal resolution and computational cost; while event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and energy efficiency, serve as a natural solution to the dilemma. However, event-based approaches commonly rely on correlation volumes to capture pairwise voxel correspondences, which incur substantial memory and computation overhead. We present E-WAVE, a correlation-free framework for high-temporal-resolution (HTR) optical flow estimation from event streams. Instead of constructing all-pairs correlation volumes, E-WAVE employs global attention mechanism to model long-range feature dependencies and performs trajectory guided feature warping using Bézier curve. Through iterative updates, it predicts trajectories that allow for querying at arbitrary timestamps without repeated inference. Experiments on MultiFlow and DSEC-Flow demonstrate a 25% lower trajectory error and comparable endpoint flow estimation accuracy relative to state-of-the art baselines. Additional evaluations on self-captured data using a head-mounted prototype validate that E-WAVE remains robust under challenging real-world conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E-WAVE 用全局注意力加 Bézier 曲线轨迹引导的特征 warping 取代全对相关体 (correlation volume)，从事件流直接输出可任意时刻查询的连续光流轨迹。在 MultiFlow 与 DSEC-Flow 上轨迹误差比 SOTA 基线低 25%，端点光流精度相当，并在自采头显数据上保持稳健。
Motivation: VR/AR 需要连续捕捉头、手与物体的快速运动，而帧基光流受时间分辨率与算力的权衡限制；事件基方法又依赖全对相关体，内存与计算开销大。
Method: E-WAVE 是无相关体的事件光流框架：用全局注意力建模长程特征依赖，用 Bézier 曲线做轨迹引导的特征 warping，经迭代更新预测轨迹，一次推理即可在任意时间戳查询光流。
Result: 在 MultiFlow 与 DSEC-Flow 上，轨迹误差比 SOTA 基线低 25%，端点光流估计精度与基线相当；在自采数据与头显原型上的额外评测显示其在真实挑战条件下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 去掉相关体、改用注意力加轨迹 warping，可以在降低开销的同时拿到可任意时刻查询的高时间分辨率连续光流。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compressible; at extremely low capacity, intervention dimensionality and input-dependent expressiveness become key constraints, and this requirement varies with injection depth. (2) Control Manifold Separation: effective control directions lie mainly in the low-variance complement of the activation principal subspace. Within a task and base model, the learned geometry stays largely consistent across training configurations, and across tasks geometric alignment correlates with capability transfer. Experiments on 5 LLMs and 6 verifiable-reward tasks support these findings. We then propose Alpha-Stabler, a plug-and-play framework with a Predictor that monitors principal-subspace intrusion for early collapse warnings, and a Controller that removes the principal-subspace component of activation gradients during backpropagation while preserving the orthogonal complement. Alpha-Stabler stabilizes training for 2,000 steps and consistently improves RL gains, offering practical insights for robust post-training. Code: https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用向量 steering 在激活空间定位 RLVR 带来的低维有效流形，发现有效控制方向主要落在激活主子空间的低方差正交补里；据此提出 Alpha-Stabler，在反向传播中剔除激活梯度的主子空间分量、只保留正交补，可稳定训练 2,000 步并持续提升 RL 收益。
Motivation: RLVR 的参数更新维度极高，训练动力学难以分析；需要判断 RL 收益究竟对应激活空间中怎样的低维几何结构，以及如何据此稳定后训练。
Method: 用 vector steering 识别与 RL 收益相关的低维有效流形，考察其容量随干预维度、输入依赖表达力与注入深度的变化，并分析控制方向相对激活主子空间的分布；再提出 Alpha-Stabler，含监测主子空间侵入的 Predictor 与在反传中去除主子空间分量、保留正交补的 Controller。
Result: 有效流形容量可以很小但并非无限可压缩，且该需求随注入深度变化；控制方向主要位于激活主子空间的低方差正交补；同一任务与基座模型下几何结构跨训练配置基本一致，跨任务的几何对齐度与能力迁移相关。结论在 5 个 LLM 与 6 个可验证奖励任务上得到实验支持，Alpha-Stabler 稳定训练 2,000 步并持续改善 RL 收益。
Conclusion: RLVR 的收益可由激活空间中低维、位于主子空间正交补的控制几何刻画，剔除梯度的主子空间分量是可行的稳定后训练手段。

papers.title: The Composition Gap in Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation compresses a training set into a small synthetic set, usually evaluated one at a time. In federated and data-governance settings, several parties distill their own data and a user trains on their union. We ask whether the union of separately distilled sets reproduces training on the union of the real data composability and show that it can fail even when every source is distilled exactly and the total budget admits an exact joint distillate. Compressing a training trajectory into fewer steps transforms the source statistics nonlinearly, so averaging compressed sources differs from compressing their average. For quadratic objectives we derive the exact composition error for two-to-one step compression in terms of the source-Hessian variance and the linear terms of the losses, and on a smooth network at small step sizes this prediction captures the local endpoint discrepancy in magnitude and direction. For learned synthetic sets, however, the composed error decomposes exactly into this local discrepancy and an aggregate source residual. Under endpoint matching the residual exceeds the structural term by more than an order of magnitude, and under distribution matching the two terms partly cancel. Joint distillation also retains an accuracy advantage when both sets are distilled from the same dataset, where the local discrepancy is exactly zero. Training fidelity and downstream accuracy are therefore distinct requirements, neither established by evaluating each set on its own.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 数据集蒸馏 (dataset distillation) 在联邦与数据治理场景下不可组合：各方分别蒸馏后合并训练，无法复现对真实数据并集的训练。二次目标下作者推出两步压一步的精确组合误差，由源 Hessian 方差与损失线性项决定；在学习式合成集上该误差分解为局部端点差异加聚合源残差，端点匹配下残差比结构项大一个数量级以上，分布匹配下两项部分抵消。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法逐个数据集评估，但联邦与数据治理中用户拿到的是多方各自蒸馏集的并集；即使每个源都被精确蒸馏、总预算足以做精确联合蒸馏，合并训练仍可能与真实并集训练不一致。
Method: 把训练轨迹压缩到更少步数，指出这会对源统计做非线性变换，使压缩后的平均不等于平均后的压缩；对二次目标推导两步到一步压缩的精确组合误差（用源 Hessian 方差与损失线性项表示），并在小步长平滑网络上检验该预测对局部端点差异的方向与量级的刻画；再对学习式合成集给出组合误差的精确分解：局部端点差异加聚合源残差。
Result: 二次目标下组合误差有闭式表达，可由源 Hessian 方差与损失线性项给出；小步长平滑网络上该预测在量级与方向上捕捉到局部端点差异。学习式合成集上，端点匹配时聚合源残差比结构项大一个数量级以上，分布匹配时两项部分抵消；当两个集合蒸馏自同一数据集时局部差异恰为零，联合蒸馏仍保有精度优势。
Conclusion: 训练保真度与下游精度是两个独立要求，逐个评估合成集既不能保证可组合性也不能保证二者；可组合性失败源于轨迹压缩的非线性，而非单源蒸馏不精确。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SAGE: Structured Strategic Reasoning for Efficient LLM Game Playing
papers.abstract_en: A strong LLM strategic agent should reason prospectively over uncertain futures, adapt its strategy to opponents' behavioral tendencies, and continuously recalibrate its decision process from interaction experience. However, incorporating these sources in free-form reasoning could lead to unsupported strategic assumptions, inconsistent opponent estimates, and harmful interference from irrelevant historical interactions. To address these issues, we propose SAGE, a training-free inference-time framework that structures LLM strategic reasoning around three coordinated operations: anchor, adapt, and recalibrate. SAGE first anchors reasoning to an equilibrium policy that provides a strategically valid prior. It then conditions deviations from this anchor on a soft belief over opponent behavioral tendencies, enabling opponent-specific exploitation. Finally, SAGE distills strategically related interactions into counterfactual hypotheses about previously missing considerations, allowing past experience to recalibrate the model's reasoning. We evaluate SAGE on three repeated imperfect-information games: Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, against various opponent types in each game. Compared with reasoning-intensive LLM agents, including Suspicion-Agent, ReTA, Agent-Pro, EMO, and Hypothetical Minds, SAGE achieves up to a 127.6% payoff improvement in Liar's Dice while reducing input and output token usage by up to 80% and 90%, respectively. In direct match-up play, it attains non-negative mean payoff against 5/10, 8/10, and 8/10 evaluated opponents in Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, and Goofspiel, respectively, while using relatively fewer tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/SAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是一个免训练的推理时框架，把 LLM 在不完全信息博弈中的策略推理组织成 anchor、adapt、recalibrate 三个协同操作：先锚定到均衡策略作为策略上有效的先验，再按对手行为倾向的 soft belief 调整偏离，最后用反事实假设让相关历史交互校准推理。在 Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel 三个重复不完全信息博弈中，相比 reasoning-intensive LLM 智能体，Liar's Dice 收益最高提升 127.6%，输入与输出 token 分别最多减少 80% 和 90%。
Motivation: LLM 策略智能体在自由形式推理中引入不确定未来、对手倾向与历史经验时，会产生无依据的策略假设、不一致的对手估计，以及无关历史交互的有害干扰。
Method: SAGE 为推理时、免训练框架，含三个协同操作：anchor 把推理锚定到均衡策略提供先验；adapt 以对手行为倾向的 soft belief 为条件刻画对该锚点的偏离，实现对手特定利用；recalibrate 将策略相关的交互蒸馏为针对缺失考量的反事实假设来校准推理。
Result: 在 Leduc Hold'em、Liar's Dice、Goofspiel 三个重复不完全信息博弈、多种对手类型上，对比 Suspicion-Agent、ReTA、Agent-Pro、EMO、Hypothetical Minds：Liar's Dice 收益最高提升 127.6%，输入 token 最多减少 80%、输出 token 最多减少 90%；直接对局中对受评对手取得非负平均收益的比例分别为 5/10、8/10、8/10。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的策略推理结构化为锚定均衡、按对手适应、用反事实经验校准三步，可以在重复不完全信息博弈中以更少 token 换取更高收益与非负对局表现。

papers.title: SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high-quality, cinematic results in text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. We propose SkillPE, a prompt engineering (PE) framework that evolves reusable cinematic skills from expert-authored seeds. SkillPE represents shot logic, composition, lighting, sound design, and other filmmaking cues in a fine-grained format, and retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively useful near-misses). The first two refine when and how a skill should be applied, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations at different degrees of modification while preserving the user intent. Candidate skills are assessed through generated videos along prompt fidelity, cinematic quality, narrative appeal, and creativity to construct the final skill libraries. Experiments on StoryEval and VBench show improvements of up to 1.40 points over the strongest external baseline and 0.51 points over seed skills on 7-point four-dimensional evaluation, while remaining competitive on benchmark-native metrics. Overall, SkillPE offers a practical approach to balancing fidelity and creativity in cinematic text-to-video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ais0n/SkillPE .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillPE 把专家种子演化成可复用的电影语言技能库：细粒度表示镜头逻辑、构图、灯光、声音设计，并按 resonators/dissonants/divergents 三类检索电影参考来决定技能何时用、怎么改。在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，7 分制四维评测较最强外部基线最多高 1.40 分、较种子技能高 0.51 分，同时在基准原生指标上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 非专业用户的文生视频 (text-to-video) 提示缺少专业叙事与创意设计，难以稳定产出电影级结果，而一次性提示工程无法沉淀可复用的创作知识。
Method: SkillPE 以专家种子为起点做技能演化：细粒度编码镜头逻辑、构图、灯光、声音设计等电影线索；检索电影参考并分为 resonators（好匹配）、dissonants（弱匹配）、divergents（有创意的近失配），前两类约束技能适用时机与方式，divergents 在保留用户意图下给出不同修改程度的替代实现；候选技能通过生成视频沿提示保真度、电影质量、叙事吸引力、创意四个维度评估后构成技能库。
Result: 在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，7 分制四维评测较最强外部基线最多提升 1.40 分，较种子技能提升 0.51 分，并在基准原生指标 (benchmark-native metrics) 上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 以电影参考的三类匹配驱动技能演化，可在文生视频中同时平衡保真度与创意，且演化后的技能优于原始种子技能。

summary_sections.result: 在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，7 分制四维评测较最强外部基线最多提升 1.40 分，较种子技能提升 0.51 分，并在基准原生指标 (benchmark-native metrics) 上保持竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以电影参考的三类匹配驱动技能演化，可在文生视频中同时平衡保真度与创意，且演化后的技能优于原始种子技能。

papers.title: MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiCo 是免训练的两阶段视觉 token 剪枝方法：从任务 log-loss 与语义擦除模型推导出互信息覆盖目标，用单调次模覆盖函数在 token 预算下贪心优化。在 LLaVA-NEXT-13B 上仅保留 5.6% 视觉 token 即保住基线 97.5% 的性能，推理加速 3.8 倍。
Motivation: MLLM 处理大量视觉 token 计算开销高，现有剪枝方法多依赖启发式，容易丢弃大量视觉信息导致性能下降。
Method: 两阶段免训练剪枝：先用视觉信号在 token 进入语言模型前选出代表性候选池，再做任务感知子集选择；两阶段各用合适的可观测代理把推导出的互信息覆盖目标实例化为单调次模覆盖函数，在 token 预算下贪心优化。
Result: 在 7B–13B 参数的多种 MLLM、覆盖通用视觉推理、细粒度 OCR 与 grounding、幻觉检测、长视频理解的图像与视频基准上，MiCo 在几乎所有被评估模型与所有剪枝比例下均取得最佳表现；LLaVA-NEXT-13B 上仅用 5.6% 视觉 token，保留基线 97.5% 性能，推理加速 3.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把互信息覆盖目标以单调次模贪心实现，可在极低 token 预算下大幅削减视觉 token 而几乎不损失 MLLM 性能。

papers.title: Knowing When Thinking Is Not Enough: Teaching Small Reasoning Models to Reason Beyond Their Parametric Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Scaling test-time computation is a powerful way to improve language-model reasoning, and is particularly appealing for small reasoning models (sRMs) that are cheap to serve. However, is additional thinking always the right operation? By intervening at intermediate reasoning states across two model families and multiple scales, we find that self-refinement largely consolidates probability mass onto solutions already reachable from the current state, rather than making new ones reachable. These interventions reveal two failure regimes: execution bottlenecks, where the correct path is reachable and reflection can recover it, and knowledge bottlenecks, where relevant external information makes it reachable. Motivated by this distinction, we introduce FlyBy, a selective querying framework, and train 4B and 8B variants to reason first, diagnose what remains unresolved, and, at a knowledge bottleneck, query stronger models whose parametric knowledge extends beyond its own. Supervised fine-tuning bootstraps a multi-depth query action, and cost-aware reinforcement learning calibrates whether to query, what to ask, and how much to spend. On 1,158 hard problems across six benchmarks, FlyBy-4B achieves 45.96% pass@8, surpassing Qwen3-14B (41.64%) at 2.7 times lower serving cost, while also exceeding Qwen3-8B in pass@1 (16.85% vs. 15.31%). Scaling to FlyBy-8B further improves pass@8 to 51.81%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlyBy 让 4B/8B 小推理模型先自行推理，再诊断剩余未解决部分，只有在知识瓶颈（knowledge bottleneck）处才向参数知识更强的大模型提问。在 1,158 道难题、六个基准上，FlyBy-4B pass@8 达 45.96%，超过 Qwen3-14B 的 41.64%，服务成本低 2.7 倍。
Motivation: 测试时扩展 (test-time computation) 对小推理模型 (sRMs) 吸引力大，但额外思考未必总是正确操作：自我精炼大多只是把概率质量压到当前状态已可达的解上，而非让新解可达。
Method: 在两个模型家族、多个规模上干预中间推理状态，区分执行瓶颈（反思可恢复）与知识瓶颈（需外部信息）；据此提出选择性查询框架 FlyBy，用监督微调引导多深度查询动作，再用成本感知强化学习校准是否查询、问什么、花多少。
Result: 在 1,158 道难题、六个基准上，FlyBy-4B pass@8 为 45.96%，高于 Qwen3-14B 的 41.64%，服务成本低 2.7 倍；pass@1 为 16.85%，高于 Qwen3-8B 的 15.31%；FlyBy-8B 的 pass@8 进一步升至 51.81%。
Conclusion: 推理应先诊断瓶颈类型：执行瓶颈靠反思，知识瓶颈靠向更强模型查询；选择性查询加成本感知训练能让 4B 模型以更低成本超过 14B 模型的 pass@8。

papers.title: Routing Without Embeddings: Fast And Interpretable Routing With Regular Expressions
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) routers commonly rely on neural query embeddings, with larger encoders expected to better capture query intent and difficulty. Yet scaling Qwen2.5 encoders from 0.5B to 72B parameters brings little improvement in routing accuracy (Figure 1b), suggesting that small encoders may already capture the query properties needed for routing. We therefore investigate which properties matter and whether they can be extracted directly from text without a neural encoder. We introduce REGEXROUTE, a pipeline that uses sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to discover interpretable regular-expression (regex) features. Using unlabeled text, an LLM turns descriptions of grouped SAE latents into regex extractors and refines them to match latent activation patterns. These extractors supply numerical features to a lightweight routing head, eliminating neural encoding at inference (Figure 1a). Across four benchmarks, one fixed set of 128 features achieves 76.43% average routing accuracy, comparable to 76.41% for the strongest neural text encoder baseline, with much smaller latency and strong robustness. These findings establish explicit, interpretable text features as a practical basis for designing and understanding LLM routers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REGEXROUTE 用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 从无标注文本中发现可解释的潜在特征，再让 LLM 把这些特征描述改写成正则表达式抽取器，直接给轻量路由头供数，推理时完全去掉神经编码器。四个基准上一组固定的 128 个特征达到 76.43% 平均路由准确率，与最强神经文本编码器基线 76.41% 持平，同时延迟大幅降低且鲁棒性强。
Motivation: LLM 路由普遍依赖神经查询嵌入，且默认更大的编码器更好，但把 Qwen2.5 编码器从 0.5B 扩到 72B 参数路由准确率几乎不涨，说明路由真正需要的查询属性可能很小、且可直接从文本显式抽取。
Method: 先用 SAE 在无标注文本上聚出潜在特征，再由 LLM 把分组后的潜在描述转成正则表达式抽取器，并按潜在激活模式迭代修正；抽取器输出数值特征送入轻量路由头，推理阶段不再做神经编码。
Result: 在四个基准上，一组固定的 128 个特征取得 76.43% 平均路由准确率，与最强神经文本编码器基线的 76.41% 相当，延迟显著更小且鲁棒性强；动机实验显示 Qwen2.5 编码器从 0.5B 扩到 72B 参数对路由准确率提升甚微。
Conclusion: 显式、可解释的文本特征足以支撑 LLM 路由，可替代神经嵌入作为设计与理解路由器的实际基础。

papers.title: DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost in the number of tokens. Most token-reduction methods adapt token identities within a prescribed layer-wise compression schedule, or search a static mask offline, and thus limit online adaptation of when and how much to prune. We propose DORA (Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent), which learns an input-adaptive pruning policy itself for frozen ViTs. At each eligible block, a hierarchical actor decides whether to prune, how many tokens to remove, and which tokens to remove from each image's evolving representation. Because early deletions change the states observed by later decisions, DORA formulates pruning as a finite-horizon Markov decision process. Complete-prefix shadow evaluations convert final-prediction fidelity into localized per-step credit, while closed-loop accuracy feedback adjusts the fidelity penalty toward a shared accuracy-drop target. A privileged critic and all shadow computations are training-only. Deployment retains the frozen backbone and a lightweight actor that applies hard deletion and packed variable-length FlashAttention, converting token reduction into measured speedups. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-Base, DORA reduces FLOPs by 38.4% relative to the uncompressed backbone within one percentage point of accuracy loss. Averaged across four ViT-type backbones at matched accuracy, DORA uses 13.2% fewer FLOPs and achieves 32.4% higher throughput than the corresponding per-backbone baseline means. Under zero-shot transfer to ImageNet-A, these gains widen to 20.3% and 45.6%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DORA 用分层 actor 把冻结 ViT 的 token 剪枝做成有限时域 MDP，逐块在线决定剪不剪、剪多少、剪哪些，并用完整前缀影子评估把最终预测保真度拆成逐步信用。在 ImageNet-1K/DeiT-Base 上相对未压缩骨干省 38.4% FLOPs、精度损失控制在 1 个百分点内；四个 ViT 骨干同精度下比各自基线均值少用 13.2% FLOPs、吞吐高 32.4%，零样本迁到 ImageNet-A 时两项增益扩大到 20.3% 和 45.6%。
Motivation: 现有 token 缩减方法要么按固定逐层压缩日程调整 token，要么离线搜静态掩码，无法在线决定何时剪、剪多少，因而难以对每张图自适应。
Method: 在冻结 ViT 的每个可剪块上放一个分层 actor，动作空间为是否剪枝、剪除数量、剪除哪些 token；把剪枝建模为有限时域 MDP，用 complete-prefix shadow evaluation 将最终预测保真度转成逐步局部信用，并用闭环精度反馈把保真度惩罚调节到共享的精度下降目标。特权 critic 与全部影子计算只在训练期使用，部署只保留轻量 actor、硬删除与打包变长 FlashAttention。
Result: ImageNet-1K + DeiT-Base：相对未压缩骨干 FLOPs 减少 38.4%，精度损失在 1 个百分点以内。四个 ViT 类型骨干在匹配精度下，相对各自基线均值少用 13.2% FLOPs、吞吐提升 32.4%。零样本迁移到 ImageNet-A 时两项增益分别扩大到 20.3% 与 45.6%。
Conclusion: 把 token 剪枝当作在线序贯决策并配逐步信用分配，可在冻结 ViT 上同时换到实测加速与跨骨干、跨数据集的泛化增益，且训练期的影子计算不进入部署。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling via Budgeted Multi-Attribute Verification
papers.abstract_en: Verifying LLM-generated answers under a shared computational budget requires jointly deciding which candidates to inspect and which verification attributes to evaluate. We formulate this problem as multi-attribute good-arm identification under a global budget: each candidate is an arm evaluated along several costly attributes, and the goal is to certify as many candidates as possible whose mean scores exceed the prescribed thresholds on all attributes. We propose \textsc{BMA-GAI}, an algorithm that combines cost-aware arm selection with adaptive sampling of attributes. Every observation serves both to guide adaptive allocation and to support anytime-valid certification, which removes the need for a separate confirmation stage. We establish an asymptotic coverage guarantee for \textsc{BMA-GAI} and derive a matching information-theoretic converse that characterizes the intrinsic complexity of the problem, thereby proving that \textsc{BMA-GAI} is first-order optimal away from critical budget levels. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and an LLM answer-verification task show that \textsc{BMA-GAI} allocates the verification budget more efficiently and certifies more high-quality candidates than competing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 答案验证形式化为全局预算下的多属性 good-arm identification (multi-attribute GAI)，提出 BMA-GAI：用成本感知的候选选择加属性自适应采样，每次观测既用于分配预算又用于 anytime-valid 认证，从而省掉单独的确认阶段。在合成基准与 LLM 答案验证任务上，它比竞争方法更省预算并认证出更多高质量候选。
Motivation: 共享计算预算下，验证 LLM 生成答案需要同时决定检查哪些候选、评估哪些属性；缺少既高效分配预算又能随时认证的统一机制。
Method: BMA-GAI 将每个候选视为在多个有成本属性上被评估的 arm，结合成本感知 arm 选择与属性自适应采样；观测同时服务自适应分配与 anytime-valid 认证。作者建立渐近覆盖保证，并给出匹配的信息论 converse，证明其在非临界预算水平下一阶最优。
Result: 在合成基准与 LLM 答案验证任务上，BMA-GAI 比竞争方法更高效地分配验证预算，并认证出更多高质量候选；理论上给出渐近覆盖保证与匹配的信息论 converse，一阶最优性在远离临界预算水平处成立。

papers.title: One Rollout Is All You Get: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents are deployed with frozen weights and discard everything they experience on the job. Existing ways to update an agent's weights assume something deployment withholds: ground truth, rollouts beyond the single attempt (retries, samples, practice runs), or a learning phase other than deployment. Because GUI actions can be irreversible, a deployed agent gets one attempt per task occurrence, in arrival order, and every attempt counts. No ground truth is available at any point. We define fully test-time adaptation for GUI agents by these constraints and pair it with a minimal weight-space method, SOLO. Auxiliary models read each episode: a judge selects the episodes it deems successful, and a proposer-verifier pair relabels a failed episode's prefix with the subtask that prefix completed. Admitted episodes enter a short sliding window, and each admission updates a small adapter by top-K self-distillation on the agent's own predictions, provided the window holds a judged success. On recurring task streams built from WebArena, VisualWebArena and MobileWorld, SOLO improves on the frozen agent with both UI-TARS-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, by three to six points of success rate, and exceeds two in-setting memory methods on the web streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOLO 在 GUI agent 部署期做完全测试时自适应：辅助 judge 挑出判定成功的 episode，proposer-verifier 对失败 episode 前缀按已完成子任务重标注，滑动窗口内只要有被判成功的样本，就用 agent 自身预测做 top-K 自蒸馏更新小 adapter。在 WebArena、VisualWebArena、MobileWorld 的重复任务流上，UI-TARS-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 的成功率相对冻结权重提升 3–6 个点，并在 web 流上超过两个 in-setting memory 方法。
Motivation: 部署中的 GUI agent 权重冻结，丢弃全部在岗经验；现有权重更新方法都依赖部署方拿不到的东西——ground truth、单次尝试之外的 rollout，或独立于部署的学习阶段，而 GUI 动作不可逆，每个任务只有一按。
Method: SOLO 是权重空间的最小方案：judge 模型挑选其判定成功的 episode，proposer-verifier 对失败 episode 的前缀按该前缀完成的子任务重标注；被接纳的 episode 进入短滑动窗口，只要窗口内保有一个 judged success，就对 agent 自己的预测做 top-K 自蒸馏，每次接纳更新一个小 adapter。全程无 ground truth，每个任务按到达顺序只试一次。
Result: 在由 WebArena、VisualWebArena、MobileWorld 构成的重复任务流上，SOLO 相对冻结 agent 在 UI-TARS-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 上均提升 3–6 个点成功率，并在 web 流上超过两个 in-setting memory 方法。

papers.title: Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TVCache 是面向 Vision-Language-Action 模型的免训练 token 缓存框架：按文本-视觉信息聚焦度过滤注意力头，用文本-视觉熵差选择可复用层，从而避开不稳定表征。在 OpenVLA-OFT 上，12.5% token 保留率时平均成功率较 VLA-Cache 最多提高 14.5 个百分点，同时相对全 token 推理降低 2.45 倍 FLOPs。
Motivation: VLA 模型推理开销大，现有 token caching 没有用上文本语义引导视觉定位这一归纳偏置，且忽视注意力聚合的 head 级可靠性与缓存复用的 layer 级稳定性。
Method: TVCache 为免训练、即插即用框架：依据 text-vision information focus 过滤注意力头以改善任务相关且物理一致的视觉 grounding；以文本-视觉熵差指导 reuse-layer selection，跳过不稳定表征以优化缓存资源分配。
Result: 在四个代表性 VLA 模型、两个仿真 benchmark 与真实机器人任务上评测；匹配 token 保留率时任务成功率一致高于现有 VLA caching 且计算量相当。OpenVLA-OFT 上，12.5% 保留率时平均成功率较 VLA-Cache 最多提升 14.5 个百分点，FLOPs 相对全 token 推理降低 2.45 倍。
Conclusion: 把 head 级可靠性与 layer 级稳定性显式纳入缓存决策，可在同等保留率与计算量下稳定提高 VLA 任务成功率，并跨模型与真实机器人任务泛化。

papers.title: Dynamical Parameters: An Interpretability Framework for Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: This work studies a central gap in interpreting time-series foundation models (TSFMs): a dynamical property may be accessible in a hidden state even when the forecast fails to respond correctly as that property changes. We formalize these properties as Dynamical Parameters, including trend slope, oscillation frequency, and autoregressive dependence. We compare their representation accessibility, measured by recovery from hidden states, with their forecast response, measured by agreement with the expected forecast change. Across nine frozen TSFMs and thirteen laws, 42 of 63 model-parameter cells achieve accessibility above 0.95, whereas their median reference-aligned response relative to the conditional reference is only 0.46. To explain this gap, causal geometry compares the hidden-state change required to produce the reference response with the change induced by the parameter intervention. Directly modifying the hidden state recovers the reference response, but the parameter intervention often moves the state in a different direction. These results show that accessible parameter information need not be expressed in forecasts when input changes miss the required hidden-state direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 中的趋势斜率、振荡频率、自回归依赖等动力学参数 (Dynamical Parameters) 形式化为可从隐状态恢复、且应随输入干预改变预报的属性。在 9 个冻结 TSFM、13 条定律共 63 个模型-参数格上，42 格的可及性高于 0.95，但相对条件参考的参考对齐响应中位数仅 0.46；因果几何显示直接改隐状态可恢复参考响应，而参数干预常把状态推向不同方向。
Motivation: TSFM 的隐状态里可能已编码某动力学属性，但当该属性变化时预报并不正确响应，可及性与预报响应之间的这一断裂使现有解释手段无法判断模型是否真的在用这些信息。
Method: 将趋势斜率、振荡频率、自回归依赖等定义为 Dynamical Parameters，分别用隐状态恢复度量可及性 (accessibility)、用与预期预报变化的一致度量响应；再用因果几何比较产生参考响应所需的隐状态改变量与参数干预实际诱导的改变量。
Result: 在 9 个冻结 TSFM 与 13 条定律上，63 个模型-参数格中 42 格可及性超过 0.95，而相对条件参考的参考对齐响应中位数仅 0.46；直接修改隐状态可恢复参考响应，参数干预则常沿不同方向移动状态。
Conclusion: 隐状态中可及的参数信息未必在预报中表达出来，因为输入变化没有命中产生该响应所需的隐状态方向。

papers.title: PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?
papers.abstract_en: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://playlisteval.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlaylistEval 用 agentic 流程在 100 小时级 playlist 上免人工标注地构造视频理解评委基准：问题配对答案的差异由因果退化控制，强制跨整段合集检索。630 对覆盖七个领域，分层 152 对与人工判断一致率 93.0%（IAA 0.781）；评测 8 个家族 17 个全模态/多模态模型，前沿评委成对准确率仅 75.4%，且 playlist 越长准确率越降。
Motivation: 现有时频理解基准的视频只有几分钟，很多答案对仅凭转录即可区分，人工标注也无法扩展到超长视频，因此超长视频下视频语言评委是否可靠无从检验。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 PlaylistEval：在 100 小时 playlist 合集上自动生成配对答案的问题，差异由 causal degradation 控制以强制跨合集检索，全程无人工标注；随后评测 8 个家族的 17 个 omnimodal/multimodal 模型，并在分层子集上与人工判断对照。
Result: 基准含 630 对、覆盖七个领域（静态与动态知识）；分层 152 对与人工判断一致率 93.0%，IAA 0.781；前沿评委成对准确率仅 75.4%，开源评委明显落后；检索与最终判断都依赖多模态信息，且评委准确率随 playlist 规模增大而下降。
Conclusion: 超长视频下视频语言评委不可直接信任：即便前沿模型也只到 75.4% 成对准确率，且随合集变长继续退化，开源评委差距更大。

papers.title: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ControlScope 把 LLM agent 的工作流修订拆成三层嵌套权限——续写生成代码 (FULL)、只改下一次工具调用的数据参数 (ARG)、从同一公开执行状态整体替换未完成工作流 (KEEP)——并用对照面板区分 agent 实际可用的修复与它真正选择的修复。在 20 个文件系统任务上 FULL 完成 15–16 个而 KEEP 为 13，但四次 fast 抽签下 FULL 只有 10–13、反而不敌 KEEP 的 13；ALFWorld 与 AppWorld 上三档权限差异很小，说明扩大修订权限并不稳定转化为成功率。
Motivation: LLM agent 在执行中途失败时能改多少、实际改了多少，此前没有可分离的度量：修复能力与策略选择混在一起，无法判断放宽修订权限是否真的带来收益。
Method: 在同一公开执行状态下并列三种修订粒度（续写代码、改参数、整体替换），配合嵌套权限区分可用修复与被选动作；在文件系统任务、ALFWorld、AppWorld 上做一次性与重复评审面板，每个任务跑两个源程序与多次 reasoning-reviewer 抽签，并用冻结回放 (frozen replay) 与离线源轨迹中点比较定位失败原因。
Result: 文件系统 20 任务、三次 reasoning 抽签下 FULL 完成 15–16 个 vs KEEP 13；四次 fast 抽签下 FULL 10–13 vs KEEP 13。ALFWorld 87 任务（52 场景）KEEP/ARG/FULL 为 85/86/87，另一组 134 任务（四场景）为 134/134/127；87 任务上 reasoning 面板同为 85/86/87 且评审开销可观。AppWorld V1 官方测试 585 个任务实例（195 个场景模板）三档净差异很小。五次调用保护省下 19.4% 的已记录模型输出，代价是 20 次新源运行中损失 1 次成功。
Conclusion: 修订权限的扩大与实际收益并不单调挂钩：文件系统上 FULL 在 reasoning 抽签下占优却在 fast 抽签下落后，ALFWorld/AppWorld 上三档几乎持平，因此应把修复可用性与策略实际选择分开审计，而不是默认更宽的替换权限更好。

papers.title: Riemannian Difference-of-Convex Optimization for K-Means Clustering
papers.abstract_en: K-means is a widely adopted clustering approach in signal processing and machine learning. In this paper, we study K-means clustering through a cardinality-constrained formulation on a compact embedded submanifold. We replace the cardinality constraint with a difference-of-convex (DC) penalty and establish a global error bound to prove that the penalized and constrained formulations share the same global minimizers whenever the penalty parameter exceeds a finite threshold. To solve the resulting nonsmooth Riemannian DC problem, we reformulate it as a minimax problem and propose RADA-DC, a Riemannian alternating descent ascent method combining dual regularization with DC linearization. Under standard assumptions and suitable parameter choices, RADA-DC finds an $ε$-Riemannian critical point within $O(ε^{-3})$ iterations. We conduct experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets to demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the tested baselines, including K-means++, in solution quality at competitive computational cost when the number of clusters is large.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把嵌入紧致子流形上的基数约束 K-means 改写为 DC 惩罚形式，证明惩罚参数超过有限阈值时两者的全局极小点相同；再用 Riemannian 交替下降上升法 RADA-DC 求解该非光滑问题，在标准假设下以 O(ε^{-3}) 次迭代达到 ε-Riemannian 临界点。合成与真实数据实验显示，当簇数较大时，该方法在有竞争力的计算开销下解质量优于包括 K-means++ 在内的所测基线。
Motivation: 子流形上的 K-means 常写成基数约束形式，约束本身难处理；需要一种既保持全局极小点等价、又能高效求解非光滑 Riemannian 问题的途径。
Method: 用 difference-of-convex (DC) 惩罚替换基数约束，并建立全局误差界 (global error bound) 以证明两形式全局极小点一致；将所得非光滑 Riemannian DC 问题改写为 minimax 问题，提出 RADA-DC（Riemannian alternating descent ascent），结合对偶正则化与 DC 线性化。
Result: 在标准假设与合适参数下，RADA-DC 在 O(ε^{-3}) 次迭代内找到 ε-Riemannian 临界点；在合成与真实数据集上，当簇数较大时，解质量优于所测基线（含 K-means++），且计算开销有竞争力。
Conclusion: DC 惩罚加 minimax 化可在保持全局极小点等价的前提下高效求解子流形上的基数约束 K-means，簇数较大时解质量优于 K-means++ 等基线。
