papers.title: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central design is to make the evolving visual program, its construction history, and its verification share a common revision reference. We define the Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) state as preserving programs and task context. Traceable Generation Process (TGP) connects edits to rendered evidence, and Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) supports restoration and checks the current revision before completion. Together, these mechanisms coordinate planning, execution, and visual feedback across rendering backends. We evaluate 11 powerful closed-source MLLMs on MaLiang-IBench and four on MaLiang-VBench, measuring generation success, visual quality, and computational cost. GPT-6-Astra achieves 100% generation success on both benchmarks, with 96.0% of image tasks and 76.9% of video tasks meeting all quality thresholds. The comparison also reveals a mismatch between general capability scores and visual generation performance, with similarly scored models differing substantially in their ability to satisfy visual requirements. MaLiang-Harness provides a systematic basis for studying how MLLMs translate executable code into visual outcomes, exposing both the potential of programmable generation and the limitations of general benchmarks as predictors of this ability. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MaLiang-Harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaLiang-Harness 把 MLLM 驱动的可编程图像/视频生成组织成「构建—检查—修订」的持久流程，用统一修订引用把视觉程序、构建历史与验证对齐，以消除程序正确但视觉不符的 Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap。在 MaLiang-IBench 上评测 11 个闭源 MLLM、MaLiang-VBench 上评测 4 个，GPT-6-Astra 两个基准生成成功率均 100%，图像任务 96.0%、视频任务 76.9% 满足全部质量阈值。
Motivation: 可执行程序能精确控制图像视频的构造，但程序跑通不等于满足要求的构图、外观与运动，即 P2V gap；通用能力评分也无法预测模型的视觉生成能力。
Method: 提出 MaLiang-Harness 统一框架，含三个机制：Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) 保存程序与任务上下文，Traceable Generation Process (TGP) 把编辑关联到渲染证据，Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) 支持回滚并在完成前检查当前修订；三者共享同一修订引用，跨渲染后端协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。
Result: 在 MaLiang-IBench 上评测 11 个闭源 MLLM、MaLiang-VBench 上评测 4 个，度量生成成功率、视觉质量与计算成本。GPT-6-Astra 在两个基准上生成成功率均为 100%，图像任务 96.0%、视频任务 76.9% 满足全部质量阈值；对比还显示通用能力评分相近的模型在满足视觉要求上差异显著。
Conclusion: 可编程生成的瓶颈在于修订与验证的组织方式，且通用基准分数不能作为 MLLM 把可执行代码转成视觉结果能力的预测指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAT-Free: Multi-View Pedestrian Localization without Calibration, Annotations, or Target-Scene Training via Adaptive Geometric Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-camera pedestrian localization is useful for wide-area monitoring in public and commercial spaces. However, deploying these systems often requires considerable setup for each new environment. Existing methods typically require camera calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. CAT-Free removes all three requirements. It uses synchronized RGB video as its only scene-specific input. Camera configuration is estimated directly from the video. Pedestrian locations are then estimated by combining observations from multiple cameras. Automatic camera estimation is not always accurate. This can produce unreliable pedestrian locations. CAT-Free therefore introduces two adaptive geometric filters. They remove unreliable position estimates. Their thresholds are estimated from each input sequence. CAT-Free achieves 82.5, 84.5, and 65.7 MODA on WildTrack, MultiviewX, and GMVD. It uses no supplied calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. Published methods using such scene-specific information report 88.2--95.0 MODA on WildTrack and 83.9--96.5 on MultiviewX under their respective protocols. CAT-Free also transfers without retuning. It reaches 74.9 MODA on four additional sequences and 78.6 on an unseen 8-camera installation. Finally, localization uncertainty predicts MODA with $r=-0.98$. This provides a label-free estimate of localization reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAT-Free 在无相机标定、无位置标注、无目标场景训练的条件下，仅用同步 RGB 视频估计相机配置并跨视角融合行人位置，再用两个阈值按输入序列自适应估计的几何滤波剔除不可靠估计。在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别取得 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，且定位不确定性与 MODA 的相关系数达 r=-0.98，可作免标签的可靠性估计。
Motivation: 多相机行人定位换场景就要重新标定、标注或重训，部署成本高；而自动估计相机配置本身会出错，产生不可靠的位置估计。
Method: 以同步 RGB 视频为唯一场景相关输入，直接从视频估计相机配置，再融合多相机观测定位行人；引入两个自适应几何滤波器剔除不可靠位置估计，其阈值由每段输入序列自身估计。
Result: MODA：WildTrack 82.5、MultiviewX 84.5、GMVD 65.7（均不使用标定、位置标注或目标场景训练）；使用场景信息的已发表方法在各自协议下 WildTrack 88.2–95.0、MultiviewX 83.9–96.5。免重调参迁移到另外四段序列达 74.9 MODA，未见过的 8 相机安装达 78.6 MODA。定位不确定性预测 MODA 的相关系数 r=-0.98。
Conclusion: 不依赖场景专属信息的多相机行人定位可以做到可用精度并跨场景直接迁移，且不确定性分数能作为免标签的定位可靠性指标。

papers.title: One Sequence, Many Decodings: CAGenMol-2 Recasts Drug Design as Masked Molecular Inference
papers.abstract_en: Drug design couples property evaluation, conditional generation, structure-based design, and local optimization, yet machine learning systems typically address these capabilities with separate task-specific models. We introduce CAGenMol-2, a masked diffusion molecular language model that represents molecules, continuous scalar properties, and 3D protein pockets within a single wrapped sequence. Within this pretrained interface, downstream operations are selected by which sequence regions are observed or masked at inference, allowing one checkpoint to perform property prediction, property- and pocket-conditioned generation, and partial-constraint design without task-specific architectures or backbone fine-tuning. We further propose Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO), a gradient-free mask-and-refill search that turns the masked decoder into an iterative local molecular optimizer. On CrossDocked2020, AdaFO increases Success Rate from 30.2\% to 70.8\%, the best reported under this protocol, while largely preserving drug-likeness and diversity. Finally, scaffold-preserving directional editing and CRBN/VHL case studies demonstrate its use in compound design workflows spanning local molecular editing, structure-based prioritization, and downstream simulation-based screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAGenMol-2 把分子、连续性质标量和 3D 蛋白口袋编码进同一条 wrapped sequence，用掩码扩散分子语言模型在推理时靠观测/掩码区域切换任务，一个 checkpoint 即可做性质预测、条件生成与局部约束设计。加入无梯度的 Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO) 后，在 CrossDocked2020 上 Success Rate 从 30.2% 提到 70.8%，为该协议下已报告的最好结果。
Motivation: 药物设计中的性质评估、条件生成、结构基设计与局部优化通常由各自独立的任务专用模型承担，架构不共享、需要针对每个任务微调骨干。
Method: 掩码扩散分子语言模型 (masked diffusion molecular language model) 将分子、连续标量性质与 3D 蛋白口袋统一为单条 wrapped sequence，推理时由观测/掩码的序列区域选择下游任务，无需任务专用架构或骨干微调；另提出无梯度的 Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO)，把掩码解码器当作迭代式局部分子优化器做 mask-and-refill 搜索。
Result: 在 CrossDocked2020 上，AdaFO 将 Success Rate 从 30.2% 提升至 70.8%，为该协议下已报告的最佳结果，同时基本保持类药性 (drug-likeness) 与多样性；另以 scaffold-preserving 方向性编辑和 CRBN/VHL 案例展示其在化合物设计流程中的使用。
Conclusion: 把药物设计的多项能力统一到单一掩码序列接口上，一个预训练 checkpoint 即可覆盖性质预测、条件生成与局部优化，且无梯度的 mask-and-refill 搜索能大幅拉高局部优化成功率。

papers.title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
papers.abstract_en: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界模型预测有偏或过度自信时，基于其动力学学到的 Hamilton-Jacobi 安全值函数会继承误差并给出过于乐观的安全估计。该自适应潜在安全滤波器用 Adaptive Conformal Inference 依据预测与观测推断隐状态的偏差构造在线不确定性集合，并在集合上取值函数最小值做悲观判定：世界模型准确时保持最小保守，观测暴露模型失配时转为谨慎。仿真与硬件实验中相对 SOTA 潜在安全滤波器显著减少失败，同时保持任务完成。
Motivation: 高维机器人系统的潜在安全滤波器在世界模型动力学上学习 HJ 安全值函数，而世界模型可能有偏、未校准或自信地出错，值函数随之继承误差；现有依赖 ensemble disagreement 或 value-target consistency 残差的自适应信号在预测已偏离观测时仍可能很小。
Method: 用 Adaptive Conformal Inference 对预测隐状态与观测推断隐状态之间的偏差构造在线不确定性集合，再在该集合上最小化学到的 HJ 值函数以做悲观安全判定；给出自适应不确定性半径的有限时间覆盖保证 (finite-time coverage guarantee)。
Result: 在仿真与硬件实验中，相比 state-of-the-art 潜在安全滤波器显著减少失败 (significantly reduces failures)，同时保持任务完成；并为自适应不确定性半径提供有限时间覆盖保证。
Conclusion: 直接用观测到的世界模型误差校准安全推理，可让滤波器在模型准确时不冗余保守、在失配时自动加严，从而避免过度自信的安全估计。

papers.title: PSM: Dataset Distillation Based on Precise Statistical Matching by Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses a large original dataset into a small distilled dataset with high training utility. Decoupled statistical matching methods substantially reduce distillation time and memory overhead while achieving strong performance. However, they typically supervise all distilled samples using running statistics estimated from the entire original dataset. These statistics mainly capture the average feature distribution while overlooking differences in sample difficulty, limiting their ability to characterize the difficulty structure of the original data. To address this issue, we propose Precise Statistical Matching (PSM) by difficulty. After pretraining, PSM uses the Global Precision Score (GPS) to estimate image difficulty, ranks the samples within each class, and partitions each class into IPC (images per class) difficulty groups. During distillation, Statistics Updated Again (SUA) updates the teacher's batch normalization (BN) running statistics through forward passes on original samples from each group, providing difficulty-specific supervision for the corresponding distilled batch. Meanwhile, Initial Sample Screening (ISS) initializes distilled samples using original images from the corresponding difficulty group, providing an effective starting point for precise matching. Experiments across multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that PSM broadens the difficulty range of distilled samples and improves downstream performance in most evaluated settings. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSM 按样本难度做精确统计匹配：用 Global Precision Score (GPS) 给类内图像排序并按 IPC 分成难度组，蒸馏时用 SUA 对每组前向传播更新教师 BN 运行统计、用 ISS 从对应难度组初始化蒸馏样本。它拓宽了蒸馏样本的难度范围，并在多数被评估设置上提升下游性能。
Motivation: 解耦式统计匹配 (decoupled statistical matching) 用全数据集运行统计监督所有蒸馏样本，只刻画平均特征分布而忽略样本难度差异，难以表达原始数据的难度结构。
Method: 预训练后用 GPS 估计图像难度，类内排序并按 IPC 划分难度组；蒸馏阶段 SUA 对每组原始样本前向传播以更新教师 BN 运行统计，为对应蒸馏 batch 提供分难度监督，ISS 用同组原始图像初始化蒸馏样本。
Result: 在多个数据集与模型架构上，PSM 拓宽了蒸馏样本的难度范围，并在多数被评估设置中提升下游性能。
Conclusion: 把统计匹配的监督从全局平均统计改为按难度分组的统计，可以在保持解耦式 DD 低开销优势的同时改善蒸馏数据的下游表现。

papers.title: Dr.Credit: Rubric-Grounded Process Credit Assignment for Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based tasks are increasingly addressed through reinforcement learning (RL), with rubric scores used as training rewards. However, these rewards typically supervise final answers without distinguishing the contributions of intermediate decisions. Many existing credit assignment methods rely on ground-truth answers to define process rewards, limiting their applicability to open-ended tasks without canonical solutions. To address this limitation, the proposed rubric-grounded credit uses task requirements as a shared reference for final answer evaluation and process supervision. The information returned by tools is assessed for the additional support it provides toward satisfying each rubric relative to that rubric's history of accepted support. By referencing these histories, credit distinguishes new support from evidence already present in the trajectory while recognizing partial support for each rubric. Dr.Credit uses rubric-grounded credit to supervise intermediate tool turns in an RL framework for deep research agents. The resulting process advantages are combined with GRPO outcome advantages to guide research decisions while retaining supervision of final-report quality. Evaluations on four in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that Dr.Credit outperforms the evaluated open deep research baselines on every primary metric and submetric. Meanwhile, with an 8B-parameter backbone, the trained agent achieves average performance competitive with the evaluated frontier proprietary models. Further analyses suggest more efficient evidence acquisition and higher-quality reports under limited research-turn budgets, motivating the extension of rubric-grounded process supervision to a broader range of rubric-based tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dr.Credit 把评分细则 (rubric) 同时用作最终报告评估与过程监督的共同参照：按每条 rubric 的历史已接受证据来判定工具返回信息的新增支撑，从而把过程信用 (process credit) 分配到中间工具轮次。该过程优势与 GRPO 结果优势结合指导研究决策，在四个域内/域外基准上于每个主指标与子指标都超过所评估的开源深度研究基线，8B 骨干的平均表现与所评估的前沿专有模型相当。
Motivation: 基于 rubric 的 RL 奖励只监督最终答案，不区分中间决策的贡献；现有过程信用分配方法依赖 ground-truth 答案来定义过程奖励，无法用于没有标准答案的开放式任务。
Method: 以任务要求 (rubric) 作为最终答案评估与过程监督的共享参照，按每条 rubric 相对其历史已接受支撑来评估工具返回信息带来的新增支持，据此区分轨迹中已有的证据与新证据并认可部分支撑；用该 rubric-grounded credit 监督深度研究 agent 的中间工具轮次，将过程优势与 GRPO 结果优势合并以指导研究决策，同时保留对最终报告质量的监督。
Result: 在四个域内与域外基准上，Dr.Credit 在每一个主指标和子指标上都超过所评估的开源深度研究基线；8B 参数骨干下训练出的 agent 平均表现与所评估的前沿专有模型相当。进一步分析显示在有限研究轮次预算下证据获取更高效、报告质量更高。
Conclusion: rubric-grounded 过程监督无需 ground-truth 答案即可为开放式任务提供过程信用，可推广到更广的 rubric-based 任务；在有限轮次预算下它同时改善证据获取效率与报告质量。

papers.title: Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID) learns person representations that can be compared across modalities without identity annotations. In the unpaired setting, however, identity correspondences between modalities are often incomplete, leaving many identities without an observed counterpart in the other modality. Existing unpaired methods bridge this gap by generating or mapping features for the other modality, mainly by exploiting the statistics of visual features without explicitly separating content that is discriminative for identity from style that is specific to modality. Consequently, the generated features may distort identity cues or inherit bias from the source modality, undermining the reliability of supervision across modalities. We formulate unpaired learning across modalities as a semantic compensation problem and propose Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC), a framework based on prompt composition that decouples identity semantics from modality style within a shared visual semantic space. SMC first constructs a discriminative ReID space through augmented dual contrastive learning, yielding pseudo labels, cluster prototypes, and memory banks for each modality. It then learns visible and infrared modality prompts in the CLIP semantic space and maps clusters obtained from pseudo labels to identity semantic tokens. For each cluster lacking a reliable match in the other modality, SMC combines its identity token with the prompt for the target modality to synthesize a semantic counterpart in the missing modality. The synthesized counterpart is then projected back into the ReID space and injected into a compensation memory through confidence gating. Extensive experiments under both paired and unpaired settings demonstrate that SMC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with particularly large gains when identity mismatch is severe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对非配对可见光-红外行人重识别 (USL-VI-ReID) 中跨模态身份对应缺失的问题，SMC 把跨模态学习形式化为语义补偿：先用增强双对比学习建 ReID 空间并产出伪标签与聚类原型，再在 CLIP 语义空间学模态 prompt，把缺少可靠匹配的簇的身份 token 与目标模态 prompt 合成缺失模态的语义对应物，经置信度门控注入补偿记忆。配对与非配对设置下均稳定超过现有方法，身份错配越严重增益越大。
Motivation: 非配对设置下许多身份在另一模态没有可观测对应，现有方法靠视觉特征统计生成或映射特征，未区分身份判别内容与模态风格，导致生成特征扭曲身份线索或继承源模态偏差，跨模态监督不可靠。
Method: SMC 基于 prompt composition，在共享视觉语义空间中解耦身份语义与模态风格：先用 augmented dual contrastive learning 构建判别 ReID 空间，得到伪标签、聚类原型与各模态 memory bank；再在 CLIP 语义空间学习可见光与红外模态 prompt，把伪标签簇映射为身份语义 token；对缺少可靠匹配的簇，将身份 token 与目标模态 prompt 组合合成语义对应物，投影回 ReID 空间后经 confidence gating 注入 compensation memory。
Result: 在配对与非配对两种设置下的大量实验中，SMC 持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法，且在身份错配 (identity mismatch) 严重时增益尤其大。
Conclusion: 把非配对跨模态 ReID 当作语义补偿、显式分离身份语义与模态风格，比直接借视觉特征统计生成另一模态特征更可靠，且对身份缺失程度更鲁棒。

papers.title: Pre-registered tests of solid-state-physics-inspired LLM compression: a cluster-level negative result at small-language-model scale
papers.abstract_en: We report a three-month autonomous research-agent program testing five solid-state-physics-inspired compression mappings on pretrained language models, with predictions committed to git before any pilot data and a 3-sigma gate deciding PASS or SHELVE. The common anchor -- area-law / Kohn-nearsighted decay of the one-particle density matrix -- has a distance face (P001 Wannier, P002 tight-binding) and a rank face (P003 DMRG-truncated MLPs, P005 Wilson-RG, P011 tensor-train embeddings). P005 was pre-empted at Phase 1; three of four Phase-3 pilots were falsified. On the attention face, GPT-2-medium attention-versus-distance is best fit by a stretched exponential in 12 of 16 median-layer heads once probe padding is excluded, and a tight-binding cutoff costs +96% perplexity (P002); on Pythia-160M the Wannier sparsity 0.054 +/- 0.004 is indistinguishable from PCA, random-Haar and identity baselines (P001). On the rank face, per-token tensor-train bond dimension does not track surprisal (r = 0.016 vs a pre-registered 0.65) and the format inflates rather than compresses (P011). P003 is mixed: its scaling claim shelved (r = -0.434), its MPO premise died at stage-0, and its cross-paper check, r = 0.523 as first written, collapses to 0.047 under the same correction, leaving both cross-paper checks null. The results invert the pre-registered prediction that most attention heads behave like Kohn-nearsighted insulators, pointing instead to critical, glassy or heavy-tailed regimes; the inversion is specific to the <= 350M scale tested, while the rank-face no-gain result held to 7-8B. We contribute the pre-registration + 3-sigma + cluster-framing + append-only-catalogue discipline -- including why our own enforcement gate was designed but not deployed -- four pre-registered negative results with full data release, and the inversion. The catalogue holds eighteen concluded studies, seventeen negative.

papers.title: ReScraper: Unified Scraping and Cleaning of Web Data for Effective LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: LLM pretraining corpora are normally cleaned by a stack of hand-written heuristics. A heuristic scraper extracts the main content from HTML, and dozens of rule-based filters then clean it, so corpus quality is capped by the coarseness and accuracy of the rules. In this work, we propose ReScraper, a unified language model of only 0.6B parameters that replaces this entire stack. To train ReScraper, we carefully curate supervised data from the outputs of three teacher models, so it learns to first extract the main content from raw data and then choose among four operations: keeping the page as extracted, editing out noisy lines and spans, deleting it entirely, or rewriting it when it is poorly written but informative. Based on the same crawled data pool, pretraining 400M, 1.4B, and 2.8B models on our curated data improves the DCLM Core score by a relative 3.8--4.7% over the strongest baseline at each scale, including the costly multi-agent curation. Our analyses show that each operation plays a distinct and complementary role, and that extracting and cleaning in one model outperforms a cascade of separate models. ReScraper also concentrates its operations on the pages that need them, raising the quality of poor pages the most while keeping the corpus diverse. These results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of AI4AI for pretraining data curation, where a small learned model takes over an entire stage of the pipeline from hand-written heuristics. We open-source our code at https://github.com/cxcscmu/ReScraper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReScraper 用一个 0.6B 的统一语言模型取代 LLM 预训练数据清洗的手写启发式栈：先从原始 HTML 抽取正文，再在保留、编辑噪声行段、整页删除、重写四种操作中选择。在同一批爬取数据上用其整理的数据预训练 400M/1.4B/2.8B 模型，DCLM Core 分数相对最强基线（含昂贵的多智能体整理）提升 3.8–4.7%。
Motivation: 预训练语料清洗依赖启发式抽取器加数十条规则过滤器，语料质量被规则的粗糙程度和准确率封顶。
Method: 从三个 teacher 模型的输出精心构造监督数据，训练 0.6B 模型学会先抽取正文、再在四种操作（保留/编辑/删除/重写）中决策；抽取与清洗合在一个模型里而非级联。
Result: 在相同爬取数据池上，用 ReScraper 整理的数据预训练 400M、1.4B、2.8B 模型，DCLM Core 分数相对各规模最强基线（含多智能体整理）提升 3.8–4.7%；分析显示四种操作角色互补，单模型抽取+清洗优于分离模型级联，且操作集中在真正需要的页面上，最差页面质量提升最大而语料多样性得以保持。
Conclusion: 一个小的可学习模型可以整体接管预训练流水线中原本由手写启发式负责的阶段，验证了 AI4AI 数据整理路线的可行性与有效性。

papers.title: Dexterous Tactile World Model
papers.abstract_en: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DTWM 把双手手套的触觉信号经零初始化残差注入预训练视频 diffusion transformer 的对应手部视频 token，用因果 mask 做自中心操作的未来帧预测。与架构、参数量、训练完全对齐的纯视觉模型相比，手部运动低估幅度从 23% 降到 9%，手部区域感知误差降 7.4%（每模型三次训练），且后期预测块的改善约为第一块的 4.1 倍。
Motivation: 操作视频世界模型难以从视觉观测到接触建立与释放这类决定操作走向的事件，而这些事件用触觉更容易感知。
Method: 以预训练视频 diffusion transformer 为骨干，通过零初始化残差把每只手的触觉信号注入视频 token 中对应手部位置；因果 mask 阻止预测帧访问未来信息，训练目标为未来帧预测，输入为自中心视频加双手手套触觉。
Result: 相对架构、参数量与训练均对齐的纯视觉模型：手部运动低估从 23% 降至 9%，手部区域感知误差降低 7.4%（每模型三次训练）；改善随预测时距增大，后期预测块的提升约为第一块的 4.1 倍；在同设置下优于其他视觉-触觉世界模型，且推理时无触觉输入也能受益于触觉训练。消融显示力的幅值与空间位置都有用：把触觉换成二值接触状态（按手或按位置）都会增大预测误差。
Conclusion: 触觉应以带空间位置的连续力信号、在对应手部 token 处注入视频世界模型，才能同时压低手部运动低估并改善长时距预测；力的时空分布本身编码了交互会持续还是会改变。

papers.title: Epistemic Learning from Imprecise Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Imprecise annotations may support several plausible labelling distributions, yet learning methods often resolve this ambiguity into a single predictive distribution. This can obscure what the annotation evidence leaves unresolved. We introduce epistemic learning from credal supervision, a framework that uses convex sets of plausible labelling distributions, called credal sets, as supervision and learns sets of predictive distributions. We instantiate the framework with the pessimistic--optimistic credal classifier (POCC), which combines a shared backbone with two classification heads trained to minimise worst-case and best-case losses over the supervision sets. Their outputs define a predictive credal set whose spread provides an uncertainty score. We also show how credal labels can be obtained through a simple relaxation of existing probabilistic labels, reducing commitment to their precise probability assignments. This construction admits closed-form inner optimisation under cross-entropy loss, enabling efficient training. Assuming the supervision sets contain the true conditional label distributions, and other regularity assumptions, we establish a finite-sample generalisation bound for the averaged predictor with an explicit penalty for supervision imprecision. We evaluate POCC using human annotator disagreement and teacher predictions, alongside label smoothing as a controlled proxy for annotation imprecision. Across these settings, POCC achieves a favourable balance of predictive accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty-based selective classification versus competitive baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从 credal supervision 做认知不确定性学习的框架：用凸的 credal set（可能标注分布的集合）作监督，学出预测分布的集合，实例化为悲观-乐观 credal 分类器 (POCC)，共享 backbone 加两个头分别最小化监督集上的最差与最好损失。输出 credal set 的张开度作为不确定性分数，在人工标注分歧、teacher 预测与 label smoothing 三种设定下，相对竞争基线在预测精度、校准与基于不确定性的 selective classification 上取得更均衡的表现。
Motivation: 不精确标注可支持多个合理的标注分布，而常规方法把它压成单一预测分布，掩盖了标注证据本身未解决的歧义。
Method: POCC 用共享 backbone 加两个分类头，分别最小化监督集上的 worst-case 与 best-case loss，其输出构成预测 credal set；credal 标签由已有概率标签经简单松弛得到，在 cross-entropy 下内层优化有闭式解，训练高效。
Result: 在人工标注分歧、teacher 预测以及作为标注不精确受控代理的 label smoothing 三种设定下，POCC 相对竞争基线在预测精度、校准和基于不确定性的 selective classification 上取得更有利的平衡；并在假设监督集包含真实条件标签分布等正则条件下，给出 averaged predictor 的有限样本泛化界，其中含显式的监督不精确惩罚项。
Conclusion: 把标注歧义保留为集合而非点估计，可在不牺牲精度的前提下改善校准与选择性预测，前提是监督集覆盖真实条件分布。

papers.title: Agentic High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Hypothesis- and Evidence-Guided Search
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization (HDBO) seeks sample-efficient optimization when the number of variables is large relative to the evaluation budget. Recent LLM-based and agentic BO methods incorporate task knowledge and adapt search decisions during a run, but have primarily been evaluated on low- and moderate-dimensional problems. We ask whether this paradigm can transfer to the higher-dimensional regime. Our experiments show that these methods do not remain reliable in the high-dimensional regime, where the challenge is not only where to evaluate, but also which modeling assumption and search geometry to use when the objective's useful structure is unknown. We therefore introduce HERA, a Hypothesis- and Evidence-guided Research Agent that uses task context, optimization feedback, and structural diagnostics to revise search hypotheses, select and configure HDBO strategies, and determine their execution length. PRISM, its numerical optimization engine, generates and evaluates candidates sequentially within each search block, updating numerical models after each observation. HERA remains competitive with strong numerical HDBO baselines and outperforms the evaluated LLM-based and agentic methods on four metadata-free synthetic functions. Across eight real-world tasks, HERA achieves the best mean final objective among all evaluated systems on most benchmarks. Further analyses show that structural diagnostics change strategy use, metadata effects vary across tasks, and adaptive search blocks reduce inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERA 用任务上下文、优化反馈与结构诊断来改写搜索假设、选择并配置高维贝叶斯优化 (HDBO) 策略及其执行长度，配套数值引擎 PRISM 在每个搜索块内顺序生成候选并逐观测更新数值模型。在四个 metadata-free 合成函数上超过所评估的 LLM-based 与 agentic 方法，在八个真实任务中的多数基准上取得最佳平均最终目标值。
Motivation: 现有 LLM-based 与 agentic BO 方法主要在低中维问题上验证，进入高维后不再可靠；难点在于目标有用结构未知时，既要选评估点，也要选建模假设与搜索几何。
Method: HERA（Hypothesis- and Evidence-guided Research Agent）结合任务上下文、优化反馈与结构诊断，修订搜索假设、选择并配置 HDBO 策略、决定各策略执行长度；PRISM 数值优化引擎在每个搜索块内顺序生成与评估候选，每次观测后更新数值模型。
Result: 在四个 metadata-free 合成函数上优于所评估的 LLM-based 与 agentic 方法；在八个真实任务上，HERA 在多数基准上取得所有被评估系统的最佳平均最终目标值；附加分析显示结构诊断会改变策略使用、metadata 效应随任务而异、自适应搜索块降低推理成本。
Conclusion: 把假设修订、策略选择与执行长度交给 agent 调度，可让 agentic BO 在高维、无 metadata 的设定下保持对强数值 HDBO 基线的竞争力，并胜过已有 LLM/agentic 方法。

papers.title: MoSPR: Histology-to-Gene Expression Prediction with Morpho-Spatial Macrostates and Low-Rank Molecular Programs
papers.abstract_en: Predicting molecular profiles from histopathology remains challenging because whole-slide images contain spatially organized, heterogeneous tissue patterns, while gene expression comprises thousands of correlated targets. We introduce MoSPR (Morpho-Spatial Program Regression), a linear framework that couples an adjacency-informed histology representation with a low-rank molecular basis. MoSPR clusters frozen patch embeddings into morphology microstates, aggregates their spatial adjacencies across the training cohort, and groups microstates with similar adjacency patterns into shared macrostates. Each slide is then represented by global morphology and macrostate-specific deviations, which are linearly mapped to coefficients of a training-derived low-rank gene-expression basis. Across three cancer cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas, MoSPR achieves the highest mean gene-expression prediction scores among all evaluated methods. Without pathway-level supervision, pathway scores derived from its predicted expression profiles rank first in eight of nine comparisons across three pathway collections. Ablation studies on the breast cancer cohort show complementary gains from adjacency-derived macrostate representation and low-rank molecular prediction. Moreover, with half of the training data on this cohort, MoSPR exceeds the full-data gene-prediction score of the strongest competing baseline. Finally, its linear formulation enables exact decomposition of each predicted expression profile into global and macrostate-specific molecular contributions, providing an interpretable link between spatially coherent macrostate regions and their associated molecular programs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Radisen-Panthera/MoSPR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoSPR 用邻接关系组织的形态宏观态 (morpho-spatial macrostates) 加低秩分子基，把全切片病理图像线性映射为基因表达谱。在 TCGA 三个癌症队列上，其基因表达预测平均分在全部被评方法中最高，通路分数在九项比较中的八项排第一；乳腺癌队列用一半训练数据仍超过最强基线的全数据得分。
Motivation: 全切片图像含空间组织的异质组织模式，而基因表达是数千个相关目标，二者难以对齐；现有方法缺少把空间结构与低维分子程序耦合的可解释表示。
Method: MoSPR (Morpho-Spatial Program Regression) 把冻结的 patch embedding 聚类为形态 microstates，在训练队列上聚合其空间邻接，再把邻接模式相似的 microstates 归为共享 macrostates；每张切片表示为全局形态加 macrostate 特异偏移，线性映射到训练导出的低秩基因表达基的系数。
Result: 在 TCGA 三个癌症队列上，MoSPR 的基因表达预测平均分在全部被评方法中最高；无通路级监督时，其预测表达导出的通路分数在三个通路集合的九项比较中八项第一。乳腺癌队列消融显示邻接宏观态表示与低秩分子预测带来互补增益；该队列用一半训练数据时，基因预测分仍超过最强竞争基线用全数据的得分。
Conclusion: 线性形式使每条预测表达谱可精确分解为全局与 macrostate 特异分子贡献，把空间连贯的 macrostate 区域与其分子程序直接对应起来，兼具可解释性与数据效率。

papers.title: Direct Self-Evolving Optimization: Evolving LLMs without Challenger Training
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving language models improve by generating tasks and learning from their own feedback, but adapting the task generator often requires a separate challenger-training loop. Can we generate tasks adapted to the current solver without explicitly training a challenger? We introduce \textbf{D}irect Self-\textbf{E}volving \textbf{O}ptimization (DEO), which replaces challenger parameter updates with solver-guided task sampling. The KL-regularized challenger objective defines an exponential tilt of a fixed base task distribution. DEO uses this distribution as a sampling target: a frozen LLM generates and mutates tasks, the solver scores them, and an approximate Metropolis selection rule refines the training pool. Only the solver is trained. Theoretically, for an idealized variant that samples exactly from the tilted distribution, and under regularity, local gradient-dominance, and initialization conditions, we show that DEO learns distributionally robust reasoning ability. In experiments, DEO achieves reasoning performance competitive with R-Zero while using over $50\%$ less wall-clock training time, and improves reasoning accuracy over a no-walk ablation. Replacing the task generator with a frozen API-only LLM further improves the local solver, illustrating a capability enabled by removing challenger training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEO 用 solver 引导的任务采样替代 challenger 训练循环：KL 正则的 challenger 目标等价于固定基础任务分布的指数倾斜，冻结 LLM 生成并变异任务、solver 打分、近似 Metropolis 选择规则筛选训练池，只训练 solver。在推理实验中达到与 R-Zero 竞争的性能，同时墙钟训练时间减少 50% 以上，并优于 no-walk 消融。
Motivation: 自演化 LLM 靠生成任务并从自身反馈学习，但让任务生成器适配当前 solver 通常需要额外的 challenger 训练循环，带来额外训练开销。
Method: 把 KL 正则 challenger 目标写成固定基础任务分布的指数倾斜，并将其作为采样目标：冻结 LLM 生成与变异任务，solver 为其打分，近似 Metropolis 选择规则精炼训练池，仅更新 solver 参数；理论上对精确从倾斜分布采样的理想化变体，在正则性、局部 gradient-dominance 与初始化条件下给出收敛论证。
Result: 推理性能与 R-Zero 竞争，墙钟训练时间减少 50% 以上；相对 no-walk 消融提升推理准确率；把任务生成器换成仅 API 的冻结 LLM 后本地 solver 进一步变好。
Conclusion: 去掉 challenger 训练、改用 solver 引导的任务采样，就能在省下过半训练时间的同时维持有竞争力的推理能力，且解锁了用冻结 API 模型做任务生成器这一能力。

papers.title: See, Measure, and Reason: Learning Visually Grounded Reasoning in Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Pathological assessment relies on recognizing fine-grained visual details in histological images. Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support pathology interpretation, yet their ability to perceive these details remains inadequate. This weakness leads to inaccurate cellular observations that can persist even when final answers are correct. In this paper, we propose ASPECT to improve visually grounded reasoning through explicit supervision of cellular appearance and abundance. ASPECT trains intermediate visual tokens through pathology feature reconstruction, cell feature alignment, and count supervision. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出病理 VLM 的视觉接地推理方法 ASPECT：用病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐与计数监督三路显式监督中间视觉 token，再经三阶段监督微调（感知、生成视觉 token、推理）与奖励答案正确性和测量一致性的强化学习。在 759 题专家审核的 PathoVernier 基准上，相对最强基线 Gemini-3.1-Pro 精度提升约 19.2%，相对 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干提升 99.3%，同时把正确答案内的计数错误指标 RAWR 分别降低 28.1% 与 42.7%。
Motivation: 病理 VLM 感知细粒度细胞形态与丰度的能力不足，导致中间细胞观察不准，即使最终答案正确也掩盖了这类错误，而现有基准只看最终答案。
Method: ASPECT 对中间视觉 token 施加三类显式监督：病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐、计数监督；随后三阶段监督微调依次教模型感知、生成视觉 token、推理，最后用强化学习同时奖励答案正确性与和报告测量值的一致性。配套提出 PathoVernier 基准，含 759 道专家审核问题、五个病理数据集、四类细胞组成任务，同时评测最终答案与中间测量。
Result: PathoVernier 上 ASPECT 相对最强基线 Gemini-3.1-Pro 精度提升约 19.2%，相对 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干提升 99.3%；衡量正确回答内计数错误的 RAWR 相对两者分别下降 28.1% 与 42.7%。在覆盖分类与问答的三个外部病理基准上也优于其骨干模型。
Conclusion: 对中间细胞观察（外观与丰度）施加显式监督并用测量一致性做强化学习奖励，能在不牺牲答案正确性的同时暴露并减少被答案精度掩盖的计数错误。

papers.title: BIABench: Evaluating AI agents on real-world bioimage analysis tasks
papers.abstract_en: Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents hold promise for automating bioimage analysis, yet no benchmark evaluates whether they can carry out real-world analyses end to end. Such analyses are hard for agents because 2D images, 3D volumes and time-lapse sequences are often too large to read as context, so an agent must choose and run an analysis through code, specialized software and rendered views. Published studies make this capability testable, because each pairs raw images with a peer-reviewed result. We introduce BIABench, a benchmark of 16 tasks reconstructed from published biological studies that retain their scientific questions, imaging data and ground truth. The tasks span eleven analysis subtasks and modalities from H&E histology to single-molecule localization microscopy. Each submission receives an outcome score, which compares the output files with the ground truth using field-standard metrics, and a process score, in which a vision-language model judges method choice and quality control against an expert-written rubric. We evaluated general-purpose and biology-specific agents across several language models, with repeated runs of every task. Routine two-dimensional tasks were solved well, but on some tasks that added a third dimension or a time axis no agent scored above 0.19. Neither biological specialization, stronger models nor detailed expert instructions closed this gap. The agents were also unreliable, with scores varying more between repeated runs of one agent than between different agents, and without ground truth a correct run could not be told from a wrong one by its process score or by the time spent. Released openly with its data and code, BIABench provides a verifiable framework for evaluating, and eventually training, agents for reliable long-horizon bioimage analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BIABench 把 16 个已发表生物影像研究重构成端到端 AI agent 基准，每个任务配原始图像与同行评议结果作为 ground truth，用 outcome score（按领域标准指标比对输出文件）和 process score（VLM 按专家评分细则评判方法选择与质控）双重打分。常规 2D 任务被解决得较好，但加入第三维或时间轴的任务上没有任何 agent 得分超过 0.19，且生物学专精、更强模型和详细专家指令都无法弥补这一差距。
Motivation: 现有基准无法检验 AI agent 能否端到端完成真实生物影像分析：2D 图像、3D 体数据和 time-lapse 序列常大到无法直接读入上下文，agent 必须通过代码、专用软件和渲染视图来选择并执行分析流程。
Method: 从已发表生物学研究重建 16 个任务，覆盖 11 个分析子任务、模态从 H&E 组织学到单分子定位显微镜 (SMLM)；每份提交同时获得 outcome score（用领域标准指标将输出文件与 ground truth 比对）和 process score（由 vision-language model 依据专家撰写的 rubric 评判方法选择与质量控制）；在多个语言模型上评估通用型与生物学专用 agent，每个任务重复运行多次。
Result: 常规二维任务被解决得较好；在加入第三维或时间轴的某些任务上，没有任何 agent 得分超过 0.19。生物学专精、更强模型、详细专家指令均未缩小该差距。agent 不可靠：同一 agent 重复运行之间的分数差异大于不同 agent 之间的差异；在没有 ground truth 时，正确运行无法通过其 process score 或所耗时间与错误运行区分开。
Conclusion: 可靠长时程 (long-horizon) 生物影像分析对当前 agent 仍是未解决问题，且现有过程指标与耗时无法替代 ground truth 来判定对错；BIABench 连同数据与代码开源，作为可验证的评估乃至训练框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 从已发表生物学研究重建 16 个任务，覆盖 11 个分析子任务、模态从 H&E 组织学到单分子定位显微镜 (SMLM)；每份提交同时获得 outcome score（用领域标准指标将输出文件与 ground truth 比对）和 process score（由 vision-language model 依据专家撰写的 rubric 评判方法选择与质量控制）；在多个语言模型上评估通用型与生物学专用 agent，每个任务重复运行多次。
summary_sections.result: 常规二维任务被解决得较好；在加入第三维或时间轴的某些任务上，没有任何 agent 得分超过 0.19。生物学专精、更强模型、详细专家指令均未缩小该差距。agent 不可靠：同一 agent 重复运行之间的分数差异大于不同 agent 之间的差异；在没有 ground truth 时，正确运行无法通过其 process score 或所耗时间与错误运行区分开。
summary_sections.conclusion: 可靠长时程 (long-horizon) 生物影像分析对当前 agent 仍是未解决问题，且现有过程指标与耗时无法替代 ground truth 来判定对错；BIABench 连同数据与代码开源，作为可验证的评估乃至训练框架。

papers.title: Query Expansion and Key Specialization in Transformer Attention Geometry
papers.abstract_en: The projection of queries and keys are central to the attention mechanism in Transformer architectures. While they are mathematically symmetric, they play different roles in attention mechanisms. The question of whether there is an effect from their functional distinction on their geometric development in training remains unanswered. We investigate the problem through the training of small GPT-like Transformers on character-level WikiText-103 for three different depths (4, 6, and 8 layers), three types of initialization for queries and keys, and four random seeds, resulting in 36 runs and 54 trajectories of average layers across seeds. We track the effective dimensionality of those layers using participation ratios and discover that effective dimension of queries expand while keys shrink, and that $PR_Q - PR_K$ is positive in all trajectories studied. In connection to attention, the shrinking of keys leads to a narrower spectrum of $QK^\top$ and more peaked attention weights. In order to determine if this connection is causal or coincidental, we directly control the spectrum of keys during training across five seeds: restricting it to make it shrink sharpens the attention with high directional confidence, while keeping it constant to the level of initial dispersion makes attention softer. Additional token-level checkpoint analyses show that the monotonic paired-contrast trend is not universal across pretrained families, but survives as an early-training regime that later decays over a full pretraining run, and the link between interaction-rank geometry and attention entropy remains visible in several models.
papers.comment: Accepted at Asian Conference on Machine Learning 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在字符级 WikiText-103 上训练小型 GPT 式 Transformer 时，query 的有效维度（participation ratio）持续扩张而 key 收缩，PR_Q − PR_K 在全部轨迹中为正；key 收缩使 QK^top 谱变窄、注意力权重更尖锐。直接约束 key 谱在五个种子上验证了因果性：强制收缩则注意力更尖锐且方向置信度高，保持初始色散水平则注意力更软。
Motivation: query 与 key 在数学上对称但在注意力中角色不同，其在训练中的几何分化是否真实存在、是否因果地影响注意力分布，此前没有答案。
Method: 在字符级 WikiText-103 上训练小型 GPT 式 Transformer，覆盖 4/6/8 三种深度、三种 query/key 初始化、四个随机种子，共 36 次运行、54 条跨种子平均层轨迹；用 participation ratio 跟踪各层有效维度，并在五个种子上直接控制训练中 key 的谱以检验因果；另做 token 级 checkpoint 分析与跨预训练模型家族比较。
Result: query 有效维度扩张、key 收缩，PR_Q − PR_K 在全部所研究轨迹中为正；key 谱收缩对应更窄的 QK^top 谱与更尖锐的注意力，直接限制 key 谱使其收缩会以高方向置信度锐化注意力，而把 key 谱保持在初始色散水平则使注意力更软；单调的配对对比趋势在不同预训练家族间并非普适，但作为早期训练阶段存在并在完整预训练过程中衰减，interaction-rank 几何与注意力熵的关联在多个模型中仍可见。
Conclusion: query/key 的功能不对称会转化为训练中的几何不对称，且 key 的谱收缩是注意力锐化的因果驱动而非伴随现象；但该配对对比趋势只是早期训练规律，随完整预训练推进而衰减。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Broken Symmetry in BF16 Attention: Why FlashAttention Gradients Blow Up Late in Training
papers.abstract_en: BF16 is now standard in large-scale pretraining, including in fused attention kernels such as FlashAttention, and these kernels are widely trusted. When we used FlashAttention-3 to pretrain a 450M-parameter transformer on 50B tokens, however, we ran into a problem: training was healthy for 25B tokens, then the gradient norm grew a thousandfold and the loss ended 0.2 nats above FP32 attention, without a single NaN. Recomputing the attention backward of just two layers in FP32 removes almost all of the excess gradient. Part of the cause is known: a fused multiply-add in the forward softmax, so far treated as an extreme-input NaN case and never fixed in FlashAttention-3. Repairing it stops the blow-up, but the query gradient is still wrong by more than its own size, and training still drives attention logits to thousands of times their size under accurate gradients. The remaining error comes from a broken conservation law. The softmax score gradient sums to zero along every row, which makes the query gradient blind to where the keys sit as a group; rounding it to BF16 leaves a small nonzero sum that leaks the mean key into the gradient, and the leak grows exactly as late training makes keys large and attention sharp. We introduce GProj (gauge projection), which restores the zero sum after the cast with two rank-one corrections per row. It cuts the remaining median query/key gradient errors from 219%/13% to 0.34%/0.37%, on par with FP32 attention, for 4.7% more time per training step. In matched from-scratch runs it trains to the same loss as FP32 attention, while FlashAttention-3 and key smoothing both destabilize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BF16 下的 FlashAttention 梯度在训练后期会爆炸：450M 模型预训练 50B tokens 时前 25B 正常，之后梯度范数暴涨千倍、loss 比 FP32 attention 高 0.2 nats 且无 NaN。根因是 softmax 分数梯度按行求和为零这一守恒律被 BF16 舍入破坏，均值 key 泄漏进 query 梯度；提出的 GProj（gauge projection）在舍入后用每行两个 rank-one 修正恢复零和，把 query/key 梯度中位误差从 219%/13% 降到 0.34%/0.37%，每步只多 4.7% 时间。
Motivation: BF16 已是大规模预训练标配，融合 attention kernel 被广泛信任，但训练后期梯度无预警爆炸且 loss 抬高，现有修复只当作极端输入 NaN 情形处理，未触及真正的守恒律破坏。
Method: 用 FlashAttention-3 预训练 450M 参数 transformer、50B tokens，先定位 forward softmax 中的 fused multiply-add 并修复，再提出 GProj：在 BF16 舍入后对每行施加两个 rank-one 修正，恢复 softmax 分数梯度的零和，从而消除均值 key 泄漏。
Result: 训练前 25B tokens 健康，之后梯度范数千倍增长，loss 比 FP32 attention 高 0.2 nats，全程无 NaN；仅把两层 attention backward 重算为 FP32 即可去掉几乎全部多余梯度。修复 FMA 后爆炸停止，但 query 梯度误差仍超过其自身量级。GProj 把 query/key 梯度中位误差从 219%/13% 降到 0.34%/0.37%，与 FP32 attention 相当，每训练步耗时增加 4.7%；matched from-scratch 运行中 GProj 训到与 FP32 attention 相同 loss，而 FlashAttention-3 与 key smoothing 均失稳。
Conclusion: BF16 attention 梯度爆炸源于被舍入破坏的零和守恒律而非单纯数值溢出，用 gauge projection 恢复该守恒即可在几乎不加开销下达到 FP32 attention 的梯度精度与训练稳定性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling Versatile 3D Assets Editing with a Million-Scale Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Although recent 3D generative models produce increasingly realistic assets, controllable 3D asset editing remains challenging. Existing methods are limited by scarce training data, insufficient source-aware modeling, and a lack of practical evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we present Alchemy3D, a unified framework for training and evaluating versatile 3D asset editors that covers data construction, model architecture, and benchmark evaluation. Specifically, we curate Alchemy3D-1M, a large-scale 3D editing dataset containing 1.25M assets and 1.38M editing pairs across seven editing types. On this data, we train a family of generative flow models for general-purpose 3D asset editing. The model family supports image- and text-conditioned editing, few-step inference, and transfer to multi-view 3D part segmentation. We further introduce GEdit3D-Bench, a large-scale, open-world benchmark with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, our method outperforms prior methods on most metrics of editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Alchemy3D：统一的 3D 资产编辑框架，含百万级编辑数据集 Alchemy3D-1M（1.25M 资产、1.38M 编辑对、七种编辑类型）、一族生成流模型（支持图像与文本条件编辑、少步推理、迁移到多视角 3D 部件分割），以及开放世界基准 GEdit3D-Bench。在既有与新引入基准上，该方法在编辑保真度、源保持与视觉质量的多数指标上超过先前方法。
Motivation: 可控 3D 资产编辑受限于训练数据稀缺、源感知建模不足，以及缺少实用的评测协议，导致编辑质量与源内容保持难以兼顾。
Method: 先构建 Alchemy3D-1M 数据集（1.25M 资产、1.38M 编辑对、七种编辑类型），再在其上训练一族生成流模型 (generative flow models)，支持图像条件与文本条件编辑、少步推理，并迁移到多视角 3D 部件分割；同时提出 GEdit3D-Bench 开放世界基准与多维评测协议。
Result: 在既有与新引入的基准上，该方法在编辑保真度、源保持、视觉质量三类指标的多数项上优于先前方法；数据规模为 1.25M 资产与 1.38M 编辑对，覆盖七种编辑类型。
Conclusion: 数据构建、模型架构与基准评测需要一起做，才能训练出通用且可公平评测的 3D 资产编辑器。

papers.title: Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
papers.abstract_en: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.
papers.comment: Accepted by CoRL 2026, also presented at IROS 2026 Human-Robot Dialogue workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把机器人澄清提问建成对 grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) 任务规格的贝叶斯主动学习：LLM 初始化候选形式规格并把信息量大的对比翻成自然语言问题，贝叶斯优化维护意图不确定性并选信息增益最大的查询，收敛后交给形式规划器合成可验证轨迹。在四个仿真与真实任务域上，该方法总体取得更高任务满意度、更少澄清轮次，并帮小模型缩小与大型推理模型的差距。
Motivation: 自然语言指令常含糊、不完整或欠指定，直接让 LLM 驱动多轮澄清会引入系统性失败，需要在形式化任务规格上显式维护意图不确定性。
Method: 贝叶斯主动学习框架：LLM 初始化候选 STL 形式规格并把 informative contrasts 译成澄清问题，贝叶斯优化做意图不确定性估计并按信息增益选查询，收敛后将推断出的 STL 规格交给 formal planner 合成可验证机器人轨迹。
Result: 在四个仿真与真实任务域上，该方法总体取得更高任务满意度、所需澄清轮次少于 LLM 基线，并帮助较小模型缩小与更大推理模型的性能差距。
Conclusion: 把澄清当作对形式规格的主动学习而非自由生成对话，能在多轮交互中以更少轮次达到更高任务满意度，并降低对大模型规模的依赖。

papers.title: SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 3 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/mtbui2010/sage_release

papers.title: ZeroCode: On-demand Error-Correcting Code Construction from the Zero Matrix via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Error-correcting codes (ECCs) are essential across diverse applications, from wireless communications and storage to quantum computing, yet each application imposes distinct design requirements on the parity-check matrix (PCM). To address these on-demand requirements in a unified framework, we propose ZeroCode, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based approach that constructs PCMs sequentially from the all-zero matrix. ZeroCode formulates construction as a discrete sequential decision-making problem and uses proximal policy optimization with action masking to select valid edges. ZeroCode achieves a gain of approximately 1 dB over the prior RL-based construction method at a bit error rate (BER) of $10^{-4}$ for the (32,16) code and outperforms existing genetic, differentiable, and classical code-design methods in our experiments. Beyond optimizing decoding performance, the masking mechanism allows on-demand structural constraints, such as a maximum degree, 4-cycle-free structure, and quasi-cyclic structure, to be flexibly incorporated. Moreover, a single policy rollout yields a library of PCMs with varying edge counts, offering trade-offs between decoding performance and complexity without retraining. Overall, ZeroCode addresses diverse code-design requirements within a unified framework, providing solutions with optimized decoding performance under given constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeroCode 用强化学习从全零矩阵逐步构造校验矩阵 (PCM)，以 PPO 加动作掩码保证结构约束合法。在 (32,16) 码上，BER 10^-4 处比此前基于 RL 的构造方法约好 1 dB，并在实验中胜过遗传、可微与经典码设计方法；单次策略 rollout 即可得到不同边数的 PCM 库。
Motivation: 不同应用对校验矩阵的结构要求（最大度数、无 4-环、准循环）各异，现有码设计方法难以在统一框架内按需满足这些约束并兼顾译码性能。
Method: 把 PCM 构造建模为离散序贯决策问题，从全零矩阵出发用 PPO 逐条选边，动作掩码只允许合法边；掩码机制同时注入最大度数、4-cycle-free、准循环等结构约束。
Result: 在 (32,16) 码上，BER 10^-4 处相对此前 RL 构造方法获得约 1 dB 增益；实验中优于遗传、可微与经典码设计方法。单次 rollout 产出边数不同的 PCM 库，给出译码性能与复杂度的权衡且无需重训练。
Conclusion: 以 PPO 加动作掩码从零矩阵序贯构造 PCM，能在同一框架下按需施加结构约束并优化译码性能，且一次 rollout 即覆盖性能-复杂度权衡谱。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rotated Manifold Optimization for Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel optimizer for low-rank adaptation (LoRA) that explicitly incorporates the gauge symmetry of low-rank factorization. Our optimizer extends recent matrix optimizers for full-parameter training to the manifold of fixed-rank matrices by interpreting them as normalization under a rotated basis. We show how rotation and normalization can be integrated with the fixed-rank manifold efficiently. Our optimizer converges faster to lower held-out loss and achieves better or comparable downstream performance on both supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向低秩适配 (LoRA) 的旋转流形优化器，把全参数训练的矩阵优化器解释为旋转基下的归一化，并显式利用低秩分解的规范对称性 (gauge symmetry)，将旋转与归一化高效地整合到固定秩矩阵流形上。该优化器收敛更快、达到更低的 held-out loss，在监督微调与强化学习任务上取得更好或相当的下游性能。
Motivation: LoRA 的低秩分解存在规范对称性，直接在因子上做优化会忽略这一几何结构；现有面向全参数训练的矩阵优化器也未被移植到固定秩矩阵流形。
Method: 把近期全参数矩阵优化器重新解释为旋转基下的归一化，将其扩展到固定秩矩阵流形 (fixed-rank manifold)，在优化过程中联合执行旋转与归一化，并保证计算高效；应用于 LoRA 的监督微调与强化学习训练。
Result: 收敛更快并达到更低的 held-out loss；在监督微调 (SFT) 与强化学习 (RL) 两类任务上，下游性能优于或可比于对照方法。
Conclusion: 把规范对称性显式纳入优化几何，可以在固定秩流形上加速 LoRA 训练并保持或提升下游表现，适用于 SFT 与 RL 两种微调范式。

papers.title: Maintaining Benchmarks Against Increasingly Capable Agents: Detection and Remediation of Unearned Passes
papers.abstract_en: Agentic benchmarks guide model selection and training. Yet an agent can pass a task without demonstrating the intended capability. Such outcomes constitute unearned passes; their proportion among all passes defines the integrity gap. As agents improve, benchmark surfaces that once seemed harmless can become exploitable, making benchmark validity an ongoing maintenance problem. We introduce a process-verification framework that audits passing trajectories, distinguishes evidenced reward hacking from verifier weakness, and localizes exploitable surfaces for repair. Across 3,810 passing trajectories from 29 model-benchmark cohorts, confirmed violations often increase with model generation but not monotonically. On SWEBench Pro V1.0, confirmed violation rates rise from 24% to 73% between Opus 4.7 and Fable 5 on matched tasks; later cohorts fall to 11% for Fable 5.1 and 0% for GPT-6 Astra. These comparisons are descriptive: configurations were not normalized, and the latest models also pass fewer exploitable tasks. Violations concentrate around a small set of recurring surfaces, especially unintended access to reference solutions through git history. Three repair case studies across two benchmarks show why blocking a recorded exploit is insufficient: the same protected information can remain accessible through another route. Therefore, we combine minimal patches with exploit replay and fresh agent evaluation, auditing new passes under the original standard. No evaluated attempt against the final patches reached the protected channel, and every post-patch pass was judged legitimate. Benchmark integrity requires ongoing maintenance: audit passing behavior, repair the enabling surface, and re-evaluate both exploit access and legitimate solvability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 agentic benchmark 的过程验证框架，审计通过轨迹、区分真实 reward hacking 与 verifier 弱点，并定位可被利用的表面。在 29 个模型-基准队列的 3,810 条通过轨迹中，SWEBench Pro V1.0 上确认违规率从 Opus 4.7 的 24% 升到 Fable 5 的 73%，随后 Fable 5.1 降到 11%、GPT-6 Astra 降到 0%；违规集中在 git history 泄露参考答案等少数反复出现的表面。作者主张基准完整性需要持续维护：审计通过行为、修补漏洞表面、再同时复测漏洞可达性与正常可解性。
Motivation: agent 可以不展示预期能力就通过任务（unearned pass），其在全部通过中的占比即 integrity gap；随着模型变强，原本看似无害的基准表面变得可利用，基准效度成为持续维护问题。
Method: 过程验证框架审计通过轨迹，区分有证据的 reward hacking 与 verifier 弱点，并定位可利用表面；修复采用最小补丁加 exploit replay 加新 agent 重评，并按原标准审计新的通过。
Result: 覆盖 29 个模型-基准队列的 3,810 条通过轨迹，确认违规常随模型代际上升但非单调；SWEBench Pro V1.0 匹配任务上确认违规率从 Opus 4.7 的 24% 升至 Fable 5 的 73%，后续队列降至 Fable 5.1 的 11% 与 GPT-6 Astra 的 0%（描述性比较，配置未归一化，最新模型通过的可利用任务也更少）；违规集中于少数反复表面，尤其是 git history 中对参考解的非预期访问；两个基准上的三个修复案例显示，最终补丁下没有任何被评估的尝试触及受保护通道，补丁后每次通过均被判为正当。
Conclusion: 基准完整性需要持续维护：审计通过行为、修补使漏洞成立的表面，并同时复评漏洞可达性与正常可解性；仅封堵已记录的单条 exploit 不够，同一受保护信息仍可经其他路径获得。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboICL 是一个不改参数、不训 VLA 的机器人上下文学习框架，把示范上下文与交互记忆分开存放，用统一的 observation-action-receipt-observation 语法和锚定记忆跨阶段保留经验。在 RoboDojo 30 任务上 Overall 50.64 对最强基线 33.68，真实机器人三任务均值从零样本 14.45 升到一 shot 63.33、三 shot 78.89。
Motivation: 通用视觉语言模型 GPT-6 Astra 做零样本机器人控制时，开放指令与图像条件操作表现好，但在高精度和长程任务上明显偏弱，且机器人专用微调成本高。
Method: RoboICL 分离 demonstration context（有示范时提供录制样例）与 interaction memory（累积自身动作与结果），两者共用 observation-action-receipt-observation 语法；用采样示范块加有界锚定记忆（bounded anchored memory）保留早期 rollout，最新交互用于即时纠错；可选 Jev-gated action reuse 减少模型调用。
Result: RoboDojo 30 任务上，Open 用零样本、其余每任务一示范，各类别相对官方零样本 GPT-6 Astra 提升 20–27 个 progress-score 点；Memory 与 Open 领先榜单基线，Precision 与最强基线相当，Long-Horizon 有竞争力；30 任务 Overall 50.64 对最强基线 33.68。独立十任务子集 60.60，距 π0.5+GPT-6 Astra 混合方案 2.00 点以内。三个真实机器人任务均值 14.45（零 shot）→63.33（一 shot）→78.89（三 shots）。两个开发任务上 Jev-gated action reuse 减少 33–48% 的 GPT-6 Astra 调用。
Conclusion: 不更新参数、不训 VLA，仅靠分离示范与交互记忆并用锚定记忆跨阶段保留经验，就能大幅缩小通用 VLM 在高精度与长程机器人任务上的差距，同时把模型调用压掉三到五成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QuantaSpike: Short-Window Spike-Driven Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks but rely on dense multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations during inference, resulting in high energy cost. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an event-driven alternative in which synaptic integration uses lightweight accumulation. However, spike-driven LLM inference remains difficult because outlier-heavy activations typically require long firing windows or auxiliary non-spiking paths. We propose QuantaSpike, a short-window spike-driven quantization framework for LLMs built around Logarithmic Ternary Integrate-and-Fire (LTIF) neurons. LTIF uses ternary events with power-of-two membrane-response quanta, improving the information represented by each firing step while retaining shift-ACC-compatible computation. QuantaSpike combines this neuron with group-adaptive gain and selective outlier admission: normal values use residual LTIF steps, whereas admitted outliers receive one additional onset spike before entering the same residual dynamics. Across OPT and Llama-2, QuantaSpike achieves state-of-the-art or competitive perplexity and zero-shot accuracy among spike-driven LLM quantization methods. It also transfers to newer dense LLMs, remaining close to the FP16 reference on Llama-3-8B and Qwen3-8B under the same four-step firing window. Analytical linear-energy projections show that QuantaSpike reduces the energy of one linear transformation by about $80.0\%$ on OPT models and $67.1\%$ on Llama-2 models relative to SpikeQuant, providing an accurate and energy-efficient spike-driven path for LLM inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuantaSpike 用对数三值发放神经元 (Logarithmic Ternary Integrate-and-Fire, LTIF) 把 spike 驱动 LLM 量化压进四步发放窗口：三值事件配 2 的幂次膜响应量子，配合 group-adaptive gain 与 selective outlier admission（被接纳的离群值先多发一个 onset spike 再进入同一残差动力学）。在 OPT 与 Llama-2 上达到 spike 驱动 LLM 量化方法中 SOTA 或有竞争力的 perplexity 与 zero-shot 准确率，线性层能耗相对 SpikeQuant 在 OPT 上降约 80.0%、Llama-2 上降 67.1%。
Motivation: LLM 推理依赖稠密 MAC 运算导致高能耗；SNN 的事件驱动累加本可省能，但激活中的离群值通常要求长发放窗口或额外非 spike 通路，使 spike 驱动 LLM 推理难以落地。
Method: 核心是 LTIF 神经元：三值事件 + 2 的幂次膜响应量子，保持 shift-ACC 兼容计算；外加 group-adaptive gain 与 selective outlier admission，普通值走残差 LTIF 步，被接纳的离群值先补一个 onset spike。在 OPT、Llama-2 上做 spike 驱动量化，并迁移到 Llama-3-8B、Qwen3-8B，统一使用四步发放窗口；能耗用线性层解析投影估计。
Result: 在 OPT 与 Llama-2 上取得 spike 驱动 LLM 量化方法中 SOTA 或有竞争力的 perplexity 与 zero-shot 准确率；在 Llama-3-8B 与 Qwen3-8B 上同样四步发放窗口下接近 FP16 参考；解析线性能耗投影显示单次线性变换能耗相对 SpikeQuant 在 OPT 模型上降低约 80.0%、Llama-2 模型上降低 67.1%。
Conclusion: 把每个发放步的信息量做对数三值化并只对离群值做选择性补偿，可以在四步短窗口内同时守住精度与省能，为 LLM 推理给出一条准确且低能耗的 spike 驱动路径。

papers.title: Investigating Human--AI Discrepancies via Multiple-Solution Problems
papers.abstract_en: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models are benchmarked on whether they reach a correct answer. Yet many problems admit several correct answers and repeated attempts, by different people or by the same model resampled, trace out a distribution over them. In this work, we ask whether human and model reasoning lead to different distributions over valid solutions. Our testbed comprises 270 reasoning puzzles across five puzzle families. These multiple-solution puzzles each have 3 to 8 valid solutions and are simple enough that humans and models can solve them reliably. The resulting distributions differ markedly: models differ from one another, yet resemble each other far more than they resemble humans. Model distributions are, moreover, within every puzzle family, less diverse than human ones. We compare these discrepancies across puzzle categories, and trace how they respond to reasoning-effort settings, to prompting, and to perturbations of the puzzle that leave its solutions unchanged. Together, these results point at significant differences between human and AI problem-solving processes, and their choice among equally defensible solutions. As progressive deployment of AI systems in society comes into focus, evaluating such differences (beyond one-dimensional accuracy metrics) is increasingly important. Data and code are available at https://hai-discrepancies.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 270 道多解推理谜题（5 个谜题族、每题 3–8 个合法解）比较人类与模型在等价正确解上的选择分布：模型之间彼此相似度远高于与人类的相似度，且在每个谜题族内模型分布都比人类分布更不多样。作者据此主张评估不能只看一维正确率，还要看解的分布差异。
Motivation: 现有 AI 基准只判答案对错，无法区分人类与模型在多个同样站得住脚的正确解之间的选择差异，而这种差异随 AI 系统部署变得需要度量。
Method: 构建 270 道跨 5 个谜题族的多解推理谜题测试床，每题有 3–8 个合法解且人和模型都能可靠解出；对同一模型重复采样、对多人重复作答得到解的分布，再跨谜题族比较人-模型与模型-模型差异，并考察 reasoning-effort 设置、prompting 以及不改变解集的谜题扰动如何影响这些差异。
Result: 模型分布之间差异明显小于它们与人类分布的差异；在每个谜题族内模型分布的多样性都低于人类分布；这些差异随 reasoning-effort 设置、prompting 和保持解集不变的谜题扰动而变化。测试床规模为 270 道谜题、5 个谜题族、每题 3–8 个合法解。
Conclusion: 人类与 AI 在同等可辩护的正确解上的选择过程存在系统性差异，仅靠一维准确率不足以刻画这种差异，评估应纳入解分布层面的比较。

papers.title: Recursive LLM Degradation in Biomedical Question Answering: A Cross-Generation Study
papers.abstract_en: Repeatedly training language models on their own generated data may create a synthetic-data feedback loop in which errors and distributional biases are reintroduced into subsequent training datasets. This paper studies that process in biomedical question answering (QA) using PubMedQA and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, 0.5B and 3B parameters. The study compares a recursive synthetic-data condition, in which generation G(k+1) is trained on answers produced by G(k), against a Human-Control condition that repeatedly uses the original human training data. The study evaluates across four generations from G0-G3 with two random seeds (42 and 123) and a fixed evaluation set of 1,000 expert-labeled samples. The evaluation includes disease and chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, lexical and semantic similarity, answer length, repetition rate, and other evaluation metrics. The Recursive condition for both model sizes and both seeds showed larger declines than the Human-Control condition in disease entity F1, chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity. Under the fixed no-repeat 3-gram decoding constraint, the main observed behavioral change was increased answer length, while the measured 3-gram repetition rate did not increase. The magnitude of the difference-in-change was larger for the 3B model than for the 0.5B model. This difference was particularly apparent in disease F1, context-supported rate, cosine similarity, and answer length. These results show domain-specific changes associated with using recursive synthetic-data training in biomedical QA, but do not establish clinical hallucination rates or universal model collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PubMedQA 上让 Qwen2.5（0.5B/3B）用自己上一代的生成答案反复训练（G0–G3），疾病实体 F1、化学实体 F1、context-supported rate、ROUGE-L 与余弦相似度的下降幅度都大于始终用原始人工数据的 Human-Control，且 3B 的差异大于 0.5B。固定 no-repeat 3-gram 解码下主要行为变化是答案变长，而 3-gram 重复率并未上升。
Motivation: 递归使用模型自产数据训练可能形成 synthetic-data feedback loop，把误差与分布偏差重新注入后续训练集；该过程在生物医学 QA 中缺少跨模型规模、跨代际的受控对照。
Method: 在 PubMedQA 上对比两种条件：Recursive（G(k+1) 用 G(k) 的答案训练）与 Human-Control（反复使用原始人工训练数据），覆盖 G0–G3 四代、随机种子 42 与 123、Qwen2.5 的 0.5B 与 3B 两个规模，评测用 1,000 条专家标注固定样本，指标含疾病/化学实体 F1、context-supported rate、词汇与语义相似度、答案长度、重复率等。
Result: Recursive 条件在两个模型规模、两个种子上，疾病实体 F1、化学实体 F1、context-supported rate、ROUGE-L 与余弦相似度的下降均大于 Human-Control；差异幅度 3B 大于 0.5B，在疾病 F1、context-supported rate、余弦相似度与答案长度上尤其明显。固定 no-repeat 3-gram 解码下主要行为变化是答案长度增加，而测得的 3-gram 重复率没有上升。
Conclusion: 递归合成数据训练与生物医学 QA 中的一组领域特定退化相关，但这些结果不确立临床幻觉率，也不构成普遍的 model collapse。

papers.title: DreamingGoose: Staged Distillation from Autoregressive Transformers to Bidirectional Recurrent Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained autoregressive Transformers represent a large sunk investment in compute. Existing conversion methods reuse that investment by changing either the architecture (attention to recurrence) or the objective (next-token prediction to denoising), never both. We convert Qwen3 teachers at 1.7B and 8B into attention-free, bidirectional, gated-delta-rule diffusion students in three stages, so that each capability can be traced to the stage that kept or lost it. Language modeling transfers only partially and in-distribution; in-context retrieval does not transfer. On a multi-query recall probe where the teachers score 0.34-0.58, both converted students score 0.000, and diffusion pretraining alone does not restore retrieval. A retrieval curriculum in the final stage, which gradually lengthens the gap between a key-value table and the queries that address it, restores it only stochastically: on a fixed schedule, one seed in three learns to retrieve. Advancing the gap only while a running accuracy estimate stays above a threshold works for all three of those seeds, holds on real text, and carries unchanged to 8B, where two of three seeds succeed. The third had not learned within its fixed 16k-step budget: retrieval switches on abruptly at a seed-dependent step (6.5k and 11k in the other two), so a fixed budget can cut a late run off. One boundary survives every intervention: every model that learns retrieval scores 0.000 on tokens that never appeared in a retrieval episode, and an arm that resamples the key and value tokens every batch shows this is a coverage limit, not memorization of particular bindings. Separately, we convert a 7B code model into a 3:1 recurrent-attention block-diffusion hybrid over 85k steps and report two negative training results.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Companion to arXiv:2609.16183. Code and result data at https://github.com/JIBSIL/dualgoose
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamingGoose 把 Qwen3 自回归教师（1.7B/8B）分三阶段蒸馏成无注意力的双向 gated-delta-rule 扩散学生，使每项能力可归因到具体阶段。语言建模仅部分且同分布迁移，in-context 检索完全不迁移（教师 0.34–0.58，学生 0.000）；末段用自适应检索课程（精度估计高于阈值才推进 key-value 表与 query 的 gap）可恢复检索，但存在覆盖边界：未出现在检索 episode 中的 token 恒为 0.000。
Motivation: 预训练自回归 Transformer 是巨大算力沉没投资，现有转换方法只改架构（attention→recurrence）或只改目标（next-token→denoising），从不同时改两者，导致能力迁移无法归因到具体改动。
Method: 三阶段蒸馏：把 Qwen3 1.7B/8B 教师转为无注意力、双向、gated-delta-rule 的扩散学生，逐阶段追踪能力保留或丢失；末段引入检索课程，逐步拉长 key-value 表与寻址 query 的 gap，一种变体按运行精度估计高于阈值才推进 gap。另将 7B 代码模型转为 3:1 recurrent-attention block-diffusion 混合，训练 85k 步。
Result: 多查询 recall 探针上教师 0.34–0.58，两个转换学生均 0.000，单纯扩散预训练不能恢复。固定 gap 推进日程下 1.7B 三个 seed 仅一个学会检索；阈值自适应推进对三个 seed 全部有效并迁移到 8B（三个 seed 中两个成功）。学会检索的模型在从未出现在检索 episode 的 token 上恒为 0.000；每 batch 重采样 key/value token 的对照臂证明这是覆盖限制而非特定绑定的记忆。检索在 seed 相关步数突变开启（另两个 seed 为 6.5k 与 11k 步），第三个 seed 在固定 16k 步预算内未学会。
Conclusion: 同时改架构与目标的分阶段蒸馏能保留语言建模但保不住 in-context 检索，检索须靠课程重新教，且自适应 gap 推进优于固定日程；固定训练预算会截断晚启动的 run，而检索能力存在覆盖而非记忆的根本边界。

summary_sections.tldr: DreamingGoose 把 Qwen3 自回归教师（1.7B/8B）分三阶段蒸馏成无注意力的双向 gated-delta-rule 扩散学生，使每项能力可归因到具体阶段。语言建模仅部分且同分布迁移，in-context 检索完全不迁移（教师 0.34–0.58，学生 0.000）；末段用自适应检索课程（精度估计高于阈值才推进 key-value 表与 query 的 gap）可恢复检索，但存在覆盖边界：未出现在检索 episode 中的 token 恒为 0.000。

summary_sections.method: 三阶段蒸馏：把 Qwen3 1.7B/8B 教师转为无注意力、双向、gated-delta-rule 的扩散学生，逐阶段追踪能力保留或丢失；末段引入检索课程，逐步拉长 key-value 表与寻址 query 的 gap，一种变体按运行精度估计高于阈值才推进 gap。另将 7B 代码模型转为 3:1 recurrent-attention block-diffusion 混合，训练 85k 步。
summary_sections.result: 多查询 recall 探针上教师 0.34–0.58，两个转换学生均 0.000，单纯扩散预训练不能恢复。固定 gap 推进日程下 1.7B 三个 seed 仅一个学会检索；阈值自适应推进对三个 seed 全部有效并迁移到 8B（三个 seed 中两个成功）。学会检索的模型在从未出现在检索 episode 的 token 上恒为 0.000；每 batch 重采样 key/value token 的对照臂证明这是覆盖限制而非特定绑定的记忆。检索在 seed 相关步数突变开启（另两个 seed 为 6.5k 与 11k 步），第三个 seed 在固定 16k 步预算内未学会。
summary_sections.conclusion: 同时改架构与目标的分阶段蒸馏能保留语言建模但保不住 in-context 检索，检索须靠课程重新教，且自适应 gap 推进优于固定日程；固定训练预算会截断晚启动的 run，而检索能力存在覆盖而非记忆的根本边界。

papers.title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WAM-OPD 用 on-policy distillation 提升预训练 world action model 的目标任务表现，同时保住未参与适配的既有技能；其核心 PWTR 用固定轨迹池（以初始学生 rollout 为主、教师 rollout 补充）替代蒸馏期间的重复环境交互，按轨迹前缀累积的 path score 计算代理重要性权重来重加权逐步蒸馏损失。仿真与真机实验显示蒸馏过程无需额外环境交互，目标任务性能提升且被排除任务保持接近初始水平。
Motivation: 预训练 WAM 要在目标任务上逼近专家水平又不退化已有技能，但闭环操作中观测历史随策略演化，on-policy 蒸馏需要持续新 rollout，即使在仿真中也昂贵、真机上往往不可行。
Method: WAM-OPD 在学生自身诱导分布上传递教师知识；PWTR 用固定轨迹池（主要为初始学生 rollout，加任务特定教师 rollout 扩展覆盖），对每条回放轨迹让学生策略在存储历史上生成新的去噪路径 (denoising paths) 并由教师监督，再用轨迹前缀上累积的 path score 得到代理重要性权重，重加权每步蒸馏损失以缓解历史分布偏移。
Result: 仿真与真实机器人实验均表明蒸馏期间无需额外环境交互即可完成任务适配；两种设置下 WAM-OPD 都提升了目标任务性能，同时在未参与适配的任务上保持接近初始水平的表现。
Conclusion: 用固定轨迹池加重要性权重重加权，可以在不重新采集环境数据的前提下把 on-policy 蒸馏用于 WAM，实现目标任务提升与既有技能保留的兼顾。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evolving Support Priorities in Empathetic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We identify a fundamental mismatch in empathetic reinforcement learning: support priorities evolve with the dialogue state, yet existing methods typically optimize predefined reward specifications that remain fixed across turns. To model these evolving support priorities, we organize empathetic support along cognitive, affective, and proactive empathy, and propose Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE). At each turn, CARE generates a context-adaptive rubric by adjusting both the weights of these three empathy dimensions and their fine-grained evaluation criteria. The rubric generator is trained with turn-level rubric supervision and human preference data through supervised fine-tuning followed by preference-based reinforcement learning, and then serves as an adaptive reward interface for online empathetic RL. Integrated with both RLVER and MICA, CARE achieves state-of-the-art performance across SentientBench, EQBench3, and EMPA under three independent LLM judges. Notably, on EMPA, CARE improves EPM-Idx over the strongest baseline by at least 13 points under all three judges, including an increase from 28.11 to 83.54 under Gemini-2.5-Pro. Further analyses show that learned rubric priorities systematically vary across dialogue stages and user emotions, demonstrating that CARE adapts what is rewarded as support needs evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 共情强化学习中支持优先级随对话状态变化，而现有方法固定优化预设奖励。提出 Context-Adaptive Rubric Evolution (CARE)，逐轮调整认知、情感、主动三类共情维度的权重与细粒度评分标准，作为在线 RL 的自适应奖励接口；在 EMPA 上 EPM-Idx 相对最强基线至少提升 13 点，Gemini-2.5-Pro 评判下从 28.11 升到 83.54。
Motivation: 共情对话中用户的支持需求随轮次与情绪演变，但现有共情 RL 方法优化的奖励规格跨轮固定，奖励对象与真实需求错位。
Method: 按认知、情感、主动共情组织支持维度，CARE 的 rubric generator 逐轮生成上下文自适应评分标准，同时调整三维权重与细粒度准则；先用轮级 rubric 监督与人类偏好数据做监督微调，再做偏好驱动的强化学习，之后作为在线共情 RL 的奖励接口，接入 RLVER 与 MICA。
Result: 在 SentientBench、EQBench3、EMPA 三个基准上，配合三个独立 LLM 评判达到 state-of-the-art；EMPA 上 EPM-Idx 相对最强基线在三个评判下均至少提升 13 点，Gemini-2.5-Pro 下由 28.11 升至 83.54。分析显示学到的 rubric 权重随对话阶段与用户情绪系统性变化。
Conclusion: 把奖励本身做成随对话状态演化的对象，比固定奖励规格更能匹配共情支持需求的变化；CARE 可作为通用自适应奖励接口接入既有共情 RL 流程。

papers.title: CasEm: A Cascade Architecture for Long-Horizon Neural Emulation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive neural emulators can drift or diverge over long rollouts despite accurate short-term predictions. We introduce Cascaded Emulation (CasEm), a one-way rollout architecture that augments an existing full-state backbone with an independently evolving model of physically specified aggregates. Its forecasts guide corrections to full-state predictions, without feedback from the backbone to the aggregate model. Effective guidance requires aggregates that cover substantial backbone error, remain accurately predictable, and support useful full-state corrections. We derive a finite-horizon error bound that clarifies these three factors and use empirical diagnostics to guide subsystem selection. Across four ODE/PDE benchmarks, CasEm reduces long-horizon rollout errors across diverse backbones and suppresses the trend toward error divergence in both diffusion tasks using Fourier neural operator backbones. In global climate emulation, CasEm with a regional total-water subsystem reduces 10-year full-state time-mean error by 66.6% and 46.3% for frozen ACE and Spherical DYffusion backbones, respectively, while adding less than 3% to inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CasEm 用单向级联把一个物理聚合量子系统（如区域总水量）与全状态骨干耦合：聚合模型独立演化，其预报单向校正全状态预测，反向不回馈。有限时域误差界给出有效引导的三条件（聚合量覆盖骨干误差、可准确预测、能支撑有用校正），在四个 ODE/PDE 基准上抑制长时程误差发散，全球气候仿真中 10 年时间平均误差对冻结 ACE 与 Spherical DYffusion 分别下降 66.6% 与 46.3%，推理时间增加不到 3%。
Motivation: 自回归神经仿真器 (autoregressive neural emulator) 短时预测虽准，长时程 rollout 会漂移甚至发散，需要在不重训骨干的前提下抑制长期误差累积。
Method: 提出 Cascaded Emulation (CasEm)：在既有全状态骨干旁挂一个物理指定聚合量的独立演化模型，聚合预报单向指导全状态校正、无骨干到聚合的反馈；推导有限时域误差界刻画覆盖度、可预测性、可校正性三因子，并用经验诊断选择子系统。
Result: 在四个 ODE/PDE 基准上，CasEm 降低多种骨干的长时程 rollout 误差，并在两个以 Fourier neural operator 为骨干的 diffusion 任务上抑制误差发散趋势；全球气候仿真中，配区域总水量 (regional total-water) 子系统使 10 年全状态时间平均误差对冻结 ACE 下降 66.6%、对 Spherical DYffusion 下降 46.3%，推理时间增加不足 3%。
Conclusion: 只要聚合量同时满足覆盖骨干误差、可准确预测、可支撑有效校正三条件，单向级联即可在几乎不增加推理开销的情况下压住长时程发散。
Relevance: 38
