papers.title: Certified Multi-Source Integrity for Structured Agent Actions
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly take privileged, often irreversible structured actions, such as paying an invoice. They assemble each action from action-critical fields in documents and tool outputs that an adversary can corrupt, and indirect prompt injection can drive the model itself to extract attacker-chosen values. Current defenses gate on a source's trust label or certify free-text answer quality. None certifies the integrity of a coupled, policy-bound structured action under a corruption budget that accounts for shared upstream sources. We characterize when such an action is safely certifiable and give the maximally live safe certifier. It admits an action only when each field clears the rule its evidence structure supports: a bounded corruption radius over corruption-distinct evidence classes, counted by a minimum hitting set so that re-publishing or laundered copies cannot manufacture a quorum, deterministic reconciliation for complementary fields, and a trusted anchor where the evidence leaves a field single-sourced. We formalize two robustness notions, validate each mechanism by ablation, and measure how often the multi-source precondition holds on sanctions designations (70,966 entities) and software supply-chain provenance (450 packages). Under upper-bound proxies, genuine corroboration is a minority phenomenon in both, and naive attestation counting overstates it, since witnesses that look independent collapse to two corruption-distinct domains once shared origin is counted. Across five current models in a real agent loop, a realistic injection fools every model but one and a naive agent then executes the fraudulent action on most attacks. The certifier admits no unsafe action and recovers the correct value where corroboration permits, while action-gating and provenance baselines are broken in every world of our harness by some attack in its space.
papers.comment: Accepted to the UK AI Conference 2026 (UKAI 2026), to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research. 14 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/anmolpandey299/certified-multisource-integrity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM agent 的结构化动作（如支付发票）缺少完整性认证，提出在腐败预算下认证耦合、绑定策略的多源动作的安全认证器：每个字段按其证据结构对应的规则放行，包括按最小 hitting set 计数的 corruption-distinct 证据类腐败半径、互补字段的确定性对账、单源字段的可信锚点。在 70,966 个制裁实体与 450 个软件供应链包上，真实佐证在两者中都是少数，朴素见证计数会高估它；五个模型的真实 agent loop 中，一次现实注入骗过除一个外的全部模型，而认证器不放行任何不安全动作。
Motivation: LLM agent 执行特权且常不可逆的结构化动作，动作字段来自可被对手篡改的文档与工具输出，间接提示注入还能让模型自行抽取攻击者选定的值；现有防御只按来源信任标签设门或只认证自由文本答案质量，无法认证在考虑共享上游来源的腐败预算下耦合、绑定策略的结构化动作的完整性。
Method: 给出可安全认证的刻画与最大存活安全认证器 (maximally live safe certifier)：字段须通过其证据结构支持的规则——对 corruption-distinct 证据类的有界腐败半径、用最小 hitting set (minimum hitting set) 计数以防重复发布或洗稿副本制造法定人数、互补字段的确定性对账 (deterministic reconciliation)、单源字段的可信锚点 (trusted anchor)；形式化两种鲁棒性概念，并对每个机制做消融验证。
Result: 在制裁指定 (sanctions designations, 70,966 entities) 与软件供应链来源 (450 packages) 上测量多源前提出现频率：在上界代理下，真实佐证在两个数据集中都是少数现象，朴素 attestation 计数会高估它，看似独立的见证在计入共享来源后坍缩为两个 corruption-distinct 域。五个当前模型的真实 agent loop 中，一次现实注入骗过除一个外的全部模型，朴素 agent 在多数攻击上执行欺诈动作；认证器不放行任何不安全动作，并在佐证允许处恢复正确值，而 action-gating 与 provenance 基线在其 harness 的每个 world 中都被其攻击空间中的某个攻击击破。
Conclusion: 结构化 agent 动作只有在每个字段的证据结构支持其腐败半径规则时才可安全认证，按 corruption-distinct 域而非见证数量计数才能防止共享来源伪造佐证；作者给出的认证器在所测攻击空间内既不放行不安全动作，又在佐证允许时保住可用性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 针对 LLM agent 的结构化动作（如支付发票）缺少完整性认证，提出在腐败预算下认证耦合、绑定策略的多源动作的安全认证器：每个字段按其证据结构对应的规则放行，包括按最小 hitting set 计数的 corruption-distinct 证据类腐败半径、互补字段的确定性对账、单源字段的可信锚点。在 70,966 个制裁实体与 450 个软件供应链包上，真实佐证在两者中都是少数，朴素见证计数会高估它；五个模型的真实 agent loop 中，一次现实注入骗过除一个外的全部模型，而认证器不放行任何不安全动作。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM agent 执行特权且常不可逆的结构化动作，动作字段来自可被对手篡改的文档与工具输出，间接提示注入还能让模型自行抽取攻击者选定的值；现有防御只按来源信任标签设门或只认证自由文本答案质量，无法认证在考虑共享上游来源的腐败预算下耦合、绑定策略的结构化动作的完整性。
summary_sections.method: 给出可安全认证的刻画与最大存活安全认证器 (maximally live safe certifier)：字段须通过其证据结构支持的规则——对 corruption-distinct 证据类的有界腐败半径、用最小 hitting set (minimum hitting set) 计数以防重复发布或洗稿副本制造法定人数、互补字段的确定性对账 (deterministic reconciliation)、单源字段的可信锚点 (trusted anchor)；形式化两种鲁棒性概念，并对每个机制做消融验证。
summary_sections.result: 在制裁指定 (sanctions designations, 70,966 entities) 与软件供应链来源 (450 packages) 上测量多源前提出现频率：在上界代理下，真实佐证在两个数据集中都是少数现象，朴素 attestation 计数会高估它，看似独立的见证在计入共享来源后坍缩为两个 corruption-distinct 域。五个当前模型的真实 agent loop 中，一次现实注入骗过除一个外的全部模型，朴素 agent 在多数攻击上执行欺诈动作；认证器不放行任何不安全动作，并在佐证允许处恢复正确值，而 action-gating 与 provenance 基线在其 harness 的每个 world 中都被其攻击空间中的某个攻击击破。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结构化 agent 动作只有在每个字段的证据结构支持其腐败半径规则时才可安全认证，按 corruption-distinct 域而非见证数量计数才能防止共享来源伪造佐证；作者给出的认证器在所测攻击空间内既不放行不安全动作，又在佐证允许时保住可用性。

papers.title: Stashbird: Efficient Speaker-Indexed Memory for Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents require memory that preserves information across user-agent exchanges, user-to-user conversations, and group conversations with or without agent participation, while supporting updates as evidence changes or is removed. We present Stashbird, an agent memory system that links source episodes to derived memory state through explicit provenance. Stashbird organizes memory into episodic records, semantic relations, community summaries, and persisted graph state, with lifecycle operations for incremental updates and episode-level deletion. We evaluate question-answering accuracy and model-facing workload across four long-term memory benchmarks. On LoCoMo, Stashbird uses 76.4x fewer ingestion prompt tokens than Graphiti. Compared with reproduced Hindsight on the same benchmark, it uses 8.1x fewer retrieval prompt tokens, with accuracy 1.6 percentage points lower. It achieves higher accuracy than Hindsight on LongMemEval-S and GroupMemBench and comparable accuracy on EverMemBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Stashbird 是面向对话智能体的长期记忆系统，用显式 provenance 把源 episode 与派生记忆状态绑定，组织为 episodic 记录、semantic 关系、community 摘要与持久化图状态，并提供增量更新与 episode 级删除的生命周期操作。在四个长期记忆基准上，它在 LoCoMo 上比 Graphiti 少用 76.4 倍的摄取 prompt token，比复现的 Hindsight 少用 8.1 倍检索 prompt token、准确率低 1.6 个百分点，并在 LongMemEval-S 与 GroupMemBench 上准确率高于 Hindsight。
Motivation: 对话智能体需要跨用户-智能体、多用户与群聊的记忆，并要在证据变更或被删除时同步更新；现有记忆系统摄取与检索的 prompt token 开销大，且难以做 episode 级回溯删除。
Method: Stashbird 以显式 provenance 关联源 episode 与派生记忆状态，记忆分四层：episodic 记录、semantic 关系、community 摘要、持久化图状态；配套生命周期操作支持增量更新与 episode 级删除。评测在四个长期记忆基准上度量问答准确率与面向模型的 prompt token 工作量。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 上摄取 prompt token 比 Graphiti 少 76.4 倍；与同基准复现的 Hindsight 相比，检索 prompt token 少 8.1 倍、准确率低 1.6 个百分点；在 LongMemEval-S 与 GroupMemBench 上准确率高于 Hindsight，在 EverMemBench 上准确率相当。
Conclusion: 带显式 provenance 的分层记忆可以用数量级更少的 prompt token 换取大致相当的问答准确率，代价是在 LoCoMo 上 1.6 个百分点的准确率损失。

papers.title: AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies
papers.abstract_en: Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. To support learning this capability, we introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset of 10,939 training examples and 1,000 test examples covering policies with 1--100 rules. The dataset combines trajectories from multiple sources with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, pairing each example with an explanation and the complete set of violated rules. These counterfactuals expose changes that alter compliance, while structural augmentations provide supervision for consistency under rule reordering and identifier remapping. Building on this supervision, we propose SafePO, a reinforcement learning algorithm for refining violation identification while balancing explanatory reasoning and final verdicts. SafePO uses structured rewards to assess prediction correctness, retains group-relative advantages at the response level, and employs a separately trained value model to modulate token weights within explanation and verdict regions. Separate normalization controls their relative contribution to training despite differences in length. Through supervised initialization followed by SafePO, we develop AdaGuard, a family of 0.6B, 4B, and 8B guard models that assess agent trajectories under policies supplied at inference time. Our 4B model achieves binary accuracies of 89.30\% on AdaptiveSafety and 71.82\% on DynaBench. The project repository is available at https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/AdaGuard
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaGuard 是一族按推理时给定的用户自定义策略判定 agent 轨迹是否违规的 guard 模型（0.6B/4B/8B），配套发布含 10,939 条训练、1,000 条测试、覆盖 1–100 条规则的 AdaptiveSafety 数据集与强化学习算法 SafePO。4B 模型在 AdaptiveSafety 上二分类准确率 89.30%，在 DynaBench 上 71.82%。
Motivation: 固定风险分类的 guard 模型无法适配随应用与任务变化的策略要求；在用户自定义策略下判定违规需同时解读规则与 agent 行为，同一动作在不同策略下可能得到不同判定。
Method: 构建 AdaptiveSafety 数据集：多源轨迹叠加策略与行为反事实（暴露改变合规性的改动），并用结构化增广监督规则重排与标识符重映射下的一致性，每条样本配解释与完整违规规则集合。提出 SafePO 强化学习算法：结构化奖励评估预测正确性、在响应层面保留 group-relative advantage、用单独训练的价值模型调节解释区与判决区的 token 权重，并对两区分别归一化以抵消长度差异；经监督初始化后训练出 AdaGuard。
Result: AdaptiveSafety 含 10,939 条训练样本与 1,000 条测试样本，策略覆盖 1–100 条规则；AdaGuard 4B 在 AdaptiveSafety 上二分类准确率 89.30%，在 DynaBench 上 71.82%。
Conclusion: 把违规判定建立在推理时输入的策略之上、并用反事实与结构化增广提供监督，可训练出跨策略的 guard 模型族，4B 规模即在两个基准上给出可用的二分类准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Coherence-Aware Distributional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing metrics for open-ended text generation measure likelihood, lexical diversity, or distributional similarity in generic representation space, yet they can miss fundamental dimensions of quality. A prominent blind spot is global coherence: a generated passage may be locally fluent while remaining globally contradictory, causally inconsistent, or topically disconnected. Such failures can still preserve the token-level and lexical statistics that existing metrics rely on. We identify representation as a central bottleneck in detecting these failures and introduce CHORD (Coherence-aware Hidden-state Open-generation Reference Distance), a coherence-sensitive distributional metric. CHORD encodes generated and human-written corpora in the hidden-state space of a frozen LLM using a coherence-eliciting prompt, and compares the resulting distributions using MMD with an RBF kernel. To validate that the metric responds to coherence degradation but not generic textual change, we construct a counterfactual evaluation suite that pairs graded coherence-degrading perturbations with meaning-preserving controls. CHORD selectively detects relation, discourse, structural, and mixture failures that perplexity, entropy, MAUVE, FBD, and MMD-based baselines either miss or cannot separate from benign rewriting. Factorial ablations show that representation is the primary source of coherence sensitivity,while RBF-MMD improves sample efficiency once the relevant distinctions become visible. Larger backbones capture finer-grained distinctions, but coherence prompting improves selectivity only when the backbone can follow the prompt.On unconditional generation and prefix continuation, CHORD yields model rankings that strongly align with human judgments of whether outputs make sense and appear human-written. Together, these results establish representation design as central to reliable distributional evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开放域文本生成的连贯性感知分布度量 CHORD：用冻结 LLM 的 hidden-state 空间加连贯性引导 prompt 编码生成与人类语料，再用 RBF 核 MMD 比较分布。在分级连贯性破坏与保义对照构成的反事实评测套件上，CHORD 能选择性检出 relation、discourse、structural 与 mixture 失败，而 perplexity、entropy、MAUVE、FBD 及普通 MMD 基线要么漏检、要么无法与良性改写区分。
Motivation: 现有开放文本生成度量依赖似然、词面多样性或通用表示空间的分布相似度，会漏掉全局连贯性这类失败：段落可以局部流畅却全局矛盾、因果不一致或主题脱节，同时仍保住 token 级与词面统计。
Method: CHORD (Coherence-aware Hidden-state Open-generation Reference Distance) 把生成文本与人类文本用连贯性引导 prompt 编码进冻结 LLM 的 hidden-state 空间，用 RBF 核 MMD 比较两组分布；验证用反事实评测套件，把分级的连贯性破坏扰动与保义对照配对，并做因子消融分离表示与核函数的贡献。
Result: CHORD 检出 relation、discourse、structural 与 mixture 四类失败，而 perplexity、entropy、MAUVE、FBD 与 MMD 基线漏检或无法与良性改写区分；因子消融显示表示选择是连贯性敏感度的主要来源，RBF-MMD 在区分可见后提升样本效率；更大 backbone 捕捉更细粒度区分，连贯性 prompt 只在 backbone 能遵循指令时提高选择性；在无条件生成与前缀续写上，CHORD 的模型排序与人类关于输出是否合理、是否像人写的判断强一致。
Conclusion: 表示设计是可靠分布度量的核心：先让连贯性差异在表示空间可见，核函数与 prompt 才能发挥作用，且 prompt 的收益受 backbone 指令遵循能力限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DecFlowEdit: Self-Localized Flow-based Image Editing via Guidance Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based image editing (FlowEdit) enables inversion-free semantic changes through the difference between source and target velocities. In this paper, we observe that FlowEdit's default classifier-free guidance (CFG) configuration, with asymmetric source and target scales, causes substantial background leakage. Matching these guidance scales, for example by removing CFG, improves edit-relevant localization but severely degrades editability. To get the best of both worlds, we propose DecFlowEdit, which decouples the optimal guidance scales for localization and for editing in flow-based generative models. In particular, DecFlowEdit first extracts an edit-relevant prior by temporally aggregating velocity differences evaluated without CFG, and then uses this prior to reweight the original updates under default CFG. Our method remains training-free and inversion-free, requiring neither external spatial masks nor attention manipulation. Experiments on PIE-Bench across FLUX, SD3, and SD3.5 show that DecFlowEdit improves background preservation, reducing structure distance by approximately 61 to 73 percent and background LPIPS by 68 to 80 percent relative to FlowEdit at comparable editing fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecFlowEdit 指出 FlowEdit 默认非对称 CFG 会把编辑泄漏到背景，而对齐或去掉 CFG 虽提升定位却严重损害可编辑性；它把定位与编辑两个最优 guidance scale 解耦：先在无 CFG 下时序聚合速度差得到编辑相关先验，再用该先验重加权默认 CFG 下的更新。在 PIE-Bench 上跨 FLUX、SD3、SD3.5 相对 FlowEdit，结构距离降约 61%–73%，背景 LPIPS 降 68%–80%，编辑保真度相当。
Motivation: FlowEdit 的默认 CFG 用非对称源/目标 scale 导致明显背景泄漏，而直接匹配 scale（如去掉 CFG）虽改善编辑定位却大幅削弱可编辑性，定位与编辑两个目标在单一 guidance scale 下互相冲突。
Method: 训练-free、免反演 (inversion-free)：先在不加 CFG 的条件下时序聚合速度差，提取编辑相关先验 (edit-relevant prior)，再用该先验对默认 CFG 下的原始更新做重加权，从而解耦定位与编辑各自的最优 guidance scale；不需要外部空间掩码或注意力操纵。
Result: 在 PIE-Bench 上、跨 FLUX、SD3 与 SD3.5 三个流模型，相对 FlowEdit 在可比编辑保真度下结构距离 (structure distance) 降低约 61%–73%，背景 LPIPS 降低 68%–80%。
Conclusion: 定位与编辑所需的最优 guidance scale 应当解耦：用无 CFG 的速度差先验重加权默认 CFG 更新，可在保持可编辑性的同时显著抑制背景泄漏，且无需训练、反演或掩码。

summary_sections.conclusion: 定位与编辑所需的最优 guidance scale 应当解耦：用无 CFG 的速度差先验重加权默认 CFG 更新，可在保持可编辑性的同时显著抑制背景泄漏，且无需训练、反演或掩码。

papers.title: SegBanana: Steering Unified Multimodal Models into Medical Segmenters
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in practical deployment, as models often struggle to generalize beyond the distributions covered by their training data and high-quality pixel-level annotations are typically unavailable for adaptation. Inspired by the cross-task transferability of large language models, we investigate whether unified multimodal models (UMMs) can transfer their pretrained visual understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities to medical image segmentation without task-specific post-training. By recasting segmentation as structured visual generation, we find that frontier UMMs (e.g., Nano Banana) already exhibit basic segmentation capabilities across diverse clinical scenarios, but still struggle with challenging tasks requiring specialized anatomical or domain-specific knowledge. We further show that these limitations can be effectively mitigated by incorporating visual anatomical knowledge from in-context exemplars, expanding candidate solutions through repeated sampling, and refining suboptimal predictions via targeted editing.Motivated by these observations, we propose SegBanana, to our knowledge, the first agentic visual generation framework for training-free medical image segmentation. SegBanana builds on a frozen UMM as the core generative model, augmented with Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval and Comparative Quality Critique to unlock its potential segmentation capability. A State-Aware Multimodal Controller maintains structured state and iteratively orchestrates these tools, repeatedly refining intermediate predictions toward higher-quality masks. Across eight medical segmentation datasets, SegBanana achieves an average mDice of 77.45%, outperforming representative generalist (SAM3 and SegGPT) and medical-specific (BiomedParse and MedSAM3) baselines by at least 14.93 points, while remaining robust to out-of-domain visual supports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SegBanana 把医学图像分割重写为结构化视觉生成，用冻结的统一多模态模型 (UMM, 如 Nano Banana) 加解剖知识检索、比较式质量批评与状态感知控制器，迭代精修掩码，实现免训练分割。在八个医学分割数据集上平均 mDice 77.45%，比 SAM3、SegGPT、BiomedParse、MedSAM3 等基线至少高 14.93 个百分点。
Motivation: 医学分割模型难超出训练分布泛化，且适配时通常没有高质量像素级标注；作者想检验 UMM 的预训练视觉理解与生成能力能否跨任务迁移到分割而无需任务后训练。
Method: 以冻结 UMM 为核心生成模型，把分割当作视觉生成；加入 Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval 从 in-context 样例取视觉解剖知识、Comparative Quality Critique 比较候选质量，由 State-Aware Multimodal Controller 维护结构化状态并反复编排这些工具，通过重复采样扩展候选、定向编辑精修次优预测。
Result: 在八个医学分割数据集上平均 mDice 77.45%，比通用基线 SAM3、SegGPT 与医学专用基线 BiomedParse、MedSAM3 至少高 14.93 个百分点，并对域外视觉支持 (out-of-domain visual supports) 保持稳健。
Conclusion: 免训练的 agentic 视觉生成框架足以把前沿 UMM 变成跨临床场景可用的医学分割器，解剖知识注入与迭代批评精修是补齐其专业短板的关键。

papers.title: Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述把合成视觉媒体的可信性问题重新定义为「证据链」问题：真实媒体不再自带可追溯历史，可信度必须来自能说明资产经历路径与使用情境的证据，其中一部分可从媒体本身恢复，另一部分必须在生成时记录并随流转保存。作者主张不存在普适的真伪标记，证据须匹配具体问题、送达做判断的人，并在更好信息出现时可被更正。
Motivation: 生成系统能不留稳定历史地生产与修改逼真图像视频，外观已无法区分拍摄、合成或篡改，单一真伪标记的思路随之失效。
Method: 作为综述 (review)，把两类证据路径——从媒体本身恢复的取证证据与生产期记录并随资产保存的溯源证据——放到同一框架下，考察其声明在常规处理或蓄意操纵后是否仍然成立。
Result: 给出论证性结论而非实验数字：可信媒体不依赖单一普适真伪标记，证据须与所问问题匹配、触达判断者，并在新信息出现时保持可更正。
Conclusion: 媒体可信性应按「证据是否适配问题、是否可达、是否可更正」来设计，目标是让媒体历史在媒体本身持续变化时仍可理解。

papers.title: ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReGDiff 把超材料体素几何生成放进受调控的隐空间，用 repel-and-sink (RAS) 平滑合理几何的隐分布，再用 short-range repulsion (SRR) 引导避开已知样本以换取新颖性。在 truss 与 shell 两类体素数据集上，相对体素生成基线平均几何合理性 +8.9%、新颖性 +46.4%、多样性 +128.6%。
Motivation: 体素化超材料生成存在合理性—新颖性权衡：贴近已知几何能保住规律，远离又容易退化，缺少统一的 benchmark 与评价模块来同时度量三者。
Method: REGDIFF 将体素表示与隐空间调控加引导扩散耦合：RAS 机制平滑合理几何的隐分布，SRR 引导抑制过于贴近已知样本的生成；并贡献覆盖 truss 与 shell 型超材料体素几何的 benchmark 及几何合理性、新颖性、多样性评价模块。
Result: 在两个数据集上相对体素生成基线平均：几何合理性 +8.9%，新颖性 +46.4%，多样性 +128.6%。
Conclusion: 在隐空间同时做分布平滑与短程排斥，可在不牺牲几何合理性的前提下大幅抬高新颖性与多样性，使 ReGDiff 成为下游评估的强几何候选生成器。

papers.title: SleuthBench: Benchmarking Statistical LLM Evaluation Using Tabular Hidden Signals
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating statistical discovery by large language model (LLM) agents requires verifiable analytical ground truth. Establishing such ground truth for real-world datasets is costly, and prior knowledge of public datasets can influence agent responses. We introduce SLEUTHBENCH, a benchmark that addresses both problems by injecting controlled data-quality problems and feature effects into public tabular datasets: the injected pattern determines the answer, so reference answers are computed automatically and memorized knowledge of the original table is insufficient, while the table keeps its background structure. The injected patterns are modeled on phenomena reported in real data analyses. The benchmark defines 17 question templates in two families: data-quality questions and feature-contribution questions. We evaluate six state-of-the-art LLMs that analyze the data using a Python coding tool, on data-science and business phrasings of 70 validated dataset-template combinations, yielding 1680 graded responses in total. The models detect data-quality problems reliably (83.8% accuracy) but recover feature contributions poorly (41.9%). Finding how features shape the target requires searching over both candidate variables and analytical procedures. To address this issue, we propose the Empirical Layer, a set of precomputed statistical artifacts comprising summaries, fitted feature and interaction effects, and dataset descriptions, which exposes candidate patterns for direct inspection. Access to these artifacts raises feature-contribution accuracy from 41.9% to 68.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLEUTHBENCH 通过向公开表格数据注入可控的数据质量问题与特征效应来构造可自动核验的统计发现基准，注入模式决定答案且原表记忆无效。六个前沿 LLM 用 Python 工具分析 70 个数据集-模板组合共 1680 条分级回答：数据质量题准确率 83.8%，特征贡献题仅 41.9%；提供预计算统计工件（Empirical Layer）后特征贡献准确率升至 68.0%。
Motivation: 评估 LLM 的统计发现能力需要可验证的分析真值，但真实数据集构造真值成本高，且公开数据集的先验知识会污染模型回答。
Method: 在公开表格数据中注入按真实数据分析现象建模的数据质量问题与特征效应，定义 17 个问题模板（数据质量与特征贡献两类）；对 70 个已验证的数据集-模板组合提供数据科学与商业两种措辞，让六个前沿 LLM 通过 Python 编码工具作答，共 1680 条分级回答；并提出 Empirical Layer，即预计算的汇总统计、拟合特征与交互效应、数据集描述等统计工件。
Result: 数据质量题准确率 83.8%，特征贡献题 41.9%；接入 Empirical Layer 工件后特征贡献准确率从 41.9% 升至 68.0%。评测覆盖六个 LLM、70 个数据集-模板组合、两种措辞，共 1680 条分级回答。
Conclusion: LLM 已能可靠检出数据质量问题，但检索特征如何塑造目标需同时搜索候选变量与分析流程，把预计算统计工件直接暴露给模型可显著补上这一短板。

papers.title: When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model
papers.abstract_en: Does conversational memory need LLM-extracted facts, or is selecting the right raw turns enough? Published results disagree. Extraction-based systems report gains from distilled facts. Recent studies find raw history with good ranking does as well, but disagree about whether ranking matters. We ran a pre-registered study on held-out LoCoMo conversations and LongMemEval. At a tight budget on LoCoMo, raw turns selected by a single call to Jev, a typed decision model, are non-inferior to an LLM-extraction memory (one-sided 95% bound -3.0 points against a -5-point margin). Blind human grading narrows the margin but does not change the result. Raw turns cost 3,061 times less to write, and the result holds with a second answer model. Within this study, reranking's gain shrinks as the budget grows. It adds 17.4 points on LoCoMo and 9.1 on LongMemEval when three of 30 candidates are kept. At generous budgets it adds 1.5 and 1.1, and extraction systems are more accurate. This suggests why published results disagree. At matched context, Jev selects as accurately as an LLM reranker (non-inferiority bound -2.0) at a third of the latency, and more accurately than a multi-call graph traversal. Reranking lowers correct abstention. Plans, code and graded answers are released.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 9 figures. Pre-registered: plan doi:10.5281/zenodo.22970745, amendment doi:10.5281/zenodo.22977848. Preprint also at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22985242. Code and data: https://github.com/ris3abh/Engram
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预注册研究在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上判定：紧预算下用 Jev（typed decision model）单次调用选出的原始对话轮次，对 LLM 抽取式记忆非劣（单侧 95% 界 -3.0 分，非劣界 -5 分），且写入成本低 3061 倍；但重排序 (reranking) 的收益随预算增长而塌缩——保留 3/30 候选时在 LoCoMo 加 17.4 分、LongMemEval 加 9.1 分，宽裕预算下只加 1.5 与 1.1 分，此时抽取式系统反而更准。
Motivation: 对话记忆该靠 LLM 抽取出的事实，还是只靠对原始轮次做检索选择，已发表结论互相矛盾：抽取式报告蒸馏事实有增益，近期工作称排序良好的原始历史同样有效，却对排序本身是否重要各执一词。
Method: 预注册研究（plan 与 amendment 均有 DOI），在 held-out LoCoMo 对话与 LongMemEval 上比较三种记忆路径：LLM 抽取式记忆、原始轮次 + Jev typed decision model 单次调用选择、原始轮次 + LLM 重排序与多跳图遍历 (graph traversal)；采用非劣性检验（-5 分界）、盲评人工打分，并换用第二个 answer model 复核。
Result: 紧预算 LoCoMo 上 Jev 选原始轮次对抽取式记忆非劣，单侧 95% 界 -3.0 分（界 -5 分），盲评缩小差距但不改结论；原始轮次写入成本低 3061 倍，结论在第二个 answer model 上成立。重排序在保留 3/30 候选时加 17.4 分（LoCoMo）与 9.1 分（LongMemEval），宽裕预算下仅 1.5 与 1.1 分，此时抽取式更准。同等上下文下 Jev 与 LLM reranker 准确度非劣（界 -2.0），延迟为其 1/3，且优于多跳图遍历；重排序会降低正确弃答 (correct abstention)。
Conclusion: 作者认为预算决定了答案：紧预算下选择原始轮次即可替代抽取，重排序收益随预算增长而消失，这解释了已发表结果为何互相冲突；但宽裕预算下抽取式系统更准确。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 预注册研究在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval 上判定：紧预算下用 Jev（typed decision model）单次调用选出的原始对话轮次，对 LLM 抽取式记忆非劣（单侧 95% 界 -3.0 分，非劣界 -5 分），且写入成本低 3061 倍；但重排序 (reranking) 的收益随预算增长而塌缩——保留 3/30 候选时在 LoCoMo 加 17.4 分、LongMemEval 加 9.1 分，宽裕预算下只加 1.5 与 1.1 分，此时抽取式系统反而更准。
summary_sections.motivation: 对话记忆该靠 LLM 抽取出的事实，还是只靠对原始轮次做检索选择，已发表结论互相矛盾：抽取式报告蒸馏事实有增益，近期工作称排序良好的原始历史同样有效，却对排序本身是否重要各执一词。
summary_sections.method: 预注册研究（plan 与 amendment 均有 DOI），在 held-out LoCoMo 对话与 LongMemEval 上比较三种记忆路径：LLM 抽取式记忆、原始轮次 + Jev typed decision model 单次调用选择、原始轮次 + LLM 重排序与多跳图遍历 (graph traversal)；采用非劣性检验（-5 分界）、盲评人工打分，并换用第二个 answer model 复核。
summary_sections.result: 紧预算 LoCoMo 上 Jev 选原始轮次对抽取式记忆非劣，单侧 95% 界 -3.0 分（界 -5 分），盲评缩小差距但不改结论；原始轮次写入成本低 3061 倍，结论在第二个 answer model 上成立。重排序在保留 3/30 候选时加 17.4 分（LoCoMo）与 9.1 分（LongMemEval），宽裕预算下仅 1.5 与 1.1 分，此时抽取式更准。同等上下文下 Jev 与 LLM reranker 准确度非劣（界 -2.0），延迟为其 1/3，且优于多跳图遍历；重排序会降低正确弃答 (correct abstention)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为预算决定了答案：紧预算下选择原始轮次即可替代抽取，重排序收益随预算增长而消失，这解释了已发表结果为何互相冲突；但宽裕预算下抽取式系统更准确。

papers.title: Low latency global carbon budget reveals strong land sink recovery in 2025
papers.abstract_en: The atmospheric CO2 growth rate fell sharply in 2025, from a record 3.76 $\pm$ 0.09 ppm yr-1 in 2024 to 2.06 $\pm$ 0.09 ppm yr-1 (NOAA marine boundary layer observations), below the 2015-2022 mean of 2.47 ppm yr-1, even as fossil CO2 emissions rose by 0.7% to 10.38 GtC yr-1. Here we present a low-latency global and regional carbon budget for 2025, combining three dynamic global vegetation models (DGVMs) and ocean model emulators with four atmospheric inversions constrained by OCO-2 satellite retrievals. The global net land sink reached 2.36 $\pm$ 0.16 GtC yr-1 in 2025 (DGVMs: 2.04 $\pm$ 0.24; inversions: 2.68 $\pm$ 0.20 GtC yr-1), strengthening by 2.81 $\pm$ 0.31 GtC yr-1 from 2024 and exceeding the 2015-2022 mean by 0.71 $\pm$ 0.13 GtC yr-1. Ocean uptake (3.11 $\pm$ 0.36 GtC yr-1) remained similar to 2024, making the land sink rebound the dominant driver of the slowdown in CO2 growth. Tropical lands shifted from net sources in 2024 to net sinks in 2025, with enhanced uptake across much of Africa and northern Eurasia, and land flux anomalies covaried with GRACE terrestrial water storage. Where the sink had weakened substantially in 2023-2024, about 80% of the area showed some recovery, with overall recovery of 87.3% (DGVMs) to 99.5% (inversions). Recovery exceeded 100% in the tropics but remained incomplete in the northern extratropics, indicating a strong but spatially uneven rebound of the land carbon sink.

papers.title: Uncovering Ordinal-Matching Bias in Audio-Visual LLMs
papers.abstract_en: This work aims to improve how audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) associate speech with the correct visible speaker in multi-speaker scenes. We find that current AVLLMs frequently fail at this task, and analyze the nature of these failures. To this end, we construct a synthetic diagnostic dataset in which multiple visible speakers each utter a single word. Analysis on this corpus reveals a consistent error pattern across three recent open-source AVLLMs: models attribute utterances by simply matching the order of spoken sentences with the left-to-right, top-to-bottom arrangement of visible faces, rather than relying on audio-visual cues such as lip synchronization. We term this behavior \emph{ordinal-matching bias}. We further show that this bias can be substantially mitigated through a simple remedy, Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning (OD-FT), in which models are fine-tuned on synthetic videos where spatial positions of speakers and speaking order are independently randomized. Despite using only 400 synthetic training videos, OD-FT not only suppresses ordinal-matching bias but also improves audio-visual understanding on real-world videos, yielding average gains of 8.27\% for Qwen2.5-Omni and 2.57\% for video-SALMONN2+ across three audio-visual benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 音频-视觉大模型 (AVLLM) 在多说话人场景里把说话顺序与画面中人脸的从左到右、从上到下排布直接对齐，而不是靠唇音同步等音视觉线索，作者称之为 ordinal-matching bias。用说话人空间位置与说话顺序各自独立随机的合成视频做 OD-FT 微调，仅 400 条训练视频即可抑制该偏置，并在三个音视觉基准上把 Qwen2.5-Omni 平均提升 8.27%、video-SALMONN2+ 提升 2.57%。
Motivation: 多说话人场景中把话语归属到正确可见说话人是 AVLLM 的基础能力，但现有模型频繁出错，且错误模式未被刻画，无法针对性修复。
Method: 先构造合成诊断数据集：多个可见说话人各说一个单词，用于定位错误模式；再提出 Ordinal-Decoupled Fine-Tuning (OD-FT)，在说话人空间位置与说话顺序被独立随机化的合成视频上微调模型。
Result: 在三个近期开源 AVLLM 上一致观察到按说话顺序匹配人脸排布的 ordinal-matching bias；OD-FT 仅用 400 条合成训练视频即抑制该偏置，并在三个音视觉基准的真实视频上取得平均增益：Qwen2.5-Omni 8.27%，video-SALMONN2+ 2.57%。
Conclusion: ordinal-matching bias 是当前 AVLLM 的共性捷径，而把空间位置与说话顺序解耦的微调能以极小合成数据量同时纠正偏置并提升真实视频上的音视觉理解。

papers.title: WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress, world models still lack explicit, persistent structural memory, making it difficult to preserve consistent world structure during continual scene expansion and cross-view revisits. To address this limitation, we present WorldWeave, a world generation framework that decouples world-state maintenance from visual rendering. Specifically, WorldWeave combines continual elevation-map generation with agent-guided scene organization and stitching to build an expandable explicit 3D world that incrementally extends structural memory while preserving existing structure. First, its terrain module uses diffusion-based image outpainting to generate continuous metric elevation maps under neighborhood conditioning and boundary constraints. Next, an agent integrates user intent, terrain evidence, and cross-region connectivity constraints to construct scenes through hierarchical semantic planning, deterministic geometry compilation, and local revision. Finally, during visual generation, planned camera trajectories query world geometry through a read-only interface, producing depth sequences that guide video synthesis without writing the generated results back into the world state. As a result, structural memory remains independent of short-window video generation, enabling continual expansion without predefined map boundaries and providing a consistent geometric basis for observations across trajectories and repeated visits.
papers.comment: Project page: https://laiyindagm.github.io/WorldWeave/ . Code repository: https://github.com/laiyindagm/WorldWeave (implementation coming soon)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldWeave 把世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦：用扩散式图像 outpainting 在邻域条件与边界约束下持续生成度量高程图，再由 agent 做层级语义规划与确定性几何编译，渲染时相机轨迹只读查询几何生成深度序列引导视频合成，生成结果不写回世界状态。由此结构记忆与短窗口视频生成相互独立，可在无预设地图边界条件下持续扩张，并在跨轨迹与重复访问时保持一致几何。
Motivation: 现有 world model 缺少显式、持久的结构记忆，连续场景扩张与跨视角重访时难以保持世界结构一致。
Method: 三段式：地形模块用 diffusion-based image outpainting 在邻域条件与边界约束下生成连续度量高程图；agent 融合用户意图、地形证据与跨区域连通约束，做层级语义规划、确定性几何编译与局部修订；视觉生成阶段相机轨迹经只读接口查询世界几何，产出深度序列引导视频合成且不写回世界状态。
Result: 产出一个可扩张的显式 3D 世界框架：结构记忆独立于短窗口视频生成，支持无预设地图边界的持续扩张，并为跨轨迹与重复访问的观测提供一致几何基准。
Conclusion: 把世界状态与渲染解耦、以只读接口查询几何，是维持持久结构记忆并允许持续场景扩张的可行设计。

papers.title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
papers.abstract_en: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: mmHRI 用毫米波雷达替代 RGB 相机做隐私保护的人机交互：双流网络同时吃未滤波原始雷达张量与雷达点云，估计人体动作与 3D 姿态，再由基于记忆的状态空间模型 (MSSM) 平滑时序抖动，估计结果转成结构化文本指令驱动 VLA 策略闭环操作。在窗帘遮挡的隐私场景下动作识别准确率 85.09%，超过现有雷达方案，机器人在视觉遮挡下完成配送与取物。
Motivation: 现有 HRI 依赖 RGB 相机持续拍摄人体以响应手势等非语言指令，在病房、餐厅等隐私敏感场所受限；毫米波雷达能穿透遮挡感知动作且无可辨识影像，但雷达数据稀疏、时序不一致，直接用于机器人操作环境困难。
Method: 双流架构并行处理未滤波原始雷达张量与雷达点云，联合估计人体动作和 3D 姿态；引入记忆式状态空间模型 (MSSM) 保留历史雷达特征以抑制姿态/动作的突变；估计出的人体状态转为结构化文本机器人指令，控制 vision-language-action (VLA) 策略做闭环操作与人机协同反应。
Result: 在隐私保护窗帘设置下动作识别准确率 85.09%，优于现有基于雷达的方案；机器人试验在视觉遮挡条件下成功完成配送与取物任务，且在未见过的受试者、杂乱布局与环境之间保持稳定任务表现。评测覆盖人体动作识别与闭环配送/取物两类任务。
Conclusion: 毫米波雷达配合双流估计与 MSSM 时序平滑，可以在无可辨识影像的前提下支撑闭环 HRI 操作，跨受试者与环境保持稳定。

papers.title: Loop Dropout: Regularizing Shared Updates in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models separate computational depth from parameter count by repeatedly applying the same transformer block. Adapting these models requires a shared update that remains effective as hidden states evolve throughout the recurrent computation. Our empirical analysis reveals a pronounced late-loop bias in standard low-rank adaptation (LoRA): the shared update is more effective at later loop positions. This imbalance motivates training shared updates under varying combinations of their applications. Randomly omitting adapter applications alone, however, does not improve task performance; it reduces expected update strength during training while leaving inference unchanged. We introduce Loop Dropout, which couples stochastic masking of adapter applications with inverse-survival rescaling to preserve expected update strength and promote effective adaptation across loops. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved mathematical reasoning across model sizes, adapter ranks and training recipes, with benefits extending to general instruction tuning and code generation. Loop Dropout outperforms existing LoRA variants and adapter regularizers, while further analysis shows stronger early-loop adaptation. Every backbone loop remains active, and inference applies the adapter at all loops using standard LoRA without additional trainable parameters or inference computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Looped language model 中 LoRA 的共享更新存在明显 late-loop bias，即同一 adapter 在靠后的 loop 位置更有效。Loop Dropout 在训练时随机丢弃 adapter 应用并用 inverse-survival rescaling 补偿，使期望更新强度与推理一致，从而把适应能力前移到早期 loop。在多种模型规模、adapter rank 与训练配方下数学推理提升，并延伸到通用指令微调与代码生成，优于现有 LoRA 变体与 adapter 正则化方法，推理时仍按标准 LoRA 在所有 loop 应用 adapter，不增加可训练参数与计算。
Motivation: Looped LM 把计算深度与参数量解耦，但同一个共享 adapter 要在 hidden state 不断演化的整段循环中保持有效；标准 LoRA 的更新在 loop 位置上分布不均，早期 loop 适应不足。
Method: Loop Dropout：训练时对 adapter 应用做随机 masking（stochastic masking），并配合 inverse-survival rescaling 保持期望更新强度，使训练期的随机丢弃与推理期全 loop 应用相匹配；骨干每个 loop 保持激活，推理用标准 LoRA 在所有 loop 应用 adapter，不引入额外可训练参数或推理计算。
Result: 在不同模型规模、adapter rank 与训练配方下均改善数学推理，并将收益扩展到通用指令微调与代码生成；相比现有 LoRA 变体与 adapter 正则化方法表现更好，进一步分析显示早期 loop 的适应更强。仅随机丢弃 adapter 应用本身并不提升任务性能，因为它降低了训练期期望更新强度而推理不变。
Conclusion: 共享更新的 loop 间不平衡可以通过保持期望更新强度的随机丢弃来纠正，使 looped LM 在不增加参数与推理开销的前提下获得更强的早期 loop 适应与更好的下游表现。

papers.title: Same Winners, Different Success Rates: Evaluating How LLM Agents Recover from Failures
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating how LLM agents recover from mid-task failures is central to deploying reliable agentic systems. Existing checkpoint-based benchmarks measure recovery by comparing which action is selected as best across independent runs, a quantity known as set agreement. However, set agreement is a purely ordinal measure that records which action wins without reflecting the absolute level of performance. When all actions fail, they tie at zero reward, and independent runs produce the same tied set with high probability, creating an illusion of stability that masks near-zero recovery success. We formalize this limitation through a set-path symmetry result, proving that for equal-cost Bernoulli actions the success probabilities (0.9, 0.8) and (0.2, 0.1) yield identical best-action-set distributions at every sample size. No procedure based solely on which action wins can distinguish these two regimes. We further prove that certifying exact population ties is impossible in finite time, and that the assignment of outcomes to checkpoints carries information beyond marginal outcome distributions. The pooled success probability is the missing scalar that resolves the ordinal ambiguity. Experiments on 864 frozen RecoveryBench episodes and two planning cohorts totaling 3,456 responses confirm the theoretical predictions. Agreement and held-out quality can move in opposite directions, and permuting checkpoint-to-action bindings changes 8 to 13 percent of cell-level conclusions. Based on these findings, we propose reporting four diagnostic quantities (agreement, all-zero fraction, held-out success, and pooled success) that expose this failure mode with no additional data collection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有基于 checkpoint 的 LLM agent 恢复评测用 set agreement（跨独立运行选同一最优动作的比例）度量恢复，但它是纯序数指标：当所有动作都失败、奖励全为 0 时，各运行以高概率给出相同的并列集合，制造出稳定假象而掩盖恢复成功率接近零。论文证明 set-path symmetry：等成本 Bernoulli 动作下成功概率 (0.9, 0.8) 与 (0.2, 0.1) 在任意样本量上给出完全相同的最优动作集分布，仅凭谁赢无法区分这两种体制；并建议同时报告 agreement、all-zero fraction、held-out success、pooled success 四个诊断量。
Motivation: checkpoint 类基准用 set agreement 度量 agent 从任务中途失败中恢复的能力，但该序数指标在全员失败时把近零成功率伪装成高稳定性，导致评测结论失真。
Method: 形式化 set-path symmetry 结果，证明等成本 Bernoulli 动作下 (0.9, 0.8) 与 (0.2, 0.1) 两组成功概率在每个样本量上产生相同的最优动作集分布；另证有限时间内无法认证真实的总体并列，且 checkpoint 到动作的绑定携带超出边际结果分布的信息。实验用 864 个冻结的 RecoveryBench episodes 与两个 planning cohort 共 3,456 条响应检验理论预测。
Result: 在 864 个冻结 RecoveryBench episodes 与两个 planning cohort 共 3,456 条响应上，agreement 与 held-out quality 可以反向变动；置换 checkpoint 与动作的绑定会改变 8% 到 13% 的 cell-level 结论。理论上 (0.9, 0.8) 与 (0.2, 0.1) 的成功概率在任意样本量下产生相同的最优动作集分布，且真实总体并列无法在有限时间内被认证。
Conclusion: 仅看谁赢的序数指标无法区分高恢复与低恢复体制，pooled success probability 是补上这一歧义的标量；评测应同时报告 agreement、all-zero fraction、held-out success、pooled success 四项，无需额外数据采集。

papers.title: GlyphBench: A Playground for Language-Model Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GlyphBench, an environment suite for reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of language-model agents, with over 360 tasks spanning diverse games. GlyphBench renders spatial observations as two-dimensional Unicode grids and connects training, evaluation, and trajectory replay through a unified interface designed to support efficient and reproducible research. We use GlyphBench to study how observation interfaces, reasoning effort, and agent harnesses affect performance, and how RL configurations shape learning dynamics. Our results show that glyph observations outperform native text and pixels in our Craftax experiments, with further gains on several BALROG environments. RL on 100 GlyphBench tasks improves Qwen3.5-4B on held-out Reasoning Gym problems, reaching 63.48% accuracy and outperforming the base model, a math-trained baseline, and a code-trained baseline. These experiments provide empirical evidence that reasoning gains from gameplay can yield stronger transfer than math or code. Together, these results highlight GlyphBench's value as a testbed for systematic research on how language-model agents learn, interact, and generalize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlyphBench 是面向语言模型智能体 RL 后训练的环境套件，把空间观测渲染成二维 Unicode 网格（glyph 观测），在 Craftax 上超过原生文本与像素输入，并在 BALROG 多个环境上进一步提升。用其中 100 个任务做 RL 后训练可把 Qwen3.5-4B 在留出的 Reasoning Gym 问题上提到 63.48% 准确率，超过基座模型、数学训练基线与代码训练基线，说明游戏玩法带来的推理增益比数学或代码训练迁移更强。
Motivation: 语言模型智能体的 RL 后训练缺少统一、可复现的环境与观测接口研究平台，观测形式（文本/像素/网格）与 harness、推理强度如何影响学习动态和跨任务泛化没有系统证据。
Method: 发布 GlyphBench 环境套件：360 多个游戏任务，空间观测统一渲染为二维 Unicode 网格，训练、评估与轨迹回放走同一接口；用它做受控实验，比较观测接口、推理强度 (reasoning effort)、agent harness 与 RL 配置对学习动态的影响，并在 Craftax 与 BALROG 上做迁移测试。
Result: Craftax 实验中 glyph 观测优于原生文本与像素，BALROG 上若干环境还有额外提升；在 100 个 GlyphBench 任务上做 RL 后训练，Qwen3.5-4B 在留出的 Reasoning Gym 问题上达到 63.48% 准确率，高于基座模型、数学训练基线和代码训练基线。
Conclusion: 游戏玩法驱动的 RL 推理增益能比数学或代码训练产生更强的跨任务迁移，Unicode 网格是一种有效的观测接口，GlyphBench 可作为研究语言模型智能体学习与泛化的测试床。

papers.title: X-MoD: Practical Scaling Laws for Sparse-Depth Routing Beyond Mixture-of-Depths
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) enables conditional computation across Transformer depth by routing only a subset of tokens through selected layers, but its original one-sparse--one-dense alternation tightly couples total capacity to active capacity and limits sparse-depth scaling. We introduce X-MoD, a scalable sparse-depth architecture that decouples token sparsity from anchor stride, allowing total parameter count to grow while keeping active-equivalent capacity nearly fixed. To make deep sparse routing trainable, X-MoD combines dense anchors with variance-scaled layer-wise gating and depth-wise token balancing. To make this regime analyzable and usable, we formulate sparse-depth routing as a conditional architecture-design problem: given compute, context length, and active-equivalent backbone size, how should the routing configuration be chosen? We develop a practical scaling-law framework by fitting X-MoD relative to FLOP-matched dense baselines, yielding an interpretable law that decomposes performance into sparse-capacity gain, sparse-context correction, and anchor-stride interaction. The law predicts validation loss across routing configurations and reveals how context length, model scale, and anchor stride shape sparse-depth performance. We validate the architecture and law through pretraining sweeps, held-out scaling-law prediction, ablations, downstream evaluations, and comparisons with Dense, MoD, and representative MoE baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-MoD 解耦 token 稀疏度与 anchor stride，使总参数量可增长而 active-equivalent 容量近似固定，并把稀疏深度路由写成条件架构设计问题，拟合出可预测验证损失的实用 scaling law。
Motivation: Mixture-of-Depths 的一稀疏一稠密交替把总容量与活跃容量强耦合，限制了稀疏深度方向的扩展；给定算力、上下文长度与活跃骨干规模时，路由配置如何选也缺少可分析的框架。
Method: X-MoD 用 dense anchors 加 variance-scaled layer-wise gating 与 depth-wise token balancing 让深稀疏路由可训练；相对 FLOP-matched dense 基线拟合 scaling law，把性能分解为 sparse-capacity gain、sparse-context correction 与 anchor-stride interaction 三项。
Result: 该 law 可跨路由配置预测 validation loss，并刻画上下文长度、模型规模与 anchor stride 对稀疏深度性能的影响；通过 pretraining sweeps、held-out scaling-law 预测、消融、下游评测以及与 Dense、MoD 和代表性 MoE 基线的比较来验证架构与 law。
Conclusion: 把 token 稀疏度与 anchor stride 解耦后，稀疏深度模型可以在活跃容量近似不变的前提下扩展总参数量，且其性能可由一个可解释的 scaling law 预测。

papers.title: Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: In financial fraud detection, rich semantic context can provide important evidence for transaction behavior modeling and fraud reasoning. However, public real-world financial datasets often lack rich semantics due to privacy constraints. Consequently, synthetic datasets incorporate generated semantics, but at the cost of behavioral realism; textual descriptions for contextual reasoning remain scarce. We address this gap through a semantic enrichment framework grounded in original transaction behavior to simulate multimodal financial data. We (1) propose a multi-agent semantic enrichment framework that generates interpretable financial semantics grounded in transaction behavior through role-specialized agents and consistency refinement, and (2) newly contribute a valuable multimodal financial fraud dataset, MS-FFSD, enriched with structured semantics and textual semantics while preserving real-data-grounded transaction behavior. Furthermore, we systematically analyze the quality and utility of semantic enrichment. Results demonstrate statistical fidelity and framework generalizability, while showing that richer semantics benefit fraud modeling and context-aware LLM reasoning. Overall, this work advances multimodal financial fraud research and bridges emerging LLM and multi-agent capabilities with operational anti-fraud practice. The framework and dataset are released at https://github.com/AI4Risk/MS-FFSD.

papers.title: Functional Autoencoders for Amplitude-Phase Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Functional data are intrinsically infinite-dimensional, and often exhibit phase variation, where corresponding events occur at different times across observations. Existing linear dimension reduction methods struggle with nonlinear amplitude variation, while functional autoencoders without an explicit warp entangle temporal misalignment with shape. We propose the Amplitude--Phase Functional Autoencoders (AP-FAE), an unsupervised framework for functional data that spans both univariate and multivariate cases, with emphasis on the multivariate setting, and factorizes the latent space into separate amplitude and phase embeddings derived from all channels. A smooth functional decoder reconstructs channel-specific amplitude functions in canonical time, and a shared monotone, endpoint-preserving warp captures phase variation. We prove a bound linking amplitude recovery to registration, reconstruction, and noise errors, and validate it numerically. Across synthetic data and six real-world benchmarks, AP-FAE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on most clustering and alignment metrics and on all reconstruction metrics. Clustering with amplitude embeddings alone consistently surpasses joint amplitude--phase clustering, confirming the benefit of explicit disentanglement. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/APFAE-418C/}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/APFAE-418C/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督的幅度-相位函数自编码器 (AP-FAE)，把函数数据潜空间显式拆成幅度嵌入与共享的单调保端点时间扭曲 (warp)，并证明一个把幅度恢复误差与配准、重构、噪声误差联系起来的界且数值验证。在合成数据与六个真实基准上，AP-FAE 在多数聚类与配准指标、以及全部重构指标上超过现有基线；仅用幅度嵌入做聚类稳定优于幅度-相位联合聚类。
Motivation: 函数数据的相位变化使对应事件在不同观测中错时出现：线性降维难以处理非线性幅度变化，而没有显式 warp 的函数自编码器会把时间错位与形状纠缠在一起。
Method: AP-FAE 覆盖单变量与多变量函数数据（重点在多变量），把潜空间分解为由全部通道导出的幅度嵌入与相位嵌入；光滑函数解码器在规范时间上重建各通道幅度函数，共享的单调、保端点 warp 承担相位变化。作者证明一个把幅度恢复与配准误差、重构误差、噪声误差联系起来的界，并数值验证该界。
Result: 在合成数据与六个真实基准上，AP-FAE 在多数聚类与配准指标、以及全部重构指标上优于 SOTA 基线；仅用幅度嵌入的聚类一致地超过幅度-相位联合聚类。误差界的数值验证支持理论结论。
Conclusion: 显式把幅度与相位解耦（而非让编码器隐式吸收错位）能同时改善函数数据的重构与聚类，且幅度嵌入单独用于聚类已足够，联合相位反而有害。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models offer a promising way to improve Vision-Language-Action policies by capturing the consequences of actions. However, models trained primarily on expert demonstrations have limited exposure to failure outcomes and may struggle to distinguish visually similar successful and failed interactions. We propose \textbf{WorldGuide}, a framework that learns these distinctions in latent space and uses them to guide policy training. WorldGuide combines predictive pretraining on successful and failed trajectories with contrastive learning on matched success--failure pairs. The learned predictor then provides a differentiable reward to guide joint optimization of the policy and visual encoder. The predictor is discarded after training, so deployment requires no additional world-model inference. Extensive experiments show that WorldGuide substantially improves VLA reliability and achieves state of the art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv, reaching \textbf{96.8\%} and \textbf{72.0\%}, respectively. Code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldGuide 在潜空间里显式学习成功与失败交互的边界，用它给 VLA 策略提供可微奖励：先在成功/失败轨迹上做预测预训练，再对配对的成功-失败样本做对比学习，训练完丢弃预测器，部署时无需额外世界模型推理。在 LIBERO 100 与 SimplerEnv 上分别达到 96.8% 与 72.0% 的 state of the art 成绩。
Motivation: 只用专家示范训练的世界模型几乎见不到失败结果，难以区分视觉上相近的成功与失败交互，VLA 策略因此可靠性受限。
Method: 对成功与失败轨迹做预测预训练，并在配对的成功-失败样本上做对比学习，得到能区分两类结果的潜空间预测器；该预测器输出可微奖励，联合优化策略与视觉编码器，训练结束后丢弃预测器。
Result: 在 LIBERO 100 上达到 96.8%，在 SimplerEnv 上达到 72.0%，摘要称这两项为 state of the art；评估为 VLA 可靠性方向的广泛实验。
Conclusion: 在潜空间显式刻画成功-失败边界并转成可微奖励，能提升 VLA 策略可靠性，且部署成本不增加（预测器训练后即丢弃）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Optimize through Solver-Grounded Self-Play
papers.abstract_en: Optimization modeling is central to many decision-making scenarios, but traditionally requires extensive domain expertise. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating this process, current training paradigms mainly rely on human-annotated or teacher-generated datasets. This dependence introduces a Generalization Ceiling, where models overfit to narrow data distributions, and Capability Anchoring, where models' reasoning is bounded by annotator proficiency and teacher model capability. In response, we propose OPT-Zero, the first fully self-play training framework for optimization modeling that requires zero external training data. OPT-Zero employs a single LLM in a dual-role closed loop: a Proposer that synthesizes increasingly challenging optimization problems alongside their mathematical formulations and solving code, and a Solver that attempts to resolve the problems given only natural-language problem descriptions. Grounded in execution feedback from external optimization solvers, we alternately train both roles using reinforcement learning. This process fosters an auto-curriculum in which the Proposer and Solver co-evolve: generating harder valid problems by the Proposer seamlessly enhances the structural reasoning ability of the Solver. Extensive results indicate that with zero curated data, OPT-Zero matches state-of-the-art data-dependent methods while exhibiting substantially stronger generalizability, establishing self-play training as a highly scalable paradigm for advancing LLM reasoning in modeling and solving optimization problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPT-Zero 用单个 LLM 分饰 Proposer 与 Solver 两个角色做闭环自博弈，完全不依赖人工标注或教师模型数据来训练优化建模能力。Proposer 合成越来越难的优化题及其数学建模与求解代码，Solver 只看自然语言题面求解，双方由外部优化求解器的执行反馈交替做强化学习，形成自动课程共进化。在零人工数据条件下 OPT-Zero 追平依赖数据的最先进方法，且泛化性明显更强。
Motivation: LLM 自动做优化建模目前依赖人工标注或教师生成数据，导致 Generalization Ceiling（过拟合到狭窄数据分布）与 Capability Anchoring（推理能力被标注者和教师模型水平封顶）。
Method: 单 LLM 双角色闭环：Proposer 合成逐步变难的优化问题、数学公式与求解代码，Solver 仅凭自然语言描述作答；以外部优化求解器的执行反馈为奖励，对两个角色交替做强化学习，形成 Proposer 与 Solver 共进化的自动课程。
Result: 在零人工整理数据条件下，OPT-Zero 匹配依赖数据的最先进方法，并表现出显著更强的泛化性；摘要以定性方式陈述该结论，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 自博弈训练可以作为扩展 LLM 优化建模与求解推理能力的可扩展范式，摆脱对人工与教师数据的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frozen Judges, Moving Agents: Version-Dependent LLM-Judge Error and the Limits of Judge-Assisted Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Language-model judges compare agent upgrades with their predecessors, but a fixed judge can make version-dependent mistakes. We analyze 35 public coding-agent submissions (20 prespecified version pairs on 250 SWE-bench Verified issues), two customer-service agents (155 tau-bench tasks), and 1,106 expert-labeled AgentRewardBench trajectories. An upstream outage left three judges for the primary SWE-bench analysis (8,743 aligned agent-task cells); the fourth is descriptive. All three coding-agent judges and all four tau-bench judges reject task-conditioned error invariance after multiplicity adjustment. On SWE-bench, 32 of 60 judge-by-pair units have a detectable differential comparison component; eight judge-only intervals declare improvements that execution-based intervals cannot establish, despite rank correlations of 0.71-0.79. In tau-bench, one judge confidently reverses a nine-point reference-reward gap by penalizing a procedural habit the reward ignores. False acceptance of failed coding patches rises with agent capability conditional on task and reference outcome, while a task-solvability prediction from AgentRewardBench reverses sign in SWE-bench. Transporting old-version calibration raises mean absolute comparison error on SWE-bench from 3.8 to 19.5 percentage points; 24.6% of ratio-bootstrap draws are undefined near the correction boundary. A tuned paired audit narrows a classical interval by only about 5% at 80 labeled tasks. A randomized three-arm test does not support the predicted increase in false acceptance from showing the agent's final report (all three Holm-adjusted p-values = 1.0). These results favor explicit reference standards and paired audits of current outputs over judge-only release decisions or transported old-version calibration.
papers.comment: 40 pages; 5 figures; prospectively planned agent-evaluation study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定 LLM judge 评 agent 版本升级时会产生随版本变化的误差：在 SWE-bench Verified 250 题、tau-bench 155 题与 AgentRewardBench 1,106 条专家标注轨迹上，三个 coding judge 与四个 tau-bench judge 经多重性校正后全部拒绝任务条件误差不变性。把旧版本校准搬到新版本会把 SWE-bench 平均绝对比较误差从 3.8 抬到 19.5 个百分点，因此发布决策应改用显式参考标准与当期输出的配对审计。
Motivation: LLM judge 被用来比较 agent 升级与前代，但固定 judge 的误差可能随版本漂移，导致 judge-only 的发布结论与执行结果不一致，旧版本校准也无法迁移。
Method: 前瞻性规划的 agent 评估研究：分析 35 个公开 coding-agent 提交（250 个 SWE-bench Verified issue 上的 20 组预设版本对）、两个客服 agent 的 155 个 tau-bench 任务与 1,106 条专家标注 AgentRewardBench 轨迹；主分析因上游故障只剩三个 judge（8,743 个对齐的 agent-task 单元），第四个仅作描述；检验任务条件误差不变性、用 ratio-bootstrap 与配对审计区间，并做三臂随机化实验检验展示 agent 最终报告是否抬高 false acceptance。
Result: 三个 coding judge 与四个 tau-bench judge 经多重性校正后全部拒绝任务条件误差不变性；SWE-bench 上 60 个 judge-by-pair 单元中 32 个可检出 differential comparison 成分，八个 judge-only 区间宣称的改进无法被执行区间确立，尽管秩相关达 0.71–0.79；tau-bench 上一个 judge 因惩罚 reward 忽略的程序性习惯而自信地反转九分的 reference-reward 差距；失败 coding patch 的 false acceptance 随 agent 能力在任务与参考结果条件下上升，AgentRewardBench 的任务可解性预测在 SWE-bench 上符号反转；迁移旧版本校准使 SWE-bench 平均绝对比较误差从 3.8 升到 19.5 个百分点，24.6% 的 ratio-bootstrap 抽样在修正边界附近无定义；调优后的配对审计在 80 个标注任务上仅把经典区间收窄约 5%；三臂随机化实验不支持展示 agent 最终报告会提高 false acceptance（三个 Holm 校正 p 值均为 1.0）。
Conclusion: 作者主张发布决策应依赖显式参考标准与对当期输出的配对审计，而不是 judge-only 结论或迁移来的旧版本校准；展示 agent 最终报告会抬高 false acceptance 的预测未获随机化实验支持。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 三个 coding judge 与四个 tau-bench judge 经多重性校正后全部拒绝任务条件误差不变性；SWE-bench 上 60 个 judge-by-pair 单元中 32 个可检出 differential comparison 成分，八个 judge-only 区间宣称的改进无法被执行区间确立，尽管秩相关达 0.71–0.79；tau-bench 上一个 judge 因惩罚 reward 忽略的程序性习惯而自信地反转九分的 reference-reward 差距；失败 coding patch 的 false acceptance 随 agent 能力在任务与参考结果条件下上升，AgentRewardBench 的任务可解性预测在 SWE-bench 上符号反转；迁移旧版本校准使 SWE-bench 平均绝对比较误差从 3.8 升到 19.5 个百分点，24.6% 的 ratio-bootstrap 抽样在修正边界附近无定义；调优后的配对审计在 80 个标注任务上仅把经典区间收窄约 5%；三臂随机化实验不支持展示 agent 最终报告会提高 false acceptance（三个 Holm 校正 p 值均为 1.0）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张发布决策应依赖显式参考标准与对当期输出的配对审计，而不是 judge-only 结论或迁移来的旧版本校准；展示 agent 最终报告会抬高 false acceptance 的预测未获随机化实验支持。

papers.title: ConvCue: Complementary Visual Inductive Biases for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance across a broad range of multimodal tasks, yet still struggle with visual questions that require fine-grained discrimination and spatial understanding. These limitations motivate investigating whether supplementary visual representations can improve existing VLMs without replacing their native visual encoders. Pretrained convolutional networks offer a candidate feature source, motivated by their local connectivity and spatial weight sharing. We introduce CONVCUE, which augments the native visual representations of a pretrained VLM with final-stage features from a parallel, frozen pretrained CNN. A learnable adapter maps convolutional features to the native visual feature dimension, while gated cross-attention allows the original visual tokens to retrieve information from the CNN features. The enhanced tokens are passed through the original visual-to-language projector, and the model is adapted through a two-stage training procedure. We evaluate CONVCUE on Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B across 13 multimodal benchmarks covering visual question answering, document and chart understanding, and multimodal reasoning. CONVCUE improves average benchmark performance over both the original models and matched two-stage fine-tuning controls on all three backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it improves over the original model on all 13 benchmarks and raises the average score from 75.00 to 78.82 relative to the matched fine-tuning control. These results show that pretrained convolutional representations, when integrated through learned adaptation and fusion, can improve the visual understanding of existing VLMs without replacing their original visual encoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CONVCUE 在不替换原生视觉编码器的前提下，把并行冻结 CNN 的末段特征经可学习 adapter 映射到原生维度，再用 gated cross-attention 让原生视觉 token 从中检索信息，经原 projector 与两阶段训练接入 VLM。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上相对匹配的两阶段微调对照，13 个多模态基准平均分从 75.00 升到 78.82，且对原模型在全部 13 个基准上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在需要细粒度判别与空间理解的视觉问题上仍然吃力，而直接替换原生视觉编码器代价高，因此需要一种只做补充、不替换原编码器的增强路径。
Method: 并行挂载一个冻结的预训练 CNN，取其末段特征；可学习 adapter 把卷积特征映射到原生视觉特征维度，gated cross-attention 让原生视觉 token 从 CNN 特征中取信息，增强后的 token 再送入原有的 visual-to-language projector，最后按两阶段训练流程适配模型。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-2B、Qwen3-VL-4B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B 三个骨干上，覆盖 VQA、文档与图表理解、多模态推理共 13 个基准，CONVCUE 的平均分均高于原模型和匹配的两阶段微调对照；在 Qwen3-VL-4B 上对原模型在全部 13 个基准上提升，平均分相对匹配微调对照从 75.00 升至 78.82。
Conclusion: 预训练卷积表征只要通过学习到的适配与融合接入，就能在不替换原视觉编码器的情况下提升现有 VLM 的视觉理解。

papers.title: PainterBench: A Figural Divergent-Thinking Benchmark for Tool-Using Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Figural divergent thinking is the ability to develop a given shape fragment into an original drawing. In humans, this ability is assessed with incomplete-drawing tasks. We introduce PainterBench, a benchmark that ports the incomplete-drawing task to the agentic setting. The agent draws on a canvas through tool calls and observes the result after every turn. The canvas includes a starting shape which cannot be erased, and the agent's goal is to incorporate this shape into the most original drawing it can produce. The task is open-ended, and the agent itself decides when the drawing is finished. The benchmark tests incremental visual planning over a short horizon and the transfer of creative ability from pretraining to multi-turn tool use. We evaluate 14 multimodal language models from small to frontier scale. Across the primary study and six sensitivity analyses, we collect 2,700 drawings and crowdsource creativity and recognizability ratings for every drawing and for 300 human reference drawings. We also present ViDrA-adapted, an automated scorer that predicts human creativity ratings of agent drawings (r = 0.85 on random held-out test split). Figural divergent thinking varies widely across the 14 models, and GPT-6 Astra produces the most creative drawings. Relative to the human drawings, the agent drawings score higher in creativity but lower in recognizability. We release the final drawings, per-round canvas snapshots, tool call traces, stimulus bank, benchmark harness, crowdsourced ratings (N = 72,000), and ViDrA checkpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PainterBench 把不完整图形补画任务搬到多轮工具调用的 agentic 画布上，评测 14 个多模态模型的图形发散思维。共收集 2,700 幅模型画作与 300 幅人类参照画的众包评分（N=72,000），ViDrA-adapted 自动打分器与人类创意评分相关 r=0.85；模型间差异极大，GPT-6 Astra 最具创意，且相对人类画作创意更高、可识别性更低。
Motivation: 发散思维在人类心理学中有成熟的不完整图形补画测验，但缺少能把同一任务搬到多轮工具使用场景、并可对开放式创意产出做可靠评分的 agent 基准。
Method: 在画布上放置不可擦除的起始形状，agent 通过工具调用逐轮作画并观察结果，自行决定何时完成；评测 14 个从小型到前沿规模的多模态模型，主研究加六项敏感性分析，对每幅画及 300 幅人类参照画做众包创意与可识别性评分，并提出 ViDrA-adapted 自动打分器回归人类创意评分。
Result: 共 2,700 幅画作、众包评分 N=72,000；ViDrA-adapted 在随机留出测试集上与人类创意评分相关 r=0.85；14 个模型的图形发散思维差异显著，GPT-6 Astra 创意最高；相对人类画作，agent 画作创意评分更高而可识别性更低。
Conclusion: 多轮工具使用能部分迁移预训练中的创意能力，但产出偏向创意而牺牲可识别性；发布物含画作、逐轮画布快照、工具调用轨迹、刺激库、评测 harness、评分与 ViDrA checkpoint。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cardinality-Stratified Interaction Decomposition for Interpretable Pairwise and Higher-Order Structure in Transactional Basket Data
papers.abstract_en: Transactional basket data can reveal associations among items, but observed co-occurrence conflates item-specific relations with basket-size structure and unmodeled higher-order dependence. We introduce Cardinality-Stratified Interaction Decomposition (CSID), an interpretable framework that decomposes log-odds contrasts stratified by the number of remaining items into item-set-specific and cardinality-common components, without fitting a global joint distribution. CSID uses an information-weighted, gauge-constrained ridge projection to estimate pair and triple components and to diagnose higher-order contributions to pairwise structure. CSID is designed primarily for interpretable decomposition of association structure rather than for full-distribution prediction. In a simulation with zero pair effects, increasingly strong small-basket cardinality potentials drive ordinary Ising couplings spuriously negative, whereas CSID pair estimates remain centered near zero. Detection power rises with the magnitude of planted triple effects, and local deprojection reduces pair-coefficient RMSE from 0.244 to 0.073. Across three grocery datasets, high-information triple components are reproducible over time. In the matched cross-period partial-transfer evaluation, transferred CSID triple components show closer agreement with later-period stratified contrasts than the nodewise-symmetrized cardinality-aware higher-order pseudolikelihood comparator, with gains in weighted Lin's concordance correlation of 0.038--0.122. These results support CSID as an exploratory and interpretable decomposition framework for pairwise and higher-order association structure in transactional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CSID（Cardinality-Stratified Interaction Decomposition）：把按篮子剩余物品数分层的 log-odds 对比拆成 item-set 特异分量与 cardinality 公共分量，无需拟合全局联合分布。模拟中零 pair 效应时小篮子 cardinality 势会把普通 Ising 耦合推成虚假负值，而 CSID pair 估计仍居中于零；local deprojection 把 pair 系数 RMSE 从 0.244 降到 0.073。
Motivation: 交易篮数据的共现混杂了物品自身关系、篮子大小结构与未建模的高阶依赖，普通 Ising/伪似然耦合因此会被 cardinality 结构带偏，难以解释。
Method: CSID 用信息加权、规范约束 (gauge-constrained) 的 ridge 投影估计 pair 与 triple 分量，并诊断高阶对 pairwise 结构的贡献；定位是可解释分解而非全分布预测。评估含植入 pair/triple 效应的模拟、三个 grocery 数据集的跨期可重复性，以及 matched cross-period partial-transfer 对比 nodewise-symmetrized cardinality-aware higher-order pseudolikelihood。
Result: 零 pair 效应模拟中，小篮子 cardinality 势越强，普通 Ising 耦合越虚假为负，CSID pair 估计仍居中于零；triple 效应越大检测力越高，local deprojection 使 pair 系数 RMSE 从 0.244 降到 0.073。三个 grocery 数据集上高信息 triple 分量跨期可复现；跨期迁移的 CSID triple 分量与后期分层对比的加权 Lin 一致性相关 (Lin's CCC) 比对照伪似然方法高 0.038–0.122。
Conclusion: CSID 可作为交易数据中 pairwise 与高阶关联结构的探索性、可解释分解框架，能把 cardinality 造成的伪耦合与真实 item-set 特异效应分开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MotionSpaceFlow: Representation-Aware Flow Matching in Direct Motion Space
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion and flow models have substantially improved text-driven human motion generation. Yet most methods generate in low-dimensional, temporally downsampled latent spaces learned primarily for reconstruction, a bottleneck that can limit generation quality and preclude direct manipulation of individual frames and joints. We introduce MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow), a representation-aware flow-matching framework that predicts clean motion directly in continuous motion space without a learned encoder or decoder. To account for the anisotropic structure of direct motion representations, we propose representation-aware noise scaling and show how the initial Gaussian source scale governs the covariance of intermediate probability-path marginals. We further introduce a Representation-Aware Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (RA-MMDiT), which jointly updates token-level language and full-resolution motion features through joint attention while adapting temporal information flow to the motion representation: causal attention for incremental features defined by frame-to-frame changes, and bidirectional attention for global features such as absolute joint coordinates. Across different datasets and motion representations, MSFlow achieves state-of-the-art text-to-motion performance. Its global representation variant additionally enables zero-shot, inference-time control over any joint or frame through projection sampling without control-conditioned training, delivering leading motion quality with exact constraint satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotionSpaceFlow (MSFlow) 把文本驱动人体动作生成从降采样 latent 空间搬回连续全分辨率动作空间，直接预测干净动作、不带学习式编解码器。用表示感知噪声缩放控制各向异性动作表示下的概率路径协方差，RA-MMDiT 对增量特征用因果注意力、对绝对关节坐标用双向注意力，在多个数据集与动作表示上达到 SOTA 文本到动作性能，并支持零样本、推理时对任意关节或帧的投影采样控制且精确满足约束。
Motivation: 现有扩散/流模型多在为重建而学的低维、时间降采样 latent 空间生成，既限制生成质量，也无法直接操作单帧与单关节。
Method: MSFlow 为表示感知的 flow matching 框架：无学习编解码器，直接在连续动作空间预测干净动作；提出表示感知噪声缩放，说明初始高斯源尺度如何决定中间概率路径边缘的协方差；核心网络为 RA-MMDiT，通过 joint attention 联合更新 token 级语言与全分辨率动作特征，对帧间变化定义的增量特征用因果注意力、对绝对关节坐标等全局特征用双向注意力。
Result: 在不同数据集与动作表示上达到 SOTA 文本到动作性能；其全局表示变体通过 projection sampling 实现对任意关节或帧的零样本、推理时控制，无需控制条件训练，并给出领先的动作质量与精确约束满足。
Conclusion: 直接在全分辨率动作空间做表示感知生成，配合按特征类型分配的注意力模式，可同时拿到 SOTA 文本到动作质量与免训练的逐关节/逐帧推理时控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AlphaPareto: Formulaic Alpha Discovery with LLM-Guided Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Formulaic alpha discovery is a core challenge in quantitative trading, as identifying alphas that work well together remains difficult. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) methods formulate this task as a Markov decision process (MDP), but two important issues remain unresolved. First, as the alpha pool evolves, the reward function changes accordingly, making the MDP inherently non-stationary. Second, most existing methods optimize a single objective, typically predictive power, while ignoring other important properties of a high-quality alpha pool. Motivated by these challenges, we propose AlphaPareto, an RL method for formulaic alpha discovery. To address non-stationarity, AlphaPareto augments the state to include both the alpha under construction and the current alpha pool, and applies a large language model (LLM) to encode the pool. This design allows the agent to adapt to the evolving search environment. To overcome the limitation of single-objective reward design, AlphaPareto replaces the scalar reward with a multi-objective vector-valued reward that simultaneously captures predictive power, temporal stability, perturbation robustness, and diversity, and optimizes these objectives through a Pareto-regularized learning procedure. Empirical applications to real-world datasets show that our AlphaPareto method outperforms its competitors.

Motivation: alpha 池随搜索演化使奖励函数随之变化，MDP 固有非平稳；且现有 RL 方法多只优化预测力单一目标，忽略高质量 alpha 池的其他性质。

papers.title: LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks
papers.abstract_en: The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用虚构语言 (conlang-like) 任务检验 LLM 的强版「随机鹦鹉」假说：只给自然语言描述的虚构语言规则、不给任何示例输出，且这些规则刻意颠覆训练数据中的高频模式。模型在三类任务上系统性地朝语义预测方向移动，有时给出与复杂翻译答案键完全一致的输出，说明其行为受 prompt 中的约束表征驱动而非表面统计模式。
Motivation: 强版随机鹦鹉论主张 LLM 只能做统计模式匹配、无法超越模式复用进入抽象或推理；需要在表面统计模式与正确答案方向相反的条件下检验这一主张。
Method: 构造三类互补的 conlang-like 任务，向多个 LLM 提供颠覆训练数据高频与未见特征组合的虚构语言的纯自然语言描述，不提供任何示例输出；若模型表现出规则遵循行为，则只能归因于对 prompt 所述约束的表征。
Result: 在三类任务族上模型系统性朝语义预测方向移动：区分 prompt 暴露与指令使用、随新约束改变语义关系、有时与复杂翻译答案键完全一致；不同模型表现有差异，生成仍受表面合理性 (superficial plausibility) 强约束。
Conclusion: 结果为意义中介的抽象 (meaning-mediated abstraction) 提供证据并反驳强版随机鹦鹉假说，但前提是适当的架构与上下文约束，且生成仍强烈受表面合理性限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EntroPack: Fast and Accurate Entropy-Coded Weight Compression at Arbitrary Bitrates
papers.abstract_en: Weight compression helps large neural networks fit deployment memory budgets, but common fixed-width formats offer only coarse storage choices. Entropy coding supports finer rates, yet the achieved size depends on the quantized weight distribution and coding overhead. Exploiting this flexibility requires accurate rate selection and efficient weight reconstruction for inference. We present EntroPack, an entropy-coded weight compressor that supports arbitrary target bitrates without activation calibration or fine-tuning. It combines row-normalized $E_8$ lattice quantization with a conditional probability model of lattice coordinates. Sampled storage estimates select the quantization resolution without repeated full-stream encoding. The final coordinates are entropy-coded in independently decodable tiles, enabling fast, fused symbol decoding and numerical weight reconstruction on the GPU. EntroPack supports floating-point and integer weight containers, such as BF16, FP16, FP8, and INT8, with storage bitrate controlled independently of numerical precision. Online decoding adds latency that grows with weight count, making the method well suited to compute-intensive workloads such as diffusion denoising and Transformer prefill. Experiments demonstrate fast encoding and modest inference overhead in these settings. When compressing the linear-layer weights of the image generator Z-Image-Turbo, EntroPack achieves substantially lower weight and denoiser output errors than fixed-width formats at comparable storage rates, with modest denoising-step overhead. Targeting 4 bits per parameter, it achieves lower weight and denoiser output errors than NF4, including about 24% lower relative $L_2$ weight error, with less storage. Source code is available at https://github.com/modelscope/entropack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EntroPack 是熵编码权重压缩器，用行归一化 E8 格量化加格坐标条件概率模型，在任意目标比特率下选量化分辨率，并把坐标按可独立解码的 tile 做熵编码以支持 GPU 上的融合符号解码与权重重构，全程无需激活值校准或微调。压缩 Z-Image-Turbo 线性层权重时，在 4 bits/parameter 下相对 NF4 的相对 L2 权重误差低约 24% 且存储更小。
Motivation: 固定宽度数值格式（BF16/FP16/FP8/INT8）只能给粗粒度的存储档位，而熵编码的细粒度码率又依赖量化后权重分布与编码开销，难以在不校准、不微调的前提下精确选码率并快速重建权重供推理使用。
Method: 行归一化 E8 lattice 量化 + 格坐标条件概率模型；用采样得到的存储估计选择量化分辨率，避免反复完整流编码；最终坐标按可独立解码的 tile 熵编码，支持 GPU 上融合符号解码与数值权重重构；可承载 BF16、FP16、FP8、INT8 容器，存储码率与数值精度独立控制。
Result: 压缩图像生成器 Z-Image-Turbo 的线性层权重时，在可比存储码率下权重误差与 denoiser 输出误差均显著低于固定宽度格式，且去噪步开销适中；目标 4 bits/parameter 时相对 NF4 的相对 L2 权重误差低约 24%，存储更小；在线解码延迟随权重数量增长，适合扩散去噪与 Transformer prefill 这类算力密集负载，实验显示编码快速、推理开销适中。
Conclusion: 在不需激活值校准或微调的条件下，熵编码可以把存储码率与数值精度解耦，并在可比存储下取得比 NF4 等固定宽度格式更低的权重与输出误差；代价是随权重规模增长的在线解码延迟，因此更适合算力密集型负载。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CASS: Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity for Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging integrates task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model, but often suffers from parameter interference caused by conflicting task-vector updates. Existing methods typically mitigate conflicts by pruning task vectors based on weight magnitude or random heuristics, treating Transformers as unstructured ``bags of parameters'' and overlooking their inherent modularity. In this paper, we propose \textbf{C}ontribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{S}parsity (CASS), a unified framework that reduces parameter interference by identifying and preserving task-specific components. At the core of CASS is a contribution-aware structured mask that identifies task-relevant attention heads and FFN neurons. We instantiate this mask in two settings: CASS-Merging, the primary post-hoc setting where masks serve as a plug-and-play denoising filter for existing merging operators, and CASS-Tuning, an extension for scenarios with fine-tuning access where masks constrain gradients to reduce structural overlap between task vectors. Our analysis shows that task-relevant components are sparse and partially disjoint, supporting structured component-level filtering as an effective way to reduce merging interference. Extensive experiments across vision (ViT, 20 tasks) and language (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) benchmarks demonstrate that CASS improves a range of representative merging baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASS 用贡献感知的结构化掩码识别任务相关的 attention head 与 FFN 神经元，把结构化过滤作为即插即用的去噪滤镜插入现有模型合并算子，从而减少冲突 task vector 带来的参数干扰。在 ViT 20 任务、RoBERTa 8 任务、Qwen2.5 4 任务基准上，CASS 改进了一系列代表性合并基线。
Motivation: 模型合并中不同任务的 task vector 更新互相冲突造成参数干扰；现有方法按权重幅值或随机启发式剪枝，把 Transformer 当作无结构的参数袋，忽略了其固有模块性。
Method: CASS 提出贡献感知结构化掩码 (contribution-aware structured mask)，定位任务相关的 attention head 与 FFN 神经元，分两种设置实例化：CASS-Merging 作为后处理阶段的即插即用去噪滤镜叠加到现有合并算子上；CASS-Tuning 在可微调场景下用掩码约束梯度，降低 task vector 之间的结构重叠。
Result: 在视觉 (ViT, 20 tasks) 与语言 (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) 基准上的大量实验表明 CASS 改进了一系列代表性合并基线；分析显示任务相关组件是稀疏且部分不相交的。
Conclusion: 任务相关组件稀疏且部分不相交，因此在组件级做结构化过滤是降低合并干扰的有效途径，且可作为通用后处理滤镜复用到不同合并算子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CRF Loss is How Networks Should Learn Boundaries in Weakly Supervised Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) learns pixel-level predictions from image-level tags. Recent work focuses on improving coarse CAMs extracted from large vision-language models (commonly CLIP), but does little to improve their accuracy along segment boundaries. That job is instead delegated to a post-processing method like DenseCRF. However, because DenseCRF relies on low-level colour cues, it can flip correct labels to incorrect ones when neighbouring pixels share similar colours. SAM has recently been adopted as a natural alternative, yet it simply takes on DenseCRF's role as an intermediate "refinement" step that outputs one-hot pseudo-labels in prior work. By discarding the valuable uncertainty in CAMs, these one-hot pseudo-labels turn borderline errors into confidently wrong targets. Our key insight is that CAMs should supervise training alongside SAM boundaries, each through its own loss, rather than being fused together into a single hard target. Inspired by CRF potentials, we propose a framework that disentangles soft pseudo-labels as unary supervision and binary edge maps as pairwise supervision. We realize our framework in a single-stage model, DS-CRF, using CAMs from dino.txt and boundaries from SAM. DS-CRF sets a new state-of-the-art of 56.5% mIoU on MS COCO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 弱监督语义分割中，CAM 的不确定性不应被 SAM 压成 one-hot 伪标签，而应拆成一元软监督与成对边界监督分别用各自的 loss 训练。受 CRF potentials 启发的单阶段模型 DS-CRF 用 dino.txt 的 CAM 与 SAM 边界，在 MS COCO 上取得 56.5% mIoU 的新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 WSSS 只改进 CLIP 等大视觉语言模型产出的粗 CAM，边界精度却交给 DenseCRF 之类后处理；DenseCRF 依赖低层颜色，邻近像素同色时会把正确标签翻成错误，而 SAM 作为中间 refinement 输出 one-hot 伪标签，丢掉 CAM 的不确定性，把边界上的临界错误变成高置信错误目标。
Method: 受 CRF potentials 启发，把软伪标签解耦为 unary 监督、二值边缘图解耦为 pairwise 监督，各自用独立 loss；实现为单阶段模型 DS-CRF，CAM 取自 dino.txt，边界取自 SAM，二者不再融合成单一硬目标。
Result: DS-CRF 在 MS COCO 上达到 56.5% mIoU，为该设定下的新 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: CAM 与 SAM 边界应各自通过独立 loss 监督训练而非融合成硬伪标签，这是弱监督分割中学边界的方式。
