papers.title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback.However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. papers.title: Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大推理模型 (LRM) 的过度思考，提出训练无关的潜空间约束优化：把偏离高效推理聚类区域的隐状态用二次规划 (quadratic program) 投回该区域，从而在不牺牲性能的前提下削减 token。在 1.5B–14B 共四个模型、数学/代码/科学 QA 六个基准上，准确率最高提升 12.1%，生成 token 减少 11.8% 至 52.8%。
Motivation: LRM 推理时产生冗余步骤、token 开销大；而压制反思关键词或强制缩短长度这类现有方法会截断必要步骤，引发 underthinking 并损害性能。
Method: 先观察到高效推理步骤在潜空间中聚成集中区域、偏离该区域的隐状态对应冗余长序列；训练时无关的框架用一个二次规划把偏离的隐状态投影回该区域，使推理保持聚焦。
Result: 在四个模型（1.5B 到 14B）与六个覆盖数学推理、代码、科学 QA 的基准上验证：准确率最高提升 12.1%，同时生成 token 减少 11.8% 到 52.8%。
Conclusion: 过度思考与 underthinking 的取舍可以在潜空间用约束优化解决：把隐状态限制在高效推理区域内，就能同时降 token 与保性能，且无需重新训练。

papers.title: Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen
papers.abstract_en: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在视频异常检测中固定视频转写的文本证据，只换决策读出方式：Jev 的 typed decision（Noul）在 XD-Violence 的 caption 条件下平均精度 75.99%，高于 Qwen 生成概率 48.47% 与更强的本地 ordinal-likelihood expectation 57.81%，配对差 18.18 个百分点（95% source-group bootstrap 5.53–31.50）。但 UCF-Crime 上优势消失，Noul caption ROC-AUC 仅 52.26% 对 ordinal likelihood 65.95%，且两种概率读出的 UCF Brier 都差于 prevalence 参考 0.0475。结论是读出方式的收益依赖数据集，作者明确称其为探索性离线结果，不构成因果的 typed-interface 优势。
Motivation: 视频异常检测里文本证据（摘要与有序 caption）已被固定，但决策读出（decision readout）如何影响排序与概率质量尚不清楚；且接口在严格数值策略下会失败，需要区分响应结构与数值一致性。
Method: 在 UCF-Crime 与 XD-Violence 的稀疏开发样本（40 视频、400 个 target anchor，每数据集 20 个 source group、200 anchor，正例仅 10 与 37）上，固定视频衍生文本证据，对比 Jev typed decisions（含 Noul、Choice）与三种 Qwen readout（generated probability、ordinal-likelihood expectation 等），输入为 summary 与 ordered captions；原五后端试点请求 4000 次预测，另审计完全匹配 anchor 上的历史 LAVAD 分数，并做 source-group bootstrap。
Result: XD captions 上 Jev Noul 平均精度 75.99%，Qwen generated probability 48.47%，ordinal-likelihood expectation 57.81%，后者配对差 18.18 个百分点（95% source-group bootstrap 5.53–31.50）。UCF 上无对应优势：caption ROC-AUC Noul 52.26% 对 ordinal likelihood 65.95%；两种概率读出的 UCF Brier 均高于（即差于）evaluation-prevalence 参考 0.0475。Jev Choice 在严格数值策略下 800 次请求仅返回 776 个有效响应，阻断其全覆盖质量对比；缺失 binary-likelihood control。
Conclusion: 读出方式的收益随数据集而变：XD captions 上 typed decision 显著抬高平均精度，UCF 上反而落后且概率校准差于 prevalence 基准。作者主张这些探索性离线结果只刻画排序、概率质量与接口失败，既不证明因果的 typed-interface 收益，也不支持普遍优越性、校准性或端到端加速。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: RAGWarrant: Evidence-Preserving Governance for RAG Policy Promotion Under Quality, Cost, Latency, and Risk Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation systems are extensively instrumented with metrics, benchmarks, traces, and automated judges, but these tools do not decide whether a proposed policy change is safe to release. We present RAGWarrant, an open-source promotion-control framework that treats deployment as a constrained evidence decision rather than a leaderboard choice. RAGWarrant normalizes evaluator outputs and operational telemetry, applies predeclared quality and hard-risk gates, assigns evidence-class claim ceilings, preserves negative outcomes, and emits auditable PROMOTE, BLOCK, REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE decisions. We evaluate the framework across T2-RAGBench, MultiHop-RAG, CRAG, HotpotQA, synthetic reproduction, and bounded local generative experiments. On HotpotQA, operational savings were blocked because answer quality fell beyond the declared margin. A bounded CRAG study selected a lower-cost quality-tied policy, but related generative gains were unstable and a held-out guardrail failed closed. We claim an auditable promotion-control abstraction, not optimizer superiority, human validation, or production readiness. The tagged artifact reproduces from a fresh clone, runs as a hardened Docker job, accepts external evaluator exports, and verifies artifact integrity.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Preprint v0.1.1-rc1. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/RAGWarrant/ragwarrant-governance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAGWarrant 把 RAG 策略变更的上线决策做成受约束的证据判定：预声明质量与硬风险门限、按证据等级设定论断上限、保留负面结果，输出可审计的 PROMOTE/BLOCK/REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE。在 HotpotQA 上因答案质量跌破声明裕度而拦截了成本节省；CRAG 上选定成本更低且质量持平的策略，但相关生成增益不稳定、留出护栏 fail-closed。
Motivation: RAG 系统有大量指标、基准、trace 和自动评委，但这些工具无法回答一个策略变更是否安全发布，缺少把质量、成本、延迟与风险约束一起判定的发布控制机制。
Method: 开源 promotion-control 框架：归一化评估器输出与运行遥测，施加预声明的质量门与硬风险门，按证据类别 (evidence-class) 设定论断上限，保留负面结果，产出四类可审计决策；在 T2-RAGBench、MultiHop-RAG、CRAG、HotpotQA、合成复现与有界本地生成实验上运行。
Result: HotpotQA 上因答案质量下降超出声明裕度，运营成本节省被 BLOCK；有界 CRAG 研究选出成本更低且质量持平的策略，但相关生成增益不稳定，留出 (held-out) 护栏 fail-closed。
Conclusion: 作者主张的是可审计的发布控制抽象，明确不主张优化器优越性、人工验证或生产就绪；工件可从全新 clone 复现、以加固 Docker 作业运行并校验完整性。

papers.title: Enhanced Video Text Editing with Trajectory-Aligned Glyph Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Video text editing aims to replace or add text in a video while keeping the rest of the video unchanged, which requires the edited text to be correct in every frame and to move coherently with the scene. Despite the remarkable progress of video diffusion models, they struggle to reproduce exact stroke structures and often produce garbled or wrong characters, especially for characters with complex strokes. To address this, we propose a trajectory-aligned glyph rendering reference that provides explicit per-frame glyph guidance following the position and perspective of the text, and a depth-normalized recognizer feature supervision that supervises the generated text on multi-depth features of a frozen text recognizer with per-depth normalized errors, targeting stroke errors overlooked by the diffusion loss. We further build VTEdit, a benchmark of 288 real-scene clips with 440 annotated text trajectories covering text replacement and text addition, which will be publicly released to facilitate future research. Experiments on VTEdit show that our method outperforms image text editing methods, video editing methods, and commercial models in text accuracy and background preservation, achieving a sentence accuracy of 0.9408, and receives the highest preference in a user study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VTEdit 用轨迹对齐的字形渲染参考 (trajectory-aligned glyph rendering) 与深度归一化的识别器特征监督，让视频扩散模型逐帧生成结构正确的文字。在自建的 288 段真实场景片段基准上，句子准确率 (sentence accuracy) 达 0.9408，文本准确率与背景保持均胜过图像文本编辑、视频编辑方法和商业模型，用户研究偏好最高。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型难以复现精确笔画结构，常生成乱码或错字，复杂笔画字符尤其严重；现有视频文本编辑缺少覆盖文字替换与文字添加的真实场景评测基准。
Method: 提出轨迹对齐的字形渲染参考，按文字的位置与透视提供逐帧显式字形引导；再用深度归一化的识别器特征监督，在冻结文本识别器的多层特征上施加逐深度归一化的误差，针对扩散损失忽略的笔画错误；并构建 VTEdit 基准，含 288 段真实场景片段与 440 条标注文字轨迹，覆盖文字替换与文字添加，将公开发布。
Result: 在 VTEdit 上句子准确率 0.9408，文本准确率与背景保持优于图像文本编辑方法、视频编辑方法与商业模型，并在用户研究中获得最高偏好。
Conclusion: 显式逐帧字形轨迹引导加识别器多深度监督能解决视频文字编辑的笔画级错误，VTEdit 作为该任务的公开评测基准可用。

papers.title: ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReplayLens 是针对复用日志经验的 agent 的黑盒审计：每次只改动存储历史中的一种关系（分数归属、记录位置、动作命名、或分数与位置同时改动），其余接口保持不变，测量决策如何变化。结果显示改分数会改变决策而整体搬移动作-分数对不会，说明决策依赖的是分数归属而非记录顺序；在序贯实验规划中改动历史分数会把探索带偏并降低最终效用。
Motivation: agent 复用日志经验时，决策变化可能来自记录的分数、动作名称或记录在存储中的位置，而标准记忆评测无法区分是哪种关系在驱动变化；两个端点准确率相同的记忆写入器对同一回放的反应可能完全不同。
Method: ReplayLens 采用黑盒干预式审计，一次只改一种关系并固定其余接口：outcome reassignment 交换分数与动作的对应，pair transport 整体搬移动作-分数对到新记录槽位，consistent renaming 同时改历史与菜单中的动作名，key-slot reassignment 同时改分数归属与位置；在黑盒 LLM 接口、有界记忆、序贯实验规划和带密封隐藏测试的代码调试 agent 上施加这些干预。
Result: 在黑盒 LLM 接口上，交换分数改变决策而整体搬移动作-分数对不改变，从而把分数归属与记录顺序分离开；有界记忆研究暴露了端点对比看不到的摄取顺序敏感性；在序贯实验规划中改动历史分数会重定向探索并降低最终效用，尽管有新测量；带密封隐藏测试的代码调试 agent 呈现同一模式。
Conclusion: 日志经验能否安全合并、重排或重建索引，取决于决策依赖的是分数归属还是记录位置，这需要关系级审计而非端点准确率来判定。

papers.title: AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AGILE-GS 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的 next-best-view 选择拆成「找信息」与「选相机」两步：在 SE(3) 上用 Riemannian 梯度上升优化一个虚拟 anchor 位姿标记模型最不确定处，再用 anchor 视角几何打分并以 greedy ridge-leverage 把候选池蒸馏成无渲染的短名单。AGILE-GS 直接取短名单首项、完全不算 Fisher 信息，AGILE-GS+ 只对短名单算 Fisher 信息增益；在标准基准与闭环具身采集中两者持平或超过现有基线，选择延迟降低一到两个数量级。
Motivation: 3DGS 需要上百个视角且摆放位置与数量同样关键，而常规 NBV 要对候选池逐个打分再取一个，信息搜索与相机选择耦合导致选择开销高。
Method: 在 SE(3) 上对期望信息增益做 Riemannian 梯度上升优化虚拟 anchor 位姿（可不可达、不必在候选池中）；候选按 anchor 的 viewing geometry 打分，greedy ridge-leverage 步在不渲染任何候选的前提下把池蒸馏成小而无冗余的短名单。AGILE-GS 取短名单第一个视角且不为任何候选计算 Fisher 信息，AGILE-GS+ 仅对短名单逐个算 Fisher 信息增益再选最优。
Result: 在标准基准与闭环具身采集 (closed-loop embodied acquisition) 两种设置下，AGILE-GS 与 AGILE-GS+ 均持平或超过现有基线，同时把 NBV 选择延迟降低一到两个数量级。
Conclusion: 信息搜索与相机选择可以解耦：先用 anchor 定位不确定区域、再用无渲染的 leverage 短名单缩小评估范围，就能在保持重建质量的同时把 NBV 选择开销降一到两个数量级。

papers.title: GradLev: Token-Parallel Test-Time Training Via Costate Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Test-time training (TTT) allows a model to improve its predictions at inference time by updating weights after every observed token. However, sequential gra- dient writes make parallel training difficult. We observe that, given layer inputs and activation gradients (costates), online gradient descent admits exact parallel scans for both forward evaluation and reverse backpropagation. GradLev lever- ages this duality: a causal auxiliary network predicts costates across all tokens in parallel; associative scans compute the adapted weights and forward activations and propagate gradients backward; and the resulting gradient targets supervise the predictor via a consistency loss. Exact consistency guarantees exact recovery of the sequential online learner. At deployment, the auxiliary predictor is discarded, and the model updates natively via token-by-token forward and backward passes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GradLev 用一个因果辅助网络并行预测所有 token 的 costate（层输入与激活梯度），使在线梯度下降的前向评估与反向传播都化为可结合扫描 (associative scan)，从而在测试时训练 (TTT) 中把逐 token 的串行梯度写入改成 token 并行。精确一致性 (exact consistency) 保证与顺序在线学习器完全等价，部署时丢弃辅助预测器，模型退回逐 token 前向/反向更新。
Motivation: TTT 每观测一个 token 就更新权重，串行梯度写入使并行训练困难，语言模型推理吞吐受限。
Method: 给定层输入与激活梯度 (costate)，在线梯度下降的前向与反向都存在精确并行扫描；因果辅助网络跨全部 token 并行预测 costate，结合扫描算出适配权重、前向激活并反向传播梯度，梯度目标再经一致性损失 (consistency loss) 监督该预测器。
Result: 精确一致性保证精确恢复顺序在线学习器；部署时丢弃辅助预测器，模型以逐 token 前向与反向更新原生运行。
Conclusion: costate 预测加可结合扫描能把 TTT 的串行梯度更新改写为 token 并行且与顺序学习严格等价的形式。

papers.title: GPARA: Graph-Posterior-Aligned Refinement and Active Acquisition for Grounding Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: Active grounding of a frozen diffusion prior requires jointly determining where new measurements should be taken and how they should be used to refine the current reconstruction. Posterior-ensemble-based methods can estimate acquisition utility from generated samples, but require repeated ensemble generation as observations accumulate and capture posterior geometry only through empirical statistics. This paper proposes GPARA, which learns a context-dependent graph surrogate over diffusion prediction residuals, inducing an explicitly reusable posterior response operator that propagates measurement innovations to unobserved variables and evaluates candidate measurements through weighted posterior-risk reduction. Under the matched surrogate, we show that the same response operator also determines expected one-step acquisition benefit and yields an analytic ranking consistent with expected reconstruction improvement. A bounded learned residual calibrates the analytic utility to account for surrogate mismatch, while a small prior ensemble is generated once and reconditioned to update risk weights without repeated diffusion posterior sampling during acquisition. Experiments on two reconstruction tasks spanning physical field and computer vision show consistent improvements in refinement and active acquisition over the evaluated baselines. Ablations further support the complementary roles of step-wise graph refinement, adaptive risk weighting, and analytically anchored calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPARA 在冻结 diffusion prior 的主动接地 (active grounding) 中，用图后验对齐的残差代理学习一个可复用的后验响应算子，把测量创新传播到未观测变量，并以加权后验风险下降给出解析的采集排序，再用有界学习残差校准代理失配。在物理场与计算机视觉两个重建任务上，其 refinement 与主动采集相对所评估基线均有一致改进。
Motivation: 基于后验集合的方法要随观测累积反复生成集合，且只能用经验统计刻画后验几何，采集效用估计代价高、几何信息弱。
Method: 在 diffusion 预测残差上学习上下文相关的图代理，导出显式可复用的后验响应算子，按加权后验风险下降评估候选测量；同一算子给出期望一步采集收益的解析排序，配一个有界学习残差做校准；小规模 prior 集合只生成一次，通过 reconditioning 更新风险权重，采集过程中不再重复采样 diffusion 后验。
Result: 在覆盖物理场与计算机视觉的两个重建任务上，refinement 与主动采集相对所评估基线均取得一致改进；消融支持逐步图 refinement、自适应风险加权与解析锚定校准三者的互补作用。
Conclusion: 在匹配代理下，同一个后验响应算子既决定 refinement 又决定采集收益，因此采集排序可解析给出且与期望重建改进一致，代价只需一次集合生成加校准。

papers.title: Natural Image Autoencoder-Based fMRI Representations for Trait and State Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models pre-trained on large-scale fMRI datasets have shown strong downstream performance, but at substantial data and computation cost. To investigate how much fMRI-specific pre-training is actually needed for such performance, we introduce FReD, which derives fMRI representations from a frozen Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) pre-trained exclusively on natural images and pairs them with a task specific readout. For trait prediction, FReD summarizes frame-wise representations by their temporal mean and log-standard deviation and applies linear probing, with late fusion across two normalization schemes. For state prediction, it represents each frame as a single token and models temporal dependencies with a shallow Transformer. Across four resting-state datasets spanning six trait-prediction targets, linear probes on frozen DCAE features generally outperform those on fMRI foundation model representations and remain competitive with fully fine-tuned fMRI foundation models. On three task-fMRI state-prediction tasks, a temporal readout on DCAE features performs comparably to the strongest foundation models evaluated. A Gaussian injection analysis further shows that localized signal changes are recovered more accurately from the frozen DCAE features than from the evaluated foundation-model representations. Together, these results show that strong performance on current fMRI benchmarks is possible without fMRI-specific representation pre-training, making frozen natural-image features as a useful baseline for assessing its added value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FReD 用只在自然图像上预训练、完全冻结的 Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) 特征加任务读出头来做 fMRI 表征：trait 预测取逐帧特征的时间均值与 log 标准差后线性探测（两种归一化晚期融合），state 预测把每帧当一个 token 用浅层 Transformer 建模时序。在四个静息态数据集的六个 trait 目标上，冻结 DCAE 特征的线性探测普遍优于 fMRI 基础模型表征，并与全量微调的基础模型相当；三个任务态 state 预测上与最强基础模型可比，高斯注入的局部信号变化恢复更准。
Motivation: 大规模 fMRI 基础模型的预训练要付出可观的数据与算力成本，但其中多少是 fMRI 特有的预训练真正带来的并不清楚，缺少一个能衡量其增量价值的参照基线。
Method: FReD 冻结一个仅在自然图像上预训练的 DCAE，直接抽取其特征作为 fMRI 表征并配任务读出：trait 用时间均值与 log 标准差汇总逐帧表征，做线性探测并在两种归一化方案间晚期融合；state 把每帧编码为单个 token，用浅层 Transformer 建模时间依赖；另用高斯注入分析检验局部信号变化的恢复。

papers.title: Hidden Activations are not Enough I: Knowledge Matrices as Higher Representations
papers.abstract_en: We study the knowledge matrix of a trained feedforward network as a higher representation of its inputs. A network is a pair $(W,f)$, a thin representation $W$ of its quiver and an activation $f$; its function factorizes through the space of quiver representations, each input $x$ inducing a representation, and the knowledge matrix $M(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times(d+1)}$ is the contraction of that representation to one matrix whose rows sum exactly to the logits. At one trained network we ask what determines it, what it is invariant to, what it determines, and what its geometry measures. Under (LCS), a locally constant slope diagonal, as for ReLU, the matrix at a regular input is a function of the realized germ; its stabilizer among encodings regular there is exactly the germ stabilizer at inputs with no vanishing coordinate, neuron permutation a special case; and it recovers the germ, whereas hidden activations, gauge-covariant and germ-incomplete, are not enough. Under (LCS) it equals per-class gradient$\times$input plus an exact aggregate bias attribution, grounding it in attribution theory and computing it by $C$ vector-Jacobian products instead of probing. The fixed shape gives an alignment-free per-sample distance between ResNet-152, DenseNet-121 and GoogLeNet; the row-sum identity gives an exact visible/invisible displacement decomposition whose unit-free coherence $A=(d_Ψ/d_M)^2$ puts adversarial germ motion at median $A\le 0.23$, with an attack-family ordering concordant across six architectures (Kendall $W=0.921$; $0.97$ on the three networks at full scale). Two honest negatives: on AlexNet/CIFAR-10 penultimate features win 5 of 6 detectors and all 16 attacks, and a matrix-direction counterfactual fails 0/54.
papers.comment: 86 pages, main text 35 pages, appendices 51 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把训练好的前馈网络在单个输入上的 knowledge matrix M(x)∈R^{C×(d+1)}（行和恰为 logits）当作输入的高阶表示：在 LCS（对角局部常数斜率，如 ReLU）下它由 realized germ 决定、可由 C 次 vector-Jacobian product 精确算出，且等价于逐类梯度×输入加精确聚合偏置归因。对抗性 germ 运动的 unit-free coherence A=(d_Ψ/d_M)² 中位数 A≤0.23，六种架构上攻击族排序一致（Kendall W=0.921，三个网络全尺度上 0.97）；但 AlexNet/CIFAR-10 上 penultimate 特征在 6 个检测器中赢 5 个、在全部 16 种攻击上全赢，矩阵方向反事实 0/54 失败。
Motivation: 隐藏激活是 gauge-covariant 且 germ-incomplete，不足以唯一刻画网络在输入处的行为；需要一个既可精确计算、又能在样本间对齐的表示来支撑归因与对抗几何分析。
Method: 把网络写成 (W,f)，函数经 quiver 表示空间分解，将每个输入诱导的表示收缩为 knowledge matrix M(x)；在 LCS 条件下证明其稳定子等于 germ 稳定子（神经元置换为特例）并可恢复 germ；给出 M(x)=逐类梯度×输入+精确聚合偏置归因的等式，用 C 次 vector-Jacobian product 计算；用行和恒等式做可见/不可见位移分解并定义 A=(d_Ψ/d_M)²。
Result: 对抗 germ 运动的 A 中位数 ≤0.23，攻击族排序在六个架构上一致（Kendall W=0.921，三个网络全尺度 0.97）；固定形状给出 ResNet-152、DenseNet-121、GoogLeNet 之间免对齐的逐样本距离。两个负面结果：AlexNet/CIFAR-10 上 penultimate 特征在 6 个检测器中赢 5 个、在全部 16 种攻击上全赢；矩阵方向反事实 0/54 失败。
Conclusion: 在 LCS 网络上 knowledge matrix 是比隐藏激活更完整的表示，可精确计算并支撑对抗几何度量；但在 AlexNet/CIFAR-10 这类设置里 penultimate 特征仍更实用，矩阵方向反事实不成立。

papers.title: GT-PSSM: Unified Probabilistic Framework for Stochastic Dynamics Modeling and Dependency Learning in Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTAD) is crucial for ensuring the safe and reliable operation of complex systems. Many existing methods learn normal patterns by training reconstruction or forecasting models on predominantly normal data. However, a large portion of these approaches rely on deterministic models and their associated point-wise output errors for anomaly scoring. Since real-world multivariate time series are inherently stochastic due to measurement noise and intrinsic system randomness, purely error-based scores can be unreliable, as large errors may arise from benign fluctuations rather than true anomalies. Probabilistic approaches address this limitation by quantifying uncertainty in model outputs. In particular, probabilistic state-space models (PSSMs) provide a principled framework by modeling stochastic system dynamics through latent state transitions and measurement noise via emission models. Despite this advantage, existing PSSM-based MTAD methods often struggle to capture long-range temporal dependencies and inter-variable dependencies, as they typically rely on noise-sensitive recurrent architectures and lack explicit cross-variable structure modeling. To address these limitations, we propose Graph-Transformer-Enhanced Probabilistic State-Space Model (GT-PSSM), a novel PSSM-based MTAD method that tightly integrates PSSM-based probabilistic modeling of stochastic dynamics with Graph Transformer-based learning of temporal and inter-variable dependencies. By jointly modeling stochasticity, long-range temporal dependence, and variable interactions within a unified probabilistic framework, GT-PSSM enables more robust anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GT-PSSM 把概率状态空间模型 (PSSM) 的随机动力学建模与 Graph Transformer 的长程时间依赖、跨变量依赖学习统一到一个框架里，用于多变量时间序列异常检测 (MTAD)。它用潜状态转移与发射噪声刻画随机性，再用图结构显式建模变量间关系，从而让基于不确定性的异常打分不再被良性波动的大误差误导。
Motivation: 现有 MTAD 多用确定性重建/预报模型的逐点误差打分，而真实多变量序列因测量噪声与系统随机性天然随机，纯误差分数会把良性波动误判为异常；已有 PSSM 方法又受限于对噪声敏感的循环结构、缺少显式跨变量建模，难以捕捉长程时间与变量间依赖。
Method: 提出 Graph-Transformer-Enhanced Probabilistic State-Space Model (GT-PSSM)：以 PSSM 的潜状态转移建模随机系统动力学、以发射模型建模测量噪声，同时用 Graph Transformer 学习长程时间依赖与 inter-variable 依赖，把随机性、长程时间依赖与变量交互放进统一的概率框架联合建模。
Result: 在统一概率框架下联合建模随机性、长程时间依赖与变量交互，使异常检测更稳健；摘要为方法提出型描述，未给出数据集、基线或定量指标对比。
Conclusion: 作者主张 MTAD 需要同时处理随机性、长程时间依赖与跨变量结构，把 Graph Transformer 嵌入 PSSM 是实现这一统一建模的可行路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Processing the same records in a different order can discard different evidence, yet endpoint accuracy alone cannot reveal what changed or whether it mattered. We introduce RoutePrism, a diagnostic protocol that builds memory twice from the same source pool in two processing orders, then traces which sources, compiled contexts, and answers differ. Because record content, timestamps, policy, and the answer model all stay fixed, any observed difference is localized to the memory construction step. A matched four-condition intervention tests whether a record displaced by reordering actually carried task-relevant evidence: restoring that single record recovers over 60 percentage points of lost accuracy, while substituting a non-supporting record of equal length does not. We evaluate the protocol on PersonaMem-32K (63 primary queries, 29 users) and 470 LongMemEval-S questions with histories spanning 38 to 62 sessions, replicating the core intervention across five answer models. Survivor selection, defined as the choice of which record a cluster retains, drives most source-level changes, while different memory policies (compaction, bounded recency, MemoChat-style summarization, A-MEM) produce distinct failure signatures at the source, context, and metadata layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoutePrism 用同一份记录池按两种处理顺序各建一次记忆，把差异逐层追到源、编译上下文与答案，从而把端点准确率变化定位到记忆构建这一步。四条件干预显示，被重排挤出的那条记录若真携带任务证据，单独恢复即可挽回 60 个百分点以上的准确率损失，而替换等长的非支撑记录则无效。
Motivation: 同一记录换序处理会丢掉不同证据，但只看端点准确率无法判断差异出在哪一层、是否真的影响任务。
Method: 固定记录内容、时间戳、策略与答案模型，仅改处理顺序，构建两次记忆并逐层比对源、编译上下文与答案；再做四条件配对干预，恢复被挤出的单条记录或换成等长非支撑记录，检验其是否携带任务证据。
Result: 在 PersonaMem-32K（63 条主查询、29 个用户）与 470 道 LongMemEval-S 问题（历史跨 38 至 62 个 session）上评测，核心干预在五种答案模型上复现；恢复被挤出记录挽回超过 60 个百分点的准确率损失，等长替换无效。Survivor selection（聚类保留哪条记录）主导源层变化，compaction、bounded recency、MemoChat 式摘要与 A-MEM 各自产生源、上下文、元数据层的不同失效特征。
Conclusion: 记忆构建的记录取舍（survivor selection）是端点准确率变化的主要来源，且不同记忆策略的失效可按层区分，因此诊断应定位到构建步骤而非只看最终准确率。

papers.title: WorldGraph: Graph-Native World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World models infer latent states of an environment to capture its underlying dynamics and predict future evolution. Many real-world environments, however, are inherently relational and observed as evolving graphs, where entities, relations, and their properties change over time. Prior graph-related world models use graph structures to organize internal states or support task-specific reasoning, rather than treating an evolving graph itself as the modeled world. We instead study graph world modeling (GWM), where graph evolution itself constitutes the world dynamics. We formulate graph world modeling over observed graph evolution, latent graph states, and heterogeneous graph-transition predictions. Based on this formulation, we construct GWM-Zero, a benchmark covering node-, edge-, and graph-level transitions over eight temporal graph datasets. We propose WorldGraph, which combines a state-aware graph transformer for multi-granularity structural and transition-conditioned evolution modeling with transition-aware GRPO using dynamic grouping and structure-aware verifiable rewards. Extensive experiments on GWM-Zero show that WorldGraph consistently outperforms representative graph representation, temporal graph learning, graph pretraining, and graph world-model baselines across all three transition granularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「世界」定义为随时间演化的图本身，提出 WorldGraph：状态感知图 Transformer 建模节点/边/图三粒度的结构与转移演化，配合转移感知的 GRPO（动态分组 + 结构化可验证奖励）训练。在自建基准 GWM-Zero（8 个时序图数据集）上，于全部三种转移粒度一致超过图表示、时序图学习、图预训练与图世界模型基线。
Motivation: 现有图相关世界模型只是用图结构组织内部状态或支撑任务推理，并未把演化图本身当作被建模的世界；关系型环境（实体、关系及其属性随时间变化）缺少对应的建模范式与基准。
Method: 形式化 graph world modeling（GWM）：观测图演化、隐图状态、异构图转移预测三层；构建 GWM-Zero 基准，覆盖 8 个时序图数据集上的节点级、边级、图级转移。模型 WorldGraph 由状态感知图 Transformer（多粒度结构 + 转移条件演化建模）与 transition-aware GRPO（dynamic grouping、structure-aware verifiable rewards）组成。

papers.title: Toward a Graded Measure of Belief Stability in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people access and reason with information, yet factual reliability is usually evaluated one judgment at a time. We introduce graded belief stability, a relational measure of how well a belief persists within an LLM's broader belief system. Unlike individual belief probability, it asks whether support for a claim persists when that claim is considered alongside the model's other epistemic commitments. We operationalize this idea with a Direct Conditional estimator that uses internal model representations to estimate conditional belief probabilities. Across 12 LLMs and three domains, lower-stability beliefs exhibit greater mean behavioral movement under conversational challenge in 83.3% of model-domain settings after matching on individual belief probability. Graded belief stability therefore extends reliability assessment beyond how strongly an LLM supports a claim to how robustly that belief is supported within its broader system of beliefs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分级信念稳定性 (graded belief stability)：衡量 LLM 对某命题的支持在与其其他认识承诺一并考虑时是否稳固，而非只看单条判断的置信度。用 Direct Conditional 估计器借内部表征估计条件信念概率，在 12 个 LLM、三个领域上，控制单条信念概率后，低稳定性信念在对话挑战下的平均行为移动更大，占 83.3% 的模型-领域设置。
Motivation: LLM 已成为人们获取与推理信息的中介，但事实可靠性评估一次只看一条判断，无法刻画某条信念在模型整体信念系统中的稳固程度。
Method: 定义关系性的分级信念稳定性，并用 Direct Conditional 估计器从模型内部表征估计条件信念概率；在 12 个 LLM、三个领域上按单条信念概率做匹配后再比较行为移动。
Result: 在按单条信念概率匹配后，低稳定性信念在对话挑战下表现出更大的平均行为移动，覆盖 83.3% 的模型-领域设置（12 个 LLM × 三个领域）。
Conclusion: 可靠性评估应从「模型多支持某命题」扩展到「该信念在其整体信念系统中被多稳固地支撑」，稳定性对对话挑战下的行为移动有超出单条置信度的预测力。

papers.title: TableSeek: Structure-Preserving Agentic Evidence Seeking over Heterogeneous Table Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Open-domain table retrieval seeks tables that contain sufficient evidence for answering a question or verifying a claim. Yet semantic relevance is often misleading: topically similar tables may lack the required facts, while answer-bearing evidence is often confined to a few cells whose meaning depends on surrounding schema and table context. Heterogeneous schemas, value formats, and serializations further weaken one-shot matching. We present TableSeek, a structure-preserving agentic search framework for heterogeneous table corpora. Instead of ranking tables once, an LLM agent iteratively follows sparse clues, inspects schema-preserving previews, identifies schema- and value-level mismatches, and refines its investigation. TableSeek uses cells and schemas as evidence anchors while retaining complete tables as evidence units, enabling fine-grained localization without losing the context required for interpretation and answerability checking. Without relying on retriever training or a precomputed semantic index, TableSeek produces transparent evidence-seeking trajectories and achieves competitive end-to-end performance against strong retrieval-and-reranking pipelines on heterogeneous table benchmarks. These results suggest that active, structure-preserving evidence seeking is a promising paradigm for open-domain table retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TableSeek 用 LLM agent 在异构表格语料上做开放式表格检索：不一次性排序，而是沿稀疏线索迭代查看 schema 保留的预览、定位 schema 与取值层面的不匹配并逐步细化调查，以单元格和 schema 为证据锚点、整表为证据单元。无需检索器训练或预建语义索引，即可在异构表格基准上取得与强检索-重排流水线相当的端到端表现。
Motivation: 开放式表格检索中语义相关常具误导性：主题相近的表格可能不含所需事实，而承载答案的证据往往只集中在少数单元格，其含义依赖周边 schema 与表上下文；异构 schema、取值格式与序列化进一步削弱一次性匹配。
Method: TableSeek 是结构保留的 agentic search 框架：LLM agent 迭代跟随稀疏线索，检视 schema 保留的预览 (schema-preserving previews)，识别 schema 级与 value 级不匹配并 refine 调查；以 cells 与 schemas 作证据锚点、保留完整表格作证据单元，且不依赖 retriever 训练或预计算语义索引。
Result: 在异构表格基准上取得与强 retrieval-and-reranking 流水线相当的端到端性能，并产出透明的证据搜寻轨迹 (evidence-seeking trajectories)。
Conclusion: 主动的、结构保留的证据搜寻是开放式表格检索的一个有前景的范式，可在不训练检索器、不建语义索引的条件下与重排流水线竞争。

papers.title: Transfer Calibrated Prediction Powered Inference
papers.abstract_en: Prediction-powered inference (PPI) and its power-tuned extension (PPI++) improve confidence intervals by combining a small gold-standard labeled sample with a large AI model's predictions. Its efficiency gain relies on low residual variance, which may not hold if the predictor is pre-trained on a different source domain. We propose Transfer Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference (TC-PPI), adapting the source-domain predictor to the target domain using gold-standard samples through cross-fitting. This approach supports various adaptation methods, such as sparse linear calibration, LoRA, and fine-tuning. Our jointly tuned cross-fit estimator, Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++, maintains unbiasedness and is simultaneously at least as efficient as classical inference, PPI, and PPI++, thereby protecting against negative transfer. We provide high-dimensional MSE bounds for calibration and show empirical improvements over baseline methods across various real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TC-PPI 用目标域少量 gold-standard 标签通过 cross-fitting 校准源域预训练预测器（支持稀疏线性校准、LoRA、微调），其联合调参版本 Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++ 在保持无偏的同时至少与经典推断、PPI、PPI++ 一样有效，从而防止负迁移；作者给出校准的高维 MSE 界并在多个真实应用上报告相对基线的经验改进。
Motivation: PPI/PPI++ 的效率增益依赖低残差方差，而预测器若在不同源域上预训练，残差方差可能很大，置信区间收益随之失效。
Method: 用目标域 gold-standard 样本经 cross-fitting 适配源域预测器，适配方法可选稀疏线性校准、LoRA 或微调；在此之上构造联合调参的 cross-fit 估计量 Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++，并推导校准的高维 MSE 界。
Result: Joint-TC-Cross-PPI++ 保持无偏性，且效率至少不低于经典推断、PPI 与 PPI++，可防御负迁移；给出校准的高维 MSE 界，并在多个真实应用场景上相对基线方法显示经验改进。
Conclusion: 把源域预测器先在目标域 gold 标签上做 cross-fit 校准再进 PPI，可以在预测器跨域失配时保住无偏性与效率下界。

papers.title: SPINET: Sheaf Protein Inverse Folding Network
papers.abstract_en: Proteins change shape as they function, yet most inverse folding models predict amino acid sequences from a single, fixed backbone. A central challenge in protein engineering is to design proteins that undergo specific motions, which requires accounting for how their structures change over time. This motivates inverse protein folding conditioned on protein motion. We introduce SPINET, which predicts sequences from molecular dynamics trajectories. It uses cellular sheaves to represent residue interactions within each frame and recurrent units to integrate information across frames, then predicts all amino acids in a single pass. We evaluate SPINET on mdCATH and ATLAS, where it outperforms all evaluated static and ensemble baselines in sequence recovery. On mdCATH, it achieves 56.7% top-1 recovery, compared with 44.5% for the strongest static baseline and 40.7% for the strongest ensemble baseline. We also evaluate whether the predicted sequences are compatible with conformations sampled along the target trajectory. On mdCATH, they achieve a median TM-score of 0.760, and structural recovery favors target conformations over unrelated decoys for 99.5% of test domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPINET 把逆折叠的输入从单一固定骨架换成分子动力学轨迹：用 cellular sheaf 表示每帧残基相互作用，用循环单元跨帧整合信息，一次性预测全部氨基酸序列。在 mdCATH 上 top-1 序列恢复率达 56.7%，高于最强静态基线 44.5% 与最强 ensemble 基线 40.7%；预测序列与目标轨迹构象的中位 TM-score 为 0.760，99.5% 的测试结构域中结构恢复偏向目标构象而非无关 decoy。
Motivation: 蛋白质执行功能时构象在变，而现有逆折叠模型都从单一固定骨架预测序列，无法处理需要设计特定运动的蛋白质工程问题。
Method: SPINET 以分子动力学轨迹为条件做逆蛋白折叠：每帧用 cellular sheaf 编码残基间相互作用，跨帧用 recurrent units 聚合信息，最后单次前向预测全部氨基酸；在 mdCATH 与 ATLAS 上评测序列恢复，并检验预测序列与轨迹采样构象的兼容性。
Result: mdCATH 上 top-1 序列恢复 56.7%，对比最强静态基线 44.5%、最强 ensemble 基线 40.7%；预测序列在 mdCASH 上中位 TM-score 0.760，且 99.5% 的测试结构域中结构恢复偏向目标构象而非无关 decoy；在 mdCATH 与 ATLAS 上序列恢复均超过全部被评估的静态与 ensemble 基线。
Conclusion: 以轨迹为条件、用 sheaf 加循环单元建模构象变化，能在序列恢复和构象兼容性上同时胜过静态与 ensemble 逆折叠基线。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents can continually improve their behavior, while tools define the executable action space through which they interact with the environment. However, exposing the full tool library to model introduces substantial irrelevant context and can impair tool-use decisions. We study tool-space self-evolution, where each recurring task type maintains a persistent tool space which is constructed from accumulated output experience. We identify three limitations of existing methods: (1) output-unaware selection: they rely primarily on tool descriptions or model priors rather than observed tool outputs; (2) statelessness across request: they select tools independently for each request without consolidating prior output experience into persistent task-specific state; (3) inference cost: they repeatedly search, rank, or reason over candidate tools for subsequent requests of the same task. We address these limitations through output-aware tool scoring, persistent task-specific tool spaces, amortized tool selection, and reusable configurations across models. We introduce LOTS (Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring), which evolves an agent's tool space from accumulated output experience while keeping model parameters fixed. After each request, LOTS holds the model's generated answer and estimates each tool's contribution by measuring how much the answer likelihood changes when its observed output is removed. These contributions are aggregated within each recurring task to rank tools and update its persistent space. Across three benchmarks, LOTS improves task performance while substantially reducing tool context. More importantly, sequential experiments demonstrate that task-specific spaces persist and continue to improve over time, while cross-model experiments show that learned configurations transfer across different models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LOTS（Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring）：模型参数固定，仅凭每次请求后答案似然的变化量来估计各工具贡献，在同一任务类型内累积排序并维护持久工具空间。在三个 benchmark 上 LOTS 提升任务表现同时大幅削减工具上下文，序列实验显示任务专属工具空间随时间持续改进，跨模型实验显示学到的配置可迁移。
Motivation: 把完整工具库暴露给模型会引入大量无关上下文并损害工具选择；现有方法只看工具描述或模型先验、跨请求无状态、且对同类请求反复搜索排序候选工具，带来推理成本。
Method: 四个组件：output-aware 工具打分、持久任务专属工具空间、摊销 (amortized) 工具选择、跨模型可复用配置。核心 LOTS 在每次请求后取模型生成的答案，逐个移除工具的观测输出并测量答案似然变化以估计该工具贡献，再在重复任务内聚合排序、更新持久工具空间，全程不更新模型参数。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 上 LOTS 提升任务表现并显著减少工具上下文；序列实验表明任务专属工具空间得以保持并随时间继续改进；跨模型实验表明学到的配置可迁移到不同模型。
Conclusion: 工具空间的自进化可以在参数冻结下靠输出似然信号完成，且持久化与跨模型复用使工具选择从逐请求搜索变为摊销成本。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 LOTS（Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring）：模型参数固定，仅凭每次请求后答案似然的变化量来估计各工具贡献，在同一任务类型内累积排序并维护持久工具空间。在三个 benchmark 上 LOTS 提升任务表现同时大幅削减工具上下文，序列实验显示任务专属工具空间随时间持续改进，跨模型实验显示学到的配置可迁移。
summary_sections.motivation: 把完整工具库暴露给模型会引入大量无关上下文并损害工具选择；现有方法只看工具描述或模型先验、跨请求无状态、且对同类请求反复搜索排序候选工具，带来推理成本。
summary_sections.method: 四个组件：output-aware 工具打分、持久任务专属工具空间、摊销 (amortized) 工具选择、跨模型可复用配置。核心 LOTS 在每次请求后取模型生成的答案，逐个移除工具的观测输出并测量答案似然变化以估计该工具贡献，再在重复任务内聚合排序、更新持久工具空间，全程不更新模型参数。
summary_sections.result: 在三个 benchmark 上 LOTS 提升任务表现并显著减少工具上下文；序列实验表明任务专属工具空间得以保持并随时间继续改进；跨模型实验表明学到的配置可迁移到不同模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 工具空间的自进化可以在参数冻结下靠输出似然信号完成，且持久化与跨模型复用使工具选择从逐请求搜索变为摊销成本。

papers.title: Functional Hand Type Prior for 3D Hand Pose Estimation and Action Recognition from Egocentric View Monocular Videos
papers.abstract_en: Current methods for egocentric view action recognition often face challenges in perceiving dynamic hand movements relying solely on geometrical or physical information. In this work, we effectively address this problem by gaining insights into the correlation between functional hand configurations and objects, which improves the detailed interpretation of real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce a practical taxonomy of hand types based on the functioning perspective and utilize it for per-frame hand type labeling on existing datasets. We also propose a novel hand action recognition framework considering semantic details of the hand type as prior. This approach boosts the network's understanding of the continuous hand interaction throughout the action sequence. Our whole pipeline consists of three main modules: (1) Feature Extraction, (2) Egocentric Knowledge Module, which estimates 3D hand pose, object category, and hand type leveraging short-term cues, and (2) Egocentric Action Module, which aggregates per-frame knowledge, including text embeddings of hand type, over a longer time. In our extensive experiments with large-scale benchmarks, FPHA and H2O, our model outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its superior performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以功能视角手型分类 (hand type taxonomy) 为先验的第一人称单目视频动作识别框架：Egocentric Knowledge Module 借短期线索估计 3D 手姿、物体类别与手型，Egocentric Action Module 再把手型文本嵌入等逐帧知识在更长时间上聚合。在 FPHA 与 H2O 大规模基准上超过现有 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 第一人称动作识别若只依赖几何或物理信息，难以感知动态手部动作；把手型与物体的功能关联作为语义先验可补足对真实场景的细致理解。
Method: 三模块流水线：特征提取；Egocentric Knowledge Module 用短期线索估计 3D hand pose、object category 与 hand type；Egocentric Action Module 将逐帧知识（含 hand type 的 text embeddings）在更长时间窗上聚合，并对现有数据集做逐帧手型标注。
Result: 在 FPHA 与 H2O 两个大规模基准上，模型超过当前 state-of-the-art 方法；摘要以定性方式表述为 superior performance，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把手型语义作为先验并跨长时间聚合逐帧知识，能提升第一人称单目视频对连续手—物交互的理解与动作识别表现。

papers.title: Geometric Encoding for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are far more reliable at recognizing what appears in a video than at reasoning about its spatial and temporal properties, such as metric distances, object dimensions, and consistent object identities across frames. We present Geometric Code, a perception-to-geometry pipeline that computes explicit spatial structure from video and supplies it to VLMs as context to augment reasoning. A perception layer segments and classifies objects and recovers depth, camera pose, and intrinsics from monocular RGB video. A deterministic geometric engine then back-projects, merges, and cleans these outputs into a spatial code, including per-object positions, dimensions, counts, inter-object distances, appearance order, and room geometry. The code is serialized into VLMs' prompts, either alongside the video or replacing it entirely. Specifically, there is no component trained or fine-tuned in our approach. On VSI-Bench, augmenting 2B and 4B open models with the spatial code improves average accuracy by +4.1 points over the frames-only baseline, with the largest gains on numeric estimation tasks such as absolute distance (+24.1 points). The results suggest that explicitly computed geometry, delivered through the language channel, recovers spatial competence that small VLMs cannot extract from pixels alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Geometric Code 把单目视频经感知层与确定性几何引擎转成显式空间码（物体位置、尺寸、数量、间距、出现顺序、房间几何），序列化进 VLM prompt 后无需任何训练即可增强空间推理。在 VSI-Bench 上，2B 与 4B 开源模型加空间码后平均精度比仅用帧的基线高 4.1 点，绝对距离估计提升最大达 24.1 点。
Motivation: VLM 识别视频内容较可靠，但对度量距离、物体尺寸、跨帧一致身份等时空属性推理明显不足，小模型难以从像素中自行提取几何。
Method: 感知层从单目 RGB 视频分割分类物体并恢复深度、相机位姿与内参；确定性几何引擎反投影、合并、清理得到 spatial code，序列化为 prompt 与视频并列或完全替代视频；全流程无训练或微调组件。
Result: 在 VSI-Bench 上，2B 与 4B 开源模型加入 spatial code 后平均精度较 frames-only 基线提升 +4.1 点；数值估计类任务增益最大，绝对距离 (absolute distance) 达 +24.1 点。
Conclusion: 显式计算的几何经语言通道输入，可补回小 VLM 从像素中无法获得的空间推理能力，且无需训练。

papers.title: ExpertoRhythm: Morphology-Aware Learning for Waveform Reconstruction and Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation from Single-Channel PPG
papers.abstract_en: Continuous cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring from photoplethysmography (PPG) has strong potential for wearable health and telemonitoring, but accurate estimation remains difficult because PPG-to-BP mapping must preserve subtle waveform morphology and pressure-range-dependent dynamics. We introduce ExpertoRhythm, an attention-enhanced 1D U-Net that reconstructs the arterial blood pressure (ABP) waveform from a single-channel PPG signal and derives systolic and diastolic BP directly from the reconstructed waveform. The central contribution is a composite morphology-aware learning objective that integrates range-weighted SmoothL1 reconstruction with a window-range regularizer to emphasize high-dynamic BP segments and reduce amplitude under/over-shoot. On the UCI cuff-less BP dataset with 942 subjects, ExpertoRhythm achieves 2.46/1.46 mmHg MAE for systolic/diastolic BP (SBP/DBP), while obtaining a 30.4% average relative error reduction over pure MSE across waveform reconstruction and BP estimation metrics. Clinical-style evaluation further demonstrates low bias and strong agreement across the BP range, including high-pressure windows up to 200 mmHg, satisfying AAMI criteria and achieving BHS Grade A. These results suggest that morphology-aware waveform reconstruction from a single PPG channel can provide an accurate and practical pathway toward continuous cuffless BP monitoring in wearable and remote-care settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExpertoRhythm 用注意力增强的 1D U-Net 从单通道 PPG 重建动脉血压 (ABP) 波形，再直接从重建波形读出收缩压/舒张压。在 UCI cuff-less BP 数据集（942 名受试者）上 SBP/DBP MAE 达 2.46/1.46 mmHg，相比纯 MSE 在波形重建与血压估计指标上平均相对误差降低 30.4%，满足 AAMI 标准并获 BHS Grade A。
Motivation: PPG 到血压的映射必须保留细微波形形态与随压力区间变化的动态，直接回归难以做到，导致无袖带连续血压监测精度不足。
Method: 注意力增强的 1D U-Net 先从单通道 PPG 重建 ABP 波形，再由波形导出 SBP/DBP；训练用复合形态感知目标：range-weighted SmoothL1 重建损失加 window-range 正则项，强调高动态血压片段并抑制幅度欠/过冲。
Result: 在 UCI cuff-less BP 数据集（942 名受试者）上 SBP/DBP MAE 为 2.46/1.46 mmHg；相对纯 MSE 在波形重建与血压估计指标上平均相对误差降低 30.4%；临床式评估显示全血压区间（含高达 200 mmHg 的高压窗口）低偏差、强一致性，满足 AAMI 标准并达 BHS Grade A。
Conclusion: 从单通道 PPG 做形态感知的波形重建是实现可穿戴与远程照护场景下连续无袖带血压监测的准确可行路径。

papers.title: CAST: Reconstruction-Coupled Acceleration of Interactive World Models
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world models must respond quickly to controls while preserving scene consistency. Existing acceleration methods can miss heterogeneous control responses and spatial transport when recovering skipped features. We observe that interaction-induced feature changes correlate with approximation error, while low-frequency interpolation errors are phase-sensitive and show more predictable phase progression. These findings motivate CAST, a reconstruction-coupled inference framework. CAST selects anchors by interaction sensitivity and cross-layer coverage, reconstructs skipped residuals with frequency- and confidence-aware Phase-Aware Reconstruction (PAR), and coordinates historical KV routing according to downstream reconstruction responsibility. On Matrix-Game 3.0 and HY-World 1.5, CAST achieves 2.15x and 3.48x speedups, respectively, while maintaining visual quality close to Native (Figure 1). It also attains the highest VBench scores among compared methods and leads non-native baselines on seven and six of thirteen WorldMark dimensions, demonstrating a balance of generation speed, visual quality, and interactive responsiveness under real-time control. Code is available at https://github.com/lokiniuniu/CAST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAST 是面向交互式世界模型的重建耦合推理加速框架：按交互敏感度与跨层覆盖选锚点，用相位感知重建 (PAR) 补回被跳过的残差，并按下游重建责任调度历史 KV 路由。在 Matrix-Game 3.0 与 HY-World 1.5 上分别取得 2.15x 与 3.48x 加速，视觉质量接近 Native，并在十三项 WorldMark 维度中于七项和六项领先非原生基线。
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需在实时控制下快速响应并保持场景一致，而现有加速方法在恢复被跳过特征时会漏掉异质控制响应与空间传输。
Method: CAST 按交互敏感度与跨层覆盖 (cross-layer coverage) 选择锚点；用频率与置信度感知的 Phase-Aware Reconstruction (PAR) 重建被跳过的残差，依据是交互引起的特征变化与近似误差相关、低频插值误差相位敏感且相位演进更可预测；再按下游重建责任协调历史 KV 路由。
Result: 在 Matrix-Game 3.0 上加速 2.15x，在 HY-World 1.5 上加速 3.48x，视觉质量接近 Native；VBench 得分在所比较方法中最高，并在十三项 WorldMark 维度中的七项（Matrix-Game 3.0）与六项（HY-World 1.5）领先非原生基线。
Conclusion: 把跳帧重建与 KV 路由耦合进推理调度，可以在实时控制下同时保住生成速度、视觉质量与交互响应性。

papers.title: Beyond Geometry: Benchmarking and Consistency Reasoning for 3D Logical Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D industrial anomaly detection mainly targets local geometric deviations. In contrast, many industrial anomalies violate object-level design or assembly rules, which we define as 3D logical anomalies. To address these challenges, we introduce the Industrial Logical Anomaly Detection Dataset (ILGAD), the first scalable benchmark dedicated to logical anomalies in industrial point clouds. ILGAD contains 2,774 samples from 15 categories with point-level annotations and covers existence, specification, pose, and assembly-state errors. To detect such 3D logical anomalies, we propose a consistency reasoning framework that assesses whether local geometry, structure coverage, and spatial relations conform to the normal design. The framework detects geometric changes, unsupported expected structures, and abnormal local arrangements. Experiments on ILGAD, Anomaly-ShapeNet, and IEC3D demonstrate superior object-level detection and point-level localization, showing that the framework effectively detects logical anomalies and generalizes to conventional geometric defects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 3D 逻辑异常检测基准 ILGAD 与一致性推理框架：判断局部几何、结构覆盖与空间关系是否符合正常设计，从而同时捕捉几何偏差、缺失的预期结构和异常排布。在 ILGAD、Anomaly-ShapeNet 与 IEC3D 上展示出更优的目标级检测与点级定位，并能泛化到常规几何缺陷。
Motivation: 现有 3D 工业异常检测主要针对局部几何偏差，而大量工业异常违反对象级设计或装配规则（即 3D 逻辑异常），此前缺少专门面向工业点云逻辑异常的可扩展基准。
Method: 发布 ILGAD 数据集：2,774 个样本、15 个类别、点级标注，覆盖存在性、规格、位姿与装配状态错误；并提出一致性推理框架，评估局部几何、结构覆盖与空间关系是否符合正常设计，检测几何变化、缺失的预期结构与异常局部排布。
Result: 在 ILGAD、Anomaly-ShapeNet 和 IEC3D 上的实验展示出更优的目标级检测与点级定位，且框架能泛化到常规几何缺陷。
Conclusion: 把逻辑一致性（几何、结构覆盖、空间关系是否符合设计）作为检测对象，可在工业点云上同时覆盖逻辑异常与常规几何缺陷。

papers.title: Analytical and Convolutional Neural Network-Based Motion-Vector Propagation for Efficient Video Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Continuous video analytics requires accurate localization at low latency within embedded power budgets. This paper presents a hardware-software design methodology that reuses codec motion vectors (MVs) between detector invocations. Two alternative models support translation and scale changes: analytical motion-vector propagation (Analytical-MV) and learned propagation using a convolutional neural network (CNN) (CNN-MV). The learned model uses convolutional operations and independent object updates suited to parallel execution on an edge graphics processing unit (GPU). Analytical-MV combines a harmonic-mean precision-recall score (F1) of 0.909 with a mean end-to-end latency of 9.03 ms and an energy consumption of 0.177 J per frame, yielding the lowest latency and energy among the evaluated configurations. Relative to detection on every frame, it reduces mean latency by 25.9% and energy per frame by 36.4%. CNN-MV offers a different trade-off: its fastest configuration raises recall from 0.871 for Analytical-MV to 0.890 and lowers mean power from 19.64 to 17.32 W, while achieving a latency of 18.42 ms and an energy consumption of 0.319 J per frame. It is therefore useful when recall or operating power is more important than minimum latency and energy. Execution on a deep learning accelerator (DLA) further reduces time-averaged GPU utilization relative to GPU execution. Host-processing optimization substantially improves both latency and energy, demonstrating the value of jointly designing temporal models and their execution pipelines.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向嵌入式视频目标检测，复用编解码器帧间运动向量 (motion vector) 在两次检测调用之间传播目标位置，给出解析式 (Analytical-MV) 与 CNN 学习式 (CNN-MV) 两种模型。Analytical-MV 取得 F1 0.909、端到端时延 9.03 ms、每帧能耗 0.177 J，相对逐帧检测时延降 25.9%、能耗降 36.4%；需要更高召回或更低功耗时改用 CNN-MV。
Motivation: 连续视频分析要求在嵌入式功耗预算内同时做到准确定位与低时延，而每帧都跑检测器在时延和能耗上代价过高。
Method: 硬件-软件协同设计方法：复用编解码器运动向量在检测器调用之间传播目标，支持平移与尺度变化的两条路线——解析式 MV 传播 (Analytical-MV) 与 CNN 学习式传播 (CNN-MV，卷积运算加独立目标更新，适合边缘 GPU 并行)；同时优化执行管线，比较 GPU 与深度学习加速器 (DLA) 执行及宿主端处理优化。
Result: Analytical-MV：F1 0.909，平均端到端时延 9.03 ms，每帧能耗 0.177 J，在所评估配置中时延与能耗最低；相对逐帧检测时延降低 25.9%、每帧能耗降低 36.4%。CNN-MV 最快配置：recall 从 Analytical-MV 的 0.871 提到 0.890，平均功率从 19.64 W 降到 17.32 W，时延 18.42 ms、每帧能耗 0.319 J。DLA 执行相比 GPU 进一步降低时间平均 GPU 利用率；宿主端处理优化同时改善时延与能耗。
Conclusion: 在低时延低能耗优先时选 Analytical-MV，当召回率或运行功率更重要时选 CNN-MV；时延与能耗收益来自时域传播模型与其执行管线的联合设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents deployed in real settings must work across different applications that support the same functionality. Most existing benchmarks test each task in only one app, so a high score can mean the agent understands the task, or only that it knows that particular app. We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed. It spans 10 functional categories, 100 task templates, and 520 task--application pairs over 52 applications. Agents run from raw instructions and with app-independent sub-goals, and a VLM judge labels every failed run under a fixed failure taxonomy whose reliability is measured by human annotation. We find that, across 13 agents, success on the original application does not transfer reliably to new applications with the same goal. Furthermore, providing high-level sub-goal decomposition produces only small, category-dependent changes that do not close the gap, and the mix of failure types changes with the target interface. Based on those insights, we believe the AnyAppBench benchmark provides an important stepping stone toward robust real-world deployment of mobile GUI agents. Our code, data and the leaderboard can be found at the project website https://anyappbench.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AnyAppBench：类别受控的 Android 跨应用基准，固定用户目标、跨 52 个应用评测 GUI agent 的泛化能力。13 个 agent 上，在原应用成功并不能可靠迁移到同目标的新应用；给出高层子目标分解只带来小幅且随类别变化的改进，无法弥合差距，且失败类型构成随目标界面变化。
Motivation: 现有基准多在单一应用内测任务，高分无法区分 agent 是真懂任务还是只熟悉那个应用，跨应用泛化这一真实部署要求无从度量。
Method: AnyAppBench 覆盖 10 个功能类别、100 个任务模板、520 个任务-应用对、52 个应用；agent 从原始指令出发并可获得与应用无关的子目标，每次失败运行由 VLM judge 按固定失败分类法标注，其可靠性用人工标注度量。
Result: 13 个 agent 上，原应用成功无法可靠迁移到同目标的新应用；高层子目标分解只产生小幅、随类别变化的改变，未能弥合差距；失败类型构成随目标界面改变。
Conclusion: 跨应用泛化是移动 GUI agent 通往真实部署的主要瓶颈，仅靠任务级子目标分解不足以解决，需要面向界面差异的改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Word Similarity Datasets for Indian Languages: Annotation and Baseline Systems
papers.abstract_en: With the advent of word representations, word similarity tasks are becoming increasing popular as an evaluation metric for the quality of the representations. In this paper, we present manually annotated monolingual word similarity datasets of six Indian languages - Urdu, Telugu, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil and Gujarati. These languages are most spoken Indian languages worldwide after Hindi and Bengali. For the construction of these datasets, our approach relies on translation and re-annotation of word similarity datasets of English. We also present baseline scores for word representation models using state-of-the-art techniques for Urdu, Telugu and Marathi by evaluating them on newly created word similarity datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、古吉拉特语六种印度语言的人工标注单语词相似度数据集，做法是把英语词相似度数据集翻译后再重新标注。并给出词表示模型在乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语上的基线分数。
Motivation: 词相似度是评价词表示质量的常用指标，但印度主要语言缺少可用的单语词相似度评测集。
Method: 以英语词相似度数据集为源，经翻译加人工重新标注 (translation and re-annotation) 构建六种语言的单语数据集，并用当前主流词表示技术在其中三种语言上跑基线。
Result: 产出 Urdu、Telugu、Marathi、Punjabi、Tamil、Gujarati 六语种人工标注词相似度数据集，并报告 Urdu、Telugu、Marathi 上词表示模型的基线分数。
Conclusion: 翻译加重标注可以低成本扩展印度语言的词相似度评测资源，配套基线为后续词表示模型提供对照。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: You Can't Have It Both Ways: Concept Entanglement Limits Diffusion Model Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress a target concept (e.g., \texttt{horse}) while preserving related but distinct content (e.g., \texttt{donkey}), yet existing methods either leak under indirect prompts or visibly degrade other concepts. We show that these failure modes stem from the geometry of concept representations rather than from any particular algorithm. Formalizing concepts as activation-space regions, we prove that the overlap between a target and other concepts lower-bounds the damage any robust erasure must inflict on them, with the trade-off scaling linearly in the degree of overlap. Across thirteen unlearning methods, including methods designed to preserve non-target concepts, no method achieves both strong erasure and strong neighbor preservation: STEREO nearly eliminates indirect leakage but cuts neighbor generation by more than 75\%, while sparse inference-time methods preserve neighbors but leak. Damage increases with our overlap measure, monotonically so for STEREO; the $κ$-scaling reproduces on SDXL, and neighbor-selective damage recurs on FLUX. Perfect unlearning is the wrong target for entangled concepts; methods should be evaluated on the Pareto frontier our theorem establishes.
papers.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除存在几何性权衡：目标概念与相邻概念在激活空间的重叠度下界了任何稳健擦除必然造成的相邻概念损伤，且该权衡随重叠度线性（κ-scaling）增长。在十三种遗忘方法上，STERIO 几乎消除间接泄漏但使相邻概念生成下降超过 75%，稀疏推理时方法保住邻居却泄漏；κ-scaling 在 SDXL 上复现，邻居选择性损伤在 FLUX 上重现。
Motivation: 概念遗忘方法要么在间接提示下泄漏目标概念，要么明显损伤相关但不同的内容；作者指出失败源于概念表征的几何结构而非具体算法。
Method: 把概念形式化为激活空间区域，证明目标与其它概念的重叠度给出稳健擦除对邻居造成损伤的下界，权衡随重叠度线性；在十三种遗忘方法（含专为保护非目标概念设计的方法）上用该重叠度度量检验损伤关系。
Result: 十三种方法中无一同时实现强擦除与强邻居保护：STERIO 几乎消除间接泄漏但邻居生成下降超过 75%，稀疏推理时方法保留邻居但泄漏；损伤随重叠度度量增大，对 STERIO 单调；κ-scaling 在 SDXL 上复现，邻居选择性损伤在 FLUX 上重现。
Conclusion: 对纠缠概念而言完美遗忘是错误目标，方法应在该定理确立的 Pareto 前沿上被评估。

papers.title: Waggle: Learning One Anonymous Local Law for Self-Organizing LLM Swarms
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly collaborate on complex tasks, how to organize their interactions becomes a central design question. Existing multi-agent systems typically learn or adapt explicit roles, hierarchies, routing policies, or communication topologies. We shift the learning target to a reusable local law that can be shared across interchangeable agents and adapt coordination as populations or interaction conditions change, without redefining a global organization. We introduce Waggle, a shared anonymous policy over bounded local views that jointly selects task actions, semantic communication, and local commitment updates. Repeated execution of the same law allows coordination to form, persist, and reorganize online without explicit roles or global topology. To learn this law across interchangeable agents and evolving coordination, we develop Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD), combining anonymous-orbit consistency with rollout-grounded prediction of the next local coordination field, with no added inference-time components. Across diverse coordination settings, the same learned law remains effective as populations and interaction budgets change, retains over 96% of substrate-specific oracle quality, and transfers without retraining; SCD further improves reorganization after counterevidence. Together, these results show that LLM-agent organization can emerge and adapt through repeated execution of a learned local law.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Waggle 把多智能体组织从显式角色/层级/拓扑改为一条可复用的匿名局部律：共享匿名策略在有界局部视图上同时选任务动作、语义通信与局部承诺更新，靠重复执行让协调自发形成与重组。用 Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD) 学到的同一条律在种群与交互预算变化时仍保持有效，保留超过 96% 的 substrate-specific oracle 质量且免重训迁移。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统靠学习显式角色、层级、路由策略或通信拓扑来组织交互，种群规模或交互条件一变就得重新定义全局组织。
Method: 提出共享匿名策略（anonymous policy），在有界局部视图上联合输出任务动作、语义通信与局部承诺更新，不引入显式角色或全局拓扑；用 Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD) 学习该律，结合 anonymous-orbit consistency 与 rollout-grounded 的下一局部协调场预测，推理时不增加额外组件。
Result: 在多种协调设置下，同一条学到的律在种群规模与交互预算变化时保持有效，保留超过 96% 的 substrate-specific oracle 质量并免重训迁移；SCD 进一步改善了出现反证 (counterevidence) 之后的重组。
Conclusion: LLM 智能体的组织可以通过反复执行一条学到的局部律而涌现并自适应，无需显式角色或全局拓扑；跨 substrate 迁移不必重训。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evo2Team: When Do Evolved Skills Transfer? From Selection to Deployment
papers.abstract_en: A skill bank that helps one multi-agent system may leave another's behavior unchanged. A transferred rule helps only when target agents act on it successfully. We study this path for routing and communication skills in Count-Frequency and AgentsNet, using teams of 4--32 agents and GPT and Qwen model ladders. Source evolution meets a joint quality, cost, model-tier, and confirmation goal in 14 of 16 settings. We then evaluate Evo2Team, which selects, adapts, and confirms source skills for the target team, alongside six frozen selectors across 28 transfer directions. Evo2Team's target-side exploration cost is below that of evolving a new target bank in every direction, even when reused reference evaluations are charged once. Twenty of 28 held-out outcomes meet the positive-transfer criterion, including three saved diagnostic tests. Selection alone does not explain these outcomes: KNN and CORAL choose different banks in two AgentsNet directions but produce identical recorded executions. When Evo2Team changes execution, gains can reach many tasks, as in a Count-Frequency direction that improves 28 of 32 tasks over KNN. Seven positive AgentsNet outcomes save 6.1--14.6\% in deployment cost while using transferred skills on only three to six of fifteen tasks. In five earlier accepted directions, all 22 task records using transferred skills pass three fixed-graph confirmations, but four fail in recorded executions on new graphs. Graphs and model responses change together in this comparison. These results show that skill transfer must be assessed through the actions agents take, the tasks those actions reach, and the quality and cost of the final deployment.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 一个对某个多智能体系统有效的技能库可能对另一个系统毫无作用，而现有迁移评估只看选择器选中了哪个库，不看目标智能体是否真的按该规则行动。

papers.title: StateGuard: Analytical-State Management with Validity-Aware Intervention for Long-Horizon Data Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities in automated data analysis and are increasingly moving toward long-horizon, multi-stage analytical workflows. However, as the analytical process evolves, constraints, variables, and conclusions remain implicitly embedded in interaction histories, making it difficult for agents to track which analytical artifacts remain valid over increasingly long horizons and changing dependencies. Consequently, stale artifacts may be silently inherited, propagating errors to downstream stages. To address this challenge, we propose StateGuard, an analytical-state validity management framework for long-horizon data agents. StateGuard externalizes evolving analytical progress into a state graph containing constraints, versioned variables, intermediate conclusions, and cross-state relations, treating each state as an executable, verifiable, and traceable object rather than textual memory alone. StateGuard maintains state validity through evidence-grounded verification and hierarchical intervention. To equip StateGuard with these capabilities, we first introduce Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision, which constructs 3K state-centric trajectories through counterfactual runtime synthesis to fine-tune StateGuard for state maintenance, verification, and repair. We then apply Validity-Guided Policy Optimization, using runtime validity evidence to provide fine-grained learning signals for protocol correctness, state grounding, and intervention quality. Experiments on three diverse long-horizon data-analysis benchmarks show that StateGuard consistently improves data-agent performance while reducing dependency-induced downstream error propagation, demonstrating the advantages of explicit analytical-state management for reliable long-horizon data analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StateGuard 把长程数据分析 agent 的中间产物外化成含约束、版本化变量、结论与跨状态关系的 state graph，用证据支撑的验证与分层干预判定每个状态是否仍有效，避免过期产物被静默继承并沿依赖链放大误差。用 Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision 构造 3K 条状态中心轨迹微调，再以 Validity-Guided Policy Optimization 用运行时有效性证据给细粒度学习信号，在三个长程数据分析基准上一致提升数据 agent 表现并减少依赖导致的下游误差传播。
Motivation: 长程多阶段分析中，约束、变量与结论隐含在交互历史里，agent 难以判断哪些分析产物在依赖变化后仍然有效，过期状态被静默继承会把误差传播到下游阶段。
Method: 将分析进度外化为 state graph（约束、版本化变量、中间结论、跨状态关系），每个状态是可执行、可验证、可追溯的对象；以证据支撑的验证 (evidence-grounded verification) 与分层干预 (hierarchical intervention) 维护有效性。训练分两步：Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision 通过反事实运行时合成构造 3K 条状态中心轨迹微调状态维护、验证与修复能力；再用 Validity-Guided Policy Optimization 以运行时有效性证据提供针对协议正确性、状态落地与干预质量的细粒度学习信号。
Result: 在三个多样的长程数据分析基准上，StateGuard 一致提升数据 agent 性能，并降低依赖导致的下游误差传播；训练用了 3K 条反事实合成的状态中心轨迹。
Conclusion: 显式的分析状态管理（状态图 + 有效性驱动的验证与干预）比纯文本记忆更适合长程数据 agent，能同时提高性能并抑制误差沿依赖链传播。

papers.title: PrefLUT: Reusable and Refinable Personalized Color Editing from Pairwise Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Photographic color editing is inherently personal: the same image can appear too warm, too muted, or already satisfactory to different users. Most lookup table (LUT) and reference-guided methods target a specified appearance rather than model persistent preferences from repeated user choices. To address this gap, we introduce PrefLUT, a reusable and refinable user-preference modeling framework for deployable 3D LUTs, encoding ordered preferred/non-preferred image pairs into a lightweight Reusable User Profile that is reused across queries and refined using additional user preference pairs, without per-user optimization. A Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor combines this profile with each image to predict a LUT latent vector and edit strength. An Identity-Residual LUT Decoder and Edit-Strength Controller then produce an exportable 3D LUT. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate effective personalized editing and general-purpose enhancement. Each quantized profile requires only 260 bytes, and editing takes 1.365 ms/image on an RTX 5090 GPU. We also introduce the Preference-Conditioning Verification Protocol (PCVP), an evaluation protocol to verify whether personalized image edits depend on user preferences and the query image through controlled changes to user profiles, preference orders, pair correspondences, and query images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrefLUT 把用户成对偏好（preferred/non-preferred 图像对）编码成仅 260 字节的可复用用户画像，由 Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor 结合查询图像预测 LUT 潜变量与编辑强度，再经 Identity-Residual LUT Decoder 输出可导出的 3D LUT，无需逐用户优化。在三个数据集上展示个性化编辑与通用增强，RTX 5090 上每张图 1.365 ms。
Motivation: 现有 LUT 与参考引导方法面向指定外观目标，不建模用户在反复选择中体现的持久偏好，同一图像对不同用户可能过暖、过淡或已满意。
Method: 将有序偏好图像对编码为 Reusable User Profile，可跨查询复用并用新增偏好对精修；Query-Conditioned LUT Predictor 融合画像与图像预测 LUT 潜向量和编辑强度，Identity-Residual LUT Decoder 与 Edit-Strength Controller 生成可导出 3D LUT；另提出 Preference-Conditioning Verification Protocol (PCVP)，通过受控改变用户画像、偏好顺序、配对对应与查询图像来验证编辑是否真正依赖偏好与查询。
Result: 在三个数据集上展示有效的个性化编辑与通用增强；每个量化画像仅 260 字节，RTX 5090 GPU 上编辑耗时 1.365 ms/图；提出 PCVP 协议用于核验编辑对用户偏好与查询图像的依赖。
Conclusion: 偏好画像加查询条件化的 3D LUT 预测可做到可复用、可精修且部署轻量，个性化色彩编辑无需逐用户优化；PCVP 提供了检验编辑是否真依赖偏好的受控评测路径。

papers.title: From Attack Success to Attack Severity: Counterfactual Memory Attacks on LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent memory for long-horizon and personalized behavior, they can retain and reuse information across interactions, but this also creates a lasting channel through which malicious memory writes can influence future behavior. Persistent-memory attacks are typically evaluated by whether they succeed, yet successful attacks can leave persistent states with substantially different downstream consequences. We study this severity as a distinct attack-design objective and formalize it with counterfactual memory regret (CMR), the paired increase in expected downstream loss relative to clean memory. We introduce MemHarm, which predeclares a finite class of sparse, grounded semantic edits, evaluates candidates through the normal agent memory interface using offline paired-loss feedback, and certifies resolved selections within that class. Compared with attack-success optimization, CMR-guided selection produces substantially larger downstream loss while retaining most of the success-rate gain. Across two agent benchmarks and diverse memory designs, MemHarm attains the highest CMR point estimates among the evaluated general attacks on identical support. Factor-removal interventions link this harm to the selected semantic factor, and native-agent deployments verify the write-to-fresh-process attack path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM agent 持久记忆攻击只看是否成功、不看后果差异的问题，提出以反事实记忆遗憾 (CMR) 作为攻击设计目标，并给出 MemHarm：在有限的稀疏语义编辑类中用离线配对损失筛选并认证选择。在两个 agent benchmark 与多种记忆设计上，CMR 导向的选择在保留大部分成功率增益的同时带来显著更大的下游损失，且在相同支撑集上取得所评估通用攻击中最高的 CMR 点估计。
Motivation: 持久记忆让恶意写入可跨交互影响后续行为，但现有评估只用攻击是否成功作二值判定，成功攻击留下的持久状态在下游后果上差异很大，缺少把危害程度本身当作设计目标的度量。
Method: 形式化 CMR（相对干净记忆的期望下游损失配对增量）；MemHarm 预声明一类有限的稀疏、有据语义编辑 (sparse grounded semantic edits)，通过 agent 正常记忆接口评估候选，用离线配对损失反馈 (offline paired-loss feedback) 选择，并在该类内认证所选编辑；再用因子移除干预 (factor-removal interventions) 归因危害。
Result: 在两个 agent benchmark 和多种记忆设计上，CMR 导向选择比攻击成功优化产生显著更大的下游损失，同时保留大部分成功率增益；MemHarm 在相同支撑集上取得所评估通用攻击中最高的 CMR 点估计；因子移除干预把危害关联到所选语义因子，原生 agent 部署验证了写入到新进程的攻击路径。
Conclusion: 攻击严重度应作为独立于攻击成功率的设计目标来优化，且在有限语义编辑类内可被度量、选择与认证。

papers.title: Training and Inference Dynamics of PLDR-LLMs: Row-Map Collapse, Renormalization, and Predictive Reduction
papers.abstract_en: This monograph develops a unified account of training and inference in Power Law Decoder Representation language models (PLDR-LLMs). Exact finite work identities decompose changes in the absolute energy of the row-centered learned map into parameter contributions, signed interactions, and numerical observation defects. Positive affine blocking retains restarts at the row-constant face, while the augmented AdamW state supplies the complete dynamical description. Predictive renormalization acts on the complete conditional training law for a single pass over distinct corpus target blocks, retaining optimizer memory, remaining data, schedule, and numerical policy. Autonomous reductions require closure; approximate reductions carry successor and emission errors. Finite-population covariance, matched physical clocks, matrix fluxes, and signed temporal energy connect row dynamics to model-wide observations. Absolute row collapse, relative row concentration, operator stabilization, and predictive accuracy are distinguished. Experiments reveal observer and optimizer dependence, reject the tested autonomous row-state candidates, and support finite conditional prediction and state-specific operator reduction. Independent single-pass families exhibit moving finite fluctuation regions without establishing a thermodynamic critical class. Conditional symmetry, head limits, covariance flows, and readout error budgets specify assumptions needed to transfer scaling laws to inference. The theory separates exact identities, conditional dynamical claims, and finite empirical findings, with proofs, selected formal checks, and compact numerical evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本 655 页的专著，用精确有限工作恒等式把 PLDR-LLM 中 row-centered 学习映射的能量变化分解为参数贡献、带符号交互与数值观测缺陷，并给出保留优化器记忆与数据余量的 predictive renormalization 单遍条件训练律。实验否定了所测试的自治 row-state 候选，支持有限条件预测与 state-specific 算子化简，同时指出独立单遍族只呈现移动的有限涨落区、未确立热力学临界类。
Motivation: PLDR-LLM 的训练与推理动力学缺少统一的有限时间描述：row 状态的绝对塌缩、相对集中、算子稳定与预测精度常被混为一谈，缩放律迁移到推理时所需假设也未被明确。
Method: 以精确有限工作恒等式分解 row-centered 映射绝对能量变化（参数项、带符号交互、数值观测缺陷），配合保留 row-constant face 重启的 positive affine blocking 与提供完整动力学描述的 augmented AdamW 状态；predictive renormalization 作用于单遍 distinct corpus target blocks 的完整条件训练律，自治化简需闭合、近似化简带 successor 与 emission 误差；再用有限总体协方差、匹配物理时钟、matrix flux 与带符号时间能量把 row 动力学接到模型级观测。
Result: 实验显示观测者与优化器依赖，拒绝了所测试的自治 row-state 候选，支持有限条件预测与 state-specific 算子化简；独立单遍族呈现移动的有限涨落区但未确立热力学临界类。全书含 76 幅图、311 张表，并区分精确恒等式、条件动力学论断与有限经验发现。
Conclusion: 缩放律要迁移到推理，必须显式给出条件对称、head 极限、covariance flows 与 readout 误差预算等假设；row 动力学的绝对塌缩与相对集中是不同现象，不能用单一自治 row-state 候选概括。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: STITCH-RAG: Spatio-Temporal Influence Tracing over Topic Hypergraphs for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation requires a retriever to connect evidence distributed across documents while preserving a concise, faithful generation context. Existing indexes leave two complementary gaps: chunk-based RAG can break cross-passage evidence chains, whereas an unlabeled pairwise projection without generating-topic provenance cannot jointly preserve topic-level co-participation and per-occurrence entity descriptions. We propose STITCH-RAG, a hypergraph-based framework with three coupled components. First, a semi-merged topic hypergraph encodes multi-entity co-participation as topic-summary hyperedges while retaining per-chunk entity states linked by canonical-name equivalence. Second, spatio-temporal influence bridging propagation (STIBP) combines topic-space propagation with deterministic chunk-index linkage across name-equivalent states under frequency-adaptive decay. Third, continuous STIBP scores replace binary entity-match seeds in localized Personalized PageRank (PPR). We characterize the condition under which this prior assigns more PPR mass to ground-truth evidence than a binary prior. Under the reported protocol, STITCH-RAG attains the highest reported Contain-Acc and LLM-Acc point estimates among the compared methods on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA, and higher Recall@8 than the methods included in the standardized retrieval comparison. Results on the mixed-domain benchmark remain auxiliary preference-based evidence because only LLM-judged accuracy is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STITCH-RAG 用超图索引做多跳 RAG 检索：半合并主题超图保留多实体共现与逐 chunk 实体状态，STIBP 传播给出连续分数替代二元实体匹配种子喂给 Personalized PageRank。在 HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 上取得所比较方法中最高的 Contain-Acc 与 LLM-Acc 点估计，以及高于标准化检索对比方法的 Recall@8。
Motivation: chunk 式 RAG 会切断跨段落证据链，而无标注的成对投影缺少生成主题来源信息，无法同时保留主题级共现与逐次出现的实体描述。
Method: 三个耦合组件：半合并主题超图把多实体共现编码为主题摘要超边并保留经规范名等价链接的逐 chunk 实体状态；spatio-temporal influence bridging propagation (STIBP) 在主题空间传播并按频率自适应衰减做确定性 chunk 索引链接；连续 STIBP 分数替换二元实体匹配种子进入 localized Personalized PageRank (PPR)，并给出该先验比二元先验分配更多 PPR 质量给真实证据的条件刻画。
Result: 在所比较方法中 HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 上取得最高的 Contain-Acc 与 LLM-Acc 点估计，Recall@8 高于纳入标准化检索对比的方法；混合领域基准上仅有 LLM 判分精度，结果作为辅助的偏好性证据。
Conclusion: 带主题来源的超图索引配合连续传播分数作 PPR 先验，能在多跳问答上同时保住证据链与检索召回；混合领域结论只由 LLM 判分支撑，属辅助证据。

papers.title: JET: Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time for Agent Programs
papers.abstract_en: An agent's executable program governs how it uses tools, processes observations, and responds to failures. Evolving this program at test time can help adaptation, but deciding which changes to retain is difficult when true rewards are unavailable. Execution traces provide evidence of agent behavior, yet interpreting that evidence requires a judge that remains useful as tasks and candidate programs change. We introduce Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time (JET), which evolves an executable judge on labeled source trajectories, then freezes and transfers it to guide target-side program evolution. The judge supplies scores and diagnostic feedback without target evaluator access or model-weight updates. On unseen WebShop tasks, JET achieves approximately 13% higher mean reward than fixed-rubric guidance when evolution begins from an unevolved program (cold start) and 4% higher when it begins from one already optimized on source tasks (warm start), with a 36% relative improvement in cold-start exact success. An exact-judge control on PushT, where the judge reconstructs the scoring rule from observations, shows that without judge error, program search becomes the bottleneck. Analyses identify useful reward-prediction logic in the evolved code and show that better final selection alone cannot explain the gains. These results support executable judge transfer for program adaptation under evaluator-preserving task shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JET 在测试时演化一个可执行 judge：先在带标注的源轨迹上进化 judge 代码，再冻结并迁移到目标任务去指导 agent 程序演化，全程不访问目标侧 evaluator、不更新模型权重。在未见过的 WebShop 任务上，冷启动时平均奖励比固定 rubric 指导高约 13%，热启动高 4%，冷启动 exact success 相对提升 36%。
Motivation: 测试时演化 agent 可执行程序需要判断哪些改动该保留，但真实 reward 不可得；执行轨迹虽含行为证据，随着任务与候选程序变化，固定评分规则会失效。
Method: 在带标注的源轨迹上用进化方式得到可执行 judge，随后冻结并迁移到目标侧，由它对候选程序的执行轨迹打分并给出诊断性反馈，以此驱动目标程序演化；不访问目标 evaluator，也不做模型权重更新。
Result: 在未见过的 WebShop 任务上，冷启动（从未经演化的程序出发）平均奖励比固定 rubric 指导高约 13%，热启动（从已在源任务优化过的程序出发）高 4%，冷启动 exact success 相对提升 36%。在 PushT 上的 exact-judge 对照中，judge 从观测重建打分规则，结果显示没有 judge 误差时程序搜索本身成为瓶颈；分析还发现演化出的代码里存在有用的 reward 预测逻辑，且仅靠更好的最终选择无法解释这些增益。
Conclusion: 在 evaluator 保持不变的任务迁移下，可执行 judge 的迁移能有效支撑程序适配；当 judge 无误差时，瓶颈转移到程序搜索本身。
