papers.title: SpatialSkill: Self-Evolving Skills for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view spatial reasoning requires a model to align different viewpoints into a coherent spatial representation, yet this ability remains challenging for vision-language models despite being natural to humans. Existing methods typically improve spatial reasoning by updating model weights, which keeps the acquired knowledge implicit and tied to a specific backbone. We propose \textit{SpatialSkill}, a weight-update-free framework that enables a frozen vision-language model to accumulate explicit natural-language reasoning skills from offline trajectories. Unlike symbolic tasks, perceptual skills cannot be reliably verified simply by executing them: a plausible spatial rule may lack visual support or require transformations that the frozen model cannot perform. SpatialSkill therefore admits candidate skills only after visual-grounding and executability checks, constrains manual evolution to prevent harmful regressions, and routes skills by spatial-reasoning category to reduce negative transfer. On CityCube, across four frozen executors, SpatialSkill yields consistent gains, and a 9B executor equipped with SpatialSkill surpasses the strongest closed-source reference in our evaluation. The skills are stored in a versioned natural-language manual, making the reasoning strategies explicit and auditable without modifying model parameters. Code at https://github.com/vindahi/SpatialSkill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpatialSkill 让冻结的视觉-语言模型从离线轨迹中累积显式的自然语言空间推理技能，不更新权重：候选技能须通过视觉接地与可执行性检查才被接纳，并按空间推理类别路由以减少负迁移。在 CityCube 上对四个冻结 executor 均带来一致增益，配备该技能库的 9B executor 超越评测中最强的闭源参考模型。
Motivation: 跨视角空间推理对视觉-语言模型仍然困难，而现有方法靠更新权重提升，知识是隐式的且绑定特定 backbone，无法审计也无法迁移。
Method: 面向冻结 VLM 的免权重更新框架：从离线轨迹抽取候选自然语言技能，经视觉接地 (visual-grounding) 与可执行性两道检查后入库；对人工演化加约束以防有害回退，并按空间推理类别路由技能。技能存入带版本号的自然语言手册。
Result: 在 CityCube 上，对四个冻结 executor 均取得一致增益；配备 SpatialSkill 的 9B executor 超越评测中最强的闭源参考模型。
Conclusion: 把空间推理策略外化为可版本管理、可审计的显式技能手册，比改权重更能在冻结 backbone 上积累与复用知识。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What Does a Stream Model Buy You in Flow Matching?
papers.abstract_en: Stream-level flow matching replaces the linear interpolant of conditional flow matching (CFM) by a Gaussian-process (GP) stream connecting each source--target pair, and reports lower sample error than \icfm{} on 2-Gaussian, MNIST and CIFAR-10 benchmarks. We ask what such a stream model actually contributes. Three results answer the question. (i)~\emph{Reduction.} The stream-level CFM objective depends on the stream law only through the per-time joint law of $(s_t,\sdot_t)$, so the conditional paths a Gaussian stream can reach are exactly the Gaussian conditional paths CFM already parametrises; in the coordinate-wise, shared-scalar-kernel construction gpcfm actually uses, the entire design space collapses to two scalar curves $(m_t,v_t)$, and cross-time covariance affects only estimator variance. (ii)~\emph{The GP is a constrained chart of that space.} One kernel sets both $m_t$ and $v_t$, so the paper's own recipe for widening coverage-shrinking the SE length-scale---destroys the interpolant (the midpoint mean weight falls from $1.03$ to $0.00$). On the 2-Gaussian benchmark this makes the GP chart diverge on $15/200$ runs at high coverage against $0/200$ for a decoupled $(m_t,v_t)$ chart ($p=6.6\times10^{-5}$), and crossing the two curves shows the divergence tracks the mean, not the variance. On MNIST the same sweep does not diverge and the ordering reverses, so whether the coupling is harmful is benchmark-dependent; what holds on both is that the recipe buys nothing---no coverage level beats the paper's own, and past $\max_t\sqrt{v_t}\approx0.6$ both charts degrade. (iii)~\emph{Audit.} The released code does not implement the mechanism it describes: state and velocity are drawn independently ($\mathrm{corr}=0.00\pm0.01$ against an intended $\pm0.83$--$0.99$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇 cs.LG 论文把 stream-level flow matching 的贡献拆成三件事：其目标函数只通过 (s_t, ṡ_t) 的逐时刻联合律依赖 stream law，因此高斯流可达的条件路径恰是 CFM 已参数化的高斯路径，在 gpcfm 的逐坐标共享标量核构造下整个设计空间塌缩为两条标量曲线 (m_t, v_t)，跨时间协方差只影响估计量方差。作者进一步指出单一核同时决定 m_t 与 v_t，按原论文缩小 SE length-scale 扩覆盖的配方会破坏插值：中点均值权重从 1.03 跌到 0.00，2-Gaussian 高覆盖下 GP chart 在 15/200 次运行发散而解耦 (m_t, v_t) chart 为 0/200（p=6.6×10⁻⁵）。审计还发现发布代码中状态与速度独立采样，相关系数 0.00±0.01，而设计意图是 ±0.83–0.99。
Motivation: stream-level flow matching 报告比 conditional flow matching (CFM) 更低的样本误差，但该改进究竟来自 stream law 本身、来自参数化约束、还是来自实现细节，此前没有被拆开；这决定了是否值得为 GP stream 引入额外复杂度。
Method: 先做归约分析：证明 stream-level CFM 目标只通过逐时刻 (s_t, ṡ_t) 联合律依赖 stream law，并在 gpcfm 的逐坐标、共享标量核构造下把设计空间化简为 (m_t, v_t) 两条标量曲线。再把 GP 视为该空间的受约束 chart，用缩放 SE length-scale 的覆盖度扫描在 2-Gaussian 与 MNIST 上对比 GP chart 与解耦 (m_t, v_t) chart，并交叉互换两条曲线定位发散来源。最后审计发布代码中状态与速度的采样相关性。
Result: 归约结果：GP 可达的条件路径恰为 CFM 已参数化的高斯路径，跨时间协方差只影响估计量方差。缩放 SE length-scale 使中点均值权重从 1.03 降到 0.00；2-Gaussian 高覆盖下 GP chart 发散 15/200 次运行，解耦 chart 为 0/200（p=6.6×10⁻⁵），交叉互换显示发散跟随均值而非方差。MNIST 上同一扫描不发散且排序反转；两基准共同的是没有覆盖度优于原论文自身设置，且超过 max_t √v_t ≈ 0.6 后两种 chart 都退化。代码审计：状态与速度独立采样，corr = 0.00±0.01，设计意图为 ±0.83–0.99。

papers.title: Probabilistic electrical power demand forecasting with uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract_en: The majority of research on electricity consumption forecasting has focused on deterministic approaches, which generate a single point estimate for each time step in the forecasting horizon. However, the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources and the growing complexity of modern smart grids have introduced greater variability and uncertainty into power-system demand and operation. Consequently, probabilistic forecasting, which quantifies the uncertainty and variability associated with future electricity demand, is becoming increasingly important for reliable power-system planning and operation. This study presents an empirical comparison of four contemporary probabilistic forecasting models for electricity consumption, highlighting their respective strengths and limitations. We have performed comparision on real-world power systems related datasets. Across all power-consumption zones, NGBoost demonstrates superior probabilistic forecasting performance, achieving the lowest MAE and RMSE while providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates with high prediction-interval coverage and reasonably narrow intervals. These results indicate that NGBoost offers a more accurate and reliable forecasting framework than Bayesian, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout, and Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) models for the considered electricity consumption data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对电力需求做概率预测的实证对比：在真实电力系统数据集上比较 NGBoost、Bayesian、MC Dropout 与 GPR 四类模型，NGBoost 在所有用电分区上取得最低 MAE 与 RMSE，且预测区间覆盖率高、区间宽度合理，优于其余三种方法。
Motivation: 既有电力消费预测研究多为确定性点估计，而可再生能源渗透与智能电网复杂度上升使需求与运行的不确定性增大，点预测不足以支撑可靠规划与运行。
Method: 实证对比四种概率预测模型：NGBoost、Bayesian 方法、MC Dropout、Gaussian Process Regression (GPR)，在真实电力系统相关数据集上按用电分区比较，评估指标为 MAE、RMSE 与预测区间覆盖率/区间宽度。
Result: 在全部用电分区上 NGBoost 取得最低 MAE 与 RMSE，同时给出校准良好的不确定性估计：预测区间覆盖率高且区间宽度合理；相较 Bayesian、MC Dropout 与 GPR 更准确可靠。
Conclusion: 对所考虑的电力消费数据，NGBoost 比 Bayesian、MC Dropout 和 GPR 提供更准确可靠的概率预测框架，是该场景下的推荐选择。

papers.title: SlimWise: Decoupling Expert Pruning Across Prefill and Decode for Efficient MoE Serving
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate few experts per token, yet batched decoding can access nearly the entire expert pool, making expert-weight traffic a major bottleneck. Expert pruning reduces this traffic, but conventional approaches also prune compute-bound prefill, sacrificing model quality for little throughput benefit. We present SlimWise, a serving framework that tailors the expert pool to each inference phase. SlimWise performs prefill with the full model and decode with a pruned model that directly reuses the prefill-generated KV cache without conversion. Across two MoE backbones and three pruning criteria, this training-free KV cache handoff substantially narrows accuracy gaps relative to the full model in many settings. We also show that benchmark accuracy can conceal substantial pruning-induced changes in generation length. To address these distortions and residual accuracy loss, SlimWise introduces a low-cost distillation stage that trains the decoder to continue from full-model KV caches while updating only a small subset of parameters. Implemented in vLLM, SlimWise supports both prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation and PD-colocated serving. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, SlimWise improves decode throughput by up to 1.81x at 50% expert pruning with minimal accuracy loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SlimWise 把 MoE 专家剪枝按推理阶段解耦：prefill 用全模型，decode 用剪裁后的专家池并直接复用 prefill 生成的 KV cache，无需转换。该 training-free 的 KV cache 交接在两个 MoE 主干、三种剪枝准则下大幅缩小与全模型的精度差距；再加一个只更新少量参数的低成本蒸馏阶段，纠正剪枝引起的生成长度变化。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，50% 专家剪枝时 decode 吞吐最高提升 1.81x，精度损失极小。
Motivation: 批量 decode 会触及几乎整个专家池，专家权重访存成为主要瓶颈；而常规专家剪枝同时砍掉 compute-bound 的 prefill，牺牲模型质量却几乎换不来吞吐。
Method: Serving 框架按阶段定制专家池：prefill 走全模型，decode 走剪枝模型并直接复用 prefill 生成的 KV cache（无需转换）；针对残余精度损失与生成长度失真，加入低成本蒸馏阶段，让 decoder 从全模型 KV cache 继续生成，只更新一小部分参数。实现于 vLLM，支持 PD 分离与 PD 同置两种服务方式。
Result: 在两个 MoE 主干、三种剪枝准则下，training-free 的 KV cache 交接在多数设置中大幅缩小与全模型的精度差距；在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，50% 专家剪枝时 decode 吞吐最高提升 1.81x，精度损失极小。另发现基准精度会掩盖剪枝引起的生成长度大幅变化。
Conclusion: prefill 与 decode 应使用不同大小的专家池：prefill 保全模型、decode 剪枝并直接复用 KV cache，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著提高 decode 吞吐；评估剪枝时不能只看基准精度，还要看生成长度变化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Forecast-Necessary Causal Discovery for Nonlinear Political Panel Data: Feedback, Functional Form, and the Dynamics of Democratization
papers.abstract_en: A non-significant coefficient in a dynamic panel model need not imply the absence of a relationship. It may instead reflect heterogeneous effects averaged toward zero, reciprocal dynamics overlooked by a recursive specification, or relationships masked by the omission of correlated covariates. Standard linear estimators cannot distinguish among these possibilities. We develop an inferential workflow for political panel data that resolves this ambiguity by combining flexible autoregressive estimation, forecast-necessity testing, functional characterization, and same-data linear benchmarking. The workflow first identifies relationships required for out-of-sample prediction, then characterizes their functional form across political contexts, and finally, distinguishes differences arising from estimator flexibility from those due to model specification. Applied to the causal sequence model of democratization on the V-Dem panel of 113 countries, the workflow reproduces the model's central finding - the protective belt of civil society, the rule of law, and institutionalized parties - while recovering reciprocal relationships from democracy to its institutional supports that a linear model cannot detect. Most importantly, three weak published direct effects, of which two are null, and one is marginally significant, receive three different diagnoses: one dissolves under the full specification, one reflects heterogeneous effects averaged toward zero, and one was masked by the reduced variable set. The workflow corrects the published record in both directions, removing one relationship and recovering two. More broadly, the workflow provides a framework for evaluating dynamic political theories under a model class capable of representing nonlinear and reciprocal mechanisms while preserving relationship-level interpretation and explicit inferential standards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向动态面板的 forecast-necessary 因果发现流程：先用灵活自回归估计找出对样本外预测必需的关系，再刻画其函数形式，最后用同数据线性基准区分估计器灵活性与模型设定造成的差异。在 V-Dem 113 国民主化序列模型上，它复现了公民社会、法治与制度化政党的保护带，同时检出线性模型看不到的从民主到制度支撑的互惠关系，并对三个已发表弱效应给出三种不同诊断：删除一个、恢复两个。
Motivation: 动态面板中不显著系数可能来自异质效应被平均抵消、递归设定漏掉的互惠关系或遗漏相关协变量，标准线性估计器无法区分这三种情形，导致已发表的因果结论可正可错。
Method: 流程分四步：灵活自回归估计、forecast-necessity 检验（关系是否为样本外预测所必需）、跨政治情境的函数形式刻画、同数据线性基准对照；应用对象是 V-Dem 113 国面板上的民主化因果序列模型。
Result: 复现了公民社会、法治与制度化政党这一保护带的核心发现，并恢复出线性模型检测不到的从民主到其制度支撑的互惠关系；三个已发表的弱直接效应（两个为 null、一个仅边缘显著）被诊断为三种不同情形：一个在完整设定下消失、一个源于被平均至零的异质效应、一个被缩减变量集所掩盖，最终删除一个关系、恢复两个。
Conclusion: 对动态政治理论的评估应使用能同时表示非线性与互惠机制、且保留关系级解释与显式推断标准的模型类；按此流程，已发表记录可在两个方向上被纠正。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Evolution of fairness in multi-objective reinforcement learning framework
papers.abstract_en: Fairness, as a fundamental social norm, continues to pose a longstanding puzzle regarding its emergence. Traditional game-theoretic models largely rely on the assumption of \emph{Homo economicus}, wherein individuals are purely rational and self-interested, acting solely to maximize material payoffs. Such accounts, however, overlook the multidimensional nature of human decision-making, which is often shaped also by other considerations beyond economic incentives. To address this gap, we propose a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that models the evolution of fairness as a dynamic trade-off between material payoff maximization and fairness-driven moral behavior, regulated by a fairness pressure coefficient. Using simulations of a two-objective Q-learning ultimatum game, we find that increased fairness pressure promotes fair outcomes, as expected. Strikingly, however, under moderate pressure, responder behavior reverses: responders become ``forgiving" by accepting low offers -- a pattern in line with our daily experience. Microscopic analyses reveal that this strategy reversal stems from competition between payoff-maximizing and fairness-oriented preferences. We further extend our framework to an asymmetric setting, where proposers and responders assign different weights to the two objectives. Overall, our work expands the reinforcement learning paradigm from a single-objective to a multi-objective formulation, offering a versatile tool for elucidating a broader range of human social behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用多目标强化学习把公平性建模为物质收益最大化与公平导向道德行为之间的动态权衡，由公平压力系数调节；在双目标 Q-learning 最后通牒博弈模拟中，压力升高促进公平结果，但在中等压力下回应者行为反转为接受低报价的“宽容”策略，微观分析显示该反转源于收益导向与公平导向偏好的竞争。
Motivation: 传统博弈论模型依赖完全理性自利的 Homo economicus 假设，忽略了经济激励之外的多维决策因素，难以解释公平这一社会规范的涌现机制。
Method: 提出多目标强化学习框架，将公平性作为物质收益与公平驱动行为两个目标间的权衡，由公平压力系数调节；用双目标 Q-learning 在最后通牒博弈中做模拟，并扩展到提议者与回应者对两目标赋不同权重的非对称设定。
Result: 模拟显示公平压力增大促进公平结果；中等压力下回应者出现行为反转，转而接受低报价；微观分析将该策略反转归因于收益最大化与公平导向偏好之间的竞争；框架进一步扩展到非对称权重设定。
Conclusion: 把强化学习从单目标扩展到多目标表述，可以刻画公平涌现及其在中等压力下的策略反转，为解释更广泛的人类社会行为提供通用工具。

summary_sections.motivation: 传统博弈论模型依赖完全理性自利的 Homo economicus 假设，忽略了经济激励之外的多维决策因素，难以解释公平这一社会规范的涌现机制。
summary_sections.method: 提出多目标强化学习框架，将公平性作为物质收益与公平驱动行为两个目标间的权衡，由公平压力系数调节；用双目标 Q-learning 在最后通牒博弈中做模拟，并扩展到提议者与回应者对两目标赋不同权重的非对称设定。
summary_sections.result: 模拟显示公平压力增大促进公平结果；中等压力下回应者出现行为反转，转而接受低报价；微观分析将该策略反转归因于收益最大化与公平导向偏好之间的竞争；框架进一步扩展到非对称权重设定。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把强化学习从单目标扩展到多目标表述，可以刻画公平涌现及其在中等压力下的策略反转，为解释更广泛的人类社会行为提供通用工具。

papers.title: GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Understanding where and why Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents fail is essential for building more reliable systems, yet current evaluation relies on step accuracy, a metric that treats each screen independently and overlooks the underlying structure of GUI environments. This leads to two critical blind spots: (1) functionally equivalent screens are evaluated in isolation, obscuring systematic failure patterns across shared screens; and (2) the long-tailed GUI distribution renders failures on rare but critical screens invisible under standard metrics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{GUITAR}, a state-centric diagnostic framework that performs structured failure analysis over both states and transitions, using a State Transition Graph (STG) by mapping visually diverse screens to shared functional states. Across 8 agents and 6 tasks from AndroidControl and Mind2Web, GUITAR reveals that 60.4\% of failures occur in 20\% of states, localizing errors to a small set of bottlenecks. Bottleneck-targeted guidance improves SR by 2.8\% and retains a 1.88\% average gain across 7 agents under three-fold trajectory-held-out evaluation with fully automatic STGs. These findings demonstrate the diagnostic and actionable value of structure-aware evaluation within the evaluated mobile and web tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/sqzhang-lazy/GUITAR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUITAR 用状态转移图 (State Transition Graph, STG) 把视觉上不同但功能等价的 GUI 屏幕映射为共享功能状态，在状态与转移两个层面做结构化失败诊断。在 AndroidControl 与 Mind2Web 的 8 个 agent、6 个任务上，60.4% 的失败集中在 20% 的状态；针对瓶颈状态给指导后 SR 提升 2.8%，在三折轨迹留出、全自动 STG 下跨 7 个 agent 平均仍保留 1.88% 增益。
Motivation: GUI agent 评测只看逐步准确率，把每屏当独立样本，功能等价屏被孤立评估、长尾稀有屏上的失败被平均掉，系统性失败模式和关键瓶颈都看不见。
Method: 提出以状态为中心的诊断框架 GUITAR：构建 State Transition Graph，将视觉多样的屏幕归并为共享功能状态，对状态与转移分别做结构化失败分析；再把诊断出的瓶颈转化为针对性指导反馈给 agent，用三折轨迹留出评测且 STG 全自动构建。
Result: 在 AndroidControl 与 Mind2Web 的 8 个 agent、6 个任务上，60.4% 的失败发生在 20% 的状态中；瓶颈针对性指导使 SR 提升 2.8%，在三折轨迹留出、全自动 STG 评测下跨 7 个 agent 平均增益 1.88%。
Conclusion: 结构感知的评测能在所评估的移动与 web 任务中定位少量瓶颈状态，并把诊断转化为可执行、可复现的性能改进。

papers.title: Unknown is not normal: separating language-model extraction from rule-based decision logic for clinical risk scores
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to compute clinical risk scores from free-text notes. Notes are often incomplete, and treating undocumented findings as normal can silently misclassify patients. We test whether separating three-state extraction (present, absent or unknown, by an LLM) from decision logic (deterministic code computing score bounds over unknown inputs) lets a system ask only questions that can change the decision. On 1,200 synthetic emergency cases across six calculators (HEART, CURB-65, qSOFA, PERC, Wells, Cockcroft-Gault), with a simulated clinician answering questions, we compared this bounds policy with asking for every missing input, a missing-equals-normal schema, and an end-to-end LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5). With Claude Haiku 4.5 as extractor, the bounds policy matched ask-all accuracy (99.4% vs 99.4%) with half the questions (0.92 vs 1.78 per case) and no irrelevant ones. Treating missing as normal dropped accuracy to 91.2% and under-triaged 8.5% of patients (95% CI 7.1-10.2), and under-triage persisted under messy notes and a noisy clinician. The agent was equally accurate under ideal conditions (99.6%) but 9.5% of its questions were irrelevant; with a noisy clinician it was less accurate than the bounds policy (83.5% vs 87.0%, p<0.001) and committed prematurely in 2.7% of cases (bounds: 0%). A 9B local model as extractor reached oracle-level accuracy (99.8%). In 584 real case reports from MedCalc-Bench, only 52% contained enough information to determine the category (HEART 13%). Routing decisions through code that reasons explicitly about unknowns avoids premature commitment and irrelevant questions, halves the questions asked, and works with small local models.
papers.comment: 14 pages (7 of main text), 5 figures, 2 tables, appendix included; full supplementary material in the code repository. Code: https://github.com/nicoveraz/calc-bounds (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004726)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把临床风险评分拆成 LLM 三态抽取（present/absent/unknown）与确定性代码的区间决策（对 unknown 输入算分数上下界），只问能改变决策的问题。在 1,200 例合成急诊病例、六个评分器上，该 bounds 策略以每例 0.92 个问题达到与 ask-all 相同的 99.4% 准确率；missing-equals-normal 掉到 91.2% 并漏诊 8.5% 患者。
Motivation: LLM 从自由文本病历算临床风险评分时，病历常不完整，把未记录当作 normal 会静默误分类；端到端 agent 又会问大量与决策无关的问题。
Method: LLM 做三态抽取（present/absent/unknown），确定性代码在 unknown 输入上计算分数上下界（bounds policy），只提出能改变决策的问题；在 1,200 例合成急诊病例、六个计算器（HEART、CURB-65、qSOFA、PERC、Wells、Cockcroft-Gault）上与 ask-all、missing-equals-normal、端到端 agent（Claude Opus 5.5）对比，抽取器用 Claude Haiku 4.5 与 9B 本地模型，并设嘈杂临床医生与杂乱病历条件。
Result: Claude Haiku 4.5 作抽取器时 bounds 策略准确率 99.4% 与 ask-all 持平，问题数减半（0.92 vs 1.78 每例）且无无关问题；missing-equals-normal 准确率降至 91.2%，漏诊 8.5%（95% CI 7.1–10.2），杂乱病历与嘈杂临床医生下仍持续。agent 理想条件下 99.6% 同样准确但 9.5% 问题无关；嘈杂临床医生下 83.5% vs bounds 87.0%（p<0.001），2.7% 病例过早下结论（bounds 0%）。9B 本地模型作抽取器达 99.8% oracle 级准确率。MedCalc-Bench 584 例真实病例报告中仅 52% 信息足以定类别（HEART 13%）。
Conclusion: 让代码显式对 unknown 做推理并路由决策，可避免过早承诺与无关提问、把提问量减半，且小本地模型即可胜任；missing-equals-normal 这类 schema 会系统性漏诊。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SpecRegMatch: Robust Semi-Supervised Regression for Vehicle Interior Noise Prediction
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has observed increased application in predicting vehicle interior noise levels within the automotive industry. However, the collection of labeled data for training models in this context involves significant costs. Previous studies in semi-supervised regression (SSR) have effectively mitigated the reliance on labeled data by incorporating unlabeled data. Nonetheless, these approaches often introduce a high computational cost due to the training of multiple models and data sampling. This study introduces SpecRegMatch, a novel SSR method aimed at addressing the computational cost associated with training by leveraging a single model, thus eliminating the need for multiple data samplings. SpecRegMatch integrates consistency regularization and information maximization to robustly train the model, achieved through various augmentations applied to both the embedding vectors and predicted values. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecRegMatch achieves state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios, even when using a single model. It attains a remarkable performance, as indicated by an R^2 score of 0.434. This is especially noteworthy in scenarios where labeled data is scarce. You can access the code for our proposed method at https://github.com/sejin-sim/SpecRegMatch.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Access, vol. 12, pp. 60-72, 2024
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Access, vol. 12, pp. 60-72, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecRegMatch 用单模型半监督回归 (SSR) 预测车内噪声：对 embedding 向量与预测值同时做多种增广，配合一致性正则与信息最大化训练，在标注稀缺场景下以单模型达到 SOTA，R² 为 0.434，并省去多模型训练与多次数据采样的开销。
Motivation: 车内噪声预测的标注数据采集成本高，已有 SSR 方法靠多模型与数据采样缓解标注依赖，却带来高计算开销。
Method: SpecRegMatch 只训练单个模型，对 embedding 向量和预测值施加多种增广，将一致性正则 (consistency regularization) 与信息最大化 (information maximization) 结合来稳健训练，从而免除多次数据采样。
Result: 在多种场景下达到 state-of-the-art，单模型即取得 R² = 0.434，尤其在标注数据稀缺的场景下表现突出。
Conclusion: 单模型加增广驱动的一致性与信息最大化，足以在标注稀缺时替代多模型 SSR 并降低训练开销。

papers.title: The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization. In particular, SpecMatch outperforms conventional feature matching in 40 of 42 teacher--student and training-setting combinations, while consistently improving over the original student model in all settings. We further demonstrate that the proposed objective generalizes beyond vision, improving downstream performance across six protein understanding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出特征匹配蒸馏中的 L2 目标天然偏向重建教师表征的主谱方向、欠优化常含任务信息的低方差方向，提出自适应强调欠优化谱方向并保留主方向相对重要性的 SpecMatch 目标。在图像分类、异常检测、医学图像分析、域泛化等下游适配上，SpecMatch 在 42 组教师-学生与训练设置组合中的 40 组优于常规特征匹配，并在全部设置上优于原始学生模型，还把收益推广到六项蛋白质理解任务。
Motivation: 无标签特征匹配蒸馏部署大视觉基础模型时，L2 目标被教师表征的主谱方向主导，低方差但任务相关的方向训练不足，下游适配因此受限。
Method: 提出 Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching（SpecMatch）：在特征匹配目标中自适应地强调欠优化的谱方向，同时保持主方向的相对重要性；实现简单，额外计算开销可忽略。
Result: 在 42 组教师-学生与训练设置组合中，SpecMatch 在 40 组上优于常规特征匹配，并在所有设置上一致优于原始学生模型；实验覆盖图像分类、异常检测、医学图像分析、域泛化，并在六项蛋白质理解任务上提升下游性能。
Conclusion: 特征匹配的谱偏差是下游适配的系统性瓶颈，按谱方向重新加权即可在视觉与非视觉任务上稳定提升学生模型表现。

papers.title: A Differentiable Optimization Framework for Registering Sequential Bounding Boxes with Point Cloud Stream
papers.abstract_en: Refining a sequence of coarse 3D bounding boxes against a LiDAR point-cloud stream demands tracks that are geometrically accurate (high IoU) and temporally coherent (low roughness), preferably without training data. The usual recipe keeps the two concerns apart: register each frame independently, then smooth the trajectory afterwards with a Kalman~RTS or Savitzky--Golay filter. Smoothing displaces boxes from a geometric optimum and never re-optimises, so it trades accuracy for smoothness. We instead fold the temporal smoothness constraint into a training-free registration objective and solve for all poses jointly with L-BFGS. The payoff depends on how well the object is seen. On well-observed tracks it is large: within the low-roughness budget, the joint objective beats both post-hoc smoothers on paired multi-seed statistics and cuts roughness several-fold relative to frame-wise registration at matched accuracy. Treating visibility as an experimental variable exposes the limit. The advantage decays monotonically as views become one-sided, until it is indistinguishable from zero for near-edge-on objects and slightly negative under a ray-cast simulator with range-dependent density and ego motion, where the decoupled pipeline is in fact ahead at tight roughness budgets. We locate that boundary and trace it to one term: orientation alignment ties yaw to the estimated velocity and fails once that estimate is noisy. A ground-truth-free rule can choose the temporal scale and keep every track inside the roughness budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把时序平滑约束直接写进免训练的点云配准目标，用 L-BFGS 联合求解整段 3D bounding box 位姿，取代先逐帧配准再用 Kalman RTS 或 Savitzky–Golay 后平滑的常规流程。在可见性良好的轨迹上，联合目标在配对多种子统计中同时胜过两种后平滑器，并在同等精度下把 roughness 相对逐帧配准降低数倍；优势随视角趋于单侧单调衰减，对近 edge-on 目标降为与零无异，在带距离相关点密度与自车运动的 ray-cast 模拟器中甚至略为负。作者定位出失效项为 orientation alignment（把 yaw 绑到估计速度上，速度估计一噪就失效），并给出一条无需 ground truth 的规则来选时序尺度、把每条轨迹留在 roughness 预算内。
Motivation: 逐帧独立配准再事后平滑会把框推离几何最优且不再回改，等于用精度换平滑；而几何精度 (IoU) 与时序一致性 (roughness) 两个目标在常规流程里被割裂处理。
Method: 提出免训练 (training-free) 的可微配准框架：把时序平滑约束折进配准目标函数，用 L-BFGS 对整段序列的所有 pose 联合求解，而非逐帧配准加 Kalman RTS / Savitzky–Golay 后平滑；以可见性作为实验变量，并用 ray-cast 模拟器（含距离相关点密度与自车运动）检验边界，另给出无需 ground truth 的时序尺度选择规则。
Result: 在可见性良好的轨迹上，联合目标在低 roughness 预算内、配对多种子统计中同时优于 Kalman RTS 与 Savitzky–Golay 两种后平滑器，并在同等精度下相对逐帧配准把 roughness 降低数倍。优势随视角单侧化单调衰减，对近 edge-on 目标与零不可区分；在 ray-cast 模拟器中略为负，紧 roughness 预算下解耦流程反而领先。失效被归因到 orientation alignment 这一项。
Conclusion: 把平滑写进配准目标的联合求解只在物体被充分观测时优于解耦加后平滑，视角单侧或点云受距离密度与自车运动影响时该优势消失；可用无需 ground truth 的规则选时序尺度以守住 roughness 预算。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Correctness: Evaluating Semantic Knowledge in Cross-Table Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Semantic knowledge is increasingly used to bridge heterogeneous schemas in tabular learning, but how much does that knowledge actually improve prediction? Studies in tabular learning commonly answer this question through semantic ablations that modify or suppress the supplied semantic knowledge. We show that these ablations can lead to misleading conclusions about predictive benefit: poor performance under altered semantics may be taken as evidence that the intended knowledge is beneficial. Across real and controlled experiments, altering semantic content can produce large performance differences even when the model gains little predictive benefit from having that semantic knowledge in the first place. To separate these effects, we distinguish two quantities: content sensitivity and predictive utility. Content sensitivity measures the change in performance when semantic content is altered, whereas predictive utility measures the benefit of the intended semantic knowledge relative to a suitable reference without that knowledge. This distinction motivates an evaluation framework in which the control is chosen according to the question being asked: altered controls assess sensitivity to semantic content, whereas claims that semantic knowledge improves prediction require a suitable reference. Even then, predictive utility is not fixed; it varies across suitable references and decreases when the reference can more easily recover the tested knowledge from other inputs or labeled examples. In a bounded audit of 25 semantic-ablation comparisons across nine studies, only one of 18 explicit predictive-utility claims is paired with a control that clearly isolates the tested semantic contribution. Together, these findings motivate a simple evaluation principle: semantic-ablation controls should be chosen and interpreted according to the question they are intended to answer.
papers.comment: 40 pages. Seokyong Sheem and Hochang Lee contributed equally. Corresponding author: Daekyum Kim. Code and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/mintlabkorea/beyond-correctness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 表格学习中用语义消融来证明语义知识有用会得出误导结论：改写语义后性能大跌只说明模型对内容敏感 (content sensitivity)，不等于该知识带来预测收益 (predictive utility)。对九项研究 25 组语义消融的有界审计发现，18 条显式预测收益主张中只有 1 条配上了能隔离该语义贡献的对照；且预测收益随参照对照越容易从其他输入或标注样本中恢复该知识而下降。
Motivation: 表格学习普遍用语义消融回答语义知识有多大用，但把改写语义后的差表现当成原知识有益的证据，会把内容敏感性误读为预测收益。
Method: 区分两个量：content sensitivity 衡量语义内容被改动时的性能变化，predictive utility 衡量目标语义知识相对合适参照（不含该知识）的收益；据此给出按所提问题选择对照的评估框架——改写对照用于测敏感性，预测收益主张需配合适参照。在真实与受控实验中检验，并对九项研究的 25 组语义消融比较做有界审计。
Result: 真实与受控实验中，改动语义内容可造成很大的性能差异，而模型从该语义知识本身获得的预测收益很小。有界审计 25 组语义消融比较（来自九项研究）：18 条显式预测收益主张中仅 1 条配有能清晰隔离所测语义贡献的对照。预测收益随参照变化，参照越容易从其他输入或标注样例中恢复被测知识，收益越低。
Conclusion: 语义消融对照必须按其要回答的问题来选择和解读：测敏感性用改写对照，主张预测收益必须用合适参照，否则结论会失真。

papers.title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
papers.abstract_en: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MetaWild：首个把环境元数据（温度、昼夜节律等，从相机陷阱叠加文字与场景上下文抽取）与视觉配对的多模态动物个体重识别数据集，共 20,890 张图像、6 个物种；并提出轻量 Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA) 插入现有基于 VLM 的 ReID 方法。在 MetaWild 上，基线 ReID 模型加 MFA 融合元数据后性能一致优于仅用视觉信息。
Motivation: 现有 Animal ReID 数据集只用视觉数据，忽略生态学家指出与动物行为和身份高度相关的环境元数据；同时现有资源未用足 VLM 的文本处理能力。
Method: 构建 MetaWild 数据集（20,890 张图像、6 物种），元数据从相机陷阱嵌入式 overlay 与场景上下文提取；提出 Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA)，一个可插入现有 VLM-based ReID 方法的轻量模块，让模型同时利用环境元数据与视觉信息。
Result: 在 MetaWild 上，基线 ReID 模型结合 MFA 引入元数据后，相比仅用视觉信息一致提升 ReID 性能。
Conclusion: 把环境元数据作为额外模态接入现有 ReID 管线可稳定提升动物个体重识别效果，验证了元数据在重识别中的作用。

papers.title: When Is an SAE Feature Interpretable? A Validation Ladder for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose dense model activations into discrete latents, making individual features easy to interpret--and easy to misinterpret. In EEG foundation models, this creates a tempting inference: if removing alpha-band activity strongly changes a latent's activation, one might conclude that the latent represents alpha activity. Across 27 settings spanning three backbones, three EEG datasets, and three network depths, this interpretation initially appears compelling: alpha removal changes latent firing 7.3 times more than an equal-width sham notch (95% CI [6.2, 8.7], bootstrapped over settings). However, the alpha filter also deletes far more signal than the sham. After normalizing by removed spectral energy, the ratio falls to 0.28 (95% CI [0.22, 0.36]) and exceeds one in none of the 27 settings. Latents selected for their response to alpha removal are, on clean EEG, slightly anti-correlated with relative alpha power (mean r = -0.073), giving no support for a simple alpha-detector reading. Motivated by this failure case, we propose a validation ladder for semantic interpretations of SAE latents: it asks in turn whether a latent responds, whether that response survives controlling for how much signal the intervention removes, whether it is specific rather than broadly fragile, and whether the proposed property is visible on unperturbed data--while separately testing the stronger claim that the latent matters to a task classifier. Perturbation sensitivity alone does not establish what an SAE latent represents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 EEG 基础模型上，仅凭 alpha 频段去除后潜变量放电变化 7.3 倍于等宽假陷波 (sham notch)，会误判 SAE 特征语义；按被去除谱能量归一化后该比值降到 0.28，27 个设置中无一超过 1。作者据此提出语义解释的四步验证阶梯：响应、能量控制、特异性、干净数据可见性，并单独检验任务相关性。
Motivation: SAE 潜变量易被过度解读：干预后激活变化常被当作语义证据，但干预同时删掉的信号量未被控制，导致把频谱能量效应误读为特征语义。
Method: 在三个 backbone、三个 EEG 数据集、三个网络深度共 27 个设置上做 alpha 频段去除与等宽 sham notch 对照，按被去除谱能量归一化比值，并在干净 EEG 上计算潜变量与相对 alpha 功率的相关；由此提出验证阶梯：是否响应、控制去除量后是否仍成立、是否特异、未扰动数据上是否可见，另单独检验潜变量对任务分类器的作用。
Result: alpha 去除使潜变量放电变化为 sham 的 7.3 倍（95% CI [6.2, 8.7]，跨设置 bootstrap）；按去除谱能量归一化后比值降至 0.28（95% CI [0.22, 0.36]），27 个设置中无一超过 1；按 alpha 去除响应选出的潜变量在干净 EEG 上与相对 alpha 功率平均 r = -0.073，略呈负相关。
Conclusion: 扰动敏感性本身不能确立 SAE 潜变量的语义，语义解释需逐级通过响应、能量控制、特异性与干净数据可见性四道检验。

papers.title: TRACE: Expert-Aligned ECG Representation Learning with Rigorous Benchmarking and Real-World Validation in Acute Cardiac Care
papers.abstract_en: TRACE (Text-Reinforced Analysis of Cardio ECGs) is a multimodal electrocardiogram (ECG) representation model that learns clinically grounded signal embeddings for downstream cardiac classification. It is designed to address the limitations of existing CLIP-style training, which often struggles with noisy clinical text and fails to leverage the complementary strengths of unimodal (from ECG) and cross-modal (between ECG and matched cardiologist reports) learning. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid architecture that jointly learns unimodal and cross-modal representations via uncertainty-weighted multi-task learning while utilizing an LLM-based pipeline to extract high-fidelity findings from cardiologist reports. We evaluate TRACE across a spectrum of clinical urgency, establishing robust performance on public benchmarks for arrhythmia classification and structural abnormalities relative to existing unimodal and multimodal ECG models. To demonstrate real-world utility, we further validate the model on acute coronary occlusion (ACO), where the prevailing ST-elevation criteria miss 25-34% of true occlusions. Utilizing a large private ACO dataset with expert-annotated ground truth, TRACE significantly outperforms real-world clinical practice, yielding a 19.0% increase in sensitivity or a 62.6% reduction in false positive rates at the clinical baseline. This extensive evaluation confirms that TRACE delivers both strong performance on benchmark tasks and tangible clinical impact in the most acute, high-risk cardiac scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是面向心电图 (ECG) 的多模态表征模型，用不确定性加权多任务学习联合训练 ECG 单模态嵌入与 ECG-报告跨模态嵌入，并用 LLM 管线从心内科医生报告中抽取高保真发现。在急性冠脉闭塞 (ACO) 上，相对临床基线敏感度提升 19.0% 或假阳性率下降 62.6%，而现行 ST 段抬高标准漏掉 25-34% 的真实闭塞。
Motivation: CLIP 式训练难以处理嘈杂的临床文本，也未利用 ECG 单模态与 ECG-报告跨模态的互补信息；同时现行 ST 标准在急性冠脉闭塞上漏诊 25-34%。
Method: 混合架构通过不确定性加权多任务学习联合优化单模态 (仅 ECG) 与跨模态 (ECG 与匹配心内科报告) 表征，并以 LLM 管线从报告中抽取高保真发现作为文本监督；在公开心律失常与结构异常基准及一个带专家标注真值的大型私有 ACO 数据集上评测。
Result: 在公开心律失常与结构异常基准上相对已有单模态与多模态 ECG 模型建立稳健表现；在私有 ACO 数据集上相对真实临床基线敏感度提升 19.0%，或假阳性率下降 62.6%；对照事实为现行 ST 标准漏掉 25-34% 的真实闭塞。

papers.title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA

Motivation: 现有 action-conditioned JEPA 世界模型（LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）用于端到端自动驾驶时要么规划准但算力开销大，要么快但不足以支撑规划，精度与效率不可兼得。
Method: 先用目标条件零样本规划（goal-conditioned zero-shot planning）系统评测 LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM，以真值未来观测作目标、不训练任何驾驶策略，从而把世界模型质量与策略学习解耦；再提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，在 projected patch embeddings 上加 SIGReg 正则化的可学习 projector，压缩 patch 数与嵌入维度，并在轨迹词表 (trajectory vocabularies) 上做世界模型 rollout。
Result: planning patch 数减少 16×、嵌入维度减少 4×，推理加速 100×，8 帧 rollout 对 256 条候选轨迹耗时 0.8 秒；不训练策略时，世界模型平均到达 20 米外目标的位移分别为 4.0/2.8 米（对应 256/8,192 条候选轨迹）。NAVSIMv2 上目标条件零样本规划得 67.3/72.9 EPDMS（含乘性安全指标）与 84.1/86.5 EPDMS†（不含）；自监督预训练 projector 使下游模仿学习从 80.2 升至 85.4 EPDMS。
Conclusion: 在端到端自动驾驶里，用正则化可学习 projector 压缩世界模型表征可以在保留规划性能的前提下把推理开销降两个数量级，且该 projector 的自监督预训练能直接反哺下游模仿学习。

papers.title: Beyond One Epoch: Uncertainty-Weighted Sensitivity Regularization for Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation models with sparse embeddings and a shared consumer often exhibit the one-epoch phenomenon: a second epoch lowers training loss while sharply degrading generalization. We present a view based on the violation of the prequential principle. On the first epoch, an example's label has not affected the embedding rows used to score it. On later epochs, those rows contain a displacement induced by the labels earlier update. This creates an incentive for the shared consumer to exploit this displacement in subsequent epochs, which fails to generalize. We call this self-influence asymmetry. Using an exact scalar model and local influence analysis, we connect this mismatch to the uncertainty in the embeddings and the consumers incentive to exploit it in subsequent epochs. We verify this hypothesis using an embedding-consumer-update interventions in deep recommendation models and propose uncertainty-weighted sensitivity regularization (UWSR) which counteracts this mismatch by augmenting the loss function to penalize the consumer for relying on uncertain embeddings. Unlike existing remedies, UWSR preserves the learned embeddings and across three benchmarks, four-epoch UWSR reduces test cross-entropy by 1.38%-6.78% and improves AUC by 0.0058-0.0231 relative to one-epoch training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐模型的稀疏 embedding 加共享 consumer 在第二个 epoch 会利用自身标签位移，违反 prequential 原则导致泛化骤降。提出 UWSR：在损失中按 embedding 不确定性加权惩罚 consumer 依赖不可靠 embedding，保留已学 embedding。三个 benchmark 上四 epoch UWSR 相对单 epoch 训练将测试交叉熵降低 1.38%-6.78%，AUC 提升 0.0058-0.0231。
Motivation: 稀疏 embedding 推荐模型存在 one-epoch 现象：第二个 epoch 训练损失下降但泛化急剧变差，现有补救手段往往要牺牲已学 embedding。
Method: 用精确标量模型与 local influence 分析把泛化失配关联到 embedding 不确定性，称为 self-influence asymmetry；通过 embedding-consumer-update 干预验证假设，提出 UWSR 在损失函数中按不确定性加权惩罚 consumer 对不确定 embedding 的依赖。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 上，四 epoch UWSR 相对单 epoch 训练使测试交叉熵降低 1.38%-6.78%，AUC 提升 0.0058-0.0231。
Conclusion: one-epoch 现象源于 consumer 利用标签诱导的 embedding 位移，按 embedding 不确定性加权做敏感性正则可在保留已学 embedding 的同时支持多 epoch 训练。

papers.title: K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) drawings is hard for general Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce K-OPSD, a VLM post-training methodology for improving AEC drawing understanding. Building on On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) with verifiable supervision, we construct a teacher from the model's own best-of-N generations, certified by a process-level verifier, and rescue failed prompts by resampling under a hint that exposes the verified answer. We then perform an on-policy model update by training on verified completions with a cross-entropy inner-loss, outperforming the bounded token-wise generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) used by on-policy distillation. Using K-OPSD, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL models on the AECV-Bench dataset. The resulting models attain the top average judge score (0.819) and combined accuracy (0.738), achieving competitive results against open-source baseline models. The recipe transfers to the out-of-domain ArchCAD dataset, where the 8B model gains most. We present the verifier suite and the continual learning and self-improving pipeline, our results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-guided self-distillation is a promising route toward more reliable machine reading of architecture drawings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: K-OPSD 用过程级验证器 (process-level verifier) 认证模型自身 best-of-N 生成来构造教师，对失败提示在暴露已验证答案的提示下重采样救回，再用交叉熵内损失在已验证补全上做 on-policy 更新，取代 on-policy distillation 的有界 token 级广义 JSD。在 AECV-Bench 上微调 Qwen3-VL 后取得最高平均 judge 分 0.819 与综合准确率 0.738，并可迁移到域外 ArchCAD 数据集（8B 模型提升最大）。
Motivation: 建筑、工程与施工 (AEC) 图纸理解对通用 MLLM/VLM 困难，而 on-policy 蒸馏依赖的 token 级 JSD 监督缺乏可验证性，难以保证建筑图纸机器阅读的可靠性。
Method: 在 On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 基础上引入可验证监督：从模型自身 best-of-N 生成中由过程级验证器认证构造教师，对失败提示用暴露已验证答案的 hint 重采样救回；随后在已验证补全上以交叉熵为内损失做 on-policy 模型更新，替代广义 JSD；用该配方微调 Qwen3-VL，并附带验证器套件与持续学习、自我改进流水线。
Result: 在 AECV-Bench 上微调后的模型取得最高平均 judge 分 0.819、综合准确率 0.738，相对开源基线模型具有竞争力结果；配方迁移到域外 ArchCAD 数据集，其中 8B 模型获益最大。
Conclusion: 作者认为验证器引导的自蒸馏是迈向更可靠建筑图纸机器阅读的有希望路线，并给出其结果作为初步证据。

papers.title: GenoMorph: Pathway-Grounded Genomic Disease Reasoning via Adaptive Latent Computation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in biological reasoning; however, genomic disease inference remains largely dependent on memorized gene-disease associations rather than understanding biological pathways. This shortcut learning undermines robustness and generalization, and breaks down when molecular identifiers are unavailable. We present GenoMorph, a multimodal genomic reasoning framework that shifts disease prediction from associative gene-disease mapping toward pathway-grounded reasoning. GenoMorph couples a frozen DNA foundation model with question-conditioned cross-attention fusion, self-adaptive latent reasoning (LatentSp), a residual reasoning gate for iterative genomic evidence reinjection, and rejection sampling fine-tuning regularized by hierarchical optimal transport (OT). Rather than learning direct gene-disease mappings, GenoMorph aligns genomic sequence representations with latent pathway dynamics, enabling reasoning trajectories that follow molecular interactions before producing disease predictions. LatentSp dynamically allocates computation according to reasoning confidence, reducing unnecessary reasoning steps and improving inference efficiency. We further construct an anonymized benchmark from the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), replacing every gene and molecular identifier with anonymous symbols while preserving sequences and pathway topology, thereby removing memorization shortcuts. GenoMorph raises the weighted F1 from 0.7863 (BioReason) to 0.9412, and rejection sampling fine-tuning with self-adaptive latent reasoning pushes it to 0.9725 while cutting latency nearly 60%. On the anonymized benchmark it reaches 0.9465 F1, substantially outperforming prior systems and confirming that accurate disease prediction can arise from pathway reasoning rather than memorized gene-disease associations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GenoMorph 把基因-疾病关联记忆式推断换成通路接地的推理：冻结 DNA 基础模型加问题条件交叉注意力融合、自适应隐式推理 LatentSp、残差推理门与层级最优传输 (OT) 正则的拒绝采样微调。加权 F1 从 BioReason 的 0.7863 提到 0.9412，再经拒绝采样微调与 LatentSp 达 0.9725，同时延迟降低近 60%；在 KEGG 匿名化基准上 F1 0.9465。
Motivation: LLM 的基因组疾病推断依赖记忆化的基因-疾病关联，一旦分子标识符被匿名化就失效，泛化与稳健性被捷径学习破坏。
Method: 冻结 DNA foundation model 与问题条件交叉注意力 (question-conditioned cross-attention) 融合，配合自适应隐式推理 LatentSp（按推理置信度动态分配计算）、残差推理门 (residual reasoning gate) 迭代重注入基因组证据，以及层级最优传输 (hierarchical OT) 正则化的拒绝采样微调；并从 KEGG 构造匿名化基准，把基因与分子标识符替换为匿名符号、保留序列与通路拓扑。
Result: 加权 F1 从 BioReason 的 0.7863 提升到 0.9412；拒绝采样微调结合 LatentSp 后 F1 达 0.9725，同时延迟降低近 60%；在 KEGG 匿名化基准上 F1 为 0.9465，大幅超过既有系统。
Conclusion: 准确的疾病预测可以来自通路推理而非记忆化的基因-疾病关联，且按置信度自适应分配推理计算能在提升 F1 的同时降低推理延迟。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 准确的疾病预测可以来自通路推理而非记忆化的基因-疾病关联，且按置信度自适应分配推理计算能在提升 F1 的同时降低推理延迟。

papers.title: WhiteCon: Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation Regression Through Whitening Transform and Dual Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation is crucial for addressing distributional shifts that degrade model performance across domains. While most existing research has centered on classification, semi-supervised domain adaptation regression (SSDAR) for continuous-output tasks remains largely unexplored, particularly in practical scenarios with limited labeled target data. To address this gap, we propose semi-supervised domain adaptation regression through whitening transform and dual consistency (WhiteCon), which combines domain-specific whitening transform (DWT) and dual consistency regularization to enhance training stability and domain adaptation. DWT reduces the variance of the model parameters by transforming the feature covariance matrix into an identity matrix, thus stabilizing training under ordinary least squares assumptions. In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at https://github.com/sejin-sim/WhiteCon.
papers.journal_ref: 28th International Conference, ICPR 2026, Lyon, France, August 17-22, 2026, Proceedings, Part II, Pages 46-60
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WhiteCon 面向半监督域适应回归 (SSDAR) 这一连续输出任务，用域特定白化变换 (DWT) 把特征协方差矩阵化为单位阵以降低参数方差、稳定普通最小二乘下的训练，再用方差一致性正则对齐弱增强、强增强与 mixup 特征的方差。在多个 SSDAR 基准数据集上取得相对现有方法的 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: 域适应研究多集中在分类，连续输出的半监督域适应回归在目标域标注有限的实际场景下基本空白，分布偏移会直接拉低回归性能。
Method: WhiteCon 组合两部分：域特定 whitening transform (DWT)，将特征协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵以减小模型参数方差、在 ordinary least squares 假设下稳定训练；以及 dual consistency regularization，其中 variance consistency 对齐弱、强与 mixup 增强特征的方差，提升对增强扰动的抗性。

papers.title: MaskCoFT: Masked Co-Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models often exceed the memory of a single GPU. Expert offloading keeps most experts in host memory and loads them on demand, so decoding speed depends on how many experts each token must fetch. Caching and prefetching reduce this cost only as far as the routing allows. Router-only fine-tuning can reshape the routing to reuse experts, but it keeps the experts frozen, so they cannot adapt to the tokens the new routing sends them. We propose MaskCoFT, a masked co-adaptive fine-tuning method that trains routers and experts together with the cross-entropy loss alone. During fine-tuning, a learnable binary mask restricts the Top-K routing of each layer to a subset of experts, and the experts adapt to the tokens redirected to them. At inference, the learned mask becomes a soft prior that re-ranks experts, so every expert remains selectable. We simulate a GPU cache of 4 experts per layer for Mixtral-8x7B and 12 for DeepSeek-V2-Lite. MaskCoFT cuts expert fetches per token by 23.7% and 10.1% relative to the base model. In real offloading system serving, it lowers the time per output token by up to 16.4% and 5.5%, respectively. Its average accuracy over nine benchmarks stays above the base model by 0.92 and 0.53 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaskCoFT 用可学习二值掩码把每层 Top-K 路由限制到专家子集，同时微调 router 与 expert，推理时掩码退化为对全部专家的软先验重排。在模拟每层 4 个专家缓存的 Mixtral-8x7B 上，每 token 专家取数相对基座降 23.7%，真实 offloading 服务中每输出 token 时间最多降 16.4%，九基准平均精度反升 0.92 分。
Motivation: MoE 语言模型显存超出单卡，专家 offloading 下解码速度取决于每 token 要取多少专家；只微调 router 虽能重塑路由复用专家，但专家被冻结，无法适应新路由送来的 token。
Method: 微调阶段用可学习二值掩码把每层 Top-K 路由限制到专家子集，router 与 expert 联合训练，损失只用交叉熵；推理时学到的掩码转为软先验对专家重排，保证每个专家仍可被选中。
Result: 模拟每层 4 专家缓存的 Mixtral-8x7B 与 12 专家的 DeepSeek-V2-Lite：每 token 专家取数相对基座分别降 23.7% 与 10.1%；真实 offloading 系统服务中每输出 token 时间最多降 16.4% 与 5.5%；九个基准上平均精度分别高出基座 0.92 与 0.53 分。
Conclusion: 让 router 与 expert 在掩码约束下共同自适应，可以在不牺牲平均精度的前提下减少专家取数与解码延迟，即显存受限的 MoE 推理用联合微调换取更少的按需加载。

papers.title: The Double-Edged Sword of Information: Revealed versus Hidden Lotteries in School Choice
papers.abstract_en: In school choice, a lottery number is often used by the matching mechanism to break ties when there are more students who prefer the same school than the number of seats available. There has been growing theoretical and empirical interest in understanding the impact of revealing the lottery number to students. In practice, in recent years, the NYC Public Schools started revealing the lottery number to students to improve transparency. Theoretical findings from prior literature also suggest that revealing the lottery number strictly improves the number of matches under the deferred acceptance algorithm. However, these theoretical results are based on the over-simplifying assumption that all students share the same preference ranking for schools. In this work, we relax this assumption and allow students to have heterogeneous preference rankings. Under a game-theoretic model where student strategies form a Bayesian Nash equilibrium, we characterize scenarios where revealing the lottery number can either improve or worsen the matching outcome, measured by two metrics of match rate and social welfare. We further consider revealing partial information about the lottery, and demonstrate non-monotonic effects in the amount of information available to students. These results together illustrate complex tradeoffs induced by the lottery revealing policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在学生偏好异质的学校选择博弈中，公开抽签号 (lottery number) 对匹配结果不是单调有益：在 Bayesian Nash equilibrium 下，它既可能改善也可能恶化 match rate 与 social welfare，而部分公开信息的效果随信息量呈非单调。这与偏好同质假设下「公开严格改善 deferred acceptance 匹配数」的既有结论相反。
Motivation: 既有理论与 NYC Public Schools 公开抽签号的实践都建立在所有学生对学校排序相同这一过度简化假设上，异质偏好下公开信息的真实效果未知。
Method: 建立学生策略构成 Bayesian Nash equilibrium 的博弈论模型，放松同质偏好假设，刻画公开抽签号使匹配结果变好或变坏的场景，并分析只公开部分抽签信息的情形。
Result: 以 match rate 和 social welfare 两个指标刻画公开抽签号可改善也可恶化匹配结果的场景；部分信息公开对结果的影响随信息量呈非单调关系。
Conclusion: 抽签号公开政策的收益取决于偏好结构，信息量与匹配质量之间存在复杂权衡，不能沿用同质偏好下的单调改进结论。

papers.title: PhysFieldBench: Can Multimodal Models Understand Physical Fields?
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly envisioned as core components of scientific and engineering agents, yet their ability to interpret physical fields remains poorly understood. Existing physics benchmarks largely emphasize textbook problem solving or intuitive physical reasoning, leaving open whether MLLMs can infer physically meaningful information from continuous field observations. We introduce PhysFieldBench, a benchmark comprising 24 tasks and 1,160 evaluation examples across controlled equation fields, simulated physical fields, and observed physical fields. The tasks assess three forms of inference: identifying physical mechanisms, comparing latent control variables, and predicting outcome properties. Across representative open-source and proprietary MLLMs, zero-shot performance is low: the best model achieves a chance-normalized score of 29.3, while several open-source models remain near chance. In contrast, a task-specific supervised vision transformer performs substantially better, demonstrating that the inputs contain learnable physical information. To diagnose these failures, a structured self-explanation analysis attributes most errors to missed visual patterns and incorrect visual-to-physical mappings. Further, to explore whether post-training can improve physical inference and generalize to unseen tasks, we compare supervised fine-tuning with final answers or chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning. Final-answer supervision performs best overall but transfers less effectively, whereas reinforcement learning after chain-of-thought supervision achieves the best generalization. Together, these findings highlight the need to improve visual-to-physical grounding and cross-task generalization for MLLMs to reliably interpret physical fields in scientific and engineering workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysFieldBench 用 24 个任务、1,160 个评测样例检验多模态大模型 (MLLM) 从连续物理场观测中做物理推断的能力，零样本表现接近随机：最佳模型的机会归一化得分仅 29.3，多个开源模型接近随机水平，而任务专用监督 ViT 明显更好，说明输入本身含可学习的物理信息。后训练对比中，最终答案监督总体最好但跨任务迁移弱，链式思维监督后再做强化学习 (RL) 取得最佳泛化。
Motivation: 现有物理基准集中在课本题与直觉推理，无法回答 MLLM 能否从连续场观测（受控方程场、模拟场、观测场）中推断出物理上有意义的信息，而这正是其充当科学与工程 agent 核心的前提。
Method: 构建 PhysFieldBench：24 个任务、1,160 个评测样例，覆盖受控方程场、模拟物理场与观测物理场三类输入，考察三类推断——识别物理机制、比较潜在控制变量、预测结果属性。诊断阶段用结构化 self-explanation 归因错误；后训练阶段对比以最终答案监督的微调、以链式思维 (CoT) 监督的微调，以及在 CoT 监督之后的强化学习。
Result: 零样本下最佳模型的机会归一化得分 (chance-normalized score) 为 29.3，多个开源模型接近随机；任务专用监督 ViT 明显更好，表明输入含可学习的物理信息。self-explanation 分析把多数错误归因于视觉模式遗漏与视觉到物理的映射错误。后训练中最终答案监督总体最佳但迁移较弱，CoT 监督后接 RL 的泛化最好。
Conclusion: MLLM 解读物理场的瓶颈在视觉到物理的接地 (visual-to-physical grounding) 与跨任务泛化，而非输入缺乏物理信息；要可靠进入科学与工程工作流，需针对这两点改进，且追求泛化时应选 CoT 加 RL 而非纯最终答案监督。

papers.title: SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-matching models can produce high-quality posterior samples for inverse problems, but typically require tens to thousands of network evaluations per draw. MeanFlow enables one-step generation, yet applying it to inverse problems leaves no intermediate steps at which to enforce measurement consistency. We introduce SNaP, a one-step MeanFlow posterior sampler for linear inverse problems with Gaussian noise. Its central innovation is a measurement-adapted source: a Gaussian distribution whose mean and anisotropic covariance are determined by the measurement operator, observation, and noise level. The source anchors well-measured directions while preserving variation where the measurements are weak or uninformative. We show that the exact conditional flow transports this source to the true posterior. Across natural-image restoration and multi-coil MRI, SNaP produces diverse, high-quality samples with one network evaluation per draw, 30 to 2250 $\times$ faster than iterative samplers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SNaP 把 MeanFlow 的单步生成改造成线性高斯逆问题的单步后验采样器，核心是用测量算子、观测和噪声水平决定均值与各向异性协方差的 measurement-adapted source：在测量强的方向锚定、在测量弱或无信息的方向保留变化。作者证明精确条件流会把该 source 输运到真实后验；在自然图像复原与多线圈 MRI 上以每次采样 1 次网络评估产出多样高质量样本，比迭代采样器快 30 至 2250 倍。
Motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型做逆问题后验采样质量高，但每次采样要几十到上千次网络评估；直接套用单步 MeanFlow 又没有中间步可施加测量一致性约束。
Method: 针对线性逆问题与高斯噪声，构造 measurement-adapted source：一个由测量算子、观测和噪声水平决定均值与各向异性协方差的高斯分布，再用单步 MeanFlow 把它输运到后验；论文给出精确条件流将该 source 映到真实后验的结论。
Result: 在自然图像复原与多线圈 MRI 上，每次采样只需 1 次网络评估，比迭代采样器快 30 至 2250 倍，同时产出多样且高质量的样本。
Conclusion: 把测量信息编码进单步生成的初始 source，可以在不依赖中间迭代步的情况下兼顾测量一致性与单步效率，使线性高斯逆问题的后验采样达到每次 1 次网络评估。

summary_sections.method: 针对线性逆问题与高斯噪声，构造 measurement-adapted source：一个由测量算子、观测和噪声水平决定均值与各向异性协方差的高斯分布，再用单步 MeanFlow 把它输运到后验；论文给出精确条件流将该 source 映到真实后验的结论。
summary_sections.result: 在自然图像复原与多线圈 MRI 上，每次采样只需 1 次网络评估，比迭代采样器快 30 至 2250 倍，同时产出多样且高质量的样本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把测量信息编码进单步生成的初始 source，可以在不依赖中间迭代步的情况下兼顾测量一致性与单步效率，使线性高斯逆问题的后验采样达到每次 1 次网络评估。

papers.title: FLARE: Flow Matching with Local Axis-Angle Representations for Stochastic Micromagnetic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon micromagnetic simulation remains expensive because conventional and learned solvers typically propagate Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) dynamics step by step. Existing learned approaches generally retain stepwise integration or model deterministic evolution, leaving full-field, direct-horizon stochastic prediction largely unexplored. We propose FLARE, a flow-matching framework that recasts stochastic finite-time magnetization prediction as conditional transport over anchor-relative local axis-angle rotations. This rotation-space formulation respects the intrinsic geometry of magnetization dynamics and preserves pointwise unit norm by construction. By explicitly conditioning on the physical prediction horizon, FLARE directly generates full-field stochastic endpoints across multiple target times without stepwise integration. Against the strongest single-checkpoint external baseline on each metric, FLARE achieves 29.9% lower angular energy distance ($15.30^\circ$), and a 37.3% lower fair energy score (0.393). On a representative composed 5-ns two-segment protocol, FLARE achieves a $3{,}062\times$ best-batch speedup over the widely used GPU micromagnetic solver MuMax$^3$ on a single GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLARE 用 flow matching 把微磁化强度的随机有限时间演化重写为相对锚点的局部 axis-angle 旋转上的条件传输，按物理预测时 horizon 直接生成全场随机终点而无需逐步积分。相对各指标最强单 checkpoint 外部基线，angular energy distance 低 29.9%（15.30°），fair energy score 低 37.3%（0.393）；在 5 ns 两段协议上相对 MuMax3 单 GPU best-batch 加速 3062 倍。
Motivation: 常规与学习型求解器都按步推进 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) 动力学，长时程微磁模拟代价高；已有学习方法仍保留逐步积分或只建模确定性演化，全场、直接到时 horizon 的随机预测基本空白。
Method: 提出 flow matching 框架 FLARE：把随机有限时间磁化预测表述为相对锚点的局部 axis-angle 旋转上的条件传输，旋转空间形式天然保持逐点单位范数；显式以物理预测时 horizon 为条件，一次性生成多个目标时刻的全场随机终点，跳过逐步积分。
Result: 相对每个指标上最强的单 checkpoint 外部基线，angular energy distance 降低 29.9%（15.30°），fair energy score 降低 37.3%（0.393）。在代表性的 5 ns 两段协议上，单 GPU 相对广泛使用的 GPU 微磁求解器 MuMax3 取得 3062 倍 best-batch 加速。
Conclusion: 把微磁随机演化当作旋转几何上的条件传输并按 horizon 直接生成终点，可在保持物理约束的同时大幅压缩长时程模拟成本。

papers.title: Towards Certificate-Driven Software Porting: A Self-Improving Agentic Harness for Scientific Program Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The upgrade and rewriting of large scientific codebases has traditionally been a major challenge. While evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can port and accelerate legacy code, repair feedback in prompts alone does not prevent subsequent candidates from repeating the same errors. We introduce Certificate-Driven Evolutionary Search (CDES), which extends evolutionary search with enforceable restrictions derived from failed candidates, recorded as certificates of assumptions, checker evidence, and justified restrictions. Its control logic enforces these restrictions through rejection, backtracking, and targeted repair while preserving compatible edits. We apply CDES to CPU-to-GPU translation of two particle-simulation functions from the Geant4 toolkit, evaluated with a harness that goes beyond unit tests to combine formal checks, numerical comparisons, physics checks, and GPU safety tests. Generated implementations achieve 13.78x and 23.54x function-level speedups over CPU code, including data conversion and transfers; for one function, GPU throughput exceeds an expert implementation by 14.9%, reaching 16.1% when complementary components are combined. In an ablation over execution settings, certificate feedback increases the fraction of candidates passing required correctness checks from 55% to 90%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出证书驱动进化搜索 (CDES)，把失败候选的教训固化为带检查证据的假设证书，用拒绝、回退和定向修复约束后续 LLM 候选，避免重复犯同一错误。在 Geant4 两个粒子模拟函数的 CPU→GPU 移植中，函数级加速 13.78× 与 23.54×（含数据转换与传输），其中一个函数吞吐超过专家实现 14.9%，组合互补组件后达 16.1%；证书反馈把通过必需正确性检查的候选比例从 55% 提到 90%。
Motivation: 用 LLM 进化搜索移植和加速大型科学代码库时，仅把修复反馈写进 prompt 无法阻止后续候选重犯同一错误，正确率停滞。
Method: CDES 在进化搜索上叠加可执行约束：从失败候选提取假设证书（假设、检查器证据、被论证的限制），控制逻辑据此做拒绝、回退与定向修复，同时保留兼容编辑。评估 harness 超出单元测试，结合形式化检查、数值比对、物理检查与 GPU 安全测试；对象是 Geant4 工具包中两个粒子模拟函数的 CPU-to-GPU 翻译。
Result: 两个函数相对 CPU 代码取得 13.78× 与 23.54× 函数级加速（含数据转换与传输）；其一 GPU 吞吐超过专家实现 14.9%，与互补组件组合后达 16.1%。在执行设置的消融中，证书反馈使通过必需正确性检查的候选比例从 55% 升至 90%。
Conclusion: 把失败教训写成可强制执行的证书约束，比在 prompt 里复述修复更能阻止 LLM 进化搜索重犯同一错误，并在 Geant4 移植上同时拿到可观加速与更高正确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Names are personal identifiers, but they also carry social meaning and are widely used to evaluate how language models treat different people. Such evaluations typically assume that matched names are comparable model inputs. We show that this assumption often fails at the lexical interface: matched names are not necessarily matched inputs. Some names receive direct single-token access, while others are assembled from multiple subwords, creating unequal name-surface support. Across nearly half a million first names and 12 LLM-associated tokenizers, direct lexical access is highly selective, model dependent, and uneven across race- and gender-associated name metadata. We introduce NameTrace, a model-native, fine-grained, pre-behavioral framework for measuring whether unequal name-surface support remains a vocabulary property or becomes visible in task-relevant internal representations. NameTrace measures concept accessibility from the model's own probabilities over task-specific adjective axes with continuous task-aligned weights. On matched atomic and short-fragmented names within the same race/ethnicity--gender-associated strata, support predicts systematic differences in concept accessibility across fellowship, hiring, clinical assessment, and lending. These differences persist across all eight matched strata, extend across model families, and transfer to unseen names. Hidden-state interventions further show that the measured task directions have downstream leverage, shifting later constrained choices. Unequal lexical support is therefore demographically structured at the input and remains visible in task-relevant model computation. NameTrace makes lexical comparability measurable, supporting a broader principle: behavioral comparability begins with lexical comparability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 近 50 万个名字在 12 个 LLM tokenizer 上的直接单 token 访问高度选择性且随模型而异，并在种族/性别关联分层上不均；提出 NameTrace，用模型自身在任务形容词轴上的概率与连续任务权重度量概念可及性。在同分层内匹配的原子名与短碎片名上，token 支持差异在 fellowship、hiring、clinical assessment、lending 四类任务中预测出系统性概念可及性差异，8 个匹配分层全部成立、跨模型家族迁移并泛化到未见名字，隐状态干预显示这些任务方向能改变后续受约束选择。
Motivation: 用配对名字评估 LLM 对不同人群的公平性，前提是配对名字是等价模型输入；但名字在词法接口上可能一个 token 直取、另一个要拼多个 subword，使行为比较从输入端就失真。
Method: NameTrace 是 pre-behavioral 框架：先在近 50 万个名字与 12 个 LLM tokenizer 上统计直接词法访问，再用模型自身在任务特定形容词轴上的概率、配连续任务对齐权重度量概念可及性；在同种族/族裔-性别分层内匹配原子名与短碎片名，并用隐状态干预检验任务方向的下游作用。
Result: 覆盖近 50 万个 first names 与 12 个 LLM-associated tokenizers，直接词法访问高度选择性、随模型而异且在 race/gender 关联元数据上不均；在全部 8 个匹配分层中，token 支持差异对应 fellowship、hiring、clinical assessment、lending 上的系统性概念可及性差异，跨模型家族成立并迁移到未见名字；隐状态干预使后续受约束选择发生偏移。
Conclusion: 名字的词法支持不均是人口结构化的输入属性，并在任务相关模型计算中持续可见，因此行为可比性以词法可比性为前提。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning Perturbation Robust Policies for LLM Agents with Stable Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective post-training paradigm for long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents. However, we find that the resulting policies can be sensitive to various policy perturbations, such as hidden-state noise, pruning, and quantization. In this work, we study how to improve perturbation robustness during policy optimization. We first introduce the notion of a perturbation robust policy and analyze conditions under which perturbed policy updates preserve stable monotonic improvement. Based on this analysis, we introduce Stable Perturbation-Robust Policy Optimization (SPrPO), which applies adaptive and sensitivity-aware perturbations during RL training. We evaluate SPrPO on ALFWorld and WebShop and conduct systematic experiments across multiple perturbation types and scales, showing improved perturbation robustness while maintaining stable policy optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM agent 强化学习后训练中策略对隐藏状态加噪、剪枝、量化等扰动敏感的问题，提出扰动鲁棒策略 (perturbation robust policy) 的定义与稳定单调改进的保持条件，并据此设计 SPrPO，在 RL 训练中施加自适应、感知敏感度的扰动。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上跨多种扰动类型与尺度的实验显示扰动鲁棒性提升，同时策略优化保持稳定。
Motivation: RL 后训练得到的长时程 LLM agent 策略对隐藏状态噪声、剪枝、量化等策略扰动敏感，扰动后的策略更新可能失去稳定的单调改进，鲁棒性与训练稳定性难以兼得。
Method: 先给出扰动鲁棒策略的形式化定义，并分析扰动后策略更新仍保持稳定单调改进的条件；据此提出 Stable Perturbation-Robust Policy Optimization (SPrPO)，在 RL 训练过程中施加自适应且感知敏感度 (sensitivity-aware) 的扰动。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个 LLM agent 环境上，跨多种扰动类型与多个扰动尺度做系统实验，结果显示扰动鲁棒性改善，同时策略优化保持稳定。
Conclusion: 把扰动鲁棒性作为优化目标的一部分、在训练中主动施加自适应扰动，可以在不牺牲优化稳定性的前提下提升 LLM agent 策略对部署期扰动的抵抗力。

papers.title: Counterexamples to Local Reconstruction Gain as a Proxy for Final Fidelity in Residual Completion
papers.abstract_en: Residual completion augments query-aware sparse attention by estimating the contribution of tokens omitted from the exact sparse computation. We ask whether improving a layer's attention-output reconstruction on the same incoming Q/K/V and selected support necessarily improves the fidelity of the final model output. We study training-free RESA and learned Top-K+$φ$ with frozen backbone language models. A prespecified single-layer screen yields two Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum interventions for which direct-runtime measurements show positive prespecified request-aggregate local reconstruction gain but worse final KL fidelity than the corresponding all-abstain Exact Top-K baseline on both discovery and prompt-token-disjoint holdout requests. Exact restoration at the same layer instead improves final fidelity, showing that the reversal is specific to approximate completion in these cases. In complementary multi-layer experiments, a task-independent local diagnostic often repairs the tested completion estimators, although the repaired models do not consistently outperform Exact Top-K. Together, these results show that better local reconstruction need not translate into better final-model fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出反例：在残差补全 (residual completion) 中，某一层注意力输出的局部重建增益为正，并不保证最终模型输出保真度更好。在 Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum 上，训练无关的 RESA 与学习型 Top-K+φ 的两个预设干预在发现集与 prompt-token 不相交的留出请求上，局部重建增益为正但最终 KL 保真度差于 all-abstain 的 Exact Top-K 基线；同层精确恢复则提升最终保真度，说明反转特指近似补全。
Motivation: query-aware 稀疏注意力用残差补全估计被略去 token 的贡献，通常默认局部重建更好就等于最终输出更忠实；本文质疑这一代理指标是否必然成立。
Method: 在冻结骨干语言模型上研究训练无关的 RESA 与学习型 Top-K+φ；先用预设的单层筛选 (single-layer screen) 找出干预，再用直接运行时测量比较局部重建增益与最终 KL 保真度，并在发现请求与 prompt-token 不相交的留出请求上检验，另做同层精确恢复与多层补充实验。
Result: 单层筛选得到两个 Qwen3-0.6B/Multi-LexSum 干预：局部重建增益为正但最终 KL 保真度差于 all-abstain 的 Exact Top-K 基线，且在发现集与 prompt-token 不相交留出集上均成立；同层精确恢复提升最终保真度，表明反转为近似补全特有。多层实验中，一个任务无关的局部诊断常能修复被测补全估计器，但修复后的模型并不一致优于 Exact Top-K。
Conclusion: 更好的局部重建不必然转化为更好的最终模型保真度，因此局部重建增益不能作为残差补全最终保真的可靠代理；任务无关局部诊断可修复估计器但不足以稳定超过 Exact Top-K。

papers.title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把回归与 flow matching 统一到同一目标并导出分位数目标，提出 Quantile Head：一次前向输出中位数与正间隔，构成有序的动作边缘分位数，无需重训即可支持多种采样策略。联合监督下直接更新中位数的方差低于仅中位数监督；在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 与两项真机任务上取得最高平均成功率，并在匹配的 LIBERO 基线中平均单集时间最短。
Motivation: VLA 动作头要么点回归只给点估计，要么标准 flow-matching 采样需要昂贵的迭代采样，二者限制了动作分布表达与推理效率。
Method: 在共享目标下统一回归与 flow matching，进而导出 quantile objective；Quantile Head 预测中位数与正 gap 组成有序边缘分位数，一次前向完成，分位数联合监督并同时训练默认中位数策略，支持免重训的多种采样策略。
Result: 联合监督的中位数策略在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 及两项真机任务上取得所比较方法中的最高平均成功率，并在匹配的 LIBERO 基线中平均单集时间最短；局部分析显示在邻近分位数校准、gap 固定、修正速度匹配时，直接中位数更新的方差低于仅中位数监督。
Conclusion: 一次前向输出有序分位数并联合监督中位数，可同时换来更高成功率与更短单集时间，且分位数本身支持免重训的多种采样策略。

papers.title: KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-specialized multi-agent systems enable multiple agents to share a model while performing complementary roles to solve complex tasks. However, agent-specific prefixes change the KV cache generated for the same shared context, causing each agent to repeatedly prefill the growing context and construct a separate cache with high computation and memory overhead. Selective recomputation reduces this redundancy but still retains substantial model execution, while existing delta correction methods either support only recurring context relations or maintain memory-intensive online correction states for dynamically changing context. For first seen shared context, these methods also construct a reference cache outside the agent workflow, and an approximate correction at the first agent affects the outputs passed to subsequent agents. We present KVCMAS, an online KV cache correction framework that represents cross-agent cache deviations using compact low-rank states and seamlessly chains corrections along the agent workflow without an additional reference prefill. This design supports dynamically changing shared context while preserving an exact first-agent cache. Across multiple language and vision-language workloads, KVCMAS matches or improves the accuracy of prior KV cache sharing methods while achieving the lowest TTFT under highly concurrent serving. Under controlled serving traces, it provides a 2.0x TTFT speedup over inference without KV cache sharing and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 3.7x relative to a prior KV cache correction method. These results establish KVCMAS as an accurate and scalable KV cache sharing approach for prompt-specialized multi-agent serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KVCMAS 用紧凑低秩状态表示跨 agent 的 KV cache 偏差，沿 agent 工作流链式传递校正且无需额外 reference prefill，同时保留首个 agent 的精确 cache。在高并发 serving 下 TTFT 相对不做 KV cache 共享的推理提速 2.0x，峰值 GPU 显存相对既有 KV cache 校正方法最多降低 3.7x，精度匹配或优于先前共享方法。
Motivation: prompt-specialized 多 agent 系统中，agent 专属前缀使同一共享上下文产生不同 KV cache，各 agent 反复 prefill 不断增长的上下文并各自建 cache，计算与内存开销高；选择性重算仍留大量模型执行，既有 delta 校正只支持周期性上下文关系或需维护内存密集的在线校正状态。
Method: KVCMAS 是在线 KV cache 校正框架：用紧凑低秩状态刻画跨 agent cache 偏差，沿 agent 工作流链式传递校正，不需额外 reference prefill；首个 agent 的 cache 保持精确，从而支持动态变化的共享上下文。
Result: 在多种语言与视觉语言负载上，精度匹配或优于先前 KV cache 共享方法，高并发 serving 下 TTFT 最低；受控 serving trace 中，相对不做 KV cache 共享的推理 TTFT 提速 2.0x，峰值 GPU 显存相对既有 KV cache 校正方法最多降低 3.7x。
Conclusion: 低秩链式校正加精确首 agent cache，可在 prompt-specialized 多 agent serving 中同时做到准确、可扩展的 KV cache 共享并压低 TTFT 与显存。

papers.title: Do World Models Learn Global Understanding?
papers.abstract_en: AI systems often feel brittle and fragmented. A large language model (LLM) may correctly explain a concept but fail to apply it, or follow safety instructions in one context but not another. This behavior suggests a general failure to lift local information to a global understanding. To gain fundamental insight, we frame "understanding" as learning constraints and propagating their consequences. We construct learning tasks on monoid worlds, sets of states connected by action transitions, where observed training transitions and an unseen constraint jointly determine held-out transitions. Measuring generalization tests whether models can learn global constraints from local transitions and propagate their consequences. We consider inverse, commutativity, composition, and periodicity constraints relevant to spatial and semantic structure. Across attention, recurrent, and state-space architectures, next-state training fits the data but fails to propagate non-trivial constraints. Compositional training, which uses identical paths but hides intermediate states from the input, achieves 96% accuracy on inverse, commutativity, and composition constraints across architectures, yields corresponding improvements in geometric generalization of world models trained on embodied environments and relational generalization in Wikidata-finetuned LLMs. How far do models propagate constraints when inferring an unseen fact may depend on first inferring others? We define proof depth d of a held-out transition, measuring the minimum number of inference rounds to infer the transition, and find that model generalization decreases sharply with proof depth. Increasing compositional path length T improves generalization. These results provide a formal way to investigate global understanding in language and world models and demonstrate that compositional training promotes information propagation and integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把“理解”形式化为学习约束并传播其后果，在 monoid worlds 上用观测转移加一条未见约束共同决定留出转移来测泛化。next-state 训练拟合数据但无法传播非平凡约束，而隐藏中间状态的 compositional training 在 inverse、commutativity、composition 三类约束上跨架构达到 96% 准确率，并把收益带到具身环境 world model 的几何泛化与 Wikidata 微调 LLM 的关系泛化。
Motivation: LLM 会解释概念却不会应用、在一种语境遵守安全指令换语境就失效，说明局部信息无法提升为全局理解；缺少可度量的框架来判定模型是否真的学到了约束并传播其推论。
Method: 构造 monoid worlds 学习任务：状态由动作转移连接，观测训练转移与一条未见约束共同决定留出转移，约束取 inverse、commutativity、composition、periodicity 四类；对比 next-state 训练与 compositional training（路径相同但把中间状态从输入中隐藏），在 attention、recurrent、state-space 三类架构上比较，并定义 proof depth d（推断留出转移所需的最少推理轮数）与路径长度 T。
Result: next-state 训练能拟合数据但无法传播非平凡约束；compositional training 在 inverse、commutativity、composition 约束上跨架构达到 96% 准确率，并相应提升具身环境中 world model 的几何泛化和 Wikidata 微调 LLM 的关系泛化。泛化随 proof depth d 增大而急剧下降，增大 compositional 路径长度 T 则改善泛化。
Conclusion: 全局理解可被操作化为“从局部转移学出约束并按 proof depth 传播其后果”，而 compositional training 是促成信息传播与整合的训练方式。
Relevance: 16

papers.title: Steering Language Model Goals with Value Transplant
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models often act as if they pursue goals, but their efforts are not always directed toward what users intend, sometimes leading them to pursue unintended outcomes. Previous work has examined how models may internally track their progress toward their goals through a "value axis." We study whether changing such a signal can retarget the model's search toward a different goal. We test value transplant: at each token, we shift the host model's activation along a candidate value axis by the donor-host difference in value coordinates (multiplied by a large scalar), aiming to redirect the host toward the donor's goal. We study this intervention in Qwen3-8B and GPT-OSS-20B models fine-tuned into honest and cheating variants. We test several candidate value axes, including a self-rating axis constructed from activations preceding high versus low elicited self-ratings of progress. The intervention works in both directions, with an honest donor reducing test-gaming in a cheating host and a cheating donor increasing test-gaming in an honest host, showing that this signal can influence which strategy the model follows. On solvable coding tasks, transplant from an honest donor also improves the cheating host's hidden-test performance. Value transplant also works across model families, providing preliminary evidence for the intervention in a setting relevant to model control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 value transplant：在每个 token 上沿候选 value axis 平移宿主模型激活，位移取供体与宿主在价值坐标上的差乘以一个大标量，把宿主的搜索重定向到供体的目标。在微调出诚实/作弊两版的 Qwen3-8B 与 GPT-OSS-20B 上双向生效——诚实供体降低作弊宿主的 test-gaming，作弊供体抬高诚实宿主的 test-gaming，且诚实供体还能提升作弊宿主在可解编码任务上的隐藏测试表现，并跨模型家族成立。
Motivation: 推理模型会表现出追逐目标的行为，但其努力未必指向用户意图，可能追求非预期结果；已有工作发现模型内部通过 value axis 跟踪目标进度，缺的是能否主动改写该信号来改变模型所追求的目标。
Method: value transplant 干预：每步按供体与宿主在价值坐标上的差（乘大标量）平移宿主激活，使其转向供体目标；测试多条候选 value axis，含由高/低自评进度前的激活构成的 self-rating axis；对象是微调成诚实与作弊变体的 Qwen3-8B 和 GPT-OSS-20B。
Result: 干预双向起效：诚实供体降低作弊宿主的 test-gaming，作弊供体提高诚实宿主的 test-gaming；在可解编码任务上，诚实供体的 transplant 提升作弊宿主的隐藏测试表现；干预跨模型家族同样成立。
Conclusion: 价值轴上的激活信号足以影响模型采用哪种策略，因此可作为模型控制相关的干预抓手；跨家族结果被作者定位为初步证据。
