summary_sections.result: 干预双向起效：诚实供体降低作弊宿主的 test-gaming，作弊供体提高诚实宿主的 test-gaming；在可解编码任务上，诚实供体的 transplant 提升作弊宿主的隐藏测试表现；干预跨模型家族同样成立。
summary_sections.conclusion: 价值轴上的激活信号足以影响模型采用哪种策略，因此可作为模型控制相关的干预抓手；跨家族结果被作者定位为初步证据。

papers.title: PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Multi-LoRA agent systems enable efficient role specialization by sharing a common backbone model. However, each agent repeatedly processes the growing shared trajectory and constructs its own KV cache, introducing substantial memory and computation redundancy in long-horizon tasks. Existing KV cache sharing methods reduce this repeated prefill, but they either require additional training or architectural constraints or retain substantial model computation. Moreover, direct cache reuse causes the current agent to rely on cache states generated by the previous agent's adapter, weakening the role-specific behavior encoded by its own LoRA. We present PReCache, a training-free KV cache sharing framework with two designs, namely PreLRShared and ReBaseShared, that share the base cache computed using the pretrained weights and precompute a compact agent-specific low-rank (LR) cache. To remove repeated prefill, PreLRShared precomputes each agent's LR cache when the shared context is first processed, allowing the current agent to use its own LR cache without reprocessing context processed by previous agents. To improve sharing accuracy, ReBaseShared reconstructs the shared base cache from adapter-free hidden states, reducing the remaining error caused by the previous agent's adapted representation. To minimize its reconstruction cost, we propose two inference schemes tailored to single-stream inference and concurrent serving, performing the same reconstruction after each agent's turn or alongside its execution, respectively. Across multiple models and agent benchmarks, PreLRShared achieves up to a 3.1x TTFT speedup and a 2.3x improvement in per-request throughput over inference without KV cache sharing. ReBaseShared best preserves accuracy overall among the evaluated cache-sharing methods, with an average drop of only 1.1 points relative to inference without cache sharing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PReCache 是面向 multi-LoRA agent 的免训练 KV cache 共享框架：PreLRShared 在共享上下文首次处理时预计算各 agent 的低秩 (LR) cache 以省掉重复 prefill，ReBaseShared 从无 adapter 的 hidden states 重建共享 base cache 以纠正上一 agent 表示带来的偏差。在多个模型与 agent benchmark 上，PreLRShared 相对无 cache 共享的推理取得最高 3.1x TTFT 加速与 2.3x 单请求吞吐提升，ReBaseShared 在所评测的 cache-sharing 方法中精度保持最好，平均仅下降 1.1 分。
Motivation: Multi-LoRA agent 系统中每个 agent 都要反复处理不断增长的共享轨迹并各自建 KV cache，在长程任务里造成大量内存与计算冗余；已有 cache 共享方法要么需要额外训练或结构约束，要么仍保留可观计算，且直接复用缓存会让当前 agent 依赖上一 agent adapter 产生的状态，削弱自身 LoRA 编码的角色行为。
Method: PReCache 含两个免训练设计：PreLRShared 在共享上下文首次被处理时预计算每个 agent 的紧凑 LR cache，使当前 agent 直接使用自己的 LR cache 而不重跑前序 agent 处理过的上下文；ReBaseShared 从 adapter-free hidden states 重建共享 base cache，以消除上一 agent 适配表示残留的误差。为压低重建开销，另给出两种推理方案：单流推理在每轮结束后做同一重建，并发服务则在 agent 执行的同时并行重建。
Result: 在多个模型与 agent benchmark 上，PreLRShared 相对不带 KV cache 共享的推理最高取得 3.1x TTFT 加速与 2.3x 单请求吞吐提升；ReBaseShared 在所评测的 cache-sharing 方法中整体精度保持最好，相对无 cache 共享的推理平均仅下降 1.1 分。
Conclusion: 把共享 base cache 与 agent 专属低秩 cache 分开预计算并从无 adapter 状态重建，可以在免训练前提下同时拿到 cache 共享的速度收益和角色特异精度；重建成本需按单流与并发两种推理形态分别安排。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Statistical Cost of Causal Discovery with Feedback
papers.abstract_en: What determines the unavoidable sample cost of learning cyclic causal structure? For cyclic linear non-Gaussian models, we study exact condensation recovery from observational data: identifying the strongly connected component (SCC) partition and all edges between components. We establish the first information-theoretic lower bounds on sample complexity for this target. For $p$ variables, maximum SCC size $s_{\max}$, and maximum external-parent count $d_B$, any estimator requires order $s_{\max}\log(ep/s_{\max})+d_B\log(ep/d_B)$ samples in the worst case over a regular model class. These bounds distinguish the costs of SCC membership and external-parent selection. Under principal invertibility and without correlation faithfulness, we establish a population block-exogeneity principle that identifies unknown root SCCs through residual independence and inclusion minimality. A sparse-adjustment characterization shows that small adjustment sets suffice to identify SCCs and their direct external parents, without regressing on all previously recovered variables. These characterizations yield BlockExo, which attains a structurally matching sample bound without knowing $s_{\max}$ or $d_B$ under suitable conditions. Simulations support the structural dependence of our sample bound and demonstrate BlockExo's sample-efficient recovery in comparisons with other methods for cyclic causal discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对含环线性非高斯模型的因果结构学习，给出精确浓缩恢复（识别强连通分量 SCC 划分及分量间全部边）的首个信息论样本复杂度下界：最坏情形需 Ω(s_max·log(ep/s_max)+d_B·log(ep/d_B)) 个样本。由此导出的 BlockExo 算法借助总体块外生性原理（残差独立 + 包含极小性）识别根 SCC，无需预知 s_max 或 d_B 即达到结构匹配的样本界。
Motivation: 含反馈环的因果结构学习缺少样本复杂度的理论下界，无法区分 SCC 成员判定与外部父节点选择各自的代价，也难以判断算法所需样本量是否本质上必要。
Method: 对循环线性非高斯模型建立首个信息论下界；在主可逆性 (principal invertibility) 且不假设相关忠实性条件下，提出总体块外生性原理，用残差独立与包含极小性识别未知根 SCC；再给出稀疏调整刻画，说明小调整集足以识别 SCC 及其直接外部父变量，据此构造 BlockExo 算法。
Result: 最坏情形样本复杂度下界为 s_max·log(ep/s_max)+d_B·log(ep/d_B)（p 个变量、最大 SCC 大小 s_max、最大外部父计数 d_B）；BlockExo 在适当条件下达到结构匹配的样本界且无需知道 s_max、d_B；模拟验证样本界对结构的依赖，并在与其他循环因果发现方法的比较中展示 BlockExo 的样本高效恢复。
Conclusion: 含环因果浓缩恢复的样本代价由 SCC 成员与外部父选择两项分别决定，且小调整集足以实现结构匹配的高效恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thinking Outside the Box: Retention and Transmission of Information in Sliding-Window KV Inference
papers.abstract_en: Sliding-window KV inference refers to processing a sequence incrementally while retaining only a fixed-size cache of recent key and value states. It can be applied to pretrained causal transformers at inference time without additional training, while its KV-cache memory remains fixed as more tokens are processed. Because cached states are computed in the context of earlier tokens, they may carry information from beyond the current window and transmit it to later states. This study presents a series of experiments using five open-weight models spanning Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Muse Glimmer. We investigate whether information originating outside the immediate context window can persist through a rolling KV cache and remain useful for retrieval. Initial results show that retaining previously computed states improves retrieval across the models tested compared with recomputing the final fixed window from raw tokens. We then measure how far this effect extends and find that Muse Glimmer and Mistral 7B show the strongest \emph{latent information relay}: they can recover information even after the relevant source tokens have left the cache. Both models incorporate sliding-window attention in their published architectures, an association that motivates testing whether training with sliding windows promotes more reliable information retention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 滑窗 KV 推理 (sliding-window KV inference) 中，缓存态是在早期 token 语境下算出的，因而可能把窗口外信息携带给后续状态。对 Qwen、Llama、Mistral、Muse Glimmer 五个开源模型的实验显示，保留已算缓存比用原始 token 重算最后一个固定窗口的检索效果更好；Muse Glimmer 与 Mistral 7B 的 latent information relay 最强，能在源 token 已离开缓存后仍恢复信息。
Motivation: 滑窗 KV 推理可在推理期免训练地把缓存固定为常数内存，但窗口外信息能否经滚动缓存持续传递并仍可用于检索，此前不清楚。
Method: 在五个开源权重模型（跨 Qwen、Llama、Mistral、Muse Glimmer）上做一系列实验，对比保留先前计算的缓存态与从原始 token 重算最后一个固定窗口，并测量该效应能延伸多远。
Result: 保留已算状态在所有受测模型上的检索表现均优于重算最后固定窗口；Muse Glimmer 与 Mistral 7B 显示最强的 latent information relay，可在相关源 token 离开缓存后仍恢复信息，且两者公开架构本身含 sliding-window attention。
Conclusion: 滚动 KV 缓存确实能传递窗口外信息，作者据此提出用滑窗训练可能促进更可靠的信息保留这一待检验假设。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
authors: Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (ρ=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARCH-B 是一个建筑跨表示视觉对应基准：354 道四选一题、11 类跨表示 archetypes，源自 390 万张建筑图像语料，用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导难度筛选与人工校验构建。评测 25 个多模态模型与 5,830 份非专业人类回答，模型准确率 10.45%–83.90%，人类基线 35.35%，且人机难度排序仅弱相关（Spearman ρ=0.33）。
Motivation: 多模态模型能否在照片、平面图、立面、剖面、渲染图之间认出同一栋建筑，此前缺少系统刻画；现有评测无法区分跨媒介表示迁移的真实能力。
Method: 从建筑关联语料（390 万张图像）出题，用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导难度筛选 (model-guided difficulty screening) 与人工校验构建 354 道四选一题，覆盖 11 类跨表示 archetypes；评测 25 个多模态模型并采集 5,830 份非专业人类回答，另做 held-out 评估检验筛选出的难度是否外推。
Result: 模型准确率区间 10.45%–83.90%，人类基线 35.35%；模型在混合表示异常检测与照片匹配上表现较好，在平面图到照片对应 (floorplan-to-photograph correspondence) 上偏弱；人机在各 archetype 上的难度仅弱相关（Spearman ρ=0.33）；held-out 评估确认筛选阶段识别的难度可外推到筛选模型之外。
Conclusion: 跨建筑媒介的视觉对应与表示迁移仍是多模态模型的诊断性短板，且人机难度感知不一致，因此难度标注不能只靠模型或只靠人来定。

papers.title: Kafila: Serving Large Language Models on a Trusted Set of Heterogeneous Commodity Machines
papers.abstract_en: Between them, the members of a research group or a circle of friends own several consumer computers, none large enough to run a capable large language model. Existing systems pool such capacity across open swarms anyone may join, which a group admitting only trusted machines cannot use. Bounding membership removes what they depend on: a swarm holds each part of the model on several peers and routes around a slow one. A bounded session must use every device it admits. Its pipeline advances at the pace of whichever device received a share it cannot serve quickly, so the division has to be right before serving begins. We propose Kafila, whose protocol assembles a ring from behind NATs, preferring direct paths and relaying where traversal fails, while its planner measures each device's memory bandwidth, capacity and reachability, divides the model exactly for a fixed ring order, and places the head, which holds the embedding and output projection, together with that division rather than beforehand. On machines with different capabilities across three fleets, from a shared LAN to five devices spanning two continents, Kafila shortens the slowest pipeline stage by up to $5.2\times$ against the even split of pipeline parallelism, as in GPipe, and up to $3\times$ against the memory-proportional split of personal-device inference, as in exo, keeps 75 to 87 per cent of the committed hardware doing work where those divisions fall below half, and serves a model no uniform split can place on the fleet at all. What that is worth to a user depends on how much of a token is computation rather than network. Where the members share a network the same division returns $1.56\times$ the throughput of a uniform split and $1.25\times$ of a memory-proportional one, and under four concurrent users that lead compounds to $3.2\times$ rather than fading, each user served at almost the rate of one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kafila 面向只由可信消费级机器组成的封闭群组做 LLM 流水线并行：协议在 NAT 后组环（直连优先、失败则中继），planner 先实测每台设备的内存带宽、容量与可达性，再按固定环序精确切分模型并把 head（embedding 与输出投影）随切分一起放置。在三个 fleet（共享 LAN 到横跨两大洲的五台设备）上，最慢流水线阶段较 GPipe 式均分最多缩短 5.2×，较 exo 式按内存比例切分最多缩短 3×；共享网络下吞吐为均分的 1.56×、为内存比例切分的 1.25×，四并发用户时优势累积到 3.2×。

Method: Kafila 协议在 NAT 后把设备组成环，直连路径优先、穿越失败时中继；planner 实测各设备内存带宽、容量与可达性，按固定环序把模型精确切分，并把持有 embedding 与输出投影的 head 与该切分绑定放置而非预先固定。

Conclusion: 在可信封闭群组里，按实测能力做非均匀切分并把 head 一并纳入规划，比均分或按内存比例切分更能压住最慢阶段；收益大小取决于单个 token 中计算相对网络的占比。

papers.title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPD 用稀疏上下文的 on-policy 自蒸馏让 VLM 在剪枝后的视觉 token 上学会可靠利用残余证据：学生从剪枝 token 生成推理轨迹，全上下文特权教师对同一批 on-policy 前缀做监督，无需真值答案、结构改动或额外推理开销。在 10% 视觉 token 保留率下，Vanilla 模型只保住未剪枝性能的 86.37%（13 个基准），SCOPD 提到 90.49%，SCOPD+ 进一步到 92.43%。
Motivation: 推理型 VLM 要把图像视频当长视觉 token 序列处理，推理昂贵；training-free token pruning 降本但激进压缩会大幅掉点，通常归因于任务相关信息被不可逆丢弃。
Method: 先用 fixed-context Pass@K 分析：对同一剪枝表示反复采样，看能否找回 greedy 解码漏掉的样本，据此提出 representation-utilization gap。SCOPD 框架中学生从剪枝视觉 token 生成推理轨迹，特权全上下文教师对相同 on-policy 前缀做自蒸馏，不需要 ground-truth 回答、结构改动或额外推理计算；SCOPD+ 用一次小的 visual-budget intervention 定位对视觉敏感的回答位置，只对这些位置选择性蒸馏。
Result: 10% 视觉 token 保留率下，Vanilla 模型在 13 个基准上保住未剪枝性能的 86.37%，SCOPD 达 90.49%，SCOPD+ 达 92.43%；结论横跨不同 token 预算、基准与剪枝算子。fixed-context Pass@K 显示对同一剪枝表示重复采样能找回 greedy 解码漏掉的许多样本。
Conclusion: 高效推理不只取决于哪些视觉信息在剪枝中存活，还取决于模型学会多可靠地使用它；表示-利用 gap 是可训练修复的，而非只能靠放宽压缩解决。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Singularities of Non-negative Matrix Factorization and their application to Bayesian inference
papers.abstract_en: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a singular statistical model whose Bayesian asymptotics are governed by the real log canonical threshold (RLCT). We study the local geometry of the factorization map and derive an upper bound for the RLCT of NMF. Let $H$ be the model inner dimension and $H_0$ the non-negative rank of the true $M\times N$ matrix. Assuming that the true matrix admits a strictly positive factorization of inner dimension $H_0$ in the interior of the parameter domain, we prove, for smooth positive priors, that $λ\leq \{(H-H_0)\min(M,N)+H_0(M+N-H_0)\}/2$. This bound strictly improves the previous bound when $H_0\geq3$. The proof uses a local analytic normal form that separates independent linear coordinates from a residual matrix product. When $H=H_0$ also equals the ordinary rank of the true matrix, we obtain the exact value $λ=H_0(M+N-H_0)/2$. Under the standard assumptions of singular learning theory, these results bound the leading coefficients of the expected Bayesian generalization error and the Bayesian free energy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NMF 是奇异统计模型，其贝叶斯渐近由实对数典范阈值 (RLCT) 决定；论文分析因子分解映射的局部几何，证明在真矩阵于参数域内部存在内维 H0 的严格正因子分解、先验光滑正的条件下，RLCT 满足 λ ≤ {(H−H0)min(M,N)+H0(M+N−H0)}/2，且当 H0≥3 时严格优于已有上界；当 H=H0 也等于真矩阵的普通秩时得到精确值 λ=H0(M+N−H0)/2。
Motivation: NMF 作为奇异模型的 RLCT 决定贝叶斯泛化误差与自由能的主阶系数，但此前的 RLCT 上界在非负秩 H0≥3 时不够紧，限制了对 NMF 贝叶斯渐近的刻画。
Method: 研究因子分解映射的局部几何，构造局部解析正规形 (local analytic normal form)，把独立线性坐标与残余矩阵乘积分离，据此在光滑正先验下推导 RLCT 上界；在标准奇异学习理论假设下将结果转为期望贝叶斯泛化误差与贝叶斯自由能主阶系数的界。
Result: 得到上界 λ ≤ {(H−H0)min(M,N)+H0(M+N−H0)}/2，在 H0≥3 时严格改进已有上界；当 H=H0 等于真矩阵普通秩时取得精确值 λ=H0(M+N−H0)/2；这些结果界定了期望贝叶斯泛化误差与贝叶斯自由能的主阶系数。
Conclusion: NMF 的 RLCT 可由内维 H、非负秩 H0 与矩阵尺寸 M、N 显式界定，在满秩匹配情形 (H=H0=普通秩) 下可精确求出，从而给出 NMF 贝叶斯渐近的可计算刻画。

papers.title: Vision--Language Signals in Constrained RL: Safety Gains Without Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximise task performance while satisfying safety constraints. In driving benchmarks, however, collision costs typically appear only at the time of collision, providing no advance warning of an approaching hazard. Frozen vision--language models can provide dense semantic feedback, yet it remains unclear whether their scores anticipate collisions and which component drives an observed safety improvement. Episodic cost can also favour policies that make little task progress. To address these gaps, we propose VLM-Safe-RL, a framework that integrates frozen CLIP signals into PPO-Lagrangian through reward shaping and an augmented multiplier update. On MetaDrive Hard, which combines the densest traffic with the largest map, the catastrophe rate falls from 31.6\% to 19.4\%. FormulaOne-L2 analysis finds no evidence that the CLIP signals anticipate collisions and shows that the VLM term has a negligible effect on the Lagrange multiplier. These findings show a conditional reduction in observed catastrophe rate without evidence of collision anticipation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM-Safe-RL 把冻结 CLIP 的视觉-语言信号接入 PPO-Lagrangian，用奖励整形与增广的乘子更新替代只在碰撞时刻出现的稀疏代价。在 MetaDrive Hard（最密车流+最大地图）上 catastrophe rate 从 31.6% 降到 19.4%，但 FormulaOne-L2 分析显示 CLIP 分数并不预示碰撞，VLM 项对 Lagrange 乘子的影响可忽略，即安全改善是条件性的、无碰撞预判证据。
Motivation: 驾驶基准里碰撞代价只在碰撞发生时出现，没有对危险的提前预警；冻结 VLM 能提供稠密语义反馈，但其分数是否预示碰撞、以及安全提升究竟由哪一部件驱动并不清楚。
Method: 提出 VLM-Safe-RL：将冻结 CLIP 信号经 reward shaping 注入 PPO-Lagrangian，并对 Lagrange 乘子更新做增广；在 MetaDrive Hard 与 FormulaOne-L2 上分别测 catastrophe rate 与 CLIP 信号的预判性、VLM 项对乘子的贡献。
Result: MetaDrive Hard 上 catastrophe rate 由 31.6% 降至 19.4%；FormulaOne-L2 分析未发现 CLIP 信号预示碰撞的证据，且 VLM 项对 Lagrange 乘子的作用可忽略。
Conclusion: 观测到的 catastrophe rate 下降是条件性的，没有证据表明 CLIP 信号具备碰撞预判能力；稠密语义反馈带来的安全收益并非来自提前预警通道。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large Language Models for Structured Clinical Data Analysis: Dual-Agent Grounding and Validation
papers.abstract_en: Objective: To develop and characterize CLEAR-Med, a dual-agent framework for natural-language analysis of structured clinical data that separates SQL-based invocation from independent validation. Methods: CLEAR-Med uses one agent to translate a question into executable Structured Query Language (SQL), retain the executed query and database result, and produce a draft. Deterministic checks and a separately invoked cross-provider Validation Agent then accept the draft, request one bounded repair, or abstain. We formalized the system as a bounded selective pipeline and evaluated CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability, and the Invocation Agent's accuracy and consistency on a 25-query development benchmark, using a harmonized 21-site neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy table containing 532 de-identified infant records and approximately 1,300 variables. Results: CLEAR-Med completed all six nominal scalability configurations, including 500x1300. Across 25 development-benchmark queries repeated five times, the Invocation Agent answered 83 of 125 responses correctly (66.4%; query-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 48.0-83.2%), compared with 15 of 125 (12.0%; 95% CI, 3.2-22.4%) for the ungrounded ChatGPT baseline, a paired improvement of 54.4 percentage points (95% CI, 36.8-72.0%). Conclusion: CLEAR-Med provides a general architecture for traceable analysis of structured clinical data: numerical claims remain linked to executed SQL, and unresolved cases can fail closed. The reported experiments characterize CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability and the Invocation Agent's accuracy, while the formal analysis establishes the encoded-property guarantee of the complete control flow; a prospective full-pipeline evaluation of the validation and abstention stages is the next stage of this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLEAR-Med 用双 agent 把自然语言到 SQL 的调用与独立校验分开：Invocation Agent 生成并保留可执行 SQL 与结果，确定性检查加单独调用的 Validation Agent 决定接受、一次有界修复或弃权。在 25 条查询重复 5 次的开发基准上，Invocation Agent 答对 83/125（66.4%），无 grounding 的 ChatGPT 基线为 15/125（12.0%），配对提升 54.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 结构化临床数据的自然语言问答里，直接让 LLM 作答会给出无法追溯到查询与数据的数值结论；需要把 SQL 调用与校验解耦，使每个数字都能挂回实际执行的查询。
Method: Invocation Agent 把问题翻译成可执行 SQL，保留执行后的查询与数据库结果并产出草稿；随后跑确定性检查，再单独调用跨 provider 的 Validation Agent，输出接受、一次有界修复或弃权。系统被形式化为有界选择性 pipeline (bounded selective pipeline)，在 21 个站点、532 条去标识婴儿记录、约 1300 个变量的新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病 (HIE) 表上评测配置、可扩展性与调用准确率。
Result: 完成全部六种名义可扩展性配置，含 500×1300；25 条开发基准查询各重复 5 次共 125 次回答中，Invocation Agent 答对 83 次（66.4%，query-cluster bootstrap 95% CI 48.0–83.2%），无 grounding 的 ChatGPT 基线 15 次（12.0%，95% CI 3.2–22.4%），配对提升 54.4 个百分点（95% CI 36.8–72.0%）。
Conclusion: 作者主张该架构可作为结构化临床数据可追溯分析的通用方案：数值声明始终绑定已执行的 SQL，未解决的案例 fail closed；形式化分析给出完整控制流的编码属性保证，而校验与弃权阶段的前瞻性全流程评测被列为下一步工作。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Cost-Sensitive Online Window Size Selection for Portfolio Management
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates cost-sensitive online window size selection for portfolio management under changing market conditions. Specifically, we propose a two-level framework that constructs portfolios using candidate window sizes and dynamically aggregates them through online learning. By treating candidate window sizes as ``experts,'' we dynamically update their aggregation weights using turnover-inclusive losses. Moreover, we derive finite-horizon cost-sensitive tracking-regret bounds that account for turnover of the aggregated portfolio, with static regret as a special case. Under bounded losses and cost rates, suitably tuned Fixed Share achieves asymptotically no tracking regret for sublinear switching budgets, with Hedge covering the static case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在换手成本不可忽略的组合管理中，把候选窗口长度当作专家，用含 turnover 的损失在线更新聚合权重，并给出有限时域 cost-sensitive tracking-regret 上界；在有界损失与成本率下，调好的 Fixed Share 对次线性切换预算渐近无 tracking regret，Hedge 覆盖静态情形。
Motivation: 市场状态变化时窗口长度需要在线调整，但忽略换手成本的在线学习会因频繁调仓而放大实际成本，静态 regret 又无法刻画窗口切换带来的代价。
Method: 两层框架：先用各候选窗口长度分别构建组合，再把窗口长度视作 experts，用含 turnover 的损失 (turnover-inclusive losses) 在线更新聚合权重；推导计入聚合组合换手的有限时域 cost-sensitive tracking-regret 上界，静态 regret 作为特例。
Result: 在有界损失与有界成本率假设下，适当调参的 Fixed Share 对次线性切换预算达到渐近无 tracking regret；Hedge 覆盖静态（无切换）情形；静态 regret 是所推导上界的特例。
Conclusion: 把窗口选择建模为带换手成本的专家聚合问题，可以在换手预算次线性时保证 tracking regret 次线性，从而把成本敏感性直接写进 regret 保证。

papers.title: AV-GRPO: Modality-Anchored Decoupling Diffusion Reinforcement Learning for Joint Audio-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed major progress in joint audio-video generation. Existing models still suffer from limited per-modality fidelity, insufficient text-modality alignment and weak cross-modal synchronization. While reinforcement-learning post-training offers a promising remedy, directly adapting it to joint audio-video generation is challenging. Heterogeneous multimodal rewards entangle learning signals and complicate credit assignment. Joint optimization of two modality towers is computationally expensive given their divergent dynamics. Moreover, synchronization evaluation difficulty depends on paired samples, preventing fair reward comparisons. We propose AV-GRPO, a modality-anchored online diffusion RL framework, and 5DAV, a decoupled, difficulty-controllable training dataset. AV-GRPO includes three key modules: (1) modality-anchored rollouts to disentangle learning signals and stabilize difficulty; (2) trajectory-locked frozen-tower optimization to reduce cost and reassign credit; (3) adaptive objectives and perturbation strengths tailored to modality-specific dynamics. This converts coupled multimodal preference learning into unimodal subproblems for precise reward attribution and better synchronization. Our 5DAV dataset decouples samples across five dimensions for systematic training. Experiments on JavisBench and VABench demonstrate AV-GRPO outperforms LTX-2.3 in generation quality, semantic alignment and cross-modal synchronization under LoRA and full fine-tuning. Ablations confirm our designs. Code and data: https://github.com/zhiyuxu03/AV-GRPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AV-GRPO 把联合音视频生成的 RL 后训练拆成单模态子问题：模态锚定 rollout 解耦学习信号，轨迹锁定的冻结塔优化降低双塔联合训练开销并重新分配 credit，自适应目标与扰动强度匹配各模态动态。配套发布五维解耦、难度可控的数据集 5DAV。在 JavisBench 与 VABench 上，LoRA 与全量微调两种设置下 AV-GRPO 在生成质量、语义对齐和跨模态同步上均超过 LTX-2.3，消融验证各模块设计。
Motivation: 联合音视频生成受限于单模态保真度不足、文本对齐弱和跨模态同步差；直接套用 RL 后训练时，异构多模态奖励纠缠学习信号、双塔联合优化开销大，且同步评估依赖配对样本导致奖励难以公平比较。
Method: 提出模态锚定的在线扩散 RL 框架 AV-GRPO，含三个模块：模态锚定 rollout 解耦学习信号并稳定难度；轨迹锁定的冻结塔优化 (trajectory-locked frozen-tower optimization) 降低计算成本并重新分配 credit；针对各模态动态的自适应目标与扰动强度。同时提出解耦、难度可控的训练数据集 5DAV，按五个维度解耦样本。
Result: 在 JavisBench 与 VABench 上，AV-GRPO 在 LoRA 与全量微调两种设置下，于生成质量、语义对齐和跨模态同步三项指标上均优于 LTX-2.3；消融实验确认各模块设计有效。
Conclusion: 把耦合的多模态偏好学习转成单模态子问题，可实现更精确的奖励归因并改善音视频同步，且该框架在参数高效与全量微调下都成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlashLoop: Fast and Memory-Efficient Looped Transformers via Lazy Updates
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers have attracted substantial attention as a parameter-efficient approach to increasing computational depth through repeated application of shared Transformer blocks. However, their practical advantages over conventional Transformers remain under debate: each additional loop incurs another Transformer pass and requires caching another set of KV states, causing inference FLOPs and KV-cache memory to grow continuously with loop depth. This overhead becomes particularly severe at large loop counts and long context, preventing the parameter efficiency of Looped Transformers from translating into practical inference efficiency. In this paper, we find that much of the additional computation and storage introduced by looping is redundant. As recurrence proceeds, state changes become increasingly concentrated on a small subset of tokens; attention-output differences are dominated by a sparse and stable subset of key columns; and KV residuals between adjacent loops become progressively more amenable to low-bit quantization. Building on these observations, we introduce FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework that reduces cross-loop redundancy through token-sparse updates, sparse attention, and KV-residual quantization. Across several Looped Transformers models, FlashLoop delivers lossless accuracy while achieving up to 1.64$\times$ end-to-end speedup and up to 6$\times$ KV-cache memory reduction, substantially improving the practicality of scaling Looped Transformers to greater computational depths and longer context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashLoop 是面向 Looped Transformer 的免训练推理框架，利用循环间状态变化集中在少数 token、注意力输出差异由稀疏稳定的 key 列主导、相邻循环 KV 残差适合低位量化这三条冗余，做 token 稀疏更新、稀疏注意力与 KV 残差量化。在多个 Looped Transformer 模型上保持无损精度，端到端加速最高 1.64×，KV-cache 内存最高降 6×。
Motivation: 每多一次循环就多一遍 Transformer 前向并多缓存一组 KV，推理 FLOPs 与 KV-cache 内存随循环深度持续增长，在大循环数与长上下文下抵消了参数效率带来的收益。
Method: 免训练推理框架，三条路径削减跨循环冗余：token 稀疏更新（状态变化集中于少量 token）、稀疏注意力（注意力输出差异由稀疏稳定 key 列主导）、KV 残差低位量化（相邻循环残差逐步更可量化）。
Result: 在多个 Looped Transformer 模型上保持无损精度，端到端加速最高 1.64×，KV-cache 内存最高降低 6×。
Conclusion: 循环引入的大部分计算与存储是冗余的，用稀疏与量化手段可把 Looped Transformer 的参数效率转成实际推理效率，支撑更大计算深度与更长上下文。

papers.title: Beyond Feature Reliability: Repeat-Informed Multifractal Curve Regression for Brain-Age Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Brain-age prediction from resting-state fMRI provides a quantitative framework for characterizing age-related changes in spontaneous brain dynamics and for identifying functional signatures. Existing studies have linked fractal and multifractal scaling to age and examined the reliability of individual features. However, prediction repeatability depends on how features fluctuate jointly and how a predictor combines them, which feature-wise reliability assessments do not capture. To address this problem, we propose Repeat-informed Multifractal Curve Regression (RMCR), a structured framework for learning stable age-predictive patterns from multifractal curves. By jointly modeling curve structure and repeat-scan variability, RMCR learns predictive combinations of fluctuation orders that target both accuracy and within-subject consistency. Relative to a matched run-level ridge baseline, RMCR reduces single-run MAE by 6.1% on HCP-A and 7.9% on an external Cam-CAN cohort, and within-visit repeat absolute difference by 18.5% on HCP-A, using a single scan at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Repeat-informed Multifractal Curve Regression (RMCR)，把多重分形曲线结构与重复扫描变异性一起建模，从静息态 fMRI 学出既准又可重复的年龄预测组合。相对匹配的 run-level ridge 基线，单次运行 MAE 在 HCP-A 降低 6.1%、在外部 Cam-CAN 队列降低 7.9%，HCP-A 同次访问内重复扫描绝对差降低 18.5%，推理只需一次扫描。
Motivation: 现有脑龄预测研究只评估单个分形/多重分形特征的可靠性，但预测可重复性取决于特征如何联合波动以及预测器如何组合它们，逐特征可靠性评估捕捉不到这一点。
Method: RMCR 是一个结构化框架，联合建模多重分形曲线结构与 repeat-scan 变异性，学习针对预测精度和被试内一致性的波动阶数组合；对照基线是匹配的 run-level ridge，推理阶段只用单次扫描。
Result: 相对匹配的 run-level ridge 基线：单次运行 MAE 在 HCP-A 降低 6.1%，在外部 Cam-CAN 队列降低 7.9%；同次访问内重复扫描绝对差在 HCP-A 降低 18.5%；推理仅用一次扫描。
Conclusion: 把重复扫描变异性与曲线结构一起纳入回归，可以在只用单次扫描推理的同时提升脑龄预测精度与被试内可重复性，且在外部 Cam-CAN 队列上仍保持 MAE 改善。

papers.title: Physics and Data Driven Transformer-Mamba Framework for Flow Field
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning accelerates expensive partial differential equation solving in computational fluid dynamics (CFD), existing methods like PINNs and FNOs often struggle with generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency. We introduce the Transformer-Mamba for Flow Field (TM4FF) framework, a physics-constrained operator learning model with three key innovations: a Residual Wavelet Mamba (RWM) layer for feature denoising, a Transformer-based attention mechanism for enhanced feature fusion, and a physics-informed loss using Fourier derivatives to enforce the Navier-Stokes equations. Experiments on four CFD datasets show TM4FF achieves high accuracy and robust generalization across varying flow conditions.
papers.comment: Corrected manual data-entry errors (row/column misalignment and misplaced decimal points) in the baseline entries in Table 1. The results of the proposed method and the conclusions remain unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TM4FF（Transformer-Mamba for Flow Field）：用 Residual Wavelet Mamba 层去噪、Transformer 注意力融合特征，再以 Fourier 导数构造物理约束损失强制满足 Navier-Stokes 方程。在四个 CFD 数据集上，该框架在不同流动条件下取得高精度与稳健泛化，优于 PINNs 与 FNOs 所代表的泛化、噪声鲁棒性与物理一致性短板。
Motivation: 深度学习加速 CFD 中昂贵的 PDE 求解，但 PINNs 与 FNOs 在泛化、噪声鲁棒性和物理一致性上常常失效，跨流动条件外推尤其不可靠。
Method: TM4FF 是物理约束的算子学习 (physics-constrained operator learning) 框架，三个组件：Residual Wavelet Mamba (RWM) 层做特征去噪，Transformer 注意力机制做特征融合，基于 Fourier 导数的 physics-informed loss 强制满足 Navier-Stokes 方程；在四个 CFD 数据集上实验。
Result: 在四个 CFD 数据集上，TM4FF 在不同流动条件下达到高精度与稳健泛化；arXiv comment 说明修正了 Table 1 中基线条目的手工录入错误（行列错位与小数点错位），所提方法的结果与结论不变。
Conclusion: 把小波去噪、Transformer 融合与 Fourier 物理约束损失组合进 Mamba 架构，可在跨流动条件的 CFD 算子学习中同时拿到精度、泛化与物理一致性。

papers.title: TRACER: Trajectory-Aligned Learning for Multi-Turn User Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Faithful user simulation is fundamental to building, evaluating, and improving interactive AI at scale. Yet current simulators often produce plausible individual responses without reproducing the intent evolution and outcomes observed in real interactions. We propose TRACER, a multi-turn user simulator that models evolving user intent and aligns simulated trajectories with real ones. TRACER is trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on real user dialogues, followed by multi-turn reinforcement learning. The RL stage combines hierarchical outcome- and trajectory-level rewards with deviation-aware advantage modulation, jointly addressing reward sparsity and credit assignment challenges in long dialogues. On real customer-service sessions organized into reference cohorts, TRACER-7B surpasses the strongest baseline by 11.4 conversion F1 points, while outperforming all baselines on group-level conversion-rate error and semantic trajectory distance and generalizing to out-of-distribution scenarios. In human Turing tests, annotators identified TRACER conversations at near-chance accuracy. Building on this simulator, we further introduce the Dynamic Marketing Benchmark, which jointly evaluates persuasion and response quality via simulated interactions, revealing that higher response quality does not necessarily correspond to higher conversion rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACER 是一个多轮用户模拟器，用两阶段训练（真实用户对话上的 SFT + 多轮强化学习）让模拟轨迹对齐真实交互轨迹，RL 阶段以层级式结果级与轨迹级奖励加偏差感知优势调制 (deviation-aware advantage modulation) 同时缓解长对话的奖励稀疏与信用分配问题。在真实客服会话上 TRACER-7B 比最强基线 conversion F1 高 11.4 点，组级转化率误差与语义轨迹距离均优于全部基线，图灵测试中被识别的准确率接近随机。
Motivation: 现有模拟器只能生成单条看似合理的回复，复现不出真实交互中的意图演化与最终结果，因而难以支撑交互式 AI 的规模化构建、评估与改进。
Method: 两阶段训练：先在真实用户对话上做监督微调 (SFT)，再做多轮强化学习；RL 奖励为层级式的结果级 (outcome-level) 与轨迹级 (trajectory-level) 组合，配合偏差感知优势调制处理长对话的奖励稀疏与 credit assignment。评估按 reference cohorts 组织真实客服会话，并配套提出 Dynamic Marketing Benchmark。
Result: 在真实客服会话上 TRACER-7B 比最强基线 conversion F1 高 11.4 点；组级转化率误差与语义轨迹距离上优于全部基线，并能泛化到 out-of-distribution 场景。人工图灵测试中标注者识别 TRACER 对话的准确率接近随机 (near-chance)。Dynamic Marketing Benchmark 显示回复质量更高并不必然带来更高转化率。
Conclusion: 把模拟轨迹与真实轨迹对齐、并用层级奖励做多轮 RL，能造出意图演化与结果都更忠实的用户模拟器；同时回复质量与转化率并不同向，评估须两者兼顾。

papers.title: HClimRep-Ocean: A Global Ocean Emulator on an Unstructured Mesh
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning (ML) emulators for atmospheric processes have advanced rapidly in recent years, transforming weather forecasting. Although early ML ocean forecasting models now exist, they remain less developed than their atmospheric counterparts. Unlike the atmosphere, much of the ocean's kinetic energy resides in mesoscale eddies whose characteristic spatial scales are approximately an order of magnitude smaller than those of comparable atmospheric features. Moreover, complex coastlines, narrow straits, and ice-covered seas make boundary representation a central challenge that atmospheric models do not face. Consequently, numerical ocean simulations commonly use locally refined or even completely unstructured meshes. However, their data-driven counterparts have so far been built around latitude-longitude grids. We present HClimRep-Ocean, an ocean emulator that operates directly on the native unstructured mesh of FESOM2. The emulator is trained on a 209-year AWI-CM3 control integration and is run without atmospheric forcing, receiving the atmospheric state only at initialisation time, which isolates the predictability carried by the ocean state itself. Skill is strongly field-dependent: for currents, HClimRep-Ocean outperforms every reference at 30 day forecast, whereas for temperature and salinity a damped-anomaly persistence forecast remains the more accurate estimator. This behaviour is physically interpretable: current variability is largely geostrophic and internally generated, whereas sea-surface temperature and salinity fluctuations are driven by atmospheric forcing through weather state. Evaluated independently on the OceanBench benchmark, a reanalysis-trained variant of HClimRep-Ocean achieves the lowest RMSE against GLORYS reanalysis among all assessed systems, confirming the competitiveness of the native-mesh approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HClimRep-Ocean 直接在 FESOM2 的非结构网格上做海洋模拟器，训练于 209 年 AWI-CM3 control 积分，仅在初始化时接收大气状态、之后无大气强迫。30 天预报中流场胜过全部参考方法，而温盐仍以阻尼异常持续性 (damped-anomaly persistence) 更准；在 OceanBench 上用再分析训练的变体对 GLORYS 的 RMSE 为所有受评系统最低。
Motivation: ML 海洋预报落后于大气同类，且现有数据驱动模型都建在经纬网格上，无法直接表示海岸线、窄海峡与冰覆盖海域，也难以解析比大气同类小约一个量级的中尺度涡。
Method: 模拟器直接以 FESOM2 原生非结构网格为输入输出，训练数据为 209 年 AWI-CM3 control 积分；运行时不加大气强迫，大气状态只在初始化时给入，以隔离海洋自身携带的可预报性；另有一个在再分析上训练的变体用于 OceanBench 评测。
Result: 30 天预报中流场 HClimRep-Ocean 优于所有参考方法；温度与盐度则仍是阻尼异常持续性预报更准。在 OceanBench 上独立评测时，再训练变体对 GLORYS 再分析的 RMSE 在所有受评系统中最低。
Conclusion: 原生非结构网格路线在流场上具备竞争力，因为流场变化主要是地转且内部生成的；而海表温盐由天气状态驱动的大气强迫主导，无强迫设置下持续性仍是更强的估计器。

papers.title: Gender Bias in Vision-Language In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables large vision-language models (LVLMs) to perform tasks by following patterns from in-context examples, yet its potential to amplify societal biases remains underexplored. We systematically investigate how ICL influences gender bias in LVLMs through VL-BICLE, an evaluation framework comprising six ICL settings, three tasks, and four datasets. Our experiments on six LVLMs reveal that gendered ICL demonstrations act as a directional force, shifting model bias toward the demonstrated gender through a cross-gender mechanism that disproportionately degrades performance on the opposite gender. This effect appears in image captioning and pronoun prediction but not in visual question answering, indicating that gendered ICL influences bias only when the task output involves gendered language. Similarity-based retrieval methods inherit the training pool's gender imbalance and offer no debiasing advantage, while standard quality metrics remain blind to these bias shifts. To mitigate this bias, we replace real in-context images with synthetic ones from stable diffusion models while keeping captions unchanged. This simple intervention reduces gender bias without degrading caption quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 VL-BICLE 框架（6 种 ICL 设置、3 类任务、4 个数据集）在 6 个 LVLM 上系统检验视觉上下文学习的性别偏见：带性别倾向的示例会把模型偏见朝示例性别方向推移，并通过跨性别机制不成比例地拉低相反性别的表现。该效应出现在图像描述与代词预测、不出现在视觉问答，即只有当任务输出含性别语言时才起作用；把真实上下文图像换成 Stable Diffusion 生成的合成图像（描述保持不变）可在不损失描述质量的前提下降低性别偏见。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型的上下文学习 (ICL) 会否放大社会性偏见缺乏系统研究，且相似性检索与常规质量指标都无法暴露这种偏见迁移。
Method: 提出评测框架 VL-BICLE，覆盖 6 种 ICL 设置、3 个任务（图像描述、代词预测、视觉问答）、4 个数据集，在 6 个 LVLM 上做对照实验；缓解手段是用 Stable Diffusion 合成图像替换真实上下文图像、保持 caption 不变。
Result: 性别化 ICL 示例使偏见朝示例性别方向移动，并经跨性别机制不成比例地损害相反性别表现；该效应在图像描述与代词预测中出现、在视觉问答中不出现。基于相似性的检索方法继承训练池的性别失衡、无去偏优势；常规质量指标对这类偏见迁移不敏感；合成图像干预降低性别偏见且不损害描述质量。
Conclusion: 性别化 ICL 只在输出含性别语言的任务上推动偏见迁移，检索式去偏无效，而保持描述不变、仅替换为合成上下文图像即可去偏。

papers.title: WhatWorkedBench: Benchmarking Experimental Understanding in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents must predict the effects of computational changes after budgeted experiments. WhatWorkedBench evaluates this experimental understanding through a delivered response surface of configuration scores. Agents inspect workflow code and buy measurements; exhaustive CPU references score conditional component effects, mean pair interactions, configuration choice, and delivery. The catalog spans 36 task conditions, 30 sources, 8 workflow families, and 1248 indexed configuration records, with 4,206 numerical controls. At eight purchased measurements plus two free anchors, pair-effect ridge selects an exact optimum on 15 of 22 sources; 13 of these cases have at least one conditional-effect error exceeding 10% of the task utility range. Shared-estimator comparisons measure acquisition and reconstruction on common observations. In a prospective typed study on 12 four-factor sources, DeepSeek Flash submits 12/12 direct tables and gains 0.147 recovery over a Gaussian process (GP) fitted to the same observations. Pro delivers 11/12 artifacts, with an all-attempt GP difference of -0.001 and a delivered-only difference of +0.063. On six prespecified new agent-evaluation sources, Flash and Pro gains are 0.149 and 0.074. In eight typed six-factor episodes, seven final tables satisfy verified code equivalences. Four fresh agents pass all six registered rules through named estimators and deliver consistent tables at 0.682 recovery versus 0.710 for separate direct-table runs. WhatWorkedBench links acquisition, inference, program structure, and delivery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WhatWorkedBench 把「AI 研究代理能否预测计算改动的效果」变成可评分的响应面任务：代理查看工作流代码并花钱购买测量，用穷举 CPU 参考答案对条件效应、均值配对交互、配置选择与交付打分。在 8 次购买测量加 2 个免费锚点下，pair-effect ridge 在 22 个 source 中 15 个选中精确最优，但其中 13 个至少有一处条件效应误差超过任务效用范围的 10%；前瞻研究中 DeepSeek Flash 直接表比同观测 GP 恢复率高 0.147。
Motivation: AI 研究代理需要在预算内做实验并预判改动效果，但缺少一个把测量获取、推断、程序结构与交付串起来、且有穷举参考答案的评测基准。
Method: 交付配置分数构成的响应面 (delivered response surface) 作为参考；代理检查工作流代码并购买测量，用 pair-effect ridge 等估计器重建条件效应与配对交互；目录覆盖 36 个 task conditions、30 个 source、8 个 workflow family、1248 条 indexed configuration records 与 4206 个数值控制；另设共享估计器对比与前瞻 typed study。
Result: 8 次购买测量加 2 个免费锚点下，pair-effect ridge 在 22 个 source 中 15 个选中精确最优，其中 13 个至少有一处条件效应误差超过任务效用范围的 10%。12 个四因子 source 的前瞻研究中，DeepSeek Flash 提交 12/12 直接表，比同观测 GP 恢复率高 0.147；Pro 交付 11/12 件产物，全尝试 GP 差 -0.001、仅交付差 +0.063。6 个新 agent-evaluation source 上 Flash 与 Pro 增益分别为 0.149 与 0.074。8 个 typed 六因子 episode 中 7 张最终表满足已验证代码等价；4 个新代理通过全部 6 条注册规则，恢复率 0.682，对比分别直接跑表的 0.710。
Conclusion: 少量购买测量加配对效应脊回归就能在多数 source 上命中精确最优，但条件效应误差仍普遍超过 10% 效用范围；直接提交表在恢复率上优于对同观测拟合 GP，交付一致性与恢复率之间存在可量化权衡。

summary_sections.conclusion: 少量购买测量加配对效应脊回归就能在多数 source 上命中精确最优，但条件效应误差仍普遍超过 10% 效用范围；直接提交表在恢复率上优于对同观测拟合 GP，交付一致性与恢复率之间存在可量化权衡。

papers.title: Emergi-PersonaOS: A Persona Agent Operating System for Situational Adaptation and Controllable Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Symbiosis between humans and digital beings offers a vision for the future of human--machine interaction. In enduring human--machine relationships, personality provides a foundation for continuity of identity, individuality in interaction, and development through experience. We investigate this capacity through persona agents as computational implementations and introduce Emergi-PersonaOS, a psychology-grounded operating system for managing persona objects throughout their lifecycle. The system organizes dispositional traits, characteristic adaptations, and narrative identity into a three-layer persona representation, distinguishing relatively enduring persona beliefs from their activation in the current persona state. During situational adaptation, it integrates the current interlocutor, relationship, event, and retrieved memories to infer a persona state and generate actions and replies; during long-term development, it records experiences and outcomes, and develops and evaluates revision candidates through change attribution, meaning-making, and behavioral testing. Belief updates are managed through explicit review, traceable evidence and version records, and the ability to reject candidates, making persona evolution controllable. Using television-character dialogue as longitudinal material, we demonstrate long-horizon system operation and examine its principal mechanisms in a concrete implementation. This work provides a computational framework for persona agents to maintain individual continuity, produce situation-specific expression, and develop through experience over sustained interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Emergi-PersonaOS 把 persona 当作可管理生命周期的对象系统：三层人格表征（特质、特征适应、叙事认同）区分持久 persona 信念与当前 persona state，情境适应时结合对话者、关系、事件与检索记忆推断状态并生成回复，长期发展时通过归因、意义建构与行为测试产出并评估修订候选。信念更新走显式审查、可追溯证据与版本记录且可拒绝候选，从而让 persona 演化可控；用电视角色对话作纵向材料演示了长时程运行。
Motivation: 长期人机关系中人格需要同时保证身份连续性、情境化表达与经验驱动的发展，而现有 persona agent 缺少对人格对象全生命周期的管理与可控演化机制。
Method: 三层 persona 表征组织特质、特征适应与叙事认同，分离持久信念与激活的 persona state；情境适应阶段整合当前对话者、关系、事件与检索记忆推断状态并生成动作与回复；长期发展阶段记录经验与结果，用 change attribution、meaning-making、behavioral testing 开发并评估修订候选，信念更新经显式审查、可追溯证据与版本记录管理。
Result: 以电视角色对话作为纵向材料，演示了系统的长时程运行并在具体实现中检验其主要机制；摘要给出的是系统运行演示与机制考察，未列出数值指标。
Conclusion: 把人格拆成持久信念与情境状态、并用带证据与版本记录的审查流程管理更新，可让 persona agent 在持续交互中保持个体连续性、产生情境化表达并可控地通过经验发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PR-Smoother: Simulator-Preserving Non-Gaussian Smoothing for Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Many physical data assimilation (DA) workflows require smoothing methods that represent non-Gaussian posteriors over physical state variables, scale to high-dimensional simulators, train from observation windows alone, and remain compatible with calibration of the prescribed simulator. We introduce PR-Smoother, a simulator-preserving amortized smoother designed for this prescribed-simulator DA regime. Its key design principle is to keep the prescribed simulator explicit in both the evidence lower bound and the variational family: rather than learning replacement dynamics or a learned trajectory prior, PR-Smoother learns only future-conditioned corrections around the prescribed rollout. This yields an explicit non-Gaussian smoothing distribution over physical trajectories and supports joint state, parameter, and sensor-bias learning from observations alone. The variational family contains the exact smoother in deterministic and linear-Gaussian limits. Empirically, PR-Smoother captures multimodal posteriors in 4-dimensional Lorenz-96, remains accurate under ambiguous nonlinear observations and process noise in 40-dimensional Lorenz-96, and scales to joint state-parameter-bias inference in 16,384-dimensional Kolmogorov flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PR-Smoother 是面向规定模拟器 (presumed-simulator) 数据同化的保模拟器摊销平滑器：在 ELBO 与变分族里都显式保留给定模拟器，只学习围绕规定 rollout 的未来条件修正，从而得到物理轨迹上的显式非高斯平滑分布，并支持仅凭观测联合推断状态、参数与传感器偏差。其变分族在确定性与线性高斯极限下包含精确平滑器；实验上捕捉到 4 维 Lorenz-96 的多峰后验，在 40 维 Lorenz-96 的歧义非线性观测与过程噪声下保持准确，并扩展到 16,384 维 Kolmogorov flow 的状态-参数-偏差联合推断。
Motivation: 物理 DA 工作流需要能表示物理状态变量非高斯后验、可扩展到高维模拟器、只从观测窗口训练、且与规定模拟器标定兼容的平滑方法；学习替代动力学或轨迹先验的做法会丢掉规定模拟器本身。
Method: 把规定模拟器显式写进证据下界 (ELBO) 与变分族，只学习围绕规定 rollout 的未来条件修正 (future-conditioned corrections)，不学习替代动力学或 learned trajectory prior；输出物理轨迹上的显式非高斯平滑分布，可从纯观测做状态、参数与传感器偏差的联合学习。
Result: 在 4 维 Lorenz-96 上捕捉多峰后验；在 40 维 Lorenz-96 上于歧义非线性观测与过程噪声下保持准确；扩展到 16,384 维 Kolmogorov flow 的状态-参数-偏差联合推断；变分族在确定性与线性高斯极限下包含精确 smoother。
Conclusion: 把规定模拟器保留在 ELBO 与变分族内、只学 rollout 周围的修正，是在高维模拟器上做非高斯平滑并联合推断状态/参数/偏差的可行路径，且在两个解析极限下不损失精确性。
Relevance: 86

papers.title: QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models achieve long-range temporal consistency by storing KV cache during generation, but the growing cache makes KV cache memory a major deployment bottleneck, which motivates low-bit quantization study for efficiency. Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods can achieve nearly lossless performance on VBench, however, when applied to video world models, we find they still cause severe temporal flickering and visual degradation. Meanwhile, deeper investigates show that Key quantization produces smaller reconstruction errors than Value, but surprisingly leads to larger output degradation. We trace this discrepancy to attention in video world models: Key perturbations can change the attention logits, and shift the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries. These observations motivate us to preserve attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection during KV cache quantization. To address this issue, we present QuantWM, a training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization framework for video world models. QuantWM introduces two complementary techniques to mitigate the attention shifts. Firstly, quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) jointly considers historical Query sensitivity and residual ranges to select INT2-friendly Key centroids, which reduces quantization errors in channels that are more critical to attention. In addition, principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) restores the remaining Key errors along the dominant Query subspace using low-rank projections, which provides a direct and efficient correction to stabilize attention logits. Experiments on LingBot-World-v2, HY-World 1.5, Matrix-Game-2, Longcat-Video and Causal-Forcing demonstrate that QuantWM significantly improves visual quality and temporal consistency, while outperforming existing methods across benchmarks with up to 6.20 KV cache memory compression and limited additional overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuantWM 是面向视频世界模型 (video world models) 的免训练 2-bit KV cache 量化框架：Key 量化重构误差更小却导致更大输出退化，因为 Key 扰动会改变 attention logits 并使 Query 选中的时序-空间 token 发生偏移。它用 QSAC 联合历史 Query 敏感度与残差范围选 INT2 友好 Key 聚类中心，再用 PSAC 沿主 Query 子空间的低秩投影补偿剩余 Key 误差，在五个视频世界模型上以最高 6.20 倍 KV cache 压缩显著改善视觉质量与时间一致性。
Motivation: 视频世界模型靠 KV cache 换长程时间一致性，缓存膨胀成为部署瓶颈；已有 2-bit KV 量化在 VBench 上近乎无损，但直接用于视频世界模型仍造成严重时间闪烁与视觉退化。
Method: 免训练的 2-bit KV cache 量化框架 QuantWM，含两个互补组件：quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) 联合历史 Query 敏感度与残差范围选择 INT2 友好 Key 聚类中心，principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) 用低秩投影沿主导 Query 子空间恢复剩余 Key 误差，目标是保持 attention logits 与时序-空间 token 选择不变。
Result: 在 LingBot-World-v2、HY-World 1.5、Matrix-Game-2、Longcat-Video 和 Causal-Forcing 上，QuantWM 显著改善视觉质量与时间一致性，并在各 benchmark 上超越现有方法，KV cache 压缩最高达 6.20 倍且额外开销有限；另有一项分析性发现：Key 量化重构误差小于 Value 却带来更大的输出退化。
Conclusion: 视频世界模型的 KV 量化应以保持 attention logits 与 token 选择为约束，而非只压重构误差；QSAC 加 PSAC 可在免训练前提下以 6.20 倍压缩换取可用的时间一致性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Canonical locks that encode part-whole hierarchies
papers.abstract_en: One of the challenges in representational learning is how to encode part-whole hierarchies in a neural net. Prior works rely on flattening tree-like structures into string-like sequences and training a sequence-to-sequence model via autoregression. While such a representation works for parse-trees in NLP, it is not entirely clear how to make it work for images. Thus, we propose a geometric primitive called canonical locks. The key idea is that parts/wholes can be modelled as higher-dimensional vectors ($d \geq 4$), and information can be encoded in their relative phase differences. Inductively, the net consists of positionally-bound bottom-up and top-down neural fields, which drive each other to achieve a state of thermal equilibrium. Additionally, we show the existence of a few symmetrical configurations in the net. The computational iterations taken to break these symmetries depend on the angle between parts/wholes arranged on a disk (or more precisely a ring) in higher dimensions. It also appears to have connections to the psychological phenomenon of mental rotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出几何基元 canonical locks，用 d≥4 维向量的相对相位差编码部分-整体层级，网络由位置绑定的自底向上与自顶向下神经场相互驱动至热平衡态。打破对称构型所需迭代数取决于部件在高维环上的夹角，作者认为这与心理旋转现象相关。
Motivation: 把树状部分-整体结构摊平成字符串序列再用自回归 seq2seq 训练的做法在 NLP 解析树上可行，但迁移到图像上如何表示并不清楚。
Method: 以 canonical locks 把部分/整体建模为 d≥4 维向量，信息编码在相对相位差中；网络归纳为位置绑定 (positionally-bound) 的自底向上与自顶向下神经场，互相驱动达到热平衡 (thermal equilibrium)，并分析网络中的若干对称构型。
Result: 证明网络中存在若干对称构型，打破这些对称所需的计算迭代次数取决于部件/整体在高维圆盘（更准确地说是环）上的排列夹角；该现象被指出与心理旋转 (mental rotation) 存在联系。
Conclusion: 部分-整体层级可以用高维向量的相位差与场间热平衡来编码，对称破缺的迭代代价由几何夹角决定，为图像上的层级表示提供了一条绕开序列化的路径。

papers.title: SBMVTrack: Spike-Budgeted Multi-View Learning for Power-Efficient UAV Tracking
papers.abstract_en: With sparse and event-driven computation, spiking neural networks show great potential for achieving accurate and power-efficient UAV visual tracking. However, existing SNN-based trackers typically use spike firing rates only for power consumption and lack explicit optimization of actual spike activity. Moreover, regulating spike activity alone does not explicitly encourage stable target representations under partial observations and temporal appearance changes. We propose SBMVTrack, a fully spiking tracking framework that combines spike activity regulation with complementary multi-view representation learning. Specifically, SBMVTrack introduces Energy-Weighted Spike Budgeting (EWSB), which incorporates layer-wise computational costs when regulating spike firing rates and penalizing saturated activations, thereby reducing redundant spike computation. To further improve target representations under the spike budget constraint, we introduce Masked Multi-View Target Modeling (MVTM), which treats the initial template, online template, and search region as temporal views of the same target. By aligning target embeddings between masked and corresponding unmasked views and enforcing cross-view identity consistency, MVTM encourages robustness to missing local cues and temporal appearance changes. Experiments on four UAV benchmarks demonstrate competitive tracking performance with a 24.1% reduction in estimated power consumption relative to the baseline. On VisDrone2018, SBMVTrack achieves a success rate of 70.0%, exceeding SpikeTrack by 9.7 percentage points while reducing estimated power consumption by 45.7%. The source code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBMVTrack 是全脉冲 (fully spiking) UAV 视觉跟踪框架，用 Energy-Weighted Spike Budgeting (EWSB) 按层级计算代价约束脉冲发放率并惩罚饱和激活，再用 Masked Multi-View Target Modeling (MVTM) 把初始模板、在线模板与搜索区当作同一目标的时间视图做掩码对齐与跨视图身份一致性。在四个 UAV 基准上跟踪性能有竞争力，估计功耗相对基线下降 24.1%；VisDrone2018 上成功率达 70.0%，超 SpikeTrack 9.7 个百分点，同时估计功耗再降 45.7%。
Motivation: 现有 SNN 跟踪器只把脉冲发放率当作功耗估计，未显式优化真实脉冲活动；而单纯约束脉冲活动又不能保证在部分观测与时间外观变化下目标表征稳定。

Result: 在四个 UAV 跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能，估计功耗相对基线下降 24.1%；VisDrone2018 上成功率为 70.0%，比 SpikeTrack 高 9.7 个百分点，同时估计功耗降低 45.7%。
Conclusion: 把逐层能耗纳入脉冲预算并配合多视图身份一致性，可以在 SNN UAV 跟踪中同时保住跟踪精度并显著压低估计功耗；代码将在录用后开源。

papers.title: iSDFT: Information-Proximal Self-Distillation for Continual Learning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation fine-tuning (SDFT) learns new skills from demonstrations while reducing forgetting, but it always distils toward the full demonstration-conditioned teacher. This fixes teacher influence at the full-teacher endpoint, providing no control over how much demonstration information should be transferred at each prediction state. We introduce Information-Proximal SDFT (iSDFT), which instead treats the teacher as a budgeted source of information. At each token, iSDFT selects the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, yielding a closed-form exponential target with a locally determined tilt. To control cumulative drift, we further anchor the student to its frozen base policy. Across four heterogeneous LLM backbones and two specialisation tasks, iSDFT improves vanilla SDFT in 7 of 8 model-task settings and matches it in the remaining one. It also provides tighter retention on the original SDFT benchmark suite, with 73% of evaluations remaining within 0.5 points of the base model versus 52% for the strongest baseline, while achieving the largest mean improvement on all ten additional mathematics, coding, and competition-mathematics benchmarks. These results show that controlling how much and when teacher information is introduced improves specialisation while preserving broader capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: iSDFT 把 on-policy 自蒸馏 (SDFT) 的教师改成带信息预算的源：每个 token 上选取满足教师信息约束且离当前学生最近的分布，得到闭式指数目标，并用冻结 base policy 锚定学生以抑制累积漂移。在四个 LLM backbone、两个专业化任务的 8 个设置中，iSDFT 有 7 个改进 vanilla SDFT、其余 1 个持平；原 SDFT 基准套件上 73% 的评测落在 base 模型 0.5 分以内（最强基线 52%），并在全部十个数学、编程与竞赛数学附加基准上取得最大平均提升。
Motivation: on-policy SDFT 总是朝完整 demonstration-conditioned 教师蒸馏，把教师影响固定在 full-teacher 端点，无法按每个预测状态控制应转移多少演示信息，专业化与能力保持难以兼顾。
Method: iSDFT 将教师视为带信息预算的源：逐 token 求解满足教师信息约束、离当前学生分布最近的目标，得到闭式指数形式 (closed-form exponential target)，其 tilt 由局部确定；再加一项对冻结 base policy 的锚定以控制累积漂移。
Result: 四个异构 LLM backbone、两个专业化任务共 8 个模型-任务设置中，iSDFT 改进 vanilla SDFT 7 个、持平 1 个；原 SDFT 基准套件上 73% 的评测保持在 base 模型 0.5 分以内，最强基线为 52%；在十个额外的数学、编程与竞赛数学基准上取得最大平均提升。
Conclusion: 控制教师信息引入的多少与时机，可以在提升专业化表现的同时保住更广泛的能力，比固定 full-teacher 端点的自蒸馏更优。

papers.title: The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark spanning fourteen parameterised families of mathematical construction problems, with verifiable scores that distinguish progress before and beyond published mathematical frontiers. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at 1. The benchmark draws long-term challenges from open mathematical problems and generates larger instances by varying their parameters. Compact certificates allow large constructions to be verified without listing every element. Across nine models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though none of the 30 published-frontier references is surpassed. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. We release the generators, verifiers, references, model responses and analysis to support continued measurement before and beyond human frontiers.
papers.comment: 54 pages; added Claude Opus 5.5 evaluations, clarified reference baselines and verification limits, and revised presentation. Uses the unchanged bench-v1.0 evaluation suite
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Endless Exam：一个覆盖十四类参数化数学构造问题的基准，自动校验提交对象的有效性并给出相对已发表前沿或构造基线的连续质量分，改进不封顶在 1。在九个模型、69 个不同实例上评测，质量分能区分各模型表现，但没有任何模型超过 30 个已发表前沿参考之一。
Motivation: 现有数学评测多在已解决问题上饱和，难以度量模型在人类已发表数学前沿之前与之后的构造能力进展。
Method: 基准由十四类参数化构造问题族组成，从开放数学问题抽取长期挑战并靠调参生成更大实例；提交对象经自动有效性校验后，与已发表前沿或构造基线比较得到不封顶的相对质量分，并用紧凑证书 (compact certificates) 使大规模构造无需列出全部元素即可验证；评测套件为 bench-v1.0。
Result: 在九个模型、69 个 distinct 实例上评测，连续质量分可区分模型表现，但 30 个已发表前沿参考无一被超越；size-quality 曲线刻画构造质量随问题规模的变化；发布生成器、验证器、参考、模型回复与分析，并新增 Claude Opus 5.5 评测（54 页版本）。
Conclusion: 数学构造能力可以用不封顶的连续质量分在前沿前后统一度量，而当前前沿模型尚未越过已发表前沿参考。

papers.title: Misaligned Clinical Risk Classification and Cost Asymmetry in Open-Weight Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: How large language models (LLMs) integrate patient risk with clinical cost tradeoffs remains poorly understood. We investigated how four open-weight LLMs (Qwen-2.5-7B/32B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B) internally represent cost tradeoffs, how these representations relate to clinical predictions, and whether decisions shift as predicted by the specified cost direction and magnitude. Using a public diabetes dataset, we varied 11 false-negative (FN) to false-positive (FP) cost ratios across three phrasings and examined representations and behavioral outputs. Patient risk was linearly recoverable on par with conventional classifiers (AUC $\approx 0.83$), and cost direction was recoverable in every model. However, representational shifts in cost direction tracked output changes only in the two larger models, and responses to cost magnitude were predominantly direction-agnostic. Only 2 of 12 model-phrasings showed both opposing responses to increasing FN versus FP costs and cost-correct ordering. Representationally, a direction fitted on one cost side did not invert when transferred to the other, as expected under mirror-symmetric encoding. These findings suggest that LLMs encode risk and cost information but do not reliably integrate them into cost-correct decisions. Clinical evaluations should therefore include tradeoff tests, phrasing sensitivity, and default operating points alongside predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 四个开源 LLM（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B、Llama-3.1-8B/70B）在公开糖尿病数据集上能线性读出患者风险（AUC≈0.83，与传统分类器相当）且成本方向在每个模型都可恢复，但表征方向变化只在两个较大模型中跟随输出变化，对成本幅度的响应以方向无关为主；12 个模型-措辞组合中仅 2 个同时对 FN/FP 成本上升给出相反响应且排序成本正确。结论是 LLM 编码了风险与成本信息却不能可靠整合为成本正确的决策，临床评测必须加入权衡测试、措辞敏感性和默认操作点。
Motivation: LLM 如何把患者风险与临床成本权衡整合起来尚不清楚，而临床上 FN/FP 代价不对称直接决定决策是否合理。
Method: 在公开糖尿病数据集上，对四个开源模型（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B、Llama-3.1-8B/70B）扫描 11 个 FN:FP 成本比、三种措辞，检查内部表征（风险与成本方向的线性可读性、跨成本侧迁移）与行为输出是否随指定成本方向和幅度变化。
Result: 患者风险线性可恢复，AUC≈0.83，与传统分类器相当；成本方向在每个模型都可恢复；表征方向变化仅在两个较大模型中跟随输出变化；对成本幅度的响应以方向无关为主；12 个模型-措辞组合中仅 2 个同时对 FN/FP 成本上升给出相反响应且成本排序正确；在一个成本侧拟合的方向迁移到另一侧时未如镜像对称编码所预期那样反转。
Conclusion: LLM 编码风险与成本信息但不能可靠整合为成本正确的决策，临床评测应在预测性能之外加入权衡测试、措辞敏感性和默认操作点。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Hybrid Attention Model Learning Unified Time-aware Patch Representation for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently delivered impressive zero-shot performance across diverse forecasting tasks. However, real-world decision-making frequently relies on \emph{irregular multivariate time series} (IMTS), where inconsistent inter-observation intervals and asynchronous sampling across variables coexist with informative missingness. Existing TSFMs handle such inputs either through imputation that injects spurious values or through index-based positional encodings that ignore continuous time. There is still a gap in the foundation model that follows the original IMTS patterns. In this paper, we propose a hybrid attention model that learns a unified time-aware patch representation for IMTS forecasting. We first design a \emph{time-aware patch encoding} that maps a variable number of intra-patch timestamps into a fixed-size embedding, producing a uniform format for irregular patches without resorting to imputation. We then introduce a \emph{time bias attention} mechanism that calibrates inter-patch temporal misalignment and asynchronous cross-channel dependencies as auxiliary attention offset. Finally, on top of a decoder-only Transformer backbone, we adopt a \emph{hybrid causal mask} that preserves a bidirectional full view over the historical context while keeping the forecast horizon strictly autoregressive. To support large-scale pretraining under irregular settings, we also curate VersaTSA, an archive of $30$B observations that retains the native sampling sparsity of its sources. Experiments on three IMTS benchmarks and a standard regular-MTS benchmark show that our model achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on IMTS and remains competitive when transferred to regular forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对不规则多变量时间序列 (IMTS) 的零样本预报，提出混合注意力模型：time-aware patch encoding 把变长 intra-patch 时间戳压成定长嵌入而不做插补，time bias attention 校正跨通道异步依赖，hybrid causal mask 在历史上下文上保持双向、对预报时域严格自回归。在三个 IMTS 基准上取得零样本 state-of-the-art，并在常规 MTS 基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 处理 IMTS 时要么插补注入伪值，要么用索引式位置编码忽略连续时间，无法保留原始不规则采样与信息性缺失模式。
Method: 三部件：time-aware patch encoding 将变长 intra-patch 时间戳映射为定长嵌入，得到不规则 patch 的统一格式且不插补；time bias attention 以辅助注意力偏置校正 inter-patch 时间错位与异步跨通道依赖；decoder-only Transformer 骨干上加 hybrid causal mask，历史上下文双向全视、预报时域严格自回归。同时整理 VersaTSA 预训练档案，含 30B 观测并保留源数据的原生采样稀疏性。
Result: 在三个 IMTS 基准与一个常规 MTS 基准上实验：零样本性能在 IMTS 上达到 state-of-the-art，迁移到常规预报时保持竞争力；预训练语料 VersaTSA 规模为 30B 观测。
Conclusion: 不插补、直接在连续时间上做 patch 编码与注意力偏置校正，是让基础模型跟随 IMTS 原始模式并实现零样本预报的可行路径，且不牺牲常规时间序列上的迁移能力。

summary_sections.method: 三部件：time-aware patch encoding 将变长 intra-patch 时间戳映射为定长嵌入，得到不规则 patch 的统一格式且不插补；time bias attention 以辅助注意力偏置校正 inter-patch 时间错位与异步跨通道依赖；decoder-only Transformer 骨干上加 hybrid causal mask，历史上下文双向全视、预报时域严格自回归。同时整理 VersaTSA 预训练档案，含 30B 观测并保留源数据的原生采样稀疏性。
summary_sections.result: 在三个 IMTS 基准与一个常规 MTS 基准上实验：零样本性能在 IMTS 上达到 state-of-the-art，迁移到常规预报时保持竞争力；预训练语料 VersaTSA 规模为 30B 观测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不插补、直接在连续时间上做 patch 编码与注意力偏置校正，是让基础模型跟随 IMTS 原始模式并实现零样本预报的可行路径，且不牺牲常规时间序列上的迁移能力。

papers.title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

papers.title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: We define OmniVChat (Omni Video Chat) as the task of native audio-visual dialogue between a user and an omni model. In OmniVChat, omni models directly and simultaneously receive audio and video from a user and return text. The user's query is embedded in the audio and video, without a separate text question, external captioning, or speech recognition. Direct audio-visual input reduces external latency and computation while preserving perceptual cues. However, research on OmniVChat faces two constraints: data availability and evaluation. Recordings of people using their own devices are scarce. Furthermore, good replies often depend on multimodal context and can be phrased in many ways, making keyword matching unreliable for evaluation. Recent progress in agent systems and video generation makes generation for comprehension viable, which means using synthesized dialogues for training and evaluation. Therefore, we present OmniVChat-Studio, a multi-agent data engine for synthesizing single- and multi-turn audio-visual dialogues. We use synthesized dialogues to build OmniVChat-Bench, an evaluation benchmark that evaluates omni models' basic dialogue abilities across five ability categories. Replies are judged by a large language model based on explicit scoring criteria. We also present OmniVChat-RL, a reinforcement learning reward design that jointly targets reply correctness, efficiency, and style in OmniVChat. Training Qwen3-Omni-Instruct with OmniVChat-RL on synthesized dialogues improves its performance on both OmniVChat-Bench and the human-recorded OmniVChat-Bench-Human. These gains validate the reward design and show transfer to real-world dialogues in training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 定义原生音视频对话任务 OmniVChat：omni 模型直接同时接收用户音频与视频并返回文本，无需外部字幕或语音识别。提出多智能体数据引擎 OmniVChat-Studio 合成单轮与多轮对话，据此构建按五类能力、由 LLM 按显式评分标准打分的 OmniVChat-Bench，并设计联合优化回复正确性、效率与风格的强化学习奖励 OmniVChat-RL；用它训练 Qwen3-Omni-Instruct 在 OmniVChat-Bench 与人工录制的 OmniVChat-Bench-Human 上均提升。
Motivation: 真人用自有设备录制的音视频对话数据稀缺，且好回复依赖多模态上下文、表述方式多样，关键词匹配无法可靠评测，导致 OmniVChat 任务的数据与评估两方面都受限。
Method: OmniVChat-Studio 作为多智能体数据引擎合成单轮与多轮音视频对话；用合成对话构建 OmniVChat-Bench，覆盖五类基础对话能力，回复由大语言模型依据显式评分标准判定；OmniVChat-RL 是面向该任务的强化学习奖励设计，同时约束回复正确性、效率与风格，用于训练 Qwen3-Omni-Instruct。
Result: 在合成对话上用 OmniVChat-RL 训练 Qwen3-Omni-Instruct，使其在 OmniVChat-Bench 和人工录制的 OmniVChat-Bench-Human 上表现均提升，说明奖励设计有效并能迁移到真实对话；评测覆盖五类能力，回复由 LLM 按显式标准打分。
Conclusion: 合成音视频对话可以同时充当训练与评测数据，按正确性、效率、风格联合设计的 RL 奖励能把收益从合成数据迁移到真实人工录制对话。

papers.title: Grounded Product Understanding in Livestream Videos
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce livestreams have emerged as an important channel for presenting products to online consumers, often featuring multiple products with relevant information distributed across different moments. This poses significant challenges for downstream product understanding applications, such as product-centric livestream clipping, where models need to identify the product and its relevant segments for information gathering. However, existing benchmarks for general product understanding typically evaluate product retrieval and temporal localization in isolation, leaving the critical correspondence between product identity and temporal evidence largely unassessed. To address this limitation, we introduce GPUB, a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,000 real-world e-commerce livestream instances with quality-controlled multi-moment temporal annotations and a catalog of over 31K fashion products. GPUB supports three evaluation tasks: given a livestream video and a candidate product set, the main task Grounded Product Understanding (GPrU) requires jointly identifying the product being presented and localizing its supporting moments; Product Retrieval and Product Moment Localization serve as two complementary subtasks. Evaluation of existing multimodal models shows that GPrU remains highly challenging, with the best-performing off-the-shelf baseline achieving only 10.13% Pair mAP@.3. To narrow the performance gap, we further develop UniPro, a unified product understanding model that derives product-aligned and temporally structured representations from shared multimodal encoding, improving Pair mAP@.3 to 24.58% while achieving 38.81% Joint R@1@.3 on GPrU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPUB 提出联合任务 Grounded Product Understanding (GPrU)：给定直播视频与候选商品集，同时识别正在讲解的商品并定位支撑片段，把商品身份与时间证据的对应关系一并评测。基准含 3,000 条真实电商直播、31K+ 时尚商品；现成多模态模型最佳 Pair mAP@.3 仅 10.13%，自研 UniPro 提到 24.58%，Joint R@1@.3 达 38.81%。
Motivation: 现有商品理解基准把商品检索与时间定位分开评测，商品身份与其时间证据之间的关键对应关系基本未被考察，而直播切片这类下游任务恰恰要求两者联合。
Method: 构建 GPUB 基准：3,000 条真实电商直播实例、质量受控的多时刻时间标注、31K+ 时尚商品目录，设 GPrU 主任务与 Product Retrieval、Product Moment Localization 两个子任务；并提出 UniPro 统一模型，从共享多模态编码中导出商品对齐且时间结构化的表示。
Result: 现成多模态模型中最佳基线在 GPrU 上 Pair mAP@.3 仅 10.13%；UniPro 将 Pair mAP@.3 提升至 24.58%，Joint R@1@.3 达到 38.81%。
Conclusion: 商品身份与时间证据的联合评测使 GPrU 对现成模型高度困难，而共享编码下的商品对齐加时间结构化表示能显著缩小这一差距。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Single-Loop Predictor--Corrector Extragradient Method for Strongly Convex--Strongly Concave Minimax Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study smooth strongly convex--strongly concave minimax optimization in the deterministic unconstrained setting, without assuming a bilinear or separable structure. Although existing multi-loop methods attain near-optimal condition-number dependence, standard single-loop methods generally exhibit a substantial complexity gap. To close this gap, we propose the Single-Loop Predictor--Corrector Extragradient Method with Damped Momentum (PCE-DM), which combines an extragradient prediction--correction scheme with a novel auxiliary feedback recursion for the weaker-curvature variable. PCE-DM uses fixed parameters and two new full-gradient evaluations per iteration after one initialization query, while requiring no inner solves, accuracy schedules, or staged restarts. We develop a Lyapunov analysis that controls the predictor--corrector mismatch through corrected-gradient increments and establish last-iterate linear convergence. Specifically, PCE-DM computes an $\varepsilon$-accurate relative solution, measured by the squared Euclidean distance to the saddle point, within $\mathcal{O}\!\left(\sqrt{κ_xκ_y} \log(2κ_xκ_y/\varepsilon)\right)$ full-gradient queries. This result closes the condition-number complexity gap between standard single-loop methods and near-optimal multi-loop methods, matching the known lower-bound order up to logarithmic factors while retaining fixed, explicit single-loop updates. Numerical experiments on regularized linear regression and AUC maximization demonstrate the computational efficiency of PCE-DM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单循环 predictor–corrector extragradient 加阻尼动量的 PCE-DM，用于无约束光滑强凸–强凹极小极大优化，不假设双线性或可分结构。每次迭代固定参数、两次全梯度查询即可达到 last-iterate 线性收敛，全梯度复杂度为 O(√(κxκy) log(2κxκy/ε))，把标准单循环方法与近最优多循环方法的条件数复杂度差距补齐到仅差对数因子。
Motivation: 标准单循环方法在强凸–强凹极小极大问题上与近最优多循环方法存在显著的条件数复杂度差距，而多循环方法需要内层求解、精度调度或分阶段重启。
Method: PCE-DM 将 extragradient 的预测–校正机制与针对弱曲率变量的新辅助反馈递归结合，配阻尼动量与固定显式参数；用 Lyapunov 分析通过校正梯度增量控制 predictor–corrector 失配，证明 last-iterate 线性收敛。
Result: 达到 ε 精度（以到鞍点的平方欧氏距离衡量）需 O(√(κxκy) log(2κxκy/ε)) 次全梯度查询，匹配已知下界阶（仅差对数因子）；初始化一次查询后每次迭代两次全梯度，无需内层求解、精度调度或分阶段重启；在 regularized linear regression 与 AUC maximization 上的数值实验展示了其计算效率。
Conclusion: 固定参数、无内层求解的单循环方案即可在光滑强凸–强凹极小极大优化上达到与近最优多循环方法同阶的条件数复杂度。

papers.title: Printing the Underdetermined: Materializing Multi-solutionness in Figurative Paintings
papers.abstract_en: Figurative paintings are often approached as if they depict a single recoverable 3D scene: viewers infer depth and occlusion, and reconstruction pipelines attempt to converge to one stable model. We instead foreground multi-solutionness, the non-uniqueness of 3D configurations compatible with a single painted image, and propose a workflow that keeps this non-uniqueness visible and material. Multi-solutionness arises from two sources: unobserved content, where backsides and occluded volumes admit multiple plausible completions, and observed cues, where perspective, shading, and occlusion still underconstrain geometry. When additional views are synthesized by a video generative model without explicit 3D constraints, small frame-level drifts become inevitable rather than exceptional. Our pipeline samples multiple camera-orbit multi-view video sequences from one painting, reconstructs each sequence with 3D Gaussian Splatting into a point-based Gaussian scene representation where density halos and ghosting expose unresolved degrees of freedom, and fabricates these representations as physical artifacts using DreamPrinting. By treating multiple compatible interpretations as explicit outputs rather than residual error, we provide a computational framework for spatial readings of figurative painting that can be inspected, compared, and discussed in both digital and physical form.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把具象绘画的三维欠定性当作输出而非误差：从单幅画采样多条相机环绕多视角视频序列，各自用 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建，密度晕与鬼影显式暴露未解自由度，再经 DreamPrinting 制成可比较的实体物件。
Motivation: 既有重建管线默认单幅画对应唯一可恢复的三维场景并收敛到单一模型，但未观测内容与透视、明暗、遮挡等观测线索本身欠定几何，强行收敛会把多解性抹成残差。
Method: 用视频生成模型在无显式三维约束下从一幅画采样多条相机环绕多视角序列，逐条以 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建为基于点的 Gaussian 场景表示，再用 DreamPrinting 将这些表示打印为实体。
Result: 无三维约束的视角合成使帧级漂移成为必然而非偶发；重建中的密度晕与鬼影被用作未解自由度的可视化载体，多解被作为显式输出而非残差误差。

papers.title: When2Think: Learning When and How Much to Reason
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often overthink easy problems and underthink hard ones, leading to inefficient computation allocation. Existing methods regulate generated computation or select between direct answering and explicit reasoning, but do not jointly control whether}to reason and how much computation to allocate within reasoning. We call the resulting difficulty-dependent loss in accuracy under computation reduction the efficiency tax. We propose When2Think, an RLVR-based post-training framework for instance-adaptive computation allocation. Its core mechanism, Instance-level Difficulty-Aware Control (IDAC), uses cached reference statistics of success and token cost to modulate a correctness-gated efficiency bonus based on generated token count. Importance sampling supports exploration of Think and NoThink, while Batch-Wise Standardization constructs standardized advantages for critic-free optimization. The framework requires neither a learned reward model nor a learned critic, and offline reference caching avoids online reference-model queries during policy updates. On AIME24, When2Think improves Pass@3 by 10.0 percentage points while reducing token usage by 27.9% relative to the backbone.

TL;DR: When2Think 是面向大推理模型 (LRM) 的 RLVR 后训练框架，用实例级难度感知控制 (IDAC) 联合决定「要不要思考」和「思考多少」：以缓存的参考成功率与 token 成本调制一个以生成 token 数为输入、由正确性门控的效率奖励。在 AIME24 上相对 backbone 提升 Pass@3 达 10.0 个百分点，同时 token 用量下降 27.9%。

papers.title: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Multi-View Optical Satellite Imagery via Reliability-Aware Height-Evidence Fusion in Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Robust 3D reconstruction from multi-view optical satellite imagery requires fusing complementary but sometimes conflicting geometric evidence. Digital surface models (DSMs) are the primary elevation representations for satellite-based 3D reconstruction, making reliable height estimation essential. However, in a Gaussian scene representation jointly optimized from multiple views, Gaussian responses at different elevations can support competing height hypotheses at the same rendered location, while conventional alpha-weighted elevation aggregation may produce intermediate elevations that do not correspond to physical surfaces. To address this challenge, we formulate DSM reconstruction as a reliability-aware height-hypothesis fusion problem and propose HLC-GS, a reliability-aware Height-Layer Consistency Gaussian Splatting framework for multi-view satellite 3D reconstruction. HLC-GS organizes projected Gaussian responses into candidate height hypotheses and evaluates their relative support using layer competition and Gaussian footprint support. A continuous height-layer risk map guides dominant-layer reliability correction and secondary-layer suppression during optimization. The proposed training strategy regulates conflicting Gaussian responses within the shared representation to improve the reliability of reconstructed surface elevations. Experiments on seven scenes from the DFC2019 and IARPA2016 datasets demonstrate improved DSM reconstruction accuracy. Compared with EOGS, HLC-GS reduces the average DSM MAE from 1.46~m to 1.18~m and RMSE from 2.78~m to 2.58~m, while increasing PAG$_{2.5}$ from 86.09\% to 88.61\%, with comparable computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HLC-GS 把卫星多视 3D 重建中的 DSM 重建表述为可靠性感知的高度假设融合问题：把投影的 Gaussian 响应组织成候选高度层，用层竞争 (layer competition) 与 Gaussian footprint 支持度评估相对支撑，再以连续高度层风险图在优化中校正主层、抑制次层。在 DFC2019 与 IARPA2016 共 7 个场景上，相比 EOGS 平均 DSM MAE 从 1.46 m 降到 1.18 m，RMSE 从 2.78 m 降到 2.58 m，PAG$_{2.5}$ 从 86.09% 升到 88.61%，计算开销相当。
Motivation: 多视光学卫星影像中不同高度的 Gaussian 响应会在同一渲染位置支撑相互竞争的高度假设，而常规 alpha 加权高程聚合会产出不对应真实物理表面的中间高程，导致 DSM 高度估计不可靠。
Method: 提出 HLC-GS（Height-Layer Consistency Gaussian Splatting）：把投影 Gaussian 响应组织为候选高度假设，用 layer competition 与 Gaussian footprint support 评估相对支撑；训练中引入连续高度层风险图，指导主层可靠性校正与次层抑制，从而在共享表示内约束冲突的 Gaussian 响应。
Result: 在 DFC2019 与 IARPA2016 的 7 个场景上，相比 EOGS，平均 DSM MAE 由 1.46 m 降至 1.18 m，RMSE 由 2.78 m 降至 2.58 m，PAG$_{2.5}$ 由 86.09% 提升至 88.61%，计算开销相当。
Conclusion: 把 DSM 重建当作可靠性感知的高度假设融合并显式抑制冲突响应，可在计算开销相当的前提下提高卫星 3D 重建的表面高程精度。

papers.title: Decentralized Gossip Learning and Federated Averaging for Histopathology Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Breast histopathology analysis increasingly relies on distributed learning because direct data pooling across institutions is often restricted by privacy, governance, and communication constraints. This study compares server-based Federated Averaging (FedAvg), fully decentralized gossip learning, and Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg for invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) patch classification. Experiments used 277,524 color image patches with patient-disjoint training, validation, and test partitions and a workload-balanced, Dirichlet-guided allocation across six nodes. Ring, random degree-3, and fully connected gossip topologies were evaluated together with sensitivity analyses for statistical heterogeneity, mixing coefficient, learning rate, model drift, prediction disagreement, calibration, clinically motivated operating points, communication payload, and patient-level IDC burden, together with auxiliary backbone robustness analyses. In the principal alpha=0.3 experiment, Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg achieved a test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.8811, closely followed by FedAvg at 0.8801 and fully connected gossip at 0.8751. Across three independent patient-level repetitions, FedAvg and Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg obtained the same mean ROC-AUC of 0.9082, with standard deviations of 0.0037 and 0.0043, respectively. Hybrid achieved the highest mean area under the precision-recall curve of 0.8240, whereas FedAvg produced the lowest mean Brier score of 0.1335. Denser gossip graphs improved discrimination but increased theoretical model payload, while ring gossip remained sensitive to learning rate and mixing strength. Overall, FedAvg provided the most consistently reliable server-based baseline, topology-aware gossip offered a viable decentralized alternative, and Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg provided a balanced compromise between peer-to-peer diffusion and periodic global coordination.

TL;DR: 在乳腺 IDC 病理 patch 分类上对比服务器式 FedAvg、全去中心化 gossip learning 与 Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg：α=0.3 主实验 Hybrid ROC-AUC 0.8811 略高于 FedAvg 0.8801 与全连接 gossip 0.8751；三次患者级重复中 FedAvg 与 Hybrid 平均 ROC-AUC 同为 0.9082。稠密 gossip 图提升判别力但增大理论通信载荷，ring 拓扑对学习率与混合系数敏感，故 Hybrid 是点对点扩散与周期全局协调之间的折中。
Motivation: 乳腺组织病理数据分散在多家机构，直接汇聚受隐私、治理与通信约束限制，需要在不集中数据的前提下做分布式训练并量化不同协作拓扑的代价。
