Result: α=0.3 主实验：Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg 测试 ROC-AUC 0.8811，FedAvg 0.8801，全连接 gossip 0.8751。三次患者级重复中 FedAvg 与 Hybrid 平均 ROC-AUC 均为 0.9082，标准差分别为 0.0037 与 0.0043；Hybrid 平均 PR-AUC 最高 0.8240，FedAvg Brier 分数最低 0.1335。
Conclusion: FedAvg 是最稳定可靠的服务器基线，拓扑感知的 gossip 是可行的去中心化替代，Hybrid Gossip-FedAvg 在点对点扩散与周期全局协调之间给出平衡折中；gossip 图越密判别力越好但理论模型载荷越大。

papers.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
papers.abstract_en: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. Retrieval pipelines move the selection out of the context, but also out of the agent's capability. We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two linear maps suffice to read it out with no skill text in the context. Our Gavel (Glance And Verdict from a frozen LLM) reads it in two steps. A glance scores the full library by matching the task's mid-layer states against a compact bank that one forward pass builds for each skill at installation, with the two maps as the only trained parameters. A verdict then resumes each shortlisted skill's forward pass, reads the model's own likelihood and yes/no judgment, and fuses both with the glance as a product of experts. Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories. On Qwen3-32B it outperforms progressive disclosure and retrieve-and-rerank pipelines that add 1.2B to 16B external parameters, by up to 13.4 points on written tasks and up to 21.9 when the need for a skill arises mid-rollout. Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness Gavel lets the 32B trigger the right skill on Skill-Use more often than models of up to 1.6T parameters in Codex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gavel 从冻结 LLM 自身的前向传播中读出技能路由信号：glance 用两个线性映射把任务中层状态与每个技能安装时一次前向生成的紧凑状态库匹配打分，verdict 再续跑入围技能的前向、融合模型自身似然与 yes/no 判断。在 Qwen3-32B 上，它在书面任务上比外挂 1.2B–16B 参数的 progressive disclosure 与 retrieve-and-rerank 管线最高高 13.4 分，技能需求出现在 rollout 中途时最高高 21.9 分。
Motivation: 把全部技能元数据预载进上下文会分散注意力并限制技能库规模；检索管线又把选择权移出 agent 自身能力。
Method: Gavel 两步：glance 用两个线性映射（唯一训练参数）将任务中层状态与每个技能安装时一次前向生成的紧凑库匹配打分；verdict 续跑入围技能的前向，读取模型自身似然与 yes/no 判断，与 glance 以 product of experts 融合。一次训练后零样本迁移到三个公开基准与新基准 SkillTraj。
Result: 在 Qwen3-32B 上，比增加 1.2B 至 16B 外部参数的 progressive disclosure 与 retrieve-and-rerank 管线：书面任务最高高 13.4 分，技能需求在 rollout 中途出现时最高高 21.9 分；路由准确率随 backbone 变强而上升；在 bash-agent harness 中，32B 模型在 Skill-Use 上触发正确技能的频率高于 Codex 中最大 1.6T 参数的模型。SkillTraj 含 372 条模拟 agent 轨迹。
Conclusion: 冻结 LLM 的前向状态本身携带足够的技能路由信号，两个线性映射即可读出，无需把技能文本放进上下文，也无需外挂大参数量的检索重排模块。

papers.title: Issue Bias in Generative AI Writing Assistance: Political Issues and LLMs in the Swedish 2026 Election
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI writing assistants and the Large Language Models (LLMs) that power them are increasingly part of how voters gather information before elections. With growing evidence that they influence users' opinions, it is increasingly important to understand the views and positions of these tools. To better understand these views, we examine the stances supplied by six LLMs on a variety of Swedish-language writing tasks ahead of the 2026 Swedish parliamentary election. We cross 107 policy propositions with 77 writing templates and neutral, positive, and negative prompt framings, producing 24,717 prompts per model and 148,302 responses. To study these, we look at the models' default stance tendencies, compare how they respond to similar issues, and compare their responses with those of each of Sweden's eight parliamentary parties on the same issue. We find that Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, and Mistral have similar profiles; ChatGPT more often supplies neutral or ambivalent text; and Grok differs most on topics such as migration, crime, and gender. When comparing the political parties, we find that the Social Democrats are closest to all six models. Still, after correcting for multiple comparisons, none of the within-model differences in party distances remains significant. Overall, we find that no model has a clear preference, nor a clear preference for a party, but that this depends on the specific issue or task the user asks about.

papers.title: Learned Bow Control on a Measured Bowed-String Model: a Revised Minimum-Bow-Force Law, a Recurrent Controller, and the Domain of a Supervision Ceiling
papers.abstract_en: A finite-difference bowed-string model with implicitly resolved Stribeck friction is presented, with a regime diagnostic. Without implicit resolution no stick phase forms at any bow force. With friction, impedance and quality factor from published measurement rather than fitted, all four strings return a stick fraction of 89.1% against an ideal 90%. Schelleng's maximum bow force is recovered on every string. His minimum, $F_{\min} \propto Z^2 v_b β^{-2}$, is replaced by a law, $F_{\min} = C Z v_b / β$ with a dimensionless $C = 1.112 \pm 0.017$ that reproduces on sixty-four held-out operating points. Six controllers at matched capacity, on four strings at twenty seeds, place a gated recurrent network ahead of a feedforward one, its margin over the mean of the other five largest when the commanded bow speed is overridden at mid-stroke. The feedforward network completes more strokes, mostly from a cold start no player would use. A minimal gated variant fails because gates computed from the input alone cannot clear a latched state. Training loss selects neither the capacity nor the context length. No learned controller improves on the lookup rule that generated its labels where that rule is correct. Of the rule's 1089 cells, 57 are playable on a properly settled plant and unplayable by its labels, and the controller commands them where the lookup will not. The controller's score regresses on the rule's with a slope of 0.32, more than ten standard errors below unity, so it overtakes the rule where the rule fails and is bounded by it where it holds. Under a rigid finger stop the plant is provably invariant, so transfer loss between pitches is the controller's alone, traced to one feature. A regime classifier without a stick test mistakes small-amplitude periodic slipping for Helmholtz motion, and a harmonicity measure rates a string the bow never grips above it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在实测参数的有限差分擦弦模型上，用带门控的循环控制器学习弓弦控制，并把最小弓力定律从 Schelleng 的 F_min ∝ Z²v_bβ⁻² 改写为 F_min = C·Z·v_b/β，无量纲常数 C = 1.112 ± 0.017 在 64 个留出工作点上复现。六个等容量控制器对比中门控循环网络领先，但任何学习控制器都无法超越生成标签的查表规则在其正确处，回归斜率 0.32 表明控制器只在规则失效处超越它。
Motivation: 弓弦控制的最小弓力定律依赖拟合参数且未在实测模型上检验，而学习控制器何时受限于其教师规则、何时能补上规则的失效区，缺少可判定的边界。
Method: 建立隐式解析 Stribeck 摩擦的有限差分擦弦模型并配 regime 诊断，摩擦、阻抗与品质因数取自已发表实测而非拟合；提出新最小弓力律 F_min = C·Z·v_b/β；在四根弦上以相同容量训练六个控制器（含门控循环网络、前馈网络与最小门控变体），每种 20 个随机种子，标签来自 1089 格查表规则。
Result: 无隐式摩擦解析时任何弓力下都不形成 stick 相；实测参数下四根弦 stick fraction 达 89.1%（理想 90%），Schelleng 最大弓力在每根弦上复现；新定律常数 C = 1.112 ± 0.017 在 64 个留出工作点复现；门控循环网络在中程覆盖弓速时对其余五个控制器均值的领先幅度最大，前馈网络完成更多弓程但多来自冷启动；查表规则 1089 格中 57 格在正确整备的被控对象上可演奏而其标签不可，控制器会指令这些格；控制器对规则得分回归斜率 0.32，低于 1 达十个标准误以上；仅由输入计算门的最小门控变体因无法清除锁存状态而失败；训练损失选不出容量与上下文长度。
Conclusion: 学习控制器受其教师规则界定：规则正确处不超越，规则失效的 57 格处补位；刚性指止下被控对象跨音高不变，迁移损失全归因于控制器的单一特征，而 regime 判别若无 stick 检验会把小振幅周期滑动误判为 Helmholtz 运动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Floquet Fibre Geometry and Higher-Order Reduced Coordinates for Off-Manifold Transients near Nonlinear Aeroelastic Flutter
papers.abstract_en: Assigning reduced coordinates to states near an attracting limit cycle requires the correct invariant-fibre geometry. The classical first-order phase-isostable chart obtained from adjoint Floquet modes projects along the strong-stable quotient fibre, whereas a metric-orthogonal complement of the retained slow bundle generally does not. We prove locally that a chart satisfying the linearised semiconjugacy relation leaves an O(delta^2) invariance residual, while projection along a non-invariant complement generically leaves an O(delta) term. For a nonlinear aeroelastic limit cycle, the metric-normal and strong-stable directions differ by 48.5 to 71.7 degrees, and metric-normal perturbations contain first-order retained phase and slow-amplitude components. Replacing the metric normal by the strong-stable fibre changes the measured residual scaling from delta^1.01 to delta^1.87 without fitted parameters. We then test learned higher-order corrections whose linearisation is pinned to the adjoint-Floquet chart, whose symmetry is exact, and whose reduced flow is fixed. Although they reduce the registered fixed-normalisation latent residual, post-hoc amplitude recalibration and adjoint-Floquet-targeted future consistency move or reverse the ranking. Because the learned maps already share the baseline's first-order gauge and the future target is supplied by the baseline chart, these diagnostics establish neither an independent positive nor negative higher-order result. Correct first-order Floquet geometry is therefore necessary in this benchmark, while the additional predictive value of the learned correction remains unidentified by the available representation-dependent diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非线性气动弹性极限环附近，把约化坐标沿强稳定商纤维 (strong-stable quotient fibre) 投影而非度量正交补，可使不变性残差从 O(delta) 降到 O(delta^2)；实测残差标度由 delta^1.01 变为 delta^1.87，且无需拟合参数。学习式高阶修正在不同诊断下排名会移动或反转，其额外预测价值在该基准上仍未被识别。
Motivation: 吸引极限环附近的约化坐标需要正确的不变纤维几何：经典一阶相位-等稳图沿强稳定商纤维投影，而保留慢束的度量正交补一般不满足半共轭关系，导致残差只有一阶小量。
Method: 证明满足线性化半共轭关系的图留下 O(delta^2) 不变性残差，而沿非不变补投影一般留下 O(delta) 项；在非线性气动弹性极限环上比较度量法向与强稳定方向，并测试线性化被钉到 adjoint-Floquet 图、对称性精确、约化流固定的学习式高阶修正式。
Result: 度量法向与强稳定方向相差 48.5 至 71.7 度，度量法向扰动含一阶保留相位与慢幅值分量；改用强稳定纤维后实测残差标度由 delta^1.01 变为 delta^1.87（无拟合参数）。学习式修正式虽降低配准固定归一化的 latent 残差，但事后幅值重标定与以 adjoint-Floquet 为目标的未来一致性会移动或反转排名。
Conclusion: 在该基准中正确的一阶 Floquet 几何是必要的；由于学习映射已共享基线的一阶规范且未来目标由基线图提供，现有表示依赖的诊断既不能确立也不能否定学习式高阶修正式的独立收益。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A latent dimension of Condorcet's jury theorem for multiple AI advisers
papers.abstract_en: When the same question is asked of multiple AI advisers, as in self-consistency and LLM-as-a-judge panels, Condorcet's jury theorem predicts that adding independent, competent advisers makes the majority more reliable. The theorem, however, has a latent dimension when viewed from the user's vantage: adding advisers also makes disagreement more visible. A binomial model reveals that this ``visible dissent'' becomes nearly inevitable as the number of advisers grows, and that reliability and disagreement approach certainty at rates that cross at an adviser accuracy of 4/5 (0.8); below it, visible dissent eventually becomes more likely than a correct majority. Even ideal panels of independent and competent advisers can be correct in aggregate but appear divided; such disagreement does not by itself indicate aggregation failure. The way advisers split also provides a common basis for predictive multiplicity, reconciliation load, and reliance miscalibration. These results separate aggregation from disclosure and turn the latter into testable questions about how disagreement should be presented and interpreted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 self-consistency 与 LLM-as-a-judge 多评委场景下，Condorcet 陪审团定理存在一个从用户视角看的隐含维度：增加独立且有能力的评委在提高多数票可靠性的同时，也让分歧更可见。二项模型显示评委数增大时可见分歧近乎必然，可靠性与分歧趋近确定的速率在评委准确率 4/5（0.8）处相交；低于该阈值，可见分歧最终比正确的多数更可能出现。
Motivation: 多评委聚合被默认为加人即更可靠，但用户实际看到的是分歧信号，聚合正确与表面分裂可以同时发生，现有框架没有把披露 (disclosure) 与聚合 (aggregation) 分开。
Method: 用二项模型刻画多个独立 AI 评委的多数票：推导可靠性与可见分歧趋近确定的速率，并求出两者速率相交的评委准确率阈值 4/5（0.8）；再以该框架统一 predictive multiplicity、reconciliation load 与 reliance miscalibration。
Result: 可靠性与分歧趋近确定的速率在评委准确率 0.8 处相交；准确率低于 0.8 时，可见分歧最终比正确的多数更可能出现；评委数增大时可见分歧近乎必然，而理想独立有能力的面板可以聚合正确却表面分裂。
Conclusion: 分歧本身不指示聚合失败，应把聚合与披露分开，并把分歧如何呈现与解读转成可检验的问题。

papers.title: SkillAtlas: An Attack Trace Library for Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are reusable units for language-model agents, but their risks emerge through model decisions, user context, tool calls, and execution feedback rather than through stable signatures or a single sandbox run. Existing static, dynamic, and benchmark-style evaluations rarely preserve public evidence that can be inspected, searched, and reused. We present SkillAtlas, a hosted attack trace library that converts private agent-skill security report bundles into reviewed, redacted, and searchable public cases. The library contains 3,014 cases, 6,589 traces, 151,131 steps, 233 affected skills, and 8 risk categories; 42.5% of successful cases first become successful after a non-success initial round, and trajectory-grounded labels improve pre-execution guard accuracy to 0.770.
papers.comment: Accepted at REALM @ EMNLP 2026 (non-archival workshop paper). 9 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillAtlas 把私有 agent skill 安全报告包转成经审核、脱敏、可检索的公开攻击轨迹库，含 3,014 个案例、6,589 条轨迹、151,131 步、233 个受影响 skill 与 8 个风险类别。42.5% 的成功案例是在首轮非成功之后才转为成功，说明风险要靠多轮轨迹而非单次沙箱运行才能暴露；基于轨迹的标注把执行前防护准确率 (pre-execution guard accuracy) 提到 0.770。
Motivation: agent skill 的风险出现在模型决策、用户上下文、工具调用与执行反馈的交互中，而非稳定签名或单次沙箱运行；现有静态、动态与 benchmark 式评测很少留下可被检查、检索和复用的公开证据。
Method: 构建托管的攻击轨迹库 SkillAtlas，将私有 agent skill 安全报告包转换为经人工审核、脱敏、可检索的公开案例，并按风险类别组织轨迹与标签，支持执行前防护的轨迹级标注。
Result: 库规模为 3,014 个案例、6,589 条轨迹、151,131 个步骤、233 个受影响 skill、8 个风险类别；42.5% 的成功案例在首轮非成功之后才变为成功；trajectory-grounded labels 将 pre-execution guard accuracy 提升到 0.770。
Conclusion: skill 安全风险需要以多轮、可复用的公开攻击轨迹来刻画，且轨迹级标注能直接支撑执行前防护。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Lookahead
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning (RL) with transition look-ahead, where the agent may observe which states would be visited upon playing any sequence of actions before deciding its course of action. Although look-ahead can substantially improve achievable performance, [1] showed that optimal planning with multi-step transition look-ahead is NP-hard. However, this hardness was established using a discount factor close to one. It was therefore unknown whether the problem remains hard for every discount factor, and whether near-optimal planning can nevertheless be performed efficiently. We resolve both questions. First, we show that for every fixed discount factor, exact planning remains NP-hard. Second, we introduce a randomized polynomial-time approximation scheme for every fixed look-ahead depth. Third, we extend our approach to account for unknown transitions. We empirically validate the soundness of our results on the wind-farm storage-control benchmark of [2], showing that our approach, optimally accounting for -step look-ahead information, offers substantially better performance than existing algorithms. [1] Corentin Pla, Hugo Richard, Marc Abeille, Nadav Merlis, Vianney Perchet : On the Hardness of Reinforcement Learning with Transition Look-Ahead [2] Chenbei Lu, Zaiwei Chen, Tongxin Li, Chenye Wu, Adam Wierman : Reinforcement Learning with Imperfect Transition Predictions: A Bellman-Jensen Approach
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在转移多步前瞻 (transition look-ahead) 的强化学习中，作者证明对任意固定折扣因子精确规划仍是 NP-hard，同时给出固定前瞻深度下的随机化多项式时间近似方案 (PTAS)，并扩展到转移未知的情形。在风电场储能控制基准上，该方法显式利用 k 步前瞻信息，性能显著优于现有算法。
Motivation: 已有工作证明多步前瞻下的最优规划是 NP-hard，但该结论只在折扣因子接近 1 时成立，因此任意折扣因子下的复杂度以及近似规划能否高效完成一直未知。
Method: 先证明任意固定折扣因子下精确规划仍为 NP-hard；再针对固定前瞻深度构造随机化 PTAS，并把方案扩展到转移概率未知的设定；实验在 Chenbei Lu 等人的风电场储能控制基准 (wind-farm storage-control benchmark) 上进行。
Result: 理论结果：对每个固定折扣因子精确规划保持 NP-hard；对每个固定前瞻深度存在随机化多项式时间近似方案；方法可处理未知转移。实验上，显式计入 k 步前瞻信息的该方法在风电场储能控制基准上性能显著优于现有算法。
Conclusion: 多步前瞻的规划难度不依赖于折扣因子接近 1，但在固定前瞻深度下仍可高效近似，且把前瞻信息显式纳入规划能带来实质性能提升。

papers.title: Rice's Theorem under Self-Modification: Elevation Operators and a Normal Form
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether it can be certified algorithmically that a self-modifying program keeps a behavioural property, a safety property in the motivating case, after its next rewrite (preservation) and along its whole evolution (persistence). When the rewrite depends only on behaviour, preservation is a behavioural property and Rice's theorem applies. When the rewrite reads the code, preservation is no longer behavioural; yet, under a uniform disruption condition, the s-m-n reduction that proves Rice's theorem works inside a single class of behaviourally identical programs, and preservation inherits the degree of the halting problem. One step never exceeds the degree of the property, while persistence can climb one level of the arithmetical hierarchy. We then isolate the mechanism shared by rewriting, supervision and system comparison, the elevation operator, and prove a normal form: the preserving set is determined by a single finite trigger and a polarity, and the Rice-Shapiro theorem restricts the polarity to the arithmetical class of the property. Runtime monitors, consistency supervision, conformance to a reference and observational equivalence are instances, and no sound theory covers the preserving systems.
papers.comment: v3: journal version. Shortened; neutral terminology; new Proposition 7.12 showing that the class of elevation operators is complete for anchored normal forms; comparison with enforcement by program rewriting (Hamlen, Morrisett and Schneider) added; illustrations moved to an appendix. 35 pages. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.28639 (applied consequences)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文问：能否算法上认证自修改程序在下一次改写后（preservation）以及整个演化过程中（persistence）保持某行为性质（动机情形为安全性质）。结论是：当改写只依赖行为时 preservation 仍是行为性质，Rice 定理直接适用；当改写读代码时 preservation 不再是行为性质，但在统一破坏条件下 s-m-n 归约可在行为等价类内部完成，preservation 继承停机问题的度；单步不超过性质的度，而 persistence 可沿算术层级上升一级。
Motivation: 自修改程序的安全性质认证缺少判定性刻画：改写依赖代码时 Rice 定理的前提失效，需要新的不可判定性论证来说明 preservation 与 persistence 的可认证边界。
Method: 在统一破坏条件 (uniform disruption condition) 下把证明 Rice 定理的 s-m-n 归约限制在单个行为等价程序类内完成；提炼出改写、监督与系统比较共用的 elevation operator，并证明范式定理：preserving 集由单个有限触发器与极性决定，Rice-Shapiro 定理把极性限制在该性质的算术类；新增 Proposition 7.12 证明 elevation operator 类对 anchored normal form 完备。
Result: preservation 继承停机问题的度；单步演化不超过性质的度，persistence 可在算术层级上升一级；范式表明 preserving 集由单个有限触发器加极性刻画，极性受 Rice-Shapiro 限制；运行时监控、一致性监督、对参考实现的符合性与观察等价都是该范式实例，且不存在覆盖 preserving 系统的可靠理论。
Conclusion: 自修改程序的性质保持认证在读代码的改写下仍不可判定，其机制统一为 elevation operator 的范式，且任何可靠理论都无法覆盖全部 preserving 系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural Process Supervision for Latent Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning approaches enhance token-level efficiency and robustness by replacing verbose, explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens with compact continuous-space embeddings. However, existing methods lack efficient process supervision over these embeddings, which often leads to representation collapse and uneven information distribution. % However, supervising these latent embeddings is challenging because a fixed number of latent states must capture information from variable-length reasoning traces. To address this, we propose Prototype-Mediated Process Supervision (PMPS), which introduces learnable reasoning prototypes as semantic anchors to provide structural process-level supervision for latent reasoning. PMPS projects latent embeddings and explicit CoT embeddings into a shared prototype space, achieving many-to-many soft alignment between unequal-length representations through prototype assignment. Meanwhile, we introduce a Progressive Sequential Alignment (PSA) module to further guide training: positional priors initially encourage sequential alignment structure, then gradually relax to permit adaptive matching. Experimental results show that PMPS compresses output token length to under 50% of explicit CoT on GSM8K-Aug. Compared to leading baseline SIM-CoT, our method achieves average accuracy gains of 2.51% across different model families. On GPT-2, accuracy of PMPS even surpasses CoT-SFT. On larger models and a more challenging task, PMPS consistently attains the highest accuracy among all latent reasoning methods with comparable output length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出原型中介的过程监督 (PMPS)，用可学习的推理原型作语义锚，把隐式 CoT 嵌入与显式 CoT 嵌入投影到共享原型空间做多对多软对齐，并用渐进序列对齐 (PSA) 先强制顺序结构再放松为自适应匹配。在 GSM8K-Aug 上输出 token 长度压到显式 CoT 的 50% 以内，相比 SIM-CoT 平均准确率提升 2.51%。
Motivation: 隐式 CoT 用连续嵌入替代冗长显式 token，但缺少对这些嵌入的高效过程监督，容易出现表征坍缩与信息分布不均。
Method: PMPS 引入可学习推理原型作语义锚，将隐式嵌入与显式 CoT 嵌入投影到共享原型空间，通过原型分配在不等长表示间做多对多软对齐；PSA 模块先用位置先验鼓励顺序对齐，再逐步放松到自适应匹配。
Result: 在 GSM8K-Aug 上输出 token 长度压缩到显式 CoT 的 50% 以内；相比领先基线 SIM-CoT，跨不同模型家族平均准确率提升 2.51%；GPT-2 上 PMPS 准确率超过 CoT-SFT；在更大模型与更难任务上，PMPS 在输出长度相当的所有隐式推理方法中准确率最高。
Conclusion: 以原型锚定的过程监督可以在保持隐式推理 token 高压缩的同时稳定训练，使隐式 CoT 在多个模型家族上达到甚至超过显式 CoT 微调的准确率。

papers.title: A Theory of Reliable Self-Evolution for Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: In harness self-evolution, agents modify their own prompts, code, tools, and orchestration while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent work has shown that agents can improve themselves in response to task failures and achieve substantial performance gains. However, gains on failed tasks do not automatically ensure that performance on previously successful tasks is preserved, raising concerns about reliable adoption. In this work, we provide a theoretically grounded condition under which a self-evolved harness can be reliably adopted. We then propose a validation rule to make the evolved system satisfy the reliable adoption condition with theoretical guarantees. Consequently, the system can achieve progressive improvement through evolution. This leads to a natural question: Does reliable self-evolution have a performance ceiling, and which factors govern this ceiling? Our theoretical results show that the performance ceiling is determined by the costs of verification and evaluation. On the other hand, self-evolution may stall in practice. In this regard, we show that experimental evidence on agent performance shifts can be used to identify the sources of stagnation. Our work thus establishes a theoretical framework for understanding and advancing reliable harness self-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 agent harness 自演化中「失败任务上的增益不保证已成功任务不回退」的问题，给出可可靠采纳的理论条件与配套验证规则，使演化系统在理论保证下实现渐进改进。理论结果表明可靠自演化的性能上限由验证与评估成本决定，并可用 agent 性能漂移的实验证据定位停滞来源。
Motivation: agent 修改自身 prompt、代码、工具与编排后，失败任务上的提升可能以牺牲此前已成功任务为代价，缺乏可靠采纳判据会阻碍自演化系统被实际部署。
Method: 先推导 harness 可被可靠采纳的理论条件，再提出满足该条件并带理论保证的验证规则，使演化后系统可渐进改进；性能上限分析以验证与评估成本为决定因素，并用 agent 性能漂移的实验证据识别停滞原因。
Result: 给出可靠采纳条件与带理论保证的验证规则；证明可靠自演化的性能上限由验证和评估成本决定；并展示如何用 agent 性能漂移的实验证据识别演化停滞的来源。
Conclusion: 可靠自演化需要以显式验证规则约束采纳，其性能天花板由验证与评估成本设定，停滞可由性能漂移证据诊断。

papers.title: Scores Alone Do Not Prove Discovery: The Discovery Certification Protocol for Auditing AI Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents combine public information and experimental feedback to produce measurable results. The Discovery Certification Protocol (DCP) turns an outcome claim into an executable audit under a registered model, information boundary, and budget. Gate 1 validates useful improvement. Gate 2 tests recovery by matched agents given the starting information and observed Web content, with run history and new measurements withheld. Core requires adequate registered controls, zero recoveries, and a finite-sample recovery bound. Optional Gate 3 compares truthful and neutral feedback from a shared checkpoint; Evidence adds a supported effect and a null-policy equivalence check. Controlled SQLite and virtual catalyst audits pass both decision kernels. On real-data response surfaces, Yacht and Ionosphere pass the Core kernel after zero recoveries in 96 attempts, with an upper bound of 0.0468. Each target combines ten observed utilities and six predictions into a 16-entry data product. Yacht scores 0.7677 on reconstruction of all 32 switch effects, with utility-prediction MAE 0.0315 on its six unmeasured configurations. Fresh truthful continuations recover the target level in 9/30 and 16/30 trials, respectively, separating achieved utility from process repeatability. A deterministic verifier reproduces these local decisions from frozen records.

Motivation: AI 研究代理靠公开信息加实验反馈产出可度量结果，单看分数无法区分真实发现与可被匹配代理轻易复现的产物，需要把声明变成可审计的判定问题。

papers.title: No-Regret Mixing of LRU and LFU with Optimal Switching Cost
papers.abstract_en: Caching systems often rely on simple eviction policies such as Least Recently Used (LRU) and Least Frequently Used (LFU), which perform well in complementary request regimes. Recent policies such as LeCar and Cacheus combine LRU and LFU using ideas from the experts problem in online learning. Specifically, upon a miss, they randomize between the two eviction rules using probabilities derived from scores updated by tracking the history of past evictions. While these policies exhibit strong empirical performance, it remains unclear whether they are guaranteed, on every request sequence, to perform asymptotically as well as the better of LRU and LFU, i.e., whether they achieve sublinear regret with respect to this benchmark. We first show that LeCar suffers linear regret against an oblivious adversary, even with unbounded history. We then propose H-MC, a Hedge-based mixture of virtual LRU and LFU caches that preserves Hedge's selection probabilities, and hence its regret guarantees, while minimizing the switching cost among all joint selection rules with these marginals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对缓存淘汰策略中 LRU 与 LFU 混合是否真能达到次线性 regret 的疑问，证明 LeCar 对 oblivious adversary 即使历史无界也存在线性 regret；随后提出 H-MC，用 Hedge 混合虚拟 LRU 与 LFU 缓存，在保持 Hedge 选择边际概率从而保留其 regret 保证的前提下，最小化所有具备该边际的联合选择规则的切换代价。
Motivation: LeCar、Cacheus 等用 experts 思路随机混合 LRU 与 LFU 的策略经验表现好，但是否在每条请求序列上都渐近不劣于 LRU 与 LFU 中较优者（即相对该基准次线性 regret）并不清楚。
Method: 先对 LeCar 建模并证明其对 oblivious adversary 线性 regret（即使历史无界）；再提出 H-MC：以 Hedge 混合虚拟 LRU 与 LFU 缓存，保留 Hedge 的选择概率与 regret 保证，并在所有具有这些边际的联合选择规则中最小化切换代价 (switching cost)。
Result: LeCar 相对 oblivious adversary 为线性 regret，即使历史无界；H-MC 在保持 Hedge 边际选择概率（因而保留其 regret 保证）的联合规则中实现最小切换代价。
Conclusion: 经验表现强的 LRU/LFU 混合策略并不自动具备次线性 regret 保证，而按 Hedge 边际做最小切换代价的耦合可以既保住 regret 保证又降低切换开销。

papers.title: RedKnot-MLA: Multi-Head Offline-Online Reuse for DeepSeek-V4 Long-Context Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) exposes many logical query heads through one packed latent KV stream. This representation is memory efficient, but it removes the physical per-head cache boundary assumed by conventional head-wise reuse. We present our system, a DeepSeek-V4 realization of RedKnot's head-aware reuse principle. Each immutable document is processed offline at canonical position zero; certified Local-head contributions are retained as MLA-Off. At serving time, query-side RoPE relocation restores the document's request position, a small Global-head set and protected Local token rows are recomputed as MLA-Online, and the two paths are merged before a single shared output projection. The packed MLA latent is never split. DeepSeek-V4-Flash uses 37 reusable layers and a 56/8 Local/Global partition, giving a 75.29% analytic logical head-row ceiling; the Pro-0813 profile uses 55 layers and 112/16 heads, giving 78.89%. Frozen Flash operating points show hot-artifact TTFT speedups of 2.02-3.84x. At 256K, the archived three-dataset study reports an aggregate F1 change of +3.24 percentage points, an EM change of +4.16 points, and a 78.7-79.5% analytic major-operator arithmetic saving, while one dataset decreases by 2.81 F1 points. A separate author-reported 256K hot-artifact QPS measurement is approximately 2.0x; because its raw concurrency trace is not included in this bundle, we mark it as preliminary rather than archived evidence. We describe the factorization, position repair, token-row closure, sparse-MoE support, TP8 integration, and the measurement boundaries needed to interpret these results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RedKnot-MLA 把 RedKnot 的 head-aware 复用原则落到 DeepSeek-V4 的 multi-head latent attention (MLA) 上：不可变文档离线在 canonical position zero 处理并保留认证的 Local-head 贡献为 MLA-Off，服务时用 query-side RoPE relocation 恢复请求位置、只重算 Global-head 与受保护的 Local token 行再合并，packed latent 全程不切分。Flash 配置 37 个可复用层、56/8 Local/Global 划分给出 75.29% 的逻辑 head-row 解析上限，hot-artifact TTFT 加速 2.02–3.84x；256K 三数据集汇总 F1 +3.24 个百分点、EM +4.16 个百分点、算子算术节省 78.7–79.5%，但其中一个数据集 F1 下降 2.81 点。
Motivation: MLA 用一条 packed latent KV 流承载大量逻辑 query 头，省内存却抹掉了传统 head-wise 复用所依赖的物理 per-head cache 边界，长上下文服务中不可变文档的跨请求复用因此失效。
Method: 离线阶段在 canonical position zero 处理每份不可变文档并缓存经认证的 Local-head 贡献（MLA-Off）；服务阶段用 query-side RoPE relocation 做位置修复，只重算一小套 Global-head 与受保护的 Local token 行（MLA-Online），两路在单次共享输出投影前合并，packed latent 不拆分。系统还覆盖 token-row closure、sparse-MoE 支持与 TP8 集成。
Result: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 用 37 个可复用层与 56/8 Local/Global 划分，解析逻辑 head-row 上限 75.29%；Pro-0813 profile 用 55 层与 112/16 头，上限 78.89%。冻结 Flash 工作点上 hot-artifact TTFT 加速 2.02–3.84x。256K 归档三数据集研究：聚合 F1 +3.24 个百分点、EM +4.16 个百分点、解析 major-operator 算术节省 78.7–79.5%，其中一个数据集 F1 下降 2.81 点。作者另报 256K hot-artifact QPS 约 2.0x，因原始并发 trace 未随包提供而标为初步结果。
Conclusion: 在不切分 packed MLA latent 的前提下，离线 Local-head 缓存加在线 Global-head 重算与 RoPE 位置修复可以同时拿到 2 倍以上的 TTFT 加速和 256K 上的正向精度变化，但逐数据集收益不一致（有一项 F1 掉 2.81 点），QPS 数字目前只是初步证据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A visual large language foundational model for medical image recognition using clinician-contributed online resources
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across diverse domains, showing considerable potential in medicine. However, their application in medical settings remains limited by the scarcity of visual question answering (VQA) datasets that capture clinical reasoning and explicit image-text alignment. Here, we leverage de-identified medical images and expert commentaries shared through clinician-oriented online resources. By combining an advanced LLM with clinician-in-the-loop verification, we established a rigorous pipeline to construct ThoughtMed-1M, a long-form medical VQA dataset containing over one million VQA pairs and designed to capture structured clinical reasoning and medical image-text alignment. To demonstrate its utility, we developed a FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M (FOLTMed). FOLTMed achieved state-of-the-art performance across 42 medical VQA benchmark datasets, with a macro accuracy of 85.4 percent. It also generated more clinically coherent responses on the ThoughtMed-1M test set, outperforming state-of-the-art models by 3 to 5 percent across factuality and similarity metrics, highlighting a scalable paradigm for advancing research on clinically grounded multimodal LLMs.
papers.comment: The authors are withdrawing this preprint to address an administrative compliance oversight regarding the Data Use Agreement (DUA) for the public de-identified dataset utilized in the study. The manuscript is being withdrawn while the authors coordinate with the data provider to ensure full alignment with institutional data-governance policies
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用临床医生在线资源中的去标识医学图像与专家点评，经高级 LLM 加临床医生在环核验，构建了含逾百万条长回答 VQA 对的 ThoughtMed-1M 数据集，并在其上训练多模态基础模型 FOLTMed。FOLTMed 在 42 个医学 VQA 基准上取得 85.4% 的宏平均准确率，在 ThoughtMed-1M 测试集的事实性与相似度指标上比现有最优模型高 3 到 5 个百分点。
Motivation: 医学 LLM 落地受限于缺少同时刻画临床推理与显式图文对齐的视觉问答数据集，现有资源难以支撑临床可依据的多模态模型训练。
Method: 以临床医生共享的去标识医学图像与专家评论为原料，结合先进 LLM 与 clinician-in-the-loop 核验，构建长回答医学 VQA 数据集 ThoughtMed-1M（逾 100 万 VQA 对，强调结构化临床推理与图文对齐）；再以该数据集训练 FOLTMed 基础模型。
Result: FOLTMed 在 42 个医学 VQA 基准数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，宏平均准确率 85.4%；在 ThoughtMed-1M 测试集上生成的回复在事实性与相似度指标上比 state-of-the-art 模型高 3 至 5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 以 clinician-in-the-loop 流水线从在线临床资源规模化构造 VQA 数据，可训练出在多项医学 VQA 基准上领先的多模态 LLM，作者视其为临床可依据多模态研究的可扩展范式。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Backdoors Leave Structural Traces: FedMAST for Backdoor Detection and Containment in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables distributed training without requiring clients to share their raw data. However, its reliance on the integrity of the client-submitted updates exposes the global model to stealthy backdoor poisoning. Existing defenses often rely on individual evidence sources, but stealth-constrained attacks can adapt to these signals. Such attacks can suppress anomaly signals they are optimized to evade, yet their poisoned updates still leave residual structural traces. We propose FedMAST, a Federated Multi-Axis Structural Tracing defense for backdoor detection in federated learning. FedMAST scores client updates using complementary structural, spectral, and historical evidence and then applies tiered filtering and round-level containment to limit adversarial influence. To capture traces that isolated signals may miss, FedMAST uses squeeze-pair coherence scoring to expose coupled feature distortions and signed spectral-drift tracking to reveal persistent directional changes over time. Across six backdoor attacks, FedMAST achieves lower attack success rate (ASR) than baseline defenses in all nine evaluated comparisons, averaging 1.51% ASR and 94.84% main-task accuracy (MTA) across the complete 200-round runs. Over the full 200-round method-aware CovertLayers run, FedMAST achieves 1.53% ASR and 92.26% MTA, compared with ASRs of 100.00%, 99.67%, 99.53%, and 32.84% for FedAvg, MultiKrum, AlignIns, and FLAME, respectively.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at IEEE ICTAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedMAST 用结构、谱、历史三轴证据给联邦学习客户端更新打分，再做分层过滤与轮级遏制，专抓那些已把异常信号压掉、但更新仍留下耦合特征畸变与持续谱漂移的隐蔽后门。在六种后门攻击、九组对比中 ASR 全部低于基线防御，200 轮平均 ASR 1.51%、主任务精度 (MTA) 94.84%；200 轮 method-aware CovertLayers 上 ASR 1.53%、MTA 92.26%，而 FedAvg、MultiKrum、AlignIns、FLAME 分别为 100.00%、99.67%、99.53%、32.84%。
Motivation: 联邦学习依赖客户端更新的完整性，而按单一证据源优化的隐蔽投毒攻击能主动压低异常信号，使现有防御失效；需要不依赖单点信号的检测依据。
Method: FedMAST（Federated Multi-Axis Structural Tracing）对客户端更新同时用结构、谱 (spectral)、历史三类证据打分：squeeze-pair coherence scoring 暴露耦合特征畸变，signed spectral-drift tracking 追踪跨轮的持续方向性变化；随后施加分层过滤与轮级 (round-level) 遏制以限制对抗影响。

papers.title: SciDocBench: A Workflow-Centered Benchmark and Data Pipeline for Scientific Document Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Scientific papers require models to integrate evidence across text, equations, figures, tables, code, and datasets while preserving its provenance. Beyond answer correctness, scientific reading requires verifiable outputs from operations such as evidence localization, definition extraction, and consistency checking. We introduce SciDocBench, a workflow-centered benchmark targeting these operations through 124 expert-authored and difficulty-screened questions across seven research-assistant capability groups, 19 subtasks, and five scientific domains. Each question is instantiated in four matched settings formed by pairing its bilingual variants with the All Images First and Markdown Interleaved document representations, yielding 496 evaluation instances. The strongest evaluated model, Claude-Opus-5, scores 62.6 out of 100, with remaining gaps in evidence localization, structured information extraction, cross-document synthesis, and robustness to document representation. To convert these diagnostics into scalable training signals, we introduce SciDocIR, a structured representation of scientific document objects, layout and cross-reference relations, and provenance. Using SciDocIR, we construct SciDocDataset, which contains 4K supervised fine-tuning instances and 10K reinforcement-learning instances, built on 14 verifiable training subtasks. Post-training Qwen3.6-27B on task-aligned data improves its SciDocBench score from 40.03 to 45.33 with supervised fine-tuning and to 45.74 with subsequent reinforcement learning. Both adapted models preserve DocVQA and InfoVQA performance and improve ChartQA accuracy over the original model by 0.80 and 3.40 points, respectively. Together, SciDocBench, SciDocIR, and SciDocDataset connect capability diagnosis with verifiable training-data construction for scientific-document assistants.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 21 figures, and 20 tables. Project page: https://github.com/InternLM/SciDocBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciDocBench 是一个以工作流为中心的科学文档理解基准：124 道专家撰写并筛难度的问题，覆盖 7 组研究助理能力、19 个子任务、5 个学科，每题配双语与两种文档表示共 496 个评测实例。最强模型 Claude-Opus-5 仅得 62.6/100，短板在证据定位、结构化抽取、跨文档综合与表示鲁棒性；配套 SciDocIR 表示与 SciDocDataset（4K SFT + 10K RL）把诊断转成可验证训练信号，Qwen3.6-27B 分数从 40.03 提到 45.33（SFT）再到 45.74（RL）。
Motivation: 科学文档阅读要求跨文本、公式、图表、代码与数据集整合证据并保留出处，且证据定位、定义抽取、一致性检查等操作需要可验证输出；现有评测难以把能力诊断直接转成可扩展的训练信号。
Method: 构建 SciDocBench：124 道专家撰写并经难度筛选的问题，按 7 组研究助理能力、19 个子任务、5 个学科组织，每题以双语变体 × All Images First 与 Markdown Interleaved 两种表示配成 496 个实例。再提出 SciDocIR，结构化表示文档对象、版面与交叉引用关系及出处（provenance），据此构建 SciDocDataset，含 4K 监督微调实例与 10K 强化学习实例，覆盖 14 个可验证训练子任务，用于后训练 Qwen3.6-27B。
Result: Claude-Opus-5 得 62.6/100，为被评模型中最高，缺口集中在证据定位、结构化信息抽取、跨文档合成与文档表示鲁棒性。Qwen3.6-27B 经任务对齐数据后训练，SciDocBench 分数由 40.03 升至 45.33（SFT），再至 45.74（随后 RL）；两个适配模型保持 DocVQA 与 InfoVQA 性能，ChartQA 准确率相对原模型分别提高 0.80 与 3.40 个百分点。
Conclusion: 以可验证子任务组织的科学文档基准加结构化中间表示，能把能力诊断转成可扩展的训练数据，在不损伤 DocVQA/InfoVQA 的前提下提升目标分数与 ChartQA。

papers.title: Better Understanding, Better Fixes? A Study of Hallucination in LLM-based Automated Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated program repair (APR), yet existing evaluations remain largely result-centric and provide limited insight into hallucination during repair. In APR, hallucination may arise not only in final patches but also in the intermediate artifacts that guide patch generation. To address this gap, we perform a multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the APR process. Specifically, we characterize hallucination as the production of patches or intermediate artifacts that are not faithfully grounded in the available repair evidence. We examine repair hallucination in final patches and understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts through three tasks, namely triggering testcase identification, line coverage prediction, and additional testcase generation. We then evaluate three representative LLMs on 832 Defects4J bugs through automatic evaluation and manual analysis. Our results show that both repair and understanding hallucinations remain prevalent. Across models and settings, only 21.0%-55.9% of generated patches pass the developer-written test suite. Moreover, although more accurate intermediate artifacts are generally associated with successful repairs, this relationship does not always hold. Manual analysis of 812 sampled repairs identifies repair hallucinations in 72.7% of cases, including patches that pass all available tests; incorrect causal localization and incorrect repair strategies account for 45.9% and 18.5% of these hallucinations, respectively. Meanwhile, models frequently misidentify triggering testcases, mispredict line coverage involving branching control flow, and generate additional testcases with missing bug-triggering conditions or incorrect expected behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 自动程序修复 (APR) 做多层幻觉分析：把幻觉定义为补丁或中间产物未忠实锚定修复证据，并在触发测试用例识别、行覆盖预测、额外测试用例生成三个任务上检验。832 个 Defects4J bug 上仅 21.0%–55.9% 的补丁通过开发者测试套件；人工分析 812 例中 72.7% 存在修复幻觉，其中错误因果定位占 45.9%、错误修复策略占 18.5%。
Motivation: 现有 APR 评测以结果为中心，只看补丁是否通过测试，无法揭示修复过程中间产物（定位、覆盖、测试生成）的幻觉如何传导到最终补丁。
Method: 将幻觉刻画为补丁或中间产物未忠实锚定可用修复证据；分两层考察最终补丁的修复幻觉与中间产物的理解幻觉，后者通过触发测试用例识别、行覆盖预测、额外测试用例生成三个任务度量；在 832 个 Defects4J bug 上评测三个代表性 LLM，结合自动评测与人工分析。
Result: 跨模型与设置仅 21.0%–55.9% 的生成补丁通过开发者编写的测试套件；中间产物更准确通常与修复成功相关但并非总是成立；人工分析 812 例抽样修复中 72.7% 含修复幻觉（包括通过全部可用测试的补丁），其中错误因果定位占 45.9%、错误修复策略占 18.5%；模型还常误判触发测试用例、误预测涉及分支控制流的行覆盖、生成缺少触发条件或期望行为错误的额外测试。
Conclusion: 补丁通过测试并不等于修复过程忠实：修复幻觉在通过全部测试的案例中同样普遍存在，中间产物准确性与修复成功的关联不稳定，因此 APR 评测需要从结果中心转向同时审计中间产物。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Linguistic Trajectory Encoding for Efficient Long-Horizon Spatial Memory in Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents performing long-horizon tasks require a memory representation in which the state transitions of dynamic objects remain queryable in natural language across hours-to-days observation horizons. Existing systems either drop fine-grained motion (clip-level video-language embeddings), keep it only as raw coordinates (geometric SLAM), or organise it around immediate task context (agent working memories). None of them gives the agent a per-object timeline whose state transitions are themselves queryable in language. Our key contribution is \textbf{Linguistic Trajectory Encoding} (LTE), which compresses dynamic object motion histories via a hybrid representation combining natural language descriptions, sparse spatial anchors, and visual anchors. LTE adapts compression to motion complexity by anchoring periods without reliable observations to the last seen location, while representing motion with geometric waypoints and linguistic descriptions to preserve accuracy. To evaluate these capabilities across extended time horizons, we construct the \textbf{Spatial Memory Benchmark} (SMB) from EgoLife multi-day recordings, targeting capabilities absent in existing benchmarks: semantic trajectory retrieval and long-horizon object retrieval. On SMB, the LTE-based system achieves $45.3\%$ success in semantic trajectory retrieval and $48.7\%$ in long-horizon object retrieval, outperforming structured-memory and VLM baselines (best prior: $31.9\%$ and $34.4\%$). LTE achieves trajectory compression by factors of $8.7\times$ to $26.1\times$ with sub-second query latency on $24$\,h video. On Ego4D natural-language queries, the system reaches $28.75\%$ / $55.10\%$ R@1/R@5, $+15.80$ / $+31.30$ pts over EgoVLPv2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Linguistic Trajectory Encoding (LTE)，把动态物体的运动历史压成自然语言描述 + 稀疏空间锚点 + 视觉锚点的混合表示，使逐物体的状态转移可在数小时到数天尺度上用语言查询。在由 EgoLife 多日记录构建的 Spatial Memory Benchmark (SMB) 上，语义轨迹检索成功率 45.3%、长时程物体检索 48.7%，对比最优结构化记忆与 VLM 基线的 31.9% 与 34.4%；轨迹压缩 8.7× 至 26.1×，24 小时视频查询延迟亚秒级。
Motivation: 现有具身记忆系统要么用片段级视频-语言嵌入丢掉细粒度运动，要么只存原始坐标的几何 SLAM，要么围绕即时任务上下文组织工作记忆，都无法给出逐物体、可用语言查询状态转移的时间线。
Method: LTE 按运动复杂度自适应压缩：无可靠观测的时段锚定到最后一次出现位置，运动段则用几何 waypoint 加语言描述联合表示；评测时从 EgoLife 多日记录构建 SMB，含语义轨迹检索与长时程物体检索两项任务，并在 Ego4D 自然语言查询上检验。
Result: SMB 上语义轨迹检索 45.3%、长时程物体检索 48.7%，对比最优结构化记忆与 VLM 基线 31.9% 与 34.4%；轨迹压缩 8.7×–26.1×，24 小时视频查询延迟亚秒级。Ego4D 自然语言查询 R@1/R@5 为 28.75%/55.10%，较 EgoVLPv2 提升 +15.80/+31.30 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把物体运动历史编码为语言可查询的混合轨迹表示，能在数天尺度上同时保住检索精度与压缩率，优于结构化记忆和 VLM 基线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: Unattended interactive autonomy - machines that step into danger in place of humans and complete tasks with human tools - remains a missing capability in mission-critical operations. These domains offer scarce training data and only onboard compute, yet deployed systems must face novelty without erasing prior competence. We introduce Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), which learn efficiently in the lab and continue learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates. CFAM uses a complementary learning architecture with a frozen slow-learning component and a fast-learning Capsule Field. The slow component contains three cortices: Sensor, which maps multimodal input into 3D-grounded geometry; Reasoning, which decomposes tasks into skills and evaluates outcomes; and Action, which executes geometric skills. The Capsule Field stores field learning one-shot and gradient-free as Competence Capsules. Skill installation is few-shot in the lab and continual in the field; open-world novelty is outside scope. We evaluate CFAM across five embodiments: manipulator, quadruped, humanoid, quadrotor, and off-road vehicle. Baselines (pi0, CogACT, SpatialVLA) use the same in-house multi-embodiment dataset for physical-platform comparisons. CFAM reaches the operating point of a standard policy trained on the full prior-training dataset using 40% of the data, or 2.5x fewer trajectories. At test time, autonomous capture of verified near-OOD cases improves action success by 13.9 percentage points. In sequential simulation, backward transfer is -0.5 percentage points versus -11.4 for LoRA. CFAM therefore provides a bounded form of post-deployment physical intelligence: few-shot skill learning, autonomous field growth from verified near-OOD experience, and retention of prior competence.

papers.title: DuplexSpeechBench-IFEval: Evaluating Implicit Instruction Following in Full-Duplex Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex voice agents must continuously decide when to speak, listen, backchannel, interrupt, overlap, and yield the conversational floor. Existing benchmarks evaluate these behaviors through explicit turn-management instructions, whereas voice agents are often configured through roles or personas from which appropriate conversational behavior must be inferred. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-IFEval (DSB-IFEval), a benchmark for evaluating implicit instruction following in real-time spoken interaction. DSB-IFEval comprises 1,038 test cases derived from 240 controlled conversations spanning eight behaviorally contrastive assistant roles and five conditioning protocols: default behavior, explicit behavioral instructions, persona-implied behavior, combined persona-rule conditioning, and instruction conflict. We measure real-time floor management using the deterministic Instruction Adherence Score (IAS) and persona-consistent response content using the LLM-judged Persona Adherence Score (PAS). Across eleven real-time speech models, we find that executing an explicit floor-management policy does not reliably imply the ability to infer the same policy from a persona. Moreover, even frontier models such as GPT-Live-1 and Gemini-3.8-Live adapt their dialogue language to the assigned persona without consistently translating that persona into the appropriate full-duplex floor-management behavior. Finally, models that successfully resolve benign instruction conflicts often fail when safety-relevant role behavior should override an explicit directive. These results show that inferring role-implied behavior, executing it in real time, and resolving instruction conflicts remain distinct challenges for full-duplex voice agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DSB-IFEval，评测全双工语音代理在没有显式指令时能否从角色/人设推断出应有的让话行为。在 11 个实时语音模型上，能执行显式话轮管理策略并不意味着能从 persona 推断同一策略，GPT-Live-1 与 Gemini-3.8-Live 会改口吻却不会把 persona 转成对的全双工让话行为；良性指令冲突能解、涉及安全的角色行为却常压不过显式指令。
Motivation: 现有基准都用显式话轮管理指令来评测，而真实部署里语音代理靠角色或 persona 配置，合适行为必须被推断出来，这条链路此前没有被单独度量。
Method: DSB-IFEval 含 1,038 个测试用例，源自 240 段受控对话，覆盖 8 个行为对照的助手角色与 5 种条件化协议（默认行为、显式行为指令、persona 隐含行为、persona+规则组合、指令冲突）；用确定性的 Instruction Adherence Score (IAS) 度量实时话轮管理，用 LLM 判分的 Persona Adherence Score (PAS) 度量回答内容与 persona 的一致性。
Result: 在 11 个实时语音模型上：执行显式话轮管理策略不能可靠推出从 persona 推断同一策略的能力；GPT-Live-1 与 Gemini-3.8-Live 会按 persona 调整对话语言，却不一致地把它转成全双工话轮管理行为；能成功化解良性指令冲突的模型，在安全相关角色行为应当覆盖显式指令时常常失败。
Conclusion: 推断角色隐含行为、实时执行它、解决指令冲突对全双工语音代理是三个彼此独立的挑战，不能用其中一个的表现代表另外两个。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WeaveMark: Robust and Scalable Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Coded Payload Spreading
papers.abstract_en: Multi-bit watermarking for large language models enables content source tracing by embedding user-identifiable messages into generated text. Existing methods face a fundamental trade-off among extraction accuracy, text quality, and payload capacity. We propose WeaveMark, a robust and scalable multi-bit LLM watermarking scheme based on coded payload spreading. WeaveMark shifts this trade-off frontier by improving payload capacity through multi-bit-per-token spreading (weaving), improving extraction accuracy through soft-decision error-correcting codes, and preserving text quality through unbiased multilayer reweighting. It further introduces dedicated zero-bit layers for reliable watermark presence detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial gains in extraction performance, especially for long messages and edited text, without degrading text quality. WeaveMark achieves an 89.8% match rate for 32-bit messages at 200 tokens, compared with 20.8% for BiMark. Under 10% substitution attacks on 16-bit messages at 200 tokens, it maintains 86.0% versus 30.7%. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WeaveMark-ED6F.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 16 tables. v2: added extended comparisons (payload scalability, generalization across model families), additional robustness results (insertion/deletion, truncation, copy-paste, rewriting), context-window and statistical reliability analyses; revised presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeaveMark 用编码载荷扩散做多比特 LLM 水印：每 token 写入多比特 (weaving)、用软判决纠错码提抽取准确率、以无偏多层重加权保文本质量，并加零比特层做水印存在检测。200 token 下 32-bit 消息匹配率 89.8%（BiMark 20.8%），10% 替换攻击下 16-bit 消息保持 86.0%（30.7%）。
Motivation: 多比特 LLM 水印在抽取准确率、文本质量与载荷容量之间存在根本性权衡，现有方法在长消息和被编辑文本上抽取失败。
Method: 基于 coded payload spreading：多比特每 token 的 weaving 提升载荷容量，软判决纠错码 (soft-decision ECC) 提升抽取准确率，无偏多层重加权 (unbiased multilayer reweighting) 保文本质量，另设专用零比特层做水印存在检测；v2 补充插入/删除、截断、复制粘贴、改写等鲁棒性与跨模型族泛化分析。
Result: 200 token、32-bit 消息匹配率 89.8% 对 BiMark 的 20.8%；10% substitution 攻击下 200 token、16-bit 消息保持 86.0% 对 30.7%；作者称抽取增益在长消息与被编辑文本上显著且不降文本质量。
Conclusion: 把载荷容量、抽取准确率与文本质量三者的权衡前沿整体外推是可行的：weaving 加软判决纠错码在长消息和编辑攻击下大幅提高匹配率，同时保持文本质量。

papers.title: EvoSCM: Scientific Belief Revision Through Causal Model Evolution and Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery depends on the ability to form hypotheses, test them through experiments, and revise them when evidence disagrees. Existing LLM agents support this process by improving their reasoning or actions, but their scientific beliefs are often scattered across free-form reasoning and difficult to update coherently. This makes it difficult to identify what failed, what should change, and whether revisions remain consistent with prior evidence. We introduce EvoSCM, which represents scientific beliefs as a population of structural causal model (SCM) hypotheses that can be tested and revised across experiments. EvoSCM formulates scientific discovery as a closed loop in which causal hypotheses guide experimentation and experimental outcomes drive causal model evolution. Competing SCM hypotheses make falsifiable predictions and guide discriminative experiments that separate alternative explanations. When observations contradict these predictions, EvoSCM distills discrepancies into correction rules identifying which aspects of the hypotheses fail to explain the evidence. These rules guide revisions to causal dependencies, latent factors, mechanisms, and parameters. Revised hypotheses are validated against accumulated evidence and carried forward to guide subsequent experiments, allowing scientific beliefs to evolve cumulatively. We evaluate EvoSCM across physics, chemistry and materials, and biology. It consistently outperforms baseline agents and existing evolution methods, yielding more accurate explanations and predictions with more effective use of experimental budgets. The evolved SCMs also transfer across base models, suggesting reusable scientific knowledge beyond any single model's reasoning process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoSCM 把科学信念表示为一组结构因果模型 (SCM) 假设种群，构成「因果假设指导实验、实验结果驱动因果模型演化」的闭环：竞争假设给出可证伪预测并挑选判别性实验，观测矛盾被蒸馏成修正规则来改写因果依赖、潜在因子、机制与参数。在物理、化学与材料、生物三类任务上，它持续优于基线 agent 与已有演化方法，用实验预算更高效，演化出的 SCM 还能跨基座模型迁移。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 的科学信念散落在自由形式推理里，难以连贯更新，于是无法定位哪一步失败、该改什么、修订是否与既有证据一致。
Method: 以 SCM 假设种群表征信念，闭环中竞争假设做可证伪预测并引导判别性实验；观测与预测矛盾时蒸馏出修正规则，据此修订因果依赖、潜在因子、机制与参数，修订后的假设再对累积证据做验证并带入下一轮实验。
Result: 在物理、化学与材料、生物三个领域评测，EvoSCM 一致优于基线 agent 与已有演化方法，给出更准确的解释与预测，并更有效地使用实验预算；演化出的 SCM 可跨基座模型迁移。
Conclusion: 把科学信念显式建成可检验、可修订的 SCM 种群，比散落的自由推理更能支持累积式科学发现，且学到的因果知识可复用于单个模型的推理之外。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiLRP: Toward One Trustworthy Explanation for Vision Transformer: Conservation-Valid Attribution via Attention Primitives
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformer (ViT) design has become increasingly diverse, with backbones combining convolutional stems, windowed, linear, or multi-axis attention, patch merging, and spatial reduction in various configurations. This diversity poses challenges for existing attribution methods, whose assumptions often do not hold across ViT variants: Grad-CAM requires a terminal spatial feature map, attention rollout assumes global softmax attention, and layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) requires module-specific rules. To the best of our knowledge, no existing method provides a unified attribution framework across this architectural space. We show that this architectural diversity can be captured by a simpler underlying structure. The attention and resolution-reduction operators in current ViTs can be decomposed into four operation types: linear maps, bilinear mixing, normalization or gating, and reindexing. Each operation admits a relevance rule that satisfies conservation. Based on these rules, HiLRP supports new backbones by construction rather than by architecture-specific derivation, and its attribution maps decompose the prediction rather than relying on heuristic assumptions. We prove conservation and conditional equivariance and verify both to machine precision. Across 14 attribution methods and 10 architectures, we find that no prior method remains reliable across ViT families, while Faithfulness Correlation becomes uninformative for backbones robust to spatial masking. HiLRP alone preserves conservation across windowed, spatial-reduction, multi-axis, and linear-attention models, where naive extensions can produce zero or inflated relevance. It also localizes attribution failures in class activation mapping, achieving 0.97 Pointing compared with 0.55 for competing methods on EfficientViT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiLRP 把 ViT 的注意力与分辨率缩减算子分解为线性映射、双线性混合、归一化/门控、重索引四类操作，每类给出满足守恒性的相关性规则，从而按构造而非逐架构推导支持新 backbone。证明了守恒性与条件等变性并验证到机器精度；在 14 种归因方法、10 种架构上仅 HiLRP 在 windowed、spatial-reduction、multi-axis、linear attention 上保持守恒，EfficientViT 上 Pointing 达 0.97（对比方法 0.55）。
Motivation: ViT 架构日趋多样（卷积 stem、windowed/linear/multi-axis attention、patch merging、spatial reduction），而 Grad-CAM 需要末端空间特征图、attention rollout 假设全局 softmax、LRP 需逐模块规则，现有归因方法的假设跨变体失效，缺少统一框架。
Method: 将注意力与分辨率缩减算子分解为四类操作（线性映射、双线性混合、归一化/门控、重索引），为每类给出满足守恒性的相关性规则；HiLRP 按构造支持新 backbone，归因图是对预测的分解而非启发式假设，并证明守恒性与条件等变性。
Result: 在 14 种归因方法、10 种架构的比较中，没有先前方法在 ViT 家族间保持可靠，且对空间遮挡鲁棒的 backbone 上 Faithfulness Correlation 变得无信息；HiLRP 是唯一在 windowed、spatial-reduction、multi-axis、linear attention 上保持守恒的方法（朴素扩展会产生零或膨胀的相关性），并在 EfficientViT 上取得 0.97 Pointing，对比方法为 0.55；守恒性与条件等变性验证到机器精度。
Conclusion: ViT 归因的架构多样性可归结为四类底层操作，按操作类型给出守恒规则即可得到跨架构统一且可分解预测的归因；类激活映射的归因失败可被定位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Do Language Models Choose Between Context and Memory?
papers.abstract_en: When contextual information conflicts with knowledge stored in model parameters, activation directions can be used to decode and steer which source the model follows. However, successful steering does not establish that the unedited model uses those directions to choose between sources, or that they remain effective across tasks. To test these possibilities, we vary the stated authority of contextual claims while holding their content fixed. We first estimate authority directions from prompts in which context and parametric knowledge agree, then test their causal contribution when the two sources conflict. Interchanging naturally occurring activation values along these directions between matched high- and low-authority prompts reproduces 30--68% of the authority-induced shift in source choice across Qwen, Llama, and OLMo models, whereas matched controls reproduce almost none. We next ask what transfers across tasks: the learned direction versus the activation values exchanged along it. Using a direction learned on another task closed 9% of the source-choice gap, compared with 57% when learned on the task being evaluated. Both interventions exchanged activation values from the evaluated task. In a separate experiment, we kept its learned direction but exchanged values taken from another task, which closed 68% of the gap. These results show that authority-related activation values can causally influence source choice across tasks when inserted along directions learned for the task being evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在上下文与参数知识冲突时，语言模型按上下文中声明的权威性 (authority) 选择信源；沿从一致提示中估出的 authority 方向互换激活值，可在 Qwen、Llama、OLMo 上复现 30–68% 的权威性引起的信源选择偏移，而匹配对照几乎为零。跨任务迁移时，方向本身迁移差（换任务学的方向只补 9% 的信源选择差距，本任务学的补 57%），但沿本任务方向插入来自另一任务的激活值可补 68%。
Motivation: 激活方向能解码并操纵模型跟随上下文还是参数知识，但成功的操纵并不证明未编辑的模型本身就用这些方向做选择，也不保证方向跨任务仍有效。
Method: 固定上下文内容、只改变其声明的权威性；先在上下文与参数知识一致的提示上估计 authority 方向，再在两者冲突时检验其因果贡献：在匹配的高/低权威提示间沿该方向互换自然出现的激活值，并设置匹配对照；随后分离“学到的方向”与“沿方向交换的激活值”，分别做跨任务迁移实验。
Result: 沿方向互换激活值复现 30–68% 的权威性引起的信源选择偏移（Qwen、Llama、OLMo），匹配对照几乎为零。跨任务时，用另一任务学到的方向只补上 9% 的信源选择差距，用被评估任务上学到的方向补 57%；保持被评估任务的方向、改用另一任务的激活值则补 68%。
Conclusion: 决定信源选择的是沿任务相关方向插入的激活值而非方向本身，权威性相关的激活值可跨任务因果地影响模型选边。

papers.title: Nonparametric Contextual Pricing and Inventory Learning under Censored Demand
papers.abstract_en: In online retailing, when a product sells out, a retailer often sees only the units sold, not how many customers would have bought it had inventory been available. However, the inventory level determines how much demand is revealed, and this information can influence subsequent decisions and future profits. We study an online selling problem in which, in each round, the seller observes a market context and then makes pricing and stocking decisions based on censored sales data from previous rounds. The challenge is to learn a context-dependent pricing and stocking policy without assuming a particular formula for demand or observing realized profit. To overcome this difficulty, we propose a Mean-Calibrated Kernel UCB (MCK-UCB) algorithm that turns each incomplete sales record into a reliable guide for both inventory and price decisions, using data from past rounds with similar market conditions. This design allows us to learn while serving customers, without a separate exploration phase or the need to recover all demand hidden by stockouts. We prove the minimax optimality of the proposed algorithm, with strictly faster rates when expected profit varies more smoothly with price. Comprehensive numerical experiments have been conducted to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线零售缺货导致需求被截断 (censored demand)，提出非参数的 Mean-Calibrated Kernel UCB (MCK-UCB)，用相似市场情境的历史销售记录同时指导定价与库存决策。算法被证明 minimax 最优，且当期望利润随价格变化更光滑时收敛速率严格更快，数值实验确认其有效性。
Motivation: 产品售罄时只能看到已售数量，看不到被库存截断的真实需求；库存水平本身又决定多少需求被观测到，而不假设需求函数形式、也观测不到实际利润时，难以学出依赖情境的定价与备货策略。
Method: 提出 MCK-UCB：以核方法 (kernel) 在相似市场情境的历史轮次上聚合不完整销售记录，做均值校准后同时给出库存与价格的 UCB 决策，无需单独探索阶段，也无需恢复全部被缺货隐藏的需求。
Result: 证明了算法的 minimax 最优性；当期望利润对价格更光滑时速率严格更快；并进行了综合数值实验确认算法有效性。
Conclusion: 把每条被截断的销售记录校准成对库存与定价都可靠的信号，即可在服务过程中在线学习，且最优速率随利润-价格光滑度提升。

papers.title: Can Video World Models Track Unobserved World States?
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators, but visual fidelity alone does not show that a model maintains the hidden state of the world. We examine this difference with an action-conditioned video Shell Game, a visual analogue of $S_5$ state tracking that separates visual rendering from compositing the unobserved world state. Trained on 5-swap chains, standard backbones (e.g., bidirectional and autoregressive Transformers, Mamba, and linear attention) render plausible videos and predict the correct ball location up to 5 swaps. However, they fail to learn the rule and generalize to longer swap chains, even with more denoising steps. As the pixel-based diffusion loss does not force the generated frames to hold the unseen ball position, output tokens cannot carry it, and the state has to live within the architecture. In a causal Transformer, this implicit state is an append-only KV cache, which is written once and never revised, so the model must re-compose the swaps at every chunk. Tracking $S_5$ this way requires depth to grow with sequence length, which no fixed-depth Transformer provides. We study what enables learning the rule, and find that length generalization requires a revisable state carried across chunks and an update expressive enough to apply a swap. Linear attention can achieve this by allowing negative transition eigenvalues, and autoregressive Transformers can do so with nonlinear TTT fast weights (e.g., SwiGLU) whose online updates change the feature map used to read their state. We further examine Memory Maze and Block World, where the state is not fixed by the input action stream alone and must be corrected from observations or keeps changing out of view, and discuss the implications for building stateful video world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用动作条件化的视频 Shell Game（$S_5$ 状态追踪的视觉类比）检验视频世界模型是否真的维护未观测的隐藏状态：标准骨干在 5 次交换内能渲染合理视频并答对球的位置，却学不会规则、无法泛化到更长交换链，即使增加去噪步数也无效。作者指出长度泛化需要跨 chunk 携带的可修订状态与足以执行一次 swap 的更新算子：线性注意力靠允许负转移特征值实现，自回归 Transformer 靠 SwiGLU 等非线性 TTT fast weights 的在线更新改变读取状态的特征映射实现。
Motivation: 视觉保真度高不等于模型维护了世界的隐藏状态：像素级扩散损失不强制生成帧保持未见球的位置，输出 token 装不下该状态，状态只能寄生在架构里，导致固定深度 Transformer 无法随序列长度增长所需深度。
Method: 构造动作条件化的视频 Shell Game 作为 $S_5$ 状态追踪的视觉类比，把视觉渲染与未观测状态合成分离；在 5-swap 链上训练双向/自回归 Transformer、Mamba、线性注意力等标准骨干，并分析因果 Transformer 中 append-only KV cache 的隐式状态机制；再考察 Memory Maze 与 Block World 两类状态需由观测修正或持续变化的场景。
Result: 标准骨干在 5 次交换内预测球位置正确，但无法泛化到更长交换链，增加去噪步数也不改善；因果 Transformer 的隐式状态是只写一次、从不修订的 KV cache，追踪 $S_5$ 所需深度随序列长度增长，而固定深度 Transformer 不具备。长度泛化由可跨 chunk 修订的状态加足够表达的 swap 更新算子实现：线性注意力允许负转移特征值，自回归 Transformer 用 SwiGLU 等非线性 TTT fast weights 的在线更新改变读取状态的特征映射。
Conclusion: 要让视频世界模型真正追踪未观测状态，必须让状态跨 chunk 可修订、更新算子足以表达一次 swap，而不是依赖只写不改的缓存与像素重建损失。

papers.title: A Systematic Survey of Agentic Skills: Architecture, Lifecycle, and Security
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents increasingly face reliability, context consumption, and execution stability bottlenecks when deployed on complex, long-horizon tasks. While monolithic prompt engineering and stateless tool-calling paradigms struggle to scale, the field is rapidly converging toward \emph{agentic skills}: modular procedural abstractions that externalize execution knowledge into reusable, executable, and portable artifacts. This paper establishes a unified systems foundation and reference architecture for the agentic skills ecosystem. We formalize skills as externalized procedural knowledge bridging high-level cognitive planning with deterministic execution environments, and systematically delineate the architecture across a nine-stage lifecycle: autonomous discovery, authoring and representation formats, memory storage, dynamic retrieval and routing, composition and orchestration, execution and repair, lifelong adaptation, empirical evaluation, and security governance. We further examine marketplace dynamics, public registries, and emerging adversarial threat vectors, alongside runtime verification and defense mechanisms. Finally, we categorize system implementations across software engineering, operating system navigation, embodied robotics, and scientific discovery, while highlighting critical open challenges in continual learning and benchmark realism. This work establishes agentic skills as a foundational paradigm for building scalable, robust, and verifiable autonomous language agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文为 LLM 智能体的 agentic skills（模块化、可外部执行的程序性技能）建立统一系统基础与参考架构，把技能形式化为连接高层规划与确定性执行环境的外部化程序知识，并按九阶段生命周期（发现、编写与表示格式、存储、动态检索与路由、组合编排、执行与修复、终身适应、实证评估、安全治理）划分架构，同时梳理市场机制、公共注册表、对抗威胁与运行时验证防御。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在复杂长程任务上遭遇可靠性、上下文消耗与执行稳定性瓶颈，单体提示工程与无状态 tool-calling 难以扩展，且 agentic skills 生态缺少统一的系统性架构框架。
Method: 把 skills 形式化为外部化程序知识，系统化给出九阶段生命周期参考架构（discovery、authoring/representation、memory storage、retrieval/routing、composition/orchestration、execution/repair、lifelong adaptation、evaluation、security governance），并按软件工程、OS 导航、具身机器人、科学发现四类系统实现做分类，同时梳理对抗威胁与运行时验证防御。
Result: 综述性工作，给出九阶段生命周期架构、市场与公共注册表动态、对抗威胁向量与防御机制分类，以及跨软件工程、操作系统导航、具身机器人、科学发现的系统实现分类；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: agentic skills 是构建可扩展、稳健、可验证自主语言代理的基础范式，其关键开放问题在持续学习与 benchmark 真实性。

papers.title: AGM: Achievement-Grounded Memory for Closed-Loop Agents with Frozen VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer broad manipulation skills but execute open-loop action chunks without tracking task progress, so the agent cannot reliably decide whether to continue, retry, or terminate. External memory is a natural remedy, yet we find it can be harmful when attempted actions are recorded as completed progress: transient execution failures become persistent task-state errors, and such a memory can underperform no progress memory at all. We propose Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM), a lightweight closed-loop framework for frozen VLA policies. AGM represents a task as a static subgoal sequence with a dynamic progress pointer and advances the pointer on physically verified achievement rather than on attempts. Proprioceptive gripper-load cues decide when to verify; coherent point tracking verifies grasps, and language-conditioned cross-view comparison, read by a single trained 2.43M-parameter verification head, verifies placements. The policy, tracker, and encoder remain frozen, the head is the only trained component, and deployment needs no auxiliary vision-language model. On the RoboMME Counting benchmark, AGM reaches 100.0% on PickXTimes and 84.0% on BinFill, surpassing the strongest memory-augmented baseline by 7.7 points on the four-task average, and the gains carry over to a physical robot, where AGM reaches 100.0% and 82.0%. These results suggest that reliable embodied memory depends more on disciplined state updates than on memory capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AGM 为冻结的 VLA 策略提供闭环记忆：任务表示为静态子目标序列加动态进度指针，指针只在物理验证达成时推进，而不是在尝试动作时推进。在 RoboMME Counting 上 PickXTimes 达 100.0%、BinFill 达 84.0%，四任务平均比最强记忆增强基线高 7.7 个百分点，实体机器人上为 100.0% 与 82.0%。
Motivation: 冻结 VLA 策略执行开环动作块、不跟踪任务进度，无法可靠判断继续、重试还是终止；而把已尝试动作记为已完成进度的外部记忆会把瞬时执行失败固化成持久任务状态错误，甚至不如完全没有进度记忆。
Method: AGM 用静态子目标序列加动态进度指针表示任务，仅在物理验证达成时推进指针；本体感觉的夹爪负载 (gripper-load) 信号决定何时验证，coherent point tracking 验证抓取，语言条件化的跨视角比较 (cross-view comparison) 验证放置，后者由一个 2.43M 参数的验证头读取。策略、tracker 与 encoder 全部冻结，只有该验证头被训练，部署不需要辅助视觉-语言模型。
Result: 在 RoboMME Counting benchmark 上 AGM 的 PickXTimes 为 100.0%、BinFill 为 84.0%，四任务平均比最强记忆增强基线高 7.7 个百分点；迁移到实体机器人后分别为 100.0% 与 82.0%。
Conclusion: 可靠的具身记忆更取决于受纪律的状态更新（只在验证达成时改进度）而非记忆容量；把尝试误记为完成会让外部记忆反而有害。

papers.title: Does Latent Planning Survive Point Clouds? Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models for Geometric Observations and Goals
papers.abstract_en: Latent action world models let agents plan new behaviors at test time by predicting how actions change the environment, and joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) do so by forecasting future latent states rather than pixels. Yet nearly all such models see the world through a camera, even though robotic manipulation is fundamentally geometric: in robotics goals for manipulation are traditionally specified by target object poses, not by images of the object once placed. We ask whether latent planning survives a shift from appearance to geometry, on the observation side as well as on the goal specifications side. To answer this, we extend the stable-worldmodel evaluation platform with simulated LiDAR-style raycast point clouds as a new sensor modality, and adapt three JEPA designs to point clouds: a frozen-encoder model built on Utonia features, a distribution-prior model based on LeWM, and an action-sensitive model based on Delta-JEPA. We further introduce a goal-encoding mechanism that constructs the goal latent from the current latent and a 3D target pose, removing the need for goal images or goal point clouds. A comparative evaluation of the different anti-collapse mechanisms shows that point-cloud world models can match their image-based counterparts, demonstrating that the modality shift from appearance to geometry is achievable. All models are released as open weights with open-source training and inference code, to make world-model planning accessible for LiDAR-driven and pose-directed robotic tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 stable-worldmodel 平台上把 JEPA 动作世界模型从图像搬到 LiDAR 式 raycast 点云，并用「当前 latent + 3D 目标位姿」编码目标，去掉目标图像或目标点云。对比三种抗坍缩机制后发现点云世界模型能与图像版本持平，说明从外观到几何的模态迁移可行。
Motivation: 现有 latent action 几乎都靠相机观测，而机器人操作的目标传统上用目标物体位姿而非图像指定；需要检验 latent planning 在观测与目标两侧同时从外观换成几何后是否仍然成立。
Method: 扩展 stable-worldmodel 评测平台加入模拟 LiDAR raycast 点云模态，并改造三种 JEPA：基于 Utonia 特征的冻结编码器模型、基于 LeWM 的分布先验模型、基于 Delta-JEPA 的动作敏感模型；新提出目标编码机制，由当前 latent 与 3D 目标位姿构造目标 latent。
Result: 对比不同抗坍缩机制的评测显示，点云世界模型可以匹配其图像对应版本，表明从外观到几何的模态迁移可实现；全部模型以开放权重与开源训练/推理代码发布。
Conclusion: latent planning 在点云观测加位姿目标的设定下依然成立，抗坍缩机制的选择足以让几何模态达到图像水平，且该路径可开放复现用于 LiDAR 驱动、位姿导向的操作任务。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PokaiTrainer: Scaling Equilibrium Search to Competitive Pokémon VGC
papers.abstract_en: Decision-time equilibrium search carried poker to superhuman play, but it has so far relied on tractable subgames: a handful of actions per decision, chance confined to card deals, one player moving at a time. Competitive Pokémon in its official doubles format (VGC) breaks all three assumptions at once. Both players act simultaneously from joint menus in the hundreds, each joint action resolves to hundreds of stochastic outcomes, and the opponent's reserves and stat allocations are hidden. No prior Pokémon agent performs equilibrium search, and whether it scales to this regime was open; we show that it does, and report what it took. PokaiEngine, our Rust battle engine, enumerates a joint action's full weighted outcome distribution in one pass, at ${\sim}99\%$ parity with Pokémon Showdown and a fraction of the cost of sampling it. PokaiTrainer adapts Student of Games to this scale and trains it by self-play over hundreds of human teams. Each decision is solved by counterfactual regret minimization as a Bayesian matrix game over public belief states, subgames grow under an explicit compute budget, and value targets are harvested from the interior of every solve and grounded by realized outcomes. The strength is in the search. The network's policy alone loses even to a shallow heuristic search. PokaiTrainer is, to our knowledge, the first VGC agent rated on the live Showdown ladder. Under open team sheets it wins 59% of 150 best-of-three sets against a human field averaging ${\sim}1320$ Elo, holds a 1350-1400 Elo band, and at its peak reached 1492 Elo, entering the format's top 500.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. v2: title and abstract revised; adds decoupled-UCT and local best response equilibrium-quality experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PokaiTrainer 把决策时均衡搜索从扑克扩展到同时行动、联合动作数百、随机结果数百且信息不完整的 Pokémon VGC 双打：用 Rust 引擎 PokaiEngine 单遍枚举联合动作的完整加权结果分布（与 Pokémon Showdown 约 99% 一致），再把 Student of Games 改造成在公开信念状态上做贝叶斯矩阵博弈的 CFR 求解。在 Showdown 天梯上它以 150 场三局两胜中 59% 胜率击败平均约 1320 Elo 的人类选手，峰值 1492 Elo、进入该赛制前 500。
Motivation: 决策时均衡搜索此前只在可解子博弈上成立：每步动作少、随机性只来自发牌、单方轮流行动。VGC 同时打破这三条，且此前没有任何 Pokémon 智能体做过均衡搜索，其能否扩展到该场景是开放问题。
Method: PokaiEngine（Rust 战斗引擎）一遍枚举联合动作的完整加权结果分布；PokaiTrainer 改造 Student of Games，在公开信念状态 (public belief states) 上把每步决策作为贝叶斯矩阵博弈用反事实遗憾最小化 (CFR) 求解，子博弈在显式算力预算下增长，价值目标从每次求解内部采集并用实际结果校准；训练方式为在数百支人类队伍上自博弈。
Result: 引擎与 Pokémon Showdown 约 99% 一致且成本远低于采样；仅用网络策略（不带搜索）连浅层启发式搜索都赢不了；在公开队伍表 (open team sheets) 下对平均约 1320 Elo 的人类选手赢下 150 场三局两胜中的 59%，维持 1350–1400 Elo 区间，峰值 1492 Elo，进入该赛制前 500。
Conclusion: 均衡搜索可以扩展到同时行动、大联合动作空间、随机与隐藏信息并存的 VGC，而强度主要来自搜索而非策略网络本身；据作者所知这是首个在 Showdown 实时天梯上评分的 VGC 智能体。

papers.title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can interpret a street view, but reliable urban action depends on whether such local evidence remains useful after the agent starts to move. In this paper, we investigate how far current MLLM agents can turn local urban perception into reliable action in a real-scale city. We propose UrbanGround, an urban sandbox built from Hong Kong's territory-wide 3D geospatial data. It combines the city's geographic structure with continuous, collision-constrained control through a shared evaluation interface. Agents use first-person observations and an interactive map to select actions across tasks ranging from local question answering to long-horizon navigation. Our analysis follows the growth of the spatial problem through three research questions. We first test whether an agent can gather and interpret local visual evidence to answer spatial questions. Then we ask whether these abilities support navigation as destinations become farther away and less explicit. Finally, we examine whether the resulting behavior survives changes in route availability and pedestrian motion. MLLM agents usually show useful atomic abilities in visual recognition and short-range spatial reasoning, while orientation and pedestrian-aware movement remain unreliable. Their central failure emerges over extended exploration, where local abilities do not compose into sustained goal-directed behavior and errors accumulate without effective correction. We hope UrbanGround will support broader study of how far MLLM agents can explore reliably in open-ended urban environments.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. Project Page: https://urbanground.github.io, Code Repository: https://github.com/UrbanGround/UrbanGround
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UrbanGround 是基于香港全域 3D 地理数据构建的城市沙盒，把地理结构与连续、碰撞约束的控制统一到共享评测接口，让 MLLM 智能体用第一人称观测加交互地图完成从局部问答到长程导航的任务。结论是：MLLM 在视觉识别与短程空间推理上具备可用的原子能力，但方向感与避让行人的移动不可靠，长程探索中局部能力无法组合成持续的目标导向行为，误差无纠正地累积。
Motivation: MLLM 能解读街景，但智能体一旦开始移动，局部证据能否支撑可靠的城市行动尚不清楚；尤其在目的地更远、更不明确以及路线与行人条件变化时，局部能力能否组合成长程行为是核心缺口。
Method: 提出 UrbanGround 城市沙盒，基于香港全域 3D 地理数据，融合城市地理结构与连续、碰撞约束的控制，提供共享评测接口；智能体以第一人称观测加交互地图选动作，按三个研究问题递进评测：局部视觉证据采集与空间问答、随距离变远变模糊的导航、路线可得性与行人运动变化下的行为存续。
Result: MLLM 智能体在视觉识别与短程空间推理上表现出有用的原子能力，但方向判断与行人感知移动仍不可靠；核心失败出现在长程探索中，局部能力无法组合成持续的目标导向行为，误差在无有效纠正的情况下不断累积。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLM 智能体可靠探索的边界止于短程局部任务，长程开放城市环境中的目标导向行为需要能纠正累积误差的机制；UrbanGround 被定位为支撑这一方向研究的平台。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GeoRefer-Bench: A Benchmark from Referring Pixels to Verifiable Geospatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Referring segmentation in overhead imagery is inherently relational: a query may ask for the buildings north of the road or the pond closest to a residential area, so the correct referent can contain one object, several objects, or none. Existing benchmarks mainly score mask overlap, which cannot verify whether a model actually resolved the stated spatial relation. We introduce GeoRefer-Bench, a benchmark for verifiable geospatial referring segmentation. Each query is represented by an executable logical form over a metric scene graph, and predictions are evaluated with Exact Query Success (EQS), which is satisfied only when the returned instance set exactly matches the set denoted by the query. GeoRefer-Bench contains 700 whole 2048x2048 UAV scenes (2.94 Gpx) at 12.5 and 25 cm ground sampling distance, 26,217 instances, 142,796 spatial relations, and 20,916 executable queries spanning five reasoning levels. It further includes three paraphrases per query, 24.0% unanswerable queries, 2,477 counterfactual pairs, and five leakage-controlled evaluation splits. An independent audit re-derives object geometry, mask ownership, relation values, query execution, and split provenance, finding zero issues across all 700 scenes. Relation-blind strategies can retain non-trivial mIoU while achieving at most 22.7 EQS overall, showing that overlap alone does not certify relational grounding. Across fifteen current models, the strongest reaches 74.1 EQS but drops from 98.9 at level 1 to 60.5 at level 5, while ten models score below 5 EQS on two-hop queries. GeoRefer-Bench turns geospatial referring segmentation from mask matching into verifiable reference resolution.

papers.title: Low-Latency Activation-Regularized Sparse Neural Operators with Distillation Assistance Towards Real-Time Neuromorphic Virtual Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Virtual sensing enables digital twins and safety-critical systems to reconstruct and forecast spatial-temporal physics in real time. However, conventional computational and data-driven methods often face challenges in generalization, latency, and energy efficiency for edge deployment. Neural operators offer a promising alternative but remain reliant on power-intensive hardware. Spiking neurons and neuromorphic computing can improve efficiency, yet surrogate-gradient training and multi-step spiking introduce convergence and latency challenges. We propose the Sparse-Activation-ReLU (SAR) layer, a single-step alternative that promotes activation sparsity without surrogate-gradient training while remaining compatible with event-based computing. Within a trunk-based NOMAD architecture, SAR achieves over a fivefold improvement in the combined Latency-Error-Energy (LEE) metric compared with Variable Spiking Neuron (VSN) and Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) implementations. We further analyze spiking entropy and feature usage and introduce synthetic knowledge distillation, reducing the LEE score by more than twofold. Finally, we improve VSN through a ReLU-based spiking loss and graph-neighbor thresholding. On the Heat Exchanger dataset, these approaches reduce L2 error by more than twofold and nearly sevenfold, respectively, while reducing spiking and spatial aggregation. Overall, the work presented is a step towards energy-efficient virtual sensing by providing an alternative framework that can be positioned towards neuromorphic or other edge device integration that can be a gold standard to compare latency, energy, and error performance for future efficient designs that are sparsity or brain-inspired spiking based.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sparse-Activation-ReLU (SAR) 单步稀疏激活层，替代需要 surrogate-gradient 的多步脉冲神经元，用在 trunk-based NOMAD 神经算子架构上做实时虚拟传感。在 Heat Exchanger 数据集上，SAR 相对 VSN 与 LIF 实现把 Latency-Error-Energy (LEE) 综合指标改善五倍以上；合成知识蒸馏再把 L2 误差降低两倍以上，改进后的 VSN（ReLU 脉冲损失 + 图邻域阈值）降低近七倍。
Motivation: 虚拟传感要在边缘设备上实时重建与预报时空物理场，但传统与数据驱动方法在泛化、延迟和能效上受限，神经算子又依赖高功耗硬件；脉冲神经元虽高效，surrogate-gradient 训练与多步脉冲带来收敛与延迟问题。
Method: 提出 SAR 层作为单步替代，促进激活稀疏且无需 surrogate-gradient 训练，同时保持与事件驱动计算兼容；嵌入 trunk-based NOMAD 架构，分析 spiking entropy 与特征使用率，并加入合成知识蒸馏 (synthetic knowledge distillation)；另用 ReLU-based spiking loss 与 graph-neighbor thresholding 改进 VSN。
Result: 在 Heat Exchanger 数据集上：SAR 相对 VSN 与 LIF 实现的 LEE 综合指标改善五倍以上；合成知识蒸馏使 LEE 分数降低两倍以上；ReLU 脉冲损失与图邻域阈值两种改进分别把 L2 误差降低两倍以上和近七倍，同时减少脉冲与空间聚合。
Conclusion: 单步稀疏激活加蒸馏可以把神经算子的延迟、误差与能耗一起压下来，为面向神经形态或边缘设备的虚拟传感提供一个可比较 LEE 的基准框架。
Relevance: 37
