papers.title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation requires a 3D representation that captures both geometry and appearance. However, preserving fine detail across the physically based rendering (PBR) modalities needed for relighting remains challenging. To address this, we propose Luce, a 3D representation that unifies geometry and PBR materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for albedo, metallic-roughness, and surface normals. A variational autoencoder compresses this representation into a unified material-aware latent space. A rectified-flow transformer generates this latent from a single image using multi-layer features from a pretrained image encoder that preserve both semantic context and fine spatial detail. The latent is then decoded into relightable PBR Gaussians and an optional textured mesh with a tangent-space normal map. On Toys4K, Luce achieves state-of-the-art single-image-to-3D generation, improving FID by 28% over the strongest baseline. We further evaluate Luce on a benchmark of AI-generated images depicting diverse subjects and materials, where it improves the CLIP image-alignment score over the best baseline (0.8519 vs. 0.8299). Luce generates relightable, geometrically accurate, and materially faithful assets that preserve fine details such as text, logos, and inscriptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Luce 把几何与 PBR 材质统一进体素化多模态 Gaussian 云，用 VAE 压成材质感知隐空间，再由 rectified-flow transformer 从单张图生成可重打光的 3D 资产。在 Toys4K 上 FID 比最强基线改善 28%，在 AI 生成图像基准上 CLIP 图像对齐 0.8519 对 0.8299。
Motivation: 单图到 3D 生成需要同时保住几何与外观，而跨 PBR 模态保持细节（重打光所需）仍是难点。
Method: 体素化多模态 Gaussian 云用专属 Gaussian 原语分别承载 albedo、metallic-roughness 与 surface normals；VAE 将其压入统一材质感知隐空间，rectified-flow transformer 借助预训练图像编码器的多层特征从单图生成该隐空间，再解码为可重打光 PBR Gaussians 与可选带切线空间法线贴图的 textured mesh。
Result: Toys4K 上单图到 3D 生成达到 state-of-the-art，FID 比最强基线改善 28%；在涵盖多样主体与材质的 AI 生成图像基准上，CLIP 图像对齐分数 0.8519 对最佳基线 0.8299；生成资产保留文字、logo、铭文等细节。
Conclusion: 把 PBR 材质与几何放进同一 Gaussian 表示并统一隐空间，可在单图到 3D 中同时做到可重打光、几何准确与材质忠实。

papers.title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Model for Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring from Triaxial Bodyseismography
papers.abstract_en: Ballistocardiography (BCG) is promising for unobtrusive long-term blood pressure (BP) monitoring in laboratory settings, but traditional BCG signals are vulnerable to the variations in body-bed interaction with shifted fiducial points in temporal or amplitude axis, and BP varies with personal hemodynamic changes, causing misaligned representations that affect model generalizability and robustness. In this work, we propose Phy-BP, a physics-constrained BP estimation framework based on triaxial bodyseismography (BSG) acquired using bed-mounted sensors as an extension of single-axis BCG. Firstly, we design an adaptive quality-control algorithm combining neighboring beat patterns and universal cardiogenic templates to retain reliable cardiac components. Secondly, we propose a physical model of wave propagation through the body-bed system to constrain latent feature evolution, aligning triaxial representations generated by a shared cardiogenic excitation. These mechanical constraints connect multi-axis feature learning to body-bed dynamics and complement data-driven regression from vibration signals. Evaluation on a 162-hour hospital dataset from 21 subjects against invasive arterial BP yields a mean absolute error of 5.07 mmHg, a prediction-error standard deviation of 7.24 mmHg, and a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.86 for mean arterial pressure. This framework is intended for unobtrusive monitoring during rest and sleep, with potential applications in overnight hospital and home monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Phy-BP 用床载三轴体震图 (BSG) 做无接触血压估计：先用相邻心搏模式与通用心源模板的自适应质控保留可靠心搏成分，再用床-身体系统波传播物理模型约束潜特征演化，使三轴表征对齐到同一心源激励。在 162 小时、21 名受试者的医院数据上对照有创动脉血压，MAE 5.07 mmHg，预测误差标准差 7.24 mmHg，平均动脉压 Pearson 相关 0.86。
Motivation: 传统单轴 BCG 信号随身体-床接触状态变化，心搏特征点在时间轴和幅度轴上漂移，加上个体血流动力学差异，导致表征错位、模型泛化与鲁棒性差。
Method: 提出 Phy-BP 框架：自适应质控算法结合相邻心搏模式与 universal cardiogenic templates 保留可靠心源成分；建立身体-床系统波传播物理模型约束潜特征演化，把共享心源激励产生的三轴表征对齐，并与振动信号的数据驱动回归互补。
Result: 在 162 小时、21 名受试者的医院数据集上对照有创动脉血压 (invasive arterial BP)：MAE 5.07 mmHg，预测误差标准差 7.24 mmHg，平均动脉压 (MAP) 的 Pearson 相关系数 0.86。
Conclusion: 把身体-床力学约束嵌入三轴 BSG 特征学习，可在静卧与睡眠场景实现无接触血压监测，面向住院过夜与家庭监测。

papers.title: The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid sequence models must satisfy prefix invariance: representations at position t must not depend on future inputs, yet this is rarely verified. We formalize prefix invariance and give a lightweight audit, two forward passes, no training or gradients, yielding a per-layer score localizing where causality breaks. Attention-mask inspection, the field's default check, is incomplete: causality is a graph-level property, and leaks can occur via scans, aggregations, or normalization despite correct masks. Across 192 injected-fault trials on eight checkpoints, mask inspection detected none, while our audit localized all 192/192 to the exact layer. Static/dynamic analysis of chunked-scan code in transformers found the same defect in Zamba2 and Nemotron-H, an inter-chunk axis error fixed via the reference implementation. The method fits on one page and runs in seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对混合序列模型 (attention、state-space、hybrid) 的前缀不变性 (prefix invariance) 缺少验证，提出一种两遍前向、无需训练与梯度的轻量审计，输出逐层分数定位因果性破坏点。在 8 个 checkpoint 的 192 次注入故障试验中，传统的 mask 检查一个都没检出，该审计 192/192 全部定位到确切层；同一缺陷在 Zamba2 与 Nemotron-H 的 chunked-scan 代码中被静态/动态分析发现，属 inter-chunk 轴错误，已由参考实现修复。
Motivation: 混合序列模型要求位置 t 的表征不依赖未来输入，但这一前缀不变性很少被真正验证；默认的 attention-mask 检查不完备，因为因果性是图级属性，scan、聚合或归一化都可能在 mask 正确时泄漏。
Method: 形式化前缀不变性定义，给出只需两次前向传播、不训练不求梯度的轻量审计，产生逐层分数以定位因果性破坏；并结合对 chunked-scan 代码的静态与动态分析交叉验证。
Result: 在 8 个 checkpoint 上共 192 次注入故障试验，mask 检查检出 0 个，该审计 192/192 全部定位到确切层；在 transformers 的 chunked-scan 代码中发现 Zamba2 与 Nemotron-H 存在相同缺陷（inter-chunk 轴错误），已由参考实现修复；方法说明仅一页、运行耗时数秒。
Conclusion: mask 正确不等于模型因果正确，前缀不变性必须用逐层审计直接检验；该审计以一页方法、秒级运行时间即可把泄漏定位到具体层。

papers.title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning
papers.abstract_en: Web agents promise to automate complex digital workflows, but their training remains limited by synthetic environments that look plausible while hiding broken links, inconsistent states, or infeasible tasks. We address the gap between scalable environment generation and trustworthy agent learning by constructing synthetic web environments that are executable, auditable, and grounded in backend state. Our framework represents each generated website as a structured scaffold of pages, navigation links, database records, state-change markers, and task constraints, then verifies and repairs structural, semantic, consistency, and feasibility defects before policy training. During interaction, ordinary UI transitions are executed deterministically, while persistent backend updates are invoked only through validated state-change markers, enabling dense rewards compiled from verified task-progress predicates. Across 500 synthetic environments spanning six domains, our method reduces task-blocking defects and improves feasible-task rate from 48.6% to 94.8%, while producing stronger PPO policies and improving transfer to WebArena, WebShop, and MiniWoB++ without LLM calls at evaluation time. These results show that verified synthetic environments can serve as a scalable and reliable training substrate for compact web agents, shifting synthetic webagent learning from surface-level plausibility toward executable, state-grounded supervision.

Motivation: 合成 web 环境可规模化生成，但常看似合理却藏着死链、状态不一致与不可行任务，导致 agent 训练信号不可信；需要在可扩展生成与可信学习之间补上验证环节。

papers.title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable planning requires converting natural-language instructions into executable symbolic specifications, yet large language models remain brittle without costly PDDL annotations and may exploit solver success in semantically unfaithful ways. We study how to learn faithful natural-language-to-PDDL formalization using only solver feedback, without human-written demonstrations. We propose a solvergrounded multi-role reinforcement learning framework where a single language model acts as an Actor, Judge, and Editor for generation, verification, and repair. The Actor proposes PDDL specifications, the Judge provides a solver-calibrated quality signal, and the Editor performs bounded diagnostic-conditioned refinement. On PlanBench, our method improves average success from 35.5% for LLM+P to 70.8%, achieves 66.3% faithful success, and reduces semantic drift to 6.4%. These results show that organizing solver feedback into generation, verification, and repair roles enables more scalable and faithful annotation-free symbolic planning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以求解器反馈为唯一监督的多角色强化学习框架，让同一个 LLM 分饰 Actor、Judge、Editor，分别负责生成 PDDL、给出求解器校准的质量信号、按诊断条件做有界修复，从而在无人工 PDDL 标注下学出语义忠实的形式化。在 PlanBench 上平均成功率从 LLM+P 的 35.5% 提到 70.8%，忠实成功率 66.3%，语义漂移降到 6.4%。
Motivation: 自然语言指令转可执行符号规格 (PDDL) 依赖昂贵的人工标注，且 LLM 会利用求解器成功却给出语义不忠实的规格，规划可靠性因此受限。
Method: solvergrounded 多角色强化学习：单一 LLM 同时充当 Actor（提出 PDDL 规格）、Judge（提供求解器校准的 quality signal）、Editor（执行有界、以诊断为条件的修复），仅用求解器反馈训练，不用人工示范。
Result: 在 PlanBench 上，平均成功率 35.5%（LLM+P）→ 70.8%，忠实成功率 66.3%，语义漂移 (semantic drift) 降至 6.4%。
Conclusion: 把求解器反馈组织成生成、验证、修复三种角色，可以在无人工标注的条件下做出更可扩展、更忠实的符号规划形式化。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Model Performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code Compliance
papers.abstract_en: The transport of dangerous goods by sea is a high-consequence activity governed by the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, a complex regulatory framework where errors in classification, packaging, stowage, or segregation can result in fire, explosion, toxic release, or loss of life or vessel. Correct compliance requires accurately interpreting hundreds of pages of interacting provisions, updated on a two-year amendment cycle. Practitioners increasingly use Large Language Models (LLMs) as decision-support tools, yet no systematic evaluation exists of whether they can reliably interpret IMDG requirements for safety-critical use. This paper introduces DGEval, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM knowledge of IMDG Amendment 42-24. Built from expert-written questions on a commercial e-learning platform and structured lookups from the Dangerous Goods List (DGL), it comprises 1,678 questions across multiple-choice, open-ended, DGL lookup, and regulatory identification tasks. We evaluate 13 models from six providers across multiple thinking configurations, including one maritime domain-specific fine-tuned model, and test the effect of web search. Although the best-performing model exceeds the human practitioner baseline on multiple-choice questions, all models are weakest in the operationally safety-critical areas of stowage, segregation, and regulatory recall. These results indicate that LLMs may support compliance tasks, particularly structured DGL lookups with web search, but unreliability in operational areas and regulatory-text recall means human oversight and authoritative source verification remain necessary before deployment in any safety-critical context. DGEval is designed as a safety assurance instrument to be applied continuously as models evolve, not as a settled characterisation of current capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DGEval：首个评测 LLM 对 IMDG Amendment 42-24 合规理解的基准，含 1,678 道题，覆盖选择题、开放题、DGL 查表与法规识别，评测六家厂商 13 个模型（含一个海运领域微调模型）及联网搜索效果。最佳模型在选择题上超过人类从业者基线，但所有模型在积载、隔离与法规回忆这些操作性安全关键环节最弱，因此安全关键部署前仍需人工监督与权威原文核验。
Motivation: IMDG 条文数百页、条款相互作用且每两年修订一次，分类、包装、积载、隔离出错会导致火灾、爆炸、毒害释放或人员与船舶损失；从业者已把 LLM 当决策支持工具，但此前没有系统评测检验其能否可靠解读 IMDG 要求。
Method: 构建 DGEval：题目来自商业 e-learning 平台的专家编写题目与 Dangerous Goods List (DGL) 的结构化查表，共 1,678 题，分多选、开放、DGL 查表、法规识别四类；评测六个厂商的 13 个模型、多种 thinking 配置，含一个海运领域微调模型，并检验 web search 的影响。
Result: 基准含 1,678 道题、13 个模型、六家厂商；最佳模型在多选题上超过人类从业者基线，但全部模型在积载 (stowage)、隔离 (segregation) 与法规回忆 (regulatory recall) 上最弱；结构化 DGL 查表配合 web search 时 LLM 可支撑合规任务。
Conclusion: LLM 可辅助合规任务（尤其是配合 web search 的结构化 DGL 查表），但操作环节与法规原文回忆不可靠，安全关键场景部署前必须保留人工监督与权威来源核验；DGEval 定位为随模型演进持续施用的安全保障工具，而非对当前能力的定论。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Don't Solve, Just Compare: Tiny Advisors for Runtime Intervention in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are emerging as an important paradigm for real-world tasks that require reasoning, tool use, and sequential decision-making. As these agents operate over longer horizons, runtime intervention offers a way to improve reliability without retraining the underlying actor. Effective intervention must provide a useful direction for recovery besides a warning. Existing approaches often rely on an expert solver or a critic that generates task-specific corrections, incurring either the cost of another capable solver or the capacity demands of a task-capable critic. We introduce Comparison-Only Tiny Advisor (COTA) for constructive runtime intervention, which reduces the learned intervention role to local action comparison. A lightweight comparator judges the actor's proposal against available alternatives, and preferred alternatives are returned as non-binding advice for replanning. The comparator is trained from same-prefix counterfactual branches. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and tau^3-Retail with three LLM actors, COTA instantiated with a 0.5B comparator consistently improves the original actor and achieves the strongest overall performance--cost trade-off among the compared methods. These results suggest that effective runtime intervention need not itself be a task-solving problem: the intervention role can be separated from task solving and handled by a lightweight model specialized for local comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COTA 把 LLM agent 的运行时干预 (runtime intervention) 从「生成任务级修正」降维成局部动作比较：0.5B 的轻量 comparator 对比 actor 当前提案与可选替代动作，把更优替代作为非约束性建议交回 replanning。在 WebShop、ALFWorld、tau^3-Retail 三个环境、三种 LLM actor 上，0.5B comparator 一致提升原 actor，并取得所比方法中最强的性能-成本权衡。
Motivation: 长时程 LLM agent 的运行时干预通常要再请一个专家 solver 或训练一个能解任务的 critic，代价是额外的强求解器开销或 critic 容量需求；而现有干预往往只给警告、不给可执行的恢复方向。
Method: Comparison-Only Tiny Advisor (COTA)：轻量 comparator 只判断 actor 提案与可用替代动作的优劣，输出非约束性建议供 replanning；comparator 从同前缀反事实分支 (same-prefix counterfactual branches) 训练，实例化为 0.5B 模型，不重训原 actor。
Result: 在 WebShop、ALFWorld、tau^3-Retail 上配合三种 LLM actor，0.5B comparator 的 COTA 一致改善原 actor 的表现，并在所比较方法中取得最强的整体性能-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 运行时干预本身不必是解任务问题：把干预角色与任务求解分离，交给专做局部比较的轻量模型即可有效。

papers.title: Learning Exact NVIDIA SASS Encoders with $\mathbb{F}_2$ Linear Algebra
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA provides a SASS disassembler but no public SASS assembler for recent data-center GPUs, limiting controlled machine-code rewriting. We present F2Asm, which learns exact 128-bit SASS encoders from paired disassembly and original CUBIN instruction words. To our knowledge, F2Asm is the first system to learn SASS instruction encoders as vector-valued affine maps over $\mathbb{F}_2$ and the first open-source NVIDIA SASS assembler to support Rubin SM107. F2Asm uses Gaussian elimination over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to incrementally build a compact basis, detect inconsistencies, and reject inputs outside the learned span. F2Asm separates target-specific control bits, relocation rules, and CUBIN metadata from its learning algorithm. We train encoders for Hopper SM90/SM90a, Blackwell SM100, and Rubin SM107 using 3,225 CUBINs from pinned NVIDIA and third-party production libraries, CUDA 13.3 packages, and CUDA 13.4 Developer Preview archives. In round-trip tests, F2Asm reassembles each CUBIN's disassembled SASS, and all compared executable text sections match the originals exactly. Joint training with F2Asm yields one shared encoder for five Blackwell SM targets and another for three Rubin SM targets, providing strong evidence of a common SASS encoding scheme for instructions shared within each family. Continual training extends the Rubin encoder to all 17,159 previously unsupported cuTile and GROMACS queries with 1,504 additional basis rows, matching the derived lower bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: F2Asm 从反汇编与原始 CUBIN 指令字的配对数据中，把 SASS 编码学习为 F2 上的向量值仿射映射，用 F2 高斯消元增量构造紧凑基并拒绝超出已学张成空间的输入。在 3,225 个 CUBIN 上训练后，往返测试中所有被比较的可执行 text 段与原文件完全一致；联合训练得到覆盖五个 Blackwell SM 目标与三个 Rubin SM 目标的共享编码器，持续训练再用 1,504 行新增基覆盖全部 17,159 条此前不支持的 cuTile 与 GROMACS 查询，且达到推导出的下界。
Motivation: NVIDIA 只提供 SASS 反汇编器、对近期数据中心 GPU 没有公开汇编器，受控的机器码改写因此受限。
Method: F2Asm 把 SASS 编码当作 F2 上的向量值仿射映射来学：用 F2 高斯消元从配对的反汇编文本与原始 CUBIN 指令字增量构建紧凑基、检测不一致并拒绝落在已学张成空间之外的输入；目标相关的控制位、重定位规则与 CUBIN 元数据与学习算法解耦。训练数据为 3,225 个 CUBIN，来自固定的 NVIDIA 与第三方生产库、CUDA 13.3 包和 CUDA 13.4 Developer Preview 归档，覆盖 Hopper SM90/SM90a、Blackwell SM100 与 Rubin SM107。
Result: 往返测试中 F2Asm 重新汇编每个 CUBIN 的反汇编 SASS，所有被比较的可执行 text 段与原文件完全一致。联合训练产出一个覆盖五个 Blackwell SM 目标的共享编码器与一个覆盖三个 Rubin SM 目标的共享编码器；持续训练用 1,504 行新增基扩展到全部 17,159 条此前不支持的 cuTile 与 GROMACS 查询，与推导出的下界相符。
Conclusion: 同一家族内共享指令的 SASS 编码方案是通用的，因此一个 F2 仿射编码器可跨多个 SM 目标复用，并能以匹配下界的基规模持续扩展到新查询。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Optimal Skill Selection for LLM Agents with Provable Bicriteria Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Loading reusable skill documents into a bounded context window has become a primary way large language model (LLM) agents acquire task-specific capabilities, which makes skill selection a first-order determinant of task performance and token cost. Yet current agents score skills independently by semantic relevance and assemble the set by top-$k$ or greedy packing, with no quality guarantee or cost awareness on the selected set. Redundant or poorly chosen skills then waste scarce context tokens and can even degrade performance. In this paper, we present a theory-grounded and practical framework for budgeted skill selection. We give the first model of how skill sets shape execution outcomes, capturing complementary capability coverage and diminishing returns from redundancy through a monotone submodular benefit, while accounting for context degradation with a linear token penalty under a hard budget. Based on this model, we develop Best Prefix Selection (BPS), a polynomial-time algorithm, and prove, to our knowledge, the first performance guarantee for skill selection: a bicriteria $(1-1/e,1)$ approximation whose benefit coefficient is optimal in polynomial time. We construct a controlled testbed based on BigCodeBench to isolate the effect of skill selection on execution success. On it, BPS with a learned capability encoder reaches a success rate of 0.65, and the strongest baselines need at least 28% more tokens to reach 0.60.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM agent 的技能选择问题，提出 Best Prefix Selection (BPS)：用单调次模收益刻画技能间的互补覆盖与冗余递减，叠加线性 token 惩罚与硬预算，给出多项式时间的 (1-1/e, 1) 双准则近似且收益系数在多项式时间内最优。在基于 BigCodeBench 的受控测试床上，BPS 配合学习式能力编码器成功率达 0.65，最强基线需多用至少 28% token 才能达到 0.60。
Motivation: LLM agent 靠向有界上下文窗口装入可复用技能文档获得任务能力，但现有做法只按语义相关性独立打分再 top-k 或贪心打包，对选出的技能集合既无质量保证也不计成本，冗余或劣质技能浪费上下文 token 甚至拉低性能。
Method: 建立预算约束下的技能选择模型：收益为单调次模函数 (monotone submodular benefit)，同时计入线性 token 惩罚与硬预算；据此设计多项式时间算法 Best Prefix Selection (BPS)，并证明 (1-1/e, 1) 双准则近似保证；另构建基于 BigCodeBench 的受控测试床以隔离技能选择对执行成功率的影响，BPS 使用学习式能力编码器 (learned capability encoder)。
Result: 在 BigCodeBench 受控测试床上，BPS 配合学习式能力编码器达到 0.65 成功率；最强基线需多用至少 28% 的 token 才能达到 0.60。理论上给出首个技能选择的性能保证，(1-1/e, 1) 近似的收益系数在多项式时间内最优。
Conclusion: 把技能选择建模为带 token 预算的次模优化，可以在多项式时间内同时给出质量与成本的双准则保证，并在相同成功率下显著省 token。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end, raising the prospect of recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet this progress is measured by aggregate benchmark scores, which cannot tell whether an agent executes a fixed plan well or strategically revises the plan when it fails. We separate these two capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within an established training strategy, and strategy-level capability, revising that strategy as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing 1,338 post-training trajectories of frontier agents, we find that agents reliably execute post-training but lock into a default strategy, which follows the agent rather than the task, and only 2.1% of transitions between adjacent training runs ever change strategy. We then test whether the agent lacks experience, reasoning, or the decision to switch. (1) Experience improves execution but not the strategy. (2) Additional reasoning compute yields front-loaded gains on easier tasks but refines, rather than revises, the committed strategy. (3) Human review before training changes which strategy the agent locks into, not whether it locks in, whereas a single mid-run instruction outperforms the agent's own continuation by up to 17.44 points under the same budget. In conclusion, what the agent lacks is the decision to reopen a committed strategy and try another one. Realizing RSI therefore calls for interaction protocols and training signals that make strategy revision an explicit, rewarded decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 1,338 条前沿 agent 的 LLM 后训练轨迹做实证分析，把能力拆成执行层（在既定训练策略内迭代）与策略层（随证据修订策略）。发现 agent 能可靠执行但锁死默认策略——策略跟着 agent 而非任务走，相邻训练 run 之间只有 2.1% 的转移真正换策略；缺的是「重开已提交策略」这一决策本身。
Motivation: LLM agent 已能端到端后训练模型，递归自我改进 (RSI) 成为可能，但聚合 benchmark 分数无法区分「执行好固定计划」与「失败时修订计划」这两种能力。
Method: 定义执行层与策略层能力的二分框架，分析 1,338 条前沿 agent 后训练轨迹；再做三组干预检验缺口来自经验、推理还是切换决策：补充经验、增加推理算力、以及训练前人工审查 vs. 训练中途单条指令。
Result: 仅 2.1% 的相邻训练 run 转移改变策略；补充经验只提升执行不提升策略；额外推理算力在简单任务上收益前置、只细化不推翻已提交策略；训练前人工审查改变锁定的策略种类但不改变是否锁定；同等预算下训练中途单条指令比 agent 自主续跑最高高出 17.44 分。
Conclusion: agent 缺的是重开已提交策略并另试他路的决策，实现 RSI 需要让策略修订成为显式且被奖励的决策，配套相应的交互协议与训练信号。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PTXBench: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for GPU Kernel Optimization with Architecture-specific PTX
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PTXBench, a benchmark for evaluating and adapting large language models (LLMs) to use architecture-specific PTX for GPU kernel optimization. PTXBench measures functional correctness, whether selected target instructions execute at runtime, and speedup over frontier libraries across GEMM and attention workloads on H100 and B200 GPUs. Our evaluation shows that architecture-specific PTX capability remains uneven: success rates fall substantially on complex attention backward workloads, and executing the target instructions does not necessarily translate into competitive performance. No evaluated model consistently matches frontier libraries across the suite. We further adapt Qwen3.6-27B using supervised fine-tuning. Repair-conditioned training improves several tasks, but generalization remains uneven; data coverage, balance, and the quality of the reasoning teacher matter in addition to dataset size. PTXBench provides an auditable testbed for measuring and improving LLMs' ability to exploit evolving GPU architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PTXBench 用架构相关 PTX 评测 LLM 做 GPU kernel 优化的能力，在 H100 与 B200 上对 GEMM 和 attention 测功能正确性、目标指令是否在运行时执行、以及相对前沿库的加速比。结论是各模型能力不均：复杂 attention backward 上成功率明显下降，执行了目标指令也不等于拿到有竞争力的性能，没有一个被评模型在整套任务上稳定追平前沿库。
Motivation: LLM 生成 GPU kernel 时能否利用随架构演进的 PTX 指令缺少可审计的评测，且指令被执行与实际获得加速之间的关系并不清楚。
Method: 构建 PTXBench 基准，覆盖 GEMM 与 attention 工作负载，在 H100 和 B200 上测三项指标：功能正确性、所选目标指令是否在运行时执行、相对 frontier libraries 的 speedup；另用监督微调 (SFT) 适配 Qwen3.6-27B，采用 repair-conditioned training。
Result: 架构相关 PTX 能力在模型间与任务间不均衡：复杂 attention backward 工作负载上成功率大幅下降；执行目标指令并不必然转化为有竞争力的性能；无一被评模型在全套任务上稳定匹配 frontier libraries。对 Qwen3.6-27B 的 repair-conditioned training 改善了若干任务，但泛化仍不均衡，数据覆盖、平衡与推理教师质量的作用不亚于数据集规模。
Conclusion: PTXBench 提供一个可审计的 testbed，用于度量并改进 LLM 利用不断演进的 GPU 架构的能力；仅靠执行目标指令或单纯堆数据规模不足以让 LLM 稳定追平前沿库。

papers.title: J-Miner: Recovering the Decision Logic of Fine-Tuned LLM Classifiers as Compact Rules
papers.abstract_en: Task-fine-tuned large language model (LLM) classifiers acquire task-specific decision knowledge, but this knowledge remains implicit in distributed internal computations, making their decision logic difficult to interpret. We introduce the Executable Decision Compression (EDC) framework and propose J-Miner, which mines vocabulary-named variables from internal readouts and learns rules shared across inputs to produce executable explanations. Analysis reveals that a small set of these variables captures much of the classifier's decision behavior, holding for both varying parameter scales within a family and distinct families. Across six binary tasks, a rule using just one variable reproduces 76.7% of source-classifier decisions on average, rising to 88.8% with 16 variables. Most of the decision information retained by these variables comes from internal activations beyond literal surface matching. A lightweight text reader predicts the variable states, allowing the same fixed rules to execute independently of the source classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可执行决策压缩框架 (Executable Decision Compression, EDC) 与 J-Miner，从微调 LLM 分类器的内部读出中挖出以词表命名的变量，并学习跨输入共享的规则来复现其决策。在六个二分类任务上，仅用 1 个变量的规则平均复现源分类器 76.7% 的决策，16 个变量升至 88.8%；轻量文本读出器预测变量状态后，固定规则可脱离源分类器独立执行。
Motivation: 任务微调后的 LLM 分类器把任务决策知识隐含在分布式内部计算中，其决策逻辑难以解释，需要把这部分知识显式、可执行地提取出来。
Method: EDC 框架从内部读出中挖掘以词表命名的变量 (vocabulary-named variables)，学习跨输入共享的规则生成可执行解释；再训练一个轻量文本读出器预测变量状态，使同一套固定规则可独立于源分类器执行。
Result: 六个二分类任务上，单变量规则平均复现源分类器 76.7% 的决策，16 个变量升至 88.8%；分析显示少量变量即可捕捉大部分决策行为，且在同族不同参数规模与不同模型族之间都成立；这些变量保留的决策信息主要来自字面表面匹配之外的内部激活。
Conclusion: 微调 LLM 分类器的决策逻辑可被压缩为少量词表命名变量加共享的可执行规则，且规则执行可与源分类器解耦。

papers.title: SubZero+: Memory-Efficient Adaptive Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning in Random Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization with SGD in random subspaces enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models without backpropagation. However, high gradient estimation noise fundamentally undermines adaptive optimizers like Adam. We propose SubZero+, which achieves practical adaptive ZO optimization through a carefully designed dual low-dimensionality strategy: (i) multi-query forward-difference gradient estimation in periodically refreshed random subspaces to mitigate noise amplification in moment buffers, and (ii) Adam updates with periodic restarts performed directly in low-dimensional space rather than full-parameter space. In experiments, this dual design retains memory overhead comparable to momentum-free ZO methods while achieving stronger optimization performance than the evaluated ZO baselines. Theoretically, in the exact-directional limit, $K$-query averaging preserves conditional unbiasedness, while the coefficient estimator's covariance and mean-squared error, as well as query-induced second-moment inflation, scale exactly as $1/K$. Extensive experiments across SuperGLUE with models from 1.3B to 32B parameters under both full fine-tuning and LoRA schemes demonstrate consistent improvements over competing ZO methods. SubZero+ significantly narrows the performance gap with first-order optimization while preserving ZO's inference-time memory efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Noisy binary comparison between two candidates is a common interface between human and learning systems, especially in modern large language model (LLM) post-training alignment. We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. We consider adversarial sequences of convex losses and measure regret with the loss at both queried points, under a comparison link with a known nonzero slope at the origin. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yielding $\mathcal O(T^{3/4})$ static and adaptive regret, and $\mathcal O(T^{3/4}\sqrt{1+P_T/D})$ dynamic regret with unknown comparator path length $P_T$. For strongly convex losses, the static and adaptive bounds improve to $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(T^{2/3})$. For smooth losses, we presents unified dueling ellipsoidal FTRL, and proves $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(T^{2/3})$ static regret, which improves to $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt T)$ under additional strong convexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把成对比较（dueling）反馈经一个简单归约转成近似梯度，从而直接套用标准一阶方法做在线凸优化；在原点斜率已知非零的比较链接下，静态与自适应 regret 为 O(T^{3/4})，动态 regret 为 O(T^{3/4}√(1+P_T/D))，强凸时改进到 Õ(T^{2/3})，光滑情形的 dueling ellipsoidal FTRL 在额外强凸下达到 Õ(√T)。
Motivation: LLM 后训练对齐等场景里人只能给出两个候选间的二元偏好，而现有在线凸优化的一阶方法需要梯度；在对抗性凸损失序列下，如何从只有成对比较的反馈中得到可用的 regret 保证是缺口。
Method: 提出一个把 dueling 反馈归约为近似梯度的简单 reduction，使标准一阶方法可直接使用，并证明 regret 保证在该归约下迁移；另对光滑损失给出统一的 dueling ellipsoidal FTRL。
Result: 在比较链接原点斜率已知非零、对抗性凸损失序列下：静态与自适应 regret 为 O(T^{3/4})，动态 regret 为 O(T^{3/4}√(1+P_T/D))（比较器路径长度 P_T 未知）；强凸损失下静态与自适应界改进到 Õ(T^{2/3})；光滑损失下 dueling ellipsoidal FTRL 的静态 regret 为 Õ(T^{2/3})，在额外强凸条件下改进到 Õ(√T)。
Conclusion: 成对二元比较反馈可以经梯度归约支撑标准一阶在线学习，regret 阶在静态、自适应、动态三种设定以及强凸、光滑条件下均可迁移并随损失性质改进。

papers.title: AQuA: Recursively Self-Improving Quantitative Trading Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: We study recursive self-improvement at the level of quantitative-investment research: whether an autonomous system can use evidence from earlier experiments to improve the hypotheses and candidates proposed in later iterations. We present AQuA, which comprises two separate language-model-driven research systems: one for symbolic factor discovery and one for trainable model development. Each system records experimental results and uses them to guide subsequent proposals. Each operates in a fixed sandbox, which fixes the data splits, feature and label definitions, and evaluator while allowing the model to act only through constrained factor expressions or configuration diffs. The factor system, a manager-mediated multi-agent pipeline, discovers and combines factors into a signal that reaches a combined validation information coefficient of about $0.190$ on a crypto universe. The model system, a config-driven loop over a hybrid time-series architecture, reaches a per-stock information coefficient of $+0.0843$ on US equities and converts it into a threshold long/short strategy with a held-out Sharpe of up to $+2.50$ at a two-leg cost. The strategy is positive in every year from 2021 to 2025.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AQuA 把量化投资研究做成两个可递归自我改进的 LM 驱动系统：因子发现用 manager-mediated 多智能体流水线，模型开发用 config-driven 循环，各自把上一轮实验结果写回以指导下一轮提案。在固定 sandbox（固定数据划分、特征/标签定义与 evaluator，只能通过受限因子表达式或配置 diff 行动）下，因子系统在加密资产 universe 上达到约 0.190 的组合验证 IC，模型系统在美股上达到每股 +0.0843 的 IC，并转成阈值多空策略，两腿成本下留出 Sharpe 最高 +2.50，2021–2025 每一年均为正。
Motivation: 量化研究迭代依赖人工试错，早期实验的证据难以系统性地回流到后续假设与候选生成；作者要检验自治系统能否在受限沙箱内利用历史实验结果自我改进。
Method: AQuA 含两个独立的 LM 驱动研究系统：符号因子发现（manager-mediated 多智能体流水线，组合因子成信号）与可训练模型开发（针对混合时间序列架构的 config-driven 循环）。两者都在固定 sandbox 中运行，数据划分、特征与标签定义、evaluator 固定，模型只能通过受限因子表达式或配置 diff 行动，并把实验结果记录下来指导后续提案。
Result: 因子系统在加密资产 universe 上组合验证信息系数 (IC) 约 0.190；模型系统在美股上每股 IC +0.0843，转成阈值多空策略后两腿成本下留出 Sharpe 最高 +2.50，且 2021 至 2025 每一年策略均为正。
Conclusion: 在固定评估沙箱内让系统回读自身实验记录来驱动下一轮提案，可以持续产出有效因子与正收益策略，覆盖加密与美股两个市场。

papers.title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLM agents, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Another line adopts an agentic paradigm in which the model calls external spatial tools, such as depth estimation and 3D reconstruction tools, to gather intermediate spatial evidence. We study a complementary and underexplored route: Can a frozen VLM agent improve its spatial reasoning through \textbf{parameter-update-free self-evolution}, without depending on external expert spatial tools at inference time? We present \textbf{Spatial Memory Agent (SMA)}, an \textbf{experience-grounded runtime framework} that converts verified spatial experience into reusable transferable lessons. In a verifiable spatial environment, SMA queries the frozen VLM, obtains a predicted answer and reward, and uses \textbf{verifier-guided reflection} to distill compact transferable lessons from spatial experience. SMA further assigns each lesson a \textbf{Transfer Reliability Score (TRS)}, which is initialized uniformly and calibrated from later retrieval outcomes as visit evidence of future transfer reliability. During \textbf{read-only deployment}, SMA retrieves lessons by semantic filter and similarity-TRS combined ranking, allowing the retrieved memory to guide frozen model inference. Across five representative spatial benchmarks and four base VLMs, SMA achieves the highest macro average in every base-model block and the best accuracy among the evaluated methods in most of the 20 evaluations, establishing a practical parameter-update-free path for spatial self-evolution across the evaluated frozen model scales and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spatial Memory Agent (SMA) 让冻结的 VLM 在推理期不更新参数、也不依赖外部空间工具，通过验证器引导反思把带奖励的空间经验蒸馏成可迁移的 lessons，并用 Transfer Reliability Score (TRS) 校准其未来迁移可靠性。在五个空间基准、四个基座 VLM 的 20 项评测中，SMA 在每个基座模型分块取得最高宏平均，并在多数评测中拿到最佳准确率。
Motivation: VLM 空间推理的现有改进要么走 SFT/RL 后训练，要么在推理期调用深度估计、3D 重建等外部专家工具；作者要检验第三条路：冻结模型能否仅凭自身经验在运行时自我进化。
Method: SMA 在可验证空间环境中查询冻结 VLM，拿到预测答案与 reward，用 verifier-guided reflection 从经验中蒸馏紧凑可迁移的 lessons；每条 lesson 赋一个初始均匀、由后续检索结果校准的 Transfer Reliability Score (TRS)；只读部署阶段按语义过滤加相似度-TRS 组合排序检索，用检索到的记忆引导冻结模型推理。
Result: 在五个代表性空间基准、四个基座 VLM 上共 20 项评测，SMA 在每个基座模型分块都取得最高宏平均，并在其中多数评测中取得被评方法里的最佳准确率。
Conclusion: 在所评测的冻结模型规模与环境下，靠经验落地的记忆检索加可靠性校准可作为不更新参数的空间自进化路径。

papers.title: ERSkill: Evolving for Skill-Guided Adaptive Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory for persistent interactions, the retrieval mechanisms governing this memory are rarely treated as evolvable components. This static approach limits performance on heterogeneous memory queries, which often demand diverse evidence construction strategies. To address this, we introduce \textbf{ERSkill}, a retrieval-centric framework for evolving, skill-guided memory access. ERSkill compiles interaction histories into a structured memory store and represents retrieval behaviors as executable skills composed of fundamental primitives. At inference time, a trained router dynamically matches each query to a suitable retrieval skill to construct tailored evidence for answer generation. ERSkill co-evolves the skill set and the router during training. It employs an experience trie to efficiently record explored retrieval paths, alongside a double-frontier mechanism that separates oracle-side capability expansion from router-validated deployment. Experiments across multiple agent memory benchmarks demonstrate that ERSkill substantially outperforms strong non-evolving and evolving baselines. Notably, it improves the overall average across F1, BLEU-1, and LLM-judge scores by 31.3\% with Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct and by 21.4\% with GPT-5.4-nano.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ERSkill 把 LLM agent 的长期记忆检索行为编译成可执行 skill（由基本原语组成），训练中让 skill 集合与路由 router 共同进化，按查询动态匹配检索技能来构造证据。在多个 agent 记忆基准上，F1、BLEU-1 与 LLM-judge 三项综合平均相对强非进化与进化基线提升 31.3%（Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct）与 21.4%（GPT-5.4-nano）。
Motivation: LLM agent 的长期记忆检索机制通常是静态的，难以应对异构记忆查询，而这类查询往往需要多样的证据构造策略。
Method: ERSkill 将交互历史编译为结构化 memory store，把检索行为表示为由基本原语构成的可执行 skill；推理时由训练好的 router 为每个查询匹配检索 skill 以构造证据。训练中共同进化 skill 集与 router，用 experience trie 记录已探索的检索路径，并以 double-frontier 机制区分 oracle 侧能力扩展与 router 验证的部署。
Result: 在多个 agent 记忆基准上，F1、BLEU-1 与 LLM-judge 的综合平均相对强非进化与进化基线提升 31.3%（Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct）与 21.4%（GPT-5.4-nano）。
Conclusion: 把记忆检索当作可进化组件、让 skill 集与 router 协同进化，能在异构记忆查询上明显优于固定检索策略。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: ERSkill 将交互历史编译为结构化 memory store，把检索行为表示为由基本原语构成的可执行 skill；推理时由训练好的 router 为每个查询匹配检索 skill 以构造证据。训练中共同进化 skill 集与 router，用 experience trie 记录已探索的检索路径，并以 double-frontier 机制区分 oracle 侧能力扩展与 router 验证的部署。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 agent 记忆基准上，F1、BLEU-1 与 LLM-judge 的综合平均相对强非进化与进化基线提升 31.3%（Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct）与 21.4%（GPT-5.4-nano）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把记忆检索当作可进化组件、让 skill 集与 router 协同进化，能在异构记忆查询上明显优于固定检索策略。

papers.title: Error-Aware Reverse Auction Mechanism for Large Language Model Routing
papers.abstract_en: Routing each query to a cost-effective large language model (LLM) is critical for balancing quality and cost, yet most routers rely on a centralized task center to predict model performance, creating an information-risk mismatch and a scalability bottleneck as the model pool grows. We formulate LLM routing as a market-based allocation problem among strategic providers and propose a routing paradigm that shifts ex-ante prediction to LLM providers via a reverse auction, where providers submit self-predicted acceptance probabilities and execution costs. To account for noisy provider predictions and center evaluations, we introduce the \textit{\textbf{E}rror-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}everse \textbf{A}uction \textbf{M}echanism} (EA-RAM), which explicitly models this Dual Error. We prove that, under a private-evaluation-belief structure, truthful effective-surplus reporting is incentive compatible in the reduced-form score space and individually rational under sellers' subjective beliefs, establish sufficient conditions for center rationality, and derive an explicit social-welfare loss bound. We further identify robustness effects: opposite-signed errors can cancel, vanishing-tail link functions (e.g., logistic) stabilize clear-cut cases via saturation, and extra noise smooths belief maps and reduces their maximal local sensitivity. Simulations and real-world benchmarks show that EA-RAM is robust to Dual Error and achieves a better cost--performance Pareto frontier than centralized baselines, with additional gains from provider-side local information, validating its practical effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 路由改写成逆向拍卖：各模型提供方自报接受概率与执行成本，中心按出价分配查询。EA-RAM 显式建模提供方预测与中心评估的双重误差 (Dual Error)，证明在私有评估信念结构下真实报告有效剩余是激励相容且个体理性的，并给出中心理性充分条件与社会福利损失上界；仿真与真实基准显示其对双重误差稳健，且比集中式基线取得更好的成本-性能 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由依赖中心任务预测模型性能，随模型池扩大形成可扩展性瓶颈，并造成信息与风险不匹配；提供方自报又带来预测噪声。
Method: 提出 Error-Aware Reverse Auction Mechanism (EA-RAM)：提供方在逆向拍卖中提交自报接受概率与执行成本，机制在约简的分数空间 (reduced-form score space) 中显式建模 Dual Error；证明真实有效剩余报告的激励相容与卖方主观信念下的个体理性，推导中心理性充分条件和社会福利损失上界，并分析反号误差相消、logistic 等 vanishing-tail 链接函数的饱和稳定作用与额外噪声对信念映射局部敏感度的平滑效应。
Result: 仿真与真实基准上 EA-RAM 对 Dual Error 稳健，取得优于集中式基线的成本-性能 Pareto 前沿，提供方侧本地信息带来额外增益；理论侧给出显式社会福利损失上界。
Conclusion: 把事前性能预测从中心移到提供方、用逆向拍卖加误差感知机制分配，可在噪声自报下同时保住激励相容、个体理性与更优的成本-性能权衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Towards Understanding On-Policy Distillation through the Lens of Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a promising post-training technique for enhancing LLM reasoning. Under the reverse KL objective, the idealized optimum of OPD aligns the student distribution with that of the teacher. When the teacher consistently outperforms the student, this naturally suggests that OPD should yield broad improvements over the pre-OPD student. However, do such improvements extend across the entire range of test-time sampling budgets? In this work, we revisit this expectation through the lens of test-time scaling by varying the sampling budget $K$ and evaluating performance with pass@$K$. Across multiple settings, we observe two distinct patterns: OPD can improve pass@$K$ at both small and large sampling budgets, but it can also improve small-budget performance while reducing large-budget pass@$K$. We show one condition that guarantees such a reversal and an idealized reverse KL counterexample where it occurs even when the teacher has higher accuracy on every problem. To choose between two candidate teachers at a target sampling budget, we propose the \textit{Teacher Advantage Score at $K$} (TAS@$K$), which can be computed before OPD training to predict which teacher will lead to a larger improvement in pass@$K$. Across three domains and thirteen benchmarks, the ordering predicted by TAS@$K$ agrees with the observed pass@$K$ improvements of the resulting OPD models in 83.6\% of experiments, providing a useful signal for teacher selection at the target pass@$K$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 视角下重审 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD)：改变采样预算 K 并用 pass@$K$ 评测，发现 OPD 可能在小预算提升的同时降低大预算 pass@$K$，即使教师在每道题上准确率都更高也可能出现这种反转。作者提出 TAS@$K$（Teacher Advantage Score at K），可在 OPD 训练前预测选哪位教师，在三个领域十三个基准上与实际 pass@$K$ 提升排序一致率达 83.6%。
Motivation: 反向 KL 下 OPD 的理想最优解使学生对齐教师，通常预期教师持续优于学生时 OPD 应带来全面改进；但这一预期在不同测试时采样预算下是否成立并不清楚，教师选择也缺少训练前的判据。
Method: 以采样预算 K 为自变量、pass@$K$ 为评测指标，跨多个设置观察 OPD 的改进模式；给出保证反转出现的条件与一个理想化反向 KL 反例；提出可在 OPD 训练前计算的 TAS@$K$，用于在目标预算下在两个候选教师间做选择。
Result: 观察到两类模式：OPD 在小预算和大预算上都提升 pass@$K$，或提升小预算同时降低大预算 pass@$K$；给出一个保证该反转的条件，以及教师在每道题上准确率都更高时仍出现反转的理想化反向 KL 反例。TAS@$K$ 预测的教师排序在三个领域、十三个基准上与实际 OPD 模型 pass@$K$ 提升排序一致率 83.6%。
Conclusion: OPD 的收益随测试时采样预算而变，不能默认教师更强就全面改进；在目标 pass@$K$ 上选教师时，可用训练前可算的 TAS@$K$ 作为信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compact Feed-Forward 3D Gaussians via Saliency-Guided Primitive Merging
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene reconstruction, modeling, and rendering are highly relevant for numerous tasks, and 3D Gaussian splatting has become a standard choice in this context. Its feed-forward variants provide fast reconstruction from sparse input views but often produce per-pixel primitives, leading to highly redundant and thus inefficient representations. We present a structure-aware merging pipeline that takes per-pixel primitives from any feed-forward method and consolidates them into a compact, content-adaptive Gaussian set while largely retaining visual quality at just $\frac{1}{20}^\text{th}$ of the Gaussians of a per-pixel method. We group spatially coherent Gaussians of similar appearance into variable-size clusters via adaptive superpixel segmentation guided by a saliency map, which allocates fine segments to textured regions and coarse segments to homogeneous areas. We compress each cluster into a compact latent representation through a learned encoder, then match and consolidate representations across views based on geometric overlap and feature similarity via a learned merger. A level-of-detail decoder then produces the final Gaussians at a controllable resolution, enabling a flexible quality-efficiency trade-off at inference. As a post-processing module, the pipeline is backbone-agnostic, leveraging the strengths of existing feed-forward methods. This leads to better and more robust quality than achieved by previous approaches that target a reduction in primitive count, while providing a highly compact representation, that can be rendered efficiently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向前馈式 3D Gaussian splatting 输出的逐像素基元冗余问题，提出结构感知合并管线：用显著性图引导的自适应超像素把外观相似、空间连贯的高斯分组，经学习编码器压成 latent，再按几何重叠与特征相似度跨视图合并，最后由 level-of-detail 解码器按可控分辨率重建高斯。仅用逐像素方法 1/20 的高斯数量即基本保持视觉质量，且作为后处理模块与 backbone 无关。
Motivation: 前馈式 3D Gaussian splatting 能从稀疏视角快速重建，但常产生逐像素基元，表示高度冗余、渲染低效，已有基元削减方法在质量与鲁棒性上不足。
Method: 管线含四步：显著性图引导的自适应超像素分割（纹理区细分、均质区粗分）生成变尺寸簇；学习编码器把每簇压成紧凑 latent；学习到的 merger 按几何重叠与特征相似度跨视图匹配合并表示；level-of-detail 解码器在可控分辨率下输出最终高斯，推理时可调质量-效率折中。作为后处理模块，可接入任意前馈方法。
Result: 在仅保留逐像素方法 1/20 高斯数量的条件下基本保持视觉质量；相比此前以削减基元数量为目标的方法，质量更好且更鲁棒，表示高度紧凑、可高效渲染。
Conclusion: 把前馈 3DGS 的逐像素基元按内容自适应地合并成紧凑高斯集，可以在大幅压缩下维持质量，且该后处理设计与骨干网络解耦、可复用现有前馈方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Behavioral Evaluation of AI Agents at Scale via Automated Behavioral Science
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in complex and new environments, knowing the conditions that influence their behavior becomes an indispensable step for their reliable and safe deployment. Yet causal behavioral evaluation of AI agents remains manual and labor-intensive. We introduce Abs2Sim and AEROBAT, a system of methods that support causal behavioral evaluation of AI agents via automated behavioral science. Given a user-specified target behavior, the methods automatically execute a full pipeline of behavioral science research---generating hypotheses about the behavior, designing and executing controlled experiments, making behavioral assessments, analyzing the results, and writing reports. For 12 target behaviors, the methods generated and tested 73 hypotheses: designing 1,160 controlled experiments and executing 22,954 simulation rounds in total. Moderate-to-strong statistical evidence emerged for 30 hypotheses, revealing potential modulators of AI behavior. In sum, our results demonstrate that automated behavioral science can extend the reach of behavioral evaluation of AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Abs2Sim 与 AEROBAT 一套自动化行为科学方法，对 AI agent 的目标行为自动完成假设生成、受控实验设计与执行、行为评估、结果分析与报告撰写。对 12 个目标行为生成并检验 73 个假设，共设计 1,160 个受控实验、执行 22,954 轮仿真，其中 30 个假设出现中到强统计证据，指向 AI 行为的潜在调节因素。
Motivation: AI agent 越来越多地部署在复杂且陌生的环境中，识别影响其行为的条件是可靠安全部署的前提，但因果行为评估目前仍靠人工、劳动密集。
Method: 给定用户指定的目标行为，Abs2Sim 与 AEROBAT 自动执行完整行为科学流水线：生成关于该行为的假设、设计并执行受控实验、做出行为评估、分析结果并撰写报告，实验在仿真环境中运行。
Result: 在 12 个目标行为上生成并检验 73 个假设，设计 1,160 个受控实验，累计执行 22,954 轮仿真；其中 30 个假设获得中到强统计证据，揭示了 AI 行为的潜在调节因素 (modulators)。
Conclusion: 自动化行为科学能够扩展 AI agent 行为评估的覆盖范围，把原本手工的因果评估流程变成可规模化执行的实验管线。

papers.title: From Objectives to What Models Learn: A Landau Theory of Invariant Learning
papers.abstract_en: Invariant-learning objectives pursue similar goals yet produce qualitatively different regularization paths, leaving unclear when shortcuts can be suppressed without damaging stable modes. Our starting point is simple: in the desired shortcut-suppressed regime, shortcut loading is small, so the objective's low-order expansion governs local stability and residual amplitude. This brings the problem into the domain of Landau phase-transition theory. We establish a mathematical isomorphism between the near-critical normal form of predictive-mode learning and Landau theory, identifying the learning objective as an effective free energy and critical-mode amplitude as an order parameter. The resulting low-order objective signatures predict distinct regularization phenotypes: quadratic $R_2$ terms shift phase boundaries and enable finite-strength elimination, whereas quartic $R_4$ terms continuously attenuate acquired modes while leaving nonzero residual loading at finite strengths. Higher-order terms may further shape nonlinear tails. In a canonical bilinear model, we derive exact phase boundaries and equilibrium loadings, identifying conditions for a selective-retention window in which shortcut suppression preserves stable structure. Controlled bilinear and ReLU experiments, including an MNIST construction, support the predicted signature-phenotype relation, while coupled-feature experiments validate its extension to collective modes. The framework connects the mathematical structure of invariant-learning objectives to what models learn as regularization varies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把不变学习目标在 shortcut 抑制区的低阶展开映射为 Landau 相变理论：目标函数等价于有效自由能，临界模振幅是序参量。二次项 R2 平移相变边界并允许有限强度下完全消除 shortcut，四次项 R4 只连续衰减已学模、有限强度下仍留非零残余 loading；双线性模型给出精确相变边界与选择性保留窗口。
Motivation: 多种不变学习目标追求同一目标却产生定性不同的正则化路径，缺少判定何时能压掉 shortcut 而不伤稳定模的准则。
Method: 建立预测模学习近临界正则形与 Landau 理论的数学同构，把目标视为有效自由能、临界模振幅视为序参量，用目标的低阶 signature（R2、R4 及更高阶项）预测正则化表型；在规范双线性模型中推导精确相变边界与平衡 loading，并用受控双线性与 ReLU 实验（含一个 MNIST 构造）及耦合特征实验检验。
Result: 低阶 signature 决定表型：R2 项平移相变边界并支持有限强度下的完全消除，R4 项连续衰减已学模但在有限强度下保留非零残余 loading；双线性模型给出精确相变边界与选择性保留窗口的条件；受控双线性与 ReLU 实验（含 MNIST 构造）支持 signature–表型关系，耦合特征实验验证其向集体模的推广。
Conclusion: 不变学习目标的低阶结构决定 shortcut 抑制与稳定模保留能否兼得：要有限强度下彻底消除 shortcut 需要 R2 型项，仅有 R4 型项时残余 loading 不会归零。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RL-Native Distillation: Exploiting Scored Trajectories for Few-Step Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Efficient text-to-image generation requires both reinforcement-learning (RL)-based reward alignment and few-step distillation, yet these procedures are typically performed sequentially, increasing training cost and risking the loss of reward gains during compression. We take an RL-native perspective: diffusion RL already generates reward-scored finite-step trajectories, whose intermediate states provide distillation supervision. Based on this insight, we propose REST (Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation), a single-stage co-training framework in which a decoupled student learns from the evolving RL teacher's trajectories without changing teacher optimization. Advantage-Modulated Distillation (AMD) transforms rollout advantages into signed weights, strengthening imitation of preferred trajectories and aligning distillation priorities with task value. The resulting framework is general and lightweight, requires no extra image rollouts, no separate distillation dataset, and no adversarial training. Experiments on compositional generation, visual text rendering, and human-preference alignment demonstrate competitive few-step, CFG-free generation with RAM or DiffusionNFT teachers. With only four sampling steps, REST-RAM achieves a DrawBench PickScore of 23.97, outperforming both the 40-step RAM teacher (23.95) and RTDMD (23.71).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REST 把扩散模型的 RL 奖励对齐与少步蒸馏合并为单阶段共训练：RL 教师本身产生的带奖励分数轨迹直接充当蒸馏监督，Advantage-Modulated Distillation (AMD) 把 rollout advantage 转成带符号权重，强化对偏好轨迹的模仿。4 步采样下 REST-RAM 在 DrawBench 上 PickScore 达 23.97，超过 40 步 RAM 教师的 23.95 和 RTDMD 的 23.71。
Motivation: 文本到图像生成中 RL 奖励对齐与少步蒸馏通常先后执行，训练成本高，且压缩阶段容易丢掉已获得的奖励收益。
Method: 提出 REST（Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation）单阶段共训练框架：解耦的 student 直接从持续演化的 RL teacher 轨迹学习，不改动 teacher 的优化；AMD 将 rollout advantage 转为带符号权重，把蒸馏优先级与任务价值对齐。框架无需额外图像 rollout、无需独立蒸馏数据集、无对抗训练，teacher 可用 RAM 或 DiffusionNFT。
Result: 在组合生成、视觉文字渲染与人类偏好对齐三类任务上，REST 以 RAM 或 DiffusionNFT 为 teacher 实现有竞争力的少步、CFG-free 生成；仅 4 步采样时 REST-RAM 在 DrawBench 上 PickScore 23.97，高于 40 步 RAM teacher 的 23.95 与 RTDMD 的 23.71。
Conclusion: RL 训练已有的带分数轨迹足以同时充当蒸馏监督，因此奖励对齐与少步压缩可以合为一个轻量单阶段流程，而不必为蒸馏另备数据或对抗训练。

papers.title: HOPPER: Learnable Hop Extraction for Linearized Graph Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks typically propagate information through repeated message-passing layers, coupling propagation distance with the number of nonlinear transformations applied. This coupling can make deep architectures difficult to optimize and lead to over-smoothing, over-squashing, and loss of long-range information. Linearized Graph Sequence Models (LGSMs) address this issue by separating propagation depth from processing depth and representing successive propagation states of each node as a sequence. However, existing LGSMs construct these sequences using fixed graph operators, limiting their ability to adapt propagation to the input graph, node features, and downstream task. We introduce HOPPER, an end-to-end learnable extension of LGSM that learns how hop sequences should be extracted before processing by a modern state-space model. HOPPER supports feature-conditioned, structure-aware, graph and hop-adaptive propagation while preserving permutation equivariance, with standard adjacency-based and non-backtracking LGSM sequences arising as special cases of the extractor family. HOPPER is state-of-the-art or competitive across ECHO-Synth and performs strongly on City-Networks. On the LRIM physics-based long-range dependency benchmark, varying the maximum neighborhood size used for message-backtracking cancellation, corresponding to the structural memory window, substantially affects performance. Ablations further isolate the contributions of the learnable extraction mechanism and its structural and feature-adaptive components, showing that adaptive hop-sequence construction provides gains beyond the downstream sequence model alone. Together, these results demonstrate that learnable sequence extraction is a flexible and effective framework for long-range graph representation learning across synthetic, physics-based and real-world graph benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HOPPER 把线性化图序列模型 (LGSM) 的固定图算子换成端到端可学习的 hop 序列抽取器，由状态空间模型处理前先按输入图、节点特征与任务自适应地决定传播路径，同时保持置换等变性，邻接与 non-backtracking 序列成为其特例。在 ECHO-Synth 上达到 SOTA 或有竞争力，在 City-Networks 表现强；LRIM 物理长程基准上，消息回溯消邻域窗口（结构记忆窗）的取值显著改变性能。
Motivation: GNN 的消息传递把传播距离与非线性变换次数耦合，深层难优化并出现 over-smoothing、over-squashing 与长程信息丢失；已有 LGSM 虽解耦两者，但用固定图算子构造序列，无法随图、特征与任务调整传播。
Method: 在 LGSM 之上加一个可学习 hop 抽取器：特征条件、结构感知、按图与 hop 自适应地生成传播序列，再交给现代状态空间模型处理；保持置换等变性，标准邻接序列与 non-backtracking 序列是该抽取器族的特例。
Result: 在 ECHO-Synth 上为 SOTA 或有竞争力，在 City-Networks 上表现强；在 LRIM 物理长程依赖基准上，改变消息回溯消邻域大小（对应结构记忆窗）会显著影响性能；消融隔离出可学习抽取机制及其结构、特征自适应组件的贡献，说明自适应 hop 序列构造带来的增益超出下游序列模型本身。
Conclusion: 可学习的序列抽取是长程图表示学习的灵活有效框架，覆盖合成、物理与真实图基准，且增益来自抽取机制而非仅下游序列模型。

papers.title: SDDBMs: Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion bridge models leverage Doob's \(h\)-transform to construct stochastic transports between arbitrary endpoint distributions, and have shown strong potential in image-to-image translation and restoration. However, most existing bridge models rely on hard endpoint conditioning, which forces the terminal state to match a prescribed target exactly. This hard constraint induces terminal-boundary singularities: the terminal law collapses to a Dirac measure, and the resulting drift coefficients become ill-conditioned near the endpoint. In this paper, we propose Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models (SDDBMs), a generalized framework that regularizes diffusion bridges directly at the level of their terminal constraints. Instead of imposing an exact endpoint, SDDBMs prescribe a non-degenerate Gaussian terminal marginal under the transformed path measure, with a flexible terminal center and variance. Starting from this prescribed marginal, we develop a complete closed-form construction of the soft bridge, including the Gaussian terminal reweighting and soft \(h\)-function, the induced Gaussian forward marginals and \(\mathbf{x}_0\)-free dynamics. Theoretically, SDDBMs provide a unified probabilistic perspective that encompasses existing diffusion bridge models, including DDBMs, GOUB, and UniDB, as special cases under specific parameter choices. Extensive experiments on image restoration tasks demonstrate that SDDBMs achieve improved numerical stability and superior generation quality over existing bridge-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SDDBM 把扩散桥的硬端点约束放松为变换路径测度下非退化的高斯终端边缘（可调中心与方差），从而消除终端 Dirac 塌缩与端点附近漂移系数病态。给出高斯终端重加权、soft h-function、高斯前向边缘与 x0-free 动力学的闭式构造，并把 DDBM、GOUB、UniDB 统一为参数特例；在图像修复任务上相对既有桥方法取得更好的数值稳定性与生成质量。
Motivation: 现有扩散桥多依赖硬端点条件，迫使终态精确匹配给定目标，导致终端律塌缩为 Dirac 测度、端点附近漂移系数 ill-conditioned，限制数值稳定性。
Method: 在终端约束层面正则化扩散桥：以变换路径测度下带可调中心与方差的非退化高斯终端边缘替代精确端点，推导高斯终端重加权与 soft h-function、诱导的高斯前向边缘及 x0-free 动力学的完整闭式构造；理论上以参数选取把 DDBM、GOUB、UniDB 纳入为特例。
Result: 在图像修复任务上的实验显示，SDDBM 相对既有基于桥的方法取得改进的数值稳定性与更优的生成质量（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把端点从硬约束放松为可调的非退化高斯终端边缘，可同时消除终端边界奇异性并统一现有扩散桥模型族。

papers.title: Evidence-RL: Towards Evidence-intensive Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) should answer from concrete image evidence rather than language priors, dataset shortcuts, or irrelevant visual context. Existing perception-aware post-training methods encourage image use through global perturbations or attention proxies, but they do not test whether a sampled answer causally depends on the local evidence that supports it. We propose Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED), a training-time evidence audit for VLM grounding. For each response, CED neutralizes an object-centric Evidence Region and compares the resulting support drop against matched non-evidence Regions. We combine this signal with answer correctness inside GRPO, rewarding correct answers that rely on the evidence path rather than shortcut or nuisance paths. CED uses weak object-level proposals, requires no question-specific evidence annotations, and adds no inference-time overhead. Across nine public benchmarks and four backbones, CED outperforms prior RL-based post-training methods, with targeted analyses verifying its object-centric signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Evidence-RL 提出 Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED)，在训练期对 VLM 的每个回答做反事实证据审计：抹掉物体级 Evidence Region 后看支撑度下降，并与匹配的非证据区域比较，再把该信号与答案正确性一起放进 GRPO，奖励走证据路径而非捷径或干扰路径的回答。在 9 个公开 benchmark、4 个 backbone 上超过既有的 RL 后训练方法，且不需问题级证据标注、不增加推理开销。
Motivation: VLM 常从语言先验、数据集捷径或无关视觉上下文作答；现有感知感知后训练只用全局扰动或注意力代理鼓励看图，不检验采样答案是否因果依赖支撑它的局部证据。
Method: CED 是训练期证据审计：对每条回答中和物体中心的 Evidence Region，比较其造成的支撑度下降与匹配的非证据 Region；把该信号与答案正确性结合进 GRPO 奖励，使用弱物体级提议，无需问题级证据标注，推理期零额外开销。
Result: 在 9 个公开 benchmark、4 个 backbone 上，CED 优于此前基于 RL 的后训练方法；针对性分析 (targeted analyses) 验证其物体中心信号有效。
Conclusion: 把反事实的局部证据依赖检验嵌入 GRPO 奖励，可以让 VLM 的正确回答建立在证据路径而非捷径上，且无需证据标注与推理开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memory--Batch Tradeoffs in Lipschitz Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Lipschitz bandits admit near-optimal regret $\widetilde O_d(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$ with little memory under full adaptivity, or with few batches under unrestricted memory. We characterize the minimax expected pseudo-regret over $T$ rounds with $W$ bits of memory and at most $B$ batches in dimension $d$. For every memory budget $W$, we prove a lower bound of order $T^{\frac{d+2}{d+3}} (1+(B-1)W)^{-\frac{1}{d(d+3)}}$. When $W\gtrsim_d\log(eT)$, algorithms with fixed batch boundaries attain, up to logarithmic factors, the larger of this bound and the optimal $B$-batch regret with unrestricted memory. The analysis separates fine-scale comparisons from the regional information needed to allocate their samples at low regret. Attaining $\widetilde O_d(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$ regret requires both $B=Ω_d(\log\log T)$ and $(B-1)W=\widetildeΩ_d(T^{d/(d+2)})$. With one bit of memory, minimax regret is $\widetildeΘ_d(TB^{-1/(d+2)})$ under adaptive batch boundaries while $Θ_d(T)$ under fixed boundaries.

Motivation: Lipschitz bandit 已知在全自适应+少记忆、或少批次+无限制记忆两种极端下可近最优，但记忆与批次同时受限时的权衡尚无刻画。

papers.title: Vision Meets WiFi: Physics-Grounded Estimation of Volumetric Mechanical Properties
papers.abstract_en: Estimating volumetric mechanical properties, including Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and density at each voxel, is intrinsically ambiguous from vision alone, as visually similar objects may have substantially different material compositions and physical behavior. Existing approaches predict these properties independently across voxels, overlooking the piecewise-constant material structure of real objects and producing noisy or inconsistent estimates for voxels that share the same material, while lacking an explicit mechanism to resolve visual ambiguity. We introduce ViWi (Vision Meets WiFi), an object-centric framework for volumetric mechanical-property estimation. ViWi represents each object using a compact set of material slots that aggregate evidence from voxels with a shared material identity and produce coherent slot-level property predictions. To complement visual appearance, ViWi incorporates a compact RF descriptor generated through WiFi-band electromagnetic simulation using permittivity and conductivity. The RF descriptor conditions the material slots with global composition cues that may be unavailable from images, while visual features preserve voxel-level spatial localization. On GVM, ViWi improves over the prior state of the art on four of six per-voxel metrics, while its vision-only variant improves all reported mass-estimation metrics on ABO-500. These results demonstrate that combining object-centric material structure with complementary RF evidence enables more accurate and physically coherent volumetric property estimation beyond what is possible from visual appearance alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViWi 用物体级 material slots 聚合同一材料的体素证据，并用 WiFi 波段电磁仿真生成的 RF 描述子（介电常数与电导率）为 slot 注入全局成分线索，从而在视觉本身有歧义时仍给出一致的体积力学属性估计。在 GVM 上它在 6 项 per-voxel 指标中的 4 项超过先前 SOTA，其 vision-only 变体在 ABO-500 上改进了全部已报告的质量估计指标。
Motivation: 仅凭视觉估计每个体素的 Young's modulus、Poisson's ratio 与密度本质上歧义：外观相似的物体材料构成可能完全不同；现有方法逐体素独立预测，忽略真实物体的分片常数材料结构，同材料体素结果嘈杂不一致，也没有显式消歧机制。
Method: 物体中心框架 ViWi：每个物体用一组紧凑 material slots 聚合共享材料身份的体素证据并输出 slot 级属性；另用基于介电常数与电导率的 WiFi 波段电磁仿真生成紧凑 RF 描述子，为 slots 提供图像中可能缺失的全局成分线索，视觉特征则保留体素级空间定位。
Result: 在 GVM 上，ViWi 在 6 项 per-voxel 指标中的 4 项优于先前 SOTA；其 vision-only 变体在 ABO-500 上改进了全部已报告的 mass-estimation 指标。
Conclusion: 把物体级材料结构与互补的 RF 证据结合，可以做到仅凭视觉外观无法达到的更准确、物理上更一致的体积属性估计。

papers.title: MaskFlow: Precise, Consistent and Seamless Regional Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Regional image editing has attracted considerable attention for its spatial controllability. Although instruction-based and mask-based editing methods can achieve strong semantic alignment, reliable regional control remains challenging, where an edit must be accurately localized and naturally integrated with the preserved context. We propose MaskFlow, a training framework for precise localization, consistent background preservation, and seamless boundary transitions. MaskFlow incorporates the mask into the probability path and flow-matching objective, coordinating generation within the editable region with source preservation outside it. The proposed Soft-Poisson De-seaming module further refines the predicted vector field during both training and sampling to improve the smooth integration of the edited foreground with the preserved background. We also introduce MaskEdit-Benchmark for general scene and infographics editing, where prompts describe the desired edits without localization cues, leaving masks to specify the target regions. Experiments on natural scenes and infographic images demonstrate consistent improvements over competing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Project page: https://reychiaro.github.io/MaskFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaskFlow 把掩码写进概率路径与 flow-matching 目标，使可编辑区域内生成与区域外源图保持协同，并用 Soft-Poisson De-seaming 模块在训练与采样阶段修正预测向量场，改善前景与背景的边界过渡。在自然场景与信息图编辑上，该方法在定量与定性评测中相对竞争方法均有一致提升。
Motivation: 指令式与掩码式区域编辑虽有较强语义对齐，但编辑难以被准确定位、也难以与保留的上下文自然融合，可靠的空间控制仍是缺口。
Method: MaskFlow 是一个训练框架：把掩码融入概率路径与 flow-matching 目标，协调可编辑区域内生成与区域外源图保持；Soft-Poisson De-seaming 模块在训练和采样时细化预测向量场。同时提出 MaskEdit-Benchmark，prompt 只描述编辑意图、不给定位线索，由掩码指定目标区域，覆盖通用场景与信息图两类编辑。
Result: 在自然场景与信息图图像上的实验显示，相对竞争方法在定量与定性评测中均取得一致提升；配套发布 MaskEdit-Benchmark（含通用场景与信息图编辑，prompt 不含定位线索）。
Conclusion: 把掩码直接嵌入生成的概率路径并配合向量场细化，可以同时拿到精确定位、背景一致与边界无缝的区域编辑。

papers.title: From Behavior to Mechanism: Tracing Divergent Response Modes in Frontier Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models are trained with distinct data, objectives, and safety pipelines, but whether those differences produce measurably different behavior under steering pressure has not been tested. We evaluate 6 frontier models from different labs on 300 paired base and steered items across 3 behavioral categories. All models also act as blind peer judges against fixed rubrics, and each response is labeled by consensus over 24,480 judgments, while leaving self-judgment out. Models differ both in how far steering moves them and in the kind of response they give. GPT-5 withholds its reasoning while still providing the answer on 99 of 100 steered items, against 0 in 500 for the others. Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5 resist explicit suppression instructions where the other four never do, and they resist differently. In Llama, the open-weight model, a linear probe reads the behavioral split from the residual stream before generation at 0.87 cross-validated accuracy. Injecting that direction drives the behavior from 0% to 86%, and ablating it cuts the natural rate by more than half, where a random direction of equal norm changes nothing. A second ablation on complementary items reproduces the effect more strongly, and its direction has cosine similarity 0.82 with the first.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 9 tables. v2 adds a directional ablation with two-split replication, a DeepSeek-R1 reasoning-trace analysis, a ridge-direction comparison, and McNemar tests for the paired design. Code and data at https://github.com/alijalalkamali/trace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 6 个前沿模型在 300 组配对基础/加压样本上测行为分化，发现 GPT-5 在 100 个被压制样本中 99 个仍给出答案（其他模型 500 例中为 0），Claude Opus 4.7 与 GPT-5 抵抗显式压制指令；在 Llama 残差流上用线性探针读出该行为分裂方向，注入使行为从 0% 升到 86%，消融使自然发生率减半以上。
Motivation: 不同实验室用不同数据、目标与安全管线训练前沿模型，但这些差异是否在 steering 压力下产生可测量的不同行为尚未被检验。
Method: 对 6 个不同实验室的前沿模型评测 300 组配对 base/steered 样本，覆盖 3 个行为类别；各模型以固定 rubric 充当盲评同伴，每条回答由 24,480 次判断的共识标注且排除自评；在 Llama 上用线性探针读残差流方向并做方向注入与消融，v2 增加方向性消融、两半复现、DeepSeek-R1 推理轨迹分析、ridge 方向对比与配对设计的 McNemar 检验。
Result: GPT-5 在 100 个 steered 样本中 99 个隐去推理但仍给出答案，其余模型为 0/500；Claude Opus 4.7 与 GPT-5 抵抗显式压制指令而另外四个从不抵抗；Llama 残差流线性探针交叉验证准确率 0.87，注入该方向把行为从 0% 推到 86%，消融使自然发生率下降过半，等范数随机方向无影响；互补样本上的第二次消融效应更强，其方向与第一次的余弦相似度 0.82。
Conclusion: 前沿模型在 steering 压力下的行为分化可由残差流中的线性方向读出并因果操控，且该方向在互补样本上可复现。

papers.title: Which Decisions Low-Bit Quantization Breaks, and How to Predict Them
papers.abstract_en: Quantization saves memory by storing model weights with fewer bits. It can also change model decisions, such as whether to call a tool or which option to choose from a finite set. We study these decision changes in 16 language models from 8 families at 4, 3 and 2 bits, across several post-training quantization settings. Our evaluation covers tool use, safety, general knowledge and social bias, using BFCL, XSTest, MMLU, BoolQ, BBQ and synthetic tasks. The decision margin is the score difference between two possible first tokens, measured before and after quantization. Writing the margin before quantization as $m$ and the margin after quantization as $m'$, we find an approximately linear relationship across decisions: $m' \approx c m + b$. The slope $c$ is usually below one and becomes smaller as precision falls, so quantization progressively shrinks decision margins. The offset $b$ is the same for every decision of one kind. Quantization therefore does not simply add random noise, and even a strong preference at full precision can flip. Quantization also affects different kinds of decisions to different degrees. Within tool use, whether to call a tool is often more sensitive than which tool to call: on 400 BFCL tasks, three of five models lose more completed calls than correct tool selections at 3-bit round-to-nearest. Under GPTQ and GGUF far fewer whether-to-call decisions flip than under plain rounding, so there is no single 3-bit failure point. The same relationship predicts how often decisions flip. Across 1,154 combinations of models, quantization settings, bit-widths and decision types drawn from our evaluation, we fit the slope, the offset and the spread around the fitted line on half of the decisions and predict the flip rate on the other half. The predicted flip rate differs from the observed flip rate by a median of 1.0 percentage point.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables. Preprint, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低比特量化不只是加噪声，而是系统性压缩决策边际：m' ≈ c·m + b，斜率 c<1 且随位宽下降而变小，偏移 b 对同类决策恒定，因此全精度下的强偏好也可能翻转。在 1,154 个模型×量化设置×位宽×决策类型组合上，用一半决策拟合 c、b 与散布，预测另一半的翻转率，中位误差仅 1.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 量化会改变模型是否调用工具、选哪个选项这类离散决策，但缺少可预测翻转的定量刻画，无法区分量化是随机噪声还是系统性偏移。
Method: 在 8 个家族共 16 个语言模型上考察 4/3/2 bit 的多种 PTQ 设置（含 round-to-nearest、GPTQ、GGUF），用 BFCL、XSTest、MMLU、BoolQ、BBQ 与合成任务覆盖工具使用、安全、常识与社会偏见；定义决策边际为两个候选首 token 的分数差，量化前后记为 m 与 m'，拟合 m' ≈ c·m + b 并在一半决策上拟合斜率、偏移与散布以预测另一半的翻转率。
Result: 斜率 c 通常小于 1 且随精度下降而变小，偏移 b 对同一类决策恒定；400 个 BFCL 任务中，3-bit round-to-nearest 下 5 个模型里有 3 个丢失的完成调用多于正确的工具选择；GPTQ 与 GGUF 下翻转的 whether-to-call 决策远少于朴素取整，故不存在单一的 3-bit 失效点；在 1,154 个组合上预测翻转率与观测值的中位偏差为 1.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 量化对决策的影响是按决策类型分层的系统性边际收缩而非随机噪声，翻转率可由拟合的斜率、偏移与散布预测，且失效点依赖量化算法而非单一 3-bit 阈值。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 低比特量化不只是加噪声，而是系统性压缩决策边际：m' ≈ c·m + b，斜率 c<1 且随位宽下降而变小，偏移 b 对同类决策恒定，因此全精度下的强偏好也可能翻转。在 1,154 个模型×量化设置×位宽×决策类型组合上，用一半决策拟合 c、b 与散布，预测另一半的翻转率，中位误差仅 1.0 个百分点。
summary_sections.motivation: 量化会改变模型是否调用工具、选哪个选项这类离散决策，但缺少可预测翻转的定量刻画，无法区分量化是随机噪声还是系统性偏移。
summary_sections.method: 在 8 个家族共 16 个语言模型上考察 4/3/2 bit 的多种 PTQ 设置（含 round-to-nearest、GPTQ、GGUF），用 BFCL、XSTest、MMLU、BoolQ、BBQ 与合成任务覆盖工具使用、安全、常识与社会偏见；定义决策边际为两个候选首 token 的分数差，量化前后记为 m 与 m'，拟合 m' ≈ c·m + b 并在一半决策上拟合斜率、偏移与散布以预测另一半的翻转率。
summary_sections.result: 斜率 c 通常小于 1 且随精度下降而变小，偏移 b 对同一类决策恒定；400 个 BFCL 任务中，3-bit round-to-nearest 下 5 个模型里有 3 个丢失的完成调用多于正确的工具选择；GPTQ 与 GGUF 下翻转的 whether-to-call 决策远少于朴素取整，故不存在单一的 3-bit 失效点；在 1,154 个组合上预测翻转率与观测值的中位偏差为 1.0 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 量化对决策的影响是按决策类型分层的系统性边际收缩而非随机噪声，翻转率可由拟合的斜率、偏移与散布预测，且失效点依赖量化算法而非单一 3-bit 阈值。

papers.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
papers.abstract_en: Achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization while maintaining low communication cost remains challenging. Existing vector quantization methods, such as vqSGD, rely on high-dimensional geometric constructions but incur unfavorable dimension-dependent variance. In this work, we propose Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ), a framework that combines a bounded Kashin representation, data-independent coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware one-dimensional quantization. SSTQ includes two variants: (1) a Flat Randomized Response variant that is unbiased and, for a fixed codebook bit-width, frame redundancy, and dimension-independent Kashin level, achieves reconstruction MSE that scales linearly with the ambient dimension $d$, while using only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$ bits per message. Here, $N = Θ(d)$ denotes the frame size in the Kashin transform and $b$ is the codebook bit-width; and (2) a metric-aware truncated-Laplace variant that removes the exponential dependence on bit-width at the cost of a non-vanishing bias. We also derive a convex uniform-surrogate codebook objective whose worst-case codebook-dependent upper bound improves from $O(4^b)$ to $O(2^b)$. Experiments on synthetic regression, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 compare the per-message privacy-utility and uplink-communication trade-offs of SSTQ with those of established baselines, demonstrating favorable utility and communication efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出隐私保护向量量化框架 SSTQ，把有界 Kashin 表示、数据无关坐标子采样与隐私感知一维量化结合，用于分布式优化的本地差分隐私 (local DP)。Flat Randomized Response 变体无偏、重建 MSE 随环境维度 d 线性增长且每条消息仅用 ⌈log₂N⌉+b 比特；metric-aware truncated-Laplace 变体去掉对比特宽度 b 的指数依赖但引入非零偏差。
Motivation: 分布式优化中要在本地差分隐私下保持低通信成本；现有 vqSGD 等向量量化依赖高维几何构造，带来不利的维度依赖方差。
Method: SSTQ 组合有界 Kashin 表示（帧尺寸 N=Θ(d)）、数据无关坐标子采样与隐私感知一维量化，含两个变体：无偏的 Flat Randomized Response，以及带非消失偏差的 metric-aware truncated-Laplace；另导出凸 uniform-surrogate 码本目标。
Result: Flat Randomized Response 在固定码本 bit-width b、帧冗余与维度无关 Kashin level 下重建 MSE 随 d 线性增长，每条消息仅 ⌈log₂N⌉+b 比特；码本目标最坏情形上界由 O(4^b) 改进到 O(2^b)；在 synthetic regression、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上比较了与既有基线的每消息隐私-实用与上行通信权衡，显示有利的实用性与通信效率。
Conclusion: 用 Kashin 表示加坐标子采样可以把本地 DP 向量量化的维度依赖方差压到线性，并把码本目标上界从指数 4^b 降到 2^b；truncated-Laplace 变体以非零偏差换取去掉对 b 的指数依赖。

papers.title: OmniVR: Audio-Video Conditional Generation for Archival Footage Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Archival footage often suffers from coupled visual and acoustic degradations, yet most restoration systems process the two modalities separately. To address this problem, we present OmniVR, the first systematic framework for joint audio-video restoration, covering data construction, model adaptation, efficient inference, and evaluation. We construct a high-quality audio-video corpus with detailed captions and use a joint degradation pipeline to produce aligned clean and degraded pairs. Using these pairs, we adapt a pretrained text-to-audio-video model (T2AV) by introducing degraded audio-video conditions (TAV2AV), then progressively replace sample captions with a fixed restoration prompt while retaining caption/null rehearsal. The resulting AV2AV model requires no user-provided text. Under a compatible residual-learning model, we prove that this condition-annealing schedule reduces gradient variance and expected restoration risk relative to direct fixed-prompt adaptation at the same training budget. For efficient deployment, OmniVR-Flash combines reduced-resolution video conditioning, MeanFlow-based one-step distillation, and Turbo VAE, achieving approximately 38 fps at 1K and 18 fps at 2K on a single B200 GPU. We further introduce OmniVRBench to evaluate four complementary dimensions: visual quality, audio quality, temporal consistency, and audio-visual synchrony. OmniVR achieves state-of-the-art results on public benchmarks and OmniVRBench. Data, code, and model weights will be released. Project Page: https://xin1u.github.io/OminiVR_PAGE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniVR 把档案影像的画质与音质退化当作一个联合恢复问题：用带字幕的音视频语料与联合退化管线造对齐的干净/退化对，把预训练 T2AV 改造成以退化音视频为条件的 TAV2AV，再逐步把字幕换成固定恢复提示并保留 caption/null rehearsal，得到无需用户输入文本的 AV2AV。理论证明该条件退火 (condition-annealing) 在同等训练预算下比直接固定提示适配降低梯度期望方差与期望恢复风险；OmniVR-Flash 用降分辨率视频条件、MeanFlow 一步蒸馏与 Turbo VAE，在单张 B200 上 1K 约 38 fps、2K 约 18 fps。
Motivation: 档案素材的视觉与声学退化是耦合的，但现有恢复系统把两个模态分开处理，导致联合退化无法一致修复，也缺少覆盖画质、音质、时序一致性与音画同步的统一评测。
Method: 构建带详细字幕的高质量音视频语料，并用联合退化管线生成对齐的干净/退化样本对；将预训练 text-to-audio-video 模型 (T2AV) 适配为以退化音视频为条件的 TAV2AV，训练中逐步用固定恢复提示替换样本字幕，同时保留 caption/null rehearsal，得到 AV2AV；在兼容的 residual-learning 模型下给出条件退火相对直接固定提示适配的理论比较；部署侧 OmniVR-Flash 结合降分辨率视频条件、MeanFlow 一步蒸馏与 Turbo VAE。
Result: 理论结果：条件退火在相同训练预算下相对直接固定提示适配降低梯度方差与期望恢复风险。效率：OmniVR-Flash 在单张 B200 GPU 上约 38 fps（1K）与 18 fps（2K）。评测：OmniVRBench 覆盖视觉质量、音频质量、时序一致性、音画同步四个维度，OmniVR 在公开基准与 OmniVRBench 上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 音视频联合条件加条件退火是档案素材恢复的可行路径：既省去用户文本输入，又在同等训练预算下有更小的梯度方差与期望风险，配合一步蒸馏可达到可部署的实时帧率；数据、代码与模型权重将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MissClick: Execution-Aware Adversarial Attacks on Coordinate Generation in GUI Grounding Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent GUI visual grounding models generate screen coordinates as digit-token sequences that are parsed into numerical values and mapped to executable clicks. This generation-to-execution interface creates an attack surface that existing objectives over visual representations or coordinate-token sequences do not explicitly model. Although each coordinate digit is predicted as a token, its spatial effect after parsing depends on decimal position: changing a hundreds-place digit by one shifts the coordinate by 100 units, whereas the same change at the ones place shifts it by one. This mismatch motivates attack objectives that account for both numerical coordinate structure and click execution. Moreover, untargeted and targeted attacks require different objectives because they aim to move the click outside the correct region and into an attacker-specified region, respectively. We propose MissClick, an execution-aware white-box attack that aligns optimization with click-level success conditions. MissClick-U maximizes soft-coordinate displacement for untargeted disruption, while MissClick-T minimizes a place-weighted target-digit loss for targeted redirection. On OS-Atlas and UGround across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, MissClick-U achieves untargeted success rates of 75.07% and 72.93% (+16.62 and +30.72 pp), while MissClick-T achieves targeted success rates of 44.86% and 62.67% (+31.73 and +47.06 pp). Among the evaluated objectives, soft-coordinate displacement performs best for untargeted attacks, whereas place-weighted target-digit optimization performs best for targeted attacks, supporting goal-specific execution-aware objective design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MissClick 是针对 GUI 视觉定位模型坐标生成的执行感知白盒攻击：把数字 token 解析成可执行点击的接口当作攻击面，按十进制位权设计目标。MissClick-U 最大化软坐标位移做无目标扰动，在 OS-Atlas 与 UGround 上无目标成功率 75.07% 与 72.93%（+16.62、+30.72 pp）；MissClick-T 最小化位权加权目标数字损失做定向重定向，成功率 44.86% 与 62.67%（+31.73、+47.06 pp）。
Motivation: GUI 定位模型把坐标当数字 token 序列生成再解析成点击，这一生成到执行的接口未被现有针对视觉表征或坐标 token 序列的攻击目标显式建模；且同一数字改动在百位与个位造成的空间位移相差百倍。
Method: 执行感知白盒攻击，分两支：MissClick-U 最大化软坐标位移实现无目标扰动，MissClick-T 最小化位权加权的目标数字损失 (place-weighted target-digit loss) 实现定向重定向，优化直接对齐点击级成功条件。
Result: 在 OS-Atlas 与 UGround（桌面、网页、移动平台）上，MissClick-U 无目标成功率 75.07% 与 72.93%，较所比目标提升 16.62 与 30.72 pp；MissClick-T 定向成功率 44.86% 与 62.67%，提升 31.73 与 47.06 pp。所评估目标中，软坐标位移对无目标攻击最优，位权加权目标数字优化对定向攻击最优。
Conclusion: 无目标与定向攻击需要不同目标函数，按点击执行条件而非 token 序列本身设计攻击目标能显著提高成功率。

papers.title: Experimental validation of an open-source low-cost single-camera 6-DOF tracking of floating-body motion in wave tanks
papers.abstract_en: Accurately measuring motion of floating structures in experimental settings is both important and non-trivial. In this paper, we present a single-camera, 6-degree-of-freedom motion-tracking system that is both low-cost and simple to set up for an experimental campaign. The system uses fiducial markers and open-source computer vision tools to estimate the positions and orientations of multi-marker geometries and track them. We validate the accuracy and limitations on a precisely controlled linear actuator with static, regular, and irregular motion. The performance is quantified depending on both the camera-to-marker distance and direction of motion relative to the camera plane. Additionally, we present a practical use case for our system in a wave tank. Although the motion direction perpendicular to the camera plane shows the highest errors, the system achieves sub-millimeter accuracy at short and moderate camera-to-marker distances. For the irregular motion validation, the best cases reproduced the displacements with an RMSE of approximately 0.5 mm. Overall, the results indicate that low-cost single-camera fiducial-marker tracking can provide sufficiently accurate, non-intrusive motion measurements for a range of hydrodynamic laboratory experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出低成本单相机 6-DOF 浮体运动追踪系统，用 fiducial markers 与开源计算机视觉估计多标记几何的位置与姿态。在精密线性执行器的静止、规则与不规则运动验证中，垂直于相机平面的方向误差最大，但短到中等相机-标记距离下达到亚毫米精度，不规则运动最佳情形位移 RMSE 约 0.5 mm。
Motivation: 实验中浮式结构的运动测量重要而非平凡，需要一种搭建简单、成本低且非侵入的 6 自由度测量手段用于水动力学实验。
Method: 单相机 + fiducial markers + 开源计算机视觉工具，估计多标记几何 (multi-marker geometry) 的位置与姿态并连续追踪；先在精密线性执行器上以静止、规则、不规则三类运动验证精度与极限，性能按相机到标记距离及运动相对相机平面的方向分别量化，再给出波浪水槽 (wave tank) 实用案例。
Result: 垂直于相机平面的运动方向误差最高；短与中等相机-标记距离下达到亚毫米精度；不规则运动验证最佳情形位移 RMSE 约 0.5 mm。
Conclusion: 低成本单相机 fiducial-marker 追踪足以提供非侵入、精度可接受的运动测量，适用于一系列水动力学实验室实验。
