summary_sections.result: 垂直于相机平面的运动方向误差最高；短与中等相机-标记距离下达到亚毫米精度；不规则运动验证最佳情形位移 RMSE 约 0.5 mm。
summary_sections.conclusion: 低成本单相机 fiducial-marker 追踪足以提供非侵入、精度可接受的运动测量，适用于一系列水动力学实验室实验。

papers.title: dots.tts.edit: Precisely Controlled Speech Editing with a Continuous Autoregressive Model
papers.abstract_en: Speech editing for content creation requires precise control over both what an edit should do and where it should apply. Free-form natural language provides a flexible interface for expressing edit requests, but its ambiguity may leave the intended operation, parameters, or target region underspecified. We study a precise and explicit interface for speech editing: a transcript-grounded structural edit instruction with XML-style tags explicitly specifies typed operations and localizes them to transcript spans or boundaries. This semantic timeline avoids explicit timestamp alignment and provides an externally inspectable contract for compositional edits. We instantiate the interface in dots$.$tts$.$edit, an editor adapted from the continuous autoregressive dots$.$tts foundation model. Four representative speech-creation controls cover lexical content, affective expression, pitch and speaking-rate delivery, and temporal phrasing through text, emotion, prosody, and pause editing. Task-specific data pipelines construct operation- and scope-controlled pairs while retaining source-derived context outside each target region. We further introduce doteBench, a bilingual evaluation suite that measures precise instruction following, local preservation, and audio quality across the four controls and their composition. Experiments show leading overall instruction following and local preservation across its five editing categories, while audio quality remains comparable to existing open-source systems. Across three Seed-TTS-Eval shards, the model shows negligible differences from the base model in zero-shot TTS recognition error rate and speaker similarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: dots.tts.edit 用 XML 式 transcript-grounded 结构编辑指令，把语音编辑的操作类型与作用范围显式绑定到文本片段，避开时间戳对齐；在自建 doteBench 上其指令遵循与局部保持领先，且零样本 TTS 识别错误率与说话人相似度相对基座模型无可察觉差异。
Motivation: 自由文本编辑指令语义含糊，操作、参数与目标区域常欠定，语音内容创作需要可检查、可组合的精确控制接口。
Method: 从连续自回归 dots.tts 基座模型适配出 dots.tts.edit，指令用 XML 风格标签声明 text、emotion、prosody、pause 四类操作并定位到 transcript span 或边界；任务专用数据管线构造受控操作-范围样本对，目标区域外保留源音频上下文；评测用双语套件 doteBench。
Result: doteBench 覆盖四类控制及其组合、五个编辑类别，dots.tts.edit 在指令遵循与局部保持上整体领先，音频质量与现有开源系统相当；在三个 Seed-TTS-Eval shard 上，零样本 TTS 识别错误率与说话人相似度相对基座模型差异可忽略。
Conclusion: 把编辑语义落在 transcript 而非时间轴上，可在不牺牲音质与说话人一致性的前提下实现可组合、可外部检查的语音编辑控制。

papers.title: RedFlow: Redirect Failure into Action-level Corrections for Flow-matching VLA Policy
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies from deployment experience, but reward- and preference-based RL primarily identifies desirable behaviors without specifying how to correct failed actions, underutilizing failure trajectories and limiting sample efficiency. Can such corrections be derived from fixed rollouts? Our key insight is that rollouts with different outcomes may contain action chunks executed in similar states, enabling higher-quality chunks to provide locally supported corrective references. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{RedFlow}, an offline post-training method for flow-matching VLA policies. \emph{Execution-Context Matching} groups chunks using a compact representation of estimated task progress and robot proprioception. \emph{Quality-Guided Action Redirection} assigns signed chunk-quality scores and aggregates higher-quality chunks into corrective targets, reinforcing high-quality chunks, suppressing low-quality chunks, and redirecting correctable chunks toward their targets. RedFlow requires neither external HIL corrections nor online data collection during post-training. Across four LIBERO suites, RedFlow improves average success from 56.2\% to 68.2\%, outperforming the strongest evaluated offline baseline, AWR (62.3\%), by 5.9 points. Across three real-robot tasks, it improves average success from 56.7\% to 74.7\%. On LIBERO-Spatial, RedFlow reaches 75.8\% success with 1{,}536 fixed rollouts, while the evaluated online methods require 8.7--16$\times$ as many fresh post-training rollouts to reach the same threshold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RedFlow 是面向 flow-matching VLA 策略的离线后训练方法：用执行上下文匹配 (Execution-Context Matching) 按任务进度与机器人本体感觉把动作块分组，再用质量引导动作重定向 (Quality-Guided Action Redirection) 给块打带符号的质量分并聚合出纠正目标，把失败轨迹转成动作级修正。在四个 LIBERO suite 上平均成功率从 56.2% 提到 68.2%，超过最强离线基线 AWR (62.3%) 5.9 个百分点。
Motivation: 基于奖励或偏好的 RL 只能识别期望行为，不指明如何纠正失败动作，失败轨迹被浪费，样本效率受限；而收集在线数据或人工 HIL 纠正成本高。
Method: 离线后训练，仅用固定 rollouts：Execution-Context Matching 用紧凑表示（估计的任务进度 + 机器人本体感觉）对动作块分组；Quality-Guided Action Redirection 给块分配带符号质量分，聚合高质量块为纠正目标，强化高质量块、抑制低质量块并把可纠正块重定向过去。后训练过程不需要外部 HIL 纠正，也不需要在线采集数据。
Result: 四个 LIBERO suite 平均成功率 56.2% → 68.2%，比最强被评估离线基线 AWR (62.3%) 高 5.9 个百分点；三个真机任务平均成功率 56.7% → 74.7%；LIBERO-Spatial 上用 1,536 条固定 rollouts 达到 75.8%，被评估的在线方法需要 8.7–16 倍的新鲜后训练 rollouts 才达到同一阈值。
Conclusion: 不同结果的 rollouts 中存在相似状态下的动作块，高质量块可充当局部有支撑的纠正参照，因此固定 rollouts 足以派生动作级修正，离线后训练在样本效率上可大幅超过在线方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fractional Parabolic Partial Differential Equations in Anisotropic Spectral Barron Spaces: Regularity and Neural Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study fractional parabolic initial-value problems with lower-order drift and potential terms in anisotropic spectral Barron spaces, defined by weighted space--time Fourier $L^1$ norms adapted to parabolic scaling. We prove existence, uniqueness, and maximal regularity with a gain of one derivative in time and $γ$ derivatives in space, where $γ>0$ is the order of the fractional Laplacian. The evolution is defined only for $t\geq0$, whereas the finite-time norm requires a global extension with sufficient temporal Fourier decay. We construct a finite reflected semigroup extension using a Vandermonde system to match derivatives at $t=0$, obtaining temporal Fourier estimates uniform in the semigroup parameter. Combined with Fourier multiplier estimates for the damped principal operator, it yields maximal regularity. Dimension-independent multiplication estimates support a finite regularity bootstrap, while interpolation and sufficient damping absorb the lower-order terms in the base estimate. The a priori estimate and the method of continuity yield maximal regularity without smallness assumptions on the lower-order coefficients. A frequency-localized counterexample shows that a uniform-in-time spatial Barron bound on the forcing does not imply the corresponding two-derivative solution bound, even for the one-dimensional heat equation. Using this regularity, Fourier sampling yields $n^{-1/2}$ approximation rates for the solution in mixed space--time Sobolev norms using shallow networks with suitable activations. Sampling in a product Hilbert space yields a population-level PINN consistency estimate for shallow cosine networks on a bounded cylinder. There exists a single width-$n$ network for which the sum of the squared mixed-Sobolev solution error, the squared $L^2$-norm of the residual for the whole-space fractional equation, and the squared initial-data error is $O(n^{-1})$.
papers.comment: 39 pages. Title changed; introduction revised and references updated. Added a population-level PINN consistency estimate
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在各向异性谱 Barron 空间中研究带低阶漂移与势项的分数阶抛物方程，证明时间一阶、空间 γ 阶增益的最大正则性，且低阶系数无需小性假设。由 Fourier 采样得到浅网络在混合时空 Sobolev 范数下 n^{-1/2} 的逼近率，并给出单个宽度 n 网络使解误差、整空间残差与初值误差平方和为 O(n^{-1}) 的 population-level PINN 一致性估计。
Motivation: 分数阶抛物方程的低阶项通常需要小性条件才能控制，且对 forcing 的一致时间 Barron 界不足以推出解的两导数界，这限制了 PINN 正则性分析与逼近率的建立。
Method: 以适配抛物标度的加权时空 Fourier L1 范数定义各向异性谱 Barron 空间；用 Vandermonde 系统构造有限反射半群延拓在 t=0 匹配导数，配合阻尼主算子的 Fourier 乘子估计、维数无关乘法估计与插值/阻尼吸收低阶项，经先验估计与连续性方法得最大正则性；再由 Fourier 采样与乘积 Hilbert 空间采样导出浅网络（含 cosine 网络）逼近与 PINN 一致性。
Result: 最大正则性增益为时间 1 阶、空间 γ 阶（γ 为分数阶 Laplacian 阶数），低阶系数无小性假设；浅网络在混合时空 Sobolev 范数下逼近率 n^{-1/2}；单个宽度 n 网络使解的混合 Sobolev 误差平方、整空间分数阶方程残差 L2 范数平方与初值误差平方之和为 O(n^{-1})；另给出频率局部化反例，说明 forcing 的一致时间空间 Barron 界不蕴含解的两导数界，即使对一维热方程。
Conclusion: 分数阶抛物方程在该 Barron 空间框架下可无小性条件获得最大正则性，并支撑浅网络 n^{-1/2} 逼近与 O(n^{-1}) 的 PINN 一致性；但 forcing 的一致 Barron 界本身不足以控制解的高阶正则性。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Placement Is Free, Composition Is Not: The Latin Square as a Provably-Balanced Construction for Heterogeneous Sequence-Mixer Stacks
papers.abstract_en: Since GPT, most Transformers have repeated the same attention mechanism at every layer. Yet this design is largely a convention rather than a tested conclusion. When multiple sequence mixers are combined in one stack, improvements may arise from mechanism choice, placement, or both, making causal attribution difficult. We introduce Aether-7B-5Attn, a 6.59B-parameter mixture-of-experts model ($\approx$2.98B active) whose 49 layers contain seven sequence-mixing mechanisms arranged as a $7\times7$ Latin square. Because each mechanism appears exactly once in every row and column, the design guarantees balanced exposure across depth while eliminating placement confounds. To evaluate this principle, we build a parameter-matched proxy with four mechanisms arranged as a $4\times4$ Latin square over sixteen layers, matched to 700.9M parameters and trained with eight seeds per arm. The results reveal a clear dissociation. Rearranging a distributed heterogeneous stack into a balanced periodic cycle changes validation loss by only 0.16\%, indicating that exact placement has little effect. In contrast, clustering the same mechanisms into contiguous depth bands incurs a 0.59\% penalty, while replacing the heterogeneous stack with a homogeneous one incurs a 1.68\% penalty. These results indicate that performance depends primarily on heterogeneous composition distributed across depth rather than on any particular permutation. We confirm this finding at 2.16$\times$ larger scale (1.514B parameters), where the homogeneous-stack penalty increases to 2.63\% and removing the SSM-family mechanism produces a 3.20\% degradation. We further report per-mechanism cost profiles, English and Korean evaluations, and a causal-safety audit of all 49 layers. We release model weights, training recipes, training code, logs, and architecture source code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文质疑 Transformer 各层重复同一注意力的惯例，用 Latin square 把 7 种序列混合机制排进 49 层，使每种机制在每行每列恰好出现一次，从而在深度上均衡暴露并消除位置混淆。参数匹配的 4×4 代理实验显示：把异构栈重排为均衡周期循环只改变验证损失 0.16%，聚成连续深度段损失 0.59%，换成同构栈损失 1.68%；在 1.514B 规模上同构惩罚升到 2.63%，去掉 SSM 族机制退化 3.20%。结论是性能主要来自跨深度分布的异构组合，而非具体排列。
Motivation: 自 GPT 以来 Transformer 每层重复同一注意力更多是惯例而非验证过的结论；当多种序列混合机制堆在同一栈里，收益可能来自机制选择、位置或两者，导致因果归因困难。
Method: 提出 Aether-7B-5Attn：6.59B 参数 MoE（约 2.98B 激活），49 层含 7 种序列混合机制，按 7×7 Latin square 排列保证每行每列各出现一次。另建参数匹配代理：4 种机制排成 4×4 Latin square、16 层、700.9M 参数，每臂 8 个随机种子；并做 2.16× 更大规模（1.514B 参数）复现，附各机制开销剖析、英韩评测与 49 层因果安全审计。
Result: 重排为均衡周期循环验证损失仅变 0.16%；聚成连续深度段损失惩罚 0.59%；换成同构栈惩罚 1.68%（700.9M、8 seeds/臂）。在 1.514B 规模上同构惩罚增至 2.63%，移除 SSM 族机制退化 3.20%。
Conclusion: 性能主要取决于跨深度分布的异构组合，而非具体排列顺序；机制选择的代价远大于位置安排，且这一差距随规模扩大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TELLER: Dual-Path Iterative Preference Optimization for Table Entity Linking
papers.abstract_en: Entity linking in tables matches short and ambiguous cell mentions to their corresponding knowledge-base entities. Existing approaches typically rely on data preprocessing pipelines that retain either compact or extensive table content as contextual evidence, and then formulate entity linking as a language generation task for instruction-tuned models; recent systems further incorporate explicit reasoning to disambiguate challenging mentions. However, their training supervision is usually static: fixed preference data cannot adapt to the residual errors of an evolving model, while variations in reasoning length can bias sequence-level preference learning. To address these limitations, we present TELLER: Table Entity Linking through Learning from Errors and Reasoning. We first retrieve and rank Wikidata candidates and retain reduced table evidence in the prompt. The direct-answer path applies iterative direct preference optimization and refreshes its preference data with residual errors from the updated model. The reasoning path uses filtered and compressed chain-of-thought rationales for supervised fine-tuning, followed by our iterative length-normalized regularized preference optimization. On the TableInstruct entity-linking subset, the direct-answer path improves accuracy from 94.35\% to 94.50\%; on the MammoTab V2 evaluation set, it improves accuracy from 87.59\% to 88.20\%. The reasoning path improves accuracy from 92.90\% to 92.95\% on TableInstruct and from 79.09\% to 81.85\% on MammoTab V2, while maintaining high rates of complete reasoning generation. These results show that iterative preference learning benefits both concise entity prediction and explicit reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 21st International Workshop on Ontology Matching (OM 2026), co-located with ISWC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TELLER 把表格实体链接拆成直接作答与显式推理双路径，各自用迭代式偏好优化持续刷新训练信号：直接路径按更新后模型的残差错误重采样偏好数据，推理路径用长度归一化的正则偏好优化。在 TableInstruct 实体链接子集上直接路径准确率 94.35%→94.50%、推理路径 92.90%→92.95%；MammoTab V2 上直接路径 87.59%→88.20%、推理路径 79.09%→81.85%。
Motivation: 现有表格实体链接方法的偏好监督是静态的：固定偏好数据无法跟随模型残差错误更新，而推理长度差异会偏置序列级偏好学习。
Method: 先从 Wikidata 检索并排序候选实体，把精简后的表格证据放进 prompt。直接路径用迭代式 direct preference optimization (DPO)，每轮用更新后模型的残差错误刷新偏好数据；推理路径先对 chain-of-thought 理由做过滤与压缩做监督微调，再用迭代的长度归一化正则偏好优化 (length-normalized regularized preference optimization)。
Result: TableInstruct 实体链接子集：直接路径准确率 94.35%→94.50%，推理路径 92.90%→92.95%。MammoTab V2 评测集：直接路径 87.59%→88.20%，推理路径 79.09%→81.85%，同时保持较高的完整推理生成率。
Conclusion: 迭代式偏好学习同时惠及简洁实体预测与显式推理两种输出形式，且在两个表格实体链接基准上都带来准确率提升。

papers.title: THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 25th International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC 2026), Research Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: THGFM 用双路架构同时解决时序异构图上的跨类型参数高效迁移与关系特化：共享空间时序注意力分支负责跨类型迁移，关系类型分区时序注意力分支负责特化，再用类型条件非竞争门控求和融合，两路可同时被放大或抑制而非零和竞争；相对时间以半相位旋转注入查询与键 (Rotary Temporal Attention)。在学术图基准六任务上平均相对提升 +3.25%，OAG-CS PV 峰值 +12.37%。
Motivation: 时序异构图学习需同时建模跨类型结构异构与交互时序动态，现有方法难以兼顾参数高效的跨类型迁移与关系感知特化，且通常把时间作为注意力核之外的加性特征注入。
Method: 双路架构：Shared-Space Temporal Attention 分支做跨类型迁移，Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention 分支做关系特化，经 Dual-Path Relational–Shared Fusion 融合，具体为 Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Fusion——为共享路与特化路分配独立的、按类型条件化的逐特征门控；另引入 Rotary Temporal Attention，在匹配前按相对时间的半相位旋转 queries 与 keys，把相对时间直接写进注意力分数。
Result: 在学术图基准上一致优于基线 graph transformer：六任务平均增益 +3.25%；单任务峰值相对增益 OAG-CS PV +12.37%、PF-L2 +4.87%、PF-L1 +1.18%；数据集级增益 OGBN-MAG +4.24%、HTAG-ArXiv +3.73%、HTAG-DBLP +4.61%。
Conclusion: 把共享迁移与关系特化拆成两条可独立门控的路径、并把相对时间放进注意力核内部，可在 web-scale 时序异构图上稳定超过基线 graph transformer。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Explicit Layer Modeling for Video Object Insertion and Video Layer Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Most video editing systems still lack explicit layered video representations, limiting realistic compositing, object reuse, and consistent manipulation. This limitation is particularly evident in video object insertion and video layer decomposition, where existing methods lack direct supervision for foreground layers that capture both objects and their associated visual effects. We introduce TriLayer, a triplet video dataset containing aligned composite--background--foreground videos, where the foreground layers include both object appearance and associated visual effects. With aligned triplet supervision, TriLayer enables explicit supervised learning of layered video representations for the first time. Building on this dataset, we propose DBL-Diffusion, a dual-branch diffusion framework that jointly models scene-level RGB content and RGBA foreground layers through cross-branch interaction during denoising. We instantiate the framework in two tasks: DBL-Insert for layered object insertion, which generates explicit RGBA layers for realistic compositing and flexible post-editing, and DBL-Decompose for video layer decomposition, which recovers foreground and background layers using triplet supervision. Experiments demonstrate that explicit layer modeling substantially improves both insertion fidelity and decomposition quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TriLayer 三元组视频数据集（对齐的 composite–background–foreground），使分层视频表示首次获得直接监督；并在此之上提出双分支扩散框架 DBL-Diffusion，在去噪过程中联合建模场景级 RGB 与 RGBA 前景层，实例化为 DBL-Insert（分层物体插入）与 DBL-Decompose（视频层分解）。实验显示显式层建模显著提升插入保真度与分解质量。
Motivation: 多数视频编辑系统缺少显式分层表示，限制了真实合成、物体复用与一致编辑；现有方法对同时包含物体及其视觉效果的前景层缺少直接监督。
Method: 构建 TriLayer 三元组视频数据集，提供对齐的 composite–background–foreground 监督，前景层含物体外观与关联视觉效果；DBL-Diffusion 用双分支在去噪中通过 cross-branch interaction 联合生成场景 RGB 与 RGBA 前景层，分为 DBL-Insert 与 DBL-Decompose 两个任务实例。
Result: 实验表明显式层建模显著改善插入保真度与分解质量；DBL-Insert 输出显式 RGBA 层以支持真实合成与后续编辑，DBL-Decompose 借三元组监督恢复前景与背景层。
Conclusion: 对齐的三元组监督加上双分支扩散联合建模 RGB/RGBA，可让视频编辑系统获得显式分层表示，从而同时改进物体插入与层分解。

papers.title: Variational Boosting for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) solve differential equations by minimizing the residual of a nonlinear operator over a neural parameterization of the solution. However, monolithic PINNs often suffer from ill-conditioning, spectral bias, and optimization instability. We introduce a variational boosting framework in which solutions are constructed additively in function space. Each stage trains a weak learner whose converged correction satisfies a local orthogonality condition, equivalent to a projected functional gradient descent step onto the tangent space of the network's function manifold. Because each correction network is deliberately small, the restricted minimization admits full Newton or conjugate gradient updates, which are typically infeasible in large PINNs. The resulting method separates global nonlinear refinement into a sequence of well-conditioned subproblems while preserving the full variational structure of the operator. This framework provides a geometric interpretation of multi-stage PINNs as projected functional gradient descent and enables stable second-order optimization for nonlinear differential equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PINN 的变分 boosting 框架：在函数空间中加性地逐阶段训练弱学习器，每个收敛的修正网络满足局部正交条件，等价于网络函数流形切空间上的投影函数梯度下降步。由于单个修正网络刻意做小，每个子问题可用完整 Newton 或共轭梯度更新，把全局非线性求精拆成一串良条件子问题，从而为非线性微分方程带来稳定的二阶优化。
Motivation: 单体 PINN 用神经参数化最小化非线性算子残差时，常受病态条件、谱偏置与优化不稳定困扰，大网络上二阶优化通常不可行。
Method: 变分 boosting：逐阶段在函数空间加性构造解，每阶段训练一个弱学习器，其收敛修正满足局部正交条件（等价于投影到网络函数流形切空间的投影函数梯度下降）；修正网络足够小，使受限最小化可做完整 Newton 或 CG 更新，并保留算子的完整变分结构。
Result: 给出多阶段 PINN 的几何解释，即投影函数梯度下降；框架使非线性微分方程上的二阶优化保持稳定。
Conclusion: 把 PINN 的全局非线性求精拆成一串良条件子问题并保留变分结构，是缓解病态与优化不稳定、启用稳定二阶优化的可行路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DualityCert: Verifier-Gated Language-Model Repair of Broken Duality Claims in Quantum Field Theory
papers.abstract_en: We present DualityCert, a symbolic verifier for candidate Seiberg-duality claims in four-dimensional N=1 quiver gauge theories. The verifier evaluates 't Hooft anomaly matching, superpotential R-charge consistency, central-charge matching, and a bounded chiral-ring proxy. A claim that passes receives a consistency certificate, which states that no tested inconsistency was found, not that the duality is proven. We use the verifier as a repair environment for language-model agents, which receive a deliberately broken claim and must edit it until it certifies. On a preregistered benchmark of 145 broken claims, with the analysis fixed before the first confirmatory model call, verifier-gated retry improves final repair success over a single attempt by +8.3 percentage points (pp) on deepseek-chat and +7.1 pp on qwen-plus (Holm-adjusted p<0.002). Under an equal budget of eleven attempts, the stop-first strategy portfolio underperforms independent verifier-filtered resampling by 10.3 percentage points on deepseek-chat but outperforms it by 14.7 points on qwen-plus, reversing the ordering of the two tested verifier-exploitation policies across the two confirmatory models. On qwen-plus, category-level verifier feedback is worth +8.7 pp over content-free retry, and interpretable obligation identities alone are worth +6.4 pp over structurally identical masked feedback. Neither effect is detected on deepseek-chat. Separately, a preregistered MiniMax-M2.5 extension again finds an iteration gain and independent verifier-filtered resampling outperforming the strategy portfolio. Which policy is better thus differs between the two models, while every winning policy uses the same cheap certificate. The verifier, benchmark, protocol, and all per-attempt records are released.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. v2: added reference and note on concurrent related work. v3: added references. Code, benchmark, and all per-attempt records: https://github.com/xingyang-yu/QFTCert
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualityCert 是针对四维 N=1 quiver 规范理论 Seiberg 对偶性声明的符号验证器，检查 't Hooft 反常匹配、超势 R-电荷一致性、中心荷匹配与有界手征环代理，通过则发放“未发现不一致”的一致性证书。在 145 条预注册破损声明上，验证器门控重试比单次尝试提升修复成功率 deepseek-chat +8.3 pp、qwen-plus +7.1 pp（Holm 校正 p<0.002），但两种策略排序在两个模型间反转。
Motivation: 大模型生成的量子场论对偶性声明难以自动判错，需要一个可作修复环境的廉价符号验证器，并检验门控重试与策略组合在不同模型上是否稳定有效。
Method: 符号验证器评估 't Hooft 反常匹配、超势 R-电荷一致性、中心荷匹配与有界手征环代理，通过则发证书；LM agent 在验证器门控下反复编辑破损声明直至通过。预注册 145 条破损声明基准，分析在首次确认性调用前固定，比较单次尝试、stop-first 策略组合与独立验证器过滤重采样，并设 MiniMax-M2.5 扩展。
Result: 验证器门控重试相对单次尝试：deepseek-chat +8.3 pp、qwen-plus +7.1 pp（Holm 校正 p<0.002）。等预算十一次尝试下，stop-first 组合在 deepseek-chat 上落后独立验证器过滤重采样 10.3 pp，在 qwen-plus 上领先 14.7 pp，两个模型排序反转。qwen-plus 上类别级反馈比无内容重试 +8.7 pp，可解释义务标识比结构相同但遮蔽的反馈 +6.4 pp，两者在 deepseek-chat 上均未检出。MiniMax-M2.5 预注册扩展再次出现迭代增益，且独立过滤重采样优于策略组合。

papers.title: Priors learned from legacy reconstructions inherit undetectable overconfidence
papers.abstract_en: Where truths are scarce (e.g., seismic and medical imaging), learned priors in ill-posed inverse problems are trained on archives of legacy reconstructions---i.e., an older method's outputs---and their reported uncertainty is taken as data-driven. We show that this prior is, in the population limit, exactly the regularizer that produced its archive of posterior samples, advanced one expectation--maximization step toward the truth. While the step improves the regularizer on the directions the measurements resolve, it leaves the regularizer's assumption on the operator's blind subspace unchanged. An archive of single-best reconstructions collapses the blind interval to zero width. Neither error is detectable in practice, as truths differing only on the blind subspace share the data law, and simulation-based calibration is neutral by construction. We identify from the operator alone which directions the measurements do not inform, and, given a handful of ground-truth models, build intervals there that contain the truth as often as they claim to. We validate these findings on a two-dimensional example with closed-form predictions and in controlled experiments on seismic-imaging and groundwater-flow operators, against priors trained on the truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用旧方法的重建档案训练出的学习先验，在总体极限下恰是生成该档案的正则化子向前推进一步期望最大化 (EM) 的结果：测量可分辨方向被改进，但算子盲子空间上的假设原封不动，单最优重建档案会把盲区间压到零宽。由于盲子空间上不同的真值共享同一数据律，这种过度自信在实践中不可检测，simulation-based calibration 也按构造呈中性；作者给出仅凭算子识别不受测量约束的方向、再用少量真值模型在这些方向上构造覆盖率达标区间的办法。
Motivation: 地震与医学成像等病态反问题中真值稀缺，学习先验只能在旧方法的重建档案上训练，其报告的不确定性被当作数据驱动的，但这种不确定性在盲子空间上系统性过度自信且无法被常规校准检验发现。
Method: 先在总体极限下把学习先验刻画为生成档案的正则化子推进一步 EM 的等价物，论证盲子空间假设不变；再仅从算子本身识别测量不提供信息的方向，并在给定少量真值模型的条件下于这些方向上构造区间。验证分两部分：一个有闭式预测的二维例子，以及地震成像与地下水流算子上的受控实验，对照在真值上训练的先验。
Result: 单最优重建档案使盲区间宽度塌缩为零；真值仅在盲子空间上不同的数据共享同一数据律，使误差不可检测，simulation-based calibration 按构造呈中性。在二维闭式例子与地震成像、地下水流算子的受控实验中验证上述结论，对照组为在真值上训练的先验；所构造的区间声称的覆盖概率与真值落入频率一致。
Conclusion: 从旧重建档案学到的先验会继承原正则化子在盲子空间上的假设，其不确定性报告因此不可检测地过度自信；要得到诚实区间，必须显式识别测量不约束的方向并在那里用少量真值重建校准。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Flash EQ-Linear: Accelerating Equivariant Linear Layers via Group-wise Discrete Fourier Transform
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant networks embed geometric symmetries as structural priors through weight sharing, achieving remarkable parameter efficiency across vision tasks. However, this parameter efficiency does not translate into compute efficiency: most existing implementations unroll the structured weights into dense matrices and dispatch them to generic dense kernels, so an equivariant layer costs no fewer MACs than its non-equivariant counterpart. In this paper, we observe that the equivariant linear (EQ-Linear) layer---the most fundamental and frequently used module in modern equivariant architectures---is essentially a circular convolution along the group dimension composed with a linear transform along the channel dimension. Building on this observation, we propose Flash EQ-Linear, an exact acceleration algorithm that reduces the cost to $2(T-1)/T^2$ of the original dense formulation ($T$ is the equivariant group size) by combining the Fourier convolution theorem along the group dimension with the conjugate symmetry of the real DFT. To translate these computational savings into wall-clock speedups, we further develop dedicated CUDA kernels for the $\mathrm{p}4$ group. At the operator level, Flash EQ-Linear achieves up to $2.1\times$ forward speedup over PyTorch's highly optimized F.linear; at the network level, Flash EQ-ViT achieves up to ${1.7\times}$ end-to-end speedup over both equivariant and non-equivariant baselines. As an operator-level acceleration algorithm, Flash EQ-Linear provides plug-and-play acceleration for diverse pretrained equivariant models, including EQ-ViT, EQ-Swin, EQ-VMamba, and EQ-INR, without retraining or architectural changes. Code is available at https://github.com/zhongchenzhao/FlashEQLinear.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flash EQ-Linear 把等变线性层重写为群维度上的循环卷积与通道维度上线性变换的组合，用群维 Fourier 卷积定理与实 DFT 共轭对称性做精确加速，把稠密实现的代价降到 2(T-1)/T²（T 为群大小）。为 p4 群写专用 CUDA kernel 后，算子级前向相对 PyTorch F.linear 最高 2.1× 加速，EQ-ViT 端到端最高 1.7×，可免重训即插即用于 EQ-ViT、EQ-Swin、EQ-VMamba、EQ-INR。
Motivation: 等变网络靠权重共享获得参数效率，但现有实现把结构化权重展开成稠密矩阵交给通用稠密 kernel，等变层的 MACs 并不比非等变层少，参数效率没有换成计算效率。
Method: 观察到 EQ-Linear 层本质是群维度上的循环卷积与通道维度上线性变换的复合；结合群维 Fourier 卷积定理与实 DFT 共轭对称性给出精确加速算法，理论代价为原稠密形式的 2(T-1)/T²；并为 p4 群开发专用 CUDA kernel 把节省转成 wall-clock 加速。
Result: 算子级相对 PyTorch F.linear 前向最高 2.1× 加速；网络级 Flash EQ-ViT 端到端相对等变与非等变基线最高 1.7× 加速；理论计算代价降至稠密形式的 2(T-1)/T²。
Conclusion: EQ-Linear 的群维结构可用 Fourier 方法无损利用，加速是精确的、即插即用的，对已训练好的 EQ-ViT、EQ-Swin、EQ-VMamba、EQ-INR 无需重训或改结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interaction Dynamics Modeling and Predictive Control for Safe Steerable Catheter--Tissue Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Steerable catheters are the primary tool for cardiac electrophysiology (EP) procedures including radiofrequency ablation, where the tip must be positioned precisely at target tissue while maintaining controlled, stable contact. The central control problem is therefore not merely tip tracking and not merely force regulation; it is the regulation of \emph{catheter--tissue interaction dynamics}. The interaction state must encode how the tip moves relative to tissue, how persistent friction and contact forces bias that motion, and how safety limits reshape what motion is physically allowable. Existing methods regulate these interaction dynamics through different mechanisms. Classical impedance control~\cite{hogan1985} shapes the tip port as a virtual mechanical impedance $Z(s) = M_d s^2 + D_d s + K_d$, providing passive compliance without an explicit contact model. Three complementary design requirements motivate the present formulation: \textbf{(i)}~an explicit force-related constraint, \textbf{(ii)}~compensation for steady error under persistent loading, and \textbf{(iii)}~a prediction model that can incorporate trajectory and actuator information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向心脏电生理 (EP) 消融中的可操控导管，提出把导管-组织交互动力学本身作为被控对象的预测控制框架：交互状态同时编码尖端相对组织的运动、持续摩擦与接触力对运动的偏置，以及安全极限对可允许运动的重塑。该框架按三条设计要求组织——显式力约束、持续负载下的稳态误差补偿、可纳入轨迹与执行器信息的预测模型——区别于只做尖端跟踪或只做力调节的方案。
Motivation: 导管尖端既要精确到达目标组织又要保持受控稳定接触，单纯跟踪或单纯力调节都无法表示交互状态；经典阻抗控制只提供被动柔顺性而没有显式接触模型，缺少力约束与稳态误差补偿。
Method: 以导管-组织交互动力学为显式建模与控制对象，交互状态包含尖端相对组织运动、持续摩擦与接触力偏置、安全极限约束；对照经典阻抗控制 Z(s)=M_d s^2+D_d s+K_d 的虚拟机械阻抗形式，按三条设计要求构造预测控制：显式力相关约束、针对持续负载的稳态误差补偿、可融合轨迹与执行器信息的预测模型。
Result: 摘要给出的是问题定义与设计要求层面的表述：交互状态需同时刻画相对运动、摩擦/接触力偏置与安全极限；三条设计要求为显式力约束、稳态误差补偿、含轨迹与执行器信息的预测模型；并指出经典阻抗控制 Z(s)=M_d s^2+D_d s+K_d 只提供被动柔顺性而无显式接触模型。
Conclusion: 导管消融的核心控制问题应表述为调节导管-组织交互动力学，而非单纯的尖端跟踪或力调节，且需要在预测控制中同时内嵌力约束、稳态误差补偿与轨迹/执行器信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOPDA: Mixed-Trajectory On-Policy Distillation for Language-Guided Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for industrial anomaly detection (IAD) by providing image-level anomaly judgments and interpretable reasoning. However, reliably translating generated judgments into precise pixel-level localization remains challenging. We propose \textbf{M}ixed-Trajectory \textbf{O}n-\textbf{P}olicy \textbf{D}istillation for Language-Guided Industrial \textbf{A}nomaly Detection (MOPDA), the first framework to introduce on-policy self-distillation into LVLM-based IAD. For judgment learning, \method introduces \textbf{Mixed-Trajectory Supervision}, combining student-generated on-policy trajectories with evidence-conditioned teacher trajectories under a shared token-level distillation objective. Student trajectories preserve supervision on deployment-relevant response paths, while teacher trajectories provide complementary evidence-conditioned supervision. For dense localization, \textbf{Language-guided Visual Anchoring} uses the final judgment as a compact semantic condition to construct image-specific normal and abnormal anchors, which are contrasted with dense visual features to produce anomaly maps. This keeps language as semantic guidance while grounding pixel-level responses in visual evidence. Under a strict cross-dataset zero-shot protocol on five IAD benchmarks, \method outperforms the evaluated LVLM-based baselines on most detection, localization, and judgment metrics while remaining competitive with CLIP-based methods. Ablations further validate both mixed-trajectory supervision and final-judgment conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOPDA 把 on-policy 自蒸馏引入 LVLM 工业异常检测 (IAD)：用学生自生成轨迹与证据条件化教师轨迹的混合轨迹监督做 token 级蒸馏，再以最终判断作为语义条件构造图像级正常/异常 anchor 生成像素级异常图。在五个 IAD 基准的严格跨数据集 zero-shot 协议下，多数检测、定位与判断指标上超过所评估的 LVLM 基线，并与基于 CLIP 的方法保持竞争力。
Motivation: LVLM 能给出图像级异常判断与可解释推理，但把生成的判断可靠地转成精确的像素级定位仍然困难。
Method: MOPDA 含两部分：Mixed-Trajectory Supervision 在共享 token 级蒸馏目标下混合学生 on-policy 轨迹与证据条件化教师轨迹；Language-guided Visual Anchoring 以最终判断为紧凑语义条件，构造图像专属的 normal/abnormal anchor，与稠密视觉特征对比得到异常图，使语言只作语义引导而像素响应落在视觉证据上。
Result: 在五个 IAD 基准的严格跨数据集 zero-shot 协议下，MOPDA 在多数检测、定位与判断指标上优于所评估的 LVLM 基线，同时与基于 CLIP 的方法保持竞争力；消融实验支持混合轨迹监督与最终判断条件化两个组件。
Conclusion: 把 on-policy 自蒸馏与语言引导的视觉 anchor 结合，可以让 LVLM 的判断更可靠地落到像素级异常定位，并在跨数据集 zero-shot 设定下胜过所测 LVLM 基线。

papers.title: SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models have emerged as a powerful planning paradigm by learning action-conditioned predictive dynamics and using them as internal simulators to imagine and evaluate candidate action sequences. However, as the planning horizon grows, performance becomes increasingly constrained by proposal quality: a fixed candidate budget must search an exponentially larger action space, making it difficult to expose the world model to high-quality candidate futures for evaluation. In this paper, we introduce SAGE, a prior-conditioned planner that replaces random proposal initialization with structured guidance. At each planning stage, a goal-conditioned generator predicts the next intermediate latent subgoal for a specified duration, which is then used to condition the generation of candidate action sequences. To capture semantic information across temporal scales, we use subgoals of varying durations as priors, balancing fine-grained local control with higher-level long-horizon progress. Then the frozen world model evaluates these proposals against the same subgoal and guides their refinement before execution. Experiments on PushT and OGBench Cube show that coupling latent subgoal decomposition with prior-conditioned action generation substantially improves long-horizon planning while preserving strong short-horizon performance. To be specific, when the target offset is $150$, it raises PushT success from $4.7\%$ to $64.7\%$ and OGBench Cube success from $20.7\%$ to $67.3\%$. We further extend latent world-model planning to LIBERO, where SAGE improves full-episode success from $0\%$ with the vanilla LeWM planner to $48.7\%$ on Scene2 and $58\%$ on Caddy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 用目标条件生成器在每个规划阶段预测指定时长的中间 latent 子目标，再以此为先验条件生成候选动作序列，替代随机提议初始化；冻结的 world model 用同一子目标评估并精炼这些提议。在 PushT 目标偏移 150 时成功率从 4.7% 升到 64.7%，OGBench Cube 从 20.7% 升到 67.3%，长程规划大幅提升且短程性能保持。
Motivation: latent world model 规划随 horizon 增长被提议质量卡住：固定候选预算要搜索指数增长的动作空间，world model 很难见到高质量候选未来。
Method: SAGE 是 prior-conditioned planner：goal-conditioned generator 预测指定时长的中间 latent 子目标，用不同时长的子目标作先验以兼顾局部控制与长程进展，再由冻结的 world model 对候选动作序列按同一子目标评估并引导精炼后执行。
Result: PushT 目标偏移 150 时成功率 4.7% → 64.7%，OGBench Cube 20.7% → 67.3%；扩展到 LIBERO 后 full-episode 成功率从 vanilla LeWM 的 0% 提到 Scene2 48.7%、Caddy 58%。
Conclusion: 把 latent 子目标分解与先验条件动作生成耦合起来，能在保持短程性能的同时大幅改善长程规划，且可迁移到 LIBERO 这类更长任务。

papers.title: Semantically Similar, Yet Not Answerable: Diagnosing the Semantic-Answerability Gap in Table RAG
papers.abstract_en: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic relevance asks whether a source matches a query in meaning, while answerability asks whether it contains sufficient information to answer the query. A Semantic-Answerability Gap (SAG) may arise in retrieval when a retriever can reach semantically relevant sources yet fail to identify those that are uniquely answerable. We uncover this gap using tables as a controlled setting, where shared schemas and entities provide strong semantic signals while localized content and row-column bindings distinguish answerable from non-answerable sources. Using TCR-Bench, a controlled sibling-table benchmark, we find that dense retrievers achieve only 18.2% top-1 target retrieval, reducing QA F1 from 0.755 with the oracle table to 0.330 with retrieved top-5 tables. Controlled diagnostics show that retrievers favor semantic volume over sufficiency, respond weakly to row-column binding disruptions, and struggle to distinguish Targets from Siblings. Explicit answerability assessment substantially improves target identification, while fine-tuning shows that answerability is learnable but difficult to transfer without compromising broad semantic retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格 RAG 中提出语义-可答性鸿沟 (Semantic-Answerability Gap, SAG)：检索器能命中语义相关源，却分不出唯一可答的那张表。用受控同胞表基准 TCR-Bench 诊断显示，dense retriever 的 top-1 目标表检索仅 18.2%，QA F1 从 oracle 表的 0.755 跌到检索 top-5 表的 0.330；显式可答性评估能显著改善目标识别，但微调学到的可答性难以在不损害广义语义检索的前提下迁移。
Motivation: RAG 中语义相关不等于可答：共享 schema 与实体给出强语义信号，而可答性取决于局部内容与行-列绑定，检索器容易命中相似却答不出的源。
Method: 以表格为受控场景构建 TCR-Bench（sibling-table 基准，共享 schema/实体、内容局部化并区分 Target 与 Sibling），对 dense retriever 做受控诊断（语义体量 vs 充分性、行-列绑定扰动、Target/Sibling 区分），并测试显式可答性评估与微调。
Result: dense retriever top-1 目标表检索仅 18.2%；QA F1 从 oracle 表 0.755 降至检索 top-5 表 0.330。诊断显示检索器偏好语义体量而非充分性，对行-列绑定扰动响应弱，难以区分 Target 与 Sibling；显式可答性评估显著改善目标识别，微调表明可答性可学但难以在不损害广义语义检索的情况下迁移。
Conclusion: 语义相似不等于可答是表格 RAG 检索的系统性缺口，需要显式建模可答性，而不能只靠语义相关性或直接微调。

papers.title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) on robot demonstrations via behavior cloning (BC) has become the standard recipe for vision-language-action (VLA) policies. However, BC finetuning progressively overwrites the pretrained representations that support visual and semantic generalization. Co-training on web image-text data, a common remedy, applies language and action losses to separate observations, leaving VLAs with language-action misalignment that standard manipulation benchmarks do not expose. We propose Anchor-Align, which augments BC with two objectives: Vision-Language Anchoring distills layer-wise representations from a frozen VLM copy to prevent this drift, while Language-Action Alignment converts each action target into a discrete motion-direction label and jointly trains language and action prediction on the same robot observation. We conduct real-world evaluations across eight manipulation settings on single-arm xArm7 and bimanual YAM robots, using two VLA architectures with regression and flow-matching action heads. Across these settings, Anchor-Align consistently improves over BC on novel targets, layouts, and motion-sensitive bimanual tasks requiring coordinated control. At scale in simulation, we demonstrate consistent improvements on OOD perturbations, perceptual robustness, and long-horizon control across LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN, respectively, suggesting that preserving pretrained representations and effective action learning are not fundamentally at odds. Project page: anchoralignvla.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Anchor-Align 用两个附加目标修补 VLA 的 BC 微调：Vision-Language Anchoring 从冻结 VLM 副本逐层蒸馏表征以阻止预训练表征漂移，Language-Action Alignment 把动作目标转成离散运动方向标签、在同一机器人观测上联合训练语言与动作预测。在八个真实操作场景（单臂 xArm7 与双臂 YAM，两种 VLA 架构、回归与 flow-matching 动作头）上，它在新目标、新布局和需协调控制的运动敏感双臂任务上一致优于 BC；仿真大规模实验在 LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN 上分别在 OOD 扰动、感知鲁棒性、长程控制上一致改进。
Motivation: BC 微调会逐步覆盖支撑视觉与语义泛化的预训练表征；常见的网页图文数据共训把语言损失和动作损失加在不同观测上，留下标准操作基准暴露不出来的语言-动作错位。
Method: 在 BC 之上加两个目标：Vision-Language Anchoring 对冻结 VLM 副本做逐层表征蒸馏以抑制漂移；Language-Action Alignment 将每个动作目标离散化为运动方向标签，在同一机器人观测上联合训练语言预测与动作预测。评测覆盖两种 VLA 架构与回归、flow-matching 两类动作头。
Result: 真实世界八个操作场景（xArm7 单臂、YAM 双臂）中，Anchor-Align 在新目标、新布局与运动敏感双臂协调任务上一致优于 BC；仿真大规模实验在 LIBERO-PRO（OOD 扰动）、LIBERO-Plus（感知鲁棒性）、CALVIN（长程控制）上分别取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 保留预训练表征与有效的动作学习并不根本冲突，锚定表征并对齐语言-动作可同时改善 VLA 的泛化与鲁棒性。

papers.title: UniMedSeg: Unified In-Context Learning for Multi-Paradigm 2D/3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation foundation models are expected to generalize across diverse clinical scenarios, yet existing universal methods remain fragmented by prompt paradigms and spatial dimensions. Visual in-context learning, interactive segmentation, and language-guided segmentation are typically handled by paradigm-specific models, while 2D and 3D images are also modeled separately. Such isolation prevents heterogeneous annotations and data from being jointly absorbed by a single scalable model and limits cross-paradigm knowledge transfer. To address this bottleneck, we propose UniMedSeg, a Transformer-centric universal segmentation framework that maps visual examples, geometric interactions, language instructions, and 2D/3D images into a shared sequence space, enabling heterogeneous medical supervision to be jointly learned through a unified in-context interface without prompt- or dimension-specific branches. To overcome the long-sequence memory bottleneck caused by visual contexts, we introduce Decoupled Split Attention, which reduces attention complexity to linear while preserving hardware-friendly computation and focused context-target interaction. Extensively trained and evaluated on a large corpus curated from 27 public datasets, UniMedSeg achieves state-of-the-art performance across visual in-context, interactive, and language-guided segmentation without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization on diverse held-out tasks. The code and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/Lii1228/UniMedSeg
papers.comment: Withdrawn because the manuscript inadvertently used a publisher-specific journal template before acceptance, which may raise copyright and publishing-policy concerns. We will replace it with a neutral preprint format in accordance with standard academic publishing practice
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniMedSeg 把视觉示例、几何交互、语言指令与 2D/3D 医学图像统一映射到共享序列空间，用单一 in-context 接口同时处理三种分割范式，无需 prompt 或维度专属分支。其 Decoupled Split Attention 把注意力复杂度降到线性，在 27 个公开数据集构成的语料上训练后，无需任务微调即在视觉 in-context、交互式与语言引导分割上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有医学图像通用分割模型被 prompt 范式与空间维度割裂：视觉 in-context、交互式、语言引导各自独立建模，2D 与 3D 也分开处理，导致异构标注与数据无法被单一可扩展模型联合吸收，跨范式知识迁移受限。
Method: Transformer 架构的 UniMedSeg 将视觉示例、几何交互、语言指令和 2D/3D 图像编码进共享序列空间，通过统一 in-context 接口联合学习异构医学监督；针对视觉上下文带来的长序列显存瓶颈，引入 Decoupled Split Attention，把注意力复杂度降为线性，同时保持硬件友好的计算与聚焦的 context-target 交互。
Result: 在由 27 个公开数据集整理的大规模语料上训练与评测，UniMedSeg 在视觉 in-context、交互式与语言引导三类分割上均达到 state-of-the-art，且不做任务专属微调，在多样 held-out 任务上表现出强泛化。
Conclusion: 医学图像分割可以靠共享序列空间与线性复杂度注意力统一到单一模型，跨范式与跨维度的联合训练在无需微调的条件下即可覆盖多种临床分割场景。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 在由 27 个公开数据集整理的大规模语料上训练与评测，UniMedSeg 在视觉 in-context、交互式与语言引导三类分割上均达到 state-of-the-art，且不做任务专属微调，在多样 held-out 任务上表现出强泛化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 医学图像分割可以靠共享序列空间与线性复杂度注意力统一到单一模型，跨范式与跨维度的联合训练在无需微调的条件下即可覆盖多种临床分割场景。

papers.title: Diversified Multinomial Logit Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Existing contextual multinomial logit (MNL) bandits model relevance-driven choice but ignore the potential benefits of within-assortment diversity, while submodular/combinatorial bandits encode diversity in rewards but lack structured choice probabilities. We bridge this gap with the $\textit{diversified multinomial logit}$ (DMNL) contextual bandit, which augments MNL choice probabilities with a generally submodular diversity function, thereby formalizing the relevance--diversity trade-off within a single model. Incorporating diversity renders exact MNL assortment optimization intractable. We propose a $\textit{white-box}$ UCB-based algorithm, $\texttt{OFU-DMNL}$, that constructs assortments item-wise by maximizing optimistic marginal gains, avoids black-box optimization oracles. We show that $\texttt{OFU-DMNL}$ achieves at least a $(1-\frac{1}{e+1})$-$\textit{approximate}$ regret bound $\tilde{O}\left(d \sqrt{T/K}\right)$, where $d$ is the context dimension, $K$ the maximum assortment size, and $T$ the horizon, and attains an improved approximation factor over standard submodular baselines. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains and, relative to exhaustive enumeration, comparable regret with substantially lower runtime. Overall, DMNL bandits provide a practical foundation for diversity-aware assortment optimization under uncertainty, and $\texttt{OFU-DMNL}$ offers a statistically and computationally efficient solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把次模多样性函数 (submodular diversity) 直接加进 contextual MNL 选择概率，得到 DMNL bandit，并提出白盒 UCB 算法 OFU-DMNL，逐物品最大化乐观边际增益来构造 assortment。其 regret 至少达到 (1-1/(e+1)) 近似因子下的 Õ(d√(T/K))，近似因子优于标准次模基线；实验中相对穷举枚举 regret 相当但运行时间大幅降低。
Motivation: 现有 contextual MNL bandit 只建模相关性驱动的选择、忽略 assortment 内部多样性，而次模/组合 bandit 虽编码多样性却缺少结构化选择概率，两者无法在同一模型里权衡 relevance 与 diversity。
Method: DMNL 在 MNL 选择概率上叠加一般次模多样性函数；由于精确 assortment 优化因此变为难解，OFU-DMNL 用 UCB 乐观界逐物品最大化边际增益来构造 assortment，不依赖黑盒优化 oracle。
Result: regret 至少为 (1-1/(e+1)) 近似因子下的 Õ(d√(T/K))（d 为上下文维度，K 为最大 assortment 大小，T 为时域），近似因子优于标准次模基线；实验显示稳定增益，且相对穷举枚举 regret 相当而运行时间显著更低。
Conclusion: 在不确定性下的 diversity-aware assortment 优化中，把多样性写进选择概率并用白盒逐物品乐观优化，可同时拿到统计效率与计算效率。

papers.title: Slot-RAE: Streamlining Object-Centric Learning via Direct Representation Auto-Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Deploying object-centric models for real-world scene understanding typically requires complex pipelines to achieve both robust scene decomposition and high-fidelity generation. Recent diffusion-based approaches have improved visual quality, but they almost universally rely on heavy, pretrained generative priors (e.g., Stable Diffusion) and external VAE latent spaces. In this paper, we propose Slot-RAE, a much simpler, fully integrated framework that operates directly within the continuous semantic feature space of visual foundation models (e.g., DINOv3). Slot-RAE employs a feature-space diffusion process using a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) decoder and a Representation Alignment (REPA) head. Unlike existing diffusion-based objectcentric methods that rely heavily on subsidized text-toimage priors, the generative core of Slot-RAE (Slot Attention and the DiT) is trained from scratch within the frozen VFM feature space. This eliminates the need for VAE bottlenecks and task-agnostic generative pre-training. Experiments on the COCO dataset demonstrate that despite its architectural simplicity, Slot-RAE achieves state-of-the-art results. It delivers comparable unsupervised object discovery, higher-fidelity image reconstruction, and robust zero-shot compositionality, all while being significantly faster and more computationally efficient than existing object-centric latent diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Slot-RAE 把物体中心学习 (object-centric learning) 直接搬进视觉基础模型（如 DINOv3）的连续语义特征空间，用 Slot Attention 加 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 解码器与 Representation Alignment (REPA) 头做特征空间扩散，生成核心从零训练。在 COCO 上取得 SOTA：无监督物体发现相当、图像重建保真度更高、零样本组合性稳健，且比现有物体中心潜空间扩散模型更快更省算力。
Motivation: 现有扩散式物体中心方法要同时做好场景分解与高保真生成，几乎都依赖沉重的预训练生成先验（Stable Diffusion）和外部 VAE 潜空间，管线复杂且算力开销大。
Method: 在冻结的 VFM 特征空间内运行特征空间扩散：Slot Attention 负责分解，DiT 解码器做生成，REPA 头对齐表示；生成核心从零训练，去掉 VAE bottleneck 与任务无关的生成预训练。
Result: 在 COCO 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art：无监督物体发现表现相当，图像重建保真度更高，零样本组合性稳健，同时显著快于并低于现有物体中心潜空间扩散模型的计算开销。
Conclusion: 不依赖文本到图像先验与外部 VAE，仅靠冻结 VFM 特征空间内的从零训练生成核心，也能同时拿到物体发现、重建质量与效率，架构简单性不构成性能代价。

papers.title: Source-Lifted Flow Matching for Intervenable Multimodal Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching policies are promising for imitation learning because they model complex multimodal action distributions. However, their stochasticity is largely passive: repeated sampling may yield diverse behaviors, but users cannot directly choose among valid continuations from the same state. We propose Source-Lifted Flow Matching (SL-FM), a source-intervenable flow-matching policy that exposes such a handle while keeping the velocity field shared and latent-free (without a separate discrete-handle input). The handle selects only the source endpoint of the conditional flow, not a mode-specific field, preserving the standard formulation while avoiding decomposition into separate mode-conditioned dynamics. The core mechanism is Orthogonal Source Lifting, designed to prevent path-crossing ambiguity. Instead of partitioning target actions by mode, SL-FM lifts handle-specific sources into auxiliary orthogonal coordinates and keeps targets in the original action subspace. This preserves the demonstrated action distribution while allowing one shared field to carry different branches without merging at crossings. To keep handles usable across states, we learn a state-dependent source mixture end to end and use a responsibility floor, giving each handle weak supervision and mitigating dead modes. Experiments on crossing-flow diagnostics and robot-control benchmarks show that SL-FM converts passive source randomness into an actionable intervention variable. It removes crossing-induced composite trajectories, changes future routes in 91.1% of matched-prefix interventions, and achieves strong free-deployment performance, with improvements in several benchmark settings. Overall, source geometry provides actionable multimodal control without conditioning the velocity field on the selected mode.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. Updated manuscript and author list
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SL-FM 把 flow-matching 策略的随机源点变成可干预的 handle：用 Orthogonal Source Lifting 把各 handle 的源点抬升到辅助正交坐标、目标动作仍留在原动作子空间，共享速度场不依赖 mode 条件。它消除了路径交叉产生的复合轨迹，在 matched-prefix 干预中 91.1% 的情况下改变了未来路线。
Motivation: 模仿学习的 flow-matching 策略能建模多模态动作分布，但其随机性是被动的：同一状态下的多个合法延续无法由用户主动选择，且条件流在交叉点会合并分支。
Method: 核心是 Orthogonal Source Lifting：handle 只选择条件流的源端点而非 mode 专属速度场，把 handle 对应源点抬升到辅助正交坐标、目标保持原动作子空间；再端到端学习 state-dependent source mixture 并加 responsibility floor，为每个 handle 提供弱监督以缓解 dead modes。
Result: 在 crossing-flow 诊断与机器人控制 benchmark 上，SL-FM 消除了交叉导致的复合轨迹，matched-prefix 干预中 91.1% 改变未来路线，并在多个 benchmark 设置上取得提升的 free-deployment 表现。
Conclusion: 源点几何本身即可提供可操作的多模态控制：无需让速度场以所选 mode 为条件，也能把被动随机性转成用户可调的干预变量。

papers.title: How LLM Task-Adaptation Reshapes Alignment: A Multi-dimensional Study of Behavioral and Representational Drift
papers.abstract_en: Post-training is a key mechanism for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. While prior work suggests that task adaptation can alter a model's pre-existing alignment, especially its safety behavior, its broader effects across alignment domains remain poorly understood. We address this gap through a systematic evaluation of representative task-adaptation methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), KL-regularized SFT, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) across 15 alignment aspects spanning six key domains: safety, factuality, stance stability, social harm, controllability, and instructability. Our results reveal that post-training does not reshape alignment uniformly. RLVR improves task performance while inducing comparatively small, but non-zero, metric-specific shifts, while SFT leads to substantially larger alignment drift across domains. KL regularization mitigates this effect: stronger reference-model anchoring reduces alignment drift from the baseline, although KL-SFT still falls short of RLVR in preserving alignment. Representation-level analysis further supports this pattern, with shifts in alignment-relevant representations tracking behavioral drift. Together, these results show that task adaptation is not merely a capability-improving step, but an alignment intervention in its own right, motivating multi-dimensional alignment evaluation as a standard component of post-training pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统比较 SFT、KL 正则化 SFT 与 RLVR 三种任务适配方法在 15 个对齐维度上的行为与表征漂移：RLVR 在提升任务性能的同时只引起较小但非零的指标级偏移，SFT 导致跨域大幅对齐漂移，KL 正则化可随锚定强度增强而减小漂移但仍不及 RLVR。结论是任务适配本身就是一种对齐干预，后训练管线应标配多维对齐评估。
Motivation: 既有工作只指出任务适配会改变模型既有的安全对齐行为，但其在安全、事实性、立场稳定性等多个对齐域上的整体影响仍不清楚，缺少系统性的多维评估。
Method: 对 SFT、KL-regularized SFT、RLVR 三类任务适配方法做系统评测，覆盖安全、事实性、立场稳定性、社会危害、可控性、可指令性六个域共 15 个对齐方面；同时做表征层分析，检查对齐相关表征的偏移是否与行为漂移一致。
Result: RLVR 提升任务性能同时只带来较小但非零的指标级偏移；SFT 在多个域上造成显著更大的对齐漂移；KL 正则化减弱该效应，参考模型锚定越强、相对基线的漂移越小，但 KL-SFT 在保持对齐上仍不及 RLVR；表征层偏移与行为漂移方向一致。
Conclusion: 任务适配不只是能力提升步骤，本身就是一种对齐干预，因此多维对齐评估应成为后训练管线的标准环节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs are increasingly deployed in long-context applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, repository-level coding, and agentic workflows whose accumulated reasoning and tool traces routinely push the input an order of magnitude past the pretraining window, making zero-shot context extension the dominant deployment path for open-weight checkpoints. The dominant zero-shot methods (YaRN, Self-Extend, DCA) fix a single rescaling factor up front, so an aggressive factor sacrifices short-context fidelity while a conservative one breaks down at long contexts; recent length-aware variants adapt the mapping, but with a fitted or distance-dependent schedule. We propose Jet-Long, a tuning-free zero-shot method that pairs a local RoPE-faithful window with a long-range window whose rescaling factor adapts dynamically to the current sequence length via a parameter-free analytic schedule, recovering the base model exactly at short inputs while extrapolating cleanly at long ones. An inclusion-exclusion attention merge and on-the-fly RoPE correction enable a fused CuTe implementation. On H100 at 64K-128K, prefill retains 83-88% of FlashAttention-3 throughput across the evaluated Qwen3 sizes and 88-93% of a matched CuTe control; Qwen3-8B single-batch generation reaches 1.04-1.08 times FlashAttention-3 throughput. On Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B up to 128K context, Jet-Long leads RULER by +4.79/+2.18/+2.03 percentage points over the strongest baseline at 1.7B/4B/8B, achieves the best overall accuracy on HELMET-RAG (a benchmark identified by HELMET as the most efficient predictor of downstream long-context performance) and attains the lowest PG-19 perplexity. Additional evaluations cover Meta-Llama-3-8B, post-trained Qwen3 checkpoints, and the hybrid Jet-Nemotron architecture, supporting broader applicability without retraining. The local-window hyperparameter remains robust across the tested settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jet-Long 是面向 LLM 长上下文扩展的免调参零样本方法：局部窗口严格保持 RoPE，长程窗口的重缩放因子随序列长度按无参数解析调度动态调整，短输入精确还原基线模型、长输入干净外推。在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 至 128K 上，RULER 领先最强基线 +4.79/+2.18/+2.03 个百分点，H100 上 64K-128K prefill 保留 FlashAttention-3 吞吐的 83-88%。
Motivation: YaRN、Self-Extend、DCA 等主流零样本扩展方法预先固定单一重缩放因子：激进因子损害短上下文保真，保守因子在长上下文失效；已有的 length-aware 变体仍依赖拟合或距离相关调度。
Method: 将局部 RoFaithful 窗口与长程窗口配对，长程重缩放因子经无参数解析调度随当前序列长度动态变化；用 inclusion-exclusion attention merge 与 on-the-fly RoPE correction 实现融合 CuTe kernel。
Result: H100 上 64K-128K prefill 保留 FlashAttention-3 吞吐的 83-88%（Qwen3 各尺寸）及匹配 CuTe 对照的 88-93%；Qwen3-8B 单批生成达 FlashAttention-3 吞吐的 1.04-1.08 倍。Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 至 128K 上 RULER 分别领先最强基线 +4.79/+2.18/+2.03 个百分点，HELMET-RAG 取得最佳总体准确率，PG-19 perplexity 最低；另评估 Meta-Llama-3-8B、后训练 Qwen3 与混合 Jet-Nemotron 架构，局部窗口超参在所测设置下稳健。
Conclusion: 用动态解析调度替代固定重缩放因子，可在免调参、不重训的前提下同时保住短上下文保真与长上下文外推，并把吞吐维持在 FlashAttention-3 量级。

papers.title: Higher-Order Geometric Updates for Levenberg-Marquardt Method via Riemann Normal Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear least-squares objectives form the foundation of scientific machine-learning tasks, yet even curvature-aware optimizers remain geometrically inconsistent at finite step sizes: Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) derives its direction from local Riemannian metrics but realizes it as a straight parameter update. Here we introduce RNC-LM, which carries the LM direction along a locally constructed curved trajectory in Riemann normal coordinates. A recursive reformulation of the geodesic equation generates arbitrary finite-order corrections while reusing the same damped Gauss-Newton matrix factorization, and curve length is controlled separately from damping. On a reaction-diffusion physics-informed neural network benchmark, RNC-LM reduces relative $L^2$ errors below $8\times10^{-3}$, whereas L-BFGS, LM and LM with geodesic acceleration remain near one. On a large-scale machine-learning potential fitting task with 985,160 configurations, fourth-order RNC-LM reaches a fixed training-error target with a $34\times$ wall-clock speedup over LM. These results establish finite-step geometric realization as a distinct optimizer design principle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RNC-LM 把 Levenberg-Marquardt 的下降方向沿 Riemann normal coordinates 中的局部测地曲线实现，而非直接直线更新参数，从而在有限步长下保持几何一致性。在反应-扩散 PINN 基准上相对 L2 误差降到 8×10⁻³ 以下（L-BFGS、LM、带 geodesic acceleration 的 LM 仍在 1 附近），在含 985,160 个构型的机器学习势拟合上四阶 RNC-LM 达到固定训练误差目标比 LM 快 34 倍。
Motivation: 非线性最小二乘是科学机器学习的核心目标，但曲率感知优化器在有限步长下几何不自洽：LM 用局部 Riemann 度量定方向，却以直线参数更新实现该方向。
Method: RNC-LM 沿 Riemann normal coordinates 中局部构造的曲线轨迹实现 LM 方向；对测地线方程做递归改写，得到任意有限阶修正，同时复用同一份阻尼 Gauss-Newton 矩阵分解，曲线长度与阻尼分开控制。
Result: 在反应-扩散 physics-informed neural network 基准上，RNC-LM 相对 L2 误差降至 8×10⁻³ 以下，而 L-BFGS、LM、LM with geodesic acceleration 仍在 1 附近；在含 985,160 个构型的大规模机器学习势拟合任务上，四阶 RNC-LM 达到固定训练误差目标的 wall-clock 时间比 LM 快 34 倍。
Conclusion: 有限步长下的几何实现（finite-step geometric realization）可作为独立的优化器设计原则，与曲率感知方向本身区分开。

papers.title: Dithered Gaussian Mechanism for Randomness-Efficient Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: We present the dithered Gaussian mechanism, an alternative to the discrete Gaussian mechanism for differential privacy that discretizes the private output rather than the noise distribution itself.By interpreting this discretization as post-processing of the Gaussian mechanism, our construction directly inherits the privacy guarantees of the standard Gaussian mechanism while avoiding vulnerabilities caused by finite-precision floating-point outputs. In addition, the mechanism is provably randomness-efficient: by sampling the discretized output values directly, the number of high-quality random bits required for privacy can be reduced significantly and made independent of the noise level. This is achieved by separating the randomness into two sources: a high-quality source used for the privacy-critical sampling step, and a high-performance public source, possibly known to the adversary, that supplies the additional randomness needed for randomized discretization. This separation enables the use of cryptographically secure randomness without substantial performance loss. As an application, we study model training with DP-SGD and show that cryptographically secure noise generation with reduced exposure to floating-point vulnerabilities can be achieved with modest practical overhead.
papers.comment: Improved Sampling Algorithm + Numerical Comparison with Baselines
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 dithered Gaussian mechanism：对高斯机制的输出做离散化（视为 post-processing），而非离散噪声分布本身，从而直接继承标准高斯机制的隐私保证并规避有限精度浮点输出漏洞。随机性被拆成隐私关键采样用的高质量源与可公开（甚至对手已知）的高性能源，使高质量随机比特需求显著下降且与噪声水平无关；在 DP-SGD 训练中，密码学安全噪声生成只需适度开销。
Motivation: 离散高斯机制与浮点输出在有限精度下存在漏洞，且密码学安全随机比特的消耗随噪声水平增长，制约 DP 训练的实际部署。
Method: 把私有输出的离散化解释为标准高斯机制的 post-processing，直接继承其隐私保证；按隐私关键采样与随机化离散化两个来源分离随机性，直接采样离散输出值以减少高质量随机比特；应用到 DP-SGD 模型训练。
Result: 高质量随机比特需求可显著降低并与噪声水平无关；DP-SGD 中用密码学安全噪声生成、减少浮点漏洞暴露，只带来适度实际开销（arXiv comment 注明含与基线的数值比较及改进采样算法）。
Conclusion: 把离散化放在输出侧而非噪声侧，可以在不牺牲隐私保证的前提下让密码学安全随机性变得实用，代价是适度的性能开销。

papers.title: TurnOPD: Making On-Policy Distillation Turn-Aware for Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy by matching a stronger teacher on the student's own trajectories, offering a promising framework for language agent training. However, its application to long-horizon agentic tasks remains insufficiently explored. We identify two key inefficiencies in vanilla agent OPD: (1) full-horizon rollouts often waste wall-clock resources on tail turns that provide weak and noisy KL supervision, and (2) trajectory-level KL objectives concentrate most of the loss on shallow tokens, leaving deeper decision turns under-trained once initial behaviors are aligned. To address these challenges, we propose TurnOPD, a turn-level budgeting strategy for efficient on-policy distillation of long-horizon agents. TurnOPD consists of two budget controllers: adaptive rollout-depth budgeting, which uses probe-based turn statistics to determine rollout length, and progressive turn-normalized loss budgeting, which gradually shifts KL weighting from token-level to turn-balanced supervision. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Multi-Hop Search with task-specialized teacher models show that TurnOPD achieves superior validation accuracy under equal wall-clock training budgets and advances the accuracy--time frontier beyond vanilla OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TurnOPD 把长程语言 agent 的 on-policy distillation 改成轮次级预算控制：用探针统计自适应截断 rollout 深度，并把 KL 权重从 token 级渐进转向轮次均衡。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Multi-Hop Search 上，等 wall-clock 预算下验证准确率优于 vanilla OPD，推进了 accuracy–time 前沿。
Motivation: vanilla agent OPD 在长程任务上有两处浪费：全轨迹 rollout 把时间耗在监督信号弱而噪的尾部轮次；轨迹级 KL 把损失集中在浅层 token，初始行为对齐后深层决策轮次训练不足。
Method: 两个预算控制器：adaptive rollout-depth budgeting 用基于探针的轮次统计决定 rollout 长度；progressive turn-normalized loss budgeting 逐步把 KL 加权从 token 级转向轮次均衡监督。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Multi-Hop Search 上用任务专用 teacher 模型，等 wall-clock 训练预算下验证准确率优于 vanilla OPD，并在 accuracy–time 前沿上更进一步。
Conclusion: 长程 agent 的 OPD 效率瓶颈在 rollout 深度与损失分配，按轮次做预算即可在同等时间预算内拿到更高准确率。

papers.title: RL Forgets! Towards Continual Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Continual post-training is becoming a central paradigm for adapting vision-language models to evolving tasks. Recent studies report that reinforcement learning is less prone to forgetting than supervised fine-tuning, motivating the view that RL is inherently resistant to forgetting. However, this view remains insufficiently validated, as existing evidence is largely drawn from outdated or homogeneous benchmarks. We revisit this assumption by introducing MRCL, a Multimodal Reasoning Continual Learning benchmark built from recent and diverse multimodal reasoning tasks. Experiments on MRCL show that standard reinforcement learning still suffers from catastrophic forgetting during continual post-training. We trace the failure to an objective mismatch. The KL regularization used in common policy optimization methods is evaluated on current-task data, whereas forgetting is caused by behavioral drift on prior-task distributions. To address this problem, we propose Continual Policy Optimization (CPO), a replay-free method grounded in a prior-task behavioral KL objective. CPO derives a local Fisher surrogate from the historical KL objective and uses parameter movement as a gradient-free proxy for Fisher sensitivity, enabling sparse regularization with negligible additional overhead. Experiments on three model scales and comparisons with multiple RL baselines show that CPO consistently reduces forgetting while maintaining effective adaptation and preserving broader pretrained capabilities. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/MaolinLuo/CPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MRCL 基准显示标准 RL 在多模态推理持续后训练中仍会发生灾难性遗忘，根因是 KL 正则只在当前任务数据上计算，而遗忘来自先验任务分布上的行为漂移。提出的免回放 CPO 用历史 KL 目标的局部 Fisher 代理与参数移动作为梯度无关的 Fisher 敏感度近似，做稀疏正则，在三个模型规模上一致减少遗忘同时保持适应能力。
Motivation: RL 比 SFT 更抗遗忘的流行看法主要来自过时或同质的基准，缺少充分验证；持续后训练视觉-语言模型时，现有 KL 正则的评估分布与实际造成遗忘的分布不一致。
Method: 构建多模态推理持续学习基准 MRCL（近期且多样的多模态推理任务）；诊断失败源于目标错配后，提出免回放的 Continual Policy Optimization（CPO），以先验任务行为 KL 目标为基础，从历史 KL 目标导出局部 Fisher 代理，并用参数移动作为梯度无关的 Fisher 敏感度代理，实现稀疏正则且额外开销可忽略。
Result: MRCL 上标准强化学习在持续后训练中仍出现灾难性遗忘；在三个模型规模上与多个 RL 基线比较，CPO 一致减少遗忘，同时保持有效适应并保留更广泛的预训练能力。
Conclusion: RL 并非天然抗遗忘，KL 正则必须对准先验任务分布而非当前任务数据；以历史行为 KL 的 Fisher 代理加参数移动做稀疏正则，可在免回放前提下缓解灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: Transformers with Physics-Informed Encodings and Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Detection of Eccentric Binary Black Holes in Pulsar Timing Array Data
papers.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) provide a unique window into nanohertz gravitational waves (GWs), but extracting astrophysical parameters from noisy, long-baseline timing residuals remains computationally challenging with traditional Bayesian techniques due to the high dimensionality of the parameter space, complex and correlated noise models, and the cost of repeated likelihood evaluations. We introduce a Transformer with a physics-informed positional-encoding framework for the efficient inference of eccentric binary black holes in relativistic orbits from PTA data. Our approach embeds analytical GW phase evolution directly into the model through structured positional encodings, enabling the network to learn physically meaningful representations from raw PTA timing residuals. We then use generative models, including discrete and continuous conditional normalizing flows, to infer posterior distributions within a simulation-based inference framework. Across a range of signal-to-noise ratios, the proposed method achieves improved accuracy, sharper posteriors, and faster inference compared to physics-agnostic baselines. While presented for deterministic white-noise signals, the modular framework readily generalizes to realistic PTA analyses incorporating red noise and additional components. This work highlights the potential of physics-aware deep learning models as scalable alternatives to conventional inference pipelines for next-generation PTA datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把解析引力波相位演化直接编码进 Transformer 的位置编码，从脉冲星计时残差中学习物理一致的表示，再用条件归一化流在 simulation-based inference 框架下给出偏心双黑洞参数后验。在多个信噪比下，该方法相比 physics-agnostic 基线取得更高精度、更尖锐的后验和更快的推理速度。
Motivation: 从 PTA 计时残差中提取天体物理参数受参数空间高维、噪声模型复杂且相关、似然反复求值代价高所限，传统贝叶斯方法计算上难以承受。
Method: Transformer 采用 physics-informed positional encoding，把解析 GW 相位演化嵌入结构化位置编码，直接吃原始 PTA timing residuals；后验由离散与连续条件归一化流 (conditional normalizing flows) 在 simulation-based inference 框架下给出，对象是相对论轨道上的偏心双黑洞。
Result: 在一系列信噪比 (SNR) 下，相比 physics-agnostic 基线，该方法精度更高、后验更尖锐、推理更快；当前演示针对确定性白噪声信号。
Conclusion: 物理感知的深度学习模型可作为传统推断管线的可扩展替代，用于下一代 PTA 数据集；框架为模块化设计，作者称其可推广到含红噪声及更多成分的真实 PTA 分析。

summary_sections.method: Transformer 采用 physics-informed positional encoding，把解析 GW 相位演化嵌入结构化位置编码，直接吃原始 PTA timing residuals；后验由离散与连续条件归一化流 (conditional normalizing flows) 在 simulation-based inference 框架下给出，对象是相对论轨道上的偏心双黑洞。
summary_sections.result: 在一系列信噪比 (SNR) 下，相比 physics-agnostic 基线，该方法精度更高、后验更尖锐、推理更快；当前演示针对确定性白噪声信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 物理感知的深度学习模型可作为传统推断管线的可扩展替代，用于下一代 PTA 数据集；框架为模块化设计，作者称其可推广到含红噪声及更多成分的真实 PTA 分析。

papers.title: BFMT: Enhancing Search Capabilities of Tree Sampler via Bootstrap Flow-Map Tree
papers.abstract_en: The ability to efficiently navigate high-dimensional spaces to identify optimal candidates-whether designing targeted molecular structures or generating images with preferred attributes-stands as a central pillar of modern scientific progress. Recent tree-based samplers enable highly scalable inference-time search by eliminating the reward-gradient bottleneck inherent to particle-based methods. Despite their potential, existing tree-based samplers are fundamentally constrained by the massive number of function evaluations (NFEs) required for node valuation, crippling their utility in exploration-heavy tasks. Furthermore, their reliance on small, uniform transitions at each depth precludes dynamic, adaptive search capabilities. To address this, we introduce Bootstrap Flow-Map-Tree (a.k.a BFMT), a computationally efficient sampling framework that enables full tree-path construction from any tree depth using a single function evaluation, drastically reducing computational overhead while providing critical foresight for sequential sampling. By enabling dynamic transition time-step scheduling, BFMT efficiently allocates its sampling budget, smoothly transitioning from broad global exploration to fine-grained local refinement of high-utility modes discovered through exploration. Extensive experiments and ablation studies across diverse domains-from high-dimensional images to large-scale molecules-demonstrate BFMT's superiority over baseline approaches in both search and alignment tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BFMT 用 bootstrap flow-map 让树采样器从任意树深度一次性构造完整树路径，把节点估值的函数评估次数 (NFEs) 压到单次，并据此动态调度转移时间步，使采样预算从广域探索平滑过渡到高价值模态的局部精修。在高维图像到大规模分子的搜索与对齐任务上，实验与消融显示其优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有树采样器虽消除了基于粒子方法的奖励梯度瓶颈，但节点估值需要海量函数评估，在探索密集任务中代价过高；且每层只能用小而统一的转移步长，无法自适应搜索。
Method: 提出 Bootstrap Flow-Map-Tree (BFMT)：借助 flow-map 从任意树深度用单次函数评估构造完整树路径，为序贯采样提供前瞻信息；再据此做动态时间步调度，把采样预算分配给探索与局部精修。
Result: 在从高维图像到大规模分子的多样领域上，搜索与对齐任务的实验和消融研究显示 BFMT 优于基线方法；核心机制为单次函数评估完成全树路径构造以大幅降低计算开销。
Conclusion: 把节点估值从逐深度多次评估改为单次 flow-map 评估并配合动态步长调度，可让树采样器在探索密集的高维搜索中既省算力又保持搜索质量。

papers.title: LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-Style Peer Review Platform
papers.abstract_en: Literature reviews are essential to scientific progress, but rigorously evaluating automatically generated reviews remains difficult because many aspects of research utility depend on expert judgment rather than reference-overlap metrics. We introduce LitReview Arena, a battle-style evaluation platform with a structured protocol tailored to literature review quality: domain experts with AI paper-writing experience compare anonymized drafts, are matched to topics within their expertise, and provide dimension-wise outcomes over five literature-review-specific criteria. From this protocol, we collect approximately 3k expert judgments, each containing five dimension-wise outcomes, and show that even the strongest current systems win only 23.0% of decisive matches against human drafts on overall utility, while agentic LLMs such as Sonar Deep Research substantially outperform base language models by over 60%. We further find that existing LLM-as-a-judge methods are substantially misaligned with human experts (Spearman's rho=0.467), especially on synthesis-heavy criteria such as paper structure and research suggestions. Using the collected preference data, we provide an expert-calibrated evaluator, LitJudge, which improves alignment to Spearman's rho=0.78, comparable to inter-expert consistency; code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LitReview Arena 用对战式同行评审平台评测文献综述智能体：领域专家匿名对比两份草稿，按五个综述专属维度给出判断。约 3k 条专家判断显示，最强系统在总体效用上对人类草稿的决定性对局胜率仅 23.0%，而 Sonar Deep Research 等 agentic LLM 比基础语言模型高出 60% 以上；现有 LLM-as-a-judge 与专家的 Spearman ρ 仅 0.467，用偏好数据训练的 LitJudge 把 ρ 提到 0.78。
Motivation: 自动文献综述的质量高度依赖专家判断，参考文献重叠类指标无法衡量研究效用，现有 LLM 评审器与人类专家在结构与研究建议等综合维度上严重不一致。
Method: 对战式评测协议：有 AI 论文写作经验的领域专家在匹配自身专长的主题上匿名对比草稿，按五个综述专属维度给出维度级结果；据此收集约 3k 条专家判断，并用该偏好数据训练专家校准评审器 LitJudge。
Result: 约 3k 条专家判断，每条含五个维度级结果；最强系统在总体效用上对人类草稿的决定性对局胜率 23.0%；Sonar Deep Research 等 agentic LLM 比基础语言模型高出 60% 以上；LLM-as-a-judge 与专家 Spearman ρ=0.467，LitJudge 提升到 ρ=0.78，与专家间一致性相当。
Conclusion: LLM-as-a-judge 在文献综述评审上与专家显著错位，尤其在论文结构与研究建议等综合维度；用专家偏好数据校准可把对齐度拉到专家间一致性水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sampling Meets Interaction: Sequentially-Controlled Multi-Particle Flow-Maps for Efficient Inference-time Search
papers.abstract_en: While generative models have enabled training-free reward alignment, existing particle-based methods are fundamentally constrained by their propensity to local exploration within narrow regions of the underlying distribution, severely restricting sample diversity. This limitation becomes especially acute under tight reward-feedback budgets, where effective search demands broad, strategic exploration to uncover high-utility regions. To address this, we propose Sequentially-Controlled Interactive Multi-Particle Flow-Maps (IMPFM), a framework for feedback-efficient search. IMPFM progressively transports a group of interactive particles toward the target distribution, maintaining the broad coverage essential for heterogeneous preference alignment. IMPFM leverages a principled and efficient posterior sample-sharing mechanism across particles powered by flow maps. By correcting individual particle drift with the collective value gradient from the entire ensemble's posterior samples at each correction step, the framework maximizes sample utility to enable global exploration while actively mitigating reward over-optimization, typical of standard control frameworks. Paired with a principled exploration-exploitation reweighting mechanism involving multi-particle interaction, this sequentially corrected multi-particle dynamics explicitly preserves structural diversity and overcomes the weight degeneracy inherent to standard Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) samplers. Crucially, we prove that the resulting sampling framework yields a multi-particle interaction-aware Feynman-Kac corrector that progressively steers the multi-particle system toward a KL-tilted target distribution, facilitating global exploration and preventing mode collapse. Extensive empirical evaluations and ablations across diverse search and alignment tasks confirm the efficacy of IMPFM over existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMPFM 用 flow maps 在粒子间共享后验样本，逐步把交互多粒子输运到 KL 倾斜目标分布，在紧奖励反馈预算下维持广覆盖而非局部探索。每步用全体集成后验样本的价值梯度校正单粒子漂移，配合探索-利用重加权保持结构多样性，缓解标准 SMC 的权重退化与奖励过优化。
Motivation: 训练无关的奖励对齐中，粒子法局限于分布的窄区域做局部探索，样本多样性差；在奖励反馈预算紧张时，需要广而有策略的探索才能找到高效用区域。
Method: 提出 Sequentially-Controlled Interactive Multi-Particle Flow-Maps (IMPFM)：靠 flow maps 实现跨粒子的后验样本共享，每步用整个集成后验样本的集体价值梯度校正单粒子漂移；再叠加多粒子交互的探索-利用重加权机制，构成序列校正的多粒子动力学。
Result: 证明该采样框架给出交互感知的 Feynman-Kac corrector，逐步把多粒子系统推向 KL 倾斜目标分布，实现全局探索并防止 mode collapse；在多样搜索与对齐任务上做了大量实证评估与消融，确认 IMPFM 相对现有基线有效。
Conclusion: 把粒子间样本共享与序列化控制结合，可以在奖励反馈受限时同时保住样本多样性并抑制奖励过优化，克服标准 SMC 的权重退化。

papers.title: FacePlex: Toward Natural Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Natural human conversation is inherently a real-time interaction in which speech and facial behavior continuously evolve. Enabling such interaction requires a conversational avatar to jointly generate speech and facial motion in real time, prepare facial motion for upcoming speech before the corresponding audio is emitted, and produce non-verbal reactions that reflect the ongoing dialogue. However, existing conversational avatar systems cannot address such requirements: audio-driven methods rely on pre-given speech, while joint streaming generation alone does not ensure anticipatory articulation or semantically appropriate reactions. We propose $\textbf{FacePlex}$, a unified framework for full-duplex speech-facial motion generation and real-time avatar rendering. FacePlex jointly coordinates speech, facial motion, and Gaussian splatting rendering on a shared streaming timeline. To prepare facial motion for upcoming speech, FacePlex predicts a short speech continuation and uses its future hidden states through asymmetric conditioning and denoising, while continuously updating them as new user audio arrives without observing future user input. For dialogue-grounded non-verbal behavior, we construct $\textit{SemReact}$, a dataset aligning dialogue context, reaction semantics, and facial motion, and introduce a semantic behavior router that guides continuous motion during both speaking and listening. Extensive experiments show improved audio-visual synchronization and facial articulation, natural dialogue-grounded non-verbal responses, and low-latency of 122 ms end-to-end avatar interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FacePlex 把语音、面部动作与 Gaussian splatting 渲染放到同一条流式时间线上，实现全双工对话虚拟人：先预测一小段语音续写并用其未来隐状态做非对称条件化与去噪，让面部动作先于音频就位，同时用语义行为路由器在说话与倾听阶段都生成对话语境驱动的非语言反应。实验显示音画同步与面部发音改善、非语言反应贴合对话语境，端到端交互延迟 122 ms。
Motivation: 现有对话虚拟人要么依赖预先给定的整段语音（audio-driven），要么只做联合流式生成，无法在音频播出前预备面部发音，也产生不了语义合适的非语言反应。
Method: FacePlex 统一协调语音、面部动作与 Gaussian splatting 渲染于共享流式时间线；预测短语音续写并取其未来隐状态，经非对称条件化 (asymmetric conditioning) 与去噪驱动面部动作，且随新到用户音频持续更新、不偷看未来用户输入；另构建 SemReact 数据集对齐对话语境、反应语义与面部动作，并引入语义行为路由器 (semantic behavior router)。
Result: 实验显示音画同步与面部发音改善、产生自然且贴合对话语境的非语言反应，端到端虚拟人交互延迟低至 122 ms。
Conclusion: 全双工对话虚拟人需要把语音续写预测、面部动作预备与语义反应路由放在同一时间线上联合协调，才能同时做到先于发声的发音准备和低延迟交互。

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory-Based Safety Patch Learning for LLM Post-Training Realignment
papers.abstract_en: Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service (FTaaS) platforms let users perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on customized data, but this pipeline can erode model safety alignment. To recover safety without re-running full alignment, existing realignment methods focus on calibrating the integration of safety patches into fine-tuned models. These methods exhibit a persistent safety-utility trade-off: weak repair leaves harmful behavior intact, while stronger repair increasingly damages the benign task. This paper shifts the focus from online calibration to offline patch learning and aims to learn a safety patch that restores safety while preserving task-specific capabilities. To this end, we propose TRACE, which simulates harmful SFT trajectories to produce progressively corrupted model states, and optimizes a safety patch simultaneously across these states. TRACE trains the safety patch during the offline stage, and reuses it across all user checkpoints without per-user calibration. We evaluate two representative models using three harmful SFT datasets, together with three utility benchmarks. Across six benchmarks and two models, TRACE consistently dominates the safety-utility frontier. TRACE improves the safety rate by up to 77 percentage points over the best baselines, while maintaining comparable utility to the undefended fine-tuned model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把安全对齐从在线校准改为离线学习安全补丁：模拟有害 SFT 轨迹生成逐步恶化的模型状态，并在这些状态上联合优化同一个补丁，训练一次即可复用到所有用户 checkpoint。在两个模型、三个有害 SFT 数据集与三个 utility 基准共六项评测上，安全率相对最强基线最多提升 77 个百分点，同时 utility 与未防御的微调模型相当。
Motivation: Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service 平台上的监督微调会侵蚀模型安全对齐；现有 realignment 方法靠在线校准安全补丁，始终存在安全-效用权衡：修复太弱则有害行为残留，修复太强则损害良性任务。
Method: TRACE 在离线阶段模拟有害 SFT 轨迹，产生逐步 corrupted 的模型状态序列，并在这些状态上同时优化一个 safety patch；补丁训练一次后跨全部用户 checkpoint 复用，无需逐用户校准。评测覆盖两个代表性模型、三个有害 SFT 数据集与三个 utility 基准。
