papers.title: A Gravitational Interpretation of Safety Reversion under Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in large language models can degrade during post-training even when neither the data nor the objective is intentionally adversarial. Alignment rebound and reverse dynamics suggest that this degradation may reactivate behavior suppressed during safety alignment. Building on these ideas, we hypothesize that ordinary non-adversarial post-training follows a reversion direction: the activation-space displacement from the safety-aligned model toward a more permissive, earlier helpful-only state. We see that for Llama, every tested trajectory across references, tasks, and seeds exceeds a matched empirical null, while at aligned Llama and Qwen checkpoints, a vocabulary readout shows that the direction locally favors task-engaging over fixed refusal-like openings. Its geometric expression is behaviorally informative: as post-training proceeds, alignment with the direction and harmfulness increase together, yielding a strong descriptive correlation (Spearman r=0.958). To move beyond correlation, we test causal relevance during adaptation using objectives constructed from this coordinate. Across all tested Llama, Qwen, and Gemma settings from 3B to 14B, an optimizer-matched objective opposing positive motion reduces geometric alignment and harmfulness relative to ordinary fine-tuning, whereas a separately stabilized objective reinforcing that motion increases both. Every model and scale exhibits the same mean block-baseline-push ordering, showing that the causal relevance of the reversion direction is not tied to one architecture or model size. Finally, we show that a standard safety-rehearsal objective, built without access to the direction, independently opposes it and cuts cumulative reversion by about 30% in Llama and Qwen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把大模型微调中的安全回退解释为一条激活空间中的“回退方向”：普通非对抗后训练会把模型从安全对齐态推向更宽松的早期 helpful-only 态。沿该方向的对齐度与有害性同步上升（Spearman r=0.958），用该坐标构造的反向目标在 Llama/Qwen/Gemma 3B–14B 上同时降低几何对齐与有害性，而标准 safety-rehearsal 目标在不访问该方向的情况下把累计回退削减约 30%。
Motivation: 安全对齐的 LLM 在普通（非对抗）后训练中也会退化，alignment rebound 与 reverse dynamics 提示这可能是被抑制行为被重新激活；需要判定是否存在一个可复现、可因果干预的几何方向。
Method: 假设存在从安全对齐模型指向更宽松 helpful-only 态的激活空间位移（reversion direction）：先用跨 reference/task/seed 的轨迹与匹配经验零假设检验该方向，再用词表读出 (vocabulary readout) 检查方向偏好 task-engaging 而非固定 refusal 开头；随后基于该坐标构造目标——反对正向运动的目标与强化该运动的稳定化目标，均与普通微调做 optimizer-matched 对比，并测试不依赖该方向的 safety-rehearsal 目标。
Result: Llama 上每条测试轨迹都超过匹配经验零假设；方向与有害性的描述性相关 Spearman r=0.958。在 Llama、Qwen、Gemma 的 3B–14B 全部设置中，反对正向运动的目标相对普通微调同时降低几何对齐与有害性，强化运动的目标则使两者上升；所有模型与规模呈现一致的 mean block-baseline-push 排序。safety-rehearsal 目标在 Llama 与 Qwen 上把累计回退削减约 30%。
Conclusion: 安全回退可被表述为一个跨架构与规模稳定的几何方向，且具因果相关性：沿它优化会改变有害性，反向或独立的 rehearsal 目标能抑制它。

papers.title: LISA: Likelihood Score Alignment for Visual-condition Controllable Generation
papers.abstract_en: The prevalent dual-branch paradigm, i.e., training a side network to encode visual conditions and fusing its intermediate-layer features to a frozen pretrained main network, has shown remarkable success in visual-condition controllable generation. Despite its widespread adoption, the role of the side branch and its training efficiency remain underexplored. In this paper, we first revisit this mainstream paradigm through the lens of score-based generative modeling: 1) The main network preserves visual perceptual quality by providing a prior unconditional score. 2) The side network steers conditional control by implicitly contributing a likelihood score. Guided by this perspective, we propose LIkelihood Score Alignment (LISA), an effective regularization method that explicitly aligns the intermediate feature of the side network with an approximated likelihood score. Specifically, we first hook features from a designated layer of the side network and project them into the score latent space by a lightweight decoder. Then, we construct an approximated likelihood score target and calculate the distance between the decoder's output and this target as an additional regularization loss. Finally, we jointly optimize the side network and decoder with both standard diffusion loss and our regularization loss. Experiments across various image/video tasks, architectures, and diffusion/flow models demonstrated that LISA can not only consistently accelerate the training convergence and improve final synthetic results, but also encourage the side network's features to be more disentangled for conditional modeling with negligible additional training cost and zero extra inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LISA 把双分支视觉条件生成中的侧网络重新解释为隐式提供 likelihood score，用轻量 decoder 把侧网络指定层特征投影到 score latent space，再与近似 likelihood score 目标做正则对齐，与标准 diffusion loss 联合优化。在多种图像/视频任务、架构与 diffusion/flow 模型上，该正则一致加速训练收敛并提升最终生成质量，且额外训练开销可忽略、推理零开销。
Motivation: 双分支范式（冻结主网络 + 训练侧网络编码视觉条件）被广泛采用，但侧网络到底起什么作用、训练效率如何，一直缺乏从 score-based generative modeling 视角的解释与针对性正则。
Method: 先从 score 视角拆解范式：主网络提供先验 unconditional score，侧网络隐式贡献 likelihood score。LISA hook 侧网络指定层特征，经轻量 decoder 投影到 score latent space，构造近似 likelihood score 目标，以 decoder 输出与该目标的距离作为额外正则损失，与标准 diffusion loss 联合优化侧网络和 decoder。
Result: 在多种图像/视频任务、架构以及 diffusion/flow 模型上，LISA 一致加速训练收敛并改善最终合成结果，使侧网络特征对条件建模更解耦 (disentangled)，额外训练成本可忽略、推理零额外成本。
Conclusion: 把侧网络的中间特征显式对齐到近似 likelihood score，是提升双分支视觉条件生成训练效率与生成质量的通用且近乎免费的正则手段。

papers.title: Fast LeWorldModel
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), including recent LeWorldModel (LeWM), have become a promising foundation for reconstruction-free visual world models. For visual planning, however, LeWM evaluates candidate action sequences by repeatedly applying a local one-step latent transition model. This autoregressive rollout makes planning computationally expensive and exposes the predicted trajectory to accumulated latent errors as the horizon grows. We propose Fast LeWorldModel (Fast-LeWM), a fast latent world model that replaces repeated local rollout with action-prefix prediction. Given the current latent and a candidate action sequence, Fast-LeWM encodes its prefixes and predicts the future latents reached after executing those prefixes in parallel. By making action prefixes the basic prediction unit, Fast-LeWM directly models action effects accumulated to different extents over multiple horizons. This prefix-level supervision forces the model to learn how states continuously evolve under different action prefixes, rather than only fitting one-step state transitions. During planning, the predictor can use the prefix token from the encoded action sequence to evaluate the corresponding future latent without explicitly rolling through each intermediate imagined state. Across multiple tasks, Fast-LeWM improves average success over LeWM while substantially reducing planning time, achieving lower open-loop latent loss whose growth becomes significantly slower as the rollout horizon increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fast-LeWM 把 LeWorldModel 规划时反复调用的单步局部 latent 转移，换成对动作前缀 (action prefix) 的并行预测：给定当前 latent 与候选动作序列，编码其各前缀并直接预测执行该前缀后到达的未来 latent。跨多个任务平均成功率高于 LeWM，规划时间大幅下降，开环 latent loss 更低且随 rollout horizon 增长明显变慢。
Motivation: LeWM 用局部单步 latent 转移反复 rollout 来评估候选动作序列，规划计算昂贵，且 horizon 变长时预测轨迹累积 latent 误差。
Method: 以 action prefix 为基本预测单元：编码器吃当前 latent 与候选动作序列的各前缀，并行预测执行这些前缀后到达的未来 latent，形成前缀级监督，迫使模型学习不同动作前缀下状态的连续演化而非单步转移；规划时直接用编码序列中的前缀 token 取对应未来 latent，跳过逐个中间想象状态的显式滚动。
Result: 跨多个任务平均成功率高于 LeWM，同时大幅缩短规划时间；开环 latent loss 更低，且其随 rollout horizon 增加的增长速度显著变慢。
Conclusion: 把预测单元从单步转移到动作前缀，可以在视觉规划中同时降低计算开销与长 horizon 的 latent 误差累积，从而在成功率与规划时间两头都优于原 LeWM。

papers.title: USS: Unifying Spatial-Semantic Prompting for End to End Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) requires an agent to continuously follow a designated target while moving through dynamic environments. Existing embodied tracking methods generally rely on either an implicit target-selection convention or a language description, leaving the target-specification interface largely fixed. However, different tracking scenarios naturally favor different forms of target specification: language can specify a target outside the robot's current view, whereas spatial prompts provide direct instance designation for visible targets and can be useful for selecting among similar looking people, designating hard-to-describe individuals, or specifying a target under time pressure. We therefore introduce unified spatial-semantic prompting for EVT, in which text, a point, a box, and a mask serve as complementary target specifications that can be selected according to different scenarios, and present USS, an end-to-end architecture that maps any of them to egocentric waypoints. A modality-specific prompt encoder feeds a common design comprising hybrid-attention fusion, temporal memory, cross-view aggregation, latent prediction, and waypoint decoding, with one policy instance trained for each interface under an identical recipe. Across 320 zero-shot real-robot trials with policies trained only in simulation, spatial prompts perform comparably to language in ordinary tracking scenarios while providing clear benefits when visually similar targets require precise instance designation, supporting our premise that different scenarios favor different target specifications. On simulation EVT-Bench under the standard language-prompt protocol, USS obtains the highest success rate among non-MLLM methods at 57 FPS, against the 4.8-10 FPS reported by MLLM trackers that are stronger on several metrics. Project site: https://arescheah.github.io/uss-project-page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: USS 把文本、点、框、mask 统一成具身视觉跟踪 (EVT) 的目标指定接口，用模态专用 prompt 编码器接同一套 hybrid-attention 融合、时序记忆、跨视角聚合、latent 预测与 waypoint 解码，端到端输出自我中心路径点。320 次零样本真机试验（仅仿真训练）中，空间 prompt 在普通场景与语言相当，在视觉相似目标上明显更准；EVT-Bench 语言协议下成功率在非 MLLM 方法中最高，达 57 FPS，而 MLLM 跟踪器为 4.8–10 FPS。
Motivation: 现有具身跟踪要么靠隐式目标选择约定、要么只用语言描述，目标指定接口被固定；但语言能指定视野外目标，空间 prompt 才能在相似个体、难以描述、时间紧迫时直接点选实例。
Method: 统一空间-语义 prompt：text/point/box/mask 四种互补指定形式各接一个模态专用 prompt 编码器，送入共享设计——hybrid-attention 融合、temporal memory、cross-view aggregation、latent prediction、waypoint decoding；每种接口用同一训练配方各训一个策略实例，端到端映射到 egocentric waypoints，且只在仿真中训练。
Result: 320 次零样本真机试验中，空间 prompt 在普通跟踪场景与语言表现相当，在需要精确实例指定的视觉相似目标上带来明显收益；仿真 EVT-Bench 标准语言 prompt 协议下，USS 成功率在非 MLLM 方法中最高，速度 57 FPS，而若干指标更强的 MLLM 跟踪器报告为 4.8–10 FPS。
Conclusion: 不同跟踪场景确实偏好不同的目标指定形式：语言与空间 prompt 各有适用条件，应按场景选接口，而非固定单一指定方式；USS 证明统一架构可在保持高帧率的同时与 MLLM 跟踪器竞争。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 320 次零样本真机试验中，空间 prompt 在普通跟踪场景与语言表现相当，在需要精确实例指定的视觉相似目标上带来明显收益；仿真 EVT-Bench 标准语言 prompt 协议下，USS 成功率在非 MLLM 方法中最高，速度 57 FPS，而若干指标更强的 MLLM 跟踪器报告为 4.8–10 FPS。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不同跟踪场景确实偏好不同的目标指定形式：语言与空间 prompt 各有适用条件，应按场景选接口，而非固定单一指定方式；USS 证明统一架构可在保持高帧率的同时与 MLLM 跟踪器竞争。

papers.title: Cliff Tokens: Analyzing Failure Trigger Tokens in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models reach high accuracy in mathematical reasoning, but individual traces on the same problem diverge; some arrive at the correct answer while others fail. Prior work localizes such failures at the step, chunk, or sentence level, or identifies tokens where failure has already occurred. These approaches leave open which token triggers failure. We introduce the cliff token, a token at which the estimated probability of reaching the correct answer (success probability) drops beyond an adaptive threshold. Across seven models and three mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM1K, MATH500, AIME 2025), cliff tokens act as failure triggers. For incorrect traces containing cliff tokens, we compare resampling immediately before and after the first cliff token. Resampling before it shows higher pass@$k$ at the same sample count. We further introduce a cliff taxonomy of deterministic, uncertain, and sampled-off cliffs, defined by greedy choice and token entropy. Additionally, we show that the three types differ as training signals. Using single-token preference optimization at cliff positions (Cliff-DPO), we find that uncertain and sampled-off cliffs show larger accuracy gains than deterministic cliffs on three evaluation benchmarks. We release token-level rollout data and source code to enable further analysis without regenerating costly rollouts: https://github.com/beaver-22/Cliff-token
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 cliff token：在 LLM 数学推理轨迹中，使到达正确答案的成功概率跌破自适应阈值的单个 token，即失败触发点。七个模型、GSM1K/MATH500/AIME 2025 上，在首个 cliff token 之前重采样比之后重采样得到更高 pass@$k$；按贪心选择与 token 熵把 cliff 分为 deterministic、uncertain、sampled-off 三类，其中 uncertain 与 sampled-off 类在 cliff 位置做单 token 偏好优化 (Cliff-DPO) 的准确率增益大于 deterministic 类。
Motivation: 同一问题上同一模型的多条推理轨迹结果发散，已有工作把失败定位到 step/chunk/sentence 级或失败已经发生的 token，仍无法指出究竟是哪个 token 触发了失败。
Method: 用成功概率（到达正确答案的估计概率）跌破自适应阈值定义 cliff token；在首个 cliff 前后对比重采样；按贪心选择与 token 熵构建 cliff taxonomy（deterministic/uncertain/sampled-off），并在 cliff 位置施加单 token 偏好优化 Cliff-DPO，同时发布 token 级 rollout 数据与代码。
Result: 覆盖七个模型与三个数学推理基准（GSM1K、MATH500、AIME 2025）：含 cliff token 的错误轨迹中，首个 cliff 之前重采样在相同采样数下 pass@$k$ 更高；三类 cliff 作为训练信号表现不同，Cliff-DPO 在三个评估基准上使 uncertain 与 sampled-off 类的准确率增益大于 deterministic 类。
Conclusion: 失败由少数 cliff token 触发，把重采样与偏好优化对准首个 cliff 之前或 uncertain/sampled-off 类位置，比在任意位置追加采样或训练更有效。

papers.title: The Interplay of Harness Design and Post-Training in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-integrated LLM agents are often wrapped within a harness: the scaffolding that determines which tools are exposed, how they are described, and what auxiliary information accompanies each per-step observation. While agents are routinely post-trained, this scaffolding is typically treated as a fixed engineering detail, with design effort limited to the training-free regime. Moreover, existing post-training algorithms assume a static environment, even though tool environments and tasks often shift upon deployment. To address this gap, we extend $\texttt{ALFWorld}$ (i) to treat the harness as a controllable design dimension and (ii) to support evaluation under task and tool environment shifts. Building on this, we systematically analyze how the harness design influences post-training in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings. We empirically show that harness-aware post-training not only improves in-distribution performance but also enables agents to robustly adapt to OOD settings. Under a harness with minimal design effort, post-training suffers a drastic performance drop under stronger tool environment shifts, further highlighting the importance of harness-aware post-training under such shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 的 harness（工具暴露方式、描述与逐步观测附带信息）从固定工程细节变成可控设计维度，并在扩展的 ALFWorld 上同时支持任务与工具环境偏移评估。结果显示 harness-aware post-training 既提升 in-distribution 表现，也让 agent 在 OOD 设定下稳健适应；而 minimal design effort 的 harness 在更强工具环境偏移下 post-training 性能急剧下降。
Motivation: 现有 post-training 算法假设静态环境，而工具环境与任务在部署时会偏移；harness 通常被当作固定工程细节，只在 training-free 范畴内投入设计。
Method: 扩展 ALFWorld：把 harness 作为可控设计维度，并支持任务与工具环境偏移下的评估；在此基础上系统分析 harness 设计对 post-training 的影响，覆盖 in-distribution 与 OOD 两类设定。
Result: 实证显示 harness-aware post-training 改善 in-distribution 表现并使 agent 稳健适应 OOD；在 minimal design effort 的 harness 下，post-training 在更强工具环境偏移时出现急剧性能下降。
Conclusion: harness 设计与 post-training 必须联合考虑：偏移越强，越需要 harness-aware post-training，否则性能会大幅下滑。

papers.title: Hyperbolic Manifold Constrained Tabular Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Tabular prediction is central to a wide range of real-world applications. Tabular data typically contain heterogeneous features as well as rich and complex relational information that can imply a latent structural manifold. Hyperbolic geometry can help capture complex structural relations in data. However, most existing tabular prediction models are constructed and optimized in Euclidean space. How to incorporate hyperbolic geometry into supervised tabular learning remains underexplored. We propose \textbf{HTNN}, a supervised hyperbolic manifold constrained tabular neural network for tabular prediction. HTNN consists of a hyperbolic feature-value representation layer for heterogeneous categorical and numerical features, followed by a conventional MLP predictor. HTNN employs a \emph{geometry-aware training} and \emph{geometry-free inference} optimization framework. The \emph{geometry-aware training} allows hyperbolic geometry to shape the latent representation learning of heterogeneous feature values. After training, the latent hyperbolic representations can be converted into ordinary Euclidean space for efficient \emph{geometry-free inference}. We conducted extensive experiments on the TALENT benchmark. HTNN ranks first among 36 methods on 200 classification datasets and third among 34 methods on 100 regression datasets. Experimental results show that the proposed hyperbolic manifold constrained tabular neural network is effective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HTNN：在双曲流形上做监督式表格学习，训练阶段用双曲几何约束异构特征值的隐表示，推理前把表示转回欧氏空间以普通 MLP 预测。在 TALENT 基准上，HTNN 在 200 个分类数据集上于 36 个方法中排第一，在 100 个回归数据集上于 34 个方法中排第三。
Motivation: 表格数据含异构特征与复杂关系结构，可能对应潜在流形，但现有表格预测模型几乎都在欧氏空间构建与优化，双曲几何如何进入监督式表格学习尚不充分。
Method: HTNN 由双曲特征值表示层（处理类别与数值异构特征）加常规 MLP 预测器组成，采用 geometry-aware training 与 geometry-free inference 框架：训练时让双曲几何塑造隐表示，训练完成后将双曲表示转换回欧氏空间再推理。
Result: 在 TALENT 基准上，HTNN 在 200 个分类数据集上于 36 个方法中排名第一，在 100 个回归数据集上于 34 个方法中排名第三。
Conclusion: 双曲流形约束能有效提升监督式表格预测，且几何只在训练期使用、推理期可转为欧氏以保持效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real vs. Complex Spectral Bases for Neural Operators: The Role of Green's Function Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) learn solution operators of partial differential equations by parameterizing global convolutions in the complex Fourier domain. For real-valued PDE solutions, the complex FFT carries representational redundancy through conjugate symmetry. We introduce the Hartley Neural Operator (HNO), the exact real-valued mirror of FNO: it replaces the FFT with the purely real Discrete Hartley Transform and learns a single real multiplier per retained spectral mode, with no complex arithmetic. Because the real Hartley spectrum is not halved by conjugate symmetry, HNO retains twice as many frequency corners as FNO but one real weight where FNO carries a complex pair, so the two operators are iso-parametric at equal width and differ only in spectral basis. Our central thesis is that the best basis is a property of the operator. Self-adjoint elliptic operators (Poisson, biharmonic) have real, symmetric Green's functions that the real Hartley multiplier diagonalizes exactly, and HNO is favored there. Time-dependent operators carry phase, from oscillation in the wave equation to transport in advection, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, which a real diagonal multiplier cannot represent, so FNO is favored there, and increasingly so with the operator's phase content, leaving the phaseless heat equation as the borderline case. Training both operators identically and benchmarking across PDE classes, initial-condition families, and boundary conditions, we find an elliptic-versus-time-dependent split that is monotone in operator phase content and matches the Green's-function theory we develop. Rather than a universal winner, our findings give a predictive rule: match the spectral basis to the symmetry of the solution operator.
papers.comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at the 62nd Allerton Conference on Communication, Control, and Computing (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Hartley Neural Operator (HNO)：用纯实数的 Discrete Hartley Transform 替换 FNO 的复 FFT，每个保留谱模只学一个实数乘子，与 FNO 在等宽下等参数、只差谱基。发现椭圆型算子（Poisson、biharmonic）上实对称 Green 函数被 Hartley 乘子精确对角化，HNO 占优；含相位的时变算子（wave、advection、Burgers、Navier-Stokes）上 FNO 占优，且随算子相位含量单调增强，无相位的 heat 方程是边界情形。给出的预测规则是：按解算子的对称性选谱基，而非追求通用赢家。
Motivation: FNO 在复 Fourier 域做全局卷积，对实值 PDE 解而言共轭对称带来表示冗余；而哪种谱基更适合哪类解算子此前缺少可预测的判据。
Method: HNO 用 Discrete Hartley Transform 取代 FFT，每个保留谱模学一个实数乘子、无复数运算；实 Hartley 谱不被共轭对称减半，故保留两倍频角但权重数与 FNO 的复数对相当，两者等参数。训练设置完全一致，在多类 PDE、初值族与边界条件上做基准，并与自伴椭圆算子 Green 函数实对称可对角化的理论对照。
Result: 在跨 PDE 类、初值族与边界条件的同设置基准中，得到椭圆型与时变算子的分野，该分野随算子相位含量单调变化，且与作者发展的 Green 函数理论一致：椭圆型（Poisson、biharmonic）上 HNO 占优，含相位的 wave/advection/Burgers/Navier-Stokes 上 FNO 占优，heat 方程为边界情形。
Conclusion: 最优谱基是解算子本身的性质：应把谱基与解算子的对称性对齐，而不是寻找通用赢家。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Rethinking Object-Centric Representations for Video Dynamics Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Learning to decompose videos into persistent objects is a fundamental challenge in unsupervised object-centric representation learning. Despite recent progress, existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve accurate object segmentation, consistent identities over time, and reliable foreground-background separation. To address these challenges, we introduce UniSlot (Unified Slots), an unsupervised framework for learning robust and disentangled object-centric representations from videos. UniSlot explicitly separates object appearance from its 3D-aware geometric pose in the scene, linking object identity to appearance while leveraging depth to better distinguish objects from their surroundings. UniSlot achieves state-of-the-art performance in unsupervised object-centric video decomposition and tracking across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, yielding substantially tighter object masks and reducing background leakage while preserving object identities. Beyond decomposition and tracking, these improved representations translate directly to downstream tasks such as unsupervised object dynamics prediction, enabling more accurate forecasting of future object trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniSlot 把视频无监督分解中的物体外观与 3D-aware 几何位姿显式分离，用物体身份绑定外观、用深度区分前景与背景。在合成与真实基准上取得无监督物体中心视频分解与跟踪的 state-of-the-art，物体掩膜更紧、背景泄漏更少，并使下游无监督物体动力学预测的未来轨迹预报更准。
Motivation: 无监督物体中心表示学习中，现有方法难以同时做到准确的物体分割、跨帧一致的身份保持，以及可靠的前景-背景分离。
Method: 提出 UniSlot（Unified Slots）无监督框架：显式分离物体外观与场景中的 3D-aware 几何位姿，将物体身份关联到外观，并利用深度改善物体与背景的区分。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上达到无监督物体中心视频分解与跟踪的 state-of-the-art：物体掩膜显著更紧、背景泄漏减少，同时保持物体身份；改进的表示直接迁移到无监督物体动力学预测，使未来物体轨迹预报更准确。
Conclusion: 把外观、位姿与深度解耦的物体中心表示，能同时改善分解、跟踪与下游轨迹预测，说明更强的分解质量可直接转化为更好的动力学预报。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: StreamPPG: Low-Latency rPPG Estimation via Consistent Privileged Learning
papers.abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) estimates the blood volume pulse (BVP) signal from facial videos, enabling contact-free health monitoring. Conventional clip-wise approaches, which use video clips as input, require capturing over one hundred frames before inference, thus introducing several seconds of delay and hindering real-time use. Meanwhile, frame-wise approaches struggle to capture long-range temporal and periodic features of physiological rhythms, and therefore lead to reduced estimation accuracy. To overcome these issues, we propose StreamPPG, a unified architecture that enables low-latency frame-wise physiological signal estimation while achieving competitive accuracy compared with clip-wise approaches. StreamPPG is trained under a consistent privileged learning (CPL) strategy, which leverages ground-truth rPPG signals as privileged information to enhance the model's representation capability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StreamPPG achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across multiple datasets while maintaining real-time throughput on edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StreamPPG 把 rPPG 从整段 clip 推理改成逐帧流式估计，用一致特权学习 (consistent privileged learning, CPL) 把真值 rPPG 信号作为特权信息训练，兼顾低延迟与长程周期特征。摘要称其在多个数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，同时在边缘设备上保持实时吞吐。
Motivation: clip-wise rPPG 需先采集一百多帧才能推理，带来数秒延迟，妨碍实时使用；frame-wise 方法又抓不住生理节律的长程时序与周期特征，精度下降。
Method: 统一架构做逐帧生理信号估计，训练采用 consistent privileged learning (CPL) 策略，以 ground-truth rPPG 信号作为特权信息增强模型表征能力。
Result: 摘要称在多个数据集上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并在边缘设备上保持实时吞吐；clip-wise 基线需采集超过一百帧、引入数秒延迟。
Conclusion: 逐帧流式估计配合特权信息训练，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下把 rPPG 延迟压到实时水平并部署到边缘设备。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Denoising-Enhanced Coarse-to-Fine Infrared Small Target Detection with Attention Prior-Guided Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) in high-resolution images is crucial for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) surveillance and UAV-based ground monitoring. However, small target size, weak features, and interference from complex dynamic backgrounds make IRSTD challenging. Existing methods incur redundant computation in non-target background regions and insufficiently exploit target context, limiting detection performance. To address these issues, we propose ECFNet, an efficient coarse-to-fine IRSTD framework with attention prior-guided knowledge distillation. In the coarse stage, we design a region binary classification network (RBCN) on grid-based multi-scale feature maps to efficiently identify target-containing context region proposals. A new denoising-assisted training strategy incorporates noisy ground-truth (GT) masks into RBCN feature maps and trains the network to reconstruct the original GT masks. This auxiliary task encourages explicit learning of target-background context to better distinguish target proposals from background regions. In the fine stage, we customize a lightweight target detector to the coarse-stage region proposals to balance accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce a knowledge distillation strategy guided by a teacher-student cross-attention prior. This strategy directs the student to focus on critical target regions, enhancing discriminative feature representations for infrared small targets. Extensive experiments on three real infrared datasets demonstrate that ECFNet outperforms existing single-stage and two-stage approaches while maintaining high real-time processing efficiency. Code: https://github.com/IVPLabs/ECFNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出红外小目标检测 (IRSTD) 框架 ECFNet：粗阶段用区域二分类网络 (RBCN) 在网格多尺度特征图上筛出含目标的上下文区域提案，并以去噪辅助训练让网络从含噪 GT 掩码重建原始掩码；细阶段用轻量检测器配合教师-学生交叉注意力先验引导的知识蒸馏。在三个真实红外数据集上超过单阶段与两阶段方法，同时保持高实时效率。
Motivation: 高分辨率红外图像中目标极小、特征弱且背景动态复杂，现有方法在非目标背景区域做冗余计算、又未充分利用目标上下文，检测性能与效率互相牵制。
Method: ECFNet 采用粗到细两阶段：粗阶段的 RBCN 在网格多尺度特征图上输出区域提案，去噪辅助训练把含噪 GT 掩码注入 RBCN 特征并要求重建原始 GT 掩码，以显式学习目标-背景上下文；细阶段针对提案定制轻量目标检测器，并用教师-学生交叉注意力先验引导的蒸馏使学生聚焦关键目标区域。
Result: 在三个真实红外数据集上的实验中，ECFNet 优于现有单阶段与两阶段方法，同时保持高实时处理效率；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 先在粗阶段用去噪辅助的区域提案排除背景冗余、再在细阶段用注意力先验蒸馏强化目标判别特征，可以在红外小目标检测上同时换取精度与实时效率。

papers.title: Beyond Flat Labels: Level-Restricted Contrastive Learning for Hierarchical Fine-Grained Vision Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal contrastive learning has enabled zero-shot visual classification by aligning images with textual categories. However, in hierarchically structured label spaces, existing methods often produce predictions that are inconsistent across taxonomic levels. For example, a model may predict a fine-grained category whose parent category contradicts its simultaneously predicted higher-level label. By analysis, the issue originates from false negative labels when contrastive comparison involves multiple taxonomic levels. To this end, we propose to restrict contrastive comparisons to categories within the same taxonomic level. In addition, we adopt a group-balanced design, ensuring each taxonomic level receives adequate optimization. As a result, the proposed framework improves both hierarchical consistency and classification accuracy from coarse to fine granularity. We train our model with TreeOfLife-10M based on BioCLIP and evaluate it across multiple hierarchical classification benchmarks, where the model demonstrates significantly improved hierarchical consistency in both Euclidean and hyperbolic spaces. Notably, on iNaturalist 2021 (iNat21), our method improves average accuracy across levels by 30.47% over the baseline, highlighting its effectiveness for hierarchical zero-shot classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 层级标签空间里跨分类阶元做对比学习会把父类当负样本，产生 false negative，导致细粒度预测与高层标签自相矛盾。把对比限制在同一分类阶元内并按阶元做 group-balanced 优化，可同时提升层级一致性与从粗到细的分类精度：在 iNat21 上各阶元平均准确率较基线提高 30.47%。
Motivation: 多模态对比学习做零样本分类时，层级标签空间中预测在不同分类阶元间不一致——细粒度类别的父类可能与同时给出的高层标签冲突；分析指出根源是跨阶元对比引入的 false negative 标签。
Method: 提出 level-restricted contrastive learning：只在同一分类阶元的类别之间做对比，避免跨阶元 false negative；再加 group-balanced 设计保证每个分类阶元都有充分优化。模型基于 BioCLIP 在 TreeOfLife-10M 上训练，并在 Euclidean 与 hyperbolic 两种空间中检验层级一致性。
Result: 在多个层级分类基准上评估，Euclidean 与 hyperbolic 空间中的层级一致性均显著提升；iNaturalist 2021 (iNat21) 上各阶元平均准确率较基线提高 30.47%。
Conclusion: 跨分类阶元的对比是层级不一致的来源，把对比限制在同阶元并做阶元间均衡优化，可同时改善层级一致性与从粗到细的分类准确率。

papers.title: Autonomous Event-Driven Multi-Agent Orchestration for Enterprise AI at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agent language models must coordinate specialist agents over continuous business event streams, yet most multi-agent evaluations assume discrete request-response workflows. We present a controlled simulation based on a sanitized enterprise research snapshot: 208 scenarios, 393 events, and 1,051 expected agent calls across Persona (<10 agents), Department (20-80), and Enterprise (200) registries. We compare DAG Plan & Execute with ReAct and evaluate a minimal Task Manager for priority inference, related-event merging, and preemption. Both systems perform well on the Persona cohort but score lower on the Enterprise cohort, especially for Simple scenarios; a larger, more confusable discovery space may contribute. The tested DAG Plan & Execute implementation generally maintains higher agent-call precision, whereas ReAct shows stronger recall and Expected Answer Completeness in several Enterprise conditions. The Task Manager reduces high-priority queue latency by 14-75% and improves related-event Expected Answer Completeness by over 20 percentage points at Enterprise scale. These controlled-simulation results characterize the tested systems but do not establish production readiness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在基于脱敏企业研究快照的受控仿真（208 场景、393 事件、1,051 次预期 agent 调用）中，对比 DAG Plan & Execute 与 ReAct，并测试一个做优先级推断、相关事件合并与抢占的最小 Task Manager。DAG 方案的 agent 调用精度更高，ReAct 在若干 Enterprise 条件下召回与 Expected Answer Completeness 更强；Task Manager 把高优先级队列延迟降低 14–75%，相关事件的 Expected Answer Completeness 在 Enterprise 规模上提升超过 20 个百分点。
Motivation: 多数多智能体评测假设离散的 request-response 工作流，而企业 agent 需要在连续业务事件流上协调专家 agent，两者不匹配。
Method: 构建受控仿真：脱敏企业研究快照，含 208 个场景、393 个事件、1,051 次预期 agent 调用，按 Persona（<10 agents）、Department（20–80）、Enterprise（200）三档注册规模分组；对比 DAG Plan & Execute 与 ReAct，并评估一个最小 Task Manager，负责优先级推断、相关事件合并与抢占。
Result: 两套系统在 Persona 组都表现良好，在 Enterprise 组得分更低，Simple 场景尤其明显，作者归因于更大且更易混淆的发现空间；DAG Plan & Execute 通常保持更高的 agent-call 精度，ReAct 在若干 Enterprise 条件下召回与 Expected Answer Completeness 更强；Task Manager 使高优先级队列延迟降低 14–75%，相关事件的 Expected Answer Completeness 在 Enterprise 规模上提升超过 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 这些受控仿真结果只刻画被测系统的表现，作者明确指出它们不构成生产就绪的证明。

papers.title: Capability Provenance in Language Models: A Case Study in Social Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We use training-data attribution as an interpretable tool for capability discovery, mapping which regions of the pretraining corpus support social reasoning versus STEM reasoning in OLMo3-7B. Training-data attribution measures how strongly each training document influences a model's predictions on a benchmark, but document-level scores are too noisy to identify which corpus regions support which capabilities. We compute gradient-based attribution (TrackStar via Bergson) over a working set drawn from the de-duplicated Dolma3 mix, aggregate influence across WebOrganizer's 24-format x 24-topic taxonomy (576 bins), and contrast benchmark pairs in a 2x2 design that varies domain (social vs. STEM) and capability type (reasoning vs. knowledge): SocialIQA and MMLU Social Sciences against ARC-Challenge and MMLU STEM. Social and STEM reasoning draw on qualitatively distinct corpus regions, and the contrast is sharper at the reasoning level than at the knowledge level. Targeted machine unlearning provides partial causal validation: forgetting high-attribution topics (e.g., Literature for SocialIQA) degrades the aligned benchmark more than within-topic random baselines. We open-source all code, data artifacts, influence scores, and checkpoints at https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/capabilibara and https://huggingface.co/HCAI-Lab-GT.
papers.comment: 101 pages. Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用训练数据归因 (training-data attribution) 定位 OLMo3-7B 预训练语料中支撑社会推理与 STEM 推理的区域：TrackStar 经 Bergson 计算梯度归因，按 WebOrganizer 的 24 格式 × 24 主题（576 个 bin）聚合影响力，并用 2×2 域×能力类型对比 SocialIQA、MMLU Social Sciences 与 ARC-Challenge、MMLU STEM。社会与 STEM 推理依赖性质不同的语料区域，且推理层面的对比比知识层面更尖锐；对高归因主题做定向机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 会使对应基准退化，幅度超过主题内随机基线。
Motivation: 文档级归因分数噪声太大，无法判定语料的哪些区域支撑哪种能力，能力发现 (capability discovery) 缺少可解释的定位手段。
Method: 在去重后的 Dolma3 混合语料工作集上用 TrackStar（经 Bergson）计算梯度归因，跨 WebOrganizer 的 24 格式 × 24 主题分类体系（576 个 bin）聚合影响力；用 2×2 设计对比基准对，域为 social vs. STEM、能力类型为 reasoning vs. knowledge（SocialIQA 与 MMLU Social Sciences 对 ARC-Challenge 与 MMLU STEM），再以定向机器遗忘做因果验证。
Result: 社会推理与 STEM 推理取自性质不同的语料区域，推理层面的对比比知识层面更尖锐；遗忘高归因主题（如 Literature 对 SocialIQA）比主题内随机基线更显著地损害对齐基准。代码、数据工件、影响力分数与 checkpoint 全部开源。
Conclusion: 训练数据归因可作为能力发现工具：语料主题与具体能力存在可定位的支撑关系，且高归因主题对基准表现具有部分因果作用。

papers.title: Guava: Distilling Frontier VLM Agents into a Compact Model with a Manipulation Harness
papers.abstract_en: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Guava 通过系统搜索 agent workflow、动作空间与观测空间的设计空间，得到一套具身工具使用 harness：迭代感知-推理-动作循环、语义动作抽象、多模态观测三要素。再用端到端蒸馏把操作能力压进 4B 开源模型，仅用不到 2K 条纯仿真轨迹，仿真与真机上达到与前沿专有模型相当的性能，并对未见物体、新指令和长程任务保持泛化。
Motivation: 具身操作中什么构成有效 harness、以及它能在多大程度上解锁各类推理模型（含小模型）的具身能力尚不清楚；端到端 VLA 系统之外的 harness 路线缺少系统的设计空间结论。
Method: 系统探索 agent workflow、action space、observation space 的设计空间，提炼三要素：iterative perception-reasoning-action loop、semantic action abstractions、multimodal observations；随后建立端到端训练管线，把具身操作能力蒸馏到 4B 开源模型，训练数据为不到 2K 条完全在仿真中采集的轨迹。
Result: 在仿真与真实环境中，蒸馏出的 4B 模型性能与前沿专有模型相当，并对未见物体、新指令和长程任务表现出强泛化；训练仅用不到 2K 条仿真轨迹。
Conclusion: 设计良好的 harness 可作为可扩展、与模型无关的具身操作接口，让紧凑开源模型在极少训练数据下涌现出强具身能力。

papers.title: Recursive Scaling in Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by iteratively refining a partially masked state and committing tokens in parallel. We introduce recursion in MDMs and propose new Recursive Masked Diffusion Models (R-MDMs), which apply a shared denoising transformer $L$ times within each denoising step, adding recursive depth as an additional compute axis without increasing parameter count. Across structured generation tasks, recursive depth improves quality at fixed parameter budget, matches substantially larger non-recursive models at matched FLOPs, and can reduce the number of denoising steps needed to reach a target quality. We interpret these gains with a dependence--fidelity decomposition of parallel decoding error: recursion refines model marginals at a fixed masked state, whereas denoising steps change that state by committing tokens. Building on this analysis, we propose to treat decoding as a two-axis decision (how many loops to run and which tokens to commit) and show that entropy-guided adaptive rules improve the quality--compute frontier over fixed schedules, transferring across various tasks on Sudoku, Countdown, RNA, and executable math generation. Together, these results establish recursive depth as a practical, complementary test-time scaling mechanism for MDMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在掩码扩散模型 (MDM) 内引入递归：每个去噪步内共享同一去噪 transformer 跑 L 次，把递归深度作为不增加参数量的额外计算轴。递归在固定参数预算下提升生成质量、在匹配 FLOPs 下追平大得多的非递归模型，并减少达到目标质量所需的去噪步数；熵引导的自适应调度（决定跑几圈、提交哪些 token）在 Sudoku、Countdown、RNA 与可执行数学生成上改善质量-计算前沿。
Motivation: MDM 的并行解码误差来自模型边缘分布与已提交 token 状态两部分，单纯加参数或加去噪步数代价高，需要在参数量之外开辟新的测试时扩展轴。
Method: 提出 Recursive Masked Diffusion (R-MDM)：每个去噪步内共享权重的去噪 transformer 递归应用 L 次；用 dependence–fidelity 分解解释并行解码误差（递归在固定掩码状态下细化模型边缘，去噪步则通过提交 token 改变状态）；据此把解码建模为双轴决策（循环次数与提交哪些 token），并给出熵引导的自适应调度规则替代固定调度。
Result: 在结构化生成任务上，递归深度在固定参数预算下提升质量，在匹配 FLOPs 下与显著更大的非递归模型相当，并可减少达到目标质量所需的去噪步数；熵引导自适应规则在质量-计算前沿上优于固定调度，且在 Sudoku、Countdown、RNA 和可执行数学生成等多种任务间迁移。
Conclusion: 递归深度是 MDM 的一种实用、与参数量和去噪步数互补的测试时扩展机制，解码应按循环次数与提交决策两个轴联合调度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RepNN: Tackling spectral bias in deep neural networks for regression and PDE problems via parameter reparameterization
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in scientific computing, yet they often suffer from spectral bias in capturing oscillatory and multiscale behaviors. In this study, we investigate this limitation by examining the failure of shallow ReLU neural networks in fitting high-frequency functions. This observation identifies two important factors in resolving rapid oscillations: the initial slope scale and the distribution of partition points induced by the networks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose RepNN, a reparameterized neural network model with ReLU or tanh activations designed for high-frequency and multiscale problems. The key idea is to reparameterize the weights and biases in the first hidden layer, which enables effective control of the initial slope scale and provides an appropriate distribution of the initial partition points. Furthermore, treating the reparameterized weights and biases as trainable parameters allows the DNN to achieve adaptive frequency scaling during training. In addition, we derive quantitative estimates for the output and slope magnitudes of the reparameterized DNN to guide the initialization of the proposed method. Numerical experiments, including multiscale one-, two-, and four-dimensional function approximations, forward and inverse PDE problems in combination with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), and operator learning for an earthquake problem using real data, demonstrate that RepNN improves the predicted accuracy of vanilla DNNs in capturing highly oscillatory features. These results indicate that RepNN provides an effective and flexible approach for overcoming spectral bias and applying DNNs to multiscale problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepNN 通过重参数化第一隐藏层的权重与偏置来控制初始斜率尺度和初始分点分布，并把重参数化后的参数设为可训练，使 DNN 在训练中自适应调整频率尺度，从而缓解谱偏差 (spectral bias)。在多尺度 1/2/4 维函数逼近、结合 PINNs 的正反向 PDE 问题以及基于真实地震数据的算子学习上，RepNN 相比 vanilla DNN 提高了对强振荡特征的预测精度。
Motivation: 浅层 ReLU 网络拟合高频函数时失败，暴露出 DNN 难以捕捉振荡与多尺度行为的谱偏差，限制了其在科学计算中的适用性。
Method: 先分析浅层 ReLU 网络拟合高频函数的失败，识别出初始斜率尺度与网络诱导的分点分布两个关键因素；据此提出 RepNN，重参数化第一隐藏层的权重与偏置（支持 ReLU 或 tanh 激活），并将这些重参数化参数作为可训练参数实现训练中的自适应频率缩放；同时推导重参数化 DNN 输出与斜率幅值的定量估计来指导初始化。
Result: 数值实验覆盖多尺度 1、2、4 维函数逼近，结合 physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) 的正向与反向 PDE 问题，以及使用真实数据的地震问题算子学习；结果显示 RepNN 在捕捉强振荡特征上提升了 vanilla DNN 的预测精度。
Conclusion: 通过重参数化第一隐藏层并配合由幅值估计导出的初始化，RepNN 提供了一种灵活有效的途径来克服谱偏差、把 DNN 用于多尺度问题。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learning New Tasks via Reusable Skills: Skill-Compositional Experts for Embodied Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Embodied Continual Learning (ECL) aims to enable robots to continually acquire new manipulation tasks while retaining previously learned behaviors under closed-loop control. In ECL, feature drift can propagate through sequential decision-making under closed-loop control, turning representation changes into compounding behavioral deviations on previously learned tasks. A key challenge in ECL lies in structured skill reuse across continually evolving tasks, since existing methods primarily focus on skill learning without explicitly organizing them for coherent task execution. To address this issue, we propose SCE, a Skill-Compositional Experts framework for ECL. SCE builds a skill base via Compositional Skill Grounding (CSG), which decomposes task demonstrations into reusable skills. Based on this, Dual Execution-and-Transition Experts (DETE) enable new task learning through skill composition, where one branch ensures skill execution and the other supports transitions between skills for coherent behavior. Experiments on LIBERO benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks show that SCE improves retention and overall task performance. Further feature drift analyses and ablation studies verify the effectiveness of our method. Project website: https://eqcy.github.io/sce/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SCE（Skill-Compositional Experts）用于机器人具身持续学习 (Embodied Continual Learning)：先用 Compositional Skill Grounding 把任务演示拆成可复用技能，再用 Dual Execution-and-Transition Experts 一支负责技能执行、一支负责技能间衔接，通过技能组合学新任务。在 LIBERO 与真实操作任务上提升了旧任务保持 (retention) 与整体任务表现。
Motivation: 闭环控制下特征漂移 (feature drift) 会沿序贯决策传播，把表征变化放大成旧任务上的行为偏差；现有方法只做技能学习而不显式组织技能以支撑连贯执行。
Method: SCE 分两层：Compositional Skill Grounding (CSG) 将任务演示分解为可复用技能构成技能库；Dual Execution-and-Transition Experts (DETE) 用双分支专家实现技能组合，一分支保证技能执行，另一分支处理技能间过渡以保持行为连贯。
Result: 在 LIBERO benchmarks 与真实机器人操作任务上，SCE 改善了旧任务保持与整体任务表现；并辅以特征漂移分析与消融研究验证方法有效性。
Conclusion: 把技能显式组织为可组合的执行与过渡专家，是在闭环具身持续学习中同时缓解特征漂移累积、保住旧技能的有效路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AutoDojo: A Generative Benchmark for Evaluating Prompt Injection Defenses in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) is a major security threat to LLM-powered agents. Thus, a growing body of work has proposed a variety of defensive approaches against IPI which can be grouped into three broad categories: prompt-level, filter-based, and system-level designs. However, commonly used benchmarks for evaluating defense, such as AgentDojo, are \emph{inherently static}, generating a fixed distribution of IPI attacks. Consequently, a defense can score well on them without being robust to adaptive threats. We introduce \textbf{AutoDojo}, a generative benchmark built on AgentDojo and AgentDyn that generates IPI \emph{adaptively} for a given agent and defense. It supports six task suites across the two benchmarks, covering banking, communication, travel, shopping, coding, and everyday-assistant domains. AutoDojo optimizes injections under a strict black-box setting, observing only whether a candidate injection succeeds, and can readily integrate, and often improve on, any existing black-box attack. Across ten defenses and five target models, AutoDojo demonstrates that standard static benchmarks often significantly overestimate defense efficacy. Moreover, we show that most existing defenses either sacrifice considerable utility or are insecure. Finally, we demonstrate that attack success interacts with task specification, with under-specified tasks particularly vulnerable. AutoDojo is available at https://github.com/xhOwenMa/AutoDojo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoDojo 是建立在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 之上的生成式基准，针对给定 agent 与防御自适应地产生间接提示注入 (IPI)，且只在黑盒设定下观测候选注入是否成功。在十个防御、五个目标模型上，它显示静态基准常显著高估防御效果，多数现有防御要么牺牲大量效用、要么并不安全，且任务规格欠定时攻击成功率更高。
Motivation: 现有 IPI 防御评测基准（如 AgentDojo）本质上是静态的，只产生固定分布的攻击，防御可以在其上拿高分却经不住自适应威胁。
Method: 在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 之上构建生成式基准，按具体 agent 与防御自适应优化注入，严格黑盒、仅观测候选注入是否成功，并可直接接入既有黑盒攻击且常能改进之；覆盖六个任务套件（banking、communication、travel、shopping、coding、everyday-assistant）。
Result: 在十个防御与五个目标模型上，静态基准常显著高估防御效能；多数现有防御要么牺牲相当可观的效用、要么并不安全；攻击成功率与任务规格交互，欠指定 (under-specified) 的任务尤其脆弱。
Conclusion: 对 IPI 防御的评测必须按防御自适应生成攻击，静态基准的分数不足以支撑鲁棒性结论，且任务规格欠定会显著抬高攻击成功率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Running the Gauntlet: Hard Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: As agentic systems continue to evolve and are widely deployed in real-world scenarios, there is a growing demand to faithfully evaluate their capabilities. However, current benchmarks are typically built on popular applications with relatively simple tasks and focus on a narrow set of capabilities while overlooking broader dimensions, resulting in saturated performance on modern agents and failing to probe their limitations. To this end, we introduce GauntletBench, a web-based benchmark for evaluating agent generalisation in challenging scenarios, focusing on three underexplored capabilities (temporal perception, graphical understanding, and 3D reasoning), across five less-covered professional applications (Video Editor, Workflow Builder, 3D Modeller, Flight Analyser, and Circuit Designer), each with 27 vision-intensive tasks (135 in total). Our benchmark provides a modular pipeline that comprises an environment compatible with both open- and closed-source agent frameworks, a controlled web-based application, a well-structured task suite, and an automated evaluation engine with diverse metrics. Contrary to widespread expectations, our empirical results reveal that frontier agentic systems remain far from achieving human-level performance. Even the state-of-the-art agent achieves only a 28.2% success rate on our GauntletBench, highlighting the limitations in these overlooked capabilities and generalisation. By comparison, non-expert human annotators achieve over 80% success on our challenging yet feasible tasks, revealing the substantial gap between current agent capabilities and those required for complex real-world scenarios.

Method: 提出模块化 pipeline：兼容开源与闭源智能体框架的环境、受控的 web 应用、结构化任务集，以及带多种指标的自动评测引擎；任务按三项能力 × 五类专业应用组织，共 135 个视觉密集任务。

papers.title: CODEBLOCK: Learning to Supervise Code at the Right Granularity
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning of code LLMs typically applies uniform cross-entropy loss to all response tokens, implicitly assuming that every token provides equally useful learning signals. Recent token-level selection methods challenge this assumption in natural-language SFT by supervising only high-value tokens. However, such pointwise selection can fragment the syntactic structures and program dependencies of code, leaving supervision scattered across incomplete code units. In experiments on 30K code instruction-response pairs, under the same 10% token budget, supervising complete coding blocks improves average performance by 11.7 points over prior approaches that supervise isolated tokens. Motivated by this observation, we propose CodeBlock, a structure-aware sparse supervision framework that uses complete, parser-aligned coding items as the basic units of supervision. CodeBlock constructs coding items from high-quality code instruction data, estimates their supervision utility using GCE, which is more robust to low-probability tokens, and further adjusts their supervision priority using data-flow reach and bridge signals. During training, the full response is retained as context, while loss is applied only to the selected supervision units. Experiments show that partial supervision over only about 6.9% of response tokens consistently outperforms full-token SFT across all five model settings, suggesting that effective code SFT depends not only on identifying high-value supervision, but also on allocating it at the appropriate structural granularity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeBlock 在代码 SFT 中把监督单元从孤立 token 换成 parser 对齐的完整代码块：用 GCE 估计监督效用，再按 data-flow reach 与 bridge 信号调权，训练时保留完整 response 作 context、只对选中单元算 loss。在 30K 代码指令-响应对上，同为 10% token 预算时按完整代码块监督比按孤立 token 监督平均高 11.7 分；只监督约 6.9% response token 在全部五种模型设置上都超过 full-token SFT。
Motivation: 代码 SFT 对所有 response token 施加统一交叉熵，而 token 级选择方法在自然语言上按点选高价值 token，会切断代码的语法结构与程序依赖，使监督散落在不完整代码单元上。
Method: CodeBlock 以 parser 对齐的完整 coding item 作为监督基本单元：从高质量代码指令数据构造 coding items，用对低概率 token 更稳健的 GCE 估计监督效用，再用 data-flow reach 与 bridge 信号调整优先级；训练时保留完整 response 作为 context，仅对被选中的监督单元施加 loss。
Result: 在 30K 代码指令-响应对上，相同 10% token 预算下监督完整 coding blocks 比监督孤立 token 的既有方法平均高 11.7 分；仅监督约 6.9% response token 在全部五种模型设置上稳定优于 full-token SFT。
Conclusion: 代码 SFT 的收益不仅取决于挑出高价值监督信号，还取决于把它放在正确的结构粒度上，完整代码块是比孤立 token 更合适的监督单位。

papers.title: Claw-SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating OpenClaw-style Agent Harnesses on Coding Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The software engineering capabilities of general-purpose agent harnesses remain underexplored, and existing benchmarks offer limited support for comparing these harnesses under consistent conditions. To address this gap, we introduce Claw-SWE-Bench, a unified benchmark that enables researchers to systematically assess the capabilities and efficiency of general-purpose harnesses on software engineering tasks. The benchmark contains 350 real-world GitHub issue-resolution instances across eight programming languages and 43 repositories and provides a shared adapter protocol to align task inputs, outputs, and execution environments across harnesses. Experiments show that general-purpose harnesses can effectively resolve real-world software issues and that their success rates and resource consumption vary substantially even when the underlying model is held fixed. To lower evaluation costs and support faster debugging and iteration, we also provide Claw-SWE-Bench Lite, an 80-instance subset designed to preserve the key evaluation properties of the full benchmark. We hope this benchmark will help researchers better evaluate and understand the performance of general-purpose harnesses on software engineering tasks and guide the development of more capable and efficient harnesses. The data is available at https://github.com/opensquilla/claw-swe-bench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/TokenRhythm/Claw-SWE-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Claw-SWE-Bench 提供统一评测协议，在固定底层模型的条件下比较通用 agent harness 的软件工程能力：350 个真实 GitHub issue 修复实例、8 种编程语言、43 个仓库，外加 80 实例的 Lite 子集用于降本快速迭代。实验显示 harness 能有效解决真实软件问题，且在模型固定时成功率与资源消耗仍差异显著。
Motivation: 通用 agent harness 的软件工程能力缺乏系统评测，现有 benchmark 无法在一致条件下横向比较不同 harness。
Method: 构建统一 benchmark Claw-SWE-Bench：350 个真实 GitHub issue-resolution 实例，覆盖 8 种编程语言与 43 个仓库，并提供共享 adapter 协议对齐各 harness 的任务输入、输出与执行环境；另发布 80 实例的 Claw-SWE-Bench Lite 子集以保留完整版的关键评测性质。
Result: 实验表明通用 harness 能有效解决真实软件问题；在固定底层模型时，不同 harness 的成功率与资源消耗仍存在显著差异。数据集含 350 实例（8 语言、43 仓库）与 80 实例 Lite 版。
Conclusion: harness 本身（而非仅模型）显著决定软件工程任务的成功率与资源开销，因此评测必须在统一协议下分离二者；Lite 子集可用于低成本快速调试与迭代。

papers.title: Plan-and-Verify Video Reward Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Scene Graph Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Reward models for text-to-video (T2V) generation guide post-training but often fail at fine-grained semantic alignment. We trace this to two structural weaknesses in existing reasoning-based reward models: they do not systematically verify every condition described in the prompt, and the visual evidence supporting each judgment remains implicit in their free-form reasoning. We propose SG-PVR, a video reward model that addresses these limitations through plan-and-verify reasoning grounded in spatio-temporal scene graphs. The verification plan decomposes the prompt into atomic claims, making the set of requirements to be checked explicit. The spatio-temporal scene graph, encoding entities, attributes, and temporally grounded relations, is extracted from the video and maintained as a persistent structured visual reference throughout reasoning. Each claim is verified against both the video and the scene graph, anchoring judgments in explicit visual evidence. SG-PVR achieves strong performance on semantic alignment, including fine-grained temporal semantics. As a test-time reranker, it further enhances compositional alignment in T2V generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 T2V 视频奖励模型 SG-PVR：把 prompt 分解为原子 claim 的验证计划，配合从视频抽取并全程维护的时空场景图 (spatio-temporal scene graph)，逐条 claim 对照视频与场景图核验。该模型在语义对齐（含细粒度时序语义）上表现强，作为 test-time reranker 进一步提升 T2V 生成的组合对齐。
Motivation: 现有基于推理的 T2V 奖励模型有两处结构缺陷：不系统核验 prompt 中的每条条件，且支撑判断的视觉证据隐含在自由文本推理里，导致细粒度语义对齐失败。
Method: SG-PVR 采用 plan-and-verify 推理：验证计划把 prompt 拆成原子 claim，使待检项显式化；从视频抽取编码实体、属性与时序关系的时空场景图，并在推理全程作为持久结构化视觉参照；每条 claim 同时对照视频与场景图核验，把判断锚定在显式视觉证据上。
Result: 在语义对齐（含细粒度时序语义）上取得强表现；作为 test-time reranker 时进一步增强 T2V 生成的组合对齐 (compositional alignment)。
Conclusion: 把 prompt 核验清单与持久时空场景图一起放进奖励模型推理，可让 T2V 奖励判断锚定显式视觉证据，从而改善细粒度与组合语义对齐。

papers.title: Toward Proactive RF Charging Scheduling: Generative AI for Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency wireless power transfer (RF-WPT) is an enabling technology for supporting uninterrupted communications in future Internet of Things systems by reducing the need for battery replacement and mitigating battery-waste-related issues. For large-scale RF-WPT deployment, one of the main challenges is the scheduler-level resource allocation. Specifically, the RF charger must decide how much energy to deliver, when, and to whom, under limited charging resources, incomplete receiver-side information, and uncertain near-future charging conditions. This article positions generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) as a promising tool for this setting because it can foresee multiple plausible charging scenarios conditioned on coarse operational context and receiver-side information. We propose GenAI to act as an uncertainty-aware support layer for the RF-WPT scheduler rather than as a standalone forecasting or decision-making tool. To this end, we first revisit the main challenges of RF-WPT scheduling, and discuss how major GenAI families can support uncertainty-aware charging decisions by generating scenario-based inputs for downstream tasks. We then present a case study showing that distribution-aware prediction can improve robust charging decisions over deterministic, ensemble, and non-learning baselines, particularly under risk-sensitive objectives. Finally, we outline key open challenges and future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把生成式 AI 定位为 RF 无线输电 (RF-WPT) 调度器的不确定性感知支持层：以粗粒度运行上下文与接收端信息为条件，生成多个可能的充电场景作为下游任务输入，而非独立预报或决策工具。案例研究显示，分布感知预测在风险敏感目标下比确定性、集成与非学习基线给出更稳健的充电决策。
Motivation: 大规模 RF-WPT 部署中，调度层要在充电资源有限、接收端信息不完整、近未来充电条件不确定的条件下决定给谁、何时、送多少能量，确定性预测难以覆盖这些不确定性。
Method: 将 GenAI 作为调度器的不确定性感知支持层，按粗粒度运行上下文与接收端信息生成场景化输入供下游任务使用；文章回顾 RF-WPT 调度的主要挑战并讨论各主要 GenAI 家族如何支撑场景生成，再以案例研究检验分布感知预测。
Result: 案例研究显示分布感知预测相对确定性、集成 (ensemble) 与非学习基线能改善充电决策的稳健性，且在风险敏感目标下改善尤为明显。
Conclusion: GenAI 更适合做 RF-WPT 调度的场景生成与不确定性支持层，而非替代调度器本身；风险敏感目标下收益最大。

papers.title: Time-frequency localization of bird calls in dense soundscapes
papers.abstract_en: Passive acoustic monitoring enables large-scale wildlife observation. Most bioacoustic classifiers predict species presence in a time window without localizing vocalizations precisely in time or frequency, limiting downstream analyses. We formulate time-frequency localization of bird calls as object detection on spectrograms and compare three computer vision model families (YOLO11, SAM 3, RF-DETR) against a non-learnable baseline. We introduce Intersection over Minimum (IoMin), an evaluation metric that better handles ambiguous acoustic boundaries than IoU. We also open-source a browser-based tool for efficient bounding-box labeling. The best RF-DETR model nearly doubles baseline performance on in-distribution, dense soundscapes from Singapore (83.4% vs. 42.1% IoMin@50 F1-score) and generalizes better to out-of-distribution recordings from Hawaii (63.2% vs. 48.6%). These results indicate that fine-tuned computer-vision models are well suited for time-frequency localization of bird vocalizations in complex soundscapes.
papers.comment: The following changes are made in this version: 1) added comparison to SAM 3 and RF-DETR models, 2) added a literature review on object-detection based acoustic segmentation, and 3) compressed the paper to fit within 5 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把鸟鸣时频定位形式化为声谱图上的目标检测，用 YOLO11、SAM 3、RF-DETR 与非学习基线对比，并提出更适配模糊声学边界的 IoMin 指标。在新加坡分布内密集声景上最佳 RF-DETR 的 IoMin@50 F1 达 83.4%（基线 42.1%），夏威夷分布外为 63.2%（基线 48.6%）。
Motivation: 多数生物声学分类器只在时间窗内判物种有无，不给出叫声在时频上的精确位置，限制了后续分析。
Method: 将时频定位表述为声谱图上的目标检测，比较 YOLO11、SAM 3、RF-DETR 三个计算机视觉模型族与一个非学习基线；提出 Intersection over Minimum (IoMin) 指标处理模糊声学边界，并开源浏览器端包围框标注工具。
Result: 分布内新加坡密集声景：最佳 RF-DETR IoMin@50 F1-score 83.4% vs 基线 42.1%；分布外夏威夷录音 63.2% vs 48.6%。
Conclusion: 微调后的计算机视觉模型适合在复杂声景中做鸟鸣时频定位，且相对基线在分布外录音上泛化更好。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agentic Hybrid RAG for Evidence-Grounded Muon Collider Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Muon collider research spans accelerator physics, detector instrumentation, and high-energy phenomenology, with relevant evidence scattered across a rapidly expanding and heterogeneous body of scientific literature. As high-energy physics (HEP) increasingly explores agent-assisted analysis workflows, efficiently locating, integrating, and verifying scientific evidence becomes an essential capability. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising framework for scientific question answering, integrating agentic reasoning without compromising retrieval precision remains a key challenge. In this work, we present agentic hybrid RAG, an evidence-grounded RAG framework for muon collider research. The framework combines a hybrid retriever, integrating sparse lexical and dense semantic retrieval, with an agentic reasoning module for query decomposition, evidence expansion, and grounded answer generation. To enable systematic evaluation, we construct the first benchmark for retrieval-augmented scientific question answering in the muon collider domain, comprising a curated literature corpus together with dedicated retrieval and answer-generation benchmarks covering major detector and physics research topics. Extensive evaluation shows that hybrid retrieval provides the strongest retrieval backbone, while agentic reasoning is most effective for controlled evidence expansion and answer synthesis. Built on this principle, agentic hybrid RAG consistently outperforms representative retrieval and RAG baselines in retrieval effectiveness, answer quality, evidence coverage, and factual grounding. Together, the benchmark and framework provide a foundation for evidence-grounded scientific question answering and future HEP analysis agents operating over large-scale scientific literature. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/AItutorialjrb/RAG_muon_JINST}{this URL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向缪子对撞机 (muon collider) 文献问答的 agentic hybrid RAG 框架：稀疏词法与稠密语义混合检索作骨干，叠加做查询分解、证据扩展与 grounded 回答生成的推理模块，并配套构建该领域首个检索增强科学问答基准。评测显示混合检索是最强检索骨干，agentic 推理最擅长受控证据扩展与答案合成，组合后在检索效果、答案质量、证据覆盖与事实接地四项上一致优于代表性检索与 RAG 基线。
Motivation: 缪子对撞机研究横跨加速器物理、探测器与高能现象学，证据散落在快速膨胀且异构的文献中；HEP 走向 agent 辅助分析时，如何在引入 agentic 推理的同时不牺牲检索精度是关键难题。
Method: agentic hybrid RAG：hybrid retriever 融合稀疏词法检索与稠密语义检索，agentic reasoning 模块负责查询分解、证据扩展与 grounded answer generation；同时构建缪子对撞机领域首个 RAG 科学问答基准，含精选文献语料以及覆盖主要探测器与物理研究主题的检索与答案生成两套 benchmark。
Result: 评测表明 hybrid retrieval 提供最强检索骨干，agentic reasoning 在受控证据扩展与答案合成上最有效；据此组合的 agentic hybrid RAG 在检索有效性、答案质量、证据覆盖与事实接地 (factual grounding) 上一致优于代表性检索与 RAG 基线。
Conclusion: 混合检索做骨干、agentic 推理只做受控扩展与合成，是证据接地科学问答的正确分工；该基准与框架可作为未来 HEP 分析 agent 在大规模文献上运行的基础。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Robust Active Learning for Few-Shot Example Selection in Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific text-to-SQL systems ground a large language model by retrieving annotated few-shot examples, and each example needs expert-written SQL. We treat the choice of which queries to annotate as constrained experimental design on the low-dimensional manifold of query embeddings, with query-dependent annotation noise, a partition matroid constraint that spreads selections across semantic domains, and an unknown covariance structure. We propose a stratified greedy algorithm that maximizes a heteroscedastic information-gain objective. We prove that the objective is monotone and submodular under query-dependent noise, so stratified greedy selection carries a 1/2-approximation guarantee under the partition constraint. Under kernel misspecification the guarantee degrades by an additive spectral term; we compute it on both experimental pools and find it too large for the bound to be quantitatively informative. To connect the design objective to the downstream task, we give a retrieval model that bounds few-shot accuracy from below by per-domain fill distance, demonstration noise, and domain coverage, and we calibrate its locality assumption on both pools. On an enterprise supply-chain corpus and on the BIRD benchmark, the selected banks improve cross-domain retrieval and end-to-end LLM SQL over random and distance-based selection at the same annotation budget. Stratified controls and pre-specified tests show that the gain comes from the partition constraint: uniform sampling within each stratum matches the full method in the oracle-label evaluations, farthest-point selection within strata adds a little at small budgets, and the noise weighting has no measurable effect. The practical advice is to annotate one example per domain per batch from the first batch on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 few-shot 示例的标注选择当作查询嵌入流形上的约束实验设计，提出分层贪心算法最大化异方差信息增益；在 partition matroid 约束下证明目标单调次模并给出 1/2 近似保证。分层对照显示增益来自约束本身：每层内均匀采样即可匹配完整方法，噪声加权无可测效果，故建议从第一批起每域每批标注一个示例。
Motivation: text-to-SQL 的检索式 few-shot 示例都要专家写 SQL，标注预算有限；随机或纯距离选择不控制跨语义域覆盖，且标注噪声随查询变化、协方差未知，缺少有保证的选样准则。
Method: 把选样建模为查询嵌入低维流形上的 constrained experimental design：partition matroid 约束把选择摊到各语义域，目标为 query-dependent 噪声下的异方差信息增益，用分层贪心 (stratified greedy) 求解；另给出以下界关联 few-shot 精度与 per-domain fill distance、示例噪声、域覆盖的检索模型，并在两个池上校准其 locality 假设。
Result: 证明目标在 query-dependent 噪声下单调次模，partition 约束下分层贪心有 1/2 近似保证；核错设时保证退化为一个加性谱项，作者在两个实验池上算出该项大到使界失去定量意义。在企业供应链语料与 BIRD benchmark 上，同等标注预算下所选示例库在跨域检索与端到端 LLM SQL 上均优于随机与基于距离的选择；分层对照与预指定检验表明增益来自 partition 约束——每层内均匀采样在 oracle-label 评估中匹配完整方法，层内最远点选择仅在小预算下略有增益，噪声加权无可测效果。
Conclusion: 增益由 partition 约束的跨域覆盖驱动，而非信息增益里的噪声加权；实操上从第一批起就每域每批标注一个示例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeoMetric: Injecting Metric Geographic Structure into Worldwide Image Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Worldwide image geo-localization aims to determine where on Earth a single image was captured. However, visually similar scenes may lie thousands of kilometers apart, so methods that localize primarily by appearance often mistake a distant look-alike for the true location. We attribute this failure to a structural cause: in existing methods, GPS coordinates serve only as training supervision, and the distance relationships among locations never enter the learned representation. To address this, we propose GeoMetric, a retrieval-based framework that encodes GPS coordinates relationally rather than in isolation, injecting the distance structure among locations into both representation learning and inference. GeoMetric comprises three components: (1) a Transformer-based GPS encoder with distance-aware location attention that modulates inter-sample aggregation by great-circle proximity; (2) a trimodal contrastive objective that aligns images, geo-textual descriptions, and GPS embeddings in a unified space; and (3) a retrieval-augmented inference stage that supplies large multimodal models (LMMs) with contrastive candidate context for grounded coordinate reasoning. Extensive experiments on IM2GPS, IM2GPS3k, YFCC4k, and YFCC26k demonstrate that GeoMetric consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving street-level accuracy (within 1 km) by 1.5%, 0.9%, 6.9%, and 2.5%, respectively. Controlled ablations confirm that the gains originate from the proposed geographic encoding rather than any specific LMM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoMetric 把 GPS 坐标从纯监督标签改成关系式编码，用大圆距离调制的 location attention 把地点间距离结构注入表征与检索推理，从而避免把千里之外的相似景象误判为真位置。在 IM2GPS、IM2GPS3k、YFCC4k、YFCC26k 上，1 km 内街景级精度分别提升 1.5%、0.9%、6.9%、2.5%。
Motivation: 全球图像地理定位中外观相似场景可相距数千公里，纯外观检索会认错地点；根因是现有方法里 GPS 只当训练监督，地点间距离关系从未进入学到的表征。
Method: 检索式框架 GeoMetric 含三部分：基于 Transformer 的 GPS 编码器，用距离感知的 location attention 按大圆距离调制样本间聚合；对齐图像、地理文本描述与 GPS 嵌入的三模态对比目标 (trimodal contrastive objective)；检索增强推理阶段给大模型 (LMM) 提供对比候选上下文以做坐标推理。
Result: 在 IM2GPS、IM2GPS3k、YFCC4k、YFCC26k 上持续优于 SOTA，1 km 内街景级精度分别提升 1.5%、0.9%、6.9%、2.5%；受控消融显示增益来自所提出的地理编码而非某个特定 LMM。
Conclusion: 把地点间距离结构显式编码进表征与推理，是缓解外观混淆型图像地理定位错误的有效来源，且增益不依赖具体 LMM 选择。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agentic Search for Counterfactual Recourse under Fixed LLM Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual recourse aims to provide actionable feature changes that would alter an unfavorable decision made by a predictive model. In practice, affected individuals often benefit from multiple feasible alternatives rather than a single optimal explanation. A natural way to produce such alternatives is to prompt large language models (LLMs). However, prompting incurs a practical constraint: the number of LLM calls is often the dominant computational and economic cost. Together, the need for multiple alternatives and this cost constraint shift the problem from finding a single high-quality counterfactual to efficiently generating a set of oracle-validated counterfactuals under a fixed LLM-call budget. In this work, we study counterfactual recourse generation in the LLM-agentic setting as a fixed-budget search problem and propose Recourse Monte Carlo Tree Search (ReCo-MCTS), an agentic tree-search framework that aims to increase the yield of unique, oracle-validated counterfactuals under this budget while accounting for the extent of the required changes. ReCo-MCTS combines LLM-based multi-candidate generation, constraint checking, black-box oracle evaluation, and UCT-guided tree search to accumulate valid counterfactuals under a fixed LLM-call budget. On four real-world tabular datasets, ReCo-MCTS returns more counterfactuals than the evaluated baselines in our main comparison under the specified resource limits, with trade-offs in the extent of the required changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把固定 LLM 调用预算下的反事实补偿 (counterfactual recourse) 生成建模为搜索问题，提出 ReCo-MCTS：用 LLM 多候选生成、约束检查、黑盒 oracle 评估与 UCT 引导的树搜索，在预算内累积唯一且经 oracle 验证的反事实。在四个真实表格数据集上，ReCo-MCTS 在指定资源限制下比被评估基线返回更多反事实，代价是所需特征改动幅度更大。
Motivation: 受影响个体需要多个可行的特征改动方案，而 prompt LLM 的调用次数是主要计算与经济成本，问题因此从找单个最优反事实转为在固定调用预算内高效产出一组经 oracle 验证的反事实。
Method: ReCo-MCTS 是 agentic 树搜索框架：LLM 负责多候选生成，随后做约束检查与黑盒 oracle 评估，用 UCT 引导树的扩展与回溯，在固定 LLM 调用预算下累积有效反事实，同时计入所需改动幅度。
Result: 在四个真实世界表格数据集 (tabular datasets) 的主对比中，给定资源限制下 ReCo-MCTS 返回的反事实数量多于被评估基线，同时在所需改动幅度上存在权衡。
Conclusion: 固定 LLM 预算下的反事实补偿应按搜索问题处理，UCT 引导的树搜索能提高唯一、经验证反事实的产出量，但要以更大的特征改动幅度为代价。

summary_sections.result: 在四个真实世界表格数据集 (tabular datasets) 的主对比中，给定资源限制下 ReCo-MCTS 返回的反事实数量多于被评估基线，同时在所需改动幅度上存在权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 固定 LLM 预算下的反事实补偿应按搜索问题处理，UCT 引导的树搜索能提高唯一、经验证反事实的产出量，但要以更大的特征改动幅度为代价。

papers.title: Hearing the Unspoken: Language Model Priors for Acoustic Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems operating in real-time settings must process acoustic input under strict temporal constraints, where transcription decisions are inherently made on incomplete information. This causal constraint serves as an information bottleneck on attackers, significantly limiting attack performance. Our new Semantic Gambit attack overcomes this causal limitation by augmenting the adversary with predictive context derived from a Large Language Model in real-time. Our experiments show that this form of augmentation can elevate the corpus-level Word Error Rate to 35.6%-a three-fold increase over the current state-of-the-art streaming attack. Ultimately, this work reveals how common, low-latency LLM tooling can be exploited to systematically subvert real-time ASR pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对实时 ASR 因因果约束只能看到不完整音频而限制攻击效果的问题，提出 Semantic Gambit 攻击，用大语言模型实时提供预测上下文来绕过该信息瓶颈。实验中语料级词错误率 (WER) 达到 35.6%，是当前最优流式攻击的三倍。
Motivation: 实时 ASR 必须在严格时延下对不完整信息做转写决策，这一因果约束构成攻击者的信息瓶颈，显著限制现有流式对抗攻击的性能。
Method: Semantic Gambit 攻击在攻击回路中实时调用低延迟 LLM 工具生成预测上下文，补足因果 ASR 看不到的未来信息，从而对实时 ASR 管线施加声学对抗攻击。
Result: 语料级词错误率 (corpus-level Word Error Rate) 达到 35.6%，为当前最优流式攻击 (state-of-the-art streaming attack) 的三倍。
Conclusion: 常见、低延迟的 LLM 工具可被用来系统性地颠覆实时 ASR 管线，因果约束本身不足以防护流式对抗攻击。

papers.title: Vault: One-Step Latent Generation with Positive-Anchored Rewards for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving must balance multimodal maneuver generation against real-time inference constraints. Diffusion planners capture diverse behaviors, but their iterative denoising incurs considerable inference cost in safety-critical deployment, while one-step alternatives still imitate only the single expert demonstration, so neither family certifies both the diversity and the quality of its outputs. To address this, we propose Vault, a framework that couples one-step latent generation with sample-based reinforcement learning guidance. Built on a V-JEPA 2.1 visual representation pretrained on the full NAVSIM training imagery, Vault generates trajectory candidates in a single forward pass by drifting in a VAE latent space. During training, a reward-gated positive pool collects the maximum-scoring trajectories that the model itself discovers under the official evaluator and anchors the drift targets to these certified samples. This closes a reinforcement-learning loop purely through sample-based target construction, without policy gradients, learned reward models, or extra interaction: the generator imitates the frontier of its own certified successes, so quality and multimodality improve together under a single fixed sampling configuration. A learned scorer that predicts the official score and its sub-metrics then selects the executed trajectory, and all training-only modules are discarded at inference. On the NAVSIM benchmarks, Vault achieves state-of-the-art performance at real-time inference cost, reaching 94.6 PDMS on v1 and 91.2 EPDMS on v2.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vault 把单步潜空间生成与基于样本的强化学习引导结合，用 V-JEPA 2.1 视觉表征在 VAE 潜空间中一次前向生成轨迹候选，再用官方评测器筛出的高分轨迹作为正向锚点回灌训练。在 NAVSIM 上达到 94.6 PDMS (v1) 与 91.2 EPDMS (v2)，以实时推理代价取得 SOTA。
Motivation: 扩散规划器迭代去噪在安全关键部署中推理开销大，而单步替代方案只模仿单条专家示范，多样性与质量无法同时保证。
Method: 基于在 NAVSIM 全量训练图像上预训练的 V-JEPA 2.1 表征，在 VAE 潜空间中漂移、单次前向生成轨迹候选；训练时用官方评测器给自身采样打分，reward-gated positive pool 收集最高分轨迹并把漂移目标锚定到这些已认证样本，不使用 policy gradient、学习式奖励模型或额外交互；再由学习的 scorer 预测官方分数及子指标来选择执行轨迹，推理时丢弃全部训练期模块。
Result: NAVSIM v1 达 94.6 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 达 91.2 EPDMS，作者称在实时推理代价下取得 state-of-the-art；单一固定采样配置下质量与多模态性同时提升。
Conclusion: 通过纯样本构造的 RL 闭环让生成器模仿自身已认证成功的前沿，可以在不牺牲实时性的前提下同时改善轨迹质量与多样性。

papers.title: Large Language Models Hack Rewards, and Society
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, enabling large language models (LLMs) to learn from rewards. We observe that societal regulations are structurally similar to reward functions. They define measurable outcomes, thresholds, and exceptions, while often leaving institutional intent only partially specified. We hypothesise that the RL training process may exploit these gaps and therefore ask whether models' well-known tendency to hack reward functions during RL can scale into a more consequential failure mode named societal hacking: discovering loopholes in the rules society runs on. To study this phenomenon, we introduce SocioHack, a sandbox of 72 societal environments, and find that within these environments, reward hacking naturally emerges and leads to regulatory loophole discovery. Models learn to hack the social rules and generate strategies that remain technically compliant while defeating regulatory intent, and current LLM safeguards provide only limited mitigation. Therefore, collecting in-the-wild feedback for model training requires greater caution, and we need a next-generation post-training paradigm for safely iterating LLMs in real society.=
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 societal hacking 概念：LLM 在 RL 后训练中对奖励函数的钻空子行为会外溢到社会规则上，即在技术上合规却违背监管意图地发现制度漏洞。为此构建含 72 个社会环境的沙盒 SocioHack，发现 reward hacking 在其中自然出现并导向监管漏洞挖掘，而现有 LLM 安全防护只能有限缓解。
Motivation: 社会法规与奖励函数结构相似——都规定可测结果、阈值与例外，却只部分指定制度意图；RL 训练可能利用这种缝隙，把已知的 reward hacking 升级为更严重的失败模式。
Method: 引入 SocioHack 沙盒，包含 72 个社会环境，用于观察 LLM 在其中的 reward hacking 行为与监管漏洞发现，并检验当前 LLM safeguards 的缓解效果。
Result: 在 SocioHack 的 72 个社会环境中，reward hacking 自然涌现并导致监管漏洞发现；模型生成的策略保持技术合规同时击败监管意图；当前 LLM safeguards 仅提供有限缓解。
Conclusion: 作者主张：在真实社会中收集 in-the-wild feedback 用于模型训练需要更大谨慎，并需要下一代后训练范式来安全地在现实社会中迭代 LLM。

papers.title: NovelAPIBench: Diagnosing How A Code LLM Learns to Use Novel APIs
papers.abstract_en: Rapidly evolving software libraries require coding language models to use unfamiliar APIs. Yet failed solutions alone tell us little about what API knowledge models need or how to provide it. We present NovelAPIBench, an automated diagnostic framework that builds benchmarks around the API knowledge gaps of a target model. It identifies novel APIs, generates executable coding tasks with separately controllable knowledge components, and classifies failures into six categories. The framework can be rerun as models and libraries evolve. We study 21 libraries across five domains and six backbone models, with our primary benchmark comprising 1,670 tasks covering 856 APIs. Our experiments show that when supplied directly, usage examples provide the strongest standalone guidance for novel API acquisition, and combining them with signature descriptions approaches full-knowledge performance. Retrieving this knowledge from a pool of APIs yields lower accuracy than supplying only the target API's knowledge, even when retrieval finds the target. Fine-tuning on other APIs improves performance on unseen APIs mainly when external knowledge is supplied, helping models both select the target API and integrate it into the surrounding code. These findings highlight complementary roles for external API knowledge and the ability to apply it. By separating knowledge content, delivery, and use, NovelAPIBench helps diagnose what limits novel API use and guides adaptation to evolving libraries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/MAPS-research/NovelAPIBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NovelAPIBench 是一个围绕目标模型 API 知识缺口自动构建的诊断基准：识别 novel API、生成知识成分可独立控制的可执行编码任务，并把失败分为六类。在 21 个库、6 个 backbone、1,670 个任务（856 个 API）上，直接提供 usage examples 是最强的单项外部知识，与 signature 描述组合后接近 full-knowledge 水平；从 API 池检索即使命中目标 API 也低于只给目标 API 知识的准确率。
Motivation: 代码 LLM 需要使用快速演进的陌生 API，但仅凭失败样例无法判断模型缺的是哪类 API 知识、也无法决定该以何种方式提供。
Method: 自动识别 novel API，生成知识成分可分别控制的可执行编码任务，将失败归入六个类别；框架可随模型与库演进重跑。评测覆盖 21 个库（五个领域）、6 个 backbone 模型，主基准含 1,670 个任务、856 个 API，并对比直接提供知识、检索提供与微调等供给方式。
Result: 直接提供时 usage examples 提供最强的单项指导；usage examples 与 signature 描述组合接近 full-knowledge 性能。从 API 池中检索知识的准确率低于只提供目标 API 的知识，即使检索命中了目标 API。在其他 API 上微调主要在同时提供外部知识时提升未见 API 的表现，帮助模型选对目标 API 并将其融入周边代码。
Conclusion: 外部 API 知识的内容与模型应用知识的能力是互补的两条瓶颈，应把知识内容、传递方式和使用能力分开诊断，以应对库的持续演进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Domain Shift in Peach Leaf Damage Classification: Attention Mechanisms and Fine-Tuning Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for crop damage assessment are typically trained and validated on curated public imagery, yet their behaviour when deployed in real orchards remains poorly quantified. This work measures and mitigates that gap for peach leaf damage classification, where climate-driven abiotic and biotic stresses produce visually similar foliar symptoms. A benchmark of 1366 manually annotated peach leaves covering six damage types was assembled from public sources, and a second, independently acquired dataset of 180 field images across four classes was collected in a commercial orchard as an unseen target domain. Eleven convolutional backbones and three attention-enhanced variants were compared; CBAM-EfficientNetB5 achieved the best source-domain performance (93.3\% accuracy, 0.849 macro F1). Applied directly to the target domain, source-trained models lost on average 0.21 macro F1 points (26.5\% relative), with 12 of 14 architectures degrading, confirming that benchmark performance substantially overestimates field behaviour. Three fine-tuning strategies were then evaluated as mitigation: feature extraction proved insufficient in nearly all cases, whereas full fine-tuning recovered performance, with CBAM-EfficientNetB3 reaching 0.9459 accuracy and 0.9297 macro F1 on the local domain. Attention mechanisms improved minority-class recall and adaptation efficiency, but did not by themselves confer robustness to domain shift. The results establish a transferability baseline for peach leaf diagnosis and quantify the adaptation cost of moving from public benchmarks to operational orchards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 桃叶损伤分类在公开基准上的高分严重高估田间表现：源域训练模型直接迁移到果园未见域时平均掉 0.21 macro F1（相对 26.5%），14 个架构中 12 个变差。特征提取式微调几乎全部不够，全量微调才能恢复，CBAM-EfficientNetB3 在本地域达到 0.9459 accuracy、0.9297 macro F1；注意力提升少数类召回与适配效率，但单独并不带来对 domain shift 的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 作物损伤模型通常只在精选公开图像上训练验证，部署到真实果园后的行为缺少量化；气候驱动的非生物与生物胁迫症状视觉相似，公开基准分数无法代表田间可用性。
Method: 构建 1366 张人工标注桃叶、覆盖六种损伤类型的公开来源基准，另在商业果园独立采集 180 张田间图像、四个类别作为未见目标域；比较 11 个卷积骨干与 3 个注意力增强变体（含 CBAM），并评估三种微调策略（特征提取、全量微调等）作为缓解手段。
Result: CBAM-EfficientNetB5 源域最佳：93.3% accuracy、0.849 macro F1。直接迁移到目标域平均损失 0.21 macro F1 点（相对 26.5%），14 个架构中 12 个性能下降。微调中特征提取在几乎所有情形下不足，全量微调恢复性能，CBAM-EfficientNetB3 在本地域达 0.9459 accuracy、0.9297 macro F1。
Conclusion: 公开基准性能会大幅高估田间表现，从公开数据到运营果园的适配成本可以量化；缓解手段应选全量微调，注意力只改善少数类召回与适配效率，不能单独抵抗 domain shift。

papers.title: Training-free image inversion for one-step diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce a novel training-free inversion (TFinv) framework for one-step diffusion models,addressing key challenges in real image inversion and editing. We first identify two critical factors hamperingreal-image inversion and editing: (1) Initial Latent Editability, which is related to the distance between theinitial noise and the ideal Gaussian distribution, and (2) Caption Gap, which means the alignment betweentext captions and image representations. Both factors influence inversion efficiency and the editability ofone-step diffusion models. Then, we propose two novel techniques: iterative noise alignment (iterNA), whichminimizes the distribution gap to align with the normal Gaussian distribution, and suffix learning (suffL),which enhances text-to-image caption alignment by introducing learned suffix prompt tokens. These techniquesenable precise inversion of input images into their initial noise representations and facilitate image editing.Furthermore, we propose a mask-based editing technique for localized edits while preserving backgroundintegrity. Comprehensive experiments on the PIE-Bench dataset validate that our method TFinv not onlyachieves state-of-the-art performance in one-step diffusion editing, but also significantly outperforms existingmultistep approaches in efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/tttao-uwu/TFinv.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的单步扩散图像反演框架 TFinv，用迭代噪声对齐 (iterNA) 把初始噪声拉回高斯分布、用后缀学习 (suffL) 补齐文本与图像表征的 caption gap，再配合 mask-based 局部编辑保持背景。在 PIE-Bench 上达到单步扩散编辑的 state-of-the-art，并在效率上显著优于现有多步方法。
Motivation: 单步扩散模型做真实图像反演与编辑时受两个因素制约：初始噪声与理想高斯分布的距离（Initial Latent Editability），以及文本 caption 与图像表征的错位（Caption Gap），二者共同拉低反演效率与可编辑性。
Method: TFinv 是免训练框架：iterNA 迭代最小化噪声分布与标准高斯的差距；suffL 引入可学习的 suffix prompt token 增强文图对齐；再加一个基于 mask 的编辑模块做局部改动并保留背景。
Result: 在 PIE-Bench 数据集上的综合实验中，TFinv 在单步扩散编辑上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并在效率上显著超过现有多步 (multistep) 方法。
Conclusion: 把初始噪声的高斯对齐和 caption 对齐当作反演的两个可操作抓手，单步扩散即可同时拿到高质量反演编辑与多步方法难以匹敌的效率。
Relevance: 0
