papers.title: Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video generation has advanced rapidly in visual quality, but remains under-evaluated for factuality and practical usefulness. We introduce knowledge-intensive video generation (KIVI), where models generate videos from short information-seeking prompts that ask for explanations, procedures, or demonstrations. To evaluate this setting, we construct KIVI-Bench, a benchmark of 1,080 prompts, and propose automatic metrics for factuality and helpfulness. Human evaluation shows that our metrics significantly better align with human annotations than existing alternatives. Experiments on seven state-of-the-art video generation models show that current systems still lag behind human performance, especially on visual properties, procedural operations, and clear information presentation. These results highlight KIVI as a challenging direction for factual and instructionally useful video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出知识密集型视频生成 (KIVI)：让模型从简短的求知型 prompt（解释、流程、演示）直接生成视频，并配套 1,080 条 prompt 的 KIVI-Bench 与事实性/有用性自动指标。七个最先进视频生成模型上，当前系统仍明显落后于人类表现，短板集中在视觉属性、流程操作与清晰的信息呈现。
Motivation: 文生视频在画质上进步快，但在事实正确性与实际有用性上缺乏评测；面向解释、流程、演示类求知 prompt 的生成设定此前没有对应 benchmark 和指标。
Method: 定义 KIVI 生成设定，构建 KIVI-Bench（1,080 条 prompt），提出针对事实性 (factuality) 与有用性 (helpfulness) 的自动指标，并与既有指标对照人工标注做对齐性检验；在七个 SOTA 视频生成模型上做实验。
Result: KIVI-Bench 含 1,080 条 prompt；自动指标与人工标注的对齐度显著优于现有替代指标；七个 SOTA 视频生成模型在视觉属性、流程操作、清晰信息呈现三类上仍落后于人类表现。
Conclusion: 事实性与教学性有用的视频生成是一个尚未解决的挑战方向，现有模型的瓶颈在内容正确与信息清晰，而非画质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chameleon: Style-Content Disentangled Framework for Cross-Domain Object Compositing
papers.abstract_en: Image compositing aims to seamlessly insert a foreground object into a background image, and recent advances in diffusion models have significantly enhanced the quality, especially when the foreground and background images come from the same domain (e.g., natural images). However, cross-domain compositing, where the foreground and background come from different domains, is underexplored and remains challenging because the model must preserve the foreground object's identity while stylizing it to match the background domain. Existing cross-domain compositing approaches largely rely on training-free blending and refinement strategies. This is partly due to the lack of large-scale paired datasets, limiting the development of training-based solutions. As a result, they are limited to tone-level alignment and often produce style-inconsistent or overstylized results. To overcome such limitations, we construct ChameleonDataset, the first large-scale training dataset for cross-domain compositing, with a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, built through a scalable data construction pipeline. Building on this, we propose Chameleon, a novel two-stage training-based cross-domain compositing framework. In the first stage, we propose Signed Style-Content Graph Learning (SSCGL) to train ChameleonEncoder, which effectively disentangles style and content representations. In the second stage, we introduce Style Gap-Aware Anisotropic Modulation (SGAM) into a diffusion transformer for effective cross-domain compositing, adaptively regulating how style tokens from the first-stage ChameleonEncoder are injected according to the foreground-background style gap, spatial region, and diffusion timestep. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art in-domain and cross-domain compositing models, sequential pipelines and commercial models, achieving improvements in both compositional plausibility and stylistic fidelity.
papers.comment: The last two authors are co-corresponding authors. Please visit our project page at https://cmlab-korea.github.io/Chameleon/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chameleon 是面向跨域图像合成 (cross-domain compositing) 的两阶段训练框架：先用 Signed Style-Content Graph Learning (SSCGL) 训练 ChameleonEncoder 解耦风格与内容，再在 diffusion transformer 中用 Style Gap-Aware Anisotropic Modulation (SGAM) 按前景-背景风格差、空间区域与扩散时间步自适应注入风格 token。配合首个大规模训练集 ChameleonDataset，方法在同域与跨域合成模型、串行 pipeline 及商业模型上均取得更优的构图合理性与风格保真度。
Motivation: 跨域合成要求前景保身份同时风格化到背景域，现有方法多依赖免训练 blending，只能做到色调级对齐，常出现风格不一致或过度风格化；缺少大规模配对数据限制了训练式方案。
Method: 构建 ChameleonDataset（含评测 benchmark，经可扩展数据构造 pipeline）。第一阶段用 SSCGL 训练 ChameleonEncoder 解耦 style/content 表示；第二阶段在 diffusion transformer 中引入 SGAM，依据前景-背景风格差、空间区域与扩散时间步调节第一阶段风格 token 的注入。
Result: 在同域与跨域合成模型、串行 pipeline 及商业模型的对比中均取得更优结果，同时提升 compositional plausibility 与 stylistic fidelity；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 大规模配对数据加两阶段解耦训练可突破免训练 blending 的色调级对齐上限，实现跨域合成中身份保持与风格匹配的兼顾。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Effective Biological Representation Learning by Masking Gene Expression
papers.abstract_en: RNA sequencing produces rich and diverse datasets of gene expression, offering compelling insights into cellular state and function that have many applications in drug discovery. Modeling such data is challenging due to inherent technical noise and experimental batch effects, as evidenced by many existing transcriptomic foundation models (FMs) underperforming relative to linear baselines. Such results raise the question of whether deep representation learning provides a distinct advantage over the direct use of raw transcript counts. Our work explores this by developing a new self-supervised model, TxFM, with a focus on inductive representation learning evaluations. TxFM employs a masked autoencoding approach tailored to diverse RNA-seq count data, and our ablation study empirically identifies crucial architecture configurations required for strong transfer performance. Additionally, we curate a public training corpus, DiverseRNA-1.4M, and find that TxFM trained on this curated dataset yields high-fidelity gene representations that outperform FMs trained on atlas-scale corpora over 100x larger. Overall, our results indicate that inductive self-supervised learning is a viable modeling approach for transcriptomics representation, provided a careful synthesis of model architecture and training data curation.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 11 figures. Accepted for main-track at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Also presented at ICLR 2026 2nd Workshop on Foundation Models for Science: Real-World Impact and Science-First Design
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出转录组基础模型 TxFM，用面向 RNA-seq 计数数据的 masked autoencoding 做自监督表示学习，并配套整理公开训练语料 DiverseRNA-1.4M。在归纳式表示迁移评测中，TxFM 用比 atlas 级语料小 100 倍以上的数据训练仍产出高保真基因表示并超过这些大语料训练的 FM；消融实验给出获得强迁移性能所需的关键架构配置。
Motivation: RNA-seq 受技术噪声与批次效应影响，许多已有转录组基础模型表现不及线性基线，深度表示学习相对直接使用原始计数是否真有优势存疑。
Method: 构建自监督模型 TxFM，采用适配多样 RNA-seq 计数数据的 masked autoencoding（掩码自编码），以归纳式表示学习评测为主；同时整理公开训练语料 DiverseRNA-1.4M，并通过消融研究确定关键架构配置。
Result: 在 DiverseRNA-1.4M 上训练的 TxFM 产出高保真基因表示，超过在大 100 倍以上的 atlas 级语料上训练的转录组 FM；消融研究实证识别出强迁移性能所需的关键架构配置。
Conclusion: 归纳式自监督学习可用于转录组表示学习，前提是模型架构与训练数据整理需仔细结合；数据语料的多样性整理可胜过单纯扩大语料规模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dex2HOI: Dexterous Bimanual Two-Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 4D Human-Object Interaction (HOI) generation have enabled increasingly realistic motion synthesis, particularly for single-object manipulation. Yet current research overlooks an inherent property of human behavior: people naturally coordinate both hands and manipulate multiple objects simultaneously. To address this gap, we present Dex2HOI, a unified diffusion model for single- and two-object HOI synthesis from text. At its core, Dex2HOI employs a Dual-Stream Diffusion approach, where each object is processed in a dedicated interaction stream and coordinated through bidirectional cross-attention. To synthesize the final motion, we introduce a Motion Fusion Network integrated with novel hand-relative object representations and contact-aware conditioning applied across the whole sequence. By sampling the diffusion process autoregressively over prefix-conditioned windows, Dex2HOI generates arbitrarily long sequences at real-time speed omitting redundant test-time optimization, achieving up to x540 inference speed-up over prior state-of-the-art methods. Extensive evaluation on both single- and two-object benchmarks demonstrates state-of-the-art quantitative results, marking a step beyond conventional single-object HOI generation and toward expressive multi-object manipulation. Project: https://cpratikaki.github.io/dex2hoi/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dex2HOI 是一个从文本生成单物体与双物体 4D 人-物交互 (HOI) 的统一扩散模型：每个物体走独立交互流，用双向 cross-attention 协调，再由 Motion Fusion Network 融合出手部相对物体表征与接触感知条件。自回归地在前缀条件窗口上采样可生成任意长序列并达到实时速度，推理加速最高达先前 SOTA 的 540 倍，且在单物体与双物体基准上取得 SOTA 定量结果。
Motivation: 现有 4D HOI 生成集中于单物体操作，忽略了人会自然协调双手同时操作多个物体这一固有属性，双物体交互生成存在方法空白。
Method: 统一的文本条件扩散模型：Dual-Stream Diffusion 为每个物体设置专用交互流并以双向 cross-attention 协调；Motion Fusion Network 结合手部相对物体表征 (hand-relative object representation) 与接触感知条件 (contact-aware conditioning) 在整段序列上合成最终动作；扩散过程在前缀条件窗口上自回归采样，无需冗余的 test-time optimization。
Result: 推理相对先前 SOTA 方法最高加速 540 倍并达到实时速度，可生成任意长序列；在单物体与双物体基准上的广泛评估取得 SOTA 定量结果。
Conclusion: 双流扩散加接触感知融合可以把 HOI 生成从单物体操作推进到表达性的多物体双手操作，同时省去 test-time optimization 换取实时推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No More K-means: Single-Stage Sparse Coding for Efficient Multi-Vector Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multi-vector retrieval (MVR) models, exemplified by ColBERT, have established new benchmarks in retrieval accuracy by preserving fine-grained token-level interactions. However, this granularity imposes prohibitive storage and retrieval efficiency bottlenecks: to manage the immense memory footprint and computational overhead of billion-scale token vectors, state-of-the-art systems are forced to rely on aggressive dimension reduction and complex clustering (e.g., K-means). This compromise introduces two critical limitations: excessive indexing latency of clustering large-scale corpora and semantic information loss inherent to compression. In this paper, we propose Single-stage Sparse Retrieval (SSR}, a paradigm shift that replaces expensive clustering with efficient sparse coding. Instead of compressing features into low-dimensional dense vectors, we utilize Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to project token embeddings into a high-dimensional but highly sparse representation. This transformation enables us to bypass vector clustering entirely and leverage inverted indexing for precise, high-throughput retrieval. Extensive experiments on the BEIR benchmark demonstrate that SSR achieves a "trifecta" of improvements: it reduces indexing time by 15x compared to ColBERTv2, halves retrieval latency, and simultaneously improves retrieval performance over leading baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSR 用 Sparse Autoencoder 把 token embedding 投到高维稀疏表示，直接绕开 K-means 聚类与倒排索引对接，在 BEIR 上同时把索引时间降到 ColBERTv2 的 1/15、检索延迟减半并提升检索性能。
Motivation: 多向量检索 (MVR) 为保留 token 级细粒度交互而付出巨大存储与计算代价，SOTA 系统被迫做激进降维加 K-means 聚类，带来语料索引延迟过高与压缩语义损失两个问题。
Method: 提出 Single-stage Sparse Retrieval (SSR)：用 Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) 将 token embeddings 投影为高维高稀疏表示，取代压缩成低维稠密向量，完全跳过向量聚类，改用倒排索引 (inverted indexing) 做高吞吐精确检索。
Result: 在 BEIR benchmark 上：索引时间较 ColBERTv2 减少 15 倍，检索延迟减半，同时检索性能优于领先基线。
Conclusion: 用稀疏编码替代聚类可以让多向量检索同时拿到索引速度、检索延迟与检索精度三项收益，不必在压缩与质量之间二选一。

papers.title: MemPoison: Bypassing Selective Memory Mechanisms to Plant Backdoors in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly leverage long-term memory to support persistent and autonomous task execution. However, this capability also introduces a new attack surface: memory poisoning, where adversaries can inject malicious information to influence future behavior. Existing memory poisoning attacks often assume that injected content can be stored directly in memory, overlooking the selective extraction and rewriting stages in modern memory pipelines. This makes prior methods ineffective under realistic settings. In this paper, we propose MemPoison, a novel memory poisoning attack that bypasses selective memory mechanisms in LLM agents, where an attacker can inject triggerable backdoors into the agent's long-term memory through dialogue interactions, thereby misleading its subsequent responses. MemPoison introduces three key components: (i) a semantic relational bridge that binds the trigger and payload into a coherent statement to ensure their co-extraction into memory; (ii) entity masquerading that optimizes triggers to mimic named entities, resisting rewriting; and (iii) joint embedding optimization that shapes trigger-injected texts into a tight cluster in the embedding space while maintaining isolation from benign embeddings for stealth. Evaluations across different agent domains and memory mechanisms show MemPoison achieves attack success rates up to 0.95, outperforming existing baselines. Mechanistic analysis reveals the exploitation of embedding-space anisotropy and attention redistribution, highlighting core vulnerabilities in selective memory systems. We evaluate multiple defense strategies and demonstrate their fundamental limitations in mitigating the attack. We release our code to facilitate further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemPoison 是针对 LLM agent 长期记忆的选择性记忆机制的后门投毒攻击：通过对话注入触发词与载荷，使其被共同抽取并抵抗改写。在多种 agent 领域与记忆机制上攻击成功率最高达 0.95，超过既有基线，且所测防御策略均被证明存在根本局限。
Motivation: 现代记忆管线含选择性抽取与改写阶段，既有记忆投毒攻击假设注入内容可直接存入记忆，在真实设定下失效。
Method: 三个组件：语义关系桥把触发词与载荷绑定为连贯陈述以保证共同抽取；实体伪装 (entity masquerading) 让触发词模仿命名实体以抵抗改写；联合嵌入优化把注入文本在嵌入空间聚成紧簇并与良性嵌入保持隔离以隐蔽。
Result: 在不同 agent 领域与记忆机制上评估，攻击成功率最高 0.95，优于既有基线；机理分析指出其利用嵌入空间各向异性与注意力重分配；多种防御策略被评估并显示在缓解该攻击上有根本局限。
Conclusion: 选择性记忆系统的核心脆弱点在于嵌入空间各向异性与注意力重分配，可被联合优化的触发词利用，现有防御不足以缓解。

papers.title: EviLink: Multi-Path Schema Linking with Uncertainty-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Large-Scale Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Schema linking is a difficult and important step in large-scale Text-to-SQL, where systems must identify a compact yet sufficient schema context from large and ambiguous databases. Existing methods often treat schema linking as deterministic selection around a single SQL path, but complex questions may admit multiple valid realizations with different schema needs. We reframe schema linking as uncertainty-aware schema-need inference over multiple plausible SQL paths, where the system distinguishes required schema items from path-dependent uncertain ones and acquires evidence only where needed. We instantiate this reframing with EviLink, which combines multi-hypothesis schema grounding with uncertainty-guided evidence acquisition. Experiments on BIRD-Dev and Spider2-Snow show that this perspective improves the balance among schema completeness, schema relevance, and token cost. On Spider2-Snow, EviLink achieves 93.04% field-level strict recall rate, uses 116.55K average tokens, and improves downstream SQL generation under a fixed generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviLink 把大规模 Text-to-SQL 的 schema linking 从单条 SQL 路径上的确定性选择，重构为对多条候选 SQL 路径的不确定性感知 schema 需求推断：先做多假设 schema grounding，再只在真正需要处用不确定性引导采集证据。在固定生成器下，Spider2-Snow 上达到 93.04% 字段级严格召回率，平均消耗 116.55K token，并改善下游 SQL 生成。
Motivation: 大规模数据库 schema 大且歧义，复杂问题往往对应多条合法 SQL 实现、各自需要不同 schema 上下文；现有方法围绕单一 SQL 路径做确定性选择，容易在完整性、相关性与 token 成本之间失衡。
Method: 将 schema linking 重构为多路径下的不确定性感知 schema 需求推断，区分必需 schema 项与随路径变化的不确定项；实例化为 EviLink，组合多假设 schema grounding (multi-hypothesis schema grounding) 与不确定性引导的证据采集 (uncertainty-guided evidence acquisition)，仅在需要处取证。
Result: 在 BIRD-Dev 与 Spider2-Snow 上实验，改善 schema 完整性、相关性与 token 成本三者的平衡；Spider2-Snow 上字段级严格召回率 93.04%，平均 token 116.55K，并在固定生成器下提升下游 SQL 生成。
Conclusion: 把 schema linking 视为多路径、带不确定性的需求推断并按需取证，可以在可控 token 成本下兼顾 schema 完整性与相关性，并转化为更好的 SQL 生成结果。

papers.title: PhoneWorld: From Real-App Trajectories to Dynamic and Verifiable Environments for Phone-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Real applications provide the training setting closest to phone-agent deployment, but are difficult to reset, scale safely, and verify programmatically. Static screenshots and interaction trajectories preserve realistic evidence but cannot generate new experience. We introduce PhoneWorld, a trace-grounded framework that converts such evidence into runnable, resettable, and verifiable Android environments. PhoneWorld induces a usage-weighted interaction skeleton from observed pages, transitions, and state-changing operations; translates it into a behavior-grounded app specification; realizes the specification through an autonomous build--inspect--repair loop; and synthesizes executable tasks with programmatic verifiers. The resulting suite spans 34 consumer-facing apps across 16 domains and supports an audited online benchmark, verified trajectory generation, and online RL through common reset and verification interfaces. Evaluations with diverse general and open-source GUI agents show that PhoneWorld supports reliable end-to-end online interaction and exposes capabilities complementary to AndroidWorld. Controlled SFT experiments further show that PhoneWorld trajectories complement AndroidWorld supervision, transfer across online and offline benchmarks, and become more effective as data volume and app coverage increase. Under a matched RL budget, combining PhoneWorld mock-app rollouts with real-app rollouts improves performance over real-app RL alone on both real-phone tasks and AndroidWorld. Together, these results demonstrate that trace-grounded executable abstraction can bridge realistic mobile behavior and scalable agent learning, turning limited real-app evidence into a growing supply of controllable and verifiable environments for training and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhoneWorld 把真实 App 的交互轨迹转成可运行、可重置、可程序化验证的 Android 环境，覆盖 16 个领域的 34 个消费级 App。受控 SFT 显示其轨迹与 AndroidWorld 互补且随数据量与 App 覆盖提升而更有效；在匹配 RL 预算下，mock-app rollout 与真实 App rollout 混合训练在真机任务和 AndroidWorld 上均优于仅用真实 App 的 RL。
Motivation: 真实 App 是手机 agent 最接近部署的训练环境，但难以重置、难以安全扩展、也难以程序化验证；静态截图与轨迹虽真实却无法产生新经验。
Method: 从观测页面、状态转移与状态改变操作中归纳使用加权的交互骨架，翻译为行为锚定的 App 规范，经自主 build–inspect–repair 循环实现该规范，再合成带程序化 verifier 的可执行任务；统一的 reset 与 verification 接口同时支撑在线 benchmark、验证轨迹生成与在线 RL。
Result: 环境套件覆盖 16 个领域的 34 个消费级 App；多种通用与开源 GUI agent 的评测表明其支持可靠的端到端在线交互，并具备与 AndroidWorld 互补的能力。受控 SFT 实验显示 PhoneWorld 轨迹补充 AndroidWorld 监督、可在线与离线 benchmark 间迁移，且随数据量与 App 覆盖增加而更有效；匹配 RL 预算下，PhoneWorld mock-app rollout 加真实 App rollout 在真机任务和 AndroidWorld 上均优于仅真实 App RL。
Conclusion: 轨迹锚定的可执行抽象能把有限真实 App 证据变成可扩展、可控可验证的训练与评估环境，且与现有环境混合使用收益最大。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Routing Plateau: Understanding the Accuracy Limits of LLM Routers
papers.abstract_en: LLM routing has become a popular approach to improve the cost-quality trade-off of LLM services by adaptively selecting a model for each query. Recent work has explored a broad range of routing methods, including clustering-based routers, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. Our extensive study of 21 routing methods across five benchmarks reveals a consistent phenomenon that we call the routing plateau (Fig. 1): many methods, including kNN, achieve very similar accuracy and converge to a narrow performance range that remains far below the oracle router. Our analysis supports a correctness-prediction bottleneck hypothesis: current routers primarily learn global-average model performance trends rather than fine-grained, query-specific routing signals. As a result, they collectively fail on queries that require instance-specific routing decisions. Moreover, to understand whether the plateau can be alleviated with a better training setup, we construct a 300K-query benchmark (Nine-by-300k). More data, larger encoders, and end-to-end fine-tuning improve eight routers by 1.24 pp on average, but leave the plateau largely intact. These findings suggest that further progress may require inputs beyond the query itself, such as partial output trajectories that reveal how models attempt the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 21 种 LLM 路由方法在五个基准上的系统研究发现「路由平台期」：包括 kNN 在内的多数方法精度高度趋同，落在一个远离 oracle router 的狭窄区间。作者提出正确性预测瓶颈假设——路由器学到的是模型的全局平均表现趋势而非查询级路由信号；用 300K 查询的 Nine-by-300k 基准改进训练（更多数据、更大编码器、端到端微调）平均只把 8 个路由器抬高 1.24 pp，平台期基本不动，因此进一步突破需要查询之外的输入（如部分输出轨迹）。
Motivation: LLM 路由旨在改善成本-质量权衡，但大量方法精度趋同且远低于 oracle，说明瓶颈不在训练配置；需要判定这一平台期的成因并检验能否靠更好的训练设置缓解。
Method: 对 21 种路由方法（聚类式、学习式分类器、成对排序、置信度方法、kNN 等）在五个基准上做统一研究，并构建 300K 查询的 Nine-by-300k 基准，用更多数据、更大编码器与端到端微调改进其中 8 个路由器，以检验平台期是否可被训练设置消除。
Result: 21 种方法在五个基准上精度高度趋同、落在远离 oracle router 的狭窄区间；Nine-by-300k 上更多数据、更大编码器与端到端微调使 8 个路由器平均提升 1.24 pp，但平台期基本保持不变。
Conclusion: 路由精度受限于正确性预测瓶颈：现有路由器只学到全局平均模型表现而非查询级信号，因此仅靠训练设置改进无法突破平台期，进一步进展需要查询之外的输入（如部分输出轨迹）。

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Reflective On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by providing dense token-level supervision for on-policy rollouts. However, existing OPSD methods often yield limited gains on complex reasoning tasks and suffer from severe training instability. We identify two key causes: conditioning the self-teacher on a complete verified solution encourages imitation of complete reference trajectories rather than extraction of transferable reasoning insights, while indiscriminate full-response distillation imposes superfluous supervision on already-valid reasoning prefixes. Together, these issues suppress reasoning diversity and contribute to late-stage mode collapse. We propose Reflective On-policy Self-Distillation (ROSD), which distills transferable reasoning insights rather than complete reference trajectories. For each erroneous rollout, a self-reflector contrasts it with a correct rollout from the same group to derive a corrective idea and identify the sentence containing the first reasoning error. The corrective idea provides the self-teacher with targeted guidance, while the diagnosed error boundary allows ROSD to mask out the distillation loss over the valid prefix and apply token-level distillation only from the first erroneous sentence onward. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and model backbones show that ROSD consistently outperforms standard OPSD and reinforcement learning baselines, better preserves reasoning diversity, stabilizes training, and mitigates late-stage mode collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiqiZhao1/ROSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROSD 把 on-policy 自蒸馏的对象从完整参考轨迹换成可迁移的推理洞见：自反思器对比错误 rollout 与同组正确 rollout，产出纠正性想法并定位首个错误句，蒸馏损失只从该句起作用、屏蔽已正确的前缀。在多个推理基准与模型骨干上，ROSD 稳定优于标准 OPSD 与强化学习基线，更好保留推理多样性并抑制后期 mode collapse。
Motivation: 现有 OPSD 把自教师条件在完整已验证解上，诱导模仿整条轨迹而非提炼洞见，且对已正确的前缀施加冗余监督，导致推理多样性下降与训练后期 mode collapse。
Method: 对每条错误 rollout，self-reflector 与同组正确 rollout 对比，生成纠正性想法并判定首个错误句；纠正想法作为自教师的定向引导，蒸馏损失在有效前缀上被 mask，仅从首个错误句起做 token 级蒸馏。
Result: 在多个推理基准与多个模型骨干上，ROSD 一致优于标准 OPSD 与强化学习基线，并更好保留推理多样性、稳定训练、缓解后期 mode collapse；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 自蒸馏应提炼可迁移的推理洞见并只监督出错之后的 token，而非模仿完整参考轨迹，这样可同时提升性能与训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Equivalent Flows, Unequal Learning: Clean-Latent Prediction in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Flow samplers consume velocity, but the neural network can predict the clean endpoint and convert it to velocity through a fixed affine readout. We study this choice with JLT, a latent Transformer in a frozen variational autoencoder (VAE) representation. For squared error, the optimal clean and velocity predictors are algebraically equivalent; a finite Transformer assigns different computation to its learned output under the two interfaces. A local Gaussian analysis identifies a known residual response supplied by the readout and isotropic target variance added by velocity prediction. Measured FLUX.2 channel spectra support this geometric distinction: 90% of target variance occupies 83 of 128 clean directions versus 109 velocity directions. Under a matched velocity objective, clean prediction improves ImageNet FID-50K from 6.56 to 2.70 at Base scale and from 2.12 to 1.47 at Large scale, with lower FID at every measured Large checkpoint. Scaling clean prediction to 951M parameters reaches FID-50K 1.19 and IS 271.96. In addition, an objective ablation at Base scale shows that direct clean regression reaches FID-50K 2.38 without time-dependent error weighting. These results show how moving known computation outside the network changes learning under algebraically equivalent flow interfaces. Code: https://github.com/akatsuki-neo/JLT/blob/main/README.md
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结 VAE 潜空间的 flow Transformer (JLT) 上，把已知的仿射读出移到网络外、直接回归干净终点 (clean-latent prediction)，比让网络预测速度场更易学：ImageNet FID-50K 在 Base 从 6.56 降到 2.70，Large 从 2.12 降到 1.47，951M 参数达 FID-50K 1.19 与 IS 271.96。
Motivation: Flow 采样器需要速度场，但网络也可以预测干净终点再经固定仿射读出转成速度；平方误差下两者最优解代数等价，却未说明有限容量 Transformer 在两种接口下学到的计算有何不同。
Method: 以 JLT（冻结 VAE 潜空间上的 latent Transformer）为载体，比较 clean 与 velocity 两种输出接口；用局部高斯分析分解读出提供的已知残差响应与速度预测引入的各向同性目标方差，并用 FLUX.2 通道谱验证几何差异，再做匹配速度目标的对照与目标函数消融。
Result: FLUX.2 通道谱显示 90% 目标方差在 clean 接口下集中于 128 个方向中的 83 个，velocity 接口需 109 个；匹配速度目标下 clean 预测使 ImageNet FID-50K 从 6.56 降到 2.70（Base）、2.12 降到 1.47（Large），Large 每个测得 checkpoint 上 FID 都更低；951M 参数达 FID-50K 1.19、IS 271.96；Base 消融中直接 clean 回归无需时间相关误差加权即达 FID-50K 2.38。
Conclusion: 代数等价的两种 flow 接口在有限网络上并不等价学习：把已知计算移出网络、改用 clean 预测能系统性降低生成 FID，且不依赖时间误差加权。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Preferred, Not Safer: Pairwise Preference Is a Poor Proxy for Clinical Safety
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate whether clinician pairwise preferences provide a reliable signal of clinical safety in large language model (LLM) evaluation using expert feedback from MOOVE (Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation), a clinician-led platform collecting blinded pairwise preferences alongside multi-criterion rubric ratings. Clinicians assign scores on a discrete $[-2, +2]$ scale, where negative values indicate clinically unsafe or misleading content. Using 26{,}804 pairwise judgments across outputs from 13 LLMs, contributed by more than 736 clinicians across 28+ countries, we find that clinician preference is a poor proxy for safety-critical performance. Models ranking highly under pairwise preference can still exhibit substantial rates of clinically meaningful failures ($\leq -1$) on dimensions such as \emph{Harmlessness} and \emph{Accuracy}. These failures are unevenly distributed across specialties, creating domain-specific ``no-go zones'' not visible in aggregate rankings or single-number leaderboards. We further analyze contributing factors including prompt length, refusal and escalation behavior, and the relative contributions of safety-critical versus surface-level features. A substantial fraction of preference votes carry no positive safety signal, while feature decomposition shows that surface-level characteristics explain slightly more preference variation than safety-critical rubric differences. Finally, we introduce a clinically adjusted preference ranking combining pairwise preference with rubric-derived feedback, producing a more safety-aware ordering than raw Bradley--Terry strength alone. Our findings support evaluation practices that separate preference from safety, report safety-critical failure rates directly, and incorporate clinically grounded adjustments when ranking LLMs for clinical decision making.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors because the manuscript was posted without final co-author approval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 MOOVE 临床医生盲测数据检验 LLM 的 pairwise preference 能否代表临床安全：26,804 次判断、13 个模型、736+ 名医生显示偏好排名高的模型仍在 Harmlessness 与 Accuracy 上出现 ≤-1 的临床失败，且失败按专科分布成“no-go zones”。表面特征对偏好方差的解释略高于安全关键 rubric 差异，作者据此提出把偏好与安全分开报告、并用 rubric 校正的临床调整排名替代纯 Bradley–Terry。
Motivation: 临床 LLM 排名普遍用 pairwise preference 或单一 leaderboard，但偏好信号是否承载安全信息、聚合排名是否会掩盖专科级失败，此前缺少大规模临床医生证据。
Method: 基于 MOOVE（clinician-led 平台）的盲测 pairwise preference 加多准则 rubric 评分，临床医生在 [-2, +2] 离散量表打分（≤-1 记为临床不安全/误导）；分析 13 个 LLM 输出的 26,804 次判断，并做特征分解比较安全关键特征与表面特征对偏好方差的贡献，最后提出偏好与 rubric 反馈结合的临床调整排名。
Result: 26,804 次 pairwise 判断、13 个 LLM、736+ 名临床医生、28+ 个国家；偏好排名高的模型在 Harmlessness 与 Accuracy 上仍有 substantial 的 ≤-1 失败率，失败按专科不均分布；相当比例的偏好投票不带正向安全信号；特征分解显示表面特征解释的偏好方差略高于安全关键 rubric 差异；临床调整排名比单独 Bradley–Terry 强度更偏安全。
Conclusion: 临床 LLM 评估应把 preference 与 safety 分开、直接报告安全关键失败率，并在排名时加入临床 grounded 的调整，而不是用偏好排名代替安全判断。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: From Privacy to Generalization: Linear Max-Information Bounds for Differentially Private Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the relationship between generalization and privacy remains a challenge in modern machine learning theory, particularly for deep networks that are trained by variants of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP- SGD). In this work we make progress on this persistent open problem. First, we derive explicit upper bounds on the approximate max-information of any algorithm that fulfills $(ε, δ)$-differential privacy or Rényi differential privacy, thereby going beyond the classical results for pure $ε$-differential privacy. Subsequently, we show even stronger guarantees for two common private learning algorithms, output perturbation with the Gaussian mechanism, and streaming DP-SGD, by exploiting the structure of their internal randomization. As an application of our results, we demonstrate how to obtain non-vacuous PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for deep networks, in which the prior distribution is learned by DP-SGD instead of the classical way of choosing it in a data-independent way.
papers.comment: 41 pages, replacement of v1 which had a mistake in Theorem 1 (multi-epoch training should not have been included)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出 (ε, δ)-差分隐私与 Rényi DP 算法的 approximate max-information 显式上界，并对高斯机制输出扰动与 streaming DP-SGD 利用其内部随机化结构给出更强保证，进而把先验改为由 DP-SGD 学到，得到非空洞 (non-vacuous) 的 PAC-Bayes 深度网络泛化界。
Motivation: DP-SGD 训练下泛化与隐私的关系仍是开放问题，经典 max-information 结果只覆盖 pure ε-DP，无法处理实践中常用的 (ε, δ)-DP 与 Rényi DP。
Method: 先对满足 (ε, δ)-DP 或 Rényi DP 的任意算法推导 approximate max-information 的显式上界；再针对高斯机制输出扰动与 streaming DP-SGD 两类具体私有学习算法，利用其内部随机化结构收紧界；最后作为应用，用 DP-SGD 学习 PAC-Bayes 的先验分布替代数据无关先验。
Result: 得到超出 pure ε-DP 经典结果的 approximate max-information 上界，并对输出扰动与 streaming DP-SGD 给出更强保证；应用上构造出先验由 DP-SGD 学习的非空洞 PAC-Bayes 深度网络泛化界。arXiv v2 为 v1 的替换版，修正了 Theorem 1 中误纳入多轮 (multi-epoch) 训练的错误，全文 41 页。
Conclusion: max-information 路线可把 (ε, δ)-DP 与 Rényi DP 的隐私保证转成可用的泛化结论，且私有学到的先验能让 PAC-Bayes 界在深度网络上非空洞；多轮训练的正确表述以 v2 为准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One-Forcing: Towards Stable One-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in autoregressive diffusion-based video generation have substantially improved the quality of real-time video synthesis. However, most existing methods still require multiple denoising steps, while reducing sampling to a single step often leads to severe quality degradation: trajectory-based consistency distillation methods often produce videos with weak dynamics, whereas DMD-based methods, such as Self-Forcing, tend to generate blurry frames. We attribute this limitation to the teacher trajectories exhibiting highly concentrated curvature near the high-noise endpoint, which poses a fundamental geometric challenge for one-step distillation under the consistency distillation framework. To address these limitations, we propose One-Forcing, a simple yet effective approach that augments the DMD objective with an auxiliary GAN loss for high-quality and efficient one-step video generation. We further find that framewise autoregression stabilizes adversarial training, enabling higher-quality generation with substantially fewer training iterations than chunkwise autoregression. Experiments on VBench show that One-Forcing achieves a total score of 83.76, establishing state-of-the-art performance among one-step causal video generation methods while remaining competitive with strong multi-step approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: One-Forcing 把 DMD 目标加上辅助 GAN 损失，实现单步自回归视频生成，并发现逐帧 (framewise) 自回归比逐块 (chunkwise) 自回归更能稳定对抗训练、用更少训练迭代得到更高质量。在 VBench 上总分 83.76，在单步因果视频生成方法中达到 SOTA，且与强多步方法相当。
Motivation: 自回归扩散视频生成若把采样压到单步，质量严重退化：一致性蒸馏 (consistency distillation) 路线动力偏弱，DMD 路线（如 Self-Forcing）画面模糊；作者归因于 teacher 轨迹在高噪声端点附近曲率高度集中，给一致性蒸馏框架下的单步蒸馏带来几何困难。
Method: 以 DMD 目标为基础，附加一个辅助 GAN 损失做单步蒸馏；采用逐帧自回归而非逐块自回归以稳定对抗训练。
Result: VBench 总分 83.76，在单步因果视频生成方法中为 state-of-the-art，并与强多步方法保持竞争力；framewise 自回归相比 chunkwise 自回归以显著更少的训练迭代达到更高质量。
Conclusion: 单步视频生成的质量瓶颈来自 teacher 轨迹高噪声端的曲率集中，用 GAN 损失补 DMD、并改用逐帧自回归，可以在单步下兼顾质量与训练效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learned Relay Representations for Forward-Thinking Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: When Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) generate sequences through iterative refinement, the rich internal computation over masked positions is discarded, forcing every subsequent refinement step to recompute the valuable internal information stored as model representations. To avoid a hard reset between denoising rounds, we propose Learned Relay Representations (Relay), a method that allows MDMs to be forward-thinking when denoising by explicitly learning how to propagate latent information for the benefit of future denoising steps. Relay introduces a differentiable per-token channel that passes information between forward passes and is trained via truncated backpropagation through time (BPTT). We show that this framework can be scaled to state-of-the-art Diffusion Language Models (DLMs), and is seamlessly compatible with techniques like block diffusion and KV caching. We first provide a thorough justification of the design choices in Relay on a challenging Sudoku-based planning task. We then scale Relay to Fast-dLLM v2, a state-of-the-art DLM, outperforming standard supervised finetuning on coding tasks while reducing inference latency by up to 32%. Our empirical results demonstrate that state-of-the-art DLMs can be explicitly trained to relay latent information forward across decoding steps, advancing the performance-latency Pareto frontier. We provide code for all our experiments.

papers.title: Factored Diffusion Policies:Compositionally Generalized Robot Control with a Single Score Network
papers.abstract_en: Robotic tasks are typically specified by a tuple of factors, such as the object to be grasped, the obstacles to be avoided, the color of the target, and so on. Collecting expert demonstrations for every combination of factor values grows combinatorially. We present factored diffusion policies: a single shared diffusion network trained with per-factor null-token dropout, whose score decomposes additively across factors at inference. Under approximate conditional independence between factors given the action-observation pair, this composition approximates the true joint score with a bounded uniform error, reducing the training-task budget from a product of factor cardinalities to a sum. A trajectory-tube certificate chains this score-level bound through the reverse-time sampling ODE and a contracting tracking controller into a closed-loop state-trajectory tube whose radius factors into an ODE-sensitivity constant and a per-factor score-error budget. Unlike compositional-diffusion methods for control that combine separately trained networks, we use one shared network. Drone racing experiments confirm both the generalization bound and the certificate. On state-based multi-gate racing, the factored policy passes 90% of held-out gates -- matching an oracle -- while a K-network composition baseline collapses to 3%; on vision-based single-gate traversal, it transfers zero-shot to an unseen venue with +11.7pp success-rate gain and 2.4X crash-rate reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 factored diffusion policy：用单个共享扩散网络加逐因子 null-token dropout 训练，推理时把 score 按因子加性分解，使训练任务预算从因子基数的乘积降为求和。在无人机竞速实验中，状态输入多门任务上通过 90% 的留出门（与 oracle 持平），而 K 个网络组合基线塌到 3%；视觉单门任务零样本迁移到未见场地，成功率 +11.7pp、撞机率降 2.4 倍。
Motivation: 机器人任务由对象、障碍、颜色等因子元组指定，为每个因子取值组合收集专家演示的成本随组合数爆炸，组合泛化因此受限。
Method: 单个共享扩散网络以 per-factor null-token dropout 训练，推理时 score 在因子间加性分解；在给定动作-观测对的近似条件独立假设下，该组合以有界一致误差逼近真实联合 score。另给出 trajectory-tube certificate，把 score 级误差界经逆时间采样 ODE 与收缩跟踪控制器串成闭环状态轨迹管，半径分解为 ODE 敏感性常数与逐因子 score 误差预算。
Result: 状态输入多门竞速上，factored policy 通过 90% 的留出门，与 oracle 持平，K-network 组合基线仅 3%；视觉单门穿越上零样本迁移到未见场地，成功率提升 11.7pp，撞机率降低 2.4 倍。训练任务预算由因子基数乘积降为求和。
Conclusion: 单一共享 score 网络的因子分解组合既能逼近联合 score，又能在闭环层面给出可组合的状态轨迹管证书，无人机竞速实验同时验证了泛化界与证书。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reasoning-Trace Collapse: Evaluating the Loss of Explicit Reasoning During Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Explicit reasoning models are trained to produce intermediate reasoning traces before final answers, but downstream fine-tuning is often performed on ordinary instruction--response data that contains no such traces. We show that this mismatch can induce reasoning-trace collapse: a fine-tuned model continues to produce plausible final answers while losing the structurally valid explicit reasoning traces that made it a reasoning model in the first place. We introduce a structural evaluation framework that separates answer correctness from reasoning-trace validity, measuring valid, empty, missing, and truncated reasoning alongside reasoning-conditioned task performance. Using this framework, we study four open-weight reasoning models and find that standard supervised fine-tuning can rapidly suppress valid reasoning traces, and that answer-only metrics can substantially obscure this failure: in several settings, performance conditional on valid reasoning remains high while the rate of valid reasoning falls sharply. We further show that simple loss-masking strategies can substantially mitigate collapse without requiring teacher-generated reasoning traces. These results suggest that evaluations of fine-tuned reasoning models should report structural reasoning reliability metrics in addition to final-answer performance, especially when adaptation data does not contain explicit reasoning traces.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 tables, 3 figures. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不含推理链的普通指令-响应数据上做监督微调，会让推理模型出现「推理链塌缩 (reasoning-trace collapse)」：最终答案仍看似合理，但结构上有效的显式推理链急剧减少。作者提出把答案正确性与推理链有效性分开的结构化评估框架，在四个开源权重推理模型上发现若干设定中「条件于有效推理的性能仍高、有效推理率却骤降」，而简单的 loss-masking 可在不依赖教师生成推理链的情况下明显缓解塌缩。
Motivation: 推理模型靠中间推理链获得能力，但下游微调数据通常只有指令-响应、不含推理链；只看最终答案的指标会掩盖推理结构已被破坏这一失败。
Method: 提出结构化评估框架，把答案正确性与推理链有效性解耦，统计 valid、empty、missing、truncated 四类推理状态，并同时报告条件于推理的任务表现 (reasoning-conditioned task performance)；在四个开源权重推理模型上研究标准监督微调，并测试无需教师推理链的 loss-masking 策略。
Result: 在四个开源权重推理模型上，标准监督微调会迅速压制有效推理链；若干设定中条件于有效推理的性能仍保持较高，而有效推理率大幅下降，说明仅凭答案指标会严重掩盖该失败；简单 loss-masking 能显著缓解塌缩。
Conclusion: 微调后的推理模型应同时报告结构化推理可靠性指标与最终答案表现，尤其当适配数据不含显式推理链时；loss-masking 是不依赖教师推理链的缓解手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Concise and Logically Consistent Conformal Sets for Neuro-Symbolic Concept-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: Neuro-Symbolic Concept-based Models (NeSy-CBMs) are a family of architectures that integrate neural networks with symbolic reasoning for enhanced reliability in high-stakes applications. They work by first extracting high-level concepts from the input and then inferring a task label from these compatibly with given logical constraints. Yet, their label and concept predictions can be overconfident, making it difficult for stakeholders to gauge when the model's decisions can be trusted. We address this issue by integrating ideas from Conformal Prediction (CP), a framework providing rigorous, distribution-free coverage guarantees. We formalize three desiderata -- consistency, coverage, and conciseness -- that any conformal method for NeSy-CBMs should satisfy, and show that existing approaches fall short of at least one. We then introduce COCOCO, a post-hoc framework that conformalizes concepts and labels jointly and reconciles them via a single deduction-abduction revision step. COCOCO satisfies all three desiderata, retains distribution-free coverage, is robust to imperfect knowledge and supports user-specified size budgets. Our experiments on 8 data sets highlight how COCOCO compares favorably against competitors and natural baselines in terms of performance and set size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对神经符号概念模型 (NeSy-CBMs) 预测过度自信的问题，提出事后框架 COCOCO：联合对概念与标签做 conformal prediction，并用单一 deduction-abduction 修订步使二者一致。它同时满足一致性、覆盖性、简洁性三条要求，保留 distribution-free coverage，支持用户指定的集合大小预算，在 8 个数据集上相对竞争方法与自然基线在性能和集合规模上表现更优。
Motivation: NeSy-CBMs 先抽取高层概念再按逻辑约束推理标签，但其概念与标签预测会过度自信，利益相关方难以判断何时可信任模型决策；已有 conformal 方法至少不满足一致性、覆盖性、简洁性三者之一。
Method: COCOCO 是一个事后 (post-hoc) 框架，把 Conformal Prediction 同时施加到概念与标签上并联合校准，再通过一个统一的 deduction-abduction 修订步调和两者；形式化三条 desiderata（consistency、coverage、conciseness），并支持用户给定的集合大小预算，对不完美知识保持稳健。
Result: 在 8 个数据集上，COCOCO 相对竞争方法与自然基线在性能和预测集规模 (set size) 上均表现更优，同时保持 distribution-free coverage；摘要给出的实验性数字为数据集数量 8。
Conclusion: 联合 conformalize 概念与标签并用单一 deduction-abduction 步修订，可以让 NeSy-CBMs 同时拿到一致性、覆盖性与简洁性，而不牺牲 distribution-free 覆盖保证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Embodied AI in 6G Networks: From Intelligent Connectivity to Physical Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Embodied artificial intelligence (AI) couples perception and learned decision making to actions that change the physical world. This coupling distinguishes an embodied agent from a conventional connected controller: the agent maintains task state and uncertainty, reasons about the consequences of actions, and adapts from subsequent observations. Wireless networking becomes relevant when perception, inference, or coordination is distributed, but it should not replace local safety control. This article develops a tutorial perception--communication--action (PCA) architecture that exposes task state, action deadlines, uncertainty, agent intent, and safety envelopes to a 6G orchestration plane. It separates capabilities already addressed by 5G and 5G-Advanced from functions that motivate 6G, including task-state interfaces, semantic freshness, predictive digital twins, and safety-aware coordination across agents. A multi-robot simulation study is retained to illustrate joint sensing, communication, and computation control. The results show where network orchestration improves task utility and where local autonomy remains essential.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE Network Magazine for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 6G 的具身 AI 教程式感知-通信-行动 (PCA) 架构，把任务状态、动作截止时间、不确定性、智能体意图与安全包络显式暴露给 6G 编排平面，并区分 5G/5G-Advanced 已覆盖的能力与真正需要 6G 的功能（任务状态接口、语义新鲜度、预测性数字孪生、跨智能体安全感知协调）。保留的多机器人仿真研究表明：网络编排在感知、推理或协调分布式的环节提升任务效用，而本地自主控制在安全关键环节不可被网络取代。
Motivation: 具身智能体需要维护任务状态与不确定性并根据观测自适应，而现有连接架构把智能体当作常规受控节点；当感知、推理或协调分布到网络上时，缺少暴露任务状态、截止时间与安全包络的编排接口，5G/5G-Advanced 也未覆盖这些功能。
Method: 构建教程式的感知-通信-行动 (perception-communication-action, PCA) 架构，向 6G 编排平面暴露任务状态、动作截止时间、不确定性、智能体意图与安全包络；按能力清单区分 5G/5G-Advanced 已解决项与 6G 动机项（任务状态接口、语义新鲜度、预测性数字孪生、跨智能体安全感知协调），并保留一个多机器人仿真研究来联合演示感知、通信与计算控制。
Result: 多机器人仿真研究给出联合感知、通信与计算控制下的结果：网络编排在部分场景提升任务效用，而在另一些环节本地自主仍然必不可少；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 6G 对具身 AI 的价值在于编排分布式感知-推理-协调并暴露任务状态与安全包络，本地安全控制不能被无线网络编排替代。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 多机器人仿真研究给出联合感知、通信与计算控制下的结果：网络编排在部分场景提升任务效用，而在另一些环节本地自主仍然必不可少；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 6G 对具身 AI 的价值在于编排分布式感知-推理-协调并暴露任务状态与安全包络，本地安全控制不能被无线网络编排替代。

papers.title: Rethinking the State Update Gate for Long-Sequence Recurrent 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction under a strict constant-memory budget hinges on how the recurrent state is updated as the stream evolves. We profile TTT3R-style per-token gates across five benchmarks and discover a structural bottleneck: the gate is intrinsically bounded in magnitude (median $0.31$; never exceeding $0.6$) and nearly frame-invariant, yielding an effective memory horizon of only $\sim$3 frames per state token, which serves as the structural origin of long-sequence drift. We trace this to a missing axis: existing inference-time methods modulate updates only at the per-token, intra-frame level, while the orthogonal frame-level question of \emph{how strongly each frame should contribute to the state} has been treated as content-independent. We close this gap with a scalar frame-level gate $α_t \in (0, 1]$ derived in closed form from frame-to-frame changes of internal features---a graded write weight, inspired by classical Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) keyframe selection, that never discards a frame and requires no parameters, no training, and no extra forward pass. Across six benchmarks spanning camera pose, video depth, and 3D reconstruction at sequence lengths up to $4,661$ frames, our gate cuts ATE by $51\%$ on long TUM-RGBD pose sequences, reduces AbsRel by $13.0\%$ on Bonn video depth, and on KITTI long-sequence pose estimation surpasses both LongStream and Keyframe-VO in average ATE, while retaining strictly constant memory at zero training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 流式 3D 重建中 TTT3R 式逐 token 门控幅度被限死（中位数 0.31、从不超过 0.6）且几乎不随帧变化，每个状态 token 的有效记忆跨度只有约 3 帧，这是长序列漂移的结构性来源。作者补上缺失的帧级维度：由帧间内部特征变化闭式导出标量写权重 α_t∈(0,1]，灵感来自 SLAM 关键帧选择，不丢帧、无参数、无需训练。在最长 4,661 帧的六个基准上，长 TUM-RGBD 位姿 ATE 降 51%，Bonn 视频深度 AbsRel 降 13.0%，KITTI 长序列平均 ATE 超过 LongStream 与 Keyframe-VO，且严格恒定内存。
Motivation: 流式 3D 重建受严格恒定内存约束，现有推理时方法只在逐 token、帧内层面调制更新，而“每帧该以多强程度写入状态”这一正交的帧级问题一直被当作与内容无关处理，导致长序列漂移。
Method: 先在五个基准上剖析 TTT3R 式逐 token 门控，定位其幅度受限且帧间几乎不变的结构瓶颈；再提出由帧间内部特征变化闭式推导的标量帧级门 α_t∈(0,1]，作为分级写权重（借鉴 SLAM 关键帧选择），不丢弃任何帧、无参数、无训练、不增加前向传播。
Result: 在跨相机位姿、视频深度与 3D 重建、序列长度达 4,661 帧的六个基准上：长 TUM-RGBD 位姿序列 ATE 降低 51%；Bonn 视频深度 AbsRel 降低 13.0%；KITTI 长序列位姿估计平均 ATE 超过 LongStream 与 Keyframe-VO；剖析给出的门控中位数 0.31、从不超过 0.6，有效记忆跨度约 3 帧/token。全程保持严格恒定内存且零训练成本。
Conclusion: 长序列流式重建的漂移源于帧级写入强度被当作内容无关，而一个由特征帧间变化闭式给出、无需训练的标量帧级门即可在恒定内存下同时改善位姿与深度精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HighSync: High-Quality Lip Synchronization via Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We present HighSync, an end-to-end diffusion-based framework for high-fidelity lip synchronization that generates photorealistic talking-face videos aligned with arbitrary input audio. Existing approaches consistently struggle to reconcile image quality with synchronization accuracy, producing either visually degraded outputs or temporally inconsistent lip movements. HighSync addresses both challenges simultaneously and, to our knowledge, is the first lip sync model to operate natively at 512*512 resolution, positioning it as a viable solution for professional production environments such as the film and broadcast industries. Central to our approach is the identification and systematic elimination of a data leakage phenomenon that has silently undermined temporal modeling in prior work, preventing models from developing a genuine dependence on the audio signal. Comprehensive evaluations across both perceptual quality and synchronization accuracy metrics confirm that HighSync achieves state-of-the-art performance on both fronts. Source code, pre-trained models, and supplementary video results are publicly available at: https://github.com/saeed5959/high_sync
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HighSync 是端到端 latent diffusion 说话人像生成框架，可对任意输入音频生成 512×512 分辨率的高保真口型同步视频，并系统消除此前工作中的数据泄漏现象——该泄漏让模型并未真正依赖音频信号。在感知质量与同步精度两类指标上均达到 state-of-the-art，代码与预训练模型已开源。
Motivation: 现有口型同步方法难以兼顾画面质量与同步精度，往往输出视觉劣化或时序不一致的口型；更严重的是先前工作中存在数据泄漏，使模型无法形成对音频信号的真实依赖。
Method: 端到端 diffusion-based 框架，以任意输入音频为条件生成说话人脸视频；核心是识别并系统性消除数据泄漏现象，恢复时序建模对音频的依赖；据作者所知是首个原生在 512×512 分辨率运行的口型同步模型。
Result: 在感知质量与同步精度两类指标上的综合评估确认 HighSync 在两方面均取得 state-of-the-art 表现；原生支持 512×512 分辨率，面向影视与广播等专业制作环境；论文含 12 页、7 图、5 表。
Conclusion: 消除数据泄漏是让口型同步模型真正依赖音频、从而同时提升画质与同步精度的关键；512×512 原生分辨率使其可用于专业制作，代码与预训练模型公开可复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Fused Prior Transfer for Controllable Generative Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Learned image compression achieves competitive rate-distortion performance, but very-low-bitrate reconstruction remains challenging because the transmitted representation cannot preserve fine textures and local structures. Perceptual and generative codecs synthesize missing details using reconstruction priors, while controllable codecs allow one model to cover different bitrate and reconstruction preferences. However, existing codebook-based controllable designs generally rely on single-codebook reconstruction priors. We propose Adaptive Fused Prior Transfer for Controllable Generative Image Compression (AFP-GIC), a controllable codec that transfers an adaptive fused prior from a frozen pretrained AdaCode model. Encoder-side fused-prior features guide latent formation, while the decoder predicts a compatible fused prior from the compressed representation and selected control variables, enabling prior-guided reconstruction without transmitting the fused prior itself. A motivating analysis shows that better decoder-side fused-prior alignment tightens a reconstruction-error upper bound and that the fused-prior family contains single-codebook choices as special cases. Under the unified benchmark, AFP-GIC achieves 18.1% lower decoder latency and uses 31.10 million (20.5%) fewer inference parameters than DC-VIC. Experiments on Kodak, CLIC2020, and DIV2K show competitive PSNR and SSIM, with the clearest perceptual gains in NIQE scores and very-low-bitrate visual comparisons.
papers.comment: Revised version. 25 pages including 3 pages of supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/yifeipet/AFP_GIC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AFP-GIC 提出自适应融合先验迁移的可控生成图像压缩：从冻结的预训练 AdaCode 模型迁移融合先验，编码器用融合先验特征引导 latent，解码器仅凭压缩表示与控制变量预测兼容先验，无需传输先验本身。在统一基准上比 DC-VIC 低 18.1% 解码延迟、少用 3110 万（20.5%）推理参数，Kodak、CLIC2020、DIV2K 上 PSNR/SSIM 有竞争力，NIQE 与极低码率视觉对比的感知增益最明显。
Motivation: 极低码率下传输表示保不住细纹理与局部结构，现有可控编解码器多依赖单一 codebook 重建先验，覆盖不同码率与重建偏好时表现受限。
Method: AFP-GIC 从冻结的预训练 AdaCode 迁移自适应融合先验：编码器侧融合先验特征引导 latent 形成，解码器从压缩表示与所选控制变量预测兼容的融合先验，实现先验引导重建而不传输先验；配套动机分析给出解码端先验对齐收紧重建误差上界的论证，并说明融合先验族以单一 codebook 选择为特例。
Result: 统一基准下 AFP-GIC 解码延迟比 DC-VIC 低 18.1%，推理参数少 3110 万（20.5%）；在 Kodak、CLIC2020、DIV2K 上 PSNR 与 SSIM 具竞争力，NIQE 分数与极低码率视觉对比中感知增益最明显。
Conclusion: 不传输先验、改由解码端预测融合先验，可在可控生成图像压缩中同时压低解码延迟与参数量，并在极低码率下拿到最清晰的感知收益。

papers.title: EfficientTDMPC: Improved MPC Objectives for Sample-Efficient Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EfficientTDMPC, a sample-efficient model-based reinforcement learning method for continuous control built on the TD-MPC family of algorithms. Central to this family is a planner that aims to find an action sequence that maximizes the estimated return. The return is estimated using a learned model and value networks, each of which can introduce error. EfficientTDMPC introduces three contributions that improve performance by aiming to reduce this error. First, we introduce a multi-horizon planning objective that evaluates the value at different rollout depths and averages them. Second, to our knowledge we are the first to train a value-equivalent dynamics ensemble. Our improved objective then averages over rollouts from multiple dynamics heads. Third, we add pessimistic reanalyze for tasks that can terminate early. Applying our contributions to a recent baseline (BMPC) yields EfficientTDMPC, which to our knowledge is the new state of the art in sample efficiency on HumanoidBench and the DeepMind Control Suite, reaching BMPC's final aggregated performance using 57\% fewer environment steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EfficientTDMPC 在 TD-MPC 系列的模型式强化学习框架下改进 MPC 目标：多深度规划目标平均不同 rollout 深度的价值估计，价值等价 (value-equivalent) 动力学集成对多个 dynamics head 的 rollout 取平均，并对可提前终止的任务加入悲观 reanalyze。在 HumanoidBench 与 DeepMind Control Suite 上，用比基线 BMPC 少 57% 的环境步数即达到其最终聚合性能。
Motivation: TD-MPC 家族的 planner 依赖学习得到的模型与价值网络估计回报，两者各自引入误差，导致连续控制任务的样本效率受限。
Method: 三项改动：多深度规划目标在不同 rollout 深度评估价值并取平均；首个价值等价动力学集成 (value-equivalent dynamics ensemble)，目标对多个 dynamics head 的 rollout 平均；对可提前终止的任务加入悲观 reanalyze (pessimistic reanalyze)。三者叠加在近期基线 BMPC 上构成 EfficientTDMPC。
Result: 在 HumanoidBench 与 DeepMind Control Suite 上，以比 BMPC 少 57% 的环境步数达到 BMPC 的最终聚合性能，作者称其为该设定下样本效率的新 state of the art。
Conclusion: 降低 planner 中模型与价值估计误差的三条目标改造，可以在连续控制上以显著更少环境步数匹配既有强基线的最终性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian Relational Graph Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Relational graph learning enables predictive modeling over relational databases by directly capturing dependencies across interconnected tables. While relational graph Transformers extend the receptive field beyond local message passing, a larger receptive field does not necessarily provide more useful information: sampling must preserve relational structure without introducing excessive semantically irrelevant nodes, while attention must account for the temporal relevance of the retained information. We propose GelGT, a Gaussian relational graph transformer that explicitly addresses these challenges. GelGT introduces a structure-semantic collaborative sampling strategy to preserve structural connectivity while filtering irrelevant semantic information, and incorporates a Gaussian graph attention mechanism with a learnable Gaussian bias on the sampled subgraphs to dynamically encode temporal dependencies. We provide theoretical analysis characterizing the structural preservation, semantic refinement, and temporal discrimination of these mechanisms. Experiments on \textbf{7} real-world relational datasets covering \textbf{21} prediction tasks show that GelGT consistently outperforms existing relational graph learning methods, with improvements of up to \textbf{13.8\%}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GelGT 面向关系型数据库上的预测建模，用结构-语义协同采样在保留结构连通性的同时过滤语义无关节点，再在采样子图上用带可学习高斯偏置的图注意力动态编码时间依赖。在覆盖 21 个预测任务的 7 个真实关系数据集上，相对已有关系图学习方法最高提升 13.8%。
Motivation: 关系图 Transformer 扩大了感受野，但更大的感受野不等于更有用的信息：采样可能引入过多语义无关节点，注意力也未考虑保留信息的时间相关性。
Method: GelGT 包含两个核心机制：结构-语义协同采样 (structure-semantic collaborative sampling) 在保持结构连通性的同时过滤无关语义信息；高斯图注意力 (Gaussian graph attention) 在采样子图上施加可学习的高斯偏置以编码时间依赖。作者对结构保持、语义精炼与时间判别性给出理论分析。
Result: 在 7 个真实世界关系数据集、覆盖 21 个预测任务的实验中，GelGT 一致优于已有关系图学习方法，提升最高达 13.8%。
Conclusion: 关系图上的预测应同时约束采样的结构与语义质量，并让注意力显式建模时间相关性；扩大感受野本身不足以带来更好的预测。

papers.title: EverAnimate: Minute-Scale Human Animation via Latent Flow Restoration
papers.abstract_en: We propose EverAnimate, an efficient post-training method for long-horizon animated video generation that preserves visual quality and character identity. Long-form animation remains challenging because highly dynamic human motion must be synthesized against relatively static environments, making chunk-based generation prone to accumulated drift: (i) low-level quality drift, such as progressive degradation of static backgrounds, and (ii) high-level semantic drift, such as inconsistent character identity and view-dependent attributes. To address this issue, EverAnimate restores drifted flow trajectories by anchoring generation to a persistent latent context memory, consisting of two complementary mechanisms. (i) Persistent Latent Propagation maintains a context memory across chunks to propagate identity and motion in latent space while mitigating temporal forgetting. (ii) Restorative Flow Matching introduces an implicit restoration objective during sampling through velocity adjustment, improving within-chunk fidelity. With only lightweight LoRA tuning, EverAnimate outperforms state-of-the-art long-animation methods in both short- and long-horizon settings: at 10 seconds, it improves PSNR/SSIM by 8%/7% and reduces LPIPS/FID by 22%/11%; at 90 seconds, the gains increase to 15%/15% and 32%/27%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EverAnimate 是面向长时程人物动画视频生成的轻量后训练方法，用持久潜在上下文记忆锚定分块生成以修复漂移的 flow 轨迹：Persistent Latent Propagation 跨块传播身份与运动以抑制时间遗忘，Restorative Flow Matching 在采样时用速度调整做隐式修复。仅用 LoRA 微调，10 秒设置下 PSNR/SSIM 提升 8%/7%、LPIPS/FID 下降 22%/11%，90 秒下增益扩大到 15%/15% 与 32%/27%。
Motivation: 长程动画需在相对静态的背景中合成高动态人体运动，分块生成会累积两类漂移：低层画质漂移（静态背景逐步退化）与高层语义漂移（人物身份与视角相关属性不一致）。
Method: 后训练阶段以持久潜在上下文记忆锚定生成，含两个机制：Persistent Latent Propagation 在 chunk 间维护上下文记忆、在 latent space 传播身份与运动以缓解时间遗忘；Restorative Flow Matching 在采样中通过 velocity adjustment 引入隐式修复目标，提升块内保真度。仅用轻量 LoRA 微调。
Result: 对比现有长动画方法 (state-of-the-art long-animation methods)：10 秒设置 PSNR/SSIM 提升 8%/7%，LPIPS/FID 降低 22%/11%；90 秒设置增益扩大到 PSNR/SSIM 15%/15%、LPIPS/FID 32%/27%，短时程与长时程设置下均占优。
Conclusion: 以持久潜在记忆加采样期速度调整修复漂移轨迹，配合轻量 LoRA 即可同时保住长时程动画的画质与人物身份，且时程越长相对增益越大。

papers.title: Distribution-Aware Programming: Learning Specialized Solvers from Experience
papers.abstract_en: Many optimization problems are solved repeatedly on instances drawn from the same underlying distribution. In this setting, a system can begin with a general-purpose solver and use experience from previous instances to learn a cheaper way to solve future ones. We formalize this as \emph{distribution-aware programming}: samples from an unknown deployment distribution are used to produce executable solver code whose quality and runtime generalize to new instances. A simple analysis shows how sample access interpolates between distribution-oblivious and distribution-informed algorithm design, and when the offline cost of specialization is recovered through lower deployment cost. We instantiate this framework with an LLM agent that proposes structural hypotheses, analyzes training instances, and synthesizes specialized solver code; the LLM is used only before deployment. Across \(21\) structured combinatorial-optimization distributions, the synthesized solvers achieve high quality while often replacing generic search or optimization with smaller distribution-specific computations. Against released PACE competition solvers, our method remains competitive while using substantially less runtime: \(75\)--\(125\times\) less on PACE 2025 Dominating Set, \(80\)--\(96\times\) less on Hitting Set, and more than \(34{,}000\times\) less on the PACE 2024 OCM exact track. More broadly, the results suggest using AI not only to solve optimization problems, but to learn how recurring distributions should be solved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 distribution-aware programming：用部署分布的样本让 LLM agent 在部署前合成专用求解器代码，把通用搜索换成更小的分布特定计算。在 21 个结构化组合优化分布上，合成求解器相对 PACE 竞赛求解器保持竞争力且运行时间大幅下降：PACE 2025 Dominating Set 少 75–125 倍，Hitting Set 少 80–96 倍，PACE 2024 OCM 精确赛道少 34,000 倍以上。
Motivation: 同一分布上反复出现的优化实例每次都用通用求解器从头解，离线特化的成本没有被摊薄；需要一个把样本访问转化为更便宜部署求解的正式框架。
Method: 形式化 distribution-aware programming：未知部署分布的样本生成可执行求解器代码，其质量与运行时在新实例上泛化；给出样本访问如何在 distribution-oblivious 与 distribution-informed 算法设计之间插值、以及离线特化成本何时被更低部署成本收回的分析。实例化为一个 LLM agent，提出结构假设、分析训练实例并合成专用求解器代码，LLM 仅在部署前使用。
Result: 在 21 个结构化组合优化分布上，合成求解器达到高质量，且常以更小的分布特定计算替代通用搜索或优化；相对已发布的 PACE 竞赛求解器，运行时间少 75–125 倍（PACE 2025 Dominating Set）、80–96 倍（Hitting Set）、超过 34,000 倍（PACE 2024 OCM 精确赛道），同时保持竞争力。
Conclusion: AI 的用处不止于直接解优化问题，而在于学习反复出现的分布应当怎样被求解；特化在离线成本可被更低部署成本收回时划算。

papers.title: Synthetic American Option Pricing via Jump-HMM-Driven Heston Implied Volatility
papers.abstract_en: Valuing American options along simulated stock paths requires an implied volatility (IV) for every option on every date. A stock-return model alone does not provide it. We built a simulator that assigned IV to American options on simulated dates for any chosen stock model. We fitted parametric and neural IV surfaces to vendor option quotes for 31 tickers. Each surface predicted IV from moneyness and time to expiration. Stock paths came from a jump hidden Markov model with capped daily returns. Each day, every option's implied variance moved partway toward its surface prediction, following the form of the Heston variance equation. Random shocks tended to raise IV when the stock fell. A binomial tree converted IV into option values and price sensitivities. Neural surfaces fitted by sector or ticker matched the quotes more closely than one parametric surface. Their errors still varied by date and carried into dollar prices. Repricing identical stock paths under five ways of updating IV changed option values before expiration, and the worst simulated short-position losses at a fixed horizon. Payoffs at expiration did not change. In forecasts of later Goldman Sachs and Eli Lilly option prices, stochastic IV did little better than fixed IV. Rerunning the forecasts with the realized stock paths pointed to stock prediction as a major source of option-price error. The hidden Markov model and an adaptive-volatility model predicted stock prices about as accurately as assuming no change, and tuning found no gain from predicting direction. The adaptive-volatility model improved predicted price ranges for Eli Lilly but not Goldman Sachs. The simulator supported reproducible comparisons of IV and stock assumptions but did not forecast better than simpler alternatives. Complete option histories and prices consistent across strikes are needed before simulated prices can replace market data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建一个为模拟路径上的美式期权逐日赋隐含波动率 (IV) 的模拟器：股价走带日收益上限的 jump HMM，每日隐含方差按 Heston 方差方程形式向 IV 曲面预测部分收敛，再用二叉树折算期权价值。按行业或个股拟合的神经 IV 曲面比单一参数曲面更贴合 31 只股票的报价，但五种 IV 更新方式会改变到期前的期权价值与固定期限最坏空头损失、不改变到期 payoff；在 Goldman Sachs 与 Eli Lilly 的后续价格预测中随机 IV 只略好于固定 IV，重跑显示误差主要来自股价预测。
Motivation: 沿模拟股价路径给每个交易日的每只美式期权定价需要逐日 IV，而股价模型本身不产生 IV；同时要检验期权价格误差究竟来自 IV 假设还是股价预测。
Method: 用带 capped daily returns 的 jump hidden Markov model 生成股价路径；对 31 只股票的 vendor option quotes 拟合参数型与神经 IV 曲面（输入为 moneyness 与 time to expiration）；每日每只期权的隐含方差按 Heston 方差方程形式向曲面预测部分收敛，冲击使股价下跌时 IV 上升；用二叉树把 IV 转为期权价值与价格敏感度，并比较五种 IV 更新方式。
Result: 按行业或个股拟合的神经曲面比单一参数曲面更贴近报价，但误差按日期变化并传导到美元价格；五种 IV 更新方式在到期前改变期权价值与固定期限最坏模拟空头损失，到期 payoff 不变；Goldman Sachs 与 Eli Lilly 的后续期权价格预测中随机 IV 仅略好于固定 IV，用实现股价路径重跑指向股价预测是期权价格误差的主要来源；HMM 与自适应波动率模型的股价预测精度与假设不变相当，调参未带来方向预测增益，自适应波动率模型改善 Eli Lilly 的价格区间但不改善 Goldman Sachs。
Conclusion: 该模拟器支持对 IV 假设与股价假设做可复现比较，但并不比更简单的替代方案预报得更好；在拿到完整期权历史与跨行权价一致的价格之前，模拟价格还不能替代市场数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Select Source Domains: Proxy-Rewarded Policy Optimization for Molecular OOD Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Molecular property prediction under severe out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts remains challenging because conventional scaffold splits can retain local structural similarity between training and test molecules, while adaptation from heterogeneous source domains may cause negative transfer. We introduce SCOPE-Bench, a scaffold-cluster benchmark constructed by partitioning Bemis-Murcko scaffolds in an explicit physicochemical descriptor space, and POMA, a retrieve-compose-adapt framework for source-domain selection when target property labels are unavailable. POMA uses unlabeled target structures to retrieve labeled source scaffolds as proxy targets. A policy is trained from reductions in proxy-task mean absolute error after adaptation, and the selected source subset is then used for target adaptation with covariance alignment at the whole-molecule and BRICS-derived substructure levels. We evaluate HOMO, LUMO, and HOMO-LUMO gap prediction on QM9 using three 3D molecular backbones and 15 target-scaffold tasks. Relative to conventional scaffold splitting, prediction errors on SCOPE-Bench increase by up to 8.0-fold, with a mean increase of 5.9-fold. Relative to the supervised baseline under the strict OOD split, POMA reduces mean absolute error by up to 11.2%, with an average relative reduction of 6.2% over the nine backbone-property combinations. These results support adaptive source selection as a useful strategy for molecular prediction under strong structural distribution shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SCOPE-Bench：在显式理化描述符空间里对 Bemis-Murcko scaffold 聚类切分，使训练/测试分子的局部结构相似性被真正切断；相对常规 scaffold split，预测误差最高涨 8.0 倍、平均涨 5.9 倍。配套提出 POMA（retrieve-compose-adapt）：用无标签目标结构检索带标签源 scaffold 作代理目标，按适配后代理任务 MAE 的下降训练策略选择源子集，再在全分子与 BRICS 子结构两个层级做 covariance alignment 适配目标。
Motivation: 常规 scaffold split 仍保留训练与测试分子间的局部结构相似性，导致 OOD 难度被高估；而从异构源域适配又可能产生负迁移，且目标属性标签不可用时无从挑选源域。
Method: SCOPE-Bench 在理化描述符空间聚类划分 Bemis-Murcko scaffold；POMA 按 retrieve-compose-adapt 组织：用无标签目标结构检索带标签源 scaffold 作为 proxy target，依据适配后代理任务 MAE 的下降训练选择策略，再用所选源子集做目标适配，协方差对齐同时在 whole-molecule 与 BRICS-derived substructure 两个层级进行。
Result: 在 QM9 上评估 HOMO、LUMO、HOMO-LUMO gap 三个属性，用 3D 分子 backbone、共 15 个 target-scaffold 任务。相对常规 scaffold splitting，SCOPE-Bench 上预测误差最高增加 8.0 倍、平均增加 5.9 倍；相对严格 OOD 划分下的监督基线，POMA 使 MAE 最高下降 11.2%，在九个 backbone-property 组合上平均相对下降 6.2%。
Conclusion: 在强结构分布偏移下，按代理奖励自适应挑选源域是分子属性预测的有效策略；同时说明常规 scaffold split 会因残留局部相似性而低估 OOD 难度。

summary_sections.result: 在 QM9 上评估 HOMO、LUMO、HOMO-LUMO gap 三个属性，用 3D 分子 backbone、共 15 个 target-scaffold 任务。相对常规 scaffold splitting，SCOPE-Bench 上预测误差最高增加 8.0 倍、平均增加 5.9 倍；相对严格 OOD 划分下的监督基线，POMA 使 MAE 最高下降 11.2%，在九个 backbone-property 组合上平均相对下降 6.2%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在强结构分布偏移下，按代理奖励自适应挑选源域是分子属性预测的有效策略；同时说明常规 scaffold split 会因残留局部相似性而低估 OOD 难度。

papers.title: Confidently Deceptive: On the Relationship Between Confidence and Deception in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The increasing capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are being accompanied by deep-rooted risks of deceptive behaviours that cause models to produce misleading outputs in service of a contextually or experimentally induced goal. The harm posed by such behaviours depends not only on the content of deceptive outputs but also how confidently models deliver them, since confidence has a major impact on how persuasive the communication is to end users. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive study on the crucial relationship between confidence and deception across existing deception benchmarks and different model families, while covering both verbalized numerical and logit-based aggregated confidence. Through this, we reveal how confidently models behave when being deceptive. We demonstrate that when producing deceptive rather than honest responses, models exhibit a gap between their belief (how likely they think a claim is to be true) and their commitment (how firmly they assert and would defend that claim). LLMs produce persuasive deceptive claims while reporting low belief in their factual correctness. Their reported commitment to deceptive responses can easily be increased through further prompting and preference fine-tuning, with smaller and condition-dependent changes in reported belief. However, we show that low reported belief remains comparatively invariant and provides a strong signal for detecting deception in the evaluated settings. Using only an API call, our approach achieves detection scores of up to 0.99 for induced deception and 0.89 for emergent deception. This ultimately shows how confidence can be a practical tool for detecting and diagnosing deceptive behaviour in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 说谎时信念与承诺分离：模型给出有说服力的欺骗性回答，却同时报告低信念；承诺可被继续提示和偏好微调轻易抬高，而低信念在所评估设置中保持相对稳定，可直接用作欺骗检测信号。仅用一次 API 调用，诱导式欺骗检测分数达 0.99，自发式欺骗达 0.89。
Motivation: 欺骗输出的危害不仅取决于内容，还取决于模型说得多自信，因为自信程度直接影响对用户的说服力；但模型在欺骗时的置信行为此前缺少跨基准、跨模型族的系统刻画。
Method: 在现有欺骗基准与多个模型族上做综合研究，同时覆盖口头数值置信 (verbalized numerical confidence) 与基于 logit 的聚合置信，比较欺骗与诚实回答下的信念 (belief) 与承诺 (commitment) 差距，并测试继续提示与偏好微调 (preference fine-tuning) 对两者的影响，最后仅用 API 调用做欺骗检测。
Result: 欺骗性回答呈现信念与承诺的落差：模型报告低信念却产出有说服力的欺骗；继续提示与偏好微调可轻易提高报告的承诺，而报告信念的变化较小且依赖条件；低报告信念在所评估设置中相对不变，仅用一次 API 调用的检测分数对诱导式欺骗 (induced deception) 最高 0.99，对自发式欺骗 (emergent deception) 最高 0.89。
Conclusion: 置信度可作为检测与诊断 LLM 欺骗行为的实用工具，其中低报告信念是最稳健的检测信号。

papers.title: When Does Equivariance Help? Canonical Alignment in Neural Fluid Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates can accelerate computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations by orders of magnitude, but practical deployment in engineering and healthcare applications requires architectures that scale to high-resolution meshes and learn effectively from limited data. Explicit equivariance offers a principled inductive bias, yet its accuracy benefits may depend on the prediction task and the distribution of anatomical orientations. We investigate this dependence across three hemodynamic benchmarks with different degrees of natural canonical alignment. To support this study, we introduce the Anchored-Branched Geometric Algebra Transformer (AB-GATr), an $E(3)$-equivariant surrogate that efficiently predicts coupled surface and volume quantities. Across these benchmarks, AB-GATr consistently outperforms the evaluated non-equivariant models, including variants trained with rotational augmentation, while achieving accuracy competitive with $E(3)$-equivariant LaB-GATr at substantially lower training cost. In comparison, rotational augmentation provides inconsistent benefits across architectures and can reduce accuracy. A controlled experiment on ShapeNet-Car shows that strong canonical alignment can favor non-equivariant models, but their accuracy generally deteriorates as training orientations broaden and can decline sharply under broader test rotations. We further investigate these patterns using extended symmetry-breaking diagnostics and probes of the predictive information associated with canonical alignment across all benchmarks. Together, these results support explicit equivariance for the evaluated hemodynamic tasks with natural orientation variation, while showing that its accuracy benefits depend on the task and orientation distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三个具有不同程度自然取向对齐的血流动力学基准上比较显式等变性与旋转增广：提出 E(3) 等变代理 AB-GATr（Anchored-Branched Geometric Algebra Transformer），同时预测耦合的表面与体数据量，一致性优于所评估的非等变模型（含旋转增广变体），训练成本显著低于 LaB-GATr。ShapeNet-Car 受控实验显示强 canonical alignment 会偏向非等变模型，但其精度随训练取向变宽而劣化、在更宽的测试旋转下急剧下降，因此血流任务应选显式等变架构。
Motivation: 神经流体代理要扩展到高分辨率网格并从有限数据学习，显式等变性提供归纳偏置，但其精度收益可能取决于预测任务与解剖取向分布，缺少跨不同取向对齐程度的系统比较。
Method: 提出 Anchored-Branched Geometric Algebra Transformer (AB-GATr)，一个 E(3) 等变代理，高效预测耦合的表面与体数据量；在三个血流动力学基准上与非等变模型（含旋转增广变体）及 E(3) 等变的 LaB-GATr 对比，并在 ShapeNet-Car 上做取向对齐受控实验，辅以扩展的对称性破缺诊断 (symmetry-breaking diagnostics) 与对 canonical alignment 相关预测信息的探针。
Result: AB-GATr 在三个血流基准上一致性优于所评估的非等变模型（含旋转增广变体），精度与 E(3) 等变 LaB-GATr 相当而训练成本大幅降低；旋转增广在各架构上收益不一致、甚至降低精度；ShapeNet-Car 受控实验中强 canonical alignment 有利于非等变模型，但其精度随训练取向变宽而劣化，在更宽的测试旋转下可急剧下降。
Conclusion: 对具有自然取向变化的血流动力学任务应支持显式等变性，但等变性的精度收益取决于任务与取向分布：canonical alignment 强时非等变模型可占优，取向变宽时其优势消失。

papers.title: PyroAdapt: Adapting Wildfire Prediction under Spatial Heterogeneity and Temporal Shift
papers.abstract_en: Prediction of wildfire occurrence is a rare-event problem compounded by spatial heterogeneity and temporal distribution shift, as fire occurrences are vastly outnumbered by non-occurrences, and predictor--fire relationship varies across space and time. Models trained on historical fire data may perform poorly under new conditions and require adaptation to the target distribution before operational use. We propose PyroAdapt, a pretrain--retrieve--rank framework that adapts a pretrained model to target conditions by retrieving historical locations with similar conditions and fine-tuning on the retrievals through risk ranking. For spatial adaptation, we condition risk on terrain, ecoregion embeddings, and fire rates, accounting for spatial context in the retrieval, and learn risk ordering from same-day fire--nonfire cell pairs. We compare direct ranking, residual pairwise DPO (RDPO), and selective ranking through a unified score-gap formulation that characterizes their gradient allocation. Over California (discretized into 666 0.25x0.25 grid cells), these objectives raise daily average precision from 21.62% for continued focal fine-tuning to 24.35--24.57%, and Top5% recall from 18.70% to 22.11--22.79%. Under a fixed daily detection budget of 34 cells (5% area), selective ranking captures 344 additional positive cell--days. For fires in the top 5%/10%/20% of dry matter consumption, selective ranking raises recall by 39.70/28.18/20.50 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, rolling evaluations over Yosemite show that the gains from ranking persist under temporal distribution shift. Together, these results show that PyroAdapt prioritizes the most fire-prone locations under a daily budget constraint and detects more extreme fire events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyroAdapt 用 pretrain–retrieve–rank 框架把预训练野火模型适配到目标区域：检索条件相似的历史格点并以同日火/非火配对做风险排序。在加州 666 个 0.25° 网格上，日均 AP 从持续 focal 微调的 21.62% 提到 24.35–24.57%，Top5% recall 从 18.70% 提到 22.11–22.79%；固定每日 34 格（5% 面积）预算下 selective ranking 多抓 344 个正例格点-日。
Motivation: 野火发生是极不平衡的稀有事件，且预测因子与火情的关系随空间和时间变化，历史数据训练的模型在新条件下性能下降，需要在业务使用前适配到目标分布。
Method: pretrain–retrieve–rank：以地形、ecoregion embedding 和火率作为空间条件检索相似历史位置，在检索结果上微调并用同日 fire–nonfire 格点对学习风险排序；将 direct ranking、residual pairwise DPO (RDPO) 与 selective ranking 统一到 score-gap 形式下刻画梯度分配。

Conclusion: 在每日预算约束下，基于检索的风险排序能优先定位最易起火的格点并捕获更多极端火灾事件，且收益在时间分布偏移下保持。

papers.title: $δ$-mem: Efficient Online Memory for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly need to accumulate and reuse historical information in long-term assistants and agent systems. Simply expanding the context window is costly and often fails to ensure effective context utilization. We propose $δ$-mem, a lightweight memory mechanism that augments a frozen full-attention backbone with a compact online state of associative memory. $δ$-mem compresses past information into a fixed-size state matrix updated by delta-rule learning, and uses its readout to generate low-rank corrections to the backbone's attention computation during generation. With only an $8\times8$ online memory state, $δ$-mem improves the average score to $1.10\times$ that of the frozen backbone and $1.15\times$ that of the strongest non-$δ$-mem memory baseline. It achieves larger gains on memory-heavy benchmarks, reaching $1.31\times$ on MemoryAgentBench and $1.20\times$ on LoCoMo, while largely preserving general capabilities. These results show that effective memory can be realized through a compact online state directly coupled with attention computation, without full fine-tuning, backbone replacement, or explicit context extension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: δ-mem 为冻结的 full-attention LLM 外挂一个固定尺寸的联想记忆在线状态：用 delta-rule 把历史压进 8×8 状态矩阵，读出后生成对注意力计算的低秩修正。平均分达冻结骨干的 1.10×、最强非 δ-mem 记忆基线的 1.15×，memory-heavy 任务上更高，且无需微调、换骨干或扩上下文。
Motivation: 长期助手与 agent 系统需要累积复用历史信息，而直接扩上下文窗口代价高，且往往不能保证上下文被有效利用。
Method: 在冻结的 full-attention 骨干上加一个紧凑联想记忆在线状态：past information 被压缩为固定尺寸状态矩阵，由 delta-rule learning 更新；生成时用该状态的 readout 对骨干注意力计算产生低秩修正 (low-rank correction)。
Result: 仅用 8×8 在线记忆状态，平均分达到冻结骨干的 1.10×、最强非 δ-mem 记忆基线的 1.15×；memory-heavy 基准上增益更大，MemoryAgentBench 达 1.31×、LoCoMo 达 1.20×，同时基本保持通用能力。
Conclusion: 有效记忆可以通过一个与注意力计算直接耦合的紧凑在线状态实现，无需全量微调、骨干替换或显式扩上下文。

papers.title: EHR-RAGp: Prototype-Guided Retrieval of Longitudinal Electronic Health Records for Clinical Prediction Models
papers.abstract_en: Electronic Health Records (EHR) contain rich longitudinal patient information and are widely used in predictive modeling applications. However, effectively leveraging historical data remains challenging due to long trajectories, heterogeneous events, temporal irregularity, and the varying relevance of past clinical context. Existing approaches often rely on fixed windows or uniform aggregation, which can obscure clinically important signals. In this work, we introduce EHR-RAGp, a retrieval-based framework that dynamically integrates the most relevant patient history consisting of diverse clinical event types. We propose a prototype-guided retrieval module that acts as an alignment mechanism and estimates the relevance of retrieved historical chunks with respect to a given prediction task, guiding the model towards the most informative context. Across multiple clinical prediction tasks and two benchmark datasets, EHR-RAGp consistently outperforms state-of- the-art EHR-based and transformer-based baselines. Furthermore, EHR-RAGp is model-agnostic, as integrating it with various backbone models yields substantial performance gains. Overall, EHR-RAGp establishes a novel direction for modeling long-range clinical context to improve downstream performance via retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EHR-RAGp 用原型引导检索 (prototype-guided retrieval) 从长程电子健康记录中挑出与当前预测任务最相关的历史片段，替代固定窗口或均匀聚合。在两个基准数据集的多个临床预测任务上，它一致优于 SOTA 的 EHR 基线与 transformer 基线，且作为模型无关模块接入不同 backbone 也带来明显增益。
Motivation: EHR 纵向轨迹长、事件异质、时间不规则，过去临床上下文对当前任务的相关性不均；固定窗口或均匀聚合会掩盖临床上重要的信号，使预测模型难以利用远期历史。
Method: 提出检索式框架 EHR-RAGp：以原型引导检索模块作为对齐机制，估计检索到的历史片段 (chunks) 相对于给定预测任务的相关性，动态整合多类型临床事件组成的最相关患者历史，并作为模型无关组件接入不同 backbone 模型。
Result: 在两个基准数据集的多个临床预测任务上，EHR-RAGp 一致优于 SOTA 的 EHR 基线与 transformer 基线；与多种 backbone 集成均带来 substantial 性能增益。
Conclusion: 用任务相关的原型引导检索来建模长程临床上下文，是提升下游临床预测性能的有效方向，且该增益不依赖特定 backbone。

papers.title: Hypernetworks for Dynamic Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic feature selection (DFS) is a machine learning framework in which features are acquired sequentially for individual samples under budget constraints. The exponential growth in the number of possible feature acquisition paths forces a DFS model to balance fitting specific scenarios against maintaining general performance, even when the feature space is moderate in size. In this paper, we study the structural limitations of existing DFS approaches to achieve an optimal solution. Then, we propose \textsc{Hyper-DFS}, a hypernetwork-based DFS approach that generates feature subset-specific classifier parameters on demand. We show that the use of hypernetworks compared to mask-embedding methods results in a smaller structural complexity bound. We also use a Set Transformer encoding to create a smooth conditioning space for the hypernetwork, so that functionally similar tasks are also geometrically close. In our benchmarks, \textsc{Hyper-DFS} performed best or second best compared to all state-of-the-art approaches on synthetic and real-life tabular data. It is also best or second best across all image datasets tested, and shows stronger zero-shot generalisation to feature subsets never seen during training than existing DFS approaches. Code available in: https://github.com/Fuminides/hyper_DFS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hyper-DFS 用超网络按需生成特征子集专属的分类器参数，并用 Set Transformer 编码构造平滑的条件空间，使功能相近的任务在几何上也接近。相比 mask-embedding 方法，其结构复杂度上界更小；在合成与真实表格数据以及所测图像数据集上均取得最好或次好成绩，且对训练中未见过的特征子集表现出更强的零样本泛化。
Motivation: 动态特征选择 (DFS) 中特征获取路径随特征数指数增长，迫使模型在拟合特定场景与维持总体性能之间权衡，现有 DFS 方法存在难以达到最优解的结构性限制。
Method: 提出 Hyper-DFS：以超网络根据所选特征子集按需生成分类器参数，替代 mask-embedding 路线；并用 Set Transformer 编码特征子集，为超网络构造平滑的条件空间。
Result: 理论上，超网络相比 mask-embedding 方法给出更小的结构复杂度上界；实验上，在合成与真实表格数据上相对全部 state-of-the-art DFS 方法取得最好或次好，在所有测试的图像数据集上同样为最好或次好，并对训练时未见的特征子集展现更强的零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 用超网络加 Set Transformer 条件化来参数化 DFS，可以在降低结构复杂度上界的同时保持竞争力并改善对未见特征子集的零样本泛化。
