papers.title: Chronicles-OCR: A Cross-Temporal Perception Benchmark for the Evolutionary Trajectory of Chinese Characters
papers.abstract_en: Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in modern text-rich visual understanding. However, their perceptual robustness in the face of the continuous morphological evolution of historical writing systems remains largely unexplored. Existing ancient text datasets typically focus on isolated historical periods, failing to capture the systematic visual distribution shifts spanning thousands of years. To bridge this gap and empower Digital Humanities, we introduce Chronicles-OCR, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the cross-temporal visual perception capabilities of VLLMs across the complete evolutionary trajectory of Chinese characters, known as the Seven Chinese Scripts. Curated in collaboration with top-tier institutional domain experts, the dataset comprises 2,800 strictly balanced images encompassing highly diverse physical media, ranging from tortoise shells to paper-based calligraphy. To accommodate the drastic morphological and topological variations across different historical stages, we propose a novel Stage-Adaptive Annotation Paradigm. Based on this, Chronicles-OCR formulates four rigorous quantitative tasks: cross-period character spotting, fine-grained archaic character recognition via visual referring, ancient text parsing, and script classification. By isolating visual perception from semantic reasoning, Chronicles-OCR provides an authoritative platform to expose the limitations of current VLLMs, paving the way for robust, evolution-aware historical text perception. Chronicles-OCR is publicly available at https://github.com/VirtualLUOUCAS/Chronicles-OCR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chronicles-OCR 是首个覆盖汉字完整演化轨迹（七体）的 VLLM 跨时段感知基准，含 2,800 张严格平衡、跨越龟甲到纸质书法的图像，用 Stage-Adaptive Annotation Paradigm 支撑跨时期字形检测、视觉指代的古文字细粒度识别、古文解析与书体分类四项任务，用以暴露当前 VLLM 在数千年形态分布漂移下的感知短板。
Motivation: 现有古文字数据集只覆盖孤立历史时期，无法呈现跨越数千年的系统性视觉分布漂移，VLLM 在历史书写系统连续形态演化下的感知鲁棒性基本未被检验。
Method: 与顶级机构领域专家合作构建 2,800 张平衡图像数据集，介质从龟甲到纸质书法；提出 Stage-Adaptive Annotation Paradigm 以适配不同历史阶段的形态与拓扑差异，并将视觉感知与语义推理隔离，形式化为跨时期字形检测、视觉指代古文字识别、古文解析、书体分类四项定量任务。
Result: 数据集含 2,800 张严格平衡图像，覆盖七种书体（Seven Chinese Scripts）与多样物理介质；提出四项定量任务：跨时期字形检测、视觉指代细粒度古文字识别、古文解析、书体分类。
Conclusion: 跨时段感知应作为独立于语义推理的能力来评测，Chronicles-OCR 提供暴露当前 VLLM 局限的权威平台，数据与代码在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: Every Bit, Everywhere, All at Once: A Binomial Multibit LLM Watermark
papers.abstract_en: With LLM watermarking already being deployed commercially, practical applications increasingly require multibit watermarks that encode more complex payloads, such as user IDs or timestamps, into the generated text. In this work, we propose a fundamentally new approach for multibit watermarking: introducing binomial encoding to directly encode every bit of the payload at every token position. We complement our approach with a stateful encoder that during generation dynamically redirects encoding pressure toward underencoded bits. Our evaluation against 8 baselines on up to 64-bit payloads shows that our scheme achieves superior message accuracy and robustness, with the gap to baseline methods widening in more relevant settings (i.e., large payloads and low-distortion regimes). At the same time, we challenge prior works' evaluation metrics, highlighting their lack of practical insights, and introduce per-bit confidence scoring as a practically relevant metric for evaluating multibit LLM watermarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出二项编码 (binomial encoding) 的多比特 LLM 水印，在每个 token 位置直接编码负载的每一个比特，并用有状态编码器在生成过程中把编码压力动态转向尚未充分编码的比特。对最多 64-bit 负载、对比 8 个基线的评测显示，该方案在消息准确率与鲁棒性上更优，且在大负载与低失真这两个更实际的设定下差距进一步拉大。
Motivation: 商用 LLM 水印需要嵌入用户 ID、时间戳等多比特负载，而现有方案在大负载、低失真场景下消息准确率与鲁棒性不足，且沿用的评测指标缺乏实际意义。
Method: 引入 binomial encoding，把负载的每一位都编码到每个 token 位置；配合有状态编码器，在生成时动态把编码压力重定向到 underencoded bits；并提出 per-bit confidence scoring 作为多比特水印的实用评测指标。
Result: 在最多 64-bit 负载上对比 8 个基线，方案取得更高的消息准确率与鲁棒性，且在大负载与低失真设定下与基线的差距扩大；同时指出既有评测指标缺乏实际参考价值。
Conclusion: 逐位、逐位置的二项编码加状态化压力重定向是多比特 LLM 水印的可行新路径，评测应转向 per-bit confidence scoring 这类实用指标。

papers.title: PoseBridge: Bridging the Skeletonization Gap for Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition (ZSSAR) is typically treated as a skeleton-text alignment problem: encode joint-coordinate sequences, align them with language, and classify unseen actions. We argue that this alignment is often too late. Skeletons are not complete action observations, but compressed outputs of human pose estimation (HPE); by the time alignment begins, human-object interactions and pose-relative visual cues may no longer be explicit. We call this upstream semantic loss. To address it, we propose PoseBridge, an HPE-aware ZSSAR framework that bridges intermediate HPE representations to skeleton-text alignment. Rather than adding an RGB action branch or object detector, PoseBridge extracts pose-anchored semantic cues from the same HPE process that produces skeletons, then transfers them through skeleton-conditioned bridging and semantic prototype adaptation. Across NTU-RGB+D 60/120, PKU-MMD, and Kinetics-200/400, PoseBridge improves ZSSAR performance under the evaluated protocols. On the Kinetics-200/400 PURLS benchmark, which contains in-the-wild videos with diverse scenes and action contexts, PoseBridge shows the clearest separation, improving the strongest compared baseline by 13.3-17.4 points across all eight splits. Our code will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoseBridge 指出零样本骨架动作识别 (ZSSAR) 的对齐发生得太晚：骨架只是人体姿态估计 (HPE) 的压缩输出，人-物体交互与相对姿态的视觉线索在对齐开始前已经丢失（上游语义损失）。它从产生骨架的同一 HPE 过程中抽取姿态锚定语义线索，经骨架条件桥接与语义原型适配转入骨架-文本对齐，在 Kinetics-200/400 PURLS 八个划分上比最强对比基线高 13.3–17.4 分。
Motivation: ZSSAR 被当作骨架-文本对齐问题，但骨架本身是 HPE 的有损压缩，人-物体交互与姿态相关视觉线索在对齐开始前已不再显式，未见动作的判别信息因此在上游丢失。
Method: 提出 HPE-aware 框架 PoseBridge：不加 RGB 动作分支或物体检测器，而是从生成骨架的同一 HPE 过程中提取姿态锚定语义线索，通过 skeleton-conditioned bridging 与 semantic prototype adaptation 把这些线索迁移到骨架-文本对齐中。
Result: 在 NTU-RGB+D 60/120、PKU-MMD、Kinetics-200/400 上按所评测协议提升 ZSSAR 表现；在含野外视频的 Kinetics-200/400 PURLS 基准上分离最明显，全部八个划分上比最强对比基线提高 13.3–17.4 分。
Conclusion: 骨架-文本对齐之前的上游语义损失是 ZSSAR 的可补救瓶颈，从 HPE 中间表征回填语义线索即可在不引入额外 RGB 或物体分支的情况下提升零样本识别。

papers.title: Internalizing Curriculum Judgment for LLM Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: In LLM Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT), curriculum learning drives both efficiency and performance. Yet, current methods externalize curriculum judgment via handcrafted heuristics or auxiliary models, risking misalignment with the policy's training dynamics. In this paper, we introduce METIS (METacognitive Internalized Self-judgment), a novel framework that internalizes curriculum judgment as a native capability. Leveraging a critical observation that within-prompt reward variance effectively gauges prompt informativeness, METIS predicts this metric based on recent training outcomes as lightweight in-context learning examples. This intrinsic self-judgment then dynamically dictates the training allocation. Moreover, METIS closes the loop between judgment and optimization by jointly optimizing the standard RFT rewards and a self-judgment reward. This allows the policy to learn what to learn next, as a form of metacognition. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic function-calling benchmarks, METIS delivers superior performance while achieving up to a 2.1x training speedup, with controlled ablations and in-depth analysis further validating the benefits of internalized curriculum judgment. By bypassing handcrafted heuristics and auxiliary models, our work establishes a simple, closed-loop, and highly efficient curriculum internalization paradigm for LLM reinforcement fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: METIS 把 LLM 强化微调 (RFT) 的课程判断内化为策略自身能力：用近期训练结果预测 prompt 内奖励方差作为信息量指标，据此动态分配训练量，并把自判断奖励与标准 RFT 奖励联合优化。在数学推理、代码生成与 agentic function-calling 基准上取得更优性能，训练加速最高 2.1 倍。
Motivation: 现有课程学习把判断外包给手工启发式或辅助模型，可能与策略自身的训练动态失配，需要把课程选择变成策略原生能力。
Method: METIS (METacognitive Internalized Self-judgment) 观察到 prompt 内奖励方差可衡量 prompt 信息量，用近期训练结果作为轻量 in-context learning 样本预测该指标，再据此动态决定训练分配；同时把标准 RFT 奖励与自判断奖励 (self-judgment reward) 联合优化，形成判断与优化的闭环。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成与 agentic function-calling 基准上取得更优性能，训练加速最高 2.1 倍；作者另做了受控消融与深入分析以验证内化课程判断的收益。
Conclusion: 绕开手工启发式与辅助模型，课程判断可以作为策略的元认知内化进 RFT，形成简单、闭环且高效的训练范式。

papers.title: DynaMiCS: Fine-tuning LLMs with Performance Constraints using Dynamic Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: Multi-domain fine-tuning of large language models requires improving performance on target domains while preserving previous capabilities, such as general knowledge, instruction following, or safety evaluations. Existing data mixing strategies rely on fixed heuristics or adaptive rules that cannot explicitly enforce preservation of such capabilities. We propose DynaMiCS, a dynamic mixture optimizer that casts multi-domain fine-tuning as a constrained optimization problem. At each update, DynaMiCS performs short domain-specific probing runs to estimate a slope matrix of local cross-domain effects, capturing how training on each fine-tuning dataset affects each evaluation domain. These estimates are then used to compute mixture weights through optimization over the probability simplex, with the objective of improving target-domain performance while keeping constrained-domain metrics within a specified tolerance of reference levels. Because these effects are measured by finite differences rather than gradients, targets and constraints need not be differentiable, or present in the fine-tuning data, and can be specified directly as benchmark accuracies. Across scenarios with varying numbers of target and constrained domains, and with loss- or accuracy-based objectives, DynaMiCS achieves stronger target-domain improvements and higher constraint satisfaction than static, dynamic, similarity-based and probing-based alternatives, without a reference model, per-example scoring, or manually tuned weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynaMiCS 把多领域 LLM 微调写成带约束的混合权重优化：每步做短程领域探测估计局部跨领域效应斜率矩阵，再在概率单纯形上求解混合权重，使目标域提升且受约束域指标保持在参考值容差内。由于效应用有限差分而非梯度度量，目标与约束可不可微、也可不在微调数据中，直接用 benchmark 准确率指定；在不同目标/约束域数量与 loss 或 accuracy 目标下，其目标域提升与约束满足率均高于静态、动态、相似度与探测类基线。
Motivation: 多领域微调要在提升目标域的同时保住通用知识、指令遵循与安全等既有能力，而现有数据混合策略依赖固定启发式或自适应规则，无法显式强制这些能力保持约束。
Method: DynaMiCS 是动态混合优化器：每个更新步对各微调数据集做短程探测 (probing) 运行，用有限差分估计斜率矩阵（每个训练集对每个评估域的局部影响），再在概率单纯形上优化混合权重，目标为目标域性能、约束为受约束域指标不超出参考水平的指定容差；因用有限差分而非梯度，目标与约束无需可微、无需出现在微调数据中。
Result: 在目标域与约束域数量各异、且分别采用 loss 基与 accuracy 基目标的多组场景下，DynaMiCS 相比静态、动态、相似度基与探测基 (probing-based) 混合策略取得更强的目标域提升与更高的约束满足率，且无需参考模型、逐样本打分或手工调权。
Conclusion: 把数据混合当作带显式容差约束的在线优化，用有限差分效应估计即可在不依赖梯度或参考模型的情况下同时驱动目标提升与能力保持。

papers.title: Investigating Single-Block Recurrence in Vision Transformers for Image Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) implement depth by stacking independently parameterized blocks, but it remains unclear how much of this parameterization is necessary and how much can be replaced by recurrent reuse. We study this question with bViT, a single-block recurrent ViT that repeatedly applies the same transformer block while preserving the iterative computation of a deep model. On ImageNet-1K, bViT-B reaches 0.779 validation accuracy compared with 0.789 for ViT-B under the same training recipe and computational budget, while using 8.6M rather than 86.6M parameters. This correspondence becomes stronger with model width, while narrow recurrent models exhibit a substantial performance gap. Beyond classification, the single-block formulation provides a controlled testbed for studying how transformer computation evolves with depth, since the same heads, neurons, and weight matrices can be tracked across recurrent steps. Analyses of attention, activation patterns, and step-conditioned spectral pruning reveal temporally organized behavior and step-dependent utilization of the shared parameters. bViT also transfers competitively to downstream tasks while enabling highly parameter-efficient adaptation. Our work shows that much of the performance associated with independently parameterized ViT depth can be recovered through recurrent reuse of a single sufficiently wide transformer block.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: bViT 用同一个 transformer block 反复迭代替代 ViT 的逐层独立参数化，在 ImageNet-1K 上以 8.6M 参数（ViT-B 为 86.6M）取得 0.779 验证准确率（ViT-B 0.789，同训练配方与算力），且模型越宽对应越强、窄模型差距明显。结论是：足够宽的单块循环可回收大部分由独立参数化深度带来的性能。
Motivation: ViT 靠堆叠独立参数化的 block 来获得深度，但其中多少参数化是必要的、多少可用循环复用替代并不清楚；同时需要一个能跨步追踪同一 head、神经元与权重的受控平台来研究计算随深度的演化。
Method: 提出 bViT：单块循环 ViT，反复应用同一个 transformer block，保持深模型的迭代计算；在 ImageNet-1K 上以相同训练配方和计算预算与 ViT-B 对比，并做 attention、激活模式与 step-conditioned spectral pruning 分析，考察共享参数的分步利用。
Result: ImageNet-1K 上 bViT-B 验证准确率 0.779，ViT-B 为 0.789；参数量 8.6M 对 86.6M。模型变宽时这一对应更强，窄的循环模型存在明显性能差距；分析显示时间上有序的行为与分步的共享参数利用，且在下游任务上迁移具有竞争力、适配参数效率高。
Conclusion: 与独立参数化 ViT 深度相关的性能，大部分可以通过循环复用一个足够宽的单 transformer block 来恢复；宽度是关键条件，窄模型不成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PACE: Policy-Native Adaptive Decision Timing for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon reasoning requires deciding not only what actions to take, but how many to execute open-loop before replanning. This number, the execution depth, balances replanning cost against compounding execution errors. Most current systems either fix the execution depth as a hand-tuned scalar or adjust it at inference time with heuristic rules decoupled from the policy; we argue both can be suboptimal. In this work, we treat the execution depth as a learnable, history-conditioned variable of the policy itself, and propose PACE, a model-native VLM policy that jointly predicts what to execute and for how long under a hard decision budget. We evaluate PACE on four long-horizon environments spanning fully and partially observable settings and visual and textual modalities: Sliding Puzzle, Sokoban, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld. Across all settings, PACE improves success rate by 3.1 to 15.6 percentage points, while using fewer decisions on average, achieving empirical success-decision Pareto dominance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACE 把长程推理中的执行深度 (execution depth) 从手调标量变成策略自身的历史条件变量，作为 VLM 策略的一部分在硬决策预算下联合预测“执行什么”和“执行多久”。在 Sliding Puzzle、Sokoban、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 四个长程环境中，成功率提升 3.1 至 15.6 个百分点，同时平均决策数更少，达到经验上的成功-决策 Pareto 占优。
Motivation: 长程推理要在重规划开销与开环执行误差累积之间取舍，现有系统要么手调固定执行深度，要么用与策略解耦的推理期启发式规则调整，两者都可能次优。
Method: 将执行深度作为策略本身的可学习、历史条件变量，构建 model-native VLM 策略 PACE，在硬决策预算 (hard decision budget) 下联合预测动作内容与执行时长；在全可观测与部分可观测、视觉与文本两类模态共四个环境上评测。
Result: 在 Sliding Puzzle、Sokoban、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 全部设置中，成功率提升 3.1 至 15.6 个百分点，平均使用更少决策，实现经验性成功-决策 Pareto 占优 (Pareto dominance)。
Conclusion: 把执行深度交给策略联合学习，而非手调或启发式调节，可在更少决策下取得更高成功率，同时覆盖全/部分可观测与视觉/文本模态。

papers.title: FLAME: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Multimodal Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world model deployment across multiple domains requires multimodal models to operate under two complementary regimes: (1) multi-task pretraining, tasks are co-available at design time where related tasks could borrow representational strength from one another, (2) continual adaptation, in which new tasks emerge after deployment with previously unseen modality combinations. However, neither regime alone suffices: the pretraining task set is never exhaustive, while bypassing joint training forfeits the transfer gains and efficiency among co-trainable tasks. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a natural fit for this dual requirement: sparse activation enables modular capacity expansion as new tasks arrive, while routing decouples modality-level computation from task-level composition. In this work, we propose a scalable MoE framework for multitask pretraining and continual learning across flexible modality combinations. The framework is designed to support training on multimodal tasks with diverse modality configurations by leveraging modality-specific routers that process tokens from each modality across tasks. Furthermore, it enables continual learning over sequential multimodal tasks within a fixed-capacity MoE by compressing accumulated expert knowledge into low-rank memory subspaces, while expanding only the lightweight routers. We validate the effectiveness of our method on multiple healthcare multimodal benchmarks. It demonstrates competitive multitask pretraining performance while alleviating catastrophic forgetting and improving parameter efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLAME 用模态专属路由器 (modality-specific routers) 把各模态 token 的路由与任务组合解耦，支持灵活模态配置的多任务预训练；面对部署后出现的新任务，在固定容量 MoE 内把已积累的专家知识压缩进低秩记忆子空间 (low-rank memory subspaces)，只扩展轻量路由器。在多个医疗多模态基准上验证，多任务预训练表现有竞争力，同时缓解灾难性遗忘并提升参数效率。
Motivation: 多任务预训练的任务集永远不穷尽，而完全跳过联合训练又会丢掉可共训任务之间的迁移增益与效率；部署后还会出现此前未见的模态组合，单一范式都不够。
Method: 提出面向多任务预训练与持续学习的可扩展 MoE 框架：模态专属路由器处理每个模态跨任务的 token；持续学习阶段在固定容量 MoE 中把累积专家知识压缩到低秩记忆子空间，仅扩展轻量路由器。
Result: 在多个医疗多模态基准 (healthcare multimodal benchmarks) 上验证：多任务预训练表现具有竞争力，同时缓解灾难性遗忘并改善参数效率。
Conclusion: 稀疏 MoE 的稀疏激活与路由解耦可以同时承接多任务预训练和部署后持续适应，且无需按新任务成比例扩容专家。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: How LLMs Are Persuaded: A Few Attention Heads, Rerouted
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can answer a factual question correctly, yet switch to an incorrect answer when exposed to persuasive context. Why this happens inside the model remains unclear. In this work, we study this question through causal interventions in controlled multiple-choice tasks and identify that persuasion mainly acts through a small set of mid-layer attention heads, which we call decision heads. These heads do not compute the answer themselves. Instead, they copy the option they attend to, so changing their attention can directly change the model's answer. We find that this attention is controlled by a one-dimensional option-routing feature in the option-token representations. Persuasive text changes this feature, causing the decision heads to attend to the persuasion target instead of the correct option. We further trace the routing feature to shallower attention heads that read persuasive keywords from the input. Together, these results reveal a causal pathway: shallow heads read persuasive keywords and write the routing feature, which redirects the decision heads' attention toward the persuasion target; the decision heads then copy the selected option, leading to the wrong answer. We verify each step through intervention and find the same mechanism across four open-source model families and in a source-selection task derived from Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Finally, based on this mechanism, we introduce a low-rank update to the decision heads' key projections to reduce their sensitivity to persuasion.
papers.comment: 62 pages, 33 figures, including references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过受控多选题上的因果干预，定位到 LLM 被说服的机制：浅层注意力头读取说服性关键词并写入选项表征中的一维 option-routing 特征，该特征把中层 decision heads 的注意力从正确选项改指到说服目标，decision heads 再复制被选选项导致答错。基于该机制对 decision heads 的 key projection 施加低秩更新以降低对说服的敏感性。
Motivation: 模型能答对事实问题却在说服性上下文下改选错误答案，这一翻转在模型内部如何发生尚不清楚，需要可干预验证的因果解释而非相关分析。
Method: 在受控多选任务上做因果干预（causal intervention），追踪 option-token 表征中的一维 option-routing 特征，区分读取说服关键词的浅层头与复制选项的中层 decision heads，并在四个开源模型家族和一个源自 Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) 的来源选择任务上验证该通路；最后对 decision heads 的 key projection 引入低秩更新。
Result: 说服通路被逐步干预验证：浅层头读关键词并写 routing feature，重定向 decision heads 注意力，decision heads 复制被选选项产生错误答案；同一机制在四个开源模型家族和 GEO 来源选择任务中一致出现，并据此提出降低说服敏感性的低秩 key projection 更新。
Conclusion: 说服不是模型重新计算答案，而是少数中层注意力头被一维路由特征改写注意力后复制选项；改这些头的 key projection 即可降低敏感性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SearchSkill: Teaching LLMs to Use Search Tools with Evolving Skill Banks
papers.abstract_en: Teaching language models to use search tools is not only a question of whether they search, but also of whether they issue good queries. This is especially important in open-domain question answering, where broad or copied queries often waste retrieval budget and derail later reasoning. We propose \Ours, a framework that makes query planning explicit through reusable search skills. At each step, the model first selects a skill, then generates a search or answer action conditioned on the selected skill card. The skill inventory itself is not fixed: SearchSkill maintains an evolving SkillBank, expands or refines it from recurrent failure patterns, and reconstructs affected trajectories before supervised training. The resulting two-stage SFT recipe aligns training with the inference-time protocol of skill selection followed by skill-grounded execution. Across open-source and closed-source models, SearchSkill improves exact match on knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks and yields better retrieval behavior, including fewer copied first queries, more atomic hop-focused queries, and more correct answers within a small search budget. These results suggest that explicit skill-conditioned query planning is a lightweight alternative to treating search as an undifferentiated action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SearchSkill 把检索查询规划显式化为可复用的搜索技能：模型先从不断演化的 SkillBank 中选技能，再在技能卡条件下生成搜索或作答动作，SkillBank 依据反复出现的失败模式扩充与精修并重建受影响轨迹。两阶段 SFT 使训练与推理时的“先选技能、再执行”协议一致，在开源与闭源模型上提升知识密集型 QA 的 exact match，且在小搜索预算下产生更少的复制式首查、更多原子化的多跳查询与更多正确答案。
Motivation: 开放域问答中模型常发出宽泛或直接复制问题的查询，浪费检索预算并带偏后续推理，而现有做法把搜索当作无差别的单一动作，缺少对查询质量的显式控制。
Method: 每步先由模型选择 SkillBank 中的技能，再在所选技能卡 (skill card) 条件下生成 search 或 answer 动作；SkillBank 不固定，依据反复失败模式扩充与精修，并在监督训练前重建受影响轨迹；最终用两阶段 SFT 对齐推理时的技能选择加技能引导执行协议。
Result: 在开源与闭源模型上，SearchSkill 提升知识密集型 QA 基准的 exact match，并改善检索行为：复制式首查询更少、原子化且聚焦单跳的查询更多，在较小搜索预算内给出更多正确答案。
Conclusion: 显式的技能条件化查询规划是把搜索当作无差别动作之外的一条轻量替代路径，能同时改善查询质量与答案正确率。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Agent Collectives Should Not Detect Their Own Imposters: A Chess Case Study
papers.abstract_en: A collective of AI agents collaborating on a task has the potential to outclass any individual agent for that task. We study the robustness of such collectives against possible imposters, i.e., agents that deliberately try to mislead their peers. Since a single imposter could undo the collective's advantage, we need to detect them. We consider two strategies: (i) incorporate imposter detection into the participating agents, or (ii) use a dedicated imposter detector outside the collective. We investigate this empirically on Gambit, a testbed in which 4 reasoning agents deliberate on chess moves. The setting is small but still challenging for frontier models. Chess allows objective, quantitative assessment (via a state-of-the-art chess engine) of both the gain of using a collective and the damage done by imposters. We find that merely warning the agents of potential imposter presence is not beneficial: it degrades decisions when no imposter is present, provokes reactions ranging from self-accusation to scapegoating, inflates token use, and reveals to the imposter how it was uncovered. We therefore recommend a detector that reads the collective's deliberation but never joins it and only returns a verdict. Such a detector must recalibrate to new attack strategies after very few examples, rather than wait for full retraining. In our benchmark, a 3B language model with a meta-trained classification head achieves that: a single gradient step on 20 labeled examples suffices to adapt to an unseen imposter strategy. At matched zero-shot accuracy, this detector yields 8x the adaptation gain of standard finetuning, at 14x lower training cost. We release the Gambit benchmark, with 37,352 labeled deliberations spanning 240 evolved imposter strategies. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/gambit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Gambit（4 个推理 agent 就棋局走法辩论）中，让参与方自行警惕冒名者会适得其反：无冒名时决策变差、出现自责与甩锅、token 消耗上升，还向冒名者暴露其被识破的方式。作者因此建议用只读辩论、只输出裁决的外部检测器；其 3B 语言模型加元训练分类头，仅用 20 条标注样本做一次梯度步即可适应未见过的冒名策略。
Motivation: 多 agent 集体可能超越单体，但一个蓄意误导的冒名者就可能抵消这一优势；需要判断检测应内嵌给参与 agent，还是放在集体之外的独立检测器。
Method: 在 Gambit 测试床上做实证比较：4 个推理 agent 辩论国际象棋走法，用顶尖棋局引擎客观量化集体收益与冒名者造成的损害；对比内嵌警示与外部检测器两条路线，外部检测器为 3B 语言模型加元训练 (meta-trained) 分类头，靠极少量样本的单步梯度更新适配新攻击。
Result: 仅警示 agent 存在冒名者在无冒名时反而降低决策质量，并引发自责到甩锅的反应、推高 token 使用、向冒名者泄露其暴露方式。外部检测器在同等 zero-shot 准确率下取得标准 finetuning 8 倍的适应增益，而训练成本低 14 倍；单次梯度步、20 条标注样本即可适应未见过的冒名策略。发布的 Gambit 基准含 37,352 条带标注辩论，覆盖 240 种演化出的冒名策略。
Conclusion: 冒名者检测应由只读辩论、只回裁决的外部检测器承担，且需靠元训练实现少量样本快速重校准，而非等待完整重训练或让参与 agent 自我警觉。

papers.title: Broximal Gradient Descent: A Projection-Free Sister of Projected Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: We propose Broximal Gradient Descent (BroxGD), a projection-free sister method to projected gradient descent for constrained optimization. Its forward--backward construction replaces the proximal backward operation by the broximal operation of Gruntkowska et al. (2025). Instead of projecting, each step minimizes a linear function over the intersection of the constraint set $\mathcal{X}$ and a ball $\mathbb{B}(x_k,t_k)$ centered at the current iterate $x_k$, of suitable radius $t_k>0$: \[ x_{k+1}\in\arg\min_{z\in\mathcal{X}\cap\mathbb{B}(x_k,t_k)}\langle\nabla f(x_k),z\rangle. \] We develop a comprehensive convergence theory spanning a wide range of optimization regimes and radius rules. We expect BroxGD to find many applications and inspire numerous extensions, much like projected gradient descent. Our contribution is theoretical; potential applications and toy experiments illustrate the method and suggest directions for future work.
papers.comment: 121 pages. Substantially expanded revision with a new title, additional convergence results, practical radius rules, applications, and numerical experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无投影的约束优化方法 Broximal Gradient Descent (BroxGD)：把 projected gradient descent 的 proximal 后向步替换为 broximal 操作，每步在约束集 X 与以当前迭代点为中心、半径 t_k 的球的交集上极小化梯度线性函数。给出覆盖多种优化体制与半径规则的收敛理论，贡献为理论性，辅以潜在应用与 toy 实验。
Motivation: 投影步在约束集复杂时代价高甚至不可得，作者希望保留 projected gradient descent 的前向-后向结构，同时避开显式投影这一瓶颈。
Method: 前向-后向构造：前向步取梯度，后向步用 Gruntkowska et al. (2025) 的 broximal 操作替代 proximal 操作，即在 X ∩ B(x_k, t_k) 上求解线性目标 argmin ⟨∇f(x_k), z⟩；配套推导多类收敛结果与实用半径规则 (radius rules)。
Result: 建立覆盖广泛优化体制与半径规则的收敛理论；arXiv comment 记录该版本为大幅扩展修订（121 页），新增收敛结果、实用半径规则、应用与数值实验；摘要明确贡献为理论性，辅以潜在应用与 toy 实验。
Conclusion: BroxGD 可作为 projected gradient descent 的无投影姊妹方法，作者预期它会像 PGD 一样衍生出大量应用与扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Token Per Frame: Reconsidering Visual Bandwidth in World Models for VLA Policy
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can use visual prediction to anticipate future states, but dense visual features make the generative sequence grow with the number of camera views, prediction horizon, and encoder resolution. Whether such dense representations are necessary for effective control remains unclear. We introduce OneWM-VLA, which represents each retained camera view with one predictive token per future step. Adaptive Attention Pooling compresses visual features into compact latents, which are jointly generated with robot actions under a conditional flow-matching objective. Future observations provide the latent targets during training and are not required at inference. This design incorporates visual prediction into a pretrained VLA policy while keeping the generative sequence compact. On MetaWorld~MT50, OneWM-VLA improves the average success rate of the $π_0$ backbone from $47.91\%$ to $61.53\%$, reaching $72.01\%$ after 60k training steps. It also achieves $98.1\%$ success on LIBERO and raises Fold Cloth success on a real Piper arm from $20.0\%$ to $60.0\%$ relative to $π_0$. Comparisons on two additional VLA backbones consistently favor one token over three across the evaluated checkpoints. A matched ablation at a longer action horizon further shows that removing the latent loss reduces success from $58.09\%$ to $21.64\%$, supporting the benefit of future supervision for policy learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneWM-VLA 把每个保留相机视角在未来每一步只编码成一个预测 token，用 Adaptive Attention Pooling 压成紧凑 latent，并与机器人动作在 conditional flow-matching 目标下联合生成，从而在把视觉预测塞进预训练 VLA 策略的同时压住生成序列长度。MetaWorld MT50 上平均成功率从 π0 的 47.91% 提到 61.53%（60k 步达 72.01%），LIBERO 成功率 98.1%，真机 Piper arm 的 Fold Cloth 从 20.0% 提到 60%。
Motivation: 稠密视觉特征使 VLA 的生成序列随相机数、预测时长和编码器分辨率膨胀，而这种稠密表示对控制是否必要并不清楚。
Method: 每个保留视角每个未来步只留一个预测 token；Adaptive Attention Pooling 把视觉特征压成紧凑 latent，latent 与机器人动作在 conditional flow-matching 目标下联合生成；训练时用未来观测作 latent 目标，推理时不需要未来观测。
Result: MetaWorld MT50 平均成功率 47.91% → 61.53%（π0 基线），60k 训练步后达 72.01%；LIBERO 成功率 98.1%；真机 Piper arm Fold Cloth 成功率 20.0% → 60%（相对 π0）；在另外两个 VLA backbone 上，所评测 checkpoint 中 one token 均一致优于 three token；更长动作时程的配对消融中去掉 latent loss 使成功率从 58.09% 降到 21.64%。
Conclusion: 视觉预测不必靠稠密特征：每视角每步一个 token 加未来 latent 监督就足以提升策略学习，去掉 latent loss 会让成功率大幅回落。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer: Decoupling Compute from Memory in Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent LLM architectures have emerged as a promising approach for improving reasoning, as they enable multi-step computation in the embedding space without generating intermediate tokens. Models such as Ouro perform reasoning by iteratively updating internal representations while retaining a standard Key-Value (KV) cache across iterations, causing memory consumption to grow linearly with reasoning depth. Consequently, increasing the number of reasoning iterations can lead to prohibitive memory usage, limiting the practical scalability of such architectures. In this work, we propose Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer (MELT), a novel architecture that decouples reasoning depth from memory consumption. Instead of using a standard KV cache per layer and loop, MELT maintains a single KV cache per layer that is shared across reasoning loops. This cache is updated over time via a learnable gating mechanism. To enable stable and efficient training under this architecture, we propose to train MELT using chunk-wise training in a two phase procedure: interpolated transition, followed by attention-aligned distillation, both from the LoopLM starting model to MELT. Empirically, we show that MELT models fine-tuned from pretrained Ouro parameters outperform standard LLMs of comparable size, while maintaining a memory footprint comparable to those models and dramatically smaller than Ouro's. Overall, MELT achieves constant-memory iterative reasoning without sacrificing LoopLM performance, using only a lightweight post-training procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MELT 把循环 LLM 每层每轮的 KV cache 收敛为每层一份跨循环共享的缓存，用可学习门控随时间更新，使推理深度与显存解耦、显存随迭代深度常数增长。经两阶段轻量后训练（interpolated transition + attention-aligned distillation，从 LoopLM 蒸馏到 MELT），从预训练 Ouro 参数微调出的模型在相当规模下超过标准 LLM，显存与同规模模型相当且远小于 Ouro。
Motivation: Ouro 这类循环推理架构在每层每轮保留独立 KV cache，显存随推理深度线性增长，迭代次数一多就不可用，限制了这类模型的可扩展性。
Method: 每层只维护一份跨循环共享的 KV cache，由可学习门控 (learnable gating) 随迭代更新；训练采用 chunk-wise 两阶段流程：先 interpolated transition，再 attention-aligned distillation，两阶段都从 LoopLM 起始模型蒸馏到 MELT，属轻量后训练。
Result: 从预训练 Ouro 参数微调的 MELT 在相当规模下优于标准 LLM，显存占用与同规模标准模型相当、远小于 Ouro；实现常数显存的迭代推理且不损失 LoopLM 性能。
Conclusion: 循环推理的显存开销来自每轮独立 KV cache 而非迭代本身，共享缓存加门控更新即可把深度与显存解耦，代价只是一段轻量后训练。

papers.title: Encoder-Decoder Transformers: Logical Characterizations and Periodicity
papers.abstract_en: We give logical characterizations of encoder-decoder transformers, the foundational architecture for LLMs that also sees use in various settings that benefit from cross-attention, in the practical setting of floating-point numbers and soft attention. First, we characterize such transformers via a new temporal logic that extends propositional logic with a counting global modality over the encoder input and a past modality over the decoder input, as well as via a type of distributed automata. We consider three frameworks: with and without a final softmax step in the transformer, and in the setting where each model generates tokens via autoregression. Second, we show that both autoregressive transformers and sentences of counting propositional logic - the fragment of the previous logic obtained by omitting the past modality - recognize exactly the commutative star-free languages. Finally, we find that the sequences of tokens the transformers generate are ultimately periodic (and each token appears in the period at most once). This allows us to characterize autoregressive transformers via sentences of counting propositional logic that generate tokens without autoregression, i.e., we can effectively eliminate recursion from the transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在浮点数与 soft attention 的实际设定下，用带计数全局模态（作用于 encoder 输入）与过去模态（作用于 decoder 输入）的新时序逻辑刻画 encoder-decoder transformer，并给出对应的分布式自动机刻画。自回归 transformer 与省略过去模态的计数命题逻辑片段恰好识别交换的 star-free 语言；其生成的 token 序列最终周期化，且每个 token 在周期中至多出现一次，从而可有效消去自回归递归。
Motivation: LLM 基础架构 encoder-decoder transformer 缺少与逻辑 formalism 的精确对应，也缺少对其生成序列长期行为的结构性刻画。
Method: 在浮点数与 soft attention 设定下提出扩展命题逻辑的时序逻辑（计数全局模态 + 过去模态）与分布式自动机两种刻画；分三种框架讨论：有/无最终 softmax、以及自回归生成；再把逻辑限制为省略过去模态的计数命题逻辑片段进行语言类比对。
Result: 自回归 transformer 与计数命题逻辑片段识别恰好是交换 star-free 语言；transformer 生成的 token 序列最终周期化，且每个 token 在周期中至多出现一次；据此可有效消除自回归递归，用不带自回归的计数命题逻辑句子生成 token。
Conclusion: encoder-decoder transformer 的计算能力可由该时序逻辑精确刻画，其自回归生成本质上是可消去递归的最终周期过程。

papers.title: On the Invariance and Generality of Neural Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws establish a predictable relationship between model performance and data or compute, offering crucial guidance for resource allocation in new domains and tasks. Yet such laws are most needed precisely where they are hardest to obtain: fitting one for a new model task pair demands expensive sweeps that typically exhaust the very compute budget the law is meant to economize. This paper poses the research question of how to develop generalizable scaling laws: laws fit once on a well-resourced source domain and reliably transported to new domains where running a full sweep is infeasible, which requires a fundamental understanding of when and why scaling properties change. We address this by identifying the right invariants: scaling laws are preserved under bijective (information-preserving) transformations of the data and modified in predictable, information-theoretically grounded ways under non-bijective transformations that lower its information resolution $ρ$: a single axis along which a law fit in one domain can be transported to another. We validate this across language, vision, and speech, and demonstrate two cross-domain applications: predicting scaling for language models trained on electronic health records from laws fit on general text, and predicting time-series classification scaling under varying levels of noise injection, recovering the data-scaling exponents to within $3\%$ error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可迁移的神经缩放律 (neural scaling laws)：缩放律在数据的双射（保信息）变换下不变，在降低信息分辨率 ρ 的非双射变换下按信息论可预测的方式改变，ρ 成为跨域迁移的单一坐标轴。在语言、视觉、语音上验证，并把通用文本上拟合的缩放律迁移到电子健康记录语言模型，以及在不同噪声注入水平下的时间序列分类，恢复数据缩放指数误差在 3% 以内。
Motivation: 为新模型-任务对拟合缩放律需要大规模超参扫描，恰好耗尽缩放律本应节省的算力，因此最需要缩放律的地方最难得到它。
Method: 识别缩放律的不变量：证明其在数据的双射变换下保持不变，在降低信息分辨率 ρ 的非双射变换下按信息论给出可预测的修改，用 ρ 作为把源域拟合的律迁移到目标域的坐标轴；在语言、视觉、语音三个模态上做验证，并给出两个跨域应用。
Result: 在语言、视觉、语音上验证不变量刻画；两个跨域应用为：用通用文本上拟合的律预测电子健康记录上训练的语言模型的缩放，以及预测不同噪声注入水平下的时间序列分类缩放，数据缩放指数恢复误差在 3% 以内。
Conclusion: 缩放律的可迁移性由信息分辨率 ρ 这一不变量决定，因此在无法承担扫描的域上可以靠源域拟合直接外推缩放行为。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ARMOR: An Agentic Framework for Reaction Feasibility Prediction via Adaptive Utility-aware Multi-tool Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reaction feasibility prediction, as a fundamental problem in computational chemistry, has benefited from diverse tools enabled by recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly large language models. However, the performance of individual tools varies substantially across reactions, making it difficult for any single tool to consistently perform well across all cases. This raises a critical challenge: how to effectively leverage multiple tools to obtain more accurate feasibility predictions. To address this, we propose ARMOR, an agentic framework that explicitly models tool-specific utilities, adaptively prioritizes tools, and further resolves the potential tool conflicts to produce the final prediction for each reaction. Unlike existing approaches that rely on simple aggregation or heuristic assignment over various tools, ARMOR organizes tools into a hierarchy that prioritizes top-performing tools and defers others when needed, characterizes their strengths through tool-specific patterns, and resolves conflicts via memoryaugmented reasoning. Extensive experiments on a public dataset demonstrate that ARMOR consistently outperforms strong baselines, including single-tool methods as well as various tool aggregation and tool selection approaches. Further analysis shows that the improvements are particularly significant on reactions with conflicting tool predictions, highlighting the effectiveness of ARMOR in leveraging the complementary strengths of multiple tools. The code is available via https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ARMOR-E13F.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARMOR 把多个 LLM 化学工具按各自效用排成层级，自适应优先调用高表现工具并用记忆增强推理 (memory-augmented reasoning) 消解工具间冲突，输出每个反应的可行性预测。在公开数据集上它稳定超过单工具方法与各类工具聚合/选择基线，且在工具预测相互冲突的反应上提升最明显。
Motivation: 不同 AI 工具在各反应上的表现差异很大，任何单一工具都无法在全部案例上稳定可靠，简单聚合或启发式选择又无法利用工具间的互补性。
Method: ARMOR 显式建模工具特定效用 (tool-specific utilities)，把工具组织成优先高表现、必要时延后的层级结构，用工具特定模式刻画各自强项，并通过记忆增强推理解决工具冲突，得到最终可行性预测。
Result: 在公开数据集上的实验中，ARMOR 一致优于强基线，包括单工具方法以及多种工具聚合与工具选择方法；进一步分析显示在工具预测冲突的反应上提升尤其显著。
Conclusion: 按效用分层调度并显式消解冲突，比简单聚合或启发式选择更能发挥多工具的互补优势，冲突案例正是收益最大的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BGM-IV: AI-Powered Bayesian Generative Modeling for Instrumental Variable Regression with High-Dimensional Covariates
papers.abstract_en: Instrumental-variable (IV) regression enables causal estimation under endogeneity, but modern IV problems often involve nonlinear structural effects and high-dimensional covariates. Existing methods typically operate in observed or generic learned feature spaces, and they often yield point estimates without uncertainty quantification. We introduce BGM-IV, a Bayesian generative modeling approach that performs nonlinear IV regression through posterior inference in a causally structured latent space. BGM-IV separates covariate variation by the role in the treatment and outcome mechanism, and accounts for endogeneity through an IV-integrated pseudo-likelihood that averages over instrument-induced treatment variation. The resulting model provides both structural-function estimates and predictive intervals for outcomes under intervention. Across various benchmark datasets, BGM-IV outperforms existing nonlinear IV methods overall, with significant gains in high-dimensional settings, while achieving near-nominal predictive coverage. These results highlight structured latent generative modeling as a flexible approach to uncertainty-aware IV inference with rich covariates. The code of BGM-IV is available at https://github.com/liuq-lab/BGM-IV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BGM-IV 用因果结构化潜空间上的贝叶斯生成建模做非线性工具变量 (IV) 回归：按在处理与结果机制中的角色拆分协变量变异，并用对工具诱导的处理变异取平均的 IV 积分伪似然刻画内生性。在多个基准数据集上总体优于现有非线性 IV 方法，高维设定下增益显著，且预测覆盖接近名义水平。
Motivation: 现代 IV 问题含非线性结构效应与高维协变量，现有方法多在观测或通用学习特征空间中工作，且只给点估计、不做不确定性量化。
Method: 在因果结构化潜空间中做后验推断的贝叶斯生成模型：按协变量在处理机制与结果机制中的角色分离其变异；用 IV 积分伪似然 (IV-integrated pseudo-likelihood) 对工具诱导的处理变异取平均以处理内生性；同时输出结构函数估计与干预下结果的预测区间。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上总体优于现有非线性 IV 方法，在高维设定下有显著增益，预测覆盖接近名义水平 (near-nominal predictive coverage)。
Conclusion: 结构化潜空间生成建模可作为富协变量下带不确定性量化的 IV 推断的灵活路径，代码已开源在 github.com/liuq-lab/BGM-IV。

papers.title: Skip What You Can Predict: Predictive Repositioning for Policy Optimization for Efficient LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the reasoning ability of large language models, but repeatedly updating a policy on the same rollout batch is expensive: every additional update requires another backward pass, and multi-step methods pay for all intermediate optimization steps. We introduce Predictive Repositioning for Policy Optimization (PrePO), which uses two observed optimizer transitions to estimate a farther point along the same-batch optimization trajectory, moves partway toward that point, evaluates the original objective there, and applies a corrective update. This gives PrePO a fixed active cost that does not grow with the virtual optimization depth. Our analysis gives finite-horizon error bounds for AdamW and Muon and shows that sufficiently accurate endpoint estimates preserve the usual descent and convergence behavior of smooth gradient descent. In RLVR experiments, PrePO reaches matched performance targets in fewer optimization steps and lower wall-clock time than the corresponding baselines. We further evaluate the same update mechanism in supervised fine-tuning on a different dataset, showing that its use is not restricted to the original RLVR setting. Together, these results suggest that PrePO provides a practical mechanism for approximating repeated same-batch optimization while avoiding the cost of explicitly executing every intermediate update.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrePO 只用同一批 rollout 上两次已观测的优化器跃迁，估计沿该批优化轨迹更远的端点，再部分移动到该点、在原目标上评估并施加校正更新，从而让虚拟优化深度增加时的活跃计算成本保持固定。在 RLVR 实验中，PrePO 用更少的优化步数和更低的墙钟时间达到与基线相同的表现目标，并在另一数据集的监督微调上验证了同一更新机制。
Motivation: RLVR 中对同一批 rollout 反复更新策略代价高：每次额外更新都要再做一次 backward pass，多步方法还要为所有中间优化步付费。
Method: PrePO 从两次已观测的优化器跃迁外推同批优化轨迹上更远的端点，部分移动到该点后在原目标处评估并施加校正更新；对 AdamW 与 Muon 给出有限视界误差界，并证明端点估计足够准时保持平滑梯度下降的常规下降与收敛行为。
Result: 在 RLVR 实验中，PrePO 以更少的优化步数和更低的墙钟时间达到与相应基线匹配的表现目标；同一更新机制在不同数据集的监督微调上也做了评估。
Conclusion: PrePO 提供了一种近似重复同批优化的实用机制，可在不显式执行每一步中间更新的情况下避免其成本，且用途不限于 RLVR。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are We Making Progress in Multimodal Domain Generalization? A Comprehensive Benchmark Study
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing popularity of Multimodal Domain Generalization (MMDG) for enhancing model robustness, it remains unclear whether reported performance gains reflect genuine algorithmic progress or are artifacts of inconsistent evaluation protocols. Current research is fragmented, with studies varying significantly across datasets, modality configurations, and experimental settings. Furthermore, existing benchmarks focus predominantly on action recognition, often neglecting critical real-world challenges such as input corruptions, missing modalities, and model trustworthiness. This lack of standardization obscures a reliable assessment of the field's advancement. To address this issue, we introduce MMDG-Bench, the first unified and comprehensive benchmark for MMDG, which standardizes evaluation across six datasets spanning three diverse tasks: action recognition, mechanical fault diagnosis, and sentiment analysis. MMDG-Bench encompasses six modality combinations, nine representative methods, and multiple evaluation settings. Beyond standard accuracy, it systematically assesses corruption robustness, missing-modality generalization, misclassification detection, and out-of-distribution detection. With 7, 402 neural networks trained in total across 95 unique cross-domain tasks, MMDG-Bench yields five key findings: (1) under fair comparisons, recent specialized MMDG methods offer only marginal improvements over ERM baseline; (2) no single method consistently outperforms others across datasets or modality combinations; (3) a substantial gap to upper-bound performance persists, indicating that MMDG remains far from solved; (4) trimodal fusion does not consistently outperform the strongest bimodal configurations; and (5) all evaluated methods exhibit significant degradation under corruption and missing-modality scenarios, with some methods further compromising model trustworthiness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMDG-Bench 统一了多模态领域泛化 (MMDG) 的评测协议，覆盖 6 个数据集、3 类任务、6 种模态组合与 9 个代表方法，共训练 7402 个网络、覆盖 95 个跨域任务。在公平比较下，近期专用 MMDG 方法相对 ERM 基线仅有边际提升，且在 corruption 与缺失模态下全部显著退化。
Motivation: MMDG 现有研究在数据集、模态配置与实验设置上高度碎片化，基准又集中于动作识别，导致报告的性能提升无法区分是真实算法进步还是评测协议不一致的产物。
Method: 提出首个统一基准 MMDG-Bench，在 6 个数据集（覆盖动作识别、机械故障诊断、情感分析三类任务）上标准化评测，组合 6 种模态配置与 9 个代表方法，共训练 7402 个神经网络、覆盖 95 个跨域任务；除标准准确率外，系统评估 corruption 鲁棒性、缺失模态泛化、误分类检测与分布外 (OOD) 检测。
Result: 五项发现：公平比较下近期专用 MMDG 方法相对 ERM 基线仅有边际改进；无单一方法在所有数据集或模态组合上持续占优；与 upper-bound 性能仍有 substantial 差距；三模态融合并不稳定优于最强双模态配置；全部被评方法在 corruption 与缺失模态场景下显著退化，部分方法还损害模型 trustworthiness。
Conclusion: 在统一协议下，MMDG 领域尚未取得实质进展、远未解决：收益多为评测口径造成，且鲁棒性与可信度是当前方法的共同短板。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Diverse Sampling in Diffusion Models with Divergence-Free Particle Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative models can produce high-quality samples, but independent samples under the same condition often yields highly similar outputs. Particle-based methods increase diversity by letting the samples in a batch interact, typically through a repulsive force. These forces, however, also push each sample away from the data distribution and produce visible artifacts. We introduce EDDY, a training-free particle guidance method designed to avoid this failure mode. Instead of a repulsive gradient, EDDY couples particles through anti-symmetric matrix fields passed through a Stein operator, a family of drift perturbations that leaves the Fokker--Planck equation invariant. Unlike repulsive guidance, these interactions do not alter a particle's distribution while the batch is independent. For the same reason they cannot create diversity on their own, so EDDY pairs them with a negatively correlated initialization that keeps each particle's prior exact. To use EDDY with perceptual kernels such as DINOv2, we approximate its second-order terms with finite differences and Hutchinson estimates. Across FLUX.1-dev, FLUX.2-klein and SDXL, EDDY achieves higher image quality and prompt alignment than existing particle guidance methods at matched diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EDDY 是一种免训练的扩散模型粒子引导方法，用反对称矩阵场经 Stein 算子耦合粒子，这类漂移不改变 Fokker–Planck 方程，因此在 batch 独立时不扭曲单个粒子的分布、不产生排斥引导那种把样本推离数据分布的伪影。由于它自身无法产生多样性，EDDY 配合保持每个粒子先验精确的负相关初始化；在 FLUX.1-dev、FLUX.2-klein 和 SDXL 上，同等多样性下图像质量与 prompt 对齐优于现有粒子引导方法。
Motivation: 同一条件下独立采样得到的样本高度相似；现有粒子方法靠排斥力提升多样性，却把每个样本推离数据分布并产生可见伪影。
Method: 免训练的 EDDY：以反对称矩阵场经 Stein 算子耦合粒子（一族保持 Fokker–Planck 方程不变的漂移扰动），替代排斥梯度；配负相关初始化以保持每个粒子先验精确。对 DINOv2 等感知核的二阶项用有限差分与 Hutchinson 估计近似。
Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、FLUX.2-klein 和 SDXL 上，EDDY 在匹配多样性 (matched diversity) 的条件下，图像质量与 prompt 对齐均高于现有粒子引导方法。
Conclusion: 保持分布不变的反对称耦合加负相关初始化，可以在不引入排斥伪影的前提下提升条件生成的多样性与质量。

papers.title: Pushing the accuracy of on-top functionals with agent-driven supervised learning
papers.abstract_en: Multiconfiguration pair-density functional theory (MC-PDFT) combines multiconfigurational reference wave functions with on-top functionals to provide an efficient electronic-structure method for strongly correlated molecular systems. We developed a large language model-based agent for functional development and combined multiple databases into the large, chemically diverse MCDDB26 database. We then used MCDDB26 to develop two on-top functionals, MC26 and COF26. MC26 retains an existing analytical form but substantially improves performance by refitting its linear parameters with optimised weights for the training datasets. Building on this result, we developed COF26, a general hybrid on-top functional with a new analytical form. COF26 provides greater overall accuracy for multireference chemistry than existing on-top functionals. Applications across MCDDB26 show that COF26 accommodates both multiconfigurational and single-configuration densities. It therefore performs well for barrier heights, isomerisation energies, thermochemistry, non-covalent interactions, radical and non-radical chemistry, single-reference and multireference systems, and transition-metal chemistry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MC-PDFT 框架下用 LLM agent 驱动泛函开发，合并多个数据库建成 MCDDB26，并据此重拟合 MC26 的线性参数、提出新解析形式的杂化 on-top 泛函 COF26。COF26 在多参考化学上整体精度高于现有 on-top 泛函，同时兼容多组态与单组态密度，覆盖势垒高度、异构化能、热化学、非共价相互作用、自由基与过渡金属化学。
Motivation: MC-PDFT 的 on-top 泛函精度受限于解析形式与训练集拟合，现有泛函在多参考化学与单参考体系之间难以兼顾，泛函开发本身也缺少系统化的数据与自动化流程。
Method: 构建基于大语言模型的 agent 辅助泛函开发流程，把多个数据库合并为化学多样性大的 MCDDB26；MC26 保留原解析形式、用训练集优化权重重拟合线性参数；COF26 则采用新的解析形式，作为通用杂化 on-top 泛函。
Result: MC26 经重拟合后性能显著提升；COF26 对多参考化学的整体精度高于现有 on-top 泛函；在 MCDDB26 上的应用显示 COF26 同时容纳多组态与单组态密度，适用于势垒高度、异构化能、热化学、非共价相互作用、自由基与非自由基化学、单参考与多参考体系及过渡金属化学。
Conclusion: 新的解析形式加系统化数据库拟合能同时抬高 on-top 泛函在多参考与单参考化学上的精度，LLM agent 可承担泛函开发中的流程性工作。

papers.title: SymDrift: One-Shot Generative Modeling under Symmetries
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of physical systems, such as molecules, requires learning distributions that are invariant under global symmetries, such as rotations in three-dimensional space. Equivariant diffusion and flow matching models can incorporate such invariances effectively, even when trained on a non-invariant empirical distribution, but they typically rely on costly multi-step sampling. Recently, drifting models have emerged as an efficient alternative, enabling single-step generation and achieving state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling tasks. However, we show that drifting models face a symmetry-specific challenge, since an equivariant generator does not generally produce the same drifting field as the one obtained from the symmetrized target distribution. Addressing this issue would require expensive symmetrization of the empirical distribution. To avoid this cost, we propose SymDrift, a framework that makes the drifting field itself symmetry-aware. We introduce two complementary strategies: (i) a symmetrized drift in coordinate space based on optimal alignment, and (ii) a $G$-invariant embedding that removes symmetry ambiguity by construction. Empirically, SymDrift outperforms existing one-shot methods on standard benchmarks for conformer and transition state generation, while remaining competitive with significantly more expensive multi-step approaches. By enabling one-shot inference, SymDrift reduces computational overhead by up to 40$\times$ compared to existing baselines, making it promising for high-throughput applications such as virtual drug screening and large-scale reaction network exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SymDrift 把对称性直接写进 drifting model 的漂移场，使单步生成在旋转等变下与对称化目标一致：坐标空间用最优对齐构造对称化漂移，另加一个按构造 G-不变的嵌入消除对称歧义。在构象体与过渡态生成基准上超过现有 one-shot 方法，推理开销相比基线最多降低 40×。
Motivation: drifting model 能单步生成且达到 SOTA，但等变生成器一般不产生与对称化目标分布相同的漂移场；直接对称化经验分布代价高昂，使单步生成在分子这类要求全局对称不变的物理系统上失效。
Method: SymDrift 框架让漂移场本身具备对称感知，含两条互补策略：坐标空间中基于最优对齐 (optimal alignment) 的对称化漂移，以及按构造消除对称歧义的 G-不变嵌入 (G-invariant embedding)；用于构象体 (conformer) 与过渡态 (transition state) 生成。
Result: 在构象体与过渡态生成的标准基准上，SymDrift 优于现有 one-shot 方法，同时与昂贵得多的多步方法 (equivariant diffusion、flow matching) 保持竞争力；单步推理相比现有基线最多降低 40× 计算开销。
Conclusion: 把对称性放进漂移场而非经验分布，就能在不付对称化代价的前提下让单步生成保持对称一致性，从而支撑虚拟药物筛选与大规模反应网络探索这类高通量场景。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learning beyond Site Bias for OOD Generalization in Brain Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based learning from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has shown strong potential for brain network analysis. However, existing methods often degrade under cross-site out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, as site-dependent confounder effects can obscure disease-related connectivity patterns and static functional connectivity (FC) does not explicitly capture informative within-scan variations. In this paper, we propose Cross-site OOD Robust brain nEtwork (CORE), a unified framework for brain network learning across unseen sites. First, CORE estimates site-specific confounder effects and aggregates the resulting deconfounders by cross-source reliability for unseen-site correction, while extracting a population scaffold of reproducible label-associated connections from site-wise residualized FC. It then summarizes temporal variations on scaffold edges into compact descriptors for line-graph modeling. Finally, prior-guided subject-adaptive gating modulates message passing, balancing population priors with individual variability. Extensive leave-one-site-out experiments on ABIDE, REST-meta-MDD, SRPBS, and ABCD demonstrate that CORE consistently outperforms competitive baselines, with up to a 10.3% relative improvement in accuracy. These gains also persist across different brain parcellation schemes on ABIDE.

papers.title: One Turn Too Late: Learning When to Intervene Against Multi-Turn Malicious Intent
papers.abstract_en: Hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue poses a growing threat to deployed large language models (LLMs). Rather than exposing a harmful objective in a single prompt, attackers can distribute their intent across multiple benign-looking turns, making defense a problem not only of whether a dialogue is harmful, but also of when intervention becomes necessary. Existing trace-level labeling approaches provide only coarse safety signals and do not identify this intervention boundary, making it difficult to distinguish timely intervention from premature refusal or a block that comes too late. This work introduces turn-level harm-enabling supervision for multi-turn defense. We define the earliest harm-enabling turn as the first point at which delivering a candidate response would make the accumulated interaction sufficient to enable harmful action. To instantiate this supervision at scale, we construct the Multi-Turn Intent Dataset (MTID), which contains adaptive attack rollouts, matched benign hard negatives, and annotations of this boundary. Using MTID, we train TurnGate, a response-aware monitor that learns when to intervene, and further optimize its policy through multi-turn reinforcement learning. Experiments show that turn-level boundary supervision improves intervention localization, while reinforcement learning further improves the safety--utility trade-off. TurnGate outperforms existing guardrails and multi-turn monitoring baselines, and generalizes across risk domains, attacker pipelines, and target models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/TurnGate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多轮对话中被拆散的恶意意图，提出轮级 harm-enabling 监督：定义「最早致害轮」为给出候选回复即足以促成有害行动的第一个时点，并据此训练响应感知监控器 TurnGate，再用多轮强化学习优化介入策略。轮级边界监督改善介入定位，强化学习进一步改善安全-效用权衡，且在风险域、攻击流水线与目标模型上都能泛化。
Motivation: 攻击者把有害目标分散到多轮看似无害的对话里，现有 trace 级标注只给粗粒度安全信号，无法定位介入边界，因而分不清及时介入、过早拒绝和过晚拦截。
Method: 构建 Multi-Turn Intent Dataset (MTID)，含自适应攻击 rollout、匹配的良性困难负例与边界标注；用它训练响应感知监控器 TurnGate 学习何时介入，再通过多轮强化学习优化其介入策略。
Result: 轮级边界监督改善介入定位 (intervention localization)，强化学习进一步改善安全-效用权衡；TurnGate 超越现有 guardrails 与多轮监控基线，并跨风险域、攻击流水线和目标模型泛化。
Conclusion: 把监督粒度从整段对话下移到「最早致害轮」这一时点，能让多轮防御在及时拦截与避免过早拒绝之间取得更好平衡。

papers.title: AeroJEPA: Learning Semantic Latent Representations for Scalable 3D Aerodynamic Field Modeling
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity CFD is essential for aerodynamic design, but repeated simulations are computationally expensive, motivating surrogate models for rapid evaluation across geometries and operating conditions. Most existing surrogates are designed for direct field regression, requiring the evaluation of millions of field points even when only an aerodynamic quantity or a localized region is needed, while their internal representations are not intended for direct use in downstream tasks. We introduce AeroJEPA, a framework inspired by joint-embedding predictive architectures that represents the problem in two distinct latent spaces: context tokens encode geometry, while predicted tokens encode the aerodynamic state. Both representations remain directly accessible for downstream tasks, such as linear readouts of design variables and aerodynamic quantities without decoding and integrating the full field. When spatial detail is needed, a continuous implicit decoder evaluates the field only at the requested coordinates while reusing the encoded geometry. We evaluate AeroJEPA on HiLiftAeroML, with multi-million-point fields, and SuperWing, which spans a broad family of transonic wings. Compared with state-of-the-art direct-regression surrogates, AeroJEPA trades peak full-field accuracy for compact, reusable representations. In our selective-decoding experiment, however, AeroJEPA substantially outperforms the evaluated direct-regression surrogates while avoiding predictions over the remainder of the aircraft. The learned representations further support controlled interpolation, concept-vector arithmetic, and preliminary constrained latent-space optimization. These results show how predictive representations can support aerodynamic analysis with or without full-field reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AeroJEPA 把 CFD 代理模型改写成 JEPA 式双隐空间：context token 编几何、predicted token 编气动状态，两者都可直接线性读出设计变量与气动量而不解码整场。在 HiLiftAeroML 与 SuperWing 上，它以牺牲整场峰值精度换取紧凑可复用表示，而在选择性解码实验中大幅超过所评估的直接回归代理并跳过机体其余部分的预测。
Motivation: 现有 CFD 代理模型面向整场回归，即使只需要一个气动量或局部区域也要评估数百万场点，且内部表示不能直接用于下游任务。
Method: AeroJEPA 借鉴 joint-embedding predictive architecture，把问题放进两个隐空间：context token 编码几何、predicted token 编码气动状态；两者支持设计变量与气动量的线性读出而不解码积分整场；需要空间细节时用连续隐式解码器只在请求坐标上求值并复用已编码几何。
Result: 在含数百万点场的 HiLiftAeroML 与覆盖跨声速机翼族的 SuperWing 上评测：相对 SOTA 直接回归代理，AeroJEPA 以牺牲整场峰值精度换取紧凑可复用表示；在选择性解码实验中大幅超过所评估的直接回归代理，同时避免对机体其余部分做预测；表示还支持受控插值、概念向量运算与初步的约束隐空间优化。
Conclusion: 预测式表示可以在不重建整场的条件下支撑气动分析，代价是整场峰值精度下降；表示本身即可用于读出、插值与隐空间优化。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Two-Stage Learned Decomposition for Scalable Routing on Multigraphs
papers.abstract_en: Most neural methods for Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are limited to Euclidean settings or simple graphs. In this work, we instead consider multigraphs, where parallel edges represent distinct travel options with varying trade-offs (e.g., distance vs. time). Multigraphs are highly relevant in practice, yet few neural methods are designed for them, and those that do exist face major scalability issues. We address these scalability issues with Node-Edge Policy Factorization (NEPF), which splits the routing policy into a node permutation stage and an edge selection stage. To enable the decomposition, we introduce a pre-encoding edge aggregation scheme and a non-autoregressive architecture for the edge stage, as well as a hierarchical reinforcement learning method to train the stages jointly. Our experiments across six VRP variants demonstrate that NEPF trains and runs up to orders of magnitude faster than prior neural multigraph methods and scales to considerably larger instances, while matching or improving on their solution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多重图 (multigraph) 上的车辆路径问题 (VRP)，提出 Node-Edge Policy Factorization (NEPF)，把路由策略拆成节点排列与边选择两个阶段，配合预编码边聚合与非自回归边架构，并用分层强化学习联合训练。在六种 VRP 变体上，训练与推理比已有神经多重图方法快至数个数量级，可扩展到明显更大的实例，同时持平或提升解质量。
Motivation: 多数神经 VRP 方法局限于欧氏空间或简单图，而带平行边、权衡距离与时间的多重图在实践中常见，现有面向多重图的神经方法存在严重可扩展性瓶颈。
Method: NEPF 将策略分解为节点排列阶段与边选择阶段；引入预编码边聚合方案 (pre-encoding edge aggregation) 与边阶段的非自回归架构，并用分层强化学习 (hierarchical RL) 联合训练两个阶段。
Result: 在六种 VRP 变体上的实验中，NEPF 训练与运行速度比已有神经多重图方法快至数个数量级 (orders of magnitude)，可扩展到明显更大的实例，解质量持平或更优。
Conclusion: 节点与边的策略分解加上分层 RL 联合训练，是让神经多重图路由在规模上可用的路径，且不以牺牲解质量为代价。

papers.title: BALAR : A Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly operate in interactive settings where solving a task requires multiple rounds of information exchange with a user. However, most current systems treat dialogue reactively and lack a principled mechanism to reason about what information is missing. We propose BALAR (Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning), a task-agnostic outer-loop algorithm that requires no fine-tuning and enables multi-turn interaction between an LLM agent and a user. BALAR maintains a structured belief over latent states, selects clarifying questions by maximizing expected mutual information, and dynamically expands its state representation when the current one proves insufficient. We evaluate BALAR on three diverse benchmarks: AR-Bench-DC (detective cases), AR-Bench-SP (thinking puzzles), and iCraft-MD (clinical diagnosis). BALAR outperforms all baselines across the three benchmarks, with 14.6% higher accuracy on AR-Bench-DC, 38.5% on AR-Bench-SP, and 30.5% on iCraft-MD. We further study whether BALAR can serve as a teacher for a questioning policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and dense-reward reinforcement learning (RL). Across 18 iCraft-MD replications, distilling BALAR into a Llama-8B yields relative gains in frozen-Qwen final-answer accuracy of 8.1% with SFT, 10.9% with DPO, and 12.1% with RL over the untuned policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BALAR 是一个免微调的外循环算法，让 LLM agent 在多轮对话中维护对隐状态的结构化 belief，按期望互信息最大化挑选澄清问题，并在状态表示不够用时动态扩展。在 AR-Bench-DC、AR-Bench-SP、iCraft-MD 三个基准上准确率分别高出全部基线 14.6%、38.5%、30.5%；把 BALAR 蒸馏成提问策略后，18 次 iCraft-MD 复现中冻结 Qwen 最终答案准确率相对提升 8.1%（SFT）、10.9%（DPO）、12.1%（RL）。
Motivation: LLM 在需要多轮信息交换的交互任务中大多被动应答，缺少一个 principled 的机制去推理还缺什么信息，因而无法主动选择澄清问题。
Method: BALAR 是 task-agnostic 的外循环算法，无需微调：维护隐状态上的结构化 belief，用期望互信息 (expected mutual information) 最大化选择澄清问题，并在当前状态表示不足时动态扩展状态空间；评测用 AR-Bench-DC（侦探案件）、AR-Bench-SP（思维谜题）、iCraft-MD（临床诊断），并用 SFT、DPO、dense-reward RL 把 BALAR 蒸馏为提问策略教师。
Result: 在三个基准上 BALAR 全面超过所有基线：AR-Bench-DC 准确率高 14.6%，AR-Bench-SP 高 38.5%，iCraft-MD 高 30.5%。跨 18 次 iCraft-MD 复现，将 BALAR 蒸馏进 Llama-8B 后，冻结 Qwen 最终答案准确率相对未调策略提升 8.1%（SFT）、10.9%（DPO）、12.1%（RL）。
Conclusion: 把主动提问写成 belief 上的互信息最大化外循环，可以在不微调主干的前提下显著提升多轮推理任务的准确率，并且这套提问策略本身可作为教师被蒸馏进更小模型，RL 蒸馏收益最高。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把主动提问写成 belief 上的互信息最大化外循环，可以在不微调主干的前提下显著提升多轮推理任务的准确率，并且这套提问策略本身可作为教师被蒸馏进更小模型，RL 蒸馏收益最高。

papers.title: Hidden States as Value Gradients: The Pontryagin Structure of Recurrent Policies
papers.abstract_en: A key capability of intelligent agents is to act effectively under incomplete state observations. Recurrent policies address this by compressing observation histories into a hidden state. In this work, we show that the hidden state of a recurrent policy admits a control-theoretic interpretation: it plays the role of the co-state in Pontryagin's minimum principle, and the readout that maps it to actions implements control-Hamiltonian minimization. The hidden state thus tracks the gradient of the value function, encoding the optimality structure of the underlying control problem. We formalize this correspondence through a class of policies we refer to as co-state policies (CPs) and show that several modern recurrent cells implicitly realize this structure. The correspondence also allows for a co-state loss for actor-critic training, in which the critic's gradient serves as a target for the actor's hidden state. Empirically, we find that hidden states trained with the co-state loss encode co-state information beyond what is linearly decodable from the environment state alone, and that the loss improves policies both within and outside this class on challenging locomotion tasks, including the H1 and Berkeley humanoids. By connecting the minimum principle to recurrent memory, we provide a control-theoretic account of what hidden states compute in continuous control and a mechanism for shaping them toward optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把循环策略的隐状态解释为 Pontryagin 最小值原理中的 co-state，隐状态即值函数梯度，readout 实现 control-Hamiltonian 最小化；据此提出 co-state loss，用 critic 的梯度作为 actor 隐状态的训练目标。在 H1 与 Berkeley humanoid 等高难度运动任务上，该损失同时提升属于与不属于该策略类的策略，且隐状态编码了环境状态线性可解码之外的 co-state 信息。
Motivation: 部分可观测下循环策略把观测历史压成隐状态，但隐状态究竟计算什么缺少控制论解释，actor-critic 训练也缺少直接塑造隐状态最优性结构的信号。
Method: 形式化 co-state policies (CPs) 这一类策略，论证若干现代循环 cell 隐式实现该结构；提出 co-state loss，把 critic 的梯度作为 actor 隐状态的回归目标，用于 actor-critic 训练。
Result: 在 H1 与 Berkeley humanoid 等挑战性运动任务上，co-state loss 同时改善属于与不属于 CP 类的策略；用该损失训练的隐状态编码了仅从环境状态线性可解码之外的 co-state 信息。
Conclusion: 最小值原理可以作为循环记忆的控制论说明：隐状态在连续控制中计算值函数梯度，而 co-state loss 是把隐状态推向最优性结构的机制。

papers.title: Demystifying Manifold Constraints in LLM Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: The recent success of matrix optimizers (e.g., Muon) suggests that specific normalization of momentum, such as orthogonalization and row-wise normalization, benefits both the stability and acceleration of LLM training. Consequently, several recent studies have suggested that weights should also be normalized, leading to a Riemannian optimization problem. While such constrained training frameworks demonstrate superior performance, the effects of explicitly constraining weights, and their interaction with existing stabilization mechanisms, remain less understood. To bridge this gap, we study manifold constrained training dynamics through activation scales, rotational dynamics, and the update-to-weight ratio. We propose a Riemannian spectral steepest descent optimizer called MACRO, alongside a radius selection principle to serve as our testbed. Our analysis and numerical experiments reveal that RMSNorm and manifold constraints serve overlapping roles, and that weight decay can be completely eliminated when manifold constraints are applied. By controlling the update-to-weight ratio, constrained training significantly alleviates update cancellation, empirically demonstrating that MACRO is robust to low-precision computation and competitive with existing algorithms for standard LLM pre-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黎曼谱最速下降优化器 MACRO 与流形半径选择原则，作为研究 LLM 预训练中权重流形约束动力学的测试床。分析与数值实验显示 RMSNorm 与流形约束作用重叠，施加流形约束后 weight decay 可被完全去掉；通过控制 update-to-weight ratio 显著缓解 update cancellation，使 MACRO 抗低精度计算且在标准 LLM 预训练上与现有算法竞争。
Motivation: 矩阵优化器 (如 Muon) 的动量正交化与行归一化带来稳定性与加速，促使权重归一化被提出为黎曼约束训练；但显式约束权重的效果及其与既有稳定机制 (RMSNorm、weight decay) 的交互尚不清楚。
Method: 从 activation scales、rotational dynamics 与 update-to-weight ratio 三个角度刻画流形约束训练动力学；提出黎曼谱最速下降 (Riemannian spectral steepest descent) 优化器 MACRO，并给出流形半径选择原则作为测试床，配合数值实验。
Result: 分析与数值实验揭示 RMSNorm 与流形约束作用重叠，施加流形约束后 weight decay 可被完全消除；通过控制 update-to-weight ratio，约束训练显著缓解 update cancellation，MACRO 抗低精度计算，并在标准 LLM 预训练上与现有算法竞争。
Conclusion: 权重流形约束与 RMSNorm、weight decay 属于可互相替代的稳定机制，约束训练下 weight decay 可整体去掉，且 update-to-weight ratio 是缓解 update cancellation 的关键控制量。

papers.title: Deco: Extending Cherished Physical Objects into AI Companion Agents through Dual Embodiment
papers.abstract_en: Physical objects (e.g., plush toys) can transcend materiality to become emotional anchors and provide companionship. However, these bonds remain one-sided because most physical objects cannot reciprocate. AI companions offer responsiveness and personalization, but typically entail building bonds from scratch. We investigated how AI companions might inherit and extend users' existing bonds with physical objects. A formative study (N=9) informed four design principles (Faithful Identity, Calibrated Agency, Ambient Presence, Reciprocal Memory), shaping our Dual-Embodiment Companion Framework. We instantiated it as Deco to create digital embodiments of physical companions. In a within-subjects lab study (N=25), Deco was rated higher than a personalized digital-only companion on six companion-related measures (all p<.01). A subsequent seven-day field deployment (N=17) showed sustained engagement, higher post-deployment well-being (p=.040), and three key relational patterns: digital activities retroactively vitalized physical objects, bond deepening centered on emotional engagement depth, and participants sustained bonds while navigating companions' AI nature. Dual embodiment offers a promising framework for revitalizing physical objects with AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Deco 用「双具身 (Dual-Embodiment)」框架把用户对毛绒玩具等实体物件的既有情感纽带延伸成可回应的 AI 陪伴代理：先由 N=9 形成性研究提炼 Faithful Identity、Calibrated Agency、Ambient Presence、Reciprocal Memory 四条设计原则，再生成实体伴侣的数字具身。被试内实验 (N=25) 中 Deco 在六项陪伴相关量表上均高于个性化纯数字陪伴（均 p<.01），七天实地部署 (N=17) 显示投入持续、部署后幸福感更高 (p=.040)。
Motivation: 实体物件承载的情感纽带是单向的、无法回应，而 AI 陪伴又要求从零建立关系；两条路径都无法复用用户已有的依恋。
Method: 形成性研究 (N=9) 产出四条设计原则并构成 Dual-Embodiment Companion Framework，据此实现 Deco，为实体伴侣创建数字具身；随后做被试内实验室研究 (N=25) 对比个性化纯数字陪伴，再做七天实地部署 (N=17)。
Result: 被试内研究 (N=25) 中 Deco 在六项陪伴相关量表上评分高于个性化纯数字陪伴，全部 p<.01；七天部署 (N=17) 观察到持续投入、部署后幸福感显著提高 (p=.040)，并归纳出三种关系模式：数字活动反向激活实体物件、关系加深集中于情感投入深度、参与者在接纳 AI 本质的同时维持纽带。
Conclusion: 双具身是用 AI 激活既有实体物件的可行框架：让数字活动反哺对实体的依恋，同时用户可在承认代理 AI 属性的前提下继续维系关系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Dynamic Point Cloud
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic point cloud pretraining is still dominated by masked reconstruction objectives. However, these objectives inherit two key limitations. Existing methods inject ground-truth tube centers as decoder positional embeddings, causing spatio-temporal positional leakage. Moreover, they supervise inter-frame motion with deterministic proxy targets that systematically discard distributional structure by collapsing multimodal trajectory uncertainty into conditional means. To address these limitations, we propose Diffusion Masked Pretraining (DiMP), a unified self-supervised framework for dynamic point clouds. DiMP introduces diffusion modeling into both positional inference and motion learning. It first applies forward diffusion noise only to masked tube centers, then predicts clean centers from visible spatio-temporal context. This removes positional leakage while preserving visible coordinates as clean temporal anchors. DiMP also reformulates point-wise inter-frame displacement supervision as a DDPM noise-prediction objective conditioned on decoded representations. This design drives the encoder to target the full conditional distribution of plausible motions under a variational surrogate, rather than collapsing to a single deterministic estimate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiMP consistently improves downstream accuracy over the backbone alone, with absolute gains of 11.21% on offline action segmentation and 13.65% under causally constrained online inference.Codes are available at https://github.com/InitalZ/DiMP.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiMP 把扩散建模同时引入动态点云预训练的位置推断与运动学习：只对被掩码的 tube center 加前向噪声、由可见时空上下文预测干净中心以消除位置泄漏，并把逐点帧间位移监督改写为以解码表征为条件的 DDPM 噪声预测，让编码器拟合完整运动条件分布而非条件均值。在动作分割下游任务上，相比 backbone 绝对提升 11.21%（离线）与 13.65%（因果受限在线推理）。
Motivation: 动态点云掩码重建预训练把真值 tube center 直接作为解码器位置嵌入造成时空位置泄漏，并用确定性代理目标把多模态轨迹不确定性压成条件均值，丢掉分布结构。
Method: DiMP 是面向动态点云的自监督框架：前向扩散噪声只施加于被掩码 tube centers，解码器从可见时空上下文预测干净中心，可见坐标保留为干净时间锚点；帧间逐点位移监督重构为以解码表征为条件的 DDPM 噪声预测目标，在变分代理下逼近运动的完整条件分布。
Result: 在下游动作分割上，DiMP 相对 backbone 的绝对增益为离线 11.21%、因果受限在线推理 13.65%；作者称其在下游精度上一致优于仅用 backbone。
Conclusion: 对位置与运动同时采用扩散建模，可以在保留干净时间锚点的同时消除位置泄漏并保留多模态运动分布，从而稳定提升动态点云下游精度。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: FoR-Net: Focus-on-Regions Network for Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Focus-on-Regions Network (FoR-Net), an efficient semantic segmentation framework that explicitly focuses on hard regions through a selector-driven Top-K mechanism. Instead of relying on heavy global modeling, FoR-Net selectively enhances structurally informative regions. Multi-scale reasoning branches are introduced to aggregate spatial context efficiently. Experiments on the Cityscapes dataset demonstrate that FoR-Net achieves competitive performance while maintaining a lightweight architecture.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the 2026 International Symposium on Intelligent Signal Processing and Communication Systems (ISPACS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoR-Net 用 selector 驱动的 Top-K 机制只增强难分区域，并用多尺度推理分支聚合空间上下文，在保持轻量结构的前提下做语义分割。在 Cityscapes 上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 语义分割中依赖重型全局建模代价高，而真正难分的结构信息区域只占少数，需要一种只在关键区域投入计算的轻量方案。
Method: 提出 Focus-on-Regions Network (FoR-Net)：selector 驱动的 Top-K 机制显式筛选难分区域并选择性增强，替代重型全局建模；引入多尺度推理分支 (multi-scale reasoning branches) 高效聚合空间上下文，整体保持轻量架构。
Result: 在 Cityscapes 数据集上的实验表明，FoR-Net 在保持轻量架构的同时达到有竞争力的分割性能（摘要未列出具体 mIoU 数值）。
Conclusion: 选择性增强难分区域加多尺度上下文聚合，可以在不引入重型全局建模的情况下支撑有竞争力的语义分割。

papers.title: Mitigating Multimodal LLMs Hallucinations via Relevance Propagation at Inference Time
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision- and audio-language tasks, yet can generate responses that conflict with the given visual or auditory inputs, a problem known as multimodal hallucinations. Prior work suggests that this occurs when models rely more on textual cues and learned language patterns than on evidence from the perceptual input. To obtain a more direct account of this imbalance, we apply Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), which attributes predictions to individual input tokens, and use the resulting relevance scores to analyze and mitigate hallucinations. First, we examine whether this imbalance leads to multimodal hallucinations. We find that hallucinations often arise when the model relies less on perceptual inputs, and that changing this reliance affects its predictions. We further leverage LRP and propose a training-free framework that shifts relevance toward perceptual tokens by optimizing key-value representations during decoding, without modifying model parameters or requiring training data. We call this method Learning Inference-time Modality Enhancement (LIME). Despite using no spatial or temporal supervision, LIME concentrates relevance on query-relevant regions. We evaluate LIME across multiple multimodal benchmarks in both vision and audio domains, demonstrating consistent reductions in hallucinations and enhanced grounding while preserving generation quality.

papers.title: Query-Dependent Use of Generated Descriptions for Reliable Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hallucinate objects that are not present, and a growing line of work tries to curb this by feeding the model its own generated caption as auxiliary evidence -- assuming that a caption, once available, is something to consume. We show this fails: naively appending a caption can lower accuracy rather than raise it, dropping Qwen2.5-VL-3B† on HallusionBench by nearly ten points. To understand why, we build GD-Probe, a diagnostic set that pairs a global and a detail question on the same image, so that any difference in caption effect is attributable to the question alone. Caption utility proves to be a per-query property: the same caption helps global questions and harms detail ones, through a single mechanism -- an embedded caption competes with the image for attention and pulls the model's evidence onto its own text -- whose sign is set by whether the caption covers the queried content. Crucially, this regime is readable from quantities the decoder already emits, with no attention access or grounding. We turn this into GEASS (Gated Evidence-Adaptive Selective Caption Trust), a training-free, logit-level module that decides per query how much of the caption to trust, gating it by the clean path's confidence, weighting it by the entropy reduction it induces, and raising the evidence bar when the two pathways disagree. Across four VLMs and two benchmarks (POPE and HallusionBench), GEASS improves over both vanilla inference and contrastive decoding under a single fixed setting, adding only two forward passes and no parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEASS 证明把 VLM 自己生成的 caption 直接拼进上下文会按问题类型双向改变准确率：同一 caption 提升全局问题、损害细节问题，HallusionBench 上 Qwen2.5-VL-3B† 掉近 10 分。机制是 caption 与图像争夺注意力，符号由 caption 是否覆盖所问内容决定；据此提出免训练、logit 级门控模块，仅加两次前向、零参数，在四个 VLM 与 POPE、HallusionBench 上同时优于原生推理和 contrastive decoding。
Motivation: 用自生成 caption 作辅助证据抑制 VLM 幻觉的做法默认 caption 一出现就该被消费，但直接拼接可能反而降准确率，且 caption 效用随问题而变、无法预先判断。
Method: 先构建诊断集 GD-Probe，在同一图像上配对全局问题与细节问题，把 caption 效应差异归因于问题本身；再提出 GEASS（Gated Evidence-Adaptive Selective Caption Trust），免训练、logit 级，按 clean path 置信度门控、按 caption 引入的熵减加权、在两条通路分歧时抬高证据阈值，只依赖 decoder 已输出的量，无需 attention 或 grounding。
Result: naive 拼接 caption 使 Qwen2.5-VL-3B† 在 HallusionBench 上准确率下降近 10 分；同一 caption 对全局问题有效、对细节问题有害。GEASS 在四个 VLM 与 POPE、HallusionBench 两个基准的单一固定设置下，同时优于 vanilla inference 和 contrastive decoding，仅增加两次前向传播、不引入参数。
Conclusion: caption 效用是逐查询属性，符号由 caption 是否覆盖所问内容决定，而该状态可从 decoder 已有输出读出，因此按查询门控 caption 信任度即可在不训练、不加参数的前提下提升 VQA 可靠性。

papers.title: SMoES: Soft Modality-Guided Expert Specialization in MoE-VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a prevalent backbone for large vision-language models (VLMs), yet how modality-specific signals should guide expert routing remains under-explored. Existing routing strategies are either hand-crafted or modality-agnostic, relying on idealized priors that ignore the layer-dependent modality fusion patterns in MoE-VLMs and provide little guidance for expert specialization. We propose Soft Modality-guided Expert Specialization (SMoES), which consists of dynamic soft modality scores that capture layer-dependent fusion patterns, an expert binning mechanism aligned with expert-parallel deployment, and an inter-bin mutual information regularization that encourages coherent modality specialization. Our method leverages attention-based or Gaussian-statistics modality scores to optimize mutual information regularization. Experiments across four MoE-based VLMs and 16 benchmarks demonstrate improvement on both effectiveness and efficiency: 0.9% and 4.2% average gain on multimodal and language-only tasks, 56.1% reduction in EP communication overhead, and 12.3% throughput improvement under realistic deployment. These results validate that aligning routing with modality-aware expert specialization unlocks MoE-VLM capacity and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMoES 用动态软模态分数引导 MoE-VLM 的专家路由，使专家按模态特化而非依赖手工或模态无关的先验。在四个 MoE-VLM、16 个 benchmark 上多模态任务平均提升 0.9%、纯语言任务提升 4.2%，EP 通信开销下降 56.1%，实际部署吞吐提升 12.3%。
Motivation: MoE-VLM 的现有路由策略要么手工设计、要么模态无关，忽略各层模态融合模式的差异，无法为专家特化提供有效指导。
Method: SMoES 包含三部分：捕捉逐层融合模式的动态软模态分数（基于 attention 或 Gaussian 统计）、与 expert-parallel 部署对齐的 expert binning 机制，以及鼓励模态特化一致性的 inter-bin 互信息正则。
Result: 在四个基于 MoE 的 VLM、16 个 benchmark 上：多模态任务平均提升 0.9%，纯语言任务平均提升 4.2%，EP 通信开销降低 56.1%，真实部署下吞吐提升 12.3%。
Conclusion: 把路由与模态感知的专家特化对齐，可以同时释放 MoE-VLM 的容量与效率。

papers.title: Rethinking Where to Edit: Task-Aware Localization for Instruction-Based Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editing (IIE) aims to modify an image according to a natural language instruction. Despite recent advances in diffusion transformers, existing methods often introduce unintended changes to regions unrelated to the requested edit. We attribute this limitation to the absence of an explicit mechanism for edit localization. Different editing operations (e.g., subject addition, removal, and replacement) induce distinct spatial patterns, yet existing IIE models typically perform localization in a task-agnostic manner. To address this limitation, we propose a training-free, task-aware edit localization framework that exploits the intrinsic source and target image streams of IIE models. For each image stream, we construct feature centroids from attention-based edit cues, and then partition tokens into edit and non-edit regions based on feature similarity. Observing that effective localization is inherently task-dependent, we introduce a unified mask construction strategy that selectively leverages the source and target streams according to the editing task. We also provide a systematic analysis of our underlying insights and design choices. Extensive experiments on EdiVal-Bench demonstrate that our framework consistently improves content consistency in non-edit regions while maintaining strong instruction-following performance on top of Step1X-Edit and Qwen-Image-Edit.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. Project page: https://jessie459.github.io/TAL/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练免调优、任务感知的指令图像编辑定位框架，按编辑任务选择性利用源/目标图像流构造注意力编辑线索的特征质心，再按特征相似度把 token 划分为编辑区与非编辑区。在 EdiVal-Bench 上叠加到 Step1X-Edit 与 Qwen-Image-Edit 后，非编辑区域的内容一致性持续改善，同时保持较强的指令跟随表现。
Motivation: 指令图像编辑常改动与指令无关的区域，原因是扩散 Transformer 缺少显式的编辑定位机制，且不同编辑操作（主体添加、移除、替换）空间模式不同，现有模型却用任务无关的方式做定位。
Method: 训练免调优 (training-free) 框架：利用 IIE 模型内在的源与目标图像双流，对每条流用注意力编辑线索构建特征质心，按特征相似度把 token 分成编辑/非编辑区；再按具体编辑任务选择性地使用源流或目标流，统一构造定位掩码，并对设计选择做系统分析。
Result: 在 EdiVal-Bench 上，该框架叠加到 Step1X-Edit 和 Qwen-Image-Edit 两个基线模型后，均持续提升非编辑区域的内容一致性，同时保持较强的指令跟随性能。
Conclusion: 编辑定位应当是任务感知的：按编辑类型选择用源流还是目标流来构造掩码，可以在不训练的前提下减少无关区域改动而不牺牲指令跟随。
