papers.title: SGAP-Gaze: Scene Grid Attention Based Point-of-Gaze Estimation Network for Driver Gaze
papers.abstract_en: Driver gaze estimation is essential for understanding the driver's situational awareness of surrounding traffic. Existing gaze estimation models use driver facial information to predict the Point-of-Gaze (PoG) or the 3D gaze direction vector. We propose a benchmark dataset, Urban Driving-Face Scene Gaze (UD-FSG), comprising synchronized driver-face and traffic-scene images. The scene images provide cues about surrounding traffic, which can help improve the gaze estimation model, along with the face images. We propose SGAP-Gaze, Scene-Grid Attention based Point-of-Gaze estimation network, trained and tested on our UD-FSG dataset, which explicitly incorporates the scene images into the gaze estimation modelling. The gaze estimation network integrates driver face, eye, iris, and scene contextual information. First, the extracted features from facial modalities are fused to form a gaze intent vector. Then, attention scores are computed over the spatial scene grid using a Transformer-based attention mechanism fusing face and scene image features to obtain the PoG. The proposed SGAP-Gaze model achieves a mean pixel error of 104.73 on the UD-FSG dataset and 63.48 on LBW dataset, achieving a 23.5% reduction in mean pixel error compared to state-of-the-art driver gaze estimation models. The spatial pixel distribution analysis shows that SGAP-Gaze consistently achieves lower mean pixel error than existing methods across all spatial ranges, including the outer regions of the scene, which are rare but critical for understanding driver attention. These results highlight the effectiveness of integrating multi-modal gaze cues with scene-aware attention for a robust driver PoG estimation model in real-world driving environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出场景栅格注意力驾驶员注视点估计网络 SGAP-Gaze，把交通场景图像经 Transformer 注意力与人脸/眼部/虹膜特征融合的 gaze intent vector 结合来预测 Point-of-Gaze。在自建 UD-FSG 数据集上平均像素误差 104.73，LBW 数据集上 63.48，较先进驾驶员注视估计模型降低 23.5%。
Motivation: 现有驾驶员注视估计只用面部信息预测 PoG 或 3D 注视向量，忽略了交通场景本身提供的周边环境线索，而这些线索对判断驾驶员情境感知至关重要。
Method: 发布同步驾驶员面部与交通场景图像的基准数据集 UD-FSG；SGAP-Gaze 先融合面部、眼部、虹膜特征得到 gaze intent vector，再用基于 Transformer 的注意力机制在空间场景栅格上计算注意力分数、融合人脸与场景特征输出 PoG。
Result: 在 UD-FSG 上平均像素误差 104.73，在 LBW 数据集上 63.48，较先进驾驶员注视估计模型降低 23.5%；空间像素分布分析显示在包括场景外围区域在内的所有空间范围上平均像素误差均低于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把场景图像通过场景感知注意力纳入多模态注视线索，可在真实驾驶环境中得到更稳健的驾驶员 PoG 估计，且对罕见但关键的外围区域同样有效。

papers.title: SGP-SAM: Self-Gated Prompting for Transferring 3D Segment Anything Models to Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Large segmentation foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have reshaped promptable segmentation in natural images, and recent efforts have extended these models to medical images and volumetric settings. However, directly transferring a 3D SAM-style model to lesion segmentation remains challenging due to (i) weak spatial representational capacity for small, irregular targets in intermediate features, and (ii) extreme foreground-background imbalance in 3D volumes.We propose SGP-SAM, a self-gated prompting framework for efficient and effective transfer to 3D lesion segmentation. Our key component, the Self-Gated Prompting Module (SGPM), performs conditional multi-scale spatial enhancement: a lightweight multi-channel gating unit predicts whether the current features require additional multi-scale fusion, and only then activates a Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Block to enrich spatial context. To further address small-lesion learning, we design a Zoom Loss that up-weights lesion-focused supervision by combining Dice and a voxel-balanced focal term.Experiments on MSD Liver Tumor and MSD Brain Tumor (enhancing tumor) show consistent gains over strong transfer baselines based on SAM-Med3D. On MSD Liver Tumor, SGP-SAM improves mDice by 7.3% over fine-tuning.

papers.title: Chain of Modality: From Static Fusion to Dynamic Orchestration in Omni-MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal Large Language Models (Omni-MLLMs) are designed to reason over diverse sensory streams within a unified model. However, we find that multimodal reasoning is not solely determined by sensory evidence, but also by how modality information is organized. Through systematic analysis across diverse reasoning scenarios, we show that different modality organizations exhibit distinct advantages and limitations, and no single topology is universally optimal. Rather than proposing a general-purpose improvement to Omni-MLLM accuracy, we ask a narrower question: can these topology-induced failures be systematically identified and corrected? Motivated by this, we propose Chain of Modality (CoM), a framework that dynamically reorganizes multimodal topology during inference and learns adaptive organization strategies. Experiments across five benchmarks, diverse architectures, and model scales show that CoM reliably recovers topology-sensitive failures, through both training-free planning and lightweight Planner-SFT, while preserving performance on the full benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Omni-MLLM 的多模态推理不只取决于传感证据，还取决于模态信息的组织拓扑，且不存在普适最优的单一拓扑。提出 Chain of Modality (CoM)，在推理期动态重组模态拓扑并学习自适应组织策略，通过 training-free planning 与轻量 Planner-SFT 两条路径修复拓扑敏感失败，同时在完整基准上保持原有性能。
Motivation: Omni-MLLM 中不同模态组织方式各有优劣、无一普适，拓扑选择不当会系统性诱发多模态推理失败，而现有工作多追求通用精度提升而非定位与纠正这类失败。
Method: CoM 框架在推理阶段动态重组多模态拓扑并学习自适应组织策略，提供两种实现路径：training-free planning 与轻量的 Planner-SFT；在多种架构与模型规模上做系统分析以识别拓扑诱导的失败模式。
Result: 在五个基准、多种架构与模型规模上，CoM 通过 training-free planning 和 Planner-SFT 均能可靠修复拓扑敏感失败，同时在完整基准上保持原有性能；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 多模态推理失败可被系统性地定位并纠正，动态拓扑编排比固定单一组织更有效，且修复不必以牺牲整体基准性能为代价。

papers.title: UniRect-CoT: Enhancing Generation in Unified Multimodal Models via Reflective Rectification with Inherent Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) aim to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single structure. However, these models exhibit a notable capability mismatch, where their understanding capability often outperforms their generation capability. This mismatch suggests that the model's rich internal knowledge, while effective for understanding tasks, is not fully utilized during generation. To address this, we draw inspiration from the human ``Thinking-While-Drawing'' paradigm, where humans continuously reflect on intermediate results and revise them according to their understanding of the intended target. In this paper, we propose UniRect-CoT, a training-free unified rectification chain-of-thought framework. We regard the multi-step denoising process in UMMs as an intrinsic visual reasoning process, whose intermediate states provide opportunities for continuous reflection and rectification. By leveraging the UMM's inherent understanding to reflect on intermediate results in light of the target instruction and rectify them accordingly, our framework forms a reflective chain of thought within a single denoising trajectory, enabling the model's internal knowledge to guide generation throughout the process. Specifically, the UMM generates a state-conditioned reflection, whose autoregressive negative log-likelihood under the same model defines a model-native differentiable semantic loss that translates textual reflection into gradients for latent rectification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniRect-CoT generalizes across existing flow-based UMMs, consistently enhancing overall text-to-image generation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniRect-CoT 是一个免训练的统一多模态模型 (UMM) 生成修正框架：把多步去噪当作视觉推理轨迹，让模型对中间状态生成反思文本，再用同一模型对该反思的自回归负对数似然作为模型原生可微语义损失，把文本反思转成潜空间修正梯度。在现有 flow-based UMM 上一致提升文生图整体生成性能。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型的理解能力普遍强于生成能力，理解阶段积累的内部知识在生成时未被充分利用，中间去噪状态因此被浪费。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 的 reflective rectification chain-of-thought：在单条去噪轨迹内，UMM 依据目标指令对中间状态生成状态条件反思，该反思在同一模型下的自回归 NLL 构成 model-native differentiable semantic loss，驱动潜变量修正，形成单轨迹内的反思链。
Result: 在多个现有 flow-based UMM 上的大量实验显示，该框架泛化可用，并一致提升文生图 (text-to-image) 的整体生成性能。
Conclusion: UMM 自身的理解能力可以在不训练的前提下，通过中间状态的反思与语义损失反传来引导生成，从而缩小理解与生成的能力落差。

papers.title: Flux Attention: Context-Aware Hybrid Attention for Efficient LLMs Inference
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic computational complexity of standard attention mechanisms presents a severe scalability bottleneck for LLMs in long-context scenarios. While hybrid attention mechanisms combining Full Attention (FA) and Sparse Attention (SA) offer a potential solution, existing methods typically rely on static allocation ratios that fail to accommodate the variable retrieval demands of different tasks. Furthermore, head-level dynamic sparsity often introduces severe computational load imbalance and synchronization long-tails, which hinder hardware acceleration during autoregressive decoding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Flux Attention, a context-aware framework that dynamically optimizes attention computation at the layer level. By integrating a lightweight Layer Router into frozen pretrained LLMs, the proposed method adaptively routes each layer to FA or SA based on the input context. This layer-wise routing preserves high-fidelity information retrieval while ensuring contiguous memory access, translating theoretical computational reductions into practical wall-clock speedups. As a parameter-efficient approach, our framework requires only 12 hours of training on 8$\times$A800 GPUs. Extensive experiments across multiple long-context and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Flux Attention achieves a superior trade-off between performance and inference speed compared with baseline models, with speed improvements of up to $2.8\times$ and $2.0\times$ in the prefill and decode stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flux Attention 用轻量 Layer Router 在冻结的预训练 LLM 上按输入上下文逐层把注意力路由到 Full Attention 或 Sparse Attention，取代静态混合比例与 head 级动态稀疏。层级路由保持连续内存访问，把理论计算量下降转成实测墙钟加速：prefill 最高 2.8×、decode 最高 2.0×，训练只需 8×A800 上 12 小时。
Motivation: 标准 attention 的二次复杂度是长上下文 LLM 的扩展瓶颈；现有 FA/SA 混合方案用静态分配比例，无法适配不同任务的检索需求，而 head 级动态稀疏又造成计算负载不均与同步长尾，拖慢自回归解码。
Method: 在冻结的预训练 LLM 中插入轻量 Layer Router，按输入上下文在层级决定每层走 Full Attention 还是 Sparse Attention；层级路由保证连续内存访问，属参数高效方案，仅需 8×A800 GPU 上 12 小时训练。
Result: 在多个长上下文与数学推理 benchmark 上，相对 baseline 取得性能与推理速度的更优折中，prefill 阶段加速最高 2.8×，decode 阶段最高 2.0×；训练成本为 8×A800 GPU 12 小时。
Conclusion: 把 FA/SA 的分配从静态比例和 head 级稀疏改为按上下文的层级路由，能在保住长上下文检索保真度的同时把计算缩减兑现为实际墙钟加速。

papers.title: MMORF: A Multi-agent Framework for Designing Multi-objective Retrosynthesis Planning Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective retrosynthesis planning is a critical chemistry task requiring dynamic balancing of quality, safety, and cost objectives. Language model-based multi-agent systems (MAS) offer a promising approach for this task: leveraging interactions of specialized agents to incorporate multiple objectives into retrosynthesis planning. We present MMORF, a framework for constructing MAS for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning. MMORF features modular agentic components, which can be flexibly combined and configured into different systems, enabling principled evaluation and comparison of different system designs. Using MMORF, we construct two representative MAS: MASIL and RFAS. On a newly curated benchmark consisting of 218 multi-objective retrosynthesis planning tasks, MASIL achieves strong safety and cost metrics on soft-constraint tasks, frequently Pareto-dominating baseline routes, while RFAS achieves a 48.6% success rate on hard-constraint tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Together, these results show the effectiveness of MMORF as a foundational framework for exploring MAS for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ninglab/MMORF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMORF 是一个用于多目标逆合成规划 (multi-objective retrosynthesis planning) 的模块化多智能体框架，可灵活组合配置成不同系统以公平比较设计。基于它构建的 MASIL 在软约束任务上频繁 Pareto 支配基线路线，RFAS 在硬约束任务上达到 48.6% 成功率并超越 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 逆合成规划需在质量、安全、成本多个目标间动态权衡，而现有基于语言模型的多智能体系统缺乏可组合、可配置的构建框架，难以对不同系统设计做有原则的评估与比较。
Method: MMORF 提供模块化的 agentic 组件，可灵活组合配置成不同多智能体系统；作者用它构建两个代表性系统 MASIL 与 RFAS，并在新整理的 218 个多目标逆合成规划任务基准上评测。
Result: 在 218 个多目标任务的新基准上：MASIL 在软约束任务上取得强安全与成本指标，频繁 Pareto 支配基线路线；RFAS 在硬约束任务上达到 48.6% 成功率，超越 state-of-the-art 基线。
Conclusion: MMORF 可作为探索多目标逆合成规划多智能体系统的基础框架，模块化组合使不同设计的评估与比较成为可能；代码与数据已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: How Does "English (US)" Become the Default? Triangulating Structural Bias Towards American English Across the LLM Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in educational, professional, and public infrastructure, yet widely used platforms expose "English (US)" as a primary English setting despite the global diversity of English. We ask: How does "English (US)" become the default? We study this question as structural bias, examining how geopolitical histories of data curation, digital dominance, and linguistic standardization intersect with the LLM development pipeline. Using British English as a controlled reference, we construct a curated resource of 1,813 matched American English (AmE)--British English (BrE) variants and introduce DiAlign, a dynamic, training-free method for estimating regional alignment from distributional evidence. We triangulate the AmE preference across data exposure --> representation --> generation, jointly examining pretraining and post-training data, tokenizer behavior and provenance, model prediction cost, and generated language across developer countries, prompt conditions, domains and sources, linguistic categories, and registers. AmE is consistently favored across all six audited pretraining corpora and 21 post-training datasets, is generally represented more compactly by tokenizers, and receives lower prediction cost. It also remains the dominant generation default under neutral English prompting; British-English prompting shifts this preference toward BrE but does not consistently eliminate the AmE default. To our knowledge, this is the first rigorous pipeline-wide study of structural bias across major phases of LLM development. Our findings show that contemporary LLMs privilege AmE as the de facto norm, raising concerns about linguistic homogenization, epistemic injustice, and inequity in global AI deployment, while providing a rigorous basis for targeted component-level intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究把「English (US)」默认化当作 LLM 流水线上的结构性偏见来审计：用 1,813 组美式/英式英语对照变体和免训练的 DiAlign 方法，从数据暴露、表征到生成逐段取证。六个预训练语料与 21 个后训练数据集一致偏向 AmE，tokenizer 表示更紧凑、预测成本更低，中性英语提示下生成仍以 AmE 为默认；改用英式提示只能部分转移偏好，不能稳定消除默认。
Motivation: 主流平台把「English (US)」设为首选项，但英语本身高度地域多样；此前缺少贯穿 LLM 数据、分词、预测与生成各阶段的系统性偏见证据。
Method: 以英式英语 (BrE) 为受控参照，构建 1,813 组匹配的 AmE–BrE 变体资源，提出免训练、基于分布证据估计地域对齐度的 DiAlign；沿数据暴露→表征→生成三段三角互证，联合考察预训练与后训练数据、tokenizer 行为与来源、模型预测成本，以及不同开发者国家、提示条件、领域来源、语言类别与语域下的生成语言。
Result: AmE 在全部六个受审预训练语料和 21 个后训练数据集中被一致偏好；tokenizer 通常更紧凑地表示 AmE，且 AmE 预测成本更低；中性英语提示下 AmE 仍是生成默认，英式英语提示会把偏好推向 BrE 但不能稳定消除 AmE 默认。
Conclusion: 当代 LLM 把 AmE 当作事实规范，这是贯穿开发各阶段的结构性偏见，可据此做组件级的针对性干预。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments
papers.abstract_en: Current benchmarks for graphical user interface (GUI) agents predominantly rely on static screenshots. However, real-world smartphone interaction routinely requires agents to process transient audio cues and temporal video dynamics that are tightly coupled with the moment of action. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniGUI, the first step-level benchmark designed to evaluate GUI agents in omni-modal smartphone environments. OmniGUI provides continuous, interleaved multimodal inputs comprising static images, synchronous audio, and video clips at every action step. The dataset encompasses 709 expert-demonstrated episodes (2,579 action steps) across 29 applications, systematically annotated with objective multimodal dependency levels. Because dedicated omni-modal GUI agent frameworks are currently in their nascent stage, we select foundational omni-modal models capable of natively processing interleaved inputs to serve as agent proxies for our initial baselines. Our empirical evaluation reveals that while current models exhibit competency on visually static tasks, their action prediction performance degrades significantly in environments requiring synchronous temporal and auditory signals. Furthermore, ablation studies isolate specific operational bottlenecks, notably cross-modal interference when processing task-irrelevant environmental noise. The complete dataset, evaluation pipeline, and baseline prompts are provided in the supplementary material. Project page: https://omni-gui.github.io.
papers.comment: Corrected author list, all paper content, experiments and conclusions remain unchanged. 27 pages, 18 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniGUI 是首个 step-level 的全模态 (omni-modal) 手机 GUI agent 基准，每个动作步都提供图像、同步音频与视频片段的交错输入。709 条专家示范 episode（2,579 个动作步）、覆盖 29 个应用并标注多模态依赖等级；评测显示现有全模态模型在视觉静态任务上尚可，但在需要同步时序与听觉信号的环境中动作预测性能显著下降，消融进一步定位到任务无关环境噪声引发的跨模态干扰。
Motivation: 现有 GUI agent 基准几乎只用静态截图，而真实手机交互常依赖瞬时音频提示与视频时序动态，这些信号与动作时刻紧密耦合，静态基准无法衡量这类能力。
Method: 构建 step-level 基准 OmniGUI，在每个动作步提供图像、同步音频、视频片段的连续交错输入；数据为 709 条专家示范 episode、2,579 个动作步、29 个应用，按客观多模态依赖等级系统标注。因专用全模态 GUI 框架尚处早期，选用能原生处理交错输入的基础全模态模型作为 agent proxy 建立初始基线，并做消融定位瓶颈。
Result: 数据集含 709 条专家示范 episode、2,579 个动作步、29 个应用；评测显示当前模型在视觉静态任务上表现胜任，但在需要同步时序与听觉信号的环境中动作预测性能显著下降；消融分离出具体操作瓶颈，尤其是处理任务无关环境噪声时的跨模态干扰 (cross-modal interference)。
Conclusion: 现有全模态模型的能力边界在听觉与同步时序信号上，GUI agent 要走出静态截图范式必须先解决跨模态干扰；数据集、评测流程与基线 prompt 随补充材料发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Prosodic ABX: A Language-Agnostic Method for Measuring Prosodic Contrast in Speech Representations
papers.abstract_en: Speech representations from self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) are known to be sensitive to phonemic contrasts, but their sensitivity to prosodic contrasts has not been directly measured. The ABX discrimination task has been used to measure phonemic contrast in S3M representations via minimal pairs. We introduce prosodic ABX, an extension of this framework to evaluate prosodic contrast with only a handful of examples and no explicit labels. Also, we build and release a dataset of English and Japanese minimal pairs and use it along with a Mandarin dataset to evaluate contrast in English stress, Japanese pitch accent, and Mandarin tone. Finally, we show that model and layer rankings are often preserved across several experimental conditions, making it practical for low-resource settings.
papers.comment: Presented at Interspeech 2026; 6 pages, 4 figures; Supplement: https://stephenmac7.github.io/prosodic-abx/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 prosodic ABX：把测量音位对比的 ABX 判别任务扩展到韵律对比，只需少量样本、无需显式标签即可评测自监督语音模型 (S3M) 对重音、音高重音和声调的敏感度。配套发布英语与日语最小对比对数据集，连同已有普通话数据集评测三种韵律对比，并发现模型与层级排名在多种实验条件下大体保持，因此可用于低资源场景。
Motivation: S3M 表征对音位对比的敏感度已知，但对韵律对比的敏感度此前没有被直接测量，缺少无需标注、样本需求小的评测手段。
Method: 将基于最小对比对 (minimal pairs) 的 ABX 判别任务扩展为 prosodic ABX，用少量样本、无显式标签评测表征中的韵律对比；构建并发布英语和日语最小对比对数据集，与普通话数据集一起评测英语重音、日语音高重音 (pitch accent) 与普通话声调，并在多种实验条件下比较模型与层级排名。
Result: 在英语重音、日语音高重音、普通话声调三类韵律对比上完成评测；模型与层级排名在多种实验条件下通常被保持，使该方法在低资源设置下可行。
Conclusion: 韵律对比可以用少量无标签样本的 ABX 框架直接测量，且排名跨条件稳定，因而适合低资源环境下的 S3M 表征评测。

papers.title: Reasoning Shift: How Context Silently Shortens LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibiting test-time scaling behavior, such as extended reasoning traces and self-verification, have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex, long-term reasoning tasks. However, the robustness of these reasoning behaviors remains underexplored. To investigate this, we conduct a systematic evaluation of multiple reasoning models across three scenarios: (1) problems augmented with lengthy, irrelevant context; (2) multi-turn conversational settings with independent tasks; and (3) problems presented as a subtask within a complex task. We observe an interesting phenomenon: reasoning models tend to produce much shorter reasoning traces (up to 74%) for the same problem under different context conditions compared to the traces produced when the problem is presented in isolation. A finer-grained analysis reveals that this compression is associated with a decrease in self-verification and uncertainty management behaviors, such as double-checking. Importantly, we show that even when additional self-checks are forced, their efficiency depends not only on the content of the reasoning traces, but also on the presence of redundant context. We hope our findings draw additional attention to both the robustness of reasoning models and the problem of context management for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统评测多个推理模型在三种上下文条件下（冗长无关上下文、多轮独立任务、作为复杂任务的子任务）的推理行为，发现同一问题在有上下文时推理链比孤立呈现时最多缩短 74%，且压缩伴随自我验证与不确定性管理（如 double-checking）行为减少；即使强制追加自检，其效率也取决于冗余上下文是否存在。
Motivation: LLM 的 test-time scaling 推理行为（长推理链、自我验证）在复杂任务上表现好，但其在不同上下文条件下的鲁棒性研究不足，上下文管理问题被忽视。
Method: 对多个推理模型做系统性评测，设置三种场景：加冗长无关上下文的问题、含独立任务的多轮对话、作为复杂任务子任务呈现的问题；对比孤立呈现时的推理链长度，并做细粒度行为分析（自我验证、不确定性管理），再强制追加自检以检验其效率。
Result: 同一问题在不同上下文条件下推理链比孤立呈现时最多缩短 74%；细粒度分析显示该压缩与自我验证和不确定性管理行为（如 double-checking）减少相关；强制追加的自检效率不仅取决于推理链内容，还取决于冗余上下文是否存在。
Conclusion: 上下文会静默压缩 LLM 推理并削弱自我验证，推理模型的鲁棒性与上下文管理是需要关注的问题。

papers.title: Meta-TTL: Meta-Learning Self-Improvement Policies for Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Learning (TTL) enables language agents to iteratively refine their performance through repeated interactions with the environment at inference time. At the core of TTL is a self-improvement policy that updates the actor policy based on experience from previous episodes, thereby improving future behavior. Existing methods rely on hand-crafted self-improvement rather than optimizing them for downstream improvement. We argue that optimal self-improvement policies should be learned from task environments, not hand-engineered based on human intuition. To achieve this, we introduce \textbf{Meta-TTL}, a framework that formulates the discovery of effective self-improvement policies as a bi-level optimization problem. Within this framework, the inner loop executes the standard TTL process, measuring how effectively a candidate self-improvement policy helps an agent correct errors across sequential episodes. Guided by the agent's performance, the outer loop performs reflective meta-training across diverse training tasks, using a balanced improvement score (BIS) to balance task contributions during candidate selection. We evaluate Meta-TTL on Jericho, WebArena-Lite, and -bench across both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings. Meta-TTL consistently outperforms existing baselines, improving TTL over the strongest baseline by up to 23% on ID tasks and 27% on OOD tasks. These results suggest that the optimized self-improvement policy encodes transferable meta-strategies that generalize beyond the training task distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Meta-TTL 把语言 agent 的测试时自我改进策略 (self-improvement policy) 从人工设计改为可学习对象，用双层优化求解：内层跑标准 TTL 衡量候选策略纠错效果，外层在多样训练任务上做反思式 meta-training，并用 balanced improvement score (BIS) 平衡任务贡献。在 Jericho、WebArena-Lite 与 -bench 的 ID/OOD 评测中，相对最强基线最高提升 23%（ID）与 27%（OOD），说明学到的策略编码了可迁移的元策略。
Motivation: 现有 TTL 方法的自我改进策略靠人工构造，而非针对下游改进优化；作者认为最优改进策略应从任务环境中学出来，而不是凭人类直觉手工设计。
Method: 将自我改进策略的发现形式化为双层优化：内层执行标准 TTL 过程，度量候选策略在连续 episode 中纠正错误的有效性；外层依据 agent 表现，在多样训练任务上做反思式 meta-training，候选选择时用 balanced improvement score (BIS) 平衡各任务贡献。
Result: 在 Jericho、WebArena-Lite 与 -bench 上，覆盖 in-distribution (ID) 与 out-of-distribution (OOD) 设置，Meta-TTL 一致优于现有基线：相对最强基线的 TTL 改进幅度在 ID 任务上最高达 23%，在 OOD 任务上最高达 27%。
Conclusion: 经优化的自我改进策略编码了可迁移的元策略，能泛化到训练任务分布之外，因此 TTL 的改进策略应当学习而非手工设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Measuring (some aspects of) the metacognition of AI
papers.abstract_en: A robust decision-making process must take into account uncertainty, especially when the choice involves inherent risks. Because artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly integrated into decision-making workflows, managing uncertainty relies more and more on the metacognitive capabilities of these systems; i.e, their ability to assess the reliability of and regulate their own decisions. Hence, it is crucial to employ robust methods to measure the metacognitive abilities of AI. This paper is primarily a methodological contribution that highlights a key limitation of commonly used measures of AI metacognitive sensitivity--the ability to generate confidence ratings that distinguish correct from incorrect responses. We then draw attention to the meta-d' framework, a well-established approach from psychology and neuroscience designed to address this limitation. Moreover, we propose to leverage signal detection theory (SDT) to measure the ability of AIs to spontaneously regulate their decisions based on uncertainty and risk. To demonstrate the practical utility of these psychophysical frameworks, we conduct two series of experiments on three large language models (LLMs)--GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and Mistral-Medium-2508.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出常用 AI 元认知敏感度指标存在关键缺陷，并引入心理学与神经科学的 meta-d' 框架，再用信号检测论 (SDT) 度量 LLM 依据不确定性与风险自发调节决策的能力；在 GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp、Mistral-Medium-2508 上做了两组实验演示其可用性。
Motivation: AI 系统进入含风险的决策流程后，其置信度能否区分对错、能否据不确定性调节决策直接关系可靠性，而常用的元认知敏感度度量本身有局限。
Method: 方法学贡献：批评现有 AI 元认知敏感度度量，转而采用 meta-d' 框架刻画置信度区分正确与错误回答的能力，并以信号检测论 (SDT) 度量依据不确定性与风险自发调节决策的能力；用两组实验在三个 LLM 上演示。
Result: 在 GPT-5、DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp、Mistral-Medium-2508 三个 LLM 上进行两组实验，以演示 meta-d' 与 SDT 框架的实用性；论文为 19 页、5 图、2 表。

papers.title: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate chains of thought (CoTs) that are not always causally responsible for their final outputs. When such a mismatch occurs, the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the actual reasons (i.e., decision-critical factors) driving the model's behavior, leading to the reduced CoT monitorability problem. This limits the use of CoTs for reliable oversight. However, a comprehensive and fully open-source benchmark for thoroughly evaluating CoT monitorability remains lacking. To address this gap, we propose MonitorBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating CoT monitorability in LLMs. MonitorBench provides: (1) a diverse set of 1,514 test instances with carefully designed decision-critical factors across 19 tasks spanning 7 categories to characterize when CoTs can be used to monitor the factors driving LLM behavior; and (2) two prompting stress-test settings to quantify the extent to which CoT monitorability can be degraded. Extensive experiments show that CoT monitorability is a conditional property affected by the evaluated LLM, monitor LLM, and task characteristics. Across these factors, monitorability is higher when decision-critical factors shape the intermediate reasoning process, rather than merely influencing the final answer. Under stress-test prompting, most evaluated LLMs can intentionally reduce monitorability, mainly on tasks where decision-critical factors are not structurally required by the reasoning process. Overall, MonitorBench provides a basis for further research on AI control, reasoning faithfulness, stress-test monitorability, and monitoring scaffords. The code is available at https://github.com/ASTRAL-Group/MonitorBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MonitorBench 是评测大模型思维链 (CoT) 可监控性的开源基准：1,514 个测试实例、19 个任务、7 个类别，配两组 prompting 压力测试。实验显示可监控性是条件性属性，取决于被评 LLM、监控 LLM 与任务特征；当决策关键因素真正塑造中间推理而非只影响最终答案时可监控性更高，而在压力测试下多数模型能主动降低可监控性，主要发生在推理过程并不结构性要求该因素的任务上。
Motivation: CoT 常与最终输出不因果一致，因而无法可靠用于监督；现有可监控性评测缺乏系统且完全开源的基准。
Method: 构建 MonitorBench：覆盖 7 类共 19 个任务的 1,514 个测试实例，每个实例设计决策关键因素 (decision-critical factors)；另设两种 prompting 压力测试设置来量化可监控性可被削弱的程度。
Result: 实验表明 CoT 可监控性是条件性属性，受被评 LLM、监控 LLM 与任务特征共同影响；决策关键因素塑造中间推理时可监控性高于仅影响最终答案的情形；压力测试下多数被评 LLM 能有意降低可监控性，集中在该因素不被推理过程结构性要求的任务上。
Conclusion: CoT 可监控性不是模型的固有属性，而是随任务结构与 prompting 条件变化，因此用 CoT 做可靠监督必须按任务与压力条件分别验证。

papers.title: Hyperspectral Trajectory Image for Multi-Month Trajectory Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory anomaly detection underpins applications from fraud detection to urban mobility analysis. Dense GPS preserves fine-grained evidence such as abnormal speeds and short-duration events, but its quadratic cost makes multi-month analysis intractable; sparse stay-point methods scale by discarding that evidence and require a separate modeling regime. We argue that this bottleneck is unnecessary: dense and sparse trajectories share a natural two-dimensional cyclic structure along within-day and across-day axes. TITAnD (Trajectory Image Transformer for Anomaly Detection) is the first framework to cast both in a single representation, a Hyperspectral Trajectory Image (HTI), a day $\times$ time-of-day grid whose channels encode spatial, semantic, temporal, and kinematic information. Under this formulation, agent-level detection reduces to image classification and temporal localization to semantic segmentation. The Cyclic Factorized Transformer (CFT) models the two temporal axes directly, reducing attention cost by up to two orders of magnitude. With the HTI, multi-month dense anomaly detection becomes feasible for the first time, and CFT keeps it accurate and fast. Empirically, TITAnD matches or beats every evaluated baseline in AUC-PR on all four benchmarks. It surpasses vision models such as U-Net while using as few as 6.5M parameters, and it runs 11--75$\times$ faster than a capacity-matched flat Transformer on the same trajectory images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TITAnD 把稠密与稀疏轨迹统一成「高光谱轨迹图像 (HTI)」——以天 × 一天内时刻为网格、通道编码空间/语义/时间/运动学信息，使轨迹级异常检测化为图像分类、时间定位化为语义分割。循环分解 Transformer (CFT) 直接建模日内与跨日两条时间轴，注意力成本最多降两个数量级，从而首次让多月稠密异常检测可行。在四个基准上 AUC-PR 追平或超过全部被评估基线，参数量低至 6.5M，比同等容量的平铺 Transformer 快 11–75×。
Motivation: 稠密 GPS 保留异常速度与短时事件等细粒度证据，但二次方开销使多月分析不可行；稀疏 stay-point 方法靠丢弃这些证据换取扩展性，且需要另一套建模范式。
Method: 提出 TITAnD：先构造 HTI（天 × 一天内时刻网格，通道承载空间、语义、时间与运动学信息），把检测转为图像分类、定位转为语义分割；再用 Cyclic Factorized Transformer (CFT) 分别建模日内与跨日两条循环时间轴以压缩注意力开销。
Result: 在全部四个基准上 AUC-PR 追平或超过每个被评估基线；以低至 6.5M 参数超越 U-Net 等视觉模型；在相同轨迹图像上比同等容量的平铺 Transformer 快 11–75×；注意力成本最多降低两个数量级。
Conclusion: 稠密与稀疏轨迹共享日内/跨日二维循环结构，用单一 HTI 表示加轴分解注意力即可同时保住细粒度证据与多月尺度的可行性、精度和速度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniWeaving: Towards Unified Video Generation with Free-form Composition and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While proprietary systems such as Seedance-2.0 have achieved remarkable success in omni-capable video generation, the academic research community lags far behind: most of its models remain heavily fragmented, and the few existing efforts toward unified video generation still struggle to seamlessly integrate diverse tasks within a single framework. To bridge this gap, we propose OmniWeaving, an omni-level video generation model featuring powerful multimodal composition and reasoning-informed capabilities. By leveraging a massive-scale pretraining dataset that encompasses diverse compositional and reasoning-augmented scenarios, OmniWeaving learns to temporally bind interleaved text, multi-image, and video inputs while acting as an intelligent agent to infer complex user intentions for sophisticated video creation. Furthermore, we introduce IntelligentVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to rigorously assess next-level intelligent unified video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniWeaving achieves SoTA performance among open-source academic unified models. The code and model are publicly available. Project Page: https://omniweaving.github.io.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 22 figures. Project Page: https://omniweaving.github.io. Github: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/OmniWeaving. Model: https://huggingface.co/tencent/HY-OmniWeaving
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniWeaving 是一个统一视频生成模型，通过大规模预训练把交错的文本、多图与视频输入在时间上绑定，并以 agent 方式推理用户意图来生成视频。在自建的 IntelligentVBench 上评测，达到开源学术统一视频生成模型中的 SoTA。
Motivation: 开源统一视频生成模型高度碎片化，少数统一化工作也难以在单一框架内无缝整合多类任务，与 Seedance-2.0 等专用系统差距明显。
Method: 用覆盖多样化组合与推理增强场景的大规模预训练数据，学习在时间上绑定交错的文本、多图和视频输入，并作为智能体推断复杂用户意图；同时提出 IntelligentVBench 基准。
Result: 在 IntelligentVBench（作者称为首个面向下一代智能统一视频生成的综合基准）上，Extensive experiments 显示 OmniWeaving 在开源学术统一视频模型中达到 SoTA；代码与模型公开。
Conclusion: 统一视频生成可以在单一框架内同时承载自由形式组合与推理，并在开源学术模型中取得最优表现。

papers.title: Do Papers Tell the Whole Story? A Benchmark and Framework for Uncovering Hidden Implementation Gaps in Bioinformatics
papers.abstract_en: As bioinformatics software is increasingly applied across a broader range of scenarios and the rapid development of large language models (LLMs) further lowers the barriers to software use and development, the composition of the bioinformatics research community is undergoing substantial change. Consequently, a growing number of researchers require a deeper understanding of methodological details and software behavior. In this context, systematically analyzing the relationship between paper descriptions and code implementations is emerging as an important new challenge in the field. To address this challenge, we introduce paper-code consistency analysis as a new research perspective and construct BioCon, the first benchmark dataset for paper-code consistency analysis in bioinformatics. Furthermore, we develop a unified cross-modal analysis framework to systematically investigate this problem from three perspectives: sentence-level detection, cross-modal retrieval, and project-level assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively model the semantic relationships between scientific publications and software implementations. Further case studies reveal that paper-code inconsistency is not a single phenomenon but arises from multiple underlying causes, among which Author-Perceived Non-Essential Details represents the most prevalent category. These findings suggest that paper-code consistency analysis is not merely a technical problem but also raises broader discussions regarding knowledge dissemination, the boundaries of code disclosure, and community norms. We hope that this work will encourage the bioinformatics community to re-examine the relationship between scientific publications and software implementations while providing a foundation for future research in paper-code consistency analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 paper-code consistency analysis 这一新任务，并构建生物信息学首个基准 BioCon，配套统一跨模态分析框架，从句子级不一致检测、跨模态检索、项目级评估三个层面刻画论文描述与代码实现的语义对应。实验表明该框架能有效建模论文与软件实现间的语义关系；案例研究显示不一致并非单一现象而是多类成因，其中 Author-Perceived Non-Essential Details（作者认为非必要的细节）最为普遍。
Motivation: LLM 降低了软件使用与开发门槛，生物信息学研究者构成变化，需要更深理解方法细节与软件行为，但论文描述与代码实现之间的对应关系缺少系统分析手段。
Method: 构建 BioCon 基准数据集（论文-代码一致性分析的首个基准），并提出统一跨模态分析框架，分三个层面：句子级不一致检测、跨模态检索、项目级评估；另以案例研究归纳不一致的成因类别。
Result: 实验结果显示该框架能有效建模科学论文与软件实现之间的语义关系；案例研究发现 paper-code 不一致由多类底层成因构成，其中 Author-Perceived Non-Essential Details 是最普遍的一类。
Conclusion: 论文-代码一致性既是技术问题，也牵涉知识传播、代码披露边界与社区规范；作者呼吁生物信息学社区重新审视论文与实现的关系，并为后续研究提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: P^2O: Joint Policy and Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) enhances Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning but is suffer from advantage collapse: when all rollouts of a query receive identical rewards, the group variance vanishes, most damagingly on hard samples, where scaling rollout budgets yields little. We introduce Joint Policy and Prompt Optimization (P O) to mitigate this collapse by alternating continuous policy updates with discrete prompt evolution. P O mines hard samples with a success-rate threshold, evolves reasoning prompts for them with GEPA, and internalizes the elicited trajectories via context distillation, which optimizes each trajectory under the original query and thus removes inference-time prompting, with a Context Ratio Mask (CRM) filtering out extreme likelihood ratios. P O restores critical advantage signals and surpasses the GRPO baseline by up to 8.2 points in average accuracy on six held-out benchmarks across all training datasets and backbones, while also outperforming DAPO and other baselines. The gains are especially pronounced on hard benchmarks, reaching up to 16.3 points above GRPO on average across AIME24 and AIME25. Our findings expose the limits of standard exploration in sparse-reward environments, illuminating the potential of unifying evolutionary algorithms with reinforcement learning. This integration of discrete semantic search and continuous parameter updates provides a self-reinforcing framework that facilitates more effective LLM alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P^2O 用离散提示进化与连续策略更新交替，缓解 RLVR 中因同组奖励全同导致的 advantage collapse：按成功率阈值挖出难题，用 GEPA 进化其推理提示，再经 context distillation 把轨迹内化进策略并用 Context Ratio Mask 过滤极端似然比。在六个 held-out benchmark 上平均准确率较 GRPO 最多高 8.2 分，AIME24/AIME25 上最多高 16.3 分。
Motivation: RLVR 中同一 query 的所有 rollout 拿到相同奖励时组内方差消失，难题上最严重，继续扩大 rollout 预算也换不来梯度信号，标准探索在稀疏奖励环境下失效。
Method: P^2O 交替执行连续策略更新与离散提示进化：以成功率阈值挖掘 hard samples，用 GEPA 对其推理提示做进化，再通过 context distillation 在原始 query 下优化被激发的轨迹从而去掉推理时提示，并用 Context Ratio Mask (CRM) 过滤极端似然比。
Result: 在覆盖所有训练数据集与 backbone 的六个 held-out benchmark 上，平均准确率较 GRPO 基线最多提升 8.2 分，并超过 DAPO 等基线；在 AIME24 与 AIME25 上平均较 GRPO 最多高出 16.3 分。

papers.title: Benchmarking Bengali Dialectal Bias: A Multi-Stage Framework Integrating RAG-Based Translation and Human-Augmented RLAIF
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) frequently exhibit performance biases against regional dialects of low-resource languages. However, frameworks to quantify these disparities remain scarce. We propose a two-phase framework to evaluate dialectal bias, operationalized as comprehension degradation relative to standard Bengali, in LLM question-answering across nine Bengali dialects. First, we translate and gold-label standard Bengali questions into dialectal variants adopting a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline to prepare 4,000 question sets. Since traditional translation quality evaluation metrics fail on unstandardized dialects, we evaluate fidelity using an LLM-as-a-judge, which human correlation confirms outperforms legacy metrics. Second, we benchmark 19 LLMs across these gold-labeled sets, running 68,395 RLAIF evaluations validated through multi-judge agreement and human fallback. Our findings reveal severe performance drops linked to linguistic divergence. For instance, responses to the highly divergent Chittagong dialect score 5.44/10, compared to 7.68/10 for Tangail. Furthermore, increased model scale does not consistently mitigate this bias. We contribute a validated translation quality evaluation method, a rigorous benchmark dataset, and a Critical Bias Sensitivity (CBS) metric for safety-critical applications.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 Main Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架量化 LLM 对孟加拉语方言的问答偏差：用 RAG 翻译流水线把标准孟加拉语问题转成 9 种方言共 4,000 组问题集，再以 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工校验评估 19 个模型的 68,395 次 RLAIF 评测。方言与标准语的语言学分歧越大，理解退化越严重：高度分歧的 Chittagong 方言得分 5.44/10，而 Tangail 为 7.68/10；扩大模型规模并不能一致缓解该偏差。
Motivation: 低资源语言的区域方言在 LLM 上存在性能偏差，但量化这类差距的框架稀缺，且传统翻译质量指标在未标准化方言上失效。
Method: 第一阶段用检索增强生成 (RAG) 流水线把标准孟加拉语问题翻译并 gold-label 成方言变体，产出 4,000 组问题集，用 LLM-as-a-judge 评估翻译保真度并经人工相关性验证其优于传统指标；第二阶段在这些 gold-labeled 集上对 19 个 LLM 跑 68,395 次 RLAIF 评测，经多评审一致与人工兜底校验。
Result: 覆盖 9 个孟加拉语方言、4,000 组问题集、19 个 LLM、68,395 次 RLAIF 评测；高度分歧的 Chittagong 方言回答得分 5.44/10，Tangail 为 7.68/10，性能下降与语言学分歧程度相关；模型规模增大并不一致缓解该偏差。
Conclusion: 方言与标准语的分歧程度决定 LLM 问答退化幅度，规模不是可靠缓解手段；作者贡献经验证的翻译质量评估方法、基准数据集，以及面向安全关键应用的 Critical Bias Sensitivity (CBS) 指标。

papers.title: Joint Surrogate Learning of Objectives, Constraints, and Sensitivities for Efficient Multi-objective Optimization of Neural Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian process surrogates dominate constrained multi-objective optimization because they are effective in data-scarce regimes, but their cubic scaling in training samples limits their ability to capture shared structure between objectives and constraints as problems grow in dimensionality. We show that deterministic neural network surrogates, equipped with feature tokenization and adaptive output normalization, match or exceed Gaussian process accuracy, while scaling to high-dimensional output spaces and training on all data including infeasible samples. Jointly training a single Feature Tokenizer Transformer to predict objectives, constraint satisfaction, and parameter sensitivities yields a unified gradient that simultaneously improves objective values, steers toward feasibility, and identifies the most influential parameters: a coherent search signal that disjoint per-output models cannot provide. We validate this on biophysical neural optimization problems of increasing complexity. In the hardest regime, with wide, uninformed parameter bounds where random sampling finds zero feasible solutions, descending the surrogate's learned constraint gradient steers the search into the feasible region and recovers near-optimal solutions where standard surrogate optimization and constrained Bayesian optimization find none.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单个 Feature Tokenizer Transformer 联合代理目标、约束满足度与参数灵敏度，产生统一梯度同时优化目标值、导向可行域并定位最具影响的参数。在最难的宽且无信息参数边界设置下，随机采样找到 0 个可行解，沿学到的约束梯度下降能进入可行域并恢复近似最优解，而标准代理优化与约束贝叶斯优化均找不到。
Motivation: 高斯过程代理在数据稀缺的约束多目标优化中占主导，但其训练样本的三次方扩展限制了它随问题维度增长时捕捉目标与约束共享结构的能力。
Method: 以带 feature tokenization 和 adaptive output normalization 的确定性神经网络代理替代 GP，联合训练单个 Feature Tokenizer Transformer 同时预测目标、约束满足与参数灵敏度，得到统一梯度；训练可用全部数据包括不可行样本，并沿学到的约束梯度下降引导搜索。
Result: 神经代理精度匹配或超过高斯过程，可扩展到高维输出空间；在生物物理神经优化问题上由简到难验证。最难的宽且无信息参数边界设置下随机采样找到 0 个可行解，沿约束梯度下降恢复近似最优解，而标准代理优化与约束贝叶斯优化找不到。
Conclusion: 联合代理目标、约束与灵敏度给出的统一梯度，是分立的逐输出模型无法提供的连贯搜索信号，可在宽参数边界下把搜索带入可行域。

papers.title: When Demonstrations Fail: Diagnosing the Limits of In-Context Learning in Large Audio-Language Models with Progressive Cue Removal
papers.abstract_en: While Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have been shown to exhibit degraded instruction-following capabilities, their ability to infer task patterns from in-context examples with audio remains understudied. To address this gap, we design a three-stage evaluation pipeline that progressively reduces textual guidance to systematically evaluate LALMs' in-context learning ability in the audio modality. Evaluating six LALMs across four audio understanding tasks under two output constraint categories, we uncover a consistent asymmetry across LALMs: in-context demonstrations reliably improve format compliance but fail to improve the core task performance. This suggests that LALMs can glean surface-level formatting patterns from demonstrations but may struggle to leverage cross-modal semantic grounding to reliably infer task objectives from examples with audio, highlighting potential limitations in current cross-modal integration. We further probe how demonstrations are used through two complementary analyses, demonstration label shuffling and attention knockout on demonstration spans, both showing that LALMs leverage in-context examples primarily to establish the output label space and format rather than to learn a meaningful input-output correspondence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用三阶段渐进削减文本提示的评测管线考察 LALM 的音频上下文学习：在 6 个模型、4 个音频理解任务、2 类输出约束上，示例稳定提升格式合规却几乎不提升核心任务性能。标签打乱与注意力 knockout 两个分析一致表明，模型只用示例确定输出标签空间与格式，而非学习输入-输出对应。
Motivation: LALM 的指令遵循能力下降已有研究，但带音频的示例能否教会模型任务模式几乎未被考察，跨模态语义 grounding 是否支撑上下文学习不清楚。
Method: 设计三阶段评测管线逐级削减文本指导，以隔离示例本身的作用；在 4 个音频理解任务、2 类输出约束上评 6 个 LALM，并做示例标签打乱 (label shuffling) 与对示例片段的注意力 knockout 两项互补分析。
Result: 跨全部 LALM 出现一致不对称：上下文示例可靠提升格式合规，却不提升核心任务性能；标签打乱与注意力 knockout 均显示模型主要用示例建立输出标签空间与格式，而非学习有意义的输入-输出对应。
Conclusion: 当前 LALM 从音频示例中只能攫取表面格式模式，难以靠跨模态语义 grounding 可靠推断任务目标，说明跨模态整合存在限制。

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Belief Graphs for Theory-of-mind Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) requires inferring how people's implicit, evolving beliefs shape what they seek and how they act under uncertainty -- especially in high-stakes settings such as disaster response, emergency medicine, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. Prior approaches either prompt LLMs directly or use latent-state models that treat beliefs as static and independent, often producing incoherent mental models over time and weak reasoning in dynamic contexts. We introduce a structured cognitive trajectory model for LLM-based ToM that represents mental state as a dynamic belief graph, jointly inferring latent beliefs, learning their time-varying dependencies, and linking belief evolution to information seeking and decisions. Our model contributes (i) a novel projection from textualized probabilistic statements to consistent probabilistic graphical model updates, (ii) an energy-based factor graph representation of belief interdependencies, and (iii) an ELBO-based objective that captures belief accumulation and delayed decisions. Across multiple real-world disaster evacuation datasets, our model significantly improves action prediction and recovers interpretable belief trajectories consistent with human reasoning, providing a principled module for augmenting LLMs with ToM in high-uncertainty environment. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ICML_submission-6373/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 LLM 心智理论 (Theory of Mind) 的动态信念图模型，把随时间演化的隐信念、时变依赖关系与信息寻求/决策联动建模，在多个真实灾害疏散数据集上显著提升动作预测并恢复出与人类推理一致的可解释信念轨迹。
Motivation: 现有 LLM ToM 方法要么直接 prompt，要么用把信念视为静态且相互独立的隐状态模型，导致随时间推移的心智模型不连贯、动态情境下推理偏弱，尤其影响灾害响应、急诊与人在回路自主等高风险场景。
Method: 提出结构化认知轨迹模型：把文本化概率陈述投影为一致的概率图模型更新；用基于能量的因子图 (energy-based factor graph) 表示信念间依赖；以 ELBO 目标刻画信念累积与延迟决策，联合推断隐信念并学习其时变依赖。
Result: 在多个真实世界灾害疏散数据集上，模型显著改善动作预测 (action prediction)，并恢复出与人类推理一致的可解释信念轨迹。
Conclusion: 把信念表示为带时变依赖的动态图并用 ELBO 联合推断，能在高不确定性环境中为 LLM 提供一个有原则的 ToM 增强模块。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Exponentially Weighted Signature
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the exponentially weighted signature (EWS), a continuous-time model that computes iterated integrals of a path, where each increment is weighted by the matrix exponential of a learnable generator over elapsed clock time. We prove that it solves a linear controlled differential equation, keeps the group-like structure and the universality of the signature, and satisfies a modified Chen identity, enabling a parallel scan. At depth one the EWS is a state-space model (SSM), and we map linear time-invariant SSMs, Mamba channels and Mamba-$2$ heads to it in closed form. The EWS extends SSMs through an arbitrary matrix generator, a clock that generalises the step size to causal functionals of the input, and higher truncation depths that are non-linear in the path within a single layer. Empirically, the EWS achieves the highest average accuracy and rank on six long time-series classification datasets, where depth generally helps. Learned clocks prove necessary for state tracking on formal language tasks, and at depth one, the EWS matches or exceeds competing SSMs on regression and forecasting with far fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出指数加权签名 (exponentially weighted signature, EWS)：对路径的迭代积分按经过时钟时间的可学习生成元矩阵指数加权，证明其等价于线性受控微分方程 (CDE)，保留签名的 group-like 结构与普适性，并满足可并行扫描的修正 Chen 恒等式。深度 1 时 EWS 即状态空间模型 (SSM)，闭式涵盖线性时不变 SSM、Mamba channels 与 Mamba-2 heads；在六个长时间序列分类数据集上取得最高平均精度与排名，深度 1 在回归与预报任务上以远少参数匹配或超越竞争 SSM。
Motivation: 现有 SSM 与 Mamba 变体的时序加权受限于固定步长与线性递推，缺少统一框架同时容纳签名的非线性高阶项、可学习时钟与任意矩阵生成元。
Method: EWS 用可学习生成元在时钟时间上的矩阵指数对路径增量加权计算迭代积分；证明其解线性 CDE、满足修正 Chen 恒等式从而支持并行扫描；深度 1 退化为 SSM，并以闭式映射线性时不变 SSM、Mamba channels、Mamba-2 heads；时钟推广为输入的因果泛函，更高截断深度在单层内对路径非线性。

papers.title: Q-Drift: Quantization-Aware Drift Correction for Diffusion Model Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a practical path to deploy large diffusion models, but quantization noise can accumulate over the denoising trajectory and degrade generation quality. We propose Q-Drift, a sampler-side correction that aims to preserve the intended sampling marginals through a deterministic drift adjustment motivated by generalized marginal-preserving SDEs. Q-Drift uses the calibrated conditional residual variance of quantization error to determine a correction factor at each step. Our SDXL study shows that calibration with as few as 10 paired full-precision/quantized runs remains effective. The resulting sampler correction is plug-and-play with common samplers, diffusion models, and PTQ methods, while incurring negligible overhead at inference. Across six diverse text-to-image models (spanning DiT and U-Net), three samplers (Euler, flow-matching, DPM-Solver++), and two PTQ methods (SVDQuant, MixDQ), Q-Drift improves FID over the corresponding quantized baseline in all seven settings of our main evaluation, with up to 4.79 FID reduction on PixArt-Sigma (SVDQuant W3A4), while preserving CLIP scores. Code is available at https://github.com/sooyoung-ryu/Q-Drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-Drift 是一种采样端的量化漂移校正：用量化误差的校准条件残差方差逐步确定校正因子，通过确定性漂移项保持广义保边缘 SDE 所期望的采样边缘分布。在 SDXL 上仅用 10 组全精度/量化配对运行即可完成校准；在六个文生图模型、三种采样器（Euler、flow-matching、DPM-Solver++）与两种 PTQ 方法（SVDQuant、MixDQ）的主评测全部七个设置中均降低 FID，PixArt-Sigma（SVDQuant W3A4）上 FID 最多下降 4.79，同时保持 CLIP 分数。
Motivation: PTQ 部署大扩散模型时，量化噪声会沿去噪轨迹累积并劣化生成质量，需要在不重训的前提下把采样边缘分布拉回预期。
Method: 采样端校正：由量化误差的校准条件残差方差在每步给出校正因子，构造确定性漂移调整，动机来自 generalized marginal-preserving SDE；校准只需 10 组全精度/量化配对运行，且与常见采样器、扩散模型和 PTQ 方法即插即用，推理开销可忽略。
Result: SDXL 上 10 组配对运行的校准即有效；在六个文生图模型（含 DiT 与 U-Net）、三个采样器、两个 PTQ 方法（SVDQuant、MixDQ）的主评测全部七个设置中 FID 均优于对应量化基线，PixArt-Sigma（SVDQuant W3A4）FID 最多降低 4.79，CLIP 分数保持不变。

papers.title: CompDiff enables fair and zero shot medical image generation across demographic intersections through compositional diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Medical image generators trained on imbalanced data can fail at demographic intersections absent from training. We introduce CompDiff, which encodes age, sex and race separately and composes supervised demographic tokens alongside clinical text. Across chest radiographs and fundus images, CompDiff improves overall and subgroup fidelity relative to prompt conditioning (RoentGen-v2) and loss reweighting (FairDiffusion). It generalises in zero-shot generation to 16 chest X-ray intersections excluded from training, achieving the lowest mean FID-RadImageNet in every intersection. In a blinded reader study of these unseen intersections, two radiologists gave CompDiff the highest mean scores among generators for anatomical realism and agreement with the clinical impression, and selected its images most often as the most realistic. Pretraining with CompDiff images improved downstream classification, while CompDiff audit cohorts reduced estimation error on rare intersections. These findings support compositional demographic conditioning for extending medical image synthesis to underserved populations. Code: https://github.com/mahmoudibrahim98/CompDiff
papers.comment: v4: substantially revised version (new title, reader study, additional co-authors). 38 pages main text + 25 pages supplement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompDiff 把年龄、性别、种族分别编码为监督式 demographic token，与临床文本一起组合进扩散模型，在胸片与眼底图像上做零样本人口学交叉生成。在训练中排除的 16 个胸片人口学交叉上，它在每个交叉都取得最低 mean FID-RadImageNet；盲法 reader study 中两位放射科医生给它最高的解剖真实度与临床印象一致性均分，并最常选其图像为最真实。
Motivation: 在不平衡数据上训练的医学图像生成器会失效于训练集中缺席的人口学交叉组合，使服务不足人群缺少可用的合成数据。
Method: CompDiff 以组合式扩散 (compositional diffusion) 分别编码 age、sex、race，再与临床文本 prompt 拼接做监督式 token 条件；对照基线为 prompt 条件的 RoentGen-v2 与损失重加权的 FairDiffusion，覆盖胸片 (chest radiographs) 和眼底图像 (fundus images)，并用 CompDiff 生成图像预训练下游分类器、构造 audit cohorts。
Result: 在 16 个被排除出训练的胸片人口学交叉上，CompDiff 在每个交叉的 mean FID-RadImageNet 均为最低；盲法 reader study 中两位放射科医生给它最高的解剖真实度与临床印象一致性均分，且最常选其图像为最真实。用 CompDiff 图像预训练提升下游分类性能，CompDiff audit cohorts 降低稀有交叉上的估计误差。
Conclusion: 组合式人口学条件化可以把医学图像合成扩展到训练中缺席的 underserved 人群交叉，同时改善保真度、读片可信度与下游分类。

papers.title: IndexRAG: Index-Time Reasoning for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires reasoning across multiple documents, yet existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches address this either through graph-based methods requiring additional online processing or iterative multi-step reasoning. We present IndexRAG, a novel approach that shifts cross-document reasoning from online inference to offline indexing. IndexRAG identifies bridge entities shared across documents and generates bridging facts as independently retrievable units, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. Experiments on three widely-used multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue) show that IndexRAG improves F1 over Naive RAG by 4.6 points on average, while requiring only single-pass retrieval and a single LLM call at inference time. When combined with IRCoT, IndexRAG achieves the best average performance among all evaluated methods, including graph-based baselines such as HippoRAG2 and FastGraphRAG, while relying on a flat vector index. Our code is available at https://github.com/Continuum-AI-Corp/IndexRAG .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IndexRAG 把多跳 RAG 的跨文档推理从在线推理搬到离线索引：识别文档间共享的 bridge entity，生成可独立检索的 bridging facts，推理时只做单次检索加一次 LLM 调用，无需训练或微调。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 上 F1 平均比 Naive RAG 高 4.6 分，叠加 IRCoT 后在含 HippoRAG2、FastGraphRAG 的全部方法中平均性能最高。
Motivation: 多跳 QA 需要跨文档推理，现有 RAG 要么用图方法做额外在线处理，要么做多步迭代推理，在线开销大。
Method: 离线索引阶段识别跨文档共享的 bridge entity 并生成 bridging facts 作为独立可检索单元，存入扁平向量索引；推理时单次检索 + 单次 LLM 调用，无需训练或微调；可与 IRCoT 组合。
Result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 三个多跳 QA 基准上，F1 平均比 Naive RAG 提升 4.6 分；与 IRCoT 组合后平均性能在所有被评估方法（含图基线 HippoRAG2、FastGraphRAG）中最好，且只依赖扁平向量索引。
Conclusion: 跨文档桥接推理可以离线预计算成可检索事实，用单次检索和单次 LLM 调用达到或超过图方法与迭代推理的多跳 QA 效果。

papers.title: Models Designed to Forget: Machine Unlearning via Key Deletion
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning for vision models is rapidly becoming a practical requirement, driven by privacy regulations, data errors, and the need to remove harmful or corrupted training images. Despite this, most existing approximate unlearning methods tackle the problem from a post-hoc perspective. They attempt to erase the influence of targeted samples through parameter updates that typically require access to the full training data. This creates a mismatch with real deployment scenarios where unlearning requests can be anticipated, revealing a fundamental limitation of post-hoc approaches. We motivate unlearning by design, a novel paradigm for approximate methods in which models are directly trained to support forgetting as an inherent architectural capability. We instantiate this idea with Machine UNlearning via KEY deletion (MUNKEY), a memory-augmented transformer that decouples instance-specific memorization from model weights. Here, unlearning corresponds to removing the instance-identifying key, enabling zero-shot forgetting without weight updates or access to the original samples or labels. Across natural image benchmarks, fine-grained visual recognition, and medical datasets, MUNKEY outperforms all post-hoc baselines. Our results establish that unlearning by design enables fast, deployment-oriented unlearning while preserving predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MUNKEY：把实例记忆从模型权重中解耦的 memory-augmented transformer，遗忘只需删除该实例的 key，即可零样本遗忘且不更新权重、不需原始样本或标签。在自然图像基准、细粒度视觉识别与医学数据集上，MUNKEY 超越全部 post-hoc 遗忘基线。
Motivation: 现有近似遗忘方法多为 post-hoc，靠参数更新抹除样本影响且通常需要访问全部训练数据，与真实部署中可预期的遗忘请求不匹配。
Method: 提出 unlearning by design 范式，实例化为 MUNKEY：memory-augmented transformer 将实例级记忆与模型权重解耦，遗忘操作即删除对应 instance-identifying key，实现无需权重更新与原始样本/标签的 zero-shot forgetting。
Result: 在自然图像基准、细粒度视觉识别 (fine-grained visual recognition) 与医学数据集上，MUNKEY 超越所有 post-hoc 基线，并在遗忘的同时保持预测性能。
Conclusion: 把遗忘做成架构内在能力，可实现快速、面向部署的遗忘而不牺牲预测精度，比事后参数更新式方法更贴合部署场景。

papers.title: Interp3R: Continuous-time 3D Geometry Estimation with Frames and Events
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, 3D visual foundation models, pioneered by pointmap-based approaches such as DUSt3R, have attracted a lot of interest, achieving impressive accuracy and strong generalization across diverse scenes. However, these methods are inherently limited to recovering scene geometry only at the discrete time instants when images are captured, leaving the scene evolution during the blind time between consecutive frames largely unexplored. We introduce Interp3R, to the best of our knowledge, the first method that enhances pointmap-based models to estimate depth and camera poses at arbitrary time instants. It leverages asynchronous event data to interpolate pointmaps produced by frame-based models, enabling temporally continuous geometric representations. Depth and camera poses are then jointly recovered by aligning the interpolated pointmaps together with those predicted by the underlying frame-based models into a consistent spatial framework. We train Interp3R exclusively on a synthetic dataset, yet demonstrate strong generalization across six datasets, both synthetic and real. Compared with the best two-stage baseline, Interp3R reduces absolute relative depth error by 15%-32% on DSEC and absolute trajectory error by up to 51% on EDS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Interp3R 用异步事件流插值 pointmap，把 DUSt3R 类帧基模型的深度与相机位姿估计推广到任意时间时刻，得到时间连续的几何表示。仅在合成数据上训练，在 DSEC 上绝对相对深度误差比最佳两阶段基线降低 15%-32%，在 EDS 上绝对轨迹误差最高降低 51%。
Motivation: pointmap 类 3D 基础模型只能恢复图像采集时刻的离散几何，相邻帧之间的盲区演化无法表示，动态场景缺少连续几何。
Method: 用异步事件数据插值帧基模型输出的 pointmap，再把插值结果与原帧基 pointmap 对齐到统一空间框架，联合求解深度与相机位姿；训练仅使用合成数据。
Result: 相比最佳两阶段基线，DSEC 上绝对相对深度误差降低 15%-32%，EDS 上绝对轨迹误差最高降低 51%；泛化在六个合成与真实数据集上验证。
Conclusion: 事件数据可以把离散 pointmap 补成任意时刻的连续几何，且纯合成训练即可跨数据集泛化。

papers.title: Adaptive Weighted h-Transform Sampling for Coarse-Guided Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-guided visual generation, which synthesizes fine visual samples from degraded or low-fidelity coarse references, is essential for various real-world applications. While training-based approaches are effective, they are inherently limited by high training costs and restricted generalization due to paired data collection. Accordingly, recent training-free works propose to leverage pretrained diffusion models and incorporate guidance during the sampling process. However, these training-free methods either require knowing the forward (fine-to-coarse) transformation operator, e.g., bicubic downsampling, or are difficult to balance between guidance and synthetic quality. To address these challenges, we propose a novel guided method by using the h-transform, a tool that can constrain stochastic processes (e.g., sampling process) under desired conditions. Specifically, we modify the transition probability at each sampling timestep by adding to the original differential equation with a drift function $h$, which approximately steers the generation toward the ideal fine sample. To address unavoidable approximation errors, we introduce an adaptive weight scheduler that combines a noise-level-aware initialization with a correction based on cross-timestep consistency, balancing guidance adherence and synthesis quality. Extensive experiments across diverse image and video generation tasks demonstrate its effectiveness and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练自由的粗引导视觉生成方法：用 h-transform 在每个采样步向原扩散微分方程加入漂移函数 h，把生成拉向理想细样本，并用噪声水平感知初始化加跨时间步一致性校正的自适应权重调度器平衡引导强度与生成质量。该方法不要求已知前向退化算子，在多种图像与视频生成任务上验证有效且可泛化。
Motivation: 基于训练的粗引导生成依赖成对数据采集，训练成本高且泛化受限；现有训练自由方法要么需要已知前向退化算子（如 bicubic 下采样），要么难以平衡引导与合成质量。
Method: 用 h-transform 约束采样这一随机过程：在每个采样时间步向原微分方程加入漂移函数 h 修改转移概率，使生成近似被引向理想细样本；针对近似误差引入自适应权重调度器，结合噪声水平感知初始化与跨时间步一致性校正。
Result: 在多种图像与视频生成任务上进行了广泛实验，验证其有效性与泛化能力。
Conclusion: h-transform 漂移引导加自适应权重调度，可在不依赖成对数据与已知前向算子的前提下完成粗引导视觉生成。

papers.title: SyncEdit: Rethinking Lip Synchronization as Editing with Audio-Driven Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Lip synchronization refers to the task of modifying facial lip movements such that they are temporally aligned with a given audio signal. It is a fundamental problem in audio-visual synthesis for generating realistic talking-head videos. Recent progress in diffusion-based generative models has led to remarkable advances in lip synchronization. Nevertheless, existing methods typically achieve audio-visual alignment by fine-tuning pre-trained diffusion models on large scale datasets, resulting in substantial computational costs and significant data requirements. Inspired by FlowEdit, we reformulate lip synchronization as a video editing problem. Building upon a pre-trained audio-driven diffusion model, our approach achieves lip synchronization in a training-free manner, without additional fine-tuning or paired data. In this paper, we present SyncEdit, a training-free framework designed for lip synchronization. We reformulate the editing paradigm by substituting the edit sequence in FlowEdit with the target sequence, yielding an unbiased estimation of the desired output. Moreover, we propose annealed noise alignment, which progressively alignes the sampled Gaussian noise with diffusion-model-estimated noise during iterative editing, producing a smooth and stable editing trajectory. Extensive experimental results validate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework. Code is available at \href[]{https://github.com/l1346792580123/SyncEdit}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyncEdit 把唇同步 (lip synchronization) 重新表述为视频编辑问题：基于预训练音频驱动扩散模型，用目标序列替换 FlowEdit 的编辑序列得到无偏输出估计，再用退火噪声对齐 (annealed noise alignment) 在迭代编辑中逐步把采样高斯噪声对齐到模型估计噪声。整个流程 training-free，无需微调也无需配对数据，实验验证了框架的有效性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有唇同步方法靠在大规模数据集上微调预训练扩散模型来实现音画对齐，计算开销大、数据需求高。
Method: 以 FlowEdit 为基座，把其中的 edit sequence 换成 target sequence，得到对期望输出的无偏估计；同时提出 annealed noise alignment，在迭代编辑过程中逐步将采样高斯噪声与扩散模型估计的噪声对齐，使编辑轨迹平滑稳定。构建在预训练音频驱动扩散模型之上，全程不训练、不用配对数据。
Result: 大量实验结果验证了该框架的有效性与鲁棒性；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 唇同步可以不靠微调、只靠编辑式推理在预训练音频驱动扩散模型上完成，无偏的目标序列替换加退火噪声对齐足以给出稳定编辑轨迹。

papers.title: Gravity Falls: A Comparative Analysis of Domain-Generation Algorithm (DGA) Detection Methods for Mobile Device Spearphishing
papers.abstract_en: Mobile devices are frequent targets of eCrime threat actors through SMS spearphishing (smishing) links that leverage Domain Generation Algorithms (DGA) to rotate hostile infrastructure, avoid individual domain blocks, and bypass perimeter enterprise defenses. Despite this, DGA research and evaluation largely emphasize malware C2 and email phishing datasets, leaving limited evidence on how well detectors generalize to smishing-driven domain tactics outside enterprise perimeters. This work addresses that gap by evaluating traditional and machine-learning DGA detectors against Gravity Falls, a new dataset derived from smishing links delivered between 2022 and 2025. Gravity Falls captures a single threat actor's evolution across four technique clusters, shifting from short randomized strings to dictionary concatenation and themed combo-squatting variants used for credential theft and fee/fine fraud. Two string-analysis approaches (Shannon entropy and Exp0se) and two ML-based detectors (an LSTM classifier and COSSAS DGAD) are assessed using Top-1M domains as benign baselines. Results are strongly tactic-dependent: performance is highest on randomized-string domains but drops on dictionary concatenation and themed combo-squatting, with generally low recall across multiple tool/cluster pairings. Overall, both traditional heuristics and some common ML detection methods are ill-suited for consistently evolving DGA tactics observed in Gravity Falls, motivating more context-aware approaches and providing a reproducible benchmark for future evaluation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 2022–2025 年 smishing 链接构建的 Gravity Falls 数据集，对比两类传统字符串启发式（Shannon 熵、Exp0se）与两类 ML 检测器（LSTM、COSSAS DGAD），以 Top-1M 域名为良性基线。结果强依赖攻击战术：随机串域名上表现最高，字典拼接与主题 combo-squatting 上明显下降，多数组合召回率偏低，说明现有启发式与常见 ML 方法难以跟上持续演化的 DGA 战术。
Motivation: DGA 检测研究与评测多集中在 malware C2 与邮件钓鱼数据集，缺少检测器在企业边界之外、由 smishing 驱动的域名战术上泛化能力的证据。
Method: 在 Gravity Falls 数据集（源自 2022–2025 年投递的 smishing 链接，覆盖单一威胁 actor 的四个技术簇）上评估四种检测器：Shannon 熵与 Exp0se 两种字符串分析方法，LSTM 分类器与 COSSAS DGAD 两种 ML 检测器，良性基线取 Top-1M 域名。
Result: 性能呈强战术依赖：随机串域名上最高，字典拼接与主题 combo-squatting 上下降，多组工具/簇配对的召回率普遍偏低；四个技术簇体现该 actor 从短随机串转向字典拼接与主题 combo-squatting（用于凭据窃取与费用/罚款欺诈）的演化。
Conclusion: 传统启发式与部分常见 ML DGA 检测方法不适合 Gravity Falls 中持续演化的 DGA 战术，需要更依赖上下文的方法；该数据集作为可复现基准供后续评测。

papers.title: MASRubric: Auditing Information Flow in Multi-Agent Systems with Failure-Distilled Pitfall Rubrics
papers.abstract_en: While multi-agent systems (MAS) excel at complex reasoning, they are vulnerable to errors that intermediate agents introduce and downstream agents build upon. Auditing intermediate messages before they propagate requires an explicit standard, yet evaluation rubrics are typically authored by domain experts or written against a reference answer, neither of which is available for an unseen message at test time. We present MASRubric, a MAS information flow auditing framework with failure-distilled pitfall rubrics. Offline, trajectories on which the MAS has failed are automatically distilled into a reusable bank of pitfall criteria, each describing a recurrent error by its underlying misconception, the reasoning situations in which it arises, and the check that would expose it. Online, the criteria applicable to each intermediate message are retrieved from this off-the-shelf bank and checked one by one, and the resulting satisfaction rate decides whether the message is broadcast, returned to its author with diagnostic feedback for revision, or withheld. Empirical results demonstrate that MASRubric enhances MAS performance on both fixed and dynamic frameworks, achieving average accuracy gains of up to 2.83 points on math reasoning benchmarks and 1.74 points on code generation benchmarks. Further analysis shows that the retrieved criteria vary systematically with task types, and that the audit effort tracks task difficulty. Moreover, the bank transfers without re-mining to a system with a stronger backbone, which makes more adaptive and more efficient use of it. Our code and dataset are released at https://github.com/TonySY2/MASRubric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASRubric 把多智能体系统 (MAS) 失败轨迹离线蒸馏成可复用的 pitfall 准则库，线上按中间消息检索适用准则逐条检查，用满足率决定广播、退回作者带诊断反馈修订或扣留。在固定与动态框架上，数学推理基准平均准确率最多提升 2.83 点，代码生成基准提升 1.74 点；准则库无需重新挖掘即可迁移到更强 backbone。
Motivation: 中间智能体的错误会被下游放大，而审计中间消息需要显式标准；现有 rubric 由领域专家撰写或对照参考答案，测试时面对一条未见消息两者都不可得。
Method: 离线把 MAS 失败轨迹自动蒸馏为 pitfall 准则库，每条准则记录底层误解、出现的推理情境与可暴露它的检查项；线上检索适用于当前中间消息的准则并逐条核对，按满足率触发广播、退回修订或扣留。
Result: 在固定与动态框架上平均准确率提升最多 2.83 点（数学推理基准）与 1.74 点（代码生成基准）；检索到的准则随任务类型系统变化，审计开销随任务难度变化；准则库可无重新挖掘迁移到更强 backbone 并被更自适应、更高效地使用。
Conclusion: 失败蒸馏的 pitfall 准则库可作为测试时可得的中间消息审计标准，跨框架与跨 backbone 复用，从而在不依赖专家或参考答案的前提下提升 MAS 准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ActionEngine: From Reactive to Programmatic Web Agents via State Machine Memory
papers.abstract_en: Many web agents operate through a reactive execution loop: they observe the current interface, reason about the next action, execute it, and repeat. This design incurs latency and cost that grow with the number of actions, while requiring agents to repeatedly rediscover how the same web application works. We present ActionEngine, a novel architecture that replaces step-by-step reasoning with programmatic execution using reusable knowledge of the application. A Crawling Agent explores the application offline and constructs an updatable state-machine memory that represents its GUI states, the operations available in each state, and the transitions between states. Unlike trajectory memory, this representation stores how the application works rather than solutions to individual tasks. At runtime, an Execution Agent uses this memory to synthesize a complete executable program in a single planning step, which is then executed deterministically without further planning calls. When the interface changes or the memory is incomplete, a reactive fallback repairs the failed action and updates the memory for future tasks. On 655 tasks across four WebArena domains, ActionEngine achieves a 91.2% success rate, outperforming the strongest reactive baseline, Claude Code, by 8.5 percentage points while reducing average task latency by 3.2x and cost by 8x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActionEngine 用离线 Crawling Agent 把 Web 应用的 GUI 状态、可用操作与状态转移编成可更新的状态机记忆 (state-machine memory)，运行时 Execution Agent 一次规划合成完整可执行程序并确定性执行，界面变化或记忆不全时由 reactive fallback 修复并回写记忆。在 WebArena 四个域 655 个任务上成功率 91.2%，比最强 reactive 基线 Claude Code 高 8.5 个百分点，平均任务延迟降 3.2 倍、成本降 8 倍。
Motivation: Web agent 的逐步 reactive 循环让延迟与成本随动作数增长，且同一 Web 应用的工作方式要被反复重新发现。
Method: 离线 Crawling Agent 探索应用并构建可更新的状态机记忆，记录 GUI 状态、各状态可用操作与状态转移（区别于只存任务解的 trajectory memory）；运行时 Execution Agent 用该记忆在单次规划步骤中合成完整可执行程序，随后确定性执行、不再调用规划；接口变化或记忆不完整时由 reactive fallback 修复失败动作并更新记忆。
Result: 在 WebArena 四个域的 655 个任务上成功率 91.2%，比最强 reactive 基线 Claude Code 高 8.5 个百分点，平均任务延迟降低 3.2 倍，成本降低 8 倍。
Conclusion: 把「应用如何工作」而非「单个任务怎么解」存成状态机记忆，可让 web agent 从逐步推理转为一次规划加确定性执行，同时压低延迟与成本。

summary_sections.method: 离线 Crawling Agent 探索应用并构建可更新的状态机记忆，记录 GUI 状态、各状态可用操作与状态转移（区别于只存任务解的 trajectory memory）；运行时 Execution Agent 用该记忆在单次规划步骤中合成完整可执行程序，随后确定性执行、不再调用规划；接口变化或记忆不完整时由 reactive fallback 修复失败动作并更新记忆。

papers.title: Neural Proposals, Symbolic Guarantees: Neuro-Symbolic Graph Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: While deep generative models excel at capturing graph data distributions, they struggle to satisfy complex, hard constraints. In unconstrained settings, these models typically produce valid topologies; yet imposing strict compositional rules, like those in drug discovery, creates an out-of-distribution (OOD) setting where purely neural methods frequently fail. Because these neural approaches rely on soft conditioning and post-hoc filtering on such tasks, they cannot provide the formal guarantees needed for high-stakes domains. To address this, we introduce Neuro-Symbolic Graph Generative Modeling (NSGGM), a framework built on the principle of Neural Proposals, Symbolic Guarantees. NSGGM decouples generation: an autoregressive model proposes structural scaffolds, and a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver handles the final discrete assembly of the proposed substructures. Empirically, NSGGM is competitive with state-of-the-art methods on unconstrained tasks. To evaluate logical-constraint satisfaction inspired by real drug discovery workflows, we introduce MolSAT, a benchmark for hard compositional rules. On MolSAT, purely neural baselines completely fail OOD (0% satisfaction with zero training support), while NSGGM achieves >95% satisfaction in-distribution and 64-86% with zero training support.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出神经-符号图生成框架 NSGGM：自回归模型只提议结构骨架，SMT 求解器负责最终离散装配，从而对硬组合约束给出形式保证。在面向药物发现的 MolSAT 基准上，纯神经基线在零训练支撑的 OOD 设定下约束满足率为 0%，NSGGM 分布内 >95%、零训练支撑下 64–86%。
Motivation: 深度图生成模型在无约束分布上拓扑有效，但一旦加入药物发现式的严格组合规则就进入 OOD，纯神经方法靠软条件与事后过滤，无法给出高风险场景所需的形式化保证。
Method: NSGGM 把生成解耦为两段：自回归模型提议结构子图骨架，Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) 求解器完成子结构的最终离散装配以满足硬逻辑约束；并提出 MolSAT 基准，用受真实药物发现流程启发的硬组合规则评测逻辑约束满足。
Result: 在无约束任务上 NSGGM 与 SOTA 方法相当；在 MolSAT 上，纯神经基线在零训练支撑的 OOD 设定下满足率为 0%，NSGGM 分布内满足率 >95%，零训练支撑下为 64–86%。
Conclusion: 把神经模型降级为提议器、把硬约束交给符号求解器，可以在 OOD 硬组合规则下拿到纯神经方法给不出的约束满足保证，同时不牺牲无约束生成质量。

papers.title: Adjoint-based shape optimization of a ship hull using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) assisted propulsion surrogate model
papers.abstract_en: Adjoint-based shape optimization of ship hulls is a powerful tool for addressing high-dimensional design problems in naval architecture, particularly in minimizing the ship resistance. However, its application to vessels that employ complex propulsion systems introduces significant challenges. They arise from the need for transient simulations extending over long periods of time with small time steps and from the reverse temporal propagation of the primal and adjoint solutions. These challenges place considerable demands on the required storage and computing power, which significantly hamper the use of adjoint methods in the industry. To address this issue, we propose a machine learning-assisted optimization framework that employs a Conditional Variational Autoencoder-based surrogate model of the propulsion system. The surrogate model replicates the time-averaged flow field induced by a Voith Schneider Propeller and replaces the geometrically and time-resolved propeller with a data-driven approximation. Primal flow verification examples demonstrate that the surrogate model achieves significant computational savings while maintaining the necessary accuracy of the resolved propeller. Optimization studies demonstrate that neglecting the propulsion system can result in hull designs whose performance is inferior to that of the initial shape when subsequently validated using a numerically resolved propulsor. In contrast, the proposed method produces shapes that actually achieve more than an 8% reduction in resistance.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Computers & Fluids. 54 pages, 21 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带推进系统的船体伴随优化因瞬态长时仿真与反向传播开销难以落地的问题，用条件变分自编码器 (CVAE) 构建推进系统代理模型，复现 Voith Schneider 螺旋桨诱导的时间平均流场，替代几何与时间分辨的螺旋桨。优化结果显示，忽略推进系统的船体外形在用数值解析推进器复验时性能可能不如初始船型，而该方法得到的外形实际实现超过 8% 的阻力下降。
Motivation: 带复杂推进系统的船体伴随优化需要长时间、小时间步的瞬态仿真以及原解与伴随解的反向时间传播，对存储和算力要求极高，阻碍了伴随方法在工业界的使用。
Method: 提出机器学习辅助优化框架：用 Conditional Varioational Autoencoder 训练推进系统代理模型，复现 Voith Schneider Propeller 诱导的时间平均流场，以数据驱动近似替换几何与时间分辨的螺旋桨，再嵌入伴随形状优化流程。
Result: 原流验证示例表明代理模型在保持解析螺旋桨所需精度的同时带来显著计算节省；优化研究中，忽略推进系统的船体外形经数值解析推进器复验后性能劣于初始船型，而所提方法得到的外形实现超过 8% 的阻力下降。
Conclusion: 船体外形优化必须把推进系统纳入评估，否则得到的“优化”外形实际更差；用 CVAE 代理时间平均推进流场可在保留精度的同时把伴随优化变得可算。

papers.title: Pseudo-differential-enhanced physics-informed neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We present pseudo-differential enhanced physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), an extension of gradient enhancement but in Fourier space. Gradient enhancement of PINNs dictates that the PDE residual is taken to a higher differential order than prescribed by the PDE, added to the objective as an augmented term in order to improve training and overall learning fidelity. We propose the same procedure after application via Fourier transforms, since differentiating in Fourier space is multiplication with the Fourier wavenumber under suitable decay. Our methods are fast and efficient. Our methods oftentimes achieve superior PINN versus numerical error in fewer training iterations, potentially pair well with few/fixed samples in collocation, and can achieve breakthrough rather than gradual effects on the error. Moreover, our methods are suitable for fractional derivatives. We establish that our methods, due to the dynamical effects, improve spectral eigenvalue decay of the neural tangent kernel (NTK), and so our methods contribute towards the learning of high frequencies in early training, mitigating the effects of frequency bias up to the polynomial order and possibly greater with smooth activations. In particular, our primary contribution can be characterized as gradient enhancement affects spectral bias, and we specialize to Fourier space, although our theory does not prove the ambient case exactly due to a result with the Plancherel theorem on the descent paths. Our methods accommodate advanced techniques in PINNs, such as Fourier feature embeddings. A pitfall of discrete Fourier transforms via the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is mesh subjugation, and so we demonstrate compatibility of our methods for greater mesh flexibility and invariance on alternative Euclidean and non-Euclidean domains via Monte Carlo methods and otherwise, although possessing trade-offs of their own.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 PINN 的梯度增强 (gradient enhancement) 移到 Fourier 空间：对 PDE 残差做傅里叶变换后乘以波数实现高阶微分，作为增广项加入目标函数。作者主张该做法改善 NTK 谱特征值衰减、在训练早期就学到高频，从而缓解频率偏置 (spectral bias)，并常以更少训练迭代取得更优的 PINN 对数值误差。
Motivation: PINN 的标准梯度增强与频率偏置问题：网络早期只学低频、PDE 残差停留在规定微分阶，训练迭代多且高频学习慢。
Method: 在 Fourier 空间复现梯度增强——对残差做傅里叶变换，用乘以 Fourier 波数代替高阶微分（在适当衰减条件下），把增广项加入目标；方法兼容 Fourier feature embeddings 与分数阶导数，并用 Monte Carlo 等方式在欧氏与非欧氏域上绕开 FFT 的网格束缚。
Result: 作者报告该方法常以更少训练迭代取得优于数值解的 PINN 误差，可能带来误差的突破式而非渐进式下降，并改善 NTK 谱特征值衰减、缓解频率偏置至多项式阶（光滑激活下可能更高）；理论部分承认因 Plancherel 定理与下降路径的结果未完全证明 ambient 情形。
Conclusion: 梯度增强本质上作用于谱偏置，专门化到 Fourier 空间即可在早期训练中学到高频；代价是离散 FFT 的网格限制需用替代采样方案补偿。

papers.title: Watch the Model Think: On-Policy Extraction of Activation Steering Vectors
papers.abstract_en: When a model solves a problem on one attempt and fails it on the next, what separates the two is rarely the final answer token; it is the trajectory that reached it. Contrastive activation steering leaves that signal unused: CAA, SADI, RepE and ITI build their direction from experimenter-supplied text, recorded while the model reads rather than reasons. That choice also caps what the vector can express, since polarity must be written into the text, and a task judged only by outcome offers nothing to write it with. ROAST makes the trajectory itself the contrast: sample rollouts, let an outcome verifier split them into successes and failures, and contrast the reasoning that worked against the reasoning that did not. A matched teacher-forced control---rollouts, labels, answer text and pair counts held fixed, the trajectory alone stripped---points to the trajectory as what matters: on GSM8K at 0.6B the pairs alone buy +0.12 points while restoring the trajectories buys +6.05, the larger and only seed-robust step. Replacing the trajectory with an equal-length neutral prefix or another question's reasoning falls below no intervention. The two corpora are also far apart geometrically, a median 70+ degrees apart at both Qwen3 scales probed, beyond what a split-half null explains. Reading from rollouts calls for two corrections---keeping the full difference vector rather than Top-10% masking, and giving each question one vote rather than one per pair---and only grouped aggregation beats the unsteered baseline under 20% verifier noise. On parser-free benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH500, IFEval), ROAST is best in all six cells over two models, by up to +9.7, at +6.4% wall-clock and no added context; it also leads on six parser-scored benchmarks across three models. Across nine models (0.6B--122B, four families), ROAST improves on the unsteered model at every scale. Code: https://github.com/TomySu404/ORBIT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROAST 从模型自身的 rollout 轨迹中抽取 activation steering 向量：用 outcome verifier 把采样轨迹分成成功与失败，对比两者的推理过程而非实验者撰写的文本。GSM8K 0.6B 上仅保留配对文本只得 +0.12 分，恢复轨迹后得 +6.05；在 GSM8K、MATH500、IFEval 三个 parser-free 基准的全部六个格子上（两个模型）最优，最高 +9.7，代价是 +6.4% 墙钟时间且不加上下文。
Motivation: CAA、SADI、RepE、ITI 等 contrastive activation steering 依赖实验者提供的文本，向量在模型阅读而非推理时录制，极性必须写进文本；纯结果判分的任务没有可写的对比信号，向量表达力被封顶。
Method: ROAST 采样 rollout，用 outcome verifier 按成败分组，对比成功与失败的推理轨迹来构造 steering 向量；配对 teacher-forced 对照固定 rollout、标签、答案文本与配对数、只去掉轨迹。读取自 rollout 需两处修正：保留完整差分向量而非 Top-10% masking，每题只投一票而非每对一票；分组聚合 (grouped aggregation) 用于应对 verifier 噪声。
Result: GSM8K 0.6B：仅配对 +0.12 分，恢复轨迹 +6.05（更大且唯一跨 seed 稳健的一步）；换成等长中性前缀或其他题的推理则低于无干预。两套语料几何上中位相差 70+ 度（两个 Qwen3 尺度），超出 split-half null。20% verifier 噪声下只有 grouped aggregation 胜过无 steering 基线。GSM8K、MATH500、IFEval 六格全胜，最高 +9.7，+6.4% 墙钟；另在六个 parser-scored 基准、三个模型上领先；九个模型（0.6B–122B、四个家族）全部相对无 steering 改善。
Conclusion: 对比信号存在于推理轨迹本身而非配对文本，从 rollout 读取方向并做分组聚合，可在不加上下文、几乎不加开销的条件下跨尺度、跨家族稳定提升推理与指令遵循表现。
