papers.title: Efficient reduction of stellar contamination and noise in planetary transmission spectra using neural networks
papers.abstract_en: The characterization of exoplanetary atmospheres has been transformed by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), whose infrared sensitivity enables transmission spectroscopy at unprecedented precision. However, stellar heterogeneities (e.g., spots and faculae) remain a dominant source of contamination that can bias atmospheric retrievals if not properly corrected. We present a methodology for reducing stellar contamination and instrument-specific noise from exoplanet transmission spectra using neural networks, in particular the so-called Denoising AutoEncoders (DAEs). Our goals are to enable fast, accurate corrections that improve the reliability of atmospheric parameter retrievals and to promote the use of unsupervised algorithms for efficient data processing. We designed and trained DAE architectures using large synthetic datasets of terrestrial (TRAPPIST-1e analogues) and sub-Neptune (K2-18b analogues) planets. Atmospheric retrieval experiments were then performed on contaminated spectra in order to compare our deep-learning approach against standard correction methods in terms of accuracy and computational cost. Our autoencoders successfully reconstruct uncontaminated spectra, preserving essential molecular features even in low-S/N regimes. In retrieval tests, the denoising autoencoder pre-processing yields atmospheric parameter estimates broadly comparable to those obtained with simultaneous stellar-contamination fitting. Notably, our method maintains a much lower computational cost, approximately one order of magnitude smaller. These results demonstrate that DAEs outperform conventional correction methods in computational efficiency while maintaining high accuracy, paving the way for their integration into future atmospheric characterization pipelines for both rocky and sub-Neptune exoplanets.

papers.title: Selective Fine-Tuning for Targeted and Robust Concept Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Text guided diffusion models are used by millions of users, but can be easily exploited to produce harmful content. Concept unlearning methods aim at reducing the models' likelihood of generating harmful content. Traditionally, this has been tackled at an individual concept level, with only a handful of recent works considering more realistic concept combinations. However, state of the art methods depend on full finetuning, which is computationally expensive. Concept localisation methods can facilitate selective finetuning, but existing techniques are static, resulting in suboptimal utility. In order to tackle these challenges, we propose TRUST (Targeted Robust Selective fine Tuning), a novel approach for dynamically estimating target concept neurons and unlearning them through selective finetuning, empowered by a Hessian based regularization. We show experimentally, against a number of SOTA baselines, that TRUST is robust against adversarial prompts, preserves generation quality to a significant degree, and is also significantly faster than the SOTA. Our method achieves unlearning of not only individual concepts but also combinations of concepts and conditional concepts, without any specific regularization.
papers.comment: Given the brittle nature of existing methods in unlearning harmful content in diffusion models, we propose TRuST, a novel approach for dynamically estimating target concept neurons and unlearning them by selectively fine-tuning
papers.journal_ref: ACM CCS 2026 main conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRUST（Targeted Robust Selective fine Tuning）在文本引导扩散模型上做概念遗忘：动态定位目标概念神经元，只对这些神经元做选择性微调，并加 Hessian 正则。实验显示它对对抗性提示鲁棒、显著保留生成质量、比 SOTA 快得多，且无需专门正则即可遗忘单个概念、概念组合与条件概念。
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法多为全参数微调，计算昂贵；概念定位技术虽可支持选择性微调，但定位是静态的，导致效用次优，且多数工作只处理单个概念而非更现实的概念组合。
Method: TRUST 动态估计目标概念神经元，仅对这些神经元做选择性微调，并以基于 Hessian 的正则约束；无需针对概念组合或条件概念的专门正则。
Result: 与多个 SOTA 基线对比的实验显示：TRUST 对对抗性提示鲁棒，显著程度上保留生成质量，且显著快于 SOTA；可遗忘单个概念、概念组合与条件概念。
Conclusion: 动态定位加选择性微调足以在扩散模型中实现稳健的多形态概念遗忘，同时降低全参数微调的计算开销。

papers.title: Semantic Purification for Conditional Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Conditional representation learning aims to extract criterion-specific features for customized tasks. Recent methods construct conditional subspaces spanned by criterion-specific text bases in the embedding space of vision-language models (VLMs). Image embeddings are then projected onto these subspaces to obtain conditional representations. However, since VLMs are not explicitly trained to disentangle semantics associated with different criteria, the corresponding conditional subspaces remain coupled. This coupling induces semantic leakage during projection, thereby degrading the semantic purity of conditional representations. To suppress semantic leakage, we propose Semantic Purification for Conditional Representation Learning (SP-CRL). Specifically, SP-CRL first decomposes the original text basis and performs curvature-based adaptive truncation on the resulting basis vectors to construct a purer conditional subspace. It then identifies an appropriate noise subspace and projects image embeddings onto its null space to remove irrelevant semantic components. Extensive experiments across customized clustering, customized few-shot classification, and customized retrieval tasks demonstrate that SP-CRL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SP-CRL 针对条件表征学习中条件子空间耦合导致的语义泄漏：先分解原始文本基并对基向量做曲率自适应截断以构造更纯的条件子空间，再识别噪声子空间并把图像嵌入投影到其零空间以去除无关语义成分。在定制化聚类、定制化少样本分类与定制化检索三类任务上达到 state-of-the-art 并展现更优泛化。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 未被显式训练去解耦不同准则的语义，由准则特定文本基张成的条件子空间彼此耦合，投影时产生语义泄漏，降低条件表征的语义纯度。
Method: SP-CRL 分两步：分解原始文本基并对所得基向量做曲率自适应截断 (curvature-based adaptive truncation) 构造更纯的条件子空间；再识别合适的噪声子空间，将图像嵌入投影到其零空间以移除无关语义成分。
Result: 在定制化聚类、定制化少样本分类 (customized few-shot classification) 与定制化检索三类任务上的大量实验中，SP-CRL 取得 state-of-the-art 性能并展现更优泛化能力。
Conclusion: 抑制语义泄漏（截断纯化条件子空间 + 零空间投影去噪）能提升条件表征的语义纯度，使条件表征学习在多类定制化任务上达到最优并更好泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stable Velocity: A Variance Perspective on Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: While flow matching is elegant, its reliance on single-sample conditional velocities leads to high-variance training targets that destabilize optimization and slow convergence. By explicitly characterizing this variance, we identify 1) a high-variance regime near the prior, where optimization is challenging, and 2) a low-variance regime near the data distribution, where conditional and marginal velocities nearly coincide. Leveraging this insight, we propose Stable Velocity, a unified framework that improves both training and sampling. For training, we introduce Stable Velocity Matching (StableVM), an unbiased variance-reduction objective, along with Variance-Aware Representation Alignment (VA-REPA), which adaptively strengthen auxiliary supervision in the low-variance regime. For inference, we show that dynamics in the low-variance regime admit closed-form simplifications, enabling Stable Velocity Sampling (StableVS), a finetuning-free acceleration. Extensive experiments on ImageNet $256\times256$ and large pretrained text-to-image and text-to-video models, including SD3.5, Flux, Qwen-Image, and Wan2.2, demonstrate consistent improvements in training efficiency and more than $2\times$ faster sampling within the low-variance regime without degrading sample quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/linYDTHU/StableVelocity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flow matching 用单样本条件速度作训练目标导致高方差、优化不稳。作者把方差拆成近先验的高方差区与近数据分布的低方差区，提出 Stable Velocity：训练端用无偏降方差目标 StableVM 与低方差区自适应加强的 VA-REPA，推理端在低方差区做闭式简化得到免微调的 StableVS，在 ImageNet 256×256 及 SD3.5、Flux、Qwen-Image、Wan2.2 上训练效率一致提升、低方差区内采样加速 2 倍以上且画质不降。
Motivation: Flow matching 依赖单样本条件速度作为训练目标，方差高，使优化不稳定、收敛慢；作者指出方差在近先验处高、近数据分布处低，此前未被显式刻画并利用。
Method: 先显式刻画条件速度的方差，区分近先验的高方差区与近数据分布的低方差区（此区间条件速度与边际速度几乎重合）。训练端提出 Stable Velocity Matching (StableVM) 这一无偏降方差目标，以及 Variance-Aware Representation Alignment (VA-REPA)，在低方差区自适应加强辅助监督；推理端利用低方差区动力学的闭式简化，得到免微调的 Stable Velocity Sampling (StableVS)。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 以及 SD3.5、Flux、Qwen-Image、Wan2.2 等大规模预训练文生图与文生视频模型上，训练效率一致提升；在低方差区内采样加速 2 倍以上（more than 2× faster），且不降低样本质量。
Conclusion: 把条件速度方差作为显式结构来设计训练目标与采样器，可在不牺牲画质的前提下同时改善 flow matching 的训练效率与推理速度，加速来自低方差区的闭式简化。

papers.title: KANFIS: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Interpretable and Uncertainty-Aware Learning
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) was designed to combine the learning capabilities of neural network with the reasoning transparency of fuzzy logic. However, conventional ANFIS architectures suffer from structural complexity, where the product-based inference mechanism causes an exponential explosion of rules in high-dimensional spaces. We herein propose the Kolmogorov-Arnold Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (KANFIS), a compact neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies fuzzy reasoning with additive function decomposition. KANFIS employs an additive aggregation mechanism, under which both model parameters and rule complexity scale linearly with input dimensionality rather than exponentially. Furthermore, KANFIS is compatible with both Type-1 (T1) and Interval Type-2 (IT2) fuzzy logic systems, enabling explicit modeling of uncertainty and ambiguity in fuzzy representations. By using sparse masking mechanisms, KANFIS generates compact and structured rule sets, resulting in an intrinsically interpretable model with clear rule semantics and transparent inference processes. Empirical results demonstrate that KANFIS achieves competitive performance against representative neural and neuro-fuzzy baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KANFIS 用加性聚合替代 ANFIS 的乘积推理，把规则数与参数量从随输入维度指数爆炸改为线性增长，并兼容 Type-1 与 Interval Type-2 模糊系统以显式建模不确定性，配合稀疏掩码生成紧凑规则集。在与代表性神经及神经模糊基线的对比中取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 常规 ANFIS 的乘积推理机制在高维空间导致规则数指数爆炸，结构复杂度高，难以兼顾可解释性与可扩展性。
Method: 提出 Kolmogorov-Arnold Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (KANFIS)，将模糊推理与加性函数分解 (additive function decomposition) 统一，用加性聚合使参数与规则复杂度随输入维度线性扩展；支持 Type-1 与 Interval Type-2 模糊逻辑系统建模不确定性，并用稀疏掩码 (sparse masking) 生成结构化紧凑规则集。
Result: 模型参数与规则复杂度随输入维度线性而非指数增长；在与代表性神经网络和神经模糊基线的对比中取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 加性聚合加稀疏规则掩码可以让神经模糊系统在保持规则语义透明、可显式表达不确定性的同时摆脱规则数的指数爆炸。

papers.title: Poly-attention: a general scheme for higher-order self-attention
papers.abstract_en: The self-attention mechanism, at the heart of the Transformer model, is able to effectively model pairwise interactions between tokens. However, numerous recent works have shown that it is unable to perform basic tasks involving detecting triples of correlated tokens, or compositional tasks where multiple input tokens need to be referenced to generate a result. Some higher-dimensional alternatives to self-attention have been proposed to address this, including higher-order attention and Strassen attention, which can perform some of these polyadic tasks in exchange for slower, superquadratic running times. In this work, we define a vast class of generalizations of self-attention, which we call poly-attention mechanisms. Our mechanisms can incorporate arbitrary higher-order (tensor) computations as well as arbitrary relationship structures between the input tokens, and they include the aforementioned alternatives as special cases. We then systematically study their computational complexity and representational strength, including giving new algorithms and matching complexity-theoretic lower bounds on the time complexity of computing the attention matrix exactly as well as approximately, and tightly determining which polyadic tasks they can each perform. Our results give interesting trade-offs between different desiderata for these mechanisms, including a tight relationship between how expressive a mechanism is, and how large the coefficients in the model may be so that the mechanism can be approximated in almost-linear time. Notably, we give a new attention mechanism which can be computed exactly in quadratic time, and which can perform function composition for any fixed number of functions. Prior mechanisms, even for just composing two functions, could only be computed in superquadratic time, and our new lower bounds show that faster algorithms for them are not possible.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Adversarial Reward Auditing for Active Detection and Mitigation of Reward Hacking
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) remains vulnerable to reward hacking, where models exploit spurious correlations in learned reward models to achieve high scores while violating human intent. Existing mitigations rely on static defenses that cannot adapt to novel exploitation strategies. We propose Adversarial Reward Auditing (ARA), a framework that reconceptualizes reward hacking as a dynamic, competitive game. ARA operates in two stages: first, a Hacker policy discovers reward model vulnerabilities while an Auditor learns to detect exploitation from latent representations; second, Auditor-Guided RLHF (AG-RLHF) gates reward signals to penalize detected hacking, transforming reward hacking from an unobservable failure into a measurable, controllable signal. Experiments across three hacking scenarios demonstrate that ARA achieves the best alignment-utility tradeoff among all baselines: reducing sycophancy to near-SFT levels while improving helpfulness, decreasing verbosity while achieving the highest ROUGE-L, and suppressing code gaming while improving Pass@1. Beyond single-domain evaluation, we show that reward hacking, detection, and mitigation all generalize across domains -- a Hacker trained on code gaming exhibits increased sycophancy despite no reward for this behavior, and an Auditor trained on one domain effectively suppresses exploitation in others, enabling efficient multi-domain defense with a single model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARA 把 reward hacking 当作动态对抗博弈：Hacker 策略挖掘 reward model 漏洞，Auditor 从隐表示检测利用行为，再用 Auditor-Guided RLHF (AG-RLHF) 对检测到的 hacking 惩罚并门控 reward 信号。在三类 hacking 场景中它取得最好的 alignment-utility 权衡：谄媚降到接近 SFT 水平且 helpfulness 提升，冗长度下降且 ROUGE-L 最高，代码 gaming 被抑制且 Pass@1 提升；检测与缓解还能跨域泛化。
Motivation: RLHF 中模型会利用 reward model 的虚假相关性刷分而违背人类意图，现有缓解手段是静态防御，无法适应新出现的利用策略。
Method: ARA 分两阶段：Hacker 策略发现 reward model 漏洞，Auditor 从隐表示学习检测利用；随后 AG-RLHF 对检测到的 hacking 惩罚并门控 reward 信号，把不可观测的失败变成可测可控信号。
Result: 在三个 hacking 场景中 ARA 在所有基线上取得最好的 alignment-utility 权衡：谄媚 (sycophancy) 降至接近 SFT 水平同时 helpfulness 提升；冗长度 (verbosity) 下降同时取得最高 ROUGE-L；抑制代码 gaming 同时 Pass@1 提升。跨域实验中，在 code gaming 上训练的 Hacker 在该行为无 reward 的情况下仍表现出更多谄媚，在一个域训练的 Auditor 能在其他域抑制利用。
Conclusion: reward hacking 可以被当作可检测、可门控的信号来治理，且单一 Auditor 模型即可支撑跨域的多域防御。

papers.title: Plain Transformers are Surprisingly Powerful Link Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Link prediction is a core challenge in graph machine learning, demanding models that capture rich and complex topological dependencies. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are the standard solution, state-of-the-art pipelines often rely on explicit structural heuristics or memory-intensive node embeddings -- approaches that struggle to generalize or scale to massive graphs. Emerging Graph Transformers (GTs) offer a potential alternative but often incur significant overhead due to complex structural encodings, hindering their applications to large-scale link prediction. We challenge these sophisticated paradigms with PENCIL, an encoder-only plain Transformer that replaces hand-crafted priors with attention over sampled local subgraphs, retaining the scalability and hardware efficiency of standard Transformers. Through experimental and theoretical analysis, we show that PENCIL extracts richer structural signals than GNNs, implicitly generalizing a broad class of heuristics and subgraph-based expressivity. Empirically, PENCIL outperforms heuristic-informed GNNs and is far more parameter-efficient than ID-embedding--based alternatives, while remaining competitive across diverse benchmarks -- even without node features. Our results challenge the prevailing reliance on complex engineering techniques, demonstrating that simple design choices are potentially sufficient to achieve the same capabilities. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/quang-truong/pencil.
papers.comment: ICML'26. UPDATE: Corrected the HeaRT-ogbl-collab results due to an evaluation code error
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PENCIL 用只编码器结构的普通 Transformer，把手工结构先验换成对采样局部子图的注意力来做链路预测，在多个基准上超过依赖启发式结构信息的 GNN，且参数量远少于 ID embedding 类方法，甚至在无节点特征时仍有竞争力。
Motivation: GNN 链路预测依赖显式结构启发式或占内存的节点 embedding，难泛化也难扩展到大规模图；Graph Transformer 又因复杂结构编码开销大而难以落地。
Method: PENCIL 是 encoder-only 的普通 Transformer，用对采样局部子图的注意力替代手工结构先验与结构编码，保留标准 Transformer 的可扩展性和硬件效率；作者从实验与理论两方面论证其能隐式覆盖一类启发式与基于子图的表达能力。
Result: 在多样基准上 PENCIL 优于启发式增强的 GNN，比基于 ID embedding 的替代方案参数效率高得多，且在无节点特征时仍具竞争力；HeaRT-ogbl-collab 结果因评估代码错误已更正。
Conclusion: 链路预测不必依赖复杂结构工程，简单设计选择足以达到同等能力，同时保住大规模图所需的可扩展性。

papers.title: Latent Chain-of-Thought as Planning: Decoupling Reasoning from Verbalization
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex problems, but remains constrained by the computational cost and early token commitments in discrete reasoning traces. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to optimize efficiency by performing reasoning within continuous hidden states. However, many such methods optimize latent states end to end without a trained interface for intermediate textual readout, and several representative configurations use a pre-defined number of latent steps during inference. In this work, we introduce \textbf{PLaT} (\textbf{P}lanning with \textbf{La}tent \textbf{T}houghts), a framework that decouples latent planning from verbalization. The Planner deterministically evolves latent planning states, while an independent Decoder provides textual readouts when needed. Answer-aware textual stopping allows the latent rollout to use a problem-dependent number of groups rather than a pre-specified chain length. PLaT achieves competitive coverage at larger $k$ in several mathematical settings, with lower Pass@1: on Llama-1B GSM8K, it reaches 80.59\% Pass@128 versus CODI's 72.37\%. These results support PLaT as a candidate-generation interface supplying multiple textual readouts for downstream verification or reranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLaT 把隐空间规划与文字表达解耦：Planner 确定性地演化隐规划状态，独立 Decoder 按需做文字读出，答案感知的文本停止让隐 rollout 用随问题变化的组数而非预设链长。在 Llama-1B GSM8K 上 Pass@128 达 80.59%，高于 CODI 的 72.37%，但 Pass@1 更低，定位为给下游验证或重排序供候选的生成接口。
Motivation: 离散 CoT 受推理轨迹的计算开销与早期 token 承诺约束，而现有隐式推理方法端到端优化隐状态、缺少用于中间文字读出的训练接口，且若干代表配置在推理时用预设的隐步数。
Method: PLaT 框架含确定性演化隐规划状态的 Planner 与独立提供文字读出的 Decoder，两者解耦；引入 answer-aware textual stopping，使隐 rollout 采用随问题而变的组数，替代固定链长。
Result: 在多个数学设定上较大 k 时 coverage 具竞争力：Llama-1B GSM8K Pass@128 为 80.59%，CODI 为 72.37%；同时 Pass@1 更低。
Conclusion: PLaT 适合作为候选生成接口，为下游验证或 reranking 提供多条文字读出，而非直接追求单次作答精度。

papers.title: Correcting Spectra Outside the Backbone: A Model-Agnostic Rectifier for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image super-resolution (HSI-SR) aims to recover spatial detail while preserving the spectral shape on which quantitative analysis relies. Recent HSI-SR methods, from repurposed RGB super-resolution backbones to dedicated spectral-spatial architectures, have greatly improved spatial reconstruction. However, overlooking the compact spectral structure of hyperspectral data leaves residual spectral errors, while binding the spectral treatment to each architecture forces it to be rebuilt for every new backbone. Yet the low-dimensional structure of spectra belongs to the data, not to any backbone. Backbones differ in the errors they leave, but not in the structure of the true spectra. One rectifier design can therefore serve any backbone. Building on this insight, we propose the \textbf{S}pectral \textbf{R}ectification \textbf{S}uper-\textbf{R}esolution Network (\textbf{SR$^{2}$-Net}), a model-agnostic rectifier that needs nothing from the backbone but its output, leaves its internal architecture untouched, and is trained per backbone. SR$^{2}$-Net follows an \emph{enhance-then-rectify} pipeline in which Hierarchical Spectral-Spatial Synergy Attention (\textbf{H-S$^{3}$A}) reinforces cross-band interactions, while Mode-Constrained Rectification (\textbf{MCR}) confines the correction to a learned compact spectral subspace. A degradation-consistency constraint further ties the output to the observed low-resolution input. Experiments with five backbones spanning CNN, Transformer, and diffusion families show that one fixed configuration improves spectral fidelity in every reported setting while preserving or improving spatial quality. Averaged over thirty in-domain settings, SR$^{2}$-Net removes 22.6\% of the residual spectral error at a backbone-independent cost of 0.048M parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR²-Net 把光谱校正从超分辨率主干中解耦出来，作为模型无关的后置 rectifier：只吃主干输出，内部结构不动，按主干单独训练。其 enhance-then-rectify 流水线用 H-S³A 强化跨波段交互、用 MCR 把修正限制在学到的紧凑光谱子空间，再加退化一致性约束把输出绑回观测低分辨率输入。在覆盖 CNN、Transformer、diffusion 的五个主干上，固定配置在每个报告设置中都提升光谱保真度且保持或改善空间质量，30 个 in-domain 设置平均消除 22.6% 残余光谱误差，代价是与主干无关的 0.048M 参数。
Motivation: 现有 HSI-SR 方法把光谱处理绑死在各自架构上，换主干就要重建一遍，同时忽略高光谱数据紧凑的光谱结构，留下残余光谱误差。
Method: 提出 SR²-Net：模型无关的 rectifier，仅以主干输出为输入、不改动主干内部、按主干训练。流水线为 enhance-then-rectify，先用 Hierarchical Spectral-Spatial Synergy Attention (H-S³A) 强化跨波段交互，再用 Mode-Constrained Rectification (MCR) 把修正约束在学到的紧凑光谱子空间，并以退化一致性约束将输出与观测低分辨率输入绑定。
Result: 在 CNN、Transformer、diffusion 三类共五个主干上，一个固定配置在每个报告设置中都改善光谱保真度并保持或提升空间质量；30 个 in-domain 设置平均消除 22.6% 残余光谱误差，参数开销 0.048M 且与主干无关。
Conclusion: 真实光谱的低维结构属于数据而非某个主干，因此一个固定的后置光谱校正器可跨架构复用，只需按主干训练即可在不动主干的前提下压低残余光谱误差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Hypersolid: Emergent Vision Representations via Short-Range Repulsion
papers.abstract_en: A central problem in self-supervised learning is preventing representation collapse. Most methods avoid it through global mechanisms, such as contrastive expansion, variance constraints, decorrelating dimensions, or enforcing certain output distributions. In this work, we study a different design: short-range repulsion. We introduce Hypersolid, a self-supervised objective that combines view alignment with local collision avoidance. Our method induces a latent geometry of compact, semantically aligned neighborhoods with low anisotropy. This geometry is especially effective for unsupervised clustering and fine-grained separation, although it comes at the cost of weaker transferability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hypersolid 是一个自监督视觉表征目标，把视图对齐 (view alignment) 与局部避碰 (short-range repulsion) 结合，用短程排斥而非全局机制来防止表征塌缩。它诱导出紧凑、语义对齐且低各向异性的邻域几何，在无监督聚类与细粒度区分上尤其有效，代价是迁移能力变弱。
Motivation: 自监督学习中表征塌缩的主流解法都依赖全局机制（对比扩张、方差约束、维度去相关、输出分布约束），作者要检验另一条设计路线——短程排斥——能否独立承担防塌缩的作用。
Method: 提出自监督目标 Hypersolid：损失同时包含视图对齐项与局部碰撞避免项，让相邻样本在潜空间中互相排斥，从而形成紧凑、语义对齐、低各向异性的邻域几何。
Result: 该几何在无监督聚类和细粒度区分上尤其有效，但以更弱的迁移能力为代价；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 防塌缩不必依赖全局机制，短程排斥即可诱导出利于聚类与细粒度分离的潜空间几何，但这条路线与迁移能力之间存在明确取舍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model-Free Output Feedback Stabilization via Policy Gradient Methods
papers.abstract_en: Stabilizing a dynamical system is a fundamental problem that serves as a cornerstone for many complex tasks in the field of control systems. The problem becomes challenging when the system model is unknown. Among the Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms that have been successfully applied to solve problems pertaining to unknown linear dynamical systems, the policy gradient (PG) method stands out due to its ease of implementation and can solve the problem in a model-free manner. However, most of the existing works on PG methods for unknown linear dynamical systems assume full-state feedback. In this paper, we take a step towards model-free learning for partially observed linear dynamical systems with output feedback and focus on the fundamental stabilization problem of the system. We propose an algorithmic framework that stretches the boundary of PG methods to the problem without global convergence guarantees. We show that by leveraging zeroth-order PG update based on system trajectories and its convergence to stationary points, the proposed algorithms return a stabilizing output feedback policy for discrete-time linear dynamical systems. We also explicitly characterize the sample complexity of our algorithm and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm using numerical examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对部分可观测、模型未知的离散时间线性系统，提出基于零阶策略梯度 (zeroth-order policy gradient) 的输出反馈稳定化算法框架，利用系统轨迹做 PG 更新并收敛到驻点，返回稳定输出反馈策略。显式刻画了样本复杂度，并用数值算例验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有 PG 方法求解未知线性动力系统时大多假设全状态反馈，而实际系统往往只能拿到部分观测的输出反馈，稳定化问题在该设定下缺少可用的无模型学习方案。
Method: 提出算法框架，用基于系统轨迹的零阶策略梯度更新替代需要模型的梯度，迭代收敛到驻点，输出反馈控制器直接由数据学出；并显式推导样本复杂度。
Result: 显式刻画了算法的样本复杂度，并通过数值算例验证算法有效性；该框架针对无全局收敛保证的问题给出可返回稳定输出反馈策略的结果。
Conclusion: 零阶 PG 更新可在不依赖系统模型与全状态反馈的前提下，把部分观测线性系统的稳定化问题推进到返回稳定输出反馈策略，但收敛保证限于驻点而非全局最优。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Scalable Entity-Based Framework for Auditing Bias in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to bias evaluation in large language models (LLMs) trade ecological validity for statistical control, relying either on artificial prompts that poorly reflect real-world use or on naturalistic tasks that lack scale and rigor. We introduce a scalable bias-auditing framework that uses named entities as controlled probes to measure systematic disparities in model behavior. Synthetic data enables us to construct diverse, controlled inputs, and we show that it reliably reproduces bias patterns observed in natural text, supporting its use for large-scale analysis. Using this framework, we conduct the largest bias audit to date, comprising 1.9 billion data points across multiple entity types, tasks, languages, models, and prompting strategies. We find consistent patterns: models penalize right-wing politicians and favor left-wing politicians, prefer Western and wealthier countries over the Global South, favor Western companies, and penalize firms in the defense and pharmaceutical sectors. While instruction tuning reduces bias, increasing model scale amplifies it, and prompting in Chinese or Russian does not mitigate Western-aligned preferences. These findings highlight the need for systematic bias auditing before deploying LLMs in high-stakes applications. Our framework is extensible to other domains and tasks, and we make it publicly available to support future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以命名实体作为受控探针的 LLM 偏见审计框架，用合成数据构造可控输入并证明其能复现自然文本中的偏见模式。迄今最大规模审计覆盖 19 亿数据点，发现模型惩罚右翼政客、偏好西方与更富裕国家、偏好西方企业并惩罚国防与制药企业；指令微调降低偏见，而模型规模增大反而放大偏见，用中文或俄文提示都不能缓解西方中心偏好。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 偏见评估在生态效度与统计控制之间二选一：人工提示不反映真实使用，自然任务又缺乏规模与严谨性。
Method: 以命名实体 (named entities) 作为受控探针测量模型行为的系统性差异，用合成数据构造多样且可控的输入，并验证其能可靠复现自然文本中的偏见模式；框架覆盖多种实体类型、任务、语言、模型与提示策略，且公开可用。
Result: 审计规模达 19 亿 (1.9 billion) 数据点，为迄今最大偏见审计；一致发现模型惩罚右翼政客、偏好左翼政客，偏好西方与更富裕国家而非 Global South，偏好西方公司，惩罚国防与制药行业企业；指令微调 (instruction tuning) 降低偏见，模型规模增大放大偏见，中文或俄文提示不缓解西方中心偏好。
Conclusion: 偏见随模型规模增大而放大、且不因提示语言改变而消失，因此在高风险应用部署前需要系统性偏见审计；该实体探针框架可扩展到其他领域与任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Lesion Segmentation of Stroke MRI Using nnU-Net: A Comprehensive External Validation Across Acute and Chronic Lesions
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and generalisable segmentation of stroke lesions from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for advancing clinical research, prognostic modelling, and personalised interventions. Although deep learning has improved automated lesion delineation, many existing models are optimised for narrow imaging contexts and generalise poorly to independent datasets, modalities, and stroke stages. Here, we systematically evaluated stroke lesion segmentation using the nnU-Net framework across multiple heterogeneous, publicly available MRI datasets spanning acute and chronic stroke. Models were trained and tested on diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR), and T1-weighted MRI, and evaluated on independent datasets. Across stroke stages, models showed robust generalisation, with segmentation accuracy approaching reported inter-rater reliability. Performance varied with imaging modality and training data characteristics. In acute stroke, DWI-trained models consistently outperformed FLAIR-based models, with only modest gains from multimodal combinations. In chronic stroke, increasing training set size improved performance, with diminishing returns beyond several hundred cases. Lesion volume was a key determinant of accuracy: smaller lesions were harder to segment, and models trained on restricted volume ranges generalised poorly. MRI image quality further constrained generalisability: models trained on lower-quality scans transferred poorly, whereas those trained on higher-quality data generalised well to noisier images. Discrepancies between predictions and reference masks were often attributable to limitations in manual annotations. Together, these findings show that automated lesion segmentation can approach human-level performance while identifying key factors governing generalisability and informing the development of lesion segmentation tools.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 nnU-Net 在多个公开异构 MRI 数据集上系统评估卒中病灶分割，覆盖急性与慢性期、DWI/FLAIR/T1 三种模态。急性期 DWI 训练的模型稳定优于 FLAIR，多模态组合仅带来有限增益；慢性期训练集超过数百例后收益递减，小病灶与低质量扫描是泛化的主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有深度学习病灶分割模型多针对窄成像场景优化，换数据集、换模态或换卒中分期后泛化差，制约其用于临床研究、预后建模与个体化干预。
Method: 基于 nnU-Net 框架，在多个公开异构 MRI 数据集上分别以 DWI、FLAIR、T1 加权像训练与测试，并在独立数据集上评估；按卒中分期、模态、训练集规模、病灶体积区间与图像质量分层考察泛化。
Result: 跨分期分割精度接近已报道的评分者间一致性 (inter-rater reliability)；急性期 DWI 训练模型持续优于 FLAIR，多模态组合仅小幅提升；慢性期扩大训练集可提升性能，超过数百例后收益递减；小病灶更难分割，在受限体积范围训练的模型泛化差；低质量扫描上训练的模型迁移差，高质量数据训练的模型可迁移到含噪图像；预测与参考掩膜的差异常可归因于人工标注本身的局限。
Conclusion: 自动化病灶分割可逼近人工水平，而决定泛化的关键是成像模态、训练集规模与构成、病灶体积分布及图像质量，开发分割工具时须据此筛选训练数据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Understanding and inverse design of implicit bias in stochastic learning: a geometric perspective
papers.abstract_en: Can we design a model such that its stochastic training favours a desired class of solutions without enforcing an explicit penalty? Under suitable conditions, the interplay between symmetries of a model's weight parametrization and stochastic training favours particular solutions, inducing an implicit bias. Building on this mechanism, we develop a framework for inverse-designing such biases by constructing novel parametrizations and their associated symmetries. We show how holomorphic functions make this construction and calculation simple and explicit. Specifically, we introduce a new parametrization that biases learned weights toward the binary values $\{-1,+1\}$. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical predictions. They also show that our parametrization reproduces the same preference induced by an explicitly regularized model without adding a penalty to the training loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个反向设计隐式偏置 (implicit bias) 的框架：模型权重参数化的对称性与随机训练相互作用会偏好特定解，作者据此构造新的参数化及其对称性，把偏好直接写进参数化而不加显式惩罚。用全纯函数 (holomorphic functions) 让构造与计算显式化，并给出一个把学到的权重偏向二值 {-1,+1} 的新参数化；数值实验验证理论预测，且该参数化复现了显式正则化模型的同等偏好，而训练损失中不加惩罚项。
Motivation: 随机训练偏好某类解通常只能靠显式正则项施加；作者要回答能否只通过设计参数化与其对称性，让训练自发偏好期望的解类。
Method: 在模型权重参数化的对称性与随机训练交互的机制上建立反向设计框架，构造新的参数化及其对称性；用全纯函数使构造与计算简单显式，并具体给出一个把学习权重偏向二值 {-1,+1} 的参数化，再以数值实验检验理论预测。
Result: 数值实验确认了理论预测；新参数化复现了显式正则化模型所诱导的同等偏好（偏向 {-1,+1}），且未在训练损失中加入惩罚项。
Conclusion: 隐式偏置可以通过参数化与其对称性来反向设计：把偏好编码进参数化即可达到与显式正则化相同的效果，而不必修改损失函数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PEST: Parameter Efficient Steering of Blackbox VLMs via Agentic Few-shot Alignment for Hateful Meme Moderation
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we examine hateful memes from three complementary angles - how to detect them, how to explain their content and how to intervene them before being posted - by applying a range of strategies built on top of generative AI models. To the best of our knowledge, explanation and intervention have typically been studied separately from detection, which does not reflect real-world conditions. Further, since curating large annotated datasets for meme moderation is prohibitively expensive, we propose a novel framework - PEST - that leverages task-specific generative VLMs and the few-shot adaptability of large VLMs to cater to different types of memes. We believe this is the first work focused on generalizable hateful meme moderation under limited data conditions, and has strong potential for deployment in real-world production scenarios. Warning: Contains potentially toxic contents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEST 用任务专用生成式 VLM 加大 VLM 的 few-shot 适配能力，在标注数据稀缺条件下把仇恨 meme 的检测、解释与发布前干预统一到一个框架里。作者称这是首个面向有限数据、可泛化的仇恨 meme 审核工作，并认为其具备真实生产环境部署潜力。
Motivation: 仇恨 meme 的检测、解释与干预此前多被分开研究，不符合真实审核流程；而为 meme 审核大规模标注数据成本过高，模型难以在有限数据下泛化。
Method: 提出 PEST 框架：结合任务专用生成式 VLM 与大 VLM 的 few-shot 适配（agentic few-shot alignment），对黑盒 VLM 做参数高效引导 (parameter-efficient steering)，以覆盖不同类型的 meme 并同时处理检测、解释与干预三个环节。
Result: 给出的是框架与定位主张：在有限数据条件下实现可泛化的仇恨 meme 审核，覆盖检测、解释、干预三个互补角度，并被作者称为该方向首个工作。
Conclusion: 在标注稀缺的 meme 审核场景中，任务专用生成式 VLM 加 few-shot 对齐足以支撑检测、解释与干预的统一处理，作者认为其可推向真实生产部署。

papers.title: Quantifying the Effect of Test Set Contamination on Generative Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: As frontier AI systems are pretrained on web-scale data, test set contamination has become a critical concern for accurately assessing their capabilities. While research has thoroughly investigated the impact of test set contamination on discriminative evaluations like multiple-choice question-answering, comparatively little research has studied the impact of test set contamination on generative evaluations. In this work, we quantitatively assess the effect of test set contamination on generative evaluations through the language model lifecycle. We pretrain language models on mixtures of web data and the MATH benchmark, sweeping model sizes and number of test set replicas contaminating the pretraining corpus; performance improves with contamination and model size. Using scaling laws, we make a surprising discovery: including even a single test set replica enables models to achieve lower loss than the irreducible error of training on the uncontaminated corpus. We then study further training: overtraining with fresh data reduces the effects of contamination, whereas supervised finetuning on the training set can either increase or decrease performance on test data, depending on the amount of pretraining contamination. Finally, at inference, we identify factors that modulate memorization: high sampling temperatures mitigate contamination effects, and longer solutions are exponentially more difficult to memorize than shorter ones, presenting a contrast with discriminative evaluations, where solutions are only a few tokens in length. By characterizing how generation and memorization interact, we highlight a new layer of complexity for trustworthy evaluation of AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预训练语料中混入 MATH 基准测试集副本会系统性抬高生成式评测成绩，且随副本数与模型规模上升；标度律显示哪怕只混入 1 个测试集副本，模型损失也能低于在无污染语料上训练的不可约误差。推理阶段高温采样可缓解污染效应，长解题过程比短解指数级更难记忆。
Motivation: 判别式评测（如多选题 QA）的测试集污染已被充分研究，但生成式评测受污染的影响几乎无人定量刻画，而这直接关系到前沿大模型能力评估的可信度。
Method: 在网页数据与 MATH 基准的混合语料上预训练语言模型，扫描模型规模与污染测试集副本数量两个维度；用标度律 (scaling laws) 拟合污染下的损失行为；再分别考察用新鲜数据继续训练（overtraining）与在训练集上监督微调 (SFT) 的影响，并在推理端测试采样温度与解题长度对记忆化的作用。
Result: 性能随污染副本数与模型规模上升；标度律显示仅 1 个测试集副本即可让模型损失低于在无污染语料上训练的不可约误差；用新鲜数据 overtraining 会减弱污染效应，而训练集上的 SFT 会随预训练污染程度不同而提升或降低测试表现；高温采样可缓解污染影响，更长的解题过程比短解指数级更难记忆（与只需几个 token 的判别式评测形成对比）。
Conclusion: 生成与记忆化交互使可信评测 AI 系统多出一层复杂度：污染效应在生成式评测中可被标度律量化，且受训练阶段与推理采样设置共同调制。

papers.title: Vulcan: Instance-specialized, Verifiable Systems Heuristics Through LLM-driven Search
papers.abstract_en: Systems resource management tasks rely primarily on hand-designed heuristics. However, growing hardware heterogeneity and workload diversity require heuristics specialized to particular deployment instances, making manual design expensive and difficult to scale. In this paper, we explore how to synthesize systems heuristics using LLMs. The main challenge is ensuring that generated heuristics execute safely, integrate correctly with the surrounding system, and still achieve strong performance. We propose Vulcan, a framework that identifies LLM-friendly interfaces that isolate core decision logic from the rest of the implementation. With Vulcan, LLM-generated code is restricted to simple stateless decision functions, while trusted runtime abstractions provide rich derived statistics for meaningful policy exploration without system-integration bugs. To ensure execution safety, LLMs synthesize heuristics in a restricted language, Anvil, that guarantees important properties by construction. We evaluate Vulcan across three well-studied domains and demonstrate up to 4.9$\times$ higher savings for spot-VM scheduling, up to 2$\times$ lower miss ratios for cache eviction, and up to 14% higher application performance for tiered-memory systems, while ensuring execution safety throughout.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 12 figures. Accepted for publication at EuroSys 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vulcan 用 LLM 搜索合成系统启发式：把核心决策逻辑隔离成无状态函数，LLM 只在可保证关键性质的受限语言 Anvil 中生成代码，由可信运行时提供派生统计量。在三个成熟系统领域中，spot-VM 调度节省最高提升 4.9 倍，缓存淘汰 miss ratio 最高降低 2 倍，分层内存应用性能最高提升 14%，全程保持执行安全。
Motivation: 硬件异构与负载多样性要求启发式针对具体部署实例定制，手工设计昂贵且难以规模化，而直接让 LLM 生成系统代码又面临执行安全与集成错误风险。
Method: Vulcan 识别出可隔离决策逻辑的 LLM 友好接口，将 LLM 生成的代码限制为简单无状态决策函数，由可信运行时提供丰富派生统计量；启发式在按构造保证关键性质的受限语言 Anvil 中合成，避免系统集成 bug。
Result: 在三个研究较充分的领域评估：spot-VM 调度节省最高达 4.9 倍提升，缓存淘汰 miss ratio 最高降低 2 倍，分层内存系统应用性能最高提升 14%，并全程保证执行安全。
Conclusion: 把决策逻辑隔离进可验证的受限接口，LLM 就能在保证执行安全的前提下合成出性能强于手工启发式的实例专用系统策略。

papers.title: Exact Flow Linear Attention: Exact Solution from Continuous-Time Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Exact Flow Linear Attention~(EFLA), an exact-flow formulation of delta-rule linear attention. We show that the delta-rule update can be interpreted as an explicit Euler discretization of an underlying continuous-time system. EFLA replaces this first-order update with the exact closed-form flow. By exploiting the rank-1 structure of the dynamics matrix, both the matrix exponential and the input integral collapse to a simple update that preserves delta-rule linear attention's algebraic structure, parameter count, linear-time complexity, and chunkwise parallelism. This attention mechanism removes the Euler discretization error of the delta-rule dynamics without introducing additional parameters. Experiments on robustness tests, language modeling benchmarks, and the MAD synthetic benchmark show that EFLA improves stability under corrupted and high-energy inputs, reduces perplexity, and achieves stronger downstream performance compared to SSM and Euler-style baselines. These results establish exact-flow integration as a principled and scalable update mechanism for delta-rule linear attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EFLA 把 delta-rule 线性注意力的更新视为连续时间系统的显式 Euler 离散，改用其精确闭式流 (exact flow) 作为更新，从而去掉离散化误差且不增参数。在鲁棒性测试、语言建模基准与 MAD 合成基准上，它在受污染和高能量输入下更稳定、困惑度更低，下游表现强于 SSM 与 Euler 类基线。
Motivation: delta-rule 线性注意力用一阶显式 Euler 步近似其背后的连续时间动力学，离散化误差在受污染或高能量输入下放大为稳定性问题。
Method: 将 delta-rule 更新解释为连续时间系统的显式 Euler 离散，用精确闭式流替换该一阶更新；利用动力学矩阵的 rank-1 结构，使矩阵指数与输入积分都坍缩为简单更新，保留原有代数结构、参数量、线性时间复杂度与 chunkwise 并行性。
Result: 在鲁棒性测试、语言建模基准与 MAD 合成基准上，EFLA 在受污染与高能量输入下稳定性提升、困惑度下降，下游性能强于 SSM 与 Euler 类基线。
Conclusion: 精确流积分是 delta-rule 线性注意力一种有原则且可扩展的更新机制，可在不引入额外参数的前提下消除 Euler 离散化误差。

papers.title: Dynamic Image Prompt Adapter for Scalable Zero-shot Personalized Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized Text-to-Image (PT2I) generation aims to produce customized images based on reference images. A prominent interest pertains to the integration of an image prompt adapter to facilitate zero-shot PT2I without test-time fine-tuning. However, current methods grapple with three fundamental challenges: 1. the elusive equilibrium between Concept Preservation (CP) and Prompt Following (PF), 2. the difficulty in retaining fine-grained concept details in reference images, and 3. the restricted scalability to extend to multi-subject personalization. To tackle these challenges, we present Dynamic Image Prompt Adapter (DynaIP), a cutting-edge plugin to enhance the fine-grained concept fidelity, CP-PF balance, and subject scalability of state-of-the-art T2I multimodal diffusion transformers (MM-DiT) for PT2I generation. Our key finding is that MM-DiT inherently exhibit decoupling learning behavior when injecting reference image features into its dual branches via cross attentions. Based on this, we design an innovative Dynamic Decoupling Strategy that removes the interference of concept-agnostic information during inference, significantly enhancing the CP-PF balance and further bolstering the scalability of multi-subject compositions. Moreover, we identify the visual encoder as a key factor affecting fine-grained CP and reveal that the hierarchical features of commonly used CLIP can capture visual information at diverse granularity levels. Therefore, we introduce a novel Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts Feature Fusion Module to fully leverage the hierarchical features of CLIP, remarkably elevating the fine-grained concept fidelity while also providing flexible control of visual granularity. Extensive experiments across single- and multi-subject PT2I tasks verify that our DynaIP outperforms existing approaches, while requiring only single-subject training datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynaIP 是一个即插即用的图像提示适配器，注入参考图特征到 MM-DiT 双分支时利用其天然解耦行为：推理期用 Dynamic Decoupling Strategy 去除概念无关信息以平衡概念保持 (CP) 与提示跟随 (PF)，再用 Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts Feature Fusion 融合 CLIP 层级特征提升细粒度保真。在单主体与多主体 PT2I 任务上超过现有方法，且只需单主体训练数据。
Motivation: 零样本个性化文生图 (zero-shot PT2I) 不做测试时微调，但现有方法在概念保持与提示跟随之间难以取舍、参考图细粒度细节易丢失，且难以扩展到多主体个性化。
Method: DynaIP 作为插件接入 SOTA 的 MM-DiT 多模态扩散 Transformer：通过 cross attention 把参考图特征注入双分支，推理期用 Dynamic Decoupling Strategy 剔除概念无关信息；同时识别视觉编码器为细粒度 CP 关键，用 Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts Feature Fusion 按粒度混合 CLIP 的层级特征，提供视觉粒度的灵活控制。
Result: 在单主体与多主体 PT2I 任务的广泛实验中，DynaIP 优于现有方法，且训练只需单主体数据集；摘要给出的改进维度为 CP-PF 平衡、细粒度概念保真与多主体组合的可扩展性。
Conclusion: MM-DiT 注入参考图特征时本身存在解耦学习行为，据此在推理期去噪概念无关信息并按层级混合 CLIP 特征，可同时改善 CP-PF 平衡、细粒度保真与多主体扩展，且无需多主体训练数据。

papers.title: Time Series Foundation Models for Process Model Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Process Model Forecasting (PMF) aims to predict how the control-flow structure of a process evolves over time by modeling the temporal dynamics of directly-follows (DF) relations, complementing predictive process monitoring that focuses on single-case prefixes. Prior benchmarks show that machine learning and deep learning models provide only modest gains over statistical baselines, mainly due to the sparsity and heterogeneity of the DF time series. We investigate Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs), large pre-trained models for generic time series, as an alternative for PMF. Using DF time series derived from real-life event logs, we compare zero-shot use of TSFMs, without additional training, with fine-tuned variants adapted on PMF-specific data. TSFMs generally achieve lower forecasting errors (MAE and RMSE) than traditional and specialized models trained from scratch on the same logs, indicating effective transfer of temporal structure from non-process domains. While fine-tuning can further improve accuracy, the gains are often small and may disappear on smaller or more complex datasets, so zero-shot use remains a strong default. Our study highlights the generalization capability and data efficiency of TSFMs for process-related time series and, to the best of our knowledge, provides the first systematic evaluation of temporal foundation models for PMF.

TL;DR: 把时序基础模型 (TSFM) 用于流程模型预报 (PMF)，即预测事件日志中 directly-follows (DF) 关系随时间的演化。零样本 TSFM 的 MAE 与 RMSE 普遍低于在同一日志上从头训练的传统与专用模型，微调还能再降误差但增益常很小、在更小或更复杂数据集上可能消失，因此零样本是强默认选项。
Motivation: PMF 需要建模 DF 时间序列的动态，但这类序列稀疏且异质，此前机器学习与深度学习模型相对统计基线只有小幅提升，需要新的建模范式。
Method: 从真实事件日志构造 DF 时间序列，对比三种用法：零样本直接使用预训练 TSFM、在 PMF 专用数据上微调的变体、以及在同一日志上从头训练的传统与专用模型；评价指标为 MAE 与 RMSE。
Result: TSFM 在 MAE 和 RMSE 上普遍低于从头训练的传统与专用模型，说明时间结构从非流程域有效迁移；微调可进一步提升精度，但增益往往很小，且在更小或更复杂的数据集上可能消失。
Conclusion: TSFM 对流程相关时间序列具备泛化能力与数据效率，零样本使用应作为 PMF 的默认方案；这是据作者所知首次对时序基础模型在 PMF 上的系统评估。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: GeoBridge++: Fact-Guided Geo-Semantic Bridging for Unified Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization infers a location by retrieving geo-tagged reference images matching a query image. However, the traditional satellite-centric paradigm limits robustness when high-resolution or up-to-date satellite imagery is unavailable and underexploits complementary cues across views and modalities. To address these challenges, we propose GeoBridge, a novel model that performs bidirectional matching across views and supports language-to-image retrieval. GeoBridge builds on a novel semantic-anchor mechanism that bridges multi-view features through textual descriptions for robust, flexible localization. We further extend GeoBridge to propose GeoBridge++, a fact-guided geo-semantic bridging framework incorporating real-world geographic knowledge to reduce the ambiguity and instability in appearance-dominated supervision. It integrates structured geographic attributes with visual observations to construct factual descriptions and applies targeted guidance based on modality-specific observable content, thereby enhancing geographic discriminability. GeoBridge++ exploits explicit spatial structures encoded by static maps to build a geo-semantic bridge that adaptively aggregates complementary multi-view information and promotes cross-view consistency. In support of this task, we further construct GeoLoc-MM, a million-scale, multi-view, and multi-scale dataset with aligned drone, satellite, street-view, and static-map imagery at six spatial extents per location, enabling systematic evaluation of arbitrary cross-view retrieval, scale robustness, and cross-view generalization. Extensive experiments show that GeoBridge supports robust cross-view and cross-modal geo-localization, while GeoBridge++ achieves consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge.
papers.comment: Extended journal version of the CVPR 2026 paper. Code, dataset, and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoBridge++ 用事实引导的地理-语义桥接做统一跨视图地理定位：以文本语义锚点双向匹配卫星、无人机、街景与静态地图，并把结构化地理属性与视觉观测合成事实描述来压低纯外观监督的歧义。在自建百万级 GeoLoc-MM（每地点六个空间尺度、四类视角对齐）上支持任意跨视图检索与尺度鲁棒性评测，多个基准上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 以卫星为中心的跨视图定位在高分辨率或最新卫星影像缺失时鲁棒性差，且外观主导的监督带来歧义与不稳定，跨视角与跨模态的互补线索被浪费。
Method: GeoBridge 引入语义锚点机制，用文本描述桥接多视图特征，支持双向匹配与文到图检索；GeoBridge++ 进一步做事实引导的地理-语义桥接，把结构化地理属性与视觉观测融合成事实描述并按模态可观测内容施加定向引导，同时用静态地图的显式空间结构自适应聚合多视图信息、促进跨视图一致性。
Result: 构建 GeoLoc-MM：百万级、多视图、多尺度数据集，每个地点对齐无人机、卫星、街景与静态地图影像，覆盖六个空间尺度，用于任意跨视图检索、尺度鲁棒性与跨视图泛化的系统评测；实验显示 GeoBridge 支持稳健的跨视图与跨模态定位，GeoBridge++ 在多个基准上取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 把真实地理知识与静态地图的空间结构引入跨视图检索，可降低外观歧义并带来跨基准的一致增益；代码、数据集与预训练模型将在 MiliLab/GeoBridge 发布。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning to Initialize Newton-Raphson for AC Power Flow with Quantum Annealing-Based Environment Updates
papers.abstract_en: The Newton-Raphson (NR) method is widely used for solving power flow (PF) equations due to its quadratic convergence. However, its performance deteriorates under poor initialization or extreme operating scenarios, e.g., high levels of renewable energy penetration. We propose the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the initialization of NR, and introduce a quantum-enhanced RL environment update mechanism that addresses the combinatorially large action space at each RL timestep by formulating the voltage adjustment task as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem, solved with an Ising machine. RL initialization is benchmarked against flat start and start from the DC (linearized) PF solution on a standard 4-bus system, Iwamoto's ill-conditioned 11-bus system, and the IEEE 118-bus system under normal and stressed loading and reactive power limits, with verified operational solutions. On all systems, a supervised initializer refined by RL requires fewer NR iterations than flat and DC starts and than the same initializer without RL, for all seeds. For example, on the 118-bus system under normal and stressed loading, it reached 2.04 and 2.86 NR iterations, compared with 3.02 and 5.13 from DC start and 2.61 and 3.09 without RL. In wall-clock time, this pays off only for an initializer integrated into the solver and reused for many solves on a fixed topology. On the 4-bus system, a quantum-enhanced RL agent with a quantum-inspired annealer moved challenging initial states that required 29 and 44 NR iterations to initializations that required three NR iterations within one RL timestep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习优化 Newton-Raphson 潮流计算的初值，并把每步 RL 动作空间的电压调整写成 QUBO 交给 Ising 机求解，以更新环境。在 4-bus、Iwamoto 11-bus 与 IEEE 118-bus 上，RL 精调的监督初始化所需 NR 迭代在所有随机种子下都少于 flat start、DC start 与不带 RL 的同一初始化器；118-bus 正常/重载下为 2.04 与 2.86 次（DC start 3.02 与 5.13，无 RL 2.61 与 3.09）。
Motivation: Newton-Raphson 依赖二次收敛，但在初值差或高可再生能源渗透等极端工况下性能退化；每步 RL 动作空间组合爆炸，难以直接搜索电压调整。
Method: 以 RL 学习 NR 初值，环境更新采用量子增强机制：把电压调整任务表述为 QUBO，用 Ising machine（quantum-inspired annealer）求解；先用监督初始化器再由 RL 精调，与 flat start、DC PF 解起点对比，在标准 4-bus、Iwamoto 病态 11-bus 与 IEEE 118-bus 的正常/重载及无功限额场景下检验，解均经校验。
Result: 所有系统上 RL 精调的监督初始化所需 NR 迭代均少于 flat、DC 起点及不带 RL 的同一初始化器，且对所有种子成立。IEEE 118-bus 正常与重载下分别为 2.04 与 2.86 次 NR 迭代，DC 起点为 3.02 与 5.13，不带 RL 为 2.61 与 3.09。墙钟时间上只有当初始化器集成进求解器并在固定拓扑上反复求解时才划算。4-bus 上量子增强 RL agent 配 quantum-inspired annealer，在一个 RL timestep 内把原本需 29 与 44 次 NR 迭代的困难初值变为只需 3 次迭代的初始化。
Conclusion: RL 加 QUBO/Ising 环境更新能显著压低 NR 迭代次数，但收益要靠固定拓扑上的多次重复求解才能在墙钟时间上兑现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: D-GAP: Improving Out-of-Domain Robustness via Dataset-Agnostic and Gradient-Guided Augmentation in Frequency and Pixel Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-domain (OOD) robustness is challenging to achieve in real-world computer vision, especially in unsupervised domain adaptation scenarios, where shifts in image background, style, and acquisition instruments often degrade model performance. Generic augmentations show inconsistent gains under such shifts, whereas dataset-specific augmentations require expert knowledge and prior analysis. Moreover, prior studies show that neural networks adapt poorly to domain shifts because they exhibit a learning bias to domain-specific frequency components. Perturbing frequency values can mitigate such bias but overlooks pixel-level details, leading to suboptimal performance. To address these limitations, we propose D-GAP, a Dataset-agnostic and Gradient-guided augmentation method for the Amplitude spectrum (in frequency space) and the Pixel values. Unlike conventional handcrafted augmentations, D-GAP computes sensitivity maps in the frequency space from task gradients, which reflect how strongly the deep models respond to different frequency components, and uses the maps to adaptively interpolate amplitudes between source and target samples. We further propose a dual-space augmentation that jointly controls spectral bias and spatial fidelity by introducing a complementary pixel-space blending branch. This way, D-GAP turns augmentation from fixed, random, or manually designed perturbation into a model-response-adaptive intervention. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed method consistently outperforms both generic and dataset-specific domain adaptation methods, improving average OOD performance by +5.3% on four real-world datasets and +1.9% on three benchmark datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/RapidsAtHKUST/D-GAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D-GAP 用任务梯度在频谱空间算敏感度图，据此在源域与目标域样本的幅度谱之间自适应插值，并加一条像素空间混合分支同时管住频谱偏置与空间细节，把数据增强从固定随机扰动变成随模型响应调整的干预。在四个真实数据集上平均 OOD 性能提升 +5.3%，三个基准数据集上 +1.9%，一致优于通用与数据集专用的域适应方法。
Motivation: 无监督域适应中背景、风格与成像仪器偏移会拉低模型性能：通用增强收益不稳定，数据集专用增强要专家先验；只扰动频率又丢掉像素级细节。
Method: D-GAP 从任务梯度在频谱空间生成敏感度图，反映模型对各频率分量的响应强度，用它在源域与目标域样本的 amplitude 之间自适应插值；再引入像素空间 blending 分支做双空间联合增强，同时控制 spectral bias 与 spatial fidelity。
Result: 在四个真实数据集上平均 OOD 性能提升 +5.3%，在三个基准数据集上提升 +1.9%，一致优于通用增强与数据集专用域适应方法；代码发布于 github.com/RapidsAtHKUST/D-GAP。
Conclusion: 把增强做成随模型梯度响应自适应的频域加像素域干预，可在无监督域适应下稳定提升跨域鲁棒性，且不依赖数据集专用的专家设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bit-Accurate Modeling of GPU Matrix Multiply-Accumulate Units: Demystifying Numerical Discrepancy and Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI accelerators rely on matrix multiply-accumulate units (MMAUs), such as NVIDIA Tensor Cores and AMD Matrix Cores, to accelerate deep neural network workloads. MMAUs expose only instruction-level or API-level interfaces of matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations, while leaving internal floating-point arithmetic behavior undocumented. Consequently, MMAUs across vendors and architectural generations often produce numerical discrepancies for identical inputs, and sometimes exhibit reduced numerical accuracy that can cause training instability. Diagnosing and understanding the root causes of these effects is challenging without white-box models of their arithmetic behavior. This paper proposes closed-loop feature probing (CLFP), a generic and systematic framework for constructing bit-accurate arithmetic behavior models of MMA operations. Based on this framework, we analyze all MMA instructions on ten GPU architectures spanning NVIDIA Volta through RTX Blackwell and AMD CDNA1 through CDNA3, and derive the first bit-accurate arithmetic models for these MMAUs. Our models explain previously observed cross-platform numerical discrepancies and accuracy issues, enable white-box numerical error analysis, reveal four types of precision bottlenecks and one type of numerical asymmetry, and inform software workarounds as well as design suggestions for future MMAUs. This work is open-source at https://github.com/microsoft/MMA-Sim
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出闭环特征探测 (CLFP)，为 GPU 矩阵乘加单元 (MMAU) 构建位精确 (bit-accurate) 算术行为白盒模型，覆盖 NVIDIA Volta 到 RTX Blackwell、AMD CDNA1 到 CDNA3 共十种 GPU 架构的全部 MMA 指令。模型解释了跨平台数值差异与精度下降（可导致训练不稳定），揭示四类精度瓶颈和一类数值不对称，并给出软件规避与未来 MMAU 设计建议。
Motivation: MMAU 只暴露指令级/API 级接口，内部浮点算术行为无文档，导致不同厂商与架构代际对相同输入产生数值差异甚至精度下降、引发训练不稳定，缺少白盒模型就难以定位根因。
Method: CLFP 框架通过闭环特征探测系统性构造 MMA 运算的位精确算术模型；基于该框架分析十种 GPU 架构上的全部 MMA 指令，推导各 MMAU 的位精确算术模型，并据此做白盒数值误差分析。
Result: 在 NVIDIA Volta 至 RTX Blackwell、AMD CDNA1 至 CDNA3 十种架构的全部 MMA 指令上得到首个位精确算术模型；模型解释了此前观察到的跨平台数值差异与精度问题，识别出四类精度瓶颈和一类数值不对称。
Conclusion: MMAU 的黑盒浮点行为可以被位精确建模，从而把跨平台数值差异归因到具体算术结构，并直接导出软件 workaround 与未来 MMAU 设计建议；代码在 github.com/microsoft/MMA-Sim 开源。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: CLFP 框架通过闭环特征探测系统性构造 MMA 运算的位精确算术模型；基于该框架分析十种 GPU 架构上的全部 MMA 指令，推导各 MMAU 的位精确算术模型，并据此做白盒数值误差分析。
summary_sections.result: 在 NVIDIA Volta 至 RTX Blackwell、AMD CDNA1 至 CDNA3 十种架构的全部 MMA 指令上得到首个位精确算术模型；模型解释了此前观察到的跨平台数值差异与精度问题，识别出四类精度瓶颈和一类数值不对称。
summary_sections.conclusion: MMAU 的黑盒浮点行为可以被位精确建模，从而把跨平台数值差异归因到具体算术结构，并直接导出软件 workaround 与未来 MMAU 设计建议；代码在 github.com/microsoft/MMA-Sim 开源。

papers.title: HAGI++: Head-Assisted Gaze Imputation and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Mobile eye-tracking is crucial for capturing human visual attention in real-world and XR settings, supporting research and human-computer interaction. Yet blinks, pupil-detection errors and lighting changes create missing values that hinder gaze analysis. We present HAGI++, a multi-modal diffusion-based imputation method that, for the first time, leverages integrated head-orientation sensors to exploit the natural correlation between head and eye movements. Using a transformer-based diffusion model, it learns cross-modal dependencies between eye and head data and can additionally incorporate wrist/hand motion when such wearable signals are available. Evaluations on the large-scale Nymeria, Ego-Exo4D and HOT3D datasets show that HAGI++ consistently outperforms traditional interpolation and deep-learning time-series imputation baselines. Statistical analysis confirms that its gaze-velocity distributions closely match real human behaviour, yielding realistic imputations. Even when 100% of gaze data are missing (pure gaze generation), HAGI++ exceeds methods that rely on the visual inputs and the methods rely on full-body motion capture by incorporating wrist motion from commercial wearables. Our approach enables more complete, accurate eye-gaze recordings in real-world contexts, enhancing gaze-based analysis and interaction across many applications. Our code is available at https://git.cai.simtech.uni-stuttgart.de/public-projects/HAGI
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG). Extended version of our UIST'25 paper, "HAGI: Head-Assisted Gaze Imputation for Mobile Eye Trackers"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HAGI++ 用基于 transformer 的多模态扩散模型，把头部朝向传感器信号引入移动眼动仪的注视缺失填补，并可在有可穿戴信号时加入手腕/手部运动。在 Nymeria、Ego-Exo4D、HOT3D 上一致优于插值与深度时序填补基线，即使 100% 注视数据缺失也能生成比依赖视觉输入或全身动捕方法更真实的注视。
Motivation: 眨眼、瞳孔检测错误和光照变化会让移动眼动仪产生注视缺失值，破坏真实世界与 XR 场景下的注意力分析；传统插值与通用时序填补没有利用头部与眼睛运动的天然相关性。
Method: HAGI++ 是多模态扩散式填补方法，用 transformer-based diffusion 学习眼动与头部朝向数据之间的跨模态依赖，可选地再接入手腕/手部运动信号；在大规模 Nymeria、Ego-Exo4D、HOT3D 数据集上评测。
Result: 在 Nymeria、Ego-Exo4D、HOT3D 上一致优于传统插值与深度学习时序填补基线；统计分析显示其填补结果的注视速度分布与真实人类行为高度吻合；即使 100% 注视数据缺失（纯注视生成），也超过依赖视觉输入的方法以及依赖全身动作捕捉的方法，后者仅用商用可穿戴设备的手腕运动实现。
Conclusion: 把头部朝向（以及可得的手腕运动）作为跨模态条件输入扩散模型，可以在真实场景中补全甚至完全生成注视数据，使注视记录更完整准确。

papers.title: Disciplined Biconvex Programming
papers.abstract_en: We introduce disciplined biconvex programming (DBCP), a modeling framework for specifying and solving biconvex optimization problems. Biconvex optimization problems arise in various applications, including machine learning, signal processing, computational science, and control. Solving a biconvex optimization problem in practice usually involves heuristic methods based on alternate convex search (ACS), which iteratively optimizes over one block of variables while keeping the other fixed, so that the resulting subproblems are convex and can be efficiently solved. However, designing and implementing an ACS solver for a specific biconvex optimization problem usually requires significant effort from the user, which can be tedious and error-prone. DBCP extends the principles of disciplined convex programming to biconvex problems, allowing users to specify biconvex optimization problems in a natural way based on a small number of syntax rules. The resulting problem can then be automatically split and transformed into convex subproblems, for which a customized ACS solver is then generated and applied. DBCP allows users to quickly experiment with different biconvex problem formulations, without expertise in convex optimization. We implement DBCP in the open-source Python package dbcp, as an extension to the well known domain specific language CVXPY for convex optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 disciplined biconvex programming (DBCP)：把 disciplined convex programming 的建模原则推广到双凸问题，用户按少量语法规则自然地写出问题，框架自动拆分并转化为凸子问题，再生成定制的 alternate convex search (ACS) 求解器。以开源 Python 包 dbcp 实现，作为 CVXPY 的扩展，使非凸优化专家也能快速试验不同双凸建模形式。
Motivation: 双凸问题在机器学习、信号处理、计算科学与控制中常见，但实践中多依赖 ACS 启发式求解，针对具体问题手工设计并实现 ACS 求解器工作量大且易出错。
Method: DBCP 沿用 disciplined convex programming 的少量语法规则让用户声明双凸问题，随后自动把问题拆分并变换为凸子问题，据此生成定制 ACS 求解器并迭代求解；实现为 CVXPY 的扩展包 dbcp（开源 Python）。
Result: 提出 DBCP 建模框架与开源 Python 包 dbcp，作为 CVXPY 的扩展，可自动将用户按语法规则写出的双凸问题拆成凸子问题并生成定制 ACS 求解器，使用户无需凸优化专业知识即可快速试验不同双凸问题建模形式。
Conclusion: 双凸建模可以像凸优化那样靠少量语法规则和编译式流程完成，把 ACS 求解器的设计与实现从用户侧移到框架侧。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Survey on Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) represent a significant frontier in embodied intelligence, aiming to bridge digital knowledge with physical-world interaction. Despite their remarkable performance, foundational VLAs are hindered by the prohibitive computational and data demands inherent to their large-scale architectures. To this end, recent studies improve VLA efficiency from different views, e.g., real-time inference, training computation, and scalable data collection. However, these efforts are mostly studied separately. A unified view is still missing for understanding how efficiency should be optimized across the full VLA lifecycle. To bridge this gap, this survey presents the first comprehensive review of Efficient Vision-Language-Action models (Efficient VLAs) across the entire model-training-data pipeline. Specifically, we introduce a unified taxonomy to systematically organize the disparate efforts in this domain, categorizing current techniques into three core pillars: (1) Efficient Model Design, focusing on efficient architectures and model compression; (2) Efficient Training, which reduces computational burdens during model learning; and (3) Efficient Data Collection, which addresses the bottlenecks in acquiring and utilizing robotic data. Through a critical review of state-of-the-art methods within this framework, this survey provides an organized reference for the community and summarizes representative applications, delineates key challenges, and charts a roadmap for future research. We maintain a continuously updated project page to track our latest developments: https://evla-survey.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). 20 pages, 8 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于高效视觉-语言-动作模型 (Efficient VLA) 的综述，把机器人 VLA 在推理、训练、数据采集三方面的效率工作统一到模型-训练-数据全生命周期框架下，按高效模型设计、高效训练、高效数据采集三大支柱组织现有方法，并给出挑战与后续研究路线图。
Motivation: VLA 基础模型性能强但受大规模架构带来的高昂算力与数据成本制约，而现有效率改进分散在实时推理、训练计算、数据采集等不同视角，缺少跨全生命周期统一优化效率的视角。
Method: 提出覆盖模型-训练-数据全流水线的统一分类法：高效模型设计（架构设计与模型压缩）、高效训练（降低学习阶段算力开销）、高效数据采集（解决机器人数据获取与利用瓶颈），并在该框架下批判性梳理 SOTA 方法、代表性应用与关键挑战。
Result: 综述性工作，给出三大支柱分类体系与覆盖全生命周期的高效 VLA 方法梳理，并总结代表性应用、关键挑战和未来研究路线图；配套持续更新的项目页 evla-survey.github.io。
Conclusion: 效率优化应贯穿 VLA 的模型、训练、数据整个生命周期统一考虑，而非各自独立推进；该综述为社区提供组织化的参考框架。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Managing Self-Learning Experts under Per-Round Budget Constraints
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of sequential decision-making under learning budget constraints. Such settings naturally arise in applications like managing a portfolio of bandit or reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms. We propose a novel UCB-type algorithm, M-LCB, designed to manage a pool of $K$ self-learning experts in a stochastic environment while accounting for a limited per-round learning budget $M$. At each round, M-LCB selects one expert to make a decision and at most $M \le K$ experts to learn. For selection, M-LCB uses confidence bounds constructed from limited prior knowledge about the experts (i.e., mild assumptions) and their observed training losses. We derive anytime regret bounds for M-LCB that scale with the individual regrets of the experts. In particular, if each expert has regret $\tilde O(T^α)$ by round $T$, then M-LCB guarantees an overall regret of $\tilde O\left(\sqrt{KT/M} + (K/M)^{1-α}T^α\right)$ relative to the best expert in hindsight. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of M-LCB using self-learning experts instantiated as (i) parametric models and (ii) bandit algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UCB 型算法 M-LCB，在每轮学习预算 M ≤ K 的约束下管理 K 个自学习专家：每轮用基于先验弱假设与观测训练损失构造的置信界选一个专家做决策、最多更新 M 个专家。若每个专家到 T 轮的 regret 为 Õ(T^α)，M-LCB 相对事后最优专家的总 regret 保证为 Õ(√(KT/M) + (K/M)^{1−α}T^α)，并以参数化模型与 bandit 算法两类自学习专家演示适用性。
Motivation: 把一组 bandit 或强化学习算法作为投资组合来管理时，每轮可用于训练的算力或样本有限，需要在预算约束下决定选谁决策、更新谁，同时只依赖对专家的温和假设。
Method: M-LCB 是 UCB 型算法：每轮依据由有限先验知识（温和假设）与专家观测训练损失构造的置信界，选择一个专家做决策，并选择至多 M ≤ K 个专家进行学习；推导 anytime regret 界，使其随各专家自身 regret 缩放。
Result: 若每个专家到第 T 轮的 regret 为 Õ(T^α)，M-LCB 相对事后最优专家的总 regret 为 Õ(√(KT/M) + (K/M)^{1−α}T^α)；适用性以两类自学习专家演示：参数化模型与 bandit 算法。
Conclusion: 在每轮学习预算受限时，用置信界同时调度决策与学习对象，可以把总 regret 控制在由预算比 M/K 与专家自身 regret 阶 α 共同决定的界内。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Theoretical Refinement of CLIP by Utilizing Linear Structure of Optimal Similarity
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we propose an enhancement to the similarity computation mechanism in multimodal contrastive pretraining frameworks such as CLIP. Prior theoretical research has demonstrated that the optimal similarity metrics between paired modalities should correspond to the pointwise mutual information (PMI) between the two modalities. However, the current implementations of CLIP and its variants fail to fully utilize the underlying linear structure of PMI. We therefore propose KME-CLIP, which leverages this structure through the inner product in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). We theoretically prove that, under our assumptions, the KME-CLIP similarity can bring the contrastive loss arbitrarily close to its optimal value, which is attained by PMI, as the size of the point set grows, and we empirically evaluate KME-CLIP against CLIP and its kernel-based variants across several retrieval and classification tasks.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KME-CLIP：用再生核 Hilbert 空间 (RKHS) 内积实现最优相似度应为逐点互信息 (PMI) 这一线性结构，理论上证明在给定假设下随点集增大对比损失可任意逼近 PMI 达到的最优值，并在多个检索与分类任务上对比 CLIP 及其核方法变体。
Motivation: 既有理论指出多模态对比预训练的最优相似度应等于两模态间的 PMI，但 CLIP 及其变体的相似度实现未能利用 PMI 底层的线性结构，导致对比损失与理论最优存在差距。
Method: KME-CLIP 将相似度计算改写为 RKHS 中的内积形式，从而显式利用 PMI 的线性结构；在给定假设下给出对比损失随点集规模收敛到 PMI 最优值的理论证明，并以 CLIP 及核方法变体为对照做实证评估。
Result: 理论上证明 KME-CLIP 相似度可使对比损失随点集增大任意接近 PMI 所达的最优值；实证上在若干检索 (retrieval) 与分类 (classification) 任务上与 CLIP 及其 kernel-based 变体比较。
Conclusion: 把 PMI 的线性结构经 RKHS 内积显式嵌入相似度计算，可在理论极限上把对比损失推到 PMI 最优，并在检索与分类任务上给出经验证据。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 KME-CLIP：用再生核 Hilbert 空间 (RKHS) 内积实现最优相似度应为逐点互信息 (PMI) 这一线性结构，理论上证明在给定假设下随点集增大对比损失可任意逼近 PMI 达到的最优值，并在多个检索与分类任务上对比 CLIP 及其核方法变体。
summary_sections.motivation: 既有理论指出多模态对比预训练的最优相似度应等于两模态间的 PMI，但 CLIP 及其变体的相似度实现未能利用 PMI 底层的线性结构，导致对比损失与理论最优存在差距。
summary_sections.method: KME-CLIP 将相似度计算改写为 RKHS 中的内积形式，从而显式利用 PMI 的线性结构；在给定假设下给出对比损失随点集规模收敛到 PMI 最优值的理论证明，并以 CLIP 及核方法变体为对照做实证评估。
summary_sections.result: 理论上证明 KME-CLIP 相似度可使对比损失随点集增大任意接近 PMI 所达的最优值；实证上在若干检索 (retrieval) 与分类 (classification) 任务上与 CLIP 及其 kernel-based 变体比较。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 PMI 的线性结构经 RKHS 内积显式嵌入相似度计算，可在理论极限上把对比损失推到 PMI 最优，并在检索与分类任务上给出经验证据。

papers.title: Scaling Vision Transformers for Functional MRI with Flat Maps
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of training self-supervised foundation models for functional MRI. Our main contributions are: (1) we introduce a new model family (CortexMAE) trained using the masked autoencoder framework on 2.1K hours of open fMRI data, and (2) we release the first open evaluation suite (Brainmarks) for fMRI foundation models. Our core innovation is simple: we adapt the Vision Transformer to fMRI by first converting each 3D fMRI volume to a 2D map using a cortical flat map projection. We directly compare flat maps to both parcellation and volume-based representations. While each has its advantages, flat maps generally perform best. We perform the first systematic scaling analysis for fMRI and observe strict power law scaling, albeit with limits. Finally, we use Brainmarks to do controlled benchmark comparisons. On subject-level trait prediction, we report a challenging null result: no single model achieves clear state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, all models struggle to outperform a simple functional connectivity baseline. On cognitive state decoding, we observe more robust performance, and in this setting our CortexMAE family outperforms prior models by a large margin. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/MedARC-AI/CortexMAE and https://github.com/MedARC-AI/Brainmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 3D fMRI 体积经皮层平坦图 (cortical flat map) 投影成 2D 图后直接套 Vision Transformer，用 masked autoencoder 在 2.1K 小时开放 fMRI 上训练 CortexMAE 模型族，并发布首个开放评测套件 Brainmarks。平坦图表示总体优于 parcellation 与 volume 表示，fMRI 预训练呈严格幂律 scaling；但被试级特质预测上没有模型明显 SOTA、全部难敌简单功能连接基线，认知状态解码上 CortexMAE 大幅超越既有模型。
Motivation: fMRI 缺少自监督基础模型与统一评测基准，且 3D 体积数据难以直接复用视觉骨干；特质预测等下游任务上各模型孰优孰劣一直没有受控比较。
Method: CortexMAE：将每个 3D fMRI 体积用皮层平坦图投影转为 2D map，再以 masked autoencoder 框架训练 Vision Transformer，语料为 2.1K 小时开放 fMRI；同时直接对比 flat map、parcellation、volume 三种表示，并做 fMRI 上首个系统性 scaling 分析；评测用新发布的 Brainmarks 做受控基准比较。
Result: 三种表示中 flat map 总体表现最佳；fMRI scaling 呈严格幂律但存在上限。Brainmarks 上被试级特质预测为挑战性 null result：无单一模型取得明显 SOTA，且所有模型都难以超过简单功能连接基线；认知状态解码上 CortexMAE 模型族大幅超越先前模型。
Conclusion: 平坦图是把 Vision Transformer 迁移到 fMRI 的有效表示并随规模幂律提升，但特质预测的天花板由功能连接基线决定，认知状态解码才是当前基础模型优势明显的任务。

papers.title: NOSA: Native and Offloadable Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Decoding throughput improvements from larger inference batches are limited by GPU memory, which is largely consumed by the key-value (KV) cache. Prior training-free KV cache offloading alleviates this by keeping redundant context on the CPU and fetching only a sparse subset for attention, but it often degrades long-generation quality due to training-inference mismatch on sparse patterns. Meanwhile, trainable sparse attention is incompatible with efficient offloading, as unconstrained KV accesses may force large CPU-to-GPU transfers and erase throughput gains. To this end, we propose NOSA, a trainable sparse attention mechanism natively designed for KV cache offloading. NOSA explicitly constrains the volume of CPU-GPU KV transfers, thereby achieving low communication overhead and high decoding throughput. We further build NOSI, a KV cache offloading inference system that fully unlocks NOSA's efficiency. Empirical results on 1,3,8B LLMs demonstrate that NOSA outperforms KV cache offloading baselines on general, long-input, and long-generation tasks, while boosting decoding throughput by up to 5.04x, 1.92x, and 1.83x over FullAttn, InfLLMv2, and ShadowKV, respectively. We release our code at https://github.com/thunlp/NOSA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NOSA 是一种为 KV cache 卸载 (offloading) 原生设计的可训练稀疏注意力机制，显式约束 CPU-GPU 之间的 KV 传输量，从而同时保住低通信开销与高解码吞吐；配套的 NOSI 推理系统进一步释放其效率。在 1/3/8B LLM 上，相对 FullAttn、InfLLMv2、ShadowKV 解码吞吐最高提升 5.04×、1.92×、1.83×。
Motivation: 大 batch 解码吞吐受 GPU 显存限制，而显存主要被 KV cache 占用；已有免训练卸载方案因稀疏模式的训练-推理失配损害长生成质量，可训练稀疏注意力又会因无约束的 KV 访问触发大量 CPU-GPU 传输、抵消吞吐收益。
Method: 提出可训练稀疏注意力 NOSA，训练时显式约束 CPU-GPU KV 传输体积，使稀疏访问模式与卸载的传输预算兼容；并构建推理系统 NOSI 来充分发挥 NOSA 的效率，代码已开源。
Result: 在 1/3/8B LLM 的通用、长输入、长生成任务上，NOSA 优于 KV cache 卸载基线；解码吞吐相对 FullAttn 最高提升 5.04×，相对 InfLLMv2 提升 1.92×，相对 ShadowKV 提升 1.83×。
Conclusion: 把传输量约束直接放进稀疏注意力的训练目标，可以让可训练稀疏注意力与 KV cache 卸载共存，兼得生成质量与解码吞吐。

papers.title: Large Language Model Selection with Limited Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Choosing a Large Language Model (LLM) for a given task requires comparing many strong candidates, yet standard evaluation relies on costly annotations over fixed evaluation sets. To address this challenge, we develop SELECT-LLM, the first framework for active model selection of LLMs. SELECT-LLM aims to find a small set of queries whose annotations are most informative for identifying the best LLM for a given task. To this end, we introduce a query selection rule based on expected information gain, computed from pairwise similarities between candidate model outputs. Because this rule only uses generated model responses, SELECT-LLM can be applied across candidate models without assumptions about their architecture or access to model weights. This makes it suitable for both open-weight and black-box LLMs. We evaluate SELECT-LLM across 23 datasets, 156 evaluated models, diverse task families, and multiple text evaluation metrics. Across all experiments, SELECT-LLM improves over the strongest baseline in every setting, with annotation cost reductions up to 81.8% for best model selection and up to 84.78% for near-best model selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SELECT-LLM 是首个面向 LLM 主动模型选择 (active model selection) 的框架：用候选模型输出之间的两两相似度计算期望信息增益，挑出标注信息量最大的少量查询，从而少标注就能选出该任务上最好的 LLM。在 23 个数据集、156 个候选模型上，它在每一种设置中都优于最强基线，最佳模型选择的标注成本最多降低 81.8%，近最佳模型选择最多降低 84.78%。
Motivation: 为给定任务挑选 LLM 需要比较大量强候选，而标准评测依赖对固定评测集的昂贵人工标注，标注成本随候选模型数量放大。
Method: 基于期望信息增益 (expected information gain) 设计查询选择规则，信息增益由候选模型输出的两两相似度计算得到；因为只用生成的模型响应，该规则不依赖模型架构或权重访问，可同时用于开源权重与黑盒 LLM。评测覆盖 23 个数据集、156 个被评模型、多类任务族与多种文本评测指标。
Result: 在全部实验中，SELECT-LLM 在每种设置下都优于最强基线：最佳模型选择的标注成本最多减少 81.8%，近最佳模型选择最多减少 84.78%；评测规模为 23 个数据集、156 个模型、多任务族与多种文本评测指标。
Conclusion: 只靠模型输出相似度驱动的主动查询选择，就能在不接触权重的前提下大幅压缩选出最佳或近最佳 LLM 所需的标注量，对黑盒模型同样适用。

papers.title: Systematic Exploration of Multi-core Architectures for Efficient LLM Serving using WaferAI-SIM
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), the demand for high-performance LLM inference services continues to grow. Multi-core AI accelerators, such as Groq, Graphcore IPU, and Cerebras WSE, provide promising platforms for LLM serving, but their distributed memory systems require careful coordination between hardware configuration and serving policies. Otherwise, mismatched tensor partitioning, data placement, and memory management can substantially underutilize compute and communication resources. To address these challenges, we present WaferAI-SIM, a multi-level simulation framework that combines transaction-level simulation with an analytical performance model. WaferAI-SIM enables simulator-driven co-design of LLM serving strategies and multi-core accelerator architectures, targeting the early design stage in which emerging platforms are not yet broadly available for empirical serving studies. It captures how LLM serving policies interact with compute-core count, memory hierarchy, and interconnect topology, enabling architecture-aware exploration beyond GPU-centric assumptions. We evaluate representative LLMs across a range of chip configurations and serving scenarios. Across the evaluation, WaferAI-SIM reports 1.32$\times$--6.03$\times$ latency improvements, where the lower endpoint comes from ring-based placement at TP=16 over the placement baselines, and the upper endpoint comes from K-dimension TP over MN-dimension TP for Qwen3\_4B at TP=4 with sequence length 256. For LLM serving, our findings provide guidance for co-designing hardware architectures and serving strategies for multi-core AI accelerators across diverse LLM workloads.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多层仿真框架 WaferAI-SIM，把事务级仿真与解析性能模型结合，用于在硬件尚未量产的早期设计阶段做 LLM 服务策略与多核 AI 加速器架构的协同探索。评测显示 1.32×–6.03× 延迟改善：下限来自 TP=16 的 ring-based placement 对比 placement 基线，上限来自 Qwen3_4B 在 TP=4、序列长度 256 下 K 维 TP 相对 MN 维 TP。
Motivation: Groq、Graphcore IPU、Cerebras WSE 等多核加速器的分布式存储要求张量切分、数据放置与存储管理协同，配置失配会大幅浪费算力与通信；而新兴平台尚无法广泛开展实测服务研究，缺少架构感知的早期探索手段。
Method: WaferAI-SIM 为多层仿真框架，结合事务级仿真 (transaction-level simulation) 与解析性能模型，刻画服务策略与计算核数、存储层次、互连拓扑的交互；在多种芯片配置与服务场景下评测代表性 LLM。
Result: 评测报告 1.32×–6.03× 延迟改善：下限为 TP=16 下 ring-based placement 相对 placement 基线，上限为 Qwen3_4B 在 TP=4、序列长度 256 时 K 维 TP 相对 MN 维 TP。
Conclusion: 在平台尚不可实测的早期设计阶段，仿真驱动的协同设计可以给出跨多样 LLM 负载的硬件架构与服务策略搭配指导，且结论应按 TP 维度与放置策略分别判断。

papers.title: Demystifying MaskGIT Sampler and Beyond: Adaptive Order Selection in Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models have shown promising performance in generating high-quality samples in a wide range of domains, but accelerating their sampling process remains relatively underexplored. To investigate efficient samplers for masked diffusion, this paper theoretically analyzes the MaskGIT sampler for image modeling, revealing its implicit temperature sampling mechanism. Through this analysis, we show that MaskGIT is asymptotically equivalent to a choose-then-sample (CTS) formulation, instantiated as the "moment sampler," which explicitly separates index selection from token sampling. This CTS reformulation is essential: it yields unbiased token sampling and exposes an algorithmic design space for index selection, both of which are inaccessible in MaskGIT's original formulation. Regarding token sampling, we reveal that MaskGIT implicitly adopts a low-temperature sampler, which explains why MaskGIT often degrades with more sampling steps. The CTS reformulation of MaskGIT allows us to fix the temperature sampling to ensure unbiasedness. We also improve the index selection in CTS through two key innovations: a partial caching technique for transformers that approximates longer sampling trajectories without proportional computational cost, and a hybrid approach formalizing the exploration-exploitation trade-off in adaptive unmasking. Experiments in image and text domains demonstrate our theory as well as the efficiency of our proposed methods, advancing both theoretical understanding and practical implementation of masked diffusion samplers.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 MaskGIT 采样器做理论分析，揭示其隐式低温温度采样机制，并证明其渐近等价于 choose-then-sample (CTS) 形式的 moment sampler，把索引选择与 token 采样显式分离。CTS 修正温度采样以保证无偏 token 采样，再用 partial caching 与探索-利用混合的自适应 unmasking 改进索引选择；图像与文本实验验证理论并显示所提方法的效率。
Motivation: Masked diffusion 的采样加速研究较少，且 MaskGIT 的隐式低温采样导致增加采样步数时性能反而下降，其索引选择与 token 采样耦合的设计空间难以触及。
Method: 理论上分析 MaskGIT 的隐式温度采样，证明其渐近等价于 choose-then-sample (CTS) 的 moment sampler，将索引选择与 token 采样解耦；修正温度采样以保证无偏性，并提出两项索引选择改进：近似更长采样轨迹的 partial caching 技术，以及形式化探索-利用权衡的混合自适应 unmasking 方法。
Result: 揭示 MaskGIT 隐式采用低温采样器，可解释其随采样步数增加而性能退化；CTS 重构给出无偏 token 采样与索引选择的设计空间；在图像与文本域实验中验证了理论并展示了所提方法的效率。
Conclusion: 把 MaskGIT 重构为 CTS 形式是同时获得无偏采样与可设计索引选择的关键，修正温度并改进索引选择可提升 masked diffusion 采样的效率与理论理解。

papers.title: Kairos: Toward Adaptive and Parameter-Efficient Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Inherent temporal heterogeneity, such as varying sampling densities and periodic structures, has posed substantial challenges in zero-shot generalization for Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs). Existing TSFMs predominantly rely on massive parameterization to absorb such heterogeneity, as their static tokenization and positional encoding schemes entangle diverse temporal patterns into a fixed representation space, encouraging memorization rather than adaptation. To address this limitation, we propose Kairos, a flexible and parameter-efficient TSFM dedicated to forecasting tasks, which decouples temporal heterogeneity from model capacity through a novel tokenization perspective. Kairos introduces a dynamic patching tokenizer and a mixture-of-size encoding that adapt observational granularity to local information density, enabling fine-grained temporal abstraction without increasing model width or depth. In addition, we design a multi-granularity positional embedding based on dynamic rotary encodings, which conditions on instance-level spectral features and temporal structure induced by dynamic patching tokenization, allowing robust modeling of diverse temporal dependencies. Trained on a novel Predictability-Stratified Time-Series (PreSTS) corpus, Kairos achieves superior zero-shot performance with substantially fewer parameters on two mainstream benchmarks, GIFT-Eval and Time-Series-Library. The project page is at https://foundation-model-research.github.io/Kairos .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kairos 用动态 patching tokenizer 与 mixture-of-size 编码把时间异质性（采样密度、周期结构）从模型容量中解耦，使观测粒度自适应局部信息密度，并配合基于 dynamic rotary 的多粒度位置编码，在不加宽加深的前提下做零样本预报。在 PreSTS 语料上训练后，于 GIFT-Eval 与 Time-Series-Library 两个基准以显著更少的参数取得更优零样本性能。
Motivation: 现有 TSFM 靠堆参数吸收时间异质性，静态 tokenization 与位置编码把多样时序模式纠缠进固定表示空间，导致记忆而非适应，零样本泛化受限。
Method: 提出 Kairos：动态 patching tokenizer 按局部信息密度自适应观测粒度，mixture-of-size 编码做细粒度时序抽象而不增宽深；多粒度位置编码基于 dynamic rotary，条件于实例级谱特征与动态 patch 引入的时序结构；在 Predictability-Stratified Time-Series (PreSTS) 语料上训练。
Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 与 Time-Series-Library 两个主流基准上，以 substantially fewer parameters 取得 superior zero-shot performance（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把时间异质性与模型容量解耦、用自适应粒度 tokenization 替代堆参数，可在更少参数下提升 TSFM 的零样本预报能力。
