papers.title: Quantifying How Training Gradient Sparsity Affect Spiking Neural Network Accuracy And Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have recently received increasing attention in both computational neuroscience and artificial intelligence owing to their potential for energy-efficient computation and reduced memory requirements. Despite these advantages, improving adversarial robustness in SNNs (particularly for vision-based applications) remains an emerging and relatively underexplored research problem. Recent work has suggested that encouraging sparse gradients can act as a regularization mechanism to improve resistance against adversarial perturbations. In this study, we report an unexpected observation: under certain architectural configurations, SNNs inherently exhibit sparse gradients and can attain state-of-the-art adversarial defense performance without requiring any explicit regularization strategy. Further investigation reveals an inherent trade-off between robustness and generalization. Specifically, increased gradient sparsity enhances resistance to adversarial attacks but may reduce the model's generalization capability, whereas denser gradients tend to improve generalization while simultaneously increasing susceptibility to adversarial perturbations. These findings provide new perspectives on the role of gradient sparsity in the training dynamics of SNNs.
papers.journal_ref: Procedia Computer Science, 289, 117-126 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文报告：在某些架构配置下，脉冲神经网络 (SNN) 训练时梯度天然稀疏，无需显式稀疏正则即可达到 SOTA 级对抗防御性能；梯度越稀疏，对抗攻击抵抗力越强但泛化能力下降，梯度越密则泛化更好而更易受对抗扰动。
Motivation: SNN 具备低能耗与低存储优势，但视觉任务上的对抗鲁棒性研究仍不充分；已有工作靠显式稀疏梯度正则提升抗扰动能力，本文关注 SNN 训练动力学中梯度稀疏性与鲁棒性、泛化之间的关系。
Method: 在若干 SNN 架构配置下考察训练梯度的稀疏程度，对比是否需要显式稀疏正则，并分析梯度稀疏性与对抗防御、泛化能力之间的权衡。
Result: 在特定架构配置下 SNN 内在呈现稀疏梯度，且无需任何显式正则化策略即可达到 state-of-the-art 的对抗防御表现；梯度稀疏度升高增强对抗攻击抵抗力但可能降低泛化能力，更密的梯度提升泛化同时增加对对抗扰动的易感性。
Conclusion: 梯度稀疏性是 SNN 训练动力学中鲁棒性与泛化之间权衡的内在调节量：稀疏换鲁棒、稠密换泛化，无需外部正则即可触发。

papers.title: Graph Your Own Prompt
papers.abstract_en: We propose Graph Consistency Regularization (GCR), a novel framework that injects relational graph structures, derived from model predictions, into the learning process to promote class-aware, semantically meaningful feature representations. Functioning as a form of self-prompting, GCR enables the model to refine its internal structure using its own outputs. While deep networks learn rich representations, these often capture noisy inter-class similarities that contradict the model's predicted semantics. GCR addresses this issue by introducing parameter-free Graph Consistency Layers (GCLs) at arbitrary depths. Each GCL builds a batch-level feature similarity graph and aligns it with a global, class-aware masked prediction graph, derived by modulating softmax prediction similarities with intra-class indicators. This alignment enforces that feature-level relationships reflect class-consistent prediction behavior, acting as a semantic regularizer throughout the network. Unlike prior work, GCR introduces a multi-layer, cross-space graph alignment mechanism with adaptive weighting, where layer importance is learned from graph discrepancy magnitudes. This allows the model to prioritize semantically reliable layers and suppress noisy ones, enhancing feature quality without modifying the architecture or training procedure. GCR is model-agnostic, lightweight, and improves semantic structure across various networks and datasets. Experiments show that GCR promotes cleaner feature structure, stronger intra-class cohesion, and improved generalization, offering a new perspective on learning from prediction structure. [Project website](https://darcyddx.github.io/gcr/) [Code](https://github.com/Darcyddx/graph-prompt)
papers.comment: Some reported results were incorrect. The paper is withdrawn until the affected results can be corrected. The manuscript was not accepted for publication at NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Graph Consistency Regularization (GCR)，把模型自身预测构成的类感知图作为自提示信号，用无参数的 Graph Consistency Layer (GCL) 在任意深度对齐批级特征相似图与掩码预测图，并按图差异幅度自适应加权多层跨空间对齐。摘要称其在多种网络与数据集上改善特征结构、类内凝聚与泛化，但论文已因部分结果有误被撤回。
Motivation: 深度网络学到的表征常带有噪声的类间相似性，与模型自身预测语义相矛盾，需要在不改架构与训练流程的前提下约束特征关系。
Method: 在任意深度插入参数无关的 GCL：构建批级特征相似图，与由 softmax 预测相似度经类内指示调制得到的全局类感知掩码预测图对齐；多层跨空间图对齐带自适应权重，层权重由图差异幅度学习得到，不修改网络架构或训练流程。
Result: 实验显示 GCR 产生更干净的特征结构、更强的类内凝聚与更好的泛化，跨多种网络与数据集均改善语义结构；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 从预测结构中学习可以作为语义正则化提升表征质量，且模型无关、开销轻；但该版本因部分报告结果有误已撤回，NeurIPS 2025 未被接收。

papers.title: WirelessMathBench-XL: An Auditable Benchmark for Wireless Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Technical-domain benchmarks constructed from arXiv papers can overlap the same public text used in LLM pretraining. Auditing this risk at training-corpus scale requires searching billions of corpus n-grams while retaining per-item evidence that users can inspect and recompute. We contribute a reverse-probe audit at a fixed 13-gram threshold: it indexes benchmark prompts, streams public pretraining corpora, and emits per-problem prompt-surface lexical-overlap metadata with memory that scales with the benchmark. We instantiate the protocol in WirelessMathBench-XL, a 4,027-problem wireless mathematical-reasoning benchmark built from 836 retained arXiv papers across 20 subfields. Against 12.9B streamed 13-grams from RedPajama-arXiv, the audit identifies a strict zero-hit view S0 covering 3,853 problems (95.7%). Filtering to S0 changes accuracy by less than 1 pp for every evaluated model; frontier calibration rows form one high-accuracy cluster between 86.5% and 91.3%, not a resolved rank order. Only 30/800 test items carry detected overlap. Under an all-flagged-correct counterfactual, their largest possible positive score inflation is 0.31-0.51 pp for the frontier rows, so full-versus-S0 is a bounded, structurally underpowered stability summary rather than a contamination-effect test or cleanliness claim. The audit channel does not cover paraphrase, target-answer, post-training, or closed-corpus exposure. The release includes source-paper identifiers, verifier-facing ground truths, audit and threshold metadata, filtered views, a paper-disjoint sensitivity view, evaluation traces, paired-bootstrap scripts, training recipes, Croissant metadata, and a Datasheet for Datasets.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://lixin.ai/WirelessMathBench-XL/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WirelessMathBench-XL 是一个 4,027 题的无线通信数学推理基准，配套提出固定 13-gram 阈值的反向探针审计 (reverse-probe audit)：索引基准 prompt、流式扫描公开预训练语料，输出可逐题复算的词面重叠证据。对 RedPajama-arXiv 流式的 12.9B 个 13-gram 中，95.7%（3,853 题）落在严格零命中视图 S0，过滤到 S0 使所有被评模型准确率变化不足 1 pp；被标记的 30/800 测试项在全对反事实下最多抬升前沿模型 0.31–0.51 pp，因此全量与 S0 之差只是有界、结构性欠功效的稳定性摘要，不构成污染效应检验或清洁性声明。
Motivation: 从 arXiv 论文构造的技术基准可能与 LLM 预训练所用的同一批公开文本重叠，而在数十亿 n-gram 规模上审计这一风险，同时保留用户可检查、可重算的逐题证据，是现有基准难以做到的。
Method: 提出固定 13-gram 阈值的反向探针审计：先索引基准 prompt，再流式扫描公开预训练语料（RedPajama-arXiv），逐题输出 prompt 表面词面重叠元数据，内存随基准规模而非语料规模增长。将协议实例化为 WirelessMathBench-XL，含 4,027 道题、来自 20 个子领域的 836 篇保留 arXiv 论文，并发布源论文标识、verifier 用 ground truth、审计与阈值元数据、过滤视图、paper-disjoint 敏感性视图、评测轨迹、paired-bootstrap 脚本、训练配方、Croissant 元数据与 Datasheet for Datasets。
Result: 对 12.9B 个流式 13-gram 的审计得到严格零命中视图 S0 覆盖 3,853 题（95.7%）；过滤到 S0 后每个被评模型准确率变化小于 1 pp。前沿模型校准行聚成一个高准确率簇，区间 86.5%–91.3%，未形成可分辨的排名。800 个测试项中仅 30 项被检出重叠，在全对反事实下其对前沿行的最大可能正向分数膨胀为 0.31–0.51 pp。
Conclusion: 该基准在词面污染维度上高度干净，全量与 S0 的差异是有界且结构性欠功效的稳定性摘要，不能当作污染效应检验或清洁性声明；审计通道不覆盖改写、目标答案、后训练与封闭语料暴露。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One Model, Many Morals: Uncovering Cross-Linguistic Misalignments in Computational Moral Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across multilingual and multicultural settings, yet it remains unclear whether changing language leads models to adopt community-specific moral reasoning or merely changes how shared learned abstractions are expressed. We conduct a controlled multilingual evaluation across six geographically, culturally, and linguistically diverse languages (Arabic, Chinese, English, Hindi, Russian, and Spanish), using parallel moral reasoning benchmarks with English-origin, Chinese-origin, and natively elicited ground-truth judgments. Across 13 open-weight LLMs spanning 2B-70B parameters, we find substantial cross-lingual divergence in moral judgments, with English generally achieving the highest performance even when ground-truth judgments originate in Chinese or are collected natively in each language. Yet the reasoning underlying these divergent judgments is considerably more convergent: Utilitarianism dominates in five of six languages, reasoning follows broadly shared stages, and language-specific moral-value associations correspond only sparsely and inconsistently to values measured in the corresponding human communities. Finally, a large-scale OLMoTrace analysis of pretraining data sources reveals little direct reproduction of training text across languages, while the corpus composition, training stage, and cultural provenance of retrieved training evidence vary substantially by response language. Thus, similar moral reasoning structures emerge even from heterogeneous and often linguistically localized training evidence. Our findings, collectively, reveal a central disconnect in multilingual moral reasoning: language changes models' moral judgments and the training evidence associated with their reasoning, but does not correspondingly localize the moral abstractions they apply.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 6 种语言（阿拉伯语、中文、英语、 Hindi、俄语、西班牙语）的平行道德推理基准做受控评测，发现 13 个 2B–70B 开源 LLM 的道德判断随语言显著漂移，英语即便在中文来源或本地采集的 ground truth 上也通常得分最高；但底层推理结构高度收敛——功利主义 (Utilitarianism) 在 6 种语言中的 5 种占主导，语言特有的道德价值关联与对应人类社群实测价值仅稀疏且不一致地对应。OLMoTrace 追溯预训练语料显示跨语言几乎无直接文本复现，训练证据的语料构成与文化来源却随回答语言大幅变化：语言改变判断与证据，不改变所套用的道德抽象。
Motivation: LLM 部署到多语言多文化场景时，不清楚换语言是让模型采纳社群特有的道德推理，还是只改变了共享抽象的表达方式；这直接关系到跨语言道德对齐的可信度。
Method: 构建含英文来源、中文来源与各语言本地采集 ground truth 的平行道德推理基准，在 6 种地理文化语言上对 13 个 2B–70B 开源 LLM 做受控多语言评测；再用 OLMoTrace 追溯预训练数据来源，比对回答语言与检索到的训练证据的语料构成、训练阶段和文化来源。
Result: 跨语言道德判断出现大幅分歧，英语在三种 ground truth 来源下通常都取得最高性能；推理层面则收敛——功利主义在 6 种语言中的 5 种占主导，推理遵循大体一致的阶段，语言特有价值关联与人类社群实测价值仅稀疏且不一致地对应。OLMoTrace 显示跨语言几乎无训练文本的直接复现，但检索到的训练证据在语料构成、训练阶段与文化来源上随回答语言显著变化。
Conclusion: 多语言道德推理存在核心错位：语言改变模型的道德判断及其关联的训练证据，却不随之本地化模型所应用的道德抽象，异质且语言局部化的训练证据仍产出相似的推理结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Platonic Universe: Do Foundation Models See the Same Sky?
papers.abstract_en: We investigate when foundation models converge towards shared representations, and how this convergence depends on model capacity, training regime, and model architecture. We take a `science-for-AI' approach, using astronomy as an experimental instrument to test the Platonic Representation Hypothesis and its Aristotelian refinement against an external physical reference. The historical success of astrophysics is evidence that a compact, modality-invariant description of galaxy observables exists, and so representation convergence toward reality should be measurable against the physical parameters astronomers already use. Given this framework, we evaluate eleven foundation model families (spanning classification, self-distillation, joint-embedding prediction, autoencoding, vision-language pre-training, and astro-specific architectures from $\mathcal{O}$(10M)${\to}\mathcal{O}$(10B) parameters) on crossmatched JWST, HSC, and Legacy imagery, and DESI spectroscopy. All models are evaluated frozen, with no astronomy-specific fine-tuning. We probe redshift, stellar mass, and sSFR via linear probes, and local (MKNN) and global (CKA) embedding geometry within families, between modalities, and across architectures. We find that physics performance scales predictably with capacity; probe directions align consistently with expected astrophysical correlations and selection effects; and local (not global) embedding alignment tracks physics performance, including between DESI spectra and HSC imagery---modalities that share essentially no low-level statistics. Our results support the ARH over the strict PRH, demonstrate astronomy's value as an experimental framework for neural representation learning, and suggest that astro-foundation models can build on general-purpose pre-trained architectures, capitalizing on the broader open machine learning community's already-spent computational investment.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 8 tables, 13 figures, code available here: https://github.com/UniverseTBD/platonic-universe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用天文学作为检验场，对 11 个基础模型家族（约 10M 到 10B 参数）在 JWST、HSC、Legacy 影像与 DESI 光谱上做冻结线性探测，发现物理性能随模型容量可预测地提升，且局部嵌入对齐（MKNN）而非全局对齐（CKA）能追踪物理性能，包括跨 DESI 光谱与 HSC 影像这两种低级统计几乎不重叠的模态。结果支持 Aristotelian 精化 (ARH) 而非严格的 Platonic 表示假说 (PRH)。
Motivation: 基础模型是否收敛到共享表示（Platonic Representation Hypothesis）缺少可对照的外部物理参考；天体物理已有紧凑、模态不变的星系观测量参数，可作为衡量表示向现实收敛的标尺。
Method: 评估 11 个基础模型家族（分类、自蒸馏、联合嵌入预测、自编码、视觉-语言预训练及天文专用架构，参数量 O(10M)→O(10B)），全部冻结、不做天文微调；在交叉匹配的 JWST、HSC、Legacy 影像与 DESI 光谱上，用线性探测 (linear probe) 测红移、恒星质量、sSFR，并用 MKNN（局部）与 CKA（全局）度量家族内、模态间、架构间的嵌入几何。
Result: 物理性能随容量可预测地 scaling；探测方向与预期天体物理相关性及选择效应一致；局部 (MKNN) 而非全局 (CKA) 嵌入对齐追踪物理性能，包括 DESI 光谱与 HSC 影像之间；评估覆盖 11 个模型家族、参数量从约 10M 到 10B。
Conclusion: 结果支持 ARH 而非严格 PRH：表示收敛是局部的、与物理性能挂钩的，天文基础模型可直接建立在通用预训练架构之上，复用开源社区已投入的算力。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Enabling Regulatory Multi-Agent Collaboration: Architecture, Challenges, and Solutions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs)-empowered autonomous agents are transforming both digital and physical environments by enabling adaptive, multi-agent collaboration. While these agents offer significant opportunities across domains such as finance, healthcare, and smart manufacturing, their unpredictable behaviors and heterogeneous capabilities pose substantial governance and accountability challenges. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-enabled layered architecture for regulatory agent collaboration, comprising an agent layer, an off-chain computation layer, and an on-chain anchoring layer. Within this framework, we design three key modules: (i) an agent behavior tracing and arbitration module for automated accountability, (ii) a dynamic reputation evaluation module for trust assessment in collaborative scenarios, and (iii) a malicious behavior forecasting module for early detection of adversarial activities. Our approach establishes a systematic foundation for trustworthy, resilient, and scalable regulatory mechanisms in large-scale agent ecosystems. Finally, we discuss the future research directions for blockchain-enabled regulatory frameworks in multi-agent systems.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 LLM 自主智能体监管的区块链分层架构：agent 层、链下计算层、链上锚定层，并在其中设计行为追踪与仲裁、动态信誉评估、恶意行为预测三个模块，用于多智能体协作中的自动问责、信任评估与对抗行为早期检测。该文为架构与方案讨论，未给出实验数字。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的智能体在金融、医疗、智能制造中行为不可预测、能力异构，导致治理与问责困难，现有协作机制缺少可审计的监管基础。
Method: 提出区块链使能的三层监管架构（agent 层、off-chain 计算层、on-chain 锚定层），内含三个模块：行为追踪与仲裁模块做自动问责，动态信誉评估模块做协作场景信任评估，恶意行为预测模块做对抗活动早期检测。
Result: 给出一个系统性的监管架构与三个关键模块的设计方案，并讨论区块链使能的多智能体监管框架的未来研究方向；摘要中无实验数据或指标。
Conclusion: 以区块链分层锚定加信誉与恶意行为预测的组合，可为大规模智能体生态建立可信、可恢复、可扩展的监管机制基础。

papers.title: An Efficient Subspace Algorithm for Federated Learning on Heterogeneous Data
papers.abstract_en: This work addresses the key challenges of applying federated learning to large-scale deep neural networks, particularly the issue of client drift due to data heterogeneity across clients and the high costs of communication, computation, and memory. We propose FedSub, an efficient subspace algorithm for federated learning on heterogeneous data. Specifically, FedSub utilizes subspace projection to guarantee local updates of each client within low-dimensional subspaces, thereby reducing communication, computation, and memory costs. Additionally, it incorporates low-dimensional dual variables to mitigate client drift. We provide convergence analysis that reveals the impact of key factors such as step size and subspace projection matrices on convergence. Experimental results demonstrate its efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSub 用子空间投影把每个客户端的本地更新限制在低维子空间内，同时引入低维对偶变量抑制异构数据下的 client drift，从而同时压低联邦学习的通信、计算与内存开销。收敛分析给出步长与投影矩阵对收敛的影响，实验表明该算法高效。
Motivation: 大规模深度网络做联邦学习时，客户端数据异构导致 client drift，且通信、计算、内存成本都很高，制约其落地。
Method: 提出 FedSub：以子空间投影约束各客户端本地更新落在低维子空间，并加入低维对偶变量缓解漂移；给出涉及步长与子空间投影矩阵的收敛性分析。
Result: 实验结果表明 FedSub 具有效率（摘要未给出具体指标数值）；收敛分析揭示步长与投影矩阵等关键因素对收敛的影响。
Conclusion: 把本地更新限制在低维子空间并配合低维对偶变量，可在异构数据的联邦学习中同时降低三类开销并抑制 client drift。

papers.title: Synthetic data for ratemaking: imputation-based methods vs adversarial networks and autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Actuarial ratemaking depends on high-quality data, yet access to such data is often limited by the cost of obtaining new data, privacy concerns, etc. In this paper, we explore synthetic-data generation as a potential solution to these issues. In addition to generative methods previously studied in the actuarial literature, we explore and benchmark another class of approaches based on Multivariate Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE). In a comparative study using an open-source dataset, MICE-based models are evaluated against other generative models like Variational Autoencoders and Conditional Tabular Generative Adversarial Networks. We assess how well synthetic data preserves the original marginal distributions of variables as well as the multivariate relationships among covariates. The consistency between Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) trained on synthetic data with GLMs trained on the original data is also investigated. Furthermore, we assess the ease of use of each generative approach and study the impact of generically augmenting original data with synthetic data on the estimation of GLMs for predicting claim counts. Our results highlight the potential of MICE-based methods in creating high-fidelity tabular data while offering lower implementation complexity compared to deep generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在精算定价 (ratemaking) 的合成数据生成上，基于链式方程多重插补 (MICE) 的方法与 Variational Autoencoder、CTGAN 等深度生成模型对比，评估其保真度与易用性。结果显示 MICE 类方法能生成高保真表格数据，且实现复杂度低于深度生成模型。
Motivation: 精算定价依赖高质量数据，但获取新数据成本高、受隐私限制，数据可得性受限。
Method: 在开源数据集上做对比研究：将基于 MICE 的生成模型与 VAE、CTGAN 等生成模型比较，评估变量边缘分布与协变量间多变量关系的保持程度，并比较在合成数据与原始数据上训练的 GLM 的一致性，同时考察用合成数据增广原始数据对 GLM 预测索赔次数 (claim counts) 估计的影响。
Result: MICE 类方法在生成高保真表格数据方面展现潜力，且相比深度生成模型实现复杂度更低；研究还检验了合成数据训练的 GLM 与原始数据训练 GLM 的一致性，以及合成数据增广对索赔次数 GLM 估计的影响。
Conclusion: MICE 类插补方法可作为精算合成数据生成的可行替代，在保真度与实现简便性上相对深度生成模型具有优势。

papers.title: Design of Experiment for Discovering Directed Mixed Graph
papers.abstract_en: We study the design of interventions for causal discovery in simple structural causal models whose causal graphs are directed mixed graphs (DMGs) that may contain directed cycles and bidirected edges representing latent confounding. In such case, observational conditional-independence (CI) information may not identify even the graph skeleton, while CI alone cannot generally detect a bidirected edge coexisting with a directed edge. To this end, we propose a stage-wise framework based on tailored separating systems. Separating-system interventions first recover descendant relations and strongly connected components (SCCs). The SCCs are then ordered by ancestry, and an SCC-Anc separating system recovers the directed subgraph. Given this subgraph, further systems use CI tests interpreted through $d$- or $σ$-separation to recover non-adjacent bidirected edges, whose endpoints share no directed edge, and do-see comparisons to recover those coexisting with exactly one directed edge. Under our assumptions, the framework recovers the directed subgraph and every bidirected edge except double-adjacent ones, whose endpoints are connected by a directed edge in each direction. We develop algorithms for unrestricted and $M$-bounded settings, with each experiment targeting at most $M$ variables in the latter. For recovering the directed subgraph and non-adjacent bidirected edges, our upper bounds on the number and maximum size of experiments match corresponding worst-case lower bounds up to logarithmic factors.

papers.title: Learning Domain- and Class-Disentangled Prototypes for Domain-Generalized EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based emotion recognition plays a critical role in affective Brain-Computer Interfaces (aBCIs), yet its practical deployment remains limited by inter-subject variability, reliance on target-domain data, and unavoidable label noise. To address these challenges, we propose a Multi-domain Aggregation Transfer learning framework with domain-class prototypes (MAT) for emotion recognition under completely unseen target domains. MAT introduces a feature decoupling module to disentangle class-invariant domain features from domain-invariant class features, enabling more robust and interpretable EEG representations. A Hierarchical-Domain Aggregation (HDA) mechanism based on Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) constructs superdomains to model shared distributional structures across subjects, while adaptive prototype updating refines domain and class prototypes to capture stable intrinsic representations. Moreover, a pairwise learning strategy reformulates classification as similarity estimation between sample pairs, effectively mitigating the effect of label noise. Extensive experiments on three public EEG emotion datasets (SEED, SEED-IV, and SEED-V) show that the accuracy of MAT is improved by 2.87%, 3.84%, and 2.05% compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) model for unseen target domains. Our results provide a promising direction for emotion recognition under real-world unseen-subject scenarios.The source code is available at https://github.com/WuCB-BCI/MAT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAT 框架在完全未见的目标域上做 EEG 情绪识别：特征解耦模块把类不变的域特征与域不变的类特征分开，基于 MMD 的层级域聚合 (HDA) 构造 superdomain，自适应原型更新细化域/类原型，成对学习把分类改写为样本对相似度估计以抗标签噪声。在 SEED、SEED-IV、SEED-V 三个公开数据集上，对未见目标域的准确率较 SOTA 分别提升 2.87%、3.84%、2.05%。
Motivation: EEG 情绪识别受被试间差异、对目标域数据的依赖和标签噪声限制，难以部署到完全未见的新被试场景。
Method: 提出 Multi-domain Aggregation Transfer learning (MAT)：特征解耦模块分离类不变域特征与域不变类特征；基于 Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) 的 Hierarchical-Domain Aggregation (HDA) 构造 superdomain 建模跨被试共享分布结构；自适应原型更新细化域与类原型；成对学习策略将分类重构为样本对相似度估计以缓解标签噪声。
Result: 在三个公开 EEG 情绪数据集 SEED、SEED-IV、SEED-V 上，MAT 对完全未见目标域的准确率较 SOTA 模型分别提高 2.87%、3.84%、2.05%。
Conclusion: 解耦域/类原型加层级域聚合与成对相似度学习，可在完全未见被试上给出更稳健的 EEG 表征，为真实场景未见被试的情绪识别提供可行方向。

papers.title: AI-driven Dispensing of Coral Reseeding Devices for Broad-scale Restoration of the Great Barrier Reef
papers.abstract_en: Coral reefs are on the brink of collapse, with climate change, ocean acidification, and pollution leading to a projected 70-90% loss of coral species within the next decade. Reef restoration is crucial, but its success hinges on introducing automation to upscale efforts. In this work, we present a highly configurable AI pipeline for the real-time deployment of coral reseeding devices. The pipeline consists of three core components: (i) the image labeling scheme, designed to address data availability and reduce the cost of expert labeling; (ii) the classifier which performs automated analysis of underwater imagery, at the image or patch-level, while also enabling quantitative coral coverage estimation; and (iii) the decision-making module that determines whether deployment should occur based on the classifier's analysis. By reducing reliance on manual experts, our proposed pipeline increases operational range and efficiency of reef restoration. We validate the proposed pipeline at five sites across the Great Barrier Reef, benchmarking its performance against annotations from expert marine scientists. The pipeline achieves 77.8% deployment accuracy, 89.1% accuracy for sub-image patch classification, and real-time model inference at 5.5 frames per second on a Jetson Orin. To address the limited availability of labeled data in this domain and encourage further research, we publicly release a comprehensive, annotated dataset of substrate imagery from the surveyed sites.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向大堡礁珊瑚再播种设备的实时 AI 投放管线：图像标注方案降低专家标注成本，分类器在图像或 patch 级分析水下影像并估计珊瑚覆盖率，决策模块据此判断是否投放。在大堡礁 5 个站点以海洋科学家标注为基准验证，投放准确率 77.8%，子图 patch 分类准确率 89.1%，Jetson Orin 上推理 5.5 FPS，并公开发布标注底质影像数据集。
Motivation: 珊瑚礁受气候变化、海洋酸化与污染影响，预计十年内损失 70-90% 珊瑚物种，人工修复难以规模化，且该领域标注数据稀缺、专家标注昂贵。
Method: 三组件可配置 AI 管线：(i) 图像标注方案应对数据稀缺并压低专家标注成本；(ii) 分类器对水下影像做图像级或 patch 级自动分析，同时给出定量珊瑚覆盖率估计；(iii) 决策模块依据分类结果判断是否执行投放。以专家海洋科学家标注为基准在 5 个站点验证，并公开发布标注底质影像数据集。
Result: 投放准确率 77.8%，子图 patch 分类准确率 89.1%，Jetson Orin 上实时推理 5.5 帧/秒；验证覆盖大堡礁 5 个站点，基准为专家海洋科学家标注。背景数字：预计十年内珊瑚物种损失 70-90%。
Conclusion: 减少对人工专家的依赖可扩大礁体修复的作业范围与效率，且该管线可实时部署在再播种设备上；配套公开数据集以缓解该领域标注数据不足。

papers.title: Diffusion-grounded VideoLLM for Entity-aware temoporal grounding
papers.abstract_en: Precise temporal grounding requires distinguishing when a queried event occurs from when its participating entities are merely visible. We propose Diffusion-Grounded VideoLLM, which conditions temporal feature extraction on query-relevant entities before language reasoning. The framework tracks entities named in the query and uses their masks to condition a frozen video diffusion backbone. Intermediate spatiotemporal features are extracted through truncated denoising and combined with entity tokens and timestamp embeddings. The language model uses this evidence together with the full query to generate temporal intervals and answers to grounded questions. On Charades-STA and NExT-GQA, the model obtains 43.5 mIoU and 28.4 Acc@GQA, improving the reported Grounded-VideoLLM reference by 6.7 and 1.7 points, respectively. Component and entity-pathway ablations support the usefulness of conditioning diffusion features on query-relevant entities for temporal grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion-Grounded VideoLLM：先跟踪查询中提到的实体并用其 mask 条件化一个冻结的 video diffusion backbone，经截断去噪 (truncated denoising) 取中间时空特征，再与实体 token、时间戳嵌入一起交给语言模型生成时间区间与 grounded 答案。在 Charades-STA 与 NExT-GQA 上取得 43.5 mIoU 与 28.4 Acc@GQA，比所报告的 Grounded-VideoLLM 参考分别高 6.7 与 1.7 点。
Motivation: 时间定位需要区分事件真正发生的时刻与参与实体仅仅可见的时刻，现有 VideoLLM 在语言推理前缺少对查询相关实体的显式视觉条件化。
Method: 框架先跟踪查询中命名的实体，用其 mask 条件化冻结的 video diffusion backbone，通过截断去噪提取中间时空特征，与实体 token 和 timestamp 嵌入拼接后，由语言模型结合完整查询生成时间区间与 grounded 问题的答案；另做组件与实体通路 (entity-pathway) 消融。
Result: Charades-STA 上 43.5 mIoU，NExT-GQA 上 28.4 Acc@GQA，相对所报告的 Grounded-VideoLLM 参考分别提升 6.7 点与 1.7 点；组件消融与实体通路消融支持在时间定位中用查询相关实体条件化 diffusion 特征这一设计。
Conclusion: 把查询相关实体的 mask 作为 diffusion 特征提取的条件，再交给语言推理，能改善视频事件的时间定位精度。

papers.title: Graph Structure Learning with Temporal Graph Information Bottleneck for Inductive Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph learning is crucial for dynamic networks where nodes and edges evolve over time and new nodes continuously join the system. Inductive representation learning in such settings faces two major challenges: effectively representing unseen nodes and mitigating noisy or redundant graph information. We propose GTGIB, a versatile framework that integrates Graph Structure Learning (GSL) with Temporal Graph Information Bottleneck (TGIB). We design a novel two-step GSL-based structural enhancer to enrich and optimize node neighborhoods and demonstrate its effectiveness and efficiency through theoretical proofs and experiments. The TGIB refines the optimized graph by extending the information bottleneck principle to temporal graphs, regularizing both edges and features based on our derived tractable TGIB objective function via variational approximation, enabling stable and efficient optimization. GTGIB-based models are evaluated to predict links on four real-world datasets; they outperform existing methods in all datasets under the inductive setting, with significant and consistent improvement in the transductive setting.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GTGIB 把图结构学习 (GSL) 与时序图信息瓶颈 (TGIB) 结合，用于动态网络的归纳表示学习：两步式 GSL 结构增强器先丰富再优化节点邻域，TGIB 经变分近似得到可处理的目标函数，同时对边和特征做正则。在四个真实数据集的链路预测上，归纳设定下全部胜过现有方法，传导设定下也有显著且一致的提升。
Motivation: 动态网络中节点与边随时间演化、新节点不断加入，归纳表示学习既要表示未见节点，又要抑制图中的噪声与冗余信息。
Method: 提出 GTGIB 框架：设计两步式 GSL 结构增强器以丰富并优化节点邻域（辅以理论证明），再把信息瓶颈原理扩展到时序图，经变分近似推出可处理的 TGIB 目标函数，对优化后图的边与特征同时正则，实现稳定高效优化。
Result: GTGIB 模型在四个真实世界数据集上做链路预测，归纳设定下全部优于现有方法，传导设定下取得显著且一致的提升；结构增强器的有效性与效率由理论证明和实验支撑。
Conclusion: 把结构学习与时序信息瓶颈结合可同时改善未见节点表示与噪声抑制，使链路预测在归纳与传导两种设定下都受益。

papers.title: Rethinking Prospect Theory for LLMs: Revealing the Instability of Decision-Making under Epistemic Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Real-world decision-making often involves uncertainty expressed in linguistic rather than numerical terms, and Prospect Theory (PT) provides a classic framework for modeling human behavior under such uncertainty. Although recent studies have developed frameworks to estimate PT parameters for Large Language Models (LLMs), few have examined whether PT itself adequately describes LLM decision-making behavior. To address these gaps, we develop a streamlined workflow grounded in a classic behavioral economics experimental paradigm. First, we estimate PT parameters and evaluate how well the resulting model captures LLM decision-making behavior. We then derive probability mappings for epistemic markers in the same context and inject them into prompts to examine the stability of PT parameters under linguistic uncertainty. Our findings suggest that PT does not consistently provide a reliable account of LLM decision-making across models, and that its application to LLMs is likely sensitive to epistemic uncertainty. The findings caution against the deployment of PT-based frameworks in real-world applications where epistemic ambiguity is prevalent, giving valuable insights in behaviour interpretation and future alignment direction for LLM decision-making.

papers.title: RooseBERT: A New Deal For Political Language Modelling
papers.abstract_en: The increasing amount of political debates and politics-related discussions calls for the definition of novel computational methods to automatically analyse such content with the final goal of lightening up political deliberation to citizens. However, the specificity of the political language and the argumentative form of these debates (employing hidden communication strategies and leveraging implicit arguments) make this task very challenging, even for current general-purpose pre-trained Language Models (PLMs). To address this, we introduce a novel PLM for political discourse language called RooseBERT. Pre-training a language model on a specialised domain presents different technical and linguistic challenges, requiring extensive computational resources and large-scale data. RooseBERT has been trained on large political debate and speech corpora (11GB) in English. To evaluate its performances, we fine-tuned it on multiple downstream tasks related to political debate analysis, i.e., stance detection, sentiment analysis, argument component detection and classification, argument relation prediction and classification, policy classification, named entity recognition (NER). Our results show improvements over general-purpose PLMs on the majority of these tasks, highlighting how domain-specific pre-training enhances performance in political debate analysis. We release RooseBERT for the research community: https://huggingface.co/collections/MARIANNE-INRIA/roosebert.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RooseBERT 是一个面向政治辩论话语的领域预训练语言模型，在 11GB 英语政治辩论与演讲语料上预训练，并在立场检测、情感分析、论点成分检测与分类、论点关系预测与分类、政策分类、命名实体识别 (NER) 等多项政治辩论分析下游任务上微调。结果显示它在多数任务上超过通用 PLM，说明领域专用预训练能提升政治话语分析表现。
Motivation: 政治辩论依赖隐含论证与隐藏交际策略，通用预训练语言模型难以处理这种语言特异性，需要面向该领域的专用模型。
Method: 在 11GB 英语政治辩论与演讲语料上预训练新 PLM RooseBERT，再在六类政治辩论分析下游任务（stance detection、sentiment analysis、argument component detection and classification、argument relation prediction and classification、policy classification、NER）上微调评估，并发布模型权重。
Result: 在多数下游任务上优于通用 PLM，表明领域专用预训练带来性能提升；预训练语料规模为 11GB 英语政治辩论与演讲数据。
Conclusion: 政治话语这一特定领域值得专用预训练，RooseBERT 在多数政治辩论分析任务上胜过通用 PLM 并已开源供研究社区使用。

papers.title: Edge Selection for the Effective use of Piecewise-Constant Distributions as Neural Network Outputs for Event Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We study the output representation of a neural network used for next event prediction. We propose partitioning the time axis into a fixed set of intervals and having a neural network output a categorical distribution over them, which we map to a (mostly) piecewise-constant probability density. We present an optimization procedure that selects interval edges in order to maximize data likelihood under the representation. The representation is well suited to processes whose inter-event distribution is a mixture of smooth and sharply peaked components$\unicode{x2013}$a pattern we find common in event data recorded from real-world processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对下一事件预测 (next event prediction) 的输出表示，把时间轴切成固定区间、让网络输出其上的 categorical 分布并映射为分段常数概率密度，再用一个优化过程挑选区间边界以最大化该表示下的数据似然。该表示适合事件间隔分布同时含平滑成分与尖锐峰值的过程，作者称这种模式在真实过程记录的事件数据中很常见。
Motivation: 事件数据的间隔分布常同时有平滑背景和极尖的峰，单一参数分布或固定网格的输出难以同时拟合两者，导致下一事件预测的似然被拉低。
Method: 将时间轴划分为一组固定区间，神经网络输出其上的 categorical 分布并映射为（基本）分段常数概率密度；再提出一个优化过程，在该表示下最大化数据似然来选择区间边界 (interval edges)。
Result: 提出分段常数输出表示与区间边界选择的似然最大化优化过程；作者指出事件间隔分布中平滑与尖锐峰值混合的模式在真实过程记录的事件数据里常见。
Conclusion: 让网络输出分段常数密度并按似然自适应选边界，是处理含尖峰的事件间隔分布的可行输出表示。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: LLM Bidders Preserve the Mechanism-Level Orderings of Human Bidders
papers.abstract_en: Training on vast amounts of human-generated data has motivated growing interest in using large language models (LLMs) to simulate human behavior. We ask which features of human behavior general-purpose models preserve when used out of the box in auctions, where multiple bidders interact under explicit rules and incentives. We evaluate five LLMs across seven laboratory settings against human benchmarks reconstructed from published experiments, with uncertainty bands for the private-value comparisons. Our main focus is on three large models without extended test-time reasoning: GPT-4o, Claude~3.5 Haiku, and Gemini~2.0 Flash. LLM and human deviations from theory differ in magnitude and often in direction: humans overbid in second-price auctions, whereas most models that deviate underbid. Surprisingly, without task-specific fine-tuning or calibration to human bids, the three non-reasoning large models robustly preserve key orderings of auction formats by deviation from theory. First-price auctions are harder than second-price, and ascending clocks reduce deviations relative to sealed bids wherever data are adequate. Kendall's $τ_b$ between the human and GPT-4o difficulty rankings is $0.60$ and positive in every joint bootstrap draw. The reasoning model bids almost at equilibrium in the observed private-value settings, leaving little variation in errors to compare; the small model's large errors yield an inverted ranking. All five models nevertheless reproduce the stronger first-price winner's curse. Clock framing improves bidding for two of the three non-reasoning large models, and GPT-4o recovers the ordering of last-minute bidding across closing rules in an eBay-style marketplace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用五个 LLM 开箱模拟拍卖出价，检验其是否保留人类对拍卖机制的偏离排序：三个非推理大模型在未微调、未校准的条件下稳健复现了「一价难于二价、时钟式优于密封式」的机制级排序，GPT-4o 与人类难度排序的 Kendall τb 为 0.60 且每次联合 bootstrap 抽样均为正。但偏离方向常相反：人类在二价拍卖中高报，多数模型低报。
Motivation: 用 LLM 模拟人类行为的前提是模型保留人类在明确规则与激励下的行为特征，但哪些特征能开箱保留、哪些会走样，此前缺少跨拍卖机制的系统对照。
Method: 在七个实验室拍卖设定上评估五个 LLM，对照由已发表实验重建的人类基准（私有价值比较带不确定性区间）；主分析聚焦三个无扩展测试时推理的大模型 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Haiku、Gemini 2.0 Flash，用 Kendall τb 与联合 bootstrap 比较人类与模型的拍卖格式难度排序。
Result: 人类在二价拍卖中高报而多数偏离模型低报，偏离的量级与方向常不一致；GPT-4o 与人类难度排序的 Kendall τb = 0.60，且在每一次联合 bootstrap 抽样中为正。推理模型在观测到的私有价值设定下几乎按均衡出价，误差变异过小；小模型误差大且排序反转。五个模型全部复现了一价拍卖更强的 winner's curse；clock framing 使三个非推理大模型中的两个出价改善，GPT-4o 还复现了 eBay 式市场不同结束规则下最后时刻出价的排序。
Conclusion: LLM 保留的是机制层面的相对排序而非个体偏离的量级与方向，因此可用来做机制比较类的行为模拟，但不能直接当作人类出价幅度的代理。

papers.title: Adaptively Truncated Signature-based Logistic Regression for Semi-parametric Functional Classification
papers.abstract_en: Modern sensing technologies routinely generate multi-dimensional functional data, often accompanied by scalar covariates, motivating statistical methods that can jointly accommodate nonlinear functional effects, complex cross-component dependencies, and irregular sampling patterns. Existing functional logistic regression approaches rely on basis expansions whose performance is critically sensitive to the choice of basis, smoothing parameters, and sampling design; meanwhile, current signature-based methods require heuristic selection of the signature truncation order. We propose Adaptively Truncated Signature-based Logistic Regression (ATSLR), a semi-parametric classification framework that integrates path-signature representations with a data-driven procedure for selecting the signature truncation order via penalized empirical risk minimization. Our method is supported by rigorous theoretical guarantees, including the existence of an optimal truncation order, consistency of its adaptive estimator, convergence rates for the classifier risk, a finite and computable search bound, and a general error-propagation analysis for irregular sampling. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms traditional functional classifiers and fixed-order signature baselines in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability. Our results highlight the practical and theoretical value of integrating rough path theory with adaptive model complexity control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出半参数函数型分类框架 ATSLR：把 path-signature 表示与惩罚经验风险最小化 (penalized ERM) 结合，数据驱动地选择 signature 截断阶数，替代人工指定阶数或基函数展开。合成与真实数据实验中，该框架在准确率、稳健性与可解释性上持续优于传统函数型分类器和固定阶 signature 基线。
Motivation: 现有多维函数型数据（含标量协变量）的 logistic 回归依赖基函数展开，性能对基、平滑参数和采样设计高度敏感；已有 signature 方法又需启发式指定截断阶数。
Method: ATSLR 用 path-signature 表示函数型输入，通过惩罚经验风险最小化数据驱动选择截断阶数；理论部分给出最优截断阶存在性、自适应估计量一致性、分类器风险收敛率、有限可计算的搜索上界，以及针对不规则采样的误差传播分析。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据集上，ATSLR 在准确率、稳健性和可解释性方面持续优于传统函数型分类器与固定阶 signature 基线；理论结果包括最优截断阶存在、自适应估计一致性、风险收敛率与有限搜索界。
Conclusion: 把 rough path theory 与自适应复杂度控制结合，可在不规则采样下替代启发式截断阶选择，兼顾理论保证与实证表现。

papers.title: A family of graph GOSPA metrics for graphs with different sizes
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a family of graph metrics for measuring distances between graphs of different sizes. The proposed metric family defines a general form of the graph generalised optimal sub-pattern assignment (GOSPA) metric and is also proved to satisfy the metric properties. Similarly to the graph GOSPA metric, the proposed graph GOSPA metric family also penalises the node attribute costs for assigned nodes between the two graphs, and the number of unassigned nodes. However, the proposed family of metrics provides more general penalties for edge mismatches than the graph GOSPA metric. This paper also shows that the graph GOSPA metric family can be approximately computed using linear programming. Simulation experiments are performed to illustrate the characteristics of the proposed graph GOSPA metric family with different choices of hyperparameters. The benefits of the proposed graph GOSPA metric family for classification tasks are also shown on real-world datasets.
papers.comment: IEEE Transactions on Signal and Information Processing over Networks.The code is available at: https://github.com/JinhaoGu/Graph_GOSPA_family
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一族可比较不同规模图之间距离的 graph GOSPA 度量，给出统一形式并证明其满足度量性质，对边失配的惩罚比原 graph GOSPA 更一般。该族可用线性规划近似计算，仿真展示不同超参数下的特性，并在真实数据集上展示其对分类任务的收益。
Motivation: 原 graph GOSPA 度量对边失配的惩罚形式固定，难以刻画不同应用中多样的边不匹配代价，且不同规模图之间的距离度量需要更一般的惩罚族。
Method: 定义 graph GOSPA 度量族的一般形式，保留对已分配节点属性代价与未分配节点数的惩罚，同时推广边失配惩罚；证明其满足度量性质，并给出基于线性规划 (linear programming) 的近似计算方法。
Result: 仿真实验说明度量族在不同超参数选择下的特性；在真实数据集上展示了该度量族对分类任务的收益。
Conclusion: 通过超参数即可在保留 GOSPA 度量性质的前提下调节边失配惩罚，使图距离适配不同任务，并可经线性规划近似求解。

papers.title: Squeeze3D: Extreme Neural Compression with Latent Space Bridging
papers.abstract_en: We propose Squeeze3D, a novel framework that leverages implicit prior knowledge learnt by existing pre-trained encoders and decoders to compress 3D data at extremely high compression ratios. Our approach bridges the latent spaces between a pre-trained encoder and a pretrained decoder model through trainable mapping networks. Any 3D asset represented as a mesh, point cloud, or radiance field is first encoded by the pre-trained encoder and then transformed (i.e. compressed) into a highly compact latent code by a mapping network. This latent code can effectively be used as an extremely compressed representation of the mesh, point cloud, or radiance field. A mapping network transforms the compressed latent code into the latent space of a powerful generative model; the decoder of this generative model then recreates the original 3D asset (i.e. decompression). Squeeze3D is trained entirely on generated synthetic data and does not require any 3D datasets. The Squeeze3D architecture can be flexibly used with existing pre-trained 3D encoders and existing generative models. It can flexibly support different formats, including meshes, point clouds, and radiance fields. Our experiments demonstrate that Squeeze3D achieves compression ratios of up to 2187$\times$ for textured meshes, 58.5$\times$ for point clouds, and more than 650$\times$ for radiance fields while maintaining visual quality comparable to many existing methods. Squeeze3D only incurs a small compression and decompression latency since it does not involve training object-specific networks to compress an object.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Squeeze3D 用可训练映射网络把预训练 3D 编码器的隐空间桥接到预训练生成模型的隐空间，把 mesh、点云、辐射场压成极短隐码再解码重建。纹理 mesh 压缩比最高 2187×、点云 58.5×、辐射场超过 650×，视觉质量与多种现有方法相当，且压缩/解压延迟很小。
Motivation: 3D 资产（mesh、点云、辐射场）体积大，逐物体训练专用压缩网络成本高；现有预训练编码器与生成模型的隐空间互不相通，无法直接复用其学到的先验做极高压缩比的通用压缩。
Method: 先用预训练编码器编码 3D 资产，再经一个映射网络压成紧凑隐码；解压时由第二个映射网络把隐码转到强大生成模型的隐空间，用其解码器重建原资产。训练完全用生成的合成数据，不需要任何 3D 数据集，架构可灵活搭配现有预训练编码器与生成模型，支持 mesh、点云、辐射场多种格式。
Result: 纹理 mesh 压缩比最高 2187×，点云 58.5×，辐射场超过 650×，视觉质量与多种现有方法相当；因不训练逐物体网络，压缩与解压只引入很小的延迟。
Conclusion: 桥接预训练编码器与生成模型的隐空间即可实现极高压缩比的通用 3D 压缩，无需 3D 训练数据或逐物体网络。

papers.title: AutoExpert: Automating 3D LiDAR Annotation from Expert-Crafted Guidelines
papers.abstract_en: The contemporary paradigm of scaling data annotation, crucial for developing machine learning solutions, is to hire ordinary human annotators and instruct them with expert-crafted guidelines to label data. This paradigm is laborious, tedious, and costly, motivating us to study an open problem, auto-annotation with expert-crafted guidelines (dubbed AutoExpert). We develop benchmarks by redesigning the evaluation protocol and re-annotating data with nuScenes and PandaSet, two 3D detection datasets for autonomous driving research that provide expert-crafted annotation guidelines. Their guidelines define 18 and 25 object classes, respectively, using nuanced language descriptions and a few visual examples. Following the guidelines that require using 3D cuboids to label LiDAR data, AutoExpert requires algorithms to learn on few-shot labeled images and texts to perform the task of 3D detection on LiDAR data. Apparently, the challenges of AutoExpert lie in the data-modality and task discrepancy. Nevertheless, public foundation models (FMs) serve as promising tools to tackle these challenges. To address AutoExpert, we adopt a conceptually simple pipeline consisting of three components: (1) 2D object detection and segmentation in RGB images, (2) lifting 2D detections into 3D using known sensor poses, and (3) 3D cuboids generation for the 2D detections. Within this pipeline, we enhance and evaluate a variety of methods such as open-vocabulary detectors, few-shot detectors, and self-supervised learned detectors. We also develop novel techniques, leading to refined components that boost 3D detection mAP from 12.1 to 25.4 on the AutoExpert-nuScenes benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/annoguide/AutoExpert-3D-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoExpert 把「按专家标注指南自动标注」形式化为新任务：在 nuScenes 与 PandaSet 上重做评测协议并重标数据，用三段式管线（RGB 图像 2D 检测分割 → 用已知传感器位姿提升到 3D → 生成 3D cuboid）在少样本图像与文本上完成 LiDAR 3D 检测。其改进组件把 AutoExpert-nuScenes 上的 3D detection mAP 从 12.1 提到 25.4。
Motivation: 当前扩展数据标注靠雇普通标注员并按专家指南操作，过程费力、枯燥且昂贵；而直接让算法遵循专家指南自动标注，在模态与任务差异上仍是开放问题。
Method: 构建 AutoExpert-nuScenes 与 AutoExpert-PandaSet 基准（指南分别定义 18 与 25 个类别），管线含三段：RGB 图像上的 2D 检测与分割、用已知传感器位姿把 2D 检测提升到 3D、为这些检测生成 3D cuboid；其中增强并评测 open-vocabulary detector、few-shot detector、self-supervised learned detector 等方法，并提出新技术精化各组件。
Result: 在 AutoExpert-nuScenes 基准上，3D detection mAP 从 12.1 提升到 25.4；基准基于 nuScenes 与 PandaSet 重做评测协议并重新标注数据，指南分别定义 18 与 25 个目标类别。
Conclusion: 以公共 foundation models 为核心的三段式管线能够沿专家指南把少样本图像/文本知识转成 LiDAR 3D cuboid 标注，组件级改进可显著抬升 3D 检测 mAP。

papers.title: Relation-Aware Graph Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capability to generalize across diverse natural language processing tasks, inspiring the development of graph foundation models (GFMs) for large-scale pre-training. However, unlike language models with explicit token units, graphs lack a well-defined unit for generalization, making it challenging to design effective pre-training strategies. In this work, we propose REEF, a novel GFM framework that leverages relation tokens as the fundamental units. We construct a vocabulary of relation tokens to encode relational information within graphs. To accommodate diverse relations, we introduce two hypernetworks that adaptively generate the parameters of aggregators and classifiers in graph neural networks based on relation tokens. In addition, we design another hypernetwork to construct dataset-specific projectors and incorporate a dataset-level feature bias into the initial node representations, enhancing flexibility across different datasets with the same relation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REEF consistently outperforms existing methods in both pre-training and transfer learning, highlighting its potential as a general-purpose graph foundation model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REEF 提出以 relation token 为基本单元的图基础模型 (GFM)：构造关系词表编码图中的关系信息，用两个超网络据 relation token 动态生成 GNN 聚合器与分类器参数，再用第三个超网络生成数据集级投影器并注入数据集级特征偏置。在预训练与迁移学习两类设置上，REEF 均持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 语言模型有显式 token 单元可做跨任务泛化，而图缺乏良好的泛化单元，导致大规模图预训练策略难以设计。
Method: 以 relation token 为基本单元：构造 relation token 词表编码图内关系；两个超网络根据 relation token 自适应生成 GNN 中聚合器与分类器的参数；第三个超网络构建数据集专属 projector，并在初始节点表示中加入数据集级特征偏置，以支持同一关系下不同数据集的灵活适配。
Result: 在预训练与迁移学习两类实验设置上，REEF 均持续优于现有方法（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 以 relation token 作为图的泛化单元、用超网络按关系生成 GNN 参数，可支撑通用图基础模型的预训练与迁移。

papers.title: Accelerating Natural Gradient Descent for PINNs with Randomized Numerical Linear Algebra
papers.abstract_en: Natural Gradient Descent (NGD) has emerged as a promising optimization algorithm for training neural network-based solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs), such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). However, its practical use is often limited by the high computational cost of solving linear systems involving the Gramian matrix. While matrix-free NGD methods based on the conjugate gradient (CG) method avoid explicit matrix inversion, the ill-conditioning of the Gramian significantly slows the convergence of CG. In this work, we extend matrix-free NGD to broader classes of problems than previously considered and propose the use of Randomized Numerical Linear Algebra (RandNLA) techniques for efficient preconditioning of the inner CG solver. The resulting algorithms demonstrate substantial performance improvements over existing NGD-based methods on a range of PDE problems discretized using neural networks, and offer competitive results compared to other state-of-the-art optimizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把随机数值线性代数 (RandNLA) 用作矩阵自由 Natural Gradient Descent 内层共轭梯度 (CG) 的预条件，加速 PINN 训练。Gramian 病态使 CG 收敛变慢，RandNLA 预条件在一系列神经网络离散的 PDE 问题上带来显著性能提升，并与其他 SOTA 优化器结果相当。
Motivation: NGD 训练 PINN 需要求解含 Gramian 矩阵的线性系统，显式求逆代价高；矩阵自由 CG 又被 Gramian 病态拖慢收敛，限制了 NGD 的实际使用。
Method: 将矩阵自由 NGD 扩展到比先前更广的问题类别，并用 RandNLA 技术为内层 CG 求解器构造高效预条件，替代显式矩阵求逆。
Result: 在一系列用神经网络离散的 PDE 问题上，所得算法相对已有 NGD 类方法有显著性能提升，并与其他 SOTA 优化器相比具有竞争力的结果。
Conclusion: RandNLA 预条件是打通矩阵自由 NGD 在 PINN 上实用化瓶颈的有效途径，使 NGD 在更广的 PDE 问题上可用。

papers.title: Emergence of psychopathological computations in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Can large language models (LLMs) instantiate computations of psychopathology? In this work, we establish a computational-theoretical framework to provide an account of psychopathology applicable to LLMs. Based on the framework, we conduct experiments supporting two key claims: first, that network-theoretic computational structures of psychopathology exist in LLMs; and second, that executing these computational structures results in psychopathological functions. We further observe that as LLM size increases, the computational structure of psychopathology becomes denser and the functions more effective. Taken together, the results suggest that network-theoretic computations of psychopathology may have emerged in LLMs. We discuss alternative explanations, including pattern matching, persona modeling, and semantic coherence, and argue that they are either complementary to our interpretation or less consistent with the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文为 LLM 建立一套可套用的 psychopathology 计算理论框架，并用实验支持两个论断：LLM 内部存在精神病理学的网络论计算结构，执行这些结构会产生精神病理功能；且模型规模越大，该计算结构越稠密、功能越有效，据此主张精神病理计算可能已在 LLM 中涌现。
Motivation: 既有讨论多停留在 LLM 是否“表现得像”有精神病理症状，缺少一个能在 LLM 上操作化、并可用实验检验的计算层面定义，因而无法区分真正的计算结构与模式匹配、人格建模等替代解释。
Method: 先提出一套适用于 LLM 的精神病理学计算理论框架，再基于该框架做实验：以网络论 (network-theoretic) 结构刻画精神病理计算，检验该结构在 LLM 中是否存在、执行后是否产生相应功能，并随模型规模变化；同时对照 pattern matching、persona modeling、semantic coherence 三种替代解释。
Result: 实验支持两个关键论断：LLM 中存在精神病理学的网络论计算结构，执行这些结构会产生精神病理功能；随 LLM 规模增大，该计算结构变得更稠密、功能更有效。作者论证三种替代解释与数据的一致性更弱或与其解读互补。
Conclusion: 精神病理学的网络论计算可能已在 LLM 中随规模涌现，而不仅是表面的模式匹配或人格扮演；这一解读相对替代解释更符合数据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 实验支持两个关键论断：LLM 中存在精神病理学的网络论计算结构，执行这些结构会产生精神病理功能；随 LLM 规模增大，该计算结构变得更稠密、功能更有效。作者论证三种替代解释与数据的一致性更弱或与其解读互补。
summary_sections.conclusion: 精神病理学的网络论计算可能已在 LLM 中随规模涌现，而不仅是表面的模式匹配或人格扮演；这一解读相对替代解释更符合数据。

papers.title: DRAN: A Distribution and Relation Adaptive Network for Spatio-temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal forecasting remains challenging under non-stationary environments because both data distributions and spatial relations evolve over time. Temporal normalization and de-normalization are widely used to mitigate distribution shifts, but they may distort inter-node relationships and thereby impair spatial dependency modeling. To address these issues, we propose the Distribution and Relation Adaptive Network (DRAN) for spatio-temporal forecasting. DRAN incorporates a Spatial Factor Learner (SFL) module, which enables effective normalization and de-normalization while preserving spatial dependencies in spatio-temporal systems. To model evolving spatial interactions, DRAN further proposes the Dynamic-Static Fusion Learner (DSFL) module. DSFL decomposes features into static and dynamic components and adaptively fuses them according to input variability. Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that DRAN outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Additional analyses demonstrate that SFL consistently reduces spatial-relation distortion across multiple normalization schemes, whereas DSFL captures complementary static and dynamic dependencies and adjusts their contributions according to temporal variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRAN 针对非平稳时空预测中时间归一化会扭曲节点间空间关系的问题，用 Spatial Factor Learner (SFL) 在归一化/反归一化时保留空间依赖，用 Dynamic-Static Fusion Learner (DSFL) 按输入变化度自适应融合静态与动态空间成分。在六个基准数据集上超过 SOTA 基线，SFL 在多种归一化方案下一致降低空间关系失真。
Motivation: 非平稳环境下数据分布与空间关系同时随时间演化，常规时间归一化虽缓解分布偏移却会破坏节点间关系，进而损害空间依赖建模。
Method: DRAN 含两个模块：SFL 实现归一化与反归一化同时保持时空系统空间依赖；DSFL 将特征分解为静态与动态成分，并按输入变异性自适应融合二者。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上优于 SOTA 基线；附加分析显示 SFL 在多种归一化方案下一致减少空间关系失真，DSFL 捕获互补的静态与动态依赖并按时间变异性调整二者贡献。
Conclusion: 时空预测中归一化应与空间关系保持联合设计，且静态与动态空间依赖需按时间变异性加权融合而非固定取舍。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Optimization on the Oblique Manifold for Sparse Simplex Constraints via Multiplicative Updates
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank optimization problems with sparse simplex constraints involve variables that must satisfy nonnegativity, sparsity, and sum-to-1 conditions, making their optimization particularly challenging due to the interplay between low-rank structures and constraints. These problems arise in various applications, including machine learning, signal processing, environmental fields, and computational biology. In this work, we propose a novel manifold optimization approach to efficiently tackle these problems. Our method leverages the geometry of oblique manifolds to reformulate the problem and introduces a new Riemannian optimization method based on Riemannian gradient descent that strictly maintains the simplex constraints. By exploiting the underlying manifold structure, our approach improves optimization efficiency. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared to standard Euclidean and Riemannian methods, paving the way for broader applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带稀疏单纯形约束（非负、和为 1、稀疏）的低秩优化问题，提出基于斜流形 (oblique manifold) 几何的黎曼梯度下降法，用乘性更新严格保持单纯形约束。在合成与真实数据集上，相比标准欧氏与黎曼方法表现出更高的优化效率。
Motivation: 低秩结构与非负、稀疏、和为 1 三重约束耦合，使这类问题在欧氏空间中难以直接高效求解。
Method: 利用斜流形几何重构问题，提出基于 Riemannian gradient descent 的新黎曼优化方法，通过乘性更新在迭代中严格维持单纯形约束。
Result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集上的实验中，所提方法相比标准欧氏方法和标准黎曼方法展现出更优的优化效率（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 把稀疏单纯形约束嵌入斜流形几何并配合乘性更新，可在严格满足约束的前提下提升低秩优化效率，并可推广到更广应用。

papers.title: Stochastic Engrams for Efficient Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: The ability to learn continuously in artificial neural networks (ANNs) is often limited by catastrophic forgetting, a phenomenon in which new knowledge becomes dominant. By taking mechanisms of memory encoding in neuroscience (i.e., engrams) as inspiration, we propose a novel approach that integrates stochastically-activated engrams as a gating mechanism for metaplastic binarized neural networks (mBNNs). This method leverages the computational efficiency of mBNNs combined with the robustness of probabilistic memory traces to mitigate forgetting and maintain the model's reliability. Previously validated metaplastic optimization techniques have been incorporated to further enhance synaptic stability. Compared to baseline binarized models and benchmark fully connected continual learning approaches, our method is the only strategy capable of achieving average accuracies over 70% in both class-incremental and domain-incremental MNIST benchmarks, matching full-precision state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, we achieve a significant reduction in peak GPU and RAM usage, under 5% and 20%, respectively, as well as an ~8x reduction in memory footprint compared to full precision counterparts. Our findings demonstrate (A) an improved stability vs. plasticity trade-off, (B) reduced memory intensiveness, and (C) enhanced performance in binarized architectures. By uniting principles of neuroscience and efficient computing, we offer new insights into the design of scalable and robust deep learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经科学的 engram 记忆痕迹做成随机激活的门控，接入元可塑性二值神经网络 (mBNN) 来缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。在 class-incremental 与 domain-incremental MNIST 上，它是唯一平均准确率超过 70% 的策略，达到全精度 SOTA 水平，同时峰值 GPU/RAM 占用低于 5% 和 20%，内存足迹比全精度小约 8 倍。
Motivation: ANN 的持续学习被灾难性遗忘限制：新知识压倒旧知识；现有二值化模型在增量任务上精度掉得厉害，全精度方法又太占内存。
Method: 以 engram 为灵感，用随机激活的记忆痕迹作门控机制，叠加在元可塑性二值神经网络 (mBNN) 上，并引入已验证的元可塑性优化来增强突触稳定性；对照基线二值模型与全连接持续学习方法。
Result: 在 class-incremental 与 domain-incremental MNIST 两个基准上平均准确率均超过 70%，是唯一做到这一点的策略，匹配全精度 SOTA；峰值 GPU 与 RAM 占用分别低于 5% 与 20%，内存足迹相对全精度降低约 8 倍。
Conclusion: 随机 engram 门控加元可塑性可以在二值架构上同时改善稳定性-可塑性权衡、降低内存开销并保住精度，让二值持续学习逼近全精度水平。

papers.title: VisionLogic: Discovering and Grounding Decision-Relevant Visual Concepts
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based explanations help users understand vision models through recognizable visual patterns. However, existing methods often rely on correlational signals without directly validating which image cues support prediction-relevant internal features. To this end, we introduce VisionLogic, a post-hoc framework that grounds these features in visual concepts through intervention-based validation. VisionLogic first identifies compact sets of features whose contributions reproduce the model's original prediction. It then represents their activation states as predicates using class-specific thresholds. An iterative refinement procedure grounds these predicates in visual regions through ablation tests. A region is accepted when its removal deactivates the corresponding predicate, linking the feature's numerical role to visual evidence in the input. The same predicates allow us to examine how features are activated, selected, and reused across images and classes. Across CNNs and vision transformers on ImageNet-1k, we find that only a few features are selected to explain each prediction, and frequently active features are not always selected. In a large-scale human evaluation with 465 participants, VisionLogic significantly improves participants' understanding of model behavior over established methods ACE and CRAFT. Code is available at https://github.com/allengeng123/VisionLogic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisionLogic 是一个事后 (post-hoc) 视觉概念解释框架：先挑出能复现原预测的紧凑特征集，把激活状态写成带类别阈值的谓词，再用 ablation 测试迭代地把谓词落到具体图像区域——某区域被移除后对应谓词失活即接受该区域。在 ImageNet-1k 的 CNN 与 vision transformer 上，每次预测只用到少数特征，且高频激活的特征并不总被选中；465 人的人类评测中，它对模型行为的理解提升显著优于 ACE 与 CRAFT。
Motivation: 现有基于概念的解释多依赖相关性信号，没有直接验证哪些图像线索真正支撑与预测相关的内部特征，导致概念与视觉证据之间的联系不可靠。
Method: 三步：识别能复现模型原预测的紧凑特征集；用类别特定阈值把特征激活状态表示为谓词 (predicates)；迭代精炼过程通过 ablation 测试把谓词落到视觉区域，区域移除导致谓词失活即被接受。同一套谓词还用于跨图像、跨类别考察特征如何被激活、选择与复用。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1k 上覆盖 CNN 与 vision transformer：每次预测仅少数特征被选中用于解释，而经常活跃的特征并不总被选中。465 名参与者的规模化人类评测中，VisionLogic 对参与者理解模型行为的提升显著优于既有方法 ACE 和 CRAFT。
Conclusion: 基于干预验证（移除区域使谓词失活）能把特征的数值作用与输入中的视觉证据绑定起来，从而比相关性驱动的概念解释更有效地帮助用户理解模型行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EFC++: Elastic Feature Consolidation with Prototype Re-balancing for Cold Start Exemplar-free Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Exemplar-free Class Incremental Learning (EFCIL) aims to learn from a sequence of tasks without having access to previous task data. In this paper, we consider the challenging Cold Start scenario in which insufficient data is available in the first task to learn a high-quality backbone. This is especially challenging for EFCIL since it requires high plasticity, resulting in feature drift which is difficult to compensate for in the exemplar-free setting. To address this problem, we propose an effective approach to consolidate feature representations by regularizing drift in directions highly relevant to previous tasks while employing prototypes to reduce task-recency bias. Our approach, which we call Elastic Feature Consolidation++ (EFC++) exploits a tractable second-order approximation of feature drift based on a proposed Empirical Feature Matrix (EFM). The EFM induces a pseudo-metric in feature space which we use to regularize feature drift in important directions and to update Gaussian prototypes. In addition, we introduce a post-training prototype re-balancing phase that updates classifiers to compensate for feature drift. This strategy allows to improve over our previous EFC method by mitigating the misalignment between stored prototypes and the evolving feature space. Extensive experimental results on Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, ImageNet-1K, and DomainNet show that EFC++ achieves a strong stability--plasticity trade-off in Cold Start and outperforms recent exemplar-free baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/simomagi/elastic_feature_consolidation
papers.comment: Accepted at International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Extension of our previous conference paper https://openreview.net/forum?id=7D9X2cFnt1
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Computer Vision, 134, 454 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EFC++ 在冷启动（Cold Start）无示例类增量学习中，用经验特征矩阵 (Empirical Feature Matrix, EFM) 诱导的伪度量对特征漂移做二阶近似正则，并在训练后用原型重平衡 (post-training prototype re-balancing) 校正分类器。在 Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-Subset、ImageNet-1K 与 DomainNet 上取得强稳定性-可塑性权衡，优于近期无示例基线。
Motivation: 首个任务数据不足以训出高质量 backbone，EFCIL 又要求高可塑性，导致特征漂移且无旧数据可补偿；存储原型与演化特征空间逐渐错位，加剧任务近因偏置 (task-recency bias)。
Method: 提出 EFC++：以 EFM 构造特征空间伪度量，对高相关方向的特征漂移做可解的二阶近似正则，并用同一度量更新高斯原型以抑制近因偏置；训练结束后增加原型重平衡阶段更新分类器，缓解原型与特征空间的错位。
Result: 在 Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-Subset、ImageNet-1K、DomainNet 四个基准上，EFC++ 在 Cold Start 设定下取得强稳定性-可塑性权衡，并优于近期无示例 (exemplar-free) 基线；相对作者前作 EFC 改善了存储原型与演化特征空间的错位。
Conclusion: 在冷启动 EFCIL 中，用二阶漂移几何约束关键方向的可塑性、再以重平衡对齐原型与分类器，可在无旧数据条件下同时保住稳定性与可塑性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Localized time-frequency representation learning for bioacoustic classification in complex soundscapes
papers.abstract_en: Prevailing bioacoustic classifiers assign species labels to fixed time-frequency windows rather than to individual vocalizations. When multiple vocalizations occur within the same window, predictions cannot be unambiguously linked to specific calls, which limits analyses at the level of individual vocalizations. This work introduces a framework for time-frequency localized bird classification. A Local-Context Classifier (LCC) identifies species from localized time-frequency events (TFEs), while a Dual-Context Classifier (DCC) combines local and global acoustic context through a fine-tuned bioacoustic foundation model. On an in-distribution dataset from Singapore comprising 306 vocalization classes from 103 bird species, the LCC achieves an F1-micro score of 79.3%, while combining local and global context through the DCC yields the highest overall performance (94.6%). To reduce labeled data requirements, the LCC is pre-trained via self-supervised contrastive learning, achieving an 18.8% relative gain on an out-of-distribution dataset. A focused evaluation on continuous soundscape recordings further demonstrates the potential of the framework for long-term monitoring applications. By preserving the time-frequency localization of individual vocalizations, the proposed framework supports both ecological monitoring and vocalization-level studies of animal acoustic behavior.

papers.title: FlexQuant: Elastic Quantization Framework for Locally Hosted LLM on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Deploying LLMs on edge devices presents serious technical challenges. Memory elasticity is crucial for edge devices with unified memory, where memory is shared and fluctuates dynamically. Existing solutions suffer from either poor transition granularity or high storage costs. We propose FlexQuant, a novel elasticity framework that generates an ensemble of quantized models, providing an elastic hosting solution with 31x more deployment options, 15x granularity improvement, and 10x storage reduction compared to SoTA methods. FlexQuant works with most quantization methods and creates a family of trade-off options under various storage limits through our pruning method. It brings great performance and flexibility to the edge deployment of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexQuant 面向统一内存、容量动态波动的边缘设备，生成一族量化模型作为弹性驻留方案，通过剪枝方法在不同存储上限下给出权衡选项。相比 SoTA 方法，部署选项多 31 倍、粒度提升 15 倍、存储降低 10 倍，且兼容多数量化方法。
Motivation: 边缘设备统一内存共享且动态波动，现有弹性驻留方案要么切换粒度差、要么存储开销高，难以在容量变化时灵活调整本地 LLM 的内存占用。
Method: 提出弹性量化框架 FlexQuant：生成一组量化模型（ensemble of quantized models）提供弹性驻留，并用其剪枝方法在不同存储限制下构造一族权衡选项；框架可与多数量化方法结合。
Result: 相比 SoTA 方法，FlexQuant 提供 31 倍更多部署选项、15 倍粒度提升、10 倍存储降低。
Conclusion: 在边缘设备上，用一族量化模型加剪枝来匹配波动的存储上限，可同时提高部署选项的粒度并压低存储成本。

papers.title: CATSplat: Context-Aware Transformer with Spatial Guidance for Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting from A Single-View Image
papers.abstract_en: Recently, generalizable feed-forward methods based on 3D Gaussian Splatting have gained significant attention for their potential to reconstruct 3D scenes using finite resources. These approaches create a 3D radiance field, parameterized by per-pixel 3D Gaussian primitives, from just a few images in a single forward pass. However, unlike multi-view methods that benefit from cross-view correspondences, 3D scene reconstruction with a single-view image remains an underexplored area. In this work, we introduce CATSplat, a novel generalizable transformer-based framework designed to break through the inherent constraints in monocular settings. First, we propose leveraging textual guidance from a visual-language model to complement insufficient information from a single image. By incorporating scene-specific contextual details from text embeddings through cross-attention, we pave the way for context-aware 3D scene reconstruction beyond relying solely on visual cues. Moreover, we advocate utilizing spatial guidance from 3D point features toward comprehensive geometric understanding under single-view settings. With 3D priors, image features can capture rich structural insights for predicting 3D Gaussians without multi-view techniques. Extensive experiments on large-scale datasets demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of CATSplat in single-view 3D scene reconstruction with high-quality novel view synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CATSplat 用单张图像做前馈式 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建：以视觉-语言模型的文本嵌入经 cross-attention 补足单视图信息不足，再用 3D 点特征提供空间引导，让图像特征在无多视图对应的情况下预测 3D Gaussians。在大规模数据集上取得单视图 3D 场景重建与新视角合成的 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: 前馈式 3DGS 重建依赖多视图交叉对应，而单目单视图设定下可用信息不足、几何理解受限，这一方向仍未被充分研究。
Method: Transformer 框架分两路引导：一是从 VLM 文本嵌入中提取场景级上下文细节，通过 cross-attention 融入视觉特征；二是引入 3D 点特征作为空间引导（3D priors），使图像特征捕捉结构信息，直接逐像素预测 3D Gaussian primitives，单次前向完成。
Result: 在大规模数据集上的实验显示 CATSplat 在单视图 3D 场景重建与高质量新视角合成上达到 state-of-the-art 性能；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 单视图 3D 重建的瓶颈可以靠文本上下文与 3D 空间先验双重引导突破，无需多视图技术即可达到 SOTA 的新视角合成质量。

papers.title: TACO: Training-free Sound Prompted Segmentation via Semantically Constrained Audio-visual CO-factorization
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pre-trained audio and image models demonstrate an unprecedented degree of generalization, making them suitable for a wide range of applications. Here, we tackle the specific task of sound-prompted segmentation, aiming to segment image regions corresponding to objects heard in an audio signal. Most existing approaches tackle this problem by fine-tuning pre-trained models or by training additional modules specifically for the task. We adopt a different strategy: we introduce a training-free approach that leverages Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) to co-factorize audio and visual features from pre-trained models so as to reveal shared interpretable concepts. These concepts are passed on to an open-vocabulary segmentation model for precise segmentation maps. By using frozen pre-trained models, our method achieves high generalization and establishes state-of-the-art performance in unsupervised sound-prompted segmentation, significantly surpassing previous unsupervised methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACO 用非负矩阵分解 (NMF) 对冻结的预训练音频与视觉特征做协同分解，提取共享可解释概念，再交给开放词汇分割模型输出分割图，全程不训练任何参数。在无监督声音提示分割任务上达到 state-of-the-art，显著超过此前无监督方法。
Motivation: 声音提示分割（按音频中听到的物体分割图像区域）现有做法多依赖微调预训练模型或额外训练模块，代价高且泛化受限。
Method: 训练-free 管线：对预训练音频与视觉模型的特征做 NMF 协同分解，得到共享可解释概念；概念输入开放词汇分割模型生成精确分割图；所有预训练模型保持冻结。
Result: 在无监督声音提示分割上建立 state-of-the-art，显著超越先前无监督方法；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 冻结大规模预训练音频与视觉模型、仅靠 NMF 协同分解即可在该任务上取得最强无监督性能，无需为任务微调。

papers.title: Detection and Characterization of Coordinated Online Behavior: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Coordination is a fundamental aspect of life. The advent of social media has made it integral also to online human interactions, such as those that characterize thriving online communities and social movements. At the same time, coordination is also core to effective disinformation, manipulation, and hate campaigns. This survey collects, categorizes, and critically discusses the body of work produced as a result of the growing interest on coordinated online behavior. We reconcile industry and academic definitions, propose a comprehensive framework to study coordinated online behavior, and review and critically discuss the existing detection and characterization methods. Our analysis identifies open challenges and promising directions of research, serving as a guide for scholars, practitioners, and policymakers in understanding and addressing the complexities inherent to online coordination. We also provide an interactive companion website for exploring the surveyed literature.
papers.comment: Preprint version of an article published in ACM Computing Surveys. Please cite the published version: doi:10.1145/3839225
papers.journal_ref: ACM Computing Surveys, Vol. 58, No. 16, Article 401 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于线上协同行为 (coordinated online behavior) 检测与刻画的综述，收录、分类并批判性讨论相关研究，调和产业界与学术界的定义差异，提出一个研究线上协同行为的统一框架，并据此审查现有检测与刻画方法，最后指出开放挑战与有前景的研究方向。
Motivation: 社交媒体上的协同既支撑社区与社会运动，也是虚假信息、操纵与仇恨活动的核心手段；产业界与学术界定义不一致、方法分散，缺少统一的分析框架供研究者与政策制定者使用。
Method: 综述性工作：收集并分类已有文献，调和 industry 与 academic 定义，提出一个研究线上协同行为的综合框架，再按该框架审查并批判讨论现有检测与刻画方法，同时给出一个可交互的文献浏览配套网站。
Result: 产出为综述本身：一个统一定义与研究框架、对现有检测和刻画方法的批判性梳理，以及识别出的开放挑战与研究方向；配套提供交互式网站用于浏览所综述文献。
Conclusion: 线上协同行为的研究需要先统一定义与框架，再在该框架下比较检测和刻画方法，方能有效支撑学者、从业者与政策制定者应对其复杂性。

papers.title: LaSEr-Edit: Localized Span-level Error Editing with Energy-based Localization
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are widely adopted in real-world applications, it has become critical to ensure LLMs satisfy safety constraints, such as non-toxicity and logical consistency, as well as task- and situation-specific constraints. Controlling the output through instructions is a simple and tempting approach; however, it remains brittle, is opaque in how it influences model behavior, and thus cannot reliably ensure constraint satisfaction. Moreover, most recent controlled text generation (CTG) methods require access to the internal components of language models--such as weights or logits--making them incompatible with popular API-based LLMs. In this work, we propose LaSEr-Edit, a constraint-satisfying text revision method that can be applied to any LLMs, black- or white-box. We first find that lightweight, task-specific energy-based models (EBMs) achieve error-localization performance competitive with or even better than that of much larger LLMs, while operating substantially faster. Based on this finding, we propose two variants of text revision methods that incorporate energy-based error localization: LaSEr-LLM Edit, which instructs an LLM to edit text given EBM-predicted error spans, and LaSEr-EBM Edit, which uses the EBM not only for localization but also for editing by reranking edit candidates. Through experiments in diverse single-constraint control tasks, we show that LaSEr-LLM Edit controls text better than plain LLM-based editing in most of the tasks. We also find that LaSEr-EBM Edit further improves the control performance of LaSEr-LLM Edit and achieves among the strongest controllability across all tasks. Furthermore, we find that LaSEr-Edit, especially LaSEr-EBM Edit, performs well even when multiple constraints are controlled simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LaSEr-Edit：用轻量级任务专用能量模型 (EBM) 定位文本中的违规 span，再让 LLM 或 EBM 本身改写该片段，从而在黑盒与白盒模型上都能满足约束。EBM 的错误定位性能与更大 LLM 相当甚至更好且更快；LaSEr-LLM Edit 在多数单约束任务上优于纯 LLM 改写，LaSEr-EBM Edit 进一步提升并在全部任务中达到最强一档可控性，多约束同时控制时也表现良好。
Motivation: 指令控制输出脆弱且不透明，无法可靠保证约束满足；多数受控文本生成 (CTG) 方法需要权重或 logits，与主流 API 型 LLM 不兼容。
Method: 先训练轻量级任务专用 EBM 做错误 span 定位，再给出两个变体：LaSEr-LLM Edit 把 EBM 预测的错误片段作为指令交给 LLM 改写；LaSEr-EBM Edit 用 EBM 对改写候选重排序，既定位又编辑。在多样的单约束控制任务上做实验。
Result: EBM 错误定位性能与远大的 LLM 相当或更好且显著更快；LaSEr-LLM Edit 在多数任务上比纯 LLM 改写控制得更好；LaSEr-EBM Edit 在其基础上进一步提升，全部任务中达到最强一档可控性；多约束同时控制时（尤其 LaSEr-EBM Edit）仍表现良好。
Conclusion: 轻量 EBM 的 span 级错误定位足以支撑约束满足的文本改写，且不依赖模型内部访问，可同时用于黑盒与白盒 LLM。

summary_sections.method: 先训练轻量级任务专用 EBM 做错误 span 定位，再给出两个变体：LaSEr-LLM Edit 把 EBM 预测的错误片段作为指令交给 LLM 改写；LaSEr-EBM Edit 用 EBM 对改写候选重排序，既定位又编辑。在多样的单约束控制任务上做实验。
summary_sections.result: EBM 错误定位性能与远大的 LLM 相当或更好且显著更快；LaSEr-LLM Edit 在多数任务上比纯 LLM 改写控制得更好；LaSEr-EBM Edit 在其基础上进一步提升，全部任务中达到最强一档可控性；多约束同时控制时（尤其 LaSEr-EBM Edit）仍表现良好。
summary_sections.conclusion: 轻量 EBM 的 span 级错误定位足以支撑约束满足的文本改写，且不依赖模型内部访问，可同时用于黑盒与白盒 LLM。

papers.title: UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts using dense supervision from a teacher. In multi-turn environments, a mistake at a critical decision step can redirect the subsequent rollout toward poor outcomes. We use low teacher confidence on student actions to select high-uncertainty steps for correction. In a controlled ALFWorld study, a single teacher correction at a low-confidence step improves subsequent student behavior and task success, motivating selective intervention during distillation. We propose UOPD, an uncertainty-aware intervention method for on-policy distillation. At low-uncertainty turns, UOPD executes student actions and applies the standard OPD loss. At high-uncertainty turns, it samples and executes teacher actions and trains the student to imitate them through supervised fine-tuning, which minimizes forward Kullback-Leibler divergence in expectation. UOPD utilizes adaptive uncertainty thresholds to target a scheduled intervention rate. Empirically, we evaluate UOPD across a broad range of agentic tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search, demonstrating its superior performance over OPD methods and their variants. UOPD improves WebShop score by up to $15.8\%$ relative to standard OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UOPD 在多轮 agent 的 on-policy distillation 中按教师置信度识别高不确定决策步：低不确定步照常执行学生动作并用标准 OPD 损失，高不确定步改采样并执行教师动作、用最小化前向 KL 的监督微调让学生模仿，且用自适应阈值锁定目标干预率。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search 上优于 OPD 及其变体，WebShop 分数相对标准 OPD 最高提升 15.8%。
Motivation: 多轮环境中关键决策步的一次错误会把后续 rollout 带向差结果，而标准 on-policy distillation 对所有步一视同仁，无法把教师监督集中到真正危险的高不确定步上。
Method: UOPD 用低教师置信度标记学生动作的高不确定步；低不确定步执行学生动作并施加标准 OPD 损失，高不确定步采样执行教师动作并以监督微调让学生模仿（期望意义下最小化前向 KL 散度），干预率由自适应不确定阈值按计划目标调节。先在受控 ALFWorld 研究中验证单次低置信步教师纠正的作用。
Result: 受控 ALFWorld 研究中，在低置信步做一次教师纠正即可改善学生后续行为与任务成功率；在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search 一类 agentic 任务上，UOPD 相对标准 OPD 及其变体表现更优，WebShop 分数相对标准 OPD 最高提升 15.8%。
Conclusion: 把教师干预限定在高不确定步、其余步保持学生自主，是多轮 agent 蒸馏中比全程 OPD 更有效的监督分配方式，且可用自适应阈值控制干预预算。

papers.title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单 GPU、免位姿 (pose-free) 单目预算下的 3D 点跟踪器：2D 轨迹由冻结光流给定，度量精度只取决于像素射线上的深度，因此用 Mamba-3 状态空间模型以 DINOv3 外观特征为条件回归该深度残差。在 TAPVid-3D minival 上 mean metric Average Jaccard 达 0.256，为同等评估条件下最高。
Motivation: 3D/4D 重建、机器人导航与自动驾驶需要以米为单位的绝对点轨迹，而现有最强 3D 跟踪器依赖 attention，显存随帧数线性增长，难以塞进单张消费级 GPU 的免位姿单目预算。
Method: 不端到端学习跟踪，而是组合两个冻结前端：稠密光流提供 2D 对应，单目度量深度网络 (monocular metric-depth) 提供第三维；再用紧凑状态空间模型 Mamba-3 以 DINOv3 外观特征为条件，只学习前端给不出的深度残差。选 SSM 而非 transformer 的理由是其循环状态定长、显存不随帧数增长，而 attention 的 key-value cache 线性增长。
Result: 在 TAPVid-3D minival 上最佳配置取得同等评估条件下最高的绝对度量精度，mean metric Average Jaccard 0.256，超过强前馈跟踪器；配套分析用各竞争方法自带的 evaluator 复现，解释若干已发表跟踪器在该预算下丢失大部分精度的原因。
Conclusion: 把 3D 点跟踪拆成冻结的 2D 对应加可学习的深度残差，并用状态空间模型替代 attention，可以在单 GPU 单目预算内达到有竞争力的绝对度量精度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ADPTNet: Adaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Non-Linear SSM for Sequence Modelling
papers.abstract_en: A central aim of neuromorphic computing is to provide a viable alternative to highly energy-intensive Transformer-based AI. However, efficient alternatives struggle to capture the set of qualities that have secured the Transformer's status as the de facto standard in sequence modelling. Any realistic contender must be data-adaptive, able to capture long-range dependencies, and GPU-parallelisable, but also non-linearly recurrent to enable complex reasoning. Based on evidence suggesting the auditory cortex operates on fixed timescales, this work proposes the ADaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Network (ADPTNet) as a potential solution to achieving all four properties simultaneously. ADPTNet is built around local topological conjugates, obtained by a novel combination of linear attention and Riemannian optimisation, applied to static global dynamics. This enables non-linear yet predictable long-term behaviour. Dynamical systems theory proofs provide theoretical guarantees for the parametric control of ADPTNet's timescales (its Lyapunov spectrum). ADPTNet improves performance on Selective Copying over Hawk, the existing method balancing long-range memory and adaptability, while also improving state tracking over linear SSMs like Mamba. On sequential CIFAR-10, ADPTNet matches linear SSM accuracy and outperforms existing selective models (incl. the Transformer), using fewer parameters. We also introduce a neuromorphic SpikingADPTNet, which achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy on the Spiking Speech Commands dataset ($83.56\%\pm0.15$). Finally, ADPTNet's constant timescales enable two efficient, Jacobian-free extensions to the DEER parallel simulation algorithm (Conv and Forward DEER) that retain the same average convergence. Conv DEER adds no computational overhead beyond the network's forward pass and enables non-linear RNN parallelisation via iterated convolutions for the first time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADPTNet 用线性注意力与 Riemannian 优化组合得到的局部拓扑共轭 (local topological conjugates) 作用于静态全局动力学，构造出可数据自适应、长程依赖、GPU 可并行且非线性递归的序列模型，并以动力系统理论证明其时间尺度（Lyapunov 谱）可参数化控制。在 Selective Copying 上超过 Hawk、状态跟踪优于 Mamba 类线性 SSM，sequential CIFAR-10 上以更少参数匹配线性 SSM 精度并超过含 Transformer 的 selective 模型；SpikingADPTNet 在 Spiking Speech Commands 上取得 83.56%±0.15 的新 SOTA。
Motivation: Transformer 能耗高，而现有高效替代方案难以同时满足数据自适应、长程依赖、GPU 可并行与非线性递归四项要求；神经形态计算需要一个能兼顾这四点的序列建模方案。
Method: 以听觉皮层固定时间尺度的证据为出发点，用线性注意力与 Riemannian 优化的新组合得到局部拓扑共轭并施加于静态全局动力学，实现非线性但可预测的长期行为；由动力系统理论证明 Lyapunov 谱（时间尺度）的参数化控制。常数时间尺度进一步支撑两个免 Jacobian 的 DEER 并行仿真扩展：Conv DEER 与 Forward DEER。
Result: 在 Selective Copying 上优于 Hawk；状态跟踪优于 Mamba 等线性 SSM；sequential CIFAR-10 上以更少参数匹配线性 SSM 精度并超过包括 Transformer 在内的现有 selective 模型；SpikingADPTNet 在 Spiking Speech Commands 上达到 83.56%±0.15 的新 SOTA。Conv DEER 在网络前向传播之外不增加计算开销，首次通过迭代卷积实现非线性 RNN 并行化，且与原 DEER 保持相同的平均收敛性。
Conclusion: 固定时间尺度的非线性 SSM 可以同时拿到数据自适应、长程记忆、GPU 并行与非线性递归四项性质，且常数时间尺度使并行仿真算法的扩展不牺牲收敛速度。
Relevance: 14
