papers.title: Re:Cognize -- Open-Set Comic Character Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: A manga reader meets a character on one page and knows them on sight a hundred pages later, without ever being handed a cast list. Re-identifying comic characters demands the same, open-set and sequential: pages arrive as a stream in reading order, new faces appear before anyone names them, and the cast is assembled as the story is read. $\textbf{Re:Cognize}$ evaluates recognition as the story is read, not against a cast handed over in advance: four protocols on one query stream, from closed-set retrieval to a cast the model must build and grow itself. The surprise is where models fail. Recognising is close to solved: one reference image per character already ranks as well as a gallery built in advance. Knowing what to believe is not: a model that adds its own matches makes its cast worse, while the same growth with correct labels would gain over twenty points of top-1 accuracy. The bottleneck is acceptance, not vision, and one comparison decides it: an addition pays exactly when it is right more often than the cast already was on the queries it takes over. The comparison has nothing to fit, and measured on half of a new corpus it calls the other half correctly. $\textbf{ReCast}$ puts it to work with nothing fitted on data: a cast sheet of one running average per character, grown only where the page itself vouches for a crop. It recovers a third to two thirds of what perfect labels would, depending on whether the cast starts from random examples or from first appearances. Re:Cognize measures whether a model can read along; ReCast is a cast that does. Our claims are on identity maintenance, recognising characters already met; the emergence of new ones is measured as a diagnostic under a fixed reference rule, and we propose no method for it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Re:Cognize 把漫画角色重识别改成按阅读顺序的开放集流式评测：四个协议共用一条查询流，从闭集检索到模型自建并增长的 cast。结论是识别本身接近解决（每角色一张参考图已与预建 gallery 排序相当），瓶颈在接受环节——模型自行加入匹配会让 cast 变差，而带正确标签的同样增长可让 top-1 提升二十多分；ReCast 用每角色一个运行均值、仅在页面本身为某个 crop 背书处增长，零数据拟合即可回收完美标签收益的三分之一到三分之二。
Motivation: 漫画角色重识别是开放集且顺序到达的：新面孔先出现才被命名，cast 只能边读边建，而现有评测默认拿到预先给定的角色表，无法衡量模型能否在流式阅读中决定该相信哪些自匹配。
Method: Re:Cognize 提出四个协议共用一条按阅读顺序的查询流，覆盖闭集检索到模型自建并增长 cast；ReCast 每角色只维护一个运行均值作为 cast sheet，仅当页面本身为该 crop 背书时才增长，接受判据是无参数拟合的比较：一次新增在其接管的查询上正确率须高于 cast 原有正确率。
Result: 每角色一张参考图的排序已与预建 gallery 相当；模型自行加入匹配使 cast 变差，而带正确标签的同等增长可让 top-1 提升二十多分；该接受比较在新语料的一半上测量、在另一半上判对；ReCast 零数据拟合，回收完美标签收益的三分之一到三分之二（取决于 cast 从随机样例还是从首次登场开始）。
Conclusion: 开放集角色重识别的瓶颈是接受而非视觉，判据是新增匹配的正确率是否超过被接管查询上 cast 的既有正确率；新角色出现本身只作为固定参考规则下的诊断测量，作者不为其提出方法。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 每角色一张参考图的排序已与预建 gallery 相当；模型自行加入匹配使 cast 变差，而带正确标签的同等增长可让 top-1 提升二十多分；该接受比较在新语料的一半上测量、在另一半上判对；ReCast 零数据拟合，回收完美标签收益的三分之一到三分之二（取决于 cast 从随机样例还是从首次登场开始）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 开放集角色重识别的瓶颈是接受而非视觉，判据是新增匹配的正确率是否超过被接管查询上 cast 的既有正确率；新角色出现本身只作为固定参考规则下的诊断测量，作者不为其提出方法。

papers.title: Posterior Regimes and Latent Deception: Variational Bayesian Inference in Hidden Markov Models for Sequential Fraud Detection in Financial Transactions
papers.abstract_en: We present a three-tier progression of Hidden Markov Models: maximum-likelihood (Baum-Welch), variational Bayesian (VBEM), and a neural variational extension (Neural VBEM), that model each customer's transaction history as a trajectory through a small number of latent behavioural regimes, one of which is empirically identified as fraud-associated. The Neural VBEM HMM replaces the fixed Gaussian-multinomial emission family with a learned encoder, compressing a 741-dimensional transaction representation into a 64-dimensional latent space in which the VBEM HMM's posterior operates; a UMAP projection of this space reveals that the discovered regimes are not discrete clusters but ordered segments of a single continuous behavioural manifold, with confirmed fraud concentrated at its extreme. We show that the model's natural output, that is, the posterior probability of regime membership, is routinely mistaken for a fraud probability, and quantify the resulting miscalibration (the regime-membership interpretation error, MRIE); a corrected posterior-predictive score, closes most of this gap. We further distinguish batch (smoothed) inference, which uses look-ahead unavailable at deployment time, from filtered (forward-only) inference, and report both. On IEEE-CIS transaction data, the neural tier achieves a 14.4$\times$ fraud enrichment in its identified regime; while its AUPRC trails a discriminative XGBoost baseline, we show this gap is structural and not incidental, and argue the model is best positioned as a calibrated triage and interpretability layer rather than a drop-in ranking replacement.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 10 figures. Adapted from the primary author's MSc dissertation, University of Stirling, Scotland
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把金融交易流的隐马尔可夫模型做成三层递进（Baum-Welch → VBEM → Neural VBEM），用学习编码器把 741 维交易表示压到 64 维潜空间，发现潜在行为 regime 中有一个与欺诈关联，且在 IEEE-CIS 上该 regime 实现 14.4 倍欺诈富集。作者同时指出后验 regime 归属概率常被误当作欺诈概率（MRIE），并主张该模型定位为可校准的分诊与可解释层，而非替代 XGBoost 的排序模型。
Motivation: HMM 的后验 regime 归属概率在实践中被当作欺诈概率使用，造成系统性误校准；同时平滑（batch）推断用了部署时不可得的前视信息，与过滤推断混报会高估线上表现。
Method: 三层 HMM：最大似然 Baum-Welch、变分贝叶斯 VBEM、以及 Neural VBEM——用学习到的 encoder 替换固定 Gaussian-multinomial emission，把 741 维交易表示压缩到 64 维潜空间，VBEM 后验在该空间上运行；用 UMAP 投影检验 regime 结构，并区分 smoothed（batch）与 forward-only filtered 推断分别报告，另提出校正的 posterior-predictive score 缓解 MRIE。
Result: 在 IEEE-CIS 交易数据上，neural 层在其识别出的 regime 内达到 14.4 倍欺诈富集；AUPRC 落后于判别式 XGBoost 基线，作者论证该差距是结构性而非偶然。UMAP 显示 regime 不是离散簇而是单一连续行为流形上的有序区段，确认欺诈集中在该流形极端。
Conclusion: 该模型应作为可校准的分诊与可解释层使用，而非直接替代排序模型；regime 后验概率不等于欺诈概率，需用校正的 posterior-predictive score 而非原始后验做解读。

papers.title: Uncovering shortcut learning in audio classifiers by discovering recurring concepts in temporal explanations
papers.abstract_en: Correlations between events in machine learning datasets may result in shortcut learning, where models learn to predict the target event based on the presence of a correlated event. When these correlations are spurious -- arising from data collection artifacts -- models are likely to perform poorly in practice. We propose a pipeline to uncover shortcut learning in audio classifiers by discovering recurring concepts in their temporal explanations. Specifically, we isolate audio segments that explain classifier decisions, caption them with an ensemble of Large Audio-Language Models, and use a Large Language Model to extract recurring concepts. The resulting concepts can be audited by humans to uncover potential shortcut learning. We evaluate our framework using datasets curated from AudioSet Strong, controlling for the presence or absence of spurious correlations. Results show that this approach reliably uncovers learned shortcuts, such as the model relying on the presence of "laughter" to predict "applause".
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一条从音频分类器的时间解释中挖掘重复概念的流水线：先分离解释分类决策的音频片段，用 Large Audio-Language Models 集成做描述，再由 LLM 抽取重复概念供人工审计，从而发现捷径学习 (shortcut learning)。在按有无虚假相关构造的 AudioSet Strong 数据集上，该方法可靠地还原出已知捷径，例如模型靠“laughter”存在来预测“applause”。
Motivation: 数据集里事件间的虚假相关会让模型依赖共现事件而非目标事件本身，部署时性能骤降；这类捷径藏在模型的时间解释里，缺少可人工审计的发现手段。
Method: 流水线分三步：分离解释分类器决策的音频片段，用 Large Audio-Language Models 集成为片段生成描述，再用 LLM 从描述中抽取重复出现的概念，交由人工审计。评测用从 AudioSet Strong 整理、并控制虚假相关存在与否的数据集。
Result: 在控制了虚假相关有无的 AudioSet Strong 数据集上，该方法可靠地还原出模型学到的捷径，例如模型依赖“laughter”的存在来预测“applause”。
Conclusion: 对时间解释做概念级挖掘可以把音频分类器的捷径变成人类可审计的具体条目，从而定位这类由数据收集伪影造成的虚假相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators
papers.abstract_en: We present a new class of near-linear algorithms for efficiently integrating general tensor fields defined on trees with distance dependent kernels, the Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators (STAD-TFIs). STAD-TFIs exploit the tree's underlying structure through decompositions built around path backbones and single vertex separators, and use two-dimensional fast Fourier transforms to compute interactions jointly. By exploiting this structural information, STAD-TFIs achieve more computationally efficient integration than their regular efficient tree field integrators (TFI) counterparts. We provide a detailed theoretical analysis of our proposed approach and complement it with an exhaustive empirical evaluation, ranging from speed tests on synthetic trees, through accelerated Sinkhorn-based relaxations of the Optimal Transport algorithms on real meshes, to Topological Attention Transformers for vision tasks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide some of the first results showing that efficient to compute and accurate relaxations of the geodesic Sinkhorn-based solutions of the Optimal Transport problem can be derived by applying fast TFI methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Structure-Adaptive Tree Field Integrators (STAD-TFIs)，一类近线性的树上张量场积分算法：沿路径主干 (path backbones) 与单顶点分隔符 (single vertex separators) 分解，用二维 FFT 联合计算核交互，比常规 tree field integrators (TFI) 更省算力。给出理论分析，并在合成树测速、真实网格上的 Sinkhorn 最优传输加速与视觉任务的 Topological Attention Transformers 上做经验验证。
Motivation: 定义在树结构上、核随距离变化的张量场积分是 Optimal Transport 松弛与树注意力模型的瓶颈，常规 TFI 在交互计算上仍不够高效。
Method: STAD-TFIs 利用树结构做基于 path backbones 和 single vertex separators 的分解，用二维 FFT 联合计算交互；评估覆盖合成树测速、真实网格上加速 Sinkhorn-based Optimal Transport 松弛，以及视觉任务中的 Topological Attention Transformers。
Result: 算法达到近线性复杂度并比常规 TFI 更高效；据作者所知，给出了首批结果表明可用快速 TFI 方法导出 geodesic Sinkhorn 最优传输解的高效且精确的松弛。
Conclusion: 把树结构先验与 FFT 结合可同时换取积分效率与精度，使 Sinkhorn-OT 松弛和树注意力视觉模型都能用 TFI 加速。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results
papers.abstract_en: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jev 1.13 是非生成式 System One 模型，只在预定义选项上给概率，无法回答选项外问题。在四个医学基准共 8,469 次请求上，其 top-1 准确率与 GPT-6 Sol（medium reasoning）在 PubMedQA 相当（78.4% vs 78.2%），但在 MetaMedQA（74.8% vs 82.7%）、DiagnosisArena-MCQ（59.8% vs 82.4%）和 NEJM Case Challenges（61.8% vs 82.4%）上更低；作者结论是临床使用前必须做任务特定验证。
Motivation: Jev 这类非生成式、封闭选项的概率模型在医学问答与病例诊断推理上的准确率和校准情况未知，需要与前沿 LLM 直接对照以判断其可用范围。
Method: 评测 Jev 1.13 于四个医学基准：MetaMedQA、PubMedQA、DiagnosisArena-MCQ 与 NEJM Case Challenges，以 GPT-6 Sol（带与不带 medium reasoning）为参照；主要结局为 top-1 准确率，次要结局为校准、选择性预测 (selective prediction) 与不可回答问题识别，共 8,469 次请求。
Result: 全部 8,469 次请求均返回有效答案。PubMedQA 78.4% vs 78.2%（相当），MetaMedQA 74.8% vs 82.7%，DiagnosisArena-MCQ 59.8% vs 82.4%，NEJM 61.8% vs 82.4%。MetaMedQA 上 Jev 校准最好（ECE 0.063 vs 0.146），概率 ≥0.9 的题目占 52.9%、准确率 93.4%，但 GPT-6 Sol 在接受相近比例题目时同样准确；DiagnosisArena-MCQ 上概率判别力差（AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768）。162 道正确答案为“不知道/无法回答”的题中，Jev 选该选项 10.5%（GPT-6 Sol 8.6%）。中位延迟 0.27–0.31 s，2,823 个条目成本 USD 0.08。
Conclusion: Jev 快且便宜，在研究摘要类任务 (PubMedQA) 上与前沿 LLM 相当，但在考试题和复杂诊断病例上明显更弱，临床使用前需任务特定验证。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling. Integrating these, LQN i) adapts and improves zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 by 9.8% Top-1 on OOD ImageNet, ii) outperforms the previous best GS-Bias on fine-grained classification by 3.9% Top-1, iii) achieves faster convergence than TPS for CLIP ResNet-50 (47 mins vs 55 mins), iv) generalizes adaptation to VLMs like SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, and CoCa, and lightweight students like MLP, ResNet, VGG, and v) extends to panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Layer Query Network (LQN)，用一个小的 student 模型在冻结 VLM 的单次前向中，通过 Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) 查询中间层空间 token 的空间坐标来模仿 teacher，并用 Location Consistency Regularization (LCR) 以 O(1) 坐标采样替代 O(H×W) 图像增强。零样本 CLIP ViT-B/16 在 OOD ImageNet 上 Top-1 提升 9.8%，细粒度分类超过 GS-Bias 3.9% Top-1，CLIP ResNet-50 收敛快于 TPS（47 分钟对 55 分钟）。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 的 Test-Time Training (TTT) 需要对多个增强视图各做一次（常含反向）全模型前向，计算代价高；而单次前向的中间层输出本身已比所有增强的最终 embedding 含更多信号。
Method: LQN 让轻量 student 在冻结 teacher VLM 的单次前向中适配：Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) 通过查询中间 token 的空间坐标模仿 teacher 的中间层空间 token；Location Consistency Regularization (LCR) 用 O(1) 坐标采样替代 O(H×W) 图像增强做自监督。
Result: 零样本 CLIP ViT-B/16 在 OOD ImageNet 上 Top-1 提升 9.8%；细粒度分类上超过此前最好的 GS-Bias 3.9% Top-1；CLIP ResNet-50 收敛快于 TPS（47 分钟对 55 分钟）；方法可推广到 SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa 及 MLP、ResNet、VGG 等轻量 student，并扩展到全景、实例与语义分割。
Conclusion: 单次前向的中间层空间信号足以支撑 VLM 的测试时适配，用坐标级自监督替代多视图增强可同时降低成本并提升 OOD 与细粒度表现。

papers.title: SR4-Fit: A Unified Interpretable Rule-Based Machine Learning Framework for Informative and Trustworthy Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: In many high-stakes applications, machine learning is dominated by black-box models that require post hoc explanations to justify their predictions. These explanations are often unreliable because they do not reflect the model's actual computations, limiting accountability and trust. A natural alternative is to use models that are interpretable by design. However, existing rule-based approaches, such as RuleFit and decision trees, while transparent, often lack stability and predictive strength, reinforcing a perceived trade-off between traditional performance measures and model understandability. To address this, we propose Sparse Relaxed Regularized Regression Rule-Fit (SR4-Fit), an intrinsically interpretable algorithm for both classification and regression that produces compact and stable rule sets without sacrificing performance. Using demographic data from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey, SR4-Fit predicts U.S. House election outcomes with high accuracy and interpretability while uncovering demographic interactions missed by black-box models. We further validate SR4-Fit across fourteen benchmark datasets (six classification and eight regression), where it outperforms existing rule-based methods, including RuleFit and decision trees in terms of accuracy, stability, and compactness while remaining competitive with black-box models in predictivity. These results demonstrate that interpretability and predictive reliability need not be mutually exclusive, offering a practical and transparent alternative for high-stakes decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SR4-Fit（Sparse Relaxed Regularized Regression Rule-Fit）是一个内在可解释的规则学习算法，同时支持分类与回归，产出紧凑且稳定的规则集而不牺牲预测性能。在美国国会选举结果预测上它以 ACS 人口普查数据取得高精度并揭示黑箱模型遗漏的人口统计交互；在十四个基准数据集上，它在准确率、稳定性与紧凑度上超过 RuleFit 和决策树，同时与黑箱模型的预测力相当。
Motivation: 高风险场景中黑箱模型依赖事后解释，而这类解释不反映模型真实计算，削弱问责与信任；RuleFit、决策树等规则模型虽透明却缺乏稳定性与预测力，形成性能与可理解性的取舍。
Method: 提出 SR4-Fit：稀疏化、松弛正则化的回归式规则拟合，生成紧凑稳定的规则集，覆盖分类与回归任务。用美国人口普查局 ACS 人口统计数据预测美国众议院选举结果，并在十四个基准数据集（六个分类、八个回归）上与 RuleFit、决策树及黑箱模型对比。
Result: 在 ACS 数据上以高准确率与可解释性预测美国众议院选举结果，并发现黑箱模型遗漏的人口统计交互；在十四个基准数据集（六分类、八回归）上，准确率、稳定性、紧凑度均优于 RuleFit 与决策树，预测力与黑箱模型相当。
Conclusion: 可解释性与预测可靠性不必互相牺牲，规则集模型可以作为高风险决策中黑箱的实用透明替代。

papers.title: Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仿真训练的接触密集操作策略部署到部分观测时，保留可微的状态专家、只学一个视觉状态估计器，并用穿过冻结专家反传的动作一致性损失加权状态误差，比直接从同一演示语料做像素到动作模仿更稳。五个目标条件操作任务上保留专家一致优于像素模仿，Panda 实机 sim-to-real 成功率 76%，无需重训专家。
Motivation: 特权状态策略部署时只能看噪声相机图像，常规 teacher-student 蒸馏要求学生同时推断状态并重新学一遍专家已有的动作映射；而只最小化状态估计误差也不等于最小化由估计误差引起的下游控制误差。
Method: 冻结可微的状态基专家，训练视觉状态估计器：损失同时含直接状态监督和穿过该专家反传的动作一致性损失 (action-consistency loss)，并用调度目标先建立物理上合理的状态估计、再逐步加重影响专家动作的误差项。
Result: 在五个 goal-conditioned 操作任务上，保留专家 (retaining the expert) 一致优于用同一专家演示语料做的直接 pixel-to-action 模仿；在实体 Panda 机器人上实现 sim-to-real 迁移，成功率 76%，且未重训底层专家。
Conclusion: 复用可微状态策略、只学感知接口并按动作影响加权状态误差，比让学生重新学动作映射更有效，且允许不重训专家直接上实机。

papers.title: Maat: Independent Deterministic Contract-Based Governance for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large-language-model multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) introduce a characteristic reliability problem: an error produced by one agent can be accepted as context by downstream agents and propagate across the workflow. Many proposed safeguards rely on learned or LLM-based judges whose verdicts are themselves probabilistic; we ask whether a deterministic layer can instead stop contract-detectable handoff defects. We present Maat, a runtime governance layer that validates agent-to-agent handoffs against a versioned workflow contract, or anchor, with no language model in the validation or scoring path. We evaluate it in six controlled domain workflows (6-15 agents, 522 trials) with injected data-level defects and a deterministic seven-check rubric. Version 1 reported gains in all six workflows (2.9-26.5%). A post-publication audit found that three benchmark scorers credited any early halt as a prevented defect. On paired trials where the governed run completed or halted on a finding attributable to a verified defect, the rubric score changes by +7.7% to +29.1% in five workflows and is flat in software development; model-call cost falls 17-53% where attributable halts occur early. A hand review of all 94 governed-arm halts found 35 false alarms (37%), caused by validator defects rather than model behaviour; counting those halts as failed work, the governed arm scores below the ungoverned arm in four of six workflows. The results support deterministic handoff validation for contract-expressible defects and show that validator configuration and halt attribution must themselves be tested; they do not establish universal correctness, hallucination detection, or model-independent effectiveness.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Benchmarks: https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-benchmarks ; CrewAI integration demo: https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-crewai-demo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Maat 是一个不含任何语言模型的确定性运行时治理层，用带版本的工作流契约 (anchor) 校验 LLM 多智能体之间的 agent-to-agent 交接，拦截契约可表达的缺陷。在 6 个受控领域工作流（6–15 个 agent、522 次试验、注入数据级缺陷、七项确定性评分规则）中，修正评分口径后配对试验的规则得分在 5 个工作流上升 7.7%–29.1%、软件开发持平，模型调用成本在早停场景下降 17%–53%；但 94 次治理臂停机中 35 次（37%）是校验器自身缺陷造成的误报，按失败计则 6 个工作流中有 4 个低于无治理臂。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统里单个 agent 的错误会被下游当作上下文接受并沿工作流传播，而现有防护多依赖本身带概率性的学习型或 LLM 型裁判，需要一条不引入新随机性的拦截路径。
Method: Maat 在验证与打分路径中完全不使用语言模型，按带版本的工作流契约 (anchor) 校验 agent-to-agent 交接；评测设 6 个受控领域工作流（6–15 agents、522 trials），注入数据级缺陷，用确定性的七项检查评分规则 (seven-check rubric) 打分，并对治理臂停机做人工复核与配对试验分析。
Result: V1 版在全部 6 个工作流报告 2.9%–26.5% 的增益；事后审计发现三个 benchmark 评分器把任何早停都记为已阻止缺陷。修正后，在停机可归因于已验证缺陷的配对试验上，规则得分在 5 个工作流上升 +7.7% 到 +29.1%，软件开发持平；归因停机较早时模型调用成本下降 17%–53%。人工复核全部 94 次治理臂停机，35 次（37%）为校验器缺陷导致的误报；把这些停机计为失败工作后，治理臂在 6 个工作流中有 4 个低于无治理臂。
Conclusion: 确定性交接校验对契约可表达的缺陷有效，但校验器配置与停机归因本身必须被测试；结果不支持普适正确性、幻觉检测或与模型无关的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Computer Vision Approach to Visual Fraud Detection in Phishing Websites Using YOLOv8
papers.abstract_en: Phishing remains one of the most common vectors for financial and identity fraud, and most detection systems still rely on inspecting a page's URL, HTML markup, or domain registration history. These signals are easy for an attacker to rotate or obfuscate, and they say very little about what actually convinces a victim to hand over a password or a card number: the way the page looks. This paper describes a visual, image-based approach to phishing detection that treats a rendered webpage the same way a human eye would, as a picture that either matches a trusted brand or doesn't. A YOLOv8 convolutional neural network was trained to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, rather than on text extracted from the page. The system reached 92% classification accuracy on a held-out test set, processed a single screenshot in roughly 100 milliseconds, and, after a round of data augmentation aimed specifically at lighting, compression, and scaling variation, cut the false-positive rate by 11% relative to the pre-augmentation baseline. The paper walks through the dataset construction, the augmentation strategy, the model architecture and training setup, and the resulting performance, and closes with a discussion of where this kind of visual detector fits alongside, rather than instead of, existing URL- and content-based defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 YOLOv8 对整页网页截图做视觉分类，靠布局、logo 位置、配色和登录表单结构判定钓鱼而非解析文本或 URL。在留出测试集上准确率 92%，单张截图约 100 毫秒；针对光照、压缩与缩放的数据增强使误报率相对增强前基线降低 11%。
Motivation: 现有钓鱼检测依赖 URL、HTML 标记和域名注册历史，这些信号易被攻击者轮换或混淆，且无法反映真正诱使受害者交出密码或卡号的页面外观。
Method: 训练 YOLOv8 卷积网络对整页网站截图做二分类（钓鱼/合法），依据布局、logo 摆放、配色与登录表单结构判断；配合针对光照、压缩、缩放变化的数据增强，并说明数据集构建、模型架构与训练设置。
Result: 留出测试集分类准确率 92%；单张截图处理耗时约 100 毫秒；数据增强后误报率相对增强前基线下降 11%。
Conclusion: 视觉检测器应与基于 URL 和页面内容的既有防御并用而非取代它们，作为钓鱼识别的补充通道。

papers.title: LTV-CTDNet: Compositional Turning Decomposition for Short-Term Turning-Movement Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Short-term turning-movement forecasts can support signal control and corridor operations, but unconstrained neural networks may produce physically impossible negative counts or outputs that are not explicitly tied to an approach-demand total. This study introduces the Linear Temporal-Variable Compositional Turning Decomposition Network (LTV-CTDNet), a forecasting framework designed to combine competitive accuracy with structurally admissible outputs. LTV-CTDNet was evaluated using seven months of 15-minute LiDAR observations from eight monitored corridor locations in Nashville, Tennessee. Its lightweight encoder combines recent turning-movement history, weekly time-slot embeddings, and location embeddings. The Compositional Turning Decomposition framework separately predicts nonnegative approach totals and within-approach turning proportions, then reconstructs movement forecasts from these components. Among the evaluated predefined configurations, LTV-CTDNet achieved a movement-level MAE of 1.8189 and RMSE of 3.8072. Its accuracy gains over the strongest sequence models were modest, but it produced no negative forecasts, while unconstrained learned models generated negative values in approximately 10.6% to 29.2% of raw forecast cells. The framework enforces nonnegative outputs and exact agreement between each model-predicted approach total and the sum of its component movements by construction, providing directly interpretable forecasts without clipping or coherence correction.
papers.comment: Accepted: September 26, 2026, for presentation at the 2027 TRB Annual Meeting, Washington, D.C. (Paper No. TRBAM-27-06161)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LTV-CTDNet 用组合式转向分解 (Compositional Turning Decomposition) 把路口转向流量拆成非负的进口道总量与进口道内转向比例，再重构各转向预测，从而在结构上保证输出非负且分量之和与进口道总量严格一致。在 Nashville 八个走廊点位七个月 15 分钟 LiDAR 观测上，movement-level MAE 1.8189、RMSE 3.8072，精度仅略优于最强序列模型，但无任何负值，而无约束模型约 10.6%–29.2% 的原始预测格点出现负数。
Motivation: 短时转向流量预测服务于信号控制与走廊运行，但无约束神经网络会输出物理上不可能的负计数，或与进口道总量不一致的结果，需要裁剪或一致性修正才能使用。
Method: 轻量编码器融合近期转向历史、周时段嵌入 (weekly time-slot embeddings) 与位置嵌入；Compositional Turning Decomposition 分别预测非负进口道总量与进口道内转向比例，再重构转向预测，训练与结构约束共同保证非负与总量一致，无需 clipping 或 coherence correction。
Result: 在七个预定义配置中，LTV-CTDNet movement-level MAE 1.8189、RMSE 3.8072（七个月、八个 Nashville 走廊点位、15 分钟 LiDAR 观测）；相对最强序列模型精度提升有限，但零负值输出，而无约束学习模型约 10.6%–29.2% 的原始预测格点为负。
Conclusion: 把总量与比例分开建模可在不牺牲竞争力精度的前提下，按构造保证非负与进口道-转向一致性，输出可直接解释、无需后处理裁剪。

papers.title: When Known Physics Helps Neural PDE Models: Residual Constraints Out-Regularize Generic Priors for Nonlinear Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE surrogates increasingly incorporate structural priors, yet it is often unclear whether their gains arise from physics-specific information or simply from regularization and training choices. We evaluate several such priors under a common protocol against a matched from-scratch neural operator baseline. Our central result is that a known-equation residual consistently outperforms the best generic regularizer at equal tuning budget. At fixed capacity this benefit appears across linear and nonlinear PDEs, but a capacity sweep reveals a sharp distinction: the advantage persists and grows for Burgers, KdV, and Allen-Cahn, while collapsing toward or below parity for linear heat and advection-diffusion. Thus, the durable value of the residual is specific to nonlinear operators. We further falsify a pre-registered hypothesis that the benefit is activated only by data sparsity: the residual remains advantageous even under full supervision. Its usefulness does, however, have a clear boundary. Under grid under-resolution, nonlinear coarse fields no longer satisfy the naive governing-equation residual, and enforcing it becomes actively harmful. In contrast, cross-family pretraining and in-context conditioning fail to outperform the strong from-scratch baseline in the regime studied. Together, these results identify when known physics provides non-redundant information to neural PDE models, when it does not, and when enforcing it introduces bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一协议下对比多种结构先验与从零训练的 neural operator 基线，发现已知方程的残差约束 (residual constraint) 在同等调参预算下稳定优于最强通用正则化器，且优势在 Burgers、KdV、Allen-Cahn 等非线性 PDE 上随容量增大而扩大，而在线性热方程与 advection-diffusion 上塌缩到持平或更差。证伪了“收益仅由数据稀疏触发”的预注册假设：全监督下残差仍占优；但在网格欠分辨时非线性粗场不再满足朴素方程残差，强制施加反而有害。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 代理模型加入结构先验后收益来源不清：究竟是物理专属信息，还是单纯的正则化与训练选择，需要在匹配基线与统一协议下分离。
Method: 在统一协议下评估多种结构先验，并与容量匹配、从零训练的 neural operator 基线对比；做容量扫描 (capacity sweep)、数据稀疏性消融（含预注册假设的证伪检验），以及网格欠分辨测试，比较残差约束、通用正则化器、cross-family pretraining 与 in-context conditioning。
Result: 同等调参预算下已知方程残差持续优于最佳通用正则化器；固定容量时在线性与非线性 PDE 上均有效，容量扫描显示优势在 Burgers、KdV、Allen-Cahn 上持续并扩大，而对线性 heat 与 advection-diffusion 塌缩至持平或更差；全监督下残差仍占优，证伪数据稀疏触发假设；网格欠分辨时强制残差转为有害；cross-family pretraining 与 in-context conditioning 在所研究范围内未能超过从零训练基线。
Conclusion: 已知物理对神经 PDE 模型的非冗余价值有明确边界：对非线性算子且网格可分辨时残差约束优于通用先验，线性方程上与通用正则化无异，欠分辨时强制施加会引入偏差。

papers.title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
papers.abstract_en: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeroBot 是一个 real2sim 机器人操作学习框架：仅凭物体单视角图像和目标位姿，用 image-to-3D 生成模型得到完整网格，在仿真中做大规模并行强化学习，并用利用生成几何与价值函数的动作空间采样含机器人-物体接触的状态。在真实任务（抓取、推动、铰接物体交互、多阶段操作）上达到 87% 成功率，平均训练时间 119 秒。
Motivation: 机器人操作学习通常依赖人工演示、策略预训练或已知物体模型；ZeroBot 要在三者皆为零的条件下，仅凭单视角图像与目标位姿，把从零训练压缩到分钟级。
Method: 以单视角图像经 image-to-3D 生成模型重建完整物体网格，作为仿真中的物体模型；在仿真中做大规模并行强化学习，并引入利用生成几何与学习到的价值函数的动作空间，专门采样涉及机器人-物体接触的状态以加速训练。
Result: 在真实世界任务（grasping、pushing、articulated object interaction、multi-stage manipulation）上成功率 87%，平均训练时间 119 秒；条件为零人工演示、零策略预训练、零已知物体模型。
Conclusion: image-to-3D 生成模型接入 real2sim 框架可实现快速、自主的机器人学习，无需演示、预训练或已知物体模型。

papers.title: Fisher-Informed Recalibration for Feedback-Based On-Policy Self-Distillation of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Feedback-based on-policy self-distillation has emerged as a promising approach for enabling foundation models, more specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), to learn from their own outputs under external feedback, with a single model serving as both teacher and student. However, such methods can exhibit unstable optimization, conducive to performance collapse during training. To address this limitation, we propose FIRE (Fisher-Informed REcalibration), a dual-branch framework that recalibrates the supervision applied to correct and incorrect on-policy outputs during fine-tuning. For correct responses, FIRE replaces self-distillation with re-weighted on-policy SFT, while for incorrect ones FIRE identifies feedback components that disproportionately influence the teacher-induced update and recalibrates the feedback-conditioned target accordingly. Both branches are influenced by a token-level radius derived in part from a softmax Fisher trace. FIRE separates which direction feedback should move the model from how far the model should move in that direction, while leaving well-behaved feedback supervision unchanged. Our experiments demonstrate that FIRE provides substantially more stable self-distillation while maintaining strong downstream performance, particularly in settings where standard feedback-conditioned distillation becomes unstable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIRE 针对反馈驱动的在策略自蒸馏 (feedback-based on-policy self-distillation) 训练不稳定甚至性能崩溃的问题，把监督拆成对正确与错误输出的双分支重标定：正确输出改用重加权在策略 SFT，错误输出识别过度影响 teacher 更新的反馈成分并重标定目标，两支都受 softmax Fisher trace 导出的 token 级半径约束。实验显示 FIRE 在标准反馈条件蒸馏不稳的设置下显著提升稳定性并保持强下游性能。
Motivation: 反馈驱动的在策略自蒸馏让单一 LLM 同时当 teacher 和 student，但优化不稳定、训练中可能出现性能崩溃，需要区分反馈该往哪个方向推模型与该推多远。
Method: FIRE 是双分支框架：对正确响应用重加权在策略 SFT 取代自蒸馏；对错误响应找出不成比例影响 teacher 诱导更新的反馈成分并重标定反馈条件目标；两支均由部分源自 softmax Fisher trace 的 token 级半径调制，同时对表现良好的反馈监督保持不变。
Result: 实验表明 FIRE 在标准反馈条件蒸馏变得不稳的设置下提供显著更稳定的自蒸馏，同时保持强下游性能。
Conclusion: 把反馈监督的方向与步长解耦、并按 Fisher 信息重标定，可以在不牺牲下游性能的前提下缓解在策略自蒸馏的训练崩溃。

papers.title: EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing them as text inflates sequence length and redundantly encodes structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality receives a learned embedding, time gaps enter through learned attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning event vectors is the central challenge: clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events too few observations for reliable estimates. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen embedding of the event's clinical description from a biomedical language model trained on clinical ontologies, mapped into the model's input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. The residual, a learned low-rank event-specific correction, refines it as evidence accumulates. We run continued pretraining on about 4 million patients' records with three frozen LLM backbones (OLMo2 1B, Llama3.2 1B, and OLMo2 7B), training only the adapter (0.1--0.6% of all parameters). The full adapter outperforms all ablations in held-out next-event prediction on every backbone. Removing the semantic pathway hurts rare events over ten times more than the most frequent ones, whereas removing the residual hurts overall prediction but improves it for the rarest events. On reportable infectious-disease and syndromic downstream classification tasks, EHRAdapt outperforms text-based LLM and count-based baselines, and both pathways improve rare-disease discrimination. The two pathways therefore play complementary roles, visible only when results are broken down by event frequency rather than averaged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EHRAdapt 把 (时间, 模态, 编码) 三元组直接映射进冻结 LLM 的嵌入空间，事件向量拆成语义先验加低秩残差：先验来自生物医学语言模型对事件临床描述的冻结嵌入，残差随证据积累修正。在约 400 万患者记录上只训 0.1–0.6% 参数的持续预训练中，完整 adapter 在三个冻结骨干的留出下一事件预测上全面胜过全部消融；去掉语义通路对高频事件的伤害比对最常见事件大十倍以上，去掉残差损害整体却提升最稀有事件。
Motivation: EHR 序列化成文本会拉长序列并冗余编码结构，而临床词表长尾导致稀有事件观测太少、事件向量估不准，冻结 LLM 难以直接吃 EHR。
Method: EHRAdapt 用 adapter 把三元组直接投进冻结 LLM 嵌入空间：模态用可学习嵌入，时间间隔走可学习 attention bias，事件码用专属向量；事件向量 = 语义先验（生物医学语言模型对临床描述的冻结嵌入，经共享投影映射）+ 低秩事件专属残差。在约 400 万患者记录上做持续预训练，骨干为 OLMo2 1B、Llama3.2 1B、OLMo2 7B，只训 adapter（占全部参数 0.1–0.6%）。
Result: 完整 adapter 在三个骨干的留出下一事件预测上均胜过全部消融；去掉语义通路对稀有事件的损害比最常见事件大十倍以上，去掉残差降低整体预测却提升最稀有事件。在可报告传染病与综合征下游分类上优于基于文本的 LLM 与基于计数的基线，两条通路都提升稀有疾病判别。
Conclusion: 语义先验与证据残差作用互补，只有按事件频次分层而非取平均才能看到；稀有事件靠先验、常见事件靠残差修正。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled. Existing LLM-based financial agents incorporate historical evidence, yet they provide limited support for preserving issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying when historical transitions contribute information beyond the current forecast. We present RICE-Alpha (Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs), a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation. A Multi-Tier Memory Layer grounds news interpretation in temporally eligible issuer-specific history, while a Typed Event Agent constructs event states whose successor relations are formed within issuers and pooled across firms only after valid local pairing. Matured transitions are calibrated by their empirical reliability, and the resulting graph signal is residualized against the Base Alpha and technical view to obtain the RICE Delta. On daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels from 2024 to 2026, RICE-Alpha achieves the strongest results among the evaluated LLM-based agents and momentum across four predictive and four portfolio-level metrics. Its ICIR more than doubles that of the strongest baseline, while net Sharpe ratios reach 1.656 and 1.725 in the U.S. and Hong Kong, respectively. U.S. ablations further show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed. These results indicate that historical event continuation adds incremental information when it is temporally grounded, reliability-calibrated, and introduced as a residual correction to a multi-view forecast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RICE-Alpha 是一个 point-in-time 股票打分框架：用 Multi-Tier Memory Layer 只取时序上合格的发行人历史新闻，Typed Event Agent 在发行人内部构建带后继关系的事件状态，再按经验可靠性校准成熟转移，把图信号对 Base Alpha 与技术视图残差化得到 RICE Delta。在 2024–2026 年 Nasdaq-100 与恒生指数日频面板上，其 ICIR 超过最强基线两倍以上，美/港净 Sharpe 分别达 1.656 与 1.725。
Motivation: LLM 金融智能体虽引入历史证据，但难以在 point-in-time 约束下保留发行人专属事件时序，也无法判断历史转移何时在当前预测之外提供增量信息。
Method: 框架分为历史感知多视图 Base Alpha 与可靠性校准的残差修正两部分：Multi-Tier Memory Layer 提供时序合格的发行人历史，Typed Event Agent 构建事件状态并仅在有效局部配对后跨公司池化后继关系，成熟转移按经验可靠性校准，图信号对 Base Alpha 与技术视图残差化得到 RICE Delta。
Result: 在 2024–2026 年 Nasdaq-100 与恒生指数日频面板上，RICE-Alpha 在四个预测类与四个组合类指标上于所评估 LLM 智能体与动量基线中最强；ICIR 超过最强基线两倍，净 Sharpe 在美国与香港分别为 1.656 与 1.725。美国市场消融中，移除主要组件后 IC 与 RankIC 经 Holm 校正显著下降。
Conclusion: 历史事件延续只有在时序落地、可靠性校准并以残差修正方式引入多视图预测时，才提供增量信息。

papers.title: T-SNN: Temporal Simplicial Neural Network for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Decoding brain states requires models that capture both the evolution of neural activity and interactions among groups of brain regions. Existing EEG methods often treat recordings as multivariate time series or represent functional connectivity with pairwise graphs, leaving dynamic higher-order interactions largely unmodeled. We introduce the Temporal Simplicial Neural Network (T-SNN), which represents EEG recordings as sequences of evolving simplicial complexes. By combining simplicial convolutions with recurrent updates, T-SNN jointly learns higher-order interactions and their temporal evolution. On the seven-class SEED-VII emotion recognition task, T-SNN outperforms convolutional, recurrent, graph-based, and Transformer methods in both trial-wise and cross-subject evaluations. Incorporating eye-movement features further improves performance, demonstrating the framework's potential for multimodal brain-state decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-SNN 把 EEG 记录表示为随时间演化的单纯复形 (simplicial complex) 序列，用单纯卷积加循环更新联合学习脑区群之间的高阶交互及其时间演化。在七类 SEED-VII 情绪识别上，它在 trial-wise 与 cross-subject 两种评测中都超过卷积、循环、图网络与 Transformer 方法，再加入眼动特征还能进一步提升。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 方法把记录当多变量时间序列，或用成对图表示功能连接，动态的高阶（三个及以上脑区群）交互基本没有被建模，而脑状态解码同时需要时间演化与区域间交互结构。
Method: 将 EEG 编码为演化的 simplicial complexes 序列，模型 T-SNN 把 simplicial convolution 与 recurrent update 结合，联合学习高阶交互及其时间演化；评测覆盖 trial-wise 与 cross-subject 两种划分，并在特征层面加入眼动 (eye-movement) 特征做多模态扩展。
Result: 在七类 SEED-VII 情绪识别任务上，T-SNN 在 trial-wise 和 cross-subject 评测中均优于卷积、循环、基于图的和 Transformer 方法；加入眼动特征后性能进一步提高。
Conclusion: 高阶单纯结构加循环演化是 EEG 脑状态解码的有效表示，且该框架可扩展到多模态脑状态解码。

papers.title: MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaSampling 是一个免训练、即插即用的帧采样策略，叠加在已有帧选择器之上，按需动态削减送入 MLLM 的帧数，从而在保持甚至提升答案准确率的同时降低长视频 VQA 的开销。在 36 组帧选择器–MLLM 主干–VQA 基准配置中，它在全部 36 组都减少帧数、在 25 组提升准确率，平均减帧 8.9%，整体准确率略有上升。
Motivation: 长视频 VQA 中帧选择方法通常工作在固定全局选择预算下，无法按问题动态收缩送入 MLLM 的帧数，导致效率受限。
Method: 提出训练-free、plug-and-play 的 MetaSampling，叠加在现有帧选择器（如 top-k embedding 检索与均匀采样）之上，动态决定实际传给 MLLM 的帧数；在 36 组帧选择器–MLLM 主干–VQA 基准配对上评测。
Result: 36 组配置中全部 36 组都减少了选中帧数，25 组准确率提升，平均减帧 8.9%，整体准确率略有提升。
Conclusion: 在固定选择预算之外再做一层动态减帧，可以在长视频 VQA 中同时拿到效率与准确率收益，且无需重新训练。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
papers.abstract_en: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^ω_β$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $Δ$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^ω_β$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UnfoldCRF 把掩码精修写成像素标签与隐区域变量上的条件随机场 (CRF) 推断，用展开的阻尼 mean-field 更新统一能量，从而把结构贡献与单纯参数量区分开。在 COD10K 上比同参数同阶段数的循环黑盒精修器高 1.0 Fωβ 点、把变差图像比例从 11.7% 降到 8.5%，在未见过的掩码生成器上增益 2.0 对 0.6 Fωβ 点。
Motivation: 学习式掩码精修的收益难以归因：无法判断提升来自显式结构还是额外容量，也不清楚当掩码生成器或其误差分布改变时是否仍然成立。
Method: 把精修建模为像素标签与隐区域变量上的 CRF 推断，能量含校正 unary 项、学习式局部 pairwise 交互、图像条件化的隐区域一致性项，以及允许弱标签一致区域退出一致性项的 null state；推断用阻尼 mean-field 更新在该能量上展开。对照组是读取相同输入、参数预算、阶段数与监督的循环黑盒精修器。
Result: COD10K 上比最强匹配对照高 1.0 Fωβ 点，四项 COD 指标全部改善，变差图像比例由 11.7% 降至 8.5%。在五个数据集与多种掩码来源的 train-once 协议下，2.6M 参数版本取得 4.2 平均 ΔIoU，对照为 2.0；基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的版本以约七分之一常驻参数追平最强基础模型精修器并仍领先自身对照。在训练中未见的掩码生成器上增益 2.0 Fωβ 点，对照为 0.6。消融显示 pairwise 消息主要修边界错误，区域消息主要修非边界错误。
Conclusion: 显式 CRF 结构本身带来超出等容量黑盒的精修收益，且在掩码生成器分布变化时更稳健；结构化消息的作用可按边界与非边界错误分工归因。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: COD10K 上比最强匹配对照高 1.0 Fωβ 点，四项 COD 指标全部改善，变差图像比例由 11.7% 降至 8.5%。在五个数据集与多种掩码来源的 train-once 协议下，2.6M 参数版本取得 4.2 平均 ΔIoU，对照为 2.0；基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的版本以约七分之一常驻参数追平最强基础模型精修器并仍领先自身对照。在训练中未见的掩码生成器上增益 2.0 Fωβ 点，对照为 0.6。消融显示 pairwise 消息主要修边界错误，区域消息主要修非边界错误。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式 CRF 结构本身带来超出等容量黑盒的精修收益，且在掩码生成器分布变化时更稳健；结构化消息的作用可按边界与非边界错误分工归因。

papers.title: A packet-level digital hardware twin for commissioning megahertz diagnostic edge AI and plasma control system integration in tokamaks
papers.abstract_en: High-bandwidth plasma diagnostics increasingly provide inputs to machine learning and signal-processing algorithms intended for real-time tokamak control, but the complete path from diagnostic sampling to control-system handoff is difficult to commission because of their sampling rates. We develop a packet-level digital hardware twin for the megahertz diagnostic edge-AI architecture. The simulator represents a 64-channel, 1 MHz beam emission spectroscopy (BES) diagnostic embedded in a 96-channel dual-carrier acquisition system, two 48-channel streams with SPAD0 sample counters, 10 GbE Hardware UDP transport, packet loss and network jitter, FPGA parsing and dual-carrier alignment, causal preprocessing and edge inference, a compact Ethernet result packet, receiver-side shared state, and a 1 kHz PCS-like control cycle. Binary UDP payloads and PCAP files are generated rather than emulating transport only at the array level. With a baseline of 20 samples per packet, each carrier generates 50,000 packets s$^{-1}$ and 100 MB s$^{-1}$ of user payload. A 110 ms reference run produces 11,000 HUDP packets; an intentionally dropped 20-sample packet is detected by the sample-counter continuity logic and invalidates the two overlapping 128-sample inference windows without silent interpolation. For valid windows, the configured engineering latency model gives a median last-input-to-shared-memory latency of 91.6 us and a 99th percentile of 108.1 us. A separate operating-system loopback test sends binary FPGA-result datagrams through a UDP receiver into POSIX shared memory and preserves packet sequence and CRC for 20/20 packets. Interactive GUI interfaces expose timing, packetization, network faults, inference thresholds, and control-state inspection. The framework provides a reproducible environment for testing diagnostic-to-accelerator interfaces and fail-safe behavior for deployment on fusion devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为托卡马克 MHz 级诊断到边缘 AI 再到等离子体控制的链路提出包级数字硬件孪生，生成真实二进制 UDP 载荷与 PCAP，覆盖 64 通道 1 MHz BES、双载波采集、10 GbE 传输、FPGA 解析、因果预处理与 1 kHz PCS 控制周期。110 ms 参考运行产生 11,000 个 HUDP 包，工程时延模型给出中位 91.6 us、99 分位 108.1 us；丢包被采样计数连续性逻辑检出并作废两个重叠推理窗，不做静默插值。
Motivation: 高带宽诊断以 MHz 采样率供实时控制用的 ML 算法，从采样到控制交接的整条链路因采样率过高而难以调试 (commissioning)。
Method: 构建包级数字硬件孪生：模拟 64 通道 1 MHz BES 嵌入 96 通道双载波采集（两路 48 通道、SPAD0 采样计数器）、10 GbE Hardware UDP 传输与丢包抖动、FPGA 解析与双载波对齐、因果预处理与边缘推理、紧凑 Ethernet 结果包、接收端共享状态及 1 kHz PCS 式控制周期；生成二进制 UDP 载荷与 PCAP 文件而非仅在阵列层模拟传输，并配交互式 GUI 暴露时序、打包、网络故障、推理阈值与控制状态。
Result: 基线每包 20 采样时每载波 50,000 packets/s 与 100 MB/s 用户载荷；110 ms 参考运行产生 11,000 个 HUDP 包；故意丢弃的 20 采样包被采样计数连续性逻辑检出并作废两个重叠的 128 采样推理窗；有效窗的工程时延模型中位 last-input-to-shared-memory 91.6 us、99 分位 108.1 us；独立 OS 环回测试经 UDP 接收器送 FPGA 结果报文入 POSIX 共享内存，20/20 包保持序列与 CRC。
Conclusion: 包级孪生加二进制 PCAP 可复现地测试诊断到加速器接口与失效保护行为，丢包时按连续性逻辑作废推理窗而非静默插值，可作为聚变装置部署前的调试环境。

papers.title: ASTRA: ADMM-Accelerated Topology Reconfiguration for Dynamic Satellite Constellations
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic topology reconfiguration is central to the reliability and efficiency of large satellite constellations, yet many existing approaches rely on idealized assumptions such as full constellation deployment or uniform orbital spacing. We present Adaptive Satellite Topology via Regret-Aware learning (ASTRA), a theoretically-grounded framework for dynamic satellite topology reconfiguration that builds on an online learning formulation and makes it computationally practical. ASTRA combines an ADMM-based offline solver with efficient online updates for both online gradient descent and online conditional gradient, yielding markedly cheaper constrained updates than generic optimization pipelines. On the theory side, we show that for a relevant class of entry-wise nonzero utility matrices, the objective is strongly convex, which yields logarithmic static regret for online gradient descent, and we further instantiate known dynamic-regret guarantees under inexact ADMM inner loops. Empirically, ASTRA matches or improves topology quality, presenting a good trade-off with computational time on synthetic constellations, and it remains effective on real Starlink data under partial deployment and non-uniform spacing, where idealized structural assumptions break down. These results position ASTRA as an efficient and theoretically grounded approach to topology reconfiguration in realistic Low Earth Orbit networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASTRA 把卫星星座拓扑重配置写成在线学习问题，用 ADMM 离线求解器加在线梯度下降/在线条件梯度的高效更新，使带约束的每步更新比通用优化管线便宜得多。理论上对一类逐项非零效用矩阵证明目标强凸，从而 OGD 获得对数静态 regret，并在非精确 ADMM 内循环下承接已知的动态 regret 保证；在合成星座上拓扑质量持平或更优且计算时间更省，在 Starlink 真实数据的部分部署与非均匀间隔设定下仍然有效。
Motivation: 现有星座拓扑重配置方法多依赖全星座部署、轨道均匀间隔等理想化假设，一旦落到部分部署的真实 LEO 网络（如 Starlink）这些结构性假设就失效，且通用优化管线的在线约束更新代价过高。
Method: ASTRA（Adaptive Satellite Topology via Regret-Aware learning）基于在线学习形式化：ADMM 离线求解器负责预计算，线上分别配合 online gradient descent 与 online conditional gradient 做高效更新；理论侧证明一类逐项非零 (entry-wise nonzero) 效用矩阵下目标强凸，并在非精确 ADMM 内循环中实例化已知的动态 regret 保证。
Result: 在合成星座上 ASTRA 的拓扑质量持平或更优，并在计算时间上呈现良好折中；在真实 Starlink 数据、部分部署与非均匀间隔的设定下（理想化结构假设失效处）依然有效。理论上给出强凸性条件、OGD 的对数静态 regret，以及非精确 ADMM 内循环下的动态 regret 保证。
Conclusion: 把 ADMM 离线预计算与轻量在线更新结合，可以在不牺牲拓扑质量的前提下让动态拓扑重配置在真实、非理想化的 LEO 网络中跑得动，且有 regret 理论支撑。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在七个公开杂草检测数据集上系统评测 YOLO26 nano/small/medium 变体，覆盖不同作物、杂草种类、田间条件与标注协议。YOLO26m 平均精度最高，YOLO26s 精度-效率折中最佳，但跨域场景下 YOLO26s 平均 mAP50:95 从 0.603 跌至 0.148；多源联合训练只能部分缓解域偏移，作者据此强调数据集多样性与目标域适配。
Motivation: 多数杂草检测研究只在单一数据集上评测，无法判断模型在不同农业域之间的鲁棒性，跨域性能衰减程度缺乏可比基准。
Method: 构建多数据集基准，评测 YOLO26 的 nano、small、medium 三个变体于七个公开杂草检测数据集；指标含检测精度、模型复杂度、推理延迟、FPS 与模型 size；除 in-dataset 评测外，用统一 one-class 杂草设定做跨域泛化测试，并用全部数据集的训练子集做 multi-source 联合训练。
Result: YOLO26m 取得最高平均精度，YOLO26s 提供最佳精度-效率折中；跨域设定下 YOLO26s 平均 mAP50:95 从 in-domain 0.603 降至 0.148；multi-source 训练在若干数据集上提升性能，但未完全消除 domain shift。
Conclusion: 杂草检测的跨域性能会大幅下降，仅靠多源联合训练不足以消除域偏移，真实部署需结合数据集多样性、域相似性与目标域适配。

papers.title: RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reward models (RMs) are a key component of large language model post-training, providing reward signals for subsequent reinforcement learning. However, conventional discriminative RMs typically output only scalar scores, making it difficult to identify the response behaviors associated with their scoring decisions. Existing interpretation methods often rely on predefined high-level attributes and require repeated counterfactual interventions for each response pair to validate candidate explanations, lacking a closed-loop mechanism that uses RMs' feedback to train a reusable explainer. To address this, we propose RewardExplainer, a framework that obtains feedback from the target reward model through counterfactual rewriting and uses this feedback to further optimize the explainer. RewardExplainer generates open-ended, atomic, and intervenable natural-language scoring mechanisms, making explanations more concrete, readable, and actionable. It further converts counterfactual feedback into preference supervision, enabling the explainer to more faithfully capture the target RM's scoring preferences and sensitive behaviors than single-pass generation. Extensive experiments across multiple target RMs and explainer backbones show consistent improvements. Beyond interpretation, we use the generated mechanisms to identify potential bias patterns and construct targeted debiasing data for fine-tuning the reward model, improving robustness on reward-hacking benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RewardExplainer 用反事实改写从目标奖励模型 (RM) 拿反馈，再把该反馈转成偏好监督来训练一个可复用的解释器，生成开放、原子化、可干预的自然语言打分机制。相比单次生成，它更能忠实刻画 RM 的打分偏好与敏感行为，并在多个 RM 与解释器骨干上取得一致改进。
Motivation: 判别式 RM 只输出标量分数，难以定位打分对应的具体响应行为；现有解释方法依赖预设高层属性、且对每对响应反复做反事实干预，缺少用 RM 反馈闭环训练可复用解释器的机制。
Method: 通过反事实改写 (counterfactual rewriting) 从目标 RM 获取反馈，并用该反馈优化解释器；生成开放、原子、可干预的自然语言打分机制，再把反事实反馈转为偏好监督 (preference supervision) 训练解释器；实验覆盖多个目标 RM 与解释器骨干。
Result: 在多个目标 RM 与解释器骨干上均有一致改进，解释比单次生成更忠实捕捉 RM 的打分偏好与敏感行为；生成的机制还被用于识别潜在偏见模式、构造定向去偏数据微调 RM，提升其在 reward-hacking 基准上的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把反事实反馈闭环转成偏好监督，可训练出可复用、可干预的 RM 解释器；这些机制还能直接转为去偏数据来增强 RM 对 reward-hacking 的鲁棒性。

papers.title: ICMAPE: In-Context Multiagent Pure Exploration
papers.abstract_en: In some multi-agent systems, the quantity to be optimized is not an externally specified reward but the information acquired about unknown properties of the environment as done in active sequential hypothesis testing (ASHT) problems. However, the ASHT literature tends to focus on finite single-agent problems with well-specified models, while there is currently a gap for practical multi-agent methods that can perform active sequential testing. We fill this gap with ICMAPE, a Bayesian learning-based framework for decentralized multi-agent pure-exploration driven by inference objectives. ICMAPE converts the fixed-confidence identification objective into a reward derived from inference confidence, so that standard reinforcement learning machinery can be applied to decentralized pure exploration. It jointly learns a centralized neural inference network that estimates a posterior distribution over hypotheses from global trajectory data, and decentralized policies that select actions from local observation histories and learn when to stop collecting data once the target confidence is reached. On two synthetic benchmarks and a Maryland nitrate concentration monitoring task based on real-world data, ICMAPE-TD3 achieves target accuracy with fewer exploration steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ICMAPE 把固定置信度的主动序贯假设检验 (ASHT) 目标转成由推理置信度导出的奖励，从而用标准 RL 机制做去中心化多智能体纯探索：联合训练一个从全局轨迹估计假设后验的集中式神经推理网络，以及从局部观测历史选动作、并在达到目标置信度时停止的去中心化策略。在两个合成基准和基于真实数据的 Maryland 硝酸盐浓度监测任务上，ICMAPE-TD3 以更少探索步数达到目标精度。
Motivation: ASHT 文献集中于有限、单智能体且模型设定良好的问题，缺少能在去中心化设定下做主动序贯检验的实用多智能体方法。
Method: Bayesian learning 框架 ICMAPE：将固定置信度识别目标改写为来自推理置信度的奖励，使标准 RL 可用于去中心化纯探索；同时训练集中式神经推理网络（从全局轨迹数据估计假设上的后验分布）与去中心化策略（依据局部观测历史选动作，并学习何时在达到目标置信度后停止采集数据），实例化为 ICMAPE-TD3。
Result: 在两个合成基准与一个基于真实数据的 Maryland 硝酸盐浓度监测任务上，ICMAPE-TD3 以更少探索步数达到目标精度。
Conclusion: 把识别目标转成推理置信度奖励后，标准 RL 机制足以驱动去中心化多智能体主动序贯检验，并在真实环境监测任务上以更少数据达到目标置信度。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Privacy Fallacy of Crowdsourced Fine-Tuning: Extracting Proprietary Data via Topic-Based Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used to adapt large language models to downstream tasks. Crowdsourcing user conversations is an established approach to collecting SFT data at scale while reducing the need for costly manual annotation. However, it also allows untrusted users to contribute data to the fine-tuning pipeline. We investigate an underexplored privacy risk arising from this setting: can a malicious user poison a small fraction of the crowdsourced data to amplify extraction of previously unseen instructions contributed by other users? We show that this is possible using only black-box, output-only access to the deployed model. Experiments across four models and two datasets demonstrate substantial increases in training-data extraction: with only 50 poisoned examples, near-verbatim extraction reaches $3.71\times$ the rate without poisoning for Qwen2.5-14B on OpenMathInstruct and $3.08\times$ for Llama-3.1-8B on AceReason. Data filtering also proves largely ineffective in detecting poisoned samples: even the best-performing method achieves only 0.378 in F-1 score, leaving the majority of poisoned samples undetected. These findings demonstrate that seemingly benign crowdsourced contributions can amplify leakage of other records while remaining difficult to identify through data filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 众包 SFT 数据中，恶意用户只需注入极少量按主题构造的毒化样本，就能在仅有黑盒输出访问的条件下放大其他用户私有指令的逐字泄露：50 条毒化样本使 Qwen2.5-14B 在 OpenMathInstruct 上的训练数据提取率达到无毒化的 3.71 倍，Llama-3.1-8B 在 AceReason 上为 3.08 倍。数据过滤基本失效，最好的方法 F1 仅 0.378，多数毒化样本检不出来。
Motivation: 众包对话收集 SFT 数据虽省去人工标注，却让不可信用户进入微调管线；此前未被充分研究的风险是：毒化少量数据能否放大对其他用户未见过指令的提取。
Method: 在仅黑盒、仅输出 (output-only) 访问已部署模型的设定下，构造基于主题的毒化样本注入众包 SFT 数据，跨四个模型、两个数据集测量训练数据提取率，并测试数据过滤方法对毒化样本的检出能力。
Result: 仅 50 条毒化样本：Qwen2.5-14B 在 OpenMathInstruct 上近逐字提取率达到无毒化的 3.71 倍，Llama-3.1-8B 在 AceReason 上为 3.08 倍；数据过滤中表现最好的方法 F1 仅 0.378，多数毒化样本未被检出。
Conclusion: 看似无害的众包贡献能放大其他记录的泄露，且难以被数据过滤识别——众包 SFT 的隐私假设在黑盒攻击者面前不成立。

papers.title: From HL to H+L-1 Parameters: A Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Linear forecasters have shown competitive accuracy against Transformer-based models in long-term time series forecasting. We study how classical stationary prediction theory can guide parameter sharing for more compact linear forecasters. For centered second-order stationary processes with nonsingular history covariance, the minimum-MSE finite-window linear predictor factors into a Hankel cross-covariance matrix and an inverse Toeplitz covariance matrix. Shared lags and scale cancellation specify this predictor using $H+L-1$ autocorrelations for lookback $L$ and horizon $H$. Building on the innovations representation, our Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster (HTF) learns one impulse response that defines both an inverse filter and a forecast map. We characterize the finite-history correction and, under summability assumptions, bound the excess risk of truncating the true filters. HTF uses $H+L-1$ trainable coefficients while allowing a full-rank forecasting matrix. Across seven benchmarks at $L=336$, its horizon-averaged MSE is within 1.2% of Dense Linear on each dataset with 75-229 times fewer trainable parameters.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把经典平稳预测理论用于长期时间序列预报的参数共享：最小 MSE 有限窗线性预测器可分解为 Hankel 互协方差与 Toeplitz 协方差逆，只需 H+L-1 个自相关即可指定。据此提出的 Hankel-Toeplitz Forecaster (HTF) 用单一冲激响应同时定义逆滤波器与预报映射，在 L=336 的七个基准上 horizon 平均 MSE 与 Dense Linear 相差不超过 1.2%，可训练参数少 75–229 倍。
Motivation: 长期时间序列预报中线性模型已能与 Transformer 竞争，但稠密线性预报器参数量大；如何用经典平稳预测理论指导参数共享、得到更紧凑的线性预报器尚不清楚。
Method: 对中心化二阶平稳过程且历史协方差非奇异的情形，将最小 MSE 有限窗线性预测器分解为 Hankel 互协方差与逆 Toeplitz 协方差；用共享时滞与尺度消去将其压缩为 H+L-1 个自相关。基于新息表示 (innovations representation) 的 HTF 学习单一冲激响应，同时定义逆滤波器与预报映射，并刻画有限历史修正、在可和性假设下给出截断真实滤波器的超额风险界。
Result: HTF 仅用 H+L-1 个可训练系数却允许满秩预报矩阵；在 L=336 的七个基准上，其 horizon 平均 MSE 在每个数据集上与 Dense Linear 相差在 1.2% 以内，同时可训练参数少 75–229 倍。
Conclusion: 经典平稳预测理论给出的 Hankel-Toeplitz 结构足以在几乎不损失精度的前提下把线性长期预报器的参数量压缩两个数量级以上，紧凑线性预报器可替代稠密版本。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: High-Level Text Preprocessing for Semantic Similarity Analysis of Discursive Texts: A Framework and Empirical Demonstration
papers.abstract_en: Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) methods assume that a document's lexical content faithfully represents what it asserts. This assumption fails for discursive documents that discuss, compare, critique, and contextualize other positions in the process of articulating their own. The result is semantic diffusion: similarity scores between documents are inflated by vocabulary acquired through discursive engagement rather than substantive alignment. Standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) preprocessing (tokenization, stopword removal, stemming, lemmatization) cannot address this problem because it operates at the lexical level, treating all content identically regardless of its discursive function. This paper introduces high-level text preprocessing: a systematic, rule-based intervention applied before the standard preprocessing pipeline to isolate each document's actual claim from its discursive structure. We propose 12 rules, each with an explicit rationale, and demonstrate their effect on an encyclopedic philosophical corpus: three entries from the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (virtue ethics, deontological ethics, and consequentialism). A three-phase experiment using eight Transformer-based STS models shows that preprocessing reduces centroid cosine similarity scores across all three theory pairs, with 23 of 24 model-pair comparisons showing the expected decrease and cross-model agreement ranging from 7-1 to 8-0. We introduce the semantic diffusion index (SDI), a per-document metric for assessing the semantic reorientation between a document's raw and high-level preprocessed representations. Although the framework is demonstrated using philosophical texts, it potentially addresses a domain-agnostic problem applicable to legal texts, policy documents, academic articles, and any genre in which a discursive approach introduces vocabulary from positions the document does not endorse.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 tables, 39 references; submitted for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出高层文本预处理 (high-level text preprocessing)：在分词、去停用词、词干化之前用 12 条规则把文档的实际主张与其话语结构分离，以纠正话语性文本中词汇借用导致的语义相似度虚高（semantic diffusion）。在 Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy 三个条目（美德伦理、义务论、后果主义）上用 8 个 Transformer STS 模型做三阶段实验，24 组模型-理论对比较中 23 组的质心余弦相似度如预期下降，跨模型一致性达 7-1 至 8-0。
Motivation: 标准 STS 假设词汇内容忠实代表文档主张，但讨论、比较、批评他者立场的话语性文档会借入非自身立场的词汇，使相似度被虚高；现有 NLP 预处理只在词法层面操作，无法按话语功能区分内容。
Method: 在标准预处理流水线之前插入 12 条带明确理由的规则式干预，隔离文档实际主张；三阶段实验用 8 个基于 Transformer 的 STS 模型，比较原始与高层预处理后的质心余弦相似度，并提出逐文档的 semantic diffusion index (SDI) 度量原始与预处理表示之间的语义重定向。
Result: 在 Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy 三个条目（virtue ethics、deontological ethics、consequentialism）构成的三组理论上，预处理使全部三组的质心余弦相似度下降；24 个模型-理论对比较中 23 组出现预期下降，跨模型一致性范围 7-1 到 8-0。
Conclusion: 语义相似度虚高源于话语性词汇借用而非实质立场一致，在词法预处理之前做规则式的话语结构剥离即可纠正；框架虽在哲学文本上演示，作者称其适用于法律、政策文档与学术文章等任何会引入非自身立场词汇的体裁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Simify 是一个免训练的测试时空间推理框架：从单张 RGB-D 图用 3D 生成模型与视觉语言模型重建可仿真资产，再在奖励函数下并行上千次 rollout 并用进化搜索优化物体摆放，通常数秒内收敛。在真实机器人上端到端完成此前未见物体的复杂重排任务，效果超过既有的空间推理基础模型方法。
Motivation: 长时程多物体操作需要显式空间推理，而现有做法依赖空间推理基础模型，缺少在推理阶段直接搜索物体布局的手段。
Method: 训练-free 测试时框架 Simify：输入单张 RGB-D 图，借助 3D 生成模型与 vision-language model 重建仿真就绪资产；给定奖励函数（如搭最高塔）后在物理仿真中发起数千并行 rollout，用进化搜索优化物体摆放。
Result: 在真实机器人硬件上定量实验，端到端执行含此前未见物体的复杂物体重排任务；相对空间推理基础模型的既有工作表现更优，收敛通常在数秒内完成，并显示完整准确的几何对 sim-to-real 迁移至关重要。
Conclusion: 推理期大规模并行仿真加进化搜索可替代（或补强）空间推理基础模型来做机器人操作的空间推理，前提是重建的几何足够完整准确以支撑 sim-to-real。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 训练-free 测试时框架 Simify：输入单张 RGB-D 图，借助 3D 生成模型与 vision-language model 重建仿真就绪资产；给定奖励函数（如搭最高塔）后在物理仿真中发起数千并行 rollout，用进化搜索优化物体摆放。
summary_sections.result: 在真实机器人硬件上定量实验，端到端执行含此前未见物体的复杂物体重排任务；相对空间推理基础模型的既有工作表现更优，收敛通常在数秒内完成，并显示完整准确的几何对 sim-to-real 迁移至关重要。
summary_sections.conclusion: 推理期大规模并行仿真加进化搜索可替代（或补强）空间推理基础模型来做机器人操作的空间推理，前提是重建的几何足够完整准确以支撑 sim-to-real。

papers.title: Future Information-Directed Sampling for Bayesian Nonstationary Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Exploration--exploitation is a central trade-off in bandit learning. While classical algorithms such as upper confidence bound methods and Thompson Sampling effectively balance this trade-off in stationary environments, their exploration strategies mainly reduce uncertainty about the current optimal arm, which can be insufficient in nonstationary settings where future optimal arms may differ substantially from current ones. In this paper, we propose Future Information-Directed Sampling (FIDS), a new algorithm for Bayesian nonstationary bandits that explicitly explores to gather information about future optimal arms. We show that FIDS achieves regret comparable to Thompson Sampling up to a small constant factor, while being able to exploit predictive information structures that conventional exploration objectives fail to capture. To address the practical difficulty of posterior inference, we further propose a supervised-learning-based approximation framework that learns the FIDS policy from offline data, and demonstrate its effectiveness on synthetic benchmarks.
papers.comment: 18 pages. An earlier version appeared at the ICML 2026 DEMO Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Future Information-Directed Sampling (FIDS)，在贝叶斯非平稳 bandit 中把探索目标从当前最优臂改为未来最优臂的信息，regret 与 Thompson Sampling 相差仅一个小常数因子；并用基于监督学习的离线近似框架学习 FIDS 策略，在合成基准上验证有效。
Motivation: UCB 与 Thompson Sampling 的探索只削减当前最优臂的不确定性，而非平稳环境中未来最优臂可能与当前差异很大，这类探索目标抓不住对未来有用的信息结构。
Method: FIDS 针对贝叶斯非平稳 bandit 显式设计面向未来最优臂的信息导向采样目标；针对后验推断难解，另提出基于监督学习的近似框架，从离线数据学习 FIDS 策略。
Result: FIDS 的 regret 与 Thompson Sampling 相比仅差一个小常数因子，并能利用传统探索目标无法捕捉的预测性信息结构；监督学习近似框架在合成基准上展示了有效性。
Conclusion: 在非平稳 bandit 中把探索对准未来最优臂的信息是可行的，且不牺牲 regret 阶段的量级，后验推断可用离线学得的策略近似绕开。

papers.title: DynGraphAgentBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Lifecycle Control in Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph anomaly detection requires repeated decisions as graph structure and class prevalence drift, yet detector benchmarks usually score a fixed pipeline after current labels are known. We introduce DynGraphAgentBench, an executable benchmark for agentic lifecycle control under delayed feedback. It comprises seven temporal graph datasets with node- and edge-level anomaly tasks, eleven selectable detectors, and eight chronological deployment windows per dataset. In each window, a controller sees only time-causal aggregate context, registered model cards, and its own matured history. It must choose a detector before current-window training or candidate scores exist. A sandboxed executor trains the chosen architecture on mature data, scores a hidden deployment window, and releases the outcome after a one-window delay. A deterministic verifier checks decision timing, leakage guards, legal actions, training scope, and persisted artifacts. We measure detection utility with average precision and capture at fixed review depth, and characterize adaptation through model switches and compute. Complete eight-window trajectories from two primary controllers and a no-memory reference on four datasets, together with three additional controllers on three datasets, expose useful, costly, and ineffective reactions to delayed evidence without granting an exhaustive current-window oracle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynGraphAgentBench 是一个可执行的动态图异常检测基准，把检测器选择当作延迟反馈下的智能体生命周期控制问题：控制器只能看时间因果的聚合上下文与已成熟的历史，必须在当前窗口训练和打分之前选定检测器，沙箱执行后延迟一个窗口才释放结果。在四个数据集上跑完八窗口轨迹的两个主控制器与无记忆参照显示，延迟证据会催生有用、昂贵和无效三类反应，而确定性校验器保证决策时序与防泄漏约束。
Motivation: 现有图异常检测基准都在标签已知后对固定流水线打分，无法衡量图结构与类别流行度漂移下反复重选检测器的生命周期决策，也缺少对决策时序与信息泄漏的约束。
Method: 基准含七个时序图数据集（节点级与边级异常任务）、十一个可选检测器、每数据集八个按时间排序的部署窗口；控制器仅获时间因果聚合上下文、注册的 model card 与自身成熟历史，沙箱执行器在成熟数据上训练所选架构并对隐藏部署窗口打分，结果延迟一个窗口释放；确定性校验器检查决策时序、泄漏防护、合法动作、训练范围与持久化产物，效用用 average precision 与固定审查深度下的 capture 度量，适应性用模型切换次数与算力量化。
Result: 两个主控制器加一个无记忆参照在四个数据集上完成完整八窗口轨迹，另有三个控制器在三个数据集上运行；轨迹暴露出对延迟证据的有用、昂贵与无效三类反应，且评测不授予当前窗口的穷举 oracle。
Conclusion: 把检测器选择建模为受时序与泄漏约束的智能体控制问题，并用延迟一窗口的可执行基准来度量，能区分哪些适应反应真正有效而非仅增加切换与算力开销。

papers.title: Adapting neural operators for mechanics decisions under changing operating conditions
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators can accelerate repeated nonlinear mechanics calculations, but their accuracy can deteriorate as operating conditions move beyond the training range. This work studies whether high-fidelity solutions acquired during use can be reused to adapt a neural operator and improve subsequent mechanics-based command selection. Two hard-magnetic soft-material systems are simulated using high-fidelity finite-element (FE) models, providing reference solutions for evaluating surrogate predictions and selected commands. A neural operator predicts deformation from known material, loading, and magnetic-field inputs, while an empirical error estimator determines which predictions may be used for command selection. Selected FE evaluations supplement these predictions, and their complete loading paths are retained for periodic updates of the neural operator and estimator. In both examples, the fixed operator loses substantial accuracy when stiffness and loading move outside the training range. Updates using 16 acquired paths recover much of the lost accuracy while preserving accuracy in the nominal regime. Under the same FE evaluation budget, the updated operators also improve command selection, although the benefit varies with the operating condition. Error estimation is less consistent, with inaccurate predictions sometimes accepted and accurate predictions rejected. These results demonstrate that reusing high-fidelity loading paths can extend the useful operating range of a neural operator. However, improved forward accuracy alone does not guarantee reliable prediction acceptance, highlighting prediction-specific error assessment as a separate requirement for trustworthy decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在硬磁软材料力学中，神经算子 (neural operator) 超出训练范围后精度明显退化；用使用过程中采集的 16 条高保真有限元 (FE) 完整加载路径周期性更新算子与经验误差估计器，可恢复大部分损失精度并保持标称工况下的精度，同时在相同 FE 预算下改善指令选择。但误差估计器不稳定：不准的预测有时被接受、准确的被拒绝，说明前向精度提升本身不能保证可靠的预测接受判定。
Motivation: 神经算子加速重复非线性力学计算，但工况（刚度、载荷）移出训练范围后精度恶化，而在线获得的高保真解能否被复用来修复这一问题尚不清楚。
Method: 对两个硬磁软材料系统建立高保真有限元 (FE) 模型作为参考；神经算子从材料、载荷与磁场输入预测变形，经验误差估计器判定哪些预测可用于指令选择；被选中的 FE 评估补充进数据集，其完整加载路径被保留，用于周期性更新神经算子与误差估计器。
Result: 固定算子在刚度与载荷移出训练范围时精度大幅下降；用 16 条采集到的加载路径更新后恢复了大部分损失精度，并保持标称工况精度；在相同 FE 评估预算下，更新后的算子也改善了指令选择，但收益随工况变化；误差估计表现不稳定，出现不准预测被接受、准确预测被拒绝的情况。
Conclusion: 复用高保真加载路径可以扩展神经算子的有效工况范围，但前向精度提升并不保证可靠的预测接受判定，预测级误差评估必须作为可信决策的独立要求单独处理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GroupMask: Layer-Adaptive Group-wise Sparsity for Semi-Structured LLM Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Semi-structured pruning compresses large language models (LLMs) while keeping a regular sparse structure, but the prevailing N:M pattern fixes the same local sparsity ratio in every layer. Layer-adaptive sparsity allocation improves unstructured pruning, yet it has been reported to be less effective under N:M sparsity, leaving open whether adaptive allocation is of limited value for semi-structured pruning in general or only under the fine-grained N:M pattern. We examine this question with group-level sparsity, which partitions each weight matrix into regular groups, retains or prunes each group as a whole, and allows each layer's sparsity ratio to vary under a global budget. We propose GroupMask, which generates the group selectors of all layers with a lightweight hypernetwork, relaxes them with a Gumbel-Sigmoid parameterization and a straight-through estimator, and learns them through sparsity-budget regularization and self-distillation while keeping the pretrained weights frozen. On LLaMA-2-7B at 50% sparsity with the same $1\times256$ group size, learned layer-adaptive allocation reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 10.02 to 8.30 and raises the average zero-shot accuracy from 0.455 to 0.496 relative to a uniform per-layer ratio. GroupMask obtains the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity on LLaMA-2-7B and the highest average zero-shot accuracy with Alpaca calibration among the evaluated baselines on five LLaMA and Qwen models. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhengaoLi/GroupMask.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GroupMask 用轻量 hypernetwork 为每层生成 group 选择器，以 Gumbel-Sigmoid 松弛加 straight-through estimator 学习，在全局稀疏预算下让各层稀疏率自适应分配，预训练权重保持冻结。LLaMA-2-7B 在 50% 稀疏度、1×256 组大小下，相对均匀逐层比例把 WikiText-2 perplexity 从 10.02 降到 8.30，平均 zero-shot 准确率从 0.455 升到 0.496。
Motivation: N:M 半结构化剪枝在每层固定同一局部稀疏率，而层自适应分配在 N:M 模式下据报效果有限，尚不清楚这是自适应分配本身受限还是仅限于细粒度 N:M 模式。
Method: 以 group 级稀疏替代 N:M：把每个权重矩阵切成规则 group，整组保留或整组剪枝，各层稀疏率在全局预算下浮动。GroupMask 用轻量 hypernetwork 生成所有层的 group selector，Gumbel-Sigmoid 参数化加 straight-through estimator 做松弛，通过稀疏预算正则与自蒸馏 (self-distillation) 学习，预训练权重冻结。
Result: LLaMA-2-7B、50% 稀疏度、1×256 组大小下，学习到的层自适应分配相对均匀逐层比例使 WikiText-2 perplexity 从 10.02 降至 8.30，平均 zero-shot 准确率从 0.455 升至 0.496。在五个 LLaMA 与 Qwen 模型上，GroupMask 取得 LLaMA-2-7B 最低的 WikiText-2 perplexity，并在用 Alpaca 校准的评测基线中取得最高平均 zero-shot 准确率。
Conclusion: 层自适应稀疏分配在半结构化剪枝中仍然有效，其失效只与细粒度 N:M 模式绑定；把粒度放宽到 group 级即可在固定全局预算下换到更低困惑度与更高 zero-shot 准确率。

papers.title: HARMONIA: Interpretable Graph Learning through Mixtures of Neural Bases
papers.abstract_en: Existing interpretable graph additive models still face limitations in either computational scalability or modeling flexibility. In terms of structural modeling, previous approaches either face quadratic scaling costs or sacrifice explicit source-to-target contribution decomposition. In terms of feature components, they rely either on per-feature neural networks or on single shared bases with limited feature specialization. We address both problems by introducing HARMONIA: Interpretable Graph Learning through Mixtures of Neural Bases, an interpretable-by-design framework. For feature modeling, HARMONIA introduces a Mixture of Neural Bases (MoNB), which routes features to specialized basis experts, enabling parameter sharing without sacrificing feature-specific specialization. For structural modeling, HARMONIA uses Relative Random Walk Probabilities (RRWP) to capture multi-hop and multi-path relationships, and proposes Sparse RRWP Aggregation (SRA) to compute these interactions through sparse graph propagation without quadratic pairwise complexity. HARMONIA retains a simple additive form in which predictions decompose into feature responses modulated by structural influence. Empirically, HARMONIA achieves stronger explanation recovery than existing interpretable graph baselines while maintaining competitive predictive performance and scaling to graphs with millions of nodes. These results show that interpretable graph learning can remain both faithful and scalable without sacrificing predictive effectiveness.

papers.title: On the Token Value Inequality in Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has enabled large language models to achieve substantial performance gains on complex tasks. However, these gains come at the cost of dramatically increased token consumption. This raises a fundamental question: is every token in the reasoning trace equally valuable? We present a diagnostic and optimization framework grounded in a key empirical finding: the value of tokens within a CoT reasoning sequence is highly non-uniform, and this non-uniformity can be effectively characterized by token-level log probability signals. We show that normalized log probability helps distinguish core tokens, which carry structural and decisive reasoning content, from redundant tokens, which are exploratory, low-confidence filler that contributes less directly to the final answer. Building on these findings, we formulate the TokenProbe framework around two empirical findings and one claim: findings identify token value inequality first and then establish TokenProbe as a core-token proxy, and the claim introduces an efficient GRPO objective positing that selectively compressing redundant tokens can yield Pareto improvements in the accuracy-token efficiency space. Empirically, our method preserves reasoning quality while reducing the token usage by 76% of the baseline. Under matched reasoning-length budgets, we show that it can even outperform strong flagship baselines like Gemini-3.1-Pro. Homepage: https://runjia.tech/tokenprobe/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TokenProbe 用归一化 log probability 把 CoT 推理序列里的 token 分成承载结构性推理的核心 token 与低置信填充的冗余 token，并据此设计选择性压缩冗余 token 的高效 GRPO 目标，主张在准确率- token 效率空间取得 Pareto 改进。实测在保持推理质量的同时把 token 用量降到基线的 76% 以下（减少 76%），在匹配的推理长度预算下还能超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro 这类旗舰基线。
Motivation: CoT 带来复杂任务性能提升的同时 token 消耗急剧膨胀，而推理轨迹中的 token 价值并非均等，需要区分哪些 token 真正决定答案、哪些只是冗余填充，才能在不损失质量的前提下压缩推理长度。
Method: TokenProbe 框架：先以 token 级 log probability（归一化后）作为核心 token 的代理信号，区分结构性核心 token 与探索性低置信冗余 token；再在此基础上提出高效 GRPO 目标，选择性压缩冗余 token，围绕两个经验发现与一个 Pareto 改进主张组织。
Result: 在保持推理质量的同时将 token 用量相对基线减少 76%；在匹配推理长度预算的条件下，性能超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro 等强旗舰基线。
Conclusion: CoT 中的 token 价值高度不均，归一化 log probability 可有效刻画这种不均，选择性压缩冗余 token 能在准确率与 token 效率之间取得 Pareto 改进。
