papers.title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.

TL;DR: 提出体积视频编码器 SAGA，用分层组织的稀疏 4D anchor 表示动态 3D 场景，坐标 INR 解码器从 anchor 间插值生成细粒度 anchor 与 Gaussian primitives，实现跨时空结构的紧凑参数共享。相对 GIFStream，Neu3D 与 MPEG MIV 上 PSNR BD-rate 分别降低 80.39% 与 83.94%。
Motivation: 动态 3DGS 原始点多、时空冗余大难以压缩；现有 anchor 方案只形变单一 canonical scaffold 且各 primitive 孤立依赖所属 anchor，难以处理非局部动态与遮挡，并浪费 inter-anchor 相关性。
Method: SAGA 以稀疏 anchor 辅助的 Gaussian splatting 表示动态场景：分层稀疏 4D anchor 加坐标 INR 解码器从 anchor 间插值生成细 anchor 与 Gaussian primitives；对非结构化 anchor 的长程依赖引入固定大小 memory slots 与正交性引导更新 (orthogonality-informed updates) 做熵上下文建模。
Result: 相对 GIFStream 的率失真对比：PSNR BD-rate 在 Neu3D 上降低 80.39%，在 MPEG MIV 上降低 83.94%。
Conclusion: 分层稀疏 4D anchor 加 INR 插值与带正交更新的 memory-slot 熵建模，可在动态场景体积视频上取得强率失真表现。

papers.title: Two-Sample Testing for Inhomogeneous Random Graphs in Non-Integral $L_r$ Norms
papers.abstract_en: Testing whether two populations of networks share the same edge probabilities is a basic problem in network inference. How hard it is depends on the norm used to measure the difference. For the inhomogeneous Erdős--Rényi (IER) model, the optimal sample complexity is known for every integer $L_r$ norm and for $1\le r<2$. For non-integral $r>2$, however, the known upper and lower bounds do not match, and the lower bound was conjectured to be tight. We study this gap for two-sample testing on aligned vertices. We propose a test that runs two published statistics, of orders $2$ and $\lceil r\rceil$, on the same data and rejects if either one rejects. Its thresholds come from Hölder interpolation, so that both statistics have the same sample cost. We prove that this test attains the conjectured rate. Combined with earlier results, this shows that for every fixed $r\ge1$ the minimax sample complexity is of order $n^{\max\{4/r-1,\,2/r\}}/ε^2$, even when the separation changes with $n$. In simulations with $n$ between 32 and 256, the number of graphs needed for 80\% power at level $0.05$ grows with $n$ at a rate consistent with the theory. For $r=2.5$, for example, the fitted exponent is $0.78$, against the theoretical value $0.8$. Interestingly, the two statistics split the work as the interpolation argument suggests: the higher-order statistic is more powerful when only a few edges change, and the $L_2$ statistic when many edges change.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对非整数 L_r 范数下非齐次 Erdős–Rényi (IER) 图的两样本检验，提出在同一数据上并行运行 2 阶与 ⌈r⌉ 阶两个已发表统计量、任一拒绝即拒绝的检验，阈值由 Hölder 插值定标使两者样本代价一致。证明该检验达到此前猜想的速率：对每个固定 r≥1，minimax 样本复杂度为 n^{max{4/r−1, 2/r}}/ε²，即使分离度随 n 变化也成立。
Motivation: IER 模型两样本检验的最优样本复杂度在整数 L_r 范数及 1≤r<2 已知，但非整数 r>2 时上下界不匹配，且下界猜想为紧，该缺口悬而未决。
Method: 在顶点对齐 (aligned vertices) 设定下，把阶数 2 与阶数 ⌈r⌉ 的两个已发表统计量作用于同一数据，任一拒绝即拒绝；阈值通过 Hölder 插值选取，使两个统计量具有相同样本代价，并证明该检验达到猜想速率。
Result: 证明 minimax 样本复杂度为 n^{max{4/r−1, 2/r}}/ε²，对每个固定 r≥1 成立，即使分离度随 n 变化。仿真中 n 取 32 至 256，达到 80% power、level 0.05 所需图数量随 n 的增长与理论一致：r=2.5 时拟合指数 0.78，理论值 0.8。两个统计量分工与插值论证一致——少数边变化时高阶统计量更强，多数边变化时 L_2 统计量更强。
Conclusion: 非整数 r>2 的样本复杂度下界是紧的，Hölder 插值给出的双统计量检验即可达到该速率；高阶与 L_2 统计量分别覆盖稀疏与稠密的边变化机制。

papers.title: ThinkNet: Compact Architecture Selection and Validation-Gated Ensembles for Subject-Independent MI-EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Practical assistive and rehabilitative brain--computer interfaces require subject-independent motor-imagery EEG (MI-EEG) decoders that generalize to new users under limited target-user data and constrained compute. However, held-out-subject performance can be overstated when test-subject information influences preprocessing, model selection, or ensemble selection. We present \textit{ThinkNet}, a validation-controlled framework that combines train-only normalization, validation-guided evolutionary search, and validation-gated inference to identify compact decoders and inference policies for held-out subjects. We evaluate four-class BCI Competition IV-2a (session T) decoding with nine Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) folds, three seeds, seven fixed decoder entries, and a broader search over ten representative decoder families; the held-out subject is never used for normalization, hyperparameter, architecture, or ensemble-policy selection. In the fixed benchmark, the validation-selected compact decoder achieved 44.35$\pm$15.41\% accuracy with 4.9K parameters, 19 KB FP32 weights, and 0.99 ms batch-1 Orin CUDA inference. Across the broader search, compact models ($\leq$25K parameters) achieved higher mean held-out accuracy than mid-size and large alternatives after selected retraining (40.10\% vs. 35.09\% and 34.78\%). Validation-gated ensembling improved over validation-selected single-model inference, reaching 43.98$\pm$16.25\% in the fixed benchmark and 43.31$\pm$15.88\% for the compact six-family ensemble. A non-deployable oracle analysis revealed a 6.1-point family-selection gap and near-zero validation--test correlation, showing that validation reliability remains a key bottleneck under subject shift. Thus, ThinkNet is a validation-controlled framework for compact MI-EEG model and inference-policy selection, rather than a single-architecture benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThinkNet 是面向被试无关运动想象 EEG (MI-EEG) 解码的验证受控框架：只用训练集归一化、验证集引导的进化搜索与验证门控推理来选紧凑解码器和集成策略，留出被试完全不参与归一化、超参、架构与集成选择。在 BCI Competition IV-2a 四分类、9 折 LOSO 下，验证选中的紧凑解码器 44.35±15.41%（4.9K 参数、19 KB FP32 权重、Orin batch-1 0.99 ms），验证门控集成在固定基准达 43.98±16.25%；oracle 分析暴露 6.1 分的家族选择差距与近零的验证-测试相关，说明被试偏移下验证可靠性仍是瓶颈。
Motivation: 被试无关 MI-EEG 解码要在目标用户数据少、算力受限下泛化，但若测试被试信息渗入预处理、模型选择或集成选择，留出被试性能会被高估。
Method: ThinkNet 组合三件事：train-only 归一化、验证集引导的进化搜索 (validation-guided evolutionary search)、验证门控推理 (validation-gated inference)；固定基准含 7 个固定解码器条目，另在 10 个代表性解码器家族上做更广搜索，评估为 BCI Competition IV-2a (session T) 四分类、9 折 LOSO、3 个随机种子。
Result: 固定基准中验证选中的紧凑解码器 44.35±15.41% 准确率、4.9K 参数、19 KB FP32 权重、Orin batch-1 CUDA 推理 0.99 ms；更广搜索中紧凑模型（≤25K 参数）经选定重训练后平均留出准确率 40.10%，高于中型 35.09% 与大型 34.78%；验证门控集成优于验证选中的单模型推理，固定基准 43.98±16.25%，紧凑六家族集成 43.31±15.88%；不可部署的 oracle 分析给出 6.1 分的家族选择差距与近零的验证-测试相关。
Conclusion: 在被试偏移下，验证可靠性本身是瓶颈：即便严格隔离留出被试，验证集也无法可靠预测测试表现，因此 ThinkNet 定位为验证受控的紧凑模型与推理策略选择框架，而非单一架构基准。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 固定基准中验证选中的紧凑解码器 44.35±15.41% 准确率、4.9K 参数、19 KB FP32 权重、Orin batch-1 CUDA 推理 0.99 ms；更广搜索中紧凑模型（≤25K 参数）经选定重训练后平均留出准确率 40.10%，高于中型 35.09% 与大型 34.78%；验证门控集成优于验证选中的单模型推理，固定基准 43.98±16.25%，紧凑六家族集成 43.31±15.88%；不可部署的 oracle 分析给出 6.1 分的家族选择差距与近零的验证-测试相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在被试偏移下，验证可靠性本身是瓶颈：即便严格隔离留出被试，验证集也无法可靠预测测试表现，因此 ThinkNet 定位为验证受控的紧凑模型与推理策略选择框架，而非单一架构基准。

papers.title: Greenpixie's AI Token Methodology: Assessing the Energy, Water and $\mathrm{CO_2\text{-}eq}$ Impact of AI Tokens for Open and Closed Weight Models
papers.abstract_en: We describe a methodology for estimating the per-token energy cost of cloud-hosted large language model (LLM) inference, separating between input (prefill) and output (decode) tokens. Graphics processing unit (GPU) energy usage is measured during inference benchmarking with open-weights models on a wide range of text-based tasks. The remaining server energy contribution from non-GPU hardware is estimated from the inference wall time. Bayesian linear regression is used to model the relationship between energy per token and LLM size, request traffic, and hardware deployment configuration. Proprietary frontier LLMs of unknown size and deployment are binned into size buckets based on naming conventions and performance priors, and the space of possible LLM configurations is sampled with Monte-Carlo methods to give a representative average energy per token and uncertainty. We also describe how these energy measurements can be used to estimate the carbon-dioxide equivalent ($\mathrm{CO_2\text{-}eq}$) emissions, both usage and embodied, and water consumed per token of AI inference. This methodology provides actionable data that enables reductions in cost, electricity usage, $\mathrm{CO_2\text{-}eq}$ emitted and water consumed in cloud and Software as a Service (SaaS).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套按 token 估算云端 LLM 推理能耗的方法：把 prefill 与 decode 分开，实测开源模型 GPU 能耗，用推理墙时估算非 GPU 部件，再用贝叶斯线性回归把每 token 能耗关联到模型规模、请求流量与硬件部署配置。对规模与部署未知的闭源前沿模型，按命名惯例与性能先验分桶，用 Monte-Carlo 采样给出代表性平均能耗与不确定性，并据此折算 CO2-eq（使用与隐含）及每 token 耗水量。
Motivation: 云端 LLM 推理的每 token 成本、电耗、碳排与水耗缺少可操作的估算依据，尤其是规模与部署均不透明的闭源前沿模型，SaaS 与云厂商无从据此削减开销与排放。
Method: 在开源权重模型上对多类文本任务做推理基准并直接测量 GPU 能耗，区分 input (prefill) 与 output (decode) token；非 GPU 硬件能耗由推理墙时推算；用贝叶斯线性回归建模每 token 能耗与 LLM 规模、请求流量、硬件部署配置的关系；闭源模型按命名惯例与性能先验分入规模桶，对可能的配置空间做 Monte-Carlo 采样得到均值与不确定性，再折算 CO2-eq（使用与隐含）与每 token 耗水。
Result: 产出一套可给出每 token 平均能耗及不确定区间的方法，并可进一步换算为使用与隐含 CO2-eq 排放和每 token 耗水量；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 按 token 拆分能耗并显式传播闭源模型配置的不确定性，可为云与 SaaS 场景削减成本、电耗、CO2-eq 与水耗提供可操作数据。

papers.title: SymNetPro: LOS-Aware Directional Multi-Transmitter Localization from Sparse Radio Observations
papers.abstract_en: Directional multi-transmitter localization from sparse received-power observations is difficult because the receiver observes only the source-unresolved aggregate field: multiple directional sources superpose, building blockage fragments their visible regions, and stronger sources can mask weaker ones. We present SymNetPro, which retains the dual-task radio-map reconstruction and localization backbone of SymNet and adds two targeted components. First, a sparse line-of-sight (LOS)-aware attention bias injects obstruction-aware spatial relations into selected token interactions. Second, transmitter-drop augmentation recomposes training scenes after removing one sample-supported transmitter, exposing the model to controlled source-cardinality variation. Experiments on directional ray-traced urban environments show substantially lower OSPA than representative localization baselines under extreme sparse sampling, with consistent gains under measurement noise and increasing transmitter count. A transmitter-specific evidence analysis further shows that remaining misses concentrate in regimes where the target contributes little distinguishable power to the aggregate observation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SymNetPro 在稀疏接收功率观测下做 LOS 感知的定向多发射机定位：用稀疏 LOS 注意力偏置注入遮挡感知空间关系，并用 transmitter-drop 增广重组训练场景以覆盖源数量变化。在方向性光线追踪城市环境中，极端稀疏采样下 OSPA 显著低于代表性定位基线，且在测量噪声与发射机数量增加时保持一致增益。
Motivation: 接收机只能看到源不可分辨的聚合场：多个定向源叠加、建筑遮挡割裂可见区域、强源掩盖弱源，稀疏采样下多发射机定位因此困难。
Method: 在 SymNet 的双任务无线电地图重建与定位骨干上加两个组件：稀疏 line-of-sight (LOS)-aware 注意力偏置，在选定 token 交互中注入遮挡感知空间关系；transmitter-drop 增广，移除一个有样本支撑的发射机后重组训练场景，让模型接触受控的源基数变化。
Result: 在方向性光线追踪城市环境中，极端稀疏采样下 OSPA 显著低于代表性定位基线；在测量噪声与发射机数量增加时增益一致。发射机级证据分析显示，剩余漏定位集中在目标对聚合观测贡献可区分功率很少的体制。
Conclusion: LOS 感知关系注入与源基数增广能改善稀疏观测下的多发射机定位，剩余误差由弱源在聚合场中功率占比过低这一可分辨性极限决定。

papers.title: EEG-Fusion: Failure-Informed Source-Free Expert Routing for Robust Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Subject-independent motor-imagery (MI) EEG decoding can exhibit subject-level failures even when average performance appears acceptable: under subject shift, a decoder can become an overconfident near-one-class predictor. This is especially problematic in source-free deployment, where target-user labels are unavailable during adaptation and expert selection. We present \textit{EEG-Fusion}, a failure-informed decision-level fusion framework that treats source-free MI decoding as label-free reliability estimation over heterogeneous experts. EEG-Fusion applies subject-wise Euclidean alignment and normalization-only test-time adaptation, then routes each target subject to a neural, covariance-based, or physiological-feature expert using a reliability gate trained on source-held-out folds to predict expert performance and collapse risk from label-free stream diagnostics. The gate uses confidence, entropy, prediction diversity, expert agreement, and predicted class balance; collapse is measured as the maximum predicted class fraction. In 9-fold leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation with three seeds, relative to a no-alignment raw EEGNet source-free anchor, EEG-Fusion improves subject macro-F1 from 0.417 to 0.529 on BCI IV-2a local protocol, from 0.314 to 0.482 on BNCI2014-001, and from 0.607 to 0.708 on BNCI2014-004; corresponding collapse-index reductions are 0.199, 0.227, and 0.169. In a 9-subject Cho2017 external subset, EEG-Fusion improves macro-F1 from 0.516 to 0.630. These results suggest that label-free reliability estimation can reduce subject-level failure modes in source-free MI-EEG deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EEG-Fusion 把无源 (source-free) 运动想象 EEG 解码重构为对异构专家的无标签可靠性估计：先做被试级欧氏对齐与仅归一化的测试时自适应，再用在源侧留出折上训练的可靠性门控，依据置信度、熵、预测多样性、专家一致性和预测类别平衡，把每个目标被试路由到神经、协方差或生理特征专家，并以最大预测类别占比度量坍塌。9 折 LOSO、3 个种子下，相对无对齐的 raw EEGNet 无源锚点，BCI IV-2a 局部协议 macro-F1 从 0.417 升到 0.529，BNCI2014-001 从 0.314 升到 0.482，BNCI2014-004 从 0.607 升到 0.708。
Motivation: 被试级偏移下，平均性能尚可的解码器可能退化为过度自信的近单类预测器；无源部署时目标用户没有标签，无法在自适应与专家选择阶段发现这种坍塌。
Method: 先做 subject-wise Euclidean alignment 与 normalization-only 测试时自适应；可靠性门控在 source-held-out folds 上训练，输入为无标签流诊断量（confidence、entropy、prediction diversity、expert agreement、predicted class balance），预测各专家性能与 collapse risk，collapse 以最大预测类别占比衡量；决策级融合按门控输出把目标被试路由到 neural、covariance-based 或 physiological-feature 专家。
Result: 9 折 leave-one-subject-out、3 seeds，相对无对齐 raw EEGNet 无源锚点：subject macro-F1 在 BCI IV-2a local protocol 由 0.417 升至 0.529，BNCI2014-001 由 0.314 升至 0.482，BNCI2014-004 由 0.607 升至 0.708；对应 collapse-index 分别下降 0.199、0.227、0.169。9 被试的 Cho2017 外部子集上 macro-F1 由 0.516 升至 0.630。
Conclusion: 无标签可靠性估计足以在无源 MI-EEG 部署中减少被试级失败模式，前提是把对齐、测试时自适应与按坍塌风险的专家路由绑在一起做决策级融合。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Designing Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge Measurement Systems for Multi-Turn Business Agents
papers.abstract_en: Many LLM-as-a-judge evaluations score fixed outputs under a fixed task definition. Production multi-turn business agents instead require a maintained measurement system: correctness depends on business-specific facts and procedures, outcomes emerge across turns, and failures must be attributed to either agent capability or missing business knowledge before they are actionable. We present an integrated methodology spanning evaluation specification, modular LLM judges, intent-preserving user simulation, and human-in-the-loop governance. The specification defines conversation-level end states and actionable failure ownership. Atomic judges share versioned evidence and feed an explicit aggregation graph. The simulator is released only after task-preservation and stability checks. Independent human audits estimate measurement fidelity, renew tiered reference sets, and route disagreements to label correction, guideline revision, or judge improvement. Production studies show that system-level fidelity improved across repeated audits, that human reviewers and automated judges improved together under the shared feedback loop, and that their combined workflow had the strongest descriptive performance in both reported task-completion settings. Because the studies are observational and the human reference itself required revision, these findings demonstrate operational usefulness rather than causal or universal superiority. The contribution is a practical framework for making multi-turn agent measurement reliable, actionable, and maintainable as the evaluated system and its evidence evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向多轮业务智能体的 LLM-as-a-judge 评测，把评测规范、模块化原子 judge、意图保持的用户模拟器和人工在环治理整合成一套可持续维护的测量系统：规范定义会话级终态与失败归属（能力不足 vs 缺业务知识），原子 judge 共享版本化证据并汇入显式聚合图。生产研究显示系统级保真度在多轮审计中提升，人工评审与自动 judge 在共享反馈回路下同步改善，二者组合在两个报告的任务完成设置中描述性表现最强。
Motivation: 固定输出、固定任务定义的 LLM-as-a-judge 无法处理业务专属事实与流程、跨轮次涌现的结果，以及失败归因，导致评测结果不可操作也不可维护。
Method: 四部分方法：评测规范定义会话级终态与可操作的失败归属；模块化原子 judge 共享版本化证据并汇入显式聚合图；意图保持的用户模拟器需通过任务保持与稳定性检查才发布；独立人工审计估计测量保真度、更新分层参考集，并把分歧路由到标签修正、指南修订或 judge 改进。
Result: 生产研究中系统级保真度在重复审计间提升；人工评审与自动 judge 在共享反馈回路下共同改善；二者组合工作流在两个报告的任务完成设置中描述性表现最强。研究为观察性，人工参考本身也经过修订。
Conclusion: 作者主张该框架使多轮智能体测量可靠、可操作并随被测系统与证据演化而维护，但明确把结论限定为操作上有用，而非因果或普适优越。

papers.title: Simple Diffusion Language Models Are More Effective Few-Step Generators Than Reported
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise fast parallel generation, yet high-quality samples often require large number of refinement steps, which diminishes their advantage in practice. This has led to massive interest in and rapid development of new methods for effective few-step generation. We show that much of the supposed quality gap at few steps can instead arise from a suboptimally configured sampler. Modest sampler sharpening, without any model retraining, enables a couple years old masked DLM to rival supposedly far improved successors. This differently sampled DLM in fact achieves lower generative perplexity in just 16 steps than what its standard sampler obtains with 1024, while improving both judged quality and semantic diversity. We further show that conventional per-output metrics can fundamentally obscure these gains, since any optimal trade-off between two such metrics can be attained by a generator supported on at most two outputs. We subsequently introduce GroupEval, which separately evaluates quality and across-output semantic diversity, and offers fresh insights including uncovering how 1.5-4.7x perplexity gains of a distilled model yield no corresponding quality gain. Finally, we explain why sharpening helps: parallel unmasking destroys dependencies among simultaneously generated tokens, creating a gap between prediction and generation. We prove that pervasive temperature choice of one is generically suboptimal under parallel sampling even for an exact denoiser, and that worse predictions can yield better samples. Through these results, we argue for a broader evaluation principle of treating the deployed generator as the object of comparison, benchmarking it against tuned baselines, and assessing quality and diversity jointly and with more human-aligned measures.

Motivation: 少步生成被视为 DLM 并行优势的关键瓶颈，催生大量蒸馏与新方法；但质量差距可能被未调优的采样器混淆，且逐输出指标会掩盖真实改进。
Method: 对既有 masked DLM 做采样器 sharpening（不重训）；提出 GroupEval，把质量与跨输出语义多样性分开评估；理论上证明在并行采样下温度取 1 即使对精确 denoiser 也通常次优、更差的预测可产生更好的样本，并给出两个指标的最优权衡可由至多两个输出支撑的生成器达到的结论。

papers.title: Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids
papers.abstract_en: Detecting failures in World Model (WM)-based planning requires monitoring whether the model is behaviorally aligned with the current task, which in turn requires studying its internal representations. Here, we show that centroids---sub-component Jacobian row-sums---effectively identify the behavioral properties of WMs, complementing traditional activation-based knowledge signals. The centroids of a model are easily computed through Jacobian vector products and characterize how the model organizes the geometry of its input space, yielding an efficient perspective on internal representations, including the generation of task-relevant saliency maps. Evaluated on continuous control tasks using JEPA WMs, this behavioral view reveals a structural dissociation, where the encoder correctly represents the goal while the predictor remains behaviorally unresponsive. This failure mode directly predicts planning failure before any action is taken, allowing for goal resampling to recapture out-of-distribution success. Moreover, centroid-based methods outperform baseline methods as distribution-shift detectors. Together, these tools yield a behavioral monitoring stack that is operational and consequential under distribution shifts.
papers.comment: Presented at Workshop on World Models - Hosted by Chicago Booth
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 Jacobian 行和定义的 centroid 监控 JEPA 世界模型的内部表征，发现编码器正确表示目标而 predictor 行为无响应的结构性解离，该失效模式能在动作执行前预测规划失败，并通过 goal resampling 恢复分布外成功率；centroid 在分布偏移检测上超过基线方法。
Motivation: 基于世界模型的规划需要判断模型是否与当前任务行为对齐，而传统激活类知识信号难以在动作执行前暴露 predictor 层面的行为失效。
Method: 定义 sub-component Jacobian 行和为 centroid，用 Jacobian vector products 高效计算，刻画模型输入空间几何并生成任务相关 saliency map；在 JEPA 世界模型的连续控制任务上做行为监控，并与激活基线及分布偏移检测基线对比。
Result: 在 JEPA 世界模型的连续控制任务上，行为视图揭示 encoder 正确表征目标而 predictor 行为无响应的结构解离；该失效模式在采取任何动作之前直接预测规划失败，goal resampling 可重新获得分布外成功；centroid 方法作为分布偏移检测器优于基线方法。
Conclusion: centroid 补充激活类信号，可在分布偏移下构成可操作且有预测力的行为监控栈，提前暴露规划失败并指导 goal resampling。

papers.title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
papers.abstract_en: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpiTransfer 用两帧单目航拍图像加相机位姿，通过极线传递 (epipolar transfer) 合成可自由选基线的虚拟立体对，把时序对应转成三角测量，训练即可得到稠密深度。室内 OptiTrack 上 AbsRel 0.092、δ<1.25 为 0.940，与直接三角测量 (AbsRel 0.073) 相当但有效深度覆盖更多困难场景，并大幅优于未针对该域训练的 ZoeDepth (0.225) 与 Depth Anything V2 (0.570)。
Motivation: 学习型深度估计在分布内精度高，但换视角、换高度就泛化差；直接两视图三角测量又存在几何退化，需要一种不依赖训练数据、跨视角稳定的深度获取方式。
Method: 几何推导的免训练方法：仅用两帧单目图像与相机位姿估计，借相机运动合成基线可自由选取的虚拟立体对，将时序对应转为立体三角测量，同时规避直接两视图三角测量的几何退化。
Result: 室内 OptiTrack 环境 AbsRel 0.092、δ<1.25 为 0.940；直接三角测量 AbsRel 0.073，但本方法在更多困难场景上保留有效深度；ZoeDepth AbsRel 0.225、Depth Anything V2 AbsRel 0.570（均未在该域训练或微调）。验证覆盖户外无人机飞行（最大距离约 90 m）与室内 OptiTrack，均以 LiDAR 为真值。
Conclusion: 不需训练数据，靠相机运动构造虚拟基线即可在新视角与新高度上得到可靠深度，且比未经本域训练的学习式模型更稳。

papers.title: Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) are traditionally treated as disjoint problems: the former adapts models to domain shift assuming all test classes are known, while the latter discovers novel categories assuming labeled training data for known classes. However, real-world deployment rarely fits either setting. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD), a unified and more realistic scenario where a vision-language model must adapt to distribution shifts, classify known categories using only textual supervision, and discover novel categories, all during test time and without access to labeled data. To address this challenging scenario, we propose PACT (Prototype Assignment for Category discovery at Test time), a fully unsupervised framework that casts known-class recognition and novel-class discovery via prototype assignment. PACT first re-aligns shifted visual features with the text-derived class representations of the VLM using confident zero-shot predictions. Known and novel categories are then both represented by prototypes in the visual embedding space, estimated from the unlabeled test stream, and each test image is assigned to the category whose prototype is most similar to its visual feature. Extensive experiments across corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that PACT outperforms adapted state-of-the-art TTA and GCD methods, effectively bridging the gap between adaptation and discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出测试时广义类别发现 (TT-GCD) 场景与全无监督框架 PACT：用高置信零样本预测把偏移后的视觉特征重新对齐到 VLM 的文本类表示，再在视觉嵌入空间中从无标签测试流估计已知类与新类的原型，按最近原型分配每个测试图像。在 corruption 与 domain-shift 基准上，PACT 超过经适配的 TTA 与 GCD 最先进方法。
Motivation: TTA 假设测试类全部已知、GCD 假设有已知类的标注训练数据，二者被当作互不相干的问题；真实部署既存在分布偏移又含未见新类，且测试时拿不到任何标注。
Method: PACT 把已知类识别与新类发现统一为原型分配：先用高置信零样本预测把偏移视觉特征与 VLM 文本导出的类表示重新对齐，再从无标签测试流估计已知类与新类的视觉空间原型，测试图像按与原型的相似度归类，全程无监督。
Result: 在 corruption 与 domain-shift 基准上，PACT 优于经过适配的 TTA 与 GCD 最先进方法。
Conclusion: 适配与发现可以在测试时用同一套原型分配统一处理，弥合 TTA 与 GCD 之间的差距。

papers.title: How Strong Is the Evidence for the Artificial Hivemind? Reevaluating Evidence for the Open-Ended Homogeneity of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent research argues that language models exhibit pronounced homogeneity in open-ended generation, framing such behavior as an Artificial Hivemind that poses a long-term threat to human creativity. We examine three of its central results. First, the flagship example is that model responses to "Write a metaphor involving time" collapse into two clusters. Visualization, spectral analysis, clustering, and language model labels all contradict this description. The labels record each response's vehicle, what it compares time to. Our responses and the original authors' own show one dominant vehicle plus a heavy tail of distinct minority vehicles. "Time" is one of our least diverse topics, so the example is a favorable case, not a representative one. Second, the paper measures homogeneity against an undemanding null: responses to unrelated prompts. Under a more demanding null (same-prompt responses expressing genuinely different ideas), 20%-32% of such pairs already exceed the paper's 0.8 convergence threshold. A residual effect survives this null. The paper's same-prompt pairs exceed 0.8 roughly two to three times as often as our different-idea pairs. Much of what the paper calls homogeneity is the shared geometry of answering the same prompt. The remaining measurements lack any null: no human baseline is collected, and the model-indistinguishability statistic has no null. Third, the paper concludes that inference-time interventions are inadequate for combating the Artificial Hivemind, writing that "more generalizable solutions are needed at the model training level." We show that this conclusion is unsupported in three ways, and that an inference-time intervention (prompting) reliably raises measured response diversity. We do not resolve whether the Artificial Hivemind is real. We show that the published evidence does not establish it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文复核「Artificial Hivemind」（语言模型开放式生成同质化）的三项核心证据并逐条反驳：所谓「Write a metaphor involving time」坍缩成两簇在可视化、谱分析、聚类与模型标注下不成立，实际是一个主导喻体加长尾；换用更严苛的零假设后，同提示对超过 0.8 收敛阈值的频率仅为不同想法对的约两到三倍，剩余差异主要来自回答同一提示的共享几何；且推理时干预（prompting）就能可靠提升测得的回答多样性。
Motivation: 近期研究把语言模型开放式生成的同质化包装成威胁人类创造力的 Artificial Hivemind，其结论依赖三项证据与「训练层面才需要解法」的推论；作者要判断这些证据本身是否成立。
Method: 对原论文三项核心结果做复核：用可视化、谱分析、聚类与语言模型标注（记录每个回答把 time 比作什么的 vehicle）重检两簇主张；构造更严苛零假设（同一提示但表达真正不同想法的回答对）与原论文的无关提示零假设对比，并检查收敛阈值 0.8；再检验其关于推理时干预不足的结论，用 prompting 作为推理时干预提升多样性。
Result: 重检显示一个主导 vehicle 加大量不同少数 vehicle 的长尾，且 time 是作者们多样性最低的主题之一，属有利个案而非代表样本；在不同想法零假设下已有 20%-32% 的回答对超过 0.8 收敛阈值，而原论文同提示对超过 0.8 的频率约为这些对的两到三倍；原论文其余测量无零假设（无人类基线，模型不可区分性统计量无零假设）；prompting 可靠提高测得的回答多样性。
Conclusion: 作者不判定 Artificial Hivemind 是否真实，但主张已发表的证据不足以确立它，且「需要训练层面的更通用解法」这一结论在三方面缺乏支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Video, Ergo Genero: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
papers.abstract_en: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

Motivation: 视频模型适配新任务通常要专门做数据整理和微调；视觉类比虽可免训练地用上下文指定任务，却一直局限于图像域，无法覆盖多样视频任务与分布外场景。

papers.title: ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics
papers.abstract_en: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions. More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/ArticulateArena-web/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ArticulateArena 提出一个与参数化无关的铰接运动 (articulation) 度量：用单自由度关节的 Lie 代数端点 twist 无序对表示关节，比较关节实际诱导的运动而非编码参数，并证明所得商距离是 metric。它统一 fixed/revolute/prismatic/helical 关节，经紧化把连续关节纳入同一分数，加权后读作运动部件的 RMS 位移（米）；再用 motion-aware tree edit distance 把度量提升到完整运动树。同时发布 19,977 个经校验运动学的铰接物体套件 ArticulateArena-20K，并用新度量重评已发表的重建方法。
Motivation: 现有协议把关节类型、轴向、原点、运动限位分开打分，但这些参数共同描述同一物理运动，同一运动可有不同参数写法，导致关节可对自身等价编码打满分错误，且若干分量误差在预测变准处病态或无定义。
Method: 以关节的无序端点 twist 对（Lie 代数）为表示，定义比较诱导运动的商距离并证明其为 metric；经紧化纳入连续关节，按质量分布加权后具有米制 RMS 运动含义；用 motion-aware tree edit distance 提升到运动树，在固定内积下对重标记保持 metric。配套发布 ArticulateArena-20K（19,977 个铰接物体，运动学经校验）。
Result: 发布 ArticulateArena-20K，含 19,977 个运动学经校验的铰接物体，并在该套件上用新度量重新评估已发表的重建方法；理论结果为商距离是 metric，树版本在固定内积下对重标记仍是 metric。
Conclusion: 铰接评价应比较关节诱导的运动而非其参数编码，这样等价参数化不再互相惩罚，结构错误也能与关节错误用同一运动单位计价。

papers.title: Diffusion-Based Rollouts as a Stabilization Mechanism for Long-Horizon Environmental Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Extending forecast lead times while maintaining predictive skill remains a major challenge in environmental forecasting. We investigate diffusion-based rollouts as a stabilization mechanism for recursive forecasting using low-dimensional water-level time series and high-dimensional precipitation fields. Across both modalities, diffusion suppresses recursive error growth, with the largest stabilization occurring where deterministic rollouts are most unstable. However, stabilization does not guarantee forecast fidelity. In the water-level experiments, forecasts progressively lose event-level fidelity as the rollout loses access to external predictive information, and trajectory-level comparisons show that diffusion can remain numerically stable while contracting toward central values and exhibiting reduced variability. In the precipitation experiments, which retain conditioning from numerical weather prediction throughout the rollout, diffusion better preserves spatial organization and event-detection skill. Together, these contrasting experiments indicate that diffusion can control recursive error amplification, while its practical benefit also depends on the predictive information available to constrain future evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在递归滚动预报中引入 diffusion rollout 作为稳定机制：低维水位序列与高维降水场两类实验里，diffusion 都抑制递归误差增长，且在确定性滚动最不稳定的时段稳定化最强。但稳定不等于保真——水位实验中滚动失去外部预测信息后逐步丢失事件级保真，diffusion 数值上稳定却向均值收缩、方差下降；降水实验因全程保留 NWP 条件化信息，空间组织与事件检测技巧保持得更好。
Motivation: 环境预报延长 lead time 时递归滚动会累积误差、发散，如何在长时程中稳定递归预报同时保住预测技巧是核心难题。
Method: 在两类模态上做 diffusion-based rollouts 递归预报实验：低维水位时间序列（滚动过程中失去外部预测信息）与高维降水场（全程保留数值天气预报 NWP 的条件化输入），对比确定性滚动与 diffusion 滚动的误差增长、事件级保真与轨迹级统计。
Result: 两类模态中 diffusion 均抑制递归误差增长，且在确定性滚动最不稳定处稳定化最强；水位实验中轨迹级对比显示 diffusion 可数值稳定却向中心值收缩、变异性下降，预报随滚动失去外部信息而逐步丢失事件级保真；降水实验中 diffusion 更好保持空间组织与事件检测技巧。
Conclusion: diffusion 能控制递归误差放大，但实际收益取决于约束未来演化的可用预测信息——仅靠稳定机制不足以保证预报保真。
Relevance: 72

papers.title: Preserving DEG Rankings for Gene Discovery in Histology-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting spatial gene expression from histology images could scale spatial transcriptomics (ST) to image-only cohorts, but conventional histology-based ST prediction is trained and evaluated mainly by per-gene spatial-profile reconstruction. This objective is misaligned with a key downstream use of ST: differentially expressed gene (DEG) discovery, where genes are ranked for a biological or morphology-defined contrast by evidence of between-group expression differences. We formulate image-based differential expression ranking (IDER), which asks whether predicted expression profiles preserve the contrast-specific ranked gene list obtained from measured profiles. IDER compares gene rankings induced by differential-expression statistics, rather than raw expression magnitudes or per-gene spatial correlations. We further introduce a differentiable IDER objective that aligns these statistics across genes and can be trained with morphology-derived proxy contrasts without predefined biological group labels. Experiments on public ST datasets show improved DEG-ranking agreement and pathway-enrichment overlap over conventional reconstruction objectives, including morphology-derived and pathologist-annotated tissue-region evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出图像基差异表达排序目标 IDER：把组织学图像预测的空间转录组 (ST) 从逐基因空间重建改为保留差异表达基因 (DEG) 排名，用可微的跨基因统计量对齐目标，并可用形态学代理对比在无预定义生物分组标签下训练。在公开 ST 数据集上，包括形态学派生与病理医生标注的组织区域评测，IDER 相比常规重建目标提高了 DEG 排序一致性与通路富集重叠。
Motivation: 常规组织学 ST 预测按逐基因空间轮廓重建来训练和评测，与下游关键用途——按组间表达差异证据给基因排序的 DEG 发现——目标错位。
Method: 提出 IDER (image-based differential expression ranking)：比较由差异表达统计量诱导的基因排名而非原始表达量或逐基因空间相关；进一步给出可微 IDER 目标，跨基因对齐这些统计量，并可用形态学派生的代理对比训练，无需预定义生物分组标签。
Result: 在公开 ST 数据集上，相比常规重建目标，DEG 排序一致性与通路富集重叠均提升；评测涵盖形态学派生对比与病理医生标注的组织区域两种设定。
Conclusion: 以保留 DEG 排名而非重建表达量作为训练目标，能让组织学图像预测的 ST 更贴合差异表达基因发现这一下游用途。

papers.title: Optimizing the Phi-2 Small Language Model for Real-time Chatbot Applications Using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with QLoRA Quantization
papers.abstract_en: This study explores the optimization of the Phi-2 Small Language Models (SLMs) for real-time chatbot applications through Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA). QLoRA specifically refers to the integration of PEFT with LoRA alongside a 4-bit quantization process, aimed at enhancing computational efficiency. These models, initially designed for high performance with minimal computational overhead, are further refined to address the constraints of mobile and edge computing environments. By integrating PEFT with QLoRA, the research aims to reduce memory usage significantly while maintaining, or potentially improving, the accuracy of model responses in real-time interactions. The effectiveness of these techniques was evaluated using the ROUGE metric system, which showed notable improvements in the summarization tasks performed by the models. This approach not only confirms the feasibility of using SLMs in resource-restricted environments but also opens up new avenues for deploying advanced AI-driven applications in real-time settings. The study's findings have significant implications for the development of efficient, scalable, and accessible AI technologies, paving the way for broader adoption in various industries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 PEFT 与 QLoRA（LoRA 加 4-bit 量化）微调 Phi-2 小语言模型，面向移动端与边缘设备的实时聊天机器人，在显著降低内存占用的同时保持或提升回答准确度。ROUGE 评测显示摘要任务表现有明显改善，验证了 SLM 在资源受限环境部署的可行性。
Motivation: 实时聊天机器人部署在移动与边缘设备上受内存和算力约束，全参数微调大模型难以落地，需要在压缩资源的同时不损失回答质量。
Method: 对 Phi-2 SLM 结合参数高效微调 (PEFT) 与 QLoRA（LoRA 低秩适配加 4-bit 量化）进行微调，以降低内存占用并适配边缘计算环境，用 ROUGE 指标评估摘要任务表现。
Result: ROUGE 评测显示模型在摘要任务上取得明显改善；方法显著降低内存占用，同时维持或可能提升实时交互中的回答准确度。
Conclusion: PEFT 加 QLoRA 可行地让 Phi-2 这类 SLM 在资源受限环境中部署，兼顾效率与回答质量，为实时 AI 应用规模化落地提供路径。

papers.title: Quantization Error Is Spectrally Flat: A Single Random Probe Is a Calibrated, Data-Free Sensitivity Estimator, with Application to Budget-Targeted Mixed-Precision Quantization
papers.abstract_en: A single random Gaussian probe gives an unbiased estimate of the squared Frobenius norm of a layer's quantization error. The estimator is well-behaved because round-to-nearest error is spectrally flat. Across 1,683 tensors from a 35B MoE and a 9B dense model, effective dimensionality is 0.93 to 0.96 times the i.i.d. noise value of the same shape, and on the MoE the median is unchanged from 2-bit to 8-bit. The probe coefficient of variation is predictable from tensor shape. One probe measures per-tensor sensitivity to within 4 to 7%; twenty probes reach 1.3 to 1.4%.RAM applies the propagated form of this estimator to budget-targeted mixed-precision quantization with no calibration data. Gaussian probes carrying the network's own input statistics score every tensor at six bit-widths. A knapsack solver allocates bits under an exact byte budget, with guardrails against catastrophic 2-bit assignments. One probe pass serves any budget. Isolated and propagated scores rank tensors independently on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Spearman -0.01), yet the propagated probe rank-correlates 0.81 to 0.83 with the GPTQ layer objective from real activations, while the isolated estimator is uncorrelated with it. That objective is the wrong allocation target: at matched bytes on Qwen3.8-27B, a block-output probe beats a vendor IQ3_M mix and an oracle that allocates from the real-activation objective.On Qwen3-8B the propagated probe ties HAWQ-V2 at matched bytes. Across seven architectures from 8B to 122B, with probe timing up to a 400B model in nine minutes on one workstation, RAM reaches 3.5 to 13.6% lower median WikiText-2 perplexity than size-comparable uniform 4-bit builds on the tested MoE models

TL;DR: RAM 用单个随机高斯探针无偏估计层量化误差的平方 Frobenius 范数，依据是 round-to-nearest 误差谱平坦；再把传播形式的分数送入背包求解器，在精确字节预算下做无校准数据的混合精度分配。1,683 个张量上单探针把敏感度估到 4–7% 误差，20 探针到 1.3–1.4%；传播分数与 GPTQ 真实激活目标的 Spearman 相关 0.81–0.83，七个架构上中位 WikiText-2 困惑度比同规模均匀 4-bit 构建低 3.5–13.6%。
Motivation: 混合精度量化通常依赖校准数据来评估各张量敏感度，而 GPTQ 层目标需要真实激活；作者主张该目标本身就是错误的分配目标，需要一个数据自由且校准过的敏感度估计量。
Method: 单个随机高斯探针给出量化误差平方 Frobenius 范数的无偏估计，其良态性来自 round-to-nearest 误差的谱平坦性；RAM 用携带网络自身输入统计的高斯探针在六个 bit-width 上给每个张量打分（传播形式），再由背包求解器在精确字节预算下分配比特，并对灾难性 2-bit 分配加护栏，一次探针扫描可服务任意预算。

papers.title: HyperMCTS: Hypergraph-Augmented MCTS for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate decisions under constraints that span an entire solution. Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) offers a promising approach to test-time scaling by exploring alternative action trajectories, but model computation and environment interaction make search costly. Efficient search therefore requires effective reuse of trajectory feedback. Standard MCTS maintains prefix-specific statistics, without explicitly accumulating outcomes for decision groups that recur across different paths. To fill this gap, we propose HyperMCTS, a training-free method that augments an ordered MCTS tree with a cross-trajectory hypergraph. Hyperedges represent groups of canonical decisions and accumulate their observed returns within the current task. Our hypergraph-guided HyperUCT selection rule aggregates evidence from overlapping hyperedges into an action prior, allowing outcomes collected under one prefix to inform selection under another while preserving execution histories in the tree. On DeepPlanning, HyperMCTS improves average planning accuracy by 2.3--7.3 percentage points over the strongest baseline for each of three backbone models. It enables Qwen3.6-27B to outperform Claude Opus 4.6 (max) on Shopping Planning, while achieving higher accuracy with fewer LLM calls and output tokens than the evaluated MCTS-based baselines. SealQA experiments further demonstrate improvements in question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperMCTS 用跨轨迹超图把不同前缀下重复出现的规范化决策分组，超边累积组内回报，再由 HyperUCT 把重叠超边的证据聚合成动作先验，使一个前缀下收集的结果能指导另一个前缀的选择。在 DeepPlanning 上，它对三个 backbone 各自最强基线的平均规划精度提升 2.3–7.3 个百分点，并让 Qwen3.6-27B 在 Shopping Planning 上超过 Claude Opus 4.6 (max)，同时用更少的 LLM 调用与输出 token。
Motivation: 标准 MCTS 只维护前缀专属的统计量，不会把跨不同路径重复出现的决策组的结果累积起来；长时程任务中模型计算与环境交互昂贵，搜索必须有效复用轨迹反馈。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的 HyperMCTS：在有序 MCTS 树之外加一个跨轨迹超图，超边表示规范化决策组并累积当前任务内的观测回报；HyperUCT 选择规则把重叠超边的证据聚合成动作先验，同时在树中保留执行历史。
Result: DeepPlanning 上，对每个 backbone 的最强基线，平均规划精度提升 2.3–7.3 个百分点（三个 backbone 模型）；Qwen3.6-27B 在 Shopping Planning 上超过 Claude Opus 4.6 (max)，且相对所评测的 MCTS 基线用更少的 LLM 调用与输出 token 达到更高精度；SealQA 问答实验也显示提升。
Conclusion: 把跨前缀重复决策的回报聚合进选择先验，可以在不训练的前提下提升长时程 LLM 规划与问答的精度并降低搜索开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Validating Memory-Optimal Transformer Kernels on Real Hardware: From Formal Derivation to Measured Performance Across Two HPC Clusters
papers.abstract_en: We validate memory-optimal cost functions for transformer kernels derived via the Mathematics of Arrays (MoA). Companion Papers I-IV formally derive kernels for attention forward, backward, fused forward+backward, decode, and the complete block (RMSNorm, gated MLP) as a hardware-independent specification (DNF) transformed to a machine-specific realization (ONF) via gamma, with verification to machine precision against PyTorch. This paper checks those predictions against measured performance on two HPC clusters (Purdue Anvil, NCSA Delta) across CPU and GPU. Three results stand out. (1) We identify and fix a GPU regression: fusing forward+backward, proven to avoid materializing an O(n^2) intermediate, initially ran slower than naive on GPU due to atomic contention. Profiling confirmed 2.00x more atomic instructions; a targeted ONF rewrite reversed it, yielding up to 2.5x speedup. (2) Identical derivations produce markedly different real costs by topology: 535x NUMA-locality penalty on one cluster vs <3x oversubscription on another, showing optimal deployment is a function of the machine's array structure. (3) We report a partially resolved anomaly: identical denotational computations run faster in C than Fortran on CPU but faster in Fortran than C on GPU, narrowed to one dominant kernel and one memory-latency stall mechanism (3.17x time gap matches 3.35x stall gap). We treat hardware-specific optimization as a routine ONF rewrite with fixed, verified DNF, a candidate methodology for scaling AI onto evolving hardware without re-deriving correctness.
papers.comment: Companion validation for Papers I-IV. Paper I arXiv:2606.07713, Paper II HAL:05659212, Paper III arXiv:2607.19456, Paper IV HAL:05734881 (https://hal.science/hal-05734881). 26 pages, 20 figures (placeholders in v1, real figures in v2). Implementation: https://github.com/womenflyplanes/moa-attention-verified-mullin. Allocation CIS261396 on Purdue Anvil and NCSA Delta via ACCESS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Mathematics of Arrays (MoA) 把 Transformer kernel 的内存最优代价函数从硬件无关规格 (DNF) 经 gamma 变换到机器相关实现 (ONF)，在 Purdue Anvil 与 NCSA Delta 两个 HPC 集群的 CPU/GPU 上实测验证。融合 forward+backward 因 atomic contention 初次比 naive 慢，profiling 显示 atomic 指令多 2.00x，改写 ONF 后最高 2.5x 加速；同一推导在不同集群上代价差 535x NUMA 惩罚 vs <3x oversubscription。
Motivation: 形式推导出的 kernel 规格与真实硬件实测性能之间存在缺口：同一份正确性已验证的推导在不同机器拓扑上可能表现迥异，AI 规模化到演进硬件时需要不重推正确性就能重写的优化路径。
Method: 以 MoA 形式推导 attention forward、backward、融合 forward+backward、decode 及完整 block（RMSNorm、gated MLP）的 kernel，DNF 经 gamma 变换为 ONF，并已对 PyTorch 验证到机器精度；本篇在两个 HPC 集群的 CPU/GPU 上实测，用 profiling 定位 atomic contention 并做针对性 ONF 改写。
Result: 融合 forward+backward 初次在 GPU 上比 naive 慢，profiling 确认 atomic 指令多 2.00x，改写 ONF 后最高 2.5x 加速；同一推导在两集群上代价差异为 535x NUMA-locality 惩罚 vs <3x oversubscription；C 与 Fortran 的异常在 CPU 上 C 更快、GPU 上 Fortran 更快，收敛到单一主导 kernel 与单一 memory-latency stall 机制，3.17x 时间差对应 3.35x stall 差。
Conclusion: 硬件特定优化可当作在固定且已验证的 DNF 上的常规 ONF 改写，无需重推正确性即可把 AI 扩展到演进中的硬件；最优部署取决于机器的 array 结构。

papers.title: Training Witnesses: Trusting the Training without Trusting the Trainer
papers.abstract_en: Progress in machine learning cannot outpace our ability to verify it. With an explosion in papers today, every scientific claim rests initially on trust in the trainer, leading to uneven evaluation, baselines, and forestalling of reliable progress. Traditionally, the burden of verification falls on the reader, who must reproduce expensive training runs. This strategy is impractical due to an explosion in slop contributions, diversity of methods, and the sheer compute required. We put the burden of proof where it belongs, on the trainer, and in the process also cut the overall cost of verification significantly. We introduce Witnesses, a method for certifying training, data usage and evaluation in a neural network training run. Our key insight is that fast behavioral fingerprints with occasional replay challenges are sufficient for auditing neural network training. Our method is applicable at scale with minimal overhead to the trainer, is cheap for the verifier, rejects bad training runs with amplifiable probability, and allows for exact queries of both data inclusion and exclusion. We test our method on language model training runs from 100M to 2B scales, across DDP and FSDP, and demonstrate this minimal overhead. We also introduce a self-regulating leaderboard of "auto-certified" training runs that enables shared baselines and progress. We invite the community to participate in the leaderboard to improve reproducibility in machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Witnesses：用快速行为指纹加偶发 replay challenge 来认证一次神经网络训练的训练过程、数据使用与评估，把验证负担从读者转回训练者。在 100M 到 2B 规模、DDP 与 FSDP 的语言模型训练上开销极小，可按可放大概率拒绝坏训练运行，并支持对数据纳入与排除的精确查询。
Motivation: 论文数量激增使每个科学结论起初都依赖对训练者的信任，评估与基线参差不齐；让读者复现昂贵训练的做法因 slop 投稿、方法多样和算力规模而不可行。
Method: Witnesses 以快速行为指纹 (behavioral fingerprints) 加偶发 replay challenge 审计训练，认证训练、数据使用与评估；对训练者开销极小、对验证者成本低，支持数据纳入/排除的精确查询，并配套一个自监管的 auto-certified 排行榜以共享基线。
Result: 在 100M 到 2B 规模的语言模型训练运行上、跨 DDP 与 FSDP 演示了最小开销；坏训练运行可以按可放大概率 (amplifiable probability) 被拒绝。
Conclusion: 把举证责任放在训练者一侧，用便宜的行为指纹加 replay challenge 即可低成本认证训练，从而支撑共享基线与可复现的机器学习进展。

papers.title: When Consent Outlives Context: Residual Authority Replay in Long-Lived Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on user approval to authorize security-sensitive actions at runtime. Such approvals are granted within a specific task and execution context. In long-lived agents, authorization decisions may need to persist across tasks or sessions. We find that this continuity can outlive the context that originally justified the approval, creating residual authority reusable without renewed consent. We expose this failure mode through a longitudinal attack that starts from a target security-sensitive action, identifies the authority required to execute it, induces benign interactions that legitimately obtain that authority, and later replays the residual authority during adversarial execution. Across controlled and live settings, we demonstrate that residual-authority replay arises in practice and substantially increases the success of prompt-injection and context-rebinding attacks. We evaluate 508 AgentDojo attack cases across six LLM families using production-derived authorization semantics. With residual authority, attack success rate (ASR) increases by up to 35.1 percentage points compared with a fresh authorization state. In live context-rebinding attacks on 55 Terminal-Bench cases across three real-world production coding agents, residual-authority replay increases ASR by 24.9 percentage points on average. These findings expose a fundamental mismatch between persistent authorization and the contextual nature of user consent in long-lived LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: JIVE: Jacobian-Informed Volume Expansion for Diverse Generative Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Generative models often suffer from mode collapse and limited sample diversity. While prior works attempt to mitigate this by jointly generating a batch of samples and repelling their trajectories, these heuristics do not explicitly maximize the diversity of the resulting endpoints. We introduce JIVE, a training-free framework that enhances generative diversity by injecting velocity perturbations aligned with the leading right singular subspace of the generator's endpoint Jacobian. By leveraging this local geometric structure, JIVE provably maximizes endpoint diversity while preserving sample quality. To maintain practical efficiency, we compute these perturbation directions via matrix-free iterations rooted in classical numerical linear algebra, requiring only a small computational overhead. Across different benchmarks, JIVE boosts both pixel and feature-level diversity in few-step and one-step generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JIVE 是免训练的生成多样性框架：把速度扰动对齐到生成器端点 Jacobian 的主右奇异子空间，在保持样本质量的前提下可证明地最大化端点多样性。扰动方向用矩阵自由 (matrix-free) 迭代求得，开销很小；在多个 benchmark 上，few-step 与 one-step 生成的像素级和特征级多样性均被提升。
Motivation: 生成模型常出现 mode collapse 与样本多样性不足；已有联合批量生成并排斥轨迹的做法是启发式，没有显式最大化最终端点的多样性。
Method: 训练-free：在采样时注入与生成器端点 Jacobian 主右奇异子空间对齐的速度扰动，利用该局部几何结构最大化端点多样性；扰动方向通过源自经典数值线性 algebra 的矩阵自由迭代计算，只带来少量计算开销。
Result: 在不同 benchmark 上，JIVE 同时提升像素级与特征级多样性，覆盖 few-step 与 one-step 生成两种设置；方法可证明地最大化端点多样性并保持样本质量，计算开销仅为少量。
Conclusion: 对齐端点 Jacobian 主右奇异子空间的速度扰动，是免训练地缓解 mode collapse、提升少步/单步生成多样性的有效手段，且代价可控。

papers.title: On the Two Faces of Adam in Separable Linear Classification
papers.abstract_en: We consider the behavior of deterministic, full-batch, bias-corrected Adam in separable linear classification with softmax parametrization under log-loss. In this setting, under a wide range of conditions Adam is known to approach max-norm-margin optimality when its stability constant $ε$ is zero, while with a positive $ε$, it is known to approach Euclidean-margin optimality. Our main contribution is the quantitative description of Adam's behavior for small fixed positive $ε$. We give sufficient conditions under which an Adam-trained classifier nearly maximizes the max-norm margin before the updates become gradient-like. We also show that the classifier reaches a fixed target Euclidean margin only much later. Specifically, we show that for polynomially decreasing stepsizes with exponent \(a\), where \(1/3<a<1\), the updates become approximately proportional to the negative gradient after $Θ(\log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})$ iterations. At that time, the classifier still nearly maximizes the max-norm margin. Reaching a fixed target Euclidean margin above that of every max-norm-optimal classifier, but below the optimum, is shown to require $ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}$ iterations. Under inverse-linear stepsize decay (\(a=1\)), the update transition takes polynomially many iterations, whereas reaching the target margin takes exponentially many. Experiments support these predictions. The later change in the classifier can improve or worsen generalization after training error reaches zero, connecting the analysis to grokking and its reverse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可分线性分类 + softmax + log-loss 下，确定性全批量带偏差修正的 Adam 在小而固定的稳定性常数 ε 下有两副面孔：更新在 Θ(log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)}) 步后才转为近似负梯度，此时分类器仍几乎最大化 max-norm margin；而要达到高于所有 max-norm 最优分类器、但低于最优的固定 Euclidean margin，需要 ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)} 步。幂率步长指数 1/3<a<1 时两者都是多项式量级，a=1（反线性衰减）时转变是多项式、达到目标 margin 却是指数级。训练误差归零后分类器的后续变化可能改善也可能恶化泛化，对应 grokking 与其反向现象。
Motivation: 已知 ε=0 时 Adam 趋向 max-norm-margin 最优、ε>0 时趋向 Euclidean-margin 最优，但小而固定的正 ε 下两种行为如何在时间上分离、分离多快，此前只有定性结论。
Method: 对确定性全批量、带偏差修正的 Adam 在可分线性分类与 softmax 参数化、log-loss 下做定量分析：给出充分条件，证明在更新转为梯度式之前分类器已几乎最大化 max-norm margin，并对幂率步长（指数 a，1/3<a<1）与反线性衰减（a=1）分别推导两个时间尺度的阶。
Result: 更新在 Θ(log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)}) 次迭代后近似正比于负梯度，此时仍几乎最大化 max-norm margin；达到高于每个 max-norm 最优分类器、但低于最优的固定目标 Euclidean margin 需要 ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)} 次迭代。a=1 时更新转变需多项式多次迭代，而达到目标 margin 需指数多次。实验支持这些预测。
Conclusion: Adam 在小固定 ε 下的两种最优性不是同时到达，而是相隔一个由 ε 与步长指数 a 决定的巨大时间窗；训练误差归零后该窗口内的分类器变化会改善或恶化泛化，把该分析与 grokking 及其反向联系起来。

papers.title: Finite Probes Suffice: Identifiability and Universality for Weight-Space Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning properties of neural networks has recently attracted growing interest, with existing approaches operating either directly on network parameters or through probe-based representations of network behavior. While probing methods have shown strong empirical performance, their theoretical foundations remain limited. In this work, we study when finite probe-based representations are sufficient for learning neural functionals. We establish general identification and universality results for probing, and show that using intermediate hidden representations can provide significantly more informative representations than relying only on final outputs. Motivated by these results, we introduce HIDDENPROBE, a simple architecture for learning from hidden probe responses. Across a range of neural functional benchmarks, including both MLPs and Transformers, HIDDENPROBE consistently improves over existing probing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is publicly available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明有限探针 (finite probe) 表示足以识别与逼近神经函数als：中间隐藏层探针比只用最终输出信息量显著更大，并据此提出 HIDDENPROBE 架构，在含 MLP 与 Transformer 的神经函数al基准上持续优于现有 probing 方法并达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 基于探针的 weight-space learning 经验效果强但理论基础薄弱：何时有限探针表示足以学习神经函数al缺少识别性与普适性结论。
Method: 先给出 probing 的一般性 identification 与 universality 结果，指出中间隐藏表示比仅用最终输出更有信息量；据此设计 HIDDENPROBE，一个从隐藏探针响应学习的简单架构，代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Result: 在一系列神经函数al基准（涵盖 MLP 与 Transformer）上，HIDDENPROBE 一致优于现有 probing 方法并取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 有限探针表示足以支撑神经函数al学习，且利用中间隐藏探针响应是比只看输出更有效的表示来源。

papers.title: No Free Efficiency: Revisiting the Trade-off Between Training Efficiency and Model Vulnerability
papers.abstract_en: Training efficiency has become the central driver of recent progress in foundation models. To overcome the massive computational and data requirements of large-scale training, researchers increasingly adopt strategies such as selective data sampling, efficient pre-training, and simplified reinforcement learning pipelines. While these strategies drastically reduce overhead, they prompt a critical, yet neglected question: Is efficiency achieved at the expense of model robustness and security? To our knowledge, we present the first systematic cross-domain investigation of the efficiency-vulnerability trade-off. Across vision and language models, we show that efficiency-oriented training increases susceptibility to adversarial and privacy attacks. We characterize this vulnerability by analyzing the models' internal geometry and functional representations, demonstrating that the evaluated efficient variants consistently exhibit sharper loss geometry together with systematic changes in representational structure. We further extend our analysis to "zero RL training", finding that models trained using simplified RL recipes exhibit substantially greater susceptibility to catastrophic forgetting and more pronounced overconfidence than those trained through conventional alignment pipelines. Our findings suggest that training efficiency is rarely a "free lunch"; rather, the mechanisms that minimize computation can inadvertently compromise safety. We conclude by calling for a paradigm shift toward multi-objective training that jointly optimizes for performance, cost, and security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文首次系统跨领域考察训练效率与模型脆弱性的权衡：选择性采样、高效预训练、简化 RL 等提效策略在视觉与语言模型上一致提高对抗攻击与隐私攻击的易感性，且高效变体呈现更尖锐的损失几何与系统性表征结构变化。简化 RL（zero RL training）训练的模型比常规对齐管线更易灾难性遗忘、过度自信更明显，作者主张转向同时优化性能、成本与安全的多目标训练。
Motivation: 基础模型训练普遍以选择性数据采样、高效预训练、简化 RL 管线压缩算力与数据开销，但效率是否以鲁棒性与安全性为代价这一问题被系统性忽视。
Method: 在视觉与语言模型上做首个跨领域效率—脆弱性权衡调查：比较效率导向训练与常规训练的变体，用对抗攻击与隐私攻击度量易感性，并从内部损失几何 (loss geometry) 与功能表征结构两个角度刻画脆弱性来源；另将分析扩展到 zero RL training，对比简化 RL 配方与常规对齐管线。
Result: 效率导向训练在视觉与语言模型上均提升对抗与隐私攻击易感性；高效变体一致表现出更尖锐的损失几何与系统性表征结构变化；简化 RL 配方训练的模型相比常规对齐管线，灾难性遗忘易感性显著更高、过度自信更明显。
Conclusion: 训练效率很少是免费午餐：压低算力的机制会无意间损害模型安全，应转向同时优化性能、成本与安全的多目标训练范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Residual-Stream Burden Shapes Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In diffusion-based generation, a neural network can be trained to predict the clean data, the noise, or the velocity from a noisy input. These prediction targets are interconvertible and describe the same generative process, yet plain Diffusion Transformers operating on large pixel patches succeed with clean prediction and fail with noise or velocity prediction. We argue that this asymmetry arises because noisy targets require the residual stream to preserve noise-dependent input variation through depth for the final readout, forcing subsequent layers to compute on noisy representations. A spectrally concentrated clean target imposes a lighter demand, leaving greater freedom to organize hidden representations for subsequent computation. We call this preservation requirement *residual-stream burden* and show how it shapes representation learning in Diffusion Transformers. Controlled experiments indicate that the exploitable structure is spectral concentration in patch space and that the bandwidth of the persistent residual state is a key resource for noisy prediction. We further show that this account is consistent with recent decoupled pixel-space architectures, whose diverse designs all reduce the residual-stream burden on the main pathway. To examine this understanding from a complementary direction, we expand and reorganize the residual-stream bandwidth directly, introducing Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC) that reach FID 1.71 on ImageNet $256^2$. Together, these results identify residual-stream burden as a mechanism through which prediction targets and architecture jointly shape representation learning in Diffusion Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 residual-stream burden 概念解释大像素 patch 的 plain Diffusion Transformer 为何用 clean prediction 成功、用 noise/velocity prediction 失败：噪声类目标要求残差流在深度上保持噪声相关的输入变化，迫使后续层在含噪表征上计算，而谱集中的 clean 目标负担更轻。据此直接扩展并重组残差流带宽，提出 Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC)，在 ImageNet 256^2 上达到 FID 1.71。
Motivation: Diffusion Transformer 的三种预测目标（clean/noise/velocity）本可互换、描述同一生成过程，但在大像素 patch 下 clean 成功而 noise/velocity 失败，这一不对称缺少机制解释。
Method: 定义 residual-stream burden：噪声类目标需残差流跨层保持噪声相关变化，clean 目标谱集中、负担更轻；用受控实验辨识可利用结构为 patch 空间谱集中、持久残差态带宽是噪声预测的关键资源；再直接扩展与重组残差流带宽，提出 Spatially Indexed Hyper-Connections (SiHC)。
Result: 受控实验指向 exploitable structure 是 patch 空间谱集中，持久残差态带宽是噪声预测的关键资源；该解释与近期多种 decoupled pixel-space 架构一致，它们都降低主通路的 residual-stream burden；SiHC 在 ImageNet 256^2 上达到 FID 1.71。
Conclusion: 预测目标与架构通过 residual-stream burden 共同塑造 Diffusion Transformer 的表征学习，扩展残差流带宽是提升生成质量的一条直接路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MISHAP-Bench: A Hallucination Benchmark for Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) produce fluent responses about audio but often hallucinate by making plausible yet ungrounded claims. Existing audio hallucination benchmarks mainly measure response correctness, leaving it unclear whether an LALM hallucinates or simply fails to understand the audio. We challenge correctness-based evaluation by defining two hallucination categories: (i) context, where claims are not grounded in the audio; and (ii) knowledge, where claims about audio-related topics lack support from externally verifiable facts. We introduce MISHAP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark with 12,000 challenging open-ended question-audio pairs and a rigorous evaluation pipeline covering both categories. To evaluate open-ended responses, we propose a groundedness judge that uses reference rubrics and judge prompts guided by human annotations. We extensively evaluate ten state-of-the-art LALMs and show that hallucination remains substantial. Even a frontier model such as Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches a hallucination rate of 36.5%. We further adapt and benchmark four mitigation methods from multiple domains for LALMs. Despite some improvements, effective hallucination mitigation remains an open challenge. Finally, we call on the community to evaluate hallucination and benchmark mitigation methods with MISHAP-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MISHAP-Bench 把音频幻觉拆成 context（主张无音频依据）与 knowledge（音频相关主张无可核验事实支撑）两类，用 12,000 条开放式问答对和基于参考 rubric、人工标注引导的 groundedness judge 评测十个前沿 LALM。幻觉依然严重：Gemini 3.7 Flash 幻觉率仍达 36.5%；四个跨领域缓解方法虽有改善，有效缓解仍是开放问题。
Motivation: 现有音频幻觉基准只测回答正确性，无法区分模型是幻觉还是根本没听懂音频，开放式回答也缺少可操作的评测手段。
Method: 构建 12,000 条高难度开放式 question-audio pairs，覆盖 context 与 knowledge 两类幻觉；提出 groundedness judge，用参考 rubric 与人工标注引导的 judge prompt 判定开放式回答是否有据；评测十个 SOTA LALM，并从多个领域改编四个缓解方法做基准。
Result: 12,000 条开放式问答对；十个前沿 LALM 上幻觉仍然大量存在，Gemini 3.7 Flash 幻觉率 36.5%；四个缓解方法带来部分改善但未解决问题。
Conclusion: 正确性评测不足以判定音频幻觉，需按 context/knowledge 分类并配合 groundedness judge；现有缓解手段尚不足以把幻觉压到可接受水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Augmented Feature Boosting for Multicalibration
papers.abstract_en: Multicalibration requires a predictor's residuals to be unbiased not only globally, but also after conditioning on the predictor's own level sets and reweighting by a rich class of test functions. Standard boosting approaches in the distributional setting achieve this by repeatedly discretizing the predictor's range then auditing and repairing the resulting level sets. One consequence is that in practice, the algorithm's guarantees are sensitive to this parametrization of the rounding parameter. A natural theoretical question, then, is how to do discretization-free boosting which avoids this rounding within the boosting process itself. Here, we analyze an alternative feature-augmentation boosting paradigm inspired by Tax et al. (2026): at each round, a squared-loss oracle is called on hypotheses that receive the previous predictor's output as an additional feature, and only the final predictor is rounded to have a finite set of level sets to provide the multicalibration guarantee with respect to. We give a theoretical analysis of this procedure through the expressivity of the augmented hypothesis class, and show how the expressivity of this class yields a hierarchy of guarantees, including multiaccuracy, multicalibration, and the stronger notion of level-set multicalibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出不做离散化的 multicalibration boosting：每轮把上一轮预测器的输出作为额外特征喂给平方损失 oracle，只在最后对最终预测器取整以给出有限水平集。通过增广假设类的表达力分析，得到从 multiaccuracy、multicalibration 到更强的 level-set multicalibration 的保证层级，从而避开标准 boosting 中保证对取整参数的敏感性。
Motivation: 分布设定下的标准 boosting 需反复离散化预测器取值范围再审计修复水平集，其保证对取整参数的参数化敏感；作者要问能否在 boosting 过程内部就避免取整。
Method: 采用受 Tax et al. (2026) 启发的特征增广 boosting 范式：每轮对以先前预测器输出为附加特征的假设调用平方损失 oracle，仅对最终预测器取整以获得有限水平集；分析路径是刻画增广假设类的表达力，并由此导出保证层级。
Result: 给出该过程的理论分析，证明增广类的表达力产生一个保证层级，涵盖 multiaccuracy、multicalibration 以及更强的 level-set multicalibration；摘要未给出数值实验或定量指标。
Conclusion: 把取整推迟到最后一步、靠特征增广换取表达力，可以在不于 boosting 内部做离散化的情况下给出 multicalibration 保证，并自然分层到更强的 level-set 版本。

papers.title: Where Activation Sparsity and KV-Cache Sparsity Cross in LLM Decoding
papers.abstract_en: At each step, decoding one sequence with a large language model rereads the projection weights, whose traffic is fixed, and the key-value (KV) cache, whose traffic grows with context. Activation sparsity trims the first term and KV-cache sparsity the second, yet their reported speedups are hard to compare because each depends on context length and on the dense attention kernel it is measured against. We derive a byte crossover, the context length at which the two savings are equal, together with ideal speedup bounds for each branch and for their composition, from model dimensions and keep ratios alone. We then time both branches and their composition from 2K to 128K tokens on two GPUs after a dense prefill of real text, with dense and sparse modes reading the cache through the same split-K attention kernel. The projection branch leads at short context and the KV branch at long context, with speedups that follow their byte bounds up to fixed kernel costs. Adding these costs, measured in separate sweeps, lets the byte account predict the measured crossings of three keep-ratio pairs, a second model, and a second GPU to within 4.1K tokens. Timing the dense baseline with masked instead of split-K attention inflates the apparent speedup of the same KV policy about fivefold. An attention-scored KV selection answers the same passkey and multi-key placements as dense decoding up to 127K tokens, whereas a KV window misses most of them. Under matched perplexity budgets, activation sparsity composed with this selection decodes 14 to 26% faster than the best single branch on both GPUs. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ByteCross.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 解码中激活稀疏省固定权重流量、KV-cache 稀疏省随上下文增长的缓存流量，两者各自的速度提升因基线核不同而不可比。作者从模型维度与 keep ratio 推出字节交叉点（byte crossover）及各分支与组合的速度提升上界，实测 2K–128K 上下文后，字节账连同实测核开销可把交叉点预测到 4.1K token 以内；按困惑度预算配对时，激活稀疏与 attention 打分 KV 选择组合比最优单分支快 14–26%。
Motivation: 激活稀疏与 KV-cache 稀疏各自报告的速度提升依赖上下文长度和所对照的 dense attention kernel，横向不可比；需要一个只由模型维度和 keep ratio 决定的判据来定位两者收益相等的位置。
Method: 从模型维度与 keep ratio 推导字节交叉点与各分支及组合的理想速度提升上界；在两块 GPU 上对真实文本 dense prefill 后，从 2K 到 128K token 计时两个分支及其组合，dense 与 sparse 模式都经同一 split-K attention kernel 读缓存；另用独立 sweep 测固定核开销并加入字节账，再用 attention 打分的 KV 选择与 KV window 对比 passkey、multi-key 放置任务。
Result: 短上下文由 projection 分支领先、长上下文由 KV 分支领先；字节账加实测核开销后，对三组 keep-ratio、第二个模型、第二块 GPU 的交叉点预测误差在 4.1K token 以内；若 dense 基线用 masked 而非 split-K attention 计时，同一 KV 策略的表观速度提升被放大约五倍；attention 打分 KV 选择在 127K token 内与 dense 解码答对同样的 passkey 与 multi-key 放置，而 KV window 大多答错；在匹配困惑度预算下，激活稀疏与该选择组合在两块 GPU 上比最优单分支快 14–26%。
Conclusion: 激活稀疏与 KV-cache 稀疏的收益交点可由字节账加核开销预测，且长上下文下两者组合在匹配困惑度时优于任一单分支；基线 kernel 的选择会把同一 KV 策略的速度提升夸大数倍，比较稀疏方法必须先对齐 kernel。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Vanilla Policy Optimization Is Both Optimal and Differentially Private for Stochastic Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Can vanilla policy optimization explore enough to achieve near-optimal regret in stochastic contextual bandits? We show that standard exponential policy updates driven by offline regression do so under realizability, without exploration bonuses or importance weighting. For $A$ actions, $T$ rounds, and a finite prediction class $F$, vanilla PO achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|)})$ regret with high probability. Our analysis reveals an implicit exploration mechanism of independent interest: gradual policy updates prevent actions from losing probability too quickly, allowing the regression oracle to learn their expected losses. We further develop a batched version using only $O(\log T)$ regression calls and policy switches, and show how private regression oracles yield differentially private contextual bandit algorithms without composition across batches. For a finite class, this gives pure $\varepsilon_{\rm priv}$-DP and regret $\widetilde O\left( \sqrt{AT \log(|F|/δ)}(1+\varepsilon_{\rm priv}^{-1/2}) \right)$. Finally, experiments across oracle-based contextual bandit algorithms, with and without privacy, demonstrate the practical effectiveness of policy optimization and the value of explicit exploration under stronger privacy constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可实现性 (realizability) 下，标准指数策略更新加离线回归即可让 vanilla policy optimization 在随机 contextual bandit 中拿到近最优 regret，无需探索 bonus 或重要性加权；高概率下 regret 为 Õ(√(AT log|F|))。渐进式策略更新构成隐式探索，且私有回归 oracle 直接给出纯 ε-DP 算法而无需跨批组合。
Motivation: contextual bandit 中近最优 regret 通常依赖显式探索或重要性加权，本文要问 vanilla PO 是否本身就够，并希望在差分隐私约束下同时保住 regret。
Method: 用离线回归驱动的指数策略更新 (vanilla policy optimization)，分析其隐式探索机制；再给出只用 O(log T) 次回归调用与策略切换的批处理版本，把私有回归 oracle 嵌入各批以获得差分隐私。
Result: A 动作、T 轮、有限预测类 F 下高概率 regret Õ(√(AT log|F|))；批处理版仅需 O(log T) 次回归调用与策略切换；纯 ε_priv-DP 下 regret 为 Õ(√(AT log(|F|/δ))·(1+ε_priv^{-1/2}))；并在带与不带隐私的 oracle 类 contextual bandit 算法上做了实验。
Conclusion: 渐进策略更新本身就足以支撑近最优 regret，隐私可经私有 oracle 逐批获得而无需跨批组合；更强隐私约束下显式探索才有额外价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faster Block-Diffusion Serving with Distribution-Free Risk Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Block-diffusion language models are served at hand-picked operating points, such as acceptance thresholds, buffer depth, schedule, checkpoint and precision, and each point is chosen by its mean benchmark accuracy. However, a mean does not tell an operator how often a faster configuration fails on prompts that the slower one answers correctly. On the serving engine and its decode traces, the default commit rule already commits every fully resolved block, a static skip rule captures nearly all of the compute that allocation can save, and self-distillation on engine-decoded targets adds speed at unchanged accuracy. Larger speedups come from lower thresholds, which commit tokens that are still uncertain. We therefore present Redline, a finite-sample procedure that selects operating points, hand-picked or learned, from the correctness of their answers on calibration prompts. Redline keeps the reference-relative risk, the joint probability that the reference answers correctly and a candidate configuration does not, within a user-chosen budget with high probability, and deploys the fastest configuration that passes. It speeds up math at a smaller risk budget than code in both model families, and at a budget of ten percent it deploys a LLaDA2 math configuration that commits over a third more tokens in each forward. It also applies without modification to the acceptance rule of speculative decoding and to weight quantization. On the same calibration data, Redline stays within its stated failure probability, whereas each tolerance of a mean-accuracy rule either gains less speed for some model and task or exceeds the risk budget far more often for another. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/Redline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Redline 用校准提示上的答案正确性做有限样本选择，为 block-diffusion 语言模型的 serving 工作点（阈值、buffer、schedule、精度）给出分布无关的参考相对风险保证：以高概率把「参考答对而候选答错」的联合概率压在用户给定预算内，并部署通过该预算的最快配置。在 10% 风险预算下它部署的 LLaDA2 数学配置每次 forward 提交的 token 多出三分之一以上；同一批校准数据上 Redline 保持在声明的失败概率内，而均值准确率规则要么在某些模型/任务上提速更少，要么在另一个上更频繁地超出风险预算。
Motivation: block-diffusion LM 的 serving 工作点全靠手工按平均 benchmark 准确率挑，但均值无法告诉运维人员：更快配置在慢配置答对的 prompt 上有多频繁地答错，因而缺少可声明的风险上界。
Method: Redline 是一个有限样本选择过程：在校准 prompt 上比较候选工作点（手工或学习得到）与参考配置的答案正确性，约束参考相对风险（参考答对且候选答错的联合概率）在用户给定预算内并以高概率成立，然后部署通过预算的最快配置；同一过程可不加修改地套到 speculative decoding 的 acceptance rule 和权重量化上。
Result: 在两个模型族上，数学任务都能在比代码更小的风险预算下提速；10% 风险预算下部署的 LLaDA2 数学配置每次 forward 提交的 token 多出三分之一以上。同一批校准数据上 Redline 保持在声明的失败概率内，而均值准确率规则的每种容忍度要么在某些模型和任务上提速更少，要么在另一个上更频繁超出风险预算。

papers.title: Prospective Interpretation Risk: Principled Communication Control Between LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agentic systems increasingly rely on models communicating with one another, yet existing uncertainty and multi-agent methods rarely estimate how a particular receiver will interpret a message before it is sent. This matters in heterogeneous systems, where capable receivers can reconstruct different tasks from the same message. We model this as a sender-receiver problem with a latent receiver type and define prospective interpretation risk (PIR): the probability that a receiver reconstructs a task other than intended. Rather than model an LLM's full input-output behaviour, we use black-box probes relating messages, intended tasks, and receiver-specific reconstructions, yielding scalable supervision while separating interpretation from downstream capability failure. Offline, heterogeneous frozen receivers provide supervision for receiver-conditioned risk and the effects of predefined mutable message features. At deployment, history induces a posterior over receiver types, guiding message revision and selection. We introduce value of interpretation information (VoII), querying for receiver information only when its expected communication benefit exceeds its cost. Our theory characterises when receiver information has decision value and bounds such queries. Empirically, interpretation-failure rates vary by 4-13x across receivers. Receiver information reduces PIR calibration error by 68% relative to a receiver-agnostic predictor, largely by correcting receiver-specific risk levels. PIR-guided revision reduces interpretation failure by 44% relative to the original message and 40% relative to a generic rewrite, mostly through a repair that helps every receiver. VoII outperforms information-gain and random querying at matched cost on the interpretation objective it optimises, lowering interpretation failure from 3.84% to 3.79% while querying 18.2% of episodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出前瞻解释风险 (prospective interpretation risk, PIR)：在消息发出前估计接收方把任务重构错的概率，用黑盒探针做接收方条件化风险估计，并以 VoII 决定何时为接收方信息付费查询。实验中不同接收方的解释失败率相差 4–13 倍，PIR 校准误差比接收方无关预测低 68%，PIR 引导改写使解释失败比原消息降 44%、比通用改写降 40%。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统里，现有不确定性与多智能体方法都不在发送前估计特定接收方会如何解读消息；异构系统中不同能力的接收方能从同一消息重构出不同任务，解释失败与下游能力失败难以区分。
Method: 把问题建模为带隐接收方类型的 sender-receiver 问题，定义 PIR 为接收方重构出非预期任务的概率；用关联消息、预期任务与接收方重构的黑盒探针替代完整输入输出建模，离线用异构 frozen receivers 提供接收方条件化风险监督与可变消息特征效应，部署时由历史推断接收方类型后验来指导改写与选择，并引入 VoII 在预期收益超过成本时才查询接收方信息。
Result: 解释失败率在不同接收方之间相差 4–13 倍；接收方信息使 PIR 校准误差相对接收方无关预测降低 68%，主要来自纠正接收方特有的风险水平；PIR 引导改写相对原消息降低解释失败 44%，相对通用改写降低 40%，主要靠一个对所有接收方都有益的修复；VoII 在匹配成本下优于 information-gain 与随机查询，把解释失败从 3.84% 降到 3.79%，查询了 18.2% 的 episodes。
Conclusion: 接收方类型信息对通信决策有实际决策价值，按 PIR 与 VoII 来改写和查询能在同等成本下降低 LLM 间的解释失败；理论刻画了接收方信息何时具有决策价值并给出查询上界。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Neuron-Level Architecture Growth: A Controlled Evaluation for EEG Time-Series Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional EEG decoders are trained at a fixed width, usually set by their authors on other data. Growing methods add neurons during training where the loss could decrease the most, but whether they improve compared to a reference width is untested on EEG. Here, we grow three convolutional backbones on 12 motor-imagery datasets under three protocols and compare each with its reference model per subject. The growing ShallowFBCSPNet scores 2.9 points above its reference model with only half the parameters (0.57x), SCCNet changes by at most 1.2 points. Deep4Net growing models show decreased accuracy, but they require adaptation that prevent to compare faithfully the results. These differences follow the selection step, which keeps a candidate neuron relying on a dynamic threshold from singular values decomposition. Overall, these results suggest that growth helps when its criterion can rank the candidate neurons, and that the rate of skipped neuron addition tells where a decoder can be grown small from scratch.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 12 个运动想象 (motor imagery) EEG 数据集上按三种协议对三个卷积骨干做神经元级生长训练，与各自参考宽度模型逐被试对比：生长版 ShallowFBCSPNet 以 0.57 倍参数量高出 2.9 个百分点，SCCNet 变化至多 1.2 点，Deep4Net 生长版精度下降。结论是生长在筛选准则能对候选神经元排序时才有效，而被跳过的神经元添加比例可指示解码器能否从小规模直接生长。
Motivation: 卷积 EEG 解码器的宽度通常由作者在其他数据上拍定，生长法在训练中于损失下降最快处加神经元，但其相对参考宽度在 EEG 上是否更好从未被检验。
Method: 在 12 个运动想象数据集上对 ShallowFBCSPNet、SCCNet、Deep4Net 三个卷积骨干分别做三种生长协议训练，并逐被试与参考宽度模型对比；候选神经元的保留由基于奇异值分解 (SVD) 的动态阈值筛选步骤决定。
Result: 生长版 ShallowFBCSPNet 比参考模型高 2.9 个百分点，参数量仅为 0.57 倍；SCCNet 变化至多 1.2 点；Deep4Net 生长模型精度下降，但其需要适应过程导致结果无法忠实对比。
Conclusion: 生长是否有效取决于筛选准则能否对候选神经元排序；被跳过的神经元添加比例可用来判断一个解码器能否从小规模直接生长。
