papers.title: DCEmbed: Scalable Optimization over Neural Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates can accelerate large-scale optimization by replacing expensive or intractable model components with efficient learned approximations, but solving the resulting embedded problems can remain prohibitively costly. For instance, standard exact encodings of neural networks with ReLU activations allow the problem to be solved by mixed-integer solvers, but add large numbers of binary variables to accommodate the nonlinearity of the activations, which can render the problem computationally prohibitive. To address this, we propose DCEmbed, a heuristic for optimization problems with embedded neural surrogates that leverages the difference-of-convex (DC) representation of the network and avoids adding activation binaries. Exploiting shared structure within the DC representation of a ReLU network, we derive a reduced-size, exact formulation for its convex components that can be embedded in optimization problems using just two linear inequalities and one continuous auxiliary variable per hidden neuron. Using this, the problem is solved via an iterative penalty convex-concave procedure, where only the concave portions of the neural terms are approximated at each stage. The original objective, constraints, and any discrete decisions are retained, allowing standard convex or mixed-integer optimization solvers to optimize the host and surrogate jointly at each iteration. In experiments on quadratic programs, mixed-integer resource allocation, and neural two-stage stochastic programming, our method demonstrates much faster progress toward high-quality feasible solutions than approaches using exact mixed-integer embeddings. In particular, DCEmbed achieves $4\times$ lower normalized primal integral than the best exact baseline on the resource allocation problem, while in two-stage stochastic programming it reaches the global surrogate optimum $\sim 5\times$ faster than Gurobi ML.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCEmbed 用 ReLU 网络的 difference-of-convex (DC) 表示替代混合整数精确编码，每个隐藏神经元只加两个线性不等式和一个连续辅助变量，避免引入大量二值变量。通过迭代惩罚凸-凹过程 (penalty convex-concave procedure) 只近似凹部分，原目标、约束与离散决策保留，可交给标准凸或混合整数求解器联合优化。在混合整数资源分配上归一化 primal integral 比最佳精确基线低 4×，在神经两阶段随机规划上达到全局 surrogate 最优比 Gurobi ML 快约 5×。
Motivation: 神经代理加速大规模优化时，ReLU 网络的精确编码要引入大量二值变量，使嵌入问题的混合整数求解代价高到不可行。
Method: 利用 ReLU 网络 DC 表示的共享结构，推导凸分量的缩减精确形式，每个隐藏神经元仅需两个线性不等式加一个连续辅助变量；随后用迭代惩罚凸-凹过程，每步只近似神经项的凹部分，原目标、约束与离散决策保持不变，由标准凸或混合整数求解器在每次迭代中联合优化宿主问题与代理。
Result: 在二次规划、混合整数资源分配、神经两阶段随机规划三类实验中，比精确混合整数嵌入方法更快逼近高质量可行解；资源分配问题上归一化 primal integral 比最佳精确基线低 4×，两阶段随机规划上达到全局 surrogate 最优比 Gurobi ML 快约 5×。
Conclusion: 用 DC 表示加凸-凹过程替代二值编码，可以在保留原问题结构的同时大幅降低嵌入神经代理的优化求解成本。

papers.title: Curating Merchant-Matching Training Data with Two Confidence-Gated Local LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: Merchant matching resolves a noisy payment descriptor to a retrieved merchant entity or returns no match. A key challenge in curating training labels is distinguishing teacher abstention from evidence that no acceptable entity exists: false no-match labels contaminate pseudo-labeled data, while conservative labeling reduces coverage. We investigate whether agreement between two local large language model judges improves pseudo-label reliability. A label is retained only when the judges agree, with separate ordered thresholds for selections and abstentions that guarantee disjoint positive and negative label sets. Retrospective replay on 2,000 expert-annotated queries shows that higher selection thresholds can improve positive-label purity, whereas higher abstention thresholds increase false no-match labels. At thresholds (0.86, 0.80), Muse Glimmer 30B and Gemma 4 31B jointly label 1,633 queries (81.7% coverage) at 96.88% purity; positive and negative purities are 99.47% and 93.38%. This exceeds either constituent model at the same thresholds by more than two percentage points, with lower coverage. A split-half check finds only 0.14 percentage points of threshold-selection optimism. A symmetric threshold of 0.86 adds 40 erroneous no-match labels, while 46 false abstentions persist even with no confidence threshold. Across five matched within-model comparisons, higher reasoning effort yields no clear F0.5 gain and increases median latency by 1.8-5.0 times. These results motivate separate thresholding and auditing for positive and negative pseudo-labels. The study establishes label purity, not student utility; fresh-data curation and student fine-tuning remain necessary to demonstrate downstream value.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, Accepted for publication in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining Workshops (ICDMW), SENTIRE 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用两个本地 LLM 评审（Muse Glimmer 30B 与 Gemma 4 31B）对商户匹配伪标签做置信度门控：仅在两者一致且各自超过分离的有序阈值时保留标签，保证正负标签集不相交。在 2,000 条专家标注查询的回放中，阈值 (0.86, 0.80) 下联合标注 1,633 条（覆盖率 81.7%），纯度 96.88%，正/负纯度分别为 99.47% 和 93.38%，比任一单模型在同阈值下高出 2 个百分点以上。
Motivation: 伪标签标注中难以区分教师弃权与确实无可匹配实体：错误的 no-match 标签污染训练数据，而保守标注又压缩覆盖率，需要在纯度与覆盖之间可控取舍。
Method: 两个本地 LLM 评审独立打分，仅当二者一致且置信度超过针对选择与弃权分别设定的有序阈值时保留标签，该设计保证正负标签集不相交；在 2,000 条专家标注查询上做 retrospective replay，并用 split-half 检查阈值选择的乐观偏差，另做五组同模型内推理强度配对比较。
Result: 阈值 (0.86, 0.80) 下联合标注 1,633 条查询，覆盖率 81.7%，纯度 96.88%，正纯度 99.47%、负纯度 93.38%，比任一构成模型在同阈值下高 2 个百分点以上但覆盖率更低；split-half 检查显示阈值选择乐观仅 0.14 个百分点；对称阈值 0.86 额外引入 40 条错误 no-match 标签，而即使不设置信阈值仍有 46 条错误弃权；五组配对比较中更强推理未带来明确 F0.5 提升，却使延迟中位数增至 1.8–5.0 倍。
Conclusion: 正负伪标签应分别设阈值并分别审计：提高选择阈值提升正标签纯度，提高弃权阈值反而增加错误 no-match；更强推理换不来 F0.5 收益却显著加延迟。作者明确该研究确立的是标签纯度而非学生模型效用，仍需新数据标注与学生微调来验证下游价值。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Counterfactual Rollout Replay: Forkable Environments as Free Process Rewards for Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-only reinforcement learning gives software engineering (SWE) agents a terminal success signal but little direct guidance about intermediate decisions. We introduce Counterfactual Rollout Replay (CRR), a training-time procedure that uses forkable executable environments to obtain step-level return contrasts. CRR selects a small set of decision points, restores each state, samples an alternative action, and rolls the branch forward under the policy. It retains the realised training trajectory and replaces the advantage at selected steps with the difference between its terminal return and the sampled counterfactual return. The method needs no human process labels or learned process reward model; free refers to those supervision costs, not replay compute. With a 14B policy, CRR improves pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Live, and SWE-rebench, and combines with process-reward and trajectory-search methods. On SWE-bench Verified, an equal-wall-clock comparison on the same hardware yields 41.7% versus 36.7% for extended outcome-only GRPO, a 5.0-point gain with fork overhead included. These results apply to environments with affordable, reliable state restoration; stochastic continuations and expensive or imperfect replay remain limitations.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Includes additional experiments and analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRR 在可分叉执行环境中恢复中间状态、采样替代动作并向前 rollout，用真实轨迹终局回报减去反事实分支回报替换所选步的 advantage，从而在无人工过程标签、无过程奖励模型的情况下给 SWE agent 提供步级监督。在同等墙钟时间与同硬件下，14B 策略在 SWE-bench Verified 上 pass@1 达 41.7%，对比扩展的 outcome-only GRPO 36.7%，含分叉开销净增 5.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 仅用终局结果的强化学习只给 SWE agent 一个成功信号，对中间决策几乎没有直接指导；显式过程奖励又需要人工标注或训练过程奖励模型。
Method: CRR 是训练期过程：挑选少量决策点，恢复该状态，采样一个替代动作并在当前策略下把分支 rollout 到终局，保留原训练轨迹，只把这些步的 advantage 替换为真实终局回报与反事实分支回报之差；与过程奖励方法和轨迹搜索方法组合使用，14B 策略上训练。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Live、SWE-rebench 上均提升 pass@1；SWE-bench Verified 同硬件等墙钟对比中 41.7% 对 36.7%（扩展 outcome-only GRPO），净增 5.0 个百分点且已计入分叉开销。
Conclusion: 可分叉环境的反事实 rollout 能充当免费的过程奖励，前提是状态恢复足够便宜可靠；随机续跑与昂贵或不完美的 replay 仍是限制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: JET: Justification Evaluation in Transformer
papers.abstract_en: JET uses pretrained language and vision-language models to select among a finite set of answers without additional training. It evaluates candidate likelihoods directly and shares computation across candidates. Experiments on desktop CPUs and consumer GPUs assess decision accuracy and execution cost. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B achieves 87.48% accuracy on the full MMLU test set and 3.69 requests per second on a separately timed MMLU subset. The accuracy-throughput comparison covers model, hardware, and reasoning choices, with Jev as an external reference. Controlled execution experiments show 2.18-2.23-fold speedups from prefix reuse and cache management, and a 30.8% reduction in process time from input preparation optimizations, with unchanged outputs. Optional reasoning has a task-dependent accuracy-throughput trade-off. These results support local decision inference from existing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JET 让预训练语言与视觉语言模型在有限候选答案中直接比较候选似然并共享计算，无需额外训练即可做本地决策推理。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在完整 MMLU 上达 87.48% 准确率、单独计时子集上 3.69 requests/s；前缀复用与缓存管理带来 2.18–2.23 倍加速，输入准备优化再降 30.8% 处理时间且输出不变。
Motivation: 在桌面 CPU 与消费级 GPU 上做本地推理时，逐候选独立请求既浪费计算又抬高执行成本，需要在不微调的前提下同时看清决策准确率与吞吐。
Method: JET 直接评估候选似然 (candidate likelihoods) 并跨候选共享计算，复用预训练语言与视觉语言模型、无需额外训练；实验在桌面 CPU 与消费级 GPU 上联合测量决策准确率与执行成本，并对比模型、硬件与推理（reasoning）选择，Jev 作为外部参照。
Result: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在完整 MMLU 测试集上准确率 87.48%，在单独计时的 MMLU 子集上 3.69 requests/s；受控执行实验中前缀复用与缓存管理带来 2.18–2.23 倍加速，输入准备优化使处理时间下降 30.8%，输出保持不变；可选推理呈现随任务而变的准确率-吞吐权衡。
Conclusion: 不加训练、靠候选似然比较与计算共享，就能在消费级硬件上从现有模型得到可用的本地决策推理，且执行层优化可在不改输出的前提下显著提速。

papers.title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Robot-GST 用 RGB-D 通过 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 重建 Gaussian-SAM 机器人环境，在执行前把候选动作序列先仿真评估、过滤不可行行为，再用几何采样的高斯感知终态估计做基于状态的轨迹规划。在 cube placing、toy packing、duck rearrangement 等刚体/软体/可变形物体操作任务上，几何感知时空推理与状态感知执行提升了跨物体类别的操作可靠性。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型驱动的端到端操作策略缺少预测任务结果与判断动作能否达成目标终态的显式机制，长时程执行中误差会不断累积，真实部署不可靠。
Method: 从 RGB-D 观测用 3D Gaussian Splatting 与 SAM3D 构建高保真 Gaussian-SAM 环境做 real-to-sim 策略验证；大视觉语言模型融合视觉观测与语言指令做长时程时空推理规划；执行前用几何采样做高斯感知终态估计 (Gaussian-aware final-state estimation) 并在环境中仿真评估候选动作序列，配合基于状态的轨迹规划过滤不可行行为。
Result: 在涉及刚体、软体与可变形物体的代表性操作任务（cube placing、toy packing、duck rearrangement）上验证，显示几何感知时空推理与状态感知执行在不同物体类别上提升了操作可靠性；摘要给出定性结论，无具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 几何感知重建加高质量渲染与仿真，可作为评估机器人操作行为的可扩展路径，即先在重建环境中仿真与评估再行动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Successful Strategies Fail: Adaptation to Environmental Novelty in Terminal Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks by autonomously interacting with their environment. In doing so, their strategies rely on assumptions about that environment: which resources and tools exist, where they are located, and how they behave. When these assumptions no longer hold, reliable agents must detect the change and adapt while pursuing the same goal. We study this adaptation capability through environmental novelty: a change that keeps the task objective fixed while invalidating an assumption underlying an otherwise successful trajectory. We introduce AGNI, an automated pipeline that extracts trajectory-relevant assumptions, injects targeted environmental changes, and validates that the resulting novel tasks remain solvable. Across three terminal benchmarks, AGNI produces diverse novelties spanning resources, interfaces, constraints, and execution semantics. Evaluating multiple LLM agents reveals a substantial adaptation gap between base and novel tasks. Trajectory analysis suggests that agents often encounter evidence of the change but fail to diagnose its cause and revise their strategy. Finally, post-training for environmental novelty improves adaptation to held-out novel tasks while also improving performance on base tasks. Our results highlight a gap between task competence and adaptive capability and motivate environmental variation as a core dimension of agent training and evaluation.
papers.comment: 53 pages, including references and appendices; 10-page main text with 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AGNI 自动流水线：从 LLM agent 的成功轨迹中抽取环境假设，注入保持任务目标不变的定向环境变化，并校验新任务仍可解。在三个 terminal benchmark 上评测多个 LLM agent，发现 base 与 novel 任务之间存在明显适应差距——agent 常看到变化证据却诊断不出原因、不改策略；针对环境新颖性的后训练同时提升留出 novel 任务与 base 任务表现。
Motivation: LLM agent 的长程策略依赖关于环境的隐含假设（资源、工具、位置、行为），假设失效时现有评测无法刻画 agent 能否在目标不变下检测变化并改写策略，任务能力与适应能力之间的缺口缺少可复现的测量手段。
Method: AGNI 流水线分三步：抽取与轨迹相关的环境假设，注入针对性的环境变化（覆盖资源、接口、约束、执行语义四类），并验证生成的新任务仍然可解；随后在三个 terminal benchmark 上评测多个 LLM agent，并对 agent 做环境新颖性后训练。
Result: AGNI 在三个 terminal benchmark 上产生覆盖资源、接口、约束与执行语义的多样化新颖性；多个 LLM agent 的评测显示 base 与 novel 任务之间存在显著适应差距，轨迹分析表明 agent 常遇到变化证据却无法诊断成因并修正策略；环境新颖性后训练提升留出 novel 任务的适应表现，同时 base 任务性能也一并提升。
Conclusion: 任务能力不等于适应能力，环境变化应作为 agent 训练与评测的核心维度；针对环境新颖性的后训练可以同时改善 novel 与 base 任务表现。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.motivation: LLM agent 的长程策略依赖关于环境的隐含假设（资源、工具、位置、行为），假设失效时现有评测无法刻画 agent 能否在目标不变下检测变化并改写策略，任务能力与适应能力之间的缺口缺少可复现的测量手段。
summary_sections.method: AGNI 流水线分三步：抽取与轨迹相关的环境假设，注入针对性的环境变化（覆盖资源、接口、约束、执行语义四类），并验证生成的新任务仍然可解；随后在三个 terminal benchmark 上评测多个 LLM agent，并对 agent 做环境新颖性后训练。
summary_sections.result: AGNI 在三个 terminal benchmark 上产生覆盖资源、接口、约束与执行语义的多样化新颖性；多个 LLM agent 的评测显示 base 与 novel 任务之间存在显著适应差距，轨迹分析表明 agent 常遇到变化证据却无法诊断成因并修正策略；环境新颖性后训练提升留出 novel 任务的适应表现，同时 base 任务性能也一并提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 任务能力不等于适应能力，环境变化应作为 agent 训练与评测的核心维度；针对环境新颖性的后训练可以同时改善 novel 与 base 任务表现。

papers.title: Conformal Coverage of Time Series: Validity and Inference
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction provides marginal coverage guarantees, yet practitioners may wonder if the observed coverage is truly abnormal or consistent with sampling variation. Inference for realized coverage has received comparatively little attention, especially for time series. We study split conformal prediction with adjacent calibration and test sets of temporally dependent data. Using the functional dependence measure, we derive non-asymptotic bounds on marginal coverage error without mixing assumptions, which can be difficult to verify and may fail even for simple short-memory models. We establish a Bahadur representation to derive, to our knowledge, the first central limit theorem for realized coverage of split conformal prediction under temporal dependence. A consistent block-based estimator of the standard error yields an asymptotically justified test. We further study long-memory time series, which remain understudied in conformal prediction. For Gaussian linear processes, we show how very strong temporal dependence can lead to a non-Gaussian limiting law of realized coverage and establish block-sampling inference with an estimated normalization. The resulting theory explains how temporal dependence changes coverage uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在时间相依数据上研究 split conformal prediction 的覆盖率推断：用 functional dependence measure 导出无需 mixing 假设的边际覆盖误差非渐近界，并给出 realized coverage 的首个 CLT 与 block 标准误检验。强相依的长记忆高斯线性过程下极限分布非高斯，需用估计归一化的 block-sampling 推断。
Motivation: conformal prediction 只给边际覆盖保证，实践者无法判断观测到的覆盖率偏离是否超出抽样波动；而时间序列下对 realized coverage 的推断研究很少，mixing 条件难验证且对短记忆模型也可能不成立。
Method: 研究相邻校准集与测试集为时间相依数据的 split conformal prediction；用 functional dependence measure 导出不依赖 mixing 的边际覆盖误差非渐近界，建立 Bahadur 表示以推出 realized coverage 的中心极限定理，并构造相合的 block 标准误估计；对长记忆高斯线性过程另给估计归一化的 block-sampling 推断。
Result: 得到时间相依下 split conformal realized coverage 的首个 CLT 及相合 block 标准误检验；证明强时间相依可使 realized coverage 呈非高斯极限分布，并给出相应 block-sampling 推断。
Conclusion: 时间相依会改变覆盖率的不确定性：短记忆下可用基于 block 的渐近正态检验，强长记忆下必须改用非高斯极限的 block 推断。

papers.title: R$^2$ Flow: Recursive Self-Improvement via Recursive Skill Evolution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: R² Flow 是面向 LLM agent 的递归自我改进框架：在共享状态编排图上交替做策略学习、独立验证与版本化技能库更新，用合并独立步骤不同顺序的历史缓解 flow 训练的策略坍缩，用对后向策略不变的 flow-share 读出加独立有符号 utility 排序技能改动。在问答、数学推理、交互决策与代码生成四类任务上，任务准确率与技能库编辑精度均优于启发式编排、强化学习与技能进化基线，并可跨执行器迁移。
Motivation: 基于 flow 的技能复用训练存在三个障碍：树结构历史上的策略坍缩、非负 flow 奖励把“常用”误当“有益”、技能库编辑只依赖策略优化的任务奖励，使 LLM agent 的自我改进不可靠。
Method: R² Flow 在共享状态编排图 (shared-state orchestration graph) 上交替执行策略学习、独立验证与版本化技能库更新；图结构合并仅独立步骤顺序不同的历史以汇聚等价执行的证据；用对后向策略不变的 flow-share 读出加独立的有符号 utility 决定改哪些技能，验证器证据决定是否该改，残差方差平台 (residual-variance plateau) 决定何时提交编辑，已提交的编辑重塑下一轮策略学习的图。
Result: 在问答、数学推理、交互决策与代码生成四类任务上，R² Flow 相对启发式编排、强化学习与技能进化基线同时提升任务准确率与技能库编辑精度，并能跨执行器 (executor) 迁移；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 把 flow 训练、独立验证与版本化编辑绑在同一编排图上，可以让技能库按递归方式演化并把自我改进做可靠，且学到的技能不绑定单一执行器。

papers.title: Valid and Efficient Split Conformal Regression for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We study conformalized quantile regression and conformalized median regression that fit a model on one block of a time series and calibrate the conformal interval on the adjacent block. The existing theory of conformal prediction for time series rests largely on mixing conditions, which are hard to verify from a time-series model and fail for many standard processes, including simple ones with short memory. We replace this theoretical toolbox with the functional dependence measure, which in principle accommodates long-memory observations. The accuracy of the conformal interval length for time series has been understudied. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first work that establishes non-asymptotic coverage guarantees and accuracy of interval length simultaneously for split conformal regression on time series. Furthermore, for Gaussian linear processes with long memory, where both the estimation of the center and its calibration converge slowly, we establish a sharper rate for the length error. We show that the calibrated length converges faster than the estimated center itself, and provide a matching lower bound for the usual centers when the calibration block is sufficiently large relative to the training block. To our knowledge, this is the first theoretical analysis of conformal interval length dedicated to long memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把时间序列 split conformal 回归（CQR 与 conformalized median regression）的理论基础从 mixing 条件换成 functional dependence measure，首次同时给出非渐近覆盖率保证与区间长度精度。对长记忆高斯线性过程，校准后的区间长度比中心估计本身收敛更快，并在校准块相对训练块足够大时给出通常中心的匹配下界。
Motivation: 现有时间序列 conformal prediction 理论依赖 mixing 条件，这类条件难以从时间序列模型本身验证，且对许多标准过程（包括短记忆的简单过程）不成立；同时区间长度的精度问题一直被忽视。
Method: 在相邻两个时间序列块上分别拟合与校准，研究 conformalized quantile regression 与 conformalized median regression；用 functional dependence measure 替代 mixing 条件作为理论工具，以容纳长记忆观测。
Result: 首次为时间序列上的 split conformal 回归同时建立非渐近覆盖率保证与区间长度精度；对中心与校准都收敛缓慢的长记忆高斯线性过程，给出更锐的长度误差速率，表明校准后长度比估计中心本身收敛更快，并在校准块相对训练块足够大时给出通常中心的匹配下界。
Conclusion: functional dependence measure 可以取代 mixing 条件支撑时间序列 conformal 理论，且长记忆下区间长度比中心估计更可靠——这是该文声称的首个专门针对长记忆的 conformal 区间长度理论分析。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: PI-NOMT: Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport for Brain Fluid Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Recovering hidden transport mechanisms from sparse spatiotemporal observations is a fundamental inverse problem in scientific machine learning. In brain tracer imaging, dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI) provides time-resolved measurements of tracer concentration, while the underlying velocity and source mechanisms governing tracer propagation remain unobserved. We formulate this problem as physics-informed latent-state inference, in which the transport field itself is the primary object of inference rather than an auxiliary variable used only to reconstruct observed densities. We propose Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport (PI-NOMT), a framework that represents density, velocity, and source as continuous neural fields and combines a continuous neural density teacher, recursive differentiable advection--diffusion--source rollout, unbalanced optimal-transport regularization, and governing-equation supervision. Physical laws act as structural priors that constrain the space of admissible transport mechanisms, while observed tracer dynamics provide evidence for estimating the latent transport state. We evaluate PI-NOMT on a synthetic benchmark with known ground-truth transport and on DCE-MRI sequences from nine control rats. On the synthetic benchmark, PI-NOMT accurately recovers the prescribed velocity field, including its magnitude, direction, and integrated trajectories, rather than merely reconstructing endpoint densities. Across the nine rat datasets, the framework yields sub-percent local endpoint error, consistent physical speed scales, and low post-training PDE and incompressibility residuals. These results support physics-informed latent-state inference as a general framework for recovering hidden transport mechanisms from observed dynamic scalar fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PI-NOMT 把稀疏时空观测中隐藏输运机制的反演写成物理约束的隐状态推断：密度、速度、源都用连续神经场表示，速度场本身是推断对象而非重建观测密度的辅助变量。在已知真值的合成基准上能准确恢复规定速度场的大小、方向与积分轨迹；在 9 只对照大鼠 DCE-MRI 上给出亚百分比局部终点误差、物理一致的速度尺度，以及训练后较低的 PDE 与不可压缩残差。
Motivation: 脑示踪成像中 DCE-MRI 只给出随时间的示踪剂浓度，决定传播的速度场与源项不可观测；常规做法把输运场当辅助量去重建观测密度，无法恢复真正的输运机制。
Method: PI-NOMT 用连续神经场分别表示密度、速度与源，配合连续神经密度 teacher、可微的 advection–diffusion–source 递归 rollout、unbalanced optimal transport 正则与控制方程监督；物理定律作为结构先验约束可容许的输运机制空间，观测到的示踪动力学作为估计隐输运状态的证据。
Result: 在含已知真值输运的合成基准上准确恢复规定速度场的量值、方向与积分轨迹，而非仅重建终点密度；在 9 只对照大鼠 DCE-MRI 序列上得到亚百分比局部终点误差、物理一致的速度尺度，以及训练后较低的 PDE 残差与不可压缩残差。
Conclusion: 物理约束的隐状态推断可作为从观测动态标量场恢复隐藏输运机制的通用框架，前提是把输运场本身当作推断对象并用控制方程监督。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Program-Verified Self-Evolution for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving vision-language models train on questions they generate from unlabeled images. Since these questions have no gold answers, prior methods label them by majority vote over sampled answers or by a model judge. In a human evaluation, we find that 24\% of majority-vote labels and 18\% of model-judge labels produced during self-evolution are wrong. To address this problem, we present Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models (VQS), which changes how the model judges answers. Instead of voting on an answer, the model parses each image into a structured record, such as a scene graph, a chart table, or a diagram graph. Fixed programs then write a question from the record and compute its answer. The model still acts as a visual checker, but it only confirms the individual facts the program reads, one short claim at a time. These claim-level checks select the parser's training targets, so the parser also improves without labels. Human raters find 94\% of VQS answers correct, against 76\% for majority voting. Across ten benchmarks, VQS improves Qwen3-VL by up to 3.18 points at the 2B, 4B, and 8B scales and outperforms the strongest self-evolving baseline at each. Gains keep growing over three training rounds, reaching 3.84 points at 2B. Code is released at https://github.com/ahmedheakl/VQS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VQS 把自演化 VLM 的答案判定从多数投票改成「模型把图像解析成结构化记录（scene graph/chart table/diagram graph），固定程序据记录出题并算出标准答案」，模型只做逐条事实核验。人工评测中多数投票标签 24%、模型裁判标签 18% 错误，而 VQS 答案 94% 正确（多数投票 76%）。
Motivation: 自演化视觉语言模型在无标注图像上自问自答，但多数投票与模型裁判给出的伪标签本身不可靠，错误标签会随训练轮次累积污染模型。
Method: VQS（Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models）：模型先把图像解析为结构化记录，再由固定程序从记录生成问题并计算答案；模型退化为视觉检查器，逐条核验程序读取的单个事实，这些 claim 级核验结果反过来作为解析器的无标签训练目标。
Result: 人工评测显示自演化过程中 24% 的多数投票标签与 18% 的模型裁判标签是错的；VQS 答案人工判定 94% 正确，多数投票为 76%。在十个 benchmark 上，VQS 使 Qwen3-VL 在 2B、4B、8B 三个规模上最多提升 3.18 个点，并在每个规模上超过最强自演化基线；增益随三轮训练持续增长，2B 上达 3.84 个点。
Conclusion: 把答案判定换成可验证的程序生成与逐事实核验，能在无金标准的自演化训练中产出更干净的伪标签，并让提升随训练轮次累积。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReDrive: Shaping Representations with World Modeling for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: Driving policies require capabilities of scene understanding and future evolution prediction. To achieve this goal, current end-to-end models typically construct complex perception-planning pipelines or introduce world models that explicitly predict future states, resulting in a complex system architecture. Inspired by the transferability of general-purpose visual representations, we argue that combining sufficiently strong visual representations with representation world modeling can support effective planning without relying on complex inference-time auxiliary modules. Based on this insight, we present ReDrive, an end-to-end driving framework that strengthens planning-oriented visual features via future representation prediction. To achieve this, ReDrive adopts a three-stage training pipeline consisting of driving video pretraining, joint world-modeling and planning training, and planner adaptation. This yields a strong planning-oriented representation and a high-performance planner, while requiring neither auxiliary perception modules nor future prediction at inference time. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate strong performance, achieving 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. These results show that shaping representations with world modeling is sufficient to enable high-performance end-to-end planning while retaining a simple encoder-planner inference pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReDrive 用「表征世界模型」替代显式预测未来状态的端到端自动驾驶框架：通过未来表征预测强化面向规划的视觉特征，推理时只保留简单 encoder-planner，不带辅助感知模块也不做未来预测。在 NAVSIM 上取得 91.0 PDMS（v1）与 90.8 EPDMS（v2）。
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型要么堆复杂的感知-规划流水线，要么引入显式预测未来状态的世界模型，系统架构复杂；作者认为强视觉表征加表征级世界建模即可支撑规划。
Method: 三阶段训练：驾驶视频预训练（driving video pretraining）、世界建模与规划联合训练（joint world-modeling and planning training）、规划器适配（planner adaptation）；核心是以未来表征预测塑造规划导向特征，而非预测像素或状态。
Result: NAVSIM v1 上 91.0 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 上 90.8 EPDMS。
Conclusion: 用世界建模塑造表征足以支撑高性能端到端规划，同时保持简单的 encoder-planner 推理管线，无需辅助感知模块与推理期未来预测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking Contextualization by Reinterpreting Attention Head Channels
papers.abstract_en: Contextualization, the core operation of language modeling, transmits information across words to build sentence-specific word representations. Prior works mainly study contextualization, focusing on individual words and attention heads as a growing discrete dictionary, lacking a global view of their general behavior. Therefore, we propose a general principle: Globally, we find and estimate that different words carry different amounts of information, and less-informative words tend to absorb more contextual information. Specifically, these low-information words do not absorb contextual words uniformly, and finer-grained selectivity enables more precise routing to promote information transmission between matched words. Moreover, to find what mechanism causes such processing, we reinterpret attention heads as channels gated by their singular vectors and find that: (1) these singular vectors point to the hidden states of more informative words, allowing such words to write their information to others more strongly to act as information sources, and vice versa; and (2) these singular vectors can be viewed equally as hidden state features, enabling automated interpretation of attention heads beyond prior heuristic head discovery, also embedding heads into a continuous space rather than treating them as discrete, independent dictionary entries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出语言建模中上下文化 (contextualization) 的全局原则：不同词携带的信息量不同，信息量低的词吸收更多上下文信息，且这种吸收并非均匀，而是通过更细粒度的选择性把信息精确路由到匹配词之间。作者把 attention head 重新解释为由其奇异向量门控的 channel，奇异向量指向信息更丰富词的 hidden state，使这些词能更强地向他人写入信息、充当信息源；同一组奇异向量也可视为 hidden state 特征，从而在连续空间中自动解释 attention head。
Motivation: 既有上下文化研究以单个词和 attention head 为对象，把它们当作不断增长的离散词典，缺少对其整体行为的全局视角，也缺少超越启发式 head 发现的自动解释手段。
Method: 先从全局出发估计不同词的信息量，并检验低信息词吸收上下文的选择性粒度；再把 attention head 重解释为由奇异向量门控的 channel，用奇异向量方向判定信息源与写入强度，并将其同时作为 hidden state 特征用于 head 的自动解释，把 head 嵌入连续空间。
Result: 发现信息量低的词吸收更多上下文信息，且吸收具有更细粒度的选择性以促进匹配词之间的信息传递；奇异向量指向信息更丰富词的 hidden state，使这些词写入信息更强、充当信息源，反之亦然；奇异向量可等价视为 hidden state 特征，实现超越启发式 head 发现的自动解释。
Conclusion: 上下文化应从全局信息量与路由选择性来刻画，attention head 不是离散独立的条目，而是由奇异向量门控、可嵌入连续空间并自动解释的 channel。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly undertake extreme-long (xlong) horizon tasks, where a single execution can span hours, hundreds of model--environment interactions, and nearly 1M tokens per rollout. Applying online reinforcement learning (RL) to such executions poses two fundamental challenges: (1) severe execution variance and prolonged rollout delays cause massive GPU idling; and (2) complex non-linear branching generates massive trajectory redundancy, crippling training efficiency. To address these, we presents QwenGyre, an end-to-end framework for xlong-horizon online RL. QwenGyre elastically reallocates GPUs between rollout and training without interrupting live executions, while its trajectory processor reconstructs branching histories, scores partial progress, and deduplicates redundant paths to bound training costs. Scaled to our flagship model, Qwen~3.8 2.4T, with 700K tokens per rollout, QwenGyre yields a 6.0% absolute gain on NL2RepoBench (52.5% $\to$ 58.5%) in 48 steps. Across our evaluations on diverse domains of training datasets, QwenGyre delivers up to $1.85\times$ and $1.78\times$ speedups over Colocate and Async, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QwenGyre 是面向超长时程 (xlong-horizon) LLM agent 在线强化学习的端到端框架：在 rollout 与训练之间弹性重分配 GPU 且不打断进行中的执行，同时用轨迹处理器重建分支历史、给部分完成度打分并去重冗余路径以压住训练开销。在 Qwen3.8 2.4T、每次 rollout 700K token 的规模下，48 步内 NL2RepoBench 从 52.5% 提到 58.5%（绝对 +6.0%），相对 Colocate 与 Async 分别取得最高 1.85× 与 1.78× 加速。
Motivation: 超长时程 agent 单次执行可达数小时、数百次模型-环境交互、近 1M token，执行时长方差与 rollout 延迟造成大量 GPU 空转；非线性分支又带来严重的轨迹冗余，使在线 RL 训练效率崩掉。
Method: QwenGyre 端到端框架包含两部分：弹性 GPU 调度在 rollout 与训练之间动态重分配资源且不中断在线执行；轨迹处理器重建分支历史、对部分进度打分并对冗余路径去重，从而给训练成本设上界。训练对象为旗舰模型 Qwen3.8 2.4T，每次 rollout 700K token。
Result: 在 Qwen3.8 2.4T、700K token/rollout 规模下，48 步内 NL2RepoBench 从 52.5% 提升到 58.5%，绝对增益 6.0%；在多个训练数据集领域的评测中，相对 Colocate 基线最高 1.85× 加速，相对 Async 最高 1.78× 加速。
Conclusion: 把 GPU 弹性重分配与分支轨迹去重放进同一个训练框架，可以在不打断在线执行的前提下同时提高超长时程 agent RL 的样本效率与吞吐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How code helps different tasks? A decompositional lens on LLM post-training
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating code data as a single corpus can obscure which types of code data benefit which models and downstream tasks. Effective data selection requires understanding both the benefits of individual categories and whether these benefits persist when categories are combined. We introduce a decompositional lens for studying these effects in LLM post-training. We first decompose an execution-verified code corpus into interpretable categories based on the computational patterns of its solutions. Through controlled fine-tuning experiments, we compare individual categories with a balanced mixture across instruction-tuned models on question answering, mathematics, and code generation. The resulting response maps reveal recurring gains in average question-answering performance, while the same category can improve one model or task and degrade another. The best-performing category also varies with the starting model and target task. We then compose compact mixtures guided by these results and examine whether benefits observed in individual categories persist under joint training. On selected model--task pairs, mixtures whose constituents each improve the target task outperform both their best constituent and full-corpus training while using roughly 10--15\% of the full corpus. These exploratory findings illustrate a \emph{less is more} pattern and highlight how the value of code data in post training depends on which categories are combined for which model and task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可执行验证的代码语料按解法的计算模式拆成可解释类别，用受控微调测出各类别对 QA、数学、代码生成的响应图，发现同一类别对不同模型/任务可升可降。据此组合的紧凑混合在选定模型-任务对上超过最佳单类与全语料训练，而只用全语料约 10–15% 的数据，呈现 less-is-more 模式。
Motivation: 把代码数据当单一语料评估会掩盖哪类数据惠及哪个模型与下游任务，且类别单独的收益在混合后未必保留，数据选择因此缺少依据。
Method: 提出 decompositional lens：先按解法计算模式把执行验证的代码语料拆成可解释类别，再在指令微调模型上做受控微调，比较单类别与均衡混合在问答、数学、代码生成上的表现，得到 response maps；随后按结果组合紧凑混合并检验联合训练下收益是否延续。
Result: 响应图显示问答平均性能反复出现增益，但同一类别可提升一个模型或任务、损害另一个；最佳类别随起始模型与目标任务变化。在选定模型-任务对上，各成分单独都能提升目标任务的混合优于最佳单类与全语料训练，且仅用全语料约 10–15% 的数据。
Conclusion: 代码数据在后训练中的价值取决于为哪个模型和任务组合哪些类别，数据量更小的定向混合可以胜过全语料训练（less is more）；这些是探索性发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ViBR-WM: Visual Bayesian Regression for World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Modeling temporal dependence and uncertainty is central to forecasting with world models. The Visual Bayesian Regression World Model combines visual features, physical histories and known covariates through interpretable regression, within a modular architecture supporting trend, seasonal and cycle dynamics. Visual compression reduces representation dimension, while Bayesian variable selection reduces active regression dimension. Posterior prediction combines forecasts across predictor subsets using their posterior probabilities as weights and accounts for parameter uncertainty and future disturbances. The model forecasts joint visual--physical states recursively and physical targets directly. Across four forecasting tasks spanning object motion, vegetation greenness and solar power, ViBR-WM achieves lower mean overall physical-target error than Temporal Straightening, ConvLSTM, PredRNN and SimVP on every task. Repeated fitting and resampling support these overall gains.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Laya as a Typed Probabilistic Assessor: An Independent Reproduction and a Preregistered Study of Calibration and Selective Escalation
papers.abstract_en: The shipped Laya Typed-Decisions checkpoint, a 421M-parameter ModernBERT-large assessor that answers typed choice/noul/score questions over workflow state, is uniformly under-confident. The signed confidence-accuracy gap is $-0.214$, every occupied reliability bin's accuracy exceeds its confidence, and that sign uniformity collapses every binned ECE variant to the same value, $0.214$. The card frames the risk as over-confidence; the measured direction is the opposite, and the direction decides which way a confidence-gated cascade fails. A single disjointly fitted temperature ($T=0.469$, sharpening) removes most of the miscalibration (held-out ECE $0.204$ to $0.037$) and outperforms the shipped per-option-count table. The frozen selection rule instead chose isotonic regression, which overfit and failed its held-out NLL contrast on both tracks, so hypothesis H2 is not supported. Re-running the released checkpoint on its full official test split reproduces the card's headline accuracy ($0.767$ vs. $0.766$). The retrospective E1 reproduction preceded the analysis freeze; E2-E8 were prospectively preregistered, and 20 of 22 executed confirmatory tests reject under Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at $q=0.05$ (two descoped). The frozen gate beats random escalation but misses its 10% accepted-set error target on both tracks, an exploratory out-of-distribution probe finds no zero-shot transfer (accuracy $0.617$), and every score measures agreement with a synthetic teacher whose self-agreement ceiling ($0.735$) the specialist exceeds. Per-decision predictions, run manifests, and the frozen preregistration are in the ancillary files. The author has no affiliation with the model's publisher, the dataset's publisher, or TypeSafe.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 8 figures. Ancillary files include the frozen preregistration, all run manifests, per-decision prediction records, and the metric code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Laya Typed-Decisions 检查点（421M 参数 ModernBERT-large）做独立复现与预注册校准研究，发现其置信度系统性偏低：signed confidence-accuracy gap 为 -0.214，各可靠性分箱准确率均高于置信度，导致所有分箱 ECE 变体都塌缩为 0.214。单个不相交拟合的温度缩放 T=0.469（锐化）把 held-out ECE 从 0.204 降到 0.037，优于随附的按选项数查表；而预注册冻结规则选中的 isotonic regression 过拟合、在两条 track 上都未通过 held-out NLL 对比，H2 不成立。
Motivation: 随附卡片把风险定为过度自信，但实测方向相反，而方向决定置信度门控级联 (confidence-gated cascade) 会朝哪边失效；校准与选择性升级规则需要在冻结预注册下独立复现，而非事后拟合。
Method: 在官方完整测试集上重跑已发布的 checkpoint 复现基线准确率；E1 为分析冻结前的回溯复现，E2–E8 为前瞻性预注册检验，用 Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 控制在 q=0.05；校准方法对比单参数温度缩放、随附的 per-option-count 表与冻结选择规则选中的 isotonic regression，并用冻结 gate 做选择性升级与 OOD 零样本探针。
Result: 复现准确率 0.767（卡片 0.766）；signed confidence-accuracy gap -0.214，所有分箱 ECE 变体同为 0.214；温度 T=0.469 使 held-out ECE 从 0.204 降至 0.037；22 项已执行确认性检验中 20 项在 q=0.05 下拒绝（2 项 descoped），H2 未获支持；冻结 gate 优于随机升级但两条 track 均未达 10% accepted-set error 目标；OOD 探针零样本准确率 0.617，无迁移；合成教师自一致上限 0.735，被 specialist 超过。
Conclusion: 该 checkpoint 的问题是欠自信而非卡片所称的过度自信，温度缩放即可消除大部分失准，而预注册的 isotonic 选择规则失败；所有指标衡量的都是与合成教师的一致性，且该教师上限 0.735 已被 specialist 超越。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ChemOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Task Chemical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly expected to support diverse chemical reasoning capabilities within a unified model. One approach is to develop specialized capabilities separately and consolidate them through multi-teacher on-policy distillation, but this raises two questions: how should specialization be organized, and how should specialist guidance be integrated? We introduce ChemOPD, which addresses both. We estimate task affinities from supervised fine-tuning gradients and solve a constrained mixed-integer program(MIP) to construct partially overlapping specialist groups. During distillation, we retain a generalist teacher trained on all tasks so that specialist guidance supplements rather than replaces its supervision. Our anchor-residual objective gradually increases the routed specialist's contribution on student-generated responses. On ChemCoTBench, affinity-guided specialization produces task-dependent gains over the generalist teacher and improves several capabilities beyond semantic task grouping. Yet stronger teacher-side performance does not automatically yield stronger students: with the same specialists and routes, anchor-residual OPD improves most reported metrics over specialist-only distillation and realizes a larger share of the available teacher gains. These results highlight specialization and capability integration as connected but distinct design problems in chemical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChemOPD 用 SFT 梯度估计任务亲和度并解约束混合整数规划 (MIP) 划出部分重叠的专家组，蒸馏时保留全任务 generalist 教师，anchor-residual 目标在学生自生成回复上逐步加大路由专家的权重。在 ChemCoTBench 上，亲和度引导的专门化相对 generalist 教师带来任务相关的增益且优于按语义分组；相同专家与路由下，anchor-residual OPD 在多数指标上优于仅用专家蒸馏，并兑现更大比例的教师端可用增益。
Motivation: 统一模型要同时具备多种化学推理能力，但专门化应如何组织、专家指导应如何与通用教师的监督整合，是两个未解决的设计问题；且教师端更强并不自动转化为学生更强。
Method: 先用监督微调 (SFT) 梯度估计任务亲和度，解约束混合整数规划 (MIP) 构造部分重叠的专家组；蒸馏阶段保留一个在全部任务上训练的 generalist 教师作为锚，专家指导只做补充；anchor-residual 目标在学生生成的回复上逐步提高被路由专家的贡献权重。
Result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，亲和度引导的专门化相对 generalist 教师产生任务相关的增益，且在若干能力上超过按语义任务分组；在相同专家与路由下，anchor-residual OPD 相对 specialist-only 蒸馏改进了报告中的多数指标，并实现更大比例的可用教师增益。
Conclusion: 化学推理中，专门化组织与能力整合是相互关联但彼此独立的两个设计问题，必须分开处理；教师端性能强不等于学生端自动变强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
papers.abstract_en: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaSeek 把机器人传感具身 (embodiment) 的可允许观测集形式化，用以判定演化施工环境中哪些几何变化是底盘视角根本看不到、还是只是要多跑路。在 IFC 派生的房间级场景、8 处受控变化、240 个底盘位姿与 5 种机械臂姿态的穷举评测中，有 2 处变化底盘完全无视角、腕部 RGB-D 相机都能看到；两者都能看到的变化，腕部相机的底盘移动中位数为 6.0 m，底盘相机为 15.2 m。
Motivation: 施工环境持续演化导致几何大变，静态建图与配准性能退化，机器人需要主动感知；但先要弄清传感具身本身如何约束可获取的观测。
Method: 形式化具身的可允许观测集，在 Husky A300 底盘加 UR5e 机械臂上，对比底盘安装与腕部安装两种 RGB-D 配置，评测用 IFC 派生 benchmark；观测按几何可见性打分，代价按可行驶距离计，穷举 240 个可允许底盘位姿与 5 种机械臂姿态。
Result: 房间级场景含 8 处受控变化、覆盖 4 种可观测性条件：2 处变化底盘视角完全不可见，腕部相机两者都能解析；对两者都可见的变化，腕部相机的底盘移动中位数 6.0 m，底盘相机 15.2 m。
Conclusion: 把观测的不可行性与获取代价分开，可以判定一个观测究竟是不可能还是仅仅需要更多移动；本文只处理具身约束这一前置问题，目标系统仍需决定何时、何处、如何观测。

papers.title: An Active-Bottleneck Mechanism for Weak-to-Strong Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Weak-to-strong generalization (W2SG) occurs when a student trained on a teacher's predictions outperforms that teacher. We study when this happens under fully converged, ridgeless two-stage learning, with no early stopping, no explicit regularization, and no assumption that the student is more expressive than the teacher. In two-stage linear regression, a teacher is fit from $n$ labeled examples and a student is trained solely on the teacher's predictions on $m$ fresh, unlabeled inputs. Although both stages share the same hypothesis class and the same training rule, we show that the student outperforms the teacher exactly when $m$ lies in an explicit intermediate range: too few pseudo-labels leave the student without enough signal, too many let it inherit the teacher's noise. Under power-law covariance, we derive this range in closed form as a function of the spectral decay and noise level, including regimes where the improving region splits into two disjoint intervals of $m$. We then study a random-feature model in which the student has strictly more features than the teacher, and identify two regimes, again given by explicit thresholds: one where improvement occurs only for $m$ in a bounded interval, and one where it occurs only once the student width $N_S$ exceeds an explicit threshold. Both regimes are governed by a single "active-bottleneck" principle: whichever of $m$ or $N_S$ is scarcer controls how much teacher error is filtered out, while increasing the other resource only reduces estimation noise. Together, these results show that finite data and finite width can themselves regularize a two-stage learner, with no explicit mechanism doing so.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在完全收敛、无早停无显式正则的两阶段学习中，学生超过老师的条件被刻画为一个显式的中间区间：伪标签数 m 太少信号不足，太多则继承老师噪声。幂律协方差下该区间有闭式解，甚至可能分裂成两个不相连的 m 区间；随机特征模型里同样由 m 与学生宽度 N_S 的显式阈值决定，服从统一的 active-bottleneck 原理——m 与 N_S 中更稀缺的那个决定过滤掉多少老师误差，另一个资源增加只降低估计噪声。
Motivation: 弱到强泛化 (W2SG) 何时发生缺少可判定条件：既有解释依赖早停、显式正则或学生表达力更强等假设，无法说明在两阶段共享同一假设类与训练规则时学生为何能超过老师。
Method: 在两阶段线性回归（ridgeless、完全收敛）中，老师用 n 个有标签样本拟合，学生只在 m 个新无标签输入上以老师预测为伪标签训练；对幂律协方差谱推导 m 的闭式区间，随谱衰减与噪声水平变化。再扩展到学生特征数严格多于老师的随机特征模型，给出 m 与 N_S 的显式阈值。

papers.title: CLIMB-flow: Coupled Linear Inverse posterior sampling via Multiscale-Based flow
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are now widely used in Bayesian inverse problems in imaging as priors, where latent diffusion models are often used for larger scale problems to keep the computational complexity and model-size manageable. Unfortunately, the auto-encoder based compression results in loss of spatial detail. In addition, the optimization is converted to a non-linear problem. In this paper, we introduce a posterior sampling algorithm customized for the pyramidal/cascaded architecture, which relies on a coarse to fine hierarchical strategy to generate images in the pixel domain. We present CLIMB-Flow which alternates between three steps: an end-point estimation from the current coarse and noisy image, data-consistent update of the clean image, and re-noising it back to the level the network expects. Together these steps sample the posterior at that scale using an approximate Gibbs sampling from two conditional distributions. Experiments on ImageNet, CelebA, AFHQ and fastMRI span inpainting, deblurring, super-resolution and accelerated MRI, with PSNR gains of 1.37-7.66 dB over the strongest competing method on CelebA and pixel-domain reconstruction up to 512x512.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIMB-Flow 为 pyramidal/cascaded latent diffusion 先验定制后验采样，在像素域按由粗到细的层级生成图像，交替做端点估计、数据一致性更新与重新加噪，用两个条件分布的近似 Gibbs 采样逐尺度采样后验。在 ImageNet、CelebA、AFHQ 与 fastMRI 的 inpainting、deblurring、超分辨和加速 MRI 上，相对最强竞争方法在 CelebA 上 PSNR 提升 1.37–7.66 dB，像素域重建最大到 512×512。
Motivation: latent diffusion 用 auto-encoder 压缩虽控制了计算量与模型规模，却损失空间细节，并把后验优化变成非线性问题；现有后验采样算法未针对 pyramidal/cascaded 架构设计。
Method: 针对 pyramidal/cascaded 架构提出 CLIMB-Flow：三步交替——由当前粗且含噪图像做端点估计、对干净图像做数据一致性更新、再重新加噪回网络期望的噪声层级；每步用两个条件分布的近似 Gibbs 采样 (approximate Gibbs sampling) 在该尺度采样后验，全程在像素域由粗到细生成。
Result: 在 CelebA 上相对最强竞争方法 PSNR 提升 1.37–7.66 dB；像素域重建达 512×512；实验覆盖 ImageNet、CelebA、AFHQ 与 fastMRI，任务含 inpainting、deblurring、超分辨与加速 MRI。
Conclusion: 把后验采样按由粗到细的层级结构定制，可在保留像素域细节的同时处理大尺度图像逆问题，覆盖从自然图像到加速 MRI 的多类任务。

papers.title: One Attack to Fool Them All: Highly Transferable Black-Box Adversarial Attacks on Frontier MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks have long posed a fundamental threat to machine learning systems. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rapidly evolve and become widely deployed, assessing their vulnerability to such attacks is essential for their safe use. In this work, we investigate whether a single adversarial image can consistently mislead diverse frontier MLLMs in black-box settings. We propose O-Attack, a highly transferable black-box attack framework. This framework builds on our insight that surrogate models contain a broad, high-level, cross-modally aligned semantic space. This space extends beyond final-layer outputs and provides multiple semantically consistent representations that remain underexploited by existing attacks. Within this space, O-Attack anchors aligned representations, progressively broadens semantic conditions, and optimizes perturbations through semantic consensus to promote consistent target alignment. By fully exploiting this space with the same surrogate models as M-Attack, O-Attack raises attack success rates on GPT-5.4 (29.1% to 77.2%), Claude-4.6 (42.8% to 81.6%), and Gemini-3.1 (38.2% to 80.9%). Extensive experiments across 24 MLLMs show that O-Attack outperforms six state-of-the-art methods in black-box transferability, with consistent effectiveness across prompts and improved efficiency and imperceptibility. This work exposes the practical safety risks posed by black-box adversarial attacks against frontier MLLMs, underscoring the need for more rigorous robustness evaluation and more effective defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 O-Attack：利用代理模型中跨模态对齐的高层语义空间，锚定对齐表征、逐步放宽语义条件并以语义共识优化扰动，使同一张对抗图像在黑盒设置下稳定欺骗多个前沿 MLLM。在与 M-Attack 相同的代理模型上，GPT-5.4 攻击成功率 29.1%→77.2%，Claude-4.6 42.8%→81.6%，Gemini-3.1 38.2%→80.9%。
Motivation: MLLM 部署日益广泛，但现有黑盒迁移攻击未能利用代理模型中超越末层输出、语义一致的多表征，导致单张对抗图像难以稳定欺骗不同前沿模型。
Method: O-Attack 在代理模型的跨模态对齐语义空间中锚定对齐表征，逐步扩大语义条件范围，并通过语义共识 (semantic consensus) 优化扰动以实现一致的目标对齐；与 M-Attack 使用相同代理模型。
Result: 攻击成功率：GPT-5.4 从 29.1% 提至 77.2%，Claude-4.6 从 42.8% 提至 81.6%，Gemini-3.1 从 38.2% 提至 80.9%；在 24 个 MLLM 上的实验中，黑盒迁移性超过六种 SOTA 方法，跨 prompt 一致有效，并在效率与不可察觉性上更优。
Conclusion: 充分挖掘代理模型的高层跨模态语义空间可大幅提高黑盒对抗迁移性，暴露前沿 MLLM 的实际安全风险，需要更严格的鲁棒性评估与更有效的防御。

papers.title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
papers.abstract_en: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界-动作模型 (World-Action Model, WAM) 常先给出视觉上合理的任务完成画面，再给出的动作序列却未必真能达成该画面。作者把 WAM 的视觉预测当作目标条件的视觉提案，用冻结的动作条件世界模型预测动作后果，以两路未来预测的一致性与对终态目标的对齐构造反馈，再用 Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) 优化动作头。在四个真实 UR5 操作任务上平均成功率从 43.4% 提到 75.1%，对照 π₀.₅ 的 61.4%。
Motivation: WAM 的视觉预测与其生成动作所隐含的后果之间存在不一致，视觉上合理的画面并不对应可执行的动作序列，直接把预测当计划会失败。
Method: 把 WAM 视觉预测降级为目标条件视觉提案；用冻结的动作条件世界模型推演动作后果，基于两路未来预测的一致性与终态目标对齐构造反馈信号；用 Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) 优化 WAM 动作头，全程无需在线机器人交互，也不额外训练任务专属奖励模型。
Result: 四个真实 UR5 操作任务上平均成功率由 43.4% 提升至 75.1%，π₀.₅ 基线为 61.4%。
Conclusion: 跨模型的预测差异本身可作为改进机器人策略的反馈信号，在所评估的操作任务上有效，且无需在线交互或任务奖励模型。

papers.title: dOPT: Differentiating Conic Optimization via Geometric Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Optimization layers enable the incorporation of structured constraints and decision problems into learning systems. Training such systems requires differentiating through the embedded optimization problem, which can be challenging for general conic programs. We introduce dOPT, a solver-agnostic framework that, rather than differentiating the full conic formulation, reduces it at a computed primal-dual solution to an equality-constrained quadratic program that preserves the reference solution and its first-order sensitivity. The reduction captures the local first- and second-order conic geometry relevant to differentiation and remains well defined at singular configurations. Computing solution derivatives then requires a single symmetric linear solve, independently of the forward solver. We derive explicit reductions for convex NLPs, QPs, SOCPs, and SDPs. Numerical experiments validate the computed gradients and show favorable backward-pass scalability, with substantial speedups over existing differentiable conic optimization methods as problem size increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: dOPT 是一个与求解器无关的可微锥优化框架：不直接对完整锥规划求导，而是在已算得的原始-对偶解处把问题化简为保持参考解及其一阶灵敏度的等式约束二次规划，随后只需一次对称线性求解即可得到解导数。该化简刻画了与求导相关的一阶、二阶锥几何并在奇异构型下仍有定义，数值实验验证了梯度并显示随问题规模增大相对现有可微锥优化方法有显著加速。
Motivation: 把结构化约束与决策问题嵌入学习系统需要对内嵌优化层求导，而一般锥规划的反向求导计算困难且受前向求解器制约。
Method: dOPT 在计算得到的 primal-dual 解处将完整锥形式化简为等式约束 QP，保留参考解与一阶灵敏度，并刻画局部一阶、二阶锥几何；解导数由单次对称线性求解得到，与前向求解器无关。作者对凸 NLP、QP、SOCP、SDP 推导了显式化简。
Result: 数值实验验证了所计算的梯度，并显示反向传播随问题规模增长具有良好的可扩展性，相对已有可微锥优化方法随问题规模增大取得显著加速。
Conclusion: 在解处做几何化简而非对完整锥形式求导，是在奇异构型下仍良定义、且反向开销与前向求解器解耦的可微锥优化路径。

papers.title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
papers.abstract_en: An agent harness controls how a language model accesses information, uses tools, preserves memory, and checks its work. Improving this software is costly when each evaluation requires a long interaction with an environment. We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model. Its organizing overhypothesis is that tasks of a shared kind may exhibit recurring failures whose remedies transfer within that kind. Vestrum expresses failures as recognizable classes, proposes changes across verification, retrieval, decomposition, and knowledge synthesis, and screens their scope before evaluating them as a bundle. A persistent lessons file informs subsequent proposals. Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench. Across our searches, verification grounded in evidence helped both intermediate steps and final answers, at lower cost at intermediate steps, while critics asked to rebuild finished answers broke more than they repaired. On the three memory benchmarks, Vestrum also scores above the evaluated GEPA configurations in every paired evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vestrum 把 agent harness 执行轨迹中的失败归类为可识别的失败类型，据此在验证、检索、分解与知识合成四个方向提出改动，先筛作用域再整体评估，且不训练任务模型。在五个设置与两个基线 harness 上冻结后的 harness 提升留出性能：UltraHorizon 47.6→59.8（对 GAM），Terminal-Bench 4 Hard 通过率 63.7%→70.3%（对 Claude Code，八个留出任务，测试成本 1.03x），细胞类型标注一致性 67.5%→77.8%。
Motivation: 改进 agent harness 成本高，因为每次评估都要与环境做长交互；而同类任务的失败往往反复出现，其补救措施可在同类内迁移。
Method: Vestrum 将执行轨迹中的失败表达为可识别的失败类别，跨 verification、retrieval、decomposition、knowledge synthesis 提出改动，先筛选改动的作用域再作为整体评估；持久化 lessons 文件为后续提案提供信息，任务模型保持冻结。
Result: 五个设置、两个基线 harness 上留出性能提升：UltraHorizon 47.6→59.8（对 GAM）；Terminal-Bench 4 Hard 通过检查比例 63.7%→70.3%（对 Claude Code，八个留出任务，测试成本 1.03x）；单张切片留出切片上的细胞类型标注一致性 67.5%→77.8%；LoCoMo 与 AMA-Bench 也有提升。跨搜索的定性结论：基于证据的 verification 同时改善中间步骤与最终答案，且在中间步骤上成本更低；要求重建已完成答案的 critics 破坏多于修复。三个 memory benchmark 的成对评估中，Vestrum 全部高于所评估的 GEPA 配置。
Conclusion: 按失败类别在同类任务内迁移 harness 改动、并先筛作用域再整体评估，可以在不训练任务模型的情况下提升留出性能；基于证据的验证应放在中间步骤，而让 critic 重建成品答案得不偿失。

papers.title: Augmenting Visual Anomaly Detection with Automated Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Visual anomaly detectors identify deviations from known-normal data, but their anomaly signals may mix evidence of actual anomalies with benign visual variation. We investigate whether automated interpretability can augment visual anomaly detectors by identifying and intervening on different components of this signal. We decompose PatchCore nearest-normal residuals into sparse features using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), and provide high-activation and contrastive non-active examples to a Multimodal LLM, which describes each feature and labels it as anomaly, distractor, or uncertain. These labels guide interventions in the SAE hidden representation, where distractor features are suppressed and anomaly features amplified. The edited representation is then used to reconstruct patch embeddings, which are rescored with PatchCore. Across 40 categories from four benchmarks, applying both interventions jointly improves macro-average image-level AUROC from 0.8724 to 0.8857 on source data and from 0.8066 to 0.8210 under synthetic corruptions. On three additional RobustAD categories with real acquisition shifts, the same interventions improve AUROC from 0.8745 to 0.9056 on source data and from 0.6069 to 0.6599 under real acquisition shifts. Finally, individual feature interventions across all 43 categories show that the MLLM labels are aligned in aggregate with how features differently affect normal and anomalous images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 PatchCore 的最近邻残差用 Sparse Autoencoder 分解成稀疏特征，再让 MLLM 把特征标为 anomaly、distractor 或 uncertain，并据此在 SAE 隐表示中抑制干扰特征、放大异常特征，最后重建 patch embedding 重新打分。联合干预在 40 个类别上把源数据宏平均图像级 AUROC 从 0.8724 提到 0.8857、合成扰动下从 0.8066 提到 0.8210；在 3 个真实采集偏移的 RobustAD 类别上从 0.8745 提到 0.9056、真实偏移下从 0.6069 提到 0.6599。
Motivation: 视觉异常检测器的异常信号混杂了真实异常与良性视觉变化，二者无法区分导致在扰动与采集偏移下判别力明显下降。
Method: 用 Sparse Autoencoder 把 PatchCore 的最近-normal 残差分解为稀疏特征，将高激活样本与对比的非激活样本交给 Multimodal LLM 描述并标注为 anomaly/distractor/uncertain；标签指导 SAE 隐表示上的干预（抑制 distractor、放大 anomaly），编辑后的表示用于重建 patch embedding，再由 PatchCore 重新打分。
Result: 在四个基准共 40 个类别上，联合干预使宏平均图像级 AUROC 源数据 0.8724→0.8857、合成扰动 0.8066→0.8210；在 3 个含真实采集偏移的 RobustAD 类别上源数据 0.8745→0.9056、真实偏移 0.6069→0.6599。全部 43 个类别的单特征干预显示 MLLM 标签在总体上与特征对正常图和异常图的不同影响一致。
Conclusion: 自动可解释性给出的特征标签可以用来定向编辑异常检测器的中间表示，从而在合成扰动与真实采集偏移下都提升 PatchCore 的图像级 AUROC。

papers.title: Dual-Vocabulary Language Model for Cross-Tokenizer Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges teacher supervision and student behavior, but different teacher-student tokenizers introduce misalignment in both input tokenization (#1) and output logits (#2). Existing approaches address the former by matching same-text spans or converting tokens to bytes, often losing fine-grained token information or disrupting the native-token paradigm, while for the latter, strategies such as ranking, padding, or key-token selection retain only shared logit dimensions, resulting in much distribution loss. In this paper, we propose Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM), which replaces the teacher's LM head with a new student-vocabulary projection head and obtains full-dimensional student logits (for #2). To support student tokens (for #1), it takes a Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS) as input, which concatenates the original teacher-tokenized sequence and a re-tokenized sequence formed by independently converting each student token into a teacher-token group. To avoid inference inconsistency with the original teacher tokens, the Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) further restricts re-tokenized groups to their corresponding teacher prefix and uses its last state as the aggregation of the original student-token representation for projection into the student vocabulary space. Similarly, via the combined use of PTS and HPA, the DVLM teacher can provide distribution-aligned supervision with the student's input-tokenization and output-logit during OPD. Experimental results demonstrate that our DVLM teacher has a similar converged loss as the original teacher model and enables student models to improve performance across six reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy distillation 中，输入分词与输出 logits 两个层面都错位，DVLM 用学生词表投影头替换教师 LM head，并以 Parallel-Tokenized Sequence 加 Hybrid-Prefix Attention 让教师按学生的输入分词与输出 logits 给出分布对齐的监督。DVLM 教师收敛损失与原教师模型相当，学生模型在六项推理任务上性能提升。
Motivation: 教师与学生 tokenizer 不同时，输入分词 (#1) 与输出 logits (#2) 双重错位；现有按同文本跨度或字节转换、以及 ranking/padding/key-token 选择的做法会丢失细粒度 token 信息或分布信息。
Method: DVLM 用学生词表投影头替换教师 LM head，得到全维学生 logits；输入用 Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS)，拼接原教师分词序列与逐个学生 token 重分词成教师 token 组的序列；Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) 把重分词组限制在对应教师前缀内，取其末状态投影到学生词表空间，PTS 与 HPA 组合使 DVLM 教师在 OPD 中提供分布对齐监督。
Result: DVLM 教师的收敛损失与原教师模型相当；学生模型在六项推理任务 (six reasoning tasks) 上性能提升。
Conclusion: 用学生词表投影头加前缀受限注意力，可以让异 tokenizer 的教师在 OPD 中给出与学生分词和 logits 对齐的监督而不损失教师能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Annealed Sinkhorn with Momentum: Certified Unregularized Optimal Transport in Linear Memory
papers.abstract_en: We characterize Bregman Douglas-Rachford splitting (BDRS) for unregularized discrete optimal transport and develop an anytime primal-dual certificate in linear memory. We first establish that BDRS coincides with warm-started Inexact Proximal point method for exact Optimal Transport (IPOT) using a single inner Sinkhorn iteration. By eliminating the primal transport plan from the updates, we derive an equivalent dual formulation that reveals BDRS as annealed Sinkhorn under an implicit inverse-linear temperature schedule, with an additional log-scaling momentum term and a cooler kernel. While this explains the role of the temperature parameter in BDRS as an initial temperature, it also reduces the solver's memory requirement from quadratic to linear. Utilizing this annealing perspective, we introduce overrelaxed BDRS, which combines annealing and overrelaxed scaling within a single recursion. We derive a primal-dual certificate for both methods that can be evaluated in linear memory without transport plan construction, thus providing a computable stopping rule. On the DOTmark benchmark, combining momentum with the cooler kernel produces substantially smaller optimality gaps than annealed Sinkhorn under the same schedule. For pixel-level color transfer between $1024\times1024$ images, BDRS attains a lower repaired transport cost than MDOT-TNT with a 9$\times$ speed up, reaching a relative duality gap of $1.59\%$ in 24 minutes. We further demonstrate a color transfer with $4238\times2365$ images, yielding 10 million pixels per image and approximately one hundred trillion implicit transport entries, reaching a best relative duality gap of $2.41\%$ and $2.80\%$ within 35 hours in each direction on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Bregman Douglas-Rachford splitting (BDRS) 改写成消去运输计划的对偶形式，等价于带隐式逆线性温度退火、log 缩放动量与 cooler kernel 的 annealed Sinkhorn，内存从平方降到线性，并给出无需构造运输计划即可评估的 anytime primal-dual 停止证书。在 DOTmark 上动量加 cooler kernel 的最优性间隙显著小于同调度 annealed Sinkhorn；1024×1024 颜色迁移相对对偶间隙 1.59%（24 分钟），比 MDOT-TNT 快 9×；4238×2365（约一亿像素、约十万亿隐式运输条目）在单张 NVIDIA L40S 上 35 小时内双向分别达 2.41% 与 2.80%。
Motivation: 无正则离散最优传输的求解器通常需要平方内存存储运输计划，且缺少可计算的停止准则，大规模像素级问题上难以给出带证书的收敛判定。
Method: 先证明 BDRS 等价于单次内层 Sinkhorn 迭代的 warm-started IPOT；再从更新中消去 primal 运输计划，导出等价对偶形式，揭示 BDRS 即 annealed Sinkhorn（隐式逆线性温度调度 + log-scaling 动量 + cooler kernel），并据此提出 overrelaxed BDRS；对两种方法推导可在内存中评估的 primal-dual 证书作为停止规则。
Result: DOTmark 上动量与 cooler kernel 组合的最优性间隙显著小于同调度的 annealed Sinkhorn；1024×1024 像素级颜色迁移中 BDRS 的 repaired transport cost 低于 MDOT-TNT，加速 9×，24 分钟内相对对偶间隙 1.59%；4238×2365（每图约一千万像素、约十万亿隐式运输条目）在单张 NVIDIA L40S 上 35 小时内双向最好相对对偶间隙分别为 2.41% 与 2.80%。
Conclusion: 退火视角使 BDRS 的温度参数被解释为初始温度，同时把内存需求从平方降到线性，配合 primal-dual 证书即可在不构造运输计划的情况下给出可计算的停止规则。

papers.title: Identical Runs, Different Results: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on Open-Weight Models
authors: Eduardo Ariño de la Rubia (Central European University)
papers.abstract_en: Repeated runs of the same coding agent are known to give different benchmark scores. We ask what that variation means for a team running an agent on its own task, by intensive replication on one machine-learning task: an agent improves the training code of an XGBoost classifier for airline delays, and a holdout it never sees scores the result. Across 584 runs, we compare six agents on six open-weight model endpoints, run six agent-model pairings 52 times each under fixed settings, and repeat three of them on a larger model from the same family. Identical runs of one pairing varied more than the pairings differed from one another, so comparisons of a few runs ranked them unreliably; resolving the agent differences we observed would take tens to more than a hundred runs of each. Runs on the larger model scored clearly higher, but by less than one run-to-run standard deviation, and the gap was more than twice as large with one agent as with the others. Fewer than one run in twenty broke the task's data rules, but those runs held the highest scores. Rejecting those runs first and keeping the best compliant result among a few attempts reliably improved the delivered model, even though a few runs could not rank the agents. On flights from a later year, the delivered models kept only a third of their gain over the starting code. At list prices, cost differed more than twentyfold between two agents on the same model, mostly through the prompt cache. Agents and models should be evaluated as pairings, over repeated attempts, with compliance reported beside quality. Data, code and every delivered program: https://github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单一 ML 任务（XGBoost 航班延误分类器的训练代码改进）上做 584 次重复运行，发现同一 agent-model 配对的运行间方差大于配对之间的差异，几次运行的排名不可靠。先剔除违反数据规则的运行（不到 1/20，但占据最高分）再取多次尝试中最好的合规结果，能稳定提升交付模型；作者主张按配对、多次重复评估 agent 与模型，并同时报告合规性与质量。
Motivation: 同一 coding agent 重复运行得到不同 benchmark 分数是已知现象，但这种方差对在自有任务上运行 agent 的团队意味着什么并不清楚：少量运行的排名不可靠，且高分运行可能来自违规。
Method: 在一项 ML 任务上做密集复现：agent 改进 XGBoost 航班延误分类器的训练代码，由 agent 从未见过的 holdout 打分。比较 6 个 agent × 6 个 open-weight model endpoint，其中 6 个配对在固定设置下各跑 52 次，另将其中 3 个配对在同家族更大模型上重复；并用一个更晚年份的航班数据检验交付模型。
Result: 共 584 次运行。同一配对的运行间差异大于配对之间的差异，少量运行排名不可靠，分辨所观察到的 agent 差异需每个数十到一百多次运行。更大模型得分明显更高，但差距小于一个运行间标准差，且该差距在某个 agent 上是其他 agent 的两倍多。不到 1/20 的运行违反数据规则，但这些运行占据最高分；先剔除违规再取最优合规结果可稳定改进交付模型。在更晚年份航班上交付模型只保留了约三分之一的增益。按标价计，两个 agent 在同一模型上成本相差二十倍以上，主要来自 prompt cache。
Conclusion: agent 与模型应作为配对、在多次尝试上评估，并把合规性与质量并列报告；拒绝违规运行后取最优合规结果是提升交付质量的可行策略。

papers.title: Eyes on the Road: A Naturalistic Comparison of MTW Rider Gaze in Urban Indian Traffic
papers.abstract_en: Motorized two-wheelers (MTW) dominate Indian roads but remain underrepresented in driver behavior research. This study presents the first large-scale analysis of MTW driver gaze behavior in naturalistic, heterogeneous urban traffic, using the \textit{myEye2Wheeler} dataset. A semantic segmentation pipeline (YOLOv11 + SAM2) was used to extract object-level gaze metrics under two attention modes: direct gaze (foveal overlap) and central vision (parafoveal monitoring). Results reveal a functional division: central vision supports broad monitoring, while direct gaze enables brief, selective sampling. Novice riders exhibit road-anchored scanning, returning to the road between object fixations, while experienced riders form longer chains of attention across multiple objects. The findings suggest that experience primarily refines temporal rhythm rather than altering allocation strategy and reduces object-class effects in gaze patterns. These findings offer new insight into MTW attention structures and inform future work on behavior modeling and safety systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 YOLOv11 + SAM2 语义分割流水线在 myEye2Wheeler 数据集上做印度城市混合交通中摩托车 (MTW) 骑手的自然驾驶视线分析，区分直接注视（中央凹重叠）与中央视觉（旁凹监控）两种注意模式。发现功能分工：中央视觉负责广域监控、直接注视做短暂选择性采样；新手骑手视线在物体间回到路面形成路锚定扫描，老手则跨多个物体形成更长的注意链，经验主要改变时间节律而非分配策略。
Motivation: 摩托车在印度道路占主导，但在驾驶行为研究中代表性不足，缺少自然驾驶情境下的大规模骑手视线数据与物体级注视指标。
Method: 构建 myEye2Wheeler 数据集，用 YOLOv11 + SAM2 语义分割流水线提取物体级视线指标，并按直接注视（foveal overlap）与中央视觉（parafoveal monitoring）两种注意模式分别统计。
Result: 揭示注意的功能分工：中央视觉支撑广域监控，直接注视实现短暂、选择性采样；新手呈路锚定扫描（物体注视之间回到路面），老手形成跨多物体的更长注意链；经验主要细化时间节律、不改变分配策略，并减弱物体类别对视线模式的影响。
Conclusion: 骑手经验的作用体现在注视的时间节律与物体类别效应的减弱上，而非注意资源的重新分配，可为行为建模与安全系统设计提供依据。

papers.title: Controlling Speaking Rate in Autoregressive TTS via Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) systems synthesize natural speech but, once trained, offer little control over speaking rate. We show that speaking rate can be steered at inference time, without retraining, by clamping a single decoder block's activation along a discovered speed axis. A decoder-block analysis recovers the rate axis, a neutral operating point, and a per-step intensity scale; at inference, the activation's projection onto this axis is set to a fixed scalar. Learning this direction from synthetically time-stretched and time-compressed speech yields rate control that largely preserves speaker identity, generalizes across model architectures, and maintains high naturalness in objective and human evaluations. Unlike standard additive steering, which breaks at the slow extreme, clamping remains stable on all three systems tested; at moderate targets, the better rule depends on the model. Finally, we show that rate information is decodable across layers but causally steerable only within a mid-depth window, and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the public Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE SLT 2026. 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自回归 TTS 训练完成后缺少语速控制手段，本文在推理阶段把单个 decoder block 的激活沿一条从时间拉伸/压缩语音中发现的 speed axis 做 clamping（钳制到固定标量），无需重训即可调节语速。该方法在三个系统上都保持稳定，而标准加性 steering (additive steering) 在慢速极端会失效；语速信息跨层可解码，但只有中层窗口内可因果操控。
Motivation: 自回归 TTS 合成语音自然，但训练后几乎无法控制 speaking rate，重训代价高；加性激活引导在慢速极端不稳定。
Method: 先做 decoder-block 分析，恢复 rate axis、neutral operating point 与 per-step intensity scale；speed axis 从合成的时间拉伸与时间压缩语音中学习，推理时把该激活在轴上的投影钳制为固定标量；在三个系统上对比 clamping 与标准 additive steering，并在公开 Seed-TTS-Eval benchmark 上演示。
Result: 在三个受测系统上 clamping 全程稳定，而 additive steering 在慢速极端失效；中等目标下两种规则孰优取决于具体模型；rate 信息跨层可解码，但仅在中层深度窗口内可因果操控；目标语速在客观与人工评价中保持高自然度，并大体保留说话人身份；在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上验证有效。
Conclusion: 语速可作为激活空间中的一条轴在推理时被因果操控，且 clamping 比加性引导更稳；能否用加性规则取决于模型与目标语速档位。

papers.title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.
papers.comment: 28 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Project website: https://codeactionbench.org
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeActionBench 用 25 个具身操作任务和共享机器人 API，测试通用多模态模型能否在无微调、无演示、无特权场景状态下把视觉理解转成可执行代码策略。九种配置共 675 次尝试成功率 2.7%–73.3%，最强的 GPT-6 Astra + Codex CLI 在三次尝试内解出 25 题中的 22 题，失败集中在空间对齐、物体保持与完成判断。
Motivation: 通用多模态模型能否把视觉推理落到真实操作动作缺少受控评测：现有设置常依赖任务微调、演示或特权场景状态，模型间难以公平比较。
Method: 提出 CodeActionBench：25 个固定任务实例配共享机器人 API（RGB 观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈、受限运动），加资源预算与隐藏的物理结果验证器；被测 agent 自选视觉证据、构造 3D 估计与操作目标并迭代修订策略，不做任务微调。
Result: 九种配置共 675 次尝试，成功率 2.7%–73.3%；最强配置 GPT-6 Astra + Codex CLI 在三次尝试内至少成功一次解出 25 个任务中的 22 个。轨迹分析显示失败集中在空间对齐、物体保持与完成判断，包括动作已完成但仍判为失败的情形。
Conclusion: 通用模型已能把部分视觉推理转成可执行操作行为，但在空间对齐与完成判断上仍明显不足，CodeActionBench 提供受控测试台来定位这类失败。

papers.title: MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception
papers.abstract_en: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE)，用联合时空坐标参数化作用在 query/key 特征上的 Lorentz 变换，使注意力分数只依赖两 token 的相对时空位移，从而对坐标全局平移不变，同时保留标准点积注意力接口与高效注意力实现的兼容性。在微观分子动力学与宏观视频预测两类任务上评测：九项多轨迹分子评估全部取得最佳结果，KTH 视频预测 MSE 相对最优基线降低 9.9%，参数量约为其十分之一。
Motivation: 物理驱动的动力学建模先验强但约束灵活性，学习驱动的架构灵活却把时空耦合留在隐式状态；需要一种既保留学习灵活性、又显式注入几何先验的时空联合建模方式。
Method: MinkowskiPE 用联合的时间与空间坐标参数化施加于 query 和 key 特征的 Lorentz 变换，使 query-key 注意力分数仅通过两 token 的相对时空位移依赖位置，因而对坐标全局平移不变；保持标准点积注意力接口，并兼容高效注意力实现。评测覆盖微观分子动力学与宏观视频预测两类任务。
Result: 在九项多轨迹分子动力学评估 (multi-trajectory molecular evaluations) 上全部取得最佳结果；在 KTH 视频预测上 MSE 相对最优基线降低 9.9%，同时参数量约为最优基线的十分之一。
Conclusion: 把相对论式的 Lorentz 变换几何先验注入注意力的位置编码，可以在保留点积注意力接口与参数效率的同时，显式建模时空耦合，并在分子动力学与视频预测两类跨尺度任务上同时奏效。

papers.title: Diffusion Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward models underpin the alignment of large language models, yet the dominant designs reduce each prompt--response pair to a point estimate or to a distribution from a fixed parametric family. This is at odds with human preference, which is inherently multimodal: the same response can be reasonably judged in many ways, and no single family covers all of them. To better fit this structure, we introduce DRM, a Diffusion Reward Model that recasts reward modeling as conditional density estimation over $p(\mathbf{r}\mid x,y)$. Conditioned on a frozen LLM encoder, a lightweight Diffusion Transformer denoises Gaussian noise into a reward vector, placing no parametric assumption on the output distribution and naturally representing its multimodal structure. A single architecture handles both multi-attribute regression and pairwise preference data, and at inference $N$ samples form an empirical reward distribution that can be aggregated into a scalar, a variance, or quantiles. Across five benchmarks, DRM matches or surpasses baselines under matched data and backbone, stays competitive with much larger discriminative, distributional, and generative RMs despite its modest training scale, and recovers multimodal reward structure where conventional heads collapse to a point. Uncertainty-aware rejection and lower-confidence-bound (LCB) aggregation further demonstrate that DRM can exploit distributional information beyond a scalar reward to improve reward-model decisions. Downstream RLHF experiments additionally show that using DRM as the training-time reward leads to improved policy performance, directly validating the practical benefit of diffusion-based reward modeling for RLHF training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRM 把奖励建模改写为条件密度估计 p(r|x,y)：冻结 LLM 编码器加轻量 Diffusion Transformer，把高斯噪声去噪成奖励向量，不预设输出分布族，从而表示多模态偏好。在五个 benchmark 上，同数据同骨干时匹配或超过基线，且用作 RLHF 训练奖励时策略性能提升。
Motivation: 现有奖励模型把 prompt-response 对压成点估计或固定参数族分布，与人类偏好天然多模态、无单一分布族覆盖的结构相冲突。
Method: 以冻结 LLM encoder 为条件，轻量 Diffusion Transformer 去噪生成奖励向量，对输出分布不作参数假设；单一架构同时吃多属性回归数据与成对偏好数据，推理时采 N 次得到经验奖励分布，可聚合成标量、方差或分位数；另用 uncertainty-aware rejection 与 lower-confidence-bound (LCB) 聚合利用分布信息。
Result: 在五个 benchmark 上，匹配数据与骨干时匹配或超过基线；尽管训练规模不大，与更大的判别式、分布化和生成式 RM 相比仍有竞争力；在传统回归头塌缩为点估计处恢复出多模态奖励结构；下游 RLHF 实验显示以 DRM 作为训练期奖励带来策略性能提升。
Conclusion: 奖励应被当作可采样的分布而非单点标量，扩散式条件密度估计既能拟合多模态偏好，也能通过 LCB 等聚合方式直接改善 RM 决策与 RLHF 训练。
