papers.title: Autonomous phase discovery
papers.abstract_en: Understanding quantum phases of matter has long relied on physicists' intuition and mathematical tools such as symmetry and topology. Remarkably successful as these approaches have been, they provide no universal way to explore a Hamiltonian space whose organizing principle is not known in advance. In this work, we introduce a fully autonomous system combining differentiable programming and unsupervised learning for quantum phase discovery. The search evaluates ground-state data along an adaptive trajectory rather than on a predetermined parameter grid. We demonstrate the system with three different solvers and benchmark it against random sampling at equal ground-state-evaluation budgets. On a generalized cluster chain hosting up to $200$ distinct phases, the search finds up to $25$ more phases at the same budget, and matches random sampling given thirty times its budget. On a $50$-parameter Chern insulator, it reaches sectors not obtained by the simple harmonic constructions considered here, in a family whose inverse problem remains open, while recovering all sectors found by sampling. Our results establish autonomous, gradient-driven exploration of Hamiltonian space as a practical route to discovering quantum phases without phase labels or a prescribed target phase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把可微编程与无监督学习耦合的自主量子相发现系统，沿自适应轨迹搜索哈密顿量空间而非在预设参数网格上扫描。在含多达 200 个不同相的广义 cluster chain 上，同等基态评估预算下比随机采样多找到多达 25 个相，且在 30 倍预算时追平随机采样；在 50 参数 Chern 绝缘体上覆盖采样找到的全部扇区并触及简单谐波构造未达的扇区。
Motivation: 对称性与拓扑等传统工具无法在组织原理未知时系统探索哈密顿量空间，预设参数网格的扫描依赖先验的相图知识。
Method: 系统耦合 differentiable programming 与 unsupervised learning，沿自适应轨迹评估基态数据而非固定网格；用三个不同求解器演示，并在等基态评估预算下与随机采样对比。
Result: 在含多达 200 个不同相的广义 cluster chain 上，同预算下最多多找到 25 个相，30 倍预算时与随机采样持平；在 50 参数 Chern 绝缘体上恢复采样找到的全部扇区，并到达本文所考虑的简单谐波构造未得到的扇区。
Conclusion: 自主的、梯度驱动的哈密顿量空间探索可在无相标签、无预设目标相的条件下发现量子相；Chern 绝缘体一族的逆问题仍开放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Binding Multiple Modalities via Multimodal Wasserstein Barycenter
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning beyond two modalities commonly leverages a specific modality (e.g., text) to bind other modalities. However, how to establish a more balanced representation space that approximates shared semantics while respecting the holistic geometry of $n$-modal data remains challenging. In this work, we present BaryBind, which aims to transport the specific modality towards the Wasserstein barycenter (WB) optimized across all modalities and introduces a volumetric alignment objective to establish a unified semantic space around the WB embedding. Specifically, we project specific modalities to the WB, which minimizes the average Wasserstein distances to multimodal distributions and serves as the anchor for subsequent alignment. We then construct a barycenter simplex, whose volume is taken as a similarity metric for global alignment centered at the WB. Experiments show that BaryBind achieves competitive performance in text-video-audio retrieval, classification, videoQA, and cross-modal generation tasks, along with robustness under modality absence and scalability to more than three modalities. Code is released at https://github.com/xl-tang3/BaryBind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BaryBind 把多模态学习中的特定模态（如文本）经 Wasserstein barycenter (WB) 投影到所有模态分布的重心上作为锚点，再用重心单纯形 (barycenter simplex) 的体积作为全局相似度做统一对齐。在 text-video-audio 检索、分类、VideoQA 与跨模态生成任务上取得有竞争力的表现，并在模态缺失下保持稳健、可扩展到三个以上模态。
Motivation: 三模态以上学习通常靠单一模态（如文本）绑定其余模态，导致表示空间不平衡，难以在尊重 n 模态数据整体几何的同时逼近共享语义。
Method: 提出 BaryBind：先把特定模态分布投影到跨全部模态优化的 Wasserstein barycenter，使其最小化到多模态分布的平均 Wasserstein 距离并充当对齐锚点；再构造以 WB 为中心的 barycenter simplex，以单纯形体积作为相似度度量做全局对齐（volumetric alignment objective）。
Result: 在 text-video-audio 检索、分类、VideoQA 和跨模态生成任务上取得有竞争力的性能；在模态缺失条件下表现稳健，并可扩展到三个以上模态。代码已发布于 github.com/xl-tang3/BaryBind。
Conclusion: 用 Wasserstein barycenter 作锚点加体积对齐目标，可以在 n 模态设定下建立更均衡、共享的语义表示空间，且不依赖单一模态绑定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAISE: Reinforcing Access Control Policy Synthesis in LLMs via Symbolic Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Translating natural-language access-control requirements into policies requires careful reasoning about permissions, constraints, and exceptions, and even frontier LLMs often produce policies that violate the intended authorization semantics. We construct CedarInstruct, to our knowledge the first dataset that supports both training and semantic evaluation for formally verifiable Cedar policy synthesis. It contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each with a verified target policy and an executable verification plan. On this data we introduce RAISE, which trains policy synthesizers from formal verification in two stages, verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by a reinforcement learning (RL) stage that learns from verifier signal. We find that SFT succeeds largely by letting models express authorization logic they already have, since untrained models rarely write valid Cedar but often reason correctly when they do. After SFT, how the verifier's information is used matters more than how much of it is used. Of six RL instantiations that consume progressively richer verifier signal, only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully on SFT; it turns failed checks and symbolic counterexamples into guided exploration and learns from the result with off-context GRPO. With about 5.4K verified scenarios and LoRA fine-tuning, RAISE-OC trains Qwen3.5-9B to surpass zero-shot GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 by 13.33 and 16.26 percentage points in semantic success on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAISE 用形式验证信号两阶段训练 LLM 合成可验证的 Cedar 访问控制策略：先 verified SFT，再用 off-context GRPO 把失败检查与符号反例转成引导式探索。仅 RAISE-OC 在 SFT 之上带来实质提升，用约 5.4K 已验证场景和 LoRA 微调 Qwen3.5-9B，在 held-out 场景语义成功率上超零样本 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5 分别 13.33 和 16.26 个百分点，并迁移到独立构建的 CedarBench。
Motivation: 把自然语言访问控制需求翻译成策略需要推理权限、约束与例外，前沿 LLM 仍常产出违反预期授权语义的策略，且此前缺少同时支持训练与语义评估的可形式验证 Cedar 策略数据集。
Method: 构建 CedarInstruct 数据集（5,800 个场景、44 个领域，其中 1,408 个代表单一合成组织，每个含已验证目标策略与可执行验证计划），在其上提出 RAISE 两阶段训练：verified SFT 后接从验证器信号学习的 RL 阶段；六种逐步更丰富验证器信号的 RL 实现中，RAISE-OC 用 off-context GRPO 从失败检查与符号反例中学习，配合 LoRA 微调。
Result: RAISE-OC 以约 5.4K 已验证场景和 LoRA 微调 Qwen3.5-9B，在 held-out 场景语义成功率上超零样本 GPT-6 Astra 13.33 个百分点、超 Claude Opus 5 16.26 个百分点；六种 RL 实现中仅 RAISE-OC 在 SFT 基础上有实质改进；训练迁移到独立构建的 CedarBench。
Conclusion: SFT 主要靠让模型表达其已有的授权逻辑，SFT 之后验证器信息的使用方式比使用多少更重要；把符号反例转成引导探索的 off-context GRPO 是六种方案中唯一在 SFT 之上继续提升的。

papers.title: Do We Really Need KL Divergence for On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: Since the advent of knowledge distillation, KL divergence has been the standard loss in distillation. Recently, on-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for LLMs. As a distillation method, OPD naturally inherits KL divergence as its standard loss. However, in this work, we find that KL divergence may not be necessary for OPD. We show that simply preserving the update direction is sufficient for effective OPD. As long as the update direction is toward the teacher, OPD works. More precisely, it is not the direction of every token, but the direction of a small subset of tokens where the teacher and student disagree strongly. We first show that simply assigning a reward of (+1) to tokens where the teacher probability is higher than the student probability and (-1) where it is lower, which merely encourages updates toward the teacher, reproduces almost the same training mode as OPD with reverse KL. We further show that only the direction of a small subset of tokens with large teacher-student disagreement is critical, and training works as long as their update direction is toward the teacher, even if other tokens are pulled away from the teacher. And as an application of these findings, we introduce Consensus Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (C-MOPD) to improve Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Unlike MOPD, which routes each sample to a single teacher and may cause capability conflicts across domains, C-MOPD lets every sample be supervised by all teachers. Experiments show that C-MOPD consistently outperforms MOPD on both math and code benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/KL-Free-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文质疑 on-policy distillation (OPD) 必须用 KL 散度这一前提：只需保证更新方向朝向 teacher 即可，且关键只在 teacher 与 student 概率分歧最大的一小撮 token 上。据此给出 +1/-1 的方向奖励即可复现 reverse KL OPD 的几乎相同训练模式，并提出 C-MOPD 让每个样本同时受全部 teacher 监督，在数学与代码基准上稳定超过按样本路由单一 teacher 的 MOPD。
Motivation: KL 散度自知识蒸馏起就是标准损失，OPD 也默认继承它；但作者认为 OPD 真正起作用的机制可能只是更新方向，而非 KL 这一具体形式，且 MOPD 按样本路由单一 teacher 会在不同领域间造成能力冲突。
Method: 把 token 分为 teacher 概率高于与低于 student 两类，分别赋奖励 +1 与 -1，仅鼓励更新朝向 teacher，作为 KL-free 的 OPD 目标；进一步检验只保留 teacher-student 分歧大的少数 token 的方向、其余 token 即使被拉离 teacher 是否仍有效。应用层面提出 Consensus Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (C-MOPD)，每个样本由所有 teacher 共同监督，对比按样本路由单一 teacher 的 MOPD。
Result: +1/-1 方向奖励复现了 reverse KL OPD 几乎相同的训练模式；只要分歧大的少数 token 更新方向朝向 teacher，训练即有效，即使其他 token 被拉离 teacher。在数学与代码基准上，C-MOPD 一致优于 MOPD。
Conclusion: OPD 的有效性来自朝向 teacher 的更新方向而非 KL 散度本身，方向一致的小样本分歧 token 足以支撑训练；多 teacher 场景下让所有 teacher 共同监督每个样本可缓解跨领域能力冲突。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 把 token 分为 teacher 概率高于与低于 student 两类，分别赋奖励 +1 与 -1，仅鼓励更新朝向 teacher，作为 KL-free 的 OPD 目标；进一步检验只保留 teacher-student 分歧大的少数 token 的方向、其余 token 即使被拉离 teacher 是否仍有效。应用层面提出 Consensus Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (C-MOPD)，每个样本由所有 teacher 共同监督，对比按样本路由单一 teacher 的 MOPD。
summary_sections.result: +1/-1 方向奖励复现了 reverse KL OPD 几乎相同的训练模式；只要分歧大的少数 token 更新方向朝向 teacher，训练即有效，即使其他 token 被拉离 teacher。在数学与代码基准上，C-MOPD 一致优于 MOPD。
summary_sections.conclusion: OPD 的有效性来自朝向 teacher 的更新方向而非 KL 散度本身，方向一致的小样本分歧 token 足以支撑训练；多 teacher 场景下让所有 teacher 共同监督每个样本可缓解跨领域能力冲突。

papers.title: Multi-Aperture PPG with MAPIS: Spatial Optical and Temporal Coherence Fields
papers.abstract_en: Conventional reflectance photoplethysmography (PPG) typically reduces tissue optical responses to one or a few detector channels. Matrix Pinhole Image Sensing (MAPIS) instead simultaneously samples multiple aperture-dependent optical signals. We analyzed 44 recordings of 30 seconds each from a single MAPIS device to characterize the spatial relationships among DC intensity, pulsatile AC, perfusion index (PI), and temporal coherence across Red and infrared channels. AC increased sublinearly with DC at both wavelengths, resulting in higher PI toward lower-DC apertures, consistent with a first-order relative path-sensitivity interpretation. A second counterintuitive spatial trend was observed in temporal coherence: lower-DC and lower-AC apertures exhibited higher autocorrelation and greater cardiac-periodic spectral concentration. IR signals also showed consistently higher temporal coherence than corresponding Red signals. These observations demonstrate that multi-aperture PPG resolves reproducible spatial relationships among optical intensity, fractional pulsatile sensitivity, and waveform coherence that are largely averaged together in conventional single-channel PPG. The present study establishes within-device relationships and motivates controlled studies of the underlying photon-path mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAPIS 多孔径 PPG 同时采多个孔径相关的光学信号，44 段 30 秒单设备记录显示 AC 随 DC 亚线性增长，低 DC 孔径的 perfusion index 更高；反直觉的是低 DC、低 AC 孔径的自相关与心周期谱集中度反而更高，且 IR 的时间一致性一致高于 Red。
Motivation: 常规反射式 PPG 把组织光学响应压成一两个探测通道，空间上可分辨的强度、脉动敏感度与波形一致性关系被平均掉，无法区分孔径间的差异。
Method: 用单台 MAPIS 设备采集 44 段 30 秒记录，在 Red 与 infrared 两个波长上刻画 DC 强度、脉动 AC、perfusion index (PI) 与 temporal coherence 的空间关系，并以一阶相对路径敏感度 (first-order relative path-sensitivity) 解释 AC-DC 亚线性关系。
Result: 两个波长下 AC 均随 DC 亚线性增长，低 DC 孔径 PI 更高；低 DC 与低 AC 孔径呈现更高自相关与更强心周期谱集中度；IR 信号的时间一致性一致高于对应 Red 信号。
Conclusion: 多孔径 PPG 能复现光学强度、分数脉动敏感度与波形一致性之间的空间关系，这些在单通道 PPG 中被平均；作者据此提出需开展受控研究以厘清底层光子路径机制。

papers.title: Is your uncertainty map wrong, or is its target? Exact diagnostics for the Tweedie diagonal, and a gradient-free alternative
papers.abstract_en: A diffusion model can predict a follow-up medical scan from a baseline, but a clinician needs a per-voxel map of where that prediction can be trusted. Many such maps approximate the diagonal of the Tweedie posterior covariance, and are evaluated against another approximation of it, so whether the estimator or the target limits them is unclear. We compute the exact diagonal on six checkpoints across fourteen model-corpus conditions. Hutchinson at M=200 tracks it at rank agreement of at least 0.92 everywhere, yet in four of the fourteen the exact diagonal is anti-correlated with the denoising error, reaching -0.13, so a faithful estimator reproduces that reversal. All four are real-image conditions; on the models' own samples the reversal does not appear, so evaluating on generated samples flatters this family. What limits these maps is the target, not the estimator. We then introduce Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT), a gradient-free residual probe that corrupts one model-supported prediction repeatedly and measures the voxel-wise variance of the denoiser's response. T-PT reads a different functional of the same Jacobian, and its exact second-order form ranks with the diagonal wherever the diagonal reverses; at thirty probes it returns a map too unstable to reproduce that ranking, while Hutchinson at M=5 already reproduces it, so T-PT there is not evidence against the reversal. We offer it as an instrument, not a better approximation. On brain MRI at full resolution, where every Jacobian-based estimator we test runs out of memory, T-PT leads a twenty-chain Monte-Carlo ensemble on five of eight endpoints inside tissue and trails it on none, at 16x fewer network evaluations; over the whole volume the ensemble leads, and fifty chains close the tissue gap. On lung CT the ensemble is ahead throughout. Both lose most of their discrimination where the change is, which remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文指出扩散模型的逐体素不确定性图（Tweedie 后验协方差对角）之所以失真，瓶颈在目标本身而非估计器：在 14 个模型-语料条件中的 4 个真实图像条件下，精确对角与去噪误差呈负相关（最低 -0.13），忠实的估计器只会复现这一反转。作者提出免梯度残差探针 T-PT，在脑 MRI 全分辨率上以 16 倍更少的网络评估在组织内 8 个终点中的 5 个领先二十链 Monte-Carlo 集成，但明确把它定位为诊断工具而非更好的近似。
Motivation: 扩散模型的逐体素不确定性图常被另一个近似量当作真值来评估，导致无法区分是估计器不准还是目标本身与去噪误差不一致；且现有基于 Jacobian 的估计器在全分辨率体积上显存不足。
Method: 先在 6 个 checkpoint、14 个模型-语料条件下计算 Tweedie 协方差对角的精确值作为基准，用 Hutchinson（M=200）等估计器对照；再提出 Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT)：对单个模型支持的预测反复加扰并测量 denoiser 响应的逐体素方差，读取同一 Jacobian 的另一泛函，其二阶精确形式用于与对角排序对照。
Result: Hutchinson 在 M=200 时处处秩一致性至少 0.92；但 14 个条件中 4 个的精确对角与去噪误差负相关，最低达 -0.13，且这 4 个全是真实图像条件，在模型自身生成样本上反转不出现。T-PT 在 30 次 probe 时排序不稳定，而 Hutchinson 在 M=5 即可复现该排序。脑 MRI 全分辨率下，T-PT 在组织内 8 个终点中的 5 个领先二十链 Monte-Carlo 集成、0 个落后，网络评估次数少 16 倍；全卷上集成领先，50 条链可补齐组织内差距；肺 CT 上集成全程领先。
Conclusion: 限制这类不确定性图的是目标而非估计器，在生成样本上评估会给该方法族虚高表现；T-PT 应作为诊断仪器而非更好的近似使用，而两类方法在变化所在的区域都失去大部分判别力，这一点仍待解决。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Surprising Success, Repeated Failure: Entropy-Guided Credit Assignment for Exploration in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models (LLMs) through outcome-level feedback, yet recent approaches to finer-grained credit assignment often require auxiliary models, additional sampling, or privileged information. Although policy entropy provides a readily available signal, prioritizing uncertain positions under both reinforcement and penalization concentrates penalties where failed responses still retain alternatives for recovery, which can suppress opportunities for exploration. To address this, we introduce Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization (EAPO), an entropy-guided credit assignment method that treats success and failure asymmetrically. Specifically, motivated by the observation that success under uncertainty is less repeatable while confident failures tend to recur, EAPO couples normalized policy entropy with the sign of the response advantage to reinforce surprising success and correct repeated failure. It assigns stronger reinforcement to high-entropy decisions in successful responses and stronger penalties to low-entropy decisions in failed responses, while attenuating penalties at uncertain positions to preserve opportunities for recovery. By redistributing the response advantage across tokens, EAPO derives token-level credit directly from existing rollout signals without additional supervision. We validate EAPO on a range of reasoning tasks across both base and reasoning backbones, demonstrating that it achieves the best overall performance. We further show that EAPO promotes more effective exploration, broadening problem coverage and generating more diverse candidate answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EAPO：把归一化策略熵与响应级 advantage 的符号耦合，对成功响应中的高熵决策给更强强化、对失败响应中的低熵决策给更强惩罚，同时衰减不确定位置的惩罚以保留恢复机会。在 base 与 reasoning 两类骨干的多项推理任务上取得最佳整体表现，并扩大问题覆盖与候选答案多样性。
Motivation: RLVR 的细粒度 credit assignment 通常要额外模型、额外采样或特权信息；而对不确定位置同时施加强化与惩罚会把惩罚集中在仍有恢复可能的失败响应上，压制探索机会。
Method: EAPO (Entropic Advantage Policy Optimization) 用响应级 advantage 的符号调制策略熵：成功响应中高熵决策获更强强化，失败响应中低熵决策获更强惩罚，不确定位置的惩罚被衰减；token 级 credit 直接由已有 rollout 信号重新分配，无需额外监督或辅助模型。
Result: 在覆盖 base 与 reasoning 骨干的一系列推理任务上取得最佳整体性能；并促进更有效的探索，扩大问题覆盖、生成更多样的候选答案。
Conclusion: 成功与失败应非对称地用熵做 credit assignment：不确定性下的成功更不可复现、自信的失败更会重演，据此重分配 advantage 即可在不加额外监督的情况下改善 RLVR 推理与探索。

papers.title: Selecting Diverse SFT Traces Improves Post-RL Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Verified solutions are not equally useful for preparing reasoning models for reinforcement learning (RL). We present a comprehensive study of route diversity, the variation in the sequences of reasoning steps in supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data, and propose a lightweight, rule-based fingerprint to select for it. From one pool at one budget, with matched training recipes and checkpoints, selecting diverse rather than similar routes improves post-RL problem coverage across puzzles and mathematics, including on problems harder than those seen in either training stage. In synthetic experiments, route-diverse SFT improves OLMo3-7B's pass@8 by 16.9 points on environments held out from SFT. In a single-model condition, where one model writes every candidate, diverse selection gains up to 6.2 points of mean pass@8 across 10 mathematics benchmarks. Pre-RL diagnostics suggest why: diverse SFT can produce both successful and failed attempts on more prompts despite slightly lower mean accuracy, giving group-relative RL more prompts with a learning signal. On 3 open-source corpora, our CPU-only selector, without model calls, outperforms more expensive alternatives in every comparison of mean post-RL performance. These results identify reasoning-route diversity as a practical criterion for selecting SFT data that better prepares models for RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在同一批候选与同一训练预算下，按轻量规则式指纹挑选推理路径 (route) 多样的 SFT 数据，比挑选相似路径更能提升 RL 后的问题覆盖。合成实验中 OLMo3-7B 在 SFT 未见过的环境上 pass@8 提升 16.9 点；单模型条件下 10 个数学基准上平均 pass@8 最多提升 6.2 点。
Motivation: 验证正确的解在为 RL 准备推理模型时价值不等，SFT 数据选择缺少一个能预测 post-RL 表现的可操作标准。
Method: 提出轻量、基于规则的 fingerprint 来度量 SFT 样本中推理步骤序列的多样性 (route diversity)，在固定数据池与预算、匹配训练配方和 checkpoint 的条件下做选择；并用 pre-RL 诊断分析多样性如何影响后续 group-relative RL。
Result: 合成实验中，route-diverse SFT 使 OLMo3-7B 在 SFT 留出环境上的 pass@8 提高 16.9 点；单模型条件下（同一模型生成全部候选）在 10 个数学基准上平均 pass@8 最多提高 6.2 点；在 3 个开源语料上，CPU-only、不调用模型的 selector 在每次 post-RL 平均性能比较中都胜过更昂贵的替代方案。诊断显示多样 SFT 虽平均准确率略低，却在更多 prompt 上同时产出成功与失败尝试，为 group-relative RL 提供更多带学习信号的 prompt。
Conclusion: 推理路径多样性是筛选 SFT 数据、使其更好衔接 RL 的实用准则，且廉价的规则式选择器即可胜过需要模型调用的昂贵方法。

papers.title: Evidence-Inference Reconstruction: When The Evidence Is Recalled But The Reasoning Goes Wrong
papers.abstract_en: Modern multi-hop LLM agents are equipped with built-in mechanisms to detect errors in intermediate reasoning steps. Such errors trigger corrective actions from these agents, which mostly follow the paradigm of retrying the steps or the reasoning trajectories. Not only are these retries expensive, we present in this paper that they are also potentially unnecessary. To this end, we introduce Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR), which uses structured state to guide one retrieval trajectory, accumulating source evidence in the process. We show that as long as the relevant evidence has been collected, EIR is capable of generating the correct answer in a single final model call even if erroneous evidence has been mixed in due to incorrect intermediate reasoning steps. In one evaluation, using Haiku 4.5 and GPT-4.1 Mini, we evaluate EIR on matched 1,000-question subsets of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, showing that EIR improves Answer F1, the overlap between the model's and the correct answer, over the baseline by 8.3--32.8 points, Agentic SSR by 10.6--29.1 points, and Reflexion by 1.1--15.9 points. Additionally, we show that EIR averages 4.85 total model calls per question, compared with 35.29 for Agentic SSR and 12.41 for Reflexion. Together, these results corroborate EIR's central premise: separating evidence retrieval from the final answer model call can improve answer accuracy while utilizing substantially less computation.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Tokens Change, Structure Endures: Spectral Watermarking for Generated Speech
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking is a promising tool for establishing the provenance of AI-generated speech. While many neural audio watermarking methods rely on a separately trained watermark generator, token-level watermarking is a training-free alternative that operates directly during generation. Its main weakness is retokenization: decoding generated speech to a waveform and encoding it again can change token identities and erode the watermark. To make the watermark robust to these changes, we propose Redwing, REtokenization-Durable Watermarking IN Generation. It builds a graph from the token substitutions observed under retokenization, whose Laplacian yields a basis that assigns similar values to tokens likely to substitute for one another. Over this basis, embedding and detection functions are jointly optimized to preserve watermark signal through retokenization while limiting embedding distortion and detector variability on unwatermarked speech. On the Moshi full-duplex system, after eight consecutive passes of Mimi resynthesis, Redwing achieves 80.7% TPR at a calibrated 1% FPR, compared with 8.3% for KGW and at most 7.3% for WMAR. It also has the highest TPR after eight passes through three other neural codecs (77.5-93.0%), and the gains generalize to TTS models at a speech-quality cost close to that of KGW. These results show that retokenization is not merely a source of noise: its transition structure can be exploited as a design principle for robust token-level watermarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Redwing：把重标记化 (retokenization) 下观测到的 token 替换构造成图，用其 Laplacian 基底让易互换的 token 取相近水印值，再联合优化嵌入与检测函数。在 Moshi 全双工系统上经八次 Mimi 重合成后，校准 1% FPR 下 TPR 达 80.7%，而 KGW 为 8.3%、WMAR 至多 7.3%。
Motivation: 训练无关 (training-free) 的 token 级语音水印把水印直接放进生成过程，但生成语音解码成波形再重新编码会改变 token 身份，水印随之被侵蚀，现有方法在重标记化下失效。
Method: Redwing 从重标记化观测到的 token 替换构建图，取图 Laplacian 的基底使可能互相替换的 token 获得相近取值；在该基底上联合优化嵌入与检测函数，同时保持水印信号、限制嵌入失真与未加水印语音上的检测器波动。
Result: 在 Moshi 全双工系统上，经八次连续 Mimi 重合成，Redwing 在校准 1% FPR 下 TPR 为 80.7%，对比 KGW 的 8.3% 与 WMAR 的至多 7.3%；经另外三种神经 codec 各八次后 TPR 仍最高，为 77.5–93.0%；增益可泛化到 TTS 模型，语音质量代价接近 KGW。
Conclusion: 重标记化不只是噪声源，其转移结构本身可作为鲁棒 token 级水印的设计原则。

papers.title: Learning Strategies to Break Judges
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents surpass human performance, it becomes exceedingly hard for system designers to evaluate them directly and understand their failure modes. Consequently, agents themselves are being deployed extensively to evaluate, judge, and provide feedback on model traces. But this raises an important question: how can we trust the judge? In this work, we propose an agent-guided method to find weaknesses of agentic judges that expose interpretable failure mechanisms. Our method focuses on mathematical reasoning and proceeds in two stages: first, we deploy adversarial agents to mutate a set of sound proofs by introducing errors, attempting to misguide judges---in other words, injecting errors that judges are unable to catch. Then, we distill these attempts into a small set of mutation strategies which allow us to analyze the failure modes of the judges. To ensure that these strategies are not overfit to the initial set of proofs, we evaluate them by applying the mutation strategies to a held-out set of proofs and querying the same judge. We deploy our method on GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Opus 5, paired with their agent orchestrators, Codex and Claude Code, respectively. These are used both as mutators to introduce errors and as judges to evaluate correctness of mathematical reasoning. We find that across all the agentic judges, we are able to distill mutation strategies that consistently bypass their evaluations, thereby enabling us to ascertain actionable failure modes. Our analysis also reveals that judge reliability degrades at the frontier: errors in Olympiad-level proofs or graduate-level mathematical texts are detected more consistently, whereas flaws in research-level manuscripts are more likely to escape detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 agent 引导的对抗方法来暴露数学推理 agentic judge 的可解释失效机制：先用对抗 agent 篡改 (mutate) 正确证明注入 judge 抓不到的错误，再把这些尝试蒸馏成少量 mutation 策略，并在 held-out 证明集上检验。在 GPT-5.6-sol 与 Claude Opus 5（配 Codex 与 Claude Code 编排器）上，蒸馏出的策略能稳定绕过各 judge 的评估；且 judge 可靠性在前沿退化——Olympiad 与研究生级错误检出更一致，research 级手稿的缺陷更易漏检。
Motivation: AI agent 超过人类水平后，设计者难以直接评估它们并理解失效模式，于是改用 agent 当 judge 打分与反馈，但 judge 本身的可信度无从检验。
Method: 两阶段：对抗 agent 对一组 sound proofs 做 mutation 注入错误以误导 judge；再把这些尝试蒸馏成少量 mutation 策略，并把策略应用到 held-out 证明集、查询同一 judge 以避免过拟合。实验对象为 GPT-5.6-sol 与 Claude Opus 5，配 Codex 与 Claude Code 编排器，同时充当 mutator 与 judge。
Result: 在全部 agentic judges 上蒸馏出的 mutation 策略都能一致绕过其评估，从而定位可操作的失效模式；错误检出率随难度分层：Olympiad 级证明与研究生级数学文本的错误检出更一致，research 级手稿中的缺陷更可能逃过检测。
Conclusion: agentic judge 在数学推理前沿（research 级文本）上可靠性下降，而对抗 mutation 加策略蒸馏是刻画这类 judge 失效模式的可行手段。

papers.title: Skill2Env: Capability-Oriented Environment Synthesis from Skills for General Agents
papers.abstract_en: Executable environments are critical for post-training agents on tasks that require tool use and multi-step interaction, but constructing executable tasks together with their environments remains difficult to scale. Skills provide reusable domain knowledge, operational procedures, and tool-use instructions, but a substantial gap remains between the information contained in a skill and a concrete, challenging task with a complete executable environment. To address this gap, we introduce Skill2Env, a capability-oriented framework that starts from a skill and uses agent capability demands to guide task and environment synthesis. Skill2Env represents these demands through reusable difficulty patterns and instantiates them into task blueprints that specify objectives, challenges, environment facts, information boundaries, and acceptance criteria. These blueprints guide the joint construction of task instructions, execution substrates, workspaces, and rubric-based evaluators around source skills. We further propose Iterative Task Hardening, which uses solver execution evidence to identify insufficiently challenging task designs, strengthen or extend their difficulty-pattern instantiations, and revise the corresponding blueprints and environments. Using 1.5K high-scoring trajectories generated from Skill2Env environments for supervised fine-tuning, we observe consistent improvements across a broad range of agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of capability-oriented environment synthesis for agent post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Skill2Env 从一条 skill 出发，用 agent 能力需求驱动任务与可执行环境的联合合成，并以求解执行证据迭代加难任务。用其环境产出的 1.5K 高分轨迹做监督微调后，agent 在一系列基准上取得一致提升。
Motivation: 面向工具使用与多步交互的 agent 后训练需要大量可执行任务与配套环境，但 skill 中的知识与一个具体、够难、带完整可执行环境的任务之间存在鸿沟，人工构造难以规模化。
Method: 以能力为导向：把能力需求表示为可复用的 difficulty patterns，实例化为 task blueprints（目标、挑战、环境事实、信息边界、验收标准），再据此联合构建任务指令、execution substrates、workspaces 与基于 rubric 的评估器；Iterative Task Hardening 用 solver 执行证据识别难度不足的设计，加强或扩展难度模式实例并修订蓝图与环境。
Result: 用 Skill2Env 环境生成的 1.5K 条高分轨迹做监督微调 (SFT)，在广泛的 agent 基准上观察到一致提升。
Conclusion: 以能力需求为导向、可迭代加难的环境合成，能产出支撑 agent 后训练的可执行任务与环境。

papers.title: M3-Score: Fidelity, Memorization and Coverage as Separate Axes for Evaluating Generative Radiology Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative evaluation of generative models for radiology remains challenging. Clinically relevant structures are often small and infrequent, feature spaces learned from natural images may represent them poorly, and a single summary score cannot distinguish limited fidelity from limited diversity. This study proposes the Medical Multi-axis Maximum Mean Discrepancy score (M3-Score), an evaluation framework based on RadioDINO-s16, a frozen vision transformer pretrained on radiology images. M3-Score reports three complementary axes computed at pre-specified encoder depths: \emph{fidelity}, measured by an unbiased multi-bandwidth radial basis function (RBF) MMD$^2$ at the final block; \emph{memorization}, measured by nearest-neighbor distances at 75\% depth; and \emph{coverage}, defined as the fraction of real images with a generated neighbor within their $k$-nearest-neighbor radius at 33\% depth. Reference sets are sampled across subjects to limit the influence of correlated slices. On BraTS brain MRI, the fidelity axis ordered five comparison sets of increasing severity (Spearman $ρ= 1.00$), and a subject-disjoint real set yielded $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0$ (permutation $p = 1$). An unconditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model achieved $\mathrm{MMD}^2 = 0.073$ (95\% confidence interval $[0.071, 0.080]$) but covered only 38\% of the real distribution. Under progressive mode dropping, $k$-NN manifold recall increased at all twelve encoder blocks, whereas the proposed coverage estimator decreased monotonically ($ρ= -1.00$). RadioDINO-s16 features separated real brain MRI from generated samples with a ROC-AUC of 0.819, compared with 0.555 for InceptionV3 and 0.582 for CLIP. Across a twentyfold range of sample sizes, the mean M3 value varied by a factor of 1.05, compared with 2.52 for the Fréchet Inception Distance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 M3-Score，用冻结的放射学预训练 RadioDINO-s16 在三个固定深度分别报告 fidelity（末块的多带宽 RBF MMD²）、memorization（75% 深度最近邻距离）与 coverage（33% 深度的 k 近邻半径覆盖率），把单一总分拆成三条独立轴。在 BraTS 脑 MRI 上，fidelity 轴对五组递增扰动排序 Spearman ρ=1.00，subject-disjoint 真实集 MMD²=0（置换 p=1）；DDPM 的 MMD²=0.073（95% CI [0.071,0.080]）却只覆盖真实分布的 38%。
Motivation: 放射学生成模型的临床相关结构小且少见，自然图像特征空间表示不佳，而单一汇总分数无法区分 fidelity 不足与 diversity 不足。
Method: 以冻结的放射学图像预训练 ViT RadioDINO-s16 为编码器，在预先指定的深度计算三条轴：末块的无偏多带宽 RBF MMD² 度量 fidelity，75% 深度的最近邻距离度量 memorization，33% 深度上落在真实图像 k 近邻半径内的真实图像比例定义 coverage；参考集跨被采样以削弱相关切片影响。
Result: 在 BraTS 脑 MRI 上，fidelity 轴对五组递增严重度比较集排序 Spearman ρ=1.00，subject-disjoint 真实集得 MMD²=0（置换 p=1）；无条件 DDPM 得 MMD²=0.073（95% CI [0.071,0.080]）但仅覆盖真实分布的 38%。渐进 mode dropping 下，k-NN manifold recall 在全部十二个编码器块上都上升，而本文 coverage 估计单调下降（ρ=-1.00）。RadioDINO-s16 区分真实与生成脑 MRI 的 ROC-AUC 为 0.819，InceptionV3 为 0.555、CLIP 为 0.582；样本量变化二十倍时 M3 均值仅变动 1.05 倍，FID 为 2.52 倍。
Conclusion: 把 fidelity、memorization、coverage 拆成独立轴可在单一分数失效处分别定位问题，且比 FID 更不依赖样本量；coverage 估计在 mode dropping 下比 k-NN manifold recall 更敏感。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: DEALS: Decentralized Expertise-Aware Load Serving for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) have recently emerged as an effective approach for coordinating large language model (LLM)-based agents to solve complex tasks through structured interactions. In practice, MASs often handle a stream of heterogeneous and complex tasks, requiring agents to decompose each task and then self-organize and self-evolve to adapt to incoming tasks while sharing execution resources. However, most early approaches to MASs rely on centralized controllers or fixed coordination patterns, which can limit scalability or adaptability. In contrast, existing decentralized and dynamic MASs often require training dedicated routers or invoking LLMs for agent selection, resulting in substantial computational costs and coordination overhead. To address these challenges and enable efficient task-level self-organization and self-evolution for task- and workload-level collaboration, we propose Decentralized Expertise-Aware Load Serving (DEALS), a decentralized and low-complexity framework that enables agents to self-organize and dynamically route concurrent tasks for processing. Specifically, each agent maintains local queues of incoming tasks, and its router decides whether to process a task locally or forward it to a neighbor based on differences in backlog and success rate. Meanwhile, executors process independent tasks concurrently within and across agents, and partially solved tasks can be resumed by other agents. Experiments show that DEALS not only improves performance along multiple dimensions (e.g., answer accuracy and task throughput) in both homogeneous and heterogeneous agent pools, but also balances agent expertise and workload in a self-organized manner, enabling effective decentralized coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEALS 为多智能体 LLM 系统提出去中心化、低复杂度的任务路由框架：每个 agent 维护本地任务队列，路由器依据邻居与自身的积压量 (backlog) 和成功率 (success rate) 差异决定本地处理还是转发，部分完成的任务可由其他 agent 续做。实验显示它在同构与异构 agent 池上同时提升答案准确率与任务吞吐，并自组织地平衡 agent 的专业度与负载。
Motivation: 早期 MAS 依赖中心化控制器或固定协作模式，可扩展性与适应性受限；现有去中心化动态 MAS 又要训练专用路由器或调用 LLM 选 agent，计算与协调开销大。
Method: 每个 agent 维护本地任务队列，路由器按积压与成功率的差异做本地处理或转发给邻居的决策；执行器在 agent 内外并发处理独立任务，部分解决的任务可被其他 agent 恢复续做，无需训练路由器或调用 LLM 选路。

Conclusion: 仅凭本地积压与成功率的分布式决策即可替代中心化控制器和 LLM 选路，在多智能体 LLM 任务流上同时拿到性能与负载均衡收益。

papers.title: Taming the Greeks: Option Portfolios with Inductive Biases
papers.abstract_en: We present an end-to-end deep learning framework for systematic options trading that directly embeds hedging behavior through explicit control of portfolio-level risk exposures. While neural networks trained to optimize risk-adjusted performance have been shown to outperform traditional rules-based strategies, such approaches remain agnostic to the sensitivities of the resulting portfolios with respect to specific underlying risk factors. We propose a general training objective that combines a performance-driven loss with a differentiable risk-sensitivity penalty, enforcing neutrality to selected risk dimensions. Unlike reinforcement learning methods that approximate optimal hedging policies via simulated market dynamics, our framework operates entirely on historical data and jointly optimizes risk-adjusted returns and targeted risk constraints in a single learning problem. We instantiate the framework on static delta-neutral straddle portfolios with the penalty directed at first-order directional exposure, and evaluate two penalty variants -- an exposure-normalized penalty and a Greek-ratio drift penalty. Empirical results on Nasdaq 100 equity options demonstrate that appropriately calibrated regularization simultaneously improves out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance relative to an unregularized baseline while reducing realized directional exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把风险敏感度直接写进训练目标的期权组合深度学习框架：在业绩损失上加可微的风险敏感度惩罚项，强制组合对选定风险维度中性。在 Nasdaq 100 股权期权的静态 delta 中性跨式组合上，校准得当的正则化相对无正则基线同时改善样本外风险调整后表现并降低已实现方向性敞口。
Motivation: 现有神经网络优化风险调整后表现的交易策略对组合在具体风险因子上的敏感度是不可知的，无法直接控制希腊值敞口；而强化学习式对冲策略依赖模拟市场动态。
Method: 端到端深度学习训练目标 = 业绩驱动损失 + 可微风险敏感度惩罚，联合优化风险调整后收益与定向风险约束，完全基于历史数据而非模拟市场；实例化为静态 delta 中性跨式组合，惩罚作用于一阶方向性敞口，比较两种惩罚变体：敞口归一化惩罚与希腊值比率漂移惩罚 (Greek-ratio drift penalty)。
Result: 在 Nasdaq 100 股权期权上的实证结果：校准得当的正则化相对无正则基线同时改善样本外风险调整后表现，并降低已实现方向性敞口；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把风险敏感度作为可微惩罚项嵌入单一学习问题，可以在不模拟市场动态的前提下同时提升风险调整后收益并收紧目标风险敞口。

papers.title: Beyond Fixed Features: Architecture-Dependent Sensitivity to Node Representations under Heterophily
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) perform well on homophilic graphs but struggle in heterophilic settings, where connected nodes often carry dissimilar labels. Existing evaluations typically compare architectures under a fixed node-feature representation, leaving unclear whether conclusions about heterophily robustness remain stable as the input representation changes. We address this question by constructing parallel feature variants of two large-scale heterophilic benchmarks, Roman-Empire and Amazon-Ratings, pairing each graph with representations ranging from static fastText vectors to contextual Transformer embeddings and evaluating seven GNN architectures across these representations. We find that the effect of representation varies across architectures: on Roman-Empire, the contextual gain ranges from 2.38 percentage points for GCN-sep to 13.67 points for GAT, with H2GCN gaining 8.77 points. On Amazon-Ratings, where node text is limited to short product titles, GAT improves by 6.78 points from fastText to MPNet, while GCN-sep changes by only 0.20 points. These results show that architectural performance is conditional on node representation: the same representation change can produce different magnitudes of performance gain across architectures, so architecture and representation cannot be treated as independent evaluation factors. A rank-correlation analysis on these two benchmarks further shows that the relative ordering of architectures remains highly stable across representations, isolating differential sensitivity, rather than ranking instability, as the primary effect.
papers.comment: Accepted to Learning on Graphs Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在异配图 (heterophily) 上，GNN 的架构优劣并非与节点表征无关：把 fastText 静态向量换成 Transformer 上下文嵌入后，Roman-Empire 上 GAT 提升 13.67 个百分点、H2GCN 提升 8.77 点、GCN-sep 仅 2.38 点，Amazon-Ratings 上 GAT 提升 6.78 点而 GCN-sep 只有 0.20 点。架构排序本身跨表征高度稳定，因此真正变化的是各架构对表征的差异敏感度，评估异配鲁棒性时架构与表征不能当作独立变量。
Motivation: 现有异配图评测都在固定节点特征表示下比较架构，无法判断“某架构更抗异配”的结论在输入表征改变后是否仍然成立。
Method: 为两个大规模异配基准 Roman-Empire 与 Amazon-Ratings 构造平行特征变体，把同一张图配以从静态 fastText 向量到上下文 Transformer 嵌入（含 MPNet）的一系列表征，并在这些表征上评测七个 GNN 架构，另做架构排序的 rank-correlation 分析。
Result: Roman-Empire 上上下文增益从 GCN-sep 的 2.38 个百分点到 GAT 的 13.67 点，H2GCN 为 8.77 点；Amazon-Ratings（节点文本仅为短商品标题）上 GAT 从 fastText 到 MPNet 提升 6.78 点，GCN-sep 仅变化 0.20 点。rank-correlation 分析显示两个基准上架构相对排序跨表征高度稳定。
Conclusion: 架构性能以节点表征为条件，同一表征变化在不同架构上产生幅度差异极大的增益，故架构与表征不能作为独立评测因素；主导效应是差异敏感度而非排序不稳定。

papers.title: SecProbe: Adaptive Evaluation of Coding Agents on Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
papers.abstract_en: Assessing cybersecurity vulnerability awareness in coding agents requires evaluations that reveal capability gaps and remain informative as models evolve. Static benchmarks offer fixed coverage and difficulty, while scarce vulnerable repositories and costly expert authoring limit their renewal at scale. We introduce SecProbe, a framework for adaptive evaluation that combines Item Response Theory (IRT) with on-demand synthesis of repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks. From observed performance, \textsc{SecProbe} estimates agent ability and identifies where additional evidence is most informative, selecting existing tasks or synthesizing new ones accordingly. As one use case, we construct 353 tasks spanning six programming languages and 151 CWE types and evaluate nine frontier models with two agent harnesses. Success rates peak at 28.33\%, highlighting substantial gaps in vulnerability recognition and repair. Compared with random and one-shot baselines, \textsc{SecProbe} achieves comparable agent ability estimates while requiring agents to solve up to 29.5\% fewer tasks. These results support adaptive evaluation as an efficient and discriminative approach to assessing cybersecurity vulnerability awareness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SecProbe 把项目反应理论 (IRT) 与按需合成的仓库级漏洞修复任务结合，用于对编码智能体做自适应评估：先由已有作答估计智能体能力，再挑选信息量最大的任务或合成新任务。在 353 个任务、六种编程语言、151 个 CWE 类型上评估 9 个前沿模型与两种 agent harness，成功率峰值仅 28.33%，且相比随机与 one-shot 基线在能力估计相当的前提下最多少做 29.5% 的任务。
Motivation: 静态安全基准覆盖与难度固定，漏洞仓库稀缺、专家出题成本高，难以随模型演进持续更新，无法持续揭示编码智能体在漏洞识别与修复上的能力缺口。
Method: SecProbe 框架用 IRT 从观测表现估计 agent 能力，并定位哪些任务能提供最多信息，据此在已有任务与按需合成的仓库级漏洞修复任务之间选择；评估覆盖 6 种编程语言、151 个 CWE 类型，用 2 种 agent harness 测试 9 个前沿模型。
Result: 构建 353 个任务，覆盖 6 种编程语言与 151 个 CWE 类型，评估 9 个前沿模型与 2 种 agent harness；成功率峰值 28.33%。与随机和 one-shot 基线相比，能力估计相当，但所需解答任务数最多减少 29.5%。
Conclusion: 自适应评估是衡量编码智能体漏洞感知能力的高效且有区分度的途径，当前前沿模型在漏洞识别与修复上仍存在明显缺口。

papers.title: EfficientAgent: What Makes KV Cache Offloading Work for Concurrent Agents?
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents resend their whole conversation on every turn, and most of it was already processed on the previous turn. Serving systems avoid recomputing it by caching its key-value (KV) state and, when GPU memory runs out, by offloading that state to host memory. For agents, offloading gives inconsistent results: on the same coding-agent workload it speeds up one deployment, slows down another, and changes nothing on a third, even where loading a token back is several times cheaper than recomputing it. The reason is that cached state must survive until it is used again. While one agent waits for its tool, the server processes the contexts of all other agents, so an agent's prefix is reused only if the host tier holds the reusable context of the whole agent pool, which we call the reuse working set. A smaller tier keeps writing state that is evicted before anyone reads it. We present EfficientAgent, which sizes and manages the host tier by this working set. A stack-distance model estimates the working set from agent histories to size the host tier; its predictions, made before the experiments, located the capacity at which offloading starts to pay. When the tier is too small, a runtime policy stops writing large refills of evicted context and keeps extending prefixes that are still cached; when the tier is large enough, it writes everything. On SWE-bench Verified coding agents, a host tier sized to the estimated working set cuts recomputed prompt tokens by 93% and end-to-end time by 39%. With a small fixed tier, the policy cuts recomputation by 35%; with a large tier, it avoids the 4.3-fold increase caused by always filtering writes. Across three GPU types and two models, offloading pays off when the GPU has little compute per byte of host bandwidth and the host tier holds the working set. Code is available at https://github.com/KunmingSHAO/efficientagent_release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EfficientAgent 用 reuse working set（整个 agent 池的可复用上下文）来决定 KV cache 主机层的容量与写入策略：stack-distance 模型从 agent 历史估计工作集，层太小时运行时策略停止写入将被淘汰的大块 refill、继续扩展仍在缓存中的前缀。在 SWE-bench Verified 编码 agent 上，按估计工作集定容的主机层把重算 prompt token 砍掉 93%、端到端时间降 39%。
Motivation: LLM agent 每轮重发整段对话，KV cache offloading 在同一编码负载上有时加速、有时减速、有时无效，因为缓存状态必须活到再次被使用，而现有定容方式没有考虑整个 agent 池的复用工作集。
Method: 提出 EfficientAgent：用 stack-distance 模型从 agent 历史估计 reuse working set 并据此给主机层定容（预测在实验之前给出）；配套运行时策略在层过小时停止写入被淘汰上下文的大块 refill、只继续扩展仍被缓存的前缀，层足够大时全部写入。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 编码 agent 上，按估计工作集定容的主机层使重算 prompt token 减少 93%、端到端时间减少 39%；小固定层下该策略把重算量降 35%；大层下它避免了始终过滤写入带来的 4.3 倍增长。跨三种 GPU 与两种模型，当 GPU 每字节主机带宽的算力少且主机层容纳工作集时 offloading 才划算。
Conclusion: KV cache offloading 的成败由主机层能否装下整个 agent 池的复用工作集决定，定容与写入策略都应围绕该工作集而非单 agent 前缀设计。

summary_sections.method: 提出 EfficientAgent：用 stack-distance 模型从 agent 历史估计 reuse working set 并据此给主机层定容（预测在实验之前给出）；配套运行时策略在层过小时停止写入被淘汰上下文的大块 refill、只继续扩展仍被缓存的前缀，层足够大时全部写入。
summary_sections.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 编码 agent 上，按估计工作集定容的主机层使重算 prompt token 减少 93%、端到端时间减少 39%；小固定层下该策略把重算量降 35%；大层下它避免了始终过滤写入带来的 4.3 倍增长。跨三种 GPU 与两种模型，当 GPU 每字节主机带宽的算力少且主机层容纳工作集时 offloading 才划算。
summary_sections.conclusion: KV cache offloading 的成败由主机层能否装下整个 agent 池的复用工作集决定，定容与写入策略都应围绕该工作集而非单 agent 前缀设计。

papers.title: StatD2GAN: When Calibration Masks Generator Quality in Held-Out Evaluation of Synthetic Weather Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for multivariate weather series are routinely evaluated with pooled distributional metrics computed after marginal calibration. We show this practice can invalidate architectural conclusions, and rebuild the evaluation of StatD2GAN, a three-discriminator GAN with evolutionary weight adaptation, around a held-out protocol: the final two calendar years of each dataset are held out behind a 168 hour embargo, calibration is fitted on the training block only, and all metrics are computed on the held-out block. Evidence comes from 25 matched (location, seed) pairs across five Koppen-Geiger climates, tested with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests under Holm correction. Four results follow. First, isotonic calibration drives the Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance to within 2% of a per-location noise-and-shift floor for every architecture tested, including a deliberately weak RCGAN baseline, so calibrated marginal metrics cannot discriminate between architectures. Second, the sorted-representation discriminator is the only component whose removal significantly degrades cross-variable dependence (Kendall tau MAE +0.080, Holm p = 0.009), with a regime-dependent effect: near zero in Ankara, above 115% in Dubai and Yakutsk. A rank-transformed variant isolates the mechanism as quantile supervision of the marginals rather than copula matching. Third, physical constraint violations are injected by calibration, not the generator; projection removes them at negligible cost (deltaKS <= 0.003). Fourth, pooled metrics conceal a collapse of between-sequence weekly-mean variability, a proxy for seasonal and regime diversity, in TimeGAN that only sequence-level statistics expose. We recommend floor-referenced marginal evaluation, matched-pair testing, and sequence-level variance decomposition as minimum requirements for calibrated generative pipelines.
papers.comment: Submitted to Neurocomputing (Elsevier). Derived from the first author's Master's thesis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StatD2GAN（三个判别器 + 进化权重自适应的 GAN）在边际校准后用汇总分布指标评测，会把架构差异抹平：isotonic 校准把所有架构的 KS 距离压到噪声-平移下限的 2% 以内，连故意做弱的 RCGAN 也不例外。作者改用留出协议（每个数据集最后两个日历年留出、168 小时 embargo、校准只在训练块拟合），据此判定 sorted-representation 判别器是唯一显著影响跨变量依赖的组件，并建议以“下限参照的边际评测 + 配对检验 + 序列级方差分解”作为校准生成管线的最低评测要求。
Motivation: 多变量天气序列的生成模型普遍先做边际校准再算汇总分布指标，这种做法可能让架构结论失效——校准本身就能把弱模型和强模型的边际指标拉到同一水平，掩盖真实的组件贡献与序列级多样性。
Method: 评测协议：每个数据集最后两个日历年作为留出块，前置 168 小时 embargo，isotonic 校准只在训练块上拟合，全部指标在留出块计算；证据来自 5 个 Koppen-Geiger 气候下 25 组匹配的 (location, seed) 对，用 Wilcoxon signed-rank 检验加 Holm 校正。被评测对象 StatD2GAN 含三个判别器（其中之一为 sorted-representation discriminator）与进化权重自适应，并用 rank-transformed 变体区分机制、用投影 (projection) 处理物理约束。
Result: isotonic 校准使所有受测架构（含弱基线 RCGAN）的 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 距离落到各位置噪声-平移下限的 2% 以内，校准后边际指标无法区分架构。移除 sorted-representation 判别器是唯一显著劣化跨变量依赖的改动：Kendall tau MAE +0.080，Holm 校正 p = 0.009，且效应随气候而变——Ankara 接近 0，Dubai 与 Yakutsk 高于 115%。物理约束违反由校准注入而非生成器产生，投影以可忽略代价消除（deltaKS ≤ 0.003）。汇总指标掩盖了 TimeGAN 序列间周均值多样性（季节与天气型多样性的代理）的坍缩，只有序列级统计能暴露。
Conclusion: 校准生成天气序列的评测必须以“下限参照的边际指标 + 匹配对检验 + 序列级方差分解”为最低要求，否则边际校准会掩盖架构差异、组件贡献与序列级多样性坍缩。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Oracle-Efficient Online Classification with Stochastic Inputs and Adversarial Outputs
papers.abstract_en: We consider contextual binary prediction with i.i.d. contexts from an unknown distribution and adaptively chosen losses. We show that a simple Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader algorithm with Gaussian perturbation for each observed context achieves the optimal $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\log N})$ expected regret for a class of $N$ experts, while requiring one optimization-oracle call per round and no explicit enumeration of the class. For an infinite hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, the algorithm attains $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H)})$ regret. This resolves an open problem posed by Lazaric and Munos (2012), showing that hybrid classification is computationally as easy as statistical learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线上下文二分类中，对每个观测到的 i.i.d. 上下文加高斯扰动的 Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader 算法，在自适应损失下对 N 个专家达到最优 ~O(√(T log N)) 期望后悔，每轮只调用一次优化 oracle 且不显式枚举专家类；对无限假设类 H 达到 ~O(√(T·VC(H)))，说明混合分类在计算上与统计学习同样容易。
Motivation: Lazaric 与 Munos (2012) 留下的开放问题：上下文随机、损失对抗的在线分类能否既达到统计最优后悔，又只依赖优化 oracle 而不枚举整个专家类。
Method: Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FPL) 变体：上下文服从未知分布的 i.i.d. 采样，损失由对手自适应选定；对每个观测上下文注入高斯扰动，每轮仅调用一次优化 oracle，无需显式枚举专家类。
Result: 对 N 个专家达到最优 ~O(√(T log N)) 期望后悔，每轮一次 oracle 调用；对无限假设类 H 达到 ~O(√(T·VC(H)))。
Conclusion: 混合分类 (hybrid classification) 在计算难度上与统计学习等价，从而解决 Lazaric 与 Munos (2012) 的开放问题。

papers.title: Positions Are Not Facts: The Mismatch Between KV Caches and Memory
papers.abstract_en: When a fact changes, how should a language model update the history stored in its key-value (KV) cache? Hiding the old record is cheap, but it may still contain needed details or answer questions about the past. We compare hiding whole records, hiding only replaced values, and deleting old text and recomputing the cache. In a controlled quantity task, masking makes all eight models prefer the new value more strongly, yet six lose complete answers through unit errors or failure to stop; keeping the unit preserves all current answers. Later states also retain useful information from earlier records: on multi-hop updates, rebuilding these states at unchanged positions lowers historical accuracy by 20-41 percentage points, whereas moving the existing states has little effect. Keeping object dependencies and unchanged revision passages prevents many losses. Recognition is a separate challenge. Learned readouts recover distinctions missed by fixed cache similarities on synthetic record pairs. On natural text, text-detector-selected masks show no clear advantage over random masks at the same rate in 14 same-model detector-generator comparisons. Query-dependent access can avoid some losses, with additional storage or access costs. These findings identify what must be preserved beyond the replaced value when using a KV cache as updatable memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 KV cache 当可更新记忆时，遮蔽旧记录会让 8 个模型更倾向新值，但其中 6 个因单位错误或不停止而丢失完整答案；保留单位即可保住全部当前答案。多跳更新中在原位置重建状态使历史准确率下降 20–41 个百分点，而移动已有状态几乎无影响，说明必须保留被替换值之外的对象依赖与未改动修订段落。
Motivation: 事实变化后语言模型如何更新 KV cache 中的历史没有定论：隐藏旧记录代价低，但旧记录可能仍含回答过去问题所需的细节，需要弄清哪些信息必须保留。
Method: 在受控数量任务上对比三种策略——整条记录遮蔽、仅遮蔽被替换值、删除旧文本并重算 cache——覆盖 8 个模型；另用多跳更新考察原位置重建与状态移动，并用学习式读出 (learned readouts) 与固定 cache 相似度在合成记录对上比较识别能力，自然文本上做 14 组同模型 detector-generator 对比。
Result: 遮蔽使 8 个模型都更强偏好新值，但 6 个因单位错误或不停止丢失完整答案，保留单位则保住全部当前答案；多跳更新中原位置重建状态使历史准确率下降 20–41 个百分点，移动已有状态影响很小；自然文本上按 text-detector 选掩码与同速率随机掩码在 14 组同模型对比中无明显优势。
Conclusion: KV cache 作为可更新记忆时，必须在被替换值之外保留对象依赖与未改动的修订段落；识别是独立难题，查询相关访问可避免部分损失但要付出额外存储或访问开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ENet-GP: Unified Document Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Reliable document digitization in uncontrolled capture settings is challenging because real images exhibit multiple interacting degradations rather than a single isolated distortion. Documents thus captured are affected simultaneously by geometric distortions, like page warping, as well as photometric degradations such as non-uniform illumination, and blurring. However, most existing approaches address these factors independently and are evaluated on benchmarks containing only one distortion type, limiting their real-world applicability. We introduce GutenDoc, a large-scale dataset of high-resolution dense-text documents with physically grounded compound degradations. Using physics-based rendering, our dataset jointly models geometric warping and diverse photometric effects, enabling systematic evaluation under realistic capture conditions. We further propose a unified restoration framework that jointly corrects geometric and photometric distortions within a single-network and single-training setup, without the need for degradation-specific retraining or sequential inference passes. Extensive experiments show that our method remains competitive on established single-distortion benchmarks while substantially improving robustness under compound degradations, providing a practical solution for real-world document digitization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ENet-GP 提出单一网络、单次训练的统一文档图像修复框架，同时校正页面翘曲等几何形变与非均匀光照、模糊等光度退化，无需按退化类型重训或分步推理。配套发布大规模高分辨率密集文本数据集 GutenDoc，用物理渲染联合建模几何与光度复合退化；实验显示该方法在既有单一退化基准上保持竞争力，同时在复合退化下显著提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 真实拍摄文档同时受几何形变与光度退化叠加影响，而现有方法逐项独立处理、评测基准也只含单一退化类型，实际可用性受限。
Method: 构建 GutenDoc：高分辨率密集文本文档、基于物理渲染 (physics-based rendering) 联合生成几何翘曲与多种光度效应；提出统一修复框架，在单网络、单次训练中同时处理几何与光度失真，不做退化特定重训或顺序多遍推理。
Result: 在既有单一退化基准上保持竞争力 (remains competitive)，并在复合退化条件下大幅改善鲁棒性；数据集为大规模高分辨率密集文本、含物理依据的复合退化。
Conclusion: 几何与光度修复放进一个网络一次训练即可兼顾单退化基准与真实复合退化，真实文档数字化不必按退化类型分模型分阶段处理。

papers.title: YuE2: Unifying Symbolic and Audio Music Generation at Frontier Quality
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. In comparisons using the same checkpoint, experts prefer symbolic planning for overall quality and musicality, with 49.3% of overall preferences versus 34.6% without planning. Experts also favor the unified model over a separate language model and diffusion Transformer. On WildSongBench, YuE2 scores 6.73 on SongBench Global Avg, exceeding all evaluated public baselines. Selecting from eight candidates (best-of-8), YuE2 reaches 6.96, the highest observed mean among all evaluated systems. Expert listening further establishes its competitiveness with proprietary song generators, favoring best-of-8 over Suno v4.5 and yielding nearly balanced preferences against Suno v5. To learn this generation process from recordings without aligned scores, we introduce MERT2 and SheetSage2 to supply semantic and symbolic supervision. MERT2 sets a new state of the art in music representation learning, surpassing previous best results on 14 of 15 MARBLE metrics; SheetSage2 leads 12 of 15 benchmark-metric pairs in our lead-sheet transcription comparison. The same checkpoint follows score edits while largely preserving unedited musical content and generates zero-shot covers without cover-specific training. Its readable score also enables agentic music editing, with external language models translating user feedback into revisions of the composition.

papers.title: Transformer-based Neural Beamforming for Real-Time Speech Enhancement on Smart Low-Power Hearable Devices
papers.abstract_en: Accurate, efficient, and low-latency spatial beamforming is a key component in emerging smart hearable devices, enhancing speech while suppressing noise and interference. However, handling multiple input sources under strict real-time constraints poses significant challenges for the low-power, resource-constrained microcontroller units (MCUs) used in hearables. We present an optimized methodology for the real-time execution of a neural-network-based minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamformer on MCUs. Using six microphones and a three-stage mixed-precision scheme (float32 MVDR, int8 CNN, float16 Transformer), the pipeline pairs a CNN that estimates the MVDR weights with a lightweight Transformer that applies a per-frame correction. By time-slicing weight estimation with beamforming, it achieves a 15~ms per-frame latency while refreshing a complete set of CNN-derived weights every 564~ms. The deployed mixed-precision pipeline attains a short-time objective intelligibility (STOI) of 97.65\%, a scale-invariant signal-to-noise ratio (SI-SNR) of 20.26~dB, and a wideband PESQ of 3.676 at an average power of 45.9~mW. A speech activity detection (SAD) module (98.5\% accuracy, 0.62~mJ per inference) bypasses the pipeline during silence; under realistic deployment conditions, the system exceeds the 16~h all-day target on a 100~mAh battery, with an estimated lifetime of up to $\sim$20~h. To our knowledge, this is the first real-time multi-channel Transformer-based neural beamforming pipeline deployed on an MCU-class device.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在低功耗 MCU 上实现实时多通道神经 MVDR 波束成形：CNN 估计 MVDR 权重、轻量 Transformer 做逐帧校正，用时间切片把权重估计与波束成形错开，实现 15 ms 每帧延迟且每 564 ms 刷新一次完整 CNN 权重。混合精度流水线（float32 MVDR、int8 CNN、float16 Transformer）在 45.9 mW 平均功耗下达到 STOI 97.65%、SI-SNR 20.26 dB、宽带 PESQ 3.676，配合 SAD 静音旁路后 100 mAh 电池续航约 20 小时，超过 16 小时全天目标。
Motivation: 助听类可穿戴设备要在严格实时约束下用 MCU 同时处理多路麦克风输入做空间滤波，而 MCU 算力与功耗预算极低，神经网络波束成形难以在该平台上实时运行。
Method: 六麦克风输入，CNN 估计 MVDR 权重，轻量 Transformer 提供逐帧校正；三阶段混合精度方案为 float32 MVDR、int8 CNN、float16 Transformer。通过时间切片 (time-slicing) 把权重估计与波束成形错开执行，并加入语音活动检测 (SAD) 模块在静音时旁路整条流水线。
Result: 每帧延迟 15 ms，完整 CNN 权重每 564 ms 刷新一次；STOI 97.65%，SI-SNR 20.26 dB，宽带 PESQ 3.676，平均功耗 45.9 mW。SAD 模块准确率 98.5%、每次推理 0.62 mJ；在 100 mAh 电池上估计续航约 20 小时，超过 16 小时全天目标。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个部署在 MCU 级设备上的实时多通道 Transformer 神经波束成形流水线，说明混合精度加时间切片可在低功耗助听设备上同时满足实时性与全天续航。

papers.title: Collaborative Synthetic Data for Privacy-Preserving Financial Fraud Detection Across Organizational Silos
papers.abstract_en: Organizations seek analytical value from AI, yet relevant data are often fragmented across organizations and constrained by privacy. This is acute in financial fraud detection, where rare fraud cases and imbalanced local datasets limit decision-relevant analytics. Federated learning enables collaboration without direct data sharing but does not resolve minority-class scarcity. Synthetic data generation can help, yet lightweight methods are interpolation-bound, while generative models require substantial data and computation. Existing collaborative generative approaches often rely on federated learning, imposing considerable organization-side training burdens. In this paper, we examine CollaFuse as a collaborative diffusion-based alternative for fraud detection and evaluate it across five fraud datasets. Compared with classical oversampling, local generative baselines, and centralized diffusion benchmarks, CollaFuse does not achieve the highest local fidelity but improves downstream fraud detection more consistently across most datasets. These findings suggest that synthetic data create analytical value less through local realism than through transferable cross-organizational structure.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the International Conference on Information Systems (ICIS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CollaFuse：跨组织协作的扩散模型合成数据方案，用于隐私约束下少数类稀缺的金融欺诈检测，不直接共享数据也不做联邦式组织侧训练。在五个欺诈数据集上对比经典过采样、本地生成基线与集中式 diffusion 基准，其局部保真度并非最高，但在多数数据集上更一致地提升下游欺诈检测效果。
Motivation: 欺诈样本稀少且各组织本地数据不平衡，联邦学习能免于共享数据却解决不了少数类稀缺；现有协作生成方法又依赖联邦训练，给组织侧带来沉重训练负担。
Method: CollaFuse 以协作式 diffusion 生成合成数据，绕开联邦学习的组织侧训练开销；在五个欺诈数据集上与经典过采样、本地生成基线及集中式 diffusion 基准对比，考察局部保真度与下游欺诈检测两类指标。
Result: 在五个欺诈数据集上，CollaFuse 相对经典过采样、本地生成基线与集中式 diffusion 基准，未取得最高局部保真度，但在多数数据集上更一致地改善下游欺诈检测表现。
Conclusion: 合成数据的价值主要来自可迁移的跨组织结构，而非局部真实感；协作式 diffusion 可作为联邦生成的轻量替代用于跨组织欺诈检测。

papers.title: ResDiffFRG: Residual Diffusion for Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: In dyadic human speaker-listener conversations, the listener's facial reactions allows the speaker to accurately perceive the listener's emotional states. Since human facial reactions are non-deterministic, the ability to generate multiple appropriate human-like facial reactions is crucial for realistic human-agent interactions. Although diffusion models are naturally suited to such one-to-many generation, existing diffusion-based Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation (MAFRG) methods attempt to denoise random Gaussian initialisations directly into multiple appropriate facial reactions (AFRs). These random initialisations are usually not well-aligned with the target listener facial reaction, which requires complex denoising trajectories from these initialisations, and subsequently creates substantial opportunities for deviations away from the range of trajectories leading to appropriate AFRs. Given the inherent mimicry between the human listener's and speaker's facial behaviours, we address the above denoising trajectory issue by leveraging this strong prior. Specifically, we propose ResDiffFRG, a novel diffusion-based MAFRG framework that explicitly anchors the diffusion process to the speaker behaviour by defining its diffusion target as the residual between the speaker anchor and an AFR. The denoiser only needs to model the comparatively small, reaction-specific residual needed to transform this anchor into an AFR, rather than reconstructing the complete reaction from an unstructured state. Extensive experiments show that ResDiffFRG achieves large improvements in correlation-based appropriateness over existing methods. Our denoising trajectory analysis showed that even at the start of the denoising trajectory, ResDiffFRG already achieves a higher facial-reaction correlation score than the Gaussian Diffusion baseline does after completing 60% of its denoising trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResDiffFRG 把扩散目标从随机高斯初始化改为「说话人行为锚点与目标听者反应之间的残差」，让去噪器只建模把锚点变成合适面部反应 (AFR) 的小残差，而非从无结构状态重建完整反应。实验显示其基于相关性的合适度 (appropriateness) 大幅超过现有 MAFRG 方法：去噪轨迹起点的相关分数就已高于 Gaussian Diffusion 基线跑完 60% 轨迹后的分数。
Motivation: 现有扩散式 MAFRG 直接从与目标听者反应不对齐的随机高斯初始化去噪，轨迹复杂、易偏离通往合适 AFR 的路径，导致一对多生成的合适度下降。
Method: 利用听者与说话人面部行为之间的模仿先验，把扩散目标定义为说话人锚点与 AFR 之间的残差，去噪器只建模该反应特定残差；框架名为 ResDiffFRG，并对去噪轨迹做分析。
Result: 在相关性 appropriateness 指标上相对现有方法取得大幅提升；去噪轨迹分析显示，ResDiffFRG 在轨迹起点的相关分数已高于 Gaussian Diffusion 基线完成 60% 去噪轨迹后的分数。
Conclusion: 把说话人行为作为扩散锚点、只学残差，可以显著缩短并稳定通往合适面部反应的去噪路径，从而提升一对多面部反应生成的合适度。

papers.title: Task-Aware Discretization of Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable logic gate networks (DLGNs) enable gradient-based training of highly efficient Boolean networks by relaxing discrete logic gates during training and discretizing them for inference. Standard approaches make this discretization decision locally, typically through argmax selection and confidence- or entropy-based convergence criteria. We show that local discretization can be task-suboptimal even for globally optimal relaxed solutions, with high gate confidence providing no general guarantee, and derive bounds relating task-aware gate selection to tractable interventions in the relaxed network. Motivated by these results, we study first-order downstream task information for progressive discretization and characterize when this local approximation is reliable. Experiments on convolutional DLGNs reveal a strong locality dependence: first-order scores become unreliable when directly optimized over nonlocal interventions, but accurately assess local argmax decisions for progressive freezing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 可微逻辑门网络 (DLGN) 的离散化若只按门自身的 argmax 与置信度/熵判据局部决定，即使松弛解全局最优也可能任务次优，高门置信度并不保证任务表现。作者推导了任务感知门选择与松弛网络中可处理干预之间的界，并给出一阶下游任务信息用于渐进冻结的适用条件：一阶分数在直接优化非局部干预时不可靠，但对局部 argmax 决策的渐进冻结能准确评估。
Motivation: DLGN 推理时必须把松弛门离散化，现有做法是纯局部的 argmax 加置信度/熵收敛判据；作者证明这种局部决策即使在全局最优松弛解上也可能是任务次优的，且高置信度不构成任务最优的保证。
Method: 先证明局部离散化的任务次优性并推导任务感知门选择与松弛网络中可处理干预的界；再研究用于渐进离散化 (progressive discretization) 的一阶下游任务信息，刻画该局部近似何时可靠；实验对象是卷积型 DLGN (convolutional DLGNs)。
Result: 实验显示强局部依赖性：一阶分数在直接针对非局部干预优化时变得不可靠，而在评估局部 argmax 决策的渐进冻结 (progressive freezing) 时能准确评估。
Conclusion: 任务感知的离散化应限定在局部干预上做渐进冻结，把一阶分数用于非局部干预会失效；门置信度本身不能作为离散化时机的判据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PQ-HSA: Reusing Product-Quantized Scores for Hybrid Sparse-Approximate Attention
papers.abstract_en: At each decoding step a language model attends over the key-value (KV) cache of every earlier token, so at long context the attention call is bounded by memory bandwidth. Sparse attention reads only a subset of keys chosen by a cheap score estimate, and most methods give the unread tokens zero weight. The output then draws on only a small fraction of the KV cache, and accuracy drops at small budgets, most on tasks that aggregate information across the context. An inverted-file product-quantization (IVF-PQ) index over the cached keys computes an approximate score for every indexed token in order to rank them; after ranking, those scores approximate the attention logits of the tokens left out. PQ-HSA (hybrid sparse-approximate attention) attends the selected tokens with their original keys and values, and the unselected tokens, the background, enter the same softmax through those scores, summed per inverted list and multiplied by the list's mean value. At 128K and a 1-2% retrieval budget, PQ-HSA is more accurate than Quest and SnapKV on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B and stays close to full attention in macro accuracy; with the same selector, the background term raises macro accuracy on the 8B model from 0.71 to 0.83. In the same 128K setting, inside vLLM on one NVIDIA H20, the decode attention call runs 1.6x faster than the FlashAttention-3 kernel; the speedup grows with context length, and a cost model fitted on 8B to 30B models gives the context length at which it begins. A vLLM plugin runs PQ-HSA on two engine versions without changes to the engine source; code is available at https://github.com/KunmingSHAO/pqhsa_release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PQ-HSA 用 IVF-PQ 索引对 KV cache 全部 key 打近似分数并排序，选中 token 走原始 key-value，未选中的 background 用这些分数按倒排表求和、乘以表均值后并入同一个 softmax。128K 上下文、1–2% 检索预算下，在 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上比 Quest 和 SnapKV 更准且接近 full attention；同一选择器下 background 项把 8B 模型 macro accuracy 从 0.71 提到 0.83。
Motivation: 长上下文解码时 attention 受内存带宽限制，稀疏 attention 只读少量 key 并把未读 token 权重置零，导致输出只依赖极小一部分 KV cache，在小预算下精度下降，跨上下文聚合信息的任务掉得最狠。

papers.title: Multi-Marginal Inverse Optimal Transport for Contrastive Learning Via Explicit Anchor-Positive-Negative Coupling
papers.abstract_en: Inverse Optimal Transport (OT) based methods for representation learning learn representations such that the global OT coupling between a pair of data marginals in the representation space, concentrates on the positive pairs. This is in contrast to previous methods that primarily focused on pairwise matching. However, these methods $\textit{DO NOT}$ utilize negative pairs and hence are not truly contrastive in their approach. We show that this leads to issues of dimensional collapse and hence degraded downstream performance. To alleviate this, we develop a novel multi-marginal (MM) inverse OT (IOT) contrastive learning (CL) approach called Neg-MMIOT-CL, which learns representations such that the global multi-marginal OT (MMOT) coupling between a triple of data marginals, with respect to a carefully designed ground-cost between triplets of data points in the representation space, concentrates on the anchor-positive-negative $\textit{triplets}$. For a latent class model, we empirically show that Neg-MMIOT-CL alleviates dimensional collapse. Furthermore, for a specific choice of ground cost for all triplets in representation space, we prove that the optimal representation configuration for Neg-MMIOT-CL exhibits equiangular property for within-class and across-class representations, which translates to Neural-Collapse when the representation dimension is larger than the number of classes minus one -- a result that is $\textit{previously established only}$ for pairwise contrastive learning methods. Finally, we propose Neg-IOT-CL-PushPull, that is a computationally efficient alternative to Neg-MMIOT-CL, alleviating the high cost of computing MMOT plans needed during implementation. We apply these methods on both synthetic and real-world datasets and show significant improvements over existing OT-based contrastive learning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有 inverse optimal transport 对比学习只让全局 OT 耦合集中在正样本对上、完全不用负对，导致维度坍缩 (dimensional collapse)。作者提出 Neg-MMIOT-CL：在三个边缘分布之间用精心设计的 triplet ground cost 让 multi-marginal OT 耦合集中在 anchor-positive-negative 三元组上，实证缓解维度坍缩，并给出高效替代 Neg-IOT-CL-PushPull，在合成与真实数据集上显著优于已有 OT 对比学习方法。
Motivation: 基于 inverse OT 的表征学习只做正对匹配、不使用负对，因而并非真正对比式，会引发维度坍缩并损害下游性能。
Method: 提出 Neg-MMIOT-CL：在三个数据边缘分布之间学习表征，使关于表征空间中三元组 ground cost 的全局 multi-marginal OT (MMOT) 耦合集中于 anchor-positive-negative 三元组；另提出计算上更高效的 Neg-IOT-CL-PushPull，规避实现中计算 MMOT plan 的高开销。
Result: 在 latent class model 上实证表明 Neg-MMIOT-CL 缓解维度坍缩；对所有三元组取特定 ground cost 时，证明其最优表征构型在类内与类间均具 equiangular 性质，当表征维度大于类别数减一时转化为 Neural Collapse（此前仅对成对对比学习方法建立）；在合成与真实数据集上相对已有 OT 对比学习方法有显著提升。
Conclusion: 把负样本以三元组形式纳入 multi-marginal OT 耦合，可让 inverse OT 对比学习真正对比化并缓解维度坍缩，同时把成对方法的 Neural Collapse 结果推广到该框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weighted Spline-Expanded Networks with Distributional Balancing for Continuous Treatment Effects
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects with continuous treatments in observational studies is challenging due to confounding, model misspecification, and high-dimensional covariates. We propose the Weighted Spline-Expanded Network (WSENet), an end-to-end neural framework that addresses these challenges by combining covariate balancing, structured treatment embedding, and bias-corrected outcome estimation. WSENet first applies Distance Covariate Optimal Weights to induce distributional independence between covariates and treatment without relying on parametric models. It then learns the conditional outcome via a structured network that fuses outcome-relevant representations of covariates with a spline-expanded treatment input, enabling smooth and flexible modeling of the dose-response relationship. To mitigate residual bias, we introduce Weighted Targeted Regularization, a correction technique based on efficient influence functions that yields a doubly robust estimator. Extensive evaluations on semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, including high-dimensional genomic and environmental health data, demonstrate that WSENet consistently outperforms existing baselines in both accuracy and stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出连续处理效应估计框架 WSENet：先用 Distance Covariate Optimal Weights 让协变量与处理分布独立（不依赖参数模型），再用样条展开的处理输入与协变量表征融合建模剂量-响应，最后用基于 efficient influence function 的 Weighted Targeted Regularization 做偏差校正，得到双重稳健估计。在半合成与真实数据（高维基因组、环境健康）上，其准确性和稳定性一致优于现有基线。
Motivation: 观察性研究中连续处理的因果效应估计受混杂、模型误设与高维协变量三重困扰，常规结果建模难以同时保证协变量平衡与剂量-响应的灵活估计。
Method: WSENet 是端到端神经框架，含三部分：Distance Covariate Optimal Weights 非参数地诱导协变量与处理的分布独立；结构化网络融合协变量的结果相关表征与样条展开 (spline-expanded) 的处理输入；Weighted Targeted Regularization 基于 efficient influence function 校正残余偏差，构成双重稳健 (doubly robust) 估计。
Result: 在半合成与真实数据集上的评测覆盖高维基因组与环境健康数据，WSENet 在准确性和稳定性两方面均持续优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 把协变量平衡、样条处理嵌入与基于影响函数的靶向正则放进一个端到端网络，可以在连续处理效应估计中同时改善精度与稳定性。

papers.title: Constrained Edit Fields for Training-Free Flow Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided image editing aims to perform a desired edit while preserving source content unrelated to it. Pretrained rectified-flow models enable training-free editing of real images through modifications to their sampling trajectories. However, responses at locations unrelated to the desired edit can still accumulate along the editing trajectory and become visible in the final result. To overcome this, we propose Constrained Edit Fields (CEF), which assigns each spatial location a continuous edit responsibility that quantifies its relevance to the desired edit. CEF estimates edit responsibility directly from the source image when the relevant content is present. For edits whose target content is absent from the source, CEF first generates an unconstrained proposal to reveal its realized spatial support and then estimates responsibility from that proposal. At each editing step, CEF decomposes the base edit field into prompt-induced and trajectory-induced components, enabling edit responsibility to preserve instruction-relevant updates while suppressing unintended trajectory-induced changes. Evaluated on all 700 PIE-Bench examples, CEF achieves state-of-the-art Structure Distance, background LPIPS, and background MSE with both Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and FLUX, while retaining competitive instruction alignment. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, it reduces these metrics over the previous best results by 10.2%, 21.2%, and 48.0%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CEF 为免训练的 rectified-flow 图像编辑给每个空间位置分配连续的编辑责任 (edit responsibility)，把基础编辑场拆成 prompt 诱导与轨迹诱导分量，从而保留指令相关更新、抑制与编辑无关区域的漂移。在 PIE-Bench 全部 700 个样例上，用 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 时 Structure Distance、background LPIPS、background MSE 相对先前最好结果分别下降 10.2%、21.2%、48.0%。
Motivation: 免训练的 rectified-flow 编辑中，与目标编辑无关位置上的响应会沿采样轨迹累积并显现在最终结果里，破坏源内容保持。
Method: CEF 给每个空间位置分配连续编辑责任：源图中已含相关内容时直接从源图估计；目标内容在源图缺失时先生成一个不受约束的 proposal 以暴露其实际空间支撑，再据此估计。每步编辑把基础编辑场分解为 prompt-induced 与 trajectory-induced 两个分量，用责任图保留指令相关更新、压制轨迹引入的改动。
Result: 在 PIE-Bench 全部 700 个样例上，CEF 以 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 和 FLUX 两种骨干均取得最优的 Structure Distance、background LPIPS 与 background MSE，同时保持有竞争力的指令对齐；在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上这三项指标相对此前最好结果分别降低 10.2%、21.2%、48.0%。
Conclusion: 把编辑责任显式建模为逐位置连续量并分解编辑场来源，可以在免训练图像编辑中同时压低背景漂移并保住指令对齐。

papers.title: HTN Planning as a Coordination Layer for Multi-Server MCP Tool Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) isolates servers by design: only the host can orchestrate cross-server workflows. When the host is a large language model, the resulting orchestrations are non-deterministic, non-reproducible, and pay one inference round-trip per tool call. We present a coordination architecture in which a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planner generates a verifiable cross-server plan once, and a runtime middleware executes it deterministically across multiple MCP servers, binding cross-action data dependencies via a template mechanism (\verb|${context.X}|) substituted at execution time. The architecture mirrors MCP's isolation constraint: each compound task decomposes into server-local primitive actions, and inter-server data flow is bound at execution time via JSON-path output extractors. We instantiate the architecture on five HTN domains spanning laboratory robotics, bioinformatics and multiscale modelling, and demonstrate end-to-end execution from a browser-based plan controller against eight live third-party MCP servers querying real biological databases.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the ICAPS 2026 Workshop on Hierarchical Planning (HPlan 2026), Dublin. Non-archival. Code: https://github.com/PCfVW/hplan26-artifact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 HTN 规划器一次性生成可验证的跨 MCP 服务器计划，再由运行时中间件确定性执行，跨动作数据依赖用 ${context.X} 模板与 JSON-path 输出提取器在执行期绑定。该架构在五个 HTN 域上实例化，并从浏览器端计划控制器对八个真实第三方 MCP 服务器完成端到端执行，查询真实生物数据库。
Motivation: MCP 按设计隔离各服务器，跨服务器编排只能由宿主完成；当宿主是 LLM 时编排不确定、不可复现，且每次工具调用都要付一次推理往返。
Method: HTN 规划器先生成一次可验证的跨服务器计划，运行时中间件确定性执行；每个复合任务分解为服务器本地的原语动作，跨服务器数据流用 ${context.X} 模板机制与 JSON-path 输出提取器在执行期绑定，镜像 MCP 的隔离约束。
Result: 在实验室机器人、生物信息学与多尺度建模五个 HTN 域上实例化该架构，并从基于浏览器的计划控制器对八个在线第三方 MCP 服务器执行端到端流程，查询真实生物数据库。
Conclusion: 把跨服务器编排从 LLM 宿主移到 HTN 规划加确定性中间件，可在保持 MCP 隔离约束的同时获得可验证、可复现的执行。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: HTN 规划器先生成一次可验证的跨服务器计划，运行时中间件确定性执行；每个复合任务分解为服务器本地的原语动作，跨服务器数据流用 ${context.X} 模板机制与 JSON-path 输出提取器在执行期绑定，镜像 MCP 的隔离约束。
summary_sections.result: 在实验室机器人、生物信息学与多尺度建模五个 HTN 域上实例化该架构，并从基于浏览器的计划控制器对八个在线第三方 MCP 服务器执行端到端流程，查询真实生物数据库。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把跨服务器编排从 LLM 宿主移到 HTN 规划加确定性中间件，可在保持 MCP 隔离约束的同时获得可验证、可复现的执行。

papers.title: ALDER: Discovering the Laws of a World by Acting in It
papers.abstract_en: Reliable world models should not only predict future states but express how actions change the world in an explicit, transparent and testable form, such as equations. Yet methods that rely on a fixed set of trajectories cannot distinguish equally good competing hypotheses, while searches over a fixed set of predefined candidates cannot discover equations outside the initial hypothesis space. We introduce ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision), a method that actively proposes novel experiments to test and revise models. Specifically, ALDER proposes parametric equations; a numerical optimizer fits their coefficients; an independent verifier tests these candidates on held-out data. To distinguish between competing valid hypotheses, a cost- and safety-aware selector queries interventions, in the form of novel experiments. The resulting counterexamples update the evidence ledger and guide the next structural revision, while incompatible laws are discarded. Across an in-house benchmark, ODE equation discovery tasks, and robotic experiments, ALDER discovers laws beyond its initial formula set, repairs failed model proposals, distinguishes fixed candidate models with fewer interactions, and improves out-of-distribution prediction. Furthermore, given a current state and a target, ALDER selects control actions by solving the inverse problem defined by its validated world model. Together, these results show that explicit equation-based world models can be tested and revised through interaction, then naturally used to guide goal-directed control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALDER 通过主动设计实验来发现、检验并修正以显式方程表示的世界模型：提出参数化方程、数值优化拟合系数、独立验证器在留出数据上测试，再由考虑成本与安全的选择器查询干预实验，用反例更新证据台账并驱动结构修正。在内部基准、ODE 方程发现任务与机器人实验中，它能发现初始公式集之外的方程、修复失败的模型提案、用更少交互区分固定候选模型并改善分布外预测。
Motivation: 依赖固定轨迹集的方法无法区分同样拟合良好的竞争假设，而在固定预定义候选集上搜索则无法发现初始假设空间之外的方程。
Method: ALDER (Action-guided Law Discovery, Evaluation, and Revision) 循环执行：提出参数化方程，用数值优化拟合系数，独立验证器在留出数据上检验候选；成本与安全感知的选择器查询干预形式的新实验来区分竞争假设，反例写入证据台账并指导下一次结构修正，不相容的定律被丢弃；给定当前状态与目标时，再由已验证的世界模型求解逆问题选择控制动作。
Result: 在内部基准、ODE 方程发现任务和机器人实验上，ALDER 发现了超出其初始公式集的方程，修复了失败的模型提案，用更少交互区分了固定的候选模型，并改善了分布外 (out-of-distribution) 预测；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 显式基于方程的世界模型可以通过与环境交互来检验与修正，并自然地用于引导目标导向控制。

papers.title: A Statistical Perspective on Knowledge Distillation: Foundations, Classical Methods, and Large Language Model Extensions
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Distillation (KD) has emerged as a vital paradigm for transferring the capabilities of high-capacity models to efficient ``student'' counterparts, addressing critical challenges in computational cost, deployment constraints, and privacy-sensitive settings. Although KD is widely used in practice, it is often viewed primarily as an engineering technique, with a unified statistical perspective remaining less developed. This review bridges that gap by presenting a unified Bayesian formulation of KD that formulates teacher predictions as prior information. This provides a principled interpretation of how teacher information is incorporated into student learning and establishes a rigorous connection to uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate how this foundational lens reconciles classical distillation with modern extensions in generative and foundation-model systems, showing that contemporary developments remain rooted in these same statistical principles. By synthesizing theory with emerging methodologies and diverse applications, this review provides a conceptual roadmap and identifies critical open problems for the future of the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述把知识蒸馏 (KD) 统一成贝叶斯框架：教师预测作为学生学习的先验信息，从而给出教师信息如何进入学生训练的原则性解释，并把经典蒸馏与生成式、基础模型扩展连到同一套不确定性量化原理。全文为理论综述，未报告实验数字。
Motivation: KD 在实践中被当作工程技巧，缺少统一的统计视角，教师信息注入学生学习的原理与不确定性量化之间的联系未被系统建立。
Method: 提出 KD 的统一贝叶斯表述，将教师预测建模为先验；以此解释经典蒸馏方法，并推广到生成式模型与基础模型（LLM）场景下的现代扩展，综合理论、方法与应用给出路线图。
Result: 综述给出统一贝叶斯形式化，建立教师先验与不确定性量化之间的严格联系，并论证生成式与基础模型时代的 KD 扩展仍遵循同一统计原理；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: KD 应被理解为以教师预测为先验的贝叶斯学习问题，现代 LLM 蒸馏扩展是这一统计原理的延续；作者据此指出该领域的关键开放问题。
