papers.title: Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexEvo 在推理时只用单个目标构象，把跨构象适配写成几何约束的双目标优化（保留输入态相互作用 vs. 承受构象扰动），用几何导出的 FlexBoxes 划定受保护锚点区、可探索区与禁区，并以 Pareto 选择保留非支配候选。在九类 binder、多个生成基线上，类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从 47.8% 降到 4.4%，每样本仅增加 1.4–3.1 分钟适配开销。
Motivation: 蛋白构象是系综，而基于结构的分子设计通常只对单一目标构象优化，候选在另一构象下会丢失有利相互作用或产生位阻冲突。
Method: 模型无关的进化框架 FlexEvo：推理时从单目标构象一次性适配，不重训源模型、不需要构象系综；几何约束的双目标优化平衡输入态相互作用保持与对合理构象扰动的稳健性；几何导出的 FlexBoxes 定义受保护锚点区、可适配局部探索区与避免冲突的禁区；统一全原子表示支持跨 binder 类别的拓扑保持适配，Pareto 选择保留两目标上的非支配候选。
Result: 在多个生成基线与九类代表性 binder（覆盖不同分子尺寸与结构拓扑）上，类别均衡的平均相对性能退化从 47.8% 降至 4.4%，每样本适配开销仅增加 1.4–3.1 分钟。
Conclusion: 单状态推理时适配是跨蛋白构象景观做稳健生物分子复合物设计的可行路径，无需构象系综或重训源模型。

papers.title: Reliable Replay through Spatial Coherence in Online Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continually adapting models to new tasks requires retaining earlier knowledge under limited memory and computation. Experience replay addresses this challenge, but priorities based on individual loss increases overlook how related memories respond to the same update and can overemphasize isolated responses. We introduce SPatial coHErent risk control for REplay (SPHERE), a general replay-allocation method applicable across a broad range of learning settings. SPHERE uses a representation kernel to aggregate signed prospective loss changes, attenuating unsupported spikes while retaining coherent increases. It then formulates allocation as entropy-regularized transport, redistributing uniform source mass toward supported high-risk regions while penalizing long-distance transfers. We derive replay coefficients from the transport objective's sensitivity to the original loss changes and blend them with uniform replay to maintain baseline rehearsal. Our analysis establishes conditions under which kernel aggregation improves risk estimation and bounds transport-value inflation due to residual noise and smoothing bias. Experiments demonstrate that SPHERE improves accuracy and reduces forgetting across noisy-label vision tasks, continual language-model instruction tuning, and code-generation reinforcement learning with incomplete test rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPHERE 把经验回放的优先级从单样本损失上升改为表示核聚合的有符号预期损失变化，再用熵正则化最优传输分配回放系数并与均匀回放混合。它在含噪标签视觉任务、持续指令微调与奖励不完整的代码生成强化学习三类设置上同时提高准确率并降低遗忘。
Motivation: 基于单个损失上升的回放优先级忽略相关记忆对同一次更新的共同响应，容易放大孤立的损失尖峰，导致在有限内存与算力下早期知识保留不可靠。
Method: SPHERE 用表示核 (representation kernel) 聚合有符号的预期损失变化，抑制无支撑的尖峰而保留一致的上升；随后把回放分配写成熵正则化传输问题，将均匀源质量推向高风险区域并惩罚长距离转移，再由传输目标对原始损失变化的敏感度导出回放系数，与均匀回放混合以保留基线排练。
Result: 在含噪标签视觉任务、持续语言模型指令微调、以及测试奖励不完整的代码生成强化学习三类实验中，SPHERE 提高准确率并减少遗忘；理论上给出核聚合改善风险估计的条件，以及残余噪声与平滑偏差导致的传输值膨胀上界。
Conclusion: 把回放优先级建立在跨相关记忆的一致风险信号（核聚合 + 传输分配）上，比按单样本损失尖峰排序更能兼顾风险估计质量与基线排练，且可跨多种学习设置通用。

papers.title: GeoShrink: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Two Lines of Code
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers incur substantial inference cost through repeated model evaluations along a sampling trajectory. We introduce GeoShrink, a training-free acceleration method that retains the original solver grid while evaluating the model only at a prescribed set of anchors. At skipped stages, GeoShrink predicts the solver-facing output by adding a geometrically retained fraction of the latest observed innovation to the most recent exact output. We derive this rule from chordal tangent transport and round-trip line projection, and establish a geometric anchor-spacing principle that minimizes the largest adjacent gap expansion under fixed coverage and first span. The analysis characterizes the geometric closure and propagation of prediction errors without assuming access to future model outputs. Experiments cover image, video, motion, and audio generation, together with adapted 3D backends. At approximately $5\times$ acceleration, GeoShrink improves FLUX PSNR by 3.10 dB over the strongest listed baseline. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a reported $4.99\times$ speedup and improves ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR by 5.44 dB over the strongest listed fidelity baseline. Comparisons at fixed evaluation budgets further show substantial gains on motion, audio, music, and 3D generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoShrink 是一种免训练的 diffusion transformer 加速方法：保留原求解器网格，只在指定 anchor 处跑模型，跳过的步用「最近一次精确输出 + 最近观测 innovation 的几何保留比例」直接外推预测输出。在约 5× 加速下，FLUX PSNR 比最强基线高 3.10 dB；HunyuanVideo 上报告 4.99× 加速，ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR 比最强保真基线高 5.44 dB。
Motivation: Diffusion transformer 沿采样轨迹需要反复调用模型，推理开销大；已有跳步/蒸馏方案往往需要重训或改变求解网格，缺少在固定网格上只靠几何外推的免训练加速规则。
Method: 免训练：保留原 solver grid，仅在 prescribed anchors 上评估模型；跳过步的 solver-facing 输出由最近一次精确输出加上最近一次观测 innovation 的几何保留分数得到。规则由 chordal tangent transport 与 round-trip line projection 推出，并给出在固定覆盖与首段跨度下最小化最大相邻 anchor 间隙扩张的 anchor 间距原则；误差分析刻画预测误差的几何闭合与传播，且不假设能访问未来模型输出。
Result: 约 5× 加速时 FLUX PSNR 比最强列出基线提升 3.10 dB；HunyuanVideo 上报告 4.99× 加速，ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR 比最强保真基线提升 5.44 dB；固定评估预算下的对比在 motion、audio、music 与 3D 生成上也有明显增益，实验覆盖 image、video、motion、audio 生成及改造的 3D 后端。
Conclusion: 在固定求解网格上按几何 anchor 间距做 innovation 外推，可以在不重训的情况下同时拿到数倍加速与更高保真度，误差传播可在不访问未来输出的前提下做几何刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BOReFT: Manifold Steering of Language Models for Black-box Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly used as proposal models for black-box search, from program optimization to molecular design. Existing approaches typically improve proposals through iterative prompting or parameter updates, offering limited control over how completely and efficiently the model's search space is explored. Continuous optimization methods, such as Bayesian optimization, provide a principled way to search but require a suitable domain to operate over. To address this, we introduce BOReFT, which learns a compact, low-dimensional space of hidden-state interventions in a frozen language model, and uses this space as the search domain for Bayesian optimization with an external scoring function. Empirically, we find that the learned domain spans semantic regions and exhibits smoothness properties that support search. Theoretically, we show that semantic coverage and interpolation control the best score available in the learned space, and that decoding from this space yields a standard stochastic-bandit observation model for adaptive search. We evaluate BOReFT on the interpretable word search task "Semantle" and on three more real-world discovery tasks in de novo molecule property optimization. Compared to strong LLM baselines, BOReFT finds in Semantle a higher number of hidden targets and, on two out of three molecular objectives, achieves higher property scores. Consequently, our method provides a principled new bridge between discrete proposal spaces of LLM-based search and continuous black-box optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BOReFT 在冻结语言模型上学出一维低维的隐状态干预空间，把它当作贝叶斯优化的连续搜索域，配合外部打分函数做黑盒搜索。在 Semantle 上找到更多隐藏目标词，在三个分子目标中的两个上取得更高属性分数。
Motivation: LLM 作为黑盒搜索的提议模型时，迭代提示或参数更新难以控制搜索空间被探索的完整度与效率，而贝叶斯优化等连续方法需要一个合适的定义域。
Method: 在冻结 LLM 中学习紧凑的隐状态干预低维流形，将该空间作为贝叶斯优化的搜索域，配合外部打分函数；理论上证明语义覆盖与插值控制该空间可达的最优分数，且从该空间解码给出标准随机 bandit 观测模型。
Result: 在 Semantle 上相比强 LLM 基线找到更多隐藏目标；在 de novo 分子性质优化的三个目标中的两个上取得更高属性分数。
Conclusion: 学习到的隐状态干预域具有支撑搜索的语义覆盖与平滑性，为 LLM 离散提议空间与连续黑盒优化之间提供了有原理的桥接。

papers.title: From Granular Revision Operations to Meaningful Revision Units: Evaluating LLMs for Revision Boundary Detection
papers.abstract_en: Revision traces provide valuable evidence about students' writing processes, but their usefulness for learning analytics depends on how individual revisions are represented. Automated draft-comparison methods often produce granular edit operations that can fragment a single purposeful revision into multiple analytic units. This study evaluates whether LLMs can identify meaningful revision unit boundaries in structured revision operation data and whether they provide value beyond simple non-LLM baselines. Using 113 matched draft--revision pairs from undergraduate writing, expert annotation yielded 4,344 candidate boundaries. We compared zero- and few-shot GPT-5.5 and base Qwen3-32B, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B, and majority and proximity-based baselines. Despite receiving revision context and task instructions, no prompted LLM condition outperformed the proximity heuristic (macro-F1 = .825). In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-32B using the two context representation achieved the highest macro-F1 (.859), identifying more same-unit relationships while maintaining precision comparable to the heuristic. Deterministic post-processing substantially improved the prompted models but added little benefit to the strongest fine-tuned model. These findings suggest that LLMs can support revision boundary judgment when task-adapted, but general purpose prompting alone may not outperform transparent structural heuristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 113 组本科生写作的配对草稿与修订、专家标注的 4,344 个候选边界，评测 LLM 能否判定有意义的修订单元边界。零样本/少样本 GPT-5.5 与 Qwen3-32B 均未超过 proximity heuristic（macro-F1 = .825），而微调后的 Qwen3-32B（two context representation）达到 .859；结论是任务适配的微调才有效，通用提示本身不敌透明的结构启发式。
Motivation: 草稿比对产生的细粒度编辑操作会把一次有目的的修订拆成多个分析单元，使修订轨迹对学习分析的可用性受损；需要判断 LLM 能否恢复有意义的修订单元边界，以及是否比简单非 LLM 基线更有价值。
Method: 在 113 组配对草稿—修订上由专家标注得到 4,344 个候选边界；对比零样本与少样本 GPT-5.5、base Qwen3-32B、参数高效微调 (parameter-efficient fine-tuning) 的 Qwen3-32B，以及 majority 与 proximity-based 两个基线，并测试确定性后处理。
Result: 所有提示式 LLM 条件均未超过 proximity heuristic，macro-F1 = .825；微调 Qwen3-32B（two context representation）取得最高 macro-F1 = .859，在保持与启发式相当的 precision 的同时识别出更多 same-unit 关系；确定性后处理显著改善提示式模型，但对最强微调模型增益很小。
Conclusion: 任务适配（微调）后的 LLM 可以支撑修订边界判定，而仅靠通用提示无法超越透明的结构启发式。

papers.title: Self-Designed Evaluators and Warm Memory for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: A tool-using language-model agent deployed over a long stream of tasks receives no reward, so it cannot tell whether it succeeded, cannot safely retry, and cannot label the experience it needs to improve. We present SelfSuite, in which the agent's own base model, given only the world's public materials, designs a small evaluation suite of weighted judges and grounded per-task briefs, freezes it, and uses it to gate a keep-best retry and to label a typed, outcome-tracked memory. On matched five-repeat benchmarks over tau2-bench and AppWorld, SelfSuite scores above the plain agent without any labels, matches methods given ten expert labels on tau2-bench, and trails Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) on AppWorld, where code execution gives a direct success signal. In an ablation campaign run on the same tasks, it is above label-free ACE in every repeat, and the gated second attempt is the only component whose removal hurts in every repeat. We also simulate a subject-matter expert who grades ten onboarding tasks per world. Using those labels to calibrate SelfSuite's evaluator gives a small, consistent gain, and using them to warm up ACE's memory lifts ACE to tie calibrated SelfSuite. A single-run study on a second model family shows the same ordering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelfSuite 让工具调用 agent 用自身基座模型、仅凭公开材料自设计一套加权 judge 与逐任务 brief，冻结后用于门控 keep-best 重试并给带类型、带结果追踪的记忆打标签。在 tau2-bench 与 AppWorld 的五次重复对照中，它无标签即超过普通 agent，在 tau2-bench 上追平使用十条专家标签的方法，在 AppWorld 上落后于 ACE；消融显示门控第二次尝试是唯一在每次重复中移除都会变差的组件。
Motivation: 长任务流上部署的工具调用 agent 拿不到奖励信号，既无法判断成败、无法安全重试，也无法为自我改进标注经验。
Method: SelfSuite：由 agent 自己的基座模型基于世界公开材料设计小型评测套件（加权 judges + grounded per-task briefs），冻结后作为 keep-best 重试的门控，并为带类型、结果可追踪的记忆生成标签；另模拟一位每世界批改十个入门任务的领域专家，用其标签校准 evaluator 或预热 ACE 记忆。
Result: 在 tau2-bench 与 AppWorld 上做 matched five-repeat 对照：SelfSuite 无标签即高于 plain agent，在 tau2-bench 上与使用十条专家标签的方法持平，在 AppWorld（有代码执行直接成功信号）上落后于 ACE；同任务消融中它每次重复都高于 label-free ACE，gated second attempt 是唯一每次移除都变差的组件；十条标签校准带来小幅一致增益，用同样标签预热 ACE 记忆后 ACE 与校准后的 SelfSuite 打平；第二个模型家族的单次运行给出相同排序。
Conclusion: 自设计评测器加门控重试能在无标签条件下支撑长程 agent 的自我改进，其中门控第二次尝试是稳定起作用的关键组件；少量专家标签对 ACE 记忆的预热收益更大，可追平校准后的 SelfSuite。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Diffusion Fine-Tuning for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) improves cross-domain transfer by generating target-specific synthetic data for downstream adaptation. Existing methods are largely designed for single-target adaptation: when a model trained on one labeled source domain must be adapted to multiple unlabeled target domains, they typically require separate diffusion fine-tuning for each source--target pair, causing training, storage, and deployment costs to grow with the number of targets. In this paper, we study multi-target data generation for diffusion-based UDA, where a single source-guided diffusion fine-tuning process is reused to generate target-specific synthetic data for multiple target domains. We propose MUSE (Multi-target UDA-oriented Synthesis with Efficient diffusion fine-tuning), a decoupled adaptation framework that separates source-supervised semantic adaptation from target-specific style adaptation. MUSE uses a shared semantic branch updated by labeled source data and target-private style branches specialized to individual target domains, enabling target-specific generation while avoiding repeated source-guided fine-tuning for each target. Experiments on standard UDA benchmarks show that MUSE achieves a stronger accuracy--efficiency trade-off than repeated per-target diffusion adaptation, reducing diffusion fine-tuning cost while improving average target-domain accuracy. The project page is available at https://xuanqi99.github.io/MUSE/.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MUSE 把多目标域的 diffusion-based UDA 拆成语义与风格两支：共享语义分支只用有标签源域更新，各目标域私有风格分支单独适配，从而一次源引导的 diffusion fine-tuning 就能为多个无标签目标域生成各自的合成数据。在标准 UDA 基准上，它相对逐对重复微调取得更强的精度-效率权衡，既降低微调开销又提高目标域平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有 diffusion-based UDA 基本只面向单目标：一个有标签源域要适配到多个无标签目标域时，必须对每个源-目标对单独做 diffusion fine-tuning，训练、存储与部署开销随目标域数量增长。
Method: 提出 MUSE（Multi-target UDA-oriented Synthesis with Efficient diffusion fine-tuning），一个解耦适配框架：共享语义分支由有标签源数据更新，目标域私有的风格分支各自专门化，实现目标特定生成而无需对每个目标重复源引导微调；生成的合成数据用于下游适配。
Result: 在标准 UDA 基准上，MUSE 相对逐目标重复 diffusion 适配取得更强的 accuracy-efficiency 权衡：降低 diffusion fine-tuning 成本的同时提高目标域平均准确率。
Conclusion: 把源监督的语义适配与目标特定的风格适配分开，一次源引导微调即可服务多个目标域，是多目标 diffusion UDA 中更省成本的组织方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Theory Guided and Interpretable Neural Operator Design for Partial Differential Equation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate numerical solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) are crucial in numerous science and engineering applications. In this work, we introduce a novel neural PDE solver named AFDONet, which incorporates neural operator learning and adaptive Fourier decomposition (AFD) theory for the first time into a specifically designed variational autoencoder (VAE) structure, to solve a general class of nonlinear PDEs on smooth manifolds. AFDONet is the first neural PDE solver whose architectural and component design is fully guided by an established mathematical framework (in this case, AFD theory), turning neural operator design from an art to a science. Thus, AFDONet also exhibits exceptional mathematical explainability and groundness, and enjoys several desired properties. Furthermore, AFDONet achieves outstanding solution accuracy and competitive computational efficiency in several benchmark problems. In particular, thanks to its deep connections with AFD theory, AFDONet shows superior performance in solving PDEs on i) arbitrary (Riemannian) manifolds, and ii) datasets with sharp gradients. Overall, this work presents a new paradigm for designing explainable neural operator frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出神经 PDE 求解器 AFDONet，首次把神经算子学习与自适应 Fourier 分解 (AFD) 理论嵌入专门设计的变分自编码器 (VAE) 结构，用于在光滑流形上求解一般非线性 PDE。架构与组件设计完全由 AFD 数学框架引导，在若干基准问题上取得高求解精度与有竞争力的计算效率，尤其在任意 Riemann 流形上的 PDE 与含陡峭梯度的数据集上表现更优。
Motivation: 神经算子的架构设计长期依赖经验试错，缺乏可解释性与数学依据；同时光滑流形上的 PDE 与含陡峭梯度的数据对现有求解器构成明显困难。
Method: AFDONet 将 AFD 理论与神经算子学习结合进一个专门设计的 VAE 结构，架构和组件选择由 AFD 这一既有数学框架推导给出，用于在光滑流形上求解一般非线性 PDE。
Result: 在若干基准问题上达到突出的求解精度与有竞争力的计算效率；相对优势集中在两类设置：任意 (Riemannian) 流形上的 PDE，以及含陡峭梯度的数据集。

papers.title: BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to specialized domains requires learning domain-specific decision criteria, which often hinge on subtle visual distinctions between otherwise plausible answers. Rationale augmentation aims to expose such evidence through additional observations or inter-sample comparisons, yet a visually valid cue is not necessarily decision-relevant: it may describe how samples differ without changing the model's relative preference between competing answers. We therefore introduce BIRD, a self-improving Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation framework that uses model-specific confusions to locate unresolved local decision boundaries and distills the evidence that resolves these confusions into rationales. For each sample, BIRD retrieves candidate neighbors from the target MLLM's own representation space and selects the most confusable one according to its answer preferences. It then generates answer-blind candidate evidence from their visual differences and functionally verifies which evidence most effectively strengthens the model's preference for the correct answer while avoiding inappropriate transfer across the pair. The verified evidence is then distilled into a single-sample rationale for standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on medical and chart VQA show that BIRD outperforms competing rationale-augmentation methods across two target MLLMs, while further analyses demonstrate clearer separation of confusable answers and stronger gains from model-matched supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BIRD 用目标 MLLM 自身表征空间里最易混淆的近邻样本定位未解决的局部决策边界，把能真正强化正确答案偏好的视觉证据蒸馏成单样本 rationale，再做标准监督微调。在医疗与图表 VQA 上、对两个目标 MLLM 均优于竞争的 rationale 增强方法，混淆答案分离更清晰。
Motivation: MLLM 领域适配需要学习依赖细微视觉差别的决策标准，而现有 rationale 增强给出的视觉线索可能只描述样本差异、并不改变模型对竞争答案的相对偏好，即视觉有效不等于决策相关。
Method: BIRD（Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation，自改进框架）：从目标 MLLM 自身表征空间检索候选近邻，按其答案偏好选出最可混淆的一个；基于视觉差异生成 answer-blind 候选证据，功能性验证哪条证据最能强化正确答案偏好且避免跨样本不当迁移；验证后的证据蒸馏为单样本 rationale，用于标准监督微调 (SFT)。
Result: 在医疗 VQA 与图表 VQA 上，BIRD 在两个目标 MLLM 上均超过竞争的 rationale 增强方法；进一步分析显示混淆答案分离更清晰，且模型匹配的监督带来更强增益。
Conclusion: 决策相关的 rationale 应由模型自身的混淆边界来定位并经功能性验证，而非仅凭视觉差异，这样蒸馏出的监督对 MLLM 领域适配更有效。

papers.title: DuoOPD: Learning from Joint Teacher-Student Outcomes for Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own responses with token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, yet the teacher can fail on questions the student already answers correctly, and how often each model succeeds varies across tasks. OPD ignores these outcomes and, on average, pushes down even the student's correct responses; gating feedback by student correctness fixes the direction but uses the teacher in the same way whether or not it succeeded. We introduce DuoOPD, in which the student's outcome sets the direction of feedback and the joint teacher-student outcome decides how the teacher supports it: when only the teacher succeeds, its verified answer becomes context for scoring the student's failed response, and when only the student succeeds, a weight shared within the task reinforces the whole response. A single rule covers all four outcome combinations without task-specific settings. Across Qwen3 and Llama, DuoOPD outperforms all five baselines in mean macro accuracy, improving over OPD by 2.58 and 5.98 percentage points, and it also leads on two further task mixtures spanning scientific calculation, instruction following, and code generation. Ablations show that outcome-based direction alone stays near the gated baseline, while the joint-outcome designs supply most of the gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoOPD 用师生联合结果决定 on-policy distillation 的反馈方向与强度：学生结果定方向，联合结果定教师如何支撑——仅教师答对时把其验证答案作为上下文给学生错误回答打分，仅学生答对时用任务内共享权重强化整段回答，一条规则覆盖四种结果组合。在 Qwen3 与 Llama 上平均 macro accuracy 超全部五个基线，较 OPD 提升 2.58 与 5.98 个百分点。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 中教师会在学生已答对的题上出错，且各模型成功率随任务变化；OPD 忽略这些结果，平均而言会压低学生本来正确的回答，而按学生正确性门控虽修正方向却仍以同样方式使用教师。
Method: DuoOPD 以学生结果设定反馈方向，以师生联合结果决定教师支撑方式：仅教师成功时其验证答案作为上下文用于给学生失败回答打分，仅学生成功时用任务内共享权重强化整段回答；单一规则覆盖四种结果组合，无需按任务设置。
Result: 在 Qwen3 与 Llama 上平均 macro accuracy 超过全部五个基线，较 OPD 分别提升 2.58 与 5.98 个百分点；在涵盖科学计算、指令遵循与代码生成的另外两个任务混合上同样领先。消融显示仅基于结果的方向与门控基线相当，联合结果设计贡献了大部分增益。
Conclusion: 把教师的可用性按联合结果而非固定方式调度，才能让 on-policy distillation 在多任务上稳定获益；增益主要来自联合结果设计而非方向修正本身。

papers.title: A Spectral Theory of Compositional Learning
papers.abstract_en: How does compositional reasoning emerge during learning? We address this question by mathematically analyzing the learning dynamics of deep linear networks. We train these networks in structured synthetic environments and derive a theory linking the structure of experience to compositional learning. Our theory predicts when compositional inferences emerge, whether they are identifiable from the available evidence, and how new linking evidence can rapidly unlock previously unavailable inferences. These results provide a qualitative explanation for several phenomena observed in human cognition. They account for why a composition can fail despite knowing its premises, why similar compositions can emerge at different times, and how a single linking fact can suddenly enable many new inferences. Taken together, these findings establish a mathematical link between the statistical structure of experience and the development of compositional reasoning.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, and 2 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对深度线性网络的学习动力学做数学分析，建立经验结构与组合推理 (compositional reasoning) 出现之间的谱理论联系，预测组合推断何时出现、是否可辨识，以及新的 linking evidence 如何迅速解锁此前不可用的推断。
Motivation: 组合推理如何在学习过程中涌现缺少数学刻画：为何已知前提仍会组合失败、相似组合为何在不同时刻出现、单条 linking fact 为何能突然开启大量新推断。
Method: 在结构化合成环境中训练深度线性网络，对其学习动力学做数学推导，得到把经验结构与组合学习联系起来的理论，用于预测推断的出现时机、可辨识性与解锁效应。
Result: 给出定性理论结果：预测组合推断的出现条件、在现有证据下的可辨识性，以及新 linking evidence 快速解锁先前不可得推断的机制；论文含 22 页、9 图、2 表。
Conclusion: 经验的统计结构与组合推理的发展之间存在数学联系，该理论为人类认知中若干组合现象提供定性解释。

papers.title: Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多视角 VLA 上直接做对抗训练 (adversarial training) 只改善第三人称视角相关的 Camera Viewpoint 与 Sensor Noise 两个偏移轴，却把策略压到 wrist view 主导，形成 view collapse：表面鲁棒来自少用被扰动的视角，而非更鲁棒的感知。加入简单的 View Swap 干预后再做 AT，可进一步改善 Camera Viewpoint、Sensor Noise 与 Robot Initial State，其余偏移轴效果仍不一。
Motivation: VLA 在分布内表现强但部署偏移下退化；对抗训练能否带来跨视角的自然分布偏移泛化此前不清楚，且可能把跨视角依赖误当成鲁棒感知。
Method: 用由预训练 VLM 直接改造的多视角 VLA，在 LIBERO-Plus 的七个偏移轴上评估 Direct AT；用受控视角干预诊断跨视角依赖，再引入 View Swap 干预降低固定视角依赖后重测 AT。
Result: Direct AT 显著改善 Camera Viewpoint 与 Sensor Noise（仅影响第三人称视角的两个偏移），其余偏移效果混杂或为负；View Swap 后 AT 进一步改善 Camera Viewpoint、Sensor Noise 与 Robot Initial State，其他偏移仍不一。
Conclusion: 多视角鲁棒性必须把视角内感知改善与跨视角依赖变化分开，AT 提供的是选择性的而非通用的分布偏移收益。

papers.title: Non-Adaptive Learning of Sparse Erdős--Rényi Graphs via Affine Splitting
papers.abstract_en: Graph learning from edge-detecting queries concerns the reconstruction of an unknown edge set on a known vertex set. Each query reports whether a specified vertex subset contains at least one edge. We study non-adaptive schemes, in which all queries are fixed before any outcomes are observed, with the goal of achieving exact recovery using few queries and fast decoding. For general graphs on $n$ vertices with at most $k$ edges, non-adaptive recovery requires $Ω(\min\{k^2\log n,n^2\})$ queries in the worst case, even when a small error probability is allowed. In this paper, we consider Erdős--Rényi ($\mathrm{ER}$) graphs $G\sim \mathrm{ER}(n,q)$, with expected edge count $\bar{k}=q\binom{n}{2}$. Our scheme uses $O(\bar{k}\log n)$ queries and achieves exact recovery in $O(\bar{k}\log n)$ decoding time with probability tending to one throughout the regime $\bar{k}\to\infty$ and $\bar{k}=o(n^2)$. This improves the previous $O(\bar{k}^{1+δ}\log n)$ decoding guarantee for any fixed $δ>0$, while maintaining the same query order. The guarantee also extends beyond the previously studied regime $\bar{k}=Θ(n^{2θ})$ with fixed $θ\in(0,1)$. Our approach builds on the binary splitting method used in prior work, which organizes vertices into a hierarchy of successively smaller groups. We introduce three main changes: (i) we use random affine hash functions over a finite field to process each candidate pair in constant time; (ii) we apply the splitting procedure directly to the full graph, avoiding the need to combine solutions to multiple smaller graph-learning subproblems; and (iii) we bound the total decoding workload directly rather than deriving separate high-probability bounds on candidate counts at each level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在边检测查询下做非自适应稀疏图重构：对 G~ER(n,q) 用随机仿射哈希 (random affine hash) 处理候选点对，直接在全图上做 binary splitting，并直接界定总解码工作量，以 O(k̄log n) 查询在 O(k̄log n) 时间内以概率趋于 1 实现精确恢复，其中 k̄=q·C(n,2)。这把先前 O(k̄^{1+δ}log n)（δ>0 固定）的解码保证改进到线性于 k̄，且适用范围从 k̄=Θ(n^{2θ})（θ∈(0,1) 固定）扩展到整个 k̄→∞、k̄=o(n²) 区间。
Motivation: 一般图上非自适应精确恢复最坏需 Ω(min{k²log n,n²}) 次查询；已有 ER 图方案的解码时间带 k̄^{1+δ} 额外因子，且只在 k̄=Θ(n^{2θ}) 的固定指数区间成立。
Method: 基于 prior work 的 binary splitting（把顶点组织成逐层缩小的分组层级），作三处改动：用有限域上的随机仿射哈希函数在常数时间内处理每个候选点对；把 splitting 直接作用于完整图，免去合并多个较小图学习子问题解；直接界定总解码工作量，而非对每层候选数分别做高概率界。

papers.title: Understanding Confabulation and Rethinking Reconstruction in Activation Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) produce unsupervised text explanations of a model's activations: a verbalizer describes an activation and a reconstructor learns to recover it from this text. Under the established point-reconstruction NLA training recipe, explanations become more useful for predicting model behavior while also increasingly introducing unsupported details and exhibiting writing defects. To assess these changes separately, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework for unstructured NLA explanations, measuring information recoverable from explanations, contextual support for their claims, and writing quality. To address confabulation and writing defects, we move beyond predicting a single activation: explanations can distinguish distributions of possible activations even when their means and optimal point-reconstruction rewards are identical. We introduce Flow-NLA, which models the distribution of activations compatible with an explanation and trains the verbalizer using a diffusion likelihood bound. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Apertus, this richer signal retains the utility gains of point reconstruction while curbing the growth of confabulation and writing defects, opening up a direction for improving activation-derived training to encourage more informative, supported, and readable explanations. Code and evaluation prompts will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自然语言自编码器 (NLA) 在点重建训练下解释越有用却越添虚构 (confabulation) 与写作缺陷的问题，提出 Flow-NLA：用扩散似然下界建模与解释相容的激活分布，替代预测单一激活。在 Qwen、Gemma、Apertus 上保留点重建的效用增益，同时抑制虚构与写作缺陷的增长。
Motivation: 既定的点重建 NLA 训练配方让解释预测模型行为的能力提升，却同时引入无依据细节和写作缺陷，二者此前无法分开度量。
Method: 先提出非结构化 NLA 解释的标准化评估框架，分别度量解释中可恢复的信息、论断的上下文支撑与写作质量；再提出 Flow-NLA，建模与解释相容的激活分布，并用扩散似然下界 (diffusion likelihood bound) 训练 verbalizer，取代单点重建。
Result: 在 Qwen、Gemma、Apertus 三个模型上，Flow-NLA 保留了点重建带来的效用增益，同时抑制了虚构与写作缺陷的增长；评估框架把信息可恢复性、上下文支撑与写作质量分开度量。
Conclusion: 把激活解释从预测单个激活改为建模激活分布，可以在不牺牲解释效用的前提下压住虚构与写作缺陷，为改进激活衍生训练指出方向。

papers.title: Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained biomedical vision-language models achieve strong zero-shot performance in biomedical image classification. However, downstream biomedical classification often depends on subtle visual differences between classes that may not be fully captured by pretrained representations. Few-shot adaptation addresses this mismatch by optimizing a task-specific predictor on a small labeled support set. Because the selected examples capture only part of the visual variation within the target classes, the adapted predictions can depend strongly on their composition. We propose Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA), which retains the frozen prompt prediction as a support-invariant semantic anchor and incorporates a visual prediction learned from the support set through an anchor-relative residual. The residual step is computed in a closed form from frozen support embeddings using anchor discrepancy and support agreement. Support-set dependence also limits evaluation: comparisons are fair within a shared draw but remain conditional on its composition. To obtain more reliable comparisons, we introduce a repeated-support protocol that separates support-selection variation from optimization randomness and reports both average and worst-20% performance. PARA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot classification and base-to-novel generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA)：把冻结 prompt 的预测当作与支持集无关的语义锚点，用冻结支持集嵌入的闭式残差项补上视觉预测，从而在少样本生物医学图像分类中降低对支持集组成的敏感度。配套提出重复支持集协议，分离支持集选择与优化随机性并报告平均与 worst-20% 性能；PARA 在少样本分类与 base-to-novel 泛化上均达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 预训练生物医学视觉-语言模型的零样本表征未必捕捉类间细微视觉差异，而少样本适配后的预测又强烈依赖所选支持样本的组成，导致不同支持集抽样之间的比较不公平。
Method: PARA 冻结 prompt 预测作为 support-invariant 语义锚点，从冻结支持集嵌入出发用 anchor discrepancy 与 support agreement 闭式求解 anchor-relative 残差，叠加得到最终预测；另提出 repeated-support 协议，把支持集选择变化与优化随机性分开，并同时报告平均与 worst-20% 性能。
Result: PARA 在少样本分类与 base-to-novel 泛化两个设置上均取得 state-of-the-art 表现；评估协议给出平均性能与 worst-20% 性能两类指标。
Conclusion: 以冻结 prompt 预测为锚、闭式残差吸收支持集视觉信息，可以在不微调主干的前提下提升生物医学 VLM 的少样本适配，并让跨支持集抽样的比较更可靠。

papers.title: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications
papers.abstract_en: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.1 contains 385 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec-RTL consistency checking, plus 82 controls (41 distractor, 41 consistent-RTL). Type-4 items are built from real RTL mutations; we retain only mutations that Icarus Verilog simulation shows to change observable behavior. A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt, not training recall alone (without-spec accuracy 3/20 on the t1/t2 subset), though memorization of the source text may still help spot mutations. As an initial characterization with a small model, Ministral-3B scores 33.2% overall (128/385; macro average 39.0%): 55.2% on retrieval, 51.7% on cross-section reasoning. On the two contradiction-focused types, the verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0% (t3) and 63.3% (t4), with a 51.2% false-positive rate on distractors and 100% on consistent-RTL controls. Layered scoring shows the model locates contradictions well (78.9-81.6% location accuracy) but scores lower on their category (43.9-49.7%). A structured "rule-table" prompting intervention lowers accuracy on every question type except t2 (tied). SpecRead is automatically scorable by deterministic checks, with gray-zone cases counted wrong under the conservative main scoring. The benchmark is regenerable for type-3 items via mutation injection, and built exclusively from public sources.
papers.comment: 13 pages. Benchmark data and code at https://github.com/EDGAhab/specread
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecRead 把硬件规格理解与代码生成能力解耦，用 385 道题加 82 道控制题直接测 LLM 是否读懂规格。Ministral-3B 总分仅 33.2%（128/385），且在一致 RTL 控制题上误报率 100%，说明失败可归因于读不懂而非写不出。
Motivation: 现有硬件设计 LLM 基准测的是生成的 RTL、断言或 testbench 等下游产物，模型失败时无法区分是没读懂规格还是没写好代码。
Method: SpecRead v2.1 覆盖 10 个开源 OpenTitan IP，含精确检索、跨章节推理、变异规格中的矛盾检测、spec-RTL 一致性检查四类共 385 题，另加 82 道控制题（41 distractor、41 consistent-RTL）；type-4 由真实 RTL 变异构造，仅保留 Icarus Verilog 仿真确认改变可观测行为的变异。评分用确定性检查，灰区按保守规则计错。
Result: Ministral-3B 总体 33.2%（128/385），宏平均 39.0%；检索 55.2%，跨章节推理 51.7%。矛盾类 verdict-plus-location：t3 48.0%、t4 63.3%，distractor 误报率 51.2%，consistent-RTL 控制题误报率 100%。定位准确率 78.9–81.6%，类别判断仅 43.9–49.7%。去掉规格的消融在 t1/t2 子集上仅 3/20。rule-table 结构化提示除 t2 持平外全部题型下降。
Conclusion: 小模型能定位规格矛盾却判错类别，且在一致 RTL 上几乎全误报，说明硬件规格理解本身是独立瓶颈；rule-table 提示反而有害。

papers.title: One Latent, Many Tokens: Jointly Learning Compressed Embeddings for Efficient Language Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Most continuous diffusion language models process one latent position per token at each sampling step, making generation expensive. Two-stage methods lower the cost by reducing the latent length, but they fix the compressed embedding space before training the diffusion model. Embeddings from the fixed space can be difficult to model with diffusion and decode reliably into tokens, which limits generation quality after compression. To address this problem, we introduce JPEG-DLM (Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model), which jointly trains a compressor, a flow matching model and a decoding module. With joint-embedding prediction, JPEG-DLM learns compressed embeddings that are more structured, easier to model with diffusion and reliably decodable into tokens. JPEG-DLM achieves the lowest mean Gen-PPL and highest throughput among recent diffusion and flow models on LM1B and OWT. At a compression rate of 0.5 on OWT, it reaches a Gen-PPL of 34.52 and approximately 2.3 times ELF's throughput. These results suggest that jointly learning compressed embeddings offers a promising path toward efficient diffusion language modeling. Code will be released soon.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables. Includes appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JPEG-DLM 把压缩器、flow matching 模型与解码模块联合训练，让压缩嵌入本身变得结构化、易被扩散建模且能可靠解回 token，取代先固定压缩空间再训扩散的做法。在 LM1B 与 OWT 上它取得最低 mean Gen-PPL 与最高吞吐；OWT 压缩率 0.5 时 Gen-PPL 为 34.52，吞吐约为 ELF 的 2.3 倍。
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型每个采样步都要在每个 token 位置处理一个 latent，生成代价高；两阶段方法虽缩短 latent 长度，却在训练扩散模型前固定压缩嵌入空间，导致嵌入难建模、难解码，压缩后生成质量受限。
Method: 提出 JPEG-DLM (Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model)，联合训练压缩器、flow matching 模型与解码模块，用 joint-embedding prediction 让压缩嵌入更结构化、更易被扩散建模并可靠解码回 token。
Result: 在 LM1B 与 OWT 上取得最近扩散与 flow 模型中最低 mean Gen-PPL 与最高吞吐；OWT 压缩率 0.5 时 Gen-PPL 34.52，吞吐约为 ELF 的 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 联合学习压缩嵌入是提升扩散语言模型效率与生成质量的可行路径，代码将发布。

papers.title: Geometric Inductive Biases for Semi-Supervised Equalization: The Constellation-Aware Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Decoding signals over unknown channels with minimal pilot overhead is a critical challenge in next-generation communications. Existing deep learning approaches typically rely on generic encoders that struggle to model long-range temporal dependencies or efficiently capture the channel's physical properties from scarce data. We argue that standard architectures suffer from agnostic estimation gaps, as they must implicitly learn the constellation geometry that is already known. We introduce the Constellation-Aware Transformer (CAT), a novel architecture that explicitly injects geometric inductive biases into the equalization process. CAT is composed of a stack of custom TransFIRmer blocks, which use an "early interaction" paradigm to co-process received signals and ideal constellation symbols. Each block features a split Feed-Forward Network that applies a Finite Impulse Response (FIR)-inspired filter for deconvolution and a parallel MLP for geometric refinement. We show that this design is structurally aligned with the optimal linear (MIMO Wiener) receiver: its attention can implement a matched-filter bank, and its bidirectional FIR branch provides the non-causal filtering that block MMSE equalization requires. In the semi-supervised setting, CAT needs fewer pilots than VAE and standard Transformer baselines: on two of our three ISI channels, it reaches a lower SER with 64 pilots than they do with 128.

papers.title: Seeing and Solving Are Not Enough for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) answer visual questions by combining visual information extraction with downstream problem solving. We investigate a fundamental question: Does an incorrect answer necessarily reflect a failure in visual extraction or problem solving? A model may succeed at both abilities when tested separately yet still fail on the original multimodal question, a distinction that overall answer accuracy cannot reveal. To study this, we perform a question-level empirical analysis across multiple VLMs and visual domains. We define an exactly scorable task state (i.e., the visual information sufficient to solve a question) and use it to test whether the same model can extract the required state, solve the question from the ground-truth state, and answer the original multimodal question. We find that composition failures, where extraction and solving both succeed but direct answering fails, account for 17.7% to 75.6% of direct-answering errors across multiple VLMs and datasets. To address this failure mode, we introduce a simple yet effective method, termed State Realization Tuning (SRT). SRT fine-tunes LoRA adapters attached to the language-model layers while keeping the pretrained VLM weights frozen. It trains the model to output the ground-truth task state before the final answer in a single autoregressive response. SRT improves over standard supervised fine-tuning by 1.7 to 14.1 percentage points and repairs 92.5% to 98.1% of diagnosed composition failures. A single LoRA adapter trained with SRT also improves performance across substantially different task-state structures. Our work shows that having both visual extraction and problem-solving capabilities does not guarantee correct multimodal answering. Requiring the model to first output the visual information needed to solve the question can help bridge this gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 答错视觉问题未必是抽取或求解单方面失效：两者分开测都对、直接答却错的 composition failure 占直接作答错误的 17.7%–75.6%。State Realization Tuning (SRT) 用 LoRA 微调语言模型层、冻结预训练权重，要求模型先输出 ground-truth task state 再作答，修复了 92.5%–98.1% 的已诊断 composition failure。
Motivation: 整体答案准确率无法区分错误来自视觉信息抽取还是下游求解；模型可能两项能力单独测试都通过，却在原始多模态问题上失败，这一失败模式此前缺少可判定的刻画。
Method: 在多个 VLM 与视觉域上做 question-level 实证分析，定义可精确打分的 task state（解题所需的视觉信息），分别测试模型能否抽取该状态、能否从 ground-truth 状态求解、能否直接回答原问题；提出 State Realization Tuning (SRT)，在语言模型层挂 LoRA adapter、冻结预训练权重，让模型在单次自回归输出中先给出 ground-truth task state 再给答案。
Result: Composition failure（抽取与求解都成功但直接作答失败）占多个 VLM 与数据集直接作答错误的 17.7%–75.6%；SRT 相对标准监督微调提升 1.7 至 14.1 个百分点，修复已诊断 composition failure 的 92.5%–98.1%；单个 SRT LoRA adapter 在结构差异很大的 task state 上也带来提升。
Conclusion: 同时具备视觉抽取与求解能力并不保证多模态作答正确，让模型先输出解题所需的视觉信息可以弥合这一组合性缺口。

papers.title: Dynamic Kuramoto-Hodge Operators for PDEs on Complex Geometries and Topologies
papers.abstract_en: Learning PDE operators on complex domains requires capturing interactions among fields on vertices, edges, and faces, alongside global responses shaped by topology. Existing neural operators accommodate irregular geometries but often overlook these distinct field supports or their condition-dependent coupling. We introduce the Dynamic Kuramoto--Hodge Operator (DKHO), which combines topology-constrained interactions with learned coordination. DKHO encodes conditions on their native cochain supports, evolves Kuramoto-inspired relation states through the boundary and coboundary operators that compose the Dirac operator, and decodes non-harmonic and harmonic responses in orthogonal Hodge subspaces. Topology thus determines where information can flow, while learned dynamics adapts how it is exchanged to each PDE instance. Across porous-medium Darcy flow, torus transport--diffusion, and cavity magnetostatics, DKHO-large reduces prediction error by approximately 61% on average over leading baselines, while DKHO-small remains competitive using only 11.5--24.3% as many parameters. These results suggest that coupling topological structure with adaptive dynamics provides an effective inductive bias for accurate and parameter-efficient PDE operator learning on complex geometries and topologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dynamic Kuramoto-Hodge Operator (DKHO)，把定义在顶点、边、面上的场按其原生 cochain 支撑编码，用构成 Dirac 算子的 boundary/coboundary 算子演化 Kuramoto 式关系状态，并在正交 Hodge 子空间中解码非调和与调和响应。在多孔介质 Darcy flow、环面 transport–diffusion、cavity magnetostatics 三个任务上，DKHO-large 相对领先基线平均降低约 61% 预测误差，DKHO-small 仅用 11.5–24.3% 参数量仍保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有神经算子能处理不规则几何，却忽略顶点/边/面上不同支撑的场及其随条件变化的耦合，也难以表达拓扑对全局响应的约束。
Method: DKHO 将条件编码在各自原生 cochain 支撑上，通过组成 Dirac 算子的 boundary 与 coboundary 算子演化 Kuramoto 启发的关系状态，并在正交 Hodge 子空间中解码非调和与调和响应：拓扑决定信息可流动的位置，学习到的动力学按每个 PDE 实例调节交换方式。
Result: 在 porous-medium Darcy flow、torus transport–diffusion、cavity magnetostatics 上，DKHO-large 相对领先基线平均降低约 61% 预测误差；DKHO-small 仅用 11.5–24.3% 的参数量仍保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把拓扑结构与自适应动力学耦合，可作为复杂几何与拓扑上精确且参数高效的 PDE 算子学习的有效归纳偏置。

papers.title: TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for predicting high-performance material distributions in topology optimization. Existing methods struggle to accurately capture load-transfer information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization, while their model architectures often incur high computational costs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TopoMamba, a topology prediction framework incorporating a load-support relation-guided multi-directional state-space model. Coupling physical fields with load-support relations enables more effective modeling of mechanical dependencies. A load-support relation-guided spatially adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multi-directional scan features according to spatial conditions. Mamba is coupled with the solid isotropic material with penalty method to enhance structural mechanical performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Results on two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks demonstrate that TopoMamba achieves superior topology prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art models. The proposed load-support physics-guided framework enables efficient optimization of more complex structural systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoMamba 用载荷-支撑关系 (load-support relation) 引导的多方向状态空间模型做拓扑优化预测：把物理场与载荷-支撑关系耦合建模力学依赖，并用空间自适应融合动态调整多方向扫描特征，再与 SIMP 方法结合。在二维拓扑优化基准上，其拓扑预测精度、分布外泛化与计算效率均优于现有最先进模型。
Motivation: 深度学习替代高成本拓扑优化时，现有方法难以准确捕捉载荷传递信息，导致分布外泛化差，且模型架构计算开销大。
Method: 提出 TopoMamba 框架：载荷-支撑关系引导的多方向 state-space model (Mamba)，将物理场与载荷-支撑关系耦合；载荷-支撑关系引导的空间自适应融合机制按空间条件动态调整多方向扫描特征；Mamba 与 SIMP (solid isotropic material with penalty) 方法耦合以兼顾结构力学性能与计算效率。
Result: 在二维拓扑优化基准上，TopoMamba 在拓扑预测精度、分布外泛化和计算效率三方面均优于 state-of-the-art 模型。
Conclusion: 载荷-支撑物理引导的框架可在保持计算效率的同时提升拓扑预测精度与分布外泛化，并可推广到更复杂结构系统的高效优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Resource-Aware Parameter-Efficient Model Adaptation for Onboard High-Dimensional Data
papers.abstract_en: Onboard satellite models often require frequent updates, but the weights adapted to earlier data distributions can quickly become outdated. However, updating large-scale model parameters in orbit presents significant challenges due to the limited uplink bandwidth of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, particularly for hyperspectral satellite imagery, where high-dimensional spectral-spatial inputs lead to increased model size and update costs. Existing full fine-tuning methods are thus expensive to retrain and difficult to deploy under strict communication constraints. To address this challenge, we propose NE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for bandwidth-constrained onboard hyperspectral model updates. NE-LoRA combines a primary low-rank branch with a nonlinear auxiliary branch to capture both global update trends and complex spectral-spatial variations. Additionally, we introduce a differentiated training strategy for multi-matrix adapters, motivated by the asymmetric initialization and gradient dynamics of different adapter matrices. Experiments on four hyperspectral datasets and three representative backbone models demonstrate that NE-LoRA consistently outperforms LoRA-based baselines and remains competitive with, and in several cases superior to, full fine-tuning. Across the evaluated settings, NE-LoRA updates only a small fraction of the total parameters on average while preserving low deployment overhead, offering a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off for onboard hyperspectral adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NE-LoRA 针对 LEO 卫星上行带宽受限的高光谱模型更新，用主低秩分支加非线性辅助分支同时捕捉全局更新趋势与复杂光谱-空间变化，并对多矩阵 adapter 采用差异化训练策略。在四个高光谱数据集、三种 backbone 上，它稳定优于 LoRA 类基线，多处持平甚至超过全量微调，且平均只更新极小一部分参数。
Motivation: 星载模型需随数据分布变化频繁更新，但 LEO 上行带宽有限，高光谱输入维度高使全量微调的重训与传输成本难以承受。
Method: NE-LoRA 是参数高效适配框架：主低秩分支加非线性辅助分支并行建模全局趋势与光谱-空间变化；针对不同 adapter 矩阵初始化与梯度动态的不对称性，设计多矩阵差异化训练策略。
Result: 在四个高光谱数据集和三种代表性 backbone 上，NE-LoRA 一致优于 LoRA 类基线，并在多处持平或优于全量微调；跨所评估设置平均只更新总参数的一小部分，部署开销低。
Conclusion: 在带宽受限的星载高光谱适配场景，NE-LoRA 提供了更优的精度-通信折中，可用极小的参数更新量替代昂贵的全量微调。

papers.title: T-MoXAI: A Hierarchical Explainability Framework for Temporal Multimodal Data
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models for temporal multimodal data have potential in healthcare and agriculture, but their opacity can limit trust and adoption. We introduce T-MoXAI (Temporal Multimodal eXplainable AI), a hierarchical framework explaining (1) when timepoints influence predictions, using temporal Shapley values; (2) which modalities contribute at those moments, using attention analysis; and (3) what features or image regions drive decisions, using gradient based attribution. A transformer based architecture handles irregular temporal sequences and heterogeneous data, generating all three explanation levels in under one second for interactive decision support. We evaluate the framework on two real world tasks: predicting IVF treatment outcomes from ultrasound sequences and clinical measurements (AUC 0.660 despite significant class imbalance), and forecasting wheat yield from temporal RGB imagery and phenotypic traits ($R^2$ 0.265 amid substantial environmental variability). Ablation studies indicate that temporal modelling is critical in both domains: removing it reduces performance to the equivalent of random guessing. Temporal ROAR experiments provide evidence that the explanations reflect the model's reasoning process. With a unified, domain agnostic architecture and open source implementation, T-MoXAI provides a baseline for temporal multimodal XAI, addressing fragmentation in the field and supporting applications where understanding decisions is as important as predictive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-MoXAI 是面向时序多模态数据的分层可解释框架：用 temporal Shapley values 定位哪些时间点影响预测，用 attention 分析定位这些时刻的模态贡献，再用梯度归因定位具体特征或图像区域，三层解释在一秒内生成。在 IVF 超声序列预测（AUC 0.660）与小麦产量预测（R² 0.265）两个真实任务上验证，消融显示去掉时序建模后性能跌到接近随机猜测水平。
Motivation: 时序多模态 AI 模型在医疗与农业中潜力大，但黑箱不透明限制信任与采用；现有可解释方法碎片化，缺少统一、跨域的分层解释框架。
Method: 基于 Transformer 架构处理不规则时序与异构数据，输出三层解释：temporal Shapley values 判定时间点影响、attention 分析判定模态贡献、梯度归因 (gradient based attribution) 定位特征或图像区域；配套消融实验与 temporal ROAR 实验检验解释是否反映模型推理过程。

papers.title: MAD-Guard: Controlled Study of Autoregressive Generation versus Direct Decision Interfaces for Closed Multimodal Forensic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: When should multimodal foundation models generate tokens, and when should they directly output a decision? We present MAD-Guard, a controlled study of output-decision interfaces for closed multimodal forensic tasks. Once a multimodal representation is computed, is autoregressive generation necessary for closed forensic decisions with high input complexity but low output entropy? Under a matched Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, 2,400 FakeClue training samples, and LoRA budget ($r=16, α=32$) on Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, we evaluate a progression of decision interfaces (AR-SFT [generate] $\to$ Logit Slice $\to$ Binary Direct Head $\to$ +choice $\to$ +act $\to$ CLM-Head) and decompose latency into backbone representation (53.12 ms), 151,643-way vocabulary projection (+85.04 ms $\to$ 138.16 ms), and decoding (+248.26 ms $\to$ 386.42 ms). Under 1-to-1 binary supervision ($\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}$), a Binary Direct Head cuts latency by $2.60\times$-$7.27\times$ (53.12 ms) and lowers calibration error by $1.88\times$ (ECE = 0.0450 vs. 0.0845), with a -1.80% accuracy trade-off (93.10% vs. 94.90%; 0.9795 vs. 0.9871 ROC-AUC) from forfeiting token priors. Gains above AR-SFT arise either from multi-task attribution and uncertainty gating (+choice+act: 96.44% accuracy, 0.9940 ROC-AUC, 0.0187 ECE at 53.71 ms) or from a disaggregated contrastive head (CLM-Head: 96.55% binary and 96.44% multi-task accuracy, 0.0166 ECE, 98.79% 7-class attribution at 54.42 ms) retaining semantic priors without token decoding. Across 5,000 out-of-sample images from five benchmarks, our framework excels on synthetic, camouflage, and document forgeries (96.44% GenImage, 97.73% Chameleon, 91.84% Doc) while showing a clear boundary on compressed face manipulation (FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913).

TL;DR: MAD-Guard 在匹配的 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干上系统比较闭集多模态取证任务的输出接口，结论是低输出熵的二分类决策不必走自回归解码：Binary Direct Head 把延迟压到 53.12 ms（2.60×–7.27× 加速），ECE 降到 0.0450，代价是准确率 -1.80%（93.10% vs 94.90%）。保留语义先验的 CLM-Head 在 54.42 ms 下达到 96.55% 二分类准确率与 0.0166 ECE，但对压缩人脸伪造失效（FF++ ROC-AUC 仅 0.5913）。
Motivation: 闭集取证任务输入复杂度高而输出熵极低，却仍被迫经过 151,643 词表投影与逐 token 解码，延迟与校准都被 token 先验拖累；缺少在匹配骨干下对生成式与直接决策接口的受控比较。
Method: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干、2,400 条 FakeClue 训练样本、LoRA r=16/α=32、华为昇腾 910C NPU 上，按 AR-SFT → Logit Slice → Binary Direct Head → +choice → +act → CLM-Head 的序列比较决策接口，用一比一二分类监督（L_BCE），并把延迟分解为骨干表征、词表投影与解码三段；在五个基准共 5,000 张样本外图像上检验。
Result: 延迟分解：骨干表征 53.12 ms，151,643 路词表投影 +85.04 ms（→138.16 ms），解码 +248.26 ms（→386.42 ms）。Binary Direct Head 加速 2.60×–7.27×（53.12 ms），ECE 降低 1.88×（0.0450 vs 0.0845），准确率 93.10% vs 94.90%（-1.80%），ROC-AUC 0.9795 vs 0.9871。+choice+act 多任务归因与不确定性门控：96.44% 准确率、0.9940 ROC-AUC、0.0187 ECE、53.71 ms。CLM-Head：96.55% 二分类与 96.44% 多任务准确率、0.0166 ECE、98.79% 七类归因、54.42 ms。5,000 张样本外图像上 GenImage 96.44%、Chameleon 97.73%、Doc 91.84%，FF++ 压缩人脸操纵 ROC-AUC 0.5913。

papers.title: SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. Five task types cover development from a brief, implementation from a game design document, skeleton completion, repair of 83 injected-fault cases, and Godot-to-Unity porting. Reference materials specify the intended gameplay, while a shared instrumentation interface lets evaluator-owned drivers and probes execute actions and observe independently implemented games. Evaluation combines engine-state checks, certified reference-input replay, and agent-authored feature demonstrations to assess mechanic correctness, demonstrated playability, and behavioral restoration and preservation after repairs. Game-specific vision-language rubrics separately assess presentation. Across six models, Opus5 achieves the highest overall score in all five task types. Best overall scores remain below 60 out of 100 across the three construction tasks, with Brief-to-Game reaching 50.38. Analysis of reviewed submissions identifies requirement omissions and gameplay logic errors as predominant implementation problems. On human-labeled behaviors from 100 agent-built games, executable checks achieve 92.59% balanced accuracy, compared with 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge. Rubric-based visual scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.829 with human ratings of 200 gameplay clips. Together, these results characterize current agent capabilities across game-development activities and support combining runtime evidence with visual assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Game 是一个游戏开发基准：247 个任务、41 个可执行 Godot 参考游戏、13 类 2D/3D 玩法，覆盖从需求简报生成、按设计文档实现、骨架补全、83 个注入故障修复到 Godot-to-Unity 移植五类任务。六个模型中 Opus5 在全部五类任务上总分最高，但三类构建任务最佳总分仍低于 60/100，Brief-to-Game 仅 50.38；主要失败模式是需求遗漏与玩法逻辑错误。
Motivation: 现有代码 agent 基准多针对通用软件任务，缺少对游戏这种需要可执行玩法验证的创作性开发活动的系统评测，也缺少比视频 VLM 评审更可靠的自动评判手段。
Method: 基准用共享 instrumentation 接口让评测方自有的 driver 与 probe 执行动作并独立观测 agent 实现的游戏；评测结合 engine-state 检查、认证的参考输入回放 (certified reference-input replay) 与 agent 自撰的功能演示来判定机制正确性与修复后行为保持，另用逐游戏的 vision-language rubric 单独评表现层。
Result: 六个模型中 Opus5 在全部五类任务总分最高；三类构建任务最佳总分均低于 60/100，Brief-to-Game 为 50.38。在 100 个 agent 构建游戏的人工标注行为上，可执行检查 balanced accuracy 92.59%，视频 VLM judge 为 78.41%；rubric 视觉分与 200 段游戏片段人工评分的 Spearman 相关为 0.829。已复核提交中需求遗漏与玩法逻辑错误是主要实现问题。
Conclusion: 当前 coding agent 在从需求到可玩游戏的构建任务上仍普遍不及格（<60/100），而运行时可执行证据加视觉评估的组合比纯视频 VLM 评审更贴近人工判断，可作为游戏开发 agent 的评测路径。

papers.title: Auditing Agent Actions through Query-Conditioned Attribution
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly take consequential actions through interactions with users, policies, and external tools. Auditing these agents requires automated attribution of realized actions to their historical basis. However, existing attribution formulations do not provide question-specific traces for diverse auditing objectives. Additionally, when access to the acting model is limited (e.g., in API-only deployments), applicable methods commonly rely on costly input perturbations or external LLM analysis of complete trajectories. We therefore formulate $\textit{query-conditioned agent action attribution}, a new task that takes a natural-language auditing query as input and recovers the source and ordered intermediate evidence for the query-specified aspect of an action. We instantiate this task with $A^3Bench$, a benchmark comprising 1,396 auditing queries across policy basis, parameter provenance, failure propagation, and unsafe-behavior tracing. To enable efficient, query-specific attribution, we use small open-weight models as attribution proposers that combine query-conditioned gradient saliency with query-semantic relevance to rank history units. Our proposer consistently achieves stronger source and evidence rankings at lower inference cost than open-weight baselines, improving source MRR by up to 40.9\% and evidence MAP by 42.1\% with only two forward passes and one backward pass. Controlled evaluations confirm that our proposer improves attribution specificity by adapting its rankings to fine-grained changes in the auditing query. Building on a proposer ensemble, our end-to-end system surpasses the strongest frontier-model baseline in source accuracy (64.5\% vs.\ 60.4\%) while reducing empirical deployment latency by 29.9\% relative to the fastest frontier API baseline. Code and data will be released after the initial review period following final validation and cleanup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 query-conditioned agent action attribution 任务与 A3Bench 基准（1,396 条审计查询），用小型开源模型把查询条件化的梯度显著性与查询语义相关性结合来排序历史单元。proposer 以两次前向加一次反向把 source MRR 最高提升 40.9%、evidence MAP 提升 42.1%；端到端系统在 source accuracy 上以 64.5% 对 60.4% 超过最强前沿模型基线，部署延迟降低 29.9%。
Motivation: 现有归因形式无法为多样的审计目标给出问题特定的轨迹线索；API-only 部署下可用方法依赖昂贵的输入扰动或用外部 LLM 分析完整轨迹。
Method: 定义以自然语言审计查询为输入、恢复动作来源与有序中间证据的任务；构建 A3Bench，含 policy basis、parameter provenance、failure propagation、unsafe-behavior tracing 四类共 1,396 条查询。proposer 用小型开源模型，将 query-conditioned gradient saliency 与 query-semantic relevance 融合以排序历史单元，再基于 proposer ensemble 构建端到端系统。
Result: proposer 相对开源权重基线将 source MRR 最高提升 40.9%、evidence MAP 提升 42.1%，仅需两次前向与一次反向；受控评测显示其排序随审计查询的细粒度变化而调整，提升归因特异性。端到端系统 source accuracy 64.5% 对最强前沿模型基线 60.4%，经验部署延迟相对最快的前沿 API 基线降低 29.9%。
Conclusion: 用小型开源模型做查询条件化归因，可以在更低成本下超过前沿模型的归因精度，且归因结果随审计查询变化而自适应。

papers.title: Benign Overfitting for General Norms and Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Understanding why predictors can generalize despite interpolating noisy training data is a central puzzle in machine learning. Most work on such "benign overfitting" studies minimum-2-norm linear regression, reflecting the inductive bias of gradient descent. However, modern optimizers such as Adam and Muon use non-Euclidean update geometries, favoring solutions associated with other norms. Analyzing regression for non-Euclidean norms is substantially more difficult, with known results essentially limited to Gaussians. In this paper, we develop a method to analyze benign overfitting in linear regression for general norms and general (sub-Gaussian) distributions. As a special case, we prove that minimum-p-norm interpolation with p>1 can benignly overfit even for non-Gaussian distributions, under suitable conditions. Perhaps surprisingly, for the 1-norm, benign overfitting does not hold in general for well-behaved (but non-Gaussian) distributions, showing that existing positive 1-norm results rely crucially on Gaussianity. Our proof analyzes the geometry of the dual optimization problem, using concentration and central limit tools to show it is approximately Euclidean in many high-dimensional cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把良性过拟合 (benign overfitting) 的分析从最小二范数推广到一般范数与一般次高斯分布：证明最小 p-范数插值 (p>1) 在合适条件下对非高斯分布也能良性过拟合，而 1-范数在良态非高斯分布下一般不成立，说明既有 1-范数正性结论关键依赖高斯性。
Motivation: 现有良性过拟合结果几乎只覆盖最小二范数线性回归（对应梯度下降的归纳偏置），而非欧氏几何的 Adam、Muon 等优化器对应其他范数；非欧氏范数下的已知结论基本限于高斯分布。
Method: 针对一般范数与一般次高斯分布下的线性回归插值，分析对偶优化问题的几何，用集中不等式与中心极限工具证明其在许多高维情形下近似欧氏，从而给出良性过拟合的判定方法。
Result: 证明最小 p-范数插值在 p>1 时于合适条件下可对非高斯分布良性过拟合；并证明对 1-范数，良性过拟合在良态（非高斯）分布下一般不成立，表明已有 1-范数正性结果关键依赖高斯性。
Conclusion: 良性过拟合并非二范数或高斯分布的专属现象，p>1 的范数在一般分布下同样可行，但 1-范数的正性结论不能脱离高斯假设外推。

papers.title: Reachability is not enough: Diagnosing long-range behavior in GNNs
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are often called long-range because their architecture can connect distant nodes, but this does not show whether they use distant information correctly. We introduce a framework that measures how strongly inputs at each graph distance affect predictions and separates limitations due to architecture, finite approximation, training, and numerical execution. Our analysis shows that local message-passing can spread influence slowly, so a finite implementation may rely mainly on nearby inputs even when the ideal computation uses the whole graph. We also explain why mathematically equivalent filters can differ in how easily they are learned and how reliably they run. Across controlled tasks, models with similar architectural reach use distant information very differently, while low average error can hide failures on distant interactions. Together, these results show that long-range capability depends on learning to use information at the distances required by the task and preserving that use during computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个诊断框架，量化图上每个距离的输入对 GNN 预测的影响强度，并把限制拆解为架构、有限近似、训练与数值执行四类来源。在受控任务中，架构可达距离相似的模型使用远距离信息的方式差异很大，而低平均误差会掩盖远距离交互上的失败。
Motivation: GNN 常被称作 long-range，但架构能连到远节点并不等于正确使用了远距离信息；现有指标无法区分限制来自架构、近似、训练还是数值执行。
Method: 提出按图距离度量输入对预测影响强度的诊断框架，将长程限制分解为架构、有限近似、训练与数值执行四类；在受控任务上比较架构可达性相同但实际远距使用不同的模型，并解释数学等价的滤波为何在可学习性与运行可靠性上不同。
Result: 受控任务中，架构可达距离 (architectural reach) 相近的模型对远距离信息的使用差异很大；低平均误差会掩盖远距离交互上的失败；局部 message passing 的影响传播缓慢，有限实现可能主要依赖邻近输入，即便理想计算会用到整张图。
Conclusion: 长程能力取决于模型是否学会按任务所需的距离使用信息，并在计算过程中保持这种使用，而不能只看架构可达性。

papers.title: COGNIT-Guard: Calibrated Standalone Direct-Decision Guardrails with Heterogeneous CPU-NPU Confidence Cascading under Explicit Latency and False-Positive Constraints
papers.abstract_en: When must a foundation-model safety gateway generate tokens, and when should it directly output a calibrated decision? We study calibrated standalone direct-decision foundation models for real-time pre-ingestion safety guardrails, jointly addressing probability calibration, dual-use false-positive control, and heterogeneous CPU-NPU routing under explicit latency SLOs. Pre-ingestion guardrails must screen prompts prior to target-LLM prefill with low false alarms on benign compliance inquiries; however, shallow classifiers are brittle to phrasing shifts, hidden-state probes require coupling to a target LLM, and generative guards incur high decoding latency and dual-use false positives. We present COGNIT-Guard, coupling a validation-calibrated CPU fast gatekeeper with confidence-gated escalation to an NPU-resident 322M bidirectional direct-decision model (Laya-322M) under an asymmetric false-positive penalty. On the clean unseen DUCS-Bench test split ($N=607$), COGNIT-Guard achieves 98.85% accuracy (McNemar $p = 1.19 \times 10^{-4}$ vs. ML), reduces benign FPR to 0.42% ($1/238$; Fisher's exact $p = 8.23 \times 10^{-4}$ vs. ML), and attains 1.12% ECE and 0.0104 Brier score. On Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, pure NPU inference runs in 21.77 ms mean latency (45.90 QPS), while the live serial CPU-NPU cascade ($θ^*_{\mathrm{deploy}}=0.70$) achieves 41.63 ms mean latency (P50: 39.47 ms, 99.23% accuracy, 0.00% FPR). Evaluation on SafetyBench-ZH ($N=2,100$) and comparison against a bi-encoder direct-decision baseline (CLM-8B) disentangle in-domain gains, OOD alignment tax (60.33% $\to$ 56.81% on Laya; 55.10% on domain CLM-8B), and experience replay recovery, restoring OOD accuracy to 64.10%-65.05% and reaching 99.67%-99.84% in-domain accuracy with 0.00%-0.42% FPR.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, IEEE double-column format
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COGNIT-Guard 面向 LLM 预填前的安全护栏，用验证校准的 CPU 快速门控加置信度触发的 NPU 322M 双向直接决策模型（Laya-322M）级联，在显式延迟 SLO 与非对称误报惩罚下路由。DUCS-Bench 未见测试集（N=607）上准确率 98.85%、良性 FPR 0.42%、ECE 1.12%；Ascend 910C 上纯 NPU 21.77 ms，串行级联（θ*=0.70）41.63 ms 且 FPR 0.00%。
Motivation: 预摄入护栏须在目标 LLM prefill 前筛 prompt 且对良性合规问询低误报：浅层分类器对措辞变化脆弱，hidden-state 探针需耦合目标 LLM，生成式护栏解码延迟高且双用途误报多。
Method: 校准的 CPU 快速门控 + 置信度触发升级到 NPU 常驻的 322M 双向直接决策模型 Laya-322M，按非对称误报惩罚与显式延迟 SLO 选择部署阈值 θ*；用经验回放 (experience replay) 缓解 OOD 对齐损失。

Conclusion: 校准的 CPU-NPU 置信度级联能在显式延迟 SLO 内把良性误报压到接近零，同时保住直接决策准确率；OOD 对齐税需经验回放恢复。

papers.title: RSD-Poker: Structure-Adaptive and Shift-Robust Risk-Utility Certification for Residual Policies in Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: Residual policy adaptation provides a lightweight way to modify a strong reference policy, but a shared scale and a fixed subgroup partition can hide heterogeneous degradation and become fragile when the deployment mixture of information states changes. We introduce RSD-Poker, a structure-adaptive and shift-robust certification framework that freezes a bank of residual families and scales, learns a policy-visible partition on an independent structure split, and freezes that partition before calibration labels are joined. Each candidate-group pair receives a weighted simultaneous upper certificate for anchor-relative risk and a lower certificate for weak-response utility. A robust group-to-candidate map is then selected over a predeclared uncertainty set of deployment group proportions. Under independent calibration units drawn from each frozen group's law, a candidate bank and partition fixed before calibration, and invariant within-group conditionals, the selected map satisfies its declared mixture-robust risk budget and utility certificate with probability at least $1-ζ_{risk}-ζ_{util}$. The information contract supports both a teacher-backed transform and a teacher-free observation-only student. The retained deterministic 24-state audit remains an exact replay diagnostic: empirical-zero selects $α=0.08$, raising the weak-response proxy from 4.2082 to 4.2889 with $0/12$ held-out threshold crossings. On stratified held-out states, the learned-partition dual selector raises weak utility from 4.4074 under global dual certification to 4.4936 and lowers held-out violation from 0.0215 to 0.0078; its mixture-robust variant reaches violation 0.0059. Across five observation-only checkpoints, risk-calibrated residuals attain weak utility $4.3659\pm0.0177$ and violation rate $0.0178\pm0.0057$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSD-Poker 针对不完全信息博弈中残差策略 (residual policy) 认证的两个脆弱点——共享缩放与固定子群划分会掩盖异质退化、且在部署信息状态混合比例漂移时失效——提出结构自适应、分布偏移稳健的认证框架：冻结残差族与缩放库，在独立结构划分上学出对策略可见的分组并在接入校准标签前冻结，再在预先声明的部署比例不确定集上选组到候选的映射。在分层留出状态上，学习划分的双选择器把弱效用从全局双认证的 4.4074 提到 4.4936，违规率从 0.0215 降到 0.0078，其混合稳健变体违规率 0.0059。
Motivation: 残差策略适配用共享 scale 和固定子群划分做认证，会隐藏异质性能退化；当部署时信息状态的混合比例改变，这类证书变得脆弱，无法保证既定风险预算与效用证书。
Method: 冻结一组残差族与缩放 (bank of residual families and scales)，在独立的 structure split 上学习对策略可见的分组 (policy-visible partition) 并在校准标签接入前冻结；对每个候选-组对给出锚点相对风险的加权同时上证书与弱响应效用的下证书，再在预先声明的部署组比例不确定集上选稳健的组到候选映射。理论保证在各冻结组独立校准单元、候选库与划分在校准前固定、组内条件分布不变的假设下，以至少 1-ζ_risk-ζ_util 的概率满足声明的混合稳健风险预算与效用证书；信息契约同时支持 teacher-backed 变换与 teacher-free 的仅观测学生。
Result: 确定性 24-state 审计中 empirical-zero 选 α=0.08，弱响应代理从 4.2082 升到 4.2889，留出阈值穿越 0/12。分层留出状态上，学习划分双选择器把弱效用从全局双认证的 4.4074 提到 4.4936，违规率从 0.0215 降到 0.0078，混合稳健变体违规率 0.0059。五个仅观测 checkpoint 上，风险校准残差的弱效用为 4.3659±0.0177，违规率 0.0178±0.0057。
Conclusion: 把分组划分在校准前冻结、再在部署比例不确定集上选映射，可以在不完全信息博弈的残差策略上同时给出可声明的风险预算与效用证书，并对信息状态混合漂移保持稳健。

papers.title: When Noise Meets Long-Tail: Feature-Threshold Dual Calibration for Robust Pseudo-Labeling
papers.abstract_en: Pseudo-labeling has become a cornerstone of learning from unlabeled data in semantic segmentation. Yet its effectiveness drops sharply in real-world scenarios where strong imaging noise and long-tailed class distributions occur together. We trace this failure to a vicious cycle of pseudo-label degradation. Imaging noise entangles foreground and background features, lowering prediction confidence across all classes, while long-tailed distributions leave tail classes with far fewer training samples and inherently lower confidence. Under fixed high-threshold filtering, these tail-class predictions are systematically filtered out, so they receive no supervision from unlabeled data and thus features keep degrading in subsequent iterations. Critically, noise and long-tail are not independent obstacles but mutually amplifying ones, and addressing either alone is insufficient. To break this cycle, we propose FTC-Seg, a Feature-Threshold dual-Calibration framework built on a standard teacher-student framework. At the feature level, Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) uses a set of learnable orthogonal prototypes to residually purify pixel-wise features, widening the margin between weak foreground targets and noisy backgrounds. At the threshold level, Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) dynamically adjusts class-specific thresholds based on learning difficulty and prediction-distribution bias, rescuing low-confidence pseudo-labels of tail classes from systematic exclusion. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks spanning three distinct noise modalities show that FTC-Seg achieves strong performance against state-of-the-art methods, with particularly substantial gains on tail classes. Our results establish that jointly calibrating features and thresholds is essential for robust pseudo-labeling under compounded noise and class imbalance.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track. Code: https://github.com/pingggg516/FTC-Seg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FTC-Seg 在标准 teacher-student 伪标注框架中同时做特征与阈值双重校准：用可学习正交原型 (OPR) 残差净化像素特征、拉开弱前景与噪声背景的间隔，用自适应阈值校准 (ATC) 按学习难度与预测分布偏置动态调整各类阈值，把尾类低置信伪标签从固定高阈值的系统性过滤中救回来。在覆盖三种噪声模态的四个公开基准上相对 SOTA 取得强性能，尾类提升尤其明显。
Motivation: 成像噪声与长尾分布同时存在时，固定高阈值会系统性滤掉尾类预测，使其在无标注数据上得不到监督、特征逐轮退化；噪声与长尾互相放大，单独解决其中一个不够。
Method: FTC-Seg 建立在标准 teacher-student 框架上，含两个模块：特征层面的 Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) 用一组可学习正交原型对像素级特征做残差净化，扩大弱前景目标与噪声背景的间隔；阈值层面的 Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) 依据学习难度与预测分布偏置动态调整类别专属阈值，回收尾类低置信伪标签。
Result: 在覆盖三种不同噪声模态的四个公开基准上，FTC-Seg 相对 state-of-the-art 方法取得强性能，尾类上的提升尤其显著。
Conclusion: 在噪声与类别不平衡叠加的场景下，联合校准特征与阈值是稳健伪标注的必要条件，只处理其一不足以打破伪标签退化的恶性循环。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Attribution and Control of Model Behavior During Training
papers.abstract_en: Attributing and controlling model behavior during training requires identifying each example's contribution quickly enough to act before the next update. However, examples in the same training batch can produce similar behavioral changes, making their individual contributions difficult to distinguish. We address this ambiguity through mutual information, accounting for interference within the batch by quantifying how much the combined behavioral change reveals about each example's contribution. We show that this mutual information is a logarithmic function of Behavioral Gradient Uniqueness (BGU). BGU gives the information measure its geometric interpretation. Our Batch-Space Ghost (BS-Ghost) algorithm makes these scores practical inside the training loop through shared computation in batch space, without storing model-sized example gradients. On a complete 1,000-example Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct workload, our BS-Ghost implementation adds 27 seconds (8.0%) to 5.5 minutes of ordinary training. Removal and retraining demonstrate that BGU identifies data that causally shapes final behavior. At each training step, signed information identifies which examples strengthen or weaken the target behavior, explaining how behavior develops during training. Signed information also enables cheap intervention during training: it predicts how changing example weights will affect behavior in the next update. We then use these predictions to choose weights that steer behavior toward a desired target. This makes our framework a practical foundation for scalable oversight and verification of training pipelines and processes, helping evaluators assess model alignment, understand how it develops during training, and guide interventions that shape ongoing learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在训练循环内对每个样本的行为贡献做归因与干预：用互信息量化批内干扰，证明其为 Behavioral Gradient Uniqueness (BGU) 的对数函数，并提出批空间共享计算的 BS-Ghost 算法，无需存储模型规模的样本梯度。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 1,000 样本完整训练上，BS-Ghost 仅给 5.5 分钟常规训练增加 27 秒（8.0%）；移除-重训练验证 BGU 找到的样本因果性地塑造最终行为，带符号信息还能预测改样本权重对下一步行为的影响并据此选权重把行为导向目标。
Motivation: 训练中难以在下一次更新前及时识别单个样本的贡献：同批样本可能产生相似的行为变化，个体贡献彼此混淆，归因与干预因此不可行。
Method: 以互信息刻画批内干扰，度量合并的行为变化对各样本贡献的揭示程度；证明该互信息是 Behavioral Gradient Uniqueness (BGU) 的对数函数，BGU 赋予信息度量几何解释。BS-Ghost 算法在批空间做共享计算，使这些分数能在训练循环内实用化，且不存储模型大小的逐样本梯度；带符号信息用于预测改变样本权重在下一步更新中对行为的影响，并据此选择权重把行为导向目标。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上 1,000 样本的完整训练工作负载中，BS-Ghost 实现给 5.5 分钟常规训练增加 27 秒（8.0%）。移除与重训练实验表明 BGU 识别出的数据因果性地塑造最终行为；每步的带符号信息指出哪些样本强化或削弱目标行为，并预测改权重对下一步行为的影响。
Conclusion: 批内归因歧义可用互信息加 BGU 解决，且开销可压到训练时间的 8.0%，使归因与权重干预成为可扩展监督和训练管线验证的实用基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CompoWorld: Compositional Environment Scaling for General Agents
papers.abstract_en: Automatically generated environments provide a scalable source of interaction data for training general agents. However, existing approaches mainly generate tasks within a single environment, while real-world workflows require agents to connect information and actions across multiple services. We introduce Compositional Environment Scaling (\textbf{CompoWorld}), which expands the task space by composing a finite library of reusable services. Coding agents turn tool specifications into verified services with typed states and shared interfaces, while a world model handles tools that cannot be reliably implemented. A random-walk procedure connects services through dependency graphs, enabling the generation and verification of tasks that require information to flow across services. Verified trajectories support supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while our Completion-Focused Rubric Reward guides reinforcement learning (RL) toward full task completion by emphasizing criteria with lower pass rates within each rollout group. We construct 448 services exposing 10,130 tools and use 3K SFT trajectories and 1K RL tasks to train Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Experimental results show that CompoWorld improves on its backbone by 9.17 points on average across eight benchmarks. On AutomationBench, it surpasses frontier models such as Claude Opus 4.6 and leads all compared agent-specialized 35B-A3B models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompoWorld 用可复用服务库的组合来自动扩增智能体训练环境：编码智能体把工具规格实现为带类型状态与共享接口的已验证服务，随机游走沿依赖图生成跨服务任务，再用 Completion-Focused Rubric Reward 引导 RL 追求任务完整完成。以 448 个服务、10,130 个工具、3K SFT 轨迹与 1K RL 任务训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，八个基准平均比骨干提升 9.17 分。
Motivation: 现有自动生成环境的方法基本只在单一环境内造任务，而真实工作流要求智能体跨多个服务连接信息与动作，任务空间因此受限。
Method: 组合式环境扩展 (Compositional Environment Scaling)：编码智能体将工具规格实现为带 typed state 与共享接口的已验证服务，无法可靠实现的工具交给 world model；随机游走过程沿依赖图连接服务以生成并验证跨服务任务；已验证轨迹用于 SFT，Completion-Focused Rubric Reward 在每个 rollout 组内强调通过率较低的准则来引导 RL。
Result: 构建 448 个服务、暴露 10,130 个工具，用 3K SFT 轨迹与 1K RL 任务训练 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B；在八个基准上平均比其骨干提升 9.17 分；在 AutomationBench 上超过 Claude Opus 4.6 等前沿模型，并领先所有对比的 35B-A3B 智能体专用模型。
Conclusion: 把有限服务库组合起来即可系统性扩增任务空间，且跨服务的已验证轨迹配合完成度导向的 rubric 奖励能训练出在多基准上更强的通用智能体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LieDiscover: Adaptive Symbolic Library Construction for Explicit Open-form Symmetry Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Discovering underlying symmetries from data has emerged as a crucial challenge in scientific discovery. Existing data-driven methods for symmetry discovery fail to determine the exact number and mathematical form of unknown infinitesimal generators. Recent explicit methods represent generators using a predefined function library and identify them through algebraic optimization, but they often struggle to capture complex symmetries involving high-order polynomials or transcendental functions. To address this limitation, we formulate symmetry discovery as a joint optimization problem over the function library and coefficients. We propose a novel framework that leverages an encoder-decoder architecture to dynamically generate symbolic expressions and expand the library. This generation process is optimized via reinforcement learning, which accelerates the exploration of the symbolic search space through step-wise rewards. Experiments demonstrate that LieDiscover can successfully uncover open-form infinitesimal generators involving high-order polynomials or transcendental functions, which remain intractable for existing methods. The discovered symmetries also improve performance in downstream PDE solving and discovery tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LieDiscover 把对称发现写成函数库与系数的联合优化，用编码器-解码器动态生成符号表达式并扩展库，以带步进奖励的强化学习加速符号搜索。实验显示它能找出含高阶多项式或超越函数的开形式无穷小生成元，且发现的对称可改进下游 PDE 求解与发现任务。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动对称发现无法确定未知无穷小生成元的确切个数与数学形式；预定义函数库的显式方法又难以覆盖高阶多项式或超越函数构成的复杂对称。
Method: 将对称发现表述为函数库与系数上的联合优化；用编码器-解码器架构动态生成符号表达式并扩展库，生成过程由强化学习优化，通过 step-wise reward 加速符号搜索空间的探索。
Result: 实验表明 LieDiscover 能成功发掘含高阶多项式或超越函数的开形式无穷小生成元，这类生成元对现有方法难以处理；所发现的对称还提升了下游 PDE 求解与发现任务的表现。
Conclusion: 把函数库本身纳入可学习对象并用强化学习驱动符号生成，是拿到开形式、非预定义无穷小生成元的有效路径，且对下游 PDE 任务有实际增益。
Relevance: 0
