papers.title: Audit-First VAPO: Risk-Certified Selective Updates under Imperfect Verification
papers.abstract_en: Imperfect verifiers can assign a harmful update direction even when clipping and regularization bound its magnitude. We introduce Audit-First VAPO, which separates discrete directional admission from continuous magnitude control. An observation-only accept-appeal-abstain policy uses a finite secondary-verification budget; its action trace is frozen before clean labels are joined. Simultaneous finite-sample bounds then certify selected harmful risk, coverage, and verifier-call rate over a predeclared policy family. Conditional Hoeffding-Azuma bounds account for the dependence induced by shared budgets, and rollout or verifier changes initiate a new certification stage. After admission, a bounded trust-clip-KL actuator controls magnitude. We evaluate two models on two reasoning benchmarks against static RLVR, matched-random selection, confidence thresholding, noise correction, and verifier augmentation. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and GSM8K at target risk $ρ=0.08$, RC-VAPO achieves 74.1% accuracy, selected harmful risk 0.0697, coverage 0.4125, and relative verifier cost $1.16\times$. At matched coverage and update magnitude, its selected-risk difference from matched random is -0.0260 with paired 95% interval $[-0.0364,-0.0157]$. Across asymmetric, confidence-dependent, and correlated-verifier noise, the certificate is satisfied on 57 of 60 independent runs. These comparisons isolate informative directional selection from proposal suppression, update shrinkage, and additional verifier computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Audit-First VAPO 把 RLVR 中的方向准入与幅度控制拆开：先用只看观测的 accept-appeal-abstain 策略在有限二次验证预算下冻结动作轨迹，再用有限样本证书认证所选有害风险、覆盖率与验证器调用率，之后才由 trust-clip-KL 执行器约束更新幅度。在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 GSM8K 上、目标风险 ρ=0.08 时 RC-VAPO 达到 74.1% 准确率、所选有害风险 0.0697、覆盖率 0.4125、相对验证器成本 1.16×；证书在 60 次独立运行中 57 次成立。
Motivation: 不完美验证器可能给出有害的更新方向，而裁剪与正则只能约束幅度、管不住方向；静态 RLVR 与阈值筛选在共享预算引入的依赖下无法认证所选风险。
Method: 分离离散方向准入与连续幅度控制：观测-only 的 accept-appeal-abstain 策略使用有限二次验证预算，动作轨迹在接入干净标签前冻结；用条件 Hoeffding-Azuma 界处理共享预算导致的依赖，对预先声明的策略族同时认证所选有害风险、覆盖率与验证器调用率，rollout 或验证器变更则开启新的认证阶段；准入后由 bounded trust-clip-KL 执行器控制幅度。
Result: 在 Qwen3.5-0.8B、GSM8K、目标风险 ρ=0.08 下，RC-VAPO 准确率 74.1%，所选有害风险 0.0697，覆盖率 0.4125，相对验证器成本 1.16×；在匹配覆盖率与更新幅度下，相对 matched random 的所选风险差为 -0.0260，配对 95% 区间 [-0.0364, -0.0157]；在非对称、置信度相关与相关验证器噪声下，证书在 60 次独立运行中 57 次成立。基线包括静态 RLVR、matched-random selection、confidence thresholding、noise correction 与 verifier augmentation。
Conclusion: 把方向准入与幅度控制分离并前置审计，可以在不完美验证器下认证所选风险，且这些对比把有信息量的方向选择与提案抑制、更新收缩、额外验证计算区分开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 不完美验证器可能给出有害的更新方向，而裁剪与正则只能约束幅度、管不住方向；静态 RLVR 与阈值筛选在共享预算引入的依赖下无法认证所选风险。
summary_sections.method: 分离离散方向准入与连续幅度控制：观测-only 的 accept-appeal-abstain 策略使用有限二次验证预算，动作轨迹在接入干净标签前冻结；用条件 Hoeffding-Azuma 界处理共享预算导致的依赖，对预先声明的策略族同时认证所选有害风险、覆盖率与验证器调用率，rollout 或验证器变更则开启新的认证阶段；准入后由 bounded trust-clip-KL 执行器控制幅度。
summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen3.5-0.8B、GSM8K、目标风险 ρ=0.08 下，RC-VAPO 准确率 74.1%，所选有害风险 0.0697，覆盖率 0.4125，相对验证器成本 1.16×；在匹配覆盖率与更新幅度下，相对 matched random 的所选风险差为 -0.0260，配对 95% 区间 [-0.0364, -0.0157]；在非对称、置信度相关与相关验证器噪声下，证书在 60 次独立运行中 57 次成立。基线包括静态 RLVR、matched-random selection、confidence thresholding、noise correction 与 verifier augmentation。

papers.title: Learning Multimodal Embeddings with Evidence-Aligned Readout
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models can expose task-relevant evidence through generation, but producing useful evidence does not by itself determine how it enters a retrieval embedding. We study whether the semantic organization of that evidence can also specify where representations are read. To address this question, we introduce EviAlign, which couples Semantic Evidence Generation with Boundary Readout in a shared multimodal large language model. It organizes evidence into five semantic units, reads the contextualized state at each unit boundary, and aggregates these states into a single normalized embedding. Generation and contrastive retrieval objectives jointly train this shared structure. With the same trailing readout, semantic evidence and free-form CoT yield nearly identical retrieval performance, suggesting that evidence organization alone does not explain the full gain. A controlled $2\times3$ study compares consistent and permuted evidence organization across three readout strategies, using training targets with matched evidence spans. With five readout states and the same mean pooling, the advantage of consistent semantic organization grows from 0.65 points at length-based training positions to 2.39 at evidence boundaries, yielding a 1.74-point co-design interaction. Across 12 MMEB retrieval tasks, EviAlign achieves 76.9 average Recall@1 with 500K training pairs while retaining single-vector indexing and scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EviAlign，在同一个多模态大模型里把语义证据生成与边界读出 (Boundary Readout) 联合起来：证据被组织成五个语义单元，在每个单元边界读出隐状态并聚合成单一归一化向量。2×3 受控实验显示，一致的语义组织相对打乱组织的增益从按长度位置读出的 0.65 点升到证据边界读出的 2.39 点，交互效应 1.74 点；在 12 个 MMEB 检索任务上以 500K 训练对达到 76.9 平均 Recall@1。
Motivation: 多模态大模型能生成任务相关证据，但证据如何进入检索嵌入、以及证据的语义组织能否决定表征从哪里被读出，此前没有被分离检验。
Method: EviAlign 在共享 MLLM 中耦合 Semantic Evidence Generation 与 Boundary Readout：把证据组织为五个语义单元，读取每个单元边界的上下文状态并聚合为单一归一化嵌入，用生成目标与对比检索目标联合训练；另做 2×3 受控研究，比较一致与打乱的证据组织乘以三种读出策略，训练目标使用匹配的证据跨度。
Result: 相同尾部读出下，语义证据与自由形式 CoT 的检索性能几乎一致；相同五个读出状态与同一 mean pooling 下，一致语义组织的增益从按长度训练位置的 0.65 点增至证据边界的 2.39 点，交互效应 1.74 点；在 12 个 MMEB 检索任务上 EviAlign 用 500K 训练对取得 76.9 平均 Recall@1，同时保持单向量索引与打分。
Conclusion: 证据的语义组织本身不足以解释全部增益，收益来自组织方式与读出位置的共同设计；边界读出才让一致组织的优势充分显现，且无需放弃单向量检索。

papers.title: AgentBoundary: Counterfactual Evaluation of Safety in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) in conversational settings is largely framed around whether to answer or refuse a request. In agentic settings, however, the same models must decide whether to act as permission-critical evidence emerges during execution. This creates a distinct challenge: apparent risk, action permissibility, and task competence are easily confounded, making agentic over-refusal difficult to distinguish from ordinary task failure. To address this, we introduce AgentBound, the first four-way counterfactual generation-and-evaluation framework for tool-using agent safety. AgentBound transforms the same executable workflow by independently varying apparent risk and action permissibility, enabling controlled comparisons of risky-looking but authorized tasks and routine-looking but unauthorized tasks. These comparisons jointly diagnose over-refusal and unsafe compliance while controlling for task competence. We instantiate AgentBound as a human-validated 4,000-task evaluation suite with trajectory-based and post-state-based judgments. Across 17 model and harness configurations, high safety frequently coexists with poor authorized-task completion: GPT-5.5 blocks 99.5\% of routine-looking unauthorized actions yet completes only 28.7\% of risky-looking authorized tasks. We further train a lightweight runtime calibration module that improves authorized-task completion by 18.2\% on average across 10 evaluated configurations, while improving unsafe-action blocking by 5.4\% on average. These show that effective agentic alignment requires action decisions to track permission-relevant execution evidence, rather than refusal strength alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentBound 是首个面向工具调用 LLM 智能体安全的四路反事实生成-评估框架：对同一条可执行工作流独立改变「表面风险」与「行动许可性」，从而在控制任务能力的前提下同时诊断过度拒绝与不安全顺从。在 17 个模型与 harness 配置上，高安全常与低授权任务完成率并存——GPT-5.5 拦截 99.5% 的看似常规但未授权的动作，却只完成 28.7% 的看似有风险但已授权的任务；轻量运行时校准模块在 10 个配置上平均把授权任务完成率提高 18.2%，同时把不安全动作拦截率再提高 5.4%。
Motivation: 对话场景的安全对齐以「答或拒」为框架，而智能体必须在执行中随许可证据出现来决定是否行动，导致表面风险、行动许可性与任务能力三者混淆，agentic over-refusal 难以与普通任务失败区分。
Method: AgentBound 对同一条可执行工作流独立改变表面风险与行动许可性，构造四类反事实任务（看似有风险但已授权、看似常规但未授权等），配套基于 trajectory 与 post-state 的判定；产出人工校验的 4,000 任务评测集，并训练一个轻量运行时校准模块。
Result: 在 17 个模型与 harness 配置上，GPT-5.5 拦截 99.5% 的看似常规但未授权动作，却仅完成 28.7% 的看似有风险但已授权任务；运行时校准模块在 10 个受评配置上平均提升授权任务完成率 18.2%，同时平均提升不安全动作拦截率 5.4%。评测集含 4,000 个人工校验任务。
Conclusion: 有效的智能体对齐要求行动决策跟随与许可相关的执行证据，而不是单纯加强拒绝强度；高拒绝率本身会掩盖授权任务上的能力塌陷。

papers.title: Towards Eliminating Catastrophic Forgetting in the Curriculum Learning of Math Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Curriculum learning has found broad application across numerous domains. Nevertheless, its effectiveness is intrinsically curtailed by catastrophic forgetting, driven by the shifts in model parameter distributions between curriculum tasks. In this paper, we investigate the phenomenon of catastrophic forgetting in this training paradigm, building on the established efficacy of curriculum learning. Our theoretical analyses of parameter update dynamics demonstrate that catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning stems from the divergence of task optima, which is generally essential to the faster convergence of curriculum learning; therefore, forgetting cannot be completely eliminated. Based on this finding, we augment the training process and propose IV-EWC, which incorporates Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) into the curriculum learning objective to curb catastrophic forgetting in mathematical reasoning, a prototypical curriculum learning scenario. IV-EWC employs the influence function to construct a representative validation set from the curriculum's training data, which is used to drive dynamic regularization during training. We further present an extended theoretical analysis to show that EWC-based regularization methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting in curriculum learning, thereby providing theoretical support for IV-EWC. Empirical evaluations on three backbone models and three benchmarks indicate that curriculum learning exhibits catastrophic forgetting. IV-EWC alleviates this issue, reducing forgetting by 162% on average relative to vanilla curriculum learning and yielding positive backward transfer, as evidenced by improved performance on easier tasks after subsequent training on challenging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 课程学习中的灾难性遗忘源于各课程任务最优点的发散，而这种发散本身正是课程学习收敛更快的必要来源，因此遗忘无法被完全消除。作者提出 IV-EWC：把 EWC 并入课程学习目标，并用影响函数 (influence function) 从课程训练数据中构造代表性验证集来驱动动态正则。在三个 backbone 模型与三个 benchmark 上，IV-EWC 相对原始课程学习平均将遗忘减少 162%，并产生正的 backward transfer——在难任务上继续训练后简单任务性能反而提升。
Motivation: 课程学习按由易到难的顺序训练，但任务间参数分布漂移会引发灾难性遗忘，削弱其在数学推理这类课程场景中的收益；需要弄清遗忘的来源并判断它能否被根除。
Method: 先从参数更新动力学做理论分析，指出遗忘源于任务最优点的发散；再提出 IV-EWC，把 Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) 嵌入课程学习目标，并用影响函数从课程训练数据中挑选代表性验证集，据此在训练中动态调整正则强度，另给出 EWC 类正则缓解课程遗忘的扩展理论分析。
Result: 在三个 backbone 模型和三个 benchmark 的实证评估中，课程学习确实表现出灾难性遗忘；IV-EWC 相对 vanilla curriculum learning 平均将遗忘减少 162%，并带来正的 backward transfer，即在难任务上继续训练后简单任务性能提升。
Conclusion: 课程学习的灾难性遗忘由任务最优点发散所致、无法被完全消除，但 EWC 式正则可以显著缓解它并把后续训练转为对简单任务的正向迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Demonstration-Free Success-Probability Reward Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables generalist robot policies to improve through trial-and-error interaction, yet its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by sparse task rewards. Existing general-purpose reward models typically alleviate this issue by learning task progress from expert demonstrations, but introduce a distribution mismatch with the mixed-quality rollouts encountered during policy optimization, making their estimates unreliable on suboptimal and failed behaviors from which the policy must learn. In this work, we introduce a demonstration-free reward learning paradigm where dense reward feedback can be learned directly from sparse task outcomes and policy experience. We theoretically show that terminal task outcomes implicitly define dense success-probability feedback at intermediate timesteps, which can be recursively learned through bootstrapping. Based on this insight, we introduce eVTA$_0$, which learns success probabilities from mixed-quality policy rollouts through temporal-difference-style bootstrapping, without expert demonstrations or intermediate annotations. We further introduce RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER), a closed-loop framework that adapts eVTA$_0$ using newly collected rollouts as the policy evolves. Experiments show that eVTA$_0$ provides more informative rewards than state-of-the-art reward models and achieves the best average policy performance across all LIBERO task suites under the same RL training budget, improving success rates by 5.4%-13.8% over the initial policy. In real-world manipulation, RLER further improves overall success rates by 20%-26%, with 35%-36% gains under out-of-distribution conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of demonstration-free reward learning and adapting rewards as the policy evolves. Project webpage: https://duowuyms.github.io/evta0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免演示的成功概率奖励学习范式：终局任务结果隐式定义了中间时刻的稠密成功概率，可用 TD 式自举从混合质量的策略 rollout 中递归学出，无需专家演示或中间标注。配套的闭环框架 RLER 用新收集的 rollout 随策略演化不断更新奖励模型，在 LIBERO 全部任务套件上取得最佳平均策略性能，相对初始策略成功率提升 5.4%–13.8%；真实操作任务上 RLER 再提升 20%–26%，分布外条件下提升 35%–36%。
Motivation: 通用奖励模型依赖专家演示，与策略优化时遇到的混合质量 rollout 存在分布错配，对次优和失败行为的估计不可靠，而策略恰恰要从这些行为中学习；稀疏任务奖励又从根本上限制了 RL 的效果。
Method: eVTA0 用 temporal-difference 式自举从混合质量策略 rollout 学习各时刻成功概率，不需专家演示与中间标注，理论部分证明终局结果隐式定义中间时刻的稠密成功概率反馈；RLER 是闭环框架，用策略演化过程中新收集的 rollout 持续适配 eVTA0。
Result: eVTA0 提供的奖励比 SOTA 奖励模型更具信息量，在相同 RL 训练预算下于 LIBERO 全部任务套件取得最佳平均策略性能，成功率相对初始策略提升 5.4%–13.8%；真实操作任务中 RLER 使总体成功率再提升 20%–26%，分布外条件下提升 35%–36%。
Conclusion: 免演示、随策略演化而更新的成功概率奖励，可以在相同训练预算下比基于演示的奖励模型更有效地训练通用机器人策略。

summary_sections.motivation: 通用奖励模型依赖专家演示，与策略优化时遇到的混合质量 rollout 存在分布错配，对次优和失败行为的估计不可靠，而策略恰恰要从这些行为中学习；稀疏任务奖励又从根本上限制了 RL 的效果。
summary_sections.method: eVTA0 用 temporal-difference 式自举从混合质量策略 rollout 学习各时刻成功概率，不需专家演示与中间标注，理论部分证明终局结果隐式定义中间时刻的稠密成功概率反馈；RLER 是闭环框架，用策略演化过程中新收集的 rollout 持续适配 eVTA0。
summary_sections.result: eVTA0 提供的奖励比 SOTA 奖励模型更具信息量，在相同 RL 训练预算下于 LIBERO 全部任务套件取得最佳平均策略性能，成功率相对初始策略提升 5.4%–13.8%；真实操作任务中 RLER 使总体成功率再提升 20%–26%，分布外条件下提升 35%–36%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 免演示、随策略演化而更新的成功概率奖励，可以在相同训练预算下比基于演示的奖励模型更有效地训练通用机器人策略。

papers.title: Tsubame: Tree Replay for Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Context-aware dynamic trees allocate the speculative decoding budget according to draft path probabilities, adapting their depth and branching to the current context. Under stochastic decoding, however, we find that this structural advantage does not always compensate for the acceptance gains of random sampling paired with advanced verification, and such dynamic trees can fall behind sampled chains in some settings. These trees grow their topology from the candidates themselves, so the tokens submitted for verification are typically the deterministic high-score tokens selected during construction. This coupling is not inherent: once the topology is fixed, its nodes can be repopulated by sampling, allowing dynamic trees to retain their structural advantage while also benefiting from random sampling and advanced verification. Diffusion-based drafters make this practical, as their parallel outputs or lightweight conditional corrections allow candidates to be regenerated cheaply after the complete topology is known. We introduce Tsubame, a two-pass tree speculative decoding framework for diffusion-based drafters. The first pass plans and freezes a context-aware topology using draft path scores; the second replays the fixed topology, sampling the tokens that populate its nodes to form the candidate tree for verification. We prove that Tsubame is lossless under compatible sampling and verification strategies. Experiments across three diffusion-based drafters, six datasets, and multiple candidate budgets show that Tsubame improves acceptance length and throughput over deterministic trees, including settings where it reverses their disadvantage against sampled chains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tsubame 把扩散式草稿 (diffusion-based drafter) 的推测解码 (speculative decoding) 拆成两遍：第一遍用草稿路径分数规划并冻结上下文感知的树拓扑，第二遍在固定拓扑上用随机采样填充节点再送验证，从而同时保留动态树的结构优势和随机采样的接受率优势。在三个扩散式草稿模型、六个数据集与多种候选预算上，Tsubame 相对确定性树提高了接受长度与吞吐，并在部分设置中逆转了动态树落后于采样链的局面。
Motivation: 上下文感知动态树按草稿路径概率分配推测解码预算，但其节点在构造时就由确定性高分 token 填充，这种拓扑与 token 的耦合使其在随机解码下未必胜过随机采样加先进验证的采样链，某些设置中反而落后。
Method: 两遍树推测解码框架：第一遍依据草稿路径分数规划并冻结上下文感知拓扑，第二遍在该固定拓扑上采样填充节点，生成候选树交给验证；扩散式草稿模型的并行输出与轻量条件修正使拓扑确定后仍能廉价重生成候选。作者证明在兼容的采样与验证策略下 Tsubame 无损 (lossless)。
Result: 在三个扩散式草稿模型、六个数据集和多种候选预算上的实验中，Tsubame 相对确定性树提升接受长度 (acceptance length) 与吞吐 (throughput)，并在部分设置中逆转了动态树相对采样链的劣势；并给出兼容采样与验证策略下的无损性证明。
Conclusion: 树拓扑的规划与节点 token 的填充可以解耦：先冻结结构再用采样回放填充，就能让上下文感知动态树在随机解码下不再落后于采样链，同时保持无损。

papers.title: FuseAlign: Forced Alignment in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Word-level forced alignment estimates when each transcript word occurs in an audio recording. It underpins text-based media editing, subtitling, speech-data curation, and phonetic analysis. Existing evaluations understate the difficulty of forced alignment by relying on short, clean speech, perfect transcripts, and metrics that obscure consequential alignment errors. In contrast, real-world media and data-processing pipelines operate on long and diverse recordings. Additionally, forced aligners often operate on error-prone automatic speech recognition (ASR) output. We address these gaps with improved evaluation metrics, a scoring protocol for real ASR transcripts, and AlignBench, a benchmark spanning diverse speaker, acoustic, and text conditions. We further introduce FuseAlign, a transformer-based aligner trained on large-scale pseudo-labeled speech with online label correction. FuseAlign performs joint contextualization of audio and text for the localization of coarse words. The model then refines boundaries at millisecond resolution and detects missing transcript words in the audio without lexicon-based or Viterbi decoding. On AlignBench, FuseAlign substantially outperforms all baselines and remains robust under real ASR transcripts. Ablations show that convolutional upsampling and EMA-snapshot label correction matter more than model properties such as parameter count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FuseAlign 是面向真实长音频与含错 ASR 转写的词级强制对齐 (forced alignment) 系统：transformer 对音频与文本做联合上下文化定位粗词位置，再以毫秒级分辨率细化边界并检测音频中缺失的转写词，全程不用词典或 Viterbi 解码。在覆盖多样说话人、声学与文本条件的 AlignBench 上，它大幅超过全部基线，且在真实 ASR 转写下保持稳健；消融显示卷积上采样与 EMA 快照标签纠错比参数量等模型属性更关键。
Motivation: 现有强制对齐评测依赖短、干净语音与完美转写，指标又掩盖了后果性错误，系统性低估了任务难度；而真实媒体与数据管线处理的是长且多样的录音，且对齐器常要吃有错的 ASR 输出。
Method: 提出三部分：改进的评测指标与面向真实 ASR 转写的打分协议；覆盖多样说话人、声学、文本条件的基准 AlignBench；以及 FuseAlign——在大规模伪标注语音上用在线标签纠错 (online label correction) 训练的 transformer 对齐器，先联合上下文化音频与文本定位粗词，再在毫秒分辨率上细化边界并检测缺失词，不依赖 lexicon 或 Viterbi 解码。
Result: 在 AlignBench 上 FuseAlign 大幅超过所有基线，并在真实 ASR 转写下保持稳健；消融表明卷积上采样 (convolutional upsampling) 与 EMA-snapshot 标签纠错的贡献大于参数量这类模型属性。
Conclusion: 强制对齐的瓶颈在评测协议与训练时的标签纠错，而不在模型规模；把评测搬到长、多样、含 ASR 错误的条件上，再配合在线标签纠错，才能得到真实可用的对齐器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Distributions to Stochastic Processes: Neural Approximation of Measure-Valued Maps
papers.abstract_en: Learning mappings between probability distributions arises naturally when inputs and outputs are represented by populations of samples rather than individual observations. We develop an approximation-theoretic framework for distribution-to-distribution learning and extend it to mappings between stochastic processes. For continuous operators on $W_2$-compact families of finite-dimensional probability laws, we establish uniform neural approximation in the 2-Wasserstein metric using finite law statistics, a simplex-valued neural map, and a shared atomic output support that guarantees valid probability measures. We further extend this principle to probability laws on separable Hilbert spaces through finite-rank orthogonal projections. These results establish the representational feasibility of learning transformations between probability laws rather than deterministic vectors or functions. To demonstrate practical relevance, we study two problems naturally defined at the distribution level: prediction of first-passage-time distributions for an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process and nonlinear response-path laws of a Duffing oscillator. Because the theory is model-agnostic and broader than any single practical architecture, the experiments use task-adapted neural models rather than reproducing the theoretical construction exactly. In both problems, the proposed models outperform a fixed-feature MLP baseline and distribution-space kernel regression. These experiments complement the theory by demonstrating the practical learnability of distribution-to-distribution transformations in random systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出分布到分布学习的逼近论框架：在 W2 紧的有限维概率律族上，用有限统计量、单纯形值神经映射 (simplex-valued neural map) 与共享原子输出支撑，保证输出是合法概率测度并在 2-Wasserstein 度量下一致逼近；再经有限秩正交投影推广到可分 Hilbert 空间上的概率律。在 OU 过程首达时分布与 Duffing 振子非线性响应路径律两个任务上，所提模型同时优于固定特征 MLP 基线与分布空间核回归 (kernel regression)。
Motivation: 当输入输出以样本群体而非单个观测表示时，需要在概率分布之间学习映射；已有逼近结果多针对确定性向量或函数，缺少对分布值映射 (measure-valued maps) 的一致逼近保证。
Method: 对 W2 紧的有限维连续算子，用有限概率律统计量加单纯形值神经网络构造一致逼近，共享原子输出支撑保证输出为合法测度；再用有限秩正交投影把原理推广到可分 Hilbert 空间上的概率律。理论是模型无关的，实验用任务适配的神经模型而非严格复刻理论构造。
Result: 在 Ornstein--Uhlenbeck 过程首达时分布预测与 Duffing 振子非线性响应路径律两个分布层面任务上，所提模型均优于固定特征 MLP 基线和分布空间核回归；理论给出 2-Wasserstein 度量下的一致神经逼近保证。
Conclusion: 分布到分布的变换本身是可学习的：有限统计量加单纯形值输出足以在 W2 紧族上保证合法测度与一致逼近，且该可行性在随机系统的实际任务中成立。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Probe to Act: Elevating Browser-Use Agent via Active Visual Probing
papers.abstract_en: Browser-use agents require seamless alignment between structured web metadata and visual information, while preserving relevant context across long interactions. Existing interfaces often rely on either screenshot-level action prediction or static Set-of-Marks overlays, leaving the model to resolve dense DOM-pixel alignment before every operation. We introduce Probe to Act (P2A), an active probing framework for the browser-agent loop that moves this alignment into decision time. P2A addresses an asymmetric bridge between symbolic DOM hypotheses and screenshot layout by rendering on-demand symbolic DOM structure back into pixels. Before committing a state-changing browser operation, the agent can issue lightweight probes to translate DOM handles into pixel evidence, map screen regions back to DOM candidates, register visual-only targets, and commit verified notes. These interleaved processes naturally produce evidence-based memory: only probed, acted-on, or explicitly committed observations are kept across steps, preserving only decision-critical evidence in long-horizon contexts. P2A can be used as a prompting strategy for proprietary models under the standard DOM+SoM interface, and can be distilled into open-weight models through cold-start synthesis and self-bootstrapped SFT. Across three browser-use benchmarks, P2A shows clear gains on task success rate for both proprietary and fine-tuned models; on VisualWebArena, for example, it improves Gemini-3-Pro from 54.1% to 61.2% and Qwen3-VL-8B from 24.6% to 32.9%, while matching the costly full-observation history ($\sim$3$\times$) at only $\sim$1.2$\times$ the peak retained input context of action-only history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: P2A 把 DOM 与截图的对齐从每次操作前移到决策时刻：agent 在执行状态改变操作前发出轻量 probe，把 DOM handle 渲染回像素、把屏幕区域映射回 DOM 候选，并只保留被 probe、被操作或显式提交的证据作为跨步记忆。在三个 browser-use 基准上任务成功率一致提升，VisualWebArena 上 Gemini-3-Pro 从 54.1% 升到 61.2%、Qwen3-VL-8B 从 24.6% 升到 32.9%，且只用约 1.2× 的峰值保留上下文就追平约 3× 的全观测历史。
Motivation: 现有 browser-use agent 要么整截图预测动作，要么用静态 Set-of-Marks overlay，模型每次操作前都要自行解析稠密的 DOM-像素对齐，长交互中相关上下文也难以保留。
Method: P2A 是一个主动 probing 框架：状态改变操作前发出轻量 probe，把符号 DOM 假设渲染回像素、把屏幕区域反查回 DOM 候选、注册仅视觉可见的目标并提交核验过的笔记，由此生成基于证据的记忆。既可作为标准 DOM+SoM 接口下的 proprietary model 提示策略，也可经 cold-start 合成与 self-bootstrapped SFT 蒸馏到开源权重模型。
Result: 在三个 browser-use 基准上，proprietary 与微调模型的任务成功率均明显提升：VisualWebArena 上 Gemini-3-Pro 由 54.1% 提至 61.2%，Qwen3-VL-8B 由 24.6% 提至 32.9%；峰值保留输入上下文约为 action-only 历史的 1.2×，而全观测历史约为 3×，P2A 以更低成本追平后者。
Conclusion: 把 DOM-像素对齐推迟到决策时刻并只保留决策关键证据，能在长程 browser-use 任务上同时提高成功率并压低上下文开销，且对专有模型与可蒸馏的开源模型都成立。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: P2A 是一个主动 probing 框架：状态改变操作前发出轻量 probe，把符号 DOM 假设渲染回像素、把屏幕区域反查回 DOM 候选、注册仅视觉可见的目标并提交核验过的笔记，由此生成基于证据的记忆。既可作为标准 DOM+SoM 接口下的 proprietary model 提示策略，也可经 cold-start 合成与 self-bootstrapped SFT 蒸馏到开源权重模型。
summary_sections.result: 在三个 browser-use 基准上，proprietary 与微调模型的任务成功率均明显提升：VisualWebArena 上 Gemini-3-Pro 由 54.1% 提至 61.2%，Qwen3-VL-8B 由 24.6% 提至 32.9%；峰值保留输入上下文约为 action-only 历史的 1.2×，而全观测历史约为 3×，P2A 以更低成本追平后者。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 DOM-像素对齐推迟到决策时刻并只保留决策关键证据，能在长程 browser-use 任务上同时提高成功率并压低上下文开销，且对专有模型与可蒸馏的开源模型都成立。

papers.title: Learning to Learn from Context: Synthetic Training from Perturbed Public Documents
papers.abstract_en: Real-world tasks often require large language models (LLMs) to learn from complex task-specific context rather than pretrained parametric knowledge. This capability remains a weakness of LLMs, while human annotation for such task contexts is expensive and difficult to scale. Public high-quality documents are an abundant alternative, but much of the public web has already been consumed during pretraining: training on such documents naively would reward memorization rather than context learning. In this work, we attempt to make use of high-quality public documents with small perturbations and empirically find that LLMs can successfully generate context-dependent reasoning traces and answers, which are then used to train a student model. Specifically, we construct a synthesis pipeline that (i) rewrites source documents to reduce memorization risk, (ii) generates questions and rubrics that require reasoning over the document, (iii) answers the questions with the document as context, and (iv) admits only samples that genuinely depend on the document. Without any human annotators, our pipeline generates about 10k samples from 3.5k documents, and the resulting student model substantially improves the performance on CL-bench. SFT raises a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student from 13.7% to 22.8%, and a subsequent rubric-reward RL stage reaches 24.6%, on CL-bench comparable with a frontier model of over a trillion parameters, Qwen3.8-2.4T (23.9%). We also observe a broad transfer of improvements to long-context understanding, instruction following, and reasoning, while code generation and knowledge remain mostly flat. We hope this work provides a reproducible and scalable way to improve the ability of LLMs to learn from context, and to facilitate further research on context-grounded reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无需人工标注的合成训练流水线：把公开高质量文档做小幅改写以降低记忆风险，再生成需要通读文档才能作答的问题、评分标准与推理轨迹，只保留真正依赖文档的样本来训练学生模型。在 CL-bench 上，SFT 把 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 从 13.7% 提到 22.8%，再加 rubric-reward RL 达到 24.6%，超过十亿参数级 Qwen3.8-2.4T 的 23.9%。
Motivation: LLM 从任务特定上下文学习仍弱，人工标注昂贵难扩展；公开文档虽丰富但大多已被预训练见过，直接训练只会奖励记忆而非上下文学习。
Method: 四步合成流水线：改写源文档降低记忆风险，生成需要基于文档推理的问题与 rubric，以文档为上下文作答，只接纳真正依赖文档的样本；随后先 SFT 再做 rubric-reward RL，全程无人工标注。
Result: 从 3.5k 文档生成约 10k 样本；CL-bench 上 SFT 使 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 从 13.7% 升至 22.8%，RL 阶段达 24.6%，对比 Qwen3.8-2.4T 的 23.9%；长上下文理解、指令遵循与推理广泛提升，代码生成与知识基本持平。
Conclusion: 小幅扰动的公开文档加可验证的依赖性筛选，能在无人工标注下规模化提升 LLM 的上下文学习能力，且改进可迁移到长上下文、指令遵循与推理。

papers.title: Scalable and Data-Driven Decision Support in the Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul Process
papers.abstract_en: Several businesses apply maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) principles to the life-cycle of their existing products. In cases like casted gas turbine component Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), repairing components in frequent intervals can extend the lifetime expectation of the product, provide higher cost efficiency compared to newly produced components, and even improve the part design during the repair cycle. Another aspect of repair concerns sustainability, as products often contain rare materials. The emissions produced by the repair process are usually smaller than mining materials and casting new components. To optimize the repair process further, we propose the Smart Expert System (SES), which assists engineering experts with machine learning-based decision support throughout the repair process. We elaborate on its IT architecture and present machine learning models employed for representative MRO use cases. The SES is evaluated using actual industry data from a leading gas turbine company and demonstrably fulfills formulated requirements concerning the suitability of the overall decision support and the stability of the enclosing IT architecture.
papers.comment: Published in: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management (IEEM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向燃气轮机铸造件维修 (MRO) 提出 Smart Expert System (SES)，用机器学习模型为维修决策提供支持，并给出其 IT 架构设计。在一家领先燃气轮机公司的实际工业数据上评估，SES 满足关于决策支持适用性与外围 IT 架构稳定性的既定需求。
Motivation: 铸造燃气轮机部件的维修环节涉及寿命、成本、稀有材料与排放权衡，但缺少一套可扩展、可落地的机器学习决策支持架构来贯穿整个维修流程。
Method: 提出 Smart Expert System (SES)：阐述其 IT 架构，并针对代表性 MRO 用例部署机器学习模型，为工程专家提供维修全过程的决策支持。
Result: 在一家领先燃气轮机公司的实际工业数据上评估 SES，结果表明其满足所制定的需求，涉及整体决策支持的适用性 (suitability) 与外围 IT 架构的稳定性 (stability)。
Conclusion: 维修决策支持可以由一套架构化的机器学习系统承载，并在真实工业数据上同时满足决策适用性与架构稳定性两类需求。

papers.title: SafeMol: Dual-Modality Safety Alignment for Molecular Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Molecular multimodal models support diverse understanding and generation tasks but may introduce safety vulnerabilities when handling hazardous molecules. In this work, We reveal substantial jailbreak vulnerabilities under both text-only and graph-conditioned settings. Our analysis further shows that safety robustness must hold across input modalities while balancing safety, over-refusal, and utility. To address these challenges, we construct SafeMolBench, a molecular multimodal safety-alignment benchmark with 3702 samples covering 618 unique hazardous molecules and safe molecular tasks, organized into hazardous-harmful, hazardous-allowed, and utility-replay subsets to support unified training and evaluation of safety, over-refusal, and utility. Based on SafeMolBench, we propose SafeMol, a parameter-efficient safety alignment framework that jointly optimizes lightweight modules across text-only and graph-conditioned inputs, uses MMD for distribution-level representation alignment to reduce modality-induced discrepancies, and explicitly models molecular hazardousness and harmful operational intent. Experiments on SafeMolBench show that SafeMol reduces attack success by several tens of percentage points while largely maintaining low over-refusal and preserving molecular-task utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeMol 针对分子多模态模型在文本与图两种输入下的越狱漏洞，提出参数高效的安全对齐框架：联合优化轻量模块，用 MMD 做分布级表征对齐以缩小模态差异，并显式建模分子危险性与有害操作意图。在自建 SafeMolBench（3702 样本、618 个独特危险分子）上，攻击成功率下降数十个百分点，同时保持低过度拒答并保住分子任务效用。
Motivation: 分子多模态模型处理危险分子时存在文本条件与图条件下的越狱漏洞，安全鲁棒性必须跨输入模态成立，同时还要平衡安全、过度拒答与效用，此前缺少统一的训练与评测基准。
Method: 构建 SafeMolBench 基准，含 3702 个样本、618 个独特危险分子与安全分子任务，划分为 hazardous-harmful、hazardous-allowed、utility-replay 三个子集以支持统一训练与评测；SafeMol 框架在文本输入与图条件输入上联合优化轻量模块（参数高效），用 MMD 做分布级表征对齐以降低模态引入的差异，并显式建模分子危险性与有害操作意图。
Result: 在 SafeMolBench 上，SafeMol 使攻击成功率下降数十个百分点 (several tens of percentage points)，同时大体维持低过度拒答并保住分子任务效用；基准规模为 3702 样本、618 个独特危险分子。
Conclusion: 跨模态联合的参数高效安全对齐（MMD 表征对齐 + 显式危险性/意图建模）能在压低越狱成功率的同时不牺牲过度拒答与任务效用，且安全鲁棒性需在文本与图两种模态上同时成立。

papers.title: Trajectory Unlearning on LLM-based Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing large language model (LLM) unlearning has focused primarily on removing specific knowledge, such as harmful facts, private data, or copyrighted content. However, as LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, a fundamental yet overlooked problem emerges: beyond suppressing what an agent knows, an agent should not reproduce undesired behaviors through its action trajectories. In this work, we introduce trajectory-level unlearning, a new problem formulation that targets the removal of specific action trajectories in long-horizon agentic tasks, rather than factual knowledge. We identify two fundamental challenges that distinguish trajectory unlearning from knowledge unlearning: (1) our unlearning target is what the agent \emph{does}, not what it \emph{says}; and (2) trajectories are sequentially dependent action sequences that cannot be decomposed into isolated prompt-response pairs without losing inter-step structure. To address these challenges, we propose Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization (GiRPO), which injects forget trajectories into the policy rollout group with penalized rewards and isolates the normalization statistics, yielding a stable and bounded unlearning signal that does not corrupt gradient updates for normal task trajectories. We construct trajectory unlearning benchmarks from two application scenarios, household tasks (ALFWorld) and online shopping (WebShop), and design three complementary metrics for evaluating forgetting quality and model utility. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that GiRPO effectively unlearns target trajectories while preserving task success rates, outperforming existing knowledge-unlearning baselines on both forgetting quality and task utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出轨迹级遗忘 (trajectory-level unlearning) 这一新问题：要删的是 agent 在长程任务中的动作轨迹而非事实知识。GiRPO 把待遗忘轨迹注入策略 rollout 组并施加惩罚奖励、隔离归一化统计量，得到稳定且有界的遗忘信号；在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上有效遗忘目标轨迹并保持任务成功率，在遗忘质量与任务效用上均超过既有知识遗忘基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 遗忘只针对有害事实、隐私或版权内容等知识，而 agent 部署后需要删掉的是它会复现的不良行为轨迹；轨迹是顺序依赖的动作序列，无法拆成孤立的 prompt-response 对而不丢失跨步结构。
Method: 提出 Group-injected Relative Policy Optimization (GiRPO)：把 forget 轨迹注入策略 rollout 组、给予惩罚奖励，并隔离归一化统计量，使遗忘信号不污染正常任务轨迹的梯度更新。基准取自两个场景——家务任务 ALFWorld 与在线购物 WebShop，并设计三个互补指标衡量遗忘质量与模型效用。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，GiRPO 有效遗忘目标轨迹同时保持任务成功率，在遗忘质量与任务效用两个维度上均超过既有知识遗忘基线；评测使用三个互补指标。
Conclusion: 轨迹级遗忘可以与任务效用共存，且把知识遗忘方法直接搬到行为轨迹上不够——需要针对顺序依赖的动作序列设计惩罚与归一化隔离。

papers.title: Quantifying Behavioral Tails in Black-Box Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce RareTrap, a framework for estimating the probability of severe behaviors in black box large language models (LLMs). A key challenge for probability estimation is defining a tractable distribution over the input space. To accomplish that, RareTrap uses a surrogate LLM and constructs a geometry-aware mapping from a lower-dimensional latent reference space into its token-embedding space to induce an explicit and reproducible distribution over input prompts. A response-level performance function is utilized on the response to quantify behavior severity. This enables sequential rare event simulation that concentrates evaluations on progressively more severe behaviors while preserving probability under the induced prompt distribution, which would otherwise be prohibitive to measure. Across 10 open-weight and two frontier models (GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6), we find that RareTrap successfully induces severe resource consumption behaviors and computes their probability with as few as 200 evaluations. RareTrap provides model developers a principled approach for evaluating language models under a common distribution, and prioritizing alignment effort to improve safety and mitigate risks. Code is published online: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rare_trap-D7F0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RareTrap 用代理 LLM 把低维隐空间几何映射到 token-embedding 空间，诱导出可复现的输入提示分布，再做保概率的序贯稀有事件模拟，把评估集中在越来越严重的行为上。在 10 个开源模型加 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6 上，它以少至 200 次评估诱导出严重的资源消耗行为并算出其概率。
Motivation: 黑盒 LLM 的严重行为概率极难估计，核心障碍是输入空间上缺少一个可处理的概率分布，直接暴力测量代价过高。
Method: 以代理 LLM 为载体，构造从低维隐参考空间到其 token-embedding 空间的几何感知映射，诱导显式且可复现的提示分布；用响应级性能函数度量行为严重度，再做保概率的序贯稀有事件模拟，把评估逐步集中到更严重行为。
Result: 在 10 个开源权重模型与 2 个前沿模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6）上，RareTrap 诱导出严重的资源消耗行为，并以少至 200 次评估算出其概率。
Conclusion: 在统一诱导分布下评估语言模型是可行的，开发者可据此优先分配对齐投入以降低风险；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safety Reconstructed: Generative Modeling via Masked Diffusion Builds Strong Safety Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: Guard models are the last line of defense between a language model and a harmful output, yet their training objective is surprisingly narrow. Existing guards learn to predict a single verdict token from a conversational context, concentrating supervision on a single target. The consequences are structural: models latch onto shortcut features, are overconfident, and remain sensitive to where safety evidence appears in the sequence rather than its role in the full context. We propose a different framing. Rather than predicting a label from text, our LLaDA-Guard asks which label better explains the text: scoring the prompt or response under each label hypothesis and classifying based on their difference. This shifts supervision to every token in the moderated region, forcing the model to account for full content rather than its most discriminative fragments. We instantiate this idea with a masked diffusion language model, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a class-conditional reconstruction objective using LoRA and requiring no architectural changes beyond the base model. LLaDA-Guard leads on average rank against discriminative baselines trained on stronger backbones across seven held-out safety benchmarks, while exhibiting substantially better confidence calibration (ECE 0.0875 vs. 0.1384 for Qwen3Guard), less over-defense on benign prompts with unsafe-looking cues, and less prompt leakage when moderating responses. Its generative nature further enables token-level risk localization as a natural byproduct, yielding a pipeline for rewriting unsafe prompts into safe equivalents without additional training and achieving a 60.7% average conversion-to-safe rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLaDA-Guard 把安全护栏从「预测单个 verdict token」改成生成式判别：用 masked diffusion 语言模型在标签假设下对被审区域做条件重构打分，按分差分类，监督落到每个 token。七个 held-out 安全基准上平均排名领先于更强 backbone 的判别式基线，ECE 0.0875（Qwen3Guard 0.1384），并顺带产出 token 级风险定位与免训练改写，unsafe prompt 平均 60.7% 转为安全。
Motivation: 现有 guard 模型把监督压在单个标签 token 上，导致走捷径特征、过度自信，且对安全证据在序列中的位置敏感而非其在全上下文中的角色。
Method: 以 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 为底座，用 LoRA 微调，训练 class-conditional reconstruction 目标：分别在各标签假设下对 prompt 或 response 打分并按分差分类，除底座外不改架构；生成式形式天然给出 token 级风险定位。
Result: 在七个 held-out 安全基准上相对更强 backbone 上训练的判别式基线取得平均领先排名；ECE 0.0875 vs Qwen3Guard 0.1384；对带 unsafe 线索的良性 prompt 过度防御更少，审 response 时 prompt leakage 更少；免训练把 unsafe prompt 改写为安全等价物，平均 60.7% 转为安全。
Conclusion: 把安全判定重构为「哪个标签更能解释文本」的生成式打分，可在不改架构的前提下同时改善校准、减少过度防御与泄漏，并顺带给出风险定位和改写能力。

papers.title: lapanda: A Matrix-Free Differentiable Solver for Nonconvex Constrained Optimization Layers
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable optimization brings the structural guarantees of mathematical optimization to network pipelines, allowing them to be trained end-to-end. However, its application remains challenging for nonconvex constrained problems, as existing differentiable solvers often suffer from limited modeling expressiveness due to their reliance on specialized problem structures, while also incurring substantial computation time and memory overhead in both the forward and backward passes. To address these challenges, we propose lapanda, a matrix-free differentiable solver for nonconvex optimization with general constraints. It reformulates the problem to a sequence of augmented Lagrangian subproblems, each handled by a first-order inner solver through a proximal averaged quasi-Newton algorithm with adaptive linesearch, thus enabling efficient forward optimization. We establish local well-posedness of the solution map and convergence of the outer iterations, and further derive a sensitivity alignment between the original problem and the final subproblem in the backward pass, demonstrating that the subproblem sensitivity, which can be computed efficiently in a matrix-free manner, provides a principled approximation to the exact optimizer sensitivity. We evaluate lapanda on nonconvex constrained Rosenbrock benchmarks, imitation learning with several representative constrained optimal control problems, and embedded robotic obstacle-avoidance tasks. Compared with state-of-the-art differentiable solvers, lapanda delivers substantial reductions in computation time and memory footprint while maintaining reliable constraint satisfaction and learning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: lapanda 是面向一般约束非凸问题的 matrix-free 可微优化求解器：把原问题改写成增广拉格朗日 (augmented Lagrangian) 子问题序列，内层用 proximal averaged quasi-Newton 加自适应线搜索求解，反向传播只算最后一个子问题的灵敏度。在 Rosenbrock 基准、模仿学习的约束最优控制问题与嵌入式机器人避障任务上，相比现有可微求解器在保持约束满足与学习性能的同时大幅降低计算时间与内存占用。
Motivation: 可微优化能把数学优化的结构性保证带进网络端到端训练，但非凸约束问题上现有可微求解器依赖特定问题结构、表达力受限，且前向与反向都带来可观的时间与内存开销。
Method: 将原问题重构为增广拉格朗日子问题序列，每个子问题由一阶内层求解器经 proximal averaged quasi-Newton (PAQN) 配自适应线搜索求解；理论上给出解映射的局部适定性、外层迭代收敛性，并推导原问题与反向最终子问题之间的灵敏度对齐 (sensitivity alignment)，使 matrix-free 的子问题灵敏度成为精确优化器灵敏度的有原则近似。
Result: 在非凸约束 Rosenbrock 基准、含多个代表性约束最优控制问题的模仿学习，以及嵌入式机器人避障任务上评测：与 state-of-the-art 可微求解器相比，lapanda 在保持可靠约束满足与学习性能的同时，显著降低计算时间与内存占用。
Conclusion: 对一般约束非凸问题，用增广拉格朗日子问题加 matrix-free 灵敏度近似即可同时拿到可微性、约束满足与前反向效率，不必依赖专用问题结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Climbing the Hill: Prompt Injection Red-Teaming Against Frontier Models with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection is a leading security risk for LLMs and LLM-based applications such as agents. State-of-the-art red-teaming methods for prompt injection leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to train an attacker LLM to generate effective injected prompts. However, when targeting frontier LLMs such as GPT-6-Luna, a major challenge is the cold-start problem: every attack attempt by the attacker LLM fails and thus receives zero reward, providing no signal for learning. In this work, we propose a curriculum learning-based method to address the cold-start problem. In particular, we propose to train the attacker LLM against a sequence of increasingly robust target LLMs, with each stage warm-starting from the attacker LLM obtained in the previous one. However, simply training against a weak target (e.g., GPT-4o-mini) may not sufficiently prepare the attacker LLM to obtain useful learning signals against a frontier LLM (e.g., GPT-5.6-Terra). Instead, we find that the design of the curriculum is critical: after each stage, the attacker LLM needs to partially succeed against the next target LLM such that it can learn from successful attempts to attack the new target. Our extensive evaluation shows that our method can effectively red-team frontier LLMs, achieving an attack success rate (ASR@10) of 93.8\% and 45.0\% against GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-5.6-Terra on AgentDyn, whereas state-of-the-art RL methods such as RL-Hammer and PISmith achieve 0\% ASR under the same setting. Moreover, we find that the attacker LLM transfers across targets, e.g., an attacker LLM trained to defeat one strong LLM (GPT-5.6-Terra) also succeeds against six other frontier LLMs (e.g., GPT-6-Luna) it was never trained on. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/albert-y1n/PIForge}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对前沿 LLM 的提示注入红队训练中，攻击者 LLM 在强目标上全部失败、奖励恒为零的冷启动问题，提出课程强化学习：按目标模型鲁棒性递增的序列逐段训练，每段从上一段的攻击者热启动，且课程设计必须让攻击者在下一目标上部分成功，才能从成功样本学到信号。在 AgentDyn 上 ASR@10 对 GPT-5.6-Luna 达 93.8%、对 GPT-5.6-Terra 达 45.0%，而 RL-Hammer 与 PISmith 同设置下均为 0%。
Motivation: 面向 GPT-6-Luna 等前沿模型的提示注入红队 RL 训练存在冷启动问题：攻击者每次尝试都失败、奖励为零，学习没有梯度信号。
Method: 课程强化学习 (curriculum RL)：让攻击者 LLM 依次对抗鲁棒性递增的目标 LLM 序列，每阶段用上一阶段得到的攻击者热启动；课程按“攻击者在下一目标上需部分成功”的原则设计，弱目标（如 GPT-4o-mini）不足以提供对前沿目标（如 GPT-5.6-Terra）有用的学习信号。
Result: 在 AgentDyn 上 ASR@10：对 GPT-5.6-Luna 93.8%，对 GPT-5.6-Terra 45.0%；同设置下 SOTA RL 方法 RL-Hammer 与 PISmith 均为 0% ASR。攻击者可跨目标迁移：在 GPT-5.6-Terra 上训练的攻击者也成功攻击六个从未训练过的其他前沿 LLM（如 GPT-6-Luna）。
Conclusion: 课程设计（每阶段对下一目标部分成功）是解决提示注入红队冷启动的关键，训练出的攻击者 LLM 对未见过的前沿模型具有迁移攻击能力。

papers.title: StoryEngine: A State-Grounded Agentic Framework for Video Storytelling
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in agentic multi-shot video generation, producing coherent and consistent long-form stories remains challenging. Existing agentic pipelines typically rely on textual shot plans or previously generated pixels, yet lack an explicit mechanism for propagating the consequences of story events and maintaining the video world state across shots. As a result, missing visual details may be reconstructed inaccurately, while visual drift may propagate across subsequent shots, undermining both narrative coherence and visual consistency. To address these challenges, we propose StoryEngine, a state-grounded agentic framework for video storytelling. StoryEngine establishes a separation between authoritative semantic plans and unreliable visual observations. Specifically, StoryEngine maintains a structured representation of entity placement and story-relevant states, and propagates event-induced changes to define the intended start and end states of each shot. To visually realize these states, StoryEngine constructs canonical references for recurring entities and environments, and compiles state and visual constraints into executable render plans. Meanwhile, to realize these states correctly, a bounded evaluation-guided repair loop further corrects local state inconsistencies. Together, these mechanisms preserve causal story progression and prevent local visual errors from propagating across shots. To comprehensively evaluate long-form storytelling, we construct a benchmark across diverse scenarios and visual styles, with metrics assessing storytelling quality, narrative coherence, and visual consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that StoryEngine consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation dimensions, validating its effectiveness for coherent and consistent video storytelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StoryEngine 为长视频故事生成建立显式的跨镜头世界状态：维护实体位置与故事状态的结构化表示，把事件引起的状态变化传播成每个镜头的起止状态，再编译为可执行渲染计划，并用有界的评估-修复回路纠正局部状态不一致。在覆盖多种场景与视觉风格的新建基准上，它在叙事质量、叙事连贯性与视觉一致性全部维度上一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 多镜头视频生成流水线只依赖文本镜头计划或已生成像素，缺少传播事件后果、跨镜头维护视频世界状态的显式机制，导致缺失细节被错误重建、视觉漂移逐镜头累积。
Method: 分离权威语义计划与不可靠视觉观测：维护实体放置与故事相关状态的结构化表示，传播事件诱导的状态变化以定义每个镜头的预期起止状态；为复现实体与环境构建 canonical reference，把状态与视觉约束编译成可执行渲染计划；再用有界的评估引导修复回路 (evaluation-guided repair loop) 纠正局部状态不一致。
Result: 新建覆盖多样场景与视觉风格的长故事基准，指标衡量 storytelling quality、narrative coherence 与 visual consistency；实验显示 StoryEngine 在全部评估维度上一致优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 把跨镜头世界状态做成权威、可传播、可编译渲染的显式结构，是同时保住长视频叙事因果推进与视觉一致性的有效路径。

papers.title: Learning Dynamics of Continual Learning: A Unified View of Data Attribution, Forgetting, and Plasticity Loss
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models are likely to be updated throughout their lifetime rather than trained once and frozen. Each update therefore participates in a recurring cycle: decide which experience to learn from, understand what that update changes, and remain capable of learning from what comes next. We show that these challenges are governed by the same evolving update--behavior interaction. We derive a token- and layer-wise decomposition of how learning from one token changes another prediction. By separating the softmax force, shared readout geometry, and residual connections, it exposes two interaction channels and yields a forward-computable approximation. Following this interaction through time reveals a unified picture of continual adaptation. Positive interaction identifies useful experience; negative interaction produces either concentrated collision or accumulated erosion; over longer horizons, updates reshape the shared geometry mediating future learning signals, reducing their transmission. These predictions lead to effective data selection, mechanism-specific controls for interference, and a readout-based diagnostic of future learnability whose degradation predicts the benefit of restoring the readout. Across models and training regimes, the same local interaction thus explains both what an update changes now and how learning today changes what can be learned tomorrow. This view connects data attribution, forgetting, and plasticity loss as distinct regimes of the same evolving learning dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把持续学习中的数据选择、遗忘与可塑性损失统一为同一条随时间演化的 token 间更新-行为交互：正交互指示有用经验，负交互表现为集中碰撞或累积侵蚀，长时程上更新重塑共享 readout 几何、削弱后续学习信号的传递。由此得到可前向计算的交互近似，导出数据选择、机制特定的干扰控制，以及一个基于 readout 的未来可学习性诊断，其退化可预测恢复 readout 的收益。
Motivation: 语言模型在其生命周期中会被反复更新，每次更新都要选经验、理解改动并保持继续学习的能力；这些挑战此前被当作数据归因、遗忘、可塑性损失三个独立问题。
Method: 推导 token 与 layer 级分解，刻画学习一个 token 如何改变另一预测；把 softmax force、共享 readout 几何与 residual connections 分离，得到两条交互通道与可前向计算的近似，并沿时间追踪该交互。
Result: 正交互可用于识别有用经验；负交互产生集中碰撞或累积侵蚀；长时程上更新重塑共享几何、降低未来学习信号的传递。基于此给出数据选择、机制特定的干扰控制，以及退化可预测恢复 readout 收益的 readout 诊断，并称在多种模型与训练机制上同一局部交互同时解释更新的即时改变与今日学习如何改变明日可学内容。
Conclusion: 数据归因、遗忘与可塑性损失是同一演化学习动力学的不同机制区间，可用统一的局部交互视角解释与控制。

papers.title: ParaAgent: Reinforcing Parallel Acting in Open-World Tool Environments
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents are increasingly deployed in open-world tool environments, which require balancing exploring unknown capabilities and exploiting known ones. Existing methods face a performance-efficiency tradeoff: they either rigidly decouple exploration and execution or interleave them without coordination. We argue that the key lies not in whether to decouple or interleave them, but in how to coordinate them across granularities. We introduce ParaAct, a structured parallel-action loop that combines phase-level Exploration $\rightleftharpoons$ Execution with action-level parallelism. To learn this loop, ParaAgent combines multi-agent cold-start demonstrations with reinforcement learning under multi-level advantage decoupling, making planning structure explicit and supervising it with step-, phase-, and trajectory-level rewards. Learning is supported by our ToolEnv, a scalable simulator grounded in 50,011 realistic tool interfaces. On two open-world tool benchmarks, ParaAgent-4B achieves the best average success among all baselines, including GPT-4.1 systems, with the largest gains on multi-tool tasks. Behavioral analyses show that these gains stem from this action organization, highlighting its importance for capable and efficient open-world agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParaAgent 提出 ParaAct 并行动作循环，把阶段级探索与执行交替和动作级并行结合起来，用多智能体冷启动示范加多层优势解耦的强化学习训练，显式监督步骤、阶段、轨迹三级奖励。在两个开放世界工具基准上，ParaAgent-4B 平均成功率超过包括 GPT-4.1 系统在内的全部基线，多工具任务提升最大。
Motivation: 开放世界工具环境中探索未知能力与利用已知能力难以兼顾：现有方法要么僵硬地解耦二者，要么无协调地交织，形成性能与效率的取舍。
Method: ParaAct 结构化并行动作循环，阶段级 Exploration ⇌ Execution 与动作级并行结合；训练用多智能体冷启动示范加多层优势解耦 (multi-level advantage decoupling) 的强化学习，以步骤级、阶段级、轨迹级奖励监督显式规划结构；学习由 ToolEnv 支撑，这是一个基于 50,011 个真实工具接口的可扩展模拟器。
Result: 在两个开放世界工具基准上，ParaAgent-4B 取得所有基线（含 GPT-4.1 系统）中最好的平均成功率，多工具任务上提升最大；行为分析显示收益源于该动作组织方式。
Conclusion: 跨粒度协调探索与执行（而非纠结解耦还是交织）是开放世界工具智能体能力与效率的关键，动作组织本身带来可测的成功率收益。

papers.title: SpatialSpeak: QA-Native Reconstruction with Local and Global Context for Spatial Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can benefit from geometric priors for multi-view spatial reasoning, yet answer-only training does not directly supervise the intermediate geometric estimates and their use in deriving quantitative spatial answers. We hypothesize that spatial chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision becomes more effective when the VLM first jointly learns complementary local geometry and global scene context through multi-view reconstruction. We introduce SpatialSpeak, a two-stage framework that connects QA-native reconstruction pretraining with spatial CoT learning. In Stage I, QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining (QA-RP) combines marked-point 3D queries for fine-grained local geometry with object-center queries for global scene context across views. Both tasks are formulated as text-based question answering, allowing geometric estimation and subsequent reasoning to share the same autoregressive output interface. In Stage II, spatial CoT with Visual Compensation (CoT-VC) trains the model to express question-relevant geometric estimates and use them to derive answers, with reliability assessment and visual compensation supporting answer refinement when needed. On ReVSI, QA-RP increases the gain from CoT-VC from 2.6 to 6.9 points, and ablations show that both local and global reconstruction supervision are beneficial. SpatialSpeak achieves state-of-the-art results on ReVSI, VSI-Bench, and SPAR-Bench, with a ReVSI score of 62.8 that exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 8.7 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpatialSpeak 用两阶段框架把多视图重建预训练与空间思维链 (spatial CoT) 训练接到同一个自回归文本问答接口上：Stage I 的 QA-RP 用 marked-point 3D 查询学局部几何、object-center 查询学跨视图全局场景上下文，Stage II 的 CoT-VC 让模型先写出与问题相关的几何估计再据此推答案。在 ReVSI 上 QA-RP 把 CoT-VC 的增益从 2.6 分抬到 6.9 分，最终 ReVSI 得分 62.8，超出最强对比基线 8.7 分。
Motivation: 只用答案监督的 VLM 训练不会直接监督中间几何估计及其在推导定量空间答案中的使用，多视图空间推理因此缺少几何先验与推理过程的对齐信号。
Method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 的 QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining (QA-RP) 把 marked-point 3D 查询（细粒度局部几何）与 object-center 查询（跨视图全局场景上下文）都表述为文本问答，使几何估计与后续推理共享同一自回归输出接口；Stage II 的 spatial CoT with Visual Compensation (CoT-VC) 训练模型表达问题相关的几何估计并据此推导答案，配合可靠性评估与视觉补偿在需要时细化答案。
Result: 在 ReVSI 上，QA-RP 使 CoT-VC 的增益从 2.6 分提高到 6.9 分；消融显示局部与全局重建监督均有益。SpatialSpeak 在 ReVSI、VSI-Bench、SPAR-Bench 上取得 state-of-the-art，ReVSI 得分 62.8，超出最强对比基线 8.7 分。
Conclusion: 先通过 QA 化的多视图重建联合学到局部几何与全局场景上下文，再做空间 CoT 训练，比只用答案监督更有效；局部与全局两种重建监督缺一不可。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EAT: Expert Account Tracker for Efficient MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as a revolutionary method to scale Transformer models. However, traditional MoE architecture still suffers from inefficiency since a large number of experts are unnecessarily activated. Existing approaches for reducing the number of activated experts often overlook the historical performance of each expert. In this paper, we propose EAT, a novel method called Expert Account Tracker (EAT), which utilizes history-awareness metrics and adaptive thresholding to dynamically select the most important experts, thereby reducing the activated expert number while effectively maintaining the model performance. Experiments show that EAT outperforms the existing baseline Top-P method across multiple models and datasets, achieving over 25% an average reduction compared to the vanilla method in the number of activated experts and performing better token generation speed compared to the baseline. Furthermore, the performance of pruned models can be efficiently recovered via OPD using only 9K data. Additionally, through ablation studies, we find that excessively reducing the number of activated experts can significantly harm model performance, and the importance of experts varies across layers, with higher-level experts being generally more critical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EAT（Expert Account Tracker）用历史感知的专家重要性度量加自适应阈值动态挑选要激活的专家，在保持模型性能的同时把激活专家数相对 vanilla 方法平均降低 25% 以上，且 token 生成速度快于 Top-P 基线；剪掉的专家用 OPD 仅 9K 数据即可恢复性能。消融显示激活专家数降得过多会显著损害性能，且高层专家通常更关键。
Motivation: 传统 MoE 架构会激活大量其实不必要的专家，现有减少激活专家数的方法忽略了每个专家的历史表现，导致效率与性能难以兼顾。
Method: EAT 为每个专家维护历史感知的重要性度量，并用自适应阈值动态决定激活哪些专家，从而在减少激活数量的同时维持模型性能；剪枝后的模型再用 OPD 恢复。
Result: 在多个模型与数据集上超过 Top-P 基线：相对 vanilla 方法平均减少 25% 以上的激活专家数，token 生成速度优于基线；剪枝模型用 OPD 仅需 9K 数据即可高效恢复性能。消融显示激活专家数降得过多会显著损害性能，专家重要性随层变化，高层专家一般更关键。
Conclusion: 按历史表现自适应地选专家可以在不明显掉点的前提下大幅削减 MoE 激活开销，但削减存在下限，且专家重要性应按层区别对待。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quizzing the Translation: A Prover-Grounded Evaluation Metric for NL$\rightarrow$FOL
papers.abstract_en: A standard pipeline for symbolic reasoning over natural-language problems translates them into first-order logic and invokes a theorem prover. The translation step is the bottleneck: swap "every" for "some" and every inference that follows is corrupted. Yet today's metrics often score more broken translations higher than less broken ones, because BLEU, BERTScore, and Smatch++ reward surface overlap that the worst errors happen to preserve. We introduce SIV, which derives two kinds of probes from the target formula and uses a theorem prover to verify the candidate translation against each. Positive probes are statements the candidate must entail, which detect translations that drop content; contrastive probes are statements the candidate must not entail, which detect translations that assert more than the original. On a controlled pool of perturbed FOLIO translations, the severity of the error accounts for 80% of SIV's score variance, compared with at most 17% for any prior metric. Across six error classes on a disjoint pool, SIV scores the reference above the perturbed candidate in over 99% of pairs. Because each probe is labeled with what it tests, the failure pattern also supplies a labeled error trace, recovering the perturbation class at macro-F1 0.638, nearly double the score-only baseline. On 434 expert-audited real LLM translations, SIV attains the top AUC, uniquely detects and grades expert-labeled major errors, and abstains, rather than mis-scoring, on out-of-vocabulary translations.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/pu-suo/siv-metric
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出定理证明器支撑的 NL→FOL 翻译评测指标 SIV：从目标公式导出正向探针（候选必须蕴含，抓内容丢失）与对比探针（候选不得蕴含，抓过度断言），用证明器逐条验证。在受扰 FOLIO 翻译池上，错误严重度解释 SIV 分数方差的 80%（既有指标至多 17%），六类错误的不相交池上 99% 以上配对中参考译文得分更高。
Motivation: 自然语言到一阶逻辑的翻译是符号推理管线的瓶颈，一个量词替换会污染后续全部推理，但 BLEU、BERTScore、Smatch++ 按表层重合打分，反而常给错误更严重的译文更高分。
Method: SIV 从目标 FOL 公式生成两类探针：正向探针要求候选蕴含以检测内容丢失，对比探针要求候选不蕴含以检测过度断言；每条探针由定理证明器验证，并标注其检测的错误类型，从而输出带标签的错误轨迹。评测在受控扰动的 FOLIO 翻译池、六类错误的不相交池与 434 条专家审校的真实 LLM 译文上进行。
Result: 受控扰动池上错误严重度解释 SIV 分数方差的 80%，既有任一指标至多 17%；不相交池六类错误中 SIV 在超过 99% 的配对里给参考译文高于扰动候选；错误轨迹恢复扰动类别的 macro-F1 为 0.638，接近分数基线的两倍；在 434 条专家审校译文上 SIV 取得最高 AUC，唯一能检出并分级专家标注的重大错误，对词表外译文选择弃权而非误判。
Conclusion: 按证明器可验证的蕴含/非蕴含探针打分，比表层重合指标更能随错误严重度单调变化，并同时产出可审计的错误类别轨迹；对词表外输入的弃权行为使指标在真实 LLM 输出上可用。

summary_sections.motivation: 自然语言到一阶逻辑的翻译是符号推理管线的瓶颈，一个量词替换会污染后续全部推理，但 BLEU、BERTScore、Smatch++ 按表层重合打分，反而常给错误更严重的译文更高分。

summary_sections.result: 受控扰动池上错误严重度解释 SIV 分数方差的 80%，既有任一指标至多 17%；不相交池六类错误中 SIV 在超过 99% 的配对里给参考译文高于扰动候选；错误轨迹恢复扰动类别的 macro-F1 为 0.638，接近分数基线的两倍；在 434 条专家审校译文上 SIV 取得最高 AUC，唯一能检出并分级专家标注的重大错误，对词表外译文选择弃权而非误判。

papers.title: Anguinus Sculpturae: Compositional Synthesis of Peak-Enhancement Breast DCE-MRI Scans
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is rich in anatomical and perfusion information, but its reliance on gadolinium-based contrast agents raises safety concerns and adds cost. Virtual contrast enhancement, synthesizing post-contrast from pre-contrast images, is a promising alternative. We address the MAMA-SYNTH challenge task of predicting peak-enhancement breast MRI. Rather than adopting the full machinery of diffusion or flow matching, we observe that under a rectified, straight-line path the generative process collapses to a single difference prediction: the synthetic peak image is the pre-contrast image plus a predicted enhancement map, recovered in one forward pass. Around this we build Anguinus Sculpturae, a compositional pipeline in which nnU-Net segmentations of lesion, foreground and breast region guide two generators - one optimized for global fidelity, one for lesion structure through an asymmetric Tversky term routed via a frozen segmenter - composited region-wise with Gaussian-weighted blending. On the held-out Duke subset of MAMA-MIA our model achieves the best FRD and Dice among all evaluated variants, showing that single-step difference prediction with segmentation guidance suffices to recover both global fidelity and lesion structure. Code is available at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/AnguinusSculpturae.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral at the MAMA-SYNTH 2026 challenge / Deep-BreAth 2026 Workshop, MICCAI 2026. 12 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MAMA-SYNTH 挑战的峰值期乳腺 DCE-MRI 合成，Anguinus Sculpturae 把生成过程压成一次前向的差分预测：合成峰值图 = 术前图像 + 预测增强图。nnU-Net 对病灶、前景、乳腺区域的分割引导两个生成器（一个保全局保真、一个用非对称 Tversky 项经冻结分割器约束病灶结构），再按区域用高斯加权融合合成。在 MAMA-MIA 的 Duke 留出子集上，该模型在所有被评估变体中取得最佳 FRD 与 Dice。
Motivation: DCE-MRI 依赖钆对比剂，带来安全性顾虑并增加成本；虚拟增强（由平扫合成增强图像）是替代路径，而峰值期预测需要同时保住全局保真与病灶结构。
Method: 在 rectified 直线路径下把生成过程化简为单次差分预测（pre-contrast + 预测增强图，一次前向恢复）；以 nnU-Net 对病灶、前景、乳腺区域的分割引导两个生成器——一个优化全局保真，一个通过冻结分割器路由的非对称 Tversky 项优化病灶结构——最后按区域用高斯加权混合合成。
Result: 在 MAMA-MIA 的 Duke 留出子集上，该模型在所有被评估变体中取得最佳 FRD 与 Dice；代码开源于 github.com/MIC-DKFZ/AnguinusSculpturae。
Conclusion: 带分割引导的单步差分预测足以同时恢复峰值期乳腺 MRI 的全局保真与病灶结构，无需 diffusion 或 flow matching 的完整机制。

papers.title: Supervision Recovery for Time Series Anomaly Detection via Context-Anchored Pairing
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) remains challenging not only because anomaly labels are scarce, but also because temporal anomalies are highly context-dependent. Existing methods often rely on unsupervised objectives or surrogate abnormal patterns, providing limited supervision for context-dependent normal--anomalous distinctions. We propose Context-Anchored Pair Supervision (CAPS), a supervision-recovery framework for TSAD. CAPS views ideal anomaly supervision as a matched comparison between normal and anomalous outcomes under the same temporal context, and seeks to recover such supervision without target-domain anomaly labels. Using simulated normal--anomalous pairs, CAPS learns structure and anomaly-semantic representations through reconstruction, background consistency, and within-pair counterfactual recombination. The resulting anomaly representations form a continuous semantic space with coarse modes and induce a sampleable multimodal prior. CAPS conditionally realizes sampled semantics as residual-form effects on target reference trajectories. The resulting context-anchored normal--anomalous counterparts provide temporal supervision for discriminative detector learning. Experiments on nine datasets show that CAPS achieves the strongest aggregate performance across all four evaluation metrics among the compared methods, while complementary ablations and transfer analyses support the roles of context anchoring, semantic disentanglement, and conditional realization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAPS 把时序异常检测中稀缺的异常标签当作「同一时间上下文下正常与异常结果的配对比较」来恢复：用模拟的正常-异常对，经重构、背景一致性与配对内反事实重组学到解耦的异常语义，再把采样语义条件化实现为目标参考轨迹上的残差效应，生成带上下文锚定的正常-异常对应样本，为判别式检测器提供时序监督。在九个数据集上，CAPS 在全部四项评估指标的综合表现上强于所比较的方法。
Motivation: 时序异常检测 (TSAD) 的异常标签稀缺，且时间异常高度依赖上下文；现有无监督目标或代理异常模式无法提供区分上下文相关正常-异常所需的监督。
Method: CAPS 是监督恢复 (supervision-recovery) 框架：先用模拟的正常-异常配对，通过重构、背景一致性 (background consistency) 与配对内反事实重组 (within-pair counterfactual recombination) 学习结构表示与异常语义表示，得到带粗粒度模式的连续语义空间并诱导可采样的多模态先验；再把采样语义条件化实现为目标参考轨迹上的残差形式效应，产出上下文锚定的正常-异常对应样本，用于训练判别式异常检测器，全程不使用目标域异常标签。
Result: 在九个数据集上，CAPS 在所比较方法中取得四项评估指标的最强综合表现；补充消融与迁移分析支持上下文锚定、语义解耦与条件化实现各自的作用。
Conclusion: 在无目标域异常标签的条件下，把异常监督重构为同一上下文下的正常-异常配对比较，是提升 TSAD 判别学习的有效路径，且上下文锚定、语义解耦与条件化实现三者缺一不可。

papers.title: You Only Edit Once: Incentivizing In-Context Capability of LLMs via Local Demonstration Refinement
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) is crucial for boosting the inference performance of large language models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of ICL in LLMs is greatly influenced by the choice of demonstration sets. Exhaustive searches over these sets are combinatorial, and existing selectors often rely on relevance or likelihood proxies to implicitly assess ICL quality. Making repeated queries to the target LLM with these strategies can incur substantial costs. This work simplifies selection by framing it as a constrained local search problem and presents local demonstration editing (LDE). Starting with an initially retrieved set of demonstrations, LDE employs a single structured edit to explore its surrounding neighborhood while balancing performance gains with search costs. Technically, LDE is reduced to a policy search problem, for which we train a small LLM, referred to as Jev-LDE. This model as the System-1 modifies the retrieved demonstration set by performing actions such as \texttt{Keep}, \texttt{Delete}, or \texttt{Replace} elements, all within a framework of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. At test time, Jev-LDE executes a single edit of the retrieved demonstration set, followed by one inference from the target LLM, avoiding the need for iterative context scoring or subset searches. Across standard classification benchmarks, various target LLMs with Jev-LDE as the plug-and-play module consistently improve ICL performance, and Jev-LDE shows transferability to held-out benchmarks and models without retraining. These findings indicate that the LDE approach offers an efficient and adaptable method for harnessing the ICL capabilities of target LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ICL 示例选择改写成受约束的局部搜索，只做一次结构化编辑：训练小模型 Jev-LDE 作为 System-1，用可验证奖励的强化学习学会对检索到的示例集执行 Keep/Delete/Replace 单步操作，随后对目标 LLM 只做一次推理。在标准分类基准上，作为即插即用模块对多种目标 LLM 一致提升 ICL 性能，并可零重训练迁移到留出基准与模型。
Motivation: 示例集的穷举搜索是组合爆炸的，现有选择器靠相关性或似然代理隐式评估 ICL 质量，反复查询目标 LLM 成本高。
Method: 将示例选择建模为受约束的局部搜索并归约为策略搜索问题：以检索到的示例集为起点，用 RL with verifiable rewards 训练小模型 Jev-LDE 执行 Keep、Delete、Replace 动作，测试时只做一次编辑加一次目标 LLM 推理，不做迭代上下文打分或子集搜索。
Result: 在标准分类基准上，Jev-LDE 作为即插即用模块对多种目标 LLM 一致提升 ICL 性能；在留出基准与未见过的模型上无需重训练即可迁移。
Conclusion: 单次局部编辑加一次推理足以替代迭代打分与子集搜索来撬动目标 LLM 的 ICL 能力，且该编辑策略可跨基准、跨模型迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Transferable Reaction Mechanisms from Visual Chemical Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Reaction mechanisms describe the step-by-step transformations underlying chemical reactions and are central to reaction analysis and synthesis. Learning-based models have achieved strong performance on established mechanism-prediction benchmarks, but transferring them to unseen chemistry remains challenging. Such transfer is difficult because familiar mechanisms must be applied to unfamiliar molecular structures, and some target mechanisms may be poorly covered by the training data. To address these challenges, we introduce MechaVLM, a visual framework that combines transferable chemical representations with external mechanistic knowledge. It learns reusable visual features through multiscale chemical grounding and cross-rendering contrastive learning. For open-book prediction, MechaVLM retrieves a fixed set of precedents from 70,384 literature mechanism figures and re-reads relevant visual evidence as the molecular state evolves, directly using the figures without symbolic mechanism parsing. An atom-indexed language decoder then recursively generates executable electron edits to construct the complete mechanism. We further introduce MechBench, a challenging literature-derived benchmark with 2,184 mechanisms and 9,146 elementary steps. Across cross-dataset and literature-derived benchmarks, MechaVLM establishes strong zero-shot mechanism prediction. Its closed-book model alone improves Step/Pathway Top-1 by 12.50/13.93 percentage points on FlowER-to-ReactMech transfer, while external visual precedents unlock further gains on challenging OOD reactions. The learned representation also generalizes beyond mechanism prediction to atom mapping and reaction center prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MechaVLM：把文献机理图当作可检索的外部知识，用多尺度化学 grounding 与跨渲染对比学习学可迁移视觉表征，再由原子索引语言解码器递归生成可执行的电子转移编辑。闭书模型在 FlowER 到 ReactMech 迁移上把 Step/Pathway Top-1 分别提高 12.50/13.93 个百分点，检索 70,384 张文献机理图的开书模式在 OOD 反应上进一步增益。
Motivation: 机理预测模型在既有基准上表现好，但迁移到未见化学体系困难：熟悉机理要套用到陌生分子结构，且部分目标机理在训练数据中覆盖不足。
Method: MechaVLM 通过 multiscale chemical grounding 与 cross-rendering contrastive learning 学可复用视觉特征；开书预测时从 70,384 张文献机理图中检索固定数量的先例，随分子状态演化重读视觉证据，不做符号机理解析；atom-indexed language decoder 递归生成可执行电子编辑以构造完整机理。另提出文献衍生基准 MechBench，含 2,184 个机理与 9,146 个基元步骤。
Result: 闭书模型在 FlowER-to-ReactMech 迁移上 Step/Pathway Top-1 分别提升 12.50/13.93 个百分点；外部视觉先例在困难 OOD 反应上带来进一步增益；在跨数据集与文献衍生基准上展现强零样本机理预测，表征还可迁移到 atom mapping 与 reaction center prediction。
Conclusion: 把文献机理图作为可检索的外部视觉先例并配合可迁移表征，能在零样本与 OOD 机理预测上取得强表现，且学到的表征可跨任务复用。

papers.title: Hierarchical Response Preservation for Continual Adaptation of Zero-Shot Graph-Text Models
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained graph-text models align graph representations with textual semantics, enabling recognition of unseen classes and transfer across graph domains. However, as graph data and classes continually arrive, models should learn from new supervision while retaining their zero-shot transfer capabilities and historical task knowledge. Two challenges arise: (i) new classes can overturn historical predictions despite preserved distinctions among historical classes, and (ii) overly strict response preservation can stall learning of new classes. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Response Preservation (HiRP). HiRP represents this competition through a hierarchical response that keeps each historical-class probability and sums new-class probabilities, preserving historical distinctions and aggregate competition while allowing distinctions within the new class group to adapt. It further uses the geometry induced by this response to guide constrained updates, retaining useful adaptation directions while controlling response drift. Across three class-incremental settings, HiRP achieves absolute gains of 1.84-7.95 percentage points in average accuracy over the strongest compared baseline in each setting, while mitigating zero-shot transfer degradation.

papers.title: Short-Length Code Designs for Integrated Sensing and Communications: A Deep Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables joint communication and sensing using a shared waveform, but its signal design is challenging due to the inherent trade-off between the two objectives, particularly in the short blocklength regime. This paper proposes an autoencoder (AE)-based framework for ISAC waveform design in noncoherent settings. We derive a modified Cramér-Rao bound for multi-target delay estimation and analyze the maximum-likelihood decoding rule for noncoherent communication under correlated fading. These results reveal structural connections and trade-offs between communication and sensing objectives in waveform design. Based on this analysis, the AE learns waveform representations that jointly optimize both functionalities, with a tunable parameter controlling the trade-off. Simulation results show that the proposed design outperforms conventional schemes in both communication reliability and sensing accuracy, especially under short blocklength and fading conditions.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, preprint of a journal paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在短码长、非相干相关衰落条件下，用自编码器 (autoencoder) 联合设计 ISAC 波形，把通信可靠性与感知精度放进同一个可调权衡参数里优化。仿真显示该设计在通信可靠性与感知精度上同时优于传统方案，短码长与衰落条件下优势更明显。
Motivation: ISAC 用同一波形兼顾通信与感知，但两目标存在固有权衡，短码长 (short blocklength) 制约下传统波形设计难以两头兼顾。
Method: 推导多目标时延估计的修正 Cramér-Rao bound，并分析相关衰落下非相干通信的最大似然译码规则，从中得到通信与感知目标的结构性联系与权衡；再让 autoencoder 学习联合优化两功能的波形表示，用一个可调参数控制权衡。
Result: 仿真结果表明所提设计在通信可靠性与感知精度上均优于传统方案，尤其在短码长与衰落条件下。
Conclusion: 把 CRB 与 ML 译码分析嵌入 autoencoder 目标，可在短码长非相干 ISAC 中用单一可调参数在通信与感知之间取舍并同时超过传统方案。

papers.title: ViCoR: Reliable Molecular Structure Extraction via Spatially Aligned Verification and Executable Revision
papers.abstract_en: Reliable optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) is essential for building high-quality chemical data from scientific literature, yet even small recognition errors can propagate into chemical databases and downstream models. In practice, recognized structures often require manual inspection and correction before use, making large-scale data curation costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study Selective Structure Recognition (SSR), a post-recognition setting that automatically produces reliable structured outputs while rejecting unresolved cases. Selection-only approaches can improve reliability by rejection, but cannot create additional correct outputs beyond those produced by the base recognizer. We propose ViCoR, a repair-before-rejection framework for iterative VerIfiCatiOn and Revision. Its key idea is to make observation-prediction correspondence explicit: coordinate-preserving rendering establishes spatial correspondence between the source image and predicted structure, while index anchoring maps localized visual discrepancies to executable graph edits without full-structure regeneration. A shared VLM is progressively trained from verification to revision. On two real-world OCSR benchmarks, ViCoR improves overall accuracy from 73.53\% to 88.26\% and from 61.83\% to 84.32\%, while achieving over 97\% accepted accuracy at 85--89\% coverage. The resulting molecular data further improve reaction-extraction F1 by 15.5 points and literature-sourced reaction prediction accuracy by 7.7 and 5.8 points, demonstrating the value of automated reliability control for scientific data curation and downstream chemical learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViCoR 针对光学化学结构识别 (OCSR) 提出“先修复再拒绝”的迭代验证-修订框架：用 coordinate-preserving rendering 建立源图与预测结构的空间对应，用 index anchoring 把局部视觉差异映射为可执行的图编辑，共享 VLM 从验证渐进训练到修订。在两个真实 OCSR benchmark 上整体准确率从 73.53% 提到 88.26%、从 61.83% 提到 84.32%，覆盖率 85–89% 时接受准确率超过 97%。
Motivation: OCSR 的小识别错误会污染化学数据库并传导到下游模型，实际使用前常需人工检查修正，难以规模化；仅靠拒绝的选择性方法无法在基础识别器之外产生新的正确输出。
Method: ViCoR 是 repair-before-rejection 的迭代 VerIfiCatiOn and Revision 框架：coordinate-preserving rendering 在源图与预测结构间建立空间对应，index anchoring 将局部视觉差异定位为无需整结构重生成的可执行图编辑，同一个 VLM 从 verification 阶段渐进训练到 revision 阶段，未解决的样本才被拒绝。
Result: 两个真实 OCSR benchmark 上整体准确率分别由 73.53% 提升至 88.26%、由 61.83% 提升至 84.32%；在 85–89% 覆盖率下接受准确率超过 97%。所得分子数据使 reaction-extraction F1 提高 15.5 点，literature-sourced reaction prediction 准确率分别提高 7.7 点和 5.8 点。
Conclusion: 在拒绝之前先做空间对齐的验证与可执行修订，能在保持高接受准确率的同时产出更多正确结构，其可靠性控制对科学数据整理和下游化学学习有直接增益。

papers.title: JustQuant: You Don't Need Smoothing, SVD, or Rotation for 4-Bit Activation Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Recent generative models have become increasingly powerful, but their inference cost continues to grow. Model quantization offers a promising way to compress these models and accelerate inference. However, at 4 bits, activation quantization is substantially more challenging than weight quantization. Recent post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) methods have made progress in 4-bit activation quantization by introducing smoothing, SVD branches, rotations, mixed precision, or advanced formats such as NVFP4. These additional operators and data types impose demanding requirements on inference engines and hardware, limiting the broad adoption of low-precision models. Can quantization be achieved using only plain low-bit operators? To answer this question, we propose JustQuant, a simple yet effective framework that moves the complexity of low-bit quantization from deployment-time operators into the training process. We first revisit model quantization from the perspective of knowledge distillation and show that a key reason existing PTQ and QAT methods fail is that they typically exploit supervision at only a single level. We then introduce Theseus QAD, a quantization-aware distillation method that progressively applies multi-level supervision, analogous to the gradual replacement process in the Ship of Theseus. Extensive experiments on DiT and diffusion large language models show two distinct regimes. For smaller models, Theseus QAD can serve as a lightweight warm-up stage that substantially improves subsequent QAT with plain operators, while naive QAD may collapse in the same setting. For larger models, Theseus QAD provides a stronger distillation training path than ordinary QAD. Across both regimes, JustQuant improves low-bit quantization quality while avoiding the complex operators required by many existing PTQ methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JustQuant 把 4-bit 激活量化的复杂度从部署算子搬进训练过程，只用普通低比特算子完成量化。它从知识蒸馏视角重审量化，提出 Theseus QAD：像忒修斯之船逐步换板那样施加多层监督。在 DiT 与 diffusion LLM 上呈两种体制——小模型中 Theseus QAD 作为轻量 warm-up 显著提升后续 QAT 而朴素 QAD 会崩溃，大模型中它比普通 QAD 提供更强的蒸馏训练路径。
Motivation: 4-bit 激活量化比权重量化难得多，现有 PTQ/QAT 依赖 smoothing、SVD 分支、旋转、混合精度或 NVFP4 等额外算子与数据类型，对推理引擎和硬件要求苛刻，阻碍低精度模型广泛部署。
Method: 从知识蒸馏视角重新审视量化，指出既有方法失败关键在于只在单一层次施加监督；据此提出 Theseus QAD（quantization-aware distillation），渐进式施加多层监督，把低比特量化复杂度从部署期算子前移到训练过程，最终仅用 plain low-bit 算子完成部署。
Result: 在 DiT 与 diffusion 大语言模型上的实验显示两个不同体制：较小模型中 Theseus QAD 可作轻量 warm-up，显著改善后续使用 plain 算子的 QAT，而 naive QAD 在同设置下会崩溃；较大模型中 Theseus QAD 提供比 ordinary QAD 更强的蒸馏训练路径；两种体制下 JustQuant 均提升低比特量化质量并规避许多现有 PTQ 所需的复杂算子。
Conclusion: 把量化难度从部署算子转移到训练期多层监督蒸馏，就能用纯低比特算子达到更好的 4-bit 激活量化质量，从而绕开对推理引擎与硬件的额外要求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Price of Peeking: Anytime-Valid Leakage Detection on ML-KEM EM Traces
papers.abstract_en: Side-channel evaluators routinely inspect leakage tests while acquisition is still running, and extend or stop the campaign based on what they see. Fixed-horizon screening such as the Welch $t$-test with threshold $|t|>4.5$ gives no error guarantee for this monitored decision rule. We study anytime-valid leakage detection based on testing by betting: SKIT-type swap-pair e-processes whose false-alarm probability is controlled uniformly over time under an explicit conditional symmetry null. In matched comparisons that share the frozen witness, rows and payoff, first-crossing detection needed 1.68-2.00$\times$ the traces of a fixed-horizon randomization test at 80% detection on synthetic streams, and 1.68-2.38$\times$ on degraded recordings from an open ML-KEM electromagnetic dataset with the primary Ridge witness at $α=0.05$. With the same primary witness and level, on undegraded reference and pqm4 recordings the monitored procedure stopped early: its median stopping point was 62-72 and 146-316 evaluation traces, i.e. 2-8% of a conservative 4096-trace budget. Under exact designed nulls on the recorded backgrounds, repeated-look $|t|>4.5$ screening over all 13000-20000 samples raised a false alarm in 2.7-12.9% of replicates, against 0.0-4.7% for terminal-only screening and no rejection by a sample-wise e-Bonferroni process, which in a prespecified follow-up detected natural-label associations in 4 of 4 backgrounds after 840-3288 traces. All recordings come from one device, and natural-label results are descriptive; we state the assumptions each claim requires.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables. Code and aggregate results: https://github.com/securagenai/price-of-peeking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对侧信道评估中边采集边看检验结果的监测式决策，提出基于 testing by betting 的 anytime-valid 泄漏检测：SKIT 型 swap-pair e-process 在条件对称零假设下把误报概率在时间上一致控制。代价是检测更慢——在 80% 检出率下首越检测需要固定期随机化检验 1.68–2.00 倍（合成流）与 1.68–2.38 倍（ML-KEM 电磁数据退化记录）的轨迹数；但在未退化记录上监测程序提前停止，中位停点 62–72 与 146–316 条评估轨迹，仅为保守 4096 条预算的 2–8%。
Motivation: 侧信道评估人员在采集过程中反复查看 Welch t 检验（阈值 |t|>4.5）并据此延长或终止测试，这种 monitored decision rule 在固定期筛查下没有任何错误率保证，反复查看会显著抬高误报。
Method: 用 SKIT 型 swap-pair e-process 做 anytime-valid 检测，在显式条件对称零假设下经 betting 控制全时段误报；与共享同一 frozen witness、rows 和 payoff 的固定期随机化检验做 matched comparison；另设 sample-wise e-Bonferroni 过程与预设的 follow-up 检验，主 witness 为 Ridge，水平 α=0.05。
Result: 80% 检出率下首越检测所需轨迹为固定期随机化检验的 1.68–2.00 倍（合成流）与 1.68–2.38 倍（ML-KEM 电磁数据集退化记录，Ridge witness，α=0.05）；未退化 reference 与 pqm4 记录上监测程序提前停止，中位停点 62–72 与 146–316 条评估轨迹，占 4096 条保守预算的 2–8%。在记录背景的精确设计零假设下，对全部 13000–20000 样本反复查看的 |t|>4.5 筛查在 2.7–12.9% 的重复中误报，仅终末查看为 0.0–4.7%，sample-wise e-Bonferroni 过程零拒绝；其预设 follow-up 在 840–3288 条轨迹后于 4/4 个背景中检出 natural-label 关联。
Conclusion: 反复查看的固定期筛查会系统性抬高误报，anytime-valid e-process 能给出全时段错误保证并大幅提前停止，代价是检出更慢；全部记录来自单一设备，natural-label 结果仅为描述性，各结论依赖其声明的假设。

summary_sections.result: 80% 检出率下首越检测所需轨迹为固定期随机化检验的 1.68–2.00 倍（合成流）与 1.68–2.38 倍（ML-KEM 电磁数据集退化记录，Ridge witness，α=0.05）；未退化 reference 与 pqm4 记录上监测程序提前停止，中位停点 62–72 与 146–316 条评估轨迹，占 4096 条保守预算的 2–8%。在记录背景的精确设计零假设下，对全部 13000–20000 样本反复查看的 |t|>4.5 筛查在 2.7–12.9% 的重复中误报，仅终末查看为 0.0–4.7%，sample-wise e-Bonferroni 过程零拒绝；其预设 follow-up 在 840–3288 条轨迹后于 4/4 个背景中检出 natural-label 关联。
