papers.title: Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding world models enable visual planning by learning action-conditioned dynamics in latent space. Yet they are commonly trained for one-step prediction on encoded states, while planning recursively applies the learned transition to its own predictions. One-step accuracy therefore does not capture how prediction errors propagate under recursive rollout. We decompose multi-step rollout error into the errors introduced at individual steps and their propagation through subsequent transitions. We show that state-affine dynamics are precisely the differentiable transitions with state-independent Jacobians, eliminating the nonlinear propagation residual and making the error propagation operators depend only on the action sequence. Guided by this result, we introduce SALT (State-Affine Latent Transition), an action-conditioned state-affine dynamics model in which the action modulates both the state transformation and the additive update. We train SALT through recursive multi-step rollout supervision, feeding each predicted latent state back into the transition so that training matches how the model is used during planning. Across four visual planning environments, SALT exhibits $1.48$--$2.19\times$ higher one-step prediction error than the matched LeWM baseline, yet improves closed-loop success in every environment by $10.0$ percentage points on average. On OGBench-Cube, the fraction of episodes that fail with a sharp rise in model-predicted cost after execution decreases from $23.3%$ to $2.0%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉规划中一步预测误差不等于递归 rollout 的误差传播，SALT 用状态仿射 (state-affine) 潜空间转移把传播算子变成只依赖动作序列，消除非线性传播残差，并用多步递归 rollout 监督训练。四个视觉规划环境里它一步预测误差比 LeWM 高 1.48–2.19 倍，闭环成功率却平均高 10.0 个百分点，OGBench-Cube 上执行后代价骤升的失败回合从 23.3% 降到 2.0%。
Motivation: 联合嵌入世界模型按一步预测训练，但规划时把学到的转移递归地作用于自身预测，一步精度无法刻画误差如何在多步 rollout 中累积放大。
Method: 把多步 rollout 误差分解为各步引入误差与其后继转移中的传播；证明状态仿射动力学恰是状态无关 Jacobian 的可微转移，从而消除非线性传播残差、使传播算子只依赖动作序列。据此提出 SALT：动作同时调制状态变换与加性更新，训练时把预测潜状态反馈回转移，用递归多步 rollout 监督对齐规划时的实际用法。
Result: 在四个视觉规划环境中，SALT 的一步预测误差比匹配的 LeWM 基线高 1.48–2.19 倍，但每个环境的闭环成功率平均提高 10.0 个百分点；在 OGBench-Cube 上，执行后模型预测代价急剧上升而失败的回合比例从 23.3% 降到 2.0%。
Conclusion: 一步预测精度与规划可靠性可以背离：状态仿射转移加递归 rollout 监督牺牲一步精度却换来更稳的闭环执行，误差传播只由动作序列决定是可靠视觉规划的关键。

papers.title: LoopLUT: 3D Lookup Tables with Progressive Region Refinement for Real-Time 4K Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Color enhancement of 4K images must meet a quality target under a tight compute budget. Three-dimensional lookup tables (3D LUTs) dominate real-time enhancement because they decide at low resolution and apply a per-pixel lookup at full resolution. A single global LUT, however, is spatially invariant, so an underexposed shadow and a well-exposed region that share a pixel value receive identical corrections. Spatially heterogeneous demands cannot be expressed by such a mapping. We propose LoopLUT, a region-cascaded 3D LUT with progressive refinement. A global LUT performs the overall correction, followed by K-1 loop iterations. In each iteration a gating head predicts at low resolution the region that still needs correction, then builds a residual LUT from the color statistics of that region alone. The cascaded gates form a partition of unity, so the output is a per-pixel convex combination of the K lookup results. Fusion is therefore performed by the gates themselves, with no separate fusion module and no interpolation error accumulating across rounds. The decision stage runs at a fixed 256x256 resolution, independent of output resolution, so a 4K image costs only K pure lookups. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks show that LoopLUT improves PSNR by up to 2.81 dB over the strongest prior method, while keeping real-time throughput at 4K. The same decomposition also generalizes well to underwater enhancement datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopLUT 用区域级联的 3D LUT 做 4K 图像色彩增强：全局 LUT 先整体校正，再由 K-1 轮门控头在低分辨率上找出仍需校正的区域并只用该区域颜色统计建残差 LUT，门控构成 partition of unity，输出是 K 个查表结果的逐像素凸组合。决策阶段固定在 256×256，与输出分辨率无关，4K 图只需 K 次纯查表；在四个 benchmark 上比最强先前方法 PSNR 最多提升 2.81 dB，并保持 4K 实时吞吐。
Motivation: 单一全局 3D LUT 空间不变，欠曝阴影与曝光良好区域若像素值相同会得到相同校正，无法表达空间异质的增强需求，而 4K 增强又受严格算力预算约束。
Method: 区域级联 3D LUT：全局 LUT 做整体校正后接 K-1 轮循环，每轮门控头在低分辨率预测仍需校正的区域，仅用该区域颜色统计构建残差 LUT；级联门控构成 partition of unity，逐像素凸组合 K 个查表结果，无需独立融合模块。决策阶段固定 256×256，与输出分辨率解耦。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 上，LoopLUT 相比最强先前方法 PSNR 最多提升 2.81 dB，同时保持 4K 实时吞吐；同一分解在水下增强数据集上也表现出良好泛化。
Conclusion: 把 3D LUT 拆成全局校正加门控残差级联，可在固定低分辨率决策下兼顾空间异质校正与 4K 实时性，且该分解可迁移到水下增强。

papers.title: Pretraining Transformers with Quantized Softmax in Attention
papers.abstract_en: Low-precision Transformer systems increasingly quantize attention matrix multiplications, while softmax often remains at higher precision. During pretraining, an approximate softmax changes the gradients that train the model as well as its forward computation. We study this interaction with K-interval attention, which approximates the exponential using K+1 grid values. We vary per-row grid calibration, interpolation versus hard rounding, and the placement of a straight-through surrogate relative to normalization. We derive the corresponding backward rules, including calibration derivatives, and compare these choices in pretraining experiments matched on model, data, and optimizer. Detaching the row extrema leaves the forward computation unchanged but produces a delayed increase in validation loss. With hard rounding at K=4, min-max calibration and a pre-normalization surrogate incur a large loss gap; changing either choice substantially reduces it. At 124M parameters and 2.5B training tokens, fixed-window calibration with a post-normalization surrogate yields a validation loss gap of +0.019 nats relative to softmax at K=4, and with a pre-normalization surrogate yields +0.004 nats at K=16.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究预训练阶段用 K-interval attention 近似 softmax 时前向与梯度的耦合：在 124M 参数、2.5B token 的预训练上，固定窗口校准 (fixed-window calibration) 加归一化后 STE 代理 (post-normalization surrogate) 在 K=4 时验证损失仅比精确 softmax 高 +0.019 nats，K=16 配归一化前代理为 +0.004 nats；而 K=4 配 min-max 校准加归一化前代理会出现大损失缺口，改动其中任一项即显著缩小。
Motivation: 低精度 Transformer 系统普遍量化注意力矩阵乘法却让 softmax 保持高精度；预训练中近似 softmax 同时改变前向计算与训练所用梯度，这一交互此前缺少系统的反向规则与对照实验。
Method: 以 K-interval attention（用 K+1 个网格值近似指数）为对象，推导含校准项导数的反向规则；在模型、数据、optimizer 对齐的预训练实验中，逐项变化每行网格校准方式（min-max vs fixed-window）、插值 vs 硬取整 (hard rounding)、以及 straight-through 代理置于归一化前还是归一化后，并测试 detach 行极值。
Result: detach 行极值不改变前向计算但导致验证损失延迟上升；K=4 下 min-max 校准 + 归一化前代理造成大的损失缺口，替换任一选择都明显缩小；124M 参数、2.5B token 上，fixed-window 校准 + 归一化后代理在 K=4 得到相对 softmax 的验证损失缺口 +0.019 nats，归一化前代理在 K=16 为 +0.004 nats。
Conclusion: 近似 softmax 的梯度设计（校准方式与 STE 代理相对归一化的位置）与前向精度同等决定预训练质量，选对组合后 K=4 即可把损失缺口压到 +0.019 nats、K=16 压到 +0.004 nats。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: TGRL: Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Exploration in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Efficient exploration often remains a central bottleneck in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Although temperature control and test-time scaling strategies can increase rollout diversity of large language models (LLMs), they either expand the sample budget at rollout time or leave the benefit of exploration unquantified. To this end, we propose Temperature-Grouped Reinforcement Learning (TGRL), which turns temperature-induced diversity into an explicit training signal. For each prompt, TGRL partitions its rollout group into low- and high-temperature subsets, estimates exploration gain through their reward contrast, and allocates this group-level signal as token-level credit using Jensen--Shannon (JS) divergence between the corresponding temperature-scaled next-token distributions induced by the same logits. Notably, TGRL reaches equivalent accuracy up to 36% faster than strong RLVR baselines without expanding the rollout budget. Across 11 benchmarks from diverse domains, TGRL broadly improves over strong RLVR baselines: it improves the six-benchmark math average by 1.6% at 32B, raises CodeForces rating by 196.7 points and LiveCodeBench Pass@16 by 4.4%, and improves ALFWorld/WebShop success rates by 6.3%/4.9%. Comprehensive ablations and wall-clock analysis confirm the efficacy of all proposed components. Code is available at https://github.com/1229095296/TGRL/tree/main.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TGRL 把温度诱导的多样性变成显式训练信号：按 prompt 把 rollout 组切成低温/高温子集，用两者 reward 差估计探索增益，再按同一 logits 下温度缩放 next-token 分布的 Jensen–Shannon 散度把组级信号分配到 token 级 credit。在不扩大 rollout 预算的前提下，达到同等精度最多快 36%，11 个基准上普遍优于强 RLVR 基线。
Motivation: RLVR 中高效探索仍是核心瓶颈：温度控制与 test-time scaling 能提高 LLM rollout 多样性，但前者在 rollout 时扩大样本预算，后者的探索收益无法量化。
Method: 对每个 prompt 将 rollout 组划分为低温与高温子集，通过两者的 reward 对比估计 exploration gain；用同一 logits 诱导的温度缩放 next-token 分布之间的 JS 散度，把组级信号作为 token 级 credit 分配，作为训练目标的一部分。
Result: 达到同等精度最多比强 RLVR 基线快 36%，且不扩大 rollout 预算；在 11 个跨领域基准上，32B 模型六项数学基准平均提升 1.6%，CodeForces rating 提升 196.7 分，LiveCodeBench Pass@16 提升 4.4%，ALFWorld/WebShop 成功率分别提升 6.3%/4.9%；消融与 wall-clock 分析确认各组件有效。
Conclusion: 把温度分组的 reward 对比与 JS 散度 credit 结合，可以在不增加 rollout 预算的情况下加速 RLVR 收敛并跨域提升性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: Approximating Softmax in Pretrained LLMs: Model Sensitivity and Kernel Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: On NVIDIA Blackwell B200, tensor-core throughput outpaces special-function exponential throughput by more than two orders of magnitude, exposing exponential evaluation in fused attention kernels. A pretrained Transformer, however, may not need it evaluated accurately at every element. We characterize what a pretrained model does need by approximating softmax at inference in ten frozen decoder-only models (0.5B-72B). The number of positions the softmax map assigns probability to and within-row resolution can be cut substantially, yet uniform weighting of the same positions is damaging. Where a fixed resolution budget is placed matters as much as its size, with resolution near the row maximum consistently favored. Perturbations matched on scalar distortion produce model-dependent responses of opposite sign. These findings motivate Rowmax-PoT, a coarse logarithmic weight representation anchored at each row maximum, and Rowmax-H15, its hardware specialization in FlashAttention-4. Measured separately on the BF16 kernel path at 2K, Rowmax-H15 increases perplexity by 0.091-0.492% across five models from three families.

papers.title: IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Content (AIGC) necessitates robust and interpretable detection mechanisms. However, existing detectors are predominantly confined to single modalities and provide binary outputs without reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) present a promising solution, their development is constrained by the scarcity of multimodal reasoning data and the reasoning-detection optimization dilemma, where explicit reasoning supervision can compromise detection accuracy. To this end, we introduce IVT-Set, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 152K diverse image, video, and text samples equipped with multi-granularity Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Based on it, we propose IVT-Guard, a pioneering framework for unified and interpretable AIGC detection across image, video, and text modalities. Furthermore, to overcome the aforementioned optimization dilemma, we design a novel three-stage training paradigm: Artifact-Aware Pre-training, Artifact-to-Evidence Supervised Fine-Tuning via artifact-aware injection, and Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IVT-Guard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-dataset settings while delivering faithful reasoning. Code and data will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IVT-Guard 是统一处理图像、视频、文本三模态 AI 生成内容 (AIGC) 检测的推理模型，配套发布含 152K 以上样本与多粒度 CoT 推理轨迹的 IVT-Set 数据集。三阶段训练（Artifact-Aware 预训练、artifact-aware injection 的证据监督微调、Evidence-Verdict Consistency GRPO）用于化解显式推理监督与检测精度互相拉扯的优化困境，在域内、跨域、跨数据集设定上均达到 SOTA 检测性能并给出忠实推理。
Motivation: 现有 AIGC 检测器局限于单一模态且只输出二值结果、无可解释推理；用 MLLM 解决又受多模态推理数据稀缺与「推理监督损害检测精度」这一优化困境制约。
Method: 构建 IVT-Set（152K 以上图像、视频、文本样本，配多粒度 Chain-of-Thought 轨迹），据此提出 IVT-Guard 框架；训练走三阶段：Artifact-Aware Pre-training、经 artifact-aware injection 的 Artifact-to-Evidence 监督微调、Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization。
Result: 在 in-domain、out-of-domain、cross-dataset 三类设定上均取得 state-of-the-art 检测性能，同时输出 faithful reasoning；数据规模为 152K 以上多模态样本。
Conclusion: 统一的多模态推理式 AIGC 检测可行，且推理监督与检测精度的矛盾可通过 artifact-aware 注入加一致性 GRPO 缓解；代码与数据将开源。

papers.title: Fill2SR: Repurposing Inpainting Diffusion Transformers for Real-World Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Recent real-world image super-resolution (SR) methods often adapt text-to-image (T2I) backbones with ControlNet-style branches or spatial conditioning tokens, which increases memory and computes with resolution and often constrains training to a fixed scale. We propose Fill2SR, which repurposes a masked-inpainting Diffusion Transformer for SR without extra spatial branches. Our Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) writes the low-quality (LQ) observation into the native masked-image slot under a full-image mask, turning inpainting into a reverse-degradation conditional rectified flow trained with LoRA-only tuning. We further introduce RCDT, an offline pipeline that distills degradation descriptors from unpaired real images and transfers them onto clean targets using frozen open-source models. Fill2SR supports mixed-resolution training up to QHD and yields stable performance across $512/1024/2048$ outputs. On synthetic benchmarks, our base model with IIEA achieves the best LPIPS on DIV2K and LSDIR; adding RCDT trades a small LPIPS drop for consistently stronger no-reference quality on RealLQ250 and RealPhoto60. Fill2SR remains memory-predictable, running $1536^2$ inference on a single 32GB GPU and extending to multi-megapixel outputs via tiled restoration.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026. 26 pages, 12 figures, including an 8-page appendix with additional visual results
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, Part XXIV, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 17024, pp. 441-457 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fill2SR 把掩码图像修复 (masked inpainting) 的 Diffusion Transformer 直接改造成真实世界超分辨率：用 Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) 把低质量图像写进原生掩码槽位，在全图掩码下把修复任务转成逆退化条件 rectified flow，仅用 LoRA 微调。在合成基准上基线模型 IIEA 在 DIV2K 与 LSDIR 上取得最佳 LPIPS，加入 RCDT 后以小幅 LPIPS 下降换取 RealLQ250 与 RealPhoto60 上更稳定的无参考画质。
Motivation: 现有真实世界 SR 多在 T2I 骨干上加 ControlNet 分支或空间条件 token，显存与计算随分辨率增长，且训练常被锁死在固定缩放比例上。
Method: IIEA 在全图掩码下把 LQ 观测写入修复模型的原生 masked-image 槽位，将 inpainting 转为逆退化条件 rectified flow，仅用 LoRA-only 微调；RCDT 是离线管线，用冻结的开源模型从不成对真实图像蒸馏退化描述子并迁移到干净目标上。支持混合分辨率训练至 QHD。
Result: 合成基准上带 IIEA 的基线模型在 DIV2K 与 LSDIR 上取得最佳 LPIPS；加上 RCDT 后 LPIPS 小幅下降，但在 RealLQ250 与 RealPhoto60 上无参考画质一致更强。输出在 512/1024/2048 分辨率上表现稳定，1536² 推理可在单张 32GB GPU 上运行，并可通过 tiled restoration 扩展到多兆像素输出。
Conclusion: 不加额外空间分支、只靠把 LQ 塞进修复接口并配 LoRA，就能把 inpainting DiT 变成显存可预测、跨分辨率稳定的真实世界 SR；RCDT 用少量 LPIPS 换取真实图像上的无参考质量提升。

papers.title: ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForeFly 用双时域隐式世界动作模型同时预测近端未来与自适应的路线关键未来，前者保证局部动作连续性、后者给长程路线引导，并通过 Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR) 非对称地用近端预测增强局部动作、用路线关键预测做特征级修正与路线级引导。在 TravelUAV 与 UAV-ON 基准的 seen 与 unseen 设置上均稳定超越强基线。
Motivation: 现有 Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) 方法多为反应式或只做单时域预测，忽略了不同时间尺度上互补的未来线索，导致 UAV 长轨迹复杂 3D 环境中的指令跟随不可靠。
Method: 提出双时域隐式世界动作模型：horizon-specific foresight queries 由近期视觉记忆与路线关键视觉记忆共同 priming，得到历史感知的未来预测上下文；再用 Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR) 非对称利用两种预测——近端 foresight 做局部动作增强，路线关键 foresight 做 feature-wise correction 与路线级引导。
Result: 在 TravelUAV 与 UAV-ON 两个基准上，ForeFly 在 seen 与 unseen 设置中均持续优于强基线，验证了双时域 foresight 与 FGAR 学习的有效性。
Conclusion: 把近端连续性与路线关键引导拆成两个时域并用非对称方式接入动作生成，是提升 AVLN 长轨迹指令跟随的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Compressing Value Predictions for Learning-Augmented Metrical Task Systems
papers.abstract_en: Learning-augmented algorithms for metrical task systems (MTS) can exploit predictions of canonical dual values, but existing formulations typically require a prediction for every state. We study whether these predictions can be compressed to a small set of representative states while retaining their algorithmic value. We introduce landmark-compressed value predictions, in which the predictor reports predicted dual values only at $m$ landmarks and the remaining values are reconstructed by a Lipschitz extension. Our algorithm achieves additive excess cost $O(T\,r(L) + \sum_t δ_t)$, where $r(L)$ is the covering radius of the landmarks and $δ_t$ measures prediction error up to additive shifts; local and value-dependent bounds refine this guarantee. For sparse landmark sets on unit-spaced finite lines, we prove a matching $Ω(T r_m)$ lower bound for every randomized algorithm using fixed landmarks, even with advance access to their entire exact absolute-value table. The prediction interface also matters: on two states with one landmark, exact absolute values permit horizon-independent excess, whereas exact relative values force worst-case expected excess linear in $T$. We give PAC guarantees for learning compressed prediction tables, with efficient empirical-risk minimization for fixed landmarks. Our results connect metric coverage, prediction interfaces, and learning guarantees for compressed predictions in online MTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MTS 的对偶值预测从逐状态压缩到 m 个 landmark，再用 Lipschitz 扩展重建其余状态，仍可保住算法价值：多余代价为 O(T r(L) + Σ δ_t)，其中 r(L) 是 landmark 覆盖半径。对单位间隔有限直线上的稀疏 landmark 集，任何用固定 landmark 的随机算法都有 Ω(T r_m) 下界；接口选择同样决定成败——两状态一 landmark 时，精确绝对值可让多余代价与视野无关，精确相对值则迫使期望多余代价在 T 上线性。
Motivation: 学习增强的 MTS 算法通常要求对每个状态都给出预测，状态数大时预测表本身成为瓶颈；需要在压缩预测的同时保住竞争性保证。
Method: 提出 landmark-compressed value predictions：预测器只在 m 个 landmark 上报告预测对偶值，其余值由 Lipschitz 扩展重建；给出带局部与值依赖细化的算法与多余代价界，并为固定 landmark 下学习压缩预测表给出 PAC 保证及高效 ERM。
Result: 多余代价上界 O(T r(L) + Σ_t δ_t)；对单位间隔有限线的稀疏 landmark 集证明匹配的 Ω(T r_m) 下界，且对任何使用固定 landmark 的随机算法成立，即使提前获知其完整精确绝对值表；两状态一 landmark 时，精确绝对值允许多余代价与视野无关，而精确相对值迫使最坏情形期望多余代价随 T 线性增长。
Conclusion: 压缩预测在 MTS 中可行且代价由 landmark 覆盖半径刻画，但预测接口（绝对值 vs 相对值）与覆盖几何共同决定能否避免随视野线性增长的损失。

papers.title: OpenFC: Learning Verification Policies towards Open-Search Fact Checking
papers.abstract_en: Open-search fact checking is not merely retrieval followed by classification, but a sequential decision problem in which every query, source visit, and stopping decision reshapes the evidence available for verification. Yet existing systems often distribute these decisions across predefined pipelines or separately prompted modules rather than learning them as a unified task-specific policy. We introduce \textbf{OpenFC}, a unified verification-policy training framework that post-trains Qwen3-8B as a compact next-action controller over reasoning, evidence acquisition, and stopping. OpenFC learns this policy in two stages. \textbf{Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start (SCCS)} uses a strong training-time supervisor to review post-initial reasoning, tool-use, and stopping proposals before execution, producing reliable trajectories for supervised fine-tuning without access to gold verdicts. \textbf{Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning (VA-RL)} then improves the cold-start policy on unresolved claims through budget-aware tool rewards, label-aware advantage reweighting, and localized response masking. Across six fact-checking benchmarks, OpenFC achieves 70.39\% average accuracy and 63.30\% macro-F1, the highest overall averages among the evaluated methods. Stage-wise ablations further show that SCCS and VA-RL provide complementary gains, supporting the design of the two-stage training framework. These results position OpenFC as a strong and effective framework for open-search fact-checking. We will open-source our code and release the model checkpoints to support reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenFC 把开放搜索事实核查当作序贯决策问题，用统一策略后训练 Qwen3-8B 作为下一步动作控制器，协调推理、取证与停止。两阶段训练（SCCS 冷启动 + VA-RL 强化）在六个事实核查基准上取得 70.39% 平均准确率与 63.30% macro-F1，为所评估方法中的最高总体均值。
Motivation: 开放搜索事实核查中每次查询、访问与停止都会改变可用证据，但现有系统把这些决策拆进预定义流水线或分别 prompt 的模块，没有作为统一的任务相关策略学习。
Method: OpenFC 后训练 Qwen3-8B 为紧凑的 next-action 控制器。第一阶段 Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start (SCCS) 用强训练时 supervisor 在执行前审查初始后的推理、工具使用与停止提议，在无 gold verdict 条件下产出可靠轨迹做 SFT；第二阶段 Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning (VA-RL) 在未解决声明上用 budget-aware tool rewards、label-aware advantage reweighting 与 localized response masking 改进冷启动策略。
Result: 在六个事实核查基准上，OpenFC 平均准确率 70.39%、macro-F1 63.30%，为所评估方法中最高总体均值；分阶段消融显示 SCCS 与 VA-RL 带来互补增益。
Conclusion: 把推理、取证与停止作为统一策略分两阶段训练，是开放搜索事实核查的有效框架；作者将开源代码与模型检查点。

papers.title: HiLoRe: What to Store, Compress, or Recompute for Efficient GRPO Training
papers.abstract_en: Group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) makes learner-side activations a major memory-computation bottleneck: gradient checkpointing reduces activation memory through recomputation, but fixed schedules can leave roughly 18 GB unused on a 48-GB GPU despite substantial recomputation overhead. Existing activation-management methods set state fidelity from execution cost, tensor properties, or generic compression sensitivity, without explicitly incorporating GRPO's analytic update structure into state-fidelity allocation. We formalize this dependence as policy-update exposure, linking the current GRPO loss coefficients to state-level approximation sensitivity. These coefficients are available before backward without an additional backward pass. We introduce HiLoRe, which allocates graph-attributed recovery units among high-precision storage, low-precision compression, and deterministic recomputation using measured recovery utility and update-conditioned approximation risk. It combines high-precision storage and deterministic recomputation with low-precision recovery under a calibrated risk budget. Across five model-task settings with 2K responses and memory < 1.10 times GC's per-GPU actor-update peak, HiLoRe's actor-update throughput gains reach 13.5% over GC and 7.9% over the fastest evaluated baseline, with paired mean downstream-score differences below 0.6 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiLoRe 把 GRPO 的解析更新结构（policy-update exposure）引入激活管理，按恢复效用与更新条件下的近似风险，把图归因的恢复单元分配到高精度存储、低精度压缩和确定性重算三路，并在校准的风险预算下组合。在 5 个模型-任务设置（2K responses、显存 <1.10× GC 的 per-GPU actor-update 峰值）中，actor-update 吞吐比 GC 高 13.5%、比最快对比基线高 7.9%，下游分数配对均值差 <0.6 个百分点。
Motivation: GRPO 训练中 learner 侧激活是显存-计算瓶颈：固定调度的 gradient checkpointing 在 48 GB GPU 上可浪费约 18 GB 显存，同时带来可观重算开销；现有激活管理方法只按执行成本、张量属性或通用压缩敏感度设定状态保真度，未把 GRPO 的解析更新结构纳入保真度分配。
Method: 将当前 GRPO 损失系数与状态级近似敏感度的联系形式化为 policy-update exposure，这些系数在 backward 之前即可获得、无需额外反向；HiLoRe 依据实测恢复效用 (recovery utility) 与更新条件化的近似风险，把图归因的恢复单元 (graph-attributed recovery units) 分配到高精度存储、低精度压缩与确定性重算，并在校准的风险预算下组合三者。
Result: 在 5 个模型-任务设置、2K responses、per-GPU actor-update 峰值显存 <1.10× gradient checkpointing 的条件下，actor-update 吞吐提升最高达 13.5%（对比 GC）和 7.9%（对比所评测的最快基线），配对均值下游分数差异 <0.6 个百分点；固定调度 GC 在 48 GB GPU 上可留下约 18 GB 未用显存。
Conclusion: 把 GRPO 的损失系数当作状态保真度分配信号，可以在不增加反向开销、下游分数基本不变的前提下同时省显存并提高 actor-update 吞吐。

papers.title: Terminal-Register Certification for Finite-Measurement Learning of Multiscale Quantum States
papers.abstract_en: Structured quantum-state learning not only depends on an expressive ansatz but also on an operational certificate that stays meaningful with finite measurements and imperfect implementation. We study pure one dimensional states learning by an inverse binary multiscale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA). In the learning procedure, the qubits removed during coarse graining are controlled coherently and measured together at the terminal register. We confirm that an ideal sequential and terminal measurement schedule delivers the same complete bit string distribution under matched causal operations, while normalized postselection can amplify perturbations inversely with prefix acceptance. A noise aware theorem introduces an individual calibrated total variation implementation budget to the finite shot certificate. The protocol is estimated on an open boundary transverse field Ising ground state. A frozen 8-qubit schedule using $560$ million simulated training measurements per run achieves fidelity above $0.99$ in all $60$ held-out runs, with a mean fidelity of $0.996886$. 1080 circuit-noise cells and 6480 confidence-coverage rows are covered by fixed-circuit robustness validation without a locked soundness violation. We then address architectural fairness at $n=16$ using three new studies. In a 120-run exact-gradient multistart diagnostic, MERA has higher fidelity in 58/60 paired restarts and lower long-range error in 60/60, although no run met the prespecified stationarity criterion. Finally, a causal cone-complete, parameter matched local circuit achieves $2.62\times$ greater aggregate gate exposure yet loses all 30 paired comparisons in fidelity, long-range error, energy, and entropy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出有限测量下的量子态学习认证方案：用 inverse binary MERA 学习一维纯态，把粗粒化中移除的 qubit 在终端寄存器统一受控测量，并给出带独立校准总变差实现预算的噪声感知定理。在开放边界横场 Ising 基态上，8-qubit 冻结调度每轮用 5.6 亿次模拟训练测量，60 次留出运行保真度全部超过 0.99、均值 0.996886；n=16 时 MERA 在 58/60 配对重启中保真度更高、长程误差 60/60 更低，而参数匹配的局域电路即使门暴露量高 2.62 倍仍在全部 30 组配对比较中落败。
Motivation: 有限测量与实现噪声下，量子态学习的 ansatz 表达力之外还缺少在实际条件下仍然有效的操作性认证；归一化后选择会按前缀接受率倒数放大扰动，使证书失效。
Method: 用 inverse binary MERA 学习一维纯态，粗粒化移除的 qubit 被相干控制并在终端寄存器一起测量；证明理想序贯测量与终端测量在匹配因果操作下给出相同完整比特串分布；引入噪声感知定理，为有限 shot 证书加入逐项校准的总变差 (total variation) 实现预算，并在固定电路上做鲁棒性验证。
Result: 开放边界横场 Ising 基态上，8-qubit 冻结调度每轮 5.6 亿次模拟训练测量，60 次留出运行保真度均 >0.99、均值 0.996886；1080 个电路噪声单元与 6480 行置信覆盖在固定电路鲁棒性验证中无 soundness 违例。n=16 的 120 次 exact-gradient 多启动诊断中，MERA 在 58/60 配对重启保真度更高、长程误差 60/60 更低，但无一运行达到预设平稳性判据；因果锥完备、参数匹配的局域电路门暴露量高 2.62 倍，却在保真度、长程误差、能量、熵全部 30 组配对比较中落败。
Conclusion: 终端寄存器认证加噪声感知总变差预算，可在有限测量与实现噪声下给出有效的 MERA 学习证书；架构公平性比较表明单纯增加门暴露量不等于更好的态学习。

papers.title: Correct then Forecast: Observer State-Space Models for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting requires extrapolating the dynamics of an observed process beyond the last available measurement. Yet recurrent forecasting models typically treat observations as inputs that directly control their latent dynamics. It leads to a regime change when these observations become unavailable at prediction time. Following a state-estimation perspective, we introduce Observer State-Space Models (OSSMs), a class of recurrent models that interprets the observed input time series as measurements of an underlying autonomous dynamical system. OSSMs explicitly separate latent-state propagation from measurement assimilation: a single transition governs the dynamics across both context and forecasting intervals, while available observations correct the estimated state through an observer. This formulation naturally exposes classical control-theoretic properties, including observability and convergence of the state estimation error. We further show that conventional and recent SSMs can be recovered as particular instances of our OSSM framework, thereby providing a unified interpretation of their recurrent dynamics and revealing modeling inconsistencies. We perform experiments across several benchmarks showing that OSSM achieves substantial improvements while maintaining the same parameter count and training setup as the corresponding SSM baseline. These results support a simple principle for recurrent forecasting: observations should correct the estimated latent state, rather than control the dynamics used to propagate it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Observer State-Space Model (OSSM)：把输入时间序列当作对一个自主动力系统的观测，用单一 transition 贯穿 context 与 forecast 两段，观测只通过 observer 校正估计状态而不驱动动力学。在多个基准上，OSSM 在与对应 SSM 基线相同参数量和训练设置下取得显著提升，并可把常规与近期 SSM 恢复为特例。
Motivation: 循环预测模型通常让观测直接控制隐状态动力学，一旦预测期观测缺失就出现 regime change；需要把状态传播与观测校正分开的建模范式。
Method: OSSM 将隐状态传播与测量同化 (measurement assimilation) 显式分离：单一 transition 同时作用于 context 与 forecast 区间，可用观测经 observer 校正估计状态；框架暴露可观测性与状态估计误差收敛等控制论性质，并把常规及近期 SSM 归约为其特例。
Result: 在多个基准上，OSSM 在与对应 SSM 基线相同的参数量与训练设置下取得 substantial improvements；同时给出 SSM 作为 OSSM 特例的统一解释并指出其建模不一致。
Conclusion: 循环预测的核心原则是：观测应校正估计的隐状态，而不是控制用于传播该状态的动力学。

summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上，OSSM 在与对应 SSM 基线相同的参数量与训练设置下取得 substantial improvements；同时给出 SSM 作为 OSSM 特例的统一解释并指出其建模不一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 循环预测的核心原则是：观测应校正估计的隐状态，而不是控制用于传播该状态的动力学。

papers.title: Dr. Free: You Don't Need Difficulty Rewards for Self-Evolving Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: A central limitation of current data-free self-evolution methods for training search agents is their reliance on difficulty-based proposer rewards. These methods reward a proposer for generating questions that challenge a co-evolving solver, using solver difficulty as a proxy for question quality. Yet difficulty alone is insufficient to distinguish questions that require cross-passage evidence from those that are answerable via simpler shortcuts. In addition, measuring difficulty demands repeated solver rollouts for every candidate question, leading to substantial computational costs. In this paper, we introduce \methodname, the first self-evolving search framework that eliminates difficulty-based proposer rewards and directly optimizes for evidence necessity relative to shortcut contexts. Dr. Free samples relational chains from a knowledge graph and pairs them with aligned passages, giving question generation an explicit multi-hop structure. A generated question receives a positive information-gain reward only when the likelihood of the target answer under the complete evidence passages exceeds the maximum likelihood under all evaluated shortcut contexts. Because this signal is computed from teacher-forced likelihoods, it removes the need for pass-rate estimation and reduces proposer training time by over $7\times$. Experiments on seven open-domain QA benchmarks show that Dr. Free outperforms prior data-free search agents and the supervised baseline, with large improvements on multi-hop QA benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dr. Free 抛弃难度奖励，直接以“证据必要性”训练自进化搜索智能体：从知识图谱采样关系链并配对段落生成多跳问题，只有当完整证据下目标答案似然高于所有捷径上下文的最大似然时才给正的信息增益奖励。该信号基于 teacher-forced 似然计算，proposer 训练时间降低 7 倍以上，在七个开放域 QA 基准上超过既往 data-free 搜索智能体与监督基线，多跳 QA 提升最大。
Motivation: data-free 自进化搜索智能体依赖难度作为问题质量代理，既无法区分真正需要跨段证据的问题与可用捷径作答的问题，又要对每个候选问题反复 rollout 估计通过率，计算代价高。
Method: Dr. Free 从知识图谱采样关系链并与对齐段落配对，为问题生成提供显式多跳结构；奖励为信息增益，仅当完整证据段落下目标答案似然超过所有已评估捷径上下文的最大似然时取正值；该信号由 teacher-forced likelihood 得到，无需 pass-rate 估计。
Result: proposer 训练时间降低 7 倍以上（over 7×）；在七个开放域 QA 基准上优于既往 data-free 搜索智能体与监督基线，多跳 QA 基准提升幅度最大。
Conclusion: 难度不是问题质量的必要代理：以相对捷径上下文的证据必要性直接优化，可在大幅降低训练开销的同时提升搜索智能体的 QA 表现，尤其在多跳问题上。

papers.title: MA-JEPA: Joint-Embedding World Models for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: World models improve sample efficiency by training policies on imagined trajectories, but their usefulness depends on learning representations that capture the information needed for future control. We study whether self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) can provide this learning signal for multi-agent reinforcement learning. We introduce MA-JEPA, a stochastic world model that replaces observation reconstruction with prediction of target representations, enabling model-based multi-agent reinforcement learning with centralized training and decentralized execution. A categorical latent state and a causal Transformer are trained with posterior and action-conditioned dynamics prediction objectives and are then used for actor-critic learning from latent imagination. A training-only joint predictor conditions on all agents' local states and actions to predict each agent's next local observation embedding. These predictions are passed through the same local posterior used during real interaction with a centralized critic that is used only for value learning, with execution remaining decentralized. Our experiments show that this architecture performs strongly on SMAC, matching or exceeding the strongest reported comparator mean win rate on four of eight evaluated maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MA-JEPA 用自监督 joint-embedding 预测替代观测重建，构建支持集中训练分散执行 (CTDE) 的多智能体随机世界模型：类别隐状态加因果 Transformer 学后验与动作条件动力学，再从隐想象做 actor-critic。在 SMAC 八张地图中四张匹配或超过最强已报告对比方法的平均胜率。
Motivation: 世界模型在多智能体 RL 中的样本效率取决于表征是否保留控制所需信息，而观测重建目标未必学到该信息；论文检验 JEPA 式预测能否提供这一学习信号。
Method: MA-JEPA 以目标表征预测取代观测重建：类别隐状态 (categorical latent state) 与因果 Transformer 用后验目标和动作条件动力学目标训练；训练专用的 joint predictor 条件于所有智能体的局部状态与动作，预测各智能体下一局部观测嵌入，再送入与真实交互相同的局部后验；actor-critic 从隐想象学习，集中式 critic 仅用于价值学习，执行保持分散。
Result: 在 SMAC 上，八张被评估地图中有四张的平均胜率匹配或超过最强的已报告对比方法 (strongest reported comparator mean win rate)。
Conclusion: JEPA 式的表征预测可以作为多智能体世界模型的学习信号，在 SMAC 上取得有竞争力的胜率，同时维持 CTDE 的分散执行约束。

papers.title: OOD Generalization as a Bifurcation Problem
papers.abstract_en: Systematic out-of-distribution (OOD) generation remains a critical bottleneck for continuous-time generative models. While standard joint classifier-free guidance (CFG) routinely fails to synthesize unobserved concept combinations, exact decomposed scoring generalizes robustly at the cost of severe computational overhead. In this work, we reveal that compositional binding is not a uniform process but a highly localized phase transition. We identify the semantic bifurcation window - the precise temporal interval where joint and decomposed vector fields meaningfully diverge. Exploiting this dynamic, we propose surgical guidance, a hybrid sampling strategy that restricts exact multi-pass scoring strictly to this critical window. On an OOD bi-digit MNIST testbed, surgical guidance achieves state-of-the-art compositional fidelity at a fraction of the inference cost, yielding a +5.3% absolute improvement in pairwise accuracy over the joint baseline by intervening during just the first 15% of the diffusion trajectory. Furthermore, our empirical analysis uncovers a fundamental topological divide: diffusion models (SDEs) force conceptual resolution immediately at peak noise, whereas Conditional Flow Matching (ODEs) delays structural binding until intermediate features emerge, establishing a new temporal framework for accelerating large-scale generative decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续时间生成模型的 OOD 组合泛化问题重新表述为分叉问题：联合 CFG 与分解打分的向量场只在轨迹的一段窄区间内显著分歧，即 semantic bifurcation window。surgical guidance 只在该窗口内做精确多遍打分，仅干预扩散轨迹的前 15% 就在 OOD bi-digit MNIST 上把 pairwise accuracy 相对联合基线提高 +5.3 个百分点，达到 SOTA 组合保真度且推理开销只是精确打分的一小部分。
Motivation: 标准联合 CFG 常常无法合成未观测的概念组合，而精确的分解打分虽泛化稳健却带来严重的计算开销，两者之间缺少一个能兼顾保真度与成本的采样策略。
Method: 先定位 joint 与 decomposed 向量场显著分歧的 semantic bifurcation window，再提出 surgical guidance 这一混合采样策略，把昂贵的精确多遍打分严格限制在该窗口内，窗口之外退回联合 CFG；实验在 OOD bi-digit MNIST 测试床上进行，并对比 diffusion (SDE) 与 Conditional Flow Matching (ODE) 的绑定时序。
Result: 在 OOD bi-digit MNIST 上，surgical guidance 取得 SOTA 组合保真度，pairwise accuracy 相对 joint 基线绝对提升 +5.3%，且只在扩散轨迹的前 15% 内干预，推理成本只是精确打分的一小部分。经验分析还发现拓扑分歧：diffusion (SDE) 在峰值噪声处立刻强制概念解析，而 Conditional Flow Matching (ODE) 把结构绑定推迟到中间特征出现时。
Conclusion: 组合绑定是高度局域化的相变而非均匀过程，因此只需在 bifurcation window 内做精确干预即可同时保住 OOD 组合保真度并大幅降低推理开销；SDE 与 ODE 在概念绑定的时间结构上存在根本分歧，为加速大规模生成解码提供了新的时间框架。

papers.title: GraphSelect for Budgeted Representation Selection in Multimodal Graph Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal graph predictors combine text, images, and relations to classify connected entities. How much of this input is needed to preserve their predictions? We study budgeted representation selection, which chooses a subset of candidate text and image vectors under a separate capacity for each modality. Predictions from the complete candidate input define the classes to preserve. The challenge is that a representation's contribution depends on the other selected inputs, while graph propagation extends its effects across nodes. Our empirical study shows that candidate rankings change with the selected input, while predicted probabilities remain informative after the class stops changing. Updating scores improves selection, and exchanging inputs can improve a subset whose capacity is already filled. These findings lead to GraphSelect, which starts from individual candidate gains and refines the subset through jointly evaluated exchanges. It screens promising removals and additions, accepts an exchange when it reduces the prediction loss, and updates the scores. Experiments on six graphs show higher mean objective recovery than six attribution and explanation methods adapted to the selection task. Across nine trained architectures on two graphs, retaining 20% of the candidate representations per modality gives a mean accuracy drop of 0.10 percentage points relative to full candidate input, preserving classification performance with substantially fewer text and image representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphSelect 在多模态图分类中做预算化表示选择：从单个候选增益出发，通过联合评估的交换（exchange）不断精炼子集，接受能降低预测损失的交换并更新打分。在六个图上其平均目标恢复度高于六种归因/解释方法改造成的基线；每个模态只保留 20% 候选表示时，相对全量输入的平均精度仅下降 0.10 个百分点。
Motivation: 多模态图预测器的输入（文本、图像向量）冗余度高，但一个表示的贡献依赖于同时选中的其他输入，且图传播会把这种影响扩散到全图，因此按独立打分挑子集会失真。
Method: GraphSelect 从每个候选的单独增益出发，联合评估移除与加入的交换对，筛选有希望的交换，只有当交换降低预测损失时才接受，并随之更新分数；各模态有独立容量上限，需保留的类别由全量候选输入的预测定义。
Result: 在六个图上，GraphSelect 的平均目标恢复度高于六种适配到选择任务的归因与解释方法；在两个图上的九种已训练架构中，每模态保留 20% 候选表示时，相对全量输入的平均精度下降 0.10 个百分点。经验观察还包括：候选排序随已选输入变化，而预测概率在类别停止变化后仍保持信息量。
Conclusion: 表示选择必须随子集更新打分并允许交换，才能在大幅压缩文本与图像表示的同时保住分类性能。

papers.title: Fine Until Fine-Tuned: Repeated Solutions Make Reasoning Fragile
papers.abstract_en: Recipes such as s1 and LIMO teach a model to reason with little data by showing it the same thousand or fewer worked solutions many times over. Judged when that training ends, the repetition looks harmless. But reasoning models are often trained again, and we find that repetition leaves their reasoning fragile to that next stage, even when the stage has nothing to do with reasoning. We fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B-Base on its own correct solutions to competition math problems, either drilling a few hundred of them about eight times each or showing many more once; with the same amount of training, both solve about 95% of held-out problems. A single pass of ordinary instruction tuning leaves the once-trained model where it was, while the drilled one falls to 86.0%, and harsher later stages take it to 59.3% or below. A third model that visited the drilled problems just as often, with a new solution at every visit, was unharmed, so the damage comes from seeing the same texts again rather than from having few problems. The break recurs with a stronger model's traces, in further training runs and on other models and tasks. It is also cheap to undo: the reasoning is suppressed rather than erased, and five updates of reasoning training bring almost all of it back, as does brief training on the reasoning format with almost no mathematics. Fresh solutions prevented the damage, and so did replaying 6.25% of the original solutions in a gentler later stage, so our claim concerns later training without such replay. Sharpening alone does not explain the break, since a model sharpened three-quarters as much without repetition was unharmed. On a skill the base model could not perform within a token budget, repetition mainly cost learning.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 7 figures. Code, data and outputs: https://github.com/ely2ba/reasoning-durability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 重复刷同一套解题轨迹（s1/LIMO 式训练）会让推理能力在后续微调中变得脆弱：Qwen3.5-9B-Base 用几百道竞赛数学题各练约八遍，与一次性看更多题在训练结束时都解出约 95% 留出题，但一次普通指令微调后刷题模型跌到 86.0%，更严苛的后续阶段跌到 59.3% 或更低。损伤来自重复同一文本而非题量少，且可被 5 步推理训练或 6.25% 原始解的回放廉价修复。
Motivation: s1、LIMO 这类少数据推理配方靠反复展示同一千条以内解法奏效，训练结束时看似无害；但推理模型通常还要再经历后续训练，重复是否留下隐患此前没有判定。
Method: 在 Qwen3.5-9B-Base 上用其自身正确的竞赛数学解做微调，对比两种等训练量配方：几百道各练约八遍（drilled）vs 更多题各看一次（once）；再叠加普通指令微调与更严苛阶段，并设置每次访问都换新解的对照模型、更强模型轨迹、其他模型与任务的复现，以及推理训练/格式训练/6.25% 回放的恢复实验。

papers.title: PGL-3D: Towards Progressive Geometric Learning for 3D Visual Query Localization
papers.abstract_en: 3D Visual Query Localization (3DVQL) retrieves the latest contiguous occurrence of a queried object in an RGB--point-cloud sequence and predicts a 9-DoF cuboid for every response frame. The query is captured independently of the search sequence, so its annotated pose may differ from how the object appears in the search frames. The benchmark baseline predicts cuboids after feature modeling, leaving their geometry unused for subsequent feature refinement. We investigate whether complete intermediate cuboids can improve query and proposal representations before final decoding. We introduce Progressive Geometric Learning for 3DVQL (PGL-3D), a predict--select--refine--re-predict framework that uses intermediate cuboids to guide the aggregation of search evidence and update query and proposal representations. A shared head first predicts a complete cuboid for every proposal. Query--Tube--Memory (QTM) then selects reference observations by combining proposal association, cuboid quality, frame response, and target absence, since association confidence alone establishes neither target presence nor geometric accuracy. The center, size, and orientation of each selected cuboid define soft pooling weights over query-conditioned proposal features. The pooled memory updates the query and proposal representations, and the head re-predicts from the updated features. A training-only objective, ST-D9O, supervises cuboid geometry at every stage by adding boundary, signed-distance, and soft-overlap terms to parameter regression. PGL-3D achieves a mean stAP of $0.270 \pm 0.004$ on 3DVQL, compared with $0.044$ reported for LaF. Ablations support the benefits of geometry-guided feature updates, while stage-wise analyses show improved cuboid accuracy. Replacing the geometry objective in our PROT3D reproduction with ST-D9O improves mAO on GSOT3D from $21.63\%$ to $25.78\%$. Our code and models will be released.
papers.comment: Code and models will be released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PGL-3D 针对 3D 视觉查询定位 (3DVQL) 提出 predict–select–refine–re-predict 框架，用中间完整 cuboid 的中心、尺寸、朝向作为软池化权重去更新查询与 proposal 表征，再重新解码。在 3DVQL 基准上 mean stAP 达 0.270±0.004，对比 LaF 报告的 0.044；在 GSOT3D 上把 PROT3D 复现的几何目标换成 ST-D9O 后 mAO 从 21.63% 升到 25.78%。
Motivation: 3DVQL 中查询与搜索序列独立采集，标注位姿可能与搜索帧中的外观不一致；基线在特征建模后才预测 cuboid，几何信息未被用于后续特征精炼。
Method: 共享头先为每个 proposal 预测完整 cuboid；Query–Tube–Memory (QTM) 结合 proposal 关联、cuboid 质量、帧响应与目标缺失选择参考观测；所选 cuboid 的中心、尺寸、朝向定义软池化权重，池化后的 memory 更新查询与 proposal 表征并重新预测。训练专用目标 ST-D9O 在各阶段以边界、符号距离、软重叠项监督 cuboid 几何。
Result: 3DVQL 上 mean stAP 0.270±0.004，LaF 报告值为 0.044；GSOT3D 上将 PROT3D 复现中的几何目标替换为 ST-D9O，mAO 从 21.63% 提升到 25.78%。消融支持几何引导的特征更新，分阶段分析显示 cuboid 精度改善。
Conclusion: 中间 cuboid 几何应参与查询与 proposal 表征的迭代精炼，而非只在解码末端使用；几何监督目标可跨方法（PROT3D）迁移带来 mAO 提升。

papers.title: Sparsity by Default: The Theory and Practice of ARD in Gaussian Process Regression for Variable Selection
papers.abstract_en: Automatic relevance determination (ARD) is the standard device for input selection in Gaussian process (GP) regression. By giving the covariance kernel a separate lengthscale for every input and learning those lengthscales by maximizing the marginal likelihood, ARD lets the data decide which coordinates matter: irrelevant inputs receive very large lengthscales and are effectively switched off. We trace this mechanism to the Bayesian Occam's razor embodied in the marginal likelihood, derive the gradient through which it prunes inputs, and emphasize that ARD delivers effective rather than exact sparsity. We review the algorithms used in practice and the rules that turn lengthscales into selections, and we survey the asymptotic theory, distinguishing the fixed-domain identifiability obstruction on the lengthscales from the high-dimensional selection-consistency guarantees recently established for hierarchical GP priors, and noting what remains open for plain ARD. We compare ARD with spike-and-slab priors, sparse axis-aligned and global-local shrinkage priors including the Bayesian lasso and horseshoe, penalized likelihood kriging, sensitivity and projection criteria, and additive kernels. We argue that ARD endures because of its seamless integration with kernel learning, universal software support, and low cost, and we close with its limitations and remedies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于高斯过程回归中自动相关性判定 (ARD) 做变量选择的理论与实践综述：给核函数每个输入配一个 lengthscale，通过最大化边缘似然学习，无关输入拿到极大 lengthscale 被 effectively 关掉。其机制源自边缘似然中的 Bayesian Occam's razor，作者给出剪枝所经的梯度，并强调 ARD 得到的是 effective 而非 exact sparsity。
Motivation: ARD 是 GP 回归输入选择的标准手段，但其稀疏性只是近似生效，且 fixed-domain 下 lengthscale 存在可辨识性障碍，与高维选择一致性保证之间的关系需要厘清。
Method: 综述性工作：从边缘似然的 Bayesian Occam's razor 推出剪枝梯度，梳理实践中把 lengthscale 转成选择的规则与算法，并区分 fixed-domain 可辨识性障碍和 hierarchical GP 先验上新近建立的高维选择一致性理论；同时对比 spike-and-slab、稀疏轴对齐与全局-局部收缩先验（Bayesian lasso、horseshoe）、惩罚似然 kriging、敏感性与投影准则以及可加核。
Result: 给出 ARD 剪枝输入的梯度推导，指出 ARD 只实现 effective 而非 exact sparsity；区分 fixed-domain 下 lengthscale 的可辨识性障碍与 hierarchical GP 先验的高维选择一致性保证，并指出 plain ARD 仍开放的问题。
Conclusion: ARD 之所以长期占据标准地位，在于它与核学习无缝集成、软件支持普遍且计算成本低；其局限与补救措施在文末一并讨论。

papers.title: Calibrated Derivative-Process Sensitivity for Gaussian-Process Variable Selection
papers.abstract_en: Automatic relevance determination (ARD), the default tool for variable selection in Gaussian-process (GP) regression, ranks inputs by inverse lengthscales -- which measure how fast a function varies, not how much an input contributes to prediction -- and offers no calibrated rule for deciding which inputs to keep. The prediction-centred alternative, the derivative sensitivity $ν_j = \mathbb{E}[(\partial f/\partial x_j)^2]$, is available in closed form from a fitted GP, but turning it into a selection rule is harder than it looks: at a null input the estimator is a degenerate quadratic form, so Wald and Bernstein-von Mises cutoffs are anti-conservative, and the natural residual bootstrap is mis-scaled. We show that a studentized multiplier bootstrap of the GP derivative process repairs both, prove its validity through an invariance principle for quadratic forms, and obtain asymptotic family-wise and false-discovery-rate control across inputs. Over 100 replications the rule controls FDR wherever inputs are truly null, while uncalibrated derivative rankings breach the target by up to 2x and a Bernstein-von Mises cutoff by 2.2x; at matched FDR it loses no power; it holds under a Matérn kernel and input correlation up to 0.99; on real data with planted and authentic null inputs it admits 5-12x fewer spurious inputs; it costs 5-18% of the GP fit; and a block-averaged variant retains validity at cost linear in $n$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GP 回归的变量选择里，ARD 按逆长度尺度排序，度量的是函数变化快慢而非输入对预测的贡献，且没有校准的保留规则。作者对导数敏感度 ν_j = E[(∂f/∂x_j)²] 施加 studentized multiplier bootstrap，修复零假设输入下方差估计退化与残差 bootstrap 尺度错误，得到渐近 FDR/FWER 控制：100 次重复中在真零输入处控制住 FDR，而未校准导数排序最多超出目标 2 倍、BvM 截断超出 2.2 倍。
Motivation: GP 变量选择缺少以预测为中心且带校准规则的方法：ARD 的逆长度尺度不反映输入对预测的贡献，而导数敏感度虽有闭式解，其 Wald 与 Bernstein-von Mises 截断在零输入处是反保守的，残差 bootstrap 尺度错误。
Method: 对拟合 GP 的导数过程用 studentized multiplier bootstrap 构造选择规则，通过二次型的不变性原理 (invariance principle) 证明有效性，得到跨输入的渐近 family-wise error 与 FDR 控制；另给出代价随 n 线性增长的 block-averaged 变体。
Result: 100 次重复中该规则在真零输入处控制 FDR，未校准导数排序最多超出目标 2 倍、BvM 截断超出 2.2 倍；匹配 FDR 下不损失检验效能；在 Matérn 核与输入相关性高达 0.99 下仍成立；在含人工与真实零输入的真实数据上误选输入少 5–12 倍；开销为 GP 拟合代价的 5–18%。
Conclusion: 导数敏感度配上 studentized multiplier bootstrap 才能成为校准的变量选择规则，且在匹配 FDR 下不牺牲效能、开销仅为 GP 拟合的 5–18%。

papers.title: TerMeZO: Ternary Sparse Zeroth-Order Optimization for Fine-tuning BitNet Models at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning anguage models (LLMs) with first-order optimizers requires a memory several times larger than that required for inference. Memory-efficient zeroth-order optimization (MeZO) sidesteps this cost by estimating gradients from forward passes only. However, for BitNet architectures, a family of LLMs with ternary {-1,0,1\} weights and 8-bit activations, fine-tuning requires updating full-precision latent weights, and thus the memory footprint of MeZO no longer matches that of inference. A promising solution is to finetune only a subset of the latent weights, but existing sparse zeroth-order (ZO) methods either ignore the ternary structure or require first-order gradient information to build a sparse mask, which is at odds with the purpose of ZO fine-tuning. We propose TerMeZO, a sparse MeZO scheme that exploits the geometry of the ternary quantizer itself to identify the latent weights that are more likely to change values during fine-tuning, at no additional data or memory cost. Our convergence analysis shows that TerMeZO can converge faster than full-parameter MeZO, owing to its optimized reduction of the fine-tuning effective dimension. We run extensive experiments on BitNet models ranging from 1B to 3B parameters, spanning classification, instruction-following, and mathematical reasoning tasks. TerMeZO matches or exceeds the performance of full-parameter MeZO while substantially reducing the fine-tuning memory footprint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TerMeZO 用三值量化器自身的几何信息挑选最可能在微调中翻转值的 latent weights，只对这部分做稀疏零阶 (ZO) 更新，不额外消耗数据与内存。在 1B–3B 的 BitNet 模型上，它在分类、指令跟随与数学推理任务上匹配或超过全参数 MeZO，同时显著降低微调内存占用。
Motivation: BitNet 这类三值权重 + 8-bit 激活的 LLM 微调需更新全精度 latent weights，使 MeZO 的内存优势消失；已有稀疏 ZO 方法要么忽略三值结构，要么依赖一阶梯度构造稀疏掩码，与 ZO 微调的初衷冲突。
Method: TerMeZO 借助三值量化器 {-1,0,1} 的几何结构识别微调中更可能改变取值的 latent weights，据此构造稀疏掩码，仅对子集做零阶梯度估计（仅前向），不引入额外数据或内存；并给出收敛性分析，指出其通过削减微调有效维度可快于全参数 MeZO。
Result: 在 1B 到 3B 参数的 BitNet 模型上，覆盖分类、指令跟随、数学推理三类任务，TerMeZO 匹配或超过全参数 MeZO 的性能，并大幅降低微调内存占用；收敛分析表明其可比全参数 MeZO 收敛更快。
Conclusion: 利用量化器几何做稀疏掩码，可以在不依赖一阶梯度的前提下让 BitNet 的 ZO 微调既省内存又不掉性能，甚至收敛更快。

summary_sections.method: TerMeZO 借助三值量化器 {-1,0,1} 的几何结构识别微调中更可能改变取值的 latent weights，据此构造稀疏掩码，仅对子集做零阶梯度估计（仅前向），不引入额外数据或内存；并给出收敛性分析，指出其通过削减微调有效维度可快于全参数 MeZO。
summary_sections.result: 在 1B 到 3B 参数的 BitNet 模型上，覆盖分类、指令跟随、数学推理三类任务，TerMeZO 匹配或超过全参数 MeZO 的性能，并大幅降低微调内存占用；收敛分析表明其可比全参数 MeZO 收敛更快。
summary_sections.conclusion: 利用量化器几何做稀疏掩码，可以在不依赖一阶梯度的前提下让 BitNet 的 ZO 微调既省内存又不掉性能，甚至收敛更快。

papers.title: OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning
papers.abstract_en: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不完美信息博弈中，OSCC 用边际保持、信息态安全、分支局部策略随机性与事件对齐等可容许性条件约束反事实耦合，并证明策略梯度噪声的变化由 policy-Jacobian 加权的回报协方差非对角项决定。OSCC-Select 据此在校准阶段选择耦合方式：Leduc 上完全耦合把回报对比方差从 41.1158 降到 18.1441（降 55.87%），三动作时梯度噪声迹 0.0783 优于按回报方差选择的 0.0917。
Motivation: 共同随机数 (CRN) 耦合能降低反事实动作对比的噪声，但非法耦合会泄露隐藏状态、同步内生策略随机性或在分支发散后错配机会事件；且多动作策略优化中，回报对比方差小并不等于梯度噪声小。
Method: 提出 OSCC 框架，以边际保持、信息态安全、分支局部策略随机性、语义事件对齐和 trace-before-oracle replay 定义可容许耦合类；推导梯度感知耦合准则，指出噪声变化由 policy-Jacobian 加权的回报协方差非对角项决定；据此构造仅用校准数据的 OSCC-Select，在独立、root-only、continuation-only、完全耦合间用安全与增益双证书选择，增益目标结合投影梯度噪声与实测采样开销，置信下界不同时成立则回退到独立采样。
Result: 在 100,000 次固定根 Leduc 对比中，完全耦合的 CP-GRPO 把回报对比方差从 41.1158 降到 18.1441，降幅 55.87%，且保持声明的分支边际；三动作设定下 OSCC-Select 选 continuation 耦合，梯度噪声迹 0.0783，按回报方差选择为 0.0917；校准组数从 64 增到 2,048 使认证率从 0.327 升到 0.995。
Conclusion: 反事实耦合要作为不完美信息学习的通用原语，必须同时满足信息安全与按投影后梯度噪声（而非回报方差）选型，且增益需经校准认证，否则回退独立采样。

papers.title: Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped reasoners spend test-time compute by iterating a weight-tied map, but a small residual does not mean the state is a fixed point when that map lives in unconstrained latent space. We propose Geometric Fixed-Point Reasoning (GFPR), in which the iterated state is the prediction itself: a field of categorical beliefs on a product of simplices, whose argmax is the answer at every step. Because the state is a belief, task structure can be imposed through compact convex relaxations, either as structured readouts or directly in the recurrent state; in the latter case the update remains a continuous self-map, so a fixed point exists for any parameters. At about 7M parameters, GFPR reaches 95.1% exact match on Sudoku-Extreme, 92.0% on Maze-Hard, and 100% sequence accuracy on S_5 length 128, above the published FPRM numbers at the same scale. The same update also trains a 201M language model on FineWeb-Edu in which each site is a distribution over the vocabulary; with 24 Picard steps it is above GPT-2 small on four zero-shot multiple-choice tasks and above GPT-2 medium on ARC-Easy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GFPR 把循环推理器的迭代状态直接定义为乘积单纯形上的分类信念场，其 argmax 即每步答案，任务结构通过紧凸松弛作为读出或直接写进循环状态，使更新成为连续自映射从而对任意参数都存在不动点。约 7M 参数下在 Sudoku-Extreme 达 95.1% exact match、Maze-Hard 92.0%、S_5 长度 128 序列准确率 100%，同规模超过已发表的 FPRM 数字。
Motivation: 循环推理器在无约束隐空间上迭代权重共享映射，残差小并不等于状态是不动点，固定点语义与任务结构都缺乏保证。
Method: 提出 Geometric Fixed-Point Reasoning (GFPR)：迭代状态是定义在乘积单纯形 (product of simplices) 上的分类信念场，argmax 即答案；任务结构用紧凸松弛实现，可作结构化读出或直接嵌入循环状态，后者使更新保持连续自映射。同一更新还训练了一个 201M 参数语言模型，词表上每个位置是分布。
Result: 约 7M 参数下：Sudoku-Extreme exact match 95.1%，Maze-Hard 92.0%，S_5 长度 128 序列准确率 100%，均高于同规模已发表的 FPRM 数字。201M 语言模型在 FineWeb-Edu 上训练，24 步 Picard 迭代后在四个零样本多选任务上超过 GPT-2 small，在 ARC-Easy 上超过 GPT-2 medium。
Conclusion: 把推理状态放在带凸结构的单纯形上，可让循环推理器的不动点对任意参数都存在，并在小参数量的符号/结构任务与中等规模语言模型上取得强结果。

papers.title: Does Execution Require Target KV Fidelity? A Mixed-Fidelity KV Runtime for LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly constrained by the GPU memory consumed by key-value (KV) caches. Existing compression, eviction, and offloading techniques alleviate this pressure, but serving runtimes typically treat only the configured target KV representation as execution-ready. Under memory pressure, this target-only contract can turn KV shortage into request stalls and preemptions. We present ElasticKV, a mixed-fidelity KV runtime built on the observation that target fidelity need not gate execution. ElasticKV introduces a compact intermediate KV state, making fidelity a runtime-managed execution property. To realize this state in a paged serving runtime, ElasticKV combines (i) a pair-structured layout that turns fidelity reduction into reusable GPU capacity, (ii) a dual-mode attention backend that directly consumes the compact state while preserving the native target-only path, and (iii) pressure-aware fidelity management that adapts KV fidelity to memory pressure. Our extensive evaluation across diverse workloads, model families and scales, and GPU platforms demonstrates the effectiveness and generality of ElasticKV. Under high concurrency, ElasticKV achieves 3.8-4.0$\times$ lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) and 9.1$\times$ lower P90 TTFT than vLLM while preserving generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ElasticKV 把 KV cache 的目标精度与执行解耦，引入紧凑中间 KV 状态并由运行时按显存压力调节保真度，使目标精度不再是执行的前置条件。在高并发下相对 vLLM 实现 3.8–4.0× 更低的 TTFT 与 9.1× 更低的 P90 TTFT，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: LLM serving 受 KV cache 显存约束，而现有运行时只把配置的目标 KV 表示视为可执行，显存不足会直接变成请求停顿与抢占。
Method: 三个组件：pair-structured layout 把保真度降低转成可复用 GPU 容量；dual-mode attention backend 直接消费紧凑状态并保留原生 target-only 路径；pressure-aware fidelity management 按显存压力调节 KV 保真度，整体构建在 paged serving runtime 上。
Result: 在多种工作负载、模型家族与规模、GPU 平台上评测：高并发下相对 vLLM TTFT 降低 3.8–4.0×，P90 TTFT 降低 9.1×，同时保持生成质量。
Conclusion: 目标 KV 保真度不必作为执行门槛，把保真度变成运行时可管理的执行属性即可在高并发下大幅降低首 token 延迟而不损失生成质量。

papers.title: Neural Scaling Laws of Transformer Operator Network
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have emerged as powerful architectures for learning solution operators of physical systems. Empirically the prediction error has been observed to decrease when the data size and model size increase, suggesting neural scaling behavior. Yet a theoretical understanding of such scaling laws for transformer-based operator learning remains limited. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for characterizing the approximation and generalization errors of transformer-based operator learning. Our analysis builds on a local-to-global approximation principle that is naturally aligned with the softmax attention mechanism and yields discretization-invariant output functions. On approximation theory, we derive a universal approximation error of transformer-based operator learning for Hölder-regular operators. On generalization theory, we establish a power scaling law between the prediction error and the training data size. The rate of convergence represented by the scaling exponent explicitly reflects the dimensions of the input and output domains, the regularity of the underlying functions and operators, and crucially, the intrinsic dimension of the input function class. By exploiting this intrinsic low-dimensional structure, our analysis yields a power-law generalization rate for operator learning, in contrast to the logarithmic-type power-law rates appearing in existing analyses of operator learning with feedforward neural networks. Numerical experiments validate the predicted power-law scaling and confirm that the convergence rate varies systematically with the intrinsic dimension of the input function class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 Transformer 算子学习建立逼近与泛化误差的理论框架：基于与 softmax 注意力天然契合的 local-to-global 近似原理给出离散不变输出，对 Hölder 正则算子推出普适逼近误差，并证明预测误差与训练数据量之间存在幂律 scaling law，其指数显式依赖输入/输出域维度、函数与算子正则性以及输入函数类的本征维数。数值实验验证了预测的幂律 scaling，且收敛速率随本征维数系统变化。
Motivation: Transformer 学习物理系统解算子时经验上误差随数据量与模型量下降，但缺少针对该架构的逼近与泛化理论，尤其无法解释 scaling 指数由什么决定。
Method: 构建与 softmax 注意力对齐的 local-to-global 近似原理以获得离散不变输出函数；对 Hölder 正则算子推导普适逼近误差界；泛化侧建立预测误差与训练数据量的幂律标度律，指数显式编码输入/输出域维度、函数与算子正则性及输入函数类的本征维数，并与前馈网络算子学习的对数型速率对比。
Result: 得到幂律型泛化速率，区别于已有前馈神经网络算子学习分析中的对数型幂律速率；数值实验验证了预测的幂律 scaling，并确认收敛速率随输入函数类本征维数系统变化。
Conclusion: Transformer 算子学习的泛化误差服从幂律 scaling，其指数由问题维度、正则性与输入函数类本征维数共同刻画，利用本征低维结构可改善泛化速率。

papers.title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Diagnostics Dataset Investigating Linguistic Phenomena in Arabic Natural Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Understanding (NLU) plays a crucial role in various applications, yet its performance suffers from weaknesses in handling the complexities of human languages, ranging from lexical ambiguity to high-level reasoning difficulties. Analyzing errors across diverse linguistic phenomena is crucial for NLU improvement, as it will help humans get insights to comprehensively assess models' limitations and capabilities, so optimizing models' generalization. Notably, several benchmarks contain diagnostics datasets designed for investigation and fine-grained error analysis. When highlighting the gaps in the state-of-the-art, we noted that there is no naming convention for macro and micro categories or even a standard set of linguistic phenomena that should be covered. To overcome this gap, we propose an initial hierarchy for Cross-Lingual NLU error analysis. Moreover, we propose a methodology to create an NLI hierarchical framework and applied a case study on Arabic NLU. Moreover, this paper introduces E-CONAN diagnostics dataset, a freely available dataset manually-annotated with coarse-grained and fine-grained categories based on our proposed Arabic hierarchy. E-CONAN dataset helps NLU designers better understand their models by doing error analysis and in-depth investigation. We used E-CONAN to investigate the performance of 9 pretrained language models and 5 LLMs. Results indicate that LLMs outperform pretrained models in world knowledge and commonsense reasoning macro-category, and underperform pretrained models in syntactic macro-category. Moreover, the hardest phenomena for all models is Reasoning, and the easiest phenomena for all pretrained models is Syntactic, and the easiest for LLMs is Lexico-Syntactic.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Early warning of road icing from antecedent meteorological conditions without consistent critical slowing down
papers.abstract_en: Critical slowing down (CSD), the slowing of recovery from perturbations as a system approaches a critical transition, is widely used for early warning, but whether such signals appear in environmental transitions subject to rapidly changing external forcing has rarely been tested with observations. Here we show, using 2,427 icing-onset events in 1-min observations from 121 South Korean road weather stations, that such signals do not consistently precede road icing. Icing began from different prior surface states, but conditions at onset varied continuously with weak separation among pathways. Cold dose, deposition dose and freeze-thaw accumulation at onset exceeded those at non-icing control times, with cold-dose discrimination highest at decay timescales of 30 min or less. However, the increases in variance and lag-1 autocorrelation expected under CSD did not distinguish icing from control times; the same procedure recovered these increases in synthetic series with a declining recovery rate, and the null result was replicated for 3,091 events at 127 independent stations. Predictive information was nevertheless present: adding recent changes and cumulative antecedent conditions to current conditions improved discrimination, and surrounding meteorological fields increased the area under the ROC curve by 0.030-0.032 for forecast windows of 1 to 12 h and reduced false alarms by 62-67% at 3 and 6 h. These results suggest that road icing is more consistent with recent meteorological forcing moving the road surface into icing-favourable conditions than with a progressive decline in internal stability, and they indicate where early warning should look when a transition is externally forced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用韩国 121 个道路气象站 1 分钟观测的 2,427 次结冰事件检验临界慢化 (CSD) 预警信号：方差与 lag-1 自相关上升并不能区分结冰时刻与对照时刻，同一流程却能在恢复率递减的合成序列中复现该上升，且在 127 个独立站的 3,091 次事件上复现零结果。真正有预警价值的是近期变化与前期累积剂量：加入周边气象场使 1–12 h 预报窗的 ROC AUC 提高 0.030–0.032，并在 3 h 和 6 h 把虚警降低 62–67%。结论是道路结冰更像外部气象强迫把路面推入易结冰状态，而非内部稳定性渐进衰减，预警应当前瞻累积强迫量而非 CSD 指标。
Motivation: CSD 类预警指标被广泛用于临界转变预警，但在外部强迫快速变化的环境转变中是否真的出现，此前极少用观测检验；道路结冰正是这类受气象强迫主导的转变。
Method: 数据为韩国 121 个道路气象站 1 分钟观测中的 2,427 次结冰起始事件，配非结冰对照时刻；比较冷剂量 (cold dose)、沉积剂量、冻融累积在结冰与对照时刻的差异，并扫描衰减时间尺度（冷剂量判别在 30 min 及以下最强）；同时检验 CSD 预期的方差与 lag-1 自相关上升，并用恢复率递减的合成序列做方法可行性对照，再在 127 个独立站的 3,091 次事件上复现。
Result: 结冰时刻的冷剂量、沉积剂量与冻融累积高于对照时刻，冷剂量判别力在衰减时间尺度 ≤30 min 时最高；CSD 预期的方差与 lag-1 自相关上升不能区分结冰与对照，而同一程序在恢复率递减的合成序列中能复现这些上升，零结果在 3,091 次事件、127 个独立站上复现。加入近期变化与前期累积条件后判别力提升，叠加周边气象场使 1–12 h 预报窗 ROC AUC 提高 0.030–0.032，并在 3 h 与 6 h 使虚警减少 62–67%。
Conclusion: 道路结冰由近期外部气象强迫累积驱动，而非内部稳定性逐步下降；早期预警应寻找累积的前期强迫条件，而不是方差或自相关这类 CSD 信号。

papers.title: Discovering Symmetries in Neural Network Parameter Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Parameter space symmetries are important for understanding neural networks' loss landscape, training dynamics, and generalization. However, systematically identifying these symmetries remains a challenge. In this paper, we formalize data-dependent parameter symmetries and characterize loss invariance and the group-action axioms through infinitesimal conditions, which provide objectives for jointly learning group generators and nonlinear action maps. Our framework systematically uncovers parameter symmetries, including previously unknown ones. To study larger networks, we establish conditions under which subnetwork symmetries extend to the full model. The same construction gives an explicit family of finite-batch symmetries, providing both analytical examples and a foundation for discovery through small subnetworks. Using the infinitesimal characterization and subnetwork construction, we implement a framework for automated discovery of parameter symmetries, and successfully uncovered symmetries in various architectures, including pretrained transformer models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数据依赖的参数空间对称性形式化为无穷小条件下的损失不变性与群作用公理，作为联合学习群生成元与非线性作用映射的目标函数，并给出子网络对称性扩展到全模型的条件，从而自动发现参数对称性。该框架在多种架构（含预训练 transformer）上成功发现了对称性，包括此前未知的那些。
Motivation: 参数空间对称性决定损失面、训练动力学与泛化，但系统性识别这些对称性一直是难题，尤其对大网络。
Method: 形式化数据依赖的参数对称性，用无穷小条件刻画损失不变性与群作用公理，构造联合学习群生成元与非线性 action map 的目标；再建立子网络对称性扩展到全模型的条件，得到显式的有限批量 (finite-batch) 对称性族，据此实现自动发现框架，从小子网络出发搜索。
Result: 在多种架构上成功发现参数对称性，包括预训练 transformer 模型，并覆盖此前未知的对称性；同时给出有限批量对称性的显式族，既提供解析例子也支撑从小子网络发现。
Conclusion: 参数对称性可由无穷小不变性目标加子网络扩展条件自动发现，小网络上的搜索结果可作为大模型对称性的发现基础。

papers.title: EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents aim to turn research feedback into reusable skills, tools, and research rules. Whether these accumulated capabilities continue to improve later research requires controlled evaluation. Long-horizon alpha discovery provides a state-dependent setting: once a new factor enters the portfolio, the predictive information already covered changes, so the value of the same candidate or experience may change over time. We introduce EverMine, an empirical framework for studying self-evolving research capabilities in long-horizon alpha discovery. EverMine decomposes the research state into history (Hist), the current factor portfolio (Frontier), and reusable capabilities (Cap). Under matched resource limits, we compare complete runs with fixed or evolving Cap, and replace Cap while holding Hist and Frontier fixed to estimate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities. We also combine full trajectories with historical-state replay to examine how experience-based decisions affect candidate selection and portfolio outcomes. Across 18 long-horizon trajectories, end-to-end comparisons show no consistent gain from Cap evolution. Across 48 continuation branches from shared Hist and Frontier states, accumulated Cap also does not consistently outperform the initial Cap. Parameter tuning of existing factor structures can still improve the portfolio. In an exploratory replay of two screening batches from one Evolving trajectory, some screened-out candidates have positive marginal value at the original state, yet submitting all screened-out candidates sequentially slightly lowers final portfolio IC in both batches. These results show that candidate value depends on the evolving portfolio and submission order, and motivate evaluating self-evolving research capabilities through end-to-end outcomes, conditional capability value, and the consequences of experience-based decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EverMine 把长周期 alpha 研究状态拆成历史 Hist、当前因子组合 Frontier 与可复用能力 Cap，在资源对齐下做替换实验来测 Cap 演化的条件价值。18 条长程轨迹的端到端对比中 Cap 演化没有一致增益，48 条续跑分支中累积 Cap 也不稳定优于初始 Cap；候选价值取决于组合演化与提交顺序。
Motivation: 自进化 agent 把研究反馈沉淀为技能与规则，但这些累积能力是否真的提升后续研究缺少受控评估；alpha 发现中因子入组合后已覆盖的预测信息改变，同一候选或经验的价值随时间漂移，正适合做状态依赖的检验。
Method: 将研究状态分解为 Hist、Frontier、Cap 三部分：在匹配资源上限下比较固定 Cap 与演化 Cap 的完整运行，再固定 Hist 与 Frontier 单独替换 Cap 以估计累积能力的条件价值；并结合完整轨迹与历史状态回放 (historical-state replay) 检验基于经验的决策如何影响候选筛选与组合结果。
Result: 18 条长程轨迹的端到端对比显示 Cap 演化无一致增益；48 条共享 Hist 与 Frontier 的续跑分支中，累积 Cap 也不一致优于初始 Cap；对既有因子结构做参数调优仍能改善组合。在一条 Evolving 轨迹的两批筛选回放中，部分被筛掉的候选在原状态下边际价值为正，但顺序提交全部被筛候选使两批的最终组合 IC 都略有下降。
Conclusion: 候选价值依赖于演化中的组合与提交顺序，因此评估自进化研究能力必须同时看端到端结果、条件能力价值和经验决策的后果，而不能只看能力是否累积。

papers.title: In-Token Learning for High-Fidelity Image Restoration via Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We present In-Token Learning, an image restoration framework that adapts a pretrained diffusion transformer using conditional rectified flow matching. Clean targets paired with degraded inputs supervise transport from Gaussian noise to restored images. Spatially aligned degraded-image tokens are fused with evolving latent tokens along the channel dimension, preserving the image-token count at a given resolution. Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) combines frozen degraded-image embeddings with a fixed task prompt through the native conditioning pathway, without a trainable ControlNet-style branch or image captioning. We evaluate super-resolution and denoising on DIV2K, LSDIR, FFHQ, RealLQ250, and RealPhoto60, and automatic colorization on DIV2K and LSDIR. The tasks use separately trained checkpoints under the same framework. Results show competitive fidelity and perceptual quality under the evaluated protocols, with weaker generalization on RealLQ250. We report full-image QHD ($2560{\times}1440$) inference and a tiled $12$K restoration demonstration of Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Attention cost still increases with resolution. This technical report preserves the early broader study underlying Fill2SR, which subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction.
papers.comment: Technical report, 25 pages, 12 figures. Preserves the earlier broader study underlying Fill2SR (ECCV 2026), including automatic colorization; Fill2SR subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: In-Token Learning 用条件 rectified flow matching 把预训练 diffusion transformer 改造成图像复原框架：干净目标与退化输入配对监督从高斯噪声到复原图的传输，退化图 token 沿通道维度与演化中的 latent token 融合且不增加 token 数，再用 Direct Low-Quality Guidance 把冻结的退化图嵌入与固定任务 prompt 走原生条件通路注入。在 DIV2K、LSDIR、FFHQ、RealLQ250、RealPhoto60 上做超分与去噪、在 DIV2K 与 LSDIR 上做自动上色，保真度与感知质量在所评协议下有竞争力，但在 RealLQ250 上泛化偏弱。
Motivation: 用 diffusion transformer 做图像复原通常要引入 ControlNet 式可训练分支或依赖图像描述来注入退化信息，既增加参数与训练成本，也把 token 数随退化条件膨胀。
Method: 条件 rectified flow matching 监督从高斯噪声到复原图的传输，配对数据为干净目标与退化输入；空间对齐的退化图 token 沿通道维度与演化 latent token 融合，保持给定分辨率下的 image-token 数不变；Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) 把冻结的退化图嵌入与固定任务 prompt 经原生 conditioning pathway 注入，不使用可训练 ControlNet 分支也不做 image captioning；各任务用同一框架下分别训练的 checkpoint。
Result: 在 DIV2K、LSDIR、FFHQ、RealLQ250、RealPhoto60 上评测超分与去噪，在 DIV2K 与 LSDIR 上评测自动上色，所评协议下保真度与感知质量有竞争力，RealLQ250 上泛化偏弱；报告全图 QHD (2560×1440) 推理与 12K 分块复原《清明上河图》演示，注意力开销仍随分辨率上升。

papers.title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Mobile Web and Intelligent Information Systems (MobiWIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Silverline 厨具工厂部署 AI-PRISM 协同检测工位：UR 10e 机械臂搭载机器视觉缺陷检测，Comau Racer-5 负责功能测试，由 ROS 2 Humble 协调，多模态数据经 Grafana 实时可视化。单件质检时间从 82 s 降到 61 s（约 25%），终检资源效率从 0.75 升到 0.88，操作员目视检查时间减少 82%，NASA-TLX 心理负荷显著下降（p = 0.005）。
Motivation: 装配线人工目视检测受长班次疲劳制约，缺陷检出率下降；双机械臂、多模态传感的现场集成还面临近距离安全、眩光反射下 AI 鲁棒性、ROS 2 命名空间冲突与依赖问题。
Method: AI-PRISM 项目下的协同检测工位：UR 10e cobot 携带机器视觉缺陷检测流水线，Comau Racer-5 cobot 执行功能测试，二者由 Ubuntu 22.04 LTS 服务器上的 ROS 2 Humble 协调；采集 Basler 相机图像、TIA 麦克风声学与 SPS 电安全测量，本地记录并用 Grafana 实时可视化，集成按四层人机交互 (HRI) 分析组织。
Result: 单件质检时间 82 s → 61 s（约 25%）；终检资源效率 0.75 → 0.88；操作员目视检查观看时间减少 82%；NASA-TLX 心理负荷显著下降（p = 0.005）。
Conclusion: 作者报告了现场部署挑战及所采用的工程对策：近距离安全、眩光与反射下的 AI 鲁棒性、双 cobot 的 ROS 2 命名空间冲突，以及操作系统与依赖问题。

papers.title: LLM4Trust: Exploring the Capabilities of Large Language Models for Trust Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Trust evaluation plays a critical role in cybersecurity by supporting risk mitigation and decision-making. A variety of trust evaluation methods have been proposed, with learning-based approaches offering high accuracy and automation. However, they often require substantial ground truth, suffer from low training efficiency, lack support for basic trust properties, and provide limited explainability. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a compelling alternative due to their strong zero-/few-shot reasoning abilities and broad knowledge. To this end, we propose LLM4Trust, the first benchmark framework that systematically explores the capabilities of LLMs for trust evaluation. We first construct diverse trust graphs to model five basic trust properties and design corresponding property understanding tasks. We then assess the ability of eight representative LLMs to understand these properties under nine prompt methods. Based on this exploration, we identify the most effective LLM-prompt combinations and apply them to five real-world datasets for validating LLMs' trust evaluation capability. During this process, we propose two strategies to extract key information from large-scale trust graphs, addressing the context window limitations of LLMs. Extensive experiments show that LLMs can effectively understand basic trust properties and have great potential for real-world trust evaluation, particularly under limited supervision. However, they remain vulnerable to attacks targeting trust graphs and demonstration examples used in few-shot prompting, and incur high inference costs. Accordingly, we propose a defense mechanism and batch inference to improve the robustness and efficiency of LLM-based trust evaluation. The source code of LLM4Trust is available at https://github.com/Jieerbobo/LLM4Trust
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM4Trust 是首个系统评估大语言模型信任评估能力的 benchmark 框架：构建覆盖五种基本信任属性的信任图 (trust graph)，用九种 prompt 方法测八个代表性 LLM 的属性理解，再把最优 LLM-prompt 组合迁移到五个真实数据集。结果显示 LLM 在少监督下能有效理解信任属性并具实用潜力，但对信任图攻击与 few-shot 示例攻击脆弱、推理成本高，作者据此提出防御机制与 batch inference。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的信任评估方法依赖大量标注真值、训练效率低、不支持基本信任属性且可解释性有限，而 LLM 的零/少样本推理与广泛知识提供了少监督的替代路径，但其能力边界此前未被系统刻画。
Method: 构建多样信任图建模五种基本信任属性并设计对应属性理解任务；用九种 prompt 方法评估八个代表性 LLM；筛出最优 LLM-prompt 组合后在五个真实数据集上验证信任评估能力；提出两种从大规模信任图提取关键信息的策略以绕过上下文窗口限制，并补充防御机制与 batch inference。
Result: 实验表明 LLM 能有效理解基本信任属性，在有限监督下对真实世界信任评估有较大潜力；同时暴露三类问题：对针对信任图的攻击和针对 few-shot demonstration 的攻击仍脆弱，且推理成本高。
Conclusion: LLM 可作为少监督条件下的信任评估方案，但要落地必须同时加防御机制与 batch inference 来解决鲁棒性和效率问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical MIL for Weakly-Supervised Thoracic Disease Detection in Chest X-rays
papers.abstract_en: Weakly-supervised thoracic disease detection in chest X-rays (CXR) is challenging due to subtle appearances and complex anatomical overlap, motivating anatomy-aware modeling for improved localization. However, prior anatomy-aware methods typically rely on coarse region proxies or static spatial priors, which may restrict dynamic instance discovery and limit precise localization of small abnormalities. We propose Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning (ASH-MIL), a framework that introduces parallel anatomy-structured observation branches (cardiac, pulmonary, and agnostic) combined with hierarchical MIL aggregation. Anatomical priors are injected as soft spatial biases into decoder cross-attention, enabling anatomically grounded evidence maps without disease bounding-box supervision. Instance localization is derived directly from MIL-weighted cross-attention maps without bounding box supervision. Experiments on CXR8 and cross-domain MIMIC-CXR held-out sets demonstrate consistent improvements over prior weakly-supervised and anatomy-aware approaches, particularly under stricter localization criteria. Our code is available at https://github.com/jn-kim/ash-mil.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASH-MIL 用并行的解剖结构观测分支（cardiac、pulmonary、agnostic）加层级 MIL 聚合做胸片弱监督疾病检测，把解剖先验作为软空间偏置注入 decoder cross-attention，无需 bounding-box 监督即可从 MIL 加权注意力图直接得到实例定位。在 CXR8 与跨域 MIMIC-CXR held-out 集上，相对既有弱监督与解剖感知方法在更严格的定位标准下提升更明显。
Motivation: 胸片病变征象细微且解剖结构重叠，既有解剖感知方法依赖粗粒度区域代理或静态空间先验，限制动态实例发现与小病灶的精确定位。
Method: 并行解剖结构观测分支（cardiac、pulmonary、agnostic）配合层级 MIL 聚合；解剖先验以软空间偏置注入 decoder cross-attention，实例定位直接由 MIL 加权 cross-attention 图导出，全程不用 bounding-box 监督。
Result: 在 CXR8 与跨域 MIMIC-CXR held-out 集上，相对先前弱监督与解剖感知方法取得一致改进，在更严格的定位标准下提升尤其明显。
Conclusion: 把解剖先验做成注入 cross-attention 的软偏置并配合层级 MIL，可在无边界框标注的前提下提升胸片病灶定位精度，跨域数据上同样成立。
Relevance: 4
