papers.title: SceneScaffold: Active Scene-State Construction for Unified 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D large multimodal models (3D-LMMs) rely on a visual bottleneck to compress complex 3D scene evidence into a limited number of visual tokens compatible with large language models (LLMs). Current visual bottlenecks, however, often passively compress heterogeneous 3D evidence into a homogeneous object-centric token sequence, leaving the spatial organization of the scene under-represented. This under-representation forces the LLM to recover spatial relations from a flattened token sequence, leading to unstable reasoning in relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous scenes. To address this issue, we propose SceneScaffold, an active scene-state construction framework for unified 3D scene understanding. SceneScaffold reformulates the visual bottleneck from a passive feature compressor into an active scene organizer, constructing a role-aware spatial scaffold before language reasoning. Specifically, SceneScaffold organizes superpoint-level visual evidence into scene-state components with distinct structural roles: entity states preserve core object semantics, scene-frame states maintain spatial references via boundary and region anchors, relation states encode object-environment interaction cues, and a global summary provides compact context. Through this role-aware construction, SceneScaffold provides the LLM with a spatially organized scene representation before language reasoning. Experiments on unified 3D scene understanding tasks, including 3D visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning, demonstrate the effectiveness of SceneScaffold, while diagnostic results further show its applicability to relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous cases. Code is available at https://github.com/lixiangqi707/SceneScaffold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SceneScaffold 把 3D-LMM 的视觉瓶颈从被动特征压缩器改成主动场景组织器：在语言推理前，把 superpoint 级证据按角色搭成空间脚手架（实体状态、场景框架的边界/区域锚点、关系状态、全局摘要）。在 3D 视觉定位、问答与密集描述任务上验证有效，诊断结果进一步显示其适用于关系密集与空间歧义场景。
Motivation: 现有视觉瓶颈把异质 3D 证据被动压成同质的以物体为中心的 token 序列，场景空间组织被压平，LLM 只能从扁平序列里恢复空间关系，在关系密集和空间歧义场景中推理不稳。
Method: 在语言推理前先构建角色感知的空间脚手架：superpoint 级视觉证据被组织成四类场景状态组件——entity states 保留核心物体语义，scene-frame states 用边界与区域锚点维持空间参照，relation states 编码物体-环境交互线索，global summary 提供紧凑上下文，再交给 LLM。
Result: 在统一 3D 场景理解任务上做实验：3D visual grounding、question answering、dense captioning 均显示有效性；诊断结果进一步显示在 relation-intensive 与 spatially ambiguous 案例上的适用性。
Conclusion: 把视觉瓶颈从被动压缩改为主动的场景状态组织，可以在语言推理前提供空间有序的场景表示，从而改善 3D 场景理解中的关系与空间歧义推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PPG-LM: A Photoplethysmography-Language Model with Multi-Level Clinical Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely recorded by clinical monitors and consumer wearables, providing a scalable source of continuous physiological information. These recordings offer an opportunity for physiological assessment at scale, but realizing this potential requires models to learn from both signal-derived physiological supervision and broader clinical context captured in electronic health records (EHRs). This involves aligning information spanning local observations, care events, and entire visits with PPG representations at corresponding temporal scales. However, existing PPG foundation models primarily rely on task-specific prediction heads, while the medical knowledge of large language models does not necessarily translate into waveform understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce PPG-LM, the first PPG-language model family to learn physiological representations from both signal-derived supervision and broader clinical context captured in EHRs. To construct clinically grounded captions, we develop an automatic captioning pipeline that generates segment-, event-, and visit-level descriptions from signal measurements and structured EHR records. We then learn from these pairs through a two-stage framework that first establishes segment-language correspondence through contrastive learning and waveform-conditioned captioning, then extends alignment to events and visits through time-aware aggregation and temporal statement matching. Pretrained on approximately 73k hours of PPG, PPG-LM supports language-based recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and segment captioning. Experiments on MC-MED, MIMIC-III, and VitalDB show improved retrieval and caption factuality over language-model baselines and gains over PPG and time-series foundation models on multiple clinical prediction tasks.

papers.title: SLP-ProbHard: Probabilistic Hard-Constrained Learning via Structural Latent Parameterization
papers.abstract_en: Many probabilistic predictors must satisfy exact structure in every stochastic realization, yet common hard-constraint approaches form predictions in ambient coordinates and then correct or project them. We introduce SLP-ProbHard, a cross-family, representation-centered framework for probabilistic hard-constrained learning when explicit structural parameterizations are available. Its core object, a Structural Feasible Latent Parameterization (SFLP), combines a structural latent law $Z \sim P^Z_θ(\cdot\mid x)$ with a feasible map $Y=h_φ(x,Z)$ that satisfies the constraint for every latent realization. Together these components define the predictive law itself, including its support and boundary probabilities, rather than serving as a final feasibility wrapper. We study how feasible coordinates and maps affect stochastic dimension, dependence, calibration, expressiveness, and computation. Experiments use Gaussian latent laws and fixed geometry-derived maps across affine equalities, ordering and simplex constraints, nonlinear manifolds, and three structural representations of seven-basin hydrological flow-duration-curve (FDC) data. In an official-source affine comparison with ProbHardE2E/DPPL, both methods achieve zero practical constraint violations. SLP-ProbHard uses 8 instead of 11 stochastic coordinates and improves MSE/MAE, while DPPL yields better marginal CRPS and closer-to-nominal coverage; a paired test detects no Energy Score difference across ten seeds. Real-world affine and nonlinear FDC representations reduce 13 to 7 and 14 to 8 ambient versus computational coordinates, respectively. Exact feasibility alone thus does not determine a predictive law, motivating direct structural generation when meaningful feasible coordinates are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLP-ProbHard 提出以 Structural Feasible Latent Parameterization (SFLP) 直接在可行坐标上生成概率预测：结构潜变量律 Z~P^Z_θ 配上对每个潜变量实现都满足约束的映射 Y=h_φ(x,Z)，预测律本身（含支撑与边界概率）即由二者定义，而非事后投影修正。在七流域水文 flow-duration-curve (FDC) 数据上，官方源码的 affine 对比中与 ProbHardE2E/DPPL 均实现零实际约束违反，SLP-ProbHard 用 8 而非 11 个随机坐标并改善 MSE/MAE，DPPL 的边缘 CRPS 与覆盖率更接近标称，十个种子的配对检验未检出 Energy Score 差异。
Motivation: 常见硬约束方法先在环境坐标中生成预测再做校正或投影，这把可行性当成事后包装，无法控制预测律本身的支撑、边界概率与随机维度。
Method: 框架核心为 SFLP：结构潜变量律 Z~P^Z_θ(·|x) 加上可行映射 Y=h_φ(x,Z)，二者共同定义预测分布；实验用高斯潜变量律与固定几何导出的映射，覆盖 affine 等式、排序与 simplex 约束、非线性流形，以及七流域水文 FDC 数据的三种结构表示，并与 ProbHardE2E/DPPL 在官方源码下做 affine 对比。
Result: affine 对比中 SLP-ProbHard 与 ProbHardE2E/DPPL 均零实际约束违反；SLP-ProbHard 用 8 个随机坐标（对照 11 个）并改善 MSE/MAE，DPPL 边缘 CRPS 更好、覆盖率更接近标称，十个种子的配对检验未检出 Energy Score 差异。真实 FDC 数据上 affine 表示把 13 个环境坐标降到 7 个计算坐标，非线性表示把 14 降到 8。
Conclusion: 仅靠精确可行性不足以决定预测律，作者主张在存在有意义的可行坐标时直接做结构化生成，而非事后投影。

papers.title: Printability-Constrained Adversarial Decals for Near-Nadir Aerial Perception: Measured Ink Gamuts, Nested Realism Constraints, and a Physical-World Bound
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial patches for aerial perception are typically evaluated as digital composites, with printing left as an implementation detail. This study imposes three physical constraints during optimization rather than after it: the color range a particular printer can reproduce, the size of the flat panel a vehicle offers, and the loss of fine detail incurred when the patch is imaged from altitude. The principal comparison isolates the ink set. Two patches share all seventeen recorded optimization settings and differ only in the colors available to them. One is constrained to a uniform color cube; the other to a gamut measured by printing and scanning a 216-patch chart. Each was optimized at three seeds and evaluated against thirteen victim conditions, with every rate reported against a size-matched optimized control. The effect of the measured gamut is victim-dependent rather than uniform. Net attack success rises on three of six closed-set segmentation victims, and for these the seed ranges of the two ink sets are disjoint: $+0.120$ on DeepLabv3-R101 and $+0.041$ on SegFormer-B0. The color-cube patch is consistently stronger on the open-vocabulary segmenter and on two of four detectors, though no detector exceeds a net of $+0.026$ under either ink set. The natural explanation is that a printable palette is simply less chromatic and lower in frequency than a digital one. Eleven further patches test this account and it does not hold. Once cardinality is matched, a palette as chromatic as the cube attacks equally well. Cardinality itself shows no trend from three inks to thirty-two. Palettes matched on cardinality, lightness and chroma, and differing only in hue placement, span $0.035$ to $0.136$. A physical evaluation with printed decals did not detect transfer; it bounds the transferred rate at $0.133$, which does not exclude the simulated value of $0.121$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把打印机实测色域、面板尺寸与高空成像细节损失作为硬约束直接放进对抗贴片优化，而非打印阶段再补救。在 13 个受害模型、3 个随机种子、与尺寸匹配对照比较下，实测色域对闭集分割是升的（DeepLabv3-R101 净攻击成功率 +0.120、SegFormer-B0 +0.041，且两套墨色的种子区间不相交），对开放词汇分割器和 4 个检测器中的 2 个则色立方更强，检测器净提升都不超过 +0.026。
Motivation: 空中感知的对抗贴片多以数字合成图评估，打印只是实现细节，打印机色域、面板尺寸与高空成像细节损失这些物理约束在优化中缺席，导致数字结果与实机表现脱节。
Method: 优化时同时施加三项物理约束：特定打印机可复现的色域（打印并扫描 216 色块图谱实测）、车辆可用平板尺寸、以及从高空成像丢失的细节。主对比只改墨色集合：一个限定均匀色立方，一个限定实测色域，其余 17 项优化设置完全相同，各跑 3 个种子，在 13 个受害条件下评测，所有比率对照尺寸匹配的优化对照贴片。
Result: 实测色域效应随受害模型而变：6 个闭集分割器中 3 个净攻击成功率上升，DeepLabv3-R101 +0.120、SegFormer-B0 +0.041，且两套墨色的种子区间不相交；色立方在开放词汇分割器和 4 个检测器中的 2 个上更强，任一墨色下检测器净提升都不超过 +0.026。另有 11 个贴片检验“可打印色板色度更低、频率更低所以更弱”的解释，结论不成立：基数匹配后与色立方同样色度的色板攻击效果相当，从 3 色到 32 色基数无趋势；仅色相布局不同、基数与明度彩度匹配的色板跨度 0.035 至 0.136。实体打印贴片的物理评测未检出迁移，把迁移率上界定在 0.133，不排除模拟值 0.121。
Conclusion: 实测色域对对抗贴片的影响由受害模型决定而非整体变弱，色板的色度或色数都不是解释，色相布局本身就能带来 0.035–0.136 的跨度；物理评测给出的迁移上界 0.133 与模拟值 0.121 相容。

papers.title: Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency in Flow Matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models are used to solve partial differential equations and model distributions of physical system states, but ensuring that the generated samples satisfy the governing laws remains challenging. Projection-based flow-matching methods enforce physics by correcting the flow from an unconstrained noise distribution. These corrections shift the generated samples away from the distribution of target solutions, especially in high noise regions. To address this limitation, we propose Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency (SAPC), a Functional Flow Matching method that encodes the physical constraints into the source noise before generation begins. We evaluate SAPC on five systems governed by partial differential equations, covering six tasks with linear and non-linear dynamics, and compare results against five baselines and the unconstrained backbone. Anchoring the source reduces the need for large corrections that drive samples onto admissible but off-distribution states, and SAPC reproduces the target distributions most accurately on every evaluated task, while matching the constraint precision of the best projection-based baselines. Ablation experiments show that this gain arises from pairing source projection with a matched training objective that regresses toward the projected source. These results identify the source distribution as a key design choice for physically consistent generative modelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAPC（Source Anchoring for Physical Consistency）把物理约束在生成开始前编码进源噪声，而非在流上做投影修正，从而避免大修正把样本推到“可行但偏离目标分布”的状态。在五个 PDE 系统、六个线性与非线性任务上，SAPC 在每个任务都最准确地复现目标分布，同时约束精度与最好的投影类基线持平。
Motivation: 投影式 flow matching 靠修正无约束噪声流来满足物理，但修正会把生成样本推离目标解分布，高噪声区尤其严重。
Method: SAPC 属于 Functional Flow Matching：先将物理约束投影到源噪声（source projection），再配合一个向投影后源回归的匹配训练目标；对比五个基线与无约束 backbone，在五个 PDE 系统的六个任务（含线性与非线性动力学）上评测，并做消融拆开源投影与训练目标的贡献。
Result: 在全部六个评测任务上 SAPC 对目标分布的复现最准确，同时约束精度与最佳投影类基线相当；消融显示增益来自源投影与“向投影源回归”的匹配训练目标的配对。
Conclusion: 源分布是物理一致生成建模的关键设计选择：把约束前移到源端，比在流上做大修正更能兼顾分布保真与约束满足。

papers.title: What Happens During Autonomous Deep Research After the User Steps Away?
papers.abstract_en: In autonomous deep research, a user provides a task and relevant background, then leaves the agent to conduct an extended investigation without further human intervention. We study how this initial user information is reflected in intermediate actions and how these actions relate to final recommendations. We introduce DRaligned, a counterfactual behavioral evaluation framework built on PDR-Bench. By varying one task-relevant user factor while keeping the remaining context fixed, we compare acquisition requests, working drafts, and final reports. Source-grounded extraction, blinded local judgments, and deterministic aggregation yield coarse directional measurements while leaving ambiguous cases unresolved. Our experiments show that strong user-specific delivery can emerge from a largely shared research process: agents investigate similar broad questions but allocate requests differently, and final recommendations distinguish user conditions more clearly than explicit requests do. Reports can also integrate user factors that were not jointly visible during acquisition. In readable draft-to-report comparisons, recommendations often retain their coarse user-specific direction despite substantial rewriting. Final directional differences recur across tested agent models, execution harnesses, and evaluator models, even as execution paths vary. These findings describe how initial user information shapes autonomous research and clarify the relationship between the process an agent follows and the recommendations it delivers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DRaligned：在 PDR-Bench 上做反事实行为评测，每次只改一个与任务相关的用户因素、其余上下文固定，比较 agent 的检索请求、工作草稿与最终报告。发现高度用户定制的交付可以来自基本共享的研究过程——各 agent 问的宽问题相似但请求分配不同，最终建议比显式请求更能区分用户条件，且方向性差异在不同 agent 模型、执行框架与评测模型间反复出现。
Motivation: 自主深度研究中，用户只在开头给一次任务与背景就离开，中间过程与最终建议如何被这份初始信息塑造、两者关系如何，缺少可控的评测手段。
Method: DRaligned 是建立在 PDR-Bench 上的反事实行为评测框架：固定其余上下文、只变动一个任务相关用户因素，对比 acquisition requests、working drafts 与 final report；用 source-grounded extraction、blinded local judgments 与 deterministic aggregation 得到粗粒度方向性度量。
Result: 实验显示：用户定制的交付可从大体共享的研究过程中产生，agent 探究相似的宽问题但请求分配不同；最终建议比显式请求更清晰地区分用户条件；报告能整合采集阶段并未同时可见的用户因素；在可读的 draft-to-report 对比中，建议在大幅改写后仍常保留粗粒度的用户特定方向；方向性差异在所测的多个 agent 模型、执行 harness 与评测模型上重复出现，尽管执行路径各异。
Conclusion: 初始用户信息主要通过最终建议而非显式请求体现，且这种方向性在跨模型、跨框架、跨评测者时稳定，说明过程与交付之间的关系可被粗粒度但可复现地刻画。

papers.title: When Evidence Changes the Subject: Subject-Typed Claim Licensing for Learned Routing
papers.abstract_en: Modern learned systems increasingly combine learned components with search, repair, or external solvers. Benchmarks often measure the resulting end-to-end system, while scientific claims may concern only one component, creating an attribution problem: evidence can fail to support the requested component-level claim while still supporting a positive conclusion about the larger system. Existing evidence-to-claim methods primarily calibrate claim strength. We argue that composite systems require a second dimension: scientific subject. We address this problem with subject-typed claim licensing, which separates weaker conclusions about the requested subject from positive but non-substitutive credit about another subject. We instantiate this idea in SCOPE-Routing for preference-conditioned multigraph routing. Non-authors reproducibly apply the declared semantics; held-out review yields fewer reference-relative upward deviations than unstructured review, while the difference from a strong evidence checklist remains unresolved; and a controlled routing study shows that score-optimal and claim-eligible methods can differ while valid hybrid-system credit is preserved. These results motivate treating claim strength and scientific subject as distinct dimensions of evidence-based evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 subject-typed claim licensing：把「证据支持的结论强度」与「结论归属的科学主体」拆成两个维度，使端到端系统上的正向证据不能被挪用为对其中某一组件的主张。实例 SCOPE-Routing 用于偏好条件化的多图路由 (preference-conditioned multigraph routing)，非作者可复现地套用声明语义，受控路由研究显示分数最优方法与主张合格方法可以不同，同时仍保留对混合系统的有效 credit。
Motivation: 现代学习系统把学习组件与搜索、修复或外部求解器组合，基准测的是端到端系统，而科学主张往往只针对其中一个组件，造成归因错位：证据可能不支持所要求的组件级主张，却仍支持对更大系统的正向结论。
Method: 提出 subject-typed claim licensing，把关于所请求主体的较弱结论与关于另一主体的正向但不可替代 (non-substitutive) credit 分开；在 SCOPE-Routing 中实例化为偏好条件化的多图路由，并设置非作者复现、留出评审 (held-out review) 与受控路由研究三种检验方式。
Result: 非作者可复现地应用所声明的语义；留出评审相对结构化评审产生更少的 reference-relative upward deviations，但与强证据清单 (evidence checklist) 的差异仍未解决；受控路由研究显示 score-optimal 与 claim-eligible 方法可以不同，同时对混合系统的有效 credit 得以保留。
Conclusion: 基于证据的评估应把 claim strength 与 scientific subject 当作两个独立维度，仅校准主张强度不足以处理组合系统的归因问题。

papers.title: RelaxKV: Recomputation Guided by the Query with Sparse Context Attention for Efficient KV Cache Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Cross-request KV caching reduces the prefill cost of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), but conventional prefix caching severely limits cache reuse across requests. Position-Independent Caching (PIC) removes this constraint by reusing independent chunks, but their KV states miss cross-chunk interactions. Existing methods selectively recompute token states to recover these missing interactions, but primarily allocate the recomputation budget to selecting which states to recompute, while fixing the recomputation context to the full causal prefix. We introduce RelaxKV, which formulates selective cache repair as a joint allocation problem over repair targets and recomputation context. Guided by the user query, RelaxKV identifies layer-specific repair targets and restricts their recomputation to a query-relevant context, reducing attention computation. Across four decoder models, RelaxKV at a 15% anchor ratio improves aggregate LongBench performance over ProphetKV on all models. On Qwen3-14B, RelaxKV provides a stronger quality-TTFT trade-off than ProphetKV across a 5%-30% anchor-ratio sweep, and achieves the best selective results on RULER-MV and LV-Eval at 16K and 32K context lengths. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the importance of recomputation context selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RelaxKV 把 RAG 中的选择性 KV cache 修复改写为「修复目标 + 重算上下文」的联合分配问题：由用户 query 指导选出逐层修复目标，并把重算限制在 query 相关上下文内以削减 attention 计算。在四个 decoder 模型上，15% anchor ratio 时聚合 LongBench 性能全面超过 ProphetKV。
Motivation: 跨请求 KV cache 复用中，Position-Independent Caching (PIC) 打破了前缀缓存的复用限制，但独立 chunk 的 KV 状态丢失跨 chunk 交互；现有重算方法只决定重算哪些状态，却把重算上下文固定为完整因果前缀，浪费计算。
Method: RelaxKV 将选择性 cache 修复建模为修复目标与重算上下文的联合分配：以用户 query 为指导识别 layer-specific repair targets，并把它们的重算限制在 query-relevant context 内，从而减少 attention 计算；并做受控 ablation 检验重算上下文选择的作用。
Result: 在四个 decoder 模型上，15% anchor ratio 时 RelaxKV 的聚合 LongBench 性能在所有模型上均超过 ProphetKV；在 Qwen3-14B 上，5%–30% anchor-ratio 扫描中质量–TTFT 权衡均强于 ProphetKV，并在 16K 与 32K 上下文长度的 RULER-MV 与 LV-Eval 上取得最佳 selective 结果。
Conclusion: 重算上下文的选择与修复目标同等重要：把重算限制在 query 相关上下文，可在同等 anchor ratio 下同时改善质量与 TTFT。

papers.title: Pulseflow: PPG Counterfactual Generation Via Latent Transport
papers.abstract_en: Photoplethysmography (PPG) has become an important modality for continuous cardiovascular monitoring, including atrial fibrillation (AF) detection. However, labeled AF recordings remain limited in many clinical settings, making model adaptation difficult when only limited target data are available. Generative modeling offers a natural way to alleviate this scarcity by synthesizing additional AF signals. Existing approaches, however, mainly generate samples that match the target condition without explicitly modeling how an observed source recording should be transformed, making it difficult to leverage abundant source recordings from a specific population or cohort for targeted augmentation. We introduce PulseFlow, a source-conditioned counterfactual generation framework that combines conditional representation learning with invertible latent transport to edit cardiac rhythm while retaining information from the source. Experiments across two clinical cohorts demonstrate effective rhythm transformation, measurable source correspondence, and improved AF classification under limited labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PulseFlow 是面向 PPG 信号的源条件反事实生成框架，用条件表征学习加可逆潜空间传输 (invertible latent transport) 改写心律，同时保留源记录信息，从而把某个人群的大量源记录定向变造成房颤 (AF) 样本。在两个临床队列上，该方法实现了有效的心律转换、可度量的源对应性，并在标注有限时提升了 AF 分类表现。
Motivation: 临床场景中标注好的房颤 PPG 记录稀缺，模型在少量目标数据上难以适配；现有生成方法只产出匹配目标条件的样本，不显式建模源记录如何被变换，因而无法利用特定人群的大量源记录做定向增广。
Method: PulseFlow 将条件表征学习与可逆潜传输结合：以源 PPG 记录为条件，在潜空间中做可逆变换来编辑心律，同时保留源记录的信息，生成反事实样本用于标注稀缺下的定向数据增广。
Result: 在两个临床队列上的实验显示有效的心律转换、可度量的源对应性 (measurable source correspondence)，并在标注有限的条件下改善了房颤 (AF) 分类。
Conclusion: 把源记录显式条件化并用可逆潜传输做反事实编辑，可以在保留源信息的前提下定向合成 AF 样本，缓解标注稀缺对 AF 分类模型适配的限制。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: The cost of useful natural gradient updates
papers.abstract_en: What information is needed to turn a natural-gradient direction into a useful finite update? Under a population Kullback-Leibler (KL) budget, we call a step useful if it is feasible and loses at most a fraction $\varepsilon$ of the best feasible gain along the direction. We construct a four-state exponential family whose laws share their initial gradient, scalar Fisher information and natural gradient, yet two laws have disjoint useful-step sets. With these quantities supplied exactly and the law otherwise known only through draws, the family's worst-case sample complexity is $Θ(\log(1/δ)/(p\varepsilon^2))$ for small $\varepsilon$, where $p$ scales rare-state probabilities and $δ$ is the failure probability. The budget is fixed and the optimal gain stays bounded away from zero, so the step length, not the direction, carries this cost. For succinctly described event-tilt models, returning a useful step is NP-hard even with the exact natural gradient and efficient exact sampling. Recovering the unit natural gradient to constant error is also NP-hard even in a two-parameter logistic family with Fisher condition number at most 3. We also give matching sample bounds for event tilts, sample bounds for damped Fisher solves and a population-KL certificate for affine classifiers. In frozen-feature classifier heads, stopping at a sampled KL boundary succeeds in about half of the trials, and a 10% KL margin raises joint success above 93% at a KL budget of 0.01. Thus, knowing where to move is not enough: how far to move can carry an update's entire cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 population KL 预算下把自然梯度的「有用有限步」形式化：步长可行且相对最优增益损失不超过 ε。四状态指数族证明即使梯度、Fisher 与自然梯度完全已知，最坏情形样本复杂度仍为 Θ(log(1/δ)/(pε²))；事件倾斜模型下求有用步是 NP-hard。结论是代价由步长而非方向承担。
Motivation: 自然梯度方向本身不足以决定一次有限更新：在固定 KL 预算下，最优增益可能远离零，而确定「走多远」在一般模型中计算与采样代价都很高。
Method: 构造共享初始梯度、标量 Fisher 信息与自然梯度但有用步集合不相交的四状态指数族，导出最坏情形样本复杂度；对 succinctly described event-tilt 模型给出 NP-hard 归约（含两参数 logistic 族、Fisher 条件数 ≤3 的单位自然梯度恢复），并给出 event tilt 的匹配样本界、damped Fisher solve 的样本界与 affine classifier 的 population-KL 证书。
Result: 最坏情形样本复杂度 Θ(log(1/δ)/(pε²))（ε 小，p 刻画稀有态概率，δ 为失败概率）；event tilt 求有用步 NP-hard，即使自然梯度精确且可高效精确采样；两参数 logistic 族（Fisher 条件数 ≤3）中恢复单位自然梯度到常数误差也 NP-hard。冻结特征分类器头实验中，停在采样 KL 边界约半数试验成功，10% KL 余量在 KL 预算 0.01 下把联合成功率提到 93% 以上。
Conclusion: 知道往哪走不够，走多远可以承载一次更新的全部代价：自然梯度的有限步长选择在一般情形下既有采样下界也有计算 hardness。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hamiltonian JEPA: Action-Conditioned World Models with an Inherited Control State
papers.abstract_en: Planning from pixels needs more than a latent space that is stable and predictable. The state the planner scores must also be organized by how actions move the system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid pixel reconstruction by predicting future representations, but existing action-conditioned JEPAs ask one embedding to serve both perception and control. We introduce H-JEPA, which separates the two. A wide perceptual code is regularized toward a well-scaled isotropic geometry with a Bures-Wasserstein prior, and a fixed orthonormal slice of that code is the control state, which inherits the code's covariance without any objective of its own. The state evolves under phase-conditioned dissipative port-Hamiltonian dynamics whose input port has orthonormal columns. Port-inverse consistency (PIC) reads the executed action back through the transpose of that port. We show that this readout is exactly the rollout error projected onto the port directions, so PIC is a parameter-free reweighting of prediction error and not an auxiliary action decoder. Untying the readout from the port breaks this identity and loses half of the gain. H-JEPA matches or exceeds reconstruction-free baselines, including the action-decoding Delta-JEPA, on four pixel-based control benchmarks after at most $10$ training epochs, and its largest gain is on OGB-Cube ($91.9$ against $79.3$ percent). Ablations on PushT and OGB-Cube separate the contributions of the structured predictor, PIC, the prediction horizon, the state rank, and the anti-collapse prior.

TL;DR: H-JEPA 把 JEPA 的感知码与控制态分离：宽感知码用 Bures-Wasserstein 先验约束为各向同性几何，其中一个固定正交切片直接继承协方差作为控制态，状态由带耗散的 port-Hamiltonian 动力学演化，输入端口列正交。port-inverse consistency (PIC) 用端口转置读回执行动作，等价于把 rollout 误差投影到端口方向上的无参数重加权；解开读出与端口的绑定会破坏该恒等式并损失一半增益。在四个基于像素的控制基准上，至多 10 个训练 epoch 内追平或超过免重建基线（含做动作解码的 Delta-JEPA），最大提升出现在 OGB-Cube（91.9 对 79.3 percent）。
Motivation: 现有 action-conditioned JEPA 让同一个 embedding 同时承担感知与控制，导致被 planner 打分的状态没有按动作如何驱动系统来组织，规划从像素出发时状态几何与控制需求不匹配。
Method: H-JEPA 将感知与控制解耦：宽感知码被 Bures-Wasserstein 先验正则到良好尺度的各向同性几何，其中一个固定正交切片作为控制态、不带自身目标地继承码的协方差；状态在 phase-conditioned 耗散 port-Hamiltonian 动力学下演化，输入端口列正交，PIC 经端口转置读回动作。消融在 PushT 与 OGB-Cube 上分离结构化预测器、PIC、预测时程、状态秩与防坍缩先验各自的贡献。

Conclusion: 作者主张把控制态从感知码中切出来并用结构化动力学演化，能让状态按动作组织，且 PIC 这一无参数读出即可带来主要收益，无需额外动作解码器。

papers.title: Chameleon: Dynamic Format Adapter for Efficient Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is the standard way to run modern diffusion models on memory-constrained accelerators, yet every existing diffusion PTQ scheme fixes the $\mathit{number\ format}$ in advance and only tunes the scale, zero point, or per-layer bit-width. At a fixed bit-width the best format depends on the distribution being encoded, and that distribution differs across weight channels, across layers, and along the diffusion timestep, where activation distributions slide from heavy-tailed and noise-dominated to tightly clustered and structured. We propose Chameleon, a PTQ framework that holds the bit-width fixed and treats the format itself as a discrete variable, chosen per weight channel and per (layer, timestep bucket) activation tensor. Activation formats come from {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8}, selected ahead of time from two cheap statistics (empirical kurtosis and the closed-form diffusion SNR) and stored in a lookup table; weight formats come from {INT8, MXINT8} at 8 bits or {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} at 4 bits, selected offline by reconstruction error. An architectural fork adapts the same selection layer to multi-step UNets, single-step distilled models, and Diffusion Transformers. Across SDXL, SDXL-Turbo, and PixArt-$α$ on COCO-2014, Chameleon achieves the best FID in all six backbone $\times$ bit-width settings, with CLIP within 0.24 of the FP16 reference and the best of all quantized methods at $W_{4}A_{8}$.
papers.comment: Under Review at International Conference on Learning Representations 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chameleon 把扩散模型 PTQ 中的数值格式本身当作离散变量，在固定位宽下按权重通道与（层、时间步桶）激活张量选择格式，而非只调 scale/zero point/位宽。在 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo、PixArt-α 与 COCO-2014 的六种 backbone×位宽组合上均取得最佳 FID，CLIP 与 FP16 参考差距不超过 0.24。
Motivation: 现有扩散 PTQ 方案预先固定数值格式，只调 scale、zero point 或逐层位宽；但固定位宽下的最优格式依赖被编码的分布，而该分布在权重通道、层与扩散时间步之间都在变化（激活分布从重尾噪声主导滑向紧凑结构化）。
Method: 固定位宽，把格式作为离散变量：激活格式从 {INT8, FP8 E4M3, FP8 E5M2, MXFP8, MXINT8} 中按经验峰度与闭式扩散 SNR 两个廉价统计量提前选定并存入查找表；权重格式在 8 bit 从 {INT8, MXINT8}、4 bit 从 {INT4, NF4, FP4 E2M1, MXINT4, MXFP4} 中按重建误差离线选择。架构分叉使同一选择层适配多步 UNet、单步蒸馏模型与 Diffusion Transformer。
Result: 在 SDXL、SDXL-Turbo、PixArt-α 于 COCO-2014 上，Chameleon 在全部六个 backbone×位宽设置中取得最佳 FID；CLIP 距 FP16 参考在 0.24 以内，且在 W4A8 下为所有量化方法中最佳。
Conclusion: 在固定位宽下把数值格式本身作为逐通道、逐（层,时间步桶）的离散选择变量，可在扩散模型量化中同时保住生成质量与对齐指标，且该选择层可跨 UNet、蒸馏单步模型与 DiT 复用。

papers.title: Federated Multi-Modal Human Activity Recognition using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from heterogeneous wearable sensors is fundamental to the Internet of Health Things (IoHT), supporting rehabilitation, elderly care, and smart healthcare. Existing multimodal fusion methods often assign fixed equal weights to sensor streams, overlooking differences in modality importance, acquisition cost, and sensor quality, which can vary due to movement, incorrect placement, or temporary blockage. We propose an adaptive and cost-aware multimodal HAR framework based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for centralized HAR and extend it to federated learning as FedMHAR. In the centralized setting, multimodal fusion is formulated as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem, where each sensing modality is assigned a PPO-based agent that learns per-sample fusion weights, enabling the model to emphasize informative modalities while down-weighting costly sensors when cheaper alternatives provide sufficient information. In the federated setting, we introduce BiFL-PPO, a bidirectional federated optimization strategy in which a server-side PPO policy learns client-specific trust weights and feeds them back to adapt local learning rates and proximal regularization. Unlike round-level optimization, BiFL-PPO uses dense batch-level rewards for more frequent feedback and stable training under heterogeneous client data. Evaluation on the MEx Rehabilitation and UTD Multimodal Human Action datasets shows that the centralized framework achieves 87.30% and 94.98% accuracy, respectively, outperforming conventional fusion methods and state-of-the-art HAR models. FedMHAR achieves 79.74% and 77.49% in the federated setting, consistently surpassing FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, FedNova, and AdaFedProx, while providing more stable performance and reducing sensor acquisition cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多模态可穿戴传感器融合建模为合作式多智能体强化学习，每个模态配一个 PPO agent 学逐样本融合权重，可在传感器昂贵或质量下降时下调其权重；再扩展为联邦版 FedMHAR，用 BiFL-PPO 的服务器端信任权重反向调节本地学习率与 proximal 正则。在 MEx Rehabilitation 与 UTD Multimodal Human Action 上集中式准确率 87.30% 与 94.98%，联邦式 79.74% 与 77.49%，均超过常规融合、SOTA HAR 及 FedAvg/FedProx/FedBN/FedNova/AdaFedProx。
Motivation: 现有 HAR 多模态融合对各传感器流固定等权，忽略模态重要性、采集成本与传感器质量差异，而这些会因动作、佩戴不当或遮挡而变化。
Method: 集中式把融合写成合作 MARL：每个传感模态一个 PPO agent，学逐样本融合权重，强调信息量大的模态并下调昂贵传感器；联邦侧提出 FedMHAR 与 BiFL-PPO，服务器端 PPO 策略学客户端信任权重，反馈回去调本地学习率与 proximal 正则，并用 batch 级密集奖励替代 round 级反馈以在异构客户端数据下稳定训练。
Result: 集中式框架在 MEx Rehabilitation 与 UTD Multimodal Human Action 上分别取得 87.30% 与 94.98% 准确率，超过常规融合方法与 SOTA HAR 模型；联邦式 FedMHAR 分别为 79.74% 与 77.49%，一致优于 FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova、AdaFedProx，同时表现更稳定并降低传感器采集成本。
Conclusion: 按样本自适应分配融合权重、并在联邦侧用信任权重调节客户端学习，可以在降低采集成本的同时保持 HAR 精度与训练稳定性。

papers.title: Domain-Adapted Diffusion Models for Conditional Independence Testing
papers.abstract_en: Conditional independence (CI) is a fundamental concept in statistics and machine learning. Recent advances in conditional generative modeling provide flexible tools for generative-model-based CI tests, which rely on an estimated conditional distribution to generate randomized samples. However, errors in estimating this distribution accumulate in existing Type I error bounds, and consistency of the generative estimator alone does not guarantee asymptotic Type I error control. To address this limitation, we formulate conditional generative modeling as a domain adaptation problem and leverage auxiliary data from multiple source domains to improve estimation in the target CI testing domain. We propose Domain-Adapted Diffusion (DA-Diff), a multi-source domain adaptation framework for conditional diffusion models based on weighted empirical risk minimization over both target and source domains. We establish the convergence rate of DA-Diff and show how transferable source data can improve target-domain estimation through an increased effective sample size while controlling transfer bias. Building on DA-Diff, we further propose Domain-Adapted Conditional Independence Testing (DA-CIT) and show that its Type I error satisfies $P(p \leq α) \leq α+ o(1)$. Experiments demonstrate that DA-Diff improved conditional generation quality compared with transfer-learning diffusion baselines, while DA-CIT provides strong Type I error control and competitive power.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把条件生成建模改写成多源域迁移问题，用加权经验风险最小化 (weighted ERM) 同时拟合目标域与源域的条件扩散模型，得到 DA-Diff 与基于它的条件独立性检验 DA-CIT。理论上给出 DA-Diff 收敛速率，并证明 DA-CIT 的第一类错误满足 P(p ≤ α) ≤ α + o(1)；实验中 DA-Diff 的条件生成质量优于 transfer-learning 扩散基线，DA-CIT 保持强 Type I error 控制与有竞争力的检验功效。
Motivation: 生成式 CI 检验依赖估计的条件分布生成随机样本，该估计误差会累积进现有 Type I error 界；仅靠生成估计器的一致性并不能保证渐近 Type I error 控制。
Method: 将条件生成建模表述为域适应问题，提出 DA-Diff：对目标域与多个源域数据做加权经验风险最小化的多源域条件扩散模型训练；再在其上构建 DA-CIT 条件独立性检验，并推导收敛速率，说明可迁移源数据通过增大有效样本量改善目标域估计、同时控制迁移偏差。
Result: 证明 DA-CIT 的 Type I error 满足 P(p ≤ α) ≤ α + o(1)，并给出 DA-Diff 的收敛速率；实验中 DA-Diff 的条件生成质量优于 transfer-learning 扩散基线，DA-CIT 表现出强 Type I error 控制与有竞争力的检验功效 (power)。
Conclusion: 把条件生成当作多源域迁移问题，可用可迁移源数据在控制迁移偏差的前提下改善目标域条件分布估计，从而让生成式 CI 检验获得可保证的第一类错误控制。

papers.title: Predicting Block-Coordinate Performance via Cross-Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous and sequential block updates are two basic optimization strategies used across machine learning, such as neural-network training, federated learning, and low-rank adaptation. Choosing between them is difficult because their relative advantage depends on both the objective geometry and the number of iterations. We develop a unified theory for comparing Jacobi (JC), Gauss--Seidel (GS), and partially sequential deterministic block-gradient updates. Our analysis expresses the one-step loss difference through cross-block curvature, with an $O(η^3)$ remainder, where $η$ is the learning rate. We derive a signed loss comparison after $K$ iterations with $O(Kη^3)$ error under regularity conditions and $ηK\le T$ for fixed $T$, identifying the better method when the predicted difference exceeds this error. We evaluate these formulas along observed training trajectories across different machine learning settings. Over 500 iterations, our theory correctly identifies the lower-loss method in 98.0\% of iterations for the neural network, 83.4\% for federated learning, and 97.6\% for LoRA. Applying the loss recursion at each step using the measured parameter difference raises these rates to 100.0\%, 93.2\%, and 99.6\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 Jacobi（同步块更新）、Gauss-Seidel（顺序块更新）与部分顺序块梯度更新给出统一比较理论：用 cross-curvature（跨块曲率）表达单步损失差，余项为 O(η³)，并在 ηK≤T 的正则条件下推出 K 步带符号的损失比较，误差 O(Kη³)。沿真实训练轨迹检验，预测差超过误差界时能正确判定低损失方法：500 次迭代内神经网络 98.0%、联邦学习 83.4%、LoRA 97.6%，逐步代入实测参数差后升至 100.0%、93.2%、99.6%。
Motivation: 同步与顺序块更新的优劣取决于目标几何与迭代次数，缺乏可提前判定谁更优的统一判据，神经网络训练、联邦学习与 LoRA 中只能试错选择。
Method: 对 JC、GS 与部分顺序确定性块梯度更新建立统一理论，把单步损失差写成 cross-curvature 的表达式并带 O(η³) 余项；在正则条件与 ηK≤T（T 固定）下推出 K 步带符号的损失比较，误差 O(Kη³)，当预测差超过该误差即可判定更优方法；沿观测到的训练轨迹在多种机器学习设置上代入公式检验。
Result: 500 次迭代中，理论正确识别低损失方法的比例为神经网络 98.0%、联邦学习 83.4%、LoRA 97.6%；每步用实测参数差代入损失递推后，比例分别提高到 100.0%、93.2%、99.6%。
Conclusion: 跨块曲率加 O(Kη³) 误差界足以在预测差超过误差时可靠判定同步与顺序块更新孰优，且逐步代入实测参数差可进一步提高判定率。

papers.title: What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models hold promise for scalable brain-signal decoding across clinical and cognitive neuroscience applications, yet their pre-training pipelines remain poorly understood. Among design choices, the masking strategy is particularly critical: it determines what the network must predict and from which context. Yet it has never been ablated in isolation, as each new model bundles a new masking strategy with a new backbone and objective. In this paper, we formalize the design choices for spatio-temporal masking strategies and train various models with a single pipeline under varying masking configurations across two SSL frameworks (MAE and JEPA). We then systematically evaluate the resulting 58 pre-trained models on the 12 datasets of OpenEEGBench under a linear probe. Both frameworks agree on an optimal masking configuration and on shared failure modes. Outside these, performance is robust: 11 MAE and 9 JEPA configurations are statistically indistinguishable from the best. We further identify a novel JEPA-specific failure mode, tagged bias-inflation collapse, invisible to standard detectors. With a well-chosen mask, our pipeline reaches REVE-level downstream performance at a fraction of REVE's pre-training compute.
papers.comment: A controlled evaluation across MAE and JEPA. 44 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Project page: https://pierregtch.github.io/eeg-fm-masking
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一训练管线下系统消融 EEG 基础模型的时空掩码几何，跨 MAE 与 JEPA 两种自监督框架训练 58 个模型，在 OpenEEGBench 12 个数据集上做线性探测。两个框架对最优掩码配置与共享失效模式结论一致，且 11 个 MAE 与 9 个 JEPA 配置与最优配置在统计上不可区分；掩码选得当，本管线可用 REVE 预训练算力的一小部分达到其下游性能。
Motivation: EEG 基础模型的预训练管线缺乏理解，掩码策略决定网络要预测什么、从什么上下文预测，但从未被单独消融——每个新模型都把掩码策略与新骨干、新目标捆绑在一起。
Method: 形式化时空掩码策略的设计选择，在单一管线下改变掩码配置，跨 MAE 与 JEPA 两个自监督框架训练多个模型，共 58 个预训练模型；用线性探测 (linear probe) 在 OpenEEGBench 的 12 个数据集上统一评估。
Result: MAE 与 JEPA 在最优掩码配置和共享失效模式上结论一致；11 个 MAE 配置与 9 个 JEPA 配置与最优配置统计上不可区分 (statistically indistinguishable)；识别出 JEPA 特有的新失效模式 bias-inflation collapse，标准检测器对其不可见；掩码选得当时管线以 REVE 预训练算力的一小部分达到 REVE 级下游性能。
Conclusion: 掩码几何是可独立消融且决定性的设计维度：两个框架给出一致的最优配置与失效模式，而配置间性能总体稳健，说明多数掩码选择可行、少数配置会触发特定崩溃。

papers.title: Mask-Induced Displacement in Audio XAI via Logit Trajectory Decomposition
authors: Anna Xambó Sedó (1) ((1) School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science
Queen Mary University of London (2) Department of Informatics
papers.abstract_en: Perturbation-based XAI methods for audio classifiers often estimate feature importance by masking spectrogram regions and crediting output changes to the retained signal. Yet they typically assume the fill (the mask replacement) is negligible. We propose logit-space trajectory decomposition to examine this assumption. An on-axis component captures output along a line connecting the fully filled (occluded) spectrogram to the fully retained original; an off-axis component captures perpendicular displacement. We evaluate across three fills, three audio classifiers, and 1,100 AudioSet clips. We demonstrate that no fill is acoustically neutral under full occlusion: Zero fill activates silence and Gaussian Noise fill activates broadband noise. Under partial masking, 41-77% of output displacement is off-axis, with the direction of the residual stable across mask retention fraction and specific to each model-fill combination. Attribution methods are unevenly exposed to off-axis displacement through their sampling and weighting strategies, revealing apparatus-dependence. Where the off-axis residual is stable and low-dimensional, its structure affords mitigation.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Paper status: submitted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 音频分类器的扰动式 XAI 假设掩码填充对输出无害，本文用 logit 轨迹分解把输出位移拆成沿「全遮挡→全保留」连线的 on-axis 分量与垂直的 off-axis 分量。在 3 种填充、3 个音频分类器、1,100 条 AudioSet 片段上，部分掩码时 41–77% 的输出位移是 off-axis，方向在各掩码保留率下稳定且随模型-填充组合而异；全遮挡下 Zero 填充激活静音、Gaussian Noise 填充激活宽带噪声，没有填充是声学中性的。
Motivation: 扰动式 XAI 把输出变化全部归因给保留的信号，却默认掩码填充（fill）本身无影响；若填充引入垂直于主轴的位移，归因结果就依赖于填充选择而非真实特征重要性。
Method: 提出 logit 空间轨迹分解：以全遮挡（occluded）谱到全保留原始谱的连线定义 on-axis 分量，垂直方向定义 off-axis 分量；在 3 种填充（含 Zero、Gaussian Noise）、3 个音频分类器与 1,100 条 AudioSet 片段上评估，并按各归因方法的采样与加权策略考察其暴露程度。
Result: 全遮挡下无填充声学中性：Zero 填充激活静音，Gaussian Noise 填充激活宽带噪声；部分掩码时 41–77% 的输出位移为 off-axis，残差方向跨掩码保留率稳定且对每个模型-填充组合特异；不同归因方法因采样与加权策略不同，对 off-axis 位移的暴露程度不均。
Conclusion: 填充并非中性，归因存在装置依赖 (apparatus-dependence)；当 off-axis 残差稳定且低维时，其结构可用于缓解这类位移带来的归因偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Synthetic Labels Improve Conformal Prediction: A Perspective on Conditional Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free finite-sample marginal coverage, but post-hoc calibration data may be too scarce to learn how uncertainty varies across inputs. Meanwhile, abundant covariates can often be labeled cheaply by domain models or general-purpose language models. We study whether these synthetic labels can improve conditional coverage when only a small trusted sample is available. Building on score-quantile regression, we introduce prediction-powered quantile learning: a synthetic-labeled pool estimates pinball risk, paired trusted and synthetic outcomes correct its bias, and an independent trusted split performs final conformalization. Profiling pinball risk over scalar corrections reveals that population conditional-coverage error is its functional gradient; the corresponding Hessian removes global shifts and weights remaining shape error by boundary density. Composing this geometry with prediction-powered learning yields a three-resource expansion and a benefit--cost rule for synthetic power. Across eight regression benchmarks, synthetic-powered quantile learning substantially improves downstream conditional coverage while preserving marginal validity and producing more compact prediction sets. A human-rating study finds similar gains from external LLM labels and exposes a quality--quantity--cost tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仅有少量可信标注时，用廉价合成标签扩充 score-quantile 回归的 pinball 风险估计，再用配对的可信-合成结果纠偏、独立可信划分做最终 conformalization，可在保持边际有效性的同时改善条件覆盖并缩小预测集。八个回归基准上条件覆盖显著改善且边际有效性保留，人工评分研究显示外部 LLM 标签带来相近收益，并暴露质量-数量-成本权衡。
Motivation: conformal prediction 只保证分布无关的有限样本边际覆盖，而事后校准数据往往太少，学不出不确定性随输入变化的条件覆盖结构；同时大量协变量可由领域模型或通用 LLM 廉价打标。
Method: 提出 prediction-powered quantile learning：合成标注池估计 pinball 风险，配对的可信与合成结果纠正其偏差，独立可信划分做最终 conformalization。对标量修正做 pinball 风险剖面，证明总体条件覆盖误差是其泛函梯度，对应 Hessian 消除全局平移、按边界密度加权剩余形状误差；与 prediction-powered 学习组合得到三资源展开与合成标签收益-成本规则。
Result: 在八个回归基准上，合成标签驱动的 quantile learning 显著改善下游条件覆盖，同时保持边际有效性并产生更紧凑的预测集；人工评分研究发现外部 LLM 标签带来相近收益，并揭示质量-数量-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 合成标签在可信样本稀缺时能实质改善条件覆盖而不牺牲边际有效性，其价值应按质量-数量-成本权衡来配置。

papers.title: Just Let Linear States Forget the Distant Past: Prefix Caching via Suffix Replay for Hybrid LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid LLMs interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce long-context inference cost, but this structure complicates prefix caching. Full-attention KV caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing systems materialize recurrent-state checkpoints, restricting prefix reuse to checkpoint-aligned positions. We present SuffixReplay, the first prefix caching system that lets hybrid LLMs reuse cached prefixes at every cache-supported page boundary without materializing recurrent-state checkpoints. Our key insight is to just let linear states forget the distant past. Modern linear-attention mechanisms use recurrent decay and gating to attenuate the influence of old inputs. Therefore, instead of checkpointing every prefix boundary, SuffixReplay approximates the state at a matched boundary by replaying only a recent suffix of the layer's input hidden states, which we retain as anchors. At the algorithmic level, SuffixReplay combines layer-wise and token-wise anchor sparsity with a bounded replay budget to control storage, computation, and quality. At the system level, it uses an independently managed anchor sidecar and a pipelined replay path to overlap anchor movement and state reconstruction with the native serving pipeline. We evaluate SuffixReplay on three hybrid LLMs: OLMo-Hybrid-7B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.6-27B-FP8. Across these models, SuffixReplay retains 91.4-100% of full-prefill quality on average across LongBench and RULER, while using only 0.36-0.51x the amortized per-token storage of SGLang's default 8192-token checkpoint cache. Integrated into SGLang, SuffixReplay reduces median TTFT by 15-70% on branching workloads, sustains 2.3-4.3x SGLang's throughput when the working set exceeds HBM, and matches SGLang on high-hit continuation traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuffixReplay 让混合 LLM（全注意力+线性注意力）的线性状态直接遗忘远端历史，只重放最近一段隐藏状态作为 anchor，从而在任意 cache page 边界复用前缀而无需物化 recurrent-state checkpoint。在 OLMo-Hybrid-7B、Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 上保留 full-prefill 质量的 91.4-100%（LongBench 与 RULER 平均），摊销每 token 存储仅为 SGLang 默认 8192-token checkpoint cache 的 0.36-0.51x。
Motivation: 混合 LLM 中线性注意力层的 recurrent state 无法回滚到任意前缀边界，现有系统只能物化状态 checkpoint，把前缀复用限制在 checkpoint 对齐位置，浪费缓存命中机会并抬高存储与 TTFT。
Method: 利用线性注意力的 recurrent decay 与 gating 会衰减旧输入影响这一性质，用保留的近期输入隐藏状态 anchor 重放来近似匹配边界处的状态；算法层结合 layer-wise 与 token-wise anchor 稀疏加有界重放预算控制存储、计算与质量，系统层用独立管理的 anchor sidecar 与流水化重放路径把 anchor 搬运和状态重建与原生 serving 流水线重叠，集成进 SGLang。
Result: 在三个混合 LLM 上，LongBench 与 RULER 平均保留 91.4-100% 的 full-prefill 质量，摊销每 token 存储为 SGLang 默认 8192-token checkpoint cache 的 0.36-0.51x；集成 SGLang 后分支负载中位 TTFT 降低 15-70%，working set 超出 HBM 时吞吐维持 SGLang 的 2.3-4.3x，高命中续写流量上与 SGLang 持平。
Conclusion: 线性注意力状态对远端历史的遗忘足以支撑任意页边界的前缀复用，无需 checkpoint 物化即可同时压低存储与 TTFT，并在超出 HBM 的工作集下显著提升吞吐。

summary_sections.tldr: SuffixReplay 让混合 LLM（全注意力+线性注意力）的线性状态直接遗忘远端历史，只重放最近一段隐藏状态作为 anchor，从而在任意 cache page 边界复用前缀而无需物化 recurrent-state checkpoint。在 OLMo-Hybrid-7B、Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 上保留 full-prefill 质量的 91.4-100%（LongBench 与 RULER 平均），摊销每 token 存储仅为 SGLang 默认 8192-token checkpoint cache 的 0.36-0.51x。

papers.title: Geometric Identification in Predict-Then-Optimize Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused surrogates can recover downstream decisions without identifying the quotient report. We characterize the equality set of the convex Smart Predict-then-Optimize surrogate (SPO+) population risk. Under central symmetry, the centered mean class is the unique Bayes minimizer exactly when every nonzero effective displacement makes the old optimizer leave the shifted optimal face with positive probability. This condition separates face crossing from selected-oracle disagreement and gives quantitative local coercivity. Without symmetry, strict crossing alone need not identify the mean; selection balance with reflected crossing restores quotient-report identification, and conditional versions extend the result to measurable predictors. These are population statements, without finite-sample report-recovery or generic transfer-regret guarantees. Closed-form mechanisms reproduce the analytic identities and rates. Portfolio, complete-matrix KuaiRec, and Energy/Storage studies measure predictive fidelity, shifted regret, and fitted-report geometry. A known data-generating process (DGP) companion retains their application geometries while isolating conditional-mean recovery and crossing, without testing the original observational assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在决策聚焦 (decision-focused) 的 SPO+ 总体风险下刻画商报告 (quotient report) 的可识别性：中心对称时，中心化均值类是唯一 Bayes 极小元，当且仅当每个非零有效位移都以正概率让原优化器离开平移后的最优面；无对称时需在反射 crossing 之外加上 selection balance 才能恢复识别。结论是纯总体层面的，不含有限样本报告恢复或通用 transfer-regret 保证。
Motivation: 决策聚焦代理能直接恢复下游决策，却可能不识别产生该决策的商报告；需要给出何时均值类可被 SPO+ 总体风险唯一识别的判定条件。
Method: 刻画凸 SPO+ 总体风险的 equality set：以 face crossing 与 selected-oracle disagreement 的分离导出定量局部强制性 (local coercivity)，非对称情形引入 selection balance 加反射 crossing，条件版本推广到可测预测器；用闭式机制复现解析恒等式与速率。
Result: 在 Portfolio、complete-matrix KuaiRec 与 Energy/Storage 三类研究中度量预测保真度、shifted regret 与 fitted-report 几何，并配一个保留应用几何、只隔离条件均值恢复与 crossing 的已知 DGP 伴随实验；摘要未在这些研究上给出具体数值。
Conclusion: SPO+ 的商报告识别由 crossing 条件（对称）或 crossing 加 selection balance（非对称）决定，且这些结论止于总体层面，不保证有限样本报告恢复。

papers.title: LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in financial decision-making, yet existing evaluations focus on equity trading and primarily assess directional prediction, overlooking the structural complexity of derivative markets. Option trading introduces fundamentally different challenges, including nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction, requiring structured decisions rather than simple directional bets. We introduce LiveOption, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in option trading. LiveOption formulates the problem as structured sequential decision-making under realistic execution and capital constraints, and provides a reproducible environment with standardized interaction protocols. The framework includes three task suites covering portfolio overlays, event-driven earnings trading, and 0DTE intraday trading. We further propose a hierarchical metric suite that evaluates action validity, decision quality, risk characteristics, and outcome-level performance. Experiments show that current agents often fail to achieve competitive returns in most scenarios. LiveOption offers a principled testbed for evaluating structured decision-making beyond outcome-based metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiveOption 把期权交易建模为带真实执行与资金约束的结构化序贯决策，为 LLM 智能体提供可复现环境与标准化交互协议，含组合覆盖、事件驱动财报交易、0DTE 日内交易三个任务套件。实验显示当前智能体在多数场景下无法取得有竞争力的收益。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 金融评测集中在股票的方向性预测，忽略衍生品的非线性收益与多腿策略构造，无法衡量结构化决策能力。
Method: 提出 LiveOption 评测框架：把期权交易形式化为受执行与资本约束的结构化序贯决策，提供可复现环境与标准化交互协议，含 portfolio overlays、事件驱动 earnings 交易、0DTE 日内交易三个任务套件，并设计分层指标体系，分别评估动作有效性、决策质量、风险特征与结果层表现。
Result: 实验表明当前 LLM 智能体在多数场景下无法取得有竞争力的收益；评测按动作有效性、决策质量、风险特征、结果层表现四个层级给出指标。
Conclusion: 仅看结果收益不足以刻画结构化决策能力，LiveOption 提供了超越 outcome-based 指标的测试床。

papers.title: A Cheap Verifier is Good Enough: LLM Post-training is Robust to Erroneous Rewards
papers.abstract_en: When post-training large language models on tasks with semi-verifiable rewards, there are many factors (training steps, base model size, training order, data quality, verifier accuracy, etc.) that practitioners must contend with to maximize model performance. Yet, it remains unclear how well verifier agreement predicts post-training performance on such tasks. In this paper, we explore this question with over 11k H100 GPU-hours, across HealthBench and PRBench tasks in medical, legal, and finance domains. Across the tested domains, Qwen3 trainees (1.7B-8B on HealthBench; 8B on PRBench), evaluation splits, and frontier LLM reference judges (which we call golden verifiers), higher verifier agreement does not consistently identify the best training verifier. Expensive verifiers need not outperform inexpensive ones, and open-weight Gemma verifiers produce strong training outcomes. We compare two low-cost choices retrospectively -- a cost-reducing choice and a balanced choice -- with estimated grading cost reductions of 98.8%-99.7% relative to the golden grading protocols and average post-training score gaps of 1-3 points from the best evaluated training verifier. These averages include larger losses in individual settings; they do not establish that verifier choices are interchangeable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 HealthBench 与 PRBench 的半可验证奖励后训练中，验证器一致率 (verifier agreement) 并不能稳定预测训练效果：昂贵的 golden verifier 不必然胜过廉价验证器，开源 Gemma 验证器也能带来强训练结果。两种低成本选择相对 golden 评分协议降低 98.8%–99.7% 的评分成本，平均后训练分数只落后最佳已测训练验证器 1–3 分。
Motivation: 半可验证奖励任务的后训练受训练步数、模型规模、数据质量、验证器准确率等诸多因素影响，但验证器一致率究竟能否预测后训练表现一直不清楚，实践者缺少选验证器的依据。
Method: 用超过 11k H100 GPU-hours，在 HealthBench 与 PRBench 的医疗、法律、金融任务上，以 Qwen3 学员模型（HealthBench 上 1.7B–8B，PRBench 上 8B）做后训练，把 frontier LLM 参考评委作为 golden verifier，并回顾性比较两种低成本选择：降本型与均衡型。
Result: 跨所测域、学员规模与评估划分，更高验证器一致率并不总能识别出最佳训练验证器；两种低成本选择的评分成本相对 golden 协议降低 98.8%–99.7%，平均后训练分数与最佳已测训练验证器相差 1–3 分，个别设置损失更大。
Conclusion: 昂贵验证器不必优于廉价验证器，开源 Gemma 验证器即可产生强训练结果；但作者明确指出这些平均值不等于验证器选择可以互换。

papers.title: SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera
papers.abstract_en: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SphMind 是一个免训练、即插即用的 360 全景空间推理框架，把语义感知与几何推理解耦：用球谐空间图 (SHSG) 在球面上以等变变换建模空间关系，再用推理时几何锚定 (IGG) 这一模型无关的闭环优化，在推理阶段把 MLLM 表示对齐到球面几何约束。三个基准上 MP3D 与 Stanford2D-3D 的方向推理平均提升超过 21.4%，真实场景 ODI-Bench 超出 prompt-engineering 基线 8.7%，全景旋转下旋转不变性提升 5.9%，全程无需额外训练或数据集特定调参。
Motivation: MLLM 都在常规 2D 透视图像上训练，面对球面几何带来的严重畸变与环绕不连续 (wrap-around discontinuity) 时表现不佳，要在不重训的前提下泛化到非欧 3D 空间仍然困难。
Method: SphMind 将语义感知与几何推理解耦，在外部处理几何而非让 MLLM 内部学习球面：一是 Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG)，通过球面上的等变变换建模空间关系；二是 Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG)，一个模型无关的闭环优化过程，在推理时把 MLLM 表示与球面几何约束对齐。
Result: 在 MP3D 与 Stanford2D-3D 上方向推理平均提升超过 21.4%；在真实世界 ODI-Bench 上比 prompt-engineering 基线高 8.7%；全景旋转下旋转不变性提升 5.9%；均无额外训练或数据集特定调参。In-the-wild 评测中，SphMind 能答对基线 vision-language models 答错的方向推理问题。
Conclusion: 把球面几何从 MLLM 内部搬到外部处理——用 SHSG 加推理时闭环 IGG——可以在完全不训练的前提下，让透视图预训练的 MLLM 做好 360 全景方向推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Protected Cores Are Not Enough: Certifying AI-Proposed Revisions of Temporal Specifications
papers.abstract_en: Runtime monitoring traditionally evaluates a specification that is fixed before execution or externally modified when requirements change. In learning-enabled and data-intensive systems, however, the temporal relationships represented by a specification may themselves evolve. Allowing an AI component to directly replace a formal specification is unsafe: it may overfit transient behavior, weaken protected requirements, or activate statistically unsupported revisions. We introduce an intersymbolic architecture in which an untrusted AI proposer suggests temporal specification revisions and a symbolic governor controls their activation. Two results organize the framework. First, origin-version semantics makes the outcome of each obligation invariant to later revisions. Second, aggregate certification can conceal systematic failures on protected triggers; simultaneous aggregate and core-conditional post-selection certification controls both targets. A structural invariant preserves designer-protected components, and a proposer-independent lifetime error bound supports repeated activation decisions. The statistical bound concerns the predictable means of completed certification samples; interpreting it as future operational validity requires an additional stability assumption. Controlled synthetic experiments use a frozen supervised AI proposer to illustrate the masked-core failure at one decision and across repeated governed revisions. The proposer is a supervised regressor trained offline on synthetic tasks and frozen before use; it ranks candidates by predicted aggregate margin and never observes the protected-trigger success rate, so the masked-core failure arises from optimising the aggregate rather than from an adversary constructed by hand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 运行时监控中让 AI 直接替换时序规约会削弱受保护需求；本文提出 intersymbolic 架构：不可信 AI proposer 提出时序规约修订，symbolic governor 控制其激活，并用 aggregate 与 core-conditional 后选择双重认证同时约束总体与受保护触发器。受控合成实验中，冻结的监督 proposer 因只优化 aggregate margin 而在受保护触发器上产生 masked-core failure。
Motivation: 在学习使能与数据密集系统中，规约本身会随需求演化；直接让 AI 替换形式规约可能过拟合瞬态行为、削弱受保护需求，而仅认证 aggregate 会掩盖受保护触发器上的系统性失败。
Method: 提出 intersymbolic 架构：离线训练并冻结的监督回归 proposer 按预测 aggregate margin 排序候选修订，从不观测受保护触发器成功率；symbolic governor 用 origin-version semantics 使每项义务结果对后续修订不变，配合结构不变量保护设计师标记组件、aggregate 与 core-conditional 后选择双重认证，以及与 proposer 无关的 lifetime error bound 支持重复激活决策。
Result: 受控合成实验用冻结的监督 proposer 演示 masked-core failure 在单次决策与多次受治理修订下均出现：失败源于优化 aggregate 而非人为构造的对抗。统计误差界约束已完成认证样本的可预测均值，将其解释为未来运行有效性还需额外的稳定性假设。
Conclusion: 仅靠受保护核心不足以保证 AI 提出的时序规约修订安全，必须叠加 core-conditional 认证与受治理激活；lifetime error bound 的运行时外推依赖额外稳定性假设。

papers.title: When Does the Concept of "Dog" Emerge in an Audio LLM?
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models answer audio questions, but how they represent auditory semantics and use them in decisions remains unclear, limiting our understanding of response formation. We study dog barking in Qwen2.5-Omni-7B using Jacobian lens (J-lens) readout and directional interventions. We define the dog direction as a J-lens-derived hidden-state vector associated with dog; adding or removing its component modulates dog-related information. We find this information decodable without dog/bark prompt cues or animal-identification requirements. Directional interventions change response tendencies and some final answers, with effects concentrated in late-layer states immediately before generation across species classification, vocalization classification, and sound description. The dog direction shows no comparable advantage over controls in animal/other classification. These results provide causal-intervention evidence that the dog direction affects output scores in a task-dependent manner, most consistently at L22 and L24 immediately before generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在音频多模态大模型 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 中，用 Jacobian lens (J-lens) 读出与方向性干预定位到与“狗”相关的隐状态方向，该方向在无狗叫提示、无动物识别任务时仍可解码。增删该方向分量会改变回答倾向与部分最终答案，效应集中在生成前的晚期层 L22 与 L24，且在物种分类、发声分类、声音描述三类任务上最一致；但在动物/其他二分类上该方向相对对照方向没有优势。
Motivation: 多模态大模型如何表征听觉语义并据此形成回答尚不清楚，缺少因果层面的证据说明某个概念方向是否真的驱动输出。
Method: 以 J-lens 读出隐状态并构造“狗方向”这一隐状态向量，通过加/删该方向分量做方向性干预，观察输出分数与回答变化，对照组为其他方向。
Result: 狗方向信息在无狗/吠叫提示、无动物识别要求时仍可解码；方向性干预改变回答倾向与部分最终答案，效应集中在生成前的晚期层，最一致的是 L22 与 L24；在物种分类、发声分类、声音描述三类任务上均观察到该效应，而在动物/其他分类上狗方向相对对照无明显优势。
Conclusion: 狗方向对输出分数具有任务依赖的因果影响，且作用位置紧邻生成前的晚期层；概念方向的效应并非在所有任务上都强于对照方向。

papers.title: A Free Knob: Decoupling Calibration and Predictive Skill in Threshold-Based Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Many dense-prediction benchmarks evaluate rare events by pooling prediction and target over spatial blocks, thresholding each, and scoring the contingency table. At a fixed rare operating point, the max-pooled Critical Success Index (CSI) confounds spatial discrimination with amplitude calibration: sharp observations promote many blocks above threshold, while attenuated predictions from squared-error regression leave the same blocks below it. We repurpose classical monotone calibration as a symmetric audit: a post-hoc transform fitted on held-out data and applied separately to each system. The transform cannot reverse pixel ordering, so any contrast it reproduces cannot establish improved spatial ranking. On SEVIR, two released checkpoints of one architecture differ by -29.5% in extreme-threshold CSI before the control and by +5.3% after it. Across 450 pairwise contrasts among 6 systems, the difference in pooled frequency-bias deviation is associated with how far the CSI contrast moves under the control (r = +0.796), and 51 contrasts reverse sign. At CasCast's published extreme-event operating point, the cascade-over-backbone CSI gap falls from 0.1601 to 0.0339, a 78.8% reduction; the remaining gap stays positive. The effect persists when the transform is fitted on a window before the test period, and calibration also reveals advantages hidden by a better-calibrated baseline. On geostationary infrared imagery the relative gain grows as events become rarer, crowd counting reproduces the bias-gain relationship under patch-sum pooling, and semantic segmentation, where frequency bias is already near one, shows little average change. The confound therefore requires both a fixed operating point and a training regime that leaves the output miscalibrated there. We recommend reporting pooled frequency bias and a symmetric held-out FreeKnob Audit alongside rare-event pool-and-threshold scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 稀有事件的池化-阈值评分（如 max-pooled CSI）把空间判别力与幅度校准混在一起：对每个系统单独施加一个不改变像素排序的单调后处理校准（FreeKnob Audit），SEVIR 上同一架构两个 checkpoint 的极端阈值 CSI 差异从 -29.5% 收缩到 +5.3%，CasCast 极端事件工作点上 cascade 相对 backbone 的 CSI 差距从 0.1601 降到 0.0339（降幅 78.8%）。作者建议在报告稀有事件 pool-and-threshold 分数时同时给出 pooled frequency bias 与对称的 held-out FreeKnob Audit。
Motivation: 密集预测基准在固定稀有工作点上用池化后阈值化的列联表打分，max-pooled CSI 会把空间判别力与幅度校准混为一谈：观测尖锐使更多块越过阈值，而平方误差回归的衰减预测让同样的块留在阈值下，导致模型间对比失真。
Method: 把经典单调校准 (monotone calibration) 改造成对称审计：在 held-out 数据上拟合一个后处理变换，分别作用于每个系统；由于变换不能反转像素排序，它复现出的任何对比都不能归因于空间排序改善。在 SEVIR、CasCast 极端事件工作点、地球静止红外影像、crowd counting 的 patch-sum 池化与语义分割上检验，并用测试期之前的时间窗拟合变换做稳健性检查。
Result: SEVIR 上同一架构两个已发布 checkpoint 的极端阈值 CSI 差异在校准前为 -29.5%，校准后为 +5.3%；6 个系统间 450 组两两对比中，pooled frequency-bias 偏差之差与 CSI 对比的移动量相关 r = +0.796，51 组对比发生符号反转。CasCast 已发表的极端事件工作点上，cascade 与 backbone 的 CSI 差距从 0.1601 降到 0.0339，降幅 78.8%，剩余差距仍为正。事件越稀有，地球静止红外影像上的相对增益越大；crowd counting 在 patch-sum 池化下复现该偏差-增益关系；frequency bias 已接近 1 的语义分割平均变化很小。
Conclusion: 该混淆需要同时满足两个条件：固定工作点，以及在该工作点上输出失准的训练机制；因此稀有事件评分应与 pooled frequency bias 和对称 held-out FreeKnob Audit 一起报告，而校准控制也能暴露被更好校准基线掩盖的优势。

papers.title: Sharp training-conditional coverage for conformal prediction under covariate shift
papers.abstract_en: Weighted split conformal prediction reweights calibration scores by the likelihood ratio between the test and training covariate distributions and guarantees marginal coverage under covariate shift. We study its coverage conditional on the calibration data. An elementary argument, based on a single concentration inequality at a fixed population quantile, gives explicit training-conditional bounds without unspecified constants, and shows that the relevant scale is not the supremum of the likelihood ratio but a variance proxy built from the chi-squared divergence of the shift and from the average of the ratio over the part of the test population, of probability equal to the miscoverage level, where it is largest. A two-point lower bound shows that the root-m rate and the chi-squared contribution are intrinsic to the shift. Run at an explicitly inflated level, the weighted quantile becomes a deterministic PAC prediction set. We compare it with randomized rejection sampling and with importance-weighted learn-then-test and, through a certified choice of a clipping level for the likelihood ratio, map the regime in which each gives the narrower valid set. The analysis extends to estimated likelihood ratios and to tail functionals estimated from an unlabeled source sample, which yields a fully finite-sample certificate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在协变量偏移下，加权 split conformal 的训练条件覆盖由一个基于 chi-squared 散度与测试分布尾部似然比均值的方差代理决定，而非似然比上确界；按显式膨胀水平运行可得到确定性 PAC 预测集，并给出各方法给出更窄有效集的适用区间。
Motivation: 加权 split conformal 用测试/训练协变量分布的似然比重校准分数，只保证协变量偏移下的边际覆盖；其给定校准数据的条件覆盖缺少显式、无未知常数的界，且不清楚决定界宽度的偏移尺度究竟是什么。
Method: 在固定总体分位数处用单个集中不等式推出显式训练条件界（无未知常数），刻画尺度为由 chi-squared 散度与测试总体中概率等于误覆盖水平、似然比最大那部分上的均值构成的方差代理；用两点下界证明根号 n 速率与 chi-squared 项内在；把加权分位数在显式膨胀水平下运行得到确定性 PAC 预测集，并与 randomized rejection sampling、importance-weighted learn-then-test 比较，通过为似然比选择裁剪 (clipping) 水平刻画各方法给出更窄有效集的区间；分析推广到估计的似然比与从无标签源样本估计的尾部泛函，得到完全有限样本证书。
Result: 证明相关尺度不是似然比上确界，而是由 chi-squared 散度与测试总体中概率等于误覆盖水平处似然比最大区域的均值构成的方差代理；两点下界表明根号 n 速率与 chi-squared 贡献对偏移是内在的；膨胀水平下的加权分位数成为确定性 PAC 预测集，并给出与 randomized rejection sampling、importance-weighted learn-then-test 在不同裁剪水平下谁的预测集更窄的区间刻画；结论覆盖估计似然比与无标签源样本尾部泛函，产出完全有限样本证书。
Conclusion: 协变量偏移下训练条件覆盖的有效尺度由 chi-squared 散度与尾部似然比均值决定，根号 n 速率不可改进；方法选择应按裁剪水平对应的区间来定，估计似然比时仍可给出完全有限样本证书。

papers.title: What Shared Prefixes Hide: Trajectory Dropout for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own trajectories using dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher model. Since each update is conditioned on the reasoning prefix already generated by the student, the prefix also shapes how effectively teacher feedback is converted into learning. We find that shared prefixes can lead to weak token-level updates, a phenomenon we call Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation (PISA). This attenuation arises in two common cases. (i) High student confidence can weaken corrective gradients even when the teacher disagrees. (ii) Tokens that rely on earlier reasoning can receive learning signals as weak as those for simple local continuations. To solve this problem, we propose Trajectory Dropout, a simple training-time intervention that exposes these weakened signals. The student first performs a standard full-context rollout to generate a complete trajectory. During training, we randomly drop a certain proportion of the student's reasoning trajectory, while the teacher continues to observe the complete trajectory for token-level supervision. This intervention strengthens corrections for overconfident predictions and introduces additional supervision at prefix-sensitive positions. Trajectory Dropout consistently improves average performance across teacher--student model pairs of different scales and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while also yielding gains on two out-of-domain benchmarks. It can also be flexibly integrated into existing OPD variants with negligible computational overhead, further improving their performance. These results demonstrate that Trajectory Dropout provides a simple mechanism for strengthening token-level supervision across model scales and OPD objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中，学生用自己的推理前缀生成轨迹时，共享前缀会削弱 token 级教师监督，作者称之为 Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation (PISA)：学生过度自信会压低纠错梯度，依赖前文推理的 token 拿到的信号与简单局部续写一样弱。Trajectory Dropout 在训练时随机丢弃学生推理轨迹的一部分而教师仍看完整轨迹，从而强化过度自信处的纠错并补上前缀敏感位置的监督，在不同规模师生对与六个数学推理基准上一致提升平均性能，并在两个 out-of-domain 基准上也有增益。

papers.title: Native Association: Confidence-Aware Human Perception in the Wild with a Foundation VLM
papers.abstract_en: Extracting who is where, on which team, wearing which number from a broadcast frame is typically done by stitching a detector, an OCR engine, and classifiers together -- and the stitching step swaps identities under occlusion. We make association native instead: a 0.77B vision-language model (Florence-2) is fine-tuned to emit all per-person attributes as one grammar-constrained sequence, with each attribute generated inside its owner's block. Output is therefore schema-valid on every frame by construction, and no post-hoc binding step exists to attach a correctly read number to the wrong player: residual misassociation is pure perception error, $\approx4\times$ rarer than zero-shot-prompted frontier APIs' (0.057 vs. 0.21-0.24). On a frozen multi-sport test set, this single pass reaches 0.95 detection F1 (APIs: 0.65-0.75). A single extra forward pass yields a per-field confidence that supports a reject option (jersey precision $0.71\rightarrow0.96$ at half coverage) and routes a training-free zoom-and-re-read for small players. Surprisingly, once the grammar is learned, further parameter-efficient tuning yields no measurable gain under the adaptation configurations we test; the identical recipe on WIDER-Attribute reaches 93.1 mAP given-box, yields the first detection-coupled end-to-end results under its standard test protocol (84.5 mAP), and reproduces the same tuning result. In this regime, the gains live in the structure, not in added weights.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Human-Centered Multimodal Intelligence in the Wild (HCMIW). 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; supplementary material included as ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把广播画面中「谁在哪、属于哪队、穿几号」的多属性提取做成单一生成任务：0.77B 的 Florence-2 微调为按语法约束 (grammar-constrained) 一次输出全部属性，每个属性写在其所属人的块内，因此每帧输出天然 schema 合法、不存在事后绑定步骤。残余错配率约为零样本提示前沿 API 的 1/4（0.057 vs 0.21–0.24），检测 F1 达 0.95（API 0.65–0.75）。
Motivation: 检测器 + OCR + 分类器拼接的流水线在遮挡下会把号码绑到错误的人身上，事后绑定 (post-hoc binding) 是身份互换的根源。
Method: 以 Florence-2（0.77B VLM）为底座做参数高效微调，用语法约束解码把每人属性作为一个序列生成，属性写入其 owner 块内；额外一次前向给出逐字段置信度，用于 reject option 与 training-free 的 zoom-and-re-read 路由；同一配方在 WIDER-Attribute 上复现。
Result: 残余错配率 0.057，对比零样本提示前沿 API 的 0.21–0.24（约 4 倍更少）；冻结多运动测试集上单次前向检测 F1 0.95，API 为 0.65–0.75；置信度 reject 使 jersey 精度 0.71→0.96（半数覆盖）；WIDER-Attribute given-box 93.1 mAP，标准测试协议端到端 84.5 mAP；语法学会后继续参数高效微调无可测增益。
Conclusion: 作者主张收益来自输出结构（属性绑定进人块）而非额外权重：结构化生成消除绑定错误，置信度加 reject 与缩放重读进一步压低小目标错误，继续加微调在所测配置下无增益。

papers.title: A Visual Classification Dataset and Model Evaluation for Historical Manuscript Illustrations
papers.abstract_en: Historical manuscript illustrations preserve rich visual evidence of past cultures. They depict people, animals, plants, diagrams, music notations, and decorative forms. Although large digitization projects have made many manuscripts available online, the material itself remains difficult to explore at scale. Extraction systems can find illustrations on manuscript pages, but without meaningful categories, large collections remain hard to search and explore. We address this gap by introducing a manually labeled dataset of 15,000 illustrations from manuscripts dating back hundreds of years across 22 categories, and evaluating modern vision models for image classification on this task. The problem is challenging due to stylistic diversity, degradation, and semantic ambiguity, with many images that fit more than one category. We compare fine-tuned CNN and Transformer-based classifiers, zero-shot CLIP, embedding-based classifiers, and direct vision-language models. Results show that fine-tuned image classifiers perform best overall, with ConvNeXt reaching 88.9% accuracy and 81.3% macro-F1. Using CLIP embeddings with XGBoost provides a strong alternative. In contrast, zero-shot CLIP and direct vision-language classification perform substantially worse, highlighting the limits of general-purpose models in this domain. Beyond overall performance, the analysis reveals which categories are visually separable and where errors reflect genuine semantic overlap, suggesting that some limitations arise from the taxonomy itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建历史手抄本插图的人工标注分类数据集（15,000 张、22 类），并系统评测 CNN、Transformer、零样本 CLIP、embedding 分类器与直接 VLM。微调图像分类器整体最佳，ConvNeXt 达到 88.9% accuracy 与 81.3% macro-F1；零样本 CLIP 与直接 VLM 明显更差，说明通用模型在该领域受限，部分误差源于分类体系本身的语义重叠。
Motivation: 大规模数字化项目已把手抄本上线，但插图缺乏有意义的类别体系，海量藏品难以按类别检索与探索；且该任务受风格多样、图像退化与语义歧义困扰，许多图像同时属于多个类别。
Method: 构建 15,000 张人工标注插图、22 个类别的数据集，覆盖可上溯数百年的手抄本；对比微调 CNN 与 Transformer 分类器、零样本 CLIP、基于 embedding 的分类器（CLIP embeddings + XGBoost）以及直接 vision-language 模型，并分析各类别可分性与错误来源。
Result: 微调图像分类器整体表现最好，ConvNeXt 达到 88.9% accuracy 与 81.3% macro-F1；CLIP embedding 加 XGBoost 是强替代方案；零样本 CLIP 与直接 VLM 分类表现明显更差。分析进一步区分了视觉上可分的类别与反映真实语义重叠的错误。
Conclusion: 在该领域微调专用图像分类器优于通用零样本与 VLM 方案；部分性能上限来自分类体系本身的语义重叠，而非模型能力。

papers.title: From PDF to Evidence: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Clinical Practice Guidelines
papers.abstract_en: Guideline documents are published as unstructured PDFs whose evidence is locked in visual structures---tables, flowcharts, and graded recommendations---that standard retrieval pipelines flatten into fixed-size text chunks. We cast evidence access as a document image analysis problem: parse each page image into typed structural elements, then retrieve structure-aware evidence units that follow the document's own layout (sections, table rows, flowchart paths, graded recommendations), each keeping its structural context so a result points to a specific element rather than a page. On 26 clinical practice guidelines from 9 sources (3,619 pages, Chinese and English) with 199 evidence queries, structure-aware units rank the gold element first under BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval (hybrid Element Hit@1 of 0.382), with a significant element-level ranking gain over per-element OCR text (MRR_e +0.107, p=0.002; the Hit@5 gain is directional, p=0.17), while matching page-level recall (Page Hit@5 0.879 vs. 0.889, p=0.75) at 3.8x less context and clearly outperforming a ColPali visual-RAG baseline (PH@5 0.497).
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把临床实践指南 PDF 的证据获取改写成文档图像分析问题：按页解析出表格行、流程图路径、分级推荐等带类型的结构元素，再检索保留结构上下文的证据单元。在 26 份指南、199 条证据查询上，hybrid 检索的 Element Hit@1 达 0.382，相对逐元素 OCR 文本 MRR_e 提升 0.107（p=0.002），页面级 Page Hit@5 为 0.879（OCR 文本 0.889，p=0.75）而上下文用量少 3.8 倍，并以 PH@5 0.497 明显超过 ColPali 视觉 RAG 基线。
Motivation: 指南证据锁在表格、流程图、分级推荐等视觉结构里，标准检索管线把页面拍平成定长文本块，结果只能定位到页而非具体元素。
Method: 将每页图像解析为带类型的结构元素，构造遵循文档自身版面（章节、表格行、流程图路径、分级推荐）的结构感知证据单元，每个单元保留结构上下文；再用 BM25、dense 与 hybrid 三种检索方式在 199 条证据查询上排序，并与逐元素 OCR 文本和 ColPali 视觉 RAG 对比。
Result: 数据为 26 份临床实践指南、9 个来源、3,619 页（中英双语）、199 条证据查询。hybrid Element Hit@1 为 0.382；相对逐元素 OCR 文本 MRR_e +0.107（p=0.002），Hit@5 提升为方向性（p=0.17）；页面级 Page Hit@5 为 0.879 对 0.889（p=0.75），上下文少 3.8 倍；ColPali 视觉 RAG 基线 PH@5 为 0.497。
Conclusion: 保留结构上下文的证据单元能在页面级召回不降的前提下把命中定位到具体元素，并显著优于逐元素 OCR 文本排序，同时以更少上下文胜过视觉 RAG 基线。

papers.title: HESP: Separating What to Probe from When to Stop in Local LLM Alert-Triage Agents
papers.abstract_en: Security operations centers receive far more alerts than analysts can investigate, and organizations that cannot send their telemetry to hosted models must automate triage with small open-weight LLMs on their own hardware. Current LLM agents leave the investigation procedure to the model, and small local models fail at it: they probe without converging, never commit to a verdict, or dismiss real attacks. In this paper, we present HESP, a controller that holds the investigation procedure outside the model. HESP keeps a ledger of competing explanations, selects read-only probes by expected information gain per cost, accepts only verdicts backed by current evidence, can end an investigation itself, and journals every prediction before its observation. We evaluated HESP in four pre-registered studies with five open-weight models from two families (7B to 72B), totalling 7,272 audited episodes in a controlled triage environment. With likelihood tables counted from LLM-free runs, HESP lifts Qwen2.5-7B from 0.125 to 1.000 verified completion, matching oracle tables. The information-gain ranking adds +0.26 to +0.35 on every model that concludes, and a controller-side stop lifts Llama-3.1-8B, which never concludes on its own, from 0 to 0.917. What to probe and when to stop are therefore separate failures, and different small models exhibit different ones. Because HESP and its planner run entirely on local hardware, it suits environments where telemetry cannot leave the premises. We release all code, protocols, and episode journals at https://github.com/lzwhehe/HESP.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/lzwhehe/HESP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HESP 把告警分诊的调查流程从 LLM 中抽出来放到外部控制器：维护竞争解释账本、按单位成本期望信息增益选只读探针、只接受有当前证据支撑的结论、并可自行终止调查。在 5 个开源模型（7B–72B）、7,272 个审计 episode 的预注册评测中，Qwen2.5-7B 的 verified completion 从 0.125 升到 1.000，Llama-3.1-8B 从 0 升到 0.917。
Motivation: SOC 告警量远超分析师处理能力，且遥测不能外发的组织只能用本地小模型做分诊；而当前 LLM agent 把调查流程交给模型本身，小模型会无收敛地探查、从不下结论或漏掉真实攻击。
Method: HESP 是一个把调查流程放在模型外部的控制器：维护竞争解释的 ledger，按 expected information gain per cost 选择只读探针，只接受有当前证据支撑的 verdict，可自行结束调查，并在每次预测观测前先写 journal。评测为四项预注册研究，覆盖两个模型家族共五个开源权重模型（7B 到 72B），likelihood table 从 LLM-free 运行中计数。
Result: 在受控分诊环境共 7,272 个审计 episode：Qwen2.5-7B 的 verified completion 从 0.125 提到 1.000，与 oracle table 持平；information-gain 排序在每个能得出结论的模型上带来 +0.26 到 +0.35 的提升；controller-side stop 使自身从不下结论的 Llama-3.1-8B 从 0 升到 0.917。
Conclusion: what to probe 与 when to stop 是两类独立失败，不同小模型各占其一，因此需要分开控制；HESP 与 planner 全部在本地硬件运行，适用于遥测不能离开内网的环境。

summary_sections.motivation: SOC 告警量远超分析师处理能力，且遥测不能外发的组织只能用本地小模型做分诊；而当前 LLM agent 把调查流程交给模型本身，小模型会无收敛地探查、从不下结论或漏掉真实攻击。
summary_sections.method: HESP 是一个把调查流程放在模型外部的控制器：维护竞争解释的 ledger，按 expected information gain per cost 选择只读探针，只接受有当前证据支撑的 verdict，可自行结束调查，并在每次预测观测前先写 journal。评测为四项预注册研究，覆盖两个模型家族共五个开源权重模型（7B 到 72B），likelihood table 从 LLM-free 运行中计数。
summary_sections.result: 在受控分诊环境共 7,272 个审计 episode：Qwen2.5-7B 的 verified completion 从 0.125 提到 1.000，与 oracle table 持平；information-gain 排序在每个能得出结论的模型上带来 +0.26 到 +0.35 的提升；controller-side stop 使自身从不下结论的 Llama-3.1-8B 从 0 升到 0.917。
summary_sections.conclusion: what to probe 与 when to stop 是两类独立失败，不同小模型各占其一，因此需要分开控制；HESP 与 planner 全部在本地硬件运行，适用于遥测不能离开内网的环境。

papers.title: Concept Score Relearning: A Unified Cross-Architecture Attack on Concept Erasure
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure aims to suppress undesirable knowledge in text-to-image generative models. However, existing robustness evaluations typically rely on relearning attacks tailored to specific model architectures. We study concept reactivation across two substantially different generative paradigms: noise-prediction U-Nets and flow-matching Transformers. We introduce \textbf{Concept Score Relearning (CSR)}, a unified parameter-level framework that reactivates erased concepts by optimizing each model within its native prediction space. CSR requires no external target-concept image dataset and applies the same concept-directed objective to both U-Net-based Stable Diffusion and Transformer-based FLUX. Experiments across diverse concepts and multiple erasure methods demonstrate consistent concept reactivation across both architectures, highlighting the cross-architecture applicability of CSR and the persistent recoverability of apparently erased concepts. For strict nudity, CSR reaches average ASRs of 50.47\% on FLUX and 40.29\% on Stable Diffusion, consistently ranking first across all evaluated safety settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Concept Score Relearning (CSR)，在被擦除概念的文本到图像模型内部原生预测空间里做参数级重学习，无需外部目标概念图像数据集，同一概念导向目标同时作用于噪声预测 U-Net (Stable Diffusion) 与 flow-matching Transformer (FLUX)。严格裸露设定下 CSR 平均 ASR 在 FLUX 达 50.47%、在 Stable Diffusion 达 40.29%，在全部被评估安全设定中均排第一，说明看似被擦除的概念仍可跨架构恢复。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除鲁棒性评估依赖针对特定模型架构的重学习攻击，无法判断擦除结果在噪声预测 U-Net 与 flow-matching Transformer 这两类差异很大的生成范式间是否同样脆弱。
Method: CSR 是参数级框架，在每个模型自身的原生预测空间内优化以重新激活被擦除概念，使用同一个概念导向目标，不需要外部目标概念图像数据集；实验覆盖多种概念与多种擦除方法，跨 U-Net 版 Stable Diffusion 与 Transformer 版 FLUX 两类架构。
Result: 严格裸露 (strict nudity) 设定下 CSR 平均 ASR：FLUX 50.47%，Stable Diffusion 40.29%，且在所有被评估安全设定中均排名第一；在多种概念与多种擦除方法上，两个架构都出现一致的概念再激活。
Conclusion: 概念擦除的可恢复性是跨架构的：同一套参数级重学习目标即可在 U-Net 与 Transformer 上重新激活被擦除概念，因此表面上被擦除的概念并不真正消失。
