papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of Regression-based Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: A nascent family of methods that forgoes the policy gradient and reweights a supervised regression instead has garnered momentum in reinforcement learning for diffusion and flow models. DiffusionNFT, FlowAWR, and RAM are representative regimes with contrasting motivations. It is yet opaque what, if anything, they share. We substantiate that each is the solution of one divergence-constrained reward-maximization problem, and they are differentiated only by the convex generator that defines the constraint. Under the unified modeling framework, we unravel the relaxations that prior art made during building the advantage-embedded regression target: approximating the KKT condition and posterior normalizer for the linear and exponential tilt shapes DiffusionNFT and FlowAWR respectively, while preserving the exact sparsemax projection onto the probability simplex for linear tilt leads to another superior model type in this work. Beyond the theoretical underpinnings, we further empirically investigate the design space and shed light on the training recipe for regression-style diffusion RL. Retaining the merits discovered during our exploration gives rise to DiffusionRFT, our paradigm that converges faster, trains more stably, and attains the top performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM 统一为同一「散度约束下的奖励最大化」问题的解，三者只差定义约束的凸生成器；据此保留线性 tilt 下对概率单纯形的精确 sparsemax 投影，得到新范式 DiffusionRFT，收敛更快、训练更稳并取得最优性能。
Motivation: 回归式扩散/流模型强化学习（绕过 policy gradient、改写监督回归）近年出现多个动机各异的代表方法，但它们之间是否共享同一原理尚不清楚，设计空间与训练配方也缺乏统一刻画。
Method: 以统一建模框架证明 DiffusionNFT、FlowAWR、RAM 各自是一个散度约束奖励最大化问题的解，差异仅在凸生成器；逐项拆解前人在构造 advantage 嵌入回归目标时的松弛——DiffusionNFT 近似 KKT 条件、FlowAWR 近似指数 tilt 的后验归一化——而线性 tilt 保留对概率单纯形的精确 sparsemax 投影，并在此基础上经验性探索设计空间、总结训练配方，得到 DiffusionRFT。
Result: DiffusionRFT 被报告为收敛更快、训练更稳定并达到最优性能（top performance）；理论贡献是把三个既有方法归结为同一散度约束问题的不同凸生成器解，并指出线性 tilt 下保留精确 sparsemax 投影可导出更优的模型类型。
Conclusion: 回归式扩散 RL 的多个分支并非动机迥异的独立方法，而是同一散度约束奖励最大化问题的不同松弛；在该框架下保留精确 sparsemax 投影的线性 tilt 配方给出更优且更稳的训练范式。

papers.title: MAC-Net: A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Modeling Cognitive Function From Task-Based fMRI
papers.abstract_en: Objective cognitive assessment from neural signals supports neurorehabilitation, but individual-level prediction from task-based fMRI (tfMRI) remains difficult because neural features coexist with substantial demographic and scanner-related variation. We present the Multi-task Activation and Contrast Network (MAC-Net), a covariate-aware deep learning framework for modeling individual cognitive function from regional tfMRI. By isolating tfMRI features into a dedicated neural pathway and restricting participant variables to a terminal late-fusion pathway, MAC-Net prevents dominant covariates from suppressing high-dimensional clinical representations during feature learning. Evaluating baseline data from 6,500 Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study participants under family-aware cross-validation, MAC-Net was benchmarked against linear models, random forests, and alternative deep architectures. The N-back plus Monetary Incentive Delay configuration achieved $R^{2}$ values of 0.174, 0.238, and 0.277 for fluid, crystallized, and total cognition, outperforming covariate-only baselines (0.178) and alternative deep models (0.217). N-back was the most informative paradigm, whereas incorporating the Stop Signal Task marginally degraded performance. Feature attributions via Integrated Gradients, DeepLIFT, and Input Gradient were highly concordant, localizing working-memory-related frontal, parietal, and cingulate regions. These findings demonstrate that covariate-aware multi-task modeling yields reproducible cognitive-function estimations, establishing a robust neural engineering framework for clinical translation.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 supplementary tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAC-Net 把 tfMRI 神经特征与人口学/扫描仪协变量拆成双通路，协变量只在末端 late fusion 进入，避免高维神经表征被主导协变量压制。在 ABCD 6,500 名参与者的 family-aware 交叉验证下，N-back + MID 配置对流体、晶体、总认知的 R² 分别为 0.174、0.238、0.277，超过协变量-only 基线 0.178 与替代深度模型 0.217。
Motivation: 任务态 fMRI 的个体级认知预测困难，因为神经特征与人口学、扫描仪带来的大量变异混在一起，协变量在特征学习阶段容易压过高维临床表征。
Method: 提出 Multi-task Activation and Contrast Network (MAC-Net)：tfMRI 特征走专用神经通路，参与者变量只在末端 late-fusion 通路进入；在 ABCD 基线数据上用 family-aware 交叉验证，对比线性模型、随机森林与替代深度架构，并用 Integrated Gradients、DeepLIFT、Input Gradient 做特征归因。
Result: N-back + Monetary Incentive Delay 配置对流体、晶体、总认知的 R² 为 0.174、0.238、0.277，协变量-only 基线为 0.178，替代深度模型为 0.217；N-back 是信息量最大的范式，加入 Stop Signal Task 则性能边际下降；三种归因方法高度一致，定位到工作记忆相关的额叶、顶叶与扣带回区域。
Conclusion: 协变量感知的多任务建模可在 ABCD 上给出可复现的个体认知功能估计，任务范式选择上应保留 N-back 而非叠加 Stop Signal Task。

papers.title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, \emph{The Harness of Harnesses}, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an \emph{All-Domain Collaboration Network}, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Raven 提出开源多智能体生态，自动构建并演化面向特定模型与领域的模块化 harness，把每个可执行的 model–harness 对当作可组合的智能单元。Host Agent 分解目标并调度专门化 agent，Skill Forge 与 host archive 跨任务沉淀经验；理论给出在共享资源预算下组合可扩大可靠任务覆盖的充分条件，并在复杂长程任务上显著优于 SOTA 智能体系统。
Motivation: harness 复杂度上升使手工设计难以扩展，且与具体领域强耦合，单一 harness 通用性受限；问题从为单域设计更强 harness 转向自主构建、经验改进并跨域编排。
Method: Raven 由 Host Agent（目标分解、子任务匹配、执行依赖协调、结果集成）、host archive 与 EverOS（跨任务经验保存）、Skill Forge（把经验固化为可复用流程）组成；理论部分给出组合扩大可靠任务覆盖的充分条件。
Result: 在复杂与长程任务上显著优于当前 SOTA 智能体系统；理论证明在共享资源预算下组合可超出可用单体 agent 的可靠任务覆盖。
Conclusion: 把 model–harness 对当作可组合单元并跨域编排，能在固定资源预算下扩大可靠任务覆盖，是应对 harness 复杂度与领域耦合的可行路径。

papers.title: SMAT: Simple and Efficient Merge-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple experts without joint retraining, but standard expert training optimizes task loss alone and does not guarantee good performance after merging. Merge-aware training (MAT) aims to improve merged performance, but existing methods do not fully account for common merging operations and add training cost. We observe that, from an expert's perspective, common merging methods can be described by three operations: Scale reweights its own update, Mask removes selected coordinates, and Perturb adds updates from other experts. Based on this view, we introduce SMAT (Simple MAT), which jointly optimizes expert loss and expected loss at simulated merged parameters generated by sampling scaling coefficients, masks, and additive noise. We further introduce periodic scheduling, kernel fusion, and parameter storage switching to make SMAT efficient, with one forward and one backward pass per step. Across four language and vision-language backbones, SMAT improves the mean score across five merging methods by 1.07-2.16 points over the strongest baseline for each backbone, with less than 2% training-time overhead over standard fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMAT 把常见模型合并算子统一成专家视角下的 Scale/Mask/Perturb 三种操作，在标准专家损失之外再优化采样缩放系数、掩码与加性噪声生成的合并参数上的期望损失，每步只需一次前向一次反向。在四个语言与视觉-语言 backbone 上，对五种合并方法的平均分相对各 backbone 最强基线提升 1.07–2.16 分，训练开销不到标准微调的 2%。
Motivation: 标准专家训练只优化任务损失，不保证合并后表现好；已有 merge-aware training 方法没有充分覆盖常见合并操作，还额外增加训练成本。
Method: SMAT 联合优化专家损失与在模拟合并参数上的期望损失，合并参数由采样缩放系数 (Scale)、掩码 (Mask) 和来自其他专家的加性噪声 (Perturb) 生成；配合周期调度、kernel fusion 与参数存储切换，每步只做一次前向和一次反向。
Result: 在四个语言与视觉-语言 backbone 上，SMAT 相对每个 backbone 的最强基线，把五种合并方法的平均分提高 1.07–2.16 分，训练时间开销比标准微调高不到 2%。
Conclusion: 把常见合并操作显式建模进训练目标，可以在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下提升合并后模型的平均表现。

papers.title: SchemaMem: Schema-Indexed Recurrent Memory for Delayed State Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Attention provides direct access to past representations, but retaining an ever-growing history is costly. Recurrent models bound persistent state, yet must preserve selected information while processing subsequent inputs. We introduce SchemaMem, an attention-based recurrent memory architecture combining chunk-local attention with a persistent, schema-indexed phase state. Learned schema embeddings provide a shared representational reference for reading and writing. Reads use the current state, whereas writes use the layer input and static schema embeddings, excluding direct feedback from that layer's own state. Chunk-boundary commits aggregate bounded phase increments through forward computation. The same parameters also support full-history attention training before and during recurrent training. We studied selective updates, preservation, and delayed retrieval in a controlled address--value task, comparing three-layer models with approximately matched parameter counts and persistent-state dimensions. Across nine address/value settings and three training seeds, SchemaMem has higher mean written-value retention at four times the maximum training delay than both baselines, which are trained toward a higher in-range accuracy target. Updated-value recovery favors SchemaMem in all nine settings against Mamba-3 and seven against Gated DeltaNet. Defaults consistently favor Gated DeltaNet over SchemaMem at that delay, and SchemaMem requires substantially more optimization steps. These results identify a promising retention--optimization trade-off in schema-indexed recurrence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SchemaMem 把 chunk 内 attention 与持久的 schema 索引相位状态结合：读取用当前状态，写入只用层输入与静态 schema embedding，从而在四倍最大训练延迟下仍保住已写入的值。在 address–value 受控任务的九组设置、三个随机种子上，其平均写入值保持率高于 Mamba-3 与 Gated DeltaNet，更新值恢复在九组全部胜过 Mamba-3、七组胜过 Gated DeltaNet；代价是默认设置在该延迟下反而偏向 Gated DeltaNet，且需要多得多的优化步数。
Motivation: attention 能直接访问历史但保留不断增长的历史代价高；循环模型状态有界，却必须在处理后续输入时保住被选中的信息，选择性更新、保持与延迟检索难以兼得。
Method: SchemaMem 是 attention 式循环记忆架构：chunk 局部 attention 加持久的 schema 索引相位状态，学习到的 schema embedding 作为读写共享的表示参照；读取用当前状态，写入用层输入与静态 schema embedding、排除该层自身状态的直接反馈；chunk 边界处通过前向计算聚合有界的相位增量，同一套参数还支持循环训练前后与训练中的全历史 attention 训练。对比实验用三层模型，参数量与持久状态维度近似匹配。
Result: 在 address–value 受控任务的九组 address/value 设置与三个训练种子上：SchemaMem 在四倍最大训练延迟下的平均写入值保持率高于两个基线（两个基线被训练向更高的范围内准确率目标）；更新值恢复在全部九组设置上优于 Mamba-3、在七组上优于 Gated DeltaNet；默认设置在该延迟下一致偏向 Gated DeltaNet 而非 SchemaMem，且 SchemaMem 需要明显更多的优化步数。
Conclusion: schema 索引的循环记忆在延迟检索上给出一个有前景的保持–优化权衡：延迟越出训练范围时保持与恢复更强，但默认配置的即时准确率与训练步数成本更高。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TC-ADA 把主动域适应 (ADA) 压成单轮流程：一次性选出并稠密标注固定的目标子集，之后不间断做域适应。在五组合成到真实、真实到真实的驾驶迁移上，仅标注 23–46 张目标图（Mapillary 140 张）时，mIoU 与目标域全监督差距不超过 1.9 个点。
Motivation: 驾驶场景语义分割部署受人工稠密标注制约，现有 ADA 方法需多轮采集-标注-重训，成本高且流程繁琐。
Method: Stage 1 用视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的视觉表征加固定无监督域适应模型的语义预测，在无目标标注下挑选有代表性且信息量大的目标图像；Stage 2 联合使用有源标注、有目标标注与剩余无标注目标数据，并在有限目标标签下校准源域与目标域的监督。
Result: 在五组合成到真实与真实到真实的驾驶迁移上一致优于代表性 ADA 基线；四组迁移仅标注 23 至 46 张目标图像、Mapillary 标注 140 张时，与目标域全监督的 mIoU 差距不超过 1.9 个点。
Conclusion: 单轮选图加目标校准的适应即可在极少目标标注下逼近全监督分割性能，无需多轮采集-标注-重训循环。

papers.title: MoGround: Measuring and Mitigating Modality Distraction in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We release MoGround, a vision-language dataset spanning four visual domains in which the answer to every question is guaranteed to be available from exactly one modality. This guarantee enables us to measure modality distraction, the failure in which a model answers a question correctly from one modality alone and then flips to a wrong answer once irrelevant content from the other modality is added. Existing probes rarely establish single-modality answerability this way, making it hard to isolate distraction in the first place. Across seven open-source VLMs, we find that modality distraction is not universal but model-dependent. The weaker-grounded modality is the more distracted one (r = +0.86), and distraction scales inversely with grounding strength (r = -0.90). The single-modality guarantee also enables a mitigation method that needs to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant context. Trained on one split of MoGround alone, a weight-space robustness vector reduces distraction on all seven models by 9% to 51%, at a cost of only 0.1 average points of accuracy on standard multimodal tasks.
papers.comment: 9 pages of the main paper with 3 tables and 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoGround 构建了一个视觉-语言数据集：每道题的答案都保证只由单一模态给出，从而可直接度量「模态干扰」——模型单模态答对后，加入另一模态的无关内容便翻错。在七个开源 VLM 上，干扰是模型相关的，弱 grounding 模态更易被干扰（r = +0.86），干扰随 grounding 强度反向变化（r = -0.90）；用单一 split 训练的 weight-space robustness vector 在全部七个模型上把干扰降低 9% 到 51%，标准多模态任务平均精度只损失 0.1 分。
Motivation: 现有探针很少先确立单模态可答性，导致难以把「模态干扰」从其他失败模式中分离出来测量。
Method: 发布 MoGround 数据集，覆盖四个视觉域，保证每题答案恰由一个模态给出；据此度量干扰，并提出一个需要区分相关与无关上下文的缓解方法——在 MoGround 的一个 split 上训练 weight-space robustness vector。
Result: 在七个开源 VLM 上：干扰是模型依赖而非普遍现象；较弱 grounding 的模态更易被干扰（r = +0.86），干扰随 grounding 强度反向缩放（r = -0.90）；weight-space robustness vector 使全部七个模型的干扰下降 9%–51%，标准多模态任务平均精度仅损失 0.1 分。
Conclusion: 模态干扰可由单模态可答性保证来隔离度量，且可通过一个在权重空间注入的鲁棒性向量在几乎不损失标准任务精度的前提下缓解。

papers.title: APEX: An Extensible Model for Agent-Assisted Production Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Production scheduling requires realistic models that reflect operational constraints and efficient methods that balance competing goals. Putting these methods into use also requires data integration, model adaptation and specialist expertise. We present APEX, an extensible production scheduling framework built around a general model and hybrid multiobjective search. Agent assistance supports both scheduling and model refinement: agents prepare data and explore scenarios in natural language, while coding agents help implement and test new constraints and objectives. Shared construction and checking procedures connect these adaptations to the scheduling core. We benchmark eight APEX configurations against NSGA-II, SPEA2, MOEA/D and SMS-EMOA on 69 public job-shop, flexible job-shop and permutation flow-shop instances, assessing workload completion time (makespan), total job flowtime and computation time. Hybrid configurations achieve the best aggregate solution quality, although the leading method depends on the problem class and objective. A separate synthetic workflow study uses OpenAI's GPT-6-astra as an interaction layer between the human planner and the algorithmic core, testing rule additions, plan and objective changes, and what-if comparisons. All 24 sessions completed the requested changes and passed independent checks of saved models and schedules. A separate coding evaluation produced six native implementations of an additional objective or hard constraint through predefined extension hooks. All passed independent checks without modifying the core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEX 是一个可扩展的生产调度框架，用通用模型加混合多目标搜索 (hybrid multiobjective search) 求解作业车间类问题，并让调度 agent 与 coding agent 分别负责数据准备、场景探索和新约束/目标的实现。在 69 个公开 job-shop、flexible job-shop、permutation flow-shop 实例上，混合配置取得最好的综合解质量，但领先方法随问题类别和目标而变。
Motivation: 生产调度需要反映真实作业约束的模型和平衡多目标的算法，而落地还要解决数据集成、模型适配与专家经验门槛，通用求解器难以随业务变化低成本扩展。
Method: APEX 以通用调度模型为核心，结合混合多目标搜索；agent 辅助覆盖调度与模型精修两端——自然语言 agent 准备数据、探索场景，coding agent 通过预定义 extension hooks 实现并测试新约束与目标，所有改动经共享的构造与校验过程接入核心。评测对比 NSGA-II、SPEA2、MOEA/D、SMS-EMOA 共八个 APEX 配置，指标为 makespan、total job flowtime 和计算时间。
Result: 在 69 个公开 job-shop/flexible job-shop/permutation flow-shop 实例上，混合配置取得最佳综合解质量，但最优方法随问题类别与目标不同而变化。合成 workflow 研究用 OpenAI 的 GPT-6-astra 作为人与算法核心之间的交互层，24 场会话全部完成所要求的规则新增、计划与目标修改及 what-if 对比，并通过保存模型与调度的独立校验。另一次 coding 评测产出六个原生实现的新目标或硬约束，全部通过校验且未改动核心。
Conclusion: 混合多目标搜索加 agent 辅助的扩展钩子，可以在不修改调度核心的前提下完成模型适配与新目标接入，且解质量在综合指标上领先；但没有单一方法在所有问题类别和目标上通吃。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph-Guided Repository Environment Construction
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents now increasingly rely on execution to validate their solutions, making the construction of reliable execution environments a critical enabling capability. However, repository environment construction is challenging because execution requirements are fragmented across repository artifacts and may only become apparent during execution. Existing agent-based approaches address this problem through iterative interaction, but information about the current construction state, including discovered requirements, satisfied and unresolved prerequisites, and their dependencies, can remain distributed across the interaction history. We present Graph2Env, an agent-based approach centered on DepGraph, a typed dependency graph that explicitly represents the environment requirements needed for repository execution, their dependency relations, and their states. Graph2Env uses DepGraph to guide environment construction and continuously refines it with execution feedback, while persisting successful repairs into a replayable construction procedure. The resulting artifacts are then applied in a fresh environment to verify that the constructed environment can be reproduced. We evaluate Graph2Env on a benchmark of 200 Python repositories drawn from RATBench and EnvBench, against a static dependency-inference baseline (pipreqs), three specialized environment-construction systems (Repo2Run, RAT, and SetupX), and two general-purpose coding agents (SWE-agent and Claude Code). Graph2Env achieves an 81.0% Environment Build Success Rate (EBSR) and a 59.3% Environment Setup Success Rate (ESSR), outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.5 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively.

papers.title: Temporal Graph Learning of Wearable Actigraphy and Sleep Traces for Modelling Adolescent Crystallized Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Wearable actigraphy offers a scalable, ecologically valid alternative to episodic clinical assessment. However, predicting continuous adolescent crystallized intelligence ($G_c$) from such traces remains challenging due to irregular device adherence and complex behavioral-environmental interactions. We address this using daily summary data derived from 21-day Fitbit records of 6,091 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (Release 5.1). We propose SATURN, a Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network. It represents participants as 21-node temporal graphs encoding daily behaviors and temporal adjacency. To prevent imputation artifacts, invalid-day edges are dynamically pruned during forward passes. Node embeddings are refined via residual GATv2 layers, aggregated through masked attention pooling, and fused with sociodemographic covariates. Under family-controlled, age-sex-BMI-stratified cross-validation, SATURN achieves $R^2 = 0.2783 \pm 0.0127$, consistently improving upon flattened machine learning (Gradient Boosting, $R^2 = 0.2372$) and sequential deep learning (BiLSTM, $R^2 = 0.2688$) baselines. Explainability analyses identify light activity, metabolic equivalents, and sleep duration as dominant predictors, while Monte Carlo dropout and subgroup analyses confirm equitable performance across sociodemographic strata. Ultimately, SATURN establishes a rigorous computational framework for digital cognitive phenotyping, offering a scalable pathway to complement traditional assessments by highlighting macro-level behavioral anomalies.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SATURN（Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network），把 6,091 名青少年的 21 天 Fitbit 日摘要构造成 21 节点时序图，前向传播中动态剪除无效日边以避免插补伪影，用残差 GATv2 加节点嵌入、掩码注意力池化后与社会人口协变量融合，直接回归晶体智力 Gc。在家庭受控、按年龄-性别-BMI 分层的交叉验证下 R²=0.2783±0.0127，高于 Gradient Boosting 的 0.2372 与 BiLSTM 的 0.2688。
Motivation: 可穿戴 actigraphy 是可扩展、生态效度高的评估替代，但设备依从不规则、行为与环境交互复杂，使连续青少年晶体智力 Gc 的预测困难。
Method: 数据为 ABCD Study Release 5.1 中 6,091 名青少年的 21 天 Fitbit 日摘要；每人表示为 21 节点时序图（日行为与时序邻接），无效日在前向传播中动态剪边；节点嵌入经残差 GATv2 精炼，掩码注意力池化后与社会人口协变量融合；采用家庭受控、年龄-性别-BMI 分层交叉验证，可解释性分析加 Monte Carlo dropout 与亚组分析。
Result: SATURN R²=0.2783±0.0127，对比 flattened Gradient Boosting R²=0.2372 与 sequential BiLSTM R²=0.2688 均提升；可解释性分析给出轻度活动、代谢当量 (METs)、睡眠时长为主要预测因子，Monte Carlo dropout 与亚组分析显示各社会人口分层表现均衡。
Conclusion: SATURN 为数字认知表型 (digital cognitive phenotyping) 提供可扩展框架，通过标注宏观行为异常来补充传统评估，且在社会人口分层上表现公平。

papers.title: A Light Bilevel Refinement Aligns Self-Supervised Representations for Stronger Task-Specific Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised pretraining learns representations that are broadly transferable across downstream tasks, yet direct fine-tuning can be suboptimal due to misalignment between self-supervised and downstream task objectives, potentially degrading pretrained features beneficial to the downstream task. The BiSSL framework addressed this by introducing a transitional training stage formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, in which the downstream task objective guides the self-supervised learning process in refining pretrained representations to better facilitate subsequent fine-tuning. However, BiSSL relies on conventional bilevel optimization solving techniques whose costly implicit hypergradient approximations render the method increasingly impractical for contemporary model architectures. To make it efficient and scalable, we introduce BiSSLight, which combines M-FAC-based implicit gradient approximation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA, enabling efficient application at larger scales that were previously impractical. Evaluation across multiple downstream tasks and contemporary model architectures shows that BiSSLight consistently improves downstream performance, with gains becoming more pronounced as model size increases despite stronger baselines. The method is highly computationally efficient, reducing computation time by more than a factor of ten compared to its predecessor on a ViT-H backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiSSLight 把 BiSSL 的双层优化过渡训练阶段做轻量化：用 M-FAC 隐式梯度近似替代昂贵的隐式超梯度求解，并与 LoRA 参数高效微调结合，使下游任务目标引导自监督表征精修可在更大规模模型上运行。在多个下游任务与当代架构上该方法一致提升下游性能，且模型越大增益越明显，在 ViT-H 主干上相比前身计算时间减少十倍以上。
Motivation: 自监督预训练目标与下游任务目标不对齐，直接微调可能损害对下游有用的预训练特征；BiSSL 用双层优化过渡阶段解决此问题，但其隐式超梯度近似代价过高，在当代大模型架构上难以实际使用。
Method: BiSSLight 在 BiSSL 的双层优化框架内，用 M-FAC 隐式梯度近似计算超梯度，并以 LoRA 参数高效微调承载下游侧更新，使过渡训练阶段可扩展到此前不可行的模型规模；在多个下游任务与当代模型架构上评测。
Result: 在多个下游任务和当代模型架构上一致提升下游性能，且模型规模增大时增益更明显（尽管基线更强）；在 ViT-H 主干上计算时间相比 BiSSL 减少十倍以上（more than a factor of ten）。
Conclusion: 廉价的隐式超梯度近似加参数高效微调，能让双层优化的自监督表征精修在大模型上既实用又随规模放大而更有效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Explainable Deep Learning of Resting-State Functional Connectomes Reveals Network Biomarkers of Adolescent Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Mapping resting-state brain organization to individual differences in cognitive ability remains a major challenge in population neuroinformatics. Although deep learning enables flexible modeling of brain connectivity, limited interpretability restricts its scientific and clinical utility. To address this objective, we developed an explainable deep learning framework based on sparse projected residual networks to predict fluid, crystallized, and total intelligence from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging in 5,285 participants from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study. We incorporated three complementary explainability methods (Integrated Gradients, Gradient Shapley Additive Explanations, and Occlusion) to interpret model behavior. The framework outperformed existing approaches, achieving Pearson correlations of 0.44, 0.58, and 0.56 for fluid, crystallized, and total intelligence, respectively, corresponding to predictive improvements of 6 to 9 percent. All three explainability methods produced near-identical feature rankings (pairwise rank correlations greater than 0.99). Consensus maps revealed a dual-layered functional architecture where primary predictive hubs localized within canonical systems, while the strongest global predictive pathways frequently bypassed these hubs through distributed, long-range relay connections. These findings suggest that intelligence emerges from the interaction between localized computational hubs and distributed communication pathways. Ultimately, these normative network architectures provide clinical reference maps to detect individual deviations, supporting earlier diagnosis, cognitive subtype stratification, and treatment monitoring in atypical neurodevelopment.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用稀疏投影残差网络 (sparse projected residual network) 从静息态 fMRI 预测青少年流体、晶体与总智力，并用 Integrated Gradients、Gradient SHAP、Occlusion 三种可解释方法交叉验证特征排序。在 ABCD 5,285 名参与者上 Pearson 相关达 0.44/0.58/0.56，提升 6–9%，三种方法排序几乎一致 (秩相关 >0.99)，显示预测枢纽位于经典网络而最强全局通路绕过枢纽走分布式长程中继。
Motivation: 静息态脑组织与个体认知能力的映射仍是群体神经信息学难题；深度学习虽能灵活建模脑连接，但可解释性不足限制其科学与临床用途。
Method: 构建基于稀疏投影残差网络的可解释深度学习框架，从 ABCD 静息态 fMRI 预测流体、晶体与总智力三种表型；叠加 Integrated Gradients、Gradient SHAP、Occlusion 三种归因方法生成共识特征图。
Result: 在 5,285 名 ABCD 参与者上，流体、晶体、总智力的 Pearson 相关分别为 0.44、0.58、0.56，相对已有方法提升 6–9%；三种可解释方法的特征排序两两秩相关 >0.99；共识图显示主要预测枢纽定位于经典系统，而最强全局预测通路常经分布式长程中继绕过这些枢纽。
Conclusion: 智力由局部计算枢纽与分布式通信通路的交互产生，这些规范网络架构可作为检测个体偏离的临床参考图，用于早期诊断、认知亚型分层与治疗监测。

papers.title: Recovering Lower-Dimensional Semialgebraic Support of a Measure from its Moments
papers.abstract_en: Recovering probability measures from their moments has numerous applications, esp. in connection with the method of moments in statistics and optimization. In the setting where measure need not be finitely atomic, but its support is known to be compact and semialgebraic with codimension at least one, the problem is still open. We combine moment-matrix kernel information with the Christoffel--Darboux kernel to provide a discrete approximation of the support. To validate the proposed approach, we test our algorithm on analytically computed moments and pseudo-moments arising from polynomial optimization problems without unique global minimizers. This complements well-known recent work on recovery of measures with algebraic support, where the kernel of a moment matrix can reveal polynomials vanishing on the support, and on recovery of sufficiently regular full-dimensional supports, where estimators constructed by thresholding the Christoffel--Darboux kernel are known to converge asymptotically to the support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在支撑集紧且半代数、余维数至少为 1、测度不必有限原子的设定下，把矩矩阵核信息与 Christoffel--Darboux 核结合，给出支撑集的离散逼近。算法在解析计算的矩以及来自无唯一全局极小点的多项式优化问题的伪矩 (pseudo-moments) 上做了验证。
Motivation: 测度未必有限原子、但支撑集为紧半代数且余维数至少为 1 时，从矩恢复测度支撑仍是公开问题；已有工作只覆盖代数支撑或足够正则的满维支撑。
Method: 组合矩矩阵核 (moment-matrix kernel) 信息与 Christoffel--Darboux 核，构造支撑集的离散逼近；验证用解析计算的矩和来自无唯一全局极小点的多项式优化问题的伪矩。
Result: 在解析矩与多项式优化伪矩两类输入上检验了所提算法；该问题设定（紧半代数、余维数至少一、非有限原子）此前仍为 open。
Conclusion: 矩矩阵核与 Christoffel--Darboux 核的组合可把支撑恢复从代数支撑与满维支撑推广到余维数至少为一的半代数支撑。

papers.title: TT-VidT: Decoupling the Temporal Axis for Efficient Motion-Centric Video Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Comparisons in video self-supervised learning often evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating the method itself: architecture, objective, data exposure, schedule, scale, and decoder capacity can all vary at once. This makes it hard to identify which choices yield motion-prioritized representations, whose gains concentrate on frame-to-frame change while retaining useful appearance. We address this with a matched $4 \times 6 = 24$ architecture-objective study at roughly 170M ~ 190M encoder scale on $\sim$1.7M OpenVid and Moments-in-Time v2 clips for 8 epochs, and propose TT-VidT. TT-VidT combines a DINOv3-initialized ViT-B/16 per-frame spatial path with a compact Temporal Transfer Layer, trained by Diff Compression to reconstruct target frames from a first-frame appearance anchor and frame-specific motion tokens. The sweep shows that TT3D with Diff Compression, not either component alone, enters the strongest motion-sensitive regime, and decoder ablations favor a compact video-pretrained decoder. In final comparison, TT-VidT leads Jester, Something-Something V2, ARID, and Diving48 fine-tuning simultaneously, improving over the strongest non-TT row by 54% ~ 121%, while using 48% fewer encoder FLOPs than DisMo and 55% fewer than VideoMAE or V-JEPA2. papers.title: Investigating the Effect of k-NN Preprocessing on Developing Graph Neural Networks: A Fairness-Based Perspective
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, a methodology to design fair graph convolutional neural networks (GCNs) is developed and tested over several application data sets. The graphs that are used as inputs to the network are constructed by a k-nearest neighbor-based preprocessing procedure, while fairness issues are considered in terms of the equalized odds criterion. To effectively incorporate the above heterogenous information, the equalized odds criterion is directly embedded into the model's optimization objective through an additional fairness-driven loss functional term. The proposed methodology investigates how varying the neighborhood size in the k-NN algorithm during graph construction influences both the classification performance and the fairness of the resulting models. Extensive experimentation is conducted on three real-world tabular datasets with known biases, evaluating the interplay between graph structure and fairness enforcement. The results demonstrate that the choice of the value of the parameter k critically impacts the performance trends, either steadily improving or peaking at intermediate values depending on dataset characteristics, while the application of fairness constraints significantly mitigates disparities in false positive and false negative rates across groups defined by the protected variable at hand, without incurring major sacrifices in overall accuracy. This study highlights the importance of jointly optimizing the graph construction process and fairness objectives in GCN-based learning, providing a systematic approach toward building more equitable and effective graph-based models.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2025 16th International Conference on Information, Intelligence, Systems & Applications (IISA), IEEE. Proceedings publication pending
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种公平图卷积网络 (GCN) 设计方法：先用 k-NN 预处理把三个真实表格数据集构造成图，再把 equalized odds 准则直接写进优化目标的附加公平损失项。结果表明 k 的取值决定性能走势——随数据集不同或单调提升、或在中间值达峰；加入公平约束后各受保护属性分组的假阳性率与假阴性率差异显著缩小，而总体准确率没有大幅牺牲。
Motivation: 表格数据的敏感属性偏差在图结构化建模中被放大，而图构建过程（k-NN 邻域大小）与公平目标如何相互作用此前缺少系统研究。
Method: 以 k-NN 预处理构造输入图，将 equalized odds 准则作为额外公平损失项直接嵌入 GCN 的优化目标；在三个带已知偏差的真实表格数据集上系统改变 k 值，考察图结构与公平约束的联合效果。
Result: 在三个真实带偏差表格数据集上：k 值对性能趋势有决定性影响，或随 k 增大稳步改善、或在中间 k 处达峰，取决于数据集特性；公平约束显著缩小受保护变量分组间的假阳性率与假阴性率差异，且总体准确率无重大损失。
Conclusion: 图构建过程与公平目标必须联合优化：k 的选择与公平损失共同决定 GCN 的性能-公平权衡，二者分开调会错过更优配置。

papers.title: TTRSD: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-time reinforcement learning enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt using unlabeled inputs. However, repeated sampling under fixed visual conditions can reinforce shared perceptual errors, while sequence-level rewards fail to isolate visual perception the foundational bottleneck that anchors multimodal reasoning risking the degradation of pre-trained reasoning capabilities. We propose TTRSD, a test-time reinforcement learning framework combining multi-view answer-level self-distillation with visual contrastive token selection. A shared policy aggregates teacher predictions across original, cropped, and downsampled views into an answer distribution. Student trajectories generated from the original image receive rewards based on the support for their final answers in this distribution. To allocate this feedback precisely toward perceptual bottlenecks, we compare the log-probabilities of the same sampled tokens under original and visually ablated inputs while holding their textual prefixes fixed, selecting visually sensitive positions for policy-gradient updates. TTRSD separates update direction, determined by group-relative advantages, from update position, determined by visual sensitivity, without requiring ground-truth labels, external verifiers, or a separate teacher. With only 20 unlabeled adaptation samples, TTRSD improves performance across seven benchmarks and three VLMs, raising InternVL3-2B's MMMU accuracy from 35.79% to 49.32%(+13.53%), demonstrating cross-dataset generalization while preserving inherent reasoning integrity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TTRSD 在测试时用无标签样本对视觉-语言模型做强化学习自适应：共享策略把原图、裁剪、降采样三种视图的答案分布聚合成教师信号，学生轨迹按该分布对最终答案的支持度取奖励，再用原图与视觉消融输入下同 token 的 log-prob 差定位视觉敏感位置做策略梯度更新。仅 20 条无标签样本即在七个基准、三个 VLM 上提升，InternVL3-2B 的 MMMU 准确率从 35.79% 升到 49.32%（+13.53%）。
Motivation: 测试时 RL 在固定视觉条件下反复采样会放大共享的感知错误，而序列级奖励无法把反馈定位到视觉感知这一瓶颈，容易损害模型已有的推理能力。
Method: 多视图答案级自蒸馏 + 视觉对比 token 选择：共享策略聚合原图/裁剪/降采样视图的教师预测得到答案分布，学生在原图上生成的轨迹按该分布对答案的支持度取奖励；再固定文本前缀，比较同一采样 token 在原图与视觉消融输入下的 log-prob，挑选视觉敏感位置做更新。更新方向由 group-relative advantage 决定，更新位置由视觉敏感度决定，全程不需要真值标签、外部验证器或独立教师。
Result: 仅用 20 条无标签适应样本，在七个基准、三个 VLM 上均提升；InternVL3-2B 的 MMMU 准确率 35.79% → 49.32%（+13.53%），并展现跨数据集泛化。
Conclusion: 把测试时 RL 的更新方向与更新位置解耦，可在极少无标签样本下同时提升感知与推理，且不破坏预训练推理能力。

papers.title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 State-Space Visual Reasoning (SSVR)：把静态视觉上下文、语言约束与一个循环 latent state 解耦，初始图像与指令只编码一次，每次动作预测以该状态为条件并用 action-conditioned GRU 更新，从而在开环 VLA 规划中替代有损压缩的文本/像素/latent 推理。以 Qwen2.5-VL 为 backbone，在 FrozenLake、Maze、MiniBehavior 上取得 99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0、83.9/90.6 的 EM/PR，并在预建 prefix cache 下把 Maze 解码 rollout 加速至多 98.58×。
Motivation: 开环规划中模型只有初始观测，却要在内部模拟动作条件下的状态转移；文本、像素与 latent 空间推理分别面临空间压缩有损、视觉生成误差累积、中间 latent token 被绕过，长时程规划因此不可靠。
Method: SSVR 将静态视觉上下文、语言约束与循环 latent state 三者解耦：初始图像与指令只编码一次，每步动作预测以 latent state 为条件，再由 action-conditioned GRU 更新该状态；backbone 采用 Qwen2.5-VL，并在输入变换与迁移设置下做实验。
Result: 在 FrozenLake、Maze、MiniBehavior 上 EM/PR 分别为 99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0、83.9/90.6，摘要称显著优于先前方法；预建 prefix cache 时 Maze 解码 rollout 比所评测基线快至多 98.58×。
Conclusion: 复用静态视觉-文本上下文并只更新一个紧凑循环状态，即可支撑 VLA 开环规划的高效多步推理；循环状态建模在输入变换与迁移设置下均有效。

papers.title: MetaBench-Harness: Unlocking End-to-End Optimization of Benchmark Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) is saturating static benchmarks faster than they can be designed. While existing automated evolution frameworks attempt to generate harder questions by perturbing individual tasks, they remain constrained by rigid, hard-coded generation rules. Moving beyond the evolution of isolated tasks, we propose to optimize the benchmark generation workflow itself end to end with MetaBench-Harness, a dual-loop search framework. Specifically, the inner loop utilizes a benchmark harness to generate a new benchmark in each round, while the outer meta-harness orchestration layer iteratively refines and searches over harness implementations based on historical evolution trajectories. By applying MetaBench-Harness to the competitive programming CodeContests and Olympiad mathematics AIME-2024 datasets, we demonstrate that the evolved benchmarks are challenging and discriminative for frontier models. Trajectory and quality analyses verify that MetaBench-Harness enables multi-dimensional evolution, steadily improving evolution reasonableness, benchmark competency, and evaluator robustness across successive rounds. Furthermore, case studies reveal its effective utilization of diverse difficulty levers to reframe problems and elevate required capabilities. Ultimately, this work provides a solution to the pressing challenge of benchmark saturation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MetaBench-Harness：用双层循环把 benchmark 生成流程本身（而非单个题目）做端到端优化，内层 harness 每轮生成新 benchmark，外层 meta-harness 依据历史演化轨迹迭代搜索 harness 实现。在 CodeContests 与 AIME-2024 上演化出的 benchmark 对前沿模型具有挑战性与区分度，多轮演化中合理性、benchmark 能力与评估器稳健性持续提升。
Motivation: 静态 benchmark 被前沿 LLM 迅速饱和，现有自动演化框架只能扰动单个任务且受硬编码生成规则约束，难以持续产出更难、更有区分度的题目。
Method: 双循环搜索框架：内层用 benchmark harness 每轮生成新 benchmark，外层 meta-harness 编排层依据历史演化轨迹迭代精化并搜索 harness 实现；在竞赛编程 CodeContests 与奥数 AIME-2024 上应用，并做轨迹与质量分析及案例研究。
Result: 在 CodeContests 与 AIME-2024 上，演化出的 benchmark 对前沿模型具有挑战性与区分度；轨迹与质量分析显示演化合理性、benchmark 能力与评估器稳健性在连续多轮中稳步提升；案例研究显示其能运用多种难度杠杆重构题目、抬高所需能力。
Conclusion: 把优化对象从孤立题目提升到整个生成 harness，可以持续产出更难且更有区分度的 benchmark，从而缓解 benchmark 饱和问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 双循环搜索框架：内层用 benchmark harness 每轮生成新 benchmark，外层 meta-harness 编排层依据历史演化轨迹迭代精化并搜索 harness 实现；在竞赛编程 CodeContests 与奥数 AIME-2024 上应用，并做轨迹与质量分析及案例研究。
summary_sections.result: 在 CodeContests 与 AIME-2024 上，演化出的 benchmark 对前沿模型具有挑战性与区分度；轨迹与质量分析显示演化合理性、benchmark 能力与评估器稳健性在连续多轮中稳步提升；案例研究显示其能运用多种难度杠杆重构题目、抬高所需能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把优化对象从孤立题目提升到整个生成 harness，可以持续产出更难且更有区分度的 benchmark，从而缓解 benchmark 饱和问题。

papers.title: FoldAttention: Declared-Reference Softmax for Fast Decode and Deterministic Backward
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive decode repeatedly streams a growing KV cache, making attention a major cost at long context. Existing high-performance kernels use online softmax, which discovers a row's normalization reference as it scans keys. Earlier contributions therefore remain provisional and may require rescaling. We argue that the reference need not be discovered: softmax is invariant to a common shift, so the reference only has to keep the weights in range. We present FoldAttention, an additive formulation of softmax attention that fixes a finite reference $Z_i$ before scanning the KV cache. Each weight $2^{s_{ij}-Z_i}$ is then final when computed, so contributions add across disjoint key ranges and their quotient equals softmax attention in real arithmetic. We use this property to develop two techniques for Hopper decode: (1) final weights gate key and value reads before the bytes are fetched, and a per-call depth $T$ cuts keys below $2^{-T}$ while keeping their mass, and (2) additive partials compose split KV and shared-prefix cascades without rescaling. On H100 at $T=16$, FoldAttention decodes seven real-model generations 1.36-2.30$\times$ faster than the fastest BF16 baseline, and up to 3.09$\times$ faster across MHA and GQA shapes, at an error within 1.5% of the lowest BF16 error on six of the seven; reading every key, it is 1.14-1.30$\times$ faster at matched error. We validate on Qwen3-8B that a whole decode step is up to 1.46$\times$ faster while likelihood and long-context accuracy match those under BF16 kernels. The same principle makes the backward deterministic: CTAs round bounded partial gradients onto an integer grid declared before the reduction and add them in any order. FoldAttention thereby removes the determinism tax: its deterministic backward is up to 1.84$\times$ faster than deterministic FlashAttention-3/4 and 1.05$\times$ faster than the fastest nondeterministic kernel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoldAttention 把 softmax 的归一化参考 Z_i 在扫描 KV cache 之前就固定下来，使每个权重 2^{s_ij-Z_i} 一经计算即为终值，从而可在不重缩放的情况下跨不相交 key 区间相加。H100 上 T=16 时，七个真实模型生成比最快 BF16 基线快 1.36–2.30×，MHA/GQA 形状最高 3.09×；确定性 backward 比确定性 FlashAttention-3/4 快至 1.84×。
Motivation: 自回归解码中 KV cache 不断增长，attention 成为主要开销；online softmax 需在扫描中发现行归一化参考，早期贡献是临时的并可能需要重缩放，且确定性 backward 通常要付出性能代价。
Method: 提出 FoldAttention：加性形式的 softmax attention，预先固定有限参考 Z_i，权重 2^{s_ij-Z_i} 计算即终值，商等于实数算术下的 softmax attention。基于此在 Hopper decode 上做两项技术——终值权重在字节取回前门控 key/value 读取并用每调用深度 T 截断低于 2^{-T} 的 key，以及加性 partial 无重缩放地组合 split KV 与 shared-prefix cascade；backward 则让 CTA 把有界部分梯度舍入到 reduction 前声明的整数网格上、任意顺序相加。
Result: H100、T=16 下，七个真实模型生成比最快 BF16 基线快 1.36–2.30×，跨 MHA 与 GQA 形状最高 3.09×；其中六个生成的误差在最低 BF16 误差的 1.5% 以内，读取全部 key 时同误差下快 1.14–1.30×。在 Qwen3-8B 上整个 decode step 最高快 1.46×，likelihood 与长上下文精度与 BF16 kernel 持平。确定性 backward 比确定性 FlashAttention-3/4 最高快 1.84×，比最快非确定性 kernel 快 1.05×。
Conclusion: 归一化参考可以预先声明而不必扫描发现，这既让权重在解码中即为终值从而免去重缩放，也让确定性 backward 不再付出性能税。

papers.title: StarBOA: Real-Time Mamba State-Space Unrolling for Sparse Radar Micro-Doppler in ISAC Networks
papers.abstract_en: In Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC), radar sensing must operate under chirp subsampling with up to 90\% missing data. An attention-based baseline, limited to a 52~ms buffer, collapses toward maximum uniform entropy ($H=2.584$ bits) as sparsity increases, failing to capture long-range gait-cycle context. We propose StarBOA, which replaces attention with a causal Mamba state-space model that updates incrementally on a per-window basis without re-scanning past reconstructions. By maintaining a persistent state, StarBOA integrates over $100\times$ more temporal history at no additional per-step computational cost. StarBOA outperforms the baseline's published results across all sparsity levels, with SSIM gains increasing from $+0.0379$ at 50\% missing data to $+0.2472$ at 90\%. Each window is processed in 1.53~ms with zero lookahead, demonstrating efficient causal reconstruction under extreme chirp subsampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ISAC 雷达 chirp 子采样、缺失率最高 90% 的条件下，用因果 Mamba 状态空间模型替代注意力做 Micro-Doppler 时序重建：持久状态按窗口增量更新、不重扫历史，从而纳入 100 倍以上的时间历史且单步开销不变。相对注意力基线的已发表结果，SSIM 增益随缺失率从 50% 时的 +0.0379 升到 90% 时的 +0.2472，单窗口处理 1.53 ms、零前瞻。
Motivation: ISAC 中雷达感知只能在 chirp 子采样下工作，缺失数据可达 90%；注意力基线受 52 ms 缓冲限制，稀疏度上升时塌向最大均匀熵 H=2.584 bits，抓不住步态周期的长程依赖。
Method: StarBOA 用因果 Mamba 状态空间模型替换 attention，按窗口增量更新持久状态而不重扫过去的重建结果，实现零前瞻的因果 Micro-Doppler 重建；对照对象为受限 52 ms 缓冲的注意力基线已发表结果。
Result: SSIM 相对基线的增益随缺失率上升：50% 缺失时 +0.0379，90% 缺失时 +0.2472，各稀疏度水平均超过基线已发表结果；基线在稀疏度上升时逼近最大均匀熵 H=2.584 bits。单窗口处理 1.53 ms、零 lookahead，持久状态纳入超过 100 倍的时间历史且每步计算开销不增加。
Conclusion: 在极端 chirp 子采样下，用持久状态的因果 SSM 取代有限缓冲的注意力，可以在不增加单步成本的前提下做高效因果重建，且稀疏度越高相对增益越大。

papers.title: Let CSP Be Your ANCHOR: Adaptive Crystal Search over Frozen Structure Priors
papers.abstract_en: De novo crystal generation (DNG) models decide where to search in composition space and how to generate structures with one set of weights. We argue that discovery is better served by separating the two. A crystal structure prediction (CSP) model is a physical prior that should be improved by likelihood training, while rewards, including novelty measured against the search's own history, should act on a search over compositions. We introduce ANCHOR, a GRPO composition policy trained with multi-objective rewards around a frozen CSP model, and continuous adaptive novelty (CAN), a graded novelty score against known structures and a growing discovery history. Using the frozen CSP model as a fixed ruler under one evaluator, we test where adaptation should act. Replacing DNG compositions with ANCHOR's policy on the same CSP backbone raises MSUN from 11.4% to 47.6% and SUN from 1.1% to 22.1% at 99.9% formula uniqueness. Fine-tuning DNG models directly on the same rewards instead moves their composition marginal without raising their on-hull fraction. We show that KL-regularized fine-tuning of a DNG model can only reweight chemistry the pretrained model already supports by a bounded factor, while unregularized DNG fine-tunes move toward known or less stable chemistry. Even a stability-only reward routed into ANCHOR's CSP backbone roughly halves SUN relative to the frozen backbone, whereas likelihood training on structures found during search can improve a CSP backbone. Under MatterGen's evaluation pipeline, ANCHOR raises state-of-the-art MSUN from 29.2% to 41.3%, transfers without retraining to two further CSP backbones, and reaches 47.1% after distillation into Crystalite-CSP. As with any model optimised against a potential, its on-hull rate depends on that potential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把晶体结构生成拆成「冻结的 CSP 物理先验 + 可训练的组成搜索策略」：ANCHOR 用 GRPO 多目标奖励在冻结 CSP 上做组成策略，配合连续自适应新颖度 CAN。在 99.9% 公式唯一性下，用 ANCHOR 组成替换 DNG 组成使 MSUN 从 11.4% 升到 47.6%、SUN 从 1.1% 升到 22.1%；MatterGen 评测管线下 SOTA MSUN 从 29.2% 提到 41.3%，蒸馏进 Crystalite-CSP 后达 47.1%。
Motivation: de novo crystal generation (DNG) 用同一套权重同时决定在组成空间何处搜索与如何生成结构，两件事耦合限制了发现效率；且直接对 DNG 微调奖励只移动组成边缘、不提升 on-hull 比例。
Method: ANCHOR：以冻结 CSP 模型为物理先验，用 GRPO 训练组成策略，优化多目标奖励（含相对搜索自身历史的新颖度）；CAN 是相对已知结构与不断增长的发现历史的分级新颖度分数；以同一 evaluator 下的冻结 CSP 作固定标尺做消融，并做 KL 正则微调的界分析与蒸馏。
Result: 同一 CSP backbone 上替换组成：MSUN 11.4%→47.6%，SUN 1.1%→22.1%（99.9% formula uniqueness）；直接微调 DNG 只移动组成边缘、不提升 on-hull；仅稳定性奖励路由进 ANCHOR 的 CSP backbone 使 SUN 相对冻结 backbone 约减半；MatterGen 管线下 SOTA MSUN 29.2%→41.3%，免重训迁移到两个额外 CSP backbone，蒸馏进 Crystalite-CSP 后 47.1%。
Conclusion: 自适应性应作用于组成搜索而非结构生成器：冻结 CSP 加可训练组成策略能大幅提升新稳定结构产出，而对 DNG 的 KL 正则微调只能在预训练已支持的化学范围内重加权。on-hull 率依赖于所优化的势。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decoupling Token Roles in Autoregressive Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive pretraining increasingly draws on heterogeneous data, making it important to understand how a model learns from an individual token. The next-token prediction objective naturally identifies a token's contribution with its own loss. However, each token is not only a prediction target but also context for what follows. Using controlled corruption, we decouple these two roles and find a reversal: making a noisy token easier to predict reduces its damage as a target but increases it as context. The same decoupling helps explain text generated by language models: generation selects each token by its fit to the prefix, while its role as context is never tested against an independently determined continuation, because that continuation is generated to fit it. At known corrupted positions, acting through the context can reduce damage that removing the token's own loss does not. Understanding and controlling what a model learns from a token therefore requires decoupling its roles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自回归预训练中把单个 token 的两种角色——预测目标与后续上下文——用受控噪声 (controlled corruption) 解耦，发现二者作用反转：让带噪 token 更容易预测会减轻它作为目标的损害，却加重它作为上下文的损害；同一框架解释了 LM 生成为何按前缀契合度选 token，而其上下文角色从未被独立续写检验。
Motivation: 异构数据下需要理解模型从单个 token 学到什么，但 next-token prediction 目标把 token 的贡献等同于它自身的 loss，掩盖了 token 同时作为后续上下文的作用。
Method: 用受控噪声 (controlled corruption) 解耦 token 的目标角色与上下文角色，分别度量两种角色下的损害；并用该解耦分析语言模型生成的选词机制。
Result: 在受控噪声下观察到角色反转：提高带噪 token 的可预测性降低其作为目标的损害、提高其作为上下文的损害；在已知被污染位置上，通过上下文起作用可减少仅移除 token 自身 loss 所无法消除的损害。
Conclusion: 理解并控制模型从单个 token 的学习必须解耦其目标与上下文两种角色，单看自身 loss 不足以刻画 token 的贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DataMagic: Authoring Data Videos through Declarative Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Data videos communicate data insights through dynamic charts, voice narration, and synchronized animations, and have become a widely adopted form of data storytelling. However, producing them requires expertise in data analysis, narrative design, and video editing. Static visualization tools lack narrative and animation capabilities; authoring tools rely on pre-prepared charts rather than raw data; and pixel-level models generate videos end-to-end but cannot guarantee data accuracy or provenance. End-to-end automatic generation faces two core challenges: how to uniformly represent charts, narration, and animations together with their temporal relationships, and how to efficiently search a vast design space for narrative-coherent compositions. We present DataMagic, which authors data videos from raw tabular data through declarative multi-agent orchestration. First, the declarative specification DVSpec unifies charts, narration, and animations with data-bound references and declarative synchronization, ensuring data provenance and automatic audio-visual alignment. Second, a "Generate-then-Orchestrate" multi-agent strategy generates candidate scenes in parallel and then optimizes narrative coherence through global orchestration. DVSpec provides a shared state for three complementary interaction modes, bridging full automation with fine-grained human control. Evaluations on 109 real-world samples show that even the most advanced LLM (e.g., GPT-5) achieves only 2.13/5 with execution success rates between 48.62% and 86.24%; DataMagic improves quality to 3.89 (+83%) with success rates above 95%, with the most significant gains in animation and narrative dimensions. A user study shows that, compared to a conversational LLM workflow, DataMagic improves creation efficiency (79.7% reduction in task time) and reduces perceived cognitive load. Project page: https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataMagic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataMagic 用声明式规格 DVSpec 把图表、旁白、动画连同数据绑定引用与同步关系统一表示，再用「先生成后编排」的多智能体策略并行产出候选场景并全局优化叙事连贯性。在 109 个真实样本上，GPT-5 端到端生成执行成功率仅 48.62%–86.24%、质量 2.13/5，DataMagic 把质量提到 3.89（+83%）、成功率超 95%，任务耗时比对话式 LLM 工作流减少 79.7%。
Motivation: 端到端生成数据视频面临两个难点：图表、旁白、动画及其时序关系缺少统一表示，以及在庞大设计空间中搜索叙事连贯的组合；现有工具要么依赖预制图表，要么无法保证数据准确性与来源可溯。
Method: 声明式规格 DVSpec 以数据绑定引用和声明式同步统一图表、旁白与动画，保证数据 provenance 与音画自动对齐，并作为共享状态支撑三种交互模式；「Generate-then-Orchestrate」多智能体策略先并行生成候选场景，再通过全局编排优化叙事连贯性，从原始表格数据直接产出视频。
Result: 在 109 个真实样本上，最先进的 LLM（如 GPT-5）执行成功率仅 48.62%–86.24%、质量 2.13/5；DataMagic 质量达 3.89（+83%）、成功率高于 95%，动画与叙事维度提升最显著；用户研究显示相比对话式 LLM 工作流任务耗时减少 79.7%，感知认知负荷下降。
Conclusion: 把图表、旁白、动画放进统一的声明式可溯表示，再用多智能体全局编排，能在保证数据准确性的同时把端到端数据视频生成的成功率与叙事质量拉到可用水平。

papers.title: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VaME 把多模态检索中的隐层推理建模为可学习的轨迹分布，用变分隐推理 (VLR) 在隐空间自回归探索，并以语义解码奖励 (SDR) 通过强化学习优化随机变分轨迹。在 78 任务的 MMEB-V2 上超过多数显式 CoT 模型与全部隐推理基线，且相对确定性隐自回归基线至少 4.25 倍推理加速。
Motivation: 多模态嵌入需要在图像、视频、文档等模态上保留任务相关语义，但既有隐推理方法局限于确定性隐路径，无法探索替代轨迹以找到更好的嵌入。
Method: VaME 三部分：Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) 在隐空间做自回归探索，由轻量 decoder 的答案重建引导；在原 embedding-token 读出之外增加 latent-fused embedding 供后续 RL 探索；用 Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) 通过强化学习在随机变分轨迹上优化，奖励语义有意义且解码结果可解释的轨迹。
Result: 在 78 任务 MMEB-V2（图像、视频、视觉文档检索）上优于多数显式 CoT 模型与全部隐推理基线；在 MRMR 等推理密集基准上稳健，RL 后有大幅提升；相对确定性隐自回归基线推理加速至少 4.25 倍。
Conclusion: 把隐推理当作分布而非单一路径，用 RL 在随机变分轨迹上优化，可以在多模态检索上同时拿到更好的语义嵌入和数倍推理加速。

papers.title: Evaluating System One Models for Agent Security Decisions: Reliability, Calibration, and Selective Automation
papers.abstract_en: Model-based judges support agent security by detecting prompt injections, assessing interaction risks, and screening harmful requests. System One models expose typed decisions with probabilities that software can use to allow, block, or escalate inputs, but whether these probabilities support reliable automated security decisions remains unclear. We evaluate Jev, Laya, Decider, and Bespoke Nimble against specialized classifiers and language-model judges, examining decision accuracy, probability calibration, and selective automation. We identify three main findings. (1) Strong overall performance and favorable average calibration can hide systematic failures on particular attack groups, including attacks that models confidently classify as safe. (2) Under strict limits on missed attacks, the evaluated policies allow few inputs automatically, and choosing separate allow and block thresholds increases automation mainly by blocking more inputs. Even policies that meet error limits during validation can exceed them on unseen inputs. (3) A second judge can detect some missed attacks, but it may also reject more benign inputs and repeat the first model's high-confidence errors. These findings show that model accuracy, probability calibration, and the behavior of the resulting decision policy must be evaluated together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 System One 模型（Jev、Laya、Decider、Bespoke Nimble）作为 agent 安全决策器做评估，发现高总体准确率与良好平均校准会掩盖特定攻击组上的系统性失败，包括模型高置信判为安全的攻击；在严格漏报上限下自动放行的输入很少，放宽 allow/block 双阈值主要靠多拦截来提升自动化率，且验证期满足误差上限的策略在未见输入上可能超限；第二裁判能补抓部分漏报，但会误拒更多良性输入并重复第一模型的高置信错误。
Motivation: System One 模型输出带概率的类型化决策，软件可据此自动 allow/block/escalate，但这些概率能否支撑可靠的自动化安全决策尚不清楚。
Method: 评估 Jev、Laya、Decider、Bespoke Nimble 四个 System One 模型，对照专用分类器与语言模型裁判，联合考察决策准确率、概率校准 (calibration) 与选择性自动化 (selective automation) 三方面，并按攻击组分解检查、比较单阈值与分离 allow/block 阈值的决策策略以及引入第二裁判的级联方案。
Result: 三项发现：强总体表现与有利的平均校准会掩盖特定攻击组的系统性失败，包括被高置信判为安全的攻击；在严格漏报上限下各策略自动放行很少，分离 allow 与 block 阈值主要通过拦截更多输入来提升自动化，验证期满足误差上限的策略在未见输入上会超限；第二裁判能检出部分漏报攻击，但会拒绝更多良性输入并重复第一模型的高置信错误。
Conclusion: 模型准确率、概率校准与由此产生的决策策略行为必须放在一起评估，单看平均校准或总体准确率不足以支撑自动化安全决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Groupwise Selective State-Space Filtering for Accurate and Streaming Action Boundary Detection
papers.abstract_en: Action boundary detection partitions untrimmed video into intervals without assigning action classes. We present a boundary-detection adapter operating on pre-extracted video features, learning temporal representations via groupwise selective scans. Learned group fusion and temporal modeling convert these into transition scores, which are decoded into boundary timestamps. Trained with boundary-time supervision, the class-agnostic model is evaluated on Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads using temporal tolerances and bipartite matching, achieving boundary $F_1$ scores of 0.457, 0.622, and 0.611. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出作用于预提取视频特征的分组选择性状态空间过滤适配器 (groupwise selective state-space filtering)，用分组选择性扫描学时序表示、经分组融合与时间建模输出过渡分数并解码为边界时间戳。在 Breakfast、GTEA、50Salads 上以时间容差与二分图匹配评测，边界 F1 分别为 0.457、0.622、0.611；其有状态变体支持零神经前瞻、单样本峰值确认与有界内存的流式推理。
Motivation: 未剪辑视频的边界检测要在不给片段分配动作类别的前提下切分区间，而流式场景还要求推理时不能等待未来帧。
Method: 在预提取视频特征之上加一个边界检测适配器：用分组选择性扫描 (groupwise selective scans) 学习时序表示，再由学习到的分组融合与时间建模转成过渡分数，解码为边界时间戳；训练只用边界时间监督，模型是类别无关的。有状态变体把同一机制改成特征流式推理。
Result: 在 Breakfast、GTEA、50Salads 三个数据集上，用时间容差与二分图匹配评测，边界 F1 分别为 0.457、0.622、0.611；有状态变体实现零神经前瞻 (zero neural look-ahead)、单样本峰值确认与有界内存的流式推理。
Conclusion: 类别无关的边界检测可以只靠边界时间监督在预提取特征上完成，并在保持有界内存与零前瞻的同时做到流式解码，下游系统随后再赋予动作类别。

papers.title: SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation
authors: Jiali Chen (South China University of Technology
Zhengteng Lin (South China University of Technology)
Zuqi Wang (South China University of Technology)
Shirong Lin (South China University of Technology)
Xi Yu (South China University of Technology)
Xusen Hei (South China University of Technology)
DingBa Fu (South China University of Technology)
Jiayuan Xie (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University)
Yi Cai (South China University of Technology)
papers.abstract_en: In realistic education, a solution is often expressed not only in words but in a drawing--a circuit, a geometric construction, a function plot--and a teacher must grade the drawing as carefully as the text. Recent advances in unified multimodal models have enabled scientific image generation, yet verifying the correctness of these specialized visual outputs remains a critical bottleneck: errors often arise from intricate domain knowledge, structural reasoning, and multi-step instruction rather than surface-level artifacts. Existing verifiers mainly target natural images and compress judgement into scalar scores, leaving scientific coverage and explainable feedback for error correction underexplored. To bridge this gap, we make three main contributions. (1) We construct SciGen-Verify, a benchmark dedicated to explainable verification of scientific image generation, spanning instruction following, multidisciplinary reasoning, and world knowledge domains. It contains a three-tier hierarchical protocol over the binary judgement, supporting explanation, and corrective editing instruction. (2) We develop SciGen-Verifier, a reasoning-driven multimodal verifier trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by a curriculum-based two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline. The rubric-guided process rewards first strengthen scientific reasoning exploration and outcome rewards subsequently align output with ground-truth annotation. (3) On SciGen-Verify, SciGen-Verifier achieves competitive performance against much larger proprietary models. It further serves as a practical online critic for iterative image rectification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciGen-Verifier 是面向科学图像生成的可解释验证器：先用冷启动 SFT，再走课程化两阶段强化学习（先用 rubric 引导的过程奖励强化科学推理探索，再用结果奖励对齐标注）。在自建三层协议基准 SciGen-Verify 上，它以小规模取得与更大专有模型相当的表现，并可作为在线 critic 迭代修图。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型已能生成电路图、几何作图、函数图像等科学图，但正确性验证是瓶颈：错误来自领域知识、结构推理与多步指令，而现有验证器只针对自然图像、把判断压成标量分数，缺少科学覆盖与可解释纠错反馈。
Method: 构建 SciGen-Verify 基准，覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与世界知识，采用三层层级协议：二值判定、解释、纠错编辑指令。SciGen-Verifier 训练流程为冷启动监督微调 (SFT) 加课程化两阶段 RL：先以 rubric 引导的过程奖励鼓励科学推理探索，再用结果奖励对齐 ground-truth 标注。
Result: 在 SciGen-Verify 上，SciGen-Verifier 的表现与体量大得多的专有模型相当，并可作为实用的在线 critic 用于迭代图像修正 (iterative image rectification)。
Conclusion: 把科学推理的过程奖励与结果奖励分阶段结合，能让较小的验证器在科学图像生成验证上达到专有大模型的竞争力水平，并支撑可解释的纠错闭环。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 SciGen-Verify 基准，覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与世界知识，采用三层层级协议：二值判定、解释、纠错编辑指令。SciGen-Verifier 训练流程为冷启动监督微调 (SFT) 加课程化两阶段 RL：先以 rubric 引导的过程奖励鼓励科学推理探索，再用结果奖励对齐 ground-truth 标注。
summary_sections.result: 在 SciGen-Verify 上，SciGen-Verifier 的表现与体量大得多的专有模型相当，并可作为实用的在线 critic 用于迭代图像修正 (iterative image rectification)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把科学推理的过程奖励与结果奖励分阶段结合，能让较小的验证器在科学图像生成验证上达到专有大模型的竞争力水平，并支撑可解释的纠错闭环。

papers.title: COEVO: Co-Evolving Context and Parameters for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to move large language models beyond static training pipelines toward systems that can participate in improving their own future behavior. Existing approaches largely follow two directions: updating model parameters through online learning, or improving the external context through search, reflection, and prompt optimization. Although both mechanisms can support continued improvement, they are typically studied independently. This separation overlooks an important interaction: the context shapes the experience from which a model learns, while an evolving model may interpret and utilize the same context differently over time. We therefore formulate RSI as a problem of parameter--context co-evolution, where model parameters and the learning context adapt within a shared feedback loop. We introduce COEVO, a framework that updates model parameters from on-policy experience while adapting contextual guidance according to the state of the evolving policy. Policy entropy and prompt-conditioned attention are used as complementary signals to guide this adaptation. Experiments show that COEVO consistently improves task performance over fixed-context reinforcement learning and produces policies that are more robust to changes in system prompts. More broadly, our results suggest that external context should be viewed not merely as a fixed interface to a large language model, but as an adaptive component of recursive self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COEVO 把递归自我改进 (RSI) 重写为参数与上下文的共演化问题：参数从 on-policy 经验更新，同时上下文指导随演化中的策略状态自适应，用策略熵 (policy entropy) 与 prompt 条件注意力两个互补信号驱动。实验显示其在任务性能上稳定优于固定上下文的强化学习，且所得策略对 system prompt 变化更稳健。
Motivation: 现有 RSI 路线把在线更新参数与通过搜索、反思、prompt 优化改进外部上下文当作两条独立线，忽略了上下文塑造学习经验、而演化中的模型会以不同方式解读同一上下文这一交互。
Method: 将 RSI 形式化为参数-上下文共演化：模型参数从 on-policy 经验更新，上下文指导依据演化中策略的状态自适应调整，适应过程由 policy entropy 和 prompt-conditioned attention 两个互补信号引导，二者处在同一反馈回路内。
Result: 实验中 COEVO 在任务性能上持续优于固定上下文的强化学习基线，并产生对 system prompt 变化更稳健的策略。
Conclusion: 外部上下文不应视为大模型的固定接口，而应作为递归自我改进中的自适应组件，与参数一起在同一反馈回路中共同演化。

papers.title: CoViST: Visual Token Compression via Composable States
papers.abstract_en: Visual token compression lowers the inference cost of vision--language models by representing images with fewer tokens. However, most existing methods compress visual tokens to a reduced set, leaving the amount of visual evidence represented by each token and its original spatial context implicit. Therefore, the compressed representation does not explicitly encode how much visual information each representative carries or where it lies in the original image. This limitation arises even after a single reduction and becomes more pronounced when compression is repeated across decoder layers. To address this issue, we propose CoViST, a training-free framework that represents a compressed image as a composable visual state. Specifically, the state combines representative features with original positions, effective contribution weights, and reusable selection metadata. CoViST constructs this state through coverage-guided selection and conservation-based contribution composition, and explicitly incorporates its contribution and positional information into decoder attention. Each component of the state retains its interpretation under successive reductions, enabling the same formulation to support both fixed compression before prefill and progressive compression within the decoder. Experimental results on seven LLaVA-1.5-7B benchmarks show that CoViST-Fixed retains 99.9\%, 99.5\%, and 98.1\% of uncompressed performance at 192, 128, and 64 tokens, respectively, and CoViST-Pro retains 99.8\%, 99.9\%, and 99.1\% at the corresponding layer-average budgets, outperforming state-of-the-art methods under their respective budget settings. Code will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoViST 把压缩后的图像表示成可组合的视觉状态，把代表特征与原始位置、有效贡献权重、可复用选择元数据绑在一起，并把贡献与位置信息显式注入 decoder attention。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的七个 benchmark 上，CoViST-Fixed 在 192/128/64 token 预算下分别保留 99.9%/99.5%/98.1% 的未压缩性能，CoViST-Pro 在对应逐层平均预算下保留 99.8%/99.9%/99.1%，均在各自预算设定下超过 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩只把图像压到更少 token，却不显式编码每个 token 承载多少视觉信息、在原图的什么位置；单次压缩后即已含混，跨 decoder 层反复压缩时问题被放大。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的 CoViST 框架：用 coverage-guided selection 与 conservation-based contribution composition 构造可组合视觉状态，状态包含代表特征、原始位置、有效贡献权重与可复用选择元数据；同一形式化同时支持 prefill 前的固定压缩 (CoViST-Fixed) 与 decoder 内的逐层渐进压缩 (CoViST-Pro)，并把贡献与位置信息显式并入 decoder attention。
Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的七个 benchmark 上，CoViST-Fixed 在 192、128、64 token 下分别保留未压缩性能的 99.9%、99.5%、98.1%；CoViST-Pro 在对应的逐层平均预算下分别保留 99.8%、99.9%、99.1%，在各自预算设定下优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 把每个视觉 token 的贡献量与原始位置显式编码进状态并注入 attention，可在 64–192 token 的高压缩比下基本不损失 VLM 性能，且同一套形式化同时覆盖固定压缩与逐层渐进压缩；代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising for Video Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: The growing threat of video deepfakes necessitates multimodal detection. Beyond serving as independent indicators of authenticity, audio and visual signals have intrinsic dependencies that also provide an essential criterion for detection. Previous methods often overlook the cross-modal correspondences, hindering information transfer between domains and leaving crucial detection cues unexplored. To address this challenge, we propose a framework called Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD) for video deepfake detection. It connects the distinct distributions of heterogeneous modalities in latent spaces, enabling smooth cross-domain information transfer to improve detection performance. We first establish a Bayesian foundation by decomposing the audio-visual joint distribution. Subsequently, CTCLD translates both modalities via bidirectional latent denoising conditioned on each other, effectively capturing subtle inconsistencies in the manipulated signals. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CTCLD enables comprehensive domain alignment, resulting in a robust video deepfake detection approach with competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CTCLD 用条件隐空间去噪做音视频跨模态翻译来检测视频 deepfake：先分解音视频联合分布建立贝叶斯基础，再让两个模态互为条件、双向隐空间去噪，从而对齐异质分布并暴露被篡改信号中的细微不一致。摘要称该方法实现全面的域对齐，检测性能具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有视频 deepfake 多模态检测把音视频各自当独立证据，忽略跨模态对应关系，导致域间信息传递受阻、关键检测线索未被利用。
Method: 提出 Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD)：先对音视频联合分布做概率分解建立贝叶斯基础，再在隐空间中以对方模态为条件做双向隐空间去噪翻译，把异质模态的不同分布连接起来，捕捉被操纵信号中的细微不一致。
Result: 实验结果表明 CTCLD 实现了全面的域对齐 (comprehensive domain alignment)，得到鲁棒且性能有竞争力 (competitive performance) 的视频 deepfake 检测方法。
Conclusion: 把音视频检测从独立打分改为互为条件的隐空间跨模态翻译，可以利用跨模态对应关系这一判据提升视频 deepfake 检测的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AutoHGNN: Robust and Efficient Neural Architecture Search for Hypergraph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraph neural networks have achieved significant success in recent years. However, manual architecture crafting is labor-intensive and often fails to capture complex, higher-order relations, making the automation of hypergraph neural network structure design crucial. To improve the automation and adaptability of hypergraph learning, this paper proposes AutoHGNN, a neural architecture search framework tailored for hypergraph neural networks. First, we introduce a Hyper-Interaction Module (HIM) into the search space to address the mismatch between conventional graph neural network designs and hypergraph data. Second, we propose Hypergraph Stable Topological Distance (HyperSTD) as a structural selection criterion to identify architectures that best preserve the intrinsic structural affinities of the original hypergraph during differentiable search. Extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets demonstrate that AutoHGNN consistently outperforms manually designed and automatically searched baselines in classification accuracy and time efficiency, proving that the discovered architectures are significantly more effective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoHGNN 是面向超图神经网络的神经架构搜索 (NAS) 框架：在搜索空间中加入 Hyper-Interaction Module (HIM) 以适配超图的高阶关系，并用 Hypergraph Stable Topological Distance (HyperSTD) 作为可微搜索中的结构选择准则。在多个基准数据集上，其分类准确率与时间效率均稳定超过人工设计与已有自动搜索的基线。
Motivation: 超图神经网络的架构目前靠人工设计，劳动密集且难以捕捉复杂的高阶关系，因此需要自动化的结构设计流程。
Method: 提出 AutoHGNN：把 Hyper-Interaction Module (HIM) 引入搜索空间，纠正常规 GNN 设计与超图数据的不匹配；以 Hypergraph Stable Topological Distance (HyperSTD) 作为结构选择准则，在可微搜索 (differentiable search) 中挑选最能保留原始超图内在结构亲和度的架构。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，AutoHGNN 在分类准确率与时间效率两方面均持续优于人工设计基线和自动搜索基线。
Conclusion: 把超图专用交互模块放进搜索空间、并用结构亲和度准则做可微选择，能搜出比人工设计更有效的超图架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Timestamps: Decision-Aligned On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often relies on sparse outcome rewards, providing coarse supervision for long-horizon agents. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this signal with dense privileged feedback. However, we identify \emph{Decision--Timestamp Mismatch}: privileged guidance may be misaligned with the student's functional decision because the corresponding decision can occur at a different timestep, while the student's decision itself may span multiple timesteps rather than being tied to a single timestamp. Thus, timestamp-local supervision can misalign both the context and the temporal scope of credit. To address this mismatch, we introduce \textsc{AlignOPSD}, following the principle of aligning supervision before assigning credit. Decision-Aligned Supervision Rectification re-scores the same student-sampled response in functionally matched contexts across sibling rollouts to calibrate local teacher evidence. Semi-Markov Hierarchical Credit Assignment then derives variable-duration decision spans from correspondence changes and uses rectified evidence to allocate outcome-grounded credit across spans and their constituent turns. We evaluate \textsc{AlignOPSD} with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA against representative baselines. \textsc{AlignOPSD} outperforms both GRPO and StepOPSD across all eight backbone--aggregate-metric comparisons, improving on GRPO by 5.5--8.7 \% and ranking first in six. Additional analyzes examine the two alignment stages and hyperparameter sensitivity between tasks. Our code is avaliable at https://github.com/mingju-c/Align-OPSD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlignOPSD 指出长程智能体上 on-policy 自蒸馏 (OPSD) 的特权监督与学生实际决策存在 Decision–Timestamp Mismatch：同一决策可能落在不同 timestep，而一个决策又可能跨多个 timestep。它先在功能匹配的上下文里对同一条学生采样响应重打分以校准局部教师证据，再用半马尔可夫层级信用分配从对应关系变化中导出可变时长决策跨度并分配结果信用。在 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 上于 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 的八组 backbone–聚合指标比较中全部超过 GRPO 与 StepOPSD，相对 GRPO 提升 5.5–8.7%，六项排第一。
Motivation: RLVR 只有稀疏结果奖励，长程智能体的信用分配监督过粗；OPSD 引入特权反馈补密度，但按 timestamp 对齐的监督会同时错配上下文与信用的时间范围。
Method: AlignOPSD 含两个阶段：Decision-Aligned Supervision Rectification 在 sibling rollouts 中把同一条学生采样响应放到功能匹配的上下文里重打分，校准局部教师证据；Semi-Markov Hierarchical Credit Assignment 依据对应关系变化导出可变时长决策跨度，用校准后的证据把结果信用分配到各跨度及其内部各轮。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 上、于 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 对比代表性基线：八组 backbone–聚合指标比较全部胜过 GRPO 与 StepOPSD，相对 GRPO 提升 5.5–8.7%，其中六项排名第一；另含两个对齐阶段的分析与跨任务超参敏感性分析。
Conclusion: 先按功能对齐监督再分配信用，可修复 timestamp 局部监督在长程智能体上的错配，从而在三个具身/网页/检索任务上稳定超过 GRPO 与 StepOPSD。

summary_sections.motivation: RLVR 只有稀疏结果奖励，长程智能体的信用分配监督过粗；OPSD 引入特权反馈补密度，但按 timestamp 对齐的监督会同时错配上下文与信用的时间范围。
summary_sections.method: AlignOPSD 含两个阶段：Decision-Aligned Supervision Rectification 在 sibling rollouts 中把同一条学生采样响应放到功能匹配的上下文里重打分，校准局部教师证据；Semi-Markov Hierarchical Credit Assignment 依据对应关系变化导出可变时长决策跨度，用校准后的证据把结果信用分配到各跨度及其内部各轮。
summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 上、于 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 对比代表性基线：八组 backbone–聚合指标比较全部胜过 GRPO 与 StepOPSD，相对 GRPO 提升 5.5–8.7%，其中六项排名第一；另含两个对齐阶段的分析与跨任务超参敏感性分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先按功能对齐监督再分配信用，可修复 timestamp 局部监督在长程智能体上的错配，从而在三个具身/网页/检索任务上稳定超过 GRPO 与 StepOPSD。

papers.title: From Position Risks to Block Survival: Faster Generation for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but there is a mismatch between how these tokens are predicted and how they ultimately contribute to generation. Parallel predictions can hardly condition on the tokens selected earlier within the same block, even though their validity depends on this realized prefix. Under the popular proposal-verification decoding, this mismatch makes errors highly asymmetric: an early rejection prevents all subsequent proposals from contributing decoding progress. We introduce BRISK-DLM, a framework that addresses both mismatches by optimizing proposal learning and selection for verified progress. BRISK-DLM trains on self-generated sequences, using risk-reward weighting to dynamically prioritize positions by their impact on verified progress and decoding cost. During inference, a lightweight prefix-conditioned corrector reranks existing candidates using previously selected tokens and preferences distilled from the model's own verifier. The corrector reuses the backbone's parallel representations and requires no additional backbone evaluation, while fused execution keeps its overhead small. BRISK-DLM improves end-to-end throughput by up to 37.4% while preserving task quality, establishing a new quality-throughput frontier for DLM generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRISK-DLM 针对扩散语言模型 (DLM) 块并行解码中「并行预测无法条件于同块已选 token」与「早期拒绝使后续提案全部作废」的双重错配，用风险-奖励加权按对已验证进度的影响重排训练位置，并在推理时用轻量前缀条件修正器重排候选。端到端吞吐最高提升 37.4%，同时保持任务质量。
Motivation: DLM 块并行生成里，提案与验证的错配使错误高度不对称：块内靠前位置被拒绝会让其后所有提案无法贡献解码进度，吞吐收益被浪费。
Method: 训练侧在自生成序列上用 risk-reward weighting 按位置对已验证进度与解码代价的影响动态加权；推理侧用前缀条件 corrector 复用骨干并行表征、按已选 token 与从模型自身 verifier 蒸馏的偏好重排候选，不额外调用骨干，配合 fused execution 控制开销。
Result: 端到端吞吐提升最高 37.4%，同时保持任务质量，建立 DLM 生成的质量-吞吐前沿。
Conclusion: 把训练目标与推理选择都对齐到「已验证进度」，可在不牺牲质量的前提下显著加速 DLM 的块并行生成。

papers.title: From Grey-Box to Green-Box: When can Physics-Informed Machine Learning Reduce Carbon Footprints in Structural Health Monitoring?
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning plays an increasingly vital role in engineering, but the corresponding increase in compute time is not without environmental cost. Physics-informed machine learning or "grey-box" models have been developed to overcome some of the limitations of traditional black-box learners, utilising the physical insight that an engineer would have about the structure they are modelling and have shown promising results in the structural engineering field among many others. This work explores whether an additional advantage could be a reduced environmental impact, considering the relationship between training data quantity and training time, linking this duration to carbon emissions from computing. In a structural health monitoring context, four physics-informed machine learning approaches - spanning Gaussian processes and neural networks - are evaluated: residual modelling, input augmentation, hybrid modelling, and constrained learning. The emissions for training each of the models to reach a given error threshold is compared, and in most examples, shown to be lower for the physics-informed models (with input augmented models being an exception). This reduction in training emissions further compounds the environmental savings achieved by collecting and storing less data. Although promising results, we cannot expect a silver bullet and the case studies demonstrate that a trade-off is needed between the increased complexity that comes from introducing physics into a machine learner, against the gain from reduced training data requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在结构健康监测 (SHM) 中比较四类 physics-informed machine learning（grey-box）模型达到给定误差阈值时的训练碳排放，多数案例中物理信息模型的排放更低，input augmentation 是例外；数据量减少带来的采集与存储节省会进一步叠加。作者同时指出必须权衡：引入物理带来的模型复杂度上升，换取训练数据需求下降。
Motivation: 机器学习在工程中的算力开销带来环境成本，而 SHM 中训练数据的采集、存储与训练时长共同决定碳排放，尚不清楚引入物理先验能否真正降低这一成本。
Method: 在结构健康监测场景下评估四种 physics-informed 建模方式——residual modelling、input augmentation、hybrid modelling、constrained learning——覆盖 Gaussian process 与 neural network 两类学习器；把训练数据量与训练时长关联到计算碳排放，比较各模型训练到同一误差阈值时的排放。
Result: 训练到给定误差阈值时，多数案例中 physics-informed 模型的碳排放更低，input augmented 模型为例外；该排放下降还与采集和存储更少数据带来的环境节省相叠加。案例研究显示引入物理带来的复杂度与数据需求下降之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: physics-informed 模型通常能降低 SHM 训练碳足迹并叠加数据侧节省，但不是 silver bullet，需按复杂度与数据收益逐案权衡。
