papers.title: PulseQuant: Propagation-Guided Subspace Correction for 4-Bit Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Quantization errors in video diffusion transformers can be amplified or attenuated by subsequent denoising updates, making local reconstruction error an incomplete predictor of final impact. We introduce PulseQuant, a 4-bit post-training quantization method that combines trajectory sensitivity with activation geometry to guide offline calibration. Isolated block--step interventions estimate propagation risk, which prioritizes sensitive trajectory states during row-radius selection. With these radii fixed, response-subspace correction uses neighboring-code edits to reduce residual components along dominant activation directions. Both stages preserve the original 4-bit weight representation. Controlled interventions show that short-horizon propagated error predicts final latent error more reliably than immediate block-output error, supporting calibration beyond local reconstruction objectives. Evaluations on Wan models, Self Forcing, and MiniMax-H3 demonstrate improvements in key consistency and dense-reference metrics while remaining competitive on other attributes across model scales and generation paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PulseQuant 是面向视频扩散 Transformer 的 4-bit 训练后量化方法：用孤立 block-step 干预估计轨迹传播风险来选 row-radius，再在固定半径下用邻近码字编辑做响应子空间 (response-subspace) 校正，两阶段都保持 4-bit 权重表示。受控干预显示短时程传播误差比即时 block 输出误差更能预测最终 latent 误差，校准应超越局部重建目标。
Motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的量化误差会被后续去噪更新放大或衰减，局部重建误差不能完整预测最终影响，仅按局部误差做校准会选错敏感状态。
Method: 两阶段训练后量化：先用 isolated block–step interventions 估计 propagation risk，在 row-radius 选择中优先处理敏感轨迹状态；半径固定后用 response-subspace correction，通过邻近码字 (neighboring-code edits) 沿主导激活方向削减残差分量，全程保留原始 4-bit 权重表示。
Result: 受控干预表明短时程传播误差比即时 block 输出误差更可靠地预测最终 latent 误差；在 Wan 模型、Self Forcing 与 MiniMax-H3 上，key consistency 与 dense-reference 指标提升，其余属性在不同模型规模与生成范式下保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 视频扩散 Transformer 的 4-bit 量化校准应以传播风险而非局部重建误差为依据，轨迹敏感度与激活几何结合可在保持 4-bit 权重的同时改善关键一致性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Local LMO is Secretly a Projection Method!
papers.abstract_en: The local linear minimization oracle (Ferris and Zavriev, 1996; arXiv:2605.08850), or Local LMO, solves constrained convex problems without having to compute a projection: it minimizes a linear model over the intersection of the feasible set with a ball around the current iterate. We show that, whenever the ball radius does not exceed the Polyak radius, the Local LMO step is the Euclidean projection of the current iterate onto the intersection of the feasible set with a half-space that separates the iterate from the solution set; this projection is nonetheless computable by a linear oracle alone. We demonstrate that Local LMO belongs to a broader family of projection methods which may be indexed by the depth of the localizing half-space. For objectives with $\vartheta$-Hölder continuous gradient, every method from this family whose half-space lies sufficiently deep drives the best of its first $K$ iterates to optimality at the universal rate $\mathcal{O}(K^{-(1+\vartheta)/2})$, matching the non-accelerated universal gradient method of Nesterov (2015). Run at the Polyak radius, Local LMO attains the same rate when the constrained optima are also unconstrained ($\|\nabla f(x_\star)\| = 0$), and the rate $\mathcal{O}(K^{-1/(2-\vartheta)})$ otherwise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 Local LMO（在当前迭代点邻域球与可行集交上做线性极小化）在球半径不超过 Polyak 半径时等价于向某个分离半空间与可行集交集的欧氏投影，且该投影仅靠线性 oracle 即可计算。由此把 Local LMO 归入按半空间深度索引的投影方法族：对 ϑ-Hölder 连续梯度目标，半空间足够深的方法使前 K 次迭代中最优点以通用速率 O(K^{-(1+ϑ)/2}) 收敛，与 Nesterov (2015) 非加速通用梯度法持平。
Motivation: 约束凸优化中投影通常比线性 oracle 昂贵，Local LMO 虽回避投影却缺少与投影方法的统一刻画，其收敛速率也未与通用梯度法对齐。
Method: 在球半径不超过 Polyak 半径的条件下，把 Local LMO 步重写为到分离迭代点与解集的半空间交集上的欧氏投影；再按局部化半空间深度把该步推广为一族投影方法，并对 ϑ-Hölder 连续梯度目标分析该族的收敛性。
Result: 半空间足够深的族成员使前 K 次迭代中最优点达到通用速率 O(K^{-(1+ϑ)/2})，匹配 Nesterov (2015) 非加速通用梯度法；在 Polyak 半径下运行的 Local LMO，当约束最优解同时是无约束最优（‖∇f(x*)‖=0）时达到同一速率，否则为 O(K^{-1/(2-ϑ)})。
Conclusion: Local LMO 本质是投影方法，可用线性 oracle 实现；其速率在约束解非无约束时退化为 O(K^{-1/(2-ϑ)})，与通用速率存在差距。

papers.title: NLPG: Natural-Language Policy Gradients for Self-Evolving Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on compound programs for retrieval, tool use, reasoning, and verification, yet their failures often arise from local procedural decisions. Existing reinforcement-learning and prompt-optimization approaches typically rely on scalar rewards or repeatedly modify entire prompts, making it difficult to capture and reuse procedural improvements while preserving a frozen agent. To address this problem, We propose Natural-Language Policy Gradients (NLPG), an external policy-memory method for improving a fixed agent without changing its model parameters or program structure. NLPG diagnoses execution traces, propagates downstream feedback backward through the module graph, and converts recurring failures into route-local natural-language corrections that are aggregated into bounded policy updates for subsequent executions. Across six benchmarks covering memory, reasoning, instruction following, and evidence verification, NLPG also outperforms the strongest listed baseline for each benchmark by 8.71 percentage points on average. These results provide evidence that evaluated procedural experience can be transformed into local and interpretable policy updates, enabling continual improvement of frozen agents.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Work in progress
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NLPG 是一种外置策略记忆方法：诊断执行轨迹、沿模块图反向传播下游反馈，把反复出现的失败转成路线级自然语言修正，并聚合成有界的策略更新，从而在不改模型参数与程序结构的前提下改进冻结 agent。在覆盖记忆、推理、指令遵循与证据验证的六个基准上，平均比各基准最强列出基线高 8.71 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM agent 的失败常来自局部过程性决策，而现有 RL 与 prompt 优化依赖标量奖励或反复改写整段 prompt，难以捕获并复用过程性改进，同时保持 agent 冻结。
Method: NLPG 诊断执行轨迹，沿模块图 (module graph) 反向传播下游反馈，将反复出现的失败转为 route-local 自然语言修正，再聚合为有界的策略更新供后续执行使用；不改动模型参数与程序结构。
Result: 在六个覆盖 memory、reasoning、instruction following、evidence verification 的基准上，NLPG 平均比每个基准最强的列出基线高 8.71 个百分点。
Conclusion: 经过评估的过程性经验可以被转化为局部、可解释的策略更新，使冻结的 agent 持续改进。

summary_sections.method: NLPG 诊断执行轨迹，沿模块图 (module graph) 反向传播下游反馈，将反复出现的失败转为 route-local 自然语言修正，再聚合为有界的策略更新供后续执行使用；不改动模型参数与程序结构。
summary_sections.result: 在六个覆盖 memory、reasoning、instruction following、evidence verification 的基准上，NLPG 平均比每个基准最强的列出基线高 8.71 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经过评估的过程性经验可以被转化为局部、可解释的策略更新，使冻结的 agent 持续改进。

papers.title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Recursive Harness Distillation：强 agent 把对 VLA 策略的干预经验蒸馏成 playbook，交给轻量 agent 执行后再用执行反馈递归精炼，使干预知识无需更新模型参数即可跨 agent、跨新任务实例复用。真实操作任务成功率从 37.3% 提到 64.0%；SimplerEnv Bridge 上带 playbook 的轻量 agent 达 66.7%，GR00T-only 基线为 41.7%，同一 playbook 也让强 agent 升到 79.2%。
Motivation: VLA 模型有广泛操作能力，但执行需要诊断失败并调整行为时表现吃力；强 agent 通过交互发现的有效干预经验目前无法沉淀复用到新任务实例。
Method: 强 agent 先把自己的干预经验蒸馏成 playbook 给轻量 agent，再用轻量 agent 的执行反馈递归精炼 playbook；推理时 agent 直接读 playbook 复用干预知识，不更新任何模型参数。
Result: 真实世界操作中 harness 把成功率从 37.3% 提升到 64.0%；SimplerEnv Bridge 上带 playbook 的轻量 agent 成功率 66.7%，GR00T-only 基线 41.7%，且超过不带 playbook 的强 agent；同一 playbook 使强 agent 成功率进一步达到 79.2%。
Conclusion: 干预经验可以被蒸馏、经执行反馈精炼并跨 agent 复用，从而在不微调参数的前提下提升机器人操作成功率，playbook 对强弱 agent 都有增益。

papers.title: Optimal Transport Dropout for Structured Predictive Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Deterministic neural networks and neural operators provide point predictions with no intrinsic measure of reliability. Yet, predictive uncertainty may stem from irreducible outcome variability, finite data, or limitations of the chosen model class. Monte Carlo dropout offers a computationally convenient way to construct a predictive distribution through stochastic feature masking, without training multiple independent networks or explicitly inferring a posterior over model parameters. However, its perturbation law is largely prescribed a priori and typically factorised across latent coordinates. We introduce Optimal Transport Dropout (OTD), which instead learns the predictive mapping and the law of its latent perturbations jointly. Starting from a simple independent reference distribution, OTD transports latent perturbations through a learnable flow and propagates them through the predictive neural network, thereby inducing a structured predictive law. Training uses the strictly proper Energy Score, while a kinetic-action term geometrically regularises the transport. Synthetic benchmarks show that OTD captures multimodal predictive distributions, generates meaningful dispersion when the model is misspecified, and exhibits contracting dispersion as more training data or greater model capacity are provided. For a field-valued partial differential equation surrogate, predictive dispersion strongly aligns with the spatial pattern of prediction errors. On this task, compared with Monte Carlo dropout, OTD yields more accurate predictions and better-calibrated, substantially narrower intervals. On real-world regression benchmarks, it further shows competitive accuracy and better probabilistic predictions compared to established baselines. OTD therefore offers a way to learn structured predictive uncertainty without explicit posterior inference or ensembles of independently trained predictors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Optimal Transport Dropout (OTD)：从独立参考分布出发，用可学习的 transport flow 变换潜空间扰动并送入预测网络，联合学习预测映射与扰动分布，训练用严格 proper 的 Energy Score 加 kinetic-action 正则。合成基准上 OTD 捕捉多峰预测分布、在模型误设时给出有意义的离散度，且随数据量或模型容量增大离散度收缩；在场值 PDE surrogate 上其离散度与空间误差格局高度吻合，相比 Monte Carlo dropout 预测更准、区间更窄且校准更好。
Motivation: 确定性网络与 neural operator 只给点预测，无内在可靠性度量；MC dropout 虽省算力，但其扰动律先验给定且在潜坐标上通常因子化，无法表达结构化的多峰预测不确定性。
Method: OTD 从简单独立参考分布出发，通过可学习 flow 输运潜扰动，再经预测神经网络传播，诱导结构化预测律；训练目标为严格 proper 的 Energy Score，另加 kinetic-action 项对输运作几何正则，从而联合学习预测映射与扰动分布，无需显式后验推断或独立训练的 ensemble。
Result: 合成基准上 OTD 捕捉多峰预测分布，在模型误设时产生有意义的 dispersion，且随训练数据增多或模型容量增大呈收缩趋势；在场值 PDE surrogate 上预测 dispersion 与空间误差格局高度吻合，相较 Monte Carlo dropout 预测更准确、区间更窄且校准更好；在真实回归基准上相较既有基线精度有竞争力、概率预测更优。
Conclusion: 结构化预测不确定性可以在不做显式后验推断、不训练独立预测器集合的条件下学出来，代价是用 Energy Score 与 kinetic-action 正则把扰动律一并优化。

papers.title: TNF based Spectral Embedding for Effective Application of Supervised Machine Learning Techniques in Automobile Insurance Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: Fraud detection is an important area of research in the insurance business due to its financial implications. The primary aim of a fraud detection model is to identify fraud and non-fraud cases with high accuracy along with other important metrics such as Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1-score, False Positive Rate, False Discovery Rate, AUC etc. To achieve this, we need to explore a suitable classification model to identify fraud and non-fraud cases. In this work, we have used auto insurance data set and explored classification models such as Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost, LightGBM and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM). To overcome the problem of data imbalance, we have employed MWMOTE and TGAN techniques. We have used Topological Node Feature(TNF) based spectral embedding for low dimensional data representation along with some popular embedding methods like MDS, Isomaps and t-SNE. After studying all the 65 possible combinations of these models, we have proposed an innovative method for effective automobile insurance fraud detection. For the given dataset, our results show that using a combination of MWMOTE as a data imbalance handling technique (Phase I), TNFSE2 as data embedding (Phase II) and Random Forest as classification (Phase III) provides the best result in comparison to all other combinations. This work also highlights the efficacy of TNF based spectral embedding in automobile insurance dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在汽车保险欺诈检测上，把流程拆成不平衡处理、谱嵌入、分类三阶段并穷举 65 种组合，最优组合为 MWMOTE + TNFSE2（Topological Node Feature 谱嵌入）+ Random Forest，在所用数据集上优于其余全部组合。
Motivation: 保险欺诈检测需要高准确率并兼顾 Sensitivity、Specificity、Precision、F1、FPR、FDR、AUC 等指标，而类别不平衡与高维特征会限制监督分类模型的效果。
Method: 在 auto insurance 数据集上比较 Decision Tree、Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM、GBM；不平衡处理用 MWMOTE 与 TGAN；低维表示用 Topological Node Feature 谱嵌入（TNFSE2）并与 MDS、Isomap、t-SNE 对比，共考察 65 种组合。
Result: 65 种组合中，MWMOTE（Phase I）+ TNFSE2（Phase II）+ Random Forest（Phase III）在该数据集上取得最佳结果，优于其余全部组合；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 三阶段流水线中 TNF 谱嵌入配合 MWMOTE 与 Random Forest 是该汽车保险数据集上的推荐配置，作者据此强调 TNF 谱嵌入在该数据集上的有效性。

papers.title: What Survives the Codec Shift: Pooled No-Vocals Residuals for Speech Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: The transition from vocoder-based to neural-codec speech synthesis makes generalization more difficult for speech deepfake detectors, particularly those relying on speech-oriented representations. It remains unclear which acoustic representations retain discriminative information when the generation mechanism changes. We therefore compare 12 acoustic representations using a shared low-capacity linear classifier to identify effective evidence under codec shift. The analysis shows that hierarchical XLS-R leads on the pooled test set, while pooled no-vocals residual statistics perform best on the unseen-codec condition, revealing complementary behavior across generation conditions. Building on this finding, we propose MN-P, a dual-view detector that integrates an utterance-level pooled no-vocals representation with token-level XLS-R features through adaptive gating. The proposed MN-P reduces EER by 54.2% overall and by 60.9% on the codec-unseen condition relative to the best-performing retrained state-of-the-art system, with consistent gains across different detector backends. These results indicate that pooled no-vocals residual statistics provide effective complementary evidence for cross-generation speech deepfake detection.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Prepared for submission to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在从 vocoder 转向 neural codec 的语音深伪检测中，用统一的低容量线性分类器横向比较 12 种声学表示，发现分层 XLS-R 在合并测试集上最强，而 pooled no-vocals 残差统计量在未见 codec 条件下最强。据此提出双视图检测器 MN-P，用自适应门控融合句级 pooled no-vocals 表示与 token 级 XLS-R 特征，相对最强重训练 SOTA 系统整体 EER 降低 54.2%，codec 未见条件降低 60.9%。
Motivation: 语音合成从 vocoder 转向 neural codec 后，依赖语音导向表示的深伪检测器泛化变差，且尚不清楚哪些声学表示在生成机制改变时仍保留判别信息。
Method: 先用共享的低容量线性分类器横向比较 12 种声学表示，以在 codec shift 下定位有效证据；再提出 MN-P 双视图检测器，通过自适应门控 (adaptive gating) 融合句级 pooled no-vocals 残差表示与 token 级 XLS-R 特征，并在不同检测器后端上检验。
Result: 合并测试集上分层 XLS-R 领先，未见 codec 条件下 pooled no-vocals 残差统计量最佳，二者呈互补；MN-P 相对最佳重训练 SOTA 系统整体 EER 降低 54.2%，codec 未见条件降低 60.9%，在不同检测器后端上增益一致。
Conclusion: pooled no-vocals 残差统计量为跨生成机制的语音深伪检测提供有效互补证据，与 XLS-R 双视图融合可在 codec shift 下取得稳定增益。

papers.title: Identifying the Predictable Drift of a Semimartingale from Marginal Laws
papers.abstract_en: A special semimartingale admits a unique decomposition $X=X_0+M+A$ into a local martingale $M$ and a predictable finite-variation part $A$. We consider the identification of $A$ when $X$ is observed only through repeated cross-sections. The estimand is then the projection of the sampled predictable compensator onto the observable feature filtration, namely the current state together with whatever randomness is shared across the population, so that at a fixed diffusion coefficient the marginal flow identifies the drift only up to a Markovian projection. If the drift is an affine functional of an observed lag window, the joint problem is a convex quadratic programme whose solution is the pseudo-panel regression of econometrics. Our principal concern is the case, which we believe not to have been treated before, in which the drift is the output of a hidden linear dynamical system whose dynamics are themselves to be identified from the marginals. The joint problem is then a bilinear quadratically constrained programme, which we solve to certified global optimality by spatial branch and bound; with unpenalised state disturbances and a drift basis growing with the grid it is NP-hard already in latent dimension one, by reduction from $\ell^1$ rank-one matrix approximation, whereas the complexity of the deterministic system at fixed latent dimension remains open. A block-coordinate decomposition offers a cheaper alternative. For the estimator itself, we obtain rates at a fixed mesh, separated into Monte-Carlo, estimation and grid contributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在重复截面（只看边际分布、看不到单条轨迹）下识别半鞅的可预测漂移：当漂移是隐藏线性动力系统的输出且该系统本身也要从边际识别时，问题写成双线性二次约束规划，用 spatial branch and bound 求到 certified global optimality。固定网格下估计误差率被拆成 Monte-Carlo、估计与网格三项；无惩罚状态扰动且漂移基随网格增长时，即使隐维为 1 也是 NP-hard（由 ℓ1 rank-one 矩阵逼近归约）。
Motivation: 重复截面数据下，固定扩散系数时边际流只能把漂移识别到 Markovian projection 一层；漂移来自待辨识的隐藏线性系统这一情形此前未被处理，而它决定了截面数据能否辨识潜在动态。
Method: 把可预测补偿子在可观测特征滤波流形上的投影作为估计目标；漂移为观测滞后窗的仿射泛函时，联合问题化为凸二次规划，解即计量经济学的 pseudo-panel regression；漂移为隐藏线性系统输出时化为双线性二次约束规划，用 spatial branch and bound 求全局最优，并给出 block-coordinate 分解作为更廉价的替代。
Result: 固定网格下的估计率被分离为 Monte-Carlo、估计与网格三项贡献；无惩罚状态扰动且漂移基随网格增长时问题 NP-hard，即便隐维为 1，由 ℓ1 rank-one 矩阵逼近归约得到；固定隐维下确定性系统的复杂度仍为 open。
Conclusion: 截面边际对隐藏线性漂移的联合辨识可被表述为可认证全局求解的双线性规划，但一般情形计算上是 NP-hard，实践中需退回 block-coordinate 这类廉价分解。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: API Secrets Should Never Become Tokens in the LLM's Vocabulary: A Threat Analysis of API Credential Handling in LLM Agent Systems and an Empirical Evaluation of a Vault-Mediated Execution Boundary
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn credential hygiene from a storage problem into an execution-security problem. A key pasted into a prompt, or embedded in a system prompt or tool configuration, crosses from an authentication boundary into a data pipeline, where it may persist in conversation history, logs, memory stores, generated code, and error payloads. Prompt injection and excessive agency then convert passive disclosure into unauthorized action. This paper formalizes the credential-exposure threat chain for agentic systems; synthesizes evidence from a platform secret-store incident, vendor-reported secret-sprawl measurement, and OWASP and NIST guidance; and describes a vault-mediated execution architecture in which the model selects a connector identifier while a trusted request boundary supplies authentication. We evaluate a production implementation, Corvic Security Vault, in two controlled black-box experiments. Across 16 probes spanning seven control domains, every probe met its expected outcome: an authenticated GitHub API request succeeded while the credential stayed absent from process environment values, caller-visible request headers, tested filesystem locations, three third-party echo services, and two unrelated API origins; both cloud instance-metadata endpoints were unreachable. We also report a negative result, a connector whose stored header mapping did not satisfy its provider's authentication contract, showing that centralized custody does not by itself guarantee correct configuration. Vault mediation removes several disclosure paths but is necessary rather than sufficient: least privilege, deterministic action authorization, human approval, telemetry redaction, and rotation remain independently required. The study is purposive and small, a functional security evaluation rather than a certification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM Agent 把 API 凭据放进 prompt 或工具配置会使其跨过认证边界进入数据流，本文形式化这条凭据暴露链，并提出 vault-mediated 执行架构：模型只选 connector 标识符，认证由可信请求边界补上。对 Corvic Security Vault 的 16 项黑盒探针全部达到预期，凭据不出现在进程环境变量、请求头、文件系统、三个第三方 echo 服务与两个无关 API 源；但 vault 只是必要条件，仍需最小权限、确定性授权、人工审批、遥测脱敏与轮换。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM Agent 把凭据卫生从存储问题变成执行安全问题：粘进 prompt 的密钥会滞留在会话历史、日志、内存、生成代码与错误载荷中，prompt injection 与 excessive agency 进一步把被动泄露转成未授权操作。
Method: 形式化 agentic 系统的凭据暴露威胁链，综合平台 secret-store 事件、厂商 secret-sprawl 测量与 OWASP/NIST 指南；提出 vault-mediated 架构，模型只选择 connector identifier，认证由可信请求边界注入；对生产实现 Corvic Security Vault 做两项受控黑盒实验，共 16 项探针覆盖七个控制域。
Result: 16 项探针全部达到预期：经认证的 GitHub API 请求成功，同时凭据不出现在进程环境变量、调用方可见请求头、受测文件系统位置、三个第三方 echo 服务和两个无关 API 源；两个云实例元数据端点均不可达。另报告一个负结果：某 connector 的存储 header 映射不满足其 provider 的认证契约。
Conclusion: vault mediation 消除若干泄露路径但只是必要而非充分条件，最小权限、确定性动作授权、人工审批、遥测脱敏与轮换仍各自必需；研究定位为小规模、目的性抽样的功能性安全评估而非认证。

papers.title: The Selection Rule Decides the Winner: A Pre-Registered Audit of Open-Set Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-set graph anomaly detection trains on a few labeled anomalies from one class and must also find anomaly classes that were never labeled. Published results share three conventions: the test score is read at the best epoch on the test set, baseline numbers are copied from earlier papers, and most anomalies are minority classes relabeled as anomalous. We ask how much of the reported ranking these conventions decide. We re-run two recent methods, DEMO and NSReg, together with OUTPOST, a small first-order detector built for this study. All three use one protocol with identical seeds and splits on eight graphs (seven for the baselines, which cannot run on ogbn-mag), ten seeds each, and every run is scored under both the best-epoch rule and a deployable validation rule. Before the runs that test them, we registered 40 predictions. Three findings hold. First, the rule changes the leader: under the best-epoch rule, OUTPOST and NSReg each lead three of seven graphs, while under the validation rule, NSReg leads five. Second, the best-epoch bonus depends on how the benchmark was built: 0.045--0.080 AUC-ROC on the three small relabeled-class graphs and 0.002--0.014 on the three real fraud graphs. Third, pseudo-labeling in OUTPOST is worth 0.038--0.065 AUC-ROC on the same three graphs but gives no benefit on any real fraud graph. We also show that a 0.002 tie band for hyperparameter selection lies below the paired standard error on all six graphs tested, even at ten seeds. Twelve of our 40 predictions were falsified, and we report them. We close with a short reporting checklist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于开放集图异常检测 (open-set graph anomaly detection) 的预注册审计：在统一协议、相同种子与划分下重跑 DEMO、NSReg 和自建的 OUTPOST，发现测试集最优 epoch 读数会直接改写方法排名——best-epoch 规则下 OUTPOST 与 NSReg 各在 7 张图中的 3 张领先，而可部署的 validation 规则下 NSReg 领先 5 张。best-epoch 奖励幅度取决于基准构造方式：三张小规模重标注类图上为 0.045–0.080 AUC-ROC，三张真实欺诈图上仅 0.002–0.014。
Motivation: 开放集图异常检测的已发表结果依赖三条可疑约定：在测试集上读最优 epoch、从旧论文抄基线数字、把少数类重标注为异常。作者要量化这些约定本身在多大程度上决定了报告的方法排名。
Method: 重跑 DEMO、NSReg 与为本研究构建的一阶小检测器 OUTPOST，三者共用同一协议、相同种子与划分，覆盖 8 张图（基线 7 张，ogbn-mag 跑不了）、每张 10 个种子，每次运行同时按 best-epoch 规则与 validation 规则打分；实验前预注册 40 条预测。
Result: best-epoch 规则下 OUTPOST 与 NSReg 各在 7 张图中的 3 张领先，validation 规则下 NSReg 领先 5 张；best-epoch 奖励在三张小规模重标注类图为 0.045–0.080 AUC-ROC、三张真实欺诈图为 0.002–0.014；OUTPOST 的伪标注在同样三张图上值 0.038–0.065 AUC-ROC，在任何真实欺诈图上无收益；超参选择的 0.002 平局带在全部 6 张受检图上低于配对标准误，即便 10 个种子；40 条预注册预测中 12 条被证伪。
Conclusion: 报告约定（读数规则与基准构造）本身就能决定开放集图异常检测的排名，因此结论应以可部署的 validation 规则和真实欺诈图为准，并按作者给出的报告清单核对。

papers.title: DrafTS: Time-Aware Decomposition with Residual Correction for Time Series Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series contain evolving underlying dynamics with irregular variations that lack stable temporal patterns and are often referred to as noise. Existing methods address this mixture by filtering frequencies or suppressing noisy observations. They either miss temporal evolution or risk suppressing useful dynamics. We propose DrafTS, a model-agnostic framework that aims to reduce noise while preserving evolving dynamics through time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series. DrafTS uses features derived from instantaneous amplitude and frequency to guide decomposition into a primary component intended to capture underlying dynamics. A task-specific backbone models the primary component, while a lightweight correction module uses residual information to correct the backbone output. Across four time series modeling tasks, DrafTS improves six diverse backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is at https://github.com/Autumn61q/DrafTS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrafTS 提出模型无关的时间序列分解框架：用瞬时幅度与瞬时频率导出的特征引导分解，把主成分交给任务专用 backbone 建模，再用轻量残差校正模块修正 backbone 输出。在四类时间序列建模任务上一致提升六种不同 backbone。
Motivation: 真实时间序列混合了随时间演化的底层动态与缺乏稳定时序模式的不规则变化；现有方法靠滤波或抑制噪声来处理，要么丢失时间演化，要么误伤有用动态。
Method: DrafTS（time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series）以瞬时幅度和瞬时频率构造的特征引导分解，分出承载底层动态的主成分；任务专用 backbone 只建模主成分，轻量校正模块利用残差信息修正 backbone 输出，整体模型无关。
Result: 在四类时间序列建模任务上，DrafTS 对六种不同 backbone 均带来提升；代码发布于 github.com/Autumn61q/DrafTS。
Conclusion: 把分解交给瞬时幅度/频率特征引导、再用残差做后校正，可以在抑制噪声的同时保留演化中的动态，且对 backbone 选择不敏感。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Geometry-Adaptive Mechanisms for Private Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Generating differentially private synthetic data with meaningful Wasserstein utility guarantees is challenging in high dimensions. For datasets of size \(n\) on $[0,1]^d$ with $d\ge2$, existing pure \(\varepsilon\)-differentially private mechanisms achieve expected $1$-Wasserstein error of order $(\varepsilon n)^{-1/d}$, reflecting the curse of dimensionality. While this rate is optimal in the worst case, it can be overly pessimistic when the data are supported on a lower-dimensional set. We formalize this through a multiscale packing-growth dimension $k$, which captures the geometric complexity of the support via the growth of packing numbers across scales. We propose \emph{Adaptive Pruned-PMM}, a pure $\varepsilon$-differentially private mechanism that combines private depth selection with our pruned variant of the Private Measure Mechanism (PMM) of He et al.\ (2023). The mechanism supports deeper, geometry-adapted hierarchies with expected running time $O\!\left(d(n+d)\log(\varepsilon n)\right)$, which is near-linear in $n$ for fixed dimension and privacy budget. Under an external multiscale packing-growth condition with dimension $k$, we show that, for fixed positive privacy budgets and fixed geometry, the expected $1$-Wasserstein error is of order $(\varepsilon n)^{-1/k}$ for $k>1$ as $n$ grows. We also prove a lower bound under a corresponding internal packing-growth condition, showing that the exponent $1/k$ is sharp within this framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出纯 ε-差分隐私合成数据机制 Adaptive Pruned-PMM：用私有深度选择加裁剪版 Private Measure Mechanism (PMM, He et al. 2023)，按数据支撑集的多尺度 packing-growth 维数 k 自适应建树。在外部 packing-growth 条件下，期望 1-Wasserstein 误差从通用的 (εn)^{-1/d} 降到 (εn)^{-1/k}（k>1），并证明对应内部条件下指数 1/k 在该框架内是紧的。
Motivation: 在 [0,1]^d（d≥2）上，现有纯 ε-差分隐私机制的期望 1-Wasserstein 误差为 (εn)^{-1/d}，受维数灾难支配；当数据实际支撑在低维集合上时这一最坏情形速率过于悲观。
Method: 提出 Adaptive Pruned-PMM：以多尺度 packing-growth 维数 k 刻画支撑集几何复杂度（跨尺度 packing 数增长），结合私有深度选择与 PMM 的裁剪变体，支持更深的几何自适应层次结构；运行时间 O(d(n+d)log(εn))，固定维数与隐私预算下对 n 近线性。
Result: 固定正隐私预算与固定几何下，n 增长时期望 1-Wasserstein 误差为 (εn)^{-1/k}（k>1），优于通用的 (εn)^{-1/d}；在对应内部 packing-growth 条件下证明下界，说明指数 1/k 在该框架内是紧的；期望运行时间 O(d(n+d)log(εn))。
Conclusion: 差分隐私合成数据的维数灾难可由支撑集几何缓解：按 packing-growth 维数 k 而非环境维数 d 计费即可，且该指数在所提框架内不可再改进。

papers.title: When Does Geometric View Synthesis Help Wine Label Retrieval? A Public One-Shot Benchmark Across Self-Supervised and Vision-Language Backbones
papers.abstract_en: Geometric view synthesis can expand a single wine-label photograph into a training set, but its value with pretrained image encoders is unclear. We study this on a public WineSensed-derived benchmark of 1,000 classes, one enrollment photograph per class, and 4,295 real queries. With the earlier DINO vision transformer (ViT-S/16) recipe, geometric views raise top-1 accuracy from 34.1% to 62.6-63.7%, about three times the gain from two-dimensional (2D) augmentation. Frozen SigLIP 2-B already reaches 94.7%. A linear head over its frozen features gains 1.2-1.3 percentage points with the two geometric pipelines localized by the Segment Anything Model (SAM), while the other pipelines gain an inconclusive 0.3-0.6 points. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and validation-selected full fine-tuning show no clear gain within the reported confidence intervals; fixed-budget full fine-tuning loses 9-24 points. SAM localization supplies all six views for 99% of sources, compared with 43% for the edge-based front end. Recognition differences between the two cylinder constructions depend on the training recipe and are confounded by their crop and canvas conventions. Rendered-cylinder tests show different responses to source tilt, but an uncalibrated rim-ratio proxy establishes no corresponding trend in recognition on real photographs. An author-confirmed audit of 50 residual errors identifies 21 query-enrollment appearance mismatches, without establishing an irreducible error rate. These results support geometric synthesis for the tested self-supervised recipe and a smaller benefit through frozen-feature adaptation of the text-supervised encoder.

TL;DR: 在 WineSensed 衍生的 1,000 类单样本酒标检索基准上，几何视角合成把早期 DINO (ViT-S/16) 的 top-1 从 34.1% 提到 62.6–63.7%，约为 2D 增强增益的三倍；但对已很强的冻结 SigLIP 2-B（94.7%）只有 1.2–1.3 个百分点的线性头增益，LoRA 与验证集选择的全量微调无明确收益，固定预算全量微调反而掉 9–24 点。结论是几何合成的收益取决于预训练配方强度，弱配方收益大、强冻结特征收益小且全量微调有害。
Motivation: 几何视角合成能把单张酒标照片扩成训练集，但在预训练图像编码器上到底值多少不清楚：强冻结特征可能已饱和，而弱配方可能仍缺视角多样性。

papers.title: DISCERN: Can AI Agents Work Like Scientists and Guide Discovery?
papers.abstract_en: Reliable automated research requires agents to vet data, verify analyses, and generate hypotheses grounded in trustworthy evidence, potentially reducing routine scientific workload while allowing scientists to focus on interpretation and discovery. Existing benchmarks often only assess analytical task completion or hypothesis generation separately rather than testing whether reliable evidence supports valid and novel claims. We introduce DISCERN (Data Integrity and Scientific Capability: Evidence, Reasoning, and Novelty), a controlled benchmark on real, publicly available datasets that evaluates three key levels of an automated research workflow. The first two levels test data integrity and analysis verification under confounds and tool traps, while the third tests hypothesis generation and revision under adversarial review, including counterfactual cases in which evidence consistent with real data and documented scientific phenomena conflicts with established expectations, motivating alternative explanations and testable hypotheses. Across 203 tasks, eight life-science tracks, and eight models, DISCERN shows that strong aggregate performance can mask level-specific weaknesses. Agents earn perfect scores in only 60.8% of Level 1, 34.2% of Level 2, and 0.6% of Level 3 evaluations, with penalties attributed to rejection of sound data, failure to carry recognized limitations into conclusions, and wide variation in hypothesis production. Cross-track rankings by token and code use are substantially more stable than rankings by evidence judgment, suggesting greater consistency in computational effort than in evidence-based reasoning. These profiles identify opportunities for supervised scientific assistance, but current agents do not yet demonstrate reliable autonomous analysis or discovery. Code and data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/discern-bench-anon/discern-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DISCERN 是一个受控基准，在真实公开数据上把自动化科研流程拆成数据完整性、分析核验、假设生成与修订三级，共 203 个任务、8 个生命科学赛道、8 个模型。Agent 拿满分的比例从 Level 1 的 60.8% 降到 Level 2 的 34.2%、Level 3 的 0.6%，按 token 与代码用量的跨赛道排名远比按证据判断的排名稳定。结论是当前 agent 尚不能可靠地自主分析与发现，更适合做有监督的科研辅助。
Motivation: 现有基准只单独考察分析任务完成或假设生成，不检验结论是否有可靠证据支撑，无法区分“算得出”与“信得过”的自动化科研能力。
Method: DISCERN（Data Integrity and Scientific Capability: Evidence, Reasoning, and Novelty）在真实公开数据上设三级评测：Level 1、2 在混淆与工具陷阱 (tool traps) 下测数据完整性与分析核验，Level 3 在对抗性评审下测假设生成与修订，含证据与真实数据及已记录科学现象一致却与既有预期冲突的反事实案例；覆盖 203 个任务、8 个生命科学赛道、8 个模型。
Result: 满分率：Level 1 60.8%、Level 2 34.2%、Level 3 0.6%；扣分来自拒绝可靠数据、未把已识别局限带入结论、以及假设产出差异很大。按 token 与代码用量的跨赛道排名比按证据判断的排名稳定得多。
Conclusion: 强的总体分数会掩盖分级短板，当前 agent 还不能可靠地自主分析或发现，价值在于为有监督的科研辅助指出改进点。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Long-Horizon Analog Design Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hours-Long Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuit Design Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents now sustain hours-long, tool-driven loops, yet their ability to carry long-horizon analog and mixed-signal circuits to electrical specification remains unmeasured. We introduce Analog Design Bench, a long-horizon agentic benchmark of 50 transistor-level design tasks contributed by 17 chip designers. Agents work with an open-source simulator, while an isolated verifier evaluates the submitted circuit using specification-based electrical tests. We evaluate 15 agent configurations across 2,250 two-hour attempts and observe full-specification pass rates from 8.0% to 78.0%. Coding-benchmark performance correlates with analog results but leaves much of the performance spread unexplained. Our failure analysis shows that most unsuccessful submissions have no recorded legality rejection but fail electrical acceptance, identifying electrical closure as the dominant endpoint challenge. We test time, reasoning effort, agent harness, and supplied design knowledge as interventions. Longer budgets and higher reasoning effort improve performance, while general skill documents provide little benefit and sometimes reduce performance. Supplying a task-matched reference topology, an idealized form of circuit-IP retrieval, raises DeepSeek V4 Pro by 18.7 percentage points and mainly accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Analog Design Bench 是面向模拟/混合信号电路设计的长时程 agent 基准：50 个晶体管级任务、15 种 agent 配置、2,250 次两小时尝试，全规格通过率 8.0%–78.0%。失败主因是电气收敛 (electrical closure) 而非合法性拒绝；延长时限与加大推理力度有效，通用技能文档基本无益甚至有害，而给出任务匹配的参考拓扑使 DeepSeek V4 Pro 提升 18.7 个百分点。
Motivation: Coding agent 已能跑数小时的工具驱动循环，但能否把长时程模拟/混合信号电路带到电气规格要求始终没有被系统测量。
Method: 基准含 50 个由 17 位芯片设计师贡献的晶体管级设计任务；agent 使用开源仿真器，独立 verifier 依据规格电气测试判定提交电路。评测 15 种 agent 配置、共 2,250 次两小时尝试，并干预时限、推理力度、agent harness 与提供的设计知识。
Result: 全规格通过率在 8.0% 到 78.0% 之间；coding 基准成绩与模拟设计结果相关但解释不了大部分性能差异。多数失败提交没有合法性拒绝记录、败在电气验收，电气收敛是主导终点难题。更长时限与更高推理力度提升表现，通用技能文档收益甚微有时反而降低表现；提供任务匹配参考拓扑（电路 IP 检索的理想化形式）使 DeepSeek V4 Pro 提升 18.7 个百分点，主要加速 GPT-5.6 Sol。
Conclusion: 长时程模拟电路设计的瓶颈在电气收敛而非流程合法性，且对症的知识供给（任务匹配拓扑）远比通用技能文档有效。

papers.title: Unmask the State: When Does State Adaptation Matter for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (MDMs) admit flexible generation orders, making the unmasking strategy an inference decision. Existing methods vary in how they prioritize positions, control parallelism, restrict selection regions, revise predictions, or plan future denoising, yet it remains unclear when these choices should change during generation. We study this question through strategy reversals, where an alternative action becomes preferable to a fixed choice. We organize MDM inference into five axes--score, cardinality, region, commitment, and planning--and define adaptation opportunity as the one-step utility advantage of the best candidate action over a validation-selected fixed action. This view shows that adaptation value depends on both the frequency and magnitude of such reversals. Across three MDMs and ten tasks, adaptation opportunities are highly heterogeneous, with some regimes exhibiting concentrated and predictable one-step gains. This motivates selective adaptation: lightweight detectors calibrated on validation prompts identify high-opportunity states, capturing, for example, 56.9 percent of the candidate-set oracle opportunity by adapting only the top 10 percent of states on LLaDA-8B constrained JSON filling. Our transition-level results suggest that state adaptation is most useful when applied selectively rather than uniformly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把掩码扩散语言模型 (MDM) 的推理策略组织为 score、cardinality、region、commitment、planning 五个轴，并用“策略反转”定义 adaptation opportunity：候选动作相对验证集选定的固定动作的一步效用优势。机会在状态间高度异质，轻量检测器只挑高机会状态做选择性适配，在 LLaDA-8B 约束 JSON 填充上仅适配前 10% 状态就捕获候选集 oracle 机会的 56.9%。
Motivation: MDM 的解码顺序是推理期决策，已有方法在位置优先、并行度、区域限制、修订与前瞻上各不相同，但何时该切换选择并不清楚，均匀适配可能浪费计算。
Method: 在三个 MDM、十个任务上以策略反转为框架，把一步效用优势定义为 adaptation opportunity，并按频率与幅度刻画；再用验证 prompt 校准的轻量检测器识别高机会状态，触发选择性适配。
Result: 跨三个 MDM 与十个任务，适配机会高度异质，部分 regime 的一步增益集中且可预测；LLaDA-8B 约束 JSON 填充上，仅适配前 10% 状态即捕获候选集 oracle 机会的 56.9%。
Conclusion: 状态适配应选择性施加而非全程统一施加，其收益取决于反转的频率与幅度。

papers.title: Focus and Supplement: Dual-Enhanced Vision Transformer for Multi-Class Anomaly Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-class anomaly classification in industrial vision remains challenging due to noisy/incomplete anomaly representations and the unknown number of anomaly classes. To overcome this, we propose MACO, a novel multi-class anomaly classification framework that learns comprehensive representations and dynamically estimates class number without prior knowledge. First, a soft-focus attention uses anomaly maps to concentrate on relevant abnormal regions, while suppressing background noise. Second, auxiliary classification ([A-CLS]) tokens complement the [CLS] token. They collectively attend to diverse anomaly sub-regions, yielding more holistic and discriminative features. These [A-CLS] tokens are also effective across more tasks and domains. To infer the class number, we propose Correlation-based Number Estimation strategy. It computes the average correlation among labeled classes and transfers its separability cue to the unlabeled set. Experiments on MVTec AD and MTD datasets demonstrate our superiority. Under known class number, MACO improves ARI by 6.5% and $\textbf{16.3%}$ on both datasets, respectively. In the more challenging unknown number scenario, it achieves an $\textbf{11.2%}$ NMI gain on MTD and outperforms existing number estimation strategies by $\textbf{24.1%}$ UPS on MVTec AD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/MACO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出工业视觉多类异常分类框架 MACO：用 soft-focus attention 借助异常图聚焦异常区域并抑制背景噪声，用辅助 [A-CLS] token 补充 [CLS] 覆盖不同异常子区域，再用基于相关性的类数估计策略在无先验下推断异常类别数。在 MVTec AD 与 MTD 上，已知类数时 ARI 分别提升 6.5% 与 16.3%；未知类数时 MTD 的 NMI 提升 11.2%，MVTec AD 上类数估计较现有策略提升 24.1% UPS。
Motivation: 工业视觉多类异常分类面临异常表征含噪且不完整、且异常类别数事先未知的问题，现有方法依赖已知类数或先验知识。
Method: MACO 框架包含三部分：soft-focus attention 用异常图把注意力集中到异常区域并抑制背景噪声；辅助 [A-CLS] token 与 [CLS] token 共同关注不同异常子区域以获得更整体、更具判别力的特征；Correlation-based Number Estimation 计算已标注类之间的平均相关性，并把其可分性线索迁移到未标注集合以推断类数。

papers.title: How Much Imprecision is Enough Imprecision in my Classifier? A Practical Elicitation Procedure
papers.abstract_en: Set-valued classifiers, whether derived from precise probabilities and an adapted cost function, from convex sets with a robust inference mechanism, or from conformal methods, are routine options to obtain more robust, trustworthy predictions. However, there is a lack of operational tools to measure how robust or imprecise a given user is ready to be when receiving predictions, that is how much precision he/she is ready to let go in exchange of more accuracy. This is why we propose, in this paper, practical and operational elicitation procedures to measure the user proneness to set-valued predictions. The effectiveness of the iterative elicitation procedure in converging to the target parameter value is demonstrated on both tabular and image datasets drawn from standard machine learning benchmarks. The results show that the procedure also presents the user with a small number of instances, highlighting the practicality of the approach for real-world applications aimed at identifying the decision maker's optimal behavior when faced with imprecision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可操作的迭代式偏好引出 (elicitation) 流程，用少量实例逐步测出用户愿意为更高准确率让渡多少精度，即其对集合值预测 (set-valued prediction) 的容忍度。在标准 ML 基准的表格与图像数据集上，该流程能收敛到目标参数值，且只需向用户呈现少量实例。
Motivation: 集合值分类器已可由概率加代价函数、凸集鲁棒推理或 conformal 方法得到，但缺少操作化工具去量化用户本人愿意接受多大不精确性来换取更高准确率。
Method: 设计迭代式引出流程，通过向决策者逐轮展示少量实例来估计其对集合值预测的偏好参数，并在标准机器学习基准的表格与图像数据集上验证收敛性。
Result: 迭代引出流程在表格与图像两类标准 ML 基准数据集上均收敛到目标参数值，且过程中只需向用户呈现少量实例。
Conclusion: 用户的不精确性容忍度可以通过一个实例数很少的迭代流程实际测出，因而适用于需要识别决策者最优行为的真实场景。

papers.title: QuPID: Quantum Parameter-Efficient Input-Dependent Retrieval Adaptation for Medical RAG
papers.abstract_en: Fidelity-based quantum retrieval ranks candidates by the fidelity between query and archive states. Applying a shared input-independent unitary after fixed state encoding leaves that fidelity unchanged, so training the circuit cannot alter the ranking. Quantum parameter-efficient input-dependent retrieval adaptation (QuPID) repairs this by making the circuit input-dependent through data re-uploading and by comparing measurement readouts, vectors of local Pauli expectations, rather than states. The result is a small readout for adapting frozen image features to a local archive with limited data: training simulates the circuit classically, and inference runs on a GPU with fixed learned parameters. We characterize the class as a structured factorization of input-modulated quadratic feature maps, bound the frequency support of its re-uploading channel, and give a parameter-count generalization bound that motivates its small budget. Under a shared frozen backbone and a label-free protocol, QuPID's 60 parameters give higher precision-at-5 (P@5) on ChestX-ray14 and MURA than frozen medical encoders, and than adapters and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with up to 5.25 million trainable parameters. On ChestX-ray14, the P@5 gain over the frozen encoder is +0.116, the lead over retuned adapters is widest at 512 adaptation examples (+0.040), and the full-budget margin over an equally compact classical rotation-plane head is +0.023 with a 95% interval excluding zero. Medical imaging is the primary testbed; the pattern recurs on two non-medical benchmarks, in report generation, and under simulated gate noise and finite-shot readout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuPID 指出量子检索中共享的输入无关酉变换在固定态编码后不改变 query-archive 保真度，因而训练无法改变排序；它改用数据重上传 (data re-uploading) 使线路依赖输入，并比较局部 Pauli 期望向量的测量读出而非态本身。在共享冻结骨干与无标签协议下，仅 60 个参数在 ChestXray14 与 MURA 上取得高于冻结医学编码器及最多 525 万可训练参数的 adapter/LoRA 的 P@5。
Motivation: 量子保真度检索在固定编码后接共享输入无关酉变换时排序不可训练，且医学影像本地档案数据有限，需要极小参数预算的适配方式。
Method: 通过 data re-uploading 让线路依赖输入，用测量读出（局部 Pauli 期望向量）替代态比较；训练阶段经典模拟线路，推理在 GPU 上以固定学习参数运行。理论上把该类刻画为输入调制二次特征映射的结构化分解，给出重上传通道的频率支撑界与参数计数泛化界；评测采用共享冻结骨干与无标签协议。
Result: 60 个参数在 ChestXray14 与 MURA 上 P@5 高于冻结医学编码器，也高于最多 525 万可训练参数的 adapter 与 LoRA；ChestXray14 上相对冻结编码器 P@5 增益 +0.116，相对重调 adapter 的领先在 512 个适配样本时最宽（+0.040），相对同等紧凑的经典 rotation-plane head 在全预算下差 +0.023 且 95% 区间不含零。
Conclusion: 让量子检索线路依赖输入并比较读出而非态，才能在极小参数预算下完成适配；该模式在两个非医学基准、报告生成以及模拟门噪声与有限 shots 读出下复现，主要试验场是医学影像。

papers.title: KoopCell: Koopman-Based Generative Model for Learning Single-Cell Dynamics from Distribution Snapshots
papers.abstract_en: Learning population dynamics from temporally sparse, unpaired distribution snapshots is a fundamental challenge in developmental biology. Recent approaches based on neural differential equations and flow matching can interpolate between observed population snapshots, but may struggle to extrapolate beyond the training horizon and often lack an explicit mechanism for modeling developmental branching. We propose KoopCell, a unified generative framework based on Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig theory that jointly learns representations and predictive linear latent dynamics. Theoretically, using the weak continuity equation, we derive a closed-form least-squares estimator for the Koopman generator from distribution snapshots and establish convergence guarantees under suitable assumptions. To model branching dynamics, we further develop KoopCell-M, which incorporates non-Markovian memory into the latent Koopman dynamics through a Markovian embedding. Experiments on synthetic systems and three scRNA-seq datasets demonstrate the ability of our framework to recover Koopman spectra, model branching through memory, and scale to predicting high-dimensional gene expression distributions, achieving state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KoopCell 用 Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig 理论从时间稀疏、非配对的分布快照中联合学习表示与线性潜空间动力学，由弱连续性方程导出 Koopman 生成元的闭式最小二乘估计；KoopCell-M 通过 Markovian embedding 引入非马尔可夫记忆来刻画发育分支。在合成系统与三个 scRNA-seq 数据集上恢复 Koopman 谱、建模分支并外推高维基因表达分布，在所评估方法中达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 发育生物学中群体分布快照时间稀疏且非配对，神经 ODE 与 flow matching 只能在观测间插值，难以越过训练时域外推，也缺少显式的发育分支建模机制。
Method: 基于 Koopman-Mori-Zwanzig 理论的统一生成框架：用弱连续性方程从分布快照闭式最小二乘估计 Koopman 生成元并给出收敛保证；KoopCell-M 用 Markovian embedding 把非马尔可夫记忆嵌入潜空间 Koopman 动力学。
Result: 在合成系统与三个 scRNA-seq 数据集上，框架能恢复 Koopman 谱、通过记忆建模分支、并扩展到预测高维基因表达分布，在所评估方法中达到 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 把分布快照上的群体动力学写成线性潜空间 Koopman 动力学并显式加入记忆项，可同时支持外推与发育分支建模。

papers.title: MultiEcho: An Experimental Science of Learned Worlds
papers.abstract_en: World models can be studied as experimental systems with response laws of their own. We introduce MultiEcho, a framework for estimating these laws through controlled counterfactual interventions, delimiting their applicability, and separately testing their physical correspondence. Across nine simulated physical systems and seven frozen model configurations, three-reference estimators predict complete intervention responses and recover intervention parameters. Estimator selection uses discovery data only; frozen fits are evaluated on validation and confirmation contexts. The experiments distinguish response predictability, intervention readability and physical accuracy. Responses can be locally describable yet poorly match physical effects in the same target coordinates. Event-window, visibility and camera interventions reveal conditional applicability, and paired generator configurations show reduced readability under a scene prompt with stronger guidance. Magnitude sweeps expose small image errors alongside large relative effect errors. An exact-reset material experiment separates registered visible-response success from fixed-readout failure on material-dependent futures at matched positions and velocities. Exact finite-scale identities resolve odd and even response errors; first-order remainder bounds specify when refined calibration converges. MultiEcho provides an experimental basis for studying learned-world laws independently of, and in relation to, physical laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiEcho 把世界模型当作可做受控反事实干预的实验系统，用三类参照估计器 (three-reference estimators) 预测完整干预响应并反演干预参数，在 9 个模拟物理系统与 7 个冻结模型配置上区分响应可预测性、干预可读性与物理准确性。发现响应可在目标坐标下局部可描述却与真实物理效应吻合差，幅度扫描显示图像误差小而相对效应误差大。
Motivation: 世界模型作为学习到的“世界”缺少独立于物理定律的实验框架：无法系统地施加反事实干预、界定适用范围，也无法把响应可预测性与物理对应性分开检验。
Method: 提出 MultiEcho 框架：通过受控反事实干预估计响应定律，用三类参照估计器预测完整干预响应并恢复干预参数；估计器选择只用 discovery 数据，冻结拟合在 validation 与 confirmation 上评估；配合 event-window、visibility、camera 干预与成对生成器配置，以及精确有限尺度恒等式与一阶余项界。
Result: 在 9 个模拟物理系统、7 个冻结模型配置上，三类参照估计器能预测完整干预响应并恢复干预参数；成对生成器配置在 scene prompt 下 guidance 更强时可读性下降；幅度扫描显示图像误差小但相对效应误差大；精确重置 (exact-reset) 材料实验在匹配位置与速度下，可见响应按配准判据成功而固定读出在材料依赖未来上失败；精确有限尺度恒等式消解奇偶响应误差，一阶余项界给出细化标定何时收敛。
Conclusion: 学习世界的响应定律可与物理定律分开、又在关系中检验：响应可局部可描述却在相同目标坐标下与物理效应吻合差，因此响应可预测性、干预可读性与物理准确性必须分别报告。

papers.title: ReLoc: Rethinking Scene Coordinate Regression Architecture for Robust Outdoor LiDAR-based Localization
papers.abstract_en: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) has recently emerged as a promising approach for LiDAR-based localization, achieving accurate localization without requiring an explicit 3D map. Despite their effectiveness, existing SCR methods rely on scene classification-based global embedding that struggles to provide fine-grained discrimination among nearby locations. Moreover, their reliance on uniform sampling of local features during training assigns equal importance to all points, thereby inadvertently propagating features from dynamic objects or unstable regions and potentially degrading training stability. In this paper, we present ReLoc, a revamped SCR architecture that can effectively address these limitations. First, we redesign the global embedding module by combining learnable context tokens with a feature aggregator to capture richer and more discriminative scene context. Second, we introduce an attention-based local feature enhancement module to mitigate the impact of noisy local features while encouraging context-consistent structures, yielding more robust local feature representations. Experimental results on two large-scale outdoor datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy over previous SCR-based methods while maintaining real-time inference performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLoc 重构了 LiDAR 场景坐标回归 (Scene Coordinate Regression, SCR) 的定位架构：用可学习 context token 加特征聚合器替换基于场景分类的全局 embedding，以获得更细粒度的邻近位置区分；再用注意力式局部特征增强模块抑制动态物体与不稳定区域的噪声特征。在两个大规模户外数据集上达到 SCR 方法中的 SOTA 精度，同时保持实时推理。
Motivation: 现有 SCR 依赖场景分类式全局 embedding，难以区分邻近位置；训练时对局部特征均匀采样会把动态物体和不稳定区域的特征等权传播，损害训练稳定性。
Method: 两处改造：全局 embedding 模块改为可学习 context token 与 feature aggregator 组合以捕获更具判别力的场景上下文；局部特征用注意力式增强模块抑制噪声并鼓励上下文一致的结构，得到更稳健的局部特征表示。
Result: 在两个大规模户外数据集上，精度超过此前 SCR 方法达到 state-of-the-art，同时保持实时推理性能。
Conclusion: 把全局上下文建模与局部特征去噪一起重构，可以在不牺牲实时性的前提下提升 LiDAR SCR 定位的精度与训练稳健性。

papers.title: CHI: A Composite Hallucination Index Unifying Entity, Relation, and Quantity Dimensions for Summarization Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Faithfulness evaluation of abstractive summaries remains an open challenge, with existing metrics addressing only isolated hallucination types: factual entity errors, relational inconsistencies, or numerical fabrications, without capturing their co-occurrence or interaction. We introduce CHI (Composite Hallucination Index), the first unified hallucination metric that decomposes faithfulness errors into three orthogonal dimensions: entity hallucination (EHI), relation hallucination (RHI*), and quantity hallucination (QHI). Each dimension employs a shared softmax-normalized architecture over Venn diagram-derived factors representing extractiveness, positive hallucination, over-focus, negative hallucination, and lost focus. The novel QHI component introduces tolerance-aware numerical matching with exact, epsilon, derived, and temporal comparison modes. We fuse the three dimensions via harmonic mean to produce a single composite score that penalizes weakness in any dimension. We validate CHI on 800 source articles spanning four domains (news, medical, legal, financial) with summaries from five generation systems. Empirical results demonstrate that: (i) the three dimensions are statistically orthogonal (mean rho = 0.148), confirming they capture distinct error types; (ii) CHI achieves the highest system-level correlation with human judgments (rho = 0.66, p = 0.006) on SummEval, outperforming ROUGE (rho = 0.53), EHI (rho = 0.58), and all individual components; and (iii) ablation studies confirm that all three dimensions contribute unique variance, with the full composite outperforming any individual component while providing decomposable error diagnostics unavailable from single-score baselines. CHI provides practitioners with a decomposable, interpretable, and efficient faithfulness metric suitable for both offline evaluation and online monitoring of summarization systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHI 把摘要忠实度错误拆成实体 (EHI)、关系 (RHI*)、数量 (QHI) 三个正交维度，各维用 Venn 图因子的共享 softmax 架构，再以调和平均合成单一分数，任一维度弱即被拉低。在 800 篇四领域源文与五个生成系统上，三维度平均 rho=0.148 确认正交；SummEval 系统级与人工判断相关 rho=0.66 (p=0.006)，高于 ROUGE 的 0.53 与 EHI 的 0.58。
Motivation: 现有摘要忠实度指标各自只覆盖实体错误、关系不一致或数值编造中的一类，无法刻画这些幻觉的共现与交互，也给不出可分解的错误诊断。
Method: CHI 将忠实度错误分解为 EHI、RHI*、QHI 三个维度，每维共享一个基于 Venn 图因子（extractiveness、positive hallucination、over-focus、negative hallucination、lost focus）的 softmax 归一化架构；QHI 新增容忍度感知的数值匹配，含 exact、epsilon、derived、temporal 四种比较模式；三维用 harmonic mean 融合成单一综合分。
Result: 在 800 篇覆盖 news、medical、legal、financial 四领域的源文与五个生成系统的摘要上验证：三维度统计正交（mean rho = 0.148）；SummEval 系统级与人工判断相关 CHI rho = 0.66 (p = 0.006)，高于 ROUGE rho = 0.53、EHI rho = 0.58 及各单维分量；消融显示三维度各贡献独特方差，完整综合分优于任一单维分量。
Conclusion: 把幻觉按实体、关系、数量三维正交分解再用调和平均合成，可同时得到与人工判断更高的系统级相关性和单分数基线无法提供的可分解错误诊断，适用于离线评估与在线监控。

papers.title: CalibHyper: Chance-Corrected Relational Hypergraphs for Few-Shot Molecular Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Molecular property prediction is central to drug development and materials discovery, but experiments are costly and labeled data are scarce. Context-aware methods use auxiliary assay labels to support few-shot prediction, and recent work supervises property relations with label agreement. However, label agreement is sensitive to class marginals and does not directly capture dependence between properties. We propose CalibHyper, a chance-corrected relational hypergraph method based on the joint label distribution. CalibHyper subtracts an independence baseline from the ordered four-state label distribution and shrinks the residual according to the number of joint observations. A swap-equivariant relation head estimates these residuals, which choose the auxiliary properties for each molecule and set the sign and weight of their hyperedge messages. On thirteen datasets from five benchmarks, in both 1-shot and 10-shot settings, CalibHyper and its ablation settings achieve ROC-AUC competitive with the strongest reported results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CalibHyper 用机会校正 (chance-corrected) 的关系超图做少样本分子性质预测：从有序四状态标签联合分布中减去独立性基线，再按联合观测次数收缩残差，由交换等变 (swap-equivariant) 关系头估计残差，据此挑选辅助性质并决定超边消息的符号与权重。在五个基准的十三个数据集上，1-shot 与 10-shot 设置下其 ROC-AUC 与已报告的最强结果相当。
Motivation: 少样本分子性质预测依赖辅助 assay 标签，但现有工作用标签一致性 (label agreement) 监督性质间关系，该量对类别边缘分布敏感，且不能直接刻画性质之间的依赖。
Method: 基于联合标签分布构建机会校正的关系超图：从有序四状态标签分布中减去独立性基线，并按联合观测次数收缩残差；swap-equivariant 关系头估计这些残差，残差决定每个分子选取哪些辅助性质，以及超边消息的符号与权重。
Result: 在五个基准的十三个数据集上，1-shot 与 10-shot 两种设置下，CalibHyper 及其消融设置的 ROC-AUC 与已报告的最强结果相当。
Conclusion: 用机会校正的联合标签分布替代标签一致性来监督性质关系，可在少样本分子性质预测中达到与最强已报告结果相当的 ROC-AUC。

papers.title: RAEGL: Risk-Aware Evidence-Gated Learning for Selective Contextual Routing under Temporal Shift
papers.abstract_en: Contextual specialization can improve forecasting accuracy, but a correction selected on one historical interval may become unreliable under temporal distribution shift. To address this issue, we propose RAEGL, a Risk-Aware Evidence-Gated Learning framework for selective contextual forecasting. RAEGL retains a validated global predictor by default and activates a contextual residual only when pre-deployment evidence supports its use. The framework separates candidate selection from gate calibration and jointly evaluates randomization significance, practically meaningful gain, and temporal stability. Experiments on real-world audits and controlled panels show how RAEGL can prevent harmful contextual deployment while making conservative opportunity costs explicit. In a reconstructed Our World in Data audit, exact fallback avoids RMSE degradations of 0.0960 and 0.0239 caused by two validation-selected corrections. In a sealed World Development Indicators evaluation, a region-based correction passes the randomization test but is withheld because its gain is only 0.000092, its country-clustered 95% confidence interval crosses zero, and only 0.02% of bootstrap replicates reach the practical threshold. In controlled panels, the stability- and support-aware extension activates in 97.2% of strong, stable-context runs while rejecting all high-drift settings. These results support RAEGL as an auditable, evidence-based mechanism for managing contextual deployment risk and as a conservative alternative to validation-driven contextual selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAEGL 默认保留已验证的全局预测器，只有部署前证据同时通过随机化显著性、实际增益门槛和时间稳定性时才启用上下文残差，用于在时间分布漂移下避免有害的上下文修正。在 Our World in Data 重构审计中，精确回退避免了两个验证集选中修正造成的 RMSE 0.0960 与 0.0239 退化；受控面板中该门控在 97.2% 的强稳定上下文运行中激活，并拒绝全部高漂移设定。
Motivation: 在历史区间上选出的上下文修正一旦遇到时间分布漂移就可能失效，而验证集驱动的上下文选择缺少对部署风险的约束。
Method: RAEGL 把候选选择与门控校准分离，对每个候选上下文残差联合评估随机化显著性、具有实际意义的增益和时间稳定性，仅在证据充分时激活残差，否则回退到全局预测器；评估用真实审计与受控面板两类设定。
Result: 在重构的 Our World in Data 审计中，精确回退避免了两个验证集选中修正造成的 RMSE 退化 0.0960 与 0.0239；在密封的 World Development Indicators 评估中，一个基于区域的修正通过随机化检验但被扣留，因其增益仅 0.000092、按国家聚类的 95% 置信区间跨零、仅 0.02% 的 bootstrap 重复达到实际门槛；受控面板中稳定性与支持度感知扩展在 97.2% 的强稳定上下文运行中激活，并拒绝全部高漂移设定。
Conclusion: RAEGL 是一种可审计、基于证据的上下文部署风险管控机制，作为验证驱动上下文选择的保守替代方案。

papers.title: Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching for Sign Language Production
papers.abstract_en: Sign Language Production (SLP) aims to generate sign motions from text. Conditional Flow Matching methods have achieved strong performance in SLP by constructing conditional paths that transform a source distribution into a target distribution. However, existing methods construct these paths via linear interpolation, whereas the rotational geometry of human joints confines valid joint rotations to a manifold embedded in Euclidean space. Consequently, linear interpolation between two sign motions leaves this manifold and ignores the motion distribution on it. In this paper, we revisit SLP from the perspective of manifold transport and propose a Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching framework, termed \textbf{SignNMFlow}, which constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold by jointly considering geometric efficiency and the motion distribution. Specifically, we exploit the intrinsic geometry of the manifold and introduce a motion naturalness measure to characterize the motion distribution. By minimizing the kinetic energy under this measure, we learn a naturalness-guided interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic, which provides geometrically efficient transport, with a learnable deviation that incorporates the motion distribution, thereby significantly improving the fidelity of generated sign motions. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SignNMFlow 把手语生成 (SLP) 的条件流匹配路径从欧氏线性插值搬到关节运动流形上：用闭式测地线保证几何高效传输，再叠加一个可学习偏移项吸收运动分布，并以最小化动能的自然度度量约束插值。摘要称定性与定量评估均验证了生成手语动作保真度的显著提升。
Motivation: 人体关节旋转的可行域是嵌入欧氏空间的流形，线性插值会离开该流形并忽略其上的运动分布，导致生成的手语动作不自然。
Method: 提出 Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching 框架 SignNMFlow：利用流形内在几何构造闭式测地线 (closed-form geodesic) 作为几何高效传输，引入运动自然度度量刻画流形上的运动分布，通过在该度量下最小化动能学习自然度引导的插值，将测地线与可学习偏移耦合，使条件路径直接落在运动流形上。
Result: 在定性与定量两类评估中，SignNMFlow 显著提升了生成手语动作的保真度 (fidelity)；摘要以“extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations”概括有效性，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 手语生成的流匹配路径应建在关节运动流形上，几何效率与运动分布需同时进入插值设计，而非沿用欧氏线性插值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OPERA: A Unified Omnimodal Progressive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Agent for Referring Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring video segmentation with heterogeneous multimodal queries---spanning text, audio, and reference images---demands both robust cross-modal understanding and precise spatio-temporal reasoning. We propose OPERA (Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent), a unified reasoning agent built on a single MLLM that performs dual-axis progressive reasoning via three specialized stages. Along the temporal axis, a Temporal Reasoning Agent narrows the frame search space through coarse-to-fine filtering to identify the most informative key frame. Along the spatial axis, a Distillation Agent establishes what to locate via cross-modal semantic distillation, and a Grounding Agent enhanced with GRPO determines where the target appears, with dense mask propagation completing the pixel-level output. OPERA sets a new state of the art on OmniAVS and Ref-AVS and transfers zero-shot to standard referring video segmentation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Safe Score Matching: Diffusion Policies with Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Online Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. A popular line of research in safe RL relaxes safety to a soft expected-cost constraint and solves the resulting Constrained Markov Decision Process via primal-dual Lagrangian updates that only enforce safety on average. To address this limitation, hard, state-wise constraints are introduced and often imposed through Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. Yet such constraints require solving different objectives in the feasible and infeasible regions: reward maximization in the former, recovery toward the feasible regions in the latter. The resulting target action distributions are inherently multimodal, and this structure poses a fundamental challenge for the Gaussian or deterministic actors used in existing HJ-based safe RL, which often collapse onto suboptimal modes. Diffusion policies provide the expressiveness needed to represent such distributions, and recent work on Q-score matching offers a route to training them for online RL by score regression -- but has been applied only to reward maximization. We propose Safe Score Matching (SSM), an off-policy actor-critic method that adapts Q-score matching to hard-constrained safe RL by gating a two-branch score target with HJ reachability: inside the feasible set, the denoising process degenerates to Q-score matching on actions classified as viable by the HJ critic; outside, a recovery branch biases denoising toward regions with lower worst-case violation. On quadrotor and fixed-wing trajectory-tracking and stabilize-and-avoid benchmarks, SSM attains the best or near-best task performance with low false-safe rates, whereas the primal-dual baseline admits more unsafe behavior and reachability-based baselines tend to be more conservative; on Safety-Gymnasium velocity tasks, SSM attains the lowest cost with competitive reward.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/byli888/safe-score-matching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Safe Score Matching (SSM)，用 Hamilton-Jacobi reachability 的可行/不可行判定给 Q-score matching 的去噪目标加双分支门控：可行集内对 HJ critic 判为 viable 的动作做 Q-score 匹配，集外把去噪偏向更低最坏违规的恢复区域。在四旋翼与固定翼轨迹跟踪、stabilize-avoid 基准上取得最好或接近最好的任务性能且 false-safe 率低，在 Safety-Gymnasium 速度任务上取得最低 cost 且 reward 有竞争力。
Motivation: 安全 RL 常把约束松弛为期望代价、只在平均意义上满足；硬的 state-wise 约束又要求在可行区做奖励最大化、在不可行区做恢复，目标动作分布天然多模态，现有 HJ-based safe RL 的高斯或确定性 actor 会塌到次优模态。
Method: SSM 是 off-policy actor-critic 方法，把 Q-score matching 适配到硬约束安全 RL：用 HJ reachability critic 门控两分支 score target，可行区内对判为 viable 的动作退化为 Q-score matching，可行区外用恢复分支把去噪偏向最坏违规更低的区域；扩散策略承担多模态分布表达。
Result: 在 quadrotor 与 fixed-wing 的轨迹跟踪和 stabilize-and-avoid 基准上，SSM 取得最好或接近最好的任务性能并保持低 false-safe 率，而 primal-dual 基线出现更多不安全行为、reachability 类基线偏保守；在 Safety-Gymnasium 速度任务上 SSM 取得最低 cost 且 reward 有竞争力。
Conclusion: 把 HJ reachability 的可行/不可行结构直接写进 score 目标，扩散策略才能在硬 state-wise 约束下同时保住多模态表达与安全，避免平均约束的不安全和可达性方法的过度保守。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Conservatism: Recoverability-Conditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model-based imitation learning (MBIL) improves real-environment interaction efficiency by optimizing policies on imagined rollouts from a learned world model. However, the gap between model-induced and real-environment occupancies makes policy learning sensitive to model error. Conservative MBIL mitigates model exploitation during policy optimization, but when real-environment interactions are collected by the same conservative policy, uncertain regions around the expert distribution remain insufficiently sampled. Generic uncertainty-driven exploration, on the other hand, may allocate interaction to novel but task-irrelevant dynamics. We propose REcoverability-CONditioned Exploration for Model-Based Imitation Learning (RECON). RECON separates conservative policy learning from active data collection by maintaining a main policy for task execution and an explorer for real-environment interaction. The explorer is optimized based on epistemic uncertainty conditioned on recoverability estimated from multi-step main-policy imagination, focusing data collection on unknown states from which the main policy can still return toward expert behavior. Experiments on locomotion, navigation and manipulation show consistent gains in interaction efficiency, imitation performance, and robustness, indicating that RECON directs real-environment interaction toward recovery regions around the expert distribution that are underexplored by prior methods, and thereby learns a world model better suited for imitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECON 把基于模型的模仿学习 (MBIL) 中的保守策略学习与主动数据采集拆开：主策略负责执行任务，探索器专门采真实交互，其探索目标是「经由主策略多步想象估计的可恢复性 (recoverability) 条件化的认知不确定性」，即只采那些主策略仍能回到专家行为的未知状态。在 locomotion、navigation、manipulation 三类任务上，交互效率、模仿性能与鲁棒性均一致提升。
Motivation: 模型诱导占用与真实环境占用的差异使策略学习对模型误差敏感；保守 MBIL 虽抑制模型利用，但用同一保守策略采数据会漏采专家分布附近的不确定区域，而通用不确定性探索又会把交互浪费在与任务无关的新颖动力学上。
Method: RECON 维护两个组件：执行任务的主策略与负责真实环境交互的 explorer。explorer 的优化目标是认知不确定性，并以 recoverability 为条件，recoverability 由主策略的多步想象 (multi-step imagination) 估计，从而把数据采集集中到主策略仍能返回专家行为的未知状态。
Result: 在 locomotion、navigation 和 manipulation 实验中，交互效率、模仿性能与鲁棒性均获得一致增益；作者归因于把交互导向专家分布周围、被先前方法欠探索的 recovery 区域，从而学到更适合模仿的世界模型。
Conclusion: 把保守策略学习与主动数据采集解耦，并用可恢复性约束不确定性探索，能让 MBIL 的真实交互集中在专家分布附近的 recovery 区域，进而改善世界模型与模仿表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Does Learning to Predict the World Help Agents Act? Auditing World-Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how an environment will change before acting is a natural route to better decision making for agents. Recent post-training methods therefore require agents to predict the next observation and turn that prediction into a reward or a direct supervision signal, which is called world model. Existing next-observation training methods help the agent to learn the environmental content. However, they additionally involve an optimization process, which may introduce several effects other than learning to predict the world. Consequently, where the performance gain comes from during the training process remains an open question. We answer this research question through replacing true next-observation targets with in-distribution mismatched observations during the training process. Across two interactive text environments, mismatched targets lower prediction accuracy by 15.3-61.6% relative to ground-truth targets, yet retain substantial task gains over the base model. Compared with the base model, trained models consider more candidate actions and exhibit less looping. We also introduce a setting that replaces prediction-based rewards with independent random signals. This training expands task coverage (pass@64) even when the reward carries no environment information. We also generalize this finding to VisualWebArena, where random-reward training raises pass@64 by 14.3% relative to the base model, without observation-matching rewards or an external multimodal teacher for reward construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 审计世界模型后训练的收益来源：把下一观测真值目标替换为分布内错配观测，预测精度相对真值目标下降 15.3–61.6%，但任务增益仍大幅保留；把基于预测的奖励换成与环境无关的独立随机信号，pass@64 仍提升（VisualWebArena 上相对基座 +14.3%）。结论是后训练增益主要来自优化过程本身而非学会预测世界。
Motivation: 现有下一观测训练方法让智能体学会环境内容，但训练同时引入预测之外的优化效应，性能增益究竟来自何处是未解问题。
Method: 在两个交互式文本环境中，用分布内错配观测替换真实下一观测目标作为监督；另设一种设定，用独立随机信号替换基于预测的奖励；并将随机奖励设定推广到 VisualWebArena，无需观测匹配奖励与外部多模态奖励教师。
Result: 错配目标使预测精度相对真值目标下降 15.3–61.6%，但相对基座模型仍保留可观任务增益；训练后模型考虑更多候选动作、循环行为减少。随机信号奖励训练即使不含环境信息也扩大任务覆盖（pass@64）；在 VisualWebArena 上随机奖励训练使 pass@64 相对基座提升 14.3%。
Conclusion: 世界模型后训练的收益并非主要来自准确预测环境，优化过程本身（更多动作探索、更少循环、任务覆盖扩大）即可解释大部分增益。

papers.title: When to Evict, Not What to Keep: Draft-Guided Eviction for Training-Free KV-Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Training-free KV-cache compression methods such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evict tokens at the end of prefill, aiming to preserve the attention mass that future queries are expected to use -optimizing what to keep. We show that this objective fails in two distinct ways. (1) Compensation: restoring the evicted attention mass can recover the attention-level target without recovering task quality. (2) Selection: covering more of the true decode-query mass can hurt quality when the recovered mass is fragmented rather than concentrated in coherent spans. These failures share a common cause: eviction occurs before the queries that determine the answer trajectory exist. We propose Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE), which defers eviction until after drafting the first k=2 answer tokens using the full cache - just one decode step beyond prefill. Because the draft is generated from the answer's own prefix, no cache entries are discarded before this trajectory signal becomes available. The per-head cache budget remains unchanged, and DGE can be applied directly to SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM without modifying their eviction scores. Unlike extra-pass methods, DGE changes when eviction occurs rather than what cache entries are selected. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGE outperforms prior methods at every evaluated budget on five of six instruct-tuned backbones, achieving 44.2 on LongBench, nearly matching FullKV at 44.3. The timing-only control DGE-W achieves the same score, demonstrating that the gain comes from when eviction occurs rather than what is selected - an effect we term trajectory anchoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练无关的 KV-cache 压缩在 prefill 结束时就驱逐 token，此时决定答案轨迹的 query 尚不存在。作者提出 Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE)：先用完整 cache 起草前 k=2 个答案 token，再执行驱逐，只改时机不改各方法的驱逐分数。在六个 instruct-tuned backbone 中的五个上、所有评测预算下超过既有方法，LongBench 达 44.2，几乎追平 FullKV 的 44.3。
Motivation: SnapKV、H2O、PyramidKV 等方法在 prefill 末尾优化“保留什么”，但摘要指出两类失败：补偿（恢复被驱逐的注意力质量却恢复不了任务质量）与选择（覆盖更多真实 decode-query 质量反而因碎片化而降质），根因是驱逐发生在答案轨迹的 query 出现之前。
Method: DGE 把驱逐推迟到用完整 cache 起草首个 k=2 个答案 token 之后，即仅比 prefill 多一个 decode step；每头 cache 预算不变，可直接叠加到 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O、StreamingLLM 而不改其驱逐分数。另设只改时机的对照 DGE-W，以及与 extra-pass 方法的对比。
Result: 在六个 instruct-tuned backbone 中的五个上、每个评测预算下均优于先前方法；LongBench 上 DGE 得 44.2，几乎追平 FullKV 的 44.3；只改时机的对照 DGE-W 取得相同分数。
Conclusion: 收益来自驱逐发生的时机而非选中哪些 cache 条目，作者称之为轨迹锚定 (trajectory anchoring)；先起草再驱逐可在不增加每头预算的前提下逼近 FullKV 质量。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: DGE 把驱逐推迟到用完整 cache 起草首个 k=2 个答案 token 之后，即仅比 prefill 多一个 decode step；每头 cache 预算不变，可直接叠加到 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O、StreamingLLM 而不改其驱逐分数。另设只改时机的对照 DGE-W，以及与 extra-pass 方法的对比。
summary_sections.result: 在六个 instruct-tuned backbone 中的五个上、每个评测预算下均优于先前方法；LongBench 上 DGE 得 44.2，几乎追平 FullKV 的 44.3；只改时机的对照 DGE-W 取得相同分数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 收益来自驱逐发生的时机而非选中哪些 cache 条目，作者称之为轨迹锚定 (trajectory anchoring)；先起草再驱逐可在不增加每头预算的前提下逼近 FullKV 质量。

papers.title: FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FeCoSplat 把前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 的压缩对象从输入图像或高斯基元换成紧凑中间特征：先压多视角特征得到中间 3DGS，用其渲染视图作反馈指导第二阶段压缩，解码为紧凑隐状态后由轻量预测器重建高斯基元。在低码率下取得有利的率失真表现，接收端重建仅需 3.45M 参数。
Motivation: 前馈 3DGS 的表示存储与传输开销大：压输入图像会把重建负担推给接收端，压重建后的高斯基元又因其属性异构且不规则而难以压缩。
Method: 两阶段反馈引导压缩框架：第一阶段压缩多视角特征得到中间 3DGS，其渲染视图作为反馈引导第二阶段压缩进一步精修；码流解码为紧凑隐状态，再由轻量预测器重建最终高斯基元。
Result: 在实验中取得有利的率失真 (rate--distortion) 性能，尤其在低码率区间；接收端高斯重建仅需 3.45M 参数。
Conclusion: 压缩中间特征而非图像或高斯基元，能在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间取得更好平衡，低码率场景收益最明显。

papers.title: ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Information-seeking agents increasingly operate over information spaces that are too large to process exhaustively. Yet many multi-agent systems organize computation around static partitions of the available space, causing coordination to grow with how information is segmented rather than with what the query still requires. We introduce ANTMAN, an adaptive coordination framework that treats evolving unresolved information needs as the unit of runtime coordination. ANTMAN maintains a revisable Need Graph that tracks unresolved requirements, accumulated evidence, prior attempts, and search progress, and uses this state to control worker selection, routing, and task-local recovery as new evidence is discovered. By separating the coordination policy from substrate-specific search interfaces, the same need-conditioned mechanism can operate across different information spaces. Experiments across multi-document question answering, controlled long-context scaling, and realistic structured navigation show that ANTMAN remains effective across settings, including when execution is delegated to substantially smaller worker models. Under a 16x increase in searchable context, ANTMAN increases active coordination by only 1.23x, compared with more than 15x for partition-driven baselines, while preserving strong answer quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANTMAN 把多智能体信息检索的协调单元从静态分区换成可修订的 Need Graph（未解决需求、已积累证据、历史尝试、搜索进度），用它驱动 worker 选择、路由与任务内恢复。在 16 倍可检索上下文增长下，协调开销只增 1.23 倍，而分区驱动基线超过 15 倍，同时保持较强答案质量，且可下放到明显更小的 worker 模型执行。
Motivation: 信息空间大到无法穷举处理时，多智能体系统按静态分区组织计算，协调成本随信息被切分的粒度增长，而不是随查询仍未满足的需求增长。
Method: 维护可修订的 Need Graph 记录未解决需求、累积证据、先前尝试与搜索进度，并以此控制 worker 选择、路由和任务局部恢复；协调策略与具体信息空间的搜索接口解耦，使同一 need-conditioned 机制可跨不同信息空间复用。
Result: 在多文档问答、受控长上下文扩展与真实结构化导航三类实验中，ANTMAN 在各设置下保持有效，包括把执行下放给明显更小的 worker 模型时；可检索上下文扩大 16 倍时协调量仅增 1.23 倍，分区驱动基线超过 15 倍，答案质量保持强。
Conclusion: 把未解决的信息需求而非静态分区作为协调单位，可让多智能体检索的协调成本随查询需求而非信息切分规模增长，并跨信息空间与 worker 规模保持答案质量。

papers.title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisionHOPE 把视觉主干建成自修改学习系统：沿图像行列四个方向扫描，用五个耦合记忆共同决定记住什么与如何学习，并以稳定性匹配的步长控制（软上限 + 谱夹紧）保证记忆动力学沿扫描非扩张。在 ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K 上取得有竞争力的结果，作者据此主张自修改学习系统可作为通用视觉主干的实用基础。
Motivation: 从 CNN 到 ViT、SSM、TTT 层，视觉计算对单个输入越来越自适应，但适应规则仍由训练好的主干预先规定；直接把 Nested Learning 的无约束自引用更新搬到视觉主干会导致不稳定。
Method: 基于 Nested Learning (NL) 的自引用构造，用五个耦合记忆存储内容、生成 key/value 表示并控制学习率与保留率，随扫描累积的视觉上下文联合演化；推导稳定性匹配的步长控制方案，对自引用注入加软上限、对保留记忆转移加谱夹紧，并证明记忆动力学沿每次扫描非扩张；对二维特征图把 NL 的 chunk 对齐到图像行与列，做四个方向扫描。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K 上取得有竞争力的结果（competitive results），并给出记忆动力学沿扫描非扩张的证明；代码发布于 github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE。
Conclusion: 自修改学习系统可以作为通用视觉主干的实用基础，前提是用软上限与谱夹紧约束自引用更新以保证稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Multi-Turn Reasoning: A Fairness Approach
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems capable of solving complex tasks through multi-turn planning, tool use, verification, and memory updates. However, learning agentic systems remains difficult due to two fundamental challenges, i.e., (1) long-horizon credit assignment, where supervision is available only at the final outcome, and (2) imbalanced data distributions, where dominant data patterns bias optimization and weaken adaptation to rare but informative reasoning behaviors. In this paper, we propose Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO or $Φ$-MPO), a new preference optimization framework for agentic learning. We first show that Multi-Level Preference Optimization provides a principled and more computationally efficient framework for long-horizon reasoning. Then, we introduce a Fair Multi-Level Objective that addresses imbalance in agentic learning. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis demonstrating that our approach addresses both long-horizon reasoning and data imbalance. Our experiments on agentic reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization（Fair-MPO / Φ-MPO），用多层级偏好优化处理 agentic 多轮推理中的长时程信用分配，并以公平目标纠正数据分布不平衡对稀有推理行为的抑制。理论分析覆盖长时程推理与数据不平衡两方面，agentic reasoning benchmark 上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: agentic 学习有两个根本障碍：监督只在最终结果给出，长时程信用分配难做；主导数据模式偏置优化，削弱对稀有但有信息量的推理行为的适应。
Method: 先论证 Multi-Level Preference Optimization 是长时程推理上更原则、更省算力的框架，再在其上加入 Fair Multi-Level Objective 处理数据不平衡，并给出覆盖两方面的理论分析。
Result: 在 agentic reasoning benchmarks 上达到 State-of-the-Art（SOTA）性能；摘要给出的是理论分析加基准实验的定性结论，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 把多层级偏好优化与公平目标结合，可同时缓解长时程信用分配和数据不平衡，是 agentic 学习的 SOTA 方案。
Relevance: 0
