papers.title: Robust Hierarchical Structures for Agentic Document Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable us to better understand text documents, including PDFs and Word documents. However, LLMs, as well as more modern LLM agents, i.e., those with tool-calling abilities, typically treat such documents as plain text, ignoring the fact that they are often organized hierarchically into sections and subsections. Extracting this structure, while difficult, can improve efficiency and effectiveness for agents (and humans)---since only sections relevant to a given task need to be processed. Unfortunately, prior work on structure extraction provides no formal guarantees on how well the inferred structure matches the true one. Instead, we target a robust and compact variant that is feasible to infer and useful in practice. Robustness ensures that the text under each subsection header is a superset of the text under the same header in the true structure. Compactness seeks to minimize this superset, reducing agentic cost (or human cognitive load). We propose SHED, a two-stage workflow for inferring a robust and compact structure. The first stage is pluggable with an infinite family of approaches, each guaranteeing robustness for a specific document class. We theoretically characterize the document space using these classes and their hierarchical relationships. Empirically, SHED improves F-1 scores (measuring the robustness--compactness trade-off) by 13%--68% over non-LLM baselines and 9%--15% over expensive LLM-based approaches. Finally, we show how SHED-inferred structures are valuable for agentic document analysis: agents using SHED outperform baselines, achieving 3%--23% higher accuracy while being up to 10x cheaper.
papers.comment: To appear in Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (SIGMOD 2027). 25 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHED 用两阶段流程从 PDF/Word 文档推断鲁棒且紧凑的层级结构：每个子标题下的文本是真实结构同名标题文本的超集（鲁棒），同时最小化该超集以压低 agent 成本。理论上按文档类及其层级关系刻画文档空间，第一阶段可插拔一整族保证鲁棒性的方法；F-1 相比非 LLM 基线提升 13%–68%、相比昂贵 LLM 方法提升 9%–15%，下游 agent 准确率高 3%–23% 且成本最多降 10 倍。
Motivation: LLM agent 把文档当纯文本处理，忽略章节层级，导致无关内容也被送入上下文；已有结构抽取工作对推断结构与真实结构的吻合程度没有形式化保证。
Method: SHED 两阶段工作流：第一阶段可插拔一整族方法，每族针对特定文档类保证鲁棒性（子标题文本为真实结构对应文本的超集），并以紧凑性最小化该超集；作者在理论上用这些文档类及其层级关系刻画文档空间。
Result: F-1（衡量鲁棒性-紧凑性权衡）比非 LLM 基线高 13%–68%，比昂贵的 LLM-based 方法高 9%–15%；使用 SHED 结构的 agent 比基线准确率高 3%–23%，成本最多降低 10 倍。
Conclusion: 对文档结构给出可保证的鲁棒-紧凑折中，比无保证的抽取更划算：agent 只处理相关章节即可同时提高准确率并大幅降本。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: SHED 用两阶段流程从 PDF/Word 文档推断鲁棒且紧凑的层级结构：每个子标题下的文本是真实结构同名标题文本的超集（鲁棒），同时最小化该超集以压低 agent 成本。理论上按文档类及其层级关系刻画文档空间，第一阶段可插拔一整族保证鲁棒性的方法；F-1 相比非 LLM 基线提升 13%–68%、相比昂贵 LLM 方法提升 9%–15%，下游 agent 准确率高 3%–23% 且成本最多降 10 倍。

summary_sections.method: SHED 两阶段工作流：第一阶段可插拔一整族方法，每族针对特定文档类保证鲁棒性（子标题文本为真实结构对应文本的超集），并以紧凑性最小化该超集；作者在理论上用这些文档类及其层级关系刻画文档空间。
summary_sections.result: F-1（衡量鲁棒性-紧凑性权衡）比非 LLM 基线高 13%–68%，比昂贵的 LLM-based 方法高 9%–15%；使用 SHED 结构的 agent 比基线准确率高 3%–23%，成本最多降低 10 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对文档结构给出可保证的鲁棒-紧凑折中，比无保证的抽取更划算：agent 只处理相关章节即可同时提高准确率并大幅降本。

papers.title: PhysAlign: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Role Alignment in Multimodal Physics Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in physics diagram understanding is correctly associating visual information with the physical entities, relations, and conditions it describes. Even when a value, symbol, or other local element is accurately recognized, assigning it to the wrong entity or scope can distort the underlying physical premise and lead to incorrect reasoning. To systematically study this challenge, we introduce \textbf{PhysAlign}, a benchmark designed to assess whether multimodal models correctly associate information recognized from physics diagrams with its intended physical role. By disentangling visual recognition from physical-role assignment through localized probes and controlled variants, PhysAlign isolates correspondence errors from recognition failures. It contains 3,341 human-validated probes spanning 986 physics problems, enabling systematic evaluation of visual recognition and physical-role correspondence at scale. We further introduce five complementary evaluation metrics, including CAcc, GAcc, and JAcc, which provide a comprehensive assessment of models' ability to recognize diagram content, establish correct physical correspondences, and solve the underlying physics problem. Across our evaluated multimodal models, PhysAlign reveals a consistent gap between local visual recognition and physical-role grounding. Even when the queried content is correctly recognized, the conditional correspondence error rate remains 13.8\% for GPT-6-Astra and rises to about 50.6\% for InternVL3.5-8B. These findings indicate that strong perception alone does not ensure reliable physical interpretation, exposing a distinct grounding bottleneck that is largely hidden by answer-level accuracy and highlighting the need for future models to better align recognized visual evidence with its physical meaning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysAlign 是一个物理图示理解基准，用局部探针和受控变体把视觉识别与物理角色指派解耦，检验多模态模型是否把识别出的符号、数值挂到正确的物理实体与作用域上。在 3,341 个人工校验探针上，即使查询内容已被正确识别，条件对应错误率对 GPT-6-Astra 仍为 13.8%，对 InternVL3.5-8B 升至约 50.6%。
Motivation: 物理图示里即使局部元素识别正确，把它指派给错误的实体或作用域也会扭曲物理前提并导致推理失败；而答案级准确率掩盖了这种对应错误，此前缺少能把它与识别失败分开的评测。
Method: 构建 PhysAlign 基准，用局部化探针 (localized probes) 与受控变体 (controlled variants) 将视觉识别和物理角色指派解耦，从而把对应错误从识别失败中隔离出来；配套提出五个互补评测指标，含 CAcc、GAcc、JAcc，分别度量图示内容识别、正确物理对应建立与底层物理问题求解。
Result: 基准含 3,341 个人工校验探针、覆盖 986 道物理题；在被评测的多模态模型上，即使查询内容被正确识别，条件对应错误率对 GPT-6-Astra 为 13.8%，对 InternVL3.5-8B 约 50.6%，且局部视觉识别与物理角色 grounding 之间存在一致的差距。
Conclusion: 强感知并不保证可靠的物理解释：存在一个被答案级准确率掩盖的 grounding 瓶颈，未来模型需把识别到的视觉证据与其物理含义对齐。

papers.title: PIC-UIE: Predicting Image-Adaptive Corrections for Lightweight Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to restore visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail from images degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter. State-of-the-art UIE methods often rely on large backbones and dense image-to-image prediction, limiting their practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, operating entirely in a single color space couples degradation estimation with luminance and chroma correction. To address these challenges, we propose PIC-UIE, a lightweight predictor--executor framework that predicts image-adaptive corrections from a fixed $256\times256$ RGB thumbnail and applies them to the native-resolution input in the YCbCr color space. The predictor produces seven outputs, organized into spatial correction, nonlinear luminance and coupled chroma mapping, and image-level color calibration. A depth map regularizes the transmission proxy during training, whereas inference uses only the RGB input. With 9,486 parameters and 0.094 GFLOPs at $256\times256$, PIC-UIE achieves 24.137 dB PSNR and 0.9216 SSIM on UIEB-90 and 21.320 dB PSNR on zero-shot LSUI. It further processes native 4K images at 55.0 FPS under the comparison protocol. These results show that structured correction prediction provides an effective and practical alternative to dense RGB reconstruction for underwater image enhancement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIC-UIE 用轻量 predictor–executor 框架从 256×256 RGB 缩略图预测七项图像自适应校正量，在 YCbCr 空间作用于原分辨率输入，替代稠密 RGB 重建。仅 9,486 参数、0.094 GFLOPs 下在 UIEB-90 达 24.137 dB PSNR / 0.9216 SSIM，零样本 LSUI 21.320 dB，原生 4K 处理 55.0 FPS，说明结构化校正预测是边缘部署可行的 UIE 路线。
Motivation: SOTA UIE 依赖大骨干与稠密逐像素预测，边缘部署不现实；且单一色彩空间把退化估计与亮度/色度校正耦合在一起。
Method: predictor 从固定 256×256 RGB 缩略图输出七项校正，分为空间校正、非线性亮度与耦合色度映射、图像级颜色标定三组，executor 在 YCbCr 空间作用于原分辨率输入；训练时用深度图正则化 transmission proxy，推理仅用 RGB 输入。
Result: 9,486 参数、256×256 下 0.094 GFLOPs；UIEB-90 上 24.137 dB PSNR、0.9216 SSIM；零样本 LSUI 21.320 dB PSNR；comparison protocol 下原生 4K 图像 55.0 FPS。
Conclusion: 结构化校正预测可作为稠密 RGB 重建的高效替代，在参数量、FLOPs 与 4K 实时性上同时满足边缘部署。

papers.title: ZeroGAR: Benchmarking the Adversarial Robustness of Zero-Shot Graph Models
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot graph models (ZGMs), which learn transferable knowledge from source graphs and directly apply to unseen target graphs without any adaptation, have achieved promising performance and attracted considerable attention. Despite their proliferation, existing ZGMs are predominantly evaluated on clean graphs, while existing graph robustness benchmarks mainly focus on supervised settings, leaving a fundamental question largely unexplored: How robust are ZGMs when their unseen target graphs are exposed to adversarial manipulation? In this paper, we answer this question by proposing ZeroGAR, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating the adversarial robustness of ZGMs. ZeroGAR evaluates 13 representative ZGMs from 3 different paradigms on 8 graph datasets across 4 domains, covering both in-domain and cross-domain transfer under structural, textual, and node injection attacks with multiple perturbation budgets. It further investigates whether existing graph defenses remain effective in the zero-shot setting. Extensive experiments reveal that strong clean zero-shot performance does not guarantee adversarial robustness, with three key findings: (1) Vulnerability patterns are related to model prediction mechanisms: GNN-based methods are particularly vulnerable to structural and node injection attacks, whereas LLM-based methods are more vulnerable to textual attacks; (2) Stronger LLM backbones introduce a structure-text robustness trade-off; (3) Existing graph defense methods do not consistently improve zero-shot robustness and may compromise clean performance. We hope that ZeroGAR will facilitate rapid, equitable evaluation and inspire further innovative research in ZGM security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZeroGAR 是首个系统评测零样本图模型 (ZGM) 对抗鲁棒性的基准，在 4 个领域 8 个图数据集上测 13 个 ZGM，覆盖结构、文本与节点注入三类攻击。发现干净性能强不等于鲁棒：GNN 类在结构与节点注入攻击下最脆弱，LLM 类更怕文本攻击，更强的 LLM backbone 带来结构-文本鲁棒性权衡，且现有图防御在零样本设定下不能稳定提升鲁棒性、还可能损害干净性能。
Motivation: 零样本图模型直接在未见目标图上应用，但现有评测只用干净图，图鲁棒性基准又局限于监督设定，ZGM 在目标图被对抗操纵时有多鲁棒这一问题基本没有被系统回答。
Method: 提出 ZeroGAR 基准，评测来自 3 种范式的 13 个代表性 ZGM，覆盖 4 个领域 8 个图数据集的 in-domain 与 cross-domain 迁移；攻击含结构攻击、文本攻击与节点注入攻击并设多种扰动预算，同时检验既有图防御方法在零样本设定下是否仍然有效。
Result: 实验给出三条发现：GNN-based 方法对结构与节点 injection 攻击特别脆弱，LLM-based 方法更易受文本攻击；更强的 LLM backbone 引入 structure-text robustness trade-off；现有图防御方法不能一致提升零样本鲁棒性并可能损害干净性能。评测规模为 13 个 ZGM、3 种范式、8 个数据集、4 个领域、3 类攻击。
Conclusion: 干净的零样本性能不能保证对抗鲁棒性，且鲁棒性模式取决于模型的预测机制（GNN 走结构、LLM 走文本），因此零样本图模型的安全评测与防御需要与监督设定分开进行。

papers.title: When Privacy Moves ML-Mediated Decisions On Device: Information and Incentive Misalignment in Auctions
papers.abstract_en: Moving ML-mediated decision making onto privacy-preserving clients decentralises the economic decision along with the inference. Shared budget constraints then depend on information that cannot be globally current, creating an information-structure failure that conventional pacing is not designed to solve. We study this information misalignment in an auction-logic-faithful on-device simulation with 36 campaigns and 50 devices. Accounting is in dimensionless integer score units; no currency semantics are claimed. Across 30 paired demand paths, proportional Even pacing overspends 17.77% after one tick of staleness and 1,669.31% after 50 ticks under the original 20-times budget pressure. The effect does not depend on that severe a budget: at two-times pressure, 50-tick overspend remains 106.95%. A visible-budget no-sale guard makes zero-lag compliance exact at this score-unit granularity, yet leaves 11.88% overspend at one tick because other devices' debits remain invisible. A declared bursty, heterogeneous-device sweep retains a strictly increasing mean lag curve. We derive a finite-window expected excess-debit bound under conditional charge caps and find positive paired slack in every bounded-value cell. A second, incentive misalignment arises when the ML/pacing score transformation is allowed to change payment units: 98.23% of rival auctions at one tick admit a profitable deviation. An executable implementation-level counterexample isolates the runner-up's multiplier in the winner's price. Critical-base-bid payment is per-auction DSIC conditional on current multipliers, but does not establish dynamic truthfulness and does not repair base-value ranking disagreement.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Previously submitted to the Economics for Machine Learning (EconML) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/sarkar-dipankar/on-device-auction-audit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 隐私计算把广告竞价的预算决策搬到设备端后，共享预算依赖无法全局同步的信息，常规 pacing 无法处理这种信息结构失配。在 36 campaigns、50 devices 的仿真中，Even pacing 在 1 tick 陈旧下超支 17.77%，50 tick 下超支 1,669.31%（20 倍预算压力），2 倍压力下 50 tick 仍超支 106.95%；可见预算守卫使零延迟合规精确，但 1 tick 仍超支 11.88%。
Motivation: ML 决策迁移到隐私保护客户端后，推理与经济决策一同去中心化，共享预算约束依赖无法全局最新的信息，而现有 pacing 机制并非为这种信息结构失配设计。
Method: 在忠实于竞价逻辑的设备端仿真（36 campaigns、50 devices、30 条配对需求路径）中测试 Even pacing 与可见预算 no-sale 守卫；在条件扣费上限下推导有限窗口期望超额扣费界，并构造实现层反例隔离赢家价格中次高价者的 multiplier。
Result: Even pacing 在 1 tick 陈旧下超支 17.77%，50 tick 下超支 1,669.31%（20 倍预算压力）；2 倍压力下 50 tick 超支 106.95%。可见预算守卫使零延迟合规在该分数单位粒度下精确，但 1 tick 仍超支 11.88%。声明的 bursty、异质设备扫描保持严格递增的平均延迟曲线；有限窗口超额扣费界在每个有界价值单元中都有正的配对松弛。1 tick 时 98.23% 的对手竞价存在可获利偏离。
Conclusion: 设备端预算决策的信息陈旧会造成随延迟单调放大的超支，且改变支付单位的 score 变换会引入激励失配；critical-base-bid 支付仅在当前 multiplier 下满足 DSIC，不建立动态真实性，也不修复 base-value 排序分歧。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. papers.title: LoopTrack: A Simple Baseline for Parameter-Efficient Transformer Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Current Transformer-based tracking methods typically stack multiple Transformer blocks with separate parameters to model interactions between the target template and the search region for target localization. These trackers often incur substantial parameter overhead from stacked blocks, making their deployment on resource-limited devices difficult. To address this, we propose a parameter-efficient Transformer tracking framework, dubbed LoopTrack, which repeatedly applies a set of Transformer blocks with shared parameters to interact features in a looped architecture for tracking, significantly reducing the number of parameters. To further exploit target cues, we present two lightweight designs, including target-aware looping (TAL) and gated target memory (GTM). The former applies intermediate target information generated by one loop to guide feature interaction in the subsequent loop, enabling progressive feature refinement, while the latter maintains a compact memory across frames, which is incorporated into the loop process to provide long-term information to the tracker, mitigating temporal drift in tracking. Compared to existing Transformer trackers, LoopTrack enables multiple rounds of feature interaction with fewer model parameters, making it resource-friendly for deployment. In extensive experiments on multiple datasets, LoopTrack shows a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. In particular, our LoopTrack$_{\rm One}$, with a single shared Transformer block, achieves 66.2\% SUC score on LaSOT with only 3.4M parameters, while LoopTrack$_{\rm Three}$, using three shared blocks, achieves 69.3\% SUC score with 6.4M parameters, surpassing existing parameter-efficient tracking methods with comparable or larger model size. With LoopTrack, we aim to establish a simple yet strong baseline for parameter-efficient Transformer tracking. Our code and models will be released.
papers.comment: Code and models will be released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoopTrack 用一组参数共享的 Transformer block 循环交互模板与搜索区域特征，把堆叠式跟踪器的参数量压下来，并以 target-aware looping (TAL) 与 gated target memory (GTM) 逐步细化目标线索、跨帧抑制漂移。单 block 的 LoopTrack_One 在 LaSOT 上以 3.4M 参数取得 66.2% SUC，三 block 的 LoopTrack_Three 以 6.4M 参数取得 69.3% SUC，超过同等或更大模型规模的参数高效跟踪方法。
Motivation: Transformer 跟踪器靠堆叠多个独立参数的 block 建模模板与搜索区域交互，参数开销大，难以部署到资源受限设备。
Method: 循环复用同一组参数的 Transformer block 多轮交互特征；target-aware looping (TAL) 用某一轮产生的中间目标信息引导后续轮的特征交互，gated target memory (GTM) 维护跨帧紧凑记忆并注入循环过程提供长期信息。
Result: 在多个数据集上评测：LoopTrack_One（单个共享 block）在 LaSOT 上 SUC 66.2%、参数 3.4M；LoopTrack_Three（三个共享 block）SUC 69.3%、参数 6.4M，超过模型规模相当或更大的参数高效跟踪方法，呈现有利的精度-参数权衡。
Conclusion: 参数共享的循环式特征交互加目标线索记忆，可以在显著减少参数的同时保持跟踪精度，作者据此把 LoopTrack 定位为参数高效 Transformer 跟踪的简单强基线，代码与模型将开源。

papers.title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3$\times$ the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对个人 GUI agent 把检索到的历史经验整段拼进上下文的做法，提出免训练框架 ExpActivator：只在当前情境确实适用时激活经验——执行中把新屏幕与冻结 GUI backbone 潜空间中的历史状态匹配并给出对应动作作参考，执行前仅当时间与场景提供足够支持才激活重复意图、否则弃权。在四个 GUI backbone 上，轨迹内步成功率平均提升 28%，每个 backbone 都取得最佳个性化执行且历史 token 约为基线的五分之一，主动建议的 MCC 约为最强基线的 2.3 倍。
Motivation: 现有方法假设任务级相关的检索历史对任务内每个决策都有用，但相关性由任务级决定、适用性取决于决策时刻的情境，导致历史帮助集中在 episode 开头、对后续 90% 步骤几乎没有持续收益，也难以判断是否该主动建议。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 框架 ExpActivator：执行时把每个新屏幕与冻结 GUI backbone 潜空间中的历史状态匹配，把对应动作作为参考提供给策略；执行前用当前时间和场景作为支持度判据，只在支持充分时激活重复意图 (recurring intent)，否则 abstain。
Result: 在四个 GUI backbone 上，轨迹内步成功率平均提升 28%；每个 backbone 上个性化执行均为最佳，同时只用约五分之一的历史 token；主动建议的 Matthews correlation coefficient 约为最强主动基线的 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 经验的价值在于被激活而非被拼接：把个性化从任务级检索改写为情境级经验激活，可以在更少历史 token 下同时提升执行成功率与主动建议质量。

papers.title: BITS: Rethinking Fair and Comprehensive Evaluation for Irregular Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in irregular time series forecasting, the field still lacks a unified benchmark for fair and comprehensive evaluation. Existing evaluations are often conducted on a limited set of datasets with inconsistent experimental protocols and predominantly error-based metrics, rendering it difficult to compare and assess methods fairly and comprehensively across diverse settings. To eliminate these limitations and accelerate progress, we propose BITS, a standardized, reproducible, and extensible benchmark for advancing research on irregular time series forecasting. BITS covers eleven datasets from nine domains with diverse irregularity characteristics, and it characterizes the datasets according to their missing rate, missing pattern complexity, sampling irregularity, and skewness. Further, it offers a unified pipeline for data preprocessing, model integration and evaluation, and reporting. It accommodates regular and irregular time series forecasting methods, including time series foundation models, under consistent settings, incorporating both error-based and non-error-based evaluation metrics. Findings include that method performance varies substantially across irregularity characteristics, with no single modeling strategy consistently dominating. We also find that using error-based or non-error-based metrics can yield different model rankings, highlighting the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. The code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BITS-8F2E/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BITS 提出不规则时间序列预测的统一基准，覆盖 9 个领域 11 个数据集，按缺失率、缺失模式复杂度、采样不规则性与偏度刻画数据，并用统一管线同时跑规则与不规则方法（含时间序列基础模型）。核心发现是方法表现随不规则性特征大幅变化、无单一策略稳定占优，且误差类与非误差类指标会给出不同模型排名。
Motivation: 现有不规则时间序列预测评测只用少量数据集、协议不一致且几乎只看误差类指标，方法之间难以公平横向比较。
Method: BITS 提供标准化、可复现、可扩展的基准：统一数据预处理、模型接入、评测与报告管线，同时容纳规则/不规则预测方法与时间序列基础模型，并纳入误差类与非误差类两类指标；数据集按缺失率、缺失模式复杂度、采样不规则性、偏度四个维度刻画。
Result: 覆盖 9 个领域 11 个数据集；方法表现随不规则性特征显著变化，无单一建模策略始终占优；仅用误差类指标与仅用非误差类指标会得到不同的模型排名。
Conclusion: 不规则时间序列预测需要多维度、协议统一的评测，单一误差指标的排名不足以判定方法优劣。

papers.title: Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iterative unmasking. At each denoising step, a dLLM proposes a token at every masked position, but the decoder commits only a confident subset of these proposals. Trace-based on-policy distillation (TOPD) builds on this process by matching the student to a stronger teacher, yet only at the committed positions. We argue that this discards much of the useful signal, which resides in the uncommitted proposals, where the student has made a prediction but is not yet confident enough to commit it. We call these proposals hesitations. In our pilot study on an SDAR-4B student, hesitations make up only 24% of supervisable state-position pairs but carry 66% of the teacher-student divergence. To exploit this signal, we propose Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which extends teacher distribution matching to every masked position of each denoising step. Because hesitations are not equally informative, we further allocate supervision using hindsight from the completed trajectory, placing more weight on positions whose proposal was later disagreed with the final token and on blocks where first-step proposals rarely survive. Since both models already produce distributions at all masked positions, HOPD requires no additional forward passes over TOPD. The only extra cost is evaluating the loss at more positions. With SDAR-1.7B and SDAR-4B students distilled from TraDo-8B-Instruct, HOPD achieves the best average score among the evaluated methods on five math and coding benchmarks, under both static and dynamic decoding and at both scales. It also speeds up decoding. On SDAR-4B, the HOPD student hesitates less and commits 11% more tokens per denoising step than TOPD, while reaching higher accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 的 on-policy 蒸馏只在已提交位置匹配教师，丢掉了未提交的 hesitation 信号；HOPD 把教师分布匹配扩展到每个去噪步的所有 masked 位置，并用完成轨迹的事后信息加权。SDAR-4B 上 hesitation 仅占可监督状态-位置对的 24%，却承载 66% 的师生分歧；HOPD 在五个数学与代码基准上取得被评方法中的最佳平均分，且每步多提交 11% 的 token。
Motivation: TOPD 只在解码器已提交的位置对齐教师，而学生已给出预测但置信度不足的位置（hesitations）被整体丢弃，浪费了大部分师生分歧信号。
Method: 提出 Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation (HOPD)：把教师分布匹配扩展到每个去噪步的全部 masked 位置；再用完成轨迹的事后信息分配监督，对后来与最终 token 不一致的 proposal 位置、以及首步 proposal 很少存活的 block 加权。两个模型本就在所有 masked 位置产生分布，因此相对 TOPD 不增加前向传播，只多算损失的位置。
Result: pilot study 中 SDAR-4B 的 hesitation 只占可监督 state-position 对的 24%，却携带 66% 的师生分歧。以 SDAR-1.7B 与 SDAR-4B 为学生、从 TraDo-8B-Instruct 蒸馏，HOPD 在五个数学与代码基准上取得被评方法中的最佳平均分，静态与动态解码、两个规模均如此，并加快解码。SDAR-4B 上 HOPD 学生犹豫更少，每个去噪步比 TOPD 多提交 11% 的 token，同时准确率更高。
Conclusion: 未提交的 hesitation 承载了远超其占比的教师信号，把蒸馏监督扩展到全部 masked 位置并按事后结果加权，可以在不增加前向传播的前提下同时提高准确率与解码速度。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation (HOPD)：把教师分布匹配扩展到每个去噪步的全部 masked 位置；再用完成轨迹的事后信息分配监督，对后来与最终 token 不一致的 proposal 位置、以及首步 proposal 很少存活的 block 加权。两个模型本就在所有 masked 位置产生分布，因此相对 TOPD 不增加前向传播，只多算损失的位置。
summary_sections.result: pilot study 中 SDAR-4B 的 hesitation 只占可监督 state-position 对的 24%，却携带 66% 的师生分歧。以 SDAR-1.7B 与 SDAR-4B 为学生、从 TraDo-8B-Instruct 蒸馏，HOPD 在五个数学与代码基准上取得被评方法中的最佳平均分，静态与动态解码、两个规模均如此，并加快解码。SDAR-4B 上 HOPD 学生犹豫更少，每个去噪步比 TOPD 多提交 11% 的 token，同时准确率更高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 未提交的 hesitation 承载了远超其占比的教师信号，把蒸馏监督扩展到全部 masked 位置并按事后结果加权，可以在不增加前向传播的前提下同时提高准确率与解码速度。

papers.title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AquaWAM 是首个面向水下具身智能体的世界行动模型 (World Action Model)，不预测未来图像，而是建模动作条件动力学与被动动力学——推进器死区、超出指令持续的惯性滑行、以及环境流。在 USIM 基准 20 项水下任务上任务成功率 72.6%，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上决策比 U0 快 2.7 倍；即使缺失 DVL 速度量测仍有 61.6% 成功率（U0 为 39.4%）。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 主要预测动作条件下的视觉观测，无法显式刻画惯性、浮力、流体阻力与持续漂移等水下被动动力学，而这些在动作结束后仍持续影响载体。
Method: AquaWAM 用 DVL、IMU、压力传感器与关节编码器感知，相机仅提供理解目标与目标位姿的语义；建模紧凑导航状态而非高维视觉观测，同时涵盖动作条件动力学与被动动力学（推进器死区、惯性滑行、环境流），从而压缩模型规模与计算开销。
Result: 在 USIM 基准 20 项水下任务上任务成功率 72.6%，优于已有方法；在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上动作决策比 U0 快 2.7 倍。部分机载传感器缺失时仍有效：无 DVL 速度量测时成功率 61.6%，U0 为 39.4%。
Conclusion: 水下 WAM 应显式建模被动动力学与紧凑导航状态，而非预测未来图像；这样既能提高任务成功率与决策速度，也能在传感器缺失时保持有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Direct Hidden-State Alignment: Mapping and Controlling Preference Expression in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: In many settings, post-training need not create the target behavior from scratch: the base model can already produce it, but not reliably. This shifts part of preference alignment from capability acquisition to behavioral expression. We ask how a specified preference is represented in native model computation, what prevents target-supporting computation from reliably dominating generation, and whether this structure can directly guide control. We introduce Residual Competition Maps (RCMs), which map a behavioral preference onto signed causal effects of native residual computation. Across preference domains, RCMs reveal coexisting target-supporting and target-competing effects, input-dependent component roles, and cases where a single native-component intervention reverses the preference outcome. DPO substantially reorganizes these effects and can weaken opposition without guaranteeing its removal. We then propose Direct Hidden-State Alignment (DHSA), which treats inference-time hidden states rather than base-model weights as the direct adaptation space. RCM-guided Causal Activation State Transition (CAST) implements DHSA through local state interventions at a small number of preference-relevant interfaces while freezing the base model. With only 256-16,384 controller parameters, CAST reaches DPO-competitive operating points across three preference domains, can complement DPO-trained models, and can be enabled or removed at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Residual Competition Maps (RCMs)，把偏好映射为原生 residual 计算的带符号因果效应，显示目标支持与目标竞争效应并存、单个原生组件干预即可反转偏好结果；据此提出 DHSA，用 RCM 引导的 CAST 在推理时对少量偏好相关接口做局部状态干预、冻结基座模型，仅 256–16,384 个控制器参数即在三个偏好域达到与 DPO 竞争的工作点。
Motivation: 许多偏好对齐场景里目标行为基座模型已能产生、只是不稳定，问题从能力获取变成行为表达：哪些原生计算在支撑偏好、什么阻碍它稳定主导生成，以及该结构能否直接用于控制。
Method: RCM 将指定偏好映射到原生 residual 计算的带符号因果效应，识别目标支持/竞争成分及其输入依赖角色；DHSA 把推理时 hidden state 而非基座权重作为适配空间，RCM 引导的 Causal Activation State Transition (CAST) 在少数偏好相关接口做局部状态干预并冻结基座模型，控制器参数量 256–16,384。
Result: RCM 显示目标支持与目标竞争效应共存、组件角色随输入变化，且单个原生组件干预可反转偏好结果；DPO 大幅重组这些效应、可削弱反对但不保证消除。CAST 在三个偏好域达到与 DPO 竞争的工作点，可与 DPO 训练模型互补，并可在推理时开启或移除。
Conclusion: 偏好对齐可部分转为对推理时 hidden state 的直接控制：用因果图谱定位少数接口做局部干预，就能以极小控制器参数量获得 DPO 级别的偏好表达控制，且开关可逆、不改基座权重。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Error You See Is Not the Error You Made: Progression-aware Reasoning Origin for Reasoning Error Localization
papers.abstract_en: Verifying multi-step LLM reasoning requires more than determining whether a trace is correct: a useful verifier should identify where the reasoning first goes wrong. However, existing holistic methods provide little positional evidence, while forward sequential verification often treats the first rejected step as the error source. Under error propagation, this assumption can fail, since an earlier mistake may remain locally plausible and become observable only through its downstream consequences. We therefore rethink reasoning verification as a progression-aware error-source localization problem: rather than asking only where a reasoning trace first appears inconsistent, we ask which earlier step best explains how that inconsistency emerges along the trajectory. Based on this view, we propose Progression-aware Reasoning Origin (PRO), a training-free framework for first-error localization. PRO jointly models incoming support from the preceding context and outgoing compatibility with subsequent reasoning, selectively refines regions where these signals disagree, and finally performs detector-conditioned source attribution with intervention-based evidence to distinguish the true error origin from its propagated manifestations. We further formalize the gap between forward rejection and structural exposure, showing why incoming-side evidence alone is insufficient for reliable localization under error propagation. Experiments across open-form, medical, and structured reasoning tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong verification baselines, supporting progression-aware source attribution as a more faithful formulation of reasoning verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRO 把多步 LLM 推理验证重构为「首个错误源定位」问题：联合建模前文的 incoming support 与后续推理的 outgoing compatibility，在两者冲突处选择性细化，再用基于干预的证据做 detector 条件化的源归因。在 open-form、医疗与结构化推理任务上相对强验证基线有一致提升。
Motivation: 整体验证只判对错、不给位置证据，而前向顺序验证把第一个被拒绝的步当成错误源；在错误传播下，更早的错误可能局部看起来合理、只在下游后果中暴露，该假设失效。
Method: 提出 training-free 的 Progression-aware Reasoning Origin (PRO)：同时建模前文 incoming support 与后续 outgoing compatibility，在两信号不一致的区域选择性细化，最后以 detector 条件化的源归因配合 intervention-based evidence 区分真实错误源与传播表现；并形式化 forward rejection 与 structural exposure 之间的差距，说明仅靠 incoming 侧证据不足以可靠定位。
Result: 在 open-form、medical 与 structured reasoning 三类任务上，相对强验证基线呈现一致改进（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: progression-aware 的源归因是比「首个不一致步」更忠实的推理验证形式，且在错误传播下前向拒绝证据本身不足。

papers.title: TraceDance: An Automated System for Building Agent Behavior Benchmarks from Real-World Agent Deployment Traces
papers.abstract_en: An agent can complete a task while exhibiting undesirable behavior during execution. Developers need tests for the specific behaviors encountered in deployment, beyond fixed benchmark suites. We present TraceDance, an agent system that constructs targeted benchmarks from deployment traces for user-specified undesirable behaviors. For efficient construction, Anchor-and-Confirm combines programmable retrieval with candidate-level confirmation by a Flash large language model (LLM), while the Anchor Synthesis Loop generates and revises specifications for custom behaviors. The benchmarks use decision-point continuation to evaluate an LLM's next turn at a recorded decision point with a behavior-specific rubric, without a reference answer or environment replay. Experiments in coding and general tool use draw on 252,557 sessions and produce 107 benchmarks with 4,125 instances, fulfilling 95.3% of build-target requests. Both human annotators confirm the requested behavior in 84% of sampled instances, and the automated grader's agreement with human pass/fail judgments is comparable to that between the annotators. Nine frontier LLMs achieve a mean pass rate of only 26.7%, showing that they still struggle to respond appropriately at the evaluated decision points. Analysis across behavior-specific benchmarks further reveals weaknesses in how current LLMs behave as agents. By turning deployment problems into targeted benchmarks, TraceDance could serve as a key component of the recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceDance 从真实 agent 部署轨迹中自动构建针对特定不良行为的基准：Anchor-and-Confirm 用可编程检索加 Flash LLM 候选确认，Anchor Synthesis Loop 生成并修订行为规格，评测用 decision-point continuation 在记录的决策点上按行为专属 rubric 打分，无需参考答案或环境回放。在编码与通用工具使用上基于 252,557 个 session 产出 107 个基准、4,125 个实例，满足 95.3% 的构建请求；9 个前沿 LLM 平均通过率仅 26.7%。
Motivation: agent 在部署中会表现出特定的不良行为，而固定 benchmark 套件覆盖不到开发者实际遇到的那些行为，需要按部署轨迹定制测试。
Method: Anchor-and-Confirm 结合可编程检索与 Flash LLM 的候选级确认来高效构造基准；Anchor Synthesis Loop 针对自定义行为生成并修订规格；评测用 decision-point continuation 在记录的决策点上以行为专属 rubric 评 LLM 的下一轮回复，不依赖参考答案或环境回放。
Result: 在编码与通用工具使用两个领域，基于 252,557 个 session 生成 107 个基准、共 4,125 个实例，完成 95.3% 的构建目标请求；抽样实例中人类标注者有 84% 确认了所请求行为，自动评分器与人类 pass/ fail 判断的一致性与标注者之间的一致性相当；9 个前沿 LLM 的平均通过率仅 26.7%。
Conclusion: 把部署问题转成针对性基准后，前沿 LLM 在被评估的决策点上仍普遍应对不当，TraceDance 可作为 recursive self-improvement (RSI) 回路的关键组件。

papers.title: The Statistical Benefits of Multiple Responses for Learning from Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Many generative systems return multiple candidate responses and are evaluated according to the best one. Recent work shows that, when demonstrations are optimal, pass@$k$ can reduce the sample complexity of learning from demonstrations by a logarithmic factor in $k$. We ask what happens when the demonstrator is not assumed to be optimal. We find that multiple responses provide a qualitatively stronger benefit in this setting. In a finite reward-class model with no reward feedback, moving from pass@$1$ to any pass@$k$ with $k\ge2$ changes the worst-case dependence on target accuracy from $1/\varepsilon^2$ to $1/\varepsilon$, uniformly over demonstrator quality. Under standard evaluation, where an unknown reward is fixed before training, increasing $k$ provides an additional and distinct benefit: the optimal dependence on a reward class of size $N$ improves from $\log N$ to $\log N/\log k$. We further show that these two effects can be separated. Under robust evaluation, where one learned policy must compete with the demonstrator simultaneously for every reward in the class, the fast $1/\varepsilon$ dependence persists, while the $1/\log k$ improvement can disappear. We establish matching upper and lower bounds in the corresponding regimes and give a greedy multiplicative-weights learner achieving the upper bounds without any assumption on demonstrator quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在从示范中学习 (learning from demonstrations) 的理论分析中，证明多候选响应 (pass@$k$) 的收益取决于评估协议：有限奖励类、无奖励反馈下，从 pass@1 到任意 k≥2 把目标精度最坏依赖从 1/ε² 降到 1/ε，且对示范者质量一致成立；标准评估下奖励类规模 N 的依赖再从 log N 降到 log N/log k。鲁棒评估下 1/ε 保留而 1/log k 改进消失，并给出匹配上下界与贪心乘性权重学习器。
Motivation: 已有工作只在示范者最优的假设下证明 pass@$k$ 带来 log k 的样本复杂度对数级改进；示范者非最优时多响应的收益结构未知，且不同评估协议下收益是否可分离没有刻画。
Method: 在有限奖励类、无奖励反馈模型中分析 pass@$k$ 学习：区分标准评估（未知奖励在训练前固定）与鲁棒评估（一个策略须同时对类中每个奖励与示范者竞争），分别推导目标精度 ε 与奖励类规模 N 的匹配上下界，并构造一个不依赖示范者质量的贪心乘性权重 (greedy multiplicative-weights) 学习器达到上界。
Result: pass@1 → 任意 k≥2：最坏情形对 ε 的依赖由 1/ε² 变为 1/ε，且对示范者质量一致；标准评估下对奖励类规模 N 的最优依赖由 log N 改进为 log N/log k；鲁棒评估下 1/ε 快依赖保留，而 1/log k 改进可消失。各情形给出匹配的上下界。
Conclusion: 多响应的收益在示范者非最优时比先前认知更强，且 ε 与 N 两条改进通道可被评估协议分离：鲁棒评估只保留精度指数的提升，放弃 log k 的奖励类改进。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning to Sell: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Large Language Model Agents in Multi-Product Markets
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents operating in multi-product markets must make sequential decisions under information asymmetry and resource constraints. We develop a machine learning approach for training such agents to act effectively as sellers in a multi-item bargaining environment, where a seller concurrently negotiates a catalog of substitutable assets across a pool of independent buyers. Buyers hold private, heterogeneous valuations across products, and each can purchase at most one item. Facing limits on total communication turns, the seller must dynamically match buyers with the most profitable products considering their private valuations, while strategically allocating its limited interaction budget toward combinations of greater potential value. We formalize this problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process using a structured, four-part message protocol that maps natural language into a parsable and regulated decision space. Using this formalization, we design a post-training method using Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). To evaluate this framework, we construct a multidimensional metric suite that quantifies constraint adherence, seller surplus extraction, and allocation quality. Our trained seller agent learns to match limited inventory to buyers more effectively, matching or outperforming trillion-parameter frontier models in both seller surplus extraction and buyer-product allocation quality. Finally, these learned strategies generalize robustly to unseen market structures, correlated valuation distributions, and price ranges not encountered during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多商品议价卖家形式化为带四段式消息协议的 POMDP，用可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 后训练 LLM 卖家智能体，在总对话轮次受限下同时做买家-商品匹配与互动预算分配。训练后的智能体在卖方剩余提取与买方-商品分配质量上追平或超过万亿参数前沿模型，并能泛化到未见过的市场结构、相关估值分布与训练外价格区间。
Motivation: 多产品市场中的 LLM 卖家智能体需在信息不对称与通信轮次受限下做序贯决策，自然语言谈判空间难以直接优化，且缺少量化约束遵守、剩余提取与分配质量的评估口径。
Method: 将问题形式化为 POMDP，用结构化的四段式消息协议把自然语言映射为可解析、受约束的决策空间；在此基础上设计基于 RLVR 的后训练方法，并构建多维指标套件，分别度量约束遵守、卖方剩余提取与分配质量。
Result: 训练后的卖家智能体在卖方剩余提取和买方-商品分配质量两项指标上追平或超过万亿参数前沿模型；策略可泛化到未见过的市场结构、相关估值分布以及训练期间未出现的价格区间。
Conclusion: 在受限互动预算下，经 RLVR 后训练的中等规模 LLM 智能体足以学到有效的库存-买家匹配与议价策略，且不依赖前沿模型规模即可在该谈判设定中站住脚。

papers.title: Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images
papers.abstract_en: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Supplementary video is provided as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在全景图像的 episodic-memory 具身问答 (EM-EQA) 中，用 cubemap 投影把 equirectangular 图转成透视视角，靠微调后的 BLIP-2 估计与问题相关的视角相关性，再用 diversity-aware 贪心选出信息量高且多样的视角喂给 VLM。在 OpenEQA 的 HM3D 子集上达到已报告 equirectangular 结果中的 SOTA；去掉旋转视角、观测帧减少 65.5% 后答案准确率基本保持。
Motivation: equirectangular 全景图直接进 VLM 有两处硬伤：投影几何畸变压低识别准确率，且整幅图带入大量无关背景，既拉低答题准确率又推高 visual token 开销。
Method: 把 equirectangular 观测经 cubemap 投影转为多个透视视角；用微调的 BLIP-2 做 question-conditioned 相关性估计；再以 diversity-aware 贪心选择既信息丰富又彼此多样的视角输入 VLM 回答自由形式问题。
Result: 在 OpenEQA 的 HM3D 子集上，模型性能达到已报告 equirectangular 观测结果中的 state-of-the-art；移除旋转视角、观测帧数减少 65.5% 后，答案准确率基本维持。
Conclusion: 对全景 EM-EQA，按问题选视角并保证多样性，可以在大幅削减观测帧与视觉 token 的同时保住答题准确率，比直接喂 equirectangular 全图更划算。

papers.title: Feedback Makes Perfect: A Closed-Loop Framework for NL-to-STL Translation
papers.abstract_en: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) enables rigorous verification and control of cyber-physical systems, but writing correct specifications requires expertise that most requirement holders lack. Large language models can translate natural-language (NL) requirements into STL, yet stronger translators alone approach an accuracy ceiling. We argue that this ceiling stems from how the task is posed: one-shot, open-loop translation is somewhat ill-defined. Natural language is ambiguous, and, more fundamentally, what a person writes may not always be what they intend, so the target specification is not fully contained in the input text. We therefore reformulate NL-to-STL translation as a closed-loop feedback process. Each generated formula is translated back into natural language for the user to check, and natural-language corrections drive revision until the user accepts the specification. Users never read or write formal syntax. This framework rests on an asymmetry familiar from feedback control theory. The forward path, from ambiguous language to formal logic, is hard and error-prone. The feedback path, from structured STL back to language, can be made highly precise, and a precise feedback path lets an imprecise forward path achieve precise closed-loop behavior. Experiments on 500 expert-authored requirements and seven LLMs support this view. Back-translated explanations agree with expert judgments in 99.5\% of cases. Closed-loop refinement raises strong models from about 89\% open-loop accuracy to 98.0--99.2\%, and yields gains of over 30 percentage points for weaker models (e.g., 17.6\%$\rightarrow$48.0\%). Ablations show these gains come from the semantic content of the feedback rather than from repeated attempts. An expert audit and a 280-session user study further confirm the reliability of the loop. We also identify a capability threshold above which feedback no longer helps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自然语言到 Signal Temporal Logic (STL) 的翻译从一次性开环改为闭环反馈：每条生成的公式反译回自然语言供用户核对，用户用自然语言修正驱动改写，直到接受为止，用户全程不读写形式语法。在 500 条专家需求与七个 LLM 上，闭环把强模型从约 89% 开环准确率提到 98.0–99.2%，弱模型提升超 30 个百分点（如 17.6%→48.0%），反译解释与专家判断一致率达 99.5%。
Motivation: NL-to-STL 翻译被表述成一次性开环任务时存在准确率天花板：自然语言本身有歧义，且用户写下的话未必等于其意图，目标公式并不完全包含在输入文本里，单纯换更强的翻译模型无法突破。
Method: 闭环框架：LLM 生成 STL 公式后反译成自然语言交给用户检查，用户的自然语言修正作为反馈驱动迭代改写，直到用户接受；依据反馈控制理论的不对称性——前向路径（模糊语言到形式逻辑）难且易错，反馈路径（STL 到语言）可做得很精确。另做消融区分反馈语义与重复尝试的贡献，并配合专家审计与 280 场次用户研究。
Result: 在 500 条专家撰写需求、七个 LLM 上：反译解释与专家判断 99.5% 一致；闭环精化把强模型从约 89% 开环准确率提到 98.0–99.2%；弱模型提升超 30 个百分点，例 17.6%→48.0%；消融显示增益来自反馈的语义内容而非重复尝试；另有 280 场次用户研究与专家审计，并识别出一个反馈不再有帮助的能力阈值。
Conclusion: NL-to-STL 的瓶颈在任务的开环设定而非模型能力：让精确的反馈路径去校正不精确的前向路径，就能把闭环行为做到精确，但模型超过某个能力阈值后反馈不再带来增益。

papers.title: InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfoEdit 提出信息图编辑基准，含 1,000 张信息图、八类逻辑关系、4,000 条编辑指令与四项编辑任务，并配套 reflow-aware 评测协议。八个前沿编辑器中仅 GPT-Image-2 平均成功率超过 60%，多数低于 7%，Swap-Block 任务即使目标定位完美也无一超过 36%。
Motivation: 多模态模型能生产级编辑自然照片，但对信息图这类靠逻辑关系组织的结构化视觉内容力不从心；现有图像编辑基准既无结构化内容专用设定，也不评测编辑一个元素后周围元素随之调整的全局布局推理能力（reflow）。
Method: 构建 InfoEdit 基准：1,000 张信息图覆盖八个逻辑关系族，配 4,000 条编辑指令、四类编辑任务，并设计 reflow-aware 评测协议；在八个前沿编辑器上评测，同时对比像素级编辑与代码级编辑 (code-level editing) 两条路径。
Result: 八个前沿编辑器中仅 GPT-Image-2 平均成功率超过 60%，多数模型低于 7%；Swap-Block 任务即使目标定位完美，无一编辑器成功率超过 36%；代码级编辑在部分任务上可匹敌最强像素级编辑器，两类方法在不同任务上互补。
Conclusion: reflow（编辑一处后全局布局随之调整）是结构化视觉内容编辑的核心难点，InfoEdit 可作为诊断该能力的基准；代码级与像素级编辑各有强项，宜按任务互补选用。

papers.title: RINI: Seeing the Prior Is Not Enough
papers.abstract_en: A research proposal can describe an established mechanism correctly while claiming to introduce it. We study whether providing the earlier paper corrects such contribution claims. Three controlled experiments compare proposals generated with a contribution-bearing prior and a same-topic control. Providing the prior yields no clear aggregate reduction in unsupported novelty. Human analysis of 175 interpretable exposed proposals finds that 137 recognize the prior's relevance, but 61 correctly attribute the established contribution. Of 71 proposed remaining distinctions, 37 are covered by the same prior. We introduce Research Idea Novelty Inspection (RINI), which audits contribution claims against evidence, checks the remaining distinction, and applies local revisions. Five human annotators evaluate 1,080 original-revision pairs across three methods. On the same 240 originals judged to require correction, successful repair is 11.7% for Self-Revision, 39.1% for Retrieve-and-Revise, and 72.2% for RINI, with research tasks weighted equally. The improvement over same-evidence direct revision is 33.0 percentage points. The revised proposals retain their research questions and technical methods. These results motivate explicit contribution attribution when using literature to generate and revise research proposals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验「把前作给生成模型能否纠正研究计划 (research proposal) 的贡献声明」：三组对照实验显示提供前作并未整体降低无依据的新颖性声明。据此提出 RINI（Research Idea Novelty Inspection），对贡献声明做证据审计、核查剩余差异并局部修订；在同一批 240 份需修正的原始计划上，5 位标注者评 1,080 组原文-修订对，修复成功率 Self-Revision 11.7%、Retrieve-and-Revise 39.1%、RINI 72.2%，比同证据直接修订高 33.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 研究计划可能在正确描述既有机制的同时声称自己首次提出它；仅把前作放进上下文并不能稳定纠正这类贡献声明，需要可审计的归因与修订流程。
Method: 先做三组对照实验，比较含贡献的前作与同主题对照两种条件下生成的计划；对 175 份可解读的暴露计划做人工分析。再提出 RINI：审计贡献声明与证据的对应、核查剩余差异 (remaining distinction)、执行局部修订 (local revisions)，并与 Self-Revision、Retrieve-and-Revise 两种方法对照，由 5 位标注者评估 1,080 组原文-修订对，研究任务等权。
Result: 提供前作未带来无依据新颖性声明的整体下降。175 份可解读暴露计划中 137 份承认前作相关，仅 61 份正确归因既有贡献；71 项声称的剩余差异中 37 项已被同一前作覆盖。在同一批 240 份判定需修正的原始计划上，修复成功率 Self-Revision 11.7%、Retrieve-and-Revise 39.1%、RINI 72.2%，RINI 相对同证据直接修订提升 33.0 个百分点，且修订后保留原研究问题与技术方法。

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Comparative Scale Construction for Efficient Personalized Subjective Judgment in High-Traffic Applications
papers.abstract_en: Subjective judgments are central to many high-traffic applications, but subjective intensity is difficult to quantify and perceptions vary substantially across individuals. To address these challenges, we propose a pairwise comparative framework for multi-dimensional scale construction. By comparing case-person pairs along case and profile dimensions, the framework constructs relative scales that capture both fine-grained intensity and individual variation. To support practical high-traffic deployment, we optimize both offline scale construction and online inference. For scale construction, we combine sparse Elo comparisons with multi-judge voting, cutting the comparison cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(NK)$ for $N$ objects and a budget of $K$ opponents per object, while limiting reliance on any single judge. For inference, we propose SubJudge, a System One model for personalized scoring with Batchwise Preference Optimization (BPO). Using Bradley-Terry comparisons, BPO trains the model to learn relative orderings, and SubJudge reads a continuous score from digit-token probabilities at the first response position, requiring only one forward pass per criterion and reducing the inference complexity to $O(1)$. Experiments on PluriHarms and iNews show that our 9B models match or surpass the evaluated frontier LLMs on multiple metrics. On the H100 GPU, SubJudge achieves an approximately $1.29\times$ to $261\times$ speedup in mean inference latency over Qwen3.5-9B with different thinking budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/SubJudge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多维比较式量表构建框架：用 case-person 成对比较生成同时刻画细粒度强度与个体差异的相对量表，并以稀疏 Elo 比较加多评委投票把构建成本从 O(N²) 降到 O(NK)。推理端的 SubJudge 用 Batchwise Preference Optimization (BPO) 基于 Bradley-Terry 比较训练，从首位 token 的 digit-token 概率直接读出连续分数，单次前向、复杂度 O(1)；在 PluriHarms 与 iNews 上 9B 模型匹敌或超过所评测的前沿 LLM，H100 上相对 Qwen3.5-9B 的平均推理延迟加速约 1.29× 至 261×。
Motivation: 高流量应用中的主观判断难以量化主观强度，且不同个体感知差异大；直接两两比较的量表构建代价为 O(N²)，逐条推理的在线打分开销也难以支撑高并发部署。
Method: 沿 case 与 profile 两个维度比较 case-person 对，构建兼顾细粒度强度与个体差异的相对量表；离线端用稀疏 Elo 比较加多评委投票，每个对象只比 K 个对手以限制对单一评委的依赖。在线端提出 SubJudge（System One 模型），用基于 Bradley-Terry 比较的 Batchwise Preference Optimization (BPO) 学习相对次序，从第一个响应位置的 digit-token 概率读出连续分数，每个准则只需一次前向。
Result: 在 PluriHarms 与 iNews 上，9B 模型在多个指标上匹敌或超过所评测的前沿 LLM；H100 上 SubJudge 相对 Qwen3-9B（不同 thinking budget）平均推理延迟加速约 1.29× 至 261×。量表构建比较成本由 O(N²) 降为 O(NK)，在线推理复杂度降为 O(1)。
Conclusion: 把主观打分改写成比较式量表加单次前向的分数读取，可在保持与前沿 LLM 相当的多指标表现的同时，把高流量场景的构建与推理开销压到可部署量级。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Text Beside the Image: Detection, Utility and Leakage for Trustworthy Multimodal Medical Data and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Medical images are released with the reports that describe them, and protecting the image does not protect the report. This paper measures the text component of such releases. We measure identifier detection, downstream utility and residual identity leakage on the same documents, with the pseudonymisation policy as the variable under test: 15 detectors, three release conditions and four corpora of medical reports, legal judgments, news and other genres, and e-mail, in German, English, Chinese and Arabic. A fixed 13-detector union reaches a person sensitivity of 0.9998 at specificity 0.8686 on the medical reports, 0.9958 at 0.8504 on the legal judgments, 0.9352 at 0.9318 on news and other genres, and 0.9906 at 0.6235 on e-mail. With this ensemble, frequency matching with a public name list recovers zero identities by alignment across the four corpora; the names it got right were ones the detector missed, left in clear text. Cross-document linkage ranks the correct person first for 0.93% of e-mail queries without training and 3.94% with it, against 1/3697 chance and 71.98% on unmodified text. On the medical reports it recovers nothing without training and 0.71% of 138 queries with it, against 1/207 chance and a 2.73% ceiling on unmodified text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文在同一批文档上同时测量医疗影像随附报告等文本发布的标识符检测、下游效用与残余身份泄露，把伪名化策略作为被测变量。13 检测器固定并集在医疗报告上达到敏感度 0.9998、特异度 0.8686；用公开姓名表做频率对齐在四个语料上恢复出 0 个身份，而跨文档链接在未修改文本上仍能以 71.98%（邮件）与 2.73%（医疗报告）命中正确人物。
Motivation: 医疗影像发布时随附的报告本身含标识符，只保护图像并不保护文本；需要在同一组文档上量化检测覆盖、效用保留与残余身份泄露，以判断伪名化策略是否真的有效。
Method: 以伪名化策略为自变量，比较 15 个检测器、3 种发布条件与 4 个语料（医疗报告、法律判决、新闻及其他体裁、电子邮件），覆盖德、英、中、阿四种语言；固定 13 检测器并集做标识符检测，并用公开姓名表做频率对齐与跨文档链接攻击，含无训练与有训练两种设置。
Result: 13 检测器并集在医疗报告上敏感度 0.9998/特异度 0.8686，法律判决 0.9958/0.8504，新闻及其他 0.9352/0.9318，电子邮件 0.9906/0.6235。频率对齐在四语料上恢复 0 个身份，其命中的是检测器漏掉的明文姓名。跨文档链接对邮件查询正确人物排第一的比例为无训练 0.93%、有训练 3.94%（随机 1/3697，未修改文本 71.98%）；医疗报告上无训练为 0、有训练 0.71%（138 个查询，随机 1/207，未修改文本上限 2.73%）。
Conclusion: 伪名化策略下检测器并集能高敏感度抓标识符，频率对齐攻击失效，但跨文档链接在有训练时仍能部分恢复身份，且未修改文本的链接风险远高于伪名化后。

papers.title: Domain Generalization under Sampling Pattern Shifts in Irregular Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series (ISMTS) are prevalent in real-world applications, where both observation times and available measurements can vary substantially across domains. While recent models increasingly exploit such sampling information for prediction, its robustness under sampling pattern shifts remains underexplored. We introduce HAR-C, to the best of our knowledge the first controlled benchmark for sampling pattern shifts in ISMTS, and show that sampling shifts alone can substantially degrade performance, induce sampling-specific shortcuts, and remain challenging for existing domain generalization (DG) methods. Motivated by these findings, we propose PRISM, a DG framework that first learns complementary feature-centric and sampling-centric representations without task labels, and subsequently performs robust supervised training across diverse sampling variations to discourage brittle shortcut reliance. Extensive experiments on controlled and real-world ISMTS benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently improves robustness to unseen sampling shifts over existing methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PRISM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对不规则采样多变量时间序列 (ISMTS) 在采样模式偏移下的域泛化问题，提出首个受控基准 HAR-C，证明仅采样模式变化就足以显著降低预测性能并诱发采样捷径。据此提出 PRISM：先无标签学习特征中心与采样中心的互补表示，再跨多样采样变化做鲁棒监督训练，在受控与真实 ISMTS 基准上对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性一致优于现有域泛化方法。
Motivation: ISMTS 的观测时刻与可用变量跨域变化大，现有模型虽利用采样信息做预测，但采样模式偏移下的鲁棒性研究不足，且现有域泛化 (DG) 方法在此类偏移上表现不佳。
Method: 先构建受控基准 HAR-C 隔离采样模式偏移；PRISM 框架分两阶段：无任务标签下学习互补的 feature-centric 与 sampling-centric 表示，随后在多样采样变化上做鲁棒监督训练以抑制对脆弱捷径的依赖。
Result: HAR-C 显示仅采样偏移即可显著降低性能、诱发采样特定捷径，且现有 DG 方法难以应对；在受控与真实 ISMTS 基准上，PRISM 对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 采样模式本身是 ISMTS 预测中被低估的偏移源，需通过解耦特征与采样表示并跨采样变化训练来获得对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性。

summary_sections.motivation: ISMTS 的观测时刻与可用变量跨域变化大，现有模型虽利用采样信息做预测，但采样模式偏移下的鲁棒性研究不足，且现有域泛化 (DG) 方法在此类偏移上表现不佳。
summary_sections.method: 先构建受控基准 HAR-C 隔离采样模式偏移；PRISM 框架分两阶段：无任务标签下学习互补的 feature-centric 与 sampling-centric 表示，随后在多样采样变化上做鲁棒监督训练以抑制对脆弱捷径的依赖。
summary_sections.result: HAR-C 显示仅采样偏移即可显著降低性能、诱发采样特定捷径，且现有 DG 方法难以应对；在受控与真实 ISMTS 基准上，PRISM 对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性一致优于现有方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 采样模式本身是 ISMTS 预测中被低估的偏移源，需通过解耦特征与采样表示并跨采样变化训练来获得对未见采样偏移的鲁棒性。

papers.title: ChronoFlow: Hierarchical Flow Matching for Irregular Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative modeling have substantially improved time series generation, yet most existing methods either assume a regular temporal grid or focus on feature dynamics under a given sampling structure. This makes them illsuited for generating irregular time series in their native form, where a model must capture not only feature values, but also how many observations occur, when they occur, and which features are observed together. To address this heterogeneous generation problem, we propose ChronoFlow, a unified hierarchical flow matching framework organized by statistical granularity. Following a coarse-to-fine hierarchy, ChronoFlow first generates observation counts and feature-wise frequencies, then jointly generates observation times and feature co-observation patterns, and finally generates values conditioned on the realized pattern. This turns a complex joint generation problem into structurally aligned subproblems while preserving their dependencies. To evaluate complete irregular time series generation, we introduce complementary metrics spanning sample realism, sampling structure, value fidelity, and temporal and cross-feature dependencies, and validate them through controlled corruptions. Across five benchmarks, ChronoFlow achieves strong improvements in generation fidelity over existing baselines, while factorization studies support the proposed hierarchy. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ChronoFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoFlow 用按统计粒度分层的 flow matching 生成原生形态的不规则时间序列：先生成观测计数与逐特征频率，再联合生成观测时刻与特征共观测模式，最后在已实现模式条件下生成数值。在五个基准上生成保真度相对现有基线显著提升，因子化研究支持该层级分解。
Motivation: 现有生成方法要么假设规则时间网格，要么只在给定采样结构下建模特征动态，无法生成原生不规则时间序列——即同时决定观测数量、发生时刻与哪些特征被共同观测。
Method: 提出统一的层级 flow matching 框架 ChronoFlow，按 coarse-to-fine 顺序分解联合生成问题：先生成观测计数与逐特征频率，再联合生成观测时刻与特征共观测模式，最后以已实现模式为条件生成数值，从而在拆分子问题的同时保留其依赖。另提出覆盖样本真实性、采样结构、数值保真度、时间与跨特征依赖的互补指标，并用受控破坏 (controlled corruptions) 验证这些指标。
Result: 在五个基准上，ChronoFlow 的生成保真度相对现有基线取得显著提升；因子化研究 (factorization studies) 支持所提出的层级分解；新指标的有效性通过受控破坏实验验证。
Conclusion: 把不规则时间序列的联合生成按统计粒度拆成计数、时刻/共观测模式、数值三个层级子问题，能在保持依赖的同时提升生成保真度。

papers.title: Modelling non-linear aeroelastic loads in long-span bridges with extreme learning machines
papers.abstract_en: Accurate modelling of aerodynamic loads is essential for predicting instabilities and ensuring the safety of long-span bridges. A methodology is introduced for modelling aerodynamic self-excited forces in bridge-deck cross-sections using extreme learning machines (ELMs). ELMs, as single-layer feedforward neural networks, offer efficient training and accurate predictions. Forced-oscillation datasets from computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or wind-tunnel experiments are used for training, enabling systematic data selection to capture non-linear aerodynamic behaviour often missed by semi-analytical approaches. Once trained, the model predicts self-excited loads for any arbitrary motion composed by frequencies and amplitudes within the training domain. Comparisons with analytical, semi-analytical, and CFD results show superior accuracy in capturing non-linear force components and close agreement for aerodynamic loads and flutter wind speeds. Training required about 1.1\% of the time of a conventional neural network, and coupled flutter analysis runs in seconds, providing orders-of-magnitude speed-ups over CFD. These results indicate that ELM-based frameworks are accurate, practical, and efficient alternatives for modelling self-excited loads, particularly when preliminary CFD or wind-tunnel data are available. The presented approach offers a reliable data-driven technique for aeroelastic load modelling in long-span bridges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用极端学习机 (ELM) 单层前馈网络从强迫振动 CFD 或风洞数据学习桥梁断面气动自激力，训练完成后可预测训练域内任意频率与幅值组合运动的自激荷载。相比常规神经网络训练耗时仅约 1.1%，耦合颤振分析秒级完成，相对 CFD 有数量级加速，且在非线性力分量与颤振风速上更贴近解析、半解析与 CFD 参照。
Motivation: 长跨桥梁气动荷载预测关乎失稳与安全，半解析方法常漏掉非线性气动行为，而 CFD 与风洞分析成本高、耗时长，需要在保留精度的同时大幅降低计算代价。
Method: 以单层前馈 ELM 建模气动自激力，训练数据来自 CFD 或风洞的强迫振动数据集，通过系统性数据选取覆盖非线性气动行为；训练后模型对训练域内任意频率与幅值组合的运动输出自激荷载，并接入耦合颤振分析。
Result: 与解析、半解析及 CFD 结果比较，ELM 在捕捉非线性力分量上精度更优，气动荷载与颤振风速吻合紧密；训练耗时约为常规神经网络的 1.1%，耦合颤振分析秒级完成，相对 CFD 达数量级加速。
Conclusion: 在已有初步 CFD 或风洞数据的前提下，ELM 框架可作为气动自激力建模的精确、实用且高效的替代方案，用于长跨桥梁的气动弹性荷载分析。

papers.title: Towards Identifiable Representations under Misspecified Structure
papers.abstract_en: The presence of noise that depends on the latent variables poses a fundamental challenge to identifiability. Existing results rely on conditional independence among the observations given the latent variables. We study a more general \emph{misspecified structure}, where this conditional factorization does not hold, and establish both precise and approximate identifiability guarantees. We characterize structural misspecification as a perturbed factor analysis problem. For precise identifiability, we establish subspace identifiability under spectral separation and controlled perturbation, followed by component-wise identifiability under structural sparsity. When the precise condition is not guaranteed, we derive an approximate subspace-identifiability theorem. Based on these results, we develop an unsupervised variational estimator for recovering latent variables. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在潜变量相关噪声破坏观测条件独立的 misspecified structure 下，把结构失配刻画为扰动因子分析 (perturbed factor analysis)，并给出子空间与分量两级可识别性条件：谱分离加受控扰动保证精确子空间可识别，结构稀疏进一步保证分量可识别，条件不满足时退化为近似子空间可识别定理。据此构造无监督变分估计器恢复潜变量，实验表明该框架有效。
Motivation: 潜变量依赖的噪声使现有依赖条件独立假设的可识别性结论失效，需要在条件分解不成立时仍能给出可识别性保证。
Method: 将结构失配建模为扰动因子分析问题；先在谱分离与受控扰动下证子空间可识别，再在结构稀疏下推进到分量级可识别，并推导近似子空间可识别定理；基于这些结果设计无监督变分估计器恢复潜变量。
Result: 得到精确与近似两类可识别性保证：谱分离加受控扰动下子空间可识别，结构稀疏下分量可识别，精确条件不成立时给出近似子空间可识别定理；实验展示所提框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 条件独立并非可识别性的必要前提，把 misspecified structure 视为受控扰动即可同时支撑精确与近似的可识别性结论，并落地为无监督变分估计。

papers.title: Next Thoughts Are Distributions: Generative Autoregressive Reasoning in the Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning problems often admit multiple valid ways to proceed. Continuous reasoning promises to move computation beyond language tokens into a more compact latent space, but representing several plausible ways to think next remains difficult. We introduce Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF), which models the next continuous thought as a multimodal distribution. A causal autoregressive model performs the reasoning computation, while a lightweight diffusion head generates a plausible next thought from the resulting condition. The sampled thought is fed back into the model, allowing continuous reasoning to unfold for a variable number of steps while preserving the pretrained backbone. Across mathematical reasoning tasks, ATF improves accuracy with compact latent traces and benefits from reinforcement learning and additional test-time thinking. Multi-sample evaluation shows broader solution coverage, indicating that its multimodal predictions capture useful diversity among reasoning paths. Our results suggest that continuous reasoning is more effective when multiple possible next thoughts remain available rather than being collapsed into a single prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATF 把连续推理中的“下一个 thought”建模为多模态分布而非单点：因果自回归模型给出条件，轻量 diffusion head 采样出一个 plausible next thought 并回喂主干，使连续推理可变步数展开且保留预训练 backbone。在数学推理任务上 ATF 以紧凑 latent trace 提升准确率，并从强化学习与额外 test-time thinking 中继续获益；多样本评测显示解覆盖更广，说明多模态预测确实捕捉到推理路径间的有用多样性。
Motivation: 连续推理把计算从语言 token 移入更紧凑的 latent 空间，但同一问题常有多种合法的下一步，单一 latent 预测会把这种分支性压扁，难以表示多个 plausible 的思考方向。
Method: 提出 Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF)：因果自回归模型执行推理计算并输出条件，轻量 diffusion head 在该条件下生成 plausible 的下一个连续 thought；采样得到的 thought 回喂模型，使连续推理以可变步数展开，同时保持预训练 backbone 不变。训练与推理可结合强化学习和额外 test-time thinking。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，ATF 用紧凑 latent trace 提升准确率，且受益于强化学习与更多 test-time thinking；多样本评测显示解的覆盖更广，表明其多模态预测在推理路径之间捕捉到有用多样性。
Conclusion: 连续推理在保留多个可能的下一步（而非塌缩为单一预测）时更有效；ATF 用“自回归条件 + diffusion 采样”的分工实现这一点，并保持 backbone 预训练能力。

papers.title: Structured Sparse Memory for Recurrent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent models trained from scratch have recently become competitive on ARC-style reasoning tasks, but the usual framing around small recurrent backbones overlooks two important parts of the system: task-conditioned memory and synthetic augmentation data. We study this regime through CHARM, a compact hybrid ARC model that combines recurrent reasoning with structured task memory, synthetic data, and inference-time aggregation. In existing approaches, task-conditioned memory supplies a large hidden source of capacity, reaching more than 30x the size of the recurrent backbone. We introduce a compositional sparse embedding (CoSE) for task conditioning that reduces learned task-memory parameters by over 90% while improving pass@2 in controlled ARC ablations. For the recurrent backbone, recurrent depth helps only when balanced with learning horizon. Combining these ingredients, our system reaches 84% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 and 46.7% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation. The benefits of structured memory also generalize to unseen puzzles and other domains. Our code, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/water-vapor/charm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CHARM：把循环推理骨干与结构化任务记忆、合成数据、推理时聚合组合的紧凑混合 ARC 模型，其中 compositional sparse embedding (CoSE) 用于任务条件化。CoSE 把学习式任务记忆参数量削减 90% 以上，同时在受控 ARC 消融中提高 pass@2；系统在 ARC-AGI-1 公开评测达 84% pass@2，ARC-AGI-2 达 46.7% pass@2。
Motivation: 从零训练的循环模型在 ARC 类推理上已有竞争力，但常见讨论只盯着小型循环骨干，忽略了任务条件化记忆与合成增强数据两部分；现有方法中任务记忆的隐性容量可达循环骨干的 30 倍以上。
Method: 以 CHARM 为实验载体：循环推理骨干 + 结构化任务记忆 + 合成数据 + 推理时聚合；任务条件化用 compositional sparse embedding (CoSE)，并做受控 ARC 消融，考察循环深度与学习视野 (learning horizon) 的平衡。
Result: CoSE 使学习式任务记忆参数量减少 90% 以上，且在受控 ARC 消融中 pass@2 提升；既有方法的任务记忆容量可达循环骨干的 30 倍以上；组合各要素后 ARC-AGI-1 公开评测 pass@2 为 84%，ARC-AGI-2 为 46.7%。
Conclusion: 结构化稀疏任务记忆可以在大幅压缩参数的同时不损失（反而提升）ARC 推理表现，并能泛化到未见过的谜题与其他领域；循环深度只有与学习视野匹配时才有收益。

summary_sections.motivation: 从零训练的循环模型在 ARC 类推理上已有竞争力，但常见讨论只盯着小型循环骨干，忽略了任务条件化记忆与合成增强数据两部分；现有方法中任务记忆的隐性容量可达循环骨干的 30 倍以上。
summary_sections.method: 以 CHARM 为实验载体：循环推理骨干 + 结构化任务记忆 + 合成数据 + 推理时聚合；任务条件化用 compositional sparse embedding (CoSE)，并做受控 ARC 消融，考察循环深度与学习视野 (learning horizon) 的平衡。
summary_sections.result: CoSE 使学习式任务记忆参数量减少 90% 以上，且在受控 ARC 消融中 pass@2 提升；既有方法的任务记忆容量可达循环骨干的 30 倍以上；组合各要素后 ARC-AGI-1 公开评测 pass@2 为 84%，ARC-AGI-2 为 46.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结构化稀疏任务记忆可以在大幅压缩参数的同时不损失（反而提升）ARC 推理表现，并能泛化到未见过的谜题与其他领域；循环深度只有与学习视野匹配时才有收益。

papers.title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-WAM 把机器人 World Action Model 的权重量化到 4-bit，用 Action Observability Gramian 度量舍入误差经全部去噪步对最终动作的影响，只把最动作敏感的少量通道组合放进 16-bit 低秩分支。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 89.6–93.0%，距 16-bit 模型仅 1.1 个百分点，量化块内存降 3.1–3.4×，比 SVDQuant 高 2.5–8.7 个百分点。
Motivation: WAM 用迭代扩散同时生成视频与机器人动作，算力和内存开销极大；现有 PTQ 的 smoothing 与 rotation 方法无法保住动作生成精度，导致部署受限。
Method: 提出 Action Observability Gramian (AOG)，度量某层输入通道各加权组合的舍入误差经全部去噪步改变最终动作的程度；Action-Subspace Protection (ASP) 把最动作敏感的少数通道组合保留在 16-bit 低秩分支，其余权重量化为 4-bit，两者均为 GPU 上高效的稠密矩阵乘；再按跨层聚合的 AOG action mass 选出最重要的 expert，仅对这些 expert 施加 ASP。
Result: 在三个 WAM 上评估，覆盖仿真与真实部署。RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 89.6–93.0%，与 16-bit 模型相差 1.1 个百分点以内，量化块内存降低 3.1–3.4×；比最强基线 SVDQuant 高 2.5–8.7 个百分点。在 Unitree G1 人形与双臂 UR3 机器人上，成功率比 SVDQuant 高 12.8–17.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 按动作敏感度选择性保护子空间，可以在 4-bit 权重量化下基本保住 WAM 的动作生成精度，同时大幅压缩内存并保持 GPU 上的稠密乘法效率。

papers.title: LSTMem: Hierarchical Long Short-Term Online Memory for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly serve as long-horizon assistants and agents, where they must both accumulate information across interactions and make the relevant parts available when later requests depend on them. Existing compact online memories typically use a single persistent state both to accumulate history and to serve readout, so what the memory stores cannot be controlled separately from what it exposes to the current computation. We propose LSTMem, an LSTM-inspired online memory that instead equips each layer of a frozen LLM with two matrix-valued states: a cell state that accumulates history and a hidden state whose readouts correct the backbone's attention. Input and forget gates control what the cell stores, while an output gate separately controls what the cell exposes through the hidden state. LSTMem further connects memory across depth through forward hidden-state propagation and block-end feedback, and uses higher-layer reconstruction gradients to refine lower-layer cell states before rebuilding hidden states from shallow to deep layers. Across memory benchmarks on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, LSTMem consistently improves MemoryAgentBench, LoCoMo, and HotpotQA over the plain backbone. Comparisons further show that the LSTM-based memory formulation outperforms an associative-memory counterpart, while removing cross-layer hidden-memory propagation degrades performance. These results demonstrate the benefits of separating memory accumulation from memory expression and organizing memory hierarchically across model depth. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/LSTMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LSTMem 为冻结 LLM 的每层配两个矩阵态：cell state 累积历史、hidden state 的读出校正 backbone 注意力，用输入/遗忘门控制存什么、输出门单独控制暴露什么。在 Qwen3-4B-Infect 上一致提升 MemoryAgentBench、LoCoMo、HotpotQA，且优于联想记忆 (associative memory) 对照，去掉跨层 hidden 传播会变差。
Motivation: 现有紧凑在线记忆用单一持久态同时承担累积与读出，存什么与暴露给当前计算的内容无法分开控制，跨交互的长程助手/agent 场景下记忆组织受限。
Method: LSTMem 受 LSTM 启发，为冻结 LLM 每层维护矩阵值 cell state 与 hidden state，输入门与遗忘门管写入、输出门管读出，hidden 读出用于修正 backbone 注意力；跨深度用 forward hidden-state propagation 与 block-end feedback 连接，并用高层重构梯度先精修低层 cell state，再由浅到深重建 hidden state。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 上，LSTMem 相对原始 backbone 一致提升 MemoryAgentBench、LoCoMo 与 HotpotQA 三个记忆基准；对比中 LSTM 式记忆表述优于联想记忆 (associative-memory) 对照，移除跨层 hidden 记忆传播会使性能下降。
Conclusion: 把记忆累积与记忆表达分离、并按模型深度分层组织记忆，对冻结 LLM 的在线记忆有效；跨层 hidden 传播是该设计的必要组成。

papers.title: SCISSOR: Score-Conditioned Instrument Source Separation for Orchestral Recordings
papers.abstract_en: Orchestral separation recovers instrument sections from mixtures in which shared pitches, harmonics, and timbres obscure source identity. An aligned score provides instrument labels, note pitches, and activity times. A score-informed approach appends piano rolls to audio features before mask prediction. We introduce SCISSOR (Score-Conditioned Instrument Source Separation for Orchestral Recordings), which uses the score to form a frame-wise query for each source. Each query matches a shared audio representation, and a softmax over instrument and background slots jointly assigns overlapping time-frequency evidence. The queries retain instrument identity even when notes are missing from the score. After training on SynthSOD and a small set of URMP and PHENICX-Anechoic recordings, SCISSOR achieves the highest average SDR on held-out real recordings. With SynthSOD-only training, it leads on SynthSOD and zero-shot PHENICX-Anechoic, and improves on its audio-only control on zero-shot URMP. SCISSOR also degrades less under score corruption than the evaluated score-based baselines.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCISSOR 用对齐乐谱为每个声部生成逐帧 query，去匹配共享音频表征，再用覆盖乐器与背景槽位的 softmax 联合分配重叠时频证据，从而在共享音高与音色下分离管弦乐声部。在 SynthSOD 训练并以少量 URMP、PHENICX-Anechoic 微调后，它在留出真实录音上取得最高平均 SDR；仅用 SynthSOD 训练时在 SynthSOD 与零样本 PHENICX-Anechoic 上领先，并在零样本 URMP 上优于纯音频对照，乐谱损坏下退化也小于所评估的乐谱基线。
Motivation: 管弦乐分离中共享音高、泛音与音色掩盖声部身份；已有乐谱引导做法只是把 piano roll 拼到音频特征后预测掩码，且乐谱缺失音符时身份易丢。
Method: SCISSOR 由乐谱（乐器标签、音高、活动时间）构造每个源的逐帧 query，query 与共享音频表征匹配，用覆盖乐器与背景槽位的 softmax 联合分配重叠时频证据；query 在乐谱缺音符时仍保留乐器身份。训练数据为 SynthSOD 加少量 URMP 与 PHENICX-Anechoic 录音。
Result: 在留出真实录音上取得最高平均 SDR；仅用 SynthSOD 训练时在 SynthSOD 与零样本 PHENICX-Anechoic 上领先，并在零样本 URMP 上改进其纯音频对照；在乐谱损坏 (score corruption) 下退化小于所评估的乐谱基线。
Conclusion: 以乐谱生成逐帧 query 而非拼接 piano roll，能在乐谱不完美时仍保持声部身份，分离质量与抗乐谱损坏性同时优于所评估的乐谱基线。

papers.title: VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VehDyn 是面向车辆动力学的驾驶世界模型基准：在 CARLA-CarSim 共仿真上做全因子设计，生成 10,080 组配置并同步记录位置、速度、姿态真值，用分层评测衡量轨迹对齐、运动学一致性与动力学一致性。12 个 SOTA 视频世界模型中 10 个轨迹误差在真值 20% 以内，但没有一个模型在动力学一致性上达到真值的 92%，且视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关。
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型基准只看视觉保真度与粗粒度物理合理性，无法判断生成的驾驶未来是否服从真实车辆运动学与动力学；同时缺少能独立控制车辆、道路、机动与速度条件且同步记录车辆状态真值的数据集。
Method: 基于 CARLA-CarSim 共仿真平台（真实感渲染耦合经验证的多体动力学模型），对 5 种车型、4 个轮胎-路面摩擦系数、3 种机动、4 个目标速度、14 个场景、3 种光照做全因子设计，得到 10,080 组配置，每组配同步的位置、速度、姿态序列；在其上构建分层评测框架（轨迹对齐、运动学一致性、动力学一致性），并用两套既有协议评测视频质量后与 VehDyn 分数做相关性分析。
Result: 基准含 10,080 组配置，覆盖 5 种车型、4 个摩擦系数、3 种机动、4 个目标速度、14 个场景、3 种光照；评测 12 个 SOTA 视频世界模型。轨迹级指标接近饱和，12 个模型中 10 个在真值 20% 以内；动力学一致性上没有模型达到真值的 92%；视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关。DrivingWorld 的 VehDyn 分数最高，其后是 Cosmos 3 Nano 与 LTX-Video 2.5，VehDyn 分数与人类判断高度一致。
Conclusion: 轨迹级指标已不足以区分驾驶世界模型，动力学一致性才是当前模型的共同短板；视觉质量好不等于车辆动力学保真，评测应转向 VehDyn 这类分层动力学指标。
Relevance: 3
