summary_sections.conclusion: 轨迹级指标已不足以区分驾驶世界模型，动力学一致性才是当前模型的共同短板；视觉质量好不等于车辆动力学保真，评测应转向 VehDyn 这类分层动力学指标。

papers.title: EngIntervene: Benchmarking Multimodal Engineering State Understanding and Design Intervention Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal engineering benchmarks largely evaluate static understanding, such as recognizing components, interpreting diagrams, or answering technical questions. This leaves a missing middle between engineering perception and full design generation: whether a model can use an understood system state to reason about relations, constraints, and the consequences of design changes. We introduce \textsc{EngIntervene}, a benchmark for this capability. It contains 3,229 questions across seven engineering domains and organizes evaluation into four levels: state grounding (T1), relational and mechanistic reasoning (T2), constraint-aware diagnosis (T3), and intervention reasoning (T4), which asks whether a proposed modification achieves its target while preserving required constraints. The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EngIntervene 是一个评测多模态工程状态理解与设计干预推理的基准，含 3,229 道题、覆盖七个工程领域，按状态接地 (T1)、关系与机理推理 (T2)、约束感知诊断 (T3)、干预推理 (T4) 四级组织。结果显示接地能力更强并不稳定转化为更好的诊断或干预：最佳开源模型在 T2–T4 平均上落后最佳闭源模型 14.7 个百分点，且基准内监督微调只提升 T1 而不提升 T2–T4。
Motivation: 现有工程多模态基准大多只测静态理解（识别部件、读图、答技术题），缺少从“看懂系统状态”到“推理设计改动的约束与后果”这一中间层的评测。
Method: 构建 3,229 题、七个工程领域的四级评测：T1 状态接地、T2 关系与机理推理、T3 约束感知诊断、T4 干预推理（判断改动是否达成目标且保住约束）；任务统一在对象、关系、约束、设计目标构成的工程状态表示上，T2–T4 用带原子判分点的结构化参考答案打分，并做移除/打乱视觉证据与基准内监督微调两类干预。
Result: 在开源与闭源多模态模型上，最佳开源模型在 T2–T4 平均分上比最佳闭源模型低 14.7 个百分点；移除或打乱视觉证据会一致降低性能；基准特定的监督微调提升 T1 但不提升 T2–T4；T4 显示满足单条修改标准与产出完全有效的干预之间存在很大差距。
Conclusion: 工程推理不只是恢复当前状态，还要可靠地用它推理约束与干预后后果；更强的状态接地本身不足以带来更好的诊断与干预能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CORTEX: A Verified Experience Layer for Generalist Agents
papers.abstract_en: An agent can solve a task today and face the same task under new facts, tools, or governing knowledge tomorrow. Most agent systems can retrieve relevant text or recall prior conversations, but they lack a principled way to decide when a previous solution is still valid, when it must be adapted, and when it should be discarded. We introduce CORTEX (Contextual Orchestration and Reuse of Task EXperience), a general AI systems framework that connects specialized agents through an external layer of verified experience. Each episode records its task conditions, source and tool state, decisive predicates, proof trace, verifier, and outcome. A meta-controller chooses exact replay, checked adaptation, fresh synthesis, or escalation. Accepted episodes can become task patterns and procedural strategies through a challenge-driven development loop. This gives the system an implicit competence layer that can grow without changing model weights. We formalize system contracts for exact replay and source-version separation, and derive when reuse saves computation. A controlled two-domain implementation tests the exact-replay core on 1,000 synthetic cases. Complete-family holdouts test procedural transfer on 1,000 new-family cases across eight clinical and policy splits, with complete fresh-evidence grounding and perfect invariance to irrelevant-field and insertion-order perturbations. The transfer trace exposes the work required for verified strategy execution. These results establish an initial path toward general intelligence through reusable procedures, typed experience, and developmental transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORTEX 为通用智能体加一层“已验证经验”外部存储：每条 episode 记录任务条件、来源与工具状态、决定性谓词、证明轨迹、验证器与结果，由 meta-controller 在精确重放、受检适配、全新合成、升级四者间选择。在 1,000 例合成用例上检验精确重放核心，并在 8 个临床与政策 split 的 1,000 个新家族用例上做完整家族留出，实现完全新证据接地与对无关字段、插入顺序扰动的完全不变性。
Motivation: 智能体今天解出的任务明天可能因新事实、新工具或新治理知识而失效，现有系统能检索文本或回忆对话，却无法判断旧解何时仍有效、何时需适配、何时应丢弃。
Method: CORTEX（Contextual Orchestration and Reuse of Task EXperience）用外部已验证经验层连接多个专门智能体；meta-controller 在 exact replay、checked adaptation、fresh synthesis、escalation 之间选择，被接受的 episode 经 challenge-driven development loop 沉淀为任务模式与程序性策略；并形式化精确重放与来源版本分离的系统契约，推导重放何时节省计算。
Result: 受控双领域实现在 1,000 个合成用例上测试精确重放核心；完整家族留出在 8 个临床与政策 split 上用 1,000 个新家族用例检验程序性迁移，具备完整新证据接地，并对无关字段与插入顺序扰动完全不变；迁移轨迹暴露执行已验证策略所需的工作量。
Conclusion: 作者主张可复用程序、带类型的经验与发育式迁移构成通往通用智能的一条初步路径，且能力层可在不改模型权重的情况下增长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GTRL: Grounding Divide-and-Conquer Value Learning with Temporal Differences
papers.abstract_en: In offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), divide-and-conquer scales to long horizons by joining two shorter segments at a subgoal. However, under stochastic dynamics, the base case of this rule values the luckiest trajectories through the data. The subgoal must also lie on a shared trajectory, so a state-goal pair that no trajectory connects gets no value update at all. To address both, we present Grounded Transitive RL (GTRL), an offline GCRL value learning algorithm that grounds the divide-and-conquer update with a one-step TD target. Over a single step, TD is correct, as its target averages over the successors and needs no subgoal. GTRL adds this target to the composition rather than replacing it, so every pair receives an update, and the composition still carries the long horizon. GTRL also corrects the bias from hindsight relabeling by reweighting each goal against how reachable it was from other successors. We evaluate our algorithm on nineteen OGBench tasks spanning stochastic, deterministic, and stitching environments, where it achieves the highest average success rate. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GTRL 把 divide-and-conquer 的分段价值组合用一步 TD target 做 grounding：TD target 对后继取期望且不需要 subgoal，作为加项而非替换加入组合更新，使任意 state-goal pair 都拿到更新，同时保留长时程组合项。在十九个 OGBench 任务上取得最高平均成功率。
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习 (GCRL) 中，divide-and-conquer 在随机动力学下会用数据中最幸运的轨迹给 base case 定值，且 subgoal 必须落在共享轨迹上，否则该 state-goal pair 完全得不到价值更新。
Method: GTRL (Grounded Transitive RL)：把一步 TD target 加到 divide-and-conquer 组合更新上（相加而非替换），使每个 pair 都有更新且组合仍携带长时程信息；另按目标从其他后继的可达性对 hindsight relabeling 的每个 goal 重新加权以纠正其偏差。
Result: 在十九个 OGBench 任务（覆盖随机、确定性与 stitching 环境）上取得最高平均成功率。
Conclusion: 用一步 TD target 给 divide-and-conquer 定值可以同时解决随机动力学下的乐观偏差与不可达 subgoal 无更新两个问题，并在 OGBench 上取得最高平均成功率。

papers.title: PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PORTER 把持久 3D 场景图 (3DSG) 的“留存”与“驻留”解耦：边缘机器人只留轻量 anchor，重的 object payload 在边缘与云之间迁移。它把任务分解为功能需求，用 Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE) 度量卸载造成的覆盖损失，再按每字节边际 ISE 最小反复卸载 payload。在 JITOMA-Bench 上跨四个 3DSG builder，渐进压缩下累计卸载 91% payload 字节时 pooled relative mR@3 仍保持 100%。
Motivation: 按任务激活的稀疏工作集只约束单次任务的表示，不约束机器人全生命周期的板载内存：任务切换后旧 payload 既占内存又可能在未来复用，全丢弃会导致重复重建的高成本。
Method: PORTER 维护边缘侧轻量 anchor 与可迁移的 object payload；将每个任务分解为功能需求，提出 ISE 度量卸载后的需求覆盖损失，对可替代的支持打折、对剩余覆盖弱的需求加重惩罚；随后按“最小边际 ISE 每字节”反复卸载，构造预算受限的本地工作集。
Result: 在 JITOMA-Bench 上跨四个 3DSG builder 评估：渐进压缩过程中，累计卸载 91% payload 字节时 pooled relative mR@3 仍维持 100%。
Conclusion: 以需求覆盖损失（而非相关性）决定 payload 驻留，可以在大幅卸载 payload 字节的同时保住任务所需的场景图检索质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Two Heads Are Better Than One: Aggregating Weaker LLMs for Better Forecasts
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events, but access to the strongest individual forecaster may be costly or otherwise constrained. We study weak-to-strong forecast aggregation: can individually weaker LLM forecasters be aggregated to outperform a stronger forecaster? Using ForecastBench (Karger et al., 2025), we evaluate 70 LLM forecasters across 16 comparison groups, each with more than 1,000 shared subquestions, yielding 1,121 weaker-model pairs. Within each group, we identify the strongest individual by test Brier score and evaluate aggregates composed exclusively of weaker forecasters, with aggregation weights learned on separate training data. We find substantial evidence of weak-to-strong improvement. Learned linear pooling identifies a weaker pair that matches or outperforms the strongest individual in 11 of 16 groups and comes within 5% of its Brier score in all 16 groups. We also find that these improvements do not rely on having a near-best constituent and are generally accompanied by good calibration. Additional analyses show that adding more models does not consistently improve performance, and competitive weaker-model aggregates also remain available under practical constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ForecastBench 上把 70 个 LLM 预测器按强弱分组，用仅由较弱模型组成、权重在独立训练数据上学出的线性池化 (learned linear pooling) 聚合，可在 16 组中 11 组追平或超过组内最强个体，并在全部 16 组把 Brier 分数差距压到 5% 以内。结论是弱模型聚合能替代昂贵的最强单体，但继续堆模型数量并不稳定增益。
Motivation: 获取最强单个预测 LLM 成本高或受限，而现实事件预测中单模型的 Brier 分数与校准往往不够，需要判断较弱模型聚合能否越过强单体。
Method: 用 ForecastBench (Karger et al., 2025) 评估 70 个 LLM 预测器，分成 16 个比较组，每组共享超过 1,000 道子问题，共 1,121 个弱模型对；组内按测试 Brier 分数定出最强个体，聚合只用更弱的预测器，池化权重在独立训练数据上学得。
Result: 学到的线性池化在 16 组中的 11 组追平或超过最强个体，且全部 16 组与其 Brier 分数相差在 5% 以内；改进不依赖组内存在接近最优的成员，并通常伴随良好校准。追加分析显示增加模型数量并不一致提升表现，且在实际约束下仍存在有竞争力的弱模型聚合。

papers.title: BERT4DTI : BERT-based Model for Predicting Drug-Protein Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how drugs interact with protein targets is fundamental to drug discovery, drug repurposing and the early identification of promising therapeutic candidates before costly experimental testing. Sequence-based DTI models face three practical limitations: labelled interactions are scarce and unevenly distributed, large pretrained chemical and protein encoders are expensive to fine-tune end-to-end, and independently encoded sequences do not capture pair-specific dependencies. We present BERT4DTI, which encodes SMILES strings with ChemBERTa and amino-acid sequences with ProtBERT, applies bidirectional mutual attention between token-level representations, and classifies the resulting interaction features using convolutional layers and a multilayer perceptron. To reduce trainable size, ProtBERT is truncated to 18 retained layers and only the last two layers of each encoder are fine-tuned. On BIOSNAP, DAVIS and BindingDB, BERT4DTI is competitive, achieving the best ROC-AUC and PR-AUC on BIOSNAP and the highest sensitivity on all three benchmarks. An ablation on DAVIS shows that mutual attention improves PR-AUC and specificity. With 125M trainable parameters compared with 353M for full BERT fine-tuning, BERT4DTI provides a favourable performance-parameter trade-off for sequence-based DTI screening, while leaving runtime profiling, calibration and leakage-audited validation for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BERT4DTI 用 ChemBERTa 编码 SMILES、ProtBERT 编码氨基酸序列，再以 token 级双向 mutual attention 捕获配体-靶点的成对依赖，最后用卷积层加 MLP 分类。在 BIOSNAP、DAVIS、BindingDB 上取得 BIOSNAP 最佳 ROC-AUC 与 PR-AUC、三个基准上最高 sensitivity，可训练参数 125M 对比全 BERT 微调的 353M。
Motivation: 序列式 DTI 面临标注交互稀缺且分布不均、大型预训练化学与蛋白编码器端到端微调开销大、独立编码两条序列无法建模配体-靶点成对依赖这三个实际限制。
Method: ChemBERTa 编码 SMILES、ProtBERT 编码氨基酸序列，对 token 级表示做双向 mutual attention，交互特征经卷积层与 MLP 分类；为缩减可训练规模，ProtBERT 截断保留 18 层，且两个编码器只微调最后两层。
Result: 在 BIOSNAP、DAVIS、BindingDB 上取得 BIOSNAP 最佳 ROC-AUC 与 PR-AUC，并在三个基准上均取得最高 sensitivity；DAVIS 上的 ablation 显示 mutual attention 提升 PR-AUC 与 specificity；可训练参数 125M，对比全 BERT 微调的 353M。
Conclusion: 只微调编码器末两层并加 mutual attention，可在序列式 DTI 筛查中给出有利的性能-参数权衡；runtime profiling、calibration 与 leakage-audited validation 留待后续工作。

papers.title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VGGT-Diff 把 VGGT-Ω 输出的视觉几何 latent 经置信度感知的 Visual Geometry Router (VGR) 路由进预训练视频扩散模型，实现稀疏视角新视角合成 (sparse-view NVS)。每个视觉 token 关联一个 3D 点与置信度，转成 query 对齐的条件引导联合去噪，再用 Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) 沿可靠 3D track 正则残差。在插值与外推、不同视角难度上达到 competitive 或 state-of-the-art 表现。
Motivation: 重建式 NVS 能保住已观测几何但难以合成未见区域，扩散式 NVS 生成先验强却依赖隐式的源到查询对应，两条路线存在根本性权衡。
Method: 从 VGGT-Ω 取视觉几何 latent，每个视觉 token 绑定 3D 点与置信度，经置信度感知的 Visual Geometry Router (VGR) 变换为 query 对齐的 latent 条件（保留前后表面证据）来引导目标视角联合去噪；用 Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) 沿可靠 3D track 正则预测的 clean 残差以稳定多视角；另加鲁棒几何条件化，结合训练时正则与推理时引导。
Result: 实验在插值与外推、不同视角难度设置下显示 competitive 或 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 把显式视觉几何作为条件路由进扩散模型，可以在稀疏视角 NVS 中同时保住观测几何并合成未见区域，缓解重建式与生成式方法的权衡。

papers.title: Feedback-Robust AI for Patient Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Patient knowledge graphs from bedside monitoring should type their relations and state whether the data support their signs. In anesthesia and intensive care, clinicians titrate drugs and ventilation in response to the physiology, so temporal relations mix the patient's response with the clinician's policy. We introduce ClosedLoopBench: 29 relations with signs fixed by physics, pharmacology or clinical practice, on 3,442 VitalDB surgical cases (12,653 h) with negative-control action streams. When each patient's actions are replaced by another patient's, six of 12 estimators declare on average 11-18 of their 19-29 distinct relation estimates significant without calibration, and after calibration cross-correlation and Granger tests still assign ventilator rate -> end-tidal CO2 the sign of the clinician's policy. We propose feedback-robust patient graphs that combine concept nodes with evidence pointers, typed relations admitted against negative controls, and beat-level couplings. On VitalDB under null streams, our graphs contain 0.06-0.10 false concept-level relation instances per graph, versus 10-12 for correlational construction. Patient-specific estimates of 11 slow drug and ventilator responses predict later data no better than population estimates, whereas the pulse-arrival-time-systolic-pressure slope is negative in 94.3% of 2,884 cases and patient-specific (early-late correlation 0.67 [0.63, 0.70]).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ClosedLoopBench 与反馈稳健的患者知识图谱：在麻醉/重症床旁数据中，时序关系混杂了患者生理反应与临床医生的给药、通气策略，因此用负对照动作流筛选可接受的关系，并把概念节点与证据指针、beat 级耦合绑定。在 VitalDB 3,442 例外科手术（12,653 小时）的空动作流下，该图谱每图仅 0.06–0.10 个假概念级关系实例，而相关性构造为 10–12；脉搏到达时间-收缩压斜率在 2,884 例中 94.3% 为负且患者特异（早晚相关 0.67 [0.63, 0.70]）。
Motivation: 床旁监测生成的患者知识图谱需要标注关系类型并说明数据是否支持其符号，但临床医生的滴定策略使时序关系把患者响应与医生策略混在一起，常规相关与 Granger 检验即使校准后仍会把通气速率→呼气末 CO2 的符号判成医生策略的符号。
Method: 提出 ClosedLoopBench：29 条由物理、药理或临床实践固定符号的关系，基于 VitalDB 3,442 例外科手术（12,653 小时），配负对照动作流（把某患者动作替换为他人动作）。提出反馈稳健患者图谱：概念节点加证据指针、针对负对照准入的类型化关系、beat 级耦合；并比较 12 种估计量（含互相关与 Granger 检验）及患者特异与群体估计。
Result: 负对照下 12 种估计量中有 6 种在未校准时平均把 19–29 个不同关系估计中的 11–18 个判为显著；校准后互相关与 Granger 仍把 ventilator rate → end-tidal CO2 判成临床策略的符号。VitalDB 空动作流下，本文图谱每图 0.06–0.10 个假概念级关系实例，相关性构造为 10–12。11 项慢药物与通气响应的患者特异估计对后续数据的预测不优于群体估计；脉搏到达时间-收缩压斜率在 2,884 例中 94.3% 为负，患者特异早晚相关 0.67 [0.63, 0.70]。
Conclusion: 患者知识图谱必须用负对照准入关系并绑定证据指针，才能在临床闭环反馈下避免把医生策略当成生理关系；而多数慢响应的患者特异估计并不比群体估计更能预测后续数据，只有脉搏到达时间-收缩压斜率这类关系呈现稳定的患者特异性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Minimax-Optimality of Posterior Sampling for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Posterior sampling for reinforcement learning (PSRL) is one of the simplest and most effective exploration methods, but a basic question has remained open: does unmodified PSRL achieve minimax regret without structural assumptions on the prior? We answer yes. Exact vanilla PSRL is minimax optimal in leading-order Bayesian regret under arbitrary correlated priors. The difficulty is that a posterior-sampled transition model is coupled with its own continuation value. We overcome this with a common empirical transition reference that isolates the resulting value mismatch and a Bellman-based variance argument that controls it without an extra leading-order state-space factor. For finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous tabular MDPs with unknown stochastic rewards, this yields the minimax $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$ regret rate under arbitrary joint priors over rewards and transitions. The same proof principle gives the minimax $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$ rate for linear-mixture MDPs under arbitrary joint parameter priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明未修改的原始后验采样强化学习 (PSRL) 在任意相关先验下即达到 minimax 首阶 Bayesian regret：用统一经验转移参考隔离后验采样转移模型与其自身续值的耦合，再用基于 Bellman 的方差论证控制该值失配，无需额外的首阶状态空间因子。有限时域、时间非齐次表格 MDP（未知随机奖励）上得到 minimax $~~O(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$，线性混合 MDP 上得到 $~~O(d\sqrt{H^3K})$。
Motivation: PSRL 是最简单有效的探索方法之一，但其在不加结构性先验假设时能否达到 minimax regret 一直未决；难点在于后验采样的转移模型与它自己的续值耦合。
Method: 引入统一经验转移参考 (common empirical transition reference) 分离值失配，配合基于 Bellman 的方差论证加以控制，避免引入额外的首阶状态空间因子；证明分两路：有限时域时间非齐次表格 MDP（未知随机奖励、奖励与转移的任意联合先验），以及线性混合 MDP（任意联合参数先验）。
Result: 表格 MDP 上首阶 Bayesian regret 为 minimax $~~O(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$；线性混合 MDP 上为 minimax $~~O(d\sqrt{H^3K})$；两者均在任意（联合）先验下成立。
Conclusion: 未修改的 vanilla PSRL 无需结构性先验假设即 minimax 最优，值失配可用统一经验转移参考加 Bellman 方差论证控制。

papers.title: ActiveMem: Dynamic Latent Memory Trees for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to support long-horizon reasoning and decision making. Existing memory systems typically retrieve historical trajectories or summaries as independent context fragments, overlooking the procedural dependencies underlying multi-step execution. As memory scales, such flat retrieval introduces context fragmentation and cross-task interference, leading to structurally inconsistent reasoning trajectories. We propose ActiveMem, a hierarchical memory framework that recursively organizes agent experiences into dependency-aware latent execution trees. ActiveMem abstracts trajectories into reusable subtask nodes while explicitly preserving execution transitions, enabling coherent reasoning-path retrieval conditioned on the current execution state. To support continual adaptation, ActiveMem further learns dynamic memory expansion, retrieval, and pruning policies through reinforcement learning. Experiments across various agent benchmarks demonstrate that ActiveMem consistently improves task completion, reasoning stability, and memory efficiency over existing memory-based agents. Moreover, ActiveMem enables compact open-weight models to achieve competitive performance with substantially larger proprietary systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActiveMem 把 LLM agent 的历史轨迹递归组织成带依赖关系的潜在执行树 (latent execution trees)，按当前执行状态检索连贯的推理路径，并用强化学习学习记忆的扩展、检索与剪枝策略。在多个 agent benchmark 上，它相对已有记忆型 agent 一致提升任务完成率、推理稳定性与记忆效率，并让紧凑的开源模型达到与大得多的专有系统相当的表现。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统把历史轨迹或摘要当独立片段检索，忽略多步执行的程序性依赖；记忆规模变大后出现上下文碎片化与跨任务干扰，导致推理轨迹结构不一致。
Method: 层次化记忆框架：把轨迹抽象为可复用的子任务节点并显式保留执行转移，构成依赖感知的潜在执行树；检索时以当前执行状态为条件取回连贯推理路径；扩展、检索、剪枝三类策略用强化学习持续学习。
Result: 在多个 agent benchmark 上，相对已有基于记忆的 agent 一致改善任务完成、推理稳定性与记忆效率；并使紧凑开源模型取得与大得多的专有系统相当的性能。
Conclusion: 把记忆组织成依赖感知的执行树并用 RL 管理其增删，可同时缓解长程 agent 的上下文碎片化与跨任务干扰，让小模型逼近大专有系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CodeSkill: Latent Skill Abstraction for Long-Horizon Code Agents
papers.abstract_en: Code agents require long-horizon decision-making over complex interaction trajectories. However, existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches typically optimize behavior at the token level, creating a mismatch between low-level generation and high-level behavioral reasoning. This limitation leads to inefficient exploration and weak credit assignment under sparse rewards. Moreover, while large-scale agent trajectories often contain recurring multi-step behavioral patterns, their noisy token-level representations hinder effective experience reuse. To address these challenges, we propose CodeSkill, a framework that adapts hierarchical latent skill modeling to the code agent domain. CodeSkill first leverages a teacher model to distill both successful and failed trajectories into multi-level textual abstractions. It then integrates temporal variational inference with reinforcement learning to map these discrete semantics into continuous latent variables, while an adaptive boundary mechanism dynamically gates skill transitions based on execution feedback. The learned skills are injected into a frozen LLM policy as latent semantic prefixes, enabling optimization in a compact semantic space rather than over raw token sequences. By shifting RL from token-level exploration to experience-level reasoning, CodeSkill improves optimization efficiency and long-horizon behavioral coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodeSkill achieves highly competitive performance against strong open-weight baselines across diverse general and industrial coding benchmarks. Furthermore, the learned skills exhibit strong transferability and robust cross-domain generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit behavioral abstraction for scalable agentic code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeSkill 把分层隐技能建模搬进代码智能体：教师模型先把成功与失败轨迹蒸馏成多层文本抽象，再用时序变分推理与 RL 把离散语义映射为连续隐变量，由执行反馈驱动的自适应边界门控技能切换，最终作为隐语义前缀注入冻结 LLM 策略。RL 从 token 级探索上移到经验级推理，在多种通用与工业代码基准上对强开源权重基线取得有竞争力的表现，且学到的技能可跨域迁移。
Motivation: 现有 RL 多在 token 级优化行为，低层生成与高层行为推理错配，导致稀疏奖励下探索低效、credit assignment 弱；大规模轨迹中反复出现的多步行为模式被噪声 token 表示掩盖，经验难以复用。
Method: 三段式：教师模型把成功与失败轨迹蒸馏为多层文本抽象；时序变分推理 (temporal variational inference) 与 RL 结合，把离散语义压成连续隐变量；自适应边界机制依据执行反馈动态门控技能转移。学到的技能以隐语义前缀形式注入冻结 LLM 策略，在紧凑语义空间而非原始 token 序列上优化。
Result: 在多种通用与工业代码基准上，对强开源权重 (open-weight) 基线取得高度有竞争力的表现；学到的技能表现出强迁移性与稳健的跨域泛化。
Conclusion: 把显式行为抽象引入代码智能体，可让 RL 摆脱 token 级探索、在经验级做推理，从而提升长时程优化效率与行为一致性，并支撑可扩展的 agentic 代码生成。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Price of Locality: Why Forward-Forward Underperforms Backpropagation?
papers.abstract_en: The Forward-Forward Algorithm (FFA) replaces backpropagation (BP) with layer-wise local contrastive objectives, eliminating the backward pass and the need to retain intermediate activations, yet suffers a persistent performance gap with BP that worsens with depth. This paper diagnoses two structural failure modes: an optimization floor arising from concurrent local updates; and a geometric collapse of layer representations driven by the local update mechanism. On the optimization side, we prove that the FFA loss satisfies the Polyak--Lojasiewicz inequality at each layer; however, simultaneous layer updates induce inter-layer representation-distribution drift, so each layer optimizes against a moving input distribution and incurs an error floor. On the representational side, the pairwise similarity kernel of layer representations contracts exponentially toward rank one as depth increases, collapsing the diversity of per-layer error signals. This collapse bounds FFA's effective learning capacity, which measures the diversity of gradient information across layers, independently of depth, whereas BP's chain-rule signal preserves per-layer diversity, yielding a capacity that scales with depth.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文诊断 Forward-Forward Algorithm (FFA) 落后于反向传播 (BP) 的两个结构性原因：各层并发局部更新造成输入分布漂移从而产生优化误差下界，以及层表示的成对相似核随深度指数收缩到秩一，使有效学习容量与深度无关，而 BP 的链式梯度信号容量随深度增长。
Motivation: FFA 用逐层局部对比目标取代 BP、省去反向传播与中间激活保留，但与 BP 存在随深度加剧的性能差距，此前缺少对这一差距来源的结构性解释。
Method: 从两方面诊断：优化侧证明 FFA 损失在每层满足 Polyak–Lojasiewicz 不等式，并分析并发层更新导致的层间表示分布漂移；表示侧分析层表示的 pairwise similarity kernel 随深度的收缩行为，并定义跨层梯度信息多样性的有效学习容量作为刻画量。
Result: 证明 FFA 损失逐层满足 Polyak–Lojasiewicz 不等式，但并发更新使每层针对移动的输入分布优化并产生 error floor；层表示的相似核随深度指数收缩至秩一，使 FFA 的有效学习容量与深度无关，而 BP 链式信号保持逐层多样性、容量随深度增长。
Conclusion: FFA 与 BP 的差距源于并发局部更新与表示几何塌缩这两个结构缺陷，而非单纯的优化不足；BP 的链式规则在深度上保有容量优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Finite-Sample Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies represent multimodal action distributions, but an advantage-weighted update does not specify how to sample from the resulting target distribution. We propose Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic (SFAC), an offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) method for Kullback--Leibler (KL)-regularized policy improvement through conditional diffusion. A minimax Bellman critic estimates the advantage function, which defines an exponentially tilted target policy. A Doob $h$-transform expresses this update as a correction to the reference diffusion drift. We derive a posterior-mean representation of the correction and estimate it using paired self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Supervised regression on these drift targets updates the neural actor without critic action gradients. In the small-update regime, the KL-regularized update follows the natural policy-gradient direction, and the Doob correction represents the same local change in the space of diffusion drifts. Under suitable conditions, we derive finite-sample bounds that separate the effects of critic estimation, neural drift regression, finite-sample SNIS, diffusion discretization, and inherited actor error on expected average policy suboptimality. Synthetic experiments assess the accuracy of approximation to prescribed advantage-tilted targets and sensitivity to sampling budgets. On six offline-to-online continuous-control tasks, a reference-anchored implementation achieves higher final-window returns than those of its corresponding offline initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Schrödinger--Föllmer Actor--Critic (SFAC)，一种基于条件扩散的 KL 正则离线到在线强化学习方法：用 minimax Bellman critic 估计优势并构造指数倾斜目标策略，再用 Doob h-transform 把策略改进写成参考扩散漂移的修正，以配对自归一化重要性采样 (SNIS) 回归漂移目标来更新 actor。给出分离 critic 估计、漂移回归、SNIS、扩散离散化与继承 actor 误差的有限样本次优性界；在六个离线到在线连续控制任务上，参考锚定实现的最终窗口回报高于其离线初始化。
Motivation: 扩散策略能表示多模态动作分布，但优势加权更新只定义了目标分布，没有说明如何从该目标中采样，KL 正则策略改进因此缺少可操作的采样与更新机制。
Method: SFAC 用 minimax Bellman critic 估计优势函数，得到指数倾斜目标策略；以 Doob h-transform 将该更新表达为参考扩散漂移的修正，导出修正的后验均值表示并用配对自归一化重要性采样 (SNIS) 估计；对漂移目标做监督回归更新神经 actor，无需 critic 的动作梯度。小更新 regime 下该 KL 正则更新对齐自然策略梯度方向。
Result: 推导出把 critic 估计、神经漂移回归、有限样本 SNIS、扩散离散化与继承 actor 误差对期望平均策略次优性影响分开的有限样本界。合成实验检验对给定优势倾斜目标的近似精度以及对采样预算的敏感性。在六个离线到在线连续控制任务上，参考锚定实现的最终窗口回报高于对应的离线初始化。
Conclusion: 把 KL 正则策略改进重写为扩散漂移上的 Doob 修正并做 SNIS 回归，可在无需 critic 动作梯度的情况下完成离线到在线改进，且其误差可按来源分解为有限样本界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PARSEE-VAD: Efficient Training-Free Online Video Anomaly Detection via Proposition-Aware Reasoning and Streaming Evidence Escalation
papers.abstract_en: Training-free online video anomaly detection (VAD) with frozen multimodal language models faces two coupled challenges: extracting reliable current-window semantics under causal and computational constraints, and maintaining temporal continuity without repeatedly transmitting high-dimensional history. Encoding history through text can compress visual evidence and introduce semantic bias, whereas retaining visual history expands multimodal context. We introduce PARSEE-VAD, a two-module framework that separates semantic evidence acquisition from score-state evolution. Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) extracts structured propositional evidence from the current causal window and conditionally activates more specific queries when coarse evidence warrants further refinement. By sharing a reusable causal visual prefix across queries, PAR reduces redundant computation through selective execution. Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) maps the acquired proposition evidence into a compact score-domain event state through current evidence escalation, then propagates only the resulting bounded state across decisions to support temporal continuity. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong training-free online performance while selective routing reduces specialist computation and score-state propagation remains sparse. These results support a current-first principle for streaming multimodal inference: resolve present semantics first, then use compact historical state only to repair residual continuity gaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PARSEE-VAD 用冻结多模态语言模型做免训练在线视频异常检测 (training-free online VAD)，把语义证据获取与分数状态演化拆成两个模块：PAR 从当前因果窗口抽取结构化命题证据并按需细化查询，SEE 把命题证据压成有界的分数域事件状态只在决策间传播。四个基准上表现出强的免训练在线性能，选择性路由降低了专家计算量且分数状态传播保持稀疏。
Motivation: 冻结多模态语言模型做在线 VAD 时，既要因果与算力约束下提取可靠的当前窗口语义，又要避免反复传输高维历史来维持时间连续性：用文本编码历史会压缩视觉证据并引入语义偏差，保留视觉历史又会撑大多模态上下文。
Method: 两模块框架：Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) 从当前因果窗口抽取结构化命题证据，粗证据需要细化时才条件激活更具体的查询，并在查询间共享可复用的因果视觉前缀以选择性执行减少冗余计算；Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) 经当前证据升级把命题证据映射为紧凑的分数域事件状态，跨决策只传播该有界状态。
Result: 在四个基准上展示强的免训练在线性能；选择性路由降低专家计算量，分数状态传播保持稀疏。
Conclusion: 流式多模态推理应遵循 current-first 原则：先解决当前语义，再用紧凑的历史状态修补残余的连续性缺口。

papers.title: Inspire: Benchmarking Scientific Literature Search for Open Research Problems
papers.abstract_en: Scientific literature search often begins with an open research problem rather than a known target paper or a fixed candidate set. We introduce INSPIRE, a benchmark for evaluating agents that search prior literature to make progress on solution-redacted research problems. Each instance pairs a research brief with a target-specific cutoff three months before a later paper and evaluates ranked outputs against graded cited antecedents from that paper's realized research lineage. Search proceeds over an open corpus, while the identity of the target paper and membership of its cited antecedents remain hidden from the agent. Beyond end-to-end retrieval quality, INSPIRE uses logged search trajectories to distinguish three coupled stages: resource exposure, whether useful antecedents are surfaced during search; selection, whether exposed antecedents are retained; and ranking, how effectively retained papers are ordered. Across 476 computer-science targets under a shared search interface and budget, the strongest evaluated agent achieves 0.284 nDCG@10. Results show that current agents more readily recover an isolated antecedent than assemble a broader portfolio of relevant prior work. The stagewise analysis identifies resource exposure as the largest observed bottleneck, with further losses in selection and ranking. We additionally construct replay-valid hindsight demonstrations and show that they improve held-out search without changing test-time information, establishing that the benchmark provides an actionable learning signal. INSPIRE therefore enables both end-to-end comparison and stage-resolved diagnosis in a setting where the agent must construct its own working criterion of relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INSPIRE 把「从开放研究问题出发检索前人文献」做成可评测任务：每个实例给研究简报与目标论文前三个月的截止时间，隐藏目标论文与其被引前驱的身份，在开放语料上按已实现研究谱系的分级前驱评 ranked 输出。476 个计算机科学目标上最强 agent 只有 0.284 nDCG@10，stagewise 分解显示 resource exposure 是最大瓶颈，selection 与 ranking 还有进一步损失；回放有效的 hindsight 示范能在不改变测试时信息的前提下改善 held-out 检索。
Motivation: 文献检索通常从已知论文或固定候选集出发，而真实科研从一个开放问题起步、相关性标准要由 agent 自己建立，现有检索评测覆盖不到这条路径。
Method: INSPIRE 为每个研究简报设定目标论文前三个月的 cutoff，隐藏目标论文与被引前驱身份，在开放语料上检索；用 logged search trajectory 把过程拆成 resource exposure、selection、ranking 三阶段分别打分，端到端指标为 nDCG@10，并构造 replay-valid hindsight 示范作为可学习信号。
Result: 在共享检索接口与预算下的 476 个计算机科学目标上，最强被评 agent 取得 0.284 nDCG@10；agent 更容易找回孤立前驱而非组装成较宽的相关前驱组合；stagewise 分析把 resource exposure 判为观察到的最大瓶颈，selection 与 ranking 还有进一步损失；hindsight 示范提升了 held-out 检索且不改变测试时信息。
Conclusion: INSPIRE 同时支持端到端比较与分阶段诊断，其核心判断是当前 agent 的主要短板在检索过程中有用前驱根本没有被暴露出来，而非暴露后的排序。

papers.title: MTLiquid: Enabling Efficient Multi-Task Learning using Liquid Neural Networks for Lightweight Healthcare Monitoring Systems
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time sensing and monitoring with timely and accurate decision-making are critical for many real-world applications. In healthcare monitoring systems, physiological signals are often available or sampled at irregular time intervals, hence requiring continuous-time processing to provide accurate prediction. Moreover, such systems often need to solve multiple detection/prediction tasks to provide a comprehensive patient review from different physiological aspects for more accurate decision-making. To solve this, continuous-time neural networks (CTNNs) can be employed. However, state-of-the-art works typically solve only one task at each network, thereby limiting their efficiency gains. To address this limitation, we propose MTLiquid, a novel methodology to enable efficient multi-task learning in continuous-time processing for healthcare monitoring systems through effective network design and training strategy. MTLiquid employs: (1) multiple input and output heads to accommodate different tasks, while sharing the same backbone network across tasks; as well as (2) an effective training strategy that leverages a loss-weighting technique to balance learning updates across different tasks and a proportional data presentation technique to address imbalanced dataset sizes. Experimental results for mortality prediction (P12) and sepsis early detection (P19) tasks for ICU patients show that, MTLiquid achieves strong performance (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.94 for P19) comparable to the state-of-the-art single-task learning in both continuous-time networks (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.95 for P19) and discrete-time networks (AUROC: 0.79-0.82 for P12 and 0.92-0.94 for P19), while incurring significantly smaller memory cost by 44%-94%. These results highlight the potential of our MTLiquid methodology to enable lightweight continuous-time healthcare monitoring systems for better decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MTLiquid 用共享骨干加多输入输出头，把连续时间网络 (CTNN) 从单任务改成多任务，用于 ICU 生理信号的死亡预测与脓毒症早期检测。在 P12/P19 上 AUROC 达 0.84/0.94，与单任务连续时间网络 (0.84/0.95) 相当，内存开销降低 44%-94%。
Motivation: 现有连续时间网络通常一个网络只做一项任务，多任务需求下要堆多个网络，效率增益被抵消；生理信号采样间隔不规则，离散时间网络处理不便。
Method: MTLiquid 采用共享骨干网络配多输入输出头以容纳不同任务；训练上用 loss-weighting 技术平衡各任务的学习更新，并用 proportional data presentation 技术处理数据集规模不平衡。
Result: 在 ICU 患者死亡预测 (P12) 与脓毒症早期检测 (P19) 上，MTLiquid AUROC 为 0.84 (P12) 和 0.94 (P19)；单任务连续时间网络为 0.84/0.95，离散时间网络为 0.79-0.82 (P12) 和 0.92-0.94 (P19)；内存开销降低 44%-94%。
Conclusion: 共享骨干的多任务连续时间网络在性能上可与单任务 SOTA 相当，同时显著降低内存成本，适合轻量化连续时间医疗监护系统。

papers.title: AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception
papers.abstract_en: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布 FMCW LiDAR 数据集与基准 AevaScenes：575 段序列（57.5K 帧）、800 万个 3D 框、16 个检测类与 24 个语义类，标注延伸到 400m，覆盖八个海湾城市含 237 段夜间序列。利用逐点多普勒 (Doppler) 径向速度后，远距离车辆与行人的检测 AP 最高提升至 2 倍，场景流 (scene flow) 精度在所有距离段上也显著提升。
Motivation: FMCW LiDAR 能逐点给出径向多普勒速度这一额外运动线索，但长距离下如何利用该信号仍研究不足，缺少公开数据与评测基准。
Method: 用六台商用 FMCW LiDAR 与六台配对 4K 相机采集 575 段序列，标注 3D 框与逐点语义；定义三项任务——3D 目标检测、场景流估计、语义分割，检测与场景流按三个距离段评测至 400m，并提供公开评测服务器。
Result: 加入多普勒测量后，远距离车辆与行人检测 AP 最高提升至 2 倍，在低延迟单帧设置下尤为明显；场景流精度在所有距离段上均随多普勒显著提升。数据集含 575 段序列（57.5K 帧）、800 万以上 3D 框、16 检测类、24 语义类、237 段夜间序列，标注至 400m。
Conclusion: 逐点多普勒速度是长距离感知的有效运动线索，尤其在低延迟单帧检测与全距离段场景流上带来实质增益；数据集与基准已在 https://scenes.aeva.com 公开。

papers.title: RMB: Reward Model Boosting Mitigates Reward Hacking
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a powerful technique for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. However, it often suffers from the reward hacking issue, where policy optimization improves the proxy reward model while actually degrading performance with respect to the true human preference, due to the imperfection of the proxy. To address this, we propose Reward Model Boosting (RMB), a novel approach that enhances the robustness and reliability of the reward signal for RLHF. RMB first trains a set of reward models with a diversity-promoting regularizer. This encourages each model to learn complementary aspects of the reward landscape. Then, RMB learns a lightweight aggregator in the principle of boosting to aggregate the outputs of the diverse reward models into a more accurate and robust reward signal. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that RMB significantly improves reward accuracy on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets, substantially mitigating the reward hacking issue and ultimately improving RLHF performance.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), September 2026
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, September 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLHF 中代理奖励模型 (reward model) 的不完美会让策略优化钻空子 (reward hacking)：代理奖励上升而真实人类偏好下降。RMB 先用多样性促进正则训练一组互补的奖励模型，再按 boosting 原则学一个轻量聚合器合成更稳健的奖励信号，从而在同分布与分布外数据上都提高奖励准确率、缓解 reward hacking 并提升 RLHF 表现。
Motivation: RLHF 依赖有缺陷的代理奖励模型做优化目标，策略会利用其漏洞使代理奖励虚高、真实人类偏好反而变差，即 reward hacking。
Method: Reward Model Boosting (RMB)：先用多样性促进正则 (diversity-promoting regularizer) 训练一组奖励模型，让各自学到奖励景观的不同侧面；再按 boosting 原则训练一个轻量聚合器 (lightweight aggregator)，把多个奖励模型的输出合成更准确稳健的奖励信号。
Result: 实验显示 RMB 在同分布 (in-distribution) 与分布外 (out-of-distribution) 数据集上都显著提高奖励准确率，大幅缓解 reward hacking，并最终提升 RLHF 性能。
Conclusion: 用多样性加 boosting 聚合的奖励模型集成可以增强 RLHF 奖励信号的稳健性与可靠性，使代理奖励更贴近真实人类偏好。

papers.title: When Do Models Admit They Are Wrong? Failure Disclosure Is Unstable Under Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can produce models with similar task performance but very different ways of communicating about their mistakes. We study failure disclosure: whether a model admits that an attempted solution failed rather than staying silent or presenting it as successful. Across repeated outcome-only GRPO training runs, failure disclosure varies far more than task accuracy. The pattern extends to a second reasoning task and stabilized PPO, persists at 7B, and also appears in an instruction-conditioned 32B setting. We also find that small floating-point and sampling differences during training can redirect reporting behavior even when the task objective and earlier training history are held fixed. Additional tests show that failure disclosure is not a single decision: Checking the answer, entering a report, and completing the admission can separate, and the weak point depends on the task and response format. Further, experiments with neutral controls show more broadly that behaviors left weakly constrained by training are especially likely to vary across runs, of which failure disclosure is an example. We can reduce variability in failure disclosure by discouraging the model from drifting from its starting policy on failed, well-formed responses. This makes reporting substantially more consistent, though its effect on task performance depends on the setting. Stable task accuracy therefore does not guarantee stable safety-relevant behavior: Researchers should measure these behaviors directly across runs and design training methods that keep them reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于结果的强化学习 (outcome-based RL) 下，任务准确率相近的模型在“是否承认失败”(failure disclosure) 上差异极大：跨重复 GRPO 训练运行，失败披露的波动远大于任务准确率，且小到浮点与采样差异即可改写报告行为。作者建议直接跨运行测量这类安全相关行为，并用约束模型在失败但格式良好响应上偏离初始策略的方法来稳定披露。
Motivation: 训练目标只约束任务结果，不约束模型如何谈论自己的错误；稳定的任务准确率掩盖了安全相关行为在不同运行间的不稳定，而这类行为通常不被直接测量。
Method: 在重复的 outcome-only GRPO 训练上研究失败披露，扩展到第二个推理任务与 stabilized PPO，覆盖 7B 与 instruction-conditioned 32B 设置；用中性对照检验“训练弱约束的行为更易跨运行变化”，并测试一种抑制模型在失败且格式良好响应上偏离起始策略的正则化手段。
Result: 跨重复 GRPO 运行，失败披露的变异远大于任务准确率；该模式延伸到第二个推理任务、stabilized PPO，持续存在于 7B，也出现在 instruction-conditioned 32B 设置。固定任务目标与早期训练历史时，微小浮点与采样差异仍会改变报告行为。失败披露可拆为检查答案、进入报告、完成承认三个可分离步骤，薄弱环节随任务与响应格式而变。抑制偏离起始策略的正则使报告显著更一致，但对任务性能的影响依设置而定。

papers.title: Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual world models enable robotic planning by predicting future observations, but dense latent-state propagation and sample-intensive trajectory optimization incur high inference latency and peak memory usage, limiting real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing sparse world-model acceleration methods either rely on unguided token sparsification, which may discard planning-relevant information and restrict achievable sparsity, or introduce heavy auxiliary modules and cumbersome multi-stage training pipelines. In this work, we present Scope-WM, an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences. Scope-WM distills prediction relevance into a lightweight action-conditioned selector and applies full dynamics prediction only to a compact subset of selected tokens. It updates the remaining tokens using a compact summary of foreground states and their changes, allowing the background to perceive foreground dynamics without costly token-to-token interactions. During planning, Scope-WM preserves and reuses high-quality action sequences discovered during the initial MPC search, focusing subsequent search under reduced rollout budgets. The resulting pipeline requires only a one-off selector distillation followed by a single joint training stage for the sparse world model. On the challenging Push-T task, Scope-WM reduces peak GPU memory usage and planning time to $18.1\%$ and $14.3\%$ of those of dense DINO-WM, respectively, corresponding to a $6.97\times$ planning speedup, while maintaining competitive task performance. Further evaluations across five diverse visual planning tasks demonstrate the general applicability of Scope-WM. Code is available at https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Scope-WM 把视觉世界模型的稠密 latent 传播压缩成按预测相关性选区的稀疏计算：轻量 action-conditioned selector 蒸馏出预测相关 token，只对选中子集做完整 dynamics 预测，其余 token 用前景状态摘要更新，并在 MPC 搜索中复用首轮高质量动作序列。在 Push-T 上峰值显存与规划时间降到稠密 DINO-WM 的 18.1% 和 14.3%，对应 6.97× 规划加速，任务性能保持竞争力。
Motivation: 视觉世界模型的稠密 latent 传播与采样密集的轨迹优化带来高推理延迟和峰值显存，难以在资源受限平台实时部署；现有稀疏化方案要么无指导地丢弃与规划相关的 token，要么引入重型辅助模块和多阶段训练。
Method: 把预测相关性蒸馏进轻量的 action-conditioned selector，只对选中的紧凑 token 子集做完整 dynamics 预测；其余 token 用前景状态及其变化的紧凑摘要更新，使背景感知前景动态而无需 token-to-token 交互。规划阶段保留并复用 MPC 初始搜索发现的高质量动作序列，在缩减的 rollout 预算下聚焦后续搜索；训练只需一次 selector 蒸馏加一次稀疏世界模型的联合训练。
Result: 在 Push-T 上，峰值 GPU 显存与规划时间分别降至稠密 DINO-WM 的 18.1% 与 14.3%，对应 6.97× 规划加速，同时任务性能保持竞争力；另在五个多样的视觉规划任务上做了进一步评估以展示通用适用性。
Conclusion: 把计算限定在预测相关的 latent 区域与有前景的动作序列，可以在保持竞争力任务性能的同时大幅削减视觉世界模型的显存与规划时间，且训练管线只需一次 selector 蒸馏加一次联合训练。

papers.title: RepFlow: Reciprocal Supervision Improves Generation and Representation in Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative models learn visual structure through denoising, yet their internal states are entangled with both noise level and network depth, making it difficult to obtain a stable visual representation from the generator itself. We introduce RepFlow, which learns such a representation from the generator's evolving computation and uses it to guide generation. Specifically, a separate timestep-free encoder is trained, through a timestep-conditioned predictor, to recover generator states across depths and noise levels from masked clean images. By excluding the reference noise and masked-out content from the encoder's input, we encourage the encoder to distill visual information that is recoverable from the visible image context and predictive of generator states. The representation learned from the generator's evolving states is then fed back to guide and improve the generator, whose updated states provide supervision for further representation learning, forming a reciprocal learning process. This reciprocal process improves multi-step generation and representation quality, as measured by frozen linear probing on ImageNet with latent-space SiT and pixel-space JiT, without an externally pretrained representation teacher. Across the two unconditional settings, FID decreases by $19.2$--$40.8\%$ relative to native training, while linear-probe accuracy improves by 6.80--10.04 percentage points over the best searched raw generator features. The learned representation also serves as a distributional metric for one-step JiT post-training, extending its role from instance-level alignment to distribution-level supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepFlow 用一个与 timestep 无关的编码器从生成器跨深度、跨噪声水平的演化状态中蒸馏稳定视觉表征，再把该表征反馈回去引导生成，形成互监督循环。在 latent 空间 SiT 与 pixel 空间 JiT 两个无条件设置上，FID 相对原生训练下降 19.2%–40.8%，ImageNet 冻结线性探测精度比搜索到的最佳原始生成器特征高 6.80–10.04 个百分点，且不需要外部预训练表征教师。
Motivation: 生成模型的内部状态同时纠缠于噪声水平与网络深度，难以从生成器本身得到稳定视觉表征；现有做法通常要依赖外部预训练教师。
Method: 训练一个独立的 timestep-free 编码器，经由 timestep-conditioned predictor 从被 mask 的干净图像跨深度、跨噪声水平恢复生成器状态；编码器输入排除参考噪声与被 mask 内容，只保留可见上下文中可恢复且能预测生成器状态的信息。学到的表征反馈给生成器做引导，生成器更新后的状态再作为表征学习的监督，构成互学习过程；表征还用作一步 JiT 后训练的分布级度量。
Result: 在 latent 空间 SiT 与 pixel 空间 JiT 两个无条件设置上，FID 相对原生训练下降 19.2%–40.8%；ImageNet 冻结线性探测精度比最佳搜索到的原始生成器特征提高 6.80–10.04 个百分点。
Conclusion: 生成器演化状态与表征学习可以互为监督，在不引入外部预训练教师的前提下同时改善多步生成质量与表征质量，且学到的表征可从实例级对齐扩展为分布级监督信号。

papers.title: Background Gradients Shape Memorization in Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Repetition is closely associated with memorization in generative models, but how other training images affect the retention and copying of targets remains unclear. We study this question in class-conditioned flow matching, where images outside the target set form the background. At fixed target repetition and same-class background row count, replacing repeated same-class images with distinct images reduces the target extraction rate from 80.7% to 18.0%. To explain this effect, we develop a paired-trajectory framework that isolates target-induced parameter displacement and the background gradient response to it. This response has an exact path-integrated curvature representation, connecting background loss geometry to target learning. Reciprocal response transfer between repeated and distinct backgrounds changes target retention and copying in both directions, establishing the response's causal role. After target removal, the response correction parallel to the target-induced displacement preserves approximately 90% of the copying effects of full response transfer. Directly scaling the displacement also changes copying without further training. The post-removal copying effects of reciprocal transfer are reproduced across datasets and architectures. Together, these results identify the background gradient response as a mechanism through which same-class training data shape the retention of target learning and the reproduction of target images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在类别条件 flow matching 中，同类别背景图像的重复性决定目标图像被记住与复制的程度：固定目标重复次数与同类别背景行数时，把重复的同类别背景换成互异图像，目标提取率从 80.7% 降到 18.0%。作者用配对轨迹框架把目标引起的参数位移与背景梯度响应分离，证明该响应具有精确的路径积分曲率表示，并通过双向互易响应转移确立其因果作用；移除目标后，与位移平行的响应修正仍保留约 90% 的复制效应。
Motivation: 重复与记忆的关联已被观察，但训练集中目标之外的其他图像如何影响目标的保留与复制尚不清楚，缺少可分离、可因果检验的机制解释。
Method: 提出配对轨迹 (paired-trajectory) 框架，分离目标诱导的参数位移与背景对其的梯度响应；为该响应推导精确的路径积分曲率表示，把背景损失几何与目标学习联系起来；再通过在重复背景与互异背景之间做双向互易响应转移 (reciprocal response transfer) 检验因果性，并在移除目标后直接缩放位移而不再训练。
Result: 固定目标重复次数与同类别背景行数时，将重复同类别背景替换为互异图像使目标提取率 (target extraction rate) 从 80.7% 降至 18.0%；目标移除后，与目标诱导位移平行的响应修正保留约 90% 的完整响应转移复制效应；互易转移的移除后复制效应在多个数据集与架构上复现。
Conclusion: 背景梯度响应是同类别训练数据塑造目标学习保留与目标图像再生成的机制，且该机制跨数据集与架构成立；直接缩放位移即可改变复制，无需再训练。

papers.title: Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
papers.abstract_en: Typed-decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer a declared yes/no or multiple-choice question about a state with a probability instead of text, and their evaluations report accuracy and calibration. Neither requires that the probabilities a model gives to logically related questions fit together item by item, which is what a system that acts on those probabilities needs. We test this property, coherence, with a battery of logically linked questions that needs no labels. For 160 items from ChaosNLI and PubMedQA, each with three mutually exclusive labels, we ask whether the label is X, whether it is not X, whether it is one of the other two labels, and which label applies. On 480 negation pairs, Jev's probabilities for "the label is X" and "the label is not X" miss summing to one by 0.064 on average (95% CI 0.055 to 0.072). Qwen3.8-27B, run from its official BF16 weights, misses by 0.293 with first-token probabilities and by 0.122 with verbalized probabilities. The gap to the first-token readout persists on pairs where both systems give similar probabilities, without double-negation labels, and after averaging Jev's repeated calls. Jev is not coherent either: its violations are about five times its repeat noise, and it over-endorses statements about single labels, so that its three single-label probabilities sum to 1.14 on average. The two systems also fail differently. Qwen3.8-27B's first-token readout under-endorses the complement of a label whether or not the question contains "not", rejecting both a statement and its negation in 196 of 480 pairs, and it does not become more coherent where it is more confident, whereas Jev's violations concentrate where its answer is uncertain. Because the checks need no labels, they expose biases that appear only when question forms are compared, and inconsistencies within items.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/bro789/typed-decision-coherence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 TypeSafe 的 Jev 等 typed-decision 模型做无标签的逻辑一致性 (coherence) 检验：在 160 道三选一题上成对询问「是 X」「不是 X」「是其余两个之一」「是哪一个」。Jev 在 480 组否定对上概率和偏离 1 平均 0.064（95% CI 0.055–0.072），三个单标签概率之和平均达 1.14；Qwen3.8-27B 首 token 读出偏离 0.293、口述概率偏离 0.122，且在 480 对中 196 对同时否定一个陈述及其否定。
Motivation: 准确率与校准 (calibration) 都不要求模型对逻辑相关问题给出的概率逐条自洽，而一个真正依据这些概率行动的系统必须满足概率公理；现有评测无法暴露只在不同问法对照下才显现的偏差。

papers.title: WorldAgent: Verification-Guided Agentic Physical World Construction
papers.abstract_en: Constructing complex physical worlds from language requires coordinating extensive 3D environments, detailed structures and objects at different spatial scales, and interacting physical processes under both stated goals and implicit physical constraints. We present WorldAgent, an agentic framework for verification-guided physical world construction from a single natural-language prompt, without iterative user debugging. A world construction layer expands the prompt into a structured world specification and uses physical knowledge to build scenes and run numerical simulations. After every step, a verification layer inspects scene geometry and simulation states alongside rendered views. Failed checks guide automatic revisions to the specification and re-execution of the affected steps. Accepted worlds pass the required checks and remain editable for further inspection and resimulation. We introduce AgenticSimBench, on which WorldAgent achieves the best scores among the evaluated agent-based methods on five of seven metrics. In a 26-participant user study, it receives the highest mean ratings across all four criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldAgent 把单条自然语言提示自动展开为结构化世界规格，用物理知识建场景并跑数值仿真，再由验证层检查几何、仿真状态与渲染视图，失败检查自动改写规格并重执行受影响步骤。在 AgenticSimBench 上它在 7 项指标中的 5 项取得被评估 agent 方法中的最好分数，26 人用户研究中 4 项准则的平均评分均最高。
Motivation: 从语言构建复杂物理世界需要同时协调大范围 3D 环境、多尺度结构与物体、以及相互作用的物理过程，还要满足显式目标与隐式物理约束；现有做法依赖用户反复调试提示。
Method: 两层 agent 框架：world construction layer 把提示扩展为结构化 world specification，用物理知识构建场景并执行数值仿真；verification layer 在每步之后检查场景几何、仿真状态与渲染视图，失败检查驱动规格自动修订并重执行受影响步骤，通过检查的世界保持可编辑以便继续检查与重仿真。
Result: 在新基准 AgenticSimBench 上，WorldAgent 在 7 项指标中的 5 项取得被评估 agent-based 方法的最好分数；26 名参与者的用户研究中，它在全部 4 项准则上获得最高平均评分。
Conclusion: 验证引导的自动修订加重执行，可以在无需迭代用户调试的条件下从单条提示构建通过检查且可继续编辑、可重仿真的物理世界。

papers.title: MorphAtt: A Neuromorphic Accelerator for Efficient Multi-Head Attention Processing in Spiking Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Vision Transformers (SViTs) are developed as an energy-efficient alternative to conventional ViTs for computer vision tasks at the edge. However, huge parameter counts and complex multi-head self-attention (MHSA) operations make it challenging to achieve high energy efficiency in SViT inference, especially in tightly constrained applications. To maximize efficiency gains of SViT processing, we propose MorphAtt, a novel digital accelerator that expedites SViT inference through streamlined processing. Specifically, it processes MHSA operations using cascaded hardware modules: a Spiking Query-Key-Value generator (SpikeQKV), a low-complexity Spiking Multi-Head Self-Attention engine (SpikeAtten), and Reparameterization Convolution (RepConv) modules. To mitigate traffic congestion in on-chip memory accesses and data reuse, specialized inter-module buffers are integrated within the dataflow. Under synthesis using 32nm CMOS technology, MorphAtt achieves 792-1605 GOPS of throughput, while incurring ~39-55 mW of power consumption and 1.5 mm^2 of area, which lead to 20.3-29.1 TOPS/W of energy efficiency. These results also demonstrate that our MorphAtt offers better performance and efficiency trade-offs than state-of-the-art, thereby enabling highly energy-efficient vision-based AI systems at the edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphAtt 是面向 Spiking Vision Transformer 推理的数字加速器，用级联的 SpikeQKV、低复杂度 SpikeAtten 与 RepConv 模块流水化多头自注意力，并在数据流中插入专用片上缓冲以缓解访存拥塞。32nm CMOS 综合下吞吐 792–1605 GOPS、功耗约 39–55 mW、面积 1.5 mm²，能效 20.3–29.1 TOPS/W，作者称其性能-效率折中优于现有方案。
Motivation: SViT 参数量大、MHSA 计算复杂，在边缘严苛功耗约束下难以做到高能效推理，需要在硬件数据流层面削减注意力开销。
Method: 数字加速器采用级联硬件模块：Spiking Query-Key-Value 生成器 (SpikeQKV)、低复杂度 Spiking Multi-Head Self-Attention 引擎 (SpikeAtten) 与 Reparameterization Convolution (RepConv)；在数据流中集成模块间专用缓冲以改善片上访存与数据复用。
Result: 32nm CMOS 综合下吞吐 792–1605 GOPS，功耗约 39–55 mW，面积 1.5 mm²，能效 20.3–29.1 TOPS/W；作者称相对 state-of-the-art 提供更好的性能与效率折中。
Conclusion: 把 SViT 的 MHSA 拆成级联专用硬件模块并配片上缓冲，可在边缘视觉 AI 系统上取得更高的能效折中。

papers.title: SMORE: Stability-Promoting Mesh-Agnostic Model Reduction for Time-Dependent PDEs
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity simulations of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) are computationally expensive, motivating data-driven reduced-order surrogates for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, design optimization, data assimilation, and optimal control. However, existing surrogate models often exhibit poor temporal stability, which can lead to unstable rollouts and exploding gradients during backpropagation, especially in multistep long-horizon forecasting. To address this, we propose SMORE, a mesh-agnostic framework for model order reduction of time-dependent PDEs. Its latent dynamics are trained with Lyapunov-guided stability regularization, which promotes stable long-horizon rollouts. We provide theoretical guarantees under the stated structural assumptions. Beyond forecasting PDE evolution, the learned latent dynamics, which are interpretable and linear or linear-quadratic, could bring benefits for downstream tasks such as data assimilation and optimal control. Moreover, our framework is capable of predicting continuous PDE solution fields from sparse measurements of the initial condition. We evaluate SMORE on a range of problems, including wave propagation, the Navier-Stokes equations, and the shallow water equations. Our results show that it improves long-horizon rollout generalization and empirical robustness, and achieves competitive accuracy at comparable parameter budgets relative to competitive baselines including DINo, FNO, CNO, and Transolver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMORE 是一个 mesh-agnostic 的时变 PDE 降阶框架，用 Lyapunov 引导的稳定性正则训练 latent dynamics，抑制长时程 rollout 的不稳定与反向传播梯度爆炸。在 wave propagation、Navier-Stokes、shallow water 上，它相对 DINo、FNO、CNO、Transolver 在可比参数量下取得有竞争力的精度，并改善长时程 rollout 泛化与经验鲁棒性。
Motivation: 时变 PDE 的高保真仿真代价高，需要数据驱动的降阶代理做 uncertainty quantification、design optimization、data assimilation、optimal control 等 many-query 任务；但现有代理时间稳定性差，多步长时程预报中 rollout 不稳、反向传播梯度爆炸。
Method: 提出 mesh-agnostic 的模型降阶框架 SMORE，其 latent dynamics 用 Lyapunov-guided stability regularization 训练以促进稳定长时程 rollout，并在所述结构假设下给出理论保证；latent dynamics 可解释且为线性或线性二次形式，还能从初始条件的稀疏测量预测连续 PDE 解场。
Result: 在 wave propagation、Navier-Stokes equations、shallow water equations 一类问题上评测，相对 DINo、FNO、CNO、Transolver 等基线，在可比参数预算 (comparable parameter budgets) 下达到有竞争力的精度，并改善长时程 rollout 泛化与经验鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 用 Lyapunov 稳定性正则约束可解释的线性/线性二次 latent dynamics，能在可比参数量下保住精度并让长时程 rollout 更稳，且这类 latent dynamics 可反哺 data assimilation 与 optimal control 下游任务。

papers.title: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 DiT 的残差连接从被动求和改成可学习的跨层检索：每个 block 通过可微的 cross-depth 路径选择性读取早期层的空间与语义特征。REPA-XL/2 的 FID 从 5.9 降到 4.34（无 guidance），加 classifier-free guidance 达 1.39，训练迭代最多减少 1.73 倍，额外参数不足 0.1%。
Motivation: DiT 用统一残差流把所有前层当作单一状态相加，不像 U-Net 有显式 skip 结构，跨层信息通路这一因素基本未被探索。
Method: 先系统分析 DiT 内部表示，发现其偏好早期层特征复用与对称层引导；据此设计结构化连接，把局部残差与长程通路结合，让每个 transformer block 通过可微 cross-depth 路径动态检索关键早期表示，而非静态 skip 或稠密全层路由。
Result: 训练收敛加快，最多 1.73× 更少训练迭代；FID 与视觉质量显著提升而额外参数 <0.1%；REPA-XL/2 无 guidance 时 FID 5.9 → 4.34，加 classifier-free guidance 达 1.39。
Conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是扩散 Transformer 中关键但被低估的因素，结构化信息通路是提升可扩展生成模型的简单有效方向。

papers.title: ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Teach Yourself Where to Look: On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation trains reasoning models on their own trajectories using dense token distribution guidance from a privileged teacher with access to a verified solution. This supervision transfers what the teacher predicts without directly transferring where it attends within the preceding context. We introduce On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation (OPASD), which complements token-level supervision with solution-conditioned attention distillation. Because the privileged teacher can attend to verified solution tokens unavailable to the student, OPASD projects teacher attention onto student-visible positions and renormalizes the resulting distribution before alignment. Across three model sizes and four competition-level mathematics benchmarks, OPASD consistently outperforms token-only OPSD, improving average accuracy by 4.98 to 8.40 percentage points. OPASD also avoids the response-length inflation and performance degradation observed with token-only distillation, reducing generated rollout tokens by 73.9% and estimated model compute by 72.6% while training 1.53x faster. These results show that solution-conditioned attention provides a complementary supervision signal that makes on-policy self-distillation more accurate, stable, and compute-efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation (OPASD)，在 token 分布蒸馏之外加入 solution-conditioned attention 蒸馏：把特权教师对已验证解的注意力投影到学生可见位置并重新归一化后再对齐。在三种模型规模、四个竞赛级数学基准上，平均准确率比 token-only OPSD 高 4.98 至 8.40 个百分点，同时生成 rollout token 减少 73.9%、估计算力减少 72.6%、训练快 1.53 倍。
Motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏只传递教师的 token 预测分布，不传递教师在前文中的注意力落点，导致 token-only 蒸馏出现响应长度膨胀与性能下降。
Method: 特权教师可访问已验证解并注意其 token，学生不可见；OPASD 将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置、对分布重新归一化后做注意力对齐，与 token 级 OPSD 监督叠加，在学生自身 rollout 轨迹上训练。
Result: 在三种模型规模与四个竞赛级数学基准上，OPASD 平均准确率较 token-only OPSD 提升 4.98 至 8.40 个百分点；避免了 token-only 蒸馏的响应长度膨胀与性能下降，生成 rollout token 减少 73.9%，估计模型算力减少 72.6%，训练速度提升 1.53 倍。
Conclusion: solution-conditioned attention 是与 token 分布互补的监督信号，可让 on-policy 自蒸馏同时更准、更稳、更省算力。

papers.title: TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAO-DA 提出对称双臂专家 (Dual-Arm Expert, DAE) 架构，在共享 VLM 主干上挂解耦的按臂专家塔，用两阶段意图路由（先按显式语言指令、再按隐式视觉语义）选择专家，从而消除双臂间的跨臂干扰。另加一个轻量任务进度预测模块，用 pre-chunk 时序特征与本体感觉、视觉观测语义表示的 cross-attention 逐帧估计完成度，支撑协同调度。实验显示意图路由与跨臂干扰解耦有效，并给出从单臂到双臂（及反向）的技能泛化与跨臂运动域迁移的初步证据。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型没有显式机制区分两臂的状态与意图，导致跨臂干扰、降低任务执行成功率。
Method: 对称 DAE 架构：共享 Vision-Language-Model 主干 + 解耦的臂专属专家塔；两阶段双臂意图路由，第一阶段按显式语言指令路由，第二阶段按隐式视觉语义路由；轻量任务进度预测模块用 pre-chunk 时序特征与本体感觉、视觉观测语义表示的 cross-attention 逐帧估计完成进度，驱动协同调度。
Result: 实验结果表明模型在双臂意图路由与跨臂干扰解耦上有效，并提供从单臂到双臂（及反向）技能泛化的初步证据，以及跨臂运动域技能迁移的证据；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把双臂意图显式路由到解耦专家塔、再用进度预测做同步，是解决 VLA 跨臂干扰并支持协同多机器人任务的可行路径，单双臂之间的技能可双向泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Are Benchmarks Reliable? Toward Structural Diagnosis via Sample-Level Capability Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) relies heavily on benchmark scores, yet aggregate metrics can obscure whether benchmark samples reliably support model comparison. We introduce \textbf{BSDProbe}, a sample-level framework for \emph{benchmark structural diagnosis} that estimates capability boundaries from repeated-response trajectories along ordered model axes. BSDProbe summarizes samples by boundary position, boundary width, boundary-signal validity, and order consistency, then aggregates them into benchmark-level structural profiles. Experiments on six benchmarks show that benchmark reliability is axis-conditioned and heterogeneous: GSM8K and MATH exhibit the most stable measurement structures, MMLU and TriviaQA are relatively stable but heterogeneous, while GPQA and PopQA show stronger axis-conditioned risks. These profiles remain consistent across Qwen3, Qwen2.5, and cross-model axes. BSDProbe further selects compact high-value subsets whose model discriminability reaches up to $8.58\times$ that of the full benchmark. These results suggest that reliable benchmark use requires examining sample-level capability boundaries beyond leaderboard scores.
papers.comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026; Rejected with reviewer scores of 4,4,4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BSDProbe：沿有序模型轴做重复回答轨迹，估计每个样本的能力边界位置、宽度、信号有效性与顺序一致性，再聚合成 benchmark 级结构画像。六个 benchmark 上可靠性呈轴条件化与异质性，GSM8K/MATH 最稳，GPQA/PopQA 风险更强；选出的紧凑子集判别力最高达全集的 8.58 倍。
Motivation: LLM 评测依赖聚合分数，掩盖了单个样本是否真能支撑模型比较；排行榜分数无法区分 benchmark 内部的结构性风险。
Method: BSDProbe 在有序模型轴上收集重复回答轨迹，为每个样本估计边界位置、边界宽度、边界信号有效性与顺序一致性，聚合成 benchmark 级结构画像；再据此挑选高价值紧凑子集。
Result: 六个 benchmark 上 GSM8K 与 MATH 测量结构最稳定，MMLU 与 TriviaQA 相对稳定但异质，GPQA 与 PopQA 轴条件化风险更强；画像在 Qwen3、Qwen2.5 及跨模型轴上保持一致；选出的紧凑子集模型判别力最高达完整 benchmark 的 8.58 倍。
Conclusion: benchmark 可靠性是轴条件化且异质的，可靠用榜必须看样本级能力边界而非只看 leaderboard 分数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Orthogonal Witness Control for Muon Optimization via Sigmoid Spectral Reshaping
papers.abstract_en: Matrix-valued optimizers such as Muon exploit the spectral structure of neural network updates through Newton--Schulz orthogonalization, but their near-flattening of the singular spectrum discards relative magnitude information across gradient modes. We introduce \emph{Soren} (\textbf{S}pectral \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{Re}shapi\textbf{n}g), a matrix-valued optimizer that preserves the singular subspaces of the gradient while applying a bounded, monotone sigmoid transformation to its singular values. This smoothly compresses dominant modes without fully flattening the spectrum. We interpret Soren as a positive-definite preconditioned gradient method and establish convergence guarantees under relative smoothness and metric Polyak--Łojasiewicz geometry. To avoid explicit singular value decomposition, we further develop a finite-depth Soft Newton--Schulz (SNS) polynomial realization of the sigmoid spectral map and characterize how its spectral approximation affects the induced convergence geometry. Experiments across LLM pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of Soren against established optimizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出矩阵值优化器 Soren：保留梯度奇异子空间，对奇异值施加有界的单调 sigmoid 重整形，平滑压缩主模态而不把谱完全拉平，从而保住跨模态的相对幅度信息。用有限深度 Soft Newton--Schulz (SNS) 多项式近似该谱映射以避开显式 SVD，并在相对光滑与 metric Polyak--Łojasiewicz 几何下给出收敛保证。
Motivation: Muon 借 Newton--Schulz 正交化利用梯度谱结构，但近似把奇异谱压平，丢掉了不同梯度模态之间的相对幅度信息。
Method: Soren 对梯度做奇异子空间保持的变换，对奇异值施加有界单调 sigmoid 映射；将其解释为正定预条件梯度法，在 relative smoothness 与 metric Polyak--Łojasiewicz 几何下建立收敛保证；再用有限深度 Soft Newton--Schulz (SNS) 多项式实现该谱映射以避免显式 SVD，并刻画谱近似对诱导收敛几何的影响。
Result: 在 LLM 预训练、监督微调 (SFT) 与直接偏好优化 (DPO) 上的实验表明 Soren 相对既有优化器有效且稳健；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把奇异谱从完全拉平改为有界的 sigmoid 重整形，可在保留正交化收益的同时保住模态间幅度信息，并有收敛性支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Apparent Compression, Real Stability: The Intrinsic Dimension of Learning a Quantum Wavefunction
papers.abstract_en: How many directions in weight space does training need? The intrinsic dimension answers this with the smallest number of random directions in which training still reaches a target accuracy, and small values have motivated parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA. We measure it for variational Monte Carlo (VMC), which trains a neural network to represent the ground state of a quantum many-body system. VMC is a demanding test, because the network generates its own training samples and every gradient is noisy, and a revealing one, because the exact answer is known and every run can be scored. We train only a small latent vector that a frozen random map turns into the network's weights, with no change to the standard natural-gradient optimizer. We find that a small dimension can be misleading, while the stability it brings is real. On a magnet with a hard sign pattern, a network that cannot represent signs reaches its best energy in 8 of 28,642 directions, but only because no such network can go lower; once signs are learnable, neither the signs nor the magnitudes are cheap. The dimension rises across a quantum phase transition, so it tracks how difficult a state is at far less compute than fitting a scaling law, yet it never falls below a floor set by the random subspace itself, even where the ground state is nearly trivial. Training in the subspace, in contrast, never diverged in our experiments, whereas full-parameter training with the same settings did, and a control with matched solvers attributes the difference to the reduced dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结随机映射把低维潜向量映射为网络权重、只训练该潜向量来测量变分蒙特卡洛 (VMC) 学习量子多体基态的本征维度。发现小维度可能只是表达能力受限的假象：符号不可学的网络在 28,642 个方向中 8 个就达到最优能量，只因再降不下去；维度随量子相变升高，可作为状态难度的低成本指标，且子空间训练在实验中从不发散，而同设置的全参数训练会发散。
Motivation: 本征维度被用来论证 LoRA 等参数高效方法，但小维度究竟反映任务简单还是表达受限并不清楚；VMC 中网络自产训练样本、梯度含噪，且精确答案已知、每次运行可打分，是检验该指标的苛刻且可判读的场景。
Method: 训练一个低维潜向量，由冻结随机映射展开为网络权重，优化器仍用标准 natural-gradient，不作改动；在带困难符号模式的磁体等量子多体系统上测量达到目标精度所需的最小随机方向数，并做匹配求解器的对照实验区分维度与优化器的作用。
Result: 符号不可学的网络在 28,642 个随机方向中仅 8 个即达最优能量，但这是表达能力上限所致；符号可学后符号与幅值都不再便宜。本征维度随量子相变升高，刻画状态难度的计算量远低于拟合标度律，且即使基态近乎平凡也不低于随机子空间本身设定的下界。子空间训练在实验中从未发散，同设置的全参数训练则发散，匹配求解器的对照把差异归因于降低的维度。
Conclusion: 小本征维度既可能来自任务简单，也可能只是随机子空间或表达能力的下界，须与稳定性分开解读；在该 VMC 设置下，降维训练带来真实的稳定性收益。

papers.title: AG-CoT: Verified Algorithmic Traces for LLM Program Synthesis on Clifford Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Scientific code generation can produce executable programs that fail to compute the intended scientific object. We study this problem in language-model synthesis of Clifford circuits, which prepare the stabilizer states used in quantum error correction and admit exact classical verification. In our target-conditioned framework, each target is given as compact signed stabilizer generators, and an exact verifier checks the generated OpenQASM circuits. We supervise models with Aaronson-Gottesman chain-of-thought (AG-CoT) traces checked by the verifier, and continue training on model generations that the verifier accepts. Across two independently trained model families (3B and 7B), AG-CoT supervision multiplies greedy-decode state-equivalence accuracy by four to six times over circuit-only baselines, and verifier-filtered continuation training adds a further consistent gain atop both. A complementary 32B study shows that supervised models achieve near-perfect syntax and Clifford validity while the strongest direct model reaches 6.14% state equivalence per target, rising to over 10% under verifier-guided selection with multiple candidates. These results show that algorithmic trace supervision gives a large, statistically significant gain in both model families and that verifier-filtered continuation adds a further repeated gain. The persistent gap between Clifford validity and state equivalence confirms that exact verification is necessary: a circuit can be syntactically and physically valid yet prepare the wrong quantum state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AG-CoT 用可精确验证的 Aaronson-Gottesman 链式思维轨迹监督 LLM 合成 Clifford 电路，使贪心解码的状态等价准确率相对仅电路监督基线提升 4–6 倍，验证器过滤的继续训练再叠加稳定增益；32B 上直接模型每目标状态等价仅 6.14%，经验证器多候选选择升至 10% 以上，说明语法与 Clifford 合法性近乎完美也仍可能准备错误量子态，精确验证不可省。
Motivation: 科学代码生成能产出可执行却算错目标对象的程序；Clifford 电路准备量子纠错用的 stabilizer 状态且可被经典精确验证，是检验该问题的具体场景。
Method: 目标以紧凑的 signed stabilizer generators 给出，精确验证器检查生成的 OpenQASM 电路；用验证器把关的 Aaronson-Gottesman chain-of-thought (AG-CoT) 轨迹监督模型，并在验证器接受的模型生成上继续训练；覆盖两个独立训练的模型族（3B、7B）与一个 32B 补充研究。
Result: AG-CoT 监督使贪心解码的状态等价准确率相对 circuit-only 基线提升 4–6 倍，验证器过滤的继续训练在两个模型族上再叠加一致增益；32B 研究中监督模型语法与 Clifford 合法性接近完美，最强直接模型每目标状态等价 6.14%，验证器引导的多候选选择下超过 10%；Clifford 合法性与状态等价之间仍存在持续差距。
Conclusion: 算法轨迹监督在两个模型族上带来大且统计显著的增益，验证器过滤的继续训练再加一层重复增益；电路可以语法与物理合法却准备错误量子态，因此精确验证是必要的。

papers.title: FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FocusDrive 把端到端驾驶规划围绕显式视觉焦点组织：将决策相关物体的描述与图像 patch 引用配对，再据此生成驾驶计划与轨迹。在 W3DA 与 NAVSIM 上，该框架展现出有竞争力的驾驶员注视预测与端到端规划表现，并优于基于文本的 chain-of-thought。
Motivation: 文本式 rationale 能描述驾驶响应，却把响应与具体视觉证据的对应关系留为隐式，场景理解与驾驶动作之间缺少可核验的连接。
Method: 提出结构化多模态推理框架 FocusDrive：为决策相关物体配对描述与图像 patch 引用，把显式视觉焦点注入生成规划和轨迹的推理；先用驾驶员注视预测检验该焦点表示，再在 NAVSIM 既有训练场景的 driving-focus 标注上考察其在规划推理中的作用。
Result: 在 W3DA 与 NAVSIM 上，FocusDrive 展现出有竞争力的注视预测与端到端规划表现，并相对基于文本的 chain-of-thought 有所提升。
Conclusion: 视觉焦点可作为场景理解与驾驶动作之间的有效连接，把决策相关物体与其图像位置显式绑定后，规划推理优于纯文本 chain-of-thought。
Relevance: 4
