papers.title: When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM
papers.abstract_en: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare the pre-overwrite targets with the released labels on all 103,288 navtrain scenes. The rule erases a candidate distinction that the training loss reads on 11,237 of them (10.8793%). Firing usually changes most of a column: lane keeping carries 9,982 of the 13,042 forgiven loss columns, and its median forgiven column had 14,391 of 16,384 candidates failing before the overwrite. On held-out navtest scenes forgiven on lane keeping, the released lane-keeping head's median AUC against the pre-overwrite outcome is 0.7095; on unforgiven scenes matched on failing-candidate count it is 0.9807. For the Hydra-MDP checkpoint released with GTRS, whose configuration takes the same label file, the two values are 0.6627 and 0.9761. Continuing the released GTRS-Dense checkpoint for 300 optimizer steps with three paired seeds, we observe the forgiven-scene AUC 0.1086-0.1251 higher with pre-overwrite than with published targets, and a narrower gap between matched groups, still above zero. Scoring with forgiveness disabled, we observe lane keeping higher by 2.478-3.524 points on navtest scenes forgiven on any of five loss metrics, with lower adjacent-frame plan consistency. Both changes are larger there than on the rest. EPDMS, scored the same way, does not separate the two target sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NAVSIM 的 GTRS-Dense 标签生成器在人类参考得零分时把整列 16,384 条候选轨迹全部标为通过（human-reference forgiveness），该规则在 103,288 个 navtrain 场景中的 11,237 个（10.8793%）抹掉了训练损失本可读到的候选区分。用覆盖前目标训练使 lane keeping 在 navtest 被宽恕场景上的中位 AUC 从 0.7095 提到 0.1086–0.1251 更高，且在关闭宽恕的评分下 lane keeping 高出 2.478–3.524 分。
Motivation: 评估规则反向写进训练标签：NAVSIM 为避免惩罚情境合理的机动而设的 human-reference forgiveness，在标签生成阶段整列覆盖候选成败，作者自己警告过它可能掩盖重要失败，但其对监督的实际影响此前没有被量化。
Method: 关闭覆盖重跑 GTRS-Dense 标签生成器，把覆盖前目标与发布标签在全部 103,288 个 navtrain 场景上对比；在 navtest 上按失败候选数匹配被宽恕与未被宽恕场景，测 lane-keeping head 与 Hydra-MDP checkpoint 对覆盖前结果的 AUC；再以三个配对种子续训 GTRS-Dense 300 optimizer steps，比较两套目标。
Result: 规则在 11,237 个场景（10.8793%）抹掉损失可读的候选区分；13,042 个被宽恕的 loss columns 中 lane keeping 占 9,982，其被宽恕列的中位数在覆盖前有 14,391/16,384 候选失败。navtest 上 lane-keeping head 中位 AUC：被宽恕 0.7095 vs 匹配未宽恕 0.9807；Hydra-MDP 为 0.6627 vs 0.9761。续训 300 步后覆盖前目标的被宽恕场景 AUC 高 0.1086–0.1251。关闭宽恕评分时 lane keeping 在五项 loss metric 任一被宽恕的 navtest 场景上高 2.478–3.524 分，相邻帧 plan consistency 更低；EPDMS 同法评分不区分两套目标。
Conclusion: human-reference forgiveness 不只是评估端的宽容，它作为训练标签会系统性削弱 lane keeping 等头对失败候选的可分性；换用覆盖前目标能抬高被宽恕场景的 AUC 并收窄组间差距，但 EPDMS 评分下两套目标无差别。

papers.title: Offline Policy Evaluation via Mixed Bellman Residuals and Adaptive Critic Representations
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating a target policy using data generated by a different behavior policy remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning. While most existing work relies on the standard one-step Bellman residual, we consider a convex combination of one-step and two-step residuals with a fixed mixing weight. In ideal settings, this mixed Bellman formulation can provide a natural bias--variance trade-off between approximation error under a restricted value-function class and the increased variance arising from multi-step importance weighting. To solve this mixed residual optimization, we adopt a minimax formulation involving a critic function. Unlike standard approaches that rely on a fixed functional class, we construct a data-dependent critic representation using predicted future feature directions which effectively induces a kernel adapted to the underlying transition dynamics. This allows the critic to focus on directions that are most relevant for the estimated Bellman error. To control overfitting, we use sample splitting to construct the critic and estimate the value function on separate data subsets. Simulation studies and MetaWorld tasks illustrate the effect of the mixing parameter and show that intermediate residual combinations can improve value estimation in challenging settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离线策略评估 (offline policy evaluation) 中把一步与两步 Bellman 残差按固定权重混合，用 minimax 形式配一个 critic，并以数据依赖的 critic 表示（由预测的未来特征方向诱导出适应转移动力学的 kernel）配合样本拆分控制过拟合。仿真与 MetaWorld 任务显示中间混合权重在困难设定下能改进价值估计。
Motivation: 用行为策略产生的数据评估目标策略是强化学习的基本难题；标准一步 Bellman 残差在受限价值函数类下有逼近误差，而多步重要性加权又抬高方差，需要在两者间取舍。
Method: 构造一步与两步残差的凸组合（固定 mixing weight）的 mixed Bellman 目标，转成含 critic 的 minimax 优化；critic 不用固定函数类，而是用预测的未来特征方向构造数据依赖表示，诱导出适应转移动力学的 kernel；用样本拆分 (sample splitting) 在不同数据子集上分别构造 critic 与估计价值函数。
Result: 仿真研究与 MetaWorld 任务说明了 mixing parameter 的影响，并显示中间残差组合在困难设定下可改进价值估计。

papers.title: Identifying Temporal Features within Transcoders for Time Sensitive Factual Recall
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from temporal misalignment, often due to the contradictory nature of their training corpora. While current mitigation strategies rely on computationally expensive fine-tuning or context-heavy retrieval augmented generation (RAG), the internal mechanisms governing time-sensitive recall remain under-explored. Unlike prior studies that identify temporal components such as attention heads and MLP layers, we provide the first feature-level map of temporal recall by isolating individual MLP features via transcoder circuit tracing. We identify three node categories (common temporal, common to the year, and chrono-semantic) which interact to generate a temporal filter during factual recall. By analysing Gemma 2 2B, LLaMA 3.2 1B, and Qwen3-4B, we show that these features do not follow a simple linear pipeline but represent time through a parallel and mixed syntactic-semantic interplay across layers. We additionally discover a class of higher-layer temporal components invisible to existing EAP-IG methods, establishing transcoders as a more complete lens for temporal interpretability in time-sensitive factual recall. These findings present MLP components for potential targeted interventions in time-sensitive factual recall
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 transcoder circuit tracing 在 MLP 特征层面绘制 LLM 时间事实召回的首个特征图，识别出 common temporal、common to the year、chrono-semantic 三类节点，它们在召回时交互形成时间过滤器。在 Gemma 2 2B、LLaMA 3.2 1B、Qwen3-4B 上显示时间表征并非线性流水线，而是跨层的并行语法-语义混合交互，并发现一类现有 EAP-IG 方法看不到的高层时间组件。
Motivation: LLM 因训练语料时间矛盾出现 temporal misalignment，现有缓解手段依赖昂贵微调或上下文繁重的 RAG，而支配时间敏感召回的内部机制研究不足；已有工作只定位到 attention head 与 MLP 层级，缺少特征级图谱。
Method: 用 transcoder circuit tracing 分离单个 MLP 特征，归纳三类节点（common temporal、common to the year、chrono-semantic）并追踪其在事实召回中的交互；在 Gemma 2 2B、LLaMA 3.2 1B、Qwen3-4B 三个模型上分析，并与 EAP-IG 方法对照。
Result: 发现三类时间特征构成时间过滤器，且不遵循简单线性流水线，而是跨层以并行、语法-语义混合的方式表征时间；另发现一类高层时间组件对现有 EAP-IG 方法不可见。
Conclusion: transcoder 是时间敏感事实召回的更完整可解释性视角，识别出的 MLP 组件可作为定向干预 (targeted intervention) 的候选靶点。

papers.title: Unlocking Latent Personalization in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to adapt to individual users, yet effective personalization remains challenging when only limited user-specific samples are available. In this work, we take an alternative perspective: pretrained LLMs may already possess latent capacity for personalization, and a few user samples may therefore suffice to guide the model toward user-aligned behavior with minimal user-specific adaptation. From this perspective, we propose LatentPersonal, a framework that formulates personalization as navigation in a shared latent adaptation space. LatentPersonal infers a compact latent representation from a few user samples to guide user-specific model adaptation, regularized with a variational information bottleneck to encourage compact preference representations. We instantiate LatentPersonal with LoRA, leveraging its low-rank parameterization as a natural low-dimensional adaptation space for personalization. By simply inserting a user-specific guidance vector between the shared low-rank factors, the model can navigate toward personalized adaptations through lightweight inference of this compact representation, without updating the shared LoRA parameters. Experiments across multiple personalization datasets demonstrate that LatentPersonal substantially reduces user-specific adaptation overhead while achieving effective personalization from only a few user-specific interactions, with particularly strong performance in the one-shot regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentPersonal 把 LLM 个性化表述为共享隐适应空间中的导航：从少量用户样本推断紧凑隐表示并插入共享 LoRA 低秩因子之间，配合变分信息瓶颈正则，不更新共享 LoRA 参数即可导向用户对齐行为。多个人性化数据集实验显示该框架大幅降低个性化适配开销，且在 one-shot 设定下表现尤其强。
Motivation: 仅有少量用户样本时，常规个性化微调开销大且易过拟合；作者认为预训练 LLM 已含潜在个性化能力，缺的是用几个样本把模型引向用户对齐行为的轻量机制。
Method: 提出 LatentPersonal：从少量用户样本推断紧凑隐表示作为用户特定引导向量，用变分信息瓶颈 (variational information bottleneck) 正则偏好表示的紧凑性；以 LoRA 的低秩参数化作为天然的低维适应空间，把引导向量插入共享低秩因子之间，仅轻量推断该表示而不更新共享 LoRA 参数。
Result: 在多个人性化数据集上，LatentPersonal 显著降低用户特定适配开销，同时仅凭少量用户交互即实现有效个性化，在 one-shot 设定下表现尤其突出。
Conclusion: 预训练 LLM 的个性化能力可以被少量样本激活：把个性化当作共享隐空间中的轻量导航而非参数微调，即可在极低样本（尤其 one-shot）下达到有效个性化并省掉适配开销。

papers.title: SeOPD: Self-Evolving LLMs via Online Policy Distillation from Self-Generated Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in online policy self-distillation (OPSD) have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can improve their capabilities by leveraging external privileged information (PI), such as manual annotations or feedback from external environments. However, obtaining accurate annotations and constructing sophisticated environments often require substantial human effort and computation, limiting the scalability of OPSD. While a few recent studies have explored self-improvement without external PI, the resulting gains remain limited. In this work, we explore whether LLMs can achieve comparable self-improvement without external PI. Our key observation is that a single LLM can support multiple reasoning modes, such as deep-thinking and non-thinking modes, with deep thinking generating additional information during reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose Self-Evolving Online Policy Distillation (SeOPD), which enables LLMs to distill and internalize information generated by their own chain of thought (CoT). Specifically, it (1) generates CoT with the deep-thinking mode, (2) produces responses with the non-thinking mode, and (3) uses the generated CoT as PI to provide token-level supervision for the non-thinking response, allowing new information inferred during reasoning to guide the non-thinking mode and be internalized into the shared model parameters, thereby improving both non-thinking and deep-thinking capabilities. Extensive experiments across LLMs and tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of SeOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeOPD 让 LLM 不依赖外部特权信息 (PI) 自我提升：用同一模型的 deep-thinking 模式生成 CoT，再把该 CoT 当作 PI 对 non-thinking 模式的回答做 token 级监督，使推理中新产生的信息被内化进共享参数，同时提升 non-thinking 与 deep-thinking 两种能力。
Motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏 (OPSD) 依赖人工标注或外部环境等特权信息，标注与环境构建成本高、难以扩展；而已有的无外部 PI 自改进工作增益有限。
Method: 三步流程：deep-thinking 模式生成 CoT；non-thinking 模式产出回答；用生成的 CoT 作为 PI 对 non-thinking 回应施加 token 级监督，把推理期间推断的新信息蒸馏进共享模型参数。
Result: 在多种 LLM 与任务上的大量实验表明 SeOPD 有效，同时提升 non-thinking 与 deep-thinking 能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 单一 LLM 内部的深思考产物可以充当自身浅思考模式的特权信息，从而在不依赖外部标注或环境的前提下实现可扩展的自我进化。

papers.title: Which Self-Improvements Should We Trust? Reliable Self-Improvement When Agents Reuse Their Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: As recursive self-improvement (RSI) rapidly advances, reliable evaluation becomes critical for guiding adaptive search. RSI typically relies on finite evaluation resources, such as fixed benchmarks, to determine which modifications are retained and what is proposed next. However, when these finite resources are repeatedly reused, new candidates are proposed based on feedback from the same evaluation set, so the search trajectory can adaptively overfit and empirical improvement may not reflect genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution. Some existing methods account for multiple comparisons but assume that candidates are chosen independently of the evaluation set, and therefore do not control this adaptive dependence. To address this, we propose REUSE (Risk-controlled Evaluation Under Sequential Evolution), a certified evaluation and promotion framework that allows a fixed evaluation set to support repeated adaptive decisions while providing statistical guarantees. For a user-specified error level $α$, with probability at least $1-α$, every promoted modification is a genuine population improvement on the underlying task distribution. REUSE achieves this by strictly limiting the evaluation feedback returned to the search process and accounting for possible promotion histories within the error budget. We develop detailed statistical theory for RSI evaluation in this setting, including simultaneous error control, valid lower bounds on cumulative improvement, and a characterization of the fundamental limits of adaptive evaluation reuse. In live self-improvement experiments, REUSE commits substantially fewer false promotions than evaluation frameworks from current RSI systems and error-controlled baselines, reducing the proportion of false promotions from up to 20.7% to 0%, while achieving final true population performance comparable to the best baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 REUSE（Risk-controlled Evaluation Under Sequential Evolution），在固定评估集被反复自适应复用时，通过限制反馈信息量并把所有可能的晋升历史计入误差预算，保证以至少 1-α 的概率每次晋升都是真实总体改进。在自改进 (RSI) 实验中，假晋升比例从现有 RSI 评估框架与误差控制基线的最高 20.7% 降到 0%，最终真实总体性能与最佳基线相当。
Motivation: 递归自改进 (RSI) 依赖有限的固定基准反复筛选候选修改，同一评估集的反馈会让搜索轨迹自适应过拟合，表面提升不等于总体提升；已有方法只处理多重比较，假设候选与评估集独立，控制不了这种自适应依赖。
Method: REUSE 是带统计保证的评估与晋升框架：严格限制返回给搜索过程的评估反馈，并在误差预算内计入所有可能的晋升历史；配套给出同时误差控制、累积改进的有效下界，以及自适应复用评估的根本极限的统计理论。
Result: 在实盘自改进实验中，REUSE 的假晋升比例从现有 RSI 系统评估框架与误差控制基线的最高 20.7% 降至 0%，同时最终真实总体性能与最佳基线相当；对用户指定误差水平 α，每次晋升为真实总体改进的概率至少 1-α。
Conclusion: 固定基准可以支撑反复的自适应晋升决策，前提是限制反馈并把晋升历史纳入误差预算；多重比较校正在候选依赖评估集时不足以保证可信的自改进。

papers.title: Scoring the Wrong Question: Readout Failures in Constrained-Option Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Constrained-option scoring reads a model's probabilities for a fixed set of permitted answers, so it returns a score even when the model is about to write something else. We study a prompt that quotes a multiple-choice item, ending in the item's own answer instruction, and asks for a forecast of whether a reader model given only a short note will answer it correctly. The model can begin answering the quoted item: on three Qwen3 checkpoints an answer letter is the most probable token on nearly every passage, and the forecast ranks the reader's correctness indistinguishably from chance. Beyond prior work's argmax check and prefill repair, we contribute a label-free diagnostic of the declared options' support, their first-token mass in context; a deletion test tracing the Qwen3 answer-letter start to the quoted instruction; and rendering and tokenisation checks for dropped separators and coinciding first tokens. Prefilling an answer stem lifts the median option mass from below to above one half on all nine checkpoints scored with this prompt and, with options and renormalisation unchanged, raises the Qwen3-averaged AUC from 0.4929 to 0.6152. lm-polygraph's default P(True) estimator shows a related failure: it reads True where Qwen3 without thinking favours an answer letter (MMLU) or the prompt's (A)/(B) label (TriviaQA), and its Qwen3-averaged AUROC is indistinguishable from chance on MMLU and below chance on TriviaQA. Scoring and renormalising the (A)/(B) labels after an answer stem raises it to 0.632 and 0.868, renormalising True against False in place reaches 0.660 and 0.860, and on TriviaQA both exceed all fourteen default single-answer library estimators. The original forecast is renormalised too, yet stays indistinguishable from chance: option mass flags low support in both settings without labels, and only checking the intended target shows which score still ranks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受限选项打分 (constrained-option scoring) 在提示词引用了选择题原文并以题目自身作答指令结尾时会失效：模型倾向直接开始作答，Qwen3 三个 checkpoint 上答案字母在几乎每段文本都是最高概率 token，导致对读者模型正确率的预测与随机不可区分。补上答案词干 (answer stem) 后选项首 token 质量中位数从低于一半升到高于一半，Qwen3 平均 AUC 从 0.4929 升到 0.6152；对 (A)/(B) 标签重归一化后 lm-polygraph 默认 P(True) 在 MMLU/TriviaQA 上的 AUROC 提到 0.632/0.868，而原始预测即使同样重归一化仍与随机不可区分。
Motivation: 受限选项打分即使模型即将输出别的内容也会给出分数，这类分数被当作置信度或正确率预测使用时会静默失真；需要一种不依赖标签的诊断来定位选项支持度不足的来源。
Method: 提出无标签诊断：度量声明选项在上下文中的首 token 质量 (first-token mass)；配合删除测试把 Qwen3 的答案字母起始追溯到被引用的作答指令，并检查渲染与分词导致的分隔符丢失和首 token 重合。干预手段为补入答案词干、对 (A)/(B) 标签或 True/False 重归一化，评估覆盖九个 checkpoint 与 lm-polygraph 的十四个默认单答案估计器，数据集为 MMLU 与 TriviaQA。

papers.title: Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?
papers.abstract_en: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三阶段病理基础模型 ProSlide：先用 12,695 条样本级 bulk 蛋白表达谱预训练 Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE)，再用配对 WSI-蛋白样本训练模型预测蛋白表达，最后用 Prot2Path 跨模态关系蒸馏，把 WSI 与蛋白谱在冻结的 PFE 编码 profile 库上的相似度分布对齐，从而绕开仅靠配对样本的监督瓶颈。在乳腺、肺、肾癌 12 项下游任务上，仅用 2,229 张 WSI 与 12,695 条蛋白谱预训练，ProSlide 在每个癌种组内取得最高平均 accuracy 与 AUC。
Motivation: 分子引导的病理基础模型受限于配对 WSI-组学样本量，独立分子语料库的知识只能间接传到病理编码器；现有分子基础模型编码的是蛋白序列或单细胞状态，而非与 WSI 配对的患者级 bulk 表达谱。
Method: 三阶段解耦框架：(1) 用 virtual profile generation 与 expression-space multi-view 预训练在 12,695 条样本级 bulk 蛋白谱上训练 PFE；(2) 预训练 patch-region-slide 层级编码器 ProSlide，从配对 WSI-蛋白样本回归蛋白表达；(3) Prot2Path 跨模态关系蒸馏，对每个配对样本，在共享且冻结的 PFE 编码（含配对与独立）profile 库上对齐 WSI 与蛋白谱的相似度分布。
Result: 在乳腺、肺、肾癌共 12 项下游任务上评测，仅用 2,229 张 WSI 与 12,695 条样本级蛋白谱预训练，ProSlide 在每个癌种组内取得最高平均 accuracy 与 AUC。
Conclusion: 把蛋白知识获取与跨模态迁移解耦、用关系蒸馏对齐相似度分布，可以在小规模配对语料下缓解 paired-support 瓶颈并提升 slide 级病理表征质量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaWAM 把机器人操作的视觉前瞻从整帧重建改为以 delta token 为预测单位：每个 token 是单个向量，编码相邻两帧稠密 DINO 特征图之间的变化，由 DeltaWorld 潜世界模型自回归地逐帧预测，再由 flow-matching 动作专家结合预测转移与当前 DINO 特征生成动作块。在 256 GPU 小时（两块 H100）训练后参数量 0.725B，LIBERO 平均成功率 92.8%，单个动作块推理 142.1 ms、峰值显存 3.86 GB。
Motivation: 像素空间的 World-Action Model 每步都重建整个未来场景，计算开销大且存在时空冗余；而操作任务中相邻帧共享大部分视觉内容，策略真正需要的是帧间变化。
Method: 以 delta token 为未来预测单元，每个 token 是编码相邻稠密 DINO 特征图变化的单个向量；在大规模视频预训练的潜世界模型 DeltaWorld 上自回归预测每帧一个 delta token，flow-matching 动作专家以预测转移和当前 DINO 特征（作为空间锚点）为条件生成 action chunks。
Result: 训练 256 GPU 小时（两块 H100），参数量 0.725B；LIBERO 平均成功率 92.8%，在 LIBERO-Pro 的程序化扰动下表现出稳健泛化；每个 action chunk 推理耗时 142.1 ms，峰值显存 3.86 GB。
Conclusion: 把未来预测的单位从整帧换成紧凑的 delta token，可以在保持操作成功率与扰动泛化的同时把推理开销压到 142.1 ms/块、3.86 GB 显存。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABO-Med 把一阶双层优化范式嵌入 MAML 元学习框架，用于少样本医学图像分类，避免二阶信息计算；在多个公开医学数据集上比既有基线提升 1.99% 到 18.76%，配合模态感知增强 MedRAug 再把平均准确率提高 2.20% 到 6.34%。
Motivation: 既有双层优化算法普遍依赖二阶信息，计算代价限制了可扩展性；少样本医学图像分类需要在小样本下高效训练元学习器。
Method: 将近最优一阶双层优化范式实例化为 ABO-Med，纳入 MAML 框架并针对医学图像分类定制；同时提出 Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug)，一种面向医学图像的模态感知增强策略；理论上给出 MAML 型元学习方法的最优性结论。
Result: 在多个公开医学数据集上 ABO-Med 相对既有基线提升 1.99% 到 18.76%；MedRAug 在此基础上再把平均准确率提高 2.20% 到 6.34%；另做了跨域实验、增强消融、骨干网络消融与训练效率分析。
Conclusion: 一阶双层优化可在不计算二阶信息的前提下把 MAML 型元学习做到最优，配合模态感知增强能进一步抬高少样本医学图像分类准确率并保持训练效率。

papers.title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
papers.abstract_en: World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation. To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution. DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
papers.comment: 48 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对在静态演示上训练的 World-Action 模型 (WAM) 抓不住运动目标，提出 Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP)：把规划用的上下文与执行用的物理解耦，用 WAM 自身的预测 rollout 估计交互时刻，结合观测到的目标运动预测未来交互位置，再构造把该位置放进熟悉机器人构型的反事实观测，从而调用已有操作技能而非生成恢复行为。仿真与真机实验在多种目标运动下一致改善，仿真性能超过全部评估基线（包括额外用动态数据训练的方法），且单张消费级 GPU 实时运行、无需动态数据再训练。
Motivation: 静态演示训练的 WAM 即使具备所需操作技能也抓不住运动目标：执行推进时策略越来越偏向既有行为的延续，对目标重定位的响应性下降（target-response collapse）。
Method: DPP 将动态操作表述为反事实规划 (counterfactual planning)：先用 WAM 的 predictive rollout 估计交互发生时刻，结合观测到的目标运动预测未来交互位置；再构造把该预测位置放入熟悉机器人上下文的反事实观测，让模型调用已有操作技能；执行阶段把该计划接回机器人真实状态。
Result: 仿真与真机实验在多种目标运动上表现一致改善；仿真性能超过所有评估基线，其中包括额外在动态数据上训练的方法；DPP 在单张消费级 GPU 上实现实时动态操作，无需在动态数据上额外训练。
Conclusion: 动态操作的瓶颈在于生成上下文与执行状态的耦合而非技能缺失，把规划上下文反事实化即可在不重训的前提下让静态 WAM 跟上运动目标。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 针对在静态演示上训练的 World-Action 模型 (WAM) 抓不住运动目标，提出 Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP)：把规划用的上下文与执行用的物理解耦，用 WAM 自身的预测 rollout 估计交互时刻，结合观测到的目标运动预测未来交互位置，再构造把该位置放进熟悉机器人构型的反事实观测，从而调用已有操作技能而非生成恢复行为。仿真与真机实验在多种目标运动下一致改善，仿真性能超过全部评估基线（包括额外用动态数据训练的方法），且单张消费级 GPU 实时运行、无需动态数据再训练。
summary_sections.motivation: 静态演示训练的 WAM 即使具备所需操作技能也抓不住运动目标：执行推进时策略越来越偏向既有行为的延续，对目标重定位的响应性下降（target-response collapse）。
summary_sections.method: DPP 将动态操作表述为反事实规划 (counterfactual planning)：先用 WAM 的 predictive rollout 估计交互发生时刻，结合观测到的目标运动预测未来交互位置；再构造把该预测位置放入熟悉机器人上下文的反事实观测，让模型调用已有操作技能；执行阶段把该计划接回机器人真实状态。
summary_sections.result: 仿真与真机实验在多种目标运动上表现一致改善；仿真性能超过所有评估基线，其中包括额外在动态数据上训练的方法；DPP 在单张消费级 GPU 上实现实时动态操作，无需在动态数据上额外训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 动态操作的瓶颈在于生成上下文与执行状态的耦合而非技能缺失，把规划上下文反事实化即可在不重训的前提下让静态 WAM 跟上运动目标。

papers.title: Perturb-and-Solve: Efficient Learned-Operator Conditioning for Latent Diffusion Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models serve as powerful priors for solving inverse problems in image restoration, such as deblurring, inpainting, and super-resolution. Current methods have a trade-off between generality and efficiency. Solvers that are restricted to a fixed set of degradation operators are fast and efficient. Methods that support arbitrary degradation operators are slow and require gradients through the diffusion network. To break this bottleneck, we introduce PASEO (Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning), a method that uses a small (1M parameters) learned network to degrade diffusion model predictions in latent space. PASEO supports learned degradation operators without back-propagating through the diffusion network. We efficiently sample reconstructions from an approximate posterior by combining the diffusion model's prediction with the observed image. We do this by adding noise and solving linear equations based on a local linear approximation of the learned network, without building or inverting large covariance matrices. Across super-resolution, deblurring, and inpainting on FFHQ and COCO, PASEO achieves strong perceptual quality while running up to 9x faster and using up to 34% less peak memory than the tested baselines, with the same or fewer model evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PASEO 用一个 1M 参数的小网络在 latent 空间对扩散模型预测做退化，通过加噪并基于该网络局部线性近似解线性方程来采样近似后验，无需对扩散网络反向传播、也无需构造或求逆大协方差矩阵。在 FFHQ 与 COCO 的超分、去模糊、inpainting 上，感知质量强，最高快 9 倍、峰值内存省 34%，且模型评估次数相同或更少。
Motivation: latent diffusion 做逆问题求解时，限定固定退化算子的求解器快但不通用，支持任意退化算子的方法通用却慢且需对扩散网络求梯度，通用性与效率不可兼得。
Method: PASEO (Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning)：训练一个 1M 参数的小网络在 latent 空间表示退化算子；采样时把扩散模型预测与观测图像结合，加噪后按该网络的局部线性近似解线性方程得到近似后验样本，全程不对扩散网络反向传播，也不构造或求逆大协方差矩阵。
Result: 在 FFHQ 和 COCO 上的 super-resolution、deblurring、inpainting 任务中，PASEO 取得强感知质量，相比被测基线最高加速 9 倍、峰值内存最多降低 34%，模型评估次数相同或更少。
Conclusion: 用小型学习算子加局部线性近似替代对扩散网络的梯度求解，可以在支持学习到的退化算子的同时把逆问题求解的开销降下来。

papers.title: When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability
papers.abstract_en: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 9 figures, 20 tables, Under review at TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文在保持前向计算不变、只改反向导数边的受控设置下，比较记忆策略的两条反向路径（穿过物理状态 vs 穿过存储表示），发现原始梯度差异会严重误导：vessel 模型中 detach key-value cache 使梯度范数缩到约十分之一但方向几乎不转，而 AdamW 把 2% 的梯度差异放大成最高 31% 的更新差异。quadrotor 在 0.20 m/s 速度噪声下移除记忆使跟踪误差升 43%、切断记忆梯度升 32%，低噪声时切断的代价反而超过记忆价值；作者建议从初始化就带着记忆截断训练来度量其代价，并用优化器实际施加的更新而非原始梯度比较反向图。
Motivation: 带记忆的策略（Transformer-XL、TBPTT）在存储历史处切断第二条反向路径，但这一刀何时真正影响训练并不清楚；以往比较反向图时依赖原始梯度，可能与优化器实际更新脱节。
Method: 保持前向计算固定、只改变导数边，在 Transformer vessel-trajectory 模型与 quadrotor 跟踪策略上分别测量参数梯度、优化器实际施加的更新以及持续训练结果；对比 detach key-value cache、不同截断位置、global-norm clipping 与 AdamW，并在不同速度噪声与隐含速度设定下从初始化训练。
Result: vessel 模型中 detach key-value cache 在梯度流经全部更早物理状态时把梯度范数缩至约 1/10 且方向几乎不转，在一步物理信用下几乎不变；强裁剪体制下 global-norm clipping 消除了两种记忆截断图的大部分梯度差异，而 AdamW 把 2% 的梯度差异在切换截断位置那一步放大为最高 31% 的更新差异。quadrotor 从初始化训练、0.20 m/s 速度噪声时，移除记忆使跟踪误差升 43%，切断记忆梯度升 32%；低噪声时截断的平均代价超过记忆价值。两段截断无可测增益，但在隐含速度下两步窗口捕获了记忆的大部分价值，八段截断消除了 1/2 到 3/4 的代价。只在训练最后 1/5 开启截断会在 0.20–0.30 m/s 下把代价低估约三倍，在低噪声或隐含速度下不会。
Conclusion: 记忆截断的代价应从初始化就带着它训练来度量，且比较反向图要看优化器实际更新而非原始梯度；截断代价的大小取决于噪声体制、信用长度与优化器裁剪/自适应行为。

papers.title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2) 是流式人体动作生成框架，用 Partial Attention 让已定稿历史表征与活动窗口解耦，从而支持 KV 缓存推理与共享历史打包；并给出回归损失保持扩散条件均值速度场的充要 Bregman 判据，据此设计免在线 FK 求值的 FK 诱导二次损失，再加入精确路径条件控制角色根轨迹。训练计算量降 4.6×，去噪加速 11.29×，长序列单步更新 2.303 ms，FID 在 SEED 上 0.048、HumanML3D 上 0.053，达到流式方法的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: FD1 虽能生成合理动作，但注意力需对整段历史反复计算导致效率低，且缺乏精确轨迹控制，难以用于真实场景。
Method: 三项设计：Partial Attention 使已定稿历史表征独立于活动窗口，支持 KV-cached 推理与 shared-history packing 训练；推导回归损失保持扩散条件均值速度场的充要 Bregman 判据，并据此构造引入动作几何的 FK 诱导二次损失（无需在线 FK 求值）；加入路径条件 (path conditioning) 控制角色根轨迹同时保留自然身体动作。
Result: 训练计算量减少 4.6×，去噪加速 11.29×，长序列上每次更新 2.303 ms；动作质量优于 FD1，流式方法中 FID 达 state-of-the-art：SEED 0.048，HumanML3D 0.053。
Conclusion: 让历史表征与活动窗口解耦可同时换来 KV 缓存效率与更高质量的流式动作生成，而 Bregman 判据给出的损失设计能在不在线求 FK 的前提下保住扩散速度场。

papers.title: Downstream-Aware Context Selection for Online In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables large language model agents to adapt to new environments using their interaction history without updating model parameters. However, repeatedly conditioning on growing histories can lead to substantial token cost. We propose a bounded-history context-management framework that predicts the task-dependent downstream effect of removing historical interactions to guide history selection and determine a decision-dependent context budget. Formally, our framework uses the full rolling history as a reference. The predictor evaluates removal effects, defines a deletion ordering, and applies a shared selection criterion to determine how much history to retain at each decision. We evaluate the method in closed-loop SUMO driving under held-out in-distribution, unseen-domain, and unseen-route settings, and in ScienceWorld under a continual ICRL protocol. Relative to a baseline using the full context, our method reduces total token usage by 25.7%, 25.8%, and 23.2% across the three driving settings while maintaining comparable closed-loop driving performance. In ScienceWorld, it reduces total token usage by 52.1% compared to full context and uses 30.2% and 37.8% fewer tokens than the Recent and Similarity baselines, respectively, while maintaining performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线上下文强化学习 (ICRL) 中反复携带不断增长的交互历史会推高 token 成本，本文提出有界历史上下文管理框架：用以完整滚动历史为参照的预测器估计删除某段历史对下游决策的影响，据此给出删除顺序与决策相关的上下文预算。在 SUMO 闭环驾驶三种设定下相对全上下文基线省 25.7%、25.8%、23.2% 的 token，ScienceWorld 上省 52.1%，驾驶性能与任务性能保持相当。
Motivation: LLM 智能体靠交互历史在线适应新环境而不更新参数，但每步都以不断增长的历史为条件会带来可观的 token 开销，需要在不损失任务表现的前提下压缩上下文。
Method: 有界历史上下文管理框架：以完整滚动历史为参照，预测器评估删除各段历史交互的下游影响，由此定义删除顺序，并用统一的选择准则在每个决策点决定保留多少历史，形成决策相关的上下文预算。评测覆盖 SUMO 闭环驾驶的 held-out in-distribution、unseen-domain、unseen-route 三种设定，以及 ScienceWorld 的 continual ICRL 协议。
Result: 相对使用全上下文的基线，SUMO 三种驾驶设定的总 token 用量分别下降 25.7%、25.8%、23.2%，闭环驾驶性能相当；ScienceWorld 中总 token 用量下降 52.1%，并比 Recent 与 Similarity 两个基线分别少用 30.2% 和 37.8% 的 token，性能保持不变。
Conclusion: 按删除历史的下游影响来裁剪上下文，可以在 ICRL 中大幅削减 token 开销而基本不损失闭环性能，且上下文预算应随决策而变而非固定。

summary_sections.tldr: 在线上下文强化学习 (ICRL) 中反复携带不断增长的交互历史会推高 token 成本，本文提出有界历史上下文管理框架：用以完整滚动历史为参照的预测器估计删除某段历史对下游决策的影响，据此给出删除顺序与决策相关的上下文预算。在 SUMO 闭环驾驶三种设定下相对全上下文基线省 25.7%、25.8%、23.2% 的 token，ScienceWorld 上省 52.1%，驾驶性能与任务性能保持相当。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 智能体靠交互历史在线适应新环境而不更新参数，但每步都以不断增长的历史为条件会带来可观的 token 开销，需要在不损失任务表现的前提下压缩上下文。
summary_sections.method: 有界历史上下文管理框架：以完整滚动历史为参照，预测器评估删除各段历史交互的下游影响，由此定义删除顺序，并用统一的选择准则在每个决策点决定保留多少历史，形成决策相关的上下文预算。评测覆盖 SUMO 闭环驾驶的 held-out in-distribution、unseen-domain、unseen-route 三种设定，以及 ScienceWorld 的 continual ICRL 协议。

papers.title: Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出「动物式行为基底 (ethological behavioral substrate)」这一概念视角，主张机器人学习应把动物持续具备的、在物理/环境/社会需求竞争下保持情境性与行为连贯的能力当作目标，而非把行为拆成孤立技能；并建议以机器人动物伴侣 (robotic animal companions) 作为研究长期互动与适应的场景。
Motivation: 机器人学习造出能力越来越强的具身智能体，但对动物持续展现的这种基础能力——随时间变化保持情境性、响应性与行为连贯——关注相对不足，且这种在竞争需求下的持续协调是被低估的学习目标。
Method: 概念性 vision paper：给出 ethological behavioral substrate 作为分析视角，把动物行为从孤立技能集合重新定义为竞争需求下的持续协调；并提出 robotic animal companions 作为实验场景，用于研究社会行为、记忆与 continual learning 在长期互动中的发展。
Result: 提出两项构想性贡献——ethological behavioral substrate 概念框架与 robotic animal companions 研究场景，用于考察社会行为、记忆和持续学习在长时段互动中的发展，以及持久行为能力如何补充具身智能体的高层能力；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: 持久的行为能力 (persistent behavioral competence) 应被视为与高层能力互补的研究目标，而机器人动物伴侣是检验长期互动与适应的合适载体。

papers.title: Notes on Generative Modeling for Feedback Control and Planning
papers.abstract_en: In these notes, we view control as a dynamically constrained sampling problem on the state-space of a control system. With this viewpoint, we extend methods from generative modeling, such as flow matching, normalizing flows and denoising diffusions to control problems. Concepts such as controllability, optimal control and trajectory planning play an important role in guiding the extension and understanding well-posedeness of the corresponding algorithms, with application to steering systems to target states or distributions and sampling from reachable sets. The notes are intended as an accessible introduction for readers with a background in control theory and robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把控制问题重述为状态空间上的动态约束采样问题，据此把 flow matching、normalizing flows、denoising diffusions 等生成模型方法移植到控制与轨迹规划，用于把系统导向目标状态或目标分布、以及从可达集采样。可控性、最优控制与轨迹规划被用作指导这种移植并判断算法适定性的工具；这是一篇面向控制理论与机器人学背景读者的入门性笔记。
Motivation: 生成模型擅长无约束分布采样，而控制要求轨迹满足系统动力学约束，直接套用会失去可行性与适定性保证。
Method: 以动态约束采样视角统一控制问题，将 flow matching、normalizing flows、denoising diffusions 扩展到控制；用可控性、最优控制、轨迹规划等经典概念引导扩展并论证相应算法的 well-posedness，任务包括 steering to target states or distributions 与 sampling from reachable sets。
Result: 给出一套将生成建模方法系统性移植到反馈控制与规划的笔记式框架，覆盖目标状态/目标分布引导与可达集采样两类应用；摘要中无定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 控制可被当作动态约束的采样问题来处理，生成模型的扩展由可控性与最优控制等概念保证适定性；文本定位为入门介绍而非实验验证工作。

papers.title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Interactive benchmark dashboard: https://huggingface.co/spaces/focus-retina-benchmark/focus-retinal-benchmark-arena
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOCUS 提出跨数据集视网膜眼底模型基准，把糖尿病视网膜病变、可转诊 DR 与青光眼视神经病变任务在 10 个公开数据集上统一，评测视觉编码器 (VM)、视觉-语言双编码器 (VLM) 与多模态大模型 (MLLM) 的排序性能、校准、亚组差异与图像质量鲁棒性。532 个基础配置加 228 个经 LoRA 监督微调的 MLLM 配置显示没有模型族在所有任务与数据集上占优：通用 VM 平均排序最强，医疗 MLLM 有竞争力但波动大，VLM 经轻量适配提升明显，而微调虽改善域内表现却在外部数据集上迁移异质、校准尤其不稳。
Motivation: 单一数据集上的指标无法反映模型在数据集偏移、不同临床定义与患者亚组下的表现，而医疗影像部署必须依赖鲁棒性、校准与公平性。
Method: FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift) 统一 10 个公开眼底数据集上的二分类 DR、可转诊 DR 与青光眼视神经病变任务，覆盖 VM、VLM 与 MLLM 三类模型；统一分析层度量排序性能、校准、亚组差异与图像质量鲁棒性，MLLM 通过 LoRA 监督微调适配。
Result: 大规模评测覆盖 532 个基础配置与 228 个 LoRA 微调 MLLM 配置：无模型族在所有任务与数据集上一致占优，通用 VM 编码器平均排序性能最强，医疗 MLLM 有竞争力但表现多变，双编码器 VLM 从轻量适配中获益显著；微调提升域内性能但向外部数据集的迁移表现异质，校准上尤为突出。
Conclusion: 视网膜模型评测本质上是多维的，单数据集排行榜不足以判断泛化、可靠性与鲁棒性，需要 FOCUS 这类跨数据集公共基准来评估。

papers.title: Sharp Critical Minimax Laws and No-Learning Thresholds in Continuous-Time Adaptive Control
papers.abstract_en: We study episodic continuous-time control with an unknown vector control gain, scalar state, quadratic action cost, and smooth convex terminal cost. In the scalar Gaussian experiment, let $Δ(H)$ denote the minimax improvement over zero control and set $δ=\sqrt2H^2-1$. We prove the critical law $$ Δ(H)\asymp δ^4\sqrt{\log(1/δ)} \qquad (δ\downarrow0), $$ with a matching lower and upper bound. The lower bound follows from a uniform deficit--energy inequality valid for fully adaptive controls with unbounded amplitudes, while a moving soft-threshold feedback attains the rate. For local parameters $θ=N^{-1/4}h$, $|h|\le H$, we show that the normalized minimax regret over $N$ episodes is within $O(N^{-1/2})$ of a fixed-horizon Gaussian sequential control problem, without an additional dimension factor. The terminal task enters the limit only through $c_g=\operatorname{Var}(g(Z))$. The Gaussian problem exhibits an exact no-learning phase transition: $$ C_d^T(H)=TH^2/2 \iff H^4T\le d^2/2, $$ yielding the asymptotic task boundary $c_gH^4=d^2/2$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究连续时间自适应控制中未知向量控制增益的极小极大 (minimax) 性能极限，证明标量高斯实验下相对零控制的改进满足临界律 Δ(H) ≍ δ⁴√(log(1/δ))（δ→0），上下界匹配。给出精确的 no-learning 相变条件 H⁴T ≤ d²/2，任务边界为 c_g H⁴ = d²/2。
Motivation: 连续时间自适应控制中，未知控制增益下的极小极大改进速率与是否存在学习相变缺少精确刻画；已有界缺少对完全自适应、无界幅值控制都成立的下界。
Method: 在标量高斯 episodic 连续时间控制设定（二次动作代价、光滑凸终端代价）下，用统一的 deficit–energy 不等式给出对完全自适应控制成立的下界，再用移动软阈值反馈 (moving soft-threshold feedback) 达到该速率；对局部参数 θ=N^{-1/4}h 将 N 个 episode 的归极小极大 regret 与固定时域高斯序贯控制问题比较。
Result: 临界律 Δ(H) ≍ δ⁴√(log(1/δ))，δ=√2H²−1，上下界匹配；N episodes 归一化极小极大 regret 与固定时域高斯序贯控制问题相差 O(N^{-1/2})，且无额外维数因子；极限中终端任务仅通过 c_g=Var(g(Z)) 进入；精确相变 C_d^T(H)=TH²/2 当且仅当 H⁴T ≤ d²/2，任务边界 c_g H⁴ = d²/2。
Conclusion: 连续时间高斯自适应控制存在精确的 no-learning 相变，临界改进速率由 δ⁴√(log(1/δ)) 刻画，终端任务对极限的影响可压缩为单个方差 c_g。

papers.title: What Does a Skill Actually Do? Estimands and Evaluation Validity for Tool and Skill Use in LLM Agents: A Critical Review
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly draw on external tools and reusable skills selected at run time from libraries that hold thousands of entries. Reports that a retriever, router, or skill library "improves" an agent may refer to retrieval recall, the success change from enabling a library, a paired contrast restricted to triggered tasks, or a gain under an approximate budget constraint. This critical review asks what each design compares and under which assumptions. Building on estimand-based approaches to agent evaluation, we describe tool and skill designs along six axes: treatment contrast, target population, outcome, budget constraint, summary measure, and identification assumptions. Thirteen core empirical studies anchor the evidence synthesis, supplemented by related methodological work and design-level reading of the wider literature. Our contribution is to make explicit distinctions that some source authors already acknowledge through a decomposition of trigger-conditioned pairing, analytic counterexamples, and comparisons across studies. Pairing on the task does not by itself identify an invocation effect; paired gain and regression counts measure protocol-specific discordance rather than the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen; and total effects of module deployment answer a different question from budget-constrained efficiency. We compare curated skill provision with retriever replacement, triggered subsets with all-task outcomes, and observed cost reductions with budget-constrained comparisons. A reporting checklist and worked examples connect these distinctions to information that studies can report. The review runs no new experiments; empirical results come from the cited studies, and numerical toy examples are analytical illustrations.

Motivation: 从上千条条目的技能库中运行时选工具的报告里，“improve”可能指检索召回、启用库的成功率变化、仅在触发任务上的配对对比或近似预算下的增益，四种说法混用导致结论不可比。
Method: 以 estimand 框架沿六个轴刻画工具与技能设计，用 13 项核心实证研究锚定证据综合，辅以触发条件配对的分解、解析反例与跨研究比较，并给出报告清单与 worked examples；综述本身不跑新实验，数值 toy example 为解析说明。

papers.title: Convergence of Practical Muon
papers.abstract_en: Muon is emerging as a promising alternative to AdamW for large-scale neural network training, yet theoretical understanding of its practical implementation remains incomplete, as existing analyses often simplify or omit two key components: (i) practical Newton--Schulz iterations with empirically tuned polynomial coefficients $(3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315)$; and (ii) decoupled weight decay for regularization. In this paper, we provide an optimization interpretation and establish convergence for practical Muon, jointly accounting for both components. Specifically, we interpret practical Muon as right-preconditioned optimization of the original loss with a dynamic weighted $\ell_2$ regularizer that vanishes as stationarity is approached, so that the optimization target remains the original objective. We then establish, to our best knowledge, the first convergence guarantee for practical Muon in the stochastic nonconvex setting, with an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate in terms of the expected Frobenius norm of the gradient, improving the dimension dependence of the best known AdamW's convergence rate by a factor of $\sqrt{d}$, where $T$ is the iteration horizon and $d$ is the parameter dimension. Experiments further support the theoretical convergence results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把实用 Muon（含经验调参的 Newton--Schulz 多项式系数 (3.4445,-4.7750,2.0315) 与解耦 weight decay）解释为带动态衰减 ℓ2 正则的右预条件优化，并给出随机非凸设定下的首个收敛保证：期望梯度 Frobenius 范数以 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛，维度依赖比已知最优 AdamW 结果改善 √d 因子。
Motivation: 现有 Muon 分析常简化或忽略实用实现的两个关键部件——Newton--Schulz 迭代的经验多项式系数与解耦 weight decay——导致实用版缺乏理论支撑。
Method: 将实用 Muon 解释为对原始损失的右预条件优化，配一个随接近平稳点而消失的动态加权 ℓ2 正则，从而优化目标仍是原始目标；在此框架下推导随机非凸设定的收敛保证，并辅以实验支持理论结论。
Result: 在随机非凸设定下得到首个实用 Muon 收敛保证，期望梯度 Frobenius 范数收敛率为 O(T^{-1/4})（T 为迭代步数、d 为参数维度），维度依赖相对已知最优 AdamW 收敛率改善 √d 因子；实验支持该理论结果。
Conclusion: 实用 Muon 的两个部件可统一进一个目标不漂移的正则化预条件框架，并在随机非凸问题上获得带 √d 维度优势的收敛保证。

papers.title: Not Too Hard, Not Too Easy: Learning from Intermediate States for LLM Structured Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: A common principle of effective learning is to practice material that is neither already mastered nor too difficult to permit progress. We ask how to apply this principle to structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. In these tasks, a model can repeatedly revise an incomplete or incorrect candidate solution until it satisfies the problem's constraints. The intermediate candidate solutions along this trajectory provide natural training examples: some are already solved, some cannot yet be repaired by the model, and others lie at its current frontier of achievable progress. We therefore investigate whether pretrained language models can learn to revise such states and whether training on states at this frontier improves reasoning more broadly. To achieve this, we couple a pretrained language-model backbone with a recurrent updater that repeatedly revises an explicit solution state, using the same parameters at every update step. We further introduce Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories (FOCUS), which selects training states from trajectories generated by the current model. FOCUS measures how much the model improves each state within a fixed number of recurrent updates and prioritizes states from which it can make substantial progress. With Qwen3-1.7B, FOCUS achieves 64.4% exact solve accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and 91.1% on Maze-Hard, with similar gains observed across five Qwen and Llama backbones spanning 1.7B to 8B parameters. We further observe zero-shot transfer in the adapted LLM to mathematical reasoning and code execution, even when the recurrent updater is disabled and no downstream fine-tuning is performed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FOCUS（Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories）：用当前模型自生成轨迹，按固定步数内可改进的幅度挑选处于能力前沿的中间解状态，训练语言模型反复修订显式解状态。Qwen3-1.7B 上 Sudoku-Extreme 精确解题率 64.4%、Maze-Hard 91.1%，五个 1.7B–8B Qwen/Llama 骨干均有类似增益，并零样本迁移到数学推理与代码执行。
Motivation: 结构化推理任务中模型可反复修订候选解，但已掌握或完全超出能力的状态都不是有效训练样本；缺少一种从模型自生成轨迹中自动挑出“不太难也不太易”中间状态的准则。
Method: 将预训练语言模型与循环更新器 (recurrent updater) 耦合，每步用同一参数反复修订显式解状态；FOCUS 从当前模型自生成轨迹中度量每个状态在固定次数更新内的改进量，优先选取可取得实质进展的状态作为训练样本。
Result: Qwen3-1.7B + FOCUS 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 64.4% exact solve accuracy，在 Maze-Hard 上 91.1%；五个 Qwen 与 Llama 骨干（1.7B 至 8B 参数）上观察到类似增益；适配后的 LLM 在关闭循环更新器且不做下游微调时，仍零样本迁移到数学推理与代码执行。
Conclusion: 在模型自身能力前沿的中间状态上训练，能提升结构化推理并把收益泛化到数学与代码任务，且这种迁移不依赖循环更新器或下游微调。

papers.title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DroneWAM 是面向无人机视觉导航的高效 world-action model：用 JEPA 在表征空间直接预测未来状态而不生成图像，预训练 Resampler 把稠密视觉特征压成更少 latent token，并由偏好训练的 Gate 按场景自适应分配 rollout 深度。在自建 DroneNav-6D 上取得对比方法中最好的轨迹精度，自适应 rollout 把平均预测深度从 8 降到 4.58 的同时轨迹精度还提升。
Motivation: 无人机视觉导航要求 agent 预判候选动作如何改变未来观测，但显式生成未来图像的 world model 在精度与效率双重约束下代价过高，且各场景所需的预测深度并不相同。
Method: JEPA 架构在表征空间建模未来状态，避免显式未来图像生成；预训练 Resampler 将稠密 encoder 特征压缩为更少 latent token，降低每个想象步的重复计算；偏好训练的 Gate 依据当前场景自适应分配预测深度（adaptive rollout）。同时构建模拟数据集 DroneNav-6D，含同步 RGB 观测、6-DoF 飞行轨迹、控制指令与随机化风扰。
Result: 在 DroneNav-6D 上，DroneWAM 在所比较方法中轨迹精度最佳；adaptive rollout 将平均预测深度由 8 降至 4.58，同时轨迹精度提升。
Conclusion: 预测性计算可以按场景更有效地分配：不必对所有场景固定深度 rollout，自适应缩短深度既省算力又不损失、反而改善轨迹精度。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CFLoRA: Federated Fine-tuning of LLMs with Complementary Factors for Error-free Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables collaborative fine-tuning of large language models without centralizing private client data. Its factorized update, however, creates a structural mismatch in federated averaging: averaging the two LoRA factors separately does not equal averaging their products. Existing exact methods resolve this issue mainly by freezing an entire factor or alternating factors across rounds, but none can update factors simultaneously without aggregation errors or expanding communication ranks. To address this fundamental problem, we present \texttt{CFLoRA}, a federated LoRA scheme that partitions latent LoRA channels into two complementary sets in every communication round. By ensuring that columns and rows are complementary across factors, we eliminate bilinear terms in matrix multiplications, making federated aggregation exact. Crucially, our framework also supports clients with heterogeneous rank budgets. Convergence analysis validates \texttt{CFLoRA} achieves $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence rate of the \textit{original} LoRA objective in homogeneous-rank cases. Extensive experiments with RoBERTa on the GLUE benchmark and with LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct on commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that \texttt{CFLoRA} achieves superior performance and training efficiency compared to state-of-the-art federated LoRA baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CFLoRA 把 LoRA 的隐通道在每轮通信中划成两组互补集合，使两因子的列与行互补、双线性项被消去，从而在不冻结因子、不扩大通信秩的前提下实现精确联邦聚合。收敛分析给出齐秩情形下对原始 LoRA 目标 O(1/√T) 的收敛率，RoBERTa/GLUE 与 LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct 常识推理实验显示其性能与训练效率优于现有联邦 LoRA 基线。
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 的两个因子分别平均不等于乘积的平均，聚合存在结构性误差；已有精确方法要么整轮冻结一个因子、要么跨轮交替更新，无法同时更新两因子又不引入聚合误差或扩大通信秩。
Method: 每轮通信把 LoRA 隐通道划成两组互补集合，令 A、B 两因子的列与行互补，使矩阵乘法中的双线性项被消去，联邦平均因此精确；框架同时支持各客户端秩预算异构，并给出齐秩情形的收敛性分析。
Result: 收敛分析给出原始 LoRA 目标在齐秩情形下 O(1/√T) 的收敛率；在 RoBERTa 上的 GLUE 基准与 LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct 上的常识推理任务中，性能与训练效率均优于 SOTA 联合 LoRA 基线。
Conclusion: 通过互补通道划分可以让联邦 LoRA 聚合做到精确且两因子同时更新，同时保住原 LoRA 目标的收敛保证并兼容异构秩预算。

papers.title: LiteEvo: Automated, Cost-Efficient Harness Evolution for Generalization to Unseen Tasks
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent is defined by two things: the weights inside its model and the harness of components assembled around it. Harnesses are still handcrafted, and HarnessX, which evolves them automatically, starts each benchmark from a handcrafted harness, reports gains on the tasks it evolved on, and budgets 100 to 175 million meta-agent tokens per benchmark. We propose LiteEvo, a lightweight harness-evolution algorithm whose tool-free meta-agents mine agent trajectories for reusable components, curate them into a versioned library, and compose each round's harness from it, starting every benchmark from the same neutral harness and never naming the benchmark. Evolving on the graded tasks of five agentic benchmarks with a frozen Qwen3.5-9B, LiteEvo lifts pass@2 by 10.5 to 67.7pp and reaches comparable or higher pass@2 than a reproduction of HarnessX (71.0 against 67.3 on average) at 13.0 lower mean API cost. Harnesses evolved on train tasks keep their gains on unseen test tasks of four benchmarks, and LiteEvo also lifts Claude Code with Sonnet 4.6 by 1.2 to 71.4pp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiteEvo 用无工具的 meta-agent 从 agent 轨迹中挖掘可复用组件、维护版本化组件库，并从中组装每轮 harness，每个 benchmark 都从中性 harness 起步且不被告知 benchmark 名称。在五个 agentic benchmark 的训练任务上用冻结的 Qwen3.5-9B 进化，pass@2 提升 10.5 至 67.7pp，平均 71.0 对 HarnessX 复现的 67.3，且平均 API 成本低 13.0。
Motivation: LLM agent 的 harness 仍靠手工搭建；现有自动进化方法 HarnessX 每个 benchmark 都从手工 harness 出发、只在进化所用任务上报收益，且每个 benchmark 花费 100 到 175 million meta-agent tokens。
Method: tool-free meta-agent 挖掘 agent 轨迹中的可复用组件，整理成 versioned library，每轮 harness 从库中组装；所有 benchmark 统一从中性 harness 起步，进化过程不输入 benchmark 名称，模型权重冻结为 Qwen3.5-9B。
Result: 在五个 agentic benchmark 的训练任务上 pass@2 提升 10.5 至 67.7pp；平均 pass@2 71.0，对比 HarnessX 复现的 67.3，平均 API 成本低 13.0；在四个 benchmark 的未见测试任务上保持训练任务的收益；对 Claude Code + Sonnet 4.6 也提升 1.2 至 71.4pp。
Conclusion: 从中性起点、不依赖 benchmark 名称的组件库式 harness 进化，能在更低成本下达到或超过 HarnessX 复现的水平，并把训练任务上的收益迁移到未见测试任务。

papers.title: Beyond the Training Horizon: Mechanisms and Limits of Length Generalization in Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers can generalize to reasoning chains longer than those encountered during training, but the computations enabling this behavior and limiting its extent remain unclear. We mechanistically compare two looped-Transformer configurations, which we call the Matched-Recurrence Looped Transformer (MR-Loop) and Decoupled-Recurrence Looped Transformer (DR-Loop), reflecting their respective recurrence-training schemes. We evaluate polynomial iteration, finite-state composition, and knowledge-graph traversal using detailed mechanistic analysis. Attention analysis, intermediate-state decoding, and causal interventions reveal distinct mechanisms learned under final-answer supervision. MR-Loop updates an intermediate state at a fixed readout while advancing relation selection through adjacent-token interactions and a transferable progress cue. DR-Loop instead propagates intermediate states across relation positions, forming an advancing computational frontier. However, both mechanisms become unreliable at greater depths: MR-Loop exhibits degradation of its readout state and progress cues, while DR-Loop exhibits declining reliability of state propagation. Limited self-correction allows local errors to persist and compound. Across both models, we uncover a common representational principle: recurrent states encode not only task-relevant content but also its computational status, whether that content remains in a form that can support subsequent computation. Transferable live-consumed and fresh-aged residual directions causally control whether represented information can participate in subsequent computation, including beyond the training horizon. We further show that length generalization need not rely on faithful step-by-step reasoning, as Looped Transformers can exploit task structure without explicitly representing every intermediate state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对两种循环 Transformer（MR-Loop 与 DR-Loop）做机制比较，发现长度泛化来自不同的中间状态更新机制，且受可迁移的残差方向因果控制；但深度增大后两种机制都失效，MR-Loop 的读出态与进度线索退化、DR-Loop 的状态传播可靠性下降，局部错误因自纠错有限而累积。
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 能外推到比训练更长的推理链，但支撑该行为的计算机制及其失效边界尚不清楚。
Method: 在多项式迭代、有限状态复合与知识图谱遍历三类任务上，用注意力分析、中间态解码与因果干预对比 MR-Loop（匹配循环训练）与 DR-Loop（解耦循环训练）在最终答案监督下学到的机制。
Result: MR-Loop 在固定读出位置更新中间态、经相邻 token 交互推进关系选择并携带可迁移进度线索；DR-Loop 跨关系位置传播中间态形成推进的计算前沿。两者在更大深度均失效：MR-Loop 读出态与进度线索退化，DR-Loop 状态传播可靠性下降，有限自纠错使局部错误持续并复合。识别出可迁移的 live-consumed 与 fresh-aged 残差方向，因果控制信息能否参与后续计算（含超出训练视野），并显示长度泛化可不依赖逐步忠实推理。
Conclusion: 长度泛化的共同原理是循环状态同时编码任务内容与其计算状态，而超出训练视野的可靠性取决于这些残差方向；模型可利用任务结构而无需显式表示每个中间态。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CAME: Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts for Interpretable Quarter-Ahead Revenue Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Quarter-ahead revenue forecasting requires company-scale numerical accuracy, strict temporal validity, and company-specific interpretation of narrative disclosures. LLMs can distill textual evidence but can produce scale-misaligned forecasts, whereas history-based anchors are stable but miss forecast-time signals such as product transitions, supply constraints, and management guidance. We introduce CAME (Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts), a residual-forecasting framework that refines a no-leakage statistical anchor when current semantic evidence and prior error patterns justify an adjustment. On a development-inclusive rolling backtest of 336 company-quarters from 12 large public technology and platform firms, CAME achieves the lowest aggregate point-estimate error among the reported methods, with statistically supported macro-sMAPE gains over the matched Statistical Anchor, and outperforms History + Guidance on all six aggregate metrics. CAME also links adjustments to source-linked evidence cards and guarded memory traces, supporting forecast inspection, provenance, and failure localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAME 是面向季度营收预测的残差预测框架：以无泄漏统计锚为基线，仅当当前语义证据与既往误差模式足以支撑时才做调整，并把调整挂到带来源的 evidence card 与受保护的 memory trace 上。在 12 家大型科技与平台公司 336 个 company-quarter 的滚动回测中，其聚合点估计误差在所报方法中最低，macro-sMAPE 相对匹配的 Statistical Anchor 有统计显著增益，并在全部六项聚合指标上超过 History + Guidance。
Motivation: 季度营收预测既要数值精度、时间无泄漏，又要对披露文本做公司级解释；LLM 能提炼文本证据但会给出量级错配的预测，历史锚稳定却错过产品转型、供应约束与管理层指引等预测时点信号。
Method: CAME（Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts）采用残差预测：以无泄漏统计锚为基线，由语义证据与既往误差模式决定是否调整；调整关联 source-linked evidence cards 与 guarded memory traces，支持检查、溯源与失败定位。评测用含开发集的滚动回测。
Result: 在 12 家大型上市科技与平台公司共 336 个 company-quarter 的滚动回测上，CAME 在所报方法中取得最低的聚合点估计误差；相对匹配的 Statistical Anchor 有统计支持的 macro-sMAPE 增益，并在全部六项聚合指标上优于 History + Guidance。
Conclusion: 以统计锚为基线、只在证据充分时做残差调整，可以在保持无泄漏的同时提升季度营收预测精度，并让每次调整可检查、可溯源、可定位失败。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise (100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, creates data privacy concerns, and, given the costs of running these models, can rapidly escalate expenses associated with supporting agentic features. This paper introduces a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches. These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring classes of actions completely on-device -- reducing latency, enhancing privacy, and lowering operational costs. We show that for a classic NL-to-Formula task, generating Excel Formula in response to user requests, this approach reduces total inference cost by 56% when compared to cloud-only model-routing based inference and, on cache hits, reduces the latency to response latency by 5x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 NL-to-Action 从生成问题改写成以设备端操作缓存 (on-device operation cache) 为核心的分类问题：高频动作类完全在本地命中，只有未命中才回退到云端大模型。在 Excel Formula 生成任务上，相比仅靠云端模型路由的推理，总推理成本下降 56%，缓存命中时响应延迟降至原来的 1/5。
Motivation: 嵌入软件的 agentic AI 依赖 100B+ 参数级云端 LLM 做 NL 到软件操作的转换，带来网络延迟、数据隐私和随调用量快速攀升的推理成本。
Method: 将 NL-to-Action 从生成式任务重构为分类中心 (classification-centric) 形式：用设备端 operation cache 覆盖高频动作类，命中即本地完成，未命中再走云端模型路由；以经典 NL-to-Formula（按用户请求生成 Excel Formula）作为验证任务。
Result: 在 Excel Formula 生成任务上，相比 cloud-only model-routing 推理，总推理成本降低 56%；缓存命中时响应延迟降低到 1/5（5x）。
Conclusion: 高频动作可由设备端分类缓存直接消化，只有长尾请求才需要云端大模型，从而同时压低延迟、成本并改善隐私。

papers.title: Leaky Students: Membership Inference against On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated trajectories. However, privileged information supplied to the teacher for OPD training may contain sensitive data. Whether the student leaks private information about the records supplied to the teacher during distillation remains poorly understood. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first systematic study of membership inference in this setting. We find that fresh student trajectories expose sparse membership signals that fixed reference-answer losses often miss. These signals are mixed with probability changes caused by training on other records. We introduce Leaky, which samples fresh trajectories from the target model and compares its token log-probabilities with the maximum across matched reference models trained without the candidate records. It applies Leaky ReLU to the resulting gaps, preserving positive gaps and downweighting negative gaps as an approximate correction for incidental positive gaps in non-members. Across fifteen targets spanning mathematics, medical question answering, and code generation, Leaky outperforms all evaluated baselines and achieves mean AUROC 0.875, compared with 0.614 for the strongest baseline on each target in the main evaluation. On the same sampled trajectories, the strongest baseline achieves mean AUROC 0.826. These results show that students trained through OPD can expose the membership of records used for teacher supervision, even when fixed reference-answer losses provide little evidence of membership.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中学生模型可能泄露教师监督记录的问题，提出成员推断攻击 Leaky：从目标模型采样新轨迹，将其 token log-probability 与多个未见过候选记录的匹配参考模型的最大值作差，再用 Leaky ReLU 保留正差、压低负差。在横跨数学、医疗问答、代码生成的 15 个目标上，Leaky 平均 AUROC 0.875，最强基线 0.614（同批采样轨迹上 0.826）。
Motivation: OPD 训练中提供给教师的特权信息可能含敏感数据，学生是否在蒸馏中泄露这些记录的成员关系此前缺乏系统研究。
Method: Leaky 从目标模型采样新轨迹，比较其 token log-probability 与多个未训练候选记录的匹配参考模型上的最大 log-probability，对差值施加 Leaky ReLU：保留正差、对负差降权，作为对非成员偶然正差的近似修正；在 15 个跨领域目标上与全部评估基线对比。
Result: 在 15 个目标（数学、医疗问答、代码生成）上，Leaky 平均 AUROC 0.875，主评估中每个目标上最强基线平均 0.614；在相同采样轨迹上最强基线平均 AUROC 0.826。定性发现：学生新轨迹携带稀疏成员信号，固定参考答案损失常捕捉不到，且这些信号与其他记录训练引起的概率变化混杂。
Conclusion: 经 OPD 训练的学生会暴露用于教师监督的记录成员关系，即便固定参考答案损失几乎不提供成员证据；采样新轨迹并做非对称差值修正是有效的攻击路径。

papers.title: Ceiling of a Task: When Can a Transformer Succeed Without Its Chain of Thought?
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models generate long chains of thought before they answer, yet it is debated whether the content of these chains does real computational work or is largely decorative. We study this question by viewing a transformer as a shallow circuit. One forward pass through a fixed number of layers has constant depth, so any procedure that runs the model a constant number of times is a shallow circuit. We call the best accuracy that a shallow circuit can reach on a task the ceiling of the task, and a task is serial if its ceiling lies below one. We prove three results on serial tasks that hold for every transformer, no matter how it was trained. Necessity: replacing the chain by anything that does not depend on its content, such as filler tokens or a restatement of the question, drives the accuracy down to the ceiling, and on a maximally serial task down to chance. Depth: no shallow computation can write the chain of a model whose accuracy exceeds the ceiling, not even approximately. Locality: the answer is one shallow pass away from the finished chain, so all of the serial reasoning happens in the chain. On word problems of finite groups, whose ceilings are known, small transformers trained from scratch, with or without reinforcement learning, attain the predicted numbers: chain-trained models solve every input length and fall to chance when the chain is erased, chainless models collapse to the ceiling as the input length grows, and open-weight reasoning models given the same problem in words return to the baseline without their chain. On MATH-500 and AIME, erasing the chain costs open reasoning models 0.52 to 0.82 accuracy, a sentence shuffle is harmless, and a token shuffle is as harmful as erasing; the same holds for checkpoints trained by GRPO with a correct or a random reward. The ceiling of a task therefore answers when a transformer can succeed without its chain of thought.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 transformer 视为浅电路，定义任务的 ceiling（浅电路可达的最高准确率），证明 serial 任务上链式思考不可被替代：删链或换成 filler 会把准确率压到 ceiling、极大 serial 任务压到随机；MATH-500 与 AIME 上删链使开放推理模型损失 0.52–0.82 准确率，token 打乱与删链等害，句子打乱无害。
Motivation: 推理模型的长 chain of thought 究竟在做真实计算还是装饰性内容存在争议，需要一个与训练方式无关的判据来说明何时 transformer 可以不靠链成功。
Method: 将固定层数 transformer 的单次前向视为浅电路，定义任务 ceiling 与 serial 任务；证明 Necessity、Depth、Locality 三条对任意训练方式的 transformer 都成立的结论，并在有限群 word problems（ceiling 已知）上从头训练小 transformer（含/不含 RL），对照开放权重推理模型与 GRPO 检查点。
Result: 有限群 word problems 上，chain-trained 模型解出所有输入长度、删链后掉到随机，chainless 模型随输入长度增长塌到 ceiling，开放权重推理模型去掉链后回到 baseline；MATH-500 与 AIME 上删链损失 0.52–0.82 准确率，句子打乱无害、token 打乱与删链同样有害，GRPO 用正确或随机 reward 训练的检查点表现一致。
Conclusion: 任务的 ceiling 决定 transformer 能否不靠 chain of thought 成功：serial 任务上链的内容不可替代，且全部串行推理发生在链里。

papers.title: Quantum Monte Carlo Tree Search with Fixed Confidence
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in quantum computing are opening new opportunities for computationally intensive decision problems. This paper studies how quantum computing can improve Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) in the fixed-confidence setting, where the goal is to identify a near-optimal move in a given game tree with high probability while minimizing query complexity. We first formulate MCTS under a quantum oracle model. We then develop a quantum MCTS algorithm (QMCTS) that combines threshold-based elimination on the search tree with quantum Monte Carlo estimation to reduce the cost of evaluating stochastic leaf values. We establish an instance-dependent lower bound on the query complexity and derive a corresponding upper bound for QMCTS. The lower-bound analysis introduces a new quantum phase-testing result that may also be useful beyond MCTS. We validate the theoretical results through simulation experiments and further demonstrate the feasibility of QMCTS on real quantum hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定置信度设定下把 MCTS 形式化为量子 oracle 模型，提出 QMCTS：用搜索树上的阈值消除 (threshold-based elimination) 剪枝，配合量子 Monte Carlo 估计降低随机叶值评估成本。建立了实例依赖的查询复杂度下界并给出 QMCTS 的匹配上界，下界分析引入新的量子相位检验 (quantum phase-testing) 结果，理论经仿真验证并在真实量子硬件上演示可行性。
Motivation: 固定置信度博弈树搜索要在高概率找近优走法的同时最小化查询复杂度，而随机叶值的 Monte Carlo 评估成本是主要瓶颈，经典 MCTS 在此设定下缺少实例依赖的复杂度刻画。
Method: 先把 MCTS 写成量子 oracle 模型；QMCTS 在搜索树上做阈值消除以淘汰次优分支，叶值评估改用量子 Monte Carlo 估计；下界由新的量子相位检验结果导出，上界与之对应，并用仿真加真实量子硬件验证。
Result: 给出实例依赖的查询复杂度下界与 QMCTS 的对应上界；理论结果通过仿真实验验证，并在真实量子硬件上展示 QMCTS 的可行性。
Conclusion: 量子估计与阈值消除结合可在固定置信度下降低 MCTS 的查询复杂度，且新的量子相位检验结果可迁移到 MCTS 之外的问题。

papers.title: ILP-BO: Integer Linear Programming-Based Black-Box Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box Optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for optimizing expensive objective functions or unknown functions with a limited number of evaluations. A central step of standard BO such as Bayesian optimization is the optimization of a surrogate-based acquisition criterion, which is commonly performed using nonlinear optimization or heuristic search. Therefore, conventional black-box optimization generally does not guarantee global optimality in candidate selection. In this study, we propose Integer Linear Programming-based Black-box Optimization (ILP-BO), a quasi-Bayesian optimization framework that transforms kernel-based surrogate optimization over discrete domains into an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem. The key idea is to represent nonlinear kernel functions exactly on finite discrete distance levels by introducing binary one-hot auxiliary variables. This transformation converts the nonlinear surrogate into a linear objective with linear constraints and binary variables. To incorporate exploration while preserving the linear structure, we further introduce a Hamming-distance margin that excludes neighborhoods around previously observed points. We derive the proposed formulation for several standard kernels and obtain an analytical upper bound on the Hamming-distance threshold based on the measure in the binary search space. The resulting candidate-selection problem can be solved by integer programming solvers with certificates of optimality. Thus, our methodology has the potential to serve as a highly transparent black-box optimization framework. Experiments on synthetic and discrete optimization benchmarks show that ILP-BO achieves competitive optimization performance compared with practical Bayesian optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ILP-BO 把离散域上基于核的采集函数优化精确改写为整数线性规划 (ILP)：用 one-hot 二值辅助变量把非线性核在有限离散距离层级上精确线性化，再加 Hamming 距离 margin 排除已观测点邻域以保留探索。候选选择由整数规划求解器求解并带最优性证书，在合成与离散优化基准上取得与实用贝叶斯优化方法相当的性能。
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化的采集准则通常用非线性优化或启发式搜索求解，候选选择因此不保证全局最优，选择过程也不透明。
Method: 提出 quasi-Bayesian optimization 框架 ILP-BO：引入二值 one-hot 辅助变量，把有限离散距离层级上的核函数精确表示为线性目标加线性约束加二值变量；为在保持线性结构的同时引入探索，加入排除已观测点邻域的 Hamming-distance margin，并基于二值搜索空间上的测度导出 Hamming 阈值的解析上界；对若干标准核给出该形式化。
Result: 在合成与离散优化基准上，ILP-BO 的优化性能与实用贝叶斯优化方法相当；候选选择问题可由整数规划求解器求解并给出最优性证书；对若干标准核导出形式化并得到 Hamming 距离阈值的解析上界。
Conclusion: 把离散域的代理优化整体搬进 ILP，可以在候选选择上拿到全局最优性证书，使黑盒优化框架更透明，同时不牺牲与常规贝叶斯优化相当的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow-Matching-Based Protein Structure Tokenizer Made Efficient and Easy
papers.abstract_en: As the bridge between protein modality and discrete modeling, protein structure tokenization still largely relies on heavily engineered training objectives tailored to specific downstream tasks and large training datasets, which hinders its transfer to broader application scenarios. To address this issue, we propose ProFiT, a lightweight flow matching tokenizer. With simple training strategies that encourage healthy codebook utilization, ProFiT can be trained efficiently and naturally learns semantically meaningful representations without any manual semantic alignment, while achieving reconstruction quality and generalization that match or surpass those of substantially larger tokenizers. We conduct extensive evaluations across a wide range of settings and demonstrate that ProFiT is a plug-and-play tokenizer adaptable to diverse downstream tasks. This study further reveals the significant potential of the flow matching tokenizer paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QDKStorm/ProFiT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProFiT 用轻量 flow matching 做蛋白质结构 tokenizer，靠鼓励 codebook 健康利用的简单训练策略，在不做人工语义对齐的情况下学到语义有意义的表示，重建质量与泛化能力匹配或超过体量大得多的 tokenizer，并可作为即插即用组件适配多种下游任务。
Motivation: 蛋白质结构 tokenization 目前高度依赖为特定下游任务手工设计的训练目标和大规模训练数据，限制了向更广应用场景的迁移。
Method: 提出轻量 flow matching tokenizer ProFiT，采用鼓励 codebook 健康利用的简单训练策略，无需任何人工语义对齐即可训练，并在多种设置下做评测，作为即插即用 tokenizer 接入不同下游任务。
Result: 在广泛设置的评测中，重建质量与泛化能力匹配或超越体量大得多的 tokenizer，并展示其可适配多样下游任务的即插即用特性；代码已公开于 github.com/QDKStorm/ProFiT。
Conclusion: flow matching tokenizer 范式本身具有显著潜力：简单训练策略即可替代重度工程化的训练目标，同时保持竞争力的重建与泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Policy Plasticity Matters in Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning: Refitting Offline Policies for Online Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (O2O RL) has emerged as a practical paradigm that pre-trains the policy using static offline datasets and subsequently adapts the policy through online interactions. Existing O2O methods primarily address the transition through value calibration, while generally treating the offline-trained policy as a given initialization. We instead study O2O adaptation from the perspective of network plasticity, asking whether the offline-trained policy remains sufficiently adaptable for online learning. Controlled experiments show that prolonged optimization on static offline data progressively reduces network plasticity even after offline performance has largely saturated, and that lower plasticity is associated with weaker subsequent online improvement. Motivated by these observations, we propose REstoring plasticity via Fresh Initialization and policy Transfer (REFIT), a lightweight model-level method for the O2O transition. Before online fine-tuning, REFIT distills the offline policy into a freshly initialized student while temporarily freezing a random subset of student units, transferring the learned offline behavior to a more plastic policy initialization. Extensive experiments on D4RL and OGBench demonstrate that REFIT consistently achieves higher aggregate performance than existing O2O plug-in methods across both Cal-QL and IQL backbones, while plasticity diagnostics and ablations provide further evidence of restored network plasticity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离线预训练越久，网络可塑性 (plasticity) 越低，后续在线提升越弱；REFIT 在在线微调前把离线策略蒸馏到全新初始化的学生网络并临时冻结随机单元子集，把学到的离线行为转移到更可塑的初始化上。在 D4RL 与 OGBench 上，作为 Cal-QL 和 IQL 的即插即用 (plug-in) 组件，REFIT 的汇总性能持续高于现有 O2O 方法。
Motivation: 现有 O2O RL 主要做价值校准 (value calibration)，把离线策略当作给定初始化，忽略了静态数据上长期优化会削弱网络可塑性、从而拖累在线适应这一缺口。
Method: REFIT 是模型级轻量方法：在线微调前用蒸馏把离线策略转移到全新初始化的学生网络，训练中临时冻结学生单元的一个随机随机子集，从而得到更可塑的策略初始化；作为 plug-in 挂在 Cal-QL 与 IQL 两个骨干上。
Result: 受控实验显示静态离线数据上的持续优化在网络性能基本饱和后仍继续降低可塑性，且低可塑性与更弱的后续在线提升相关；在 D4RL 与 OGBench 上，REFIT 的汇总性能在 Cal-QL 和 IQL 两个骨干上均一致高于现有 O2O plug-in 方法，并有可塑性诊断与消融支持。
Conclusion: 离线策略不应被当作固定初始化：把离线行为转移到全新且更可塑的网络上，是比单纯价值校准更有效的 O2O 过渡手段。
