summary_sections.result: 受控实验显示静态离线数据上的持续优化在网络性能基本饱和后仍继续降低可塑性，且低可塑性与更弱的后续在线提升相关；在 D4RL 与 OGBench 上，REFIT 的汇总性能在 Cal-QL 和 IQL 两个骨干上均一致高于现有 O2O plug-in 方法，并有可塑性诊断与消融支持。
summary_sections.conclusion: 离线策略不应被当作固定初始化：把离线行为转移到全新且更可塑的网络上，是比单纯价值校准更有效的 O2O 过渡手段。

papers.title: Save Your Saturated Data: Learning Beyond Reward Saturation in Group-Based RL
papers.abstract_en: Group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) relies on reward variation among sampled responses to estimate informative relative advantages. As language models become increasingly capable, existing training data can become reward-saturated: all sampled responses to the same problem might receive equally high rewards, where the group-relative learning signals vanish and leave previously useful data obsolete. In this work, we investigate whether useful learning signals can be recovered from such saturated data. We study interventions at four levels of group-policy RL pipelines---data, rollout, reward, and advantage---and conduct extensive RL training on saturated reasoning data only. While standard GRPO on saturated data would almost always yield near-0 advantages and near-noise signals, diverse interventions successfully recycle and repurpose such data: among the proposed strategies, interventions at rollout generation are consistently most effective: nudging the policy to generate ``high-quality'', incorrect solutions introduces rollouts with poor rewards into saturated groups as negative samples, which turns out to improve GRPO by 6.4% to 9.0% across Qwen3-1.7B and 4B. Other interventions such as increasing rollout temperature or adding auxiliary rewards can also restore non-zero advantages, but yield less consistent gains. Further analyses show that effective negative rollouts require informative negative trajectories, that the method remains effective alongside unsaturated data, and that it supports iterative recycling of newly saturated examples. While increasingly stronger LLMs would render more data as saturated, our results demonstrate that don't waste your saturated data: with the right strategies they can be recycled into useful RL training signals in an increasingly data-scarce world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在组相对强化学习 (GRPO) 中，同一问题的所有采样回复都拿满分时组内优势趋近 0、学习信号消失。作者在数据、rollout、奖励、优势四个层面做干预，发现 rollout 生成端最有效：诱导策略产出高质量但错误的解，把低奖励 rollout 作为负样本注入饱和组，在 Qwen3-1.7B 与 4B 上把 GRPO 提升 6.4% 到 9.0%。
Motivation: 随着 LLM 能力增强，现有推理训练数据逐渐奖励饱和，组内奖励无差异使相对优势消失，原本有用的数据变得废弃，而可用数据正日益稀缺。
Method: 在组策略 RL 流水线的数据、rollout、奖励、优势四个层级设计干预，仅在饱和推理数据上做大量 RL 训练；核心策略是让策略生成高奖励之外的“高质量错误解”，向饱和组注入低奖励 rollout 作为负样本，另含提高 rollout 温度、加辅助奖励等对照干预。
Result: 标准 GRPO 在饱和数据上几乎总是得到近 0 的优势与近噪声信号；rollout 端干预在 Qwen3-1.7B 和 4B 上使 GRPO 提升 6.4% 到 9.0%；提高 rollout 温度或加辅助奖励也能恢复非零优势，但收益更不稳定。进一步分析显示有效负 rollout 需要信息量充足的负轨迹，方法可与未饱和数据并用，并支持对新饱和样本的迭代回收。
Conclusion: 饱和数据不必丢弃：用 rollout 端干预注入有信息量的负样本即可回收出可用的 RL 训练信号，且随模型变强、饱和数据增多，这一回收路径的价值会上升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
papers.abstract_en: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 多任务策略中，各专家对动作接口（归一化与动作编解码器）的任务专属改动会让模型合并失效。PolicyWeave 要求所有专家在后训练阶段保留共享基础策略的动作接口、只用动作模型隐层的 LoRA 做任务适配，再按初始视觉-语言上下文给 LoRA 打分并以 leave-one-layer-out 排名稳定性选专家集，做固定稀疏加权合并。在 RoboCasa365 18 个任务上，共享接口把四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从 17.0% 抬到 52.8%，PolicyWeave 达 64.7%，任务专属 RL 后 74.1%，高于联合 RL 的 60.7%。
Motivation: 联合训练的多任务 VLA 常不如各任务独立训练；直接合并独立专家也未必得到强策略，因为各专家改动了动作接口，且部署时全量合并会引入无关任务干扰。
Method: PolicyWeave = merge-compatible 后训练 + context-guided 稀疏合并：后训练时所有专家保留共享基础策略的动作接口，任务适配限制为动作模型隐层的 LoRA 更新；合并时用初始视觉-语言上下文给每个专家的 LoRA 打分，用 leave-one-layer-out 排名稳定性确定专家集，对选中更新做对当前任务固定的稀疏加权合并。基于 GR00T N1.5，仅用目标任务 10% 演示做 SFT。
Result: RoboCasa365 18 任务上，保留共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从 17.0% 升到 52.8%；PolicyWeave 用这些 SFT 专家达 64.7% 成功率，任务专属 RL 后 74.1%，联合 RL 为 60.7%。另在 LIBERO-10 与 AgileX Piper 机械臂上做了长程与真实操作评测。
Conclusion: 动作接口不兼容是独立专家合并失败的一个来源；共享接口加稀疏上下文引导合并，能让独立学到的技能在部署时超过联合 RL。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agent harnesses continually update persistent components such as memory, prompts, skills, and tools. We call this process harness evolution. However, such evolution could introduce unexpected safety risks. Existing work studies harness misevolution and validates candidate harnesses or attributed individual component updates, leaving safety analysis of cross-component update interactions largely unexamined. To address this gap, we study compositional safety failures in harness evolution, where interactions among individually safe and utility-preserving component updates can produce undesirable or unsafe agent behavior, revealing a safety risk intrinsic to harness evolution. Across three safety-related benchmarks, we identify 43 pairwise and 18 irreducible 3-way compositional safety failures. Conventional solution incurs combinatorial complexity in validating cross-component interactions, leaving the safety checking impractical as the harness evolves. To solve this, we introduced a typed hypergraph that represents component states as nodes and safety-relevant higher-order interactions as hyperedges. When the harness changes, the hypergraph updates only the interaction neighborhood of the changed states rather than reconstructing the global composition space. Building on that, we develop a hypergraph-guided runtime monitoring mechanism. Experiments show that our method effectively mitigates compositional safety risks while preserving task utility and reducing interaction-checking costs, and further reveal an empirical safety-utility-cost trade-off across different safety mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自演化 agent harness 中跨组件更新交互导致的组合性安全失效，用类型化超图 (typed hypergraph) 把组件状态表示为节点、安全相关高阶交互表示为超边，只在 harness 变更时更新受影响的交互邻域，并据此做运行时监控。在三个安全基准上识别出 43 个两两组合失效与 18 个不可约三元组合失效，实验显示该方法在保持任务效用的同时降低交互检查成本。
Motivation: 现有工作只验证候选 harness 或归因单个组件更新，跨组件更新交互的安全分析基本空白；而穷举验证组合交互的复杂度随组件数爆炸，harness 持续演化时不可行。
Method: 提出类型化超图：组件状态（memory、prompt、skill、tool）为节点，安全相关的高阶交互为超边；harness 变更时仅更新变更状态的交互邻域而非重建全局组合空间，并在其上构建超图引导的运行时监控机制 (hypergraph-guided runtime monitoring)。
Result: 在三个安全相关基准上识别出 43 个两两 (pairwise) 与 18 个不可约三元 (irreducible 3-way) 组合安全失效；实验显示该方法有效缓解组合安全风险、保持任务效用并降低交互检查成本，并揭示不同安全机制间经验性的安全-效用-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 组合安全失效是 harness evolution 内在的风险：各自安全且保效用的组件更新交互后仍可产生不安全行为，而超图邻域更新加运行时监控能在可控检查成本下覆盖这类高阶交互。

papers.title: Mycelium: A Generalizable Cross-Grid Multi-Task Model for Electrical Distribution Systems
papers.abstract_en: Electrical distribution grid operations require inference across heterogeneous networks from sparse, noisy, and incomplete time series measurements. In this work, we identify challenges and explore solutions towards a unified model that can perform diverse tasks grounded in the physics of the electric grid and generalize to unseen distribution networks. We define a unified grid ontology that represents variable sized distribution networks as heterogeneous graphs while preserving native topology, asset types, and electrical relationships across networks. We develop a physics based data simulation pipeline that combines reference and procedurally generated distribution networks with network reconfigurations, fault scenarios, and configurable sensing conditions. We present Mycelium, a heterogeneous graph transformer with structure aware communication edges and electrical reference features that encode network position and nominal phase orientation, together with task specific temporal readouts which generate per task outputs. We train Mycelium on reference as well as synthetic grids, and study its generalization on benchmark networks completely excluded from training and validation. Mycelium is observed to outperform task specific neural baselines on most reported benchmark metrics. Architectural ablations and the aforementioned studies reveal Mycelium's capability to learn representations of the underlying physics which serves to enhance cross-task performance, thereby addressing a significant challenge in unified grid models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mcelium 把异构配电网统一成保留原生拓扑与电气关系的图本体，用带结构感知通信边与电气参考特征的异构图 Transformer 在参考网与程序生成网上训练，做多任务推理并泛化到训练中完全排除的基准网。在多数已报告基准指标上超过任务专用神经基线，消融显示其学到的物理表示能提升跨任务表现。
Motivation: 配电网运行需要在异构网络上从稀疏、含噪、不完整的时间序列测量做推理，而现有模型难以统一多任务并泛化到未见过的网络。
Method: 定义统一电网本体，把可变规模的配电网表示为保留拓扑、资产类型与电气关系的异构图；构建物理数据仿真管线，组合参考网与程序生成网，加入网络重构、故障场景与可配置传感条件；主模型 Mycelium 为异构图 Transformer，带结构感知通信边与编码网络位置和标称相位方向的电气参考特征，配任务专用时间读出头。
Result: 在训练与验证中完全排除的基准网络上，Mycelium 在多数已报告基准指标上超过任务专用神经基线；架构消融与该泛化研究显示其学到的底层物理表示可提升跨任务表现。
Conclusion: 统一电网模型可以通过物理接地的图表示与跨任务共享表示来解决泛化难题，物理表示是跨任务性能的来源。

papers.title: MedRouter: Demystifying Knowledge Differences Across Medical LLMs for Routing-Based Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Medical question answering spans diverse specialties and modalities, and individual medical large language models (LLMs) exhibit distinct strengths across tasks and domains. This heterogeneity suggests that combining specialists may enable broader coverage of medical questions than relying on any single model. However, existing LLM routing methods primarily seek to balance answer quality and inference cost, leaving open how to exploit differences in specialist competence to improve medical reasoning. In this paper, we introduce MedRouter, an agentic system that uses an embedding-based multi-label router to select and query specialist LLMs, then passes their responses to a generator to produce the final answer. We further propose SCALE (Specialist Competence-Aware Learning), a two-stage training framework that first trains the Router with specialist correctness supervision and then optimizes its selections through reinforcement learning. The second stage uses a Performance Gain Reward (PGR) that measures how specialist information affects the generator's answer correctness relative to answering without that information. Experiments on eight text-based and multimodal medical QA benchmarks show that MedRouter outperforms the strongest routing baseline by 8% in average accuracy. Our analysis of specialist outputs further reveals distinct strengths and complementary question-level coverage, motivating learned routing to combine these capabilities for more comprehensive medical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedRouter 用 embedding 多标签路由器挑选并查询多个医学专科 LLM，再把它们的回答交给生成器产出最终答案；配套的 SCALE 两阶段训练先用专科正确性监督训练 Router，再用衡量专科信息对生成器答题增益的 Performance Gain Reward (PGR) 做强化学习优化选择。在八个文本与多模态医学 QA benchmark 上，平均准确率比最强路由基线高 8%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由方法主要在答案质量与推理成本之间做权衡，没有利用各专科模型能力差异来提升医学推理；而单个医学 LLM 在不同任务和科室上各有强项，覆盖不全。

papers.title: ECG-Scroll: A Long-Horizon, Streaming Benchmark and Agent Environment for Interpretation of Ambulatory Electrocardiograms
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now interpret a standard ten-second, twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) with clinically grounded, reward-verified reasoning. Real cardiac monitoring is different. Ambulatory (Holter) and telemetry recordings span hours to days and are read as they stream in, and their clinically decisive findings are paroxysmal, brief episodes buried in an otherwise unremarkable trace. Such a recording cannot be held in one context at diagnostic resolution, and its future has not yet happened, so a reader must work online, deciding what to measure now, committing evidence to memory as it passes, and reporting events as they occur. We recast long-duration ECG interpretation as a long-horizon, online (streaming, causal) sequential decision process and introduce ECG-Scroll. As a benchmark, long ambulatory recordings are streamed to an agent chunk by chunk, and it must localize, quantify, and promptly flag paroxysmal events without access to future signal; because the underlying signal is retained, every answer is checkable against objective ground truth, giving rule-based rather than judge-based rewards, and the streaming formulation adds a metric batch evaluation cannot express, the detection latency between an event's onset and the moment the agent records it. As an agent environment, it is a fixed, gym-style interaction layer that exercises three competencies single-glance ECG models never touch: Memory, Tool use through signal-grounded measurement rather than reading pixels, and Planning of what to measure now and when to commit. We release 390 whole-recording instances spanning 2,536 hours of two-lead ambulatory ECG and evaluate a signal-threshold rule agent alongside off-the-shelf LLM agents online, characterizing how they use memory, tools, and planning and where the benchmark's head-room lies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECG-Scroll 把长程动态心电 (Holter/遥测) 判读重写为长时程、在线流式（因果）序贯决策问题：信号按 chunk 推给 agent，不得访问未来，需定位、量化并及时标记阵发事件，奖励由保留的原始信号直接核对（rule-based 而非 judge-based），并新增检测延迟指标。发布 390 个整记录实例、覆盖 2,536 小时双导联动态心电，对信号阈值规则 agent 与现成 LLM agent 做在线评测，刻画其记忆、工具与规划用法及 benchmark 的 head-room。
Motivation: 动态心电长达数小时至数天、边流边读，决定性发现是埋在正常背景里的短暂阵发事件；整段无法以诊断分辨率放进一个上下文，未来信号也尚未发生，而单次十秒十二导联 ECG 模型与批量评测都覆盖不到这种在线判读。
Method: 把长程 ECG 判读形式化为长时程在线序贯决策：benchmark 逐 chunk 流式送入长记录、禁止访问未来信号，答案对照保留的原始信号给出 rule-based 奖励，并引入事件起始到 agent 记录之间的检测延迟指标；作为 agent 环境则提供固定 gym 式交互层，考察 Memory、基于信号测量（而非读像素）的 Tool use、以及 Planning（现在测什么、何时提交）。
Result: 发布 390 个整记录实例、合计 2,536 小时双导联动态心电；在线评测了一个信号阈值规则 agent 与若干现成 LLM agent，刻画它们如何使用记忆、工具与规划，并指出 benchmark 的 head-room 所在。
Conclusion: 长程动态心电判读应按在线流式决策来建模与评测，因为检测延迟这一指标只有流式设定才能表达，且记忆、工具、规划是单次浏览模型不触及的三项能力。

papers.title: Modular Discovery of General Game-Playing Algorithms with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: General Game Playing across arbitrary games from rules alone remains challenging due to differing algorithmic requirements across game classes and strict decision-time constraints. Rather than hand-designing search heuristics for specific domains, can we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to discover general game-playing algorithms? Because language models can propose and refactor structured code, they provide an expressive proposal engine for exploring the space of algorithmic designs. We introduce a multi-agent LLM meta-learning system to co-evolve game-agnostic procedural search mechanisms in C++ alongside domain heuristics synthesized directly from game rules. Controlling the compute budget, we benchmark the discovered mechanisms across more than 400 diverse environments, including OpenSpiel training and held-out games, procedural simulation engines, and games with deep neural policy-value representations trained via PPO. Evaluated via AlphaRank stationary distributions and Soft Condorcet Optimization (SCO) against 15 established MCTS baselines, the discovered search mechanisms consistently achieve top-tier ratings and pairwise ballot majorities over most baselines across independent evolutionary runs, generalizing to unseen human-designed and procedurally synthesized games and remaining competitive with baselines on frozen neural network representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用多智能体 LLM 元学习系统共同进化与游戏无关的 C++ 过程式搜索机制和从规则直接合成的领域启发式，在 400 多个环境中用 AlphaRank 与 SCO 对比 15 个 MCTS 基线，发现的搜索机制在多数基线之上取得顶级评分与成对多数，且能泛化到未见过的人工设计与程序生成游戏。
Motivation: 通用博弈需要针对不同游戏类别手写搜索启发式，且受严格决策时间约束；作者提出用 LLM 作为提议引擎替代手工设计。
Method: 多智能体 LLM 元学习系统共同进化游戏无关的过程式搜索机制（C++ 实现）与直接由游戏规则合成的领域启发式，控制算力预算；评测用 AlphaRank 稳定分布与 Soft Condorcet Optimization (SCO)，对手为 15 个已建立的 MCTS 基线。
Result: 在 400 多个多样环境（含 OpenSpiel 训练与留出游戏、程序化仿真引擎、以及用 PPO 训练的深度神经策略-价值表示游戏）上，发现的搜索机制在独立进化运行中对多数基线取得顶级评分与成对投票多数，并在冻结神经网络表示上与基线保持竞争力。
Conclusion: LLM 可以发现跨游戏类别泛化的通用搜索机制，无需为每个领域手工设计启发式，并能迁移到未见过的人工与程序生成游戏。

papers.title: Can Tabular Foundation Models Amortize Statistical Inference?
papers.abstract_en: For decades, statistical inference has largely been developed one problem at a time. Given a scientific target, such as a treatment effect or a regression function, statisticians design a problem-specific estimator together with a procedure for quantifying its uncertainty. This paper proposes a different paradigm. We focus on a classical problem in statistical inference, confidence interval construction, and develop TabCon, an amortized inference system built on a tabular foundation model that produces confidence intervals for new datasets through a simple forward pass. The key methodological ingredients of TabCon are a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture and reinforcement-learning-based post-training that calibrate the resulting confidence intervals to a desired coverage level. Across a wide range of benchmark datasets, TabCon attains near-nominal coverage while producing short confidence intervals. At inference time, it also offers considerably greater computational efficiency, running 50 times faster than the classical bootstrap procedure, even when the latter uses only 50 bootstrap samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabCon 用表格基础模型把置信区间构造做成摊销推理 (amortized inference)：新数据集只需一次前向传播即输出区间，靠稀疏 MoE 架构加基于强化学习的后训练把覆盖率校准到目标水平。在多组基准数据集上达到接近名义的覆盖率且区间较短，推理速度比经典 bootstrap 快 50 倍——即便后者只抽 50 个自助样本。
Motivation: 统计推断长期是逐问题设计：针对每个科学目标（处理效应、回归函数）单独构造估计量和不确定性量化流程，无法复用、计算开销大。
Method: TabCon 以表格基础模型为骨干，采用稀疏 mixture-of-experts 架构，并用 reinforcement-learning-based post-training 校准置信区间使其达到期望覆盖水平；推理阶段对新数据集做一次前向传播直接产出区间。
Result: 在广泛基准数据集上达到接近名义 (near-nominal) 的覆盖率同时给出较短的置信区间；推理时比经典 bootstrap 快 50 倍，即使 bootstrap 只使用 50 个自助样本。
Conclusion: 置信区间构造可以改写为一次前向传播的摊销推断问题，用 RL 后训练控覆盖率，在精度与速度上同时成立。

papers.title: ParallelPilot: Supporting Coordination and Monitoring in Parallel AI Coding
papers.abstract_en: As coding assistants become increasingly autonomous, developers run multiple sessions in parallel, shifting the challenge from code generation alone to coordinating and monitoring concurrent agent work. Through a formative study (N=14), we identified PILOT: five supervisory practices for Planning, Isolating, Logging, Observing, and Triaging parallel sessions. We present ParallelPilot, a design probe that instantiates PILOT through a planning interface, a run-logger, and an ambient dashboard alongside existing coding tools. In a counterbalanced within-subjects study (N=16), participants using ParallelPilot increased ticket throughput by 63% in short coding tasks and supervised an average of one more concurrent agent at peak, while their tracking effort and context switching dropped. ParallelPilot also clarified execution plans, task dependencies, and intervention cues, and 14 of 16 participants preferred it over their current setup. These gains were not accompanied by significant improvements in perceived control or perceived success in redirecting the agents. Our findings demonstrate the value of explicit supervision support and position PILOT as a scaffold for designing tools that help people supervise concurrent work within and beyond coding. We suggest that future coding assistants should pair high-level awareness with low-cost paths back to the implementation evidence developers need to judge and steer agent work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParallelPilot 把并行 AI 编码会话的监督拆成 PILOT 五项实践（Planning、Isolating、Logging、Observing、Triaging），并做成规划界面、run-logger 与 ambient dashboard 三件套。在 N=16 的被试内平衡实验中，短任务 ticket 吞吐提升 63%，峰值可同时监督的 agent 平均多 1 个，跟踪负担与上下文切换下降，16 人中 14 人偏好它；但感知控制与重定向成功率无显著提升。
Motivation: 编码助手越来越自主，开发者同时开多个会话，难点从生成代码转向协调与监控并发 agent 工作，现有工具缺少显式监督支持。
Method: 先做 N=14 的 formative study 归纳出 PILOT 五项监督实践，再据此实现 design probe ParallelPilot：规划界面、run-logger、ambient dashboard，与既有编码工具并用；用被试内平衡 (within-subjects) 实验 N=16 评测。
Result: 短编码任务 ticket 吞吐提升 63%；峰值时人均多监督 1 个并发 agent；跟踪 effort 与 context switching 下降；16 名参与者中 14 人偏好 ParallelPilot 而非现有设置；感知控制 (perceived control) 与重定向 agent 的感知成功率 (perceived success) 无显著改善。
Conclusion: 显式监督支持能提高并行 agent 的吞吐与并发监督规模，但不自动转化为更强的控制感；作者建议未来编码助手把高层态势感知与回到实现证据的低成本路径配对。

papers.title: Simulation-Free Learning of GP-SDEs from Irregular Observations
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian process stochastic differential equations (GP-SDEs) provide a flexible Bayesian model for unknown continuous-time state dynamics with uncertainty quantification, but learning and inference from noisy and irregular observations remain computationally challenging. To address this issue, we propose GP-SDE Matching, a simulation-free variational framework for Bayesian GP drift learning and continuous-time state smoothing. We analytically marginalize the sparse GP posterior to derive a tractable drift-matching objective that accounts for both the posterior mean and uncertainty of the unknown drift. To handle irregular observations, we further introduce an irregular-time-aware variational state posterior that incorporates the actual observation times during both encoding and continuous-time marginal querying. Experiments on the stochastic Lorenz--63 system demonstrate substantially improved drift recovery and state reconstruction under irregular observations, while five system identification benchmarks show robust forecasting under increasing observation sparsity and competitive performance against existing latent-SDE and state-space methods.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: GP-SDE 能对未知连续时间动力学做贝叶斯建模并给出不确定性量化，但从含噪且时间不规则的观测中学习与推断计算代价高，需要免模拟的替代方案。

papers.title: D-JEPA: Design-Recoverable JEPA Representation with Swappable Physics Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide a framework for learning compact representations without directly reconstructing high-dimensional observations. However, in parameterized physical systems, learned representations can entangle geometry with operating conditions and task-specific physical responses, limiting their reuse across prediction tasks. We introduce D-JEPA (Design-recoverable JEPA), a geometry-centric JEPA that computes a compact representation from geometry alone and reuses it across operating conditions and physical response spaces through lightweight physics-specific decoders. An explicit design-recoverability objective encourages the geometry latent to preserve information about the underlying design variables, enabling the representation to support design analysis and optimization. We further identify a case-level collapse failure mode in which target representations become nearly invariant across distinct geometries despite low reconstruction error, and mitigate it using case-level variation constraints and auxiliary target reconstruction. Across four 3D aerodynamic, hydrodynamic, and structural benchmarks, D-JEPA maintains or improves full-field prediction accuracy while achieving near-perfect linear recoverability of design parameters. The frozen geometry representation can be reused at held-out operating conditions and transferred to a structural response task with fewer trainable parameters. Finally, the representation supports differentiable design optimization, with designs validated using high-fidelity CFD, preserving the predicted ranking of candidate designs. These results demonstrate that separating a reusable geometry representation from physics-specific prediction provides a practical representation for scientific surrogate modeling and design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D-JEPA 把参数化物理系统中的表征拆成只由几何决定的 geometry latent 与轻量 physics-specific decoder，使同一表征可跨工况和响应空间复用。它用 design-recoverability 目标保住设计变量信息，并用 case-level variation constraints 与辅助目标重建抑制 case-level collapse；在四个 3D 气动、水动与结构基准上保持或提升全场预测精度，设计参数线性可恢复性接近完全。
Motivation: 参数化物理系统里学到的表征把几何、工况与任务相关的物理响应纠缠在一起，跨预测任务复用受限，且设计变量信息在压缩中丢失。
Method: geometry-centric JEPA：仅从几何计算紧凑表征，配可替换的轻量 physics-specific decoder 映射到不同物理响应空间；加入显式 design-recoverability 目标使 geometry latent 保留设计变量，针对 case-level collapse（重建误差低但不同几何的目标表征几乎不变）施加 case-level variation constraints 与辅助目标重建。
Result: 在四个 3D 气动、水动与结构基准上，全场预测精度保持或提升，设计参数达到接近完全的线性可恢复性 (near-perfect linear recoverability)；冻结的几何表征可在 held-out 工况复用并以更少可训练参数迁移到结构响应任务；支持可微设计优化，用高保真 CCF 校验的设计保持候选设计的预测排序。
Conclusion: 把可复用的几何表征与物理专用预测解耦，可作为科学 surrogate modeling 与设计优化的实用表征，前提是显式保住设计变量并约束 case-level 变化。

papers.title: Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 orientation grounding 任务：从语言或框查询预测物体的 6D 朝向与轴对称性，并构建 ReferOri 数据集（331K 多视图 + 387K 单视图查询）与模型 OG-VLM。OG-VLM 在单视图与多视图基准上明显超过朝向感知 VLM 基线，并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型，说明显式朝向接地是独立于定位、可学习的能力。
Motivation: 现有 3D 视觉语言接地只回答物体在哪里，而许多 3D 任务还需要知道它朝向如何；现有 3D VLM 即使预测有向框，框位姿也无法显式表达物体自身朝向与对称性带来的歧义。
Method: 定义 orientation grounding 任务，输出结构化的框/朝向、符号与对称 token，并加几何感知辅助损失；数据集 ReferOri 通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工核验构建，覆盖单视图与多视图查询。
Result: ReferOri 含 331K 多视图与 387K 单视图朝向接地查询；OG-VLM 在单视图与多视图基准上大幅优于朝向感知 VLM 基线，并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型，下游结果验证其对朝向相关空间推理的增益。
Conclusion: 显式朝向接地是区别于定位且可学习的能力，把朝向与对称性作为结构化输出并配几何辅助损失，能同时改善场景级指代与下游朝向推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CARVE: Breaking Data Barriers in Chip Placement by Harnessing Reusable Expertise
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained macro-placement policies can reduce repeated optimization across circuits, but deployment often exposes them to unfamiliar designs when the original training data are unavailable. Repeatedly fine-tuning a single serving model can overwrite earlier improvements, while simply saving checkpoints does not determine where they can be reliably reused. We introduce Continual Adaptation through the Reuse of Validated Expertise (CARVE), a framework that represents accumulated expertise as a frozen base policy, immutable specialists, and task-specific credentials obtained through local validation. For a new task, CARVE first checks existing specialists and trains a new specialist from the frozen base only when none qualifies. Under fixed task distributions and validation rules that control cumulative error, we establish expected-performance guarantees for repeated reuse. For bounded losses, we also derive matching worst-case bounds on the local samples needed for reliable reuse. In macro placement, a reuse-first follow-up reduces recorded training time by 58.5% (9.66 to 4.01 hours), while mean HPWL gain changes only from 8.41% to 7.86%. In a simulated receiving deployment, imported specialists are reused on six of seven new IBM circuits with no receiver-side training, achieving a 5.76% mean HPWL gain. Navigation studies provide complementary evidence on repair retention and repeated adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARVE 把芯片宏单元布局 (macro placement) 的累积经验固化为冻结基座策略、不可变专家和经局部验证签发的 credentials，新任务先复用已有专家、只有都不合格才从基座新训。复用优先把记录的训练时间从 9.66 小时压到 4.01 小时（降 58.5%），而平均 HPWL 增益仅从 8.41% 变到 7.86%；在模拟接收方部署中，7 个新 IBM 电路上有 6 个直接导入专家、接收端零训练，仍拿到 5.76% 平均 HPWL 增益。
Motivation: 预训练布局策略部署到新设计时常缺少原始训练数据，反复微调单一服务模型会覆盖早期改进，而只存 checkpoint 无法判断哪些能可靠复用。
Method: CARVE（Continual Adaptation through the Reuse of Validated Expertise）用冻结基座策略加不可变专家 (immutable specialists) 表示经验，凭局部验证得到任务级 credentials；新任务先查已有专家，都不合格才从基座训新专家。在固定任务分布与控制累积误差的验证规则下给出重复复用的期望性能保证，对有界损失推导所需局部样本量的匹配最坏情形界。
Result: 宏单元布局上，复用优先使记录训练时间下降 58.5%（9.66 → 4.01 小时），平均 HPWL 增益仅由 8.41% 变为 7.86%。模拟接收方部署中，导入专家在 7 个新 IBM 电路中的 6 个上零接收端训练被复用，平均 HPWL 增益 5.76%。导航研究 (navigation studies) 提供了修复保持与重复适应的补充证据。
Conclusion: 在验证规则约束下，先复用已验证专家再训练新专家，能在几乎不损失 HPWL 增益的前提下大幅削减布局策略的重复训练成本。

papers.title: VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning
papers.abstract_en: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VPTwin 用真实演示重建的可执行数字孪生做锚点，把 Isaac Sim 在随机物理配置下的多条前向 rollout 作为 in-context 参考，让真实视频预测受仿真动力学约束、同时保留真实视频里未建模的接触交互，并据此视觉核验 VLM 提出的动作。评测显示视频预测中的物理幻觉大幅减少，操作规划性能明显提升。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的动作条件视频预测在长时程 rollout 中误差累积并产生物理上不合理的幻觉，直接拖垮下游动作规划。
Method: VLM 从真实演示片段重建可执行数字孪生；Isaac Sim 在候选动作轨迹下对随机化的物理配置做多条前向动力学 rollout，处理未观测物理属性的病态估计；VPTwin 以这些 rollout 为 in-context 参考融合真实与仿真两个域，并构成预测式规划闭环，用视频预测视觉核验 VLM 提议的动作。
Result: 评测显示视频预测中的物理幻觉 (physical hallucination) 大幅减少，操作规划性能显著提升。
Conclusion: 以仿真孪生锚定真实未来预测，可以在长时程动作条件视频预测中同时保证物理合理性并保留真实接触交互，从而支撑可靠的真实世界执行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Little is known about how to manually design agents capable of dexterous manipulation. Some design principles have been inferred from close examination of how animals manipulate objects, but these structures and behaviors have so far resisted biomimicry and may not be optimal for artificial machines. Here we evolve freeform robots to pick up, hold, rotate, and use diverse objects. Unlike other approaches to optimizing robot hands, we do not presuppose the presence, articulation, or geometry of any part of the body. Although familiar prehensile forms such as tails, beaks, paws and claws may emerge spontaneously under certain conditions--and while such conditions could be of interest to evolutionary biologists--de novo manipulator design can also reveal whole new solutions, overlooked or unknown structures which may be better suited for the task at hand. We use contrastive learning to create a highly searchable genetic embedding of design space, an autoregressive developmental model to decode designs, evolutionary strategies to find good designs, and reinforcement learning to train each evolved design. Winning designs were automatically converted into a manufacturable blueprint, printed, assembled and tested in the real world in a zero-shot manner. The results represent the state-of-the-art in evolutionary robotics in terms of performance, diversity and complexity.

TL;DR: 从零进化出自由形态的灵巧操作机器人：用对比学习构造设计空间的可搜索遗传嵌入，自回归发育模型解码设计，进化策略搜索，再用强化学习训练每个个体，获胜设计自动转成可制造蓝图并零样本打印装配上实机测试。结果在进化机器人领域的性能、多样性与复杂度上达到当前最佳。
Motivation: 如何手工设计能灵巧操作物体的 agent 几乎无从下手；从动物解剖推得的设计原则至今难以仿生复现，且对人造机器未必最优。
Method: 四段流水线：对比学习生成设计空间的遗传嵌入 (genetic embedding)，自回归发育模型 (autoregressive developmental model) 解码为具体结构，进化策略 (evolutionary strategies) 搜索优质设计，强化学习逐个训练策略；不预设身体部件的存在、关节或几何。
Result: 进化出的机器人可抓取、握持、旋转并使用多样物体；尾巴、喙、爪等熟悉抓握形态在特定条件下自发涌现，同时出现全新结构。获胜设计自动转为可制造蓝图，打印、装配后以零样本方式在真实世界测试；作者称结果在性能、多样性与复杂度上代表进化机器人 (evolutionary robotics) 的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 不预设本体结构的 de novo 设计加进化搜索，能产出超越仿生先验的灵巧操作形态，并可直接落地为实机。

papers.title: Octree-based Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OctVideo 用八叉树 (octree) 递归划分时空体，让平滑区域保持粗格、细节区域细分，叶节点存 RGB、时空梯度与轻量学习残差，再由 Conv1D VAE 把序列化单元映射回规则 latent grid 并在解码时选择性细化。在 Kinetics-400 上以 38.2M 参数、每片段 189.4 GFLOPs 达到 36.12 dB PSNR，零样本迁移到 DAVIS 2016 高分辨率数据仍与最佳被评模型相当，且在两个数据集上 FLOPs 最少、编解码最快。
Motivation: 视频模型普遍用均匀网格，而视觉复杂度在时空上分布很不均匀，均匀划分在平滑区域浪费容量、在细节区域又不够细。
Method: 八叉树把时空体递归八分，叶节点存储局部 RGB 值与时空梯度并附加轻量学习残差；重建时用 Conv1D VAE 将序列化的单元映射到规则 latent grid，解码中选择性细化细节。
Result: Kinetics-400 上 VAE 重建 36.12 dB PSNR，参数 38.2M，每片段 189.4 GFLOPs；零样本泛化到高分辨率 DAVIS 2016，重建质量与被评最佳模型相当；在两个数据集上所需模型 FLOPs 最少、编码与解码速度最快；从零训练时以少量输入 token 取得有竞争力的识别性能。
Conclusion: 利用视频信号自带的冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，可以在更少 FLOPs 与更快编解码下提供高效视频表示，同时兼顾重建与少量 token 的视频理解。

papers.title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视觉-语言导航 (VLN) 模型参数量大、部署成本高的问题，提出 Query-Align-Distill 两步法：教师端用可学习 query 槽显式抽取全局与局部可导航证据并与指令对齐，学生端通过导航感知的 token 自适应蒸馏同时迁移注意力位置与动作决策。在标准 VLN 基准上，学生模型参数量比教师减少 93.65%，导航性能接近教师。
Motivation: 大规模 VLN 模型精度高但参数量与计算开销大，难以部署；证据选择过程隐式、不可压缩，缺少可作为蒸馏接口的显式中间表示。
Method: 教师端由 Navigable Query Generator 用少量可学习 query 槽从全景观测提取全局与局部的动作充分可导航证据，再由 Instruction-Query Aligner 将证据 token 逐步与指令接地以预测动作；学生端以该显式 query 瓶颈为蒸馏接口，用导航感知的 token 自适应目标蒸馏全局与局部可导航 query，并在微调阶段进一步匹配动作分布。
Result: 在标准 VLN 基准上，学生模型参数量较教师减少 93.65%，导航性能接近教师水平。
Conclusion: 把导航证据选择显式化为可压缩的 query 瓶颈，可以在大幅削减参数的同时保住 VLN 导航精度。

papers.title: How Linear Attention Remembers
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention replaces the growing key--value (KV) cache of standard attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, substantially reducing memory growth with context length. This efficiency, however, changes how past information is stored: many tokens must share and repeatedly update the same memory. We study how this recurrent state functions as a memory system. Using an analytical decomposition together with controlled causal interventions in pretrained GLA and GDN models, we trace how recalled information is written, retained, and later accessed. We find that fact-specific information enters recurrent memory through concentrated, content-dependent writes and is later accessed through concentrated query-time read pathways. Multiple facts can remain selectively accessible within the same state, yet their internal representations exhibit cross-fact causal coupling rather than independent KV-like storage. As memory load increases, both recall and targeted editability degrade, whereas elapsed context alone has a substantially smaller effect within the tested regime. Causal interventions on subsequent writes further show that interference is shaped by their overlap with existing memory. Finally, in hybrid architectures that combine recurrent layers with full attention, the runtime memory directly supporting recall shifts predominantly to the full-attention KV state. Together, these results reveal how fixed-size recurrent memory supports selective recall despite shared storage, while exposing the interference and capacity limits that distinguish it from token-addressable KV memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 线性注意力用固定大小循环态替代 KV cache，本文用解析分解加受控因果干预追踪 GLA 与 GDN 预训练模型中信息的写入、保留与读取：事实经集中的内容依赖写入进入、经集中的 query 读取通路取出，多事实共享同一状态但存在跨事实因果耦合。记忆负载升高时回忆与定向可编辑性同时下降，而单纯上下文长度增长在测试范围内影响小得多；干扰由后续写入与已有记忆的重叠决定，混合架构中支撑回忆的运行时记忆主要转移到全注意力 KV 态。
Motivation: 线性注意力把过去信息压进固定大小的循环态，多个 token 共享并反复更新同一份记忆，这与可按 token 寻址的 KV cache 在存储机制上根本不同，其回忆、干扰与容量边界此前缺少因果层面的刻画。
Method: 在预训练的 GLA 与 GDN 模型上结合解析分解与受控因果干预 (controlled causal interventions)，追踪被回忆信息的写入、保留与后续访问路径，并对后续写入做干预以检验干扰来源，同时比较纯循环架构与循环层加全注意力的混合架构。
Result: 事实信息经集中的内容依赖写入进入循环记忆，并经集中的 query 时读取通路访问；同一状态内多事实可选择性访问但表征存在跨事实因果耦合。记忆负载增加时回忆与定向可编辑性均下降，而仅上下文长度增长在测试范围内影响明显更小；干扰由后续写入与已有记忆的重叠塑造。混合架构中直接支撑回忆的运行时记忆主要转到全注意力 KV 态。
Conclusion: 固定大小循环记忆能靠集中读写通路实现选择性回忆，但其共享存储带来跨事实耦合与负载相关的干扰和容量上限，这是它区别于 token 可寻址 KV 记忆的本质；需要定向编辑或高负载回忆时，全注意力 KV 层仍是更可靠的载体。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: OneSign: Unifying Sign Language Understanding Tasks with One Model
papers.abstract_en: SLU encompasses a diverse set of tasks, including ISLR, CSLR, and SLT. Although these tasks share basic semantic and linguistic foundations, they are typically addressed with task-specific architectures and training pipelines, which hinders knowledge sharing and requires costly pretraining and finetuning for each task. In this paper, we focus on two aspects of SLU tasks: (1) training and inference pipelines are highly fragmented: most methods rely on pretraining on large-scale SL datasets followed by task- or dataset-specific finetuning, which leads to multiple specialized models rather than a single checkpoint. (2) current LLM-based methods may overlook the inherent modality discrepancy between sign and text tokens, simply concatenating them and processing both modalities with the same decoder layers. In this paper, we present OneSign, a unified framework that addresses multiple SLU tasks within a single model and a single checkpoint. OneSign reformulates ISLR, CSLR, and SLT under a single training paradigm. To accommodate the heterogeneous characteristics of sign and text representations, we introduce a Modality-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MA-MoE) architecture, consisting of a shared expert and modality-specific experts for sign and text tokens. A modality router dynamically activates the corresponding experts, and their outputs are aggregated to form the final token representations. By enabling modality-dependent expert specialization while preserving a shared expert path, MA-MoE can effectively model the modality differences between continuous sign representations and discrete text tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OneSign achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness as a unified SLU model. Datasets are available at : https://github.com/gswycf/OneSign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneSign 用单一模型、单一 checkpoint 统一手语理解 (SLU) 的 ISLR、CSLR 与 SLT 三项任务，把它们重写进同一训练范式，并用 Modality-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MA-MoE) 处理手语连续表征与文本离散 token 的模态差异：共享专家加手语/文本各自的模态专家，由 modality router 动态激活并聚合输出。在多个基准上取得有竞争力或 state-of-the-art 的表现。
Motivation: SLU 各任务目前依赖任务专属架构与训练流程，需对每个任务分别做大规模预训练加微调，得到多个专用模型；现有 LLM 方法又把 sign 与 text token 直接拼接、用同一套 decoder 层处理，忽略两者固有的模态差异。
Method: 把 ISLR、CSLR、SLT 重构到统一训练范式下，由单模型单 checkpoint 承载；架构上提出 MA-MoE，含一个共享专家与手语、文本各自的模态专家，modality router 按 token 模态动态激活对应专家并聚合其输出形成最终 token 表征，保留共享专家通路以兼顾模态专属分化。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验显示 OneSign 在若干基准上达到有竞争力或 state-of-the-art 的性能；数据集发布于 github.com/gswycf/OneSign。
Conclusion: 手语理解的多项任务可以在一个模型、一个 checkpoint 内统一训练，模态自适应的专家分化是处理 sign 与 text 表征差异的有效方式。

summary_sections.method: 把 ISLR、CSLR、SLT 重构到统一训练范式下，由单模型单 checkpoint 承载；架构上提出 MA-MoE，含一个共享专家与手语、文本各自的模态专家，modality router 按 token 模态动态激活对应专家并聚合其输出形成最终 token 表征，保留共享专家通路以兼顾模态专属分化。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上的实验显示 OneSign 在若干基准上达到有竞争力或 state-of-the-art 的性能；数据集发布于 github.com/gswycf/OneSign。
summary_sections.conclusion: 手语理解的多项任务可以在一个模型、一个 checkpoint 内统一训练，模态自适应的专家分化是处理 sign 与 text 表征差异的有效方式。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Operator Families for Structured Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: The geometry of latent representations governs which components should interact and how information should propagate, making geometry-aware operator design a fundamental ingredient of structured deep representation learning. However, existing neural architectures typically rely on generic operator templates or geometry-specific constructions, creating a need for a unified framework that can derive admissible operators directly from fixed structural information while remaining adaptive to changing contexts. We introduce \emph{Geometry-Induced Operator Families} (GIOF), a general framework that converts fixed geometry into a structured family of propagation operators and dynamically selects an appropriate member of this family according to the current context. GIOF first transforms geometry-derived interaction channels into reusable generator bases, then combines them through a context-dependent selector and adaptive propagation scale, and finally realizes the selected operator through stable continuous-time propagation and a bottleneck residual layer. We establish theoretical guarantees covering parameter compression, identifiability, stability, locality, compositional structure, and oversmoothing behavior, while controlled experiments validate these mechanisms and experiments on PEMS-BAY and METR-LA achieve the lowest mean MAE across all reported regional-outage settings, improving over the strongest retained baseline by 2.4\%--8.8\% at 30\% missing sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Geometry-Induced Operator Families (GIOF)，把固定几何转成一族可复用的传播算子生成基，再按当前上下文用选择器与自适应传播尺度挑出具体算子，经稳定连续时间传播与瓶颈残差层实现。在 PEMS-BAY 与 METR-LA 交通传感器缺失任务上，30% 传感器缺失时相对最强保留基线 MAE 改善 2.4%–8.8%，为全部报告的区域断连设置中最低平均 MAE。
Motivation: 现有神经架构要么用通用算子模板、要么做死几何专用构造，缺少能从固定结构信息直接导出可用算子、又能随上下文自适应的统一框架。
Method: GIOF 先把几何导出的交互通道变换为可复用的生成基 (generator bases)，再由上下文相关选择器与自适应传播尺度组合，最后通过稳定连续时间传播和瓶颈残差层实现所选算子；给出覆盖参数压缩、可辨识性、稳定性、局部性、组合结构与过平滑行为的理论保证。
Result: 在 PEMS-BAY 与 METR-LA 上，GIOF 在所有报告的区域断连 (regional-outage) 设置中取得最低平均 MAE，30% 传感器缺失时比最强保留基线改善 2.4%–8.8%；另有受控实验验证各机制。
Conclusion: 把固定几何编码成算子族并按上下文动态选择，可在传感器缺失的图结构时空预测中同时给出理论保证与更低的 MAE。

papers.title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QSCP 把查询解析成意图与语义槽，用查询条件化解码器同时输出查询专属变化掩码和双时相语义图，支持类别名、同义词与带意图的句子，可回答“什么变成了什么”的转变查询。在 SECOND 上于同义词、句子与转变查询三类设定优于 RCDNet，并在 WHU-CDC 上检验无目标域训练的跨数据集迁移与等价表达一致性。
Motivation: 现有类别提示型 RCD 只用查询类别定位变化终点并返回二值掩码，无法表达源到目标的转变，也给不出成对的双时相语义图，难以回答用户真正关心的“什么变成了什么”。
Method: QSCP 将请求解析为意图与语义槽，组合双向视觉证据，用查询条件化解码器同时预测两个时相的语义状态，输出查询专属掩码与成对时相语义图；查询形式覆盖类别名、同义词和意图句。
Result: 在 SECOND 上，QSCP 在同义词查询、句子查询和转变查询上均优于 RCDNet，并在端到端语义预测上优于所评估的语义基线；WHU-CDC 实验进一步检验了无目标域训练下的跨数据集迁移，以及等价表达的一致性。
Conclusion: 把查询从单一目标类别扩展为意图与语义槽的解析，可让变化检测直接回答带源目标的转变问题，并在跨数据集、无目标域训练时保持一致。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Methods Provably Converge Even with Improperly Trained Denoisers: Convergence by Architectural Design
papers.abstract_en: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods replace proximal operators with learned denoisers, which produce state-of-the-art reconstruction quality, but sacrifice the variational interpretation and convergence guarantees of proximal methods. Learned Proximal Networks (LPNs) address this problem by designing the denoiser architecture so that it is exactly the proximal operator of a regularizer. In this work, we clarify the theoretical foundations of LPNs and extend the framework to a broader class of activation functions. We then study two practical mechanisms for controlling the learned prior: (i) averaging the LPN with the identity, a common heuristic in PnP methods, and (ii) directly scaling the implicit regularizer induced by the proximal operator. In particular, we characterize the regularizer induced by averaging and develop a convergent method for evaluating the scaled proximal operator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Learned Proximal Network (LPN) 的理论基础讲清并扩展到更广的激活函数类，证明只要去噪器按架构设计成某个正则项的精确邻近算子 (proximal operator)，即使训练不充分，Plug-and-Play 迭代仍收敛。对两种控制学习先验的机制——LPN 与恒等映射取平均、以及直接缩放隐式正则项——分别刻画了所诱导的正则项，并给出求缩放邻近算子的收敛算法。
Motivation: PnP 用学习去噪器替换邻近算子，重建质量高但丢掉了变分解释与收敛保证；LPN 通过架构设计恢复这两点，但其理论基础此前不清晰，且只覆盖有限的激活函数与先验控制手段。
Method: 澄清 LPN 的理论基础并把可表示为邻近算子的去噪器架构推广到更广的激活函数类；分析两种控制学习先验的机制：(i) LPN 与恒等取平均（PnP 中常见启发式），(ii) 直接缩放由邻近算子诱导的隐式正则项；对缩放情形给出求值缩放邻近算子的收敛方法。
Result: 给出 LPN 在更广激活函数下的理论刻画；表征了取平均所诱导的正则项；提出求缩放邻近算子的收敛方法，从而在去噪器训练不当时仍保留收敛保证。
Conclusion: PnP 的收敛可以由架构设计保证，而不依赖去噪器是否被恰当训练；先验强度既可通过与恒等平均、也可通过直接缩放隐式正则项来控制。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: From Constitutions to Control: Interpretable Rewards for Aligning Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Current approaches to aligning language models often make it hard to know what behavior is being rewarded or to change that reward in a targeted way. In particular, standard preference-based methods collapse multiple considerations into aggregate human judgments, obscuring what drives the resulting reward, while principle-based methods specify high-level values without fully operationalizing them. To address this gap, we develop a rubric-based framework to transform a general-purpose constitution into an interpretable and tunable reward model, using constitution-guided AI feedback to estimate initial weights for the constituent rubric items. We then reweight those dimensions to construct modified rewards for training. Across experiments on political alignment and safety-helpfulness tradeoffs, reweighting individual dimensions predictably changes targeted behaviors largely independently while navigating tradeoffs between conflicting alignment objectives. We show that the same framework can mitigate label bias encoded in preference judgments -- including sycophancy and demographic bias -- by reducing their influence on the training reward. Our results demonstrate that constitution-derived, interpretable rewards can translate high-level alignment principles into more transparent and controllable model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把通用宪法 (constitution) 拆成可解释的 rubric 条目，用宪法引导的 AI 反馈估计各条目初始权重，再通过重加权构造新奖励训练语言模型。在政治对齐与 safety-helpfulness 权衡实验中，单独重加权某一维度可大体独立地定向改变目标行为，并能通过降低其在训练奖励中的权重来削弱偏好判断中的标签偏差（谄媚、人口统计偏差）。
Motivation: 偏好对齐把多个考量压成聚合的人类判断，看不出奖励到底在奖励什么、也无法定向修改；原则型方法给出高层价值却未真正操作化。
Method: 提出 rubric-based 框架：将通用 constitution 分解为 rubric 条目，用 constitution-guided AI feedback 估计各条目初始权重，得到可解释、可调的奖励模型；随后对这些维度重加权，构造修改后的奖励用于训练。
Result: 在政治对齐与 safety-helpfulness 权衡两类实验中，重加权单个维度可大体独立地、可预期地改变目标行为，同时处理相互冲突的对齐目标之间的权衡；同一框架通过降低标签偏差在训练奖励中的影响，可缓解偏好判断中编码的谄媚 (sycophancy) 与人口统计偏差。
Conclusion: 从宪法导出的可解释奖励能把高层对齐原则转化为透明、可控的模型行为，使奖励既可审计又可定向调节。

papers.title: The Model Knows Another Way: Strategy Switching for Effective RLVR Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is often limited by insufficient exploration: difficult problems can yield uniformly incorrect rollout groups and therefore little learning signal. We show that such failures need not reflect missing capability. Instead, finite sampling often concentrates on a problem-specific dominant reasoning strategy while leaving alternative strategies already supported by the model unexplored. Moreover, the accessibility of these strategies evolves during RL: some are internalized into autonomous behavior, while others become difficult to elicit before being absorbed. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Problem--Strategy Rollout Allocation (PSRA), which treats unguided and strategy-conditioned prompts as competing exploration arms and uses Bayesian sequential allocation to direct a fixed rollout budget toward arms most likely to yield informative, non-saturated groups. A preservation objective keeps useful strategy-conditioned routes accessible while successful guided behaviors are transferred to the unguided policy. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B and two RL training corpora, PSRA consistently improves reasoning performance, reduces dead saturation, strengthens out-of-distribution transfer, and maintains larger gains under increased inference budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 中难题整组 rollout 全错、学习信号枯竭，根因是有限采样集中在单一主导推理策略上，而非模型能力缺失。PSRA 把无引导提示与策略条件提示当作竞争的探索臂，用贝叶斯序分配把固定 rollout 预算导向最可能产生非饱和组的臂，并用保留目标维持策略条件路径可达。在 Qwen2.5 1.5B–7B 与两个 RL 语料上一致提升推理表现、降低 dead saturation、增强分布外迁移。
Motivation: RLVR 在难题上 rollout 组均匀全错，探索不足导致几乎没有学习信号；作者指出这常是采样集中在单一策略、模型已支持的替代策略未被触及，而非能力缺失。
Method: 提出 Problem-Strategy Rollout Allocation (PSRA)：把 unguided 与 strategy-conditioned 提示当作竞争的探索臂，用贝叶斯序贯分配 (Bayesian sequential allocation) 在固定 rollout 预算下导向最可能产出 informative、非饱和组的臂；配一个 preservation 目标保持策略条件路径可达，同时把成功的 guided 行为迁移到 unguided 策略。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5 1.5B 到 7B 两个规模与两个 RL 训练语料上，PSRA 一致提升推理表现、减少 dead saturation、增强分布外 (OOD) 迁移，且在提高推理预算时保持更大增益。
Conclusion: RLVR 的探索瓶颈可通过在策略维度上分配 rollout 预算缓解：把替代策略当作可竞争的臂来调度，比单纯增加采样更能激活模型已有但未被触及的推理路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: RLVR 中难题整组 rollout 全错、学习信号枯竭，根因是有限采样集中在单一主导推理策略上，而非模型能力缺失。PSRA 把无引导提示与策略条件提示当作竞争的探索臂，用贝叶斯序分配把固定 rollout 预算导向最可能产生非饱和组的臂，并用保留目标维持策略条件路径可达。在 Qwen2.5 1.5B–7B 与两个 RL 语料上一致提升推理表现、降低 dead saturation、增强分布外迁移。

papers.title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: dKFD 在固定帧预算下按事件前、事件中、事件后三个阶段划分证据容量，替代让所有帧互相竞争的全局 Top-K 选择器。在 DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition 上 K=12 时 Frame AUC 比匹配预算的 Global Top-K 高 30.97（p<0.01）；去掉阶段监督后跌回 41.1±12.0，说明阶段划分本身是起作用的机制。
Motivation: 稀疏视频理解要在固定帧预算下选证据，但全局 Top-K 让所有帧同池竞争，对时间上局部化的事件是错误归纳偏置：证据分散在事件前语境、事件本身与事件后后果，导致识别与定位看似正常而选中帧与事件的对齐不稳定。
Method: 先对完整视频序列做时间编码，再用可微分选择器 (differentiable selector) 在 pre-event、event、post-event 三阶段间预留证据容量，并用阶段监督 (phase supervision) 约束分配；在匹配预算下做多随机种子评测，另做机制消融（保留阶段预算但去掉阶段监督）与跨 VLM 家族的下游诊断。
Result: DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition 上 Global Top-K 在 K=12 时识别与时间定位有竞争力但 Frame AUC 仅 51.5±10.8；dKFD 在 K=12 时比匹配预算的 Global Top-K 提升 Frame AUC +30.97（p<0.01），识别增益温和但统计显著，时间定位相当。去掉阶段监督后 Frame AUC 降至 41.1±12.0。VRU-Accident 上相对 learned Global Top-K 在各 VLM 家族一致增益；密集字幕任务上均匀采样仍有竞争力，构成边界条件。
Conclusion: 阶段结构化分配是面向事件的固定预算证据选择的可控方案，而非通用视频摘要策略；阶段监督是不可省略的承重组件，密集字幕类任务上均匀采样即可。

papers.title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemReward-VL 用临床结局标签替代行为描述标注，让视觉语言模型生成条目特异的儿童行为描述，再由冻结语言模型按结局一致性、条目相关性、无关视频-条目对的弃答与清晰度四项语义奖励打分，经 GRPO 更新 LoRA 适配器。在 13,379 段视频、41 个条目上提升了总体准确率与 recall>0.5 的条目数，但错误仍集中在行为的时间方向、持续时长与年龄特异解读上。
Motivation: 发育筛查视频记录了儿童的具体行为，但临床记录通常只存结局标签而没有行为描述，缺少可监督的文本标注，行为描述生成难以直接训练。
Method: 视觉语言模型先生成条目特异的行为描述，冻结语言模型作为奖励模型，从结局一致性、条目相关性、无关视频-条目对上的弃答、清晰度四个维度给出语义奖励；用 GRPO 据此更新 LoRA 适配器。
Result: 在覆盖 41 个条目的 13,379 段视频上，方法提升了总体准确率，并增加了 recall 高于 0.5 的条目数量；残余错误出现在行为的时间方向、持续时长与年龄特异解读三类。
Conclusion: 仅凭临床结局标签即可通过语义奖励驱动视频-语言适配来学习行为描述，但生成结果在时间方向、时长和年龄特异解读上仍不可靠。

papers.title: Structure-Mapping-Guided Self-Explanation for Learning Mathematical Procedures
papers.abstract_en: Worked examples are a powerful form of instruction, but learners must infer how the demonstrated steps were produced. A naive simulation of this self-explanation process can generate thousands of numerical explanations that reproduce one observed change without capturing its underlying procedure. We propose structure-mapping-guided self-explanation as a computational account of the cognitive biases that reduce search effort and make this inference tractable. The model represents mathematical expressions as typed relational structures and uses structure mapping to identify corresponding source and target regions. For each changed target value, the corresponding source region serves as an anchor: it guides abductive search toward structurally relevant values and operations before broader alternatives, yielding ordered, executable candidate procedures with inspectable source evidence. Across 70 mathematical transformations containing 120 changed numeric components, the model recovered every intended procedure. It returned the intended procedure before any other computation producing the same target value in 104 subproblems (86.7%), compared with a median of 32 (26.7%) across 100 unguided runs that tested candidate calculations in random order. Our proposed model also tested 93.8% fewer combinations of values and operations than unguided search before reaching the intended procedures. These results provide an efficient, interpretable account of how relational structure can guide procedural learning and a testable hypothesis about human self-explanation from worked examples.
papers.comment: 19 pages. Accepted for oral presentation at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 structure-mapping-guided self-explanation：把数学表达式表示为带类型的关系结构，用 structure mapping 定位源/目标区域，以源区域为锚引导 abduction 搜索，先试结构相关的值与运算再扩展。在 70 个数学变换（含 120 个变化数值成分）上恢复了全部目标过程，104 个子问题（86.7%）在任何产生相同目标值的其他计算之前就返回目标过程，而 100 次无引导随机顺序运行的中位数为 32（26.7%），且在到达目标过程前少测 93.8% 的值-运算组合。
Motivation: 从 worked example 学习时，学习者需推断示范步骤如何产生；朴素模拟 self-explanation 会生成上千个只复现某一处数值变化、却抓不到背后过程的解释，搜索空间过大。
Method: 模型把数学表达式表示为 typed relational structures，用 structure mapping 识别对应的 source 与 target 区域；对每个变化的 target 值，以其对应 source 区域为 anchor，先做结构相关的 abductive search 再扩展到更广候选，输出有序、可执行且带可查证 source 证据的候选过程。
Result: 在 70 个数学变换、120 个变化数值成分上恢复了每一个目标过程；104 个子问题（86.7%）在任何产生相同目标值的其他计算之前返回目标过程，对照 100 次随机顺序无引导运行的中位数 32（26.7%）；到达目标过程前测试的值-运算组合比无引导搜索少 93.8%。
Conclusion: 关系结构引导的锚定 abduction 能高效、可解释地缩小过程性学习的搜索空间，并给出关于人类从 worked example 做 self-explanation 的可检验假设。

papers.title: The limits of exactness: On the failure of automatic differentiation in physics-informed machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Automatic differentiation (AD) lets neural networks compute derivatives of governing equations to machine precision, and this precision has made it the computational backbone of physics-informed machine learning. Yet exactness in the mathematical sense is not the same as fidelity to the physics. Here I argue that a derivative can be numerically perfect and still be the wrong derivative for the problem at hand, because AD, by construction, has no notion of the physical structure a solution must obey. Convection and its associated directionality, diffusion, and dispersion are only the most visible instances of a much longer list that spans all branches of computational science and engineering, including conservation, thermodynamic consistency, symmetry, symplectic structure, positivity, monotonicity, and boundedness. Recognizing this broader gap reframes how the field should build the next generation of PDE-driven neural surrogates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张：自动微分 (AD) 给出的导数可以达到机器精度却仍是该问题的错误导数，因为 AD 在构造上不携带解必须满足的物理结构。对流方向性、扩散、色散只是最显眼的实例，缺口还覆盖守恒、热力学一致性、对称性、辛结构、正性、单调性与有界性；作者据此主张下一代 PDE 驱动的神经代理应按这一更广的缺口重新定位。
Motivation: 物理信息机器学习把 AD 当作计算控制方程导数的骨干，但数学上的精确不等于对物理的保真：数值完美的导数仍可能违反解必须服从的物理结构，这一缺口横跨计算科学与工程各分支。
Method: 这是一篇立场性论证：以 AD 的构造性局限为出发点，逐项列出被忽略的物理结构（对流与方向性、扩散、色散、守恒、热力学一致性、对称性、辛结构、正性、单调性、有界性），并据此重构 PDE 驱动神经代理的建设方向。
Result: 核心论断为定性：导数可以数值完美却仍是错的导数，因为 AD 没有物理结构的概念；文中点名的失效实例包括对流方向性、扩散与色散。全文为 18 页、2 图的论证性短文。
Conclusion: AD 的机器精度不能作为物理保真的判据，PDE 神经代理的下一代设计必须把守恒、正性、辛结构等物理约束显式纳入，而不是依赖微分本身的精确性。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

papers.title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NutriVision 用 DepthAnything-V3 从单张 RGB 补出深度、用 CLIP 编码可选配料文本，通过配料条件化的频率对齐融合与掩码预测头直接估计热量、质量、脂肪、碳水与蛋白质。在 Nutrition5k 上平均 PMAE 达 13.60±0.10%，比作者的 IGSMNet 实现低 0.89 个百分点、比 OmniFood8k 低 2.90 个百分点（p<0.001），消融显示配料感知预测头贡献最大（+1.50±0.17 个百分点）。
Motivation: 现有单图营养估计沿两条割裂路线走：视觉模型依赖标定好的 RGB-depth 采集，配料感知方法只用文本线索且多模态融合有限，都需要专用深度硬件。
Method: 端到端框架以单张 RGB 加可选配料表为输入：DepthAnything-V3 生成缺失的深度模态，CLIP 编码配料描述；三个机制分别是 IC-FAFM（用文本引导重加权并对齐 RGB-depth 频率分量）、IA-MPH（门控与通道掩码以食物身份为条件）、以及模态内部的 ISM 块。
Result: Nutrition5k 上平均 PMAE 13.60±0.10%，优于作者 IGSMNet 实现 0.89 个百分点、优于 OmniFood8k 2.90 个百分点，均 p<0.001；模块级消融中 IA-MPH 使平均 PMAE 改善 1.50±0.17 个百分点（p<0.001），是主要架构贡献者。
Conclusion: 配料条件化预测与频率感知 RGB-depth 融合能为单图营养估计带来可测增益，且无需专用深度传感硬件。

papers.title: QureRadEmbed: Structuring Radiological Similarity through Attribute and Reasoning Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Radiological similarity depends on disease relationships and on fine details such as laterality, lobe, severity, size, and certainty. Broad biomedical similarity can overlook these qualifiers, particularly when several attributes vary together. We introduce QureRadEmbed, a 4B radiology-aware encoder trained with two complementary signals: RadSim supplies deterministic, attribute-decomposed ranking targets, while RadThought aligns reports with hierarchical evidence and reasoning descriptions. A three-stage curriculum combines these signals with report triplets, finding perturbations, and single- and cross-attribute contrasts. The final model achieves 0.996 mean ordering accuracy across ten controlled synthetic attributes and raises Spearman correlation with the designed joint-attribute targets from 0.501 to 0.976. On external findings-to-impression retrieval, Recall@1 reaches 10.5% on Open-I, 12.4% on testing XR, and 42.9% on testing CT, compared with 6.6%, 5.7%, and 31.4% for its backbone. Frozen embeddings support finding extraction with only 100 labeled testing-XR reports (macro-F1 0.481 versus 0.412 for the backbone). Whole-report comparison costs 8.8 seconds per 1,000 pairs in our benchmark, versus 2,755.1 seconds for the generative evaluator GREEN. Sentence-level comparison improves sensitivity to local discrepancies, although generative evaluation remains stronger on several expert-rated and subtle-error tasks. The results support reusable radiology-aware representations for search, structured report indexing, and efficient report comparison.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 10 figures, including appendices with per-tag labeling results. Janhavi Prabhu and Sahil are co-first authors. Manoj Tadepalli is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QureRadEmbed 是一个 4B 的放射学感知编码器，用 RadSim 的属性分解排序目标与 RadThought 的报告-证据推理对齐两路信号，经三阶段课程（报告三元组、finding 扰动、单属性与跨属性对比）训练。在十个受控合成属性上平均排序准确率 0.996，与联合属性目标的 Spearman 相关从 0.501 提到 0.976；外部 findings-to-impression 检索 Recall@1 在 Open-I、testing XR、testing CT 上分别为 10.5%、12.4%、42.9%，均高于其 backbone 的 6.6%、5.7%、31.4%。
Motivation: 广泛的生物医学相似度模型会忽略 laterality、lobe、severity、size、certainty 这类属性限定词，尤其在多个属性同时变化时无法区分放射学意义上的相似与不同。
Method: 4B 放射学感知编码器，训练信号为 RadSim 提供的确定性属性分解排序目标与 RadThought 提供的报告对齐层级证据和推理描述；三阶段课程把这些信号与报告三元组、finding 扰动、单属性及跨属性对比组合起来。
Result: 十个受控合成属性上平均排序准确率 0.996，与设计的联合属性目标 Spearman 相关从 0.501 升至 0.976。外部 findings-to-impression 检索 Recall@1：Open-I 10.5%（backbone 6.6%）、testing XR 12.4%（5.7%）、testing CT 42.9%（31.4%）。冻结嵌入仅用 100 条标注 testing-XR 报告即可做 finding 抽取，macro-F1 0.481 对 backbone 的 0.412。整报告比较在本基准中每 1,000 对耗时 8.8 秒，生成式评测器 GREEN 为 2,755.1 秒；句级比较对局部差异更敏感，但生成式评测在若干专家评分与细微错误任务上仍更强。
Conclusion: 可复用的放射学感知嵌入足以支撑检索、结构化报告索引与高效报告比较，且在速度上远快于生成式评测器 GREEN；在专家评分的细微错误任务上生成式评测仍占优。

papers.title: KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation
papers.abstract_en: High-performance GPU kernels are essential to modern machine learning systems, yet automatically generating kernels that are both correct and efficient remains challenging. Existing LLM-based approaches face two major limitations: the scarcity of high-quality training data aligned with the model's current capabilities, and the inherent trade-off between kernel correctness and performance. To address these challenges, we propose KernelZero, a co-evolution framework that continuously improves GPU kernel generation through two specialized models: a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates them into CUDA or Triton kernels. KernelZero uses a frontier-driven module generation mechanism to continuously produce capability-aligned training modules based on the Coder's current weaknesses. It further introduces Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO), which optimizes performance only after correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. By alternating the optimization of the Proposer and Coder, KernelZero forms an automatic curriculum that enables targeted and training-efficient capability improvement. Empirically, KernelZero-7B surpasses Claude-4.5-Sonnet on CUDA and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Triton. On KernelBench Level 1 and 2, it achieves CUDA pass@1 scores of 75.8% and 69.6%, respectively, with pass@10 reaching 100% and 97%. On Triton, it achieves pass@1 scores of 77.2% and 72.5%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KernelZero 用 Proposer 与 Coder 两个模型交替优化，构成自动课程式的 GPU kernel 生成框架：Proposer 按 Coder 当前弱点生成能力对齐的 Torch 模块，Coder 再译成 CUDA/Triton，正确性达标后才用 CA-GRPO 优化性能。KernelZero-7B 在 KernelBench Level 1/2 上 CUDA pass@1 达 75.8%/69.6%、pass@10 达 100%/97%，Triton pass@1 达 77.2%/72.5%，超过 Claude-4.5-Sonnet（CUDA）与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（Triton）。
Motivation: LLM 生成 GPU kernel 受两类限制：与模型当前能力对齐的高质量训练数据稀缺，以及正确性与性能之间的固有权衡。
Method: KernelZero 交替优化两个专用模型：Proposer 从 API 集合生成 Torch 模块，Coder 将其翻译为 CUDA 或 Triton kernel；frontier-driven module generation 依据 Coder 当前弱点持续产出能力对齐的训练模块，形成自动课程；Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO) 仅在正确性足够可靠后才优化性能。
Result: KernelZero-7B 在 CUDA 上超过 Claude-4.5-Sonnet，在 Triton 上超过 DeepSeek-V4-Pro。KernelBench Level 1/2 的 CUDA pass@1 分别为 75.8% 和 69.6%，pass@10 分别为 100% 和 97%；Triton pass@1 分别为 77.2% 和 72.5%。
Conclusion: 让 Proposer 与 Coder 共同进化、并把性能优化推迟到正确性可靠之后，可以自动构造课程，实现训练高效且持续的 kernel 生成能力提升。

papers.title: Algorithmic Harms Associated with Generative Model-Augmented Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we consider algorithmic harms that may arise as generative models are incorporated into machine learning platforms. We argue that existing harm taxonomies and threat models require extension to (1) address novel causal drivers of well-studied representational and quality-of-service harms; and (2) anticipate and mitigate endogenous harms, such as sanitization, which may arise when system inputs are misaligned with the system designer's objectives, or the generative model's inductive priors. To this end, we introduce an expanded taxonomy of algorithmic harms associated with the use of generative models in non-conversational recommendation systems. In addition, we offer a causal analysis of how problematic subsets of the (input, output) joint distribution can arise, in an effort to inform harms detection and mitigation efforts.
papers.comment: Presented at the KDD 2025 Workshop on Online and Adaptive Recommender Systems (OARS), August 3, 2025, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张现有算法危害分类与威胁模型不足以覆盖生成模型接入推荐系统后的新情形：一是既有代表性危害与服务质量危害出现了新的因果驱动因素，二是会内生出 sanitization 这类新危害，即系统输入与设计者目标或生成模型归纳偏置失配时产生的危害。为此给出面向非对话式推荐系统的扩展危害分类，并对（输入，输出）联合分布中问题子集如何形成做因果分析，以支撑危害检测与缓解。
Motivation: 生成模型被并入机器学习平台后，原有危害分类和威胁模型既解释不了代表性危害与服务质量危害的新因果驱动，也无法预判输入与设计者目标或模型归纳偏置失配所内生的 sanitization 危害。
Method: 提出面向非对话式推荐系统中生成模型使用的扩展算法危害分类（taxonomy），并给出因果分析，刻画（输入，输出）联合分布中问题子集（problematic subsets）的形成机制，用于指导危害检测与缓解。
Result: 给出扩展的生成式增强推荐系统危害分类，以及（输入，输出）联合分布问题子集的因果分析；论文为分类与因果论证性质的工作。

papers.title: Baroclinic Annular Mode Modulates Global Atmospheric Rivers and Extreme Precipitation
papers.abstract_en: The Baroclinic Annular Mode (BAM) strongly influences extratropical circulation, yet its role in the global hydrological cycle remains unclear. Using ERA5 reanalysis and a global atmospheric river (AR) database, we show that BAM systematically reorganizes AR occurrence and extreme precipitation in both hemispheres. During high-BAM states, AR frequency increases along the flanks of major storm tracks and decreases near their climatological cores, redistributing preferred AR corridors. Relative AR-frequency changes locally exceed 50%, with the most zonally coherent patterns over the Southern Ocean. Extreme precipitation varies correspondingly, with 99th-percentile precipitation occurrence increasing by more than 50% across broad poleward storm-track regions. A large fraction of these extremes coincide with ARs, and AR-associated extreme precipitation shows similar BAM-related modulations. Low-BAM states show broadly opposite anomalies. These results identify BAM as a key mode linking large-scale circulation to global moisture transport and hydrological extremes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ERA5 再分析与全球大气河 (atmospheric river, AR) 数据库证明，斜压环状模 (BAM) 系统性重排两个半球的 AR 路径与极端降水：高 BAM 态下 AR 频率沿主要风暴轴两翼增加、在其气候态核心附近减少，局地相对变化超过 50%，南大洋上纬向一致性最强；对应地，极向风暴轴大范围区域的 99 百分位降水发生率增加超过 50%，且这些极端中很大比例与 AR 相伴。低 BAM 态的异常大体相反。
Motivation: BAM 对中纬度环流的影响已知，但它如何调制全球水汽输送与极端降水这一环流到水文循环的联系此前不清楚。
Method: 基于 ERA5 再分析与一套全球大气河数据库，比较高低 BAM 态下两个半球的 AR 出现频率、99 百分位极端降水发生率及其与 AR 的重合，识别 BAM 相关的异常型。
Result: 高 BAM 态下 AR 频率沿主要风暴轴两翼增加、气候态核心附近减少，局地相对 AR 频率变化超过 50%，南大洋上纬向一致性最强；99 百分位降水发生率在广大的极向风暴轴区域增加超过 50%；相当大比例的极端降水与 AR 重合，AR 相关极端降水呈现相似的 BAM 调制；低 BAM 态异常大体相反。
Conclusion: BAM 是连接大尺度环流与全球水汽输送及水文极端的关键模态，其位相决定 AR 走廊的重新分布与极端降水的增减方向。

papers.title: Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed $Θ= (c_x, c_y, \text{zoom})$ along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set ($\partial\mathcal{M}$). By projecting the recurrence $z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c$ onto the modular residue ring $\mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ and the fixed-point domain $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving $\mathcal{I}_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset \mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting ($\le 9$ and $\le 12$ steps), absence of $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$ square overflow below $2^{63}-1$, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound ($\le 22,557 \le 24,000$ gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, 1 listing. Formal verification in Lean 4 (v4.34.1, Mathlib4, 0 sorry). Ancillary files include Lean 4 proofs, Solidity contracts, and bare-metal 40-core gauntlet replication scripts

Motivation: 稠密浮点权重矩阵依赖高带宽 VRAM，带来 memory-wall 瓶颈，也使神经推理无法原生跑在 EVM 这类确定性虚拟机里；而连续域递归动力系统的终止与算术不变量在 Blum-Shub-Smale 模型下一般不可判定。
Method: WERR (Waves & Errors) 与 Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED) 用 24 字节种子 Θ=(c_x, c_y, zoom) 在 Mandelbrot 集边界 ∂M 上按需合成决策边界；将 z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c 投影到模 9 剩余环 Z/9Z 与 Q16.16 定点域，用 Lean 4 (v4.34.1) + Mathlib4 证明十条定理（0 sorry），并附 Solidity 合约与 40 核裸机复现脚本。
Result: Lean 4 机器验证十条定理、零 sorry：I_3={0,3,6} 在 Z/9Z 中的理想闭包、普适 fuel 有界停机（≤9 与 ≤12 步）、Q16.16 在 2^63-1 以下无平方溢出、边界逃逸敏感度非常数、EVM gas 上界 ≤22,557 ≤24,000。40 核 Dual Intel Xeon 上向量化 36 迭代 CPU kernel 处理 100,000 次决策用 6.49 s，即 15,397 decisions/s、0 Bytes VRAM、15.15x 加速；sigmoidal outlier gate 抑制 100.00% 对抗尖峰并保留 89.60% 干净基线信号。
Conclusion: 非张量、按需程序化合成的决策边界可以在零 VRAM 占用下同时给出形式化终止与算术保证和 EVM gas 上界，并在裸机上达到 15,397 decisions/s 与 15.15x 加速。
