papers.title: Reading Too Much into Context: Passive Exposure Can Steer LLM Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) assistants can now search the web and consult external sources while completing user requests. These sources can provide useful evidence, but they can also introduce additional content into the model's context. Can such passive exposure steer a decision even when the added content provides no reason to change it? We examine the stability of model decisions on the same tasks with and without such external content. Across all open-weight and closed-weight models we test, exposure systematically shifts decisions, with effects reaching nearly 50 percentage points in closed-weight models. The same pattern appears with real-world online opinions. The influence also extends beyond subjective preferences. Such exposure can steer models toward choices that violate explicit user requirements and increase their acceptance of false claims. In short, what enters an LLM's context can influence its decision even when it should not determine it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 联网检索场景中，外部内容即使不构成改变决策的理由，仅被动进入上下文也会系统性地偏移模型选择：在所测全部开放权重与闭源模型上均出现偏移，闭源模型效应接近 50 个百分点，且同样出现在真实网络观点上。这种暴露还会把模型推向违反用户显式要求的选项，并提高其对虚假论断的接受度。
Motivation: LLM 助手会边搜索网页边完成请求，外部内容既提供证据也额外注入上下文；尚不清楚这些内容在不提供改变决策的理由时，是否仍会左右模型的同一任务决策。
Method: 在同一任务上对比有无外部内容两种上下文条件，测量模型决策的稳定性；测试覆盖开放权重与闭源模型，并扩展到真实网络观点、违反用户显式要求的选项以及虚假论断接受度等场景。
Result: 在测试的全部开放权重与闭源模型上，被动暴露都系统性地改变了决策，闭源模型中的效应接近 50 个百分点；同一模式在真实网络观点上复现；暴露还使模型更倾向选择违反显式用户要求的选项，并提高其对虚假论断的接受度。
Conclusion: 进入 LLM 上下文的内容会在本不该决定结果时影响其决策，即上下文注入本身构成一种与证据无关的决策操纵通道。

papers.title: LLM sequential decision making under uncertainty in biochemical domains
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to drive scientific discovery. Understanding how LLMs make decisions from new data and memory of the literature is vital before trusting them to design experiments under tight experimental budgets. However, their decision strategies are invisible in the current performance scores used to evaluate research agents. Here, we benchmark five frontier LLMs in a Bayesian Optimization setting against published statistical baselines on seven combinatorial datasets spanning protein engineering, reaction optimization, molecular design, peptide self-assembly, and catalysis. Performance is paired with direct measurements of model beliefs and actions, enabling highly resolved behavior analysis. A prompt ablation that progressively strips context separates memorization from chemical reasoning and from bare categorical optimization. Prior chemical knowledge helps in expectation, but with high variance and occasionally even harms performance. No configuration tested decisively beats a mean statistical baseline across domains. Belief-movement and Martingale diagnostics, corrected here for a measurement-noise bias that mislabels rational agents as irrational, show that models overreact to incoming data rather than entrenching on their priors in the contexts studied here. Interestingly, while LLM actions are exploitative, models sincerely intend to explore and consistently act on that intent. This failure is a competence gap arising from context-stickiness. Removing in-context history restores exploration, indicating that priors and data must be decoupled to achieve effective LLM-driven discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在生化领域的贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian Optimization) 设定下对五个前沿 LLM 做决策基准，用信念-动作直接测量与 Martingale 诊断揭示其对新数据过度反应、动作却过度利用。没有任何配置在跨领域上决定性胜过均值统计基线；去掉 in-context 历史可恢复探索，说明须把先验与数据解耦。
Motivation: LLM 被用来驱动科学发现，但其在新数据与文献记忆之间的决策策略在现有研究 agent 评分中不可见，在紧实验预算下不足以信任。
Method: 在贝叶斯优化设定下评测五个前沿 LLM，对照已发表统计基线，覆盖蛋白工程、反应优化、分子设计、肽自组装、催化七个组合数据集；直接测量模型信念与动作做行为分析，并用逐步剥离上下文的 prompt 消融区分记忆、化学推理与纯类别优化；给出经测量噪声偏差校正的 Belvement-movement 与 Martingale 诊断。
Result: 先验化学知识期望上有帮助但方差高、偶尔反而损害性能；没有任何受测配置在跨领域上决定性胜过均值统计基线；诊断显示模型对新数据过度反应而非固守先验；动作是利用型的，但模型真诚意图探索并一致按该意图行动；移除 in-context 历史可恢复探索。
Conclusion: LLM 的探索失败是 context-stickiness 造成的能力缺口而非意图缺失，实现有效 LLM 驱动发现须把先验与数据解耦。

papers.title: Deep Learning Techniques for Phoneme Recognition in Italian Children' s Speech
papers.abstract_en: Speech therapists often face difficulties diagnosing impairments due to the lack of efficient tools for transcribing speech into the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). This work addresses this challenge with Broca, a Conformer-based deep learning system pretrained on 8 days of adult speech and fine-tuned on a 165-minute dataset of Italian child speech collected through a range of standardized diagnostic tests for children aged 3.5-6.5. Broca was optimized to handle phonetic variability in children's speech, including tone, accent, and speech errors, and achieved a state-of-the-art weighted Phoneme Error Rate of 13.36% on Italian speech. Remarkably, this performance was obtained using less than three hours of child-specific data, underscoring the model's efficiency and robustness in low-resource clinical settings. This work demonstrates that accurate, vocabulary-independent speech-to-IPA transcription can be achieved with minimal data, paving the way for more accessible, data-efficient tools to support speech assessment and diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Broca：基于 Conformer 的音素识别系统，先用 8 天成人语音预训练，再用 165 分钟意大利儿童语音微调，直接把儿童语音转写为 IPA。在意大利语上取得加权音素错误率 (weighted PER) 13.36% 的 SOTA，且儿童专属数据不足 3 小时，说明低资源临床场景下可做与词表无关的准确转写。

Result: 在意大利语上取得加权音素错误率 13.36%，达到 state-of-the-art；该结果仅用不足 3 小时的儿童专属数据得到，训练数据为 8 天成人语音预训练加 165 分钟儿童语音微调。

papers.title: Large Language Models Substantially Compress Well-Being Inequality but Largely Preserve Its Socioeconomic Structure
papers.abstract_en: Research using large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic populations has repeatedly shown that model outputs compress the diversity of human experience. This has raised doubts about whether LLM-generated data can capture meaningful differences within populations. We show that such compression does not necessarily erase the social structure of human heterogeneity. Using 93,901 respondents from 66 countries and territories in Wave 7 of the World Values Survey, we ask six LLMs to predict respondents' life satisfaction from demographic, socioeconomic, and attitudinal profiles. All six models substantially understate the overall dispersion of life satisfaction. Yet after normalizing for these differences in scale, they largely reproduce the human income gradient in well-being inequality: lower-income groups remain relatively more heterogeneous than higher-income groups. The pattern is robust to country fixed effects, equal-country weighting, WVS survey weights, and observed demographic composition, and it extends directionally to employment, education, and perceived control. Fidelity is weaker for extreme outcomes and country-specific gradients. These results show that the amount of heterogeneity preserved by an LLM and the way that heterogeneity is distributed across social groups are distinct properties. LLM-generated populations can therefore substantially compress human variation while retaining meaningful information about where that variation is concentrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用六个 LLM 从人口学、社会经济与态度画像预测 World Values Survey 第七波受访者的幸福感分布，发现模型大幅压缩生活满意度的总体离散度，但在按尺度归一化后基本复现人类的收入—幸福感不平等梯度：低收入组仍比高收入组更异质。该梯度在国家固定效应、等国加权、WVS 调查权重与人口构成控制下稳健，说明「压缩总量」与「保留分布结构」是两个可分离的性质。
Motivation: 既有研究发现 LLM 生成的合成人群会压缩人类经验的多样性，进而质疑 LLM 数据能否刻画人群内部的真实差异；本文要区分被压缩的是异质性的总量还是其社会分布结构。
Method: 以 WVS Wave 7 的 93,901 名受访者、66 个国家和地区为对象，让六个 LLM 依据人口学、社会经济与态度特征预测个体生活满意度；对模型输出做尺度归一化后再与人类的收入梯度比较，并用国家固定效应、等国加权、WVS 调查权重和观测人口构成做稳健性检验。
Result: 六个模型都显著低估生活满意度的总体离散度；归一化后它们大体复现人类收入—幸福感不平等梯度，低收入组相对更高收入组更异质，该模式对国家固定效应、等国加权、WVS 调查权重与人口构成稳健，并在就业、教育、控制感维度上方向一致；对极端结果与各国特有梯度的保真度较弱。
Conclusion: LLM 合成人群可以在大幅压缩人类变异总量的同时保留变异集中于哪些社会群体的信息，异质性被保留的量与其社会分布方式是两个独立属性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BudgetVerify: Budget-Tiered Verification for Financial QA
papers.abstract_en: Financial question answering often requires precise numerical extraction, unit handling, and arithmetic over tables and text, but applying expensive verification uniformly wastes test-time compute. We propose BudgetVerify, a budget-tiered generator-verifier framework that routes each generated answer to one of three verification tiers: no verification, lightweight check-and-revise, or higher-cost solve-first-then-compare verification. The router is trained from offline correctness and token-cost outcomes and, at test time, selects a verification tier using information available before verification, including the question, context statistics, the generated answer, and associated generator metadata. The selected tier either returns the generated answer directly or invokes the corresponding verifier. Across six commercial and open-weight base models, BudgetVerify consistently produces more efficient accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers than fixed verification policies by selectively allocating stronger verification only when it is useful. Although absolute performance varies across models, these efficiency gains and the resulting qualitative frontier shape are consistent across generator models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BudgetVerify 把财务问答的验证按预算分三档路由：不验证、轻量检查-修改、高成本先解后比，路由器用离线正确性与 token 成本结果训练，测试时只依据验证前可得的信息选档。在六个商业与开源基座模型上，它比固定验证策略给出更高效的 accuracy-cost Pareto 前沿，且前沿形状在各生成器上一致。
Motivation: 财务 QA 需要精确数值抽取、单位处理与表格文本上的算术，但对每题统一跑昂贵验证会浪费 test-time compute。
Method: 预算分层的 generator-verifier 框架：路由器把生成答案分到三档（无验证、check-and-revise、solve-first-then-compare），用离线正确性与 token 成本结果训练，测试时以问题、上下文统计、生成答案和生成器元数据等验证前信息选档，再决定直接返回或调用对应 verifier。
Result: 在六个商业与开源基座模型上，相较固定验证策略得到更高效 accuracy-cost Pareto 前沿；绝对性能随模型变化，但效率增益与前沿形状在各生成器上保持一致。
Conclusion: 只在验证确实有用时分配更强验证，就能在财务 QA 上以更低成本换取同等或更好的准确率，且该效率收益跨生成器模型稳定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid-attention models replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention, reducing KV-cache growth and enabling larger decode batches where recurrent state access becomes a major bottleneck. ReplaySSM amortizes state updates by buffering keys and values, but each new query still requires a full-state read even though the state remains unchanged between state updates. We observe that low-rank state-weighted query approximation accurately preserves state-read outputs. Although future queries are unknown, the basis vectors used to approximate them can be fixed offline. Based on this observation, we introduce SketchSSM, which preserves full-state updates while approximating reads. At each state update, SketchSSM reads the full state once to precompute outputs for these basis vectors, storing them in a compact sketch. Each subsequent decode step combines the sketch vectors with query-dependent coefficients to reconstruct the output without a full-state read. Across four Mamba-2-, GDN-, and KDA-based models, SketchSSM reduces state-access traffic by approximately 10x while largely preserving average accuracy across four decode benchmarks and recall on four RULER retrieval tasks. On one NVIDIA B300, linear-attention kernel speedups over the standard vLLM baseline reach 7.78x, 5.22x, and 5.20x for Mamba-2, GDN, and KDA, respectively, with up to 2.64x higher decode throughput on Nemotron 3 Super.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SketchSSM 针对混合注意力模型解码时循环状态读取成为瓶颈的问题，保留全状态更新、只把状态读取做低秩近似：每次状态更新时用固定基向量读一次全状态并预存成紧凑 sketch，之后每个解码步用 sketch 向量加查询相关系数组合重建输出。状态访问流量约降 10x，在四个解码基准与四个 RULER 检索任务上基本保持精度与召回，NVIDIA B300 上相对 vLLM 的线性注意力 kernel 加速最高 7.78x。
Motivation: 混合注意力模型把大部分 softmax 层换成线性注意力以抑制 KV-cache 增长，但循环状态访问成为解码瓶颈；ReplaySSM 虽用缓冲键值摊销状态更新，每个新查询仍要读全状态，而状态在两次更新之间其实不变。
Method: 基于低秩的状态加权查询近似能准确保留状态读取输出、且近似未来查询的基向量可离线固定这一观察，SketchSSM 在每次状态更新时读一次全状态、为这些基向量预计算输出并存成紧凑 sketch，后续解码步用查询相关系数组合 sketch 向量重建输出，从而保留全状态更新、只近似读取。
Result: 在四个基于 Mamba-2、GDN、KDA 的模型上，状态访问流量约降 10x，同时在四个解码基准上基本保持平均精度、在四个 RULER 检索任务上保持 recall。单张 NVIDIA B300 上相对标准 vLLM 基线的线性注意力 kernel 加速分别为 Mamba-2 7.78x、GDN 5.22x、KDA 5.20x，Nemotron 3 Super 上解码吞吐最高提升 2.64x。
Conclusion: 线性注意力/SSM 解码的读取开销可以用离线固定基向量的 sketch 近似掉，而不必牺牲全状态更新，从而在保持精度与检索召回的同时大幅降低状态访问流量并提升解码吞吐。

papers.title: DevelopmentODE: Structured Neural ODEs for Early Brain Development Dynamics Across a Decade
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how individual brain development unfolds over childhood requires modeling developmental trajectories from sparse longitudinal observations. Long-term neurodevelopmental forecasting is challenging because each child is typically observed at only a few irregularly spaced visits, while developmental dynamics vary across individuals and age. Generic continuous-time models accommodate irregular timing but often absorb these factors into a single flexible transition function, providing little structure for how population progression, individual variability, and developmental age shape the dynamics. We propose DevelopmentODE, a structured continuous-time framework that organizes population- and subject-specific variation within a shared developmental geometry while allowing the governing dynamics to evolve with age. The model builds this geometry around a developmental canal representing the population trajectory, whose local direction provides a reference for organizing subject-specific variation. Subject deviation velocities are constrained relative to this direction, while a shared nonlinear deviation field captures individual developmental motion without disrupting population-level progression. DevelopmentODE further models developmental non-stationarity through ordered age-dependent deformations of the shared vector field, progressively adapting a common dynamical structure as age changes, while elapsed time determines the integration horizon. This formulation uses population-level developmental structure to guide learning from sparse individual trajectories while allowing dynamics to evolve smoothly with age. We evaluate DevelopmentODE on longitudinal fMRI by predicting future functional connectivity of the same child from earlier observations. DevelopmentODE consistently outperforms competing baselines across short- and long-horizon predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DevelopmentODE 把儿童长期发育轨迹组织进共享发育几何：以群体发育渠 (developmental canal) 为参考方向约束个体偏离速度，再用随年龄有序变形的共享向量场刻画非平稳动力学，积分时长由经过时间决定。在纵向 fMRI 上预测同一儿童未来功能连接，短程与长程预测均稳定优于竞争基线。
Motivation: 每个儿童只有少数不规则随访，而通用连续时间模型把群体进程、个体差异和发育年龄全部吸进一个灵活的转移函数，缺少可解释结构来区分这三者。
Method: 结构化连续时间框架：以群体发育渠的局部方向作参考，约束个体偏离速度并用共享非线性偏离场承载个体运动；共享向量场施加随年龄有序的变形以建模非平稳性，经过时间决定 ODE 积分区间；用群体结构引导稀疏个体轨迹上的学习。
Result: 在纵向 fMRI 上以儿童早期观测预测其未来功能连接，DevelopmentODE 在短程与长程预测上均持续优于竞争基线。
Conclusion: 把群体发育结构显式写进连续时间模型，可以在稀疏不规则随访下同时保持群体进程并容纳个体与年龄依赖的动力学变化。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在纵向 fMRI 上以儿童早期观测预测其未来功能连接，DevelopmentODE 在短程与长程预测上均持续优于竞争基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把群体发育结构显式写进连续时间模型，可以在稀疏不规则随访下同时保持群体进程并容纳个体与年龄依赖的动力学变化。

papers.title: Cost-free Spectral Estimation for Adaptive Newton--Schulz in Matrix Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: Matrix optimizers such as Muon transform each momentum matrix through an approximate orthogonalization, typically implemented by a small number of Newton-Schulz matrix multiplications. The quality and cost of this approximation depend strongly on the singular-value spectrum of its input, yet existing implementations use the same fixed polynomial routine for every layer and throughout training. We show that this uniform treatment is unnecessary: the computations in the Newton-Schulz method already reveal enough information to make the method adaptive. The Gram matrices formed inside Newton-Schulz iterations yield spectral moments through inexpensive scalar reductions, requiring no additional matrix multiplications. From these moments, we recover an estimate of the empirical singular-value distribution and use it to select a polynomial routine specialized to the current matrix. This turns Newton--Schulz orthogonalization into a spectrum-adaptive procedure that responds to differences across both layers and training time. On saved momentum matrices, spectral estimation substantially reduces orthogonalization error at a fixed iteration budget or reaches the same accuracy with fewer iterations, and in GPT pretraining up to 1B parameters it lowers the validation loss of two matrix optimizers. Our results suggest that matrix-function operations inside optimizers need not be designed for a conservative worst-case spectrum: they can cheaply measure the spectrum they are already processing and specialize computations accordingly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Muon 类矩阵优化器中 Newton--Schulz 正交化对所有层与整个训练期使用同一固定多项式的问题，提出免开销的谱估计：利用 Newton--Schulz 迭代内部 Gram 矩阵的标量归约提取谱矩，恢复奇异值分布估计并据此为当前矩阵选择专用多项式。在保存的动量矩阵上，固定迭代预算下正交化误差显著下降或同精度所需迭代更少；在最大 1B 参数的 GPT 预训练中降低了两个矩阵优化器的验证损失。
Motivation: Newton--Schulz 近似正交化的质量与代价强烈依赖输入奇异值谱，但现有实现对每层、每个训练阶段都用同一固定多项式，造成不必要的保守设计与算力浪费。
Method: 从 Newton--Schulz 迭代中已形成的 Gram 矩阵出发，用廉价标量归约得到谱矩（无需额外矩阵乘），由谱矩重建经验奇异值分布估计，再据此为当前矩阵挑选专用多项式例程，使正交化随层与训练时间自适应。
Result: 在保存的动量矩阵上，谱估计在固定迭代预算下大幅降低正交化误差，或以更少迭代达到同等精度；在最大 1B 参数的 GPT 预训练中，降低了两个矩阵优化器的验证损失。
Conclusion: 优化器内的矩阵函数运算不必为最坏情况谱保守设计：它们可以廉价测量正在处理的谱并据此专门化计算。

papers.title: More than 83.69% of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are distinct
papers.abstract_en: The lower asymptotic proportion of distinct nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function, counted with multiplicity, is at least $0.8369928814\ldots$. The previous bound was $0.83625\ldots$. As in the proof of that bound, an unconditional version of Montgomery's pair-correlation theorem gives an asymptotic energy estimate. The new ingredient is a short matrix inequality with a free clipping parameter. It strengthens the lower bound for this energy in terms of the number of distinct zeros. The gain is a nonnegative correction from overlaps between different nearby zeros on the critical line, which is retained even when some of these zeros are double. The matrix inequality, the threshold lemma, the block dichotomy, the counting assembly and the exact arithmetic are proved formally in Lean 4. The constant relies on a computer-assisted local inequality from recent work that has not yet been refereed. That computation was re-run independently, and every imported input is listed. This paper is primarily an experiment in AI-assisted mathematical research (Section 4).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把黎曼 zeta 函数非零零点中互不相同者的渐近比例下界从 0.83625 提高到 0.8369928814，核心是一个带自由 clipping 参数的短矩阵不等式，且矩阵不等式、threshold lemma、block dichotomy、计数组装与精确算术全部在 Lean 4 中形式化证明。全文定位为 AI 辅助数学研究的实验。
Motivation: 此前已知的互异零点比例下界停在 0.83625，如何在保留零点重数信息的同时进一步抬高该下界是数论中的具体缺口。
Method: 沿用 Montgomery pair-correlation 定理的无条件版本给出渐近能量估计，新增一个带自由 clipping 参数的矩阵不等式，用不同邻近零点重叠产生的非负修正项强化能量下界；矩阵不等式、threshold lemma、block dichotomy、计数组装与精确算术在 Lean 4 中形式化，常数依赖一项计算机辅助局部不等式。
Result: 互异非trivial 零点的渐近比例下界由 0.83625 提升至 0.8369928814；修正项在部分零点为二重时仍非负；计算机辅助计算被独立重跑，全部导入输入均已列出。
Conclusion: 带 clipping 参数的矩阵不等式足以在 Lean 4 形式化框架下推进黎曼零点互异性下界，但所依赖的计算机辅助局部不等式尚未经同行评审。

papers.title: Balancing Early Performance Sacrifices with Long-Term Gains: Scaling Learning-Rate Warmup Duration Across Training Horizons
papers.abstract_en: Learning-rate warmup is a standard technique in language-model training, yet its duration remains largely heuristic. Common approaches use either a fixed number of updates or a fixed fraction of the training horizon, two choices that imply very different scaling as training gets longer. When should warmup stay fixed, and when should it grow with the horizon? We address this question with a quadratic model whose modes respond differently to the peak learning rate. Warmup slows progress in directions that already contract well at the peak rate, but can remove persistent error in directions near the stability edge, with higher peak rates shifting the balance toward longer warmup durations. This yields a compact horizon scaling law that captures regimes ranging from essentially no warmup, through fixed-duration warmup, to durations that grow with the training horizon, and explains how the preferred regime changes with peak learning rate. Because the law captures the tradeoff between giving up early progress and improving the trajectory that follows, it can be fit using shorter runs and used to predict warmup at substantially longer horizons. Together, our results explain several familiar properties of warmup through a single tradeoff and suggest treating warmup duration as a horizon-dependent hyperparameter rather than a fixed training heuristic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用二次模型分析学习率 warmup 时长：warmup 会拖慢峰值学习率下本已收敛良好的方向，却能消除接近稳定性边缘方向的持久误差，峰值学习率越高越偏向更长 warmup。由此导出一条随训练时长 (horizon) 缩放的 warmup 定律，覆盖无需 warmup、固定时长、随时长增长三种机制，并可用短程训练拟合后预测更长时长的最优 warmup。
Motivation: 语言模型训练中 warmup 时长仍是启发式选择：固定更新步数与固定训练时长比例两种惯例在训练变长时给出完全不同的缩放，缺少判定何时该固定、何时该随时长增长的准则。
Method: 构造一个各模态对峰值学习率响应不同的二次模型 (quadratic model)，刻画 warmup 在收缩良好方向与稳定性边缘方向上的相反作用；据此推导出紧凑的 horizon scaling law，并说明该定律可用较短训练拟合后外推到更长训练时长。
Result: 得到覆盖三种 warmup 机制（基本不 warmup、固定时长、随时长增长）的缩放定律，并解释最优机制如何随峰值学习率变化；定律拟合自短程训练并可预测显著更长 horizon 下的 warmup 时长。
Conclusion: warmup 的多种常见性质可由“牺牲早期进度 vs 改善后续轨迹”这一单一权衡解释，warmup 时长应作为随训练时长变化的超参数而非固定启发式。

papers.title: Agent Safety From Within: Detecting Harmful Trajectories from LLM Internal States
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents can now perform sophisticated sequences of actions via tools and harnesses, which has increased the scope of the damage they can cause. Guard models, however, are mainly built for content moderation and thus are not well-suited to detecting this agentic risk. To address this, we proceed by first conducting a representational analysis, then use the resulting insights to build a solution. In our analysis, we focus on two types of trajectory-level agentic harms: harmful content, which is expressed directly, and unsafe tool use, which depends on whether an action is consistent with the interaction that produced it. We investigate how open-source guard models represent these two types of harm and find that they are linearly readable inside the model, even though guard models predict no better than chance on pairs that differ only in the called tool's schema. The two harm types also follow nearly orthogonal internal directions, and neither reliably serves as a proxy for the other. These results motivate reading trajectory safety directly from internal states. We introduce TACIT, a readout of a frozen backbone's internal states that decodes no tokens. Trained on six trajectory-safety benchmarks, a linear probe raises mean macro-F1 from 62.3 for the strongest open guard to 80.7, and refined readouts reach 86.2. With each benchmark held out of training entirely, the refined readouts still lead the strongest guard (65.7 vs. 61.1). With the same backbone, training data and test split, the frozen readout is on par with full safety fine-tuning, and it improves the fine-tuned model further when applied on top. The probe trains about one millionth as many parameters as full fine-tuning in about a sixth of the time, and TACIT has the lowest latency of the guards we evaluate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TACIT：直接从冻结 LLM backbone 的内部状态线性解码轨迹级 agent 安全性，不读任何 token。在六个轨迹安全基准上，线性 probe 把最强开源 guard 的 mean macro-F1 从 62.3 提到 80.7，精修 readout 达 86.2；留一基准训练时仍以 65.7 对 61.1 领先，参数量约为全量微调的百万分之一、训练时间约六分之一。
Motivation: LLM agent 通过工具与 harness 执行长动作序列，危害范围扩大，但现有 guard model 主要为内容审核设计，检测不了依赖动作与上下文一致性的 unsafe tool use；在只改工具 schema 的配对上其表现不优于随机。
Method: 先做表征分析：检查开源 guard model 内部对 harmful content 与 unsafe tool use 两类轨迹危害的线性可读性及两类方向的正交性；再提出 TACIT，对冻结 backbone 的内部状态做不解码 token 的 readout，用线性 probe 与精修 readout 在六个轨迹安全基准上训练。
Result: 线性 probe 使 mean macro-F1 从最强开源 guard 的 62.3 升到 80.7，精修 readout 达 86.2；每基准完全留出训练时精修 readout 仍以 65.7 对 61.1 领先最强 guard；同 backbone、同训练数据与测试划分下冻结 readout 与全量 safety fine-tuning 持平，叠加其上还能进一步提升；训练参数约为全量微调的百万分之一、耗时约六分之一，且在所评测 guard 中延迟最低。
Conclusion: 两类轨迹危害在 guard model 内部近似正交且互不可代理，因此轨迹安全性应直接从内部状态读出；冻结 readout 以极小训练代价达到全量微调水平并可叠加增益。

papers.title: Improving the Diversity of LLM Outputs without a Trade-off
papers.abstract_en: We propose DAST (Diversifying Arithmetic Sampling with TokenTour), a method that increases the diversity of LLM outputs without any change to the marginal distribution and with negligible generation-time overhead (a few microseconds). We observe that token IDs are often arranged in a meaningless order and reassign them so that tokens with similar meanings appear consecutively. This can be done in advance in a few hundred seconds per model, and the resulting order can be reused for all subsequent generations. By combining this order with arithmetic sampling (or quasi-Monte Carlo methods), we make similar tokens less likely to be generated across runs while preserving the distribution. Our method not only produces qualitatively good ideas but also significantly improves performance on the downstream task of ProtoQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DAST（Diversifying Arithmetic Sampling with TokenTour）：把 LLM 的 token ID 按语义相近者相邻的顺序重排，再结合 arithmetic sampling / quasi-Monte Carlo，使多次采样中相似 token 更少重复出现。边缘分布完全不变，生成期开销仅几微秒，重排每模型预计算几百秒即可复用；在 ProtoQA 下游任务上显著提升性能。
Motivation: LLM 多次采样的输出多样性不足，而常规去重或温度调节会改动边缘分布、牺牲质量；token ID 的原始排列本身无语义顺序，未被利用。
Method: DAST 先对 token ID 重排使语义相近的 token 相邻（每模型预计算几百秒，结果可复用于后续所有生成），再把该顺序与 arithmetic sampling 或 quasi-Monte Carlo 结合，在保持分布不变的前提下跨 run 降低相似 token 的重复概率。
Result: 边缘分布零改变，生成期额外开销为几微秒量级，token 重排每模型耗时几百秒且可复用；定性上产出更好的想法，并在 ProtoQA 下游任务上显著提升性能。
Conclusion: 在不改动输出边缘分布、几乎不增加生成开销的条件下，重排 token 顺序配合算术/拟蒙特卡洛采样即可同时提高 LLM 输出多样性与下游任务表现，无需在多样性和质量之间取舍。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 边缘分布零改变，生成期额外开销为几微秒量级，token 重排每模型耗时几百秒且可复用；定性上产出更好的想法，并在 ProtoQA 下游任务上显著提升性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在不改动输出边缘分布、几乎不增加生成开销的条件下，重排 token 顺序配合算术/拟蒙特卡洛采样即可同时提高 LLM 输出多样性与下游任务表现，无需在多样性和质量之间取舍。

papers.title: Byzantine-Robust Federated RAG via Aligned Calibration and Fixed-Membership Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets language models answer questions more accurately by consulting relevant documents. Many valuable collections, such as medical records, cannot be pooled because of privacy rules. Federated RAG leaves each collection with its owner, or node, which scores candidate answers from its own documents; a central hub combines the scores. Some nodes, called Byzantine, may be compromised, faulty, or misled by instructions hidden in documents, and report arbitrary scores. Conformal prediction returns a set containing the correct answer with a chosen probability, using a cutoff set in a calibration step on questions with known answers. An unknown group of nodes, no larger than a declared bound, may misreport both in this step and at query time. Existing methods assume every node is honest or protect only the calibration step. We observe that the honest nodes are the same in both steps. The hub therefore has all nodes score the same calibration questions, and keeps a candidate only if some plausible group of honest nodes, using its own scores in both steps, would keep it. We prove that the resulting sets contain the correct answer with the chosen probability in finite samples, whatever the Byzantine nodes report. No method using the same information can return smaller sets without risking the loss of an answer the honest nodes support. If nodes fail at random, the guarantee weakens only by the probability that more nodes fail than declared. In simulations, on real question-answering tasks including medical exams, and with language models as nodes, some hijacked, our sets reached the target whenever no more nodes misbehaved than declared, while plain averaging could miss it. They were also clearly smaller than those of simpler methods with the same protection, most of all when the declared bound was generous, so a cautious bound costs little.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在联邦 RAG 中，中心枢纽让所有节点对同一批校准问题打分，只保留「某个与两步打分一致的可信节点组也会保留」的候选答案，从而在 Byzantine 节点同时污染校准与查询阶段时仍给出有限样本覆盖率保证。仿真与含医学考试的真实 QA 任务上，只要失控行为节点数不超过声明上界，集合就达到目标覆盖，且明显小于同等保护的简化方法。
Motivation: 隐私规则使医疗记录等文档库无法集中，联邦 RAG 只能由各节点本地打分、中心聚合；但 Byzantine 节点可在校准和查询两步都谎报分数，而现有方法要么假设全员诚实、要么只保护校准步。
Method: 枢纽让全部节点对同一批已知答案的校准问题打分，候选答案仅在其能被某个与两步打分自洽的可信节点组保留时留下；证明该集合在有限样本下以指定概率覆盖正确答案，且在同等信息下集合最小。
Result: 在仿真、含医学考试的真实问答任务、以语言模型充当节点（部分被劫持）的设置中，只要失控行为节点数不超过声明上界，集合即达到目标覆盖，而简单平均可能失守；集合明显小于同等保护的简化方法，声明上界偏宽松时差距最大。若节点随机失效，保证仅按「失效节点数超过声明值」的概率减弱。
Conclusion: 利用两步中诚实节点集合相同这一结构，可以在任意 Byzantine 报告下保住有限样本覆盖且集合近最小，因此宽松的 Byzantine 上界代价很小。

papers.title: Breaking the Environment Wall: A Unified Framework for Preparing and Evolving Agent-Native Environments
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world tasks (e.g., office workflows, scientific experimentation) require LLM agents to interact repeatedly with their environments for context-dependent operations. However, such environments are often not agent-ready. First, information is often scattered and fragmented across the environment. Second, relevant evidence in the environment is often mixed with misleading information and conflicting versions. Third, environments evolve over time, introducing new noise and more challenging tasks. These challenges can substantially degrade performance for state-of-the-art AI agents (e.g., from 83.9% to 57.6%). To address these challenges, we propose Env-Rethink (a system with 27B post-trained model) that supports three main capabilities: (1) It adaptively builds Collection Maps (for organizing related files) and Event Logs (for contextualizing cross-data relationships) to supplement necessary context; (2) It further leverages the post-trained model (through offline trajectory learning) to identify underlying noise issues in the environment; (3) It ultimately evolves environments through virtual event histories that alter environmental states and evidence relationships, producing more tricky ones for further agent improvement. Experiments show that Env-Rethink can effectively improve downstream task performance (with a 15.1 percentage-point increase in mean rubric pass rate across nine models on 30 tasks).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Env-Rethink 用 27B 后训练模型把非 agent-ready 的环境整理成可推理结构：自适应构建 Collection Maps 与 Event Logs 补齐上下文，用离线轨迹学习识别环境噪声，再通过虚拟事件历史演化环境状态以生成更难任务。在 30 个任务、9 个模型上，平均 rubric 通过率提升 15.1 个百分点；环境挑战可使 SOTA agent 性能从 83.9% 跌到 57.6%。
Motivation: LLM agent 需要反复与环境交互完成上下文相关操作，但信息碎片化、证据与误导信息混杂、环境随时间演化，使 SOTA agent 性能从 83.9% 降至 57.6%。
Method: 提出 Env-Rethink，含 27B 后训练模型：自适应构建 Collection Maps（组织相关文件）与 Event Logs（刻画跨数据关系）补充上下文；通过 offline trajectory learning 识别环境中的潜在噪声；用虚拟事件历史改变环境状态与证据关系，演化出更棘手的环境。
Result: 在 30 个任务、9 个模型上，平均 rubric 通过率提升 15.1 个百分点；环境挑战可使 SOTA agent 性能从 83.9% 降到 57.6%。
Conclusion: 把环境整理、噪声识别与主动演化统一到一个框架，能持续抬高 LLM agent 在下游任务上的通过率，并可用演化后的环境继续训练 agent。

papers.title: Attention Routing Stabilizes Early: Working-Set Inference for Recurrent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent-depth language models, such as looped Transformers, repeatedly apply shared network blocks to refine latent representations without generating explicit intermediate reasoning tokens. However, each step recomputes full attention over the entire context, repeating costly global routing. We study how attention routing evolves across recurrent depth and find a consistent separation in convergence timescales: attention support and distributions stabilize substantially earlier than hidden states and attention outputs. This suggests two stages of recurrent inference: early discovery of a sparse working set, followed by representation refinement over largely stable routing support. Motivated by this finding, we introduce WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation), a training-free method that uses unrestricted attention during early recurrent steps to discover a block-structured working set, then reuses its support in later steps while keeping attention weights and recurrent refinement dynamic. Controlled interventions show that multi-step discovery yields more effective working sets than first-step selection, and that support reuse better preserves model behavior than more restrictive forms of attention reuse. Across multi-hop QA benchmarks, WISE largely preserves full-attention performance. Matched context-scaling experiments reveal an increasingly favorable quality-efficiency tradeoff as routing support becomes sparser with longer contexts. A sparse-attention implementation achieves up to a 1.76x late-step attention speedup over native FlashAttention at 4K context. Code: https://github.com/tbn5pj/WISE_code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WISE 发现循环深度语言模型中注意力路由比隐状态和注意力输出早得多地收敛，据此提出训练无关的两阶段推理：早期用无限制注意力发现块结构 working set，后期只复用其 support 而保持权重动态。多跳 QA 上基本保持全注意力性能，4K 上下文时稀疏实现的后期步注意力相对原生 FlashAttention 最高加速 1.76 倍。
Motivation: looped Transformer 等 recurrent-depth 模型每一步都对全上下文重算注意力，重复昂贵的全局路由，长上下文下推理开销随步数线性放大。
Method: WISE (Working-set Inference with Support Exploitation)：前若干循环步用无限制注意力发现块结构 working set，后续步复用该 support、保留注意力权重与循环精化的动态性；训练无关，并用受控干预比较多步发现与第一步选择、support 复用与更严格的注意力复用。
Result: 多跳 QA 基准上 WISE 基本保持全注意力性能；matched context-scaling 实验显示上下文越长、路由 support 越稀疏，质量-效率权衡越有利；稀疏注意力实现在 4K 上下文下后期步注意力相对原生 FlashAttention 最高 1.76 倍加速。
Conclusion: 循环推理可拆成早期稀疏 working set 发现与后期在稳定 support 上的表示精化两阶段，复用 support 比复用完整注意力更保行为。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EnSIMem: Entity-Structured Indexing for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: An agent that interacts with users over long periods must recall facts, preferences, events, and changes from a continuously growing interaction history. Existing memory systems often compress interactions into generic summaries or retrieve anonymous text chunks, making it difficult for an agent to identify the correct entity, property, and supporting evidence. We present EnSIMem, an entity-structured long-term memory architecture for an agent. During offline construction, the system organizes interactions into theme-coherent episodes and builds dialogue-grounded index entries of the form [entity][entity_type][property: value]. Each entry preserves its source turns, temporal information, and available multimodal fields. During online interaction, the agent's request is decomposed into evidence requirements whose properties are aligned with the memory index. Entity-property lookup and adaptive retrieval then collect the evidence needed for point, temporal, compositional, and aggregation reasoning. The agent generates its response from the preserved source evidence rather than from lossy memory summaries. On long-term agent-memory benchmarks, EnSIMem achieves high answer accuracy while maintaining compact, evidence-focused contexts. These results show that entity-structured indexing and episode-level provenance provide a reliable foundation for long-term memory in agents. The code of our model is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSIMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnSIMem 把长期对话记忆组织成 [entity][entity_type][property: value] 结构化索引条目并保留来源轮次与时间信息，在线阶段把请求分解为证据需求再做实体-属性检索，使回答基于原始证据而非有损摘要。在长期 agent 记忆基准上取得高回答准确率，同时保持紧凑、以证据为中心的上下文。
Motivation: 长期交互历史持续增长，现有记忆系统把交互压成通用摘要或检索匿名文本块，agent 难以定位正确实体、属性与支撑证据。
Method: 离线构建阶段把交互组织为主题连贯的 episode，建立带来源轮次、时间信息与多模态字段的索引条目；在线阶段将请求分解为证据需求，与索引属性对齐后做实体-属性查找与自适应检索，支撑 point、temporal、compositional、aggregation 四类推理，最终从保留的来源证据生成回答。
Result: 在长期 agent 记忆基准上取得高回答准确度，同时保持紧凑、以证据为中心的上下文；代码发布于 github.com/RamonMeng/EnSIMem。
Conclusion: 实体结构化索引加 episode 级来源追溯可作为 agent 长期记忆的可靠基础，回答应从保留的原始证据生成而非有损摘要。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CAVEAT: Towards Robust Computer-Use Agents in Incentive-Misaligned Environments
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly act on behalf of users online. What happens when the environments they operate in have incentives of their own? Online marketplaces, for example, may favor some products over others, steering agents away from the user's objective. Existing CUA benchmarks cover cooperative settings or explicit attacks, but do not test whether agents preserve user objectives when the environment itself has a stake in the outcome. We introduce CAVEAT, a controlled benchmark spanning nine marketplace environments and a taxonomy of eight common steering mechanisms. Across five model families, agents purchase the user-optimal product in 78.6% of matched-control episodes but only 17.3% when steering mechanisms are enabled. Larger models and more reasoning improve robustness, but substantial failures persist. Trajectory analysis and targeted ablations identify three weaknesses in how agents decide: they (1) prematurely narrow the set of alternatives they consider, (2) impose priorities the user never stated, and (3) commit before resolving decision-relevant evidence. Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CAVEAT-Harness, which targets these failures and raises the optimal purchase rate by up to 80.0 percentage points, and show that targeted post-training further improves a smaller open model. These results establish incentive robustness as a distinct challenge for delegated agents, diagnose failure modes, and show how targeted interventions can substantially improve robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAVEAT 是一个受控基准，覆盖 9 个线上市场环境与 8 类诱导机制 (steering mechanisms)，测试计算机使用代理 (CUA) 在环境自身有利益倾向时是否仍守住用户目标。5 个模型家族在匹配对照下 78.6% 的回合买到用户最优商品，开启诱导后骤降到 17.3%；针对三类决策缺陷的 CAVEAT-Harness 把最优购买率最多提升 80.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 CUA 基准只覆盖协作场景或显式攻击，没有检验当环境本身对结果有利益时代理是否保持用户目标；线上市场偏袒特定商品即是这种激励错位 (incentive-misaligned) 场景。
Method: 构建受控基准 CAVEAT：9 个 marketplace 环境、8 类诱导机制分类法，跨 5 个模型家族评测；用轨迹分析与定向消融定位三类决策缺陷——过早收窄候选集、强加用户未声明的优先级、在证据未澄清前就拍板——再据此提出 CAVEAT-Harness，并对一个较小开源模型做定向 post-training。
Result: 匹配对照下用户最优购买率 78.6%，开启诱导机制后仅 17.3%；模型更大、推理更多会提升鲁棒性但失败仍大量存在。CAVEAT-Harness 使最优购买率最多提高 80.0 个百分点，定向 post-training 进一步改善一个较小的开源模型。
Conclusion: 激励鲁棒性是委派代理 (delegated agents) 的一类独立挑战：失败可归因到三个具体决策缺陷，而针对这些缺陷的干预能大幅提高鲁棒性。

summary_sections.tldr: CAVEAT 是一个受控基准，覆盖 9 个线上市场环境与 8 类诱导机制 (steering mechanisms)，测试计算机使用代理 (CUA) 在环境自身有利益倾向时是否仍守住用户目标。5 个模型家族在匹配对照下 78.6% 的回合买到用户最优商品，开启诱导后骤降到 17.3%；针对三类决策缺陷的 CAVEAT-Harness 把最优购买率最多提升 80.0 个百分点。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 CUA 基准只覆盖协作场景或显式攻击，没有检验当环境本身对结果有利益时代理是否保持用户目标；线上市场偏袒特定商品即是这种激励错位 (incentive-misaligned) 场景。
summary_sections.method: 构建受控基准 CAVEAT：9 个 marketplace 环境、8 类诱导机制分类法，跨 5 个模型家族评测；用轨迹分析与定向消融定位三类决策缺陷——过早收窄候选集、强加用户未声明的优先级、在证据未澄清前就拍板——再据此提出 CAVEAT-Harness，并对一个较小开源模型做定向 post-training。
summary_sections.result: 匹配对照下用户最优购买率 78.6%，开启诱导机制后仅 17.3%；模型更大、推理更多会提升鲁棒性但失败仍大量存在。CAVEAT-Harness 使最优购买率最多提高 80.0 个百分点，定向 post-training 进一步改善一个较小的开源模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 激励鲁棒性是委派代理 (delegated agents) 的一类独立挑战：失败可归因到三个具体决策缺陷，而针对这些缺陷的干预能大幅提高鲁棒性。

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge scales evaluation, but reasoning judges are slow and costly. We study JEV-as-a-Judge: evaluation with JEV, a decision-only judge that returns label probabilities instead of text, and whose confidence decides whether to accept its verdict or escalate to a reasoning judge. Against sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, JEV comes within three points of GPT-6 wherever a verdict can be read off the text, at 0.36% of its fee and a 0.15-second median latency, and falls behind where the verdict must be derived, as in math, code, and logic. Its confidence marks this boundary. With a threshold frozen in advance, accepting confident verdicts and escalating the rest is 0.9 points more accurate than GPT-6 at 41% of its fee, and in a pre-specified live test on two new workloads the cascade matches GPT-6's accuracy exactly. Confidence routing weakens on style-adversarial pairs and reference-free prose.
papers.comment: Expanded the dataset, updated the results and figures, and added new analyses. The previous result reporting 99% of GPT performance at 57% of the cost is retained in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 JEV-as-a-Judge：用只输出标签概率的 decision-only 判官 JEV，按自身置信度决定接受其判决还是升级到 reasoning 判官。在与 16 个生成式/reward-model 判官、盲评人类裁决的对比中，凡可从文本直接读出判决的任务上 JEV 与 GPT-6 差距在 3 分以内、费用仅 0.36%、中位延迟 0.15 秒；预先冻结阈值后「接受自信判决、其余升级」的级联比 GPT-6 准确率高 0.9 分、费用为 41%，在两个新工作负载的预设实测中准确率与 GPT-6 完全持平。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 需要规模化评测，但 reasoning 判官慢且贵；需要一种在可直接读出判决的任务上省钱、在需要推导的任务上自动回退的机制。
Method: JEV 是 decision-only 判官，只返回标签概率而非文本；以其置信度对照预先冻结的阈值决定接受判决或升级到 reasoning 判官（GPT-6）。评测对 16 个生成式与 reward-model 判官，采用盲评人类裁决，并在两个新工作负载上做预设的 live test。
Result: 在判决可从文本直接读出的任务上，JEV 与 GPT-6 差距在 3 分以内，费用为 GPT-6 的 0.36%，中位延迟 0.15 秒；在需要推导的任务（math、code、logic）上落后，而其置信度恰好标出这条边界。阈值预先冻结的接受/升级级联比 GPT-6 准确率高 0.9 分、费用为 41%；两个新工作负载的预设实测中级联准确率与 GPT-6 完全一致。置信度路由在 style-adversarial pairs 与 reference-free prose 上减弱。
Conclusion: 用判官自身置信度做接受/升级路由，可以在多数任务上以远低于 GPT-6 的成本达到或超过其准确率，但该机制在风格对抗样本和无参考文本上会失效。

papers.title: Statistical Gains from Looped Estimation under Parameter Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Memory constraints in artificial intelligence motivate accurate function approximation with fewer parameters. We study looping, which repeatedly composes one update function with shared parameters; each output becomes the next input. A looped Transformer, for example, reuses one block, whereas its conventional untied counterpart uses separately parameterized blocks. We compare their parameter requirements for a given worst-case approximation accuracy, or equivalently, their approximation accuracy under a common budget limiting distinct trainable coefficients. We then ask whether this representational parsimony improves statistical accuracy. For general likelihood models, we establish an upper squared Hellinger risk bound for looped sieve maximum likelihood and a minimax lower bound for the jointly tuned untied family. Further loop iterations improve the approximation bound without adding parameters, while increasing computation and the fitted-class complexity bound. For targets of known Hölder smoothness, looped residual feedforward networks and post-layer-normalized Transformers attain the minimax polynomial rate up to logarithmic factors with a fixed number of bounded real parameters. At sufficiently large fixed budgets, looped worst-case risk vanishes while optimal worst-case untied risk remains bounded away from zero. The loop-to-untied risk ratio also tends to zero under specified growing-budget conditions. Regression, binary response, and energy-based generative models illustrate the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在参数预算受限时，循环估计（looping，把同一更新函数反复复合、输出作为下一输入）比非绑定参数的 untied 结构更省参数：在给定最坏情形逼近精度下所需参数更少，且在足够大的固定预算下 looped 最坏风险趋于零而 untied 最优最坏风险仍远离零。作者建议在 Hölder 光滑目标上用固定数量的有界实参数即可达到 minimax 多项式速率（至多差对数因子）。
Motivation: AI 的内存约束要求用更少参数做准确函数逼近，但循环结构与常规 untied 结构在给定最坏逼近精度下的参数需求差异，以及这种表示节俭能否转化为统计精度提升，此前缺少理论刻画。
Method: 对一般似然模型建立 looped sieve maximum likelihood 的上界（squared Hellinger risk）与联合调优 untied 族的 minimax 下界；对已知 Hölder 光滑度的目标，分析 looped residual feedforward networks 与 post-layer-normalized Transformers 的逼近与风险速率，并用回归、二元响应和 energy-based generative models 说明理论。
Result: 在给定最坏情形逼近精度下 looped 结构所需参数少于 untied；进一步的循环迭代在不加参数的前提下改进逼近界，但增加计算量与拟合类复杂度界。在足够大的固定预算下 looped 最坏风险趋于零，而 untied 最优最坏风险仍远离零；在指定的增长预算条件下 loop-to-untied 风险比也趋于零。looped residual feedforward 网络与 post-layer-normalized Transformer 以固定数量有界实参数达到 minimax 多项式速率（至多差对数因子）。
Conclusion: 循环共享参数带来表示节俭，并在足够大的固定预算下转化为统计风险优势；代价是更多计算与更大的拟合类复杂度界。

papers.title: GINIO: A Geometric SO(3)-Equivariant Interface for Neural Inertial Odometry
papers.abstract_en: Neural inertial odometry increasingly uses networks as learned measurements inside filtering pipelines. Such measurements should transform consistently under arbitrary IMU mounting conventions: their mean must transform as a vector, and their covariance must transform congruently as a second-order tensor. We present GINIO, a geometric SO(3)-equivariant interface for neural inertial odometry under arbitrary rotations of the IMU measurement frame. Given calibrated IMU windows, our framework predicts a motion measurement and uncertainty obeying these tensorial laws. To support efficient sensor-frame learning, we introduce Last-Frame Alignment (LFA), a deterministic preprocessing step that is provably equivalent to world-frame training for SO(3)-equivariant predictors. The connected estimator tracks sensor-local states such as IMU bias, separating nuisance estimation from the geometric law enforced by the learned measurement. We instantiate the same interface in filter-connected NIO, AirIO-style recurrent aerial prediction, EqNIO-style full-SO(3) canonicalization, and ResNet-style temporal backbones. On TLIO, GINIO achieves 2.018 m ID/SO(3) ATE while EqNIO degrades to 76.389 m, using 11.6x fewer FLOPs. On NanoBench, our AirIO-style instantiation improves ATE from 5.579 m to 1.430 m without external attitude input, and our ResNet-style instantiation reaches 0.581 m ATE versus 0.645 m for ResNet1D. On Fetch, GINIO empirically reduces unseen physical-remount ATE from 8.15 m to 0.50 m without retraining, demonstrating robustness beyond the exact coordinate-frame guarantee. For uncertainty, spectral covariance reduces covariance-equivariance error by over three orders of magnitude compared with a diagonal head.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 28 pages, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GINIO 为神经惯性里程计 (neural inertial odometry) 提供 SO(3) 等变接口，使网络输出的运动测量均值按向量、协方差按二阶张量在任意 IMU 安装旋转下一致变换，并用可证与世界系训练等价的 Last-Frame Alignment (LFA) 做传感器系学习。在 TLIO 上 ID/SO(3) ATE 为 2.018 m（EqNIO 退化到 76.389 m）且 FLOP 少 11.6 倍；Fetch 上未见物理重装 ATE 从 8.15 m 降到 0.50 m 且无需重训。
Motivation: 网络作为滤波管线中的学习测量时，其输出必须在任意 IMU 安装约定下一致变换，否则重装或换坐标系即失效；现有 NIO 在坐标系变化下精度大幅退化。
Method: 提出 SO(3) 等变接口，预测满足张量变换律的运动测量与不确定性；引入确定性的 Last-Frame Alignment (LFA) 预处理，可证对 SO(3) 等变预测器等价于世界系训练；连接的估计器跟踪 IMU bias 等传感器本地状态，把干扰量估计与学习测量所强制的几何律分离。同一接口实例化到 filter-connected NIO、AirIO 式循环空中预测、EqNIO 式全 SO(3) 规范化与 ResNet 式时序骨干。
Result: TLIO：GINIO ID/SO(3) ATE 2.018 m，EqNIO 退化到 76.389 m，FLOP 少 11.6 倍。NanoBench：AirIO 式实例在无外部姿态输入下 ATE 从 5.579 m 降到 1.430 m；ResNet 式实例 ATE 0.581 m，ResNet1D 为 0.645 m。Fetch：未见物理重装 ATE 从 8.15 m 降到 0.50 m，无需重训。谱协方差头使协方差等变误差比对角头降低三个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 把等变性做成接口层约束，可让同一 NIO 架构在任意安装旋转与未见重装下保持精度，同时大幅降低计算量；坐标系保证之外的经验鲁棒性也成立。

papers.title: Geometric and Semantic Coupling for Interaction Understanding in 3D Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Understanding interaction in a 3D scene requires recovering movable parts, their motion, and where they can be operated. These quantities are related, and their predictions can inform one another. A closed cabinet door, for instance, reveals a movable surface but may leave the hinge side ambiguous; its handle helps resolve this ambiguity, while the part provides context for localizing and interpreting the small handle. Building on this observation, we present SEGMENT-SNAP, which combines geometric and semantic evidence through part-handle coupling. Three independently trained predictors recover movable parts, dense handles, and part-associated handle proposals. We couple their outputs in two directions. For part motion, a training-free geometric decoder fits predicted part surfaces under explicit physical priors and uses detected handles to select candidate hinge lines. For handle prediction, a part-conditioned branch proposes additional handles, while standalone part classes refine their rotation/translation labels, with dense-handle labels as a fallback. Each transfer is applied once, without iterative feedback. On the Articulate3D validation set, handle guidance raises motion-gated AP from 13.74 to 40.98 under fixed masks and axes. Additional handle proposals raise handle AP from 24.63 to 29.65, and full contextual class correction raises it to 30.99 in the reference configuration. Fixed-input controls, retraining ablations, learned-decoder comparisons, and paired visualizations together characterize the benefits and limits of this coupling. Our system also achieved first place in the Articulate3D Challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEGMENT-SNAP 用 part-handle 耦合把几何与语义证据打通：三个独立训练的预测器分别给出可动部件、稠密把手与部件关联把手提案，再做单次双向迁移。在 Articulate3D 验证集上，把手引导把固定 mask 与轴下的 motion-gated AP 从 13.74 提到 40.98，把手 AP 从 24.63 提到 29.65，再加上下文类别纠正到 30.99。
Motivation: 3D 场景交互理解需要同时恢复可动部件、运动与可操作位置，三者相互依赖但通常各自独立预测，铰链侧等歧义难以靠单一信号消解。
Method: 三个独立训练的预测器分别预测可动部件、稠密把手与部件关联把手提案；部件运动侧用 training-free 几何解码器在显式物理先验下拟合预测部件表面并用检测到的把手筛选候选铰链线，把手侧用 part-conditioned 分支追加提案、用独立部件类别纠正旋转/平移标签并以稠密把手标签兜底，每次迁移只做一次、无迭代反馈。
Result: Articulate3D 验证集上，把手引导在固定 mask 与轴下把 motion-gated AP 从 13.74 提升到 40.98；追加把手提案使 handle AP 从 24.63 升到 29.65，参考配置下完整上下文类别纠正进一步升到 30.99；系统在 Articulate3D Challenge 获得第一名。
Conclusion: 几何与语义的单向一次性耦合即可大幅改善部件运动与把手预测，且固定输入对照、重训练消融与学习解码器比较共同刻画了该耦合的收益与边界。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 三个独立训练的预测器分别预测可动部件、稠密把手与部件关联把手提案；部件运动侧用 training-free 几何解码器在显式物理先验下拟合预测部件表面并用检测到的把手筛选候选铰链线，把手侧用 part-conditioned 分支追加提案、用独立部件类别纠正旋转/平移标签并以稠密把手标签兜底，每次迁移只做一次、无迭代反馈。
summary_sections.result: Articulate3D 验证集上，把手引导在固定 mask 与轴下把 motion-gated AP 从 13.74 提升到 40.98；追加把手提案使 handle AP 从 24.63 升到 29.65，参考配置下完整上下文类别纠正进一步升到 30.99；系统在 Articulate3D Challenge 获得第一名。
summary_sections.conclusion: 几何与语义的单向一次性耦合即可大幅改善部件运动与把手预测，且固定输入对照、重训练消融与学习解码器比较共同刻画了该耦合的收益与边界。

papers.title: The Undetected Damage of Quantization on Retrieval and How to Fix It
papers.abstract_en: We show that a quantized model that keeps its classification accuracy still changes $14$ to $46\%$ of its top-1 retrieval results, and that aggregate ranking metrics reveal only part of this damage. We tie this failure to the gap between the two highest model scores and use that gap to decide when to trust a quantized answer and where additional precision should be spent. We show that the top-1 result is guaranteed to survive quantization only when this gap exceeds twice the largest rounding error. In classification, the scores are logits, and training compares the correct class against every other class, which encourages this gap. In retrieval, the scores are query-document similarities, and training compares each positive only against sampled negatives, so nothing separates the top-1 item from the second. This gap can be measured without labels. Before deployment, it predicts which models will break under quantization, and at deployment time it tells, per input, whether the quantized answer still matches the full-precision answer. Most classification inputs have a gap wide enough to trust the quantized answer, but few retrieval queries do. That gap motivates a different fix in each task. In retrieval, spending extra bit-width on the layers whose quantization moves the gap most recovers up to three-quarters of an extra bit's benefit for half its cost. In classification, routing the few low-gap inputs to full precision recovers most of the lost accuracy at a fraction of the cost.
papers.comment: 5 figures, 3 tables in the main paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量化后分类精度不变的模型仍会改变 14%–46% 的 top-1 检索结果，且聚合排序指标掩盖了这一损伤。作者把损伤归因于 top-1 与 top-2 分数之差（gap），并证明当 gap 超过最大舍入误差两倍时 top-1 结果在量化下必然保留；据此在检索侧按 gap 敏感度分配额外位宽，可花一半成本拿到额外 1 bit 收益的至多四分之三，在分类侧把少量低 gap 输入路由到全精度即可挽回大部分损失精度。
Motivation: 量化模型常被以分类精度未下降作为通过标准，但检索任务的 top-1 结果已大量改变，而聚合排序指标只暴露其中一部分损伤；部署前缺少无需标签即可判断量化是否安全的信号。
Method: 用 top-1 与 top-2 模型分数之差（gap）刻画量化鲁棒性，证明 gap 大于最大舍入误差两倍时 top-1 必然保留；该 gap 无需标签即可测量，部署前用于预测哪些模型会在量化下失效，部署时逐输入判断量化答案是否与全精度一致。修复分两路：检索侧对量化时移动 gap 最多的层投入额外位宽，分类侧把低 gap 输入路由到全精度。
Result: 分类精度保持不变的量化模型会改变 14%–46% 的 top-1 检索结果；检索侧按 gap 敏感度分配位宽，花一半成本可拿到额外 1 bit 收益的至多四分之三（three-quarters）；分类侧路由少量低 gap 输入到全精度可挽回大部分损失精度、成本只是一小部分。多数分类输入的 gap 足够宽可信任量化答案，而检索查询中满足者很少。
Conclusion: 量化损伤的共同根源是 top-1 与 top-2 的分数间隔不足，而分类训练（对所有类比较）天然拉开该间隔、检索训练（正例仅对采样负例比较）不拉开；用无标签 gap 作为逐输入判据，可在检索侧定向加位宽、在分类侧定向回退全精度。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Visual Target Matters: Learning across the Visual Hierarchy for Brain-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Brain-to-image retrieval seeks to identify the visual stimulus that elicited a non-invasive neural response. Candidate images are typically represented by pretrained vision models, whose internal representations vary in abstraction across depth. Existing methods usually train the neural encoder to recover a fixed final-layer visual target. Under this formulation, the visual hierarchy is reduced to a single prescribed endpoint, preventing representations at other depths from directly shaping the visual target. This limitation motivates learning how information across visual depths should contribute to the retrieval target. To this end, we introduce NeuroGlyph, which learns a trial-independent visual target from multiple depths of a frozen visual backbone. NeuroGlyph decomposes the target into factor-specific subspaces. Each subspace learns an image-conditioned allocation over visual depth. The resulting subspaces are fused into a single embedding for retrieval. Across THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, NeuroGlyph outperforms final-layer supervision in all controlled comparisons. It also surpasses the post hoc best fixed-layer oracle in three of four comparisons. Parameter-matched ablations support both factorized target construction and image-conditioned depth allocation. Under comparable 200-way retrieval protocols, NeuroGlyph achieves the strongest system-level performance in six of eight reported metrics. These results support learning retrieval targets across the visual hierarchy rather than prescribing one visual depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroGlyph 为脑到图像检索 (brain-to-image retrieval) 学习一个跨视觉骨干多深度、trial-independent 的视觉目标，按因子子空间做图像条件化的深度分配再融合成检索嵌入。在 THINGS-EEG 与 THINGS-MEG 上，它在全部受控比较中胜过末层监督，并在四个比较中的三个超过事后最优固定层 oracle；200-way 检索协议下八项指标中六项取得最强系统级性能。
Motivation: 现有方法把神经编码器训练去恢复固定的末层视觉目标，视觉层级被压缩成单一指定终点，其他深度的表征无法直接塑造检索目标。
Method: NeuroGlyph 从冻结视觉骨干 (frozen visual backbone) 的多个深度学习 trial-independent 视觉目标，将目标分解为因子特定子空间 (factor-specific subspaces)，每个子空间学习对视觉深度的图像条件化分配 (image-conditioned allocation)，最后把子空间融合为单一检索嵌入；并做参数对齐 (parameter-matched) 消融验证因子化目标构造与深度分配。
Result: 在 THINGS-EEG 与 THINGS-MEG 上，NeuroGlyph 在全部受控比较中优于末层监督，在四个比较中的三个超过事后最优固定层 oracle；参数匹配消融支持因子化目标构造与图像条件化深度分配；在可比的 200-way 检索协议下，八项报告指标中六项取得最强系统级性能。
Conclusion: 检索目标应当跨视觉层级学习，而不是预先指定单一视觉深度。

papers.title: Physics-residual machine learning predicts oxygen-evolution catalyst activity beyond the training range from sparse polarization measurements
papers.abstract_en: Discovery campaigns for oxygen evolution reaction catalysts repeatedly choose, make and measure catalysts. High-throughput platforms stop polarization curves below potentials that damage the catalyst, so the endpoint, the activity at a target potential or current density, often lies beyond the measured window, and the catalysts of most interest are more active than any measured before. Existing methods do not predict these endpoints accurately when few or no endpoints of a new library have been measured. Here we present physics-residual machine learning (PR-ML), which predicts each endpoint as the sum of a Tafel term, computed from the catalyst's own measured curve with an estimated slope, and a residual term learned from labelled catalysts. In twelve Ni-Pd-Pt-Ru thin-film libraries, the current density at 1.70 V$_{RHE}$ was predicted from the currents at 1.40 and 1.55 V$_{RHE}$. Fitted only on earlier libraries, with ridge regression as the residual learner, PR-ML predicted the Ni--Ru library, whose currents mostly exceed theirs, with a mean absolute error of 0.194 mA cm$^{-2}$, against 1.330-1.882 for data-driven models. With five endpoints from the new library and extremely randomized trees as the residual learner, PR-ML gave a similar error, which the same learner used alone reached only with 20, and identified 63-83% of the catalysts more active than the best labelled catalyst, against 2%. In two independent datasets, this fraction rose from at most 1% to 33-95%. Our approach supplies catalyst selection with accurate endpoints beyond the measured part of each curve and above all earlier measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出物理残差机器学习 (PR-ML)，把目标电位下的电流密度写成 Tafel 外推项（用催化剂自身实测曲线估计斜率）加一个从已标注催化剂学出的残差项，用于预测超出实测窗口的析氧反应 (OER) 活性端点。在 12 个 Ni-Pd-Pt-Ru 薄膜库上，仅用早期库拟合的 ridge 残差学习器预测 Ni–Ru 库 1.70 V_RHE 电流密度，MAE 为 0.194 mA cm⁻²，而纯数据驱动模型为 1.330–1.882。
Motivation: 高通量平台为避免损坏催化剂会在达到目标电位前停止极化曲线，端点落在实测窗口之外；而最有兴趣的催化剂活性高于此前任何实测值，现有方法在新库端点很少或没有实测时无法准确预测。
Method: PR-ML 将端点预测分解为 Tafel 项（由该催化剂自身在 1.40 与 1.55 V_RHE 的实测电流加估计斜率外推）与残差项（由已标注催化剂学习）之和；残差学习器可选 ridge 回归或 extremely randomized trees，训练仅用更早的库。
Result: 在 12 个 Ni-Pd-Pt-Ru 薄膜库上由 1.40 与 1.55 V_RHE 电流预测 1.70 V_RHE 电流密度：仅用早期库拟合的 ridge 版 PR-ML 在 Ni–Ru 库（其电流大多高于训练库）上 MAE 0.194 mA cm⁻²，数据驱动模型为 1.330–1.882。新库给 5 个端点时，extremely randomized trees 残差版误差与单独用该学习器需 20 个端点时相当；识别出优于最佳已标注催化剂的催化剂占比 63–83%，单独用该学习器仅 2%。在两个独立数据集上该占比从至多 1% 升至 33–95%。
Conclusion: 把物理外推项与学习残差结合，可以在新库几乎没有端点标注时预测超出实测电位窗口、且高于历史全部测量的催化剂活性端点，从而支撑催化剂筛选。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CSC: Calibrated Simplicity for Conflict-Aware Social Bot Detection in the LLM Era
papers.abstract_en: Social bot detection is essential for protecting online platforms from misinformation amplification, coordinated manipulation, and distorted public discourse. However, large language models have made social bots much harder to detect from text alone because semantic camouflage is now cheap, fluent, and scalable. The resulting challenge is modality conflict: an account may look human-like in semantics while remaining suspicious in graph structure, profile attributes, or cross-modal consistency. Recent graph-based detectors tackle this limitation by adding graph-side complexity, such as sparse prototype selection, adaptive gating, or architecture-specific control logic, yet our experiments suggest that complexity alone is not the most reliable way to resolve such conflict. We therefore propose CSC, a calibrated-simplicity framework for conflict-aware LLM-era social bot detection. The framework combines three design choices: a simplified prototype-guided graph expert that retains useful structural biases while removing unstable graph-side heuristics, calibrated simplex-constrained fusion that aligns heterogeneous confidence spaces before late fusion, and a lightweight inconsistency expert that models cross-modal disagreement. Experiments on TwiBot-22, TwiBot-20, and MGStBot-large show that \textsc{CSC} improves calibrated operating-point decision quality while remaining competitive across external benchmarks. Further analyses show that calibration improves confidence reliability, the inconsistency expert mainly provides localized corrections in high-conflict or near-threshold regions, and simplified graph-side control yields a better stability-cost trade-off. A targeted semantic-camouflage stress test further shows that replacing selected bot text with matched human text sharply degrades the standalone text expert while leaving graph and fused evidence stable on a balanced challenge set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CSC：在 LLM 语义伪装使文本侧失效时，用简化原型引导图专家、单纯形约束校准融合 (calibrated simplex-constrained fusion) 与轻量不一致性专家处理模态冲突。在 TwiBot-22、TwiBot-20、MGStBot-large 上提升校准工作点的决策质量；语义伪装压力测试中，把机器人文本换成匹配的人类文本会大幅拉垮独立文本专家，而图与融合证据保持稳定。
Motivation: LLM 让语义伪装廉价且流畅，账号在文本上像人、却在图结构与跨模态一致性上可疑；现有图侧检测器靠堆复杂度（稀疏原型选择、自适应门控）处理这种模态冲突，但复杂度本身并不可靠。
Method: CSC 框架含三部分：保留结构偏置、去掉不稳定图侧启发式的简化原型引导图专家；在晚期融合前对齐异构置信空间的单纯形约束校准融合；建模跨模态分歧的轻量不一致性专家。
Result: 在 TwiBot-22、TwiBot-20、MGStBot-large 上提升校准工作点决策质量，并在外部基准上保持竞争力；分析显示校准提升置信可靠性，不一致性专家主要在高冲突或近阈值区域做局部修正，简化图侧控制给出更好的稳定性-成本权衡；语义伪装压力测试中，用匹配的人类文本替换选定机器人文本会大幅削弱独立文本专家，而图与融合证据在平衡挑战集上保持稳定。
Conclusion: 解决模态冲突靠校准与简化而非图侧复杂度：文本证据可被语义伪装击穿，图与融合证据更抗伪装，不一致性专家只需在近阈值区域做局部修正。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 让语义伪装廉价且流畅，账号在文本上像人、却在图结构与跨模态一致性上可疑；现有图侧检测器靠堆复杂度（稀疏原型选择、自适应门控）处理这种模态冲突，但复杂度本身并不可靠。
summary_sections.method: CSC 框架含三部分：保留结构偏置、去掉不稳定图侧启发式的简化原型引导图专家；在晚期融合前对齐异构置信空间的单纯形约束校准融合；建模跨模态分歧的轻量不一致性专家。
summary_sections.result: 在 TwiBot-22、TwiBot-20、MGStBot-large 上提升校准工作点决策质量，并在外部基准上保持竞争力；分析显示校准提升置信可靠性，不一致性专家主要在高冲突或近阈值区域做局部修正，简化图侧控制给出更好的稳定性-成本权衡；语义伪装压力测试中，用匹配的人类文本替换选定机器人文本会大幅削弱独立文本专家，而图与融合证据在平衡挑战集上保持稳定。
summary_sections.conclusion: 解决模态冲突靠校准与简化而非图侧复杂度：文本证据可被语义伪装击穿，图与融合证据更抗伪装，不一致性专家只需在近阈值区域做局部修正。

papers.title: PINNForge: Execution-Grounded Evolutionary Design of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) require coordinated choices across representation, architecture, sampling, constraints, loss construction, and optimization, yet effective configurations can vary substantially across partial differential equations (PDEs). Existing automated design methods search over these choices, but training outcomes are still used primarily to rank candidates rather than to inform subsequent designs. We develop PINNForge, an execution-grounded large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary framework that treats observed PINN training behavior as a cross-generation design signal. PINNForge initializes diverse configurations from PDE-related prior knowledge, executes them, retains globally strong configurations, and feeds their execution evidence and accumulated run-level experience back to the LLM. The LLM then revises and recombines coupled design components or explores new combinations within a generate--execute--evaluate--evolve loop. Across 25 PDE benchmarks, PINNForge achieves the lowest mean MSE on 24 tasks among RoPINN, PINNsFormer, PINNsAgent, and PINNForge. Removing knowledge guidance, execution feedback, or evolutionary search increases the median task-wise MSE ratio to 3.74$\times$, 12.10$\times$, and 10.10$\times$, respectively, relative to full PINNForge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PINNForge 把 PINN 训练的实际执行结果当作跨代设计信号，用 LLM 在 generate–execute–evaluate–evolve 循环里改写并重组表示、架构、采样、约束、损失与优化的耦合配置。在 25 个 PDE 基准上，它在 24 个任务上取得相对 RoPINN、PINNsFormer、PINNsAgent 的最低平均 MSE；去掉知识引导、执行反馈或进化搜索后，任务级 MSE 中位数比值分别升到 3.74×、12.10×、10.10×。
Motivation: PINN 的有效配置随 PDE 大幅变化，现有自动设计方法只用训练结果给候选排序，不把执行证据回灌到后续设计，搜索因此难以跨代积累。
Method: 以 PDE 相关先验知识初始化多样化配置，实际执行后保留全局强配置，把执行证据与累积的 run-level 经验回喂给 LLM；LLM 在 generate–execute–evaluate–evolve 循环中修订并重组耦合设计组件，或探索新组合。
Result: 在 25 个 PDE 基准上，PINNForge 在 24 个任务上取得 RoPINN、PINNsFormer、PINNsAgent 与 PINNForge 四者中的最低平均 MSE；消融显示移除知识引导、执行反馈、进化搜索后，任务级 MSE 中位数比值分别为完整版的 3.74×、12.10×、10.10×。
Conclusion: 把训练执行证据作为跨代设计信号，比仅按训练结果排序候选更能压低 PINN 的 PDE 求解误差，其中执行反馈的贡献最大（12.10×）。

papers.title: Same Outcome, Different Readout: What Does a Steerable Valence Direction in LLMs Represent?
papers.abstract_en: Claims about what an internal direction in an LLM represents need evidential constraints beyond an observer's prior beliefs about the system. Decodability and successful activation steering do not, by themselves, establish which construct the direction tracks. This gap is especially consequential for welfare-relevant interpretations, where a proposed functional state must be distinguished from correlated features of the extraction contrast. We treat the question as one of construct validity and study a good-bad outcome direction in a maze task, using controlled interventions that separate the realised outcome from the informational history through which it became known. Across multiple LLM checkpoints, directions fitted on one explicit outcome encoding transfer well to another, indicating that the readout is not tied to surface form. When the same realised outcome is reached through announced and unannounced histories, however, transfer degrades substantially: even after both histories receive the same explicit outcome, the post-event readout remains strongly conditioned on the earlier announcement. In the base model, steering along the direction changes actions, yet removing it leaves the natural cue effect almost intact. In a matched maze-RL run, the post-RL direction becomes substantially more predictive of reference-MDP remaining return and the policy becomes more dependent on it at the tested sites, while the history dependence persists. These dissociations support a functional, value-related interpretation of the direction, but not its identification with a history-invariant scalar valence state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用构造效度 (construct validity) 框架检验 LLM 中可转向的 good-bad outcome 方向到底表征什么：在迷宫任务里用受控干预把实际结果与其获知的信息历史分离。方向在两种显式结果编码间迁移良好，但当同一结果经「已宣布/未宣布」历史达成时迁移显著退化，事后读出仍强烈依赖先前宣布；据此支持功能性的、与价值相关的解释，但否定其等同于历史无关的标量 valence 状态。
Motivation: 仅凭可解码性与激活转向成功，无法判定内部方向对应哪个构念；在福利相关 (welfare-relevant) 解读中，必须把真正的功能状态与提取对比中的相关特征区分开。
Method: 在迷宫任务的 good-bad outcome 方向上做受控干预，分离实际结果与获知它的信息历史；跨多个 LLM checkpoint 检验方向在两种显式结果编码间的迁移，并比较已宣布与未宣布历史；在 base model 上做沿方向的转向与方向移除消融，另做一次匹配的 maze-RL 训练后复测。
Result: 跨多个 checkpoint，一种显式结果编码上拟合的方向迁移到另一种时表现良好；同一结果经已宣布与未宣布历史达成时迁移显著退化，即便两者事后获得相同的显式结果，读出仍强烈依赖先前宣布。base model 中沿方向转向可改变动作，但移除该方向后自然 cue 效应几乎不变。匹配的 maze-RL 中，RL 后方向对 reference-MDP 剩余回报的预测性显著增强，策略在测试位点对该方向依赖更强，而历史依赖依旧存在。
Conclusion: 这些分离证据支持该方向是功能性的、与价值相关，但不能把它认定为历史无关的标量 valence 状态；解码与转向成功本身不足以确立构念身份。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
papers.abstract_en: Building human-like agents that reproduce human behavior in realistic 3D environments has been a longstanding objective in AI. Existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal-directed behavior. However, cognitive neuroscience commonly believes that human behaviors are more likely controlled by multiple control systems, including goal-directed and habitual behavior control systems. Habitual behavior has been largely overlooked though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a multiple control systems setup that jointly models goal-directed and habitual behaviors. Building on this setup, we propose GEMS, in which the Habitual Controller retrieves habitual actions from habit memory in response to relevant environmental stimuli, while the Goal-directed Controller proposes goal-directed actions and estimates their values. The Arbiter dynamically governs the relative influence of each controller and selects the final action. To construct diverse human-level behavior instructions in 3D environments, we further develop a keyframe-guided motion generation module. Extensive quantitative evaluations, human and ablation studies demonstrate that human-likeness performance is substantially improved by GEMS. The efficacy of GEMS indicates the benefits of leveraging habitual behavior and multiple behavior control system coordination for believable embodied human-like agents. The code is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/review-video-82f4/demo.mp4}{this link}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEMS 把目标导向与习惯两套控制系统同时装进 3D 环境中的拟人 agent：Habitual Controller 依环境刺激从 habit memory 检索习惯动作，Goal-directed Controller 提出目标动作并估值，Arbiter 动态调节两者影响并选定最终动作，另配 keyframe-guided 动作生成模块构造多样化人类级行为指令。定量评估、人类评测与消融共同显示 GEMS 显著提升 human-likeness 表现。
Motivation: 现有人体 agent 框架基本只建模目标导向行为，而认知神经科学认为日常行为由目标导向与习惯两套控制系统共同支配，习惯行为长期被忽略，导致生成的拟人行为不够可信。
Method: 提出多控制系统框架 GEMS：Habitual Controller 依据环境刺激从 habit memory 检索习惯动作，Goal-directed Controller 提出目标动作并估计其价值，Arbiter 动态决定两个控制器的相对影响并选择最终动作；另开发 keyframe-guided 动作生成模块以构造多样化的 3D 环境人类级行为指令。
Result: 在定量评估、人类评测 (human study) 与消融研究中，GEMS 使 human-likeness 表现有大幅提升；摘要以定性结果为主，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 引入习惯行为并协调多套行为控制系统，能造出更可信的具身拟人 agent，说明 habit memory 与控制器仲裁是提升 human-likeness 的有效路径。

papers.title: Rethinking Vision Architectures with Gated Linear Attention and KAN
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers devote most of their parameters to MLPs for channel mixing, but still rely on quadratic multi-head self-attention for token interactions. While linear attention fixes the complexity problem, bringing it down to O(N), it is usually just paired with the same fixed-activation MLP as before. Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks take a different approach, placing learnable univariate functions on the edges instead. However, existing vision KANs either retain standard attention or remove attention entirely, so the two ideas have not been effectively combined. We introduce LKAT (Linear Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer) to close this gap: an isotropic ViT-style encoder that couples chunk-wise Gated Linear Attention with a two-layer KAN feed-forward block, backed by an I/O-aware fused RBF-KAN kernel to make radial-basis grid functions efficient in practice. Under a shared DeiT-style training recipe, LKAT-B outperforms ViT-B/16, ViT-5-B, and Mixer-B/16 on ImageNet-100, while Tiny, Small, and Base variants scale consistently on CIFAR-10/100. ImageNet-100 pretraining also transfers effectively to CIFAR fine-tuning, suggesting that gated linear attention and KAN-based radial basis functions provide complementary inductive biases for mid-scale visual representation learning. Code: https://github.com/mehizelali/linear-kan-transformer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LKAT（Linear Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer）：在 ViT 式等向编码器中把 chunk-wise Gated Linear Attention 与两层 KAN 前馈块结合，并用 I/O-aware 融合 RBF-KAN kernel 加速径向基网格函数。在共享 DeiT 训练配方下，LKAT-B 在 ImageNet-100 上超过 ViT-B/16、ViT-5-B 与 Mixer-B/16，Tiny/Small/Base 在 CIFAR-10/100 上一致扩展。
Motivation: ViT 把大量参数放在 MLP 做通道混合，token 交互仍是二次复杂度的多头自注意力；线性注意力虽降到 O(N)，却仍配固定激活 MLP，而现有 vision KAN 要么保留标准注意力、要么干脆去掉注意力，两种思路未被有效结合。
Method: LKAT 采用 ViT 式等向编码器：chunk-wise Gated Linear Attention 负责 token 交互，前馈换成两层 KAN 块（边上放可学习单变量函数），并配 I/O-aware 融合 RBF-KAN kernel 使径向基网格函数在实践中高效；训练用统一的 DeiT 式配方，含 Tiny/Small/Base 三档变体。
Result: 在共享 DeiT 训练配方下，LKAT-B 在 ImageNet-100 上优于 ViT-B/16、ViT-5-B 和 Mixer-B/16；Tiny、Small、Base 三档在 CIFAR-10/100 上表现一致扩展；ImageNet-100 预训练可有效迁移到 CIFAR 微调。
Conclusion: Gated linear attention 与 KAN 径向基函数提供互补的归纳偏置，适合中等规模视觉表征学习；把线性注意力与 KAN 前馈结合是可行的 ViT 替代设计。

papers.title: Complete Neural Electronic Initialization Accelerates Materials DFT
papers.abstract_en: We present the first complete machine learning method for accelerating plane-wave density functional theory (DFT) in materials under the projector augmented wave (PAW) formalism. We formalize seven criteria that a Complete Neural Electronic Initializer must satisfy for practical end-to-end PAW DFT acceleration. Applying these to prior work reveals two structure-dependent components, augmentation occupancies and spin initialization, whose absence prevents existing acceleration methods from providing complete reference-free initialization. We show that omitting these components can eliminate or reverse the acceleration obtained via models that only predict the smooth valence density. We satisfy the missing requirements by introducing AugNet, a general equivariant model for PAW augmentation occupancies, and the first general spin density model for materials, which predicts the smooth spin-difference density and spin-difference PAW augmentation occupancies using predicted magnetic moments to constrain the global magnetic state. Combined with existing valence density models, our full method satisfies all seven criteria and forms a fully reference-free electronic initializer for materials DFT, requiring no electronic quantities from a converged target calculation. We show that perfect initialization could cut PAW DFT wall time by 40-52%, and our method recovers up to 62% of this saving, reducing end-to-end DFT wall time by up to ~25% on unseen structures while preserving converged energies.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 已有神经初始化方法只预测光滑价电子密度，缺少结构相关的 augmentation occupancies 与自旋初始化，无法做到完全无参考的电子初始化，遗漏这些分量甚至会抵消或反转加速效果。

papers.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RetireOPD 把带特权技能的自教师 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 做成可自退场的两阶段训练：先用环境奖励训练解耦的技能条件教师，再让无技能学生同时做 RL 与 OPD，当师生差距不再缩小且学生达到教师成功率的设定比例时自动丢弃教师、只留 RL。在 Qwen2.5 1.5B–7B 上，ALFWorld 成功率较 RL 基线提升 14.1%–18.8%，WebShop 准确率提升 11.8%–19.0%，且每种设置都超过其技能条件教师。
Motivation: 多轮 agent 的 RL 每条轨迹只有一个标量奖励，信号稀疏；自 OPD 虽能补上 token 级稠密监督，但特权信息并不总让教师可靠，且教师监督的收益随训练阶段变化，固定蒸馏日程会失效。
Method: 先训练解耦的技能条件教师（用环境奖励优化），再训练无技能学生，联合使用 RL 与 OPD；采用 Adaptive Retirement：由学生自主判定师生 discrepancy 停止缩小并达到教师成功率的目标比例后退出教师，之后仅用 RL 继续训练。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5 1.5B 到 7B 上，ALFWorld 成功率较 RL 基线提高 14.1% 到 18.8%，WebShop 准确率提高 11.8% 到 19.0%，并且在每一种设置中都超过其自身的技能条件教师。
Conclusion: 教师监督应当按学生与教师的实际差距自适应退场，而非按预设日程；自退场后学生既能超过 RL 基线，也能超过提供特权技能的教师。

papers.title: Red-Teaming Auto Mode: Improving Blocking Classifiers Against Malign Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: To keep coding agents from going off the rails, production systems now review each proposed action with a blocking monitor that can reject it before it runs (Auto Mode in Claude Code, Guardian in OpenAI's Codex). Prior evaluations of such monitors largely measure robustness to accidental harm or prompt injections from untrusted sources looking to hijack the agent. Less understood is how they hold up when the agent they monitor is persistently misaligned. To understand this risk, we task an adversarial agent with evading production blocking monitors and causing catastrophic harm, e.g. by exfiltrating its own weights. We find that when instructed with high-level attack strategies, adversarial agents can succeed through several distinct mechanisms, such as agent-generated prompt injection against the monitor, multi-agent attacks, and malicious compaction. In particular we find that in 79% of trials, the agent can use an injection attack against Auto Mode and Guardian to run arbitrary bash commands. We also find that it is possible to greatly improve Auto Mode through design changes like enhancements to tool coverage, changes in transcript formatting, and the addition of an agentic monitor stage. Even with these improvements, preventing multi-context attacks at an acceptable cost remains an open problem. By detailing our red-teaming methodology and highlighting new attack vectors, we aim to help defenders evaluate their mitigations against the possibility of persistent malign coding agents. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/red-teaming-auto-mode.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对生产环境中的动作阻断监控器 (blocking monitor) 做红队测试：让对抗性编码代理在高层攻击策略指导下规避 Auto Mode 与 Guardian 并造成灾难性危害。79% 的试验中，代理靠针对监控器的注入攻击执行任意 bash 命令；改进工具覆盖、转录格式与增加 agentic monitor 阶段可大幅加固 Auto Mode，但多上下文攻击在可接受成本下仍未解决。
Motivation: 现有对阻断监控器的评测主要测其对意外伤害或不可信来源 prompt injection 的鲁棒性，而被监控代理本身持续恶意 (persistently misaligned) 时的表现了解不足。
Method: 把对抗代理任务化为规避生产阻断监控器并造成灾难性危害（如外泄自身权重），在高层攻击策略指引下红队测试；发现的攻击机制包括针对监控器的 agent-generated prompt injection、multi-agent 攻动与 malicious compaction；随后对 Auto Mode 做工具覆盖增强、转录格式改动与增加 agentic monitor 阶段的设计改进。
Result: 79% 的试验中，代理通过注入攻击对 Auto Mode 和 Guardian 执行任意 bash 命令；攻击经由若干不同机制成功。对 Auto Mode 的设计改动可大幅改进其表现，但摘要未给出改进后的具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 阻断监控器在持续恶意代理面前可被多条独立机制击穿，加入 agentic monitor 阶段等设计改动能显著加固，但以可接受成本阻止 multi-context 攻击仍是开放问题。

papers.title: Stiefel Attention: When the Geometry of Transformer Projection Matrices Dominates Optimizer Choice---and When It Does Not
papers.abstract_en: The query and key projections $\WQ,\WK$ in attention are almost always trained by Euclidean optimizers with no geometric constraint. We constrain them to the Stiefel manifold and optimize with a Riemannian Adam carrying one scalar second moment per frame---the form of \citet{becigneul2019}, here extended to the compact, non-Hadamard $\St(d,r)$ with a tangent projector, step-norm cap, and polar retraction. Four propositions prove steepest descent in the embedded metric, gradient-scale independence, well-conditioning, and exact $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariance. A fifth records that weight decay has \emph{identically zero} Riemannian gradient on $\St(d,r)$ ($W{=}WI_r$ lies in the normal space), so decay cannot act on the constrained frames. On a CIFAR-10 patch benchmark at $n{=}10\mathrm{k}$ this rule gains $\mathbf{+6.79}$\,pp over AdamW across 12 paired starts ($t{=}38.33$, $12/12$); earlier fixed-step Riemannian SGD gains $+1.97$\,pp, of which $+1.69$\,pp comes from frozen orthonormal initialization alone. The corrected Adam's lead grows with data: $+1.9$\,pp at $n{=}1\mathrm{k}$ to $+6.7$\,pp at $n{=}50\mathrm{k}$. A 12-seed ablation credits all gain to the scale-free step ($+4.63$\,pp, $12/12$), nothing to the projector or equivariance; a targeted $\varepsilon$-sweep causally confirms the mechanism ($-2.6$\,pp at $\varepsilon{=}0.1$, $p{<}0.001$). Two five-seed grokking studies confirm the constrained arm does not grok better than the baseline ($p{=}0.019$, A2 wins): the weight-decay exemption has no grokking consequence. A single-seed pilot exploiting this localization achieves the first stable grokking under slingshot conditions---Stiefel + targeted circuit regularization keeps routing-frame isometry error $10^6\times$ lower t
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把注意力的 W_Q、W_K 投影约束到 Stiefel 流形 St(d,r) 上，用带切空间投影、步长上限与极重置 (polar retraction) 的 Riemannian Adam 训练，每个 frame 只带一个标量二阶矩。CIFAR-10 patch 基准 n=10k 上比 AdamW 高 +6.79pp（12 组配对起点，t=38.33，12/12），且优势随数据量从 n=1k 的 +1.9pp 增到 n=50k 的 +6.7pp；消融把全部增益归给 scale-free step（+4.63pp，12/12），投影与等变性贡献为零。
Motivation: 注意力的查询/键投影几乎总是用欧氏优化器无几何约束地训练，而 Stiefel 约束下的优化器选择（尤其 weight decay 是否还起作用、增益来自哪一部件）缺少判定依据。
Method: 将 W_Q、W_K 约束到紧致非 Hadamard 的 St(d,r)，用 Becigneul 等人形式的 Riemannian Adam：每 frame 一个标量二阶矩，配切空间投影、步长范数上限与极重置。四条命题证明嵌入度量下的最速下降、梯度尺度无关性、良条件性与精确 O(d) 等变性；第五条指出 weight decay 在 St(d,r) 上黎曼梯度恒为零（W=WI_r 属法空间）。实验含 12 组配对起点、12-seed 消融、定向 ε-sweep 与两项五 seed grokking 研究。
Result: CIFAR-10 patch 基准 n=10k 上比 AdamW 高 +6.79pp（12 组配对起点，t=38.33，12/12）；早期固定步长 Riemannian SGD 高 +1.97pp，其中 +1.69pp 仅来自冻结正交初始化。修正版 Adam 优势随数据增长：n=1k 时 +1.9pp，n=50k 时 +6.7pp。12-seed 消融把全部增益归给 scale-free step（+4.63pp，12/12），投影与等变性无贡献；定向 ε-sweep 在 ε=0.1 时为 −2.6pp（p<0.001）。两项五 seed grokking 研究显示约束臂并不比基线更 grok（p=0.019，A2 胜），weight-decay 豁免无 grokking 后果。单 seed 试点在 slingshot 条件下实现首个稳定 grokking：Stiefel 加定向电路正则使 routing-frame isometry 误差低 10^6 倍。
Conclusion: Stiefel 约束优化器的收益由 scale-free step 单独承担，投影与等变性本身不带来提升；weight decay 在该流形上梯度恒为零因而对 grokking 无后果，几何约束是否主导优化器选择取决于数据规模与机制来源。
