papers.title: Training-Adaptive Convolutional Sparse Coding via Information Bottleneck for Robust Visual Representation
papers.abstract_en: Visual signals require compact yet sufficient representations for robust downstream prediction. Convolutional sparse coding (CSC) provides an explicit mechanism for suppressing redundant components while preserving signal content, but its sparsity coefficient is often manually selected during training. We propose a training-adaptive convolutional sparse coding framework for robust visual signal representation. Specifically, we unfold the CSC optimization with the Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (FISTA) and treat the sparsity coefficient as a differentiable variable jointly learned with the network parameters. From the information bottleneck perspective, this coefficient controls the trade-off between information retention and compression: the sparsity term promotes compact representations, while the reconstruction term together with task loss preserves task-relevant signal content. We further introduce a label-free post-training strategy that adjusts the compression strength for corrupted inputs with the main network parameters fixed. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet demonstrate competitive clean-data recognition and greatly improved robustness under different input perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把卷积稀疏编码 (CSC) 的稀疏系数从手工超参变成可微变量，与网络参数联合学习，用信息瓶颈解释其在信息保留与压缩之间的权衡。FISTA 展开使该系数可训练，并配一个主参数冻结、只调压缩强度的无标签后训练策略。CIFAR 与 ImageNet 上干净数据识别保持竞争力，不同输入扰动下鲁棒性大幅提升。
Motivation: CSC 的稀疏系数在训练中通常靠人工选定，无法随任务与数据自适应，导致视觉表征在输入受扰时既难保证紧凑又难保留任务相关信息。
Method: 用 FISTA 展开 CSC 优化，把稀疏系数作为可微变量与网络参数联合训练；从信息瓶颈视角约束稀疏项（压缩）与重建项加任务损失（保留任务相关内容）的权衡；再引入主网络参数固定的无标签后训练策略，针对受扰输入调节压缩强度。
Result: 在 CIFAR 与 ImageNet 上，干净数据识别表现保持竞争力，且在不同输入扰动下鲁棒性显著提升。
Conclusion: 把 CSC 稀疏系数纳入端到端学习并配合针对受扰输入的无标签后训练，可在不牺牲干净数据识别的前提下提升视觉表征的抗扰动能力。

papers.title: K-Bench: a clinically calibrated benchmark for evaluating large language models in high-risk mental health conversations
papers.abstract_en: People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet their safety in evolving, high-risk conversations remains poorly characterised. We developed K-Bench, a clinician-calibrated, protected benchmark evaluating 125 model configurations representing 33 base models from 14 providers across a fixed cohort of 200 multi-turn vignettes involving suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, substance misuse, and no-risk presentations. Synthetic patient conversations showed substantial distributional overlap with real human-AI conversations. A frozen GPT-4o judge achieved 94.2% exact agreement with clinician consensus across 6,751 eligible item comparisons from 151 clinician-rated transcripts. Leading models combined strong supportive conversation with combined-risk scores above 95, whereas risk exploration exposed substantial variation among lower-performing configurations. Therapeutic prompting produced configuration-specific gains concentrated among weaker models, while elevated reasoning produced no average improvement. K-Bench combines broader clinical coverage and configuration-scale comparison with a continuously updated public leaderboard whose operational test materials are protected from direct optimisation. The leaderboard is available at www.k-bench.ai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: K-Bench 是一个临床医生校准的高风险心理健康对话基准，覆盖 33 个基座模型、14 家提供商的 125 个模型配置与 200 个多轮 vignette（自杀、自伤、家暴、物质滥用及无风险场景）。冻结的 GPT-4o 评审与临床共识在 6,751 条条目比较上达到 94.2% 完全一致；领先模型综合风险分超过 95，而治疗性提示只在弱模型上带来配置相关的提升，提高推理强度平均无改善。
Motivation: 人们越来越多用 LLM 获取心理健康支持，但其在演化的高风险对话中的安全性缺乏刻画，且缺少临床校准、可跨配置比较的评测。
Method: 构建临床医生校准且受保护的 K-Bench：200 个多轮 vignette 覆盖自杀、自伤、家暴、物质滥用与无风险呈现，评测 33 个基座模型的 125 个配置；用冻结 GPT-4o 作为评审，与 151 份临床医生评分转录中的共识对齐；合成病人对话与真实人机对话做分布重叠检验，并配持续更新的公开 leaderboard（测试材料受保护以防直接优化）。
Result: 合成病人对话与真实人机对话有显著分布重叠；GPT-4o 评审在 151 份临床医生评分转录的 6,751 条合格条目比较上与临床共识 94.2% 完全一致；领先模型 supportive conversation 强且综合风险分 >95，risk exploration 暴露低分配置间的显著差异；治疗性提示在弱模型上产生配置相关增益，提高推理强度平均无改善。
Conclusion: LLM 高风险心理健康对话的表现高度依赖具体配置与提示策略：治疗性提示只对弱模型有用，加推理强度不带来平均收益，因此评测必须按配置粒度并由临床共识校准。

papers.title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and overlooks richer execution feedback. To bridge this gap, we introduce an end-to-end framework, AlgoEvo, a unified agentic architecture that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a unified workflow to seamlessly handle single-heuristic, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience bank organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo reaches state-of-the-art performance with as little as 7% of the evaluation budget and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed the strongest existing methods through flexible skill activation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlgoEvo 把自动算法发现改造成端到端的智能体搜索：自主 agent 依据运行时反馈检查、诊断并编辑代码，设计技能中心 (design skill hub) 解耦范式知识，层级经验库把搜索轨迹组织成任务级树并沉淀跨任务可复用技能。在六个代表性基准任务上以低至 7% 的评估预算达到 SOTA，并降低 token 消耗。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 自动算法发现框架把模型锁在预定义控制流的刚性搜索管线里，限制自适应推理、阻断跨范式迁移，也浪费了更丰富的执行反馈。
Method: 统一智能体架构：自主 agent 读取运行时反馈后动态检查、诊断并编辑代码；design skill hub 将范式特定知识与核心发现引擎解耦，使同一工作流覆盖单启发式、多目标与多组件设计；层级 experience bank 把搜索轨迹组织成任务级树引导探索，并把跨任务模式固化为可复用技能，通过灵活技能激活复现或超越既有方法。
Result: 在六个代表性基准任务上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，评估预算低至 7%，同时 token 消耗下降；表现出强的 intra-task 积累与 cross-task 迁移能力，可复现或超越最强既有方法。
Conclusion: 把范式知识与任务经验都做成可激活的技能层，自动算法发现就能在远低于常规的评估预算内达到或超过最强既有方法。

papers.title: Evaluating Losslessness in Speculative Decoding Under Finite-Precision Inference
papers.abstract_en: Lossless speculative decoding is typically defined at the algorithmic level: a speculative procedure proposes multiple tokens and a verification procedure is designed to preserve the output trajectory of an autoregressive reference model exactly. In practical neural inference, however, this guarantee is implemented using finite-precision floating-point computations, and discrete token selection can amplify small numerical differences into divergent generation trajectories. We investigate this distinction using Orthrus, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion architecture that performs self-drafting and self-verification within a frozen autoregressive backbone, as a representative case study. Across 1,190 prompts from 12 domains, exact trajectory matching under BF16 occurs for only 45\% of the authors' checkpoint generations and 43% of those from our independently trained model. The probability of matching is strongly associated with the response-conditional perplexity of the autoregressive reference, indicating that trajectory divergence is not uniform across inputs. Despite these divergences, Orthrus does not exhibit systematic degradation on the evaluated downstream tasks. In contrast, FP32 inference yields exact trajectory matching on all evaluated prompts. These results demonstrate a gap between algorithmic losslessness and its implementation under finite-precision arithmetic, and motivate evaluating lossless speculative decoding at the level of exact generation trajectories as well as downstream task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 算法层面的无损投机解码 (lossless speculative decoding) 在有限精度推理下并不无损：以冻结自回归骨干内自起草、自验证的混合架构 Orthrus 为案例，1,190 条覆盖 12 个领域的 prompt 上，BF16 精度只有 45%（作者 checkpoint）与 43%（独立训练模型）的生成与自回归参考模型轨迹完全一致，而 FP32 在全部被评估 prompt 上精确匹配。轨迹是否匹配与参考模型的 response-conditional perplexity 强相关，说明发散并非均匀分布；但 Orthrus 在被评估的下游任务上没有系统性退化。
Motivation: 无损投机解码的保证定义在算法层面，实际推理却用有限精度浮点实现，离散 token 选择会把微小数值差异放大成分叉的生成轨迹，使算法保证与实现行为脱节。
Method: 以 Orthrus（在冻结自回归骨干内做 self-drafting 与 self-verification 的自回归-扩散混合架构）为案例，比较作者 checkpoint 与独立训练模型；在 12 个领域共 1,190 条 prompt 上，逐 prompt 比对投机解码输出与自回归参考模型的精确生成轨迹，并分别在 BF16 与 FP32 下测试，同时统计匹配概率与参考模型 response-conditional perplexity 的关联并检查下游任务表现。
Result: BF16 下精确轨迹匹配率仅 45%（作者 checkpoint）与 43%（独立训练模型），FP32 下所有被评估 prompt 均精确匹配；匹配概率与自回归参考模型的 response-conditional perplexity 强相关；尽管存在轨迹分叉，Orthrus 在被评估的下游任务上未出现系统性退化。
Conclusion: 算法层面的无损性与有限精度算术下的实现之间存在真实差距，因此评估无损投机解码必须同时看精确生成轨迹和下游任务表现，而不能只看任务指标。

papers.title: Reason What Matters: Retrieval-Grounded Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space for diverse retrieval tasks. Recent methods improve embeddings through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning optimized with GRPO using retrieval rewards. However, existing methods overlook the mismatch bettween candidate-aware retrieval supervision and input-only CoT generation: (1)trajectory-level rewards convey retrieval outcomes without explicitly identifying the input-supported evidence that distinguishes the positive from hard negatives; (2) input-only generation cannot directly assess whether further reasoning improves retrieval, potentially producing redundant CoTs with substantial latency. To bridge this gap, we propose Reason What Matters (ReWAM), a retrieval-grounded framework that aligns candidate-aware supervision with input-only generation. Specifically, we introduce Retrieval-Aware Self-Distillation (RASD), which extracts privileged guidance from input-supported facts and evidence distinguishing the positive from hard negatives. Conditioned on this guidance, an on-policy self-teacher provides token-level feedback to refine credit assignment, directing policy updates toward retrieval-relevant reasoning grounded in the input. We further propose Retrieval-Adaptive Inference (RAI), which learns a retrieval-aware stopping criterion from prefix-level retrieval feedback. It stops redundant reasoning without candidate access and uses speculative decoding to further reduce CoT latency. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and MRMR demonstrate that ReWAM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance while delivering up to 5x the inference throughput of competitive explicit-CoT UME methods. ReWAM thus enables high-quality retrieval through efficient input-only reasoning, making explicit CoT practical for corpus-scale multimodal retrieval. The code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReWAM 把候选感知的检索监督对齐到只依赖输入的 CoT 生成：用 Retrieval-Aware Self-Distillation (RASD) 从区分正例与难负例的输入支持事实上提取特权指导，再由 on-policy self-teacher 给出 token 级反馈；Retrieval-Adaptive Inference (RAI) 学一个前缀级检索反馈的停止准则，无需候选即可停掉冗余推理并配合 speculative decoding。在 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 上达到 SOTA 检索性能，推理吞吐最高为显式 CoT UME 方法的 5 倍。
Motivation: 现有用 GRPO 与检索奖励优化 CoT 的 UME 存在候选感知监督与只依赖输入生成的错配：轨迹级奖励只给结果不指出区分正例与难负例的证据，输入-only 生成也无法判断继续推理是否真的提升检索，导致冗余 CoT 与高延迟。
Method: RASD 从输入支持的事实与区分正例/难负例的证据中抽取特权指导，在此条件下由 on-policy self-teacher 提供 token 级反馈改进 credit assignment，把策略更新导向与检索相关的推理；RAI 从前缀级检索反馈学习检索感知停止准则，在无候选访问时停止冗余推理，并用 speculative decoding 进一步压缩 CoT 延迟。
Result: 在 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 上取得 SOTA 检索性能，推理吞吐最高达到有竞争力的显式 CoT UME 方法的 5 倍。
Conclusion: 把候选级检索证据蒸馏进输入-only 推理并配检索感知停止，可让显式 CoT 在语料库规模的多模态检索中变得实用：既保检索质量又大幅降延迟。

summary_sections.result: 在 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 上取得 SOTA 检索性能，推理吞吐最高达到有竞争力的显式 CoT UME 方法的 5 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把候选级检索证据蒸馏进输入-only 推理并配检索感知停止，可让显式 CoT 在语料库规模的多模态检索中变得实用：既保检索质量又大幅降延迟。

papers.title: Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based policies offer an expressive representation for online reinforcement learning, but conventional flow matching requires samples drawn from the distribution to be modeled. This poses a challenge when the desired action distribution is defined only implicitly by a Q-function, since directly sampling actions from the resulting distribution is generally intractable. We propose Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization (RFPO), a novel framework for training a flow policy in online reinforcement learning by alternating between Q-guided sample refinement and self-target flow matching. RFPO first generates actions from Gaussian noise using the current flow policy and then uses a finite-step stochastic refinement procedure to move them toward an energy-based distribution induced by the Q-function. Each refined action is then paired with its corresponding initial noise sample and used as a fixed target for flow-matching training. By repeatedly refining its own outputs and learning from the resulting targets, RFPO incorporates Q-guidance into the policy without requiring direct samples from the target distribution, while retaining the capacity to represent multiple action modes. We further provide a theoretical analysis of the distributional dynamics induced by RFPO. Across six continuous-control tasks, RFPO matches or outperforms a standard Gaussian-policy baseline on almost every task. Experiments on six synthetic two-dimensional target distributions with diverse geometries demonstrate that RFPO captures complex multimodal structure without mode collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RFPO 用「Q 引导的有限步随机精炼 + 自目标 flow matching」交替训练在线强化学习的 flow 策略，绕开能量型目标分布不可直接采样的问题。在六个连续控制任务上几乎全部持平或优于标准高斯策略基线，在六个合成二维目标分布上捕获复杂多模态结构且无模式坍缩。
Motivation: flow matching 要求从被建模分布中直接采样，而在线 RL 中目标动作分布只由 Q 函数隐式定义，直接采样不可解，导致 flow 策略难以训练。
Method: RFPO 交替执行两步：先由当前 flow 策略从高斯噪声生成动作，再用有限步随机精炼过程把动作推向 Q 诱导的能量型分布；每个精炼后的动作与其初始噪声配对，作为 flow-matching 训练的固定目标（self-target）。附带对 RFPO 诱导的分布动力学的理论分析。
Result: 在六个连续控制任务上，RFPO 几乎每个任务都持平或优于标准高斯策略基线；在六个几何各异的合成二维目标分布上，RFPO 捕获复杂多模态结构且无 mode collapse。
Conclusion: 无需从目标分布直接采样也能把 Q 引导注入 flow 策略，同时保留表示多动作模态的能力。

papers.title: SpliTEE: Fast and Private LLM Inference by Coupling GPU-Assisted Trusted Execution Environments with Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: User prompts provided to large language models (LLMs) may contain sensitive or private information that can be misused by remotely deployed models, such as through inadvertent memorization during retraining. One way to protect user prompts is to execute the LLM inside a trusted execution environment (TEE), with the guarantee that the service provider has no access to computations performed within or information exchanged with the TEE. However, current TEEs are primarily CPU-based and significantly slower than GPUs optimized for LLM inference. To circumvent this, Tramer and Boneh (2019) proposed Slalom, which splits neural network inference between a TEE and an untrusted GPU and encrypts intermediate inputs sent to the GPU. We extend this split-inference architecture to LLM inference and instead protect intermediate inputs using differential privacy. We show that masking intermediate representations is necessary by showing that a prompt-reconstruction attack can recover prompts from these representations with nearly 80% accuracy. Our main contribution is a global sensitivity analysis of key LLM functions, which bounds the required scale of differentially private noise. Unlike encryption, differential privacy avoids quantization, allowing the LLM to remain in the floating-point domain. We also derive an upper bound on floating-point error from masking and noise cancellation in the TEE as a function of the privacy parameter epsilon. We implement our architecture using Intel TDX and evaluate it with two LLMs: Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen3-4B. Our split execution is nearly twice as fast as fully CPU-based inference inside TDX and 5-15 seconds faster than encryption-based Slalom while achieving higher accuracy. Finally, we demonstrate that prompt reconstruction, even with knowledge of the differential privacy mechanism, cannot recover more information than is contained in an unrelated prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpliTEE 把 LLM 推理拆到 GPU 辅助的 TEE（Intel TDX）与不可信 GPU 之间，用差分隐私而非加密保护中间表示：先证明从中间表示重建提示可达近 80% 准确率，再对关键 LLM 函数做全局敏感度分析以界定噪声尺度。在 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Qwen3-4B 上，拆分执行比 TDX 内纯 CPU 推理快近 2 倍、比加密版 Slalom 快 5–15 秒且精度更高。
Motivation: 用户提示含敏感信息，只能靠 TEE 保护，但现有 TEE 以 CPU 为主、远慢于 LLM 推理所用 GPU；Slalom 的加密方案需要量化，牺牲浮点精度与速度。
Method: 扩展 Slalom 的拆分推理架构到 LLM：中间输入改用差分隐私掩码而非加密，保持模型在浮点域；对关键 LLM 函数做全局敏感度分析以给出噪声尺度上界，并推导 TEE 内掩码与噪声抵消导致的浮点误差关于隐私参数 epsilon 的上界；用 Intel TDX 实现。
Result: 提示重建攻击可从中间表示恢复提示、准确率近 80%；拆分执行比 TDX 内全 CPU 推理快近 2 倍，比基于加密的 Slalom 快 5–15 秒且精度更高；即使攻击者知道 DP 机制，重建出的信息也不超过一条无关提示所含信息。
Conclusion: 在 TEE–GPU 拆分推理中用差分隐私替代加密即可同时保住速度与浮点精度，且中间表示必须加噪才挡得住提示重建。

papers.title: WaterKron and FlipFlop Hessian: Information-Theoretically Grounded Quantization with Kronecker-factored Hessians
papers.abstract_en: How should a Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation be chosen for post-training quantization? We address this question through WaterKron, which combines two-sided GPTQ with row- and column-dependent waterfilling scales and entropy coding. We derive its high-rate distortion with respect to the full Hessian using an explicit Kronecker-Hessian mismatch factor $Φ$. This factor quantifies the asymptotic distortion penalty due to the Kronecker Hessian approximation and provides a criterion for selecting the factors optimally. Minimizing $Φ$ leads to a Gaussian covariance-fitting problem with classical ``flip-flop'' updates. We thus give a rate-distortion justification for using the resulting FlipFlop Hessian in quantization. We evaluate it empirically, finding that the FlipFlop Hessian consistently improves KL divergence and perplexity over input-only, marginal, and Frobenius-based Hessian choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 WaterKron：把两侧 GPTQ 与逐行逐列的 waterfilling 量化尺度及熵编码结合，并用显式的 Kronecker-Hessian 失配因子 Φ 推导其相对完整 Hessian 的高率失真，Φ 可作为选择 Kronecker 因子的准则。最小化 Φ 导出高斯协方差拟合问题，用经典 flip-flop 迭代求解，得到 FlipFlop Hessian；实证中它在 KL 散度与困惑度上一致优于 input-only、marginal 与 Frobenius 基线 Hessian 选择。
Motivation: 后训练量化 (post-training quantization) 中 Kronecker 分解 Hessian 的选取缺乏准则：不同近似带来的失真代价没有显式度量，难以判断哪种因子分解更接近完整 Hessian。
Method: WaterKron 组合两侧 GPTQ (two-sided GPTQ)、逐行与逐列相关的 waterfilling 尺度以及熵编码；推导相对于完整 Hessian 的高率失真，其中显式的 Kronecker-Hessian 失配因子 Φ 量化 Kronecker 近似的渐近失真惩罚并给出因子选择准则；最小化 Φ 得到高斯协方差拟合问题，用经典 flip-flop 更新求解，产出 FlipFlop Hessian。
Result: 实证评估中，FlipFlop Hessian 在 KL 散度与 perplexity 上一致优于 input-only、marginal 与基于 Frobenius 的 Hessian 选择；理论侧给出相对完整 Hessian 的高率失真表达式与失配因子 Φ。
Conclusion: Kronecker 因子应按最小化失配因子 Φ 的协方差拟合准则来选，由此得到的 FlipFlop Hessian 为量化中的 Kronecker 近似提供了率失真 (rate-distortion) 依据。

papers.title: Pathwise Individual Rationality in Federated Learning: A Mechanism-Architecture Co-Design
papers.abstract_en: Participation in federated learning (FL) comes at a cost. Clients trade off privacy, communication, and compute costs for potentially greater gains in model efficacy. This paper explores this tradeoff under the aegis of individual rationality (IR) versus autarky, the basic game-theoretic requirement that the federation provide utility no worse than local training. Using the above as the design target, we examine pathwise performance of FL, as a per-round bound on cumulative surplus rather than only an asymptotic equilibrium guarantee under different degrees of client data heterogeneity. Along the learning path, clients can remain below their local-training baseline for hundreds of rounds. The natural remedy is to cap each client's per-round contribution so that this shortfall stays bounded. We prove that such a cap drives all contributions to zero, with high probability, when its tolerance is small relative to the warm-up deficit, and we observe learning collapse under it even at low heterogeneity. We then propose a design that combines a short-term participation guarantee, enforced after an announced grace window, with personalized model evaluation, while preserving the incentive properties of the underlying mechanism. We provide a theoretical basis for this approach and empirically demonstrate that, after the grace window, clients meet IR on nearly all rounds without harming overall performance under low to moderate heterogeneity; under severe heterogeneity, the design shows promising outcomes for clients compared to their local baseline at some cost in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦学习中客户端参与有隐私、通信与计算成本，本文以个体理性 (IR) 对比自给自足 (autarky) 为设计目标，考察按路径 (pathwise) 的每轮累计盈余上界而非仅渐近均衡。证明小容差的单轮贡献上限会在高概率下把所有贡献压到零并导致学习崩溃，进而提出宽限期后强制的短期参与保证加个性化模型评估的机制-架构协同设计。
Motivation: 仅靠渐近均衡保证掩盖了学习路径上客户端可能连续数百轮低于本地训练基线的现实，需要按路径的 IR 保证与可执行的参与约束。
Method: 以 pathwise IR（每轮累计盈余上界）替代渐近均衡分析，考察不同客户端数据异质度；证明小容差贡献上限导致贡献归零的高概率结论；提出宽限期后强制的短期参与保证与个性化模型评估相结合的机制-架构设计，并给出理论基础。
Result: 客户端在学习路径上可连续数百轮低于本地训练基线；小容差相对 warm-up 缺口的贡献上限以高概率使所有贡献为零，即使低异质度下也观察到学习崩溃；所提设计在宽限期后使客户端几乎全部轮次满足 IR，低到中等异质度下不损害整体性能，严重异质度下客户端相对本地基线结果有前景但牺牲部分精度。
Conclusion: 按路径的参与保证优于单轮贡献上限：宽限期后强制 IR 加个性化评估可在低到中等异质度下兼顾客户端理性与整体性能，严重异质度下需以精度换取客户端收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FIRM: Flow-based Imaging via Regularized Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching methods for imaging inverse problems typically incorporate measurements through network conditioning or guidance during sampling. Neither approach explicitly applies the forward operator within the learned conditional velocity field. We develop a principled measurement-conditional velocity parameterization that does. For a linear interpolation path, we express the optimal velocity through the posterior mean $E[x_1|x_t, y]$ and show that this mean is the unique minimizer of a variational objective with an explicit data-consistency term. The velocity defined by this minimizer provably transports the source distribution to the measurement-conditioned posterior. This result leads to a forward operator-aware velocity field that is trained end-to-end and requires no separate guidance during sampling. Across five imaging tasks, our method achieves leading reconstruction quality with up to $50\times$ fewer network evaluations than competitive flow-based methods. Varying the number of sampling steps also controls the distortion-perception trade-off without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIRM 把成像逆问题的前向算子显式写进 flow matching 的条件速度场：在线性插值路径下，最优速度等于后验均值 E[x1|xt,y]，且是带显式数据一致性项的变分目标的唯一极小点，由此定义的速度可把源分布精确传输到测量条件后验。在五个成像任务上重建质量领先，最多只需竞争方法 1/50 的网络求值次数，采样步数还能在不重训的前提下调节 distortion-perception 权衡。
Motivation: 现有 flow matching 成像逆问题方法靠网络条件化或采样期 guidance 注入测量，学到的条件速度场里并不真正调用前向算子，数据一致性没有被显式优化。
Method: 提出 measurement-conditional velocity parameterization：对线性插值路径，把最优速度表达为后验均值 E[x1|xt,y]，证明它是含显式数据一致性项的变分目标的唯一极小点；该速度场端到端训练，采样时无需单独 guidance。
Result: 在五个成像任务上取得领先的重建质量，相比有竞争力的 flow-based 方法最多减少 50 倍网络求值 (network evaluations)；改变采样步数即可在不重训的情况下调节 distortion-perception 权衡。
Conclusion: 把前向算子写进速度场本身，既能保证传输到测量条件后验，又能同时压低采样成本并提供免重训的 distortion-perception 调节旋钮。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: KBBQ: A Predictive Noise Law and the Limits of Spectrum Flattening in FP4 Quantization
papers.abstract_en: We develop a second-order theory of quantization noise in matrix multiplication in which the quantization format is characterized by the variance it assigns to each element. The constant variance profile of integer quantization recovers existing integer-noise theory, while the multiplicative profile of floating-point rounding reduces the data dependence to a scalar, the participation factor $κ$, yielding a closed-form signal-to-noise-ratio law. The resulting functional also admits a closed-form upper bound $κ^{*}$ that no function-preserving linear transform can exceed and that is attained by a recent state-of-the-art method. Building on this analysis, we introduce KBBQ (\textbf{K}appa-\textbf{B}raked \textbf{B}lockwise \textbf{Q}uantization), which parameterizes the extent to which a transform approaches this ceiling. At W4A4, across four base models and two FP4 formats, KBBQ outperforms the prior state of the art without additional deployment-time computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KBBQ 用二阶量化噪声理论把 FP4 矩阵乘的量化格式统一为每元素方差剖面，浮点舍入的乘性剖面把数据依赖压缩成标量 participation factor κ，得到闭式信噪比律及其上界 κ*；任何保函数线性变换都超不过该上界。KBBQ 以参数化逼近该天花板的方式设计变换，在 W4A4、四个基座模型与两种 FP4 格式上超过先前 SOTA，且不增加部署期计算。
Motivation: FP4 量化中不同格式的噪声结构不同，缺少统一的二阶理论来刻画量化噪声并判定线性变换能达到的信噪比上限，导致变换设计只能靠试错。
Method: 建立以每元素方差剖面刻画量化格式的二阶量化噪声理论：整数量化的常数剖面退化为已有整数噪声理论，浮点舍入的乘性剖面把数据依赖化为标量 κ 并给出闭式 SNR 律；由此导出闭式上界 κ*，再提出 KBBQ（Kappa-Braked Blockwise Quantization）参数化变换逼近该上界的程度。
Result: 在 W4A4 设置下，跨四个基座模型与两种 FP4 格式，KBBQ 超过先前 SOTA，且不引入额外部署期计算；κ* 上界被一个近期 SOTA 方法达到。
Conclusion: 量化噪声可由方差剖面与 participation factor κ 统一描述，保函数线性变换的 SNR 存在不可突破的闭式天花板，KBBQ 通过参数化逼近该天花板取得更好 W4A4 精度。

papers.title: PocketVE: Stable and Property-Guided Structure-Based Drug Design with Variance-Exploding Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Protein-conditioned 3D molecule generation is a central challenge in structure-based drug design, requiring a balance between pocket compatibility, molecular properties, and physical geometry. We propose \textbf{PocketVE}, a protein-pocket-conditioned variance-exploding (VE) diffusion framework that couples stable coordinate denoising with inference-time property guidance. Specifically, PocketVE combines an EDM-style training and sampling setup for 3D denoising, classifier-free guidance for multi-property steering, and adaptive protein perturbation as a training-time pocket regularizer.On the CrossDocked2020 benchmark under GenBench3D, PocketVE improves Valid$_{3\text{D}}$ from 58.6 to 80.6 and reduces strain energy from 457.4 to 127.9 relative to its guided TAGMol architectural parent; relative to TargetDiff, it attains comparable Valid$_{3\text{D}}$ with lower strain energy (127.9 vs.\ 306.0), while retaining competitive docking and molecular-property scores under moderate guidance. A guidance-scale study shows that moderate guidance gives a favorable balance between target-related objectives and geometric quality, whereas stronger guidance can degrade geometry and distributional fidelity. Pocket-permutation and PoseCheck diagnostics further support pocket-specific spatial compatibility with reduced steric conflicts. Overall, the results suggest that geometric stability and inference-time property guidance should be considered as coupled design objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PocketVE 把 variance-exploding (VE) 扩散的稳定坐标去噪与推理期属性引导耦合起来做蛋白口袋条件 3D 分子生成：EDM 式训练采样、classifier-free guidance 多属性调控、训练期自适应蛋白扰动作口袋正则。在 CrossDocked2020/GenBench3D 上 Valid_3D 从 58.6 升到 80.6、应变能从 457.4 降到 127.9（相对 TAGMol），且中等引导尺度才同时保住几何质量。
Motivation: 基于结构的药物设计需要同时满足口袋兼容性、分子属性与物理几何，而现有生成框架在属性引导下容易牺牲几何稳定性与分布保真度。
Method: 口袋条件的 variance-exploding 扩散框架：EDM 风格的 3D 坐标去噪训练与采样，classifier-free guidance 做多属性推理期引导，训练期用 adaptive protein perturbation 作为口袋正则；并做 guidance-scale 研究与 pocket-permutation、PoseCheck 诊断。
Result: CrossDocked2020（GenBench3D）上，相对其引导版父模型 TAGMol，Valid_3D 由 58.6 提升至 80.6，strain energy 由 457.4 降至 127.9；相对 TargetDiff，Valid_3D 相当而 strain energy 更低（127.9 vs 306.0），中等引导下 docking 与分子属性分数保持竞争力。guidance-scale 研究显示中等引导在目标相关目标与几何质量间取得较好平衡，更强引导会损害几何与分布保真度；pocket-permutation 与 PoseCheck 诊断支持口袋特异空间兼容性与更少空间位阻冲突。
Conclusion: 几何稳定性与推理期属性引导应作为耦合的设计目标一起考虑，且引导尺度需取中等强度。

papers.title: VidaForge: Open Research Infrastructure for Video Pretraining Data Recipes
papers.abstract_en: Video foundation models increasingly rely on large-scale pretraining data, yet the end-to-end data pipelines behind them remain largely closed and difficult to inspect or reuse. Researchers seeking to understand how video data recipes affect model pretraining often need to build substantial infrastructure before testing even a focused hypothesis. We present VIDAFORGE, an open research infrastructure that represents a video data recipe as an executable five-stage workflow from raw videos to training datasets. A decision in this workflow can be varied to construct alternative datasets while preserving how every sample was produced. To demon strate this research workflow, we compare data recipes with different coverage and quality in early from-scratch pretraining of Wan 2.1 and V-JEPA 2.1. Across both learning objectives, the broader-coverage recipe achieves the highest downstream benchmark scores, while loss-based evaluation favors different recipes. This study demonstrates how VidaForge connects data-recipe choices to downstream model performance. We further release VIDAFORGE-3M, containing 3.14 million scene level clips totaling 6,475 hours, with fine-grained annotations and curation signals for video data-recipe research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VidaForge 把视频预训练数据配方做成可执行的五阶段流水线，改动任一决策都能生成替代数据集并保留每个样本的来源记录。用它从零预训练 Wan 2.1 与 V-JEPA 2.1 对比不同覆盖与质量的配方：广覆盖配方在下游基准上得分最高，而基于 loss 的评估偏好不同配方。同时发布 VIDAFORGE-3M（314 万场景级片段、6475 小时）。
Motivation: 视频基础模型的端到端数据流水线基本封闭、难以检查与复用，研究者想验证一个数据配方假设就得先自建大量基础设施。
Method: 把数据配方表示为从原始视频到训练集的五阶段可执行工作流，任一环节可被替换以构造对照数据集且保留样本溯源；以该工作流在 Wan 2.1 与 V-JEPA 2.1 上做 from-scratch 早期预训练，对比不同覆盖与质量的配方，并同时用下游基准与 loss 两类评估。
Result: 在两种学习目标下，广覆盖 (broader-coverage) 配方取得最高下游基准分数，而 loss-based 评估偏好不同的配方；发布 VIDAFORGE-3M，含 314 万 (3.14 million) 场景级片段、共 6,475 小时，带细粒度标注与 curation signals。
Conclusion: 数据配方的选择能直接连到下游模型性能，但下游基准与 loss 评估会给出不同排序，配方研究需要可复现、可溯源的开放基础设施。

papers.title: MLLMs Hallucinate when Information Distribution Drifts in Synergy Heads
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with hallucinations, thus hindering their reliable practical applications. Existing attention-based mitigation methods mainly rely on indirect signals (e.g., attention weights) that fail to accurately reflect the actual information shift underlying hallucination generation. In this paper, we propose HEAL, Head-lEvel information disentAnglement and caLibration for identifying and mitigating hallucinations. HEAL first employs causal noise intervention on multi-head outputs to filter out causally redundant heads. Subsequently, it disentangles information distribution within the remaining heads via the counterfactual Difference-in-Differences, categorizing heads into four types. Through analysis, we observe: hallucinations happen when information distribution drifts away from a healthy equilibrium in synergy heads, not strongly correlated with the quantity or strength of modality-specific heads. Motivated by this insight, HEAL injects dynamic information calibration factors into the value vectors of synergy heads and actively regulates visual-language dependencies, steering the output distribution towards factual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HEAL effectively reduces hallucinations across multiple MLLMs, offering a simple and interpretable pathway to enhance model trustworthiness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEAL 在 MLLM 的多头层面定位幻觉来源：用因果噪声干预滤掉冗余头，再用反事实双重差分把剩余头分成四类，发现幻觉发生在 synergy heads 的信息分布偏离健康均衡时，而与 modality-specific heads 的数量或强度关系不强。随后向 synergy heads 的 value 向量注入动态信息校准因子，主动调控视觉-语言依赖，把输出分布拉回事实证据，在多个 MLLM 上降低幻觉。
Motivation: 现有基于 attention 的幻觉缓解方法依赖注意力权重这类间接信号，无法真实反映幻觉生成背后的信息偏移。
Method: HEAL 分三步：对 multi-head 输出做因果噪声干预以滤除因果冗余头；对剩余头用反事实 Difference-in-Differences 分解信息分布并把头分为四类；向 synergy heads 的 value 向量注入动态信息校准因子，主动调节视觉-语言依赖。
Result: 在多个 MLLM 上的实验表明 HEAL 有效降低幻觉；核心观察是幻觉与 synergy heads 的信息分布偏离健康均衡相关，而与 modality-specific heads 的数量或强度不强相关。
Conclusion: 幻觉的因果位点在 synergy heads 的信息分布均衡上，直接校准这些头的 value 向量即可提供一条简单且可解释的提升 MLLM 可信度的路径。

papers.title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Derivation Currency for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: A large language model (LLM) agent that inherits a plan through shared memory can hold the latest requirement yet act on a plan derived from an older one: fresh memory, stale plan. Freshness checks miss this failure because they compare local copies with current state (observation currency) rather than the inputs the plan was derived from (derivation currency). Planfence makes derivation currency checkable after a handoff. Stored plans carry exact links to their recorded inputs; before a protected action, Planfence follows those links to an action-specific dependency frontier, asks each input's owner for its current head, refreshes what changed, and allows one replan before blocking. Application code supplies the links and declares the scope; no shared memory service is required. Holding the native S-Bus validator fixed, supplying inherited input versions raises detected handoff conflicts from 0/30 to 30/30: retained evidence is the missing ingredient. In 30 live five-agent workflows with a revision inserted after planning, a freshness-only executor acts on the stale plan every time, whereas Planfence, like a centralized-lineage baseline that requires a shared store, completes all 30 correctly. In matched replay under emulated LTE traces, Planfence's stall stays within 143-237ms per action across a 64$\times$ range of update rates while per-update synchronization grows from 52 to 1196ms; synchronization is cheaper only at the lowest tested rates. Scoping queries to the declared dependencies holds traffic at 8.1KiB per action, a tenth of all-key validation at 128 keys; at full scope the two tie.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 经共享内存交接计划时，只查观测新鲜度会漏掉「记忆是新的、计划却由旧输入推导」的失败；Planfence 给存储计划附上推导输入的精确链接，受保护动作前沿链接取各输入 owner 的当前 head、刷新变化并允许一次 replan 后再阻断。固定 S-Bus validator 下补入继承的输入版本使检出的交接冲突从 0/30 升到 30/30；30 个五 agent 工作流中 freshness-only 每次都执行陈旧计划，Planfence 与需要共享存储的 centralized-lineage 基线一样全部 30 次正确完成。
Motivation: 共享内存继承计划的 agent 可能持有最新需求却执行由旧版本推导的计划；现有 freshness 检查只比对本地副本与当前状态（observation currency），不检查计划所依赖输入的推导时刻（derivation currency），因此这类交接冲突完全检不出来。
Method: Planfence 让存储计划携带其记录输入的精确链接；受保护动作执行前，沿链接解析到该动作的 dependency frontier，向每个输入的 owner 索取当前 head，刷新已变化的输入，并允许一次 replan，之后才阻断。链接由应用代码提供并声明作用域，不需要共享内存服务；评估固定原生 S-Bus validator，对照 centralized-lineage 基线（依赖共享存储）与 freshness-only 执行器，并在模拟 LTE trace 下做 matched replay。
Result: 固定 S-Bus validator 时，补入继承的输入版本使检出的交接冲突从 0/30 升至 30/30。30 个在规划后插入修订的五 agent 实时工作流中，freshness-only 执行器每次都执行陈旧计划，Planfence 与 centralized-lineage 基线均 30/30 正确完成。模拟 LTE replay 中，更新率跨越 64× 范围时 Planfence 每动作停顿保持在 143–237ms，而逐次同步开销从 52ms 增至 1196ms，同步仅在最低测试更新率下更省；把查询限定到声明依赖后每动作流量为 8.1KiB，是 128 键全键校验的十分之一，全作用域下两者持平。
Conclusion: 交接正确性缺的是推导输入的版本证据而非更新鲜的状态副本；把 derivation currency 做成可检查的链接并限定查询作用域，能在不引入共享存储的前提下达到 centralized-lineage 的正确率，同时把每动作流量压到全键校验的十分之一。

papers.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization: Variance Cascades and Nested Symmetry
papers.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), which is known to steer deep neural networks toward invariant sets that correspond to simpler subnetworks. How this steering unfolds over time remains poorly understood. We answer this by modeling the stochastic gradient flow (SGF) as a percolation process, in which nested architectural symmetries force subnetworks to merge in discrete blocks rather than by single-edge attachment. These structural transitions register as variance spikes in a macroscopic order parameter echoing physical phase transitions. We further state sufficient conditions under which the trapping argument carries over to Adam and AdamW under heavy-tailed gradient noise and measure them on a trained Transformer.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 9 in the main text, v2 corrected theoretical results for Adam with verified additional experiments in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 SGD 的随机梯度流 (stochastic gradient flow) 建模为渗流 (percolation) 过程：嵌套架构对称性迫使子网络按离散块而非单边附着方式合并，这些结构转变在宏观序参量上表现为方差尖峰，对应物理相变。进一步给出 trapping 论证可迁移到 Adam/AdamW（重尾梯度噪声下）的充分条件，并在训练好的 Transformer 上测量。
Motivation: SGD 已知会把深度网络推向对应更简单子网络的不变集，但这一 steering 过程如何随时间展开仍不清楚，缺少刻画结构跃迁的动力学模型。
Method: 将随机梯度流建模为渗流过程，用嵌套架构对称性 (nested architectural symmetry) 约束子网络以离散块合并；以宏观序参量的方差尖峰记录结构转变，并推导 trapping 论证适用于 Adam/AdamW 在重尾梯度噪声下的充分条件，在训练好的 Transformer 上测量这些条件。
Result: 结构性块合并被记录为宏观序参量上的方差尖峰，与物理相变呼应；给出 Adam/AdamW 在重尾梯度噪声下 trapping 论证成立的充分条件，并在训练好的 Transformer 上测量；v2 修正了 Adam 的理论结果并在附录补充经核验的实验。
Conclusion: SGD 通向简单子网络的路径可由渗流式块合并与序参量方差尖峰刻画，且该 trapping 论证在满足充分条件时可扩展到 Adam/AdamW。

papers.title: Linear Reusable Neural Bases Architecture for Network Compression
papers.abstract_en: Memory constraints remain a critical bottleneck in the deployment of large-scale AI models. Parameter sharing across network depth reduces model storage, but repeatedly applying an identical transformation limits flexibility across layers. Inspired by time--memory trade-offs in classical algorithms, we introduce the Linear Reusable Neural Bases (LRNB) architecture, an RNN-based framework that improves parameter efficiency through parameter reuse at the \textit{neuron level}. Each feedforward residual module is represented as a linear combination of shared neural bases, with depth-specific learnable coefficients and optional shifts providing flexibility across layers. This formulation reduces parameter redundancy across depth and enables the construction of wider and deeper networks within a fixed parameter budget. We further provide a geometric interpretation of the neural bases from a vector-field perspective and extend the framework to linear projection modules. Experiments demonstrate that the LRNB architecture achieves comparable or lower final training loss than independently parameterized baselines while using fewer parameters and maintaining stable training dynamics. These findings support neuron-level reuse as a practical approach to parameter-efficient network design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Linear Reusable Neural Bases (LRNB)：把每个前馈残差模块写成共享神经基的线性组合，用逐深度可学习系数与可选偏移在神经元层面复用参数，从而在固定参数预算内构建更宽更深的网络。实验显示其最终训练损失与独立参数化基线相当或更低，参数更少且训练动态稳定。
Motivation: 大模型部署受内存约束，跨深度共享参数能压缩存储，但反复施加同一变换会限制各层灵活性，需要在参数复用与层间表达力之间取得平衡。
Method: 基于 RNN 的 LRNB 架构：每个前馈残差模块表示为共享神经基的线性组合，配逐深度可学习系数与可选 shift 提供层间差异；从向量场视角给出神经基的几何解释，并把框架扩展到线性投影模块。
Result: 实验中 LRNB 的最终训练损失与独立参数化基线相当或更低，同时使用更少参数并保持稳定的训练动态。
Conclusion: 神经元层面的参数复用是参数高效网络设计的可行路径，能在固定参数预算下兼顾模型容量与训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Escaping Reasoning Basin Collapse with History-Biased Search
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time search with large language models (LLMs) often concentrates on a small set of structurally or semantically similar trajectories, leaving alternative reasoning strategies underexplored---a failure mode we call \textit{reasoning basin collapse}. We introduce \textsc{BASIN}, a training-free, history-biased search method that groups reasoning states into basins and accumulates a revisit penalty on repeatedly selected basins, reallocating a fixed inference budget toward underexplored reasoning strategies. Under matched inference budgets, \textsc{BASIN} improves over Tree of Thoughts (ToT) by up to $+22$pp on Game of 24 and $+6.7$pp on MuSR. Because indiscriminate diversification can over-explore once search has found a promising basin, we further introduce \textsc{QA-BASIN}, a quality-aware variant that weakens the revisit penalty for high-quality basins and yields more robust gains. To characterize when basin-aware search helps, we introduce the \emph{redundancy gap} $Δ$, which measures the difference in search concentration between correct and incorrect predictions: standard ToT often operates near $Δ\approx 0$, whereas \textsc{BASIN} consistently shifts $Δ$ positive. Together, these results identify reasoning basin collapse as a failure mode of inference-time search and show that history-dependent bias provides a simple, training-free mechanism for escaping redundant reasoning under fixed compute. Code is available at https://github.com/GitHubLuCheng/basin
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BASIN 把 LLM 推理时搜索中反复收敛到少数相似轨迹的现象定义为 reasoning basin collapse，用按 basin 分组并累计 revisit penalty 的免训练搜索把固定推理预算重新分配给未充分探索的推理策略。在匹配推理预算下，相对 Tree of Thoughts 在 Game of 24 上最多提升 +22pp、在 MuSR 上 +6.7pp；质量感知变体 QA-BASIN 对高质量 basin 弱化惩罚，收益更稳健。
Motivation: 推理时搜索 (inference-time search) 常集中在一小批结构或语义相似的轨迹上，替代推理策略被系统性忽略，且盲目多样化会在已找到有希望的 basin 后过度探索。
Method: BASIN 是免训练、历史偏置的搜索方法：把推理状态分组为 basin，对被反复选中的 basin 累计 revisit penalty，在固定推理预算下重新分配探索；QA-BASIN 按 basin 质量弱化惩罚。另定义 redundancy gap Δ，度量正确与错误预测之间搜索集中度的差异。
Result: 匹配推理预算下，BASIN 相对 Tree of Thoughts 在 Game of 24 上最多 +22pp、在 MuSR 上 +6.7pp；标准 ToT 常处于 Δ≈0，BASIN 使 Δ 稳定转为正值。
Conclusion: reasoning basin collapse 是推理时搜索的一个真实失效模式，历史依赖的偏置是在固定算力下摆脱冗余推理的简单免训练机制；质量感知的惩罚调制让收益更稳健。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Seasonality-Aware Hybrid Convolutional Transformer for Antarctic Sea Ice Concentration Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Antarctic sea ice concentration (SIC) forecasting is an important yet challenging task due to the coexistence of complex spatial structure, long-range temporal dependencies, and strong seasonal variability. Conventional convolution-based models are effective at capturing local spatial patterns, but often have limited ability to model long-term temporal evolution. To address these challenges, we build on a hybrid convolutional transformer forecasting framework for monthly Antarctic SIC forecasting. This framework combines convolutional encoding for spatial feature extraction with space-time factorised self-attention for SIC modelling. We further introduce two season-based mechanisms: a month-aware positional encoding that injects calendar-month information into the token representation, and a seasonal temporal bias that encourages attention to periodically related historical states. Experimental results show that the proposed framework achieves better performance than convolutional and recurrent baselines as well as ECMWF's physics-based dynamical model SEAS5 under both classification and regression metrics. Ablation studies further indicate that the seasonality-aware components provide consistent additional gains in both short- and long-horizon prediction. These results demonstrate the value of combining convolutional structures, attention mechanisms, and periodic prior information for Antarctic SIC forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向南极海冰浓度 (SIC) 月尺度预报，在混合卷积-Transformer 框架上加入月份感知位置编码与季节性时间偏置，把日历月信息注入 token 表示并促使注意力关注周期相关的历史状态。在分类与回归指标上均优于卷积、循环基线以及 ECMWF 物理动力模式 SEAS5，消融显示季节性组件在短、长时效上都带来稳定增益。
Motivation: 南极 SIC 月预报同时受复杂空间结构、长程时间依赖与强季节性影响，卷积模型擅长局部空间模式但难以刻画长期时间演变，需要引入周期先验。
Method: 在混合卷积-Transformer 框架上做月尺度 SIC 预报：卷积编码提取空间特征，space-time factorised self-attention 建模 SIC；新增 month-aware positional encoding 注入日历月信息，以及 seasonal temporal bias 引导注意力偏向周期相关历史状态，并做消融。
Result: 在分类与回归两类指标上均优于卷积基线、循环基线以及 ECMWF 的物理动力模式 SEAS5；消融研究显示季节性组件在短时效与长时效预测上都提供一致的额外增益。
Conclusion: 卷积结构、注意力机制与周期先验信息结合对南极 SIC 预报有效，季节性感知组件是稳定增益的来源。

papers.title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting
papers.abstract_en: Block drafters propose several tokens in one forward pass, before earlier target tokens are realised. Their rejection mixes two losses: missing within-block path information and imperfect modelling of observable information. Accepted length cannot distinguish them. We separate the two with an information floor, the minimum expected rejection at a specified conditioning order; rejection above this floor is the model gap. Measurements across four domains and four open-weight targets, plus floor estimates on a frontier API target, yield three findings. First, the all-parallel floor reaches $0.286$ at the final slot on Qwen3-4B, limiting even the best proposal to $71\%$ per-slot acceptance. Second, one realised token removes $86$--$100\%$ of this floor, a locality also recovered by an independent mutual-information analysis. Third, current drafters remain far above their floors: the final-slot model gap accounts for $43$--$64\%$ of DFlash rejection and $85$--$92\%$ of DSpark's oracle-conditioned rejection. Guided by this separation of short-range conditioning from proposal quality, we replace a context-independent predecessor correction with a prefix-attention head that reads committed context conditional on the predecessor. With supporting backbone components, the resulting Qwen3-4B drafter improves mean serving accepted length by $3.93\%$ over the released DSpark checkpoint across nine tasks, without increasing the conditioning order. Code and data: https://github.com/tie-pilot-qxw/specfloor; drafter checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/TIE-Pilot/dspark-attnconv-block7-qwen3-4b.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 块并行解码 (block drafting) 的拒绝率混合了两种损失：块内路径信息缺失造成的下界 (information floor) 与模型本身对可观测信息建模不足造成的 model gap，二者可用条件阶数下的最小期望拒绝分离。在 Qwen3-4B 上全并行 floor 在末槽达 0.286，即使最优提案每槽接受率也只有 71%；补一个已实现 token 可消除该 floor 的 86–100%。
Motivation: 块起草的 accepted length 无法区分「并行盲区」与「模型没学好可观测信息」这两种拒绝来源，导致改进方向不明：该修条件阶数还是该修提案模型。
Method: 定义 information floor 为指定条件阶数下的最小期望拒绝，超出部分记为 model gap；在四个领域、四个开源权重目标模型上测量，并对一个 frontier API 目标做 floor 估计。据此把短程条件化与提案质量解耦，用读取已提交上下文、以前驱为条件的 prefix-attention head 替换与上下文无关的 predecessor correction，配合 backbone 组件构成新 drafter。
Result: 全并行 floor 在 Qwen3-4B 末槽达 0.286，限制最优提案每槽接受率至 71%；一个已实现 token 消除该 floor 的 86–100%，独立互信息分析复现这一局部性；末槽 model gap 占 DFlash 拒绝的 43–64%、占 DSpark oracle-conditioned 拒绝的 85–92%。新 drafter 在九个任务上把 Qwen3-4B 的平均服务 accepted length 相对已发布 DSpark checkpoint 提升 3.93%，且不增加条件阶数。
Conclusion: 块起草的拒绝应拆成信息下界与模型缺口两部分：当前 drafter 远高于各自 floor，主要短板是提案质量而非条件阶数，因此在不加深条件的前提下改条件化结构即可带来实际 accepted length 收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models via Velocity Matching
papers.abstract_en: Reward-based fine-tuning of diffusion models has largely inherited likelihood-based policy optimization developed for autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Diffusion models, however, are natively trained through velocity regression and do not directly provide the likelihood of a generated sample. Existing methods address this using transition likelihoods along stochastic denoising trajectories or evidence lower bounds (ELBOs) to approximate generated-sample likelihoods. These approximations arise from applying likelihood-based updates to models whose native training and generation operate through velocity fields. We instead take velocity matching as the starting point for reward fine-tuning. We propose \textbf{reward-based velocity matching (RVM)}, which weights the velocity-matching loss by reward with an additional anchor regression term, requiring neither likelihood estimation nor likelihood ratios. RVM recovers Reinforce Adjoint Matching at the update level and contains DiffusionNFT as a special case, while ELBO-based methods are closely related through the same velocity-regression structure. This unified view isolates reward design and anchor velocity as principal design choices in velocity-based fine-tuning. Across text-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video generation, RVM matches or outperforms the evaluated trajectory-based methods. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, it achieves the highest VBench Overall among the evaluated methods, with substantially lower estimated training costs than the trajectory-based approaches. For video fine-tuning, we introduce a dynamic-tracking reward that provides explicit motion feedback and improves both Dynamic Degree and overall VBench performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出奖励化速度匹配 (reward-based velocity matching, RVM)：用奖励加权扩散模型原生的速度匹配损失并加一项锚定回归项，无需似然估计或似然比即可做奖励微调。在文本到图像、文本到视频、图生视频上 RVM 与所评估的基于轨迹的方法持平或更优，在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上取得所评估方法中最高的 VBench Overall，且估计训练成本显著更低。
Motivation: 扩散模型的奖励微调沿用了面向自回归 LLM 的似然式策略优化，但扩散模型原生以速度回归训练、不直接给出生成样本似然，只能靠随机去噪轨迹似然或 ELBO 近似，绕了远路。
Method: RVM 把奖励作为权重乘到速度匹配损失上，再加一个锚定回归 (anchor regression) 项，全程不需要似然估计或似然比；在更新层面它复现 Reinforce Adjoint Matching，并把 DiffusionNFT 作为特例包含，ELBO 类方法也归入同一速度回归结构。该统一视角把奖励设计与锚定速度 (anchor velocity) 分离为两个主要设计变量；视频微调另引入带显式运动反馈的动态跟踪奖励 (dynamic-tracking reward)。
Result: 在文本到图像、文本到视频、图生视频生成上，RVM 与所评估的基于轨迹的方法持平或更优；在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上取得所评估方法中最高的 VBench Overall，估计训练成本显著低于基于轨迹的方法；动态跟踪奖励同时提升 VBench 的 Dynamic Degree 与 Overall。
Conclusion: 奖励微调应从速度匹配而非似然近似出发，奖励设计与锚定速度是速度式微调的两个关键设计选择；该框架统一了 Reinforce Adjoint Matching、DiffusionNFT 与 ELBO 类方法。

papers.title: Three-Phase Scribble-Adaptive Curriculum Learning for autoPETV Grand Challenge
papers.abstract_en: This report describes Libo Zhang's algorithmic solution to autoPETV Grand Challenge on interactive lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT. Interaction is encoded as two additional input channels that rasterize the accumulated foreground and background scribbles, and a residual-encoder U-Net of about 140 million parameters is trained with a three-phase curriculum over 4000 epochs: the network first learns fully automatic segmentation with silent interaction channels, then observes ground-truth-derived scribbles under randomly sampled visibility modes, and finally adapts to its own mistakes through online simulation of up to five error-driven correction steps. Training draws on 1811 autoPET and DeepPSMA studies, and the submission ensembles the best and final checkpoints of five folds by logit averaging. In interactive five-fold cross-validation with six interaction steps, the final checkpoints reach a mean AUC-Dice of 3.836 and a mean AUC-DMM of 3.869, improving monotonically in every fold, with roughly half of the total gain delivered by the first corrective scribble. Our code and trained model checkpoints are available on https://github.com/Libo1023/autoPETV-Curriculum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 autoPETV Grand Challenge 的 PET/CT 病灶交互分割，把前景/背景涂鸦栅格化为两个额外输入通道，用三阶段课程训练约 1.4 亿参数的残差编码器 U-Net：先静默交互通道学全自动分割，再看真值派生涂鸦，最后在线模拟至多五步纠错。五折交互交叉验证、六步交互下最终 checkpoint 平均 AUC-Dice 3.836、AUC-DMM 3.869，每折均单调提升，约一半增益来自第一条纠错涂鸦。
Motivation: 交互式病灶分割中，模型若只在训练时见到真值涂鸦，推理时面对自己错误产生的涂鸦会失配；需要让网络在训练阶段就适应自身错误驱动的修正。
Method: 交互编码为两个额外输入通道（累积前景/背景涂鸦栅格化），残差编码器 U-Net 约 140M 参数，三阶段课程共 4000 epochs：静默交互通道的全自动分割、随机可见性模式下的真值涂鸦、在线模拟至多五步纠错；训练数据为 1811 例 autoPET 与 DeepPSMA 研究，提交时对五折的 best 与 final checkpoint 做 logit 平均集成。
Result: 五折交互交叉验证、六步交互下，final checkpoint 平均 AUC-Dice 3.836、平均 AUC-DMM 3.869，每一折都单调提升；约一半总增益由第一条纠错涂鸦带来。
Conclusion: 先自动、再见真值涂鸦、最后适应自身错误的三阶段课程，能让交互分割在每折都随交互步数单调改善，且首条纠错涂鸦贡献约一半增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In Two Minds about Lifelong Learning: Exploring Hemispheric Redundancy and Specialisation in Neural Models
papers.abstract_en: Persistent intelligent systems require the ability to learn continually, but current machine learning approaches face significant challenges in this area compared to biological learning systems. Machine learning algorithms typically trade off retention of previously learned information and adaptation to new or changing data patterns. When continual learning capabilities are absent, algorithms must undergo retraining using the entire data set, an approach that becomes impractical when original training data are unavailable due to storage constraints, financial or computational costs, or privacy restrictions. However, biological animals can learn continually, without experiencing catastrophic forgetting. This paper attempts to build a high-level framework for how animals learn and preserve knowledge by modelling neural components and states that are known to be related to memory consolidation. We focus on three concepts: experience replay, REM sleep, and bilaterality. We propose 4MAS (4 Module Awake/Sleep), a novel macroarchitecture demonstrating how machine learning models might benefit from asymmetric hemispheres, each with their own long- and short-term memory mechanisms, and how a period of sleep between incremental learning tasks might benefit memory consolidation. Finally, we present results showing that our architecture achieves statistical improvements over established generative replay baselines on Split-MNIST (98.3%) and Split-Fashion-MNIST (84.9%), while reducing forgetting by more than half relative to the strongest replay baseline and demonstrating monotonic capacity scaling on Split-CIFAR-100 (29.29%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 4MAS（4 Module Awake/Sleep）宏观架构：两个不对称半球各带长短期记忆，任务间插入睡眠期做记忆巩固，结合 experience replay 与 REM sleep 模拟生物巩固机制。在持续学习基准上取得统计显著提升：Split-MNIST 98.3%、Split-Fashion-MNIST 84.9%，遗忘较最强 replay 基线减少一半以上，Split-CIFAR-100 上容量单调扩展至 29.29%。
Motivation: 持续学习中保留旧知识与适应新数据相互权衡；缺少持续学习能力时只能用全量数据重训，而原始数据常因存储、成本或隐私不可得。
Method: 以 experience replay、REM sleep、bilaterality 三个概念建模与记忆巩固相关的神经组件与状态，提出 4MAS 宏架构：不对称半球各配长短期记忆机制，并在增量任务之间插入睡眠期以巩固记忆。
Result: Split-MNIST 达到 98.3%，Split-Fashion-MNIST 达到 84.9%，相对既有 generative replay 基线有统计显著提升；遗忘较最强 replay 基线减少超过一半；Split-CIFAR-100 达到 29.29% 并展示单调容量扩展。
Conclusion: 把半球不对称与睡眠期巩固引入宏观架构，可以在持续学习中同时提升准确率并把遗忘减半，且容量随架构扩展单调增长。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Multimodal Alignment: Shared Physical Representations Across Sensors and Action Orders
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal world models are often evaluated by whether different sensors produce similar representations. However, similar representations do not necessarily imply that the models make the same physical predictions, or that those representations can be reused when actions are combined in a new order. We study both questions through the physical responses predicted by a model. We first use the Cluster Haptic dataset to ask whether audio and acceleration can independently recover the behavior of the same surface from different observations. Predictions from the two sensors are substantially closer for the same surface than for different surfaces, with a $4.5\times$ gap on average, while both also outperform an average-surface prediction. We then show that this agreement alone does not determine how familiar actions should compose. In a controlled elastoplastic system, shared step dynamics fit observed programs less accurately than a whole-program predictor but generalize better to unseen action orders, with the ranking reversing on both held-out transitions across three independent initializations. Fusing free-decay and hysteresis observations further improves prediction, with diagonal Gaussian beliefs yielding the lowest errors. Together, these results distinguish cross-sensor consistency, multimodal fusion, and generalization to new action orders as separate questions in evaluating multimodal physical representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态世界模型的表征相似并不等于物理预测一致或动作顺序可组合。在 Cluster Haptic 数据集上，音频与加速度各自独立预测同一表面行为时，同表面预测比不同表面接近 4.5 倍，且都优于平均表面预测；在受控弹塑性系统中，共享 step 动力学拟合精度低于整程序预测器，却在未见动作顺序上泛化更好，且该排序在三次独立初始化的 held-out transitions 上发生反转。
Motivation: 多模态世界模型评测常以传感器表征相似度为准，但相似表征既不保证物理预测一致，也不保证动作以新顺序组合时可复用，评测口径本身有缺口。
Method: 先在 Cluster Haptic 数据集上让音频与加速度各自独立恢复同一表面的行为并比较预测距离；再在受控弹塑性系统中对比共享 step 动力学与整程序预测器，评估未见动作顺序泛化，并融合 free-decay 与 hysteresis 观测，用对角高斯信念 (diagonal Gaussian beliefs) 做预测。
Result: 同表面的两传感器预测比不同表面接近平均 4.5 倍，且两者都优于平均表面预测；共享 step 动力学对观测程序的拟合精度低于整程序预测器，但在未见动作顺序上泛化更好，该排序在三次独立初始化的 held-out transitions 上均反转；融合 free-decay 与 hysteresis 观测进一步降低预测误差，其中对角高斯信念误差最低。
Conclusion: 跨传感器一致性、多模态融合与新动作顺序泛化是评测多模态物理表征的三个独立问题，拟合精度与泛化能力在动作顺序维度上会给出相反排序。

papers.title: Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Humans solve complex problems by constructing plans and mentally simulating their outcomes with an internal model of the world. Machine learning has made substantial progress in learning world models that predict the consequences of action sequences, yet the procedures used to plan with these models remain largely hand-designed. Most planners rely on fixed search or optimization rules; approaches that learn aspects of search typically imitate a predefined optimizer or use planning to inform an amortized policy, rather improving multi-step plans. We introduce \textbf{Reinforced Planning}, a method that learns the plan-update itself by reinforcing update rules that produce better plans, using gradients propagated through a differentiable world model. We instantiate Reinforced Planning in RP1, which learns a critic over imagined outcomes via temporal-difference learning and a neural plan-improvement operator trained via imagined rollouts with a pretrained world model. RP1 can be trained fully offline without environment interaction; environment episodes are used only for checkpoint selection. Across visual navigation, arm reaching, and robotic manipulation on two world-model backbones, RP1 matches or exceeds existing planners, achieving near-perfect success in several settings while using $1{,}000\times$ fewer world-model rollouts than the strongest alternative (CEM) and planning up to $67\times$ faster under concurrent planners inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Reinformed Planning（RP1）：用可微世界模型把「计划更新规则本身」当作被强化的对象，学一个神经 plan-improvement 算子而非沿用固定搜索。在视觉导航、机械臂到达与机器人操作三类任务、两种世界模型骨干上，RP1 与现有 planner 持平或更好，多个设置接近完全成功，同时比最强替代方案 CEM 少用 1,000× 的世界模型 rollout，并发推理下规划快至 67×。
Motivation: 世界模型已能预测动作序列的后果，但用它做规划的流程基本是手工设计的：多数 planner 依赖固定搜索或优化规则，会学习搜索的方法要么模仿预定义优化器，要么只把规划用于摊销策略，而不是直接改进多步计划。
Method: RP1 通过 temporal-difference learning 学一个针对想象结果的 critic，并用预训练世界模型上的 imagined rollouts 训练神经 plan-improvement 算子；更新规则产生的更好计划本身作为强化信号，梯度经可微世界模型反传。训练可完全离线、不与环境交互，环境 episode 仅用于 checkpoint 选择。
Result: 在视觉导航、arm reaching、robotic manipulation 三类任务与两种世界模型骨干上，RP1 与现有 planner 持平或超越，多个设置达到接近完美的成功率；相比最强替代方案 CEM 使用少 1,000× 的世界模型 rollouts，并发 planner 推理下规划速度最高快 67×。
Conclusion: 把计划更新规则本身作为可学习、可强化的对象是可行的：能在大幅削减 rollout 预算与规划时间的同时保持或提升多步计划质量，且训练无需环境交互。

papers.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Source Mixing
papers.abstract_en: When generating text, a Transformer produces representations of past tokens at every layer, but each layer can normally use only representations from the same depth. This restriction prevents the model from fully reusing information it has already computed. We introduce WhiteMatter, which allows every layer to draw on past-token representations from any depth. A learned mixer selects the most useful depths for the current context and combines their representations into shared key-value (KV) cache channels. Sharing these channels across layers can reduce the cache size. Given the same number of training tokens, WhiteMatter with a full-size cache performs comparably to a standard Transformer with 50% more layers. With half the KV cache, WhiteMatter outperforms matched standard Transformers at two model scales, up to 1.3B parameters. Cross-layer connections, however, introduce dependencies that slow training and prompt processing. We address this problem with cyclic iteration, which updates interleaved groups of tokens in turn while processing the tokens within each group in parallel. On a reference model trained with exact autoregressive execution, cyclic iteration converges 12.5x faster than standard Jacobi iteration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WhiteMatter 打破 Transformer 各层只能读同深度表示的限制，用一个 learned mixer 挑出当前上下文最有用的深度，把各层 past-token 表示混入共享 KV cache 通道，从而跨层复用并压缩缓存。同等训练 token 下，全尺寸缓存的 WhiteMatter 与多 50% 层的标准 Transformer 表现相当；半 KV cache 时在最高 1.3B 参数的两个规模上超过匹配基线。跨层依赖拖慢训练与 prompt 处理，作者用 cyclic iteration（分组轮转更新、组内并行）缓解，在精确自回归参考模型上比标准 Jacobi iteration 收敛快 12.5 倍。
Motivation: Transformer 每层都算出了过去 token 的表示，却只能取同深度那一份，已算信息无法跨层复用，KV cache 因此随层数线性膨胀，跨层连接又会引入拖慢训练与 prompt 处理的依赖。
Method: 核心是跨层全连接的 KV source mixing：一个 learned mixer 依据当前上下文选择最有用的深度，把各层 past-token 表示混合进共享 KV cache 通道，各层共用这些通道以缩小缓存。针对跨层依赖带来的训练与 prompt 处理变慢，提出 cyclic iteration，把 token 分成交错组、组间轮转更新而组内并行处理，并在采用精确自回归执行的参考模型上与标准 Jacobi iteration 对比。
Result: 同等训练 token 数下，全尺寸缓存的 WhiteMatter 与层数多 50% 的标准 Transformer 表现相当；KV cache 减半时，在两个模型规模（最大 1.3B 参数）上均超过匹配的标准 Transformer。在精确自回归执行的参考模型上，cyclic iteration 收敛速度是标准 Jacobi iteration 的 12.5 倍。
Conclusion: 跨层共享 KV 通道能在同等训练预算下换到更深模型的容量、或在半缓存下超过匹配基线，代价是跨层依赖；用 cyclic iteration 可把这一训练与 prompt 处理开销压下去。

papers.title: Partition the Support, Reconstruct the Residual: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Video Generation and World Models
papers.abstract_en: Block-sparse attention accelerates video transformers by grouping queries and keys and computing attention only between selected groups. However, it faces two challenges: (1) queries sharing a block route may attend to different keys; and (2) retaining most attention mass does not necessarily preserve the attention output. We find that partition choice affects both the overlap among grouped queries' preferred supports and how well an affine function of the sparse output can represent the difference between dense and sparse outputs. We introduce SparsePR, a training-free method combining Response-Coupled Partitioning with Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction. We first group paired key/value tokens by how their keys respond to sampled queries. We then group queries by their responses to the resulting key-group centroids for shared sparse routing. We compute exact attention on a small set of query rows and fit an affine correction to the differences between their dense and sparse outputs using weighted ridge regression. The fitted map predicts a residual for each unprobed query, which we add to its sparse output. We measure attention-output error as the relative L2 error with respect to each query's dense output. Across four video generation and world models, SparsePR reduces this error, averaged over unprobed queries, by 61.6--90.5% compared with semantic block-sparse attention without residual correction, at 22% executed-pair density including exact probes. SparsePR achieves 1.48x--2.61x end-to-end speedups over dense attention, with dense-reference PSNR of 24.42--31.84 dB at 21.9--26.0% realized executed-pair density. Project page: https://pardistaghavi.github.io/SparsePR-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparsePR 是一种免训练的块稀疏注意力方法：先按 key 对采样 query 的响应配对分组，再按 query 对 key 组质心的响应共享稀疏路由，最后对少量精确 probe 行用加权岭回归拟合 dense 与 sparse 输出差的仿射修正并外推到未探测 query。在四个视频生成与世界模型上，22% 执行对密度（含精确 probe）时相对 L2 注意力输出误差比无残差修正的语义块稀疏注意力降低 61.6–90.5%，端到端加速 1.48x–2.61x。
Motivation: 块稀疏注意力里共享同一 block 路由的 query 可能偏好完全不同的 key，而且保住大部分注意力质量并不等于保住注意力输出本身，导致稀疏化后输出误差大。
Method: Response-Coupled Partitioning：按 key 对采样 query 的响应配对 key/value token，再按 query 对所得 key 组质心的响应分组以共享稀疏路由；Probe-Fitted Residual Reconstruction：在少量 query 行上算精确 attention，用加权岭回归 (weighted ridge regression) 拟合 dense 与 sparse 输出差的仿射映射，预测每个未探测 query 的残差并加回其稀疏输出。
Result: 在四个视频生成与世界模型上，22% 执行对密度（含精确 probe）时，未探测 query 上平均的注意力输出相对 L2 误差比无残差修正的语义块稀疏注意力降低 61.6–90.5%；相对 dense attention 端到端加速 1.48x–2.61x，dense 参考 PSNR 为 24.42–31.84 dB，实现的执行对密度为 21.9–26.0%。
Conclusion: 分区方式同时决定共享路由 query 的支持重叠度与稀疏输出仿射可修正性，把响应耦合分区与 probe 拟合残差重建结合，可在免训练前提下以约两成执行对密度逼近 dense 注意力输出并拿到 1.48x–2.61x 加速。

papers.title: Multinomial Subset Routing with Sum-Max Rewards and Operational Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study online routing to subsets of experts under aggregate bandit feedback and long-run operational constraints. Expert contributions can be complementary: for each task dimension, the best selected expert determines the contribution, and the total reward aggregates these dimension-wise maxima. At the same time, capacity, budget, and fairness requirements impose lower and upper bounds on long-run expert activation frequencies. A fixed deterministic subset cannot generally satisfy such heterogeneous requirements, motivating a stochastic routing policy. We formalize this problem as Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR). The learner maintains a distribution \(q\) over \(K\) experts, samples an expert independently \(M\) times from \(q\), and routes each task to the distinct sampled experts. We propose OMD-Approachability, which combines online mirror descent with Blackwell's approachability to optimize MSR under two-sided operational constraints. We establish \(O(T^{-1/2})\) average reward regret and expected constraint violation. We also quantify the approximation gap induced by a linear surrogate, and evaluate the approach on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带长期运营约束（容量、预算、公平性）的专家子集在线路由形式化为 Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR)：奖励按任务维度取所选专家的最大值再聚合，约束是对专家激活频率的上下界。提出 OMD-Approachability，将 online mirror descent 与 Blackwell approachability 结合，得到 O(T^{-1/2}) 的平均奖励 regret 与期望约束违反，并在真实 crowdsourcing 数据集上评估。
Motivation: 专家贡献互补且存在异质的长期容量、预算与公平约束时，固定确定性子集一般无法同时满足，需要随机路由策略；此前缺少在双边运营约束下同时控制 regret 与约束违反的在线算法。
Method: 学习者维护 K 个专家上的分布 q，独立采样 M 次得到互异专家子集并把任务路由过去；OMD-Approachability 用 online mirror descent 优化奖励、用 Blackwell's approachability 处理双边约束，并用线性代理近似 sum-max 奖励。
Result: 证明平均奖励 regret 与期望约束违反均为 O(T^{-1/2})；量化了线性代理引入的近似间隙 (approximation gap)；在真实 crowdsourcing 数据集上对该方法做了评估。
Conclusion: 随机子集路由配合 OMD-Approachability 可在互补 sum-max 奖励与长期双边运营约束下同时保证 regret 与约束违反的收敛速率，代价是线性代理带来的可量化近似间隙。

papers.title: AeroCopilotBench: Safety-Gated Evaluation of LLM Agents on Aircraft Emergency Procedures in an Executable Cockpit
papers.abstract_en: Aviation knowledge question answering cannot directly assess the operational effectiveness and safety compliance of large language models throughout aircraft emergency procedures. We introduce AeroCopilotBench and its executable cockpit environment, ACOE, which define state-transition rules, task goals, and trajectory-level safety constraints based on aircraft-specific Pilot's Operating Handbooks (POHs). The benchmark comprises 12 scenario templates and 73 tasks across two aircraft types, evaluating task completion, safety compliance, execution discipline, and repeatability. Across repeated evaluations of 12 models, the highest safety-gated success rate is 72.6\%. Most failed episodes achieve all critical goals but do not satisfy all remaining terminal goals. Across repeated runs, models still omit steps that they execute in other runs of the same task. Analysis of failed trajectories further reveals that some reasons for actions that conflict with the aircraft's POH recur across models. These results expose shortcomings in complete procedure execution, consistency across runs, and aircraft-specific emergency response.

papers.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
papers.abstract_en: A primary goal of science is to learn mechanistic world models from limited experimental data, both to explain observations and to predict novel interventions. We introduce the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which combines LLM proposals for $\mathcal M$-open model discovery, experiment design based on Value of Information, and approximate Bayesian inference over model structures, parameters, and stochastic latent trajectories. We apply MDA to learn symbolic reaction rate laws for ChemBench \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}, partially observed ODE models for GlucoseBench \citep{xie2018simglucose,kovatchev2009insilico}, and partially observed SDE models for a new stochastic single-neuron simulator we create. In the appendix, we also show results on various other domains from BoxingGym \citep{gandhi2025boxinggym}. We show that MDA has improved sample efficiency compared to various baseline methods, and the learned models are good predictors but also provide interpretable abstractions of each domain.
papers.comment: v5: Major update: Added GlucoseBench; added experiments with BIC (not just SMC) for marginal likelihood approximation, and de-emphasized SCMC3 narrative; modifed NeuronBench to focus on the stochastic setting; significant rewrite of the main text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Model Discovery Agent (MDA)，用 LLM 提出候选模型结构、按 Value of Information 设计实验，并对模型结构、参数与随机隐轨迹做近似贝叶斯推断，从有限实验数据中发现机理世界模型。在 ChemBench 的符号反应速率律、GlucoseBench 的部分观测 ODE、以及自建的随机单神经元 SDE 模拟器上，MDA 相比多种基线方法样本效率更高，学到的模型既能预测又能给出可解释抽象。
Motivation: 从有限实验数据中学习可解释的机理世界模型，既要解释观测又要预测新干预，而手工建模与盲目试错实验在数据效率和结构搜索上都受限。
Method: MDA 三部分联动：LLM 负责 M-open 模型发现的候选提议；基于 Value of Information 的实验设计决定下一步测什么；近似贝叶斯推断同时覆盖模型结构、参数与随机隐轨迹，v5 中补充了 BIC 与 SMC 两种边际似然近似。
Result: 在 ChemBench（符号反应速率律）、GlucoseBench（部分观测 ODE，v5 新增）、自建随机单神经元模拟器（部分观测 SDE，v5 改为随机设定）上，MDA 相比多种基线方法样本效率更高；附录另在 BoxingGym 的多个域上给出结果。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 提议、基于信息价值的实验设计与贝叶斯结构推断合到一个 agent 里，可以在数据受限下同时拿到预测精度和可解释的机理抽象。

papers.title: Tokenizer-Generator Coupling in Medical Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Latent medical image generators usually treat the tokenizer as fixed preprocessing. We test whether this separation holds in a controlled ChestMNIST study at $64\times64$ that crosses discrete tokenizers, generator families, and sampler settings under a shared latent grid, with continuous-latent reference cells. The rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler. The best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. We interpret this through a rate-distortion-modelability framing in which modelability is conditional on the generator, sampler, and inference budget. The interaction persists when the vocabulary-1024 block is retrained at three seeds, with 4 of 9 pairwise quantizer comparisons exceeding three seed standard deviations, including a reversal between LFQ and FSQ from MaskGIT to D3PM; the rest of the grid was trained at a single seed and is correspondingly less certain. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion. On LFQ-1024, retuning the D3PM and SEDD samplers on a held-out validation split reduces FID-192 from 0.44/0.41 at the default budget to 0.09/0.10 at lower NFE, replicated across seeds, although the continuous references were not given an equivalent sampler sweep. FID-192, our internal ranking metric, ranks consistently with standard FID-2048 (Spearman 0.89) and with a label-free classifier two-sample test (0.86). All experiments are unconditional, use low-resolution $64\times64$ medical-style images and are evaluated with non-clinical FID-based metrics, and our claims are limited to that setting. Implementations are released at https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medtokenizers and https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medlatents.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Extended version with additional analyses and appendices. Code: https://github.com/liamchalcroft/tokenizer-generator-coupling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ChestMNIST 64×64 受控实验中交叉离散 tokenizer、生成器族与采样器设置，证明医学图像隐空间生成的排名由三者共同决定：最佳量化器随生成器改变，验证集选采样器会改变生成器排名，且 LFQ→FSQ 在 MaskGIT 到 D3PM 间出现反转。作者据此主张用 rate-distortion-modelability 框架选型，并指出单看重建 PSNR 不可靠。
Motivation: 隐空间医学图像生成通常把 tokenizer 当固定预处理，但 tokenizer、生成器与采样器的耦合会扭曲模型排名，导致选型结论不可靠。
Method: 在共享隐网格上交叉离散 tokenizer（LFQ、FSQ、vocabulary-1024 等）、生成器族（MaskGIT、D3PM、SEDD）与采样器设置，并设连续隐变量参考组；vocabulary-1024 块用三个种子重训，其余网格单种子；用 rate-distortion-modelability 框架解释，指标为 FID-192、FID-2048、PSNR 与 label-free classifier two-sample test。
Result: 9 组两两量化器比较中 4 组超过三个种子标准差，含 LFQ 与 FSQ 在 MaskGIT→D3PM 间的排名反转；LFQ-1024 上在留出验证集重调 D3PM 与 SEDD 采样器，FID-192 从默认预算的 0.44/0.41 降到更低 NFE 下的 0.09/0.10，且跨种子复现；FID-192 与 FID-2048 排名 Spearman 0.89，与 label-free classifier two-sample test 0.89→0.86。
Conclusion: tokenizer 与生成器、采样器必须联合选型，重建 PSNR 不能单独作为选择依据；结论限于无条件 64×64 低分辨率医学风格图像与非临床 FID 类指标，连续参考组未做同等采样器扫描。

papers.title: FastKron: Efficient Quantization with Kronecker-Factored Hessians
papers.abstract_en: We accelerate a family of algorithms for neural network quantization which utilize a two-sided version of the GPTQ/LDLQ algorithm. Standard GPTQ-style adaptive rounding uses one-sided correlation information derived from input activations. A natural two-sided extension can additionally capture correlations across output channels. It utilizes a general Kronecker-factored approximation of the weight matrix curvature. This approach has been used in BoA and YAQA. But making a concrete algorithmic implementation of this two-sided GPTQ variant is nontrivial. BoA uses a large number of sequential steps, while YAQA improves over the sequential depth but still has quartic total cost. We introduce FastKron, an efficient algorithmic implementation that combines anti-diagonal parallelism with a recursive divide-and-conquer construction. For an $m\times n$ weight matrix, FastKron uses $O(m+n)$ sequential steps while reducing the total work from $O(m^2n^2)$ to $O(mn(m+n))$. Thus, it matches the cubic scaling of GPTQ while exploiting richer curvature information. Moreover, FastKron is modular with respect to both the base quantizer and the Hessian estimator. We also provide practical benchmarks, consider a range of Hessian approximations that FastKron can be used with, and provide an efficient technique to compute these Hessians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastKron 把双边 GPTQ/LDLQ 量化（用 Kronecker 分解的权重曲率同时利用输入激活与输出通道相关性）做成可并行的算法：对 m×n 权重矩阵用反对角并行加递归分治，把顺序步数压到 O(m+n)、总工作量从 O(m²n²) 降到 O(mn(m+n))，与 GPTQ 的三次方标度持平，同时保留更丰富的曲率信息。
Motivation: 双边 GPTQ 变体能额外利用输出通道间相关性，但落地困难：BoA 需要大量顺序步，YAQA 虽减少顺序深度，总代价仍是四次方。
Method: FastKron 采用反对角并行 (anti-diagonal parallelism) 与递归分治构造来实现 Kronecker 分解的权重矩阵曲率近似；对 base quantizer 与 Hessian estimator 均模块化，并给出一组可用的 Hessian 近似及高效计算这些 Hessian 的技术。
Result: 对 m×n 权重矩阵，顺序步数为 O(m+n)，总工作量由 O(m²n²) 降至 O(mn(m+n))，与 GPTQ 的三次方标度一致；相对 YAQA 的四次方总代价为多项式级改进。摘要还称提供 practical benchmarks 与一系列 Hessian 近似选项。
Conclusion: 双边曲率信息不必以四次方代价换取：FastKron 让二阶 GPTQ 类量化在保持 GPTQ 三次方标度的同时用上输出通道相关性，且可替换量化器与 Hessian 估计器。

papers.title: A Unified Risk View of Uncertainty: Posterior Risk for Disentanglement and Evaluation Beyond Proxies
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty estimates are critical in safety-sensitive applications. For such estimates to be useful in practice, it is crucial to understand the sources underlying a model's uncertainty, motivating the disentanglement of total uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. Existing notions of uncertainty differ in the sources they capture and, consequently, in their definitions of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, with no universally accepted definition. We define uncertainty through sample-conditional pointwise posterior risk, which is the expected loss of a predictor under the distribution of plausible ground-truth functions given the observed sample. This definition unifies probabilistic and risk-based concepts of uncertainty. To assess state-of-the-art uncertainty disentanglement methods, we develop a framework that directly compares their estimates against ground-truth uncertainty defined primarily by posterior risk, alongside commonly used alternative uncertainty definitions. We find that Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Processes and Variational Latent Gaussian Processes most closely recover the ground-truth uncertainty, while most methods track posterior variance more closely than posterior risk, missing the predictors' bias. Beyond method rankings, we investigate how strongly estimated aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty are entangled and how sensitive uncertainty quality is to modeling choices, yielding practical guidance for uncertainty disentanglement. To support further method development and validation, we release 13 semi-synthetic UCI/OpenML datasets with known posteriors, enabling the computation of ground-truth uncertainty. Code and data will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以样本条件的逐点后验风险 (posterior risk) 统一定义不确定性，把概率式与风险式概念纳入同一框架，并据此直接评测不确定性解耦方法。发现 Spectral-normalized Neural Gaussian Processes 与 Variational Latent Gaussian Processes 最接近真值不确定性，多数方法只跟踪 posterior variance 而漏掉预测偏差。
Motivation: 现有认知/偶然不确定性定义互不一致、无公认标准，导致解耦方法无法在同一真值下比较，且常用代理指标掩盖预测偏差。
Method: 在观测样本给定的真实函数分布下，用预测器期望损失定义逐点后验风险作为真值不确定性；构建直接对比各方法估计与该真值（及替代定义）的评测框架，并发布 13 个带已知后验的 semi-synthetic UCI/OpenML 数据集。
Result: SNGP 与 Variational Latent Gaussian Processes 最接近真值不确定性；多数方法与 posterior variance 的吻合度高于 posterior risk，因而漏掉预测偏差；同时给出 aleatoric/epistemic 估计的纠缠程度与对建模选择的敏感性分析。
Conclusion: 以后验风险为基准，解耦质量的排序会改变，且现有方法普遍偏向方差而忽略偏差；13 个已知后验的数据集可支撑后续方法开发与验证。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Predicting Task Difficulty Without Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge in evaluating and training autonomous agents is measuring the intrinsic difficulty of the tasks they attempt. Estimating this quantity can be useful for environment designers creating synthetic data or benchmarks, as well as for constructing training curricula, thereby offering a way to reduce compute costs. Such an estimation becomes increasingly important as agents (particularly LLM-based) move into longer-horizon domains, where empirical trial-and-error becomes a severe computational bottleneck. However existing work is largely confined to static tasks and relies on evaluation metrics that, as we show, can give an incomplete picture of predictive performance. In this paper we study ex ante difficulty prediction across 17 agentic benchmarks spanning coding, mathematics, machine learning, web navigation, function calling, and other domains. We find that AUC can mask poor difficulty estimates, identify token-level entropy as a useful predictive signal, and demonstrate how residuals between expected and observed difficulty can expose environment flaws such as contamination and infeasibility.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting needs Cross Variable Loss
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series forecasting presents unique challenges because future variables often co-evolve under shared system dynamics. While existing studies mainly focus on cross-variable dependencies in historical observations, dependencies among future values are much less explored. Specifically, modern forecasting models largely follow the Direct Forecasting (DF) paradigm, generating multi-step forecasts with point-wise objectives that do not explicitly constrain cross-variable structure. In this work, we show that the DF objective is mismatched in the presence of cross-variable and lagged dependencies, revealing an objective gap. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{C}ross-\textbf{V}ariable \textbf{Loss} (CvLoss), a plug-in structural regularizer that constrains forecast residuals on a cross-variable graph. CvLoss penalizes inconsistent edge-wise residual differences over forecast patches, encouraging consistency across both synchronous and asynchronous interactions. Our experiments show that CvLoss consistently improves competitive forecasting models, outperforms representative learning objectives, and is compatible with a variety of forecasting backbones.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多变量时间序列预报中，Direct Forecasting 的逐点损失不约束未来各变量间的耦合结构，导致目标与交叉变量、滞后依赖错位。提出即插即用的 CvLoss：在交叉变量图上约束预报残差，惩罚预报 patch 上不一致的边级残差差分，同时覆盖同步与异步交互。实验中 CvLoss 稳定提升多个有竞争力的预报模型，优于代表性学习目标，并与多种 backbone 兼容。
Motivation: 现有工作主要建模历史观测中的交叉变量依赖，而未来值之间的依赖很少被显式利用；DF 的 point-wise 目标在存在交叉变量与滞后依赖时与真实目标错位（objective gap）。
Method: CvLoss 作为 plug-in 结构正则项：在交叉变量图上约束预报残差，对预报 patch 上的边级残差差分施加一致性惩罚，覆盖同步与异步交互，可叠加到现有 Direct Forecasting 训练目标上。
Result: 实验显示 CvLoss 一致改进多个有竞争力的预报模型，优于代表性学习目标（representative learning objectives），且兼容多种预报 backbone；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 多变量时间序列预报需要在损失层面显式约束未来变量间的交叉结构，而不只在输入侧建模历史依赖；CvLoss 可作为即插即用正则项接入现有模型。
