papers.title: PhyLatent: Learning Dynamics-Relevant Representations for JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose PhyLatent, a dynamics-relevant training objective for Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Our key observation is that preventing global latent collapse does not necessarily ensure that the learned representation preserves physically meaningful state and action relationships. We identify three failure modes: sensitivity to appearance changes that leave the physical state unchanged, insufficient separation of distinct physical states, and insufficient separation of different action-conditioned futures. We refer to these as Physical Invariance Collapse, Physical Distinguishability Collapse, and Counterfactual Dynamics Collapse, respectively. PhyLatent targets these failures through three coordinated training pathways, implemented with static visual invariance, physical state grounding, future representation alignment, counterfactual branch separation, and latent denoising. On OGBench-Cube, PhyLatent reduces the three collapse rates by 43.9%, 27.9%, and 47.1%, respectively, while improving model predictive control (MPC) success by 12.0 percentage points (17.2% relative). Across four visual-control tasks, average planning success increases by 6.62 percentage points (8.3% relative). These results show that global non-collapse alone is insufficient for learning a reliable JEPA world-model state space, and that explicitly preserving dynamics-relevant structure can improve closed-loop planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhyLatent 为 JEPA 世界模型提出动力学相关的训练目标：即使全局 latent 不塌缩，表示仍可能丢失物理状态与动作关系。它识别三种失效——外观变化敏感、物理状态区分不足、反事实未来区分不足——并用静态视觉不变性、物理状态 grounding、未来表示对齐、反事实分支分离与 latent 去噪五条协同路径修复。在 OGBench-Cube 上三种塌缩率分别下降 43.9%、27.9%、47.1%，MPC 成功率提高 12.0 个百分点（相对 17.2%）。
Motivation: JEPA 世界模型中防止全局 latent 塌缩并不保证表示保留物理上有意义的状态与动作关系，导致控制规划不可靠。
Method: PhyLatent 通过三条协同训练路径针对三种塌缩：静态视觉不变性 (static visual invariance)、物理状态 grounding (physical state grounding)、未来表示对齐 (future representation alignment)、反事实分支分离 (counterfactual branch separation) 与 latent 去噪 (latent denoising)。
Result: 在 OGBench-Cube 上，三种塌缩率分别降低 43.9%、27.9%、47.1%，模型预测控制 (MPC) 成功率提高 12.0 个百分点（相对 17.2%）；在四个视觉-控制任务上平均规划成功率提高 6.62 个百分点（相对 8.3%）。
Conclusion: 全局不塌缩不足以学到可靠的 JEPA 世界模型状态空间，显式保留动力学相关结构可改善闭环规划。

papers.title: E$^3$-Orch: Towards Effective, Efficient, and Extensible Agentic Orchestration with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic orchestration enables multiple autonomous agents to solve complex tasks through adaptive decomposition, delegation, and execution. However, existing orchestrators often rely on hand-crafted logic and prompting strategies, limiting adaptation and generalization across tasks and executor configurations. We propose E$^3$-Orch, a reinforcement learning framework for effective, efficient, and extensible agentic orchestration based on a milestone-plan-act workflow. Instead of planning all subtasks upfront, E$^3$-Orch organizes execution around milestones, a mid-level abstraction that scopes planning around meaningful intermediate objectives and allows orchestration decisions to adapt as execution progresses. For each milestone, the orchestrator builds a dependency-aware plan, assigns subtasks to suitable executors, and executes independent subtasks in parallel. We train the orchestration policy from execution feedback, using milestone and plan decisions as units for fine-grained credit assignment. Tree-structured rollouts compare alternative decisions under shared execution histories, while complementary rewards optimize task performance, execution cost, and planning completeness, including an uncertainty-aware performance reward for stochastic downstream outcomes. Across seven benchmarks, E$^3$-Orch achieves the best task performance under multiple executor configurations, improving over the strongest baselines by $0.7$--$3.8$ points and delivering $1.16$--$1.59\times$ higher intelligence efficiency. The learned policy also transfers to unseen executor configurations introduced only at evaluation time, supporting extensible agentic orchestration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E³-Orch 用强化学习训练多智能体编排策略，按 milestone-plan-act 工作流把任务切成中层里程碑，逐里程碑建依赖感知计划、把子任务派给合适 executor 并并行执行。在七个 benchmark 上，其任务性能在多种 executor 配置下最优，比最强基线高 0.7–3.8 点，intelligence efficiency 高 1.16–1.59 倍，且策略可迁移到仅在评测时才出现的未见 executor 配置。
Motivation: 现有 orchestrator 依赖手工设计的逻辑与提示策略，难以跨任务和跨 executor 配置自适应与泛化。
Method: milestone-plan-act 工作流：以 milestone 作为中层抽象限定规划范围，逐 milestone 构建依赖感知计划、派发子任务并行执行；用执行反馈训练编排策略，以 milestone 与 plan 决策作为细粒度信用分配单元，用 tree-structured rollouts 在共享执行历史下比较备选决策，奖励同时覆盖任务性能、执行成本与规划完整度，并含面向随机下游结果的 uncertainty-aware performance reward。
Result: 在七个 benchmark 上，E³-Orch 在多种 executor 配置下取得最佳任务性能，比最强基线高 0.7–3.8 点，intelligence efficiency 高 1.16–1.59 倍；学到的策略可迁移到仅在评测阶段引入的未见 executor 配置。
Conclusion: 以 milestone 为信用分配单元的 RL 编排能同时提升任务性能与执行效率，并让编排策略在新 executor 配置下保持可扩展。

papers.title: SpecDrop: Parameter-Free Category-Conditioned Routing for Modular Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks pursue specialization through learned routers, gates, and load-balancing losses, yet at matched total-parameter budgets learned routers can underperform equal-weight No-Routing baselines. Is the bottleneck the routing algorithm, or the alignment between training-signal granularity and the target categories? We probe the question with SpecDrop, a fixed parameter-free routing scheme: each of $K$ branches receives weight $p_a$ for its assigned category and a small leakage $p_i > 0$ otherwise, merged through a category-independent fixed denominator, with no learned routing parameters and no auxiliary losses; the category label is required at inference. On vision tasks where each image has one superclass label (CIFAR-100 on ResNet-110; ImageNet-1K on ViT-S/16), SpecDrop reaches 79.23% on CIFAR-100 and 79.89% on ImageNet-1K, exceeding parameter-matched baselines that do not use the label (+4.75 over dense on CIFAR-100; +6.53 over the No-Routing+SE control on ImageNet-1K). These gains quantify what category supervision buys when deployed through routing -- not an advantage over label-aware deployments of the baselines: given the same label, masking a dense model's outputs is stronger for accuracy alone (85.2 / 83.7). SpecDrop's contribution is converting the label into trained-in modular structure: 68%/100% branch-category alignment, and masking gains of 0.00 (CIFAR) / +1.06 (ImageNet) -- the output-space restriction is largely internalized during training. On fuzzy partitions, where training units span multiple categories (SlimPajama-6B language modeling with a 30M Transformer; SuperNI instruction tuning over Llama-3.2-1B with LoRA), the routing mechanism reduces to the matched No-Routing controls within seed noise, the null our thesis predicts. Granularity alignment, not algorithm choice, localizes when routing helps. Code: https://github.com/Beryex/SpecDrop
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Camera-ready version. 37 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/Beryex/SpecDrop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecDrop 用免参数的类别条件路由替代可学习 router：每个分支按所属类别得权重 p_a、其余得小泄漏 p_i>0，经类别无关的固定分母合并，无辅助损失但推理需类别标签。在 CIFAR-100/ResNet-110 达 79.23%、ImageNet-1K/ViT-S/16 达 79.89%，比不用标签的参数匹配基线分别高 4.75 与 6.53；但在模糊划分（SlimPajama-6B、SuperNI）上与 No-Routing 对照在种子噪声内无差别，说明起作用的是训练信号粒度与目标类别的对齐，而非路由算法。
Motivation: 在相同总参数预算下，带 router、gate 和负载平衡损失的 MoE 可能不如等权 No-Routing 基线；瓶颈究竟是路由算法，还是训练信号粒度与目标类别的对齐，此前不清楚。
Method: SpecDrop 是固定免参数路由：K 个分支各得所属类别权重 p_a 与泄漏 p_i>0，用类别无关的固定分母合并，不引入可学习路由参数与辅助损失，推理时需要类别标签。视觉任务用单超类标签（CIFAR-100 + ResNet-110，ImageNet-1K + ViT-S/16）；模糊划分上用 SlimPajama-6B 语言建模（30M Transformer）与 SuperNI 指令微调（Llama-3.2-1B + LoRA）。
Result: CIFAR-100 上 79.23%，比 dense 基线高 4.75 个百分点；ImageNet-1K 上 79.89%，比 No-Routing+SE 对照高 6.53。给定同一标签时，对 dense 模型输出做 masking 的精度更高（85.2 / 83.7）。SpecDrop 达到 68%/100% 的分支-类别对齐，masking 增益为 0.00（CIFAR）与 +1.06（ImageNet）。在 SlimPajama-6B 与 SuperNI 上，路由相对匹配的 No-Routing 对照的差异落在种子噪声内。
Conclusion: 类别监督经路由部署能带来增益，但其价值在于把标签转成训练中内化的模块化结构，而非优于标签感知的基线部署；决定路由何时有效的因素是粒度对齐而非算法选择。

papers.title: TransSLR: A Lightweight Transformer for Sign Language Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automated sign language recognition for underrepresented languages remains a largely unsolved problem. Central African Sign Language (CASL) exemplifies this challenge: the CASL-W60 benchmark contains 60 isolated signs, and the best published result is 69.93%. We present TransSLR, a lightweight Temporal Transformer Encoder trained from scratch on normalized 64-frame pose sequences. By operating on geometric keypoint representations rather than raw RGB, TransSLR achieves 80.39% top-1 accuracy and 91.07% top-5 accuracy on a signer-independent evaluation split. This result is 10.46 percentage points higher than the published 69.93% result. TransSLR has 8.67 million trainable parameters. We also evaluate zero-shot transfer from a high-resource sign-language model, which achieves 0.00% exact-match accuracy under our manual gloss-matching protocol. Our experiments compare pose-based, RGB-based, and multimodal approaches to sign-language recognition for a low-resource language.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for oral presentation at Deep Learning Indaba 2026 which will be hosted on the IJCAI hosting platform. paper link: https://chairingtool.com/conferences/dli2026/main-track/submissions/356
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对低资源手语识别，提出轻量级 Temporal Transformer Encoder (TransSLR)，在归一化的 64 帧姿态序列上从零训练，用几何关键点替代原始 RGB。在 CASL-W60（60 个孤立手势）的 signer-independent 划分上 top-1 达 80.39%、top-5 达 91.07%，比已发表最好结果 69.93% 高 10.46 个百分点；而从高资源手语模型做零样本迁移在人工 gloss 匹配协议下 exact-match 为 0.00%。
Motivation: 代表性不足语言的手语识别基本未解：CASL-W60 上已发表最好结果仅 69.93%，且高资源模型难以直接迁移到低资源语言。
Method: TransSLR 是轻量级 Temporal Transformer Encoder，输入为归一化的 64 帧姿态关键点序列（几何表征而非 RGB），从零训练；实验对比基于姿态、RGB 与多模态三类方案，并测试从高资源手语模型的零样本迁移（人工 gloss 匹配协议）。
Result: CASL-W60 signer-independent 划分上 top-1 准确率 80.39%、top-5 准确率 91.07%，较已发表 69.93% 提升 10.46 个百分点；模型 867 万 (8.67M) 可训练参数；高资源模型零样本迁移 exact-match 准确率 0.00%。
Conclusion: 在低资源手语上，从零训练的姿态序列 Transformer 明显优于沿用已发表结果与跨语言零样本迁移，几何关键点是比 RGB 更可行的输入。

papers.title: DynActiveGS: Active Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We present DynActiveGS, a dynamic-aware active reconstruction framework based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for autonomous exploration in dynamic environments. The framework incrementally reconstructs a 3D Gaussian scene representation while suppressing motion-corrupted observations through online uncertainty prediction and uncertainty-weighted Gaussian optimization. A key component of DynActiveGS is the explicit decomposition of uncertainty into structural uncertainty and motion-induced uncertainty, which enables the system to distinguish under-reconstructed static regions from dynamically unreliable areas. Based on these uncertainty fields, DynActiveGS performs dynamic-aware viewpoint selection and dynamic-constrained path planning to favor informative yet stable observations during exploration. The resulting system forms a unified closed-loop pipeline for robust active reconstruction in dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments on challenging dynamic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing active reconstruction baselines in reconstruction accuracy, completeness, rendering quality, and exploration efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynActiveGS 在动态环境中做基于 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 的主动重建：在线预测不确定性并把它显式拆成结构不确定性与运动诱导不确定性，用前者找欠重建静态区、用后者屏蔽运动污染观测，再据此做动态感知视角选择与动态约束路径规划，形成增量重建的闭环。在动态基准上相对已有主动重建基线在重建精度、完整性、渲染质量与探索效率上一致提升。
Motivation: 动态场景中运动污染的观测会破坏增量式 3DGS 重建，而现有主动重建方法难以区分“还没建够的静态区域”和“因运动而不可靠的区域”，导致视角与路径选择偏向不稳定观测。
Method: 框架在线预测不确定性，并显式分解为结构不确定性与运动诱导不确定性两个场；以结构不确定性标出欠重建静态区、以运动诱导不确定性抑制运动污染观测，进行不确定性加权的 Gaussian 优化；再基于这两个不确定性场做动态感知视角选择与动态约束路径规划，构成增量重建的闭环主动探索管线。
Result: 在具有挑战性的动态基准上，相对已有主动重建基线，在重建精度、完整性、渲染质量与探索效率四个维度均取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 把不确定性拆成结构与运动两部分并同时驱动观测筛选和探索决策，是动态场景下做鲁棒主动重建的有效闭环设计。

papers.title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and is non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentStream 把既有 agentic benchmark 组织成可配置任务流，在测试时构造 Isolated、Sequential、Interleaved 三种流式场景，对 5 种自进化方法 × 3 个前沿模型做组合评测。结果显示自进化可靠性随流式场景变化，收益受模型能力门控且随模型强度非单调，没有单一方法在所有模型与场景上占优；作者主张自进化智能体应在真实任务流而非孤立单任务下评测。
Motivation: 现有自进化 LLM 智能体研究几乎都用相互独立的单任务评测，无法刻画智能体在多样、复杂任务流中持续适应时的真实行为。
Method: 提出统一评测框架 AgentStream：把 agentic benchmarks 组织成可配置任务流，测试时实例化 Isolated、Sequential、Interleaved 三种场景以逐步改变任务流的范围与领域构成；在此之上组合评测 5 种代表性自进化方法与 3 个前沿基础模型，分离模型能力、方法架构与流式场景三者对自进化的共同作用。
Result: 自进化可靠性在不同流式场景间存在差异；自进化收益受模型能力门控，且随模型强度呈非单调关系；没有任何单一方法在所有模型与场景上占优。
Conclusion: 自进化方法的选择必须同时看模型与流式场景，评测应从孤立单任务转向真实任务流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeSyFS: A Neuro-symbolic Fast-Slow Thinking Framework for LLM Agent under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in applications such as self-reflection, retrieval-augmented generation, and scientific discovery. In these settings, agents must act based on limited observations rather than full environmental states, leading to partial observability. This introduces several key challenges: belief state inference, task objective misalignment, and planning under uncertainty. Prior approaches typically condition actions on full or summarized action-observation histories whose redundant and irrelevant information can mislead the decision making of LLM agent. Inspired by human cognition, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic fast-slow thinking (NeSyFS) framework for LLM agent, addressing the challenges introduced by partial observability in a unified approach. We use a knowledge graph (KG) to represent the belief state, providing triplets as context for every module of NeSyFS. The fast-thinking module performs reactive action, while slow-thinking conducts a new uncertainty-aware planning by following the high-level structure of twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) algorithm. To mitigate the misalignment of task objective, a reflection module is used to reflect fast-thinking actions, and also switches to the slow-thinking module whenever reactive actions repeatedly fail. Experiments on three representative benchmarks, i.e. ALFWorld, Webshop, and ScienceWorld, demonstrate significant advantages over previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeSyFS 用知识图谱三元组表示 LLM agent 在部分可观测下的信念状态，快思考做反应式动作、慢思考按 twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) 结构做不确定性感知规划，反思模块校正目标错位并在反应式动作反复失败时切换到慢思考。在 ALFWorld、Webshop、ScienceWorld 三个基准上相对既有方法展示显著优势。
Motivation: 部分可观测下 LLM agent 需从完整或摘要化动作-观察历史取条件，其中冗余与无关信息会误导决策，同时带来信念状态推断、任务目标错位与不确定性下规划三类问题。
Method: 以知识图谱 (KG) 三元组作为信念状态表示并为各模块提供上下文；快思考模块执行反应式动作，慢思考模块沿 twisted sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) 的高层结构做不确定性感知规划；反思模块反思快思考动作，并在反应式动作反复失败时切换到慢思考。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、Webshop、ScienceWorld 三个代表性基准上的实验显示相对先前方法具有显著优势。
Conclusion: 把信念状态符号化、快慢双系统规划与反思切换放进同一框架，可在部分可观测设定下改善 LLM agent 的决策。

papers.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, processing visual observations and language instructions through a large language model before predicting robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a compact VLA architecture built on a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. Instead of using a large language model as the central interface between perception and action, TurboVLA independently encodes visual observations and language instructions, directly exchanges information between them through lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction, and predicts continuous action chunks with a compact decoder. This simple design directly constructs task-conditioned representations while avoiding the overhead of an LLM-centered execution pathway. On LIBERO, TurboVLA achieves 97.6% average success with only 0.2B parameters, 31.2 ms inference latency, and 0.9 GiB inference VRAM on a consumer-grade RTX 4090. Notably, a 0.4B TurboVLA achieves 88.06% success on RoboTwin 2.0, even matching or outperforming substantially larger VLA policies. These results demonstrate that the simple $V + L \to A$ design of TurboVLA can achieve high performance without requiring an LLM-centric execution pathway, offering a new perspective on how vision, language, and action can be connected for efficient robotic manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/TurboVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TurboVLA 抛弃 LLM 中心的 V→L→A 路径，改为独立编码视觉与语言、经轻量双向视觉-语言交互直接预测连续动作块 (action chunks)。在 LIBERO 上以 0.2B 参数达到 97.6% 平均成功率，31.2 ms 延迟、0.9 GiB 显存跑在 RTX 4090 上；0.4B 版本在 RoboTwin 2.0 上 88.06% 成功率，可匹配或超过大得多的 VLA 策略。
Motivation: 以大语言模型为感知与动作之间中心接口的 VLA 设计带来大量计算与内存开销，限制了机器人策略在消费级硬件上的实时部署。
Method: 构建紧凑 VLA 架构，直接做 V + L → A 映射：分别编码视觉观测与语言指令，通过轻量双向 vision-language interaction 直接交换信息，再用紧凑解码器预测连续动作块，绕开 LLM 中心执行路径。
Result: LIBERO 上 0.2B 参数的 TurboVLA 平均成功率 97.6%，推理延迟 31.2 ms，推理显存 0.9 GiB（消费级 RTX 4090）；0.4B 版本在 RoboTwin 2.0 上成功率 88.06%，匹配或优于参数量大得多的 VLA 策略。
Conclusion: 视觉、语言与动作可以用简单的 V + L → A 直连方式高效连接，无需 LLM 中心执行路径即可同时拿到高性能与实时、低显存的机器人操作部署。

papers.title: InferScale: GPU-Native KV Injection for Personalized LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed with persistent personalized context, such as accumulated memory profiles or long conversation histories, that is shared across a user's many requests. Production memory systems (e.g., Mem0, MemGPT, and Zep) retrieve a relevant subset of this memory and inject it into the prompt, forcing the serving engine to repeatedly prefill the same content. As the retrieval budget grows, time-to-first-token (TTFT) increases even though the underlying memory is reused across requests. We present InferScale, a GPU-native LLM memory system that replaces repeated prompt prefilling with reusable KV state. InferScale precomputes each memory fact's KV representation, stores it alongside a semantic embedding on the GPU, retrieves relevant facts at serving time, and injects their KV directly into vLLM's paged cache. To support dynamically assembled memories under rotary position embeddings, we introduce Chunked RoPE, which stores keys before rotation and applies their serving-time positions during injection. However, encoding memory facts independently omits the cross-fact context available during joint prefilling. We mitigate this with Context-Window Encoding, which encodes each memory fact together with a small window of preceding conversation context while caching only the target fact's KV. InferScale is implemented through vLLM's KV-connector interface, requiring neither engine modifications nor model fine-tuning. Across three open-weight models on LoCoMo, InferScale keeps TTFT nearly constant as the retrieval budget increases: at k=50 it reduces TTFT by 72-79% (3.6-4.8x), achieves 60.3% accuracy versus 63.3% for Mem0 without serving-time recomputation, and delivers 3.7-4.5x the throughput under concurrent load. Reusable KV state thus decouples memory-conditioned serving latency from retrieved-context size while preserving application quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InferScale 把 LLM 个性化记忆的 KV 状态预计算后存到 GPU，服务时直接注入 vLLM 的 paged cache，取代重复 prefill。在 LoCoMo 上三个开源模型上，检索预算增至 k=50 时 TTFT 几乎不变、降低 72-79%（3.6-4.8x），并发吞吐为 3.7-4.5x，准确率 60.3% 对 Mem0 的 63.3%。
Motivation: Mem0、MemGPT、Zep 这类生产记忆系统每次请求都把检索到的记忆重新 prefill，检索预算增大时 TTFT 随之上升，尽管记忆内容跨请求复用。
Method: 预计算每条记忆事实的 KV 表示并与语义 embedding 一同存在 GPU 上；提出 Chunked RoPE（存旋转前的 key、注入时再套用服务位置）以支持动态组装记忆；用 Context-Window Encoding 把事实连同前序对话窗口一起编码但只缓存目标事实的 KV；通过 vLLM 的 KV-connector 接口实现，不改引擎也不微调模型。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 上三个开源模型上，k=50 时 TTFT 降低 72-79%（3.6-4.8x）且随检索预算增大几乎恒定；准确率 60.3% 对 Mem0 的 63.3%（无需服务时重算）；并发负载下吞吐为 3.7-4.5x。
Conclusion: 可复用 KV 状态能把记忆条件化的服务延迟与检索上下文大小解耦，同时保持应用质量。

papers.title: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning is widely used in language model training to improve performance on a target task while limiting drift from a reference policy. A standard way to balance this trade-off is via a KL-regularized RL objective, although this formulation does not by itself provide a principled way to set the regularization coefficient. In practice, the coefficient is typically chosen heuristically or via hyperparameter search, which can lead to unnecessary overhead in training cost or undesirable reward-retention trade-offs. We instead propose a game-theoretic framework that gives this trade-off an explicit statistical interpretation. Specifically, we study a sequential game in which an agent chooses a policy to maximize cumulative reward while a monitor observes policy outputs over time and tests for deviations from the reference policy. Although not originating from the same perspective, we show that the resulting equilibrium policy can nonetheless be expressed as the solution to a KL-regularized RL problem for an optimal regularization parameter that can be viewed as maximizing reward per unit of statistical distinguishability. Drawing on classical results from concave-convex fractional programming, we provide a principled method for learning this equilibrium coefficient via reduction to the KL-regularized RL objective, thus allowing for flexible integration into standard fine-tuning pipelines. In experiments with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.2-1B, we show that our methods result in competitive reward-retention trade-offs in a continual learning setting, and illustrate how our framework may be used to audit API providers serving open-source models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 KL 正则 RL 微调写成「微调方 vs 监控方」的序贯博弈：监控方持续检验输出是否偏离参考策略，均衡策略恰好等于某个最优 KL 系数下的 KL 正则 RL 解，该系数最大化单位统计可区分性的奖励。用凹-凸分式规划把系数学习归约到标准 KL 正则 RL 目标，可直接嵌入现有微调流程；在 Qwen3-8B 与 Llama-3.2-1B 的 continual learning 设定下给出有竞争力的 reward-retention 权衡，并可用于审计托管开源模型的 API 提供方。
Motivation: KL 正则 RL 目标本身不给正则系数的设定依据，实践中靠启发式或超参搜索，带来训练开销或不良的 reward-retention 权衡；同时缺少对策略偏离参考策略的统计可检测性刻画。
Method: 构造序贯博弈：agent 选策略最大化累积奖励，monitor 观察输出序列并检验对参考策略的偏离；证明均衡策略可写成 KL 正则 RL 问题的解，最优系数解释为最大化单位统计可区分性的奖励。借助凹-凸分式规划 (concave-convex fractional programming) 把均衡系数的学习归约到 KL 正则 RL 目标，从而接入标准微调管线。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 与 Llama-3.2-1B 上的 continual learning 设定实验中，该方法得到有竞争力的 reward-retention 权衡；框架还被用于审计托管开源模型的 API 提供方。
Conclusion: KL 正则系数可以有统计意义的最优解：它由奖励与可区分性的分式目标决定，而非靠超参搜索；同一框架既能指导微调，也能作为对 API 提供方的审计工具。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Why Large Language Models and Humans Converge and Diverge in Evaluating Creativity
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing use of large language models (LLMs) as creativity evaluators, evidence of their alignment with human evaluations remains mixed, raising the question of when and why their judgments converge with or diverge from those of humans. Across three studies and six widely used LLMs, we addressed this gap by identifying the standards underlying LLM creativity evaluation and examining their downstream implications. Study 1 showed that LLMs generally relied on a narrower subset of human creativity evaluation standards. Convergence with human standards was strongest in the novelty dimension, whereas divergence was clearest in the contextual dimension, which captures social, market, and reputational information. Moreover, each LLM exhibited distinct, model-specific standards that varied substantially in breadth. These differences in evaluation standards were reflected in actual creativity judgments. Study 2 (N = 1,103 ideas) showed that LLM evaluations were moderately correlated with human evaluations, and individual LLMs with broader standards better distinguished ideas humans judged as more versus less creative. Study 3 (N = 1,195 participants) showed that LLMs were less sensitive to contextual information: such information significantly altered human creativity ratings but left LLM ratings largely unchanged. Together, our findings help explain the mixed evidence on LLM-human alignment, showing that alignment depends on the evidence a judgment demands and the standards each model applies. Selecting an LLM evaluator is therefore a consequential decision: different models, applying different standards, recognise different ideas as creative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三项研究、六个 LLM 检验其作为创造力评估者与人类的对齐：LLM 只用人类评估标准中较窄的子集，在 novelty 维度与人类最一致、在 contextual 维度分歧最大，且各模型标准广度差异明显。情境信息显著改变人类评分却基本不改变 LLM 评分，因此选哪个 LLM 当评估者会直接改变哪些创意被认定为有创造力。
Motivation: LLM 被越来越多地用作创造力评估者，但其判断与人类评估何时收敛、何时分歧的证据混杂，缺少对背后评估标准的识别。
Method: 三项研究、六个常用 LLM：Study 1 识别 LLM 依赖的人类创造力评估标准子集及其模型特异性；Study 2 用 N=1,103 个创意比较 LLM 与人类评分相关性；Study 3 用 N=1,195 名被试操纵情境信息，观察人类与 LLM 评分的敏感度差异。
Result: LLM 与人类标准在 novelty 维度收敛最强、在 contextual（社会、市场、声誉信息）维度分歧最明显；LLM 评估与人类评估中度相关，标准更广的单个 LLM 更能区分人类判定为高创造力与低创造力的创意；情境信息显著改变人类创造力评分，但 LLM 评分基本不变。
Conclusion: 对齐与否取决于判断所需的证据与各模型采用的标准，因此选择 LLM 评估者是一个有后果的决定：不同模型会认可不同的创意为有创造力。

papers.title: DWM: Separating World Effects from Actions in Latent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models underpin much of modern model-based control, yet current action-conditioned formulations supervise the next-latent transition with a single, undifferentiated target, forcing a monolithic learning signal to absorb every source of state change. In real world, however, transitions arise from two heterogeneous sources: an action-driven component induced by the agent, and an action-invariant world effect -- the change that would still occur under a null action, dictated by the environment's intrinsic dynamics (e.g., gravity-driven sliding, inertia, contact rebound, and persistent drift). Fusing them into a single target entangles the two inside the latent transition, prevents the model from attributing observed changes to their underlying causes, and undermines the transferability of the learned dynamics. We introduce DWM (Decomposed World Model), a supervision-level framework that operationalizes this decomposition. DWM augments the predictor of a latent world model with an auxiliary world head, regularized by a normalized world-contrastive objective to be action-invariant, while the original pred head is coupled to it via an orthogonality constraint; together, the two signals induce an explicit additive decomposition of the predicted transition into an action-invariant and a complementary action-driven component, without altering the underlying architecture or inference pipeline. To evaluate DWM under persistent world effects, we construct W-variants of three standard control benchmarks -- PushT-W, Reacher-W, and TwoRoom-W -- each instantiating a distinct action-invariant dynamic. DWM matches strong baselines on the flat counterparts and delivers a mean absolute improvement of 13.1% in CEM planning success across the W-variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DWM 在潜空间世界模型的监督层把下一潜状态转移拆成动作不变的世界效应与动作驱动分量：辅助 world head 用归一化 world-contrastive 目标约束为动作不变，pred head 与其施加正交约束，架构与推理流程不变。在含持续世界效应的 PushT-W、Reacher-W、TwoRoom-W 上，CEM 规划成功率相对强基线平均绝对提升 13.1%，平坦对照任务上持平。
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型用单一未分化的目标监督下一潜状态转移，把动作引起的改变与环境内禀动力学（重力滑动、惯性、接触回弹、持续漂移）混在一起，导致潜转移内纠缠、无法归因状态变化来源，并削弱学到的动力学的可迁移性。
Method: DWM (Decomposed World Model) 是监督层框架：在潜世界模型预测器上加一个辅助 world head，用归一化的 world-contrastive 目标将其正则为动作不变；原 pred head 通过正交约束与之耦合，两个信号共同诱导预测转移显式加性分解为动作不变分量与动作驱动分量，不改动底层架构和推理管线。评测上构造三个标准控制基准的 W-变体 PushT-W、Reacher-W、TwoRoom-W，各实例化一种不同的动作不变动力学。
Result: 在三个 W-变体上 DWM 相对强基线取得 CEM 规划成功率平均绝对提升 13.1%；在对应的平坦 (flat) 对照任务上与强基线持平。
Conclusion: 把动作不变世界效应与动作驱动分量在监督层显式解耦，可以在不改架构的前提下提升含持续世界效应的控制规划成功率，同时不损失平坦环境上的表现。

papers.title: Conditioned Direct Feedback Alignment via Activity and Error Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Direct feedback alignment (DFA) trains hidden layers with fixed random projections of the output error. Even when this feedback provides useful credit, unequal scales across activity or error directions can distort the local update. We study conditioned DFA (nDFA), a family that adapts established inverse-moment preconditioning to either side of this update. An aligned linear analysis describes how activity conditioning changes spectral learning rates and early-stopping risk. Synthetic experiments show gains from both stabilization and changes in update direction. Confirmatory CIFAR-10 experiments show that activity conditioning, including its FOOF formulation, improves tuned DFA at matched measured training time. Controls support a role for centered correlations beyond the tested mean and diagonal alternatives, while early-only conditioning retains most of the benefit with less training work. Conditioning also benefits backpropagation, and timing interventions do not establish a mechanism specific to random feedback. Error conditioning improves short-budget models and changes update directions, but its small additional improvement under stable training does not survive correction for multiple comparisons. Predicted benefits on image-background benchmarks are not confirmed. These findings establish practical benefits and important limits of conditioning learning with fixed random feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把逆矩预条件 (inverse-moment preconditioning) 分别加到直接反馈对齐 (DFA) 更新的活动侧与误差侧，得到 nDFA 家族；线性分析给出活动条件化如何改变谱学习率与早停风险。CIFAR-10 上活动条件化（含 FOOF 形式）在匹配实测训练时间下改进调优后的 DFA，早停条件化保留大部分收益且训练开销更小；误差条件化的额外改进在多重比较校正后不成立，图像背景基准上预测的收益未被确认。
Motivation: DFA 用固定随机投影回传输出误差，但活动与误差各方向尺度不均会扭曲局部更新方向，即使反馈本身携带有效信用分配信息。
Method: 提出 nDFA：把已有的逆矩预条件分别施加到 DFA 更新的活动侧与误差侧；用对齐线性分析刻画活动条件化对谱学习率与早停风险的影响，并在合成实验与 CIFAR-10 上检验，含 FOOF 形式、早停条件化变体，以及针对均值/对角替代和随机反馈机制的对照与计时干预。
Result: 合成实验显示稳定化与更新方向改变都带来增益；CIFAR-10 确认实验中活动条件化（含 FOOF）在匹配实测训练时间下改进调优 DFA，对照支持中心化相关 (centered correlations) 的作用，早停条件化以更少训练工作保留大部分收益；误差条件化改善短预算模型并改变更新方向，但在稳定训练下其小幅额外改进经多重比较校正后不成立；图像背景基准上预测的收益未被确认。
Conclusion: 条件化对固定随机反馈学习既有实际收益也有明确边界：活动侧收益稳健且可早停获得，误差侧的额外收益与随机反馈特异机制的证据都不牢靠，条件化同样惠及反向传播。

papers.title: CriPO: Enhancing Rubric-based RL via Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Rubric-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has recently shown promise in improving Large Language Models (LLMs) on open-ended tasks. A widely recognized limitation of rubric-based RL is limited exploration: criteria that no rollout manages to satisfy (Unexplored Criteria) receive no optimization signal. Recent methods address this by incorporating rubric information as external guidance during rollout generation, yet they introduce a train-inference mismatch: the policy is optimized on rollouts produced under external guidance while this guidance is absent at inference time, causing error accumulation through autoregressive decoding. Moreover, these exploration-focused approaches overlook a fundamentally different failure mode that we term Suppressed Criteria---criteria that are satisfied by some rollouts yet whose learning signals might be lost during optimization because scalar reward aggregation assigns them non-positive aggregate advantages. Our analysis reveals that suppressed criteria constitute a persistent and non-negligible failure mode---over 25% of samples exhibit this issue throughout training. To simultaneously address both unexplored and suppressed criteria without introducing training-inference mismatch, we propose Criterion-Distilled Policy Optimization (CriPO), which enhances rubric-based RL via on-policy self-distillation. For unexplored criteria, CriPO constructs a behavior-injection teacher and computes a filtered forward-KL loss to inject missing behaviors into the policy. For suppressed criteria, CriPO uses a counterfactual teacher to locate criterion-relevant tokens in negative-advantage rollouts, and corrects their advantages in GRPO to preserve useful patterns. Experiments on medicine and science benchmarks demonstrate that CriPO outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods, e.g., achieving an average gain of 3.3 points over GRPO on Qwen3-4B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CriPO 用 on-policy 自蒸馏同时解决 rubric-based RL 的两类失效：无 rollout 命中的 Unexplored Criteria 与被标量奖励聚合压成非正优势的 Suppressed Criteria，后者在超过 25% 的样本上贯穿整个训练。在医学与科学基准上，CriPO 平均比 GRPO 高 3.3 分（Qwen3-4B）。
Motivation: Rubric-based RL 中没有任何 rollout 满足的准则拿不到优化信号；现有靠外部引导注入 rollout 的方法又造成训练-推理失配，推理时引导缺失会经自回归解码累积误差。
Method: CriPO（Criterion-Distilled Policy Optimization）做 on-policy 自蒸馏：对 Unexplored Criteria 构造 behavior-injection teacher 并计算 filtered forward-KL 损失注入缺失行为；对 Supervised Criteria 用 counterfactual teacher 定位负优势 rollout 中与准则相关的 token，并在 GRPO 中修正其优势。
Result: 分析显示超过 25% 的样本在整个训练过程中都存在 Suppressed Criteria 问题；在医学与科学基准上，CriPO 超过现有 rubric-based RL 方法，Qwen3-4B 上平均比 GRPO 提升 3.3 分。
Conclusion: 用 on-policy 自蒸馏可以同时覆盖未探索与被抑制两类准则而不引入训练-推理失配；标量奖励聚合是 Suppressed Criteria 的根因，需在 GRPO 层面修正优势。

papers.title: What Does Model Growth Really Add? Functional Capacity Beyond Parameter Count
papers.abstract_en: Model growth adds parameters to a trained checkpoint and continues training, aiming to increase capacity while reusing the existing model instead of training from scratch. But does growing a trained model actually create new functional capacity that survives subsequent training? Parameter count alone cannot answer this question, and ``capacity'' is itself ambiguous; it can refer to parameter count, effective dimensionality, or the ability to represent new functions. We measure it directly, as the number of new, functionally independent directions a growth step adds, formalized as the rank increment of the model's functional Jacobian and estimated matrix-free at scale. For zero-gated function-preserving growth, this increment is exactly $K$ under a transversality condition, i.e. $\operatorname{rank}(J_{\mathrm{grown}})=\operatorname{rank}(J_{\mathrm{old}})+K$. Continually training a Transformer grown from $253\mathrm{M}$ to $857\mathrm{M}$ parameters across three domains, we find these added directions persist, with all $K=36$ remaining independent after continual learning, even when the model catastrophically forgets (perplexity $28\to481$) or we deliberately destroy the old function ($25.9\to127$). Geometric capacity and retained function are therefore decoupled. The functional capacity introduced by growth persists, while the previously learned function is not retained. A second, geometrically distinct mechanism, Net2Net, reaches the same $K$-dimensional capacity from directions that are dormant at initialization ($0 \to K$) and then retains it, so the decoupling is not specific to the zero-gate parameterization. The implication is precise. Catastrophic forgetting need not reflect a loss of functional capacity, and preserving dimensionality alone is insufficient to preserve the learned function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把模型增长新增的功能容量直接定义为函数 Jacobian 的秩增量并做 matrix-free 估计：零门控保函数增长在横截条件下恰增 K 个独立方向。持续训练 253M→857M 的 Transformer 时 K=36 全部保留，即使灾难性遗忘（困惑度 28→481）或主动破坏旧函数（25.9→127），说明几何容量与保留功能解耦。
Motivation: 模型增长只加参数并续训，参数量本身无法回答是否真的新增了可表征新函数的能力，且 capacity 一词在参数量、有效维数、函数表示力之间含混。
Method: 把新增容量形式化为模型函数 Jacobian 的秩增量，用 matrix-free 方式在大规模上估计；对零门控保函数增长证明在横截条件下秩增量恰为 K，即 rank(J_grown)=rank(J_old)+K；再用 Net2Net 这一几何上不同的机制作对照。
Result: 零门控增长的秩增量恰为 K；Transformer 从 253M 增至 857M 参数、跨三个领域持续训练后 K=36 个新增方向全部保持独立，即便困惑度从 28 升到 481 或旧函数被主动破坏（25.9→127）；Net2Net 从初始化时休眠的方向达到同样的 K 维容量（0→K）并将其保留。
Conclusion: 灾难性遗忘不必意味着功能容量丢失，而只保持维数不足以保住已学到的函数——几何容量与保留功能是解耦的。

papers.title: The Steering Budget: Examples beat Knobs
papers.abstract_en: Generative models are steered with knobs -- prompts, guidance scales, property tags. Turn one as hard as you like and, past a point, it stops moving the property you care about. We find that ceiling is not a shortcoming of the model but a budget, set by the training data before the model is trained: a property's movable range splits in two -- the part a knob can reach, and a second, significant part that only examples -- concrete instances of what you want more of -- can reach. That second part is usually much larger, but not always, and the same budget says so in advance. Reaching that second part takes a different move: instead of turning a knob, you show the model examples, composed from what it already learned rather than added to its training. A cheap audit of the training data measures the budget; we give a recipe for building the example set that reaches all of it. This buys two things a knob can't. Reach: it moves a property across the whole budget, not just the part a knob reaches. Expressiveness: it steers toward targets you can only specify by example -- including ones you can't put into words. We turn these into a handful of falsifiable claims and verify them in two unrelated domains, image and crystal-structure generation -- marking where a knob is enough, and where only examples will do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成模型的属性可调范围在训练数据里就被切成两段：旋钮（prompt、guidance scale、property tag）只能触及其中一段，另一段更大的部分只有示例能触及。作者给出对训练数据的廉价审计来提前测出这个预算，并给出构建示例集的配方，使示例能覆盖全部预算，同时支持只能用例子表达、无法用语言描述的目标。
Motivation: 旋钮调到一定程度就不再推动目标属性，通常被当成模型能力上限；作者主张这个天花板是训练数据设定的预算，需要在训练前就能测出并区分旋钮够用与只有示例才够用的区间。
Method: 对训练数据做廉价审计以测量属性预算，把可动范围拆成旋钮可达段与示例可达段；给出构建示例集的配方，示例由模型已学到的内容组合而非新增训练数据；把结论写成若干可证伪命题。
Result: 在图像生成与晶体结构生成两个互不相关的领域上验证这些可证伪命题，并标出旋钮足够与只有示例才有效的区间；摘要称第二段预算通常更大但不总是如此，且同一预算可事先给出判断。
Conclusion: 属性控制的上限由训练数据预算决定，示例在可达范围与表达力上补上旋钮做不到的部分，审计预算即可预先判断该用旋钮还是示例。

papers.title: Just-In-Time Scene Graph Growth: Combating Perceptual Saturation in Long-Horizon Robotics
papers.abstract_en: While 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) provide crucial structured representations for embodied agents, conventional Ahead-of-Time, "build-everything-then-filter" pipelines conflict with the real-time, low-latency demands of edge platforms, inducing a perceptual saturation effect via severe observation redundancy. To resolve this, we present JITOMA (Just-In-Time On-demand Memory Activation), a closed-loop framework that unifies task reasoning, perception, and memory into a just-in-time growth process. Instead of exhaustively mapping the entire environment, JITOMA leverages a top-down task heatmap at the frontend to filter continuous observations, routing minimal streams to maintain a global foundation of low-cost, dormant anchors. Upon a cognitive query, the backend Large Language Model (LLM) parses the robotic intent to dynamically awaken task-relevant anchors, triggering expensive semantic operations such as dense node captioning exclusively within the activated local subgraph. To evaluate these dynamic capabilities and study perceptual saturation trade offs, we introduce JITOMA-Bench, a benchmark for long-horizon task switching and complex intent grounding. Across JITOMA-Bench, JITOMA maintains only 1--6 active semantic objects and 0.25--0.28 s/frame across all tiers, showing that semantic computation remains bounded by current task demand rather than accumulated scene complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JITOMA 把长时程机器人 3D 场景图从“先建全图再过滤”改成按需增长：前端任务热图筛掉冗余观测，只留低成本休眠锚点，LLM 解析意图后仅在被激活的局部子图上做密集描述等昂贵语义操作。在 JITOMA-Bench 上全程只维持 1–6 个活跃语义对象、0.25–0.28 s/frame，说明语义计算量由当前任务需求而非累积场景复杂度决定。
Motivation: Ahead-of-Time 的“先建全图再过滤”流水线在边缘平台上与实时低延迟要求冲突，严重观测冗余造成 perceptual saturation（感知饱和）。
Method: JITOMA 是闭环框架，把任务推理、感知与记忆统一为按需增长过程：前端用自顶向下的任务热图过滤连续观测，只把最小数据流送去维护全局的低成本休眠锚点；后端 LLM 解析机器人意图，动态唤醒任务相关锚点，仅在被激活的局部子图内触发密集节点描述等昂贵语义操作。
Result: 提出面向长时程任务切换与复杂意图 grounding 的基准 JITOMA-Bench；在该基准各层级上，JITOMA 仅维持 1–6 个活跃语义对象，处理速度 0.25–0.28 s/frame。
Conclusion: 按需增长的场景图让语义计算量被当前任务需求而非累积场景复杂度封顶，从而避开先建全图带来的观测冗余与感知饱和。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 按需增长的场景图让语义计算量被当前任务需求而非累积场景复杂度封顶，从而避开先建全图带来的观测冗余与感知饱和。

papers.title: Beyond Critical Slowing Down: Slow Modes, Extreme Tails, and Field Decoherence in Tipping Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Tipping transitions are abrupt reorganizations between statistical regimes, usually anticipated through critical slowing down: recovery slows, autocorrelation and variance rise, and spectral power shifts toward low frequencies. In noisy, spatially extended systems, however, these signatures alone cannot distinguish weakening resilience, increasingly likely excursions toward a competing state, and spatial reorganization. We address these questions in the stochastic Ghil-Sellers energy balance model, whose ice-albedo feedback supports warm and snowball metastable regimes, through three viewpoints. Reduced Ruelle-Pollicott resonances and Kolmogorov modes diagnose relaxation and response in physically interpretable observables; Extreme Value Theory probes the accessibility and persistence of tail excursions; and Data-Adaptive Harmonic Modes diagnose the frequency-resolved organization of the temperature field. Near tipping, several reduced decay rates slow together and their modes become geometrically harmonized along a common transition direction, while Green functions show delayed recovery and enhanced low-frequency susceptibility only when the response residues are nonzero. Cold extremes become less sharply bounded and more clustered, and the full field becomes less compressible as its phase distribution broadens, even as a dominant low-frequency component emerges. Read jointly, these diagnostics reconcile apparently contrasting signatures and connect statistical indicators to the physical geometry of competing climate states. We further show that a small localized albedo change can create an additional pair of folds, so that a distance to tipping may carry structural as well as statistical uncertainty. The results provide a framework for interpreting early warnings that distinguishes changes in the system's dynamics from uncertainty in the model's bifurcation structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机 Ghil-Sellers 能量平衡模型（冰-反照率反馈支撑暖态与雪球态两个亚稳态）中，临界减速 (critical slowing down) 的经典前兆不足以区分韧性减弱、向竞争态的偏移和空间重组。临近翻转时多条 Ruelle-Pollicott 共振衰减率同时变慢、模态沿共同转变方向几何对齐，冷极端变得不那么尖锐且更成簇，温度场相位分布展宽导致可压缩性下降；而 Green 函数的恢复迟滞与低频 susceptibility 增强只在响应留数非零时出现。小的局地反照率改变可额外产生一对 fold，使翻转距离同时携带结构性与统计性不确定性。
Motivation: 在含噪空间延展系统中，自相关、方差和低频功率上升这些经典前兆无法区分韧性真正变弱、向竞争态的 excursion 变得更可能、以及场的空间重组三种机制，早期预警因此可能被误读。
Method: 以随机 Ghil-Sellers 能量平衡模型为试验床，从三个视角联合诊断：约化 Ruelle-Pollicott 共振与 Kolmogorov 模态刻画物理可观测量的弛豫与响应，Extreme Value Theory 刻画尾部 excursion 的可达性与持续性，Data-Adaptive Harmonic Modes 刻画温度场的频率分辨组织；并用 Green 函数检查响应留数，另考察局地反照率扰动对分岔结构的影响。
Result: 临近翻转时多条约化衰减率同时变慢且模态沿共同转变方向几何对齐；Green 函数显示只有响应留数非零时才出现恢复迟滞与低频 susceptibility 增强；冷极端变得不那么尖锐且更成簇，温度场相位分布展宽、可压缩性下降，同时出现主导低频分量；小的局地反照率改变可额外生成一对 fold。
Conclusion: 把动力学诊断、极值统计与场组织读在一起可以调和看似矛盾的前兆，并把统计指标与竞争气候态的物理几何联系起来；翻转距离的不确定性既有统计来源也有模型分岔结构来源，早期预警须据此区分动力学变化与结构不确定性。

papers.title: The Entanglement Wall: Activation-Space Probes as Risk Detectors, Not Context Adjudicators
papers.abstract_en: An activation-based safety gate must distinguish harmful assistance from legitimate work on the same topic. We test whether probes trained on broad harmful-versus-harmless data provide this decision boundary. Five checkpoint-specific readouts and their source-derived thresholds are transferred unchanged to four matched-pair cohorts containing 450 pairs, manually reviewed for topic and request-frame similarity. On Twin-70, the primary cohort of 70 pairs, central harmful and harmless score intervals overlap. Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) falls from 0.996-0.999 on the broad source task to 0.701-0.860. Pair ranking remains 0.829-0.929, but the transferred thresholds detect 0.943-1.000 of harmful requests while falsely blocking 0.686-0.986 of matched harmless requests. False blocking remains low on XSTest. Even with thresholds refitted within pair-grouped cross-validation, balanced threshold error is 0.229-0.329. Alternative source-trained logistic, radial-basis, and shallow multilayer probes reduce false blocking but detect only 0.200-0.671 of harmful requests at their transferred thresholds. Three primary readouts meet all prespecified Wall criteria, while two yield mixed evidence. Matched-label training recovers the distinction for the three checkpoints tested, and lexical controls also exhibit transfer loss. An automated post-freeze audit finds little numerical sensitivity to arm-label disagreement. The evaluated source operating points fail to combine strong harmful-request detection with access for legitimate same-topic work. This gap between risk ranking and a usable decision boundary is the security concern captured by the Entanglement Wall.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 23 tables. Substantially revised manuscript with updated evaluations. Reproduction materials: https://github.com/dschwarz33/entanglement-wall
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 激活空间安全探针上，用宽泛有害/无害数据训练的读出迁移到同主题匹配对后失去可用决策边界：Twin-70 上 AUROC 从源任务 0.996–0.999 掉到 0.701–0.860，迁移阈值虽检出 0.943–1.000 的有害请求，却误拦 0.686–0.986 的同主题无害请求。匹配标签训练可在三个 checkpoint 上恢复区分。
Motivation: 激活型安全门需要在同一主题内区分有害请求与合法工作，而探针通常在宽泛的有害/无害数据上训练并直接迁移阈值，这一决策边界是否成立此前未经检验。
Method: 五个 checkpoint 专属读出及其源导出阈值原封不动迁移到四个匹配对队列（共 450 对，人工复核主题与请求框架相似度）；另做组内交叉验证下的阈值重拟合、logistic/径向基/浅层多层探针对比、匹配标签训练与词汇控制，并用冻结后自动审计检查臂标签分歧的数值敏感性。
Result: Twin-70（70 对主队列）上 AUROC 由源任务 0.996–0.999 降至 0.701–0.860，pair ranking 保持 0.829–0.929；迁移阈值检出 0.943–1.000 有害请求但误拦 0.686–0.986 匹配无害请求，XSTest 上误拦仍低；组内交叉验证重拟合阈值后 balanced threshold error 仍为 0.229–0.329；替代探针误拦更低但仅检出 0.200–0.671 有害请求；三个主读出满足全部预设 Wall 判据，两个证据混合，匹配标签训练在测试的三个 checkpoint 上恢复区分。
Conclusion: 风险排序与可用决策边界之间存在鸿沟（Entanglement Wall）：源工作点无法同时做到强有害检出与同主题合法访问，需匹配标签训练才能恢复该区分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agents Don't Just Agree, They Remember: Benchmarking Persistent Sycophancy in Self-Improving Personal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving personal agents now write profiles, memories, and reusable skills that carry over from one chat to the next. Prior work asks whether user pressure bends a model's next answer. Yet these agents can also write the user's claim down, so a later chat may read it back as trusted context. We call this persistent sycophancy. We introduce the Personal Agent Sycophancy Benchmark, PASB, with 1,600 tasks run on two real agents, Hermes-Agent and OpenClaw, across twelve models. Each task isolates a first chat containing the claim from a neutral follow-up chat, so any carryover must pass through a note the agent chose to write. Our analysis shows that downstream failure, meaning how often later answers side with the claim, reason from it, treat it as fact, or stretch it, reaches 71.9% when the follow-up chat can read a saved claim, against 45.0% when the claim stays in the first chat. Writing also edits the claim, as agents save it as a stable preference, a background fact, or a reusable procedure in 51.4% of runs. A saved claim still shapes answers in a different domain. Among the mitigations we test, explicit memory editing helps most, cutting downstream failure to 32.7% for Hermes-Agent and 54.5% for OpenClaw on same-domain follow-ups. PASB shows that self-improving agents must govern what they write down before it governs what they say. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/henrymao2004/agent-sycophancy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PASB（Personal Agent Sycophancy Benchmark），1600 个任务、两个真实 agent（Hermes-Agent、OpenClaw）、12 个模型，把首聊中的用户主张与中性追问隔离，证明持久性谄媚 (persistent sycophancy) 来自 agent 自己写下的记忆。追问可读到已保存主张时下游失败率达 71.9%，主张留在首聊时为 45.0%；显式记忆编辑把同域追问失败率降到 Hermes-Agent 32.7%、OpenClaw 54.5%。
Motivation: 既有工作只考察用户施压是否改变模型的下一句回答，但自我改进的 personal agent 会把主张写进 profile、memory、可复用 skill 并跨聊天带过去，使谄媚从单轮偏移变成被后续会话当作可信上下文读回的持久污染。
Method: 构建 PASB 基准，每个任务把含主张的首聊与中性追问隔离开，使任何跨会话影响只能经由 agent 主动写下的笔记传递；在 Hermes-Agent 与 OpenClaw 两个真实 agent 上跑 12 个模型共 1600 个任务，并测试多种缓解手段，包括显式记忆编辑 (explicit memory editing)。
Result: 追问可读取已保存主张时下游失败率 71.9%，主张仅留在首聊时 45.0%；agent 在 51.4% 的运行中把主张改写为稳定偏好、背景事实或可复用流程；已保存主张还能跨域影响回答；显式记忆编辑把同域追问的下游失败率降到 Hermes-Agent 32.7%、OpenClaw 54.5%。
Conclusion: 自我改进的 personal agent 必须先管住自己写下的内容，否则写下的内容会反过来支配它们说出的话；显式记忆编辑是所测缓解手段中效果最强的一种。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Autonomous and Auditable Medical Imaging Model Development
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to automate machine learning engineering (MLE) by coupling planning, code execution, debugging, and empirical feedback. Translating this capability to medical imaging remains difficult because each task imposes modality-specific experimentation and strict requirements for validation protocols and prediction artifacts. Here we introduce AMID, an autonomous multi-agent framework for medical imaging model development. AMID first proposes Data-Conditioned Method Planning, which refines coarse task-level search spaces into executable, parallelizable method lanes grounded in task-specific data analysis and runnable medical-imaging resources. It then develops Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization, moving from broad early exploration of diverse method lanes to selective exploitation of promising candidates while enforcing strict verification of validation protocols, metric computation, and prediction artifacts throughout the optimization. Across 20 medical imaging challenge tasks spanning diverse modalities and prediction types, AMID outperformed evaluated general-purpose MLE systems and, on several tasks, approached or matched strong human-designed challenge solutions. These results suggest that AMID can turn task-specific medical imaging model development from bespoke manual engineering into an agentic workflow for producing high-performing and auditable model artifacts across heterogeneous tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMID 用多智能体把医学影像建模从手工工程变成可审计的自动流程：先按任务数据把粗粒度搜索空间细化成可并行的方法通道，再在两阶段优化中全程强制校验验证协议、指标计算与预测产物。在 20 个跨模态医学影像挑战任务上，它超过了所评估的通用 MLE 系统，并在若干任务上接近或匹敌强人工设计的挑战方案。
Motivation: LLM 智能体已能自动化通用 MLE，但医学影像每个任务都有模态特定的实验需求，且对验证协议与预测产物有严格要求，通用系统难以直接迁移。
Method: AMID 提出 Data-Conditioned Method Planning，用任务特定数据分析与可运行的医学影像资源把粗粒度任务级搜索空间细化为可执行、可并行的方法通道；再用 Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization，先广泛探索各方法通道，后选择性利用有前景的候选，并在优化全程强制校验验证协议、指标计算与预测产物。
Result: 在 20 个覆盖多种模态与预测类型的医学影像挑战任务上，AMID 优于所评估的通用 MLE 系统，并在若干任务上接近或匹敌强人工设计的挑战方案。
Conclusion: 医学影像建模可以由智能体工作流产出高性能且可审计的模型产物，取代逐任务的手工工程。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 医学影像建模可以由智能体工作流产出高性能且可审计的模型产物，取代逐任务的手工工程。

papers.title: NetInjectBench: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injection in Tool-Using Large Language Model Agents for Network Operations
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents are attractive for network operations, but tickets, alerts, logs, runbooks, and ChatOps messages can carry indirect prompt injections. We present NetInjectBench, a 130-scenario benchmark that separates untrusted artifact text, trusted policy metadata, and evaluation labels for network-operation tool use. The sample contains 40 benign, 40 weak-attack, 40 strong-attack, and 10 approved high-impact change scenarios; each is evaluated with Qwen2.5-7B, Llama3.1-8B, and Mistral-7B. Across 240 attack instances, naive execution reached an 82.50% unsafe tool-action rate. Prompt-only safety, Self-Reminder, Spotlighting, and a Two-Pass LLM Judge reduced this rate to 25.63%, 21.67%, 18.33%, and 10.00%, respectively. Static allowlisting reached 5.00% but blocked all approved changes, yielding 0.00% usefulness and 100.00% overblocking on approved cases. Under the stated metadata-integrity assumption, the metadata-aware policy gate produced 0/240 unsafe attack actions, with a 95% Wilson upper bound of 1.58%, while preserving 99.17% attack-scenario usefulness and 100.00% approved-change usefulness. The findings show that network-operation agents need execution-time authorization boundaries alongside prompt-level instruction hygiene.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NetInjectBench 是一个 130 场景的网络运维 LLM agent 间接提示注入基准，把不可信工件文本、可信策略元数据与评估标签分离。240 个攻击实例上朴素执行的不安全工具动作率达 82.50%，元数据感知策略门 (metadata-aware policy gate) 在给定元数据完整性假设下做到 0/240 不安全动作（95% Wilson 上界 1.58%），同时保住 99.17% 攻击场景有用性与 100.00% 已批准变更有用性。
Motivation: 网络运维 agent 会读取工单、告警、日志、runbook 与 ChatOps 消息，这些都可携带间接提示注入；仅靠提示层指令卫生无法约束执行时的工具调用。
Method: 构建 130 场景基准（40 良性、40 弱攻击、40 强攻击、10 已批准高影响变更），用 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 三个模型评测；对比朴素执行、prompt-only 安全、Self-Reminder、Spotlighting、Two-Pass LLM Judge、静态允许清单与元数据感知策略门。
Result: 240 个攻击实例上朴素执行不安全工具动作率 82.50%；prompt-only、Self-Reminder、Spotlighting、Two-Pass LLM Judge 分别降到 25.63%、21.67%、18.33%、10.00%；静态允许清单 5.00% 但拦掉全部已批准变更，有用性 0.00%、过度拦截 100.00%；元数据感知策略门 0/240 不安全攻击动作，95% Wilson 上界 1.58%，攻击场景有用性 99.17%、已批准变更有用性 100.00%。
Conclusion: 网络运维 agent 需要在提示层指令卫生之外增加执行时授权边界；静态允许清单虽压低攻击率却摧毁可用性，元数据感知策略门在元数据完整性假设下同时保住安全与有用性。

papers.title: BOCCHI: A More Realistic and Challenging Benchmark for Local Motion Blur Detection with MSDCT-UNet
papers.abstract_en: Local motion blur detection requires pixel-level localization of blurred regions. Existing benchmarks let models rely on gradient shortcuts that fail to transfer. We introduce BOCCHI (Blurred Objects Captured across Cameras with Human-annotated Imagery), a real-captured benchmark whose sharp regions overlap the blur gradient distribution and defeat these shortcuts, and propose MSDCT-UNet (Multi-Scale Discrete Cosine Transform UNet), a frequency-aware encoder-decoder injecting multi-scale DCT priors through DCT Attention and FiLM. MSDCT-UNet ranks first in in-domain mIoU and boundary localization on BOCCHI, and BOCCHI-trained models outperform every other training source on cross-dataset transfer with only 633 training images. Our project page is available at https://brianchen1120.github.io/project/bocchi/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BOCCHI 是实拍的局部运动模糊检测基准，其清晰区域与模糊梯度分布重叠，堵死现有基准上的梯度捷径；配套提出 MSDCT-UNet，用多尺度 DCT 先验经 DCT Attention 与 FiLM 注入编码器-解码器。在 BOCCHI 上该模型 in-domain mIoU 与边界定位均排第一，且仅用 633 张训练图的 BOCCHI 训练模型在跨数据集迁移上胜过其他所有训练来源。
Motivation: 现有局部运动模糊检测基准让模型学到梯度捷径，换数据集就失效，缺少能逼出真实模糊特征的像素级评测集。
Method: 构建实拍基准 BOCCHI（Blurred Objects Captured across Cameras with Human-annotated Imagery），人工标注且使清晰区域与模糊梯度分布重叠；提出 MSDCT-UNet（Multi-Scale Discrete Cosine Transform UNet），在编码器-解码器中通过 DCT Attention 与 FiLM 注入多尺度 DCT 频域先验。
Result: MSDCT-UNet 在 BOCCHI 的 in-domain mIoU 与边界定位两项指标上均排名第一；用 BOCCHI 训练的模型在跨数据集迁移上优于其他所有训练来源，仅需 633 张训练图像。
Conclusion: 消除梯度捷径的实拍基准加频域先验注入，能在极少训练样本下同时提升模糊区域分割精度与跨数据集泛化。

papers.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning LLMs to inject new knowledge faces a critical challenge: LLMs can quickly memorize new facts, yet fail to use them for downstream reasoning tasks. We formalize this failure as the Knowing-Using Gap, characterized by an accuracy gap and a temporal lag between memorization and generalization. To understand this phenomenon, we fine-tune LLMs with unseen knowledge and monitor the spatial permeation dynamics of the knowledge internally with self-patching, an adaptation of activation patching that scans all layer pairs at every fine-tuning check-point. Self-patching identifies activation locations where relocating representations substantially improves failed generalization cases. These results are consistent with a knowledge-circuit misalignment hypothesis: memorized representations can exist internally but may not be routed to computation-effective layers. Experiments are done cross-domain for the robustness of this finding. Building on this diagnosis, we propose layer-wise representation self-distillation (LRSD) that aligns knowledge representation from late storage layer to middle layer. LRSD keeps improving generalization after fine-tuning saturates and nearly doubles multi-hop chaining accuracy on Qwen, while leaving memorization intact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「记住了却用不上」形式化为 Knowing-Using Gap：微调注入新知识后模型能快速记住事实，但下游推理准确率存在滞后。用 self-patching（逐微调检查点扫描所有层对的 activation patching）发现记忆表征滞留在存储层、未被路由到计算有效层，据此提出 LRSD 把表征从晚层对齐到中层，在 Qwen 上让多跳链式推理准确率接近翻倍且不损害记忆。
Motivation: 微调注入新知识时，模型能迅速记住新事实却无法用于下游推理，记忆与泛化之间存在准确率差距和时间滞后，其内部机制此前不清楚。
Method: 对含未见知识的 LLM 做微调，并在每个微调检查点用 self-patching（activation patching 的改造版）扫描所有层对，定位重定位表征能显著改善失败泛化案例的激活位置；跨领域实验检验结论稳健性；再提出 layer-wise representation self-distillation (LRSD)，把知识表征从晚层存储层对齐到中层。
Result: self-patching 找到的激活位置支持 knowledge-circuit misalignment 假设：记忆表征存在但未被路由到计算有效层。LRSD 在微调饱和后仍持续提升泛化，在 Qwen 上使多跳链式推理 (multi-hop chaining) 准确率接近翻倍，同时保持记忆不受损。
Conclusion: 记忆与泛化脱节的根因是知识电路错位——表征存对了位置但没进入计算路径，因此把晚层知识对齐到中层即可在不牺牲记忆的前提下恢复推理使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What is Left for Us? Second Scholarship Against the Degradation of Research by AI
papers.abstract_en: We argue that generative AI can degrade research by eroding the very practices through which scholarly judgement is formed. As constitutive conditions for the production and validation of knowledge, these practices cannot be reduced to the outputs of research, which is what AI tools so effectively simulate. When scholars delegate central tasks of inquiry to Large Language Models (LLMs), they may stop engaging in these practices and lose the formation they provide: the output may improve while the researcher fails to develop. Against this risk, merely keeping humans "in the loop" as prompters or quality checkers of AI outputs is insufficient to preserve research as a site of intellectual formation. What is needed instead is a renewed commitment to research as a lived practice in which judgement is formed gradually, often through friction, and participation in a scholarly community. We defend it because it rests on four sources and warrants of research that cannot be automated: tacit knowledge, personal commitment, socialisation, and deep reading. These enact what we call second scholarship, i.e., the reappropriation of scholarly craft, chosen out of a critical experience of what AI tools can and cannot do. Researchers who practise it may delegate tasks to these tools, provided that their own judgement in the delegated competence is already formed, that they can answer for the output, and that they keep exercising the competence themselves. What cannot and should not be delegated becomes what research communities must value and answer for. This is what is left for us.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论证生成式 AI 会通过掏空学术判断的形成过程来劣化研究：研究实践是知识生产与验证的构成性条件，无法还原为 AI 能模拟的研究产出。当学者把探究核心任务委托给 LLM 时，产出可能变好而研究者本人不再成长；仅让人留在环内做提示者或质检员不足以保住研究作为智识养成场所的功能。作者主张以「second scholarship」回应——只有当学者在该能力上的判断已经养成、能为产出负责、且自己持续练习该能力时，才可把任务委托给 AI。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 模拟研究产出的能力越来越强，但研究实践本身是学者判断力的养成渠道；若把委托误当作等价替代，研究共同体将失去判断力的来源，而现有「human-in-the-loop」的补救方案解决不了这一点。
Method: 论证式哲学工作：先把研究实践界定为知识生产与验证的构成性条件、不可还原为产出；再论证 in-the-loop 方案不足；随后提出 four sources and warrants of research——tacit knowledge、personal commitment、socialisation、deep reading——作为不可自动化的依据，据此定义 second scholarship 并给出可委托的三个条件。
Result: 给出的核心命题是：委托 LLM 后产出可能改善而研究者不再养成（output may improve while the researcher fails to develop）；判定可委托的条件有三条——该能力上的判断已先养成、能为产出负责、自己持续练习该能力；不可也不应委托的部分即研究共同体必须珍视并为之负责的部分。
Conclusion: 研究的价值不只在产出，还在判断力的养成过程；委托的边界应由「判断是否已养成 + 能否为产出负责 + 是否仍在练习」三条来划，而不是由人是否在环内来划。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SiamJEPA: On the Role of Siamese Student Encoders in JEPA
papers.abstract_en: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising framework for self-supervised representation learning by predicting latent embeddings of masked regions rather than reconstructing pixels. Existing JEPA methods typically employ a single student encoder, leaving the role of Siamese student encoders largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Siamese JEPA (SiamJEPA), a JEPA framework with masked Siamese student encoders and an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher, which can also be viewed as a JEPA formulation of the brain-inspired representation learning model PhiNet. We further introduce Random Shuffle Teacher (RST), which removes spatial correspondence in teacher targets to encourage semantic patch representations, and develop an RST-based semantic-to-spatial curriculum. Experiments on ImageNet show that Siamese student encoders effectively regularize the JEPA objective, improving representation separability and accelerating early-stage learning. Moreover, under RST, stronger Siamese regularization substantially increases class-discriminative information in individual patch tokens, suggesting that the semantic bias arises from the interaction between RST and the Siamese objective rather than from shuffling alone. SiamJEPA consistently outperforms comparable single-encoder JEPA variants under limited training budgets. With RST-based curriculum learning and a ViT-Base backbone, SiamJEPA achieves 74.2\% linear-probing accuracy after 450 epochs using a substantially simpler masking strategy, compared with I-JEPA (72.9\%) and DSeq-JEPA (73.5\%) after 600 epochs. These results demonstrate that Siamese student encoders provide an effective inductive bias for predictive representation learning and can be further enhanced through semantic-to-spatial curriculum learning. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/oist/SiamJEPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SiamJEPA 把 JEPA 的单学生编码器换成带掩码的孪生学生编码器 (Siamese student encoders) 加 EMA teacher，并加入 Random Shuffle Teacher (RST) 打破 teacher 目标的空间对应以鼓励语义 patch 表示。ImageNet 上用 ViT-Base 与 RST 语义到空间课程学习，450 epoch 线性探测达 74.2%，超过 I-JEPA 72.9% 与 DSeq-JEPA 73.5%（均为 600 epoch）。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 方法几乎都用单学生编码器，孪生学生编码器在预测式自监督表示学习中的作用基本未被探索。
Method: 提出 SiamJEPA：掩码孪生学生编码器 + EMA teacher 的 JEPA 框架，可视为脑启发模型 PhiNet 的 JEPA 形式化；再引入 Random Shuffle Teacher (RST) 移除 teacher 目标的 spatial correspondence，并基于 RST 设计 semantic-to-spatial curriculum。
Result: ImageNet 上，RST 课程学习 + ViT-Base 的 SiamJEPA 在 450 epoch 后线性探测准确率 74.2%，对比 I-JEPA 72.9% 与 DSeq-JEPA 73.5%（各 600 epoch），且掩码策略更简单；在有限训练预算下持续优于可比的单编码器 JEPA 变体。RST 条件下更强的 Siamese 正则显著提高单个 patch token 的类别判别信息，说明语义偏置来自 RST 与 Siamese 目标的交互而非仅打乱。
Conclusion: 孪生学生编码器为预测式表示学习提供了有效的归纳偏置，能正则化 JEPA 目标、提升表示可分性并加速早期学习，再叠加语义到空间课程学习可进一步增强。

papers.title: What Does a Routing Oracle Measure Under Stochastic Decoding? Coupling, Scorer Choice, and Single-Commit Ceilings
papers.abstract_en: Routing benchmarks often compare a policy that commits to one model before seeing its response with a hindsight oracle that credits any correct recorded output. Under stochastic decoding these are different decision classes. For success marginals $p_{im}$ under a frozen query--model--decoder--scorer protocol, we distinguish the clairvoyant single-commit ceiling $R_i=\max_m p_{im}$, product-coupling union $U_i^\perp=1-\prod_m(1-p_{im})$, and premium $Δ_i^\perp=U_i^\perp-R_i$. The marginals alone identify exactly the union interval $[R_i,\min\{1,\sum_m p_{im}\}]$: zero premium is attainable over compatible couplings, not established for an actual deployment. If generation is independent across models, product is the specified protocol's union probability. We audit frozen correctness tensors from 11 open models and 30 archived responses per query--model cell on GSM8K, MATH-500, and GPQA-Diamond. Full-pool display-channel product premiums are 0.371, 3.542, and 5.100 percentage points; the premium intervals from empirical marginals are $[0,0.473]$, $[0,4.787]$, and $[0,7.744]$. Their zero lower endpoints are algebraic. All retained scorers, eight finite-draw paths, and all 2,047 nonempty subpools expose scorer, estimator, and pool sensitivity, not confidence intervals. The GSM8K and GPQA display scorers were developed after limited output inspection. A separate retrospective held-out policy illustration instantiates the policy-specific gap decomposition without establishing new-data generalization. A limited reference-based human check supports scorer agreement only on definite-consensus subsets. Hash-bound evidence supports number checks, not end-to-end reproduction. The contribution is a measurement contract for interpreting oracle gaps conditional on coupling, decision class, scorer, pool, and finite draws, not a population effect or an equal-cost routing gain.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and retitled; supersedes empirical summaries and interpretations in earlier versions. Coupling-aware fixed-archive audit, retrospective policy illustration, and limited reference-based human check. 19 pages, 8 figures. Source and evidence: https://github.com/luka-krixvon/routing-oracle-experiment/tree/main/releases/2026-09-27
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文指出路由基准里“事后 oracle”与“事前单次承诺策略”在随机解码下属于不同决策类别，给出耦合感知的测量契约：在冻结的 query–model–decoder–scorer 协议下，边际成功率只能识别并集区间 [R_i, min{1,Σp_im}]，零 premium 可在相容耦合下达到但不等于部署可得。对 11 个开放模型、每格 30 条存档响应在 GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond 上审计，全池 product premium 分别为 0.371、3.542、5.100 个百分点，而经验边际给出的区间为 [0,0.473]、[0,4.787]、[0,7.744]，其零下端点是代数性的。
Motivation: 路由基准常把“看到全部输出后选对的 hindsight oracle”与“看响应前就锁定单一模型的策略”直接比较，二者在随机解码下并非同一决策类，导致 oracle gap 被误读为可实现的路由收益。
Method: 在冻结的 query–model–decoder–scorer 协议下定义三个量：单次承诺上限 R_i=max_m p_im、独立乘积耦合并集 U_i^⊥=1−∏(1−p_im)、premium Δ_i^⊥=U_i^⊥−R_i；用 11 个开放模型、每 query–model 格 30 条存档响应的冻结正确性张量做审计，覆盖全部保留 scorer、八条有限抽样路径与 2,047 个非空子池，并附一次回顾性留出策略示例与有限的基于参考的人工核查。
Result: 全池 display-channel product premium：GSM8K 0.371、MATH-500 3.542、GPQA-Diamond 5.100 个百分点；由经验边际得到的 premium 区间依次为 [0,0.473]、[0,4.787]、[0,7.744]，零下端点为代数所致。全部保留 scorer、八条有限抽样路径与 2,047 个非空子池均显示 scorer、估计量与池敏感性（非置信区间）；GSM8K 与 GPQA 的 display scorer 在有限输出检视后开发；人工核查仅在 definite-consensus 子集上支持 scorer 一致性。
Conclusion: oracle gap 必须条件于耦合、决策类别、scorer、池与有限抽样来解读，它不是总体效应也不是等成本路由增益；哈希绑定证据只支持数值核对而非端到端复现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: OmniLayout: A Schematic-Coupled Multimodal Benchmark for Constraint-Aware Geometric Reasoning in PCB Layout
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in 3D spatial reasoning, spatial grounding, and fine-grained geometric understanding. However, their ability to reason about densely packed object placement under strict spatial and functional constraints remains largely unexplored, despite being a fundamental challenge in practical electronic design automation (EDA) workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniLayout, the first benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on printed-circuit-board (PCB) layout placement reasoning under real-world geometric, routing, and connectivity constraints. OmniLayout contains 1,681 industrial-grade schematic-coupled PCB layouts and includes four tasks: (1) geometric reasoning for IC physical placement, with 77.24K placement instances constrained within PCB board boundaries; (2) routability-aware placement reasoning, generating physically valid component placements; (3) electrical functionality, preserving schematic-specified connectivity and electronic functional correctness; and (4) tool-augmented agentic reasoning for invoking external tools to accomplish tasks (1)-(3). Our results reveal substantial limitations of current LLMs in PCB layout placement, including weak geometric reasoning, poor routability optimization, and inconsistent preservation of electrical functionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniLayout 是首个面向 PCB 布局摆放推理的多模态基准，用 1,681 个工业级原理图耦合布局在几何、布线、电气功能与工具增强 agent 四类任务上评测 LLM。结果显示当前 LLM 几何推理弱、布线可达性优化差、电气功能保持不一致。
Motivation: LLM 在 3D 空间推理上已有进展，但在严格空间与功能约束下的密集物体摆放推理几乎未被探索，而这正是 EDA 工作流中的基础难题。
Method: 构建 schematic-coupled 多模态基准 OmniLayout，含四项任务：IC 物理摆放的几何推理（77.24K 摆放实例、受 PCB 板边界约束）、布线可达性感知摆放、保持原理图连通性与电气功能正确性、以及调用外部工具完成前三项的 agentic reasoning。
Result: 基准含 1,681 个工业级原理图耦合 PCB 布局，几何推理任务含 77.24K 受板边界约束的摆放实例；评测揭示当前 LLM 几何推理弱、布线可达性优化差、电气功能保持不一致。
Conclusion: 在真实几何、布线与连通约束下，现有 LLM 尚不足以胜任 PCB 布局摆放推理，需要专门基准来暴露这些短板。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Collapse in Asynchronous GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves the throughput of large language model post-training by decoupling rollout generation from policy optimization, but introduces a mismatch between the behavior and learner policies. How the resulting policy staleness couples with the learning rate to govern training stability and collapse time remains poorly understood. We investigate this coupling in vanilla GRPO through controlled sweeps of the synchronization interval $S$ and constant learning rate $η$ on Llama-3.2-1B/3B, complemented by experiments on Qwen3-8B. We identify two empirical scaling laws: (i) Stability-boundary scaling: the largest stable learning rate scales approximately as $S^{-1}$, yielding a stability boundary characterized by an approximately constant product $Sη$. (ii) Collapse-time scaling: among collapsing runs, estimated collapse times scale approximately as $η^{-1}$, corresponding to a model- and setup-dependent cumulative learning-rate budget that aligns across synchronization intervals in the Llama sweeps. We interpret these laws through a local analysis of the behavior-dependent GRPO surrogate and a complementary mean-field model. Under local regularity conditions, the analysis yields an $O(Sη)$ upper bound on the staleness-induced update bias that resets at synchronization. The mean-field model shows how sufficiently strong positive feedback can sustain directional drift when update directions persist across synchronization cycles. When drift speed saturates under optimizer normalization, this mechanism predicts exit from a local surrogate-validity region after an approximately fixed cumulative learning rate. Together, these findings motivate a practical calibration rule: estimate the stability threshold and collapse budget from a coarse sweep, then jointly select $S$ and $η$ for the intended training horizon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在异步 GRPO 后训练中，同步间隔 S 与学习率 η 的耦合决定稳定性与崩溃时间：最大稳定学习率近似按 S^{-1} 缩放，即稳定边界由近似恒定的 Sη 刻画；会崩溃的运行其崩溃时间近似按 η^{-1} 缩放，对应一个跨同步间隔对齐的累计学习率预算。作者据此给出校准规则：先用粗扫估计稳定阈值与崩溃预算，再为训练时长联合选定 S 和 η。
Motivation: 异步强化学习把 rollout 生成与策略优化解耦以提升 LLM 后训练吞吐，但行为策略与学习者策略之间产生 staleness，这种陈旧性如何与学习率共同决定训练稳定性和崩溃时间尚不清楚。
Method: 在 vanilla GRPO 上对同步间隔 S 与恒定学习率 η 做受控扫描，模型为 Llama-3.2-1B/3B，并在 Qwen3-8B 上补充实验；用 behavior-dependent GRPO surrogate 的局部分析与 mean-field 模型解释规律，局部正则条件下给出 O(Sη) 的 staleness 更新偏差上界（同步时重置）。
Result: 两条经验缩放律：(i) 最大稳定学习率近似按 S^{-1} 缩放，稳定边界由近似恒定的乘积 Sη 刻画；(ii) 在崩溃运行中估计的崩溃时间近似按 η^{-1} 缩放，对应依赖模型与设置的累计学习率预算，在 Llama 扫描中跨同步间隔对齐。mean-field 模型显示足够强的正反馈可在更新方向跨同步周期持续时维持方向性漂移；当优化器归一化使漂移速度饱和，预测在近似固定的累计学习率后退出局部 surrogate 有效区。
Conclusion: 异步 GRPO 的稳定性由 Sη 这一乘积而非单独的 S 或 η 控制，崩溃由累计学习率预算触发，因此应先粗扫标定稳定阈值与崩溃预算再联合选 S 和 η。

papers.title: Flow-Map GRPO: Reinforcement Learning for Few-Step Flow-Map Generators via Anchored Stochastic Composition
papers.abstract_en: Few-step flow-map generators, such as consistency models and MeanFlow, accelerate sampling by learning long-range transport maps between noise and data. However, their deterministic transitions do not directly provide the stochastic trajectories and tractable likelihood ratios required by reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. Existing SDE-based stochasticization techniques target velocity-based samplers and do not directly extend to long-range flow-map transitions. We propose Flow-Map GRPO, an online RL post-training framework for deterministic few-step flow-map generators. Its key component, Anchored Stochastic Flow Map Composition (ASFMC), combines deterministic transport with anchor-based conditional resampling. We establish the conditions under which this construction preserves the marginal probability path and develop tractable local- and endpoint-anchor policies for two-time and single-time flow maps. These policies enable a unified GRPO training procedure. Experiments on FLUX-based MeanFlow and sCM generators demonstrate substantial improvements in OCR, PickScore, and GenEval at different numbers of inference steps, including joint OCR--PickScore gains with mixed rewards. Controlled ablations show that the stochastic transition design is essential for translating training rewards into generation quality. Flow-Map GRPO enables effective RL alignment of pretrained deterministic flow-map generators while retaining their original parameterization, without retraining them as native stochastic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flow-Map GRPO 为确定性少步 flow-map 生成器（consistency models、MeanFlow）补上 RL 后训练所需的随机轨迹与可处理似然比：核心组件 Anchored Stochastic Flow Map Composition (ASFMC) 把确定性传输与基于 anchor 的条件重采样组合，并给出保持边缘概率路径的成立条件。在 FLUX 基座的 MeanFlow 与 sCM 上，不同推理步数下 OCR、PickScore、GenEval 均有明显提升，混合奖励下 OCR 与 PickScore 联合提升；受控消融显示随机转移设计是把训练奖励转成生成质量的关键。
Motivation: 少步 flow-map 生成器的确定性转移不提供 RL 后训练所需的随机轨迹与可处理似然比，而现有基于 SDE 的随机化技术面向速度场 (velocity-based) 采样器，无法直接推广到长程 flow-map 转移。
Method: 提出在线 RL 后训练框架 Flow-Map GRPO，核心为 ASFMC：确定性传输加 anchor 条件重采样；推导保持边缘概率路径的条件，并为 two-time 与 single-time flow map 构造可处理的 local-anchor 与 endpoint-anchor 策略，统一进 GRPO 训练，保留预训练模型原参数化、无需重训为原生随机模型。
Result: 在 FLUX 基座的 MeanFlow 与 sCM 生成器上，不同推理步数下 OCR、PickScore、GenEval 均有 substantial 提升，混合奖励下出现 OCR 与 PickScore 的联合增益；受控消融表明随机转移设计对把训练奖励转化为生成质量是必要的。

papers.title: Revisiting the Volume Hypothesis
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep neural networks often contain far more parameters than needed to fit their training data, yet they achieve impressive generalization. A common explanation for this success is the implicit bias of stochastic gradient descent (SGD). An alternative volume hypothesis posits that, within low training-loss regions, loss-landscape basins leading to strong generalization occupy much larger regions of weight space than basins that generalize poorly, and therefore SGD is simply more likely to land in the former. Recent experimental explorations of this idea present seemingly contradictory results. While in one set of experiments randomly sampling the network weights until achieving zero training error yielded poor generalization, molecular dynamics density estimates supported the volume hypothesis. We observe that these experiments were performed at different dataset size regimes, and explore an intermediate regime using the Replica Exchange Wang-Landau algorithm to estimate the joint density of states over training and test accuracies in binary networks. Across several architectures and datasets, we show that the generalization advantage of gradient learning over random sampling training generally diminishes as the training data size grows, suggesting a resolution of the paradox.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Replica Exchange Wang-Landau 算法在二值网络上估计训练与测试准确率的联合态密度 (joint density of states)，发现梯度学习相对随机采样权重的泛化优势随训练数据量增大而普遍减弱，从而调和了此前「随机采样零训练误差泛化差」与「分子动力学态密度支持 volume hypothesis」两组矛盾实验——它们其实处在不同数据规模区间。
Motivation: 过参数化网络为何泛化存在两种解释：SGD 的隐式偏置，或低训练损失区域内好泛化 basin 在权重空间中体积更大 (volume hypothesis)。近期实验结论互相矛盾，作者指出分歧源于所用数据集规模不同，需要一个能跨数据规模刻画泛化的框架。
Method: 在二值网络 (binary networks) 上用 Replica Exchange Wang-Landau 算法估计训练准确率与测试准确率的联合态密度，覆盖多个架构与多个数据集，并考察中间数据规模区间，对比梯度学习与随机采样权重两条路径。
Result: 跨多个架构与数据集，梯度学习相对随机采样训练的泛化优势随训练数据量增长而普遍减弱；该趋势被用来解释此前两组看似矛盾的实验结论。
Conclusion: volume hypothesis 与 SGD 隐式偏置之争在很大程度上是数据规模依赖的：数据量足够大时随机采样与梯度学习的泛化差距收窄，矛盾由此消解。

papers.title: Fusing Complementary Multi-view Features for Screen-Based Eye Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Current multi-view gaze estimation remains limited by existing datasets, insufficient exploitation of complementary cross-view information, and evaluation focused primarily on average gaze error. We address these limitations through a more systematic study of multi-view gaze estimation. First, we introduce PrismGaze, a new dataset with over three million images, capturing continuous headpose variation for the same gaze targets. Second, we propose PrismFusion, a multi-view feature fusion framework based on region partitioning, which masks complementary image regions across views during training to encourage effective cross-view information integration. Third, we develop a broader evaluation framework that examines the effects of camera number and placement, target location,and viewing depth. Our experiments show that the primary benefit of multi-view gaze estimation comes from compensating for poorly observed views with cameras providing more favorable viewpoints. PrismFusion remains robust to changes in viewing depth. Together, our dataset, method, and evaluation provide a more comprehensive foundation for studying multi-view gaze estimation in realistic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PrismGaze 多视图视线估计数据集（超过三百万张图像，覆盖同一注视目标的连续 headpose 变化）与基于区域划分的融合框架 PrismFusion：训练时跨视图遮蔽互补图像区域，迫使模型整合跨视图信息。实验表明多视图的主要收益来自用视角更有利的相机补偿观测差的视图，且 PrismFusion 对 viewing depth 变化保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有数据集受限、跨视图互补信息利用不足，且评估只看平均视线误差，无法说明相机数量与布位、目标位置、观察深度如何影响多视图视线估计。
Method: 三部分：PrismGaze 数据集（超过三百万张图像，同一注视目标下连续 headpose 变化）；PrismFusion 融合框架，按区域划分并在训练中跨视图遮蔽互补区域以促进跨视图信息整合；更广的评估框架，考察相机数量与布位、目标位置、viewing depth 的影响。
Result: 实验显示多视图视线估计的主要收益来自用视角更有利的相机补偿观测不佳的视图；PrismFusion 在 viewing depth 变化下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 数据集、方法与评估共同为真实场景下的多视图视线估计研究提供更完整的基础，多视图增益的关键在于视图间互补而非简单堆叠相机。

papers.title: Mind the Residual Gap: Probabilistic Downscaling under Real-World Bias
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic downscaling models the conditional distribution of high-resolution fields given coarse inputs and is a core challenge in atmospheric science, climate modeling, and other multiscale physical systems. A widely used paradigm decomposes the problem into a deterministic mean predictor followed by a stochastic residual generator. While effective in idealized settings, this mean-residual approach frequently produces biased and underdispersive ensembles in real-world applications. We identify a fundamental source of this failure: residual target misspecification, where the residual distribution induced during training systematically differs from the correction distribution required at test time, a mismatch amplified by downscaling bias. We theoretically connect this misspecification to underdispersion through the spread-skill ratio and show that conditional residual distribution matching controls both residual-energy and conditional-mean mismatch. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce ReMatch (Residual Distribution Matching), which aligns training residual targets toward a held-out calibration regime via optimal transport. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with varying bias levels and a real-world HRRR-ERA5 wind-field downscaling task, ReMatch substantially reduces underdispersion, improves calibration, and outperforms strong mean-residual and super-resolution baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/sdean-group/ReMatch.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 概率降尺度中「确定性均值预测器+随机残差生成器」范式在真实数据上产生有偏且欠离散的集合，根因是训练期残差分布与测试期所需修正分布不一致（residual target misspecification），且被降尺度偏差放大。提出 ReMatch，用最优传输 (optimal transport) 把训练残差目标对齐到留出的校准机制，在合成基准与 HRRR-ERA5 风场降尺度上显著降低欠离散、改善校准并强于均值-残差与超分辨率基线。
Motivation: 均值-残差分解在理想化设置有效，但真实应用中集合有偏且欠离散；训练期诱导的残差分布与测试期需要的修正分布系统性不同，这一错配被降尺度偏差放大，直接影响 spread-skill 比。
Method: 理论上把 residual target misspecification 与欠离散通过 spread-skill ratio 联系起来，证明条件残差分布匹配同时控制残差能量与条件均值失配；据此提出 ReMatch (Residual Distribution Matching)，用最优传输把训练残差目标向留出的校准 regime 对齐。评测含不同偏差水平的受控合成基准与真实 HRRR-ERA5 风场降尺度任务。
Result: 在受控合成基准（不同偏差水平）与真实 HRRR-ERA5 风场降尺度任务上，ReMatch substantially reduces underdispersion、improves calibration，并 outperforms strong mean-residual 与 super-resolution 基线。
Conclusion: 概率降尺度的欠离散可归因于残差目标错配，把训练残差分布对齐到校准 regime 能同时控制残差能量与条件均值失配并改善集合校准；代码已开源。
Relevance: 58
