papers.title: Retrieval Observability Bounds on Provenance Detection for Agent Memory Poisoning: Measured Coverage and a Falsified Standalone Detector
papers.abstract_en: Whether a trajectory-based detector can observe the retrieval provenance of an agent memory-poisoning attack is governed by one architectural variable: retrieval observability, whether the agent's memory access produces a logged tool call. We formalise this as a framework-agnostic retrieval-to-action provenance graph, classify published attack families by their position relative to it, measure the resulting coverage property against collected agent traces, and then falsify the detector's standalone deployment, reversing our own earlier recommendation to use the signature as a pre-filter ahead of recipient-metadata gating. Under exclusive tool-mediated payload access a retrieval-before-exfiltration event is structurally forced. Across eight non-overlapping zero-event control cells we observe 0 violations in 289 eligible successes over 87 scenario configurations. The invariant is empirically unbroken, but on the clustering unit no registered cell certifies the preregistered <=0.10 upper bound (per-cell bounds 0.10-0.35); a post-hoc pool of two control arms nominally clears it but is not credited. When the scaffold delivers the payload implicitly the signature disappears; we had read this as agents declining an available retrieval, but a follow-up shows it tracks store content instead, and that behavioural reading is withdrawn. The detector is then falsified for standalone use. Benign memory-grounded sends are trajectory-isomorphic: false-positive rate 24.7-57.6% on a 13-model factorial (N=4,160), positive predictive value <=3.85% at 1% attack prevalence, and a recipient-metadata gate flags 129/129 legitimate external emails. Retrieval-before-send is an attack precondition, not a maliciousness predicate; its cross-validated AUC also reflects membership of a 22-vector feature codebook, not generalisation. Companion to arXiv:2605.08442; we release the corpus and scoring code.
papers.comment: 71 pages, 3 figures. Companion to arXiv:2605.08442. Retitled; major revision. v3 reverses v2's practical claim: the trajectory signature is not a deployable detector (benign FPR 24.7-57.6%, PPV <=3.85% at 1% prevalence; CV AUC reflects a 22-vector codebook). Withdrawn from v2: the pre-filter recommendation, the frontier-transfer result, and all claims of meeting the preregistered 0.10 bound
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 agent 记忆投毒攻击中“检索先于外发”的轨迹签名形式化为 retrieval-to-action provenance 图，并实测其可观测覆盖，最终证伪该签名作为独立检测器的部署可行性：良性记忆外发与其轨迹同构，FPR 达 24.7–57.6%，1% 攻击流行率下 PPV ≤3.85%。
Motivation: 轨迹签名能否观测到记忆投毒的检索来源，取决于 agent 记忆访问是否产生日志化的 tool call；作者此前推荐把它用作 recipient-metadata gating 的前置过滤器，需要检验这一推荐是否站得住。
Method: 构建框架无关的 retrieval-to-action provenance graph，按攻击家族相对该图的位置分类，在收集的 agent traces 上测量覆盖性质，并用 13 模型析因实验（N=4,160）与交叉验证 AUC 检验检测器的独立部署可行性。
Result: 八个非重叠零事件对照 cell 中，87 个场景配置的 289 次合格成功里观察到 0 次违反；但按聚类单元无任何注册 cell 达到预注册的 ≤0.10 上界（逐 cell 上界 0.10–0.35），事后合并两个对照臂名义上通过但不计入。良性 FPR 24.7–57.6%（13 模型析因，N=4,160），1% 攻击流行率下 PPV ≤3.85%，recipient-metadata gate 标记 129/129 封合法外发邮件；交叉验证 AUC 反映 22-vector 特征码本的成员归属而非泛化。
Conclusion: 检索先于发送是攻击的前置条件而非恶意性判据，该签名不可作为独立检测器部署，作者撤回 v2 的前置过滤推荐与达到 0.10 上界的全部主张。

papers.title: StrucTab: A Structured Optimization Framework for Table Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Table parsing aims to convert table images into structured, machine-readable representations, a task requiring the joint perception of complex spatial layouts and textual content. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) enable end-to-end parsing, they typically rely on direct supervision of the final output, thereby bypassing the explicit intermediate reasoning that is crucial for understanding complex table structures. Furthermore, attempts to optimize these models using reinforcement learning (RL) are often hindered by unstable or ambiguous reward designs, limiting potential performance gains. To address these limitations, we propose StrucTab, a table parsing model learned through intermediate structural supervision and reward decomposition. At the modeling level, by decomposing the parsing process into human-inspired subtasks, such as row-column counting and merged-cell analysis, StrucTab progressively unifies them through a sequential reasoning strategy. At the optimization level, we introduce Uni-TabRL, a unified RL framework that leverages decomposed rewards (validity, structure, and content) to provide stable and informative optimization signals. Finally, at the evaluation level, we present TableVerse-5K, a large-scale, challenging benchmark encompassing diverse, real-world table scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of StrucTab across all evaluated public benchmarks and significant improvements on TableVerse-5K, validating the effectiveness of explicit structural modeling and decomposed reward optimization. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/VirtualLUOUCAS/StrucTab.

papers.title: Affix Cache for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) enable non-autoregressive decoding, but efficient inference support remains immature: unlike autoregressive models, whose requests reuse a shared prefix key-value (KV) cache, DLLMs use bidirectional attention, so a shared context's KV states depend on the tokens still being decoded, leaving directly reused caches stale and full recomputation necessary. We present ACache, a cross-request cache reuse mechanism for shared spans, or affixes, at any position: prefix, infix, or suffix. ACache measures the influence of affix tokens on the masked generation region to identify a small request-specific subset as Anchor Tokens, and recomputes only their KV states while reusing the remaining affix cache. Built on state-of-the-art intra-request caching mechanisms, ACache recovers most of the accuracy lost to direct affix-cache reuse on average when recomputing around 20% of affix tokens, and at that budget preserves more accuracy than selection criteria adapted from prior cross-request cache-reuse systems. We co-design ACache with a modern inference engine, whose attention reads each request's recomputed Anchor KV states alongside one affix cache shared across concurrent requests. Against the same system with only intra-request caching, ACache cuts recompute latency by up to 56.7%, translating to as much as 1.71$\times$ end-to-end throughput, while reducing peak KV cache memory by up to 45.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACache 让 Diffusion LLM 在跨请求复用任意位置的共享片段 (affix) KV 缓存时只重算约 20% 的 affix token：按 affix token 对被掩码生成区域的影响力挑出 Anchor Tokens，其余直接复用。与仅含 intra-request 缓存的同一系统相比，重算延迟最多降 56.7%，端到端吞吐最高 1.71×，峰值 KV 缓存内存最多降 45.8%。
Motivation: DLLM 用双向注意力做非自回归解码，共享上下文的 KV 状态依赖仍在解码的 token，直接复用缓存会失效，只能全量重算，跨请求缓存复用因此缺失。
Method: ACache 支持 prefix、infix、suffix 任意位置的共享 affix 跨请求复用：度量 affix token 对掩码生成区域的影响力，选出请求特有的 Anchor Tokens 只重算其 KV，其余复用；建立在 SOTA 的 intra-request 缓存机制之上，并与推理引擎协同设计，注意力同时读各请求重算的 Anchor KV 与跨并发请求共享的一份 affix 缓存。
Result: 平均只需重算约 20% 的 affix token 即可恢复直接复用 affix 缓存所损失的大部分精度，且在该预算下精度高于从既有跨请求缓存复用系统改造的选择准则；相对仅有 intra-request 缓存的同一系统，重算延迟最多降 56.7%，端到端吞吐最高提升 1.71×，峰值 KV 缓存内存最多降 45.8%。
Conclusion: 跨请求 affix 缓存复用在 DLLM 上可行，前提是按影响力只重算少数 Anchor token 而非全量重算，且这一选择准则比沿用自回归系统的准则更保精度。

papers.title: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial gains in language-model reasoning. However, models fine-tuned with RLVR need not remain compatible with weaker partners: gains achieved alone may erode under collaboration, while policy drift may place reasoning beyond a weaker model's predictive reach. To address both problems, we introduce Tandem RLVR (TRLVR), bringing the recently proposed tandem-training paradigm beyond proof-of-concept settings and into modern RLVR. In TRLVR, a senior learns from rewarded trajectories co-generated with a frozen junior, while the standard GRPO objective is applied only to senior-emitted tokens. Training Qwen3-4B-Instruct on competition math, TRLVR performs on par with a matched GRPO senior when reasoning alone. We characterize compatibility through the complementary lenses of handoff robustness and junior legibility. Under reasoning-step handoffs, the TRLVR senior retains nearly all of its solo performance with the junior, reducing the communication tax to a negligible loss. The senior's reasoning is also more legible to the junior: its token distribution stays more closely anchored to the junior's, and the junior predicts the senior's chain-of-thought more readily token by token. An ablation that explicitly regularizes GRPO toward the junior does not recover the same combination of capability and compatibility. These results provide initial evidence that tandem rollout structure is a promising direction for keeping RLVR reasoning gains accessible to weaker partners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tandem RLVR (TRLVR)：senior 与冻结的 junior 共同生成轨迹并从中学习，GRPO 目标只作用于 senior 发出的 token。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 竞赛数学训练上，TRLVR 单独推理时与同规模 GRPO senior 持平，同时在推理步交接 (handoff) 中几乎保留全部单独性能、通信开销降到可忽略，且 junior 更容易逐 token 预测其思维链。
Motivation: RLVR 提升了语言模型推理能力，但单独训练后的模型可能与更弱的伙伴不再兼容：独自获得的收益在协作中会流失，策略漂移也会让推理超出弱模型的可预测范围。
Method: 沿用 tandem-training 范式：senior 与冻结的 junior 共同生成被奖励的轨迹，标准 GRPO 目标只施加在 senior 发出的 token 上；用 handoff robustness 与 junior legibility 两个互补视角刻画兼容性，并与显式把 GRPO 向 junior 正则化的消融对比。
Result: 在竞赛数学上训练 Qwen3-4B-Instruct，TRLVR 单独推理表现与匹配的 GRPO senior 持平；推理步交接下 senior 几乎保留全部单独性能，通信开销降为可忽略的损失；其 token 分布更贴近 junior，junior 逐 token 预测其 CoT 更容易；显式正则化 GRPO 向 junior 的消融无法同时复现能力与兼容性。
Conclusion: tandem rollout 结构是让 RLVR 推理收益保持对弱伙伴可用的有前景方向，且仅靠对 junior 的正则化不足以同时获得能力与兼容性。

papers.title: JuZhou 1.0 Technical Report: The First Edge-Native Text-to-Image Foundation Model Trained Entirely on China-Developed AI Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models typically require substantial computational resources and cloud infrastructure, posing significant challenges for edge deployment in terms of latency, cost, and user privacy. We present JuZhou 1.0, an ultra-lightweight T2I foundation model designed for fully offline, on-device execution. JuZhou 1.0 achieves its efficiency through four key designs: (1) a compact image-generation backbone consisting of a 0.385B-parameter denoising U-Net and a 1.90M-parameter distilled decoder, totaling approximately 0.387B parameters; (2) Rectified Flow training combined with DMD2 distillation, reducing inference to 4 sampling steps; (3) Chinese semantic alignment trained on 9M curated image-text pairs, enabling direct Chinese prompting without external translation at inference time; and (4) a training and distillation pipeline completed on domestically developed Sugon K100 AI accelerators without relying on NVIDIA GPUs for training or distillation. Despite its compact scale, the 28-step base model of JuZhou 1.0 achieves an overall GenEval score of 0.69, outperforming published baselines including SDXL (2.6B, 0.55), SD3-Medium (2B, 0.62), and IF-XL (4.3B, 0.61). We further validate the full poetry-to-image pipeline on Android and the core CLIP-U-Net-VAE generation branch on iOS. On a smartphone powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform, the 4-step U-Net denoising branch runs in approximately 1.6 seconds, while the full Android poetry-to-image pipeline takes 4.5 seconds with on-device prompt refinement on Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. These results position JuZhou 1.0 as a practical approach to mobile text-to-image generation and provide a concrete reference for Chinese-native generation, domestic-compute training, and fully offline on-device deployment after one-time installation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JuZhou 1.0 是一个完全在国产加速器（Sugon K100）上训练、可全离线端侧运行的超轻量文生图基础模型：0.385B 去噪 U-Net 加 1.90M 蒸馏解码器共约 0.387B 参数，Rectified Flow 训练配合 DMD2 蒸馏把推理压到 4 步。28 步基座 GenEval 0.69，超过 SDXL 0.55、SD3-Medium 0.62、IF-XL 0.61；骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5 上 4 步去噪约 1.6 秒，Android 全流程 4.5 秒。
Motivation: T2I diffusion 依赖大规模算力与云设施，端侧部署在延迟、成本与用户隐私上都受限，且国产 AI 加速器上缺少可用的生成模型训练范例。
Method: 四项设计：0.385B 参数去噪 U-Net 加 1.90M 蒸馏 decoder；Rectified Flow 训练加 DMD2 蒸馏实现 4 步采样；用 900 万精选图文对做中文语义对齐，推理时无需外部翻译即可直接中文提示；训练与蒸馏全程在国产 Sugon K100 加速器上完成，不依赖 NVIDIA GPU。
Result: 28 步基座 GenEval 总分 0.69，对比 SDXL（2.6B，0.55）、SD3-Medium（2B，0.62）、IF-XL（4.3B，0.61）；在 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 手机上 4 步 U-Net 去噪约 1.6 秒，Xiaomi 17 Pro Max 上含端侧提示改写的 Android 全诗歌生图流程 4.5 秒；已在 Android 验证全流程、iOS 验证 CLIP-U-Net-VAE 生成分支。
Conclusion: 约 0.387B 参数加 4 步蒸馏采样足以支撑手机上完全离线的中文文生图，且整条训练链可在国产 AI 加速器上跑通，为中文原生生成与国产算力训练提供可复现参考。

papers.title: Extracting Neural Materials from Images
papers.abstract_en: Neural materials can represent complex specular reflections and scattering effects in a compact, universal basis. However, acquiring and authoring such materials remains challenging. We present NeuMatEx, a differentiable inverse rendering method for extracting spatially varying neural materials from images. The nonlinear structure of neural material latent spaces makes optimization with naive inverse rendering infeasible. To address this, we train a Large Material Reconstruction Model (LMRM) that directly predicts initial base color, neural material latents, and aleatoric uncertainty guides from images. This material prior provides a good initialization and better constrains our subsequent optimization using inverse path tracing. The predicted uncertainty further helps by anchoring high-confidence regions more tightly to the LMRM prediction, preventing lighting and complex specular effects from being baked into materials. Experiments on synthetic and real assets show that NeuMatEx extracts complex materials with better visual quality and material decomposition than PBR-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuMatEx 用可微逆渲染从图像中提取空间变化的神经材质 (neural materials)，先训一个 Large Material Reconstruction Model (LMRM) 直接预测 base color、神经材质 latent 与 aleatoric 不确定度作为初始化，再用 inverse path tracing 优化，并用不确定度把高置信区域锚定在预测附近，防止光照与复杂高光被烘进材质。合成与真实资产上其视觉质量与材质分解优于 PBR 方法。
Motivation: 神经材质能紧凑表达复杂高光与散射，但获取和创作困难；神经材质 latent 空间的非线性使朴素逆渲染优化不可行。
Method: 训练 LMRM 从图像直接预测初始 base color、神经材质 latent 和 aleatoric 不确定度图，作为材质先验初始化；随后用 inverse path tracing 做可微逆渲染优化，不确定度高的区域被更强地约束在 LMRM 预测上。
Result: 在合成与真实资产上，NeuMatEx 提取的复杂材质在视觉质量与材质分解上优于基于 PBR 的方法。
Conclusion: 神经材质先验加不确定度引导的逆渲染优化，能绕开 latent 空间非线性导致的优化不可行问题，得到比 PBR 更好的材质重建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EpiKV: Epiphany-Aware KV Cache Eviction Without the Attention Matrix
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models can generate chains of thought tens of thousands of tokens long, making the key--value (KV) cache that holds them a major bottleneck for inference throughput. Existing eviction policies for long reasoning traces typically rank cached tokens using attention weights, requiring access to the attention matrix and making them incompatible with fast inference kernels. In this work we study the limits of such policies under tight cache budgets. Surprisingly, we find that under the strongest of them the generations that finish are wrong about as often as without eviction; most of the accuracy loss comes from generations that enter loops and run until the length limit, and retaining more tokens according to a fixed importance score exacerbates this behavior. What stops the looping is keeping the tokens the model's recent queries point to, and the forward pass the model already runs reveals them without the attention matrix. Motivated by this observation, we introduce epiphany-aware KV cache eviction EpiKV, which combines hidden-state shifts with the model's recent query--key relevance to rank cached tokens without materializing the attention matrix. On multiple benchmarks, EpiKV matches or outperforms the strongest attention-based eviction baselines while running directly in vLLM with unmodified attention kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpiKV 用隐状态偏移 (hidden-state shifts) 加模型近期 query-key 相关性给 KV cache 中的 token 排序，无需物化 attention matrix 即可做驱逐。作者发现强 attention 驱逐策略下生成出错多半因为进入循环跑到长度上限，而保住近期 query 指向的 token 才能终止循环；EpiKV 在多个 benchmark 上匹配或超过最强 attention 基线，并可直接跑在 vLLM 的未改动 kernel 上。
Motivation: 长推理链的 KV cache 是推理吞吐瓶颈，而现有驱逐策略依赖 attention matrix、与快速推理 kernel 不兼容；在紧 cache 预算下它们的精度损失主要来自循环到长度上限的生成。
Method: EpiKV 结合隐状态偏移与模型近期 query-key 相关性对缓存 token 排序，避免物化 attention matrix；直接在 vLLM 中以未修改的 attention kernel 运行。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上，EpiKV 匹配或优于最强的 attention-based 驱逐基线；观察到最强基线下完成的生成出错频率与不驱逐时相当，精度损失主要来自进入循环并跑到长度上限的生成，按固定重要性分数保留更多 token 会加剧该行为。
Conclusion: 驱逐的关键是保留模型近期 query 指向的 token，而前向过程本身已暴露这些信息，因此无需 attention matrix 也能在紧 cache 预算下做到不掉精度且兼容快速 kernel。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: GeoFidelity-Bench: Evaluating Block-Conditioned Geographic Fidelity in Text-to-Image Street-View Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models can generate plausible street scenes from prompts such as "a street in New York City," but it remains unclear whether these images resemble the requested place or show a generic city appearance. Commonly used evaluation metrics mainly measure image quality or text alignment and do not directly assess geographic fidelity. We introduce GeoFidelity-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating whether generated street-view images match a target location at the level of named street blocks. The benchmark contains 112 street blocks from 25 cities across six continents, each paired with a panel of real Mapillary images and geographic metadata. From this metadata we build prompts with the city only, with street and neighborhood names, and with these names plus raw GPS coordinates. Across six open-weight text-to-image models, street and neighborhood names improve similarity to the target location, while raw GPS coordinates add only a small and uneven gain. Control prompts that swap in the names of other blocks while keeping the city fixed reduce retrieval accuracy, with larger decreases when the neighborhood name or both names are replaced. Generated images also distinguish their target blocks from local alternatives less reliably than held-out real images. CLIP alignment between generated images and their prompts is nearly uninformative about whether the images achieve block-level geographic fidelity. GeoFidelity-Bench provides a controlled testbed for studying location-conditioned generation and for measuring progress beyond generic city-level plausibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoFidelity-Bench 在 25 座城市 112 个街道街区上检验文生图模型能否生成目标街区而非泛化城市街景：加入街道与街区 (neighborhood) 名称能提升与目标地点的相似度，而再加原始 GPS 坐标只有小且不稳定的增益；换掉街区名会拉低检索准确率，且 CLIP 与 prompt 的对齐度几乎无法反映街区级地理保真度。
Motivation: 现有文生图评测只测画质或文本对齐，无法判断生成街景是否真的像被指定的地点，更细到命名街区一级的地理保真度没有受控测试手段。
Method: 构建含 112 个街道街区、横跨六大洲 25 座城市的基准，每个街区配一组真实 Mapillary 图像与地理元数据；由元数据生成三档 prompt（仅城市、加街道与街区名、再加原始 GPS 坐标），并设置固定城市、替换街区名的对照 prompt，在六个开源权重文生图模型上比较检索准确率。
Result: 在六个开源权重模型上，街道与街区名提升与目标地点的相似度，原始 GPS 坐标只带来小且不均匀的增益；替换街区名（尤其替换街区名或两个名字都换）使检索准确率下降更多；生成图像区分目标街区与本地备选的能力弱于留出的真实图像；生成图像与其 prompt 的 CLIP 对齐度对是否达到街区级地理保真度几乎无信息量。
Conclusion: 街区级地理保真度要靠受控的检索式评测来测，靠 CLIP 文本对齐分数和加 GPS 坐标都不可靠。

papers.title: PHOEBI: An Open-World Benchmark for Bacterial Identification in Phase-Contrast Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Optical microscopy (OM) enables rapid, label-free imaging of live bacteria and is the standard instrument for species identification across clinical, environmental, and industrial microbiology. Real samples, however, are routinely polymicrobial and may contain organisms never seen during training, and no computer-vision benchmark evaluates multi-label species identification from phase-contrast microscopy (PCM) of such mixtures. We introduce Phase-contrast Optical bEnchmark for Bacterial Identification ($\textbf{PHOEBI}$), a wet-lab-prepared dataset of $120{,}000$ PCM images covering $40$ combinations of six rod-shaped species, together with a leave-combinations-out (LCO) protocol that holds out entire species combinations, mirroring a model trained on catalogued mixtures that must recognise new ones. Under LCO, gradient-trained per-image classifiers, from fine-tuned backbones to attention-based multiple-instance learning, collapse on unseen combinations despite high in-distribution accuracy, and the failure lies in how per-image predictions are aggregated rather than in the visual representation. We propose three lightweight $\textbf{anchor-based}$ decoders that read each species' presence against fixed geometric prototypes over a shared frozen tile-feature pool, and they remain stable under the same shift. Without additional training, the same features also support open-set rejection of unseen species and the discovery of a new class from unlabeled test images, with negligible disruption to the known classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHOEBI 是首个针对相差显微镜 (PCM) 混合菌样本的多标签菌种识别开放世界基准：12 万张湿实验图像覆盖 6 种杆状菌的 40 种组合，并用 leave-combinations-out (LCO) 协议整组留出组合。在 LCO 下，梯度训练的逐图分类器（微调 backbone 到 attention-based multiple-instance learning）尽管分布内精度高仍全面崩溃，失败出在逐图预测的聚合方式而非视觉表征；三种基于固定几何原型的 anchor-based 解码器在同一分布偏移下保持稳定，并在不额外训练的前提下支持未见菌种的开放集拒识与新类发现。
Motivation: 真实样本常是多菌种混合且可能含训练时从未见过的生物体，但此前没有任何计算机视觉基准评测相差显微镜混合样本上的多标签菌种识别，更无法刻画模型面对全新物种组合时的失效。
Method: 湿实验制备 PHOEBI 数据集：120,000 张 PCM 图像、6 种杆状菌的 40 种组合，配 leave-combinations-out 协议整组留出物种组合。对比对象为梯度训练的逐图分类器（微调 backbone 与 attention-based multiple-instance learning）；所提三种轻量 anchor-based 解码器在共享的冻结 tile-feature 池上，用每个物种的固定几何原型读出其存在与否。
Result: LCO 下逐图分类器在未见组合上崩溃，尽管分布内精度很高，且失效定位在逐图预测的聚合环节而非视觉表征；三种 anchor-based 解码器在同一偏移下保持稳定。同一特征无需额外训练即可支持未见物种的开放集拒识，并从无标签测试图像中发现新类，对已知类的干扰可忽略。
Conclusion: 多标签混合菌识别的开放世界失效源于预测聚合而非表征，因此把逐图打分换成对固定原型的存在性读出，可在不重训的条件下同时保住已知类、拒识未见菌种并发现新类。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Only Ask What You Don't Know: Grounded Delta Planning for Efficient Multi-step RAG
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop question answering remains challenging for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) because existing approaches either propagate errors across iterative retrieval rounds or over-generate reasoning steps, increasing cost without improving accuracy. We propose Grounded Delta Planning RAG (GDP-RAG), a plan-based framework that targets only the information delta based on three simple design choices: (1) preliminary retrieval to ground planning before execution, (2) a gap-conditioned planning prompt that asks only for missing information, and (3) a skeletal trajectory that pairs each subquery with a Thought capturing evidence from preliminary retrieval and carrying it through to the final answer. GDP-RAG focuses computation on unresolved gaps, yielding concise, reliable reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue show that GDP-RAG achieves the highest accuracy (60.63%) among all compared systems while maintaining a cost-of-pass of 0.51, 22% lower than PAR-RAG (0.65) and 68% lower than KnowTrace (1.57), with no method achieving both higher accuracy and lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GDP-RAG：先做一轮 preliminary retrieval 把规划锚定在证据上，再用 gap-conditioned prompt 只问缺失信息，并用 skeletal trajectory 把每个子问题的 Thought 沿证据带到最终答案。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 上以 60.63% 的准确率居首，同时 cost-of-pass 0.51，比 PAR-RAG 低 22%、比 KnowTrace 低 68%，没有方法同时更准更省。
Motivation: 多跳问答里现有 RAG 要么在多轮迭代检索中传播误差，要么过度生成推理步骤，成本上升却不提升准确率。
Method: GDP-RAG 是 plan-based 框架，只针对信息 delta：先 preliminary retrieval 为规划提供 grounding，再用 gap-conditioned planning prompt 只索取缺失信息，skeletal trajectory 把每个子查询与携带初步检索证据的 Thought 配对并传递到最终答案。
Result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 上准确率 60.63%，为所有对比系统最高；cost-of-pass 0.51，较 PAR-RAG 的 0.65 低 22%，较 KnowTrace 的 1.57 低 68%；没有任何方法同时取得更高准确率与更低成本。
Conclusion: 把计算集中在未解决的信息缺口上，就能在多跳 RAG 中同时拿到更高准确率与更低成本，而非在两者间取舍。

papers.title: SSD: Spatially Speculative Decoding Accelerates Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive image models treat images as 1D token sequences, inheriting the next-token factorization of language models. This flattening discards a useful property of images: visual tokens are organized and correlated in two-dimensional space. We introduce Spatially Speculative Decoding (SSD), an inference-time decoding framework that exploits this spatial structure for accelerated generation. Rather than speculating only along the flattened sequence, SSD predicts both the adjacent horizontal token and the token directly below it, allowing multiple spatial directions to advance in parallel. This reduces the number of backbone forward evaluations and alleviates the memory bottleneck of autoregressive decoding. SSD accelerates image generation by up to 11.03x in wall-clock time while maintaining generation quality on DPG-Bench and GenEval. These results show that spatial structure provides a simple and effective source of parallelism for faster autoregressive image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSD 把自回归图像生成的一维 token 序列还原成二维空间结构，同时推测相邻水平 token 与其正下方 token，让多个空间方向并行推进，从而减少 backbone 前向次数并缓解解码显存瓶颈。在 DPG-Bench 与 GenEval 上保持生成质量的同时，wall-clock 时间最高加速 11.03 倍。
Motivation: 自回归图像模型沿用语言模型的 next-token 分解，把图像拉平成一维序列，丢掉了视觉 token 天然的二维组织与相关性，解码只能串行推进，前向次数与显存开销都高。
Method: 提出推理时解码框架 Spatially Speculative Decoding (SSD)：在沿拉平序列推测之外，同时预测相邻水平 token 与正下方 token，使多个空间方向并行前进，减少 backbone 前向评估次数。
Result: 生成质量在 DPG-Bench 与 GenEval 上保持不变，wall-clock 时间最高加速 11.03 倍。
Conclusion: 图像的二维空间结构本身就是自回归解码可用的并行来源，无需改动模型质量即可显著提速。

papers.title: CRAX: Fast Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Safety is a core concern for deploying reinforcement learning (RL) agents in real-world domains such as robotics and autonomous driving. While benchmarks have been central to progress in RL, existing 3D physics-based safety benchmarks remain computationally slow, limiting large-scale experimentation and rapid prototyping. To address this gap, we propose CRAX (Constrained RL Accelerated with JAX). Built on top of the MuJoCo XLA (MJX) physics engine, CRAX leverages vectorized operations and hardware acceleration, yielding up to 200x faster training over comparable CPU-based safety benchmarks. The benchmark features eight tasks spanning three difficulty levels and multiple agent morphologies. Evaluating seven popular safe RL methods, we find that none dominates across tasks, and that learning safe policies from pixels remains largely unsolved.

papers.title: DiffMath: Symbol- and Graph-Aware Latent Diffusion Transformer for Handwritten Mathematical Expression Generation
papers.abstract_en: Handwritten Mathematical Expression Generation (HMEG) is challenging due to the complex two-dimensional layouts and long-range structural dependencies of mathematical expressions. Existing methods typically rely on explicit spatial supervision, such as symbol-level bounding boxes, which incurs high annotation costs and limits scalability. In this work, we propose DiffMath, a symbol- and graph-aware latent diffusion framework that leverages the hierarchical structure inherent in LaTeX as a structural prior, eliminating the need for positional supervision. First, we design a Relational Abstract Syntax Tree (RelAST), a generation-oriented representation that distills MathML trees into compact triplet sequences [S, R, D], where each token directly encodes a symbol identity, spatial relation, or nesting depth. Second, we introduce MathVAE, which learns structure-preserving latent representations through symbol-aware and relation-aware perceptual regularization, ensuring that the latent space captures both character semantics and spatial topology. Third, MathDiT performs conditional denoising in this structured latent space, further guided by a global symbol-count prior via Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) to improve structural coherence. Experiments show that DiffMath produces structurally consistent handwritten expressions, achieves superior performance over existing methods, and improves the accuracy of downstream OCR models through synthetic data augmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffMath 用 LaTeX 层级结构作结构先验，摆脱符号级 bbox 的显式空间监督，做手写数学表达式生成 (HMEG)：RelAST 把 MathML 树压成 [S, R, D] 三元组序列，MathVAE 学结构保持的 latent，MathDiT 在该 latent 空间做条件去噪并用全局符号计数先验经 AdaLN 引导。生成结果结构一致、性能优于现有方法，并能以合成数据增强提升下游 OCR 精度。
Motivation: 手写数学表达式二维布局复杂、长程结构依赖强，现有方法依赖符号级 bbox 等显式空间监督，标注成本高、难以扩展。
Method: 三组件：Relational Abstract Syntax Tree (RelAST) 将 MathML 树蒸馏为紧凑三元组序列 [S, R, D]，每个 token 直接编码符号身份、空间关系或嵌套深度；MathVAE 通过 symbol-aware 与 relation-aware 感知正则学习结构保持的 latent 表示；MathDiT 在该结构化 latent 空间做条件去噪，由全局符号计数先验经 Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) 引导。
Result: 实验显示 DiffMath 生成结构一致的手写表达式，性能优于现有方法，并通过合成数据增强提升下游 OCR 模型精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 以 LaTeX 层级结构和关系化 AST 替代显式空间监督，足以支撑结构一致的手写数学表达式生成，并可作为下游 OCR 的合成数据来源。

papers.title: OneCanvas: 3D Scene Understanding via Panoramic Reprojection
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to 3D scene understanding in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) either rely on complex, model-specific geometry encoders or large training budgets in pursuit of spatial reasoning. Instead, OneCanvas aggregates patch features from all views onto a single equirectangular panoramic canvas. Namely, each patch is unprojected to a 3D world coordinate using its depth and camera pose, then placed on the canvas at the continuous longitude and latitude of that point as seen from the canvas origin, with no rasterization or aggregation across overlapping views. A 3D position embedding of the patch's metric coordinates is added to its feature, restoring the depth lost when collapsing the world position to an angular canvas coordinate. Patches from all frames thus share one spatial coordinate system with no fusion or major architectural modifications of the backbone. The pretrained VLM consumes this representation as if it were an ordinary image. Because the canvas can be centered on any pose of interest, the same representation directly supports situated reasoning from a specific viewpoint, a common requirement in robotics and embodied AI. Thanks to this representation, we can also introduce a spatial pretraining curriculum: by procedurally placing patch features of objects, drawn from real images, at chosen 3D world positions on an otherwise empty canvas, we generate on-the-fly supervision spanning a broad range of spatial reasoning tasks, with answer distributions controlled to reduce spatial reasoning shortcuts. OneCanvas achieves state-of-the-art results on SQA3D and VSI-Bench and generalizes to out-of-distribution data on SPBench, using an order of magnitude less training compute than its competitors closest in benchmark performance.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). Project page: https://baranowskibrt.github.io/onecanvas/ Code and model: https://github.com/baranowskibrt/onecanvas
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneCanvas 把多视角 patch 特征按深度与相机位姿反投影到单一等距柱状全景画布的经纬度上，不栅格化、不跨视角聚合，再叠加度量坐标的 3D 位置嵌入，让预训练 VLM 像读普通图像一样做 3D 场景理解。在 SQA3D 与 VSI-Bench 上取得 SOTA，并在 SPBench 上泛化到分布外数据，训练算力比性能最接近的竞品低一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 的 3D 场景理解要么依赖复杂的专用几何编码器，要么靠巨额训练预算换取空间推理能力。
Method: 每个 patch 用深度与相机位姿反投影到 3D 世界坐标，再按其相对画布原点的连续经纬度落到等距柱状画布上，不做栅格化也不跨重叠视角聚合；在特征上加 3D 度量坐标位置嵌入以补回被压平的深度。画布可居中于任意感兴趣位姿以支持 situated reasoning，并配套空间预训练课程：把真实图像的物体 patch 程序化放到空画布的指定 3D 位置，按可控答案分布生成在线监督。
Result: 在 SQA3D 与 VSI-Bench 上达到 state-of-the-art，并在分布外的 SPBench 上保持泛化；相对性能最接近的竞品，训练算力少一个数量级 (an order of magnitude less training compute)。
Conclusion: 统一坐标系的全景重投影表示足以让预训练 VLM 做到需要专用几何编码器或大算力的空间推理，且该表示可直接复用骨干网络、无需主要架构改动。

papers.title: Making AI Scientists Auditable from Evidence to Claim
papers.abstract_en: AI research systems can report improved results without establishing that the tested implementation matches the method described in their conclusions. We introduce Xcientist, a research harness that connects literature review, component-based idea generation, experiment validation and reporting. An evidence graph retains source passages, methods, baselines and evaluation conditions; component records track design revisions; and validation contracts specify the implementation, comparisons and artifacts required at each stage. We define claim drift as an unresolved mismatch between an accepted claim and its attributed sources, code or experiments. A retrospective audit across agent memory, traffic forecasting and physics-informed learning found audit claim drift rates of 3.6--16.7\% for Xcientist, lower than those of each of three comparison systems in all nine task-by-relation comparisons. This measure includes both confirmed mismatches and unverifiable claims; most of the difference arose from fewer unverifiable records. The case studies also document performance gains, unsuccessful revisions and limits on component attribution. This technical report describes the system, its implementation and the records needed to check how a proposed idea became a tested method and a final claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出研究 harness Xcientist，用 evidence graph 保留文献原文、方法、基线与评测条件，用 validation contracts 约束每个阶段必须交付的实现、对比与产物，并把 claim drift 定义为已接受结论与其来源、代码或实验之间的未消解不一致。在 agent memory、traffic forecasting、physics-informed learning 三个领域的回顾性审计中，Xcientist 的 claim drift 率为 3.6–16.7%，在全部九项“任务×关系”比较中都低于三个对比系统，差异主要来自更少的不可核实记录。
Motivation: AI 研究系统可能报告性能提升，却无法证明被测实现与其结论中描述的方法一致；现有系统缺少可追溯的证据与审计机制来定位这种结论漂移。
Method: Xcientist 串联文献综述、基于组件的 idea 生成、实验验证与报告；evidence graph 保存来源段落、方法、基线与评测条件，component records 追踪设计修订，validation contracts 规定各阶段所需的实现、对比与产物；在此之上定义并审计 claim drift。
Result: 回顾性审计覆盖 agent memory、traffic forecasting、physics-informed learning 三个领域：Xcientist 的审计 claim drift 率为 3.6–16.7%，在全部九项任务×关系比较中均低于三个对比系统；差异主要由更少的 unverifiable 记录构成（该指标同时包含已确认不一致与不可核实的声明）。案例研究还记录了性能提升、失败的修订以及组件归因上的限制。
Conclusion: 把证据、组件修订与阶段验证契约固化为可审计记录，可以压低 AI 研究系统结论与其来源、代码、实验之间的 claim drift，且收益主要来自减少不可核实的声明。

papers.title: When to Commit and When to Defer: Maturing Markov Decision Processes under Refining Information and Expiring Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Sequential decisions often become better informed as action opportunities expire. We introduce Maturing Markov Decision Processes (MMDPs), a structured subclass of augmented finite-horizon Markov decision processes, for organizing when to commit and when to defer. The Expiring-Actions-First Principle provides a sufficient condition for deferral based on information gain and delay loss. This structure motivates stage-local policies, action abstraction, and policy-guided planning. Replenishment experiments show improved learning and test performance under the MMDP interface and, in the primary setting, a larger test-performance gain from forecast refinement. In synthetic cash management, MMDP improves PPO test returns across both network sizes; five-account equal-size mask controls show that action count alone does not explain its learned gain, and the advantage persists with action abstraction and policy-guided search. A production-scale cash-management case study adds complementary evidence. Together, these results support commitment timing as a useful inductive bias for learning and planning.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 5 figures. Substantially revised formulation, theoretical analysis, and experiments; expanded appendices. Research code: https://github.com/scujx/mmdp (v1.0.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出成熟马尔可夫决策过程 (MMDP)，把「信息还在细化、行动机会在到期」的序贯决策形式化为可承诺或可推迟的结构，并给出 Expiring-Actions-First Principle：基于信息增益与延迟损失给出推迟的充分条件。在补货实验与合成现金管理中，MMDP 接口提升 PPO 测试回报，且主要设定下预报细化 (forecast refinement) 带来的测试性能增益更大。
Motivation: 序贯决策中行动机会会随时间到期，而信息仍在细化，标准有限时域 MDP 缺少区分「何时承诺、何时推迟」的结构，学习与规划难以利用这一时机偏置。
Method: 将 MMDP 定义为增广有限时域 MDP 的结构化子类，提出基于信息增益与延迟损失的 Expiring-Actions-First Principle 推迟充分条件；据此设计 stage-local 策略、动作抽象 (action abstraction) 与策略引导规划 (policy-guided planning)，在补货实验与合成现金管理中用 PPO 训练并做五账户等尺寸掩码对照。
Result: 补货实验显示 MMDP 接口下学习与测试性能提升，且主要设定中测试性能增益更多来自预报细化；合成现金管理中 MMDP 在两种网络规模上均提高 PPO 测试回报，五账户等尺寸掩码对照表明动作数量本身不能解释该增益，优势在动作抽象与策略引导搜索下仍保持；另有生产规模现金管理案例研究提供补充证据。
Conclusion: 承诺时机 (commitment timing) 可作为学习与规划的有效归纳偏置，MMDP 结构在补货与现金管理设定下带来可复现的测试性能增益。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: When Does Depth Matter For In-Context Learning? Adaptive Inference in Deep Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers perform computations through many successive attention and feedforward blocks, allowing them to learn complex correlations between a large collection of coupled variables. When does stacking successive attention-feedforward computations over many layers provide a computational advantage over a single transformer block? We address this question by examining in-context learning in generalized linear attention transformers. We first introduce a general theory of distributed inference in such transformers, subject to constraints on communication and depth. We show that such systems can exploit internal representations (`function vectors') to infer a latent context variable at increasingly finer scales over its layers. For an in-context linear regression task, the theory predicts that while one-layer transformers without feedforward blocks are optimal for Gaussian priors over the context variable, multi-layer transformers are superior for non-Gaussian, tree-like priors. Trained linear attention transformers reproduce quantitative predictions from the theory. Using causal key-patching experiments, we verify that function vectors in intermediate layers mediate adaptive routing of information. Our results suggest that depth and feedforward blocks enable transformers to implement adaptive inference, and this is advantageous when the distribution over latent variables has hierarchical structure.

TL;DR: 论文问的是堆叠多层 attention-feedforward 何时比单层更有计算优势：在广义线性注意力 Transformer 上给出受通信与深度约束的分布式推理理论，预测高斯先验下单层无 FFN 最优、非高斯树状先验下多层更优，训练出的线性注意力模型复现了这些定量预测。
Motivation: 深度 Transformer 的层数优势缺少可判定的理论条件：何时多层堆叠相对单层带来计算增益，取决于潜变量先验的何种结构，此前没有可检验的判据。
Method: 在广义线性注意力 Transformer 上建立受通信与深度约束的分布式推理理论，引入 function vector 表示中间层如何逐层细化推断潜上下文变量；用 in-context 线性回归任务给出高斯与树状先验下的预测，并训练线性注意力 Transformer 检验，再用 causal key-patching 实验追踪信息的自适应路由。
Result: 理论预测：高斯先验下无 FFN 的单层 Transformer 最优，非高斯树状先验下多层 Transformer 更优；训练出的线性注意力 Transformer 定量复现了理论预测，causal key-patching 验证中间层 function vector 介导了信息的自适应路由。
Conclusion: 深度与 FFN 块的价值在于实现自适应推理 (adaptive inference)，其优势条件是潜变量分布具有层级结构。

papers.title: Toward Open-World Video Segmentation over Long Horizons
papers.abstract_en: Long videos challenge open-world segmentation systems to continually discover objects and preserve their identities through disappearance and reappearance. Savvy, a zero-shot, semi-online, class-agnostic system for persistent object discovery and identity maintenance, and OGA, an evaluation suite that credits coherent part-level predictions when their granularity differs from the reference annotations. Savvy combines modular mask discovery, deferred admission based on accumulated evidence, and track consolidation to maintain an evolving object set. OGA allows multiple predictions to support one reference while preserving prediction IDs, pairing granularity-aware fidelity with diagnostics of identity bleeding and fragmented support. Across 142 ScanNet videos and 106 HM3D trajectories, evaluated using adaptively sampled prefixes capped at 1,500 source frames, Savvy outperforms DEVA+SAM and EntitySAM in VPQ_inf, STQ, and AQ under both conventional and OGA evaluation. Conventional VPQ_inf reaches 18.44 versus DEVA+SAM's 11.52 on ScanNet and 17.31 versus 6.58 on HM3D. VIPSeg comparisons reveal conventional one-to-one VPQ's sensitivity to annotation granularity. Controlled identity-severing and flicker tests show that OGA detects temporal failures even when frame-level masks remain unchanged. Together, these results demonstrate complementary advances: Savvy improves long-horizon segmentation and association, and OGA distinguishes coherent part-level support from temporal identity failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本、半在线、类无关的长视频开放世界分割系统 Savvy，用模块化 mask 发现、基于累积证据的延迟准入 (deferred admission) 和轨迹合并维护持续演化的物体集合；配套提出评测套件 OGA，允许一个参考物体由多条预测共同支撑并保留预测 ID。在 142 段 ScanNet 视频与 106 条 HM3D 轨迹（前缀上限 1,500 帧）上，Savvy 的常规 VPQ_inf 在 ScanNet 达 18.44（DEVA+SAM 11.52）、HM3D 达 17.31（DEVA+SAM 6.58），并在常规与 OGA 两种评测下于 VPQ_inf、STQ、AQ 上均优于 DEVA+SAM 与 EntitySAM。
Motivation: 长视频中物体会消失再出现，开放世界分割系统既要持续发现新物体又要跨时段保持身份；而常规一对一 VPQ 对标注粒度敏感，无法区分真正的时序身份失败与合理的部件级预测。
Method: Savvy 为零样本半在线类无关系统，组合模块化 mask 发现、基于累积证据的延迟准入与轨迹合并来维护演化物体集；OGA 评测套件允许多条预测支撑同一参考并保留预测 ID，同时给出粒度感知保真度以及 identity bleeding 与 fragmented support 诊断。评测用自适应采样、上限 1,500 源帧的视频前缀。
Result: 在 142 段 ScanNet 视频上常规 VPQ_inf 为 18.44，对比 DEVA+SAM 的 11.52；106 条 HM3D 轨迹上为 17.31，对比 6.58；Savvy 在常规与 OGA 评测下于 VPQ_inf、STQ、AQ 上均超过 DEVA+SAM 与 EntitySAM。VIPSeg 对比显示常规一对一 VPQ 对标注粒度敏感；受控的身份切断与闪烁测试表明，即使逐帧 mask 不变，OGA 仍能检出时序失败。
Conclusion: 长时程分割的进展需要两件事同时成立：Savvy 改善长时程分割与关联，OGA 把连贯的部件级支撑与时序身份失败区分开，常规一对一指标会掩盖后者。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning Coordinated Preference for Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) models team decision making under multiple, potentially conflicting objectives. In this setting, conflicts arise not only across objectives but also across agents with different observations, roles, and contributions. We propose Preference Coordinated Multi-agent Policy Optimization (PCMA), which learns coordinated agent-specific preferences to enable complementary trade-offs among agents. Theoretically, we formulate cooperative MOMARL as a team-optimal equilibrium problem, and show that, under suitable conditions, preference diversity yields a first-order improvement in the team objective. Experiments on multiple cooperative MOMA environments and a practical traffic-control scenario show that PCMA improves both performance and trade-off coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PCMA 为合作式多目标多智能体强化学习 (cooperative MOMARL) 学习协调的智能体专属偏好，使各智能体在冲突目标间做互补权衡。理论上把合作 MOMARL 形式化为 team-optimal equilibrium 问题，并证明在合适条件下偏好多样性对团队目标带来一阶改进；在多个合作 MOMA 环境与一个实际交通控制场景实验中，PCMA 同时提升性能与权衡协调性。
Motivation: 多目标多智能体设定中，冲突不仅存在于目标之间，还存在于观测、角色与贡献不同的智能体之间，缺少让各智能体偏好互补的机制。
Method: 提出 Preference Coordinated Multi-agent Policy Optimization (PCMA)，学习协调的 agent-specific preferences 以实现互补权衡；并将合作 MOMARL 形式化为 team-optimal equilibrium 问题，给出偏好多样性带来一阶改进的理论条件。
Result: 在多个合作 MOMA 环境与一个实际交通控制场景上，PCMA 同时改善性能与权衡协调性；理论上在合适条件下偏好多样性对团队目标产生一阶改进。
Conclusion: 让智能体持有协调而非同质的偏好，是提升合作式多目标多智能体系统团队目标与权衡质量的有效途径，且有理论条件支撑。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: S$^2$COPE: Self-Supervised Concept Discovery via Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning can learn useful representations from unlabeled images. Yet these representations remain largely opaque, making it difficult to understand what visual concepts they encode. Can self-supervision instead produce useful visual concepts that are directly understandable to people? We introduce S$^2$COPE, a framework that represents images as sets of concepts expressed in natural language. A vision-language model proposes candidate concepts, and a self-supervised objective evaluates how well each concept describes the source image while distinguishing it from other images. This feedback is used to construct preferences and train the model to propose better concepts. Across eight diverse visual datasets, our self-supervised concept representations transfer without adaptation and improve downstream recognition accuracy over prior interpretable approaches. In medical imaging, our discovered concepts reveal spurious visual cues and enable a more robust classifier. These results show that self-supervision can discover useful, human-readable visual representations from unlabeled images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S$^2$COPE 把图像表示成一组自然语言概念：视觉-语言模型提出候选概念，自监督目标衡量该概念对源图像的描述力并要求其区分其他图像，据此构造偏好对并训练模型提出更好的概念。在八个视觉数据集上，该概念表示无需适配即可迁移并提升下游识别精度；在医学影像中发现的概念揭示了虚假视觉线索并支撑更稳健的分类器。
Motivation: 自监督学习从无标注图像学到的表示是不透明的，难以知道模型编码了哪些视觉概念，人也无法直接读懂。
Method: 视觉-语言模型提出候选概念，自监督目标评估每个概念描述源图像并将其与其他图像区别的程度；该反馈被构造成偏好对 (preference learning)，用于训练模型提出更好的概念，最终以自然语言概念集合表示图像。
Result: 在八个多样的视觉数据集上，自监督概念表示无需适配即可迁移，并相对既往可解释方法提升下游识别精度；在医学影像中，发现的概念揭示虚假视觉线索并支撑更稳健的分类器。
Conclusion: 自监督学习可以从无标注图像中发现人类可读且对下游有用的概念表示，可解释性与表征质量不必互相牺牲。

papers.title: Trainability of IQP Quantum Circuit Born Machines Under Gaussian Initialization
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Circuit Born Machines (QCBMs) offer a natural approach to generative machine learning by leveraging the Born rule. Recent work has provided a method to classically train QCBMs with Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) circuits via the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) loss. Despite the assumed intractability of sampling from IQP circuits classically, their expectation values can be computed classically, enabling training of these IQP QCBMs. However, quantum machine learning (QML) models have various other challenges, including trainability issues caused by exponential concentration or barren plateaus. While these issues have been explored for parameters sampled from a uniform distribution, little work has been done to rigorously treat the use of arbitrary Gaussian initialization schemes. This work leverages Stein's lemma and Lipschitz concentration bounds for Gaussian random variables to provide an analytical lower bound of the variance of the gradient and a probabilistic concentration bound of the deviation of the gradient from its mean. It discusses strategies to either avoid or encourage exponential concentration, as well as the conditions under which barren plateaus are more likely to occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 IQP 量子线路 Born 机 (QCBM) 在高斯参数初始化下的可训练性，用 Stein 引理与高斯随机变量的 Lipschitz 集中界，给出梯度方差的解析下界和梯度偏离均值的概率集中界，并刻画何时更易出现贫瘠高原 (barren plateau) 或指数集中。
Motivation: QML 的指数集中与贫瘠高原此前多在均匀分布初始化下研究，任意高斯初始化方案缺少严格处理，训练 IQP QCBM 时梯度消失风险不明。
Method: 在 MMD 损失下经典训练 IQP QCBM 的设定中，对高斯初始化参数运用 Stein 引理与 Lipschitz 集中界，推导梯度方差下界与梯度偏差的概率集中界，并讨论规避或诱发指数浓度的策略。
Result: 给出梯度方差的解析下界、梯度偏离均值的概率集中界，以及贫瘠高原更可能出现的条件；摘要未给出数值实验。
Conclusion: 高斯初始化下 IQP QCBM 的可训练性可由解析界判定：满足相应条件时梯度方差被压低、贫瘠高原更易出现，反之可规避指数集中。

papers.title: PRISM: Recovering Instruction Sets from Language Model Activations
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are deployed as agents, reliable monitoring requires knowing not only what they output, but which instructions are steering their behavior. This is difficult when models infer unintended subgoals, follow contextual cues, or are influenced by prompt injections and hidden objectives. While activation-to-language methods suggest that hidden states can reveal natural-language information, existing approaches are not designed to recover the full set of simultaneous instructions, constraints, prohibitions, and subgoals present in agentic settings. As a first step toward this monitoring goal, we formalize instruction set retrieval and introduce PRISM, an activation-conditioned interpreter that decodes hidden states from a frozen target model into a faithful bullet list of instructions. Unlike prior activation-to-language methods, PRISM is trained to recover instruction sets directly, using judge-guided GRPO to reward covered instructions and penalize unsupported ones. Across benign, constrained, prompt-injection, and hidden-objective settings, PRISM outperforms activation-to-language baselines, especially on security-relevant objectives.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/Offensive-AI-Lab/prism
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 是一个激活条件化的解释器，把冻结目标模型的 hidden states 直接解码成完整的指令集合（bullet list），用 judge-guided GRPO 奖励被覆盖的指令、惩罚无依据的指令。在 benign、constrained、prompt-injection、hidden-objective 四类设定下，它在恢复指令集合上超过既有 activation-to-language 基线，且在安全相关目标上优势更明显。
Motivation: LLM 作为 agent 部署时需要监控是什么指令在驱动其行为，但模型会推断非预期子目标、跟随上下文线索或受 prompt injection 与隐藏目标影响；现有 activation-to-language 方法并非为恢复 agentic 场景中同时存在的指令、约束、禁止项与子目标集合而设计。
Method: 将 instruction set retrieval 形式化，提出 activation-conditioned interpreter PRISM，从冻结目标模型的 hidden states 解码出忠实的指令 bullet list；训练采用 judge-guided GRPO，奖励被覆盖的指令并惩罚无依据的条目。

papers.title: Tac2Pix: Image-Space Visuo-Tactile Fusion for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision and touch are naturally complementary for dexterous manipulation. Yet they are represented in fundamentally different forms: visual observations are dense and spatially structured, whereas tactile measurements are sparse, heterogeneous, and robot-centric. This mismatch makes it challenging to establish explicit spatial correspondence between the two modalities, particularly when they are fused in latent space. However, each tactile measurement is associated with a known location on the robot's kinematic chain, offering a localization prior that could bridge this representational gap. This raises a natural question: can this localization prior be used to construct a shared representation that explicitly aligns touch with vision? We introduce Tac2Pix, an image-space visuo-tactile fusion framework that projects sparse tactile measurements onto the RGB image plane using forward kinematics and camera calibration, then renders them as force-aware saliency maps. By expressing touch in the same pixel space as vision, Tac2Pix directly leverages pretrained 2D visual representations. We further employ zero-initialized input adaptation to preserve the original visual pathway at the start of policy learning. To assess whether this geometry-based interface yields consistent policy gains, we evaluate Tac2Pix on three simulated and three real-world dexterous manipulation tasks. In simulation, Tac2Pix consistently improves visuo-tactile policy learning across tasks, policy architectures, and visual backbones. In real-world experiments, it improves average success under visual occlusion by 26.7 percentage points over the strongest latent visuo-tactile fusion baseline, with gains persisting under both random and physical occlusions. Together, these results support image space as an effective interface for fusing sparse touch with pretrained visual representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tac2Pix 用正向运动学与相机标定把稀疏触觉投影到 RGB 图像平面，渲染成力感知显著图，使触觉与视觉共享像素空间并直接复用预训练 2D 视觉表征。在 3 个仿真与 3 个真实灵巧操作任务上，视觉遮挡时平均成功率比最强的 latent 融合基线高 26.7 个百分点，随机与物理遮挡下增益均保持。
Motivation: 视觉是稠密空间结构、触觉是稀疏且以机器人为中心的异构量，二者在 latent 空间融合难以建立显式空间对应，预训练视觉表征也无法直接利用。
Method: Tac2Pix 通过 forward kinematics 与 camera calibration 将触觉测量投影到 RGB 图像平面，渲染为 force-aware saliency map；策略学习初期用 zero-initialized input adaptation 保留原始视觉通路。
Result: 在 3 个仿真与 3 个真实灵巧操作任务上，仿真中跨任务、策略架构与视觉 backbone 均一致提升视触策略学习；真实实验中视觉遮挡下平均成功率比最强 latent 视触融合基线提高 26.7 个百分点，随机遮挡与物理遮挡下增益均保持。
Conclusion: 图像空间可作为稀疏触觉与预训练视觉表征融合的有效接口，几何对齐带来的策略增益在遮挡条件下依然稳定。

papers.title: DyCo-RL: Dynamic Cross-Modal Coordination for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a leading paradigm for enhancing visual reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, existing RLVR methods optimize primarily for the reasoning outcome and overlook how that outcome is produced: as a chain-of-thought unfolds, some tokens must extract evidence from the image while others must anchor to the preceding textual context, yet a single sequence-level reward provides no signal about whether each token draws on the modality its role demands. Token-level analyses and controlled interventions reveal that tokens frequently under-attend to their designated modality, and that this coordination breakdown may contribute to reasoning failures. Motivated by these findings, we propose DyCo-RL, which integrates dynamic cross-modal coordination into RLVR optimization. Specifically, DyCo-RL uses the Fisher-Rao geodesic distance to measure within-modality attention shifts, assigning tokens to either visually-oriented or text-oriented functional roles. It then evaluates the alignment between a token's actual attention allocation and its assigned role, leveraging this score for alignment-guided advantage reweighting during policy optimization. Extensive experiments using 11K examples for RL training demonstrate that the algorithm-agnostic DyCo-RL, when applied to Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B and Qwen3.5-27B, improves the average performance of all four evaluated RLVR algorithms across seven benchmarks spanning visual-centric and mathematical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyCo-RL 在多模态大模型的 RLVR 训练中引入 token 级跨模态协调：用 Fisher-Rao 测地距离度量模态内注意力漂移，把 token 分配为视觉导向或文本导向角色，再按实际注意力与角色的对齐分数做 advantage 重加权。用 11K 样本训练后，在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B 与 Qwen3.5-27B 上，对四个 RLVR 算法在七个视觉与数学推理 benchmark 上的平均性能均有提升。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 只优化推理结果、用序列级奖励，无法判断每个 token 是否用对了它角色所要求的模态；token 级分析与受控干预显示 token 常欠注意其指定模态，这种协调断裂可能引发推理失败。
Method: DyCo-RL 用 Fisher-Rao 测地距离度量模态内注意力转移，据此把 token 划分为视觉导向与文本导向两类功能角色；再评估 token 实际注意力分配与所指派角色的对齐度，将该分数用于策略优化中的 alignment-guided advantage 重加权，算法本身与具体 RLVR 算法解耦。
Result: 用 11K 样本做 RL 训练，DyCo-RL 应用于 Qwen2.5-VL-3B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Qwen3.5-27B，提升了全部四个被评估 RLVR 算法在七个 benchmark（覆盖视觉中心与数学推理）上的平均性能。
Conclusion: 序列级奖励不足以约束 token 的模态使用，把 token 的角色—注意力对齐信号纳入 advantage 加权，可在算法无关的前提下普遍改善 MLLM 的视觉推理 RLVR 训练。

papers.title: Defending Against Malicious Finetuning by Scaling Train-time Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Malicious finetuning attacks pose a major safety threat against open-weight large language models (LLMs). However, existing alignment-stage defenses provide limited protection against strong attacks that use full-parameter finetuning. To address this issue, we propose Patcher, a novel and efficient adversarial training algorithm that alternates between an attack stage and a defense stage: the attack stage simulates many-step malicious finetuning and computes the resulting parameter displacement as an "attack vector", while the defense stage aims to preserve safe behavior under such perturbations. Compared with other adversarial training methods, a key feature of Patcher is that the attack vector can be reused across multiple defense updates, substantially reducing training costs. Theoretically, we characterize how the relative gradient estimation error is influenced by the number of attack steps during training and reuse-duration of attack vectors. Empirically, experiment results show that Patcher reduces Attack Success Rate by 67.5%, 53.4% and 54.8% on three benchmarks compared to the second-best method while preserving the model's utility. Moreover, Patcher remains effective under diverse model sizes and attack scenarios, and generalizes to prompt-based jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/haomingwen/patcher
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Patcher 把多步恶意微调模拟成参数位移向量 (attack vector)，交替执行攻击阶段与防御阶段，且同一攻击向量可复用于多次防御更新以压低训练成本。在三个基准上，相比次优方法 Attack Success Rate 分别下降 67.5%、53.4%、54.8%，同时保持模型效用。
Motivation: 开放权重 LLM 面临全参数恶意微调攻击，而现有对齐阶段防御在强攻击下保护有限。
Method: Patcher 是一种对抗训练算法：攻击阶段模拟多步恶意微调并把参数位移算作 attack vector，防御阶段要求模型在该扰动下保持安全行为；攻击向量可跨多次防御更新复用。理论上刻画了相对梯度估计误差如何随攻击步数与向量复用时长变化。
Result: 在三个基准上，相比次优方法 Attack Success Rate 分别降低 67.5%、53.4%、54.8%，并保持模型效用；在不同模型规模与攻击场景下仍有效，并可泛化到基于 prompt 的 jailbreak 攻击。
Conclusion: 用可复用的攻击向量做对抗训练，能在控制训练成本的同时抵御全参数恶意微调，并迁移到 prompt 级越狱攻击。

papers.title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve high accuracy on many visual question-answering benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether this accuracy reflects reliable use of the visual details a question depends on. We examine this tension through the lens of visual ignorance: cases where a model can represent task-relevant visual evidence without using it to determine the answer. Across three VLMs and twelve benchmarks, we track the answer-relevant information decodable at each decoder layer and measure when it becomes coupled to the final output. The visual evidence needed for the correct answer can already be read out from intermediate layers, yet it has little effect on the output until the final layers of the decoder. Causal residual interchange confirms that shifting the answer requires the late states, not the earlier ones. We then evaluate all twelve benchmarks under progressive Gaussian blur and find that substantial fractions of predictions survive the entire degradation sequence while continuing to receive benchmark credit. These results distinguish the availability of visual information from its influence on prediction, and show that standard accuracy can coexist with limited sensitivity to the tested visual detail. They motivate training and evaluation that make answer-relevant visual distinctions necessary to answer correctly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把「视觉无知」定义为模型能表征答题所需的视觉证据却不用它决定答案：跨 3 个 VLM、12 个基准追踪各解码层可解码的答案相关信息，发现证据在中间层已可读出、但直到最后几层才与输出耦合，因果残差互换证实只有晚期状态能改变答案。在渐进高斯模糊下，大量预测在整个退化序列中仍存活并继续获得基准分数，说明标准准确率可与对所测视觉细节的低敏感度并存。
Motivation: VLM 在视觉问答基准上准确率很高，但这种准确率是否真的依赖题目所依赖的视觉细节并不清楚；需要区分「视觉信息可用」与「视觉信息影响预测」这两件事。
Method: 在 3 个 VLM、12 个基准上逐解码层追踪可解码的答案相关信息，测量其何时与最终输出耦合；用因果残差互换 (causal residual interchange) 检验改变答案需要早期还是晚期状态；再对全部 12 个基准施加渐进高斯模糊 (progressive Gaussian blur) 退化序列。
Result: 正确答案所需的视觉证据在中间层即可读出，但在解码器最后几层之前对输出影响很小；因果残差互换表明改变答案需要晚期状态而非早期状态。渐进高斯模糊下，相当大比例的预测在整个退化序列中存活并继续获得基准分数（跨 3 个 VLM、12 个基准）。
Conclusion: 标准准确率可以与对所测视觉细节的有限敏感度共存，训练与评测应让答案相关的视觉区分成为答对的必要条件。

papers.title: Safety Paradox: How Enhanced Safety Awareness Leaves LLMs Vulnerable to Posterior Attack
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rigorously aligned to refuse harmful requests, a process that inherently cultivates a latent capacity to evaluate and recognize unsafe content. In this work, we reveal that this advanced safety awareness inadvertently introduces a fatal vulnerability. We introduce Posterior Attack, a single-query jailbreak that bypasses guardrails by prompting the model to generate the exact harmful response its internal classifier would normally flag as unsafe. Through extensive empirical evaluation across 30 open-source LLMs (up to 35B parameters in size) and frontier models (e.g., GPT-5, Claude 4.6), we observe a striking phenomenon: models with superior safety-judgment capabilities are disproportionately more susceptible to this exploitation. To explain this, we formalize the Safety Paradox, analytically showing that monotonic improvements in safety alignment naturally amplify posterior vulnerability. Finally, we establish a causal link via reinforcement learning interventions, exemplifying that artificially degrading a model's safety judgment immunizes it against the attack, whereas enhancing judgment exacerbates the vulnerability. Our findings highlight potential flaws in current alignment paradigms, indicating that defense mechanisms may require further structural refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单次查询越狱方法 Posterior Attack：诱导模型直接生成其内部安全分类器本会判定为有害的那段回答，从而绕过护栏。在 30 个开源 LLM（最大 35B）与 GPT-5、Claude 4.6 等前沿模型上，安全判断能力越强的模型越容易被此攻击利用；强化学习干预显示人为削弱安全判断可免疫该攻击，增强判断则加剧脆弱性。
Motivation: 对齐训练在让模型拒绝有害请求的同时，也培养了识别不安全内容的判断能力，而这一能力本身可能成为可被利用的攻击面，现有对齐范式因此存在结构性缺陷。
Method: 提出 Posterior Attack 单查询越狱：提示模型生成其内部分类器通常会标记为不安全的确切有害回答；用解析形式化的 Safety Paradox 说明安全对齐的单调改进会放大后验脆弱性，并通过强化学习干预（削弱或增强安全判断）建立因果联系。

papers.title: Multilingual Fine-Tuning via Localized Gradient Conflict Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Cross-lingual versatility has become a defining capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, fine-tuning these models often induces negative interference, where gains in one language come at another's expense. To address this, we cast multilingual fine-tuning as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem. Specifically, we introduce Bucket-Level MOO, a scalable distributed framework that applies gradient-based MOO algorithms locally, within the parameter buckets of distributed training. This enables conflict-aware updates without ever materializing a full gradient vector for any objective, and improves multilingual performance over standard fine-tuning by up to $4.3$ points. Theoretically, we define bucketwise Pareto stationarity, show it is necessary for Pareto optimality under any fixed partition, and prove descent and convergence for representative Bucket-Level variants. Our work brings conventional MOO within reach for multilingual LLMs at a far lower cost. More broadly, Bucket-Level MOO is agnostic to both the objectives and the update rule, readily extending to other multi-task learning at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多语言微调形式化为多目标优化 (MOO)，提出 Bucket-Level MOO：在分布式训练的参数桶内局部做基于梯度的冲突消解，全程不物化任何目标的完整梯度向量。标准微调相比多语言性能最多提升 4.3 个点，并证明了桶级 Pareto 平稳性对固定划分下 Pareto 最优的必要性以及代表性变体的下降与收敛。
Motivation: 多语言微调存在负干扰：一种语言的收益以另一种语言的退化为代价；而常规 MOO 算法需要完整梯度向量，在大规模分布式 LLM 训练中代价过高。
Method: 将多语言微调建模为 MOO 问题，提出可扩展的分布式框架 Bucket-Level MOO，把基于梯度的 MOO 算法局部应用于分布式训练的参数桶 (parameter buckets) 内，实现冲突感知更新而不物化任何目标的完整梯度；框架对目标与更新规则均无绑定。
Result: 相比标准微调，多语言性能最多提升 4.3 个点；理论上定义桶级 Pareto 平稳性 (bucketwise Pareto stationarity)，证明其在任意固定划分下对 Pareto 最优是必要的，并证明代表性 Bucket-Level 变体的下降与收敛性。
Conclusion: 常规 MOO 可以在远低于以往成本的条件下用于多语言 LLM 微调，且该桶级框架与具体目标和更新规则无关，可推广到其他大规模多任务学习。

papers.title: SWARD: Stochastic Window-Attention-Based Relational Distillation for Cross-Architectural Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale vision foundation models have driven substantial gains on dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation, but their size makes deployment impractical in resource-constrained settings, motivating knowledge distillation as a means of transferring their capabilities to lightweight student networks. However, modern foundation teachers are predominantly transformer-based that encode global context, whereas efficient students are typically convolutional networks with locally biased receptive fields. Existing distillation methods largely assume architectural homogeneity and rely on direct feature mimicry, which fails to bridge this representational gap and neglects the structured spatial dependencies and discriminative organization required for accurate semantic segmentation. In this paper, we propose SWARD, a knowledge distillation framework that addresses this gap through two complementary mechanisms. First, we introduce a Multi-Scale Windowed Attention Distillation (MWAD) module that aligns teacher-student attention-based relations within stochastically shifted window partitions whose offsets are randomly resampled at every training iteration. This removes window boundary bias, and, combined with the multi-scale design, captures both short- and long-range spatial dependencies. Second, we introduce Prototype Discriminative Regularization (PDR), a loss that helps shape the student's feature distribution by enforcing inter-class separation and intra-class compactness, further sharpening the discriminative structure beyond what feature mimicry alone can produce under the student's reduced capacity. Experiments across different vision applications (i.e., urban scene parsing and medical image segmentation) show that SWARD achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWARD 面向跨架构知识蒸馏：用随机移位窗口划分的多尺度窗口注意力蒸馏 (MWAD) 对齐 transformer 教师与 CNN 学生的关系特征，再加原型判别正则 (PDR) 拉开类间距离、收紧类内紧凑度。在城市场景解析与医学图像分割上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 基础教师多为编码全局上下文的 transformer，高效学生多为局部感受野的 CNN，而现有蒸馏方法假设架构同构、依赖直接特征模仿，无法弥合这一表征鸿沟。
Method: 两个互补机制：MWAD 在每次训练迭代随机重采样偏移的窗口划分内对齐师生注意力关系，消除窗口边界偏置并以多尺度设计覆盖短程与长程空间依赖；PDR 作为损失约束学生特征分布的类间分离与类内紧凑。
Result: 在城市场景解析与医学图像分割两类视觉任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 跨架构蒸馏应改对齐关系结构并加判别性正则，而非直接模仿特征，才能在学生容量受限时仍保住语义分割所需的判别组织。

papers.title: Context-aware tokenization for Cross-subject Emotion Decoding from EEG
papers.abstract_en: In cross-subject EEG emotion decoding, neighboring windows can inform the representation of a target window, but they contain both background variation and sustained task signals. This creates a challenge for contextual representation learning because subtracting shared activity can also remove useful information. We introduce the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), which conditions target-window tokens on a structured spectral summary before attention. MST averages the Morlet log-amplitude spectra of unlabeled same-trial neighbors and uses frequency-specific electrode projections to combine the target spectrum with its reference-relative residual. This retains access to absolute activity while incorporating context into a fixed attended target-token grid. Without external pretraining, MST achieves 66.5\%, 40.7\%, 36.1\%, and 27.9\% accuracy on SEED, SEED-IV, SEED-V, and SEED-VII under leave-one-subject-out evaluation, averaged over three random seeds, outperforming the evaluated pretrained and from-scratch baselines. On FACED, MST achieves 17.52\% accuracy in nine-class cross-subject evaluation, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 1.15 percentage points. We also performed the ablation studies across all 15 SEED subjects to evaluate the contribution of different components of MST.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨被试 EEG 情绪解码中，MST (Morlet Spectral Transformer) 先把同 trial 未标注邻窗的 Morlet 对数幅度谱取平均作为结构化谱摘要，再用频率相关的电极投影把目标窗谱与其相对参考残差合并，之后才做注意力，从而在引入上下文的同时保留绝对活动。无外部预训练时，leave-one-subject-out 下 SEED/SEED-IV/SEED-V/SEED-VII 准确率分别为 66.5%、40.7%、36.1%、27.9%（三个随机种子平均），FACED 九类 17.52%，均超过所评估的预训练与从零训练基线。
Motivation: 跨被试 EEG 情绪解码里，邻近窗口既含背景变化又含持续任务信号，直接减去共享活动会连同有用信息一起丢掉，上下文表示学习因此难以取舍。
Method: MST 在注意力之前先构造目标窗的条件化 token：对同 trial 未标注邻窗的 Morlet 对数幅度谱求平均得到参考谱，再用频率特定的电极投影将目标谱与相对参考的残差组合，输出固定的目标 token 网格；不使用外部预训练，并在全部 15 名 SEED 被试上做组件消融。
Result: leave-one-subject-out、三个随机种子平均下，MST 在 SEED 66.5%、SEED-IV 40.7%、SEED-V 36.1%、SEED-VII 27.9%，超过所评估的预训练与从零训练基线；FACED 九类跨被试 17.52%，比最强基线高 1.15 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把邻窗谱摘要作为条件而非直接相减，可以在保留绝对活动的同时引入上下文，使无预训练的跨被试 EEG 情绪解码超过有预训练的基线。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Shared Doubt: Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Confidence Estimation for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Confidence estimation (CE), i.e. quantifying the reliability of a model's prediction, has attracted great interest in the context of large language models (LLMs). However, most studies focus on English, ignoring the multilingual reality of LLM usage, while many CE methods degrade or require retraining across languages. To address this gap, we investigate whether multilingual LLMs encode shared, language-transferable confidence features in open-ended question answering. We use a lightweight linear probe that predicts answer correctness directly from intermediate representations. Trained monolingually, the probe generalizes zero-shot to unseen, linguistically diverse languages without target-language supervision. Multiple ablations and learned layer weights reveal that confidence features concentrate in middle layers across languages, suggesting a shared confidence subspace. While zero-shot cross-lingual performance depends on similarity to the source language, the probe provides a strong baseline without any retraining and compares favorably to other popular confidence estimation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多语言 LLM 开放式问答上，用一个轻量线性探针直接从中间层表征预测答案正确性，仅在源语言上训练即可零样本迁移到未见语言而无需目标语监督。消融与学到的层权重显示置信特征跨语言集中在中间层，提示存在共享的 confidence subspace；性能随与源语言的相似度变化，但无需重训即可与其他常用置信估计方法相竞争。
Motivation: 现有置信估计 (CE) 研究几乎只做英语，而许多 CE 方法跨语言会退化或需要重训练，多语言 LLM 用户得不到可靠的预测可靠性度量。
Method: 在开放式问答任务上，用轻量线性探针 (linear probe) 直接从模型中间层表征预测答案正确性；探针只在源语言上单语训练，再零样本应用到语言多样的未见语言，配合多组消融与学习到的层权重分析。
Result: 零样本跨语言性能取决于与源语言的相似度；探针在无需任何重训的情况下给出强基线，并与其他流行的置信估计方法相比具有竞争力；消融与层权重显示置信特征跨语言集中在中间层。
Conclusion: 多语言 LLM 中存在跨语言共享、可迁移的置信子空间，因此单语训练的轻量探针可作为零样本跨语言置信估计的可行路径。

papers.title: Digitally enriching a high-risk population for pancreatic cancer using routine blood-based measures and clinical histories
papers.abstract_en: Earlier detection of pancreatic cancer is key to enabling wider access to curative treatment and reducing cancer deaths; however, screening is presently not viable. Latent digital indicators of pathology are evident in an individual's disease and blood test trajectories and may predict the development of pancreatic cancer. Longitudinal sequences of coded diagnoses and blood test values accrued by patients throughout their clinical interactions were used to train a custom Transformer-based neural network with a multi-head attention mechanism to predict risk of pancreatic cancer with a multi-year lead time and risk-stratify populations for targeted screening. Mayo Clinic Platform with trained model from Mayo Clinic Rochester validated at Mayo Clinic Arizona, Mayo Clinic Florida, and Mayo Clinic Health Systems. The cohort comprised 6,017 adults with pancreatic cancer and 177,081 controls (median age 75, 45% female) with median 12 years (interquartile range 6.9-16.2) of medical history prior to pancreatic cancer diagnosis. External validation via leave-one-site-out, out-of-sample testing predicting pancreatic cancer 1-, 2-, and 3-years prior to diagnosis demonstrated mean area under the receiver operating characteristic of 0.837 (95% confidence interval 0.827-0.848), 0.797 (95% confidence interval 0.782-0.813), and 0.760 (95% confidence interval 0.745-0.776), respectively. Estimated pancreatic cancer risks were well-calibrated (calibration plot slope 1.08, intercept of -0.077; Brier score 0.025), and a Bayesian population pancreatic cancer prevalence update allows estimated cancer risk outputs to be transportable across settings. At testing, a screening threshold of >3.3% risk of pancreatic cancer in 1-year offered a diagnostic odds ratio of 18.2. Our work therefore lays the foundation for a digital population-level risk enrichment tool that could widen access to curative-intent management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用编码诊断与化验值的纵向序列训练多头注意力 Transformer，在确诊前 1、2、3 年预测胰腺癌风险并做人群风险分层。Mayo Clinic Rochester 训练、Arizona/Florida/Health Systems 留一站点外验证，1 年 AUROC 0.837、2 年 0.797、3 年 0.760；1 年阈值 >3.3% 的诊断比值比为 18.2。
Motivation: 胰腺癌早筛目前不可行，而病理的潜在数字指标已存在于个人的疾病与化验轨迹中，可在多年提前量上预测发病、把高危人群富集出来做定向筛查。
Method: 输入为患者临床交互中累积的编码诊断序列与化验值序列，训练带多头注意力的定制 Transformer 预测胰腺癌风险；Mayo Clinic Platform 上用 Rochester 数据训练，在 Arizona、Florida 与 Mayo Clinic Health Systems 做留一站点外部验证，并用 Bayesian 人群患病率更新使风险输出可跨场景迁移。

papers.title: Inference-Native Zeroth-Order Optimization for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) methods train large language models using only forward passes, yet common ZO execution paths perform substantial work beyond what the algorithm itself requires. To remove this extra execution overhead, we present Infer-ZO, which separates the evaluations required by the algorithm from how they are executed, allowing them to reuse existing inference-engine optimizations. After removing inherited execution work, a complete Infer-ZO step on Qwen3-14B adds only 1.16% wall-clock time over matched inference, bringing ZO execution close to its fundamental inference workload. With Infer-ZO, ZO evaluations run at near-inference cost with frozen base weights and can share GPU batches with ordinary inference requests. In co-serving experiments, foreground and background throughput remain within 1-3% of the corresponding background-request baseline. Across 15 Qwen3, Llama, and OPT models, Infer-ZO achieves 2.10x-9.94x end-to-end step speedups over released LoZO. Code is available at https://github.com/playeriv65/zo-vllm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Infer-ZO 把零阶 (ZO) 训练中算法必需的评估与执行方式解耦，使 ZO 步骤复用推理引擎优化，从而在冻结权重下以接近纯推理的成本运行并与普通推理请求共享 GPU batch。Qwen3-14B 上完整一步仅比匹配推理多 1.16% 墙钟时间，15 个 Qwen3/Llama/OPT 模型上端到端步加速 2.10x–9.94x（对比 LoZO）。
Motivation: 零阶方法只用前向即可训练 LLM，但常见 ZO 执行路径做了大量算法本身不需要的额外工作，带来与算法无关的执行开销，使 ZO 训练成本远高于其理论下限。
Method: Infer-ZO 将算法要求的评估与执行解耦，让这些评估复用现有推理引擎优化；ZO 评估在冻结基座权重下运行，并可与普通推理请求共享 GPU batch，配套代码发布于 zo-vllm。
Result: Qwen3-14B 上一个完整 Infer-ZO 步骤仅比匹配推理多 1.16% 墙钟时间；共服务 (co-serving) 实验中前台与后台吞吐保持在各自后台请求基线的 1–3% 以内；在 15 个 Qwen3、Llama、OPT 模型上，端到端步加速为对比 LoZO 的 2.10x–9.94x。
Conclusion: ZO 训练的执行开销主要来自继承的执行路径而非算法本身，把评估交给推理引擎优化即可让 ZO 步骤逼近其基本推理负载，并支持与在线推理共存。

papers.title: BEAT: Rhythm-Elastic Alignment for Agentic Music-guided Movie Trailer Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic movie trailer generation must select shots from a full-length film and synchronize them with background music. Existing methods either relegate music alignment to post-processing or enforce rigid one-to-one shot-music mappings, overlooking that professional editing rhythm is elastic: rapid cuts accompany high-energy passages while sustained shots span quieter bars. We introduce BEAT, a framework that addresses this gap with two core components: MuVA, a compact music-visual alignment encoder trained with Sinkhorn-regularized two-stage learning, and Bar-DP, an energy-adaptive dynamic programming algorithm that produces elastic many-to-one alignments following musical dynamics. These components are integrated into a five-phase agentic pipeline that grounds the core alignment in learned cross-modal features while coordinating higher-level creative decisions through structured text signals. To support comprehensive evaluation, we also introduce TrailerArena, a benchmark with 20+ metrics across four complementary dimensions. On TrailerArena, BEAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across shot selection, ordering, and perceptual quality, while producing fully composed trailers end-to-end.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEAT 用 MuVA（Sinkhorn 正则两阶段训练的紧凑音乐-视觉对齐编码器）与 Bar-DP（能量自适应动态规划，产出随音乐动态变化的弹性多对一对齐）组成五阶段 agentic 管线，端到端生成配乐完整的电影预告片。在自建基准 TrailerArena（四个维度、20+ 指标）上，BEAT 在镜头选择、排序与感知质量上均达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有预告片生成方法要么把音乐对齐推迟到后处理，要么强制刚性的一对一镜头-音乐映射，忽略了专业剪辑节奏的弹性：快切对应高能段落，长镜头跨越安静小节。
Method: 两个核心组件：MuVA，用 Sinkhorn 正则的两阶段学习训练的紧凑音乐-视觉对齐编码器；Bar-DP，能量自适应动态规划算法，按音乐动态产出弹性多对一对齐。二者嵌入五阶段 agentic 管线，用学习到的跨模态特征做底层对齐，用结构化文本信号协调上层创作决策。
Result: 提出 TrailerArena 基准，含四个互补维度上的 20+ 指标；在 TrailerArena 上 BEAT 于镜头选择、排序与感知质量均取得 SOTA，并端到端产出完整配乐的预告片。
Conclusion: 把音乐-视觉对齐做成弹性多对一而非刚性一对一，并用 agentic 管线把跨模态对齐与文本层创作决策结合，可端到端生成专业节奏的电影预告片。

papers.title: Can Predicted Dynamics Exist in the Physical World?
papers.abstract_en: Can learned state-action proposals exist in the physical world? Before executing a proposed action sequence, a robot can inspect empirical variation and disagreement with a learned transition model. However, aggregating these diagnostic signals obscures whether a proposal is inconsistent with the predictor or merely departs from recorded behavior. We formalize this prediction-control interface, separate the scalar trigger from its channel-wise diagnostic log, and establish that an all-pairs displacement term is redundant within a maximum that already contains the corresponding one-step term. We evaluate the monitors on 700 nominal and 5,250 synthetically perturbed 32-transition PushT windows, observing only planar pusher positions and goals. The transition-RMSE baseline achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.982, compared with 0.957 for a heterogeneous maximum and 0.972 for a spread-scaled residual.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把机器人执行前的预测-控制接口形式化：将标量触发信号与其逐通道诊断日志分离，并证明在已含一步项的 maximum 中，全对位移项是冗余的。在 700 个名义与 5,250 个合成扰动的 32 步 PushT 窗口上（仅观测平面推动器位置与目标），transition-RMSE 基线 ROC-AUC 达 0.982，高于异构 maximum 的 0.957 与 spread 缩放残差的 0.972。
Motivation: 执行学习到的动作序列前，机器人可用经验变异与转移模型分歧做诊断，但把这些信号聚合会掩盖提案究竟是与预测器不一致、还是仅仅偏离记录行为。
Method: 形式化 prediction-control 接口，把标量触发器与逐通道诊断日志分开；证明在已含对应一步项的 maximum 内，全对位移 (all-pairs displacement) 项冗余；在 PushT 的 32-transition 窗口上评估监视器，观测仅限平面推动器位置与目标。
Result: 数据为 700 个名义窗口加 5,250 个合成扰动窗口；transition-RMSE 基线 ROC-AUC 0.982，异构 maximum 0.957，spread-scaled residual 0.972。
Conclusion: 诊断信号应把标量触发与逐通道日志分开报告，且 maximum 内的全对位移项可去掉；在该 PushT 设置下 transition-RMSE 是最强的不一致检测量。

papers.title: BitsMoE: Cost-Aware Bit Allocation in Spectral Space for MoE LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models incur substantial memory costs due to their large expert parameter counts. Mixed-precision quantization reduces these costs by allocating different bit-widths to experts or linear blocks according to their importance. However, assigning a single precision within each expert or linear block overlooks its internal structural heterogeneity. This limitation motivates two key questions: (1) how to define a fine-grained unit for quantization within a linear transformation; and (2) how to characterize the quantization cost of each unit under actual activation patterns and different bit-widths. To address these two questions, we propose BitsMoE, a cost-aware mixed-precision quantization framework built on two complementary techniques: (1) Shared-basis Spectral Decomposition (SSD) separates expert weights into a shared basis and expert-specific spectral components, defining structural quantization units while exploiting cross-expert redundancy. (2) Factorized Quantization Cost Modeling (FQCM) estimates component-wise costs from output reconstruction loss by combining intrinsic spectral importance, activation-dependent importance, and bit-width-dependent distortion. Using these component-wise costs, we formulate bit allocation as an integer linear program (ILP) that minimizes total modeled quantization cost under a fixed memory budget. On Qwen3-30B-A3B at 2-bit, BitsMoE achieves 64.29% average accuracy over seven downstream tasks, outperforming the evaluated MoE-specific methods, including those using ILP-based bit allocation, and exceeding GEMQ by 2.80 percentage points. Under the same setting, it achieves a $16.47\times$ end-to-end offline quantization speedup over GEMQ. It also achieves up to $6.46\times$ the decode throughput of GPTQ.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 10 figures, 16 tables. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE and our models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/zjiayu064/bitsmoe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BitsMoE 把 MoE 专家权重做 Shared-basis Spectral Decomposition (SSD)，拆出共享基与专家特有谱分量作为量化单元，再用 Factorized Quantization Cost Modeling (FQCM) 由输出重构损失估计各分量代价，最后在固定显存预算下用整数线性规划 (ILP) 分配比特。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 2-bit 上七项下游任务平均准确率 64.29%，超 GEMQ 2.80 个百分点，离线量化加速 16.47 倍，解码吞吐最高达 GPTQ 的 6.46 倍。
Motivation: MoE LLM 专家参数量大、显存开销高；现有混合精度量化在每个专家或线性块内只给单一精度，忽略了内部结构异质性，也缺少在真实激活模式下刻画各单元量化代价的方法。
Method: SSD 将专家权重分解为共享基与专家特有谱分量，既定义细粒度量化单元又利用跨专家冗余；FQCM 结合内在谱重要性、激活依赖重要性与比特宽度依赖失真，从输出重构损失估计分量级代价；再把比特分配建模为固定显存预算下最小化总代价的 ILP。
Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 2-bit 设置下，七项下游任务平均准确率 64.29%，优于所评估的 MoE 专用方法（含基于 ILP 分配比特的方法），比 GEMQ 高 2.80 个百分点；同设置下端到端离线量化相对 GEMQ 加速 16.47 倍，解码吞吐最高达 GPTQ 的 6.46 倍。
Conclusion: 把量化单元下沉到谱分解分量并按实际激活代价做预算内比特分配，可在 2-bit 极低精度下同时换取更高下游精度与大幅量化/解码加速。
