papers.title: Complete-muE: Optimal Hyperparameter Transfer and Scaling for MoE Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose Complete-muE, a framework which targets hyperparameter transfer across dense FFN and any Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) setups in transformer blocks. Existing tools such as $μ$P (requires fixed architectue) or SDE (requires fixed per-step token count) cannot directly solve the hyperparameter transfer problem in MoE setups because Dense to MoE transfer or MoE total experts scaling changes both architecture and tokens per expert. Complete-muE solves this challenge with a two-bridge system: Bridge~I maps between dense FFN and Dense MoE by active-width $μ$P with a normalized router scale. Bridge~II maps between Dense MoE and sparse MoE by activated-expert scaling, where the first-order SDE LR/WD correction cancels while a bounded residual $σ_0$ shift remains. The resulting transfer rule, which we term as Complete muE, covers changes in activated experts, total capacity, granularity, and shared/group-balanced hybrids for MoE models as well as network width/depth, batch size, and duration changes for general Transformer models. Extensive language model and diffusion model pretraining experiments confirm that complete-muE yields relatively stable hyperparameter optima across model architectures and parameter counts -- with only minor drift consistent with the non-strict SDE behavior of Bridge~II. In practice this drift is small enough that hyperparameters tuned on a single dense reference transfer near-optimally to all MoE configurations -- \emph{tune dense once, transfer to all} is the practical recipe at the core of Complete-muE. This enables MoE models to achieve accelerated convergence speedup over dense models when scaling model capacity without costly hyperparameter search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Complete-muE 把 μP 与 SDE 拼成两座桥，让超参在 dense FFN、Dense MoE 与稀疏 MoE 之间直接迁移：Bridge I 用 active-width μP 加归一化 router scale 打通 dense 与 Dense MoE，Bridge II 用 activated-expert scaling 打通 Dense MoE 与稀疏 MoE，此时一阶 SDE 的 LR/WD 修正相消、只剩有界的 σ₀ 残差偏移。语言模型与扩散模型预训练实验确认超参最优点跨架构与参数量基本稳定，只需在单个 dense 参考上调一次即可近最优地迁移到所有 MoE 配置。
Motivation: μP 要求架构固定，SDE 要求每步 token 数固定，而 dense→MoE 迁移或 MoE 总专家数缩放会同时改变架构与每专家 token 数，现有工具无法直接处理 MoE 的超参迁移。
Method: 两桥体系：Bridge I 以 active-width μP 加归一化 router scale 在 dense FFN 与 Dense MoE 间映射；Bridge II 以 activated-expert scaling 在 Dense MoE 与稀疏 MoE 间映射，其中一阶 SDE 的学习率/权重衰减修正相消、保留有界残差 σ₀ 偏移。最终的 Complete muE 迁移规则覆盖激活专家数、总容量、granularity、shared/group-balanced 混合结构，以及宽度/深度、batch size 与训练时长变化。
Result: 在语言模型与扩散模型预训练实验中，complete-muE 跨模型架构与参数量给出相对稳定的超参最优点，仅存在与 Bridge II 非严格 SDE 行为一致的轻微漂移；该漂移小到单个 dense 参考上调出的超参可近最优迁移到全部 MoE 配置，并使 MoE 在扩大容量时相对 dense 模型获得加速收敛的 speedup。
Conclusion: 实践配方是 tune dense once, transfer to all：在单个 dense 参考上做一次超参搜索即可覆盖各类 MoE 配置，从而在扩大模型容量时免去昂贵的超参搜索。

papers.title: XWind: A Cross-site Router for Large Language Model Inference Serving at Renewable Energy Farms
papers.abstract_en: AI power demand is growing at an unprecedented rate while power grids are often ailing and struggle to keep up. Grid expansion comes with high capital expenditure and long-distance transmission losses, yet there is abundant renewable energy at the source, just not matched to demand. This paper proposes a complementary AI infrastructure deployment model, AI Greeninferencing, that brings modular AI compute to renewable energy sources, focusing on wind, allowing AI footprint expansion, generating local behind-the-meter demand for renewable sites, and helping ease the growing strain on power utilities. Our feasibility analysis shows that 890+ GW of wind capacity lies within 50 ms network round trip time of Azure data centers, and that site-wise right-sizing combined with spatial complementarity of wind energy keeps aggregate fleet utilization on par with traditional deployments. To serve inference requests under variable wind power, we build XWind, a lightweight, reactive, and workload-agnostic AI inference router that uses only real-time signals: inference latency, KV-cache utilization, and queue depth, to dynamically configure sites and distribute requests. Evaluated on a real 64-GPU A100 testbed emulating three wind-powered sites with Azure production traces, XWind reduces P99 end-to-end latency by up to 52% over the strongest contender (also our idea) and by up to 98% over baselines such as power-capping and GPU idling, with consistent gains across workload types, load levels, and GPU generations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把模块化 AI 算力直接建在风电场侧的部署模式 AI Greeninferencing，并用只依赖实时信号（推理延迟、KV-cache 占用、队列深度）的轻量路由器 XWind 在波动风电下分发推理请求。在 64 卡 A100 仿真三个风电站点、使用 Azure 生产 trace 的测试床上，XWind 的 P99 端到端延迟比最强对照低至多 52%，比 power-capping、GPU idling 等基线低至多 98%。
Motivation: AI 电力需求激增而电网扩容资本开支高、远距离输电有损耗，源侧富余的可再生能源与需求在时空上不匹配；在波动风电下服务推理请求还缺少不依赖功率预测的调度手段。
Method: 部署模式 AI Greeninferencing 把模块化算力放到风电场（behind-the-meter 就地消纳）；XWind 是 workload-agnostic 的反应式推理路由器，仅用推理延迟、KV-cache 利用率、队列深度三类实时信号动态配置站点并分发请求。评估用真实 64-GPU A100 测试床模拟三个风电站点，回放 Azure 生产 trace。
Result: 可行性分析显示 890+ GW 风电容量位于 Azure 数据中心 50 ms 网络往返时延内；站点级 right-sizing 加上风能的空间互补性使聚合机组利用率与传统部署持平。XWind 相对最强对照（同为作者思路）P99 端到端延迟降低至多 52%，相对 power-capping、GPU idling 等基线降低至多 98%，在不同负载类型、负载水平与 GPU 代际上增益一致。
Conclusion: 把 AI 推理搬到风电源侧并用纯实时信号做跨站点路由，可在不牺牲机组利用率的前提下大幅压低 P99 延迟，无需依赖功率预测或 workload 特征。

papers.title: DeferMem: Query-Time Evidence Distillation via Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents still struggle to effectively use long-term memory, with answer-supporting evidence often scattered across long conversational histories and buried in substantial irrelevant content. Existing memory systems commonly process memory into dedicated units before future queries are known and retrieve these preconstructed units at query time. Because the contents and granularity of these units are determined before the current query is known, the retrieved units can remain coarse and noisy for that query, leaving downstream answerers to further denoise them and uncover query-specific evidence. We present DeferMem, a long-term memory framework that decouples this problem into high-recall candidate retrieval and query-conditioned evidence distillation. DeferMem uses a lightweight segment-link structure to organize raw history and retrieve broad candidates at query time. A memory distiller then distills these high-recall but highly noisy candidates into a set of faithful, self-contained, and query-conditioned evidence. To train this distiller, we introduce DistillPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that formulates post-retrieval evidence distillation as a structured action comprising message selection and evidence rewriting. It optimizes this action with a decomposed-and-gated reward pipeline and structure-aligned advantage assignment, gating reward components from validity to quality checks while exposing answerability-related feedback early and assigning each reward to its responsible output span. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, DeferMem surpasses strong baselines in QA accuracy and memory-system efficiency, achieving the highest QA accuracy and fastest runtime while consuming no commercial-API tokens for memory operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeferMem 把 LLM agent 长期记忆拆成查询时的高召回候选检索与查询条件化的证据蒸馏：轻量 segment-link 结构组织原始对话历史，memory distiller 把噪声候选压成自足证据，并用强化学习 DistillPO 训练该蒸馏器。在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上取得最高 QA 准确率与最快运行时，且记忆操作不消耗商业 API token。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统在查询未知前就把历史预构造成固定单元，粒度与内容对当前查询过粗且噪声大，迫使下游 answerer 再次去噪并自行挖掘查询相关证据。
Method: 两阶段解耦：segment-link 结构在查询时检索高召回候选；memory distiller 将候选蒸馏为忠实、自足、查询条件化的证据。训练用 DistillPO，把蒸馏建模为消息选择加证据改写的结构化动作，采用分解门控奖励流水线（从有效性到质量逐级门控，尽早暴露可回答性反馈）与结构对齐的 advantage 分配，把每段奖励归到对应输出 span。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上超过强基线，取得最高 QA 准确率与最快运行时，记忆操作不消耗商业 API token。
Conclusion: 把记忆单元的构造推迟到查询时刻并用 RL 训练查询条件化蒸馏，可同时提升长期记忆 QA 准确率与记忆系统效率。

papers.title: Learning Spatiotemporal Sensitivity in Video LLMs via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (Video LLMs) can achieve strong video-QA accuracy without reliably tracking spatiotemporal dynamics. A model may answer a motion question from static cues, for example, and give the same prediction even after the underlying motion is reversed. Correctness-based reinforcement learning does not directly address this problem because it rewards the final answer without requiring the policy to respond to task-relevant video dynamics. We propose Counterfactual Relational Policy Optimization (CRPO), which explicitly trains Video LLMs to respond to controlled changes in the visual input. For each training example, CRPO constructs a counterfactual video, such as a horizontally flipped or temporally reversed version of the original, and jointly optimizes rollouts from both videos under a shared policy. Factual supervision anchors what the model should answer, while counterfactual supervision constrains when that answer should change: predictions should change when an intervention alters task-relevant dynamics and remain stable when the queried property is preserved. This coupling provides a direct behavioral learning signal without requiring ground-truth labels for transformed videos or annotated spatiotemporal reasoning traces, while discouraging indiscriminate answer changes. To evaluate this property, we introduce DyBench, a paired counterfactual benchmark with 3{,}014 videos and a strict pair-accuracy metric. Across paired spatiotemporal evaluations and standard video benchmarks, CRPO improves sensitivity to motion and temporal changes while improving performance on general video understanding. The gains also extend to segment reordering, a transformation never used during training, suggesting that CRPO learns sensitivity to video dynamics beyond the training interventions. The project website can be found at https://ddz16.github.io/crpo.github.io/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video LLM 常靠静态线索答对运动题，动作反转后预测不变。CRPO 为每个样本构造水平翻转或时间倒放的反事实视频，在同一策略下联合优化事实与反事实 rollout：干预改变任务相关动态时答案须变，被查询属性不变时答案须稳。新基准 DyBench 含 3{,}014 段配对视频与严格 pair-accuracy，CRPO 同时提升运动/时间敏感性与常规视频理解，且收益迁移到训练未用的片段重排。
Motivation: Video LLM 的 video-QA 准确率可以很高却不追踪时空动态，例如靠静态线索答运动题、动作反转后预测不变；基于正确性的 RL 只奖励最终答案，不约束策略对任务相关视频动态的响应。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Relational Policy Optimization (CRPO)：对每个训练样本构造反事实视频（水平翻转或时间倒放），在同一策略下联合优化两段视频的 rollout；事实监督锚定正确答案，反事实监督约束答案何时应变，无需变换视频的真值标签或时空推理标注。
Result: 引入配对反事实基准 DyBench，含 3{,}014 段视频与严格 pair-accuracy 指标。在配对时空评测与常规视频基准上，CRPO 提升对运动与时间变化的敏感性，同时提升通用视频理解；收益还延伸到训练中从未使用的 segment reordering。
Conclusion: 用反事实配对监督而非仅正确性奖励，能让 Video LLM 学到超出所用干预的视频动态敏感性。

papers.title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues
papers.abstract_en: Video temporal grounding (VTG), which localizes the start and end times of a queried event in an untrimmed video, is a key test of whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) understand not only what happens but also when it happens. Although modern MLLMs describe video content fluently, their timestamp predictions remain unreliable, while existing remedies either require costly post-training on temporal annotations or rely on coarse training-free heuristics. In this work, we probe the cross-modal attention of MLLMs and uncover a perception-generation gap. Our key finding is that MLLMs often know the target interval during prefill, but lose this signal when generating the final answer. In the prefill stage, a sparse set of attention heads, which we call Temporal Grounding Heads (TG-Heads), concentrates query-to-video attention on the ground-truth interval. During autoregressive decoding, however, the answer tokens shift attention away from this interval toward visually salient but query-irrelevant segments. This observation motivates an inference-time read-then-regenerate framework. We first convert TG-Head prefill attention into a debiased frame-level relevance signal and extract the high-attention interval it highlights. We then re-invoke the MLLM with visual context restricted to this interval using video cropping. Without parameter updates or architectural changes, our framework consistently improves MiMo-VL, Qwen3-VL, and Molmo2 on three benchmarks, with gains of up to +3.5 mIoU. The project website can be found at https://ddz16.github.io/mllmsknowwhen.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视频时序定位 (VTG) 中 MLLM 其实在 prefill 阶段就已通过少数 Temporal Grounding Heads (TG-Heads) 把 query-to-video 注意力集中到真值区间，但自回归解码时答案 token 把注意力带偏到视觉显著却与查询无关的片段。据此提出推理时 read-then-regenerate：把 TG-Heads 的 prefill 注意力去偏成帧级相关信号、截取高注意力区间，再用 video cropping 限制视觉上下文重跑模型，不更新参数即可在三个 benchmark 上一致提升 MiMo-VL、Qwen3-VL 与 Molmo2，mIoU 最高 +3.5。
Motivation: MLLM 视频描述流畅但时间戳预测不可靠，现有补救要么依赖时序标注做昂贵 post-training，要么依赖粗糙的 training-free 启发式。
Method: 先探查跨模态注意力，定位稀疏的 TG-Heads 在 prefill 时把 query-to-video 注意力压到真值区间；再把该注意力转成去偏的帧级相关信号并抽取高注意力区间，最后以 video cropping 限制视觉上下文重新调用 MLLM，全程无参数更新与结构改动。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 上对 MiMo-VL、Qwen3-VL、Molmo2 一致提升，mIoU 增益最高达 +3.5。

papers.title: Stage-adaptive Token Selection for Efficient Omni-modal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The unified audio-visual understanding capability of omni-modal large language models (om-LLMs) comes at the high cost of processing tens of thousands of visual and audio tokens throughout the LLM. To reduce the cost, training-free methods for om-LLM token selection are being actively developed, operating either pre-LLM or inner-LLM. Recognizing that the non-textual token redundancy varies across stages and LLM layers, we propose in this paper a novel stage-adaptive token selection (SEATS) method that operates in both pre-LLM and inner-LLM stages. Given an overall token budget measured by the token retention rate (TRR), SEATS performs top-down token budget allocation in an input-dependent manner. Specifically, a larger TRR is used for pre-LLM token selection, whilst within the LLM, all tokens are retained in shallow layers, increasingly decreased TRRs are applied in middle layers, and the non-textual tokens are fully removed in late layers. Extensive experiments on three representative om-LLMs and six benchmarks verify the viability of the proposed method. By retaining only 10\% of visual and audio tokens, SEATS preserves 94.9\% of the full-token performance on Qwen2.5-Omni while achieving a 9.3x FLOPs reduction and a 4.9x prefill speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEATS 在 pre-LLM 与 inner-LLM 两阶段按层自适应分配 token 预算：浅层全保留、中层逐层降低 token 保留率 (TRR)、深层彻底移除非文本 token，且 pre-LLM 阶段给更高 TRR。只保留 10% 视觉与音频 token 时，Qwen2.5-Omni 上保住全 token 性能的 94.9%，FLOPs 降 9.3 倍、prefill 加速 4.9 倍。
Motivation: omni-modal LLM 的统一音视理解要让 LLM 处理数以万计的视觉与音频 token，成本极高；现有免训练 token 选择方法只在 pre-LLM 或 inner-LLM 单侧操作，忽略了非文本 token 冗余度随阶段与层变化这一事实。
Method: 提出 stage-adaptive token selection (SEATS)，在 pre-LLM 与 inner-LLM 两阶段做免训练 token 选择；给定总体 token 预算（以 token retention rate, TRR 衡量），按输入依赖方式自顶向下分配：pre-LLM 用较高 TRR，LLM 内浅层全保留、中层 TRR 逐层递减、深层完全移除非文本 token。
Result: 在三个代表性 om-LLM 与六个 benchmark 上实验；仅保留 10% 视觉与音频 token 时，Qwen2.5-Omni 上保住全 token 性能的 94.9%，同时 FLOPs 降低 9.3 倍、prefill 加速 4.9 倍。
Conclusion: 非文本 token 的冗余度确实随 LLM 层与阶段变化，把预算按层自适应分配即可在极低保留率下基本保住全 token 性能并大幅削减计算与预填充开销。

papers.title: PACE-FNO: Physics-Aligned Canonical Equivariance for Fourier Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators are often tested on states that differ physically from training data. A distinct failure occurs when the physical dynamics are unchanged but the observed coordinate frame differs from training. PACE-FNO addresses this case by estimating the frame, predicting after pulling the field to a canonical representative, and restoring the requested terminal frame. The default inference path uses one forward prediction; optional test-time adaptation (TTA) updates only the low-dimensional coordinate. On translated and Galilean-shifted Burgers and shallow-water systems, PACE-FNO lowers out-of-distribution (OOD) relative error by up to $12\times$ relative to a data-augmented Fourier Neural Operator (FNO+Aug). A matched-estimator control supports attributing the gain to prediction in the canonical frame rather than added estimator capacity. Our analysis separates the canonical approximation error from the two alignment residuals. We also test regional WeatherBench2 time-series forecasting with the fifth-generation ECMWF reanalysis (ERA5) under natural time OOD, where PACE-FNO and FNO achieve nearly identical performance. Experiments with approximate rotation, other backbones, irregular domains, rollouts, and image data delineate the conditions under which the mechanism is effective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACE-FNO 针对「动力不变、只换坐标系」的分布外 (OOD) 失效：先估计坐标系，把场拉回 canonical representative 再预测，最后还原到目标坐标系；默认单次前向，可选 TTA 只更新低维坐标。在平移与 Galilean 平移的 Burgers 和 shallow-water 上，OOD 相对误差比数据增强的 FNO+Aug 最多降低 12 倍，而 WeatherBench2/ERA5 自然时间 OOD 下与普通 FNO 几乎持平。
Motivation: 神经算子常在物理上与训练不同的状态上测试，但还有一类更隐蔽的失效：动力学完全不变、只是观测坐标系与训练不同，现有数据增强难以针对性解决。
Method: 三段式推理：估计坐标 frame，把场拉到 canonical representative 后用 FNO 做一次前向预测，再还原到请求的终端 frame；可选 test-time adaptation (TTA) 只更新低维坐标。分析把 canonical 近似误差与两个 alignment 残差分开，并用 matched-estimator control 排除估计器容量的贡献。
Result: 在平移与 Galilean 平移的 Burgers 与 shallow-water 系统上，OOD 相对误差相对 FNO+Aug 最多降低 12 倍；matched-estimator control 支持增益来自 canonical frame 预测而非估计器容量。区域 WeatherBench2 时间序列（ERA5，自然时间 OOD）上 PACE-FNO 与 FNO 表现几乎相同；另测试了近似旋转、其他 backbone、不规则域、rollout 与图像数据。
Conclusion: 坐标对齐机制在坐标系变化型 OOD 上有效且增益来自 canonical frame 预测本身，但在自然时间 OOD 的天气预报上不带来优势，其适用条件由旋转近似、backbone、域规则性等实验划定。

papers.title: Latent Action Reparameterization for Efficient Agent Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents often rely on long sequences of low-level textual actions, resulting in large effective decision horizons and high inference cost. While prior work has focused on improving inference efficiency through system-level optimizations or prompt engineering, we argue that a key bottleneck lies in the representation of the action space itself. We propose Latent Action Reparameterization (LAR), a framework that learns a compact latent action space in which each latent action corresponds to a multi-step semantic behavior. By reparameterizing agent actions into latent units, LAR enables decision making over a shorter effective horizon while preserving the expressiveness of the original action space. Unlike hand-crafted macros or hierarchical controllers, latent actions are learned from agent trajectories and integrated directly into the model, allowing both planning and execution to operate over abstract action representations. Across a range of LLM-based agent benchmarks, LAR significantly reduces the effective action horizon and improves inference efficiency under fixed compute budgets. As a consequence, our approach achieves substantial reductions in action tokens and corresponding wall-clock inference time, while maintaining or improving task success rates. These results suggest that action representation learning is a critical and underexplored factor in scaling efficient LLM agent inference, complementary to advances in model architecture and hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 推理慢的根因被归到动作空间表示本身：Latent Action Reparameterization (LAR) 学一个紧凑 latent action 空间，每个 latent action 对应多步语义行为，把决策压到更短的有效 horizon。在多个 LLM agent benchmark 上，固定算力预算下动作 token 与墙钟推理时间大幅下降，同时任务成功率持平或提升。
Motivation: LLM agent 依赖长串低层文本动作，有效决策 horizon 大、推理成本高；已有工作只做系统级优化或 prompt 工程，动作表示这一瓶颈被忽视。
Method: LAR 从 agent 轨迹中学习 latent action，把原始动作重参数化为抽象单元，latent action 直接集成进模型，使规划与执行都在抽象动作表示上进行，区别于手工 macro 与分层控制器。
Result: 在一系列 LLM agent benchmark 上，LAR 显著缩短有效动作 horizon，并在固定算力预算下提升推理效率；动作 token 数与对应墙钟推理时间大幅减少，任务成功率维持或提高。
Conclusion: 动作表示学习是扩展高效 LLM agent 推理的关键且未被充分研究的因素，与模型架构和硬件进步互补。

papers.title: Low Latency Gaze Tracking via Latent Optical Sensing
papers.abstract_en: We present a real-time gaze tracking system that directly acquires task-relevant latent features using a fully passive optical encoder. Instead of forming and processing full-resolution images, our approach leverages a microlens array with a co-designed binary chromium mask to perform spatially multiplexed optical encoding, producing a compact set of measurements sufficient for gaze estimation. By integrating sensing and feature extraction in the optical domain, the proposed system eliminates the need for high-bandwidth image readout and substantially reduces computational overhead. The encoded measurements are captured by a 4 x 4 phototransistor array and mapped to gaze direction using a lightweight neural network. Our proof-of-concept prototype enables an end-to-end sensing-to-inference latency of 3.4 ms, outperforming published research systems. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on both simulated and real-world data, achieving competitive gaze estimation accuracy while significantly reducing end-to-end latency compared to conventional camera-based pipelines. The proposed system establishes a new operating point in the accuracy-latency-compute trade-off for latency- and resource-constrained gaze tracking. This work highlights the potential of task-driven optical sensing for ultra-low-latency, computationally efficient human-computer interaction systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用微透镜阵列与共设计的二元铬掩模在光学域直接编码任务相关潜特征，4×4 光电晶体管阵列的紧凑测量经轻量神经网络直接映射为视线方向，绕过高分辨率图像读出。原型端到端传感到推理延迟 3.4 ms，优于已发表研究系统，在仿真与真实数据上以有竞争力的视线估计精度换取大幅降低的延迟。
Motivation: 常规相机管线先成全分辨率图像再做视线估计，图像读出带宽与计算开销把端到端延迟顶高，难以满足延迟与资源受限的 HCI 场景。
Method: 微透镜阵列与共设计二元铬掩模 (binary chromium mask) 做空间复用光学编码，把场景压成一组紧凑测量；4×4 光电晶体管阵列接收后由轻量神经网络直接回归视线方向，传感与特征提取合并在光学域完成。
Result: 原型实现端到端 3.4 ms 传感到推理延迟，优于已发表研究系统；在仿真与真实数据上均达到有竞争力的视线估计精度，并显著降低相对传统相机管线的端到端延迟。
Conclusion: 把任务驱动的光学传感与特征提取合并，可以在精度-延迟-计算的权衡上开出新的工作点，适用于延迟与资源受限的视线追踪。

papers.title: AMO: Operator-level Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: Muon has recently emerged as a competitive alternative to AdamW for large-scale pre-training, with orthogonalization via Newton-Schulz (NS) iteration as its core operation. Standard Muon applies a uniform NS schedule to all parameter matrices, overlooking possible differences in orthogonalization difficulty and its impact on performance. Through a systematic empirical study, we show that this per-matrix heterogeneity is pervasive and strongly associated with matrix geometry, which evolves dynamically across operator types, training stages, and network depths. Therefore, uniform NS schedules can lead to uneven orthogonalization quality across the model. Motivated by these findings, we propose Operator-level Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization (AMO), an observe-then-commit method that measures weight geometry by operator type early in training and then uses these signals to allocate the NS budget for the remainder of training. AMO delivers consistent improvements over uniform-schedule Muon across standard, prolonged, and continual pre-training, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.76 on Llama3.1-1.4B and +0.51 on Qwen3-1.7B in average downstream performance of 12 evaluation tasks, with gains persisting at Llama3.1-4B scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMO 发现 Muon 对所有参数矩阵统一的 Newton-Schulz (NS) 迭代预算会造成正交化质量不均，因为正交化难度随算子类型、训练阶段和网络深度动态变化。它在训练早期按算子类型度量权重几何，再据此一次性分配后续训练的 NS 预算。在 12 项下游任务的平均性能上，Llama3.1-1.4B 超最强基线 +0.76、Qwen3-1.7B +0.51，增益在 Llama3.1-4B 规模仍保持。
Motivation: 标准 Muon 对全部参数矩阵施加统一 NS 调度，忽略各矩阵正交化难度的差异，导致模型内正交化质量不均，可能拖累大规模预训练性能。
Method: AMO 采用 observe-then-commit 策略：训练早期按算子类型度量权重几何（矩阵几何信号），随后用这些信号为剩余训练分配 NS 迭代预算；在标准、延长与持续预训练三种设置下与 Muon 基线对比。
Result: 在 12 项下游任务的平均性能上，AMO 超最强基线 +0.76（Llama3.1-1.4B）与 +0.51（Qwen3-1.7B），增益在 Llama3.1-4B 规模上持续存在，并在 standard、prolonged、continual pre-training 中一致改进。
Conclusion: 按算子类型自适应分配 NS 预算比统一调度更有效，正交化难度的按算子异质性是 Muon 性能的可利用杠杆，且该收益随模型规模扩大仍保持。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: AMO 发现 Muon 对所有参数矩阵统一的 Newton-Schulz (NS) 迭代预算会造成正交化质量不均，因为正交化难度随算子类型、训练阶段和网络深度动态变化。它在训练早期按算子类型度量权重几何，再据此一次性分配后续训练的 NS 预算。在 12 项下游任务的平均性能上，Llama3.1-1.4B 超最强基线 +0.76、Qwen3-1.7B +0.51，增益在 Llama3.1-4B 规模仍保持。
summary_sections.motivation: 标准 Muon 对全部参数矩阵施加统一 NS 调度，忽略各矩阵正交化难度的差异，导致模型内正交化质量不均，可能拖累大规模预训练性能。
summary_sections.method: AMO 采用 observe-then-commit 策略：训练早期按算子类型度量权重几何（矩阵几何信号），随后用这些信号为剩余训练分配 NS 迭代预算；在标准、延长与持续预训练三种设置下与 Muon 基线对比。
summary_sections.result: 在 12 项下游任务的平均性能上，AMO 超最强基线 +0.76（Llama3.1-1.4B）与 +0.51（Qwen3-1.7B），增益在 Llama3.1-4B 规模上持续存在，并在 standard、prolonged、continual pre-training 中一致改进。

papers.title: ContractBench: Can LLM Agents Preserve Observation Contracts?
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented LLM agents call APIs whose intermediate outputs, such as presigned URLs, session tokens, and OAuth state parameters, are observation contracts: artifacts whose later use is constrained by the external system that produced them. We show that observation contract compliance (preserving the temporal validity and byte-level integrity) is an emergent, regression-prone capability: it is neither guaranteed by general tool-use ability nor consistently improved by larger or newer models. To measure this, we introduce ContractBench, a benchmark of 33 dual-axis tasks that probe two orthogonal failure modes no existing benchmark evaluates: validity failures (using an artifact after expiry) and integrity failures (corrupting an artifact's bytes through the observation-to-action pipeline). Our evaluation is deterministic and programmatic, with a virtual clock controlling time and SHA-256 hashes verifying byte integrity. We assign each outcome a failure label drawn from real-world API specifications. We evaluate 38 models and report four findings: (i) no evaluated model clears 80%, with Claude-Opus-4.6 leading at 77.8%, revealing that current frontier models still fail to comply with observation contracts; (ii) a sharp within-family capability cliff in Qwen 3.5 between 4B (0%) and 9B (56.6%), smoothing to 70.7% at 397B-A17B: what emerges across the cliff is mid-trajectory restraint, not tool-call competence; (iii) non-monotonic scaling across the GPT-5 family: agentic post-training can erode compliance through sycophancy-driven regression; (iv) our failure taxonomy works as an actionable in-context reward signal, yielding +7.1 pp on 42 paired GPT-5.1 failures.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContractBench 用 33 个双轴任务测 LLM agent 能否保住 observation contract（如 presigned URL、session token、OAuth state 的时效与字节完整性），38 个模型无一过 80%，Claude-Opus-4.6 最高 77.8%。合规是会回退的涌现能力：Qwen 3.5 在 4B 到 9B 之间从 0% 跳到 56.6%，GPT-5 家族随 agentic post-training 出现非单调下滑；失败分类法可作 in-context 奖励信号，在 42 个配对 GPT-5.1 失败上提升 +7.1 pp。
Motivation: 工具增强 LLM agent 依赖外部系统产出的中间产物，其后续使用受时效与字节完整性约束，但现有 benchmark 不测这两类失效，且通用 tool-use 能力与模型规模都不保证合规。
Method: 构建 ContractBench：33 个双轴任务分别探测 validity（过期后仍用）与 integrity（在 observation-to-action 管线中破坏字节）两类失效；评测确定性可编程，用虚拟时钟控制时间、SHA-256 校验字节完整性，每个结果按真实 API 规范打上失败标签；在 38 个模型上评测，并把失败分类法用作 in-context 奖励信号做干预。
Result: 38 个模型无一超过 80%，Claude-Opus-4.6 以 77.8% 居首；Qwen 3.5 家族内 4B 为 0%、9B 为 56.6%、397B-A17B 为 70.7%，断崖处涌现的是 mid-trajectory restraint 而非 tool-call 能力；GPT-5 家族跨规模非单调，agentic post-training 因 sycophancy-driven regression 反而侵蚀合规；失败分类法作为奖励信号在 42 个配对 GPT-5.1 失败上带来 +7.1 pp。
Conclusion: observation contract 合规既不由通用工具能力保证，也不随模型变大变新单调提升，需要专门的评测与可操作的失败信号来约束。

papers.title: DeepArrhythmia: Segment-Contextualized ECG Arrhythmia Classification via Selective Evidence Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Beat-level Electrocardiography (ECG) arrhythmia detection aims to assign an arrhythmia class to each beat in a recording, yet many existing systems treat beats as isolated local instances. This is limiting because beat labels often depend on multi-beat rhythm context, including timing, compensatory pauses, and beat-to-beat morphological consistency. We present DeepArrhythmia, a tool-grounded multimodal framework for segment-contextualized beat-level ECG arrhythmia classification. Given a multi-beat ECG segment, DeepArrhythmia combines the raw ECG signal and a rendered waveform image, localizes R peaks to identify beat instances, and produces structured beat-level predictions. The framework decouples physiological measurement from evidence integration using specialized tools for beat localization, numerical rhythm--morphology extraction, and morphology-focused textual analysis. DeepArrhythmia uses segment-level confidence to route between minimal and rich evidence states, since richer physiological evidence is not uniformly useful. This agentic design integrates rhythm context, explicit physiological grounding, and selective evidence acquisition for decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepArrhythmia 把心拍当作孤立样本的做法判为错误前提，提出工具驱动的多模态框架：对多拍 ECG 段同时吃原始信号与渲染波形图，用专用工具定位 R 峰、抽取节律-形态数值与形态文本分析，再按段级置信度在最小证据与丰富证据两种状态间路由。输出为带节律上下文的结构化逐拍心律失常分类。
Motivation: 逐拍 ECG 心律失常标注依赖多拍节律上下文（时序、代偿间歇、拍间形态一致性），而现有系统把每拍当作孤立的局部实例处理，丢失了这些依赖。
Method: DeepArrhythmia 是 tool-grounded 多模态 agentic 框架：输入多拍 ECG 段的原始信号与渲染波形图像，先用工具定位 R 峰确定拍实例，再由专用工具分别完成拍定位、节律-形态数值抽取与形态聚焦的文本分析，把生理测量与证据整合解耦；以段级置信度在最小证据与丰富证据状态间选择性获取证据，最后产出结构化逐拍预测。
Result: 给出结构化逐拍预测，融合节律上下文、显式生理 grounding 与选择性证据获取；摘要中的贡献为框架与设计本身，未给出数据集、指标或与基线的数值对比。
Conclusion: 逐拍心律失常分类应按段做上下文化，并让证据丰富度随段级置信度自适应，因为更丰富的生理证据并非对所有段都有用。

papers.title: Who Owns This Agent? Tracing AI Agents Back to Their Owners
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly act autonomously in the world, yet harmful behavior cannot be reliably traced to the account that deployed the agent. This creates an accountability gap across both benign and malicious settings: misconfigured or hijacked agents may cause unintended harm, while malicious operators may deploy agents for scams, harassment, or cyberattacks. In many cases, these agents rely on vendor-hosted language models. Affected parties can observe the harm, but cannot identify the responsible vendor session or account. We formalize this problem as agent attribution: linking an observed agent interaction to the account responsible for the underlying model calls. We present a canary-based protocol in which an authorized party embeds selected signals in content consumed by the agent, then asks the vendor to search a narrow time window of account-linked session logs. Lexical canaries provide exact-match attribution when a benign operator does not deliberately evade detection. Against adaptive adversaries, we use task-relevant semantic canaries whose removal or replacement also removes information required for successful task execution, creating a utility--evasion asymmetry. Across communication, web, and cyber-agent settings, we show that the protocol supports reliable session attribution, withstands adaptive transformations, and scales to practical vendor-side log search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI agent 的有害行为归因到部署账户被形式化为 agent attribution 问题，并提出 canary 协议：授权方在 agent 消费的内容里嵌入信号，再让厂商在窄时间窗内检索账户关联的 session 日志。词法 canary 在良性运营者不刻意规避时给出精确匹配归因；面对自适应对手改用任务相关语义 canary，删除或替换它会同时毁掉任务所需信息，形成效用–规避不对称。
Motivation: 自主 agent 造成的危害无法可靠追溯到部署账户：配置错误或被劫持的 agent 产生非预期损害，恶意运营者用其做诈骗、骚扰或网络攻击，受害方能看到伤害却定位不到对应的厂商 session 或账户。
Method: 将问题形式化为 agent attribution（把观测到的 agent 交互链接到背后模型调用所属账户）；协议分两步——在 agent 消费的内容中嵌入选定 canary 信号，再要求厂商在窄时间窗内搜索账户关联的 session 日志。词法 canary 走精确匹配，自适应对手场景改用任务相关语义 canary，其移除或替换会同时移除成功执行任务所需的信息。
Result: 在 communication、web、cyber-agent 三类场景中，协议支持可靠的 session 归因、能抵御自适应变换，并可扩展到实际的厂商侧日志搜索。
Conclusion: 借助厂商侧日志检索，agent 行为可以归因到责任账户；语义 canary 通过效用–规避不对称在对手主动规避时仍维持归因能力。

papers.title: Not All Tasks Quantize Equally: Fisher-Guided Quantization for Visual Geometry Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, represented by Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), jointly predict multiple visual geometry tasks such as depth estimation, camera pose prediction, and point cloud reconstruction in a single forward pass. They have been widely adopted in 3D vision applications, but their billion-scale parameters bring substantial memory and computation overhead, posing challenges for on-device deployment. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is an effective technique to reduce this overhead. Existing PTQ methods for feed-forward 3D models mainly focus on handling heavy-tailed activation distributions and constructing diverse calibration datasets. However, we observe that feed-forward 3D models predict multiple geometric attributes through a shared backbone, where different transformer blocks and hidden channels contribute distinctly to each task, resulting in substantially different sensitivities to quantization errors across tasks, blocks, and channels. Consequently, treating all tasks equally over-emphasizes insensitive tasks and causes significant accuracy loss on the sensitive ones. To address this issue, we propose Fisher-Guided Quantization (FGQ) for feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. Specifically, FGQ uses the diagonal Fisher information matrix to quantify the different sensitivities across tasks, blocks, and channels, and incorporates these sensitivities into the Learnable Affine Transformation during calibration to better preserve the channels and blocks most critical to each task. Extensive experiments across camera pose estimation, point map reconstruction, and depth estimation show that FGQ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art quantization baselines on VGGT, achieving up to 39% relative improvement under the 4-bit quantization. Code is available at https://github.com/ypzhng/FGQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 前馈 3D 重建模型 VGGT 的共享 backbone 中，不同 block 与 hidden channel 对 depth、camera pose、point map 各任务的贡献差异很大，等权对待所有任务会过度保护不敏感任务、让敏感任务掉点。FGQ 用对角 Fisher 信息矩阵量化任务/block/channel 三级量化敏感度，并在标定阶段并入 Learnable Affine Transformation，4-bit 量化下相对 SOTA 量化基线最高提升 39%。
Motivation: VGGT 这类十亿参数前馈 3D 模型难以部署到端侧；现有 PTQ 只处理重尾激活分布与标定集多样性，忽略了多任务共享 backbone 时各任务对量化误差敏感度差异巨大这一问题。
Method: 提出 Fisher-Guided Quantization (FGQ)：用对角 Fisher information matrix 度量不同任务、block、channel 对量化误差的敏感度，把该敏感度在标定 (calibration) 阶段并入 Learnable Affine Transformation，优先保护对各任务最关键的 channel 与 block。
Result: 在 camera pose estimation、point map reconstruction、depth estimation 三个任务上，FGQ 在 VGGT 上一致优于现有 SOTA 量化基线，4-bit 量化下相对提升最高达 39%。
Conclusion: 多任务前馈 3D 模型的 PTQ 必须按任务/block/channel 差异化分配量化保护，等权处理会造成敏感任务显著掉点；代码已开源。

papers.title: CM-EVS: Sparse Panoramic RGB-D-Pose Data for Complete Scene Coverage
papers.abstract_en: Modern 3D visual learning relies on observations sampled from metric 3D assets, yet existing scans, meshes, point clouds, simulations, and reconstructions do not directly provide a sparse, comparable, and geometry-consistent panoramic training interface. Dense trajectories duplicate nearby views, source-specific rendering policies yield heterogeneous annotations, and sparse heuristics may miss important regions or introduce depth-inconsistent observations. We study how to convert 3D assets into sparse panoramic RGB-D-pose data that preserves complete scene coverage with low redundancy and auditable provenance. We propose COVER (Coverage-Oriented Viewpoint curation with ERP Range-depth warping), a training-free ERP viewpoint curator that projects geometry observed from selected views into candidate ERP probes, scores incremental coverage, and penalizes depth conflicts. Under bounded proxy error, its greedy coverage proxy preserves the standard coverage-style approximation behavior up to an additive error term. Using COVER, we build CM-EVS (Coverage-curated Metric ERP View Set), a panoramic RGB-D-pose dataset with 36,373 curated ERP frames from 1,275 indoor scenes across Blender indoor, HM3D, and ScanNet++, complemented by outdoor panoramas from TartanGround and OB3D re-encoded into the same schema. Each frame provides full-sphere RGB, metric range depth, calibrated pose; COVER-produced indoor frames include per-step provenance logs. With a median of only 25 frames per indoor scene, CM-EVS covers all 13 unified room types while maintaining compact scene-level coverage. Experiments show that COVER improves the coverage-conflict trade-off, making CM-EVS a sparse, compact, and auditable RGB-D-pose resource for geometry-consistent panoramic 3D learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CM-EVS 把 3D 资产转成稀疏、可审计的全景 RGB-D-pose 训练数据：COVER 用 ERP range-depth warping 把已选视角的几何投影到候选 ERP 探针，贪心打分增量覆盖并惩罚深度冲突，每室内场景中位数仅 25 帧即可覆盖全部 13 类统一房型。数据集含 36,373 帧、1,275 个室内场景，实验显示 COVER 改善了覆盖-冲突权衡。
Motivation: 现有扫描、网格、点云与重建不直接提供稀疏、可比、几何一致的全景训练接口：稠密轨迹重复邻近视角，源特定渲染策略导致标注异构，稀疏启发式会漏掉重要区域或引入深度不一致观测。
Method: COVER 是 training-free 的 ERP 视角策展器：把选定视角观测到的几何投影到候选 ERP 探针，贪心打分增量覆盖并惩罚深度冲突；在有界代理误差下，其贪心覆盖代理保持标准覆盖式近似行为至一个加性误差项。用 COVER 构建 CM-EVS，室内帧附带逐步 provenance 日志。
Result: CM-EVS 含 36,373 帧精选 ERP 帧、1,275 个室内场景，来自 Blender indoor、HM3D、ScanNet++，另有 TartanGround 与 OB3D 户外全景统一编码；每室内场景中位数 25 帧覆盖全部 13 类统一房型。实验显示 COVER 改善覆盖-冲突权衡。
Conclusion: 以覆盖为导向的贪心视角策展加深度冲突惩罚，可以在极低帧数下保住完整场景覆盖与可审计来源，使 CM-EVS 成为几何一致全景 3D 学习的稀疏紧凑资源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Where Should Diffusion Enter a Language Model? Geometry-Guided Hidden-State Replacement
papers.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion language models require choosing a representation space in which denoising operates, yet it remains unclear which representations are most compatible with diffusion. We study a basic design question: where inside a pretrained language model should continuous diffusion operate? We formulate this as a hidden-state interface-selection problem and hypothesize that diffusion-friendly interfaces can be identified from representation geometry. We operationalize this hypothesis using three training-free geometric proxies: local compactness, global stiffness, and effective rank. Across two 8B-scale backbones, the resulting geometry score predicts fixed-budget diffusion bridgeability beyond the dominant effect of layer depth. We then instantiate DiHAL, a Locate-and-Replace framework that replaces the transformer prefix below a selected interface with conditional diffusion while retaining the pretrained suffix and LM head. Under full training, geometry-selected interfaces remain close to validation-loss oracles and outperform worst-layer controls, while the diffusion bridge outperforms a parameter-matched deterministic replacement under matched diagnostic conditions. These results suggest that the representation space in which diffusion operates should itself be treated as a first-class design variable for continuous diffusion in language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续扩散语言模型的插入位置形式化为 hidden-state 接口选择问题，用三个免训练几何代理（local compactness、global stiffness、effective rank）打分选层，再以 DiHAL 的 Locate-and-Replace 把选定接口以下的 transformer 前缀换成条件扩散、保留预训练后缀与 LM head。在两个 8B 级 backbone 上，几何分数在层深这一主导效应之外仍能预测固定预算下的 diffusion bridgeability；全量训练时几何所选接口接近验证损失 oracle 并优于最差层对照，扩散桥也优于参数量匹配的确定性替换。
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型必须选定去噪所作用的表示空间，但预训练 LM 内部哪些表示与扩散最兼容尚不清楚，选层目前缺乏可操作的判据。
Method: 把选层写成 hidden-state interface-selection 问题，用三个免训练几何代理（local compactness、global stiffness、effective rank）合成 geometry score 排序候选接口；再实例化 DiHAL 框架，Locate-and-Replace 用条件扩散替换所选接口下方的 transformer 前缀，保留预训练后缀与 LM head，并与验证损失 oracle、最差层对照及参数量匹配的确定性替换在匹配诊断条件下比较。
Result: 在两个 8B 级 backbone 上，geometry score 在层深的主导效应之外仍能预测固定预算的 diffusion bridgeability；全量训练下几何所选接口接近验证损失 oracle 并超过最差层对照；在匹配诊断条件下扩散桥优于参数量匹配的确定性替换。
Conclusion: 扩散所作用的表示空间本身应被视为连续扩散语言模型的一等设计变量，且可由免训练的表示几何判据来选定接口。

papers.title: Regret Equals Covariance: A Closed-Form Characterization for Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying regret typically involves repeatedly re-solving a stochastic optimization problem across simulated scenarios. Such an approach is costly: the cost scales with the number of scenarios and the cost of each solve. We propose that regret can instead be measured using the joint moments of the cost vector $c$ and the optimal decision $π^*(c)$. Working with the optimal concave and Lipschitz under only a feasible region value function $v(c) = \min_{z\in Z} c^\top z$, we show that regret always decomposes as $\mathrm{Regret} = -\mathrm{Cov}(c,π^*(c)) - R(c)$ for a residual $R(c)$. We further show that $R(c)=0$ when $π^*$ is affine in $c$, which holds for unconstrained and equality-constrained (e.g., budget-constrained Markowitz) quadratic programs and many, but not all, linear programs. For all cases, we give a distribution-free bound $\mathrm{Regret} \le D\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}(Σ_c)}$ that depends only on the radius of the feasible region and the cost covariance. We also derive concentration and asymptotic-normality results for the empirical regret, the latter under an explicit and checkable non-degeneracy condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把随机优化的 regret 从「跨情景反复重解」改写为闭式矩表达：Regret = -Cov(c, π*(c)) - R(c)，当最优解 π* 对成本 c 为仿射（无约束与等式约束二次规划，如预算约束 Markowitz，以及许多线性规划）时残差 R(c)=0，regret 直接等于负协方差。另给出只依赖可行域半径与成本协方差 Σ_c 的分布无关上界 Regret ≤ D√tr(Σ_c)，并推导经验 regret 的集中性与渐近正态性。
Motivation: 量化 regret 通常要在大量模拟情景上反复重解随机优化问题，成本随情景数与单次求解代价相乘而增长；作者要绕开这条昂贵路径。
Method: 用成本向量 c 与最优决策 π*(c) 的联合矩刻画 regret，核心对象是仅依赖可行域的最优值函数 v(c)=min_{z∈Z} cᵀz（凹且 Lipschitz）；在此之上给出分解 Regret = -Cov(c,π*(c)) - R(c)，判定 R(c)=0 的仿射条件，并推导分布无关界、经验 regret 的集中不等式与在显式可检验非退化条件下的渐近正态性。
Result: 分解式 Regret = -Cov(c,π*(c)) - R(c) 恒成立；R(c)=0 当 π* 关于 c 仿射，覆盖无约束与等式约束二次规划（含预算约束 Markowitz）及许多但非全部线性规划；分布无关上界 Regret ≤ D√tr(Σ_c)，只用可行域半径 D 与成本协方差；另给出经验 regret 的集中性与渐近正态结果。
Conclusion: regret 可以用成本与最优决策的协方差闭式刻画，从而免去跨情景重复求解；仿射最优解时残差消失，非仿射情形仍保留一个残差项与通用上界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross Modality Image Translation In Medical Imaging Using Generative Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Computed Tomography (CT), and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) provide complementary information about tissues. Medical image-to-image (I2I) translation enables virtual scanning by synthesizing a target modality from a source one without requiring an additional acquisition. Despite growing interest, many methods operate on 2D slices, are evaluated on isolated tasks under different experimental settings, and lack clinically oriented assessment. This work presents a reproducible benchmark for 3D I2I translation in oncological imaging that compares seven generative models: three Generative Adversarial Networks (Pix2Pix, CycleGAN, and SRGAN) and four latent models (Latent Diffusion Model, Latent Diffusion Model+ControlNet, Brownian Bridge, and Flow Matching). The benchmark comprises 77 experiments across eleven configurations drawn from five datasets, covering three anatomical regions (head/neck, lung, and pelvis) and four translation directions (cone-beam CT to CT, MRI to CT, CT to PET, and T2-weighted MRI to T2-FLAIR). Under the evaluated configurations, SRGAN achieves the highest quantitative image fidelity across all tasks, while latent models perform less well, due to information loss introduced by the variational autoencoder. A tumor-level analysis reveals that all models struggle with small lesions and that, in CT to PET synthesis, models reproduce tumor shape more reliably than tracer uptake values. A Visual Turing test involving 17 physicians, including 15 radiologists, shows near-chance classification accuracy (56.7\%), suggesting that experts struggle to distinguish real from synthetic volumes under the viewing conditions of the study. Expert preferences do not follow quantitative rankings, exposing a dissociation between quantitative metrics and clinical preference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向肿瘤影像的 3D 跨模态图像翻译 (I2I) 可复现基准，用 7 个生成模型在 5 个数据集、11 种配置上跑 77 组实验，覆盖 CBCT→CT、MRI→CT、CT→PET、T2→T2-FLAIR 四个方向。SRGAN 在全部任务上定量保真度最高，latent 模型因 VAE 信息损失表现较差；17 名医师的视觉图灵测试准确率仅 56.7%，且专家偏好与定量排名不一致。
Motivation: 现有医学 I2I 方法多在 2D 切片上做、任务彼此孤立且实验设置不统一，缺少面向临床的评估，难以横向比较。
Method: 构建可复现的 3D I2I 基准，比较 7 个生成模型：3 个 GAN（Pix2Pix、CycleGAN、SRGAN）与 4 个 latent 模型（Latent Diffusion Model、LDM+ControlNet、Brownian Bridge、Flow Matching）；共 77 组实验、11 种配置、5 个数据集，覆盖头颈/肺/盆腔三个部位与四个翻译方向，并加入肿瘤层面分析与 17 名医师（含 15 名放射科医生）的视觉图灵测试。
Result: 在所评估配置下 SRGAN 在所有任务上定量图像保真度最高，latent 模型因 VAE 引入的信息损失表现较差；所有模型都难以处理小病灶，CT→PET 合成中模型复现肿瘤形状比复现示踪剂摄取值更可靠。视觉图灵测试中 17 名医师（15 名放射科医生）的分类准确率为 56.7%，接近随机；专家偏好不遵循定量指标排名。
Conclusion: 定量指标与临床偏好在 3D 医学 I2I 上存在脱节，评估必须同时包含肿瘤层面分析与医师判断，且小病灶与 CT→PET 的摄取值合成是当前模型的薄弱环节。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CoRe-Gen: Robust Spectrum-to-Structure Generation under Imperfect Fingerprint Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) remains challenging, particularly for de novo generation beyond database coverage. A common approach decomposes the task into spectrum-to-fingerprint prediction followed by fingerprint-to-structure decoding, enabling the use of large-scale molecular corpora. However, at deployment, the decoder relies on predicted rather than oracle fingerprints, introducing structured errors that propagate into generation. Moreover, common autoregressive decoders threshold fingerprint probabilities and serialize active bits as discrete input tokens, blocking molecular generation gradients from the spectrum encoder. We present \textit{CoRe-Gen}, which improves the intermediate condition through synthetic-spectrum pretraining, matches deployment-time noise through frequency-aware corruption, and introduces a differentiable fingerprint-to-memory bridge for joint encoder--decoder finetuning. The bridge preserves soft bit confidences and conditions a structure-aware autoregressive decoder without discrete fingerprint tokenization. CoRe-Gen achieves 21.49\%/35.42\% Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy on NPLIB1 and, under encoder-aligned evaluation, 20.02\%/22.45\% on MassSpecGym, while retaining efficient autoregressive inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoRe-Gen 针对串联质谱 (MS/MS) 分子结构解析中“谱图→指纹→结构”两阶段管线的部署失配：用合成谱图预训练改善中间指纹条件、以频率感知损坏 (frequency-aware corruption) 匹配部署期噪声，并提出可微的 fingerprint-to-memory bridge 取代离散指纹 token，让谱图编码器的梯度能传到结构解码器。在 NPLIB1 上 Top-1/Top-10 exact-match 达 21.49%/35.42%，encoder-aligned 评测下 MassSpecGym 为 20.02%/22.45%。
Motivation: 部署时解码器吃的是预测指纹而非 oracle 指纹，结构化误差会传播进生成；同时常见自回归解码器把指纹概率阈值化后串成离散 token，切断了谱图编码器与分子生成之间的梯度。
Method: 三部分：合成谱图预训练改善中间指纹条件；频率感知损坏使训练噪声匹配部署期指纹噪声；可微 fingerprint-to-memory bridge 保留软 bit 置信度，直接条件化 structure-aware 自回归解码器，不做离散指纹 token 化，从而支持编码器-解码器联合微调。
Result: NPLIB1 上 Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy 为 21.49%/35.42%；encoder-aligned 评测下 MassSpecGym 为 20.02%/22.45%，并保持高效自回归推理。
Conclusion: 把中间指纹条件做噪声对齐并保持可微，能在超出数据库覆盖的 de novo 结构生成上取得可用的 exact-match 精度，同时不牺牲自回归推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: G$^2$TR: Generation-Guided Visual Token Reduction for Separate-Encoder Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: The development of separate-encoder Unified multimodal models (UMMs) comes with a rapidly growing inference cost due to dense visual token processing. In this paper, we focus on understanding-side visual token reduction for improving the efficiency of separate-encoder UMMs. While this topic has been widely studied for MLLMs, existing methods typically rely on attention scores, text-image similarity and so on, implicitly assuming that the final objective is discriminative reasoning. This assumption does not hold for UMMs, where understanding-side visual tokens must also preserve the model's capabilities for editing images. We propose G$^2$TR, a generation-guided visual token reduction framework for separate-encoder UMMs. Our key insight is that the generation branch provides a task-agnostic signal for identifying understanding-side visual tokens that are not only semantically relevant but also important for latent-space image reconstruction and generation. G$^2$TR estimates token importance from consistency with VAE latent, performs balanced token selection, and merges redundant tokens into retained representatives to reduce information loss. The method is training-free, plug-and-play, and applied only after the understanding encoding stage, making it compatible with existing UMM inference pipelines. Experiments on image understanding and editing benchmarks show that G$^2$TR substantially reduces visual tokens and prefill computation by 1.94x while maintaining both reasoning accuracy and editing quality, outperforming baselines on almost all benchmarks. Code is at: https://github.com/lijunxian111/G2TR.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026; Code is at https://github.com/lijunxian111/G2TR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G²TR 用生成分支给理解侧视觉 token 打分：以 token 与 VAE latent 的一致性估计重要性，做均衡选择并把冗余 token 合并进保留代表，从而在压缩 token 的同时保住图像编辑所需的重建信息。训练即插即用、只作用于理解编码之后，视觉 token 与 prefill 计算减少 1.94×，同时维持推理精度与编辑质量，在几乎所有基准上超过基线。
Motivation: 分编码器 Unified 多模态模型 (UMM) 因稠密视觉 token 处理导致推理成本快速上升；已有 token 剪枝方法默认最终目标是判别式推理，忽略了理解侧 token 还必须支撑图像编辑。
Method: 提出 generation-guided 视觉 token 剪枝框架 G²TR：从理解侧 token 与 VAE latent 的一致性估计重要性，做 balanced token selection，再把冗余 token 合并进保留代表以减少信息损失；训练-free、plug-and-play，仅在理解编码阶段之后应用，兼容现有 UMM 推理管线。

Conclusion: 生成分支可作为任务无关信号来挑选理解侧视觉 token，使压缩与编辑能力不必二选一；该方法可直接插入现有 UMM 推理管线。

papers.title: Deep Minds and Shallow Probes
papers.abstract_en: Neural representations are not unique objects. Even when two systems realize the same downstream computation, their hidden coordinates may differ by reparameterization. A probe family intended to reveal structure already present in a representation should therefore be stable under the relevant representation symmetries rather than be tied to a particular basis. We prove that, under standard nondegeneracy assumptions, behaviorally equivalent LLMs have hidden representations related by an invertible affine transformation. The resulting symmetry principle singles out a unique hierarchy of shallow coordinate-stable probes, with linear probes as its degree-1 member. We also show that a natural object for cross-model probe transfer is a shared probe-visible quotient--the representation modulo directions invisible to the probe family--rather than the full hidden state. Experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks support both predictions, showing where degree-2 probes help beyond linear ones and how quotient-based transfer enables coverage-aware monitor portability across model families. These results point toward a broader geometric representation theory of neural probing, with coverage-aware monitor transfer as a concrete operational consequence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明行为等价的 LLM 隐藏表示之间相差一个可逆仿射变换，据此导出一族在该对称性下坐标稳定的浅层 probe，线性 probe 是 degree-1 成员；跨模型迁移的正确对象是 probe 可见商空间 (probe-visible quotient) 而非完整隐藏状态。合成与真实任务实验显示 degree-2 probe 在何处超出线性 probe，以及商空间迁移如何实现跨模型族的 coverage-aware monitor portability。
Motivation: 神经表示的隐藏坐标在重参数化下不唯一，绑定特定基的 probe 家族无法揭示表示中真正存在的结构，跨模型迁移 probe 也因此缺乏稳固对象。
Method: 在标准非退化假设下证明行为等价 LLM 的隐藏表示由可逆仿射变换相联系；由该对称性导出唯一的浅层坐标稳定 probe 层级（linear probe 为 degree-1），并把跨模型 probe 迁移的对象定义为表示对 probe 家族不可见方向取模的共享商空间。
Result: 实验覆盖合成与真实任务，支持两项预测：degree-2 probe 在特定情形下优于线性 probe；基于商空间的迁移实现跨模型族的 coverage-aware monitor portability。
Conclusion: 神经 probing 需要一套几何表示理论：probe 应按表示对称性分层，跨模型迁移应作用于 probe 可见商空间，其操作性后果是 coverage-aware monitor transfer。

papers.title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image
papers.abstract_en: Tabular Foundation Models have recently established the state of the art in supervised tabular learning, by leveraging pretraining to learn generalizable representations of numerical and categorical structured data. However, they lack native support for unstructured modalities such as text and image, and rely on frozen, pretrained embeddings to process them. On established Multimodal Tabular Learning benchmarks, we show that tuning the embeddings to the task improves performance. Existing benchmarks, however, often focus on the mere co-occurrence of modalities; this leads to high variance across datasets and masks the benefits of task-specific tuning. To address this gap, we introduce MulTaBench, a benchmark of 40 datasets, split equally between image-tabular and text-tabular tasks. We focus on predictive tasks where the modalities provide complementary predictive signal, and where generic embeddings lose critical information, necessitating Target-Aware Representations that are aligned with the task. Our experimental results demonstrate that the gains from target-aware representation tuning generalize across both text and image modalities, several tabular learners, encoder scales, and embedding dimensions. MulTaBench constitutes the largest image-tabular benchmarking effort to date, spanning high-impact domains such as healthcare and e-commerce. It is designed to enable the research of novel architectures which incorporate joint modeling and target-aware representations, paving the way for the development of novel Multimodal Tabular Foundation Models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MulTaBench 是一个含 40 个数据集的多模态表格学习基准，图像-表格与文本-表格任务各占一半，专门挑选模态提供互补预测信号、通用冻结 embedding 会丢失关键信息的任务。结果显示按任务微调 embedding（target-aware representation tuning）的增益可跨文本与图像两种模态、多种表格学习器、编码器规模和 embedding 维度泛化。
Motivation: 表格基础模型 (Tabular Foundation Models) 缺少对文本、图像等非结构化模态的原生支持，只能依赖冻结的预训练 embedding；而现有多模态表格基准多聚焦模态共现，数据集间方差大，掩盖了任务相关微调的真实收益。
Method: 构建 40 个数据集的基准，图像-表格与文本-表格各 20 个，筛选标准是模态互补且通用 embedding 丢失关键信息；在此之上对比冻结 embedding 与 target-aware representation tuning，并跨多种表格学习器、编码器规模与 embedding 维度做实验。
Result: 基准含 40 个数据集，图像-表格与文本-表格任务各占一半；实验显示 target-aware representation tuning 的增益在文本与图像两种模态、多种表格学习器、多个编码器规模和 embedding 维度上均成立；涵盖 healthcare 与 e-commerce 等高影响领域，是迄今最大的图像-表格基准。
Conclusion: 多模态表格学习中应按任务微调 embedding 而非沿用冻结表示，且这一收益不依赖特定模态、学习器或 embedding 配置；基准旨在支撑联合建模与 target-aware 表示的新架构研究，以推动多模态表格基础模型发展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot imitation learning have produced powerful visuomotor policies that manipulate diverse objects from visual inputs. However, monocular observations lack depth information, which is critical for precise manipulation in cluttered or geometrically complex scenes. Explicit depth maps and point clouds are often noisy and fragile in real-world manipulation. We introduce StereoPolicy, a visuomotor policy learning framework that directly leverages synchronized stereo image pairs to improve spatial perception without constructing explicit 3D representations. StereoPolicy processes each image with pretrained 2D vision encoders and fuses left-right features through a cross-attention-based Stereo Transformer, learning task-conditioned binocular representations. The framework integrates with diffusion-based and pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, delivering consistent improvements over RGB, RGB-D, point cloud, and multi-view baselines across three simulation benchmarks and seven real-robot tabletop and bimanual mobile manipulation tasks. Our results support task-trained binocular fusion as an effective way to adapt 2D visual representations for manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StereoPolicy 直接用同步双目图像对替代显式深度图与点云，通过预训练 2D 编码器加跨注意力 Stereo Transformer 学习任务条件化的双眼表征，可接入 diffusion 与预训练 VLA 策略。在三个仿真基准与七个真实机器人桌面/双臂移动操作任务上，相对 RGB、RGB-D、点云和多视角基线均取得一致提升。
Motivation: 单目视觉缺少深度信息，而显式深度图与点云在真实操作中噪声大、易失效，杂乱或几何复杂场景下的精确操作因此受限。
Method: 每路图像用预训练 2D vision encoder 编码，左右特征经基于 cross-attention 的 Stereo Transformer 融合，得到任务条件化的 binocular 表征，不构建显式 3D 表示；该框架与 diffusion-based 策略及预训练 vision-language-action (VLA) 策略集成训练。
Result: 在三个仿真基准和七个真实机器人桌面与双臂移动操作任务上，相对 RGB、RGB-D、点云、多视角基线均取得一致提升（consistent improvements）。
Conclusion: 任务训练的双眼融合 (task-trained binocular fusion) 是把 2D 视觉表征适配到机器人操作的有效途径，无需显式 3D 重建。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ACSAC: Adaptive Chunk Size Actor-Critic with Causal Transformer Q-Network
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon, sparse-reward tasks pose a fundamental challenge for reinforcement learning, since single-step TD learning suffers from bootstrapping error accumulation across successive Bellman updates. Actor-critic methods with action chunking address this by operating over temporally extended actions, which reduce the effective horizon, enable fast value backups, and support temporally consistent exploration. However, existing methods rely on a fixed chunk size and therefore cannot adaptively balance reactivity against temporal consistency. A large fixed chunk size reduces responsiveness to new observations, while a small one produces incoherent motions, forcing task-specific tuning of the chunk size. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Chunk Size Actor-Critic (ACSAC). ACSAC leverages a causal Transformer critic to evaluate expected returns for action chunks of different sizes. At each chunk boundary, it adaptively selects the chunk size that maximizes the expected return, supporting flexible, state-dependent chunk sizes. We prove that the ACSAC Bellman operator is a $γ$-contraction whose unique fixed point is the action-value function of the adaptive policy. Experiments on OGBench demonstrate that ACSAC achieves strong performance on long-horizon, sparse-reward manipulation and navigation tasks across both offline RL and offline-to-online RL settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACSAC 用因果 Transformer critic 对不同长度的动作块 (action chunk) 打分，在每个块边界自适应选出期望回报最大的块大小，从而在反应性与时间一致性之间按状态取舍。证明其 Bellman 算子是 γ-收缩且唯一不动点为自适应策略的动作价值函数；在 OGBench 的长时程稀疏奖励操作与导航任务上，离线 RL 与 offline-to-online RL 两种设定均取得强性能。
Motivation: 长时程稀疏奖励任务中单步 TD 学习会跨 Bellman 更新累积 bootstrapping 误差，而现有动作块方法块大小固定：过大降低对新观测的响应，过小导致动作不连贯，只能逐任务调参。
Method: ACSAC 由因果 Transformer critic 评估不同大小动作块的期望回报，在每个块边界自适应选择使期望回报最大的块大小，得到状态相关的可变块长；理论上证明该 Bellman 算子为 γ-收缩，唯一不动点是自适应策略的动作价值函数。
Result: 在 OGBench 上，针对长时程、稀疏奖励的操作与导航任务，ACSAC 在离线 RL 和 offline-to-online RL 两种设定下均表现出强性能。
Conclusion: 块大小应按状态在线选择而非逐任务固定调参，因果 Transformer critic 可以支撑这种自适应决策并保持 Bellman 收敛性。

summary_sections.result: 在 OGBench 上，针对长时程、稀疏奖励的操作与导航任务，ACSAC 在离线 RL 和 offline-to-online RL 两种设定下均表现出强性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 块大小应按状态在线选择而非逐任务固定调参，因果 Transformer critic 可以支撑这种自适应决策并保持 Bellman 收敛性。

papers.title: When and How to Canonize: A Generalization Perspective
papers.abstract_en: While invariant architectures are standard for processing symmetric data, there is growing interest in achieving invariance by applying group averaging or canonization to non-invariant backbones. However, the theoretical generalization properties of these alternative strategies remain poorly understood. We introduce a theoretical framework to analyze the generalization error of these methods by bounding their covering numbers. We establish a rigorous generalization hierarchy: the error bounds of canonized models are at best equal to the error bounds of structurally invariant and group-averaged models, and at worst equal to the bounds of non-invariant baselines. Furthermore, we show that there exist optimal canonizations which attain the optimal error bounds, and poor canonizations which attain the non-invariant error bounds, and that this depends on the regularity of the canonization. Finally, applying this framework to permutation groups in point cloud processing, we rigorously prove that the covering number of lexicographical sorting grows exponentially with point cloud dimension, whereas Hilbert curve canonization guarantees polynomial growth. This provides the first formal theoretical justification for the empirical success of Hilbert curve serialization in state-of-the-art point cloud architectures. We conclude with experiments that support our theoretical claims. Code is available at https://github.com/yonatansverdlov/Canonization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出用 canonization（分组取代表元）替代不变架构时泛化误差的覆盖数上界框架：canonized 模型的误差界最好与结构性不变/群平均模型持平，最差退化到非不变基线，好坏取决于 canonization 的正则性。对点云置换群，字典序排序的覆盖数随维度指数增长，而 Hilbert 曲线 canonization 保证多项式增长，为 Hilbert 曲线序列化在点云架构中的经验成功给出首个形式化理论依据。
Motivation: 对非不变骨干用群平均或 canonization 获得不变性正流行，但这两条替代路线的泛化性质缺少理论刻画，无法判断何时该用、用哪种 canonization。
Method: 通过界定覆盖数 (covering number) 建立泛化误差的理论框架，比较 canonized、结构性不变、群平均与非不变四类模型的误差界，并把框架落到点云的置换群上分析字典序排序与 Hilbert 曲线两种 canonization。
Result: 证明 canonized 模型误差界上界为结构性不变/群平均模型的界、下界为非不变基线的界；存在达到最优界的最优 canonization 与退化到非平凡界的差 canonization，取决于正则性。点云上字典序排序的覆盖数随维度指数增长，Hilbert 曲线 canonization 保证多项式增长；摘要称以实验支持理论主张，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: canonization 的泛化能力由其正则性决定：选得好可达到不变模型的最优误差界，选得差则与非不变基线同阶；点云任务应优先用 Hilbert 曲线这类保证多项式覆盖数增长的 canonization 而非字典序排序。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Let the Target Select for Itself: Data Selection via Target-Aligned Paths
papers.abstract_en: Targeted data selection seeks training examples from a candidate pool that improve downstream task performance. While trajectory-based selectors effectively guide this process, existing approaches typically construct reference states by warming up on the candidate pool itself, thereby inheriting pool-dependent distributional biases. To address this coupling, we introduce Target-Aligned Candidate Selection (TACS), which constructs a short, capacity-constrained reference path using a compact target-validation proxy. Candidates are ranked by their normalized loss reduction along this trajectory, requiring only forward passes and allowing the path to be reused across distinct pools for a fixed model-target pair. Empirically, TACS achieves competitive downstream performance across controlled logistic, vision, and NLP benchmarks, while slashing selection compute by up to 69% and candidate storage to less than 10 MB in large-scale instruction tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Target-Aligned Candidate Selection (TACS)，用紧凑的目标验证集代理构造短且容量受限的参考路径，按候选样本沿该路径的归一化损失下降排序，摆脱在候选池本身热身带来的池依赖分布偏差。只需前向传播，同一模型-目标对下路径可跨池复用；在大规模指令微调中选择计算量最多削减 69%，候选存储降到 10 MB 以下。
Motivation: 轨迹式数据选择器的参考状态通常在候选池上热身得到，使选择结果继承池依赖的分布偏差，且热身开销与存储成本高。
Method: TACS 用紧凑的目标验证集代理 (target-validation proxy) 构造短、容量受限的参考路径，按候选样本沿该轨迹的归一化损失下降打分排序；只需前向传播，固定模型-目标对下该路径可跨不同候选池复用。
Result: 在受控的 logistic、视觉与 NLP 基准上取得有竞争力的下游性能；在大规模指令微调中选择计算量最多削减 69%，候选存储降至 10 MB 以下。
Conclusion: 把参考路径对齐到目标而非候选池，可以在保持下游性能的同时大幅降低数据选择的计算与存储开销，并让路径跨池复用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Cluster First, Route Second: Capacitated Vehicle Routing via Differentiable Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) underpins modern last-mile logistics, where routing decisions recur over the same fixed service area, like a city. In this setting, routing problems share a fixed set of potential customer locations, while active customers and demands vary between instances. We study how this spatial support can be exploited through reusable learned representations and design our method around three symmetries of the symmetric Euclidean CVRP: $E(2)$ transformations, vehicle-route permutations, and tour reversal. We introduce Neural Cluster-First--Route-Second (CFRS), a neural extension of the Fisher--Jaikumar framework that predicts seed-selection scores and customer-to-cluster assignment costs non-autoregressively and respects the three symmetries. A differentiable entropic optimal transport layer provides capacity-aware supervision and guides discrete capacitated assignment, followed by independent traveling salesman subproblems for route recovery. Component ablations show consistent benefits from learned seed selection, while learned assignment costs perform best near the training size and classical FJ costs perform better at larger sizes under exact decoding. On the fixed-support distribution with constant capacity, a model trained on $N=100$ achieves a $3.77\%$ routing gap relative to HGS at $N=1000$ without retraining. A shallow variant with one attention layer in each transformer achieves a $5.08\%$ gap at this scale, with spatial embeddings consistently improving routing quality over raw coordinates. Embedding interpolation further accommodates entirely unseen customer locations without retraining. On standard CVRP benchmarks, a separately trained model achieves a $2.73\%$ routing gap relative to LKH-3 at $N=100$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Neural Cluster-First--Route-Second (CFRS)，把 Fisher--Jaikumar 框架改成非自回归的种子选择与客户分配预测，并用可微分熵正则最优传输层做容量感知监督，再对各簇独立解 TSP 子问题恢复路径。在固定服务区域、恒定容量的 CVRP 分布上，N=100 训练的模型在 N=1000 时相对 HGS 的路径差距为 3.77% 且无需重训，标准基准上相对 LKH-3 在 N=100 达 2.73%。
Motivation: 同城重复出现的 CVRP 实例共享同一组潜在客户位置，但活跃客户与需求逐例变化；现有方法难以复用这种固定空间支撑上的学习表示，并同时尊重 E(2) 变换、车辆-路径置换与回路反转三类对称性。
Method: CFRS 非自回归地预测种子选择分数与客户到簇的分配代价，显式满足 E(2)、车辆-路径置换、回路反转三种对称性；用可微分熵正则 optimal transport 层提供容量感知监督并引导离散容量分配，随后对每个簇独立求解 TSP 子问题恢复路径。消融比较学习式种子选择、学习式分配代价与经典 Fisher--Jaikumar 代价，并测试单层注意力的浅层变体与空间嵌入。
Result: 固定支撑、恒定容量分布上，N=100 训练的模型在 N=1000 达 3.77% 路径差距（相对 HGS）且不重训；单层注意力的浅层变体在该规模为 5.08% 差距；标准 CVRP 基准上单独训练的模型在 N=100 相对 LKH-3 为 2.73% 差距。消融显示学习式种子选择带来一致收益，学习式分配代价在训练规模附近最佳、更大规模下经典 FJ 代价配精确解码更优，空间嵌入一致优于原始坐标，嵌入插值可容纳完全未见过的客户位置。
Conclusion: 利用固定空间支撑的可复用表示与对称性约束，能在不重训的情况下把小规模训练的 CVRP 模型外推到大一个数量级的实例；分配代价的学习式与经典式选择应按实例规模与解码方式切换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FraudBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Fraudulent Refund Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-generated images have become increasingly realistic and readily adaptable to real-world claims, creating new challenges for verifying visual evidence. A concrete emerging risk is AI-generated refund fraud, in which manipulated or synthetic images are used to support claims about damaged products, poor delivery conditions, or service-related defects. Existing AI-generated image detection benchmarks mainly evaluate standalone authenticity classification, cross-generator transfer, or forensic localization, leaving claim-conditioned fraudulent evidence detection underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce FraudBench, a multimodal benchmark for detecting AI-generated fraudulent refund evidence. FraudBench is constructed from real-world user-review evidence across e-commerce, food delivery, and travel-service scenarios. We curate real evidence images together with their associated review and product metadata, identify genuine damaged and undamaged evidence through MLLM-assisted filtering and human annotation, and synthesize fake-damaged evidence from genuine undamaged reference images using 12 state-of-the-art image editing and generation models. Using FraudBench, we evaluate MLLMs, specialized AI-generated image detectors, and human evaluators on the same evaluation images. Experiments show that current MLLMs often recognize real-damaged evidence but fail on many fake-damaged subsets, with fake-damage detection rates (TPR) far below the 50\% baseline on most generator subsets. Specialized detectors generally perform better but remain inconsistent across generators and can produce false positives on real-damaged samples, revealing a clear gap between generic AI image detection and reliable claim-conditioned refund-evidence verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FraudBench 是面向 AI 生成退款欺诈证据的多模态基准，从电商、外卖、旅行评价中整理真实证据图与评论/商品元数据，再用 12 个图像编辑与生成模型从完好参考图合成“损坏”假证据。同一批图上评测 MLLM、专用 AI 生成图像检测器与人类评审：多数生成器子集上 MLLM 的假损坏检出率 (TPR) 远低于 50% 基线，专用检测器整体更好但跨生成器不稳定且对真损坏样本产生误报。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像基准只测独立真伪分类、跨生成器迁移或取证定位，缺少在具体索赔条件下（商品损坏、配送问题）判断证据是否为合成的评测，而退款欺诈正利用这一点。
Method: 从电商、外卖、旅行服务的真实用户评价证据出发，整理真实证据图及其评论与商品元数据；用 MLLM 辅助筛选加人工标注区分真损坏与真完好证据，再以 12 个 SOTA 图像编辑/生成模型从真完好参考图合成假损坏证据；在同一评测图上比较 MLLM、专用 AI 生成图像检测器与人类评审。
Result: 在 FraudBench 上，当前 MLLM 常能识别真损坏证据，但在多个假损坏子集上失败，多数生成器子集的假损坏检出率 (TPR) 远低于 50% 基线；专用检测器总体更好，但跨生成器表现不一致，并对真损坏样本产生假阳性。
Conclusion: 通用 AI 图像检测与可靠的索赔条件式退款证据核验之间存在明确差距：检测器不能直接迁移为欺诈证据判定，需按生成器与索赔条件分别验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often require fine-tuning to better align their behavior with user intent at deployment. Existing approaches are commonly divided into online and offline paradigms. Online methods, such as RL-based alignment, can directly optimize outcome quality but typically rely on external reward models and iterative rollouts, making them costly and difficult to deploy in many cases. Offline methods are more efficient, but prevailing approaches such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO) remain limited: SFT typically collapses graded feedback into binary supervision, while DPO depends on paired preference data that is often unavailable or expensive to construct. In this paper, we propose goal-conditioned supervised learning (GCSL) as an offline fine-tuning framework for LLMs. Our core idea is to treat feedback signals directly as an explicit goal and train the model, purely through supervised learning, to generate responses that achieve that goal. To better exploit graded feedback, we further introduce a novel goal formulation that defines learning as consistently pursuing outcomes above a target quality threshold, rather than imitating samples from a selected high-quality subset. This design mitigates the bounded-learning effect by learning transferable patterns of meeting or exceeding quality thresholds. We also propose natural-language goal representations to further connect these patterns to the LLM's pretrained knowledge and generalization capabilities. We evaluate our method on three tasks: non-toxic generation, code generation, and LLM for recommendation. Results show that our approach consistently outperforms standard offline fine-tuning baselines while retaining the efficiency, scalability, and simple data requirements of supervised learning.

papers.title: AIPO: Learning to Reason from Active Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLMs have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, largely stimulated by RLVR. However, the exploration of existing RLVR algorithms remains largely constrained by the knowledge and reasoning strategies already accessible to the policy model. Although recent methods introduce external expert demonstrations to broaden exploration, they typically rely on complete trajectory-level guidance, which can be sample-inefficient, information-sparse, and insufficiently adaptive to intermediate reasoning bottlenecks. Inspired by collaborative multi-agent systems, we propose AIPO, an enhanced reinforcement learning framework that improves LLM reasoning through active multi-agent interaction during exploration. Specifically, when encountering reasoning bottlenecks, AIPO enables the policy model to proactively consult three functional collaborative agents, namely the verify agent, knowledge agent, and reasoning agent, thereby obtaining fine-grained and state-dependent guidance during rollout. The resulting mixed-policy trajectories expose the policy to reasoning directions that may be difficult to discover through isolated on-policy exploration. To learn effectively from collaborator-provided tokens, we further introduce a corrected importance sampling coefficient together with a lower-bound clipping strategy to mitigate off-policy discrepancy and vanishing gradients. After training, the policy model reasons independently without relying on collaborative agents. Extensive experiments across mathematical, scientific, coding, and puzzle reasoning benchmarks show that AIPO consistently improves reasoning performance and generalizes across different policy models, collaborator backbones, and RLVR algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIPO 在 RLVR 推理遇到瓶颈时让策略模型主动向三个协作 agent（verify、knowledge、reasoning）咨询，得到细粒度、依赖状态的引导，形成混合策略轨迹；再用修正的重要性采样系数加下界裁剪来吸收协作 token，训练后策略可独立推理。在数学、科学、代码与谜题推理基准上一致提升性能，并跨策略模型、协作 backbone 与 RLVR 算法泛化。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 的探索被策略模型已有知识与推理策略限制；引入外部专家示范的方法依赖整条轨迹级指导，样本效率低、信息稀疏，且难以适配中间推理瓶颈。
Method: AIPO 是多智能体交互的强化学习框架：rollout 中遇到推理瓶颈时策略主动咨询 verify agent、knowledge agent、reasoning agent，得到状态相关的细粒度引导，产生混合策略轨迹；为从协作 token 学习，引入修正的重要性采样系数与下界裁剪 (lower-bound clipping) 缓解 off-policy 偏差与梯度消失。
Result: 在数学、科学、代码与谜题推理基准上，AIPO 一致提升推理性能，并跨不同策略模型、协作 backbone 与 RLVR 算法泛化；训练后策略独立推理、不再依赖协作 agent。
Conclusion: 把整条轨迹级的外部示范换成瓶颈处的主动多智能体咨询，配合修正的重要性采样，能让 RLVR 探索到孤立 on-policy 探索难以发现的推理方向，且训练完即可脱离协作 agent。

papers.title: Self-Play Enhancement via Advantage-Weighted Refinement in Online Federated LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Recent works have advanced feedback-based learning systems, whereby a foundation model is able to intake incoming feedback (e.g., from a user) to self-improve, creating a self-loop system of training. However, existing works are limited in needing to consider an offline setup to allow for such feedback-based methods, requiring privileged ground-truth contexts for training. Moreover, there is limited consideration of federated learning (FL), which is particularly well-suited for incorporating external feedback across large networks of end users, for example, but requires methods to be efficient for training on resource-constrained edge devices. Therefore, we introduce SPEAR (Self-Play Enhancement via Advantage-Weighted Refinement), an efficient online learning algorithm for federated LLM fine-tuning. SPEAR utilizes a feedback-guided self-play loop to construct naturally contrastive pairs per prompt which are used to train the model with (i) standard maximum likelihood on satisfactory completions and (ii) confidence-weighted unlikelihood on tail tokens of unsatisfactory completions. SPEAR requires only an interaction-level binary satisfaction signal together with non-answer feedback, without requiring a ground-truth answer to be provided, and does not need expensive group generations, meaning training both online and in a resource-efficient manner is feasible. We validate SPEAR across various benchmark datasets, demonstrating its superior performance in comparison to relevant baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEAR 把联邦 LLM 在线微调中的反馈学习改成自博弈回路：按 prompt 构造天然对比对，对满意完成做最大似然、对不满意完成的尾部 token 做置信度加权 unlikelihood，只需交互级二值满意度信号与非答案反馈，无需 ground-truth 答案也无需昂贵的组生成。在多个 benchmark 数据集上相对相关基线表现更优。
Motivation: 现有反馈式自改进方法依赖离线设置并需要特权 ground-truth 上下文；联邦场景需要在资源受限边缘设备上高效训练，这两点同时缺位。
Method: SPEAR（Self-Play Enhancement via Advantage-Weighted Refinement）：反馈引导的自博弈回路为每个 prompt 构造对比完成对，损失由两部分组成——对满意完成的标准最大似然，以及对不满意完成尾部 token 的置信度加权 unlikelihood；训练信号仅为交互级二值满意度加非答案反馈，全程在线且不做组生成。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 数据集上验证，性能优于相关基线；摘要给出定性结论，未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 不依赖 ground-truth 答案、不做组生成的在线反馈自博弈，可以在联邦 LLM 微调中同时满足免特权标注与资源高效两个约束。

papers.title: GazeVLM: Active Vision via Internal Attention Control for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Human visual reasoning is governed by active vision, a process where meta-cognitive control drives top-down goal-directed attention, dynamically routing foveal focus toward task-relevant details while maintaining peripheral awareness of the global scene. In contrast, modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information passively, relying on the static accumulation of massive token contexts that dilute the visual evidence as the reasoning chain grows. Here we propose GazeVLM, a VLM that learns to exert this oversight over its attention resources by generating gaze actions in its reasoning chain, in the form of <LOOK> tags specifying the coordinates of the region to inspect. During training, each <LOOK> block triggers a continuous suppression bias on the attention logits that dampens features outside the regions gazed at so far, and that lifts at the end of the block, restoring the global view. The model is trained with this bias as a teaching signal, first by Supervised Fine-Tuning on curated gaze-reasoning traces, then through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and valid grounding. At deployment, the external suppression is removed and the model, running its unmodified forward pass, steers its own attention to the regions indicated by the <LOOK> blocks, retaining most of the effect of the bias and emulating top-down control of spatial attention. This model thus transitions between global spatial awareness and localized focal reasoning without relying on external agentic tools like cropping, and without adding visual tokens from re-encoded patches. Applied to 4B-parameter backbones, GazeVLM demonstrates strong high-resolution multimodal reasoning on HRBench-4k and HRBench-8k, surpassing its base models by about 4 points, and outperforming agentic multimodal pipelines built around thinking with images by 5 to 12 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GazeVLM 让 VLM 在推理链中生成 <LOOK> 标签指定要查看的坐标，训练时该块对注视区域之外的 attention logits 施加连续抑制偏置、块结束时解除以恢复全局视野。在 4B 参数骨干上，SFT 加 GRPO 训练后部署时移除外部抑制，模型仍自发把注意力导向 <LOOK> 指定区域，在 HRBench-4k/8k 上比原基座高约 4 分，比围绕 thinking with images 构建的 agentic 多模态管线高 5–12 分。
Motivation: 现代 VLM 被动地把视觉信息堆进静态 token 上下文，推理链越长视觉证据越被稀释，缺少人类式主动视觉中元认知控制驱动的自上而下注视调度。
Method: 在推理链中生成 <LOOK> 块指定待检区域坐标；训练时该块触发对已注视区域之外特征的 attention logits 连续抑制偏置并在块尾抬起。先用人工整理的 gaze-reasoning 轨迹做 SFT，再用 GRPO 以答案正确与 grounding 有效为奖励训练；部署时移除外部抑制，走未改动的前向传播。
Result: 在 4B 参数骨干上，HRBench-4k 与 HRBench-8k 高分辨率多模态推理比各自基座高约 4 分，比围绕 thinking with images 构建的 agentic 多模态管线高 5 至 12 分；部署时移除抑制后仍保留偏置的大部分效果。
Conclusion: 把空间注意力的自上而下控制以 <LOOK> 标签内化进模型自身，可在不依赖裁剪类外部 agentic 工具、不重编码 patch 增加视觉 token 的前提下实现全局感知与局部聚焦推理的切换。

papers.title: Probabilistic Object Detection with Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Prediction (CP) is a distribution-free method for constructing prediction sets with marginal finite-sample coverage guarantees, making it a suitable framework for reliable uncertainty quantification in safety-critical object detection. However, object detection introduces structured multi-output predictions, complicating the application of classical CP theory developed for single outputs. In addition, standard, unscaled CP produces fixed-width prediction intervals across inputs, leading to unnecessary width for low-uncertainty predictions. While scaled CP addresses this by adapting the interval width to an input-dependent uncertainty estimate, prior work has neither systematically compared unscaled and scaled CP for multi-class object detection, nor integrated CP with a complementary uncertainty quantification method in this setting. We fill this gap by: (i) applying CP coordinate-wise to bounding box corners with a Bonferroni correction for box-level guarantees; (ii) scaling the resulting intervals using per-prediction aleatoric uncertainty estimates derived from a probabilistic object detector trained with loss attenuation, evaluated in uncalibrated and two calibrated variants; (iii) extending to a two-step pipeline that constructs prediction sets for the class using RAPS and conditions the conformalized bounding boxes on the predicted class set. Across three autonomous driving datasets (KITTI, BDD, CODA), including a cross-domain setting under distribution shift, scaled CP consistently improves interval sharpness over unscaled CP, achieving up to 19% higher IoU and 39% lower interval scores, without sacrificing coverage. Class-wise calibration further improves coverage for both variants with a negligible effect on sharpness. Together, these improvements yield more actionable uncertainty estimates for real-time, real-world object detection.
papers.comment: Accepted and selected for oral presentation at COPA 2026 (https://proceedings.mlr.press/v329/ries26a.html). Code is available at https://github.com/mos-ks/OD-CP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Conformal Prediction 逐坐标用于 3D/2D 目标检测框角点并做 Bonferroni 校正，再用带 loss attenuation 的概率检测器输出的 aleatoric 不确定性缩放区间宽度，同时用 RAPS 构造类别预测集。在 KITTI、BDD、CODA 三个自动驾驶数据集（含分布偏移的跨域设置）上，scaled CP 相对 unscaled CP 最高提升 19% IoU、降低 39% interval score，且不牺牲覆盖率。
Motivation: 经典 CP 理论面向单输出，而目标检测是结构化多输出；未缩放的 CP 对所有输入给固定宽度区间，低不确定性样本的区间白白变宽，且此前无人系统比较多类检测上的 unscaled/scaled CP，也未与互补的不确定性量化方法结合。
Method: 三步：对 bounding box 角点逐坐标施加 CP 并用 Bonferroni 校正得到框级保证；用 loss attenuation 训练的概率检测器给出 per-prediction aleatoric 不确定性来缩放区间（含未校准与两种校准变体）；两步管线先用 RAPS 构造类别预测集，再让 conformalized 框以预测类别集合为条件。
Result: 在 KITTI、BDD、CODA 三个自动驾驶数据集及跨域分布偏移设置下，scaled CP 相对 unscaled CP 一致改善区间锐度：最高 19% 更高 IoU、39% 更低 interval score，且不牺牲 coverage；class-wise calibration 对两种变体都进一步改善覆盖率，对锐度影响可忽略。
Conclusion: 用检测器自身的 aleatoric 不确定性驱动 CP 区间宽度，可以在保持有限样本覆盖保证的同时给出更可操作的实时检测不确定性估计。
