summary_sections.result: 在 KITTI、BDD、CODA 三个自动驾驶数据集及跨域分布偏移设置下，scaled CP 相对 unscaled CP 一致改善区间锐度：最高 19% 更高 IoU、39% 更低 interval score，且不牺牲 coverage；class-wise calibration 对两种变体都进一步改善覆盖率，对锐度影响可忽略。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用检测器自身的 aleatoric 不确定性驱动 CP 区间宽度，可以在保持有限样本覆盖保证的同时给出更可操作的实时检测不确定性估计。

papers.title: How Far Is Document Parsing from Solved? PureDocBench: A Source-Traceable Benchmark across Clean, Degraded, and Real-World Settings
papers.abstract_en: Document parsing models are improving rapidly, but existing benchmarks are still insufficient for a comprehensive evaluation of their capabilities. We introduce PureDocBench, a benchmark with 10 domains, 66 subcategories, and 1,475 pages. Each page has matched Clean, Digital, and Real versions, covering clean renders, simulated degradation, and real capture or sharing conditions. The resulting 4,425 images have source-derived annotations for text, formulas, tables, and reading order, checked through automated validation and human review. Keeping page content and annotations fixed allows direct comparisons across image conditions. We evaluate 58 models, including pipeline-based parsers, end-to-end parsers, and general vision-language models. The best three-track average score is 79.69 out of 100, and the mean across models is 63.84. Scores drop by 3.34 points on Digital and 11.61 points on Real on average, relative to Clean. TeleOCR leads on Clean, GLM-5.3-Flash on Digital, and Gemini 3.6 Flash on Real. The benchmark dataset, source documents, generation tools, and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/PureDocBench.
papers.comment: 57 pages, 19 figures, 16 tables. Expanded evaluation of 58 models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PureDocBench 用 1,475 页、每页 Clean/Digital/Real 三版本共 4,425 张图的可溯源文档解析基准评测 58 个模型，三轨平均分最高 79.69/100、模型均值 63.84。相对 Clean，Digital 平均掉 3.34 分、Real 掉 11.61 分，说明退化与真实拍摄/分享条件仍是主要短板。
Motivation: 文档解析模型迭代快，但现有基准无法在固定页面内容与标注下区分模型对干净渲染、模拟退化、真实采集三类图像条件的鲁棒性差异。
Method: 构建 10 领域、66 子类、1,475 页的基准，每页生成 Clean、Digital、Real 三个配对版本共 4,425 张图；标注覆盖文本、公式、表格与阅读顺序，经自动校验加人工复核，并保持内容与标注固定以便跨条件直接比较；评测覆盖 pipeline 解析器、端到端解析器与通用 VLM 共 58 个模型。
Result: 最佳三轨平均分 79.69/100，58 个模型均值 63.84；相对 Clean，Digital 平均降 3.34 分、Real 降 11.61 分。Clean 上 TeleOCR 领先，Digital 上 GLM-5.3-Flash 领先，Real 上 Gemini 3.6 Flash 领先。
Conclusion: 文档解析在干净渲染上已接近可用，但真实拍摄与分享条件下的性能塌陷（-11.61 分）说明整体尚未 solved，评测必须在配对退化条件下进行。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: InsHuman: Towards Natural and Identity-Preserving Human Insertion
papers.abstract_en: Human insertion aims to naturally place specific individuals into a target background. Although existing image editing models may have such ability, they often produce failure cases, including inappropriate human pose in new background, inconsistent number of people, and modified facial identity. Moreover, publicly available human datasets often lack full-body portraits and realistic physical interaction between humans and their background. To address these challenges, we propose InsHuman for natural and identity-preserving human insertion. Specifically, we propose Human-Background Adaptive Fusion (HBAF), which detects foreground humans to obtain a binary mask and applies region-aware weighting to align the human regions between predicted and ground-truth latents, ensuring the person's pose, count, and overall appearance are coherently adapted to the target background.We further propose Face-to-Face ID-Preserving (FFIP), which detects and matches faces between the generated image and the source image in terms of face recognition features to enforce identity consistency for each face.In addition, we propose Bidirectional Data Pairing (BDP) strategy to construct BDP-InsHuman, a high-quality dataset with realistic human-background interactions. Experiments demonstrate that InsHuman achieves significant improvements in generating plausible images while keeping human identity unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InsHuman 针对把指定人物插入目标背景的图像编辑任务，提出 Human-Background Adaptive Fusion 用前景检测二值掩码与区域感知加权对齐预测与真值 latent 中的人体区域，保证姿态、人数与外观协调；再用 Face-to-Face ID-Preserving 按人脸识别特征匹配生成图与源图的每张脸以锁定身份，并以 Bidirectional Data Pairing 构建含真实人景交互的 BDP-InsHuman 数据集。实验显示其在生成合理图像的同时保持人物身份不变上有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑模型插入人物时会出现姿态与新背景不搭、人数不一致、面部身份被改动等失败；公开人像数据集又缺少全身人像与人和背景之间真实的物理交互。
Method: 三个组件：HBAF 检测前景人得到二值掩码，用区域感知加权对齐预测 latent 与真值 latent 中的人体区域；FFIP 在生成图与源图之间做人脸检测与人脸识别特征匹配，逐脸施加身份一致性；BDP 策略构造 BDP-InsHuman 数据集，提供真实的人景交互配对。
Result: 实验表明 InsHuman 在生成可信图像的同时保持人物身份不变，取得显著提升；摘要给出的定性指标为姿态、人数与面部身份三类失败的改善。
Conclusion: 把区域感知的 latent 对齐、逐脸身份约束与专门构建的人景配对数据合在一起，可以在人物插入任务上同时解决结构一致性和身份保持问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ShellfishNet: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Visual Recognition of Marine Molluscs
papers.abstract_en: Reliable visual recognition of shellfish is important for ecological monitoring and aquaculture, but real-world imagery exhibits substantial variation in acquisition conditions, appearance, and posture. Existing marine vision resources cover diverse taxa and imaging settings, but fine-grained mollusc recognition remains underexplored in a group-disjoint benchmark that jointly evaluates class prediction, representation-space retrieval, and condition sensitivity. To address this gap, we introduce ShellfishNet, a provenance-aware, group-disjoint benchmark of 40,130 images from 100 marine mollusc classes, organized into 30,879 acquisition or observation groups. Rather than treating recognition as a single clean-accuracy leaderboard, ShellfishNet evaluates model configurations across classification, image-to-image retrieval, taxonomic error structure, and controlled condition sensitivity. We benchmark representative convolutional, transformer-based, hybrid and efficient, self-supervised, and vision-language models on classification and retrieval. Separately, we evaluate open image-captioning and vision-language models on the captioning subset and assess selected fixed checkpoints under controlled generic and marine-inspired synthetic transformations. Across the benchmark, image-level and class-aware classification largely agree, whereas retrieval provides complementary model rankings and taxonomy projection reveals that a non-negligible subset of exact-class errors remains correct at higher taxonomic ranks. Selected fixed checkpoints with similar clean accuracy can also exhibit distinct sensitivity profiles under controlled transformations. These results show that model comparison on shellfish imagery should account for both task and image condition, rather than rely on a single clean classification score. The dataset and evaluation protocols will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShellfishNet 是一个面向海洋软体动物细粒度视觉识别的 group-disposed 基准：40,130 张图像、100 个类、30,879 个采集/观测组，联合评测分类、图到图检索、分类错误的分类学结构与受控条件敏感性。结论是分类与检索给出互补的模型排名，且干净精度相近的模型在受控变换下敏感性差异明显，因此模型比较必须同时看任务与图像条件，不能只看单一干净分类分数。
Motivation: 现有海洋视觉资源覆盖类群与成像条件，但缺少在 group-disjoint 划分下同时评测类别预测、表征空间检索与条件敏感性的细粒度软体动物基准，真实图像在采集条件、外观和姿态上差异很大。
Method: 构建 provenance-aware、group-disjoint 的 ShellfishNet：40,130 张图像、100 个海洋软体动物类、30,879 个采集/观测组；评测覆盖分类、图到图检索、分类错误的分类学投影，以及在受控的通用与海洋启发的合成变换下的条件敏感性。对比卷积、Transformer、混合与高效模型、自监督模型和视觉-语言模型；另在图像描述子集上评测开放的 image-captioning 与 VLM，并对选定的固定 checkpoint 做受控变换测试。
Result: 图像级与 class-aware 分类结果大体一致，而检索给出互补的模型排名；分类学投影显示相当一部分 exact-class 错误在更高分类阶元上仍正确；干净精度相近的选定固定 checkpoint 在受控变换下呈现不同的敏感性剖面。数据集与评测协议将公开发布。
Conclusion: 对贝类图像的模型比较应同时考虑任务类型与图像条件，单一干净分类分数不足以支撑结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CellScientist: From Execution Feedback to Auditable Model-Revision Trajectories for Cellular Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cellular perturbation-response modeling requires coordinated choices of representations, fusion mechanisms, objectives, and training procedures. Large language models (LLMs) can propose executable candidates, but unconstrained revision can produce invalid implementations, change task semantics, or discard useful components. We present CellScientist, a protocol-constrained workflow that converts execution and validation feedback into auditable model-revision trajectories. It records design states and outcomes, routes discrepancies to specific components, and applies local revisions under a fixed task contract. A matched-budget study fixes the candidate language, predictor, fitting, and evaluator: structured revision finds better held-out predictors at small budgets under two LLM backbones. Operational audits link history to fewer repeated proposals, contract checks to contained violations, and discrepancy routing to targeted repairs. Refits of two frozen designs on an independently acquired cohort evaluate external predictive utility. Open-workflow trajectories retain improvements, regressions, and failures, while transcriptomic and single-cell searches extend application to additional response spaces. CellScientist produces both a selected predictor and an inspectable record of its development. Project page: https://limengran98.github.io/CellScientist/.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 7 figures. Mengran Li and Bo Li contributed equally. Corresponding author: Zelin Zang. Project page: https://limengran98.github.io/CellScientist/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CellScientist 是一个受协议约束的 LLM 工作流，把执行与验证反馈转成可审计的模型修订轨迹：记录设计状态与结果，把偏差路由到具体组件，并在固定任务契约下做局部修订。在匹配预算研究中，结构化修订在小预算下、两个 LLM backbone 上都找到更好的 held-out predictor；契约检查使违规受控，偏差路由带来定向修复，历史记录减少重复提案。
Motivation: LLM 能提出可执行的细胞扰动响应模型候选，但无约束修订会产生无效实现、改变任务语义或丢弃有用组件，且修订过程不可追溯。
Method: 协议约束的修订工作流：记录设计状态与执行/验证结果，将偏差路由到表示、融合、目标或训练等具体组件，在固定任务契约下施加局部修订；匹配预算研究固定候选语言、predictor、拟合与 evaluator，仅改变修订策略，并对比两个 LLM backbone；另对两个冻结设计在独立获取的队列上重拟合。
Result: 匹配预算下，结构化修订在小预算时找到更好的 held-out predictor，且在两个 LLM backbone 上成立；操作审计显示历史记录对应更少的重复提案、契约检查对应受控的违规、偏差路由对应定向修复；两个冻结设计在独立队列上的重拟合用于评估外部预测效用。
Conclusion: 受契约约束的结构化修订比无约束 LLM 修订更能在小预算下改进细胞扰动预测，同时产出可检查的开发记录——选定的 predictor 与保留改进、回退和失败的轨迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RRCM: Ranking-Driven Retrieval over Collaborative and Meta Memories for LLM Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for next-generation recommender systems, offering strong semantic understanding and natural-language reasoning abilities. Despite recent progress, current LLM-based recommenders still face key challenges in constructing decision-relevant contexts from heterogeneous evidence. First, existing methods often rely on fixed context construction strategies: collaborative behavioral evidence and item-side metadata are typically incorporated through predefined prompts, static retrieval pipelines, or handcrafted injection mechanisms, making it difficult to determine what information is truly beneficial for each instance. Second, heterogeneous evidence introduces a severe context-efficiency bottleneck. Rich metadata and collaborative interaction records can quickly overwhelm the context window, while aggressive compression or heuristic filtering may discard fine-grained evidence critical for accurate recommendation. To address these challenges, we propose RRCM, a ranking-driven retrieval-and-reasoning framework over collaborative and metadata memories for LLM-based agentic recommendation. RRCM starts from a lightweight user-history context and learns whether to recommend directly, retrieve collaborative evidence, retrieve item metadata, or interleave both through reasoning. Both memories are represented in natural language and accessed through a unified retrieval interface, enabling flexible evidence acquisition without handcrafted CF injection or fixed retrieval rules. We optimize this memory-reading policy with an outcome-only ranking reward, instantiated using group relative policy optimization, so that retrieval decisions are directly driven by final top-k recommendation quality. Extensive experiments show that RRCM significantly outperforms traditional baselines and diverse LLM-based recommendation approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RRCM 把 LLM 推荐的上下文构造变成一个可学习的检索策略：从轻量用户历史出发，由推理决定直接推荐、检索协同记忆、检索物品元数据还是两者交错，并用仅基于结果的排序奖励（GRPO）优化该读取策略。实验显示其显著优于传统基线与多种 LLM 推荐方法。
Motivation: LLM 推荐器依赖固定上下文构造（预定义 prompt、静态检索、手工注入），无法判断每个样本真正需要哪类证据；同时异构证据（协同交互记录 + 丰富元数据）迅速撑爆上下文窗口，而激进压缩或启发式过滤又会丢掉细粒度证据。
Method: RRCM 是面向 LLM agentic 推荐的 ranking-driven 检索-推理框架：以轻量用户历史为起点，由推理策略在四个动作（直接推荐 / 检索协同证据 / 检索元数据 / 交错两者）中选择；两类记忆均以自然语言表示并经统一检索接口访问，无需手工 CF 注入或固定检索规则；读取策略用仅结果的排序奖励优化，奖励以 group relative policy optimization (GRPO) 实例化，直接由最终 top-k 推荐质量驱动。
Result: 在实验中 RRCM 显著优于传统推荐基线以及多种 LLM-based 推荐方法（摘要以显著性表述，未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把「读哪类记忆」本身作为被策略优化的决策，并用 top-k 排序质量作为唯一奖励，可以在不手工注入 CF 证据的前提下同时缓解上下文效率瓶颈与证据选择失当。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Eta Given Delta: Defining LLM Tool Efficiency With Marginal Tool Utility
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces tool efficiency, a new quantitative metric to evaluate the rate of useful tool calls in an LLM agent trajectory. To ensure that tool efficiency is well-defined, we also introduce marginal tool utility, a new quantitative metric defined per tool call indicating whether a tool is useful or whether it can be safely removed from the tool suite without affecting accuracy while increasing tool efficiency; in this paper, we determine the sign of marginal tool utility for each tool call in a trajectory using LLM-as-a-Judge. While much prior work has been done to develop techniques that improve tool use by LLMs and design evaluation methods measuring efficiency indirectly using accuracy as a proxy, our work is centered on measuring efficiency directly via the quantitative metric proposed in this paper in post hoc trajectory analyses. It is our intention that this work contributes to the frontier of LLM evaluation research as a springboard for future benchmark designs and agent harness engineering (specifically with regards to creating lean tool suites) that optimize for metrics that complement but are distinct from accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 tool efficiency（单位轨迹中有用工具调用的速率）与逐调用的 marginal tool utility 两个指标，用 LLM-as-a-Judge 判定每次调用的边际效用符号，从而判断该工具能否在不损失准确率的前提下从工具套件中移除。指标用于事后轨迹分析，直接度量效率而非以准确率作代理。
Motivation: 既有工作多以准确率作代理间接衡量 LLM agent 的工具使用效率，缺少直接、可事后计算的效率度量，也难以判断单个工具是否可安全删减。
Method: 定义 tool efficiency 与 marginal tool utility 两个量化指标；对轨迹中每次工具调用，用 LLM-as-a-Judge 判定其边际效用符号（该调用是否有用、或能否移除而不影响准确率）；在 post hoc 轨迹分析中直接计算效率。
Result: 提出两个新指标及其判定流程（LLM-as-a-Judge 判定逐调用边际效用符号），用于 post hoc 轨迹分析；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: 工具效率应作为与准确率互补但独立的度量，用于构建精简工具套件 (lean tool suites) 的 benchmark 与 agent harness 设计。

papers.title: Why Does Agentic Safety Fail to Generalize Across Tasks?
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly deployed in multi-task settings, where the task to perform is specified at test time, and the agent must generalize to unseen tasks. A major concern in such settings is safety: often, an agent must not only execute unseen tasks, but do so while avoiding risks and handling ones that materialize. Empirical evidence suggests that even when the ability to execute generalizes to unseen tasks, the ability to do so safely frequently does not. This paper provides theory and experiments indicating that failures of agentic safety to generalize across tasks are not merely due to limitations of training methods, but can also reflect an inherent property of safety itself: the relationship between a task and its safe execution is more complex than the relationship between a task and its execution alone. Theoretically, we analyze linear-quadratic control with $H_{\infty}$-robustness, and prove that in many cases, the mapping from task specification to an optimal controller has higher Lipschitz constant with safety requirements than without, yielding a Lipschitz bound of independent interest. Empirically, we demonstrate our conclusions in simulated quadcopter navigation with a neural network agent and in CRM with an LLM agent, showing that imitating safe and unsafe teachers is similarly straightforward on tasks seen in training, yet generalizing across tasks is considerably more difficult with the safe teacher. Our findings suggest that current efforts to enhance agentic safety may be insufficient, and point to a need for fundamentally different approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证智能体安全跨任务泛化失败是安全本身的内在性质，而非训练方法不足：任务到安全执行的映射比到执行本身的映射更复杂。在线性二次控制加 H∞ 鲁棒性的理论分析中，带安全要求的任务规格到最优控制器的映射具有更高的 Lipschitz 常数；四旋翼导航与 CRM 的实验显示，模仿安全/不安全教师在训练见过的任务上同样容易，但跨任务泛化时安全教师明显更难。
Motivation: 多任务部署中智能体需在测试时执行未见任务并规避风险，实证表明执行能力能泛化而安全能力常常不能；需要判断这是训练方法的局限还是安全问题的固有属性。
Method: 理论上分析带 H∞ 鲁棒性的线性二次控制 (linear-quadratic control)，证明任务规格到最优控制器的映射在安全要求下 Lipschitz 常数更高，并给出独立成立的 Lipschitz 界；实证上用神经网络智能体做模拟四旋翼导航、用 LLM 智能体做 CRM，比较模仿安全教师与不安全教师在训练内与跨任务上的难度。
Result: 理论证明在许多情形下带安全要求的映射 Lipschitz 常数高于不带安全要求的情形；实验显示在训练见过的任务上模仿安全与不安全教师同样容易，而跨任务泛化时跟随安全教师明显更难，分别在四旋翼导航（神经网络智能体）与 CRM（LLM 智能体）两个设定中复现。
Conclusion: 安全跨任务泛化的失败可源于安全本身的复杂度而非训练方法不足，因此当前增强智能体安全的努力可能不充分，需要根本不同的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TrajGANR: Trajectory-Centric Urban Multimodal Learning via Geospatially Aligned Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Many urban prediction tasks depend not only on the static attributes of a location, such as the visual appearance of its built environment, but also on its dynamic function: how people navigate and use it over time. Predicting congestion, travel demand, or road safety risks, for instance, requires mobility information that imagery and geographic coordinates alone cannot provide. Trajectories carry this signal, yet current trajectory representations are difficult to align with static geospatial observations: sparse, irregular GPS samples rarely coincide with street-view image coordinates, and existing encoders produce either a single embedding per trajectory or road segment, or embeddings only at the observed GPS samples. We introduce TrajGANR, a trajectory-centric multimodal self-supervised learning framework that represents each trajectory as a continuous, path-conditioned neural field. Reconstructed from the observed GPS samples, this representation can be queried at arbitrary coordinates (including the off-path locations where street-view images were captured), yielding localized mobility embeddings that align with street-view image and location representations at the same coordinate. Across four fine-grained road-level tasks in San Francisco and Porto, TrajGANR consistently outperforms recent geospatial and trajectory foundation models, with ablations attributing the gains to both the mobility signal and the fine granularity at which it is aligned. TrajGANR's location encoder further generalizes beyond the road network to areas where neither street-view imagery nor trajectories are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TrajGANR 把每条轨迹表示成以路径为条件的连续神经场 (path-conditioned neural field)，可在任意坐标查询，从而在同坐标上与街景图像和位置表征对齐。在旧金山与 Porto 的四项细粒度路段级任务上，它持续优于近期地理空间与轨迹基础模型，消融把增益归因于移动性信号本身和对齐的细粒度。
Motivation: 拥堵、出行需求与道路安全预测依赖地点的动态功能，但稀疏不规则 GPS 样本很少与街景图像坐标重合，现有编码器只能给整条轨迹或整个路段一个 embedding，或只在 GPS 观测点给出 embedding，难以与静态地理观测对齐。
Method: TrajGANR 是轨迹中心的多模态自监督学习框架：由观测 GPS 样本重建以路径为条件的连续神经场，可在任意坐标（包括街景拍摄的偏离路径位置）查询，得到与街景图像、位置表征同坐标对齐的局域移动性 embedding；另配一个位置编码器。
Result: 在旧金山与 Porto 的四项细粒度路段级任务上，TrajGANR 一致优于近期地理空间与轨迹基础模型；消融将增益归于移动性信号与对齐所用的细粒度两方面；位置编码器还能泛化到既无街景影像也无轨迹的区域。
Conclusion: 把轨迹做成可任意坐标查询的连续神经场，是让移动性信号与静态地理观测在细粒度上对齐并带来跨任务增益的关键，且位置编码器可外推到无观测覆盖的路网之外区域。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: In-Context Credit Assignment via the Core
papers.abstract_en: We propose incentive-aligned mechanisms for in-context credit assignment: the task of assigning credit for AI-generated content among creators whose intellectual property appears in the context window. Our approach is based on the least core solution concept from cooperative game theory, which distributes value in a way that is as stable as possible by ensuring that no subset of creators is significantly under-compensated relative to the value they could generate on their own. We develop algorithms for approximating the least core, which leverage novel routines for constraint seeding and constraint separation. On a web retrieval credit assignment task, we find that our approaches approximate the least core using an order of magnitude fewer LLM calls compared to alternative methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI 生成内容中按上下文窗口内的创作者分配信用的问题，提出基于合作博弈 least core 解的激励相容机制，保证任何创作者子集都不会相对其独立产出被显著少付。配套的 least core 近似算法引入约束播种 (constraint seeding) 与约束分离 (constraint separation) 例程，在网页检索信用分配任务上，用比替代方法少一个数量级的 LLM 调用达到 least core 近似。
Motivation: AI 生成内容引用了多位创作者的知识产权，如何在他们之间分配信用与报酬缺乏稳定、激励相容的机制，容易出现子集被低估而退出。
Method: 以 least core 解概念定义分配稳定性，开发近似 least core 的算法，核心是新的约束播种与约束分离例程，减少求解所需的 LLM 调用。
Result: 在 web retrieval 信用分配任务上，所提方法达到 least core 近似所需的 LLM 调用比替代方法少一个数量级 (an order of magnitude fewer)。
Conclusion: least core 可作为上下文信用分配的稳定分配标准，且通过约束播种与分离能以显著更少的 LLM 调用求得近似解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continuous First, Discrete Later: VQ-VAEs Without Dimensional Collapse
papers.abstract_en: While many approaches to improve VQ-VAE performance focus on codebook size and utilization, the effect of dimensional collapse, where trained VQ-VAE representations live in an extremely low-dimensional subspace (1-2% of full rank), remains unaddressed. We show theoretically and empirically that dimension collapse causes a hard loss lower bound that various codebook improvement techniques fail to surpass. Our analytic framework extends the sequential learning effect of Saxe et al. [2014] by introducing ideas from rate-distortion theory and explains how the latent collapse is caused by the VQ suppressing lower-variance directions. Our theory justifies a simple solution: a "warm-up phase" that trains the model as an (unquantized) autoencoder before introducing VQ. On both synthetic experiments and large-scale image (VQGAN) and audio (WavTokenizer) VQ-VAEs, we show that AE Warm-Up successfully restores representation dimension, leading to lower reconstruction and perceptual loss at the same training budget. Across codebook sizes $K \in$ {$2^{10}, 2^{14}, 2^{16}$}, AE warm-up raises VQGAN codebook effective dimension from 3-5 to 17-19 and reduces rFID by 17-35%; on WavTokenizer at $K \in$ {$2^{13}, 2^{14}$}, it raises codebook dimension from 4 to 17-19 and improves PESQ by 11-14%. We empirically characterize how warm-up duration governs the achievable final loss. In agreement with experiment, our theoretical analysis predicts downstream performance as a function of warm-up length, enabling an adaptive criterion for switching from AE Warm-up to VQ-VAE training.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VQ-VAE 的维度坍缩（表示只落在 1–2% 满秩的子空间）造成一个硬损失下界，各种 codebook 改进技术都跨不过去。先用未量化的自编码器做 warm-up 再引入 VQ，可恢复表示维度：VQGAN 在 K∈{2^10,2^14,2^16} 上把 codebook 有效维度从 3–5 提到 17–19，rFID 降低 17–35%；WavTokenizer 在 K∈{2^13,2^14} 上维度从 4 提到 17–19，PESQ 提升 11–14%。
Motivation: VQ-VAE 的改进长期围绕 codebook 大小与利用率，而维度坍缩——训练后表示挤在极低维子空间——没有被处理，它带来的硬损失下界使各类 codebook 技术无法突破。
Method: 以 rate-distortion 理论扩展 Saxe et al. [2014] 的序贯学习效应，给出解析框架解释 VQ 抑制低方差方向如何导致 latent collapse；据此提出 AE Warm-Up：先训练未量化自编码器再切入 VQ-VAE，并由理论把下游性能建模为 warm-up 长度的函数，导出自适应切换准则。
Result: 合成实验与大规模图像 (VQGAN)、音频 (WavTokenizer) 上，AE Warm-Up 在相同训练预算下恢复表示维度并降低重建与感知损失。VQGAN 在 K∈{2^10,2^14,2^16} 上 codebook 有效维度 3–5 → 17–19，rFID 降低 17–35%；WavTokenizer 在 K∈{2^13,2^14} 上维度 4 → 17–19，PESQ 提升 11–14%。
Conclusion: 维度坍缩是 VQ-VAE 损失的硬瓶颈，先 AE 后 VQ 的 warm-up 能解除它，且 warm-up 时长决定最终损失，理论可预测该关系并给出自适应切换时机。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniPool: Learning Expert-to-Layer Ownership from Brief Global Access
papers.abstract_en: Most Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers preassign each expert to one layer for the whole of training. We study whether a brief global-access phase can learn a compatible expert-to-layer allocation that is then executed privately. UniPool-Lock gives every layer its own router over one global pool, balances aggregate pool usage, and scores experts with a scale-stable NormRouter. After the short ownership-learning phase, it assigns each expert to one layer, locks the disjoint allocation, and continues training as a layer-private MoE. With the same expert-FFN budget and routed expert FLOPs, this recipe lowers held-out loss relative to vanilla MoE by 0.024-0.037 across five dense-equivalent scales from 182M to 1.5B, including -0.0247 at 1.5B after 60B tokens. The ownership-learning phase lasts 2K steps, about 3.3% of training, and post-lock step time is within -0.7% to +2.8% of vanilla MoE in our throughput measurements. Controls locate the gain in full-pool training and in the allocation it produces: a random disjoint allocation fixed at initialization, trained with the same router and losses, matches vanilla, whereas locking the allocation learned during the full-pool phase recovers nearly all of the persistent full-pool gain, and substituting a random allocation at the lock forfeits about half of it. Keeping full-pool access throughout training (UniPool-Full) also improves over vanilla MoE at four scales and outperforms it with only 66.7% (182M) to 50% (469M and 650M) of its expert parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniPool-Lock 先用一个短暂的全局专家池访问阶段（2K 步，约占训练 3.3%）学习各层对专家的独占分配，再锁定为层私有 MoE 继续训练。在相同专家 FFN 预算与路由 FLOPs 下，五个 dense-equivalent 规模（182M–1.5B）上 held-out loss 相对 vanilla MoE 降低 0.024–0.037，1.5B 上 60B tokens 后为 -0.0247。
Motivation: 主流 MoE transformer 在整个训练期把每个专家固定绑定到某一层，作者追问短暂的全局池访问能否学到一个兼容的专家到层分配，之后再私下执行。
Method: UniPool-Lock 让每层在共享全局池上各有一个 router，用尺度稳定的 NormRouter 给专家打分并平衡池的整体使用；短暂的 ownership-learning 阶段结束后把每个专家指派给唯一一层、锁定不相交分配，再按层私有 MoE 继续训练。对照组包括初始化时固定的随机不相交分配、锁定阶段替换为随机分配，以及全程保持全局池访问的 UniPool-Full。
Result: 相同专家 FFN 预算与路由专家 FLOPs 下，held-out loss 相对 vanilla MoE 降低 0.024–0.037，覆盖 182M 到 1.5B 五个 dense-equivalent 规模，1.5B 在 60B tokens 后为 -0.0247；ownership-learning 阶段 2K 步（约训练的 3.3%），锁定后步时相对 vanilla MoE 在 -0.7% 到 +2.8% 之间。对照显示：初始化固定的随机不相交分配（同 router 同损失）只追平 vanilla，锁定全池阶段学到的分配可保留几乎全部持续的全池增益，而在锁定时换成随机分配会损失约一半增益。UniPool-Full 在四个规模上优于 vanilla，且只用其 66.7%（182M）到 50%（469M、650M）的专家参数即可胜出。
Conclusion: 增益来自全池训练本身以及它产出的分配，而不是 router 或损失的改动；短暂全局访问学到的专家到层所有权在锁定后仍能持续降低 held-out loss，且吞吐开销很小。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PrefixGuard: Online Failure Warning and Trace-Grounded Diagnosis for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents execute multi-step tasks, but terminal verdicts arrive too late for intervention. Agent traces mix messages, tool calls, and feedback, making it difficult to learn failure signals from terminal outcomes. Even if a model learns to predict failure from execution prefixes, its predictions alone cannot show which actions, feedback, or unmet conditions need inspection. Existing work studies online failure prediction and diagnosis from completed trajectories, yet few methods connect timely warning to a compact symbolic model of execution behavior. We introduce \textbf{PrefixGuard}, a neuro-symbolic method that uses learned events to connect online failure warning with finite-state execution diagnosis. A gated recurrent unit (GRU) predicts horizon-specific failure risk from these events. A deterministic finite automaton (DFA) organizes their histories into compact risk-labeled paths for replay and rule-monitor composition. Across all 24 benchmark--horizon settings, PrefixGuard exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in mean test area under the precision--recall curve (AUPRC). Average gains range from 12.0 to 21.9 percentage points. At a nominal 10\% FAR budget, averaged test recall spans 56.1\%--93.0\% across benchmarks. On one frozen $τ^2$-Bench DFA, model checking five specifications identifies violations in 21 of 265 benchmark-successful runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrefixGuard 用学习到的事件把 LLM agent 的在线失败预警与有限自动机诊断接在一起：GRU 按预测时程给出失败风险，DFA 把事件历史压成带风险标签的路径供回放与规则监控。在全部 24 个 benchmark–horizon 设置上，其平均测试 AUPRC 均超过最强基线，平均增益 12.0–21.9 个百分点；在名义 10% FAR 预算下平均测试召回率为 56.1%–93.0%。
Motivation: LLM agent 的多步任务只有终局判定，来得太晚无法干预；轨迹里消息、工具调用与反馈混杂，难以从终局结果学出失败信号，即便能从执行前缀预测失败，也无法指出该检查哪些动作、反馈或未满足条件。
Method: 神经-符号方法：先用学习得到的事件表征执行，GRU（gated recurrent unit）基于这些事件预测各时程 (horizon) 的失败风险；确定性有限自动机 (DFA) 把事件历史组织成紧凑的风险标注路径，支持回放与规则监控组合 (rule-monitor composition)。
Result: 在全部 24 个 benchmark–horizon 设置上，PrefixGuard 的平均测试 AUPRC 均高于所评估的最强基线，平均增益 12.0 至 21.9 个百分点；在名义 10% FAR 预算下，跨 benchmark 的平均测试召回率为 56.1%–93.0%；在一个冻结的 τ²-Bench DFA 上，对五项规格做模型检验，在 265 次 benchmark 判定成功的运行中发现 21 次违规。
Conclusion: 把在线失败预警接到一个执行行为的紧凑符号模型上，可以在任务进行中给出可回放、可定位到具体动作与条件的失败信号，而不止是一个预测分数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LINC: Decoupling Local Consequence Scoring from Hidden Matching in Constructive Neural Routing
papers.abstract_en: Constructive neural routing solvers usually score the next action by matching a decoder context to candidate embeddings, leaving deterministic one-step consequences such as travel, waiting, slack, and capacity changes implicit. We propose LINC, a decoder-side candidate decision architecture that computes these consequences explicitly. LINC uses them according to their decision role: candidate-level consequences are scored by a state-conditioned shared linear comparator, while feasible-set summaries modulate the decoder context. This preserves standard global matching while reducing the burden on the hidden state to reconstruct transition arithmetic. The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW) serves as the main constrained-routing testbed, and the same interface extends to the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) and Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). Across external benchmarks and no-retraining scale-transfer settings, LINC consistently improves strong neural baselines, with the advantage becoming more pronounced as test size moves further beyond the training scale, especially on constrained routing problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LINC 把构造式神经路由中本就确定的一步后果（行驶、等待、松弛、容量变化）显式算出：候选级后果用状态条件共享线性比较器打分，可行集摘要去调制解码器上下文，从而保留全局匹配同时减轻隐状态重建转移算术的负担。在 CVRPTW 主测床上并外推到 CVRP、TSP，LINC 一致提升强神经基线，且测试规模越超出训练规模优势越明显，约束路由上尤其突出。
Motivation: 构造式神经路由求解器靠解码器上下文与候选嵌入的匹配给下一步动作打分，旅行、等待、松弛、容量变化这类确定性一步后果被隐式化，迫使隐状态去重建转移算术。
Method: LINC 是解码器侧的候选决策架构：显式计算一步后果，候选级后果交给状态条件共享线性比较器 (state-conditioned shared linear comparator) 打分，可行集摘要 (feasible-set summaries) 则调制解码器上下文，两路按决策角色分工，同时保留标准全局匹配。
Result: 在外部基准与免重训的规模迁移 (no-retraining scale-transfer) 设置下，LINC 一致改进强神经基线；测试规模越超出训练规模优势越大，在约束路由问题 (CVRPTW) 上尤为明显。主测床为 CVRPTW，同一接口扩展到 CVRP 与 TSP。
Conclusion: 把确定性转移后果从隐状态里解耦出来显式打分，是构造式路由解码器在规模外推下更有效的决策接口，约束路由受益最大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future visual observations and actions, but typically execute a fixed number of actions before replanning, regardless of whether the imagined future remains consistent with reality. We formulate adaptive WAM execution as future--reality verification and propose Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC), a lightweight verifier that reasons over predicted actions, predicted visual dynamics, real observations, and instruction-conditioned semantics. FFDC allows continued execution when a plan remains reliable and triggers replanning when its validity deteriorates. We combine verification with Mixture-of-Horizon Training to improve long-horizon trajectory coverage. On RoboTwin, FFDC-WAM achieves the highest average success rate among the evaluated methods in both clean and randomized settings. Under randomization, it improves success by 2.54 percentage points over Base-Motus while reducing WAM planning calls by 69.10% and completion time by 33.88%. Notably, across six real-world tasks on a Unitree G1D robot, FFDC-WAM improves average success by 9.17% over Base-Motus-LC16 while reducing calls by 74.06% and completion time by 51.31%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界动作模型 (WAM) 原本固定执行若干步再重规划，不看想象的未来是否已偏离现实。FFDC 用轻量验证器比对预测动作、预测视觉动态与真实观测，计划仍可靠就继续执行、失效就触发重规划；配合 Mixture-of-Horizon Training 扩长轨迹覆盖，在 RoboTwin 随机化设置下比 Base-Motus 提升 2.54 个百分点成功率并减少 69.10% 规划调用。
Motivation: WAM 固定步数重规划，无论想象未来是否仍与现实一致，导致冗余规划调用与时间开销，长时程任务成功率受限。
Method: 提出 Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC) 验证器，同时推理预测动作、预测视觉动态、真实观测与指令条件语义，判定继续执行或触发重规划；并结合 Mixture-of-Horizon Training 改善长时程轨迹覆盖。
Result: 在 RoboTwin 上 FFDC-WAM 于 clean 与 randomized 两种设置均取得所评估方法中最高平均成功率；随机化下较 Base-Motus 成功率 +2.54 个百分点、WAM 规划调用减少 69.10%、完成时间减少 33.88%。在 Unitree G1D 机器人六项真实任务上，较 Base-Motus-LC16 平均成功率 +9.17%、调用减少 74.06%、完成时间减少 51.31%。

papers.title: MOSAIC-Bench: Measuring Compositional Vulnerability Induction in Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents often pass per-prompt safety review yet ship exploitable code when their tasks are decomposed into routine engineering tickets. The challenge is structural: existing safety alignment evaluates overt requests in isolation, leaving models blind to malicious end-states that emerge from sequenced compliance with innocuous-looking requests. We introduce MOSAIC-Bench (Malicious Objectives Sequenced As Innocuous Compliance), a benchmark of 199 three-stage attack chains paired with deterministic exploit oracles on deployed software substrates (10 web-application substrates, 31 CWE classes, 5 programming languages) that treats both exploit ground truth and downstream reviewer protocol as first-class evaluation axes. On this benchmark, nine production coding agents from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Moonshot, Zhipu, and Minimax compose innocuous tickets at 53-86% end-to-end ASR with only two refusals across all staged runs. In a matched direct-prompt experiment over four frontier Claude/Codex agents, vulnerable-output rates fall to 0-20.4%: Claude primarily refuses, while Codex primarily hardens rather than emitting the vulnerable implementation - ticket staging silences both defense modes simultaneously. Downstream, code reviewer agents approve 25.8% of these confirmed-vulnerable cumulative diffs as routine PRs, and a full-context implementation protocol closes only 50% of the staged/direct gap, ruling out context fragmentation as the sole explanation. As a deployable but non-adaptive mitigation, reframing the reviewer as an adversarial pentester reduces evasion across the evaluated reviewer subset; pentester framed evasion ranges from 3.0% to 17.6%, and an open-weight Gemma-4-E4B-it reviewer under this framing detects 88.4% of attacks on the dataset with a 4.6% false-positive rate measured on 608 real-world GitHub PRs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOSAIC-Bench 用 199 条三阶段攻击链证明：把恶意目标拆成看似无害的工程 ticket 后，编码 agent 会顺序合规地拼出可利用代码——九个生产级 agent 端到端 ASR 达 53–86%，而直接提示下漏洞输出率仅 0–20.4%。把下游审查者重框为对抗性渗透测试者可把逃逸率压到 3.0–17.6%。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐只孤立评估显式恶意请求，无法识别由多个无害请求顺序执行而涌现的恶意终态，导致 agent 逐条通过审查却交付可利用代码。
Method: 构建 MOSAIC-Bench：199 条三阶段攻击链，配部署软件基底上的确定性 exploit oracle（10 个 web 应用基底、31 类 CWE、5 种编程语言），把漏洞真值与下游审查协议都作为一等评测轴；另设匹配的直接提示对照实验与审查者重框（对抗渗透测试者）缓解实验。
Result: 九个生产编码 agent（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Moonshot、Zhipu、Minimax）端到端 ASR 53–86%，全部分阶段运行中仅 2 次拒绝；匹配直接提示下四个前沿 Claude/Codex 漏洞输出率降至 0–20.4%（Claude 主要拒绝、Codex 主要加固）；审查者 agent 将 25.8% 已确认漏洞累积 diff 当常规 PR 批准，全上下文实现协议仅弥合分阶段/直接差距的 50%；渗透测试者重框下逃逸率 3.0–17.6%，Gemma-4-E4B-it 审查者检出 88.4% 攻击、在 608 个真实 GitHub PR 上误报率 4.6%。
Conclusion: ticket 分阶段会同时沉默拒绝与加固两种防御模式，且上下文碎片化不能作为唯一解释；把审查者重框为对抗渗透测试者是有效的非自适应缓解手段。

papers.title: RoboAlign-R1: Distilled Multimodal Reward Alignment for Robot Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing robot video world models are typically trained with low-level objectives such as reconstruction and perceptual similarity, which are poorly aligned with the capabilities that matter most for robot decision making, including instruction following, manipulation success, and physical plausibility. They also suffer from error accumulation in long-horizon autoregressive prediction. We present RoboAlign-R1, a framework that combines reward-aligned post-training with stabilized long-horizon inference for robot video world models. We construct RobotWorldBench, a benchmark of 10,000 annotated video-instruction pairs collected from four robot data sources, and train a multimodal teacher judge, RoboAlign-Judge, to provide fine-grained six-dimensional evaluation of generated videos. We then distill the teacher into a lightweight student reward model for efficient reinforcement-learning-based post-training. To reduce long-horizon rollout drift, we further introduce Sliding Window Re-encoding (SWR), a training-free inference strategy that periodically refreshes the generation context. Under our in-domain evaluation protocol, RoboAlign-R1 improves the aggregate six-dimension score by 10.1% over the strongest baseline, including gains of 7.5% on Manipulation Accuracy and 4.6% on Instruction Following; these ranking improvements are further supported by an external VLM-based cross-check and a blinded human study. Meanwhile, SWR improves long-horizon prediction quality with only about 1% additional latency, yielding a 2.8% gain in SSIM and a 9.8% reduction in LPIPS. Together, these results show that reward-aligned post-training and stabilized long-horizon decoding improve task consistency, physical realism, and long-horizon prediction quality in robot video world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboAlign-R1 把机器人视频世界模型的训练目标从重建/感知相似度换成对齐机器人决策能力的奖励：用 RobotWorldBench（10,000 条标注视频-指令对，来自四个机器人数据源）训练六维评测的多模态教师 RoboAlign-Judge，蒸馏成轻量学生奖励模型做 RL 后训练，再用免训练的 Sliding Window Re-encoding (SWR) 周期刷新生成上下文以抑制长时程漂移。域内评测中六维总分比最强基线高 10.1%（Manipulation Accuracy +7.5%、Instruction Following +4.6%），SWR 仅增约 1% 延迟即带来 SSIM +2.8%、LPIPS −9.8%。
Motivation: 机器人视频世界模型用重建与感知相似度这类低层目标训练，与指令跟随、操作成功率、物理合理性等决策能力脱节，且自回归长时程预测会累积误差。
Method: 构建 RobotWorldBench（10,000 条标注视频-指令对，四个机器人数据源），训练多模态教师 judge RoboAlign-Judge 做六维细粒度评分，蒸馏为轻量学生奖励模型驱动基于 RL 的奖励对齐后训练；推理端引入免训练的 Sliding Window Re-encoding (SWR)，周期性刷新生成上下文。
Result: 域内评测协议下，六维总分较最强基线提升 10.1%，其中 Manipulation Accuracy 提升 7.5%、Instruction Following 提升 4.6%；排名结果另有外部 VLM 交叉核验与盲测人类研究支持。SWR 以约 1% 的额外延迟使长时程预测 SSIM 提升 2.8%、LPIPS 降低 9.8%。
Conclusion: 奖励对齐后训练与稳定化长时程解码能同时改善机器人视频世界模型的任务一致性、物理真实感与长时程预测质量，且 SWR 的质量收益只需约 1% 延迟代价。

papers.title: Mantis: Mamba-native Tuning is Efficient for 3D Point Cloud Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained 3D point cloud foundation models (PFMs) have demonstrated strong transferability across diverse downstream tasks. However, full fine-tuning these models is computationally expensive and storage-intensive. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising alternative, but existing PEFT approaches are primarily designed for Transformer-based backbones and rely on token-level prompting or feature transformation. Mamba-based backbones introduce a granularity mismatch between token-level adaptation and state-level sequence dynamics. Consequently, straightforward transfer of existing PEFT approaches to frozen Mamba backbones leads to substantial accuracy degradation and unstable optimization. To address this issue, we propose Mantis, the first Mamba-native PEFT framework for 3D PFMs. Specifically, a State-Aware Adapter (SAA) is introduced to inject lightweight task-conditioned control signals into selective state-space updates, enabling state-level adaptation while keeping the pre-trained backbone frozen. Moreover, different valid point cloud serializations are regularized by Dual-Serialization Consistency Distillation (DSCD), thereby reducing serialization-induced instability. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Mantis achieves competitive performance while training less than 5\% of the backbone parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mantis 是首个面向 Mamba 骨干 3D 点云基础模型 (PFM) 的原生参数高效微调 (PEFT) 框架：用 State-Aware Adapter 向选择性状态空间更新注入任务相关控制信号做状态级适配，再用 Dual-Serialization Consistency Distillation 约束不同点云序列化的一致性。在多个基准上以训练不到 5% 骨干参数取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 面向 Transformer，靠 token 级提示或特征变换，与 Mamba 的状态级序列动态存在粒度错配；直接搬到冻结 Mamba 骨干上会明显掉精度且优化不稳。
Method: State-Aware Adapter (SAA) 在选择性状态空间更新中注入轻量任务条件控制信号，实现状态级适配并保持骨干冻结；Dual-Serialization Consistency Distillation (DSCD) 对多种合法点云序列化施加一致性蒸馏，抑制序列化带来的不稳定。
Result: 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能，同时训练的参数不到骨干的 5%；相对直接迁移现有 PEFT 方案，缓解了精度下降与优化不稳定。
Conclusion: PEFT 必须按 Mamba 的状态级动力学原生设计，而非沿用 token 级方案；状态级适配加序列化一致性约束可以在极少可训参数下稳住冻结 Mamba 点云骨干的微调。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Happens Inside Agent Memory? Circuit Analysis from Emergence to Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory failures are silent: an LLM-based agent can produce a fluent response even when it fails to extract, retain, or retrieve the information needed across sessions. The write-manage-read loop describes the external pipeline of these systems but leaves open which internal computations implement each stage. We trace feature circuits across the Qwen-3 family (0.6B--14B), two memory frameworks (mem0, A-MEM), and a matched Gemma-3 replication, reporting two mechanistic findings plus one deliverable. First, under mem0, control is detectable before content. Routing circuitry is causally active at 0.6B, while content circuitry produces no detectable signal until 4B. Gemma-3 reproduces the same order at 1B and 4B. Small models therefore route memory decisions before they can reliably extract or ground the underlying facts. Second, the shared hub is recruited, not created. Write and Read converge on a late-layer hub that already exists in the base model as a context-grounding substrate, on which memory framing recruits a memory-specific functional direction. The hub and the early routing circuit carry over to A-MEM, indicating that these computations belong to the base model rather than to a particular interface. Building on this circuit structure, we develop an unsupervised stage-level diagnostic that localizes silent failures to the responsible operation at 76.2% accuracy. It outperforms a strong LLM trace judge by 3.1 points as well as a supervised hidden-state probe by 8.8 points. Together, these results establish circuit-level signatures as a practical handle for monitoring agent memory and guiding its structural design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM agent 记忆的 write-manage-read 循环做特征电路 (feature circuit) 追踪，发现 mem0 下控制路由电路在 0.6B 模型即因果活跃，而内容电路到 4B 才出现可检测信号，Gemma-3 在 1B/4B 复现同一顺序；Write 与 Read 汇聚到一个基底模型本就存在的晚期层 hub。基于该电路结构构建的无监督阶段级诊断把静默失败定位到具体操作，准确率 76.2%。
Motivation: Agent 记忆失败是静默的：模型仍能给出流畅回答，却没真正跨会话提取、保留或检索信息；write-manage-read 只描述外部流水线，无法说明每个阶段由哪些内部计算实现。
Method: 在 Qwen-3 家族（0.6B–14B）、mem0 与 A-MEM 两个记忆框架以及参数匹配的 Gemma-3 复现上追踪 feature circuits，比较控制路由与内容电路的因果活性，并检查 Write/Read 是否汇聚到基底模型已有的晚期层 hub；再据此构建无监督的阶段级诊断器，与 LLM trace judge 和有监督 hidden-state probe 对比。
Result: mem0 下路由电路在 0.6B 即因果活跃，内容电路到 4B 才有可检测信号，Gemma-3 在 1B 与 4B 复现同一先后顺序；hub 与早期路由电路在 A-MEM 上同样成立。无监督阶段级诊断准确率 76.2%，比强 LLM trace judge 高 3.1 个百分点，比有监督 hidden-state probe 高 8.8 个百分点。
Conclusion: 小模型先学会路由记忆决策、后才能可靠抽取与落地事实，且关键计算属于基底模型而非某个记忆接口；电路级特征因此可作为监控 agent 记忆并指导其结构设计的实用抓手。

summary_sections.method: 在 Qwen-3 家族（0.6B–14B）、mem0 与 A-MEM 两个记忆框架以及参数匹配的 Gemma-3 复现上追踪 feature circuits，比较控制路由与内容电路的因果活性，并检查 Write/Read 是否汇聚到基底模型已有的晚期层 hub；再据此构建无监督的阶段级诊断器，与 LLM trace judge 和有监督 hidden-state probe 对比。
summary_sections.result: mem0 下路由电路在 0.6B 即因果活跃，内容电路到 4B 才有可检测信号，Gemma-3 在 1B 与 4B 复现同一先后顺序；hub 与早期路由电路在 A-MEM 上同样成立。无监督阶段级诊断准确率 76.2%，比强 LLM trace judge 高 3.1 个百分点，比有监督 hidden-state probe 高 8.8 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 小模型先学会路由记忆决策、后才能可靠抽取与落地事实，且关键计算属于基底模型而非某个记忆接口；电路级特征因此可作为监控 agent 记忆并指导其结构设计的实用抓手。

papers.title: Federated Semi-Supervised Graph Neural Networks with Prototype-Guided Pseudo-Labeling for Privacy-Preserving Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is a high-prevalence pregnancy complication that requires accurate early risk stratification to reduce maternal and fetal morbidity. However, real-world clinical deployment of machine learning is hindered by two coupled constraints: (i) label scarcity, where a large fraction of electronic health records (EHR) lack confirmed diagnostic labels, and (ii) data privacy, which prevents sharing patient-level data across hospitals. This paper proposes FedTGNN-SS, a privacy-preserving federated semi-supervised framework for clinical tabular EHR. Each hospital builds a local k-nearest-neighbor patient similarity graph and trains a topology-adaptive GNN encoder. To robustly exploit unlabeled records, FedTGNN-SS combines (1) prototype-guided pseudo-labeling with neighborhood agreement, (2) adaptive graph refinement that periodically updates the k-NN graph using learned embeddings, (3) clinical-aware consistency augmentation applied only to continuous variables, and (4) privacy-safe prototype sharing that exchanges only class-level centroids. Across three diabetes-related datasets (GDM: N = 3,525; Pima: N = 768; Early Stage: N = 520) under 10\%-80\% missing labels per silo, FedTGNN-SS achieves 56 significant wins ($p < 0.05$) against 11 federated baselines and attains strong AUROC under extreme scarcity (Pima: 0.8037 at 80\% missing, Early Stage: 0.9634 at 80\% missing).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedTGNN-SS 把联邦学习与半监督图神经网络结合用于临床表格 EHR 的妊娠糖尿病 (GDM) 风险预测：各医院本地建 k-NN 患者相似图并训练拓扑自适应 GNN 编码器，只在医院间交换类级原型中心。在三个糖尿病数据集、10%–80% 缺失标签设定下对 11 个联邦基线取得 56 项显著胜出 (p < 0.05)，极端缺失时 AUROC 仍达 Pima 0.8037、Early Stage 0.9634。
Motivation: 临床 EHR 部署同时受标签稀缺与隐私约束：大量病历无确诊标签，且医院间不能共享患者级数据，常规监督联邦学习在这两个耦合限制下失效。
Method: 各医院本地构建 k-NN 患者相似图并训练 topology-adaptive GNN 编码器；四个组件为原型引导伪标签加邻域一致性 (prototype-guided pseudo-labeling with neighborhood agreement)、用学习嵌入周期性更新 k-NN 图的自适应图细化、仅作用于连续变量的临床感知一致性增强，以及只交换类级中心的隐私安全原型共享。
Result: 在 GDM (N=3,525)、Pima (N=768)、Early Stage (N=520) 三个数据集、每 silo 10%–80% 缺失标签下，对 11 个联邦基线取得 56 项显著胜出 (p < 0.05)；极端缺失 (80% missing) 时 AUROC 为 Pima 0.8037、Early Stage 0.9634。
Conclusion: 只共享类级原型而非患者级数据，配合原型引导伪标签与图细化，可在标签极端稀缺的跨医院 EHR 上维持有判别力的 GDM 风险分层。

papers.title: Model Compression with Exact Budget Constraints via Riemannian Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Assigning one of K options to each of N groups under a total cost budget is a recurring problem in efficient AI, arising in mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection. The objective (model loss) depends on all assignments jointly and does not decompose across groups, so combinatorial solvers can only optimize proxy objectives. Evolutionary search evaluates the actual loss but lacks gradients, while penalty-based methods enforce the budget only approximately and often require heavy hyperparameter tuning. We show that under softmax relaxation, the budget constraint defines a smooth Riemannian manifold in logit space with unusually clean geometry: the normal vector is available in closed form, shifting logits along the cost vector changes expected cost monotonically, and vector transport reduces to a single inner product. Building on this, we propose Riemannian Constrained Optimization (RCO), which wraps tangent projection, binary-search retraction, and momentum transport around a standard Adam step. Combined with Gumbel straight-through estimation and budget-constrained dynamic programming for discrete feasibility, RCO optimizes the actual loss with first-order methods, enforces the expected budget exactly at every iterate, and introduces no constraint-related hyperparameters. The same construction handles multiple simultaneous budgets with no additional coefficients. RCO matches or exceeds state-of-the-art methods on synthetic problems and realistic LLM compression settings, often at considerably lower wall-clock cost. Source code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/RCO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCO 把 K 选一的总预算约束在 softmax 松弛下写成 logit 空间中的光滑黎曼流形，法向量有闭式解、沿代价向量平移 logit 单调改变期望代价、向量传输退化为一次内积。围绕标准 Adam 步包裹切空间投影、二分搜索 retraction 与动量传输，配合 Gumbel straight-through 与预算约束动态规划，在每个迭代点精确满足期望预算且不引入约束超参。
Motivation: 混合精度量化、非均匀剪枝与专家选择都要在总预算下给 N 组各分配 K 个选项之一，而模型损失跨组耦合不可分解：组合求解器只能优化代理目标，进化搜索无梯度，罚函数法只能近似满足预算且需大量调参。
Method: RCO 在标准 Adam 外包裹切空间投影 (tangent projection)、二分搜索 retraction 与动量向量传输 (momentum transport)；用 Gumbel straight-through 估计离散梯度，用预算约束动态规划保证离散可行性，可同时处理多个预算而不加系数。
Result: 在合成问题与真实 LLM 压缩设置上匹配或超越 state-of-the-art 方法，且墙钟时间往往明显更低；每个迭代点的期望预算被精确满足，且无约束相关超参数。
Conclusion: 预算约束在 softmax 松弛下具有可用的黎曼几何，因此模型压缩的硬预算可以用一阶方法精确强制，而不必退回罚函数或代理目标。

papers.title: DRAGON: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Visual Reasoning over Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Diagram question answering (DQA) requires models to interpret structured visual representations such as charts, maps, infographics, circuit schematics, and scientific diagrams. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) often achieve high answer accuracy on these tasks, yet correct answers do not guarantee that models ground their reasoning in the diagram regions that support the prediction. Models may instead rely on textual correlations or dataset artifacts without identifying the visual evidence required to verify the answer. This limitation prevents reliable evaluation of diagram reasoning and reduces interpretability. We introduce DRAGON, a benchmark for evaluating evidence-grounded visual reasoning in diagrams. Given a diagram, a question, and the correct answer, a model must predict bounding boxes that correspond to the visual elements required to justify the answer. These evidence regions may include answer-bearing components, textual labels, legends, axes, connectors, and other supporting structures involved in the reasoning process. The DRAGON dataset contains 11,664 annotated question instances from six diagram QA datasets: ChartQA, Circuit-VQA, InfographicsVQA, MapIQ, MapWise, and AI2D, with a 2,445-instance test set carrying human-verified evidence annotations and a standardized evaluation framework. Our evaluation on recent VLMs reveals that even Claude Opus 4.6 achieves a Grounding IoU of only 23.8% on AI2D, showing that faithful visual grounding remains an open challenge. DRAGON supports future research on models that ground their predictions in visual evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRAGON 是一个评测图表类视觉证据接地的基准：给定图表、问题和正确答案，模型需预测支撑该答案的 bounding box。数据集含 11,664 个标注问答实例，来自 ChartQA、Circuit-VQA、InfographicsVQA、MapIQ、MapWise、AI2D 六个 DQA 数据集，其中 2,445 条测试集带人工核验的证据标注。评测近期 VLM 显示即使 Claude Opus 4.6 在 AI2D 上 Grounding IoU 也只有 23.8%，说明忠实视觉接地仍是开放难题。
Motivation: VLM 在图表问答上答案准确率高，但正确答案不等于模型真的把推理接地到支撑区域，可能依赖文本相关性或数据集伪迹，导致图表推理无法可靠评测、可解释性差。
Method: 构建 DRAGON 基准：输入为图表、问题与正确答案，要求模型输出对应视觉证据元素的 bounding box，证据可包括答案承载部件、文本标签、图例、坐标轴、连接线等；配标准化评测框架，测试集 2,445 条带人工核验证据标注。
Result: 数据集共 11,664 个标注问答实例，取自 ChartQA、Circuit-VQA、InfographicsVQA、MapIQ、MapWise、AI2D 六个图表 QA 数据集；测试集 2,445 条。对近期 VLM 的评测中，Claude Opus 4.6 在 AI2D 上 Grounding IoU 仅 23.8%。
Conclusion: 即使最强的商用 VLM 也难以把答案接地到正确的图表区域，答案准确率不能替代证据接地评测，faithful visual grounding 仍是开放挑战。

papers.title: ZID-Net: Zero-Inference Diffusion Prior Decoupling Network for Single Image Dehazing
papers.abstract_en: Single image dehazing is often constrained by a trade-off between restoration quality and computational efficiency. While efficient, CNNs struggle to learn robust priors for dense and non-homogeneous haze. Conversely, diffusion models provide strong generative priors but suffer from severe inference latency and sampling instability. To address these limitations, we propose ZID-Net, a novel framework that explicitly decouples diffusion supervision from feed-forward inference. For efficient inference, we design a frequency-spatial decoupled feed-forward backbone. Within this backbone, a Channel-Spatial Laplacian Mask (CSLM) filters haze-amplified noise to extract purified structural details, while Lightweight Global Context Blocks (LGCBs) establish long-range spatial dependencies to capture global haze variations. A Dynamic Feature Arbitration Block (DFAB) then adaptively fuses these semantic and structural features for robust reconstruction. To provide the backbone with degradation-aware priors without increasing inference cost, we introduce a Zero-Inference Prior Propagation Head (ZI-PPH) during training. ZI-PPH leverages a conditional diffusion process to predict residual noise and regularize the shared representation. By discarding the diffusion branch at test time, ZID-Net integrates the representation-shaping benefits of diffusion supervision into a pure feed-forward architecture. Extensive experiments on synthetic, real-world, and remote-sensing benchmarks demonstrate robust restoration across diverse haze conditions, with particularly strong performance on StateHaze1k, where ZID-Net achieves an average PSNR gain of 3.06 dB while maintaining efficient deterministic inference at 19.35 ms.
papers.comment: Submitted to Neurocomputing. Includes 13 figures and 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZID-Net 把扩散模型的先验监督与前馈推理解耦：训练时用条件扩散分支 (ZI-PPH) 预测残差噪声并正则共享表征，测试时直接丢弃该分支，得到纯前馈的单图去雾网络。在 StateHaze1k 上平均 PSNR 提升 3.06 dB，同时保持 19.35 ms 的确定性推理。
Motivation: 单图去雾在恢复质量与计算效率之间取舍：CNN 高效但难以学到应对浓密非均匀雾的鲁棒先验，扩散模型先验强却有严重推理延迟与采样不稳定。
Method: 前馈主干采用频域-空间解耦设计：Channel-Spatial Laplacian Mask (CSLM) 滤除雾致放大噪声以提取纯净结构细节，Lightweight Global Context Blocks (LGCBs) 建立长程空间依赖，Dynamic Feature Arbitration Block (DFAB) 自适应融合语义与结构特征。训练阶段引入 Zero-Inference Prior Propagation Head (ZI-PPH)，用条件扩散过程预测残差噪声并正则共享表征，测试时丢弃扩散分支。
Result: 在合成、真实与遥感基准上评测，StateHaze1k 上平均 PSNR 提升 3.06 dB，推理延迟 19.35 ms 且为确定性推理。
Conclusion: 把扩散监督仅用于训练期的表征塑形、推理期退回纯前馈，可以在不增加推理成本的前提下获得扩散先验的去雾收益。

papers.title: Agentic Forecasting with Structured Linguistic Beliefs
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Bayesian Linguistic Forecaster (BLF), which is a search-based ReAct style agent for (binary) forecasting that augments its context with a linguistic 'belief state', consisting of a probability estimate and a \emph{structured} natural-language evidence summary. (The belief update is 'Bayesian-inspired' rather than exact Bayesian inference, although we do include a comparison to a more explicit Bayesian approach using LLM-elicited likelihood surrogates.) On 400 historical ForecastBench question-date instances, BLF has the highest overall Brier Index among the compared external agents, and is the only compared method to significantly outperform a crowd+empirical-prior baseline in terms of overall performance. Our backtesting framework combines date-aware search tools, leakage auditing, and paired comparisons for variance control to provide a rigorous empirical framework for comparing agentic forecasting systems.
papers.comment: v5 is a complete rewrite! Shorter and clearer, and includes new experiments measuring effect of the belief state, and comparison to a "proper" Bayesian approach (based on LLM likelihoods)
papers.journal_ref: v3 was published in ICML AI Forecasting workshop 2026 (https://forecasting-workshop.github.io/)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Bayesian Linguistic Forecaster (BLF)：一个面向二元事件预测的 ReAct 式搜索 agent，把「概率估计 + 结构化自然语言证据摘要」作为语言化 belief state 注入上下文，并用泄漏审计与配对比较做回测。在 ForecastBench 的 400 个历史 question-date 实例上，BLF 在所比较的外部 agent 中总体 Brier Index 最高，也是唯一显著优于 crowd+empirical-prior 基线的方法。
Motivation: agentic 预测系统缺少能控制泄漏、控制方差的严格比较框架，且 agent 的中间信念如何影响最终概率预测并不清楚。
Method: BLF 采用 ReAct 式搜索 agent，上下文中维护结构化语言 belief state（概率 + 结构化证据摘要），更新为 Bayesian-inspired 而非精确推断；另与基于 LLM 似然代理的更显式 Bayesian 方法对比。回测框架包含 date-aware 搜索工具、泄漏审计 (leakage auditing) 与配对比较 (paired comparisons) 以控制方差，并有测量 belief state 作用的新实验。
Result: 在 400 个 ForecastBench 历史 question-date 实例上，BLF 在所比较外部 agent 中总体 Brier Index 最高，且是唯一在总体表现上显著优于 crowd+empirical-prior 基线的方法。
Conclusion: 把结构化语言 belief state 嵌入搜索式 agent，可在严格回测下提升二元事件的概率预测校准度；belief update 是 Bayesian-inspired 而非精确贝叶斯。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Towards Multi-View Sign Language Understanding: A Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
papers.abstract_en: Most existing Sign Language Understanding (SLU) methods are developed under fixed-view settings and remain vulnerable to viewpoint changes, while the scarcity of multi-view data hinders systematic research on viewpoint robustness. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{MVSign}, a benchmark spanning three sign languages and seven viewpoints. MVSign combines original frontal recordings from existing datasets with additional views synthesized via $3$D whole-body motion reconstruction and target-view rendering, while preserving the source splits and annotations. We further propose \textbf{CanonSLU}, a framework for multi-view SLU. This framework employs a canonical-view-guided strategy, using the frontal view as a semantic anchor. Specifically, CanonSLU incorporates \emph{Canonical-View Knowledge Transfer (CKT)} to transfer canonical knowledge from the frontal view to non-frontal views, and \emph{Motion Relation Aggregation (MRA)} to aggregate motion-related features across frames and strengthen temporal representations under viewpoint changes. Extensive experiments on MVSign demonstrate competitive performance with gains on non-frontal views, establishing CanonSLU as an effective baseline for multi-view SLU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多视角手语理解基准 MVSign，覆盖 3 种手语与 7 个视角，用 3D 全身动作重建加目标视角渲染合成非正面视角并保留原始划分与标注；配套提出 CanonSLU，以正面视角为语义锚点，通过 Canonical-View Knowledge Transfer (CKT) 迁移正面知识、Motion Relation Aggregation (MRA) 跨帧聚合运动特征。实验在 MVSign 上取得竞争性表现，并在非正面视角上有增益。
Motivation: 现有手语理解方法都在固定视角下开发，视角一变就退化；多视角数据稀缺又使视角鲁棒性无法系统研究。
Method: MVSign 把既有数据集的正面原始录制与经 3D 全身动作重建、目标视角渲染合成的新视角组合，保留源划分与标注。CanonSLU 用正面视角作语义锚点：CKT 把正面视角的规范知识迁移到非正面视角，MRA 跨帧聚合运动相关特征以强化视角变化下的时序表征。
Result: 在 MVSign 上的实验显示 CanonSLU 具备竞争性表现，并在非正面视角上取得增益；基准覆盖 3 种手语、7 个视角，合成视角由 3D 全身动作重建与目标视角渲染生成。
Conclusion: 以正面视角为锚点做知识迁移加跨帧运动聚合，是多视角手语理解的一个有效基线，视角鲁棒性可通过合成多视角数据系统研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Lost in Motion: Vision Language Models Fail the Dynamic Gauges Test
papers.abstract_en: The digital transformation of industrial manufacturing increasingly relies on the ability of autonomous robots to interact with legacy infrastructure, particularly analog gauges. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have the potential to provide a general solution for gauge reading and have already shown good performance in instrument recognition. However, performing accurate, real-time gauge readings is a more complex task. This paper evaluates state-of-the-art models, including versions from the GPT-5 (5.4 Thinking and 5.3 Instant) and Gemini 3 (Pro and Flash) families, against a set of simple but realistic dynamic gauge reading scenarios. To facilitate this evaluation, we introduce a novel dataset comprising video sequences of three instruments of different gauge types: circular, linear, and Vernier, under diverse motion and speed profiles. Our findings indicate that the evaluated frontier VLMs, under our specific testing conditions, exhibit a limited ability to interpret needle trajectories and scale semantics, failing to provide the traceability and reliability needed for safety-critical monitoring. The results demonstrate that these models have not yet achieved the performance necessary to be classified as trustworthy synthetic instruments under existing IEEE and ISO standards.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Instrumentation & Measurement Magazine (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在动态仪表盘（dynamic gauges）测试中，GPT-5（5.4 Thinking、5.3 Instant）与 Gemini 3（Pro、Flash）等前沿 VLM 无法可靠解读指针轨迹与刻度语义，读数缺乏安全关键监测所需的可追溯性与可靠性，尚不能按现有 IEEE/ISO 标准被认定为可信的合成仪表。
Motivation: 工业机器人读取遗留模拟仪表需要实时、准确且可追溯的读数，而现有 VLM 只在仪表识别上表现良好，动态读数能力尚未被系统检验。
Method: 构建新数据集：三类仪表（circular、linear、Vernier）在多种运动与速度剖面下的视频序列；用该数据集评测 GPT-5 与 Gemini 3 家族的多个版本在动态读数场景中的表现。
Result: 在所设测试条件下，被评测的前沿 VLM 解读指针轨迹与刻度语义的能力有限，无法给出安全关键监测所需的可追溯性与可靠性；按现有 IEEE 与 ISO 标准尚未达到可信合成仪表的性能要求。
Conclusion: 前沿 VLM 目前不能作为可信赖的合成仪表用于安全关键的动态仪表监测。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: MambaSL: Exploring Single-Layer Mamba for Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in state space models (SSMs) such as Mamba across various sequence domains, research on their standalone capacity for time series classification (TSC) has remained limited. We propose MambaSL, a framework that minimally redesigns the selective SSM and projection layers of a single-layer Mamba, guided by four TSC-specific hypotheses. To address benchmarking limitations -- restricted configurations, partial University of East Anglia (UEA) dataset coverage, and insufficiently reproducible setups -- we re-evaluate 20 strong baselines across all 30 UEA datasets under a unified protocol. As a result, MambaSL achieves state-of-the-art performance with statistically significant average improvements, while ensuring reproducibility via public checkpoints for all evaluated models. Together with visualizations, these results demonstrate the potential of Mamba-based architectures as a TSC backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MambaSL 对单层 Mamba 的选择性 SSM 与投影层做最小改造，按四条 TSC 专属假设重设计，用于时间序列分类 (TSC)。在统一协议下重评 20 个强基线、覆盖 UEA 全部 30 个数据集，MambaSL 取得 SOTA 平均性能且统计显著，并公开全部被评模型的 checkpoint 以保证可复现。
Motivation: Mamba 在多个序列域表现强，但其作为时间序列分类独立骨干的能力研究很少；现有基准存在配置受限、UEA 数据集覆盖不全、实验难以复现三类问题。
Method: 提出 MambaSL：在单层 Mamba 上最小化地重新设计选择性 SSM 与投影层，设计由四条针对 TSC 的假设引导；同时建立统一评测协议，重评 20 个强基线并覆盖 UEA 全部 30 个数据集，公开所有被评模型的 checkpoint。
Result: 在 UEA 全部 30 个数据集、统一协议下对比 20 个强基线，MambaSL 达到 SOTA 平均性能并有统计显著的平均提升；所有被评模型均提供公开 checkpoint，另附可视化结果。
Conclusion: Mamba 架构有潜力作为时间序列分类的骨干，而统一协议加公开 checkpoint 是让 TSC 基准可复现的必要条件。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Acceptance Dynamics Across Cognitive Domains in Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference. It uses a small draft model to propose a tree of future tokens. A larger target model then verifies these tokens in a single batched forward pass. Despite the growing body of work on speculative methods, the degree to which the cognitive characteristics of a task affect acceptance probability remains largely unexplored. We present an empirical study of tree-based speculative decoding acceptance dynamics. Our study spans four well-established NLP benchmark domains: code generation, mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and open-ended chat. For this, we use TinyLlama-1.1B as the draft model against Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ as the target. Over 99,768 speculative nodes collected from 200 prompts, we derive per-domain acceptance rates, expected accepted lengths, depth-acceptance profiles, and entropy-acceptance correlations. We find that task type is a stronger predictor of acceptance than tree depth. Furthermore, only the chat domain consistently yields an expected accepted length exceeding 1.0 token per step. We also show that the entropy-acceptance correlation is consistently negative but weak across all domains (rho in [-0.20, -0.15]). Counterintuitively, chat produces the highest entropy yet the highest acceptance rate. We attribute this divergence to the lexical predictability of RLHF-aligned register. These findings have direct implications for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection strategies. Index Terms--speculative decoding, large language model inference, tree attention, draft model, acceptance probability, LLM efficiency
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对树式投机解码 (tree-based speculative decoding) 的接受动力学做实证研究，发现任务域比树深度更能预测接受概率：只有 chat 域每步期望接受长度稳定超过 1.0 token，且熵与接受率在所有域都呈一致但微弱的负相关 (rho 在 [-0.20, -0.15])，chat 同时给出最高熵与最高接受率。作者据此主张按域分配投机预算并选择 draft model。
Motivation: 已有投机解码工作多关注加速机制本身，但任务的认知特征（域差异）如何影响接受概率基本未被探索，而接受率直接决定投机解码的加速收益与预算分配。
Method: 以 TinyLlama-1.1B 为 draft model、Llama-2-7B-Chat-GPTQ 为 target，在代码生成、数学推理、逻辑推理、开放对话四个 NLP benchmark 域上收集 200 条 prompt 的 99,768 个投机节点，统计各域接受率、期望接受长度、深度-接受剖面与熵-接受相关性。
Result: 任务类型比树深度是更强的接受预测因子；仅 chat 域的期望接受长度每步稳定超过 1.0 token；熵-接受相关性在所有域一致为负但微弱，rho 落在 [-0.20, -0.15]；chat 域熵最高却接受率也最高，作者归因于 RLHF 对齐语域的词汇可预测性。
Conclusion: 接受概率主要由任务域而非树深度决定，因此投机预算与 draft model 选择应按域定制；chat 的高熵高接受说明熵不足以单独作为接受率的代理。

papers.title: Deployment of AI-Assisted Interventions: Capacity Constraints and Noisy Compliance
papers.abstract_en: AI tools increasingly drive targeted interventions in various service settings, including healthcare, education, and public services. Algorithms score individuals, trigger outreach to those above a threshold (e.g., high-risk or high-value), and encourage them to request service; then providers deliver service to those who request. Much of the work in this area has focused on improving predictive accuracy, implicitly assuming that better predictions lead to better outcomes. We show that predictions are only one component of a larger service system: when service capacity is limited and behavioral responses to outreach are probabilistic, system efficacy depends on operational forces that predictive accuracy does not capture. In such settings, the optimal score threshold must balance two effects: ensuring all capacity is filled (utilization) and, when capacity is constrained, preventing low-value requests from crowding out high-value ones (cannibalization). We characterize the optimal threshold and prove that thresholds based solely on predictive accuracy are generally suboptimal. Further, algorithm selection metrics such as AUC can be misaligned with operational performance: they weight all thresholds equally, while optimal deployment uses a subset of thresholds that depends on both capacity and compliance behavior. We introduce a new metric, Operational AUC (OpAUC), and show that it identifies the efficacy-optimal algorithm. Finally, we conduct a case study on sepsis early warning data that illustrates the magnitude of the improvement available from better threshold selection and shows that a predictor with lower AUC can achieve higher system efficacy under optimal deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在服务能力有限、外展后人群是否申请服务带随机性的系统里，最优打分阈值必须同时权衡填满容量（利用率）与防止低价值请求挤出高价值请求（cannibalization）。作者证明只按预测精度定阈值一般次优，AUC 会因对所有阈值等权而与运营目标错位；提出 Operational AUC (OpAUC) 可识别效能最优的算法，脓毒症早期预警案例显示更低 AUC 的预测器在最优部署下反而有更高系统效能。
Motivation: 算法触发外展类干预的既有工作默认预测越准结果越好，忽略了服务容量受限与人群对 outreach 的概率性响应这两条运营约束，导致阈值选择与算法评价指标可能和真实系统效能脱节。
Method: 把打分阈值、服务容量与合规概率放进同一服务系统模型，刻画最优阈值并证明仅基于预测精度的阈值一般次optimal；指出 AUC 对所有阈值等权而实际部署只用到依赖容量与合规行为的一小部分阈值，据此提出新指标 Operational AUC (OpAUC)。
Result: 证明单靠预测精度的阈值一般次优，AUC 可与运营绩效错位；OpAUC 能识别效能最优算法。在脓毒症早期预警数据的案例研究中，展示了更优阈值选择带来的改进幅度，并显示更低 AUC 的预测器在最优部署下可取得更高系统效能。

papers.title: FastGrasp: Learning-based Whole-Body Control Method for Fast Dexterous Grasping with Mobile Manipulators
papers.abstract_en: Fast dexterous grasping while a mobile base remains in motion requires coordinated whole-body control and rapid adaptation to physical contact. We propose FastGrasp, a two-stage learning framework that integrates grasp guidance, whole-body control, and tactile feedback. First, a pretrained conditional variational autoencoder generates diverse grasp candidates from object point clouds. Candidates are filtered by approach direction and supporting-surface constraints, then ranked using an envelopment-based criterion combining grasp width and depth coverage measures. Second, a reinforcement learning policy jointly controls the mobile base, arm, and dexterous hand, using the selected grasp as guidance and tactile observations for online grasp adjustment. The policy is trained with domain randomization and deployed with command filtering and tactile-triggered grasp tightening. Simulation experiments show higher grasp success rates than the evaluated baselines under full and partial point-cloud observations, while real-world experiments demonstrate sim-to-real transfer across diverse object geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastGrasp 面向移动机械臂在底盘运动中的快速灵巧抓取，提出两阶段学习框架：先用条件 VAE 从物体点云生成抓取候选并按接近方向、支撑面约束过滤，再用基于包络度的抓取宽度与深度覆盖准则排序；第二阶段的强化学习策略联合控制底盘、机械臂与灵巧手，靠触觉观测在线调整抓取。仿真中在完整与部分点云观测下抓取成功率均高于所评测基线，实机实验展示了跨多种物体几何的 sim-to-real 迁移。
Motivation: 移动底盘持续运动时的抓取要求全身协调与接触瞬间的快速适应，抓取候选生成、全身控制与触觉反馈通常彼此割裂，难以在运动中完成灵巧抓取。
Method: 两阶段框架：预训练条件变分自编码器 (cVAE) 从物体点云生成多样抓取候选，按接近方向与支撑面约束过滤，再用结合抓取宽度与深度覆盖的包络度准则 (envelopment-based criterion) 排名；随后用强化学习策略联合控制移动底盘、机械臂与灵巧手，以选中抓取为引导、以触觉观测做在线调整，训练加 domain randomization，部署时用 command filtering 与触觉触发的抓取收紧。
Result: 仿真实验显示，在完整点云与部分点云两种观测条件下，抓取成功率均高于所评测的基线；实机实验在多种物体几何上展示了 sim-to-real 迁移。
Conclusion: 把抓取候选生成、全身控制与触觉在线调整串成一个两阶段学习流程，可在底盘运动中完成快速灵巧抓取，并能从仿真迁移到实体系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoLen: Evolution-Guided Tokenization for DNA Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Tokens serve as the basic units of representation in DNA language models (DNALMs), yet their design remains underexplored. Unlike natural language, DNA lacks inherent token boundaries or predefined compositional rules, making tokenization a fundamental modeling decision rather than a naturally specified one. While existing approaches like byte-pair encoding (BPE) excel at capturing token structures that reflect human-generated linguistic regularities, DNA is organized by biological function and evolutionary constraint rather than linguistic convention. We argue that DNA tokenization should prioritize functional sequence patterns like regulatory motifs-short, recurring segments under evolutionary constraint and typically preserved across species. We incorporate evolutionary information directly into the tokenization process through EvoLen, a tokenizer that combines evolutionary stratification with length-aware decoding to better preserve motif-scale functional sequence units. EvoLen uses cross-species evolutionary signals to group DNA sequences, trains separate BPE tokenizers on each group, merges the resulting vocabularies via a rule prioritizing preserved patterns, and applies length-aware decoding with dynamic programming. Through controlled experiments, EvoLen improves the preservation of functional sequence patterns, differentiation across genomic contexts, and alignment with evolutionary constraint, while matching or outperforming standard BPE across diverse DNALM benchmarks. These results demonstrate that tokenization introduces a critical inductive bias and that incorporating evolutionary information yields more biologically meaningful and interpretable sequence representations. Code, pretrained and fine-tuned checkpoints, and tokenizer files are available at https://github.com/HN020719/EvoLen and https://huggingface.co/EvoLenTokenizer.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoLen 把跨物种进化信号直接写进 DNA 分词：按进化分层分组序列、每组各训一个 BPE、按保守模式优先的规则合并词表，再用动态规划做长度感知解码，以保留 motif 尺度的功能序列单元。受控实验中它提升了功能序列模式保留、基因组上下文区分度与进化约束对齐，并在多项 DNALM benchmark 上匹配或超过标准 BPE。
Motivation: DNA 没有天然 token 边界，BPE 学到的是类语言统计规律，而 DNA 按生物功能与进化约束组织，分词因此成为关键却欠研究的归纳偏置来源。
Method: EvoLen tokenizer 结合进化分层 (evolutionary stratification) 与长度感知解码：用跨物种进化信号对 DNA 序列分组，每组训练独立 BPE，再按优先保留保守模式的规则合并词表，最后用动态规划实现长度感知解码。
Result: 受控实验显示 EvoLen 改善功能序列模式的保留、跨基因组上下文的区分度以及与进化约束的对齐，并在多种 DNALM benchmark 上匹配或优于标准 BPE。
Conclusion: 分词本身是一种关键归纳偏置，把进化信息纳入分词能得到更有生物学意义、更可解释的序列表示。

papers.title: An Imperfect Verifier is Good Enough: Learning with Noisy Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is widely used for post-training Large Language Models, but practical verifiers can make errors. We study how the rate and structure of reward noise affect RLVR in code generation, with a preliminary scientific-reasoning check. In multi-seed Qwen3 8B experiments on MBPP, mean validation reward over two fixed late evaluations is within 1 percentage point of the clean baseline at the tested resampled group-rollout noise rates through 20%, and within about 2 points at 30%. Confidence intervals allow larger losses; these point estimates do not establish a general tolerance threshold. We also examine full-program pass@k, four controlled noise structures, two model-based verifiers, and policy models from three families spanning 4B-9B parameters. We derive conditional advantage distributions for symmetric and asymmetric group noise, including retained format penalties, and show why clipping limits simple gradient-scaling arguments. The analysis identifies information preserved by whole-group corruption and limits on interpreting our asymmetric sweep as a precision-recall comparison. Overall, the results indicate that imperfect verification can support effective RLVR in the tested settings, while aggregate error rates alone do not characterize the learning signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RLVR 中系统注入可验证奖励噪声，发现 Qwen3 8B 在 MBPP 上即使重采样组滚动噪声率达 20%，两轮固定后期评估的平均验证奖励仍与干净基线相差不到 1 个百分点，30% 时约差 2 个百分点；但整体错误率本身不足以刻画学习信号，噪声结构同样关键。
Motivation: RLVR 依赖可验证奖励，而实际 verifier 会出错；现有实践缺少对奖励噪声的比率与结构如何影响后训练的定量刻画。
Method: 在 MBPP 上做多 seed 的 Qwen3 8B RLVR 实验，注入重采样组滚动 (resampled group-rollout) 噪声并扫描 20% 与 30% 比率，另设四种受控噪声结构、两个 model-based verifier，以及 4B–9B 三个模型家族的 policy；推导对称与非对称组噪声下的条件优势分布（含保留的 format penalty），并论证 clipping 为何限制简单的梯度缩放论证；附带科学推理任务的初步检验。
Result: MBPP 上两轮固定后期评估的平均验证奖励在 20% 噪声率内与干净基线相差不到 1 个百分点，30% 时约差 2 个百分点；置信区间允许更大损失，点估计不构成通用容忍阈值。另评估 full-program pass@k、四种受控噪声结构、两个 model-based verifier，以及 4B–9B 三个模型家族的 policy。
Conclusion: 在所测设置下不完美的验证器足以支撑有效的 RLVR，但仅看聚合错误率无法刻画学习信号，噪声结构与保留信息（如整组损坏保留的信息）同样决定结果。

papers.title: Auditable Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents call tools, query databases, delegate tasks, and trigger external side effects. Once an agent system can act in the world, the question is no longer only whether harmful actions can be prevented--it is whether those actions remain answerable after deployment. We distinguish accountability (the ability to determine compliance and assign responsibility), auditability (the system property that makes accountability possible), and auditing (the process of reconstructing behavior from trustworthy evidence). Our claim is direct: no agent system can be accountable without auditability. To make this operational, we define five dimensions of agent auditability, i.e., action recoverability, lifecycle coverage, policy checkability, responsibility attribution, and evidence integrity, and identify three mechanism classes (detect, enforce, recover) whose temporal information-and-intervention constraints explain why, in practice, no single approach suffices. We support the position with layered evidence rather than a single benchmark: lower-bound ecosystem measurements suggest that even basic security prerequisites for auditability are widely unmet (617 security findings across six prominent open-source projects); runtime feasibility results show that pre-execution mediation with tamper-evident records adds only 8.3 ms median overhead; and controlled recovery experiments show that responsibility-relevant information can be partially recovered even when conventional logs are missing. We propose an Auditability Card for agent systems and identify six open research problems organized by mechanism class.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Extended version. A condensed 5-page version was accepted to ACM AI Summit 2026 (Visionary Papers track). Updated Figure 1 and references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出 LLM agent 可审计性 (auditability) 的立场性定义与框架：区分 accountability、auditability、auditing 三层概念，提出五个可审计性维度与 detect/enforce/recover 三类机制，主张没有 auditability 就不可能有 accountability。证据显示六个开源项目共 617 条安全发现说明基础安全前提普遍缺失，事前中介加防篡改记录仅增加 8.3 ms 中位开销，且在常规日志缺失时仍可部分恢复与责任相关的信息。
Motivation: LLM agent 已能调工具、查库、委派任务并触发外部副作用，部署后其行为是否仍可追责成为核心问题；现有 agent 系统普遍缺少使追责成为可能的可审计性这一系统属性。
Method: 提出概念框架而非单一基准：区分 accountability/auditability/auditing，定义五个维度（action recoverability、lifecycle coverage、policy checkability、responsibility attribution、evidence integrity），按 detect/enforce/recover 三类机制分析其时间上的信息与干预约束，并给出分层证据与 Auditability Card 提案。
Result: 分层证据包含三部分：六个知名开源项目的下界生态测量发现 617 条安全发现，说明可审计性的基础安全前提广泛未满足；运行时可行性结果显示事前中介 (pre-execution mediation) 加防篡改记录仅带来 8.3 ms 中位开销；受控恢复实验显示即使常规日志缺失，与责任相关的信息仍可被部分恢复。
Conclusion: 作者主张任何 agent 系统没有 auditability 就无法 accountability，且因三类机制的时间约束，实践中没有任何单一方法足以独立支撑可审计性；同时提出 Auditability Card 并列出按机制类组织的六个开放研究问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Communication Gain and Delay Cost Under Cross-Timestep Delays in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Communication is essential for coordination in \emph{cooperative} multi-agent reinforcement learning under partial observability, yet \emph{cross-timestep} delays cause messages to arrive multiple timesteps after generation, inducing temporal misalignment and making information stale when consumed. We formalize this setting as a delayed-communication partially observable Markov game (DeComm-POMG) and decompose a message's effect into \emph{communication gain} and \emph{delay cost}, yielding the Communication Gain and Delay Cost (CGDC) metric. We further establish a value-loss bound showing that the degradation induced by delayed messages is upper-bounded by a discounted accumulation of an information gap between the action distributions induced by timely versus delayed messages. Guided by CGDC, we propose \textbf{CDCMA}, an actor--critic framework that requests messages only when predicted CGDC is positive, predicts future observations to reduce misalignment at consumption, and fuses delayed messages via CGDC-guided attention. Experiments on no-teammate-vision variants of Cooperative Navigation and Predator Prey, and on SMAC maps across multiple delay levels show consistent improvements in performance, robustness, and generalization, with ablations validating each component.

Motivation: 合作多智能体在部分可观测下依赖通信协调，但消息跨多个时刻才到达会造成时间错位与信息过期，现有方法缺少刻画这种延迟代价的度量与理论约束。
Method: 提出 DeComm-POMG 形式化与 CGDC 度量（communication gain 减 delay cost），并给出价值损失上界：延迟导致的性能退化被及时与延迟消息所诱导动作分布之间信息差的折扣累积所界定。CDCMA 框架包含三部分——仅在预测 CGDC 为正时请求消息、预测未来观测以降低消费时错位、用 CGDC 引导的注意力融合延迟消息。
Result: 在 Cooperative Navigation 与 Predator Prey 的无队友视野变体、以及 SMAC 多张地图的多个延迟档位上，CDCMA 在性能、鲁棒性和泛化方面一致改进，消融实验验证每个组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 以 CGDC 作为请求与融合的判据，可以把跨时刻延迟通信的收益与代价分开度量，并据此在部分可观测合作任务中同时提升性能与对延迟的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Contrast Matters: Understanding Robustness of In-Context Fine-Tuning to Target-Context Relatedness
papers.abstract_en: In-context fine-tuning (IC-Train), training an LLM with labeled examples in-context, is increasingly used in place of standard fine-tuning for domain adaptation and continual absorption of labeled data. We study the robustness of the in-context learning ability that emerges from such training: does the fine-tuned model perform well across test inputs whose in-context examples range from unrelated to nearly identical? Across 32 configurations spanning four open-source LLMs and eight test sets over machine translation, Text-to-SQL, and multilingual semantic parsing, we show that robustness hinges on an overlooked design choice: how in-context examples are selected relative to the target during training. The two prevailing strategies turn out to be accurate over complementary parts of this spectrum: random contexts yield a model that gains little from related examples even when they are placed in its context, while retrieved similar contexts weaken accuracy on targets lacking close neighbors and raise the propensity to copy labels from context. Probes tracking in-weights learning, in-context learning, and copying trace these failures to distinct training dynamics, and show that introducing contrast in target-context similarity both within a context and across batches, restores robustness across the entire spectrum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IC-Train（in-context fine-tuning）的鲁棒性取决于训练时上下文与目标的相似度设计：random contexts 让模型即使拿到相关示例也几乎不受益，retrieved similar contexts 则在缺少近邻的目标上掉精度并抬高照抄上下文标签的倾向。在上下文内与 batch 间同时引入相似度对比 (contrast) 可恢复全谱系上的鲁棒性。
Motivation: IC-Train 已被广泛用于领域适配与持续吸收标注数据，但训练时如何挑选 in-context 示例这一设计选择被忽视，导致模型在测试上下文从无关到近乎相同的变化谱上表现不稳。
Method: 在 32 种配置、四个开源 LLM、八个测试集（machine translation、Text-to-SQL、multilingual semantic parsing）上对比 random contexts 与 retrieved similar contexts 两种主流训练策略，并用追踪 in-weights learning、in-context learning 与 copying 的 probes 定位失败来源。
Result: 32 个配置横跨四个开源 LLM 与八个测试集：random contexts 训出的模型从相关示例中获益极少，retrieved similar contexts 在缺乏近邻的目标上精度下降且更倾向从上下文复制标签；probes 显示两者失败源于不同的训练动态，而引入目标-上下文相似度对比后在整条谱系上恢复鲁棒性。
Conclusion: IC-Train 的鲁棒性由训练期目标-上下文相似度的对比结构决定，random 与 retrieved 两种策略各覆盖谱系的一段，加入 within-context 与 across-batch 的对比才能全谱稳健。
