papers.title: RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on complex reasoning tasks such as competitive programming (CP), existing methods predominantly focus on single-attempt settings, overlooking their capacity for iterative refinement. In this paper, we present RefineRL, a novel approach designed to unleash the self-refinement capabilities of LLMs for CP problem solving. RefineRL introduces two key innovations: (1) Skeptical-Agent, an iterative self-refinement agent equipped with local execution tools to validate generated solutions against public test cases of CP problems. This agent always remains skeptical of its own outputs and thereby enforces rigorous self-refinement even when validation suggests correctness. (2) A reinforcement learning (RL) solution to incentivize LLMs to self-refine with only standard RLVR data (i.e., problems paired with their verifiable answers). Extensive experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-2507 demonstrate that our method yields substantial gains: after our RL training, these compact 4B models integrated with the Skeptical-Agent not only outperform much larger 32B models but also approach the single-attempt performance of 235B models. Notably, although our models are trained solely on CP coding data, RefineRL also substantially improves their performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, suggesting that the learned self-refinement behavior can transfer beyond coding-specific tasks. These findings highlight self-refinement as a promising direction for scaling LLMs' general reasoning ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefineRL 用带本地执行工具的 Skeptical-Agent 让 LLM 对自身输出持续保持怀疑、即使测试通过也继续严格自精炼，并用仅含可验证答案的 RLVR 数据做强化学习训练。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-4B-2507 上，训练后的 4B 模型配合该 agent 超过更大的 32B 模型、接近 235B 模型的单次尝试性能，且只用竞赛编程数据训练也能提升数学推理基准表现。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 竞赛编程方法多聚焦单次尝试设定，忽略了模型通过迭代自我精炼提升解题能力的潜力。
Method: 提出 RefineRL：其一为 Skeptical-Agent，带本地执行工具、用公开测试用例校验生成解，并对自己的输出保持怀疑以强制严格自精炼；其二为仅用标准 RLVR 数据（问题配可验证答案）的强化学习方案，激励 LLM 主动自精炼。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-4B-2507 上，RL 训练后的 4B 模型接入 Skeptical-Agent 后超过明显更大的 32B 模型，并接近 235B 模型的单次尝试性能；仅用竞赛编程数据训练，仍在数学推理基准上取得实质提升。
Conclusion: 自精炼是扩展 LLM 通用推理能力的有前景方向，且这种学到的自精炼行为可迁移到编码之外的数学推理任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering What You Can Control: Interventional Boundary Discovery for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: When an RL agent's observations contain distractors driven by the same confounders as its true state, observational data alone cannot identify which dimensions the agent controls. In our benchmarks, even state-conditioned observational selectors can collapse when distractors mimic controllable state variables. We propose Interventional Boundary Discovery (IBD), which treats the agent's own action channel as a source of randomized interventions: randomizing actions implements an interventional contrast, and per-dimension two-sample tests with FDR correction produce a binary mask over observation dimensions. Across 12 continuous-control settings with up to 100 distractors, IBD matches oracle return in 11 of 12 settings, while observational baselines including mutual information, state-conditioned forward models, and gradient-based sensitivity often underperform simply passing the full observation to SAC. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxin26/IBD-RL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 强化学习中观测维度若被与真实状态同源的混淆因子驱动，纯观测数据无法判定哪些维度可控；IBD 把智能体自身动作通道当作随机干预源，对每个维度做带 FDR 校正的两样本检验，输出观测维度的二值掩码。在最多 100 个干扰项的 12 个连续控制设置中，IBD 在 11 个设置上追平 oracle return，而互信息、状态条件前向模型与梯度敏感性等观测基线常不如直接把完整观测喂给 SAC。
Motivation: 当干扰项与真实状态由同一混淆因子驱动时，观测选择器无法区分可控维度与干扰维度，state-conditioned 选择器在干扰项模仿可控状态变量时也会失效，导致策略学到虚假关联。
Method: 提出 Interventional Boundary Discovery (IBD)：把动作通道当作随机干预来源，随机化动作即构造 interventional contrast；对每个观测维度做两样本检验并施加 FDR 校正，得到观测维度的二值掩码，再将掩码后的观测交给 RL 训练。
Result: 在 12 个连续控制设置、最多 100 个干扰项下，IBD 在 11/12 个设置上匹配 oracle return；互信息、state-conditioned forward model、梯度敏感性等观测基线常常不如直接把完整观测输入 SAC。
Conclusion: 把动作当作随机干预源，可以在观测数据不可辨识的场景下判定可控维度，从而在干扰项模仿状态变量时仍接近 oracle 策略回报。

papers.title: Understanding Quantization of Optimizer States in LLM Pre-training: Dynamics of State Staleness and Effectiveness of State Resets
papers.abstract_en: Quantizing optimizer states is becoming an important ingredient of memory-efficient large-scale pre-training, but the resulting optimizer dynamics remain only partially understood. We study low-precision exponential moving average (EMA) optimizer states and show how quantization can cause many nominal updates to round back to the same stored value, making the state effectively stale and slowing adaptation beyond what the nominal decay would suggest. We then develop a simple predictive model of stalling that estimates one-step stalling probabilities and characterizes how stalling builds up over time after the initialization. This perspective provides a mechanistic explanation for why optimizer-state resets help in low precision: once a quantized EMA becomes effectively stale, resetting it can temporarily restore responsiveness. Motivated by this picture, we derive a simple theory-guided method for choosing useful reset periods, showing that in low precision the key question is not only whether resets help, but when they should be applied. Experiments in controlled simulations and LLM pre-training show that suitable reset schedules recover the performance lost to low-precision state storage while substantially reducing optimizer-state memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低精度量化下 EMA 优化器状态的多次名义更新会四舍五入回同一存储值，使状态实际停滞 (stalling)、适应速度比名义衰减所暗示的更慢。论文建立一步停滞概率的预测模型，解释为何重置 (reset) 能临时恢复响应性，并据此推导选择重置周期的理论方法；受控仿真与 LLM 预训练实验显示合适重置周期可找回低精度状态存储损失的性能，同时大幅降低优化器状态显存。
Motivation: 大规模 LLM 预训练中量化优化器状态是省显存的常用手段，但低精度下优化器动力学机制不清：名义更新被舍入吞掉导致状态陈旧，性能损失从何而来、重置何时该做都缺少解释。
Method: 针对低精度 EMA 优化器状态，建立 stalling 预测模型，估计一步停滞概率并刻画停滞自初始化后随时间的累积；由此给出机制解释并推导理论引导的重置周期选择方法，在受控仿真与 LLM 预训练上验证。
Result: 受控仿真与 LLM 预训练实验表明，合适的重置周期可恢复低精度状态存储造成的性能损失，并显著减少优化器状态显存；核心定量结论是低精度下重置不仅是否有用，还取决于何时施加。
Conclusion: 低精度优化器状态的性能损失源于量化导致的停滞累积，按理论选择的重置周期能在省显存的同时把这部分性能补回来。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: HO-SFL: Hybrid-Order Split Federated Learning with Backprop-Free Clients and Dimension-Free Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large models on edge devices is severely hindered by the memory-intensive backpropagation (BP) in standard frameworks like federated learning and split learning. While substituting BP with zeroth-order optimization can significantly reduce memory footprints, it typically suffers from prohibitively degraded convergence speed. To resolve this dilemma, we propose Hybrid-Order Split Federated Learning (HO-SFL). By reformulating the split learning process within a Lagrangian framework, HO-SFL decouples the optimization landscape: The server performs precise first-order updates (i.e., BP), whereas clients conduct memory-efficient zeroth-order optimization. This hybrid design not only eliminates the need for client-side BP but also enables dimension-free model aggregation, drastically lowering communication costs. Crucially, we provide a theoretical convergence analysis, demonstrating that HO-SFL mitigates the dimension-dependent convergence slowdown of zeroth-order optimization, achieving a convergence rate comparable to first-order methods. Extensive experiments on tasks across vision and language modalities validate that HO-SFL achieves convergence speeds comparable to first-order baselines while significantly reducing communication costs and client memory footprints.

Motivation: 边缘设备上微调大模型受限于标准联邦学习与 split learning 中占内存的反向传播；直接用零阶优化替换 BP 虽省内存，却带来不可接受的收敛速度退化。
Method: 在 Lagrangian 框架下重构 split learning，将优化问题解耦：服务器侧执行精确的一阶 BP 更新，客户端侧执行内存高效的零阶优化；由此免除客户端 BP 并支持 dimension-free 模型聚合。附带给出收敛性理论分析。
Result: 理论结果：HO-SFL 缓解零阶优化的维度相关收敛变慢，收敛率达到与一阶方法相当的水平。实验覆盖视觉与语言两类模态任务，收敛速度与一阶基线相当，同时显著降低通信成本与客户端内存占用。
Conclusion: 把一阶更新留在服务器、零阶优化放在客户端的混合阶拆分，可以在不牺牲收敛速度的前提下消除客户端 BP 并压低通信与内存开销。

papers.title: Less Data, Faster Convergence: Goal-Driven Data Optimization for Multimodal Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal instruction tuning is often compute-inefficient because training budgets are spread across large mixed image-video pools whose utility is highly uneven. We present Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO), a framework that computes six sample descriptors for each candidate and constructs optimized 1$\times$ training subsets for different goals. Under a fixed one-epoch Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct training and evaluation recipe on 8 H20 GPUs, GDO uses far fewer training samples than the Uni-10x baseline while converging faster and achieving higher accuracy. Relative to the fixed 512k-sample Uni-10x baseline, GDO reaches the Uni-10x reference after 35.4k samples on MVBench, 26.6k on VideoMME, 27.3k on MLVU, and 34.7k on LVBench, while improving Accuracy by +1.38, +1.67, +3.08, and +0.84 percentage points, respectively. The gains are largest on MVBench and MLVU, while LVBench improves more modestly, consistent with its ultra-long-video setting and the mismatch between that benchmark and the short-video/image-dominant training pool. Across MinLoss, Diverse, Temp, and Temp+, stronger temporal emphasis yields steadily better long-video understanding behavior. Overall, GDO provides a goal-driven data optimization framework that enables faster convergence with fewer training samples under a fixed training protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/rujiewu/GDO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出目标驱动数据优化框架 GDO，为每个候选样本计算六个描述子并构造面向不同目标的 1× 训练子集，在固定 one-epoch Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 配方下用远少于 Uni-10x 的样本达到其参考精度并继续提升。相对 512k 样本的 Uni-10x，GDO 在 MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU、LVBench 上分别只需 35.4k、26.6k、27.3k、34.7k 样本即达参考线，Accuracy 还分别高出 +1.38、+1.67、+3.08、+0.84 个百分点。
Motivation: 多模态指令微调的算力被摊在规模庞大且样本效用高度不均的图文-视频混合池上，固定预算下大量算力浪费在低价值样本上。
Method: GDO 为每个候选样本计算六个描述子，据此构造面向不同目标的 1× 训练子集；训练与评测配方固定为 one-epoch Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，跑在 8 张 H20 GPU 上，并对比 MinLoss、Diverse、Temp、Temp+ 四种子集构造目标。
Result: 相对 512k 样本的 Uni-10x 基线，GDO 达到其参考精度所需样本数为 MVBench 35.4k、VideoMME 26.6k、MLVU 27.3k、LVBench 34.7k，同时 Accuracy 分别提升 +1.38、+1.67、+3.08、+0.84 个百分点；增益在 MVBench 与 MLVU 上最大，LVBench 因超长视频设定与以短视频/图像为主的训练池不匹配而提升较小；在 MinLoss、Diverse、Temp、Temp+ 中，时间性（temporal）权重越强，长视频理解表现越好。
Conclusion: 在固定训练协议下，按目标筛选数据子集可以用不到 14% 的样本数更快收敛并超过 512k 全量基线的精度，且时间性更强的子集目标持续改善长视频理解。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Sensor Models via Language-Informed Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal language models have demonstrated strong semantic understanding and reasoning over physiological and behavioral signals captured from diverse healthcare sensors. However, existing sensor-language models can only process a fixed number of sensor channels at a fixed sampling rate, making them difficult to adapt to new or different sensor configurations. This inflexibility prevents models from generalizing across heterogeneous health sensing ecosystems, where data spans high-frequency wearable streams to sparse, day-scale clinical signals. To bridge this gap, we introduce SLIP (Sensor Language-Informed Pretraining), an open-source framework for learning language-aligned representations that generalize across diverse sensor setups. SLIP integrates contrastive alignment with sensor-conditioned captioning, facilitating both discriminative understanding and generative reasoning. By repurposing a pretrained decoder-only language model via cross-attention and introducing a flexible patch embedder, SLIP transfers to new sensor configurations at inference without retraining, regardless of their native sampling rate or input length. Across 11 datasets, SLIP demonstrates superior performance in retrieval, signal captioning, and question answering. It achieves a 77.14% average linear-probing accuracy, a 3.56% improvement over the strongest baseline (SensorLM). Beyond classification, SLIP supports open-vocabulary sensor captioning and question answering without any architectural modifications. Our work offers broad implications for the development of sensor-language models, utilizing cross-modal supervision to ensure more robust generalizability in health sensing applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLIP（Sensor Language-Informed Pretraining）用对比对齐加传感器条件化描述生成，把任意采样率与长度的生理传感通道映射到语言模型空间，推理时换新传感器配置无需重训练。在 11 个健康传感数据集上平均线性探测准确率 77.14%，比最强基线 SensorLM 高 3.56%。
Motivation: 现有传感器-语言模型只能处理固定通道数与固定采样率，难以适配新的传感器配置，无法在高频可穿戴流到稀疏临床信号的异构健康传感生态上泛化。
Method: SLIP 将对比对齐 (contrastive alignment) 与传感器条件化描述 (sensor-conditioned captioning) 结合，兼顾判别理解与生成推理；把预训练 decoder-only 语言模型改造为经 cross-attention 接入，并引入灵活的 patch embedder，使模型在推理阶段迁移到任意原生采样率与输入长度的新传感器配置而无需重训练。
Result: 在 11 个数据集上，检索、信号描述与问答三类任务表现均优于对比方法；平均线性探测准确率 77.14%，较最强基线 SensorLM 提升 3.56%；开放词表传感器描述与问答无需任何架构改动即可支持。
Conclusion: 用跨模态语言监督训练的传感器表征可以在不改架构、不重训练的前提下跨异构传感器配置迁移，作者称其对健康传感的泛化性有广泛意义。

papers.title: Agentic Service Markets Across the Computing Continuum: A Polymatroidal Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents are becoming economic actors. They compose deadline-bound services across the device-edge-cloud continuum and contend for capacity no single operator owns. This article asks when decentralised pricing can coordinate them exactly and truthfully, and what their service dependencies must satisfy. We model the pipelines as service-dependency graphs under governance constraints and identify the decisive property: laminarity of the induced leaf-block family. Where it holds, the feasible allocation space is a polymatroid and efficient incentive-compatible clearing exists per epoch; where a crossing breaks it, exactness and truthfulness can fail, while clearing prices survive on every totally unimodular family. The formal results instantiate polymatroid, gross-substitutes and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves theory; the contribution is the bridge from dependency structure to that machinery and an integrator architecture that exposes a laminar interface. The node-level evaluation (32,020 runs), at testbed-calibrated congestion, locates the boundary. One crossing costs exactness in 14.7% of high-load rounds and none on laminar instances, and truthfulness fails where exactness does, across contention. An integrator's inner exposure restores exactness at a cost in admitted volume, and before translation overhead it cuts median latency by 16 to 17 percent. Against truth-free posted prices the tuned market leads at medium load and trails a demand-responsive one in four of six high-load cells. Recorded and composed agent workloads drive the allocation. For platform designers, laminar pipelines admit exact decentralised pricing, truthful under the VCG mechanism, and a crossing needs an integrator's inner exposure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自主 AI agent 的服务流水线建成带治理约束的服务依赖图，判定其诱导叶块族是否为 laminar：laminar 时可行分配空间是 polymatroid，每轮存在精确且激励相容的清算；出现 crossing 时精确性与真实性会失效。32,020 次节点级测试显示，一个 crossing 在高负载轮次中造成 14.7% 的精确性损失，laminar 实例上为零；引入 integrator 的内部暴露可恢复精确性，代价是接纳量下降，并在翻译开销前把延迟中位数降低 16%–17%。
Motivation: AI agent 正成为经济主体，在 device-edge-cloud 连续体上组合有截止期的服务并争夺没有任何单一运营者拥有的容量；需要回答去中心化定价在什么条件下能精确且真实地协调它们。
Method: 把流水线建模为服务依赖图并识别决定性性质——诱导叶块族的 laminarity；将 polymatroid、gross-substitutes 与 Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) 理论实例化，给出暴露 laminar 接口的 integrator 架构，并在 testbed 校准的拥塞条件下做节点级评估（32,020 次运行）。
Result: laminar 实例上精确性损失为零，一个 crossing 在高负载轮次中使 14.7% 的轮次失去精确性，且真实性在精确性失效处同样失效；integrator 内部暴露恢复精确性但牺牲接纳量，翻译开销前延迟中位数降低 16%–17%；对比免真值的 posted price，调优后的市场在中负载领先，在六个高负载单元中有四个落后于需求响应定价。清算价格在所有 totally unimodular 族上仍然成立。
Conclusion: laminar 流水线可用 VCG 机制做精确的去中心化定价且保持真实，出现 crossing 则需要 integrator 的内部暴露来恢复精确性。

papers.title: A theoretical model of dynamical grammatical gender shifting based on set-valued set function
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the diverse characteristics of nouns, focusing on both semantic (e.g., countable/uncountable) and morphosyntactic (e.g., masculine/feminine) distinctions. We explore inter-word variations for gender markers in noun morphology. Grammatical gender shift is a widespread phenomenon in languages around the world.The aim is to uncover the underlying patterns governing the variation of lexemes. To this end, we propose a new computational component dedicated to pairing items with morphological templates (e.g., the result of a generated item-template pair: (funas, $\{N, +SG, -PL, -M, +F, -COL, +SING\}$), with its spell-out form: $ð$a-funast 'cow'). This process is formally represented by the Template-Based and Modular Cognitive model. This proposed model, defined by a set-valued set function $h : \mathscr{P}(M) \rightarrow \mathscr{P}(M)$, predicts the nonlinear dynamic mapping of lexical items onto morphological templates. By applying this formalism, we present a unified framework for understanding the complexities of morphological markings across languages. Through empirical observations, we demonstrate how these shifts, as well as non-gender shifts, arise during lexical changes, especially in Riffian. Our model posits that these variant markings emerge due to template shifts occurring during word and meaning formation. This study achieves two primary objectives. First, on the formal side, we prove the model's representational completeness in learning and prediction. Second, on the linguistic side, we challenge and broaden the conventional view of word formation by formally demonstrating that conversion is applicable to noun-to-noun derivation. This data-driven mathematical model not only contributes to a deeper understanding of morphosyntactic variation but also offers potential applications in other fields requiring precise modelling of linguistic patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Template-Based and Modular Cognitive model，用集值集合函数 h: P(M)→P(M) 把词汇项非线性地映射到形态模板，以解释跨语言（尤其 Riffian）的语法性转换。形式上证明了模型在学习与预测上的表示完备性，并论证 conversion 可用于名词到名词的派生。
Motivation: 语法性转换是跨语言普遍现象，但词形变化背后的统一模式缺少形式化刻画，传统构词观也未把 conversion 纳入名词派生。
Method: 提出配对词汇项与形态模板的计算部件，输出如 (funas, {N,+SG,-PL,-M,+F,-COL,+SING}) 及其语音形式 ða-funast；整体由 Template-Based and Modular Cognitive model 形式化为集值集合函数 h: P(M)→P(M)，预测词汇到模板的非线性动态映射，并以 Riffian 的实证观察检验。
Result: 证明模型在学习与预测上的表示完备性；形式化演示 conversion 适用于名词到名词派生；以 Riffian 词汇变化中的性别与非性别转换作为实证观察支撑模板转移机制。
Conclusion: 变体标记源于词与义形成过程中的模板转移，该集值函数框架可统一解释跨语言形态标记的复杂性，并可迁移到其他需要精确建模语言模式的领域。

papers.title: LFPO: Likelihood-Free Policy Optimization for Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has achieved remarkable success in improving autoregressive models, especially in domains requiring correctness like mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, directly applying such paradigms to Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) is fundamentally hindered by the intractability of exact likelihood computation, which forces existing methods to rely on high-variance approximations. To bridge this gap, we propose Likelihood-Free Policy Optimization (LFPO), a native framework that maps the concept of vector field flow matching to the discrete token space. Specifically, LFPO formulates alignment as geometric velocity rectification, which directly optimizes denoising logits via contrastive updates. This design effectively bypasses the errors inherent in likelihood approximation, yielding the precise gradient estimation. Furthermore, LFPO enforce consistency by predicting final solutions from intermediate steps, effectively straightening the probability flow to enable high-quality generation with significantly fewer iterations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LFPO not only outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on code and reasoning benchmarks but also accelerates inference by approximately 20% through reduced diffusion steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LFPO 把连续向量场的 flow matching 搬到离散 token 空间，用几何速度整流 (geometric velocity rectification) 直接对去噪 logits 做对比更新，绕开扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 难以精确计算的似然。同时用中间步预测最终解来拉直概率流，使推理在减少扩散步数的同时加速约 20%，在代码与推理基准上超过 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: RLVR 在自回归模型上很成功，但直接套到 dLLM 上受阻于精确似然不可计算，现有方法只能依赖高方差的似然近似。
Method: LFPO 将对齐形式化为几何速度整流，通过对比更新直接优化去噪 logits，绕过似然近似误差以获得精确的梯度估计；再以从中间步预测最终解的方式强制一致性，拉直概率流。
Result: 在代码与推理基准上超过 state-of-the-art 基线，并通过减少扩散步数把推理加速约 20%。
Conclusion: 无需似然的对比式 logits 更新可替代高方差似然近似来微调 dLLM，同时缩短概率流还能减少生成所需迭代数。

papers.title: Words & Weights: Streamlining Multi-Turn Interactions via Co-Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time policy adaptation for multi-turn interactions (T2PAM) is essential for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with dynamic user needs during inference time. However, existing paradigms commonly treat test-time adaptation as a single-axis problem, either purely refining instructions (Prompt Engineering) or only adjusting weights (Test-Time Training), ignoring that interaction failures stem from a coupled mix of ambiguity and incapacity. We argue that these two optimization paths are not merely additive but synergistic: semantic clarity acts as a pre-conditioner for effective parameter updates. To this end, we propose ROSA2, a framework that reformulates interaction as a joint optimization problem over the heterogeneous space of Words and Weights. By mathematically decomposing the error signal, ROSA2 utilizes textual gradients to rectify intent ambiguity and parameter updates to bridge capability gaps. Theoretically, we prove that this co-adaptation strictly reduces the required parameter shift for convergence. Empirically, ROSA2 outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 30% on MATH while reducing interaction turns by 40%, demonstrating that refining the context unlocks the true potential of parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROSA2 把多轮交互的测试时适配改写成「文字与权重」的联合优化：用 textual gradient 修正意图歧义，用参数更新弥补能力缺口，二者协同而非相加。理论上证明共适应严格降低收敛所需的参数偏移；在 MATH 上比 SOTA 基线高 30%，交互轮数减少 40%。
Motivation: 现有测试时适配把问题当单轴处理——只改 prompt 或只改权重，忽略了交互失败来自歧义与能力不足的耦合，导致对齐动态用户需求时效率低。
Method: 提出 ROSA2 框架，将交互重构为 Words 与 Weights 异构空间上的联合优化；对误差信号做数学分解，用 textual gradient 处理意图歧义、用参数更新弥补能力缺口，并给出共适应降低参数偏移的理论证明。
Result: 在 MATH 上超越 SOTA 基线 30%，同时交互轮数减少 40%；理论上证明共适应严格降低收敛所需参数偏移。
Conclusion: 语义清晰是有效参数更新的预条件，先精炼上下文能解锁参数更新的潜力，使多轮测试时适配同时更准更省轮数。

papers.title: SWE-Adept: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Deep Codebase Analysis and Structured Issue Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong performance on self-contained programming tasks. However, they still struggle with repository-level software engineering (SWE), which demands (1) deep codebase navigation with effective context management for accurate localization, and (2) systematic approaches for iterative, test-driven code modification to resolve issues. To address these challenges, we propose SWE-Adept, an LLM-based two-agent framework where a localization agent identifies issue-relevant code locations and a resolution agent implements the corresponding fixes. For issue localization, we introduce agent-directed depth-first search that selectively traverses code dependencies. This minimizes issue-irrelevant content in the agent's context window and improves localization accuracy. For issue resolution, we employ adaptive planning and structured problem solving. We equip the agent with specialized tools for progress tracking and Git-based version control. These tools interface with a shared working memory that stores code-state checkpoints indexed by execution steps, facilitating precise checkpoint retrieval. This design enables reliable agent-driven version-control operations for systematic issue resolution, including branching to explore alternative solutions and reverting failed edits. Experiments on SWE-Bench Lite and SWE-Bench Pro demonstrate that SWE-Adept consistently outperforms prior approaches in both issue localization and resolution, improving the end-to-end resolve rate by up to 4.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Adept 用定位与修复两个 agent 做仓库级 issue 处理：定位端用 agent 导向的深度优先搜索 (depth-first search) 选择性遍历代码依赖以压缩上下文，修复端用自适应规划加共享工作记忆中的执行步索引代码状态检查点，支持分支与回滚。在 SWE-Bench Lite 与 SWE-Bench Pro 上端到端 resolve rate 最多提升 4.3%。
Motivation: LLM 在自包含编程任务上表现强，但仓库级 SWE 需要带上下文管理的深度代码导航与迭代、测试驱动的改码流程，现有模型在这两点上仍然吃力。
Method: 双 agent 框架：定位 agent 用 agent-directed depth-first search 选择性遍历代码依赖，减少上下文窗口中的无关内容；修复 agent 走 adaptive planning 与结构化问题求解，配备进度跟踪工具和基于 Git 的版本控制工具，工具通过共享工作记忆访问按执行步索引的代码状态检查点 (code-state checkpoints)，从而支持分支探索与失败编辑回滚。
Result: 在 SWE-Bench Lite 与 SWE-Bench Pro 上，SWE-Adept 在 issue 定位与修复两方面均持续优于先前方法，端到端 resolve rate 最多提升 4.3%。
Conclusion: 把代码定位与修复拆成两个 agent、并用深度优先依赖遍历和检查点化的版本控制支撑迭代改码，可以在仓库级 issue 解决上稳定超过既有方案。

papers.title: Don't stop me now: How Validation Criteria Affect Checkpoint Selection and Early Stopping
papers.abstract_en: Checkpoint selection is a standard component of neural network training, yet the validation criterion used to select a checkpoint is often chosen heuristically. Moreover, the same criterion may be used either only to rank checkpoints after completion of a predefined training run or also to determine when training should stop, thereby affecting both the selected checkpoint and the set of checkpoints available for selection. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of validation criteria under these two settings. We separately vary the training loss, the validation criterion, and the target evaluation metric, and compare post-hoc checkpoint selection, in which training proceeds for all predefined epochs, with patience-based early stopping, in which the validation criterion also controls training termination. We consider three Cross-Entropy, C-Loss, and PolyLoss as training losses, and accuracy, macro-F1, and Matthews correlation coefficient as target metrics. Selection quality is assessed through the relative gap between the test performance of the validation-selected checkpoint and the best-observed test performance for the same target metric over the complete predefined training run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统考察验证准则在两种用途下的差异：只用于事后挑选 checkpoint，还是同时用 patience 控制早停。结论是同一准则的两种用法会同时改变被选中的 checkpoint 和可选集合，作者用相对差距（验证所选 checkpoint 的测试性能与完整训练中该目标指标最优测试性能之比）来度量选择质量。
Motivation: checkpoint 选择是训练标配，但验证准则往往凭经验选定；同一准则既可只做事后排序，也可决定何时停止训练，从而同时影响被选 checkpoint 与候选集合，这一角色此前缺少系统研究。
Method: 分别改变训练损失（Cross-Entropy、C-Loss、PolyLoss）、验证准则与目标评估指标（accuracy、macro-F1、Matthews correlation coefficient），对比两种设置：跑完预定全部 epoch 的 post-hoc checkpoint selection，以及由验证准则控制终止的 patience-based early stopping。
Result: 以相对差距度量选择质量：验证所选 checkpoint 的测试性能与同一目标指标在整个预定训练过程中最佳测试性能之间的相对差距。
Conclusion: 验证准则的用途（事后排序 vs. 控制早停）本身是影响 checkpoint 选择质量的独立变量，需与训练损失和目标指标分开考察。

papers.title: CausalReasoningBenchmark: A Real-World Benchmark for Disentangled Evaluation of Causal Identification and Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Many benchmarks for automated causal inference evaluate a system's performance based on a single numerical output, such as an Average Treatment Effect (ATE). This approach conflates two distinct steps in causal analysis: identification, formulating a valid research design under stated assumptions, and estimation, implementing that design numerically on finite data. We introduce CausalReasoningBenchmark, a benchmark of 174 queries across 139 real-world datasets, curated from 73 peer-reviewed research papers and three widely used causal-inference textbooks. For each query, a system must produce (i) a structured identification specification that names the strategy, the treatment, outcome, and control variables, and all design-specific elements, and (ii) a point estimate with a standard error. By scoring these two components separately, our benchmark enables granular diagnosis: it distinguishes failures in causal reasoning from errors in numerical execution. Baseline results with a state-of-the-art LLM show that, while the model correctly identifies the high-level strategy in 81% of cases, full identification-specification correctness drops to only 38%, revealing that the bottleneck lies in the nuanced details of research design rather than in computation. CausalReasoningBenchmark is publicly available on Hugging Face and is designed to foster the development of more robust automated causal-inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalReasoningBenchmark 把自动因果推断评测拆成识别与估计两段：174 条查询、139 个真实数据集，要求系统先给出结构化识别规格（策略、处理、结果、控制变量及设计要素），再给出点估计与标准误。SOTA LLM 在 81% 的案例中选对高层策略，但完整识别规格正确率仅 38%，说明瓶颈在研究设计的细节而非数值计算。
Motivation: 现有自动因果推断基准只用 ATE 等单一数值打分，把识别（在给定假设下构造有效研究设计）与估计（在有限数据上数值实现）混为一谈，无法区分因果推理错误与数值执行错误。
Method: 构建 174 条查询、覆盖 139 个真实数据集，语料来自 73 篇同行评议论文与三本常用因果推断教材；每条查询要求输出两部分：结构化识别规格（策略、处理、结果、控制变量及设计特定要素）与带标准误的点估计，两部分分别打分以实现细粒度诊断。
Result: 基准含 174 条查询、139 个真实数据集、73 篇论文与 3 本教材；SOTA LLM 在 81% 案例中正确识别高层策略，但完整识别规格正确率仅 38%。
Conclusion: 自动因果推断的瓶颈在研究设计的细节层面而非数值计算，评测必须把识别与估计分开打分才能定位失败环节。

papers.title: Universal Pose Pretraining for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often suffer from feature collapse and low training efficiency because they entangle high-level perception with sparse, embodiment-specific action supervision. Since these models typically rely on VLM backbones optimized for Visual Question Answering (VQA), they excel at semantic identification but often overlook subtle 3D state variations that dictate distinct action patterns. To resolve these misalignments, we propose Pose-VLA, a decoupled paradigm that separates VLA training into a pre-training phase for extracting universal 3D spatial priors in a unified camera-centric space, and a post-training phase for efficient embodiment alignment within robot-specific action space. By introducing discrete pose tokens as a universal representation, Pose-VLA seamlessly integrates spatial grounding from diverse 3D datasets with geometry-level trajectories from robotic demonstrations. Our framework follows a two-stage pre-training pipeline, establishing fundamental spatial grounding via poses followed by motion alignment through trajectory supervision. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Pose-VLA achieves state-of-the-art results on RoboTwin 2.0 with a 79.5% average success rate and competitive performance on LIBERO at 96.0%. Real-world experiments further showcase robust generalization across diverse objects using only 100 demonstrations per task, validating the efficiency of our pre-training paradigm.
papers.comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026. Project website: https://hetolin.github.io/PoseVLA

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pose-VLA 把 VLA 训练拆成两阶段：先在统一相机坐标系里用离散 pose token 做通用 3D 空间预训练，再在机器人动作空间做本体对齐的后训练。RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 79.5% 达到 SOTA，LIBERO 上 96.0%，真实世界每任务仅 100 条演示即可跨物体泛化。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 把高层感知与稀疏、绑定本体的动作监督纠缠在一起，导致特征塌缩与训练低效；VQA 优化的 VLM 骨干擅长语义识别，却忽略决定动作差异的细微 3D 状态变化。
Method: Pose-VLA 两阶段流程：先用离散 pose token 作为统一表示，把多源 3D 数据集的空间定位与机器人演示的几何轨迹一起接入，第一阶段以位姿建立空间 grounding，第二阶段用轨迹监督做运动对齐；后训练阶段在机器人专属动作空间内做高效本体对齐。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 79.5%，达到 state-of-the-art；LIBERO 上 96.0% 的竞争性表现；真实世界实验中每任务仅用 100 条演示即可跨多样物体实现稳健泛化。
Conclusion: 把 3D 空间先验预训练与本体动作对齐解耦，用 pose token 作中介，可在少量演示下得到可泛化的 VLA 策略。

papers.title: Coverage-aware Semantic Representation Learning for Underrepresented Visual Concepts
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision models increasingly rely on rich semantic representations that extend beyond class labels to include descriptive concepts, attributes, and contextual cues. However, semantic concepts are not uniformly represented across classes: a concept may be frequent globally yet remain underrepresented within a class, resulting in low class-concept coverage. We formalize this class-concept phenomenon as Semantic Coverage Imbalance (SCI) and study its relationship with learned semantic representations. We find that lower class-concept coverage is consistently associated with weaker semantic representations. To address this, we introduce Coverage-aware Semantic Representation Learning, which shares more semantic structure for low coverage or uncertain relations while preserving more pair-specific structure for high coverage relations. We instantiate this principle in SemCovNet with Coverage-Calibrated Semantic Sharing (CCSS), a coverage- and uncertainty-aware partial-pooling mechanism. Using a range of vision datasets spanning facial attributes and fine-grained recognition, as well as real-world medical datasets, we show that SCI is widespread, degrades representation quality, and can be mitigated through coverage-aware semantic representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉模型的语义概念在类内分布不均，作者把这一现象形式化为 Semantic Coverage Imbalance (SCI)，并证明类-概念覆盖率越低，学到的语义表征越弱。提出的 SemCovNet 用 Coverage-Calibrated Semantic Sharing (CCSS) 做覆盖率与不确定性感知的 partial pooling：低覆盖或不确定的关系共享更多语义结构，高覆盖关系保留更多类对专属结构。在人脸属性、细粒度识别与真实医学数据集上，SCI 普遍存在、损害表征质量，且可被该方法缓解。
Motivation: 语义概念在类间并非均匀分布：一个概念可能全局高频却在某个类内严重欠表示，导致类-概念覆盖率低，进而削弱该类学到的语义表征。
Method: 提出 Coverage-aware Semantic Representation Learning，实例化为 SemCovNet 的 Coverage-Calibrated Semantic Sharing (CCSS)：一个覆盖率与不确定性感知的 partial-pooling 机制，对低覆盖或不确定的关系共享更多语义结构，对高覆盖关系保留更多 pair-specific 结构。
Result: 在覆盖人脸属性、细粒度识别以及真实医学数据集的一组视觉数据集上，结果显示 SCI 广泛存在、会降低表征质量，并可通过 coverage-aware 语义表征学习得到缓解；摘要给出的是定性结论。
Conclusion: 类-概念覆盖率是语义表征质量的一个可操作的结构性决定因素，按覆盖率调节共享程度即可缓解 SCI 带来的表征退化。

papers.title: Use What You Know: Causal Foundation Models with Partial Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal quantities traditionally relies on bespoke estimators tailored to specific assumptions. Recently proposed Causal Foundation Models (CFMs) promise a more unified approach by amortising causal discovery and inference in a single step. However, in their current state, they do not allow for the incorporation of any domain knowledge, which can lead to suboptimal predictions. We bridge this gap by introducing methods to condition CFMs on causal information, such as the causal graph or more readily available ancestral information. When access to complete causal graph information is too strict a requirement, our approach also effectively leverages partial causal information. We systematically evaluate conditioning strategies and find that injecting learnable biases into the attention mechanism, together with a graph-convolutional encoder, is a highly effective method to utilise full and partial causal information. Our experiments show that this conditioning allows a general-purpose CFM to match the performance of specialised models trained on specific causal structures. Overall, our approach addresses a central hurdle on the path towards all-in-one causal foundation models: the capability to answer causal queries in a data-driven manner while effectively leveraging any amount of domain expertise.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 因果基础模型 (CFM) 原本无法注入领域知识，本文提出在注意力机制中注入可学习偏置并配合图卷积编码器，使 CFM 能以完整或部分因果图（含祖先关系）为条件。该条件化让通用 CFM 在特定因果结构上追平专门训练的模型。
Motivation: 现有 CFM 把因果发现与推断一次性摊销，但不能纳入任何领域知识，导致预测次优；而完整因果图往往难以获得，需要能利用部分因果信息的条件化方案。
Method: 系统评估多种条件化策略：把因果图或更易得的祖先 (ancestral) 信息作为条件，注入注意力机制的可学习偏置 (learnable biases)，并用图卷积编码器 (graph-convolutional encoder) 编码全图与部分图信息。
Result: 实验显示，注意力偏置加图卷积编码器是利用完整与部分因果信息的高效策略；该条件化使通用 CFM 在特定因果结构上的表现追平专门训练的模型。
Conclusion: 把任意数量的领域知识以部分图形式条件化注入注意力，是通向能数据驱动回答因果查询的 all-in-one 因果基础模型的关键一步。

papers.title: TADA! Tuning Audio Diffusion Models through Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Audio diffusion models can synthesize high-fidelity music from text, yet achieving fine-grained control over specific musical attributes remains challenging, as their internal mechanisms for representing high-level concepts are poorly understood. In this work, we use activation patching to demonstrate that recent audio diffusion architectures exhibit a semantic bottleneck, where a small, shared subset of consecutive attention layers controls distinct musical concepts, such as the presence of specific instruments, vocals, or genres. Building on this, we systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of steering paradigms, comparing activation steering against prompt-level, score-space, and weight-space interventions, analyzing the interaction between the steering mechanism and the intervention site. Our new benchmark, supported by an extensive user study, demonstrates that localized activation steering establishes a new state-of-the-art in audio concept modulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 activation patching 证明音频扩散模型存在语义瓶颈：少数连续注意力层共同控制乐器、人声、流派等音乐概念。在此基础上系统比较 activation steering 与 prompt-level、score-space、weight-space 干预，发现定位式 activation steering 在音频概念调制上达到新的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 文本到音频扩散模型能合成高保真音乐，但对特定音乐属性的细粒度控制困难，因为其内部表示高层概念的机制不透明。
Method: 先用 activation patching 定位控制概念的少数连续注意力层（语义瓶颈），再系统评估 activation steering、prompt-level、score-space、weight-space 四类干预范式，并分析干预机制与干预位置的交互；提出新 benchmark 并配大规模 user study。
Result: 定位式 activation steering 在新 benchmark 与用户研究中确立音频概念调制的新 state-of-the-art；activation patching 显示控制不同音乐概念的是一个小的、共享的连续注意力层子集。
Conclusion: 音频扩散模型的高层音乐概念集中在少数共享注意力层，因此在该位置做 activation steering 比改 prompt、score 或权重更有效地实现细粒度概念控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSR: Trajectory-Search Rollouts for Multi-Turn RL of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are driving a shift toward using reinforcement learning (RL) to train agents from iterative, multi-turn interactions across tasks. However, multi-turn RL remains challenging as rewards are often sparse or delayed, and environments can be stochastic. In this regime, naive trajectory sampling can hinder exploitation and induce mode collapse. We propose TSR (Trajectory-Search Rollouts), a training-time approach that repurposes test-time scaling ideas for improved per-turn rollout generation. TSR performs lightweight tree-style search to construct higher-quality trajectories by selecting promising actions and trajectory prefixes during rollout generation. This improves rollout quality while preserving stable policy optimization and remains compatible with standard policy-gradient optimizers by design. Across Sokoban, FrozenLake, and WebShop, TSR achieves success-rate gains of up to 15 percentage points and converges in fewer optimization steps, while trading additional training-time rollout compute for stronger policies that require no search at inference time. By moving search from test time to the rollout stage of training, TSR provides a modular mechanism for stronger multi-turn agent learning, complementary to existing frameworks and rejection-sampling-style selection methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TSR (Trajectory-Search Rollouts) 把测试时的树搜索搬到多轮 RL 的 rollout 阶段，在生成轨迹时做轻量树搜索挑选有希望的动作与轨迹前缀，从而在稀疏/延迟奖励与随机环境下缓解朴素轨迹采样导致的利用不足和 mode collapse。在 Sokoban、FrozenLake、WebShop 上成功率最高提升 15 个百分点，且收敛所需优化步数更少，代价是训练期 rollout 计算增加，推理时无需搜索。
Motivation: 多轮 RL 训练 LLM agent 时奖励稀疏或延迟、环境随机，朴素轨迹采样妨碍利用并引发 mode collapse，需要在不破坏策略优化稳定性的前提下提高 rollout 质量。
Method: TSR 是训练期方法：rollout 生成时执行轻量树式搜索 (tree-style search)，挑选有希望的动作与轨迹前缀来构造更高质量轨迹；设计上与标准 policy-gradient 优化器兼容，属于模块化机制，可与现有框架及 rejection-sampling 式选择方法互补。
Result: 在 Sokoban、FrozenLake、WebShop 三个环境上，成功率提升最高达 15 个百分点，并以更少的优化步数收敛；以额外的训练期 rollout 计算换取更强的策略，推理阶段不需要搜索。
Conclusion: 把搜索从测试时前移到训练 rollout 阶段，是增强多轮 agent 学习的模块化手段：策略更强且推理零搜索开销，代价只落在训练算力上。

papers.title: Dr. MAS: Stable Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems enable advanced reasoning and tool use via role specialization, yet reliable reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for such systems remains difficult. In this work, we theoretically pinpoint a key reason for training instability when extending group-based RL to multi-agent LLM systems. We show that under GRPO-style optimization, a global normalization baseline may deviate from diverse agents' reward distributions, which ultimately leads to gradient-norm instability. Based on this finding, we propose Dr. MAS, a simple and stable RL training recipe for multi-agent LLM systems. Dr. MAS uses an agent-wise remedy: normalizing advantages per agent using each agent's own reward statistics, which calibrates gradient scales and dramatically stabilizes training, both theoretically and empirically. Beyond the algorithm, Dr. MAS provides an end-to-end RL training framework for multi-agent LLM systems, supporting scalable orchestration, flexible per-agent LLM serving and optimization configs, and shared resource scheduling of LLM actor backends. We evaluate Dr. MAS on multi-agent math reasoning and multi-turn search benchmarks using Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 series models. Dr. MAS achieves clear gains over vanilla GRPO (e.g., +5.6\% avg@16 and +4.6\% pass@16 on math, and +15.2\% avg@16 and +13.1\% pass@16 on search) while largely eliminating gradient spikes. Moreover, it remains highly effective under heterogeneous agent-model assignments while improving efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体 LLM 的 GRPO 训练用全局归一化基线时会偏离各 agent 各自的奖励分布，导致梯度范数不稳定；Dr. MAS 改为按每个 agent 自身的奖励统计量逐智能体归一化优势，标定梯度尺度。在 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 的多智能体数学推理与多轮搜索基准上，相对 vanilla GRPO 数学 avg@16 +5.6%、pass@16 +4.6%，搜索 avg@16 +15.2%、pass@16 +13.1%，同时基本消除梯度尖峰。
Motivation: 把基于组的 RL 扩展到多智能体 LLM 系统时训练不稳定，需要定位其理论根源而不只是调参。
Method: 理论上指出 GRPO 式优化的全局归一化基线与多样化 agent 的奖励分布失配会引发梯度范数不稳定；据此提出 Dr. MAS：逐 agent 用各自奖励统计量归一化优势，并配套端到端 RL 训练框架，支持可扩展编排、灵活的 per-agent LLM serving 与优化配置、以及 LLM actor 后端的共享资源调度。
Result: 在多智能体数学推理与多轮搜索基准上（Qwen2.5 与 Qwen3 系列），相对 vanilla GRPO：数学 avg@16 +5.6%、pass@16 +4.6%；搜索 avg@16 +15.2%、pass@16 +13.1%；梯度尖峰基本被消除，在异构 agent-模型分配下仍保持高效并提升效率。
Conclusion: 训练不稳的根源是全局基线与各 agent 奖励分布失配，逐智能体优势归一化即可在理论与经验上稳定多智能体 LLM 的 RL 训练，且对异构模型分配鲁棒。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unveiling Implicit Advantage Symmetry: Why GRPO Struggles with Exploration and Difficulty Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), particularly GRPO, has become the standard for eliciting LLM reasoning. However, its efficiency in exploration and difficulty adaptation remains an open challenge. In this work, we identify an implicit advantage symmetry inherent in Group Relative Advantage Estimation (GRAE) as a structural property that provides a new perspective for understanding these bottlenecks. This symmetry induces two critical limitations: (i) at the group level, strict symmetry in weights between correct and incorrect trajectories leaves unsampled action logits unchanged, thereby hindering the exploration of novel correct solution. (ii) at the sample level, the algorithm implicitly prioritizes medium-difficulty samples, remaining agnostic to the non-stationary demands of difficulty focus. Through controlled experiments, we reveal that this symmetric property is sub-optimal, yielding two pivotal insights: (i) asymmetrically down-weighting the advantages of correct trajectories encourages essential exploration but risks instability; (ii) learning efficiency can be boosted by a curriculum-like transition-prioritizing simpler samples initially before gradually shifting to complex ones. Motivated by these findings, we propose Asymmetric GRAE (A-GRAE), which dynamically modulates exploration incentives and sample-difficulty focus. Experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that A-GRAE consistently improves GRPO and its variants across both LLMs and MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/A-GRAE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 GRPO 的组相对优势估计 (GRAE) 存在隐式优势对称性：组层面正确与错误轨迹权重严格对称使未采样动作的 logit 不变，样本层面则隐式偏好中等难度。非对称下调正确轨迹优势可促进探索但有不稳定风险，课程式先易后难的难度调度能提升学习效率；据此提出 A-GRAE 动态调节探索激励与难度焦点，在七个基准上一致改进 GRPO 及其变体。
Motivation: RLVR 中 GRPO 的探索效率与难度自适应仍是开放问题：对称权重抑制新正确解的探索，且样本难度焦点无法响应非平稳的训练需求。
Method: 先用受控实验刻画 GRAE 的隐式优势对称性及其两条后果，再据此提出 Asymmetric GRAE (A-GRAE)，非对称调制正确轨迹的探索激励，并加入先简后繁的课程式样本难度调度；在 LLM 与 MLLM 上评测。
Result: 受控实验给出两条结论：非对称下调正确轨迹优势能促进探索但伴随不稳定风险；学习效率可通过先优先简单样本、再逐步转向复杂样本的课程式过渡提升。A-GRAE 在七个基准上一致改进 GRPO 及其变体，覆盖 LLM 与 MLLM。
Conclusion: GRAE 的对称性是次优的结构性质，非对称优势加权加课程式难度调度可同时改善 GRPO 的探索与难度自适应。

papers.title: Structure-First Point Cloud Learning with Mapper Region Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Robust 3D point cloud classification is often pursued by scaling up backbones or relying on specialized data augmentation. We instead ask whether structural abstraction alone can improve robustness, and study a simple topology-inspired decomposition based on the Mapper algorithm. We propose Mapper-GIN, a lightweight pipeline that partitions a point cloud into overlapping regions using Mapper (PCA lens, cubical cover, and followed by density-based clustering), constructs a region graph from their overlaps, and performs graph classification with a Graph Isomorphism Network. On the corruption benchmark ModelNet40-C, Mapper-GIN achieves competitive and stable accuracy under Noise and Transformation corruptions with only 0.5M parameters. In contrast to prior approaches that require heavier architectures or additional mechanisms to gain robustness, Mapper-GIN attains strong corruption robustness through simple region-level graph abstraction and GIN message passing. Overall, our results suggest that region-graph structure offers an efficient and interpretable source of robustness for 3D visual recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mapper-GIN 用 Mapper 算法（PCA lens + cubical cover + 密度聚类）把点云切成重叠区域并建成区域重叠图，再用 GIN 做图分类，在 ModelNet40-C 的 Noise 与 Transformation 损坏下以 0.5M 参数取得有竞争力且稳定的准确率。结论是区域级结构抽象本身即可提供鲁棒性，无需加重骨干或额外增强机制。
Motivation: 3D 点云分类的鲁棒性通常靠放大骨干网络或堆专用数据增强来换取，计算代价高且机制不透明；作者要检验仅靠结构抽象能否带来鲁棒性。
Method: Mapper-GIN 流水线：先用 Mapper 算法（PCA lens、cubical cover、随后基于密度的聚类）把点云划分为重叠区域，再由区域间重叠构造 region graph，最后用 Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN) 做消息传递与图分类；整体仅 0.5M 参数。
Result: 在 ModelNet40-C 损坏基准上，Mapper-GIN 在 Noise 与 Transformation 两类损坏下取得有竞争力且稳定的准确率，参数量仅 0.5M；对比对象为需要更重架构或额外机制的既有鲁棒性方法。
Conclusion: 区域图结构（region-graph structure）是 3D 视觉识别中高效且可解释的鲁棒性来源，轻量的结构抽象加 GIN 消息传递足以对抗噪声与变换类损坏。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CodeScaler: Scaling Code LLM Training and Test-Time Inference via Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has driven recent progress in code large language models by leveraging execution-based feedback from unit tests, but its scalability is fundamentally constrained by the availability and reliability of high-quality test cases. We propose CodeScaler, a reward model designed to scale both reinforcement learning training and test-time inference for code generation. CodeScaler is trained on carefully curated preference data derived from verified code problems and incorporates syntax-aware code extraction and validity-preserving reward shaping to ensure stable and robust optimization. Across four coding benchmarks, CodeScaler consistently outperforms execution-based RL by +1.55 points on Qwen3-8B-Base and +4.23 points on Qwen3-14B-Base. By further scaling to 44K problems with additional synthetic data, CodeScaler yields +14.64 points improvement over the base model without requiring any test cases. At inference time, CodeScaler serves as an effective test-time scaling method, achieving performance comparable to unit test approaches while providing a 10-fold reduction in latency. Moreover, CodeScaler surpasses existing reward models on RM-Bench not only in the code domain (+3.3 points), but also in general and reasoning domains (+2.7 points on average).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeScaler 是一个面向代码生成的奖励模型，用可验证代码问题构造的偏好数据训练，并加入语法感知的代码抽取与保有效应的 reward shaping，以替代依赖单元测试的 RLVR。在四个代码基准上它比基于执行的 RL 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上高 1.55 分、Qwen3-14B-Base 上高 4.23 分；扩到 44K 问题后比 base 模型高 14.64 分且完全不需要测试用例，推理时延迟降低 10 倍。
Motivation: RLVR 在代码 LLM 上的可扩展性被高质量测试用例的数量与可靠性卡住，测试用例的获取和执行成本同时限制训练规模与推理时扩展。
Method: CodeScaler 作为奖励模型，训练数据是从可验证代码问题整理出的偏好数据；训练中加入 syntax-aware code extraction 与 validity-preserving reward shaping 以稳定优化。训练规模进一步扩到 44K 问题并加入合成数据；推理阶段直接把该 RM 用作 test-time scaling 的打分器，替代单元测试执行。
Result: 四个代码基准上，CodeScaler 一致优于基于执行的 RL：Qwen3-8B-Base +1.55 分，Qwen3-14B-Base +4.23 分。扩到 44K 问题加合成数据后，相对 base 模型提升 +14.64 分且不需要任何测试用例。推理时性能与单元测试方法相当，延迟降低 10 倍。在 RM-Bench 上超过已有奖励模型：代码域 +3.3 分，通用与推理域平均 +2.7 分。
Conclusion: 奖励模型可以在不依赖单元测试的前提下同时扩展代码 RL 训练与 test-time 推理，并把延迟降一个数量级；其收益还外溢到通用与推理域的奖励建模。

papers.title: Symmetric Composition of Anisotropic Operators for Global Subseasonal-to-Seasonal Climate Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate global Subseasonal-to-Seasonal (S2S) climate forecasting is critical for disaster preparedness and resource management, yet it remains challenging due to chaotic atmospheric dynamics. Despite advances in geometry-aware representations, existing methods do not specify how the zonal and meridional interactions that govern real atmospheric dynamics should be explicitly coordinated and composed, leaving an important architectural gap for S2S forecasting. In this paper, we propose AnisoCast, which explicitly models anisotropic global atmospheric dynamics for accurate S2S climate forecasting. It couples: (1) an Anisotropic Embedding strategy that tokenizes the global grid into latitudinal rings, preserving the integrity of zonal periodic structures; and (2) stacked Aniso Blocks that arrange latent Zonal and Meridional Operators in a weight-shared palindromic composition inspired by symmetric operator splitting. Extensive experiments on the ERA5 reanalysis dataset demonstrate that AnisoCast establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming existing methods in both forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 S2S 气候预报模型 AnisoCast：把全球网格按纬向环 (latitudinal rings) token 化以保留纬向周期结构，再把潜在的纬向与经向算子按权重共享的回文顺序堆叠，显式协调各向异性大气动力学。在 ERA5 再分析数据上，该模型在预报精度与计算效率两方面同时达到新的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有几何感知表示没有规定主导真实大气动力学的纬向与经向相互作用应如何显式协调与组合，S2S 预报因此存在架构缺口，而大气混沌动力学本身又使这一尺度的预报困难。
Method: AnisoCast 由两部分耦合：Anisotropic Embedding 将全球网格按纬向环 token 化，保持纬向周期结构完整；堆叠的 Aniso Block 把潜在 Zonal 与 Meridional Operators 排成权重共享的回文组合 (palindromic composition)，思路来自对称算子分裂 (symmetric operator splitting)。
Result: 在 ERA5 再分析数据集上的大量实验中，AnisoCast 建立新的 state-of-the-art，在预报精度与计算效率两方面均显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把纬向/经向算子按对称分裂方式显式组合，是补齐 S2S 预报架构缺口的有效路径，可同时改善精度与计算效率。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: Instance-optimal high-precision shadow tomography with few-copy measurements: A metrological approach
papers.abstract_en: We study the sample complexity of shadow tomography in the high-precision regime under realistic measurement constraints. Given an unknown $d$-dimensional quantum state $ρ$ and a known set of observables $\{O_i\}_{i=1}^m$, the goal is to estimate expectation values $\{\mathrm{tr}(O_iρ)\}_{i=1}^m$ to accuracy $ε$ in $L_p$-norm, using possibly adaptive measurements that act on $O(\mathrm{polylog}(d))$ number of copies of $ρ$ at a time. We focus on the regime where $ε$ is below an instance-dependent threshold. Our main contribution is an instance-optimal characterization of the sample complexity as $\tildeΘ(Γ_p/ε^2)$, where $Γ_p$ is a function of $\{O_i\}_{i=1}^m$ defined via an optimization formula involving the inverse Fisher information matrix. Previously, tight bounds were known only in special cases, e.g. Pauli shadow tomography with $L_\infty$-norm error. Concretely, we first analyze a simpler oblivious variant where the goal is to estimate an observable of the form $\sum_{i=1}^m α_i O_i$ with $\|α\|_q = 1$ (where $q$ is dual to $p$) revealed after the measurement. For single-copy measurements, we obtain a sample complexity of $Θ(Γ^{\mathrm{ob}}_p/ε^2)$. We then show $\tildeΘ(Γ_p/ε^2)$ is necessary and sufficient for the original problem, with the lower bound applying to unbiased, bounded estimators. Our upper bounds rely on a two-step algorithm combining coarse tomography with local estimation. Notably, $Γ^{\mathrm{ob}}_\infty = Γ_\infty$. In both cases, allowing $c$-copy measurements improves the sample complexity by at most $Ω(1/c)$. Our results establish a quantitative correspondence between quantum learning and metrology, unifying asymptotic metrological limits with finite-sample learning guarantees.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Thirty Ninth Conference on Learning Theory, PMLR 336:1115-1185, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高精度区间（ε 低于实例相关阈值）给出 shadow tomography 样本复杂度的实例最优刻画：用逆 Fisher 信息矩阵定义的 Γ_p，样本复杂度为 ~Θ(Γ_p/ε²)。单拷贝测量下 oblivious 变体为 Θ(Γ_p^ob/ε²)，且 Γ_∞^ob = Γ_∞；允许 c 拷贝测量最多把样本复杂度改进 Ω(1/c)。
Motivation: 高精度 shadow tomography 此前只有 Pauli shadow tomography 配 L_∞ 误差等特例有紧界，一般观测量集合与 L_p 误差下缺少实例依赖的最优样本复杂度刻画。
Method: 先分析 oblivious 变体：测量后才揭示系数 α（‖α‖_q=1）的可观测量 Σα_iO_i，单拷贝测量下得 Θ(Γ_p^ob/ε²)；再把结论提升到原问题，下界适用于无偏有界估计器，上界用「粗 tomography + 局部估计」两步算法，Γ_p 由含逆 Fisher 信息矩阵的优化式定义。

papers.title: SalamahBench: Dialect and Category Level Safety Evaluation of Arabic Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While different stakeholders are trying to leverage Arabic Language Models (ALMs), safety alignment in ALMs remains largely underexplored, hindering their mainstream adoption. Existing safety benchmarks are predominantly English-centric and evaluate Arabic only in its standardized form, obscuring fine-grained safety vulnerabilities in Arabic NLP systems. This paper introduces SalamahBench, a unified benchmark of 8{,}270 human-verified harmful prompts across ML Commons hazard categories, each rendered in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and five regional Arabic varieties, namely Egyptian, Syrian, Saudi, Lebanese, and Moroccan, for a total of 49{,}620 paired instances. To analyze the resulting data, we introduce two complementary metrics, namely Dialect Shift, which measures a model's aggregate change in safety under dialectal reformulation, and Category-Specific Dialect Deviation, which isolates harm categories whose change departs from that aggregate trend. Evaluating models such as Fanar 2, ALLaM 2, and Karnak 1 under multiple safeguard configurations, we find that cross-variety robustness is strongly model dependent, and that aggregate scores can conceal category-level divergence. Our findings highlight the necessity of evaluating Arabic model safety jointly across linguistic varieties and harm domains rather than relying on aggregate scores or MSA alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SalamahBench 把 8,270 条人工核验的有害提示分别改写成 MSA 与埃及、叙利亚、沙特、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥五种阿拉伯方言，共 49,620 条配对实例，并提出 Dialect Shift 与 Category-Specific Dialect Deviation 两个指标衡量方言改写下的安全变化。对 Fanar 2、ALLaM 2、Karnak 1 的评测显示跨方言鲁棒性强烈依赖具体模型，且聚合分数会掩盖危害类别层面的分歧。
Motivation: 现有安全基准以英语为主，且只测阿拉伯语的标准形式 (MSA)，掩盖了方言改写下细粒度的安全脆弱性，阻碍阿拉伯语言模型 (ALM) 的主流采用。
Method: 构建统一基准：8,270 条人工核验有害提示，按 ML Commons 危害类别组织，每条渲染为 MSA 加五种区域方言，形成 49,620 条配对实例；提出 Dialect Shift（方言改写下安全性的总体变化）与 Category-Specific Dialect Deviation（偏离该总体趋势的危害类别）两个互补指标，在多种 safeguard 配置下评测 Fanar 2、ALLaM 2、Karnak 1。
Result: 跨方言鲁棒性强烈依赖模型，聚合分数会掩盖类别层面的分歧；基准规模为 8,270 条提示、49,620 条配对实例，覆盖 MSA 与五种方言。
Conclusion: 阿拉伯模型的安全必须跨语言变体与危害领域联合评估，不能只看聚合分数或仅用 MSA。

papers.title: VLM-Guided Experience Replay
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled powerful semantic and multimodal reasoning capabilities, creating new opportunities to enhance sample efficiency, high-level planning, and interpretability in reinforcement learning (RL). While prior work has integrated LLMs and VLMs into various components of RL, the replay buffer, a core component for storing and reusing experiences, remains unexplored. We propose addressing this gap by leveraging VLMs to guide the prioritization of experiences in the replay buffer. Our key idea is to use a frozen, pre-trained VLM as an automated evaluator to identify and prioritize promising sub-trajectories from the agent's experiences. Across scenarios, including game-playing and robotics, spanning both discrete and continuous domains, agents trained with our proposed prioritization method achieve 15-57% higher average success rates and improve sample efficiency by 35-55% compared to previous approaches. Project page: https://esharony.me/projects/vlm-rb/
papers.comment: Revised experimental results and expanded ablations and analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结的预训练 VLM 作为自动评估器，对 replay buffer 中的子轨迹打分并优先回放，在游戏与机器人（离散与连续）任务上把平均成功率提高 15–57%、样本效率提高 35–55%。
Motivation: LLM/VLM 已被接入 RL 的多个组件，但存储与复用经验的 replay buffer 这一核心环节尚未被利用语义与多模态推理来改进优先级排序。
Method: 提出 VLM-Guided Experience Replay：冻结的预训练 VLM 充当自动评估器，对智能体经验中的子轨迹做优先级排序，再按该优先级回放训练。
Result: 在游戏与机器人、离散与连续域的多场景中，采用该优先级方法的智能体平均成功率比既有方法高 15–57%，样本效率提升 35–55%。
Conclusion: 把冻结 VLM 作为 replay buffer 的经验评估器，可以在离散与连续控制任务上同时提高成功率与样本效率。

papers.title: Do Latent-CoT Models Think Step-by-Step? A Mechanistic Study on Sequential Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Latent Chain-of-Thought aims to enable step-by-step computation without emitting long rationales, yet its internal mechanisms remain unclear. We study CODI, a continuous-thought teacher-student distillation model, on strictly sequential polynomial-iteration tasks with known intermediate states. Using logit-lens decoding, linear probes, attention analysis, and activation patching, we localize intermediate-state representations and trace how they are routed to the final readout. In short-horizon, low-hop tasks, CODI forms faithful bridge states across latent-thought positions, while the final input follows a separate near-direct route; predictions arise through late fusion at the answer readout. As task depth and difficulty increase, however, CODI does not reliably sustain a full latent rollout: it either compresses computation into a partial late-intermediate pathway or, in harder regimes, loses the latent reasoning signature altogether. To explain this transition, we show theoretically that the task's algebraic structure controls its effective memory: compressible regimes support late-bottleneck reasoning, while incompressible regimes preserve full-history dependence and destabilize latent rollouts. Overall, our results characterize when CODI-style latent-CoT yields faithful iterative computation versus compressed or shortcut strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 CODI（连续思维教师-学生蒸馏模型）做机制可解释性研究：在已知中间状态的严格顺序多项式迭代任务上，用 logit-lens、线性探针、注意力分析与 activation patching 定位中间态表征及其到最终读出的路由。浅层低跳任务中 CODI 形成忠实 bridge state，但最终输入走近乎直连的独立路径、在读出处晚期融合；任务加深后它要么把计算压缩到部分晚中间通路，要么完全丢失 latent reasoning 签名。
Motivation: Latent CoT 声称在不输出长推理链的情况下做逐步计算，但其内部机制不清：无法判断模型是真的迭代计算还是走了捷径。
Method: 研究对象为 CODI，任务是具有已知中间状态的严格顺序多项式迭代任务；工具组合为 logit-lens 解码、线性探针 (linear probes)、注意力分析与 activation patching，用于定位中间态表征并追踪其到最终读出的路由；另给出理论解释，说明任务的代数结构如何控制有效记忆。
Result: 短视界低跳任务中 CODI 在各 latent-thought 位置形成忠实 bridge state，但最终输入经由独立的近直连路径、预测在答案读出处通过晚期融合产生；随深度与难度上升，CODI 或压缩计算到部分晚中间通路，或在更难 regime 完全丢失 latent reasoning 签名。理论上可压缩 regime 支持 late-bottleneck 推理，不可压缩 regime 保留全历史依赖并使 latent rollout 失稳。
Conclusion: CODI 式 latent-CoT 只在任务代数结构可压缩、深度较浅时产生忠实的迭代计算，深度或难度上升后退化为压缩或捷径策略；有效记忆由任务代数结构决定。

papers.title: Pay for Hints, Not Answers: LLM Shepherding for Cost-Efficient Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver state-of-the-art performance on complex reasoning tasks, but their inference costs limit deployment at scale. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer dramatic cost savings yet lag substantially in accuracy. Existing approaches - routing and cascading - treat the LLM as an all-or-nothing resource: either the query bypasses the LLM entirely, or the LLM generates a complete response at full cost. We introduce LLM Shepherding, a framework that requests only a short prefix (a hint) from the LLM and provides it to SLM. This simple mechanism is surprisingly effective for math and coding tasks: even hints comprising 10-30% of the full LLM response improve SLM accuracy significantly. Shepherding generalizes both routing and cascading, and it achieves lower cost under oracle decision-making. We develop a two-stage predictor that jointly determines whether a hint is needed and how many tokens to request. On the widely-used mathematical reasoning (GSM8K, CNK12) and code generation (HumanEval, MBPP) benchmarks, Shepherding reduces costs by 42-94% relative to LLM-only inference. Compared to state-of-the-art routing and cascading baselines, shepherding delivers up to 2.8x cost reduction while matching accuracy. To our knowledge, this is the first work to exploit token-level budget control for SLM-LLM collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM Shepherding：只向 LLM 请求占完整回答 10-30% 的短前缀 (hint) 交给 SLM 继续生成，用两阶段预测器同时决定是否要 hint 以及请求多少 token。在 GSM8K、CNK12、HumanEval、MBPP 上，相对纯 LLM 推理降低 42-94% 成本，相比 SOTA 路由与级联基线在匹配精度下最高省 2.8 倍成本。
Motivation: LLM 推理成本限制规模化部署，SLM 便宜但精度明显落后；现有 routing 与 cascading 把 LLM 当成全有或全无的资源，要么完全绕过、要么全价生成完整回答，中间的 token 级预算没有被利用。
Method: Shepherding 框架向 LLM 只请求一个短前缀 hint 并注入 SLM，泛化 routing 与 cascading；配套训练一个两阶段预测器，联合判断是否需要 hint 与请求的 token 数量，实现 token 级预算控制的 SLM-LLM 协作。
Result: 在数学推理 GSM8K、CNK12 与代码生成 HumanEval、MBPP 上，相对 LLM-only 推理降低成本 42-94%；仅占完整 LLM 回答 10-30% 的 hint 即可显著提升 SLM 精度；对比 SOTA routing 与 cascading 基线，在匹配精度下最高带来 2.8 倍成本下降，oracle 决策下也比二者成本更低。
Conclusion: 按 token 预算付费买提示而非完整答案，可在数学与代码任务上以显著更低的推理成本维持精度；作者称这是首个利用 token 级预算控制做 SLM-LLM 协作的工作。

papers.title: From Instruction to Event: Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Current mobile manipulation research predominantly follows an instruction-driven paradigm, where robots rely on predefined textual commands to execute tasks. However, this setting confines robots to a passive role, limiting robotic autonomy and the ability to react to dynamic environmental events. To address these limitations, we introduce Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation (STMM), where robots must actively perceive and interact with sound-emitting objects without explicit action instructions. To support STMM, we develop Habitat-Echo, a simulation platform that integrates sound rendering with physical interaction. We further propose a hierarchical baseline that translates high-level planning into low-level executions, where a task planner predicts a skill chain for policy models to execute sequentially. Experiments indicate the feasibility of perceiving auditory events and executing corresponding physical interactions without explicit instructions. Notably, in challenging multi-event scenarios, the robot successfully isolates the primary sources from overlapping acoustic interference to execute the first interactions, and subsequently proceeds to manipulate the secondary objects. These new challenges of planning-to-execution position STMM as a measurable research direction.The code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出声音触发移动操作 (STMM)：机器人在没有文字指令的情况下主动感知发声物体并执行交互。配套仿真平台 Habitat-Echo 把声音渲染与物理交互结合，分层基线由任务 planner 预测 skill chain、策略模型顺序执行；实验显示机器人能在重叠声干扰中分离主要声源先交互，再操作次要物体。
Motivation: 现有移动操作依赖预定义文字指令，机器人处于被动角色，无法对动态环境事件做出反应，自主性受限。
Method: 构建 Habitat-Echo 仿真平台，将声音渲染与物理交互集成；提出分层基线，高层任务 planner 预测 skill chain，低层策略模型按序执行各技能，完成从规划到执行的闭环。
Result: 实验表明在无显式指令下感知听觉事件并执行相应物理交互是可行的；在多事件场景中，机器人能从重叠声学干扰中分离主要声源先执行首次交互，随后继续操作次要物体。
Conclusion: STMM 把从指令到事件的移动操作确立为可度量的研究方向，代码与数据集将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: MGSM-Pro: A Simple Strategy for Robust Multilingual Mathematical Reasoning Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning. However, benchmark development for multilingual evaluation has lagged behind English in both difficulty and recency. Recently, GSM-Symbolic showed a strong evidence of high variance when models are evaluated on different instantiations of the same question; however, the evaluation was conducted only in English. In this paper, we introduce MGSM-Pro, an extension of MGSM dataset with GSM-Symbolic approach. Our dataset provides five instantiations per MGSM question by varying names, digits and irrelevant context. Evaluations across nine languages reveal that many low-resource languages suffer large performance drops when tested on digit instantiations different from those in the original test set. We further find that models robustness in HRL setting do not necessarily translate to LRL. Moreover, proprietary models, such as Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-4.1 are less robust to digit, whereas Gemini 3.0 Pro is more robust. Among open models, GPT-OSS 120B and DeepSeek v3 show stronger robustness. Based on these findings, we recommend evaluating each problem using at least five digit-varying instantiations to obtain a more robust and realistic assessment of math reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGSM-Pro 把 GSM-Symbolic 的实例化扰动搬到 MGSM 上，每题生成五个变体（改名字、改数字、加无关上下文），在九种语言上测出低资源语言在换数字后性能大幅下滑，且高资源语言的鲁棒性不迁移到低资源语言。作者据此建议每题至少用五个变体评测数学推理。
Motivation: 多语言数学推理基准在难度和时效上落后于英文，且现有评测只在英文上检验同一问题不同实例化的高方差问题，低资源语言的鲁棒性缺口无人量化。
Method: 以 MGSM 为底、套用 GSM-Symbolic 方法，对每道 MGSM 题生成五个实例化变体，通过改变名字、数字和无关上下文，在九种语言上对模型做评测。
Result: 评测覆盖九种语言，发现许多低资源语言在与原测试集不同的数字实例化上性能大幅下降；高资源语言 (HRL) 下的鲁棒性不必然迁移到低资源语言 (LRL)；Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 GPT-4.1 对数字扰动鲁棒性较弱，Gemini 3.0 Pro 更强，开源模型中 GPT-OSS 120B 与 DeepSeek v3 鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 单实例化评测会高估数学推理能力，每题至少用五个变体才能得到更稳健、更真实的评估。

papers.title: Bayesian-LoRA: Probabilistic Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models usually put more emphasis on accuracy and therefore, will guess even when not certain about the prediction, which is especially severe when fine-tuned on small datasets due to the inherent tendency toward miscalibration. In this work, we introduce Bayesian-LoRA, which reformulates the deterministic LoRA update as a probabilistic low-rank representation inspired by Sparse Gaussian Processes. We identify a structural isomorphism between LoRA's factorization and Kronecker-factored SGP posteriors, and show that LoRA emerges as a limiting case when posterior uncertainty collapses. We conduct extensive experiments on various LLM architectures across commonsense reasoning benchmarks. With only approximately 0.42M additional parameters and ${\approx}1.2{\times}$ training cost relative to standard LoRA, Bayesian-LoRA significantly improves calibration across models up to 30B, achieving up to 84% ECE reduction and 76% NLL reduction while maintaining competitive accuracy for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OoD) evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Bayesian-LoRA 把确定性 LoRA 更新重构为受 Sparse Gaussian Process 启发的概率低秩表示，指出 LoRA 分解与 Kronecker-factored SGP 后验之间存在结构同构，且 LoRA 是后验不确定性坍缩时的极限情形。在多种 LLM 架构的常识推理基准上，仅增加约 0.42M 参数、约 1.2 倍训练开销，即可在最高 30B 模型上把 ECE 最多降低 84%、NLL 最多降低 76%，同时在分布内与 OoD 评测上保持有竞争力的准确率。
Motivation: LLM 尤其在小数据集微调时倾向于过度自信地猜测，校准 (miscalibration) 问题严重，而标准 LoRA 是确定性更新、无法表达后验不确定性。
Method: 将 LoRA 的低秩分解与 Kronecker-factored SGP 后验建立结构同构，把确定性 LoRA 更新改写为概率低秩表示，并说明 LoRA 是后验不确定性坍缩时的极限情形；在多种 LLM 架构上于常识推理基准进行微调实验。
Result: 相对标准 LoRA 仅增加约 0.42M 参数、约 1.2 倍训练开销；在最高 30B 的模型上 ECE 最多降低 84%、NLL 最多降低 76%，且在分布内与 out-of-distribution (OoD) 评测上保持有竞争力的准确率。
Conclusion: 把 LoRA 视为 SGP 后验的极限情形并保留后验不确定性，可以在极小的参数与训练开销下显著改善 LLM 校准，同时不牺牲准确率。

papers.title: Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning: Continual Learning in LLM Agents Without Gradient Updates
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents excel at general tasks, they inherently struggle with continual adaptation due to the frozen weights after deployment. Conventional reinforcement learning (RL) offers a solution but incurs prohibitive computational costs and the risk of catastrophic forgetting. We introduce Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL), a training-free framework that enables test-time policy optimization without any gradient updates. JitRL maintains a dynamic, non-parametric memory of experiences and retrieves relevant trajectories to estimate action advantages on-the-fly. These estimates are then used to directly modulate the LLM's output logits. We theoretically prove that this additive update rule is the exact closed-form solution to the KL-constrained policy optimization objective. Extensive experiments on WebArena and Jericho demonstrate that JitRL establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods. Crucially, JitRL outperforms the performance of computationally expensive fine-tuning methods (e.g., WebRL) while reducing monetary costs by over 30 times, offering a scalable path for continual learning agents. The code is available at https://github.com/liushiliushi/JitRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JitRL 是免训练的 LLM agent 强化学习框架：维护动态非参数经验记忆，检索相关轨迹在线估计动作优势并直接调制输出 logits，无需任何梯度更新。在 WebArena 与 Jericho 上达到免训练方法的新 SOTA，且超过 WebRL 等微调方法，货币成本降低 30 倍以上。
Motivation: LLM agent 部署后权重冻结，难以持续适应；常规 RL 又带来高昂计算成本与灾难性遗忘风险。
Method: 维护动态非参数经验记忆，检索相关轨迹在线估计动作优势，用加性更新直接调制 LLM 输出 logits；作者从理论上证明该加性规则是 KL 约束策略优化目标的精确闭式解，全程无梯度更新。
Result: 在 WebArena 与 Jericho 上确立免训练方法的新 SOTA；性能超过计算昂贵的微调方法（如 WebRL），同时货币成本降低 30 倍以上。
Conclusion: 无需梯度更新的在线优势调制足以支撑 LLM agent 的持续学习，并以远低于微调的成本达到更优性能。

papers.title: STEP-LLM: Generating CAD STEP Models from Natural Language with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Computer-aided design (CAD) is vital to modern manufacturing, yet model creation remains labor-intensive and expertise-heavy. To enable non-experts to translate intuitive design intent into manufacturable artifacts, recent large language models-based text-to-CAD efforts focus on command sequences or script-based formats like CadQuery. However, these formats are kernel-dependent and lack universality for manufacturing. In contrast, the Standard for the Exchange of Product Data (STEP, ISO 10303) file is a widely adopted, neutral boundary representation (B-rep) format directly compatible with manufacturing, but its graph-structured, cross-referenced nature poses unique challenges for auto-regressive LLMs. To address this, we curate a dataset of ~40K STEP-caption pairs and introduce novel preprocessing tailored for the graph-structured format of STEP, including a depth-first search-based reserialization that linearizes cross-references while preserving locality and chain-of-thought(CoT)-style structural annotations that guide global coherence. We integrate retrieval-augmented generation to ground predictions in relevant examples for supervised fine-tuning, and refine generation quality through reinforcement learning with a specific Chamfer Distance-based geometric reward. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains of our STEP-LLM in geometric fidelity over the Text2CAD baseline, with improvements arising from multiple stages of our framework: the RAG module substantially enhances completeness and renderability, the DFS-based reserialization strengthens overall accuracy, and the RL further reduces geometric discrepancy. Both metrics and visual comparisons confirm that STEP-LLM generates shapes with higher fidelity than Text2CAD. These results show the feasibility of LLM-driven STEP model generation from natural language, showing its potential to democratize CAD design for manufacturing.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Design, Automation & Test in Europe Conference (DATE) 2026; v2 updated to the accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STEP-LLM 用 LLM 直接从自然语言生成 STEP (ISO 10303) B-rep CAD 模型：约 40K STEP-caption 数据集配 DFS 线性化重序列化与 CoT 结构标注，SFT 阶段接入 RAG，再用 Chamfer Distance 几何奖励做 RL。实验显示几何保真度一致优于 Text2CAD 基线，RAG 提升完整性与可渲染性，DFS 重序列化提升整体准确率，RL 进一步缩小几何偏差。
Motivation: 现有 text-to-CAD 走命令序列或 CadQuery 脚本，这类格式依赖 CAD kernel、对制造不通用；而制造直接使用的 STEP 是图结构、交叉引用的 B-rep，自回归 LLM 难以直接生成。
Method: 整理约 40K STEP-caption 对，做面向图结构的预处理：基于深度优先搜索 (DFS) 的重序列化把交叉引用线性化并保持局部性，加 CoT 式结构标注引导全局一致性；监督微调 (SFT) 阶段集成检索增强生成 (RAG) 以相关样例约束预测，再用以 Chamfer Distance 为几何奖励的强化学习 (RL) 精修生成质量。
Result: 实验中 STEP-LLM 的几何保真度相对 Text2CAD 基线一致提升；消融显示增益来自多个阶段：RAG 模块显著提升完整性与可渲染性，DFS 重序列化提升整体准确率，RL 进一步降低几何偏差；指标与可视化对比均显示生成形状保真度高于 Text2CAD。
Conclusion: LLM 从自然语言生成 STEP 模型是可行的，图结构预处理、检索接地与几何奖励 RL 三者叠加才能拿到保真度增益，该路径有望让非专家参与制造导向的 CAD 设计。

papers.title: Contextual Distributionally Robust Optimization with Causal and Continuous Structure
papers.abstract_en: We propose a framework for contextual distributionally robust optimization (DRO) that considers the causal and continuous structure of the underlying distribution, and we develop an interpretable and tractable decision rule. We first introduce the causal Sinkhorn discrepancy (CSD), an entropy-regularized causal Wasserstein distance that encourages continuous transport plans while preserving causal consistency. We then formulate a contextual DRO model with a CSD-based ambiguity set, termed Causal Sinkhorn DRO (Causal-SDRO), and derive its strong dual reformulation, where the worst-case distribution is characterized as a mixture of Gibbs distributions. To obtain an (infinite-dimensional) optimal policy, we propose a soft regression forest (SRF) decision rule: it preserves the interpretability of classical decision trees while being fully parametric, differentiable, and Lipschitz-smooth, enabling intrinsic interpretation from both global and local perspectives. To solve the Causal-SDRO with parametric decision rules, we develop an efficient stochastic compositional gradient algorithm that converges to an $\varepsilon$-stationary point at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$, matching that of standard stochastic gradient descent. Finally, we validate our method through numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating its superior performance and interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出因果 Sinkhorn DRO (Causal-SDRO)：用熵正则化的因果 Wasserstein 距离——causal Sinkhorn discrepancy (CSD)——构造歧义集，其强对偶把最坏分布刻画为 Gibbs 分布的混合；再用 soft regression forest (SRF) 决策规则和随机复合梯度算法求解，收敛到 ε-驻点的速率为 O(ε⁻⁴)，与标准 SGD 同阶。
Motivation: 上下文 DRO 通常忽略底层分布的因果与连续结构，导致歧义集既不保因果一致性也难解释，最优策略难以给出可解释且可计算的形式。
Method: 先定义 CSD（熵正则化、鼓励连续传输计划且保持因果一致），据此建立 Causal-SDRO 并推导强对偶重构；用 SRF 决策规则保持经典决策树的可解释性同时做到全参数化、可微、Lipschitz 光滑；求解用随机复合梯度算法。
Result: 随机复合梯度算法收敛到 ε-驻点的速率为 O(ε⁻⁴)，与标准 SGD 同阶；在合成与真实数据集上的数值实验展示了更优的性能与可解释性。
Conclusion: 把因果与连续结构写进歧义集并配合参数化可微决策规则，可以在保持可解释性的同时把上下文 DRO 求解做到与 SGD 同阶的收敛率。

summary_sections.result: 随机复合梯度算法收敛到 ε-驻点的速率为 O(ε⁻⁴)，与标准 SGD 同阶；在合成与真实数据集上的数值实验展示了更优的性能与可解释性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把因果与连续结构写进歧义集并配合参数化可微决策规则，可以在保持可解释性的同时把上下文 DRO 求解做到与 SGD 同阶的收敛率。

papers.title: Untangling Input Language from Reasoning Language: A Diagnostic Framework for Cross-Lingual Moral Alignment in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: When LLMs judge moral dilemmas, do they reach different conclusions in different languages, and if so, why? Two factors could drive such differences: the language of the dilemma itself, or the language in which the model reasons. Standard evaluation conflates these by testing only matched conditions (e.g., English dilemma with English reasoning). We introduce a methodology that separately manipulates each factor, covering also mismatched conditions (e.g., English dilemma with Chinese reasoning), enabling decomposition of their contributions. To study \emph{what} changes, we propose an approach to interpret the moral judgments in terms of Moral Foundations Theory. As a side result, we identify evidence for splitting the Authority dimension into a family-related and an institutional dimension. Applying this methodology to English-Chinese moral judgment with 13 LLMs, we demonstrate its diagnostic power: (1) the framework isolates reasoning-language effects as contributing twice the variance of input-language effects; (2) it detects context-dependency in nearly half of models that standard evaluation misses; and (3) a diagnostic taxonomy translates these patterns into deployment guidance. We release our code and datasets at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CrossCulturalMoralJudgement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套解耦诊断框架：把道德困境的输入语言与模型推理语言分开操纵，覆盖匹配与错配条件，从而分解两者对 LLM 道德判断差异的贡献。在 13 个 LLM 的英中道德判断上，推理语言效应贡献的方差是输入语言效应的两倍，且框架检出近半数模型存在标准评测漏掉的语境依赖性。
Motivation: 标准跨语言道德评测只测匹配条件（如英文困境配英文推理），把输入语言与推理语言的贡献混在一起，无法解释 LLM 在不同语言下为何给出不同道德结论。
Method: 分别操纵输入语言与推理语言并纳入错配条件（如英文困境配中文推理），用 Moral Foundations Theory 解读道德判断以刻画“什么变了”；在英中道德判断上对 13 个 LLM 应用该方法，并给出把诊断模式转成部署指引的分类体系。
Result: 在 13 个 LLM 的英中道德判断上：推理语言效应贡献的方差约为输入语言效应的两倍；框架检出近半数模型存在语境依赖性，而标准评测对此漏检；作为副产物识别出将 Authority 维度拆为 family-related 与 institutional 两个维度的证据。
Conclusion: 跨语言道德差异主要由推理语言而非输入语言驱动，只测匹配条件会漏掉近半数模型的语境依赖性；诊断分类体系可将这些模式转为部署指引。

papers.title: Beyond Inpainting: Unleash 3D Understanding for Stable Camera-Controlled Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Camera control has been extensively studied in conditioned video generation; however, performing precisely altering the camera trajectories while faithfully preserving the video content remains a challenging task. The mainstream approach to achieving precise camera control is warping a 3D representation according to the target trajectory. However, such methods fail to fully leverage the 3D priors of video diffusion models (VDMs) and often fall into the Inpainting Trap, resulting in subject inconsistency and degraded generation quality. To address this problem, we propose DepthDirector, a video re-rendering framework with precise camera controllability. By leveraging the depth video from explicit 3D representation as camera-control guidance, our method can faithfully reproduce the dynamic scene of an input video under novel camera trajectories. Specifically, we design a View-Content Dual-Stream Condition mechanism that injects both the source video and the warped depth sequence rendered under the target viewpoint into the pretrained video generation model. This geometric guidance signal enables VDMs to comprehend camera movements and leverage their 3D understanding capabilities, thereby facilitating precise camera control and consistent content generation. Next, we introduce a lightweight LoRA-based video diffusion adapter to train our framework, fully preserving the knowledge priors of VDMs. Additionally, we construct a large-scale multi-camera synchronized dataset named MultiCam-WarpData using Unreal Engine 5, containing 8K videos across 1K dynamic scenes. Extensive experiments show that DepthDirector outperforms existing methods in both camera controllability and visual quality. Our code and dataset will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DepthDirector 把相机控制从「按目标轨迹 warp 后 inpainting」改为用显式 3D 表示渲染的深度视频作引导，通过 View-Content 双流条件把源视频与目标视角下的 warped depth 序列一起注入预训练视频扩散模型，使其调用自身的 3D 理解能力。配合轻量 LoRA 适配器训练，作者称该方法在相机可控性与视觉质量上均超过现有方法。
Motivation: 主流做法按目标相机轨迹 warp 3D 表示，却无法充分利用视频扩散模型 (VDMs) 的 3D 先验，容易陷入 Inpainting Trap，导致主体不一致与生成质量下降。
Method: 提出视频重渲染框架 DepthDirector：以显式 3D 表示渲染出的深度视频作为相机控制引导，设计 View-Content Dual-Stream Condition 机制，把源视频与目标视角下 warped 的深度序列同时注入预训练视频生成模型；再用轻量 LoRA-based 视频扩散适配器训练，保留 VDM 的知识先验。
Result: 用 Unreal Engine 5 构建大规模多相机同步数据集 MultiCam-WarpData，含 1K 个动态场景的 8K 视频；作者称大量实验显示 DepthDirector 在相机可控性与视觉质量两方面均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把几何引导（目标视角深度）作为条件而非 inpainting 掩码，能让 VDM 的 3D 理解转化为精确相机控制与一致内容生成，同时靠 LoRA 保住预训练先验。

papers.title: Leveraging Soft Prompts for Privacy Attacks in Federated Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) pose a serious privacy threat in federated learning (FL). While MIAs have been extensively studied in standard FL, the recent shift toward federated fine-tuning introduces new and largely unexplored attack surfaces. In this work, we show that federated prompt-tuning, which adapts pre-trained foundation models using lightweight input prefixes, exposes a novel and effective vector for membership inference. We propose PromptMIA, a membership inference attack tailored to federated prompt-tuning, in which a malicious server introduces adversarially crafted prompts and exploits their updates during collaborative training to determine whether a target data point belongs to a client's private dataset. We formalize this threat via a security game and demonstrate that PromptMIA achieves consistently high attack advantage across diverse benchmark datasets, substantially outperforming current SOTA federated MIAs. We also provide a theoretical lower bound on the attack advantage that explains the observed empirical behavior. Finally, we show that existing MIA defenses are often ineffective against PromptMIA, highlighting the need for defense mechanisms specifically tailored to prompt-tuning in federated settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PromptMIA 是针对联邦 prompt tuning 的成员推断攻击：恶意服务器注入对抗构造的 soft prompt，利用协同训练中客户端回传的 prompt 更新判断目标样本是否属于该客户端私有数据。攻击在多个基准数据集上取得稳定且很高的 attack advantage，明显超过现有 SOTA 联邦 MIA，并给出解释该经验表现的 attack advantage 理论下界；现有 MIA 防御手段对其大多失效。
Motivation: 联邦学习的成员推断攻击多在标准 FL 场景研究，而面向基础模型的联邦微调（尤其是用轻量输入前缀做 prompt tuning）引入了新的、几乎未被探索的攻击面，且现有防御未必适用。
Method: 提出 PromptMIA：恶意服务器在协同训练中注入对抗构造的 prompt，并利用客户端对这些 prompt 的更新推断目标数据点是否在客户端私有数据集中；用 security game 形式化该威胁模型，并推导 attack advantage 的理论下界。
Result: 在多个不同基准数据集上，PromptMIA 取得持续较高的 attack advantage，大幅优于当前 SOTA 联邦 MIA；理论下界解释了观察到的经验表现；针对 PromptMIA，已有 MIA 防御手段往往失效。
Conclusion: 联邦 prompt tuning 本身构成新的成员推断攻击向量，需要专门面向 prompt tuning 的联邦场景防御机制，而不能沿用现有 MIA 防御。
