papers.title: A Novel Unified Approach to Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Advancements in the field of AI are increasingly giving rise to various threats, one of the most prominent being the synthesis and misuse of deepfakes. To sustain trust in this digital age, the detection and tagging of deepfakes are essential. In this paper, a novel architecture for deepfake detection in images and videos is presented. The architecture uses cross-attention between spatial and frequency domain features to classify an image as real or fake. This paper aims to develop a unified architecture and provide insights into each step. Through this approach, we achieve results competitive with the State-of-the-Art (SOTA). Furthermore, this approach generalizes well to cross-dataset testing, which is evident from the experimental results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种图像与视频深度伪造 (deepfake) 检测架构，用空间域特征与频域特征之间的 cross-attention 做真伪分类。作者称结果与 SOTA 竞争，并在跨数据集测试上表现出良好泛化。
Motivation: AI 合成与滥用 deepfake 日益威胁数字信任，需要可靠的检测与标注手段；现有方法在跨数据集场景下泛化不足。
Method: 统一架构同时提取空间域与频域特征，通过 cross-attention 融合后对图像做 real/fake 二分类，并逐步给出各环节的解析；面向图像与视频两类输入。
Result: 作者报告结果与 State-of-the-Art (SOTA) 竞争，且实验结果显示跨数据集测试泛化良好；摘要未给出具体数据集名称或指标数值。
Conclusion: 空间-频域 cross-attention 的统一架构可作为 deepfake 检测的有效路径，其卖点在于跨数据集泛化而非单一数据集刷点。

papers.title: SB-TRPO: Towards Safe Reinforcement Learning with Hard Constraints
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical domains, reinforcement learning (RL) systems must satisfy strict, zero-cost safety constraints while achieving meaningful task performance. Existing model-free methods can struggle to achieve high safety without substantially compromising task performance. We introduce \emph{Safety-Biased Trust Region Policy Optimisation (SB-TRPO)}, a principled approach to RL with zero-cost constraints, which requires only a fixed fraction of the maximal cost reduction achievable within the trust region, thus retaining flexibility for reward optimisation. We show that the idealised update nevertheless converges to zero cost and maximal reward amongst zero-cost policies in finite MDPs. A practical gradient-based approximation provides local improvements in both safety and reward under suitable gradient alignment. Experiments on \emph{Safety Gymnasium} demonstrate high safety alongside strong task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SB-TRPO 把硬约束写成信任域内只需达到最大可实现成本削减的一个固定比例，从而给奖励优化留出余地；理想化更新在有限 MDP 上仍收敛到零成本且在零成本策略中奖励最大，梯度对齐条件下的实用近似同时局部改进安全与奖励。
Motivation: 安全关键领域的 RL 必须满足零成本硬约束，而已有无模型方法往往要大幅牺牲任务性能才能换来高安全性。
Method: 提出 Safety-Biased Trust Region Policy Optimisation (SB-TRPO)：在信任域内只要求实现最大可达成成本削减的固定比例，保留奖励优化自由度；给出理想化更新的收敛性论证，并提供基于梯度的实用近似，在梯度对齐条件下同时改进安全与奖励。
Result: 理论上证明理想化更新在有限 MDP 中收敛到零成本，并在零成本策略集合中取得最大奖励；在 Safety Gymnasium 上的实验展示高安全性与强任务性能并存。
Conclusion: 把安全目标设为信任域内成本削减的固定比例而非直接压到最低，可以在零成本约束下同时保住任务性能。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Soft Geometric Inductive Bias for Object Centric Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Physical systems are naturally parameterized in terms of geometric entities and their transformations. While exact equivariance can be a powerful inductive bias, real-world applications frequently exhibit approximate or broken symmetries in practice. We introduce object-centric world models that provide a soft geometric inductive bias without enforcing exact symmetries. By embedding object states as Clifford multivectors, our models encourage physically meaningful transformations while retaining the expressivity needed to handle asymmetric dynamics. We evaluate our approach on 2D rigid-body dynamics, 3D charged-particle systems, and real-world driving trajectories. Compared to both unstructured baselines and strictly equivariant models, our soft Clifford transformer achieves better long-horizon fidelity, particularly in regimes with broken symmetries. These results suggest that geometric algebra offers an effective middle ground, delivering sample-efficient dynamics without the inflexibility of hard mathematical constraints.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 16 pages supplementary material; Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以 Clifford 多重向量 (Clifford multivector) 表示物体状态的软几何归纳偏置世界模型：鼓励物理上有意义的变换，但不强制严格等变，从而保留处理非对称动力学的表达力。在 2D 刚体、3D 带电粒子与真实驾驶轨迹上，相比无结构基线与严格等变模型，soft Clifford transformer 在对称性破缺的场景下取得更好的长时程保真度。
Motivation: 真实系统常只近似满足或根本不满足对称性，严格等变的硬约束因此过刚、表达力受限，而完全无结构的模型又缺少几何先验、样本效率低。
Method: 构建 object-centric world model，把物体状态嵌入为 Clifford 多重向量，用 soft Clifford transformer 学习动力学；在 2D 刚体动力学、3D 带电粒子系统与真实驾驶轨迹三类设定上评测，对照无结构基线与严格等变模型。
Result: 在 2D 刚体动力学、3D 带电粒子系统和真实驾驶轨迹上，soft Clifford transformer 相比无结构基线与严格等变模型取得更好的长时程保真度 (long-horizon fidelity)，优势在对称性破缺 (broken symmetries) 的场景下尤为明显。
Conclusion: 几何代数提供了硬等变与无结构之间的折中：在不施加严格数学约束的前提下获得样本高效的动态建模。

papers.title: Borrowing from anything: A generalizable framework for reference-guided instance editing
papers.abstract_en: Reference-guided instance editing is fundamentally limited by semantic entanglement, where a reference's intrinsic appearance is intertwined with its extrinsic attributes. The key challenge lies in disentangling what information should be borrowed from the reference, and determining how to apply it appropriately to the target. To tackle this challenge, we propose GENIE, a Generalizable Instance Editing framework capable of achieving explicit disentanglement. GENIE first corrects spatial misalignments with a Spatial Alignment Module (SAM). Then, an Adaptive Residual Scaling Module (ARSM) learns what to borrow by amplifying salient intrinsic cues while suppressing extrinsic attributes, while a Progressive Attention Fusion (PAF) mechanism learns how to render this appearance onto the target, preserving its structure. Extensive experiments on the challenging AnyInsertion dataset demonstrate that GENIE achieves state-of-the-art fidelity and robustness, setting a new standard for disentanglement-based instance editing.
papers.comment: We have identified substantive issues in the current version of the paper that require further correction and validation. We therefore withdraw this version while we address these issues
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GENIE 针对参考引导实例编辑中的语义纠缠，先用 Spatial Alignment Module 校正空间错位，再用 Adaptive Residual Scaling Module 决定借什么（放大内在线索、抑制外在属性），最后用 Progressive Attention Fusion 在保留目标结构的前提下渲染外观。在 AnyInsertion 数据集上达到 SOTA 的保真度与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 参考图的内在外观与外在属性纠缠在一起，导致难以判断应从参考借哪些信息、以及如何应用到目标上。
Method: GENIE 框架三阶段：Spatial Alignment Module (SAM) 校正空间错位；Adaptive Residual Scaling Module (ARSM) 放大显著内在线索并抑制外在属性以学习借什么；Progressive Attention Fusion (PAF) 学习如何把外观渲染到目标并保留其结构。
Result: 在 AnyInsertion 数据集上，GENIE 达到 state-of-the-art 的保真度与鲁棒性，为基于解纠缠的实例编辑设定新标准（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把借什么与怎么借拆成显式解纠缠的两个模块，可在参考引导实例编辑上同时提升保真度与鲁棒性。

papers.title: CAT: Can Trust be Predicted with Context-Awareness in Dynamic Heterogeneous Networks?
papers.abstract_en: Trust prediction provides valuable support for decision-making, risk mitigation, and system security enhancement. Recently, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a promising approach for trust prediction, owing to their ability to learn expressive node representations that capture intricate trust relationships within a network. However, current GNN-based trust prediction models face several limitations: (i) Most of them fail to capture trust dynamicity, leading to questionable inferences. (ii) They rarely consider the heterogeneous nature of real-world networks, resulting in a loss of rich semantics. (iii) None of them support context-awareness, a basic property of trust, making prediction results coarse-grained. To this end, we propose CAT, the first Context-Aware GNN-based Trust prediction model that supports trust dynamicity and accurately represents real-world heterogeneity. CAT consists of a graph construction layer, an embedding layer, a heterogeneous attention layer, and a prediction layer. It handles dynamic graphs using continuous-time representations and captures temporal information through a time encoding function. To model graph heterogeneity and leverage semantic information, CAT employs a dual attention mechanism that identifies the importance of different node types and nodes within each type. For context-awareness, we introduce a new notion of meta-paths to extract contextual features. By constructing context embeddings and integrating a context-aware aggregator, CAT can predict both context-aware trust and overall trust. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that CAT outperforms five groups of baselines in trust prediction, while exhibiting strong scalability to large-scale graphs and robustness against both trust-oriented and GNN-oriented attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAT 是首个支持信任动态性、网络异构性与上下文感知的 GNN 信任预测模型：用连续时间图表示加时间编码函数处理动态图，用双注意力机制区分节点类型与类型内节点的重要性，再用新定义的 meta-path 抽取上下文特征并配合上下文感知聚合器，同时预测上下文信任与整体信任。在三个真实数据集上超过五组基线，并对大规模图与信任导向、GNN 导向攻击均表现出可扩展性与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 GNN 信任预测模型大多忽略信任的动态性导致推断可疑，很少处理真实网络的异构性而丢失语义，且都不支持信任的基本属性——上下文感知，使预测结果过于粗糙。
Method: CAT 由图构建层、嵌入层、异构注意力层和预测层组成：动态图用连续时间表示处理并以时间编码函数捕捉时序信息；双注意力机制同时建模不同节点类型的重要性和各类型内节点的重要性；引入新的 meta-path 概念抽取上下文特征，构造上下文嵌入并接入 context-aware aggregator，从而同时输出上下文信任与整体信任。
Result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的大量实验中，CAT 在信任预测上超过五组基线，并对大规模图表现出强可扩展性，对 trust-oriented 与 GNN-oriented 两类攻击均具鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把动态性、异构语义与上下文感知同时纳入 GNN 信任预测，可以得到更细粒度且更抗攻击的信任推断；该工作被 NDSS 2026 接收。

papers.title: MILE: A Mechanically Isomorphic Hand Exoskeleton and Visuotactile Robotic Hand for Data Collection in Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous robotic hands perform complex, contact-rich manipulation. Imitation learning provides a route to such skills, but collecting human demonstrations with accurate hand actions and rich tactile information remains a key bottleneck. We present MILE, a teleoperation-based data-collection system comprising the wearable MILE exoskeleton and the mechanically corresponding MILE-Tac robotic hand. Because human-hand anatomy and wearability place tighter constraints on the high-DoF wearable, our human-first design begins with the MILE exoskeleton, equipped with custom modular joint encoders for accurate joint-angle acquisition. We then design the MILE-Tac robotic hand to share the exoskeleton's selected kinematic topology and joint-axis arrangement while satisfying robot-side implementation constraints, and equip its fingertips with compact visuotactile sensor modules. This correspondence enables direct exoskeleton-to-robot joint-space command transfer without online task-space inverse-kinematics retargeting. During teleoperation, the system synchronously records task-specific visual observations, four fingertip visuotactile streams, robot-hand proprioception, and exoskeleton-derived action commands. In a four-task teleoperation benchmark, MILE achieved a mean success rate of 76%, compared with 28% and 8% for glove-based and vision-based baselines, respectively. For downstream imitation learning, we trained paired ACT and DP policies with and without tactile input on MILE-collected demonstrations. The tactile-input variants achieved higher success rates in all paired evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MILE 用机械同构的可穿戴外骨骼与机器人手做遥操作数据采集，使外骨骼关节角可直接映射为机器人关节指令，免去在线任务空间逆运动学重定向。四任务遥操作基准上平均成功率 76%，对比手套式基线 28%、视觉基线 8%；加入触觉输入的 ACT 与 DP 策略在全部配对评测中成功率更高。
Motivation: 模仿学习需要带精确手部动作与丰富触觉的人类演示，而现有采集方式在这两点上是瓶颈，高自由度可穿戴设备还受人手解剖与可穿戴性约束。
Method: 先做人一侧的 MILE 外骨骼，配自研模块化关节编码器采集关节角；再设计共享其选定运动学拓扑与关节轴布置的 MILE-Tac 机器人手，指尖装紧凑视触觉 (visuotactile) 传感器模块。遥操作时同步记录任务视觉观测、四指视触觉流、机器人手本体感觉与外骨骼动作指令，并在采集演示上训练配对的 ACT 与 DP 策略（含/不含触觉输入）。
Result: 四任务遥操作基准平均成功率 76%，手套式基线 28%、视觉基线 8%；下游模仿学习中，带触觉输入的 ACT 与 DP 变体在所有配对评测里成功率均更高。
Conclusion: 把运动学同构与直接关节空间映射作为设计主线，可同时解决高自由度遥操作的重定向开销与演示数据的动作/触觉质量问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neural Tractability via Structure: Learning-Augmented Algorithms for Graph Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Neural solvers provide fast solutions to graph combinatorial optimization problems, but training alone does not guarantee solution quality. Exact methods guarantee optimality but can be prohibitively expensive. We propose Neural Fixed-Parameter Tractable (N-FPT), a neural-model-agnostic framework that uses parameterized algorithms to improve neural solutions without retraining and guide learning. It restricts neural advice to a treewidth modulator and completes the bounded-treewidth remainder exactly. It returns and certifies the best achievable solution under any valid advice, improving the neural solution whenever a better compatible completion exists. We prove this guarantee and global optimality under perfect advice. Its incremental-confidence N-FPT (NIC-FPT) and randomized-deferral N-FPT (NRD-FPT) variants consolidate neural advice. Beyond inference, N-FPT feedback becomes available as neural decisions make exact completion tractable. From that state onward, it supplies what final solution rewards lack: the first decision that rules out every optimal completion and alternatives that preserve one. One exact computation supplies reusable guidance for continuations from that state, even when neural samples miss its optimum. Experiments across graph combinatorial optimization problems demonstrate solution-quality gains with different neural models and robustness to graph-size and distribution shifts. The learned completion model reaches optimal completions more often than reinforcement learning (RL) alone, without an exact solver at inference. N-FPT thus uses graph structure to improve neural solutions and guide learning toward optimal completion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出与神经模型无关的 Neural Fixed-Parameter Tractable (N-FPT) 框架：把神经网络的建议限制在 treewidth modulator 上，对剩余的有界 treewidth 部分做精确求解，从而在不重训的前提下改进并认证神经解。证明了「在任意合法建议下返回并认证该建议下可达到的最优解」以及完美建议下的全局最优性；实验显示该框架在多种图组合优化问题上带来解质量提升，且对图规模与分布偏移稳健。
Motivation: 神经求解器快但训练本身不保证解质量，而精确方法虽保证最优却可能代价过高，二者之间缺少既能利用神经建议又能给出最优性保证的衔接机制。
Method: N-FPT 将神经建议限制在 treewidth modulator，对有界 treewidth 的剩余部分用参数化算法精确补全；变体 NIC-FPT（incremental-confidence）与 NRD-FPT（randomized-deferral）用于整合神经建议；N-FPT 的反馈在神经决策使精确补全变得可解时提供，指出排除所有最优补全的第一个决策以及保留最优补全的替代选择，一次精确计算即可复用于后续决策。
Result: 实验覆盖多类图组合优化问题，显示在不同神经模型上均有解质量提升，并对图规模与分布偏移稳健；学到的补全模型比单独使用强化学习 (RL) 更常达到最优补全，且推理时不需要精确求解器。
Conclusion: 借助图结构（treewidth modulator + 有界 treewidth 精确补全）可以在不重训的情况下改进并认证神经解，并把这种精确计算的反馈转化为引导向最优补全的学习信号。

papers.title: MASTEST: A LLM-Based Multi-Agent System For Testing RESTful APIs
papers.abstract_en: Testing RESTful API is increasingly complicated but indispensable to quality assurance of cloud-native applications. This paper reports a multi-agent system called MASTEST that combines LLM-based intelligent agents and programmed agents to automate REST API testing. They form a complete tool chain covering the whole workflow of REST API test with API specification in the OpenAPI Swagger format as the input. It also incorporates human testers in the process to review and correct LLM generated test artefacts to control the quality of testing activities. MASTEST is evaluated on two LLMs, GPT-4o and DeepSeek V3.1 Reasoner with five public APIs. Its performances on various testing activities are measured by a wide range of metrics, including adequacy and coverage metrics, the syntax and data type correctness of generated test scripts, the usability of LLM generated test cases and scripts, as well as the bug detection ability. Experiment results demonstrated that both DeepSeek and GPT-4o achieved a high overall performance but had strengths and weaknesses on different testing activities. MASTEST generated test cases achieved 94% and 98% unit test coverage and 79% and 78% system test coverage for GPT-4o and DeepSeek respectively in comparison with human designed test cases. The generated test scripts maintained 100% syntax correctness and only required minimal manual edits for semantic correctness. The generated test scripts contain assertions on the expected status code as well as contents in the response messages. They are highly capable of detecting bugs in the REST APIs. Experiment data shows that the bug detection rates are between 2.13 to 4.50 per operation. These findings indicate that MASTEST is highly efficient and effective.
papers.comment: This is a revised version of the paper. It is formally published by IEEE in the Proceedings of the 8TH IEEE International Conference on AI Test (IEEE AITest 2026). Reader are also referred to the first version for technical details
papers.journal_ref: X. Han and H. Zhu, "MASTEST: A LLM-Based Multi-Agent System For Testing RESTful APIs," 2026 IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Testing (AITest), Fukuoka, Japan, 2026, pp. 235-248
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASTEST 用 LLM 智能体加程序化智能体组成 REST API 测试工具链，以 OpenAPI Swagger 规范为输入，并让人工测试者复核修正 LLM 生成的测试制品以控质量。在 GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek V3.1 Reasoner、5 个公开 API 上，单元测试覆盖率达 94%/98%、系统测试覆盖率 79%/78%，脚本语法正确率 100%，bug 检出率 2.13–4.50 per operation。
Motivation: 云原生应用的 REST API 测试日益复杂却不可省略，手工编写测试用例与脚本成本高，纯 LLM 生成又难以保证语义正确性与质量。
Method: MASTEST 将 LLM 智能体与程序化智能体结合成覆盖 REST 测试全流程的工具链，输入为 OpenAPI Swagger 规范；流程中嵌入人工测试者复核并修正 LLM 生成的测试制品。评测在 GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek V3.1 Reasoner 两个模型、5 个公开 API 上进行，指标涵盖 adequacy/coverage、脚本语法与数据类型正确性、用例可用性与 bug 检出能力。
Result: 相对人工设计的测试用例，GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek 生成的单元测试覆盖率为 94% 与 98%，系统测试覆盖率为 79% 与 78%；生成脚本保持 100% 语法正确性，仅需极少人工修改即可满足语义正确；bug 检出率为每 operation 2.13 至 4.50。两个模型总体表现都高，但在不同测试活动上各有强弱。
Conclusion: LLM 与程序化智能体混合、并由人工复核兜底的测试流水线能高效产出高覆盖、语法正确且能检出 bug 的 REST API 测试制品，GPT-4o 与 DeepSeek 各有擅长的测试活动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scriboora: Rethinking Human Pose Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Human pose forecasting predicts future human poses from past observations for applications including action recognition, sports analysis, and human-robot interaction. However, progress in the field is difficult to assess because reported results often rely on heterogeneous preprocessing, inconsistent metric implementations, and partially released artifacts. This paper re-examines human pose forecasting as an evaluation problem by auditing a wide range of recent forecasting methods, identifying several reproducibility issues, and introducing a unified training and evaluation pipeline for absolute pose forecasting. Under this unified protocol, mature cross-domain sequence models adapted from speech recognition provide strong baselines and obtain the lowest errors among the evaluated models. To study deployment-relevant noise, a paired clean/detector-noisy dataset variant is introduced using poses generated by a pose-estimation model. The experiments show that detector-generated poses cause substantial performance degradation compared with clean motion-capture inputs, but that part of this degradation can be recovered by adapting the forecaster on detector-generated pose sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人体姿态预报 (human pose forecasting) 重新当作评测问题：审计近期多种预报方法的可复现性，给出统一的绝对姿态训练与评测流程。在该协议下，从语音识别改造来的成熟跨域序列模型取得被评模型中最低误差；检测器生成的姿态相比干净动捕输入造成显著性能下降，但在检测器姿态序列上适配预报器可挽回部分退化。
Motivation: 该领域结果依赖异构预处理、指标实现不一致、工件部分发布，导致进展难以客观评估。
Method: 审计近期多种预报方法并识别可复现性问题，建立统一的绝对姿态训练与评测 pipeline；引入由姿态估计模型生成姿态的配对 clean/detector-noisy 数据集变体，并把语音识别的跨域序列模型改造为基线。
Result: 统一协议下，改造自语音识别的跨域序列模型在被评模型中误差最低；检测器生成姿态相比干净动捕输入造成显著性能下降；在检测器生成的姿态序列上适配预报器可恢复部分退化。
Conclusion: 统一评测协议能暴露该领域被预处理与指标差异掩盖的可复现性问题，且姿态源噪声导致的退化可通过在含噪序列上适配预报器部分挽回。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: COGNOS: Universal Enhancement for Time Series Anomaly Detection via Constrained Gaussian-Noise Optimization and Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction-based methods are a dominant paradigm in time series anomaly detection (TSAD), however, their near-universal reliance on Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss results in statistically flawed reconstruction residuals. This fundamental weakness leads to noisy, unstable anomaly scores, hindering reliable detection. To address this, we propose Constrained Gaussian-Noise Optimization and Smoothing (COGNOS), a universal, model-agnostic enhancement framework that tackles this issue at its source. COGNOS introduces a novel Gaussian-White Noise Regularization strategy during training, which directly constrains the model's output residuals to conform to a Gaussian white noise distribution. This engineered statistical property creates the ideal precondition for our second contribution: Adaptive Residual Kalman Smoother that operates as a statistically robust estimator to denoise the raw anomaly scores. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that COGNOS consistently enhances the performance of state-of-the-art backbones significantly, validating the efficacy of coupling statistical regularization with adaptive filtering.
papers.comment: Paper accepted by the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对重建式时间序列异常检测 (TSAD) 因 MSE 损失导致残差统计有缺陷、异常分数噪声大且不稳定的问题，提出 COGNOS：训练时用高斯白噪声正则约束模型输出残差服从高斯白噪声分布，再用 Adaptive Residual Kalman Smoother 对原始异常分数去噪。在多个基准上该框架一致显著提升多个 SOTA backbone 的检测性能。
Motivation: 重建式 TSAD 几乎一律用 MSE 损失，导致重建残差在统计上有缺陷，异常分数噪声大、不稳定，可靠检测受阻。
Method: COGNOS 是模型无关的通用增强框架，含两部分：训练阶段的 Gaussian-White Noise Regularization，直接约束模型输出残差符合高斯白噪声分布；在此统计前提下用 Adaptive Residual Kalman Smoother 作为稳健估计器对原始异常分数去噪。
Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，COGNOS 一致且显著地提升了多个 SOTA backbone 的异常检测性能，验证了统计正则与自适应滤波耦合的有效性。
Conclusion: 把重建残差约束成高斯白噪声并配合 Kalman 平滑，是可嫁接到任意重建式 TSAD backbone 的通用增强路径，其有效性来自统计正则与自适应滤波的耦合。

papers.title: Sparse, self-organizing ensembles of local kernels detect rare statistical anomalies
papers.abstract_en: Modern artificial intelligence has revolutionized how we extract representations from scientific data, yet the statistical properties of these representations remain poorly controlled, causing misspecified anomaly detection methods to falter. The hardest anomalies to detect are the rare, weakly separable ones hiding within the nominal distribution-a regime that grows in importance as models mature and easily separable signals are exhausted. We identify structural desiderata for detection in this regime under minimal prior information: sparsity, to enforce parsimony; locality, to preserve geometric sensitivity; and competition, to promote efficient allocation of model capacity. These principles define a class of self-organizing local kernels that adaptively partition the representation space around regions of statistical imbalance. As an instantiation, we introduce SparKer, a sparse ensemble of Gaussian kernels trained in a semi-supervised Neyman-Pearson framework to locally model the likelihood ratio between a sample that may contain anomalies and an anomaly-free reference. We provide theoretical insights into the mechanisms driving detection and self-organization, and demonstrate the approach on realistic high-dimensional problems in scientific discovery, open-world novelty detection, intrusion detection, and generative-model validation. Ensembles of only a handful of kernels identify statistically significant anomalies in representation spaces of thousands of dimensions while remaining sensitive across regimes, underscoring the interpretability, efficiency, and scalability of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparKer 用稀疏高斯核集成在半监督 Neyman-Pearson 框架下局部建模似然比，自组织地在表征空间中统计失衡区域划分，专攻名义分布内稀有、弱可分的异常。仅少量核即可在数千维表征空间中识别统计显著异常，并在科学发现、开放世界新奇检测、入侵检测与生成模型验证上保持跨体制敏感性。
Motivation: AI 表征的统计性质缺乏控制，导致异常检测方法设定错误而失效；易分信号耗尽后，稀有且弱可分的异常成为最难也日益重要的体制。
Method: 提出三条结构准则——稀疏、局部、竞争——定义自组织局部核类；实例化为 SparKer：稀疏高斯核集成，在半监督 Neyman-Pearson 框架下训练，对可能含异常的样本相对无异常参考局部建模似然比，并给出检测与自组织机制的理论分析。
Result: 仅一小把核（handful of kernels）即可在数千维表征空间中识别统计显著异常，且跨体制保持敏感；方法在科学发现、开放世界新奇检测、入侵检测、生成模型验证四类高维真实问题上演示。
Conclusion: 稀疏、局部、竞争三准则驱动的自组织核集成能在极少先验信息下高效分配模型容量，兼顾可解释性、效率与可扩展性地检测稀有弱可分异常。

papers.title: AD-SAM: Adapting the Segment Anything Model for Semantic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the Autonomous Driving Segment Anything Model (AD-SAM), a foundation-model adaptation framework for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving. AD-SAM combines a frozen Segment Anything Model (SAM) Vision Transformer (ViT-H) encoder with a trainable ResNet-50 encoder to integrate general visual representations with multi-scale, domain-specific spatial features. Features from the two encoders are integrated through deformable convolution and channel attention, followed by a multi-stage deformable decoder for semantic prediction. Training employs a hybrid objective combining Focal, Dice, Lovász-Softmax, and Surface losses. Experiments on Cityscapes and Berkeley DeepDrive 100K (BDD100K) show that AD-SAM outperforms SAM, Generalized SAM (G-SAM), and DeepLabV3 under a controlled training protocol. AD-SAM achieves 76.27% mIoU on Cityscapes and 64.74% on BDD100K, exceeding DeepLabV3 by 3.45 and 5.00 percentage points, respectively, with larger gains over the SAM-based baselines. Sample-size experiments reveal dataset-dependent behavior. In particular, AD-SAM performs strongly across training sizes on Cityscapes, while its advantage on the more heterogeneous BDD100K becomes pronounced with increased training data. When trained on Cityscapes and directly evaluated on BDD100K, AD-SAM achieves the highest cross-dataset retention (84.88%) among the evaluated models. AD-SAM also converges rapidly, while precomputed frozen SAM embeddings reduce training memory requirements. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining general foundation-model representations with domain-specific multi-scale features for accurate and robust autonomous-driving semantic segmentation.
papers.comment: v2: Substantially revised. Results regenerated under a common training protocol with retrained baselines; architecture updated (single-scale deformable fusion, three-stage progressive decoder). Title and author order updated. Submitted to Image and Vision Computing (Special Issue: Visual Perception Enabling Autonomous Navigation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AD-SAM 把冻结的 SAM ViT-H 编码器与可训练 ResNet-50 编码器结合，用可变形卷积与通道注意力融合，再经多阶段可变形解码器做自动驾驶语义分割。在统一训练协议下，Cityscapes mIoU 76.27%、BDD100K 64.74%，分别超 DeepLabV3 3.45 和 5.00 个百分点，跨数据集迁移保留率 84.88% 为受评模型最高。
Motivation: 通用基础模型的表征缺少多尺度、领域专属的空间细节，直接用于自动驾驶语义分割精度不足；而领域专用模型又缺乏泛化能力，需要在统一训练协议下公平比较两类路线。
Method: 冻结 SAM ViT-H 编码器提供通用视觉表征，接一个可训练 ResNet-50 编码器补充多尺度领域特征；两路特征经可变形卷积 (deformable convolution) 与通道注意力融合，送入多阶段可变形解码器输出语义预测。训练用 Focal、Dice、Lovász-Softmax 与 Surface 损失的混合目标，冻结 SAM embedding 预计算以降低显存。
Result: Cityscapes mIoU 76.27%，BDD100K 64.74%，分别超 DeepLabV3 3.45 与 5.00 个百分点，对 SAM、G-SAM 基线的领先幅度更大（统一训练协议下重训基线）。Cityscapes 上各训练规模均表现强，BDD100K 上优势随训练数据增加才显现；Cityscapes 训练直接评测 BDD100K 时跨数据集保留率 84.88%，为受评模型最高。
Conclusion: 把基础模型的通用表征与领域专属多尺度特征结合，可在自动驾驶语义分割上同时拿到更高精度与更强的跨数据集鲁棒性，且收敛快、显存需求低。

papers.title: A Game-Theoretic Spatio-Temporal Reinforcement Learning Framework for Collaborative Public Resource Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Public resource allocation involves distributing resources, including urban infrastructure, energy, and transportation, which are typically limited in capacity, to meet social demands. In real-world scenarios, resources are typically limited in capacity, which makes coordination among multiple resources essential. However, existing methods often optimize resource movements in an isolated manner and do not explicitly account for capacity-aware collaboration under spatio-temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce the Collaborative Public Resource Allocation (CPRA) problem, and propose a Game-Theoretic Spatio-Temporal Reinforcement Learning (GSTRL) framework to solve it. Our contributions are twofold: 1) We formulate CPRA as a potential game and construct the potential function based on the objective function of CPRA, laying a theoretical foundation for approximating the Nash equilibrium of this NP-hard problem; and 2) Our GSTRL framework effectively captures the spatio-temporal dynamics of the overall system. We evaluate GSTRL on two real-world datasets, where experiments show its superior performance. Our source codes are available at https://github.com/thunderlrr/GSTRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出协作式公共资源分配 (CPRA) 问题与博弈论时空强化学习框架 GSTRL：把 CPRA 形式化为势博弈 (potential game) 并基于其目标函数构造势函数，为这个 NP-hard 问题的 Nash 均衡近似提供理论基础，再用时空建模捕捉系统整体动态。在两个真实数据集上实验显示其性能更优。
Motivation: 现有方法孤立地优化资源调配，未显式处理时空动态下的容量约束协作，而城市基础设施、能源、交通等资源本身容量有限，多资源协调因此成为必需。
Method: 将 CPRA 形式化为势博弈，依据 CPRA 目标函数构造势函数以近似其 NP-hard 解的 Nash 均衡；GSTRL 框架在此之上捕捉整体系统的时空动态，源码发布于 github.com/thunderlrr/GSTRL。
Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上评估 GSTRL，实验显示其性能优于对照方法（superior performance）。
Conclusion: 把容量感知的多资源协作写成势博弈加时空强化学习，可以在 NP-hard 的公共资源分配上取得更好的解。

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucination in Large Language Models: A Capability-Oriented Survey on RAG, Reasoning, and Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains one of the key obstacles to the reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs). Although various mitigation approaches have been proposed, existing studies often analyze different technical paradigms independently, lacking a unified perspective to understand the underlying mechanisms of different approaches and their correspondence with different types of hallucinations. This survey adopts a capability enhancement perspective to systematically examine hallucination mitigation approaches, focusing on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), reasoning enhancement, and their integration within agentic systems. Based on their primary mitigation mechanisms, we categorize hallucinations into knowledge-based hallucinations and logic-based hallucinations, analyze how RAG and reasoning enhancement methods respectively improve knowledge acquisition and reasoning reliability, and further discuss the integration mechanisms of retrieval and reasoning capabilities in Agentic Systems for mitigating composite hallucinations. By considering the applicability, mitigation mechanisms, and limitations of different approaches, this survey establishes a unified analytical framework connecting hallucination types, key capability dimensions, and technical paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 LLM 幻觉缓解综述，按缓解机制把幻觉分为知识型 (knowledge-based) 与逻辑型 (logic-based)，用能力增强视角统一 RAG、推理增强 (reasoning enhancement) 与 Agentic Systems 中检索-推理整合三类范式，给出幻觉类型、能力维度与技术范式的对应框架。
Motivation: 现有幻觉研究各自独立分析不同技术范式，缺少统一视角来理解不同缓解方法的底层机制及其与幻觉类型的对应关系。
Method: 以能力增强视角系统梳理 RAG、推理增强及其在 Agentic Systems 中的整合；按主要缓解机制把幻觉二分为知识型与逻辑型，分别分析 RAG 与推理方法如何提升知识获取和推理可靠性，再讨论检索与推理能力的整合机制以应对复合幻觉 (composite hallucination)。
Result: 综述建立了一个统一分析框架，把幻觉类型、关键能力维度与技术范式连接起来，并按适用性、缓解机制与局限性比较各方法；全文 35 页、7 图、3 表。
Conclusion: 幻觉缓解应按幻觉类型选能力路径：知识型靠 RAG 补知识获取，逻辑型靠推理增强，复合幻觉则需在 Agentic Systems 中整合检索与推理。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning and Consumption-Savings Behavior
papers.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates how reinforcement learning can explain two puzzling empirical patterns in household consumption behavior during economic downturns. I develop a model where agents use Q-learning with neural network approximation to make consumption-savings decisions under income uncertainty, departing from standard rational expectations assumptions. The model replicates two key findings from recent literature: (1) unemployed households with previously low liquid assets exhibit substantially higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) out of stimulus transfers compared to high-asset households (0.50 vs 0.34), even when neither group faces borrowing constraints, consistent with Ganong et al. (2024); and (2) households with more past unemployment experiences maintain persistently lower consumption levels after controlling for current economic conditions, a "scarring" effect documented by Malmendier and Shen (2024). Unlike existing explanations based on belief updating about income risk or ex-ante heterogeneity, the reinforcement learning mechanism generates both higher MPCs and lower consumption levels simultaneously through value function approximation errors that evolve with experience. Simulation results closely match the empirical estimates, suggesting that adaptive learning through reinforcement learning provides a unifying framework for understanding how past experiences shape current consumption behavior beyond what current economic conditions would predict.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Q-learning 加神经网络逼近值函数来解释衰退期家庭消费的两个反常模式：低流动资产失业家庭对刺激支票的边际消费倾向 (MPC) 达 0.50、高资产家庭为 0.34，且失业经历越多的家庭在控制当前经济状况后消费水平持续更低。强化学习机制通过随经验演化的价值函数逼近误差同时生成这两个结果，无需借贷约束或信念更新。
Motivation: 衰退期消费的两个经验规律——低资产失业家庭 MPC 显著更高、失业经历留下消费“疤痕”——现有解释要么靠收入风险信念更新、要么靠事前异质性，难以用同一机制同时说明。
Method: 构建家庭在收入不确定性下做消费-储蓄决策的 Q-learning 模型，用神经网络逼近值函数，偏离标准理性预期假设；通过仿真复现 Ganong et al. (2024) 与 Malmendier and Shen (2024) 的经验发现。
Result: 仿真复现两条经验规律：失业且原低流动资产家庭对刺激转移的 MPC 为 0.50、高资产家庭为 0.34（两组均无借贷约束），与 Ganong et al. (2024) 一致；更多失业经历的家庭在控制当前经济条件后消费水平持续更低，对应 Malmendier and Shen (2024) 的“疤痕”效应。仿真结果与经验估计紧密吻合。
Conclusion: 适应性强化学习可作为统一框架，解释过去经历如何在当前经济状况之外塑造消费行为，其机制是随经验演化的价值函数逼近误差，而非信念更新或事前异质性。

papers.title: MA-SAPO: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Score-Aware Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimization has become a practical way to improve the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without retraining. However, most existing frameworks treat evaluation as a black box, relying solely on outcome scores without explaining why prompts succeed or fail. Moreover, they involve repetitive trial-and-error refinements that remain implicit, offering limited interpretability or actionable guidance for systematic improvement. In this paper, we propose MA-SAPO: a new Multi-Agent Reasoning for Score Aware Prompt Optimization framework that links evaluation outcomes directly to targeted refinements. Specifically, in the Training Phase, multiple agents interpret evaluation scores, diagnose weaknesses, and generate concrete revision directives, which are stored as reusable reasoning assets. In the Test Phase, an analyzer agent retrieves relevant exemplars and assets for a new prompt, and a refiner agent applies evidence-based edits to improve the prompt and its response. By grounding optimization in structured reasoning, MA-SAPO ensures edits are interpretable, auditable, and controllable. Experiments on the HelpSteer1/2 benchmarks show that our framework consistently outperforms single-pass prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, and prior multi-agent methods across multiple evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MA-SAPO 用多智能体推理把 prompt 优化的评估分数直接转成可复用的修订指令：训练阶段多个 agent 解读分数、诊断弱点并生成 revision directives 存为推理资产，测试阶段 analyzer 检索相关范例与资产、refiner 据证据改写 prompt。在 HelpSteer1/2 上相对单轮 prompt、RAG 与既有 multi-agent 方法在多个评估指标上一致更优。
Motivation: 现有 prompt 优化框架把评估当黑箱，只看 outcome score 而不解释 prompt 为何成败，反复试错过程隐式，缺乏可解释性与可操作的改进指引。
Method: Training Phase：多个 agent 解读评估分数、诊断弱点、生成具体修订指令并存为可复用推理资产；Test Phase：analyzer agent 为新 prompt 检索相关范例与资产，refiner agent 执行基于证据的编辑，同时改进 prompt 及其回答，使编辑可解释、可审计、可控。
Result: 在 HelpSteer1/2 基准上，MA-SAPO 在多个评估指标上一致优于 single-pass prompting、retrieval-augmented generation 与既有 multi-agent 方法。
Conclusion: 把 prompt 优化建立在结构化推理之上，可将评估结果与定向修订直接挂钩，从而让编辑可解释、可审计、可控。

papers.title: Auditing Information Disclosure During Large-Scale Gradient-Based Training via Gradient Uniqueness
papers.abstract_en: Auditing information disclosure across every datapoint during the training of LLMs is challenging. We propose a principled, attack-agnostic approach that uses mutual information to measure what the final model reveals about a datapoint's training membership. We show that this final-model disclosure is upper bounded by the sum of per-iteration gradient disclosures and that, under a reasonable set of assumptions, these gradient disclosures increase with Gradient Uniqueness (GNQ), which measures how distinguishable a datapoint's gradient is relative to other gradients in the batch. While naively computing GNQ requires forming and inverting a $P\times P$ matrix for every datapoint (for a model with $P$ parameters), we introduce Batch-Space Ghost (BS-Ghost). This efficient algorithm performs all computations in a much smaller batch space and uses ghost kernels to compute GNQ "in-run" for every datapoint in the training corpus, with minimal computational and memory overhead. Our experiments show the following: (i) GNQ predicts MIA vulnerability without the need for shadow models. (ii) Beyond membership disclosure, GNQ predicts the success of reconstruction attacks. (iii) GNQ-guided removal and retraining identify datapoints that causally contribute to disclosure. (iv) GNQ outperforms counterfactual memorization in text extraction and common-knowledge discrimination without the need for additional model training. (v) For data attribution, GNQ-guided filtering reduces emergent misalignment in Qwen2.5-7B more than baselines. Further, GNQ attributes 1000 datapoints in 17 seconds---roughly $70\times$ faster than the baselines. (vi) GNQ explains how training choices affect training-set disclosure and captures how per-datapoint disclosure emerges during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出攻击无关的成员推断审计框架：用互信息界定最终模型对单条训练数据的披露，并证明其被各步梯度披露之和上界，而梯度披露随 Gradient Uniqueness (GNQ) 单调上升。Batch-Space Ghost 在批空间用 ghost kernel 在线计算每条数据的 GNQ，无需 P×P 矩阵求逆；GNQ 无需 shadow model 即可预测 MIA 与重构攻击成功率，1000 条数据归因仅 17 秒，约为基线的 70 倍。
Motivation: LLM 训练中逐条数据的隐私披露难以审计：现有 MIA 依赖 shadow model，反事实记忆度需额外训练，数据归因方法开销大。
Method: 以互信息度量最终模型对训练成员的披露，给出其对各迭代梯度披露之和的上界；在合理假设下用 GNQ（单条数据梯度相对批内其他梯度的可区分度）代理梯度披露。提出 Batch-Space Ghost，在批空间用 ghost kernel 在线 (in-run) 计算全语料 GNQ，避免为 P 参数模型构造并求逆 P×P 矩阵。
Result: 实验显示：GNQ 无需 shadow model 即可预测 MIA 脆弱性；还能预测重构攻击成功率；GNQ 引导的移除-重训练识别出对披露有因果贡献的数据；在文本抽取与常识判别上 GNQ 优于 counterfactual memorization 且无需额外训练；在 Qwen2.5-7B 上 GNQ 引导过滤比基线更大幅度降低 emergent misalignment；GNQ 归因 1000 条数据用时 17 秒，约比基线快 70 倍。
Conclusion: 训练集披露可由梯度可区分度这一单量刻画并高效逐数据审计，且 GNQ 同时解释训练选择如何影响披露、披露如何随训练进程涌现。

papers.title: R2T: Rule-Encoded Loss Functions for Sequence Tagging in Low-Resource Languages
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Rule-to-Tag (R2T), a framework that turns linguistic rules into the training signal for neural sequence taggers in low-resource languages. R2T encodes lexical, morphological, and syntactic rules as differentiable loss terms, so that a tagger learns from rules and unlabeled text, with no labeled training data. It also adds an out-of-vocabulary (OOV) loss term that discourages confident predictions on words that no rule covers. R2T is a first instance of a broader paradigm we call principled learning (PrL): using explicit principles as a learning signal, rather than relying on example-based supervision alone. We evaluate R2T on part-of-speech (POS) tagging for Zarma (Songhay), Bambara (Mande), and French (Romance), and on named entity recognition (NER) for Zarma. On Zarma POS tagging, R2T-BiLSTM uses no labeled training data, yet it reaches 0.968 Macro F1. This score comes within 0.007 of a supervised BiLSTM-CRF trained on 300 labeled sentences (0.975) and exceeds AfriBERTa fine-tuned on the same sentences (0.941). On NER, R2T works well as pre-training: after R2T pre-training, a model fine-tuned on 50 labeled sentences outperforms AfriBERTa fine-tuned on 300 (0.83 vs.\ 0.79 span F1). On Bambara, R2T reaches 0.91 Macro F1 with rules written in about 2.75 hours, while a supervised Masakhane tagger reaches 0.78. We release ZarmaPOS-Bench, a silver-standard Zarma POS corpus, together with ZarmaNER-600 and all trained models, to support future work on under-resourced languages.

Method: Rule-to-Tag (R2T) 将词法、形态、句法规则写成可微损失项，配合无标注文本训练 BiLSTM 标注器，无标注训练数据；另加 OOV 损失项，惩罚对无规则覆盖词的自信预测。作者将此归入 principled learning (PrL) 范式，并在 NER 上用作预训练再微调。

papers.title: Federated Computation of ROC and PR Curves
papers.abstract_en: Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) and Precision-Recall (PR) curves are fundamental analytical tools for evaluating classification models, providing a comprehensive view of performance across decision thresholds. In modern data management settings, such evaluation must often be performed over data that is distributed across multiple parties and subject to strict privacy constraints. This setting arises naturally in federated learning (FL) and collaborative data platforms, where raw prediction scores and labels cannot be centrally collected. We study the problem of computing ROC and PR curves over distributed data under formal privacy guarantees. The key challenge is that exact computation requires access to all prediction scores and labels, leading to linear communication costs and privacy risks. To address this, we propose a novel framework for approximating ROC and PR curves using quantiles of the score distribution, which can be computed efficiently under secure aggregation and distributed differential privacy. Our approach requires only $O(Q)$ communication, where $Q$ is the number of quantiles, and avoids sharing raw data entirely. We provide theoretical guarantees on the approximation quality by bounding the Area Error (AE) between the true and estimated curves, demonstrating principled trade-offs among approximation accuracy, privacy protection, and communication cost. Our method is robust to data heterogeneity and skew, making it suitable for real-world distributed data management scenarios. Experiments on real-world datasets show that our approach achieves high accuracy with low communication overhead under strong privacy constraints. Overall, this work provides a practical and theoretically grounded solution for privacy-preserving evaluation of classification models over distributed data.
papers.comment: VLDB 2027. 19 pages, 26 figures, 1 table. Project page see http://xuefeng-xu.github.io/fedcurve.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分布式数据上用分数分布的分位数近似 ROC 与 PR 曲线，通信量从线性降到 O(Q)，并在 secure aggregation 与分布式差分隐私下给出面积误差 (Area Error) 上界。该方法对数据异质与偏斜稳健，实验在真实数据集上以低通信开销取得高精度。
Motivation: 联邦学习与协作数据平台中预测分数与标签不能集中收集，精确计算 ROC/PR 曲线需要访问全部数据，导致线性通信成本与隐私风险。
Method: 提出用分数分布的 Q 个分位数近似 ROC 与 PR 曲线的框架，分位数在 secure aggregation 与分布式差分隐私下计算，全程不共享原始数据；并对真实曲线与估计曲线之间的 Area Error 给出理论上界，刻画精度、隐私与通信三者的权衡。
Result: 通信复杂度为 O(Q)，Q 为分位数个数，避免线性通信；给出 Area Error 上界作为近似质量的理论保证；真实数据集实验显示在强隐私约束下精度高且通信开销低，并对数据异质与偏斜稳健。
Conclusion: 用分位数加安全聚合与分布式差分隐私，可以在不共享原始数据的前提下实用且有理论保证地计算 ROC/PR 曲线，权衡近似精度、隐私保护与通信成本。

papers.title: AI Adoption Across Mission-Driven Organizations
papers.abstract_en: Despite AI's promise, little is known about how mission-driven organizations (MDOs) adopt AI. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 15 experts and leaders within environmental, humanitarian, and development organizations across the Global North and South. We find that MDOs adopt AI selectively, with uses in content creation and data analysis, while maintaining human oversight for mission-critical applications. In case of conflicts between the organization's values and efficiency, participants consider sustainability, neutrality, and community trust as constraints that could limit or prevent AI adoption. Individual adoption of AI is not translated into organizational practice due to fragmented data infrastructure, lack of in-house expertise, inertia, ethical challenges, and dependency on vendors. Participants expected AI use in MDOs to involve institutional control over infrastructure, support for missions, and human-centered human-AI collaboration. We contribute an analysis on how MDOs manage AI adoption, identify barriers to responsible deployment, and provide recommendations for designing mission-aligned AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 15 位环境、人道与发展组织的专家与领导者做半结构化访谈，发现使命驱动型组织 (MDOs) 只选择性采用 AI：内容创作与数据分析落地，任务关键环节保留人工监督；当组织价值观与效率冲突时，可持续性、中立性与社区信任被视为限制甚至阻止 AI 采用的约束。个体层面的 AI 使用因数据基础设施碎片化、缺乏内部专长、组织惯性、伦理挑战与供应商依赖而无法转化为组织实践。
Motivation: 使命驱动型组织如何采用 AI 几乎无人研究，而这类组织在价值观与效率冲突时的取舍方式与一般企业不同，需要弄清阻碍负责任部署的具体障碍。
Method: 对全球北方与南方的环境、人道与发展组织内部 15 位专家与领导者开展半结构化访谈，围绕采用场景、价值冲突与障碍进行定性分析。
Result: 15 名受访者；采用集中在内容创作与数据分析，任务关键应用保留人工监督；识别出五类阻碍个体采用转化为组织实践的因素：数据基础设施碎片化、缺乏内部专长、组织惯性、伦理挑战、供应商依赖。
Conclusion: MDOs 的 AI 采用由使命对齐而非效率驱动，负责任部署的瓶颈在组织与基础设施层面；作者据此给出面向使命对齐 AI 系统的设计建议。

papers.title: Investigating The Smells of LLM Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: Context: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate program code. Much research has been reported on the functional correctness of generated code, but there is far less on code quality. Objectives: In this study, we propose a scenario-based method of evaluating the quality of LLM-generated code to identify the weakest scenarios, for which the quality of LLM-generated code should be improved. Methods: The method measures code smells, an important indicator of code quality, and compares them with a baseline formed from reference solutions of professionally written code. The test dataset is divided into various subsets according to the topics of the code and complexity of the coding tasks to represent different scenarios of using LLMs for code generation. We will also present an automated test system for this purpose and report experiments with the Java programs generated in response to prompts given to four state-of-the-art LLMs: Gemini Pro, ChatGPT, Codex, and Falcon. Results: We find that LLM-generated code has a higher incidence of code smells compared to reference solutions. Falcon performed the least badly, with a smell increase of 42.28%, followed by Gemini Pro (62.07%), ChatGPT (65.05%) and finally Codex (84.97%). The average smell increase across all LLMs was 63.34%, comprising 73.35% for implementation smells and 21.42% for design smells. We also found that the increase in code smells is greater for more complex coding tasks and for more advanced topics, such as those involving object-orientated concepts. Conclusion: In terms of code smells, LLMs' performances on various coding task complexities and topics are highly correlated to the quality of human-written code in the corresponding scenarios. However, the quality of LLM-generated code is noticeably poorer than human-written code.
papers.comment: This is a revised version of the paper done in June 2026. It improves the presentation of the work and the statistical analysis of the data. The raw data of the experiments are the same as the previous version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于场景的 LLM 生成代码质量评估方法，用 code smell 计数并与专业参考解基线对比，按题目主题与任务复杂度分组。四个 LLM 的 smell 增幅均高于参考解：Falcon 42.28%、Gemini Pro 62.07%、ChatGPT 65.05%、Codex 84.97%，平均 63.34%（implementation 73.35%、design 21.42%），且任务越复杂、面向对象等高级主题上增幅越大。
Motivation: 已有研究集中在 LLM 生成代码的功能正确性，代码质量关注很少；需要定位哪些使用场景下生成代码质量最弱，以便针对性改进。
Method: 以 code smell 为质量指标，与专业手写参考解构成的基线比较；测试集按代码主题与任务复杂度划分为多个场景子集，并配套自动化测试系统；实验对象为响应 prompt 生成的 Java 程序，覆盖 Gemini Pro、ChatGPT、Codex、Falcon 四个 LLM。
Result: 相对参考解的 smell 增幅：Falcon 42.28%、Gemini Pro 62.07%、ChatGPT 65.05%、Codex 84.97%，四模型平均 63.34%，其中 implementation smells 73.35%、design smells 21.42%；smell 增幅在更复杂的编码任务和面向对象等高级主题上更大。
Conclusion: LLM 在各复杂度与主题上的表现与对应场景的人写代码质量高度相关，但生成代码的 code smell 水平明显差于人写代码。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Generate Rigid Body Interactions with Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent video generation models have achieved remarkable progress and are now deployed in film, social media production, and advertising. Beyond their creative potential, such models also hold promise as world simulators for robotics and embodied decision making. Despite strong advances, current approaches still struggle to generate physically plausible object interactions and lack object-level control mechanisms. To address these limitations, we introduce KineMask, an approach for video generation that enables realistic rigid body control, interactions, and effects. Given a single image and a specified object velocity, our method generates videos with inferred motions and future object interactions. We propose a two-stage training strategy that gradually removes future motion supervision via object masks. Using this strategy we train video diffusion models (VDMs) on synthetic scenes of simple interactions and demonstrate significant improvements and generalization to rigid body and hand-object interactions in real scenes. Furthermore, KineMask integrates low-level motion control with high-level textual conditioning via predicted scene descriptions, leading to support for synthesis of complex dynamical phenomena. Our experiments show that KineMask generalizes to different VDMs and achieves strong improvements over recent models of comparable size. Ablation studies further highlight the complementary roles of low- and high-level conditioning in VDMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KineMask 让视频扩散模型 (VDM) 在单张图像加指定物体速度的条件下生成带刚体运动与未来交互的视频，用两阶段训练逐步通过物体掩码移除未来运动监督。该方法在合成简单交互场景上训练后可泛化到真实场景的刚体与手-物交互，并与预测的场景描述结合以支持复杂动力学现象的文本条件合成。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽已用于影视与广告，但难以生成物理上合理的物体交互，也缺少物体级控制手段，限制了其作为机器人与具身决策世界模拟器的可用性。
Method: KineMask 以单图和指定物体速度为输入，采用两阶段训练策略逐步通过物体掩码 (object masks) 移除未来运动监督，在合成的简单交互场景上训练视频扩散模型；再把低层运动控制与基于预测场景描述的高层文本条件整合。
Result: 在真实场景的刚体与手-物交互上展示显著提升与泛化；对不同 VDM 均可泛化，并相对同规模的近期模型取得强提升；消融实验显示低层与高层条件在 VDM 中作用互补。
Conclusion: 物体级运动掩码监督加文本条件的组合，可让视频扩散模型同时获得刚体交互控制与复杂动力学现象合成能力，且该训练策略可迁移到不同 VDM 架构。

summary_sections.result: 在真实场景的刚体与手-物交互上展示显著提升与泛化；对不同 VDM 均可泛化，并相对同规模的近期模型取得强提升；消融实验显示低层与高层条件在 VDM 中作用互补。
summary_sections.conclusion: 物体级运动掩码监督加文本条件的组合，可让视频扩散模型同时获得刚体交互控制与复杂动力学现象合成能力，且该训练策略可迁移到不同 VDM 架构。

papers.title: AttentionViG: Cross-Attention-Based Dynamic Neighbor Aggregation in Vision GNNs
papers.abstract_en: Vision Graph Neural Networks (ViGs) have demonstrated promising performance in image recognition tasks against Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs). An essential part of the ViG framework is the node-neighbor feature aggregation method. Although various graph convolution methods, such as Max-Relative, EdgeConv, GIN, and GraphSAGE, have been explored, a versatile aggregation method that effectively captures complex node-neighbor relationships without requiring architecture-specific refinements is needed. To address this gap, we propose a cross-attention-based aggregation method in which the query projections come from the node, while the key projections come from its neighbors. Additionally, we introduce a novel architecture called AttentionViG that uses the proposed cross-attention aggregation scheme to conduct non-local message passing. We evaluated the image recognition performance of AttentionViG on the ImageNet-1K benchmark, where it achieved SOTA performance. Additionally, we assessed its transferability to downstream tasks, including object detection and instance segmentation on MS COCO 2017, as well as semantic segmentation on ADE20K. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method not only achieves strong performance, but also maintains efficiency, delivering competitive accuracy with comparable FLOPs to prior vision GNN architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted to Learning on Graphs Conference, 2026 (LoG)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AttentionViG 用跨注意力做节点-邻居聚合：query 来自节点、key 来自邻居，从而在 Vision GNN 中实现非局部消息传递，无需按架构专门调聚合算子。在 ImageNet-1K 图像识别上达到 SOTA，并在 MS COCO 2017 检测/实例分割与 ADE20K 语义分割上验证可迁移性，FLOPs 与既有视觉 GNN 相当。
Motivation: 现有图卷积聚合算子（Max-Relative、EdgeConv、GIN、GraphSAGE）难以在不做架构特定改造的前提下刻画复杂的节点-邻居关系，缺少通用的聚合方法。
Method: 提出跨注意力聚合：节点产生 query 投影、其邻居产生 key 投影，据此做非局部消息传递，并据此构建 AttentionViG 架构；在 ImageNet-1K 上做图像识别评测，再迁移到目标检测、实例分割与语义分割任务。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 图像识别上取得 SOTA 性能；在 MS COCO 2017 上评测目标检测与实例分割、在 ADE20K 上评测语义分割，均表现出强性能，且 FLOPs 与既有视觉 GNN 架构相当、精度具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 跨注意力式的节点-邻居聚合可作为视觉 GNN 的通用聚合方案，在保持效率的同时兼顾识别与下游迁移任务的精度。

papers.title: Patch Rebirth: Toward Fast and Transferable Model Inversion of Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Model inversion is a widely adopted technique in data-free learning that reconstructs synthetic inputs from a pretrained model through iterative optimization, without access to original training data. Unfortunately, its application to state-of-the-art Vision Transformers (ViTs) poses a major computational challenge, due to their expensive self-attention mechanisms. To address this, Sparse Model Inversion (SMI) was proposed to improve efficiency by pruning and discarding seemingly unimportant patches, which were even claimed to be obstacles to knowledge transfer. However, our empirical findings suggest the opposite: even randomly selected patches can eventually acquire transferable knowledge through continued inversion. This reveals that discarding any prematurely inverted patches is inefficient, as it suppresses the extraction of class-agnostic features essential for knowledge transfer, along with class-specific features. In this paper, we propose Patch Rebirth Inversion (PRI), a novel approach that incrementally detaches the most important patches during the inversion process to construct sparse synthetic images, while allowing the remaining patches to continue evolving for future selection. This progressive strategy not only improves efficiency, but also encourages initially less informative patches to gradually accumulate more class-relevant knowledge, a phenomenon we refer to as the Re-Birth effect, thereby effectively balancing class-agnostic and class-specific knowledge. Experimental results show that PRI achieves up to 10x faster inversion than standard Dense Model Inversion (DMI) and 2x faster than SMI, while consistently outperforming SMI in accuracy and matching the performance of DMI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Vision Transformer 模型反演 (model inversion) 中自注意力开销过大的问题，提出 Patch Rebirth Inversion (PRI)：在反演过程中增量式剥离最重要的 patch 构造稀疏合成图像，其余 patch 继续演化等待后续被选。相比 Dense Model Inversion (DMI) 最高加速 10x、相比 Sparse Model Inversion (SMI) 加速 2x，精度持续超过 SMI 并与 DMI 持平。
Motivation: ViT 的自注意力使标准稠密模型反演计算代价高昂；SMI 通过剪枝丢弃不重要 patch 提速，但过早丢弃会抑制类无关特征提取，损害知识迁移。
Method: PRI 在反演迭代中按重要性增量 detach patch 以构造稀疏合成图像，被保留的 patch 继续演化供后续选择，使初期信息弱的 patch 逐步积累类相关知识（Re-Birth effect），平衡类无关与类特定知识。
Result: 实验显示 PRI 反演速度比 DMI 最高快 10x、比 SMI 快 2x，同时精度持续优于 SMI 并与 DMI 相当；经验发现随机选取的 patch 经持续反演也能获得可迁移知识。
Conclusion: 过早丢弃任何 patch 都是低效的，稀疏反演应让未选中的 patch 持续演化，才能兼顾效率与类无关/类特定知识的平衡。

papers.title: Pushing Toward the Simplex Vertices: A Simple Remedy for Code Collapse in Smoothed Vector Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization, which discretizes a continuous vector space into a finite set of representative vectors (a codebook), has been widely adopted in modern machine learning. Despite its effectiveness, vector quantization poses a fundamental challenge: the non-differentiable quantization step blocks gradient backpropagation. Smoothed vector quantization addresses this issue by relaxing the discrete selection of a codebook vector into a weighted combination of codebook entries, represented as the matrix product of a simplex vector and the codebook. Effective smoothing requires two properties: (1) smoothed code-selection vectors should remain close to a onehot vector, ensuring tight approximation, and (2) all codebook entries should be utilized, preventing code collapse. Existing methods typically address these desiderata separately. By contrast, the present study introduces a simple and intuitive regularization that promotes both simultaneously by minimizing the distance between each simplex vertex and its $K$-nearest smoothed code-selectors. Representative benchmarks on image encoding demonstrate that the proposed method achieves more effective codebook utilization and improves performance over prior approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对平滑向量量化 (smoothed vector quantization) 中代码本坍缩与选择向量偏离 one-hot 的矛盾，提出一个正则项：最小化每个单纯形顶点与其 K 近邻平滑选择向量的距离，同时把选择向量拉向 one-hot 并促使全部代码本条目被使用。在图像编码代表性基准上，该方法比既有方法取得更好的代码本利用率与性能。
Motivation: 向量量化的离散选择步骤不可微、阻断梯度回传；平滑化虽缓解了这一点，但紧致近似（选择向量接近 one-hot）与避免 code collapse（所有码字都被用到）这两点通常被分开处理，难以同时满足。
Method: 在平滑向量量化框架内加入一个正则项，最小化每个单纯形顶点 (simplex vertex) 与其 K 个最近邻平滑代码选择向量之间的距离，用单一目标同时促进接近 one-hot 与代码本充分利用；在图像编码基准上与既有方法比较。
Result: 在图像编码的代表性基准上，所提方法相比先前方法实现了更有效的代码本利用率 (codebook utilization) 并提升了性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把“贴近 one-hot”与“避免 code collapse”合并到同一个基于 K 近邻距离的正则项里即可同时达成，无需分两步处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Kernel-based Stochastic Approximation Framework for Nonlinear Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: We develop a stochastic approximation framework for learning nonlinear operators between infinite-dimensional spaces utilizing general Mercer operator-valued kernels. Our framework encompasses two key classes: (i) operator-valued kernels whose associated integral operators are compact and hence admit discrete spectral decompositions, and (ii) separable kernels of the form $K(x,x')=k(x,x')T$, where $k$ is a scalar-valued kernel and $T$ is a positive operator on the output space. This broad setting induces expressive vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) that generalize the classical $K=kI$ paradigm, thereby enabling rich structural modeling with rigorous theoretical guarantees. To address target operators lying outside the RKHS, we introduce vector-valued interpolation spaces to precisely quantify misspecification error. Within this framework, we establish non-asymptotic convergence rates for prediction, estimation, and misspecification errors in the online and finite-horizon settings. Importantly, the framework also accommodates a range of operator learning settings, from Fredholm integral operators to encoder--decoder architectures. Numerical experiments on the two-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations illustrate the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Mercer 算子值核的随机逼近框架，用于学习无穷维空间之间的非线性算子，覆盖紧积分算子的离散谱分解与可分核 K(x,x')=k(x,x')T 两类情形。通过引入向量值插值空间量化 RKHS 外目标算子的误设误差，在线与有限时域下给出预测、估计、误设三类误差的非渐近收敛率，并在二维 Navier–Stokes 方程上做数值实验。
Motivation: 经典 K=kI 的算子学习表达能力受限，且目标算子落在 RKHS 之外时缺少刻画误设误差的严格框架，非渐近收敛保证不完整。
Method: 用一般 Mercer 算子值核构造向量值 RKHS，覆盖紧积分算子的离散谱分解与可分核 K(x,x')=k(x,x')T 两类；引入向量值插值空间 (interpolation spaces) 度量误设误差，并在在线与有限时域两种设定下推导随机逼近的非渐近收敛率，框架兼容 Fredholm 积分算子到 encoder–decoder 架构。
Result: 建立预测误差、估计误差与误设误差的非渐近收敛率（在线与有限时域设定）；数值实验在二维 Navier–Stokes 方程上演示所提方法。
Conclusion: 算子值核加插值空间的随机逼近可同时容纳紧谱分解与可分核两大类，并对 RKHS 外目标给出带误设项的收敛保证，适用范围从 Fredholm 积分算子延伸到 encoder–decoder 架构。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: On the Interaction of Compressibility and Adversarial Robustness
papers.abstract_en: As demands for resource efficiency and safety in modern neural networks intensify, substantial research effort has gone into model compression and adversarial robustness. Yet despite progress on each in isolation, a systematic understanding of how compressibility shapes robustness remains elusive. In this paper, we develop a principled framework to analyze how different forms of structured compressibility - such as neuron-level and spectral compressibility - affect adversarial robustness. We show that structured compressibility can induce a small number of highly sensitive directions in the representation space, which adversaries can exploit to construct effective perturbations. Our analysis yields a robustness bound that reveals how neuron and spectral compressibility impact $\ell_\infty$ and $\ell_2$ robustness via their effects on the learned representations. Crucially, the vulnerabilities we identify arise irrespective of how compressibility is achieved - whether via regularization, architectural bias, or learning dynamics. Through empirical evaluations across synthetic and realistic tasks, we confirm our theoretical predictions, and further demonstrate that these vulnerabilities persist under adversarial training and transfer learning, and contribute to the emergence of universal adversarial examples. Our findings show a fundamental tension between structured compressibility and robustness and highlight new pathways for designing models that are efficient and safe.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一个分析框架，说明结构化可压缩性（神经元级与谱可压缩性）会在表示空间中诱导出少量高敏感方向，攻击者据此构造有效对抗扰动，从而在 ℓ∞ 与 ℓ2 两种度量下给出鲁棒性上界。该脆弱性与可压缩性如何达成无关（正则化、架构偏置或学习动力学均可），在合成与真实任务上经实验确认，且在对抗训练与迁移学习下依然存在，并促成通用对抗样本 (universal adversarial examples) 的出现。
Motivation: 模型压缩与对抗鲁棒性各自已有大量研究，但结构化可压缩性如何系统性地影响鲁棒性缺乏统一理解，压缩与安全之间的张力没有可推导的刻画。
Method: 建立分析框架，把神经元级与谱可压缩性对学习表示的作用写进一个鲁棒性上界，据此推导对 ℓ∞ 与 ℓ2 鲁棒性的影响；再用合成任务与真实任务上的实验检验理论预测，并考察对抗训练与迁移学习两种设定。
Result: 结构化可压缩性诱导表示空间中少量高敏感方向，产生随神经元与谱可压缩性变化的 ℓ∞ 与 ℓ2 鲁棒性上界；实验在合成与真实任务上确认理论预测，并显示脆弱性在对抗训练与迁移学习下持续存在，且与通用对抗样本的出现相关。
Conclusion: 结构化可压缩性与鲁棒性之间存在根本性张力，且该脆弱性不依赖于可压缩性的获得方式，因此设计高效模型时需同时考虑其对抗安全代价。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 结构化可压缩性与鲁棒性之间存在根本性张力，且该脆弱性不依赖于可压缩性的获得方式，因此设计高效模型时需同时考虑其对抗安全代价。

papers.title: Bridging MOOCs, Smart Teaching, and AI-Assisted Learning: A Unified Quantitative Model
papers.abstract_en: Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs), Smart Teaching (ST), and AI-assisted learning have reshaped higher education at different stages of its digital transformation. Existing educational technology research often examines these approaches in isolation or relies on aggregate outcomes, making their contributions within a continuous learning process difficult to distinguish. This study develops a unified quantitative model comprising MOOC-based pre-class learning, ST-based in-class adaptation, and AI-assisted post-class personalization. Student knowledge is represented as a bounded multidimensional state, and all stages follow a common exponential learning-response function through which instructional resources reduce remaining knowledge gaps. The stages differ in their resource-allocation rules: predefined course-content emphasis for MOOCs, class-level adaptation based on aggregate feedback for ST, and individualized allocation based on mastery gaps for AI-assisted learning. Simulations demonstrate cumulative learning gains, adaptive resource redistribution across knowledge components, and diminishing returns as the learning budget increases. Experiments across 100 independently generated classes further show stable stage-wise progression under learner heterogeneity. By making state transitions and allocation mechanisms explicit, the framework enables stage-wise decomposition of learning gains and controlled analysis of resource distribution and budget sensitivity. It thus provides a quantitative foundation for analyzing and coordinating successive instructional stages within an integrated learning process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MOOC 课前、Smart Teaching 课中、AI 辅助课后三阶段统一成一个定量模型：学生知识记为有界多维状态，三阶段共用同一条指数学习响应函数，靠资源分配规则区分——MOOC 按预设课程重点、ST 按班级聚合反馈、AI 按个人掌握度缺口。仿真显示学习增益随预算增加而边际递减，100 个独立生成班级的实验在学习者异质性下仍保持稳定的阶段递进。
Motivation: 现有教育技术研究把 MOOC、Smart Teaching、AI 辅助学习割裂开考察，或只看聚合结果，无法区分它们在连续学习过程各阶段的贡献。
Method: 构建统一量化模型：学生知识表示为有界多维状态，三阶段共用指数学习响应函数，用资源削减剩余知识缺口；差异体现在资源分配规则（预设重点 / 班级级聚合反馈 / 个体掌握度缺口），通过仿真与 100 个独立生成班级的实验检验。
Result: 仿真给出累积学习增益、跨知识组件的自适应资源再分配，以及学习预算增大时的边际收益递减；100 个独立生成班级的实验显示在学习者异质性下阶段递进保持稳定。
Conclusion: 把状态转移与分配机制显式化后，学习增益可按阶段分解，并能对资源分布与预算敏感性做受控分析，从而为连续教学阶段的协调提供量化基础。

papers.title: Tags for DAGs: Graph Refinement with Meta-Informed Relations
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery has shifted from data-centric methods to hybrid strategies that integrate semantic knowledge from experts or large language models (LLMs). Such external information is vital for identifying causal structures beyond the Markov Equivalence Class (MEC), which data alone cannot resolve. However, expert availability is often limited, and LLMs frequently misidentify causal directions in specialized domains. To overcome such shortcomings, we propose a tag-based approach that leverages semantically meaningful labels while deriving causal directionality directly from data. Using variable-level tag assignments from available sources (e.g., LLMs), our tags for DAGs method learns from identifiable data structures to extract higher-level causal relations. These are then used to orient undirected edges, enabling causal discovery to move beyond the MEC without reliance on fallible external knowledge.
papers.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tags for DAGs：用 LLM 等来源给出的变量级语义标签，从可识别的数据结构中学习高阶因果关系，再据此定向无向边，从而在不直接依赖易错外部知识的情况下把因果发现推出马尔可夫等价类 (MEC)。
Motivation: 因果发现需要外部语义知识才能分辨 MEC 内的等价结构，但专家稀缺、LLM 在专业领域常判错因果方向，纯数据方法又无法解决 MEC。
Method: 基于变量级标签分配（可来自 LLM），从可识别的数据结构中学习高阶因果关系，用这些关系为无向边定向，构成 tag-based 的 DAG 图精炼流程。
Result: 摘要给出的是方法主张：从数据结构中提取的高阶关系可定向无向边，使因果发现超越 MEC，且不依赖易出错的外部知识。
Conclusion: 语义标签应作为先验线索而非直接方向来源——方向性仍从数据导出，这样既利用外部语义又规避 LLM 判错因果方向的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEGATO: Large-scale End-to-end Generalizable Approach to Typeset OMR
papers.abstract_en: We propose Legato, a new end-to-end model for optical music recognition (OMR), a task of converting music score images to machine-readable documents. Legato is the first large-scale pretrained OMR model capable of recognizing full-page or multi-page typeset music scores and the first to generate documents in ABC notation, a concise, human-readable format for symbolic music. Bringing together a pretrained vision encoder with an ABC decoder trained on a dataset of more than 214K images, our model exhibits the strong ability to generalize across various typeset scores. We conduct comprehensive experiments on a range of datasets and metrics and demonstrate that Legato outperforms the previous state of the art. On our most realistic dataset, we see a 68.2% and 48.1% absolute error reduction on the standard metrics TEDn and OMR-NED, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Legato 是首个大规模预训练的端到端光学乐谱识别 (OMR) 模型，用预训练视觉编码器直接把整页或多页印刷乐谱图转成 ABC 记号文本，在 214K+ 图像上训练的解码器上实现跨多种印刷乐谱的泛化。在最贴近真实的数据集上，标准指标 TEDn 与 OMR-NED 分别取得 68.2% 和 48.1% 的绝对误差下降，超过此前 SOTA。
Motivation: OMR 此前缺少能一次处理整页乃至多页印刷乐谱、并直接输出结构化可读符号文档的大规模预训练模型，跨乐谱版式的泛化能力不足。
Method: 端到端架构：预训练视觉编码器 + 在超过 214K 张图像上训练的 ABC 记号解码器，直接从乐谱图像生成 ABC 符号音乐文档，覆盖整页与多页输入。
Result: 在最真实 (most realistic) 的数据集上，标准指标 TEDn 绝对误差下降 68.2%，OMR-NED 绝对误差下降 48.1%，在一系列数据集与指标上超过此前 state of the art。
Conclusion: 大规模预训练视觉编码器配合 ABC 解码器足以让 OMR 跨印刷乐谱版式泛化，并把整页/多页识别的错误率大幅压低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identifiable Convex-Concave Regression via Sub-gradient Regularised Least Squares
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel nonparametric regression method that models complex input-output relationships as the sum of convex and concave components. The method-Identifiable Convex-Concave Nonparametric Least Squares (ICCNLS)-decomposes the target function into additive shape-constrained components, each represented via sub-gradient-constrained affine functions. To address the affine ambiguity inherent in convex-concave decompositions, we introduce global statistical orthogonality constraints, ensuring that residuals are uncorrelated with both intercept and input variables. This enforces decomposition identifiability and improves interpretability. We further incorporate L1, L2 and elastic net regularisation on sub-gradients to enhance generalisation and promote structural sparsity. The proposed method is evaluated on synthetic and real-world datasets, including healthcare pricing data, and demonstrates improved predictive accuracy and model simplicity compared to conventional CNLS and difference-of-convex (DC) regression approaches. Our results show that statistical identifiability, when paired with convex-concave structure and sub-gradient regularisation, yields interpretable models suited for forecasting, benchmarking, and policy evaluation.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the author because the identifiability result in Sections 3.3-3.4 is incorrect. Residual orthogonality depends only on the fitted sum and therefore cannot identify the convex-concave decomposition; the proof also incorrectly treats the difference of two concave functions as necessarily affine. A substantially revised manuscript is in preparation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出非参数回归方法 ICCNLS，把目标函数分解为凸与凹两个形状约束分量，用次梯度约束的仿射函数表示，并加全局统计正交约束（残差与截距和输入变量不相关）来消除凸凹分解的仿射歧义，再叠加 L1、L2 与 elastic net 次梯度正则。在合成数据与含医疗定价的真实数据上，相较传统 CNLS 与 difference-of-convex (DC) 回归取得更好的预测精度与模型简洁度。
Motivation: 凸凹分解存在固有的仿射歧义（两个分量可互相平移而不改变拟合值），导致分解不可辨识、可解释性差；现有 CNLS 与 DC 回归未处理这一问题。
Method: ICCNLS 将目标函数写成凸分量加凹分量，每个分量用次梯度约束的仿射函数表示；引入全局统计正交约束使残差与截距及输入变量不相关以强制可辨识；对次梯度施加 L1、L2 与 elastic net 正则以提升泛化并促进结构稀疏。
Result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集（含 healthcare pricing data）上评估，相较 conventional CNLS 与 difference-of-convex (DC) regression 展示了改进的预测精度与模型简洁度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张统计可辨识性与凸凹结构、次梯度正则结合可产出适用于 forecasting、benchmarking 与 policy evaluation 的可解释模型；但 arXiv comment 注明该稿已因第 3.3–3.4 节可辨识性结果不正确而撤回，修订稿在准备中。

papers.title: AutoSDT: Scaling Data-Driven Discovery Tasks Toward Open Co-Scientists
papers.abstract_en: Despite long-standing efforts in accelerating scientific discovery with AI, building AI co-scientists remains challenging due to limited high-quality data for training and evaluation. To tackle this data scarcity issue, we present AutoSDT, an automatic pipeline that collects high-quality coding tasks in real-world data-driven discovery workflows. AutoSDT leverages the coding capabilities and parametric knowledge of LLMs to search for diverse sources, select ecologically valid tasks, and synthesize accurate task instructions and code solutions. Using our pipeline, we construct AutoSDT-5K, a dataset of 5,404 coding tasks for data-driven discovery that covers four scientific disciplines and 756 unique Python packages. To the best of our knowledge, AutoSDT-5K is the only automatically collected and the largest open dataset for data-driven scientific discovery. Expert feedback on a subset of 256 tasks shows the effectiveness of AutoSDT: 93% of the collected tasks are ecologically valid, and 92.2% of the synthesized programs are functionally correct. Trained on AutoSDT-5K, the Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct LLM series, dubbed AutoSDT-Coder, show substantial improvement on two challenging data-driven discovery benchmarks, ScienceAgentBench and DiscoveryBench. Most notably, AutoSDT-Coder-32B reaches the same level of performance as GPT-4o on ScienceAgentBench with a success rate of 7.8%, doubling the performance of its base model. On DiscoveryBench, it lifts the hypothesis matching score to 8.1, bringing a 17.4% relative improvement and closing the gap between open-weight models and GPT-4o.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2025 (Main Conference); Best Paper Award at LM4Sci @ COLM 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pp. 30396-30418, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoSDT 用 LLM 自动搜索、筛选并合成真实数据驱动科研流程中的编码任务，产出 5,404 道题的 AutoSDT-5K（覆盖 4 个学科、756 个 Python 包）。用它训练的 AutoSDT-Coder-32B 在 ScienceAgentBench 成功率达 7.8%、追平 GPT-4o，DiscoveryBench 假设匹配分提到 8.1（相对提升 17.4%）。
Motivation: AI co-scientist 缺少高质量训练与评测数据，人工构建科研编码任务成本高、规模有限，制约数据驱动科学发现能力的提升。
Method: AutoSDT 流水线利用 LLM 的编码能力与参数化知识：搜索多样来源、筛选具生态效度 (ecologically valid) 的任务，再合成任务指令与代码解答；据此构建 AutoSDT-5K，并在其上微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct 系列得到 AutoSDT-Coder。
Result: AutoSDT-5K 含 5,404 道编码任务，覆盖 4 个学科、756 个唯一 Python 包，是目前唯一自动收集且最大的开放数据驱动科学发现数据集。256 道任务的专家反馈显示 93% 生态有效、92.2% 合成程序功能正确。AutoSDT-Coder-32B 在 ScienceAgentBench 成功率 7.8%（与 GPT-4o 同级，为其基座模型的两倍）；DiscoveryBench 假设匹配分 8.1，相对提升 17.4%。
Conclusion: 自动合成的科研编码任务能有效缩小开放权重模型与 GPT-4o 在数据驱动发现基准上的差距，训练数据稀缺是可由流水线缓解的瓶颈。

papers.title: Federated Independent Component Analysis via Spectral Alignment and Robust Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies robust estimation for Independent Component Analysis (ICA) in the federated learning setting, where data are locally distributed across clients and may exhibit substantial heterogeneity. The goal is to recover a common global mixing matrix by aggregating local estimators computed by individual clients. The main difficulty is that local ICA estimators are identifiable only up to sign flips and column permutations and may have highly heterogeneous estimation quality. We propose a novel three-step aggregation method that first aligns the permutations across all local estimators via a particular spectral clustering approach, then aligns the signs within each estimated cluster via another tailored spectral approach, and finally applies the geometric median for robust aggregation. The proposed estimator is shown to remain accurate even when a substantial fraction of local estimators are of low quality or inconsistent, as long as each cluster contains a majority of accurate estimators. This contrasts with its analogue based on simple averaging, whose performance is determined by the worst local estimator. In the homogeneous setting, the robust estimator is also shown to be minimax optimal, up to a logarithmic factor, both when the number of clients remains fixed and when it diverges. The theoretical findings are corroborated by simulation studies and a real-data analysis.

TL;DR: 在联邦学习设定下做 ICA 鲁棒估计：先用谱聚类对齐各客户端混合矩阵估计的列置换，再在簇内用谱方法对齐符号，最后用几何中位数 (geometric median) 聚合。只要每个簇内准确估计占多数，即使相当一部分本地估计质量低或不一致，全局混合矩阵仍能恢复；而简单平均的表现由最差的本地估计决定。
Motivation: 联邦设定下各客户端本地 ICA 估计只在符号与列置换意义下可辨识，且估计质量高度异质，直接平均会被最差的本地估计拖垮。
Method: 三步聚合：谱聚类跨客户端对齐列置换，簇内定制谱方法对齐符号，再以几何中位数做鲁棒聚合；同质设定下给出客户端数固定与发散两种情形的 minimax 最优性（差一个对数因子）分析，并用模拟与真实数据检验。
Result: 理论保证：每个簇含多数准确估计时估计仍准确，对比简单平均由最差本地估计决定；同质设定下 minimax 最优至多差一个对数因子，覆盖客户端数固定与发散两种情形；结论由模拟研究和真实数据分析佐证。
Conclusion: 先对齐置换与符号再做鲁棒聚合，可让联邦 ICA 对低质量本地估计免疫，而平均聚合不具备这一性质。

papers.title: On the $O(\frac{\sqrt{d}}{K^{1/4}})$ Convergence Rate of AdamW Measured by $\ell_1$ Norm
papers.abstract_en:
As the default optimizer for training large language models, AdamW has achieved remarkable success in deep learning. However, its convergence behavior is not theoretically well-understood. This paper establishes the convergence rate $ rac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^KE\left[||
abla f(x^k)||_1ight]\leq O( rac{\sqrt{d}C}{K^{1/4}})$ for AdamW measured by $\ell_1$ norm, where $K$ represents the iteration number, $d$ denotes the model dimension, and $C$ matches the constant in the optimal convergence rate of SGD. Theoretically, we have $||
abla f(x)||_2\ll ||
abla f(x)||_1\leq \sqrt{d}||
abla f(x)||_2$ for any high-dimensional vector $x$ and $E\left[||
abla f(x)||_1ight]\geq\sqrt{ rac{2d}π}E\left[||
abla f(x)||_2ight]$ when each element of $
abla f(x)$ is generated from Gaussian distribution $\mathcal N(0,1)$. Empirically, our experimental results on real-world deep learning tasks reveal $||
abla f(x)||_1=\varTheta(\sqrt{d})||
abla f(x)||_2$. Both support that our convergence rate can be considered to be analogous to the optimal $ rac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^KE\left[||
abla f(x^k)||_2ight]\leq O( rac{C}{K^{1/4}})$ convergence rate of SGD in the ideal case. We also extend our result to NAdamW, an AdamW variant that employs a double-momentum mechanism, and demonstrate that it maintains the same convergence rate.
papers.comment: V2: NeurIPS Camera-Ready. V3: expand upon the conference version by incorporating the analysis of NAdamW. V4: Relax the coordinate-wise bounded noise variance assumption to the more general bounded noise variance assumption
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 AdamW 在 ℓ1 范数下的收敛率为 (1/K)Σ E[||∇f(x^k)||_1] ≤ O(√d·C/K^{1/4})，其中 C 与 SGD 最优收敛率的常数一致；结合高维梯度下 ℓ1 与 ℓ2 的标度关系，该速率可类比 SGD 理想情形的 O(C/K^{1/4})。结果同样适用于采用双动量机制的 NAdamW。
Motivation: AdamW 是训练大语言模型的默认优化器，但其收敛行为缺少理论理解，尤其在高维模型下用何种范数度量收敛尚无清晰刻画。
Method: 对 AdamW 推导以 ℓ1 范数度量的收敛界，常数 C 对齐 SGD 最优速率；理论上给出高维向量 ℓ1/ℓ2 关系（含梯度元素服从 N(0,1) 时 E[||∇f||_1] ≥ √(2d/π)·E[||∇f||_2]），并在真实深度学习任务上做实证检验；V3 版本将分析扩展到双动量变体 NAdamW，V4 放松了逐坐标有界噪声方差假设。
Result: 收敛率 (1/K)Σ_{k=1}^K E[||∇f(x^k)||_1] ≤ O(√d·C/K^{1/4})；高斯梯度下 E[||∇f||_1] ≥ √(2d/π)·E[||∇f||_2]；真实深度学习任务上实测 ||∇f(x)||_1 = Θ(√d)·||∇f(x)||_2；NAdamW 保持相同收敛率。
Conclusion: AdamW 的 O(√d·C/K^{1/4}) ℓ1 收敛率在高维标度下可视为与 SGD 理想情形的 O(C/K^{1/4}) 相当，且该结论对 NAdamW 同样成立。

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Under-Confidence in GNNs from the Final Layer
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness on graph-based tasks. However, their predictive confidence is often miscalibrated, typically exhibiting under-confidence, which harms the reliability of their decisions. Existing calibration methods for GNNs normally introduce additional calibration components, which fail to capture the intrinsic relationship between the model and the prediction confidence, resulting in limited theoretical guarantees and increased computational overhead. To address this issue, we propose a simple yet efficient graph calibration method. We establish a unified theoretical framework revealing that model confidence is jointly governed by class-centroid-level and node-level calibration at the final layer. Based on this insight, we theoretically show that reducing the weight decay of the final-layer parameters alleviates GNN under-confidence by acting on the class-centroid level, while node-level calibration acts as a finer-grained complement to class-centroid-level calibration, which encourages each test node to be closer to its predicted class prototype in the final-layer representations. Extensive experiments validate the superiority of our method. The code is released at https://github.com/huangJC0429/SCAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GNN 的预测置信度普遍欠校准 (under-confidence)，本文建立统一理论框架，指出最后一层的置信度由类中心级 (class-centroid-level) 与节点级 (node-level) 校准共同决定，并据此提出简单方法：降低最后一层参数的 weight decay 从类中心级缓解欠配合，再以节点级校准促使每个测试节点在最后一层表示中更靠近其预测类原型。实验验证了该方法的优越性。
Motivation: GNN 置信度常呈欠校准，损害决策可靠性；现有校准方法额外加装校准组件，无法刻画模型与置信度的内在联系，理论保证有限且带来额外计算开销。
Method: 建立统一理论框架，把最后一层置信度分解为类中心级与节点级两个校准分量；据此降低最后一层参数的 weight decay 作用于类中心级，并以节点级校准作为更细粒度的补充，鼓励测试节点在最后一层表示上靠近预测类原型。
Result: 在图任务上，所提方法相对现有 GCL 方法取得更优的校准表现（摘要以 extensive experiments 概括，未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: GNN 欠配合可由最后一层的类中心级与节点级校准共同解释，降低最后一层 weight decay 是一条无需额外校准组件的缓解路径；代码已发布于 github.com/huangJC0429/SCAR。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Focus on Likely Classes for Test-Time Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We ask: Can focusing on likely classes of a single, in-domain sample improve accuracy? Prior work argued "no", we answer "yes" on average. Standard entropy minimization yields largest gains, and we further dissect why by looking at its two core mechanisms: increasing likely and decreasing unlikely class predictions. Simply maximizing logits of the two most likely classes explains most of its benefits and, in some cases, even outperforms entropy minimization. Thus, decreasing classes is a secondary concern. Our controlled experiment and theory investigate the most puzzling case, why simply optimizing the logits of the two most likely classes leads to accuracy gains. Our small scale networks suggest that the degree of uncertainty of a prediction, followed by model choice, and to a lesser extent dataset choice moderate the success chances of the optimization. We show that the true class tends to have larger gradients independent of whether the prediction is correct or not. Our theory thoroughly investigates one of multiple possible explanations from the angle of shared features. Our evaluation focuses on 26 large language models and 12 text datasets, and 18 image recognition models trained on ImageNet. It demonstrates gains of 0.6 percent on average for entropy minimization on uncertain samples using no extra data aside from the given test sample using a fixed learning rate. We also suggest gradient-ray ensembling. When traversing input/embedding space by applying the same gradient with differing learning rates and aggregating probabilities for the same sample further improves accuracy significantly to 0.75 percent relying on a coarse range for learning rates, thus improving accuracy and eliminating the need to find a precise learning rate at the expense of computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 测试时只对单个域内样本的最可能类别做优化即可提升准确率：熵最小化的收益主要来自抬高最可能类别的 logit，压低不必要类别是次要机制。在 26 个大语言模型与 12 个文本数据集、18 个 ImageNet 图像识别模型上，熵最小化在不确定样本上平均提升 0.6 个百分点；提出的 gradient-ray ensembling 用同一梯度配不同学习率遍历输入/嵌入空间并聚合概率，进一步提升到 0.75 个百分点。
Motivation: 此前工作认为单个域内测试样本上做测试时预测优化无法提升准确率，本文要在平均意义上回答“可以”，并解释熵最小化为何有效。
Method: 把熵最小化拆成“提高最可能类别”与“压低不必要类别”两个机制，单独最大化两个最可能类别的 logit 做对照；用受控实验与基于共享特征 (shared features) 角度的理论解释为何优化两个最可能类别的 logit 就能带来增益，并提出 gradient-ray ensembling（同一梯度、不同学习率遍历输入/嵌入空间后聚合同一样本的概率）。评测覆盖 26 个 LLM 与 12 个文本数据集、18 个在 ImageNet 上训练的图像识别模型，固定学习率、不使用测试样本之外的额外数据。
Result: 熵最小化在不确定样本上平均提升 0.6 个百分点（26 个 LLM、12 个文本数据集、18 个 ImageNet 图像识别模型，固定学习率、无额外数据）；gradient-ray ensembling 在粗略学习率范围上进一步提升到 0.75 个百分点并显著改善准确率，代价是额外计算。仅最大化两个最可能类别的 logit 解释了大部分收益，某些情况下甚至超过熵最小化；真类别的梯度倾向于更大，与预测是否正确无关。
Conclusion: 测试时聚焦最可能类别平均能提升准确率，压低不必要类别是次要关注点；成功概率主要由预测的不确定程度调节，其次是模型选择，数据集选择影响较小。
Relevance: 0
