papers.title: Generative Classifier for Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization (DG) aims to improve the generalizability of computer vision models toward distribution shifts. The mainstream DG methods predominantly focus on learning domain invariance across domains, however, such methods overlook the untapped potential inherent in domain-specific information. While the prevailing practice of discriminative linear classifier has been tailored to domain-invariant features, it struggles when confronted with diverse domain-specific information, \emph{e.g.,} intra-class shifts, that exhibits multi-modality. To address these issues, we explore the theoretical implications of relying on domain-invariant features, revealing the crucial role of domain-specific information in mitigating the target risk for DG. Drawing from these insights, we propose Generative Classifier-driven Domain Generalization (GCDG), introducing a generative paradigm for the DG classifier based on Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) for each class across domains. GCDG consists of three key modules: Heterogeneity Learning Classifier~(HLC), Spurious Correlation Blocking~(SCB), and Diverse Component Balancing~(DCB). Concretely, HLC attempts to model the feature distributions and thereby capture valuable domain-specific information via GMMs. SCB identifies the neural units containing spurious correlations and perturbs them, mitigating the risk of HLC learning irrelevant spurious patterns. Meanwhile, DCB ensures a balanced contribution of components within HLC, preventing the underestimation or neglect of critical components. In this way, GCDG excels in capturing the nuances of domain-specific information characterized by diverse distributions. Extensive experiments show GCDG's comparable performance on five DG benchmarks and one face anti-spoofing dataset, seamlessly integrating into existing DG methods with consistent improvements.
papers.comment: Code will be available at https://github.com/longshaocong/GCDG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GCDG 把域泛化 (DG) 的分类头从判别式线性分类器换成按类建模的高斯混合模型 (GMM)，用 HLC 学习域特异特征分布、SCB 扰动含虚假相关的神经单元、DCB 平衡混合成分，从而利用被忽略的域特异信息降低目标风险。在五个 DG 基准与一个人脸反欺骗数据集上取得可比性能，并可嵌入现有 DG 方法带来一致提升。
Motivation: 主流 DG 只学域不变性，丢掉了域特异信息；为域不变特征定制的判别式线性分类器面对类内偏移这类多模态域特异信息时失效。
Method: 提出 Generative Classifier-driven Domain Generalization (GCDG)：为每个类跨域建立 GMM 生成式分类器，含三个模块——Heterogeneity Learning Classifier (HLC) 用 GMM 建模特征分布以捕获域特异信息，Spurious Correlation Blocking (SCB) 识别并扰动带虚假相关的神经单元，Diverse Component Balancing (DCB) 保证 HLC 内成分贡献均衡；并给出依赖域不变特征的目标风险理论分析。
Result: 在五个 DG 基准和一个人脸反欺骗数据集上表现与现有方法相当，且能无缝接入已有 DG 方法并带来一致提升。
Conclusion: 域特异信息对降低 DG 目标风险至关重要，用按类 GMM 的生成式分类头替代判别式线性分类器可捕获多模态域特异分布，并与现有 DG 方法互补。

summary_sections.motivation: 主流 DG 只学域不变性，丢掉了域特异信息；为域不变特征定制的判别式线性分类器面对类内偏移这类多模态域特异信息时失效。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Generative Classifier-driven Domain Generalization (GCDG)：为每个类跨域建立 GMM 生成式分类器，含三个模块——Heterogeneity Learning Classifier (HLC) 用 GMM 建模特征分布以捕获域特异信息，Spurious Correlation Blocking (SCB) 识别并扰动带虚假相关的神经单元，Diverse Component Balancing (DCB) 保证 HLC 内成分贡献均衡；并给出依赖域不变特征的目标风险理论分析。
summary_sections.result: 在五个 DG 基准和一个人脸反欺骗数据集上表现与现有方法相当，且能无缝接入已有 DG 方法并带来一致提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 域特异信息对降低 DG 目标风险至关重要，用按类 GMM 的生成式分类头替代判别式线性分类器可捕获多模态域特异分布，并与现有 DG 方法互补。

papers.title: Learning Where and What to Restore for Composite Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Real-world degraded images often contain multiple co-occurring degradation types, making composite image restoration fundamentally different from the single-degradation setting assumed by most existing all-in-one methods. These methods typically apply uniform spatial computation and single-label task conditioning, limiting both spatial adaptivity and explicit modeling of degradation mixtures. We propose CART (Composite-Adaptive Routing and Task Conditioning), a unified framework that jointly decides where to spend computation and what degradation cues should guide restoration: a spatial mixer routes patches to graded-capacity experts by local restoration difficulty, and a channel mixer routes each image through degradation-specific experts, conditioned on the global task feature with multi-hot classification supervision. Empirically, CART achieves state-of-the-art performance for composite degradation restoration on CDD-11 and delivers the best results to date on the conventional 3-task and 5-task all-in-one benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 16 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. v2: substantially revised camera-ready version; title changed from "Cat-AIR: Content and Task-Aware All-in-One Image Restoration"; method renamed from Cat-AIR to CART and extended to composite degradations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CART 针对多种退化同时出现的复合图像修复，用空间混合器按局部修复难度把 patch 路由到分级容量专家，用通道混合器在全局任务特征与 multi-hot 分类监督下选择退化专属专家，联合决定算在哪、按什么线索修。在 CDD-11 复合退化基准上达到 SOTA，并在常规 3-task 与 5-task all-in-one 基准上取得迄今最佳结果。
Motivation: 真实退化图像常同时含多种退化类型，而现有 all-in-one 方法假设单一退化，用均匀空间计算与单标签任务条件，既缺乏空间自适应也无法显式建模退化混合。

Result: 在 CDD-11 复合退化修复上达到 state-of-the-art；在常规 3-task 与 5-task all-in-one 基准上取得迄今最佳结果（abstract 未给出具体数值）。

papers.title: Classifier-pruned Bayesian optimization for particle accelerator tuning: Exploring temporally structured manifold of 6D beam phase space
papers.abstract_en: Complex dynamical systems, such as particle accelerators, require tuning over high-dimensional, nonlinear state and parameter spaces while experimental measurements and high-fidelity simulations can be expensive. Learned latent representations provide a compact domain for such optimization, but poorly supported regions of the learned manifold may decode into unrealistic physical states and yield deceptively favorable objectives. To address this challenge, we propose the Classifier-pruned Bayesian Optimization-based Latent-space Tuner (CBOL-Tuner), which performs Bayesian optimization over a temporally structured latent representation of 6D beam phase-space dynamics. The CBOL-Tuner integrates a conditional variational autoencoder for latent space representation, a long short-term memory network for temporal dynamics, a lightweight neural network for parameter estimation, and a classifier-pruned Bayesian optimizer to adaptively search and filter the latent space for optimal solutions. This framework enables feasibility-aware exploration of learned scientific representations for accelerator tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CBOL-Tuner：在 6D 束流相空间的时间结构化潜空间上做贝叶斯优化，用分类器剪枝掉学习表示中数据支撑不足、解码为非物理状态的区域，使目标函数不再被虚假的“好解”欺骗，实现可行域感知的加速器调谐。
Motivation: 粒子加速器调谐要在高维非线性状态与参数空间上进行，而实验测量与高保真仿真代价高昂；学习到的潜表示在数据稀疏区会解码出不真实的物理状态，给出看似有利的虚假目标值。
Method: CBOL-Tuner 组合条件变分自编码器 (CVAE) 构建潜表示、LSTM 建模时间动力学、轻量神经网络做参数估计，以及分类器剪枝的贝叶斯优化器，在潜空间中自适应搜索并过滤不可行解。
Result: 提出并整合了上述四个组件的框架，用于在时间结构化的 6D 束流相空间潜表示上进行可行性感知的贝叶斯优化搜索。
Conclusion: 在学习到的科学表示上做优化时，必须用分类器把数据支撑不足的潜区域剪掉，否则目标值会系统性偏乐观；该框架面向加速器调谐场景。

papers.title: OrientedFormer: An End-to-End Transformer-Based Oriented Object Detector in Remote Sensing Images
papers.abstract_en: Oriented object detection in remote sensing images is a challenging task due to objects being distributed in multi-orientation. Recently, end-to-end transformer-based methods have achieved success by eliminating the need for post-processing operators compared to traditional CNN-based methods. However, directly extending transformers to oriented object detection presents three main issues: 1) objects rotate arbitrarily, necessitating the encoding of angles along with position and size; 2) the geometric relations of oriented objects are lacking in self-attention, due to the absence of interaction between content and positional queries; and 3) oriented objects cause misalignment, mainly between values and positional queries in cross-attention, making accurate classification and localization difficult. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end transformer-based oriented object detector, consisting of three dedicated modules to address these issues. First, Gaussian positional encoding is proposed to encode the angle, position, and size of oriented boxes using Gaussian distributions. Second, Wasserstein self-attention is proposed to introduce geometric relations and facilitate interaction between content and positional queries by utilizing Gaussian Wasserstein distance scores. Third, oriented cross-attention is proposed to align values and positional queries by rotating sampling points around the positional query according to their angles. Experiments on six datasets DIOR-R, a series of DOTA, HRSC2016 and ICDAR2015 show the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with previous end-to-end detectors, the OrientedFormer gains 1.16 and 1.21 AP$_{50}$ on DIOR-R and DOTA-v1.0 respectively, while reducing training epochs from 3$\times$ to 1$\times$. The codes are available at https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/ai4rs and https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/OrientedFormer.
papers.comment: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS 2024) ESI Highly Cited Paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OrientedFormer 把端到端 Transformer 直接改造为遥感旋转目标检测器：用 Gaussian positional encoding 编码角度/位置/尺寸，用 Wasserstein self-attention 引入几何关系，用 oriented cross-attention 按角度旋转采样点对齐 value 与位置 query。在 DIOR-R 与 DOTA-v1.0 上相对已有端到端检测器 AP50 分别提升 1.16 与 1.21，训练轮次从 3× 降到 1×。
Motivation: 直接把 Transformer 用于旋转目标检测会遇到三个问题：任意旋转需要编码角度、self-attention 缺少内容与位置 query 交互带来的几何关系、cross-attention 中 value 与位置 query 错位导致分类定位不准。
Method: 三个专用模块：Gaussian positional encoding 用高斯分布编码旋转框的角度、位置与尺寸；Wasserstein self-attention 用 Gaussian Wasserstein 距离分数建立几何关系并促进内容与位置 query 交互；oriented cross-attention 按位置 query 的角度旋转采样点以对齐 value 与位置 query。
Result: 在 DIOR-R 与 DOTA-v1.0 上相对先前端到端检测器 AP50 分别提升 1.16 与 1.21，训练轮次由 3× 减至 1×；实验覆盖 DIOR-R、DOTA 系列、HRSC2016、ICDAR2015 共六个数据集。
Conclusion: 把角度编码、几何自注意力与旋转交叉注意力做成三个专用模块，可在减少训练轮次的同时提升遥感旋转目标检测精度。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Survey on Reinforcement Learning Applications in SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) allows a mobile robot or autonomous vehicle to build a map of an unknown environment while estimating its own pose within that map. Reinforcement learning (RL), in which an agent learns a decision policy from interaction and reward, has been applied to decide how such systems move, explore, and recognize places they have visited before. This survey reviews the applications of RL in SLAM. We first distinguish passive SLAM, in which the robot's motion is not chosen by the SLAM system, from active SLAM, in which it is, and summarize the sensors that provide the input to SLAM. We then introduce the RL methods used in this literature, from value-based and policy-based methods to actor-critic and deep RL. Next, we classify RL applications in SLAM into three categories: path planning, including environment exploration and obstacle avoidance; loop closure detection; and active SLAM. Thirteen representative studies are compared in terms of their simulation environment, deep learning method, SLAM method, and RL algorithm. Most of these studies are evaluated mainly in simulation, and value-based methods from the deep Q-network family are the most common. Finally, we discuss the challenges of applying RL to SLAM, namely computational demands, safety, generalization, high-dimensional state and action spaces, sample efficiency, and sensor and actuator delays, and we outline directions for future research.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Machine Learning and Deep Learning 1(1), 20-31 (2024)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述强化学习在 SLAM 中的应用，把文献按路径规划（含环境探索与避障）、回环检测 (loop closure detection)、主动 SLAM 三类归档，并区分被动 SLAM 与主动 SLAM。所比较的 13 项代表性研究大多只在仿真中评估，且以 DQN 系列 value-based 方法为主；作者列出的落地障碍是算力、安全、泛化、高维状态与动作空间、样本效率以及传感器与执行器延迟。
Motivation: RL 与 SLAM 的交叉文献分散在不同任务与算法族中，缺少统一分类与可比维度，难以判断哪些 RL 方法真正支撑移动机器人或自动驾驶的定位建图。
Method: 综述先区分被动 SLAM 与主动 SLAM 并梳理 SLAM 的传感器输入，再按 value-based、policy-based、actor-critic 与 deep RL 介绍所用方法，最后把 RL 应用归为路径规划、回环检测、主动 SLAM 三类，从仿真环境、深度学习方法、SLAM 方法、RL 算法四个维度对比 13 项代表性研究。
Result: 13 项代表性研究中大多数仅在仿真环境里评估；使用最频繁的是 DQN 系列的 value-based 方法。综述归纳出六项挑战：计算需求、安全性、泛化、高维状态与动作空间、样本效率、传感器与执行器延迟。
Conclusion: RL 在 SLAM 中的应用仍以仿真验证和 DQN 类算法为主，走向真实部署需先解决算力、安全、样本效率与传感执行延迟这几项被点名的障碍。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Multimodal Feature Distillation with Mamba-Transformer Network for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Incomplete Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Existing brain tumor segmentation methods usually utilize multiple Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) modalities in brain tumor images for segmentation, which can achieve better segmentation performance. However, in clinical applications, some modalities are often missing due to resource constraints, resulting in significant performance degradation for methods that rely on complete modality segmentation. In this paper, we propose a Multimodal feature distillation with Mamba-Transformer hybrid network (MMTSeg) for accurate brain tumor segmentation with missing modalities. We first employ a Multimodal Feature Distillation (MFD) module to distill feature-level multimodal knowledge into different unimodalities to extract complete modality information. We further develop an Unimodal Feature Enhancement (UFE) module to model the semantic relationship between global and local information. Finally, we built a Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module to explicitly align the global correlations across modalities, even when some modalities are missing. Complementary features within and across modalities are refined by the Mamba-Transformer hybrid architectures in both the UFE and CMF modules, dynamically capturing long-range dependencies and global semantic information for complex spatial contexts. A boundary-wise loss function is employed as the segmentation loss of the proposed MMTSeg to minimize boundary discrepancies for a distance-based metric. Our ablation study demonstrates the importance of the proposed feature enhancement and fusion modules in the proposed network and the Transformer with Mamba block for improving the performance of brain tumor segmentation with missing modalities. Extensive experiments on the BraTS 2018 and BraTS 2020 datasets demonstrate that the proposed MMTSeg framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when modalities are missing.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Trans. Artif. Intell. 7(9) (2026) 5076--5090
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MRI 模态缺失导致脑肿瘤分割性能下降，提出 MMTSeg：用多模态特征蒸馏 (MFD) 把完整模态知识灌入单模态，再以 Mamba-Transformer 混合结构做单模态增强 (UFE) 与跨模态融合 (CMF)，配合边界损失。在 BraTS 2018 与 BraTS 2020 上，模态缺失时优于现有方法。
Motivation: 临床中受资源限制常缺失部分 MRI 模态，依赖完整模态的分割方法性能显著下降，需要在缺失条件下仍保持精度。
Method: 三个模块串联：MFD 将特征级多模态知识蒸馏到各单模态以补全模态信息；UFE 建模全局与局部语义关系；CMF 显式对齐跨模态全局相关，即使模态缺失也成立。UFE 与 CMF 内部用 Mamba-Transformer 混合结构捕获长程依赖，分割损失采用 boundary-wise loss 最小化边界距离差异。
Result: 在 BraTS 2018 与 BraTS 2020 上，模态缺失设置下优于 state-of-the-art 方法；消融实验表明特征增强与融合模块、以及 Transformer 与 Mamba block 的组合对缺失模态分割性能有提升作用。
Conclusion: 把多模态知识蒸馏到单模态、再用 Mamba-Transformer 显式对齐跨模态相关，可以在 MRI 模态不全时维持脑肿瘤分割精度。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 三个模块串联：MFD 将特征级多模态知识蒸馏到各单模态以补全模态信息；UFE 建模全局与局部语义关系；CMF 显式对齐跨模态全局相关，即使模态缺失也成立。UFE 与 CMF 内部用 Mamba-Transformer 混合结构捕获长程依赖，分割损失采用 boundary-wise loss 最小化边界距离差异。
summary_sections.result: 在 BraTS 2018 与 BraTS 2020 上，模态缺失设置下优于 state-of-the-art 方法；消融实验表明特征增强与融合模块、以及 Transformer 与 Mamba block 的组合对缺失模态分割性能有提升作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把多模态知识蒸馏到单模态、再用 Mamba-Transformer 显式对齐跨模态相关，可以在 MRI 模态不全时维持脑肿瘤分割精度。

papers.title: ELiSe: Efficient Learning of Sequences in Structured Recurrent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Behavior can be described as a temporal sequence of actions driven by neural activity. To learn complex sequential patterns in neural networks, memories of past activities need to persist on significantly longer timescales than the relaxation times of single-neuron activity. While recurrent networks can produce such long transients, training these networks is a challenge. Learning via error propagation confers models such as FORCE, RTRL or BPTT a significant functional advantage, but at the expense of biological plausibility. While reservoir computing circumvents this issue by learning only the readout weights, it does not scale well with problem complexity. We propose that two prominent structural features of cortical networks can alleviate these issues: the presence of a certain network scaffold at the onset of learning and the existence of dendritic compartments for enhancing neuronal information storage and computation. Our resulting model for Efficient Learning of Sequences (ELiSe) builds on these features to acquire and replay complex non-Markovian spatio-temporal patterns using only local, always-on and phase-free synaptic plasticity. We showcase the capabilities of ELiSe in a mock-up of birdsong learning, and demonstrate its flexibility with respect to parametrization, as well as its robustness to external disturbances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELiSe 用皮层网络的两类结构特征——学习起始时的特定网络骨架 (scaffold) 与树突分区 (dendritic compartments)——在只用局部、始终在线、无相位依赖的突触可塑性条件下获取并回放复杂的非马尔可夫时空序列。在鸟鸣学习的模拟任务中展示其能力，并演示对参数化的灵活性与对外部扰动的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 循环网络能产生长瞬态但难训练：FORCE、RTRL、BPTT 靠误差传播获得功能优势却牺牲生物合理性，reservoir computing 只学读出权重绕开该问题却随问题复杂度扩展性差。
Method: ELiSe 结合学习起始时的网络骨架与树突分区以增强神经元信息存储和计算，仅用局部、always-on、phase-free 的突触可塑性习得并回放非马尔可夫时空序列；在鸟鸣学习的 mock-up 任务上展示，并考察参数化与外部扰动。
Result: 在鸟鸣学习模拟任务中展示序列获取与回放能力，并演示对参数化的灵活性以及对外部扰动的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 网络骨架加树突分区这两项结构先验，可让局部生物可塑性规则足以学习复杂非马尔可夫序列，从而绕开误差传播的不可生物实现性与 reservoir 的扩展性瓶颈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Training-Free Uncertainty Estimation for Embedding Models
papers.abstract_en: Embedding models, often obtained via self-supervised learning, extract general-purpose representations from data. Quantifying the reliability of these representations is crucial, as many downstream models rely on them as input for their own tasks. To this end, we introduce a formal definition of representation reliability: the representation for a given test point is considered to be reliable if the downstream models built on top of that representation can, on average, consistently generate accurate predictions for that test point across various downstream tasks. However, accessing the downstream data to quantify the representation reliability is often limited or restricted for various reasons. We propose training-free methods for estimating the representation reliability without access to the downstream data. Our method is based on the concept of neighborhood consistency (NC) across distinct pre-trained representation spaces. The key insight is to find shared neighboring points as anchors to align these representation spaces before comparing them. We provide theoretical justifications for NC and develop two practical approaches: (1) directly computing NC when multiple pre-trained models are available, and (2) a perturbation-based NC (PNC), which creates synthetic ensembles from a single model through isotropic Gaussian noise, avoiding the computational cost of training deep ensembles. We further propose PNC-spread tuning, which systematically determines the perturbation magnitude by maximizing the spread of the PNC scores on a reference set. We demonstrate through comprehensive numerical experiments that our methods effectively capture the representation reliability with a high degree of correlation, achieving robust and favorable performance compared with baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的表征可靠性估计方法：用跨多个预训练表征空间的邻域一致性 (neighborhood consistency, NC) 衡量测试点表征是否可靠，无需访问下游数据。核心是先用共享邻居点作 anchor 对齐不同表征空间再比较；单模型时用各向同性高斯扰动构造合成集成得到 PNC，并用 PNC-spread tuning 在参考集上最大化分数 spread 来选扰动幅度。数值实验中该方法与表征可靠性高度相关，相对基线方法表现稳健有利。
Motivation: 下游模型依赖自监督表征，但访问下游数据常受限，无法直接量化该表征对具体测试点是否可靠。
Method: 定义表征可靠性为下游模型基于该表征在各任务上平均能稳定准确预测该测试点；用共享邻居点作 anchor 对齐多个预训练表征空间后计算 NC；单模型时以各向同性高斯噪声生成合成集成得到 perturbation-based NC (PNC)，并提出 PNC-spread tuning 在参考集上最大化 PNC 分数 spread 来确定扰动幅度，附 NC 的理论论证。
Result: 数值实验中所提方法以高度相关性捕捉表征可靠性，相对基线方法取得稳健且有利的表现。
Conclusion: 不接触下游数据、仅靠跨表征空间的邻域一致性（含单模型扰动版本）即可估计表征可靠性，且避免了训练 deep ensemble 的计算开销。

papers.title: Advanced Policies: A First-Principles Path from Policy Gradient to Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: We apply entropy to reinforcement learning in two ways: entropy-augmented reward defines the soft objective, while relative-entropy regularization controls the size of a policy-improvement step without changing that objective. Together they yield a one-parameter family of advanced policies connecting a base policy to its soft-greedy policy. Under exact evaluation, every nontrivial member improves upon the common base, although the improvement need not be monotone along the family. Under policy-value consistency, this family forms an entropic mirror-descent path. We then relax this consistency, treating the policy and action-value function as independent coordinates of the advanced policy. Differentiating the objective of the advanced policy yields Advanced Actor-Critic (AAC), whose endpoint gradients recover soft policy gradient and an action-centered Q-learning-like update. We develop implementations for discrete and continuous actions. Experiments demonstrate effective learning at both endpoints and intermediate parameter values.
papers.comment: Substantially revised version. Corrects the earlier monotonic-improvement claim, develops a substantially revised formulation of Advanced Actor-Critic (AAC), and adds expanded theoretical analysis, continuous-action implementations, and substantially expanded experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把熵以两种方式引入强化学习：熵增广奖励定义 soft 目标，相对熵正则控制策略改进步长而不改目标，两者生成连接基础策略与 soft-greedy 策略的单参数族。放松策略-价值一致性后对 advanced policy 求导得到 Advanced Actor-Critic (AAC)，其端点梯度分别还原 soft policy gradient 与以动作中心化的类 Q-learning 更新；实验显示两个端点与中间参数值都能有效学习。
Motivation: 策略改进步长与 soft 目标之间的关系缺少统一的第一性原理框架，policy gradient 与 Q-learning 两类更新也缺少同一目标下的推导路径。
Method: 熵增广奖励给出 soft 目标，相对熵 (relative-entropy) 正则单独控制改进步长；在精确评估下得到连接 base policy 与 soft-greedy policy 的单参数 advanced policy 族，策略-价值一致时该族构成 entropic mirror-descent 路径；再把策略与动作价值函数当作独立坐标求导，导出 AAC，并给出离散与连续动作实现。
Result: 精确评估下族中每个非平凡成员都改进共同的 base policy，但沿族的改进不必单调；放松一致性后端点梯度分别恢复 soft policy gradient 与动作中心化的 Q-learning 式更新；实验展示两个端点与中间参数值上的有效学习。
Conclusion: 熵正则与 soft 目标可以解耦成同一 advanced policy 族的两个旋钮，AAC 把 policy gradient 与 Q-learning 统一为该族的端点梯度；早期版本的单调改进主张已被修正为非单调。

papers.title: What Must a World Model Distinguish for Planning?
papers.abstract_en: World models simulate the consequences of action candidates, but good planning need not preserve every physical distinction required for accurate prediction. We formalize this gap through a hierarchy of mechanism, response, and decision sufficiency. Given a candidate set, the planning query determines which physical variations matter and how precisely they must be preserved: coarse decisions can discard much of the information needed for prediction, whereas fine decisions may require nearly the same resolution. In practice, planners often adaptively search to construct candidates, and information unnecessary for final selection may still be needed to discover good candidates. What a world model must preserve therefore depends on the query, the candidate set, and the planner. We study these effects in a collision system, nonlinear dynamics, and robotic planning. These varying requirements raise a design question: where should query information enter the planning system? A model that jointly generates actions and outcomes conditioned on the query achieves lower regret than an action-conditioned world model on seen objectives, but this advantage largely disappears when generalizing to unseen objectives. Motivated by this, we propose a modular design in which the query determines where to look and an action-conditioned model predicts what will happen, allowing the same predictions to be reused across objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把「规划需要世界模型保留哪些物理区分」形式化为机制、响应、决策三层充分性层级：规划查询决定哪些变化重要、要保留到多粗精度，粗决策可丢弃大量预测所需信息，细决策则接近预测分辨率。在碰撞系统、非线性动力学与机器人规划上，查询条件化的联合生成动作与结果的模型在已见目标上 regret 低于动作条件化世界模型，但泛化到未见目标时优势基本消失，因此作者主张查询决定「往哪看」、动作条件化模型负责「会发生什么」的模块化设计。
Motivation: 准确预测所需的物理区分与良好规划所需的区分并不一致，而现有世界模型多按预测精度构建，无法回答规划查询到底需要保留哪些信息、以及查询信息应放在系统的哪个位置。
Method: 建立机制—响应—决策充分性 (mechanism, response, decision sufficiency) 层级，按查询、候选集与规划器的自适应搜索分析所需保留的信息；在碰撞系统、非线性动力学与机器人规划三类设定中比较查询条件化的动作-结果联合生成模型与动作条件化世界模型，并据此提出查询决定观察位置、动作条件化模型预测结果的模块化设计。
Result: 在已见目标上，联合生成动作与结果并以查询为条件的模型取得低于动作条件化世界模型的 regret；泛化到未见目标时这一优势基本消失。
Conclusion: 世界模型该保留什么取决于查询、候选集与规划器，而非固定不变；把查询信息放在「决定看哪里」的模块、让动作条件化预测跨目标复用，比把查询塞进预测模型更利于目标泛化。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Łukasiewicz Neural Networks Extended: Residual Architectures and Crystallization Strategies for Interpretable Rule Extraction
papers.abstract_en: A feed-forward neural network whose weights are integers and whose activation is the truncated identity implements, neuron by neuron, the connectives of Łukasiewicz many-valued logic. This exact correspondence --- established theoretically by Castro and Trillas and developed into a training algorithm by Leandro --- enables \emph{symbolic knowledge extraction}: training produces not a black-box model but a logical formula. Two obstacles have limited the approach to shallow architectures and small datasets: crystallization (forcing weights to integers) succeeds only probabilistically under the original Levenberg--Marquardt training scheme, and the theoretical guarantees break down as networks grow deeper. This paper addresses both obstacles. First, we prove that \emph{residual connections} (skip connections of the kind used in ResNets) extend Łukasiewicz neural networks to arbitrary depth while preserving the symbolic correspondence \emph{at merge neurons} by construction: merge neurons in a Łukasiewicz residual block automatically satisfy the neuron-classification proposition, regardless of the inner layer weights; inner-layer neurons are trained toward representability by the crystallization strategy. Second, we analyse three crystallization strategies --- Levenberg--Marquardt (corrected), straight-through estimation (STE), and proximal regularization --- characterizing their theoretical guarantees, failure modes, and interpretability trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Łukasiewicz 整数权神经网络扩展到任意深度：证明 ResNet 式残差连接在 merge neuron 上按构造保持「神经元=逻辑联结词」的符号对应，与内层权重无关；并对比三种 crystallization 策略（修正版 Levenberg–Marquardt、straight-through estimation、proximal regularization）的理论保证、失效模式与可解释性权衡。
Motivation: 整数权与截断恒等激活使网络逐神经元对应 Łukasiewicz 多值逻辑、训练直接产出逻辑公式，但原 Levenberg–Marquardt 方案下权重整数化 (crystallization) 只能概率性成功，且网络加深后理论保证失效，方法一直局限于浅层与小数据集。
Method: 理论上证明残差块的 merge neuron 自动满足 neuron-classification proposition，从而把 Łukasiewicz 网络推广到任意深度；内层神经元通过 crystallization 策略向可表示性训练。对三种整数化策略——修正 Levenberg–Marquardt、straight-through estimation (STE)、proximal regularization——逐一刻画理论保证、失败模式与可解释性权衡。
Result: 证明残差连接在 merge neuron 处按构造保持符号对应，无论内层权重如何都满足 neuron-classification proposition，从而支持任意深度；对三种 crystallization 策略给出理论保证、失败模式与可解释性权衡的比较分析。

papers.title: Low-Rank Single-Index Bandits with Unknown Links: From Matrices to Tensors
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank matrix and tensor bandits exploit structured interactions but typically assume a known reward link. Recent single-index bandit methods accommodate unknown links without directly exploiting matrix or tensor rank. We address this gap by studying stochastic matrix and tensor bandits with an unknown shared Lipschitz link and a low-rank index parameter under known regular candidate distributions and finite-variance noise. For monotone links, T-ESTOR combines robust, rank-adaptive Stein estimation with epoch-based greedy selection. Under exact selected-score access and a uniformly positive selected-design Stein signal, it achieves square-root regret with dimension dependence determined by the low-rank structure. For every admissible design, the monotone lower bound matches the rank, dimension, and horizon dependence up to logarithmic factors at large horizons, for fixed menu size and model/design constants. For nonmonotone links under a nonzero base-law Stein signal, T-BSTOR combines structured estimation with robust bin-based learning and attains the optimal $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ horizon rate for fixed dimensions, menu size, and model/design constants. Synthetic and CCLE-based experiments illustrate the benefits of structured estimation relative to vectorized and competing single-index baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究未知共享 Lipschitz link、低秩 index 参数的随机矩阵与张量 bandit：单调 link 下 T-ESTOR 用秩自适应 Stein 估计加 epoch 贪心选择达到平方根 regret，非单调 link 下 T-BSTOR 结合分箱学习达到最优 T^{2/3} 阶。合成与 CCLE 实验显示结构化估计优于向量化与既有 single-index 基线。
Motivation: 低秩矩阵/张量 bandit 通常假设 reward link 已知，而现有 single-index bandit 方法虽容忍未知 link 却不利用矩阵/张量的秩结构，两者之间存在空白。
Method: 单调 link 下 T-ESTOR 组合稳健、秩自适应的 Stein 估计与基于 epoch 的贪心选择；非单调 link 下 T-BSTOR 用结构化估计加稳健分箱学习。理论在 exact selected-score access、uniformly positive selected-design Stein signal（单调）或 nonzero base-law Stein signal（非单调）条件下分析，噪声为有限方差。
Result: 单调 link 下达到平方根 regret，维度依赖由低秩结构决定；对任意 admissible design，单调下界在大 horizon、固定菜单与模型/设计常数下与 rank、维度、horizon 依赖在对数因子内匹配。非单调 link 下 T-BSTOR 在固定维度、菜单与常数时达到最优 $̃O(T^{2/3})$ horizon 阶。合成与 CCLE 实验展示结构化估计相对向量化与竞争 single-index 基线的优势。
Conclusion: 把低秩结构与未知 link 的 single-index bandit 结合可在单调情形取得平方根 regret 且下界匹配，在非单调情形取得最优 T^{2/3} 阶。

papers.title: SRE-Marathon: A Continuous, Change-Driven Benchmark for Autonomous Site Reliability Agents
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarks for site reliability engineering (SRE) agents are typically episodic: one fault is injected, the agent receives an incident task, and its response is scored. Production operation is not. Incidents surface through noisy alerts, overlap in time, and often originate from code or configuration changes. We present SRE-Marathon, a benchmark for long-horizon, continuous SRE operation. An agent is invoked at a fixed cadence with cumulative alert history and a persistent workspace while operating a live two-zone Kubernetes deployment as a fault orchestrator injects overlapping faults according to a seeded, production-calibrated schedule. Curated code and configuration changes deployed through the same build pipeline available for repair. Each run is recorded into a sealed bundle and scored offline: Marathon-Score credits each injected fault for ordered progress through correlation, localization, and repair, with all metrics computed deterministically from recorded system evidence. Across three applications and about sixty faults per run, the best of 10 methods reaches only 41.3 out of 100. Agents often correlate and localize faults, but almost never complete repairs while the faults remain active.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRE-Marathon 把 SRE agent 评测从单故障 episodic 改成长时程连续运行：在双可用区 Kubernetes 上按种子化的生产校准调度注入重叠故障，agent 以固定节奏带着累积告警历史与持久工作区介入，Marathon-Score 按关联、定位、修复的有序进展打分。三个应用、每次约 60 个故障下，10 种方法中最好的仅得 41.3/100，且 agent 常能关联与定位却几乎无法在故障仍活跃时完成修复。
Motivation: 现有 SRE agent 基准是 episodic 的：注入一个故障、下发事件任务、打分一次；而生产环境告警嘈杂、故障在时间上重叠、且常源于代码或配置变更，这种评测测不到持续运维能力。
Method: agent 以固定节奏被调用，输入为累积告警历史与持久工作区，操作一个 live 双可用区 Kubernetes 部署；故障编排器按种子化、生产校准的调度注入重叠故障，同时通过同一构建流水线下发可供修复的代码与配置变更。每次运行录成 sealed bundle 后离线打分，Marathon-Score 对每个注入故障按关联、定位、修复的有序进展给分，全部指标从记录的系统证据确定性计算。
Result: 在三个应用、每次运行约 60 个故障的设置下，10 种方法中最好的仅达到 41.3/100。agent 通常能完成故障关联与定位，但几乎从不在故障仍活跃时完成修复。
Conclusion: 连续、变更驱动的评测暴露出当前 SRE agent 的短板集中在修复闭环而非关联定位：长时程重叠故障下修复完成率才是瓶颈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decentralized Optimization with Cross-Coupled Mixed Affine Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized optimization with cross-coupled mixed affine constraints, where local and shared variables interact through two affine channels. We show that the intrinsic difficulty of combining separately well-conditioned channels is governed by their Friedrichs angle. This geometry induces a cross-coupling factor that cannot be removed by channelwise preconditioning and governs the additional affine-oracle and communication complexity. We develop an accelerated decentralized method with matching minimax guarantees in the smooth strongly convex regime and extend the framework to smooth and nonsmooth convex objectives. Experiments confirm the predicted dependence on cross-channel geometry and network conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究局部变量与共享变量经两条 affine 通道耦合的分散式优化，证明两通道即便各自条件数良好，其组合难度仍由 Friedrichs 角决定，由此诱导出通道级预条件无法消除的 cross-coupling 因子，该因子支配额外的 affine oracle 与通信复杂度。提出加速分散式方法，在光滑强凸情形给出匹配的 minimax 保证，并扩展到光滑与非光滑凸目标；实验验证了复杂度对跨通道几何与网络条件数的预测依赖。
Motivation: 分散式优化中两条各自良态的 affine 约束通道耦合后会出现无法通过分通道预条件消除的额外复杂度，此前缺少刻画这一内在难度的几何量与对应的最优算法界。
Method: 以 Friedrichs 角刻画两 affine 通道的几何，导出 cross-coupling 因子并纳入复杂度分析；据此设计加速分散式算法，处理含局部与共享变量的 mixed affine 约束，覆盖光滑强凸、光滑凸与非光滑凸三类目标。
Result: 在光滑强凸情形给出与 minimax 下界匹配的 affine oracle 与通信复杂度保证，并扩展至光滑与非光滑凸目标；实验确认复杂度随跨通道几何（Friedrichs 角诱导的耦合因子）与网络条件数变化的预测依赖。
Conclusion: cross-coupled affine 约束的额外难度是几何性的、由 Friedrichs 角决定且不能靠通道级预条件消除，所提加速方法在光滑强凸下达到 minimax 最优。

papers.title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at https://github.com/joaolcguerreiro/RDIM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出残差扩散隐式模型 (RDIM)，把前向扩散建在 HQ 与 LQ 图像的残差上而非纯高斯噪声，使生成过程与真实退化对齐；推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器可跳过中间时间步，配合可调控方差机制在确定性与随机采样之间插值。在去噪与超分辨率基准上，RDIM 以常仅一步的采样在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 上持续优于 bridge 与 consistency 模型，同时减少长扩散链的幻觉。
Motivation: 逆问题中从纯高斯噪声初始化与真实退化不匹配；diffusion bridge 的端点约束要求长反向过程易产生幻觉，consistency model 虽可一步映射但缺乏方差建模、在严重损坏下退化。
Method: RDIM 显式建模 HQ–LQ 图像残差作为前向过程；推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器以跳过中间时间步实现少步乃至单步重建；引入可调控方差机制在确定性与随机采样间插值，并支持直接使用感知损失 (perceptual losses)。
Result: 在去噪与超分辨率基准上，RDIM 在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 上持续超越包括 bridge 与 consistency 模型在内的 SOTA，同时减少幻觉，采样步数常只需一步。
Conclusion: 把扩散的前向过程对齐到实际图像退化并配非马尔可夫少步采样，可在极少步数下同时保住保真度与多样性，使 RDIM 成为广谱图像修复任务的高效方案。

papers.title: Trust and Task Completion in the World of Consumer AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Action agents do things for people. They send email, spend money, and call businesses while the user is busy with something else, so a mistake can turn into an action before anyone notices. They fail their users in two ways. They break trust when they do something the user never agreed to, or hold back after the user clearly said go. And they fall short on completion when they give up on errands that turn out to be hard. Both depend heavily on the harness around the model, meaning its instructions, tools, context, and guardrails. We built an evaluation that scores trust and completion on the same runs, in a simulated world of businesses with their own websites, inboxes, and phone lines, and of people who write back. A simulated user answers the assistant's questions. Trust means that nothing happens the user did not agree to. No email goes to someone they never approved, no private detail ends up on a group thread, no money is spent past their limit, no stranger's instructions are followed, and nothing is claimed without a source. Every trap has a matched control in which acting is the right call. We use the evaluation to measure Fo, Wajo's personal assistant, against a base model with basic instructions on three foundation models, and against the Fo harness with its guardrails switched off. Fo completes 71% of the errands and keeps the user's trust on 94% of the trap runs. The base models complete 50% to 64% and keep trust on 59% to 75%. On the matched controls, Fo goes ahead slightly less often. OpenClaw, a popular open-source assistant given the same access, completes 42% of the errands it shares with Fo, against 71%, and keeps the user's trust on 74% of the shared trap runs, against 94%. Measuring trust and completion together, on the whole system rather than the model alone, is how we think action agents become safe to hand real work to.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Relative Generalization Invariance of LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining performance is jointly shaped by three components of the training triplet: the optimizer, model architecture, and training data stream. However, how these components influence performance in distinct ways remains unclear. We take a first step toward isolating their effects by studying relative generalization. We introduce Relative Generalization Invariance (RGI), the invariance of the validation-loss difference between any two tokens across models. We show that RGI approximately holds across a wide range of optimizers and moderate architectural variations, suggesting that these choices induce an approximately uniform shift in token-wise losses. In contrast, changing the training data stream can substantially alter relative generalization. We further show that RGI cannot be explained by the neural tangent kernel or mean-field regimes alone and prove that it can emerge in an overparameterized quadratic model. Overall, our work identifies RGI as a new phenomenon in LLM pretraining that helps distinguish the effects of optimizers and architectures from those of training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Relative Generalization Invariance (RGI)：任意两个 token 的验证损失之差在不同模型间保持不变。该性质在多种优化器与中等架构变化下近似成立，说明这两类选择只对 token 级损失施加近似均匀的平移；而更换训练数据流会显著破坏 RGI。
Motivation: LLM 预训练性能由优化器、模型架构与训练数据流三者共同决定，但三者各自如何不同地影响性能尚不清楚，需要一个能把优化器/架构效应与数据效应分离开的判据。
Method: 定义 RGI 为任意两 token 验证损失之差在模型间的不变性；在优化器与架构变化下检验其近似成立，并用神经正切核 (NTK) 与 mean-field 判别解释，另在一个过参数化二次模型中证明 RGI 可以出现。
Result: RGI 在广泛优化器与中等架构变化下近似成立，即这些选择对 token 级损失造成近似均匀平移；改变训练数据流则会显著改变相对泛化。RGI 无法仅由 NTK 或 mean-field 制度解释，并在过参数化二次模型中被证明可产生。
Conclusion: RGI 是 LLM 预训练中的新现象，可用来把优化器与架构的作用同训练数据的作用区分开：优化器和架构基本只平移损失，数据流才改变 token 间的相对泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TCMQA: A 38K-Question Traditional Chinese Medicine Benchmark with a Licensed-Practitioner Reference
papers.abstract_en: Medical benchmarks for language models are built almost entirely on Western biomedicine. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is a separate system, with its own diagnostic framework and its own literature, and it remains largely unmeasured. The few TCM evaluations that exist are small, narrow, and rarely paired with a human reference. We present TCMQA, an open benchmark of 38,279 questions from Chinese TCM licensing examinations, paired with 15,151 responses from 101 licensed practitioners. We evaluate 29 instruction-tuned models from 9 families, spanning 0.27B to 14.8B parameters. Accuracy ranges over 59 points, and no model approaches saturation. Pretraining data predicts TCM ability far better than scale: a 12B Western-pretrained model reaches 39.6%, while a Chinese-pretrained model an eighth its size reaches 60.8%. Nine models exceed the practitioner majority vote of 64.9%, the best by 21.8 points, and all nine come from that same Chinese-pretrained family. Yet difficulty does not transfer between models and practitioners: accuracy is flat across practitioner-rated difficulty, item-level agreement is near zero for all 29 models, and on $8.4\%$ of items the practitioners are correct where the leading model is wrong. We release the corpus, the practitioner responses, the harness, and per-item model outputs at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TechTCM/TCMQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TCMQA 是一个 38,279 题的中医执照考试基准，配 101 名持证医师的 15,151 条作答作人类参照。评测 9 个家族 29 个指令微调模型（0.27B–14.8B）后发现：预训练数据比参数规模更能预测中医能力——12B 西医预训练模型仅 39.6%，而其八分之一大小的中文预训练模型达 60.8%；9 个模型超过医师多数票 64.9%，最高超出 21.8 个百分点，且全部来自同一中文预训练家族。
Motivation: 医学语言模型基准几乎全部建立在西医生物医学上，中医有独立诊断框架与文献却基本未被测量；已有中医评测规模小、覆盖面窄，且很少配人类参照。
Method: 从中文中医执照考试构建 38,279 题开放基准，配对 101 名持证中医师的 15,151 条作答作为人类参照；评测 9 个家族共 29 个指令微调模型（0.27B 至 14.8B 参数），并发布语料、医师作答、评测 harness 与逐题模型输出。
Result: 模型准确率跨度 59 个百分点，无模型接近饱和；12B 西医预训练模型 39.6%，八分之一大小的中文预训练模型 60.8%；9 个模型超过医师多数票 64.9%，最佳超出 21.8 个百分点，且这 9 个全部出自同一中文预训练家族。难度不迁移：准确率在医师评定难度上持平，29 个模型的逐题一致性均接近零，8.4% 的题目上医师答对而领先模型答错。
Conclusion: 对中医而言预训练语料的语言与领域覆盖比模型规模更决定能力，且模型难度判断与人类医师几乎不重合，因此中医能力评测必须配人类参照而非只看总分。

papers.title: The Epistemics of Agent Memory: Measuring, and Governing, the Consolidation Decision in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents must convert accumulated experience into durable memory, deciding what to keep, compress, abstract into reusable skills and rules, or forget. We report a four-phase research program on this consolidation problem whose central finding is a shift in what is measured: from how much an agent remembers, to whether its consolidation decisions are any good, to whether those decisions can be trusted. Phase 1 learns episodic boundaries from agent traces by downstream utility; an honest near-miss (oracle correlation 0.691 vs a 0.70 bar) whose lasting output is a three-gate anti-leakage protocol. Phase 2 learns when to promote experience and to which abstraction level under a token budget, achieving a verified +22.7% task-success improvement with 7x compression, but exposing a degenerate-forgetting failure and a distribution-shift failure mode we name lambda-prevalence coupling. Phase 3 introduces ConsolidationBench, an oracle-by-construction benchmark that scores consolidation decisions against a known optimum on three non-circular axes; production retrieval systems retain information yet score zero on cross-level transfer. Phase 4 introduces governed consolidation: the decision wrapped in poison-resistance, reversibility, and auditability guarantees with a quality gate. Governance is statistically distinct from the quality score ($r^2 = 0.43$; partial $r = 0.27$; identical-quality policies differ threefold in governance), so the contribution survives independently of the metric's external validity. On that question we report a resolved negative: after a graded-reuse redesign removed a structural ceiling, a two-benchmark study with 2,532 real answer cells finds the quality score does not predict real transfer accuracy (pooled Spearman $ρ= -0.24$, n = 12, CI spanning zero). An adversarial self-critique pass cleared the final claim set with zero surviving overclaims.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 tables, no figures. A four-phase research program. Experiments executed and adversarially verified by PRIMA (arXiv:2605.24775); per-phase result files and preregistrations available to reviewers on request; certain mechanism internals held under controlled release (see Section 7)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文研究长程 LLM agent 的记忆固化 (consolidation) 决策，把评价重心从「记住多少」转向「固化决策是否可靠、是否可治理」。四阶段计划给出 +22.7% 任务成功率与 7 倍压缩，但也给出一个 resolved negative：质量分数并不预测真实迁移准确率（pooled Spearman ρ=-0.24, n=12, CI 跨零）。
Motivation: 长程 agent 必须在保留、压缩、抽象成技能规则与遗忘之间做决策，但现有评估只衡量记忆量，不衡量决策质量与可信度，且生产检索系统保留信息却无法跨层迁移。
Method: 四阶段计划：Phase 1 从 agent 轨迹按下游效用学习情节边界，并产出三门 anti-leakage 协议；Phase 2 在 token 预算下学习何时提升经验到哪一抽象层；Phase 3 提出 oracle-by-construction 的 ConsolidationBench，按三个非循环轴对已知最优打分；Phase 4 把固化决策包进 poison-resistance、reversibility、auditability 与质量门的 governed consolidation。
Result: Phase 1 oracle 相关 0.691 对 0.70 门槛（near-miss）；Phase 2 任务成功率 +22.7% 且 7 倍压缩，并暴露 degenerate-forgetting 与 lambda-prevalence coupling 两种失效；治理与质量分数统计上可分（r²=0.43，partial r=0.27，同质量策略治理差三倍）；质量分数对真实迁移的预测为 pooled Spearman ρ=-0.24（n=12，CI 跨零），基于 2,532 个真实答案单元的两基准研究。
Conclusion: 作者主张治理维度独立于质量指标的外部效度而成立，并把质量分数不预测真实迁移报告为 resolved negative；最终论断集经对抗性自我批评后零残留 overclaim。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Pair Count Is Not the Sample Size: What All-Pairs Agent Comparisons Estimate
papers.abstract_en: When an agent benchmark compares every pair of leaderboard entries, the number of comparisons can look much larger than the independent evidence behind them: A versus B and A versus C both reuse A. Whether this reuse affects inference depends on what the analysis is meant to describe. If the board and its outcomes are fixed, the all-pairs mean is an exact summary of those entries, and any interval must come from another declared source of randomness. If the entries are instead treated as iid draws from a population of future configurations and the pair rule is regular and nondegenerate, the same mean is an order-two U-statistic whose first-order uncertainty depends on the number of configurations, not the number of pairs. We use near ties as the running example, but the distinction extends to other symmetric pair summaries when their regularity conditions hold. We examine both interpretations using a fixed SWE-bench Verified snapshot and an exact binary model with known truth. On SWE-bench, intervals that accounted for shared configurations were more than twice as wide as a pair-iid reference that treated the pairs as independent. In the exact model, pair-iid coverage fell far below the nominal level when edges shared endpoints but remained near nominal for matched independent edges. Results on two other fixed leaderboards show that exact summaries also depend on which pairs are included and how they are weighted. An all-pairs analysis must therefore state what is fixed, what is sampled, and how it handles shared entries and pair aggregation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当基准对排行榜条目做全配对比较时，配对数远大于独立证据量：A-B 与 A-C 复用 A。若把条目当作未来配置的 iid 抽样，全配对均值是 order-two U-statistic，其一阶不确定性由配置数而非配对数决定；在 SWE-bench Verified 固定快照上，考虑共享配置的区间比把配对当独立的 pair-iid 参考宽两倍以上，作者要求全配对分析必须声明固定量、抽样量以及共享条目的处理方式。
Motivation: Agent 基准的全配对比较让配对数看起来远大于背后的独立证据，若按 pair-iid 做推断会低估不确定性，读者无法判断区间在描述什么。
Method: 区分两种解释：条目固定时全配对均值是精确摘要、区间须来自另行声明的随机性；条目为 iid 抽样且配对规则正则非退化时，均值是 order-two U-statistic，一阶不确定性由配置数决定。以 near ties 为贯穿示例，在固定 SWE-bench Verified 快照与一个真值已知的精确二元模型上检验两种解释，并在另外两个固定排行榜上考察配对纳入与加权的影响。

papers.title: Saturation-Insensitive Dueling Bandits with General Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual dueling bandits with general function approximation under the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) preference model. A key challenge in this setting is the saturation of the preference model: when the current reward model can already distinguish two actions with high confidence, the resulting preference feedback becomes weakly informative, making it difficult to further improve reward estimation. Consequently, existing sample-complexity analyses often depend on the inverse-derivative factor $1 / σ'[Δ_{r^\ast}]$ which can be prohibitively large when the link function $σ$ saturates for large reward gaps $Δ_{r^\ast}$. To address this issue, we introduce `SI-CDB`, an algorithm that selects opponent arms using a carefully designed heuristic for arm selection. This design enables saturation-insensitive reward learning and recovers the near-optimal dependence for linear reward classes, eliminating the unfavorable $1/σ'(\cdot)$ factor. The core of our analysis is a localized Eluder dimension framework tailored to dueling bandits with general function approximation. Our theoretical results also explain why two-arm regret analysis is crucial for improving single-arm performance in dueling bandits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 BTL 偏好模型的上下文 dueling bandits 中，当奖励模型已能高置信区分两臂时偏好反馈趋于饱和、信息变弱，SI-CDB 用专门设计的对手臂选择启发式实现对饱和不敏感的奖励学习，消除样本复杂度中不利的 1/σ'(Δ) 因子，并对线性奖励类恢复近最优依赖。
Motivation: 现有样本复杂度分析依赖 1/σ'[Δ_{r*}]，当 link 函数 σ 在大奖励间隔 Δ_{r*} 处饱和时该因子可能极大，导致偏好反馈弱信息、奖励估计难以继续改进。
Method: 提出 SI-CDB 算法，用专门设计的启发式选择对手臂以实现饱和不敏感的奖励学习；分析核心是为一般函数逼近下的 dueling bandits 定制的局部化 Eluder 维数 (localized Eluder dimension) 框架。
Result: 消除样本复杂度中不利的 1/σ'(·) 因子，并对线性奖励类恢复近最优依赖；理论结果解释了为何两臂 regret 分析对提升 dueling bandits 中单臂性能至关重要。
Conclusion: 通过臂选择启发式绕开饱和 link 导致的 1/σ' 代价，是处理一般函数逼近下 BTL 偏好反馈信息变弱问题的有效路径，两臂 regret 分析是改进单臂性能的关键。

papers.title: Model-Aware Data Selection from In-and-Out Information Interplay
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are effective representations that assimilate vast amounts of knowledge during pretraining, but post-training is necessary for models to reliably access this knowledge and "know what they know." We observe an interesting rank equilibrium between knowledge stored in the weights and the data stream passing through the model. Across all model layers, we find that the hidden states (data stream) follow a U-shaped pattern, showing substantial compression in early layers and a steep rise during the late-layer decoding phase. In contrast, the weight rank follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, with very low rank in the early and late layers and high rank in the middle. We interpret this as an in-and-out information interplay: intermediate activations do not need to carry content that the weights can supply later, so they primarily preserve what the weights cannot provide. Motivated by this observation, we propose a model-aware data selection method, CAP (Counterfactual Assimilation Profile), which can determine whether a data candidate contains information accessible to the current model by utilizing the divergence gap in early- and late-layer representations between model-generated and reference responses. Across math, code, and science domains, CAP delivers 35.4% greater average improvement over the base model than the strongest baseline under different selection budgets. With only 10% of the data pool, CAP surpasses or matches full-pool training on math and science. We further show that CAP transfers to multimodal data selection and is robust to response horizon and noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模型感知的数据选择方法 CAP (Counterfactual Assimilation Profile)：利用模型生成回答与参考回答在早期层和晚期层表征上的散度差距，判断候选数据是否含有当前模型尚不可得的信息。在 math、code、science 三域上，CAP 在不同选择预算下平均比最强基线多带来 35.4% 的相对提升；仅用 10% 数据池即可在 math 与 science 上追平或超过全池训练。
Motivation: LLM 后训练需要挑出模型尚未掌握的数据，但现有选择方法不利用模型自身的层级表征结构，难以判断候选样本是否真的包含模型缺的信息。
Method: 先观察各层隐藏态（数据流）秩呈 U 形、权重秩呈倒 U 形的 rank equilibrium，据此提出 in-and-out information interplay 解释；CAP 据此用早期层与晚期层上模型生成回答 vs 参考回答的散度差距作为选择信号，跨 math/code/science 三域在不同选择预算下筛选数据，并扩展到多模态数据选择。
Result: 在 math、code、science 三域、不同选择预算下，CAP 相对 base model 的平均改进比最强基线高 35.4%；仅用 10% 数据池时在 math 与 science 上超过或匹配全池训练；对 response horizon 与噪声鲁棒，并可迁移到多模态数据选择。
Conclusion: 权重秩与激活秩的互补分布意味着中间激活主要保存权重无法提供的信息，据此用层级散度差距做数据选择即可在远小于全池的预算下达到全池训练效果。

papers.title: A statistical theory for blind denoising: minimax estimation of the noise level from a single sample
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by blind denoising in diffusion models, we study estimation of an unknown Gaussian noise level from a single high-dimensional observation, assuming the signal law P is known. We characterize the minimax mean-squared error under two structural assumptions on P. For signals with covering complexity k, the minimax rate is $\widetildeΘ_Λ(\min\{Δ_Λ^2,d^{-1}+k^2d^{-2}\})$, and the constrained MLE attains it up to logarithmic factors. For $α$-strongly log-concave signals, the rate is $Θ_Λ(\min\{Δ_Λ^2,(1+α^{-1})^2d^{-1}\})$, attained up to constants by a $P$-centered norm estimator. These results show that the structure of the signal law determines both the difficulty of blind noise estimation and the appropriate estimator.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 1 figure. Under review at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在信号分布 P 已知、仅观测单个高维样本的盲去噪设定下，给出高斯噪声水平的 minimax 均方误差刻画：覆盖复杂度为 k 的信号类速率是 $~~Θ_Λ(min{Δ_Λ^2, d^{-1}+k^2d^{-2}})$，α-强对数凹信号类是 $Θ_Λ(min{Δ_Λ^2, (1+α^{-1})^2d^{-1}})$，并分别由约束 MLE 与 P-centered norm 估计器达到。结论是信号律的结构同时决定盲噪声估计的难度与该用哪个估计器。
Motivation: 扩散模型的盲去噪需要在不知道噪声水平时从单个高维观测估出它，但 minimax 难度如何随信号分布的结构（复杂度、对数凹性）变化尚无刻画。
Method: 假设信号分布 P 已知、观测为单个含未知高斯噪声的高维样本；对覆盖复杂度 k 的信号类与 α-强对数凹信号类分别推导 minimax MSE 速率，并构造约束 MLE 与 P-centered norm 估计器作为达到速率的估计器。
Result: 覆盖复杂度 k 下 minimax 速率为 $~~Θ_Λ(min{Δ_Λ^2, d^{-1}+k^2d^{-2}})$，约束 MLE 在对数因子内达到；α-强对数凹下速率为 $Θ_Λ(min{Δ_Λ^2, (1+α^{-1})^2d^{-1}})$，P-centered norm 估计器在常数因子内达到。
Conclusion: 盲噪声估计的难度与最优估计器的选择都由信号分布 P 的结构决定：复杂度类用 MLE，强对数凹类用 P-centered norm 估计器。

papers.title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAPEX 用多模态基础模型当自主示教者，按历史执行经验动态调整模型需要观察、推理与重规划的频率，把零样本操作轨迹蒸馏成可部署机器人策略。在 RoboCasa 任务与 Franka、双臂 YAM-arm 实机上，成功示教数提升 4.3 倍，单条成功示教成本下降 80%；用其数据从头训练的 Diffusion Policy 与 ACT 接近人类遥操作示教的水平，训练更久后差距基本消失。
Motivation: 机器人学习依赖人类遥操作示教，采集过程不直观、难扩展且异步；直接反复调用基础模型做零样本示教虽然可行，但物理执行中调用慢、贵，难以充当可扩展的数据生成器。
Method: CAPEX 是经验条件化的示教采集框架：利用先前尝试的执行经验，自适应决定基础模型何时需要观察、推理与重规划，从而减少调用；随后在匹配规模的人类遥操作示教与基础模型生成示教上分别训练 Diffusion Policy 与 ACT，衡量自主数据的下游学习价值。
Result: 在 RoboCasa 任务与 Franka、双臂 YAM-arm 平台上，以任务成功率、模型调用次数、token 用量、采集时间与成本为指标：CAPEX 使成功示教数提升 4.3 倍，单条成功示教成本下降 80%；用 CAPEX 数据训练的策略接近用匹配人类示教训练的策略，从头训练时更长训练可让该差距基本闭合。
Conclusion: 基础模型可以作为可复用机器人经验的可扩展来源：按执行经验调节其介入频率，能在大幅降本的同时产出对策略训练几乎等价的示教数据。

papers.title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
papers.abstract_en: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

papers.title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AliasForge：用定点重采样 (fixed-point resampling) 把预取整 resize 变成精确整数线性映射，构造视觉事实在接口处被证明丢失、但 step-correctness 标签相反的图像对，使任何验证器在两成员上输出分布相同、成对平衡精度恰为 1/2、语言侧修复零增益。在三个架构上构造认证对并再认证四个处理器，18 个计分对决策 logit 差为 0，18 个对照均非零。
Motivation: 视觉-语言验证器与路由器无法区分「多推理可修复的错误」与「视觉证据从未进入语言模型」的错误，因为标注者看原图而模型只看预处理张量，该区分缺少 ground truth。
Method: AliasForge 用定点重采样使预取整 resize 成为精确整数线性映射，把可翻转标签的扰动藏入其零空间，得到接口状态逐位相同而标签相反的图像对；再由 lattice 判据从 resize 配置直接判定碰撞是否可实现，并证明每个定点下采样器都存在此类零向量、给出最小尺寸界。
Result: 20 个筛查配置全部判定：17 个可构造、3 个不可构造；零向量最小尺寸界超过 255 时排除 8-bit 拟合。三个架构上构造认证对并再认证四个处理器，18 个计分对决策 logit 差为 0，18 个对照均非零；成对平衡精度恰为 1/2。自然样本上存在逐项路由余量，但没有任何被测的仅接口 router 优于直接停止。
Conclusion: 接口处的信息丢失可被精确构造与认证，其造成的路由余量有 fiber ceiling 上界，仅靠接口的路由器无法从中获益。

papers.title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.
papers.comment: 32 pages (10-page main text plus appendices), 4 figures, 25 tables. Under review. Code, checkpoints, and demo video: https://huggingface.co/HenryYHW/TriDrive
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TriDrive 用自动化条件化的 transition model 联合预报驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求，三路模态编码器经有向残差连接互相细化。在 AIDE 上运动学编码器取得 48.05 对 71.47 的 All-MPJPE SOTA，在 197.2 小时 BATON 上把辅助开启时的 steering onset PR-AUC 提高 0.084、TTC 下降提高 0.286；车载 comma four 加 8 GB GPU 上预警探针 5 Hz 更新、p95 延迟 177 ms，AUROC 0.725 对 openpilot 基线 0.563。
Motivation: 驾驶员监测此前把座舱内活动或交通条件下的驾驶员动作分开建模，缺少能同时预报 driver、vehicle、road 且可在车载实时运行的统一框架。
Method: automation-conditioned transition model：驾驶员用锚定运动学表示编码器，车辆用因果 CAN-bus 动力学编码器，道路用冻结 V-JEPA 2 latent 加结构化 road margins；三者经有向残差连接耦合，由 driver 与 road 上下文细化 vehicle 预报；道路编码器经蒸馏以支持车载部署，并配一个轻量当前状态预警探针。
Result: AIDE 公开基准上运动学编码器配方取得全集 SOTA，All-MPJPE 48.05 对已发表基线 71.47；197.2 小时自然驾驶 BATON 子集上，有向连接与 road margins 使辅助开启时 steering onset PR-AUC 提升 0.084、TTC 下降 PR-AUC 提升 0.286；comma four 加外接 8 GB GPU 上预警探针 5 Hz 更新、p95 延迟 177 ms，人工标注手动驾驶预警 AUROC 0.725 对 openpilot 基线 0.563；14 名驾驶员的配对路测中预警被评为更合适（+1.79）更及时（+2.67）。
Conclusion: 把 driver、vehicle、road 放进一个联合预报模型并用有向残差连接定向传递上下文，可在保持车载 5 Hz 实时预警的同时提升运动学精度与预警质量。

papers.title: Oracle Gaps in Reliability Coverage: Sampling Noise or Policy Specialization?
papers.abstract_en: Policies trained from the same base model can appear to solve different problems. An oracle that chooses the best policy for each problem may therefore appear much stronger than any single policy. Selecting the largest estimated success rate also selects favorable sampling errors. We study this effect through reliability coverage, the fraction of problems whose success probability reaches a chosen threshold. Our first test redistributes stored correctness outcomes across policies within each problem. A second also preserves each policy's total successes, accounting for overall quality differences under a specified statistical model. For five training seeds of a seven-billion-parameter vision-language model, redistribution reproduces 0.096 of an estimated 0.113 oracle gap at threshold 0.10. Neither test finds significant evidence at this threshold. Small advantages remain unresolved. Mixtures, routers, voting, and weight averaging show no detectable improvement over their corresponding single-policy baselines. Training policies on different datasets shows little detectable specialization under light post-training, and no router gain. A stronger recipe does create it, both tests detect it, and a router gain appears only at the high thresholds where the specialists separate. In a control with predictable specialization, a router recovers about half the oracle gap. Coverage bounds explain why even a genuine oracle advantage need not yield a deployment gain. The tests assess apparent specialization from stored responses before investment in routing. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/oracle-gaps
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对同一基座模型训练出的多个策略之间看似存在的 oracle gap，提出 reliability coverage（成功概率达到阈值的问题占比）框架与两种重分配检验：其一在每个问题内重排各策略的存储正确性结果，其二在保留各策略总成功数的统计模型下重排。对一个 70 亿参数视觉-语言模型的五个训练种子，重分配在阈值 0.10 上复现了估计 oracle gap 0.113 中的 0.096，两项检验在该阈值均不显著；混合、路由、投票与权重平均相对单策略基线无可检测提升，只有更强的训练配方才产生可被检验捕获的特化，且路由增益只出现在专家分离的高阈值处。
Motivation: 同一基座训练出的多个策略被 oracle 逐题挑选时会显得远强于任一单策略，而按最大估计成功率挑选本身就会挑中采样误差；需要在投入路由工程之前判定这种优势是采样噪声还是真实的策略特化。
Method: 定义 reliability coverage 为成功概率达到给定阈值的问题占比；检验一在每个问题内部重新分配各策略已存储的正确性结果，检验二在指定统计模型下同时保留每个策略的总成功数以扣除整体质量差异；再用 mixtures、routers、voting、weight averaging 与不同数据集训练作对照，并设一个特化可预测的 control。
Result: 在 70 亿参数视觉-语言模型的五个训练种子上，阈值 0.10 处估计 oracle gap 为 0.113，重分配复现其中 0.096，两项检验在该阈值均无显著证据；mixtures、routers、voting、weight averaging 相对各自单策略基线无可检测提升；轻度 post-training 下不同数据集训练几乎无可检测特化且无 router 增益，更强配方产生特化并被两项检验捕获，router 增益仅出现在专家分离的高阈值；在特化可预测的 control 中 router 恢复了约一半的 oracle gap。
Conclusion: 看似显著的 oracle 优势大多可由采样噪声与阈值选择解释，即便真实存在也未必转化为部署收益（coverage bounds）；应在投入路由之前先用存储响应做这两项特化检验。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.conclusion: 看似显著的 oracle 优势大多可由采样噪声与阈值选择解释，即便真实存在也未必转化为部署收益（coverage bounds）；应在投入路由之前先用存储响应做这两项特化检验。

papers.title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step agents are trained on flat action streams: SFT and RLVR weight every token uniformly and ignore the sub-procedures that recur across tasks, the hierarchy that lets humans plan top-down from reusable routines. This structure sits unused, and flat training uses each scarce trajectory less fully than its content allows. Recent agents do use that structure, but only as LLM-written skills in context, never in the weights, so their gains do not generalize beyond retrieval. We instead recover this hierarchy from the data itself and train on it, with no LLM calls. Following text tokenizers, which build a vocabulary by counting alone, we score action spans by reusability and merge canonicalized actions into a reusable eXperience tree (X-Tree). Each X-Tree node captures how a frequent and success-bearing skill is composed from sub-skills, guiding efficient generalization. We integrate X-Tree into three training settings: offline RL, with each node as a training instance; online RLVR, with an adaptive skill bonus; and on-policy self-distillation, with X-Tree as the self-teacher's privileged context. Across WebArena, ScienceWorld, and WebShop at three model scales, X-Tree improves over standard recipes at matched data and budget by up to 4.5% SR on WebArena, 5.8% SR on ScienceWorld and 4.1% success on WebShop. Matched analyses attribute the gains to the X-Tree structure and the three integrations.
papers.comment: Project in Progress. Homepage: https://sitaocheng.github.io/xtree/. Code: https://github.com/sitaocheng/X-Tree/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-Tree 从智能体轨迹数据本身统计并合并可复用动作片段，构建层级化 experience tree，把重复出现的子过程写进权重而非只放进上下文。在 WebArena、ScienceWorld、WebShop 三个模型规模上，同数据同预算下相对标准训练配方最高提升 4.5% SR（WebArena）、5.8% SR（ScienceWorld）和 4.1% success（WebShop）。
Motivation: 多步智能体在扁平动作流上做 SFT/RLVR，均匀加权每个 token，浪费了跨任务复用的子过程层级；已有工作只把 LLM 写的 skill 放在上下文里，收益无法泛化到检索之外。
Method: 仿照文本 tokenizer 的纯计数建词表，按可复用性给动作片段打分并把规范化动作合并成 X-Tree，节点表示高频且与成功相关的技能如何由子技能组成；将 X-Tree 接入三种训练：offline RL 中每个节点作为一个训练样本，online RLVR 中加自适应 skill bonus，on-policy self-distillation 中把 X-Tree 作为 self-teacher 的 privileged context，全程无 LLM 调用。
Result: 在 WebArena、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上、三个模型规模下，同数据同预算时相对标准配方最高提升 4.5% SR（WebArena）、5.8% SR（ScienceWorld）、4.1% success（WebShop）；matched 分析把增益归因于 X-Tree 结构与三种接入方式。
Conclusion: 把可复用技能层级从数据中恢复并写入权重，能在匹配数据与预算下提升多步智能体的泛化，且增益来自结构本身而非额外调用。

papers.title: What Should Data Teach? Moving Bottlenecks Across Circuit, Store, and Use
papers.abstract_en: What should data teach a language model at a particular point in training? A circuit view reveals three distinct bottlenecks: forming a computation, making its required content available, and selecting among available routes. A shared diagnosis-to-data principle connects them: localize the missing operation, preserve its causal relation, vary shortcut-bearing context, and re-audit the residual. Formation-sensitive selection and prerequisite ordering accelerate a binding-matching-transport path; a brief early prefix from the same training multiset retains a validation advantage through 100B tokens. Availability counterfactuals then distinguish writing content from invoking available memory, while paired supervision and context-opportunity ranking improve matched route decisions and long-context answer likelihood. A continuous 350M-model experiment connects the three interventions on the same facts: early circuit training improves subsequent learning, and the complete sequence outperforms stage-replacement controls on facts withheld from Use teaching. Independent query surfaces and opposed-source decisions expose conditional arbitration as the remaining frontier. Together, these results show why a change in the limiting operation calls for a change in supervision, not merely a new ranking of difficult examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把语言模型训练中的瓶颈拆成形成计算、提供内容、选择通路三类，并给出统一的诊断到数据原则：定位缺失操作、保留因果关系、变换带捷径的上下文、复查残差。在 350M 模型上，早期电路训练加速后续学习，三段完整干预序列在被排除出 Use 教学的事实上优于阶段替换对照；同一训练多集的早期前缀优势可保持到 100B tokens。
Motivation: 训练中不同阶段真正限制学习的操作不同，但数据构造通常只对难例重排序，不区分瓶颈类型，导致监督与实际缺失操作错配。
Method: 按电路视角区分 formation、availability、selection 三类瓶颈，套用同一诊断到数据原则；formation 用选择性与先决顺序编排，availability 用反事实对照区分写入内容与调用已有记忆，selection 用配对监督与 context-opportunity ranking；在 350M 模型上用同一批事实串联三段干预。
Result: formation 敏感选择与先决顺序加速 binding-matching-transport 路径；同一训练多集的简短早期前缀在 100B tokens 后仍保持验证优势；配对监督与 context-opportunity ranking 改善匹配通路决策与长上下文答案似然；350M 实验中完整干预序列在未参与 Use 教学的事实上优于阶段替换对照。
Conclusion: 限制性操作变了，监督方式就该跟着变，而不是只对难例重新排序；独立查询面与对立来源决策下的条件仲裁被作者指为剩余前沿。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Long horizon agent self-evolution without model weight updates is essential for enabling deployed agents to accumulate reusable skills and improve over time. Prior self-evolution work has focused primarily on short-horizon tasks, while repository-level software engineering remains unexplored despite being an ideal testbed for long-horizon adaptation. In this setting, agents are required to solve streams of sequential tasks, navigate complex dependencies with evolving repositories and persistently store and reuse experience. Text-based skill optimization offers an efficient, non-parametric approach for such adaptation. However, existing methods often suffer from unstable updates, performance drawdown, and agent collapse over extended deployments. In this paper, we formalize the concept of in-context self-evolution and introduce VALVE, a validated-gated framework for long-horizon skill optimization. We establish finite convergence, provide theoretical guarantees for future-task gain and drawdown, and derive the validation and evaluation holdout sizes required for a prescribed tolerance, with leading-order scaling Empirically, our pipeline, VALVE achieves stable self-improvement over evolution horizon spanning more than 1,000 SWE tasks, with average final and peak gains of $14.9$ and $16.5$ points across three frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude-4.6 and MiniMax-M2.7). The validation gate reduces average drawdown by 75% and produces an 11x more compact skill bank than ungated evolution. We further present extensive ablations identifying the design choices most critical to long-horizon skill evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VALVE：面向仓库级软件工程长程任务的上下文自进化 (in-context self-evolution) 框架，用验证门控 (validation gate) 筛选文本技能更新，避免无门控进化导致的性能回退与 agent 崩溃。在跨越 1000+ 个 SWE 任务的进化时程上，GPT-5.5、Claude-4.6、MiniMax-M2.7 三个前沿模型平均最终增益 14.9 点、峰值增益 16.5 点，回退平均降低 75%，技能库比无门控进化紧凑 11 倍。
Motivation: 已有 agent 自进化工作集中在短程任务，仓库级软件工程这类需要跨任务持久存储与复用经验的长程场景尚未被探索；现有文本技能优化方法在长时部署中更新不稳、性能回退甚至 agent 崩溃。
Method: 形式化 in-context self-evolution 概念，提出验证门控框架 VALVE：技能更新须通过验证门才写入技能库；建立有限收敛性，给出未来任务增益与回退的理论保证，并推导在给定容差下所需的 validation 与 evaluation holdout 样本量及其首阶标度。
Result: 在跨越 1000+ SWE 任务的进化时程上，VALVE 在 GPT-5.5、Claude-4.6、MiniMax-M2.7 三个前沿模型上取得平均最终增益 14.9 点、峰值增益 16.5 点；验证门使平均回退降低 75%，产出的技能库比无门控进化紧凑 11 倍；另给出消融实验定位长程技能进化最关键的若干设计选择。
Conclusion: 带验证门控的文本技能优化能在不更新模型权重的前提下，让部署 agent 在上千任务的长时程上稳定自改进，且回退与技能库膨胀都可被门控压住。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Entity Ranking under Iterative Synthetic Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: We study entity ranking and inference under the Bradley--Terry--Luce (BTL) model using pairwise comparisons collected over sparse comparison graphs. In practice, collecting high-quality human judgments can be expensive and time-consuming, motivating the use of synthetic data augmentation in model training. We analyze an iterative synthetic augmentation workflow in which synthetic comparisons generated from fitted models are successively added to the original dataset. In this process, the proportion of real data may vanish as the number of iterations grows. However, emerging literature has shown that recursive training on synthetic data can lead to model collapse, raising concerns about the statistical reliability of such augmentation procedures. To this end, we systematically analyze the resulting MLE in finite-sample, high-dimensional regimes. For the resulting iterative maximum likelihood estimator (MLE), we derive its optimal finite-sample $\ell_2$ and $\ell_{\infty}$ statistical rates and establish its asymptotic normality under natural identifiability conditions. We further characterize regimes in which model collapse is avoided despite the diminishing fraction of real data. We validate our theoretical findings through large-scale numerical experiments and an application to the Arena Human Preference 140k dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Bradley–Terry–Luce (BTL) 稀疏成对比较图上，分析迭代式合成数据增强后 MLE 的统计性质：推导最优有限样本 ℓ2 与 ℓ∞ 收敛速率及渐近正态性，并刻画即使真实数据占比随迭代趋零仍可避免 model collapse 的条件。理论结论经大规模数值实验与 Arena Human Preference 140k 数据集应用验证。
Motivation: 人工高质量成对比较采集昂贵，实践中用拟合模型生成的合成比较反复回灌训练；真实数据占比随迭代消失，递归合成训练可能引发 model collapse，其统计可靠性缺乏刻画。
Method: 在稀疏比较图上的 BTL 模型中研究迭代 MLE：每轮把拟合模型生成的合成比较累加进原数据集，再重新做极大似然估计；在有限样本、高维体制下推导 ℓ2 与 ℓ∞ 速率与渐近正态性，需满足可识别性条件，并给出避免 model collapse 的参数区间。
Result: 给出迭代 MLE 的最优有限样本 ℓ2 与 ℓ∞ 统计速率，并在自然可识别性条件下建立渐近正态性；刻画出真实数据占比递减时仍避免 model collapse 的体制；结论通过大规模数值实验及 Arena Human Preference 140k 数据集应用验证。
Conclusion: 迭代合成增强下的 MLE 在特定参数体制内仍保持可靠统计性质，即便真实数据比例趋零也可避开 model collapse，前提是满足可识别性与所刻画的速率条件。

papers.title: ReVision3D: Attribution-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement for 3D Medical Perception
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising path for overcoming the limited visual capability of current medical imaging agents. Yet applying RSI to volumetric imaging remains difficult: failures can arise from acquisition, perception, training recipe, or downstream inference, while self-generated feedback and logged trajectories provide little guidance on which component should change. We introduce ReVision3D, an RSI system that leverages 3D volumes with spatially grounded annotations to determine where visual evidence is lost and recursively improve the corresponding visual capability. A frozen language-model designer proposes revisions to acquisition, perception, training, or inference, while the verifier and system-level objective remain fixed. Our key insight is that an annotated volume forms an exact replay world for view rendering and spatial verification: unvisited views can be rendered on demand, and localized predictions can be checked directly against reference masks. This grounded feedback directs targeted revision, while only changes that improve beyond measured seed noise are retained. Each accepted change triggers renewed attribution, allowing the dominant bottleneck to shift across rounds. On abdominal CT, attribution identifies perception as the dominant remaining limitation. Revising that level enables ReVision3D to achieve 79% liver recall and 83% kidney recall at under 0.4 false positives per patient, outperforming the evaluated frozen multimodal foundation models, with the largest gains on small lesions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReVision3D 把递归自我改进 (RSI) 用到 3D 医学体积感知上：用带空间标注的体积作为可按需渲染视角、可对照参考 mask 校验的“精确回放世界”，让冻结的 LM designer 定位视觉证据丢失在哪一层并只保留超过 seed noise 的改动。在腹部 CT 上归因指向感知层，修订后在每患者假阳性低于 0.4 时达到 79% 肝脏召回与 83% 肾脏召回，超过所评估的冻结多模态基础模型，小病灶增益最大。
Motivation: 医学影像 agent 的视觉能力受限，而 RSI 难以用于体积成像：失败可能来自采集、感知、训练配方或下游推理，自生成反馈与日志轨迹无法指出该改哪一环。
Method: 以带空间标注的 3D 体积作为回放世界，按需渲染未访问视角并把局部预测直接对照参考 mask 校验；冻结的 LM designer 提出对 acquisition、perception、training、inference 的修订，verifier 与系统级目标保持固定，仅保留超过实测 seed noise 的改动，每次接受的改动触发新一轮归因。

papers.title: Feasible Flow Matching for Graph Reconstruction via Within-Sampling Primal-Dual Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Graph reconstruction from partial observations often comes with structural side information, such as degree bounds, triangle counts, or an edge-density band. Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM) reconstructs graphs by transporting a local prior toward the graph distribution, but it provides no mechanism to incorporate this side information. We put forth Constrained Primal-Dual PIFM (CPD-PIFM), which augments the sampler with Lagrange multipliers that evolve along each trajectory. The multipliers respond to constraint violations at a predicted endpoint and guide subsequent sampling steps without retraining. We prove that the sampler inherits PIFM's permutation equivariance and bound its expected terminal slack by a term that decays as the inverse square root of the number of steps, plus two approximation terms. On three link-prediction benchmarks and nine combinations of datasets and constraints, CPD-PIFM raises feasibility by 11-26 percentage points and remains competitive with fixed guidance without selecting a separate multiplier for each constraint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带结构侧信息（度数上界、三角形计数、边密度区间）的图重建中，CPD-PIFM 给 flow matching 采样器加上沿轨迹演化的拉格朗日乘子，在预测端点处响应约束违反并回指导后续采样步，无需重训练。三个 link-prediction 基准、九组数据集与约束组合上，可行性 (feasibility) 提升 11–26 个百分点，且不必为每个约束单独调乘子。
Motivation: 图重建常带度数上界、三角形计数、边密度带等结构侧信息，而 Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM) 只把局部先验输运到图分布，没有任何机制吸收这些约束。
Method: 提出 Constrained Primal-Dual PIFM (CPD-PIFM)：在 PIFM 采样器上挂拉格朗日乘子，乘子沿每条轨迹演化，根据预测端点的约束违反量引导后续采样步，全程不重训练；理论上证明采样器继承 PIFM 的置换等变性 (permutation equivariance)，并给出期望终端松弛 (terminal slack) 上界。
Result: 在三个 link-prediction 基准、九组数据集与约束组合上，feasibility 提升 11–26 个百分点，同时与固定 guidance 保持竞争力，且无需为每个约束单独选取乘子。理论上终端期望松弛以步数的平方根倒数 (1/√T) 衰减，另加两个近似项。
