papers.title: Adaptive Ensemble Selection for Noisy Labels on Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Incorrect or corrupted labels in tabular datasets can significantly degrade supervised learning performance, particularly when mislabeling is subtle and not easily detectable from feature space alone. In the context of automated or AI-augmented data science workflows, robust detection of such label noise is critical for building reliable models. We propose a data-centric reasoning module for AI data science systems that automatically diagnoses dataset quality and selects appropriate cleaning strategies. Given a dataset, a meta-model predicts weights over a diverse set of detectors, including confidence-based, neighborhood-based, and distributional methods. Across benchmark datasets with controlled noise, our approach achieves performance comparable to a Confident Learning baseline on average, with dataset-dependent gains and losses, particularly in heterogeneous regimes. We further show that detector effectiveness is systematically linked to dataset properties. These results demonstrate the value of descriptor-driven, data-centric ensembling as a component of AI-assisted data-science pipelines for robust dataset assessment and model reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对表格数据中难以从特征空间察觉的标签噪声，提出数据驱动的元模型：对置信度、邻域、分布三类噪声检测器输出权重，自动选择清洗策略。在含受控噪声的基准数据集上，平均表现与 Confident Learning 基线相当，增益与损失依数据集而异，异质性 regime 下波动更明显。
Motivation: 表格数据集的标签错误或损坏会显著拉低监督学习性能，且细微误标难以仅凭特征空间检测；自动化或 AI 增强的数据科学流程需要可靠的标签噪声诊断与清洗策略选择。
Method: 提出面向 AI 数据科学系统的数据驱动推理模块：先计算数据集描述子，再由元模型对一组异构检测器（confidence-based、neighborhood-based、distributional）预测权重，据此自动诊断数据集质量并挑选清洗策略。
Result: 在含受控噪声的基准数据集上，平均性能与 Confident Learning 基线相当，具体增益与损失依数据集而异，在 heterogeneous regimes 下尤为明显；并显示检测器有效性与数据集属性系统相关。
Conclusion: 描述子驱动的数据驱动集成 (descriptor-driven, data-centric ensembling) 可作为 AI 辅助数据科学管线中评估数据集、保障模型可靠性的组件，检测器选择应依据数据集属性而非固定单一方法。

papers.title: Physics-based logarithmic description of electrostatic field enhancement in hemisphere-on-cylindrical-post structures for high-field applications
papers.abstract_en: Electrostatic (ES) field enhancement at sharp conducting structures plays a central role in lightning protection, corona discharge, electrical breakdown in vacuum (for example in particle accelerators), and more generally in technological applications of field electron emitters. A canonical geometry for studying this ES effect is the hemisphere-on-cylindrical-post (HCP) model, in the regime where the structure stands on a planar conductor of large lateral extent, and a large gap exists between the structure and the counter-electrode. A parameter of major interest is the apex field enhancement factor (AFEF) (apex-ES-field/background-ES-field). For this (and other) structures, a formula for the AFEF can be written in the form AFEF = ASC x ASR, where the apex sharpness ratio (ASR) is given by the ratio (post-height/apex-radius-of-curvature), and the apex sharpness coefficient (ASC) depends on the post shape. For the HCP model, no exact analytical formulas for the ASC or the AFEF are currently known. (Quite possibly none exist.) This paper develops a compact analytical approximation for the ASC and hence for the AFEF. This compact formula has a logarithmic-style structure, rather than the power-style structure used in previous approximations. When compared with precise finite-element analyses of the HCP model, over the computationally accessible range 1 to 1000 for the ASR, this logarithmic-style formula has a maximum error-magnitude of 0.15 percent, which is significantly better than older approximations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 hemisphere-on-cylindrical-post (HCP) 结构的顶点场增强因子 (AFEF = ASC × ASR) 推导出一个对数型 (logarithmic-style) 解析近似，取代以往的幂律型近似。与精确有限元结果在 ASR 1–1000 范围内比较，最大误差 0.15%，显著优于旧近似。
Motivation: HCP 模型的 ASC 与 AFEF 此前没有精确解析公式，工程上只能依赖有限元或误差较大的幂律近似，而 AFEF 是闪电防护、电晕放电、真空击穿与场致发射设计中的关键参数。
Method: 将 AFEF 分解为 ASC × ASR（ASR = 顶点曲率半径分之柱高），针对 HCP 几何推导一个紧凑的对数型解析近似来给出 ASC，再与精确有限元分析 (finite-element analysis) 对照。
Result: 在计算可及的 ASR 范围 1 至 1000 内，对数型公式相对精确有限元的最大误差幅度为 0.15%，显著优于以往的幂律型近似。
Conclusion: HCP 结构的场增强因子在宽 ASR 范围内服从对数型而非幂律型标度，可用一个紧凑解析式高精度替代有限元计算。

papers.title: Distributed Hydrological Modeling in the Feature Space
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting of river discharge and floods is very challenging. River dynamics are affected by storage, meteorological forcing, and flow propagation at different spatial and temporal scales. Forecasting thus requires a framework that considers the upstream-to-downstream flow through river networks across grid cells and catchments. This modeling is known in hydrology as distributed modeling and routing. Existing deep learning approaches either ignore this topology, operate on lumped catchments, or route predicted physical quantities through a separate graph or physical routing model. We instead introduce feature-space routing: a topology-aware state-space operator embedded directly in the forecasting dynamics. At every forecast step, the operator gathers latent states from upstream grid cells and causally updates the downstream state according to the known river network. This preserves the physical connectivity of the river system while allowing the propagated state itself to be learned end-to-end and allows the model to predict river discharge considering both local dynamics and neighboring upstream contributions. To address uncertainty and provide probabilistic forecasts, we minimize the fair continuous ranked probability score (fCRPS) as a training objective. Our experiments on the European Flood Awareness System (EFAS) and observational data for river discharge forecasting demonstrate that encoding the physical structure of river networks explicitly in the feature space substantially improves the forecasting skill, particularly in an ungauged setting. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on both reanalysis and observational data and is able to forecast maps of river discharge at 1 arcminute and 6-hourly resolution up to 10 days lead time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 feature-space routing：把河网拓扑做成嵌在预报动力学里的 topology-aware state-space 算子，每步从上游网格收集隐状态并按已知河网因果更新下游状态，传播状态本身端到端学习。以 fCRPS 为训练目标做概率预报，在 EFAS 与实测径流数据上达到 SOTA，尤其在 ungauged 设定下提升明显，可输出 1 arcminute、6 小时步长、最长 10 天预见期的河川流量图。
Motivation: 现有深度学习径流预报要么忽略河网拓扑、要么只做集总式集水区预报，要么把物理量交给独立的图或物理路由模型，无法同时表达上下游连通与端到端学习。
Method: 在预报动力学中嵌入 topology-aware state-space 算子做 feature-space routing：每步按已知河网收集上游网格隐状态并因果更新下游状态，保留物理连通性且传播状态可端到端训练；训练目标为 fair continuous ranked probability score (fCRPS) 以给出概率预报。
Result: 在 European Flood Awareness System (EFAS) 与河流径流观测数据上的实验表明，显式在 feature space 编码河网物理结构显著提升预报技巧，ungauged 设定下尤其明显；在再分析与观测数据上均取得 state-of-the-art 结果，可预报 1 arcminute、6 小时分辨率、最长 10 天预见期的径流流量图。
Conclusion: 把河网拓扑直接放进模型的隐状态传播而非外挂路由，是径流与洪水预报达到 SOTA 的有效路径，且在无观测站点的流域更有优势。

papers.title: Self-Confirming Superposition Traps in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains representations on data selected by the agent's policy, which then uses the resulting returns to guide its next choices. We show that this loop can sustain a lower-return policy even when representation fitting is globally optimal on those data. In a self-confirming superposition trap, every optimal code assigns overlapping directions to features that rarely occur together under the current policy. An alternative action brings them together, causing interference that lowers its return and reinforces avoidance, although refitting to that action would yield more return at the same capacity. We characterize the dimensions admitting a trap in a tied two-step model and show separately that equal feature frequencies, continued visitation, and independent controller learning need not prevent it. Because fitting weights errors by visitation, an avoided action can lose its return advantage at little cost to the objective. In a finite-action model, we bound this distortion and derive a replay condition: sufficient training weight on the best separately adapted action preserves its ranking despite residual error. Neural PPO experiments show how the feedback develops during learning: agents initialized toward different actions develop different interference patterns, opposite mean return rankings, and different final policies at the same capacity. We therefore test whether retaining access to neglected states can improve control. Keeping these states in training reduces measured interference and improves sequential return, with gains even when the encoder is frozen. Related interventions on state access, replay weights, and feature overlap improve control on MiniGrid and DMControl. For agents that learn through a world model, protected fitting improves DreamerV3--Crafter's cumulative training scores at unchanged capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 强化学习中策略选择数据、表征又反过来决定回报，这一闭环会把低回报策略锁成自证式叠加陷阱 (self-confirming superposition trap)：当前策略下极少共现的特征在所有最优码字里方向重叠，换一个动作把它们拉到一起就产生干扰、压低该动作回报并强化回避，而按该动作重拟合本可在同等容量下拿到更高回报。保留被忽视状态的访问权能降低测得的干扰并提升序列回报，即使编码器冻结也有增益。
Motivation: 策略自选训练数据使表征拟合按访问频率加权，被回避动作的回报优势会以极小的目标损失被抹掉，导致容量充足时仍收敛到次优策略。
Method: 在 tied two-step 模型中刻画可容纳陷阱的维度条件，并证明等特征频率、持续访问、独立控制器学习都不必然阻止陷阱；在有限动作模型中给出失真界与 replay 条件（对最优单独适配动作给予足够训练权重可保住其排序），随后用 Neural PPO 实验观察干扰如何在学习中形成，并测试保留被忽视状态访问权的干预。
Result: Neural PPO 实验中，初始化偏向不同动作的智能体发展出不同干扰模式、相反的平均回报排序，并在同等容量下得到不同最终策略；保留被忽视状态进入训练可降低测得干扰、提升序列回报，编码器冻结时仍有增益。相关干预（状态访问、replay 权重、特征重叠）在 MiniGrid 与 DMControl 上改善控制；对基于 world model 的智能体，protected fitting 在容量不变时提升 DreamerV3--Crafter 的累计训练分数。
Conclusion: 回报排序的失真源于按访问频率加权的拟合而非容量不足，因此给被忽视状态保留访问权或加大其 replay 权重即可在不扩容的前提下保住更优动作的排名。

papers.title: Relic: From Multi-Agent Collaboration to Persistent Organizational Capability
papers.abstract_en: Multiple agents may often conflict in an organization: for example, one coding agent changes an interface in a repository, but another continues to develop on the old version where existing tests become stale. A conversation can resolve the episode, but when the participants change, what makes the lesson continue to govern the team? We introduce Relic, which turns recurring collaboration failures into organization-owned, executable protocols. Members reflect on visible work, propose rules, and govern their adoption. Adopted protocols bind triggers, responsibilities, required evidence, and execution consequences to the runtime, while remaining open to revision and retirement. In one traced case, repeated integration friction produces an interface-review rule that governs later pull requests and is revised as work continues. Across 360 controlled runs over ten software workloads and three models, Relic raises complete-contract delivery from 14.06% to 19.76% (+5.71 percentage points) over a matched structured team without the protocol lifecycle, improving all four verified production endpoints in every model stratum. Under fresh-member transfer, behavioral correctness is 25.4% with no inherited protocol, 34.6% with the same rules provided as readable text, and 41.2% with executable bindings, a +6.5-point advantage over text alone. On the full CooperBench benchmark, after excluding broken benchmark pairs, Relic achieves 367/477 (76.9%), establishing the best reported result among peer-structured systems. On the fixed 48-pair same-model subset, Relic also exceeds Solo (29/48 vs. 26/48), reversing the coordination loss exhibited by the official peer baseline. Together, these results show how collaboration experience can become persistent organizational state that remains useful beyond the members who created it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Relic 把多智能体协作中反复出现的失败沉淀为组织级、可执行的协议：成员反思工作并提案规则，被采纳的协议把触发条件、职责、所需证据与执行后果绑定到运行时，且可修订与退役。在 10 个软件工作负载、3 个模型的 360 次受控运行中，完整契约交付率从 14.06% 升到 19.76%（+5.71 个百分点）；新成员迁移下行为正确率从无协议 25.4%、纯文本规则 34.6% 升到可执行绑定 41.2%。
Motivation: 多智能体在组织里会因接口变更、测试过期等反复冲突，一次对话只能解决当次事件；参与者更换后，经验无法继续约束团队，协作成果随成员流失而丢失。
Method: Relic 让成员对可见工作进行反思并提案规则、共同治理采纳；被采纳的协议把 trigger、职责、所需证据与执行后果绑定到运行时，同时保留修订与退役通道。评测覆盖 10 个软件工作负载、3 个模型的 360 次受控运行，并在 CooperBench 全量与固定 48 对同模型子集上对比。
Result: 完整契约交付率 14.06% → 19.76%（+5.71 个百分点），相对带结构化团队但无协议生命周期的对照，且在每个模型分层上四个已验证生产端点全部改善。新成员迁移行为正确率：无继承协议 25.4%，同规则以可读文本提供 34.6%，可执行绑定 41.2%（较纯文本 +6.5 个百分点）。CooperBench 排除损坏配对后 367/477（76.9%），为同类结构化系统中最佳报告结果；固定 48 对同模型子集上 29/48 对比 Solo 的 26/48。
Conclusion: 协作经验可以转化为持久的组织状态，在原始成员离开后继续发挥作用；把规则做成绑定到运行时的可执行约束，比只提供可读文本更能带来新成员的行为正确性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Commit-Abstain Circuit: Why Language Models Hallucinate Instead of Abstaining
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) often hallucinate by committing to confident answers rather than abstaining, even when they do not have enough information to answer reliably. A large body of existing work mitigates hallucination through detection or abstention mechanisms, but leaves open how models internally arrive at the decision to commit or abstain in the first place. We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. Across ten LMs (3B-14B) from five families and three benchmarks, the CAC exhibits a recurring accumulate-yet-undercorrect pattern: commitment-promoting components build up commitment in earlier layers, while abstention-promoting components act later as corrective signals that are often insufficient to overturn the accumulated commitment. Building on this finding, a lightweight policy trained on CAC activations improves decision accuracy by 12.2 points over the model's intrinsic commit-abstain margin, reduces false abstentions by 2.5 times, transfers to unseen benchmarks, and extends to larger models (27B-35B). The CAC is both diagnostic, clarifying how models overcommit, and practical, enabling improved abstention decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用因果门控 (causal gating) 在 10 个 3B–14B 语言模型上定位出 Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC)，即决定「作答还是弃答」的稀疏、因果局部化的注意力头与 MLP 子层集合。其模式是 accumulate-yet-undercorrect：前层组件不断累积承诺，后层弃答组件作为纠正信号却常不足以推翻已累积的承诺，因此模型在本应弃答时仍自信作答，产生幻觉。基于 CAC 激活训练的轻量策略把决策准确率相对模型内在 commit-abstain margin 提升 12.2 点，假弃答减少 2.5 倍，并可迁移到未见基准与 27B–35B 更大模型。
Motivation: 现有幻觉缓解工作集中在检测或弃答机制，却未解释模型内部究竟如何做出「承诺作答还是弃答」这一决定，导致无法解释模型为何在缺乏可靠信息时仍自信作答。
Method: 把幻觉框定为 unsupported commitment（模型已呈现不可回答信号却仍承诺），用因果门控 (causal gating) 定位 Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC)——一组稀疏且因果局部化的注意力头与 MLP 子层；随后在 CAC 激活上训练一个轻量决策策略，替代模型内在的 commit-abstain margin。
Result: 在五个模型家族的十个 LM（3B–14B）与三个基准上，CAC 呈现一致的 accumulate-yet-undercorrect 模式；轻量策略使决策准确率相对内在 commit-abstain margin 提升 12.2 点，假弃答 (false abstention) 减少 2.5 倍，可迁移到未见基准，并扩展到 27B–35B 更大模型。
Conclusion: 幻觉源于一个可定位的电路级失衡：承诺信号在前层累积而弃答纠正来得太晚且太弱，因此诊断与改进弃答都可直接针对 CAC 进行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Clipped or Unclipped? Finite-Sample Trade-offs for Averaged SGD under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: Gradient clipping is widely used to stabilize training, but it need not improve the statistical accuracy of averaged SGD, even under heavy-tailed noise. We derive a finite-sample comparison of clipped and unclipped Polyak-Ruppert averaged SGD under finite conditional $p$-th moments, $p\ge2$. Our main result gives explicit accuracy and confidence conditions under which, for $p>2$, the Gaussian term dominates the unclipped deviation bound, so clipping need not improve its leading order. By balancing clipping bias and concentration, we obtain a bound in which the heavy-tail correction depends logarithmically rather than polynomially on the inverse failure probability. At $p=2$, this improves the confidence dependence of the leading bound. We establish sharpness of the unclipped heavy-tail term through an exact one-dimensional quadratic recursion and extend the comparison to projected convex SGD. We also prove concrete costs of clipping: every fixed finite threshold increases asymptotic variance on a scalar Gaussian quadratic, while whole-gradient clipping can shift the limiting point under asymmetric noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限条件 p 阶矩（p≥2）的重尾噪声下，对 Polyak-Ruppert 平均 SGD 给出裁剪与不裁剪的有限样本比较：p>2 时高斯项主导不裁剪偏差界，裁剪未必改善主阶；通过权衡裁剪偏差与集中性得到重尾修正对失败概率倒数只呈对数（而非多项式）依赖的界，p=2 时改善主界的置信度依赖。同时证明裁剪的代价：任何固定有限阈值都会提高标量高斯二次问题的渐近方差，整梯度裁剪在非对称噪声下会移动极限点。
Motivation: 梯度裁剪被广泛用于稳定训练，但在重尾噪声下它未必提升 averaged SGD 的统计精度；此前缺少裁剪与不裁剪在有限样本下的显式比较条件。
Method: 在有限条件 p 阶矩（p≥2）假设下推导裁剪与不裁剪 Polyak-Ruppert averaged SGD 的有限样本比较；通过权衡裁剪偏差与集中性得到界，并用一维精确二次递归证明不裁剪重尾项的锐性，再把比较推广到投影凸 SGD (projected convex SGD)。
Result: p>2 时高斯项主导不裁剪偏差界，裁剪未必改善其主阶；所得界中重尾修正对失败概率倒数呈对数依赖而非多项式依赖；p=2 时改善主界对失败概率的置信度依赖；一维精确二次递归确立不裁剪重尾项的锐性；任何固定有限裁剪阈值都会提高标量高斯二次问题的渐近方差，整梯度裁剪在非对称噪声下会移动极限点。
Conclusion: 重尾噪声下裁剪是方差与极限点上的代价换取稳定性，未必带来 averaged SGD 主阶精度提升；置信度依赖的对数修正是不裁剪（或 p=2）情形的实质改进。

papers.title: Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents tackle longer tasks, they increasingly compress growing histories of reasoning, actions, and tool outputs. Compression can reduce token use, but it also changes the information available for later decisions. Existing agentic harnesses bundle decisions about what to compress, when to compress, and how much to remove into fixed policies. A systematic characterization is needed to disentangle these decisions and reveal how each affects task success and execution cost. We systematically vary these decisions across three open-weight models on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 1.0. Across nearly 35,000 agent runs, we measure task success, token use, end-to-end latency, and estimated cost. We find that fewer tokens need not mean faster or cheaper execution: on Terminal-Bench with Qwen, policies using roughly one-third as many tokens can take 20-80% longer than the uncompressed agent. Policies with similar overall success can solve different tasks, while the same policy can perform quite differently across models. Our results motivate evaluating compression by its effects on agent execution and tailoring policies to the task, model, and workload.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究 LLM agent 的上下文压缩策略，把「压什么、何时压、压掉多少」三个决策解耦，在三个开源模型上跨 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 1.0 跑近 35,000 次 agent 运行。发现省 token 不等于更快更省：Terminal-Bench 上 Qwen 用约三分之一 token 的策略可能比不压缩慢 20–80%；成功率相近的策略解出的任务不同，同一策略跨模型表现差异大。作者主张按执行影响评估压缩，并按任务、模型、负载定制策略。
Motivation: 现有 agent 框架把压什么、何时压、压多少捆成固定策略，无法区分各决策对任务成功率与执行成本的独立影响。
Method: 在三个开源模型上系统改变压缩的三个决策维度，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 1.0 上运行近 35,000 次 agent 任务，测量任务成功率、token 用量、端到端延迟与估算成本。
Result: Terminal-Bench 上 Qwen 使用约为不压缩三分之一 token 的策略，端到端耗时反而增加 20–80%；总体成功率相近的策略解出的任务集合不同，同一策略在不同模型上表现差异明显；共近 35,000 次 agent 运行，覆盖三个开源模型与两个 benchmark。
Conclusion: token 节省不能作为压缩策略的唯一评价指标，应按对执行的影响来评估，并针对具体任务、模型和负载定制压缩策略。

papers.title: Environmental Impact of Generative and Agentic AI: An in-Depth Analysis and Green Solutions
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems has introduced computational demands whose environmental consequences are substantial yet underexamined. This paper examines the environmental footprint of modern AI systems across energy consumption, carbon emissions, water usage, and electronic waste over the full lifecycle of large language models, multimodal foundation models, and agentic workflows, from hardware fabrication and training through fine-tuning and inference to end-of-life disposal. This work provides a conceptual analysis, utilizing order-of-magnitude estimations based on published data, without conducting original physical measurements. We contribute a lifecycle taxonomy that crosses lifecycle phases with five impact dimensions and emission scopes; a Sustainability Assessment Framework for AI Systems (SAFIA) comprising nine indicators; a comparative analysis of traditional, generative, and agentic AI; seven open challenges; policy recommendations for regulators, cloud providers, hardware manufacturers, and AI developers; and a research roadmap to 2035. The analysis indicates that inference can rival or exceed training energy over a deployment lifetime, that agentic workflows can multiply the energy of equivalent single-pass inference by one to several orders of magnitude depending on the number of model and tool calls, that indirect water use and embodied carbon are systematically underreported, and that measurement tools, disclosure practices, and regulation have not kept pace with agentic deployment. These findings call for agent-aware energy measurement, lifecycle-based carbon and water accounting, and mandatory disclosure for large-scale AI training and deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文对生成式与 agentic AI 的全生命周期环境足迹做概念性量级估算，提出交叉生命周期阶段×五个影响维度×排放范围的分类法与含九项指标的 SAFIA 框架。核心结论是推理在部署期内能耗可追平甚至超过训练，agentic workflow 依模型与工具调用次数可把单次推理能耗放大一到数个数量级，而间接用水与隐含碳被系统性低报。
Motivation: LLM、多模态基础模型与 agentic 工作流的算力需求带来实质却欠研究的环境后果，现有测量工具、披露实践与监管跟不上 agentic 部署速度。
Method: 基于已发表数据做数量级估算的概念分析，不做原始物理测量；构建生命周期分类法（阶段×五个影响维度×排放范围）、含九项指标的 Sustainability Assessment Framework for AI Systems (SAFIA)，并对比传统、生成式与 agentic AI。
Result: 分析给出四项判断：推理在部署生命周期内能耗可追平或超过训练；agentic workflow 依模型与工具调用次数可将等价单次推理能耗放大一到数个数量级；间接用水与隐含碳被系统性低报；测量、披露与监管未跟上 agentic 部署。产出还包括七个开放挑战与面向 2035 年的研究路线图。
Conclusion: 作者主张采用 agent-aware 能耗测量、基于生命周期的碳与水核算，以及对大规模 AI 训练与部署的强制披露。

papers.title: DynamicDx: Evaluating Evidence Acquisition in Video-Based Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing a patient from video requires more than recognizing the sign: a vision-language model must turn what it sees into hypotheses, questions and tests. DynamicDx evaluates each step in 71 neurological consultations across 11 sign categories, linking authentic patient videos to confirmed diagnoses and fixed charts built from the same case reports, so that every model queries the same evidence. Across five such models, video improves accuracy by 9.9-22.5 percentage points over blind input, but neither recognition alone nor temporal order explains the gain: the cause is usually missing from the model's video-only differential diagnosis even when the sign is recognized, and shuffling the frames produces no reliable accuracy loss. Instead, a trajectory replay traces most of the gain to the investigation results the video prompts. Evidence acquisition is the bottleneck: supplying the decisive investigations raises accuracy to 73.2-93.0%. Two interventions act on it. A post-trained 4B video describer improves sign descriptions, especially from a short, densely sampled segment, and source-clean literature retrieval expands initial hypotheses; both bring the tests a model orders closer to those the treating clinicians documented and, through them, raise accuracy. For video-based diagnosis, seeing better helps when it leads to asking better.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynamicDx 用 71 例神经科问诊视频加固定病历，逐步评估视觉语言模型从识别体征到提出假设、追问与开检查的证据获取链路。五个模型上视频比盲输入提高 9.9–22.5 个百分点，但打乱帧序不掉点、体征识别本身也不解释增益；轨迹回放把增益归因到视频提示出的检查结果，直接补上决定性检查可把准确率推到 73.2–93.0%。结论是视频诊断的瓶颈在证据获取：看得更准只有在促成问得更准时才有用。
Motivation: 视频诊断评测通常只看体征识别，而从看到的体征走到假设、追问和检查这条链路缺少可比的证据环境，无法判断准确率提升究竟来自哪一步。
Method: 构建 DynamicDx：71 例神经科问诊、11 类体征，把真实患者视频与确诊结论、以及由同一病例报告生成的固定图表配对，使所有模型查询同一份证据；在五个视觉语言模型上比较视频与盲输入，用帧打乱与轨迹回放 (trajectory replay) 分解增益来源，并测试两个干预——后训练的 4B 视频描述器（用短而密集采样的片段）与 source-clean 文献检索。
Result: 视频相对盲输入提高准确率 9.9–22.5 个百分点（五个模型）；打乱帧序没有可靠的准确率下降；补上决定性检查结果后准确率升至 73.2–93.0%；4B 视频描述器改善体征描述，文献检索扩展初始假设，两者都让模型开的检查更接近主治医生记录的检查并由此抬高准确率。
Conclusion: 视频诊断的瓶颈是证据获取而非识别或时序：体征被认出时病因仍常缺席于视频单模态鉴别诊断，因此看得更好只有在促成问得更好时才转化为准确率。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Efficient Message Passing for Partial Differential Equation Priors
papers.abstract_en: Prior information for real-world physical quantities is most elegantly expressed via partial differential equations (PDEs). In this paper, we propose a novel way to solve PDEs using probabilistic inference on a factor graph. In general, factor graphs provide a natural way to encode prior knowledge into a model as explicit factors; here, this knowledge is provided by a governing PDE, which narrows the solution space, while observed data further shape the posterior over the parameters. The approximate parameter posterior is inferred using message passing based on moment matching, without posterior sampling or global gradient-based optimization. We demonstrate our approach on the first-order advection and the second-order semi-linear Fisher-KPP equations, where it achieves predictive accuracy comparable to a standard baseline while providing structured predictive uncertainty. Moreover, the inferred posterior marginal means and uncertainty structure match more closely those obtained using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo than the evaluated mean-field variational inference baseline, while requiring up to 10x less training time in our experiments, with inference speed comparable to variational inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用因子图上的消息传递求解 PDE，把控制方程作为先验因子、观测数据塑造参数后验，通过矩匹配做近似推断，无需后验采样或全局梯度优化。在一阶平流与二阶半线性 Fisher-KPP 方程上，预测精度与标准基线相当且给出结构化不确定性，后验边缘均值与不确定性结构比 mean-field 变分推断更接近 HMC，训练时间最多减少 10 倍。
Motivation: 用 PDE 表达物理量先验时，既要利用方程收窄解空间，又要从数据得到带结构的后验不确定性；现有变分推断均值场假设过强，HMC 又代价高。
Method: 在因子图上编码控制 PDE 作为显式先验因子，观测数据作为条件；用基于矩匹配的消息传递推断近似参数后验，不做后验采样也不做全局梯度优化。
Result: 在一阶平流方程与二阶半线性 Fisher-KPP 方程上，预测精度与标准基线相当并给出结构化预测不确定性；推断出的后验边缘均值与不确定性结构比所评估的 mean-field 变分推断更接近 Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC)，训练时间最多减少 10 倍，推断速度与变分推断相当。
Conclusion: 矩匹配消息传递能在不采样、不全局优化的前提下逼近 HMC 质量的后验结构，同时把训练成本压到变分推断量级。

papers.title: Constrained Flow Policy Updates: A Generalized Schrödinger Bridge View
papers.abstract_en: Online safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks policies that maximize reward while satisfying safety constraints. Reward and safety can induce multimodal action distributions, challenging the prevailing primal-dual methods: Gaussian actors may collapse onto a single suboptimal mode, and optimization over the nonconvex Lagrangian landscape can be unstable. Diffusion and flow policies can represent such distributions, but recent work with a diffusion actor relies on estimating and matching the score of an augmented-Lagrangian target policy. Instead, we differentiate the augmented objective directly through the generation path of a flow policy, so no score needs to be estimated. Because a flow policy lacks a readily available action log-density for entropy regularization, we build on the density-free kinetic-energy regularizer of FLAC, a recent reward-only method, and propose Reparameterized Augmented-Lagrangian Flow Actor with Least Energy (RAFALE), an off-policy actor-critic method for safe RL. We formulate its update as a constrained one-ended generalized Schrödinger bridge and show that, for each source draw, this path-space problem is exactly an entropy-regularized problem in action space. At positive noise, its solution reweights the reward-only action distribution only where the estimated cost exceeds a threshold set by the Lagrange multiplier. As the noise vanishes, the optimal value converges to that of a least-energy map objective that the flow policy optimizes directly. Across seven Safety-Gymnasium tasks, RAFALE achieves competitive reward with mean final cost within budget on every task, whereas strong baselines trade one for the other; ablations support the necessity of both its augmented objective and its flow actor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出安全强化学习方法 RAFALE：把带增广拉格朗日目标的 flow policy 更新写成约束单端广义 Schrödinger bridge，直接对生成路径求导，无需估计目标策略 score。正噪声下解只在估计代价超过拉格朗日乘子阈值处重加权奖励策略，噪声趋零时收敛到 least-energy map 目标。在 Safety-Gymnasium 七个任务上奖励有竞争力且每个任务的平均最终代价都在预算内，而强基线在两者间取舍。
Motivation: 奖励与安全约束会使动作分布多模态，Gaussian actor 会塌到单一次优模态，非凸拉格朗日景观上的原始-对偶优化不稳定；已有 diffusion actor 需估计并匹配增广拉格朗日目标策略的 score。
Method: RAFALE 是 off-policy actor-critic：沿 flow policy 的生成路径直接对增广目标求导，绕开 score 估计；动作 log-density 不可得，故沿用 FLAC 的 density-free 动能正则器。更新被表述为约束单端广义 Schrödinger bridge，并证明对每个源样本该路径空间问题等价于动作空间的熵正则问题。
Result: 在 Safety-Gymnasium 七个任务上，RAFAFALE 奖励有竞争力，且每个任务的平均最终代价都在预算内，而强基线在奖励与代价之间取一舍一；消融支持增广目标与 flow actor 两者缺一不可。
Conclusion: 把增广拉格朗日 flow 更新视为约束 Schrödinger bridge，可在不估计 score 的前提下同时守住奖励与安全预算；正噪声解按代价阈值重加权，零噪声极限落到 least-energy map。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在 Safety-Gymnasium 七个任务上，RAFAFALE 奖励有竞争力，且每个任务的平均最终代价都在预算内，而强基线在奖励与代价之间取一舍一；消融支持增广目标与 flow actor 两者缺一不可。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把增广拉格朗日 flow 更新视为约束 Schrödinger bridge，可在不估计 score 的前提下同时守住奖励与安全预算；正噪声解按代价阈值重加权，零噪声极限落到 least-energy map。

papers.title: Optimal Nonparametric Dynamic Pricing with Censored Demand and Adversarial Inventory
papers.abstract_en: We study online dynamic pricing with censored demand, where an arbitrary inventory level is revealed before pricing and may adapt to past observations, while demand follows an unknown, price-dependent distribution that is stationary over time. For a horizon of $T$ rounds, Xu et al. [2026] achieved $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under restrictive structural assumptions including linear demand, price-independent additive noise, and conditions relating inventory levels to the noise support. Our first contribution is to extend this framework to a substantially more general and statistically harder nonparametric setting, requiring only the natural assumption that expected sales are nonincreasing in price and allowing nonlinear demand curves and price-dependent noise. For this model, we first propose a simple baseline, Double-Grid-UCB, which discretizes both price and inventory and achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{3/4})$ expected regret using separate revenue estimates for each price-inventory grid pair. Then, we develop Threshold-UCB, which improves the expected regret to $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{2/3})$. Unlike Double-Grid-UCB, Threshold-UCB reuses sales observations across inventory levels through shared estimates of demand-tail probabilities, allowing the same data to support revenue upper bounds for multiple inventories rather than a single inventory bin. We also complement this upper bound with an $Ω(T^{2/3})$ lower bound via a reduction from stochastic posted pricing, establishing its minimax optimality. Finally, extensive experiments across inventory processes, demand functions, and noise models demonstrate consistently superior performance of Threshold-UCB over benchmark algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在库存自适应、需求分布未知且被截断的在线动态定价中，Threshold-UCB 通过共享需求尾概率估计跨库存水平复用销售观测，把期望后悔从 Double-Grid-UCB 的 Õ(T^{3/4}) 降到 Õ(T^{2/3})，并由随机 posted pricing 归约给出 Ω(T^{2/3}) 下界，确立极小极大最优。
Motivation: Xu et al. [2026] 的 Õ(√T) 后悔界依赖线性需求、与价格无关的加性噪声等苛刻结构条件；在更一般的非参数设定下，库存先于定价揭示且可自适应历史观测时，缺少匹配的最优算法。
Method: 先提出 Double-Grid-UCB，对价格与库存双重离散化，为每个价格-库存网格对维护独立收入估计；再提出 Threshold-UCB，用共享的需求尾概率 (demand-tail probability) 估计让同一份销售数据支撑多个库存水平的收入上界，仅假设期望销量随价格非增，允许非线性需求曲线与价格相关噪声。
Result: T 轮时域下，Double-Grid-UCB 期望后悔 Õ(T^{3/4})，Threshold-UCB 改进到 Õ(T^{2/3})，并通过从随机 posted pricing 的归约得到 Ω(T^{2/3}) 下界；在多种库存过程、需求函数与噪声模型上的实验中，Threshold-UCB 一致优于基准算法。
Conclusion: 在只假设期望销量随价格非增的非参数截断需求模型下，Õ(T^{2/3}) 是可达到的极小极大最优后悔阶，跨库存复用数据是达成该阶的关键。

papers.title: Synthetic Thermal Image Generation for Real-Time Animal Detection Under Low-Visibility Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Wildlife-vehicle collisions remain a significant road safety concern, particularly during nighttime and low-visibility conditions when RGB-based perception systems are often unreliable. Thermal imaging offers a promising alternative for detecting animals under poor illumination. However, the limited availability of annotated infrared animal datasets restricts the development of robust deep learning-based detection models. This paper investigates synthetic thermal image generation as a scalable approach for real-time animal detection under low-visibility conditions. A subset of 514 annotated visible-spectrum animal images from the NTLNP dataset is translated into synthetic thermal representations using CycleGAN-Turbo, while a limited real thermal dataset of 60 images is expanded through thermal-focused augmentation. Multiple object detection architectures, including YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and RT-DETR, are trained independently on synthetic and real thermal datasets and evaluated using precision, recall, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, model size, and inference latency. Experimental results show that synthetic thermal images provide competitive detection performance, with RT-DETR achieving the highest synthetic-data mAP@0.5 of 0.9613. Models trained on augmented real thermal data achieve the strongest overall performance, with YOLOv10s obtaining 0.9879 mAP@0.5 and 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95. Computational analysis further indicates that lightweight YOLO variants provide favorable inference latency, supporting their potential for real-time deployment. These findings demonstrate that synthetic thermal imagery can reduce dependence on scarce infrared datasets and support the development of efficient animal detection systems for future vehicle-mounted wildlife collision mitigation applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 CycleGAN-Turbo 把 NTLNP 数据集 514 张可见光动物图像翻译成合成热图像，并对 60 张真实热图像做热成像导向增强，独立训练 YOLOv8/v9/v10 与 RT-DETR 做低能见度动物检测。合成数据上 RT-DETR 的 mAP@0.5 达 0.9613，增强真实热数据上 YOLOv10s 达 0.9879 mAP@0.5 与 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95，说明合成热图像可缓解红外标注稀缺，但真实数据增强仍是性能上限。
Motivation: 夜间与低能见度下 RGB 感知不可靠，而标注红外动物数据集稀缺，制约了鲁棒检测模型的开发。
Method: 从 NTLNP 取 514 张可见光动物图像，用 CycleGAN-Turbo 翻译为合成热图像；60 张真实热图像经热成像导向扩充。YOLOv8、YOLOv9、YOLOv10、RT-DETR 分别在合成与真实热数据上独立训练，按 precision、recall、mAP@0.5、mAP@0.5:0.95、模型体积与推理延迟评估。
Result: 合成数据上 RT-DETR 取得最高 mAP@0.5 0.9613；增强真实热数据上 YOLOv10s 达 0.9879 mAP@0.5 与 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95，为整体最强。轻量 YOLO 变体在推理延迟上更有优势，支持实时部署。
Conclusion: 合成热图像能减少对稀缺红外数据集的依赖并支撑高效动物检测，用于车载野生动物碰撞缓解；就绝对精度而言，增强的真实热数据训练仍优于纯合成数据。

papers.title: The Key Handoff: Retrieval in Hybrid Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A two-hop question makes a language model retrieve twice: once to produce a bridge entity, and once to retrieve with it. Transformers resolve that entity in their early layers. Hybrid models replace most of the attention with a recurrent state, so where the key becomes usable, and where it is spent on an answer, is not known. Answering "Where is the ball?" from "the ball belongs to Alice" and "Alice is in the garden" turns on Alice, a name the question does not mention. A model could reach garden through Alice, the key it computed, or through where the fact sits in the prompt. Across twelve models, dense and hybrid, we move a hidden state from one story into another where the two routes lead to different places, and read off which place the model gives. An attention layer converts the key in every model we tested, and crossing that layer removes its usable effect, all of it where no attention follows. In sequential hybrids this makes the answer a handoff: recurrent layers carry the key forward, and attention spends it. Retrieval does not always stop there. Writing a different fact into the memory of the recurrent layers that follow the last attention layer can move the answer toward that fact, multiplying its odds by 1.3 to 2.7, and which hybrids do this is not settled by their architecture or training. That read is addressed by the key, not by position: recurrent state in a hybrid is not only a carrier, but a memory that later layers can query.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用跨模型的隐藏状态移植实验判定混合语言模型 (hybrid language model) 中两跳检索的 key 在何处变得可用、何处被消耗：注意力层在全部 12 个被测模型中转换该 key，跨过注意力层后其可用效应完全消失，答案因此成为递归层携带、注意力花费的 handoff。写入最后一个注意力层之后的递归层记忆仍能把答案拉向该事实，使其赔率乘以 1.3 到 2.7。
Motivation: 两跳问题要求模型先产出桥接实体再据此检索，Transformer 在早期层解决该实体；但混合模型把大部分注意力换成递归状态，key 何时可用、何时被用于答案尚不清楚。
Method: 在 12 个 dense 与 hybrid 模型上，把一个故事中的隐藏状态移植到另一个故事，使“经由 key”与“经由 prompt 中事实位置”两条路径指向不同答案，读出模型给出哪个答案；再改写最后一个注意力层之后的递归层记忆，检验其对答案的可查询性。
Result: 全部被测模型中注意力层都转换该 key，跨过该层后其可用效应完全消失，且在没有后续注意力处消失殆尽；向后续递归层记忆写入不同事实可使答案赔率乘以 1.3 到 2.7，哪些 hybrid 出现该现象不能由其架构或训练决定。
Conclusion: 在序列式混合模型中检索是递归层携带 key、注意力花费 key 的 handoff；递归状态不只是载体，而是后续层可以查询的记忆，且该读取由 key 而非位置寻址。

papers.title: Generative Priors Conditioned on Natural Language for Bayesian Inversion in PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Inferring quantities of interest (QoI) from data is a central task in Science and Engineering. In such contexts, we often have access to both quantitative data and qualitative data. Quantitative data may be represented by noisy sensor measurements, simulation data, re-analysis data; qualitative data may be in the form of text descriptions of experimental setups, expected experiment outcomes, and human-perceived system behaviours. The task we address in this paper is the following. Given a training set of paired qualitative text and quantitative QoI data, we learn to exploit the inherent correlation between the two modalities to learn a highly informative data-driven natural-language-conditional Bayesian prior, such that when presented with a new physical system, we can coherently combine (i) the training dataset, (ii) qualitative text describing the new system, and (iii) a small number of noisy sensor readings from that new system, to perform inference and uncertainty quantification (UQ) over the QoI. To achieve this task, we develop two parallel approaches, one uses conditional diffusion and the other conditional autoencoders, and compare both against classical Bayesian methodology, unconditional generative models and deterministic supervised methods. Each approach has specific strengths and tradeoffs; conditional autoencoder offers theoretical tractability, allows for fast posterior sampling, and provides better-calibrated UQ, whereas conditional diffusion is explored for greater expressiveness and capturing complex posteriors with irregular QoI fields. The approach is tested on the steady-state heat equation, damped Helmholtz equation, and UK weather reanalysis data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以自然语言为条件的生成式贝叶斯先验，从配对文本与定量 QoI 数据中学习，把训练集、新系统的文字描述和少量含噪传感器读数相干结合，对 PDE 的感兴趣量做推断与不确定性量化 (UQ)。两条并行路线——条件扩散与条件 autoencoder——在稳态热方程、阻尼 Helmholtz 方程和英国天气再分析数据上检验，autoencoder 换来理论可处理、快速后验采样与更好校准的 UQ，扩散换取更强表达力以刻画不规则 QoI 场的复杂后验。
Motivation: 科学工程反演中同时存在定量数据（含噪传感、模拟、再分析）与定性文本（实验设置、预期结果、人感行为），经典贝叶斯方法难以把两者相干地并入同一个先验并给出 UQ。
Method: 用配对的定性文本与定量 QoI 训练自然语言条件的贝叶斯先验，两条并行实现：条件扩散 (conditional diffusion) 与条件 autoencoder；推理时融合训练集、新系统文本描述与少量含噪读数。对照经典贝叶斯方法、无条件生成模型与确定性监督方法。
Result: 在稳态热方程、阻尼 Helmholtz 方程与英国天气再分析数据上检验；条件 autoencoder 具理论可处理性、后验采样快且 UQ 校准更好，条件扩散表达力更强、能捕捉不规则 QoI 场的复杂后验，两类方法各有取舍。
Conclusion: 文本条件生成先验可以把定性知识与少量观测相干地并入 PDE 反演的推断与 UQ；选 autoencoder 还是扩散取决于要校准与速度、还是要表达力。

papers.title: TwinS-GCN: Spectral conjugate for Spectral Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph convolutional networks propagate information by repeated local aggregation through a graph shift operator; i.e., a $K$-layer network reaches $K$ hops neighborhood. On the one hand, such spreading can lead to oversmoothing. On the other hand, long-range dependencies demand the depth. Transporting information on long distances and without attenuation requires the shift to distinguish a direction of flow, which a symmetric operator cannot perform but a directed one can fulfill. A natural way to extract pure-directionality is to take the skew-symmetric part of the shift operator through the Cartesian split, which, however, generally does not commute with the shift itself, meaning that the filters built on it are not shift-invariant. We instead use the spectral conjugate; i.e., the image of the operator under $τ:z\mapsto \bar{z}$, which commutes with the shift and splits it into a dissipative and a non-dissipative part. Two filter families follow: a sum filter, whose non-dissipative component transports signal without energy loss, and a ratio filter, ratio in the pair of components rather than polynomial in the shift. Both arise from non-holomorphic kernels, placing them outside the holomorphic class underlying classical spectral convolution. On the directed cycle, the ratio filter becomes an IIR filter with global impulse response, for which we prove a long-range reach gap against every degree-$K$ polynomial filter. Chebyshev reparameterization gives stable vertex-domain layers with real coefficients, yielding TwinS-GCN, which solves graph transfer tasks at reduced depth and is competitive with state-of-the-art graph convolutional networks on node classification benchmarks.

Motivation: K 层 GCN 只能覆盖 K 跳邻域，加深以获取长程依赖会带来 oversmoothing；而对称移位算子无法区分信息流方向，用 Cartesian split 取斜对称部分又与移位算子不对易，导致滤波器失去 shift-invariant 性。
Method: 以谱共轭（算子在 τ:z→z̄ 下的像）替代斜对称分解：它与移位算子对易，并把算子拆成耗散与非耗散分量；据此构造 sum filter（非耗散分量无能量损失地传输信号）与 ratio filter（两分量之比而非移位算子的多项式），二者均来自非全纯核，落在经典谱卷积的全纯类之外；再用 Chebyshev 重参数化得到实系数的稳定顶点域层，即 TwinS-GCN。

Conclusion: 用与移位算子对易的谱共轭而非斜对称部分来提取方向性，可以构造出非多项式、非全纯的滤波器族，在长程传输上突破多项式滤波器的深度限制。

papers.title: Theory of Scene: Breaking the Symmetry Trap in Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are largely homogeneous, as their agents behave alike even across distinct LLMs. We show that when such agents act concurrently without communication, they collide on targets they must split and diverge on targets they must take together, a double failure we term the symmetry trap. Theory of Mind (ToM), widely used for coordination without communication, cannot escape this trap, since homogeneous agents form the same prediction of one another and respond to it in the same way. We propose Theory of Scene (ToS), a training-free reasoning schema in which each agent reads its public role, the only difference between the agents, and the task context they all observe. Homogeneous agents thereby derive one division of labor, each taking the part its role fixes, which turns homogeneity from the cause of the trap into the cure. ToS reads the role together with the scene through role gating, which determines whether ownership overlaps or is already divided, and the task context through task coupling, which infers whether the team must converge on each target, divide it, or take its stages in turn. We evaluate on DivvyBench, a controlled environment we introduce, whose target types make an episode Competitive, Cooperative, or Mixed across Tabletop, Airspace, and Household scenarios, and on two established agentic benchmarks, GovSim and Overcooked. ToS outperforms all six baselines on every benchmark, and each baseline falls far behind it in at least one setting. Against ToM given the same inputs, ToS raises the DivvyBench success rate from 71.1% to 99.6%, the GovSim total gain from 207 to 400, and the Overcooked level-normalized throughput from 1.41 to 1.67.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体 LLM 在无通信并发协作时会同时犯两类错：该分工的目标上撞车、该合力的目标上分散，作者称之为对称陷阱 (symmetry trap)；Theory of Mind 因同质智能体互相预测一致而无法摆脱。提出的训练免调 (training-free) 推理框架 Theory of Scene 让每个智能体读取自己唯一的公共角色加上共同任务上下文，用 role gating 判定目标归属是否重叠、task coupling 判定该汇聚还是拆分，把同质性从陷阱成因变成解法：DivvyBench 成功率相对同输入 ToM 从 71.1% 升到 99.6%。
Motivation: 同质 LLM 智能体在无通信并发下既会在必须拆分的目标上撞车、又会在必须合力的目标上分散，而现有 ToM 协调机制因预测同质而无法破解这一双重失败。
Method: 提出训练免调的 Theory of Scene 推理框架：每个智能体读取公共角色（智能体间唯一差异）与共享任务上下文；role gating 判断目标归属是重叠还是已划分，task coupling 推断团队应汇聚、拆分还是分阶段接管。评测环境为自建的 DivvyBench（Tabletop、Airspace、Household 三类场景，目标类型构成 Competitive、Cooperative、Mixed 三种 episode），另加 GovSim 与 Overcooked 两个既有 agentic benchmark，共对比六个基线。
Result: DivvyBench 成功率相对同输入的 ToM 从 71.1% 提升到 99.6%；GovSim total gain 从 207 提升到 400；Overcooked level-normalized throughput 从 1.41 提升到 1.67。ToS 在全部三个 benchmark 上均胜过全部六个基线，且每个基线至少在一个设置上大幅落后。
Conclusion: 同质智能体的协调不必靠制造差异：让每个智能体按自身角色读取场景并推断任务耦合结构，就能在无通信并发下同时避免撞车与分散。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Impact of Stochasticity on the Rashomon Effect in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural network training is inherently stochastic, with factors such as weight initialization leading to distinct models despite comparable predictive performance. This phenomenon is commonly associated with the Rashomon effect, which describes the existence of multiple near-optimal models for the same task. Although the Rashomon effect has received increasing attention, it remains unclear whether different sources of training stochasticity contribute similarly or differently to its manifestations. In this work, we present an empirical study of the Rashomon phenomenon along three complementary dimensions: solution-space multiplicity, predictive multiplicity, and decision-basis multiplicity. These dimensions are quantified through the size of the empirical Rashomon set, predictive ambiguity, and agreement between XAI attribution maps, respectively. By independently controlling three standard sources of stochasticity, namely weight initialization, mini-batch data ordering, and dropout, we isolate their respective contributions to each dimension of the Rashomon phenomenon. Experiments on tabular and image classification benchmarks reveal that these sources affect the three dimensions in different ways. In particular, larger empirical Rashomon sets do not necessarily correspond to greater predictive disagreement or lower explanation agreement, indicating that solution-space, predictive, and decision-basis multiplicity capture complementary rather than interchangeable aspects of the Rashomon effect. Overall, our results show that training stochasticity influences not only predictive performance but also the stability of predictions and explanations, highlighting the importance of identifying the specific sources of stochasticity responsible for different manifestations of the Rashomon phenomenon when assessing the reliability, reproducibility, and interpretability of neural network models.
papers.comment: Submitted to a journal for peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格与图像分类基准上独立控制权重初始化、mini-batch 数据顺序与 dropout 三种训练随机性，沿经验 Rashomon 集大小、预测歧义 (predictive ambiguity)、XAI 归因图一致性三个维度量化 Rashomon 效应。发现三者对三个维度的影响方式不同：更大的经验 Rashomon 集并不必然带来更大的预测分歧或更低的解释一致性，说明解空间、预测与决策依据三种多重性互补而非可互换。
Motivation: 训练随机性导致性能相当的不同模型，但不同随机性来源对 Rashomon 效应各维度的贡献是否相同尚不清楚，影响模型可靠性、可复现性与可解释性的评估。
Method: 经验研究：独立控制权重初始化、mini-batch 数据顺序、dropout 三种随机性来源，分别用经验 Rashomon 集大小、predictive ambiguity、XAI attribution map 之间的一致性量化解空间多重性、预测多重性与决策依据多重性，在表格与图像分类基准上做实验。
Result: 实验显示三种随机性来源对三个维度的影响方式不同；更大的经验 Rashomon 集不一定对应更大的预测分歧或更低的解释一致性。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 解空间、预测、决策依据三重多重性捕捉的是 Rashomon 效应互补而非可互换的侧面；评估神经网络可靠性时需先定位具体是哪一种随机性来源导致了哪种表现。

papers.title: Last-Iterate Guarantees for Online Reinforcement Learning in Structured Constrained MDPs
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical applications, deployment uses a single policy, whose performance and constraint satisfaction should hold directly rather than only for an average or mixture of training policies. This motivates last-iterate guarantees in constrained reinforcement learning. Recent progress has established such guarantees in exact-gradient or tabular online settings, yet scalable results for structured large-state problems remain open. We develop a general, statistically efficient framework for last-iterate convergence in structured Constrained MDPs (CMDPs). Our analysis separates contraction of the regularised primal-dual dynamics from actor approximation and statistical errors in policy evaluation under online exploration. This enables model-free on- and off-policy learning with structured function approximation: optimistic policy evaluation avoids explicit transition-model construction, while a compact parametric actor avoids maintaining mixtures or histories of past policies. We instantiate the framework for linear CMDPs and general function approximation, obtaining representation-dependent complexity and improved target-accuracy dependence over prior optimistic regularised primal-dual analyses. We further validate the stabilising effect predicted by our theory on a synthetic linear CMDP: the regularised method exhibits stable last-iterate behaviour, whereas its unregularised counterpart shows larger oscillations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在结构化 Constrained MDP 上给出在线强化学习的 last-iterate 收敛框架：把正则化 primal-dual 动力学的收缩与 actor 近似、在线策略评估的统计误差分开处理，从而支持 model-free 的 on-/off-policy 学习与结构化函数逼近。在合成线性 CMDP 上，正则化方法呈现稳定的 last-iterate 行为，未正则化版本振荡更大。
Motivation: 安全关键场景部署只用单一策略，其性能与约束满足需直接成立而非对训练策略平均或混合成立；已有 last-iterate 保证限于精确梯度或表格设定，大规模结构化状态问题仍缺可扩展结果。
Method: 提出结构化 CMDP 上 last-iterate 收敛的一般统计高效框架：用乐观策略评估 (optimistic policy evaluation) 避免显式构造转移模型，用紧凑参数化 actor 避免维护历史策略的混合或历史；框架实例化到线性 CMDP 与一般函数逼近，得到依赖表示的复杂度与改进的目标精度依赖。
Result: 在合成线性 CMDP 上验证理论预测的稳定效应：正则化方法 last-iterate 行为稳定，未正则化对应方法振荡更大；相对先前乐观正则化 primal-dual 分析取得依赖表示的复杂度与改进的目标精度依赖。
Conclusion: 把正则化 primal-dual 动力学的收缩与 actor 近似、策略评估统计误差解耦，可在结构化函数逼近下获得可扩展的 last-iterate 保证，且正则化是抑制 last-iterate 振荡的关键。

papers.title: Counting on Thinking: Tracing Evidence Integration in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Finite computational resources force a tradeoff between automatic System 1 processes and costly System 2 thinking. Large language models (LLMs) can spend extra computation on hard problems, yet direct answers struggle even with counting, an elementary operation humans and animals perform automatically. We ask why this requires thinking in LLMs. Evidence integration has long been used in psychology and neuroscience to probe decision-making. Our evidence-integration task presents one letter per conversational turn and asks which of two target letters appeared more often. A running count difference solves the task optimally by weighting every letter equally; tokens at each turn could represent and update this difference. Direct responses instead weighted evidence unevenly, with strong recency effects, and assigned less probability to the correct answer as difficulty increased. Thinking improved performance and made integration weights nearly uniform, yet final-query attention remained concentrated on the sequence ends in both modes. Reasoning trajectories showed models revisiting input, recounting letters, and checking intermediate counts that informed the answer, suggesting that thinking constructs the accumulated count that direct responses lack rather than reading out one already formed. Reasoning-token costs grew with the number of letters far more than with coherence. Outcome feedback did not bring this computation into direct responses: under in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL), performance deteriorated over repeated games and recency effects strengthened, yet models grew more confident. Humans and animals amortize such computations into automatic processes, whereas current LLMs still pay for them with thinking on every trial. Which operations learning can make directly available remains central to how future models allocate computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用逐轮呈现单个字母、比较两个目标字母出现次数的证据整合任务，追踪 LLM 为何必须「思考」：直接作答的整合权重不均且有强近因效应，难度上升时正确率下降；思考模式让权重接近均匀、成绩提升，但最终查询注意力仍集中在序列两端。推理轨迹显示模型在重读输入、重数字母、核对中间计数，说明思考是在现场构造累计计数而非读出已算好的结果；ICRL 反馈反而让表现随局数下降、近因效应增强而置信度上升。
Motivation: 有限算力下 System 1 与 System 2 存在取舍，LLM 连计数这类人类与动物自动完成的基础操作都做不好，需要解释为什么必须靠思考才能完成证据整合。
Method: 构造证据整合任务：每轮对话给出一个字母，问两个目标字母哪个出现更多；最优解是维护运行计数差（等权加权）。对比直接作答与思考两种模式下的整合权重、最终查询注意力与推理轨迹，并测试 in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) 的结果反馈。
Result: 直接作答的整合权重不均、近因效应强，难度增大时正确答案概率下降；思考提升表现并使整合权重接近均匀，但两种模式下最终查询注意力都集中在序列两端；推理轨迹包含重读输入、重数字母与核对中间计数；推理 token 成本随字母数增长远快于随连贯性增长；ICRL 下表现随重复局数恶化、近因效应增强而模型置信度提高。
Conclusion: 思考是在构造直接作答所缺的累计计数，而非读出已形成的计数；结果反馈无法把该计算搬进直接作答，当前 LLM 仍在每次试次上为这类计算付出思考开销，哪些运算能被学习直接自动化是未来模型算力分配的核心问题。

papers.title: EEG-Based Motor Imagery BCI Algorithms and Technologies: A Review
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have emerged as transformative technologies that enable direct communication between the brain and external devices. Among various BCI paradigms, EEG-based motor imagery (MI) has gained prominence due to its simplicity, non-invasiveness, and potential to restore motor function and facilitate rehabilitation for patients with motor impairments. This paper presents a comprehensive review of the most practical processing algorithms developed over the past decade for decoding brain sensorimotor cortex signals. Specifically, this paper discusses the integration of artificial intelligence (AI)-based algorithms, particularly machine learning and deep learning techniques, and their contributions to improving the performance and efficiency of MI-BCI systems in detail. Furthermore, the paper reviews state-of-the-art hardware platforms and emerging converging technologies, including system-on-chip (SoC) architectures, application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), wearable devices, the Internet of Things (IoT), and augmented/virtual reality (AR/VR), and discusses their integration with advanced signal processing algorithms to enable next-generation MI-BCI systems. By highlighting current achievements of EEG-based MI-BCI technology and predicting future research directions that could further enhance real-time capabilities, this paper aims to provide valuable insights for researchers and practitioners, fostering innovation in high-performance EEG-based MI-BCI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 EEG 运动想象 (motor imagery) BCI 的十年综述，梳理用于解码感觉运动皮层信号的机器学习与深度学习算法，并把它们与 SoC、ASIC、FPGA、可穿戴、IoT、AR/VR 等硬件平台的集成放在一起讨论。结论是 MI-BCI 的实时能力提升依赖算法与硬件的协同设计，而非单侧推进。
Motivation: EEG 运动想象 BCI 算法与硬件平台在过去十年分散发展，缺少一份把 AI 解码算法与 SoC/ASIC/FPGA 等实现载体放在同一框架下审视的综述，研究者难以判断实时 MI-BCI 系统的可行路径。
Method: 综述近十年最实用的 MI-BCI 处理算法，重点覆盖机器学习与深度学习在脑电信号解码中的应用；同时梳理 SoC、ASIC、FPGA、可穿戴设备、IoT、AR/VR 等硬件与新兴融合技术，并讨论它们与先进信号处理算法的集成方式。
Result: 综述给出 EEG MI-BCI 当前成就的定性评估，并预测能进一步增强系统实时能力的未来研究方向；摘要中的贡献为算法与硬件平台的分类梳理，未给出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 高性能 MI-BCI 系统的下一步在于 AI 解码算法与专用硬件平台的深度集成，实时性是作者判断未来研究方向的核心指标。

papers.title: Efficient Dynamic Algorithms for Graph Neural Networks with Non-Linear Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used for representation learning on graphs, but most methods assume static topologies, making them inefficient on evolving networks where edges change over time. Existing dynamic approaches either model graph evolution through temporal GNN architectures without focusing on efficient dynamic maintenance, or are restricted to linear propagation models based on Personalized PageRank. In this work, we study how to efficiently maintain node representations for non-linear GNN propagation under edge insertions and deletions. The propagation has no learned parameters, and only a classifier applied afterward is trained. For a broad class of standard activation functions, we develop a residual-based dynamic algorithm that selectively propagates local errors via push operations, maintaining an approximation to the evolving fixed point without full recomputation. We prove that our method achieves amortized $O(1/ε)$ update time per graph change under a degree-normalized error guarantee. Our approach uses a potential-based analysis in a degree-scaled norm and, in contrast to prior work on the linear case, requires no randomness assumptions on either the update sequence or the input vector. For the linear special case, we additionally provide an exact dynamic algorithm via low-rank matrix inverse updates. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that incorporating non-linearity improves accuracy while preserving efficient update performance, yielding a scalable and theoretically grounded method for maintaining this propagation on dynamic graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对动态图上非线性 GNN 传播的高效维护，提出基于残差的动态算法：边增删后只用 push 操作选择性传播局部误差，近似演化中的不动点而不整体重算。证明摊还每次图变更 O(1/ε) 更新时间（度数归一化误差保证），且对更新序列与输入向量都不需要随机性假设；线性特例另给低秩矩阵逆更新的精确动态算法。
Motivation: 多数 GNN 方法假设拓扑静态，在边随时间变化的演化网络上需反复全量重算；已有动态方案要么只做时序架构而不关注高效维护，要么局限于基于 Personalized PageRank 的线性传播。
Method: 对无学习参数、仅后接分类器训练的非线性 GNN 传播，设计残差驱动的动态算法：边插入/删除后通过 push 操作选择性传播局部误差，维护演化不动点的近似；分析用度数缩放范数 (degree-scaled norm) 下的势函数方法；线性特例用低秩矩阵逆更新给出精确动态算法。
Result: 证明对一大类标准激活函数，摊还每次图变更更新时间为 O(1/ε)，带度数归一化误差保证，且相比线性情形的先前工作不需要更新序列或输入向量上的随机性假设；基准数据集实验显示引入非线性在保持高效更新的同时提升准确率。
Conclusion: 非线性 GNN 传播可以在动态图上做到理论保证的高效维护，且非线性带来的准确率收益与低更新开销可以兼得。

papers.title: Phenomenon-Graph JEPA: Label-Efficient Representation Learning for Contactless Cardiorespiratory Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar and RGB-D cameras can record cardiac and respiratory waveforms continuously and without contact, but labeled recordings remain scarce because every label requires a supervised acquisition session. Self-supervised pretraining can exploit the unlabeled signals, yet contrastive methods depend on signal transformations and negative pairs whose validity is uncertain for cardiorespiratory data, where time warping changes breathing rate and distant windows can share the same physiological state. We present Phenomenon-Graph JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns from four processed one-dimensional streams without negative pairs or synthetic augmentation in its base configuration. Each stream is encoded by a temporal convolutional branch and a band-limited spectral branch. During pretraining, the model predicts stopped target embeddings along typed edges, which connect streams assigned to the same physiological phenomenon, and forward in time within a state episode. We treat this physiological typing as a testable hypothesis and compare it with wrong-edge and all-pairs prediction graphs. In the OMuSense-23 dataset, pretraining improves label-efficiency area over matched supervised training by 3.91 percentage points (95% interval 2.08 to 5.80, Holm-adjusted p = 0.006), and by 3.74 points under a second configuration evaluated on the same test participants. However, the wrong-edge and all-pairs controls do not establish a benefit from physiological typing. Optional Takens-inspired delay coordinates improve a validation comparison with learned history, whereas two wrist-only WESAD protocols do not establish a pretraining advantage. The study therefore separates the measured benefit of predictive representations from the physiological prior used to organize their training.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, 24 numbered equations. Extended version of a conference submission, with additional methodological details, implementation settings, and analyzes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Phenomenon-Graph JEPA：用带类型边（同一生理现象的流之间、状态 episode 内向前）的图结构做联合嵌入预测预训练，从四路一维 mmWave 雷达与 RGB-D 信号中学表示，不依赖负样本对与合成增强。在 OMuSense-23 上预训练相对同等监督训练把标签效率面积 (label-efficiency area) 提高 3.91 个百分点（95% 区间 2.08–5.80，Holm 校正 p = 0.006），第二种配置下提高 3.74 个百分点；但 wrong-edge 与 all-pairs 对照未能确立生理类型边的额外收益，WESAD 两个仅腕部协议也未确立预训练优势。
Motivation: 非接触式心肺信号的标注每次都要走一遍有监督采集流程，标注稀缺；而对比学习依赖的信号变换与负样本对在心肺数据上有效性存疑——时间扭曲会改变呼吸率，相距很远的窗口也可能处于同一生理状态。
Method: Phenomenon-Graph JEPA 是一种 JEPA 架构：四路处理后的一维流各由时域卷积分支与带限谱分支编码，预训练时沿带类型的边预测 stopped target embedding，边连接被指派到同一生理现象的流以及状态 episode 内的时间前向；生理类型化本身作为可检验假设，与 wrong-edge 和 all-pairs 预测图对照比较。可选地引入 Takens 启发的 delay coordinates。
Result: 在 OMuSense-23 上，预训练相对匹配的监督训练标签效率面积提高 3.91 个百分点（95% 区间 2.08 至 5.80，Holm 校正 p = 0.006），第二种配置下提高 3.74 个百分点（同一测试被试）。wrong-edge 与 all-pairs 对照未确立生理类型边的收益；Takens delay coordinates 在验证集比较中优于学习历史；WESAD 两个仅腕部协议未确立预训练优势。
Conclusion: 预测式表示本身在 OMuSense-23 上带来可测的标签效率收益，但该收益与组织训练用的生理先验是两回事——类型边的贡献未被对照实验确立，换到 WESAD 腕部协议该优势也不成立。

papers.title: The Geometry of Logic: Stratification Induces Semantic Structure and Robust Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based language models perform well on symbolic tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they learn generalizable rules or rely on statistical shortcuts. Mechanistic studies link algorithmic behavior to structured internal representations, motivating the hypothesis that robust reasoning benefits from separating values from the types that control their manipulation. Can making this separation an architectural primitive improve the learnability and generalization of logical mechanisms? We introduce \textbf{STRAT} (\textbf{ST}ratified \textbf{R}egisters \textbf{A}nd \textbf{T}ypes), which partitions the residual stream into orthogonal Data and Type subspaces and uses Type-based attention and gating to govern Data transformations. Controlled arithmetic ablations identify three failure modes associated with data-control interference: the Linear Trap, Gradient Wall, and Open Gate Trap. Mechanistic analysis reveals interpretable logical structure, and in arithmetic, STRAT reduces median OOD error 35-fold relative to a Transformer baseline. On each of 11 datasets spanning 10 tasks, STRAT outperforms the Transformer baseline in mean accuracy, by 26 percentage points on average, with both models trained from 10 base examples per dataset using identical task-specific augmentation where applicable. Under distribution shift, STRAT's mean accuracy drops by only 2.39 percentage points, compared with 11.75 for the Transformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 STRAT（Stratified Registers And Types），把 Transformer 残差流切成正交的 Data 与 Type 子空间，用 Type 注意力与门控约束 Data 变换，使逻辑机制可学且可泛化。算术上 OOD 中位误差相对基线降 35 倍；11 个数据集、10 个任务上平均准确率高出 26 个百分点，分布偏移下仅掉 2.39 个百分点（基线掉 11.75）。
Motivation: Transformer 在符号任务上表现好，但不清楚它学到的是可泛化规则还是统计捷径；数据与控制类型的混杂会干扰逻辑机制的可学性。
Method: STRAT 把残差流划分为正交 Data/Type 子空间，用基于 Type 的 attention 与 gating 支配 Data 变换；以受控算术消融定位三种数据-控制干扰失效模式（Linear Trap、Gradient Wall、Open Gate Trap），并做机制可解释性分析。
Result: 算术任务上 STRAT 的 OOD 中位误差相对 Transformer 基线降低 35 倍；在 10 个任务的 11 个数据集上平均准确率高出 26 个百分点，两模型均从每数据集 10 个 base example 训练；分布偏移下 STRAT 平均准确率仅下降 2.39 个百分点，Transformer 下降 11.75 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把值与其控制类型在架构上分离，可提升逻辑机制的可学性与分布外泛化，且机制分析呈现可解释的逻辑结构。

summary_sections.method: STRAT 把残差流划分为正交 Data/Type 子空间，用基于 Type 的 attention 与 gating 支配 Data 变换；以受控算术消融定位三种数据-控制干扰失效模式（Linear Trap、Gradient Wall、Open Gate Trap），并做机制可解释性分析。
summary_sections.result: 算术任务上 STRAT 的 OOD 中位误差相对 Transformer 基线降低 35 倍；在 10 个任务的 11 个数据集上平均准确率高出 26 个百分点，两模型均从每数据集 10 个 base example 训练；分布偏移下 STRAT 平均准确率仅下降 2.39 个百分点，Transformer 下降 11.75 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把值与其控制类型在架构上分离，可提升逻辑机制的可学性与分布外泛化，且机制分析呈现可解释的逻辑结构。

papers.title: Identification of Nonlinear and Dependent Latent Factor Structure through Clique Search
papers.abstract_en: Learning the structure of latent factor models involves two central challenges: (1) estimating the number of latent factors and (2) learning the support of the mapping from latent variables to observed variables. This is especially challenging for nonparametric regimes and nonlinear settings. We propose a method for latent structure learning, based on pairwise dependence measures on the observed variables using a graph-theoretic representation. We show that both the number of latent factors and nonlinear mapping structure can be identified from the distribution of observed variables under mild structural assumptions. Unlike prior work restricted to linear correlations, we establish identifiability and consistency for a general class of dependence measures under nonlinear factor models. This motivates a Dependence Thresholding (DT) algorithm, which jointly estimates the number of latent factors and nonlinear mapping structure from observational data alone. We pair this with a neural network architecture constrained by the nonlinear mapping structure, to recover the nonlinear function. Through simulation studies, we show that the DT algorithm is accurate in practice, even when using flexible methods such as neural networks, and exhibits robustness against violations of its assumptions in high-dimensional settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于观测变量两两依赖度的图论式潜因子结构学习方法：用 Dependence Thresholding (DT) 算法从观测数据同时估计潜因子个数与非线性映射支撑，再用受该结构约束的神经网络恢复非线性函数。在温和结构假设下证明因子个数与映射结构可识别，并对一般依赖度量建立可识别性与相合性；仿真中 DT 在高维设定下即使搭配神经网络也准确且对假设违背稳健。
Motivation: 潜因子模型学习要同时解决因子个数估计与映射支撑学习，非参数与非线性设定下尤其困难；已有工作多局限于线性相关。
Method: 以观测变量的 pairwise dependence measure 构造图表示，通过 clique search 做 Dependence Thresholding (DT)，联合估计因子数与非线性映射结构；再配一个受该映射结构约束的神经网络恢复非线性函数，仅用观测数据。
Result: 在温和结构假设下证明因子个数与非线性映射结构可从观测变量分布识别，并对一般依赖度量类建立可识别性与相合性（不限于线性相关）；仿真研究表明 DT 算法在实践中准确，即使搭配神经网络这类灵活方法，并在高维设定下对假设违背表现稳健。
Conclusion: 借助图论式依赖度量搜索，可在非线性潜因子模型中仅凭观测数据同时识别因子数与映射结构，且对高维下的假设违背有稳健性。

papers.title: Diagnosing Sampled LLM Reasoning in Formal Geometry: Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Repeated sampling can reveal a correct numerical answer without yielding either a reliable system output or a supported derivation. We present Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence (CRV), an evaluation protocol for sampled large language model (LLM) reasoning over formal geometry states. Coverage is answer availability, realization is readout accuracy on the frozen candidate pool, and validity evidence is a label-blinded critic judgment of derivational support rather than a proof certificate. CRV freezes each candidate pool before comparing readouts and analyzes covered failures by correct-answer multiplicity and within-problem discrimination. On HardShift441, a 441-problem set for which a reference solver leaves 406 problems unsolved, a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B generator obtains 24.2% average single-sample accuracy and 68.9% pass@16, whereas verifier-weighted self-consistency (WSC) reaches 38.0%. Readout accuracy is particularly low when the correct answer occurs only once or twice in the pool. In a separate constructed audit of 195 covered problems, the critic labels 12 correct-answer representatives as supported, 181 as refuted, and two as uncertain. These results show that coverage, realization, and validity evidence from the critic are distinct quantities and should be reported separately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CRV 评测协议，把采样 LLM 在形式几何题上的答案可用性 (coverage)、冻结候选池上的读出准确率 (realization) 与判据对推导支持度的标签盲评判 (validity evidence) 拆成三个独立量分别报告。在 HardShift441 上，LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-7B 单样本平均准确率 24.2%、pass@16 68.9%，而 verifier-weighted self-consistency 只到 38.0%；195 道已覆盖题的审计中判据仅判 12 个正确答案代表为 supported、181 个 refuted、2 个 uncertain。
Motivation: 重复采样常能撞出正确数值答案，却既不给可靠系统输出也不给有支撑的推导；coverage、读出准确率与推导有效性被混为一谈，评测无法区分“答对”与“推对”。
Method: CRV 协议：先冻结每个候选池再比较读出方式，coverage 记答案是否出现，realization 记冻结池上的读出准确率，validity evidence 用标签盲的 critic 判推导是否支持答案（非证明证书）；对已覆盖的失败按正确答案重数与题内区分度分析，并另做 195 题构造审计。
Result: HardShift441 共 441 题，参考 solver 有 406 题未解；LoRA 微调 Qwen2.5-7B 单样本平均准确率 24.2%、pass@16 68.9%，verifier-weighted self-consistency (WSC) 达 38.0%；正确答案在池中仅出现一两次时读出准确率特别低。195 道已覆盖题的审计中，critic 判 12 个正确答案代表 supported、181 个 refuted、2 个 uncertain。
Conclusion: coverage、realization 与 critic 给出的 validity evidence 是三个不同的量，应分开报告；高 pass@16 不等于可靠输出或有支撑的推导。

papers.title: TRACE: Learning to Self-Calibrate Wireless Digital Twins from ISAC Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Wireless digital twins (DTs) rely on 3D environment models to predict radio propagation and support wireless-network decisions, yet these models are often initialized from imperfect 3D maps. Errors in building position, height, footprint, and orientation can therefore cause a high-fidelity propagation engine to simulate the wrong physical environment. In this paper, we study how a deployed wireless network can repair an existing DT using its own radio frequency (RF) measurements. In particular, we introduce Twin Residual Alignment and Calibration Engine (TRACE), a physics-grounded learning-based self-calibration framework that treats twin maintenance as residual alignment between the physical world and the current DT. Using the same sensing configuration as the physical measurements, TRACE ray-traces the current DT, coherently backprojects the measured and simulated RF onto a common world grid, and extracts the same local region around each building's current DT position. A multi-view corrector then fuses evidence across sensing nodes and neighboring buildings to predict a gated six-parameter correction per building, without relying on absolute layout or sensor ordering, and supports iterative correction through re-rendering. On 5,400 held-out samples from unseen simulated scenes at 28 GHz, TRACE reduces 3D position RMSE from 2.202 m to 0.302 m and yaw RMSE from 4.978° to 0.894°, outperforming ViT and U-Net baselines under changes in layout, building count, sensing-node count, and SNR. On measured 28 GHz RF data from the NIST outdoor courtyard, a model trained only on synthetic RF reduces mean planar wall-position error from 1.00 m to 7.8 cm, without measured-data fine-tuning or geometric labels. These results show that the discrepancy between measured and twin-rendered RF can serve as a learning signal for repairing a wireless DT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把无线数字孪生的维护建模为实测 RF 与孪生渲染 RF 之间的残差对齐：对当前孪生做 ray-trace，将实测与仿真 RF 相干反投影到同一世界网格，围绕每栋建筑的当前位姿截取同一局部区域，再用 multi-view corrector 跨感知节点与邻近建筑融合证据，输出每栋建筑带门控的六参数修正并支持重渲染迭代。在 28 GHz 未见仿真场景的 5,400 条留出样本上，3D 位置 RMSE 从 2.202 m 降到 0.302 m、yaw RMSE 从 4.978° 降到 0.894°，优于 ViT 与 U-Net 基线；在 NIST 室外庭院实测 28 GHz 数据上，仅用合成 RF 训练即把平均平面墙位误差从 1.00 m 降到 7.8 cm，无需实测微调或几何标签。
Motivation: 无线数字孪生依赖 3D 环境模型预测无线电传播，但初始地图在建筑位置、高度、 footprint 与朝向上常有误差，导致高保真传播引擎仿真的是错误的物理环境，网络决策随之失真。
Method: TRACE 用与实测相同的感知配置对当前孪生做 ray-trace，把实测与仿真 RF 相干反投影 (coherent backprojection) 到同一世界网格，围绕每栋建筑当前 DT 位置截取同一局部区域；multi-view corrector 融合多感知节点与邻近建筑的证据，预测每栋建筑带门控的六参数修正，不依赖绝对布局或传感器顺序，并通过 re-rendering 支持迭代修正。
Result: 在 28 GHz 未见仿真场景的 5,400 条留出样本上，3D 位置 RMSE 由 2.202 m 降至 0.302 m，yaw RMSE 由 4.978° 降至 0.894°，在布局、建筑数量、感知节点数与 SNR 变化下均优于 ViT 和 U-Net 基线。在 NIST 室外庭院实测 28 GHz RF 数据上，仅用合成 RF 训练的模型把平均平面墙位误差从 1.00 m 降到 7.8 cm，无需实测数据微调或几何标签。
Conclusion: 实测 RF 与孪生渲染 RF 之间的差异本身可以作为修复无线数字孪生的学习信号，从而在没有几何标注和实测微调的条件下完成自标定。

papers.title: Precision As You Need: Stochastic Computing Is a Dense Adaptive Quantizer
papers.abstract_en: Matrix multiplications dominate the inference cost of modern transformer-based vision models, yet existing efficiency techniques such as post-training quantization and mixed-precision inference are largely limited to the small set of fixed-width formats (INT4, INT8, BF16, and FP16) supported by conventional accelerators. We revisit stochastic computing (SC) as a way to lift this constraint: viewed as a dense adaptive quantizer, SC controls precision by bit-stream length L rather than a fixed datapath, while each multiplication reduces to a single AND/XNOR gate. We build a GPU library that emulates SC matrix multiplication at scale, exposes stream lengths as first-class kernel arguments, and evaluates SC end-to-end on image classification, object detection and instance segmentation, class-conditional image generation, and visual world-model planning. On top of this substrate, we develop a dynamic per-row mixed-precision policy that assigns stream length per token or group at matched average budget, requires no retraining, and uses the same SC hardware across schedules. Across tasks, SC remains competitive with fixed-format INT quantization at matched bit budgets, while per-row mixed precision helps maintain accuracy at lower average stream lengths. These results provide software-level feasibility evidence that SC can serve as a dense-precision substrate for fine-grained mixed-precision inference on modern vision transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把随机计算 (stochastic computing, SC) 重新解释为稠密自适应量化器：精度由比特流长度 L 而非固定位宽 (INT4/INT8/BF16/FP16) 决定，每次乘法退化为单个 AND/XNOR 门。作者构建了可大规模仿真 SC 矩阵乘的 GPU 库，并在其上做无需重训的逐行动态混合精度策略，在匹配平均比特预算下与 INT 量化保持竞争力，且在更低平均流长时仍维持精度。
Motivation: 后训练量化与混合精度推理被加速器支持的少数固定位宽格式卡住，无法在 token 或行级别细粒度地分配精度。
Method: 构建 GPU 库仿真 SC 矩阵乘，把比特流长度作为一等 kernel 参数；在其上提出逐行混合精度策略，按 token 或 group 分配流长、匹配平均预算、无需重训，且不同调度共用同一 SC 硬件；在图像分类、目标检测与实例分割、类别条件图像生成、视觉世界模型规划四类任务上端到端评测。
Result: 在匹配比特预算下，SC 与固定格式 INT 量化在各任务上保持竞争力；逐行混合精度在更低平均流长下有助于保持精度。评测覆盖图像分类、目标检测与实例分割、类别条件图像生成与视觉世界模型规划。
Conclusion: SC 可作为现代 vision transformer 细粒度混合精度推理的软件级可行稠密精度基底，提供的是可行性证据而非硬件实现。

papers.title: Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Adaptive LeWorldModel (ALeWM), a world model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns to concentrate predictive information in compact prefixes of a wide latent representation. To encourage this ordering, ALeWM learns a sequence-conditioned distribution over prefix lengths and trains the predictor to estimate the full next embedding from a sampled input prefix. As standard anti-collapse objectives encourage variation across latent coordinates and do not organize them by predictive importance, we also introduce MixSIGReg. MixSIGReg regularizes the masked embeddings against a prior-weighted mixture with Gaussian active prefixes and zeros in the remaining coordinates. As a result, the ALeWM objective encourages early coordinates to retain information useful for prediction and recursive planning. Our analysis shows that the mixture distribution used by MixSIGReg assigns higher variance to earlier coordinate blocks and lower variance to later ones. In addition, we show that, under specified assumptions, prediction error is minimized by placing the information most useful for prediction in earlier blocks. Empirically, we study the behavior of ALeWM in a controlled dynamical system with known state variables and in goal-conditioned visual control. We show that ALeWM consistently achieves higher mean success rates than tuned fixed-width LeWM, with lower planning capacity on average.

TL;DR: ALeWM 把 JEPA 世界模型的宽隐空间按预测重要性排序，让预测信息集中在隐表示的紧凑前缀里：学习一个随序列变化的前缀长度分布，从采样的前缀预测完整下一嵌入，并用 MixSIGReg 把掩码嵌入正则到「高斯活跃前缀 + 其余坐标置零」的先验加权混合上。分析表明该混合给靠前坐标块更高方差、靠后更低方差，且在给定假设下把最有用的信息放在前块可最小化预测误差；在受控动力系统与目标条件视觉控制中，ALeWM 平均成功率高于调过宽度的固定宽度 LeWM，且所需规划容量更低。
Motivation: 标准防坍缩目标只鼓励各隐坐标之间产生变化，不按预测重要性组织坐标，导致宽隐表示里大量坐标对预测与递归规划无用，规划容量被浪费。
Method: ALeWM 基于 joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)：学习一个序列条件的前缀长度分布，训练预测器从采样得到的输入前缀估计完整下一嵌入；同时引入 MixSIGReg，把掩码嵌入正则到先验加权混合分布上，该混合在活跃前缀上取高斯、其余坐标置零。
Result: 分析给出两点：MixSIGReg 的混合分布给靠前坐标块更高方差、靠后坐标块更低方差；在所述假设下，把对预测最有用的信息放在靠前块可最小化预测误差。实验在已知状态变量的受控动力系统与目标条件视觉控制 (goal-conditioned visual control) 上进行，ALeWM 的平均成功率持续高于调过宽度的固定宽度 LeWM，同时平均规划容量更低。
Conclusion: 按预测重要性排序隐坐标、并用前缀容量自适应分配，可以在更低规划容量下提高世界模型的预测与递归规划表现；固定宽度的隐表示并非必要。

papers.title: Vision-Language Agents for Active Perception in Optics Laboratories
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being used in scientific workflows, but their ability as agents to directly control laboratory experiments from visual feedback remains underexplored. This capability is important because many laboratory tasks do not naturally provide dense, pre-defined numerical objectives: informative signals can be sparse, intermittent, or visually ambiguous. A more general laboratory agent should instead be able to interpret visual observations, take actions to acquire useful feedback, and adapt its behavior based on the consequences of those actions. We study whether general-purpose VLMs can perform this kind of closed-loop scientific control using experimental optics as a testbed. We evaluate agents on three experimental systems that isolate distinct capabilities: a Michelson interferometer, a two-mirror cavity, and a four-mirror optical relay. The agents observe camera images, directly issue actuator and measurement commands, and retain their interaction history without receiving an engineered scalar objective during control. Across these experiments and matched simulations, we find that, given task-specific natural-language guidance, VLMs can estimate actuator-response relationships, resolve ambiguous observations through intervention, and actively create informative visual feedback when signals are sparse. These results suggest that pretrained multimodal models can serve as important decision-making agents within the experimental loop. Our work also establishes optics as a physically grounded testbed for visual reasoning and active perception in scientific agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以光学实验台为测试床，检验通用 VLM 能否在无工程化标量目标的条件下，仅凭相机图像做闭环主动感知控制。在 Michelson 干涉仪、两镜腔、四镜光学中继三套系统及匹配仿真中，给定任务级自然语言指引后，VLM 能估计执行器-响应关系、通过主动干预消解歧义观测，并在信号稀疏时自行创造有信息量的视觉反馈。
Motivation: 许多实验室任务没有稠密、预定义的数值目标，信号稀疏、间断或视觉上歧义，VLM 作为 agent 直接从视觉反馈控制实验的能力尚未被充分研究。
Method: 在三套光学系统（Michelson 干涉仪、两镜腔、四镜光学中继）及匹配仿真上评测通用 VLM agent：观察相机图像，直接下发执行器与测量指令，保留交互历史，控制过程中不接收工程化标量目标，仅给任务级自然语言指引。
Result: 跨三套实验与匹配仿真，VLM 能估计执行器-响应关系，通过干预解决观测歧义，并在信号稀疏时主动创造有信息量的视觉反馈。
Conclusion: 预训练多模态模型可以作为实验回路内的决策 agent，光学实验则是检验科学 agent 视觉推理与主动感知的物理可落地测试床。

papers.title: Planner-as-Router: Joint Plan-Time Model Routing for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Running large language model (LLM) agents in production gets expensive fast. A frontier model (the largest, most capable tier) is accurate but can cost 25 times what a small model costs per token, and the gap compounds once a workflow chains several calls together. Planner-as-Router (PaR) attacks this from a different angle. Instead of leaving model-tier selection to some component downstream, it folds the choice into planning itself. As the planner breaks a query into subtasks, it also assigns each one a model size tier (small, mid, or frontier, ordered by capability and price), so the dependencies between subtasks are visible before any specialist runs. Unlike per-call routers such as cascade routing, which look at one node at a time, PaR sees the whole workflow up front and needs no separate router model or training data. We evaluate PaR with EntBench, a benchmark of 54 enterprise agentic tasks across seven classes, graded by actually running the generated Structured Query Language (SQL) and MongoDB queries against live databases. Over 1,157 evaluations spanning eight routers and three seeds, PaR stays on the observed cost-accuracy frontier. It matches a sink-frontier heuristic (frontier model on terminal nodes only) in accuracy at comparable cost and a faithful FrugalGPT cascade at lower cost, and cuts cost 44% against all-frontier routing while giving up 2.9 points of accuracy. Several accuracy gaps fall inside the plus-or-minus six-point confidence interval of a 54-task study, so we frame PaR's advantage as frontier position rather than a clean accuracy win. We also report a preliminary observation, not a validated result: a small pilot hints that cheap routing may carry a hidden compounding penalty on compositional workflows, which we frame as a hypothesis for future measurement. PaR, EntBench, and all evaluation code are open source.
papers.comment: Accepted at AIxSET 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Data and Code in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/par-entbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Planner-as-Router (PaR) 把模型档位选择（small/mid/frontier）直接并入 LLM agent 的规划阶段，随子任务划分一并分配，从而在看到整条工作流依赖的前提下省成本。在 EntBench 的 54 个企业 agent 任务、1,157 次评测（8 种 router、3 个 seed）中，PaR 相对全 frontier 路由削减 44% 成本、代价是 2.9 个百分点精度，且保持在观测到的成本-精度前沿上。
Motivation: 生产环境 LLM agent 成本高：frontier 模型每 token 可达小模型的 25 倍，工作流多次调用后差距进一步放大；而 cascade 一类 per-call router 一次只看一个节点，无法利用子任务间的依赖。
Method: PaR 在 planner 把查询拆成子任务时同步为每个子任务指派模型档位（small/mid/frontier，按能力与价格排序），使依赖关系在任何 specialist 运行前可见；不需要单独的 router 模型，也不需要训练数据。评测用 EntBench——54 个企业 agent 任务、7 个类别，通过实际执行生成的 SQL 与 MongoDB 查询到活数据库来打分。
Result: 1,157 次评测、8 种 router、3 个 seed 下 PaR 保持在观测成本-精度前沿：精度与 sink-frontier 启发式（仅末端节点用 frontier）相当而成本接近，精度与 faithful FrugalGPT cascade 相当但成本更低；相对全 frontier 路由成本下降 44%，精度让出 2.9 个百分点。作者指出若干精度差距落在 54 任务研究的 ±6 点置信区间内。
Conclusion: PaR 的卖点是成本-精度前沿位置而非干净的精度胜出；另有一项初步小规模观察提示廉价路由可能在组合式工作流上带来累积惩罚，作者明确将其作为待验证假设而非结论。
