papers.title: AgentTell: Behavioural Side-Channel Leakage in Browser-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Browser-use agents often carry information in their context as they move between websites. While it may be necessary for task completion, it also creates a privacy risk, especially when the information contains a private fact regarding the user. For example, an agent may learn a user's affiliation after reading a membership record. If it later selects a registration option specific to that affiliation on another website instead of a general option, the information gets leaked. In this work, we define and study behavioural side-channel leakage in browser-use agents, where an agent's actions inadvertently reveal private information (secret) retained from a prior website, despite an explicit instruction not to disclose it. We introduce AgentTell, a benchmark of 20 scenarios and 100 tasks in which an agent acquires a secret on one website and then completes a task on another website that offers secret-specific actions alongside a general action that reveals nothing. Our evaluation across 9,760 sessions on six backbones shows that agents carrying a secret reveal it through their actions in 61.1% of sessions. Even when agents explicitly state in memory that the secret must not be shared, they still reveal it in 56.7% of those sessions. Moreover, in 34.5% of leaking sessions, their final responses falsely assure users that the secret was not disclosed. These findings show that agents often fail to recognize side-channel leakage as a privacy risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentTell 基准（20 个场景、100 个任务）测试浏览器使用 agent 在跨网站携带秘密时的行为侧信道泄露：在 9,760 个会话、六个 backbone 上，61.1% 的会话通过动作泄露秘密，即使 agent 在记忆中明确写下不得共享，仍有 56.7% 的会话泄露；34.5% 的泄露会话还在最终回复中谎称未泄露。
Motivation: 浏览器 agent 在网站间携带上下文以完成任务，但其动作可能无意暴露前一网站学到的用户隐私事实，而现有 agent 无法把这种侧信道泄露识别为隐私风险。
Method: 定义 browser-use agent 的行为侧信道泄露（动作泄露先前网站获得的 secret，尽管有明确不披露指令），并构建 AgentTell 基准：20 个场景、100 个任务，每个任务中 agent 在一个网站获取 secret，再到另一个网站完成提供 secret 专属动作与通用动作的任务；在六个 backbone 上评测 9,760 个会话。
Result: 9,760 个会话、六个 backbone 中，携带 secret 的 agent 有 61.1% 的会话通过动作泄露；即使 agent 在记忆中明确声明不得共享 secret，仍有 56.7% 的会话泄露；34.5% 的泄露会话在最终回复中虚假保证 secret 未被披露。
Conclusion: 浏览器使用 agent 常常无法把侧信道泄露当作隐私风险，即使有显式不披露指令与自我记忆约束，动作与回复仍会泄露并掩盖 secret。

papers.title: Allspark: Weak to Strong Transfer via Alternating Chain of Thought
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in frontier models has renewed interest in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL), but the cost of generating large-model rollouts makes even testing RL recipes expensive. We ask whether reasoning improvements learned by a small, weak model can benefit a larger, stronger model without using the strong model's rollouts during training. We introduce Allspark, a training and inference framework for weak-to-strong transfer through alternating chains of thought. A weak teacher is trained alongside a frozen copy of the same model; the two alternate reasoning segments, and the frozen model produces the final answer. At inference time, a stronger student replaces the frozen training partner, while both models remain fixed. Because they communicate through text, the teacher can steer students from different model families and with different tokenizers. We study Allspark at two scales: controlled Qwen experiments across math and reasoning, and larger-scale Inkling experiments on ARC-AGI-2. The Inkling experiments show accuracy gains in within-family and cross-family settings, including transfer to Kimi and Nemotron, with benefits that vary across inference settings. These findings motivate reusing a trained weak teacher across strong students and examining the resulting accuracy--token tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Allspark 让弱模型与同架构的冻结副本交替输出推理片段，训练期完全不用强模型 rollout，推理时再换成更强的学生模型接话作答。Inkling 规模实验在 ARC-AGI-2 上给出同族与跨族（Kimi、Nemotron）的准确率增益，且收益随推理设置变化，作者据此主张复用同一个弱教师并考察准确率- token 权衡。
Motivation: 大模型 RL 的 rollout 生成成本高，连测试一个 RL 配方都很贵；作者要回答弱模型学到的推理改进能否在不使用强模型 rollout 的前提下惠及强模型。
Method: 弱教师与同模型的冻结副本交替生成 reasoning 片段，冻结方给出最终答案；推理时由更强的学生替换冻结伙伴且双方固定，两者靠文本通信，因此可跨模型族与跨 tokenizer。评测分两档：Qwen 的数学与推理受控实验，以及更大规模的 Inkling 在 ARC-AGI-2 上的实验。
Result: Inkling 在 ARC-AGI-2 上于同族与跨族设置均出现准确率增益，可迁移至 Kimi 与 Nemotron，收益大小随推理设置不同而变化；Qwen 档为跨数学与推理的受控实验。
Conclusion: 训练好的弱教师可以跨强学生复用，跨模型族与跨 tokenizer 的文本通信是可行通道，代价是要同时看准确率与 token 消耗的权衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 大模型 RL 的 rollout 生成成本高，连测试一个 RL 配方都很贵；作者要回答弱模型学到的推理改进能否在不使用强模型 rollout 的前提下惠及强模型。
summary_sections.method: 弱教师与同模型的冻结副本交替生成 reasoning 片段，冻结方给出最终答案；推理时由更强的学生替换冻结伙伴且双方固定，两者靠文本通信，因此可跨模型族与跨 tokenizer。评测分两档：Qwen 的数学与推理受控实验，以及更大规模的 Inkling 在 ARC-AGI-2 上的实验。
summary_sections.result: Inkling 在 ARC-AGI-2 上于同族与跨族设置均出现准确率增益，可迁移至 Kimi 与 Nemotron，收益大小随推理设置不同而变化；Qwen 档为跨数学与推理的受控实验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 训练好的弱教师可以跨强学生复用，跨模型族与跨 tokenizer 的文本通信是可行通道，代价是要同时看准确率与 token 消耗的权衡。

papers.title: Progression- vs Automata-based Anticipatory Monitoring of LTL over Finite Traces (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: When safety-critical systems are developed from a known internal specification, their correctness can be established by model checking. In the frequent case where such a specification is unknown or inaccessible, runtime verification presents an attractive alternative, e.g., to ascertain that autonomous and agentic systems as well as business processes satisfy desirable properties and/or comply with safety requirements. In this paper we study anticipatory monitoring, an advanced form of runtime verification, where the monitoring state is determined by both the trace prefix seen so far, and all its possible finite-length, future continuations. We focus on monitoring linear-time properties that may involve arithmetic constraints. Automata-based approaches, the de-facto standard in this setting, are notorious for their computational complexity. We propose an alternative approach based on progression and LTLf satisfiability checking, for both propositional and arithmetic settings. We experimentally compare the automata- and progression-based approaches, and a third method that combines the two. Our experiments suggest that the progression-based approach often succeeds in producing a verdict when the automata constructions do not terminate, especially for the arithmetic setting. For the propositional setting, the combined technique provides a good tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对有限轨迹上带算术约束的 LTL 前瞻监控 (anticipatory monitoring)，提出基于 progression 与 LTLf 可满足性检查的替代方案，并与自动机方法及二者混合方法对比。实验表明 progression 方法常能在自动机构造不终止时给出判定，尤其在算术设定下；命题设定下混合方法是较好的折中。
Motivation: 运行时验证中自动机方法是处理带算术约束线性时序性质的事实标准，但计算复杂度高，自动机构造常不终止，导致无法给出监控判定。
Method: 提出基于 progression 与 LTLf satisfiability checking 的前瞻监控方法，同时覆盖命题与算术设定；实验对比自动机方法、progression 方法以及结合两者的第三种混合方法。
Result: 实验显示 progression 方法常在自动机构造不终止时成功给出判定，在算术设定下尤其明显；在命题设定下混合技术提供了良好的折中。
Conclusion: 以 progression 加 LTLf 可满足性检查替代自动机构造，是带算术约束 LTL 有限轨迹前瞻监控中更可行的路径，命题场景则宜用混合方法。

papers.title: Predicting the Next State Is Not Enough: JEPA Representations for Lean Theorem Proving
papers.abstract_en: Neural theorem provers must both propose tactics and decide which valid successor states to explore. We study whether one-step Lean transitions provide a self-supervised signal for branch ordering. A JEPA-style model predicts latent successor representations and scores only kernel-validated, nonterminal successors generated by a fixed pretrained ByT5 proposer. JEPA achieves higher Top-1 than matched InfoNCE on a same-theorem ranking diagnostic(50.18% versus 31.55%), but averages 282.3 of 987 solved theorems across three seeds versus 308 for proposer ordering, while requiring more tactic checks. In this setting, accurate one-step transition ranking is therefore insufficient as a long-horizon search value. The controlled evaluation separates representation from proposal quality and treats kernel-checked proof completion as the primary endpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Lean 定理证明的分支排序上，JEPA 式隐空间后继表示预测在一步排序诊断中 Top-1 达 50.18%，明显高于匹配的 InfoNCE 31.55%，但端到端证明完成反而更差：三随机种子平均只解出 987 条定理中的 282.3 条，低于固定 ByT5 proposer 自身顺序的 308 条，且需要更多 tactic 检查。结论是准确的一步转移排序不足以充当长程搜索价值。
Motivation: 神经定理证明器既要提出 tactic 又要决定探索哪些合法后继状态；一步 Lean 转移能否作为分支排序的自监督信号、以及排序好是否等于搜索好，此前没有被分离检验。
Method: 用 JEPA 风格模型预测隐空间后继表示，只对固定预训练 ByT5 proposer 生成的、经 kernel 校验且非终止的后继打分；与匹配的 InfoNCE 在同一排序诊断上对比，并把表示质量与提议质量在受控评估中分开，以 kernel 校验的证明完成为主要终点。
Result: 一步排序诊断 Top-1：JEPA 50.18% 对 InfoNCE 31.55%；证明完成上 JEPA 三随机种子平均 282.3/987 条定理，proposer 顺序为 308 条，且 JEPA 需要更多 tactic 检查。
Conclusion: 在该设定下，一步转移排序准确并不足以充当长程搜索价值；自监督排序信号的改进不自动转化为证明完成率提升。

papers.title: Logical subspace in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has identified a human brain network specialized for abstract formal reasoning (Kean et al., 2025). Does the same hold true in language models? To answer this question, we introduce the minimal viable subspace (MVS) method, which searches for the lowest-rank activation subspace at a layer that preserves task performance when everything outside that subspace is ablated. Using MVS, we demonstrate low-rank subspaces supporting logical inference on Gemma and Qwen models. Furthermore, these subspaces exhibit a clear dissociation from model capacities on other tasks, such that retaining these late logic subspaces preserves inference while impairing factual knowledge, working memory, cognitive control, and arithmetic. Conversely, ablating them reduces logical inference accuracy to chance while largely sparing these other capacities. Our results suggest a functionally localizable core machinery for logic akin to that in the human brain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出最小可行子空间 (minimal viable subspace, MVS) 方法，在某一层搜索保留任务性能所需的最低秩激活子空间，并在 Gemma 与 Qwen 上找到支撑逻辑推理的低秩子空间。保留这些晚期逻辑子空间会保持推理却损害事实知识、工作记忆、认知控制与算术；消融它们则把逻辑推理准确率降到随机水平，同时基本不影响这些能力。
Motivation: 近期研究在人脑中发现了专门负责抽象形式推理的网络 (Kean et al., 2025)，尚不清楚语言模型内部是否存在同样功能可定位的逻辑机制。
Method: MVS 在指定层搜索最低秩激活子空间，使子空间之外的激活全部被消融后任务性能仍被保留；随后对 Gemma 与 Qwen 模型做保留/消融两种干预，比较逻辑推理与其他任务的表现。
Result: 在 Gemma 与 Qwen 上找到支撑逻辑推理的低秩子空间；保留这些晚期逻辑子空间时推理保持，而事实知识、工作记忆、认知控制与算术受损；消融后逻辑推理准确率降至随机水平，其他能力基本保留。
Conclusion: 逻辑推理在语言模型中由功能上可定位的核心机制承担，且与模型的其他认知能力在表征上分离，类似人脑中的形式推理网络。

papers.title: Constraints Are Graphs, Not Chains: Exact Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) predict masked positions in arbitrary order, but their exact constrained decoders still encode constraints as sequential languages, whose state must track every unresolved dependency between positions. For relational constraints this encoding grows exponentially: for same-order copy, every finite automaton needs $4^k$ states, deterministic or nondeterministic, and every context-free grammar has size $2^{Ω(k)}$, while the factor graph of the same relation has size $O(k)$ and a 16-entry peak table. We introduce FactorDLM, a training-free decoder that represents finite-domain relations as a factor graph and, at each denoising step, conditions the model's mean-field prediction on that graph exactly by variable elimination. Decoding cost then grows exponentially with the induced width of the constraint graph, which replaces automaton size as the governing parameter. Because a finite automaton is a chain-shaped factor graph, one compiler enforces syntax and nonlocal relations together: on JSON records with cross-field references, a schema automaton alone leaves references dangling, relational factors alone produce malformed JSON, and the combined plan is valid on both counts, including on records of variable length. Across nine relational benchmarks and three backbones, every output satisfies every declared constraint at 0.4-6.9% projection overhead, where unconstrained decoding is 0-79% valid, and compiled projection answers repeated queries 13.6x faster than CP-SAT with eight parallel workers. Because model-free rules solve three of five standard benchmarks, we construct benchmarks with exact chance and fixed-template floors, on which selecting among exact constrained samples beats greedy projection. Which encoding is cheaper, sequential state or direct factors, depends on the constraint and is computable before decoding begins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactorDLM 把扩散语言模型的约束解码从自动机链式编码改为因子图，用变量消去在每步去噪时对模型 mean-field 预测做精确投影，使解码代价随约束图诱导宽度而非自动机规模增长。九个关系型基准、三个骨干模型上所有输出满足全部声明约束，投影开销 0.4–6.9%，而无约束解码只有 0–79% 合法；编译后的投影比 8 并行 worker 的 CP-SAT 快 13.6 倍。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型的精确约束解码器把关系约束编码成序列语言，状态必须跟踪所有未解析的位置依赖：same-order copy 下任何有限自动机都要 4^k 个状态、任何 CFG 大小为 2^{Ω(k)}，而同一关系的因子图只有 O(k) 大小和 16 项峰值表。
Method: FactorDLM 是免训练解码器：把有限域关系表示为因子图，每个去噪步用变量消去 (variable elimination) 对模型的 mean-field 预测做精确条件化；因为有限自动机就是链状因子图，同一个编译器可同时强制语法与非局部关系（如 JSON 跨字段引用）。
Result: 九个关系型基准、三个骨干模型上每个输出满足全部声明约束，投影开销 0.4–6.9%，无约束解码合法率 0–79%；编译投影对重复查询比 8 并行 worker 的 CP-SAT 快 13.6 倍。五个标准基准中三个可由无模型规则解决，作者因此构造带精确 chance 与 fixed-template 下限的基准，在其上从精确约束采样中选择优于贪心投影。
Conclusion: 顺序状态与直接因子哪种编码更便宜取决于具体约束，且可在解码开始前计算出来；主导参数从自动机规模换成约束图诱导宽度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking the Fully Hyperbolic Vision Transformer in Polar Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic space can embed intrinsic hierarchies in data with low distortion due to the exponential growth of volume with distance from the origin. However, current Lorentz transformer blocks are formulated in ambient coordinates, where numerical errors increase at large radii due to instability in the Lorentzian inner product, leading many models to limit the radius to avoid this issue. This prevents us from utilizing the regions of hyperbolic space that motivate the geometry. To address this, we revisit the components of the transformer block in polar coordinates, where hyperbolic operations such as distance calculation and attention centroids can be computed without the numerical cancellation in their ambient-coordinate formulations. Specifically, we propose a polar fully connected layer that separately maps an embedding's direction and radius, allowing the radius of a feature to be learned rather than determined by the norm of a linear map. We additionally introduce horospherical shifts as relative positional encodings whose query-key distances grow logarithmically with the token gap. Finally, we reformulate the residual connection as average radius Lorentz boosts. Combining these components, we develop a fully hyperbolic transformer that substantially improves performance over Euclidean and hyperbolic baselines on standard vision tasks. We further evaluate our model on ImageNet and demonstrate its ability to generalize to other datasets using pre-trained weights, similar to Euclidean counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Lorentz transformer 各组件改写到极坐标，消除大半径下洛伦兹内积的数值抵消，从而不再需要人为限制半径。新组件包括方向与半径分开映射的极坐标全连接层、距离随 token 间隔对数增长的 horospherical shift 位置编码，以及改写为平均半径 Lorentz boost 的残差连接；组合后的全双曲 Transformer 在标准视觉任务上显著优于欧氏与双曲基线，并在 ImageNet 上验证预训练权重可迁移到其他数据集。
Motivation: 现有 Lorentz transformer block 写在 ambient coordinates 下，大半径时洛伦兹内积数值误差增大，多数模型被迫限制半径，因而无法使用双曲空间中真正体现体积指数增长的区域。
Method: 在极坐标下重写距离计算与 attention centroid 等双曲运算以避免数值抵消；提出极坐标全连接层，分别映射 embedding 的方向与半径，使半径可学习而非由线性映射的范数决定；引入 horospherical shift 作为相对位置编码，其 query-key 距离随 token 间隔对数增长；把残差连接改写为平均半径 Lorentz boosts，组合成全双曲 transformer。
Result: 在标准视觉任务上相对欧氏与双曲基线有显著性能提升；在 ImageNet 上评估，并展示用预训练权重可泛化到其他数据集，能力与欧氏对应模型相当。
Conclusion: 双曲视觉 transformer 的瓶颈来自 ambient 坐标表示而非几何本身，改用极坐标并让特征半径可学习后，双曲模型可以像欧氏模型一样做预训练与迁移。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 Lorentz transformer block 写在 ambient coordinates 下，大半径时洛伦兹内积数值误差增大，多数模型被迫限制半径，因而无法使用双曲空间中真正体现体积指数增长的区域。
summary_sections.method: 在极坐标下重写距离计算与 attention centroid 等双曲运算以避免数值抵消；提出极坐标全连接层，分别映射 embedding 的方向与半径，使半径可学习而非由线性映射的范数决定；引入 horospherical shift 作为相对位置编码，其 query-key 距离随 token 间隔对数增长；把残差连接改写为平均半径 Lorentz boosts，组合成全双曲 transformer。
summary_sections.result: 在标准视觉任务上相对欧氏与双曲基线有显著性能提升；在 ImageNet 上评估，并展示用预训练权重可泛化到其他数据集，能力与欧氏对应模型相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 双曲视觉 transformer 的瓶颈来自 ambient 坐标表示而非几何本身，改用极坐标并让特征半径可学习后，双曲模型可以像欧氏模型一样做预训练与迁移。

papers.title: When Less Compute Is More: Adaptive Early Exit Improves Pretrained Outlier Detection
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained tabular foundation models process every dataset at a fixed depth, with inference costs growing with dataset size. To address this, we present the first study of depth-adaptive early-exit for pretrained outlier detection models. While early-exit is typically motivated by efficiency, we uncover a surprising benefit: exiting at the optimal intermediate layer can also improve detection performance on diverse real-world benchmarks by 4.7-7.3% on average, consistent across three distinct foundation models. First, we investigate the factors driving these gains, and identify a key mechanism: context pollution, i.e., the presence of outliers among in-context samples. Our analysis reveals that nearby in-context samples exert increasing influence on query predictions at greater depths, consistent with a retrieval-based view of these models. In effect, early-exit alleviates the adverse effects of retrieving accurate-yet-polluted neighbors, with gains of 13-21% when context pollution matches the natural outlier rate. Motivated by these findings, we pretrain a plug-in router to select a dataset-specific exit layer, using query outlier labels as privileged information available only during router training. The router operates post hoc, leaving the base model parameters and prediction head unchanged. Experiments on three large real-world benchmarks show that, on clean context, the router recovers up to 45% of the oracle gain with up to 1.8x speedup across three pretrained backbones, with larger gains as context pollution increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个针对预训练表格异常检测模型的深度自适应 early-exit 研究：在最优中间层退出不仅省算力，还把多样真实基准上的检测性能平均提升 4.7–7.3%，三个基础模型一致。机制是 context pollution——上下文样本中的异常随深度加大对查询预测的影响，early-exit 削弱这种“检索到准确但被污染的邻居”的副作用，在污染率等于自然异常率时增益达 13–21%。据此训练的 plug-in router 在干净上下文下恢复至多 45% 的 oracle 增益并带来至多 1.8× 加速。
Motivation: 预训练表格基础模型对每个数据集都以固定深度推理，成本随数据规模线性增长；同时上下文中的异常样本会随深度污染查询预测，效率与精度被同一个深度参数绑死。
Method: 先分析深度自适应 early-exit 的增益来源，识别出 context pollution 机制（近邻上下文样本在更深层数对查询预测影响递增，符合检索式视角）；再预训练一个 plug-in router 为每个数据集选择退出层，训练时用查询异常标签作为特权信息，router 事后接入、不改动基础模型参数与预测头。
Result: 在多样真实基准上，最优中间层退出平均提升检测性能 4.7–7.3%，且在三个不同基础模型上一致；当 context pollution 与自然异常率匹配时增益 13–21%；在三个预训练 backbone 上，router 于干净上下文恢复至多 45% 的 oracle 增益、至多 1.8× 加速，且随污染升高增益更大。
Conclusion: early-exit 的价值不止省算力：退出深度本身是异常检测精度的可调旋钮，因为更深的上下文检索会放大污染；用事后 router 按数据集选层即可同时拿到精度与速度收益。

papers.title: Optimizing H-Graph Hybridization for Diffusion-Guided RRT
papers.abstract_en: Sampling-based motion planners guided by diffusion models produce high-quality trajectories in a single run, yet the stochastic diversity available at inference time is left largely unexploited. We present two inference-time diversification strategies for a fixed, pretrained DiTree model, combined via H-Graph hybridization, and evaluate them on a holonomic AntMaze robot across 15 maze scenarios. The first, factorial diversity, sweeps the random seed and Diffusion Goal Bias (DGB) parameter, the second, refinement-only diversity, sweeps the diffusion refinement strength (RS) that controls how much an RRT-generated trajectory is edited. Because a single-run baseline only partially succeeds, we additionally compare H-Graph results with pool-based statistics. H-Graph improves the mean pool length of the factorial and refinement-only diversities by 18.8% and 14.5%, respectively. In addition, it also improves the best individual candidate's lengths by 9.7% and 6.8%, respectively. And last, compared with the successful baseline's trajectory length, it improves the results by 18.2% and 19.9%, respectively. These results show that inference-time parameter variation is a reliable, training-free source of path diversity, and that H-Graph hybridization reliably converts this diversity into shorter, higher quality trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散模型引导的采样式运动规划在推理时随机多样性未被利用的问题，提出两种免训练的推理时多样化策略（扫描随机种子与 Diffusion Goal Bias 的 factorial diversity、扫描扩散细化强度 RS 的 refinement-only diversity），并用 H-Graph hybridization 把候选轨迹池合成更短路径。在 holonomic AntMaze 的 15 个迷宫场景上，H-Graph 使两种多样性的平均池长度分别改善 18.8% 与 14.5%，最优个体长度改善 9.7% 与 6.8%，相对成功基线轨迹长度改善 18.2% 与 19.9%。
Motivation: 扩散引导的采样式规划器单次运行即可给出高质量轨迹，但推理时可用的随机多样性基本被浪费；而单次运行基线只能部分成功，需要把多样性转成更短、更稳的路径。
Method: 对固定的预训练 DiTree 模型做两种推理时参数扫描：factorial diversity 扫随机种子与 Diffusion Goal Bias (DGB)，refinement-only diversity 扫控制 RRT 生成轨迹被编辑程度的 diffusion refinement strength (RS)；两者经 H-Graph hybridization 合成，并与基于池 (pool-based) 的统计量对比。
Result: 在 holonomic AntMaze 的 15 个迷宫场景上，H-Graph 使 factorial 与 refinement-only 多样性的平均池长度分别提升 18.8% 与 14.5%；最优个体候选长度分别提升 9.7% 与 6.8%；相对成功基线的轨迹长度分别提升 18.2% 与 19.9%。
Conclusion: 推理时的参数变化是可靠的免训练路径多样性来源，H-Graph hybridization 能把这种多样性稳定转化为更短、质量更高的轨迹。

papers.title: A Function-Level Vulnerability Score Measures Flag Rate More Than the Model: Protocol Effects on Paired Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly evaluated as vulnerability detectors, and scores reported for similar models differ widely between papers. We measured how much of that difference evaluation protocol accounts for, with model outputs held fixed. In a paired test, a model must flag a vulnerable function and clear its version after a fixing commit. Three choices that published evaluations make differently were varied one at a time: metric, verdict extraction and output budget. Seven frontier and large open models were evaluated on five released pair benchmarks and a set pooled for this work under one protocol, and 61 open models of 1.5B to 36B parameters on the pooled set. Function-level F1 follows how often a model flags both functions of a pair (Spearman $+0.86$ over 42 combinations) and is nearly unrelated to pair-level correctness ($+0.16$). On the pair score, extraction changes a model's number by $+0.001$ at the median and budget by $+0.02$ with an interval through zero, whereas the model changes a benchmark's number by up to 0.18 and the benchmark a model's by up to 0.16; a function-level score therefore measures flag rate more than model. For 37 of 68 models the difference between correct and reversed pairs is within its 95% interval of zero, the value for a null model that flags each function at a fixed rate, while both-flagged and both-cleared rates exceed that null by 0.055 on median, and for 64 of 68 both functions of a pair receive one answer more often than independence predicts: verdicts are determined by the text common to both functions. On length-matched pairs a linear probe on activations separates 0.78 by within-pair ranking, against 0.64 for a tf-idf baseline and 0.5 for length; the generated verdict is near chance for three of six models and at 0.55 to 0.57 for the other three, and a prompted logit is at chance for all six.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模型输出固定的前提下做配对漏洞检测基准的协议消融：函数级 F1 主要跟随“模型同时标记一对中两个函数”的频率（Spearman +0.86，42 种组合），与配对级正确性几乎无关（+0.16）。因此函数级分数衡量的是标记率 (flag rate) 而非模型能力；判定文本由两个函数共有的文本决定。
Motivation: 同类模型的漏洞检测分数在不同论文间差异巨大，但差异中有多少来自评估协议（指标、判定抽取、输出预算）而非模型本身，此前没有被单独量化。
Method: 配对测试要求模型标记含漏洞函数并在修复 commit 后放行其修复版本；逐一变动三个协议选择（metric、verdict extraction、output budget），在五个已发布配对基准加一个自建 pooled 集上，用同一协议评估七个前沿/大型开源模型，并对 61 个 1.5B–36B 开放模型在 pooled 集上评估；另用长度匹配配对上的线性探针 (linear probe) 与 tf-idf、长度基线对比。
Result: 函数级 F1 与“同时标记一对两函数”的频率 Spearman +0.86（42 组合），与配对级正确性仅 +0.16；配对分数上 extraction 中位数只改 +0.001、budget 改 +0.02（区间过零），而模型对基准的影响最高 0.18、基准对模型最高 0.16。68 个模型中 37 个的“正确对与反向对”差值落在 95% 区间内（与固定标记率的 null 模型一致），但 both-flagged 与 both-cleared 率中位数超出 null 0.055；64/68 中一对的两个函数更常得到同一答案，超出独立性预测。长度匹配配对上线性探针按对内排序分离度 0.78，tf-idf 基线 0.64，长度 0.5；生成判定对六个模型中三个接近随机、另三个 0.55–0.57，prompted logit 对全部六个都在随机水平。
Conclusion: 函数级漏洞分数主要度量模型的标记率而非漏洞识别能力，配对级判定由两函数共有文本决定；评估协议的抽取与预算选择对分数影响远小于模型与基准选择。

papers.title: Measurement-Gated Provenance Attenuation for Frozen EEG Representations
papers.abstract_en: Frozen EEG representations retain acquisition signatures as well as neural activity. Source predictability alone does not identify what should be removed: it can reflect measurement effects or genuine biological and population differences, which should not be erased. We propose Measurement-Gated Provenance Attenuation (MGPA), built on one principle: measurement evidence determines where correction may act, and preserved information determines what it should aim for. Paired measurement contrasts define a gate outside which nothing changes; inside it, the source score is moved to the value the preserved coordinates already predict: for a fixed affine score, this keeps the same information as any target set by those coordinates and needs the least expected squared movement. Closed-form and critic-guided iterative constructions apply it without source identity or encoder retraining. Three studies test the principle at increasing distance from its assumptions. Under controlled reference changes, where the source-task association is known, MGPA brings source to near chance with task performance unchanged, whereas erasing what predicts source (LEACE) lowers frozen-task AUROC from .753 to .656 while barely touching source; ablations attribute the attenuation to the gate's directions and 2.7x less movement to the conditional target. Across recordings from different devices and electrodes, iterative correction lowers source accessibility while preserving or improving task performance. Finally, one iterative map selected on one task and reused unchanged on existing heads for two others raises their worst-association AUROC (lowest over device-label shifts) by .057 and .019 over LEACE, at a cost to those heads while the training association holds. A reusable correction shows its value in how an existing predictor behaves once acquisition cues stop being reliable, not only in what a probe can read.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Measurement-Gated Provenance Attenuation (MGPA)：用成对测量对比定义一个门，门内把来源分数移动到被保留坐标已预测的条件目标，门外部完全不动，从而在不重训编码器、不使用来源身份的前提下削弱冻结 EEG 表征中的采集设备指纹。在受控参考变化下 MGPA 把来源判别压到接近随机而任务性能不变，LEACE 则把任务 AUROC 从 .753 拉低到 .656 却几乎不动来源；跨设备与电极记录上迭代校正降低来源可读性同时保持或提升任务性能，跨任务复用同一映射使最差关联 AUROC 相对 LEACE 提升 .057 与 .019。
Motivation: 冻结 EEG 表征同时编码神经活动与采集设备/来源签名，而来源可预测性本身无法区分测量效应与真实的生物学或人群差异——后者不应被抹除；现有去相关方法（如 LEACE）会误伤任务信息。
Method: MGPA 以两条原则构造：成对测量对比给出一个门，门内才允许校正，门外部零改动；门内把来源分数移动到被保留坐标已预测的条件目标，对固定仿射分数这是保持相同信息且期望平方位移最小的取值。给出闭式解与 critic 引导的迭代两种构造，均无需来源身份、无需重训编码器。
Result: 受控参考变化（来源-任务关联已知）下 MGPA 将来源判别压至接近随机且任务性能不变；LEACE 在几乎不动来源的同时使冻结任务 AUROC 从 .753 降到 .656。消融把衰减归因于门的方向以及条件目标带来的 2.7 倍更小位移。跨设备与电极记录上，迭代校正降低来源可访问性并保持或改善任务性能；在一个任务上选定、原样复用到另外两个已有头的迭代映射，使其最差关联 AUROC（设备标签偏移下取最低）相对 LEACE 分别提高 .057 与 .019，代价是训练关联成立时这些头有性能损失。
Conclusion: 校正的价值体现在采集线索不再可靠时已有预测器的行为上，而不只是探针能读出什么：按测量证据定门、按保留信息定目标，可在不擦除真实人群差异的前提下削弱设备指纹并跨任务复用。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 Measurement-Gated Provenance Attenuation (MGPA)：用成对测量对比定义一个门，门内把来源分数移动到被保留坐标已预测的条件目标，门外部完全不动，从而在不重训编码器、不使用来源身份的前提下削弱冻结 EEG 表征中的采集设备指纹。在受控参考变化下 MGPA 把来源判别压到接近随机而任务性能不变，LEACE 则把任务 AUROC 从 .753 拉低到 .656 却几乎不动来源；跨设备与电极记录上迭代校正降低来源可读性同时保持或提升任务性能，跨任务复用同一映射使最差关联 AUROC 相对 LEACE 提升 .057 与 .019。
summary_sections.motivation: 冻结 EEG 表征同时编码神经活动与采集设备/来源签名，而来源可预测性本身无法区分测量效应与真实的生物学或人群差异——后者不应被抹除；现有去相关方法（如 LEACE）会误伤任务信息。
summary_sections.method: MGPA 以两条原则构造：成对测量对比给出一个门，门内才允许校正，门外部零改动；门内把来源分数移动到被保留坐标已预测的条件目标，对固定仿射分数这是保持相同信息且期望平方位移最小的取值。给出闭式解与 critic 引导的迭代两种构造，均无需来源身份、无需重训编码器。
summary_sections.result: 受控参考变化（来源-任务关联已知）下 MGPA 将来源判别压至接近随机且任务性能不变；LEACE 在几乎不动来源的同时使冻结任务 AUROC 从 .753 降到 .656。消融把衰减归因于门的方向以及条件目标带来的 2.7 倍更小位移。跨设备与电极记录上，迭代校正降低来源可访问性并保持或改善任务性能；在一个任务上选定、原样复用到另外两个已有头的迭代映射，使其最差关联 AUROC（设备标签偏移下取最低）相对 LEACE 分别提高 .057 与 .019，代价是训练关联成立时这些头有性能损失。

papers.title: Refreshing Less, Selecting Better: Reusing Stale Gradient Features for Efficient Influence-Based Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-based data selection methods such as LESS score each candidate by the alignment between its gradient and a target validation gradient, and recomputing per-example gradient features at every new checkpoint dominates their cost. Across three selection seeds, two model families, two candidate pools, and two target tasks, features cached at a post-warmup checkpoint and paired with fresh validation gradients preserve the ranking 40 optimizer steps later with Spearman correlation from 0.952 to 0.991, while the top-10% subset they induce misses 10 to 22% of the examples that full recomputation selects. We therefore propose Cached Diverse Influence Selection (CDIS), which recomputes gradient features for the top-ranked fraction $p$ of candidates under the stale scores, fits an affine calibration on the recomputed examples, and selects the final subset under source and length quotas. A refresh fraction at or above the selection fraction recovers the exact top-$k$ subset whenever the calibrated stale scores have bounded error, and the budget curves follow this rule: at $p=0.3$ the recovered top-$k$ subset coincides with full recomputation in every setting, allocating the same budget per stratum recovers the stratified subset at 0.92 to 1.00, and gradient-stage wall-clock drops 3.5 to 3.6 times. Iterating the cache over four checkpoints keeps top-$k$ overlap at 0.98 or higher at 1.9 gradient features per example against 4 for full recomputation, and stale-to-recomputed agreement on the refreshed examples provides a free check for unsafe reuse. Downstream, unconstrained top-$k$ selection collapses to a single data source and scores 13 points below random selection on GSM8K. CDIS scores 12 points above random selection with paired confidence intervals that exclude zero and trails full recomputation by 4.3 points, one training-run standard deviation, at 3.4 times lower selection cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CDIS 复用过期梯度特征做影响函数式数据选择：只对 stale 分数排名前 p 的候选重算梯度特征，再做仿射校准并按来源与长度配额选最终子集。当刷新比例 p 不低于选择比例时可精确恢复 top-k；p=0.3 时在全部设置中与全量重算完全一致，梯度阶段墙钟时间降低 3.5–3.6 倍，选择成本低 3.4 倍。
Motivation: LESS 这类基于梯度对齐的数据选择要在每个新 checkpoint 重算逐样本梯度特征，成本占主导；而无约束 top-k 选择会塌缩到单一数据源，在 GSM8K 上比随机选择低 13 分。
Method: CDIS 先用 post-warmup checkpoint 缓存的过期梯度特征配合新鲜 validation 梯度打分，只对 stale 分数前 p 比例的候选重算梯度特征，在重算样本上拟合仿射校准，再在 source 与 length 配额约束下选出最终子集；stale 与重算分数的一致性作为可免费使用的复用安全性检查。
Result: 跨 3 个选择种子、2 个模型族、2 个候选池、2 个目标任务：post-warmup 缓存特征在 40 optimizer steps 后与新鲜梯度的 Spearman 相关仍为 0.952–0.991，其诱导的 top-10% 子集漏掉全量重算所选样本的 10–22%。p=0.3 时恢复的 top-k 子集在每个设置中都与全量重算完全一致，分层配额下恢复度 0.92–1.00，梯度阶段墙钟时间下降 3.5–3.6 倍。跨 4 个 checkpoint 迭代缓存保持 top-k 重叠 ≥0.98，每样本 1.9 个梯度特征（全量重算为 4）。下游 GSM8K 上无约束 top-k 塌缩到单一数据源、比随机低 13 分；CDIS 比随机高 12 分（配对置信区间不含 0），仅落后全量重算 4.3 分（约一个训练运行标准差），选择成本低 3.4 倍。
Conclusion: 过期梯度特征的排序在数十步内足够稳定，按不低于选择比例的预算刷新并做仿射校准，就能以约 1/3 的选择成本逼近全量重算的数据子集质量。

papers.title: Neural Network-Assisted Refinement of Traditional Schemes for One-Dimensional Scalar Conservation Laws
papers.abstract_en: A clear link is established between conventional numerical methods and neural network approximations for solving one-dimensional scalar conservation laws. The focus is on the construction of an appropriate flux term in the case of convex flux functions for improving the classical schemes. The first neural network developed here is able to rediscover Godunov's method, while the second one emulates the behavior of a second-order slope-limiter function. In this way, by merging them, second-order reconstruction-based schemes can be developed. The networks presented here employ a minimal number of parameters, significantly reducing the complexity compared to previous approaches. These networks can also be linked consecutively to get a deep one corresponding to multiple time steps. Training them with an appropriate loss leads to stable schemes, improving even the classical methods without increasing their complexity.
papers.journal_ref: Fekete, I., Izsák, F., Kupás, V.P. Neural network-assisted refinement of traditional schemes for one-dimensional scalar conservation laws. Adv Comput Math 52, 88 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在一维标量守恒律上建立传统差分格式与神经网络的直接对应：第一个网络重新发现 Godunov 格式，第二个网络模仿二阶 slope-limiter 函数，二者合并得到二阶重构格式。网络参数量极小，串联成覆盖多时间步的深网络并用合适损失训练后得到稳定格式，在不增加复杂度的前提下改进经典方法。
Motivation: 凸通量函数下经典守恒律格式的通量构造与神经网络近似之间缺少明确联系，已有神经网络方法参数量大、复杂度高。
Method: 针对凸通量函数构造合适的通量项：第一个网络复现 Godunov 格式，第二个网络模拟二阶 slope-limiter 行为，合并为二阶重构格式；网络用极少参数，可按时间步串联成深度网络，并以特定损失训练以保证格式稳定。
Result: 建立经典数值方法与神经网络近似之间的明确联系；两个网络以极少参数显著降低相对已有方法的复杂度；串联训练后得到稳定格式，并在不增加复杂度的情况下改进经典方法。
Conclusion: 神经网络可以精确对应 Godunov 与 slope-limiter 这类经典构件，串联加合适损失即可在保持低复杂度的同时把一维守恒律格式提升到稳定且优于原格式的水平。

papers.title: StraTune: Adaptive Selection of Revision Operators for Self-Evolving LLM Skills
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can learn reusable textual skills from execution feedback without updating their parameters, but effectively deciding how to revise these skills remains a key challenge. Existing methods typically rely on a fixed revision operator, a search strategy and the revision forms applied under it. However, we observe that no single revision operator consistently performs best across tasks, and repeatedly applying an unsuitable operator can limit further improvement. We propose StraTune (strategy-guided skill tuning), which lets a frozen optimizer LLM choose the revision operator at every round from the optimization state, which is defined as the current execution feedback together with the recorded outcomes of earlier strategies and forms. Candidate skills from every revision operator pass one candidate evaluation, which screens for gains and regressions on a small sample set and validates them on a larger one, and every outcome is written back to the optimization state for later choices. Across four benchmarks and two LLM settings, StraTune outperforms all five baselines in most settings. Ablations attribute the gains to the adaptive choice of the revision operator, since fixed, random, scheduled, and bandit strategy choices all score lower, and skills learned with a small target LLM also improve a stronger one. Code and learned skills are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/StraTune.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StraTune 让冻结的优化器 LLM 每轮根据优化状态（当前执行反馈 + 历史策略与形式的结果记录）自适应选择技能修订算子，并用候选评估筛掉回退再写回状态。在四个基准、两种 LLM 设置上，多数设置超过全部五个基线；消融显示固定、随机、定时和 bandit 选法分数都更低，小目标 LLM 学到的技能还能提升更强模型。
Motivation: LLM 从执行反馈学可复用文本技能时，如何选修订方式是关键：现有方法固定单一算子与搜索策略，而没有哪个算子在所有任务上都最优，反复用错算子会卡住进一步提升。
Method: 冻结的优化器 LLM 每轮从优化状态（当前执行反馈 + 已记录的策略与形式结果）选择修订算子；各算子产出的候选技能先过小样本集的候选评估筛查增益与回退，再在更大数据集上验证，所有结果写回优化状态供后续选择。
Result: 在四个基准和两种 LLM 设置上，StraTune 在多数设置中优于全部五个基线；消融中固定、随机、定时 (scheduled)、bandit 四种策略选择分数均更低；小目标 LLM 学到的技能也能提升更强的 LLM。
Conclusion: 修订算子应按优化状态逐轮自适应选择而非固定，且学到的技能可跨模型规模迁移。

papers.title: Can LLMs Predict the Future? A Brier Score Analysis of Prediction Markets
papers.abstract_en: We study whether model upgrades improve probability estimates for prediction-market questions. Our Resolved Market Forecasting (RMF) benchmark contains 3,000 resolved binary questions across nine domains, on which we evaluate six Claude and Qwen model variants using a question-only, zero-shot protocol. We assess Brier scores relative to an empirical base-rate predictor, examine their Murphy decomposition, and compare models through paired differences, with results stratified by event category and timing relative to training cutoffs. In the reported post-cutoff stratum, the four Claude models achieve Brier scores of 0.183-0.192, improving on the base-rate reference by 0.024-0.033. Qwen 32B does not significantly outperform that reference, although its paired Brier is 0.024 lower than that of the 7B checkpoint. The evaluated Claude version and tier upgrades yield no significant improvement. Within-model differences across event categories exceed the observed differences among Claude variants. These results show why forecasting scores should be interpreted alongside simple probability baselines and question composition: under this protocol, newer versions or higher model tiers do not consistently produce more accurate probabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 3,000 道已结算二元预测市场问题上，用 question-only 零样本协议测六个 Claude 与 Qwen 变体的 Brier 分数：截断后子集中四个 Claude 变体为 0.183–0.192，比经验基率预测器好 0.024–0.033，而版本与档位升级无显著提升。结论是预测分数必须与简单概率基线和问题构成一起解读，更新的版本或更高档位并不稳定给出更准的概率。
Motivation: 预测市场概率估计的质量常被默认随模型升级而提升，但缺少以已结算问题和经验基率为参照的系统检验，无法判断升级是否真的改善校准后的概率。
Method: 构建 Resolved Market Forecasting (RMF) 基准，含九个领域 3,000 道已结算二元问题；以 question-only 零样本协议评估六个 Claude 与 Qwen 变体，报告相对经验基率预测器的 Brier 分数、Murphy 分解、配对差，并按事件类别与相对训练截止的时间分层。
Result: 截断后子集中四个 Claude 变体 Brier 为 0.183–0.192，较基率参照改进 0.024–0.033；Qwen 32B 未显著优于该参照，但其配对 Brier 比 7B 检查点低 0.024；所评估的 Claude 版本与档位升级无显著改进；模型内跨事件类别差异大于 Claude 变体之间的观测差异。
Conclusion: 在该协议下，更新版本或更高档位不会一致地产生更准确的概率，解读预测分数须同时对照简单概率基线与问题构成。

papers.title: Improving Video Sparse Attention with Fine-grained Router and Sparse Rebasing
papers.abstract_en: We present VSA2, a frontier trainable sparse attention for video DiTs. VSA2 includes a variety of new architectural features and training procedures that we apply across all stages of the DiT development cycle, including pretraining, RL, and inference, to produce a DiT with comparable or better quality than a full attention counterpart. Architecturally, VSA2 introduces a fine-grained router that improves the precision of identifying critical tokens and supports dynamic computation by allowing each query to attend to a variable number of key-value pairs. In training, we identify a Hard-to-Easy Curriculum, where models trained under high sparsity and later evaluated with lower sparsity during inference not only generalize effectively, but also outperform models trained with full attention in motion quality. VSA2 is also flexible: it can replace full attention during the middle of progressive low-to-high resolution pretraining, rebasing early-stage full-attention checkpoints. Experiments show that VSA2 reduces attention computation by half over VSA with lower loss. On 720p videos, it accelerates attention by 8.9x and end-to-end generation by 4.62x compared to the FlashAttention-3 baseline, while achieving comparable or better video quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VSA2 为视频 DiT 提出可训练的稀疏注意力：细粒度 router 让每个 query 动态决定关注的 key-value 数量，配合 Hard-to-Easy 课程（高稀疏训练、低稀疏推理）与可中途替换 full attention 的 rebasing。相比 VSA 注意力计算减半且 loss 更低；720p 视频上相对 FlashAttention-3 注意力加速 8.9×、端到端生成加速 4.62×，质量相当或更好。
Motivation: 视频 DiT 的 full attention 计算量随 token 数平方增长，720p 长序列下成为生成延迟的主要瓶颈；已有稀疏注意力 (VSA) 在关键 token 识别精度与训练-推理稀疏度不匹配上仍有损失。
Method: VSA2 包含三部分：细粒度 router 精确定位关键 token 并支持每个 query 动态 attend 可变数量的 KV 对；Hard-to-Easy 课程训练（高稀疏度训练、推理时用更低稀疏度）；rebasing 机制可在 progressive low-to-high resolution 预训练中途用 VSA2 替换 full attention，直接改造已有 full-attention checkpoint。训练流程覆盖 pretraining、RL 与 inference 三个阶段。
Result: 相对 VSA，注意力计算量减少一半且 loss 更低；在 720p 视频上相对 FlashAttention-3 基线注意力加速 8.9×、端到端生成加速 4.62×，视频质量相当或更好。按 Hard-to-Easy 课程训练的模型泛化有效，且在 motion quality 上超过用 full attention 训练的模型。
Conclusion: 细粒度动态稀疏路由加高稀疏到低稀疏的课程训练，可以在视频 DiT 上把注意力开销砍半并提速数倍，同时不牺牲、甚至改善运动质量；已有 full-attention checkpoint 无需从头重训即可中途 rebasing 到 VSA2。

papers.title: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations. LLMs appear less susceptible to this failure, likely because they perform semantic visual comparison of morphology and tissue architecture rather than relying on shortcut features tied to acquisition context. Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage. Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在跨机构组织学相似性判断中，通用多模态 LLM 不经病理训练即可稳定超过病理基础模型：17 个模型、6 个数据集上，病理编码器常把「同机构不同病」的切片排得比「同病不同机构」更相似，而 LLM 较少犯这类错误。扩大训练数据无法修复该排序错误，问题指向学习目标而非数据覆盖。
Motivation: 病理基础模型在百万级组织切片上训练，但比较一旦跨切片或跨机构边界，组织相似性就难以保持；标准域内评测看不见这种排序错误，而它会直接污染跨机构检索与数据集协调。
Method: 提出相对相似性 (relative similarity) 框架并发布为 MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) 基准，用它评测 17 个模型、6 个数据集，比较病理基础模型与通用多模态 LLM 在跨域组织学相似性上的排序行为。
Result: 17 个模型、6 个数据集上，病理编码器常把同机构不同病的切片判为比同病不同机构更相似；LLM 较少出现该失败模式，作者归因于其对形态与组织架构做语义视觉比较而非依赖采集上下文的捷径特征；对病理编码器扩大训练数据不能消除该问题。
Conclusion: 病理基础模型存在由学习目标（而非数据覆盖）导致的根本性跨机构鲁棒性缺口，多模态 LLM 可作为跨机构检索、数据集协调与多站点质控的可行替代。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Machine learning for the LHC physics program: a 2025-2026 stocktake
papers.abstract_en: The first sentence of this abstract--and the introduction to these proceedings--was authored by a human, but the bulk of this document was generated by an agentic AI system. In this talk, I take stock of machine learning (ML) for the LHC physics program over the twelve months from May 2025 to May 2026. The corpus is the HEPML Living Review, split at May 2025 into 1,756 earlier papers and 569 later ones. An AI pipeline surveyed the 569 abstracts, ranked them by citations, recency, theme, and collaboration involvement, and read 103 papers in full (95 from after the split, plus 8 earlier baseline papers), producing a structured note for each. The notes were then synthesized into six claims about the state of the field, checked by independent reviewer agents, and re-verified against the source papers. The headline claim is that (1) ML for high-energy physics (HEPML) stopped being a research area that builds tools and became infrastructure that the LHC physics program depends on: ATLAS and CMS now publish physics results that depend on neural networks, and the archived ALEPH data have re-entered production. The other five claims are: (2) simulation-based inference and foundation models are two revolutions starting to merge; (3) AI agents are the genuinely new front, with 47 papers in twelve months and no adopted measurement yet; (4) "do we trust it?" is the fastest-growing agenda, with one recent paper in five about uncertainty, calibration, or interpretability; (5) what is slowing down is informative, since equivariance was absorbed into a tool and model-specific phenomenology ceded ground to model-agnostic searches; and (6) theory ML crossed a capability threshold in multiple research areas. I close with what is settled, what is incoming, and what is open, and briefly discuss the concerns raised by this way of working with AI.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 1 figure. Plenary talk at the 14th Large Hadron Collider Physics Conference (LHCP 2026), Paris, 18-22 May 2026. Conversations welcome; tomatoes expected
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 LHC 物理机器学习的年度盘点（2025年5月–2026年5月），由 AI pipeline 检索 HEPML Living Review 并综合出六条领域论断：核心结论是 HEPML 已从造工具的研究方向变成 LHC 物理计划所依赖的基础设施，ATLAS 与 CMS 已发表依赖神经网络的物理结果。与天气/资料同化关键词无实质重叠。
Motivation: 高能物理 ML 一年内论文量巨大（切分后 1,756 + 569 篇），人工难以通读判断领域走向，需要一次系统性的盘点来区分已成定论、正在到来与仍然开放的问题。
Method: 以 HEPML Living Review 在 2025 年 5 月切分为语料（此前 1,756 篇、之后 569 篇），AI pipeline 按引用、时效、主题与合作参与度对 569 篇排序，全文精读 103 篇（切分后 95 篇 + 早期基线 8 篇）并各生成结构化笔记，再综合为六条论断，由独立 reviewer agent 复核并回溯原文验证。
Result: 六条论断含具体计数：AI agent 方向十二个月 47 篇论文但尚无被采纳的测量；约五分之一的近期论文涉及不确定性、校准或可解释性；语料规模为 1,756 + 569 篇，精读 103 篇（95 + 8）。
Conclusion: 作者主张 HEPML 已成为 LHC 物理计划依赖的基础设施，SBI 与 foundation model 两条革命正在合流，而 equivariance 已被吸收进工具、模型相关唯象学让位于模型无关搜索；同时坦陈这种 AI 辅助工作方式本身引发的担忧。

papers.title: Counterfactual Self-Evolving Agents for Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-play proposer--solver methods improve reasoning by generating tasks and learning from verified solutions. However, for evidence-identifiable tasks, where case-specific evidence and domain knowledge determine a checkable answer, self-play requires generating plausible cases whose answers can be independently verified. We introduce counterfactual self-evolution, which generates counterfactual context for reconsidering the original case. A trainable Proposer constructs targeted evidence edits and describes potential outcome changes with causal explanations. We handcraft an expert-verified counterfactual instruction-tuning dataset to teach the Proposer to generate high-quality counterfactuals across a broad range of action--outcome scenarios. Each counterfactual instruction-tuning example specifies an edit within a defined category and explains its hypothesized causal effect on the decision, teaching the Proposer to reason systematically about what changes and why. We instruction-tune the Proposer on these examples, then formulate a fine-tuning reward that integrates feedback from the Solver and Verifier. Across diverse counterfactual scenarios, this reward favors high-quality counterfactuals and warranted revisions, while penalizing changes that overturn correct decisions. The counterfactual context aims to correct errors and strengthen confidence in correct decisions. Accepted counterfactuals accumulate in memory that supplies in-context evidence to the frozen Solver; the Solver adapts through evolving context rather than weight updates. We apply the framework to clinical reasoning, fact verification, and business reasoning. Our evaluation tracks performance over successive rounds as counterfactual memory grows, including transfer to harder cases. Our method achieves superior results across diverse frontier models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出反事实自进化 (counterfactual self-evolution) 框架：可训练的 Proposer 为原始案例生成带因果解释的证据编辑，被接受的反事实累积成记忆，为冻结的 Solver 提供上下文证据，使其靠演化上下文而非权重更新来修正错误并巩固正确判断。在临床推理、事实核查与商业推理三类任务上，该方法跨多种 frontier 模型取得更优结果，并覆盖向更难案例的迁移。
Motivation: 自博弈 proposer–solver 方法在证据可判定任务上难以自动生成可独立验证的案例，因为答案取决于个案证据与领域知识。
Method: 训练 Proposer 生成定向证据编辑并给出因果解释；用人工构建、专家审核的反事实指令微调数据集（每例指定一类编辑并解释其对决策的假设因果效应）做 instruction-tuning；再设计整合 Solver 与 Verifier 反馈的微调奖励，奖励高质量反事实与有依据的修订、惩罚推翻正确决策的改动；被接受的反事实进入记忆，为冻结 Solver 提供 in-context 证据。
Result: 在临床推理、事实核查与商业推理上，评测追踪反事实记忆增长过程中逐轮性能变化（含向更难案例的迁移），方法在多种 frontier 模型上取得 superior results。
Conclusion: 反事实自进化让 proposer–solver 自博弈在证据可判定任务上可行：靠可验证的证据编辑与累积记忆驱动推理改进，而不必更新 Solver 权重。

papers.title: ASCEND: Personal AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Computing Across HPC Clusters and GPU Workstations
papers.abstract_en: Traditional scientific computing requires researchers to translate computational intent into environment configuration, resource requests, and executable jobs, then diagnose failures from scheduler state and application logs. We present ASCEND (Autonomous Scientific Computing Engine and Novel Discovery), an AI-powered agent interface that runs the agent on the researcher's own laptop, reaching Slurm-managed clusters and a GPU workstation over a multiplexed authenticated connection, with site-specific execution policies checked by locally executed tools; the language model is hosted remotely and holds no credentials. No facility-scale service is required: an account on each resource is sufficient, and the public installer lets users link additional Slurm clusters or workstations of their own. We report four recorded cases: (1) the agent closed a failure-recovery loop on a planted tensor-device fault, submitting, diagnosing, repairing and resubmitting with job-level artifacts preserved; (2) it reproduced the published evaluation of a weather-forecasting model from the author's released forecasts, agreeing with the published curves to 2.1% (z500) and 2.4% (t850) while identifying a unit discrepancy in the paper's prose and an initialization-field discrepancy in its released data; (3) it parallelized a released 12,693-line geophysical solver under a bit-for-bit identity requirement, reducing wall-clock runtime from about twelve hours to about two; (4) that requirement exposed two instances of undefined behaviour in the published solver, both repaired and reported upstream. Separately, a pre-specified evaluation of the policy layer found the deployed validator rejected 29 of 30 constructed violations and held the remaining one for approval, while denying 3 of 14 legitimate requests. Autonomy was exercised under author supervision; an end-to-end recovery benchmark remains outstanding.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Code and installer: https://github.com/jpliu168/ASCEND
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASCEND 把 AI agent 装在研究者笔记本上，经多路复用认证连接操作 Slurm 集群与 GPU 工作站，凭据不交给远端 LLM。四个录制案例中它复现了天气预报模型评测（z500 与 t850 曲线分别吻合到 2.1% 和 2.4%），并把 12,693 行地球物理求解器在逐位一致约束下从约 12 小时并行压到约 2 小时。

papers.title: Staying on the Attractor: Supervising Neural Surrogates of 3D Turbulence Where They Leave It
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates are trained to predict 3D turbulent flows in place of direct numerical simulation (DNS). For chaotic flows, the goal is short-term pointwise accuracy followed by long-term physical and statistical fidelity. However, small prediction errors can carry a surrogate away from the flow's attractor. Off-attractor states are poorly represented in training data, leaving their evolution weakly constrained. The learned dynamics can then amplify deviations and lead to blow-up, freezing, or statistical drift. We propose off-attractor supervision (OAS) to supervise neural surrogates where they leave the attractor. OAS teaches the model how the true Navier-Stokes dynamics would evolve from these states. Each selected state is paired with its own future computed by DNS. Three generators select a few hundred states for relabeling. The first collects states from the surrogate's own rollouts. The second uses surrogate attacks to target freezing, excessive amplification, and violations of incompressibility and energy balance. The third perturbs training states along an amplified direction and a strongly damped random direction of the dynamics. All attacks run on the surrogate alone, and DNS relabeling is performed offline once per selected state. Experiments on $128^3$ turbulence show that OAS increases the median time to failure from 21 to 721 steps. The compared baselines achieve medians of at most 110 steps, and the advantage holds across training seeds. OAS also achieves the lowest pointwise error at step 15 and the best long-horizon statistics among the compared methods. OAS integrates physical models into neural simulation by extending supervision from fixed reference trajectories to states where the surrogate is likely to fail. This principle can guide the development of more reliable scientific surrogates when deployment takes models beyond the coverage of their training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 3D 湍流神经代理 (neural surrogate) 离开吸引子后发散的问题，提出 off-attractor supervision (OAS)：用三类生成器挑出几百个易失效状态，各自配一条 DNS 未来轨迹做离线重标注，教模型在吸引子外的真实 Navier-Stokes 演化。在 128^3 湍流上，中位失效时间从 21 步提到 721 步，对比基线最多 110 步。
Motivation: 混沌流动的代理模型短期逐点误差虽小，却会把状态带离训练数据覆盖的吸引子；离吸引子状态在训练集中稀少、演化约束弱，误差被动力学放大后出现 blow-up、freezing 或统计漂移。
Method: OAS 用三个生成器各选几百个状态做重标注：其一收集代理自身 rollout 中的状态；其二用 surrogate attacks 针对 freezing、过度放大、不可压缩性与能量平衡违背；其三沿动力学的放大方向与强阻尼随机方向扰动训练状态。攻击只作用于代理本身，每个选中状态的 DNS 未来轨迹离线计算一次。
Result: 在 128^3 湍流实验中，OAS 把中位失效时间 (median time to failure) 从 21 步提升到 721 步，对比基线中位数至多 110 步，且优势跨训练随机种子成立；OAS 在第 15 步的逐点误差最低，长时程统计在对比方法中最好。
Conclusion: 把监督从固定参考轨迹扩展到代理易失效的状态，能在部署超出训练数据覆盖时显著延长神经代理的可靠运行时间；该原则可推广到更一般的科学代理模型。

papers.title: SV2V-RSim: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Self-Selective V2V Cooperative Perception with Near-Realistic Data
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) cooperative perception enhances autonomous driving by enabling vehicles to share information beyond their direct line of sight. However, existing V2V datasets are limited by a small number of participating agents, static collaborator selection strategies, and a significant domain gap between simulated and real-world environments. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SV2V-RSim, a large-scale, multi-modal, near-realistic simulation dataset engineered to elevate agent diversity and realism. Additionally, we present the Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) module, which optimizes collaborator selection to balance perception performance against communication bandwidth constraints. Our dataset is generated using the Unreal Engine 5-based simulator that integrates high-fidelity 3D assets, diverse environments, and intricate traffic scenarios. All vehicles within a specified range of the ego vehicle are equipped with sensor suites, enabling dynamic and adaptive collaborator selection. SV2V-RSim encompasses four maps, four weather conditions, six time periods from sunrise to night, 203K LiDAR frames, 402K RGB frames, and 788K annotated 3D bounding boxes across 17 object classes, supporting a range of cooperative perception tasks such as 3D object detection, segmentation, and depth estimation. Benchmarking on recent cooperative perception algorithms demonstrates that SVA achieves a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off, while sim-to-real experiments and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment validate the dataset's high realism and practical effectiveness. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SV2V-RSim 提出基于 Unreal Engine 5 的近真实 V2V 协同感知仿真数据集，并配套 Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) 模块，在通信带宽约束下动态挑选协作车辆以平衡感知性能与带宽。数据集含 4 张地图、4 种天气、6 个时段、203K LiDAR 帧、402K RGB 帧与 788K 个 3D 框（17 类）；在近期协同感知算法上基准测试显示 SVA 取得更优的性能-带宽权衡。
Motivation: 现有 V2V 协同感知数据集参与车辆少、协作方选择策略静态，且仿真与真实环境之间存在明显 domain gap，限制了协同感知算法的训练与评测。
Method: 用 Unreal Engine 5 仿真器生成多模态近真实数据集，范围内全部车辆装配传感器套件以支持动态协作方选择；提出 SVA 模块在感知性能与通信带宽之间做权衡优化，并在近期协同感知算法上做基准测试，辅以 sim-to-real 实验与无参考图像质量评估 (No-Reference Image Quality Assessment)。
Result: 数据集覆盖 4 张地图、4 种天气条件、6 个从日出到夜晚的时段，含 203K LiDAR 帧、402K RGB 帧、788K 标注 3D bounding boxes、17 个物体类别，支持 3D 目标检测、分割与深度估计；基准测试显示 SVA 取得更优的性能-带宽权衡，sim-to-real 实验与无参考图像质量评估验证了数据集的高真实感与实用有效性。
Conclusion: 自适应协作方选择加近真实仿真数据，是缓解 V2V 协同感知中带宽约束与 sim-to-real 差距的可行路径；数据集与代码将公开发布。

papers.title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboFoundry 把具身智能体的支撑系统本身当作可进化的策略 (System-as-Policy)：诊断决策与记忆管理的能力缺口，把执行轨迹转成经过验证的系统更新，并把反复出现的改进提升到通用系统层。在 EmbodiedBench 上把 GPT-5.5 提升 27.8%，Qwen3.7-Plus 达到 70.3% 对 GPT-5.5 的 72.7% 近乎持平。
Motivation: 现有方法各自优化记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口等单个组件，且单纯交互不会带来自我提升，除非执行经验被转化为持久且经过验证的系统改动。
Method: 进化作用于两个界面：管理活跃上下文与持久文件系统记忆的 context system，以及组织原子技能、可复用组合与失败条件恢复的 hierarchical skill system；共享语义接口把具身无关决策与具身相关执行分离，使进化出的能力可跨异构机器人迁移。
Result: EmbodiedBench 上达到 SOTA，GPT-5.5 提升 27.8%；Qwen3.7-Plus 70.3% vs GPT-5.5 72.7%；RoboMemArena 长程记忆上至少超过所有基线 39.0%，包括借助外部基础模型的方法；LIBERO-PRO 上超过 Cap-Agent0 243.8%–679.7%，覆盖全部扰动类型；真实部署中展示跨机器人与任务的零样本迁移和在线进化。
Conclusion: 把整个支撑系统当作可进化的策略，能在多个基础模型上一致带来增益，并让能力跨异构机器人零样本迁移，指向完全自主的具身智能体。

papers.title: Muon Under Gradient Noise and the Limits of Orthogonalization Near Optima
papers.abstract_en: Muon replaces the momentum buffer of each weight matrix by its orthogonal polar factor. We ask what this orthogonalization does near an optimum, where minibatch noise dominates the gradient. Under a Gaussian noise model, the expected Muon update becomes a scaled gradient step, so a linear method with a suitably matched learning rate reproduces Muon's first-order mean response. The stochastic update is a different matter: after the response is matched, Muon retains a nonlinear residual that is uncorrelated with the input noise and contributes additional covariance. A Hermite expansion shows how momentum acts on this residual. Its higher-order components decorrelate faster than the linear component, so momentum suppresses the residual's accumulated covariance relative to the linear part, but never eliminates it. In a local quadratic surrogate that evaluates the residual on the stationary noise buffer, the residual adds stationary covariance and raises the stationary loss floor at every stable step size, while leaving the contraction dynamics unchanged. Simulations of the full nonlinear recursion on quadratics and measurements on frozen transformer gradients support each step of this picture. Together, the results make a theoretical case for replacing orthogonalization by response-matched momentum SGD once optimization becomes noise-dominated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在梯度噪声主导的最优点附近，Muon 的正交极化分解期望更新等价于一个学习率匹配的线性梯度步，但随机更新仍保留与输入噪声不相关的非线性残差，额外增加协方差。Hermite 展开显示动量会更快地去相关残差的高阶分量、从而压低其累积协方差，却永远无法消除；在局部二次替代模型中，该残差在所有稳定步长下都抬高稳态 loss floor 而不改变收缩动力学。作者据此主张：一旦优化进入噪声主导阶段，用响应匹配的 momentum SGD 替换正交化。
Motivation: Muon 用正交极化因子替换动量缓冲，但正交化在最优点附近、minibatch 噪声压过真实梯度时究竟起什么作用并不清楚；需要区分其均值响应与随机残差两部分，才能判断该机制在噪声主导阶段是否还有收益。
Method: 在高斯噪声模型下把 Muon 更新分解为期望响应与非线性残差：期望部分用学习率匹配的线性方法复现，残差用 Hermite 展开分析其各阶分量与动量的相互作用；再在局部二次替代模型中于平稳噪声缓冲上评估残差，最后用完整非线性递推在二次函数上的仿真以及冻结 transformer 梯度上的测量逐步验证。
Result: Hermite 展开表明残差的高阶分量比线性分量去相关更快，动量因此压低残差累积协方差但不消除；在局部二次替代中，残差在每个稳定步长下都增加平稳协方差并抬高稳态 loss floor，而收缩动力学不变；二次函数上的完整非线性递推仿真与冻结 transformer 梯度测量支持上述每一步。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是一个理论主张：Muon 的正交化在噪声主导阶段只带来无法被动量消除的额外协方差与更高 loss floor，因此优化一旦被噪声支配，就应改用响应匹配的 momentum SGD。

papers.title: Is H&E Image-to-Spatial Transcriptomics Simpler Than It Looks?
papers.abstract_en: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H&E histology offers a scalable route toward spatial molecular profiling. Recent work has pursued increasingly sophisticated architectures to capture spatial context and richer expression structure. At the same time, simple estimators have shown strong performance in several studies, but what they already solve and where additional complexity is needed remain unclear. We study this behavior through the structure of prediction error under the mean-squared error (MSE) objective. Differences in average expression across genes can account for a substantial part of aggregate prediction performance, while a key unresolved error lies in recovering variation within each slide. Decomposing MSE into slide-level and within-slide components, we find that the within-slide component has lower residual-normalized parameter sensitivity in controlled neural experiments. This motivates Component-Guided Loss (CGL), which increases supervision of the within-slide component. CGL-Linear is a closed-form affine instantiation that achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across HEST-1k cohorts and gene-panel sizes. The same within-slide supervision improves existing neural models. These results suggest that substantial gains can come from aligning the training objective with prediction-error structure rather than increasing model complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 MSE 分解出发，指出 H&E 图像到空间转录组预测中，基因间平均表达差异已解释了大部分总体误差，真正难的是 slide 内变异；据此提出 Component-Guided Loss (CGL) 加强 slide 内分量的监督，其闭式仿射版本 CGL-Linear 在 HEST-1k 各队列与不同 gene-panel 规模上取得整体 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 近期工作不断加复杂度来捕捉空间上下文，而简单估计器已在若干研究中表现强劲，但它们究竟解决了什么、哪里仍需复杂结构并不清楚。
Method: 把 MSE 分解为 slide 级与 slide 内两个分量，在受控神经实验中测量各分量对参数的残差归一化敏感度；据此设计 Component-Guided Loss (CGL) 加大 slide 内分量监督，并给出闭式仿射实例 CGL-Linear，同时把该监督加到已有神经模型上。
Result: slide 内分量在受控神经实验中具有更低的残差归一化参数敏感度；CGL-Linear 在 HEST-1k 各队列与各 gene-panel 规模上取得整体 state-of-the-art 表现；同一 slide 内监督也能改进已有神经模型。
Conclusion: 把训练目标与预测误差结构对齐，比继续增加模型复杂度更能带来实质增益。

papers.title: PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyTopoBench 提出面向遥感影像复杂矢量多边形生成的统一评测框架，同时评估外环与内环（含带孔、多环多边形），覆盖建筑物、道路、植被与非植被区域两类 RS 数据集，并对 11 个代表性方法（分割式 polygonization 流水线、视觉基础模型基线、专用矢量生成器）做基准测试。结果显示现有方法多能恢复简单外部边界，但在带孔或多环多边形上性能显著退化。
Motivation: 现有矢量多边形生成方法要么只能处理简单外轮廓、无法表示带孔的复杂多边形，要么不能保持拓扑；早期 raster mask 加后处理的流程还阻碍端到端优化、易漏检小目标或产生不准确顶点，缺少针对复杂多边形的评测标准。
Method: 构建统一评测框架 PolyTopoBench，对外环与内环分别计分；基准测试 11 个代表性方法，涵盖分割式 polygonization 流水线、视觉基础模型基线与专用矢量多边形生成器，在两个覆盖建筑物、道路、植被和非植被区域的遥感影像数据集上评测。
Result: 在两个 RS 数据集上对 11 个方法的实验显示：现有方法通常能恢复简单外部边界，但在带孔或多环多边形上性能显著退化；代码与数据发布于 github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench。
Conclusion: 复杂多边形生成仍是未解决的挑战，需要拓扑感知的基准与模型设计；评测必须同时覆盖外环与内环，只看外部边界会掩盖真实短板。

papers.title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FINE 从已有 VLN 演示轨迹中挖掘未来观测携带的隐式监督：按指令顺序的显式 landmark token 同时在语义 2D patch 特征与视角相关 3D 几何特征空间预测未来 landmark 区域，隐式 future token 用视频世界模型生成的同场景反事实未来区分实际到达状态。在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上给 InternVLA-N1 带来 2.6 与 4.5 个成功率点提升；演示数据降到 70% 预算时提升扩大到 6.8 点，约收回砍掉三分之一演示所损失性能的一半以上。
Motivation: VLN 策略适配新环境需要逐条具身演示，成本高；而标准的 observation-to-action 训练只用了轨迹中一小部分信息，未来观测里已包含指令相关 landmark 的外观与 3D 排布。
Method: FINE 在 VLN backbone 上加两组辅助表征：显式 landmark token 按指令给定的有序 landmark，在语义 2D patch 特征空间与视角相关的 3D 几何特征空间预测未来 landmark 区域；隐式 future token 学习区分实际到达的 landmark 状态与由视频世界模型生成的同场景反事实未来。
Result: 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上，全量训练数据时 FINE 使 InternVLA-N1 成功率分别提升 2.6 与 4.5 点；在 70% 演示预算下成功率提升 6.8 点，约收回演示量削减所损失性能的三分之一。
Conclusion: 把未来观测作为辅助监督能在演示稀缺时更大幅度提升 VLN 成功率，数据越少 FINE 的边际收益越大。

papers.title: Logic Gate Networks and Lookup Table Networks as Lightweight Hardware Classifiers for Inter-patient ECG Arrhythmia Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs) and Lookup Table Networks (LUTNs) offer a promising approach for very low power inference due to their use of simple binary logic operations instead of arithmetic. In this work, we generalize the logic gates of LGNs to more than two input pins, naturally arriving at networks consisting of $N$-input LUTs. To obtain a differentiable expression for training the $N$-LUT entries, we adopt the Boolean equation of a $2^N$:1 multiplexer (MUX) and optimize its input parameters during training. We investigate the applicability of LGNs and LUTNs to inter-patient ECG arrhythmia classification using the MIT-BIH data set. The proposed models achieve up to 94.41\% accuracy and a $jκ$ index of 0.683 on a four-class task, showing a competitive performance compared to existing CNN-, SVM- and SNN-based methods. Our LGNs and LUTNs only require an estimated 2.89k to 6.17k FLOPs, including preprocessing and readout, which is three to six orders of magnitude less than state-of-the-art methods. We verified our design, which consists of the preprocessing pipeline and a 6-LUTN classifier, by implementing it on a Xilinx Zynq-7000 ZedBoard. The complete system consumes a dynamic energy of 8.25 $μ$J/inference, of which only 0.46 nJ is utilized by the LUTN classifier. These results show that both LGNs and LUTNs can be employed as lightweight hardware-based classifiers for inter-patient ECG arrhythmia classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可微逻辑门网络 (LGN) 的门推广到多于两个输入，得到由 N 输入查找表 (N-LUT) 构成的网络，并用 2^N:1 多路复用器 (MUX) 的布尔方程使 N-LUT 条目可微、可在训练中优化。在 MIT-BIH 跨病人 (inter-patient) 心律失常四分类上达到最高 94.41% 准确率与 jκ 指数 0.683，含预处理与读出仅需约 2.89k–6.17k FLOPs，比现有方法少三到六个数量级。
Motivation: ECG 可穿戴与嵌入式端侧推理受功耗约束，CNN、SVM、SNN 等算术型模型的 FLOPs 与能耗过高；用纯二值逻辑运算替代算术是降低推理功耗的路径，但需要在跨病人分类上保持可用精度。
Method: 将 LGN 的二输入逻辑门推广为多输入，网络自然化为 N 输入 LUT；为得到可微的训练表达式，采用 2^N:1 MUX 的布尔方程并优化其输入参数。整套设计包含预处理流水线与 6-LUTN 分类器，并在 Xilinx Zynq-7000 ZedBoard 上实现验证。
Result: 在 MIT-BIH 数据集的四分类任务上，模型最高 94.41% 准确率、jκ 指数 0.683，与 CNN、SVM、SNN 类方法相比具竞争力；含预处理与读出仅需估计 2.89k 至 6.17k FLOPs，比最先进方法少三到六个数量级。ZedBoard 实测整机每次推理动态能耗 8.25 μJ，其中 LUTN 分类器仅占 0.46 nJ。
Conclusion: LGN 与 LUTN 可作为跨病人 ECG 心律失常分类的轻量级硬件分类器，在保持有竞争力精度的同时把计算量与分类器能耗压到极低水平。

papers.title: Transfer Learning for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Learning transferable representations for dynamic text-attributed graphs (DyTAGs) requires models to capture underlying interaction dynamics that persist across domains. However, existing methods tend to overfit to domain-specific structural, temporal, and semantic patterns, limiting edge classification performance under distribution shifts. To expose and address this, we formally establish a leave-one-domain-out (LODO) transfer learning protocol for edge classification on DyTAGs. Under this protocol, we demonstrate that state-of-the-art self-supervised methods for dynamic graph learning perform poorly when transferred to unseen domains. Strikingly, existing methods underperform a structurally and temporally unaware Bag of Events (BoE) model we introduce, which inputs only unordered sequences of node and edge text features. Proceeding from the BoE, we propose Spatio-Temporal Semantic Alignment (STSA), which integrates a spatio-temporal encoder that fuses representations of time deltas and node occurrence frequencies into a unified manifold. STSA is trained with a Contrastive Semantic Forecasting objective, which anchors edge representations to a multi-domain textual latent space initialized by a pretrained language model, providing a robust prior that outperforms BoE and all existing methods we evaluate.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein
papers.abstract_en: We propose sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW) distance which is a generalization of sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. SOW replaces the $L^p$ norm in SW with a Luxemburg norm cost induced by an Orlicz function $φ$. First, we prove that SOW distance is a metric on the space of measures with finite Orlicz norm, and show that it recovers the SW distance when the Orlicz function is $φ(x)=x^p$. Next, we derive the topological properties of the SOW distance. In particular, we show that convergence under SOW implies weak convergence, and the converse is true under the compact support condition. We then present the theoretical results for estimating the SOW distance. We derive sample complexity for both the distance itself and the powered functional of the distance, and prove their minimax optimality. In addition, we discuss the computational algorithm for approximating the SOW distance by Monte-Carlo estimation and bisection search, as well as the associated approximation error and computational complexity analysis. Our experimental results reveal the superior computational efficiency of SOW compared with Orlicz-Wasserstein (OW) distance. Also, in the experiments, we demonstrate the favorable flexibility of SOW distance over SW in detecting differences between distributions by comparing their performance in two-sample tests and evaluating generative models on image datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 sliced Orlicz-Wasserstein (SOW) 距离，用 Orlicz 函数诱导的 Luxemburg 范数代价替换 sliced Wasserstein (SW) 中的 L^p 范数。SOW 在有限 Orlicz 范数测度空间上是度量，φ(x)=x^p 时退化为 SW；SOW 收敛蕴含弱收敛，紧支撑下两者等价。实验显示 SOW 计算效率优于 Orlicz-Wasserstein (OW)，且在两样本检验与图像生成模型评估上比 SW 更能检出分布差异。
Motivation: SW 只能用 L^p 范数诱导的代价，OW 虽更灵活但计算昂贵；需要一种既保留切片降维计算优势、又能用一般 Orlicz 代价刻画分布差异的距离。
Method: 将 SW 的 L^p 投影代价替换为 Orlicz 函数 φ 诱导的 Luxemburg 范数代价，证明其为度量并给出拓扑性质；推导距离本身与距离幂泛函的样本复杂度并证明 minimax 最优；用 Monte-Carlo 估计加二分搜索近似 SOW，给出近似误差与计算复杂度分析。
Result: 证明 SOW 是有限 Orlicz 范数测度空间上的度量，φ(x)=x^p 时恢复 SW；SOW 收敛推出弱收敛，紧支撑下逆命题成立；给出距离与幂泛函的样本复杂度并证明 minimax 最优；实验中 SOW 计算效率优于 OW，在两样本检验和图像数据集生成模型评估上检出分布差异的能力优于 SW。
Conclusion: 用 Orlicz 代价加切片可以在保持计算可行的同时获得比 SW 更强的分布差异检测能力，代价是比 OW 更省算力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SynCo: Learning Cross-Modal Synergy by Contrasting Interaction Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal contrastive learning is a dominant paradigm for learning transferable representations from unlabeled data, but standard objectives primarily capture information that is redundant between modalities. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) shows that task-relevant information in multimodal data decomposes into three components: redundancy shared between modalities, uniqueness specific to each modality, and synergy available only from their joint observation. Recent frameworks extend contrastive learning to capture all three components, yet synergy remains undertrained in practice. We propose SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning), a method that directly addresses synergy undertraining through dedicated supervision on an interaction residual. SynCo fits a linear projector to predict the fused representation from independently computed unimodal features, and the resulting interaction residual, which removes the linearly unimodal-predictable component, receives dedicated contrastive supervision at negligible computational cost. On the controlled Trifeature benchmark, SynCo achieves state-of-the-art synergy capture with a $+5.98\%$ gain over the baseline, and on real-world benchmarks from MultiBench, DARai, and MM-IMDb, SynCo consistently outperforms or matches prior methods across diverse modality combinations and task types. The method operates as a plug-in to existing contrastive multimodal frameworks without modifying the underlying fusion architecture and can further improve synergy capture when combined with other methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SynCo 针对多模态对比学习中 synergy（协同信息）训练不足的问题，用一个线性 projector 从各模态独立特征预测融合表示，把残差中线性可由单模态预测的成分去掉，对剩下的 interaction residual 施加专门的对比监督。在受控 Trifeature 基准上 synergy 捕获较基线提升 +5.98%，在 MultiBench、DARai、MM-IMDb 真实基准上跨模态组合与任务类型一致优于或持平已有方法。
Motivation: 标准多模态对比目标主要捕获模态间冗余信息；按 Partial Information Decomposition (PID)，任务相关信息还包含各模态独有的 uniqueness 与仅联合观测才有的 synergy，而现有扩展框架中 synergy 实际处于欠训练状态。
Method: SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning) 先用线性 projector 从独立计算的单模态特征预测融合表示，取其 interaction residual（去掉线性单模态可预测成分）并施加专门的对比监督，计算开销可忽略；作为插件接入已有对比多模态框架，不改动底层融合架构，也可与其他方法叠加。
Result: 在受控 Trifeature 基准上 SynCo 取得 state-of-the-art 的 synergy 捕获，较基线提升 +5.98%；在 MultiBench、DARai、MM-IMDb 的真实基准上，跨多种模态组合与任务类型一致优于或匹配已有方法。
Conclusion: 对 interaction residual 施加专门对比监督即可直接缓解 synergy 欠训练，且无需改动融合架构，可作为现有对比多模态框架的即插即用组件并与其他方法叠加进一步提升 synergy 捕获。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Mask2Restore: Self-Supervised Ultrasound Despeckling via Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: Medical ultrasound (US) is inherently degraded by speckle, a granular interference pattern that is often treated as a complex form of noise in image restoration. However, unlike random noise, US speckle originates from coherent scattering within tissue and is therefore highly spatially dependent and deterministic under fixed acquisition conditions, making US speckle suppression fundamentally different from natural image denoising. Because speckle-free US targets are unavailable in practice, self-supervised denoising is necessary. Blind-spot networks (BSN) are the dominant self-supervised paradigm for natural images, but their pixel-wise masking strategy assumes spatially independent noise, an assumption poorly matched to US speckle, which is spatially correlated over multiple pixels rather than pixel-wise independent. To address this mismatch, we propose Mask2Restore, a self-supervised US despeckling framework that reformulates despeckling as contextual inpainting with block-wise masking on single noisy images. Unlike pixel-wise BSN masking, block-wise masking addresses this multi-pixel speckle correlation by removing locally correlated speckle neighborhoods and shifting the reconstruction cues used by the network from adjacent speckle correlations to broader anatomical context. We further introduce cross-resolution context regularization (CRCR), which suppresses residual speckle bias by enforcing consistency across multi-resolution predictions. Experiments on simulated and in vivo carotid US, unseen fine-structure cases, and downstream cardiac segmentation demonstrate improved speckle-detail trade-offs, better preservation of fine anatomical structures, and practical value for subsequent image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mask2Restore 把超声去斑 (despeckling) 重写为单张含噪图像上的块级掩码上下文修复 (block-wise contextual inpainting)，绕开盲点网络 (BSN) 逐像素掩码假设噪声空间独立的失效点，并用跨分辨率上下文正则 (CRCR) 抑制残余斑点偏差。在模拟与在体颈动脉超声、未见细结构案例及下游心脏分割上，改善斑点-细节权衡并更好保留精细解剖结构。
Motivation: 超声斑点源于组织相干散射，在固定采集条件下空间相关且确定，而主导的自监督范式 BSN 的逐像素掩码假设噪声空间独立，与多像素相关的斑点不匹配；临床上又拿不到无斑点真值。
Method: 在单张含噪图像上做块级掩码的上下文修复，把网络的重建线索从相邻斑点相关转到更广的解剖上下文；再引入跨分辨率上下文正则 (CRCR)，通过多分辨率预测间的一致性约束抑制残余斑点偏差。
Result: 在模拟与在体颈动脉超声、未见细结构案例以及下游心脏分割上，改善斑点-细节权衡、更好保留精细解剖结构，并对后续图像分析体现实际价值。
Conclusion: 对空间相关的超声斑点，自监督去斑应改用块级掩码加跨分辨率一致性，而不是沿用面向独立噪声的逐像素盲点掩码。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Beyond Temporal Smoothing: Spatial Energy Budgets Stabilize One-Step Diffusion Editing
papers.abstract_en: One-step text-guided diffusion editing is efficient but prone to spatially misallocated updates that distort the edited object and alter the background. Existing methods often improve stability by averaging the editing field across timesteps. We instead identify spatial energy misallocation as a distinct and measurable failure mode: across two independent noise draws, the residual field is essentially unrepeatable, making the background field unreliable for direct transport, while its total energy still sets a usable magnitude for the draw at hand. BudEdit turns that magnitude into an explicit budget and reallocates it to edit-relevant regions selected jointly by residual energy and cross-attention, controlling where editing energy is spent rather than averaging over timesteps. The resulting training-free, inversion-free editor spends the budget on transport and reuses it to scale a correction in a lower-noise gated refinement. The budgeted injection field matches its prescribed budget exactly and vanishes on the identified background support, by construction. On PIE-Bench with SD-Turbo, BudEdit outperforms ChordEdit under each method's reported default settings on all 11 evaluated metrics, including a $2.1$\,dB gain in background PSNR, $31$\% lower DINO, and $36$\% lower LPIPS, while improving all five editing-quality metrics and reporting the lowest runtime in the comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BudEdit 把一步扩散编辑中的空间能量错配当作可测的失败模式：两次独立噪声抽样下残差场几乎不可重复，但其总能量仍可作为该次抽样的幅值。方法将该幅值显式设为预算，按残差能量与 cross-attention 联合选择的编辑相关区域重新分配，并在低噪声门控精修中复用预算做校正缩放。在 PIE-Bench 上用 SD-Turbo，11 项指标全部优于 ChordEdit 默认设置，背景 PSNR 提升 2.1 dB、DINO 降低 31%、LPIPS 降低 36%。
Motivation: 一步文本引导扩散编辑效率高，但更新在空间上错配，会扭曲被编辑对象并改动背景；现有方法靠跨时间步平均编辑场来稳住结果，掩盖而非定位这一失败模式。
Method: BudEdit 是 training-free、inversion-free 的编辑器：先在两次独立噪声抽样上量化残差场的不可重复性，取其总能量作为显式预算，再按残差能量与 cross-attention 联合选出的编辑相关区域重新分配预算；预算用于 transport，并在低噪声门控精修 (gated refinement) 中复用来缩放校正项。
Result: 在 PIE-Bench 上用 SD-Turbo，按各方法默认设置，BudEdit 在全部 11 项评估指标上优于 ChordEdit：背景 PSNR 提升 2.1 dB，DINO 降低 31%，LPIPS 降低 36%，五项编辑质量指标全部改善，且运行时间在对比中最低。注入场按构造精确匹配给定预算，并在识别出的背景支撑上消失。
Conclusion: 控制编辑能量花在哪里比跨时间步平均更有效：把残差总能量当预算并重分配到编辑相关区域，可同时保住背景、提升编辑质量并降低运行时间。
Relevance: 0
