summary_sections.method: BudEdit 是 training-free、inversion-free 的编辑器：先在两次独立噪声抽样上量化残差场的不可重复性，取其总能量作为显式预算，再按残差能量与 cross-attention 联合选出的编辑相关区域重新分配预算；预算用于 transport，并在低噪声门控精修 (gated refinement) 中复用来缩放校正项。
summary_sections.result: 在 PIE-Bench 上用 SD-Turbo，按各方法默认设置，BudEdit 在全部 11 项评估指标上优于 ChordEdit：背景 PSNR 提升 2.1 dB，DINO 降低 31%，LPIPS 降低 36%，五项编辑质量指标全部改善，且运行时间在对比中最低。注入场按构造精确匹配给定预算，并在识别出的背景支撑上消失。
summary_sections.conclusion: 控制编辑能量花在哪里比跨时间步平均更有效：把残差总能量当预算并重分配到编辑相关区域，可同时保住背景、提升编辑质量并降低运行时间。

papers.title: VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis
papers.abstract_en: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/StatXzy7/vcre-fib
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VCRE-Fib 在空间池化之前构造视图条件化的局部分级证据，用弱定位引导其聚合再与全局预测融合，仅凭图像同时输出血吸虫肝纤维化评分、采集视图与候选异常区域图。在 4,107 张图像、240 例患者的跨中心测试集上，相对同数据划分训练的 SFibAI，预设复合分级风险下降 7.115%，图像级 MAE 从 0.391 降到 0.378。
Motivation: 超声评估血吸虫病肝纤维化时局部回声模式与解剖结构复杂，现有深度学习能预测评分，却难以在保留空间信息供检查的同时把采集视图与区域线索直接纳入分级。
Method: VCRE-Fib 框架在空间池化前形成视图条件化的局部分级证据，用弱定位 (weak localization) 引导证据聚合，再与全局预测结合；仅图像推理联合返回纤维化评分、采集视图和候选异常区域图。开发与评估使用 35 个中心、6,373 例患者、108,709 张超声图像的重整理队列。
Result: 在患者不相交测试集（4 个中心、240 例患者、4,107 张图像）上，VCRE-Fib 相对在同一数据划分上训练与评估的 SFibAI 将预设复合分级风险降低 7.115%；图像级平均绝对误差 (MAE) 从 0.391 降至 0.378，patient-max、patient-median 与 center-balanced 风险同步下降。完整模型的复合分级风险也低于分别移除视图条件化或弱定位的消融变体。
Conclusion: 把解剖上下文与区域证据纳入超声分级、同时暴露空间预测供人工检查，能降低细粒度纤维化分级风险；视图条件化与弱定位两者都对这一风险下降有贡献。

papers.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems rely heavily on heterogeneous behavioral feedback to infer user preference. Although abundant, these signals are imperfect measurements: the same observed behavior can arise from different underlying states, such as genuine enjoyment, passive consumption, or inattention. The challenge is especially acute in short-form video, where watch-based signals are strongly affected by measurement confounders such as video duration - the same watch time can imply different levels of preference for videos of different lengths, while ratio-based metrics can systematically favor short videos. As a result, optimizing raw engagement can amplify measurement artifacts rather than improving user value. We propose a Factorized Latent Value Model (FLVM) for measuring user preference from heterogeneous behavioral feedback. The model treats observed behaviors as noisy measurements of a low-dimensional, factorized latent value state and uses structured output heads to model heterogeneous feedback signals. A restricted baseline path captures predictable variation from measurement-confounding features such as video duration, user propensity, and session context, while a routed latent path estimates preference-relevant value advantage. The resulting latent value score can be integrated into an existing recommender system as a ranking feature or ranking score. On YouTube Shorts, a major short-form video platform, this model improves offline metrics and lifts a primary viewer enjoyment metric by 2.67% in online A/B tests.
papers.comment: RecSys '26: 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems
papers.journal_ref: In 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), September 27-October 02, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA. ACM, 7 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 短视频推荐里观看类信号受视频时长等测量混淆因素污染，直接优化原始互动会放大测量伪影而非提升用户价值。FLVM 把异构行为当作低维分解潜在价值状态的含噪测量，用受限基线路径吸收时长、用户倾向、会话上下文带来的可预测变异，再用路由潜在路径估计与偏好相关的价值优势。在 YouTube Shorts 上该模型改善离线指标，并在在线 A/B 测试中把主要观看愉悦度指标提升 2.67%。
Motivation: 同一段观看行为可能来自真正喜爱、被动消费或走神，短视频中观看时长还被视频长度系统性混淆，比率类指标偏向短视频，导致优化原始互动只是在放大测量伪影。
Method: 提出 Factorized Latent Value Model (FLVM)：把观测行为建模为低维、分解的潜在价值状态的含噪测量，用结构化输出头 (structured output heads) 分别刻画异构反馈信号；受限基线路径 (restricted baseline path) 吸收视频时长、用户倾向、会话上下文等测量混淆特征的可预测变异，路由潜在路径 (routed latent path) 估计与偏好相关的价值优势，输出的潜在价值分可作为排序特征或排序分数接入现有推荐系统。
Result: 在 YouTube Shorts 上，FLVM 改善离线指标，并在在线 A/B 测试中把主要观看愉悦度指标 (primary viewer enjoyment metric) 提升 2.67%。
Conclusion: 把异构行为信号与测量混淆因素显式分解，得到的潜在价值分比原始互动指标更能代表用户价值，可直接作为排序特征或排序分数接入现有推荐系统。

papers.title: HamiFormer: Dual-Expert Diffusion Fields with Affine Symplectic Maps
papers.abstract_en: Predicting smooth dynamics and collisions requires modeling continuous evolution and abrupt state changes. We introduce HamiFormer, a dual-expert diffusion field combining whole-window denoising with residual-corrected Hamiltonian propagation. Their mixed-state feedback attenuates the direct contribution of inherited autoregressive error: each mixed state guides subsequent propagation within the jointly refined window. Parallel Local Affine Scan (PLAS) amortizes iterative refinement across rectified-flow steps and evaluates derivatives in parallel across physical time. PLAS's affine symplectic maps achieve lower solver error and runtime than sequential explicit Euler in our evaluation. A Regime Model Tree specializes residuals and routing to balance typical-state accuracy against large tail errors. Our analysis gives conditions for physically consistent refinement and warm-start tracking, and finite-window error bounds under diffusion feedback. In 192-step evaluations, HamiFormer reduces normalized phase-space MSE by 26.3% against PhysiFormer on HamiBalls-1 and 21.4% against DiT on HamiBalls-2, with comparable model capacities. Disjoint-interval comparisons show the lowest late-horizon position and momentum errors among baselines on both datasets. Project page: https://hamiformer.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HamiFormer 用双专家扩散场建模连续演化与突变碰撞：整窗去噪与残差修正的 Hamilton 传播耦合，混合态反馈抑制自回归误差的直接累积。在 192 步评估中，HamiBalls-1 归一化相空间 MSE 比 PhysiFormer 低 26.3%，HamiBalls-2 比 DiT 低 21.4%，且晚期位置与动量误差在基线中最低。
Motivation: 平滑动力学与碰撞这类突变状态变化难以用单一连续模型刻画，自回归推进会把继承误差直接带入后续传播，长时域下尾部误差被放大。
Method: 双专家扩散场结合整窗去残差与残差修正的 Hamilton 传播，混合态反馈在联合精修窗内引导后续推进；Parallel Local Affine Scan (PLAS) 把迭代精修摊到 rectified-flow 各步、并在物理时间上并行求导，其 affine symplectic map 替代顺序显式 Euler；Regime Model Tree 对残差与路由专门化，以平衡典型态精度与大尾部误差；作者给出物理一致精修与 warm-start 跟踪的条件，以及扩散反馈下的有限窗误差界。
Result: 192 步评估中，HamiFormer 在 HamiBalls-1 上归一化相空间 MSE 比 PhysiFormer 降低 26.3%，在 HamiBalls-2 上比 DiT 降低 21.4%，且模型容量相当；disjoint-interval 对比显示其在两个数据集上的晚期位置与动量误差均为基线中最低。PLAS 的 affine symplectic map 在作者评估中求解器误差与运行时间均低于顺序显式 Euler。
Conclusion: 把扩散反馈与 Hamilton 传播耦合、并用辛映射并行化求解，可在容量相当条件下同时压低长时域的相空间误差与尾部误差；物理一致性与误差界给出了精修可用的条件。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations. To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SonoGraph-WM 用场景图 (scene graph) 而非超声图像本身表示解剖，由统一 Transformer 联合预测未来场景图与探头位姿，再以滚动时域规划想象候选轨迹并频繁重规划。在 4 例留出 CT 上空间关系 F1 在 20 步预测内保持 93% 以上，闭环导航胆囊、胰腺成功率分别为 77.50% 与 75.00%，机器人-体模实验达 73.7%。
Motivation: 现有机器人超声导航多直接选动作，不显式预测探头运动引起的解剖视野变化，导致缺乏预见性的探头规划；同时依赖带追踪与解剖标注的超声序列成本高。
Method: 以场景图表示可见结构、几何与空间关系（不合成超声图像），输入场景图历史与探头位姿，统一 Transformer 联合预测未来 SG 与位姿；滚动时域规划器递归想象候选轨迹，选到达目标图的最短预测路径，短执行后据新观测重规划；训练数据由 CT label map 沿表面约束探头轨迹生成的 SG–pose 对提供。
Result: 4 例留出 CT 上空间关系 F1 在 20 步预测内保持 93% 以上；用标注导出 SG 的闭环导航成功率胆囊 77.50%、胰腺 75.00%；机器人-体模实验（label map 导出 SG）规划器 73.7% 试验到达目标视野。
Conclusion: CT 监督的解剖世界模型可支撑超声探头规划，且可靠导航依赖频繁的观测更新。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 4 例留出 CT 上空间关系 F1 在 20 步预测内保持 93% 以上；用标注导出 SG 的闭环导航成功率胆囊 77.50%、胰腺 75.00%；机器人-体模实验（label map 导出 SG）规划器 73.7% 试验到达目标视野。
summary_sections.conclusion: CT 监督的解剖世界模型可支撑超声探头规划，且可靠导航依赖频繁的观测更新。

papers.title: Radiomap Blind Prediction under Incomplete Observation: Error Characterization and Correctable Propagation-Prior Learning
papers.abstract_en: Radiomap blind prediction aims to infer radiomaps from observable representations of the propagation environment and base station configuration without field measurements. In practice, the observable representations are inherently incomplete. Thus, the target radiomap is not fully determined by the inputs when generalizing to unseen configurations or environments. Under incomplete observation, we establish a population-level theory of deterministic radiomap blind prediction that identifies the conditional mean as its optimal target and separates prediction error into reducible predictor approximation and irreducible uncertainty caused by missing physical information. The framework further characterizes the train-test risk gap and the uncertainty reduction enabled by observation enrichment. Building on it, we reveal the dual role of propagation priors: they provide physically grounded guidance, yet their implementable forms may bias the attainable predictor. This motivates RadioDecomp, which treats a prior-guided predictor as a correctable base and learns its remaining predictable discrepancy through residual refinement. To evaluate RadioDecomp across distinct propagation-prior designs, we instantiate it with a feature-guided monolithic base and a LoS-Shadow structured base, yielding RadioFR and RadioLSR, respectively. Across random, cross-configuration, and cross-environment settings, experiments confirm the benefit of propagation-related representations and show that both instantiations improve upon their respective bases. Further controlled studies on base capacity, training-support coverage, and observation coarsening corroborate the proposed analysis.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在观测不完整的 radiomap 盲预测下，建立总体层面的误差分解理论：把预测误差拆成可约简的预测器逼近误差与因缺失物理信息导致的不可约不确定性，并指出传播先验既能提供物理引导、其可实现形式又会给可达预测器带来偏差。据此提出 RadioDecomp，把先验引导的预测器当作可纠正的 base，用残差精修学习其剩余可预测偏差；实例化为 RadioFR（feature-guided 单体 base）与 RadioLSR（LoS-Shadow 结构化 base），在 random、cross-configuration、cross-environment 三种设定下两者均优于各自 base。
Motivation: 可观测的传播环境与基站配置表示本身不完整，目标 radiomap 在未见配置或环境下并不被输入完全决定，确定性盲预测的误差来源与先验的作用缺少总体层面的刻画。
Method: 先建立总体层面理论，把最优目标定为条件均值，并将误差分解为预测器逼近（可约简）与缺失物理信息导致的不可约不确定性，同时刻画 train-test risk gap 与观测富集带来的不确定性下降；再提出 RadioDecomp，以先验引导预测器为 base、用残差精修学习剩余可预测偏差，实例化为 RadioFR 与 RadioLSR。
Result: 在 random、cross-configuration、cross-environment 三种设定下，实验确认传播相关表示的收益，RadioFR 与 RadioLSR 均分别优于各自的 base；另有针对 base 容量、training-support 覆盖度与观测粗化 (observation coarsening) 的受控研究，与所提分析相互印证。
Conclusion: 传播先验具有双重作用：物理上有据可依，但其可实现形式会限制可达预测器，因此应把先验预测器当作可纠正的 base 而非最终答案，用残差学习补上剩余可预测偏差。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: FinancialAuditBench: Benchmark Construction under Differential Privacy Using Real-World Priors
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are becoming widely adopted in the financial services industry, careful measurement is essential to understand where they can be reliably deployed and where oversight and professional review remain necessary. Such measurement, however, is constrained by limited access to proprietary or privacy-sensitive data. Existing benchmarks therefore often rely on publicly available data, human- and/or LLM-authored tasks, or simplified settings. We introduce FinancialAuditBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on financial statement audit tasks, along with a framework for systematically generating synthetic engagements. Our task generation framework leverages differentially private aggregate statistics from historical audits along with audit expertise contributed through over 1,100 hours of benchmark development and review. FinancialAuditBench consists of 90 tasks spanning workpaper completion and review across six synthetic audit engagements, each containing an average of 179 files. Evaluation on eleven frontier models shows that while agents complete substantial portions of staff-level audit tasks well, they sometimes perform inappropriate procedures or produce incorrect documentation. Beyond financial auditing, our framework offers an approach for systematically generating synthetic tasks for model evaluation and training in privacy-sensitive domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinancialAuditBench 是一个金融报表审计 agent 基准，用差分隐私聚合的历史审计统计加 1,100+ 小时审计专家评审，系统生成六个合成审计业务共 90 项任务（每个业务平均 179 个文件）。对十一个前沿模型的评测显示，agent 能较好完成相当一部分 staff 级审计任务，但会执行不恰当的审计程序或产出错误文档。
Motivation: 金融 agent 的可靠部署边界需要测量，但专有与隐私敏感数据难以获取，现有基准只能依赖公开数据、人写或 LLM 生成任务与简化设定，无法反映真实审计业务的规模与复杂度。
Method: 任务生成框架利用历史审计的差分隐私 (differential privacy) 聚合统计，结合 1,100 小时以上的基准开发与评审中贡献的审计专业知识，系统合成审计业务；基准覆盖 workpaper 填写与复核两类任务，分布在六个合成业务中，每个业务平均 179 个文件。
Result: FinancialAuditBench 含 90 项任务、六个合成审计业务、平均每业务 179 个文件，任务开发与评审投入超过 1,100 小时；在十一个前沿模型上的评测发现，agent 能较好完成相当一部分 staff 级审计任务，但有时执行不恰当程序或产出错误文档。
Conclusion: 差分隐私先验加专家评审可以系统生成隐私敏感领域的合成评测任务，且该框架可推广到金融审计之外的模型评测与训练；agent 在 staff 级审计任务上仍需人工监督以拦截不当程序与错误文档。

papers.title: Permutation-Equivariant Flow Matching for Alignment-Free Neural Weight Generation
papers.abstract_en: A trained neural network can be represented by a parameter vector in high dimensions. Learning distributions over these vectors enables the generation of new models across various tasks and architectures. A central challenge is permutation symmetry: permuting hidden neurons can produce distant parameter vectors representing the same function. This introduces variations that a generative model must account for when learning from trained networks. Existing methods typically address this using networks derived from a common base model or costly approximate neuron alignment. We instead parameterize a flow-matching velocity field with a permutation-equivariant Graph Meta Network, enabling direct learning from independently trained networks without alignment. Extensive experiments show that our method closely reproduces the joint statistics of accuracy, functional similarity, and weight similarity of independently trained collections, providing evidence of generation beyond checkpoint memorization. A single conditional model also generates task-specific networks on heterogeneous architectures and generalizes to unseen hidden-width configurations. On a tabular domain-shift task, intermediate conditioning produces individual networks with performance comparable to logit ensembles across both domains. Taken together, our results show how permutation equivariance enables learning from diverse collections of independently trained networks without permutation alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用置换等变的 Graph Meta Network 参数化 flow matching 速度场，直接从各自独立训练的网络学权重分布，绕开昂贵的神经元对齐。单一条件模型可在异构架构上生成任务特定网络并泛化到未见过的隐藏层宽度；在表格域偏移任务上，中间条件生成的单网络性能与两域上的 logit 集成相当。
Motivation: 神经权重生成要处理隐藏神经元置换带来的参数空间多解：同一函数对应相距很远的参数向量，现有方法只能依赖同源模型或昂贵的近似神经元对齐。
Method: 以置换等变的 Graph Meta Network 参数化 flow matching 速度场，使模型可直接从独立训练的网络集合学习，无需置换对齐；用条件生成覆盖异构架构与未见隐藏宽度。
Result: 方法紧密复现独立训练集合在准确率、功能相似度与权重相似度上的联合统计，给出超越 checkpoint 记忆的生成证据；单一条件模型在异构架构上生成任务特定网络并泛化到未见隐藏宽度；表格域偏移任务上，中间条件生成的单网络在两个域上性能与 logit 集成相当。
Conclusion: 置换等变性本身就足以让生成模型从多样、独立训练的网络集合中学习，无需先做置换对齐。

papers.title: Over-the-Air Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Mobile Wireless Networks
papers.abstract_en: Over-the-air computation has emerged as a scalable and efficient solution for deploying federated learning algorithms in wireless networks by exploiting waveform superposition for simultaneous model aggregation. Most existing work struggles with heterogeneous fading channels. These approaches either enforce unbiased updates from all devices or allow partial device contributions, requiring careful tuning of the convergence bound to mitigate bias under specific fading models. However, the former significantly amplifies receiver noise due to the weakest channel, whereas the latter is sensitive to fading model mismatch and converges only to a biased objective. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedOAG, which employs algorithmic components to automatically satisfy energy constraints via gradient normalization and evenly mix devices' updates through implicit gossiping. Importantly, FedOAG does not require transmission from all devices, nor does it rely on a specific fading model or knowledge of time-varying statistical channel distributions. We show that FedOAG converges to a stationary point of an unbiased non-convex objective at the best possible rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ for any stochastic first-order method. We corroborate our analysis with numerical experiments over dynamic wireless conditions on real-world datasets.
papers.comment: MobiHoc 2026 (the 27th International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedOAG 用梯度归一化自动满足空中计算 (over-the-air computation) 的能量约束，并通过隐式 gossiping 均匀混合各设备更新，在异构时变衰落信道下无需全员发送、无需指定衰落模型或时变信道统计知识，即可收敛到无偏非凸目标的驻点，速率达随机一阶方法的最优 O(1/√T)。
Motivation: 空中聚合 (AirComp) 联邦学习在异构衰落下两难：强制全员无偏更新会被最弱信道放大接收噪声，允许部分参与则对衰落模型失配敏感且只收敛到有偏目标。
Method: 提出 FedOAG：以梯度归一化 (gradient normalization) 自动满足能量约束，用隐式 gossiping (implicit gossiping) 均匀混合设备更新；不要求所有设备发送，不依赖特定衰落模型或时变统计信道分布的先验知识。
Result: 证明 FedOAG 收敛到无偏非凸目标的驻点，且达到任意随机一阶方法的最优速率 O(1/√T)；并在动态无线条件下用真实世界数据集 (real-world datasets) 的数值实验佐证分析。
Conclusion: 在异构移动无线网络中，靠归一化与隐式 gossiping 即可同时去掉全员参与和衰落模型假设，仍保住无偏收敛与最优速率。

papers.title: UniCache: Task- and Type-Aware KV Cache Compression for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models combine understanding, generation, and editing within a single network, offering a promising foundation for versatile multimodal applications. However, growing multimodal contexts make KV cache storage and access increasingly costly. Existing KV cache compression methods are typically tailored to specific tasks and single-modality caches, while overlooking changes in cache importance across tasks and timesteps. However, in unified multimodal models, each task involves multiple KV cache types, and both their composition and dynamics differ across tasks. As a result, a single compression policy overlooks task- and type-specific requirements, leading to the loss of critical information and degraded quality across tasks. Based on these findings, we propose UniCache, a training-free framework for task- and type-aware KV cache compression. UniCache identifies the cache segments activated by each task and assigns suitable compression policies through offline calibration. It coordinates their parallel execution under a shared storage budget through attention-guided allocation and task-aware temporal scheduling. Experiments show that UniCache achieves $5\times$ KV cache compression for understanding and editing and $2.5\times$ for generation with negligible quality loss, while increasing throughput by up to $1.78\times$ in long-context settings, significantly improving the practicality of scaling unified multimodal models to longer context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniCache 是面向统一多模态模型的免训练 KV cache 压缩框架：按任务识别被激活的 cache 段并离线标定各自的压缩策略，再用注意力引导的分配与任务感知时序调度在共享存储预算下并行执行。长上下文下理解与编辑任务实现 5× KV cache 压缩、生成任务 2.5×，吞吐最高提升 1.78×，质量损失可忽略。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型把理解、生成、编辑放进同一网络，多模态上下文变长后 KV cache 存储与访问开销急剧上升；现有压缩方法只针对单一任务和单一模态 cache，忽略 cache 重要性随任务与时间步的变化，导致关键信息丢失、各任务质量下降。
Method: 免训练 (training-free) 框架：先识别每个任务激活的 cache 段，通过离线标定 (offline calibration) 为各段分配合适的压缩策略；再在共享存储预算下用注意力引导分配 (attention-guided allocation) 与任务感知时序调度 (task-aware temporal scheduling) 协调并行执行。
Result: 长上下文设置下，理解与编辑任务达到 5× KV cache 压缩、生成任务 2.5×，质量损失可忽略；吞吐最高提升 1.78×。
Conclusion: 统一多模态模型的 cache 压缩必须按任务与 cache 类型分别定制策略并在预算下统一调度，才能在大幅压缩的同时保住各任务质量并提高长上下文吞吐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retimed Bellman Flows: Escaping the Impossible Triangle of Velocity Bootstrapping
papers.abstract_en: Flow critics learn return distributions by transporting Gaussian noise to Bellman endpoints via continuous velocity fields. While velocity bootstrapping stabilizes training by querying a successor teacher, existing methods face a structural dilemma: on straight paths, no residual-free same-time affine mapping can preserve Gaussian initial noise while maintaining an unbiased target. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Retimed Bellman Flows (ReBF). ReBF queries the teacher critic at a dynamically shifted earlier flow time, aligning intermediate student and teacher trajectories. By combining this retimed clock with fresh, decoupled noise generation, ReBF constructs a provably conditionally unbiased velocity target that preserves the Bellman fixed point and contracts under Wasserstein distances. Empirically, ReBF reduces $W_1$ distance to ground-truth return distributions by up to $7.7\times$ on synthetic MRPs and outperforms existing flow critics across 38 challenging OGBench and D4RL offline reinforcement learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 flow critic 中速度自举 (velocity bootstrapping) 的结构性两难——直线路径上不存在既保持高斯初始噪声又给出无偏目标的无残差同时刻仿射映射——提出 Retimed Bellman Flows (ReBF)：把教师 critic 查询点动态前移到更早的流时间以对齐师生轨迹，配合新鲜解耦噪声，构造可证明条件无偏的速度目标。该目标保持 Bellman 不动点并在 Wasserstein 距离下收缩；在合成 MRP 上与真实回报分布的 W1 距离最多降低 7.7×，并在 38 项 OGBench 与 D4RL 离线强化学习任务上优于现有 flow critic。
Motivation: flow critic 用连续速度场把高斯噪声输运到 Bellman 端点来学回报分布，速度自举虽能稳定训练，但在直线路径上无法同时保住高斯初始噪声与无偏目标，形成结构性两难。
Method: ReBF 在动态前移的更早流时间上查询 successor teacher critic，使中间时刻的学生与教师轨迹对齐；再结合新鲜、解耦的噪声生成，构造条件无偏的速度目标，并证明其保持 Bellman 不动点、在 Wasserstein 距离下收缩。
Result: 在合成 MRP 上，与真实回报分布的 W1 距离最多降低 7.7×；在 38 项 OGBench 和 D4RL 离线强化学习任务上优于现有 flow critic。
Conclusion: 重定时的教师查询加解耦噪声可以绕开速度自举的无偏性两难，得到既保 Bellman 不动点又在 Wasserstein 下收缩的条件无偏速度目标。

papers.title: Improving LLM Collaboration via Multi-Agent Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Several works have explored multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in LLM collaboration. However, constructing reliable rewards is difficult in practice, as complete and accurate metrics are often unavailable and hard to aggregate. Preference learning provides an alternative by learning from comparative human or AI feedback. Yet, its extension to multi-agent systems remains underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate preference-based multi-agent systems (MAS) from decentralized and centralized collaboration perspectives. We also introduce a general multi-agent preference learning framework (MAPL) to solve these problems. MAPL allows iterative updates by comparing the current solution with decentralized or centralized solutions generated by various agents. We instantiate MAPL using MARL from human feedback (MARLHF) with a learned reward model and multi-agent direct preference optimization (MADPO). Experiments on collaborative writing, coding, tool use, and travel planning show that MAPL can improve collaboration quality and efficiency while approaching the performance of MARL with fixed, well-defined rewards. Within MAPL, MARLHF generally outperforms MADPO on most tasks but remains sensitive to data coverage, agent and comparator models, and the underlying MARL algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAPL 把单智能体偏好学习推广到 LLM 多智能体协作，用去中心化与中心化两种比较方式迭代更新策略，绕开难以构造的固定奖励。在协作写作、编码、工具使用与旅行规划四类任务上，MAPL 使协作质量与效率提升并接近固定良定义奖励的 MARL 水平；其中 MARLHF 在多数任务上优于 MADPO，但对数据覆盖、智能体与比较器模型以及底层 MARL 算法敏感。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体协作的 MARL 依赖完整、准确且可聚合的奖励，实践中难以构造；偏好学习在多智能体系统中的扩展基本空白。
Method: 提出 MAPL 框架，从去中心化与中心化两个协作视角形式化 preference-based MAS，通过将当前解与各智能体生成的去中心化/中心化解比较实现迭代更新；具体实例化为带学得奖励模型的 MARLHF 与多智能体直接偏好优化 MADPO。
Result: 在协作写作、编码、工具使用、旅行规划四类实验中，MAPL 提升协作质量与效率并接近固定良定义奖励的 MARL 表现；MAPL 内部 MARLHF 在多数任务上优于 MADPO，但对数据覆盖、智能体与比较器模型及底层 MARL 算法敏感。
Conclusion: 偏好学习可在缺少可靠奖励时替代固定奖励训练 LLM 多智能体协作，且基于奖励模型的 MARLHF 比 MADPO 更稳，但其效果取决于数据覆盖与算法选择。

papers.title: The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: A four-stage LLM pipeline gives up as much as 40.5 accuracy points at its own interfaces (gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19; the largest tax in the primary family). We hold model, problem, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, vary only whether each stage can still see the original problem, and call the accuracy difference the decomposition tax. Across 21 open-weight models from nine organisations, on GSM-Hard and MATH-500 at n = 200 paired items per cell, 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction and 54 survive Holm. On GSM-Hard, a placebo recovers nothing: it carries at least 60% of the extra tokens and at most one word of the problem. Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. Rewriting one stage's instruction moves gemma-3-12B's tax from 4.5 to 36.5 points, and adding "every relationship stated between them" to a stage that lists the numerical quantities lowers the tax on 9 of 9 models on MATH-500. Re-grounding, which shows a stage the original problem again, belongs after the loss. With one lossy interface, re-grounding the stage after it beats re-grounding the stage before it on 7 of 7 models on both benchmarks; on MATH-500 the earlier repair is worse than none on 7 of 7. Newer models still pay: gemma-4-12B gives up 37.0 points, and the repair holds on all three of the newest models we test. A sealed held-out test refuted a stronger rule we registered, which predicted the paying stage from the interface and receiver types, so we locate the tax by measuring one stage at a time. The prescription has two parts: re-ground the stage after the lossy interface, and if a stage must list the quantities, tell it to keep the relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 四阶段 LLM 流水线在自身阶段接口上最多损失 40.5 个准确率点（gemma-3-12B 在 MATH-500，Holm 校正 p=1.66e-19）：固定模型、题目、阶段与提示，只改变每个阶段能否看到原题，差值即 decomposition tax。修复规则是把 re-grounding 放在有损接口之后——在两个基准上 7/7 模型均优于在接口之前 re-ground，且在 MATH-500 上提前修复比不修复还差（7/7 模型）。
Motivation: 构建者逐个阶段设计 LLM 流水线，却在阶段之间的接口处悄悄丢掉原题信息，损失在设计时不可见，需要可测量的归因方式。
Method: 固定模型、题目、阶段、阶段提示与补全预算，只翻转每个阶段能否看到原题，把准确率差定义为 decomposition tax；在 9 家机构的 21 个开源模型上、GSM-Hard 与 MATH-500 各 cell n=200 配对题目做检验，用 Benjamini-Hochberg 与 Holm 校正，并设 placebo（携带至少 60% 额外 token、至多一个原题词）与 sealed held-out test。
Result: 最大 tax 40.5 点（gemma-3-12B/MATH-500，Holm p=1.66e-19）；118 项 primary-family 检验中 70 项过 BH、54 项过 Holm；GSM-Hard 上 placebo 至多恢复一个词的信息；改写一个阶段的指令使 gemma-3-12B 的 tax 从 4.5 变到 36.5 点；给列举数值量的阶段补上“every relationship stated between them”在 MATH-500 上 9/9 模型降低 tax；单个有损接口时，re-ground 其后阶段在两个基准 7/7 模型优于 re-ground 其前阶段，MATH-500 上提前修复在 7/7 模型比不修复更差；gemma-4-12B 仍损失 37.0 点，最新三个模型均如此。
Conclusion: decomposition tax 定位要靠逐阶段测量：预注册的“由接口与接收者类型预测付费阶段”强规则被 held-out 测试推翻；处方是 re-ground 有损接口之后的阶段，且让列举数值量的阶段同时保留关系。

papers.title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
papers.abstract_en: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EGGroW（Efficient Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein methods），用 entropic Sinkhorn 类算法结合 GenusSink 与随机特征 (random features) 计算流形测地线上的 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离，绕开稠密空间内距离矩阵带来的三次复杂度。用于 3D 姿态估计与 3D 模板检测（模板恢复拆成容量约束场景选择 + 半松弛可见性与对应恢复），在标准欧氏方法失效处仍给出准确解且计算开销轻。
Motivation: GWD 可比较不同度量空间上的分布，但依赖稠密距离矩阵的三次复杂度限制了规模化使用；欧氏空间已有可扩展核方法，一般流形测地线与图最短路径距离上此前没有对应技术。
Method: EGGroW 用 entropic Sinkhorn 类方案计算测地 GWD，依托 GenusSink 方法与随机特征理论；下游任务为 3D 姿态估计与 3D 模板检测，后者把部分 3D 模板恢复表述为两阶段问题：容量约束的场景选择，随后对模板可见性与对应做半松弛恢复。
Result: 实证上 EGGroW 在标准欧氏技术失效的情形下给出准确解，并具有轻量计算开销，与论文的理论分析预测一致。
Conclusion: 测地 GWD 可以借助 Sinkhorn 化与随机特征做到可扩展且准确，从而把 GWD 用到 3D 姿态估计与模板检测这类非欧氏结构任务上。

papers.title: Routing Drift Alone Does Not Diagnose Failure in Merged MoE LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Model merging efficiently combines specialized large language models (LLMs) without joint retraining, but can substantially alter expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Such \emph{routing drift} is often interpreted as routing failure, raising a fundamental question that remains unclear: \emph{does routing drift after MoE merging actually indicate routing failure, and what evidence should justify repair?} We investigate these questions across DeepSeekMoE, OLMoE, and Qwen3-MoE proposing a routing analysis toolkit for controlled counterfactual interventions and token-level analysis. By crossing source and merged router inputs and parameters, we attribute most expert reassignments to input shifts rather than parameter changes at the same layer. However, source-relative routing differences poorly predict next-token likelihood gains from source-route restoration, and different expert selections can produce directionally similar mixture outputs. We therefore operationalize routing failure as \textit{task loss recoverable under a specified routing intervention, with non-routing parameters fixed.} These tests detect recoverable loss under deliberate router corruption, whereas source-route restoration does not establish reliable task benefits in the evaluated merged models. Motivated by these, we propose \emph{Selective Router Repair (SRR)} as a case study, and find that source-specialist token-likelihood advantages do not reliably identify beneficial local corrections. Together, these findings show that \textbf{routing drift alone is insufficient evidence of routing failure}: source-informed corrections must be judged by their task-level intervention effects. The analysis toolkit and SRR code are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DeepSeekMoE、OLMoE、Qwen3-MoE 上用受控反事实干预拆解模型合并后的 routing drift，发现专家重指派主要来自同层输入偏移而非参数变化，且 source-relative 路由差异无法预测恢复 source-route 带来的 next-token likelihood 增益。据此把 routing failure 操作化为「固定非路由参数时可由指定路由干预恢复的任务损失」：故意破坏路由器能检出可恢复损失，而恢复 source-route 在被评估的合并模型上不带来可靠任务收益，因此 routing drift 本身不足以作为路由失效证据。
Motivation: 模型合并 (model merging) 会大幅改变 MoE 的专家路由，routing drift 常被直接当作 routing failure 并触发修复，但漂移是否真的意味着失效、什么证据才够格支持修复，一直没有明确判据。
Method: 提出一套 routing 分析工具箱，做受控反事实干预与 token 级分析：交叉组合 source 与 merged 的路由器输入和参数，把专家重指派归因到输入偏移或参数变化；再把 routing failure 操作化为「非路由参数固定时可由指定路由干预恢复的任务损失」，并以 Selective Router Repair (SRR) 作为案例研究。
Result: 在 DeepSeekMoE、OLMoE、Qwen3-MoE 上，同层的大部分专家重指派归因于输入偏移而非参数变化；source-relative 路由差异对恢复 source-route 所带来的 next-token likelihood 增益预测很差，不同专家选择可产生方向相似的 mixture 输出；故意破坏路由器的测试能检出可恢复损失，而 source-route 恢复在被评估的合并模型上未建立可靠任务收益，SRR 中 source-specialist 的 token-likelihood 优势也不能可靠识别有益的局部修正。
Conclusion: routing drift 单独看不足以构成 routing failure 的证据，任何 source-informed 的路由修正都必须按其任务级干预效果来判定；分析工具箱与 SRR 代码已开源。

papers.title: Learning Shuffle Ideals with Membership Queries and Contrastive Examples
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies learning of shuffle ideals with membership queries as well as with contrastive queries---a form of membership query that reveals not only whether a selected word $w$ is in the target language or not, but also provides a most similar word $w'$ that belongs to the target language if %and only if $w$ does not. For both settings, it is shown that even some very simple classes of shuffle ideals cannot be learned efficiently. By contrast, we obtain positive learnability results for classes of shuffle ideals that meet certain structural conditions. In the case of membership queries, these structural conditions are related to the previously studied notion of universal words, and raise new questions in word combinatorics. In the case of contrastive queries, the structural conditions relate to partitioning sets of words that are listed in shortlex order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在成员查询 (membership query) 与对比查询 (contrastive query，即答非成员词时还返回一个最相似的成员词) 两种模型下学习 shuffle ideal，证明即便很简单的类也无法被高效学习，而满足特定结构条件的类则可学。成员查询下的条件与 universal words 相关，对比查询下的条件与 shortlex 序下词集的划分相关。
Motivation: shuffle ideal 的可学习性此前缺少刻画：哪些类在只回答成员关系、或额外返回相似成员词的查询下仍能高效学习，是形式语言学习与词组合学的开放问题。
Method: 分别在成员查询与对比查询两种查询模型下分析 shuffle ideal 的学习：给出不可高效学习的简单类的下界，并对满足结构条件的类给出正面可学性结果；条件分别联系 universal words 与 shortlex 序下的词集划分。
Result: 两种查询模型下均证明某些非常简单的 shuffle ideal 类不能被高效学习；同时对满足相应结构条件的类得到正面的可学习性结果。
Conclusion: shuffle ideal 的可学习性取决于结构条件而非查询强度：加入对比信息并不让简单类变得可高效学习，正面结果只在满足 universal words 或 shortlex 划分条件的类上成立。

papers.title: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing $|Q|$ Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value Divergence in High-UTD Soft Actor-Critic
papers.abstract_en: Raising the update-to-data (UTD) ratio breaks off-policy critics in two ways grouped as "plasticity loss": collapsing representations and growing value magnitude $|Q|$. We separate them in Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with scaled critics (width 2048, no normalization). Collapse is survivable: at UTD ratio 16, HalfCheetah critics with most units dormant keep learning, and the training guard, which stops runs whose loss or $|Q|$ explodes, never flags them. Within one high-UTD SAC configuration, runs start close together, and how far a critic's $\log_{10}|Q|$ has climbed by step 15k, its early growth, ranks the runs by how soon the guard flags them. At 15k, a flagged run's $|Q|$ sits a median of over a hundredfold below its flag level, yet the climb's rate already orders the flags (Harrell's C and out-of-sample AUC 0.78 on Walker2d, 0.98 on Ant, at UTD ratio 4). Dormancy does not. Aborting on this rate saves about a tenth of held-out Walker2d compute and stays net-positive live. A LayerNorm critic lowers the rate, removes the flag on Walker2d at UTD ratio 4 and lowers the return.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高 update-to-data (UTD) 比的 Soft Actor-Critic 中，把 plasticity loss 拆成表征坍缩与价值幅度 |Q| 增长两类，并证明后者可由早期增长速率做样本外预警。在 step 15k 处被标记 (flag) 的 run，其 |Q| 中位数仍比阈值低两个数量级以上，但 log10|Q| 的爬升速率已能排序预警：Walker2d 与 Ant 在 UTD ratio 4 下 Harrell's C 与样本外 AUC 分别为 0.78 与 0.98；按该速率中止可省约一成 held-out Walker2d 算力，而休眠单元比例 (dormancy) 无预警力。
Motivation: 提高 UTD 比会让 off-policy critic 出现两类 plasticity loss——表征坍缩与 |Q| 幅度增长——训练守卫 (guard) 只在损失或 |Q| 爆炸后才中止，浪费算力；需要在爆炸前判断哪些 run 会失败。
Method: 在 SAC 中用 scaled critics（宽度 2048、无 normalization）分离两类失效；同一高-UTD 配置下比较多个 run，以 step 15k 处 log10|Q| 的早期增长速率对 run 按被 flag 的早晚排序，用 Harrell's C 与样本外 AUC 评估，并与 dormancy 指标对照；另测 LayerNorm critic 的影响。
Result: UTD ratio 16 下 HalfCheetah 大量单元休眠的 critic 仍继续学习且 guard 从不触发；step 15k 时被标记 run 的 |Q| 中位数比 flag 阈值低一百倍以上，但增长速率已能排序：Harrell's C 与样本外 AUC 在 Walker2d 为 0.78、Ant 为 0.98（UTD ratio 4），dormancy 则无此能力。按该速率中止可省约一成 held-out Walker2d 算力且在线仍净收益；LayerNorm critic 降低该速率、消除 Walker2d 在 UTD ratio 4 的 flag，但降低回报。
Conclusion: 高 UTD 下可恢复的是 rank collapse，不可恢复的是 |Q| 持续增长；应以早期 |Q| 增长速率而非休眠率做中止判据，LayerNorm 虽压低预警信号却以牺牲回报为代价。

papers.title: When Can First-Order Models of Fine-Tuning Bound Forgetting?
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a language model on new data can make it forget facts that it should keep. We ask whether measurements taken at the start of a fine-tuning run can bound, for each protected fact, the probability that the run makes the model forget it. In LoRA fine-tuning with stochastic gradient descent on models from 0.6B to 14B parameters, a first-order response model estimated by finite-difference probes predicts changes of per-fact margins with correlation 0.974-0.998. Predictions of forgetting built on this model nevertheless failed, because forgetting requires parameter changes far outside the region in which the model was validated. The probes can, however, bound the probability that a margin first falls below a boundary near zero: we derive Freedman and Azuma first-passage bounds for a linear surrogate of the margin and test on new runs whether they hold for the model. The bounds contain a term R that measures how much the response coefficients change during the run. The simplified Freedman bound, which sets R = 0, certified most facts but was violated in 14 of 112 conditions, and every fact on which it was violated had R >= a, where a is the distance of the fact's margin to the boundary. The complete Freedman bound certifies only facts with R < a, and it held in every condition. On the violated facts, the spread of the margin across test runs was a median of 14.6 times the prediction of the response model, so the failures are breakdowns of the model, and in our data they occurred only where R >= a. We found this pattern post hoc and tested it in two preregistered confirmatory studies with 43 new conditions: the complete bound held in all of them, and the simplified bound failed there on only 3 facts, each with R >= a. First-order models of fine-tuning can thus bound forgetting on the facts whose response coefficients change by less than their distance to the boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LoRA + SGD 微调（0.6B–14B 模型）中，用有限差分探针估计的一阶响应模型对单条事实 margin 变化的预测相关性达 0.974–0.998，但直接据此预测遗忘会失败，因为遗忘发生在模型验证区域之外。作者改推 Freedman 与 Azuma 首达时 (first-passage) 界：完整 Freedman 界（要求响应系数漂移 R < 边界距离 a）在全部条件与 43 个预注册新条件中均成立；置 R = 0 的简化界在 112 个条件中违反 14 次，且被违反事实全部满足 R ≥ a。
Motivation: 微调会让语言模型遗忘本应保留的事实，但缺少在微调开始时就能对每条受保护事实给出遗忘概率上界的可检验方法；直接用一阶响应模型外推遗忘预测会因参数变化超出验证区域而失效。
Method: 在 LoRA + SGD 微调中用有限差分探针 (finite-difference probes) 在运行起点估计一阶响应模型，对 margin 的线性代理推导 Freedman 与 Azuma 首达时界，界中含度量响应系数漂移的项 R；先在新运行上事后检验，再用两个预注册确认研究（43 个新条件）验证 R < a 的判据。
Result: 一阶响应模型预测 per-fact margin 变化的相关性为 0.974–0.998；基于它的遗忘预测失败。简化 Freedman 界（R = 0）认证了大多数事实，但在 112 个条件中违反 14 次，违反事实全部 R ≥ a；完整 Freedman 界只认证 R < a 的事实，在所有条件中成立。被违反事实上 margin 跨运行的离散度中位数为响应模型预测的 14.6 倍。预注册确认研究的 43 个新条件中完整界全部成立，简化界仅在 3 条事实上失败，且均 R ≥ a。
Conclusion: 一阶微调模型不能预测遗忘本身，但只要响应系数的变化小于该事实到边界的距离（R < a），就能给出可认证的遗忘概率上界。

papers.title: Right Answer, Wrong Reason: Accuracy, Consistency, and Consensus Are Misleading Indicators of LLM Faithfulness in Clinical Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Clinical Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong medical-exam accuracy; however, a correct answer does not guarantee that the explanation names the concepts that actually drove the decision. We introduce three lightweight, directly interpretable metrics for this faithfulness gap: the Explanation Stability Index (ESI), which measures reasoning consistency across repeated queries; the Causal Faithfulness Score (CFS), which tests whether cited concepts drive predictions via concept ablation; and the Perturbation Stability Score (PSS), which measures robustness to semantic-preserving paraphrases. By evaluating six LLMs on 150 MedQA-USMLE questions (900 model-question observations), we found that only 23.3% of the cited clinical concepts were causally necessary. Correct answers had lower CFS than incorrect answers (0.212 vs. 0.398), answer consistency negatively predicted CFS (Spearman r = -0.466), and model pairs could agree on answers while sharing only 8.8% of cited reasoning concepts. These results show that accuracy, consistency, and consensus are incomplete safety signals for clinical decision-making support. The evidence is behavioral rather than mechanistic: concept ablation tests counterfactual sensitivity of outputs, not internal circuits.
papers.comment: Accepted and received best paper award from ICETCI 2026 Conference, https://ietcint.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 临床 LLM 答对题不等于解释忠实：提出 ESI、CFS、PSS 三个轻量指标，在 150 道 MedQA-USMLE 上测 6 个模型（900 次观测），只有 23.3% 被引用的临床概念是因果必需的，且答对题的 CFS 反而低于答错题（0.212 vs 0.398）。结论是准确率、答案一致性与模型间共识都不能单独作为临床决策支持的安全信号。
Motivation: 临床 LLM 医学考试准确率很高，但正确答案不保证解释里点出的概念真正驱动了决策；现有评估依赖准确率、一致性、共识这些指标，会掩盖解释与决策脱节的忠实性缺口。
Method: 提出三个可直接解释的指标：Explanation Stability Index (ESI) 衡量重复提问下推理的一致性，Causal Faithfulness Score (CFS) 通过概念消融 (concept ablation) 检验被引概念是否驱动预测，Perturbation Stability Score (PSS) 衡量语义保持改写下的鲁棒性；在 150 道 MedQA-USMLE 题目上评估 6 个 LLM，共 900 个模型-题目观测。

papers.title: Change the Product, Keep the Parameters: Associative Algebra Layers for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Fast matrix multiplication algorithms keep the product fixed and search for a cheaper way to evaluate it. We instead ask whether a Transformer's learned projections can use a different, cheaper product altogether. Building on an associative-algebra construction that replaces ordinary matrix multiplication with a sparser interaction table over the same weight blocks, we construct a family with quadratic arithmetic in the matrix dimension when the physical block size remains fixed, and derive finite-shape constraints for GPU execution. The construction is provably optimal for its bilinear rank by the Alder--Strassen bound and can be realized as row-typed rectangular projections compatible with causal masking and KV-cached decoding. We provide an empirical test of this approach by training two approximately 110M-parameter decoder-only Transformer LMs from the same recipe and 12.3B-token budget, differing only in their feed-forward layer: one uses ordinary dense matrix multiplication and the other uses the associative-algebra product. Across four prompt domains, the algebraic model achieves a 6.2--7.8\% increase in end-to-end generation throughput, while obtaining lower scores on all three reported downstream metrics. We treat these results as a feasibility and trainability check for the proposed approach at small scale, leaving further investigation to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transformer 投影里的普通矩阵乘法换成更稀疏的结合代数乘积 (associative algebra product)，在块大小固定时算术量随矩阵维度呈二次而非三次，且按 Alder–Strassen 界对双线性秩最优。约 110M 参数、12.3B token 预算下训练的两个 decoder-only LM 显示端到端生成吞吐提升 6.2–7.8%，但三项下游指标全部更低，作者将其定位为小规模可行性与可训练性检验。
Motivation: 快速矩阵乘法只在固定乘积下找更便宜的求值方式；本文反问 Transformer 的学习投影能否直接换用更便宜的乘积本身，以降低投影的算术复杂度。
Method: 基于把普通矩阵乘法替换为同一权重块上更稀疏交互表的结合代数构造，构造在物理块大小固定时对矩阵维度呈二次算术量的族，并推导 GPU 执行的有限形状约束；实现为与 causal masking 和 KV-cached decoding 兼容的 row-typed 矩形投影。实证部分用同一 recipe、12.3B token 预算训练两个约 110M 参数的 decoder-only Transformer LM，唯一差别是 feed-forward 层用稠密矩阵乘法还是结合代数乘积。
Result: 代数模型在四个 prompt 域上端到端生成吞吐提升 6.2–7.8%，但在报告的全部三项下游指标上得分更低。构造对其双线性秩按 Alder–Strassen 界可证最优。
Conclusion: 结合代数层在小规模上可训练且能换来吞吐收益，但当前代价是下游指标全面下降；作者将其视为可行性检验，进一步调查留待后续工作。

papers.title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 USAI-Quant：首个用遥感影像定量评估 VLM 对建成环境指标推理能力的基准，从美国 335 个最大城市对齐高分辨率遥感图像与量化指标，按三个复杂度层级出题。评测通用 VLM 与遥感 VLM (RS-VLM) 后发现，当前最强模型在数值推理任务上一致表现不足。
Motivation: 现有 VQA 基准与算法以定性问答为主，无法刻画 VLM 对建成环境量化指标的数值推理能力，而城市与空间 AI 恰恰依赖这类定量输出。
Method: 从美国 335 个最大城市整理高分辨率遥感影像并与量化建成环境指标对齐，构造覆盖数十个建成环境指标、三个复杂度层级的 VQA 题目；对通用 VLM 与 RS-VLM 分别施测，并按模型、题型、地理位置做分维度分析。
Result: 在数十个建成环境指标、三个复杂度层级的 VQA 上，当前 state-of-the-art 模型在数值推理任务上一致表现不足；分模型、题型与地理位置的分析揭示了性能差异与任务特有难点。
Conclusion: 定量建成环境推理是现有 VLM 的共同短板，需要专门的量化基准而非定性 VQA 来衡量，且表现随题型与地理位置变化。

papers.title: Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/PRE-ACT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRE-ACT 把事故预期从二分类改写为随碰撞逼近而连续上升的风险信号，通过显式的时间顺序约束与到事故距离感知逐步抬高风险并抑制过早报警。在 MM-AU 子集与 Nexar 上取得显著改进，并提出 Separation Score 用于评估整条风险曲线的全局行为。
Motivation: 现有事故预期方法多做二分类，只判断是否会发生而不建模何时发生，无法刻画风险随时间演化的过程，也缺少评价整条风险曲线的指标。
Method: PRE-ACT 框架将事故风险建模为连续演化信号，显式施加时间顺序 (temporal ordering) 与到事故距离感知约束，使风险随碰撞逼近逐步上升、抑制过早报警；另提出 Separation Score 在局部时间窗之外评估预测风险曲线的全局行为。
Result: 在 MM-AU 子集与 Nexar 上取得显著改进（摘要未列出具体数值），并引入 Separation Score 度量风险曲线的全局表现。
Conclusion: 把事故预期从是否发生改为何时逼近的连续风险建模，配合全局曲线评价指标，可同时提升提前识别与误报抑制。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Discussion Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Multidisciplinary tumor boards integrate multimodal clinical observations and longitudinal patient histories through specialist discussions, yet benchmarks rarely capture these real-world trajectories. We introduce OpenTumorBoard, a benchmark with 611 patient cases and 19,157 discussion turns across ten specialist roles, transcribed from 12,534 minutes of publicly available tumor board recordings on YouTube. The benchmark evaluates two settings: SPECIALIST TURN, in which an LLM responds to a clinically significant question posed during a real discussion, and BOARD SIMULATION, in which it generates an entire back-and-forth discussion and reaches a consensus on therapy recommendations, surgical plans, next actions and clinical trial matching. Evaluation of 14 general-purpose frontier and medical LLMs reveals substantial limitations: the best models score 3.43 out of 5 in clinical equivalence to specialist answers and 2.78 out of 5 in alignment with recorded board conclusions. Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning improve performance on a held-out test set, suggesting that real-world discussion trajectories can support model adaptation. Three M.D. experts review a subset of the benchmark, finding high information coverage and factuality of patient cases and strong fidelity of extracted consensus conclusions. We will release OpenTumorBoard and its automated curation pipeline to support the development and evaluation of LLMs for multidisciplinary, personalized cancer decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenTumorBoard 把 YouTube 上公开的肿瘤多学科会诊 (tumor board) 录音转成 611 例患者、19,157 轮讨论、覆盖十个专科角色的基准，设 SPECIALIST TURN（回答真实讨论中的临床问题）与 BOARD SIMULATION（生成整场往返讨论并就治疗推荐、手术方案、下一步行动和临床试验匹配达成共识）两个评测设置。评测 14 个通用与医学前沿 LLM，最佳模型临床等价性仅 3.43/5、与录播会诊结论的一致性 2.78/5；监督微调与强化学习可在留出测试集上提升表现。
Motivation: 多学科肿瘤会诊依赖多模态临床观察与纵向病史的专家讨论，但现有基准很少捕捉这种真实讨论轨迹，LLM 在该场景的能力缺乏可评测的载体。
Method: 从 YouTube 公开肿瘤会诊录音转写构建基准，含自动整理 pipeline；评测 14 个通用与医学 LLM 在 SPECIALIST TURN 与 BOARD SIMULATION 两设置下的表现，并用监督微调与强化学习在留出测试集上做模型适配；三名医学博士专家复核部分病例。
Result: 基准含 611 例患者、19,157 轮讨论、十个专科角色，源自 12,534 分钟公开录音；14 个 LLM 中最佳模型临床等价性 3.43/5、与录播会诊结论一致性 2.78/5；监督微调与强化学习在留出测试集上提升性能；三名 M.D. 专家复核显示病例信息覆盖与事实性高、提取的共识结论保真度强。
Conclusion: 前沿 LLM 在真实多学科肿瘤讨论轨迹上仍显著不足，而真实讨论轨迹本身足以支撑模型适配；作者将发布基准与自动整理 pipeline。

papers.title: Overwhelmed by Choice: Studying LLM Decision Making at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-choice and candidate-selection evaluations are widely used to assess LLM reasoning and decision-making, yet most benchmarks contain relatively small candidate sets. It remains unclear whether conclusions drawn from these settings remain valid as the candidate space scales. We systematically evaluate LLMs as the number of competing candidates increases and find substantial accuracy degradation across tasks, prompting strategies, and model scales. Controlled analyses show that standard long-context retrieval explanations cannot fully account for this degradation. Instead, we identify two systematic failure patterns. First, gold-margin collapse: the score gap between the correct answer and the strongest distractor progressively shrinks, driven primarily by weakening confidence in the correct answer. Second, earlier candidate preferences become increasingly difficult to overturn, with later candidates exerting progressively weaker influence on the final prediction. Motivated by these findings, we evaluate hierarchical partitioning and permutation-based inference, which improve accuracy by roughly 20 percentage points at $N=160$ on both HotpotQA and MIMIC. Overall, our results identify candidate-set scale as an important evaluation-protocol variable and show that strong small-option performance does not necessarily imply robust large-scale candidate comparison.
papers.comment: Accepted at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop. 23 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统评估 LLM 在候选集规模增大时的多选与候选选择决策，发现准确率随候选数增加在不同任务、提示策略和模型规模上普遍下降，且长上下文检索解释无法完全说明该下降。识别出两种失败模式：gold-margin collapse（正确答案与最强干扰项的分差持续缩小，主因是正确答案置信度减弱）与早期候选偏好越来越难被推翻；据此提出的分层划分与置换推断在 N=160 时于 HotpotQA 和 MIMIC 上各提升约 20 个百分点。
Motivation: 多选与候选选择评测的候选集通常很小，尚不清楚在小候选集上得出的结论能否随候选空间扩展仍然成立。
Method: 系统改变竞争候选数量 N，跨任务、提示策略与模型规模评估 LLM，并做受控分析排除长上下文检索解释；随后评测两种受失败模式启发的方法：hierarchical partitioning 与 permutation-based inference。
Result: 准确率随候选数增加在各任务、提示策略和模型规模上普遍下降；分层划分与置换推断在 N=160 时于 HotpotQA 与 MIMIC 上各提升约 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 候选集规模是评测协议中必须显式控制的变量，小选项集上的强表现并不意味着大规模候选比较同样稳健。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mind the Spike: Mechanisms and Brittleness of Visual Massive Activations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) inherit massive activations from their text-only bases: spikes where a few fixed hidden channels receive values thousands of times above the typical magnitude. The text spike systematically appears in early layers at a fixed initial position, independently of input content. Visual spikes vary across images, but whether their formation follows a consistent pattern across LVLMs and how they respond to image perturbations remain open questions. We find that some LVLMs do not form visual spikes, while others spike at different rates, typically in deeper layers. We identify the trigger direction from model weights and an interpretable location rule: before the language model decoder runs, eventual spike tokens are largely restricted to those sharing least with the rest of the image. Crucially, visual spikes are strikingly brittle. Common corruptions frequently create and relocate spikes, and less often remove them, raising overall incidence. Our trigger-guided spike attack deliberately creates or removes spikes under a small $\ell_\infty$ budget, with 1/255 enough in nine of the ten models that spike. Finally, our preventive intervention removes only the trigger component before spikes erupt, eliminating or substantially reducing spikes on clean and perturbed images while leaving the other image tokens nearly unchanged. Our study spans 25 adapter-based LVLMs built on 18 released text-only bases from 10 families, ranging from 2B to 72B parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统刻画视觉大模型 (LVLM) 中的视觉 massive activation（尖峰）：从权重中识别触发方向并给出可解释的位置规则——进入语言模型解码器前，将要成为尖峰的 token 主要限于与图像其余部分共享特征最少的那些。尖峰极脆弱，常见扰动常会新建或搬移尖峰，触发引导攻击在 ℓ∞ 预算 1/255 下即可在 10 个会尖峰的模型中的 9 个上制造或移除尖峰；仅在尖峰爆发前剔除触发分量的预防性干预可消除或大幅减少干净与扰动图像上的尖峰。
Motivation: LVLM 从纯文本基座继承了 massive activation，但视觉尖峰是否跨模型遵循一致形成规律、以及对图像扰动如何响应，此前是开放问题；尖峰的脆弱性也缺少可控的触发与抑制手段。
Method: 在 25 个 adapter 式 LVLM（基于 10 个家族的 18 个已发布纯文本基座，2B–72B 参数）上，从模型权重中识别触发方向，归纳尖峰 token 的可解释位置规则；构造触发引导的尖峰攻击（在小 ℓ∞ 预算下刻意制造或移除尖峰），并设计在尖峰爆发前只剔除触发分量的预防性干预。
Result: 部分 LVLM 完全不形成视觉尖峰，其余尖峰率各异且多出现在更深层；常见扰动经常新建并搬移尖峰、较少移除，总体发生率上升；触发引导攻击在 ℓ∞ 预算 1/255 下即可在 10 个会尖峰的模型中的 9 个上制造或移除尖峰；预防性干预在干净与扰动图像上消除或大幅减少尖峰，同时其余图像 token 几乎不变。
Conclusion: 视觉尖峰由权重中可识别的触发方向驱动、位置受可解释规则约束，且对常见扰动高度脆弱，因此可以在爆发前只干预触发分量来抑制它而不损伤其他图像 token。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Clinical LLM evaluation often emphasizes answer accuracy; however, accuracy alone does not test counterfactual consistency or demographic robustness. We evaluated six LLMs on 150 MedQA USMLE questions using two automated perturbation tests to assess their performance. The counterfactual validity (CFV) test asked each model to make a minimal, plausible clinical change that would make a different answer correct. The demographic robustness test added six demographic prefixes to the same vignette and compared the answers and explanations with a no demographic baseline. Of the 900 CFV attempts, 228 (25.3 %) were valid and 672 were invalid. Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%). Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category. MedGemma 27B achieved the highest accuracy (87.1%) and CFV (63.3%), lowest answer change rate (16.0%), and low mean Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) score (0.169). However, its accuracy still exceeded its CFV, indicating that correct answers do not guarantee reliable performance on the counterfactual validity task. OpenBioLLM had the highest answer change rate and EDD, whereas GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate. These findings show that accuracy, CFV, answer stability, EDD, and stereotype evidence capture different evaluation aspects. Because all judgments were automated and no clinician validation was available, the results support safety screening but do not establish clinical deployability of the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个 LLM 在 150 道 MedQA USMLE 题上做两类自动扰动评测：反事实有效性 (CFV) 与人口学前缀稳健性。900 次 CFV 尝试仅 228 次 (25.3%) 有效，5,400 次人口学对比中 1,097 次 (20.3%) 答案被改变；准确率最高的 MedGemma 27B (87.1%) 其 CFV 仍只有 63.3%，说明答对不等于反事实可靠。
Motivation: 临床 LLM 评测只看准确率，无法暴露模型在最小临床改动下是否换答案、以及加入人口学前缀后答案与解释是否漂移，这两类脆弱性直接关系安全筛查。
Method: 在 150 道 MedQA USMLE 题上评测六个 LLM：CFV 测试要求模型做出使另一选项正确的最小合理临床改动；人口学稳健性测试给同一病例加六个人口学前缀，与无人口学基线比较答案与解释，并用自动判官统计刻板印象证据标记与 Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD)。
Result: 900 次 CFV 尝试中 228 次 (25.3%) 有效、672 次无效；5,400 次人口学对比中 1,097 次 (20.3%) 答案改变；自动判官给出 3,128 个刻板印象证据标记，其中 1,932 个属 Other 大类。MedGemma 27B 准确率 87.1%、CFV 63.3%、答案改变率最低 16.0%、EDD 均值 0.169；OpenBioLLM 答案改变率与 EDD 最高，GLM 刻板印象标记率最高。
Conclusion: 准确率、CFV、答案稳定性、EDD 与刻板印象标记衡量的是不同评测维度，答对不保证反事实有效；因全部判断为自动且无临床医生校验，结果只支持安全筛查，不足以确立模型可临床部署。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Decision-Sufficient State Representations: Measuring and Reducing Write-Time Regret
papers.abstract_en: Long tasks produce more history than an LLM agent can hold in its context, and more than it uses reliably even when the history fits. A growing line of work therefore has agents carry a short written state instead: at every step a writer rewrites the state, and a reader acts from the state alone. Steps stay cheap, but anything the writer drops is lost before later decisions reveal that they need it. We quantify this loss and ask whether training can reduce it. Comparing the written state with the best state of the same size written in hindsight, we split the reader's loss into a budget loss, which any state of that size must incur, and a write-time regret, which comes from the writer's choices. In TextWorld cooking games where we control how long a fact must be carried before it is needed, a 128-token state holding the facts wins nearly every game, while prompted language-model writers win at most 17%. Almost all of the loss is write-time regret, and it grows with the delay. We then train the writer from the reader's own loss. DSSR (decision-sufficient state representations) scores candidate states by how well the reader acts after the writer carries them forward, and teaches the writer to prefer the better ones. This forward-rolled score predicts game outcomes ($ρ= 0.48$), whereas scoring a candidate as a fixed context, as hindsight methods usually do, does not ($ρ\leq 0.07$). On a pre-registered test split opened once, training adds +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] points of success when facts are needed soon, bringing a plain summary writer to the level of belief- and slot-based memory prompts. The gain shrinks as the delay grows and is significant only at the shortest delay. We trace this limit to credit assignment: keeping a fact now pays off only if every later rewrite keeps it too, which a per-step score cannot see.
papers.comment: 29 pages (10 main, 17 appendix), 12 figures (4 main, 8 appendix), 18 tables (2 main, 16 appendix)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的短写入状态 (written state) 中，读者损失可拆为任何同尺寸状态都有的 budget loss 与由写入者选择造成的 write-time regret；在 TextWorld 烹饪游戏里，128-token 状态几乎全胜，而提示式 LM 写入者最多赢 17%，且损失几乎全是随延迟增长的 write-time regret。用读者自身损失训练的 DSSR 前向滚动打分（ρ=0.48，固定上下文打分 ρ≤0.07）在事实很快被需要时把成功率提高 +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] 分，但延迟变长后增益缩小、仅最短延迟显著。
Motivation: 长任务历史超出 LLM agent 上下文容量，即使放得下也用不稳；写入者丢掉的事实要到后续决策才暴露其价值，这部分损失此前没有被量化，也无法归因到写入者本身。
Method: 把读者损失拆成 budget loss 与 write-time regret，用事后最优同尺寸状态作参照；在可控事实延迟的 TextWorld 烹饪游戏中测量，并提出 DSSR：按写入者前向携带候选状态后读者的表现给候选打分，再据此训练写入者，与 hindsight 式固定上下文打分对比。
Result: 128-token 状态几乎赢得全部游戏，提示式 LM 写入者最多赢 17%；损失几乎全是 write-time regret 且随延迟增长。前向滚动打分预测游戏结果 ρ=0.48，固定上下文打分 ρ≤0.07。在预注册测试集（一次性开启）上，事实很快需要时训练带来 +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] 分成功率，把普通 summary 写入者提到 belief- 与 slot-based memory prompt 的水平；增益随延迟变长而缩小，仅最短延迟显著。
Conclusion: 写入时后悔是短状态 agent 的主要损失来源，且可由读者自身损失训练来削减；其上限来自 credit assignment——保留一个事实只有在之后每次重写都保留时才有回报，这是逐步打分看不见的。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Finding Emotions Where They Belong: Rethinking Audio Emotion Recognition through Masked Temporal Affective Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Audio emotion recognition (AER) typically assigns a single label to an entire recording, leaving the temporal scope of that label ambiguous when multiple speakers and affective events are present. We address this limitation by reformulating AER as a Temporal Affective Grounding (TAG) task that associates emotions with temporally bounded speech spans and vocal tone descriptions. To support this formulation, we curate temporally annotated versions of existing emotion recognition datasets and construct recordings containing two to four affective speech spans, including overlapping speech. Training in this longer format with a standard language-modeling objective can degrade both emotion recognition and temporal grounding performance, while tone descriptions can provide shortcuts for emotion prediction. To address these challenges, we introduce Masked Temporal Affective Grounding (M-TAG), a supervised training objective that combines full-sequence language modeling with emotion and timestamp cross-entropy losses under attention masking. The masking varies the context visible to emotion-label tokens to reduce reliance on shortcuts and improve generalization, while the timestamp loss incorporates a distance-aware weight to penalize larger temporal errors. We evaluate EMO-TAG, a model fine-tuned using our dataset and objective, on emotion recognition and affective temporal-grounding against three AER and audio-language baselines: Flamingo-Next, Audio-Reasoner, and AffectGPT. Our results show that existing models achieve limited affective temporal-grounding despite competitive emotion recognition performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把音频情感识别 (AER) 重构成时序情感定位 (Temporal Affective Grounding, TAG) 任务，让情绪绑定到有时间边界的话语片段与音色描述；提出 M-TAG 监督目标，在注意力掩蔽下联合全序列语言建模与情绪、时间戳交叉熵，削弱音色描述捷径并惩罚更大的时间误差。评测显示现有模型情绪识别尚可但情感时序定位能力有限。
Motivation: AER 通常给整段录音打单一标签，在多说话人、多情感事件场景下标签的时间范围含糊；直接用标准语言建模目标在长格式数据上训练会同时损害情绪识别与时序定位，音色描述还会成为预测捷径。
Method: 为现有情感识别数据集整理时序标注版本，构造含 2–4 个情感语音片段（含重叠语音）的录音；M-TAG 目标在注意力掩蔽下结合全序列语言建模、情绪交叉熵与时间戳交叉熵，时间戳损失带距离感知权重以加大对更大时间误差的惩罚；EMO-TAG 模型用该数据与目标微调。
Result: 在 EMO-TAG 上对 Flamingo-Next、Audio-Reasoner、AffectGPT 三个 AER 与音频语言基线评测：现有模型情绪识别表现有竞争力，但情感时序定位 (affective temporal-grounding) 能力有限。
Conclusion: 整段录音单标签的 AER 范式无法给出可靠的情感时间范围，需用带掩蔽与距离加权时间戳损失的时序定位目标来训练；音色描述是必须切断的捷径。

papers.title: Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition
papers.abstract_en: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world. It integrates graph-grounded nutrition reasoning, hardware-aware LLM selection, and robot-based evidence acquisition. Nutri-ATLAS builds a unified Food-Nutrient knowledge graph from USDA FoodData Central and FoodKG and learns 64-dimensional GATv2 food and recipe embeddings. A shared hybrid graph-text scoring mechanism supports food nutrition extraction, nutritional gap filling, substitute retrieval, and recipe-level meal composition, while an LLM-guided skill interface navigates landmarks, updates dietary-context and food-accessibility memory, and grounds recommendations in observed food availability. We evaluate Nutri-ATLAS across nutrient estimation, substitution retrieval, recipe recommendation, patient-profile adherence, edge deployment, and real-world embodied execution. On HealthyFoodSubs, the hybrid retriever achieves 37.9% MAP, 80.7% RR@5, and 90.1% RR@10. On NutriBench v2, Dense+GAT retrieval grounds nutrient estimation across nine quantized Qwen3.5-9B configurations. On PFoodReQ, Nutri-ATLAS reaches 78.8% MAP, 83.0% MAR, and 77.5% F1. A patient-profile study shows adherence to allergy and healthy-target constraints for all selected cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Nutri-ATLAS 是一个具身营养助手智能体，用 USDA FoodData Central 与 FoodKG 构建统一食物-营养知识图谱，学习 64 维 GATv2 食物与食谱嵌入，并由混合图-文本打分支撑营养抽取、缺口填补、替代检索与食谱级配餐。在 HealthyFoodSubs 上混合检索器达到 37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5、90.1% RR@10，在 PFoodReQ 上达到 78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR、77.5% F1。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 营养系统只做被动文本交互、上下文静态，在食物描述含糊或营养证据缺失时不可靠，且缺少真实环境中的证据获取能力。
Method: 整合图接地营养推理、硬件感知 LLM 选择与机器人证据获取：从 USDA FoodData Central 和 FoodFoodKG 构建统一 Food-Nutrient 知识图谱，训练 64 维 GATv2 食物/食谱嵌入，共享的混合图-文本打分机制支持营养抽取、缺口填补、替代检索与食谱配餐；LLM 引导的技能接口负责地标导航、饮食上下文与食物可及性记忆更新，并在九种量化 Qwen3.5-9B 配置上做 Dense+GAT 检索。
Result: HealthyFoodSubs 上混合检索器 37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5、90.1% RR@10；NutriBench v2 上 Dense+GAT 检索在九种量化 Qwen3.5-9B 配置下接地营养估计；PFoodReQ 上 78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR、77.5% F1；患者画像研究中所有选定案例均遵守过敏与健康目标约束；评测覆盖边缘部署与真实世界具身执行。
Conclusion: 把知识图谱接地、混合检索与机器人证据获取合到一个智能体里，可以在营养估计、替代检索、食谱推荐和患者约束遵守上同时成立，并可边缘部署与实机执行。

papers.title: Re-derivability Decides What a Staged Agent Pipeline Recovers After an Upstream Fault
papers.abstract_en: One variable sets what an upstream fault costs a staged pipeline of language-model agents: re-derivability, how much of what a stage needs it can rebuild from the original problem. Grounding an inspector agent in that problem is worth +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] to +0.358 over a blind one on four open-weight backbones served with thinking disabled, and on the two Qwen backbones the blind inspector changes no item at all. That head-to-head is exploratory. One deterministic fault enters the first stage, and we re-expose the original problem to $k = 0,\dots,3$ of the downstream stages with agents, items, fault and topology held fixed, on 120 gsm_hard items per arm at temperature zero. Accuracy under fault rises on four of four backbones, from +0.233 to +0.392, the largest Holm-adjusted $p$ being $2.1\times10^{-6}$. A registered kill test rules out tokens. Blanking every word holds the word slots fixed, and retention tracks the visible fraction on four of four, climbing from 0.221 to 0.692 on the primary. Those two families are confirmatory and everything else here is exploratory. The interaction excludes zero on two of four backbones under the registered pipeline, four of four under a three-stage pipeline, and three of four under full message history, the primary at +0.317. On Llama-3.1-8B the fault carries no detectable cost at any dose, so the other three carry every claim about what a fault costs. Re-derivability also sets what the architecture costs, and no decomposition we measured reliably beats one direct call. With no fault injected the registered pipeline loses to that call by -0.267, -0.125 and -0.317, and on Phi-4 reads +0.058 at $p = 0.118$, which the test fails to separate from zero. The repair that works is cheap and front-loaded: the first re-grounded stage buys +0.394 of matched retention for +59.8 tokens per item on Qwen3-14B, and the stages after it buy nothing.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables; preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出 re-derivability（上游故障后某阶段能从原始问题重建所需信息的程度）作为决定分阶段 LLM agent 流水线故障代价的变量：把原始问题重新暴露给下游阶段可使故障下准确率在四个开源 backbone 上提升 +0.233 到 +0.392（Holm 校正 p 最大 2.1×10⁻⁶），且首个 re-grounded 阶段以每条 +59.8 tokens 的代价买到 +0.394 的 retention，后续阶段再加无效；但无故障时该流水线反而输给单次直接调用 −0.267、−0.125、−0.317。
Motivation: 分阶段 agent 流水线在上游阶段出错后，下游阶段是否还能恢复取决于它能否从原始问题重建所需信息，但这一代价此前缺少可判定的变量；同时流水线本身的架构开销是否值得也未被量化。
Method: 在四个开源 backbone（thinking 关闭、temperature 0）上注入一个确定性故障到第一阶段，把原始问题重新暴露给 k=0,…,3 个下游阶段，agent、条目、故障与拓扑固定，每臂 120 道 gsm_hard 题；比较 blind 与 grounding 到原始问题的 inspector agent，另设 registered kill test 排除 token 数解释，并做逐词置空（blanking）检验 retention 随可见比例的变化；报告 Holm 校正 p 值，区分 confirmatory 与 exploratory 分析。
Result: grounding inspector 相对 blind 提升 +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] 至 +0.358，两个 Qwen backbone 上 blind inspector 完全不改动任何条目；故障下准确率在 4/4 backbone 上升 +0.233 至 +0.392，最大 Holm 校正 p=2.1×10⁻⁶；逐词置空后 retention 随可见比例在 4/4 上升，主实验从 0.221 升到 0.692；interaction 在 registered pipeline 下 2/4 backbone 排除零、three-stage pipeline 下 4/4、full message history 下 3/4，主实验 +0.317；Llama-3.1-8B 上故障在任何剂量下无可检测代价；无故障时 registered pipeline 输给单次直接调用 −0.267、−0.125、−0.317，Phi-4 上 +0.058（p=0.118，与零无法区分）；首个 re-grounded 阶段在 Qwen3-14B 上以每条 +59.8 tokens 换来 +0.394 matched retention，其后阶段收益为零。
Conclusion: re-derivability 决定上游故障的代价，而修复应廉价且前置：把重 grounding 集中在第一个下游阶段即可拿到几乎全部收益；同时没有测得的任何分解方案能稳定胜过一次直接调用，无故障时分阶段流水线是净损失。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlanGuard 是首个在执行前对完整多步计划做物理安全检测的护栏：构建 MSP-Safe 数据集（配对任务、多规划器生成、三名裁判标注），先做任务导向 SFT，再用 STAC-OPD 沿学生 on-policy 轨迹做自适应强教师蒸馏。PlanGuard-2B 在全部测试子集上平均 ACC 87.15%、F1 87.21%，在紧凑模型规模上实现整计划物理风险检测。
Motivation: 现有护栏只看语义危害，具身安全检测器又把子任务孤立评估，忽略了子任务依赖与环境交互带来的组合性物理风险。
Method: 构建 MSP-Safe 数据集：配对任务构造、用多种规划器生成计划、由三名裁判做安全标注；先在 MSP-Safe 上做任务导向 SFT，再提出 STAC-OPD（Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation），沿学生 on-policy 轨迹提供自适应强教师监督，结合来自微调强教师的 token 级分布迁移与概率路由的序列级补偿——学生偏向参考安全决策时保留学生生成目标，否则改用教师重构目标。
Result: 在全部测试子集上 PlanGuard-2B 平均 ACC 87.15%、F1 87.21%；SFT 后紧凑模型与更强但更贵的大模型之间仍存在明显差距，STAC-OPD 即针对该差距设计。
Conclusion: 整计划物理安全可以在 2B 级紧凑模型上达到可用的检测水平，靠的是 on-policy 轨迹上的强教师自适应补偿；代码与数据集将公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Derivative-Informed Training of Neural Operators On-the-Fly via Sketched Tangent Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Derivative-informed training improves neural operators by directly supervising their input-output sensitivities, which is crucial when neural operators are used as differentiable surrogates for inverse problems, PDE-constrained optimization, design, and control. However, existing methods rely on offline-generated derivative labels, making data generation slow, storage-intensive, and difficult to adapt across datasets, resolutions, or perturbation bases. We propose sketched tangent consistency loss (sTCL), an on-the-fly derivative-informed training objective that, for PDEs with a known and differentiable residual, enforces sensitivity consistency directly from the governing equation without offline tangent labels or neural-operator architecture changes. sTCL uses randomly sketched input perturbations to provide a lightweight derivative-level physics constraint during training. However, raw forward-sensitivity residual penalties can fail for stiff, ill-conditioned, indefinite, or coupled saddle-point tangent operators. To address this, we introduce lightweight operator-aware loss-conditioning mechanisms selected by a simple tangent-operator decision rule. Across Helmholtz, nonlinear diffusion-reaction, Burgers, Allen-Cahn, and Navier-Stokes, with the same neural-operator backbone for all methods, the PDE-specific sTCL losses achieve solution and Jacobian accuracy comparable to offline derivative-informed training (DIFNO) while eliminating the offline derivative-data generation and storage pipeline. These results show that on-the-fly derivative-informed training need not merely amortize offline tangent-solve cost into training; with appropriate sketching and loss design, sTCL provides an effective drop-in path to derivative-informed neural operators. Code is available at https://github.com/yang9579/Derivative-informed-traning-on-the-fly.

papers.title: AgentHabit: Characterizing Distinct Behaviors of Agents on Everyday Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways. Even when their answers are useful, how agents carry out these tasks may not match users' preferences and needs. For example, agents differ in whether they ask clarifying questions or search the web. We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains. On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation. Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks. Profiling 18 models with AgentHABIT reveals a range of distinctive tendencies. For example, most GPT and Claude models state their assumptions and offer alternatives when requirements conflict, whereas Qwen and Google's models more often leave assumptions or changes to requirements unstated. These profiles remain recognizable even when built from entirely different sets of tasks, indicating that they reflect general tendencies rather than task-specific behavior. Prompting agents to adopt specific behaviors shifts some axes readily but barely changes others, while fine-tuning on another model's trajectories changes only part of a model's profile and leaves much of it intact. Overall, HABIT and AgentHABIT provide a systematic framework for characterizing how agents carry out everyday tasks beyond task success, offering insights to guide the development of agents whose behavior better fits users' needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出行为轴分类体系 HABIT（23 个轴、5 大类），由 3 位作者与 3 个 LLM 从 408 条 agent 轨迹、17 个领域自下而上归纳，并据此构建基准 AgentHabit，在 86 项日常任务上给 18 个模型的行为倾向画像。画像显示 GPT 与 Claude 多会声明假设、在需求冲突时给出备选，Qwen 与 Google 系模型更常不声明假设或需求变更；换一组任务重建画像仍可识别，提示这些是模型的总体倾向而非任务特例。
Motivation: LLM agent 即使任务成功，其执行方式（是否先问澄清问题、是否上网搜索）也可能与用户偏好不符，而现有人类价值观与 agent 行为分类体系难以清晰区分不同模型。
Method: HABIT：3 位作者与 3 个 LLM 从 408 条 agent 轨迹、17 个领域自下而上归纳出 5 大类共 23 条行为轴；AgentHabit 基准据此从轨迹中对每个 agent 在 86 项日常任务上的行为倾向做画像，并用提示指定行为与在他人轨迹上微调来检验画像可改性。
Result: 在 held-out 任务上 HABIT 区分模型比现有人类价值观与 agent 行为分类体系更清晰，同时标注一致性相当；用 AgentHabit 画像 18 个模型发现：多数 GPT 与 Claude 模型会声明假设并在需求冲突时提供备选，Qwen 与 Google 的模型更常不声明假设或需求变更；换用完全不同的任务集画像仍可识别；提示指定行为可较容易改变部分轴、几乎不改变另一些轴，而在另一模型轨迹上微调只改变画像的一部分，其余大体保持。
Conclusion: agent 的行为倾向是可跨任务集识别的模型级特征，任务成功之外需要一套系统框架来刻画行为；提示能部分调节行为轴，微调只能改动画像的一部分。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D 医学图像潜空间生成中，ℓ2 目标隐含的平坦欧氏假设不成立：潜空间几何高度各向异性，等幅误差会带来截然不同的解码失真，且敏感变化集中在一个低秩子空间。据此提出 Latent Structure Flow (LSF)，在每个 block 把潜状态拆成结构与残差，用全局上下文建模结构变化、局部预测残差变化，并保留输入结构的直通路径；在跨模态合成与肿瘤 inpainting 任务上，LSF 在全局与肿瘤专属指标上均超过全部对比基线。
Motivation: 潜空间生成模型用压缩空间让 3D 医学图像合成变得可行，但 ℓ2 目标诱导的平坦欧氏几何与潜空间实际的强各向异性不符，等幅误差的解码失真差异极大。
Method: 提出 Latent Structure Flow (LSF)：利用各向异性呈低秩的特征，把潜状态分解为结构分量（长程、空间协同、抗局部噪声）与正交残差（局部、图像特异），每个 block 用全局上下文建模结构变化、局部预测残差变化，并为输入结构保留直接通路；只改生成器，冻结 codec 与逐点训练目标不变。
Result: 在跨模态合成 (cross-modality synthesis) 与肿瘤 inpainting 两类任务上，LSF 在全局指标和肿瘤专属指标上均优于所有对比基线；arXiv comment 标注 5 页、4 图、4 表。
Conclusion: 显式建模潜空间的结构—残差不对称性能提升 3D 医学图像合成质量，且无需改动冻结的 codec 与训练目标。
Relevance: 4
