papers.title: Understanding and Exploiting Anisotropy in Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: LLM post-training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT), a mode-covering forward-KL objective, with reinforcement learning (RL), a mode-seeking reverse-KL objective. Frequency-weighted likelihood training leaves a well-known signature: \emph{anisotropy}, in which a few residual channels carry disproportionately large activations. Anisotropy is widely documented and usually treated as a defect, yet its function and its interaction with post-training remain unclear. We first analyze it. A label-free outlier rule isolates about 5\% of residual channels that are essential for language modeling: removing them raises perplexity from 10 to over $10^6$, versus 35 for count-matched random channels. Yet they barely distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning. SFT reshapes them, whereas RL leaves them largely intact and adapts the complementary channels. These channels therefore form the model's \emph{coherence substrate}, and reasoning adaptation happens elsewhere. We then exploit this. \textsc{SphereGate} learns one bounded gain per residual channel on a frozen backbone. Its activation-weighted gradients provably limit movement of high-energy coherence channels and leave the remaining channels free. With 0.1M trainable parameters, \textsc{SphereGate} outperforms parameter-efficient baselines by 2.0--7.3 points on MATH-500 across Qwen2.5 (0.5B--7B) and Llama-3-8B, is comparable or exceeds full-model GRPO. Anisotropy is not a defect but a division of labor that post-training can exploit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 后训练中的残差通道各向异性 (anisotropy) 不是缺陷而是分工：约 5% 的高能量通道承载语言建模连贯性，SFT 重塑它们而 RL 基本不动、转而调整互补通道。据此提出 SphereGate，在冻结骨干上为每个残差通道学一个有界增益，仅 0.1M 可训练参数即在 MATH-500 上比参数高效基线高 2.0–7.3 分。
Motivation: 各向异性被广泛记录却通常当作缺陷，其功能以及与 SFT/RL 后训练的交互关系不清，导致后训练无法有针对性地利用这些通道。
Method: 先用无标签离群规则分离约 5% 残差通道并做删除/随机对照，比较 SFT 与 RL 对这些通道与互补通道的改动；再提出 SphereGate，在冻结骨干上为每个残差通道学一个有界增益，其激活加权梯度在理论上限制高能量通道的移动、放开其余通道。
Result: 删除约 5% 离群通道使困惑度从 10 升到超过 10^6，等量随机通道仅 35；这些通道几乎不能区分正确与错误推理。SphereGate 用 0.1M 可训练参数在 MATH-500 上比参数高效基线高 2.0–7.3 分，覆盖 Qwen2.5（0.5B–7B）与 Llama-3-8B，并可比或超过全模型 GRPO。
Conclusion: 各向异性是后训练可利用的分工而非缺陷：连贯性由少数高能量通道承载，推理适配发生在其余通道，因此只需在冻结骨干上做通道级增益调制即可。

papers.title: $T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T$^5$（Twin-Critic Training）用两个 critic 从单条生成轨迹校准 token 级 advantage，通过条件矩鞍点目标学出随动作变化的混合权重，使每个前缀上的平均 advantage 趋于零，同时用信号保留约束防止修正抹掉学习信号。相比 SOTA 的 critic-free 方法，平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步时间最多降低 63.4%。
Motivation: 强化中训练里 token 级信用分配效率低：group-relative 方法要重复采样、成本高，而单 critic 的回报预测再准也不保证策略更新可靠——训练-推理失配与 PPO 裁剪会让 advantage 估计中的共同偏移无法抵消，引入额外更新漂移。
Method: 提出 T$^5$ 双 critic 方法：warmup 与 held-out 资格验证后，两个 critic 各给出一份 advantage 估计，用条件矩鞍点目标 (conditional-moment saddle-point objective) 学出的 action-dependent 权重进行混合，使每个前缀的平均 advantage 归零；信号保留约束 (signal-retaining constraint) 阻止修正抹除学习信号；跨文本位置共享信息以避免对每个前缀重复采样。理论上刻画了信号保留约束下的最优混合并给出残余均值诱导漂移的上界。
Result: 与 SOTA 的 critic-free 方法相比，T$^5$ 平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步时间最多降低 63.4%；理论上给出信号保留约束下的最优混合刻画与残余 mean-induced drift 的上界。
Conclusion: 准确的回报预测不足以保证可靠更新，用双 critic 校准 advantage 的共同偏移并配合信号保留约束，可以在单轨迹反馈下同时提升性能并大幅压缩训练步耗时。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: T$^5$（Twin-Critic Training）用两个 critic 从单条生成轨迹校准 token 级 advantage，通过条件矩鞍点目标学出随动作变化的混合权重，使每个前缀上的平均 advantage 趋于零，同时用信号保留约束防止修正抹掉学习信号。相比 SOTA 的 critic-free 方法，平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步时间最多降低 63.4%。
summary_sections.motivation: 强化中训练里 token 级信用分配效率低：group-relative 方法要重复采样、成本高，而单 critic 的回报预测再准也不保证策略更新可靠——训练-推理失配与 PPO 裁剪会让 advantage 估计中的共同偏移无法抵消，引入额外更新漂移。
summary_sections.method: 提出 T$^5$ 双 critic 方法：warmup 与 held-out 资格验证后，两个 critic 各给出一份 advantage 估计，用条件矩鞍点目标 (conditional-moment saddle-point objective) 学出的 action-dependent 权重进行混合，使每个前缀的平均 advantage 归零；信号保留约束 (signal-retaining constraint) 阻止修正抹除学习信号；跨文本位置共享信息以避免对每个前缀重复采样。理论上刻画了信号保留约束下的最优混合并给出残余均值诱导漂移的上界。

papers.title: FedHV: Low-Overhead Hypervolume Weighting for Federated Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Task-wise federated multi-objective optimization (FedMOO) trains a shared model for competing prediction objectives under heterogeneous data, partial participation, and communication constraints. Existing methods commonly derive task weights from gradient or update geometry. This requires task-specific information or iterative server-side optimization. We introduce FedHV, which maps reference-relative objective slacks to closed-form inverse-slack weights. Each client optimizes one weighted loss and returns objective estimates with its model update. The protocol adds exactly 2m auxiliary scalars per participating client, yielding Theta(d + m) total per-client communication, compared with the Theta(md) task-specific communication of FSMGDA, and requires no additional synchronization stage. We analyze the resulting one-round-delayed weights under client heterogeneity, multi-step local updates, partial participation, and finite-sample objective reports. Under a fixed-horizon positive-slack reference condition, with the prescribed horizon-dependent step size and vanishing report error, FedHV achieves an O(T^(-1/2)) rate for the average squared log-hypervolume gradient norm; persistent report error determines the resulting stationarity neighborhood. The same bound controls the squared Pareto-stationarity residual. Across six Dirichlet-partitioned non-IID settings from four vision benchmark families and three training seeds, FedHV exceeds FSMGDA and FedCMOO in mean accuracy in five settings. Among these methods and uniform scalarization, it achieves the highest worst-task accuracy in four settings and improves the difficult CIFAR-10 objective in both CIFAR10-MNIST settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedHV 把参考点相对的目标松弛 (objective slack) 映射为闭式 inverse-slack 权重，让每个客户端只优化一个加权损失并随模型更新回传目标估计，通信开销为每客户端 Theta(d+m)（仅多 2m 个辅助标量），低于 FSMGDA 的 Theta(md) 且不需额外同步轮次。在固定视野正松弛参考条件下，配合规定步长与消失的报告误差，平均平方 log-hypervolume 梯度范数达到 O(T^(-1/2)) 收敛率；在四个视觉基准家族的六个 Dirichlet 非 IID 设置、三个随机种子下，FedHV 在其中五个设置的平均精度超过 FSMGDA 与 FedCMOO。
Motivation: FedMOO 中现有任务权重多来自梯度或更新几何，需要任务级信息或服务器端迭代优化，在异构数据、部分参与和通信受限下开销大。
Method: FedHV 用参考点相对目标松弛的闭式 inverse-slack 权重替代几何权重：客户端优化单个加权损失，随模型更新回传目标估计（每参与客户端仅增 2m 个标量）；理论分析一轮延迟权重在客户端异构、多步本地更新、部分参与与有限样本报告下的行为，给出规定步长与正松弛参考条件。
Result: 通信量 Theta(d+m) 每客户端，对比 FSMGDA 的 Theta(md)；在正松弛参考、规定步长与报告误差消失时，平均平方 log-hypervolume 梯度范数收敛率 O(T^(-1/2))，同一界控制平方 Pareto 稳定性残差，持续报告误差决定稳定点邻域。实验在四个视觉基准家族的六个 Dirichlet 非 IID 设置、三个种子上：FedHV 平均精度在六个设置中五个超过 FSMGDA 与 FedCMOO；在这些方法与均匀标量化中，四个设置取得最高最差任务精度，并在两个 CIFAR10-MNIST 设置中都改善了较难的 CIFAR-10 目标。
Conclusion: 闭式 inverse-slack 权重可以在不引入服务器端迭代与额外同步的前提下支撑 FedMOO 的通信效率与 O(T^(-1/2)) 稳定性，且在非 IID 视觉多任务上平均与最差任务精度占优；持续的目标报告误差决定最终能达到的稳定点邻域。

papers.title: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出点云隐式几何场的分层频域压缩框架：把无序点云映射为物理包围盒内的隐式场，用平滑 Fourier 金字塔把全局几何压进低频分量、层间高频残差保留细节，再用分层 3D 神经网络条件预测压缩丢失的高频，最后经等值面提取还原点云。在超过八百万点的复杂边界点云上，压缩比高于现有方法且重建质量相当。
Motivation: 复杂几何的大规模点云表示带来难以承受的计算与内存开销，需要压缩的隐式表示，而压缩本身会丢掉重建细节所需的高频信息。
Method: 统一框架含三部分：无序点云映射到物理包围盒内的隐式几何场；构建平滑 Fourier 金字塔，以紧凑低频分量表示全局几何并编码层间高频残差；用分层 3D 神经网络做条件高频预测以补回压缩损失，重建的隐式场再经等值面提取 (isosurface extraction) 转回点云。
Result: 在含八百万以上点的复杂边界点云实验中，压缩比高于已有压缩方法，同时重建质量与之相当。
Conclusion: 频域分层压缩加条件高频预测可以在不牺牲重建质量的前提下提高大规模点云的压缩比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Getting Motif-ated: Controllable AI Compositions from Injected Motif Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has transformed symbolic music generation by borrowing the training paradigms of large language models, with systems such as NotaGen now producing complete, stylistically convincing classical scores from a short prompt. These systems could become powerful creative partners, helping musicians generate endless possibilities. However, current systems expose almost no control handles on the music itself. In principle, control handles could be built into a foundation model trained from scratch, but this is rarely practical without massive amounts of quality annotated data and compute resources. We therefore present MotiGen, a recipe for retrofitting pretrained symbolic music models to use new instruction prompts. MotiGen injects a musical motif as a structured prompt line, reinforces it with a scalar attention bias toward the motif tokens, and learns the association with a two-phase curriculum. First, it learns from focused excerpts cropped around motif occurrences in the training data, then full scores including the motifs. Our experiments show that our model composes with the prompted motif in over 92.3\% of generated pieces. Generated pieces using a variety of motifs are included in our sample site: https://motigen-site.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotiGen 把音乐动机 (motif) 作为结构化 prompt 行注入预训练符号音乐模型，用标量 attention bias 偏向 motif token，并以两阶段课程（先裁剪 motif 片段、后全谱）学习关联。生成作品中超过 92.3% 确实用到了所注入的 motif，从而在不重训基础模型的前提下补上可控性。
Motivation: NotaGen 等系统能从短提示生成完整古典乐谱，但几乎不提供对音乐本身的控制手柄；从零训练带控制的 foundation model 又需要大量高质量标注数据与算力，实践中不可行。
Method: MotiGen 是改造 (retrofit) 预训练符号音乐模型的配方：把 motif 作为结构化 prompt 行注入，加一个指向 motif token 的标量 attention bias，并用两阶段课程学习——先在训练数据中裁剪出 motif 出现位置的片段上学习，再过渡到包含 motif 的完整乐谱。
Result: 实验中模型生成的作品有超过 92.3% 包含所提示的 motif；另附多种 motif 的生成样例站点。
Conclusion: 无需从零重训，靠 prompt 注入加 attention bias 与两阶段课程即可让预训练符号音乐模型按给定 motif 可控作曲。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAIRE 把医疗行政表单填写拆成字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性校验、有界纠错、升级与审计追踪六个环节，语言模型只做映射辅助、不授权无依据或有后果的操作。在五个合成 schema、1,000 条源记录、24,000 个 benchmark episodes 上，完整 CLAIRE 在两套数据质量套件中 episode 成功率、字段准确率、必填完成率、依赖完成率均为 1.000；去掉校验后 stress 套件成功率降到 0.500。
Motivation: 医疗行政人员要在 EHR、转诊、理赔、provider roster 与工作队列之间向动态表单搬运结构化信息，纯语言模型直填缺少状态发现与确定性校验，容易产生无依据的字段写入。
Method: 混合工作流分阶段处理：字段状态发现、source-to-field 映射、确定性 validation、bounded correction、escalation、audit tracing。评测覆盖五个合成医疗行政 schema、1,000 条源记录、四种界面变体、两套数据质量套件与六个对照，共 24,000 episodes；另有 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 的 strict-output 直填审计，以及 6,000 episodes 的 trace 派生运营仿真。
Result: 完整 CLAIRE 在两套套件中 episode 成功率、字段准确率、必填字段完成率、依赖完成率均为 1.000；移除 validation 使 stress 套件成功率降至 0.500。仿真中 100.0% 的 clean 与 validation-stress episode 达到可供员工复核的草稿，escalation challenge episode 为 68.6%，无依据案例被拦截。按场景估算每例节省 149.7–165.5 秒，为仿真值而非实测员工耗时。
Conclusion: 在该合成基准条件下，schema-grounded、validation-first 的自动化可行：语言模型负责映射，校验环节负责阻止无依据与有后果的操作，去掉校验会使压力场景成功率减半。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning When to Recur: Token-Adaptive Recursion for Imbalanced Ophthalmic Domain Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Domain incremental learning is essential for adapting ophthalmic deep learning models to sequential clinical domains while preserving diagnostic expertise. Existing domain incremental learning methods predominantly address the domain shift induced by style variations. However, they often overlook the severe class imbalance inherent in real-world clinical scenarios, such as clinical referral systems. Institutions in these systems encounter drastic fluctuations in class priors, resulting in label distribution shift, a critical form of domain shift that triggers severe catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose ToRe, a rehearsal-free and parameter-efficient framework that leverages frozen ophthalmic foundation models for robust incremental adaptation. ToRe employs a parameter isolation strategy to decouple domain-specific optimization paths, thereby helping mitigate catastrophic forgetting driven by both label distribution shift and style variations. Simultaneously, it introduces token-adaptive recursion that adaptively allocates additional computational depth across tokens, allowing simple tokens to exit the recursion loop early while subjecting complex tokens, such as those associated with lesions, to deeper recursive processing. This mechanism enhances the feature representations for minority classes, thereby supporting generalization throughout the domain incremental learning process. Extensive evaluations on nine heterogeneous datasets demonstrate that ToRe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in overall performance across the three benchmarks, while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Together, these results support the applicability of ToRe to dynamic and imbalanced clinical environments. The code is available at https://github.com/Nancyolo/ToRe

papers.title: CollisionGAT: Controller-Agnostic One-Step Collision Screening for Multi-Agent Motion
papers.abstract_en: Before a team of robots moves, each proposed step must be checked for collisions with other robots and with obstacles. We present CollisionGAT, a graph-attention network that reads the current and proposed states of moving agents together with locally relevant stationary obstacles and returns one collision-risk score per moving agent. Any controller can use these scores to accept, repair, replan, or postpone a proposed step. We mount CollisionGAT on a continuous path-following controller and on GATeD, an obstacle-blind D* Lite planner that uses typed vetoes to update its planning graphs. Exact geometric checks supply the training labels and independently audit every executed step.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, 2 algorithms. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CollisionGAT 用图注意力网络对每个移动智能体输出一个碰撞风险分，任何控制器都能据此接受、修复、重规划或推迟所提议的一步。它被挂到连续路径跟踪控制器和 GATeD（基于 D* Lite 的障碍盲规划器）上，精确几何检查既提供训练标签又独立审计每一步执行。
Motivation: 多机器人团队每走一步前都要检查与其他机器人及障碍物的碰撞，而现有控制器与规划器各自为政，缺少一个与控制器无关、可复用的单步碰撞筛查模块。
Method: 图注意力网络读取移动智能体的当前与提议状态以及局部相关静态障碍，为每个移动智能体输出一个碰撞风险分；训练标签由精确几何检查提供。该分数被接入连续路径跟随控制器，以及使用 typed veto 更新规划图的障碍盲 D* Lite 规划器 GATeD。
Result: 精确几何检查为每个执行步提供训练标签并独立审计；系统在连续路径跟随控制器与 GATeD 规划器两种挂载方式下运行，输出为每智能体一个碰撞风险分。
Conclusion: 碰撞筛查可以做成控制器无关的单步打分模块，由任意控制器用于接受、修复、重规划或推迟，并由精确几何检查保证执行期可审计。

papers.title: Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support
papers.abstract_en: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU cohorts from two independent institutions, the proposed model achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction to patient dynamics baselines, with more consistent improvements when physiological states are changing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出响应感知的患者动力学模型，把预测的生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动力学与呼吸支持相关偏离，以室内空气 (room air) 作为分解参考锚点，并用响应通路 (response pathway) 在自回归状态更新中显式编码这一变化。在两个独立机构的 ICU 队列上，整体轨迹预测与患者动力学基线相当，而在生理状态正在变化时改进更一致。
Motivation: 同一呼吸支持干预下患者生理轨迹差异很大，而临床患者动力学模型把生理变化几乎全部压进预测的未来状态，缺少对干预响应本身的显式表示。
Method: 模型将预测生理变化分解为状态依赖基线动力学与呼吸支持相关偏离，room air 提供分解参考；一条响应通路编码该变化并在整个预报时段内更新潜在患者状态，作者并对这一参考锚定形式给出形式化分析。
Result: 在两个独立机构的 ICU 队列上，整体轨迹预测与患者动力学基线相当 (comparable)，当生理状态处于变化中时改进更一致。
Conclusion: 把干预响应显式建模为对基线动力学的偏离，可以在不牺牲整体轨迹预测精度的前提下，让状态变化阶段的预测更稳定。

papers.title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CT-OPD 把教师完整回答按学生词表重切词，并用学生当前反向过程各阶段的未解位置掩码重建部分状态，使监督位置跟随当前轨迹、可见上下文与目标保持一致。在稠密与稀疏扩散架构上九基准平均提升最高 9.80 点，统一理解-生成架构上视觉理解与图像生成同时改善。
Motivation: 扩散视觉-语言模型后训练中，掩码完整回答得到的掩码不反映模型实际的揭示决策，而基于轨迹的强化学习只有响应级反馈，采样奖励打平时失去区分度。
Method: CT-OPD 组合教师完整回答与当前学生的轨迹掩码：将教师回答按学生词表重切词，在学生反向过程各阶段提取未解位置掩码，丢弃临时 rollout 值、从教师端点重建部分状态，再用模型原生 categorical loss 训练，轨迹随模型更新刷新。
Result: 在稠密与稀疏扩散架构上一致提升多模态理解与推理，九基准平均提升最高 9.80 点；在统一理解-生成架构上同时改善视觉理解与图像生成；消融把增益归因于一致重建与当前模型轨迹掩码。
Conclusion: 让 token 级监督同时对齐一致上下文与模型自身揭示决策这一原则，可跨扩散架构与跨模态（理解、生成）迁移。

papers.title: OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector. For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniMoE-VL 提出耦合视觉深度路由的投影器 (coupled visual-depth routed projector)，为每个图像-指令对稀疏选择中间视觉层深度，并把该全局偏好同时用于局部 patch 融合与向语言模型的动态视觉注入，从而实现问题相关的视觉访问且保持原生视觉 token 序列。在八个图像基准上平均分 85.9，总参数 28B、激活 9B；受控对比显示路由视觉接口是主要架构增益来源。
Motivation: 稀疏 MoE 只扩展了语言侧计算，视觉信息仍经固定跨模态接口进入语言侧，没有回答针对给定问题应暴露哪些中间视觉表示这一未决选择。
Method: 耦合视觉深度路由投影器：对每个图像-指令对稀疏选择若干中间视觉深度，得到全局偏好并同时指导局部 patch 融合与向语言模型的动态视觉注入；与视觉和语言栈内的 token 级专家路由互补，并保留原生视觉 token 序列。
Result: 在八个图像基准上平均分 85.9，总参数 28B、激活 9B；受控对比表明路由视觉接口带来主要架构增益，匹配的路由与组件对照、同图路由分析以及路由干预进一步支持耦合与问题条件化视觉访问的价值。
Conclusion: 把视觉深度选择做成问题条件化的路由并让其同时驱动融合与注入，是该稀疏 VLM 的主要增益来源，且可在 9B 激活参数下取得 85.9 的八基准平均分。

papers.title: Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on task intention without reconstructing pixels. This prediction and action decoding shape the representation jointly, while the policy retains access to current-frame spatial detail for execution. Representation analyses show that the learned features better separate task-driven change from perturbations and provide complementary information for control. Compact prediction targets reduce training tokens per sample, enabling a 2B-parameter model trained in 9.67 hours on 8$\times$ RTX 5090 GPUs and 6$\times$ faster than Fast-WAM on matched A100 GPUs. Copper-Policy outperforms every compared method without embodied pretraining on RoboTwin and several embodied-pretrained VLAs on LIBERO-Plus (80.85%). On three challenging real-robot tasks, it performs comparably to $π_{0.5}$ and attains a higher average score. Together, these results show that Copper-Policy combines strong control performance with efficient training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Copper-Policy 不再在像素或隐空间预测完整未来，而是与策略联合学一个紧凑 World 表示：用 temporal joint-embedding prediction 按任务意图预测未来观测 embedding，再由动作解码共同塑形表示，同时保留当前帧空间细节供执行。2B 模型在 8×RTX 5090 上 9.67 小时训完，比 Fast-WAM 在同款 A100 上快 6 倍；LIBERO-Plus 达 80.85%，三项真机任务平均分高于 π0.5。
Motivation: World Action Model 在像素或隐空间预测细粒度未来代价高昂；而 co-training 收益在不做 test-time generation 时依然存在，说明 WAM 真正该学的是对控制有用的表示而非重建未来。
Method: 与策略联合学习一个紧凑 World 表示，不依赖预定义目标空间：通过 temporal joint-embedding prediction 按任务意图预测未来观测 embedding（不重建像素），该预测与动作解码共同塑造表示，策略同时保留当前帧空间细节用于执行；并做表示分析检验特征对任务驱动变化与扰动的区分度。

papers.title: Agentic Network Traffic Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: As the use of agentic artificial intelligence increases in nearly every industry, there exists a widening attack surface. It is necessary to monitor agents to ensure that agents are acting in a way that is aligned with the users intent. Auditing an agent's network traffic provides a clear record of the agent interactions. This work presents a novel approach to monitoring the network traffic of agentic systems using complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices by integrating DBOS (DataBase OS), the OneSparse PostgreSQL database, and the GraphBLAS math library. To develop these concepts an agentic simulator was constructed, allowing a varying numbers of AI agents to collectively survey a virtual environment using different strategies. The resulting network traffic matrices enable easy monitoring of the AI agents.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, to appear in IEEE URTC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用复值超稀疏流量矩阵 (complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices) 监控 agentic AI 系统的网络流量，把 DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL 与 GraphBLAS 串成一条审计链路，并构造 agentic 模拟器让可变数量的 AI agent 以不同策略集体勘察虚拟环境，产出的流量矩阵便于监控 agent 行为是否符合用户意图。
Motivation: agentic AI 在各行业部署扩大了攻击面，需要可审计的记录来核对 agent 行为是否与用户意图一致，而 agent 交互缺少清晰的留痕手段。
Method: 以复值超稀疏流量矩阵表示 agent 间通信，集成 DBOS (DataBase OS)、OneSparse PostgreSQL 数据库与 GraphBLAS 数学库进行存储与运算；另构建 agentic 模拟器，让数量可变的 AI agent 用不同策略共同勘察虚拟环境以生成流量数据。
Result: 构建了可变 agent 数量、多种策略的 agentic 模拟器，并产出可直接用于监控 AI agent 的网络流量矩阵；摘要给出的成果为方法与模拟器本身（5 页、3 图，将发表于 IEEE URTC 2026）。
Conclusion: 把 agent 网络流量组织成复值超稀疏矩阵并落在稀疏数据库栈上，可以作为审计 agentic 系统交互、核对其与用户意图一致性的可行路径。

papers.title: Robust Bayesian Optimization with Q-Exponential Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used framework for optimizing expensive black-box objectives, but standard BO methods often use Gaussian process (GP) surrogates whose Gaussian assumption is sensitive to outliers and heavy-tailed noise. We introduce q-ED-BO, a robust BO method whose surrogate follows a univariate q-exponential (q-ED) distribution, preserving GP-BO's closed-form posterior mean and variance while a shape parameter q controls the tail behavior, recovering the GP at q = 2 and growing heavier-tailed with wider confidence bounds as q decreases. This tractability yields a closed-form q-upper confidence bound (q-UCB) with sublinear regret, and an exact closed-form q-expected improvement (q-EI) that generalizes EI to the heavy-tailed predictive, recovering classical EI at q = 2. Experiments on beamformer and adaptive filter tuning with impulsive outliers show that q-ED-BO matches or exceeds existing baselines on clean data, and under corruption, improves the strongest baseline by approximately 0.7 dB in output SINR and 1.1 to 1.2 dB in misalignment reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 q-ED-BO：把 BO 的 GP 代理换成单变量 q-exponential (q-ED) 分布，用形状参数 q 控制尾部，q=2 时退回 GP，并给出闭式 q-UCB（次线性 regret）与闭式 q-EI。在含脉冲离群点的 beamformer 与自适应滤波器调参上，干净数据持平或略优于基线，污染下把最强基线的输出 SINR 提升约 0.7 dB、失配降低 1.1–1.2 dB。
Motivation: 标准 BO 用 GP 代理，其高斯假设对离群点和重尾噪声敏感，在受污染的昂贵黑箱优化中置信界失真、采集函数失效。
Method: 代理采用单变量 q-exponential 分布，保留 GP-BO 的闭式后验均值与方差，q 控制尾部（q=2 恢复 GP，q 减小尾更重、置信界更宽）；据此构造闭式 q-UCB（带次线性 regret）与闭式 q-EI（q=2 退回经典 EI）。
Result: 在 beamformer 与自适应滤波器调参、含脉冲离群点的实验中：干净数据上与现有基线持平或更优；污染下相对最强基线输出 SINR 提升约 0.7 dB，失配降低 1.1 至 1.2 dB。
Conclusion: 用 q-exponential 代理替代高斯代理，可在保持闭式后验与采集函数可解性的同时，让 BO 在重尾/离群噪声下更稳健，且不牺牲干净数据表现。

papers.title: Beyond Gaussian Assumptions: Distribution-Aware Channel Capacity for Effective Connectivity
papers.abstract_en: Effective-connectivity estimation from brain signals often relies on Gaussian residual modeling, which enables tractable estimation but can discard informative distributional structure and distort inferred directed interactions when empirical residuals are non-Gaussian. We show across multiple modalities, species, and experimental conditions that both brain signals and fitted channel residuals frequently deviate from Gaussianity. We therefore introduce a distribution-aware, information-theoretic measure of effective connectivity based on channel capacity under general residual distributions. To estimate the resulting capacity from empirical, potentially non-Gaussian residuals, we develop a dual-flow min-max estimator based on normalizing flows, in which a generator searches over admissible input distributions under a power constraint while an observer estimates output entropy. We provide a theoretical characterization of the estimator, showing that the observer objective recovers differential entropy up to a KL approximation term, that the formulation reduces to classical Gaussian capacity as a special case, and that residual entropy can alter achievable information rates beyond variance; game-gap and error analyses further characterize optimization and approximation sources. In brain-like simulations with known directed connectivity, Dual-flow achieves the highest AUROC and AUPRC across ten conditions spanning diverse network topologies, hidden drivers, feedback, and heterogeneous hemodynamics, compared with Gaussian capacity, Granger causality, VAR-LiNGAM, and GIMME. Applied to multimodal brain signals, the method reveals time- and condition-resolved directed interactions consistent with known neurobiological circuitry. Together, these results establish a principled distribution-aware framework for effective-connectivity estimation beyond Gaussian residual modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于广义残差分布下信道容量 (channel capacity) 的有效连接度量，用基于 normalizing flow 的 dual-flow min-max 估计器同时搜索满足功率约束的输入分布与估计输出熵。在含已知有向连接的类脑仿真十种条件下，Dual-flow 的 AUROC 与 AUPRC 均高于 Gaussian capacity、Granger causality、VAR-LiNGAM 与 GIMME。
Motivation: 脑信号有效连接估计普遍假设残差高斯，可解但会丢弃分布信息，在残差非高斯时扭曲推断出的有向交互。
Method: 定义一般残差分布下的信道容量式有效连接度量；dual-flow min-max 估计器中 generator 在功率约束下搜索可行输入分布，observer 估计输出熵。理论刻画：observer 目标在 KL 近似项下恢复 differential entropy，高斯容量为特例，并给出 game-gap 与误差分析。
Result: 在含已知有向连接的类脑仿真中，Dual-flow 在跨十种条件（多样网络拓扑、隐变量驱动、反馈、异质血流动力学）上取得最高 AUROC 与 AUPRC，对比 Gaussian capacity、Granger causality、VAR-LiNGAM、GIMME；多模态脑信号上给出与已知神经回路一致的时序与条件分辨有向交互。
Conclusion: 有效连接估计应超越高斯残差假设：残差熵本身会改变可达信息率，分布感知的容量框架在仿真与真实多模态信号上都给出更可信的有向交互。

papers.title: Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals
papers.abstract_en: Monetary-policy announcements and central-bank communications play a central role in foreign exchange markets, yet their qualitative, unstructured form makes their forecasting value difficult to quantify. While prior research has largely focused on sentiment extracted from financial news, comparatively little is known about the relative contribution of different dimensions of monetary-policy communication. Existing studies primarily evaluate whether textual information improves overall forecasting performance but provide limited insight into which communication channels drive such improvements. To address this gap, this paper introduces a statistical attribution methodology that decomposes monetary-policy communication into interpretable channels and quantifies their incremental forecasting contribution under false-discovery-rate control. Monetary-policy news is transformed into structured communication signals using large language models (LLMs) and temporal feature engineering. These signals are evaluated using rolling-window experiments with tree-based machine-learning models. The results show that monetary-policy communication contains measurable predictive information. Attribution analysis shows that predictive value is concentrated in a small subset of signals, with communication timing providing the strongest individual feature-level contribution, targeted communication-activity measures also contributing positively, and LLM-derived sentiment providing complementary information at the group level. The findings indicate that communication-based forecasting value extends beyond sentiment alone and that attribution, rather than aggregate accuracy alone, is central to evaluating news-derived signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 把货币政策沟通新闻转成结构化信号，在滚动窗口下用树模型预测日内 USD/CAD 汇率，并在 FDR 控制下做统计归因。归因显示预测价值集中在少数信号上：沟通时点 (communication timing) 的单特征贡献最强，定向沟通活动度量次之，LLM 情绪只在组层面提供补充信息。
Motivation: 既有研究多问文本信息是否提升整体预测精度，却说不清是哪个沟通渠道在驱动提升；货币政策沟通的定性、非结构化形式也使其预测价值难以量化。
Method: 用大语言模型 (LLM) 与时间特征工程把货币政策新闻转为结构化沟通信号；以滚动窗口实验配合树机器学习模型评估，并提出在错误发现率 (FDR) 控制下的统计归因方法，把沟通分解为可解释渠道并量化各自的增量预测贡献。
Result: 货币政策沟通含有可测的预测信息；归因显示预测价值集中在一小部分信号，沟通时点的单特征级贡献最强，定向沟通活动度量也呈正向贡献，LLM 派生情绪在组层面提供互补信息。
Conclusion: 基于沟通的预测价值不止于情绪本身，评估新闻衍生信号时归因比单纯看整体精度更关键。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Learnable Randomization as Commitment Against Adaptive Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: A pricing page can walk the posted price up to the last amount a buyer still accepts, a recommender can hold back a better item for a barely acceptable promoted one, and a classifier can shift its boundary once applicants change their features. The system predicts the response and then picks the menu that serves its own objective, so the surplus above the user's cutoff is taken. Playing the single best action publishes that cutoff, while noise on actions the user would never take throws away payoff and teaches the platform that a worse menu is still acceptable. We study unpredictable near-optimal policies (UNOP), which mix uniformly on near-best actions that remain individually rational. The mixture is a commitment about the response. On a finite price grid, when the best sure-demand price strictly out-earns the randomized band, a seller who already knows the curve posts below the band, and the purchase that occurs is deterministic. Knowing that curve is not the same as predicting the next draw. The mixture can be learned and the optimizer can match its best response, while the user's payoff stays higher because the mixture changes which action is targeted. In pricing and in policy-aware recommendation this leaves more surplus than greedy play when the platform optimizes against the curve and more than one action is acceptable. The gain goes away under quality ranking, a singleton near-optimal set, a wrong utility estimate, or a short-horizon explorer. That is also where mixing should be turned off if the other side is trying to cooperate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UNOP（unpredictable near-optimal policies）：平台在仍满足个体理性的近最优动作上均匀混合，用混合分布本身作为对用户响应的承诺，避免暴露用户可接受的底线。在有限价格网格上，当最优保需求价格严格优于随机化区间时，已知需求曲线的卖方会把价格定在区间之下且成交是确定的；在定价与 policy-aware 推荐中，只要平台是对着曲线优化且有多个动作可接受，混合比贪心打法留下更多剩余。
Motivation: 平台先预测用户响应再选对自己最优的菜单，会把用户底线之上的剩余全部拿走：打出唯一最优动作等于公布底线，而在用户绝不会选的动作上加噪声既损失收益又让平台学到更差的菜单仍可接受。
Method: 定义 UNOP：在仍满足 individual rationality 的近最优动作上均匀混合，混合本身构成对响应的承诺；在有限价格网格上分析已知需求曲线的卖方定价，并把同一机制推广到 policy-aware recommendation，讨论最优保需求价格严格优于随机化区间时的最优反应。
Result: 有限价格网格上，当 best sure-demand price 严格高于随机化区间收益时，已知曲线的卖方定价落在区间之下且成交确定；混合可被学习、优化器能匹配其最优反应，而用户剩余更高，因为混合改变了被瞄准的动作。在定价与 policy-aware 推荐中，当平台对着曲线优化且可接受动作多于一个时，混合比贪心打法留下更多剩余；增益在 quality ranking、近最优集为单点、效用估计错误或短视探索者这四种情形下消失。
Conclusion: 混合近最优动作是对抗自适应优化器的一种可学习承诺，其适用条件是存在多个 individually rational 的近最优动作且对方并非合作；这些条件不成立时应关掉 mixing。

papers.title: Continual Learning via Self-Probe Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Adapting pretrained models to new data can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behavior. When only a few past samples remain, they give continual learning methods sparse and narrow evidence about what to preserve. We show that language models can expand this evidence through self-probing, in which the frozen model generates new inputs from the retained samples and records its own predictions on them. Unlike prior work that replays such data as training examples, our method, CPLUS uses self-probe and past-sample gradients to scale down parameter updates that conflict with prior behavior. Experiments with five language models on four benchmarks show three results. First, the same probes preserve more prior behavior as gradient signals than as replay data. Second, CPLUS learns the new data while consistently reducing forgetting more than existing baselines, especially when past data are scarce, and this protection extends to benchmarks not used for training. Third, we observe that CPLUS also becomes more effective as models grow: within the Qwen3 model family, it recovers an increasing share of the forgetting caused by standard fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CPLUS 用冻结语言模型对留存旧样本做 self-probe（自生成新输入并记录自身预测），把 probe 梯度与旧样本梯度合起来缩小与旧行为冲突的参数更新。五个语言模型、四个基准上，同样的 probe 作为梯度信号比作为回放数据保住更多旧行为；在旧数据稀缺时遗忘下降幅度超过现有基线，且保护泛化到未参与训练的基准。
Motivation: 预训练模型适配新数据会灾难性遗忘；当只剩少量旧样本时，持续学习方法可用的“该保住什么”的证据稀疏而狭窄。
Method: CPLUS：冻结模型从留存样本 self-probe 生成新输入并记录自身预测，用这些 probe 梯度与 past-sample 梯度共同缩放（scale down）与旧行为冲突的参数更新，而非把 probe 当回放训练数据。
Result: 五个语言模型、四个基准的实验给出三点：同样的 probe 作为梯度信号比作为回放数据保留更多旧行为；CPLUS 学到新数据的同时比现有基线更稳定地减少遗忘，旧数据稀缺时尤其明显，且保护延伸到未用于训练的基准；在 Qwen3 模型族内，模型越大 CPLUS 恢复的“标准微调所致遗忘”份额越大。
Conclusion: 自生成的 probe 作为梯度约束比作为回放样本更有效，且这条持续学习路径随模型规模增大而更有力。

papers.title: Structuring Relations Among Learning Paradigms via Protocol--Objective--Resource Reductions
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning spans supervised, transfer, continual, meta-learning, and related regimes that often reuse the same hypothesis classes, architectures, and optimizers but differ in information access, objectives, memory, adaptation, and sample accounting. This makes it difficult to determine whether one paradigm is genuinely distinct, a special case of another, or part of a broader structural hierarchy. We introduce a protocol-objective-resource (POR) framework that separates representational capacity from these design choices. A paradigm is specified by an environment class, observation protocol, admissible learners, performance functional, and resource accounting rule. POR reductions combine environment embeddings, learner compilers, threshold maps, and calibrated resource overheads. Our main theorem shows that such reductions imply worst-case complexity domination on embedded comparison classes, transferring upper bounds forward and lower bounds backward; under labeled-example accounting, this yields sample complexity domination. We also show that calibrated nontrivial accuracy regimes are necessary to avoid vacuous comparisons, and that strengthening the objective can strictly increase minimax sample complexity even with unchanged protocols and learner classes. Instantiating the framework for supervised, transfer, continual, and meta-learning yields canonical special-case relations: continual contains transfer, transfer contains supervised, and meta-learning contains supervised under aligned raw-example accounting. We further derive a non-exact episode-to-example reduction for episodic meta-learning and capture within-paradigm refinements such as replay memory and task identifiers. The framework thus provides a unified language for structuring learning paradigms and transferring complexity guarantees across them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 protocol-objective-resource (POR) 框架，把学习范式拆成环境类、观测协议、可采纳学习器、性能泛函与资源记账规则，用环境嵌入、学习器编译、阈值映射和校准资源开销定义范式间归约。主定理证明这类归约蕴含嵌入比较类上的最坏情形复杂度支配（上界前传、下界后传），在标注样本记账下给出样本复杂度支配，并得到 continual ⊃ transfer ⊃ supervised、meta-learning ⊃ supervised 的包含关系。
Motivation: 监督、迁移、持续、元学习常复用同一假设类与优化器，却在信息访问、目标、记忆和样本记账上不同，难以判定一个范式是真正独立、另一范式的特例，还是更广层级的一部分。
Method: POR 用五元组（环境类、观测协议、可采纳学习器、性能泛函、资源记账规则）刻画范式，归约由环境嵌入、learner compiler、阈值映射与校准资源开销组成；并给出 episodic 元学习到样本的非精确 episode-to-example 归约，以及 replay memory、task identifier 等范式内细化的刻画。
Result: 主定理：POR 归约在嵌入比较类上给出最坏情形复杂度支配，上界前传、下界后传，标注样本记账下化为样本复杂度支配；校准的非平凡精度区间是避免空洞比较的必要条件；即使协议与学习器类不变，强化目标也可严格增大 minimax 样本复杂度。实例化得到 continual 包含 transfer、transfer 包含 supervised、meta-learning 在对齐的 raw-example 记账下包含 supervised。
Conclusion: POR 提供一套统一语言来结构化学习范式并跨范式转移复杂度保证，其判断标准是复杂度支配而非表面的架构差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnchorMixGAN: Anchor-Aligned Generative Semi-Supervision for DDoS Detection in Cloud-Integrated IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: Detecting distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks in cloud-integrated IoT networks is difficult when labeled traffic is scarce. Generative semi-supervised learning can supplement the available training data, but prediction shifts induced by synthetic views may affect the targets assigned to real unlabeled flows. We propose AnchorMixGAN, a generative semi-supervised framework that addresses this problem through anchor-aligned target construction. Its Anchor-MAS module treats each real unlabeled flow as an anchor and creates alternative views by replacing one field group at a time with values from generated traffic. A frozen reference classifier predicts the anchor and its views; averaging and sharpening these predictions produces a soft target for the original flow. The flow and its target are then mixed with a labeled example using MixUp, allowing the detector to learn from both the original labeled records and the mixed examples. We analyze how reference-classifier error, view construction, and sharpening affect the target, and derive a bound on the resulting change in cross-entropy at a fixed detector prediction. At the reported 90% training setting with 20% of the training records labeled, AnchorMixGAN attains accuracies of 97.3%, 97.4%, and 96.5% on NSLKDD, BoT-IoT, and CICIoT2023, respectively, exceeding the corresponding MixGAN results by 1.6, 1.0, and 4.4 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorMixGAN 用锚点对齐的目标构造解决云集成 IoT 网络中标签稀缺的 DDoS 检测：以每条真实无标签流为锚，逐组替换字段生成合成视图，冻结参考分类器对锚与视图的预测做平均与锐化得到软目标，再与有标签样本 MixUp 混合训练。在 90% 训练设置、仅 20% 记录有标签时，NSLKDD、BoT-IoT、CICIoT2023 准确率分别达 97.3%、97.4%、96.5%，比 MixGAN 高 1.6、1.0、4.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 云集成 IoT 网络中 DDoS 标注流量稀缺，生成式半监督学习可补充训练数据，但合成视图引起的预测偏移会污染分配给真实无标签流的训练目标。
Method: Anchor-MAS 模块把每条真实无标签流当锚点，一次替换一个字段组、取生成流量的值构造替代视图；冻结的参考分类器对锚与各视图预测，平均并锐化得到该流的软目标，再与有标签样本用 MixUp 混合。作者分析参考分类器误差、视图构造与锐化对目标的影响，并推导固定检测器预测下交叉熵变化的界。
Result: 在 90% 训练设置、20% 训练记录有标签的条件下，AnchorMixGAN 在 NSLKDD、BoT-IoT、CICIoT2023 上准确率分别为 97.3%、97.4%、96.5%，分别超出 MixGAN 1.6、1.0、4.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 锚点对齐的软目标加 MixUp 能在低标签率下把生成式半监督的预测偏移控制住，从而在三个入侵检测数据集上稳定超过 MixGAN。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mandela-Bench: Multimodal Models Remember Canonical Images Instead of Seeing Them
papers.abstract_en: Historical photographs and other canonical images can now be edited seamlessly with a single instruction, often leaving no reliable pixel-level trace. In such cases, the only evidence of manipulation may be a fact about what the image depicts. Existing benchmarks instead rely on generator artefacts, image-caption inconsistencies, visual implausibilities, or external references, and therefore do not test whether a model can use its own world knowledge to verify a recognized image. We introduce Mandela-Bench, containing 1,507 edits of canonical images: 1,359 knowledge-only forgeries, each contradicting one verifiable fact, and 148 anchor-free controls that preserve the editing process without introducing a factual contradiction, together with 474 untouched originals. We score not only whether a model detects a forgery, but whether its explanation identifies the inserted entity or the fact being violated. Across 36 multimodal models, from 0.8B parameters to frontier scale, we find a consistent failure mode. When a public figure is removed from a familiar photograph, models still name that person in up to 72.7% of responses. Some models can distinguish the replacement face from the original when shown in isolation, yet still judge the full edited photograph as authentic. Providing the true event and date does not improve knowledge-grounded detection, whereas providing the same information after cropping away the recognizable composition does. Even under explicit verification prompts, only one of the 36 models meets the KGR criterion on at least half of the forged images. These results suggest that the failures cannot be explained by missing knowledge or inadequate perception alone. Instead, they are consistent with recognition biasing verification toward the remembered canonical image rather than the observed edit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mandela-Bench 用 1,507 条经典图像编辑（1,359 条知识型伪造 + 148 条无锚点对照）加 474 张原图，检验多模态模型能否用世界知识核验被识别图像是否被改。在 36 个模型（0.8B 到前沿规模）上发现一致失败：移除公众人物后模型仍最高 72.7% 的回答点名该人物，且 36 个中仅 1 个在至少一半伪造图上满足 KGR 判据。
Motivation: 单指令图像编辑已不留像素痕迹，操纵证据只剩图像所描绘的事实；现有基准依赖生成器痕迹、图文不一致或视觉不合理，无法检验模型是否用自己的世界知识核验一张被识别的图像。
Method: 构建 Mandela-Bench：1,359 条各违反一条可验证事实的知识型伪造、148 条保留编辑过程但不引入事实矛盾的 anchor-free 对照，以及 474 张未改动原图；评分既看是否检出伪造，也看解释是否指出被插入的实体或被违反的事实（KGR 判据），并在 36 个 0.8B 至前沿规模的多模态模型上施加不同提示条件（给真实事件与日期、裁掉可识别构图、显式核验提示）。
Result: 36 个模型中，移除熟悉照片里的公众人物后，模型仍最高 72.7% 的回答点名该人物；部分模型单独看替换人脸能区分，却仍判定整张编辑图为真实；提供真实事件与日期不提升知识接地的检出，裁掉可识别构图后再给同样信息则有效；即便显式核验提示，36 个模型中仅 1 个在至少一半伪造图上满足 KGR 判据。

papers.title: An Empirical Study on What Matters for Viewpoint-Generalizable Policies in Visual Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Visual imitation learning is a promising approach to training robot manipulation policies capable of completing a wide variety of tasks. However, policies today remain brittle to viewpoint perturbations, making deployment in diverse environments a challenge. We present a controlled empirical study of which design choices allow visuomotor policies to generalize across viewpoints. We find that viewpoint generalization improves when dense visual tokens are retained and the action head participates in geometric reasoning. On a suite of simulated tasks that span a wide range of camera poses, we show that these design choices yield a policy that remains performant across viewpoints. As a practical consequence, a policy trained with these design choices also transfers zero-shot from simulation to the real world under random camera configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视觉模仿学习中策略对视角扰动脆弱的问题，受控实证研究发现：保留稠密视觉 token、并让动作头参与几何推理，可使视角泛化提升。在覆盖大范围相机位姿的仿真任务套件上，按这两项设计训练的策略在各视角下保持性能，并能以随机相机配置零样本从仿真迁移到真实世界。
Motivation: 机器人操作的视觉模仿策略对视角变化敏感，换相机位姿后性能下降，限制了在多样环境中的部署。
Method: 对视觉运动 (visuomotor) 策略的设计选择做受控实证研究，比较保留稠密视觉 token 与动作头参与几何推理等选择，在覆盖大范围相机位姿的仿真任务套件上训练并检验策略。
Result: 保留稠密视觉 token 且让动作头参与几何推理时，视角泛化提升，策略在各视角下保持性能；按此设计训练的策略在随机相机配置下实现仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移。
Conclusion: 视角泛化主要取决于视觉 token 粒度与动作头是否参与几何推理，这两项设计足以支撑随机相机配置下的 sim-to-real 零样本部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.
papers.comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Haoru Wang and Qianfan Shen contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一重建与生成的 flow-based 公式：共享 clean-target predictor 在单步端点直接做重建，经多步 flow 展开做条件生成。玩具实验显示单步会塌缩到条件均值（等同前馈方法、偏一致牺牲多样），多步下生成细节保真度随上下文丰富度提升；实例化为 JiT-LVSM 与 JUSt3R，新视角合成的感知与分布质量改善，单步几何预测保持竞争力且多步推理减少 veil 与 flying-pixel 伪影。
Motivation: 重建与生成长期分属两种范式且失败模式相反：前馈重建把歧义平均成模糊，条件生成编出合理但与场景不一致的细节；Atlas 等空间世界模型说明二者合一有价值。
Method: 统一 flow-based 公式：共享 clean-target predictor，单步端点直接重建，多步 flow 展开条件生成；先用受控玩具研究验证机制，再在外观与几何两类 3D 任务上实例化为 JiT-LVSM 和 JUSt3R。
Result: 玩具研究显示单步时 predictor 塌缩到条件均值、偏好一致性而非多样性；多步推理下生成细节保真度随上下文丰富度增长，观测越近歧义越小、细节匹配越好。JiT-LVSM 在新视角合成上提升感知与分布质量；JUSt3R 保持有竞争力的单步几何预测，同时多步推理减少 veil 与 flying-pixel 伪影、在更多测试时计算下产出更干净的表面结构。
Conclusion: 重建与生成可以共享同一公式与同一 backbone，行为由 denoising 配置（单步 vs 多步）决定，因此统一比预想简单。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Extender: A Log-Structured Transformer
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Extender, a log-structured variant of the standard Transformer architecture. In a standard Transformer, each layer communicates with subsequent layers exclusively via the residual $\mathbf{h}$, a superposition channel. The Extender adds a concatenation channel $\mathbf{x}$: each layer $\ell$ emits both a residual update $δ_\ell$ which is added to $\mathbf{h}$, and a much smaller extension $ε_\ell$ which is appended to $\mathbf{x}$. While both the FFN and $\mathbf{q}$ see $\mathbf{h}$, the attention $\mathbf{kv}$ projections take only $\mathbf{x}$ as input. As a result, the fully extended $\mathbf{x}$ contains the complete input for the $\mathbf{kv}$ projections of all layers, reducing the persistent attention memory footprint from $2Ld_{model}$ to $\sum|ε_\ell|$. We find that with $|ε_\ell|=32$, the Extender matches Transformer accuracy on short-context (CORE) tasks at 199M-924M parameters, and exceeds Transformer accuracy on long-context (RULER) workloads, again at 924M parameters. For our 1664-wide, 924M model, the Extender's persistent attention memory footprint is $104\times$ smaller than MHA. The memory savings grow with model width.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 log-structured Transformer 变体 Extender：每层除残差更新 δ_ℓ 外再输出一个小的扩展 ε_ℓ 拼进独立的 concatenation 通道 x，attention 的 kv 投影只读 x 而不读叠加态 h。当 |ε_ℓ|=32 时，199M–924M 参数下短上下文 CORE 任务与标准 Transformer 精度持平，924M 参数下长上下文 RULER 负载超过 Transformer；1664 宽、924M 模型的常驻 attention 显存比 MHA 小 104 倍，且节省随模型宽度增长。
Motivation: 标准 Transformer 各层只能通过叠加通道 residual h 通信，kv 投影的输入被压在这一条通道里，常驻 attention 显存随层数与宽度线性增长，长上下文负载下成为瓶颈。
Method: Extender 在 h 之外增加 concatenation 通道 x：每层发出加到 h 的残差更新 δ_ℓ 和远更小的扩展 ε_ℓ（追加进 x）；FFN 与 q 仍读 h，只有 attention 的 kv 投影只读 x。完全扩展后的 x 汇集了所有层 kv 投影的完整输入，把常驻 attention 显存从 2L·d_model 降到 Σ|ε_ℓ|。
Result: 取 |ε_ℓ|=32 时，Extender 在 199M–924M 参数区间于短上下文 CORE 任务上匹配 Transformer 精度，并在 924M 参数下于长上下文 RULER 负载上超过 Transformer 精度；1664 宽、924M 模型的常驻 attention 显存比 MHA 小 104 倍，显存节省随模型宽度增大。
Conclusion: 把 kv 投影的输入从叠加的残差通道拆到独立的紧凑 concatenation 通道，可以在不损失短上下文精度、并提升长上下文表现的前提下大幅压缩常驻 attention 显存，且收益随宽度放大。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: How Far Do Persona Effects Generalize in Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: Persona prompts ask language models to answer as particular kinds of people. We test whether relationships learned from these effects predict responses to new questions and remain useful across models and prompts. Across 57 attributes, three behavioral domains, and seven pairs of open 7 to 9B checkpoints, persona effects can be predictable without being portable. Separate attribute and task gains improve prediction beyond shared scaling significantly in OLMo-3 and Qwen2.5, with the most robust evidence in OLMo-3. In that model, target refitting significantly outperforms gains borrowed from each of the other six pairs. Across model transfers, borrowed gains with one amplitude underperform shared scaling in most directions; allowing two target parameters removes the significant losses but yields no significant benefit over target shared scaling. After rewording, refitting significantly outperforms reuse with one amplitude in all six tested pairs, while changes of examples or country context often preserve reuse value. In the tested prompt transfers, regularized updates outperform both reuse strategies in median at 64 target questions per attribute. A separate survey comparison finds that selecting the more responsive checkpoint can worsen human fit; responsiveness is confounded with training status, and temperature calibration largely removes this cost but not errors in group ordering. Within the tested gain representation, apparent transfer can come from target calibration; source relationships must add predictive value beyond calibration and regularization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain
papers.comment: 42 pages, 11 figures, 41 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 57 个人格属性、三个行为领域、七对 7–9B 开源模型上检验 persona 效应能否跨问题、跨模型、跨提示迁移：效应可预测但不可移植，跨模型借用单一幅度的增益在多数方向上不如共享 scaling，改写提示后目标重拟合在全部六对中显著优于复用。作者主张，表面迁移可能只来自目标端校准，源关系必须在校准与正则化之外提供额外预测价值。
Motivation: Persona prompts 让模型扮演特定人群作答，但已学到的 persona 效应关系能否预测新问题、能否跨模型与跨提示复用，此前缺少系统检验。
Method: 在七对 7–9B 开源 checkpoint（OLMo-3、Qwen2.5 等）上，把 persona 效应表示为 attribute gain 与 task gain，比较共享 scaling、单幅度借用、双参数目标参数化、正则化更新等迁移策略，并与目标端重拟合对照；另做一项独立问卷比较，检验选择响应性更强的 checkpoint 对人类拟合度的影响。
Result: 在 OLMo-3 与 Qwen2.5 中，分离的 attribute 与 task gain 显著优于共享 scaling，OLMo-3 证据最稳健，其目标重拟合显著优于从其余六对借用的增益。跨模型迁移时，单幅度借用增益在多数方向上不如共享 scaling；放开到两个目标参数后显著损失消失，但相对目标共享 scaling 也无显著收益。改写提示后，六对全部中重拟合显著优于单幅度复用；更换示例或国家语境常保留复用价值。提示迁移中，正则化更新在中位数上优于两种复用策略，对应每属性 64 个目标问题。问卷比较中，选择响应性更强的 checkpoint 反而恶化人类拟合，响应性与训练状态混淆，temperature calibration 基本消除该代价但不纠正组间排序错误。
Conclusion: 在该增益表示下，persona 效应的可预测性不等于可移植性；判断迁移是否真实，须看源关系是否在校准与正则化之外仍增加预测价值。

summary_sections.result: 在 OLMo-3 与 Qwen2.5 中，分离的 attribute 与 task gain 显著优于共享 scaling，OLMo-3 证据最稳健，其目标重拟合显著优于从其余六对借用的增益。跨模型迁移时，单幅度借用增益在多数方向上不如共享 scaling；放开到两个目标参数后显著损失消失，但相对目标共享 scaling 也无显著收益。改写提示后，六对全部中重拟合显著优于单幅度复用；更换示例或国家语境常保留复用价值。提示迁移中，正则化更新在中位数上优于两种复用策略，对应每属性 64 个目标问题。问卷比较中，选择响应性更强的 checkpoint 反而恶化人类拟合，响应性与训练状态混淆，temperature calibration 基本消除该代价但不纠正组间排序错误。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在该增益表示下，persona 效应的可预测性不等于可移植性；判断迁移是否真实，须看源关系是否在校准与正则化之外仍增加预测价值。

papers.title: Readout is not Recovery: Dissociating Coordinate Emission from Visual-Corruption Repair in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: VLM bounding-box localization is both language generation and spatial commitment. Parseable fields such as bbox_2d make localization easy to score, but dimensions that emit coordinate tokens need not repair localization after visual evidence is damaged. We study this readout/recovery separation in Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on single-object COCO grounding. We compare clean coordinate-token readout rankings with corruption-derived repair rankings, using object-mask endpoint replacement for recovery and clean-input flooring for depth localization. In Qwen3-VL, coordinate-token rankings are inert through layer 24, load-bearing from layers 32-35, and peak at layer 34; corruption-derived rankings harm layers 16-24 but become beneficial near layer 35/final. A Kimi-VL-A3B diagnostic shows a matching output-proximal transition despite a different box format. Object-mask recovery separates rank budgets: $k=250$ shows necessity, $k=500$ shows Top-$k$ restoration above random, and $k=d/2$ is largely capacity-driven. Partial-occlusion sweeps reveal that high-overlap coordinate-token sets can hurt at $k=1000$ and help mainly at half-width, while population corruption-derived sets provide no reliable fixed repair set. Edge-attribution patching shows coordinate-token paths are high precision but low recall for detection recovery, and RMSNorm quasi-layer controls do not close the endpoint-repair gap. Endpoint coordinate triage is therefore a useful circuit prior, but occlusion recovery requires a separate benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 的单目标 COCO grounding 上，坐标 token 的读出（readout）与视觉受损后的定位修复（recovery）是两条不同的通路：坐标 token 排名在第 24 层之前惰性、第 32–35 层承重、第 34 层达峰，而 corruption-derived 修复排名在第 16–24 层有害、到第 35 层/末层才转为有益。结论是端点坐标 triage 可作 circuit prior，但遮挡修复需要单独的 benchmark。
Motivation: bbox_2d 这类可解析字段让 grounding 易于打分，但能吐出坐标 token 不等于在视觉证据受损后仍能修复定位；两者被混为一谈，缺少把读出与恢复分开的诊断手段。
Method: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 上比较干净输入的坐标 token 读出排名与 corruption-derived 修复排名：用 object-mask endpoint replacement 度量 recovery、用 clean-input flooring 度量 depth localization；配合 partial-occlusion 扫描、edge-attribution patching 与 RMSNorm quasi-layer 对照，并以 Kimi-VL-A3B（不同 box 格式）做诊断。
Result: 坐标 token 排名在第 24 层之前惰性、第 32–35 层承重、第 34 层峰值；corruption-derived 排名在第 16–24 层有害、第 35 层/末层转为有益。object-mask recovery 的 rank 预算分离：k=250 显示 necessity，k=500 显示 Top-k 优于 random 的 restoration，k=d/2 主要由 capacity 驱动。部分遮挡扫描中高重合坐标 token 集在 k=1000 时反而有害、主要在 half-width 处有益，population corruption-derived 集给不出可靠固定修复集。edge-attribution patching 显示坐标 token 路径对 detection recovery 高精度低召回，RMSNorm quasi-layer 对照无法弥合 endpoint-repair 差距。
Conclusion: 端点坐标 triage 是有用的 circuit prior，但视觉遮挡下的定位恢复由独立机制承担，需要单独的 occlusion recovery benchmark 来评估。

papers.title: Reuse or Relearn? A Spectral View of Earth Observation Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are rarely used as generic, frozen feature extractors; instead, they are fine-tuned for the target downstream application. This practice is particularly prevalent in Earth observation (EO), and it raises a question that downstream accuracy alone cannot answer: does fine-tuning reuse the pretrained representation, or does it relearn a new one? We study this with spectral diagnostics that compare a model before and after adaptation, quantifying how well its dominant singular subspaces are preserved, how broadly the weight update is distributed, and how large it is. Using natural image models such as CLIP and DINO as a reference, we find that, under the evaluated fine-tuning settings, EO models undergo far larger, higher-rank updates and retain much less of their pretrained structure, so their downstream performance is often obtained with substantial changes to the pretrained weight structure. The diagnostics further provide insight into how cheaply a model can be adapted: where the pretrained subspaces are preserved, adapting a small fraction of the parameters can match full fine-tuning, and where they are not, it can fall behind. More broadly, foundation models, and EO foundation models in particular, should be assessed not only by benchmark accuracy, but also by how reusable their pretrained representation is.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用谱诊断比较微调前后模型的主奇异子空间保留度、权重更新的分布广度与幅度，判定微调是在复用预训练表征还是在重新学一套。结果显示在所评估的微调设置下，地球观测 (EO) 模型的更新远更大、秩更高、保留的预训练结构更少，其下游精度往往以大幅改动预训练权重结构为代价；子空间被保留时只调一小部分参数即可匹配全量微调，不被保留时则会落后。
Motivation: EO 领域普遍把基础模型微调到具体下游任务，但仅看下游精度无法回答微调究竟复用了预训练表征还是重学了一套，也无法判断模型能多便宜地被适配。
Method: 对模型微调前后做谱诊断 (spectral diagnostics)：量化主奇异子空间 (dominant singular subspaces) 的保留程度、权重更新在参数上的分布广度与幅度，并以自然图像模型 CLIP、DINO 作为参照系对比 EO 模型。
Result: 在所评估的微调设置下，EO 模型的权重更新比 CLIP、DINO 这类自然图像模型更大、秩更高，保留的预训练结构明显更少，下游性能常伴随对预训练权重结构的大幅改动；诊断还显示子空间被保留的位置上，微调一小部分参数即可匹配全量微调，而在子空间未被保留的位置上小参数量适配会落后。
Conclusion: 基础模型（尤其 EO 基础模型）不应只按 benchmark 精度评判，还要看其预训练表征的可复用性；可复用性直接决定低成本参数高效微调能否追平全量微调。

papers.title: SAGE: Semantic Audio Generative Encoder
papers.abstract_en: Audio autoencoders compress waveforms into compact latent representations that serve as the interface between raw audio and downstream models. Current systems navigate a three-way trade-off between reconstruction quality, semantic structure of the latent space, and inference speed, typically favoring one or two of these at the expense of the others. This paper introduces SAGE, Semantic Audio Generative Encoder: a compact variational autoencoder, trained solely on publicly available music, that shapes its latent by distilling embeddings from a pretrained audio-text model. This 105M-parameter model runs at the inference cost of Stable Audio Open and reaches the listening-test quality of SAME-L, an autoencoder 8x larger and 4x slower, while surpassing both on objective perceptual and distributional metrics of reconstruction. Furthermore, it sets the state of the art on all nineteen probing tasks of latent semantics, in domain and out of domain. These results establish SAGE as a lightweight audio autoencoder that strikes the best balance of the three-way trade-off among those we evaluate, combining high reconstruction fidelity, state-of-the-art semantic structure, and fast inference.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and weights: https://github.com/francescobrigante/SAGE. Project page: https://sage-music.pages.dev/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是一个 105M 参数的紧凑变分自编码器，仅用公开音乐数据训练，通过蒸馏预训练 audio-text 模型的 embedding 来塑造潜空间语义。其推理开销与 Stable Audio Open 相当，听感达到大 8 倍、慢 4 倍的 SAME-L 水平，并在域内与域外全部 19 项潜语义 probing 任务上取得 SOTA。
Motivation: 音频自编码器在重建质量、潜空间语义结构与推理速度之间只能三选二，现有系统通常牺牲其中一到两项。
Method: 紧凑变分自编码器 (VAE)，仅在公开可得音乐数据上训练；潜空间通过蒸馏一个预训练 audio-text 模型的 embedding 来约束语义结构，模型规模 105M 参数。
Result: 105M 参数，推理开销与 Stable Audio Open 相当；听感质量达到 SAME-L（大 8 倍、慢 4 倍）水平；在客观感知与分布性重建指标上同时超过 Stable Audio Open 与 SAME-L；在全部 19 项潜语义 probing 任务上（域内与域外）均取得 state of the art。
Conclusion: 在所评估的系统中，SAGE 在重建保真、语义结构与推理速度的三方权衡上取得最佳平衡，说明蒸馏 audio-text embedding 可以在小模型里同时拿到语义与速度。

papers.title: Adaptive Consistency Graph for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can often make reasonable local decisions on short tasks, yet their performance degrades when success requires long sequences of dependent actions and tool calls. During execution, task requirements, historical evidence, and the current execution state may gradually become disconnected, so later decisions can drift from the original objective. We study this problem by introducing the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) for long-horizon execution. ACG incrementally organizes execution evidence and its provenance in a persistent graph, then constructs a temporary requirement-centered view for each decision under a bounded context budget. Rather than replacing the base agent's planner or tool executor, ACG provides a structured and traceable context view for each decision. In the matched evaluation, ACG improves GPT-5.6-luna's average success from 44.5\% with ReAct to 50.2\%, with the largest gain on BrowseComp-Plus (73.5\% versus 62.4\%). We further analyze trajectory structure and inference cost to characterize this improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACG 为长程 LLM agent 的每次决策动态构造以需求为中心的临时上下文视图，把执行证据与来源关系存进持久图，在有界上下文预算内保持决策与原始目标一致。在匹配评测中，GPT-5.6-luna 平均成功率从 ReAct 的 44.5% 提到 50.2%，BrowseComp-Plus 上从 62.4% 提到 73.5%。
Motivation: LLM agent 在短任务上局部决策合理，但当成功依赖长串相互依赖的动作与工具调用时性能退化：任务需求、历史证据与当前执行状态逐渐脱节，后期决策偏离原始目标。
Method: ACG 增量地把执行证据及其 provenance 组织成持久图，再为每个决策在有界上下文预算下构造以需求为中心的临时视图；不替换基座 agent 的 planner 或 tool executor，只提供结构化、可追溯的上下文视图，并额外分析轨迹结构与推理成本。
Result: 匹配评测中 GPT-5.6-luna 平均成功率由 ReAct 的 44.5% 提升至 50.2%；BrowseComp-Plus 上提升最大，73.5% 对 62.4%。
Conclusion: 在不改动 planner 与执行器的前提下，用持久证据图加按需上下文视图即可缓解长程执行中的目标漂移，把成功率抬高约 5.7 个百分点。

papers.title: Action Shaping: Policies Absorb What They Can Express
papers.abstract_en: Reward shaping has a theorem: a potential-based term can be removed without changing the optimal policy. The same practice on the action channel, an offset added in training and dropped at deployment, has no theorem. Nothing cancels an action offset, so the correction is kept at deployment or removed without a guarantee. We call it action shaping and state its principle. A trainable policy absorbs an offset its own output layer can reproduce exactly, which is what we mean by express; what is absorbed can be removed with the return intact. Its minimal instance is a zero-initialized linear head behind a learnable gate, added to an actor that trains through a learned action-value function, with no penalty or schedule. The gate rises and then falls on its own, for deterministic and stochastic actors alike, and on 20 tasks removing the head costs almost nothing. The condition is exact reproduction, not capacity: a nonlinear head with more parameters is not absorbed, and in a paired control, one linear path added to a nonlinear base head restores absorption. Exact reproduction gives the loss a flat direction that gradient noise drifts along, and the offset's amplitude indicates, before removal, what dropping the head will cost. Action shaping thus gains the counterpart of the shaping theorem, a condition for absorption, together with the mechanism behind it and a diagnostic that reads it. Policies absorb what they can express, and only that.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 reward shaping 的定理搬到动作通道：训练时加在动作上的 offset 若能被策略自身输出层精确复现，就会被策略吸收，部署时可直接去掉而不损失回报。最小实现是 actor 后接零初始化线性头加可学习 gate，gate 自行先升后降；在 20 个任务上去掉该头代价几乎为零，而参数更多的非线性头反而不被吸收。
Motivation: reward shaping 有 potential-based 定理保证移除不改变最优策略，但训练加、部署丢的动作 offset 没有任何定理：要么必须带着它部署，要么无保证地删掉。
Method: 提出 action shaping 及其吸收条件：可训练策略吸收其输出层能精确复现的 offset。最小实例是 actor（经学习到的 action-value function 训练，确定性与随机策略皆可）后接零初始化线性头与可学习 gate，不加惩罚项与调度；配对对照中给非线性基头补一条线性通路以检验复现条件。
Result: 在 20 个任务上移除该头代价几乎为零；gate 自行先升后降；条件是精确复现而非容量——参数更多的非线性头不被吸收，而给非线性基头加一条线性通路即恢复吸收。精确复现使 loss 出现平坦方向、由梯度噪声沿其漂移，offset 幅度可在移除前指示删除代价。

papers.title: CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables computer-use agents to improve through interaction with real software environments, including websites and desktop applications. However, conventional deployments replicate an initialized runtime for each independent rollout, even when trajectories use the same software, incurring repeated memory and initialization costs as the number of parallel environments grows. Does an independent computer-use environment require an independent execution runtime? Our key observation is that trajectories require independent mutable state, while initialized application runtimes can be reused across concurrently evolving environments, making state the natural unit of environment independence. Guided by this observation, we introduce CUA-Sandbox, which separates private state capsules from shared runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations, including resets and branches, while retaining the original software interfaces and task evaluators. Experiments show comparable or improved task success relative to Docker, while substantially reducing rollout and resource costs. CUA-Sandbox achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CUA-Sandbox 把计算机使用智能体 (computer-use agent) 强化学习环境的「私有可变状态」与「已初始化应用运行时」拆开：状态胶囊 (state capsule) 各自独立，运行时跨并发环境复用，并用带事务语义的 reset/branch 管理生命周期，同时保留原软件接口与任务评测器。相对 Docker，任务成功率相当或更好，rollout 吞吐最高提升 6.20 倍，单环境内存下降 9.2 倍，增量存储下降 504 倍。
Motivation: 现有部署为每条独立 rollout 复制一份完整运行时，即使轨迹操作同一软件；并行环境数一涨，内存与初始化开销就重复累积。
Method: 以状态作为环境独立性的自然单元，用 state-scoped execution 把私有状态胶囊与共享运行时分离，配合事务化的生命周期操作（reset、branch），并在沙箱中保留原始软件接口与任务评测器。
Result: 相对 Docker，任务成功率相当或更优；rollout 吞吐最高提升 6.20 倍，单环境内存降低 9.2 倍，增量存储降低 504 倍。
Conclusion: 计算机使用环境的独立性可以落在状态而非整个运行时上：复用已初始化运行时能在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下大幅压低 rollout 与资源成本。

papers.title: Retrospective Distillation Attribution via Normalized Response Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Model distillation transfers capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher responses, often collected from commercial APIs, raising questions of model provenance. Existing distillation attribution methods have been largely evaluated on students immediately after the SFT step. However, a distilled model may undergo further SFT, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning before release, while an auditor may lack access to the pre-distillation checkpoint required by reference-based attribution. To close this gap, we propose SCOUT, an output-only method that aggregates recurring *syntactic patterns* into candidate profiles, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates student--candidate distances against inter-candidate distances. SCOUT supports attribution and abstention using only current texts, without model weights, token likelihoods, or historical checkpoints. Auditing publicly released descendants of distilled models spanning diverse post-training objectives, SCOUT consistently identifies the distillation source. Furthermore, tracing teacher-associated *syntactic signatures* along training trajectories reveals that they emerge during distillation and persist through subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOUT 是一种仅用输出文本的模型蒸馏来源归因方法：把反复出现的句法模式聚成候选画像，过滤低对比度模式，再用候选间距离校准学生到候选的距离，从而在没有权重、token 似然和蒸馏前 checkpoint 的情况下做归因与弃权。对经历后续 SFT、偏好优化或 RL 的公开蒸馏后代审计时，它能持续识别蒸馏来源，且教师句法签名在蒸馏阶段出现并在此后训练中保持。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏归因方法多在 SFT 刚结束的学生上评测，而发布前的模型还会经历偏好优化或强化学习，审计者也拿不到基于参考方法所需的蒸馏前 checkpoint。
Method: SCOUT 为 output-only 归因：将反复出现的句法模式 (syntactic patterns) 聚合为候选画像，过滤低对比度模式，并用候选间距离校准学生与候选的距离；归因与弃权只依赖当前文本，不需要模型权重、token 似然或历史 checkpoint。评测对象是经历不同后训练目标（SFT、偏好优化、RL）的公开蒸馏模型后代，并沿训练轨迹追踪教师相关句法签名。
Result: 在覆盖多种后训练目标的公开蒸馏后代审计中，SCOUT 一致地识别出蒸馏来源；沿训练轨迹的追踪显示教师相关句法签名在蒸馏期间出现，并在后续偏好优化与强化学习之后持续存在。
Conclusion: 蒸馏来源信息以句法签名的形式留在输出文本里，且能穿过后续后训练存活，因此仅凭当前文本即可在缺少参考 checkpoint 时完成归因。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Symbolic Discovery for Financial Fundamental Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While symbolic regression (SR) has been successfully used in science to discover new equations, its use in financial valuation is hindered by several limitations. Whereas the natural sciences provide objectively correct relationships, financial valuation constitutes a distinct class of symbolic discovery problems, as it admits multiple valid perspectives, operates under non-stationary market conditions, and involves noisy, continuous performance signals. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Fundamental Analysis with Symbolic Adaptive learning (MUFASA), a hierarchical multi-agent framework for symbolic discovery in finance. MUFASA introduces (1) disentangled equation discovery via specialized agents representing distinct valuation perspectives, (2) a meta-coordinator that performs hierarchical-level reasoning over market context information, and (3) a memory mechanism that reasons over statistical performance summaries (e.g., accuracy, stability, and tail risk) to guide learning under noisy feedback. Experiments across datasets from multiple countries show that MUFASA achieves state-of-the-art performance on the valuation task compared to classical finance methods, financial large language models, and SR approaches, while simultaneously producing interpretable equations, which we share with the community. We also make publicly available the distilled learnings across evolution iterations and context-dependent strategy weights, which might offer useful insights for future research on financial fundamental analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MUFASA 用分层多智能体框架做金融估值的符号发现：专职智能体分别代表不同估值视角做解耦的方程发现，meta-coordinator 在市场上下文上做层级推理，记忆机制依据 accuracy、stability、tail risk 等统计表现摘要在噪声反馈下引导学习。在多国数据集上，它相对经典金融方法、金融大模型与符号回归 (SR) 方法取得 state-of-the-art 的估值表现，同时产出可解释方程。
Motivation: 符号回归在自然科学中能发现客观正确的方程，但金融估值是另一类符号发现问题：存在多个合理视角、市场条件非平稳、性能信号噪声大且连续，直接套用 SR 受限。
Method: 提出 Multi-Agent Fundamental Analysis with Symbolic Adaptive learning (MUFASA)：一是用代表不同估值视角的专职智能体做解耦的方程发现；二是 meta-coordinator 对市场上下文信息做层级推理；三是记忆机制在统计表现摘要（accuracy、stability、tail risk）上推理，以在噪声反馈下引导学习。
Result: 在多国数据集上，MUFASA 在估值任务上相对经典金融方法、金融大模型 (financial LLM) 与符号回归方法达到 state-of-the-art，同时产出可解释方程；作者公开了跨演化迭代的蒸馏经验与依赖上下文的策略权重。
Conclusion: 把估值视角拆成专职智能体、由 meta-coordinator 做层级市场推理并用表现记忆对抗噪声反馈，可以在非平稳金融数据上同时拿到 SOTA 估值精度与可解释方程。

papers.title: Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining data scaling, and robustness to channel configuration. We find that (1) EEG FMs outperform strong task-specific supervised baselines on most evaluated tasks, particularly under non-bipolar settings; (2) compared with architecture-matched supervised training from scratch, pretraining improves both early optimization and final downstream performance, with larger and more consistent gains as more labeled downstream data become available; (3) existing EEG FMs do not exhibit a consistent positive relationship between parameter count and downstream performance; (4) under a fixed architecture, increasing the pretraining data scale yields sustained downstream gains; and (5) channel-flexible FMs achieve higher absolute performance than channel-constrained models across most evaluated channel configurations. Together, these findings demonstrate the downstream value of EEG FMs and identify pretraining data expansion as a promising direction for further progress. To support continued research, we release EEG-Arena as an open-source evaluation framework that provides shared infrastructure for reproducible benchmarking, model comparison, and community-driven development.
papers.comment: 91 pages, including appendices and supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开源 EEG 基准 EEG-Arena，覆盖 30 个 EEG foundation model 与 25 个监督基线、57 个下游任务、23 个公开数据集，累计超过 20,000 次评测、五种实验协议。结论是：EEG FM 在多数任务上胜过强监督基线（非 bipolar 设置尤其明显），预训练同时改善早期优化与最终性能且标注数据越多增益越大，但参数量与性能无一致正相关；固定架构下扩大预训练数据可持续提升下游表现，作者据此把预训练数据扩展列为最有前景的方向。
Motivation: EEG foundation model 相对强监督基线的优势以及继续扩展的路径都不清楚，缺少统一、可复现的大规模评测来同时考察下游性能、预训练收益、参数量与数据量的 scaling 以及通道配置鲁棒性。
Method: 构建开源评测框架 EEG-Arena：30 个 EEG FM 对 25 个监督基线，在 23 个公开数据集的 57 个下游任务上按五种实验协议做超过 20,000 次评测，分别考察下游表现、预训练收益、参数量 scaling、预训练数据 scaling 与通道配置鲁棒性，并与架构匹配的从零监督训练对照。
Result: 在多数被评任务上 EEG FM 优于强任务专用监督基线，非 bipolar 设置下优势尤其明显；与架构匹配的从零训练相比，预训练同时改善早期优化与最终下游性能，且可用标注下游数据越多、增益越大且越一致；参数量与下游性能不存在一致的正相关；固定架构下增加预训练数据规模带来持续的下游提升；通道灵活的 FM 在多数通道配置上取得比通道受限模型更高的绝对性能。
Conclusion: EEG FM 的下游价值成立，但继续堆参数不划算，扩大预训练数据规模才是更可靠的提升路径；EEG-Arena 作为开源评测框架支撑可复现的模型比较与社区共建。

papers.title: LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

papers.title: Predicting the Financial Impact of Supply Chain Risk for Major AI-Related Semiconductor Firms: A Heterogeneous Graph Patch Transformer Approach
papers.abstract_en: Modern semiconductor production relies on a globally distributed, multi-tier supply chain in which financial stress at one firm spreads with a delay and eventually affects the revenue, inventory, and profitability of the companies that design AI chips. Most firms see only their direct partners, and prior predictive research has mainly targeted market-based risk measures, so few tools forecast how supply chain stress will appear in reported financials. In this study, we propose a heterogeneous graph patch transformer that forecasts these quarterly changes one and two quarters ahead. Learning from a 15,186-company network over 60 quarters, the proposed model fuses quarterly fundamentals with macro-trade, event, and disaster signals through learned gates, carries risk across supplier, customer, ownership, and headquarters relations through typed, direction-specific propagation, and encodes the propagated histories with patch-based tokenization. In preliminary experiments on 116 focal semiconductor firms, the proposed model achieves the lowest error on every target at both horizons, and its profitability advantage widens at the two-quarter horizon. These forecasts can help supply chain managers and investors act before disruptions appear in reported financials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出异构图 patch transformer (heterogeneous graph patch transformer)，在 15,186 家公司、60 个季度的供应链网络上学供应链压力向 AI 芯片设计方财报的滞后传导，提前 1 至 2 个季度预测营收、库存与盈利的季度变化。在 116 家半导体焦点企业的初步实验中，该模型在两个时效、所有目标上误差最低，且两季度时效上的盈利优势进一步扩大。
Motivation: 多数企业只能看到直接上下游，且既有预测研究集中于市场风险指标，缺少工具在供应链压力进入已披露财报之前就预测其对营收、库存、盈利的滞后影响。
Method: 以供应商、客户、持股、总部四类有类型且区分方向的关系在图上传播风险，用学习到的门控 (learned gates) 融合季度基本面与宏观贸易、事件、灾害信号，再对传播后的历史序列做 patch-based tokenization 编码，输出 1 与 2 个季度时效的财报变化预测。
Result: 初步实验在 116 家焦点半导体企业上进行，训练数据为 15,186 家公司、60 个季度的网络；模型在两个时效的每一个目标上都取得最低误差，且盈利 (profitability) 上的优势在两季度时效比一季度时效更大。
Conclusion: 带类型的方向化图传播加 patch tokenization 能在财报披露之前给出供应链压力的量化预测，供供应链管理者与投资者提前行动；结果为初步实验。
