papers.title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnesTRACE 是术中麻醉的多模态评测套件，把围术期感知、单点决策与多步决策放进同一条链路，并用麻醉医师定义的准则评开放式回答。在 30 多个模型上，最佳模型的 TEE 视觉定位仅 32.2 mIoU，多步管理仍保留 17.5% 重大/危急安全错误率，且最优决策质量伴随 74.3 秒 P95 延迟，说明总体分数高并不等于安全、及时的纵向决策。
Motivation: 现有术中麻醉基准把感知与单点推理拆开评测，无法反映患者状态变化下需要持续修订的多步管理能力，也缺少与安全和时效绑定的评价。
Method: 评测套件含 AnesTRACE-Bench 与 AnesTRACE-Eval：前者基于公开围术期数据集加麻醉医师标注，评 Intraoperative Perception、单点与多步麻醉决策；后者按临床正确性、证据锚定、任务完整性、安全及多步的时间一致性评开放式回答，其领域评测器用专家评审判断做监督微调与偏好对齐两阶段训练。
Result: 在 30 多个模型上，最佳模型 TEE 视觉定位仅 32.2 mIoU，多步管理的重大/危急安全错误率 (Major/Critical Safety Error Rate) 为 17.5%，最优决策质量对应 74.3 秒 P95 延迟；评测器与麻醉医师的一致性在两个训练阶段均提升。
Conclusion: 聚合分数本身不能证明安全、及时的纵向决策能力，术中麻醉评测必须同时看视觉定位、干预选择、安全错误率与延迟。

papers.title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G2DA 用梯度信号把地理空间多任务拆成视觉中心与语言中心两组，按任务梯度相似度构造模态专属课程，并用双向 rehearsal 抵消顺序优化带来的 recency effect。在三个 Geo-VLM benchmark、六个 InternVL3 与 Qwen3.5-VL 变体加 GeoChat、GeoLLaVA 共 24 个 benchmark-model 组合上，相对最强竞争方法在 UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite、VRS-Bench-VQA 上分别提升 3.08、4.30、2.81 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 Geo-VLM 用统一多任务适配优化各类地理空间任务，却不区分任务间异构的优化特性；实测的跨模态梯度差异、分支内梯度关系与任务干扰会拖累多任务优化。
Method: G2DA 是梯度感知的多任务 Geo-VLM 优化框架：先做 gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling，把任务分成 vision-centric 与 language-centric 两组；再按任务梯度相似度构造 modality-specific curricula；顺序优化时用 bidirectional rehearsal 缓解 recency effect。评测覆盖三个 Geo-VLM benchmark、六个 InternVL3 与 Qwen3.5-VL 变体，以及 GeoChat 和 GeoLLaVA。
Result: 在全部 24 个 benchmark-model 组合上 G2DA 均超过代表性基线，相对最强竞争方法的提升为 UrBench-MCQ +3.08、XLRS-Bench-Lite +4.30、VRS-Bench-VQA +2.81 个百分点。
Conclusion: 按梯度组织任务的解耦适配能稳定改善 Geo-VLM 多任务学习，跨全部 24 个组合一致有效，说明异构梯度特性是统一多任务适配的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REALIS 是一个 143 万张真实与合成图像的 AI 图像检测数据集，覆盖 42 个文生图模型（含 Nano Banana 2），用真实图像派生提示、质量过滤与分层采样压掉类别捷径，并附带 REALIS-Expert 高质量合成压力子集与 35 种变换、五级严重度的鲁棒性协议。在最难的处理后划分上，最佳预训练常规检测器 ROC-AUC 仅 0.550，而 REALIS 训练的检测器达 0.752，说明检测器在生成器与后处理偏移下会退化。
Motivation: 现有 AI 图像检测基准里真实与合成样本在内容、质量或生成伪影上系统性不同，模型可依赖数据集特有捷径，遇到陌生生成器或处理过的图像即失效；缺少能联合评测这些挑战且覆盖多样视觉内容的数据集。
Method: 构建 REALIS：143 万张真实与合成图像，来自 42 个现代文生图模型（含 Nano Banana 2 等最新专有系统），提示词派生自真实图像，配合质量过滤与分层采样以减少类别特有捷径；另设 REALIS-Expert 子集，真实与生成样本在语义与视觉特征上紧密匹配；提出覆盖 35 种变换、五个严重度等级的鲁棒性协议，并在生成器偏移与后处理偏移下评测预训练检测器、微调模型与零样本视觉-语言模型。
Result: 在最难的处理后 (processed) 划分上，最佳预训练常规检测器 ROC-AUC 为 0.550，最佳 REALIS 训练检测器为 0.752。数据集规模 143 万张图像、42 个文生图模型，鲁棒性协议含 35 种变换 × 5 个严重度等级。
Conclusion: REALIS 提供统一框架，在更贴近真实使用的条件下衡量并提升 AI 图像检测器的可靠性；核心结论是检测器在后处理偏移下大幅退化，需在该类数据上训练才能保住判别力。

summary_sections.method: 构建 REALIS：143 万张真实与合成图像，来自 42 个现代文生图模型（含 Nano Banana 2 等最新专有系统），提示词派生自真实图像，配合质量过滤与分层采样以减少类别特有捷径；另设 REALIS-Expert 子集，真实与生成样本在语义与视觉特征上紧密匹配；提出覆盖 35 种变换、五个严重度等级的鲁棒性协议，并在生成器偏移与后处理偏移下评测预训练检测器、微调模型与零样本视觉-语言模型。
summary_sections.result: 在最难的处理后 (processed) 划分上，最佳预训练常规检测器 ROC-AUC 为 0.550，最佳 REALIS 训练检测器为 0.752。数据集规模 143 万张图像、42 个文生图模型，鲁棒性协议含 35 种变换 × 5 个严重度等级。
summary_sections.conclusion: REALIS 提供统一框架，在更贴近真实使用的条件下衡量并提升 AI 图像检测器的可靠性；核心结论是检测器在后处理偏移下大幅退化，需在该类数据上训练才能保住判别力。

papers.title: Plan-to-Synthesis: Cross-City Human Mobility Generation via Semantic Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Human mobility generation aims to synthesize realistic point-of-interest (POI) visitation trajectories and has become an important tool for travel behavior modeling, transportation management, and urban planning. Existing diffusion-based methods achieve high fidelity but require per-city generation, given the inherent heterogeneity of geospatial locations and POI categories, while large language model-based methods generalize across cities but remain too costly at scale, especially for long-horizon trajectory generation. To address this, we propose SeMoFlow, a Semantic human Mobility generation framework based on latent Flow matching. We first encode heterogeneous POIs from different cities into a shared cross-city representation space via hierarchical Semantic IDs, where shared prefixes capture transferable semantics, and successive codes progressively refine the representation toward individual POIs. Building on the semantic IDs, SeMoFlow follows a plan-to-synthesis hierarchical generation paradigm, in which an autoregressive planner generates coarse-grained semantic and recurrence patterns, and a flow matching realizer synthesizes fine-grained suffix latents. The generated latents are subsequently decoded and grounded to concrete POIs. Extensive experiments on large-scale multi-city datasets show that SeMoFlow achieves higher trajectory fidelity than existing baselines, preserves city-specific mobility motifs, and supports both joint multi-city generation and effective cross-city transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SeMoFlow，用分层 Semantic ID 把多城市异构 POI 编到共享跨城表示空间，再按 plan-to-synthesis 两级生成：自回归 planner 出粗粒度语义与复现模式，flow matching realizer 出细粒度后缀 latent 并解码落到具体 POI。大规模多城市实验中轨迹保真度高于现有基线，同时保留城市特有 mobility motif，支持联合多城生成与跨城迁移。
Motivation: 扩散式出行生成保真度高但必须逐城训练，LLM 式方法能跨城泛化却在长轨迹上开销过大，两者都无法低成本覆盖多城异构的地理与 POI 类别。
Method: 用分层 Semantic ID 编码不同城市的异构 POI：共享前缀承载可迁移语义，后续码位逐级细化到单个 POI；生成端为 plan-to-synthesis 层级范式，自回归 planner 产出粗粒度语义与 recurrence 模式，latent flow matching realizer 合成细粒度后缀 latent，再解码并 grounding 到具体 POI。
Result: 在大规模多城市数据集上，SeMoFlow 的轨迹保真度高于现有基线，并保留城市特有的 mobility motif，同时支持联合多城生成与有效跨城迁移。
Conclusion: 把跨城共享语义与逐城细化拆成 planner 加 flow matching realizer 两级，可以在不逐城重训的前提下兼顾多城生成的保真度与跨城迁移能力。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SkillVine: Agent Skill Evolution via Branching Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge that enables LLM agents to perform tasks, and they can be improved automatically using trajectories from interactions with the environment. This is the classic problem of skill evolution. Existing approaches predominately follow a linear evolution paradigm, in which updates are sequentially applied to the latest skill-library version. As a result, they inevitably fall into local optima, leaving many promising evolution paths unexplored. We propose SkillVine, an automatic skill-evolution framework that formulates skill evolution as a graph search problem and employs a branching exploration strategy. Equipped with a trunk-branch collaborative searching mechanism, an intelligent parent-node selector, and an adaptive-granularity update rule, SkillVine achieves a balance between exploration and exploitation. We evaluate SkillVine on 5 benchmarks with two LLMs. Results show that SkillVine discovers better skill-library versions along branches than along the linear trunk and achieves the best test performance in nine of ten benchmark-model combinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillVine 把 LLM agent 的技能库演化从线性迭代改写成图搜索，用主干-分支协同搜索、智能父节点选择器和自适应粒度更新规则在分支上探索。在 5 个 benchmark × 2 个 LLM 的评测中，分支上找到的技能库版本优于线性主干，10 个 benchmark-模型组合里有 9 个取得最佳测试性能。
Motivation: 现有技能演化方法按线性范式把更新顺序施加到最新版技能库上，必然陷入局部最优，大量有希望的演化路径没有被探索。
Method: 将技能演化形式化为图搜索问题，采用 branching exploration 策略，核心是 trunk-branch collaborative searching 机制、intelligent parent-node selector 与 adaptive-granularity update rule，用三者共同平衡探索与利用；技能本身由 agent 与环境交互得到的轨迹自动改进。
Result: 在 5 个 benchmark、2 个 LLM 上评测：沿分支发现的技能库版本优于沿线性主干的版本，并在 10 个 benchmark-模型组合中的 9 个取得最佳测试性能。
Conclusion: 技能演化应当按图搜索而非线性迭代来做，分支探索能在探索与利用之间取得平衡并带来更好的测试表现。

papers.title: Domain Adaptation with Target Information via Doubly-Anchored Distributionally Robust Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Domain Adaptation (DA) often lacks worst-case guarantees, while Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) based only on source data centers its ambiguity set at the source law and ignores available target structure. To bridge this gap, we introduce a doubly-anchored DRO framework whose ambiguity set is the intersection of $φ$-divergence balls centered at the source law and a source-completed target reference law, the latter pairing the target covariate law with the source conditional law. We derive dual-induced adversarial bridge geometries for symmetric and asymmetric divergence pairings, notably introducing a Kullback--Leibler/squared-Hellinger (KL/HD) bridge. This asymmetric formulation yields a Lambert-$W$ geometry in which source-side exponential risk tilting and target-side Hellinger stabilization enter through distinct terms, attenuating, but not bounding, the effect of large likelihood ratios. Furthermore, without imposing covariate shift, we establish finite-sample generalization bounds for the minimizer of a structural, loss-agnostic density-bridge risk under bounded-overlap conditions; these bounds do not apply directly to the loss-aware DRO min--max estimator. We translate our framework into a bridge-weighted Nadaraya--Watson estimator, proving uniform consistency for the source regression function and pointwise asymptotic normality, with target recovery when the source and target regression functions coincide, as under covariate shift. Finally, an empirical evaluation on a domain-shifted Fashion-MNIST dataset illustrates the finite-sample stability of the asymmetric KL/HD bridge under severe synthetic target-covariate corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双重锚定的分布鲁棒优化 (doubly-anchored DRO)：模糊集取源分布 φ-散度球与“源补齐的目标参考分布”φ-散度球的交集，后者把目标协变量分布与源条件分布配对。非对称 KL/Hellinger (KL/HD) 桥导出 Lambert-W 几何，源侧指数风险倾斜与目标侧 Hellinger 稳定化分列不同项，从而削弱但不约束大似然比的影响；Fashion-MNIST 域偏移实验显示该桥在严重合成目标协变量污染下保持有限样本稳定。
Motivation: 域适应 (DA) 常缺少最坏情形保证，而只用源数据的 DRO 把模糊集中心放在源分布上，忽略了可用的目标结构。
Method: 模糊集定义为源分布与源补齐目标参考分布（目标协变量分布 × 源条件分布）两个 φ-散度球的交集；对称与非对称散度配对分别导出对偶诱导的对抗桥几何，其中 KL/HD 配对给出 Lambert-W 几何。在 bounded-overlap 条件下、不假设 covariate shift，为结构性、损失无关的密度桥风险极小值推导有限样本泛化界；并把框架转成 bridge-weighted Nadaraya-Watson 估计量。
Result: 证明源回归函数的一致性 (uniform consistency) 与逐点渐近正态性，当源与目标回归函数相同（如 covariate shift）时可恢复目标；有限样本泛化界适用于结构性密度桥风险的极小值，但不直接适用于 loss-aware 的 DRO min–max 估计量。在域偏移的 Fashion-MNIST 上，非对称 KL/HD 桥在严重合成目标协变量污染下表现出有限样本稳定性。
Conclusion: 把目标结构作为第二个锚点并入 DRO 模糊集，可在不假设 covariate shift 的前提下给出可证的泛化与一致性保证；非对称 KL/HD 桥对大似然比是削弱而非有界，且泛化界不覆盖 loss-aware 的 min–max 估计量。

papers.title: Revisiting AdaGrad in Stochastic Convex Optimization: Last Iterates, High Probability, and Lower Bounds
papers.abstract_en: AdaGrad and AdaGrad-Norm are widely used adaptive methods, but their precise behavior in stochastic convex optimization remains less understood. We first show that AdaGrad-Norm and AdaGrad do not admit any universal \textbf{last-iterate} rate, even under sub-Gaussian noise and bounded iterates. We then prove that bounded variance alone is too weak: even with bounded iterates, it cannot yield \textbf{high-probability average-iterate} rates, and without bounded iterates it may not even guarantee convergence in expectation. Besides, we construct tight $Ω(\log T/\sqrt T)$ lower bounds for both AdaGrad-Norm and AdaGrad under sub-Gaussian noise, showing that $\log T$ in existing average-iterate upper bounds is unavoidable. Finally, we show that this $\log T$ loss disappears once bounded-iterate condition is imposed: under a general ABC condition, both methods achieve rates ${O}(1/\sqrt{T})$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机凸优化中证明 AdaGrad 与 AdaGrad-Norm 不存在通用的 last-iterate 收敛率（即使噪声次高斯且迭代有界），仅有有界方差也不足以给出高概率平均迭代率；并构造 Ω(log T/√T) 紧下界说明现有上界中的 log T 不可去掉，而一旦加上有界迭代条件，在一般 ABC 条件下两者都恢复 O(1/√T)。
Motivation: AdaGrad/AdaGrad-Norm 广泛使用，但其在随机凸优化中的精确行为仍不清楚：何种噪声与有界性假设能支撑 last-iterate、高概率平均迭代率，以及 log T 损失是否本质。
Method: 分三步：给出 AdaGrad-Norm 与 AdaGrad 无通用 last-iterate 率的反例（次高斯噪声、迭代有界）；构造 Ω(log T/√T) 下界（次高斯噪声）；在一般 ABC 条件加有界迭代下证明 O(1/√T) 上界。
Result: 仅有有界方差时，即使迭代有界也无法得到高概率平均迭代率，无界迭代时甚至不能保证期望收敛；两种方法在次高斯噪声下有 Ω(log T/√T) 紧下界，说明现有平均迭代上界的 log T 不可避免；施加有界迭代后在 ABC 条件下两者均达 O(1/√T)。
Conclusion: AdaGrad 类方法的 log T 损失是下界本质而非证明松弛，但可通过有界迭代条件消除；高概率与 last-iterate 性质对噪声和有界性假设高度敏感。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning: Finite-Sample Guarantees under Weak Communication
papers.abstract_en: We study distributionally robust reinforcement learning (DR-RL) in the average-reward setting under weak communication. Our main result provides finite-sample guarantees for estimating the robust optimal average reward and learning a near-optimal policy, covering both SA-rectangular and S-rectangular structures with divergence-based and distance-based uncertainty sets. Specifically, for Kullback--Leibler and $f_k$-divergence balls, we establish explicit radius conditions under which the robust average-reward Bellman equation admits a constant-gain solution, while for total variation and Wasserstein balls, any positive radius suffices without requiring the nominal MDP to be weakly communicating. Our algorithm is prior-knowledge-free and achieves sample complexities of $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-1}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ for estimating the robust optimal average reward and $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-2}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ for learning an $ε$-optimal policy. Here, $p_{\wedge}$ is the smallest positive nominal transition probability and $u_δ^{\ast}$ is a robust optimal bias function. We further provide an almost-tight explicit upper bound on $\operatorname{Span}(u_δ^{\ast})$. Finally, we validate the predicted $n^{-1/2}$ convergence rate through numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究弱通信 (weak communication) 平均奖励 MDP 下的分布鲁棒强化学习 (DR-RL)，给出鲁棒最优平均奖励估计与近优策略学习的有限样本保证，覆盖 SA-rectangular 与 S-rectangular 结构及散度/距离两类不确定集。KL 与 f_k 散度球需显式半径条件才能让鲁棒 Bellman 方程有常数增益解，而总变差与 Wasserstein 球任意正半径即可、且不要求名义 MDP 弱通信。样本复杂度为 Õ(|S||A|p_∧⁻¹Span²(u*_δ)ε⁻²)（估计奖励）与 Õ(|S||A|p_∧⁻²Span²(u*_δ)ε⁻²)（学 ε-最优策略），数值实验验证 n^{-1/2} 收敛速率。
Motivation: 弱通信平均奖励 MDP 上的分布鲁棒 RL 缺少有限样本理论：不确定集形状何时破坏鲁棒 Bellman 方程的常数增益解、以及不依赖先验知识的样本复杂度如何，均无明确刻画。
Method: 在平均奖励框架下分析 SA-rectangular 与 S-rectangular 鲁棒 MDP，对 KL 与 f_k 散度球推导保证常数增益解存在的显式半径条件，对总变差与 Wasserstein 球证明任意正半径即可；给出先验知识无关的算法，并推导鲁棒最优偏置函数 Span(u*_δ) 的几乎紧显式上界。

papers.title: Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: *Reinforcement learning (RL)* can induce substantial reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), but how much of this capability transfers across model scales, and how quickly, remains unclear. We study the scaling properties of *on-policy distillation (OPD)* across *weak-to-strong*, *same-base*, and *strong-to-weak* teacher--student setups. We find that early OPD training dynamics uniformly exhibit a regular *useful-transfer* regime, in which held-out accuracy (the *gold score*, $G$) rises approximately linearly in $d=\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}(π_θ\Vert π_{\mathrm{ref}})}$, the square root of token-level reverse KL divergence from the student initialization. In every observed weak-to-strong pair, the student's peak gold score exceeds its teacher's own, so a compact RL expert can transfer capability to a much larger student via OPD. To estimate OPD outcomes, we fit *power laws* for how $G_{\mathrm{peak}}$ and the slope of the useful-transfer regime scale with student and teacher parameter counts and with teacher gold score. These laws show that peak gold score improves with teacher scale only up to roughly the student's scale, and that at a matched gold score smaller teachers transfer better, so a teacher's score alone does not define its supervision value. We also study the scaling effects of two OPD variants, bootstrapping weak-to-strong OPD, and the degree of on-policy supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究同族 on-policy distillation (OPD) 在弱到强、同基座、强到弱三类师生配置下的标度性质：早期训练中 held-out accuracy（gold score G）随 d=√KL(πθ‖πref) 近似线性上升，构成统一的 useful-transfer 区间。每个弱到强配对中学生峰值 gold score 都超过教师本人，说明小规模 RL 专家可通过 OPD 把能力传给大得多的学生；对 G_peak 与该斜率拟合参数量与教师分数的幂律后发现，教师规模只在约等于学生规模之前有效，同等 gold score 下更小的教师传递更好。
Motivation: RL 能在 LLM 中诱导出可观的推理能力，但这种能力跨模型规模迁移多少、多快仍不清楚，教师的监督价值也无法只由其 gold score 判断。
Method: 在 weak-to-strong、same-base、strong-to-weak 三类师生配置上考察 OPD；以 d=√KL(πθ‖πref)（学生初始化的 token 级 reverse KL 平方根）为横轴刻画早期训练动力学，并对 G_peak 与 useful-transfer 区间斜率关于师生参数量和教师 gold score 拟合幂律；另考察 bootstrapping weak-to-strong OPD 与 on-policy 监督程度两个变体的标度效应。
Result: 早期 OPD 训练动力学一致呈现 useful-transfer 区间，G 随 d 近似线性上升；每个观测到的弱到强配对中学生峰值 gold score 均超过教师自身；幂律显示 G_peak 随教师规模提升仅持续到大致学生规模，且在匹配 gold score 下更小的教师传递更好。
Conclusion: OPD 的能力迁移在早期服从可预测的线性-幂律标度，教师的监督价值由其规模与学生规模的相对关系决定，单看教师分数不足以定义其价值。

papers.title: BiasReducer: Adaptive Bias Mitigation for Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward models score responses from large language models (LLMs) and guide LLM training toward human preferences. However, reward models can favor superficial attributes such as length or confidence, leading LLMs to produce higher-scoring but not more correct responses. Existing mitigation methods either retrain the reward model or apply a fixed correction to one known bias, such as a preference for longer responses. Retraining requires additional data and computational resources, while existing editing methods require the target bias to be specified in advance and use a fixed edit for that bias. To this end, we propose BiasReducer, a lightweight framework that edits only the linear reward head and selects the relevant edits for each new dataset. First, BiasReducer uses a sparse autoencoder (SAE)-style encoder to learn which attributes (e.g., length and confidence) the reward model is sensitive to. Second, it learns how to reduce the reward model's dependence on each attribute by determining which direction to adjust the reward head and how much to adjust it. Third, for a new dataset, it ranks the attributes by their influence on reward scores, selects the relevant ones, and edits the reward model accordingly. BiasReducer consistently improves reward-model robustness to biases toward superficial response attributes. Across five reward models, BiasReducer-M improves the three benchmarks by 8.3, 18.0, and 6.9 percentage points on average, outperforming the two training-based baselines. The gains transfer downstream, reducing unnecessary verbosity and sycophancy while maintaining comparable judged quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiasReducer 只编辑奖励模型的线性 reward head：用 SAE 式编码器学出模型对长度、置信度等表层属性的敏感方向，再按新数据集上各属性对奖励分数的影响力排序选属性并施加编辑。跨五个奖励模型，BiasReducer-M 在三个基准上平均提升 8.3、18.0、6.9 个百分点，超过两个基于训练的基线，并在下游减少冗长与谄媚。
Motivation: 奖励模型会给长度、置信度等表层属性打高分，使 LLM 学到分数更高但并不更正确的回答；现有缓解方法要么重训奖励模型（需额外数据与算力），要么对事先指定的单一偏差用固定修正，无法应对新数据集上的未知偏差。
Method: 三步框架，仅编辑线性 reward head：SAE 式编码器学习奖励模型敏感的属性（如长度、置信度）；学习每个属性上奖励头的调整方向与幅度以降低依赖；对新数据集按属性对奖励分数的影响力排序，选取相关属性后执行编辑。
Result: 跨五个奖励模型，BiasReducer-M 在三个基准上平均提升 8.3、18.0、6.9 个百分点，优于两个 training-based 基线；下游表现为减少不必要的冗长 (verbosity) 与谄媚 (sycophancy)，同时保持相当的 judged quality。
Conclusion: 只编辑奖励头并按数据集自适应选择属性编辑，就能一致提升奖励模型对表层属性偏差的鲁棒性，且收益可迁移到下游生成行为。

papers.title: LLM Alignment--Utility Asymmetry under Semantic-Preserving Transformations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment is intended to ensure that models remain helpful and safe, but its stability under input distributional shift is not yet fully understood. Prior work shows that aligned models can fail under jailbreak prompts, alternative encodings, and cross-lingual transfer, yet these failures are usually studied as attacks rather than controlled probes of alignment generalization. Moreover, existing evidence is largely grounded in natural language variation already represented during pretraining, leaving unresolved whether alignment generalizes with semantic content or remains tied to superficial surface patterns. In this paper, we study this question using synthetic semantic-preserving transformations that are rule-based and invertible, preserving task-relevant meaning while shifting inputs beyond standard linguistic variation. Across four open-weight and four commercial models, under both fine-tuning and in-context learning, we use these transformations as a probe of alignment generalization and identify an empirical pattern we term Alignment--utility asymmetry: once models can operate effectively on transformed inputs, task utility is often substantially retained while alignment failure increases more sharply. For example, adapted GPT-4.1 mini shows only limited utility degradation under transformation while its harmful rate rises from 13.3 to 74.3; Gemini 3 Flash similarly retains near-original utility while its harmful rate increases from 2.3 to 43.0. Taken together, these results suggest that semantic-preserving distribution shifts can expose a recurring gap in how utility and alignment generalize in current LLMs.
papers.journal_ref: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用规则化、可逆的语义保持变换 (semantic-preserving transformations) 探测 LLM 对齐的泛化，发现“对齐—效用不对称”：模型一旦能在变换后输入上正常完成任务，效用基本保留，而有害输出率急剧上升。GPT-4.1 mini 适配后效用仅轻微下降，harmful rate 却从 13.3 升到 74.3；Gemini 3 Flash 保持接近原始效用，harmful rate 从 2.3 升到 43.0。
Motivation: 既有对齐失效证据多来自越狱、编码替换、跨语言迁移等攻击视角，且局限于预训练已见过的自然语言变化，无法区分对齐是随语义泛化还是绑定在表层模式上。
Method: 构造规则化、可逆、保留任务语义的合成变换，把输入推到标准语言变化之外；在 4 个开放权重与 4 个商业模型上，分别以微调和 in-context learning 两种适配方式，把变换当作对齐泛化的探针，对照任务效用与对齐失效。
Result: 识别出 Alignment–utility asymmetry 模式：适配后的 GPT-4.1 mini 在变换下效用仅有限退化，harmful rate 从 13.3 升至 74.3；Gemini 3 Flash 保持接近原始效用，harmful rate 从 2.3 升至 43.0。
Conclusion: 语义保持的分布偏移会反复暴露当前 LLM 中效用泛化与对齐泛化的缺口：效用跟得上变换，对齐跟不上。

papers.title: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在异构遥感变化检测中，把 superpixel 区域 copula 证据与空间变化的局部依赖异常融合：先用独立拟合的局部模型刻画跨影像非不变关系，再经参考排序与上尾门控 (upper-tail gate) 与连续区域置信度融合，并推导出区域相关的局部决策阈值。在 Lake 与 UK 上整图优化配置 kappa 分别为 0.78136 与 0.90817，四折回溯空间验证中无门控参考融合使平均 kappa 提升 0.00693 与 0.01793。
Motivation: superpixel copula 模型能给出稳定的区域证据，但每个区域只有一个标签，混合 superpixel 内部的定位受限，区域内部的局部依赖变化被抹平。
Method: 保留区域决策结构，同时引入空间变化的局部依赖异常；用独立拟合的局部模型刻画跨影像非不变关系，经参考排序与上尾门控变换后与连续区域置信度融合；推导区域相关的局部决策阈值，并给出门控等价于对无门控融合重参数化的条件。
Result: Lake 与 UK 整图优化配置 kappa 为 0.78136 与 0.90817，并改善混合区域与边界决策；四折回溯空间验证（十个训练子集）中，无门控参考融合使平均 kappa 提升 0.00693（Lake）与 0.01793（UK）；固定门控在 UK 增益更大，为 0.03353，而 Lake 仅 0.00041。
Conclusion: 区域-局部依赖交互有效，但校准与门控的收益是场景依赖的：固定门控在 UK 明显有利，在 Lake 几乎无增益。

papers.title: MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute
papers.abstract_en: FullAttn often assigns negligible normalized mass to much of the causal score space, yet dense kernels execute the complete post-score path after forming each QK tile. We introduce MALA, a fused attention primitive that preserves score access to every legal causal interaction and uses normalized contribution to allocate post-score computation. Forward uses its evolving online-softmax normalizer, while backward reuses the finalized normalizer to derive nested retained support using only standard attention state. A common tolerance governs training and inference, allowing for adaptive retention of the work. MALA reduces low-contribution post-score computation. A matched-work study at 8K isolates the benefit of distribution-adaptive allocation: under exactly matched total post-score work, MALA approaches a per-instance reference-mass oracle, with mean omitted mass of 0.0188% versus 0.0182%. Across context lengths from 1K to 32K tokens, the same tolerance maintains low output and gradient errors relative to the reference. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison, MALA closely tracks FullAttn as context grows, reaching 89.67% accuracy at 8K compared with 89.97% for FullAttn. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, MALA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 2.2x and 3.0x and decoding latency during inference by 1.6x relative to FullAttn. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, MALA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results indicate that allocating post-score computation according to normalized attention contributions can retain the evaluated capabilities of FullAttn while reducing attention computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MALA 是一个融合 attention 算子：保留对全部合法 causal score 的访问，但按归一化贡献度 (normalized contribution) 分配 post-score 计算，用 online-softmax normalizer 在前向做自适应保留、后向复用最终 normalizer 构造嵌套保留支撑。在 8K 等算力对照下 MALA 的平均遗漏质量为 0.0188%（oracle 参考 0.0182%），128K 张量并行下训练前向/反向延迟分别降 2.2x/3.0x、解码降 1.6x，同时 0.6B–14B 规模训练的 perplexity 与下游能力贴近 FullAttn。
Motivation: FullAttn 对 causal score 空间的大量区域分配的归一化质量可忽略，但 dense kernel 仍对每个 QK tile 执行完整的 post-score 路径，造成大量无效算力。
Method: 提出融合 attention 原语 MALA：前向用逐步演化的 online-softmax normalizer 按归一化贡献自适应保留，后向用最终 normalizer 从标准 attention 状态推导嵌套保留支撑 (nested retained support)；训练与推理共用同一个 tolerance 控制保留量。
Result: 8K 等总 post-score 算力对照下 MALA 平均遗漏质量 0.0188%，接近 per-instance 参考质量 oracle 的 0.0182%；1K–32K 上下文内同一 tolerance 保持低输出与梯度误差；associative-recall 对比中 8K 处 MALA 89.67% vs FullAttn 89.97%；128K token 张量并行 attention 基准中训练前向/反向延迟降 2.2x/3.0x、推理解码延迟降 1.6x；0.6B–14B 规模化训练 perplexity 贴近 FullAttn 且总训练 FLOPs 更低，14B 与续训 32B 模型在知识、推理、长上下文检索上与 FullAttn 相当。
Conclusion: 按归一化 attention 贡献分配 post-score 计算可以在保留 FullAttn 所评估能力的同时减少 attention 计算量，且同一 tolerance 可贯通训练与推理。

papers.title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
papers.abstract_en: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProDyGS 在单台静态相机拍摄的视频上做动态新视角合成：用基础单目深度网络估计时间一致深度，据此构造 3D Gaussian 并从任意视角生成 proxy 图像，充当合成多视角监督，再由 deformation network 以该增强监督 warp canonical Gaussians 学习时序动态。在 DyNeRF 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，且外部监督只需单目深度估计，优于依赖 scene flow 等更强先验的方法。
Motivation: 现有动态 3D Gaussian Splatting 方法依赖多视角设置或显著相机运动来提供几何约束，而单台完全静止的相机既无多视角监督也无相机运动，这一场景下的几何约束缺失问题尚未解决。
Method: 先用基础单目深度网络 (foundational monocular depth networks) 估计时间一致的深度图，再据此构建 3D Gaussian 表示并从任意视角渲染 proxy 图像，合成多视角监督；deformation network 在该增强监督下 warp canonical Gaussians 学习时序动态。
Result: 在 DyNeRF 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，仅以单目深度估计作为外部监督，优于依赖 scene flow 等更强先验的方法。
Conclusion: 深度引导的 proxy 图像合成可以在完全没有多视角监督的单静态相机条件下替代多视角或强先验，支撑高质量动态新视角合成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Unbalanced Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Drifting models enable one-step generation by amortizing distribution transport into training, but this efficiency places greater demands on the transport field estimated at each update. In large-scale training, the field is computed from finite mini-batches of generated and real samples, which provide only imperfect approximations to the underlying distributions. Balanced optimal transport enforces exact mass matching within every mini-batch, making the estimated field sensitive to the particular composition of the real-data batch. We find that generated and real samples should be treated asymmetrically: letting the mass assigned to real samples adapt while keeping every generated sample fully transported improves generation across six feature-space metrics in controlled ablations, and is more robust to the relaxation strength than relaxing both marginals simultaneously, which falls below balanced transport under stronger relaxation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Unbalanced Optimal Transport Gradient Flow (UOT-GF), which keeps the generated-sample marginal fixed and relaxes only the real-data marginal. Under identical settings at DiT-B/2 on ImageNet-256, UOT-GF improves Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) from 1.53 to 1.46 over the balanced W-Flow baseline; scaling the same recipe yields 1.34 and 1.22 FID at L/2 and XL/2, the best FID among the one-step models we compare. We further derive the induced UOT transport force, establish a kinetic Vlasov--Fokker--Planck formulation whose overdamped zero-temperature limit recovers the drifting dynamics, and characterize non-target stationary states together with sufficient conditions for convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 mini-batch 上估计传输场时，生成样本与真实样本应不对称处理：固定生成样本边际、只放松真实数据边际，可让 one-step 生成在六个 feature-space 指标上全面改善，并对放松强度更稳健。DiT-B/2 于 ImageNet-256 上 FID 从 balanced W-Flow 的 1.53 降到 1.46，同配方放大到 L/2、XL/2 分别得 1.34 与 1.22，为所比较 one-step 模型中最佳。
Motivation: Drifting 模型把分布传输摊销进训练以实现 one-step 生成，但大规模训练中传输场只能由有限 mini-batch 估计；balanced OT 强制每个 batch 内质量严格配平，使估计场对真实数据 batch 的具体组成敏感。
Method: 提出 Unbalanced Optimal Transport Gradient Flow (UOT-GF)：生成样本边际保持固定、每个生成样本被完全传输，只放松真实数据边际的质量；同时推导诱导的 UOT 传输力，建立 kinetic Vlasov--Fokker--Planck 表述，其 overdamped 零温极限回收 drifting dynamics，并刻画非目标稳态与收敛充分条件。
Result: 受控消融中，只放松真实边际在六个 feature-space 指标上均改善生成，且比同时放松两个边际对放松强度更稳健——后者在更强放松下低于 balanced transport。相同设置下 DiT-B/2 于 ImageNet-256 的 FID 由 balanced W-Flow 的 1.53 降至 1.46；同配方放大到 L/2 与 XL/2 分别为 1.34 与 1.22，是所比较 one-step 模型中最好的 FID。
Conclusion: 生成样本与真实样本在 OT 梯度流中应被不对称对待：固定生成边际、只放松真实边际，既提升 one-step 生成质量又增强对放松强度的鲁棒性；该动力学有 Vlasov--Fokker--Planck 层面的表述与收敛条件支撑。

papers.title: Learning to Refer: Client-Resolved Generation for Privacy-Aware Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-based large language models (LLMs) require users to disclose plaintext data to service providers, creating privacy risks in sensitive domains. Existing privacy-preserving approaches often trade utility for protection, incur substantial computational or communication overhead, remain vulnerable to reconstruction from intermediate representations, or protect only a subset of the training and inference pipeline. We introduce Client-Resolved Generation (CRG), a genera- tion interface that separates server-side generation from the lexical realization of input-derived content. The client transmits only pooled and noise-perturbed rep- resentations, while input-derived output content is represented using request-local positional references and resolved to its original strings only on the client. This interface protects private input and input-derived output content during both train- ing and inference while allowing the service provider to keep its proprietary model parameters hidden from the client. At the same time, exact lexical reuse remains possible without directly exposing the reused content on the provider-visible gen- eration path. We evaluate CRG on medical and document-grounded QA, sensi- tive identifier transfer, and tool calling, together with reconstruction and raw-logit leakage analyses. On SealTools, CRG improves complete-call exact match from 57.3% to 79.9% over the input-privacy framework PPFT, with larger gains as more required output content can be resolved through references. Together, these results show that CRG provides a practical interface for privacy-sensitive cloud LLMs by reducing plaintext exposure across both input and output pathways while preserv- ing task utility and server-side model confidentiality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Client-Resolved Generation (CRG)：服务端只做生成，输入派生内容用请求内位置引用 (request-local positional references) 表示，仅在客户端还原为原字符串，客户端只上传加噪的池化表示。在 SealTools 上把完整工具调用 exact match 从 PPFT 的 57.3% 提到 79.9%，且可引用解析的输出内容越多增益越大。
Motivation: 云端 LLM 要求用户明文上传，现有隐私方案在效用、计算通信开销、中间表示重建风险与保护覆盖范围之间取舍，且往往只保护训练或推理的一段管线。
Method: CRG 把服务端生成与输入派生内容的词面实现分离：客户端发送池化且加噪的表示，输出中的输入派生内容用请求局部位置引用编码，仅在客户端解析回原串；同时保护训练与推理两阶段，并保留服务端模型参数机密性。评测覆盖医疗与文档 grounded QA、敏感标识符迁移、工具调用，以及重建与 raw-logit 泄漏分析。
Result: 在 SealTools 上，CRG 的 complete-call exact match 从输入隐私框架 PPFT 的 57.3% 提升到 79.9%，且当更多必需输出内容可通过引用解析时增益更大；另做重建与 raw-logit 泄漏分析。
Conclusion: CRG 作为面向隐私敏感云 LLM 的接口，可在减少输入与输出两条通路上明文暴露的同时保住任务效用和服务端模型机密性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DPAMixerSR 把图像按退化程度分区路由：轻量 Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) 把 patch 分为严重退化与轻度退化，前者送入 Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) 做结构对齐的多尺度稀疏传播与双向细化，后者走轻量卷积分支，从而在重建质量与计算开销之间自适应平衡。
Motivation: 现有内容自适应 SR 方案只看纹理复杂度，忽略模糊核与噪声等内在退化因素，导致算力分配与重建性能都非最优。
Method: PDR 模块对图像 patch 做退化严重度排序并分区；严重退化区走 ASP 的结构对齐多尺度稀疏传播加双向细化，轻度退化区走轻量卷积分支，退化驱动路由与稀疏处理耦合形成自调节框架。

Conclusion: 把退化模式而非仅纹理复杂度作为算力分配依据，可在资源受限的 SR 中同时保住重建保真度并压缩计算量。

papers.title: CoWindow Attention: Full Causal Coverage Is a Collective Property
papers.abstract_en: FullAttn repeatedly exposes the complete causal history to every attention head, creating substantial redundant computation and memory traffic even with IO-efficient dense kernels. We introduce CoWA, a structured attention architecture that distributes access to the causal history across KV heads. All heads share near-diagonal and prefix-sink windows, while complementary long-range windows partition the remaining history. Their union provides full causal coverage although each head attends sparsely to distant tokens. This position-defined attention pattern requires no learned router or indexer, is used consistently during training and inference, and aligns with KV-head tensor parallelism. A window-matched ablation at 8K isolates the effect of complementary long-range allocation: CoWA with 100% collective coverage reaches 89.73% accuracy, compared with 89.97% for FullAttn, while duplicated long-range windows perform substantially worse. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison with matched token budgets, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn as the context grows, whereas other sparse patterns lose a substantial fraction of the associations. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, CoWA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 7.4x and 8.6x and decoding latency during inference by 3.0x over FullAttn. Its per-rank peak operator memory matches FullAttn during training and is 7.6x lower during decoding. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results show that full causal coverage can be a collective property of the head ensemble rather than a duplicated property of every head.

TL;DR: CoWA 把因果历史按位置切分给各 KV head：所有 head 共享近对角与 prefix-sink 窗口，互补的长程窗口拼起来覆盖全部历史，从而每个 head 稀疏注意远端 token 但整体保持 full causal coverage。8K 消融中 CoWA（100% 集体覆盖）准确率 89.73% 对 FullAttn 89.97%，而重复长程窗口明显更差；128K 张量并行下训练前向/反向延迟降 7.4x/8.6x、解码延迟降 3.0x。
Motivation: FullAttn 让每个 attention head 都看完整因果历史，即使有 IO 高效 dense kernel 也带来大量冗余计算与显存带宽开销；现有稀疏模式又会丢掉相当一部分长程关联。
Method: CoWA 是位置定义 (position-defined) 的结构化注意力：各 KV head 共享近对角窗口与 prefix-sink 窗口，互补长程窗口对剩余历史做划分，联合起来构成 full causal coverage；无需学习式 router 或 indexer，训练与推理使用同一模式，并与 KV-head 张量并行对齐。评测含 8K 窗口匹配消融、匹配 token 预算的 associative-recall 对比、128K 注意力算子基准，以及 0.6B 到 14B 的 scaling-law 训练。
Result: 8K 窗口匹配消融：CoWA（100% 集体覆盖）89.73% 准确率 vs FullAttn 89.97%，重复长程窗口显著更差；匹配 token 预算的 associative-recall 中 CoWA 随上下文增长紧贴 FullAttn，其他稀疏模式丢失大量关联。128K 张量并行算子基准：训练前向/反向延迟降低 7.4x 与 8.6x，推理解码延迟降低 3.0x；训练时每 rank 峰值算子显存与 FullAttn 持平，解码时低 7.6x。0.6B–14B scaling-law 训练中 perplexity 紧贴 FullAttn 且总训练 FLOPs 更低，所得 14B 与续训 32B 模型在知识、推理与长上下文检索分数上与 FullAttn 相当。

papers.title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time
papers.abstract_en: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicating whether the receiver inferred it correctly. This learning occurs during inference with fixed parameters and no supplied codebook or encoding examples. The effect also persists when agents generate their own free-form updates in a simulated incident-response task. Across ten independent games, pairs of GPT-5.6 Sol agents reach 98.8% final accuracy, compared with 25% chance, despite explicit instructions prohibiting disclosure and a monitor that screens each message without access to the agents' interaction histories. The same interactions that help agents cooperate can therefore allow confidential information to pass through messages intended for legitimate coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在反复博弈中，语言模型 agent 仅凭「接收方是否猜对」这一比特反馈，就能在推理阶段、参数固定且无码本的情况下自发建立隐蔽信道：发送方从四选一的公开报告摘要中编码秘密状态。GPT-5.6 Sol 配对在十局独立博弈中最终准确率达 98.8%（随机 25%），即便有明令禁止泄露的指令和无历史记录的消息监控器。
Motivation: 安全敏感场景要求 agent 在不泄露机密的前提下协作，但反复交互会让普通消息逐渐承载共享私有含义，现有监控器只看单条消息、看不到交互历史，无法识别这种测试时形成的隐蔽信道。
Method: 构造重复博弈：发送方观察四个秘密状态之一，从同一公开报告的四个摘要中选一个发出，接收方推断秘密；反馈仅为一比特「是否猜对」。学习发生在推理期、参数固定、无码本与编码示例；另在一个模拟 incident-response 任务中让 agent 自行生成自由文本更新以检验效应是否延续。
Result: 十局独立博弈中 GPT-5.6 Sol 配对最终准确率 98.8%，对照随机水平 25%；该结果在明令禁止披露的指令与不访问交互历史的消息监控器下仍然成立，且在自由文本更新的 incident-response 任务中同样出现。
Conclusion: 帮助 agent 合作的同一批交互本身就能让机密信息穿过看似合法的协调消息，仅靠单条消息监控与显式禁令不足以阻断测试时涌现的隐蔽信道。

papers.title: CAIRN: Dynamic Fact-Intent DAGs for Multi-Agent Exploration
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered autonomous systems have demonstrated promising capabilities in mathematical reasoning, engineering, and cybersecurity. Yet how to organize these systems for effective, reliable, and sustained performance remains an open question. In this paper, we present CAIRN, a fact-intent-driven multi-agent paradigm for goal-directed exploration. CAIRN represents observations and planned investigations as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG). A reasoner interprets facts to propose intents, which workers execute to produce new facts. Each intent references its supporting facts and defines a potential exploration branch. The persistent graph preserves goals, dependencies and findings across workers, supporting knowledge reuse and parallel exploration. The graph also makes execution trajectories traceable and auditable, providing a basis for human verification and intervention. We evaluate CAIRN across cybersecurity and mathematical reasoning tasks, examining task success, time to solution, and token consumption. DAG-based coordination can incur higher token costs with no observable performance gains on tasks that require little effort. However, on high-effort tasks (at least 1M tokens), we observe faster solutions in 76.5% of cases, with speedups of up to 3.08x. Moreover, as task effort increases, these time gains become more pronounced while relative token overhead declines, highlighting the potential of DAG-guided parallel exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAIRN 用事实-意图驱动的动态 DAG 组织 LLM 多智能体探索：reasoner 从观测事实提出意图，worker 执行意图产出新事实，持久图跨 worker 保留目标、依赖与发现。在网络安全与数学推理任务上，低工作量任务中 DAG 协调带来更高 token 成本且无可观察性能收益；而在至少 1M token 的高工作量任务中，76.5% 的案例解题更快，最高加速 3.08x，且工作量越大时间收益越明显、相对 token 开销越低。
Motivation: LLM 自主系统在数学推理、工程与网络安全上已有能力，但如何组织它们以实现有效、可靠、可持续的运行仍是开放问题。
Method: CAIRN 将观测与计划中的调查表示为动态有向无环图 (DAG)：reasoner 解读事实并提出意图，worker 执行意图产出新事实，每个意图引用其支撑事实并定义一条潜在探索分支；持久图跨 worker 保存目标、依赖与发现，支持知识复用、并行探索与执行轨迹的可追溯审计。
Result: 在网络安全与数学推理任务上评测任务成功率、解题时间与 token 消耗：低工作量任务中 DAG 协调 token 成本更高且无可观察性能收益；至少 1M token 的高工作量任务中 76.5% 案例解题更快，加速最高达 3.08x，且随任务工作量上升时间收益更显著、相对 token 开销下降。
Conclusion: DAG 引导的并行探索在高工作量任务上划算，在低工作量任务上则只增加 token 开销而无收益。

papers.title: Flat-Consensus Diffusion for Robust Data Reshaping under Noisy Evaluator
papers.abstract_en: Data shape determines how features are structured, how patterns are separated, and how distributions cover the underlying domain. Poor data shape can make models learn noise rather than generalizable structure. This paper studies robust feature-centric data reshaping: generating feature transformations that remain useful, stable, and reproducible under noisy evaluation and imperfect data conditions. We view reshaping operation sequence search as reward-guided diffusion generation, and robust reshaping as searching for regions in the latent reward landscape rather than isolated high-reward transformations. The key challenge is dual instability: noisy evaluators distort local reward guidance, while stochastic generative trajectories can converge to inconsistent solutions. We propose FCDiff, a flat-consensus diffusion framework that addresses both failures through a micro-macro decomposition. The micro layer replaces point-estimate reward guidance with Gaussian-smoothed, Monte Carlo averaged gradients, steering generation toward locally flat reward regions. The macro layer aggregates independently guided trajectories with a weighted Frechet-mean barycenter, selecting consensus-supported basins and filtering stochastic outliers. Across an 8-dataset headline cohort under heavy-tailed evaluator noise, FCDiff attains the best aggregate rank on lower-tail reliability and robustness against both search-based AutoFE and robustness-oriented generative baselines, with statistically significant accuracy gains over every generative baseline. Our results show that robust data reshaping requires searching for flat, consensus-supported regions rather than sharp single-trajectory optima.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FCDiff 把特征工程式数据重塑 (data reshaping) 序列搜索写成奖励引导的扩散生成，用高斯平滑、蒙特卡洛平均的梯度把生成推向奖励景观中局部平坦的区域，再用加权 Fréchet-mean barycenter 聚合多条独立轨迹、筛掉随机离群解。在 8 个数据集的 headline 队列、重尾评估器噪声设定下，FCDiff 在下尾可靠性与稳健性上取得最佳综合排名，并相对每个生成式基线取得统计显著的准确率提升。
Motivation: 数据形状差会让模型学到噪声而非可泛化结构；而搜索式 AutoFE 与生成式重塑都受双重不稳定困扰：噪声评估器扭曲局部奖励引导，随机生成轨迹又会收敛到互不一致的解。
Method: 将重塑算子序列搜索表述为 reward-guided diffusion generation，核心是 micro-macro 分解：micro 层用高斯平滑、Monte Carlo 平均梯度替代点估计奖励引导，macro 层对独立引导的轨迹做加权 Fréchet-mean barycenter 聚合，只保留有共识支撑的 basin 并过滤随机离群轨迹。
Result: 在 8-dataset headline cohort、重尾 (heavy-tailed) 评估器噪声下，FCDiff 在 lower-tail reliability 与 robustness 上取得最佳综合排名，对手包括搜索式 AutoFE 与面向稳健性的生成式基线；相对每一个生成式基线的准确率提升均具统计显著性。
Conclusion: 稳健的数据重塑应当搜索平坦、有共识支撑的区域，而不是尖锐的单轨迹最优点。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: FCDiff 把特征工程式数据重塑 (data reshaping) 序列搜索写成奖励引导的扩散生成，用高斯平滑、蒙特卡洛平均的梯度把生成推向奖励景观中局部平坦的区域，再用加权 Fréchet-mean barycenter 聚合多条独立轨迹、筛掉随机离群解。在 8 个数据集的 headline 队列、重尾评估器噪声设定下，FCDiff 在下尾可靠性与稳健性上取得最佳综合排名，并相对每个生成式基线取得统计显著的准确率提升。

summary_sections.method: 将重塑算子序列搜索表述为 reward-guided diffusion generation，核心是 micro-macro 分解：micro 层用高斯平滑、Monte Carlo 平均梯度替代点估计奖励引导，macro 层对独立引导的轨迹做加权 Fréchet-mean barycenter 聚合，只保留有共识支撑的 basin 并过滤随机离群轨迹。
summary_sections.result: 在 8-dataset headline cohort、重尾 (heavy-tailed) 评估器噪声下，FCDiff 在 lower-tail reliability 与 robustness 上取得最佳综合排名，对手包括搜索式 AutoFE 与面向稳健性的生成式基线；相对每一个生成式基线的准确率提升均具统计显著性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 稳健的数据重塑应当搜索平坦、有共识支撑的区域，而不是尖锐的单轨迹最优点。

papers.title: Affine Geometry of Gaussian ReLU Networks via Conditional Kac-Rice Formulas
papers.abstract_en: We study how the affine geometry of finite ReLU networks is created at random initialization and reorganized by supervised training. We call a sign-changing zero of a hidden preactivation an activation switch and a point where the scalar network output is nondifferentiable a scalar kink. For one-dimensional input, conditioning on the preceding layers makes each preactivation Gaussian and affine on the cells of a random finite partition. This yields an exact finite-width conditional Kac-Rice formula for the expected number of activation switches along an input interval. For fixed depth and proportionally growing widths, the resulting switch intensities converge to explicit deterministic limits. A visibility estimate shows that the expected number of switches that do not produce scalar kinks is negligible, yielding an explicit leading formula for the expected number of scalar kinks and hence affine regions. In higher input dimensions d >= 2, the analogous conditional surface formula yields the leading expected (d-1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the scalar kink set. On the Breast Cancer Wisconsin data, the initialization formula accurately predicts switch counts along held-out segments. After training, switch counts decrease along within-class segments and increase along between-class segments. Thus, training redistributes rather than merely contracts affine complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 1 维输入下对有限宽 ReLU 网络给出条件 Kac-Rice 精确公式，预测随机初始化时激活开关 (activation switch) 与标量 kink（即仿射区域）的期望数目；固定深度、宽度按比例增长时开关强度收敛到显式确定性极限。在 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 数据上，初始化公式能准确预测 held-out 段上的开关数；训练后类内段开关数下降、类间段上升，说明训练是重新分配而非单纯压缩仿射复杂度。
Motivation: 有限宽 ReLU 网络在随机初始化下仿射区域结构如何产生、监督训练如何重组它，缺少可计算的精确刻画；已有直觉只停留在“训练压缩复杂度”这一粗糙说法。
Method: 对 1 维输入，条件于前层后每个 preactivation 在随机有限划分的胞腔上是高斯且仿射，据此导出沿输入区间激活开关期望数目的有限宽条件 Kac-Rice 公式；用 visibility 估计证明不产生标量 kink 的开关期望数可忽略，从而得到标量 kink 与仿射区域数目的显式首项公式；d ≥ 2 时用条件曲面公式给出标量 kink 集的首项 (d-1) 维 Hausdorff 测度。
Result: 固定深度、宽度按比例增长时开关强度收敛到显式确定性极限；在 Breast Cancer Wisconsin 数据上，初始化公式准确预测 held-out 段上的开关计数；训练后类内段 (within-class) 开关数下降、类间段 (between-class) 开关数上升。
Conclusion: 监督训练对仿射复杂度的作用是沿数据流形重新分配（类内收缩、类间扩张），而不是整体收缩；开关与 kink 的期望计数可用条件 Kac-Rice 公式在初始化处精确预测。

papers.title: IGSD: Environment-Verified Hindsight Self-Distillation for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation densifies agent training without external teachers: a policy conditioned on privileged hindsight provides step-level guidance for its own unprivileged rollouts. For search agents, however, hindsight can make the teacher prefer a query that does not improve retrieval from the student's state. Existing methods either distill this preference directly or filter it with model-internal scores, but neither strategy verifies the query's executed retrieval consequence. We propose Information-Gain-Gated Self-Distillation (IGSD), which verifies on-policy token proposals with environment feedback before distilling them. Treating each query token as a micro-action, IGSD completes the teacher's token proposal and the student's sampled token into matched queries and executes both from the same failed state with the same retriever. Shared counterfactual controls account for query-conditioned shifts in answer likelihood, so their difference, the executed paired information gain, provides a relative utility contrast for the retrieved documents. IGSD uses this contrast as a positive-only soft weight for candidate-pair distillation, while leaving the GRPO objective unchanged and confining verification to training. Across seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks, IGSD reaches macro-average exact-match accuracies of 42.8% and 47.0% with 3B and 7B policies, respectively, without inference-time verification. These results support environment-verified hindsight as an effective approach to reliable action-level supervision for search agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IGSD 用环境反馈核验 on-policy 的 hindsight 自蒸馏：把查询 token 当作微动作，从同一失败状态用同一检索器执行教师与学生补全的配对查询，以执行后的配对信息增益作为正向软权重做候选对蒸馏，GRPO 目标不变。七个单跳与多跳 QA 基准上，3B 与 7B 策略的宏平均 exact-match 分别达 42.8% 与 47.0%，且推理时不需核验。
Motivation: hindsight 教师可能偏好并不改善学生当前状态检索的查询；现有方法或直接蒸馏该偏好，或用模型内部分数过滤，都没有核验查询实际执行的检索后果。
Method: IGSD 把每个查询 token 视为 micro-action，将教师 token 提案与学生采样 token 补全为配对查询，从同一失败状态、用同一检索器执行两者；用共享反事实控制抵消查询条件化的答案似然偏移，其差值即执行配对信息增益，作为候选对蒸馏的正向软权重，GRPO 目标保持不变，核验只在训练期进行。
Result: 在七个单跳与多跳 QA 基准上，宏平均 exact-match：3B 策略 42.8%，7B 策略 47.0%，且推理时不做核验。
Conclusion: 环境核验的 hindsight 能为 search agent 提供可靠的动作级监督，且核验成本可只留在训练阶段。

papers.title: World Agent: Can Language Models Keep a World Running?
papers.abstract_en: World models are moving from generating realistic frames to generating playable worlds, yet whether a delivered world can keep running is not tested anywhere. Existing evaluations stop at generation, at delivery, or at single-step transitions, and each stops at a different point along the way. Correct local state transitions or intermediate outcomes do not guarantee a correctly organized causal event flow. We propose the world agent task, which moves the evaluation point of world generation from the moment of delivery to the continued operation that follows. In this task, a model is not asked to generate a world. It is held responsible for keeping the world running, which requires coordinating events and carrying forward their consequences to constrain subsequent evolution. We instantiate the task in WorldAgent-Benchmark with two complementary tracks. In the maintenance track, the model must ground the events of a continuous narrative into correct transitions of the explicit world state while respecting causal, temporal, and concurrency constraints. In the deduction track, the model must predict how the world will evolve under partial observations and act toward a goal. The maintenance track combines LLM-assisted semantic judgments with programmatic validation and scoring, while the deduction track is evaluated entirely programmatically. Individual judgments are auditable against world states and execution logs, and scores can be recomputed from the saved judgments and execution records. Across 8 models, scores decline steadily as pre-built structure is removed from the world, and causal-relation checking is the weakest component for every model. The benchmark makes the continued operation of a world measurable and distinguishes local completion from failures in event organization. Code and dataset will be released on https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/WorldAgent-Benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 world agent 任务与 WorldAgent-Benchmark，把世界生成的评测点从“交付那一刻”移到“交付后的持续运行”：模型不再生成世界，而要负责让世界继续跑，协调事件并把后果传递下去以约束后续演化。在 8 个模型上，随着世界中预置结构被逐步移除，分数持续下降，且因果关系检查 (causal-relation checking) 对每个模型都是最弱环节。
Motivation: 现有世界模型评测止步于生成、交付或单步状态转移，而局部转移正确并不保证因果事件流被正确组织，交付后世界能否持续运行无处可测。
Method: 定义 world agent 任务并落地为 WorldAgent-Benchmark，含两条互补赛道：maintenance 赛道要求把连续叙事中的事件落到显式世界状态的正确转移上，同时满足因果、时间与并发约束，用 LLM 辅助语义判断加程序化校验打分；deduction 赛道要求在部分观测下预测世界演化并朝目标行动，完全程序化评测，单条判断可对照世界状态与执行日志审计、分数可从保存的判断与执行记录重算。
Result: 在 8 个模型上，随着世界预置结构被移除，分数持续下降；因果关系检查是所有模型的最弱组件。
Conclusion: 世界模型的“持续运行”可被测量，且该评测能把局部完成 (local completion) 与事件组织失败区分开；代码与数据集将在 GitHub 的 WorldAgent-Benchmark 仓库发布。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Silent Failures in Agentic Security Evaluation: A Validated Harness for Tool-Call Mediation Under Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents that invoke privileged tools are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which adversarial instructions embedded in retrieved data hijack the agent's actions. A growing body of work evaluates defenses against IPI, but the validity of that evaluation is rarely examined. We audit an IPI benchmark and its harness and identify four defect classes -- silent payload non-delivery, attack success scored by tool identity rather than arguments, false-rejection rate conflated with model incapacity, and the absence of an audit trail -- each of which yields a plausible, publishable, and incorrect number. We quantify the distortion by re-scoring identical execution traces under the defective and corrected definitions: on real agent behaviour, the tool-identity scorer reports a 21.7% attack-success rate where the true argument-level rate is 1.2%. In the sharpest case, an open model previously reported at 62.8% registers 0% under the corrected harness -- the prior figure largely an artifact of undelivered payloads and identity-level scoring. We release a harness whose construction makes each defect unrepresentable -- machine-checkable payload placement, argument-level attacker predicates, per-scenario environments, and mandatory trace persistence -- and use it to report three quantities the field does not: whether a compromised agent discloses the attack, the full security/utility operating curve of an LLM-judge defense, and tool-calling capability disentangled from defensive over-blocking. A corrected harness further overturns a reported "capability barrier": a model deemed incapable of tool use is in fact fully capable, its earlier result an artifact of environment mismatch. We argue that evaluation validity is a prerequisite for, not a footnote to, defense claims in agentic security, and provide an instrument that enforces it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 审计间接提示注入 (indirect prompt injection, IPI) 评测基准与其执行 harness，识别出四类缺陷——载荷静默未送达、按工具身份而非参数判定攻击成功、把误拒率与模型能力混为一谈、缺少审计轨迹——并证明每一类都会产出看似合理却错误的数字。同一执行轨迹在缺陷与修正定义下重打分：真实 agent 行为上工具身份打分器报 21.7% 攻击成功率，而参数级真值仅 1.2%；某开源模型此前报告 62.8%，修正后为 0%。作者主张评测有效性是 agentic 安全防御结论的前提而非脚注。
Motivation: 针对 IPI 防御的评测工作在增长，但评测本身的效度很少被检验；harness 缺陷会把错误结论伪装成可发表的数字，甚至支撑所谓“能力壁垒”这类论断。
Method: 审计既有 IPI 基准与 harness，归纳四类缺陷并用同一执行轨迹在缺陷/修正两套定义下重打分来量化失真；发布新 harness，构造上使缺陷不可表达：机器可校验的载荷放置 (machine-checkable payload placement)、参数级攻击者谓词 (argument-level attacker predicates)、逐场景环境、强制轨迹持久化。
Result: 工具身份打分器报 21.7% 攻击成功率，参数级真值为 1.2%；某开源模型此前报告 62.8%，修正 harness 下为 0%，原值主要源于载荷未送达与身份级打分；被判定不会用工具的模型实际完全具备该能力，原结果是环境不匹配的产物。新 harness 另报告三项量：被攻陷 agent 是否披露攻击、LLM-judge 防御的完整安全/效用运行曲线、与防御性过度拦截解耦的工具调用能力。
Conclusion: agentic 安全中防御主张必须以评测效度为前提；修正后的 harness 使四类缺陷不可表达，并推翻了此前报告的“能力壁垒”。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MM-OPD 指出 MLLM 在感知与推理之间还卡着一个「证据选择」瓶颈：把图像换成 caption 或 code 这类符号视图后，模型对正确视觉证据的注意力显著更高，性能反而提升 10.2% 到 23.6%。作者据此提出多模态 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，用符号视图产生的残差 token 级目标把图像条件策略拉回正确证据。
Motivation: 现有工作分别强化感知与推理，隐含假设感知到推理可无缝过渡；但符号视图输入反而更优，说明瓶颈在于从已感知信息中挑选供后续推理使用的证据，而非感知或推理能力本身。
Method: MM-OPD 是面向符号到视觉纠正的多模态 on-policy 自蒸馏 (on-policy self-distillation) 框架：以符号条件行为作为监督，通过残差 token 级目标 (residual token-level targets) 迁移到图像条件策略，引导模型关注正确视觉证据；证据监督无需人工标注。
Result: 固定模型、问题与解码，仅将图像替换为 caption 或 code 符号视图，性能在不同模型规模与数据集上提升 10.2% 到 23.6%（Symbolic Visual Gap）；符号视图输入模型对正确证据的注意力远高于图像输入模型。跨 benchmark 与模型规模的实验显示 MM-OPD 提升视觉感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理和通用 VQA 等多类能力。
Conclusion: 感知与推理之间存在独立的证据选择瓶颈，符号视图可作为免人工标注的监督信号，通过 on-policy 自蒸馏把这一引导注入图像条件策略，从而同时改善多类多模态能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Evolving Time-Series Forecasting Agents with Episodic Memory and Online Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly used for time-series forecasting because they can organise contextual information, perform multi-step analysis, and guide the sequence of actions required to complete forecasting tasks. Most existing agents focus only on the current forecasting instance. However, in real-world deployments, forecasting commonly operates online, with new forecasts issued from the currently available history as the forecast origin advances and the ground-truth targets of earlier instances progressively become available. These targets provide feedback on the actions taken in earlier instances, yet existing agents generally do not preserve or utilise this information to adapt their subsequent actions. To address this limitation, we introduce FASE, a Feedback-Aware Self-Evolving forecasting agent that converts such feedback into task-specific experience for subsequent forecasting instances. FASE combines episodic memory, which retrieves relevant completed instances, with online policy learning, which summarises the feedback accumulated across instances into ranking guidance. The proposed framework is evaluated on 29 dataset configurations selected from the GIFT-Eval benchmark. Across these 29 configurations, FASE attains the strongest aggregate point forecasting performance among the evaluated methods and reduces the normalised MAE by 9.1% relative to the best individual foundation model baseline. The results further indicate that the cumulative advantage of FASE increases as delayed feedback accumulates. Together, these findings demonstrate that FASE can continually self-evolve through feedback from completed forecasting instances without updating the parameters of the LLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FASE 把在线时序预报中逐步揭晓的真实值转成可复用经验：情景记忆 (episodic memory) 检索已完成的相似实例，在线策略学习把跨实例累积的反馈总结为排序指导，从而在不更新 LLM 参数的前提下持续自我进化。在 GIFT-Eval 的 29 个数据集配置上，FASE 取得所评估方法中最强的聚合点预报性能，相对最优单一基础模型基线把归一化 MAE 降低 9.1%，且延迟反馈累积越多优势越大。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 预报 agent 只处理当前这一次预报，而真实部署中预报原点不断前移、早期实例的真实值陆续揭晓；这些对先前动作的反馈被丢弃，agent 无法据此调整后续动作。
Method: FASE 由两部分组成：情景记忆检索已完成的相关预报实例供后续使用；在线策略学习把跨实例累积的反馈总结成排序指导 (ranking guidance)，驱动后续实例的动作选择，全程不更新 LLM 参数。
Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 基准选出的 29 个数据集配置上，FASE 在所评估方法中取得最强的聚合点预报性能，归一化 MAE 相对最优单一基础模型基线下降 9.1%；随延迟反馈累积，FASE 的累积优势增大。
Conclusion: 已完成预报实例的反馈足以让 LLM 预报 agent 在参数冻结下持续自我进化，且这种基于反馈的累积优势随反馈增多而扩大。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Dude, Where's My State? Execution Information Requirements for Stateful Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-running agents must preserve information that later steps depend on. We introduce the Execution Information Requirement (EIR), a lower bound on the information that must remain accessible for correct completion under specified task and access conditions. We develop LACUNA, a framework that generates tasks with known dependencies and varies information demand, retention, and recovery separately from the difficulty of individual operations. Across four models, restoring a missing result raises accuracy on affected recall steps to 100%, compared with 0% for equal-length irrelevant information. Sufficient storage alone does not ensure success: retention policies can discard required results, errors can propagate through later computations, and agents can stop before recovery is complete. We also introduce VESTIGE, which uses agent execution traces to construct semantic graphs and measure information demand for real tasks. Across 72,562 software-agent trajectories, VESTIGE reveals a steeper distance-related decline in solution-relevant rereading for failed runs (RR 0.951 per distance doubling), while adjusted peak demand alone is not associated with failure. Together, these contributions support evaluating whether agents preserve and recover the information their tasks require.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出执行信息需求 (EIR) 作为任务正确完成所必须保持可访问信息的下界，并给出 LACUNA 框架把信息需求、保留与恢复从单步操作难度中解耦。恢复缺失结果使受影响回忆步骤准确率达 100%，等长无关信息仅 0%；在 72,562 条软件 agent 轨迹上，失败运行的解题相关重读随距离加倍衰减更陡 (RR 0.951)。
Motivation: 长时程 agent 必须保留后续步骤依赖的信息，但现有评测无法区分信息需求、保留策略与恢复能力，也难以判断失败是否源于信息丢失。
Method: 定义 EIR 下界；LACUNA 生成已知依赖结构的任务，独立改变信息需求、保留与恢复，并与单步操作难度分离；VESTIGE 从执行轨迹构建语义图以测量真实任务的信息需求。
Result: 跨 4 个模型，恢复缺失结果使受影响 recall 步骤准确率升至 100%，等长无关信息为 0%；72,562 条软件 agent 轨迹中，失败运行的解题相关重读随距离加倍的 RR 为 0.951，而调整后峰值需求本身与失败无关联。
Conclusion: 存储充足不等于成功：保留策略可能丢弃必需结果、错误会沿后续计算传播、agent 可能在恢复完成前停止，因此评测应直接检查 agent 是否保留并恢复任务所需信息。

papers.title: PINNMorph: Evolving Online Adaptation Policies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a learning-based framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their training behavior can change substantially throughout optimization. Residual distributions, gradient interactions, regional learning difficulty, and model-capacity requirements may evolve over time, while the network architecture and major training mechanisms are typically determined before training. We propose PINNMorph, an online PINN adaptation framework based on large language model (LLM)-guided policy evolution. PINNMorph maintains a population of state-conditioned adaptation policies that map execution diagnostics to controlled interventions over topology modification, additive representation augmentation, objective balancing, gradient handling, adaptive sampling, and optimizer-phase control. At each intervention opportunity, candidate programs are instantiated from the current policy population, selected according to the observed training state, and applied directly to the PINN under training. The resulting model inherits its existing parameters and training state and continues optimization along the same trajectory. Execution outcomes are subsequently used to evaluate interventions and evolve the policy population. Unlike pre-training architecture search or fixed adaptation rules, PINNMorph jointly adapts the current PINN and the policies governing its interventions using feedback from actual training. Experiments on 13 PDE benchmarks show that PINNMorph achieves lower solution errors than SA-PINN, ConFIG, RoPINN, HARMONIC, and PINNsAgent across all evaluated problems. Ablation studies further examine the effects of online adaptation, state-conditioned intervention selection, and execution-feedback-driven policy evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PINNMorph 用 LLM 引导的策略进化做 PINN 在线自适应：维护一组以训练状态为条件的干预策略，在训练中直接对拓扑修改、表示增广、目标平衡、梯度处理、自适应采样与优化器阶段控制施加干预，模型继承原参数与训练状态继续优化。在 13 个 PDE 基准上，其解误差低于 SA-PINN、ConFIG、RoPINN、HARMONIC 和 PINNsAgent 全部被评估问题。
Motivation: PINN 的残差分布、梯度交互、区域学习难度与容量需求在优化过程中会变化，而网络结构与主要训练机制通常在训练前就固定，无法跟随这一演化。
Method: 维护一组状态条件化的适应策略（policy population），把执行诊断映射到六类受控干预：拓扑修改、加性表示增广、目标平衡、梯度处理、自适应采样、优化器阶段控制；在每个干预机会从当前策略群实例化候选程序，按观测到的训练状态选择并直接施加到训练中的 PINN，继承既有参数与训练状态沿原轨迹继续优化，再用执行结果评估干预并进化策略群。
Result: 在 13 个 PDE 基准上，PINNMorph 在全部被评估问题中取得比 SA-PINN、ConFIG、RoPINN、HARMONIC、PINNsAgent 更低的解误差；另设消融研究考察在线自适应、状态条件化干预选择、执行反馈驱动的策略进化各自的作用。
Conclusion: 训练架构与干预规则应当与当前 PINN 一起由真实训练反馈联合调整，而非在训练前一次性定死。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: 4D radar provides geometric and motion cues that complement visual semantics, but integrating it into vision-language-action (VLA) models requires both radar--language alignment for semantic reasoning and explicit use of radar measurements for trajectory refinement and selection. To support these capabilities, we construct Cap4DR with 86,016 radar-image-text samples for alignment pretraining and OmniHD-QA with 520,161 question-answer pairs for instruction tuning across scene description, key-object reasoning, occupancy understanding, and trajectory planning. Building on these datasets, we propose RCVLA, a radar-camera VLA framework consisting of a radar-grounded semantic reasoning stage (RCVLA-Sem) and a trajectory arbitration stage (RCVLA-Phys). RCVLA-Sem performs gated bidirectional interaction between camera and radar tokens for driving question answering and reference trajectory generation, while auxiliary heads provide object and occupancy queries. RCVLA-Phys refines reference-guided trajectory candidates through truncated diffusion conditioned on these queries and cluster-level radar measurements, then calibrates candidate scores using radar-derived time-to-collision risk. On OmniHD-QA, RCVLA-Sem improves CIDEr by 9.92 points and reduces key-object velocity error by $21.9\%$ relative to OmniDrive. RCVLA-Phys further reduces average L2 error from $0.348$ to $0.259\,\mathrm{m}$ and average open-loop collision rate from $0.576\%$ to $0.175\%$ relative to RCVLA-Sem. Ablation studies further show that language-aligned radar tokens improve semantic reasoning, while cluster-level radar measurements and risk calibration improve trajectory arbitration. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCVLA 把 4D 雷达接入视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 自动驾驶模型：先用雷达-语言对齐做语义推理 (RCVLA-Sem)，再用截断扩散与雷达碰撞风险校准仲裁轨迹 (RCVLA-Phys)。在 OmniHD-QA 上 CIDEr 比 OmniDrive 提高 9.92 点、关键目标速度误差降 21.9%；Phys 阶段把平均 L2 从 0.348 m 降到 0.259 m，开环碰撞率从 0.576% 降到 0.175%。
Motivation: 4D 雷达有几何与运动线索可补足视觉语义，但接入 VLA 需同时解决雷达-语言对齐与用雷达量测显式精修、筛选轨迹两个问题。
Method: 构建 Cap4DR（86,016 条雷达-图像-文本样本）做对齐预训练，OmniHD-QA（520,161 问答对）覆盖场景描述、关键目标推理、占据理解与轨迹规划的指令微调。RCVLA-Sem 在相机与雷达 token 间做门控双向交互，辅以目标与占据查询头；RCVLA-Phys 以这些查询和 cluster 级雷达量测为条件做截断扩散 (truncated diffusion) 精修候选轨迹，再用雷达导出的 time-to-collision 风险校准候选得分。
Result: 在 OmniHD-QA 上 RCVLA-Sem 相对 OmniDrive 的 CIDEr 提高 9.92 点，关键目标速度误差降低 21.9%；RCVLA-Phys 相对 RCVLA-Sem 把平均 L2 误差从 0.348 m 降到 0.259 m，平均开环碰撞率从 0.576% 降到 0.175%。消融显示语言对齐的雷达 token 改善语义推理，cluster 级雷达量测与风险校准改善轨迹仲裁。
Conclusion: 雷达-语言对齐与基于雷达量测的轨迹仲裁分工为两个阶段，可同时提升驾驶问答语义质量与开环轨迹的安全性、精度；代码将开源。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: The GUI Is Not the State: Diagnosing State Aliasing in GUI World Models
papers.abstract_en: GUI World Models (GUI-WMs) are increasingly used to predict future states for agent planning and simulation, yet most existing formulations condition only on the current GUI observation and action. We identify state aliasing, where the vis- ible interface omits transition-relevant environment state, so identical observable conditions can correspond to different valid futures. To diagnose this failure mode, we introduce StateAliasBench, a diagnostic benchmark that explicitly isolates such ambiguities via strict pairing. We further propose lightweight predictive- state recovery that infers structured state from history and augments otherwise frozen GUI-WMs through a deterministic state interface. Family-specific special- ists provide state recovery across heterogeneous state types, and multi-teacher dis- tillation consolidates them into a single unified estimator. Experiments show that existing GUI-WMs exhibit systematic failures under observation-only condition- ing, while predictive-state augmentation substantially restores state-sensitive pre- diction across evaluated WMs, preserves generative fidelity, and improves down- stream performance of GUI agents on AndroidWorld. These results suggest that reliable GUI world modeling should account not only for what is visible, but also for the hidden transition state that determines what happens next.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI 世界模型只以当前界面观测和动作为条件时会出现状态混叠 (state aliasing)：可见界面遗漏决定转移的环境状态，相同观测对应不同合法未来。作者提出 StateAliasBench 用严格配对隔离这类歧义，并用从历史推断结构化状态的轻量预测态恢复模块，经确定性状态接口增强冻结的 GUI-WM；多教师蒸馏把异质状态类型的家庭专家合并为单一估计器。实验显示观测条件化下现有 GUI-WM 存在系统性失败，而预测态增强在所评估的模型上大幅恢复状态敏感预测、保持生成保真度，并提升 AndroidWorld 上 GUI agent 的下游表现。
Motivation: 现有 GUI 世界模型几乎都只以当前 GUI 观测和动作为条件，可见界面会遗漏决定转移的环境状态，导致相同可观测条件对应不同合法未来，规划与仿真因此被误导。
Method: 提出 StateAliasBench，用严格配对 (strict pairing) 显式隔离状态混叠歧义；再提出轻量预测态恢复，从历史推断结构化状态并通过确定性状态接口增强 otherwise 冻结的 GUI-WM，其中按状态类型分工的家庭专家由多教师蒸馏 (multi-teacher distillation) 合并为单一统一估计器。
Result: 实验显示现有 GUI-WM 在观测条件化下出现系统性失败；预测态增强在所评估的多个 GUI-WM 上大幅恢复状态敏感预测，保持生成保真度，并提升 GUI agent 在 AndroidWorld 上的下游表现。
Conclusion: 可靠的 GUI 世界建模不能只看可见界面，必须显式刻画决定下一步发生什么的隐藏转移状态。

papers.title: When Better Gets Worse: Improvement Fidelity for Self-Improving Agents in Adaptive Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents increasingly rely on proxy verifiers to choose policy updates, yet deployment can change the world in which those updates are evaluated. An update that looks better to the verifier can therefore become worse after deployment even when the verifier ranks policies well overall. We formalize this gap as Improvement Fidelity, which asks whether proxy improvements preserve the sign and ordering of deployment improvements over the updates an improvement process actually proposes. We show that global policy accuracy need not guarantee update fidelity: operator shift and deployment response can create update-level errors, while candidate margins determine whether those errors change the replacement decision. We introduce PIVOT-KG, a paired, decision-aware validator that allocates scarce high-fidelity evaluation according to the expected reduction in selection regret per unit cost. Across 90 held-out roots in Leduc, Kuhn, and Melting Pot, proxy and deployment optimal sets are disjoint in 51 cases. In an eight-candidate HighwayEnv stress test, PIVOT-KG reduces mean improvement-selection regret from 0.0435 under the exact Uniform validation rule to 0.0055 at the primary budget. Together, these results show why reliable self-improvement should evaluate proposed improvements in the worlds they induce, while providing a practical rule for allocating scarce deployment evidence when it can affect the replacement decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自改进智能体用代理验证器挑选策略更新，但部署会改变被评估的世界，使验证器看起更好的更新部署后反而更差。作者把这一落差形式化为 Improvement Fidelity（改进保真度），并提出按单位成本的预期选择后悔下降来分配高保真评估预算的 PIVOT-KG：在 Leduc、Kuhn、Melting Pot 的 90 个 held-out roots 中有 51 例代理最优集与部署最优集不相交；在 HighwayEnv 八候选压力测试中，PIVOT-KG 把平均改进选择后悔从 exact Uniform 规则的 0.0435 降到主预算下的 0.0055。
Motivation: 代理验证器即使整体排序准确，部署引起的 operator shift 与 deployment response 也会在更新层面翻转符号与次序，导致自改进过程选错替换；需要一个衡量并缓解该落差的准则。
Method: 形式化 Improvement Fidelity：检验代理改进能否在改进过程实际提出的更新集合上保持部署改进的符号与次序；证明全局策略精度不保证更新保真，错误是否改变替换决策取决于 candidate margins；提出 PIVOT-KG，一种 paired、decision-aware 的验证器，按单位成本的预期 selection regret 下降分配稀缺高保真评估。
Result: 在 Leduc、Kuhn、Melting Pot 的 90 个 held-out roots 上，代理最优集与部署最优集有 51 例不相交；在 HighwayEnv 八候选压力测试中，exact Uniform 验证规则的平均改进选择后悔为 0.0435，PIVOT-KG 在主预算下降到 0.0055。
Conclusion: 可靠的自改进应在更新所诱导的世界里评估这些更新；当高保真证据会影响替换决策时，按预期选择后悔下降分配预算是可行的实用规则。

papers.title: SIFT: Enhancing Time Series Foundation Models via Semantic Invariance and Structural Fidelity Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have achieved remarkable zero-shot performance through extensive pre-training on massive time series datasets. Nevertheless, due to the low-dimensional properties and diverse structural patterns of time series data, performing naive fine-tuning on TSFMs often leads to overfitting and falling into the mean-prediction trap. To address these challenges, we propose SIFT, a robust adaptation method that enhances time series foundation models by preserving Semantic Invariance and structural Fidelity throughout the fine-Tuning process. We employ semantic-invariant adversarial augmentation, which utilizes semantic spectrum decomposition to partition the semantic space and then generates perturbations within the non-core semantic subspace to bolster the model's robustness against these perturbations, mitigating overfitting. We implement a component-based structural fidelity enhancement, which facilitates component-wise mixup and imposes a reconstruction objective to improve the model's ability to preserve structural fidelity, alleviating the mean-prediction trap. Extensive experiments on representative TSFMs covering 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that SIFT can significantly enhance the performance of TSFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIFT 是时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的微调适配方法：用语义谱分解把语义空间切开，只在非核心语义子空间内做对抗扰动以增强鲁棒性、抑制过拟合；再用分量级 mixup 加重建目标保持结构保真，缓解均值预测陷阱。在覆盖 10 个真实数据集的多个代表性 TSFM 上，SIFT 显著提升微调性能。
Motivation: TSFM 零样本表现虽强，但时间序列维度低、结构模式多样，朴素微调容易过拟合并陷入均值预测陷阱 (mean-prediction trap)。
Method: 两条机制：语义不变对抗增强 (semantic-invariant adversarial augmentation) 先用语义谱分解划分语义空间，再在非核心语义子空间内生成扰动；分量级结构保真增强 (component-based structural fidelity enhancement) 做分量 mixup 并加重建目标。
Result: 在覆盖 10 个真实数据集的代表性 TSFM 上，SIFT 显著提升模型性能，同时缓解过拟合与均值预测陷阱。
Conclusion: 在非核心语义子空间内做对抗扰动、配合分量 mixup 与重建约束，是让 TSFM 微调既鲁棒又保住结构的有效适配路径。
