papers.title: Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration
papers.abstract_en: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LevyMatch 用 Lévy 随机跳对软匹配矩阵做迭代精修：网络预测目标匹配矩阵，Brownian reference bridge 给出更新的显式公式，Gamma 随机时钟决定每步时间步长。再加一个固定的 front-loaded Gamma 策略，把更多期望时钟时间分给早期更新，不需重训也不增加网络评估；把同一批 Gamma 增量重排后，大增量放前面比放后面精度更高。在 4DMatch 上达到 93.09% NFMR 与 92.11% IR，4DLoMatch 上 82.79% NFMR 与 79.07% IR，两项指标均优于所比较的方法。
Motivation: 低重叠或非刚性形变下点云难以找到可靠对应；迭代精修能纠正不确定匹配，但网络评估开销限制了可执行的更新次数。
Method: 每步由网络根据当前匹配状态与几何信息预测目标匹配矩阵，Brownian reference bridge 给出朝向该目标的显式更新公式，Gamma 随机时钟设定每步时间步长，更新后的匹配再提供几何反馈进入下一轮预测；另提出固定的 front-loaded Gamma 策略，把更多期望时钟时间分配给早期更新，无需重训练或额外网络评估。
Result: 在 4DMatch 上 front-loaded 策略取得 93.09% NFMR 与 92.11% IR，在 4DLoMatch 上取得 82.79% NFMR 与 79.07% IR，两项指标相对所比较方法均有提升；重排同一批采样 Gamma 增量的对照显示，大增量置于早期比置于晚期精度更高。
Conclusion: 用随机时钟驱动的 Lévy 式迭代精修配合前重的时间步分配，可以在不增加网络评估的前提下提高非刚性点云匹配的召回率与内点率。

papers.title: KV-Lingo: Learning KV-Cache Translators with Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models represent context with a key-value (KV) cache. Caches are model-specific: for the same text, models with different architectures or weights produce incompatible representations. This makes it costly to switch models over a shared context: although the context has already been processed by one model, the incoming model must process it again to build its own cache. We introduce KV-Lingo, a method for translating the KV cache of a source model into one that can be read by a target model. KV-Lingo consists of a collection of linear maps, typically one per layer of the target model, that are applied independently on all tokens' key and value representations. We train these maps using distillation, minimising the divergence between the target model's predictions from its native cache and those from the translated cache. We consider several model pairs spanning multiple sizes and architectures, training one translator per pair on a generic text corpus. The resulting translators preserve strong downstream performance in both small-to-large and large-to-small transfers. Since a switch then costs a linear map and a single decoding step instead of a prefill, replacing re-prefill with cache translation reduces the time to first token after a model switch by 9.6x already on a 64-token prompt for Qwen models on an Apple M3 Ultra, and by up to 29x at 32k context length on an H100. These gains make KV-Lingo particularly useful for dynamic model routing: a context can be processed by one model and handed off to another only when needed, without re-prefilling the shared prefix. We finally show that KV-Lingo can be used for seamless model switching, staying close to re-prefill across repeated switches in our multi-turn evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KV-Lingo 用逐层线性映射把源模型的 KV cache 直接翻译成目标模型可读的 cache，训练时以蒸馏最小化目标模型在原生 cache 与翻译 cache 上预测的散度。切换模型因此只需一次线性映射加一次解码步而非重新 prefill：Qwen 模型在 Apple M3 Ultra 上 64-token prompt 的切换后首 token 时间缩短 9.6 倍，H100 上 32k 上下文最高缩短 29 倍。
Motivation: 不同架构或权重的模型 KV cache 互不兼容，共享上下文换模型时新模型必须重新处理整段前缀，长上下文下切换代价高，阻碍动态模型路由。
Method: 为每对模型（跨多种规模与架构）在通用文本语料上训练一组线性映射，通常目标模型每层一个，独立作用于所有 token 的 key 与 value 表示；训练目标是蒸馏损失，即最小化目标模型原生 cache 预测与翻译 cache 预测之间的散度。
Result: 翻译后的 cache 在 small-to-large 与 large-to-small 迁移上均保持强下游性能；切换开销从 prefill 降为一次线性映射加一次解码步，Qwen 模型在 Apple M3 Ultra 上 64-token prompt 的切换后首 token 时间加快 9.6 倍，在 H100 上 32k 上下文长度最高加快 29 倍；多轮评测中反复切换的表现接近 re-prefill。
Conclusion: cache 翻译可以替代 re-prefill，让上下文由一个模型处理、按需交给另一个模型，支撑无需重算共享前缀的动态模型路由与无缝切换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnchorRep: Defending LLMs Against Cross-Model Adversarial Transfer via Representation Repulsion
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks optimized on a single open-weight LLM can transfer to and jailbreak architecturally different models, allowing an attacker with white-box access to one model to compromise independently deployed systems. This creates a shared vulnerability across models, yet existing defenses are not designed for this cross-model threat. We find that cross-model transfer aligns with shared internal representation geometry, making it a natural defense target. AnchorRep targets this geometry directly with a lightweight LoRA adapter that pushes the defended model's internal representations of harmful prompts away from those of a frozen anchor model on the same prompts. Training uses a small set of harmful prompts and no adversarial examples. Across five models and four architectural families, AnchorRep reduces cross-model attack success rate to <=1.1% on 2,000 transferred attacks (0% on two), including the largest drop on Mistral (36% -> 1.1%). Existing defenses can reduce transfer, but only at high cost either inducing up to 77% degenerate benign output or increasing over-refusal by up to 18%. Because such degenerate benign outputs are not captured by standard refusal-based metrics, we introduce the Benign Garble Rate to quantify them. Our results suggest that cross-model robustness can be achieved by shaping representation geometry, without requiring attack-specific training
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026; Code, configs and logs: https://github.com/galwert/AnchorRep
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorRep 用一个轻量 LoRA adapter 把被防御模型对有害 prompt 的内部表征推离冻结 anchor 模型的同 prompt 表征，仅用少量有害 prompt、不含对抗样本训练，即可切断跨模型对抗迁移。在五个模型、四个架构族上，2000 次迁移攻击的跨模型攻击成功率降到 ≤1.1%（Mistral 从 36% 降到 1.1%，其中两个模型为 0%），同时不引入既有防御那种高达 77% 的良性输出退化或 18% 的过度拒绝。
Motivation: 针对单个开源 LLM 优化的对抗样本可迁移到架构不同的模型，让只掌握一个模型白盒的攻击者攻破独立部署的系统；现有防御并未针对这种跨模型威胁设计。
Method: AnchorRep 在被防御模型上挂一个轻量 LoRA adapter，训练目标是把该模型对有害 prompt 的内部表征推离一个冻结 anchor 模型在同一批 prompt 上的表征；训练数据只是一小集有害 prompt，不含任何对抗样本。作者还提出 Benign Garble Rate 指标来量化标准拒绝类指标捕捉不到的良性输出退化。
Result: 在五个模型、四个架构族上，2000 次迁移攻击的跨模型攻击成功率降至 ≤1.1%，其中两个模型为 0%；Mistral 上降幅最大，从 36% 降到 1.1%。既有防御虽能降低迁移，但代价是最多 77% 的良性输出退化或最多 18% 的过度拒绝上升。
Conclusion: 跨模型鲁棒性可以通过塑造共享的表征几何来实现，无需针对具体攻击做训练；衡量这类防御时必须同时看良性输出退化，而不只看拒绝类指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Software development requires more than editing code: developers repeatedly run software, interact with its interfaces, visually inspect its behavior, and use these observations to decide what to change next and whether a change works. Existing coding agents and computer-use agents are largely studied in isolation, leaving this integrated development process underexplored. Diagnosing a runtime interaction failure requires agents to connect visual observations with the responsible code, then use the application again to verify the repair. We introduce CUA-SWE, a benchmark, environment, and evaluation pipeline for software engineering with computer use. Beyond studying how GUI feedback supports diagnosis and repair, we ask whether agents can complete software engineering tasks when required specification or operational information is available only through the running application's visual interface. CUA-SWE spans four software engineering domains and requires agents to modify code and configuration, execute commands, interact with running software, and inspect visual feedback within the same task. Each task includes deterministic, task-specific tests that verify whether the resulting software satisfies the requirements and preserves specified behavior. Our evaluation characterizes how frontier agents combine source-level execution with application screenshots and graphical interaction to produce verified software changes. We examine performance across domains and task information requirements, alongside the development behaviors associated with successful repairs. CUA-SWE provides a unified testbed for studying how agents use visual feedback and interaction to guide software engineering, with executable correctness criteria for the resulting software.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CUA-SWE 提出一个面向计算机使用型软件工程 (computer-use software engineering) 的基准、环境与评测流水线：任务要求 agent 在同一任务内改代码与配置、执行命令、操作运行中的应用并读取截图反馈，最终由任务专属的确定性测试判定修复是否正确。评测刻画前沿 agent 如何把源码级执行与 GUI 视觉反馈结合产出可验证的软件改动，并按四个软件工程领域与任务信息需求（规格是否只能从运行界面获得）分维度分析表现。
Motivation: 现有 coding agent 与 computer-use agent 被分开研究，而真实开发需要反复运行软件、看界面、据视觉观察决定下一步修改；运行时交互故障的诊断与验证这一整合过程缺乏可评测的载体。
Method: CUA-SWE 由基准、环境和评测流水线三部分组成，覆盖四个软件工程领域；每个任务要求同时修改代码与配置、执行命令、与运行中软件交互并检查视觉反馈，且配有确定性、任务专属测试来验证需求满足与行为保持；评测维度包括领域、任务信息需求（规格/操作信息是否仅存在于运行界面）以及与成功修复相关的发展行为。
Result: 评测刻画前沿 agent 将源码级执行与应用截图、图形交互结合以产出经验证软件改动的方式，并按四个软件工程领域和任务信息要求分列表现，同时分析与成功修复相关的行为；摘要未给出具体分数或基线数值。
Conclusion: 软件工程任务可以在规格信息只通过运行界面可得的条件下被评测，且正确性由可执行测试而非人工判断给出，CUA-SWE 为此提供统一 testbed。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: CUA-SWE 由基准、环境和评测流水线三部分组成，覆盖四个软件工程领域；每个任务要求同时修改代码与配置、执行命令、与运行中软件交互并检查视觉反馈，且配有确定性、任务专属测试来验证需求满足与行为保持；评测维度包括领域、任务信息需求（规格/操作信息是否仅存在于运行界面）以及与成功修复相关的发展行为。
summary_sections.result: 评测刻画前沿 agent 将源码级执行与应用截图、图形交互结合以产出经验证软件改动的方式，并按四个软件工程领域和任务信息要求分列表现，同时分析与成功修复相关的行为；摘要未给出具体分数或基线数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 软件工程任务可以在规格信息只通过运行界面可得的条件下被评测，且正确性由可执行测试而非人工判断给出，CUA-SWE 为此提供统一 testbed。

papers.title: Not Every Term Adds New Structure: Sobolev Novelty for Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover compact and meaningful mathematical equations from data, but searching the vast combinatorial space of symbolic structures remains challenging. Existing methods typically guide this process using expression-level objectives, such as fitting error, which assess a candidate equation as a whole but provide little information about whether an individual term contributes genuinely new structure or is largely redundant with the rest of the expression. We introduce \textbf{Sobolev Novelty}, a term-level measure of structural independence for symbolic equations. For each term, we construct an empirical Sobolev signature from its function values and exact derivatives over the observed inputs, and quantify how much of this behavior cannot be reconstructed by the remaining terms. We further derive a theory-calibrated threshold, yielding a principled and tuning-free criterion for identifying structurally novel terms. Using this threshold, 92.6\% of terms in benchmark ground-truth equations exhibit sufficient structural novelty, compared with only 38.3\% on average for expressions produced by 15 SR methods, revealing a substantial gap between scientific equations and current SR solutions. As a lightweight plug-in, Sobolev Novelty can be incorporated into diverse SR paradigms to support term pruning, search guidance, LLM feedback, and data selection, yielding consistent performance gains and demonstrating broad applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sobolev Novelty：对符号回归 (SR) 表达式中的每个项，用其在观测输入上的函数值与精确导数构造经验 Sobolev 签名，度量该项无法被其余项重构的部分，并给出理论校准阈值判定结构新颖性。基准真值方程中 92.6% 的项通过该阈值，而 15 个 SR 方法产出的表达式平均仅 38.3%，显示科学方程与当前 SR 解之间存在结构性差距。
Motivation: 符号回归的搜索空间组合爆炸，而现有方法用整体拟合误差这类表达式级目标引导搜索，无法判断单个项是真正贡献新结构还是与其余项冗余。
Method: 为每个项在观测输入上计算函数值与精确导数的经验 Sobolev signature，量化其行为中不能被其余项重构的成分；推导理论校准阈值得到免调参的新颖性判据，作为轻量即插即用组件用于项剪枝、搜索引导、LLM 反馈与数据选择。
Result: 基准真值方程中 92.6% 的项满足结构新颖性阈值，15 个 SR 方法生成的表达式平均仅 38.3%；作为 plug-in 接入多种 SR 范式后取得一致的性能增益。
Conclusion: 项级结构独立性（而非整体拟合误差）能区分科学方程与 SR 搜索产物，Sobolev Novelty 可免调参地接入多种 SR 范式并带来一致增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90° random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-level translation from 1% to 5% metric anchors, four degrees of freedom per group and frame. On dynamic query points of eight trackers, including D4RT, 4RC and SM4RT, our correction lowers endpoint error by 15.1% to 62.6% over the uncorrected predictions, while spending the same anchors on gradient fine-tuning improves the same models by only -1.1% to 15.2%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main text plus appendices. Code: https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAUGE 是一个免训练、模型无关的后处理模块，把前馈 3D 轨迹跟踪中全局对齐后的残差解释为按运动分组的径向自由度（group-wise view inconsistency），并用 1%–5% 度量锚点逐帧估计径向尺度与组平移。在八个跟踪器（含 D4RT、4RC、SM4RT）的动态查询点上，端点误差下降 15.1%–62.6%，而同样锚点做梯度微调只改善 -1.1%–15.2%。
Motivation: 单目视频前馈 3D 点轨迹回归在全局对齐后残差仍然很大且缺少结构性解释：误差沿视线方向集中，且各运动分组所需的尺度修正不同，而 2D 观测本身无法约束这些径向自由度。
Method: GAUGE（Group-Wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation）先用预测位移方向的一致性与空间连通性恢复运动分组（方向中值角远低于 90° 随机基线），再从 1%–5% 度量锚点估计逐帧径向尺度与组级平移，每组每帧四个自由度；作为训练无关、模型无关的 post-hoc 模块挂在任意跟踪器之后。
Result: 在八个跟踪器（含 D4RT、4RC、SM4RT）的动态查询点上，GAUGE 校正使端点误差 (endpoint error) 相对未校正预测下降 15.1% 到 62.6%；同样把锚点用于梯度微调，同批模型只改善 -1.1% 到 15.2%。分组可靠性以位移方向中值角远低于 90° 随机基线衡量。
Conclusion: 前馈单目 3D 跟踪的系统性残差是每个运动分组一族沿视线的径向自由度，用少量度量锚点做分组级解析校正比把同样锚点投入梯度微调更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at https://recast-nav.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECAST 把 VLM 对场景的四类判断（可通行表面、风险物体、偏好朝向、可穿越缝隙）经视觉基础模型在图像中落地，重铸成一张紧凑的 Actionable Cost map，同时约束轨迹解码器并给候选打分。仿真中成功率比最强先前方法高 13.3 个百分点、真实四足机器人上高 31.4 个百分点，碰撞率分别相对下降 9.6 和 14.3 个百分点，为全部方法中最低。
Motivation: 纯学习式导航模型在训练分布外失效，而 VLM 方法虽有场景理解却难以把判断落到图像空间、也难让动作与之对齐，导致复杂环境下的稳定运动不足。
Method: 输入机器人前视图像与用户指令，先由 VLM 分解场景给出四类判断，再用视觉基础模型在图像中 grounding 这些表面与物体，将四类判断空间重铸为单一 cost map；该图既作为条件输入轨迹解码器，又对候选轨迹打分择优执行。因 VLM 判断滞后于实时场景，同时使用 pivot frame（含全部四类判断）与 current frame（按当前图像重建地形与碰撞代价）两张 cost map。
Result: 相对最强先前方法，仿真成功率提升 13.3 个百分点，真实四足机器人提升 31.4 个百分点；碰撞率相对下降 9.6（仿真）和 14.3（真实）个百分点，达到所有方法中最低碰撞率。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 的高层判断经视觉基础模型空间落地为统一 cost map 并同时用于条件化与打分，可在仿真与真实四足平台上同时提高成功率、降低碰撞率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent flow policies learn cooperative behavior from fixed offline datasets, but often struggle to complete tasks in situations not covered by the offline data. In these situations, agents must both adapt to changes in the environment and coordinate with one another, yet action patterns learned offline are often insufficient for effective adaptation and coordination. To address this problem, we propose Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization (MA-FPPO), which uses online fine-tuning to improve the cooperative behavior of models pretrained with flow matching through new interactions with the environment. Building on the behavior learned during pretraining, we construct policies with explicit action likelihoods for discrete and continuous action spaces. We then update the pretrained model using shared team advantages to further improve coordination based on team performance. Our method achieves, on average, relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest listed offline baselines across 30 settings and 29.8% over purely online learning across 38 comparisons with matched online budgets and evaluation protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MA-FPPO 对 flow matching 预训练的多智能体策略做在线微调，用共享团队优势 (shared team advantages) 更新预训练模型，使离线数据未覆盖的情形下仍能适应环境并协调动作。在 30 个设定上平均相对最强离线基线提升 52.8%，在 38 组匹配在线预算的对比上相对纯在线学习提升 29.8%。
Motivation: 多智能体 flow policy 只能从固定离线数据学协作行为，遇到离线数据未覆盖的情形时，学到的动作模式不足以支撑环境适应与智能体间协调。
Method: 提出 MA-FPPO：在 flow matching 预训练基础上做在线微调，通过与环境的新交互改进协作；为离散与连续动作空间构造带显式动作似然的策略，并用基于团队表现的共享团队优势更新预训练模型以强化协调。
Result: 在 30 个设定上平均相对最强所列离线基线提升 52.8%；在 38 组匹配在线预算与评估协议的对比上，相对纯在线学习提升 29.8%。
Conclusion: 离线预训练加共享团队优势的在线微调，能在离线数据覆盖之外的情形同时保住预训练行为并提升多智能体协作，且优于纯在线学习。

papers.title: Age of Learning: Temporal Persistence of Prediction Errors as a Learning Signal
papers.abstract_en: Current machine learning algorithms primarily rely on instantaneous signals such as loss, margin, and prediction confidence to characterize model behavior. These signals indicate how difficult a prediction is at the current optimization step, but they do not capture how long the model has remained incorrect. We study this temporal dimension of learning and introduce Age of Learning (AoL), a learning-state variable that measures the persistence of prediction errors over time. AoL increases while an error remains unresolved and resets when a correct prediction is achieved, thereby distinguishing persistent under-learning from transient mistakes. We develop AoL-based training strategies for both offline and streaming settings. In offline learning, sample-level AoL is accumulated over training and aggregated into class-level states that guide adaptive reweighting and resampling. In streaming learning, where full historical access is unavailable, we maintain lightweight class-level AoL states using current and buffered observations. Across long-tailed classification settings, AoL improves or matches standard training baselines, with larger benefits when learning difficulty persists over time. Multi-seed streaming experiments further show reproducible gains under temporally stable imbalance. Analysis of class frequency, loss, and margin shows that AoL is related to conventional difficulty measures but captures additional information about error duration. These results suggest that temporal persistence provides a useful complementary signal for characterizing and controlling learning dynamics in imbalanced and non-stationary environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Age of Learning (AoL)：一个记录预测错误持续时长的学习状态变量，错误未解决时累加、预测正确时清零，用来区分长期欠学习与偶发失误。离线训练用样本级 AoL 聚合成类级状态指导自适应重加权与重采样，流式训练只维护轻量类级状态；在长尾分类设定下 AoL 改进或持平标准训练基线，学习难度随时间持续时收益更大。
Motivation: 现有训练信号（loss、margin、预测置信度）只刻画当前优化步的难度，无法区分持续未解决的错误与瞬时失误，因而在长尾与非平稳环境下难以针对性地调整学习。
Method: 定义 AoL 为随错误持续增长、正确预测即重置的学习状态变量；离线设定下样本级 AoL 跨训练累积并聚合为类级状态，驱动自适应重加权与重采样；流式设定下无完整历史访问，仅用当前与缓冲观测维护轻量类级 AoL 状态。
Result: 在长尾分类设定下，AoL 训练改进或匹配标准训练基线，且学习难度随时间持续时收益更大；多种子流式实验在时间稳定的不平衡下显示可复现的增益；对类频率、loss、margin 的分析表明 AoL 与常规难度度量相关但额外携带错误持续时长信息。
Conclusion: 错误的时间持续性是刻画与控制不平衡、非平稳环境下学习动力学的有用互补信号，可与常规难度度量并用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPACE: Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction for Streaming Video Memory
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-capacity streaming video memory requires repeated eviction decisions whose effects accumulate over time. Yet existing policies are evaluated primarily in terms of retained information or downstream accuracy, leaving how repeated updates alter the futures supported by memory largely unexamined. We define a memory's predictive state as the future representations supported by its retained history and formulate eviction as counterfactual control over transitions in this space. We introduce SPACE (Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction), which uses a frozen multi-horizon JEPA to predict the future representations induced by alternative eviction actions. Counterfactual utility identifies future-useful alternatives, while slow predictive-basin geometry determines when to correct avoidable drift and when to adapt to sustained predictive change, without online parameter updates. We further introduce MABS-Bench, which evaluates future-task sufficiency, within-regime predictive stability, transition responsiveness, and perturbation recovery under matched causal streams and memory budgets. Across multiple video datasets, SPACE yields consistent improvements in dataset-native task performance while reducing predictive-state drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPACE 把定容流式视频记忆的逐次淘汰定义为对记忆预测状态的反事实控制，用冻结的多步 JEPA 预测各淘汰动作诱导的未来表征，按反事实效用挑选未来有用项，并依据慢变预测盆地几何决定何时纠正可避免漂移、何时适应持续预测变化，全程不做在线参数更新。配套 MABS-Bench 在匹配因果流与记忆预算下评测未来任务充分性、域内预测稳定性、转变响应性与扰动恢复；在多个视频数据集上 SPACE 一致提升数据集原生任务表现并降低预测状态漂移。
Motivation: 定容流式视频记忆要反复做淘汰决策，其影响随时间累积；现有策略只按保留信息量或下游准确率评估，反复更新如何改变记忆所支持的未来基本无人考察。
Method: 定义记忆的预测状态为保留历史所支持的未来表征集合，将淘汰建模为对该空间状态转移的反事实控制；用冻结的多步 JEPA 预测不同淘汰动作导致的未来表征，以反事实效用 (counterfactual utility) 识别未来有用项，用慢变预测盆地几何 (slow predictive-basin geometry) 决定纠正漂移还是适应持续变化，不更新在线参数。同时提出 MABS-Bench，在匹配因果流与记忆预算下评测四个维度。
Result: 在多个视频数据集上，SPACE 一致提升数据集原生任务性能，同时降低预测状态漂移；评测维度为未来任务充分性、域内预测稳定性、转变响应性与扰动恢复。
Conclusion: 反复淘汰应按其对未来表征的支持来控制而非只看保留量：以冻结多步 JEPA 做反事实淘汰，可在不更新参数的前提下同时保住任务性能并压住预测状态漂移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) combines learned world models with online trajectory optimization, achieving strong performance in continuous control. However, the per-step cost of sampling and evaluating hundreds of candidate trajectories restricts deployment to control frequencies well below what real-time robotics demands. Motivated by the dual-process theory of human cognition, which distinguishes between fast, intuitive processing (System 1) and slower, deliberative reasoning (System 2), we ask whether every decision requires the same degree of computational deliberation. We propose Fast-TD-MPC, a lightweight framework that adaptively routes between fast policy execution and test-time planning, reserving costly deliberation for states where it is most needed. Fast-TD-MPC delivers competitive task performance across 103 continuous control tasks while achieving up to ~4x faster inference. Under external disturbances, Fast-TD-MPC selectively falls back to planning, maintaining robustness comparable to the original planner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fast-TD-MPC 把双过程认知理论搬进 data-driven MPC：在快速策略执行与 test-time planning 之间自适应路由，只在最需要的状态才启动昂贵的轨迹规划。在 103 个连续控制任务上保持有竞争力的任务性能，推理最高提速约 4 倍；遇到外部扰动时选择性回退到 planner，鲁棒性与原 planner 相当。
Motivation: data-driven MPC 每步要采样并评估数百条候选轨迹，控制频率被压到远低于实时机器人需求；而并非每个决策都需要同等程度的计算 deliberation。
Method: 提出 Fast-TD-MPC，借双过程理论 (dual-process theory) 在轻量快速策略与 test-time planning 之间自适应路由，把昂贵 deliberation 保留给最需要的状态，并在外部扰动下回退到原 planner。
Result: 在 103 个连续控制任务上取得有竞争力的任务性能，推理速度最高提升约 4 倍；在外部扰动下选择性回退到 planning，鲁棒性与原 planner 相当。
Conclusion: 按状态选择性地分配计算 deliberation，可以在不牺牲任务性能与扰动鲁棒性的前提下把 data-driven MPC 的推理成本降下来，满足更高控制频率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
papers.abstract_en: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form. We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on those same messages improves it by 2.31. Delivery is the larger term on all three MemLens backbones and grows with backbone strength; retrieval grows too, without closing the gap. We propose DeliverMem, an instantiation of delivery as three decisions: keep the original modality, give each item a readable identity, and state when it was seen, with a retrieval-side adapter for the one property delivery cannot supply. Each is measured against a delivery-matched control that alters only its own variable. DeliverMem leads the strongest published memory agent on MemLens at all four context lengths, and beats DMV-Bench's own strongest method at every setting on both backbones. On MemLens it does this on a tenth to a seventieth of the input. Each decision helps only where the question lacks what it supplies, and is null elsewhere. A single fixed configuration nonetheless leads both benchmarks, without training any component or modifying the stored records. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
papers.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态 agent 记忆研究只优化写入与检索，本文把检索到答案之间的 delivery 单独拆出来量化：证据固定时直接给原始像素比扣留像素在 8B backbone 上多 13.87 分，而把同一批消息的检索做到完美只多 2.31 分。DeliverMem 把 delivery 落成三个决策（保留原始模态、给每条记忆可读身份、标注何时见过）加一个检索侧 adapter，在 MemLens 四种上下文长度上超过最强已发布记忆 agent，并在 DMV-Bench 每个设置、两个 backbone 上超过其最强方法，且只用十分之一到七十分之一的输入。
Motivation: 多模态记忆评测只度量写入、更新与检索，检索结果以何种形式真正进入模型这一段从未被单独隔离，导致检索做到极致后仍有大量精度残差无法归因。
Method: 在 MemLens 上做受控分解，固定检索到的证据集合，只改变交付形式（扣留 vs 原始像素）与检索质量，分别测精度增量；再提出 DeliverMem，把 delivery 实例化为三个决策——保留原始模态、给每条记忆可读身份、标注被看到的时间——并配一个检索侧 adapter 补上 delivery 无法提供的属性，每个决策都对照只改自身变量的 delivery-matched control 消融。
Result: 证据固定时交付原始像素比扣留在 8B backbone 上提升 13.87 分，同批消息上把检索做到完美只提升 2.31 分；delivery 在 MemLens 三个 backbone 上都是更大项且随 backbone 变强而增大，检索也在增长但未缩小差距。DeliverMem 在 MemLens 四种上下文长度上领先最强已发布记忆 agent，并在 DMV-Bench 每个设置、两个 backbone 上击败其最强方法，同时只用十分之一到七十分之一的输入；每个决策只在问题缺少其所提供信息时有效，其余情形为零增益，单一固定配置在两个 benchmark 上均领先，全程不训练任何组件、不修改存储记录。
Conclusion: 多模态记忆的剩余提升空间主要在 delivery 而非检索，且随 backbone 变强而扩大；保留原始模态、可读身份与时间标注这组无需训练的固定配置足以同时领先 MemLens 与 DMV-Bench。

papers.title: EMIR$^2$: Evolution-Aware Memory with Intent-Guided Multi-Round Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to leverage historical interactions for future tasks. However, existing memory systems struggle to utilize continuously evolving historical information, as they often rely on static memory representations and single-round retrieval strategies, failing to track factual changes or integrate distributed evidence across long-term interactions. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$, an \textbf{E}volution-Aware \textbf{M}emory framework with \textbf{I}ntent-Guided Multi-\textbf{R}ound \textbf{R}etrieval, enabling LLM agents to maintain evolving historical knowledge and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence. Specifically, \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ constructs a State-Evolving Memory Graph (SEMG) that represents long-term memory as evolving knowledge states supported by temporal event trajectories and evidential associations. By maintaining semantic states through evidence-based updates, SEMG preserves historical evolution and enables evidence tracing under complex and conflicting scenarios. Building upon this, we introduce an intent-guided multi-round retrieval mechanism that iteratively identifies missing evidence and expands retrieval based on accumulated information. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemConflict demonstrate that \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ improves long-term memory utilization, dynamic and static conflict handling, and complex retrieval performance, achieving relative improvements of more than 12\% in certain categories. These results highlight the effectiveness of jointly modeling memory evolution and adaptive evidence acquisition for long-term agent interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMIR² 用状态演化记忆图 (State-Evolving Memory Graph, SEMG) 把长期记忆表示为随时间事件轨迹更新的知识状态，再以意图引导的多轮检索迭代定位缺失证据。在 LoCoMo 与 MemConflict 上，该框架在部分类别取得超过 12% 的相对提升，改善长期记忆利用、动态与静态冲突处理及复杂检索。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 记忆系统依赖静态记忆表示与单轮检索，无法跟踪事实变化，也难以整合长程交互中分散的证据。
Method: 构建 SEMG：以时间事件轨迹和证据关联支撑记忆的演化知识状态，通过基于证据的更新维护语义状态，保留历史演化并支持冲突场景下的证据追溯；其上叠加意图引导的多轮检索，迭代识别缺失证据并据已累积信息扩展检索范围。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 与 MemConflict 上实验，EMIR² 改善长期记忆利用、动态与静态冲突处理与复杂检索性能，部分类别相对提升超过 12%。
Conclusion: 联合建模记忆演化与自适应证据获取对长期 agent 交互有效，静态记忆加单轮检索不足以应对事实变化与分散证据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建 SEMG：以时间事件轨迹和证据关联支撑记忆的演化知识状态，通过基于证据的更新维护语义状态，保留历史演化并支持冲突场景下的证据追溯；其上叠加意图引导的多轮检索，迭代识别缺失证据并据已累积信息扩展检索范围。
summary_sections.result: 在 LoCoMo 与 MemConflict 上实验，EMIR² 改善长期记忆利用、动态与静态冲突处理与复杂检索性能，部分类别相对提升超过 12%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 联合建模记忆演化与自适应证据获取对长期 agent 交互有效，静态记忆加单轮检索不足以应对事实变化与分散证据。

papers.title: HERO-MoE: Historical Expert Routing with Scale-Preserving Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become a standard way to scale model capacity while keeping computation sparse, yet routing remains a key determinant of MoE quality and training behavior. Prior empirical studies suggest that MoE routing reflects input semantics and upstream computation across depth, but standard routers do not explicitly use the routing distributions produced by preceding layers. We propose HERO-MoE, Historical Expert ROuting with Scale-Preserving Fusion, a routing framework that injects historical routing priors into MoE routers by reusing detached, dense routing distributions collected from preceding MoE layers. The key idea is simple: HERO-MoE preserves the original token-conditioned routing branch and adds a residual historical routing contribution before the standard softmax and top-$k$ dispatch. To stabilize this historical signal, HERO-MoE introduces a scale-preserving fusion mechanism that matches the magnitude of historical routing memory to the current hidden representation and accounts for the number of visible historical layers, without introducing an auxiliary routing loss or a fusion-specific tuning parameter. By reusing routing distributions already computed by preceding MoE layers, HERO-MoE improves training-loss reduction with modest end-to-end overhead. The resulting router remains compatible with standard sparse dispatch, including top-$k$ and group-limited routing, and can be inserted into existing MoE backbones with minimal architectural changes. Experiments on an approximately 8B-parameter MoE model with 0.5B active parameters, trained from scratch on 100B tokens, show that HERO-MoE reduces the final loss from 1.6393 to 1.6184, while peak memory and FLOPs increase by only 0.44\% and 0.64\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERO-MoE 在标准 MoE 路由上加一条历史路由先验分支：复用前面 MoE 层已算出的 dense 路由分布（detach 后），在 softmax 与 top-k 派发前做残差融合，并用 scale-preserving fusion 把历史记忆的量级对齐当前隐表示、同时计入可见历史层数，不引入辅助路由损失或额外融合超参。在约 8B 参数、0.5B 激活、从零训练 100B token 的 MoE 模型上，最终 loss 从 1.6393 降到 1.6184，峰值显存与 FLOPs 仅分别增加 0.44% 和 0.64%。
Motivation: MoE 路由决定模型质量与训练行为，已有研究表明路由反映输入语义与跨层上游计算，但标准 router 不显式利用前序层产生的路由分布，这部分信号被丢弃。
Method: 保留原有 token 条件路由分支，另加一条历史路由残差贡献，融合发生在标准 softmax 与 top-k 派发之前；历史信号来自前序 MoE 层已计算的 dense 路由分布（detached 复用）。scale-preserving fusion 将历史路由记忆的幅值与当前隐表示匹配，并按可见历史层数校正，不使用辅助路由损失、不引入融合专用调参。router 与标准稀疏派发兼容（top-k 与 group-limited routing），可插入现有 MoE backbone，改动极小。
Result: 在约 8B 参数 MoE（0.5B 激活）从零训练 100B token 的实验中，最终训练 loss 由 1.6393 降至 1.6184；峰值内存增加 0.44%，FLOPs 增加 0.64%，端到端开销温和。
Conclusion: 复用前序层已有的路由分布作为历史先验并做尺度保持融合，能在几乎不增加显存与计算的前提下降低 MoE 训练 loss，且无需辅助路由损失或额外超参。

papers.title: DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: A linear projection can reduce the dimension of query and key vectors without updating the pretrained model, but it remains unclear which training objective best preserves model behavior. We ask whether preferences over keys and attention mass on the highest-weighted keys provide a better signal than matching the full attention distribution with KL divergence, especially in long-context settings. We introduce DimPO, which combines listwise preference optimization with a lightweight top-k cross-entropy term for head-fidelity. DimPO is trained offline from the attention patterns of a frozen language model, with one map per layer, shared by the query and the keys and trained separately from the other layers. Across LLaMA3.2-3B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-4B Instruct models, pairwise preference objectives outperform the triplet baseline and retain 98% of the original score on short-context tasks when projecting to half the dimension on the last 40% of the layers. With more projected layers or on long-context RULER, they degrade rapidly. In contrast, KL and DimPO, which use every key during training, retain about 95% of the original RULER 4k score on the 8B model when projecting up to 50% of the layers. KL-based projections remain closer to the original attention distribution and attention output, yet DimPO achieves better downstream performance. Beyond 50% of projected layers, DimPO increasingly outperforms KL on tasks including SQuAD, common-word extraction, frequent-word extraction, and variable tracking. These results suggest that under dimensionality reduction, preserving the ordering and concentration of task-relevant attention can matter more than reproducing the full attention distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DimPO 用 listwise 偏好优化加轻量 top-k 交叉熵项，离线训练从冻结语言模型注意力中学习的线性投影，把 query/key 维度减半而不更新原模型。在 LLaMA3.1-8B 上投影至多 50% 层时保留约 95% 的 RULER 4k 原始分数，超过 50% 层后在 SQuAD、词抽取与 variable tracking 等任务上反超 KL 投影。
Motivation: 线性投影可在不更新预训练模型的前提下降低 query/key 维度，但哪种训练目标最能保持模型行为尚不清楚：匹配完整注意力分布的 KL 是否优于对 key 的偏好与最高权重 key 上的注意力质量信号，尤其在长上下文场景。
Method: DimPO 将 listwise preference optimization 与轻量 top-k 交叉熵项（head-fidelity）结合，离线从冻结语言模型的注意力模式训练；每层一个映射，query 与 key 共享，且各层独立训练。
Result: 在 LLaMA3.2-3B、LLaMA3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B Instruct 上：pairwise 偏好目标超过 triplet 基线，在最后 40% 层投影至一半维度时短上下文任务保留原始分数的 98%；投影层更多或在长上下文 RULER 上则快速退化。KL 与 DimPO 训练时用到全部 key，在 8B 模型上投影至多 50% 层时保留约 95% 的原始 RULER 4k 分数。KL 投影更贴近原始注意力分布与注意力输出，但 DimPO 下游表现更好；超过 50% 投影层后，DimPO 在 SQuAD、common-word extraction、frequent-word extraction、variable tracking 上日益领先 KL。
Conclusion: 维度压缩下，保持任务相关注意力的排序与集中度比复现完整注意力分布更能保住下游性能；KL 更忠实于原分布但不等于更好的下游结果。

papers.title: Groupwise Agentic Grading and Advantage Redistribution for Code Agent RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for code agents often uses executable tests to provide binary rewards. With these rewards, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns identical advantages to test-passing trajectories within each rollout group, overlooking differences in implementation quality and adherence to task requirements. This leaves the policy without a learning signal that favors clean, targeted implementations over those containing unnecessary or out-of-scope changes. We introduce GAGAR, a framework for quality-aware credit redistribution in code agent RL. Built on dynamic sampling that retains groups containing both passing and failing trajectories, GAGAR places all trajectories from each group in a shared workspace, where an SFT-trained agentic grader jointly inspects them and ranks the test-passing candidates. Based on this ranking, we downweight lower-ranked trajectories and proportionally rescale the advantages of all test-passing trajectories to restore their original sum. This sum-preserving redistribution retains the relative weights established by quality-based downweighting while shifting credit toward higher-quality implementations. We evaluate GAGAR at industrial scale using pre-RL SFT checkpoints of MiMo-V2.6-Flash (310B total parameters) and MiMo-V2.6-Pro (1.02T total parameters). Controlled code-only Flash experiments show improved code agent performance, reduced trajectory-length growth, and more stable training. We further apply GAGAR in large-scale mixed-task RL with both Flash and Pro. Our results support combining test-based verification with groupwise agentic grading to improve the quality and stability of code agent RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAGAR 针对代码 agent RL 中二值测试奖励让 GRPO 组内同过轨迹拿相同优势的问题，用 SFT 训练的 agentic grader 在共享工作区里对通过测试的轨迹排序，再按排名下调低质量轨迹并按比例重标优势以保持总和不变。在 MiMo-V2.6-Flash（310B）与 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（1.02T）上的受控纯代码实验与大规模混合任务 RL 中，代码 agent 性能提升、轨迹长度增长受抑、训练更稳定。
Motivation: 可执行测试给出的二值奖励使 GRPO 组内所有通过轨迹共享同一优势，策略学不到偏好干净、贴合需求的实现，也容忍多余或越界的改动。
Method: GAGAR 建立在动态采样之上（只保留同时含通过与失败轨迹的组），把每组轨迹放进共享工作区，由 SFT 训练的 agentic grader 联合检查并对通过候选排序；随后下调低排名轨迹权重，并按比例重标所有通过轨迹的优势以恢复其原始总和，形成 sum-preserving redistribution。
Result: 在工业规模上用 pre-RL SFT checkpoint 的 MiMo-V2.6-Flash（310B 总参数）与 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（1.02T 总参数）评测；受控纯代码 Flash 实验显示代码 agent 性能提升、轨迹长度增长减少、训练更稳定；随后在 Flash 与 Pro 上用于大规模混合任务 RL。
Conclusion: 作者主张把基于测试的验证与组级 agentic 评分结合，可在保持质量加权相对权重的同时把信用转向更高质量实现，从而改善代码 agent RL 的质量与稳定性。

papers.title: CUE-Mem: Benchmarking Long-Term User Memory via Implicit Cues in Multimodal Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents that interact with users across sustained conversations. However, user memories are not always explicitly stated: they may also be implied by recurring background objects in images, ambient sounds in audio, or other peripheral multimodal cues. Existing benchmarks largely focus on text-only memory or explicit multimodal evidence, leaving implicit multimodal cues underexplored. We introduce CUE-Mem, a text-image-audio benchmark for evaluating long-term user memory from implicit cues. CUE-Mem contains 2,674 questions across explicit and implicit evidence settings and covers four tasks: Entity Recall, Long Pattern, Personalized Recommendation, and Answer Refusal. Across textualized memory systems, implicit performance remains far below oracle evidence, locating the main bottleneck in preserving and retrieving subtle cues rather than question answerability. Increasing caption detail recovers more of this evidence, but brings uneven gains and rapidly growing token costs, motivating native multimodal access. Yet native access does not uniformly resolve the bottleneck: evidence use depends strongly on the backbone, while multimodal indexing introduces substantial retrieval noise. CUE-Mem provides a testbed for memory systems that selectively retain, retrieve, and use subtle multimodal evidence.
papers.comment: 28 pages. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Code: https://github.com/yulinlp/CUE-MEM. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kkryptonite/CUE-Mem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CUE-Mem 是一个文本-图像-音频长时用户记忆基准，用 2,674 道题在显式与隐式证据两种设定下考察四类任务（Entity Recall、Long Pattern、Personalized Recommendation、Answer Refusal）。隐式线索上的表现远低于 oracle 证据，瓶颈在保留与检索细微线索而非答题能力；提高 caption 细节能找回部分证据但收益不均且 token 成本快速上升，原生多模态访问也未统一解决瓶颈，效果强依赖 backbone 且多模态索引引入明显检索噪声。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准多限于纯文本记忆或显式多模态证据，图像背景物体、环境音等隐式线索基本未被覆盖，而多模态 agent 正需要跨长对话记住这类用户信息。
Method: 构建 CUE-Mem 文本-图像-音频基准，含 2,674 道题，覆盖显式与隐式证据两种设定与四类任务；在多类 textualized 记忆系统上对比 oracle 证据，并考察提高 caption 细节与原生多模态访问（含多模态索引）两种路线。
Result: 隐式线索上的性能远低于 oracle 证据，定位瓶颈在保留与检索细微线索；提高 caption 细节可找回更多证据但收益不均、token 成本快速增长；原生多模态访问未统一解决瓶颈，证据使用强依赖 backbone，多模态索引引入显著检索噪声。
Conclusion: 长时用户记忆的关键难点是细微隐式线索的保留与检索，而非问题可答性；需要能选择性保留、检索并利用细微多模态证据的记忆系统，单纯加细 caption 或改用原生多模态访问都不足以单独解决。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 长时用户记忆的关键难点是细微隐式线索的保留与检索，而非问题可答性；需要能选择性保留、检索并利用细微多模态证据的记忆系统，单纯加细 caption 或改用原生多模态访问都不足以单独解决。

papers.title: Trapped by Their Own Rollouts: Understanding Aggregation--Rollout Feedback in Federated On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach to language-model adaptation, aligning teacher supervision with the student's own generated trajectories. When adaptation prompts are distributed across clients, can this process benefit from federated collaboration? We study federated OPD and find that substantial collaboration gains can be obscured by learning-rate sensitivity: FedAvg can perform no better than independent local training at a small learning rate, yet recover a clear advantage at a larger rate. We explain this phenomenon through the student's dual role as learner and generator of future training data. An aggregation-induced optimization lag can delay access to useful teacher supervision, which in turn slows subsequent learning. Our theory establishes this aggregation--rollout feedback in a solvable model with a common optimum and stable updates, and identifies two coupled roles of learning rate: learning from current supervision and reaching future supervision. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedTOPS (Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling), which reuses teacher feedback on current trajectories to adapt the FedAvg update magnitude under clientwise predictive-change constraints. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FedTOPS improves macro Avg@8 over FedAvg by 4.56--14.57 percentage points across the evaluated student models and local learning rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦 on-policy 蒸馏 (federated OPD) 中，FedAvg 的聚合优化滞后会推迟学生拿到有用教师监督，从而拖慢后续学习，使小学习率下协作收益被掩盖、甚至不优于本地独立训练。FedTOPS 复用当前轨迹上的教师反馈，按客户端预测变化约束自适应调整 FedAvg 更新幅度，在六个数学推理基准上把 macro Avg@8 相对 FedAvg 提升 4.56–14.57 个百分点。
Motivation: 把适配提示分发到多客户端做 on-policy 蒸馏时，联邦协作的收益可能被学习率敏感性掩盖：小学习率下 FedAvg 不优于本地训练，读者无法判断协作本身是否有价值。
Method: 在具有共同最优解且更新稳定的可解模型中建立 aggregation–rollout feedback 理论，刻画学习率的两个耦合角色（从当前监督学习、够到未来监督）；据此提出 FedTOPS（Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling），复用当前轨迹上的教师反馈，在客户端预测变化约束 (clientwise predictive-change constraints) 下自适应缩放 FedAvg 更新幅度。
Result: 在六个数学推理基准上，FedTOPS 相对 FedAvg 的 macro Avg@8 提升 4.56–14.57 个百分点，覆盖所评测的学生模型与本地学习率；FedAvg 在小学习率下不优于独立本地训练，在较大学习率下恢复明显优势。
Conclusion: 联邦 OPD 的协作收益取决于学习率能否同时服务当前监督与未来监督，聚合滞后是收益被掩盖的机制；按教师反馈自适应调整更新幅度可把这部分收益拿回来。

papers.title: CAESAR: Clustering via Autonomous Embedding-Space Agglomerative Reorganization
papers.abstract_en: Clustering algorithms that operate on nearest-neighbor graphs, such as FINCH (First Integer Neighbor Clustering Hierarchy), depend heavily on the quality of the embedding space they are given. However, pretrained vision and language model embeddings are not optimized for this purpose. We propose CAESAR, a method that reorganizes a pretrained embedding space: a reorganization network is trained to pull mutual nearest neighbors together and push non-neighbors apart, yielding a reorganized embedding space substantially better suited to clustering. CAESAR offers a second major advantage: it never requires the number of clusters $K$. This matters because in realistic unsupervised settings, $K$ is typically unknown and discovering it is often part of the problem, yet most strong clustering methods take it as an input. We therefore design the entire CAESAR pipeline to infer $K$ rather than assume it is known. Empirically, reorganizing the embeddings consistently improves clustering over the raw space on both text and image datasets. Since the few deep clustering methods that also infer $K$ do not release their code, we complement controlled comparisons with methods that infer $K$ on the same embedding space by comparisons with strong deep clustering methods that are given the true $K$, giving them a substantial oracle advantage. Even so, CAESAR outperforms all of them on text, achieves the best results on the most challenging image benchmark and remains competitive on the others. Reorganizing pretrained embeddings thus emerges as a simple and powerful route to clustering realistic data, where classes overlap and the number of clusters is unknown.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAESAR 训练一个重组网络把互相最近邻拉近、非邻居推远，从而把预训练视觉/语言模型的嵌入空间改造成更适合近邻图聚类（如 FINCH）的形式，且整条流水线自动推断簇数 K 而不假设已知。在文本与图像数据集上重组嵌入一致优于原始嵌入：文本上超过所有给定真实 K 的深度聚类基线，在最难的图像 benchmark 上取得最佳，其余图像 benchmark 保持竞争力。
Motivation: FINCH 等基于最近邻图的聚类高度依赖嵌入质量，而预训练视觉/语言模型的嵌入并非为此优化；同时真实无监督场景中簇数 K 通常未知，多数强聚类方法却要求把 K 作为输入。
Method: 训练一个重组网络 (reorganization network)：拉近互相最近邻 (mutual nearest neighbors)、推开非邻居，得到重组后的嵌入空间，再交给近邻图聚类；整条 CAESAR 流水线设计为推断 K 而非假设已知。评测上先与在相同嵌入空间上推断 K 的方法做受控比较，再与被给定真实 K（拥有 oracle 优势）的强深度聚类方法比较。
Result: 在文本与图像数据集上，重组后的嵌入相对原始嵌入一致改善聚类；文本上 CAESAR 超过所有被给定真实 K 的深度聚类方法，在最具挑战性的图像 benchmark 上取得最佳结果，在其余图像 benchmark 上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 重组预训练嵌入是面向类别重叠、簇数未知的真实数据聚类的简单而有效的路径，且无需把 K 当作已知输入。

papers.title: OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents
papers.abstract_en: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at https://omni-smart-home.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniSmartHome 是一个多模态智能家居 agent 基准，把每条口语请求配上视觉与空间音频上下文，用来检验仅靠语言无法消歧的欠定请求。评测 16 个 omnimodal LLM 显示：语音单独足以表达意图时表现强，一旦需要跨模态线索推理，性能大幅下降；提供带视听感知工具与程序性记忆的 agent 基线 PROME，在六个 Omni-LLM 上普遍提升表现。
Motivation: 现有智能家居基准只用语言表达用户请求，而真实场景中用户常靠指向物体、所见所闻等上下文补足语义，导致欠定请求这一类真实交互未被覆盖。
Method: 构建 OmniSmartHome 基准，每条口语请求配对视觉与空间音频 (spatial-audio) 上下文以提供消歧线索；评测 16 个 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs)；并给出 agent 基线 PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering)，为 agent 配备专用视听感知工具与编排这些工具的程序性记忆。
Result: 基准含 1,360 个合成 episodes 与 272 个真实 episodes；16 个 Omni-LLM 在语音单独足以表达意图时表现强，但需跨多模态上下文推理消歧时性能大幅下降；PROME 在六个 Omni-LLM 上普遍提升表现。
Conclusion: 语音 alone 不足以覆盖真实智能家居请求，跨视觉与空间音频上下文的推理是当前 Omni-LLM 的短板，而以工具加程序性记忆编排证据收集的 PROME 可普遍缓解这一短板。

papers.title: Spall Failure of Coral Skeleton beneath Gas-Laden Canopies: An Idealized Blast-Fishing Model
papers.abstract_en: Improvised explosives used for fishing on shallow Indonesian reefs shatter coral skeleton, yet the damage they cause has been described largely through empirical radii and ecological surveys. We formulate an idealized model of how free gas held within a coral canopy modifies the shock loading that such a charge delivers to skeletal plates. The canopy is treated as a relaxed bubbly mixture whose shock impedance follows from the conservation of mass and momentum, and the reef is represented as a layered column of water, canopy, skeletal plate, and canopy struck at normal incidence. Three closed-form results emerge. Above a crossover pressure set by the void fraction and the stiffness of seawater, the canopy becomes nearly transparent to the shock. The impulse transmitted through any lossless layered stack is independent of the canopy, so gas redistributes the pulse in time without changing its total push. A plate carries tension after reflection from its lower face only when the canopy impedance falls below a threshold fixed by the plate thickness and the pulse duration, which defines a critical thickness. For a one-kilogram charge directly overhead, a gas-rich canopy more than triples the standoff at which a twelve-centimeter plate spalls while shortening the standoff at which it is crushed. A prescribed daily cycle of photosynthetic gas makes the same charge markedly more damaging at noon than at night. Bubble dynamics show that the canopy does not reach equilibrium within the pulse, so the results are best read as upper bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对印尼浅水珊瑚礁炸鱼炸药对骨骼的破坏，作者把含自由气的珊瑚冠层当作松弛气泡混合物，与水层、骨骼板组成正入射分层柱，给出三个闭式结果：超过由孔隙率和海水刚度决定的交叉压力后冠层对冲击近乎透明；无损分层堆栈的透射冲量与冠层无关；板在下表面反射后受拉的条件给出临界厚度。对 1 kg 正上方装药，富气冠层使 12 cm 骨骼板发生剥落 (spall) 的距离增至三倍以上、同时缩短被压碎的距离；按日光合作用产气周期，同一装药在正午比夜间破坏性明显更强。
Motivation: 炸鱼对珊瑚礁的破坏此前主要靠经验半径和生态调查描述，缺少解释含气冠层如何改变骨骼板所受冲击载荷的机理模型。
Method: 把冠层处理为松弛气泡混合物，由质量与动量守恒导出冲击阻抗；将礁体表示为水—冠层—骨骼板—冠层的分层柱并取正入射，推导三个闭式结果（交叉压力、与冠层无关的透射冲量、临界厚度），再用气泡动力学检验冠层在脉冲内是否达到平衡。
Result: 1 kg 装药正上方时，富气冠层使 12 cm 板发生剥落的距离增至三倍以上，同时缩短其被压碎的距离；按规定的日光合作用产气周期，同一装药在正午比夜间破坏性明显更强。气泡动力学显示冠层在脉冲内未达平衡，故结果应视为上界。
Conclusion: 含气量通过交叉压力和临界厚度两个阈值决定冲击是透过还是使板受拉剥落，且产气的日周期让正午炸药破坏更强；由于冠层在脉冲内未达平衡，闭式结果是上界而非精确值。

papers.title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

papers.title: Compositional Objectives: Learning Structure in Structure
papers.abstract_en: Intelligence is defined in many ways. One of these definitions defines intelligence as the pursuit of learnable novelty. However, learnable novelty can be meaningless without the ability to compose the learned structures to take action and achieve goals. Learnable novelty builds on epiplexity, which is a way to measure learnable structure in data through a bounded observer. In this paper, we investigate a closed-form spectral approximation to compute epiplexity. We use a fixed-trace constraint and find that the epiplexity objective prefers a more uniform distribution of spectral mass rather than concentrating it in a small number of directions. However, a representation may spread information across many directions without organizing that information into features useful for a particular task. To address this gap, we propose a compositional objective whose observer measures the relationships between the parts and interactions of an image. We compare it with the original spectral objective given only the masked parts. In our ImageNet training runs, the spectral objective with masked parts produces an almost maximally spread representation while achieving the strongest frozen-feature classification performance on most evaluations, more than doubling the linear-probe accuracy of the whole-image baseline. Across multiple image benchmarks, changing what the observer sees matters more than adding relation and interaction tokens. At the same time, our prediction-oriented compositional objective produces substantially better held-out observer prediction but relatively weaker classification, revealing that spectral diversity, predictability, and downstream utility are distinct properties. These results suggest that the usefulness of spectral spreading depends not only on how much structure is preserved, but on which relationships the observer makes available to the objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 epiplexity（用有界 observer 度量数据中可学习结构）化为闭式谱近似，在固定迹约束下发现该目标偏好谱质量均匀铺开而非集中于少数方向；据此提出让 observer 度量图像部件之间关系与交互的 compositional objective。ImageNet 训练中，只给 masked parts 的谱目标在多数评测上冻结特征分类最强，线性探测精度超过整图基线两倍以上；跨多个图像基准，改变 observer 所见比加入 relation/interaction token 更关键，而面向预测的 compositional 目标 held-out observer prediction 明显更好但分类偏弱，说明谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用是三种不同性质。
Motivation: learnable novelty 若不能把学到的结构组合起来行动就可能没有意义；而谱目标只保证信息铺开，不保证这些信息被组织成对特定任务有用的特征。
Method: 先为 epiplexity 求闭式谱近似，在固定迹 (fixed-trace) 约束下分析其对谱质量分布的偏好；再提出 compositional objective，其 observer 度量图像各部件及其关系与交互，并与只给 masked parts 的原始谱目标对照，在 ImageNet 上训练并做冻结特征线性探测与 held-out observer prediction。
Result: ImageNet 训练中，masked-parts 谱目标得到近乎最大铺开的表示，并在多数评测上取得最强冻结特征分类性能，线性探测精度是整图基线的两倍以上；跨多个图像基准，改变 observer 所见比增加 relation/interaction token 影响更大；预测导向的 compositional 目标在 held-out observer prediction 上显著更好，但分类相对较弱。
Conclusion: 谱铺开是否有用不只取决于保留了多少结构，还取决于 objective 让 observer 可见哪些关系；谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用应作为三个独立性质分别衡量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ProTTT: Learning to Learn Semantic User Memory with Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Personalization requires language models to capture user-specific knowledge from a growing user history. Existing context-based approaches incur increasing inference costs as user history accumulates and rely on separate retrieval or summarization stages, while parametric-based approaches often require reconstructing user representations when new user data is added. We introduce ProTTT, a profile-supervised meta-learning framework for learning semantic user memory. The memory construction starts from a shared initialization and is updated for each user through test-time training on user history, allowing it to evolve continuously as the history grows. However, since test-time training alone does not explicitly encourage the memory to capture semantic user knowledge necessary for personalization, we learn this shared initialization using textual user profiles as supervision, so that test-time training on user history captures semantic knowledge more effectively. ProTTT consistently outperforms both full history ICL and all parametric baselines across diverse benchmarks, while substantially reducing inference cost by compressing user history into a lightweight parameterized memory. Our analysis also shows that profile supervision is a reliable objective for learning semantic user knowledge and that the resulting memory can track and retain evolving user preferences, while remaining robust across different history sizes. Overall, we demonstrate the effectiveness of test-time training for personalization and establish ProTTT as a baseline for continuously evolving user memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProTTT 用 profile 监督的元学习初始化共享记忆，再对每个用户的历史做 test-time training 更新参数化用户记忆，使记忆随历史增长连续演化。它在多个基准上一致优于全历史 ICL 与全部参数化基线，同时把用户历史压缩成轻量参数记忆、显著降低推理开销。
Motivation: 基于上下文的个性化随用户历史累积使推理成本不断上升，且依赖额外的检索或摘要阶段；基于参数的方法在新增用户数据时往往要重建用户表示。
Method: 提出 profile-supervised 元学习框架 ProTTT：记忆从共享初始化出发，对每个用户在其历史上做 test-time training 更新；共享初始化用文本用户 profile 作为监督信号学习，使 TTT 更有效地捕获个性化所需的语义用户知识。
Result: 在多个多样基准上一致优于全历史 ICL 与所有参数化基线，并通过把用户历史压缩为轻量参数化记忆显著降低推理成本；分析显示 profile 监督是学习语义用户知识的可靠目标，所得记忆能跟踪并保留演化中的用户偏好，且在不同历史长度下保持稳健。
Conclusion: test-time training 配合 profile 监督的共享初始化可作为持续演化用户记忆的有效基线，兼顾个性化质量、历史增长下的连续更新与推理效率。

papers.title: Artificial intelligences and human scientists exhibit complementary strengths in theory building
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the effectiveness of artificial intelligences (AI)-specifically large language models (LLMs)-relative to human scientists at high-level cognitive tasks in social science such as theory formulation, predictions of novel empirical results, and theory revision in response to new evidence. The research domain was academic discourse regarding gender and race inequality. Our findings, comparing 25 LLMs with 13 senior researchers and 60 doctoral scholars, reveal that the AIs outperformed most humans individually on most of the present tasks, while human theories were more diverse and exhibited greater gains in predictive accuracy from aggregation. AI-generated theories were more extensively elaborated, involving additional theoretical paths and latent variables, and were rated as higher quality than human theories by independent raters blinded to source. However, this theoretical complexity was in part ornamental, in that it was not associated with more accurate predictions about empirical patterns in data; in contrast, human scientists achieved greater predictive efficiency with simpler theories. The AIs were significantly more likely than human scientists to revise their theories to incorporate new evidence; human scientists updated their beliefs in a selective way that is sensitive to prior prediction errors. We speculate that the superior processing capacity of artificial intelligences makes them especially well-suited to tasks requiring grappling with complexity, but that the greater diversity of human ideas is essential to wise crowds and collective creativity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在性别与种族不平等的社会科学理论构建任务中，25 个 LLM 整体优于 13 位资深研究者与 60 位博士学者的个体表现，但人类理论更多样、聚合后预测精度提升更大。AI 理论更复杂且被盲评打分为更高质量，但这种复杂性部分是装饰性的——并不带来更准的预测；人类用更简单的理论取得更高的预测效率。
Motivation: LLM 在高阶认知任务上是否能替代人类科学家尚缺系统对照：理论提出、对新实证结果的预测、以及面对新证据的理论修订，这三类任务此前没有把 AI 与不同资历人类放在同一框架下比较。
Method: 在性别与种族不平等的学术话语领域，让 25 个 LLM 与 13 位资深研究者、60 位博士学者完成理论构建、预测新实证结果与依据新证据修订理论三类任务；理论质量由不知来源的独立评分者盲评，预测准确性与聚合增益另行度量。
Result: AI 在多数任务上超过大多数个体人类；人类理论更多样且聚合带来的预测精度增益更大；AI 理论含更多理论路径与潜变量、被盲评者评为质量更高，但该复杂性与预测准确性不相关，人类以更简单理论实现更高的预测效率；AI 显著更倾向为纳入新证据而修订理论，人类则按先前预测误差选择性更新信念。
Conclusion: 处理能力优势使 AI 适合应对复杂性，而人类想法的多样性对 wise crowd 与集体创造力不可或缺；两者互补而非替代。

papers.title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CFCH 用粗-细双分支协同的层次化学习框架，把角膜、结膜、晶状体等解剖区域与疾病语义的结构依赖显式建模，替代把眼前节疾病当作平坦多类分类的做法。配套构建 AS-9K 数据集（8975 张图像、12 类常见疾病），据称是最大的公开眼前节图像分类数据集；在两个眼前节数据集上超过现有最优方法，可视化显示激活更聚焦于病灶。
Motivation: 裂隙灯图像受成像条件差异大与眼病固有的解剖-疾病层级结构双重影响，现有方法把该任务压成平坦多类分类，丢掉了区域与病灶表现之间的结构化依赖。
Method: CFCH 采用双分支架构分别建模解剖上下文与疾病语义，通过语义一致性约束与跨粒度注意力一致性约束 (semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints) 促成两分支对齐而互补的特征学习；同时构建 AS-9K 数据集（8975 张图像、12 类）。
Result: 在两个眼前节数据集上的实验中 CFCH 优于 state-of-the-art 方法；定性可视化显示更聚焦、与病灶相关的激活响应。AS-9K 含 8975 张图像、覆盖 12 类常见疾病，据称是最大的公开眼前节图像分类数据集。
Conclusion: 把眼前节疾病分类按解剖-疾病层级做粗细分支协同，比平坦多类分类更有效；代码将在 github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH 公开。

papers.title: Language as an Independent Information Layer: A Conceptual Model of Communication, Cognition and Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Based on an analysis of the role of language in thought and communication, this article proposes a new concept for designing corporate knowledge bases. The concept integrates the probabilistic vector space of a corporate vocabulary, reflect-ing industry specifics, subject focus, terminology, and culture, with traditional ontological modeling. This combination enables the efficient extraction of knowledge from accumulated corporate documents while strictly accounting for specific business processes. Consequently, this concept bridges statistical and semantic (cause-and-effect) methodologies. Furthermore, analyzing the projec-tions of probabilistic spaces and causal relationships can help identify bottlenecks in business logic. As a dynamic system, language functions as a separate, inde-pendent layer within the overall information architecture. Introducing a dynamic component into the probabilistic space of word distribution allows it to be mod-eled as a multidimensional solution space for various problem formulations. In this context, input data defining the problem conditions serve as control parame-ters for dynamic transformations.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication in the proceedigns of ISBM 2026 (Springer LNNS)

TL;DR: 提出把企业词汇的概率向量空间与传统本体建模结合的企业知识库设计概念：语言作为信息架构中独立的动态层，词分布概率空间被建成多维解空间，问题输入作为控制参数驱动动态变换。该组合用于从企业文档中高效抽取知识并同时保留业务流程的因果约束，投影概率空间与因果关系可定位业务逻辑瓶颈。
Motivation: 纯统计方法缺少业务流程的因果语义，纯本体建模又难以吸收企业文档中积累的术语与文化等隐性知识，两者割裂导致知识抽取既不高效也不贴合具体业务。
Method: 以企业词汇的概率向量空间（反映行业特性、主题、术语与文化）叠加传统本体建模，桥接统计方法与语义（因果）方法；把语言建模为动态系统，引入词分布概率空间的动态分量，将问题条件的输入数据作为控制参数做多维解空间上的动态变换。
Result: 给出一个企业知识库设计概念：概率空间与因果关系的投影可用于识别业务逻辑瓶颈；语言作为独立动态层进入整体信息架构，词分布概率空间可按不同问题形式化建为多维解空间。
Conclusion: 把语言当作独立信息层、让统计表示与本体因果建模共存，是企业知识库设计中同时处理知识抽取效率与业务流程约束的可行路径。

papers.title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 DCE-MRI 乳腺癌分类中 4D 高维输入、小病灶与跨中心采集协议差异，提出动态分析潜表示的框架：抑制背景摄取混淆、补偿软组织形变错位、跨相位挑选最具信息量的时间特征，并用大规模监督病灶分割预训练促进判别特征。在 ODELIA 留一中心验证与 held-out AMBL 队列上，较最强基线 mean AUROC 提升近 8 点、balanced accuracy 提升 4 点，并获 MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025 第一名。
Motivation: DCE-MRI 的 4D 高维输入、小病灶与各临床中心异质采集协议，使健康/良性/恶性三分类难以鲁棒自动化。
Method: 框架动态分析潜表示以适配协议特性：空间上降低混淆性背景摄取并补偿可变形软组织造成的错位；时间上利用跨相位潜空间关系挑选信息量最大的时间特征；再以大规模监督病灶分割预训练促进任务判别特征，随后下游微调。
Result: 在 ODELIA 数据集留一中心 (leave-one-center-out) 验证与 held-out AMBL 队列上，mean AUROC 较最强基线提高近 8 点，balanced accuracy 提高 4 点，明显优于微调的放射学 foundation models 与既有方法；在 MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025 获得第一名。
Conclusion: 按协议自适应地处理空间混淆与时间变异、并配合大规模病灶分割预训练，可显著提升跨中心 DCE-MRI 乳腺癌分类的鲁棒性；代码已在 CURIAtor 开源。

papers.title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TRACE：把人体动作、物体轨迹与旋转、手部关节三条流分别编码到独立 latent，再用耦合的流速度预测让每条流都基于完整交互状态更新，并在解码后的运动上加几何损失直接约束接触与物体相对运动。在 InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE 上，联合补全训练提升生成效果，冻结的 flow 特征喂给语言模型优于原始运动编码，TRACE 在 InterAct 上取得对比方法中最高的 contact precision、recall 与 F1。
Motivation: 文本条件的 HOI 生成要求身体、物体、手三流在接触、相对位姿与时序上一致，但共享表示会压掉各流的独立结构，独立生成又让各流无法响应彼此变化，且仅靠 latent 监督在解码后不直接约束接触。
Method: TRACE 是连续 latent 框架：把 body、object、hand 运动分别编码进独立 latent，每条流的速度由当前完整交互状态预测；解码后的运动上施加几何损失约束接触与物体相对运动；同一模型支持从任意两条流补全缺失的第三条流，并把冻结的 flow 特征作为语言模型输入做 HOI 理解。
Result: 在 InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE 上，联合补全训练 (joint completion training) 改善生成；冻结 flow 特征在 HOI 理解上优于原始运动编码；在 InterAct 上 TRACE 的 contact precision、recall、F1 在对比方法中最高。
Conclusion: 保持流状态分离同时耦合其更新、并用解码后几何损失约束接触，能让三流 HOI 生成在接触与相对运动上更一致，且同一套 latent 既能补全缺失流又能支撑理解任务。

papers.title: Are Vision-Language-Action Models Robust to One-Step Observation Perturbations?
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the safety risks of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for their deployment in the physical world. Existing safety research has mainly considered persistent perturbations that are applied continuously to observations throughout an episode. However, momentary observation corruption, in which observations are severely perturbed only briefly within an episode, remains an underexplored safety threat. To address this gap, this work investigates robustness to one-step perturbations applied at a single time step per episode. Our experiments reveal that these perturbations substantially degrade VLA performance and that their impact depends on the action chunk execution length. Based on them, we propose CARE, which dynamically selects the execution length based on consistency with the previously predicted action chunk. CARE improves robustness with low computational overhead while preserving clean performance by selecting shorter execution lengths only under perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA 模型对单步瞬时观测扰动（每 episode 仅一个时间步被严重污染）并不鲁棒，性能显著下降，且下降幅度取决于动作块执行长度 (action chunk execution length)。据此提出 CARE：按当前预测与上一动作块的一致性动态选择执行长度，仅在检测到扰动时缩短执行长度，从而以低计算开销提升鲁棒性并保持干净性能。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 安全研究集中在贯穿整个 episode 的持续性扰动，而只在 episode 内短暂出现的瞬时观测损坏几乎未被考察，但这类扰动同样会显著拉低 VLA 的任务表现。
Method: 先做实验考察每 episode 单个时间步施加的一步扰动如何影响 VLA，发现影响随动作块执行长度变化；再提出 CARE，依据当前预测动作块与上一动作块的一致性动态决定执行长度，仅在扰动下采用更短的执行长度。
Result: 一步扰动会显著降低 VLA 性能，且影响程度取决于动作块执行长度；CARE 在提升鲁棒性的同时计算开销低，并在干净观测下保持原有性能。
Conclusion: 瞬时单步观测损坏是 VLA 部署中不可忽视的安全威胁，而按动作块一致性动态调节执行长度可以在不牺牲干净性能的前提下缓解它。

papers.title: Prioritizing Repeated LLM Evaluation for Hidden Failure Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are commonly evaluated by generating a small number of stochastic responses for each prompt in a benchmark. Because inference budgets are limited, this shallow evaluation may fail to observe low-probability but operationally important failures. A prompt that produces no failures in a small sample may therefore appear reliable despite having a nonzero latent probability of failure under repeated inference. We formulate LLM reliability evaluation as a budget-constrained discovery problem in which each prompt is associated with an unknown per-generation failure probability. We propose a budgeted discovery framework that first performs shallow evaluation across the prompt set and then uses trial-level failure outcomes together with prompt-derived representations to learn a feature-based ranking of failure propensity. The resulting scores prioritize prompts with zero observed shallow failures for deeper evaluation, concentrating the deep-evaluation budget where hidden failures are more likely to be discovered. We evaluate this approach on AIRBench and StrongREJECT across multiple model and system-prompt conditions. The central empirical test asks whether models fit without access to deep-evaluation outcomes can rank prompts with zero observed shallow failures according to their likelihood of producing failures under deeper evaluation. On AIRBench, the highest-ranked 10\% of unresolved prompts achieves 2.54x hidden-failure lift for Qwen 2.5 7B and 1.87x for Gemma 3n E4B, recovering 25.4\% and 18.7\% of subsequently observed hidden failures, respectively, compared with 10\% expected under random allocation. Semantic-neighborhood and feature-ablation analyses further show that this predictive signal can be recovered from multiple representations of prompt content and relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 可靠性评测改写成预算受限的隐藏故障发现问题：先对全部 prompt 做浅层多次采样，再用 trial 级故障结果与 prompt 表征学出故障倾向排序，把深评预算集中到浅层零故障的 prompt 上。在 AIRBench 上，排序最高的 10% 未决 prompt 对 Qwen 2.5 7B 达到 2.54 倍隐藏故障提升、对 Gemma 3n E4B 为 1.87 倍，分别回收 25.4% 与 18.7% 的后续隐藏故障，而随机分配期望为 10%。
Motivation: 推理预算有限时每个 prompt 只采样少量随机响应，低概率但运营上重要的故障可能完全观察不到，浅层零故障的 prompt 会被误判为可靠，尽管其潜在故障概率非零。
Method: 提出 budgeted discovery 框架：先在整个 prompt 集上做浅层评测，再用 trial 级故障结果加上 prompt 派生表征训练基于特征的故障倾向排序模型，对浅层零故障的 prompt 打分以决定深评顺序；并做语义邻域与特征消融分析检验预测信号来源。

papers.title: Shared Autoregressive Context Can Distort Relationships in Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate several records within one autoregressive completion, making earlier answers available as context for later records. This paper shows that such shared-completion batching can distort relationships among variables in the resulting synthetic data, using controlled tests on synthetic survey respondents. In a matched experiment on 2,000 European Social Survey profiles, generating ten rather than one respondent per request increases mean absolute error in within-country correlations by 48-58% for Qwen3.8-27B and 114-127% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across three seeds, holding profiles, examples, questions and decoding parameters fixed. The distortion primarily reflects exaggerated relationship strength, while retaining substantial agreement with the human ordering of correlations. Controlled interventions establish answer history as a causal channel: re-pairing the same preceding values, with profiles and marginal distributions fixed, changes correlations among subsequently generated responses. Hiding preceding answers reduces correlation error in the tested settings but worsens marginal accuracy. Exploratory corrections across social-attitude, health and economic data likewise show that lower correlation error can coexist with worse marginal distributions and regression estimates. Request construction is therefore part of the data-generating process, and synthetic-data validity must be evaluated against the analyses the generated data are intended to support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 在一次自回归补全里批量生成多条记录时，先前答案会成为后续记录的上下文，从而系统性放大变量间相关强度。在 2,000 份 European Social Survey 档案的配对实验中，每次请求生成 10 位而非 1 位受访者，使国家内相关的平均绝对误差对 Qwen3.8-27B 上升 48-58%、对 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 上升 114-127%；隐藏前序答案能降低相关误差但损害边缘分布精度。
Motivation: LLM 批量生成合成数据时请求构造方式被当作纯工程细节，但它实际进入数据生成过程，会扭曲变量关系，进而影响下游回归等分析的效度。
Method: 在 2,000 份 European Social Survey 受访者档案上做配对对照，固定档案、示例、问题与解码参数，只改变每次请求生成的记录数（10 vs 1），跨 3 个随机种子；再用受控干预重排前序取值（固定档案与边缘分布）确立 answer history 的因果通道，并测试隐藏前序答案与若干探索性校正。
Result: 每次请求生成 10 条使国家内相关 MAE 上升 48-58%（Qwen3.8-27B）与 114-127%（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct），跨 3 seeds；失真主要表现为关系强度被夸大，但与人类相关排序仍保持较大一致。重排相同前序取值即改变后续回答间的相关；隐藏前序答案在所测设置下降低相关误差却恶化边缘精度；在社会态度、健康与经济数据上的探索性校正显示，更低的相关误差可与更差的边缘分布和回归估计并存。
Conclusion: 请求构造是数据生成过程的一部分，合成数据效度必须针对其预定下游分析来评估，而不能只看边缘分布；降低相关误差与保持边缘/回归精度在所测设置下存在权衡。

papers.title: Porimon: An LLM-Based Pokémon Battle Agent Enhanced by Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we use Pokémon Battles as a case study to investigate how to improve the performance of LLM-based agents in tasks that require opponent-aware planning without additional fine-tuning. We propose Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation (LSTKAG), a mechanism that enables LLM-based agents to leverage past states of the current task and retrieve experience summaries from similar previous task instances based on the current state. Based on LSTKAG, we design Porimon, an LLM-based agent structure for Pokémon Battles. For optimization, we introduce an external API for precise damage calculation and more detailed information about the game. We conduct tournament-like evaluation experiments comprising 15,000 battles for hyperparameter optimization, ablation studies, and performance evaluation. The results indicate that Porimon-based players with hyperparameter optimization significantly outperform players based on PokéLLMon, an LLM-based agent structure proposed in previous research, and the rule-based heuristic player. Furthermore, our ablation study shows that Porimon variants outperform the one without extension in game information retrieval, which shows the contribution of that extension. However, the current experiment results are inconclusive regarding the contribution of Long-Term KAG. These results suggest that introducing external resources, information from previous states of the current task, and experience summaries from similar previous task instances could elevate the performance of LLM-based agents designed for tasks requiring opponent-aware planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LSTKAG（Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation）机制与基于它的宝可梦对战 agent Porimon，让 LLM 在不微调的前提下利用当前任务的历史状态并检索相似旧任务的经验摘要，另接外部 API 做精确伤害计算。15,000 场对战的锦标赛式评测中，超参调优后的 Porimon 显著优于 PokéLLMon 与规则启发式玩家，消融显示游戏信息检索扩展有贡献，但 Long-Term KAG 的贡献尚无定论。
Motivation: 需要对手感知规划 (opponent-aware planning) 的任务中，LLM agent 在不做额外微调时难以利用历史状态与相似任务经验，性能受限。
Method: LSTKAG 机制让 agent 依据当前状态取用当前任务的历史状态并从相似旧任务实例检索经验摘要；在此之上构建 Porimon 对战结构，并引入外部 API 承担精确伤害计算与更细的游戏信息；通过锦标赛式实验做超参优化与消融。
Result: 锦标赛式评测共 15,000 场对战，用于超参优化、消融与性能评估；超参调优后的 Porimon 显著优于基于 PokéLLMon 的玩家与规则启发式玩家；消融中带游戏信息检索扩展的 Porimon 变体优于不带扩展的版本；Long-Term KAG 的贡献在当前实验结果下尚无定论 (inconclusive)。
Conclusion: 外部资源、当前任务历史状态与相似任务经验摘要的组合可提升对手感知规划类 LLM agent 的表现，其中信息检索扩展已被消融支持，而 Long-Term KAG 的作用仍待确认。
