papers.title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashForward 直接复用每个去噪阶段已在计算的 in-flight KV cache，替代此前为重建干净缓存而额外做的 forward，从而让不同 chunk 并发占用不同阶段；再配合稀疏 clean anchor latents 做双向条件化，抑制 stage-matched 历史噪声带来的外观与运动漂移。最多 4 卡下，20 秒以上 16 FPS 视频在 1.3B 与 14B backbone、480p/720p 上比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69×、比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92×。
Motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散为记住已生成 chunk，需额外 forward 重建干净或低噪 KV cache，却不推进输出 latent，开销重；而直接用 stage-matched 历史又因带噪导致 chunk 间外观与运动漂移。
Method: FlashForward 复用当前 chunk 每个去噪阶段已算出的 in-flight KV cache 作为下一 chunk 的历史，每阶段分配一张 GPU 使不同 chunk 并发；同时在对应区域生成前产出稀疏 auxiliary clean anchor latents，形成双侧条件化：稀疏 clean anchor KV 提供粗粒度长程结构引导，稠密 stage-matched history 保留细粒度近期演化。
Result: 最多 4 GPU 下，对 20 秒及以上的 16 FPS 视频，1.3B 与 14B backbone、480p 与 720p 上比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69×，比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92×。VBench 上 1.3B 模型 480p 取得更高分数，且在 20s、35s、65s 时长上保持稳定。
Conclusion: 直接复用 in-flight KV 并用稀疏 clean anchor 补足双向条件，可以在更长时长下同时保住视频质量、时序一致性与生成速度。

papers.title: Interpretable Physics Informed WiFi Indoor Localization: Learning an Effective Access Point Geometry and Using It to Prune
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models can achieve high accuracy for indoor localization, but their black-box nature limits interpretability and the reuse of learned information. We propose a hierarchical deep learning framework for WiFi fingerprint-based indoor localization that jointly predicts user location and learns an effective geometry of the surrounding access points (APs). Physics-informed decoders infer this geometry directly from RSSI measurements and labelled user positions, without requiring the true AP coordinates during training. The learned geometry is then used to rank and prune APs. On the UJIIndoorLoc dataset, the proposed chained model achieves a mean 3D localization error of 7.07 m, reducing error by 26% to 36% compared with baseline models. Previously published methods evaluated on the same official split report errors 10.6% to 31.0% higher. Pruning 35% or 50% of the APs causes only a small loss in localization accuracy. The inferred geometry also enables Fisher-information-based AP ranking even when fingerprint databases do not contain surveyed AP coordinates. Experiments on the Tampere/TUT and UTSIndoorLoc datasets show that geometry-guided AP selection performs comparably to selectors built directly from labelled data. These results show that physics-informed interpretability can improve indoor localization while also supporting effective feature selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层深度学习框架，用 physics-informed decoder 从 RSSI 与标注位置直接推断接入点 (AP) 的有效几何，再据此排序并剪枝 AP。在 UJIIndoorLoc 上 chained 模型平均 3D 定位误差 7.07 m，比基线降低 26%–36%；剪掉 35% 或 50% 的 AP 只造成很小的精度损失。
Motivation: WiFi 指纹室内定位的深度模型精度高但黑箱，学到的信息难以复用；同时指纹库常不含 AP 的实测坐标，无法直接做基于几何的特征选择。
Method: 分层框架联合预测用户位置并学习周边 AP 的有效几何：physics-informed decoder 仅凭 RSSI 测量与标注用户位置推断几何，训练不需要真实 AP 坐标；随后用学到的几何对 AP 排序并剪枝，并支持基于 Fisher 信息的 AP 排序。
Result: UJIIndoorLoc 官方划分上 chained 模型平均 3D 误差 7.07 m，较基线降低 26%–36%；同划分下已发表方法的误差高出 10.6%–31.0%；剪枝 35% 或 50% 的 AP 仅小幅损失精度。在 Tampere/TUT 与 UTSIndoorLoc 上，几何引导的 AP 选择与直接用标注数据构建的选择器表现相当。
Conclusion: physics-informed 可解释性既能提升 WiFi 定位精度，也能在指纹库缺少 AP 坐标时支撑有效的特征（AP）选择。

summary_sections.result: UJIIndoorLoc 官方划分上 chained 模型平均 3D 误差 7.07 m，较基线降低 26%–36%；同划分下已发表方法的误差高出 10.6%–31.0%；剪枝 35% 或 50% 的 AP 仅小幅损失精度。在 Tampere/TUT 与 UTSIndoorLoc 上，几何引导的 AP 选择与直接用标注数据构建的选择器表现相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: physics-informed 可解释性既能提升 WiFi 定位精度，也能在指纹库缺少 AP 坐标时支撑有效的特征（AP）选择。

papers.title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
papers.abstract_en: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIPE-MambaSpike 用固定通道宽度的层级多分辨率桥替换事件视觉 Spiking-Mamba 混合模型中随分辨率增长的投影层，使部署参数量在 43 倍输入面积范围内保持 0.870M 恒定。在 DailyDVS-200 上 8.04M 配置取得 45.7% top-1，为该基准最佳 spiking 结果，且比稠密 ANN 少 3.0–15.1 倍参数。

Method: 以固定通道宽度的层级多分辨率桥 (hierarchical multi-resolution bridge) 取代该投影，配合 reparameterized spiking stages、temporal decoupled modulation 与 dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention，在紧凑设计下保持精度；在 CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200 上比较。

papers.title: Do Audio LLMs Listen Before They Act? Diagnosing Acoustic-Context Gating in Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: Audio language models can recognize spoken commands and invoke tools, but an agent must first decide whether the acoustic and conversational context warrants action. We introduce VGBench, a 1,018-item diagnostic benchmark for action-level addressedness across side-talk, self-talk, and speaker-switch scenarios. Each item uses a shared action space comprising silence, a tool call, and a natural-language answer. Speaker-switch pairs hold the specified words fixed while source, distance rendering, and a temporal boundary define a controlled wearer-to-bystander shift. Six raw Audio LLMs and three training-free adaptations often identify the target tool yet rarely withhold action under this shift; the highest raw switch mute rate is 14%. We then use VoxGate as a post-training case study. Supervised training mutes 91.3% of switched commands while choosing the correct tool for all nearby wearer commands and text-only controls. An exploratory GRPO stage has similar switch performance; side-talk accuracy rises from 68.4% to 70.9%, and self-talk muting from 52.0% to 60.0%. Factorized controls identify an independent source-change effect, while sensitivity to the far-field manipulation varies across acoustic renderings. The benchmark therefore measures multi-cue acoustic-context gating rather than isolated speaker identity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VGBench：1,018 条动作级 addressedness 诊断集，覆盖 side-talk、self-talk、speaker-switch 三类场景，动作空间固定为静默、工具调用、自然语言回答。六个原始 Audio LLM 与三种 training-free 改造常能选对工具却在说话人切换时几乎不静默（最高 switch mute rate 仅 14%）；后训练方法 VoxGate 用监督训练把切换指令静默率提到 91.3%，GRPO 阶段再把 side-talk 准确率从 68.4% 提到 70.9%、self-talk 静默率从 52.0% 提到 60.0%。
Motivation: 语音 agent 能识别口令并调用工具，却缺少在声学与对话上下文不支持行动时按兵不动的判据：说话人切换、旁人插话、自言自语都会触发误动作，现有评测不度量这一动作级 addressedness。
Method: VGBench 用共享动作空间（静默/工具调用/自然语言回答）构造 side-talk、self-talk、speaker-switch 三类条目；speaker-switch 对在固定词句下改变声源、距离渲染与时间边界，形成受控的 wearer→bystander 转移。评测六个原始 Audio LLM 与三种 training-free 改造，再以 VoxGate 作后训练案例：监督训练加一个探索性 GRPO 阶段，并用因子化控制 (factorized controls) 分离声源变化与远场渲染两个因素。
Result: 原始模型与 training-free 改造常选对目标工具但切换时极少静默，最高 raw switch mute rate 14%。VoxGate 监督训练使切换指令静默率达 91.3%，同时对全部近处 wearer 指令与 text-only 对照仍选对工具；GRPO 阶段 switch 表现相当，side-talk 准确率 68.4%→70.9%，self-talk 静默率 52.0%→60.0%。因子化控制显示独立的声源变化效应，远场操纵的敏感度随声学渲染而变。
Conclusion: 该基准度量的是多线索声学上下文门控 (multi-cue acoustic-context gating) 而非孤立的说话人身份；后训练监督信号足以让 agent 在上下文不支持时静默，但 side-talk 与 self-talk 仍只到 70.9% 与 60.0%。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
papers.abstract_en: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DepthBench 是一个受控基准：固定模型规模与预训练配方，把宽深比 d_model/n_layer 从浅宽扫到深窄，测架构能否把新增深度转成有效计算深度。在 10 个代表性架构上，标准 Pre-LN 及其多数归一化/缩放变体在更深更窄时几乎无收益甚至变差，而 HC 与 Full AttnRes 在极端深窄形状下仍持续改善，且收益从预训练损失延伸到领域性能。
Motivation: 加深 Transformer 时深层贡献会衰减，而 LayerNorm Scaling、mHC、AttnRes 等改进声称提升深度利用，却不清楚它们是否真把架构深度转成有效计算深度，还是收益来自未控制的混杂因素。
Method: 提出受控基准 DepthBench：固定模型大小与预训练 recipe，系统扫描宽深比 d_model/n_layer（浅宽到深窄），覆盖 10 个代表性架构；并做受控的 layer-level 分析，区分跨深度的信息访问与混杂因素。
Result: 在 10 个代表性架构上，把容量更多分给深度的收益强烈依赖架构：标准 Pre-LN 及多数 norm/scaling 变体收益很小、在更深更窄时甚至性能下降；HC 与 Full AttnRes 即在极端深窄形状下也持续改善。收益不止于预训练损失，还一致转化为领域特定性能与有效计算的提升；layer-level 分析显示 HC 与 Full AttnRes 的增益与更有效地利用新增层相关。
Conclusion: 残差连接设计是深度能否成为有意义的 scaling 轴的关键决定因素：只有让新增架构深度转成有效计算的残差结构（如 HC、Full AttnRes）才值得在深窄方向扩容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLMAdBench: A Human Preference Benchmark for Advertising in LLM Responses
papers.abstract_en: Inserting advertisements (ads) into consumer-facing LLM output is emerging as a new business model, but there is little shared evidence on how such ad insertion should be evaluated or how it affects user preferences. We introduce LLMAdBench, a human-preference benchmark for studying advertising in LLM-generated content. The benchmark isolates a simple but practically important decision: given a user conversation, an LLM response, and a matched advertisement, where should the ad be placed? Our dataset compares pairs of responses that differ only in ad position while holding all other conditions fixed including the user query, base answer, advertisement, and disclosure condition. Human annotators evaluate each pair based on six criteria from both advertiser's and user's perspectives. The resulting benchmark contains more than 18000 human judgments across two disclosure conditions: explicitly labeling the ad as sponsored and merging it into the response without disclosure. We use LLMAdBench to evaluate eight frontier LLMs as preference judges and find that they are not reliable substitutes for human evaluation. Even the most stable models reverse roughly one quarter of their decisions when the presentation order is swapped, agreement across models is low, and their placement preferences differ systematically from those of human annotators. Moreover, LLMAdBench contains substantial learnable signal. In particular, a Qwen3-8B model fine-tuned on the human preferences improves substantially over its base model and outperforms all zero-shot frontier judges on the held-out prediction task. Beyond model evaluation, LLMAdBench provides quantitative evidence on the advertiser-user trade-off and shows that the sponsorship disclosure systematically changes users' preference over ad placement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLMAdBench 是一个针对 LLM 回答中广告插入位置的人类偏好基准：固定用户查询、基础回答、广告与披露条件，只改变广告位置，收集超过 18000 条人类判断。用它评测八个前沿 LLM 作为偏好评判器，发现它们不能可靠替代人类——最稳定的模型在交换呈现顺序后也会翻转约四分之一的判断；而 Qwen3-8B 在人类偏好上微调后大幅超过基座模型并胜过全部零样本前沿评判器。
Motivation: 把广告插入消费级 LLM 输出正成为新商业模式，但缺少关于广告应如何评估、以及如何影响用户偏好的共享证据，尤其是广告位置这一决策。
Method: 构建成对比较数据集：每对回答仅广告位置不同，其余（用户查询、基础回答、广告、披露条件）全部固定；人类标注者按来自广告主与用户双视角的六项标准评估，覆盖显式标注 sponsored 与无披露合并两种披露条件；随后用该基准评测八个前沿 LLM 作为偏好评判器，并在留出预测任务上微调 Qwen3-8B。
Result: 基准包含超过 18000 条人类判断，横跨两种披露条件；八个前沿 LLM 评判器中即使最稳定的模型在交换呈现顺序后也翻转约四分之一判断，模型间一致性低，且其位置偏好与人类标注者系统性不同；Qwen3-8B 在人类偏好上微调后显著优于其基座模型，并在留出预测任务上超过所有零样本前沿评判器；基准还给出广告主-用户权衡的定量证据，并显示赞助披露会系统性改变用户对广告位置的偏好。
Conclusion: LLM 评判器目前不能替代人类评估广告插入位置，而在人类偏好上微调的小模型更可靠；赞助披露本身会系统性改变用户对广告位置的偏好，评估广告插入时必须把披露条件作为变量控制。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 基准包含超过 18000 条人类判断，横跨两种披露条件；八个前沿 LLM 评判器中即使最稳定的模型在交换呈现顺序后也翻转约四分之一判断，模型间一致性低，且其位置偏好与人类标注者系统性不同；Qwen3-8B 在人类偏好上微调后显著优于其基座模型，并在留出预测任务上超过所有零样本前沿评判器；基准还给出广告主-用户权衡的定量证据，并显示赞助披露会系统性改变用户对广告位置的偏好。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLM 评判器目前不能替代人类评估广告插入位置，而在人类偏好上微调的小模型更可靠；赞助披露本身会系统性改变用户对广告位置的偏好，评估广告插入时必须把披露条件作为变量控制。

papers.title: What Does a ProcGen Generalization Gap Measure? Action Rules, Convergence, and the Missing Random Floor
papers.abstract_en: A generalization gap in reinforcement learning (return on training levels minus return on held-out levels) is usually reported without a reference point. We argue that the missing reference is a measured random floor: the return of a uniform-random policy on the same levels under the same harness. On ProcGen, the floor changes what several standard numbers mean. On identical checkpoints and levels across eight environments, switching between sampled and greedy (argmax) test-time actions moves held-out return in both directions, and greedy evaluation takes three environments to or below the floor: in miner, the sampled policy scores 4.9x the floor on held-out levels while its argmax scores below it. Raw policy entropy places seven of eight environments short of convergence, but 35-65% of that entropy is spread across actions with identical effects; after merging them, one to three remain short, and against the floor only heist has learned nothing that transfers. An audit of twelve prior ProcGen codebases finds that all eleven with held-out evaluation sample test-time actions for their policy-gradient agents, nine by default rather than explicit choice, and six report running in-loop averages rather than evaluating a fixed checkpoint. Applied to our own case study, the same checks grade down a statistically significant encoder effect and rule out a within-encoder train-vs-test CKA statistic. We recommend that every reported gap state its action rule, use a matched and seeded protocol, and report the random floor on both level sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProcGen 上的泛化差距（训练关卡回报减留出关卡回报）缺少参照点，作者主张用同一 harness 下均匀随机策略在同批关卡上的实测回报作为 random floor。八个环境同一 checkpoint 上，采样与 argmax 测试动作会把留出回报双向移动，greedy 评估使三个环境掉到 floor 以下（miner 中采样策略留出回报是 floor 的 4.9 倍，argmax 则低于 floor）；合并等效动作后原始熵高估未收敛，对 floor 而言只有 heist 没学到可迁移的东西。
Motivation: ProcGen 泛化差距通常不带参照点报告，测试时动作规则、是否评估固定 checkpoint 等协议差异会改变数字含义，使跨代码库比较与结论（如 encoder 效应）不可靠。
Method: 在八个 ProcGen 环境的相同 checkpoint 与关卡上，对照 sampled 与 greedy (argmax) 测试动作；用动作等效合并修正原始策略熵判断收敛；审计十二个既有 ProcGen 代码库的评估协议；并把同一套检查用于自选案例研究（含 encoder 效应与 train-vs-test CKA 统计）。
Result: greedy 评估使三个环境的留出回报降到 floor 及以下；miner 中采样策略留出回报为 floor 的 4.9 倍而 argmax 低于 floor。原始策略熵显示八个环境中七个未收敛，但其中 35–65% 的熵分布在效果相同的动作上，合并后仅剩一到三个未收敛；对 floor 而言只有 heist 没学到可迁移内容。十二个既有代码库中，十一个做留出评估的都对 policy-gradient agent 采样测试动作（九个是默认而非显式选择），六个报告 in-loop 运行平均而非固定 checkpoint 评估。同一检查使作者案例研究中统计显著的 encoder 效应被降级，并排除 within-encoder 的 train-vs-test CKA 统计。
Conclusion: 每个报告的泛化差距都应注明动作规则、使用匹配且带种子的协议，并在两个关卡集上同时报告 random floor；否则动作规则与聚合方式足以改变结论方向。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Activation Flow: Manufacturing Activations for Steering
papers.abstract_en: Difference-in-means steering requires activations recorded while a model shows the desired behavior, which a sandbagging model withholds by deliberately underperforming. We introduce Activation Flow (ActFlow), which manufactures these activations from $k$ correct labels without fine-tuning. ActFlow sets target logits that rank each labeled item's correct answer first, and moves the logits toward them by adding one vector $x$ to all $k$ residual streams at one layer. ActFlow is a family of ordinary differential equations for $x$, one for each rule that maps the required logit change to the velocity of $x$. The smallest-norm rule lands exactly on the targets, while the others keep only the top singular directions of the Jacobian. We test ActFlow on three instruction-tuned models, each locked by a sandbagging prompt and by a password-locked LoRA. At $k=40$, ActFlow keeping five singular directions raises the mean held-out ARC-Easy accuracy over the six locked models from $0.05$ to $0.85$, against $0.88$ for fine-tuning and $0.92$ for the honest models. Furthermore, it scores higher than the smallest-norm rule in 16 of the 18 combinations of locked model and $k$, and its steering direction is nearly orthogonal to the honest difference-in-means direction. It also unlocks two LoRA locks where the honest direction fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActFlow 无需微调，仅凭 k 个正确标签就为差分均值 steering 合成被 sandbagging 模型扣留的激活：设定让正确答案排第一的目标 logits，并用一族 ODE 把某一层 k 条残差流的 logits 推向目标。在 6 个被 sandbagging prompt 与 password-locked LoRA 锁定的指令微调模型上，k=40 且保留 5 个奇异方向时，held-out ARC-Easy 平均准确率从 0.05 升到 0.85（微调 0.88，诚实模型 0.92）。
Motivation: 差分均值 steering 需要模型表现正常时录得的激活，而 sandbagging 模型故意表现差、扣留这类激活，使该方法在被锁定模型上失效。
Method: ActFlow 设定目标 logits 使每个带标签样本的正确答案排第一，再通过向同一层 k 条残差流各加一个向量 x 移动 logits；这是一族关于 x 的 ODE，每条规则把所需 logit 变化映射为 x 的速度，最小范数规则精确命中目标，其余规则只保留 Jacobian 的顶部奇异方向。
Result: 在三个指令微调模型、共 6 个锁定配置上，k=40 且保留 5 个奇异方向时 held-out ARC-Easy 平均准确率 0.05 → 0.85，对照微调 0.88、诚实模型 0.92；在锁定模型与 k 的 18 种组合中，该规则有 16 种高于最小范数规则；steering 方向与诚实差分均值方向近乎正交，并解锁了两个诚实方向失败的 LoRA 锁。
Conclusion: 被扣留的激活可以由正确标签直接合成，且保留 Jacobian 顶部奇异方向的规则在多数配置下优于最小范数规则，使差分均值 steering 在 sandbagging 与 LoRA 锁定下仍可用。

papers.title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SetOPD 把开放提示检测中的多模态协作从表示级融合改成候选集建模：Box-Set Prompting 逐个读取带框视觉样本的完整场景上下文，把池化支持证据分解为 Base 锚点与学习到的 Residual 修正，得到容量与样本数无关的提示并驱动独立视觉检测通路；Paired-Query Arbitration 在两条通路各自形成候选状态后，用共享查询初始化使候选按索引配对，再由学习门控逐对仲裁、置换等变模块在融合集合上推理。
Motivation: 现有开放提示检测器把多个视觉样本压缩成单一类级嵌入，等价于把视觉提示文本化，在只有少量异质样本时可能次优；且交互发生在提示或表示空间，早于模态专属检测状态的形成。
Method: SetOPD 从共享的 prompt-conditioned 初始化保留模态专属解码状态：Box-Set Prompting 读取每个 boxed exemplar 的完整场景上下文，将池化支持证据分解为 Base anchor 与学习的 Residual correction，提示容量固定且驱动自身视觉检测通路；Paired-Query Arbitration 让两个 reader 共享查询初始化使候选按索引配对，学习门控在每对内仲裁，随后用 permutation-equivariant 模块对融合后的候选集合推理。
Result: 摘要给出的是设计层面的性质：提示容量不随样本数量变化，候选因共享查询初始化而按索引配对，跨模态仲裁发生在模态专属候选状态形成之后。
Conclusion: 视觉提示不应被压成类名式的单一向量，文本-视觉协作应在候选状态层面显式仲裁，而非在表示空间提前融合。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fail Loudly: An Auditable Runtime for Agentic Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled data-science agents to automate multi-step analyses over heterogeneous files. However, incorrect choices regarding data sources, scope, or statistical definitions often lead to silent errors: computations execute successfully but produce plausible yet incorrect outputs that fail to answer the intended question. To mitigate this, we present RADAR, an auditable runtime that makes an agent's analytical choices inspectable and supports their revision through execution feedback. RADAR operates through three core mechanisms. First, an evidence-preserving exploration module retrieves task-relevant content while retaining source locations and observation coverage. Next, the runtime uses typed operators to record the agent's declared inputs, operation arguments, and resulting observations. Finally, runtime validation checks proposed operations against these observations. When a conflict is detected, the runtime rejects the operation or provides diagnostic feedback, allowing the agent to revise its choices before errors propagate. This design enables agents to fail loudly while leaving semantic interpretation to the LLM. On KramaBench, RADAR achieves overall scores of 0.723 with full source retrieval and 0.747 with gold sources supplied, corresponding to relative gains of 35.9% and 28.8% over the strongest baselines. Beyond KramaBench, RADAR achieves relative performance gains of 14.0% on DA-Code and 59.3% on DABStep, demonstrating its applicability across diverse agentic data-analysis workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RADAR 为 LLM 数据分析 agent 提供可审计运行时：用保留来源位置的证据探索、记录输入与参数的 typed operators、以及运行时校验，在操作与观测冲突时直接拒绝或给出诊断反馈，让 agent 的错误大声失败而不是静默产出貌似合理的错误结果。在 KramaBench 上整体得分 0.723（全量来源检索）与 0.747（给定 gold sources），相对最强基线提升 35.9% 与 28.8%。
Motivation: 数据科学 agent 在异构文件上做多步分析时，数据源、范围或统计定义选错会静默失败：计算跑通但输出貌似合理却答非所问，用户难以察觉。
Method: RADAR 含三个机制：证据保留探索模块检索任务相关内容并保留来源位置与观测覆盖；typed operators 记录 agent 声明的输入、操作参数与产生的观测；运行时校验用这些观测检查新操作，冲突时拒绝操作或返回诊断反馈，语义解释仍交给 LLM。
Result: KramaBench 整体得分 0.723（full source retrieval）与 0.747（gold sources），相对最强基线分别提升 35.9% 与 28.8%；跨基准相对提升为 DA-Code 14.0%、DABStep 59.3%。
Conclusion: 把分析选择显式记录并在执行前校验，能让 agent 在错误传播前失败并自我修正，且该运行时可迁移到不同 agentic 数据分析工作流。

papers.title: AmbiModBench: Benchmarking Gene Perturbation Prediction Beyond Shared Responses
papers.abstract_en: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations helps prioritize experiments in single-cell genomics, where exhaustive measurement is infeasible. While computational models increasingly predict these responses, three evaluation deficiencies obscure what their scores demonstrate. First, absolute metrics cannot separate target-specific predictions from a shared background response. Second, common metrics remain high under gene shuffling, so gene-level accuracy is never verified. Third, a score at one training size says nothing about coverage, which depends on representation-space proximity and response-constraining power. We propose AmbiModBench, a specificity-aware, gene-resolved and coverage-aware benchmark. It pairs every score with a training-mean reference fitted on the same split, screens each readout by gene-coordinate permutation, and links embedding distance to response variation. Across K562, RPE1 and Norman, strong absolute scores largely reflect shared background rather than target-specific learning. Widely used readouts track response magnitude distributions rather than the affected genes. Detectable gain follows representation-space coverage rather than training-set size. Nonetheless, on RPE1 the protocol yields a reproducible target-specific gain across five additional splits and three gene selections, which absolute scores alone cannot distinguish from shared background.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AmbiModBench 把基因扰动响应预测的评分拆成三重检验：每个分数配同划分训练均值参照、用基因坐标置换筛掉只跟踪响应幅度的读出、把 embedding 距离与响应变化挂钩。在 K562、RPE1、Norman 上，强绝对分数主要来自共享背景响应而非靶点特异学习；可检测增益随表示空间覆盖而非训练集规模变化，仅在 RPE1 上跨 5 个额外划分与 3 种基因选择得到可复现的靶点特异增益。
Motivation: 单细胞基因扰动预测的评测有三个缺陷：绝对指标无法区分靶点特异预测与共享背景响应；常用读出在基因打乱后仍高，基因级准确性从未被验证；单一训练规模的分数无法说明覆盖度，而覆盖度取决于表示空间邻近性与响应约束力。
Method: 提出 specificity-aware、gene-resolved、coverage-aware 的基准：每个分数配同一划分上拟合的训练均值参照；用基因坐标置换 (gene-coordinate permutation) 筛查每个读出；把 embedding 距离与响应变化关联以刻画覆盖度。评测覆盖 K562、RPE1、Norman 三个数据集。
Result: 在 K562、RPE1、Norman 上，强绝对分数很大程度反映共享背景而非靶点特异学习；广泛使用的读出跟踪的是响应幅度分布而非受影响基因；可检测增益随表示空间覆盖而非训练集规模出现。在 RPE1 上该协议跨 5 个额外划分与 3 种基因选择给出可复现的靶点特异增益，而绝对分数无法将其与共享背景区分。
Conclusion: 扰动预测的绝对分数会把共享背景误当靶点特异学习，评测必须配训练均值参照、基因置换筛查与覆盖度分析；靶点特异增益只在表示空间覆盖足够时可检测。

papers.title: Does Transolver really need a Transformer?
papers.abstract_en: The widely used Transolver family of neural operators is based on physics-attention, which softly assigns the points of an unstructured mesh to a small number of slices, applies self-attention among the resulting tokens, and broadcasts the result back to the points. We provide a comprehensive empirical and theoretical analysis to elucidate the mechanisms which are responsible for model performance. To this end, we perform careful ablations on a challenging suite of nine 3D fluid dynamics benchmarks to find that replacing token attention with a constant linear map does not affect the accuracy. Thus, Transolver does not need a Transformer at all. However, removing the global mixing (slicing/deslicing) or doing it only once leads to performance collapse. We leverage the theory of averaging neural operators to explain and corroborate our findings by showing that just slicing/deslicing, in conjunction with pointwise MLPs, already suffices for universal approximation of continuous operators and attention is redundant in this context. Finally, we provide a novel FlashAttention-style efficient implementation of the key slicing/deslicing module of Transolver. This flashslice kernel streams slice and deslice over the points without materializing the heavy slice-weight tensor, while reproducing the best available implementation to floating point error. At the same time, it leads to very significant memory and compute savings, particularly at large slice counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Transolver 系列神经算子做消融与理论分析，发现 physics-attention 中的 token 自注意力可被常数线性映射替代而不掉精度，真正决定性能的是 slicing/deslicing 全局混合；只做一次混合会导致性能崩溃。基于 averaging neural operator 理论证明仅 slicing/deslicing 加逐点 MLP 即可通用逼近连续算子，并给出 flashslice 高效内核。
Motivation: Transolver 依赖 physics-attention 取得好效果，但其性能来源不清：究竟是自注意力在起作用，还是 slicing/deslicing 的全局混合在起作用，需要在困难的 3D 流体基准上分离二者贡献。
Method: 在九个 3D 流体动力学基准上做系统消融：把 token attention 换成常数线性映射、去掉全局混合或只保留一次；用 averaging neural operator 理论解释并证明 slicing/deslicing 配逐点 MLP 的通用逼近性；提出 flashslice 内核，流式处理 slice/deslice 而不物化 slice-weight 张量。
Result: 九个 3D 流体基准上，用常数线性映射替换 token attention 不影响精度；去掉全局混合或只做一次导致性能崩溃；理论表明仅 slicing/deslicing 加逐点 MLP 已足以通用逼近连续算子，attention 在此语境下冗余；flashslice 在浮点误差内复现最佳可用实现，并在大 slice 数时带来显著内存与计算节省。
Conclusion: Transolver 不需要 Transformer：起作用的机制是 slicing/deslicing 的全局混合而非自注意力，attention 在该架构中是冗余的，效率优化应集中在 slice/deslice 模块上。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Beyond Dyadic Memory: Interaction-Aware Multimodal Memory with Adaptive Agentic Retrieval for Multi-Party Spoken Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables agents to accumulate information and reason across sessions, yet existing research primarily focuses on dyadic text or image-text conversations, leaving long-term memory for multi-party spoken conversations underexplored. This setting requires preserving conversational content, identifying participants across sessions, and retaining who speaks to whom. To this end, we propose VoxPolyMem, an interaction-aware multimodal memory framework combining incremental speaker identification with a memory hierarchy comprising interaction memory, fact memory, and participant profiles. We formulate retrieval as sequential decision-making, where an agent rewrites queries and selects retrieval tools and memory layers based on accumulated evidence to address information gaps. We further introduce Evidence-Gain GRPO (EG-GRPO), which uses round-wise credit assignment to encourage complementary evidence acquisition. We also construct VoxPolyBench to evaluate memory evolution, personalized answering, memory retrieval and reasoning, and interaction reasoning and attribution in multi-party spoken conversations. VoxPolyMem achieves an overall score of 85.0 on VoxPolyBench, surpassing the strongest evaluated baseline by 23.6 points. On Mem-Gallery and H2HMem-Multi, it scores 89.6 and 74.4, respectively, exceeding the strongest evaluated public memory baselines by over 8 points each. These results highlight its potential for persistent, personalized assistance in multi-party multimodal interactions. Code and datasets are available at https://voxpolymem.github.io/VoxPolyBench/demo/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 VoxPolyMem：面向多方语音对话的交互感知多模态记忆框架，把增量说话人辨识与交互记忆、事实记忆、参与者画像三层记忆层级结合，并把检索建模为由 agent 改写查询、选择检索工具与记忆层的序贯决策，用轮次级 credit assignment 的 Evidence-Gain GRPO (EG-GRPO) 训练。在自建 VoxPolyBench 上总分 85.0，比最强基线高 23.6 分。
Motivation: 长期记忆研究集中在二元 (dyadic) 文本或图文对话，多方语音对话的长期记忆几乎空白；该场景要同时保留对话内容、跨会话识别说话人、记住谁对谁说话。
Method: VoxPolyMem 组合增量说话人辨识与三层记忆层级（interaction memory、fact memory、participant profiles）；检索被形式化为序贯决策，agent 依据累积证据改写查询并选择检索工具与记忆层以填补信息缺口；训练用 EG-GRPO，按轮次分配 credit 以鼓励互补证据获取；并构建 VoxPolyBench 评测记忆演化、个性化问答、记忆检索与推理、交互推理与归因。
Result: VoxPolyMem 在 VoxPolyBench 上总分 85.0，超过最强被评基线 23.6 分；在 Mem-Gallery 与 H2HMem-Multi 上分别得 89.6 与 74.4，各自比最强公开记忆基线高出 8 分以上。
Conclusion: 交互感知的分层记忆加序贯决策检索，能在多方多模态对话中支撑持久的个性化助手；代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: MemAgent: Learning to Manage Heterogeneous Memory Providers for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Current agents remain largely stateless across tasks, limiting their ability to continually improve from prior interactions and making memory essential for long-horizon agentic behavior. Existing memory methods seek to reuse past experience, but most rely on a single memory representation (e.g., trajectories, reflections, skills, structured knowledge) whose effectiveness varies across task distributions. Rethinking this design space, we evaluate 13 memory methods and find that no single method generalizes across benchmarks, revealing the potential of managing heterogeneous memory providers. We formulate agent memory as a routing problem in which a memory agent decides which memory provider to retrieve from, whether to inject short-term memory, and which providers should store the resulting experience. Based on this perspective, we propose MemAgent, featuring a content-aware routing architecture and a training-data synthesis pipeline. The routing architecture combines content-aware probing before retrieval, short-term memory gating during execution, and selective multi-provider storage, while the training pipeline synthesizes phase-specific supervision for routing decisions. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DS, MemAgent improves average accuracy by 10.0% and outperforms every individual memory method across all three benchmarks. These gains come with less than 0.3% routing overhead and a 12% reduction in average task steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemAgent 把 LLM agent 的记忆管理形式化为路由问题：由一个 memory agent 决定从哪个异构记忆提供者检索、是否注入短期记忆、以及把新经验存到哪里。评测 13 种记忆方法发现没有单一方法能跨基准通用，而 MemAgent 在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA、xBench-DS 上平均准确率提升 10.0%，超过所有单个记忆方法，路由开销低于 0.3%，平均任务步数减少 12%。
Motivation: 现有 agent 跨任务基本无状态，记忆方法多依赖单一表示（轨迹、反思、技能、结构化知识），而其效果随任务分布变化，13 种方法的评测显示没有一种能跨基准通用。
Method: 将 agent 记忆建模为路由问题，提出内容感知路由架构：检索前做 content-aware probing，执行中做短期记忆 gating，最后做 selective multi-provider storage；配套训练数据合成流水线，为路由决策生成分阶段 (phase-specific) 监督信号。
Result: 在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA、xBench-DS 三个基准上平均准确率提升 10.0%，且在全部三个基准上均超过每一种单独的记忆方法；路由开销低于 0.3%，平均任务步数减少 12%。
Conclusion: 跨任务分布不存在普适的单一记忆表示，按内容路由异构记忆提供者才能稳定复用既往经验，且额外路由代价可忽略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Users Change Their Minds: Measuring and Repairing Intent Drift in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents often operate over multi-turn interactions in which user intent changes before execution. We study intent drift: the failure mode in which superseded parts of the user's intent continue to influence the final answer or tool action. We introduce IntentFlux, an executable benchmark that converts verifiable tasks into dialogues with controlled intent changes while preserving their original graders. In a 627-case calibration, mean task score falls from 0.476 to 0.384 as dialogues contain more superseded and withdrawn information. Across eight models, the rate of fully correct solutions is significantly lower when the same final task must be recovered from an evolving dialogue rather than given directly in a single turn. We further introduce StateForge, which explicitly maintains the active requirements before generation. On General-Test, it improves mean task score from 0.367 to 0.467. Providing the ground-truth final state improves performance further but still does not recover single-turn performance, indicating that state-estimation errors explain only part of the gap. These results establish intent drift as a measurable multi-turn failure mode and explicit state maintenance as a partial mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IntentFlux 基准，把可验证任务改写成含受控意图变更的多轮对话并保留原评分器，量化 LLM agent 的意图漂移 (intent drift)：对话中被取代/撤回的信息越多，平均任务分从 0.476 降到 0.384。再提出 StateForge，在生成前显式维护当前有效需求，General-Test 上把平均分从 0.367 提到 0.467，但即便给出真值最终状态也回不到单轮水平，说明状态估计误差只解释部分差距。
Motivation: LLM agent 在执行前用户意图会变，被取代的旧需求仍继续影响最终答案或工具调用；这一失败模式此前缺少可控、可评分的测量手段。
Method: IntentFlux 把可验证任务转成带受控意图变更的对话并沿用原 grader，做 627 例校准；StateForge 在生成前显式维护 active requirements，并对比直接给出真值最终状态的设定。
Result: 627 例校准中平均任务分随对话含更多被取代与撤回信息从 0.476 降至 0.384；八个模型上，同一最终任务从演化对话中恢复的完全正确率显著低于单轮直接给出；StateForge 在 General-Test 上把平均任务分从 0.367 提到 0.467；给定真值最终状态性能进一步提升但仍不及单轮。
Conclusion: 意图漂移是可测量的多轮失败模式，显式状态维护只是部分缓解；状态估计误差只解释单轮与多轮差距的一部分。

papers.title: STR: Supervised Transcoder Replacement for Reducing Steering Side Effects
papers.abstract_en: Model steering can strengthen a target behavior while degrading other useful behaviors. We introduce Supervised Transcoder Replacement (STR) to reduce these side effects for existing steering methods, including those fitted without a protection objective. STR learns a replacement for the multilayer perceptron (MLP) computation at the steering layer through supervision for target control, non-target preservation, and fidelity without steering. Selected steering methods then fit directions on the frozen replacement while retaining their own fitting objectives. We evaluate three steering methods across Gemma and Llama models using Corrigibility preferences and four harmful-request safety datasets. SALAD-Bench supplies protection training data and a separate in-distribution evaluation split; HarmBench, AdvBench, and StrongREJECT are reserved for out-of-distribution testing. STR substantially reduces steering side effects on the in-distribution evaluation and extends this protection to the unseen safety datasets while retaining effective target control. For target-only supervised steering vectors, pooled out-of-distribution attack success rate falls from 42.46% to 14.42% on Gemma-3-4B and from 34.97% to 12.91% on Gemma-3-12B. These results show that replacement training can benefit steering methods fitted without protection objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STR 用监督训练的替换模块接管 steering 层的 MLP 计算，让原有 steering 方法在冻结替换上重新拟合方向，从而在保持目标控制的同时压低对其它行为的副作用。对 target-only 监督 steering 向量，OOD 攻击成功率在 Gemma-3-4B 上从 42.46% 降到 14.42%，在 Gemma-3-12B 上从 34.97% 降到 12.91%。
Motivation: 模型 steering 在强化目标行为时会损害其它有用行为，而现有 steering 方法很多是在没有保护目标 (protection objective) 的情况下拟合的，事后难以补救。
Method: STR 在 steering 层用监督信号替换 MLP 计算，监督同时约束目标控制、非目标保持、以及不加 steering 时的保真度 (fidelity)；随后选定的 steering 方法在冻结的替换模块上按各自原有目标拟合方向。评测覆盖 Gemma 与 Llama 上的三种 steering 方法，用 Corrigibility 偏好与四个有害请求安全数据集：SALAD-Bench 提供保护训练数据及同分布评测切分，HarmBench、AdvBench、StrongREJECT 留作分布外测试。

Conclusion: 替换训练 (replacement training) 可以让原本没有保护目标的 steering 方法也获得副作用保护，且不牺牲目标控制效果。

papers.title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UnStep 是一个免训练推理包装器，让少步因果视频扩散模型以少于蒸馏时的 DiT 步数运行，并截断注意力 KV cache 的时间窗口，再用两项推理期机制补回质量：把生成 latent 重加噪到接近干净的水平后复用已有的 clean-cache pass 精修，以及对 DiT 注意力 value/output 投影做截断 SVD。配合 DiT 与 VAE decoder 的运行时优化，它在单张 H100 上达到 50 FPS、GB200 上 77 FPS，且不损失质量、无需重训练。
Motivation: 把双向多步视频扩散蒸馏成少步因果模型已是流式视频生成的常见做法，学生虽比教师快，但对实时生成仍然太慢。
Method: 推理期减少 DiT 扩散步数并限制注意力 KV cache 保留的时间窗口；用 renoising 加 clean-cache pass 复用精修、以及对注意力 value/output 投影的截断 SVD 恢复质量；运行时栈包含更高效的 attention 调用与 KV 索引、融合 Triton RoPE 与缓存系数、以及优化内存布局/精度/卷积核的 VAE 解码。
Result: 在单张 H100 上达到 50 FPS 且无质量损失，在 GB200 上达到 77 FPS，全部无需重训练；相比当前方法运行显著更快，开启新的因果视频扩散吞吐区间。
Conclusion: 少步因果视频扩散的实时性瓶颈可以在不重训练的前提下，靠推理期步数削减、注意力窗口截断与运行时栈优化一起解决。

papers.title: LocalProp: Neuro-Localized Memory-Efficient Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: The current deep learning training paradigm employs end-to-end backpropagation, regardless of the training stage, i.e. pre-training or fine-tuning. However, backpropagating through the entire model is neither biologically plausible nor memory efficient, since learning inside the brain is highly localized. Therefore, we propose LocalProp, a training procedure that locally updates the weights of a model. Our neuro-localized weight updates follow the "pre-training then fine-tuning" paradigm, where the pre-training is based on I-JEPA. After locally updating the weights, a pruning operation is performed, followed by a short final fine-tuning phase. Pruning helps by sending the learning signal from higher blocks to lower blocks. We perform experiments on several datasets, including large-scale benchmarks such as ImageNet, and empirically show that LocalProp reaches good performance at a fraction of GPU peak memory. By varying the number of jointly optimized blocks, we identify gradient-propagation span as a practical control over the accuracy-memory trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LocalProp 把端到端反传改为分段局部权重更新：先用 I-JEPA 做预训练，再逐段局部更新，随后剪枝以把高层学习信号传给低层，最后短程微调。在 ImageNet 等数据集上以远低于峰值 GPU 显存的开销达到良好精度，联合优化块数即梯度传播跨度 (gradient-propagation span) 可作为精度-显存权衡的旋钮。
Motivation: 端到端反传无论预训练还是微调都要穿过整个模型，既不符合大脑的局部化学习，也带来高显存开销。
Method: 按“先预训练后微调”范式做局部权重更新：预训练基于 I-JEPA，局部更新后执行剪枝以把学习信号从高层块传向低层块，再进入短的最终微调阶段；通过改变联合优化的块数调节梯度传播跨度。
Result: 在包括 ImageNet 在内的多个数据集上实验，LocalProp 以远低于 GPU 峰值显存的一小部分开销达到良好性能；联合优化块数被识别为精度-显存权衡的实用控制量。
Conclusion: 分段局部反传加剪枝可以在保住精度的同时大幅压低训练显存，梯度传播跨度是调节精度与显存的直接旋钮。

papers.title: REFINE: A Resilient Evolution Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Alert Triage in Security Operations Centers
papers.abstract_en: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) process large volumes of alerts daily. Alert triage prioritizes high-risk threats while reducing manual review of benign alerts. LLM agents can reason over logs and threat intelligence, but struggle to keep aligned with organization-specific, rapidly evolving SOC operational standards. We introduce REFINE, an LLM-agent framework for enterprise alert triage. REFINE encodes analyst expertise as structured skills and continuously adapts using analyst disposition feedback. It enforces recall = 1.0 as a hard constraint during evolution to maximize auto-closure of false positives, and identifies judgment blind spots by combining alert distributions with model error boundaries. Evaluated on four real industrial SOC scenarios across four MITRE ATT&CK phases with temporal split: REFINE achieves recall=1.0 on all evolution sets. On future test windows, it retains recall=1.0 in three scenarios; the degraded case reaches 0.807 recall, still outperforming self-evolution baselines (0.49-0.58).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REFINE 把分析师处置经验编码为结构化 skill，并用处置反馈持续演化 LLM agent 做企业 SOC 告警分诊，演化过程中把 recall=1.0 当硬约束以最大化自动关闭误报。在四个真实工业 SOC 场景、四个 MITRE ATT&CK 阶段的时间切分评测中，全部演化集 recall=1.0；未来测试窗口三个场景保住 1.0，最差场景降到 0.807，仍高于自演化基线的 0.49–0.58。
Motivation: SOC 每天处理海量告警，LLM agent 能推理日志与威胁情报，却难以跟上组织内部快速变化的运营标准，导致误报清理与高风险威胁优先级失衡。
Method: REFINE 将分析师专业知识编码为结构化 skills，用分析师处置反馈持续演化；演化时强制 recall=1.0 为硬约束，并结合告警分布与模型误差边界定位判断盲区。评测采用四个真实工业 SOC 场景、覆盖四个 MITRE ATT&CK 阶段的时间切分 (temporal split)。
Result: 四个演化集全部 recall=1.0；未来测试窗口三个场景保持 recall=1.0，退化场景 recall=0.807，仍优于自演化基线的 0.49–0.58。
Conclusion: 以 recall=1.0 为硬约束的技能演化能在 SOC 告警分诊中持续自动关闭误报，且在时间外推的未来窗口仍比自演化基线稳健。

papers.title: From Anomalies to Failures: Constructing Causal Error Graphs for Agentic Trace Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: LLM-driven agents are increasingly deployed in complex applications, where long agentic traces make failures difficult to diagnose. Existing trace diagnosis methods often conflate anomalies, errors, and failures, making diagnostic targets ambiguous; they also lack structured modeling of how causally relevant errors propagate and amplify into final task failures, resulting in unreliable failure attribution. To address these problems, we propose CEG-Agent, a tool-augmented agentic framework for causal diagnosis of agentic traces. Specifically, CEG-Agent introduces an explicit taxonomy of anomalies, errors, and failures, and constructs Causal Error Graphs (CEGs), a unified typed representation that links execution events, diagnostic nodes, and failure outcomes through causal relations. To evaluate causal trace diagnosis, we further construct CEG-Bench, a fully agent-annotated benchmark with high-confidence, consensus-derived CEG annotations obtained through an Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP). We validate the resulting annotations against an expert-curated human gold set, which shows close agreement with the automatic annotations. Experiments on CEG-Bench demonstrate that CEG-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance under both semantically relaxed and structurally exact evaluation criteria. Our code is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CEG-Agent，用显式的异常-错误-失败分类法把 LLM agent 长轨迹构建成因果错误图 (Causal Error Graphs)，把执行事件、诊断节点与最终失败用因果边连起来，从而给出明确的诊断目标与可追溯的失败归因。配套发布 CEG-Bench，其标注经对抗式 agent 裁决协议 (AAAP) 达成共识并与专家人工金标集高度一致；实验显示 CEG-Agent 在语义宽松与结构精确两种评测标准下均达到 SOTA。
Motivation: LLM agent 的长轨迹难以诊断：现有方法混淆 anomaly、error 与 failure 导致诊断目标含糊，且不建模错误如何因果传播放大成任务失败，失败归因不可靠。
Method: CEG-Agent 是工具增强的 agent 框架，先给出 anomaly/error/failure 的显式分类，再构建统一的类型化表示 CEG，用因果关系连接执行事件、诊断节点与失败结果。评测侧构造 CEG-Bench，用 Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP) 产出高置信度、共识推导的 CEG 标注，并对照专家人工金标集验证。
Result: 在 CEG-Bench 上，CEG-Agent 在语义宽松 (semantically relaxed) 与结构精确 (structurally exact) 两种评测标准下均取得 SOTA；AAAP 自动标注与专家人工金标集对照显示高度一致。
Conclusion: 把异常、错误、失败分层并用因果错误图显式建模错误传播，是让 agent 轨迹诊断目标明确、失败归因可靠的有效路径；代码已公开。

summary_sections.motivation: LLM agent 的长轨迹难以诊断：现有方法混淆 anomaly、error 与 failure 导致诊断目标含糊，且不建模错误如何因果传播放大成任务失败，失败归因不可靠。
summary_sections.method: CEG-Agent 是工具增强的 agent 框架，先给出 anomaly/error/failure 的显式分类，再构建统一的类型化表示 CEG，用因果关系连接执行事件、诊断节点与失败结果。评测侧构造 CEG-Bench，用 Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP) 产出高置信度、共识推导的 CEG 标注，并对照专家人工金标集验证。
summary_sections.result: 在 CEG-Bench 上，CEG-Agent 在语义宽松 (semantically relaxed) 与结构精确 (structurally exact) 两种评测标准下均取得 SOTA；AAAP 自动标注与专家人工金标集对照显示高度一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把异常、错误、失败分层并用因果错误图显式建模错误传播，是让 agent 轨迹诊断目标明确、失败归因可靠的有效路径；代码已公开。

papers.title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对手写数学公式识别 (HMER) 中训练图像与相机拍摄图像的域差距，作者刻画该差距并给 MFH-CoMER 加入作者自适应微调流水线。在两位作者、五个书写类别的自建子集上，数字手写识别率上升、CER 下降，物理拍摄手写结果不一，但五个子集中四个的适配模型结果改善，McNemar 与置换检验显示其中两个子集改善具有一致性。
Motivation: 现有 HMER 系统无法适配特定书写者的写法，且训练图像（数字或完美二值化）与推理时相机实拍图像之间的域差距在该问题上关注很少。
Method: 通过碎片化 (fragmentation) 与笔画宽度分析刻画域差距；在 MFH-CoMER 上引入作者自适应微调流水线；构建含两位作者、五个书写类别子集的作者专属数据集，并用 McNemar 检验与针对小数据改造的置换检验做统计评估。
Result: 数字手写上表达式识别率提高、CER 下降；物理拍摄手写结果更不一，模型在基座模型本已能很好处理的书写文章上表现吃力。五个子集中四个的适配模型结果改善；统计检验显示两个受测作者专属子集的改善具有一致性。
Conclusion: HMER 任务上的书写者自适应具有潜在可行性，但效果在物理拍摄手写上不稳定，且对基座模型已擅长的样本改善有限。

papers.title: What Do Latent Predictive Vehicle Representations Retain? Measuring State, Geometry, and Local Response
papers.abstract_en: Models of vehicle dynamics learned from logged states and commands complement physics-based models, and latent world models, which predict in a learned representation, are used to plan and train controllers in other domains. Vehicle controllers are usually specified in physical terms: costs, limits, and references depend on position, yaw angle, speed, and yaw rate, and the optimizer compares or differentiates predicted outcomes across nearby commands. A latent model placed in such a controller must therefore let these quantities be recovered and must change its predictions with commands as the vehicle does, and prediction error on its own latent targets measures neither. We contribute a measurement protocol for action-conditioned latent predictors with a physical readout that separately tests retention, physical-neighborhood organization, forecasting, and local response to command perturbations, using an untrained-encoder reference and three matched response paths that locate errors in the representation or the predictor. In a case study of a temporal joint-embedding predictive model trained on signals logged in IPG CarMaker, the representations retain the measured planar outputs, though an untrained encoder of the same architecture retains them slightly better; future-command input improves one-second forecasts with retention nearly unchanged; and responses to small command pulses diverge from the simulator already in latent coordinates, raising regret when choosing among nearby commands in all comparisons. Updating the predictor on responses corrects them locally at a cost in forecast accuracy. Measuring retention, forecasting, and local response separately is thus what qualifies a predictive latent as a candidate model for control, and the protocol provides the basis for its closed-loop evaluation.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 14 figures, under review, double-blind, code will be made public upon acceptance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套面向动作条件 latent 预测器的测量协议，用物理读出分别检验表征保留、物理邻域组织、预测以及对指令扰动的局部响应，并配一个未训练编码器参照与三条匹配响应路径定位误差来源。在 IPG CarMaker 日志上训练的 temporal joint-embedding predictive model 案例中，表征保留了被测平面输出但略逊于同架构未训练编码器；加入未来指令输入改善 1 秒预测且保留几乎不变；小指令脉冲的响应在 latent 坐标下已与仿真器发散，使邻近指令选择的 regret 在所有比较中上升，更新预测器可局部纠正但牺牲预测精度。
Motivation: latent world model 常以自身 latent 目标上的预测误差作为唯一评价，但这既不能说明位置、偏航角、速度、偏航率等物理量能否被恢复，也不能说明预测是否随指令正确变化，而这两点正是控制器在物理量上设定代价、约束与参考、并对邻近指令做比较或求导的前提。
Method: 提出动作条件 latent 预测器的测量协议：带物理读出，分别测试 retention、物理邻域组织 (physical-neighborhood organization)、forecasting 与对指令扰动的局部响应；用同架构未训练编码器作参照，并用三条匹配的响应路径把误差定位到表征或预测器。案例研究为在 IPG CarMaker 记录信号上训练的 temporal joint-embedding predictive model。
Result: 表征保留了被测平面输出，但同架构未训练编码器保留得略好；加入未来指令输入改善 1 秒预测而 retention 几乎不变；对小指令脉冲的响应在 latent 坐标下即与仿真器发散，在所有比较中提高了在邻近指令间选择的 regret；在预测器上用响应数据更新可局部纠正响应，代价是预测精度下降。
Conclusion: 只有把 retention、forecasting 与 local response 分开测量，才能判定一个 predictive latent 是否够格作为控制用模型的候选，该协议为后续闭环评估提供了基础。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning from Others, Acting for You: Cross-User Memory Sharing for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents serving different users often solve related tasks, yet separate user histories can leave reusable experience inaccessible to other agents. Pooling memories expands access but risks transferring preferences that conflict with the receiving user's requirements. We introduce ShareMem, a memory architecture that shares reusable experience while grounding its application in the receiving user's own preferences. Shared experiences indicate how to act and which preferences to consult; the receiving user's memory supplies their concrete values. Two-stage consolidation refines experience locally before integrating accepted edits into a shared pool. During execution, scope-first retrieval jointly selects local and shared experiences under a common entry budget, while a user-bound channel supports initial and agent-initiated preference retrieval. We evaluate ShareMem across web navigation (Mind2Web), online personalized interaction (VitaBench~2.0), and multi-session coding (MemoryCode) with four backbone models. It improves step success, average task success, and dialogue-macro coding scores, respectively, over matched user-local memory across all four models. Ablations favor two-stage consolidation for smaller shared pools, lower induction token usage, and better downstream performance, and support complementarity between experience guidance and active preference retrieval. Further analyses show that sharing helps most when relevant local experience is scarce, while source quality and cross-user preference interference limit useful transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShareMem 让 LLM agent 跨用户共享可复用经验，但把「怎么行动」的共享经验与「取什么值」的用户本地偏好分开：共享条目只指示参考哪些偏好，具体取值仍由接收用户自己的记忆提供。在 Mind2Web、VitaBench 2.0、MemoryCode 三个基准、四个 backbone 上，它相对同配置的 user-local memory 分别提升 step success、平均任务成功率与 dialogue-macro coding 分数。
Motivation: 不同用户的独立历史使相关任务的可复用经验无法互通，而直接合并记忆又会把与接收用户要求冲突的偏好一起迁移过去。
Method: ShareMem 包含两阶段 consolidation（先在本地精炼经验，再把被接受的编辑并入共享池）、scope-first retrieval（在统一 entry 预算下同时选取本地与共享经验），以及一条 user-bound channel 支持初始与 agent 主动发起的偏好检索；在 Mind2Web、VitaBench 2.0、MemoryCode 上用四个 backbone 评测。
Result: 相对匹配的 user-local memory，ShareMem 在四个 backbone 上分别提升 step success（Mind2Web）、平均任务成功率（VitaBench 2.0）与 dialogue-macro coding 分数（MemoryCode）。消融显示两阶段 consolidation 在共享池更小、induction token 用量更低时带来更好下游表现，并支持经验引导与主动偏好检索的互补性；进一步分析表明本地相关经验稀缺时共享收益最大，而源质量与跨用户偏好干扰会限制有效迁移。
Conclusion: 把经验共享与偏好取值解耦，可以在不引入跨用户偏好冲突的前提下让 agent 复用他人经验，且本地经验越稀缺共享越有价值；收益上限由共享源的质量和跨用户偏好干扰决定。

papers.title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
papers.abstract_en: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoCR 用单一网络统一 RGB-only 与多光谱、单时相与多时相的云去除 (cloud removal)，可选 SAR 引导：在冻结的预训练 RGB autoencoder 主干上接紧凑输入/输出 stem，用一个 flow transformer 联合建模干净 RGB 与非 RGB latent。十个数据集共 883,331 张无云目标图联合预训练后，同一 checkpoint 免数据集微调直接推理，也可用 LoRA 适配；在 SEN12MS-CR、Sen2_MTC_New 全波段与 CUHK-CR2 RGB-only 测试集上取得最佳 FID 与 DISTS。
Motivation: 云去除方法通常绑定单一数据集与输入配置（波段、时相、传感器），跨观测设置无法复用，导致每换一个场景就要重训一个专用模型。
Method: 冻结预训练 RGB autoencoder 的 encoder/decoder 主干，仅增加紧凑 input/output stem 以容纳不同光谱与传感域；单一 flow transformer 在共享 latent 接口上联合建模干净 RGB 与非 RGB latent，条件来自分离的多云观测流与可选 SAR token。在十个数据集的训练划分上联合预训练，推理支持免微调直接推断或 LoRA 适配。
Result: 联合预训练覆盖十个数据集、883,331 张无云目标图像；在测试划分的对比中，GeoCR 在全波段 SEN12MS-CR 与 Sen2_MTC_New、RGB-only CUHK-CR2 上取得最佳 FID 与 DISTS，胜过通用图像修复方法与已有云去除模型。
Conclusion: 跨异构观测配置可以学出一个可复用的生成式云去除先验，同一 checkpoint 覆盖全波段与 RGB-only 设置，无需按数据集专门微调。

papers.title: Fast Differentiable SVD on GPU via Polar Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We present a fully GPU-oriented SVD pipeline based on polar decomposition, motivated by iterative methods that rely solely on matrix multiplications, such as the Newton-Schulz iteration. We show that this approach enables up to a $2\times$ speedup compared to standard implementations. Furthermore, we derive a numerically stable backward pass for the polar decomposition and leverage it to obtain a fully differentiable SVD. Our methods are released as open-source implementations in both PyTorch and JAX: https://github.com/fallnlove/cans_svd.

papers.title: Fisher Simplicity in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks and Multilayer Perceptrons
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) are motivated in part by interpretability: their learned edge functions can be inspected, pruned, and reduced to symbolic structure. In a fixed-basis KAN, this makes a small or zero basis coefficient look like a certificate of simplicity, much as a dead rectified linear unit (ReLU) marks unused computation in a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Fisher nullity gives a precise statistical notion: a parameter direction is Fisher-simple exactly when perturbing it is invisible under the task distribution. We study when these architectural and Fisher notions agree. For a dead ReLU unit, they agree: the closed activation region makes the associated score directions vanish. For a fixed-basis KAN, they do not. In the single-layer Gaussian case, the coefficient Fisher matrix is a basis Gram matrix under the input distribution and is independent of the fitted coefficients. In a multilayer KAN, Fisher simplicity is graph-path based: the data must reach a basis atom and its perturbation must propagate through the downstream network. We encode these two conditions in an effective edge measure and, under local dictionary independence and effective-measure nondegeneracy, show that zero effective exposure exactly identifies Fisher-null directions within an edge. Controlled diagnostics confirm that zero coefficients can preserve rank while effective path disconnections remove the predicted directions. Coefficient magnitude alone is therefore not a Fisher-based pruning criterion for KANs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文判定 KAN 中小/零基系数并不等于统计意义上的可剪枝：Fisher nullity 要求扰动在任务分布下不可见，而固定基 KAN 的系数 Fisher 矩阵是输入分布下的基 Gram 矩阵、与拟合系数无关。只有当数据经有效路径到达某个基原子（有效暴露为零）时才精确识别 Fisher-null 方向，因此单看系数幅度不能作为 KAN 的 Fisher 剪枝判据。
Motivation: KAN 的可解释性叙事把小或零基系数当作简明性的证书（类比 MLP 的 dead ReLU），但架构层面的稀疏与 Fisher 统计意义上的简单并不天然一致，需要明确二者何时等价。
Method: 以 Fisher nullity（参数方向扰动在任务分布下不可见）为基准，对比 dead ReLU 与固定基 KAN：单层高斯情形下把系数 Fisher 矩阵化为输入分布下的基 Gram 矩阵；多层 KAN 中把「数据到达基原子」与「扰动经下游网络传播」两条条件编码为 effective edge measure，并在局部字典独立与有效测度非退化假设下给出零有效暴露精确识别 Fisher-null 方向的结论。
Result: dead ReLU 单元上架构与 Fisher 判据一致（闭激活区域使相关 score 方向消失）；固定基 KAN 上不一致，单层高斯情形的系数 Fisher 矩阵与拟合系数无关。受控诊断 (controlled diagnostics) 确认：零系数可以保留秩，而有效路径断开会移除被预测的方向。
Conclusion: 系数幅度本身不是 KAN 的 Fisher 剪枝判据，剪枝应改用基于有效路径暴露的 Fisher 判据；等价性在 dead ReLU 上成立、在固定基 KAN 上不成立。

papers.title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
papers.abstract_en: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TreeRef-BFN 用树结构表示把分子拓扑与依赖拓扑的局部 3D 几何绑定在一起，RingRef 节点在保持树结构的前提下编码环闭合，Null 节点让分子大小由节点占据自然涌现。基于该表示的 Bayesian Flow Network 用标准 Transformer 全局耦合这些局部变量，联合生成离散分子变量与连续局部几何；单个预训练模型仅靠 masking 即可支持无条件生成与变尺寸结构条件 3D 生成而无需重训。
Motivation: 现有 de novo 3D 分子生成多先预采样分子尺寸再生成笛卡尔坐标，难以处理片段补全、骨架修饰这类变尺寸条件任务，且常依赖等变架构；内坐标方法虽避开刚体冗余，却通常需要已知分子图或自回归构建，误差会累积。
Method: 提出 TreeRef 树表示：把分子拓扑与拓扑依赖的局部 3D 几何挂到天然变尺寸的树上，RingRef 节点编码环闭合同时保持树结构，Null 节点让分子尺寸由节点占据决定。其上构建 TreeRef-BFN——Bayesian Flow Network，骨干为标准 Transformer，全局耦合这些局部定义的变量，联合生成离散分子变量与连续局部几何；结构条件生成通过 masking 实现，不需重训。
Result: 实证研究显示该方法在化学有效性 (chemical validity)、分子稳定性 (molecular stability) 与多样性上表现强，局部几何分布准确，采样速度快，并在性质条件生成 (property-conditioned generation) 上具竞争力。
Conclusion: 把拓扑与局部几何统一到可变尺寸树表示上，配合 Bayesian Flow Network 与 masking 条件化，可让单个预训练模型同时覆盖无条件与变尺寸结构条件 3D 分子生成，且无需等变架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rondo: Unsupervised Discovery of Recurring Temporal Structure
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world time series data exhibit structural properties at multiple scales, from short, recurring units to complex sequences composed of these units. Unsupervised discovery of both these components and structure enables the design of intelligent systems that help interpret temporal data, thereby limiting the amount of costly human annotations required. Existing modeling approaches typically overlook the hierarchical structure inherent to many time series, treating recurring patterns at different temporal scales as independent structures. Moreover, most assume access to the complete data sequence and treat discovery as a static process, limiting their ability to evolve as new observations arrive. We introduce Rondo, an unsupervised approach for modeling recurring hierarchical structure in continuous temporal streams. By explicitly constructing vocabularies of reusable units and their recurring compositions, Rondo captures structure shared across complex temporal patterns while refining and expanding its discoveries as the stream evolves. Evaluations on temporal sequences spanning diverse domains and data modalities show that Rondo outperforms existing unsupervised recurrence-discovery baselines, with particularly pronounced advantages in limited-data and continual-stream settings. These capabilities provide a stronger foundation for recurring-pattern discovery, scalable behavior understanding, and adaptive intelligent systems operating on long, unlabeled temporal streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rondo 是面向连续时间流的无监督层次化循环结构发现方法，显式构建可复用单元词表及其组合词表，随流式观测到达不断精化与扩展已有发现。在跨领域、跨模态的时间序列评测中优于现有无监督循环发现基线，优势在有限数据与持续流设定下最明显。
Motivation: 现有无监督时序发现方法忽略多尺度层次结构，把不同时间尺度的循环模式当作彼此独立的结构，且假设拿到完整序列、把发现当作一次性静态过程，无法随新观测演化。
Method: Rondo 显式构建两层词表：可复用的短时单元 (units) 与其递归组合 (compositions)，捕获跨复杂模式共享的结构；在连续时间流上随观测到达不断精化并扩展已有发现，而非一次性处理完整序列。
Result: 在覆盖多个领域与数据模态的时间序列评测中，Rondo 超过现有无监督循环发现基线，在有限数据 (limited-data) 与持续流 (continual-stream) 设定下优势尤为显著。
Conclusion: 把层次词表与流式增量发现结合起来，可以在长的无标注时间流上做更省标注的循环模式发现与行为理解。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learning an Anchored Prompt Space for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Continually adapting large language models requires acquiring new knowledge while preserving previously learned capabilities. Jointly adapting model parameters and task-specific soft prompts offers a promising solution, but faces two key limitations: historical prompts may become less effective as the model evolves, while their transferable cross-task relationships are not explicitly learned. We propose Learning an Anchored Prompt Space (LAPS), which preserves historical prompt effectiveness and learns relationships among task-specific soft prompts to facilitate positive transfer. LAPS first aligns historical prompts with the updated model through self-distillation. LAPS then constructs an anchored prompt space whose vertices correspond to learned task-specific soft prompts and whose intermediate geometry is shaped by learnable Bézier control prompts. Once this anchored prompt space is learned, LAPS identifies the best-performing prompt for each task on its validation set, allowing the optimized prompt to draw on knowledge acquired from observed tasks. Experiments on the TRACE benchmark across three Qwen3 model scales show that LAPS consistently outperforms distillation-based, prompt-based, and joint prompt--parameter adaptation baselines, improving average performance while reducing forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAPS 用自蒸馏把历史 soft prompt 对齐到更新后的模型，再以可学习的 Bézier 控制 prompt 构造锚定 prompt 空间，顶点为各任务 prompt，最后在验证集上为每个任务挑选最优 prompt。在 TRACE 基准、三种 Qwen3 规模上，它一致优于蒸馏式、prompt 式与 prompt–参数联合适应基线，平均性能提升且遗忘减少。
Motivation: 联合适应模型参数与任务 soft prompt 时，历史 prompt 会随模型演化而失效，且它们之间可迁移的跨任务关系没有被显式学习。
Method: LAPS 分三步：先用 self-distillation 将历史 prompt 与更新后的模型对齐；再构造 anchored prompt space，顶点是学到的任务 soft prompt，中间几何由可学习的 Bézier control prompts 塑形；空间学成后在各任务验证集上选出表现最好的 prompt，使优化后的 prompt 能调用已观测任务的知识。
Result: 在 TRACE 基准上跨三种 Qwen3 模型规模实验，LAPS 一致优于 distillation-based、prompt-based 与 joint prompt–parameter adaptation 三类基线，平均性能提升并降低遗忘。
Conclusion: 把历史 prompt 显式对齐并放进带几何结构的锚定空间，可在持续适应中同时保住旧能力并促成跨任务正迁移。

papers.title: DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAAF 把 LLM agent 的故障定位从「错误发生在哪段执行」改判为「该改哪个可编辑系统资产」，用受控重放学到的属性替换效果来支撑部署期诊断。在 held-out tau^2-bench Telecom 任务上 attribute Hit@1 达 80.72%，恢复 62.65% 的失败执行，干净任务回退控制在 3.23%，总体任务成功率 71.93%。
Motivation: 现有故障定位方法只能指出错误在 agent 或执行轨迹中的位置，但修复需要另一个决策：改哪个带版本的可编辑资产（路由规则、知识片段、prompt 指令、可复用 skill），以及这次改动是否真能改善任务结果。

Result: 在 held-out tau^2-bench Telecom 任务上：attribute Hit@1 80.72%，恢复 62.65% 的失败执行，干净任务回退限制在 3.23%，总体任务成功率 71.93%。

papers.title: Hearsay: Can an Auditor Trust the Record a Deployed Agent Harness Writes?
papers.abstract_en: An agent harness, the code that turns a model into an agent, writes its own record of each run, and that record is all a later reader gets when a run is disputed, investigated or audited. We call a record evidentiary when a reader who was not there can check it without trusting the writer. Across sixteen deployed frameworks, none writes one in full. Hearsay examines the record, not the task: five harnesses run fourteen tasks, three blinded LLM examiners and a human panel read the records, and every excerpt an examiner quotes is checked mechanically for who wrote it. First, the record lets a reader name the fault but not prove how the run went. Examiners name the right fault in 74 to 91% of 140 runs, but the fault can be proved only from two files the benchmark adds; for what happened in between, fewer than one citation in ten lands on anything the harness did not write, and the examiner with the fewest false alarms catches half of the entries we delete, rewrite or fabricate. Second, the remedy is a second author, not a stronger seal on the first. An append-only log of what passes between harness and model, kept outside the harness and read against the record in both directions, reports all 28 omissions and fabrications we made a harness commit as it ran, where a hash chain over the harness's own record passes all 28. Handed the log, examiners keep their fault verdicts but rest more of their citations on what the harness did not write. What makes a record evidence is who writes it, not what is captured.
papers.comment: 48 pages (9-page main text), 5 figures. Under review. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/hearsay-4E7C
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hearsay 指出 agent harness 自写的运行记录不具备证据性：跨 16 个已部署框架无一写全，读者能指认故障却无法证明过程。解法是引入 harness 之外的第二作者——记录 harness 与模型之间往来的 append-only 日志并双向比对，它报出全部 28 处遗漏与伪造，而对 harness 自身记录做 hash chain 则 28 处全部漏报。
Motivation: 运行记录是争议、调查或审计时读者唯一能拿到的东西，但现有 harness 自写自证，读者必须信任写入方才能核对，审计链条因此断裂。
Method: 在 16 个已部署框架上做记录审计：5 个 harness 跑 14 个任务共 140 次运行，由 3 个盲评 LLM 审阅者加人类小组阅读记录，并对审阅者引用的每段摘录机械校验其真实写入方；再对比 harness 外置的 append-only 日志与 harness 自身记录上的 hash chain 两种补救。
Result: 审阅者在 140 次运行中 74%–91% 能指对故障，但故障只能靠 benchmark 额外添加的两个文件证明；不到十分之一的引用落在 harness 未写的内容上，误报最少的审阅者也只能抓出被删除、改写或伪造条目的一半。外置 append-only 日志报出 harness 运行中提交的全部 28 处遗漏与伪造，hash chain 则 28 处全部通过。
Conclusion: 记录之所以成为证据取决于谁写的，而不是捕获了什么；补救应是 harness 之外的第二作者，而非给第一作者的记录加更强的封印。

papers.title: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control over this balance. To this end, we propose soft-target fine-tuning (SoFT) to balance learning from teacher demonstrations with retaining the Base model's existing capabilities. SoFT sets a minimum target probability for each demonstrated token while making the smallest KL change to the Base distribution. The resulting objective couples learning from demonstrations with adaptively weighted regularization toward the Base model. We further use domain-specific gradient budgets to control this balance and determine a probability threshold for each trajectory. Experiments on mixed-domain reasoning and agentic tasks show that SoFT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, with improvements in both in-distribution capability acquisition and out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoFT 在多教师多域蒸馏式 SFT 中，为每个示范 token 设定最低目标概率，同时让 Base 模型分布的 KL 改动最小，并用按域划分的梯度预算与逐轨迹概率阈值控制学习与保持之间的平衡。在混合域推理与 agentic 任务上，它在所比较方法中取得最佳总体表现，同时提升分布内能力获取与分布外泛化。
Motivation: 把多教师、多域示范蒸馏进单个学生时，SFT 各方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间呈现不同取舍，缺少对这一平衡的显式控制手段。
Method: 提出 soft-target fine-tuning (SoFT)：对每个示范 token 设最低目标概率，同时对 Base 分布做最小 KL 改动，得到耦合示范学习与自适应加权 Base 正则的目标；再用 domain-specific gradient budgets 与逐轨迹概率阈值调节该平衡。
Result: 在混合域推理与 agentic 任务实验中，SoFT 在所比较方法里总体表现最佳，分布内能力获取与分布外泛化同时改善；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 对示范 token 设下限并约束对 Base 分布的 KL 改动，配合按域梯度预算，可以在多域 SFT 中同时保住分布内学习与分布外泛化。

papers.title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARO 联合优化模块化 LLM 程序的 prompt、可复用 skill 块与路由规则：用受控反事实评估把每个样例的效果转成对三类组件的概率责任分布，从中采样一个组件再做定向变异。在五个 benchmark、五个 worker 模型上，它一致优于以 prompt 为中心和以 skill 为中心的优化基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 程序优化只覆盖设计空间的一角——要么改整体 prompt，要么单独归纳并打磨 skill，失败时没有原则性机制判断该更新哪个组件，prompt、skill 与 skill 使用策略无法在同一框架内统一优化。
Method: SPARO（Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization）对任务指令、可复用 skill 块与路由规则做联合优化：先做受控反事实评估 (controlled counterfactual evaluations)，把样例的效果转成覆盖 prompt/skill/routing 三组件的概率责任分布 (responsibility distribution)，从该分布采样一个组件，再施加对应的定向变异 (targeted mutation)。
Result: 在五个 benchmark 和五个 worker 模型上，SPARO 一致优于以 prompt 为中心与以 skill 为中心的优化基线。
Conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不只在于发现有用的任务知识，还在于决定这些知识存放在哪里、何时被激活；结构化、可复用、选择性激活优于全局 prompt 重写。

papers.title: Explaining Textual Entailment with Lexical Entailments: Using LLMs to Supply Lexical Relations for Formal Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly capable of natural language reasoning and appear to store a great deal of lexical knowledge, but it is still unclear how much of this knowledge they actually use when reasoning, and whether they use it in the right way. On the other hand, logic-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) systems provide transparent and formally grounded reasoning, but they need to be supplied with rich lexical knowledge to prove inferences beyond purely logical ones. In this paper, we evaluate whether LLMs can identify all lexical knowledge needed to solve NLI problems and how much this knowledge contributes to proof search in a logic-based NLI system. Our research focuses exclusively on structured lexical entailments (e.g., chinchilla$\sqsubseteq$small animal) as a proxy for structured explanations for NLI problems with an entailment label. First, we curate a dataset for a new task of explaining sentential entailments with a set of lexical entailments. The dataset is used to intrinsically evaluate LLMs on generating structured lexical explanations. Then, we use NLI as an extrinsic evaluation in a simple neuro-symbolic setting, assessing whether LLMs can supply sufficient lexical relations to LangPro, a natural-logic theorem prover for natural language. The results show that the proposed task remains challenging even for hosted proprietary LLMs, and that their contribution to theorem proving is moderate: generated relations are often only partially sound and may be tailored to the specific NLI problem rather than representing generally valid lexical knowledge.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 LLM 为自然语言推理 (NLI) 生成结构化词汇蕴含（如 chinchilla⊑small animal）作为可解释证明的新任务，先构建数据集做内在评估，再把 LLM 产出的词汇关系喂给自然逻辑定理证明器 LangPro 做外在评估。结果是该任务对托管的专有 LLM 仍困难，对定理证明的贡献仅为中等：生成的关系常只部分可靠，且往往针对具体 NLI 问题而非普遍有效的词汇知识。
Motivation: 逻辑型 NLI 系统推理透明、形式化，但缺少词汇知识就无法证明超出纯逻辑的推理；同时 LLM 虽看似存储大量词汇知识，却不清楚它在推理中实际用到多少、用得是否正确。
Method: 先为「用一组词汇蕴含解释句子级蕴含」这一新任务整理数据集，用它对 LLM 做内在评估，考察其生成结构化词汇解释的能力；再在简单神经-符号设置中把 LLM 供给的词汇关系接入自然逻辑定理证明器 LangPro，以 NLI 作外在评估，衡量这些关系对证明搜索的贡献。
Result: 该解释任务即便对托管的专有 LLM 仍具挑战性；它们对定理证明的贡献为中等（moderate），生成的词汇关系常常只是部分可靠 (partially sound)，并且可能针对特定 NLI 问题而生成，而非代表普遍有效的词汇知识。
Conclusion: LLM 可以充当逻辑型 NLI 系统的词汇知识供给方，但当前其产出的词汇蕴含既不够可靠也不够通用，因此对证明搜索的增益有限。
