papers.title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks. To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving. Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 多智能体系统在执行中不仅要修订解法，还要修订对任务需求本身的显式表示。

papers.title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三模态 VQA 中最有害的辅助文本不是最不事实错误的，而是与问题一致、却与图像矛盾并偏向某个干扰选项的文本，它会把模型预测系统性地重定向到该选项。Textual Reliability Ladder 沿图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持三个轴分解辅助文本后，这类文本造成最高 53.1% 的准确率下降；提出的免训练推理干预（噪声稳定性引导 + 动态接地）在忠实文本下基本保住性能。
Motivation: 辅助文本可靠性不受控，已有工作只研究一般模态冲突，不清楚在图像-问题-选项固定时，不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何改变答案选择。
Method: 提出 Textual Reliability Ladder 受控诊断协议，沿图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持三个轴分解辅助文本；再提出免训练的推理时干预，用噪声稳定性引导 (noise-stability steering) 与动态接地 (dynamic grounding) 抵消重定向效应。
Result: 在 ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA 多个数据集与近期 VLM 上，支持干扰选项的文本造成最大 53.1% 的准确率下降，且错误集中在特定错误选项上；干预减少被重定向的错误，并在忠实文本下基本保持性能。
Conclusion: 辅助文本的可靠性必须在决策层面理解，而不能只看事实正确性；重定向效应可在推理时被抵消而无需重训。

papers.title: When Does Dense Retrieval Need Asymmetric Geometry? A Bias-Variance Theory of Shared and Dual Projections
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrieval powers retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, and question answering, yet the theoretical basis for choosing between shared and dual query-document projections remains unclear. We introduce a bias-variance theory for low-rank bilinear scoring. Shared projections induce positive-semidefinite operators, whereas dual projections realize arbitrary low-rank operators. We derive their exact approximation gap and prove a local Gaussian boundary: dual has lower risk exactly when squared directional signal exceeds the estimation cost of its additional degrees of freedom. This boundary motivates the Cross-fitted Asymmetry Risk Selector (CARS), which estimates reproducible directional signal from training pairs; its Gaussian counterpart admits exact selection-power and regret formulas. Guided by the theory, we run retrieval experiments across multiple datasets and embedding models. The mean Dual-minus-Shared NDCG@10 advantage more than doubles as query rotation increases from 0 degrees to 90 degrees. In the rank-sample-size grids, Shared wins 13 of 16 cells at n=32, whereas Dual wins all 32 cells at n=1024 and n=2048. Consistent with this shift, all 168 comparable operator-risk curves move toward Dual as training data grow. Compared to the two fixed-geometry baselines, CARS reduces held-out regret by 49-96% and achieves 90.1% mean geometry-selection accuracy.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Yancheng Yuan, Jian Huang, and Ruijian Han are joint corresponding authors
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为稠密检索中 shared 与 dual 投影的选择给出偏差-方差理论：dual 仅在方向性信号平方超过其额外自由度的估计代价时风险更低（局部高斯边界），并据此提出 CARS 选择器。实验显示数据量是决定性条件——n=32 时 Shared 在 16 格中赢 13 格，n=1024 与 n=2048 时 Dual 赢全部 32 格；CARS 相对两个固定几何基线把 held-out regret 降低 49–96%，几何选择准确率 90.1%。
Motivation: 稠密检索中 query-document 用共享投影还是双投影缺乏理论判据，实践者只能凭经验固定一种几何，既可能欠拟合方向性信号，也可能在小样本下白付额外自由度的估计代价。
Method: 对低秩双线性打分建立偏差-方差理论：证明 shared 投影诱导半正定 (PSD) 算子、dual 可实现任意低秩算子，导出两者精确逼近间隙与局部高斯边界（dual 风险更低当且仅当方向性信号平方超过其额外自由度的估计代价）；据此提出 Cross-fitted Asymmetry Risk Selector (CARS)，从训练对估计可复现的方向性信号，其高斯对应式给出精确的选择功效与 regret 公式。
Result: 在多个数据集与 embedding 模型上的检索实验：Dual 相对 Shared 的 NDCG@10 平均优势随 query 旋转角从 0 度增至 90 度而翻倍以上；rank-样本量网格中 n=32 时 Shared 赢 16 格中的 13 格，n=1024 与 n=2048 时 Dual 赢全部 32 格；168 条可比的算子风险曲线全部随训练数据增长向 Dual 移动；CARS 相对两个固定几何基线降低 held-out regret 49–96%，几何选择准确率 90.1%。
Conclusion: shared 与 dual 投影没有普适赢家：几何选择应由方向性信号与样本量的比值决定，小样本偏 Shared、大样本或强方向性偏 Dual，CARS 可据训练对数据自动落到正确一侧。

papers.title: Neural Dynamics as the Composition of Quantized Units
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning is commonly interpreted at two levels: the macroscopic, through aggregate trends in loss summarized by scaling laws, and the microscopic, through neurons, features, and circuits. A central challenge is understanding how these levels connect, so that we can explain how elementary computations compose and collectively shape macroscopic behavior. To this end, we study an intermediate abstraction in which training is described as the ordered acquisition of quanta: reusable computations acquired suddenly and binary-activated across examples to reduce loss. By approximating population-gradient updates, we derive quanta's acquisition dynamics. This yields an acquisition priority governed by demand, how frequently a computation is required across examples, and conditional complexity, how difficult that computation is to acquire given those already available. In a Boolean compositional task, we derive predictions for acquisition order and show how staggered discrete acquisitions can produce smooth aggregate loss and, under certain geometries of quanta composition, give rise to scaling laws. We then train a Transformer to map numerals to English number names and recover candidate quanta from its checkpoint trajectory. From these units, we construct a model that preserves much of the Transformer's behavior while exposing interpretable latent computations and acquisition dynamics consistent with the theory. Separately, the quanta structure can serve as training targets to improve transformer generalization. Together, these results suggest the quanta abstraction can provide useful computational atoms for studying a variety of macroscopic phenomena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把训练重述为可复用计算单元 (quanta) 的有序获得：每个 quanta 二值激活、突然习得，其获得顺序由需求（该计算在样本中被需要的频率）与条件复杂度（在已有 quanta 条件下习得的难度）共同决定。错峰的离散获得在特定 quanta 组合几何下能产生平滑的聚合 loss 并导出 scaling law；在 numeral→英文数名的 Transformer 上从 checkpoint 轨迹恢复出候选 quanta，据此重建的模型保留了原 Transformer 的大部分行为，且 quanta 结构可作为训练目标改善泛化。
Motivation: 深度学习的宏观描述（scaling law）与微观描述（神经元、特征、回路）之间缺少连接层，无法解释基本计算如何组合并集体塑造宏观行为。
Method: 通过近似 population-gradient 更新推导 quanta 的获得动力学，得到由 demand 与 conditional complexity 决定的获得优先级；先在 Boolean 组合任务上推导获得顺序的预测，再训练一个把 numeral 映射到英文数名的 Transformer，从其 checkpoint 轨迹中恢复候选 quanta，并用这些单元重建一个保留原模型行为、暴露可解释潜在计算的模型。
Result: 在 Boolean 组合任务上推导出获得顺序的预测，并表明错峰的离散获得可产生平滑的聚合 loss、在特定 quanta 组合几何下导出 scaling law；在 numeral→英文数名任务中从 Transformer checkpoint 轨迹恢复出候选 quanta，重建模型保留了原 Transformer 的大部分行为，其获得动力学与理论一致；quanta 结构作为训练目标可改善 Transformer 泛化。
Conclusion: quanta 这一中间抽象可作为研究各类宏观现象的可计算原子，把微观计算组合与宏观 loss 行为连起来。

papers.title: Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrids for Train-Once, Export-Many Budgeted Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deploying a language model under different computing and latency budgets calls for compact models with different quality-cost trade-offs. Towards this end, elastic spectral state space models provide ordered and temporally decomposed channels that can be truncated, but they are associated with linear time-invariant filters that cannot selectively preserve relevant past information or forget irrelevant information as the context evolves. To address this, we introduce the Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrid (ESSH), which realizes each Hankel spectral channel as an independent recurrent unit using fitted damped rotation modes. It also features an input-dependent decay and write/read gates that make temporal retention and state update input-dependent while preserving channel-wise truncation and a structured recurrence for efficient execution. ESSH combines these selective spectral mixers with sliding-window attention and jointly trains multiple capacities by reducing spectral-channel count and feed-forward width at different rates through a two-rate capacity map with full-model distillation. The resulting models support chunked parallel training and fused recurrent decoding while avoiding computation for discarded channels. At full capacity, ESSH achieves language-modeling quality comparable to similarly sized independently trained models, while smaller exports exhibit a smooth quality-cost trade-off. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework using language understanding, retrieval, cross-domain text, and DNA experiments, by assessing quality retention and the trade-off against independently trained and elastic baselines. At the 1.53B model configuration, fused batch-one decoding takes 1.37 ms per token on a B300, providing a 2.14-2.80x speedup over the tested Mamba-2 and Mamba-3 implementations and 3.03x over Transformer++ at matched parameter counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ESSH 把弹性谱状态空间模型的每个 Hankel 谱通道实现为带阻尼旋转模态的独立递归单元，配合输入依赖的衰减与写/读门控，在保留通道截断的同时让记忆保留随输入变化。用两速率容量图联合训练多容量并做全模型蒸馏，一次训练即可导出不同质量-成本权衡的模型；1.53B 配置下 B300 上批量为 1 的融合解码每 token 1.37 ms，比 Mamba-2/Mamba-3 快 2.14–2.80 倍、比 Transformer++ 快 3.03 倍。
Motivation: 弹性谱 SSM 的通道可截断但滤波器是线时不变的，无法随上下文演化选择性保留相关信息或遗忘无关信息；部署时不同算力与时延预算又需要多档质量-成本权衡的紧凑模型。
Method: ESSH 用拟合的阻尼旋转模态 (fitted damped rotation modes) 把每个 Hankel 谱通道实现为独立递归单元，加入输入依赖衰减与写/读门控，同时保留通道级截断与结构化递归；再与滑窗注意力 (sliding-window attention) 组成选择性谱混合器，通过两速率容量图 (two-rate capacity map) 以不同速率削减谱通道数与前馈宽度，配合全模型蒸馏联合训练多容量，支持分块并行训练与融合递归解码。
Result: 全容量下语言建模质量与同规模独立训练的模型相当，较小导出模型呈平滑的质量-成本权衡；在语言理解、检索、跨领域文本与 DNA 四类实验上对照独立训练与弹性基线评估质量保持与权衡。1.53B 配置下 B300 批量为 1 的融合解码每 token 1.37 ms，在匹配参数量下相对所测 Mamba-2 与 Mamba-3 实现提速 2.14–2.80 倍，相对 Transformer++ 提速 3.03 倍。
Conclusion: 把选择性门控注入可截断的谱递归并配合两速率容量图，可以在一次训练后导出多档预算的模型，且全容量质量不落后于独立训练、解码速度优于 Mamba 与 Transformer 基线。

papers.title: What Should Federated LoRA Share? FedSAIL via Input-aware Subspace Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) requires identifying an update structure that is shared across heterogeneous clients. Prior work reports strong similarity among trained LoRA projection matrices across clients; however, such agreement may be largely induced by common initialization and collapses toward random overlap under independent initialization. More crucially, relying solely on parameter similarity inherently ignores the influence of local input regime. To uncover a more robust shared structure, we introduce an input-aware action matrix that weights the adapter update by the second-moment statistics of local layer inputs. Empirically, while parameter similarity vanishes, the leading right singular directions of this action matrix remain strongly aligned across clients. This shared geometry preserves task-conditioned differences and naturally varies across network depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Federated Subspace-Guided Action-Informed Learning (FedSAIL). Instead of averaging weights, FedSAIL estimates a shared action subspace to regularize local training while preserving client-specific coefficients. Across several benchmarks, our approach consistently improves predictive performance over competing federated LoRA methods while reducing communication cost significantly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦 LoRA 中跨客户端的参数相似性主要由共同初始化诱导，独立初始化下退化为随机重叠，且忽略了本地输入分布。作者提出用本地层输入二阶矩加权的 action matrix，其前几个右奇异方向在客户端间仍强对齐，并随网络深度变化；据此提出 FedSAIL，估计共享 action subspace 来约束本地训练、保留客户端私有系数，在多个基准上同时提升预测性能并显著降低通信开销。
Motivation: 联邦 LoRA 需要找出跨异构客户端共享的更新结构，但既有工作依赖的参数相似性会被共同初始化人为放大，独立初始化下塌缩为随机重叠，且完全忽略本地输入 regime 的影响。
Method: 构造 input-aware action matrix：用本地层输入的二阶矩统计量对 adapter 更新加权；分析其右奇异方向的跨客户端对齐。据此提出 FedSAIL（Federated Subspace-Guided Action-Informed Learning），不直接平均权重，而是估计共享 action subspace 来正则化本地训练，同时保留每客户端的私有系数。
Result: 实证上参数相似性在独立初始化下消失，而 action matrix 的前导右奇异方向在客户端间仍强对齐，且该共享几何保留任务条件差异、随网络深度自然变化。在多个基准上，FedSAIL 相比竞争的联邦 LoRA 方法一致提升预测性能，并显著降低通信开销。
Conclusion: 跨客户端真正可共享的是由输入统计定义的 action subspace 而非权重本身；按子空间而非权重做联邦聚合，能同时改善性能与通信效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)，用 leverage score 迭代选择最大化嵌入数据行列式体积的样本，免去协方差矩阵重算。相比 DiSF 最高 72× 加速、Vendi score 多样性提升 9.2%，CommonCrawl 上七项下游任务最高提 1.31%，StarCoderData 上 bits-per-byte 降 3.08%。
Motivation: 质量过滤会诱发多样性坍缩，偏向教育/QA 风格文本而系统性排除欠代表领域；现有多样化方法要么只间接优化覆盖，要么靠代价高昂的协方差矩阵重算，难以扩展。
Method: Lev 通过 leverage score 迭代选择样本，使嵌入数据的 determinantal volume 最大化，该判据无需矩阵重算即可扩展；在 CommonCrawl 网页数据与 StarCoderData 上做无监督数据集构建。
Result: 相对强多样化基线 DiSF：最高 72× 加速，Vendi score 多样性提升 9.2%；CommonCrawl 选择在七项下游任务上最高提 1.31%；StarCoderData 选择子集 bits-per-byte 降 3.08%。DCLM-fastText 过滤的 CC 数据未能保留足够代码内容，代码表现低于 Lev 选择的数据。
Conclusion: 质量过滤存在跨领域坍缩（代码内容被滤掉），应把 diversity-aware 实践整合进质量过滤以做更有效的预训练数据筛选。

papers.title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMD-EEG 把 EEG 诊断证据与疾病表征拆成两个视图：固定的头皮频谱专家负责诊断，源空间疾病状态则建模为健康神经动力学先验的低秩稀疏迭代形变，二者只在固定决策层融合。在 MDD、FEP、PD 上，决策级融合在 MDD 与 FEP 追平最强单专家、在 PD 超过源分支；高显著性坐标落在已知疾病环路（MDD 的额-边缘-颞区、PD 的运动皮层 beta），且 MDD 状态可按秩迁移到不同导联的未见队列。
Motivation: 闭环神经调控需要的是受试者特异的结构化状态（哪些脑区、哪些频率、哪些滞后异常），而非单一疾病概率；但传感器空间模型丢掉解剖、源空间模型丢掉预测信号，事后归因又游离于预测之外。
Method: 提出 DMD-EEG（Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG）：固定头皮频谱专家做诊断，源空间疾病表征写成健康神经动力学先验的低秩、稀疏、迭代形变，定义在 46 个 ROI × 5 个频率 × 4 个滞后（自相关时间尺度）的空间上；两个专家只在固定决策层相遇，源状态与头皮专家在架构上分离。
Result: 在 MDD、FEP、PD 三个任务上，决策级融合在 MDD 与 FEP 与最强单专家持平，在 PD 超过源分支；FEP 上源专家是最强分支，也是形变贡献最大的任务。高显著性坐标与已知疾病环路对齐（MDD 的额-边缘-颞区、PD 的运动皮层 beta），MDD 状态可按秩迁移到用不同导联记录的未见队列。
Conclusion: 把诊断与疾病表征分成两个视图、只在决策层融合，可以既保住头皮端的预测信号又得到可直接读出、可生成假设的 ROI-频率-滞后源状态，且该状态跨导联可迁移。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SURE 框架，把高层策略（定理选择、子目标分解）与其具体推理分离，用策略条件 rollout 与教师生成对比构造偏好对，训练 Strategy Reward Model 估计相对策略效用，并在 GRPO 中与正确性、格式奖励合并。相比 outcome-and-format GRPO 基线，三个策略骨干上平均 pass@1 分别提升 1.87%、2.64%、2.93%，且 GRPO 阶段算力显著更低。
Motivation: 只看最终正确性的可验证奖励 RL 无法区分高层策略本身的好坏，因为策略质量与其后续执行混在一起，难以对定理选择、子目标分解这类抽象决策给出信号。
Method: SURE 将高层策略从详细推理中抽取出来；用策略条件 rollout 和 teacher 生成的对比构造成对偏好，训练 Strategy Reward Model 估计相对策略效用；RL 阶段冻结该奖励模型，只读取抽取的策略，其分数与正确性、格式奖励一起进入 sequence-level GRPO 目标。
Result: 相对 outcome-and-format GRPO 基线，SURE 在三个策略骨干上平均 pass@1 分别提升 1.87%、2.64%、2.93%；相对更强的奖励基线达到有竞争力或更好的准确率，同时 GRPO 阶段算力需求显著更低。
Conclusion: 把策略效用作为独立于执行的相对奖励来学，可以在更低 GRPO 算力下提升数学推理的 pass@1，说明终端正确性之外的策略级信号确实有用。

papers.title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

TL;DR: 把 JEPA 的掩码解释为线性测量：小波基下支撑完全落在隐藏区的原子落在零空间，目标若可被低层先验恢复就产生捷径，只有掩码留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容才迫使编码器学语义。151 次预训练中，ImageNet-100 上 block 掩码 64.3% linear top-1，strip 40.3%、random 40.8%；同一几何族内留下最少不可恢复内容的放置比最多者低 6.5 分，pixel 目标跨度 7 分而 latent 目标跨度 25 分，冻结 target encoder 后 random 与 block 的 19 分差缩到 1.5。
Motivation: JEPA 对掩码方式异常敏感（block 有效、random 无效），但现有解释停留在经验层面，缺少能事先打分并给出可检验预测的机制说明。
Method: 把掩码建模为线性测量，用紧支撑小波基刻画零空间与不可恢复内容并给出训练前打分；在 151 次预训练中检验该解释的独特预测，比较掩码几何、pixel 与 latent 目标、以及冻结 target encoder 的对照，数据集为 ImageNet-100 与 UCF101，并在 V-JEPA 自带掩码上做消融。
Result: ImageNet-100：strip 掩码 40.3% linear top-1、random 40.8%、block 64.3%；同一几何族内留下最少不可恢复内容者比最多者低 6.5 分（五个 seed 对）；pixel 目标跨度 7 分、latent 目标跨度 25 分；冻结 target 下 random 与 block 差距从 19 分缩到 1.5（同款 GPU）。UCF101：整帧移除在两种掩码比例下都最差；V-JEPA 掩码原样批处理 36.0% 对截断 35.1%，块内放可见 100 个 target token 提到 48.7%，块外隐藏 100 个 context token 则为 33.7%。
Conclusion: 掩码几何是通过 target encoder 自己生成的目标起作用的：决定预训练成败的是掩码留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容与每个目标可达的上下文量，而非面积或连通性本身。

papers.title: Fast and Precise Learned Charged-Particle Trajectory Regression at the Large Hadron Collider
papers.abstract_en: We propose a training recipe that treats charged-particle trajectory parameter regression on high-energy physics detector data as a sequence-modeling task. Kalman filters and linearized least-squares fits have been the classical standard approach for this task: they are optimal estimators for sparsely sampled linear-Gaussian data and are commonly used for trajectory parameter regression (fitting). The classical fitting techniques implemented for this domain reach a final precision of one part in $10^5$ through detailed modeling of detector geometry, material, detection effects and precise numerical integration of the equations of motion through the detector's inhomogeneous magnetic field. With this study, we demonstrate that using a bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder, one is able to reproduce the full precision of classical track fitting techniques. Using a custom kernel, we also achieve significantly higher throughput during GPU inference, compared to classical fitting software running on similarly priced multi-core CPU servers representing typically employed hardware. Such a speedup would lead to considerable cost savings for the pattern recognition at the Large Hadron Collider. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end learned track fit to reach the full precision and, at the same time, offer the opportunity to reduce the computing costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LHC 探测器上的带电粒子径迹参数回归改写成序列建模任务，用双向门控线性循环编码器 (bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder) 直接复现经典 Kalman filter / 线性最小二乘拟合的精度。自定义 kernel 使 GPU 推理吞吐显著高于同价位多核 CPU 上的经典拟合软件，作者称这是首个同时达到经典全精度并可降低计算成本的端到端学习径迹拟合。
Motivation: 经典径迹拟合靠精细建模探测器几何、物质与磁场数值积分才能达到 10^5 分之一的精度，计算成本高，而 LHC 的径迹模式识别需要极高吞吐。
Method: 把轨迹参数回归当作序列建模：以双向门控线性循环编码器 (bidirectional gated linear recurrent encoder) 作为回归模型，配合自定义 CUDA kernel 做 GPU 推理，训练配方对标经典 Kalman filter 与线性化最小二乘拟合的输出精度。
Result: 经典拟合在该域达到 10^5 分之一 (one part in 10^5) 的最终精度，学习模型复现了这一全精度；GPU 推理吞吐相比运行在同价位多核 CPU 服务器上的经典拟合软件显著更高（摘要未给出具体倍数）。
Conclusion: 学习式径迹拟合可以在不牺牲经典精度的前提下大幅提高吞吐，从而为 LHC 的模式识别节省计算成本；作者称此为首个同时满足全精度与降本的端到端学习径迹拟合。

papers.title: Agnostic Smoothed Online Regression with Adversarial Responses
papers.abstract_en: We study smoothed online prediction with bounded adversarial responses. This widely studied framework bridges i.i.d. sampling and adversarial covariate selection through a smoothness parameter $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$, which bounds conditional covariate densities relative to a fixed, unknown base measure. We propose \textsc{Hedge-Cover}, an information-theoretic algorithm that achieves sublinear regret $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ for function classes with bounded pseudo-dimension. The algorithm aggregates a carefully constructed family of experts using \textsc{Hedge}, with a prior that links regret to the number of disagreements between a consistent selector and a target function. We bound this number by exploiting covariate smoothness. This answers an open problem posed in \cite{blanchard2025agnostic} on the minimax optimal adaptive regret of the smoothed online regression problem. We establish a matching lower bound for the class of linear predictors. The main intricacy of the lower bound lies in explicitly constructing a challenging sequential covariate distribution supported on mutually orthogonal hyperplanes. This construction may be of independent technical interest. Finally, we revisit the well-specified setting and quantify the effect of response noise. For conditionally $ν^2$-subGaussian responses, we extend the existing lower bound under realizable responses by showing that the minimax expected regret is $Ω((1\vee ν)\sqrt{(\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}-1)dT})$ for a function class of VC dimension $d$. A corresponding upper bound for ERM matches this dependence on $ν$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有界对抗响应的平滑在线回归中提出 Hedge-Cover：用与一致选择器同目标函数的分歧数构造先验，经 Hedge 聚合专家族，得到次线性后悔 Õ(√(Pdim(F)·C_cov·T))，并给出线性预测类的匹配下界，回答了 blanchard2025agnostic 提出的开放问题。
Motivation: 平滑在线回归的 minimax 最优自适应后悔此前是开放问题：i.i.d. 与对抗协变量选择之间的平滑度参数 C_cov 下，缺少与伪维度匹配的上界与下界。
Method: Hedge-Cover 用信息论方式经 Hedge 聚合一族专家，先验把后悔与一致选择器到目标函数的分歧数挂钩，再利用协变量平滑性 (C_cov) 界住该分歧数；下界在互正交超平面上构造困难的序贯协变量分布；另在条件 ν²-次高斯响应下扩展可实现情形的下界并给出 ERM 上界。
Result: 上界 Õ(√(Pdim(F)·C_cov·T))，对线性预测类给出匹配下界；条件 ν²-次高斯响应下 VC 维 d 的 minimax 期望后悔为 Ω((1∨ν)·√((C_cov−1)dT))，ERM 上界在 ν 依赖上与之匹配。
Conclusion: 平滑在线回归的 minimax 最优自适应后悔由 √(Pdim·C_cov·T) 刻画，响应噪声 ν 以 (1∨ν) 因子进入下界且 ERM 可达；正交超平面上的协变量构造本身有独立技术价值。

papers.title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
papers.abstract_en: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自监督框架 Back-Tracking：用现有 text spotting 模型在大而清晰文字上的高置信检测作为监督，沿视频时间轴向前回溯 (temporally back-tracking) 这些检测，为远处仍模糊、过小的前序帧合成伪标签，从而免人工标注地训练一个专攻远距离早期文字检测的学生模型。核心依赖一个专门的 scene text tracker 在困难视频序列中保持文字身份一致，并配套发布多语种户外数据集 SceneText50。
Motivation: 远距离场景文字通常小、模糊，常规 scene text detector 经常漏检；为这类样本做人工标注成本高，需要一种能自动生成监督信号的训练方式。
Method: 以现有 text spotting 模型在大而清晰文字上的高置信检测为伪标签源，通过视频序列时间回溯把检测传播到更早、文字仍退化的帧；用专门设计的 scene text tracker 跨帧维持文字身份一致以保证伪标签质量；学生模型据此训练，无需人工标注，并提出多语种户外数据集 SceneText50 用于训练与评测。
Result: 实验显示该框架在多种场景与语言上显著提升早期文字检测的准确率与鲁棒性；配套发布 SceneText50 多语种户外数据集与代码（github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText）。
Conclusion: 以清晰文字上的可靠检测为时间回溯监督源，可以在不标注的前提下把 scene text detector 的检测能力向远距离、退化文字前推；伪标签生成的准确性由专用 text tracker 保障。

papers.title: VPEvolve: A Self-Evolving Virtual Process Engineer for Computational Lithography
papers.abstract_en: Optical proximity correction (OPC) recipes grow as engineers add local rules to repair newly discovered lithography hotspots. Each correction can interact with existing rules, while lessons from commercial-tool trials remain scattered across code and logs. \system combines a Virtual Process Engineer (VPE) harness with a Skill Bank of measured engineering experience. The harness equips a frozen language model with process manuals, layout analysis, recipe editing, and commercial-tool evaluation. The actor proposes changes to the global parameters, local targeted rules, or diagnostic trials. After each evaluation, an LLM reflector and curator turn the measured response into evidence-linked judgments. The actor retrieves them before its next trial. Feasible improvements update the retained recipe; every measured trial informs the Skill Bank that guides the next edit. The model weights remain fixed. On a FreePDK45-derived benchmark with ten commercial-tool evaluations per case, \system reduces the mean per-case maximum edge placement error from 18.294 to 5.361 nm on Poly and from 22.052 to 15.692 nm on Metal1. Every final recipe satisfies the predefined quality constraints and improves the maximum error by at least 0.1 nm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VPEvolve 用冻结语言模型加 Skill Bank 让虚拟工艺工程师 (VPE) 自演化地改 OPC recipe：actor 提出全局参数、局部规则或诊断试验改动，LLM reflector/curator 把每次商业工具评测结果转成带证据的判断存回 Skill Bank 供下次检索。在 FreePDK45 派生基准（每例 10 次商业工具评测）上，Poly 最大边缘放置误差 (EPE) 均值从 18.294 nm 降到 5.361 nm，Metal1 从 22.052 nm 降到 15.692 nm，全部最终 recipe 满足预设质量约束且最大误差至少改善 0.1 nm。
Motivation: OPC recipe 随工程师不断补局部规则而膨胀，新修正会与既有规则相互作用，商业工具试错经验又散落在代码和日志里，难以沉淀复用。
Method: VPE harness 给冻结的语言模型配备工艺手册、版图分析、recipe 编辑与商业工具评测能力；actor 提出对全局参数、局部规则或诊断试验的改动，每次评测后由 LLM reflector 与 curator 将实测响应转成证据关联的判断，actor 在下一次试验前检索这些判断，可行改进写回 recipe，全部实测试验汇入 Skill Bank 指导后续编辑，模型权重保持固定。
Result: FreePDK45 派生基准、每例 10 次商业工具评测：Poly 上每例最大 EPE 均值 18.294 → 5.361 nm，Metal1 上 22.052 → 15.692 nm；每个最终 recipe 都满足预设质量约束，且最大误差至少改善 0.1 nm。
Conclusion: 在模型权重不更新的前提下，把评测结果沉淀为可检索的 Skill Bank 判断，就足以让 actor 持续改进 OPC recipe 并同时满足质量约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Pitfalls of Verbalized Confidence Priors for Calibrating Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often suffer from overconfidence when expressing their uncertainty. Confidence-aware reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising way to optimize calibration. However, it relies on on-policy rollouts and is thus constrained by the model's pre-RL confidence distribution, which we term confidence prior. In this work, we reveal that off-the-shelf LRMs exhibit a confidence prior heavily concentrated on a few high values, which persists throughout RL. Theoretically, we prove that this concentration suppresses policy gradient updates for rarely sampled confidence values and inflates the lower bound on expected Brier risk. To overcome this exploration bottleneck, we propose CalibSFT, a plug-and-play supervised fine-tuning stage that shapes a calibrated confidence prior with broad support before RL. For each question, CalibSFT constructs confidence targets combining its success rate with response-level correctness, which provably preserves proper-scoring optimality, and then balances training responses across the confidence spectrum to enable diverse confidence exploration during RL. To learn from incorrect responses without imitating their reasoning, CalibSFT introduces correctness-conditional supervision, guiding confidence across all responses while supervising reasoning only on correct ones. Across 16 mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks, incorporating CalibSFT reduces calibration errors and improves discrimination across five representative RL algorithms while preserving comparable accuracy. Furthermore, CalibSFT delivers practical benefits for downstream selective prediction and model routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/ml-stat-Sustech/verbalized-confidence-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 大推理模型 (LRM) 的口头置信度先验集中在少数高值上，且在 RL 全程持续，理论上会压制低频置信度值的策略梯度更新并抬高期望 Brier 风险下界。提出 CalibSFT：在 RL 前用成功率加响应级正确性构造置信度目标、按置信度谱均衡采样响应做 SFT，塑造支撑更宽的校准先验。在 16 个数学与通用推理基准上，接入 CalibSFT 后五种代表性 RL 算法的校准误差下降、判别力提升，准确率保持相当。
Motivation: 置信度感知 RL 依赖 on-policy rollout，被模型 RL 前的置信度先验（confidence prior）锁死；现成 LRM 的先验集中在少数高值，形成探索瓶颈，稀有置信度值几乎得不到梯度更新。
Method: CalibSFT 是 RL 前的即插即用 SFT 阶段：对每道题用成功率与响应级正确性组合构造置信度目标（可证明保持 proper-scoring 最优性），再在置信度谱上均衡训练响应以支持 RL 中的多样置信度探索；用 correctness-conditional supervision 在错误响应上只学置信度、只在正确响应上监督推理。
Result: 在 16 个数学与通用推理基准上，加入 CalibSFT 后五种代表性 RL 算法的校准误差均降低、判别力 (discrimination) 提升，同时准确率保持相当；理论结果给出置信度集中对策略梯度更新的压制与期望 Brier 风险下界的抬高；在下游选择性预测 (selective prediction) 与模型路由 (model routing) 上带来实际收益。
Conclusion: 口头置信度先验的集中是置信度感知 RL 的根本瓶颈，先用 SFT 塑造支撑更宽的校准先验再做 RL，可在不损失准确率的前提下改善校准与判别力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PULSE: Identifying Demonstration-Utility Features with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning is highly sensitive to demonstration choice, yet most methods select demonstrations using external query-demonstration similarity. Such criteria can miss model-specific signals: Similar demonstrations may activate different internal features and downstream behaviors. We introduce PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings), an SAE-based framework for identifying model-internal features associated with demonstration utility and using them for demonstration selection. Using a small labeled discovery set, PULSE samples candidate demonstration sets, measures their zero-shot-relative utility under the target model, and scores SAE features by how their activation differences align with utility differences. The top positive and negative coordinates form a sparse utility-localization vector. We use this vector in two complementary ways: as a signed score for controlled complete-set ranking, and as PULSE-Retriever, which converts its magnitude into a feature-relevance mask for scalable pool-scale retrieval. Across classification, generation, and reasoning benchmarks, PULSE-Retriever improves over the strongest baseline by 2-3 accuracy points, 0.6-0.9 BLEU-4, and 3.2 exact-match points, respectively, while controlled ranking validates the identified features encode a predictive set-level utility signal. Feature inspection and cross-dataset experiments suggest that the identified features capture task-relevant, dataset-conditioned patterns, yet retain utility signals that partially transfer across datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/aohenuo/PULSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PULSE 用 sparse autoencoder (SAE) 从模型内部激活中定位与示例效用相关的特征，替代外部 query-demonstration 相似度选示例：在小规模标注发现集上采样候选示例集，测其相对 zero-shot 的效用，按激活差与效用差的对齐程度给 SAE 特征打分，取正负坐标构成稀疏 utility-localization 向量。该向量既做完整示例集排序的带符号打分，也作为 PULSE-Retriever 的特征相关性掩码做池级检索；在分类、生成、推理基准上分别比最强基线高 2–3 个准确率点、0.6–0.9 BLEU-4 和 3.2 个 exact-match 点。
Motivation: 示例选择普遍依赖外部的 query-demonstration 相似度，而相似示例在模型内部可能激活不同特征与下游行为，从而漏掉模型特有的效用信号。
Method: PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings)：用小规模标注发现集采样候选示例集，测其在目标模型上的 zero-shot-relative utility，按 SAE 特征激活差与效用差的对齐打分，取最高正负坐标组成稀疏 utility-localization 向量；该向量带符号用于受控完整集排序，其幅值转成特征相关性掩码供 PULSE-Retriever 做池级检索。
Result: 在分类、生成、推理三类基准上，PULSE-Retriever 相对最强基线分别提升 2–3 个准确率点、0.6–0.9 BLEU-4、3.2 个 exact-match 点；受控排序验证所识别特征编码了可预测的集合级效用信号，特征检视与跨数据集实验显示这些特征捕捉任务相关、数据集条件化的模式，并保留可部分跨数据集迁移的效用信号。
Conclusion: 模型内部的 SAE 效用特征可作为示例选择的有效依据，且比外部相似度更贴合模型自身行为；识别出的特征既依赖数据集条件，也带有可部分迁移的效用信息。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Bison: Cross-Dataset Learning for Unseen-Compound Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptional responses to unseen compounds is limited by fragmented chemical coverage and heterogeneous experimental platforms and gene panels. To assess molecular generalization across these settings, we build on Chem-PerturBridge to benchmark eight datasets with 16,771 compounds, withholding test compounds from every training dataset. This comparison reveals that high overall response agreement can coexist with weak prediction of drug-specific differences, despite reproducible signals across repeated measurements. To exploit complementary chemical supervision while targeting these differences, we introduce Bison: a shared gene representation connects native panels, while two discrete diffusion models compose context-dependent responses with molecular deviations learned through matched drug-contrast supervision. A single Bison model jointly trained across all eight datasets achieves the highest mean overall-response and drug-contrast Pearson correlations on the full benchmark in comparison with 11 methods trained independently per dataset. Compared with dataset-specific training of the same architecture, joint training increases mean drug-contrast correlation by 27.4\%, with gains across all eight datasets and improvements in overall response prediction. These results demonstrate how matched drug contrasts turn complementary screens into shared molecular supervision for unseen-drug response prediction while preserving native gene measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Bison 用共享基因表征打通八个转录组扰动数据集的原生基因面板，并用两个离散扩散模型分别合成上下文相关响应与经配对药物对比监督学到的分子偏差。在 16,771 个化合物、测试化合物从每个训练集全部留出的基准上，单一联合训练的 Bison 在 11 个逐数据集独立训练的方法中取得最高的总体响应与药物对比 Pearson 相关；相比同架构的数据集专属训练，药物对比相关平均提升 27.4%，且八个数据集全部获益。
Motivation: 未见化合物的转录响应预测受化学覆盖碎片化与实验平台/基因面板异构限制；整体响应高度一致可能掩盖药物特异差异预测很弱。
Method: 在 Chem-PerturBridge 之上构建八数据集基准（16,771 个化合物，测试化合物从每个训练集留出）；Bison 以共享基因表征连接各原生面板，用两个离散扩散模型分别生成上下文相关响应与分子偏差，后者由配对药物对比 (matched drug-contrast) 监督约束，单一模型跨全部八集联合训练。
Result: 在完整基准上，联合训练的单一 Bison 相比 11 个逐数据集独立训练的方法取得最高的平均总体响应 Pearson 相关与药物对比 Pearson 相关；与同架构的数据集专属训练相比，平均药物对比相关提升 27.4%，八个数据集均有增益，总体响应预测同时改善。
Conclusion: 配对药物对比能把互补的化学筛选转成共享分子监督，在保留原生基因测量的同时提升未见药物响应预测，且联合跨数据集训练优于逐数据集独立训练。

papers.title: PolyStepOR: Learning to Decide Without Optimal Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors for downstream decision quality, but often relies on optimal reference decisions that are expensive to obtain. We present PolyStepOR, which trains directly from realized decision costs without pre-computed optima and extends to in-constraint predictions through repair or infeasibility penalties. To handle piecewise-constant losses, PolyStepOR perturbs predictor parameters, evaluates the resulting decisions, and uses optimal transport to favor lower-cost directions, requiring no derivatives. Without task-specific tuning, PolyStepOR performs strongly on classical optimization benchmarks and competitively on predicted-constraint and real-world problems. Theoretically, we characterize decision-preserving perturbations and boundary detection, bound sensitivity to cost errors, and establish stationarity guarantees for a smoothed objective. PolyStepOR thus replaces optimal reference decisions and derivatives with forward evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyStepOR 在没有最优参考决策、损失分段常数的情况下，直接用已实现的决策成本训练预测器：扰动预测器参数、前向求解决策，再用 optimal transport 挑选更低成本的扰动方向，完全不需要导数。对预测约束问题通过修复或不可行惩罚扩展，理论上给出决策保持扰动与边界检测刻画、成本误差敏感性上界以及平滑目标的平稳性保证。
Motivation: 决策聚焦学习 (DFL) 通常依赖最优参考决策作为训练信号，而这类参考解获取昂贵；分段常数损失又使基于梯度的优化失效。
Method: PolyStepOR 直接从已实现的决策成本学习，不预计算最优解；对预测器参数施加扰动，求解扰动后得到的决策，用 optimal transport 在决策空间中偏好更低成本的参数方向，全程无需导数。对预测约束场景引入 repair 与 infeasibility penalty 两种处理，使模型能给出满足约束的预测。
Result: 在无需任务特定调参的设置下，PolyStepOR 在经典优化基准上表现强劲，在带预测约束与真实世界问题上具有竞争力；理论部分刻画了决策保持扰动与边界检测，给出对成本误差的敏感性界，并为平滑目标建立平稳性保证。
Conclusion: 最优参考决策与导数都可以用前向评估替代：只要能反复求解决策并读到成本，DFL 就能在分段常数损失下训练并保留理论保证。

papers.title: Adapting Nonstationary Multi-output Gaussian Processes to Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) commonly relies on independent Gaussian processes (GPs) with stationary kernels, limiting its ability to represent nonstationary structure and share information between objectives. However, expressive nonstationary GPs do not necessarily make reliable BO decisions. We study this mismatch for the multi-output low-rank nonstationary (MO-LRN) GP: strong training fit can coexist with large off-design errors and optimistic acquisition predictions. We introduce MOLRN-BO, which combines a regularized shared-spectral surrogate with objective-specific residuals, prequential mean correction and tempered covariance scaling, and Pareto-local qLogEHVI optimization with periodic global search. Experiments on 12 deterministic bi-objective benchmarks show that MOLRN-BO substantially improves upon the original MO-LRN and achieves the best average problem ranks for final normalized hypervolume and normalized inverted generational distance among nine evaluated algorithms. It also achieves the strongest adverse-tail performance while remaining competitive with the leading baselines in anytime optimization. Ablation studies further show that the shared spectral construction improves off-design prediction, the local--global decision policy improves optimization performance, and hierarchical calibration reduces systematic candidate bias. These results demonstrate that nonstationary multi-output surrogates can deliver strong and robust MOBO performance when their structure and use are explicitly adapted to the demands of sequential optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOLRN-BO 把非平稳多输出 GP 从「拟合好但决策不可靠」改造成可用的多目标贝叶斯优化代理：正则化共享谱代理加目标特定残差，配合 prequential 均值校正与温化协方差缩放，再用 Pareto 局部 qLogEHVI 加周期性全局搜索做采集优化。在 12 个确定性双目标基准上，它在九个算法中取得最终归一化超体积与归一化反世代距离的最优平均问题排名。
Motivation: MOBO 常用独立平稳核 GP，既表达不了非平稳结构也不能在目标间共享信息；但更强表达力的非平稳 GP（如 MO-LRN）会出现训练拟合强、设计点外误差大、采集预测过于乐观的错配，导致 BO 决策失准。
Method: MOLRN-BO 由三部分组成：正则化共享谱代理加目标特定残差 (objective-specific residuals)；prequential 均值校正与温化协方差缩放 (tempered covariance scaling)；Pareto 局部 qLogEHVI 优化加周期性全局搜索的局部-全局决策策略。另做消融分别检验共享谱构造、局部-全局策略与分层校准的作用。
Result: 在 12 个确定性双目标基准、共九个被评算法上，MOLRN-BO 显著优于原始 MO-LRN，最终归一化超体积与归一化反世代距离 (normalized IGD) 的平均问题排名均为最优；在不利尾部 (adverse-tail) 表现上最强，anytime 优化上与领先基线相当。消融显示共享谱构造改善设计点外预测，局部-全局决策策略改善优化表现，分层校准 (hierarchical calibration) 降低系统性候选偏差。
Conclusion: 非平稳多输出代理只要针对序贯优化的使用方式显式改造结构与决策流程，就能在 MOBO 中给出强且稳健的表现，而不必牺牲表达力。

papers.title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIDE 基准用 5,869 个「动作-原描述-扰动描述」三元组审计动作-语言评估器 (motion-language evaluator) 的结构 grounding 能力，发现被审评估器时序与镜像结构 grounding 普遍偏弱、镜像敏感性严重缺失，而常规评测协议暴露不出这些问题。把结构 hard negatives 加进对比学习，时序顺序与镜像反射上的表现显著提升。
Motivation: 动作-语言模型靠 motion-language evaluator 打分，但这些评估器能否跟踪语言结构（时序、镜像、动作身份）本身未经检验；现有数据集上的朴素扰动测试可被纯文本先验解掉，常规检索与分布度量对镜像破坏几乎无反应。
Method: STRIDE 含 5,869 个三元组（动作、原描述、扰动描述），覆盖长短描述；对 caption 对做 likelihood balancing 以削弱 text-only bias，并在无关动作下测评估器的 caption 偏好，作为匹配动作带来的 discrimination gain 基线；再审计评估器并测试结构 hard negatives 对对比学习的改动。
Result: 被审评估器结构 grounding 弱、镜像敏感性严重缺失，常规评测协议无法暴露；纯文本先验即可在既有数据集上解出朴素扰动测试，检索与分布指标对镜像 ground-truth 破坏几乎不响应；加入结构 hard negatives 的对比学习改动显著改善时序顺序与镜像反射表现。
Conclusion: 评估器的结构 grounding 缺陷被现行评测掩盖，需用 likelihood 平衡的结构 hard negatives 才能测出并改进；基准与代码将发布。

papers.title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
papers.abstract_en: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REMEDY 是首个面向 AI 生成医学教学演示的基准：用 900 张真实演示首帧覆盖 4 类场景 12 项任务，让 5 个开源视频生成模型各出视频共 4,500 条，按临床动作遵循、临床画像、视频质量、运动质量四维评测。结果显示画面真实与时序一致并不等于临床动作正确，最强的 MiniMax-H3 严格临床成功率也只有 28.25%。
Motivation: 视频生成模型被视为世界模型的基础，但生成医学教学演示同时要求视觉可信与动作精准，此前没有任何基准测量过现有生成器能否达到这两条要求。
Method: 构建 REMEDY 基准：900 张来自真实演示视频的首帧，覆盖手术室、影像、门诊与床旁、复苏四类场景共 12 项任务；5 个当代开源视频生成模型据此生成 4,500 条视频，把任务专用临床检查表与视频质量、运动质量指标结合，从临床动作遵循、临床画像、视频质量、运动质量四个维度评测。
Result: 共 900 张首帧、12 项任务、4 类场景、5 个模型、4,500 条生成视频；最先进模型 MiniMax-H3 的严格临床成功率 (strict clinical success rate) 仅 28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍是难点，且画面真实与时间一致性并不保证临床动作正确。
Conclusion: 当前视频生成模型离医学教育世界模型仍有距离：视觉与时间质量的提升不会自动带来正确的临床动作，需要以临床检查表驱动的细粒度动作评测来牵引后续开发。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Write Back the $Δ$: Revisiting the Same Tokens with Fresh Representations
papers.abstract_en: Transformers process information strictly forward through depth, preventing deeper computation from revisiting and refining earlier representations. To augment the standard forward pass, existing approaches either re-execute depth, incurring additional computation, or modify the residual stream using predefined directions, limiting their instance-level adaptation. Recently, inference-time feedback offers a direct mechanism for recycling endogenously produced computation by writing deeper residual states back to earlier layers, yet what should be fed back remains unclear. We argue that the depth increment Delta, capturing newly accumulated computation between two layers, provides a more effective, composable, and scalable feedback signal than the full state. Building on this observation, we introduce ReFlux, a learnable feedback graph that dynamically selects and composes increment-carrying routes. ReFlux supports synchronous feedback to the same token and streaming feedback to subsequent tokens. Extensive experiments across various models, corpora, and benchmarks show that synchronous ReFlux consistently reduces perplexity across ten language-modeling corpora, and improves accuracy by 2.1-2.3 points, with gains reaching 4.7 points on multi-hop reasoning. Streaming ReFlux further retains most of these gains while preserving the base model's 1x theoretical backbone FLOPs. These results establish ReFlux as an efficient paradigm for unlocking the latent computational potential of LLMs, allowing them to revisit the same tokens with fresh representations. Code implementation can be found at https://github.com/gooogleshanghai/reflux.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReFlux 把 Transformer 深度增量 Δ（两层之间新累积的计算）作为推理时反馈信号，用可学习的反馈图动态选择并组合携带增量的路径，把深层残差状态写回早期层让同一 token 被重新访问。同步反馈在十个语言建模语料上一致降低困惑度并把准确率提高 2.1–2.3 点，多-hop 推理最高提升 4.7 点；流式反馈保留大部分增益且保持基座 1x 理论 FLOPs。
Motivation: Transformer 只能沿深度前向传播，深层计算无法回头精化早期表示；现有补救要么重跑深度增加计算，要么按预设方向改残差流，缺少实例级自适应，而推理时反馈该喂什么一直不清楚。
Method: 以深度增量 Δ 而非完整状态作为反馈信号，提出可学习反馈图 ReFlux，动态选择并组合携带增量的路由；支持对同一 token 的同步反馈与对后续 token 的流式反馈，在多种模型、语料与基准上做推理时实验。
Result: 同步 ReFlux 在十个语言建模语料上一致降低 perplexity，准确率提升 2.1–2.3 点，多-hop 推理上最高达 4.7 点；流式 ReFlux 保留大部分增益，同时保持基座模型 1x 理论 backbone FLOPs。
Conclusion: 深度增量是比完整状态更有效、可组合、可扩展的反馈信号，ReFlex 据此成为在不增加骨干 FLOPs 的前提下释放 LLM 潜在计算能力的范式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
papers.abstract_en: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 WorldScope：用可能世界语义构建部分观测下的视觉推理基准与模型，WorldFlow 把跨视角实体证据与支撑面覆盖组合成图像子集证据格 (evidence lattice)，用反事实世界 (counterworld) 兼容性与转移目标训练子集表示。在 WorldScope-Bench 5,000 题测试集上 exact accuracy 达 64.34%，比同一 backbone 仅用 QA 训练高 24.88 个百分点，结构不相交场景的 3,000 题上保持 50.43%。
Motivation: 遮挡与未见区域使同一视觉证据兼容多个世界状态，现有世界模型缺少刻画“哪些结论被观测支持、哪些仍开放”的数据与表示框架。
Method: 发布 WorldScope-1.2M：120 万英文问答对，覆盖 8 种世界属性、10 类任务接口、3 种观测协议，答案区分已确认事实、可支持边界与未决可能；另含 4,800 组 certified counterworld（基础观测相同、隐藏物体配置与答案不同）。WorldFlow 将跨视角实体证据与支撑面覆盖组合为图像子集证据格，以 counterworld 兼容性与转移目标训练子集表示，共享答案生成器输出最强可支持结论。

papers.title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuacamFM 把相机旋转的四元数单位模长约束贯穿 flow matching 的整条流轨迹，用球面线性插值 (slerp) 构造四元数流的最优传输，避免把四元数当无约束 4D 向量导致的非光滑、次优生成轨迹。在 CO3Dv2 上，其相机位姿精度优于基于扩散的方法、经典 SfM，以及把标准 flow matching 直接套在 4D 四元数上的做法，并能跨数据集与野外样本泛化。
Motivation: 稀疏视角下几何约束不足，SfM 与 bundle adjustment 得到的相机位姿本身存在歧义；现有概率生成方法用单位四元数表示旋转却在生成中忽略单位模长约束，产生非光滑、次优的轨迹。
Method: 提出四元数约束的 flow matching 框架 QuacamFM，在整条流轨迹上保持单位四元数表示；用球面线性插值 (slerp) 设计四元数流的最优传输 (optimal transport)，并与标准 flow matching 直接作用于 4D 四元数的朴素版本对比。
Result: 在 CO3Dv2 上，相机位姿精度优于基于扩散的方法与经典 SfM；相比把标准 flow matching 朴素应用于 4D 四元数的版本，在稀疏视角相机位姿估计上更优；并观察到跨数据集与野外样本的良好泛化。
Conclusion: 把四元数的单位模长约束和 slerp 最优传输一起放进 flow matching，能改善稀疏视角下生成式相机位姿估计的精度与泛化性。

papers.title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/CHASE
papers.journal_ref: Liu, M., Wen, Y., Zhang, Y. et al. De-biasing Skeleton-Based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift. Int J Comput Vis 134, 443 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHASE 把骨架动作识别中的实体偏差归因于世界坐标系原点选择，提出凸包自适应平移归一化：参数化网络把世界原点限制在骨架凸包内以避免不收敛，再用成对分布距离的辅助目标进一步压低偏差，并用子实体策略统一单实体与多实体动作。在 7 个数据集上与多种骨干和骨架内模态（骨、速度）结合，显著提升识别性能。
Motivation: 骨架动作与交互识别常用 late fusion 并假设各实体独立同分布以训练权值共享的实体编码器，但各类骨架数据中观测到的实体偏差违反该假设，导致骨干模型次优优化甚至误识别；偏差源自世界坐标系初始配置中原点的选择。
Method: CHASE 是一种即插即用的归一化方法：参数化网络对输入骨架自适应施加平移，并约束平移后的世界原点落在骨架凸包内以缩小搜索空间、避免不收敛；辅以成对分布距离 (pair-wise distribution distances) 构成的辅助目标引导优化；再用子实体 (sub-entity) 策略统一单实体与多实体动作，并兼容骨、速度等骨架内模态。
Result: 在 7 个数据集上的大量实验中，CHASE 可无缝对接多种骨干网络并显著提升其在各类骨架动作与交互识别任务上的性能。
Conclusion: 实体偏差本质上是坐标原点选择带来的表示偏差，把它当作归一化问题处理即可让后续分类器在多样设置下取得更好的识别结果，且该方法可作为即插即用模块适配不同骨干与模态。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. We introduce DRAM (Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory), a plug-and-play memory module that can be attached to a wide range of pretrained robotic policies, endowing them with long-horizon memory without architectural modification or backbone retraining, requiring only task-specific post-training of the memory module and action expert. DRAM maintains a fixed-size associative memory using gated delta-rule linear attention, with a modified update that incorporates all tokens within each frame in parallel. An architecture-agnostic readout integrates historical context into action prediction across different policy architectures. Experiments show that DRAM consistently improves frozen pretrained policies over short-context baselines and alternative compact memory designs, validating its effectiveness as a fixed-size, post-hoc memory module trained with the backbone frozen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRAM 是可插拔的长期记忆模块，用门控 delta-rule 线性注意力维护固定大小的联想记忆，并行纳入每帧全部 token，通过架构无关的 readout 把历史上下文注入动作预测；在冻结预训练机器人策略上仅后训练记忆模块与动作专家，实验中一致优于短上下文基线与其他紧凑记忆设计。
Motivation: 机器人操作本质依赖历史，但多数预训练策略只看当前观测或短窗口；喂多帧观测会大幅抬高推理成本，依赖预定义语义特征则限制任务通用性且常需重训 backbone。
Method: DRAM 以门控 delta-rule 线性注意力维护固定大小联想记忆，更新规则改为一帧内所有 token 并行写入；架构无关 readout 将历史上下文接入动作预测，backbone 保持冻结，只对记忆模块与动作专家做任务后训练，无需改动架构。
Result: 实验显示 DRAM 在冻结的预训练策略上一致优于短上下文基线与替代的紧凑记忆设计，验证其作为固定大小、事后 (post-hoc) 记忆模块的有效性。
Conclusion: 给预训练机器人策略补长期记忆可以不改架构、不重训 backbone，只需后训练一个固定大小的记忆模块加动作专家。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Should the Reflector See? An Empirical Study of Evidence in Reflective Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reflective prompt optimization revises instructions using examples of a model's behavior, but which evidence the reflector should receive remains unclear. We study evidence composition, visibility of examples, candidate selection and domain-knowledge policy within a single-parent Pareto-guided search. Using Qwen3.5-9B as both task model and reflector, we evaluate nine reflection strategies on five datasets. From these experiments, we find three distinct patterns. For performance improvement, Failures-only produces the largest mean test gain (+8.0 percentage points), while Balanced-mix and No-examples+Val share the best mean performance rank. For reflection effectiveness, No-examples achieves the best rank for improving sampled parents, yet yields only a 1.4-point mean test gain: local reflection success does not necessarily produce a stronger final prompt. For overfitting assessment, Failures-only and Balanced-mix share the lowest mean calibration-gap rank, while larger gaps on GPQA and IFBench show that calibration gains can overstate held-out improvement. This gap is a descriptive indicator, not a direct measure of overfitting. Together, these results show why reflection strategies should be assessed separately on final performance, parent improvement and calibration-to-test transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在单亲 Pareto 引导搜索 (single-parent Pareto-guided search) 内系统比较反思式 prompt 优化的证据组合策略：用 Qwen3.5-9B 同时作任务模型与 reflector，在五个数据集上评测九种反思策略。Failures-only 带来最大平均测试增益 +8.0 个百分点，而局部反思成功（No-examples 改善被采样父代最好）只换来 1.4 点增益，说明三类指标必须分开评。
Motivation: 反思式 prompt 优化靠模型行为样例改写指令，但 reflector 该看到哪些证据（失败样例、平衡混合、是否含验证样例）一直不清楚，且局部反思效果与最终 prompt 强度可能脱节。
Method: 在单亲 Pareto 引导搜索框架内操纵证据组合、样例可见性、候选选择与领域知识策略，共九种反思策略；Qwen3.5-9B 既作任务模型又作 reflector，在五个数据集上评测，并按最终性能、父代改善、校准-测试迁移三个维度分别排名。
Result: Failures-only 平均测试增益最大，+8.0 个百分点；Balanced-mix 与 No-examples+Val 并列最佳平均性能排名。No-examples 在改善被采样父代上排名最好，但平均测试增益仅 1.4 点。Failures-only 与 Balanced-mix 并列最低平均校准差距 (calibration-gap) 排名；GPQA 与 IFBench 上校准差距更大，说明校准收益可能夸大留出集改进。
Conclusion: 局部反思成功不必然产出更强的最终 prompt，反思策略必须在最终性能、父代改善、校准-测试迁移三方面分别评估；校准差距只是描述性指标，不是过拟合的直接度量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ForkLeft: Entropy-First Rollouts for Prefix-Aligned Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has enabled strong reasoning capabilities in language models, while Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible token orders and parallel generation. We ask whether DLMs can acquire NTP-style reasoning through distillation without giving up their native generation process. Direct distillation, however, faces a fundamental mismatch: an autoregressive teacher predicts from a left prefix, whereas a DLM can condition on tokens on both sides. We introduce ForkLeft, a distillation framework that resolves this mismatch by separating the student's rollout from teacher supervision. During training, the student first performs entropy-first rollouts that commit uncertain positions and expose potential forks. We then fix the resulting student prefix and distill an NTP teacher under the same context, with answer correctness determining the supervision source. At inference, the student returns to its native confidence-first parallel decoding. With Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ForkLeft improves Efficient-DLM-4B on all ten benchmarks, raising MATH500 from 72.60% to 79.60% and consistently outperforming three alternative designs. The gains scale with teacher strength and generalize to SDAR-4B with only $500$ updates. At matched scale, the distilled 4B and 8B students exceed the published SDAR-Chat and OPDLM models on seven benchmarks, showing that DLMs can learn NTP-style reasoning without sacrificing native parallel generation. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForkLeft 把自回归教师的前缀条件与扩散语言模型的双向条件错位拆开：训练时学生先做熵优先 rollout 固定不确定位置，再固定该前缀让 NTP 教师在同一上下文下监督，答案正确性决定监督来源；推理时回到原生置信优先并行解码。用 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 蒸馏 Efficient-DLM-4B，十项基准全部提升，MATH500 从 72.60% 升到 79.60%。
Motivation: 自回归教师只从左前缀预测，而 DLM 可以同时利用左右两侧 token，直接蒸馏存在条件分布的根本错位，导致 NTP 风格推理难以在不放弃原生生成过程的前提下迁移给 DLM。
Method: 训练分两段：学生先做 entropy-first rollouts 提交高不确定位置并暴露分叉，随后固定该学生前缀，在同一上下文下用 NTP 教师（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base）蒸馏，监督信号由答案正确性选择来源；推理阶段回到原生 confidence-first 并行解码。
Result: 在十项基准上全部提升 Efficient-DLM-4B，MATH500 从 72.60% 升至 79.60%，并一致优于三种替代设计；增益随教师强度放大，且仅 500 次更新即可迁移到 SDAR-4B。同等规模下，蒸馏后的 4B 与 8B 学生在七项基准上超过已发布的 SDAR-Chat 与 OPDLM 模型。
Conclusion: 把学生 rollout 与教师监督解耦，可以让扩散语言模型学到 NTP 风格推理而不牺牲原生并行生成；增益随教师能力缩放，且对不同 DLM 架构迁移成本很低。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Length-Independent State Tracking Under a Parallel Scan
papers.abstract_en: Learning robust and scalable finite-state tracking is fundamental to sequence processing. While linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs), linear attention, and state space models enable scalable parallel training through affine recurrences, their theoretical expressivity guarantees assume idealized arithmetic and do not extend to finite precision, where the parallel scan that makes them fast is itself a source of perturbation. We formalize finite-state tracking at finite precision and characterize length independence: tracking that stays correct at every sequence length, at a precision cost that does not grow with the length. We show that length-independent state tracking requires two competing dynamics within a single map: contraction to suppress numerical perturbations and separation to keep distinct states apart. We prove that affine recurrences, which offer a single rate at each step to serve both roles, realize at most definite automata at finite precision. Instead of treating scan compatibility as a restriction on the update map, we reinterpret it as a computational budget and introduce the Neural Finite-State Machine (NFSM): a nonaffine, scan-compatible RNN built for length-independent finite-state tracking. On synthetic benchmarks spanning abelian and nonabelian groups, noninvertible monoids, and textual state-tracking tasks, affine baselines fail on every nondefinite task, most of them within a few hundred steps. A single NFSM layer instead learns the exact transition tables of every algebraic task, which certifies correctness beyond the tested lengths, and a stack of NFSMs keeps perfect accuracy on the textual tasks at every tested length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限精度下，affine 递归（线性 RNN、线性注意力、SSM）每步只能给出一个速率，同时承担抑制数值扰动的收缩与区分状态的分离两种作用，因而至多实现 definite 自动机；作者把并行扫描 (parallel scan) 从限制重新解释为计算预算，提出非 affine 但 scan-compatible 的 Neural Finite-State Machine (NFSM)。affine 基线在每个非 definite 任务上失败（多数在几百步内），单层 NFSM 学到全部代数任务的精确转移表，堆叠后在文本任务的所有测试长度上保持完美精度。
Motivation: 线性 RNN、线性注意力与 SSM 的表达力保证建立在理想算术上，而使它们可并行训练的扫描本身在有限精度下就是扰动源，长度无关的有限状态跟踪因此缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 形式化有限精度下的有限状态跟踪并刻画 length independence（每一步都正确且精度代价不随长度增长）；证明 affine 递归至多实现 definite 自动机；在此基础上提出非 affine、scan-compatible 的 Neural Finite-State Machine (NFSM)，在 abelian 与 nonabelian 群、noninvertible monoid 及文本状态跟踪任务上检验。
Result: affine 基线在全部非 definite 任务上失败，多数在几百步内出错；单层 NFSM 学到每个代数任务的精确转移表，从而把正确性认证推广到测试长度之外；NFSM 堆叠在文本任务的所有测试长度上保持完美精度。
Conclusion: 长度无关的有限状态跟踪要求收缩与分离两种竞争动力共存于同一映射，affine 递归的单一速率做不到，非 affine 的 scan-compatible 更新才能在有限精度下保持任意长度的正确状态跟踪。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Masking Frequent Tokens Sharpens Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models by optimizing over sequence-level sums of token-wise implicit reward differences. However, we identify a pervasive pathology in this formulation: a disproportionately small subset of high-frequency token types dominates cumulative sequence scores while appearing symmetrically across both preferred and dispreferred responses. Specifically, under canonical Qwen tokenization on Anthropic HH-RLHF, merely 69 token types account for $55.1\%$ of all response tokens and $85.9\%$ of within-pair shared token mass, exhibiting substantially lower preference-side specificity than the remaining vocabulary. This symmetric ubiquity induces gradient entanglement and dilutes the discriminative preference signal propagated through the objective. To resolve this issue, we introduce \emph{Anisotropic DPO} (\textsf{ADPO}) and its canonical realization, \emph{Frequency-Hard DPO}. Using a fixed, label-agnostic vocabulary mask, our method zeroes the implicit reward contribution of high-frequency response tokens while assigning unit weight to informative positions, thereby suppressing gradient interference without modifying preference pairs, discarding context, or introducing learned parameters. Here, \emph{anisotropy} designates non-uniform token-level objective weighting rather than representational geometry. Extensive empirical evaluations on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and Arena-Hard demonstrate that Frequency-Hard DPO consistently outperforms standard DPO across Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct, establishing that selectively masking shared high-frequency tokens offers an effective, zero-overhead mechanism for robust preference alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DPO 的序列级隐式奖励差分被高频 token 主导：在 Qwen 分词 + Anthropic HH-RLHF 上仅 69 个 token 类型就占全部响应 token 的 55.1%、占对内共享 token 质量的 85.9%，且在偏好与非偏好两侧对称出现，造成梯度纠缠、稀释偏好信号。Anisotropic DPO（ADPO，规范实现为 Frequency-Hard DPO）用固定且与标签无关的词表掩码把高频响应 token 的隐式奖励置零、其余位置取单位权重，在不改动偏好对、不丢上下文、不加参数的前提下抑制梯度干扰。
Motivation: DPO 的 token 级隐式奖励差分按序列求和时，少数高频 token 类型在偏好与非偏好响应两侧对称出现并主导累计分数，使真正有区分度的偏好信号被稀释、梯度相互纠缠。
Method: 提出 Anisotropic DPO（ADPO）及其规范形式 Frequency-Hard DPO：用固定、label-agnostic 的词表掩码，将高频响应 token 的隐式奖励贡献置零，其余信息性位置赋单位权重；不修改偏好对、不丢弃上下文、不引入可学习参数。这里的 anisotropy 指 token 级目标权重的非均匀分配，而非表示几何。
Result: 在 Qwen 分词 + Anthropic HH-RLHF 上，69 个 token 类型占全部响应 token 的 55.1%、占对内共享 token 质量的 85.9%，其偏好侧特异性显著低于其余词表。在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，Frequency-Hard DPO 在 AlpacaEval、MT-Bench、Arena-Hard 的评测中一致优于标准 DPO。
Conclusion: 选择性掩掉共享高频 token 是零开销的偏好对齐机制，可稳定优于标准 DPO；其有效性来自对 token 级目标权重的非均匀重加权，而非改变数据或模型容量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning: Where It Arises and How to Correct It
papers.abstract_en: We study training-inference mismatch in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for large language models, where rollouts are sampled by an inference engine while gradients are computed by a training engine, and the two engines assign different probabilities to the same tokens. To account for this discrepancy in policy updates, we introduce calibrated importance sampling (CIS). CIS is motivated by an empirically supported logit-displacement characterization that expresses the mismatch as an additive displacement $\varepsilon_t$ in log-odds, determined by the per-logit perturbation before the softmax, whose distribution is approximately invariant to token confidence. This characterization motivates a confidence-aware truncation: large positive displacements are truncated at a single constant threshold, which maps back to an importance-ratio cap that tightens as token confidence increases. Theoretically, we show that CIS replaces the unbounded second moment that governs the error of exact importance sampling with a term bounded by a constant, at the cost of a bias controlled by the truncated excess. In evaluation across three mixture-of-experts models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CIS achieves the highest five-benchmark average on all three models among the evaluated baselines. Diagnostic analyses show that CIS places less truncation bias on low-confidence tokens than truncated importance sampling, while upward clipping of small importance weights reduces held-out accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 的 RLVR 训练中，rollout 用推理引擎采样而梯度由训练引擎计算，两引擎对同一 token 概率不一致。CIS 把该失配建模为 log-odds 上的加性位移 ε_t，并按 token 置信度做截断：高位移截到单一常数阈值，等价于随置信度升高而收紧的重要性比上限。在三个 MoE 模型与五个数学推理基准上，CIS 在全部三个模型上都取得五基准平均分最高。
Motivation: RLVR 中训练引擎与推理引擎对同一 token 给出不同概率，直接套用重要性采样会带来无界二阶矩，使策略更新的误差方差不可控。
Method: 提出 calibrated importance sampling (CIS)：先用经验支持的 logit 位移刻画把失配表示为 log-odds 加性位移 ε_t（分布近似不随 token 置信度变化），再做 confidence-aware 截断——大正位移截到单一常数阈值，映射回随置信度收紧的重要性比上限；理论上用有界常数项替换精确重要性采样的无界二阶矩，代价是由截断超额控制的偏差。
Result: 在三个 mixture-of-experts 模型与五个数学推理基准上，CIS 在全部三个模型上都取得所评基线中最高的五基准平均分。诊断分析显示 CIS 对低置信 token 施加的截断偏差小于 truncated importance sampling，而对小重要性权重的上抬裁剪 (upward clipping) 会降低 held-out accuracy。
Conclusion: 把训练-推理失配当作可校准的 logit 位移并按置信度截断，能在可控偏差下替换无界二阶矩；对小重要性权重做上抬裁剪是有害的。

papers.title: Controllable GNN Explanations via Multi-Metric Preference Selection
papers.abstract_en: Mechanisms for generating GNN explanations are crucial for building trust and mitigating biases in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), especially in high-stakes scenarios. Most current methods optimize only for fidelity under the sparsity constraint. However, this discounts the need for interpretable explanations (those that consist of familiar motif patterns) and stable explanations (those that remain unchanged under structural perturbations). We propose a novel approach that optimizes GNN explanations across these metrics, exposing their relative weighing as a control. Experiments on various real-world datasets, including MUTAG, BA-2Motif, BAMultiShapes, and PROTEINS, suggest that our method produces higher-fidelity explanations than a state-of-the-art baseline on MUTAG and PROTEINS across all evaluated budgets, and on BA-2Motif at larger budgets, while being faster in the regime of small explanation budgets. We also explore how, given an input motif library containing standard motifs for the corresponding domain, the method can be used to determine the relative importance of those motifs in generating the explanations, and how this information can be used to further improve the quality of the output explanations. We also examine the relationship between different metrics through their induced tradeoff surface, and explore its dependence on the nature of the motif library.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在稀疏预算下同时优化 fidelity、motif 可解释性与结构扰动稳定性三个指标的 GNN 解释方法，并把三者的相对权重暴露为可调控制项。在 MUTAG 与 PROTEINS 上各预算下均给出比 SOTA 基线更高 fidelity 的解释，BA-2Motif 在大预算下更高，小预算区间速度更快。
Motivation: 现有 GNN 解释方法大多只在稀疏约束下优化 fidelity，忽略解释是否由熟悉 motif 构成以及在结构扰动下是否稳定，难以支撑高风险场景中的信任与偏差审查。
Method: 在统一目标中同时优化 fidelity、motif 模式可解释性与结构扰动下的稳定性，并把三者相对权重作为可调控制暴露给用户；给定领域标准 motif 库时，用方法反推各 motif 对解释的相对重要性，再据此改进输出解释。
Result: 在 MUTAG、BA-2Motif、BAMultiShapes、PROTEINS 上实验：MUTAG 与 PROTEINS 全部预算下 fidelity 高于 SOTA 基线，BA-2Motif 在较大预算下更高，小解释预算区间速度更快；并刻画各指标经由 tradeoff surface 的关系及其对 motif 库性质的依赖。

papers.title: From Latents to Wires: Surgical Post-Editing on Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Given a large language model (LLM), can whoever holds the weights name a semantic target (e.g., the model's identity), locate the model components that produce it, and edit them so that the target no longer appears while other capability is preserved? We call such an edit on a trained model a post-edit. We present L2W (latents to wires), a framework that performs surgical post-edits for named semantic targets. For localization, L2W uses Jacobian lens (J-lens) attribution to score components against the semantic target. For surgical removal, because LLM mechanisms are redundant (i.e., a semantic target may have multiple components producing it), L2W runs Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC) until the target no longer appears. CGCC first cumulatively closes model components, treating each surviving expression of the target as a counterexample that exposes the next components to close, and then reopens some of them to preserve capability. In a controlled experiment with an implanted behavioural watermark, L2W removes the watermark, and its localization lands on the model region the implant changed. Across three model configurations, L2W removes model-metadata (e.g., identity) self-claims in all nine runs, and adult-content refusal in all three, with no held-out target residual. L2W further composes two post-edits on a text-to-image model: one removes the refusal of requested nudity, and a second removes the nude rendering the first exposes. The results support post-editing as a complement to post-training: post-training installs preferred behaviours, and post-editing removes named unwanted ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 L2W（latents to wires）框架，对已训练 LLM 做针对命名语义目标的“外科式 post-edit”：用 Jacobian lens (J-lens) 归因定位产生该目标的组件，再用反例引导因果切割 (CGCC) 反复关闭组件直至目标消失、并重开部分以保住能力。在植入行为水印的受控实验中定位命中植入改动的模型区域；三种模型配置下九次运行全部移除模型元数据（如身份）自述、三次全部移除成人内容拒答，且无保留目标残留。
Motivation: 持有权重者需要定点移除模型中已命名的不良语义目标（身份自述、拒答行为），同时保住其他能力；而 LLM 机制冗余，同一目标常由多个组件产生，单次编辑难以除净。
Method: L2W 分两步：定位阶段用 J-lens 归因对模型组件按语义目标打分；移除阶段运行 Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC)，先累积关闭组件、把每次残留的目标表达当作反例暴露下一个待关闭组件，再重开部分组件以保留能力，循环直到目标不再出现。
Result: 植入行为水印的受控实验中，L2W 移除水印且定位落在模型被植入改动的区域；跨三种模型配置，模型元数据（如身份）自述在全部九次运行中被移除，成人内容拒答在全部三次中被移除，均无保留目标残留；在 text-to-image 模型上组合两次 post-edit，先移除对所请求裸露的拒答，再移除第一次编辑暴露出的裸露渲染。
Conclusion: post-editing 可作为 post-training 的补充：post-training 装入期望行为，post-editing 移除已命名的不期望行为。
Relevance: 0
