papers.title: STRIDE: State-Transition Representation via Increment Dynamics and Evolution
papers.abstract_en: We introduce STRIDE (State-Transition Representation via Increment Dynamics and Evolution), which defines states through derivative fingerprints and learns local functions for state transitions (qpairs), recasting continuous forecasting as transition prediction. Trailing convolution windows estimate local joint-transition frequencies, whose lagged differences form a high-dimensional increment trajectory. Proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) gives coordinate paths, jointly forecast by sparse dynamics with memory. Recombining their forecasts and applying history-anchored inversion recovers future transition distributions; sampled state paths select local functions to generate continuous forecasts. Three-seed experiments compare STRIDE against fourteen baselines across nine benchmark families. Five independent Markov and hidden-state baselines cover all 230 evaluated tasks, with 220 complete whole-horizon pairs. Against these comparators, system-weighted late-Energy win fractions range from 73.6% to 78.5% on 190 multi-step pairs; against DLinear, the fraction is 77.3% on 72 paired multi-step tasks. Matched controls examine the intermediate representation. On 64 independently initialized Aizawa trajectories, late-Energy reductions against four matched controls range from approximately 24% to 56%, with all four prespecified contrasts passing Holm correction. These results connect transition-statistic prediction to continuous probabilistic forecasting, with substantial long-horizon gains in the matched Aizawa study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIDE 用导数指纹定义状态、以局部转移函数 (qpairs) 学习状态转移，把连续预报重构为转移预测：尾随卷积窗估计局部联合转移频率，滞后差分构成高维增量轨迹，POD 降维后由带记忆的稀疏动力学联合预报坐标路径，再经历史锚定反演恢复未来转移分布。三随机种子、九个基准族上对 14 个基线，五个 Markov/隐藏态基线覆盖全部 230 个任务，system-weighted late-Energy 胜率 73.6%–78.5%（190 个多步对），对 DLinear 为 77.3%（72 个多步任务）；64 条独立初始化 Aizawa 轨迹上相对四个匹配对照 late-Energy 降约 24%–56%，四项预设对比均过 Holm 校正。
Motivation: 连续时间序列的长程预报需要把状态演化拆成可组合的局部转移，而现有基线多把预报当作直接的值回归，缺少显式的中间状态表示来支撑长时域概率预报。
Method: 以导数指纹定义状态并学习局部转移函数 (qpairs)；尾随卷积窗估计局部联合转移频率，滞后差分形成高维增量轨迹；proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) 给出坐标路径，由带记忆的稀疏动力学联合预报；再用历史锚定反演 (history-anchored inversion) 重建未来转移分布，采样状态路径选择局部函数生成连续预报。实验为三随机种子、九个基准族、14 个基线，含五个覆盖 230 个任务的 Markov 与隐藏态基线，以及针对中间表示的匹配对照。
Result: 对五个 Markov/隐藏态基线（覆盖全部 230 个评估任务、220 个完整全时域对），system-weighted late-Energy 胜率在 190 个多步对上为 73.6%–78.5%；对 DLinear 在 72 个配对多步任务上为 77.3%。在 64 条独立初始化的 Aizawa 轨迹上，相对四个匹配对照的 late-Energy 降幅约 24%–56%，四项预设对比全部通过 Holm 校正。
Conclusion: 把转移统计量预测与连续概率预报连起来是可行的，且在匹配的 Aizawa 研究中带来显著的长时域增益；中间表示本身经匹配对照检验确有贡献。

papers.title: Graph Memory: Spectral Associative Memory via Dirichlet Energy
papers.abstract_en: Dense associative memories have traditionally focused on storing and retrieving vector-valued patterns. Many modern machine learning problems, however, are naturally graph-structured, requiring memory mechanisms for relational patterns, graph diffusion geometries, community structures, and graph-based inductive biases. We propose a spectral dense associative memory for storage and retrieval of graph data, extending the classical vector-valued memories. Retrieval is performed through a log-sum-exp energy induced by Dirichlet energy with spectral norm distances, producing a softmax-weighted average of the stored Laplacians that remains a valid graph Laplacian. We prove exponential storage capacity and exponentially decaying retrieval error. Beyond graph retrieval, we establish theoretical guarantees for spectral quantities central to graph learning, including eigenvalues, eigenspaces, and diffusion operators. Experiments on synthetic graph data, real-world airline network, protein conformation data and wearable sensor data demonstrate robust graph retrieval while preserving the graph geometry of the data. Our framework provides a new associative memory paradigm for graph-structured data and bridges dense associative memory with modern graph learning and generative AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向图结构数据的谱稠密联想记忆 (spectral dense associative memory)：用 Dirichlet energy 加谱范数距离构造 log-sum-exp 能量做检索，输出为存储 Laplacian 的 softmax 加权平均且仍是合法图 Laplacian。证明存储容量指数增长、检索误差指数衰减，并给出特征值、特征空间与扩散算子的理论保证。
Motivation: 稠密联想记忆长期只处理向量模式，而现代机器学习问题多为图结构，需要能存储关系模式、图扩散几何与社区结构的记忆机制。
Method: 检索通过 Dirichlet energy 诱导的 log-sum-exp 能量配合谱范数距离完成，返回存储 Laplacian 的 softmax 加权平均；理论上证明指数存储容量与指数衰减的检索误差，并给出图学习核心谱量（特征值、特征空间、扩散算子）的保证。
Result: 在合成图数据、真实航空网络、蛋白质构象数据与可穿戴传感器数据上展示稳健的图检索并保持数据的图几何；理论结果为指数存储容量与指数衰减检索误差。
Conclusion: 联想记忆可以扩展到图结构数据，成为连接稠密联想记忆与图学习、生成式 AI 的新范式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DiffPTS: Rethinking Diffusion ELBO for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic time series forecasting requires modeling and predicting complex and time-varying distributions. Recently, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based approaches have shown promise by equipping the dif- fusion process with pretrained mean and variance estimators to accommodate distributional shift. However, these methods typically follow the standard DDPM framework and consider only partial components of the evidence lower bound (ELBO), treating the training of estimators as designed regression tasks separate from the variational inference framework. To address this, we rethink the ELBO under the Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) and find that it naturally induces a Gaussian negative log likelihood objective for the estimators and inherently defines a joint training objective that unifies recent diffusion paradigms for probabilistic forecasting. Building on this principled ELBO reformulation, we propose Diff- PTS, a general framework that enables end-to-end optimization of all components within the ELBO. Across multiple benchmarks, DiffPTS consistently outperforms recent models, achieving state-of-the-art performance with an average CRPS/MSE reduction of over 14.53%/16.55% compared to existing diffusion-based methods. The code is available at https://github.com/wwy155/DiffPTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffPTS 在 Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) 下重推扩散模型的 ELBO，发现它自然诱导出估计器的高斯负对数似然目标，并把均值/方差估计器与扩散过程统一成一个联合训练目标，从而支持 ELBO 全部组件的端到端优化。在多个概率时间序列基准上，相比现有扩散方法平均 CRPS 降低超过 14.53%、MSE 降低超过 16.55%。
Motivation: 现有 DDPM 类概率时间序列预报只取 ELBO 的部分项，且把均值、方差估计器当作独立回归任务训练，脱离变分推断框架，导致无法端到端优化、难以应对分布漂移。
Method: 在 LSNM 下重新推导 ELBO，得到估计器的高斯 NLL 目标与统一各扩散范式的联合训练目标；据此构建 DiffPTS 框架，对 ELBO 内所有组件做端到端优化，代码已开源。
Result: 在多个概率时间序列预报基准上，DiffPTS 相比现有扩散方法平均 CRPS 降低超过 14.53%、MSE 降低超过 16.55%，作者称达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把 ELBO 当作统一的变分推断目标而非部分项拼接，可让扩散概率时间序列预报的全部组件端到端训练并取得一致增益。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
papers.abstract_en: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StegGNN 把图像隐写从 CNN 网格表示转为图结构表示，用基于 GNN 的自编码器、cover-agnostic 方式嵌入秘密信息，以规避 CNN 感受野与空间局部性偏置。在标准基准数据集上的视觉质量与不可感知性实验中，其表现与现有 CNN 基线相当。
Motivation: 现有深度学习隐写框架基本建立在 CNN 上，图像被当作规则网格处理，受感受野大小和空间局部性偏置限制，需要更灵活的表示来承载嵌入。
Method: 提出 StegGNN：一个基于 GNN 的、cover-agnostic 的自编码器隐写框架，将图像建模为图结构，利用 GNN 的表示灵活性替代网格化的 CNN 编码器，并在标准基准数据集上评估视觉质量与不可感知性。
Result: 在标准基准数据集上的实验显示，该 GNN 方法的视觉质量与不可感知性表现与现有 CNN 基线相当（comparable），摘要未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: GNN 可作为隐写嵌入的一种有前景的替代表示，为深度学习隐写打开基于 GNN 架构的进一步探索空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Black-Box Auditing of Epistemic Reliability in Multi-Agent Debate Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Debate distillation adapts weaker verifiers using multi-agent debate transcripts to improve their judgement in subsequent debates, but gains on monitored tasks do not establish reliability on related unmonitored tasks. We study epistemic reliability degradation, in which adaptation preserves monitored performance while reducing support for correct responses on hidden tasks. We consider an adversarial debater that manipulates debate arguments while defending the correct monitored response, and ask whether the resulting degradation merely reflects catastrophic forgetting and whether standard evaluation can detect it. To address these questions, we propose ER-Audit, a two-stage black-box auditing framework that compares frozen verifier checkpoints before and after adaptation, and introduce two evaluation benchmarks pairing monitored and hidden task prompts grounded in shared contexts. ER-Audit searches for counterexamples to non-degradation by evaluating semantically valid paraphrases and, if none is found, uses independent paraphrases for sequential hypothesis testing. We derive anytime-valid lower confidence bounds on the non-degradation probability, allowing data-dependent stopping within a finite budget. We further establish a common lower bound across fixed paraphrase distributions and extend it to distributions within a bounded total variation distance of their mixtures. Our experiments show that higher hidden-task accuracy can coexist with more counterexamples to non-degradation and lower non-degradation bounds. This divergence challenges explanations based solely on broad catastrophic forgetting and shows that auditing can uncover selective hidden-task degradation concealed by aggregate performance gains. Our code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/CSIRO-CQS-AI-alignment-Team/Epistemic-Reliability-Auditor.
papers.comment: Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/CSIRO-CQS-AI-alignment-Team/Epistemic-Reliability-Auditor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多智能体辩论蒸馏 (debate distillation) 中监控任务性能提升掩盖隐藏任务可靠性下降的问题，提出两阶段黑盒审计框架 ER-Audit：对比适配前后的冻结 verifier checkpoint，搜索非退化 (non-degradation) 的反例，并在无反例时用独立改写做序贯假设检验。实验显示隐藏任务准确率更高可以与更多反例、更低的非退化置信下界并存，说明聚合性能增益会掩盖选择性退化。
Motivation: 弱 verifier 经辩论转录适配后，监控任务上的收益不能保证相关未监控任务的可靠性；标准评估难以区分这种选择性退化与广义灾难性遗忘。
Method: ER-Audit 分两阶段黑盒比较适配前后的冻结 verifier checkpoint；引入两组将监控与隐藏任务提示配对到共享上下文的 benchmark；先评估语义有效改写搜索非退化反例，找不到则用独立改写做序贯假设检验，导出非退化概率的 anytime-valid 下置信界以支持有限预算内数据依赖停止；再在固定改写分布上给出公共下界，并扩展到其混合的有界总变差距离内分布。
Result: 实验显示更高的隐藏任务准确率可以与更多非退化反例、更低的非退化下界同时出现；该分歧挑战了仅用广义灾难性遗忘解释的立场。
Conclusion: 审计能揭示被聚合性能增益掩盖的选择性隐藏任务退化，监控任务指标本身不足以支撑可靠性主张。

papers.title: Editable Map-Conditioned Trajectory Generation for Human Mobility Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial simulation of infrastructure interventions requires mobility generators that respond directly to edited maps, yet many data-driven generators do not expose the map as an editable condition. We formulate this task as map-conditioned autoregressive generation of human mobility: a road raster conditions a decoder that emits nominal 31.25 m mesh-cell tokens at one-minute intervals. The mesh-local vocabulary supports held-out and locally edited maps without retraining or vocabulary changes. We instantiate a ResNet-50 visual-prefix configuration and a Vision Transformer (ViT) cross-attention configuration, trained from scratch on 87,400 smartphone-derived trajectories from 874 meshes in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan; 219 meshes are held out. We evaluate map sensitivity by comparing correct-map and within-split shuffled-map generations with held-out real trajectories. On the 110-mesh test split, for the ResNet-50 configuration, correct-map generations are closer than shuffled-map generations on 60% of meshes under Hausdorff-based energy distance (p = 0.021), while DTW is directional but inconclusive (57%, p = 0.074); correlation with real density is 0.38 with the correct map versus 0.01 with shuffled maps. The ViT configuration shows weaker trajectory-level sensitivity and smaller density gains. An illustrative bridge-removal edit changes generated continuations without retraining. Together, these results support the feasibility of editable-map human-mobility simulation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 9th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on GeoSpatial Simulation (GeoSim '26). 10 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把地图栅格作为可编辑条件做自回归人类移动生成：31.25 m 网格单元 token、1 分钟步长，词表 mesh-local，改图无需重训。在石川县 87,400 条手机轨迹上，ResNet-50 配置在 110 个测试 mesh 中 60% 的 mesh 上正确地图生成比打乱地图更接近真实轨迹（Hausdorff 能量距离 p=0.021），真实密度相关性 0.38 对 0.01；移除一座桥的编辑即可改变生成结果。
Motivation: 基础设施干预的地理空间仿真需要能直接响应地图编辑的移动生成器，但多数数据驱动生成器不把地图暴露为可编辑条件。
Method: 把任务表述为地图条件的自回归人类移动生成：道路栅格作为条件输入解码器，输出 31.25 m 网格单元 token、时间步 1 分钟；词表 mesh-local，支持留出与局部编辑地图而无需重训或改词表。实例化两种配置——ResNet-50 视觉前缀与 Vision Transformer (ViT) 交叉注意力，从零训练于石川县 874 个 mesh 的 87,400 条手机轨迹，留出 219 个 mesh。评测方式为比较正确地图与同 split 内打乱地图的生成结果，并对照留出的真实轨迹。
Result: 在 110-mesh 测试 split 上，ResNet-50 配置下正确地图生成在 60% 的 mesh 上比打乱地图更接近真实轨迹（Hausdorff 能量距离，p=0.021）；DTW 方向一致但不确定（57%，p=0.074）；与真实密度的相关性为正确地图 0.38、打乱地图 0.01。ViT 配置的轨迹级敏感性更弱、密度增益更小。示例性的桥梁移除编辑在不重训的情况下改变了生成的后续轨迹。

papers.title: Gradients for Interventions and Activations for Detection: Targeted Feature Learning in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Model-internal features can be studied through both their ability to identify a specified concept and their causal effect when manipulated, e.g., through steering or weight editing. A prominent approach to feature learning is Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which learn broad feature dictionaries whose relation to particular concepts is typically identified post hoc. However, many interpretability questions are instead hypothesis-driven and concern a concept specified in advance. We study this setting as targeted feature learning, where a single feature is constructed for such a predefined concept. We present a controlled comparison across three model signals (activation values, activation gradients, and parameter gradients) and two estimators (contrastive mean and a learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder), yielding six targeted methods, with CAA and GRADIEND as existing instances and four new methods covering the remaining combinations. We compare these methods against pretrained SAEs across 15 tasks and three language models, evaluating both detection and causal intervention. Across models, the strongest detection performance is achieved by contrastive activation value methods, whereas the strongest intervention performance is achieved by gradient-based methods. Overall, our results show that targeted feature quality depends jointly on the model signal and estimator, with detection and intervention capturing complementary properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在语言模型可解释性中提出 targeted feature learning：针对预先指定的概念直接构造单个特征，而非像 Sparse Autoencoder 那样先学大字典再事后关联。用三种模型信号（activation values、activation gradients、parameter gradients）与两种估计器（contrastive mean、learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder）组合出六种方法，其中 CAA 与 GRADIEND 是已有实例。在 15 个任务、三个语言模型上，检测最强的是 contrastive activation value 方法，干预最强的是基于梯度的方法。
Motivation: SAE 学到的宽泛特征字典与特定概念的对应关系通常要事后识别，而许多可解释性问题是假设驱动的、概念事先给定，需要直接为该概念构造特征。
Method: 把 targeted feature learning 形式化为单特征构造问题，系统比较三种模型信号（activation values、activation gradients、parameter gradients）与两种估计器（contrastive mean、learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder）的全组合，得到六种 targeted 方法（CAA、GRADIEND 为已有实例，另四种为新组合），并与预训练 SAE 在 15 个任务、三个语言模型上对比，同时评测 detection 与 causal intervention。
Result: 跨模型上 detection 性能最强的是 contrastive activation value 方法，intervention 性能最强的是基于梯度的方法；整体上 targeted feature 质量同时取决于模型信号与估计器，detection 与 intervention 捕捉的是互补性质。
Conclusion: 检测能力与干预能力由不同信号-估计器组合主导，二者互补，因此评估 targeted feature 必须同时报告 detection 与 intervention 两个维度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LT-OPD：视觉 token 极度压缩的 MLLM 学生用少量 token 自己生成回答，再由冻结的全 token 同模型在这些自生成轨迹上做 on-policy 自蒸馏，并用逐步降低 token 预算的 budget-level curriculum 稳定训练。在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个基准上，5% 视觉 token 保留率的平均保留性能从 68.6% 提到 82.3%，同时 KV-cache 占用降 85.2%、prefill FLOPs 降 85.4%。
Motivation: 视觉 token 选择与训练适配已有工作，但在极低 token 预算下性能迅速恶化；压缩后的 MLLM 如何从自身生成所诱导的状态中学习仍是空白。
Method: LT-OPD 训练框架：学生只保留一小部分视觉 token 滚动生成回答，冻结的全 token 同模型副本沿学生自生成轨迹提供分布级监督（on-policy self-distillation）；训练中引入 budget-level curriculum 逐步下调 token 预算以稳定学习。
Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个基准上，5% 视觉 token 保留率的平均保留性能由 68.6% 升至 82.3%，在同预算下超过 training-free、training-based 与强化学习基线；增益一致迁移到 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B、LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B；KV-cache 占用减少 85.2%，prefill FLOPs 减少 85.4%，且无额外推理开销。
Conclusion: on-policy 自蒸馏配合预算课程可以大幅挽回极端视觉 token 压缩损失的能力，且在多个 MLLM 上可迁移、不增加推理开销。

papers.title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA.
papers.comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2027 CREATE Workshop. 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Project page: [https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA](https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EyeVQA 把 21 个现有眼科数据集统一成 20,000 条问答的 VQA 基准，覆盖六类疾病与七种题型（含 Point Location、Bounding Box 空间定位），金标准答案由诊断、分级、分割掩膜与解剖标志确定性推导，不依赖模型生成标注。在统一 zero-shot 协议下评测 14 个通用、科学与医学专用 VLM，最佳模型总分仅 62.8，空间定位与跨任务泛化差距明显。
Motivation: 现有眼科数据集多针对单一疾病或专门任务，无法系统判断 VLM 是否已从疾病识别推进到比较推理与细粒度空间定位 (spatial grounding)。
Method: 从 21 个眼科数据集构建 20,000 条 QA，题型含 Single-Choice、Multi-Select、Variable-Select、True-False、Ranking、Point Location、Bounding Box；答案由源数据的诊断、严重度分级、临床发现、分割掩膜、边界框与解剖标志确定性生成；44.5% 的问题要求跨多图推理；以统一 zero-shot 协议评测 14 个 VLM。
Result: 最佳模型总分 62.8，空间定位与跨任务泛化仍存在明显差距；44.5% 的问题需要跨多图推理；基准规模为 21 个数据集、20,000 条 QA、六类疾病、七种题型、14 个被测模型。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 在综合眼科视觉理解上仍不足，尤其在空间定位与跨任务泛化；EyeVQA 可作为开发更可靠、具备空间定位能力的眼科多模态模型的诊断基准。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs
papers.abstract_en: Comparative Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide critical step-level guidance for autonomous web agents by evaluating state-conditioned preferences between candidate actions. However, existing preference training data synthesized via multi-policy sampling suffers from a severe scarcity of Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)-where competing candidates target genuine on-page elements with identical action types. In representative baselines preference data (namely, WebArbiter), GMCPs account for merely 24.19%, biasing PRMs during training to rely on shallow shortcuts (such as element hallucinations and action type mismatches) rather than acquiring genuine contextual decision semantics. To address these challenges, we propose SURFPRM, a graph-guided process preference synthesis framework for comparative Web PRMs. SURFPRM structures web demonstrations into a persistent Interaction Element Graph that acts as an environment-grounded negative action proposal mechanism, systematically synthesizing contrastive negative actions across spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal confusion axes. This elevates the GMCP proportion from 24.19% to 74.60%, producing the curated SURFPRM-DATA dataset. Across six open-source backbones (3B to 9B parameters), PRMs trained on SURFPRM-DATA outperform baseline-trained models on average on WEBPRMBENCH and rival leading proprietary LLMs. In downstream reward-guided trajectory search on WEBARENA-LITE, SURFPRM provides step-level guidance for both GPT-4o (+14.21%) and GPT-4o-mini (+12.83%) policies, yielding substantial improvements in complex web task success rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SURFPRM 用持久化 Interaction Element Graph 把网页演示结构化为环境落地的负动作提议机制，按空间、时间、时空三条混淆轴合成对比负动作，把 WebArbiter 中 GMCP 占比从 24.19% 提到 74.60%。在六个开源 backbone（3B–9B）上训练的 PRM 于 WebPRMBench 平均超过基线训练模型，并在 WebArena-Lite 的奖励引导轨迹搜索中把 GPT-4o 与 GPT-4o-mini 策略成功率分别提升 14.21% 与 12.83%。
Motivation: 多策略采样合成的偏好数据里，Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs（GMCP，即候选动作同为同一真实页面元素上的相同动作类型）严重稀缺，WebArbiter 中仅占 24.19%，使 PRM 学到元素幻觉、动作类型不匹配这类浅层捷径而非真正的上下文决策语义。
Method: SURFPRM 把网页演示组织成持久的 Interaction Element Graph，作为环境落地的负动作提议器，系统合成跨空间、时间与时空混淆轴的对比负动作，产出 SURFPRM-DATA；再用该数据训练比较式 Web PRM，覆盖六个 3B–9B 开源 backbone，并在下游奖励引导轨迹搜索中提供步级指导。
Result: GMCP 占比从 24.19% 升到 74.60%；在六个开源 backbone（3B–9B）上，用 SURFPRM-DATA 训练的 PRM 在 WebPRMBench 上平均优于基线训练模型，并与领先专有 LLM 相当；在 WebArena-Lite 的奖励引导轨迹搜索中，GPT-4o 成功率 +14.21%，GPT-4o-mini +12.83%。
Conclusion: 把负动作提议落到真实页面元素的图结构上，能大幅提高可对比偏好对的密度，从而让比较式 Web PRM 学到真正的上下文决策语义，并在复杂 web 任务上转化为步级搜索收益。

summary_sections.method: SURFPRM 把网页演示组织成持久的 Interaction Element Graph，作为环境落地的负动作提议器，系统合成跨空间、时间与时空混淆轴的对比负动作，产出 SURFPRM-DATA；再用该数据训练比较式 Web PRM，覆盖六个 3B–9B 开源 backbone，并在下游奖励引导轨迹搜索中提供步级指导。
summary_sections.result: GMCP 占比从 24.19% 升到 74.60%；在六个开源 backbone（3B–9B）上，用 SURFPRM-DATA 训练的 PRM 在 WebPRMBench 上平均优于基线训练模型，并与领先专有 LLM 相当；在 WebArena-Lite 的奖励引导轨迹搜索中，GPT-4o 成功率 +14.21%，GPT-4o-mini +12.83%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把负动作提议落到真实页面元素的图结构上，能大幅提高可对比偏好对的密度，从而让比较式 Web PRM 学到真正的上下文决策语义，并在复杂 web 任务上转化为步级搜索收益。

papers.title: Analog-Friendly Predictive Coding without Activation Derivatives
papers.abstract_en: Predictive coding (PC) is a local, energy-based alternative to backpropagation (BP) whose iterative inference dynamics make it attractive for implementation on analog hardware. However, standard nonlinear PC requires evaluating the derivative of the activation function during both inference and learning, which can be difficult to realise physically. Here, we introduce \textit{activation-matched Bregman PC}, replacing standard squared-error energies with Bregman divergences matched to the activation function. This formulation eliminates activation derivatives and, when combined with inference via mirror descent, yields local inference and learning rules requiring only weighted sums, local prediction errors, state integration, and the activation function. In digital experiments, Bregman PC performs comparably to standard PC and BP on classification and generative tasks, while preserving characteristic learning dynamics of PC and its convergence to BP under stable large-model parameterisations. These results provide a more analog-friendly formulation of nonlinear PC while retaining its key computational properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 activation-matched Bregman PC：把预测编码 (predictive coding) 的平方误差能量换成与激活函数匹配的 Bregman 散度，配合 mirror descent 推断，使非线性 PC 的推断与学习都不再需要激活函数导数，只用加权求和、局部预测误差、状态积分和激活函数本身。数字实验中它在分类与生成任务上表现与标准 PC 和 BP 相当，同时保留 PC 的特征学习动力学及其在稳定大模型参数化下向 BP 的收敛。
Motivation: 标准非线性 PC 在推断和学习中都要计算激活函数导数，这在模拟 (analog) 硬件上难以物理实现，限制了 PC 作为 BP 的本地化、基于能量的替代方案在模拟电路上落地。
Method: 以与激活函数匹配的 Bregman 散度替换标准平方误差能量，得到 activation-matched Bregman PC；推断采用 mirror descent，由此得到的推断与学习规则只需加权求和、局部预测误差、状态积分与激活函数。
Result: 在数字实验的分类与生成任务上，Bregman PC 的表现与标准 PC 和 BP 相当，并保留 PC 的特征性学习动力学及其在稳定大模型参数化下向 BP 的收敛；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 用与激活匹配的 Bregman 散度可以去掉非线性 PC 对激活导数的依赖，同时保留其本地学习规则与向 BP 收敛的关键计算性质，从而得到更适于模拟硬件实现的 PC 形式。

papers.title: ALLOT: Budgeted Hybrid-Memory Routing for Knowledge Updates in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: For large language models (LLMs), parametric adaptation is costly when retrieval already suffices. We introduce ALLOT, a hybrid-memory routing framework that separates learned write priority from a hard parametric budget. A memory-aware router combines frozen text representations, retrieval confidence, and relation metadata; a single ranking supports multiple write budgets while preserving all facts in external memory. On CounterFact with Qwen3-4B, ALLOT reaches 0.760 accuracy at a 20% parametric-write budget and recovers 78.4% of the budget-matched oracle gain, with 80% fewer parametric writes than dual-writing every fact. At this budget, jointly adding retrieval and relation features to text improves normalized oracle gain by 6.2 percentage points. Complementary Qwen3-0.6B shared-store results achieve dual-write-level accuracy with 6-14.5% parametric writes, and cross-benchmark transfer retains approximately 88% of in-domain gain. These results support allocating adaptation capacity according to its incremental value rather than treating every factual update as an equally valuable training target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALLOT 把 LLM 知识更新拆成「写入优先级学习」与「硬参数化预算」两层：路由器融合冻结文本表示、检索置信度与关系元数据，用单一排序在任意写入预算下分配参数化写入，其余事实留在外部记忆。在 CounterFact + Qwen3-4B 上，20% 参数化写入预算时准确率 0.760，回收 78.4% 的预算匹配 oracle 增益，参数化写入比全量 dual-write 少 80%。
Motivation: 当检索已足够时，对每条事实都做参数化微调成本高；作者主张按增量价值分配适配容量，而不是把每个事实更新当作同等价值的训练目标。
Method: memory-aware 路由器融合冻结文本表示、检索置信度与关系元数据，输出单一写入优先级排序；该排序可在多个写入预算下复用，同时全部事实保留在外部记忆中，从而把学习到的写入优先级与硬参数化预算解耦。
Result: CounterFact + Qwen3-4B：20% 参数化写入预算下准确率 0.760，回收预算匹配 oracle 增益的 78.4%，参数化写入比 dual-write 全写少 80%；该预算下在文本特征上联合加入 retrieval 与 relation 特征使 normalized oracle gain 提升 6.2 个百分点。Qwen3-0.6B shared-store 补充结果以 6–14.5% 参数化写入达到 dual-write 级准确率；跨基准迁移保留约 88% 的 in-domain 增益。
Conclusion: 适配容量应按增量价值分配而非平均分配：单一预算无关排序加外部记忆即可在远低于全量写入的预算下保住大部分知识更新收益，且跨基准仍保留约 88% 增益。

papers.title: OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI
papers.abstract_en: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenMASC 是面向金属伪影加速 MRI 的开源全流程管线：用物理数据生成模块把公开 CT 转成带/不带金属的成对 k-space 与图像（Cartesian 与 radial 两种轨迹），MA-VarNet 逐级 DC Rectifier 纠正数据一致性步骤从污染测量中重新引入的伪影，RL 智能体主动选 k-space readout 并与重建网络解耦三阶段共训。在两个数据集、4× 与 8× 加速下，两种轨迹上相对传统与学习基线均一致改善。
Motivation: 金属植入物会污染整个 k-space，而现有加速 MRI 方法假设数据干净、多数金属伪影抑制方法假设全采样；同时缺少同一解剖部位带/不带金属的成对 k-space-图像公开数据集，也没有跨采样轨迹统一处理伪影感知采集与重建的框架。
Method: 物理数据生成模块把公开 CT 体积转成 Cartesian 与 radial 格式的成对干净/金属污染 MRI 数据；MA-VarNet 是带逐级 DC Rectifier 的展开重建网络，纠正 DC 步骤从污染测量重新引入的伪影；RL 智能体主动选择 k-space readout，通过解耦三阶段流程与重建网络共训；除 DC 算子外框架与轨迹无关，无需架构改动即可支持两种轨迹。
Result: 在两个数据集、4× 与 8× 加速设置下，OpenMASC 在 Cartesian 与 radial 两种轨迹上相对传统基线与学习基线均取得一致改善。
Conclusion: 把伪影感知的采集与重建放进同一条跨轨迹开源管线是可行的：金属污染下的加速 MRI 可在不改架构的前提下同时支持 Cartesian 与 radial 采样并稳定优于基线。

papers.title: A Comparative Analysis of Attention versus State-Space Models for In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transformers and state-space models (SSMs) are two prominent sequential learning architectures, yet their comparison remains largely empirical and existing theoretical analyses are typically task-specific or architecturally restricted. In this paper, we develop belief geometry, a unified analytical framework for comparing the representational capabilities of broad classes of attention and SSMs. Starting from a generalized formulation of in-context linear regression and using cumulative Bayes regret as our measure, we abstract three capabilities required by many sequential learning problems in our belief geometry: evidence assembly, belief maintenance, and addressing. We then study three cases of our formulation that isolate these capabilities and yield sharp architectural lessons: For belief maintenance, SSMs attain the optimal regret over stationary aggregation kernels; for positional assembly, SSMs have a memory advantage; and for content addressing, softmax attention has an exponential width advantage over sigmoid-selective SSMs. Experiments with LLaMA-type Transformers and Mamba-2 show that these architectural insights extend beyond our analytically tractable classes and linear-regression testbed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 belief geometry 统一分析框架，用累积 Bayes regret 比较 attention 与 state-space model 在上下文学习中的表达能力，抽象出证据装配、信念维护、内容寻址三种能力。结论分三支：平稳聚合核下 SSM 达到最优 regret，位置装配上 SSM 有记忆优势，内容寻址上 softmax attention 相对 sigmoid-selective SSM 有指数宽度优势。
Motivation: Transformer 与 SSM 的对比多停留在经验层面，已有理论分析要么绑定特定任务、要么绑定特定架构，缺少跨架构类的统一比较框架。
Method: 从上下文线性回归 (in-context linear regression) 的广义形式化出发，以累积 Bayes regret 为度量构建 belief geometry；设计隔离三种能力的三个特例问题，再用 LLaMA 型 Transformer 与 Mamba-2 做实验检验解析结论是否越出可解类与线性回归测试床。
Result: 三个解析结论：信念维护上 SSM 在平稳聚合核 (stationary aggregation kernels) 上达到最优 regret；位置装配 (positional assembly) 上 SSM 有记忆优势；内容寻址 (content addressing) 上 softmax attention 相对 sigmoid-selective SSM 有指数宽度优势。LLaMA 型 Transformer 与 Mamba-2 的实验显示这些架构洞见可推广到解析可处理类与线性回归测试床之外。
Conclusion: attention 与 SSM 的能力差异可按证据装配、信念维护、内容寻址三种能力分别刻画：SSM 赢在维护与位置记忆，attention 赢在内容寻址且优势随宽度指数放大。

papers.title: SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SGA-Flow-GRPO 把 Flow-GRPO 的统一标量 advantage 拆成 token 级重要性采样比，并用奖励梯度生成连续空间信用图（配 MAD 归一化与温度缩放）为 DiT 图像的空间维度分配细粒度 credit。在 GenEval 上达到 SOTA 对齐质量，收敛速度与 DiffusionNFT 相当，同时显著优于基于 Flow-GRPO 的方法。
Motivation: Flow-GRPO 作为无 critic 的对齐范式，把同一个标量 advantage 均匀施加到所有去噪时间步和空间 latent 维度，忽略生成图像的空间结构，导致策略更新次优。
Method: 面向 Diffusion Transformer (DiT)：把 Flow-GRPO 的 transition 级 log-likelihood 重写为与 DiT patch 架构对齐的 token 级表示，构造空间细粒度重要性采样比；用奖励梯度导出连续空间信用图分配局部 credit，避免刚性、边界敏感的分割启发式；再用基于 Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) 的离群鲁棒归一化配合温度缩放抑制梯度噪声、突出与 prompt 对应的功能区域。

papers.title: Enabling Timely Guidance before Skill Retrieval: Retaining Helpful Warm Tips in Agent Context
papers.abstract_en: Reusable skills help LLM-based agents solve complex tasks, but the agent must receive guidance before it commits to an ineffective approach. Existing skill mechanisms often expose only metadata and load full content on demand, leaving useful guidance unavailable until the agent decides to retrieve it. General memory methods can incur substantial maintenance overhead, while keeping guidance in conversation context risks repeatedly exposing the agent to irrelevant or harmful advice. We propose TipsWarm, a mechanism that complements existing skill mechanisms by maintaining a budgeted pool of skill-derived keypoints, or \textit{warm tips}, for selective injection into the context of every message turn. By separating event-triggered LLM assessment from inexpensive per-turn screening, it makes transferable skill guidance readily available while controlling maintenance costs. In three coding and iterative task-execution benchmarks, TipsWarm achieves the highest task success rate while remaining time-efficient, compared to recent skill and general memory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TipsWarm 在技能检索触发之前就把技能蒸馏出的关键点（warm tips）按预算常驻上下文，使 LLM agent 在决定检索前就能拿到可迁移的指导。它把事件触发的 LLM 评估与每轮廉价筛选分离，在控制维护开销的同时，在三个编码与迭代任务执行基准上取得最高任务成功率且保持时间效率。
Motivation: 现有技能机制只暴露元数据、按需加载全文，指导要等 agent 已经选错方向才可用；通用记忆方法维护开销大，而把指导全留在对话上下文又会反复暴露无关或有害建议。
Method: 提出 TipsWarm：维护一个有预算的技能派生关键点池（warm tips），每轮消息选择性注入上下文；机制上把事件触发的 LLM 评估与每轮的低成本筛选分开，以兼顾指导可得性与维护成本。
Result: 在三个编码与迭代任务执行基准上，TipsWarm 取得最高任务成功率，同时保持时间效率，对比对象是近期的技能机制与通用记忆基线。
Conclusion: 在检索前预热关键点是让技能指导及时可用的可行路径，前提是用预算池加两级筛选把维护开销压住。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出渐进视角在线策略蒸馏 (progressive-view on-policy distillation, PVD)，把学生的输入视角从裁剪图逐步移到全图，中间插入保持长宽比的 padded crop 以对齐全图的 visual-token 网格，并用裁剪条件教师-学生 log-probability 差做 token 级 regional-advantage 加权。三个 seed 平均准确率 77.51，比无奖励蒸馏基线高 2.01 点、比奖励匹配变体高 1.00 点。
Motivation: 区域到全局蒸馏里教师靠裁剪图有优势，难点是把这份优势转成学生在全图推理时的能力，而直接对齐会让学生视角分布与部署时不一致。
Method: PVD 分阶段调整视角混合概率，从裁剪图经保持长宽比的 padded crop 过渡到全图；padded crop 保留区域内容同时匹配全图 visual-token 网格。轻量 regional-advantage 加权按每次采样输入下的教师-学生 log-probability 差重分配 token 级监督，差距小则温和加权、差距大则侧重高差距 token；并用 Jensen-Shannon 度量分解解释该调度是从匹配输入模仿转向部署目标。
Result: 在覆盖感知、视觉数学与通用多模态问答的多个 benchmark 上，PVD-full 三个 seed 平均准确率 77.51，较无奖励蒸馏基线提升 2.01 点，较奖励匹配变体提升 1.00 点；无奖励设置下 PVD-distill 仍提升 1.16 点。
Conclusion: 把视角分布按阶段从裁剪推向全图、并按教师-学生概率差重加权 token 监督，能把教师的裁剪优势转成全图推理收益，且不依赖奖励即可取得大部分增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When the Merge Coefficient Stops Mattering: Proximity Regularized Merging for Continual LoRA Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Rehearsal-free continual learning with parameter-efficient adapters can be cast as a sequence of task-vector write-in operations: for each new task, a low-rank adapter is learned and merged into a running model. We propose Proximity Regularized Merging (PRM), a minimal modification to sequential LoRA merging that adds a proximal penalty during task-vector training without changing the subsequent write-in rule. PRM acts as a robust task-vector regularizer: in the reported Base->+Prox diagnostics, it improves AAA across multiple write-in rules, backbones, and class-incremental settings, while its fixed-coefficient variant remains competitive with strong coefficient-based baselines. Mechanistically, matched-prefix norm controls and proximal-strength sweeps show that proximal training shrinks the task-vector radius, lowers Fisher-weighted interference, broadens the coefficient plateau, and exposes a stability-plasticity trade-off. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of sequential LoRA merging depends not only on how much of a task vector is written in, but also on whether the task vector itself has been trained to be mergeable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把无回放持续学习的 LoRA 顺序合并写成任务向量写入操作，提出在任务向量训练阶段加近端惩罚 (Proximity Regularized Merging, PRM) 的最小改动，写入规则本身不变。PRM 使任务向量半径收缩、Fisher 加权干扰下降、合并系数平台变宽，并在多种写入规则、骨干与类增量设置上提升 AAA；固定系数版本仍与强系数基线相当。
Motivation: 无回放持续学习中，顺序合并 LoRA 适配器的效果高度依赖合并系数的调参，任务向量本身是否可合并被忽视，导致系数敏感、干扰随任务累积。
Method: PRM 在任务向量训练时加入近端惩罚项 (proximal penalty)，不改动后续写入规则；用匹配前缀范数控制 (matched-prefix norm controls) 与近端强度扫描 (proximal-strength sweeps) 做机制诊断，比较多种写入规则、骨干网络与类增量设置。
Result: 在报告的 Base→+Prox 诊断中，PRM 在多种写入规则、骨干与类增量设置上提升 AAA；其固定系数变体与强系数基线相当。机制上，近端训练收缩任务向量半径、降低 Fisher 加权干扰、拓宽系数平台，并显现出稳定性-可塑性权衡。
Conclusion: 顺序 LoRA 合并的效果不只取决于写入多少任务向量，还取决于任务向量在训练时是否被训练成可合并的；近端正则通过扩大系数平台降低对合并系数的敏感度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continual Data Unlearning in Diffusion Models via Transition-based Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Data unlearning in diffusion models aims to remove the influence of specific training examples without suppressing the broader concepts they represent. However, when deletion requests arrive sequentially, updates for new requests can degrade generative utility and undermine earlier deletions. We propose a continual data unlearning framework that uses completed deletion transitions as directional references to regularize future updates. For each request, we record changes in denoiser responses on the same fixed noisy inputs before and after unlearning. Rather than matching full post-deletion responses, we apply a one-sided penalty that discourages reversal along the recorded directions relative to the post-deletion references, while leaving orthogonal response changes and progress beyond these references unpenalized. To keep storage independent of the number of requests, we maintain a fixed-capacity bank of representative transition records. Records are selected based on the local sensitivity of progress along their recorded directions to parameter updates, allowing them to be retained even when their penalties are inactive. Empirical evaluations show that the proposed framework achieves a better balance between deletion persistence and generative utility than existing unlearning baselines as requests accumulate, using only a small transition memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散模型中删除请求顺序到达、后续更新会削弱先前删除效果的问题，提出以已完成删除的去噪器响应变化方向作为参考来约束后续更新的持续数据遗忘框架：对固定含噪输入记录删除前后响应变化，用单边惩罚禁止沿记录方向回退，而正交变化与超越参考的进展不受罚；并用固定容量的转移记录库按局部敏感度选留记录，使存储与请求数量无关。实验证明该框架在请求累积时比现有遗忘基线更好地平衡删除持久性与生成效用，且只需少量转移记忆。
Motivation: 顺序到达的删除请求会让新更新同时损害生成效用并推翻先前删除，而现有遗忘方法难以在请求持续累积时维持删除的持久性。
Method: 对每个请求，在同一批固定含噪输入上记录去噪器响应在遗忘前后的变化方向；不匹配完整删除后响应，而是施加单边惩罚，禁止参数更新沿记录方向相对删除后参考回退，正交变化与超越参考的进展不罚。用固定容量的转移记录库控制存储，按记录方向上进展对参数更新的局部敏感度选择保留记录，即使其惩罚处于非激活状态也保留。
Result: 实证评估显示，随着删除请求累积，该框架在删除持久性与生成效用的平衡上优于现有遗忘基线，且仅使用少量转移记忆。
Conclusion: 以删除转移方向做单边正则并配合固定容量记录库，可以在请求持续到达时同时守住先前删除与生成质量，存储开销与请求数量解耦。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HyperReCo: Retrieving and Connecting Evidence with Hypergraph Neural Networks for LLM Multi-hop Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities, with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supporting complex multi-hop reasoning by retrieving evidence distributed across documents. Graph-based approaches exploit connections among evidence, and hypergraph-based retrieval further preserves higher-order entity associations within documents and connects documents through shared entities. However, existing hypergraph retrievers often rely on predefined structural expansion or diffusion, which may miss query-dependent interactions needed to identify relevant evidence. They also leave connections among retrieved evidence implicit, requiring LLMs to reconstruct these connections before reasoning. Therefore, we propose HyperReCo, a framework for retrieving and connecting evidence with a hypergraph neural network (HyperGNN). We represent each document as a hyperedge over its extracted entities, with shared entities connecting the hyperedges. Through hypergraph message passing with joint supervision over documents and entities, the HyperGNN learns query-dependent interactions to retrieve complementary evidence. We further introduce Gradient-Guided Hyper-Path Decoding (GGHD), which uses gradient attribution to interpret the learned interactions and translate them into explicit hyper-paths that help LLMs combine complementary facts for multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on six benchmarks show that HyperReCo achieves the best retrieval performance among the compared methods on all three multi-hop QA datasets, together with strong downstream QA performance. Case studies and further analyses demonstrate the utility of decoded hyper-paths for connecting retrieved evidence.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 将每篇文档表示为其抽取实体构成的超边，共享实体连接各超边；用 HyperGNN 做超图消息传递，并在文档与实体上联合监督，学习查询相关的交互以检索互补证据；GGHD 用梯度归因解释学到的交互并解码为显式超路径，辅助 LLM 多跳推理。
Result: 在六个基准实验中，HyperReCo 在全部三个多跳 QA 数据集上的检索性能均为所比较方法中最优，同时下游 QA 表现强；案例研究与进一步分析显示解码出的超路径对连接检索证据有用。

papers.title: RLHarness: Co-evolving Procedural Skills with Reinforcement Learning for Long-horizon Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal reasoning requires models to preserve visual evidence through long decision chains while selecting appropriate procedures across diverse scenarios and rules. When learning is guided only by terminal verifiers, reinforcement learning (RL) reveals whether a final answer is correct but not how it should be produced. The policy must therefore discover reusable reasoning procedures while learning to execute them, creating a program cold-start problem. Skills can externalize successful procedures, reduce repeated exploration, and provide inspectable guidance. However, a fixed Skill Bank assumes that this guidance remains compatible with an evolving policy, while updating Skills alone can leave their triggers, execution protocols, and demonstrations stale or mutually inconsistent. We introduce RLHARNESS, which organizes Skills, selection and execution protocols, few-shot demonstrations, and task contracts into a unified, versioned Harness and alternates Harness evolution with policy learning. An Exploration-Distillation Harness builds the initial Harness and version-aligned verified traces for SFT and DAPO I. After the first RL block, a Post-RL Reconstruction Harness rebuilds Skills, protocols, and demonstrations from fresh success-failure rollouts, and DAPO II adapts the policy to the reconstructed program. RLHARNESS improves Accuracy from 16.25%/27.50% to 62.00%/50.00% on MetroMap/TravelMap and raises F1 score from 37.13%/45.50% to 65.81%/65.51% on Fee-VL/Cancel-VL. All four tasks achieve their best results only after reconstruction and DAPO II, showing that an evolving Harness complements RL by continually updating the external program that the policy learns to execute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLHARNESS 把 Skills、选择与执行协议、少样本示例和任务契约打包成带版本的 Harness，与策略学习交替演化：先由 Exploration-Distillation Harness 构建初版并做 SFT 与 DAPO I，RL 块之后再用新成功-失败 rollout 重建 Harness 并跑 DAPO II。MetroMap/TravelMap 准确率从 16.25%/27.50% 升到 62.00%/50.00%，Fee-VL/Cancel-VL 的 F1 从 37.13%/45.50% 升到 65.81%/65.51%，且四个任务都只在重建与 DAPO II 之后达到最佳。
Motivation: 只靠终局验证器的 RL 只能判断答案对错，无法告诉策略过程该怎么走，导致可复用推理程序的冷启动问题；而固定 Skill Bank 会与不断演化的策略失配，单独更新 Skills 又会让触发条件、执行协议和示例过期或互相矛盾。
Method: 将 Skills、选择与执行协议、少样本演示、任务契约组织为统一且带版本的 Harness，交替进行 Harness 演化与策略学习：Exploration-Distillation Harness 构建初始 Harness 并产出版本对齐的已验证轨迹用于 SFT 与 DAPO I；首个 RL 块后由 Post-RL Reconstruction Harness 依据新 success-failure rollouts 重建 Skills、协议与演示，再用 DAPO II 适配策略。
Result: MetroMap/TravelMap Accuracy 由 16.25%/27.50% 提升至 62.00%/50.00%；Fee-VL/Cancel-VL 的 F1 由 37.13%/45.50% 提升至 65.81%/65.51%；四个任务的最佳结果均出现在重建与 DAPO II 之后。
Conclusion: 不断演化的外部程序（Harness）与 RL 互补：策略学习执行的程序必须随 rollout 更新，否则 Skills、协议与演示会与策略脱节。

papers.title: Active Feature Acquisition With Incomplete Training Data
papers.abstract_en: In many prediction tasks, acquiring all features can be a prohibitively expensive or outright impossible task. Further, in many cases a static subset of features may not be enough to solve the problem sufficiently across various instances. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses these problems by formalizing the trade-off between feature cost and predictive performance during sequential feature selection. However, prior AFA work largely assumes access to complete training data, an assumption that is often violated in practice. Here we study AFA with Incomplete Training Data (AFA-ITD), showing that under missing completely at random (MCAR) data, one-step acquisition values remain unchanged, whereas multi-step values can decrease. We analyze three approaches to learning from incomplete data: aliasing, filtering, and generative restoration. We show that filtering can require a number of training instances scaling exponentially with the dimension, whereas generative restoration scales exponentially with the acquisition budget. We empirically test our theory on a controlled experiment and across common AFA datasets and find that missingness mainly damages methods that exploit multi-step acquisitions and that generative restoration is able to recover lost performance in many experiments. Code is available at https://github.com/Linusaronsson/AFA-Benchmark/tree/missing-data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究主动特征获取 (AFA) 在训练数据不完整时的 AFA-ITD 问题：MCAR 缺失下 one-step acquisition value 不变，而 multi-step value 会下降。三种学习策略中 filtering 所需训练样本数随维度指数增长，generative restoration 则随 acquisition budget 指数增长；实验显示缺失主要损害利用 multi-step acquisition 的方法，generative restoration 在多数实验中恢复了损失的性能。
Motivation: 既有 AFA 工作普遍假设训练数据完整，而实践中该假设常被违反；需要弄清缺失如何改变 acquisition value 以及各策略的代价。
Method: 在 MCAR 缺失假设下分析 one-step 与 multi-step acquisition value 的变化，比较三种从不完整数据学习的策略：aliasing、filtering、generative restoration，并推导 filtering 与 generative restoration 的样本复杂度随维度和 acquisition budget 的指数标度；在受控实验与常用 AFA 数据集上做实证检验，代码发布于 AFA-Benchmark 的 missing-data 分支。
Result: MCAR 下 one-step acquisition value 保持不变，multi-step value 可能下降；filtering 所需训练实例数随维度指数增长，generative restoration 随 acquisition budget 指数增长；受控实验与常用 AFA 数据集上，缺失主要破坏利用 multi-step acquisition 的方法，generative restoration 在多数实验中恢复了损失的性能。
Conclusion: 训练缺失对 AFA 的伤害集中在 multi-step 价值上，generative restoration 是多数情形下可行的补救，但其代价随 acquisition budget 指数增长。

papers.title: FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoundDSR 用高分辨率 RGB 作 prompt 引导 2D Gaussian Splatting，让高斯原语沿高频结构方向各向异性形变，再经深度重建分支上采样到高分辨率深度；并用异构联邦学习把每个数据源分到独立客户端做本地优化与全局聚合，以缓解大规模异构数据的分布差异导致的训练不稳与对主导数据源的偏置。在合成、真实、任意尺度与含噪四类零样本评测中一致优于现有 SOTA。
Motivation: 深度超分辨要跨未见过的数据分布泛化，而大规模异构训练数据存在分布差异，会带来训练不稳定并偏向主导数据源。
Method: 以高分辨率 RGB 为 prompt 优化高斯参数，使每个 Gaussian primitive 沿高频结构方向各向异性形变；高斯上采样表示再送入深度重建分支映射为高分辨率深度。训练侧引入 heterogeneous federated learning，每个数据源作为独立客户端做本地优化与全局聚合。
Result: 在合成、真实世界、任意尺度 (arbitrary-scale) 与含噪条件上的零样本评测中，FoundDSR 一致优于现有 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 引导式 2D Gaussian Splatting 加异构联邦学习能让基础模型在未知场景上保持稳健的深度重建与对多样大规模训练数据的稳定扩展性。

papers.title: Not All Errors Matter: Decision-Relevant Prediction Error Predicts Planning Quality
papers.abstract_en: World models are typically trained and evaluated by prediction error, assuming that more accurate predictions lead to better decisions. We show that this assumption can fail because models with similar total error can differ substantially in planning performance when their errors occur on different state dimensions. We introduce Decision-Relevant Prediction Error (DRPE), which measures prediction error on the state dimensions that affect decisions. We also develop an iso-error evaluation protocol that varies error allocation while keeping total error fixed. In a factored gridworld with known state relevance and a standardized planner, we evaluate 55 controlled and learned models across different error levels and allocations. Total prediction error is weakly related to planning success (Spearman $ρ=-0.25$), whereas DRPE is strongly predictive ($ρ=-0.84$; $-0.98$ within the controlled family). Models with only a 1\% difference in total error can differ by 60 percentage points in planning success (97\% vs 37\%). The relevant error also depends on the task, with model rankings reversing across tasks at the same total error. Deeper imagination further amplifies decision-relevant errors, while learned models exhibit systematic bias on rare but decision-critical events. We formalize sufficient conditions under which DRPE correctly ranks models and total prediction error cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界模型用总预测误差训练与选型，但总误差相近的模型规划质量可差 60 个百分点（97% vs 37%）。提出 Decision-Relevant Prediction Error (DRPE)，只度量落在影响决策的状态维度上的误差；在固定总误差、只改变误差分配的 iso-error 协议下，DRPE 与规划成功率的 Spearman ρ=-0.84（受控模型族内 -0.98），而总误差仅 ρ=-0.25。
Motivation: 世界模型默认预测越准规划越好，但同样的总误差落在不同状态维度上时规划表现差异巨大，总误差这一选型指标会给出错误排序。
Method: 提出 DRPE，只统计影响决策的状态维度上的预测误差；配套 iso-error 评测协议，在固定总误差的前提下改变误差分配。在状态相关性已知、使用标准化 planner 的 factored gridworld 中，评测 55 个受控与学习模型在不同误差水平和分配下的表现，并形式化 DRPE 能正确排序而总误差不能的充分条件。
Result: 总预测误差与规划成功仅弱相关（Spearman ρ=-0.25），DRPE 强预测（ρ=-0.84，受控模型族内 ρ=-0.98）；总误差只差 1% 的模型规划成功率可差 60 个百分点（97% vs 37%）。同一总误差下不同任务的模型排序会反转；更深的 imagination 放大决策相关误差，学习模型在稀有但决策关键事件上存在系统性偏差。
Conclusion: 世界模型的评价与训练目标应换成决策相关误差 DRPE，因为总预测误差无法可靠排序规划质量，且相关误差随任务而变。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Superposed Inference for Hyperdimensional Computing
papers.abstract_en: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is attractive for efficient and robust learning, but conventional inference still encodes every query independently, repeatedly paying the cost of high-dimensional projection. We introduce SupHDC, a new inference paradigm that processes multiple queries through a shared encoding computation. SupHDC assigns lightweight random slot keys, superposes the keyed queries before encoding, and uses slot-specific classifiers to recover their individual predictions. A random-feature kernel view explains why exact recovery of each hypervector is unnecessary: inference only needs to preserve the class evidence that determines the prediction. Across ten datasets, SupHDC achieves 1.39x analytical speedup with no average accuracy loss, and up to 2.08x speedup with only a 2.67 percentage-point mean accuracy loss. On a Raspberry Pi~5, it delivers 2.01x measured wall-clock speedup with a 2.26 percentage-point loss in mean prediction accuracy. SupHDC shows that high-dimensional redundancy can be used not only for robustness, but also as capacity for shared inference.

Motivation: HDC 推理要为每条查询独立重复高维投影，高维冗余只被用于鲁棒性，反复支付同一编码开销。
Method: SupHDC 推理范式：给每条查询分配轻量随机 slot key，对加键查询做叠加后统一编码，再用 slot 专用分类器恢复各自预测；用 random-feature kernel 视角论证无需精确恢复每条 hypervector，只要保留决定预测的类别证据即可。
Result: 十个数据集上 1.39x 解析加速且平均精度无损失；最高 2.08x 加速、平均精度损失 2.67 个百分点；Raspberry Pi 5 上实测墙钟加速 2.01x、平均预测精度损失 2.26 个百分点。

papers.title: Phase Space Attention:A Hairer Lift Circumvents the Single-Layer Induction Obstruction
papers.abstract_en: We circumvent the Sanford-Hsu-Telgarsky (SHT) single-layer induction obstruction within a linear, one-step, causal, bilinear, symplectically consistent design class on the post-RoPE substrate, by lifting attention onto a symplectic phase space, mirroring Hairer's lift of Stormer-Verlet. The lift exits the premise of the SHT counting argument rather than the bound itself. The reframing exhibits the obstruction as a filter-order gap: a one-layer bilinear score realises a $z$-transform of joint order $(0,0)$, whereas the induction discriminator requires key-side order $\geq 1$. Applying the symplectic upper shear $M_γ:(q,p)\mapsto(q+γp,p)$ to the post-RoPE query and key streams closes it. We prove this lift is unique within the factorised subclass, exactly symplectic at operator level, and requires post-RoPE placement; and in an explicit $T_4$-only Gaussian reduction we derive a closed-form two-branch induction phase transition, held out at $r=0.9876$ with zero fitted parameters. That law is an analytically solvable limit, not a robust prediction: restoring the $T_3$ channel moves $γ_c$ at $d_k=64$ from 1.030 to 0.569 and removes the crossover. Deployability follows by exact derivation: the KV cache is unchanged, prefix reuse and speculative decoding are preserved, overhead is $6d$ FLOPs per token per layer, INT8 headroom grows by at most $\log_2(1+2γ)$ bits, fused kernels are unmodified, and no parameters are added. At 91.3M parameters a supercritical sweep locates an emergence band: induction forms 3/3 seeds at $γ=0.80$ in a mean of 717 steps, against 2/3 seeds and 2700 steps at $γ=0$. Adverse results are reported as directly: a key-only half-lift reaches 0.949 against 0.811 for the symmetric operator, so if induction accuracy is the objective, the half-lift is the better construction. Forty-one notebooks and result files ship as ancillary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把注意力提升到辛相空间 (symplectic phase space)、对 post-RoPE 的 query/key 流施加辛上剪切 M_γ:(q,p)→(q+γp,p)，绕开 SHT 单层归纳障碍。91.3M 参数扫描中 γ=0.80 时 3/3 种子形成归纳、平均 717 步，而 γ=0 只有 2/3 种子、2700 步；但 key-only 半提升以 0.949 对 0.811 更优，若目标是归纳精度应选半提升。
Motivation: SHT 计数论证指出单层双线性 score 的 z 变换阶数为 (0,0)，达不到归纳判别器要求的 key 侧阶数 ≥1，构成单层归纳障碍；需要在保持因果、一步、辛一致的设计类内退出该论证前提。
Method: 把障碍重构为滤波器阶数缺口，用 Hairer 对 Störmer-Verlet 的提升思路施加辛上剪切 M_γ 于 post-RoPE query/key 流；证明该提升在因子化子类中唯一、算子级精确辛且必须 post-RoPE 放置，并在仅 T_4 的高斯约化中解析推导双分支归纳相变。
Result: T_4-only 极限给出零拟合参数的相变律，held out 于 r=0.9876；恢复 T_3 通道后 d_k=64 处 γ_c 从 1.030 移到 0.569 并消除交叉。91.3M 参数超临界扫描：γ=0.80 时 3/3 种子形成归纳、平均 717 步，γ=0 时 2/3 种子、2700 步；key-only 半提升 0.949 对对称算子 0.811。开销为每 token 每层 6d FLOPs，INT8 headroom 至多增加 log2(1+2γ) 比特，KV cache 不变、不加参数。
Conclusion: 障碍是阶数缺口而非界本身，辛提升可零参数、不改 fused kernel 地关闭它；但解析相变律只是可解极限而非稳健预测，且若以归纳精度为目标，半提升优于对称辛算子。

papers.title: What Can a Leaderboard Certify? Compositional Controllability for Fair Evaluation and Training of Biomedical Literature-Review Agents
papers.abstract_en: Leaderboards rank long-horizon agents by their final outputs. Yet a higher score alone does not establish whether two systems are comparable or which stage accounts for the difference. Unequal evidence, inputs, or budgets can affect scores, and statistical corrections do not remove this mismatch. We introduce compositional controllability to address these questions. A comparison window covers one stage, several stages, or the whole agent. Our central result bounds the gap between observed and controlled score differences using only nuisance outside the window. This yields an admissibility test applied before scores are inspected. Inadmissible comparisons are refused. For admissible pairs, an ordering is certified only when the score gap exceeds the combined sampling and nuisance radii; otherwise, it remains undecided. These decisions give each system a rank interval. We introduce BioLitBench, a benchmark of 2,042 biomedical articles represented as structured claim graphs. Among seven published pipelines, a conventional statistical analysis declares a winner in 14 of 21 pairwise comparisons. Yet the top-ranked system alone received the target review's bibliography. To isolate pipeline performance, our test requires matched inputs and a fixed backbone model. It refuses 11 of the 21 comparisons, including every comparison involving the top-ranked system. Seven of the 14 conventional conclusions fall within these refused pairs. The same comparison windows support stage-level training. We train SCRIBE on Qwen3.8-27B using rewards measured at each stage's exit. Under matched evidence, SCRIBE achieves a certified rank interval of [1,2], with certified advantages over all evaluated published pipelines and the evaluated Claude and OpenAI agents. Under same pool, SCRIBE matches the strongest published retriever and is certified above three published pipelines.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 1 figure, 18 tables. Zhaowei Han, Xiang Zhang, and Lingxiao Guan contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/shawnzhg/LitReview-SCRIBE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 compositional controllability：用比较窗口界定可比性，先做准入检验再看分数，拒绝输入或预算不匹配的比较，只在分差超过采样与 nuisance 半径之和时认证排序。在 BioLitBench（2,042 篇生物医学文献的结构化 claim graph）上，21 组两两比较中常规统计分析在 14 组宣布赢家，而该检验拒绝 11 组，其中包含全部涉及最高排名系统的比较。用逐阶段奖励训练的 SCRIBE（Qwen3.8-27B）在匹配证据下取得认证排名区间 [1,2]。
Motivation: 长程 agent 的 leaderboard 只看最终输出分数，证据、输入或预算不平等就会污染分数，统计校正无法消除这种不可比性，也无法指出差异出在哪个阶段。
Method: 定义覆盖单阶段、多阶段或整条 agent 的比较窗口，中心结果把观测分差与受控分差之差用窗口外 nuisance 界定；据此在看分数前做准入检验，不合格比较直接拒绝，合格对只有分差超过采样半径与 nuisance 半径之和才认证排序，否则记为未定，每个系统得到一个排名区间。同一窗口用于逐阶段训练：在 Qwen3.8-27B 上以各阶段出口处的奖励训练 SCRIBE。
Result: BioLitBench 含 2,042 篇生物医学文章的结构化 claim graph；七条已发表 pipeline 的 21 组两两比较中，常规统计分析在 14 组宣布赢家，本检验拒绝 11 组（含全部涉及最高排名系统的比较），14 个常规结论中有 7 个落在被拒绝的比较里；最高排名系统单独获得了目标综述的参考文献。匹配证据下 SCRIBE 认证排名区间 [1,2]，相对所有被评估的已发表 pipeline 及 Claude、OpenAI agent 有认证优势；同池设定下 SCRIBE 与最强已发表 retriever 持平，并认证高于三条已发表 pipeline。
Conclusion: leaderboard 排名只有在输入、证据与 backbone 匹配且分差超过采样与 nuisance 半径时才可被认证，否则应拒绝或记为未定；逐阶段可比的比较窗口同时能支撑阶段级训练。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: All On-Board: Fully On-Chip Neuromorphic Q-Learning with Embedded CartPole Simulation
papers.abstract_en: As AI models grow in size and usage, their energy demands increase dramatically, raising sustainability and economic concerns. Neuromorphic hardware, inspired by the energy efficiency of the brain, seeks to address this challenge by offering low-power, fast-processing alternatives to conventional computing. Such hardware is particularly well-suited to control systems deployed in resource-constrained environments, which are best trained via reinforcement learning (RL). This contribution presents the design and implementation of a fully on-chip, closed-loop Loihi 2 RL agent. Our neuromorphic circuit consists of a fully embedded Q-learning algorithm and an on-chip simulation of the CartPole-v0 environment on Loihi 2. Our Q-learning algorithm trained the same number of successful agents as the CPU implementation in only half the execution time and with two orders of magnitude less dynamic power. These findings demonstrate the viability of RL on neuromorphic hardware and highlight its promise for building energy-efficient, real-time, embedded AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Loihi 2 上实现全片上闭环强化学习：Q-learning 算法与 CartPole-v0 环境仿真都嵌入芯片，无需外部 CPU。与 CPU 实现相比，训练出的成功 agent 数量相同，执行时间减半，动态功耗低两个数量级。
Motivation: AI 模型能耗快速上升带来可持续性与经济压力，资源受限环境中部署的控制系统需要低功耗、实时的训练与推理方案。
Method: 在 Loihi 2 神经形态硬件上设计并实现全片上闭环 RL agent：神经形态电路内嵌完整的 Q-learning 算法，并把 CartPole-v0 环境仿真也放到片上，与 CPU 实现对照。
Result: 训练出的成功 agent 数量与 CPU 实现相同；执行时间仅为 CPU 的一半；动态功耗比 CPU 低两个数量级（约 100 倍）。
Conclusion: 强化学习可以在神经形态硬件上以更低功耗和更短执行时间完成训练，为资源受限环境中的节能实时嵌入式 AI 系统提供可行路径。

papers.title: One Perception, All Maneuvers: Directional Traffic Signal Understanding for Maneuver-Level Signal Intent Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Traffic lights are a key regulatory signal for autonomous driving at urban intersections, yet existing traffic signal perception is still predominantly formulated as instance-level detection or color recognition. Such formulations identify where traffic lights are and what colors they display, but leave a critical semantic gap before downstream planning: which ego maneuver is controlled by each visible signal and what dynamic permission the signal expresses for that maneuver. In this paper, we formulate Directional Traffic Signal Understanding, a decision-oriented task that predicts structured signal states for straight, left-turn, right-turn, and U-turn maneuvers from a front-view image. Each state contains the associated signal color and signal-implied passability. Based on OpenLane-V2, we provide a direction-level benchmark with maneuver-level supervision and metrics for color recognition, passability, full-frame consistency, and safety-critical errors. A direction-aware baseline combines global context, localized traffic-light evidence, and maneuver-specific representations. Experiments show that direction-level modeling improves passability prediction over image-level classifiers and detection-oriented pipelines, particularly at complex multi-signal intersections. The resulting representation provides a direct and interpretable traffic-signal interface for downstream planning together with topology, route, and surrounding-agent information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把交通信号理解从实例级检测/颜色识别改成面向机动动作的 Directional Traffic Signal Understanding：从前视图像直接预测直行、左转、右转、掉头各自的信号颜色与通行许可 (passability)。基于 OpenLane-V2 建方向级 benchmark，方向感知基线在复杂多信号交叉口的通行许可预测优于图像级分类器与检测式流程。
Motivation: 现有交通信号感知只回答灯在哪、什么颜色，与下游规划所需的“哪条机动动作受该灯控制、允许什么动态通行”之间存在语义鸿沟。
Method: 定义结构化信号状态任务（每个机动动作含颜色与 passability），基于 OpenLane-V2 提供带方向级监督的 benchmark，指标覆盖颜色识别、passability、全帧一致性与安全关键错误；方向感知基线融合全局上下文、局部灯光证据与机动动作专属表示。
Result: 实验显示方向级建模在 passability 预测上优于图像级分类器与检测导向流程，在复杂多信号交叉口提升尤为明显；benchmark 提供颜色识别、passability、全帧一致性与安全关键错误四类指标。
Conclusion: 按机动动作建模交通信号能给出可直接接入下游规划的、可解释的信号接口，与拓扑、路径和周围智能体信息配合使用。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-time language models adapt a compact memory while processing the input sequence. This perspective encompasses nonlinear fast-weight learning in LaCT, associative delta-rule updates in DeltaNet, and generalized delta-rule state updates in RWKV-7. Training these models to predict the next token does not explicitly require a fact to remain accessible after many subsequent memory updates. We study delayed supervision for this test-time memory: during post-training, ask a simulator-grounded question only after a long interval of unrelated events, and supervise its answer alongside ordinary next-token prediction. Questions are evaluated on disposable branches, so their answers never enter the continuing event stream. The construction distinguishes retention from revision: a retained fact must remain valid throughout the delay, whereas a revised fact must be answered with its latest value. We evaluate this approach on LaCT-760M and plain DeltaNet-1.3B using TextWorld training trajectories and shared BABILong and RULER evaluation panels, and include a separately reported RWKV-7 comparison. Relative to event-only training, delayed QA improves BABILong by 5.48 percentage points for LaCT and 1.32 points for DeltaNet, and single-needle RULER by 1.45 and 3.27 points, respectively. The RWKV-7 comparison reports gains of 4.60 and 7.00 points on its own panels. These results support delayed semantic supervision as a practical outer training objective for usable test-time memory, while leaving open how much of the benefit derives specifically from delay rather than general question-answering and answer-termination supervision.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Equal contribution by both authors. Work done at MIT CSAIL

TL;DR: 在后训练阶段给测试时记忆模型加延迟监督：事件流推进很长一段无关内容后才提一个由模拟器支撑的问题，并与常规 next-token 预测一起监督答案，问题在一次性分支上作答、答案不进入后续事件流。相对仅事件训练，LaCT-760M 的 BABILong 提升 5.48 个百分点、DeltaNet-1.3B 提升 1.32 点，单针 RULER 分别提升 1.45 与 3.27 点，RWKV-7 自有面板上提升 4.60 与 7.00 点。

Method: 后训练时在长间隔无关事件之后提出模拟器支撑的问答 (simulator-grounded QA)，与 next-token 预测联合监督；问题在 disposable branch 上评测，答案不进入继续的事件流。构造区分 retention（延迟内始终有效）与 revision（须答最新值），在 LaCT-760M 与 plain DeltaNet-1.3B 上用 TextWorld 训练轨迹，配 BABILong 与 RULER 共享评测面板，并单独报告 RWKV-7 对照。
Result: 相对 event-only 训练：BABILong 上 LaCT 提升 5.48 个百分点、DeltaNet 提升 1.32 点；单针 RULER 上分别提升 1.45 与 3.27 点；RWKV-7 在其自有面板上提升 4.60 与 7.00 点。
Conclusion: 延迟语义监督可作为让测试时记忆可用的外层训练目标；收益中有多少专门来自“延迟”而非一般问答与答案终止监督，仍是开放问题。

papers.title: PhiFold: Towards Dynamic Protein Design with Physics-Structured Covariance Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Protein design is moving beyond structural correctness toward function-aware design, yet existing generative models typically treat dynamics as a downstream property estimated through simulation or prediction after structure generation. Using MD trajectories as a generative target is also undesirable because stochastic, path-dependent trajectories over-specify the underlying equilibrium ensemble. We introduce PhiFold, a framework for jointly generating protein backbones and their second-order dynamics, represented by residue-displacement covariance. Rather than predicting the quadratically sized full covariance, PhiFold decomposes dynamics into three interpretable components: local flexibility, a low-rank collective-motion representation, and residue-wise collective participation. These components are assembled into a positive-definite covariance matrix with exact marginal consistency, yielding a compact and physically constrained representation of equilibrium dynamics. Across generated proteins, PhiFold improves recovery of local fluctuations and long-range residue coupling while remaining competitive on dominant collective-motion subspaces. It further enables bidirectional control of residue flexibility while preserving backbone designability. By unifying structure generation with an explicit representation of equilibrium dynamics, PhiFold lays a foundation for designing proteins not only by how they look, but also by how they move.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhiFold 把蛋白骨架生成与平衡态二阶动力学（残基位移协方差）联合生成，将协方差分解为局部柔性、低秩集体运动、残基级集体参与三个可解释分量，再组装成正定且边缘一致的矩阵。生成蛋白上局部涨落与长程残基耦合的恢复得到改善，主导集体运动子空间保持竞争力，并支持在保持骨架可设计性的同时双向调控残基柔性。
Motivation: 现有生成模型把动力学当作结构生成之后用模拟或预测估计的下游属性；直接以 MD 轨迹为生成目标又因随机、路径依赖而过度指定底层平衡系综。
Method: PhiFold 联合生成蛋白骨架与残基位移协方差表示的二阶动力学；不预测二次方规模的完整协方差，而是分解为局部柔性、低秩集体运动表示、残基级集体参与三个分量，再组装成具有精确边缘一致性的正定协方差矩阵，形成紧凑且受物理约束的平衡动力学表示。
Result: 在生成的蛋白上，PhiFold 改善局部涨落与长程残基耦合的恢复，在主导集体运动子空间上保持竞争力；并实现在保持骨架可设计性 (designability) 的前提下对残基柔性的双向控制。
Conclusion: 结构生成应与显式的平衡动力学表示统一，蛋白设计可以同时按“长什么样”和“怎么动”来进行。

papers.title: Train4Merge: A Controlled Single-Teacher Study of RL vs. SFT Teachers for OPD-Based Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Domain experts trained from a shared checkpoint can be merged into one model through on-policy distillation (OPD), where they act as teachers supervising a student on its own trajectories. One upstream choice is rarely examined: whether to build each expert with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL). Yet equally strong teachers need not be equally good teachers. We probe this choice through controlled single-teacher OPD, a building block of multi-teacher OPD: in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, comparably performing SFT and RL teachers are trained from Qwen3.5-9B, each guiding a student initialized from it. At their best checkpoints, RL-guided students outperform SFT-guided students by 4.27, 1.50, and 0.86 percentage points in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, respectively, and recover more of their teachers' performance gains over the base model. The contrast is clearest in Agentic, where the best SFT-guided student recovers only 44.44% of its teacher's gain, whereas the best RL-guided student recovers 115.00%, surpassing its teacher. Our analysis points to an explanation: RL teachers stay much closer to the shared initialization in parameter space than SFT teachers and are therefore easier for their students to follow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受控单教师 on-policy distillation (OPD) 设定下，用 RL 而非 SFT 训练教师更利于学生继承教师增益：从 Qwen3.5-9B 出发训练的可比强度教师分别指导同初始化的学生，RL 指导学生在 Agentic、Reasoning、Perception 上分别高出 4.27、1.50、0.86 个百分点。Agentic 上最佳 SFT 学生只回收教师相对基座增益的 44.44%，RL 学生回收 115.00% 并超过教师；原因是 RL 教师在参数空间更贴近共享初始化，学生更容易跟随。
Motivation: 多教师 OPD 中每个专家用 SFT 还是 RL 训练这一上游选择很少被检验，而强度相当的教师未必同样是好教师。
Method: 受控单教师 OPD（多教师 OPD 的构建块）：从共享 checkpoint Qwen3.5-9B 分别训练 Agentic、Reasoning、Perception 三个可比性能的 SFT 教师与 RL 教师，各自在学生自身轨迹上做蒸馏，学生同样初始化自该基座，比较各自最佳 checkpoint。
Result: RL 指导学生在 Agentic、Reasoning、Perception 上分别比 SFT 指导学生高 4.27、1.50、0.86 个百分点，且回收教师相对基座的增益更多；Agentic 上最佳 SFT 指导学生仅回收教师增益的 44.44%，最佳 RL 指导学生回收 115.00% 并超过其教师。
Conclusion: 教师的可跟随性不只取决于强度：RL 教师在参数空间更靠近共享初始化，因此学生更容易学到位，选教师时应把参数空间偏移纳入考量。

papers.title: On the Capability and Limitation of Hard Prompt
papers.abstract_en: Prompt engineering has become an indispensable tool for using large language models (LLMs), turning LLMs into task-specific experts without changing their weights. Despite notable theoretical advances in prompt engineering, the theory for the more practical hard or discrete prompts is largely open. In this paper, we try to fill this gap either by providing a complete solution or by making substantial progress on the three core theoretical questions regarding hard prompts. First, we show that determining the existence of a hard prompt for a transformer to solve a downstream task is NP-complete and that finding an optimal hard prompt is NP-hard, which is the first computational complexity result for hard prompting, as far as we know. Second, we show that, unlike soft or continuous prompts, hard prompts have essential limitations: hard prompts are not complete; short hard prompts do not significantly enhance the ability of transformers; and long hard prompts exhibit the "prompt dominating answer phenomenon," meaning that, with high probability, the same answer is given for all queries of the same length. On the other hand, linear hard prompts do not have the limitations of short or long prompts. Third, we provide a tight bound on the size of the task in terms of the prompt length for the performance of prompts on the finite task to generalize to the entire data distribution, leading to a necessary and sufficient condition for generalizability. This is the first result on generalization for prompting, as far as we know. Our findings not only offer the first theoretical insights into hard prompts but also provide provably reliable practical guidance for real-world LLM usage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对硬提示 (hard prompt) 给出首个计算复杂度与能力边界结论：判定 transformer 上是否存在解下游任务的硬提示是 NP-complete，找最优硬提示是 NP-hard；短硬提示不能显著增强 transformer 能力，长硬提示则出现 prompt dominating answer 现象——以高概率对同长度的所有查询给出同一答案，而线性硬提示不具这两类局限。
Motivation: 提示工程理论主要建立在连续 soft prompt 上，实际更常用的离散硬提示缺乏理论刻画：其可解性、能力上限与泛化条件都不清楚。
Method: 围绕硬提示的三个核心理论问题展开：判定存在性与求最优解的复杂度归约；区分短、长与线性硬提示的能力刻画（含 prompt dominating answer 现象的概率陈述）；就任务规模相对提示长度给出紧界，导出从有限任务泛化到整个数据分布的充要条件。
Result: 判定硬提示存在性为 NP-complete、求最优硬提示为 NP-hard；硬提示不具完备性 (not complete)；短硬提示不显著增强 transformer 能力，长硬提示以高概率对同长度所有查询给出相同答案，线性硬提示无此两类限制；给出任务规模关于提示长度的紧界，得到泛化的充要条件。
Conclusion: 硬提示的能力与局限可由复杂度、提示长度分档与泛化条件三组理论结果刻画，作者称其为对真实 LLM 使用的可证明可靠的实际指导。

papers.title: When Does Synergy Help Active Feature Acquisition? A PID-Based Study
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects informative features under budget constraints. However, existing policies rarely distinguish whether information contributed by interacting features is redundant, unique, or synergistic. We introduce SynAFA, a state-dependent AFA policy that combines pairwise joint information and conditional information, with Partial Information Decomposition (PID) characterizing its information structure. Across five tabular datasets and MNIST-loop, performance is heterogeneous. SynAFA shows its strongest gains at low budgets on PhysioNet, where synergistic and redundant feature pairs are supported by permutation tests, but its advantage diminishes as budgets increase and does not depend on pair proposals. SynAFA performs significantly worse than nearly all baselines on MiniBooNE, and than CAE on MNIST-loop. Controlled synthetic experiments further show that, within budget, SynAFA's advantage rises as joint information becomes more synergy-dominated, including when total joint information is held approximately constant. Further analyses show that the budget-dependent erosion is not resolved by non-greedy local search, which improves a diagnostic set-level objective but leaves predictive performance no better, often significantly worse, and that improvements in this objective are weakly aligned with the fixed classifier's predictive utility. These findings characterize when pairwise synergy can benefit AFA while exposing a persistent challenge in translating local information into effective acquisition objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SynAFA 是一个状态相关的主动特征获取 (AFA) 策略，用成对联合信息加条件信息、并以部分信息分解 (PID) 刻画其信息结构。在五个表格数据集与 MNIST-loop 上表现异质：低预算时 PhysioNet 增益最强（协同与冗余对经置换检验支持），但预算增大优势被侵蚀；MiniBooNE 上显著差于几乎所有基线，MNIST-loop 上差于 CAE。合成实验显示，预算内联合信息越偏协同，SynAFA 优势越大（总联合信息近似固定时亦然）。
Motivation: 现有 AFA 策略很少区分交互特征提供的信息是冗余、独特还是协同，导致预算分配无法针对协同主导的特征对，且局部信息难以转化为有效的采集目标。
Method: SynAFA 为状态依赖策略，组合成对联合信息与条件信息，并用 Partial Information Decomposition (PID) 刻画信息结构；在五个表格数据集与 MNIST-loop 上评测，辅以可控合成实验（固定总联合信息、调节协同占比）与非贪婪局部搜索分析。
Result: PhysioNet 低预算下增益最强，协同与冗余特征对经置换检验支持，优势随预算增大而减弱，且不依赖 pair proposals；MiniBooNE 上显著差于几乎所有基线，MNIST-loop 上差于 CAE；合成实验中预算内优势随联合信息更偏协同而上升（总联合信息近似恒定时仍成立）；非贪婪局部搜索改善集合级诊断目标，但预测性能不更优、常显著更差，且该目标改善与固定分类器预测效用弱对齐。
Conclusion: 成对协同只有在预算受限且特征对确由协同/冗余支撑时才利于 AFA；把局部信息目标直接当作采集目标存在持续困难，诊断目标的改善不保证预测效用提升。
Relevance: 2
