papers.title: Refresh or Realize? Compute Allocation in Drifting Models
papers.abstract_en: Drifting Models train a one-step generator by recomputing a finite-sample drift field at every iteration and taking an optimizer step toward the drifted target. The field says how generated samples should move, but the step is taken in parameters shared by all samples, so the motion the network actually makes need not match the motion it was given. This leaves a basic training question open: should extra compute go into fitting the current target more closely, or into recomputing the field? We study it on ImageNet 256x256. Holding the target fixed for k optimizer steps and measuring the realized displacement, we find that deeper fitting does bring the network closer to the frozen target, and that the number of steps needed before it makes any net progress drops from about sixteen early in training to one later on. When the extra steps come for free, k=2 also lowers FID. Once they are paid for, the result flips: at approximately matched measured wall-clock, spending the budget on fresh fields gives lower FID than deeper fitting, on both training seeds. The target itself shows why a fresh field is worth so much. Redrawing the finite support rotates its direction far more than a parameter update does (cosine ~0.3-0.6 against ~0.95), and a correction that is optimal in field space is not reliably better in FID than a parameter-free one. For Drifting, fitting each target well and spending compute well are different goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Drifting Models 每步重算有限样本 drift field 并朝漂移目标走一步，但参数更新是所有样本共享的，实际位移与给定位移不一致。在 ImageNet 256x256 上，固定目标多走 k 步确实更贴近冻结目标，取得净进展所需步数从训练早期约 16 步降到后期 1 步；额外步数免费时 k=2 还能降低 FID，但按实测 wall-clock 对齐付费后结论反转：把预算花在重算新 field 上比继续深拟合得到更低 FID，两个训练种子上一致。
Motivation: Drifting Models 的一步生成器训练里，多算力该用于更紧地拟合当前目标还是用于重算 drift field，是一个未决的训练问题：网络在共享参数上的实际运动未必等于 field 给出的运动。
Method: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上固定目标连续跑 k 个 optimizer step 并测量实际位移 (realized displacement)，比较深拟合与重算新 field 两种算力去向；同时比较 field 空间中方向在重采样有限支撑后的旋转幅度与参数更新后的方向变化（余弦相似度），并对照 field 空间最优校正与无参数校正的 FID。
Result: 深拟合使网络更接近冻结目标，取得净进展所需步数从训练早期约 16 步降到后期 1 步；额外步数免费时 k=2 降低 FID，按实测 wall-clock 对齐后改为重算新 field 的 FID 更低，两个训练种子上一致。重绘有限支撑使 field 方向旋转远大于参数更新（余弦约 0.3–0.6 对约 0.95），field 空间最优的校正在 FID 上不比无参数校正更可靠。
Conclusion: 对 Drifting 而言，把每个目标拟合好与把算力花好是两个不同目标：目标本身变化远快于参数更新，因此按 wall-clock 计预算时重算 field 优于更深拟合。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Agentsensus: Consensus-Compressed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent Story Worlds
papers.abstract_en: A agentic story world is a dynamic system simulating who learned what, when, and from whom -- yet the standard design gives each character a private memory stream. A shared event is therefore stored once per witness, large duplication will be incurred in terms of storage. We present Agentsensus, a story-world simulation framework in which there is an unified long-term memory. Records of the same event merge into one owned by all its witnesses, and semantically relevant memory records are linked. We evaluate on four worlds -- two classical Chinese novels, Hamlet, and a real-world conflict timeline -- run for 40 to 80 rounds against three per-character memory designs under an equal-granularity protocol. Agentsensus writes 22-44% fewer entries than the closest baseline and is the only design whose memory becomes shared (14-28% of records held by more than one character, some by 10) and linked (94-99%), at judged simulation quality indistinguishable or even better than the baselines. An ablation attributes this to the merge itself: disabling it multiplies the store by 3.1x and takes sharing to exactly zero. Sharing also compounds with the horizon rather than saturating early, rising 6% to 9% to 14% as one world is re-run at 10, 20 and 40 rounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentsensus 把多智能体故事世界的私有记忆流改成统一长期记忆：同一事件的记录合并为一条由全体见证者共有，并对语义相关记录建链接。在四个世界（两部中国古典小说、Hamlet、真实冲突时间线）各跑 40–80 轮、对比三种逐角色记忆设计，写入条目少 22–44%，共享记录占 14–28%（最高一条被 10 个角色持有）、链接率 94–99%，且仿真质量与基线持平或更好；关闭合并后存储放大 3.1 倍、共享率归零。
Motivation: 标准设计给每个角色独立记忆流，同一共享事件被每个见证者各存一份，存储冗余大，且角色间记忆彼此孤立。
Method: 提出统一长期记忆框架 Agentsensus：同一事件的多份记录合并为一条由所有见证者共有，语义相关的记忆记录之间建立链接；在四个故事世界（两部中国古典小说、Hamlet、真实冲突时间线）上以等粒度协议运行 40–80 轮，对比三种逐角色记忆设计，并做关闭合并的消融。
Result: 写入条目比最接近的基线少 22–44%；是唯一同时做到共享（14–28% 的记录被多个角色持有，其中一些被 10 个角色持有）与链接（94–99%）的设计，仿真质量被判为与基线无差别甚至更好。消融显示关闭合并使存储放大 3.1 倍、共享率恰为零。共享率随轮次累积而非早期饱和：同一世界在 10、20、40 轮重跑时从 6% 升到 9% 再到 14%。
Conclusion: 记忆合并本身是共享与压缩的来源，且共享随仿真时长继续累积；统一共享记忆可在不损失仿真质量的前提下显著压缩多智能体故事世界的存储。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FUND: Density Flow for Sampling Unnormalised Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Efficient sampling from Boltzmann distributions is central to modelling complex physical systems. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods suffer from critical slowing down, high autocorrelation, and poor mode-mixing, limiting their scalability. Recent advances, like Boltzmann Generators, offer a promising alternative but remain constrained by costly MCMC-based training, inefficient sampling, and poor ergodicity. We introduce an algorithm for learning Boltzmann distributions that does not require any true samples for training. Our approach draws inspiration from flow matching but departs fundamentally from sample-trajectory matching to distribution-trajectory matching. The algorithm iteratively reshapes the target distribution, using model generated samples to guide learning and ensure comprehensive mode coverage. We validate our method on standard benchmarks, including a 2D Gaussian mixture, Many-Well distributions, and high-dimensional scalar $φ^4$ theory. The proposed approach not only improves sampling performance and accuracy over traditional MCMC and flow-based baselines but also establishes a new method for sample-free learning of complex physical distributions.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FUND：把 flow matching 的样本轨迹匹配改成分布轨迹匹配，用模型自生成样本迭代重塑目标分布，实现无需真实样本训练的 Boltzmann 分布学习。在 2D Gaussian mixture、Many-Well 与高维标量 φ⁴ 理论上，采样性能与精度优于传统 MCMC 与 flow 基线。
Motivation: MCMC 存在临界慢化、高自相关与模式混合差，Boltzmann Generators 又受制于昂贵的 MCMC 训练、低效采样与遍历性差，难以扩展到复杂物理体系。
Method: 受 flow matching 启发但改为 distribution-trajectory matching：不匹配样本轨迹而匹配分布轨迹，迭代重塑目标分布，并用模型生成的样本引导学习以保证模式覆盖；训练不需要真实样本。
Result: 在标准基准上验证：2D Gaussian mixture、Many-Well 分布与高维标量 φ⁴ 理论；相对传统 MCMC 与 flow-based 基线，采样性能与精度均有提升。
Conclusion: 分布轨迹匹配加自生成样本引导，可以摆脱真实样本与 MCMC 训练的依赖，成为学习复杂物理分布的一条 sample-free 路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GLIDE: Generalized Layer-wise Intrinsic Distributional Evaluation for Heterogeneous LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents require reliable step-level evaluation to compare candidate branches and allocate computation effectively. However, lightweight evaluation remains challenging. External verifiers introduce additional inference cost, while agent-produced confidence or self-evaluation scores can be miscalibrated, especially when candidates are generated by heterogeneous agents. We propose \textbf{G}eneralized \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{D}istributional \textbf{E}valuation (\textbf{GLIDE}) for LLM agents. \textsc{GLIDE} derives intrinsic step evidence from layer-wise residual coherence, which measures whether local residual updates consistently support the global residual change induced by a candidate step. It calibrates this evidence against the recent score distribution of the generating agent and converts it into a pessimistic reward that jointly accounts for absolute residual evidence and agent-relative standing. The reward provides a cross-agent value signal for MCTS branch selection, while normalized predictive uncertainty guides adaptive branching. Experiments on multi-hop reasoning, sequential decision making, and symbolic logic show that \textsc{GLIDE} improves task performance, step-level ranking quality, and computational efficiency without external verifiers or task-specific supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLIDE 用 LLM 内部逐层残差一致性 (layer-wise residual coherence) 生成步级证据，按生成 agent 的近期分数分布校准后转成悲观奖励，供 MCTS 跨 agent 选分支，并用归一化预测不确定性引导自适应分支。在多跳推理、序贯决策与符号逻辑三类任务上，该方法在不引入外部验证器和任务特定监督的前提下同时改善任务性能、步级排序质量与计算效率。
Motivation: LLM agent 需要步级评估来比较候选分支并分配算力，但外部验证器带来额外推理成本，agent 自报置信度或自评分数在异构 agent 生成候选时容易失准。
Method: GLIDE 从逐层残差一致性提取内在步级证据，衡量局部残差更新是否一致支持候选步引起的全局残差变化；再对照生成 agent 的近期分数分布做校准，转成同时考虑绝对残差证据与 agent 相对位次的悲观奖励。该奖励作为 MCTS 分支选择的跨 agent 价值信号，归一化预测不确定性用于自适应分支。
Result: 在多跳推理、序贯决策和符号逻辑三类实验中，GLIDE 提升任务性能、步级排序质量与计算效率，且不使用外部验证器与任务特定监督。
Conclusion: 内部残差证据加 agent 相对校准可以替代外部验证器，为异构 LLM agent 的 MCTS 分支选择提供跨 agent 步级价值信号。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: GLIDE 从逐层残差一致性提取内在步级证据，衡量局部残差更新是否一致支持候选步引起的全局残差变化；再对照生成 agent 的近期分数分布做校准，转成同时考虑绝对残差证据与 agent 相对位次的悲观奖励。该奖励作为 MCTS 分支选择的跨 agent 价值信号，归一化预测不确定性用于自适应分支。
summary_sections.result: 在多跳推理、序贯决策和符号逻辑三类实验中，GLIDE 提升任务性能、步级排序质量与计算效率，且不使用外部验证器与任务特定监督。
summary_sections.conclusion: 内部残差证据加 agent 相对校准可以替代外部验证器，为异构 LLM agent 的 MCTS 分支选择提供跨 agent 步级价值信号。

papers.title: TRAP: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Memorization in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a language model on sensitive records can leave it able to reproduce them. We ask when this memorization arises and how to prevent it without knowing in advance which spans are sensitive. Our starting point is that most memorization scores and attacks share one statistical core: whether the model assigns a token more probability than some reference would. Taking as the reference a model trained on the complementary half of the same corpus gives the Target Reference Advantage (TRA), a per-token signal that separates what a model fit to a particular record from what it learned across records, and is cheap and differentiable. We then study what drives memorization during fine-tuning: it keeps growing well past the validation minimum, is larger on small datasets and at higher learning rates, and higher when the underlying task is harder. Early stopping removes much of it, but because it is chosen by aggregate validation loss it helps least for rare, hard-to-predict spans embedded in otherwise learnable text, which is exactly what sensitive information tends to be. We therefore introduce TRAP, a one-sided penalty on tokenwise TRA that acts only where the target model pulls ahead of its reference. On student essays with annotated personal information and clinical cases with patient identifiers, TRAP brings memorization near the level of an untrained model at little utility cost, where generic regularizers barely move and differential privacy gives up most of what fine-tuning bought.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRAP 用互补语料训练的参考模型定义 Target Reference Advantage (TRA)，把「目标模型比参考模型更偏爱某个 token」作为逐 token 记忆信号，并对其施加单侧惩罚。记忆在验证损失最低点之后仍持续增长，小数据集、高学习率、任务更难时更严重；早停对嵌在易学文本中的稀有敏感片段帮助最小。在带标注个人信息的学生作文与含患者标识的临床病例上，TRAP 把记忆压到接近未训练模型且效用损失很小，而通用正则几乎不动、差分隐私丢掉微调的大部分收益。
Motivation: 在敏感记录上微调语言模型会记住并复现这些记录，而事先不知道哪些片段敏感；按聚合验证损失选的早停恰好对稀有、难预测的敏感片段最不管用。
Method: 以在同一语料互补半集上训练的模型为参考，定义逐 token 的 Target Reference Advantage (TRA)，可微且便宜；在此之上引入 TRAP，即只在目标模型概率超过参考处生效的单侧 token 级惩罚。
Result: 记忆在验证损失最低点之后仍继续增长，且在小数据集、更高学习率、任务更难时更大；早停能去掉大部分记忆但对易学文本中的稀有难预测片段帮助最小。在带标注个人信息的学生作文和含患者标识的临床病例上，TRAP 使记忆降到接近未训练模型的水平且效用代价很小，而通用正则器几乎不改变记忆、差分隐私则放弃了微调带来的大部分收益。
Conclusion: 记忆可由「相对参考模型的逐 token 概率优势」统一刻画并直接惩罚，从而在不知道敏感片段位置的前提下抑制微调记忆，且不必像差分隐私那样牺牲大部分微调收益。

papers.title: Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. We further post-train PACE through failure-aware preference refinement using rollout-derived pairs that contrast normal or recovery behaviors with deviation-amplifying behaviors, thereby improving closed-loop correction. We integrate PACE into six open-source zero-shot VLN navigators and demonstrate consistent improvements on the cross-floor subsets of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, increasing the average success rate from 16.35% to 27.65% and from 4.76% to 12.06%, respectively. Real-world experiments further demonstrate PACE's applicability in unseen environments, highlighting the potential of traversable affordances to bridge semantic intent and reliable embodied behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACE 是一个监督式局部执行模块，把语义规划器给出的高层意图落到可执行的 affordance 位姿上，再以此为空间目标生成短程动作，并用 rollout 失败对做偏好微调以强化闭环纠偏。接入六个开源零样本 VLN 导航器后，R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 跨楼层子集平均成功率分别从 16.35% 升到 27.65%、从 4.76% 升到 12.06%。
Motivation: 零样本语义规划器能给出正确高层意图，但在楼梯、门洞、窄通道等空间受限的跨楼层过渡中，到达目标附近不等于能通过，动作误差还会累积，语义目标与物理执行之间存在断裂。
Method: PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution) 是监督式局部执行模块：先把过渡相关语义落到长时程、以智能体为中心的可穿越 affordance 位姿，再以该位姿为条件生成短程动作；随后用 rollout 产生的偏好对做失败感知的偏好后训练 (failure-aware preference refinement)，把正常或恢复行为与放大偏差的行为对比。
Result: 接入六个开源零样本 VLN 导航器后，R2R-CE 跨楼层子集平均成功率 16.35% → 27.65%，RxR-CE 跨楼层子集 4.76% → 12.06%；真实世界实验显示其在未见环境中可用。
Conclusion: 把语义目标显式锚定到可穿越 affordance 位姿并做失败感知偏好微调，能显著提升零样本 VLN 在跨楼层场景的闭环执行成功率，且可迁移到真实未见环境。

papers.title: A Journey to the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: It has recently been found that deep learning often occurs at the "edge of stability (EoS)," where the maximum Hessian eigenvalue of the model is stabilized at a value reciprocal to the learning rate. However, what happens before we reach that regime? We fix a deep learning problem and vary first order optimization methods with dense learning rate sweeps. We then track the characterizing quantities of a learning trajectory: the loss, the sharpness, and the alignment between consecutive gradients. To our surprise, if we scale the learning rate by the dc gain of the optimizer, these traces from the sweeps from different optimizers almost perfectly overlap across a large range of learning rates. The dc-normalized optimizers have another role that only becomes apparent in high learning rates: they select when the sharpness value detaches from this universal curve and enters the edge of stability. Upon this discovery, we specify three distinct regimes with respect to the dc-adjusted learning rate: the low-LR regime where the trajectory is nearly insensitive to the optimizer, the high-LR regime, where the optimizer governs the sharpness according to the EoS reciprocal rule, and the in-between mid-LR regime where so-called progressive sharpening originates independently of the optimizer. This distinguishes the role of the optimizer, the learning rate, and the model in shaping the learning progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定一个深度学习问题、对不同一阶优化器做稠密学习率扫描后发现：把学习率按优化器的 dc 增益归一化，loss、sharpness 与相邻梯度对齐度三条轨迹在很宽的学习率范围内几乎完全重合。dc 归一化学习率还决定 sharpness 何时脱离这条普适曲线、进入 edge of stability，据此划分低、中、高三个学习率区间。
Motivation: 已知深度学习常停在 edge of stability（最大 Hessian 特征值稳定在与学习率互为倒数的量级），但到达该状态之前的轨迹如何被优化器、学习率与模型各自塑造并不清楚。
Method: 固定一个深度学习问题，对多个一阶优化器做稠密学习率 (dense learning rate) 扫描，沿轨迹追踪 loss、sharpness 与相邻梯度对齐度；再按各优化器的 dc 增益缩放学习率，比较不同优化器的轨迹是否重合，并据此划分三个学习率区间。
Result: dc 增益归一化后，不同优化器在很宽学习率范围内的 loss、sharpness、梯度对齐度轨迹几乎完全重合；dc 归一化学习率决定 sharpness 何时脱离普适曲线并进入 EoS。据此分出三段：低 LR 区轨迹对优化器几乎不敏感，高 LR 区 sharpness 由优化器按 EoS 倒数规则支配，中间 mid-LR 区的 progressive sharpening 与优化器无关。
Conclusion: 学习进程的塑造可拆成三份：优化器、学习率、模型各管一段——低 LR 归轨迹本身，高 LR 归优化器与 EoS 规则，中段的 progressive sharpening 则独立于优化器产生。

papers.title: Neural ODEs Meet Concurrent Learning: Stable Online Learning with Lyapunov Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Neural ODEs learn dynamics from trajectory losses, but their adjoint gradients lack the regressor-times-parameter-error structure on which Lyapunov analyses of online adaptation rest, so training on streaming data comes without stability guarantees. We show that this structure is in fact present: the adjoint gradient decomposes exactly into a positive semi-definite trajectory operator acting on the parameter error plus a nonlinear perturbation with explicit, horizon-dependent bounds. A quadratic Lyapunov function then certifies online Neural ODE training over sliding windows under computable gain and horizon conditions, and the same certificate extends to stored data: its drift branch recovers concurrent learning, and its trajectory branch yields NODE-CL, a stored-segment Gauss-Newton method built on batched forward sensitivities that needs no state-derivative estimates. On four DeepMind Control Suite domains, NODE-CL attains the lowest median prediction error on three under velocity measurement noise, where observer-based concurrent learning degrades by up to 8x; with clean measurements it is best on the pendulum and within a factor of 1.6 of the best stored-data baseline on the cartpole and reacher.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明 Neural ODE 的伴随梯度可精确分解为半正定轨迹算子作用于参数误差加带显式时域界的非线性扰动，从而用二次 Lyapunov 函数为滑窗在线训练给出可计算的增益与时域稳定条件；同一证书的漂移分支退化为 concurrent learning，轨迹分支导出 NODE-CL——基于批量前向灵敏度的存储段 Gauss-Newton 方法，无需状态导数估计。在 DeepMind Control Suite 四个域上，速度测量含噪时 NODE-CL 在三个域取得最低中位数预测误差，而基于观测器的 concurrent learning 最多退化 8 倍。
Motivation: Neural ODE 的伴随梯度缺少 Lyapunov 在线稳定性分析所依赖的“回归量×参数误差”结构，因此在流数据上训练没有稳定性保证。
Method: 把伴随梯度分解为半正定轨迹算子加带显式时域依赖界的非线性扰动；用二次 Lyapunov 函数在滑动窗口上给出可计算的增益与时域条件；证书扩展到存储数据后，漂移分支对应 concurrent learning，轨迹分支导出 NODE-CL——用批量前向灵敏度 (batched forward sensitivities) 的存储段 Gauss-Newton 方法，不需要状态导数估计。
Result: 在 DeepMind Control Suite 四个域上，速度测量含噪时 NODE-CL 在其中三个域取得最低中位数预测误差，基于观测器的 concurrent learning 最多退化 8 倍；干净测量下 NODE-CL 在 pendulum 上最优，在 cartpole 与 reacher 上与最好的存储数据基线差距在 1.6 倍以内。
Conclusion: 伴随梯度本身具备 Lyapunov 分析所需的结构，因此 Neural ODE 在线训练可在可计算条件下被证书化；把同一证书的轨迹分支做成存储段 Gauss-Newton 更新，能在测量噪声下比观测器式 concurrent learning 更稳。

papers.title: A Solvable Theory of Pre-training Data Poisoning: Regime-Dependent Scaling Exponents
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training data poisoning of large language models is usually studied using targeted backdoors and their survival through safety post-training, which leaves open a more basic question: how does a model's clean data performance degrade as the poison rate $\varepsilon$ grows? Motivated by our controlled pre-training runs of OLMo-style models, in which the relative clean data validation perplexity increase $Δ$ between poisoned and clean models matched in architecture, token budget, and optimization schedule is well fit by a power law $Δ\approx C\varepsilon^{a}$ with a non-integer exponent, we ask what such a law requires theoretically. We first prove an analyticity barrier: whenever the contaminated objective depends analytically on $\varepsilon$ around a nondegenerate clean data optimum, $Δ$ is generically quadratic in $\varepsilon$, so a generic non-integer exponent is a signature of genuinely singular structure. We then supply that structure in solvable truncated ridge regression with heavy-tailed covariates, controlled by $q_\star$, and a label-shift poisoning. Our central result is that the excess risk scaling exponent depending on the order of limits: in the higher dimensional proportional regime it is $ε^{q_\star/(q_\star+2)}$, whereas taking the ample-data limit first gives $ε^{2-2/q_\star}$, and the limits do not commute. We confirm this prediction through several numerical simulations. Finally, we argue that finite training time plays the role of truncation on the curvature spectrum in local LLM pre-training, deriving the observed scaling law under heavy tailed inverse curvature spectrum as a modeling hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 预训练数据投毒中干净数据性能随毒率 ε 的退化规律，证明解析性壁垒：污染目标在非退化干净最优点附近对 ε 解析时 Δ 必为 ε 的二次型，非整数指数意味着奇异结构。在重尾协变量的截断岭回归可解模型中，超额风险指数依赖极限次序：高维比例极限为 ε^{q*/(q*+2)}，先取充足数据极限为 ε^{2-2/q*}，两者不可交换，并由数值模拟确认。
Motivation: 现有预训练投毒研究聚焦定向后门及其在安全后训练中的存活，缺少对干净数据性能随毒率 ε 增长如何退化这一基本问题的理论刻画。
Method: 以 OLMo 式受控预训练中相对验证困惑度增量 Δ≈Cε^a（非整数指数）为动机：先证明解析性壁垒（解析依赖 ⇒ Δ 一般为 ε 二次），再在重尾协变量（由 q* 控制）的截断岭回归与 label-shift 投毒中给出奇异结构的可解模型，最后把有限训练时间类比为曲率谱截断，在重尾逆曲率谱假设下推导观测标度律。
Result: 受控预训练中 Δ≈Cε^a 由非整数指数幂律良好拟合；可解模型给出两种极限次序下的指数 ε^{q*/(q*+2)} 与 ε^{2-2/q*}，极限不可交换；该预测经若干数值模拟确认。
Conclusion: 非整数投毒标度指数是奇异结构的签名而非解析扰动的产物，且指数由极限次序决定；有限训练时间对曲率谱的截断是解释本地 LLM 预训练观测标度律的建模假设。

papers.title: Supporting and Performing Culture from the Inside
papers.abstract_en: Anthropology and related disciplines which study culture have often found it useful to consider their epistemological and methodological approaches in terms of emic versus etic. This is the distinction between the insider perspective, how the world is viewed by a member of the culture, versus the outsider perspective, the scientific cataloguing of cultural knowledge and practice. We adopt this framework to systematically analyse assumptions in recent research on culture in NLP along the full pipeline of task selection, data collection, system design and evaluation. We draw attention to the `culture of NLP' which shapes the research focus and approaches of our field, and suggest pathways towards a more culturally attuned AI.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, To appear in Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), Budapest, October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人类学的 emic/etic（内部视角/外部视角）框架系统套到 NLP 文化研究的全流水线上，逐环节检视任务选择、数据采集、系统设计与评估中的隐含假设，并指出 NLP 自身的“文化”如何塑造研究取向。作者据此给出通向更具文化敏感性 AI 的路径。
Motivation: NLP 中文化相关研究常默认外部视角的科学编目方式，缺少对任务选择到评估各环节隐含文化假设的系统审视。
Method: 以 emic/etic 二分作为分析框架，沿任务选择、数据收集、系统设计、评估四段流水线系统梳理近期 NLP 文化研究的假设，并反思 NLP 领域自身的研究文化。
Result: 给出对近期 NLP 文化研究在全流水线各环节上的系统性假设分析，以及面向更具文化敏感性 AI 的路径建议；为 9 页、1 图的 EMNLP 2026 Findings 论文。
Conclusion: 文化敏感的 AI 需要从内部视角出发审视从任务定义到评估的每一环节，而不只是把文化当作被编目的外部数据。

papers.title: HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection
papers.abstract_en: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HeroFrame-Bench：用 VLM-as-a-Judge 对电影 hero frame 选择做参考锚定评测，通过 Reference-anchored Percentile 把待评帧插入可复用的预排序参考链打分，并用 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution 让影片专属 rubric 与排名互相迭代。在 204 部电影、2,031 条参考链、1,970 条学到的 rubric 上，VLM 与人类一致率从 77.56% 提到 83.78%，且现有方法在该任务上仍具挑战性。
Motivation: keyframe 选择的既有基准偏重内容相关性而忽略美学，且要么用排除合理备选的有限标注，要么用 VideoQA 把选择质量与下游模型能力混在一起，无法可靠评测 hero frame 选择。
Method: 构建可扩展的 VLM-as-a-Judge 框架：从多样元数据合成多模态上下文锚定 VLM 判官，用 Reference-anchored Percentile（把每帧插入可复用预排序参考链）打分；再提出 Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution 生成影片专属 rubric 条件化判官并与排名联合精炼，并引入可验证信号（最主要是 Inverted Rubric Attack）筛选稳健 rubric。
Result: 基准实例覆盖 204 部电影、2,031 条参考链、1,970 条学到的 rubric；人类对齐研究显示该构造设计把 VLM 与人类的一致率从 77.56% 提升到 83.78%；对多种方法的评测显示 hero frame 选择仍具挑战性。
Conclusion: 参考锚定的百分位评测配合 rubric 与排名的共同演化，能更直接、可扩展且可靠地评测主观的 hero frame 选择，而现有方法在此任务上尚未解决。

papers.title: SIMANF: Sample Free Learning of Unnormalized Distributions via Simulated Annealing in Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently learning and sampling from high dimensional, multimodal unnormalized distributions without target samples remains a challenging problem. Although normalizing flows can generate samples efficiently, training based on the reverse KL divergence using only the unnormalized target density may suffer from mode collapse. We introduce SIMANF, a sample free framework that integrates simulated annealing with normalizing flows. SIMANF progressively transforms the target distribution from a smooth initial form to the original target distribution and trains the flow sequentially across these stages. By transferring the learned representation between stages, the method promotes mode coverage while progressively capturing finer features of the target distribution. Following annealing, a final refinement stage combines the reverse KL divergence with an importance weighted forward KL objective using samples generated by the flow. SIMANF requires no target samples during training and uses only the unnormalized density. We demonstrate its effectiveness on Many-Well distributions and high dimensional Scalar Phi4 lattice field theory distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIMANF 把模拟退火与 normalizing flow 结合，无需目标样本、只用未归一化密度，从平滑初始分布逐级退火到原目标分布并跨阶段迁移表示，最后用 reverse KL 加重要性加权 forward KL 精修，以缓解 reverse KL 训练下的 mode collapse、提升模式覆盖。
Motivation: 高维多峰未归一化分布难以在没有目标样本的情况下学习与采样；仅用未归一化密度做 reverse KL 训练的 normalizing flow 容易 mode collapse。
Method: SIMANF 分阶段把目标分布从平滑形式渐进变换到原始目标，逐阶段顺序训练 flow 并在阶段间迁移已学表示；末尾精修阶段将 reverse KL 与基于 flow 自生成样本的重要性加权 forward KL 目标结合，全程只用未归一化密度、不需目标样本。
Result: 在 Many-Well 分布与高维 Scalar Phi4 格点场论分布上验证有效性；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 模拟退火式的分阶段训练加重要性加权 forward KL 精修，可在仅访问未归一化密度的条件下促进模式覆盖并逐步捕捉目标的精细结构。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: HyperLabel: Multi-Label Classification via Hypergraph-Based Label Correlation Modeling
authors: Paul Bogdan (1) ((1) University of Southern California
papers.abstract_en: Multi-label classification (MLC) requires predicting multiple relevant labels for each instance, where a central challenge is modeling complex label dependencies arising from co-occurrence patterns. Existing approaches are limited in capturing high-order label correlations, relying on implicit learning through contrastive objectives or pairwise attention mechanisms without structural guidance. We propose HyperLabel, an encoder-decoder framework that explicitly models label dependencies through hypergraph neural networks. Our contributions are twofold: (i) We construct a label hypergraph where sample-defined hyperedges naturally encode multi-way co-occurrence patterns, providing explicit structural prior knowledge that captures relationships beyond pairwise interactions. (ii) We propose a unified cross-modal learning approach where HGNN+ performs bidirectional message passing to integrate feature information with label structure, and a shared cross-attention decoder processes both modalities through complementary learning objectives. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that HyperLabel achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly significant improvements on macro-F1 scores (+10.3% on Delicious, +8.2% on Bibtex), validating that explicit hypergraph structure effectively captures complex label relationships. The code is available at https://github.com/iZHpy/Multi-label_hypergraph .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperLabel 用超图神经网络显式建模多标签分类中的高阶标签共现：把样本定义为超边构成标签超图，HGNN+ 双向消息传递融合特征与标签结构，共享跨注意力解码器同时处理两种模态。在七个基准数据集上达到 SOTA，macro-F1 在 Delicious 上提升 10.3%、Bibtex 上提升 8.2%。
Motivation: 多标签分类中标签依赖来自共现模式，现有方法靠对比目标或成对注意力隐式学习，缺少结构先验，难以捕捉超越成对关系的高阶标签相关性。
Method: 编码器-解码器框架：构造标签超图，以样本定义的超边编码多方共现；HGNN+ 在特征与标签结构间做双向消息传递；共享跨注意力解码器以互补学习目标处理两种模态。
Result: 在七个基准数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，macro-F1 提升显著：Delicious +10.3%，Bibtex +8.2%。
Conclusion: 显式超图结构能有效捕捉复杂标签关系，优于依赖隐式学习的对比目标与成对注意力方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topology-Adaptive Hyperbolic Graph Attention Networks Guided by the Hyperbolic Sombor Index
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic geometry has emerged as a principled space for representing hierarchical graphs. However, existing hyperbolic graph neural networks typically rely on shared curvature configurations and feature-driven attention, failing to explicitly exploit local hierarchical topological patterns. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hyperbolic Sombor Index (HSO) as a lightweight structural prior for capturing hierarchy-indicative degree stratification. Building on this, we propose \textbf{HSO-GAT}, a topology-adaptive hyperbolic graph attention network that unifies geometric adaptation and message propagation. Specifically, it comprises two complementary modules: HSO-Guided Local Curvature Adaptation, which performs adaptive node-wise geometric scaling from aggregated node-level HSO signals, and HSO-Gated Hyperbolic Graph Attention, which enables structure-aware message passing through feature-conditioned gating. Theoretically, we establish the monotonic sensitivity of edge-level HSO to degree imbalance and analyze the validity and radial scaling properties of node-adaptive hyperbolic mappings. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSO-GAT consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both node classification and link prediction tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HSO-GAT：用超曲 Sombor 指数 (Hyperbolic Sombor Index, HSO) 作为轻量结构先验，同时驱动节点级自适应曲率缩放与结构门控的双曲图注意力，在八个基准数据集上于节点分类和链接预测均达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有双曲图神经网络共用统一曲率配置、且注意力只由特征驱动，无法显式利用局部层级拓扑（度分层）模式。
Method: HSO-GAT 含两个模块：HSO-Guided Local Curvature Adaptation 由聚合的节点级 HSO 信号做逐节点几何缩放；HSO-Gated Hyperbolic Graph Attention 用特征条件门控实现结构感知消息传递。理论上给出边级 HSO 对度失衡的单调敏感性，以及节点自适应双曲映射的有效性与径向缩放性质。
Result: 在八个 benchmark 数据集上，节点分类与链接预测两项任务均一致达到 state-of-the-art。

papers.title: When Does a Skill Add Value? Task-Conditional Gain Prediction for Selective Skill Use
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are expected to improve task performance. Yet we find that they often provide no benefit, and can even hurt performance while incurring additional token costs. Can we predict whether a skill will help before the agent acts? We introduce SkillDelta, a framework for predicting task-conditional skill gains from paired executions of the same agent with and without the skill. A local predictor transfers these historical gains to new tasks without retraining the agent. Under explicit transfer assumptions, our analysis links support coverage, representation mismatch, and execution noise to prediction error and decision regret. Across five benchmarks and three target agents, paired history improves observed-gain ranking over skill-assisted outcomes alone in 12 of 15 settings. At matched expected skill-use rates, SkillDelta improves success over random activation in all 15 settings, with an average absolute gain of 4.3%. Most of this advantage comes from allocation across task groups. Evidence for additional within-group selection value is strongest on ToolQA and weaker elsewhere. Code is available at https://github.com/TankTechnology/skilldelta.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillDelta 用同一 agent 带技能与不带技能的成对执行历史，预测任务条件下的技能增益，在行动前决定是否启用该技能。五个基准、三个目标 agent 的 15 个设置中，配对历史在 12 个设置上改进了观测增益排序；在相同预期技能使用率下，相对随机启用在全部 15 个设置提升成功率，平均绝对增益 4.3%。
Motivation: agent 技能常无收益甚至损害性能，还要额外付出 token 成本；需要在 agent 行动前预测某技能对当前任务是否真的有帮助，而不是盲目启用。
Method: SkillDelta 从同一 agent 带/不带技能的成对执行中估计任务条件增益，用一个 local predictor 把历史增益迁移到新任务而无需重训 agent；在显式迁移假设下，把 support coverage、representation mismatch 与 execution noise 关联到预测误差与决策 regret。
Result: 五个基准、三个目标 agent 共 15 个设置中，配对历史相对仅用技能辅助结果在 12 个设置改进观测增益排序；在匹配的预期技能使用率下，SkillDelta 相对随机启用在全部 15 个设置提升成功率，平均绝对增益 4.3%。优势主要来自跨任务组的分配，组内选择的额外价值在 ToolQA 上证据最强、其他基准较弱。

papers.title: FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FSS-UBrain 用一张带标注的阳性 support slice 分别对 WT、TC、ET 做 one-shot 二值 query 分割，并用硬负例与全负例 query 加空查询正则抑制无病灶时的伪前景激活。在 BraTS 2020 留出集上体积 Dice 为 WT 89.82%、TC 82.14%、ET 77.42%，HD95 分别 11.12、9.01、4.46 mm；在 BraTS 2023 与 BraTS-Africa 的跨队列协议中 mean Dice 最高、finite-pair mean HD95 最低，且不做目标域微调。
Motivation: 多模态 MRI 的全肿瘤勾画在标注稀缺、跨队列差异与目标极度稀疏下难以泛化，而现有少样本分割在目标域缺席区域容易产生伪前景激活。
Method: 区域级 one-shot 框架：以 support slice 的前景/背景描述子引导 query 特征适配、bottleneck 交互、解码器重构与边界细化；episodic 训练加入 hard-negative 与 fully-negative query 及 empty-query 正则；推理用二维 support-query slice 对，但 checkpoint 选择、阈值标定与评测在体积重建后进行，且不使用目标域微调或测试时参数更新。
Result: BraTS 2020 留出集体积 Dice：WT 89.82%、TC 82.14%、ET 77.42%，对应 HD95 为 11.12、9.01、4.46 mm；在 target-supported 跨队列协议下，BraTS 2023 与 BraTS-Africa 上取得所比较少样本方法中最高 mean Dice 与最低 finite-pair mean HD95 点估计。
Conclusion: 目标条件化的少样本分割可行，但结果对 support 选择与队列差异敏感。

papers.title: Learning Through Game: Skewed Transfer of Tabular Knowledge to Strengthen Image Model
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal tabular-image learning is gaining growing attention, yet it faces challenges due to tabular data unavailable at test time. A practical solution involves transferring tabular knowledge to images during training to enhance the performance of image models at inference. However, the overlooked yet important challenges lie in the modality imbalance between images and tables, as well as their asymmetric modality relationship in cross-modal transfer, which limits the auxiliary role of tabular data. To address these issues, we propose Skewed Knowledge Transfer (SKT), which asymmetrically transfers tabular knowledge to improve the image model by adaptive integration of modality gradients in a shared parameter space. Specifically, we first introduce a multimodal shared head, which allows the model to benefit from cross-modal structure without adding additional parameters. We then design a two-step Nash Bargaining strategy to effectively leverage tabular gradients. In the first step, SKT seeks a point of modality balance and uses preference awareness in the second step to steer combined gradients toward image-beneficial directions. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze the Pareto improvement and convergence of SKT. To this end, tabular knowledge is explicitly transferred to enhance image models. Empirical experiments on widely used tabular-image datasets reveal that SKT consistently improves image unimodal performance by using tabular data as auxiliary information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Skewed Knowledge Transfer (SKT)，在训练期把表格知识单向迁移到图像模型：共享多模态头 + 两步 Nash Bargaining 自适应整合模态梯度，使推理时无需表格也能提升图像单模态性能。在常用表格-图像数据集上，用表格作辅助信息时图像单模态表现一致提升。
Motivation: 多模态表格-图像学习中测试时往往拿不到表格数据，且图像与表格存在模态不平衡与非对称关系，限制了表格数据的辅助作用。
Method: SKT 在共享参数空间中非对称迁移表格知识：先引入不增加额外参数的多模态共享头，再用两步 Nash Bargaining 策略利用表格梯度——第一步求模态平衡点，第二步用偏好感知 (preference awareness) 把合并梯度导向对图像有利的方向；并给出 Pareto 改进与收敛性的理论分析。
Result: 在广泛使用的表格-图像数据集上的实验显示，SKT 借助表格作为辅助信息，一致地提升图像单模态性能。
Conclusion: 把表格知识以非对称、梯度级的方式在训练期转移给图像模型，可在推理阶段无表格输入的条件下稳定增强图像模型。

papers.title: Certification Frontiers for Gaussian LoRA: Independent Priors, Posterior Risk, and Prediction-Preserving Balancing
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc Bayesian fine-tuning places Gaussians around trained low-rank adapters, yet a calibrated posterior does not by itself yield a useful generalization certificate. Such a posterior admits an informative PAC-Bayes certificate only when both the loss of its sampled predictors and its KL divergence from an admissible prior are small. In this research, we characterize this certification frontier for Gaussian LoRA posteriors and separate three interventions: changing the prior, changing the stochastic predictor, and changing only how its complexity is counted. First, an exact isotropic KL envelope eliminates the prior scale and yields a width threshold that excludes posterior widths before sampling, while a zero-KL floor identifies targets that no complexity reduction can reach at a measured risk bound. Second, we minimize KL in closed form over the full $GL(r)$ symmetry of the low-rank factors, leaving every sampled adapter product unchanged, and derive the noncentral objective required when the prior center is trained on an independent split. On a small-pool RoBERTa audit of 567 configurations, the recorded 64-draw summaries imply a certificate floor of $0.7298$ even with zero KL and Chernoff accounting, so reducing complexity alone cannot certify these posteriors at the recorded budgets. For a stable posterior in a controlled Gaussian-factor task, Chernoff accounting certifies risk below $0.1$ on 20 of 20 datasets with 1024 draws, whereas Hoeffding certifies none. On deliberately deformed synthetic rank-four factors, matrix balancing reduces KL by $29.3\%$ on average beyond scalar balancing without changing any prediction. Numerical split-prior scenarios make the remaining risk and complexity budgets explicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文刻画 Gaussian LoRA 后验的 PAC-Bayes 认证边界，把三种干预分开：改先验、改随机预测器、只改复杂度计账。小池 RoBERTa 567 配置审计显示即使 KL 为零并用 Chernoff 计账，证书下限仍为 0.7298；受控高斯因子任务中 Chernoff 在 20/20 数据集上以 1024 次抽样认证风险低于 0.1，而 Hoeffding 一个都认证不了；矩阵平衡在不改变任何预测的前提下比标量平衡额外降低 KL 29.3%。
Motivation: 后验校准本身不构成可用的泛化证书：只有当采样预测器的损失与相对可容许先验的 KL 同时足够小时，PAC-Bayes 证书才有信息量，而 LoRA 低秩因子的对称性与先验选择如何影响这条边界此前未被刻画。
Method: 先给出各向同性 KL 精确包络以消去先验尺度并导出宽度阈值与零 KL 下限；再在低秩因子的整个 GL(r) 对称性上闭式最小化 KL（采样得到的 adapter 乘积不变），并为先验中心在独立 split 上训练的情形推导非中心目标；最后用矩阵平衡替代标量平衡调整复杂度计账，配合 Chernoff 与 Hoeffding 两种计账方式做认证。
Result: 小池 RoBERTa 567 配置审计中，64 次抽样的记录摘要蕴含证书下限 0.7298（即使 KL 为零并用 Chernoff 计账）。受控高斯因子任务里，Chernoff 计账在 20/20 个数据集上以 1024 次抽样认证风险低于 0.1，Hoeffding 认证数为 0。在刻意变形的合成 rank-four 因子上，矩阵平衡比标量平衡平均多降 KL 29.3%，且不改变任何预测。
Conclusion: 只压复杂度无法在记录预算下认证这些 LoRA 后验，必须同时控制采样风险；计账方式（Chernoff 优于 Hoeffding）与利用 GL(r) 对称性的先验/平衡选择是把证书推过边界的实际杠杆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overfitting of Spectral Gradient Descent: How Matrix Geometry shapes Generalization and Implicit Bias
papers.abstract_en: We study the generalization of spectral gradient descent (SpecGD) in overparameterized matrix classification with corrupted labels. Each input combines a shared low-rank signal with a rank-one sample-specific perturbation, referred to as a shortcut, that enables memorization but does not generalize. We contrast collapsed shortcuts, which share a singular direction, with dispersed shortcuts, which occupy distinct singular directions. Changing only this geometry can reverse the relative generalization of GD and SpecGD: collapsed shortcuts can favor SpecGD, while dispersed shortcuts can favor GD. In the dispersed regime, exact shortcut orthogonality eliminates the signal from the late-stage SpecGD direction, while vanishing random correlations collectively generate a small but generalization-relevant signal through a second-order effect. To identify the direction selected by SpecGD, which the spectral max-margin problem alone does not determine, we combine a refined analysis of its dual with the exponentiated-gradient dynamics of normalized loss weights. Finally, we show that a single SpecGD step can already interpolate and generalize well, while continued training converges to a direction with substantially worse generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在过参数化矩阵分类加标签噪声的设定下，SpecGD 与 GD 的相对泛化优劣完全由 shortcut 的奇异方向几何决定：collapsed shortcut 偏向 SpecGD，dispersed shortcut 偏向 GD。dispersed 情形下 shortcut 正交会把信号从 SpecGD 后期方向中剔除，而随机相关的二阶效应仍保留微弱但与泛化相关的信号；单步 SpecGD 即可插值并取得良好泛化，继续训练反而收敛到泛化显著更差的方向。
Motivation: 过参数化模型靠 shortcut 记忆标签噪声时，何种几何结构决定梯度法的泛化排序尚不清楚；spectral max-margin 问题本身也无法唯一确定 SpecGD 所选方向。
Method: 设定每个输入为共享低秩信号加 rank-one 样本特异 shortcut，对比 collapsed（共享奇异方向）与 dispersed（各异奇异方向）两种几何；对 SpecGD 的对偶做精细分析，并结合归一化损失权重的 exponentiated-gradient 动态来识别其选择的方向。
Result: 仅改变 shortcut 几何即可反转 GD 与 SpecGD 的相对泛化排序；dispersed 情形下精确正交使信号从 SpecGD 后期方向消失，而消失的随机相关通过二阶效应累积出小但与泛化相关的信号；单步 SpecGD 已能插值且泛化良好，持续训练收敛到泛化差得多的方向。
Conclusion: SpecGD 的泛化与隐式偏置由 shortcut 的矩阵几何而非算法本身决定，且训练越久未必越好——单步插值解优于持续训练的收敛方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Before Answering: Evidence Sufficiency under Size-Matched Memory Construction
papers.abstract_en: Agents that answer questions from compressed or retrieved memory must recognize when the evidence a query needs is no longer in memory. Benchmarks for this task usually create insufficient-evidence examples by deleting supporting passages. We show that this construction leaks the label through memory size: on MuSiQue, a classifier that only counts paragraphs reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of $0.979$ for detecting unsafe memory, higher than the lexical estimator we initially evaluated. We propose a size-matched construction that provably removes this shortcut, and use it to study MemSafe, an estimator that cross-encodes the query with each memory unit and aggregates the units with a set transformer. Across three multi-hop question answering datasets and five seeds, MemSafe reaches $0.968$ and $0.983$ AUROC on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, $0.26$ to $0.39$ above a lexical baseline, while the third dataset, 2WikiMultiHopQA, is saturated. A frozen pretrained cross-encoder with a logistic head already closes $41\%$ of the MuSiQue gap between the lexical baseline and MemSafe. At the same time, MemSafe degrades more than a weak baseline on the unanswerable questions released with MuSiQue, reaches only $0.639$ AUROC on SQuAD~2.0, and needs several thousand clinical training examples before it outperforms a feature-based estimator. Used as a gate for a 7B reader, it reduces the error rate on answered questions from $0.850$ to $0.631$ at $5\%$ coverage, outperforming both reader confidence and, on average, the ground-truth integrity label, although a 7B LLM judge is the better gate at $10\%$ coverage. These results indicate that the way insufficient evidence is constructed matters as much as the estimator that detects it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证据充分性检测基准通过删除支撑段落制造“证据不足”样本，导致记忆大小直接泄露标签：在 MuSiQue 上仅数段落的分类器 AUROC 达 0.979。作者提出可证明消除该捷径的 size-matched 构造，并用 MemSafe（cross-encoder 逐单元编码查询后经 set transformer 聚合）评测，在 MuSiQue/HotpotQA 上 AUROC 0.968/0.983，比词法基线高 0.26–0.39。
Motivation: 证据不足样本的构造方式本身泄漏标签，使估计器评测失真；需要一种消除大小捷径的构造来公平比较检测方法。
Method: 提出 size-matched 记忆构造以消除段落数捷径；MemSafe 将查询与每个记忆单元做 cross-encoder 编码，再用 set transformer 聚合单元表示，作为证据充分性估计器，并用作 7B reader 的门控。
Result: 仅数段落的分类器在 MuSiQue 上 AUROC 0.979；MemSafe 在三个多跳 QA 数据集、五个种子上 MuSiQue 0.968、HotpotQA 0.983，比词法基线高 0.26–0.39，2WikiMultiHopQA 已饱和；冻结 cross-encoder 加逻辑头可弥合 MuSiQue 上词法基线与 MemSafe 差距的 41%；在 SQuAD 2.0 上仅 0.639 AUROC，需数千条临床训练样本才超过特征法；作为 7B reader 门控在 5% 覆盖率下把已回答问题错误率从 0.850 降到 0.631，优于 reader 置信度与真实完整性标签的平均表现，但 10% 覆盖率下 7B LLM judge 更好。
Conclusion: 作者主张：证据不足样本的构造方式与检测估计器同等重要；MemSafe 在多跳 QA 上强但在 SQuAD 2.0 与低资源域上明显退化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Reconstruction Dynamics for Autoencoder Reconstruction Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Standard autoencoder (AE) inference uses a single encoder-decoder pass, though the latent may not be optimal for each sample under a fixed decoder. We ask whether a trained AE can reveal information for improving its own reconstruction. Repeated application of a frozen AE to its reconstruction produces transient image- and latent-space trajectories, termed Self-Reconstruction Dynamics (SRD). Although this degrades fidelity in the AEs studied here, SRD contains sample-specific information for correcting the reconstruction. We propose SRD-guided Reconstruction Refinement (SRD-RR), which predicts a latent correction from a short SRD with the AE frozen and no per-sample test-time optimization. We also introduce MSE-recov, an MSE recovery ratio relative to an empirical decoder-optimized reference. Across six datasets, SRD-RR recovers 38.6% of the empirically recoverable MSE gap with one transition and 45.3% with two. A two-transition variant trained without direct access to original images, using an SRD-derived pseudo-target, achieves 40.7% recovery and a 1.74 dB average PSNR gain. Removing trajectory information reduces the gain, while cross-sample trajectory assignment causes severe degradation, confirming strong sample specificity. Nonlinear SRD-conditioned refinement consistently outperforms fixed and trained linear latent correction. On a pretrained DINOv2-based representation autoencoder (RAE) with substantially different latent dynamics, SRD conditioning again improves a matched trajectory-free predictor. However, pixel-MSE latent refinement reveals a strong mismatch between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality, while the SRD-derived pseudo-target mitigates this degradation. Overall, SRD is a useful sample-specific refinement signal, while the objective determines how it translates into pixel and perceptual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把冻结的自编码器反复作用于自身重建，得到图像与潜空间的瞬态轨迹 Self-Reconstruction Dynamics (SRD)，并用它预测潜变量修正 (SRD-RR) 而不做逐样本测试时优化。在六个数据集上，一次 transition 恢复 38.6% 的可恢复 MSE 差距，两次 45.3%；不用原图、只用 SRD 伪目标训练的两 transition 变体恢复 40.7% 并带来平均 1.74 dB PSNR 提升。
Motivation: 标准 AE 推理只做一次编码器-解码器前向，固定解码器下每个样本的潜变量未必最优；作者追问训练好的 AE 能否用自身重建过程透露的信息改进该样本的重建。
Method: 对冻结 AE 的输出反复前向得到 SRD 轨迹，SRD-RR 从短轨迹预测潜变量修正，无逐样本测试时优化；提出 MSE-recov（相对经验解码器优化参考的 MSE 恢复率），并引入不接触原图、以 SRD 伪目标训练的变体；同时对比固定与训练的线性潜变量修正、轨迹信息消融、跨样本轨迹交换，以及 DINOv2 表示自编码器 (RAE) 上的 SRD 条件化。
Result: 六个数据集上 SRD-RR 一次 transition 恢复 38.6%、两次恢复 45.3% 的可恢复 MSE 差距；无原图的伪目标两 transition 变体恢复 40.7%、平均 PSNR 提升 1.74 dB。去掉轨迹信息会降低增益，跨样本轨迹分配导致严重退化，说明强样本特异性；非线性 SRD 条件化一致优于固定与训练的线性潜变量修正；在 DINOv2 RAE 上 SRD 条件化同样改进无轨迹预测器，而像素 MSE 潜变量修正暴露像素保真与感知质量的强失配，SRD 伪目标可缓解该退化。
Conclusion: SRD 是有用的样本特异性修正信号，但目标函数决定它如何转化为像素与感知质量：像素 MSE 修正会牺牲感知质量，SRD 伪目标能缓解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Can Old Evaluations Certify a New Model? Label-Efficient Release Decisions under Evaluator Drift
papers.abstract_en: Releasing a model update requires certifying that its current-population risk stays below a threshold. Trusted labels are expensive, while a cheap evaluator, such as an LLM judge, scores every example. Reusing evaluator errors from earlier audits is tempting, but when may such evidence replace current labels? It depends on the status of history. If the errors can change invisibly, no label-free test detects the change, and every valid, useful certifier must keep buying labels at a rate we characterize; if a bound on the change is assumed, label-free certification is valid at an explicit error cost. For the middle ground, where history is informative but untrusted, we propose \emph{portfolio vigilance}, a sequential certifier mixing a betting expert guided by history with one that learns only from current labels; history affects only how it bets, so validity holds for any history. The contribution is not prior-informed betting or expert mixtures, but separating history that may enter validity from history that may only guide label collection. In a canonical model, accurate history shortens decisions but never raises the evidence growth rate; stale history can destroy it. On held-out CIFAR-10N and DICES-990 data, portfolio vigilance needs 0.465 (95\% CI $[0.327,0.575]$) and 0.740 ($[0.618,0.877]$) times the labels of a matched prediction-powered monitor, with no observed false certification, and fewer labels on all six external blocks. Under corrupted advice it stays within 8.0\% of its better component, while trusting history alone costs up to 1.66 times as much. In post-confirmatory repeated-judge experiments on DICES-990 and ToxicChat, changing a fixed LLM judge's rubric moves its scores beyond run-to-run variation; the portfolio then needs 0.790 ($[0.667,0.909]$) and 0.631 ($[0.520,0.770]$) times the labels of the matched monitor, and fewer than trusting history alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 模型发布前需证明当前人群风险低于阈值，而历史审计中的评估器（如 LLM judge）误差可能悄悄漂移。提出 portfolio vigilance：把受历史引导的 betting expert 与只用当前标签学习的 expert 混合成序列式 certifier，历史只影响下注方式、不进入有效性。在 CIFAR-10N 与 DICES-990 上所需标签量为匹配 prediction-powered monitor 的 0.465 与 0.740 倍，无观测到的错误认证。
Motivation: 模型更新发布需要当前人群风险的认证，但可信标签昂贵；复用历史审计中廉价评估器的误差很诱人，问题是历史在什么状态下可以替代当前标签而不损害认证有效性。
Method: 提出 portfolio vigilance 序列式 certifier：混合一个由历史引导的 betting expert 与一个仅从当前标签学习的 expert，历史只进入下注、不进入有效性；并给出历史不可信变化下必须持续购买标签的速率刻画，以及假设变化上界时带显式误差代价的 label-free 认证。
Result: 在 held-out CIFAR-10N 与 DICES-990 上，portfolio vigilance 所需标签为匹配 prediction-powered monitor 的 0.465（95% CI [0.327, 0.575]）与 0.740（[0.618, 0.877]）倍，无观测到的错误认证，并在全部六个 external blocks 上更少标签。污染建议下保持在较优组件的 8.0% 以内，而只信历史代价高达 1.66 倍标签。在 DICES-990 与 ToxicChat 的 post-confirmatory repeated-judge 实验中，改变固定 LLM judge 的 rubric 会使其分数超出 run-to-run 波动，此时所需标签为匹配 monitor 的 0.790（[0.667, 0.909]）与 0.631（[0.520, 0.770]）倍，且少于只信历史。
Conclusion: 准确历史能缩短决策但不会提高证据增长率，过期历史会摧毁它；应把可进入有效性的历史与只能引导标签收集的历史分开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Representation Editing for Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt a pretrained multimodal model online to distribution shift across modalities using unlabeled test data, showing broad potential in real-world applications. However, existing methods primarily focus on adjusting fused features to bridge the source-target gap, lacking explicit control over intermediate representation misalignment, which is a key driver of performance drop under distribution shift. In this work, we tackle this challenge from the perspective of representation engineering. Unlike previous TTA methods that update fusion weights in place, we propose FourIer Representation Editor (FIRE), a novel multimodal TTA approach that directly edits semantically rich intermediate representations. Specifically, we first adopt representation editors into each intermediate layer of the unimodal encoders, enabling layer-wise calibration of unimodal representations. To further enhance the diversity and stability of the low-rank editing subspaces, each representation editor performs frequency domain mixing via the fast Fourier transform to construct structured bases. Moreover, we introduce multi-level adaptation objectives to optimize these editors, jointly promoting cross-modal semantic alignment, source-target statistical alignment, and asymmetric prediction consistency. In this way, FIRE yields aligned unimodal representations for fusion and further improves prediction reliability. Extensive experiments on two widely used multimodal benchmarks under various corruption types demonstrate the superiority of FIRE over existing multimodal TTA methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIRE 把多模态测试时适应 (multimodal TTA) 的干预点从融合权重移到中间表征：在单模态编码器各中间层插入 representation editor 做逐层校准，用 FFT 频域混合构造结构化低秩基，并以多目标联合优化对齐语义、统计与预测一致性。在两个常用多模态基准的多种 corruption 设定下，FIRE 优于现有 TTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有 TTA 方法只调整融合特征来弥合源-目标差距，缺少对中间表征错位 (representation misalignment) 的显式控制，而这种错位是分布偏移下性能下降的关键驱动。
Method: 在单模态编码器每个中间层插入 representation editor 做逐层校准；每个 editor 通过快速傅里叶变换 (FFT) 做频域混合以构造结构化基，提升低秩编辑子空间的多样性与稳定性；用多层适应目标联合优化，同时促进跨模态语义对齐、源-目标统计对齐和非对称预测一致性。
Result: 在两个广泛使用的多模态基准、多种 corruption 类型下，FIRE 优于已有多模态 TTA 方法。
Conclusion: 直接编辑语义丰富的中间表征（而非原地更新融合权重）是对抗多模态分布偏移、提升预测可靠性的有效路径。

papers.title: Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose \textit{HeteroFold}, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. Across six transfer directions, HeteroFold achieves the best cache-transfer performance on all four long-context benchmarks and most short-context settings. It also matches text-based communication on the multi-agent benchmark. At 32K context length, Llama-3.1-8B$\rightarrow$Ministral-3-14B transfer is $10.7\times$ faster than Native Prefill and $1.18$--$1.47\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art prefill-free baselines, Dense Latent and KV Ridge. These results show that HeteroFold enables efficient cross-family KV reuse without receiver prefill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HeteroFold 让异构多智能体 LLM 在不重新 prefill 的前提下跨模型家族复用发送方 KV cache：对齐双方结构、把发送方 cache 映射到接收方空间再做校准，收发双方均保持冻结。在六个迁移方向上，它于全部四个长上下文基准和多数短上下文设置取得最佳 cache 迁移性能，32K 上下文 Llama-3.1-8B→Ministral-3-14B 比 Native Prefill 快 10.7×，比 Dense Latent、KV Ridge 快 1.18–1.47×。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统按角色混用不同模型，文本通信迫使接收方对发送方已处理过的共享上下文重新 prefill，造成冗余计算；而跨家族复用 cache 又受分词、模型深度与 KV 表示差异阻碍。
Method: HeteroFold 分三步：对齐发送方与接收方的模型结构，把发送方 KV cache 映射到接收方表示空间，再对映射结果做校准以保持接收方行为；发送方与接收方模型全程冻结，无需接收方 prefill。
Result: 在六个迁移方向上，HeteroFold 在全部四个长上下文基准与多数短上下文设置中取得最佳 cache 迁移性能，并在多智能体基准上与文本通信持平。32K 上下文下 Llama-3.1-8B→Ministral-3-14B 迁移比 Native Prefill 快 10.7×，比 SOTA 无 prefill 基线 Dense Latent 与 KV Ridge 快 1.18–1.47×。
Conclusion: 跨模型家族的 KV cache 复用可以在收发双方都不 prefill、都不微调的条件下做到高效且不损害接收方行为，从而取代多智能体间的重复上下文 prefill。

papers.title: LAM: Efficient Lossy Agent Memory Framework With A Retrieval-Score Error Bound
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory grows as agents read inputs, reason, and call tools. Longer histories increase inference cost and eventually exceed the context window. LLM-based summarization reduces this history but adds latency and provides no explicit bound on information loss. We propose LAM, a Lossy Agent Memory system with three components: a deterministic deduplication rule with a substitution bound on retrieval scores - a bound on score perturbation, not a certificate of unchanged ranking; a memory manager that preserves the cached prefix and overlaps compaction with inference; and a performance model that estimates compaction costs before deployment. On 600 agent trajectories, LAM removes 22.47% of observation tokens while retaining 99.984% of the measured gold-patch evidence. At a fixed deletion set, the performance model predicts a 71.4x-91.6x end-to-end speedup from removing records before prefill instead of deleting them from a prefilled context. That benefit comes from the schedule rather than the rule and applies to any prefix-preserving test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAM 是面向 LLM agent 的有损记忆框架，用带检索分数替换界 (substitution bound) 的确定性去重规则压缩历史，并保留缓存前缀、把压缩与推理重叠。在 600 条 agent 轨迹上删除 22.47% 观测 token 仍保留 99.984% 的 gold-patch 证据；性能模型预测在 prefill 之前删记录相对 prefill 后删除可带来 71.4x–91.6x 端到端加速，且该收益来自调度而非去重规则本身。
Motivation: Agent 随读输入、推理和调用工具使记忆不断膨胀，历史过长会推高推理成本并最终超出上下文窗口；LLM 摘要式压缩增加延迟且对信息损失没有显式上界。
Method: LAM 含三部分：带检索分数替换界的确定性去重规则（界约束分数扰动，不保证排序不变）；保留已缓存前缀并把 compaction 与推理重叠的 memory manager；以及在部署前估计 compaction 成本的 performance model。
Result: 在 600 条 agent 轨迹上删除 22.47% 的 observation token，保留 99.984% 的实测 gold-patch 证据；在固定删除集合下，性能模型预测在 prefill 前删除记录相比从已 prefill 的上下文删除可带来 71.4x–91.6x 端到端加速。
Conclusion: 作者主张该加速收益来自前缀保持的调度而非去重规则本身，因而适用于任何 prefix-preserving 的测试；检索分数界只约束分数扰动，不构成排序不变的证书。

papers.title: Clarify the User or Verify the World? Uncertainty Routing for Proactive Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents must decide not only whether additional information is needed, but also which source can resolve the uncertainty. Existing proactive approaches often specialize in either user clarification or environment verification, without explicitly determining the appropriate information source for each decision. We formulate this problem as uncertainty routing among ACT, CLARIFY, and VERIFY, and propose PROUR, a proactive uncertainty routing framework. PROUR decomposes action uncertainty into disagreement across plausible user-goal interpretations, which signals user-side ambiguity, and the entropy remaining within each interpretation, which signals missing world-side evidence. To acquire information from the routed source, a query generator is trained with a mode-conditioned information-gain reward, targeting user-goal identification under CLARIFY and next-action identification under VERIFY. On $τ$-bench, PROUR achieves 28.17% average success rate across retail and airline, outperforming the strongest prior method by 4.57% while using 2.17 fewer interaction steps. The learned policy further generalizes to stronger task agents and transactional domains of $τ^3$-bench without retraining, demonstrating the benefit of source-aligned uncertainty resolution for proactive agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROUR 把工具型 LLM agent 的动作不确定性拆成「对用户目标解释之间的分歧」与「每个解释内部的剩余熵」，据此在 ACT、CLARIFY、VERIFY 三种信息源之间路由。在 τ-bench 的 retail 与 airline 上平均成功率 28.17%，比最强既有方法高 4.57 个百分点且少用 2.17 次交互步。
Motivation: 现有主动式 agent 方法要么只做用户澄清、要么只做环境验证，缺少对每个决策该向哪一侧取信息的显式选择，导致交互步数浪费。
Method: PROUR 将动作不确定性分解为用户目标解释间分歧（用户侧歧义）与解释内熵（世界侧证据缺失）以决定路由；被路由到的源由一个查询生成器获取信息，该生成器用 mode-conditioned information-gain reward 训练，CLARIFY 模式瞄准用户目标识别、VERIFY 模式瞄准下一动作识别。
Result: 在 τ-bench 上跨 retail 与 airline 的平均成功率 28.17%，比最强既有方法高 4.57%，同时少 2.17 次交互步；学到的策略无需重训即可迁移到更强的任务型 agent 与 τ³-bench 的交易类领域。
Conclusion: 按不确定性来源对齐信息源（用户侧歧义走 CLARIFY、世界侧证据缺失走 VERIFY）能同时提高主动 agent 的成功率并减少交互步数，且该策略可跨 agent 与领域泛化。

papers.title: Why Directly Learning Periodic Trajectories Can Fail
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning of periodic solutions requires deciding how simulation data should be recorded and represented. A natural choice is to integrate long enough for transients to decay and record a window wide enough to contain at least one full period of all trajectories. We find that these conservative choices can make the resulting trajectories difficult to learn, even when the underlying periodic orbits vary regularly with system parameters. Unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even within the training distribution. Phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization, but models trained on a fixed physical-time window still have large errors on trajectories with periods outside the training range. We explain both failures through a common mechanism: frequency differences accumulate over time, so the target phase varies rapidly with the parameters. Predictors that cannot track this variation incur a population MSE floor in both settings; for fixed window prediction, we also derive a per-sample lower bound. We then study one of the simplest representations that escape these floors: learning an aligned, normalized waveform and its period separately. We establish regularity of the decoupled targets under ODE assumptions and show experimentally that this approach avoids both failures in ODE systems and a PDE case study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 直接学周期轨迹会因频率差随时间累积、目标相位对参数变化过快而失败：未对齐轨迹在训练分布内就泛化差，固定物理时间窗训练的模型在周期超出训练范围时误差仍大，两者都产生 population MSE 下界。改成分开学对齐归一化波形与周期可同时避开这两个下界，并在 ODE 与一个 PDE 案例中实验验证。
Motivation: 算子学习选周期解的记录方式时，保守做法（等瞬态衰减、窗口覆盖整周期）反而让轨迹难学；需要解释为何未对齐与固定时间窗两种设置都会失败。
Method: 在 ODE 假设下证明解耦目标（对齐归一化波形 + 周期）的正则性，并推导固定窗口预测的 per-sample 下界与两种设置共有的 population MSE floor；在 ODE 系统与一个 PDE 案例上做实验。
Result: 未对齐轨迹在训练分布内泛化差；相位对齐显著改善分布内泛化，但固定物理时间窗训练的模型在周期超出训练范围的轨迹上误差仍大；两种失败有共同机制（频率差随时间累积导致目标相位随参数快速变化），预测器跟不上即产生 population MSE floor，固定窗口另有 per-sample 下界；解耦表示在 ODE 与 PDE 案例中实验上避开两者。
Conclusion: 周期轨迹学习的失败源于目标相位对参数的快速变化而非数据不足，把波形与周期解耦学习是能逃出这些下界的最简表示之一。

papers.title: DS-VLA: A Dendritic-inspired Vision-Language-Action Model for Robust Action Control
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in language-conditioned manipulation, yet success under nominal evaluation does not necessarily translate into robust closed-loop behavior when executed actions are transiently corrupted. We introduce DS-VLA, a dendritic-inspired action architecture that incorporates dendritic spiking dynamics into VLA control to address this limitation. Specifically, to enable modularized feature processing and temporal information integration, DS-VLA equips action neurons with multiple sparsely connected dendritic branches, each featuring heterogeneous, learned decay factors. Furthermore, to suppress unreliable state updates while preserving task-relevant historical information, we introduce a neuron-wise inhibitory gate that adaptively regulates the admission of new multimodal evidence into dendritic states prior to somatic dynamics. We evaluate DS-VLA on all four LIBERO suites under both nominal rollouts and a unified closed-loop action-perturbation protocol. DS-VLA achieves a 91.6\% average nominal success rate and an 87.35\% average perturbed success rate, retaining 95.4\% of its nominal performance. Under the same reported perturbation setting, OpenVLA-OFT, FAST, $π_0$, and GR00T achieve 39.45\%, 23.90\%, 28.55\%, and 30.75\%, respectively. A controlled ablation isolates the contribution of neuron-wise shared inhibition, while analyses of neural dynamics and post-perturbation trajectories associate robust performance with selective evidence suppression and effective behavioral recovery. Together, these results demonstrate that integrating brain-inspired computational mechanisms offers a promising architectural prior for robust embodied intelligence beyond merely scaling vision-language backbones or generative action decoders.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Active Data Acquisition with Side Information via Discrete Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: Acquiring data is costly: higher measurement fidelity costs power and storage and risks collecting irrelevant content, while aggressive cost reduction can discard information that later analysis needs. We address this trade-off with an information-theoretic framework that acquires data relevant to a broad set of tasks rather than to one model. A mask policy, conditioned on side information, chooses which pixels to measure so as to maximize the mutual information between a discrete image and its partial observation under a budget; since the image entropy does not depend on the mask, this is equivalent to minimizing the conditional entropy. A frozen discrete denoising diffusion model (D3PM) supplies the posterior, and we use it in two ways: as an entropy surrogate for training a one-shot mask generator, and as the criterion for sequential greedy acquisition. The one-shot generator outperforms random masks only with care, including an unbiased gradient estimator for binary masks. With sequential acquisition, on MNIST the prior makes $8\times$ fewer errors than random at a $10\%$ budget, and on CIFAR-10 it gains $0.9$--$3.4$~dB. On fastMRI, our proposed technique using a static mask outperforms the well-known methods such as variable density and LOUPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预算约束下用条件化 mask 策略选择要测量的像素，以最大化离散图像与部分观测的互信息；冻结的 D3PM 离散去噪扩散模型同时充当熵代理（训练 one-shot mask 生成器）和序贯贪心采集的判据。序贯采集下 MNIST 在 10% 预算时比随机 mask 少 8 倍错误，CIFAR-10 提升 0.9–3.4 dB，fastMRI 上静态 mask 超过 variable density 与 LOUPE。
Motivation: 采集数据有成本：提高测量保真度费电、占存储并可能采到无关内容，而过度压缩又会丢掉后续分析需要的信息；现有采集策略多针对单一模型，缺少面向广泛任务集的信息论框架。
Method: 以信息论框架建模：在预算下由依赖 side information 的 mask 策略选择测量像素，因图像熵与 mask 无关，最大化互信息等价于最小化条件熵。冻结的 D3PM 提供后验，既作为训练 one-shot mask 生成器的熵代理（配合针对二值 mask 的无偏梯度估计器），也作为序贯贪心采集的判据。
Result: 序贯采集下，MNIST 在 10% 预算时先验使错误比随机 mask 少 8 倍；CIFAR-10 上提升 0.9–3.4 dB；fastMRI 上所提静态 mask 方法优于 variable density 与 LOUPE 等知名方法。one-shot 生成器只有在加入无偏梯度估计器等处理时才胜过随机 mask。
Conclusion: 用冻结离散扩散先验做基于互信息的采集判据，可在固定预算下同时服务多任务并优于随机与经典 mask 设计；one-shot 版本需要无偏梯度估计器才可靠，序贯采集是更稳的用法。

papers.title: RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract_en: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoBoSTAR 是文本条件的手语生成 (sign language production) 框架，用分部位 Finite Scalar Quantization 加 next-scale 自回归，按由粗到细的时间分辨率逐步生成动作，并在每一步并行预测身体与手部 token。自条件化与上下文腐蚀 (context corruption) 提升跨尺度预测误差下的鲁棒性，生成动作再重定向到人形机器人执行。
Motivation: 公共沟通的手语翻译依赖专业译员、难以规模化；现有自回归动作生成把运动压成单一全分辨率 token 序列，长程与局部依赖被迫用同一时间粒度建模。
Method: 文本条件输入，分部位 FSQ 量化配合 next-scale 自回归：在逐级细化的时间分辨率上生成，每步并行输出同步的身体与手部 token；用 self-conditioning 与 context corruption 缓解跨尺度预测误差；可选外接 ASR 前端支持语音，生成动作再重定向到实体人形机器人。
Result: 摘要称进行了大量定性与定量评估以验证 RoBoSTAR 的有效性，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 由粗到细的 next-scale 自回归加并行身体/手部 token 可以替代全分辨率单序列的动作生成范式，并把生成结果接到人形机器人执行。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Anytime-Valid LLM Leaderboards via Benchmark-weighted and Block-Factorized e-Processes
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) leaderboards compare model capabilities by ranking models according to their mean performance on fixed benchmarks. However, variability in evaluation outcomes across runs may produce unsupported claims of model superiority on the benchmark, a risk compounded by leaderboard updates. In this paper, we propose BB-EDGE (Benchmark-Weighted and Block-Factorized e-processes for Directed Graph Evaluation), a principled framework that represents an LLM leaderboard as a directed graph whose edges certify pairwise mean-performance advantages, with anytime-valid family-wise error rate (FWER) control. Concretely, for each direction, BB-EDGE constructs an empirical-Bernstein e-process by factorizing evidence over protocol-defined blocks and assigning stakes proportional to the corresponding block weights, then applies direct e-Holm across these $e$-processes to certify directional advantages as edges. Theoretically, we characterize weight-proportional linear stakes under heterogeneous benchmark-average nulls and prove anytime FWER control under arbitrary within-block and cross-pair dependence. BB-EDGE further supports anytime-valid Top-$k$ certification and simultaneous rank intervals. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and four real-world benchmarks demonstrate that BB-EDGE maintains anytime FWER control while achieving high efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BB-EDGE 把 LLM 排行榜表示成有向图，用按 block 权重下注的 empirical-Bernstein e-process 认证两两均值优势，并在任意 block 内与跨对依赖下证明 anytime FWER 控制。合成数据与四个真实 benchmark 上同时保持 anytime FWER 控制且效率高，还支持 anytime-valid Top-k 认证与同步排名区间。
Motivation: LLM 排行榜按固定 benchmark 的均值排名，但多次评测的运行间波动会产出缺乏支撑的模型优越性主张，排行榜持续更新会进一步放大这一风险。
Method: 将排行榜建模为有向图，每条边认证一个方向的均值优势：对每个方向按协议定义的 block 分解证据、按 block 权重设定 stakes，构造 empirical-Bernstein e-process，再对这些 e-process 施加 direct e-Holm 得到边；理论上刻画异质 benchmark-average 零假设下的权重比例线性 stakes，并证明任意 block 内与跨对依赖下的 anytime FWER 控制。
Result: 在合成数据与四个真实 benchmark 上，BB-EDGE 维持 anytime FWER 控制同时达到高效率；并给出 anytime-valid Top-k 认证与同步 rank 区间。
Conclusion: 用 e-process 加权分解与 e-Holm 可以在排行榜持续更新、评测结果相关的条件下给出带 anytime FWER 保证的两两优势与排名认证。

papers.title: Certifying Interventional Agreement Among Observationally Equivalent Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Observationally equivalent causal models can still disagree about what happens under intervention, because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data. We introduce Interventional Separation Selection (ISS), which repeatedly queries the true system with an admissible intervention on which the surviving candidate models disagree, discards the candidates the outcome contradicts, and stops once no intervention within a cost bound separates the survivors. If the true system is among the candidates, this stopping condition certifies that every survivor agrees with it on every admissible intervention within the bound, a guarantee that no observational learner can give, however much data it sees. The stopping condition depends only on the survivors, so it can be checked without knowing the truth. For continuous variables the candidates form an infinite version space, and mixed-integer linear programs decide the stopping condition exactly over all of it, with agreement holding up to a tolerance. On a three-digit colored MNIST causal abstraction task in which ink hue tracks digit size, plain convolutional networks trained on examples reach zero held-out error, yet disagree with shape-based labels on 26% of single-digit edits, as often as hue-based labels do. Auditing the causal abstractions of networks observed only on such images, ISS certifies what each network perceives with 13.6 interventions per image on average, and each certificate, checked against every admissible intervention, holds whenever the network's true abstraction is among the candidates. When a network bypasses a unit that every candidate abstraction relies on, certificates covering interventions on that unit can be silently void, and twenty random validation interventions refute 69% of them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Interventional Separation Selection (ISS)：反复用成本受限的干预查询真实系统，淘汰被结果否定的候选因果模型，直到没有干预能区分幸存者，从而在观测等价模型之间给出干预一致性的可检验证书。在三色 MNIST 因果抽象任务上，卷积网络零留出误差却与形状标签在 26% 的单字符编辑上不一致；ISS 平均每张图用 13.6 次干预完成认证，而 20 次随机验证干预可推翻 69% 的“绕过单元”证书。
Motivation: 观测等价的因果模型在干预下可能分歧，因为干预产生观测数据中从未出现的输入；纯观测学习者无论数据多少都无法给出干预一致性的保证。
Method: ISS 在成本界内挑选候选模型分歧最大的可容许干预查询真实系统，剔除被否定的候选，停机条件仅依赖幸存者、无需知道真值；连续变量下用混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 在整个无限版本空间上精确判定停机，一致性能带容差成立。
Result: 在 ink hue 跟随 digit size 的三色 MNIST 因果抽象任务上，普通卷积网络训练到留出误差为 0，却在 26% 的单字符编辑上与形状标签不一致（与 hue 标签的不一致程度相当）；ISS 认证每张图平均需 13.6 次干预，证书在真实抽象属于候选集时对所有可容许干预成立；当网络绕过某个所有候选抽象都依赖的单元时，20 次随机验证干预推翻了 69% 的相关证书。
Conclusion: 干预查询加可检验停机条件能在观测等价模型间给出观测学习者给不出的干预一致性证书，但证书在真实抽象不在候选集时可能被静默作废，随机干预审计可暴露这类失效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoPDEBench: Benchmarking LLM Auto-Research for Neural PDE Solver Design
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equations (PDEs) are essential for modeling complex physical systems, and neural solvers have recently emerged as powerful data-driven tools for numerically solving them. However, existing neural solvers struggle with domain-specific challenges, such as varying parameters and high-speed flows, necessitating specialized architectures. Manually designing these specialized solver architectures is a highly iterative, time-consuming process requiring deep expertise, creating a significant bottleneck in scientific discovery. We propose leveraging autonomous AI research agents to automate the synthesis of specialized solvers. To support this, we introduce AutoPDEBench, a benchmark dedicated to LLM-driven automated research for PDE solver design. The benchmark includes 25 challenging datasets featuring both novel and actively studied physical scenarios. We evaluate a suite of general-purpose models (transformer, ROM, and graph-based) alongside a multi-agent instantiation of the iterative automated research pipeline, which serves as an agentic baseline. Empirical results show that the iterative automated research system significantly outperforms the general-purpose neural solver baselines. Our findings demonstrate the viability of using AI agents to automatically design neural solvers for complex physical systems. AutoPDEBench provides a foundational testbed to accelerate agent-driven scientific discovery in physics and engineering.

papers.title: Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network
papers.abstract_en: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 单阶段步态识别方法存在严重过拟合与刚性视角约束，输入视角数量固定，难以在推理时灵活融合多视角。
Method: 第一阶段用浅层 Siamese 卷积网络配合 triplet loss，将 Gait Energy Images (GEIs) 映射到 128 维视图专属嵌入空间；第二阶段把这些逐视角嵌入当作 token，输入 12 层 Transformer encoder 重新投影到余弦可分性更好的新空间，支持任意视角数融合。

papers.title: Residual Transferability in Neural Image Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Neural image watermarks can be forged by extracting watermark-bearing residuals from released images and transferring them to unrelated content. While prior work has demonstrated this vulnerability, what makes these residuals transferable remains poorly understood. We formalize this vulnerability with \textbf{residual transferability (RT)}, a metric that quantifies how well watermark evidence remains decodable after transfer across unrelated images. Through comparative analyses and controlled interventions, we find that common training-side variations do not account for the large RT differences across watermarking systems; instead, architectural design plays a central role. By contrasting high- and low-RT systems and validating their architectural differences through controlled interventions, we identify two mechanisms that strengthen the dependence of watermark evidence on the cover image, thereby suppressing the residual transferability. These findings provide concrete design guidance for developing more forgery-resistant watermarking architectures. Complementarily, for existing watermarking systems where architectural redesign is impractical, we introduce \textbf{CoverLock}, a plug-and-play strategy for existing watermarking systems that strengthens such image dependence without architectural redesign. Across representative watermarking systems exhibiting high residual transferability, CoverLock achieves a more favorable security--robustness trade-off than both traditional handcrafted defenses and learned classifier-based defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经图像水印的伪造脆弱性形式化为残差可迁移性 (residual transferability, RT)，即水印残差转移到无关图像后仍可解码的程度。对比分析与受控干预显示 RT 差异主要来自架构设计而非训练侧设置，据此识别出两个增强水印证据对载体图像依赖、从而压制 RT 的机制；对无法改架构的系统提出即插即用的 CoverLock，在高 RT 代表性水印系统上取得比手工防御与学习型分类器防御更有利的安全–鲁棒性权衡。
Motivation: 从发布图像中提取带水印残差并转移到无关内容即可伪造水印，此前工作已展示该漏洞，但残差为何可迁移缺乏解释，导致防御设计无从下手。
Method: 形式化 RT 度量，量化水印证据跨无关图像转移后的可解码性；用对比分析与受控干预区分训练侧变化与架构设计的作用，对照高 RT 与低 RT 系统验证架构差异；再提出无需重构架构的即插即用策略 CoverLock，强化水印证据对载体图像的依赖。
Result: 训练侧常见变化无法解释各水印系统间巨大的 RT 差异，架构设计起核心作用；受控干预验证了两个抑制残差可迁移性的机制；在表现出高残差可迁移性的代表性水印系统上，CoverLock 相较传统手工防御和学习型分类器防御取得更有利的安全–鲁棒性权衡。
Conclusion: 残差可迁移性主要由架构决定，增强水印证据对载体图像的依赖即可压制伪造；改架构不可行时可用 CoverLock 在不重构的前提下获得更好的安全–鲁棒性折中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Arithmetic Simplicity in Stochastic Gradient Methods
papers.abstract_en: A gradient descent method is arithmetically simple if the operations are limited to $+,-, \times$, and division $x/2^t$ with integer $t$. An arthmetically simple gradient method is easy to implement in chip design. We show how to transform AdaGrad, Adam, and AdamW into arithmetically simple. AdamW is based on the recursion $x_{t+1}=(1-λη)x_t-\frac{η}{s}m_t$ and Adam is the special case of AdamW with $λ=0$. We transform them into a static case with $s=S(T)$, where $T$ is the number of iterations, and $S(T)$ is a fixed function. The convergence analysis is given for a static Adam, which is also arithmetically simple.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW 改写成只含加减乘与移位除 x/2^t 的算术简单形式，便于芯片实现：将自适应步长 s 固定为只依赖总迭代数 T 的静态函数 S(T)，得到静态 Adam 并给出其收敛性分析。
Motivation: Adam 系优化器含除法与自适应状态，硬件实现成本高；目标是把它们化为仅用 +、−、× 与移位除的等价形式，同时保留可分析的收敛性。
Method: 沿用 AdamW 递推 x_{t+1}=(1−λη)x_t−(η/s)m_t（λ=0 即 Adam），把时变步长 s 替换为静态 s=S(T)，S(T) 为总迭代数 T 的固定函数；对静态 Adam 给出收敛分析。
Result: 给出 AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW 到算术简单形式的变换方案，并对静态 Adam（算术简单）给出收敛性分析；摘要未含实验数值。
Conclusion: Adam 系优化器可以化为只用加减乘与移位除的静态步长版本，从而易于芯片实现且仍可做收敛分析。
Relevance: 0
