papers.title: Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedDRMan 用联邦子空间引导的蒸馏解决非独立同分布 (non-IID) 多机器人操作策略聚合中的表征漂移与更新不兼容：服务器模型作冻结 teacher 做局部行为克隆，低秩多模态子空间与动作分布蒸馏保留全局表征几何，按更新兼容性分簇并做谱重平衡。在 LIBERO 的多种 non-IID 设定下峰值平均成功率 80.7%，比最强联邦基线高 11.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 多机器人想在不集中访问演示数据的前提下联合改进操作策略，但 non-IID 任务与环境分布会造成表征漂移和互不兼容的策略更新，朴素参数聚合反而有害。
Method: FedDRMan 每轮以服务器模型作冻结 teacher 做局部行为克隆，用低秩多模态子空间蒸馏与动作分布蒸馏保留全局表征几何和策略行为；服务器按更新兼容性给客户端分簇并为每簇维护持久模型，再对每个兼容聚合做谱重平衡，以缓解较弱但任务相关的更新方向被衰减。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上覆盖多样 non-IID 设定、异质性程度、客户端参与率变化，并含消融与聚合分析：峰值平均成功率 80.7%，比最强评估的联邦基线高 11.6 个百分点，且一致优于强联邦基线。
Conclusion: 非 IID 多机器人操作策略的联邦聚合要按更新兼容性分簇并保护任务相关的弱更新方向，而不是直接平均参数；子空间与动作分布蒸馏能稳定知识迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM)，用单个条件速度场把整段未来骨架轨迹从最后观测姿态的随机轨迹沿测地路径输运到真实未来，空间与时间注意力按骨骼关系和时间偏移耦合演化，切空间演化保证生成过程中骨长不变。在 AMASS 上评估预测精度、多样性校准与运动统计并做消融，训练好的模型零参数更新迁移到未见过的 Human3.6M 骨架上仍有竞争力表现。
Motivation: 人体运动预测既要轨迹多样又要符合观测运动与骨骼物理结构：骨骼约束限制单帧姿态，而协调运动依赖关节间空间交互与时刻间时间交互，现有生成式预测需同时满足这两类约束。
Method: GSFM 以单个条件速度场输运完整未来骨架轨迹，轨迹构成时空骨架图，空间与时间注意力按骨骼关系与物理时间偏移耦合其演化；骨方向表示为相对根关节的单位球面上的量，切空间演化保证生成全程骨长不变。训练用条件 flow matching，沿连接「以最后观测姿态为中心的随机轨迹」与「记录的未来轨迹」的测地路径学习速度场。
Result: 在 AMASS (Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes) 上评估预测精度、多样性校准与运动统计，并通过消融研究展示空间与时间消息传递的贡献；在 AMASS 上训练的 GSFM 无需参数更新或重训即可在 Human3.6M 骨架上表现有竞争力，说明可迁移到未见过的骨骼结构。
Conclusion: 把整段未来轨迹作为时空骨架图用单个条件速度场生成，并用切空间约束保住骨长，可在满足骨骼物理结构的同时保持多样性，且能跨未见过的骨架结构零微调迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: "Where Can I Trust You?": Boundary-Aware Evaluation of Surrogate Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Surrogate models are commonly evaluated by how often they agree with their teacher model over an evaluation set. Local variation in this agreement is well known, but its structure and consequences are less clear. We ask whether disagreement is systematically concentrated near the teacher's decision boundary and whether retaining that structure provides information beyond a single global score. Across several datasets and surrogate model classes, we find substantially lower fidelity near teacher decision boundaries under two different methods of identifying near-boundary examples. Moreover, conditioning agreement on confidence-defined regions improves prediction of teacher--surrogate agreement when evaluation-set composition changes, relative to the global score alone. Yet surrogates that agree equally well with the teacher both globally and near the decision boundary can respond very differently to changes selected using the surrogate itself. Finally, we show that independently trained deep teachers can agree on most predictions while identifying different examples as lying near their decision boundaries, complicating the use of those boundaries as stable reference regions for evaluating surrogates. Together, these results show that surrogate fidelity depends not only on how often a surrogate agrees with its teacher, but also on where that agreement holds and, for deep models, how stable the teacher's decision boundary is across training runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出代理模型 (surrogate) 对教师模型的整体一致率掩盖了结构：在多种数据集与代理模型类别上，靠近教师决策边界的样本一致率显著更低，且按置信度分区条件化后的一致率在评估集组成变化时比单一全局分数更能预测真实一致率。但全局与边界一致率都相同的代理，在用代理自身选出的扰动下响应可以很不同，而独立训练的深教师虽在多数预测上一致、却对哪些样本算近边界给出不同判定，因此边界不能当作稳定的评测参考区。
Motivation: 代理保真度评测长期只报一个全局一致率，已知一致率存在局部差异，但其结构与后果不清：无法判断一致率在何处失效，也无法在评估集组成变化时外推真实一致率。
Method: 在多个数据集与多类代理模型上，用两种识别近边界样本的方法比较边界附近与整体的一致率；再按置信度定义的区域对一致率做条件化，检验其在评估集组成变化时对教师-代理一致率的预测能力；并比较全局与边界一致率相同的代理对自身所选扰动的响应，以及独立训练的深教师对近边界样本判定的一致性。
Result: 两种近边界识别方法下，靠近教师决策边界的保真度都显著低于整体；按置信度分区条件化一致率在评估集组成变化时比全局分数更能预测教师-代理一致率；全局与边界一致率都相同的代理对基于代理选择的扰动响应却很不同；独立训练的深教师在多数预测上一致，却把不同样本判为近边界。
Conclusion: 代理保真度取决于一致率在哪里成立，以及深教师的决策边界在不同训练运行间是否稳定，单一全局分数不足以支撑可信度判断。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CompassPlay: Rewarding the Proposer for Where It Moves the Solver
papers.abstract_en: In self-play, a proposer generates verifiable tasks to train a solver. Proposer rewards often depend on the solver's success rate, but equally difficult tasks can differ in their training value. We introduce CompassPlay, a self-play method that rewards the proposer through gradient alignment. The reward favors tasks whose solver loss gradients align with those of reference tasks representing the target capabilities. It draws on a first-order approximation to learning progress and scores each eligible task without additional solver training. Our experiments show gains in performance and training efficiency. In coding self-play with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, a small external reference set guides task generation. CompassPlay improves average accuracy over AZR's difficulty reward by 1.5 percentage points on in-domain coding and 2.7 on out-of-domain mathematics. In Lean4 theorem proving, CompassPlay matches the difficulty baseline's 150-iteration cumulative coverage with 40\% fewer GPU-hours.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompassPlay 用梯度对齐替代成功率作为自博弈 (self-play) 中 proposer 的奖励：任务的 solver loss 梯度与代表目标能力的参考任务梯度越对齐，得分越高，该分数由学习进度的一阶近似给出，无需额外 solver 训练即可打分。在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 编码自博弈上，相对 AZR 的难度奖励平均准确率在域内提升 1.5 个百分点、域外数学提升 2.7 个百分点；在 Lean4 定理证明中用少 40% GPU-hours 达到难度基线 150 轮的累计覆盖率。
Motivation: 自博弈里 proposer 的奖励通常只看 solver 成功率，但难度相同的任务训练价值可能差别很大，导致生成的任务未必最能推动目标能力。
Method: 以参考任务（编码任务中来自小型外部参考集）的 solver loss 梯度为基准，用学习进度的一阶近似给每个合格任务打分，奖励梯度与参考梯度对齐的任务，打分过程不需额外 solver 训练。
Result: 编码自博弈（Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）上，平均准确率较 AZR 难度奖励在域内高 1.5 个百分点、在域外数学高 2.7 个百分点；Lean4 定理证明中以少 40% 的 GPU-hours 匹配难度基线 150 轮的累计覆盖率。
Conclusion: 按梯度对齐而非单纯难度给 proposer 发奖励，可同时提高自博弈的性能与训练效率，且打分无需额外 solver 训练。

papers.title: Toward Agentic Optical Networks: A Vision of LLM Agent-Driven Autonomous Lifecycle Management
papers.abstract_en: As optical networks continue to expand in scale, complexity, and service diversity, the implementation of automation has become essential for ensuring agility, efficiency, and reliability in lifecycle management (LCM) of optical networks. Large language model (LLM) Agent, distinguished by its progressively sophisticated capabilities in logical reasoning, adaptive decision-making, complex problem solving, and multi-task orchestration, presents great opportunities to advance network automation beyond traditional AI techniques. Nevertheless, the application of LLM Agent in optical networks remains in its early exploratory stage, challenged by the lack of multi-task coordination, high computational demands, data dependence, and reliability concerns. In this paper, we envision a conceptual roadmap toward Agentic Optical Networks (AONs) by integrating LLM Agents throughout the LCM with high-level autonomy. First, we trace the evolution from manual operations to AI-empowered frameworks and distill key technologies in Agent, providing actionable insights into leveraging its strengths for addressing practical network automation challenges. A core contribution of this paper is the proposal of a hierarchical multi-Agent framework, which is specifically developed to manage every phase in LCM of AONs, including planning, deployment, operation, maintenance, upgrade, and decommission, thereby enabling more cohesive and comprehensive automation throughout the entire lifecycle. In addition, future directions and underlying challenges are also discussed at the intersection of LLM and optical networks. By aligning the LLM Agent with the specialized requirements of AONs, this work aims to explore the potential for the evolution of optical networks moving from task-level semi-automatic execution toward lifecycle-level full autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向光网络的分层多 LLM Agent 框架，把规划、部署、运行、维护、升级、退役六个生命周期阶段统一交给 Agent 编排，主张光网络运维从任务级半自动走向生命周期级全自主。该文是概念路线图与愿景论文，同时梳理从人工运维到 AI 驱动框架的演进与 Agent 关键技术，并指出多任务协同缺失、算力开销、数据依赖与可靠性是落地障碍。
Motivation: 光网络规模、复杂度与业务多样性持续扩大，传统 AI 驱动的自动化难以覆盖跨阶段的多任务协同；LLM Agent 在光网络中的应用尚处早期探索，受协同能力不足、算力需求高、数据依赖和可靠性问题制约。
Method: 梳理从人工运维到 AI 赋能框架的演进并提炼 Agent 关键技术；核心是提出分层多 Agent 框架，覆盖光网络生命周期管理的 planning、deployment、operation、maintenance、upgrade、decommission 全阶段；同时讨论 LLM 与光网络交叉的未来方向与挑战。
Result: 产出为概念路线图与分层多 Agent 框架设计，覆盖生命周期六个阶段，并给出 Agent 技术演进梳理与未来挑战讨论。
Conclusion: 把 LLM Agent 对齐光网络的专用需求并贯穿全生命周期，是光网络从任务级半自动执行走向生命周期级全自主的可行路径。

papers.title: LaMET-Agent: An Agent Framework for Large-Momentum Effective Theory Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large-momentum effective theory (LaMET) provides a first-principles framework for computing the $x$ dependence of light-cone parton distributions from lattice QCD. Over the past decade, theoretical and numerical advances have established a mature multi-stage workflow for systematic calculation of parton physics, although its implementation still requires expert judgment and substantial repeated effort. We present lamet-agent, an open-source large language model (LLM) agent framework that organizes this workflow into an executable, reproducible, and inspectable analysis pipeline. The present release supports collinear quark distributions and implements correlator analysis, renormalization, Fourier transformation, perturbative matching, continuum, physical pion mass and infinite-momentum extrapolations, and automated result review. We validate it on four end-to-end analyses: pion parton distribution functions in the gauge-invariant and Coulomb-gauge formulations, and pion and kaon distribution amplitudes, obtaining results consistent with the published calculations. Extensions to transverse-momentum-dependent distributions, generalized transverse-momentum-dependent distributions, and gluonic distribution functions are planned for subsequent releases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LaMET-Agent 把大动量有效理论 (LaMET) 从格点 QCD 计算光锥部分子分布的多阶段流程封装成开源 LLM agent 流水线，覆盖 correlator 分析、重整化、Fourier 变换、微扰匹配、连续极限、物理 pion 质量与无穷动量外推以及自动结果审查。在四个端到端算例（gauge-invariant 与 Coulomb-gauge 两种规范下的 pion PDF，以及 pion 与 kaon 的分布振幅）上得到与已发表计算一致的结果。
Motivation: LaMET 计算流程虽已成熟，但每一步实现仍依赖专家判断和大量重复劳动，难以复现与审查。
Method: 开源 LLM agent 框架 lamet-agent 将流程组织为可执行、可复现、可检查的流水线：correlator 分析、renormalization、Fourier transformation、perturbative matching、continuum 外推、physical pion mass 与 infinite-momentum 外推，并带自动结果审查；当前版本支持 collinear quark distributions。
Result: 在四个端到端分析上验证：gauge-invariant 与 Coulomb-gauge 两种表述下的 pion parton distribution functions，以及 pion 与 kaon distribution amplitudes，结果与已发表计算一致。
Conclusion: LaMET 的标准多阶段部分子计算可以被 agent 化为可复现流水线；transverse-momentum-dependent、generalized TMD 与 gluonic 分布函数留待后续版本。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在四个端到端分析上验证：gauge-invariant 与 Coulomb-gauge 两种表述下的 pion parton distribution functions，以及 pion 与 kaon distribution amplitudes，结果与已发表计算一致。

papers.title: RAO-Nav: Probing Omni-Language Models for Zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: We explore whether Omni-Language Models (OLMs) can be directly applied to zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation (SAVN). Recent work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art specialized models still struggle to achieve generalist multimodal navigation, despite extensive task-specific training. In this paper, we introduce RAO-Nav, short for Reasoning All-in-One OLM, a deployment pipeline for zero-shot SAVN. By leveraging the rich implicit audio-visual knowledge encoded in OLMs, the embodied agent is enabled to ``hear'', ``see'', ``reason'', and ``act'' in the environment. To further elicit the built-in thinking ability of OLMs, we propose a test-time Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) module that can be seamlessly integrated into the decoding space. LNR encourages the model to retrieve more target-relevant observations and make effective navigation decisions. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that our framework surpasses existing state-of-the-art baselines on public SAVN benchmarks without using any training data. Moreover, we introduce a new \emph{Global Navigation Instruction} setting to further evaluate the ability of OLMs to serve as embodied navigation agents. Code: https://github.com/rikeilong/OmniAV\_Nav.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAO-Nav 把 Omni-Language Model (OLM) 直接当作零样本语义视听导航 (SAV N) 智能体，通过测试时的 Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) 模块在解码空间激发模型内建思考，促使其检索更多与目标相关的观测并做出导航决策。在公开 SAVN 基准上，该框架在完全不使用训练数据的情况下超过现有 SOTA 基线，并新增 Global Navigation Instruction 设置来评测 OLM 作为具身导航智能体的能力。
Motivation: 即使经过大量任务专用训练，最先进的专用模型仍难以实现通用多模态导航；作者要检验 OLM 能否零样本直接用于语义视听导航，绕开任务专用训练。
Method: 提出 RAO-Nav（Reasoning All-in-One OLM）部署流水线，利用 OLM 编码的隐式视听知识让智能体在环境中听、看、推理、行动；再加入测试时的 Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) 模块，无缝接入解码空间以激发内建思考能力。
Result: 在公开 SAVN 基准上，该框架在不使用任何训练数据的情况下超过现有 SOTA 基线；并引入新的 Global Navigation Instruction 设置以进一步评测 OLM 作为具身导航智能体的能力。
Conclusion: OLM 的隐式视听知识加测试时推理干预足以支撑零样本语义视听导航，专用模型的任务专用训练并非必需。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes. Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接作用于 xyz 坐标的 3D 点云盲水印框架，用前馈 octree 架构联合学习嵌入与提取，验证时仅凭观测点云即可恢复消息，无需原点云、颜色、法线或网格连接。训练中随机变换层让解码器见过常见几何扰动，渐进位姿对齐提升位姿变化下的鲁棒性；在物体级与场景级基准上，常见几何处理后仍能可靠恢复消息且几何失真低，扰动比手工方案更不显眼、空间结构更弱。
Motivation: 点云是不规则、无结构的几何表示，且常被重采样与几何预处理改动，所有权确权困难；现有方案多依赖原始点云或附加属性才能提取。
Method: 盲水印框架直接在 xyz 坐标上操作，用前馈 octree 架构联合学习水印嵌入与提取，实现大规模点集的多尺度几何推理；训练时加入随机变换层暴露解码器于常见几何扰动，并用渐进式位姿对齐 (progressive pose alignment) 提升位姿鲁棒性，同时支持物体级形状与场景级扫描。
Result: 在物体级与场景级基准上，常见几何处理后消息可可靠恢复且保持低几何失真；定性对比显示所学扰动比手工替代方案更不易察觉、空间结构更弱。
Conclusion: 盲水印可以在不访问原始点云与颜色/法线/网格的前提下，兼顾几何处理鲁棒性与低视觉失真，且优于手工扰动方案的隐蔽性。

papers.title: A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided playbook induction outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases
papers.abstract_en: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we induced a 19-rule consultation policy from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $Δ$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.
papers.comment: 75 pages, including 51 pages of Supplementary Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 21 项评分细则引导的 playbook 归纳（rubric-guided playbook induction），从 73 例训练病例中归纳出 19 条问诊策略，配合多模态听力图解读与检索增强，在不微调 LLM 主干的前提下构建双语 AI 听力师。在 58 例独立模拟病例、17 名执业听力师的来源盲法对照中，AI 在全部 58 例胜出，5 分制综合分平均配对差 +1.35（Cohen's d = 1.84，P = 4.5×10⁻²⁰），21 项细则中 20 项占优且中英文皆然；消融显示 playbook 是最大贡献项。
Motivation: 听力学问诊依赖结构化病史采集、听力图解读与以患者为中心的沟通，而真实病例材料稀缺，专科问诊智能体难以靠微调或大量标注数据获得。
Method: 通用 LLM 不微调主干，配 rubric-guided playbook induction：以 21 项评分细则和 AI 患者模拟器从 73 例训练病例（43 英文、30 中文）归纳出 19 条问诊策略；再加多模态听力图解读与检索增强 (retrieval-augmented grounding)。评估为预设的来源盲法对照，58 例独立模拟病例（30 中文、28 英文）对 17 名执业听力师。
Result: AI 在 58/58 例全部胜过人类听力师，5 分制综合分平均配对差 Δ = +1.35，Cohen's d = 1.84，P = 4.5×10⁻²⁰；在 21 项细则中的 20 项占优，且中英文两种语言均占优。组件消融显示 playbook 是最大贡献项。
Conclusion: 在低数据专科医疗问诊中，用评分细则归纳出的问诊策略（playbook）比微调模型主干更关键，为专科问诊智能体提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: DP-Rec: Towards Dynamic Patching for Efficient Long-Sequence Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have redefined sequential recommendation by effectively modeling dynamic user behaviors and long-range dependencies. However, they remain inherently inefficient: standard architectures operate at a fixed rate, allocating comparable computation to every item in a user's history regardless of its information content. This leads to prohibitive computational overhead on long sequences and increased sensitivity to behavioral noise. To address this, practitioners often resort to lossy sequence compression, staged modeling, or truncation. This limits the model's ability to leverage the full context of long histories during inference. Inspired by the recent success of Byte Latent Transformer, we propose DP-Rec, a dynamic latent patching architecture for recommendation. DP-Rec shifts from item-level modeling to patch-level modeling by segmenting interaction sequences using contrastive entropy surprise to identify informative behavioral boundaries. A lightweight patch encoder compresses these temporally contextualized segments into a reduced set of dynamic latent behavior vectors, which are then processed by a larger latent transformer and decoded for next-item prediction. Extensive experiments show that, under constrained computational budgets, DP-Rec scales effectively to long sequences and achieves a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off over both non-compressed and fixed-size compression baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DP-Rec 把序列推荐从逐 item 建模改为 patch 级建模：用对比熵惊奇 (contrastive entropy surprise) 在交互序列上切出有信息量的行为边界，轻量 patch encoder 把各段压成动态 latent 行为向量，再交给更大的 latent transformer 做 next-item prediction。在受限算力预算下，它对长序列有效扩展，效率-精度权衡优于非压缩与固定大小压缩两类基线。
Motivation: Transformer 序列推荐对每个 item 平均分配算力，长历史下计算开销高且对行为噪声敏感；实践中常用的有损压缩、分阶段建模或截断会损失推理时的完整长上下文。
Method: 受 Byte Latent Transformer 启发，DP-Rec 先用 contrastive entropy surprise 对交互序列分段以定位信息性行为边界，再用轻量 patch encoder 将分段压缩为一组动态 latent 行为向量，输入更大的 latent transformer 解码预测下一个 item。
Result: 在受限计算预算下，DP-Rec 能有效扩展到长序列，并在效率-精度权衡上优于非压缩基线与固定大小压缩基线。
Conclusion: 按信息内容自适应分配算力的动态 patch 化，是长序列推荐在固定算力下兼顾效率与精度的可行路径。

papers.title: HM-ROUTER: Joint Model and Harness Routing for Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agent performance depends on both the underlying model and the harness that manages its tool use and execution. Selecting a suitable pair requires accounting for their compatibility, yet training samples may cover only a subset of the growing combination space. We introduce HM-Router, a routing method that jointly selects a model and harness for each query. It learns separate model and harness representations shared across routes, with an interaction term inspired by canonical polyadic (CP) tensor decomposition to capture how their compatibility varies with the query. This sharing allows training samples from observed pairs to inform predictions for unobserved combinations. We curate a benchmark from 12 public agent benchmarks, covering 293 routes, 73 models, and 25 harnesses. HM-Router exceeds the strongest evaluated learned baseline by 7.3 percentage points in mean routing accuracy and leads at all seven evaluated cost budgets on the six-benchmark subset. When 90% of routes have their training outcomes withheld, allowing unobserved combinations improves normalized accuracy by 15.8 points over restricting the same router to observed routes. HM-Router has also demonstrated training sample efficiency for new routes and components and generalization to unseen benchmarks. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/hmarkc/HM-Router.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HM-Router 对每个 query 同时选模型与 harness，用共享的模型/ harness 表征加一个受 CP 张量分解启发的交互项刻画兼容性随 query 的变化，使已观测组合的训练样本能外推到未观测组合。在由 12 个公开 agent benchmark 构建、覆盖 293 条路由的基准上，平均路由准确率比最强已评测学习型基线高 7.3 个百分点；当 90% 路由的训练结果被隐藏时，允许未观测组合比限定在已观测路由高出 15.8 个百分点的归一化准确率。
Motivation: 模型与 harness 的组合空间快速增长，训练样本往往只覆盖其中一小部分，而选型必须考虑两者的兼容性，逐对穷举训练不可行。
Method: 为模型和 harness 分别学共享表征，加一个受 canonical polyadic (CP) 张量分解启发的交互项，按 query 建模二者兼容性；用 12 个公开 agent benchmark 整理出覆盖 293 routes、73 models、25 harnesses 的基准进行训练与评测。
Result: 平均路由准确率比最强已评测学习型基线高 7.3 个百分点，并在六个 benchmark 子集上的全部七个评测成本预算中领先；当 90% 路由的训练结果被隐藏时，允许未观测组合比把同一 router 限制在已观测路由的归一化准确率高 15.8 个百分点；另在新路由与新组件上体现训练样本效率，并能泛化到未见 benchmark。
Conclusion: 把模型与 harness 的兼容性拆成共享表征加交互项，可以在组合空间大部分未被观测时仍做出准确的联合路由选择。

summary_sections.result: 平均路由准确率比最强已评测学习型基线高 7.3 个百分点，并在六个 benchmark 子集上的全部七个评测成本预算中领先；当 90% 路由的训练结果被隐藏时，允许未观测组合比把同一 router 限制在已观测路由的归一化准确率高 15.8 个百分点；另在新路由与新组件上体现训练样本效率，并能泛化到未见 benchmark。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把模型与 harness 的兼容性拆成共享表征加交互项，可以在组合空间大部分未被观测时仍做出准确的联合路由选择。

papers.title: Rank Confidence Sequences:Anytime-valid Leaderboards
papers.abstract_en: Leaderboards rank models by their average scores on benchmark items, and they are consulted repeatedly while the evaluation is still running. Existing confidence intervals for a model's rank control their error rate only if they are computed once, after a number of items chosen in advance. If they are recomputed as results arrive, and the evaluation stops once they look decisive, their error rate exceeds its nominal level. Anytime-valid methods keep their guarantees at all sample sizes simultaneously and hence under any stopping rule. They exist for the accuracy of one model, for one pair of models and for the set of models that may be best. For pairwise battles they also give ranks. None gives ranks when all models are scored on the same items, which makes their scores dependent. We construct rank confidence sequences: for every model, a set of ranks that contains its true rank, simultaneously for all models and at all times, at a chosen error level $α$, in finite samples. The construction combines betting e-processes, one for each ordered pair of models, with closed testing over the possible orderings of the models. It allows any dependence between the models' scores on an item. The method has two advantages. A leaderboard can be inspected after every item without inflating its error rate. The evaluation of each model can stop as soon as the question asked about it is answered, which saves compute. When results are examined only once, halfway through or later, little power is lost relative to fixed-sample methods. The paper quantifies these advantages in simulations and on public leaderboard data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 rank confidence sequence：对每个模型给出一个排名集合，同时对所有模型、所有时刻、在给定错误水平 α 下包含真实排名，允许同一题目上各模型得分任意相关。构造把每个有序模型对的 betting e-process 与对模型所有可能排序的 closed testing 组合起来，使排行榜可在每道题后查看而不膨胀错误率，并可在问题一回答就停止以节省算力。
Motivation: 现有模型排名的置信区间只在预先固定样本量、一次性计算时才控制错误率；一旦边看结果边重算、看到显著就停，错误率会超过名义水平。已有 anytime-valid 方法只覆盖单模型精度、模型对或可能最优的模型集合，成对比较虽能给排名，但没有方法能在所有模型共用同一批题目（得分相关）时给出排名。
Method: 为每个有序模型对构造 betting e-process，再对模型的全部可能排序做 closed testing，合成每个模型的排名置信序列；构造允许同一题目上模型得分之间任意依赖，且在有限样本下于选定 α 保证覆盖。
Result: 在模拟与公开排行榜数据上量化两项优势：排行榜每看完一道题即可检查而不膨胀错误率；每个模型的评估可在所问问题一回答时立即停止以节省计算。当结果只在过半或更晚才查看一次时，相对固定样本方法损失的检验功效很小。
Conclusion: 把逐对 e-process 与 closed testing 结合，可以在得分相关、任意停止规则下给出同时有效的模型排名区间，且早停与随时查看的代价在只看一次的情形下几乎不损失功效。

papers.title: Fracast-0: Fractal Weight Sharing for a Time Series Foundation Model with Only 85K Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models must preserve multi-domain breadth, probabilistic output, and multiple temporal scales, but parameter count grows when each scale receives a separate representation. We introduce Fracast-0, a probabilistic forecasting foundation model that exploits temporal self-similarity to reuse one operator across scales. A parameter-free detector extracts significant seasonal structure. The encoder applies a shared local block along a geometric dilation ladder with scale conditioning, while the decoder combines context-gathered states with an explicit seasonal future state and reuses a second block along another ladder before emitting nine quantiles. Pretraining across six corpora preserves multi-domain breadth within 85,001 parameters. On 97 GIFT-Eval configurations without per-dataset fine-tuning, Fracast-0 is the smallest of 28 evaluated checkpoints and remains non-dominated in the aggregate parameter-accuracy plane with MASE 0.808 and WQL 0.564. It uses 42.0% fewer parameters than TinyCast, whose MASE and WQL are 4.2% and 3.3% lower. These results support cross-scale weight reuse as a practical route to further time series foundation model compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fracast-0 用时间自相似性把同一个算子沿几何扩张阶梯跨尺度复用，以 85,001 参数做概率预报基础模型。在 GIFT-Eval 的 97 个配置上不做逐数据集微调，MASE 0.808、WQL 0.564，在参数-精度聚合平面上不被 28 个已评测 checkpoint 中任何一个支配，参数比 TinyCast 少 42.0%。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型要同时保住多领域广度、概率输出与多时间尺度，而每个尺度各配一套表示会让参数量随尺度数增长，压缩困难。
Method: 参数无关检测器提取显著季节结构；编码器用带尺度条件 (scale conditioning) 的共享局部块沿几何扩张阶梯 (dilation ladder) 逐级作用，解码器把上下文聚合状态与显式季节未来状态合并，再沿另一条阶梯复用第二个块，最终输出九个分位数；在六个语料上预训练。
Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 97 个配置上不做逐数据集微调，MASE 0.808、WQL 0.564，是 28 个已评测 checkpoint 中最小者且在聚合参数-精度平面上不被支配；参数量 85,001，比 TinyCast 少 42.0%，而 TinyCast 的 MASE 与 WQL 分别低 4.2% 与 3.3%。
Conclusion: 跨尺度权重复用是时间序列基础模型继续压缩的可行路径，代价是相对 TinyCast 在 MASE 与 WQL 上略有让步。

papers.title: Witness: Discovery, Deciphering, and Epiphany in Interactive Puzzle Environments
papers.abstract_en: Automated science needs agents that can work out the rules of an unfamiliar environment by interacting with it. Interactive rule-discovery puzzles offer a controlled setting for studying this ability: an agent infers hidden rules through experimentation and uses what it has inferred to reach a stated goal. We ask what limits current language models on these puzzles and whether reinforcement learning (RL) improves performance on rules held out from training. To study both, we introduce WITNESS, a 2D grid-based puzzle environment with ground-truth ASCII observations and controlled access to rules. An agentic pipeline generates games for WitnessGym, the RL training suite, and WitnessBench, comprising public validation and private test games. The validation set separately tests new compositions of trained rule primitives and primitives absent from training. Under a shared harness, the best of 18 frontier proprietary and open-weight models solves only 24\% of private test level slots, with scores sensitive to the observation interface and agent configuration. Providing ground-truth rules raises Opus-5's validation RHAE-L5 (relative human action efficiency over the first five levels) from 59.9 to 97.8, whereas a 27B open-weight model gains only 2.1 points and remains limited even with the rules provided. RL on WitnessGym raises the 27B model's private test RHAE-L5 from 2.1 to 5.4 and yields a mean gain of 4.1 points on four external discovery benchmarks. Together, these results point to rule acquisition as a major difficulty for frontier models like Opus-5 while smaller models further struggle on rule-based execution, and indicate that RL on hidden-rule puzzles transfers to broader rules and real-world tasks beyond training. Benchmark is available at: https://witnessbench.ai
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WITNESS 是一个 2D 网格规则发现谜题环境与基准，含 WitnessGym（RL 训练套件）和 WitnessBench（公开验证 + 私有测试）。在统一 harness 下 18 个前沿模型中最强者只解出私有测试 24% 的关卡槽位；给出真值规则可把 Opus-5 的验证 RHAE-L5 从 59.9 提到 97.8，而 27B 开放权重模型只涨 2.1 点。RL 训练把 27B 的私有 RHAE-L5 从 2.1 提到 5.4，并在四个外部发现基准上平均涨 4.1 点。
Motivation: 自动化科学需要 agent 通过与陌生环境交互自行推断隐藏规则，但当前语言模型在规则发现类任务上的瓶颈（规则获取 vs 规则执行）未被分离检验。
Method: 构建 WITNESS：2D 网格谜题环境，观测为 ground-truth ASCII，规则访问可控；agentic pipeline 生成 WitnessGym 训练集与 WitnessBench（公开验证 + 私有测试），验证集分别测试已训练规则原语的新组合与训练中缺席的原语；在共享 harness 下比较 18 个前沿专有与开放权重模型，并对 27B 模型做 RL 训练。
Result: 共享 harness 下最强模型仅解出私有测试 24% 的 level slots，分数对观测接口与 agent 配置敏感；提供真值规则使 Opus-5 验证 RHAE-L5 从 59.9 升至 97.8，27B 开放权重模型仅升 2.1 点；RL 使 27B 私有测试 RHAE-L5 从 2.1 升至 5.4，并在四个外部 discovery 基准上平均提升 4.1 点。
Conclusion: 规则获取是 Opus-5 等前沿模型的主要难点，小模型还额外受限于基于规则的执行；在隐藏规则谜题上的 RL 可迁移到训练之外的更广规则与真实任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DegreeSpar: Structured Degree Sparsity for Efficient Secure Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Secure Transformer inference protects sensitive inputs but incurs substantial cryptographic overhead, with nonlinear operations such as Softmax and GeLU becoming major bottlenecks. Existing compression methods reduce nonlinear complexity, sequence-dependent computation, or model structure through separately defined compression variables. Under aggressive compression, however, these independently optimized perturbations can accumulate: at a matched compression level, stacking representative approximation, token-pruning, and model-pruning methods reduces ViT-S accuracy from 80.20% to 76.41%. We introduce DegreeSpar, which formulates secure Transformer compression as structured sparsification over nonlinear polynomial degrees. Polynomial degree directly controls the cost of secure nonlinear evaluation, while computation-aligned zero-degree structures expose token-level and model-dimension computation as removable within the same optimization space. DegreeSpar further incorporates approximation-aware training for low-degree Softmax and GeLU, enabling aggressive degree reduction and creating the optimization headroom required for structured computation removal. Across vision and language Transformers, DegreeSpar consistently improves the accuracy-latency trade-off across model scales, tasks, and sequence lengths, achieving speedups from 2.29x to 6.63x over the corresponding baselines. Under the same network setting, DegreeSpar achieves 92.68% accuracy on BERT/SST-2 in 110.55 s, compared with 92.66% in 167.26 s for CipherPrune, the closest prior hybrid secure-inference approach. These results establish structured polynomial degree as an effective shared optimization space for secure Transformer compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DegreeSpar 把安全 Transformer 推理的多种压缩变量统一成对非线性多项式次数的结构化稀疏化：次数直接决定安全求值代价，零次数结构把 token 与模型维度的计算纳入同一优化空间，并配合面向低次 Softmax/GeLU 的 approximation-aware 训练。相比把近似、token 剪枝、模型剪枝各自独立叠加（ViT-S 精度 80.20% 掉到 76.41%），DegreeSpar 在视觉与语言 Transformer 上取得 2.29x–6.63x 加速，BERT/SST-2 达 92.68% 精度、110.55 s。
Motivation: 安全推理中 Softmax、GeLU 等非线性操作的密码学开销是主要瓶颈；现有方法各自定义压缩变量，激进压缩下扰动叠加——同等压缩水平下叠加近似、token 剪枝与模型剪枝使 ViT-S 精度从 80.20% 降至 76.41%。
Method: 将安全 Transformer 压缩表述为对非线性多项式次数的结构化稀疏化：多项式次数直接控制安全非线性求值代价，与计算对齐的零次数结构把 token 级与模型维度计算暴露为可移除项，纳入同一优化空间；并引入面向低次 Softmax 与 GeLU 的 approximation-aware 训练以腾出结构化剪枝余量。
Result: 在视觉与语言 Transformer 上跨模型规模、任务与序列长度一致改善精度-延迟权衡，相对对应基线加速 2.29x 至 6.63x；同一网络设置下 BERT/SST-2 达 92.68% 精度、耗时 110.55 s，而最接近的既有混合安全推理方法 CipherPrune 为 92.66%、167.26 s。独立压缩变量叠加时 ViT-S 精度由 80.20% 降至 76.41%。
Conclusion: 结构化多项式次数是一个有效的安全 Transformer 压缩共享优化空间，能在保持精度的同时大幅降低安全推理延迟。

papers.title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) has recently emerged as a powerful technique for transferring context to student models and for self-improvement. In OPCD, the teacher is conditioned on privileged information, and the goal is to minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the privileged teacher and the student, evaluated on student-generated tokens. Many existing studies show that using instance-specific gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training performance, especially out-of-distribution (OOD). In this work, we instead design general instructions that target common student mistakes observed on the training samples, and show that such simple instructions can outperform gold as the OPCD privilege. In autoformalization tasks, using a matched formatting instruction as the privilege could outperform gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin. In 7 out of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA as datasets, and Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking families as models, matched instruction privileges outperform gold in OOD by 4 to 17 points, while remaining on par with gold in-domain. Each instruction is only a few sentences (and thus contains much less information compared to all instance-specific gold) and is applied uniformly to every training sample. These results indicate that a general instruction, which applies equally to source and target domain examples, can be substantially more transferable than instance-specific gold in OPCD while maintaining in-domain performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) 中，把特权信息从逐样本 gold answer 换成针对常见学生错误的通用指令，OOD 泛化反而更好。在 ProverQA、ProofWriter、ProntoQA 上用 Qwen3-Thinking 与 Olmo3-Thinking 家族做 8 组实验，7 组中匹配指令特权的 OOD 精度比 gold 高 4 到 17 个百分点，域内精度与 gold 持平。
Motivation: OPCD 中教师以特权信息为条件、最小化师生在学生生成 token 上的 KL 散度，但既有工作默认用逐样本 gold answer 或 gold demonstration 作特权，训练表现反而受损，尤其在 OOD 场景。
Method: 设计针对训练样本上常见学生错误的通用指令（如 autoformalization 的匹配格式指令）作为 OPCD 特权，每条仅几句话、对所有训练样本统一施加，替代逐样本 gold；教师以该指令为条件，按学生生成 token 上的 KL 蒸馏给学生。
Result: 在 ProverQA、ProofWriter、ProntoQA 三个数据集与 Qwen3-Thinking、Olmo3-Thinking 模型家族的 8 组实验中，7 组里匹配指令特权的 OOD 精度超过 gold 4 到 17 个百分点，域内与 gold 持平；autoformalization 任务上匹配格式指令的 OOD 精度大幅超过 gold。
Conclusion: 对源域和目标域同等适用的通用指令，比信息量大得多的逐样本 gold 更可迁移，同时保持域内性能。

papers.title: Agents as Software: A Programming Languages Agenda for Agent Reliability
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly resemble software systems: they call tools, remember facts, follow policies, delegate work, and take actions with real consequences. % Yet the ``program'' of an agent is scattered across prompts, tools, memories, workflows, and execution traces, making its behavior difficult to inspect through ordinary testing and debugging alone. % This essay argues that a programming-systems perspective offers a natural lens for making agents reliable. % We recast agents as programmable artifacts whose behavior can be specified over traces and state, checked before deployment, monitored during execution, and improved from observed failures. % The goal is not to make probabilistic agents behave like deterministic programs, but to give them enough structure that their behavior can be reasoned about, controlled, and repaired.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AI agent 当作可编程软件构件：其“程序”散落在 prompts、tools、memories、workflows 与 execution traces 中，仅靠常规测试调试无法审视。文章主张用编程系统视角把 agent 行为在 trace 与 state 上做规范、部署前检查、运行中监控、并据观测到的失败迭代修复，目标不是让概率 agent 变成确定性程序，而是给足可推理、可控制、可修复的结构。
Motivation: Agent 行为分散在提示、工具、记忆、工作流与执行轨迹多处，普通测试与调试难以覆盖，可靠性缺乏系统化的规范与检查手段。
Method: 以议程性文章形式提出编程系统视角：把 agent 重铸为可编程构件，对其行为在 traces 与 state 上给出规范，并配套部署前检查、运行期监控与基于失败的改进流程。
Result: 提出的是概念性议程而非实验方法：给出“specify–check–monitor–repair”的四步可靠性框架，并明确目标限定为让 agent 行为可推理、可控制、可修复，而非使其确定性化。
Conclusion: 编程语言与编程系统的技术可作为 agent 可靠性的主要杠杆，前提是行为能在 trace 与 state 层面被显式规范和持续检查。

papers.title: SparSP: Exploiting Communication Sparsity for Sequence-Parallel Video DiTs
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers have become the dominant architecture for video generation. Their substantial computational cost motivates scaling inference across multi-GPU servers, yet efficient scaling remains challenging on commodity GPUs connected via PCIe, whose bandwidth is limited. Although sparse attention substantially reduces computation, its implications for communication remain underexplored. This paper argues that attention sparsity should be treated as a communication primitive. We present SparSP, an efficient sparse sequence parallel communication system that co-designs token distribution, communication routing, and asynchronous execution for sparse video diffusion models. First, Dependency-Aware Placement distributes sequence blocks according to diffusion models' sparse attention patterns. Second, Demand-Directed KV Routing transfers KV blocks directly to requesting GPUs without intermediate relays. Third, a Decoupled Transfer Runtime separates communication from GPU computation to reduce resource contention and maximize effective bandwidth. Our evaluation shows that SparSP improves attention performance by 1.38- 1.5$\times$, achieves an average 1.17$\times$ (up to 1.69$\times$) end-to-end speedup across three representative servers and three video diffusion models, and reduces communication volume by 12.54-23.05%. Moreover, we achieve an average 1.53-1.76$\times$ bandwidth improvement over NCCL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparSP 把稀疏注意力当作通信原语，为 PCIe 多 GPU 上的视频 DiT 序列并行设计依赖感知放置、按需 KV 路由与通信-计算解耦的运行时。在三台服务器、三个视频扩散模型上端到端平均加速 1.17×（最高 1.69×），通信量下降 12.54–23.05%，相对 NCCL 带宽提升 1.53–1.76×。
Motivation: 视频 DiT 推理需跨多 GPU 扩展，但消费级 GPU 走 PCIe、带宽受限；稀疏注意力虽省算力，其对通信的影响此前未被当作设计对象。
Method: 三个组件协同设计：Dependency-Aware Placement 按扩散模型稀疏注意力模式分布序列块；Demand-Directed KV Routing 把 KV 块直接送到请求方 GPU、不经中继；Decoupled Transfer Runtime 将通信与 GPU 计算分离以减少资源争用、提高有效带宽。
Result: 注意力性能提升 1.38–1.5×；在三台代表性服务器与三个视频扩散模型上端到端平均加速 1.17×、最高 1.69×；通信量减少 12.54–23.05%；相对 NCCL 平均带宽提升 1.53–1.76×。
Conclusion: 把稀疏注意力模式纳入通信设计（放置、路由、运行时三者协同）能在 PCIe 环境下同时降低通信量并抬高有效带宽，从而加速稀疏视频扩散模型的多 GPU 推理。

papers.title: The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing
papers.abstract_en: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models. If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 追踪 OLMo-2 与 Zephyr 两个 7B 开源模型家族的公开训练阶段（base、SFT、DPO），每个阶段同时以短篇小说写作者和故事对评判者两种身份测量。写作侧如担忧般漂移：完全训练后的模型对自家 base/SFT/DPO 阶段故事越来越熟悉，跨家族评判时每 token 惊奇度下降 7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）与 24–25%（Zephyr）；但评判侧几乎不动，没有一个训练后评判者对更可预测故事的偏好增长达到 1 个百分点。
Motivation: 若后训练让模型自己的写作更可预测，同一模型担任评判者时可能转而奖励可预测写作，使自动化评估看不见创造力上的进展；需要检验这条担忧是否真的成立。
Method: 沿 OLMo-2 与 Zephyr（各 7B）的公开训练阶段（base、SFT、DPO）逐阶段测量，每阶段跑两种角色：写十道提示的短篇小说，以及对故事对做判断（“哪个更好”“哪个更有创造力”），并用打乱词序的同一故事作为可预测性对照；对偏好增长做 post hoc 单侧 95% 上界估计。
Result: 写作侧：完全训练模型对自家 base/SFT/DPO 阶段故事在全部十道提示上越来越熟悉，另一家族模型对已训练故事每 token 惊奇度降低 7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）与 24–25%（Zephyr）。评判侧：没有训练后评判者对更可预测故事的“更好”偏好增长达到 1 个百分点，post hoc 单侧 95% 上界为平均故事对 2.7 个百分点，约等于未训练 OLMo-2 评判者自身的倾斜；“更有创造力”题下没有训练后评判者比其 base 更偏向可预测故事。训练反而强化了“更有创造力”题下偏好更长故事与固定答案槽位，并破坏该题：训练后评判者不再可靠地偏好原故事而非其打乱词序版本。后续实验无法构造只在可预测性上不同而质量相同的 story 对，因为降低可预测性的路径会破坏部分故事，常达不到预先设定的质量下限。
Conclusion: 后训练确实让模型写作更可预测，但没有把评判者推向奖励可预测写作，写作漂移与评判口味基本解耦；真正被训练改变的是评判者对长度与答案槽位的偏好，以及“更有创造力”这一提问本身的可靠性。

summary_sections.result: 写作侧：完全训练模型对自家 base/SFT/DPO 阶段故事在全部十道提示上越来越熟悉，另一家族模型对已训练故事每 token 惊奇度降低 7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）与 24–25%（Zephyr）。评判侧：没有训练后评判者对更可预测故事的“更好”偏好增长达到 1 个百分点，post hoc 单侧 95% 上界为平均故事对 2.7 个百分点，约等于未训练 OLMo-2 评判者自身的倾斜；“更有创造力”题下没有训练后评判者比其 base 更偏向可预测故事。训练反而强化了“更有创造力”题下偏好更长故事与固定答案槽位，并破坏该题：训练后评判者不再可靠地偏好原故事而非其打乱词序版本。后续实验无法构造只在可预测性上不同而质量相同的 story 对，因为降低可预测性的路径会破坏部分故事，常达不到预先设定的质量下限。
summary_sections.conclusion: 后训练确实让模型写作更可预测，但没有把评判者推向奖励可预测写作，写作漂移与评判口味基本解耦；真正被训练改变的是评判者对长度与答案槽位的偏好，以及“更有创造力”这一提问本身的可靠性。

papers.title: High-Probability Guarantees for SGD under $β$-Heavy-Tailed Gradient Noise
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is widely used to train machine learning models, but subsampling the training data introduces noise into its updates. The strength and applicability of high-probability guarantees therefore depend critically on how the tails of gradient noise are modeled. Reports of heavy-tailed gradient noise in deep learning motivate relaxing the bounded-noise and sub-Gaussian assumptions commonly used in high-probability analyses of SGD. We use Young functions from Orlicz space theory to describe noise tails in a common framework. We model SGD gradient noise by adopting a Young function that preserves the finiteness of all polynomial moments while allowing tails heavier than sub-Weibull, including lognormal distributions. The resulting class is called $β$-heavy-tailed, with $β$ controlling the tail heaviness. We establish concentration inequalities for $β$-heavy-tailed noise and combine them with a uniform bound on the difference between empirical and population gradients along the SGD trajectory to obtain high-probability bounds on optimization and population-risk stationarity for smooth nonconvex losses under trajectory assumptions. The bounds are not restricted to a particular learning-rate decay rule and make explicit the effects of noise tails and learning-rate schedules. Under the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, we bound the risk at the last iterate. We also analyze SGD with gradient clipping under the $β$-heavy-tailed noise model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Orlicz 空间的 Young 函数统一刻画 SGD 梯度噪声尾部，提出 β-heavy-tailed 模型：保留所有多项式矩有限，同时允许比 sub-Weibull 更重的尾（含 lognormal）。据此推出集中不等式，并结合 SGD 轨迹上经验梯度与总体梯度之差的一致界，得到光滑非凸损失下优化与总体风险平稳性的高概率界；界不依赖特定学习率衰减规则，并显式给出噪声尾与学习率调度的影响。
Motivation: 深度学习中梯度噪声呈重尾的报告，使高概率分析常用的有界噪声与 sub-Gaussian 假设过强；需要一个能同时容纳更重尾部并给出可算高概率保证的统一框架。
Method: 以 Young 函数描述噪声尾，定义保留全部多项式矩、尾重于 sub-Weibull（含 lognormal）的 β-heavy-tailed 类；对该类建立集中不等式，再与 SGD 轨迹上经验梯度和总体梯度差的一致界结合，导出光滑非凸损失的高概率界；在 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 条件下给出末次迭代风险界，并分析带梯度 clipping 的 SGD。
Result: 得到优化与总体风险平稳性的高概率界，界不限定特定学习率衰减规则，且显式依赖噪声尾参数 β 与学习率调度；在 PL 条件下给出末次迭代的风险界，并覆盖梯度 clipping 的分析。
Conclusion: 高概率 SGD 保证可以在比 sub-Gaussian 更宽的重尾噪声类上成立，其强度由尾部 Young 函数与学习率调度共同决定，而非必须靠有界或次高斯假设。

papers.title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Devol-ONE 用 Mixture of Transformers 把视觉语言理解、潜空间世界动力学预测和动作生成放进同一个自回归框架：视觉语言流与 V-JEPA 预训练动力学流联合自回归预测，每层都 attend 视觉语言 KV cache，动作专家由语义推理和预测物理动态持续塑形而非固定预计算表征。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0 及 Flexiv 单臂/双臂真机评测中，消融显示动态流预测与逐层统一注意力有效。
Motivation: VLA 模型直接由当前视觉与语言上下文出动作，缺少对候选动作下场景如何演化的显式刻画；现有 WAM 把预测与策略学习在架构上分开，仅靠输出（像素视频或独立于策略训练的潜空间预测模块）连接。
Method: Mixture of Transformers 架构：不再只编码一次视觉语言 token 再喂给动作专家，而是让视觉语言流与 V-JEPA 预训练动力学流联合自回归预测，每层 attend 视觉语言 key-value cache，在语言引导下预报未来潜状态；动作专家据此连续更新。
Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0 基准与 Flexiv 单臂、双臂真机上做实验；消融研究显示动态流预测与逐层统一注意力有效，验证模型架构一致性。
Conclusion: 把世界预测与策略学习放进单一自回归框架、让动作专家持续受预测物理动态塑造，比预测与策略分离的 WAM 设计更连贯。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. It constructs 800 composite workflows across four domains from source-grounded dependency graphs, with node-local specifications, verifiable artifact handoffs, native evaluators, and matched isolation challenges. CoMemBench measures workflow completion, verified node progress, required-handoff reliability, isolation robustness, and token cost. Experiments reveal a sharing-isolation trade-off: broader context improves information availability but can weaken isolation, while system rankings shift across topologies and artifact violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoMemBench 把「协作记忆边界」（该共享的任务相关信息与该隔离的无关、过期、未验证信息）做成可执行基准：从源依赖图构造 800 条跨四领域的复合工作流，带节点规格、可验证 artifact 交接、原生评估器与配对的隔离挑战。实验揭示共享-隔离权衡：上下文越宽信息可得性越高但隔离越弱，且系统排名随工作流拓扑与 artifact 违规类型而变。
Motivation: 现有记忆基准只测保留与检索，多智能体基准只测协调与端到端完成，拓扑条件下的记忆边界（哪些中间产物对哪些下游节点有效、何时失效）基本无人测量。
Method: 从 source-grounded 依赖图生成 800 条覆盖四个领域的复合工作流，每条带节点局部规格、可验证的 artifact 交接、原生评估器，以及配对构造的隔离挑战（isolation challenges）；评测维度为工作流完成度、已验证节点进度、必需交接可靠性、隔离稳健性与 token 成本。
Result: 实验显示共享-隔离权衡：更宽的上下文提升信息可得性但削弱隔离；系统排名会随拓扑变化和 artifact 违规类型发生位移。基准规模为 800 条复合工作流、四个领域，报告五项指标（完成度、验证节点进度、交接可靠性、隔离稳健性、token 成本）。
Conclusion: 记忆基准必须按工作流拓扑条件化地同时考核共享与隔离，单看检索或端到端完成会给出不稳定的系统排名。

papers.title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
papers.abstract_en: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOXAI 把 DNA 甲基化与拷贝数变异 (CNV) 拼成多模态输入，用 ResNet50、DINOv2、GAT 分类成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型，并用 CAM/Grad-CAM 把决策归因到具体 CpG 位点、基因与染色体区域。在 TCGA 队列上多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高 92.98%，超过仅用 CNV 的模型；DINOv2 在独立验证集上达 94.25%（置信度 >0.9），泛化最强。
Motivation: 现有计算模型把甲基化与 CNV 分开分析，丢掉二者互补信息；分类模型也缺少类似传统肿瘤分级的类内风险评估，且没有方法能把决策归因到具体基因组位点。
Method: 从甲基化芯片提取 DNA 甲基化与 CNV 双模态，训练 ResNet50、DINOv2 与 Graph Attention Network (GAT) 的单模态及多模态变体；再基于 class activation maps (CAM) 与 Grad-CAM 构建 XAI 归因，定位与各分类决策最相关的 CpG 位点、基因和染色体区域。
Result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高 92.98%，优于仅用 CNV 训练的模型；DINOv2 在独立验证集上准确率 94.25%（confidence >0.9），泛化最强；XAI 结果与成人型弥漫性胶质瘤亚型的已确立分子特征一致。
Conclusion: 甲基化与 CNV 的多模态融合加位点级归因，可同时提升胶质瘤分子亚型分类精度并给出生物学可解释的决策依据。

papers.title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本到图像 (TTI) 模型会把比喻中的喻体 (vehicle) 当成实体直接画出来，即 Figurative Vehicle Intrusion：内容在文本上被许可，却被赋予错误的视觉角色。为此提出多语言基准 VISTA（按 Figurative Form 与 Mapping Mechanism 组织）与角色感知的诊断指标 V-Score，评测显示该入侵在各语言与各比喻类别上持续存在；轻量缓解方法 VISTA-Guard 可部分降低入侵。
Motivation: 比喻语言暴露了 TTI 的系统性失败：以“视觉在场”为导向的评测会把错误画出的喻体当成忠实，掩盖角色错配问题。
Method: 构建多语言比喻 prompt 基准 VISTA，按 Figurative Form 与 Mapping Mechanism 两个维度组织；提出基于问答 (QA) 的诊断指标 V-Score，评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实度；并给出轻量缓解方法 VISTA-Guard。
Result: 在近期表现较强的 TTI 模型上评测，vehicle intrusion 在不同语言和不同比喻类别中持续存在；VISTA-Guard 作为轻量缓解手段可部分减少 vehicle intrusion。
Conclusion: 视觉在场不等于语义忠实，presence 导向的评测会漏掉角色错配；需要角色感知的指标与缓解手段，VISTA-Guard 只能部分消除该失败。

papers.title: Rethinking Cross-Channel Importance in Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Cross-channel modeling is central to multivariate time-series forecasting, yet channels that are statistically related, predictively useful, and actually used by a trained forecaster are often treated as if they defined the same notion of importance. We show that they need not coincide. Cross-channel dependency structures change substantially across future offsets, and horizon-adaptive source selection improves a controlled Ridge predictor in 21 of 32 dataset--prediction-length conditions, with a mean gain of $5.16\%$. This selected-set signal also transfers to a matched nonlinear predictor. Yet imposing the same horizon-specific source logic on iTransformer yields only 11 of 20 wins and a mean gain of $0.208\%$, with little alignment between controlled and neural gains. Functional interventions further show that strong forecasters use cross-channel information, while their source-reliance rankings agree little with controlled utility or with one another across iTransformer, TimesNet, and a cross-channel TimeMixer. As a constructive consequence, bounded post-hoc support improves a frozen channel-independent forecaster in 12 of 16 dataset--horizon conditions, with a positive aggregate bootstrap interval. Cross-channel importance should therefore be interpreted relative to the forecasting mechanism and question that define it: related $\neq$ useful $\neq$ used.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多变量时间序列预报中，通道间的“统计相关、预测有用、被模型实际使用”三种重要性并不等价，且跨通道依赖结构随预测步长显著变化。按预测步长自适应选源可使受控 Ridge 预报器在 32 个数据集-预测长度条件中的 21 个胜出、平均增益 5.16%，但同一逻辑套到 iTransformer 上仅 11/20 胜、平均增益 0.208%；作者据此主张跨通道重要性必须相对于具体预报机制与问题来解释。
Motivation: 多变量预报常把通道的统计相关性、预测有用性与训练后模型的实际依赖混为同一“重要性”，并默认一套跨通道源选择逻辑可跨模型、跨预测步长通用；本文证明三者不必重合，且依赖结构随 horizon 变化。
Method: 提出随预测步长 (horizon-adaptive) 的跨通道源选择，先在受控 Ridge 预报器上检验，再把同一选择逻辑迁移到匹配的非线性预报器与 iTransformer；用功能性干预 (functional interventions) 比较受控效用与 iTransformer、TimesNet、cross-channel TimeMixer 的源依赖排序，并以有界事后支持 (bounded post-hoc support) 改造冻结的通道无关预报器，配 bootstrap 区间判断聚合增益。
Result: 自适应选源在受控 Ridge 上 32 个数据集-预测长度条件中 21 个胜出，平均增益 5.16%，且该信号可迁移到匹配的非线性预报器；同一逻辑施加到 iTransformer 仅 20 个条件中 11 个胜出、平均增益 0.208%，受控增益与神经增益几乎不对齐。干预实验显示强预报器确实使用跨通道信息，但其源依赖排序与受控效用、以及 iTransformer/TimesNet/cross-channel TimeMixer 彼此之间都高度不一致。有界事后支持在 16 个数据集-时长条件中改善冻结的通道无关预报器 12 个，聚合 bootstrap 区间为正。
Conclusion: 跨通道重要性不是通道的固有属性，而是由所用预报机制与所提问题定义的：相关 ≠ 有用 ≠ 被使用，因此源选择与事后干预都应绑定到具体模型和预测步长。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 病理 VLM 的准确率会把数据集污染、先验知识和图像证据混在一起，作者用 CleanSlide 消污 VQA 基准与 Pair-DPO 偏好损失把三者拆开。在 CleanSlide 上该方法从图像证据获得 15.29% 增益，而最好的已发表模型只有 2.81%；外部 CPTAC、BCNB 队列准确率 57.6% 与 59.0%，分别领先 9.7% 与 3.4%。
Motivation: 病理 VLM 只按准确率评测，无法区分答对是靠图像证据还是靠题目泄漏与先验记忆；淋巴结转移预测的动机实验显示，喂整张切片、标注病灶或完全不给图，多数公开模型表现几乎无差别。
Method: 提出 CleanSlide：基于 TCGA、消除图像侧与题目侧污染的 VQA 基准，含 149K 道经审计的选择题与 9,985 张切片，按患者与组织来源做不相交划分，并逐题审计选项捷径、题干泄漏、跨划分重复与盲解性。再提出 Pair-DPO：在同一问题与来源下对反事实切片对施加偏好损失，用共享混杂因素相消，只留下图像证据作为偏好来源；每对为两张结论相反且经核实的真实切片，覆盖侵袭、坏死、肿瘤分级等弥漫或分级特征。
Result: CleanSlide 含 149K 道审计选择题、9,985 张切片。图像证据增益 15.29%（最佳已发表模型 2.81%）；外部 CPTAC 与 BCNB 队列准确率分别为 57.6% 与 59.0%，比所有其他被评模型高 9.7% 与 3.4%。
Conclusion: 准确率不足以衡量证据使用，需用消污基准与反事实偏好训练把图像证据从污染和先验中分离出来；基准与代码将开源。

papers.title: AI Harness: Certification under Proposal-Conditioned Information for Foundation-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model agents are often modeled as policies over an observed state. In deployed systems, however, a runtime may intervene only after the model has emitted a semantic proposal, making the proposal both an action candidate and a decision-time observation generated by a history-conditioned process. We show that collapsing this structure into a state-only proposal envelope can preserve proposal coverage while destroying certifiability. In a finite robust interface, the viability kernel of the collapsed model is contained in the physical projection of the history-augmented kernel, and the collapse is lossless exactly when every proposal-conditioned collapsed fiber retains a common robust-safe intervention. This gap can be maximal even with constant-size proposal and history alphabets. The same common-action condition yields a dual result: observing the current proposal can restore robust feasibility when it separates latent modes requiring incompatible interventions. We extend these one-step results over time using exact finite beliefs and standard safety and reachability fixed points, separating indefinite operational viability from finite worst-case verified progress. Controlled model-in-the-loop tests reproduce the predicted obstructions when telemetry or effect verification is removed or intervention authority is restricted. Thus, our contribution is not a new fixed-point calculus, but a characterization of when proposal--history correlation at the model--tool boundary is necessary for certification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI Harness 刻画基础模型 agent 在「模型先给出语义 proposal、运行时再介入」这一接口下何时可认证：把 proposal 与历史的相关性压成仅状态的 proposal envelope，可能保住 proposal 覆盖率却摧毁可认证性。塌缩无损当且仅当每个 proposal 条件化的塌缩纤维都保留一个共同的 robust-safe 干预；反之，观测当前 proposal 可在它区分需要不相容干预的潜在模式时恢复 robust 可行性。
Motivation: 部署系统中运行时只能在模型发出 proposal 之后介入，而现有建模把 agent 当作状态上的策略，丢掉了 proposal 作为历史条件化观测这一结构，导致认证结论可能失真。
Method: 在有限 robust interface 中比较塌缩模型与历史增广模型的 viability kernel：证明前者包含于后者的物理投影，并给出塌缩无损的共同干预 (common robust-safe intervention) 判据；再用精确有限信念与标准安全/可达不动点把单步结论推广到时间维，区分无限期运行可行性与有限最坏情形已验证进展。
Result: 塌缩模型的 viability kernel 被历史增广 kernel 的物理投影包含，塌缩无损当且仅当每个 proposal 条件化纤维保留共同 robust-safe 干预；该差距在 proposal 与历史字母表均为常数大小时仍可达到最大。共同动作条件给出对偶结论：proposal 能分离需要不相容干预的潜在模式时，观测它可恢复 robust 可行性。受控 model-in-the-loop 测试在移除遥测或效果验证、或限制干预权限时复现了预测的障碍。
Conclusion: 贡献不是新的不动点演算，而是刻画 model–tool 边界上 proposal–历史相关性对认证何时是必要的：塌缩掉这层相关性可能在保覆盖的同时让认证失效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对高分辨率多物种植物图像的稠密科学分析受像素级标注昂贵与现有基础模型域差限制，提出以 ViT 为骨干的 masked autoencoder，在分布式训练下用超过 1000 万张多视角植物图像块做 in-domain 自监督预训练。在有限标注、跨视角变化与分辨率退化条件下，该 in-domain FM 取得 Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，比在大规模自然图像上预训练的 MAE 对应模型分别高 0.0694 与 0.0613；扩大 in-domain 预训练规模带来稠密特征迁移的一致改善。
Motivation: 高分辨率植物成像的像素级标注成本高、图像像素维度大、成像条件差异显著，而现有基础模型在稠密特征表示与迁移上存在域差 (domain gap)，限制了精细稠密预测。
Method: 以 ViT 为骨干的 masked autoencoder，在分布式训练下于超过 1000 万张多视角植物图像块上做 in-domain 自监督预训练；随后在精细稠密预测与粗粒度全局特征识别两类任务上系统评测表征，重点考察有限标注与真实下游成像条件，并测试跨视角变化与分辨率退化。
Result: in-domain FM 取得 Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，相对在大规模自然图像上预训练的 MAE 对应模型分别高出 0.0694 与 0.0613；实验还显示提高预训练规模带来稠密特征迁移的一致改善，评测覆盖有限标注、跨视角变化与分辨率退化设置。

papers.title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KeyRec 用有界视觉记忆替代稠密视觉 token：近期帧存入 visual cache，历史证据按新颖度组织成 event bank 并做在线 add-merge-evict，问题到来时由纯文本 router 在两块记忆间分配固定读出预算。在 4 个流式/长视频基准、3 个 VLM backbone 的 15 个设置中，仅用稠密 decoder-facing 视觉 token 预算的 10% 就在 13 个设置取得最佳压缩性能，实时问题上比最强压缩基线高 2.21–18.37 分。
Motivation: 视觉 token 随视频时长线性累积，使长上下文推理代价过高；现有免训练选 token 方法会丢掉连贯事件证据，也分不清近期细粒度观测与远期历史。
Method: 免训练框架 KeyRec：query-agnostic 写入阶段把近期观测存入 visual cache，历史证据按相对已存事件的新颖度提议候选事件并经在线 add-merge-evict 维护成 event bank；问题到达时用纯文本 router 在近期与事件记忆间分配固定读出预算，不重处理历史帧。作用于模型侧视觉 embedding，兼容模块化 encoder-projector VLM 与无 encoder/projector 的 NEO-ov 架构。
Result: 在 4 个流式与长视频基准、3 个 VLM backbone 的 15 个设置中，用稠密 decoder-facing 视觉 token 预算的 10% 取得 13 个设置的最佳压缩性能；实时问题上比最强压缩基线高 2.21–18.37 分；6 个长视频设置中 5 个取得最佳压缩结果；NEO-ov 2B 的全部设置均最优。
Conclusion: 把近期观测与历史事件分开存储、按问题动态分配读出预算，可以在只保留 10% 视觉 token 的条件下维持流式与长视频理解性能，且对有无 encoder-projector 的 VLM 都适用。

papers.title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双耳视听实例分割新任务 BiAVIS，用双耳音频中的耳间差异与头部/耳廓方向滤波做物理可依据的声源定位，把空间先验注入实例分割解码器，从而区分同语义类的相似实例。在自建的两个基准上，BiAVIS 模型在更具挑战的 BiAVIS-Bench 上比最佳单耳基线 mAP 高 17.22%、FSLA 高 7.71%。
Motivation: 现有视听分割 (AVS) 基本都是单耳设定，且依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类下视觉相似的不同实例。
Method: 定义 BiAVIS 任务并建立两个基准：人工标注已有双耳视听数据集，另采集更复杂真实场景的新数据集 BiAVIS-Bench。模型先用 audio-only 声源定位网络从双耳音频学空间与语义先验，再以 query 级视听融合策略把这些先验注入实例分割解码器。
Result: 在两个自建基准上，BiAVIS 模型整体优于既有单耳 AVS 方法，尤其在解决实例级类内歧义上；在更难的 BiAVIS-Bench 上，比最佳单耳基线 mAP 提升 17.22%、FSLA 提升 7.71%。
Conclusion: 双耳空间线索加 query 级融合能补上单耳 AVS 的类内实例歧义短板，新任务与两个基准为该方向提供了评测载体。

papers.title: Analytic-Walk Rotary Positional Encodings for Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Rotary position encodings make attention sensitive to relative position, but extending them to graphs requires choosing how graph structure enters the rotation. Previous works assign each node a rotation from spectral coordinates, so the rotary factor between two nodes depends only on their endpoints and cannot distinguish the routes connecting them. We introduce \textit{Analytic-Walk Rotary Positional Encodings} (AW-RoPE), which place the rotations on edges and sum the transported features over all walks, so contributions along different routes can reinforce or cancel. An exact variant evaluates the complete sum by a differentiable linear solve, and a sparse variant truncates it at a finite depth. We prove forward and parameter-derivative truncation bounds at fixed inputs and parameters. Both variants act on projected queries and keys, and the sparse recurrence also augments message-passing networks. Across five synthetic tasks both variants reduce nRMSE by $15$--$58\%$ relative to the strongest baseline, and on real superpixel, peptide and OGB benchmarks the sparse recurrence attains the best mean on every dataset with Performer kernels and on twelve of thirteen datasets with GIN. Analysis shows that AW-RoPE can distinguish routes whose only cue is how two endpoints are connected, while node-wise rotary encodings cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AW-RoPE 把旋转放到边上并对所有 walk 求和，使注意力能区分连接同一对端点的不同路径，而谱坐标式的逐节点 rotary 只看端点。精确变体用可微线性求解算完整和，稀疏变体在有限深度截断并可增强消息传递网络；五个合成任务上 nRMSE 相对最强基线降低 15–58%。
Motivation: 既有图上 rotary 位置编码把旋转赋给节点，旋转因子只依赖两端点，无法区分连接它们的不同路径，图结构信息因此丢失。
Method: AW-RoPE 将旋转置于边上，对沿所有 walk 传输的特征求和，使不同路径的贡献可相互增强或抵消；精确变体通过可微线性求解计算完整和，稀疏变体在有限深度截断，并在固定输入与参数下证明前向与参数导数的截断界。两个变体都作用于投影后的 query 与 key，稀疏递推还可增强消息传递网络。
Result: 在五个合成任务上，两个变体相对最强基线均将 nRMSE 降低 15–58%；在真实 superpixel、peptide 与 OGB 基准上，稀疏递推在使用 Performer kernel 时于每个数据集取得最佳均值，在使用 GIN 时于 13 个数据集中的 12 个取得最佳均值。分析显示 AW-RoPE 能区分唯一线索仅为端点连接方式的路径，而逐节点 rotary 编码不能。
Conclusion: 把 rotary 位置编码从节点移到边上并沿 walk 求和，是让注意力携带路径级图结构信息的可行设计，且在合成与真实图基准上均带来一致增益。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向无线边缘的联邦 3D Gaussian Splatting 训练框架，在通信、算力与 GPU 显存受限下用重要性-延迟比准则自适应剪枝 Gaussian 点，并在不访问私有相机参数的前提下恢复各本地模型的结构一致性以完成聚合。实验显示该方法相对 SOTA 联邦 3D-GS 基线显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量并降低训练延迟。
Motivation: 大场景 3D-GS 训练搬到无线边缘会撞上设备端通信、计算与 GPU 显存受限，各本地模型结构不一致导致无法有效聚合，原始图像与相机参数还有隐私泄露风险。
Method: 框架含两个核心机制：一是端上模型轻量化，逐设备量化每个 Gaussian 点的重要性，按重要性-延迟比 (importance-to-latency ratio) 在显存与计算/通信时延约束下决定剪枝数量，权衡渲染质量与训练效率；二是 3D-GS 模型恢复机制，在不接触私有相机参数的情况下恢复本地模型间的结构一致性，从而聚合出全局模型。
Result: 大量实验表明，相比 SOTA 联邦 3D-GS 基线，该方法显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量并降低训练延迟；论文共 16 页、10 图、6 表。
Conclusion: 在资源受限的无线边缘，把逐点剪枝与结构一致性恢复结合，可以在保护相机参数隐私的同时有效训练大规模 3D-GS 模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Support Recovery of Mixtures of Sparse Linear Classifiers with Less Measurements
papers.abstract_en: The support recovery problem in mixture of linear classifiers intends to identify which features actually matter when data is generated by a mixture of several linear decision rules. In particular, the aim is to recover the support (nonzero coordinates) of $l$ unknown $k$-sparse vectors from sign measurements. Each measurement is generated by selecting one of the $l$ vectors uniformly at random, and returning the sign of its inner product with a chosen measurement vector. In this paper, we propose adaptive and non-adaptive schemes that significantly improve upon prior results by reducing the number of measurements and achieving sublinear decoding time simultaneously. In particular, our adaptive constructions substantially reduce measurements compared to existing approaches, while also lowering decoding complexity from super-quadratic to sublinear in the ambient dimension. We further provide a non-adaptive scheme that improves previous measurement bounds while maintaining efficient decoding. Overall, our approach yields a more efficient trade-off between sample complexity and decoding time for support recovery in mixture models than previously known methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性分类器混合模型的支撑恢复问题上，提出自适应与非自适应测量方案，从 k-稀疏向量的符号测量中恢复非零坐标，同时把测量数降到更低、解码时间从环境维度的超二次降到次线性。
Motivation: 数据由多条线性决策规则混合生成时，要从符号测量中识别哪些特征真正起作用；已有方法测量数多且解码复杂度随环境维度超二次增长。
Method: 针对每次测量随机选取 l 个 k-稀疏向量之一并返回其与测量向量内积符号的模型，给出自适应与非自适应两套测量方案，自适应构造减少测量数并把解码复杂度从超二次降到次线性，非自适应方案在保持高效解码的同时改进测量数界。
Result: 自适应构造相比已有方法显著减少测量数，并把解码复杂度从环境维度的超二次降为次线性；非自适应方案在维持高效解码的前提下改进了先前的测量数界，整体给出样本复杂度与解码时间之间更优的权衡。
Conclusion: 混合稀疏线性分类器的支撑恢复可以在更少测量下用次线性时间解码，样本复杂度与解码时间的权衡优于已知方法。
