papers.title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OneFixer 用单阶段任务适配训练一步自回归视频扩散修复器，让模型自己的一步预测直接充当 flow matching 的因果上下文，并在同一 rollout 上加像素空间感知监督。在 Waymo 与专有驾驶场景 900 帧 rollout 上，一步生成取得全部基线中最低的 FVD、LPIPS 与 DISTS，时间一致性持平或多阶段 DMD；闭环驾驶中碰撞率相对原始 3DGS 渲染降低三分之一。
Motivation: 驾驶仿真要求 3DGS 渲染修复既高质量又时间一致且低延迟，但一步因果生成中每个不完美预测都会成为后续帧的上下文，现有分阶段多模块训练加 rollout 正则仍达不到部署质量。
Method: 单阶段任务适配训练：deployment-matched shared rollout 让模型自己的一步预测作为 flow matching 的因果上下文，同一 rollout 接受像素空间感知监督；不使用双向到因果转换或 teacher-student 蒸馏，并额外输入车道几何与动态目标状态提升几何保真。
Result: 在 Waymo 与专有驾驶场景 900 帧 rollout 上，一步生成的 FVD、LPIPS、DISTS 在所有基线中最低，时间一致性持平或超过多阶段 DMD 管线；在相同 backbone 与条件下，以不到一半 GPU-hours 匹配多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing 管线并越过其平台期；闭环仿真中碰撞率相对原始 3DGS 渲染降低三分之一。
Conclusion: 把部署时的自回归误差直接放进训练上下文并同时监督当前帧质量，可以在一步生成下联合获得保真度与自回归鲁棒性，且训练成本低于多阶段管线。

papers.title: Noisy Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various code-related tasks. However, unlike carefully curated datasets that are typically high-quality and error-free, real-world user instructions are often vague and error-prone, posing significant challenges to the robustness of code LLMs. Furthermore, robustness-oriented fine-tuning relies on paired clean-noisy samples, which are costly to curate and require sophisticated noisy simulation techniques. To address these challenges, we propose the Noisy Test-time Reinforcement Learning framework (NTRL-Code), which enables robust self-evolution of code LLMs using only unlabeled noisy data during the testing stage. Specifically, NTRL-Code uses conservative self-denoising to obtain a cleaner semantic anchor for target estimation, and employs an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-based structural aggregation mechanism to estimate a proxy target from multiple candidate programs. The policy is then optimized on the original noisy prompts with a hybrid reward that combines format validity, code similarity, and anti-repetition signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, each incorporating character-level, word-level, and paragraph-level perturbations, demonstrate that NTRL-Code yields robust and consistent improvements, stabilizing the predictions of various base models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xikai97/NTRL-Code.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NTRL-Code：代码 LLM 在测试阶段仅用无标签的含噪用户指令做自进化，无需配对的干净-噪声样本。保守自去噪给出更干净的语义锚点，AST 结构聚合从多个候选程序估计代理目标，再用格式有效性、代码相似度与反重复的混合奖励在原始噪声提示上优化策略，在三个基准的字符/词/段落级扰动下对多种基座模型都给出稳定一致的提升。
Motivation: 真实用户指令含糊且易错，而面向鲁棒性的微调依赖人工整理的干净-噪声配对样本，成本高且需要精细的噪声模拟技术。
Method: NTRL-Code 在测试阶段用无标签噪声数据做强化学习：保守自去噪 (conservative self-denoising) 产生更干净的语义锚点以估计目标，AST-based structural aggregation 从多个候选程序聚合出代理目标，随后在原始噪声 prompt 上以混合奖励（格式有效性 + 代码相似度 + 反重复信号）优化策略。
Result: 在三个基准上、每个基准含字符级、词级与段落级扰动的设置下，NTRL-Code 取得稳健且一致的改进，并稳定了多种基座模型的预测；代码已开源至 github.com/Xikai97/NTRL-Code。
Conclusion: 代码 LLM 的鲁棒性可以在测试时只靠无标签噪声数据自进化得到，不必依赖昂贵的配对干净-噪声微调数据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Selection of Online Algorithms with Simulator Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: The performance of online reinforcement learning depends critically on design choices, especially those that affect exploration. These choices are often selected by fitting a simulator to offline data, evaluating candidate algorithms in that simulator, and deploying the best-performing one. The simplest Plug-In selection rule simply selects the best performing algorithm on the fitted simulator, making evaluations unreliable when the offline data used to fit the simulator are limited. We investigate Uncertainty-Aware selection, which forms an ensemble of simulators---for example, obtained by bootstrap resampling---and selects the online algorithm with the best average performance across the ensemble. While ensemble-based approaches have been used to mitigate distribution shift and facilitate sim-to-real transfer, we formally show that this approach can mitigate the effects of limited data when fitting the simulator and theoretically has significant regret gains compared to Plug-In selection in multi-armed bandits. We also empirically investigate the Uncertainty-Aware selection approach in deep RL experiments on robotic control tasks that involve selecting reward-shaping hyperparameters, and show that it leads to more reliable selection and improved online performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线强化学习选超参时，用 bootstrap 重采样拟合多个模拟器构成 ensemble，按候选算法在 ensemble 上的平均表现做 Uncertainty-Aware 选择，替代只看单一拟合模拟器的 Plug-In 规则。理论上在 multi-armed bandit 中相对 Plug-In 有显著 regret 收益，机器人控制 reward-shaping 实验中选择更可靠、在线性能更好。
Motivation: 用离线数据拟合模拟器再选算法时，数据有限会让 Plug-In 选择的评估不可靠，选出的在线算法设计（尤其探索相关超参）随之失准。
Method: 对拟合模拟器的离线数据做 bootstrap 重采样得到 simulator ensemble，按候选算法在 ensemble 上的平均表现选择；在 multi-armed bandit 中做理论分析，并在深度 RL 机器人控制任务上选择 reward-shaping 超参做实证检验。
Result: 理论上证明 ensemble 选择可缓解拟合模拟器的数据有限问题，并相对 Plug-In 在 multi-armed bandit 中获得显著 regret 收益；深度 RL 机器人控制实验中该选择带来更可靠的选择与更好的在线性能。
Conclusion: 把模拟器拟合的不确定性显式纳入选择环节，能在离线数据有限时比 Plug-In 规则给出更可靠的在线算法选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification of Next Generation Reservoir Computing with Applications to Memory-Driven Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear dynamical systems with memory arise across science and engineering, yet uncertainty quantification for efficient forecasting methods such as Next Generation Reservoir Computing (NGRC) remains underdeveloped. We study Bayesian ridge and conformal prediction intervals for NGRC and characterize when their uncertainty estimates agree or differ. In low dimensions, their asymptotic widths are governed by different summaries of the residual distribution, so agreement depends on residual shape rather than dimensionality alone. In high dimensions, regularization introduces a further tradeoff between estimation variance, shrinkage bias, and posterior uncertainty, leading to an explicit transition between regimes where Bayesian intervals are wider or narrower than conformal intervals. We extend these results to quadratic NGRC feature maps and give sufficient conditions for transferring the analysis to temporally dependent forecast windows. Simulations and real-data experiments support the theoretical predictions and illustrate how residual distribution, regularization, dimensionality, and distribution shift affect interval calibration and efficiency. These results provide a principled framework for choosing and interpreting uncertainty quantification methods in reservoir-based forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Next Generation Reservoir Computing (NGRC) 的两类不确定性量化——Bayesian ridge 预测区间与 conformal prediction 区间——给出何时一致、何时分叉的理论刻画：低维下两者渐近宽度由残差分布的不同摘要决定，高维下正则化引入估计方差、收缩偏差与后验不确定性的权衡，出现 Bayesian 区间更宽或更窄的显式转变。结论是区间选型取决于残差形状、正则化与维度，而非维度本身。
Motivation: 带记忆的非线性动力系统常用 NGRC 做高效预报，但其不确定性量化方法学尚不成熟，缺少判断 Bayesian 与 conformal 区间何时可互换的准则。
Method: 研究 Bayesian ridge 与 conformal prediction 两类区间在 NGRC 上的表现，刻画低维与高维下的渐近宽度；把结果推广到 quadratic NGRC feature map，并给出把分析转移到时间依赖预报窗口的充分条件，再用模拟与真实数据实验检验理论预测。
Result: 低维下两区间渐近宽度由残差分布的不同摘要决定，一致性取决于残差形状而非仅维度；高维下正则化导致估计方差、收缩偏差与后验不确定性的权衡，Bayesian 区间相对 conformal 更宽或更窄存在显式转变；模拟与真实数据实验支持理论预测，并展示残差分布、正则化、维度与分布偏移如何影响区间校准与效率。
Conclusion: NGRC 的区间选型应由残差形状、正则化强度、维度与分布偏移共同决定，作者据此给出选择与解释 reservoir-based forecasting 不确定性量化方法的原则性框架。

papers.title: CAFE: Counterfactual Prediction via Fast Posterior Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual prediction estimates an individual's outcome under an alternative intervention given their factual observations. Such outcomes are generally not identifiable from observational data without additional assumptions. Even within the class of fully observed additive noise models (ANMs), different causal graphs can generate the same observational distribution yet imply different individual counterfactual outcomes. Predictions based on a single estimated graph ignore this structural uncertainty. We therefore target a Bayesian counterfactual posterior predictive distribution that combines predictions from plausible SCMs. We introduce CAFE (\textbf{C}ounterf\textbf{A}ctual Prediction via \textbf{F}ast Posterior \textbf{E}stimation), an amortized inference framework that directly approximates the Bayesian counterfactual posterior predictive distribution. We pretrain a transformer-based model on synthetic counterfactual tasks generated from a diverse prior over ANMs. Given an observational dataset, an individual's factual observations, and an intervention, CAFE approximates the corresponding posterior predictive distribution in a single forward pass. Experiments show that CAFE accurately predicts individual counterfactual outcomes in identifiable settings and approximates the posterior predictive distribution when structural uncertainty induced by observationally indistinguishable causal graphs exists. Strong performance in realistic manufacturing and viticulture settings further demonstrates its empirical robustness beyond the assumptions of the training prior.

papers.title: PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Running GUI agents on edge devices can keep sensitive screens and interaction histories local, but the computational cost of inference at every action step makes deployment challenging. Existing GUI agent systems either perform full vision-language model (VLM) inference at each action step or reuse coarse-grained knowledge matched to prior tasks. However, dynamic mobile environments and user tasks make it difficult to fully utilize prior task executions without additional fine-tuning or task-specific offline exploration. To address this challenge, we present PastForward, a system that accelerates GUI agents through validated, fine-grained reuse of computational experience accumulated during ordinary task execution. During decoding, PastForward retrieves prior output sequences as device-adaptive multi-token proposals and verifies them in a single VLM forward pass. Across action steps, it uses prior GUI transitions to begin next-step inference while the device executes the current action, retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward. We evaluate PastForward on AndroidWorld workloads derived from real mobile usage patterns using multiple VLM backbones across server and edge platforms. On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PastForward 在端侧 GUI agent 中复用历史计算经验：解码时把先前输出序列作为 device-adaptive 多 token 提案并用一次 VLM forward 验证，跨步用先前 GUI transition 提前启动下一步推理，仅当预测屏幕与实际屏幕一致时保留早期计算并携带可复用 KV state。在 AndroidWorld 工作负载、多 VLM backbone 与服务器/端侧平台上，端侧 action-step 延迟加速 1.63–2.36×，任务成功率保持不变。
Motivation: 端侧 GUI agent 每个动作步都要跑完整 VLM 推理，计算成本使部署困难；现有系统要么每步全量推理，要么复用与先前任务粗粒度匹配的知识，难以在不微调、不做任务特定离线探索的前提下利用历史任务执行。
Method: 解码阶段检索先前输出序列作为 device-adaptive 多 token 提案，用单次 VLM forward pass 验证；跨动作步用先前 GUI transition 在设备执行当前动作时提前开始下一步推理，仅当预测屏幕与观测屏幕匹配才保留早期计算，并携带可复用的 KV state 前传。
Result: 在源自真实移动使用模式的 AndroidWorld 工作负载上，跨多个 VLM backbone 与服务器/端侧平台评估：端侧 action-step 延迟加速 1.63–2.36×，同时保持任务成功率。
Conclusion: 经过验证的细粒度计算经验复用可以在不牺牲任务成功率的前提下显著降低端侧 GUI agent 的每步延迟，无需额外微调或任务特定离线探索。

papers.title: FOCUS: Fixed-Confidence Online Causal Learning Using Sequential Adaptive Interventions
papers.abstract_en: We study fully online fixed-confidence causal discovery without any historical observational data. Starting from zero samples, the learner sequentially selects interventions to recover both the causal DAG and its edge weights under a linear-Gaussian structural equation model. We establish an instance-dependent lower bound for any $(ε,δ)$-correct algorithm and propose \textsc{FOCUS}, which adaptively allocates interventions through an online max--min game. A key contribution is a computable concentration inequality for the accumulated KL divergence involving causal parameters shared across interventions. We prove that \textsc{FOCUS} is $(ε,δ)$-correct and that its expected stopping time matches the lower bound in its $Θ(\log(1/δ))$ dependence up to an instance-dependent constant. Experiments demonstrate improved structure and edge-weight recovery and confirm the predicted stopping-time trend. Our codes are available on https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FOCUS_code-76E5
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FOCUS 在线因果发现：从零样本出发，在线性高斯结构方程模型 (linear-Gaussian SEM) 下通过序贯自适应干预同时恢复因果 DAG 与其边权，干预分配由在线 max–min 博弈决定。证明其 (ε,δ)-correct 且期望停止时间在 Θ(log(1/δ)) 依赖上与实例相关下界匹配（差一实例相关常数），实验显示结构与边权恢复改善并验证了停止时间趋势。
Motivation: 无历史观测数据的全在线场景下，如何为 (ε,δ)-correct 因果发现算法分配干预以最小化停止时间缺少理论依据；已有工作未给出含跨干预共享因果参数的累积 KL 散度界。
Method: 在 linear-Gaussian SEM 中从零样本序贯选择干预，用在线 max–min 博弈自适应分配干预以同时恢复 DAG 与边权；核心工具是针对跨干预共享因果参数的累积 KL 散度可计算集中不等式，并据此给出实例相关 (ε,δ) 下界与 FOCUS 的正确性证明。
Result: 建立任意 (ε,δ)-correct 算法的实例相关下界；证明 FOCUS 为 (ε,δ)-correct，期望停止时间在 Θ(log(1/δ)) 依赖上与下界匹配至实例相关常数；实验显示结构与边权恢复均有改善，并验证了预测的停止时间趋势。
Conclusion: 以在线 max–min 干预分配加共享参数的 KL 集中界，可在无观测数据的在线因果发现中把停止时间做到与实例相关下界同阶。

papers.title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PQR3D 把多视图 3D 检测的时序建模从跨帧持久 query 记忆改为参考帧条件化时间窗口内的渐进 query 精修，从而支持随机帧采样与无状态独立推理。窗口内把早期时间戳上运动对齐的高置信 query 逐步转移到目标帧，配合掩码自注意力与阶段解耦 anchor embedding；ViT-L 主干下 nuScenes 测试集达到 71.6 NDS、64.9 mAP，创 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有流式检测器要在帧间传递 query 状态，被迫做序列化训练和按时间顺序推理，无法随机采样帧或独立推理单帧。
Method: 在参考条件化时间窗口内做渐进 query 精修：把早期时间戳上运动对齐的高置信 query 逐步转移到目标帧；用掩码自注意力 (masked self-attention) 调节 regular、propagated、denoising 三类 query 的交互，并把 denoising 监督与检测 query 隔离；阶段解耦 anchor embedding 在自注意力前注入位置、之后注入尺寸/朝向/速度，减少时序不一致属性的干扰；主干为 ViT-L。
Result: 在 nuScenes 测试集上取得 71.6 NDS 与 64.9 mAP，摘要称其为新的 state of the art；该设计使随机帧采样与不依赖持久 query 记忆的独立推理成为可能。
Conclusion: 时序上下文不必靠跨帧持久 query 状态承载，在窗口内做参考帧条件化的渐进精修即可同时保住检测精度与训练/推理的帧独立性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PruneForget 把机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 与模型剪枝 (pruning) 联合求解：用待遗忘样本集作为剪枝引导，因为编码这些样本的参数本身就是天然剪枝目标。在图像分类器与生成模型上，该方法既移除了被遗忘样本的影响，又得到更紧凑、推理成本更低的模型，相对「先从头重训再剪枝」的 oracle 性能差距可忽略。
Motivation: 现实中模型既要响应安全相关的遗忘请求，又要满足延迟与内存预算，但已有工作把两者当作独立问题、顺序执行，导致遗忘与剪枝互不知情。
Method: 提出 PruneForget，用 unlearn set 作为剪枝的引导信号，使遗忘与剪枝互相受益；在图像分类器与生成模型上做实验，并以「先为遗忘从头重训、再剪枝」的 oracle 作为对照。
Result: 在图像分类器与生成模型上的实验中，PruneForget 移除了被遗忘样本的影响，同时产出更紧凑、推理成本更低的模型；相对先重训后剪枝的 oracle，性能差距可忽略 (negligible)。
Conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝在参数层面天然对齐，应联合求解而非顺序执行：被遗忘样本占用的参数可直接当作剪枝对象，一次操作同时满足遗忘与压缩目标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 tables. Corpus: 28 arXiv papers (19-24 September 2026); arXiv versions listed in Appendix A. Ancillary file: per-paper corpus sheet (versions and headline results)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 TypeSafe 于 2026-09-15 发布的 typed decision model（TDM，如 Jev）做早期证据审计：综述发布后 19–24 日的 28 篇 arXiv 论文，结论是 typed readout 本身相对可比的 label-probability readout 尚无独立精度优势，Jev 的明确收益在延迟与成本，难题上精度差距仍在，并据此给出 14 项评估清单。
Motivation: Jev 发布数天内涌现一批评测与复现工作，但证据只覆盖单一托管模型发布后的头九天，缺少统一的评估口径来判断 TDM 是否真有精度收益。
Method: 以 28 篇 2026 年 9 月 19–24 日的 arXiv 论文为语料，关联既有 label-probability 分类、constrained decoding、reranking、calibration 与 model cascades 文献，从这些研究的反复弱点中提炼 14 项评估清单；附录 A 列出各论文版本并配 per-paper corpus sheet。
Result: 综述 28 篇论文（19–24 September 2026，25 页、8 张表）；早期文献中 typed readout 相对可比 label-probability readout 未显示独立精度优势，Jev 最明确的收益是延迟与成本，难题上精度差距仍存在；证据仅覆盖单一托管模型发布后的头九天。
Conclusion: TDM 应按早期证据地图而非既定结论来读：现阶段其价值主张落在延迟与成本而非精度，且置信度用于向更强模型或人工 defer 的部署需按 14 项清单评估。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalDriveBench 用 Pearl 因果层级 (PCH) 四层结构在 nuScenes 上评测自动驾驶 VLA 的因果推理，含 7,285 条已验证因果 QA 与 1,000 条反事实轨迹。最佳模型 QA 准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中 4 个低于随机水平；因果 QA 与轨迹准确率统计不相关，反事实提示下轨迹要么过度反应要么塌回观测场景基线。
Motivation: 驾驶 VLA 会输出自然语言推理，但这些理由是否对应场景的因果结构从未被检验；现有评测无法区分感知显著性与因果相关性。
Method: 在 nuScenes 上构建区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体的因果场景图，按 PCH 四层（关联、干预、反事实加因果发现）生成结构化视觉 QA，并为高层提供指定场景修改下的参考轨迹以做动作级验证；评测 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM。
Result: 基准含 7,285 条已验证因果 QA 与 1,000 条反事实轨迹；最佳模型 QA 准确率 70.6%，13 个模型中 4 个低于随机水平；驾驶 VLA 相对共享语言骨干的通用 VLM，驾驶微调在因果 QA 上代价为 2 至 34 个百分点，跨度由后训练设计解释；因果 QA 与轨迹准确率跨模型统计不相关，反事实提示下轨迹过度反应或塌回观测场景基线。
Conclusion: 流畅的理由与准确的观测场景轨迹都不构成因果理解的证据，驾驶微调的后训练设计决定因果 QA 的代价大小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AquaBEV-Nav: Learned BEV Occupancy for Underwater Navigation and Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Safe underwater exploration requires a robot to understand where surrounding structures are located and which regions are available for motion. Existing vision-based underwater exploration systems commonly obtain this information indirectly by estimating monocular depth, unprojecting the geometry into 3D space, and accumulating it into a 2D bird's-eye-view occupancy map. This reliance on intermediate depth estimation is particularly problematic underwater, where scattering and wavelength-dependent attenuation degrade visual cues and limit the reliability of monocular depth estimates. We introduce AquaBEV-Nav, an underwater exploration framework that bypasses explicit monocular depth estimation through direct bird's-eye-view occupancy prediction. Built upon the CORAL hierarchical exploration framework, AquaBEV-Nav replaces its depth-based perception front end with AquaBEV. Given a single RGB frame, AquaBEV maps visual features into a learned polar representation, performs causal reasoning along the range dimension, and reconstructs local Cartesian occupancy without relying on intermediate depth prediction. The resulting occupancy map is accumulated into CORAL's persistent spatial memory, providing spatial context for VLM-based high-level planning and collision constraints for dynamics-aware local trajectory generation. Across ten simulated reef environments and six occupancy backbones evaluated under a single protocol, AquaBEV-Nav reaches 37.48 structure IoU and 53.2 target IoU, 88.95% closed-loop coverage with zero collisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AquaBEV-Nav 抛开单目深度估计，直接从单帧 RGB 预测 BEV 占据图用于水下机器人探索：视觉特征映射到学习的极坐标表示、沿距离维做因果推理，再重建局部 Cartesian 占据并累积进 CORAL 的持久空间记忆。在 10 个模拟珊瑚礁环境、6 种占据骨干的统一协议下，结构 IoU 37.48、目标 IoU 53.2，闭环覆盖 88.95% 且零碰撞。
Motivation: 水下散射与波长相关衰减使单目深度不可靠，而现有视觉探索系统靠深度反投影再累积成 BEV 占据图，中间深度误差直接污染占据与后续规划。
Method: 基于 CORAL 层级探索框架，用 AquaBEV 替换其深度感知前端：单帧 RGB 经视觉编码映射到学习的极坐标表示，沿 range 维做因果推理后重建局部 Cartesian 占据，不经过显式深度；占据图累积进 CORAL 持久空间记忆，供 VLM 高层规划与动力学感知轨迹生成的碰撞约束使用。
Result: 在 10 个模拟珊瑚礁环境、6 个占据骨干的单一评估协议下：结构 IoU 37.48，目标 IoU 53.2，闭环覆盖率 88.95%，碰撞数为 0。
Conclusion: 水下探索可以绕过显式单目深度，直接学 BEV 占据即可支撑高层规划与避碰轨迹生成，并在模拟礁石环境中做到高覆盖且零碰撞。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Unified Optimism-Agnostic Framework for Linear Bandits over Spherical Action Sets
papers.abstract_en: Linear bandits model sequential decision-making problems with noisy rewards that are linear in the decision variable, where an agent must simultaneously learn about an unknown parameter that governs the mean rewards, while maximizing (expected) rewards over time. Two prominent algorithmic families--upper confidence bound (UCB) and Thompson sampling (TS)--achieve a balance of exploration (to estimate said parameter) and exploitation (utilization of knowledge about it) across time. The quality of estimation of that parameter depends on the eigenvalues of a design matrix. In this paper, we begin by showing that if the inference quality obtained from exploration, encoded in the minimum eigenvalue of the design matrix, grows $\gtrsim \sqrt{t}$ with time $t$, while actions remain sufficiently concentrated for exploitation, then an algorithm produces optimal high-probability $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T}\log T)$-regret rate over a time-horizon $T$ for spherical action sets. This analysis is algorithm-agnostic and follows an alternative route to the classical optimism-based elliptical-potential argument for regret analysis. Then, we illustrate that variants of UCB and TS satisfy the inference and concentration properties and in turn, enjoy optimal regret rate. In effect, our results provide a modular framework that can be used to analyze linear bandit algorithms and explicitly connect quality of parameter estimation to optimal regret accumulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性 bandit 的球形动作集上，给出一个与乐观性 (optimism) 无关的统一后悔分析框架：只要探索得到的推断质量（设计矩阵最小特征值）随时间以 ≳√t 增长、且动作对利用足够集中，算法即可在时间跨度 T 上取得最优高概率 O(√T·log T) 后悔率。UCB 与 TS 的变体满足这两个性质，因而同样达到该最优速率。
Motivation: 经典线性 bandit 后悔分析依赖基于乐观性的椭圆势能 (elliptical-potential) 论证，把参数估计质量与后悔积累之间的关系埋在证明里，缺少一个可模块化复用、直接刻画估计质量如何决定后悔的分析工具。
Method: 以设计矩阵最小特征值刻画探索的推断质量，以动作的时间集中程度刻画利用，二者作为可检验的前置条件；沿非乐观性的替代路线推导高概率后悔界，再验证 UCB 与 TS 的变体满足这两个条件。
Result: 在球形动作集上，若最小特征值增长 ≳√t 且动作保持足够集中，则得到最优高概率 O(√T·log T) 后悔率；该分析对算法本身无关，UCB 与 TS 变体均被证明满足条件并享有该速率。
Conclusion: 参数估计质量可以直接、模块化地决定线性 bandit 的最优后悔积累，无需经由乐观性论证；该框架可用于分析其他线性 bandit 算法。

papers.title: Playing to Par: Reinforcement Learning for Provably Optimal Quadrilateral Block Decompositions
papers.abstract_en: A quadrilateral block decomposition of a planar domain is judged by whether it is complete, whether its elements are well shaped, and how many of its vertices are irregular. The last has a provable floor: the discrete Gauss-Bonnet identity enforces a lower bound on the total vertex irregularity of any all-quadrilateral mesh of a given domain purely based on its topology and corner angles. We train a reinforcement learning agent to build decompositions that reach this bound, which we call par. It acts directly on the mesh's half-edge data structure through local edits, with a policy network whose convolutions follow the mesh's own connectivity, so it applies unchanged to domains larger than any seen in training. The reward targets the floor directly, and it is sparse: random play reaches it on no domain with more than eight sides. We overcome this exploration barrier via behaviour cloning on optimal meshes that are trivial to construct, walked backward into demonstrations, before training it with PPO. On 96 held-out domains the agent produces an all-quadrilateral mesh on every one, a usable one on 95.7 on average, and a provably optimal one on 90; Gmsh's strongest configuration at the same element count completes 51, is usable on 38 and optimal on none, and even at three to fourteen times the elements never produces a more regular mesh. On 64 domains twice the training size the agent completes all, is usable on 62, and keeps a median excess over par below one against Gmsh's 39 at the same element count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习直接在四边形网格的 half-edge 数据结构上做局部编辑，以离散 Gauss-Bonnet 给出的顶点不规则度下界（par）为稀疏奖励，训练出在任意域上都能达到该下界的全四边形分解策略。在 96 个留出域上全部生成全四边形网格、平均 95.7 个可用、90 个可证明最优，而 Gmsh 同单元数配置仅完成 51 个、可用 38 个、最优 0 个。
Motivation: 全四边形网格分解中顶点不规则度存在由拓扑与角点角度决定的可证明下界，但奖励稀疏且随机探索在超过八边的域上从不达标，强化学习难以直接学出达到该下界的分解。
Method: 策略网络的卷积沿网格自身连通性作用于 half-edge 结构的局部编辑，可直接泛化到比训练更大的域；先对易构造的最优网格做行为克隆 (behaviour cloning) 并反向回放成示范，再用 PPO 训练，奖励直接对准 Gauss-Bonnet 下界。
Result: 在 96 个留出域上：全部生成全四边形网格，平均 95.7 个可用，90 个可证明最优；Gmsh 同单元数最强配置完成 51 个、可用 38 个、最优 0 个，且即使单元数多 3–14 倍也未产生更规则的网格。在 64 个两倍训练规模的域上全部完成、62 个可用，相对 par 的中位超额低于 1，而 Gmsh 同单元数为 39。
Conclusion: 把可证明下界直接做成稀疏奖励、配合示范预训练，能让 RL 策略在全四边形分解上达到拓扑决定的最优 par，并跨域规模泛化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 96 个留出域上：全部生成全四边形网格，平均 95.7 个可用，90 个可证明最优；Gmsh 同单元数最强配置完成 51 个、可用 38 个、最优 0 个，且即使单元数多 3–14 倍也未产生更规则的网格。在 64 个两倍训练规模的域上全部完成、62 个可用，相对 par 的中位超额低于 1，而 Gmsh 同单元数为 39。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把可证明下界直接做成稀疏奖励、配合示范预训练，能让 RL 策略在全四边形分解上达到拓扑决定的最优 par，并跨域规模泛化。

papers.title: Spectral Reversal: Counteracting Singular Value Bias for Graph Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) via self-supervised learning has become a dominant paradigm, yet efficiently adapting frozen encoders remains a challenge. Graph prompting offers a parameter-efficient alternative to fine-tuning, but existing methods largely treat pre-trained models as opaque feature extractors, ignoring their internal spectral structure. In this work, we identify a systematic phenomenon in pre-trained GNNs, which we term spectral bias: optimization during pre-training disproportionately aligns representations with directions associated with large singular values, leaving low-energy directions under-explored. We show that these underutilized directions can encode complementary information that is beneficial for downstream adaptation, especially under distribution shift. To leverage this insight, we propose Spectral Reverse Prompt (SRP), a prompting framework that rebalances the spectral contributions of frozen GNN encoders. SRP applies a learnable soft-thresholding mask in the spectral domain to down-weight dominant directions while amplifying weaker ones. In addition, SRP incorporates a null-space augmentation module that captures variation in directions with minimal activation under the frozen encoder. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SRP achieves state-of-the-art performance with minimal additional parameters, highlighting that reweighting spectral components is a principled and effective strategy for parameter-efficient graph adaptation.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 as a spotlight paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预训练 GNN 的自监督优化会把表征系统性地对齐到大奇异值方向，低能量方向欠利用。Spectral Reverse Prompt (SRP) 对冻结编码器做谱重平衡：谱域可学习软阈值掩码压低主导方向、放大弱方向，再加空空间增强模块捕捉激活极小的方向。在多个 benchmark 上以极少额外参数达到 state-of-the-art，说明谱重加权是参数高效图适应的有效策略。
Motivation: 图提示 (graph prompting) 把预训练 GNN 当作不透明的特征提取器，忽略其内部谱结构；冻结编码器的参数高效适应在分布偏移下仍是难题。
Method: SRP 框架对冻结 GNN 编码器做谱重平衡：在谱域施加可学习的 soft-thresholding mask，下调主导奇异方向、放大弱方向；并引入 null-space augmentation 模块，建模冻结编码器激活极小的方向上的变化，用于下游适应。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，且只增加极少参数；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 重加权谱成分是参数高效图适应的原则性有效策略，欠利用的低能量方向在分布偏移下携带对下游适应有用的互补信息。

papers.title: REALM: Regime-Switching, Explainable, and Activation-Induced Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep ReLU networks are piecewise-affine mappings that partition the input space into cells, each characterized by a distinct activation pattern. This structure motivates fitting a local linear model within each cell to preserve predictive accuracy while improving interpretability. The challenge is to identify regimes that are stable, data-adaptive, and easy to explain. We propose REALM, a mixture of linear models whose regimes are induced by neural activation patterns. Because the number of activation cells in a deep neural network (DNN) can grow rapidly with depth, we first distill a deep teacher into a wide, shallow student network (WSSN), then binarize and cluster its hidden-layer activations to define the regimes and fit a linear model within each regime. Since the regimes are discovered from internal structure, the router does not carry the predictive burden. To make regime assignment interpretable, we train a multiclass logistic regression, the explanatory gate, to reproduce the regime assignments. The two-level structure is interpretable at both stages in terms of raw tabular or learned convolutional features: the gate identifies features that determine regime assignments, while the linear models identify features that drive predictions within each regime. We analyze an idealized setting that illustrates a trade-off between partition complexity and stability: as the number of regimes grows, finer partitions can improve approximation but may reduce regime-assignment stability. Experiments on tabular and image datasets show that REALM achieves competitive predictive performance relative to other DNN-guided mixture surrogates and inherently interpretable models while producing stable regime-level explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REALM 把深度 ReLU 网络的分段仿射结构转成可解释的线性模型混合：先蒸馏成宽浅学生网络 (WSSN)，再对隐层激活二值化聚类定义 regime，每个 regime 内拟合线性模型，并用多分类逻辑回归作为 explanatory gate 复现 regime 归属。理论上给出分区复杂度与稳定性权衡：regime 数增多时更细的分区提升近似精度但降低归类稳定性；表格与图像数据集上预测性能相对其他 DNN 引导混合代理与内在可解释模型具有竞争力，同时给出稳定的 regime 级解释。
Motivation: 深度 ReLU 网络把输入空间切成大量激活胞元，直接在每个胞元上拟合局部线性模型可兼顾精度与可解释性，但难点在于找到稳定、数据自适应且易于解释的 regime，且激活胞元数量随深度急剧增长。
Method: 先将深度教师网络蒸馏为宽浅学生网络 (WSSN) 以控制胞元数量，再对其隐层激活做二值化与聚类以定义 regime，并在每个 regime 内拟合线性模型；另训练多分类逻辑回归作为 explanatory gate 复现 regime 归属，使归类与预测两层都可解释。作者还分析了一个理想化设定下的分区复杂度与稳定性权衡。
Result: 在表格与图像数据集上，REALM 的预测性能相对其他 DNN 引导的混合代理 (mixture surrogates) 与内在可解释模型具有竞争力，并产生稳定的 regime 级解释；理论分析表明 regime 数目增加时，更细的分区可改善近似但可能降低 regime 归属稳定性。
Conclusion: 由神经网络激活模式诱导的 regime 加上独立的解释性 gate，可以在不把预测负担交给 router 的前提下同时保住预测精度与两层可解释性，代价是分区精细度与归类稳定性之间存在权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latency-Aware Client Assignment for Parallel Split Learning With Global Sampling
papers.abstract_en: In cross-silo split learning, Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling forms representative pooled batches when class distributions differ across clients, but ignores client delay when several clients can supply the same class. We introduce Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling, which separates each pooled batch's integer class target from the choice of clients that supply its examples. The flow variant formulates this assignment as an integral network-flow problem and minimizes modeled client-side completion time for the current target. The fast variant uses a greedy next-completion rule to reduce schedule-construction cost. Both preserve the target stream and use every local example once per epoch. A planning rule selects between the variants while accounting for the cost of constructing both candidate schedules. On CIFAR-10, the flow variant reduces modeled training time by 6.75%, with a 0.30 percentage-point decrease in final accuracy. On Tiny ImageNet with 20 candidate classes per client, the fast variant reduces modeled time by 16.87% and reaches all four validation targets earlier than the latency-unaware baseline. Across 405 schedule comparisons, the planning rule stays within 2% of the lower realized cost in 96.54% of cases. In our evaluation, latency-aware provider assignment reduces modeled training time without changing the prescribed class targets, while the preferred variant depends on whether assignment savings outweigh schedule-construction overhead.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 cross-silo 并行 split learning 的全局采样中，把每个 pooled batch 的整数类别目标与「由哪些客户端供样」解耦，用 Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling 最小化建模的客户端完成时间。CIFAR-10 上 flow 变体把建模训练时间降 6.75%，最终准确率降 0.30 个百分点；Tiny ImageNet（每客户端 20 个候选类）上 fast 变体降 16.87% 并更早达到全部四个验证目标。
Motivation: Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling 在各客户端类别分布不同时能构造有代表性的 pooled batch，但当多个客户端都能供同一类别时完全忽略客户端延迟，慢客户端会拖长训练时间。
Method: 把 pooled batch 的整数类别目标与供样客户端选择分离：flow 变体将该指派写成整数网络流 (integral network-flow) 问题，最小化当前目标下的建模客户端完成时间；fast 变体用贪心 next-completion 规则降低调度构造开销。两者都保持目标流不变、每个 epoch 用尽每个本地样本一次；另有一条 planning rule 在计入构造两份候选调度的成本后选择变体。
Result: CIFAR-10 上 flow 变体建模训练时间减少 6.75%，最终准确率下降 0.30 个百分点。Tiny ImageNet、每客户端 20 个候选类时，fast 变体建模时间减少 16.87%，且比 latency-unaware 基线更早达到全部四个验证目标。405 次调度比较中，planning rule 有 96.54% 的情况落在较低实现成本的 2% 以内。
Conclusion: 延迟感知的供样客户端指派能在不改变规定类别目标的前提下压低建模训练时间；选 flow 还是 fast 取决于指派节省是否超过调度构造开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 8-bit 秘密消息嵌进 2D Gaussian 图像表示的参数域而非像素：用密钥选出参数子集并微调，优先改动对重建扰动最小的参数。30 次拟合实验中正确密钥零误码，错误密钥 BER 0.543；在 112 张 256×256 自然图像、4096 个 Gaussian 上正确密钥 BER 0.000、错误密钥 0.520，PSNR 平均代价仅 0.091 dB。
Motivation: 2D Gaussian 图像表示日益流行，但传统隐写把信息藏在像素域，与这种参数化表示不匹配；作者要在保持重建视觉保真度的前提下把消息藏进 Gaussian 参数。
Method: 先将 Gaussian 表示参数拟合到目标图像，用密钥选择参数子集做微调以嵌入 8-bit 消息；嵌入通过 log-anisotropy、opacity、color luminance 三类参数实现，并对比密钥随机选参与选择 least-disturbing edits 两种策略。
Result: 合成图上 30 次拟合实验：正确密钥零误码，错误密钥 BER 0.543（接近随机 0.5）；least-disturbing 选参比随机选参更可靠（单侧 p=0.031），平均 PSNR 代价 0.091 dB。112 张 256×256 自然图像、4096 Gaussians：正确密钥 BER 0.000，错误密钥 0.520。去掉 color luminance 的九次拟合缩减设置中参数类型由 3 降到 2（减少 33.3%，256 Gaussians 不变），正确密钥仍零误码，错误密钥 BER 从 0.514 升到 0.571，偏离 0.5 更远。
Conclusion: 把消息藏进 Gaussian 参数域并按最小扰动选参，可在近乎无损的重建下实现密钥控制的可靠提取，而错误密钥的解码停留在随机猜测水平；减少所用参数类型会让错误密钥行为进一步偏离随机。

papers.title: What Should We Freeze? Guarded Freezing: Connectivity Shapes the Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
papers.abstract_en: When adapting pre-trained models through fine-tuning, freezing weights alone might not preserve performance, as updates elsewhere can change the inputs to the frozen core, ultimately affecting overall performance. We first analyse the case where a selected frozen core can be isolated and propose removal-value, a capacity-based score that approximates HOPE's removal cost averaged over removal orders. We show that in VGG-8, cutting paths from trainable neurons into a frozen core makes selection using this score useful: $70\%$ frozen preserves $5.22\pm0.51$ percentage points more old-task accuracy than DEFT at similar new-task accuracy. In transformers, shared residual streams leave paths into frozen neurons open. For this case, we derive drift-value, a forward-only proxy for the output disturbance from updating each weight entry under a local update model. In language models, at 40 epochs, this policy exceeds adapted Wanda and RIA freezing scores in settings with substantial retention loss, while its differences from Fisher remain unresolved. After 160 epochs on Qwen2.5-1.5B, it retains $0.0433\pm0.0102$ more than static Fisher. In DINOv3 vision-transformer adaptation to point clouds, drift-value retains $0.440$ image accuracy versus $0.187$ for a random mask of the same count. These results motivate Guarded Freezing: select by removal-value when incoming paths are cut, and by drift-value when they remain.

TL;DR: 微调时冻结权重本身不足以保住旧任务性能，因为其他位置的更新会改变进入冻结核心的输入。论文提出 Guarded Freezing：当通往冻结核心的路径被切断时用 removal-value 选择（VGG-8 中冻结 70% 比 DEFT 多保留 5.22±0.51 个百分点旧任务精度），路径仍开放时用前向代理 drift-value 选择（Qwen2.5-1.5B 训练 160 轮比静态 Fisher 多保留 0.0433±0.0102）。
Motivation: 冻结预训练模型的部分权重并不自动保住旧任务性能：可训练部分的更新会改变冻结核心的输入，导致漂移；现有冻结评分（DEFT、Wanda、RIA、Fisher）在保留损失大的场景下表现不稳。
Method: 两个互补评分：removal-value 是基于容量的分数，近似 HOPE removal cost 在多种移除顺序上的均值，适用于冻结核心可被隔离（路径被切断）的情形；drift-value 是前向计算的代理，在局部更新模型下估计更新每个权重条目对输出的扰动，适用于 transformer 共享 residual stream 使路径保持开放的情形。Guarded Freezing 按路径是否被切断在两者间选择。
Result: VGG-8 中切断从可训练神经元进入冻结核心的路径后，按 removal-value 选择、冻结 70% 时，比 DEFT 在相近新任务精度下多保留 5.22±0.51 个百分点旧任务精度。语言模型中 40 轮时该策略在保留损失显著的设定下超过 adapted Wanda 与 RIA 冻结评分，与 Fisher 的差异尚未分辨；Qwen2.5-1.5B 训练 160 轮后比静态 Fisher 多保留 0.0433±0.0102。DINOv3 vision transformer 适配点云时，drift-value 保留 0.440 图像精度，同数量随机掩码仅 0.187。

papers.title: READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: READ-Bench 是面向时间序列诊断的历史案例检索基准，覆盖 12 个诊断数据集，按共享故障/事件类型而非信号形状定义相关性。结论是：仅检索阶段预训练表示相对强经典与符号基线无可检测统计优势，决定性因素是重排阶段少量已解案例监督——高斯过程重排器在嵌入空间传播少量邻居标签；据此融合 normal-residual 打分嵌入器与 DTW 分支做倒数排名融合再重排，NDCG@10 在全部 12 个数据集上提升，重排贡献 +0.11，较最强单一基础检索器 +0.16。
Motivation: 时间序列诊断系统很少真正调用历史案例检索，即便使用也只通过下游预测间接评估检索质量，缺少以故障/事件语义定义相关性的专用基准。
Method: 将检索拆为基础检索器加重排器，在统一协议下评估经典距离、符号检索器、自监督与基础模型嵌入器及其融合，以及标签感知与语言模型重排器，并系统改变监督量、语料污染与语料规模，配合显著性检验；接口为 channel-independent。最终系统用 normal-residual 打分嵌入器与 dynamic time warping (DTW) 分支做 reciprocal-rank fusion，再接高斯过程重排器。
Result: 在 12 个诊断数据集上，仅检索阶段预训练表示相对强经典与符号基线无统计可检测优势；高斯过程重排器传播少量邻居标签带来的提升超过更复杂表示或语言模型推理，且在污染与全语料规模下保持。最终融合系统 NDCG@10 相对自身检索阶段在全部 12 个数据集上提升，重排贡献 +0.11，相对最强单一基础检索器 +0.16。
Conclusion: 历史案例检索的瓶颈不在更强的表示或语言模型推理，而在重排阶段少量已解案例监督；诊断检索基准应按故障/事件类型而非信号形状定义相关性。

papers.title: Handwritten Digit Leakage from Smartphone Motion Sensors Across Unseen Users and Phone Models
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone motion sensors support interactive applications, but their readings may also reveal touchscreen input beyond their intended use. Assuming known drawing intervals, we study whether handwritten digits remain predictable across users and devices, as a 10-class problem on 19,628 HuMIdb recordings from 481 participants. We compare handcrafted features with classical machine learning algorithms, MiniRocket kernels, and a compact sensor patch transformer on accelerometer, linear acceleration, gyroscope, and gravity signals. The transformer achieves 57.74\% accuracy and 82.64\% top-3 accuracy on 75 unseen participants, and 58.77$\pm$0.95\% over 3 seeds for unseen participants on 9 unseen phone models. Low motion recordings remain informative, accuracy is not monotonic in motion level, and the tested contrastive pretraining, augmentation, and derived signals give no consistent gains. Digits are thus predictable beyond familiar users and phone models under assumed segmentation, while acquisition-order shortcuts limit conclusions about practical privacy exposure. Code available at: https://github.com/Arritmic/motion-digit-leakage.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, 7 numbered equations, and 33 references. Code available at https://github.com/Arritmic/motion-digit-leakage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在假定已知书写时间窗的前提下，手机运动传感器读数足以在陌生用户与陌生机型上还原手写数字：紧凑的 sensor patch transformer 在 HuMIdb 的 10 类任务上对 75 名未见参与者达到 57.74% 准确率、top-3 为 82.64%，对 9 种未见机型为 58.77±0.95%（3 seeds）。低运动量记录仍有信息量，且准确率随运动水平不单调；对比学习预训练、数据增强与派生信号均无一致增益。作者同时指出采集顺序捷径限制了对真实隐私暴露程度的结论。
Motivation: 运动传感器本为交互设计，但其读数可能泄露触屏输入；已有工作多在同用户同机型上验证，跨用户、跨机型的可预测性与隐私边界不清。
Method: 把 19,628 条 HuMIdb 记录（481 名参与者）的 accelerometer、linear acceleration、gyroscope、gravity 信号视为 10 类分类问题，对比手工特征 + 经典机器学习、MiniRocket kernels 与紧凑 sensor patch transformer，并测试对比预训练、数据增强和派生信号。
Result: transformer 在 75 名未见参与者上 57.74% 准确率、82.64% top-3；在 9 种未见机型的未见参与者上 58.77±0.95%（3 seeds）。低运动量记录仍具信息量，准确率随运动水平不单调，对比预训练、增强与派生信号无一致增益。
Conclusion: 在假定分段的前提下，数字可跨熟悉用户与机型被预测；但采集顺序捷径使结果不能直接等同于实际隐私暴露。

papers.title: Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, with an exponential crossover which is a finite-size artifact of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then four numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. They extrapolate predictions from $N \leq 100$ to $N = 10^4$, collapse five distinct models on the same scaling function and predict ASR at different temperatures from the one they were fitted at.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用统计物理的热激活势垒模型重写 Best-of-N 越狱 (BoN jailbreaking)：每条 prompt 有基线安全水平，每次改写带一个随机势垒，四个可解释参数即决定整个 (N, M) 攻击面。作者据此否定 ASR 随 N 的幂律说法——指数随 N 漂移，所谓指数 crossover 只是对抗数据集的有限尺寸假象；模型能从 N≤100 外推到 N=10^4，把五个模型塌缩到同一标度函数，并从拟合温度预测其他温度下的 ASR。
Motivation: 已有工作声称 BoN 攻击成功率 (ASR) 随 N 呈幂律，但指数随 N 漂移，且 (N, M) 双预算攻击面与生成温度 T 的依赖几乎无人系统探索。
Method: 提出简单 barrier model：每条 prompt 一个基线安全水平，每次改写 (augmentation) 一个随机的热激活势垒，用四个带安全机制解释的数字刻画全部 (N, M) 攻击面；在 N≤100 上拟合后外推，并跨温度迁移预测。
Result: 挑战 ASR 关于 N 的幂律：指数随 N 漂移，指数 crossover 是对抗数据集的有限尺寸假象；从 N≤100 外推到 N=10^4 成立，五个不同模型塌缩到同一标度函数，并能预测拟合温度以外温度下的 ASR。
Conclusion: BoN 越狱的 (N, M, T) 攻击面可由四个可解释参数的热激活势垒模型统一描述，幂律表述是有限尺寸误导。

papers.title: Empowering Hybrid Attention Models on NPUs
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid attention models have emerged as a crucial architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs) (e.g., the Qwen3.5 and Kimi series). Their memory and computational efficiency make them highly attractive for on-device inference, forming a promising synergy with edge Neural Processing Units (NPUs). However, naive execution of these hybrid models on edge NPUs fails to deliver these benefits, often bottlenecking the prefill stage due to severe memory-system inefficiencies and architectural mismatches within the linear attention (LA) layers. We present HA-NPU, the first system to enable efficient hybrid attention LLM inference on edge NPUs without modifying the underlying algorithms. HA-NPU enhances execution efficiency by reorganizing the dataflow of the LA components across three levels: (1) At the core level, it partitions workloads by the head dimension and fuses dependent operators, eliminating cross-core global memory accesses; (2) At the operator level, it reorders execution to consume intermediate tensors immediately, drastically minimizing local-buffer pressure; (3) At the tensor level, it employs dataflow-aware layout planning to minimize transformation overhead between matrix and vector processing units. Compared to competitive baselines, HA-NPU achieves up to 35.95$\times$ LA kernel speedup and 36.14$\times$ energy reduction, delivering up to 2.03$\times$ faster end-to-end request latency. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yinyuanzhang/HA-NPU
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HA-NPU 是首个在不改动算法的前提下让混合注意力 (hybrid attention) LLM 在边缘 NPU 上高效推理的系统，通过 core、operator、tensor 三级数据流重组消除跨核全局访存、即时消费中间张量并做布局规划。相比竞争基线，LA kernel 最高加速 35.95×、能耗降低 36.14×，端到端请求延迟最高加快 2.03×。
Motivation: 混合注意力模型的内存与计算优势在边缘 NPU 上被内存系统低效和 linear attention (LA) 层的架构失配抵消，prefill 阶段成为瓶颈。
Method: HA-NPU 三级数据流重组：core 级按 head dimension 划分负载并融合相关算子，消除跨核全局内存访问；operator 级重排执行顺序即时消费中间张量以压低 local-buffer 压力；tensor 级做 dataflow-aware 布局规划，减少矩阵与向量处理单元间的转换开销。不修改底层算法。
Result: 相比竞争基线，LA kernel 最高 35.95× 加速、36.14× 能耗降低，端到端请求延迟最高 2.03× 提升；面向 Qwen3.5、Kimi 系列这类混合注意力 LLM 的 on-device 推理。
Conclusion: 不改算法、只重组数据流即可在边缘 NPU 上兑现混合注意力模型的效率收益，瓶颈主要来自 LA 层的访存与布局失配。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: HA-NPU 是首个在不改动算法的前提下让混合注意力 (hybrid attention) LLM 在边缘 NPU 上高效推理的系统，通过 core、operator、tensor 三级数据流重组消除跨核全局访存、即时消费中间张量并做布局规划。相比竞争基线，LA kernel 最高加速 35.95×、能耗降低 36.14×，端到端请求延迟最高加快 2.03×。

papers.title: How Reusable Are Benchmarks with Richer Feedback?
papers.abstract_en: We study whether benchmarks reliably guide model selection as developers adapt to evaluation feedback across multiple criteria. We find that the worst-case test-set size needed to estimate the best score among $k$ adaptively chosen models, under any convex combination of the criteria, grows exponentially with the number of criteria, reaching the $Θ(\sqrt{k})$ cost of answering $k$ adaptive statistical queries with only $O(\log k)$ criteria, at fixed accuracy and confidence. In attacks on multi-task large language model benchmarks with five to ten criteria, feedback restricted to nondominated task profiles produces large reused-to-held-out score gaps and frequent false winners. These results challenge a prominent explanation for prior observed reliable benchmark reuse---that developers mainly respond to convincing improvements over the current best---in rich-feedback settings, while leaving open how often ordinary model development encounters this vulnerability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究多准则评估反馈下基准的可复用性：估计 k 个自适应选择模型在任意凸组合准则下的最优分数，所需最坏情形测试集规模随准则数指数增长，仅 O(log k) 个准则就达到回答 k 个自适应统计查询的 Θ(√k) 代价。在五到十准则的多任务 LLM 基准攻击中，仅反馈非支配任务剖面会造成复用集与留出集分数大幅落差与频繁假赢家。
Motivation: 开发者依据评估反馈跨多个准则调整模型时，基准能否可靠指导模型选择存疑；已有「基准可复用」的解释（开发者主要响应对当前最优的可信改进）在富反馈设定下受到挑战。
Method: 理论上分析在任意准则凸组合下估计 k 个自适应选择模型最优分数所需的最坏情形测试集规模；并在多任务 LLM 基准上做攻击实验，反馈限制为非支配 (nondominated) 任务剖面。
Result: 最坏情形测试集规模随准则数指数增长，在固定精度与置信度下仅 O(log k) 个准则即达到回答 k 个自适应统计查询的 Θ(√k) 代价；在五到十准则的多任务 LLM 基准攻击中，复用集与留出集分数出现大幅落差，并频繁产生假赢家 (false winners)。

papers.title: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale pretraining to ultimately achieve generalist manipulation. Deployed VLA policies must support continual learning to acquire new tasks over time. Teaching a VLA a new task generally requires finetuning it on demonstrations of that task. However, naively finetuning on downstream tasks causes the policy to forget earlier tasks and degrades generalist capabilities. This failure is known as catastrophic forgetting. Most continual learning methods counter it by replaying data from earlier tasks. However, the old task demonstrations are not always readily available. In this paper, we introduce SAMBAR, a continual learning algorithm that prevents catastrophic forgetting during VLA finetuning without requiring access to the demonstrations of any previously learned task. We propose to cast continual learning as a constrained optimization problem and solve it with the method of multipliers. In our approach, the method of multipliers drives the policy to learn the new task without the model parameters drifting far away from their previous values. In contrast to a standard regularization penalty, the method of multipliers raises the penalty as the constraint violation accumulates by using a dual variable. We also selectively anchor the parameters critical to previous tasks to preserve past knowledge, leaving other parameters free for new task acquisition. The combination of dual variable and selective anchoring, therefore, balances knowledge acquisition with knowledge retention. We evaluate our method, SAMBAR, on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and on hardware. When sequentially finetuning on a VLA, every replay-free baseline we compare against completely forgets the first task it learned, whereas SAMBAR retains every task it has learned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAMBAR 把 VLA 的持续学习写成带约束的优化问题，用乘子法 (method of multipliers) 的对偶变量随约束违反累积自动加大惩罚，再选择性锚定对旧任务关键的参数，其余参数放开学新任务。在 LIBERO 仿真基准与硬件上顺序微调时，所有对比的免回放 (replay-free) 基线都完全遗忘第一个学到的任务，而 SAMBAR 保留了它学过的每一个任务。
Motivation: VLA 策略部署后需持续学新任务，但下游微调会造成灾难性遗忘；主流免回放方法依赖旧任务演示数据，而这些演示往往拿不到。
Method: 将持续学习表述为约束优化问题并用乘子法求解：对偶变量随约束违反累积逐步抬高惩罚，抑制参数偏离先前取值；同时只锚定对旧任务关键的参数，其余参数自由更新，以对偶变量加选择性锚定共同平衡知识获取与保留。
Result: 在 LIBERO 仿真基准与硬件上顺序微调 VLA 时，每个被对比的免回放基线都完全遗忘其学到的第一个任务，SAMBAR 则保留了它学过的全部任务。
Conclusion: 免回放的持续学习不必靠旧任务演示：对偶变量加选择性锚定即可在 VLA 微调中同时保住新任务学习与旧任务记忆。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An Attention-Driven Heterogeneous GNN Model for Credit Card Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: The global transition to a cashless economy has placed credit cards as the key element of digital transactions, acclaimed for their easy use, speed, and acceptance in most places. However, the growing dependence on this payment method has led to an escalation of the risks associated with credit card (CC) fraud. Detecting this type of fraud is a difficult task because the patterns are constantly changing, there is a data imbalance, and it is necessary to identify the legitimate transactions and the fraud ones at the same time. This study addresses this challenge by proposing a credit card fraud detection (CCFD) framework using a data balancing technique and a deep learning (DL) model. The proposed fraud detection model is trained and evaluated by collecting the dataset called Credit Card Fraud Detection from the Kaggle repository. As the dataset is highly imbalanced, we utilized the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE)-Tomek technique to balance the dataset. Further, the balanced dataset is classified using the Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (HGNN) model. The HGNN model represent various transactions using a heterogeneous graph architecture and by using an attention based message passing technique, it managed to consider the complex relationships, time factors, and user behavior. The integration of SMOTE-Tomek in the model further boosted its capacity to identify fraudulent transactions, while lowering the rate of false positives. The HGNN model attained a 99.97% accuracy, a 99.48% F1-score, a 99.15% precision, and a 98.97% recall. The findings indicates that this model is effective and can be applied to real-world CCFD scenarios.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, original work, implementation at https://github.com/kathiresan-jayabalan/graphfen-ccfd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 信用卡欺诈检测框架用 SMOTE-Tomek 先平衡 Kaggle 高度不平衡数据，再用带注意力消息传递的异构图神经网络 (HGNN) 建模交易、时间与用户行为关系。在该数据集上达到 99.97% 准确率、99.48% F1、99.15% 精确率、98.97% 召回率，作者称可用于真实 CCFD 场景。
Motivation: 信用卡欺诈模式持续变化、数据高度不平衡，且需同时识别正常与欺诈交易，传统分类难以处理交易间的复杂关系。
Method: 先用 SMOTE-Tomek 对 Kaggle Credit Card Fraud Detection 数据集做过采样与近邻清理平衡，再用异构图神经网络 (HGNN) 将交易表示为异构图，通过基于注意力的消息传递建模交易关系、时间因素与用户行为，最后分类。
Result: 在 Kaggle Credit Card Fraud Detection 数据集上：准确率 99.97%，F1-score 99.48%，precision 99.15%，recall 98.97%；作者称 SMOTE-Tomek 集成提升了欺诈识别能力并降低误报率。
Conclusion: SMOTE-Tomek 平衡加注意力 HGNN 的组合在该数据集上可有效检测欺诈，作者认为可应用于真实世界 CCFD 场景。

papers.title: LLM Unlearning Evaluation with TRIAGE
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can memorize private or harmful information, motivating machine unlearning methods that remove targeted knowledge while preserving other capabilities. However, existing evaluations rely primarily on behavioral benchmarks, which assess \emph{whether} a model appears to forget but provide limited insight into \emph{how} unlearning changes the model or affects related knowledge. We introduce \textit{TRIAGE} (\textit{Tripartite Representation-internal Introspection for Adjacency Gap Evaluation}), a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework for characterizing these changes. TRIAGE uses diagonal approximations of the Fisher information and Hessian to measure changes in parameter sensitivity and local curvature, and utilizes a Forget / \emph{Adjacent-Retain} / \emph{Generic-Retain} partition to quantify an \emph{adjacency gap} in semantically related knowledge. Based on the magnitude and distribution of these changes, TRIAGE further classifies each algorithm's update as \emph{no-op}, \emph{partially localized}, \emph{collateral dominant}, or \emph{globally destructive}. Across 12 unlearning methods, four language models, and the WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE benchmarks, we find that methods with similar behavioral forgetting can produce substantially different internal changes and patterns of collateral damage. These signatures also vary across models and benchmarks, indicating that the effects of unlearning are not determined solely by the unlearning algorithm. TRIAGE can be applied alongside existing unlearning benchmarks to complement behavioral evaluation with a model-internal view of how unlearning reshapes the model's parameter space and affects retained knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRIAGE 是一个与具体 benchmark 解耦的机器遗忘评估框架，用 Fisher 信息与 Hessian 的对角近似度量参数敏感度和局部曲率的变化，并按 Forget / Adjacent-Retain / Generic-Retain 三分区量化语义相关知识上的 adjacency gap，据此把每个遗忘算法的更新分类为 no-op、partially localized、collateral dominant 或 globally destructive。在 12 个遗忘方法、4 个语言模型与 WMDP、TOFU、MUSE 三个 benchmark 上，行为遗忘程度相近的方法内部变化与附带损伤模式差异显著，且这些签名随模型和 benchmark 变化。
Motivation: 现有遗忘评估主要靠行为 benchmark，只能判断模型是否看起来忘掉，无法说明遗忘如何改变模型内部以及是否伤及相关知识。
Method: TRIAGE 用 Fisher 信息与 Hessian 的对角近似度量参数敏感度和局部曲率的变化，配合 Forget / Adjacent-Retain / Generic-Retain 三分区量化语义相关知识上的 adjacency gap，再按这些变化的幅度与分布把更新归为 no-op、partially localized、collateral dominant、globally destructive 四类；框架与 benchmark 无关，可叠加在既有遗忘评测之上。
Result: 在 12 个遗忘方法、4 个语言模型以及 WMDP、TOFU、MUSE 三个 benchmark 上，行为遗忘相近的方法产生显著不同的内部变化与附带损伤模式；这些签名随模型与 benchmark 变化，说明遗忘效果并非仅由遗忘算法决定。
Conclusion: 行为遗忘分数不足以刻画遗忘效果，必须补上模型内部视角，因为同一算法在不同模型和 benchmark 上的参数空间重塑与保留知识损伤并不一致。

papers.title: Residual Streams Read, Recurrent States Remember: The Global Workspace in Mamba Models
papers.abstract_en: Can the global-workspace account of transformer representations extend to state-space language models? We fit Jacobian lenses to the residual streams and recurrent states of Mamba-1, Mamba-2 and Mamba-3, using the original 1000-prompt recipe. Joint residual--state readouts improve recovery of known intermediate concepts over the residual lens on at least five of six task families in every tested Mamba checkpoint. On Mamba-2, state alone exceeds residual and logit lenses on all six families; a normalised joint readout improves on both components on five. Temporal maps and word-list experiments show earlier content remaining state-readable as residual visibility changes. We also propose sign-guarded steering, which improves target top-five success over coordinate exchange on matched verbal-report trials in five models. Recurrent state alone supports this verbal access. These gains do not extend consistently to relational answers: guarded edits often output the edited concept itself, and Mamba-3's joint edits can disrupt successful state-only redirection. Recurrent state thus provides a complementary carrier of workspace content, whose recovery, persistence and causal uses require separate measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全局工作区 (global workspace) 解释从 Transformer 推广到状态空间语言模型：对 Mamba-1/2/3 的残差流与循环状态拟合 Jacobian lens，联合读出在每个被测 checkpoint 上至少六个任务族中的五个优于纯残差 lens。循环状态是内容的互补载体，其可读性、持久性与因果可用性需分别测量，且符号守卫引导 (sign-guarded steering) 的收益不一致地延伸到关系型答案。
Motivation: 全局工作区解释目前建立在 Transformer 表征上，尚不清楚它能否延伸到以循环状态而非残差流承载信息的状态空间语言模型 (Mamba)。
Method: 对 Mamba-1、Mamba-2、Mamba-3 的残差流与循环状态拟合 Jacobian lenses，沿用原始 1000-prompt 配方；比较残差 lens、logit lens、状态单独读出与联合残差-状态读出，并用 temporal maps 与 word-list 实验追踪内容随时间的可读性；另提出 sign-guarded steering，与 coordinate exchange 在配对 verbal-report 试验上对照。
Result: 联合残差-状态读出在每个被测 Mamba checkpoint 上至少六个任务族中的五个恢复已知中间概念优于残差 lens；Mamba-2 上状态单独读出在全部六个任务族上超过残差 lens 与 logit lens，归一化联合读出在五个任务族上优于两个分量；sign-guarded steering 在五个模型的配对 verbal-report 试验上把目标 top-five 成功率做得高于 coordinate exchange；关系型答案上收益不一致，guarded edits 常输出被编辑概念本身，Mamba-3 的联合编辑会破坏原本成功的状态单独重定向。
Conclusion: 循环状态是工作区内容的互补载体，可作为独立的读出与因果操控通道，但其恢复、持久性与因果用途必须分开测量，且关系型答案上的编辑尚不可靠。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Emergent One-Third Scaling Law as Attention Tries to Concentrate
papers.abstract_en: The neural scaling law relating longer training to better performance through a power law is central to today's large language models (LLMs), yet its origin remains debated. One recent proposal is that power laws can emerge from the strong non-linearity of a single softmax head learning peaked distributions. What happens with multiple softmax functions, as in LLMs, is unclear. Here, we show through toy models that any softmax learning peaked distributions, regardless of its position in the model, can develop logit magnitudes that grow in a power law with exponent $1/3$, becoming a training bottleneck whose loss contribution decays as a power law with the same exponent $1/3$. The overall loss therefore obeys $1/3$ scaling whenever at least one softmax learns peaked distributions. We confirm that many softmax functions in LLMs learn peaked distributions and that LLM loss scaling matches this $1/3$ prediction. Moreover, logit growth dynamics reveal that attention heads, rather than the language modeling head, are the bottleneck likely driving the $1/3$ loss scaling in LLMs. Attention trying to concentrate on specific information, which is the heart of Transformers, may therefore also be the heart of the neural scaling law of training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用玩具模型证明：任何学习尖峰分布的 softmax，无论在模型中的位置，其 logit 幅值都会以指数 1/3 的幂律增长并成为训练瓶颈，其损失贡献同样以 1/3 幂律衰减，因此只要至少有一个 softmax 在学尖峰分布，总损失就呈 1/3 标度。作者确认 LLM 中多个 softmax 确实学尖峰分布、其损失标度与 1/3 预测吻合，且 logit 增长动力学指向 attention head 而非语言建模头是驱动该标度的瓶颈。
Motivation: 神经标度律（训练越久性能按幂律提升）是当代 LLM 的核心现象但起源仍有争议；已有解释只针对单个 softmax 头，而 LLM 含多个 softmax 函数时幂律是否仍成立并不清楚。
Method: 用玩具模型推导任意位置上学习尖峰分布的 softmax 的 logit 增长动力学，得到指数 1/3 的幂律及其损失贡献；再在 LLM 中检验多个 softmax 是否学习尖峰分布、损失标度是否匹配 1/3 预测，并用 logit 增长动力学定位瓶颈在 attention head 还是语言建模头。
Result: logit 幅值以指数 1/3 的幂律增长，其损失贡献以同一 1/3 指数衰减，总损失在至少一个 softmax 学尖峰分布时呈 1/3 标度；LLM 的损失标度与该 1/3 预测吻合，且动力学显示瓶颈是 attention head 而非语言建模头。
Conclusion: LLM 的神经标度律可能源于 attention 试图集中于特定信息这一 Transformer 核心机制，即 softmax 对尖峰分布的学习是 1/3 损失标度的共同来源。

papers.title: HEXIS: Compiling Agent Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills provide instructions and reusable knowledge, yet agents have to frequently infer which action to take next. This skill's execution paradigm combines task reasoning with control decisions, which could cause the agent to act improperly or omit necessary steps. To improve agent compliance for skills, we introduce HEXIS, which compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines (FSM) that separate knowledge from control flow. Skill knowledge is incorporated into local instructions that guide reasoning and generation within states. The machine records execution progress and intermediate results, while explicit transition conditions determine subsequent operations. Our incremental compiler first maps skill clauses and tool interfaces to state operations, local instructions, data bindings, and transitions. It then aligns development traces with existing states to identify missing operations and dependencies. These are incorporated by adding or reusing states and refining their connections. Updates are accepted only after static checks and replay of the current and all previously accepted traces. Across four benchmarks and four executors, HEXIS improves success over Skill + ReAct by 16.2 percentage points on average. Qwen3.8-27B reduces execution tokens by 38.4-88.9% across benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEXIS 把 agent skill 编译成扩展有限状态机 (EFSM)，将知识放进状态内局部指令、把控制流交给显式转移条件，从而减少 agent 漏步骤或乱执行。增量编译器对齐开发轨迹补齐缺失状态，只有通过静态检查并回放当前与全部已接受轨迹才接受更新；在四个 benchmark、四种 executor 上平均比 Skill + ReAct 提升 16.2 个百分点成功率，Qwen3.8-27B 执行 token 减少 38.4–88.9%。
Motivation: skill 执行范式把任务推理与控制决策混在一起，agent 需要频繁自行推断下一步，容易执行不当或遗漏必要步骤，skill 遵循度 (compliance) 不稳。
Method: 增量编译器先把 skill 子句与工具接口映射为状态操作、局部指令、数据绑定与转移；再把开发轨迹与已有状态对齐，找出缺失操作与依赖，通过新增或复用状态并细化连接补上；更新须通过静态检查并回放当前及全部已接受轨迹后才被接受。知识与控制流被显式分离，机器记录执行进度与中间结果。
Result: 在四个 benchmark、四种 executor 上，HEXIS 相对 Skill + ReAct 平均提升 16.2 个百分点成功率；Qwen3.8-27B 上执行 token 在各 benchmark 减少 38.4–88.9%。
Conclusion: 把 skill 的知识与控制流分离并编译成带显式转移条件的状态机，可同时提高 agent 执行 skill 的成功率并压缩执行 token 开销。

papers.title: Improving Calibration of Black-Box Radiology AI Using Test-Time Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology AI systems increasingly inform clinical decisions such as triage, follow-up imaging, and treatment planning. For these decisions to be made safely, model outputs must be well calibrated, meaning predicted probabilities accurately reflect true risk. Many standard techniques for improving calibration, such as MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles, require access to model parameters or retraining. However, proprietary clinical AI systems operate as black boxes, preventing access to the model's internals. To that end, we propose a model-agnostic framework for improving calibration of black-box models using clinically grounded test-time augmentation (TTA). Our framework applies geometric and physics-inspired 3D CT perturbations and learns probability-level aggregation strategies without access to model internals or the original training data. Across pulmonary embolism and intracranial hemorrhage detection tasks, DualTTA achieved the strongest overall calibration among TTA methods, reducing the Expected Calibration Error by 54% (0.239 -> 0.109) and 43% (0.051 -> 0.029), respectively, while requiring only input-output access. Additionally, DualTTA outperformed uncertainty estimation techniques that require access to model internals, such as Temperature Scaling, MC Dropout, and Deep Ensembles, in most calibration metrics. These results demonstrate that learned TTA aggregation can improve the calibration of clinical AI systems, providing a practical approach for improving the reliability of black-box medical AI.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 Workshop on Uncertainty for Safe Utilization of Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (UNSURE 2026). Code: https://github.com/stanfordaide/TTA_Calibration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DualTTA：对黑盒放射学 AI 施加几何与物理启发的 3D CT 测试时增强 (TTA)，学习概率层聚合策略来改善校准，只需输入输出访问。在肺栓塞与颅内出血检测上 ECE 分别下降 54%（0.239→0.109）和 43%（0.051→0.029），多数校准指标优于 Temperature Scaling、MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles。
Motivation: MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles、Temperature Scaling 等校准方法需要模型参数或重训练，而专有临床 AI 是黑盒，无法访问内部，校准差会直接威胁分诊与治疗决策的安全性。
Method: 模型无关框架：对输入施加几何与物理启发的 3D CT 扰动，学习概率层的 TTA 聚合策略（DualTTA），不访问模型内部也不需要原始训练数据。
Result: 肺栓塞检测 ECE 从 0.239 降到 0.109（降 54%），颅内出血检测 ECE 从 0.051 降到 0.029（降 43%）；在多数校准指标上超过需要内部访问的 Temperature Scaling、MC Dropout 与 Deep Ensembles。
Conclusion: 学习式 TTA 聚合可在只用输入输出的黑盒条件下改善临床 AI 校准，是提升医疗黑盒模型可靠性的实用路径。

papers.title: Not Every Token Is Worth Distilling: Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD
papers.abstract_en: Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) transfers reinforcement-learning-induced policy improvements from a small model to a larger student by using the token-level log-ratio between post-RL and pre-RL checkpoints as dense supervision on the student's own rollouts. This transfer rewards the policy shift at every state, yet the log-ratio measures only relative change: it can stay fixed even as the probability mass that both checkpoints assign to the student's candidate tokens vanishes. Through an exact construction, we show that the Direct-OPD reward and its update can remain unchanged while the Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) and both KL directions between the checkpoints vanish with this mass, and we note that a small JSD bounds how much the teacher's behavior changed. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD (S$^2$D-OPD), which ranks student-sampled states by their teacher-reference JSD and masks Direct-OPD supervision at low-divergence states, retaining only the top 10% of states per response. Across two teacher pairs and four student models ranging from 1.7B to 8B parameters, S$^2$D-OPD improves held-out accuracy over dense Direct-OPD on AIME and HMMT benchmarks in seven of eight settings and matches it in the eighth, without extra forward passes.
papers.comment: 19 pages. Yibo Zhao and Zixuan Yang are equal contributors and may list their names in either order on their CVs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Direct-OPD 用 post-RL 与 pre-RL 检查点的 token 级 log-ratio 在学生自身 rollout 上做稠密监督，但该比值只度量相对变化，即使两个检查点赋予候选 token 的概率质量同时趋于零，奖励与更新仍可不变。作者据此提出 S²D-OPD：按 teacher-reference JSD 给学生采样的状态排序，屏蔽低散度状态的监督，每条回复只保留前 10% 状态；在 1.7B–8B 的四个学生模型上，AIME 与 HMMT 八个设置中七个提升、一个持平。
Motivation: Direct-OPD 的稠密奖励在每个状态都奖励策略偏移，但 log-ratio 对绝对概率质量不敏感：两个检查点可以同时把质量压到零而奖励不变，导致在教师实际未改变行为的状态上仍施加监督。
Method: 先给出精确构造，证明 Direct-OPD 奖励与更新可保持不变而 JSD 与双向 KL 同时随质量消失，并指出小 JSD 限制教师行为变化幅度；再提出 Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD (S²D-OPD)，按学生采样状态的 teacher-reference JSD 排序，屏蔽低散度状态，仅保留每条回复前 10% 的状态，且不引入额外前向传播。
Result: 在两组 teacher pair、四个 1.7B–8B 学生模型上，S²D-OPD 相对稠密 Direct-OPD 在 AIME 与 HMMT 八个设置中的七个提升 held-out accuracy，第八个持平，且无需额外前向传播。
Conclusion: 稠密的 token 级 log-ratio 监督会浪费在教师几乎未变的状态上，按 teacher-reference JSD 选择性施加监督即可在不增加前向开销的情况下提升蒸馏效果。

papers.title: CounterRoute: Self-Routed Reasoning via Hierarchical Counterfactual Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-capable language models often produce long chains of thought when direct answers suffice, wasting inference compute. Dual-mode models offer both thinking and direct-answer modes, but typically leave mode selection to users. Automating this selection while improving responses under both modes is challenging because routing targets evolve with the policy, strong initial mode preferences can destabilize exploration, and sequence-level objectives entangle routing with response learning. We introduce CounterRoute, an online reinforcement-learning framework that jointly learns routing and mode-conditioned responses in one shared policy directly from a native dual-mode checkpoint, without method-specific SFT warm-up. Paired current-policy counterfactual rollouts estimate cross-mode routing credit, which is assigned only to the routing token, while within-mode GRPO trains response tokens. A paired-to-self-routed curriculum stabilizes early training with forced coverage of both modes before progressively transferring training to autonomous routing. Across nine benchmarks, CounterRoute better balances accuracy and efficiency than heuristic and learned adaptive-routing methods, improving macro-average accuracy at both Qwen3 scales while cutting mean generated tokens by 51% and 41%, respectively, versus always-thinking checkpoints. On instruction-following and commonsense benchmarks where direct answering is strong, think rates fall as low as 1% while response quality improves. Despite training only on math and synthetic instruction-following data, its routing and response quality generalize to held-out tasks in coding, science, knowledge, and commonsense.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CounterRoute 是一个在线强化学习框架，让双模式模型在同一个共享策略里同时学路由和按模式生成的回答，直接从原生 dual-mode checkpoint 起训、无需方法特定的 SFT 热身。用当前策略的配对反事实 rollout 估计跨模式路由信用并只归给 routing token，模式内用 GRPO 训回答 token，再经 paired-to-self-routed 课程从强制双模式覆盖过渡到自主路由。在九个基准上，两个 Qwen3 规模的宏平均准确率均提升，同时相对 always-thinking checkpoint 平均生成 token 数分别减少 51% 和 41%。
Motivation: 推理模型常在可直接作答时仍输出长思维链，浪费推理算力；双模式模型虽有 thinking 与 direct-answer 两档，却把模式选择留给用户，而自动路由的难点在于路由目标随策略演化、强初始模式偏好会破坏探索、序列级目标把路由与回答学习纠缠在一起。
Method: 在线 RL 框架 CounterRoute：用当前策略的配对反事实 rollout 估计跨模式路由信用，只归给 routing token；模式内用 GRPO 训练回答 token；paired-to-self-routed 课程先强制覆盖两种模式再逐步交给自主路由；从原生 dual-mode checkpoint 直接训练，不做方法特定 SFT 热身，训练数据仅数学与合成指令跟随数据。
Result: 在九个基准上，两个 Qwen3 规模的宏平均准确率相对 always-thinking checkpoint 均提升，平均生成 token 数分别减少 51% 与 41%；在 direct answering 占优的指令跟随与常识基准上，think rate 最低降到 1%，同时回答质量提升；仅用数学与合成指令跟随数据训练，路由与回答质量可泛化到 coding、science、knowledge、commonsense 等留出任务。
Conclusion: 把跨模式路由信用与模式内回答学习拆开、并用课程稳定早期探索，可以在同一策略里同时改善准确率与推理开销；路由能力可从数学与合成指令跟随数据迁移到留出领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Harness Tokenomics: A Router for the Enterprise Agentic Control Plane
papers.abstract_en: Harnesses, the products that run AI coding agents, are multiplying, and enterprises are rolling them out to their employees. What started as pilots with a few hundred seats is now scaling to tens of thousands. Enterprises rarely build these harnesses and usually adopt the ones model vendors bundle with their seats and APIs, such as Anthropic's Claude Code or OpenAI's Codex. A harness decides which model answers, what the model reads, how the prompt cache is used and which subagents run, so it picks the rate on the price sheet and sets the volume bought at it. Enterprises that keep a proprietary or untuned harness at its defaults inherit these choices and their bill. We build a fast, customisable router in which Jev, a classifier with calibrated probabilities, labels every prompt against a bring-your-own taxonomy of agentic requests. One user turn is many requests over a prompt cache that belongs to one model, so the router moves work only where no running conversation has to rebuild its cache. It routes at session start, in side lanes and at subagent launch. From the price sheet we derive when a mid-task switch pays back. We also find a crossover, in which the highest-priced model costs less than the next tier on long tool-heavy sessions, and repricing about 10,000 real sessions from public datasets confirms it. In an emulated enterprise of 10,000 seats with user behaviour taken from these datasets, the router recovers 13 to 21% of model spend at Anthropic's list prices of 21 September 2026, \$3.3M to \$5.1M a year. The paper also maps the risks across twenty-one harnesses, prices the dependence on one vendor's models, and proposes a control plane that enterprises can run from within, starting now, with a ladder for deciding later whether to own the harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向企业 AI 编码 harness 的成本路由控制面：分类器 Jev 按自带 taxonomy 给每条 prompt 打带校准概率的标签，只在无需重建 prompt cache 的位置（会话开始、side lane、subagent 启动）切换模型，并从价目表推导中途切换的回本条件。在 10,000 席位的企业仿真中按 Anthropic 2026-09-21 牌价可回收 13–21% 的模型支出，即每年 330 万至 510 万美元。
Motivation: 企业把模型厂商捆绑的 harness 直接铺到上万席位，等于默认继承其选模型、读取内容、用 prompt cache 与派 subagent 的方式，账单也随之继承；缺少在企业内部可运行的成本与风险控制层。
Method: 构建可定制的快速 router：分类器 Jev 以校准概率把每条 prompt 归入 bring-your-own 的 agent 请求 taxonomy；因一个用户轮次对应同一模型 prompt cache 上的多次请求，只在没有运行中会话需要重建 cache 的位置路由（会话开始、side lane、subagent 启动）；从价目表推导中途切换的回本条件，并对约 10,000 个来自公开数据集的真实会话重新计价。
Result: 发现一个 crossover：在长的工具密集会话上，最高价模型的总成本低于次一档；约 10,000 个真实会话的重新计价证实该现象。在 10,000 席位、用户行为取自这些数据集的企业仿真中，按 Anthropic 2026-09-21 牌价每年回收 13–21% 的模型支出，即 330 万至 510 万美元。另对二十一个 harness 做了风险映射。
Conclusion: 企业应从现在起在内部运行该控制面，用价目表决定何时中途切换，并按一条阶梯决定日后是否自建 harness；保留默认 harness 会连同其成本选择一并继承。
Relevance: 1
