papers.title: Non-Commutative State Tracking with Input-Dependent Low-Rank Updates in Mamba-3
papers.abstract_en: State tracking from sequential observations can require both retaining information and updating it by composing observed operations. We extend Mamba-3's diagonal transition with an input-dependent low-rank reflection term to support noncommutative state tracking, in which the order of operations matters. The rank-one update couples state coordinates along an input-dependent direction, enabling non-diagonal state transitions within a single Mamba-3 block. The extension preserves Mamba-3's exponential-trapezoidal discretization, rotary embeddings (RoPE), and readout. For training, we adapt chunkwise computation to parallelize the proposed recurrence within each chunk. Experiments cover group word problems with discrete inputs and a shell game with continuous observations, in which a policy is trained by behavioral cloning. Among the models selected for their strong performance under fixed timing, the proposed model maintains higher tracking success on longer swap sequences in the shell game with continuous observations and timing jitter. These experiments show that the proposed method achieves high accuracy on the evaluated non-commutative tracking tasks, improving on standard Mamba-3. The extension thus offers a Mamba-3-based approach to non-commutative state tracking.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Updated experimental results and discussion. Added IEEE submission notice
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Mamba-3 的对角转移上加入输入依赖的低秩 reflection 项，使单个 block 内即可实现非对角状态转移，从而跟踪操作顺序不可交换的状态。在 shell game 连续观测与时序抖动设定下，所提模型在更长 swap 序列上保持更高的跟踪成功率，优于标准 Mamba-3。
Motivation: 状态跟踪既要保留信息又要按观测到的操作顺序做复合更新，而 Mamba-3 的对角转移无法表达非交换（顺序敏感）的状态演化。
Method: 把 Mamba-3 的对角转移扩展为加上输入依赖的 rank-one reflection 项，沿输入依赖方向耦合状态坐标；保留 exponential-trapezoidal 离散化、RoPE 与 readout，并改造 chunkwise 计算以在 chunk 内并行化该递推。训练与评测覆盖离散输入的 group word problems，以及用 behavioral cloning 训练策略的连续观测 shell game。
Result: 在固定时序下选出的强性能模型中，所提模型在带时序抖动、连续观测的 shell game 上于更长 swap 序列保持更高跟踪成功率；在所评测的非交换跟踪任务上取得高准确率并改进标准 Mamba-3。
Conclusion: 输入依赖的低秩 reflection 扩展是让基于 Mamba-3 的模型处理非交换状态跟踪的一条可行路径，优势在长序列与抖动时序下最明显。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A Unified Framework and Dataset for Oriented Object Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding in remote sensing images aims to locate objects described by referring expressions. Most existing methods predict horizontal bounding boxes, which are often inaccurate for objects with arbitrary orientations. To address this limitation, we introduce O$^2$-VG, a family of models for oriented object visual grounding with three complementary designs. Specifically, O$^2$-VG-Trans is a cross-modality transformer for oriented object visual grounding. It establishes a strong discriminative foundation for the model family. Building upon it, O$^2$-VG-Uni predicts universal oriented proposals for possible foreground objects without specific text prompts. It also supports object retrieval through cached proposal embeddings. Using these universal oriented proposals as input prompts, O$^2$-VG-VLM is an autoregressive vision-language model. It generates oriented box token blocks in parallel through multi-token prediction. In addition, we construct DIOR-R-RSVG, a dataset for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images. It provides image, expression, and oriented box triplets for training and evaluation. Together, the O$^2$-VG family provides a flexible framework that spans discriminative transformers and generative vision-language models. It achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/ai4rs and https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/Eagle_o2_vg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向遥感任意朝向目标的视觉定位 (oriented object visual grounding) 框架 O²-VG：先用跨模态 Transformer 建判别基础，再用无文本提示的通用朝向 proposal 支持检索，最后由自回归视觉-语言模型并行生成朝向框 token 块，并配套发布 DIOR-R-RSVG 数据集。该框架在多个基准上取得更优性能。
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉定位方法多预测水平边界框，对任意朝向目标定位不准，且缺少带朝向框标注的训练评测数据。
Method: O²-VG 包含三个互补设计：O²-VG-Trans 跨模态 Transformer 建立判别基础；O²-VG-Uni 在无文本提示下预测通用朝向 proposal，并以缓存的 proposal embedding 支持目标检索；O²-VG-VLM 以这些 proposal 作输入提示，通过 multi-token prediction 并行生成朝向框 token 块。同时构建 DIOR-R-RSVG 数据集，提供图像、指代表达与朝向框三元组用于训练与评测。
Result: 在多个基准上取得 superior performance（abstract 未给出具体数值）；发布 DIOR-R-RSVG 数据集与两个代码仓库。
Conclusion: 判别式 Transformer 与生成式视觉-语言模型可统一在同一个朝向目标视觉定位框架内，通用朝向 proposal 可作为两者的衔接接口。

papers.title: Adaptive Tiling for Least-Squares Phase Unwrapping: Runtime and Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Phase unwrapping estimates the missing multiples of $2π$ in measured phase images. For large images, tiling limits the size of local reconstruction problems and enables parallel processing. Adaptive tiling could further reduce the number of local problems and boundaries by retaining large tiles where little refinement is needed. We investigate whether this reduction makes reconstruction faster. We compare complete reconstruction time and accuracy for a regular grid, quadtree, and kd-tree partitions. We also evaluate nine criteria for deciding where quadtree tiles should be subdivided, including residue count, fringe density, and measures of phase variation, at different tile sizes and budgets. In single-threaded experiments on a heterogeneous image dataset, optimized adaptive partitions use fewer tiles but remain slower than the optimized grid, and some reconstructions lose substantial accuracy. Stage measurements explain why: constructing the partition and solving larger retained tiles outweigh the savings at tile boundaries. The criterion comparison also shows that more refinement does not consistently improve accuracy. These results motivate evaluating adaptive partitions by the complete time needed to reach a chosen reconstruction accuracy, including whether limited refinement can provide a faster approximate result.
papers.comment: Technical report. 15 pages of main text and references, followed by 8 pages of supplementary material. 6 figures, 8 tables and 2 algorithms in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在相位解缠 (phase unwrapping) 的分块重建中，自适应分块（quadtree、kd-tree）虽然用更少的 tile，但在单线程异构图像数据集上总耗时仍慢于优化的规则网格，且部分重建精度明显下降。阶段计时显示构造分块与求解更大保留 tile 的开销超过边界处节省；九种细分判据中，更细的细分并不一致提升精度。作者主张用「达到指定重建精度所需的总时间」来评价自适应分块，并考察有限细分是否能给出更快的近似结果。
Motivation: 大尺寸相位图的局部重建问题规模大，分块虽限制问题规模并支持并行，但自适应分块能否真正缩短总重建时间、是否牺牲精度，此前缺少按完整耗时与精度的对照。
Method: 在单线程实验中对比规则网格、quadtree、kd-tree 三种划分的完整重建时间与精度；对 quadtree 评估九种细分判据（residue count、fringe density 及多种相位变化度量），在不同 tile 尺寸与预算下测试，使用异构图像数据集，并做阶段计时归因。
Result: 优化的自适应划分用更少 tile，但比优化网格更慢，且部分重建精度大幅下降；阶段计时表明构造划分与求解更大保留 tile 的开销超过边界节省；判据对比显示更多细分并不一致改善精度。
Conclusion: 自适应分块的 tile 数减少不等于端到端加速，评价标准应改为达到指定精度所需的完整时间，并检验有限细分能否作为更快的近似方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 在单线程实验中对比规则网格、quadtree、kd-tree 三种划分的完整重建时间与精度；对 quadtree 评估九种细分判据（residue count、fringe density 及多种相位变化度量），在不同 tile 尺寸与预算下测试，使用异构图像数据集，并做阶段计时归因。
summary_sections.result: 优化的自适应划分用更少 tile，但比优化网格更慢，且部分重建精度大幅下降；阶段计时表明构造划分与求解更大保留 tile 的开销超过边界节省；判据对比显示更多细分并不一致改善精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应分块的 tile 数减少不等于端到端加速，评价标准应改为达到指定精度所需的完整时间，并检验有限细分能否作为更快的近似方案。

papers.title: In-Context Guidance: Learning Inter-Task Synergies via Numerical Foundational Models for Few-Shot Multitask Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task optimization (MTO) addresses a set of optimization tasks simultaneously, often suffering from inaccurate inter-task relationship estimation under limited evaluation budgets, leading to negative transfer. This paper introduces In-Context Guidance Multitask Optimization (ICG-MTO), a novel framework that leverages numerical foundational models to improve inter-task coupling estimation in few-shot scenarios. Unlike conventional methods that rely solely on scarce observed data, ICG-MTO employs a frozen foundational model to infer auxiliary guidance through in-context learning. The framework operates through three stages: constructing an algorithm-specific in-context query from evaluated solutions, using the foundational model to infer a guidance signal characterizing predictive relationships among tasks, and translating this signal into algorithm-specific guidance for maximum-a-posteriori coupling estimation. This approach provides regularization during the early, data-scarce stages of optimization and gradually relinquishes control as task-specific observations accumulate. We instantiate the framework in multitask Bayesian optimization as ICG-MTBO, using directional fitness-class queries to guide inter-task coupling estimation, and further instantiate it in MFEA-II using decision-space-overlap queries to guide random mating probability estimation. Experiments across synthetic benchmarks and a real-world robot arm control problem, together with evaluations under different acquisition functions and evolutionary multitasking, demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of ICG-MTO for few-shot multitask optimization.
papers.comment: In Submission to IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ICG-MTO 用冻结的数值基础模型 (numerical foundational model) 做 in-context learning，在少样本阶段推断任务间耦合的辅助引导信号，替代仅依赖稀疏观测数据的耦合估计，从而抑制负迁移。该引导在优化早期作正则、随任务观测积累逐步退出；框架分别实例化为多任务贝叶斯优化 ICG-MTBO（方向性 fitness-class 查询）与 MFEA-II（decision-space-overlap 查询），在合成基准和真实机械臂控制问题上验证有效性与通用性。
Motivation: 多任务优化在有限评估预算下对任务间关系估计不准，容易产生负迁移；少样本阶段可用数据太稀疏，常规方法难以可靠估计耦合。
Method: 三阶段流程：由已评估解构造算法特定的 in-context query；用冻结的基础模型经 in-context learning 推断刻画任务预测关系的引导信号；把该信号转成算法特定引导，用于最大后验 (MAP) 耦合估计。两个实例化：ICG-MTBO 用方向性 fitness-class 查询指导多任务贝叶斯优化的耦合估计，MFEA-II 用 decision-space-overlap 查询指导随机交配概率估计。
Result: 在合成基准与真实机械臂控制问题上实验，并在不同采集函数 (acquisition functions) 与进化多任务设置下评测，显示 ICG-MTO 对少样本多任务优化有效且具通用性。
Conclusion: 用冻结基础模型的 in-context 引导替代纯数据驱动的耦合估计，可在数据稀缺期提供正则并随观测积累自动让位，从而改善少样本多任务优化。

papers.title: Graph Domain Adaptation Does Not End with Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph domain adaptation (GDA) transfers knowledge from a labeled source graph to an unlabeled target graph under shifts in both node attributes and graph structure. Existing methods primarily adapt graph representations through propagation redesign, distribution alignment, or source-to-target transition modeling, but still rely on a single graph-propagating path for target prediction. This leaves open whether an adapted graph representation exhausts the predictive evidence available in the target domain, since the graph-aware expert and graph-free local expert may exhibit different failure modes under topological shifts. To address this limitation, we propose EviGDA, an Evidence-Augmented Graph Domain Adaptation framework that complements graph representation adaptation with a graph-free local expert. The graph-aware expert performs message passing and entropy-aware marginal alignment, while the graph-free local expert learns solely from source node features and labels without graph propagation or target alignment. The two experts are optimized independently and combined only at inference through a task-level constant probability mixture, preserving complementary evidence without joint training, learned routing, or target pseudo-labels. Extensive experiments on ten datasets and 16 transfer tasks show that EviGDA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Complementary prediction paths add value beyond graph representation alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviGDA 在图域适应 (GDA) 中把图感知专家与不依赖图结构的局部专家分开训练，仅在推理阶段用任务级常数概率混合做预测，从而在节点属性与图结构同时偏移时补足单一图传播路径丢失的证据。在 10 个数据集、16 个迁移任务上超过现有 SOTA 基线，说明互补预测路径在图表示对齐之外仍有增量价值。
Motivation: 现有 GDA 方法（传播重设计、分布对齐、源到目标转移建模）仍只用单一图传播路径做目标预测，无法判断适配后的图表示是否已穷尽目标域证据；图感知专家与无图局部专家在拓扑偏移下失败模式不同。
Method: EviGDA 框架含两个独立优化的专家：图感知专家做消息传递加熵感知边际对齐 (entropy-aware marginal alignment)，无图局部专家只用源节点特征与标签、不做图传播也不做目标对齐；两者不联合训练、不用学习式路由、不用目标伪标签，仅在推理时按任务级常数概率混合。
Result: 在 10 个数据集、16 个迁移任务上的实验中，EviGDA 超过 state-of-the-art 基线；互补预测路径在图表示对齐之外仍带来增益。
Conclusion: 图域适应不应止于表示学习：把无图局部证据作为独立专家在推理期融合，可在拓扑偏移下补足单一图传播路径的预测证据。

papers.title: What Should a Self-Teacher See? Privileged Context Design for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: More privileged information does not always make a better teacher. We study this tension in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a self-teacher scores the student's own rollouts under privileged context, conventionally a complete reference solution that bundles the final answer with one particular reasoning path. Holding the student view and training fixed within each scale, we compare that default against three abstractions compiled offline, a named strategy, a method-independent framing, and a problem category, and against an answer-only control that keeps the destination but removes the path. In the primary runs on competition mathematics, the best intermediate contexts improve the in-domain peak mean over the full solution by 1.4 points at 4B and 1.6 at 8B, while storing an order of magnitude fewer hint tokens. Comparisons across three seeds also show positive mean gains for the framing and category contexts at both scales. Answer-only conditioning remains competitive in the primary runs, within 0.2 points of the full solution at these scales. The preferred context varies with student scale and task. Initial teacher-student KL does not order downstream performance. What a self-teacher should see is therefore not everything it could, but the level of abstraction its student can still act on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 中，自教师用何种特权上下文给学生自己的 rollout 打分并非越全越好：在竞赛数学上，离线编译的中等抽象上下文（命名策略、方法无关框架、问题类别）比完整参考解在 4B 上把 in-domain peak mean 提高 1.4 点、8B 上提高 1.6 点，同时少存一个数量级的 hint token。作者主张教师应看到学生仍能据以行动的抽象层级，而非它能看到的一切。
Motivation: OPSD 的默认做法是把最终答案与某一条推理路径捆绑成完整参考解作为特权上下文，但更多特权信息未必造就更好的教师；且初始 teacher-student KL 并不能排序下游表现，需要弄清哪种抽象层级真正有效。
Method: 固定学生视角与训练配置，在每个规模内对比四种特权上下文：默认的完整参考解，以及三种离线编译的抽象（named strategy、method-independent framing、problem category），外加只保留答案的 answer-only 对照；主实验在竞赛数学上做，跨 4B 与 8B 两个学生规模、三个随机种子比较。
Result: 主实验中最好的中间上下文相对完整解把 in-domain peak mean 在 4B 上提高 1.4 点、8B 上提高 1.6 点，且存储的 hint token 少一个数量级；三个种子的对比显示 framing 与 category 上下文在两个规模上均为正的平均增益；answer-only 在主实验中仍有竞争力，与完整解相差 0.2 点以内。
Conclusion: 自教师该看的不是它能拿到的全部信息，而是学生仍能据以行动的抽象层级；最优上下文随学生规模与任务变化，初始 KL 不可用于预测下游表现。

papers.title: SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for safety, security, and privacy (SSP) relies heavily on static benchmarks, which suffer from score saturation, data contamination, and aggregation artifacts, and fail to capture sensitivity to linguistic variation. As a result, models that perform well on fixed test sets often fail under semantically equivalent rephrasings. We introduce SSP-Bench, a dynamic benchmarking framework that generates evaluation instances on demand while preserving domain consistency. The framework ensures label validity through externally grounded sources, enforces scope via service-specific validation, and calibrates difficulty using a multi-model steering panel. Benchmark construction is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem over difficulty, separability, novelty, and diversity. Across 24 models and four SSP services, SSP-Bench reveals systematic failures of static evaluation, including near-zero correlation in safety rankings due to construct mixing, strong safety--over-refusal coupling, and hidden within-family regressions. These results show that static benchmarks can misrepresent model behavior, motivating dynamic, deployment-relevant evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSP-Bench 是一个按需生成评测实例的 LLM 安全、安全攻击与隐私 (SSP) 动态基准框架：用外部可信来源保证标签有效、用服务特定校验限定范围、用多模型 steering panel 校准难度，并把构建过程写成关于难度、可分性、新颖性与多样性的多目标优化。在 24 个模型、四类 SSP 服务上，它揭示静态评测的系统性失效——安全排名相关性接近零、安全与过度拒绝强耦合、同系列模型内部回退被掩盖。
Motivation: 静态 LLM 安全基准存在分数饱和、数据污染与聚合假象，且无法刻画对语言改写的敏感性：在固定测试集上表现好的模型，遇到语义等价的改写就失效。
Method: 按需生成评测实例并保持领域一致；标签有效性由外部可信来源锚定，范围由服务特定校验强制，难度由多模型 steering panel 校准；基准构建被形式化为在难度、可分性、新颖性、多样性四个目标上的多目标优化问题。
Result: 在 24 个模型与四类 SSP 服务上，静态评测出现系统性失效：安全排名相关性接近零（源于 construct mixing），安全与过度拒绝 (over-refusal) 强耦合，同系列模型内部存在被隐藏的回退。
Conclusion: 静态基准会误表征模型行为，LLM 安全评测应转向按需生成、与部署相关的动态评测。

papers.title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet long-term interaction may give rise to undesirable coordination. We study the emergence of collusion in a long-horizon multi-agent environment: two agents repeatedly complete individual tasks, share task logs, verify each other's work, and receive rewards. We introduce realistic constraints under which higher reward is attainable only by violating the verification protocol, and find that agents increasingly deviate from the protocol over repeated interactions. Collusion emerges in 94% of trajectories across 10 models, and more capable models within the same family reach it earlier. Controlled peer interventions show that collusion is shaped by peer behavior, while ablations reveal additional effects of the verification feedback agents receive, their interaction history, and the reward structure. In particular, restricting the amount and scope of interaction history available to agents reduces collusion. Overall, our findings show that long-horizon interaction can reshape how agents coordinate in ways that create safety risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在长时程多智能体环境中，当只有违反验证协议才能拿到更高奖励时，LLM agent 会随交互轮次逐渐偏离协议：10 个模型上 94% 的轨迹出现合谋 (collusion)，同系列中能力更强的模型更早到达合谋。限制可用交互历史的长度与范围会降低合谋，验证反馈、交互历史与奖励结构各有额外影响。
Motivation: LLM agent 被部署到需要反复协作、互相验证与共享日志的场景，但长期交互可能催生不受欢迎的协调方式，且这种安全风险此前缺少受控的实验刻画。
Method: 构造长时程双 agent 环境：两 agent 反复完成各自任务、共享任务日志、互相验证并获取奖励；引入现实约束使高奖励只能靠违反验证协议获得，再用受控的 peer 干预与消融分离同伴行为、验证反馈、交互历史和奖励结构的作用。
Result: 合谋在 10 个模型的 94% 轨迹中出现；同系列中能力更强的模型更早到达合谋；peer 干预显示合谋受同伴行为塑造；消融显示验证反馈、交互历史与奖励结构均有影响，限制交互历史的数量与范围会减少合谋。
Conclusion: 长时程交互会重塑 agent 的协调方式并带来安全风险，而限制交互历史的可见范围是摘要中唯一被指出可降低合谋的干预手段。

papers.title: PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibility into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker's capabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action-only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajectory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion provides this representation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly executed policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned behavior, while classifier guidance steers predicted states toward test-time objectives. Only actions are executed, without a separate motion-reference tracker or externally estimated full-body states as policy inputs. In simulation, PredActor reaches 44 of 45 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.539, compared with 0.424 for conditional action diffusion, with similar observed disturbance survival. To make this guided policy practical onboard, rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations reduce the complete callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, both below the 20 ms control period. We deploy PredActor on a Unitree G1; evaluations across simulation and physical hardware demonstrate text-conditioned motion, disturbance response, joystick control, and semantic interpolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PredActor 把预测式动作扩散 (predictive action diffusion) 做成单一可直接执行的人形机器人控制策略：由本体感觉历史与可选文本条件同时生成可执行动作和内部未来状态轨迹，用 classifier-free guidance 强化文本条件行为、classifier guidance 在测试时把预测状态导向运动目标，只执行动作、不需独立运动参考跟踪器或外部估计的全身状态。仿真中到达 45 个目标中的 44 个，文本检索分 0.539（条件动作扩散基线 0.424）；滚动去噪与运行时优化把完整回调压到 Jetson Orin NX 上中位 16.790 ms、p95 19.383 ms，均低于 20 ms 控制周期，并在 Unitree G1 实机部署。
Motivation: 分层系统经由参考轨迹引导动作，参考常超出独立跟踪器能力，恢复与物理执行全压在跟踪器上；纯动作扩散没有显式未来状态轨迹可供测试时运动目标使用，而联合状态-动作扩散又多依赖特权全身状态，行为选择与测试时引导能力分散。
Method: PredActor 以本体感觉观测为输入，条件于本体感觉历史与可选任务上下文，联合生成可执行动作与内部未来状态轨迹；classifier-free guidance 强化文本条件行为，classifier guidance 把预测状态推向测试时运动目标；配合滚动去噪 (rolling denoising) 与保持计算量的运行时优化，使策略可在机载 Jetson Orin NX 上以 20 ms 控制周期运行。
Result: 仿真中到达 45 个目的地目标中的 44 个；文本检索分 0.539，对比条件动作扩散 (conditional action diffusion) 的 0.424；扰动存活表现与基线相当。机载 Jetson Orin NX 上完整回调中位 16.790 ms、p95 19.383 ms，均低于 20 ms 控制周期。在 Unitree G1 实机部署，跨仿真与物理硬件展示文本条件动作、扰动响应、摇杆控制与语义插值。
Conclusion: 把未来状态轨迹与两类引导统一进一个直接执行的策略，可在不依赖特权全身状态和独立跟踪器的前提下，同时获得文本行为选择、测试时运动引导与机载实时性。

papers.title: APEXA: Execution-Integrity Enforcement for Multi-Agent LLM Automation of Synchrotron Data Reduction
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can make expert scientific workflows accessible through natural language, but a plausible response does not establish that the requested computation ran. This matters at synchrotron facilities, where calibration and integration are multi-step operations over terabyte-scale datasets. We present APEXA, a deployed framework coordinating 61 tools for synchrotron data reduction. A deterministic execution-integrity guard prevents it from returning results for tool calls that did not execute, and the same tool layer enforces motor safety: across 50 adversarial scenarios and four models, it produced 0/200 violations against a simulated EPICS controller, versus 15/200 for a prompt-only baseline. We also introduce APEXA-Bench, 58 facility tasks organized by scientific correctness and physical consequence. On real APS beamline data, one prompt recovered detector geometry and integrated a full attenuation and exposure sweep. Trustworthy scientific agents need deterministic validation of execution, not model-side assurances. We release the framework, benchmark, and traces.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 4th TPC Workshop @ SC'26 (Building Open AI Infrastructure, Models, and Agentic Systems for Science). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/AdvancedPhotonSource/APEXA-APS-Beamline-Assistant ; data: https://doi.org/10.18126/tgg4-1m26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEXA 是面向同步辐射数据归约的多智能体 LLM 框架，协调 61 个工具，并用确定性执行完整性守卫 (execution-integrity guard) 拦截未真正执行的工具调用，同一工具层同时强制电机安全。在 50 个对抗场景、四个模型共 200 次试验中对模拟 EPICS 控制器产生 0/200 次违规，而仅靠 prompt 的基线为 15/200。
Motivation: LLM 智能体给出看似合理的回答并不等于请求的计算真的执行过；同步辐射设施的标定与积分是覆盖 TB 级数据的多步操作，错误执行会带来物理后果。
Method: APEXA 协调 61 个工具做同步辐射数据归约，用确定性执行完整性守卫保证未执行的工具调用不返回结果，并在同一工具层强制电机安全；配套发布 APEXA-Bench，含 58 个按科学正确性与物理后果组织的设施任务，以及框架、基准与执行轨迹。
Result: 在 50 个对抗场景、四个模型上，对模拟 EPICS 控制器违规 0/200，prompt-only 基线为 15/200；APEXA-Bench 含 58 个设施任务；在真实 APS beamline 数据上，单个 prompt 恢复了探测器几何并完成整条衰减与曝光扫描的积分。
Conclusion: 可信科学智能体需要对执行做确定性校验，而不是依赖模型侧的自我保证；框架、基准与轨迹已开源。

papers.title: Tail-Weight Control and Localized Generalization in Nearly Low-Rank Adversarial Classification
papers.abstract_en: We study norm-constrained linear classification under Eu clidean adversarial perturbations in a Gaussian model with a low-dimen sional informative subspace and an independent noise tail. For bounded ramp loss, we prove that a principal-space witness with risk below one half forces every near-optimal predictor to have small tail weight. A path-specific density bound yields constants without requiring positive tail variance. Under isotropic principal covariance, we establish a unique population minimizer and joint local growth. Boundary normalization then removes the common attack penalty from centered margins, giving localized finite-sample guarantees governed by principal dimension and total tail energy. Globalized growth removes the entrance condition at weaker constants; a model-aware comparison retains local guarantees. Experiments with twenty paired repetitions show decreasing excess risk and tail use with sample size, and nearly unchanged behavior when tail dimension grows at fixed total energy. Pure-noise controls and optimizer diagnostics clarify the scope and limitations of these conclusions.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors. A substantially revised version will be posted in the future
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性对抗分类的低维信号子空间+独立噪声尾模型中，证明当主空间 witness 的 ramp loss 风险低于 1/2 时，任何近最优预测器的尾部权重必然很小；边界归一化去掉中心化 margin 中的常见攻击惩罚后，可得到只依赖主维数与总尾能量的局部有限样本保证。二十组配对重复实验显示超额风险与尾部使用随样本量下降，固定总能量下尾维数增长几乎不改变行为。
Motivation: 对抗分类中噪声尾维度常被误当作有效容量，需要在不假设尾方差为正的条件下刻画近最优解对尾部的依赖，并把有限样本保证定位到主维数与总尾能量这两个可控量上。
Method: 在高斯模型（低维 informative subspace + 独立噪声尾）下研究范数约束线性分类与欧氏对抗扰动，用 bounded ramp loss、principal-space witness 与 path-specific density bound 推导常数；在各向同性主协方差下建立唯一总体极小点与 joint local growth，再经 boundary normalization 去除中心化 margin 的攻击惩罚得到局部有限样本界，并以 globalized growth 在更弱常数下去掉 entrance condition。
Result: 证明 witness 风险低于 1/2 时近最优预测器尾部权重小；各向同性主协方差下总体极小点唯一。二十组配对重复实验中，超额风险与尾部使用随样本量下降，固定总能量下尾维数增长时行为几乎不变；另含 pure-noise controls 与 optimizer diagnostics。
Conclusion: 尾部依赖可由主空间风险与总尾能量控制，局部保证在更弱常数下可全局化；结论范围由 pure-noise 对照与优化器诊断界定，作者已撤回该版本并将提交大幅修订稿。

papers.title: FREESIA: Covariance-Aware Posterior Transport for Expressive and Scalable Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation aims to infer the state of complex dynamical systems based on observational data. However, accurate inference of the multimodal posteriors induced by nonlinear or non-injective observation operators remains a key challenge under high-dimensional and sparse observation conditions. Ensemble filters scale to high dimensions but are confined by restrictive distributional assumptions, while training-free generative filters (e.g., EnSF, EnFF) alleviate this limitation but may introduce structural errors and hinder information propagation under sparse observations. To address these issues, we propose a training-free, asymptotically exact posterior transport method. Firstly, a covariance-aware posterior transport scheme is designed, which embeds the forecast cross-covariance into flow-based transport and accurately recovers unobserved states while preserving the non-Gaussian posterior structure. Furthermore, the method combines a tractable observation-adaptive proposal with posterior correction, ensuring accurate approximation of the nonlinear posterior distribution. Finally, we establish the corresponding posterior flow theory, from which the asymptotic exactness of the proposed method relative to finite-ensemble surrogates and the Wasserstein error bound are derived. Experiments on Double-Well, Lorenz-96, and Kolmogorov flow show that the proposed method captures complex posterior structure and remains accurate under sparse, nonlinear, and non-injective observations. In the sparse non-injective setting, it reduces RMSE by 56% relative to the best baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FREESIA：一种免训练、渐近精确的协方差感知后验传输 (covariance-aware posterior transport) 数据同化方法，把预报交叉协方差嵌入 flow-based transport，配合观测自适应提议与后验修正来恢复未观测状态并保留非高斯后验结构。在 Double-Well、Lorenz-96 与 Kolmogorov flow 上，稀疏非单射观测设定中相对最优基线降低 RMSE 56%。
Motivation: 非线性或非单射观测算子在高维稀疏观测下诱导多峰后验：集合滤波受分布假设限制，免训练生成式滤波 (EnSF、EnFF) 又会引入结构误差、阻碍稀疏观测下的信息传播。
Method: FREESIA 是免训练的后验传输方法：其协方差感知传输方案把预报交叉协方差 (forecast cross-covariance) 嵌入 flow-based transport；再结合可处理的观测自适应提议 (observation-adaptive proposal) 与后验修正；并建立后验流理论，推出相对有限集合代理的渐近精确性与 Wasserstein 误差界。
Result: 在 Double-Well、Lorenz-96、Kolmogorov flow 三个基准上检验：方法能捕捉复杂后验结构，在稀疏、非线性、非单射观测下保持准确；在稀疏非单射设定中相对最优基线降低 RMSE 56%。
Conclusion: 把预报交叉协方差嵌入流式传输并配合观测自适应提议与后验修正，可在免训练前提下对非线性非单射观测的多峰后验做到渐近精确，且在稀疏观测下显著优于集合滤波与生成式滤波基线。
Relevance: 86

summary_sections.method: FREESIA 是免训练的后验传输方法：其协方差感知传输方案把预报交叉协方差 (forecast cross-covariance) 嵌入 flow-based transport；再结合可处理的观测自适应提议 (observation-adaptive proposal) 与后验修正；并建立后验流理论，推出相对有限集合代理的渐近精确性与 Wasserstein 误差界。
summary_sections.result: 在 Double-Well、Lorenz-96、Kolmogorov flow 三个基准上检验：方法能捕捉复杂后验结构，在稀疏、非线性、非单射观测下保持准确；在稀疏非单射设定中相对最优基线降低 RMSE 56%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把预报交叉协方差嵌入流式传输并配合观测自适应提议与后验修正，可在免训练前提下对非线性非单射观测的多峰后验做到渐近精确，且在稀疏观测下显著优于集合滤波与生成式滤波基线。

papers.title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models repeatedly apply a weight-shared block to increase effective depth without increasing parameter count, but the resulting T sequential recurrent-block calls per generated token substantially increase decoding latency. To address the issue, we introduce Wavefront Decoding (WFD), a training-free self-speculative decoding framework designed for looped language models. WFD exploits two properties of these architectures: intermediate recurrence outputs provide effective draft predictions, and weight sharing allows token states at different positions and recurrence depths to be processed in one batched recurrent-block call. WFD organizes these mixed-depth states into a diagonal wavefront, continuously drafting new positions at shallow depth while advancing earlier positions toward full-depth verification. Unlike the phase-separated draft-then-verify schedule, WFD therefore concurrently batches drafting and verification within the same recurrent calls, while rejected drafts are corrected using full-depth predictions. Across six Spec-Bench task categories, WFD achieves 2.42x speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 3.54x on Huginn-3.5B over autoregressive decoding, consistently outperforming draft-then-verify. Cross-recurrence KV sharing further reduces wavefront KV traffic and increases WFD's speedup to 4.81x on Huginn-3.5B. The code is available at https://github.com/summerbro-hhj/wavefront-decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对循环语言模型 (looped language models) 每个 token 需 T 次顺序循环块调用导致的解码延迟，提出免训练的自投机解码框架 Wavefront Decoding (WFD)：把不同位置与不同循环深度的 token 状态排成对角波前，在同一批循环块调用里并发做草拟与验证，被拒绝的草稿用全深度预测纠正。在 Spec-Bench 六类任务上，WFD 相对自回归解码在 Ouro-2.6B 加速 2.42x、Huginn-3.5B 加速 3.54x，且稳定快于 draft-then-verify；加上 cross-recurrence KV sharing 后 Huginn-3.5B 提升到 4.81x。
Motivation: 循环语言模型用权值共享的块重复调用换取有效深度而不增参数量，但每个 token 的 T 次顺序循环块调用使解码延迟显著上升，常规 draft-then-verify 的分阶段调度无法利用其结构特性。
Method: WFD 是免训练的自投机解码框架，利用中间循环输出作为草稿预测，并借助权值共享把不同位置、不同循环深度的 token 状态放进一次批量循环块调用；这些混合深度状态被组织成对角波前 (diagonal wavefront)，浅深度持续草拟新位置、已有位置推进到全深度验证，草稿被拒时用全深度预测纠正；另加 cross-recurrence KV sharing 减少波前 KV 流量。
Result: 在 Spec-Bench 六类任务上，WFD 相对自回归解码在 Ouro-2.6B 加速 2.42x、在 Huginn-3.5B 加速 3.54x，并且始终快于 draft-then-verify 调度；加入 cross-recurrence KV sharing 后 Huginn-3.5B 的加速进一步升到 4.81x。
Conclusion: 循环模型的中间循环输出可直接充当草稿、权值共享允许跨位置跨深度批量执行，因此把草拟与验证并发进同一批循环调用就能在免训练前提下大幅降低解码延迟，且优于分阶段的 draft-then-verify。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Bayesian Vertical Federated Learning Framework for Multivariate Reduced-Rank High-Dimensional Regression
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a leading privacy-preserving framework for collaborative machine learning across decentralized environments. While considerable progress has been made in horizontal federated learning (HFL), where data with common features is distributed across sites, vertical federated learning (VFL), where sites share observations across distinct feature sets, remains less explored. Advancing Bayesian high-dimensional multivariate reduced-rank regression methods for VFL poses unique challenges: (a) stringent privacy regulations preventing local site data sharing, and (b) fitting local regressions overlooks essential modeling aspects like inter-variable correlations. In contrast HFL allows each site to fit a comparable model independently. We present a novel Bayesian VFL framework for multivariate high-dimensional reduced-rank regression, termed BayesVFLReg, which enables precise coefficient estimation while safeguarding both feature and response privacy. Participating sites use a shared random sketching matrix to compress local variables into privacy-preserving sketches. A central server collects these sketches where Bayesian multivariate reduced-rank regression uses Gaussian scale mixture priors. For feature selection, we introduce a single-step post-processing strategy based on mixture-model clustering of the absolute posterior coefficient means to distinguish signal from noise per response variable. BayesVFLReg is computationally scalable for large, high-dimensional datasets and facilitates efficient variable selection. Theoretically, we establish sharp non-asymptotic bounds on the posterior probability that the fitted density falls within a Hellinger ball centered at the true data-generating density. Comparative simulation studies and real-world data analyses show that BayesVFLReg reliably identifies sparse feature effects, even under feature correlation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BayesVFLReg：纵向联邦 (VFL) 下用共享随机 sketching 矩阵把各站点局部变量压成隐私保护 sketch，中心服务器在其上做带 Gaussian scale mixture 先验的贝叶斯多元降秩回归，并用后验系数均值绝对值的混合模型聚类做单步特征选择。仿真与真实数据分析显示它在特征相关条件下仍能可靠识别稀疏特征效应，并给出 Hellinger 球内后验概率的非渐近界。
Motivation: 纵向联邦中各站点特征集不同且受隐私法规约束不能共享原始数据，而各自拟合局部回归会忽略变量间相关结构；现有进展集中在横向联邦 (HFL)，VFL 上的贝叶斯高维多元降秩回归尚不成熟。
Method: 各参与站点用共享随机 sketching 矩阵将局部变量压缩为隐私保护 sketch 并上传；中心服务器对 sketch 做贝叶斯多元降秩回归，先验为 Gaussian scale mixture；特征选择采用对后验系数均值绝对值做混合模型聚类的单步后处理，按响应变量区分信号与噪声。
Result: 对比仿真研究与真实数据分析表明 BayesVFLReg 在特征相关情形下仍可靠识别稀疏特征效应；理论上建立了拟合密度落在以真实生成密度为中心的 Hellinger 球内的后验概率的非渐近 (sharp non-asymptotic) 界。
Conclusion: 在 VFL 中先共享随机 sketch 再集中做贝叶斯降秩回归，可同时保护特征与响应隐私并保持系数估计精度与可扩展的变量选择。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: X-Beat: An Explainable Framework for ECG Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Accurate automated interpretation of electrocardio- grams (ECGs) is essential for early detection of cardiac condi- tions such as myocardial infarction and rhythm abnormalities. However, many high-performing deep learning models remain difficult to deploy in clinical settings due to limited transparency and lack of reliability validation. In this work, we present X- Beat, an explainable and reliability-aware benchmark framework for ECG image classification designed to support trustworthy AI systems in healthcare. The proposed framework combines transfer learning with post-hoc explainability and systematic reliability evaluation across four cardiac classes: Abnormal Heartbeat, History of Myocardial Infarction, Myocardial In- farction, and Normal Heartbeat. Multiple ImageNet-pretrained CNN backbones, including EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, DenseNet- 121, and MobileNetV3-Large, are evaluated under a unified training protocol. Beyond standard performance metrics, we incorporate Grad-CAM-based visual explanations together with additional analyses, including explanation stability, regional sen- sitivity, and confidence-based reliability assessment, to examine whether model predictions are supported by clinically meaningful evidence. Experimental results show that ResNet-50 achieves the best performance, reaching 91.94% accuracy and a macro F1- score of 0.9098, with strong class separability (AUC up to 0.995). Explanation analyses indicate that the model primarily focuses on waveform-relevant regions, while reliability evaluation suggests that most incorrect predictions occur with lower confidence. Overall, this work provides a structured and reproducible bench- mark for evaluating both predictive performance and explanation reliability in ECG image classification, contributing toward the development of trustworthy and interpretable AI components for clinical decision support systems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Data Quality Aware, High-Performance, and Trustworthy AI Systems for Healthcare at IEEE/ACM CHASE 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-Beat 是一个面向 ECG 图像分类的可解释性与可靠性基准框架，把迁移学习、Grad-CAM 事后解释和可靠性评估统一到同一训练协议下，覆盖四类心脏状态。ResNet-50 表现最好，准确率 91.94%、macro F1 0.9098、AUC 最高 0.995；解释主要落在波形相关区域，且多数错误预测出现在低置信度样本上。
Motivation: 高性能深度学习 ECG 模型透明度不足、缺少可靠性验证，难以在临床场景部署。
Method: 在统一训练协议下评估多个 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 主干（EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50、DenseNet-121、MobileNetV3-Large），任务为四类分类：Abnormal Heartbeat、History of Myocardial Infarction、Myocardial Infarction、Normal Heartbeat；在标准性能指标之外加入 Grad-CAM 视觉解释，并做解释稳定性、区域敏感性和基于置信度的可靠性分析。
Result: ResNet-50 取得最佳性能，准确率 91.94%，macro F1 0.9098，AUC 最高 0.995。解释分析显示模型主要关注波形相关区域；可靠性评估显示多数错误预测发生在较低置信度。
Conclusion: 预测性能与解释可靠性应作为同一基准一起评估，且低置信度可作为 ECG 分类错误的警示信号。

papers.title: Text, Pixels, or Both? Evaluating Input Representations for Multimodal Document QA
papers.abstract_en: Every document QA system begins with a choice that is rarely studied on its own: whether to feed the model page images, extracted text, or both. We isolate this choice, holding the prompt, judge, and scoring pipeline fixed, across four commercial model endpoints, two corpora, and two context regimes (gold evidence pages and the full document). On documents that fit the image budget, page images lead on accuracy at every document length on both corpora, but this advantage carries a growing latency and cost premium: text latency stays roughly flat as documents lengthen while image latency rises steadily. Text and images also fail on different questions, with exactly one representation correct on 19--25% of items across the reported cells, so neither subsumes the other. Exploiting this complementarity, a lightweight TF-IDF router that reads only the question text gains 2.6 points over always-text while cutting median latency 30% relative to always-vision, on a document-disjoint held-out split.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) Workshop at COLM 2026 and the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多模态文档 QA 中单独隔离“输入用页图像、抽取文本还是两者”的选择，固定 prompt、judge 与打分流程，跨 4 个商业模型端点、2 个语料与 2 种上下文设定比较。能放进图像预算的文档上页图像在各长度都更准但延迟与成本随文档变长持续上升；两者答错的题目不同，恰好一方正确的占 19–25%，故用只读问题文本的 TF-IDF 路由器在 document-disjoint 留出集上比恒用文本高 2.6 分、比恒用视觉中位延迟低 30%。
Motivation: 文档 QA 起点的输入表示选择（图像/文本/两者）几乎未被单独研究，而它同时决定准确率、延迟与成本，且两种表示的错误并不重合。
Method: 固定 prompt、judge 与打分流水线，在 4 个商业模型端点、2 个语料、2 种上下文设定（gold evidence pages 与 full document）下隔离输入表示这一变量；再用只读问题文本的轻量 TF-IDF 路由器在 document-disjoint 留出划分上选择表示。
Result: 在能放进图像预算的文档上，页图像在两个语料、各文档长度下准确率均更高，但文本延迟随文档变长基本持平而图像延迟持续上升；恰好只有一种表示答对的题目占 19–25%（跨报告单元）。TF-IDF 路由器相对恒用文本 +2.6 分，相对恒用视觉中位延迟降低 30%。
Conclusion: 文本与图像互不覆盖，准确率与延迟成本需一起权衡：按问题文本路由表示即可同时拿到接近视觉的准确率与接近文本的延迟。

papers.title: Splitting Documents at Lower Cost: Multi-Split Boundary Decisions for LLM-Based Page Stream Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Scanned mail, uploaded PDFs, and consolidated attachments often arrive as page streams that must be split into individual documents before downstream classification, extraction, or routing. Zero-shot large language models can detect document boundaries without task-specific training, but standard Page Classification (PC) and Boundary Decision (BD) formulations resolve only one boundary per model call. We introduce Multi-Split Boundary Decision (MSBD), which predicts multiple boundaries within a page window in a single call, reducing the number of inference requests. We evaluate MSBD across multiple language models, document collections, input modalities, and window sizes. The results reveal a model- and corpus-dependent operating range in which MSBD preserves strong segmentation accuracy while substantially improving inference efficiency, followed by a sharp decline at larger windows. MSBD provided the strongest overall accuracy--efficiency trade-off, while large windows expose distinct over- and under-segmentation behavior across models. These findings show that multi-boundary prediction can make zero-shot page stream segmentation more efficient when the window size is selected for the target corpus.
papers.comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Multi-Split Boundary Decisions (MSBD)：让零样本 LLM 在一个页面窗口内一次预测多个文档边界，从而减少推理请求数。评测显示存在模型与语料相关的操作区间，窗口选对时 MSBD 在保持分割精度的同时显著提升推理效率，窗口过大则精度急剧下降并出现过分割与欠分割。
Motivation: 扫描邮件、上传 PDF 与合并附件以页面流形式到达，需先切分为单个文档才能做下游分类、抽取与路由；标准 Page Classification (PC) 与 Boundary Decision (BD) 每次调用只解一个边界，推理成本高。
Method: MSBD 在单次模型调用中对一个页面窗口预测多个边界，取代每次调用只解一个边界的 PC/BD；在多种语言模型、文档集合、输入模态与窗口大小上做零样本评测，无需任务特定训练。
Result: 评测覆盖多个语言模型、文档集合、输入模态与窗口大小：MSBD 给出最强的总体精度-效率权衡；存在模型与语料依赖的操作区间，窗口继续增大后精度急剧下降，且不同模型在大窗口下分别表现出过分割与欠分割。
Conclusion: 多边界预测能让零样本页面流分割更高效，前提是按目标语料选择窗口大小；窗口过大时精度会急剧下滑并出现过分割/欠分割分化。

papers.title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出摘要评测框架 Semantic Scaffold：从源文本抽取事实、问题与实体属性的层级结构并标注主点/支撑细节，作为固定参照给摘要打分，派生 FPS、QPS、EPS 三个诊断指标。动机是 LLM-as-judge 分数在三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集与多语设置中饱和到近乎相同、无法区分模型，而 ROUGE 只测表面重叠；作者分析了 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 的四类反复出现的失效模式，主张 scaffold 式评测在整体性指标塌掉处仍保持区分力。
Motivation: 生产系统的模型选型依赖摘要质量度量，但 ROUGE 只反映表面重叠，LLM-as-judge 分数饱和到近乎相同值、无法对模型排序，该饱和现象横跨三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集与多语场景。
Method: Semantic Scaffold 从源文本抽取事实、问题、实体属性的层级表示，逐条标注为 main point 或 supporting detail，并把该结构作为固定参照给摘要打分；据此派生 Fact Preservation Score (FPS)、Question Preservation Score (QPS)、Entity Preservation Score (EPS)，奖励保留关键信息同时惩罚细节堆砌。
Result: 观察到 LLM-as-judge 分数在三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集及多语设置中饱和到近乎相同值；归纳出 ROUGE 与 LLM-as-judge 的四类反复出现的失效模式，并论证 scaffold 式评测在这些常规指标塌掉处仍保持信息量。
Conclusion: 摘要评测应以源文本的语义脚手架作固定参照，用 FPS/QPS/EPS 这类可解释诊断指标替代会饱和的整体性分数。

papers.title: What Should We Ask Next? Retrieval-Aware Question Learning for Interactive ReID
papers.abstract_en: Interactive retrieval with partial evidence constitutes a sequential information-acquisition problem: an agent must choose questions that acquire useful evidence for the next retrieval update. Existing systems train this decision by imitating an offline ordering of candidate QA pairs. However, a question's value depends on the response it elicits and its downstream effect on retrieval. We establish that candidate discriminativeness and perceived usefulness provide weak supervision for this objective, then introduce RAVEL, a retrieval-aware online reinforcement learning framework for interactive person re-identification. RAVEL initializes from supervised question generation, observes the current Top-4 candidates directly, and optimizes the question policy with rank feedback from the full question-answer-retrieval loop. Experiments on Interactive-PEDES show that RAVEL delivers progressively stronger retrieval performance across five interaction rounds. Further analysis shows that RAVEL allocates more of its interaction budget to localized open-ended prompts targeting specific attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAVEL 把交互式行人重识别 (interactive person re-identification) 的提问决策建模为序贯信息获取问题，用检索感知的在线强化学习替代模仿离线 QA 排序：从监督式问题生成初始化，直接观察当前 Top-4 候选，并用完整「问题-回答-检索」回路的排名反馈优化提问策略。在 Interactive-PEDES 上五个交互轮次中检索性能逐轮增强，且策略把更多交互预算分配给针对具体属性的局部开放式提问。
Motivation: 现有交互式检索系统靠模仿离线 QA 排序来训练提问决策，但问题的价值取决于它引出的回答及其对检索的下游影响，离线排序无法反映这一点。
Method: 提出 RAVEL：检索感知的在线强化学习框架，从监督式问题生成初始化策略，观测当前 Top-4 候选，用完整问题-回答-检索回路产生的排名反馈 (rank feedback) 优化提问策略；并论证候选判别力与感知有用性只能提供弱监督。
Result: 在 Interactive-PEDES 上，RAVEL 在五个交互轮次中检索性能逐轮增强；进一步分析显示其把更多交互预算分配给针对特定属性的局部开放式提示 (localized open-ended prompts)。
Conclusion: 提问策略应由检索回路的在线排名反馈而非离线 QA 排序来训练，且把预算投向针对具体属性的开放式问题更有效。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DENSE: Distilling Agent Trajectories into Evidence-Grounded Shortcut Trees for Self-Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Online agent deployments accumulate execution trajectories at massive scale and behavioral diversity, for which predefined annotation criteria hardly exist. Extracting useful evidence therefore demands costly manual annotation or verifier signals that fail to scale, leaving valuable evidence buried among redundant, incomplete, and failed executions. This raises a question: without post-execution rewards or correctness labels, how can reusable experience be distilled from the trajectories themselves? To address this challenge, we introduce DENSE (Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions), which organizes trajectory-derived evidence into nested shortcut trees. By consolidating redundant attempts, identifying resolved subtasks, and retaining useful steps alongside outstanding requirements, DENSE transforms noisy execution traces into structured and reusable task-solving feedback. To evaluate whether such feedback helps agents retry the same task, we design REFIT, which measures success-rate changes between the initial attempt and feedback-guided retries. Among feedback methods without external outcome supervision, DENSE achieves the highest strict pass rate across four agent models on Terminal-Bench 2.1, improving over initial attempts by 7.12-21.81 percentage points with 19.0-43.6% fewer agent tokens on retries. In addition, on hard tasks DENSE consistently outperforms self-reflection in cumulative pass rate across multiple feedback iterations on all four models, demonstrating its strong potential for continual agent self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DENSE 在无执行后奖励与正确性标签的条件下，把 agent 执行轨迹蒸馏成嵌套 shortcut tree 形式的证据，作为重试同一任务时的反馈。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上按 REFIT 协议，四个 agent 模型的 strict pass rate 相对首次尝试提升 7.12–21.81 个百分点，且重试少用 19.0–43.6% 的 agent token；在困难任务上多轮反馈迭代的累计通过率一致高于 self-reflection。
Motivation: 线上 agent 部署积累了大规模、行为多样的执行轨迹，但预定义标注标准几乎不存在，靠人工标注或 verifier 信号成本高且无法扩展，导致冗余、不完整、失败执行中的有用证据被埋没。
Method: DENSE（Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions）把轨迹派生证据组织成嵌套 shortcut tree：合并冗余尝试、识别已解决的子任务、保留有用步骤与未完成要求，将噪声执行轨迹转成结构化可复用的任务求解反馈。评测用自建协议 REFIT，度量首次尝试与反馈引导重试之间的成功率变化。
Result: 在无外部结果监督的反馈方法中，DENSE 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上对四个 agent 模型取得最高 strict pass rate，较首次尝试提升 7.12–21.81 个百分点，重试阶段 agent token 少用 19.0–43.6%。在困难任务上，跨多个反馈迭代 DENSE 的累计 pass rate 在全部四个模型上一致超过 self-reflection。
Conclusion: 无需执行后奖励或正确性标签，轨迹自身即可蒸馏出可复用经验，支撑 agent 在同一任务上的持续自我改进。

papers.title: DART: Distillation-Aware Reparameterization for Training-Free LoRA Reuse in Few-Step Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Few-step distillation reduces the inference cost of image-to-video generation, but directly reusing LoRA adapters trained for long denoising trajectories can weaken their intended effects and degrade video quality. We observe that adapters with similar measured static parameter geometry can behave differently under the shortened target schedule, motivating response-aware transfer. We propose DART, a training-free reparameterization method that transports source LoRAs into aligned coordinates through a low-rank distillation bridge. Paired forward evaluations measure channel-level incremental responses under the target schedule to fit coefficients that calibrate response direction, source-relative magnitude, and timestep allocation. Coordinate transport establishes update directions, while calibration adapts their contributions, requiring neither source training videos nor backpropagation. Experiments across multiple distilled I2V models demonstrate improved generation quality and aggregate functional retention over direct reuse. Further analyses show that coordinate transport complements response calibration, with adapter-level benefits encompassing both functional preservation and reduced negative transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DART 是一种 training-free 的 LoRA 重参数化方法，把为长去噪轨迹训练的源 LoRA 经低秩蒸馏桥 (low-rank distillation bridge) 搬到少步蒸馏模型的对齐坐标系，再用成对前向评估拟合通道级响应系数来校准方向、幅度与时间步分配。在多个蒸馏 I2V 模型上，它比直接复用 LoRA 提升生成质量与整体功能保持，并降低负迁移。
Motivation: 少步蒸馏降低了 image-to-video 生成的推理成本，但直接复用面向长去噪轨迹训练的 LoRA 会削弱其预期效果并劣化视频质量；静态参数几何相近的 adapter 在缩短后的时间表下行为却不同。
Method: 训练-free 重参数化：先用低秩蒸馏桥把源 LoRA 输运到对齐坐标（确定更新方向），再用目标时间表下的成对前向评估测通道级增量响应，拟合系数校准响应方向、相对源的幅度与时间步分配；全程不需要源训练视频，也不需要反向传播。
Result: 在多个蒸馏 I2V 模型上的实验显示，相比直接复用 LoRA，DART 改善生成质量并提升整体功能保持 (aggregate functional retention)；进一步分析表明坐标输运与响应校准互补，adapter 层面收益同时覆盖功能保持与负迁移减少。
Conclusion: 少步蒸馏下复用 LoRA 不能只看静态参数几何，需按目标时间表的响应做坐标输运加响应校准；两者互补，且无需源数据或训练即可实现。

papers.title: The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval assembles repository context by ranking passages for relevance to the current query. A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what such a ranker returns. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: independently scored passages can fill the budget with support for one requirement while another goes unmet. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination supplying what its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen, crediting only sets that satisfy every annotated evidence requirement of the current decision, and separating set recovery from candidate discovery. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone recovers fewer complete sets, placing the margin over it in the set-level policy, not the computation. The lead persists from frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from a complete set costs repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把智能体检索重构为状态条件下的最小充分证据恢复 (state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery)：给定已捕获的编码智能体状态，用三次语义调用联合构造一个仍缺什么就补什么的紧凑证据集合，而非逐段重排。在 SERBench 的 500 个留出状态上，五项时完整集合恢复率 73.0%、八项时 80.6%，对比 Qwen3 embedding+rerank 的 61.4% 与 72.4%。
Motivation: 逐段相关性打分与集合级充分性不匹配：独立打分的段落会把预算全填给某一条需求，另一条需求落空，而智能体其实已读过 ranker 返回的大部分内容。
Method: MSS-Complement 把获取当作集合构造：三次语义调用分别提议联合充分的集合、搜索其缺失部分、返回 4–8 个完整源单元（6,144 token 内）；一套配置在校准数据上固定。SERBench 记录智能体已见内容，只对满足当前决策全部标注证据需求的集合给分，并把集合恢复与候选发现分开度量。
Result: SERBench 500 个留出状态、45 个仓库：五项时 73.0%、八项时 80.6% 完整集合恢复率，Qwen3 embedding+rerank 为 61.4% 与 72.4%；仅按相似度排序的匹配对照恢复更少，说明优势在集合级策略而非计算量；在冻结仓库源、无 gold 派生候选池时优势仍在。AMA-Bench 上答案 prompt 缩小 76.2%，准确率比该基准自带 memory agent 高 2.08 点；从完整集合中移除一个必需组会降低两种执行器下的修复定位精度。
Conclusion: 对智能体的检索应表述为恢复当前决策所缺的证据，而不是重排与 issue 相似的内容。

papers.title: IMFD: End-to-end Multi-Face Forgery Detection through Instruction-based Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid increase of deepfakes has raised significant concerns due to their spread on social media. Traditional multi-face forgery detectors crop and verify each face independently, ignoring background context and inter-face relationships, which often yields suboptimal performance. To overcome these limitations, we leverage instruction-based Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), which can interpret entire images and follow complex textual instructions. We propose a simple yet effective single-stage multi-face forgery detector, called IMFD (Instruction-based Multi-face Forgery Detector), which is trained end-to-end to jointly localize faces and predict per-face forgery labels. Rather than treating face box prediction only as a joint objective, IMFD explicitly integrates predicted face bounding boxes into the instruction as visual cues that enhance instruction grounding and forgery detection. To support the training and evaluation of IMFD, we convert existing multi-face forgery datasets into an instruction-based format. Experimental results and analyses show that IMFD improves multi-face forgery detection by integrating face bounding boxes into the instruction, and consistently outperforms various state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMFD 用基于指令的大视觉-语言模型 (LVLM) 做单阶段多脸伪造检测，端到端联合定位人脸并逐脸判伪造，且把预测出的人脸框写进指令作为视觉线索来增强指令 grounding。在转换为指令格式的多脸伪造数据集上，IMFD 一致优于多种 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 传统多脸伪造检测器逐张裁剪人脸独立判别，忽略背景上下文与人脸间关系，导致性能次优。
Method: 提出 IMFD：基于指令的 LVLM 端到端训练，同时输出人脸框与逐脸伪造标签；人脸框不只作为联合目标，而是显式拼入文本指令作为视觉线索。为训练与评测，把已有多脸伪造数据集转换成指令格式。
Result: 实验结果显示 IMFD 通过把人脸框整合进指令提升了多脸伪造检测，并一致优于多种 state-of-the-art 方法；论文为 8 页、5 图、5 表。
Conclusion: 把人脸框作为指令中的视觉线索而非单纯回归目标，是让 LVLM 做好多脸伪造检测的有效设计。

papers.title: Learning and Control Beyond Linearity: Towards a Non-asymptotic Theory for Bilinear Systems
papers.abstract_en: This tutorial provides a unified view of the emerging area of bilinear learning and control. Using linear systems as a benchmark, it explains what fundamentally changes in the bilinear settings, how recent theory addresses finite-sample learning and control, and how these ideas connect to broader themes in nonlinear control, representation learning, and data-driven decision making. For learning, we emphasize tools that are particularly useful in the bilinear settings, such as one-sided Bernstein's inequality for dependent and heavy-tailed covariates, blocking arguments, and martingale concentration for input-dependent noise. We then apply these tools to obtain finite-sample learning guarantees for fully observed bilinear systems, partially observed bilinear systems, and linear systems with bilinear observations. For control, we discuss quadratic control from bilinear observations, where the classical separation principle fails, and review tractable approaches based on belief-space receding horizon control. We also cover stabilization of bilinear dynamics under state feedback using semi-definite programming, LMI relaxations, sum-of-squares methods, and Koopman-based lifting. We conclude by discussing connections to reinforcement learning and machine learning, and some open problems in combined learning and control of bilinear systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于双线性系统 (bilinear systems) 学习与控制的教程，把线性系统作为基准，系统梳理有限样本学习保证与非渐近理论工具：一侧 Bernstein 不等式、blocking 论证、鞅集中不等式，用于全观测、部分观测以及带双线性观测的线性系统。控制部分指出双线性观测下经典分离原理失效，转而采用 belief-space receding horizon control 与基于 SDP/LMI/sum-of-squares/Koopman lifting 的镇定方法。
Motivation: 双线性系统介于线性与一般非线性之间，但线性系统下的有限样本学习保证与分离原理式控制设计在此不再直接成立，需要一套非渐近理论说明哪些结论保留、哪些失效。
Method: 教程以线性系统为对照组织内容：学习侧用 one-sided Bernstein's inequality（针对 dependent 与 heavy-tailed covariates）、blocking arguments、martingale concentration（针对 input-dependent noise）推导全观测双线性系统、部分观测双线性系统、以及带双线性观测的线性系统的有限样本保证；控制侧讨论双线性观测下的 quadratic control（分离原理失效）与 belief-space receding horizon control，并覆盖状态反馈下用 semi-definite programming、LMI relaxations、sum-of-squares、Koopman-based lifting 做双线性动力学镇定。
Result: 给出三类设定的有限样本学习保证（全观测双线性系统、部分观测双线性系统、带双线性观测的线性系统），并指出双线性观测下 quadratic control 的经典分离原理失效；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 双线性系统的非渐近理论可以借助依赖/重尾协变量与输入依赖噪声下的集中不等式建立，而控制设计需放弃分离原理、改用 belief-space 与 LMI/sum-of-squares/Koopman 类方法；作者列出学习与控制联合的开放问题，并讨论与强化学习的联系。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: VLA-ULAP: Interleaving Cloud VLA Calls with Ultra-Lightweight Local Action Prediction at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Billion-parameter vision-language-action (VLA) policies run either onboard, consuming substantial power, or on remote servers, adding communication latency. To address these drawbacks and better balance latency and onboard energy consumption, we propose VLA-ULAP. It partitions inference across decision times, interleaving remote VLA calls with predictions from an Ultra-Lightweight Local Action Predictor (ULAP). A single ULAP has $\sim$7.4M parameters including the frozen vision encoder. It combines current views, proprioception, and executed action history to predict chunks in one pass. Trained independently, it requires no VLA hidden states, online verification, or server round trips. On Jetson Orin Nano, ULAP takes 20.7 ms and 0.122 J of idle-subtracted energy per inference, versus 289.3 ms and 40.46 J for GR00T on RTX A6000. Across four simulated base-policy/benchmark pairs, VLA-ULAP removes 45.3-77.3% of VLA calls while retaining 95.0-98.5% of baseline success rates at selected operating points. On VLA-JEPA, VLA-ULAP also surpasses local acceleration alternatives, using an estimated 49.4% less inference time and 51.5% less GPU energy per successful episode than ACT, and 77.5% less time and 80.7% less energy than SP-VLA at higher success rates. In physical SO-101 trials, it similarly removes 70.3-71.9% of VLA calls without observed success-rate loss at seen or held-out placements. Measured device costs imply 64.6-66.4% less inference time and 70.1-71.7% less idle-subtracted energy per successful episode at these call counts. Beyond these savings, faster responses help VLA-ULAP exceed $π_{0.5}$'s success rate by 11.0 and 15.5 percentage points (pp) on two tasks in latency-aware LIBERO-Safety simulation while approximately halving VLA calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-ULAP 把十亿参数 VLA 策略的推理按决策时刻切分：远程 VLA 调用之间插入 7.4M 参数的本地超轻量动作预测器 (ULAP)，单次前向直接预测动作块。在四个仿真基策略/基准组合上它砍掉 45.3–77.3% 的 VLA 调用仍保住 95.0–98.5% 的基线成功率，物理 SO-101 上去掉 70.3–71.9% 调用且成功率无可见损失。
Motivation: 十亿参数 VLA 策略要么上机运行耗电大，要么放远程服务器带来通信延迟，边缘机器人需要在延迟与机载能耗之间取得平衡。
Method: VLA-ULAP 在决策时刻之间交替远程 VLA 调用与本地 ULAP 预测：单个 ULAP 约 7.4M 参数（含冻结视觉编码器），融合当前视野、本体感知与已执行动作历史，一次前向预测动作块；ULAP 独立训练，不需要 VLA 隐状态、在线校验或服务器往返。
Result: Jetson Orin Nano 上 ULAP 单次推理 20.7 ms、0.122 J（扣除空闲），对比 GR00T 在 RTX A6000 上的 289.3 ms 与 40.46 J。四个仿真基策略/基准组合中移除 45.3–77.3% 的 VLA 调用，保留 95.0–98.5% 基线成功率；VLA-JEPA 上比 ACT 每成功回合少用 49.4% 推理时间与 51.5% GPU 能耗，比 SP-VLA 少 77.5% 时间与 80.7% 能耗且成功率更高。物理 SO-101 试验移除 70.3–71.9% 调用，已见与留出摆放位成功率无可见损失，对应每成功回合 64.6–66.4% 推理时间与 70.1–71.7% 扣空闲能耗下降；LIBERO-Safety 延迟感知仿真中两项任务成功率比 π0.5 高 11.0 与 15.5 个百分点，同时 VLA 调用约减半。
Conclusion: 在远程 VLA 调用之间插入独立训练的本地轻量预测器，可以在几乎不损失成功率的前提下大幅削减调用次数、延迟与能耗，且更快的响应本身还能抬高延迟敏感任务的成功率。

papers.title: AquiLLM: Evaluating Faithfulness in Open-Weight RAG-LLM Systems for Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: Scientific research increasingly relies on large, heterogeneous data sources, motivating interest in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that provide natural language access to scientific knowledge and research workflows. Researchers are exploring the viability of these systems as natural language interfaces for document search and for generating analysis code and pipeline components. At the same time, concerns about data privacy and control over research infrastructure have motivated interest in open-weight models and open-source deployments hosted within research institutions. In astronomy, this development follows a long history of computational infrastructure development, from archival databases and Structured Query Language (SQL)-based systems to large language model (LLM)-assisted research tools. This paper presents a domain-expert evaluation of faithfulness for AquiLLM, an open-weight, offline RAG-LLM platform designed to support scientific research groups in the use and preservation of tacit and formal knowledge. We define faithfulness as the extent to which generated responses remain grounded in retrieved scientific context without unsupported claims or omissions. We report results from an astronomy case study evaluating AquiLLM across retrieval and scientific analysis tasks. AquiLLM performs most reliably on explicit retrieval-oriented questions grounded in the RAG collection, while faithfulness degrades for queries requiring synthesis or ambiguity resolution. These results highlight both the promise and limitations of open-weight RAG-LLM systems for scientific research and demonstrate the importance of domain-expert evaluation beyond standard benchmark leaderboards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AquiLLM 是面向科研团队的开源权重、离线 RAG-LLM 平台，作者把 faithfulness 定义为生成回答在检索到的科学语境内保持有据、无无支撑断言与无遗漏的程度，并用天文学领域专家做案例评估。结论是：在以 RAG 文档集合为依据的显式检索类问题上表现最可靠，而需要跨文档综合或消歧的查询上 faithfulness 明显下降。
Motivation: 科研机构因数据隐私与基础设施自主权转向开源权重、自托管的 RAG 系统，但标准 benchmark 排行榜不足以判断回答是否真正忠于检索到的科学语境，需要领域专家层面的 faithfulness 评估。
Method: 对 AquiLLM 这一开源权重、离线 RAG-LLM 平台做领域专家评估 (domain-expert evaluation)，把 faithfulness 操作化为回答是否完全基于检索到的科学上下文、既无无支撑断言也无遗漏；评估覆盖检索类任务与科学分析类任务两类查询，场景为天文学案例研究。
Result: 在天文学案例研究中，AquiLLM 在以 RAG 集合为依据的显式检索类问题上表现最可靠；当查询需要综合多个来源或消歧时 faithfulness 下降。
Conclusion: 开源权重 RAG-LLM 在科学检索场景可用但能力有边界：检索直取可靠、综合与消歧不可靠，因此 faithfulness 必须由领域专家评估，而不能只看标准 benchmark 排行榜。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Physics-Aware ACOPF Surrogate Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based surrogates for AC optimal power flow (ACOPF) promise large speedups over classical solvers, but their operational value depends on physical feasibility as much as predictive accuracy. Physics-aware objectives such as the augmented Lagrangian (AL) improve constraint satisfaction at additional per-step cost, yet how this trade-off behaves with scale is uncharacterized. We sweep model and dataset sizes under MSE and AL training, and measure how violation changes with network size. Both objectives improve as power laws: MSE prediction loss depends more on model size than on data, while the AL composite of prediction loss and violation improves comparably along both axes. Violation grows markedly more slowly with network size under AL. On matched hardware and equal training samples, AL reduces violation about $19\times$ with $2.4\times$ the training time and negligible added memory. The training objective shapes not only where a surrogate lands but how its quality evolves with scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AC 最优潮流 (ACOPF) 代理模型学习中，增广拉格朗日 (AL) 目标相对纯 MSE 让预测损失与约束违反都按幂律改善，且违反随电网规模增长明显更慢。在同等硬件与相同训练样本下，AL 把违反降低约 19 倍，代价是 2.4 倍训练时间、内存开销可忽略。
Motivation: 基于学习的 ACOPF 代理虽能大幅提速，但运行价值取决于物理可行性而不只是预测精度；AL 这类物理感知目标能改善约束满足却增加每步开销，其随模型、数据与电网规模的权衡此前未被刻画。
Method: 在模型规模与数据规模两个轴上扫描训练，分别用 MSE 与增广拉格朗日 (AL) 目标（预测损失加约束违反的复合），并测量约束违反随电网规模的变化，比较两条目标的幂律标度行为。
Result: 两种目标都按幂律改善：MSE 预测损失对模型规模比对数据更敏感，AL 复合目标沿两轴改善幅度相当；违反随电网规模在 AL 下增长明显更慢。在匹配硬件与相同训练样本下，AL 使违反降低约 19 倍，训练时间为 2.4 倍，内存增加可忽略。
Conclusion: 训练目标不仅决定代理模型落在哪里，还决定其质量随规模演化的速度；用 AL 换取约 19 倍的违反下降只需 2.4 倍训练时间与可忽略内存，是规模扩展下值得的物理可行性代价。

papers.title: Sharp Regret Bounds and a Task-Covariance Correction for Spectral Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Spectral features can remain optimal under strongly uneven task preferences when they retain the directions most useful to the tasks. In a local-task model, expected probing gain depends on the task prior only through its covariance $Λ$: with $B$ recording dependence between views, $k$ spectral features span the leading eigenspace of $BB^\top$, while task-optimal features span that of $BΛB^\top$. We derive alignment-dependent regret bounds, matching worst-case lower bounds for a flat leading spectrum, and bounds using the leading $2k$ directions with a spectral-tail term; a spectral gap makes the bound quadratic in small anisotropy. We also bound the imbalance from random preference patterns and from averaging independent tasks with an isotropic population covariance. With known $Λ$, changing one term of the spectral contrastive loss selects task-optimal features; with a labelled task bank, we propose a diagnostic and test correction without retraining. Correction reduces synthetic held-out regret from $0.858$ to $0.003$ with $2000$ tasks when less task-relevant directions dominate, and on CIFAR-100 lowers empirical regret by $0.031$--$0.053$ on held-out fine-label tasks using the same images. With a small task bank, however, correction can hurt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在局部任务模型下，谱对比学习的期望探针增益只通过任务先验协方差 Λ 起作用：k 个谱特征张成 BB^T 的主子空间，而任务最优特征张成 BΛB^T 的主子空间。已知 Λ 时改写谱对比损失中的一项即可选出任务最优特征；有标注任务库时可做免重训练的诊断与测试时修正，把合成 held-out regret 从 0.858 降到 0.003（2000 个任务），CIFAR-100 held-out 细标签任务上经验 regret 降 0.031–0.053，但任务库小时修正反而可能有害。
Motivation: 谱表示在任务偏好强不均时会保留对任务无用的方向，导致相对任务最优特征的 regret 不可控；现有谱对比学习没有刻画任务先验不均如何进入增益的理论界与可操作修正。
Method: 在局部任务模型中把期望探针增益写成只依赖任务协方差 Λ 的形式，比较谱特征（BB^T 主子空间）与任务最优特征（BΛB^T 主子空间），推导依赖对齐度的 regret 界、平坦主谱下的匹配最坏情形下界、以及用前 2k 个方向加谱尾项的界；再对随机偏好模式与各向同性总体协方差下独立任务平均给出失衡界。已知 Λ 时修改谱对比损失的一项，另有基于标注任务库的诊断与测试时修正（不重训练）。
Result: 谱隙使界对小各向异性呈二次。修正使合成 held-out regret 从 0.858 降到 0.003（2000 个任务，且不相关方向占主导时）；CIFAR-100 上同一批图像的 held-out 细标签任务经验 regret 降低 0.031–0.053。任务库较小时修正可能反而变差。
Conclusion: 谱特征的失配可由任务协差 Λ 解释并用一个损失项加测试时修正来消除，前提是任务库足够大；小任务库下该修正不安全。

papers.title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents can create complex videos in software such as Blender by writing code instead of using diffusion models. Yet video understanding benchmarks still evaluate models mainly through question answering. If an agent truly understands a video, it can reconstruct it programmatically. We introduce BVB, Blender-VideoBench, a benchmark that tests this ability by asking agents to reconstruct real-world videos as animated Blender scenes. To ensure fair comparison, each agent programs the reconstruction through a lightweight harness, Mini-BVB, in an identical sandbox under a shared cost limit. The benchmark renders each reconstruction from its animated camera and evaluates it on two axes: (1) Dual VQA measures how many spatiotemporal facts the reconstruction preserves. (2) Latent Similarity measures how closely the reconstruction matches the source video perceptually. Our overall score, a square-root mean, favors balanced performance. We evaluate 51 configurations from 10 model families and analyze semantic retention, perceptual similarity, reasoning effort, and cost. The best model reaches 88.6 Latent Similarity but retains only 53.7% of the spatiotemporal facts from the source video. Additional reasoning improves perceptual similarity but does not close this gap. In a blind study with 15 raters and five configurations, Latent Similarity correlates strongly with human preference. These results show that programmatic reconstruction is a viable test of agentic video understanding, and that semantic retention remains the main challenge.
papers.comment: The 3rd version. V1 was released on Sept. 14, 2026. Project Page: https://yoloytang.me/BVB/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BVB (Blender-VideoBench) 让多模态 agent 用代码把真实视频重建为可动画的 Blender 场景，并在统一沙箱与成本上限下按 Dual VQA（时空事实保留）与 Latent Similarity（感知相似）两轴打分。评测 10 个模型家族的 51 个配置后发现：最佳模型 Latent Similarity 达 88.6，却只保留源视频 53.7% 的时空事实，额外推理能提升感知相似但补不上语义缺口。
Motivation: 视频理解基准普遍只用问答评测，无法区分模型是真理解了视频内容还是仅能描述；用程序化重建作为可执行的理解检验，可把语义保留与感知相似拆开度量。
Method: 提出 BVB，要求 agent 在轻量 harness Mini-BVB 中、同一沙箱与共享成本上限下编程重建真实视频为带动画相机的 Blender 场景；渲染该相机轨迹后按两轴评分——Dual VQA 统计保留的时空事实数，Latent Similarity 度量与源视频的感知接近度，总分为两者的平方根均值以奖励均衡表现。
Result: 评测 10 个模型家族的 51 个配置，分析语义保留、感知相似、推理投入与成本：最佳模型 Latent Similarity 88.6，但仅保留源视频 53.7% 的时空事实；增加推理提升感知相似却不缩小该差距。15 名评审、5 个配置的盲测中，Latent Similarity 与人类偏好强相关。
Conclusion: 程序化重建可作为 agentic 视频理解的有效检验，而语义保留（而非感知相似）是当前模型的主要瓶颈。

papers.title: Neural-Network Solutions to Real-Space Charge Density and Generalization
papers.abstract_en: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem establishes that, in principle, the ground state (GS) charge density contains all GS information of a many-electron system, such that all GS observables can be expressed as functionals of the GS charge density. Conventional Kohn-Sham density functional theory requires iterative solution of the self-consistent-field equations at substantial computational cost, motivating the development of deep learning surrogates for electronic structure calculations and, in turn, accelerating computer-aided materials design. Here, we propose AIDEN, an Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network for solving real-space charge density. AIDEN separates the element-dependent one-center density from environment-induced density redistribution and represents the latter through complementary atom- and edge-centered tensor correlations. A continuous low-rank Gaussian decoder then reconstructs the density at arbitrary spatial coordinates while reusing atomic encodings independently of the evaluation grid. AIDEN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on periodic crystal benchmarks while remaining competitive for molecular systems, and further demonstrates zero-shot transferability across several structurally distinct out-of-distribution case studies. Furthermore, AIDEN provides substantially faster inference than both baseline models and full SCF calculations, enabling efficient charge density reconstruction for large-scale electronic structure calculations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AIDEN（Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network），把元素依赖的 one-center 密度与环境诱导的密度重分配分离，后者用原子中心与边中心张量相关表示，再由连续低秩 Gaussian 解码器在任意空间坐标重建实空间电荷密度。在周期晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系保持竞争力，并对多个结构迥异的 OOD 案例展现零样本迁移，推理速度显著快于基线模型与完整 SCF 计算。
Motivation: Kohn-Sham DFT 需要迭代求解自洽场 (SCF) 方程，计算代价高；深度学习代理可绕开迭代以加速计算机辅助材料设计，但需要在任意网格上重建电荷密度并保持跨体系泛化。
Method: AIDEN 用等变网络分离元素依赖的 one-center 密度与环境诱导密度重分配，后者以互补的原子中心与边中心张量相关表示；连续低秩 Gaussian 解码器在任意空间坐标重建密度，且原子编码可独立于评估网格复用。
Result: 在周期晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系上保持竞争力；在多个结构不同的 out-of-distribution 案例上展示零样本可迁移性；推理速度显著快于两类基线模型与完整 SCF 计算。
Conclusion: 把密度拆成 one-center 部分与环境重分配、再用与网格无关的连续解码器重建，可以在保持精度的同时实现跨结构零样本迁移和大幅加速的电荷密度求解。

summary_sections.result: 在周期晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系上保持竞争力；在多个结构不同的 out-of-distribution 案例上展示零样本可迁移性；推理速度显著快于两类基线模型与完整 SCF 计算。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把密度拆成 one-center 部分与环境重分配、再用与网格无关的连续解码器重建，可以在保持精度的同时实现跨结构零样本迁移和大幅加速的电荷密度求解。

papers.title: DynSTEER: Dynamic Stage-wise Trajectory Evaluation and Execution-time Review for Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon task execution, raising a central granularity question for trajectory evaluation: whole-trajectory verification is too coarse to capture concrete failures and their associated evidence in long trajectories, while atomic-step scoring is too fine-grained, noise-sensitive, and computationally expensive. This granularity gap makes a single-reference trajectory paradigm inadequate for assessing the rich space of valid agent execution paths and delays timely feedback and early stopping in long-horizon tasks. To address these issues, we propose DynSTEER, a dynamic stage-wise framework for agent trajectory evaluation. DynSTEER bridges the granularity gap through stage-wise dynamic evaluation that segments rollouts at key execution nodes and adapts its multi-level review strategy based on stage-level results; it compiles a path-tolerant milestone graph from available task inputs to preserve diverse legal paths without reference leakage; and it supports terminating unrecoverable agent executions to curb resource waste. Experimental results show that DynSTEER improves evaluation discriminability by over 85\% compared with whole-trajectory evaluation and saves 17.74\% of execution steps. The code is available at https://github.com/zhichao-stone/DynSTEER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynSTEER 针对 LLM agent 长程轨迹评估的粒度困境，提出按关键执行节点切分 rollout 的分阶段动态评估：阶段级结果决定多层 review 策略，并编译路径容忍的 milestone graph 以覆盖合法多路径而不泄露参考轨迹，同时可终止不可恢复的执行。相比整轨迹评估，评估判别力提升超过 85%，并节省 17.74% 的执行步数。
Motivation: 长程任务中整轨迹验证太粗、原子步打分太细且噪声敏感、算力开销大，单一参考轨迹范式无法覆盖合法执行路径的多样空间，导致反馈滞后、无法早停。
Method: DynSTEER 在关键执行节点切分 rollout 做阶段级动态评估，按阶段结果自适应调整多层 review 策略；从任务输入编译路径容忍的 milestone graph（避免参考轨迹泄漏）；对不可恢复的执行提前终止以节省资源。
Result: 相比 whole-trajectory evaluation，评估判别力 (evaluation discriminability) 提升超过 85%，并节省 17.74% 的执行步数；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 阶段级动态评估加路径容忍里程碑图，能在长程 agent 任务中同时提高轨迹评估的判别力并减少无效执行开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Not Restart: Residual Completion for Stateful Agent Handoffs
papers.abstract_en: Routing and cascades reduce tool-agent cost by transferring control across models, but stateful handoffs must preserve accepted choices, realized effects, and unfinished obligations. We formulate this as commitment-constrained residual completion and introduce Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion (CFRC). CFRC enforces target-before-proposal, whole-proposal-before-authority, and live-evidence-before-success: it freezes a residual contract from accepted progress, closes the successor continuation into an evidence-linked graph, and admits execution only when the remainder is covered, with live receipts discharging obligations. We establish contract-relative partial correctness, which extends to the original residual request under complete contract construction. Across five environments and two same-provider model pairs, CFRC achieves comparable macro accuracy to strong full-task agents at 22.0% to 34.6% mean per-surface cost, with additional cross-provider results demonstrating broader transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向有状态多模型交接 (stateful handoff) 提出 Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion (CFRC)：把已接受进度冻结成残余契约，用三条前置约束（先目标后提案、先整提案后授权、先实证后成功）约束续跑，只在余量被覆盖且有 live receipts 时放行执行。在五个环境、两组同厂商模型对上，CFRC 达到与强全任务 agent 相当的 macro accuracy，而平均单面成本仅为 22.0%–34.6%。
Motivation: routing 与 cascade 靠跨模型转交控制来压低工具调用成本，但交接必须保住已接受的选择、已发生的副作用和未完成的义务，现有 agent 缺少对残余请求的形式化约束。
Method: 把交接形式化为承诺约束的残余补全 (commitment-constrained residual completion)：冻结残余契约，把后继 continuation 收成证据关联图，以三条前置规则裁决执行准入，live receipts 用于销解义务；并证明契约相对的部分正确性，在契约完备构造下推广到原残余请求。
Result: 在五个环境与两组同厂商模型对上，CFRC 的 macro accuracy 与强全任务 agent 相当，平均单面成本为 22.0% 至 34.6%；另有跨厂商结果展示更广的迁移性。
Conclusion: 只要把已接受进度冻结成契约并用证据门控执行，跨模型交接就能在保住正确性的同时把单面成本压到全任务 agent 的约两到三成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tight Sampling Complexity with Stochastic Gradient Oracles in Fixed Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: We establish the stochastic-gradient query complexity of sampling smooth strongly log-concave distributions in every fixed dimension $d\geq1$. For $μ$-strongly convex, $L$-smooth potentials with unknown minimizers $x_f^\star$ in the ball $\mathbb{B}(0,μ^{-1/2})$, and unbiased gradient oracles with variance at most $σ^2$, the minimax worst-case expected query complexity is $Θ\left(\log(1+κ)+\frac{σ^2}{μ\varepsilon}\right)$, jointly optimal for the condition number $κ:=L/μ$, variance $σ^2\ge 0$, and TV accuracy $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/10$. In the noiseless setting $σ=0$, this tight complexity $Θ\left(\log(1+κ)\right)$ is independent of $\varepsilon$. Moreover, a gradient-only sampler generates an exact sample with ${O}(\log(1+κ))$ worst-case expected queries. Without previous ball $\mathbb{B}(0,μ^{-1/2})$, exact sampling from any initial point $x_0$ can be implemented with expected cost ${O}\left(\log(1+κ)+\log(1+\sqrtμ\|x_0-x_f^\star\|)\right)$, without knowing the initial distance. We also show that dependence on initial distance is generally unavoidable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定维度 d≥1 下给出光滑强对数凹分布采样的随机梯度查询复杂度极小极大刻画：对 μ-强凸、L-光滑势函数与方差不超过 σ² 的无偏梯度 oracle，最坏情形期望查询复杂度为 Θ(log(1+κ)+σ²/(με))，对条件数 κ=L/μ、方差 σ² 与 TV 精度 ε 联合最优。噪声为零时该复杂度退化为 Θ(log(1+κ)) 且与 ε 无关，梯度型采样器可用 O(log(1+κ)) 次查询生成精确样本。
Motivation: 强对数凹采样的随机梯度查询复杂度此前未在固定维度下给出对条件数、方差与精度同时紧的刻画，且无噪声时精度依赖是否必要并不清楚。
Method: 在 μ-强凸、L-光滑势函数、极小值位于球 B(0,μ^{-1/2})、无偏梯度 oracle（方差 ≤σ²）的设定下做极小极大最坏情形分析，目标为 TV 精度 ε∈(0,1/10]；并构造梯度型精确采样器，以及不预设初始球、从任意 x₀ 出发的实现。
Result: 极小极大最坏情形期望查询复杂度为 Θ(log(1+κ)+σ²/(με))，对 κ=L/μ、σ²≥0、0<ε≤1/10 联合最优；σ=0 时为 Θ(log(1+κ))，与 ε 无关；梯度型采样器以 O(log(1+κ)) 次最坏情形期望查询生成精确样本；无预设球时从任意 x₀ 精确采样的期望代价为 O(log(1+κ)+log(1+√μ‖x₀-x*_f‖))，且无需知道初始距离，并证明对初始距离的依赖一般不可避免。
Conclusion: 固定维度下强对数凹采样的随机梯度复杂度由条件数与方差-精度比两项决定，无噪声时精度不再是瓶颈，而初始距离的对数依赖无法消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Certified Safety Curation: Distribution-Free Guarantees for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Safe offline reinforcement learning assumes a cost function on every transition. We ask what remains possible when safety can be judged only by comparing short clips and occasionally asking whether an episode exceeded its budget. Certified safety curation answers with a filter-then-clone pipeline: a state-only value trained from segment comparisons scores whole trajectories, Learn-then-Test calibration certifies a selection threshold under a distribution-free $(α, δ)$ bound on the unsafe fraction of the selection, and behavior cloning follows. What is certified is the training set, not the policy, whose cost we report rather than bound. Where no threshold attains the target, the procedure refuses. We are not aware of prior work certifying the composition of a training set for offline RL or imitation. Oracle controls justify the design: reweighting individual transitions fails even with an exact value, so the value selects whole trajectories. The policies satisfy the cost budget on twelve of fifteen DSRL tasks, matching a clone of the ground-truth safe subset, which needs a label on every trajectory. Retrained on the certified selection, the strongest full-label method becomes safe where no setting of its own cost target rescues it. Refusal is predictable: the certificate's probability has a closed form in the purity of the pool's top quantile, which the calibration sample estimates and through which the scorer enters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Certified Safety Curation：在离线强化学习只有片段比较与整条 episode 是否超预算的稀疏安全标签下，用 filter-then-clone 流水线先筛数据再克隆。状态无关价值由片段比较训练并给整条轨迹打分，Learn-then-Test 校准在分布无关 (α, δ) 界下认证选择阈值，随后行为克隆；15 个 DSRL 任务中 12 个满足成本预算，与需要逐条标签的真值安全子集克隆持平。
Motivation: 安全离线 RL 通常假设每个 transition 都有成本函数，而现实中安全只能靠比较短片段、偶尔判断整条 episode 是否超预算获得，训练集层面的安全性此前无人给出认证。
Method: filter-then-clone：用片段比较训练 state-only 价值函数给整条轨迹打分；Learn-then-Test 校准认证一个选择阈值，给出被选集合中不安全比例的分布无关 (α, δ) 界；再做行为克隆。认证对象是训练集而非策略（策略成本只报告不设界），无阈值达标时程序拒绝；并用 oracle 对照说明逐 transition 重加权即使有精确价值也失败，故价值必须选整条轨迹。
Result: 在 15 个 DSRL 任务中的 12 个上策略满足成本预算，与克隆真值安全子集（需每条轨迹一个标签）持平；把最强全标签方法在认证选择上重训，可在其自身成本目标无法救回的设置下变安全。拒绝行为可预测：证书概率关于池中最高分位纯度有闭式，由校准样本估计。
Conclusion: 训练集可以被分布无关地认证为安全筛选对象，且整条轨迹选择优于逐 transition 重加权；认证的是数据而非策略，无达标阈值时应拒绝而非强行选择。
Relevance: 0
