papers.title: Beyond Frame Selection: Rethinking Long-Video Understanding with MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made strong progress in video understanding, yet long videos remain difficult: the visual token budget grows with video length, so temporally sparse evidence is easily lost. Existing methods, whether frame selection or agent-based exploration, ultimately rely on a single frame set that must trade off broad temporal coverage against fine-grained, question-relevant evidence: mixing both dilutes decisive evidence, while focusing on either sacrifices the other. We propose VideoRouter (VR), which rethinks long-video understanding as coordinating complementary evidence views rather than selecting a single subset of frames. VideoRouter first organizes each video into a question-agnostic temporal hierarchy that partitions it into coarse-to-fine temporally coherent segments. Upper-level nodes capture broad storyline context and event progression, while lower-level nodes preserve fine-grained local details and evidence-bearing moments. This gives rise to two complementary views: a global view for coverage-oriented reasoning and a local view for detail-oriented evidence recovery. We further introduce a verification-guided router that judges which view is better supported by its own selected evidence and decides the final answer. Across six backbones, routing improves over both views in all settings, and the choice of view is shown to be dataset-dependent, confirming that no single evidence granularity is universally preferable. On VideoMME and LongVideoBench, our method outperforms state-of-the-art frame-selection methods by 2.5 and 1.3 points, respectively, under the LLaVA-Video-7B backbone. We will release the code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoRouter 把长视频理解从「选一组帧」改写为「协调全局与局部两种证据视图」：先建与问题无关的粗到细时序层级，再由 verification-guided router 判断哪种视图的自选证据更能支撑答案。在 LLaVA-Video-7B 上，VideoMME 与 LongVideoBench 分别比 SOTA 帧选择方法高 2.5 与 1.3 分，且视图选择依数据集而变。
Motivation: 长视频的视觉 token 预算随长度增长，稀疏时序证据易丢失；帧选择与 agent 探索都只能落在单一帧集上，广覆盖与细粒度证据互相稀释。
Method: 先将视频组织成与问题无关的时序层级，切成粗到细的时序一致片段，上层节点承载整体剧情与事件推进、下层节点保留局部细节与证据时刻，由此产生 coverage 导向的 global view 与 detail 导向的 local view；再用 verification-guided router 依据各视图自选证据判断以哪个视图作答。
Result: 在六个 backbone 上，routing 在所有设置中都优于单一视图；LLaVA-Video-7B backbone 下 VideoMME 与 LongVideoBench 分别超出 SOTA 帧选择方法 2.5 分与 1.3 分。
Conclusion: 不存在普适更优的单一证据粒度，视图选择依数据集而定，因此长视频问答应路由而非选帧。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Introspecting Alignment Shifts Beyond Behaviors Implanted Through Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning enables a source model to acquire desired capabilities and behaviors in a target domain while retaining much of its general-purpose competence. However, this adaptation process can also degrade alignment properties that were present in the source model. Recent work has shown that large language models can be trained using LoRA-based modules known as introspection adapters (IAs) to describe behavioral changes induced by fine-tuning. However, existing studies primarily consider settings in which the model is fine-tuned on datasets explicitly designed to implant a specific behavior and is then asked to explain the implanted behavior. This differs from practical deployment scenarios, where the misalignment is not necessarily deliberately implanted, but arises only as a side effect. To bridge this gap, we formulate a novel problem setting, in which the target of introspection is not necessarily a behavior explicitly implanted through fine-tuning, but rather alignment shifts that may emerge as unintended side effects, and we construct a dataset for this setting. Furthermore, to enhance sensitivity to internal model changes, we propose the Delta-Aware Introspection Adapter (DAIA), a novel mechanism designed to explicitly process both base-model activations and activation differences induced by fine-tuning. Our empirical evaluation shows that introspection learning generalizes to unseen fine-tuned models and safety categories, and that DAIA generally outperforms existing IAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把内省适配器 (introspection adapter) 的目标从「解释被刻意植入的行为」改成「识别微调副作用导致的对齐偏移」，并提出 Delta-Aware Introspection Adapter (DAIA)，显式同时处理基座激活与微调引起的激活差分。实证显示内省学习能泛化到未见过的微调模型与安全类别，且 DAIA 总体优于现有 IA。
Motivation: 现有内省适配器研究都设定在专门设计的数据集上刻意植入行为再让模型解释，而实际部署中的失准往往只是微调的副作用、并非刻意植入，这一场景尚未被形式化。
Method: 构造面向副作用型对齐偏移的新问题设定与配套数据集；提出 DAIA 机制，用 LoRA 式模块显式联合处理基座模型激活与微调诱导的激活差分，以提升对内部模型变化的敏感度。
Result: 实证评估显示内省学习可泛化到未见过的微调模型与安全类别，且 DAIA 总体优于现有 introspection adapters；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 对齐偏移的内省不必依赖刻意植入的行为设定，显式建模微调前后激活差分能更敏感地捕捉副作用型失准。

papers.title: Assuming You Knew: Fixing an Epistemic Semantics for Flow Policies Using Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Many high-level security requirements are about the allowed flow of information in programs and are difficult to make precise because they involve selective downgrading. Notions from epistemic logic have emerged as a good approach to policy semantics but a robust general framework remains elusive. A paper appearing in CSF 2018, entitled ``Assuming You Know: Epistemic Semantics of Relational Annotations for Expressive Flow Policies'', attempted to provide a unifying framework---but the formalization was sketchy and a correction was announced during the conference presentation. With aid from an agentic AI coding assistant, a corrected formalization has been machine checked in the Rocq proof assistant. The simplicity and generality of the framework may help compare different policy specification styles and enforce them by leveraging existing techniques.
papers.comment: v2 adds notion of alignment fiat; also minor revisions and link to new version of Rocq code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 CSF 2018 论文《Assuming You Know》中原本粗略且已在会上宣布更正的信息流策略认识论语义 (epistemic semantics) 重新形式化，并借助 agentic AI 编码助手在 Rocq 证明助手中完成机器检查；v2 另加入 alignment fiat 概念。作者主张该框架的简洁与一般性可用于比较不同策略规约风格并复用既有强制执行技术。
Motivation: 选择性降级 (selective downgrading) 使高层安全需求难以精确刻画，认识论逻辑虽成为策略语义的可行路径，但缺少稳健的一般框架；CSF 2018 的统一尝试形式化粗糙且当场更正。
Method: 对关系标注 (relational annotations) 的信息流策略给出修正后的认识论语义形式化，用 agentic AI 编码辅助完成，并在 Rocq 证明助手中机器检查；v2 增补 alignment fiat 概念并更新 Rocq 代码版本链接。

papers.title: DASH-OPD: Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While on-policy distillation (OPD) reduces exposure bias by training student language models on their own rollouts, early student errors in long-horizon agentic scenarios can lead to contexts unfamiliar to the teacher. To improve trajectory quality, recent work on agentic OPD introduces teacher intervention into training rollouts by switching the executor between the student and the teacher. However, existing methods determine how much teacher intervention is needed---but not when. To address this limitation, we propose DASH-OPD (Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for OPD), the first agentic OPD method to perform adaptive, bidirectional executor switching. At each turn, DASH-OPD measures teacher--student discrepancy using a mean log-likelihood ratio over action tokens. High student-to-teacher ratios on student turns serve as drift signals, while low teacher-to-student ratios on teacher turns serve as recovery signals. These signals are accumulated over multiple turns to form drift and recovery evidence, respectively. DASH-OPD switches executors when either type of evidence exceeds its corresponding switching threshold, introducing hysteresis that prevents rapid switching triggered by transient discrepancy fluctuations. Across three benchmarks and two student model scales, DASH-OPD outperforms five baselines in all 14 task-performance comparisons, while requiring the fewest interaction turns in nine of ten efficiency comparisons. Code, trained models, and training logs are available at https://github.com/Lucian1115/DASH-OPD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DASH-OPD 在 agentic on-policy distillation 中做自适应双向执行器切换：用动作 token 上的平均对数似然比度量师生差异，学生轮的高 student-to-teacher 比作为漂移信号、教师轮的低 teacher-to-student 比作为恢复信号，跨多轮累积成证据并设双阈值引入迟滞 (hysteresis)，避免瞬时差异抖动导致的频繁切换。在三个 benchmark、两种学生规模上，14 项任务性能对比全部胜过五个基线，10 项效率对比中 9 项用的交互轮数最少。
Motivation: agentic OPD 里学生早期错误会把长程 rollout 带进教师陌生的上下文；现有教师介入方法只决定介入多少，不决定何时介入，切换时机固定。
Method: DASH-OPD 在每轮用动作 token 上的平均对数似然比度量 teacher-student discrepancy：学生轮的高 student-to-teacher 比记为漂移信号，教师轮的低 teacher-to-student 比记为恢复信号；两类信号跨多轮累积为证据，任一超过各自切换阈值即切换执行器，双阈值形成迟滞。
Result: 在三个 benchmark、两种学生模型规模上，DASH-OPD 在全部 14 项任务性能对比中超过五个基线；在 10 项效率对比中的 9 项需要的交互轮数最少。
Conclusion: 教师介入的时机可以由师生差异的漂移/恢复证据加迟滞自适应决定，同时改善任务性能与交互效率。

papers.title: Efficient LLM Adversarial Training via Low-Rank Defense and Circuit-Guided Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training is one of the most effective defenses against adversarial attacks, yet the computational cost remains prohibitive at modern scales, especially for large language models (LLMs). While existing mitigation strategies, e.g., latent adversarial training (LAT), have been developed, they still incur a high computational cost. In this work, focusing on LLM-based classifiers, we investigate computation-efficient strategies to speed up LAT from two complementary perspectives: (1) Defense-side optimization: We explore representation fine-tuning (ReFT) within LAT, and reveal a potential issue if there is a mismatch on which tokens to apply ReFT and the attack. (2) Attack-side optimization: When computing adversarial attacks in each LAT iteration, we extract only the relevant circuits from the LLM to construct a lightweight surrogate model, avoiding the computation in the forward-backward passes through the full model during the attack generation. For both perspectives, we provide theoretical justifications and numerical evidence to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategies. Compared to standard LAT with full fine-tuning, our method on average reduces per-step adversarial-training FLOPs by 29.6% while requiring only 0.0118% trainable parameters, at a moderate cost in robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 LLM 分类器的潜在对抗训练 (LAT) 提速方案：防御侧在 LAT 中引入表示微调 (ReFT) 并指出 ReFT 作用的 token 与攻击 token 不匹配会出问题，攻击侧只抽取 LLM 中相关 circuit 构造轻量 surrogate 来生成攻击，省去全模型前反向传播。相比全参数微调的标准 LAT，每步对抗训练 FLOPs 平均降 29.6%，可训练参数仅 0.0118%，代价是鲁棒性有适度损失。
Motivation: 对抗训练是抵御对抗攻击最有效的手段，但在现代规模尤其是 LLM 上计算代价过高；现有缓解方案如 LAT 仍然昂贵，需要在防御侧和攻击侧同时降低开销。
Method: 两条互补路线：防御侧在 LAT 框架内探索表示微调 (ReFT)，并分析 ReFT 所选 token 与攻击 token 不匹配带来的问题；攻击侧在每次 LAT 迭代生成对抗攻击时，只从 LLM 中抽取相关 circuits 构成轻量 surrogate 模型，避免全模型前向-反向传播。两个方向均给出理论论证与数值证据。
Result: 相对全参数微调的标准 LAT，该方法平均每步对抗训练 FLOPs 降低 29.6%，可训练参数只占 0.0118%，鲁棒性有适度代价 (moderate cost in robustness)；实验对象为 LLM-based classifiers。
Conclusion: 在 LLM 分类器上，把防御侧的 ReFT 与攻击侧的 circuit 引导 surrogate 结合，可以在可训练参数近乎为零的情况下显著削减 LAT 每步计算量，代价是鲁棒性适度下降。

papers.title: SciFigQual-Bench: A Benchmark for Scientific Figure Quality Assessment with Full-Manuscript Context
papers.abstract_en: Scientific figure quality is bound to the manuscript: a crop can be visually clear and still contradict its caption or the paragraph that cites it. Most image quality assessment and chart-understanding methods target a detached visual surface or a question-answering score, rather than alignment among the figure, its caption, and the citing text. A single end-to-end prompt that sees the image and the text together still mixes what is visible with what the caption and the citing paragraph claim, so fluent wording can raise a visual score and missing text can be treated as low quality. To address this gap, we introduce SciFigQual-Bench, a manuscript-linked benchmark for published CS-conference figures that binds each figure to its caption and to index-resolved citing paragraphs, and scores visual clarity, layout, caption consistency, context consistency, and misleading risk, leaving a dimension unevaluated when its evidence is absent. SFQ-Agent reads the image and the text in separate calls and records modality-specific evidence. A cross-modal judge scores caption and citing-text alignment from those reports, and a deterministic runner keeps the visual scores, sets misleading risk by a fixed rule, and applies the written caps, so each dimension follows the rubric instead of a single end-to-end prompt. Experiments comparing this staged judge with single-pass and OCR-sidecar protocols find the closest point-estimate fit to mean human ratings under staged judging, while the gap between protocols remains small. Caption consistency remains the main gap, and agreement with the rater mean answers a different question from agreement among human raters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciFigQual-Bench 把论文图表与其 caption、索引定位的引用段落绑定，分维度打视觉清晰度、布局、caption 一致性、上下文一致性和误导风险，证据缺失的维度直接留空不评。SFQ-Agent 分别读图与读文并记录模态内证据，跨模态 judge 打分，确定性 runner 保留视觉分、按固定规则定误导风险并施加书面封顶；对比 single-pass 与 OCR-sidecar 协议的实验中，staged judging 与人类评分均值的点估计拟合最接近，但协议间差距很小。
Motivation: 现有图像质量评估与图表理解方法只看脱离文本的视觉表面或给一个 QA 分数，无法判断图表是否与 caption、引用它的段落一致；单一端到端 prompt 会把可见内容与文本主张混在一起，措辞流畅可抬高视觉分、缺文本会被当成低质量。
Method: SciFigQual-Bench 收集已发表 CS 会议论文图表，绑定 caption 与 index-resolved 引用段落，按五个维度评分且证据缺失即不评。SFQ-Agent 以独立调用分别读图与读文并记录模态专属证据，跨模态 judge 依据这些报告评 caption 与引用文本对齐，确定性 runner 保留视觉分、按固定规则设定误导风险并执行书面封顶。
Result: 对比 staged judge、single-pass 与 OCR-sidecar 三种协议的实验中，staged judging 与人类评分均值的点估计拟合最接近，但协议间差距仍小；caption consistency 是主要差距来源，且与评分者均值的一致性不同于人类评分者之间的一致性。
Conclusion: 按维度分阶段、证据驱动的评审比单一端到端 prompt 更贴合人类评分均值，但提升幅度有限，caption 一致性仍是主要瓶颈，且与 rater 均值吻合并不等于人类评分者彼此一致。

papers.title: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Information in Multimodal Predictive Representations
papers.abstract_en: A central premise of latent world models is that predicting the future encourages representations to internalize the physics of their environment. We ask which physical quantities are accessible in learned latent states, how this depends on training, and how those quantities relate to the model's predictions. We present PokeWorld, a simulated environment in which a robot finger pushes objects whose mass, drag, and contact stiffness vary across episodes while remaining visually identical. We first measure parameter recovery from raw observation sequences, then train matched action-conditioned world models. Prediction targets can strongly shape latent content. For example, contact stiffness becomes decodable when touch is predicted, while providing touch only as an input does not. Longer-horizon prediction improves estimation of position and velocity from learned representations relative to single-step prediction. Drag is recoverable from raw observations, but has weak linear readout from the learned latent states. Yet the models' glide forecasts depend systematically on drag. Experiments on RH20T reproduce the same input-target dependence on real multimodal robot data. Together, these results show that observations, prediction targets, and prediction horizons shape both which physical quantities are accessible in latent states and how they affect future predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PokeWorld 仿真环境中机器人手指推动物体，质量、阻力、接触刚度逐回合变化但外观完全相同，用于检验 latent world model 的隐状态到底编码了哪些物理量。预测目标决定隐状态内容：把触觉作为预测目标时接触刚度可被线性解码，只作为输入则不行；多步预测比单步预测更能从隐状态中估计位置与速度。阻力可从原始观测恢复、隐状态线性读出很弱，但滑行预测仍系统性依赖阻力；RH20T 真实多模态机器人数据复现了同样的输入-目标依赖。
Motivation: latent world model 的核心假设是预测未来会让表征内化环境物理，但哪些物理量真正进入隐状态、如何随训练目标与时域变化、与模型预测是什么关系，此前缺少直接测量。
Method: 构建 PokeWorld 仿真环境（物体质量、drag、contact stiffness 跨回合变化且视觉相同），先从原始观测序列测参数可恢复性，再训练配对的 action-conditioned world model，改变预测目标（触觉作为输入 vs. 作为预测目标）与预测时域（单步 vs. 多步），对隐状态做线性 readout，并在真实数据集 RH20T 上复现。
Result: 触觉作为预测目标时 contact stiffness 变为可解码，仅作为输入则不可；多步预测相对单步预测提升位置与速度的估计；drag 可从原始观测恢复但隐状态线性 readout 弱，而 glide 预测仍系统性依赖 drag；RH20T 真实多模态机器人数据复现同一输入-目标依赖。
Conclusion: 观测、预测目标与预测时域共同决定哪些物理量在隐状态中可访问、以及它们如何影响未来预测；隐状态可解码性与预测依赖性可以脱节（drag 即为例证）。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Prior Directions: Separating Geometric Identification from Behavioral Efficacy in Visual Revision
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models can remain anchored to stale verbal priors even when current visual evidence supports a different answer. We use this controlled revision failure to ask whether the subspace that best captures recurrent prior-induced representation change is also uniquely more behaviorally effective. Across four models, paired prior and reference states define Prior Directions, a compact low-rank geometry that, at rank 32, spans only 0.78% of the state dimensions yet captures 49.7% to 64.0% of held-out displacement energy. Matched correspondence improves held-out capture at every tested rank in all four models; across 20 permutation seeds, this advantage remains positive in all 15 available combinations of model and rank. Yet the geometric advantage does not translate into a comparable intervention advantage: matched and Pairing-Permuted edits restore 60/66 and 59/66 clean prior-induced failures, respectively. We trace this discrepancy to the geometry of the realized edits. Pairing-Permuted edits remain strongly aligned with the matched Prior Directions; their aligned component restores 59/66 cases, whereas an equally norm-matched orthogonal residual restores only 20/66. These results show that the construction that best identifies recurrent representation change need not be uniquely more behaviorally effective, distinguishing global subspace identification from the geometry actually used by an intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在视觉语言模型的受控修订失败上，用成对 prior/reference 状态定义的 Prior Directions 低秩子空间（rank 32 仅占状态维度 0.78%，却捕获 49.7%–64.0% 的留出位移能量）在几何上确实优于打乱配对的对照，但行为干预上几乎不占优：matched 与 Pairing-Permuted 编辑分别修复 60/66 与 59/66 个 prior 诱导错误。差异来自编辑几何——Permuted 编辑仍与 matched Prior Directions 强对齐，其对齐分量修复 59/66，而等范数正交残差只修复 20/66。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型会被陈旧的言语先验锚定，即使当前视觉证据支持另一答案；需要区分「最能刻画反复出现的 prior 表示变化的子空间」与「干预时真正起作用的几何」。
Method: 在四个模型上，用成对的 prior 状态与 reference 状态定义 Prior Directions 这一低秩几何，并与 Pairing-Permuted（打乱配对）对照比较；在多个 rank 与 20 个 permutation seed 上评估留出位移能量捕获，再对编辑做对齐分量与等范数正交残差的分解干预。
Result: rank 32 只占状态维度 0.78%，捕获 49.7%–64.0% 的留出位移能量；matched 对应在全部四个模型的每个测试 rank 上都提高留出捕获，20 个 permutation seed 下该优势在全部 15 个可用的模型×rank 组合中均为正。行为上 matched 与 Pairing-Permuted 编辑分别修复 60/66 与 59/66 个 prior 诱导失败；Permuted 编辑的对齐分量修复 59/66，而等范数正交残差仅修复 20/66。
Conclusion: 最优识别反复表示变化的构造并不唯一更具行为有效性，全局子空间识别与干预实际使用的几何是两回事。

papers.title: Budget-Aware LLM Discovery via Cost-Calibrated Frontier Utility
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly support scientific and algorithmic discovery through inference-time search over evaluated candidates. Existing adaptive discovery controllers assign credit based only on score progress, even though prompt length, retries, and guidance calls cause search actions to incur different token costs. Under a fixed search budget, the controller must decide which frontier to develop and whether its gain justifies the realized cost before the budget is exhausted. We prove that, in the worst case, cost-blind control can forfeit all but a vanishing fraction of attainable quality as frontier count and cost heterogeneity grow. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{CostAda}, an adaptive controller built on \emph{cost-calibrated frontier utility}. By valuing progress relative to realized action cost and conditioning credit on the remaining budget, CostAda coordinates local exploration intensity, frontier allocation, and budgeted tactic intervention. Realized action cost and remaining budget therefore shape the search rather than serving only as accounting variables or a stopping rule. Across eight benchmarks with GLM-5 and GPT-5.4, CostAda reaches the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with at most half the budget on thirteen of sixteen benchmark--backbone pairs and achieves the strongest final quality on all sixteen pairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CostAda 用「成本校准的前沿效用」改造 LLM 推断时搜索控制器：按实际动作成本折算进展、并把剩余预算纳入信用分配，从而在固定预算下决定开发哪条前沿。理论上证明成本盲控制在前沿数与成本异质性增长时最坏情况只能保住可得质量的消失比例；在 8 个基准 × GLM-5/GPT-5.4 共 16 组配对上，13 组以至多一半预算达到最强基线满预算质量，16 组全部取得最强最终质量。
Motivation: 现有自适应发现控制器只按分数进展分配信用，忽略 prompt 长度、重试与 guidance 调用带来的 token 成本差异，固定预算下无法判断某前沿的增益是否值得其实际开销。
Method: 提出 CostAda：以实际动作成本为分母折算进展、并以剩余预算为条件分配信用，据此协调局部探索强度、前沿分配与受预算约束的 tactic 干预；并给出成本盲控制的最坏情况损失证明。
Result: 在 8 个基准、GLM-5 与 GPT-5.4 两个 backbone 的 16 个 benchmark–backbone 配对中，CostAda 在 13 个配对上用至多一半预算即达到最强基线满预算时的质量，并在全部 16 个配对上取得最强最终质量；理论上，前沿数与成本异质性增长时成本盲控制最坏情况仅保住可得质量的消失比例 (vanishing fraction)。
Conclusion: 把实际成本与剩余预算写进信用分配本身（而非只当记账或停止条件），可在同等或更省的预算下稳定提高 LLM 推断时搜索的最终质量。

papers.title: Existence-Field Diffusion Model for Spatial Point Processes with Variable Cardinality
papers.abstract_en: We study generative modeling of spatial point processes (SPP), where both the number of points and their spatial configuration are governed by a joint distribution. While diffusion models have achieved strong performance in modeling complex distributions, extending them to variable-cardinality SPP remains challenging. Existing approaches either sample cardinality before generating locations conditionally, or introduce specialized discrete operations to change the number of points during generation. We propose the existence-field diffusion model (EFDM), which associates each potential point with a continuous variable representing its degree of presence. EFDM uses Gaussian diffusion to jointly model point locations and cardinality through a simple continuous representation. Existence probabilities can increase or decrease in both forward and reverse diffusion, without explicit point-addition or point-deletion steps. The same construction naturally accommodates categorical attributes, allowing locations, existence, and attributes to be modeled together. Experiments demonstrate improved molecular stability and validity over the compared baselines on the molecular dataset, alongside competitive performance on real-world spatial and synthetic datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出存在场扩散模型 (EFDM)，给每个潜在点配一个连续的“存在程度”变量，用高斯扩散把点位置与点数 (cardinality) 联合建模，前向与反向过程中存在概率都可升可降，无需显式的加点/删点离散操作。在分子数据集上相对基线提升了分子的稳定性与有效性，并在真实空间数据与合成数据集上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 空间点过程 (SPP) 的点数与位置由联合分布决定，现有扩散方法要么先采样点数再条件生成位置，要么引入专门的离散增删操作，难以统一处理变点数生成。
Method: EFDM 为每个潜在点赋予连续存在变量，用 Gaussian diffusion 联合建模位置与 cardinality；存在概率在前向与反向扩散中均可增减，无需显式加点/删点步骤；同一构造可自然容纳类别属性，把位置、存在与属性一起建模。
Result: 在分子数据集上，EFDM 相对所比较基线提升了分子的稳定性 (stability) 与有效性 (validity)；在真实空间数据集与合成数据集上取得有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 用连续存在场替代离散增删操作，可以在一个高斯扩散框架内统一处理变点数空间点过程的位置、点数与类别属性生成。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: ClinLens: Towards Long-Horizon LLM Agents for Longitudinal Multimodal Clinical Data Science
papers.abstract_en: Automating clinical data science requires agents to translate patient-centric objectives into executable workflows grounded in longitudinal multimodal evidence. Existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of two essential capabilities: grounding analyses in the correct patient episode and harmonizing multimodal observations. We introduce ClinLens, a patient-centric benchmark for evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon clinical data science workflows. ClinLens comprises 126 executable tasks spanning five data modalities, four analytical scopes, and five analytical capabilities. The tasks assess agents' ability to maintain a coherent patient-specific analytical context across interdependent stages of evidence grounding, multimodal integration, and analytical pipeline generation and execution. We evaluate general-purpose, coding, and biomedical agents, with task runs averaging 36.93 steps and 8.06 minutes. The strongest evaluated agent achieves an execution success rate of 86.4% and a final-answer accuracy of 54.0%, but a strict pass rate of only 29.4%. Failure analysis identifies patient-episode grounding as the most frequently recorded failure category under the evaluation procedure. By jointly evaluating analytical outcomes and the validity of the supporting clinical context, ClinLens provides a testbed for advancing reliable agents for longitudinal clinical data science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClinLens 是面向纵向多模态临床数据科学的 LLM agent 基准，含 126 个可执行任务，覆盖五种数据模态、四种分析范围与五类分析能力，要求 agent 在证据定位、多模态整合与分析流水线生成执行的多阶段任务中维持一致的患者上下文。评测中任务平均跑 36.93 步、8.06 分钟，最强 agent 执行成功率 86.4%、最终答案准确率 54.0%，但严格通过率仅 29.4%，失败分析显示患者就诊片段定位 (patient-episode grounding) 是记录最多的失败类别。
Motivation: 现有临床数据科学基准对两项能力覆盖不足：把分析锚定到正确的患者就诊片段，以及协调多模态观测；长时程 agent 在跨阶段维持患者特异分析上下文的能力缺少可执行的评测载体。
Method: 构建患者中心基准 ClinLens：126 个可执行任务，横跨五种数据模态、四种分析范围 (analytical scopes) 与五类分析能力，任务链要求 agent 依次完成证据定位 (evidence grounding)、多模态整合 (multimodal integration) 与分析流水线生成并执行；评测对象包括通用、编码与生物医学三类 agent，同时考核分析产出与支撑临床上下文的有效性。
Result: 任务运行平均 36.93 步、耗时 8.06 分钟；被评测中最强的 agent 执行成功率 86.4%，最终答案准确率 54.0%，严格通过率 (strict pass rate) 仅 29.4%；失败分析中患者就诊片段定位是评测流程下记录最频繁的失败类别。
Conclusion: 执行成功不等于答案正确：LLM agent 能跑完长时程临床工作流，但严格通过率被患者片段定位失败拉到 29.4%，因此可靠临床数据科学 agent 需同时考核分析结果与上下文有效性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: One Analyst Is Not Ground Truth: Grading Agent-Built Financial Models Against Observed Professional Practice
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents can now construct complete financial models, but it remains unclear whether they have learned the financial judgment that gives those models meaning. Existing benchmarks often anchor correctness to an expert-authored solution (e.g., numerical targets or detailed rubrics) which introduces a implicit assumption: \emph{one expert solution can serve as ground truth.} This is appropriate when finance provides a unique answer, but not when judgment is required. Evidence from professional practice challenges this assumption: When financial models built by different analysts for the same company are graded against one another, the median score is only 0.33 under standard tolerances, \emph{revealing that single-reference grading confounds professional disagreement with error.} We therefore introduce GAUGE, a benchmark that decomposes financial-model evaluation into deterministic checks, rubric judgments and numerical rules. Built from 1,001 professional valuation spanning 922 companies and all 25 GICS industry groups, GAUGE checks mechanical properties deterministically and evaluates judgment-bearing quantities against ranges in professional practice. We then validate GAUGE as a measurement instrument by testing expertise ordering, held-out professional values, and robustness to LM judgements. Our findings show that current LM agents are far better at constructing financial models than at deriving the company-specific assumptions that drive valuation, a gap that even persists after fine-tuning.
papers.comment: 55 pages, including appendices. Code, benchmark materials, and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAUGE 把金融模型评测拆成确定性检查、rubric 判断与数值规则三部分，用执业分布区间而非单一专家答案打分。不同分析师为同一家公司建的模型互评中位分仅 0.33，说明单参考评测把专业分歧误判为错误；当前 LM agent 建模能力强于推导公司特定估值假设，且微调后差距仍在。
Motivation: 现有基准默认一个专家解即 ground truth，但金融估值在需要判断的量上本就没有唯一答案，单参考打分会把分析师间的专业分歧算成模型错误。
Method: 提出 GAUGE 基准，将评测分解为确定性检查 (deterministic checks)、rubric 判断与数值规则 (numerical rules)：机械属性用确定性方式校验，承载判断的量对照执业实践中的取值区间评分。数据为 1,001 份专业估值、覆盖 922 家公司与全部 25 个 GICS 行业组；通过专家排序、留出专业值、对 LM 判断的稳健性三类检验来验证其作为测量工具的效度。
Result: 不同分析师为同一公司构建的模型互评，在标准容差下中位分仅 0.33。GAUGE 建于 1,001 份专业估值、922 家公司、25 个 GICS 行业组之上，并通过 expertise ordering、留出专业值与对 LM 判断的稳健性验证。评测显示 LM agent 构建财务模型的能力远强于推导驱动估值的公司特定假设，该差距在微调后依然存在。

papers.title: SeekJudge: A Practical Reward Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deciding whether a trajectory actually fulfills its instruction determines how we measure computer-use agents on long-horizon graphical-user-interface tasks and how we train them with reinforcement learning (RL). This judgment has long relied on rule-based evaluation. Rule-based evaluation often disagrees with human intention and becomes outdated when an app updates or its online content drifts. Existing model-based judges attempt to address these problems, but their judging accuracy remains limited. We propose the \textbf{SeekJudge} framework, whose four agents, a Condense, a Ground, a Seek and an Analyze agent, reach a verdict through a Seek--Analyze loop over the trajectory. To train a specialized model on densely labeled trajectories, we propose a seed-driven distillation pipeline that expands a few human-labeled seed trajectories into $10$K such trajectories. To evaluate step-level judgments, we build CUAStepBench, a human-annotated benchmark that pairs trajectory verdicts with dense step labels. Beyond accuracy, SeekJudge costs far less than a closed-source large model. We further propose rollout overlap, a reward-server design that reduces the overhead of a reward model in RL training. To our knowledge, SeekJudge is the first model-based reward to match or surpass native rule-based reward in online RL, measured by downstream success rate on held-out RL test goals. In offline judging, SeekJudge-9B also exceeds rule-based evaluation by $9.5$ F1 on AgentRewardBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeekJudge 用 Condense、Ground、Seek、Analyze 四个 agent 经 Seek–Analyze 循环判定 GUI 轨迹是否完成指令，并以种子驱动蒸馏把少量人工标注轨迹扩到 10K 训练专用评判模型。在线 RL 中它首次达到或超过原生规则奖励的下游成功率，离线判定在 AgentRewardBench 上比规则评估高 9.5 F1。
Motivation: 长时程 computer-use agent 的轨迹判定长期依赖规则评估，规则与人类意图不一致且随应用更新或线上内容漂移而失效；已有 model-based judge 的判定精度不足。
Method: SeekJudge 框架由 Condense、Ground、Seek、Analyze 四个 agent 组成，对轨迹经 Seek–Analyze 循环给出 verdict；用 seed-driven distillation pipeline 把少量人工标注种子轨迹扩成 10K 条密集标注轨迹训练专用模型；另提出 rollout overlap 这一 reward-server 设计以降低 RL 训练中奖励模型开销，并构建人标基准 CUAStepBench（轨迹 verdict 配密集 step 标签）。
Result: 离线判定上 SeekJudge-9B 在 AgentRewardBench 上比规则评估高 9.5 F1；在线 RL 中 SeekJudge 是首个在 held-out RL 测试目标的下游成功率上匹配或超过原生规则奖励的 model-based reward；成本远低于闭源大模型。
Conclusion: model-based 轨迹奖励可以在线 RL 中替代规则奖励并同时降低成本，前提是用密集标注蒸馏出专用判定模型并配合 rollout overlap 降低奖励服务开销。

papers.title: SARATR-X-v2: Scale-Aware Structural Pre-Training for SAR Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked image modeling has become a dominant paradigm for SAR pre-training, yet the design of the reconstruction target remains fundamentally unsettled. This article argues that a SAR pre-training target should satisfy two conditions to produce transferable representations: (i) physics-grounded stability, i.e., approximate invariance of the target operator to multiplicative speckle inherent in coherent imaging; and (ii) semantic scale compatibility, i.e., coverage of the heterogeneous spatial scales that downstream tasks demand. These two conditions are individually achievable but jointly difficult: physics-grounded stability favors fixed operators, while semantic scale compatibility favors data-driven composition. To this end, SARATR-X-v2 reconciles both within a single design. The target is constructed through fixed structural extractors spanning six receptive fields, from blind-spot local aggregation to directional log-ratio region contrast, and fused via learnable weights into one unified supervision signal for masked reconstruction. On twelve SAR benchmarks across classification, detection, and segmentation, SARATR-X-v2 achieves state-of-the-art transfer performance. Under synthetic speckle variation, the proposed target reduces perturbation drift in the learned supervision by nearly two orders of magnitude relative to pixel-space supervision. Taken together, these results support physics-grounded stability and semantic scale compatibility as a principled framework for pre-training target design under coherent imaging, and suggest that effective SAR pre-training is not about reconstructing more signal, but about reconstructing the right structural target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SARATR-X-v2 用六个感受野的固定结构提取器（从 blind-spot 局部聚合到方向性 log-ratio 区域对比）经可学习权重融合成统一的掩码重建监督目标，同时满足对乘性斑点的物理稳定性和语义尺度覆盖。在十二个 SAR 分类、检测、分割基准上取得 SOTA 迁移性能；在合成斑点变化下，其监督目标的扰动漂移比像素空间监督小近两个数量级。
Motivation: SAR 掩码预训练的重建目标设计未有定论：物理稳定偏好固定算子，语义尺度兼容偏好数据驱动组合，两者单独易得、兼顾难。
Method: 目标由跨越六个感受野的固定结构提取器构成（blind-spot 局部聚合到方向性 log-ratio 区域对比），用可学习权重融合为单一监督信号，驱动掩码图像重建 (masked image modeling) 预训练。
Result: 在覆盖分类、检测、分割的十二个 SAR 基准上达到 SOTA 迁移性能；在合成斑点变化下，所提目标使学习到的监督的扰动漂移相对像素空间监督减小近两个数量级。
Conclusion: 有效 SAR 预训练的关键不是重建更多信号，而是重建正确的结构目标；物理稳定与语义尺度兼容可作为相干成像下预训练目标设计的原则框架。

papers.title: On the Convergence of Stochastic Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) optimizes $J(B,A)=\mathcal L(W_\mathrm{base}+sBA)$ over two adapters $B \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times r}$ and $A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times n}$ that form a low-rank update to a frozen pretrained weight matrix $W_\mathrm{base} \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$. The prior analysis shows LoRA-GD takes $\exp\{\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})\}$ oracle calls to find an $ε$-stationary point such that $\|\nabla J(B,A)\|\leq ε$ in the deterministic setting. We sharpen the analysis and show that $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ full-gradient evaluations suffice for the same first-order criterion. We further study stochastic LoRA under unbiased gradient estimates and finite variance. We propose LoRA-NSGDM, which finds an $ε$-stationary point with $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-8})$ stochastic oracle complexity. Under the additional mean-square smoothness condition, we use variance reduction strategy and propose LoRA-STORM, which improves the stochastic oracle complexity to $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-6})$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LoRA 的双变量非凸优化 J(B,A)=L(W_base+sBA) 当作 bilevel 结构重新分析，将确定性 LoRA-GD 找到 ε-驻点的 oracle 复杂度从先前的 exp{O(ε^{-2})} 收紧到 O(ε^{-4})。对无偏有限方差随机梯度提出 LoRA-NSGDM，复杂度 O(ε^{-8})；在额外的均方光滑条件下用方差缩减提出 LoRA-STORM，改进到 O(ε^{-6})。
Motivation: 先前对 LoRA-GD 的收敛界是指数级 exp{O(ε^{-2})}，对 ε-驻点这一一阶判据过于松；随机 LoRA 在无偏有限方差梯度下的 oracle 复杂度此前缺少刻画。
Method: 把 J(B,A) 的优化结构重新刻画并收紧确定性分析；随机侧在无偏梯度估计与有限方差假设下提出 LoRA-NSGDM，再在附加均方光滑 (mean-square smoothness) 条件下引入方差缩减策略得到 LoRA-STORM。
Result: 确定性 LoRA-GD 达到 ‖∇J(B,A)‖≤ε 所需全梯度评估从 exp{O(ε^{-2})} 收紧为 O(ε^{-4})；LoRA-NSGDM 的随机 oracle 复杂度为 O(ε^{-8})；LoRA-STORM 在均方光滑条件下改进到 O(ε^{-6})。
Conclusion: LoRA 的一阶收敛界可以做成多项式级而非指数级，且方差缩减在均方光滑下能把随机复杂度再降两阶。

papers.title: Rethinking Open-World Video Anomaly Detection: Diagnosing Definition Blindness
papers.abstract_en: Open-world video anomaly detection (OWVAD) aims to localize anomalous events in videos according to a user-specified definition. An OWVAD detector should therefore use the supplied definition to decide what is anomalous. We call this behavior definition following, and its failure definition blindness. However, existing temporal evaluation protocols may obscure this distinction, making strong generic anomaly detection appear to reflect definition following. For example, Drift@5 and the customizable VAD protocol treat both normal frames and anomalies outside the current definition as negatives. Across the three benchmarks used in our study, normal frames account for 78.6%-96.4% of these negatives. As a result, the reported score can be driven largely by target-versus-normal separation rather than target-versus-other-anomaly separation. Consistent with this diagnosis, a LaGoVAD branch that never receives the anomaly definition nearly matches the full model under Drift@5. We therefore introduce three complementary definition-conditioned evaluations that separate definition following from generic anomaly detection. Applying them to VAD systems and general vision-language models on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD reveals that strong performance under existing evaluation can coexist with weak definition following. Motivated by these results, we introduce Definition-Contrastive Scoring (DeCoS), which reduces anomaly evidence shared across competing definitions and improves definition following across the three benchmarks. Our results show that generic anomaly detection and definition following are distinct capabilities and should be evaluated separately in OWVAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开放世界视频异常检测 (OWVAD) 的现有评测把正常帧与当前定义之外的异常都算作负例，导致分数主要反映目标与正常的区分而非按用户定义跟随异常。作者提出 Definition-Contrastive Scoring (DeCoS) 抑制跨定义共享的异常证据，在 UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD 上提升 definition following，主张通用异常检测与定义跟随是两种能力、须分开评测。
Motivation: Drift@5 与 customizable VAD 协议混淆了正常帧和定义外异常，使强通用异常检测被误读为定义跟随，评测无法区分这两种能力。
Method: 诊断现有协议的负例构成（三个基准中正常帧占负例 78.6%-96.4%），提出三个 definition-conditioned 评测分离定义跟随与通用异常检测，并给出 DeCoS 打分方法；在 UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD 上评测 VAD 系统与通用 vision-language model。
Result: 三个基准中正常帧占负例 78.6%-96.4%；从不接收异常定义的 LaGoVAD 分支在 Drift@5 下几乎追平完整模型；新评测显示现有协议下的强表现可与弱定义跟随并存；DeCoS 在三个基准上改善 definition following。
Conclusion: 通用异常检测与 definition following 是不同能力，OWVAD 应分开评测；DeCoS 通过削减跨定义共享的异常证据来提升定义跟随。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interval and fuzzy physics-augmented neural networks (iPANN and fPANN) for uncertainty quantification and propagation in constitutive modeling
papers.abstract_en: Constitutive modeling under uncertainty remains a central challenge for reliable mechanics simulations, particularly when the available stress-deformation data are sparse, noisy, or heterogeneous. We propose interval and fuzzy physics-augmented neural networks (iPANNs and fPANNs) for uncertainty-aware hyperelastic constitutive modeling. iPANNs learn sparse lower, mean, and upper free energy density branches whose stresses, obtained by automatic differentiation, ultimately enclose noisy stress observations. In contrast to this deterministic interval description, fPANNs embed the learned iPANN branches into a fuzzy-set representation through membership-level (alpha-cut) interpolation, yielding a nested family of admissible responses. iPANNs and fPANNs encode mechanistic constraints by preserving objectivity, consistency and promoting polyconvexity and, smoothed L0 regularization promoting interpretable energy representations. The bound models are trained through a two-stage transfer-learning procedure in which a sparse mean constitutive response is learned first and then fine-tuned into lower and upper energy branches. We evaluate the framework on synthetic isotropic hyperelastic data with heteroscedastic noise, varying random realizations, shifted noise means, and varying noise magnitudes. The results show that the learned bounds enclose noisy stress observations while generalizing to the test set. Further, we examine the propagation of uncertainty through the mean, upper and lower bound predictions of the learned iPANN models in a finite element setting. The proposed framework provides a compact, physics-consistent route for distribution-free aleatoric uncertainty quantification in hyperelastic constitutive modeling, and propagation in downstream finite element simulations.

Motivation: 本构建模在应力-变形数据稀疏、含噪或异构时难以量化不确定性，而确定性模型无法给出可传播的界。

papers.title: Latent-Action-Guided Vision-Language Contrastive Learning for Surgical Interaction Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing instrument-tissue interactions is essential for context-aware surgical AI. Vision-language models offer a natural way to inject semantic structure into surgical representations by aligning video features with textual action descriptions. However, pretrained encoders may lack spatial coherence, while global semantic alignment does not ensure precise spatial and temporal representations. By analyzing frame-to-frame feature changes, we find that semantic alignment increases their dimensionality, but larger increases do not necessarily improve recognition; encoders also differ in how strongly dominant changes localize to interaction regions. Motivated by these findings, we introduce LAViFiT, which compresses frame-to-frame changes into latent actions and predicts next-frame features during end-to-end video-language alignment. Without additional spatial or motion annotations, LAViFiT improves the interaction grounding of leading feature changes and temporal-direction sensitivity in our evaluated settings. We further characterize how action capacity and prediction strength affect recognition across encoders and triplet components. Using image encoders without large-scale video pretraining, LAViFiT achieves competitive recognition with faster inference and smaller INT4 accuracy drops than V-JEPA2/2.1, supporting its deployment potential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LAViFiT：在端到端视频-语言对齐中把逐帧特征变化压缩为 latent action 并预测下一帧特征，从而在不加额外空间或运动标注的情况下提升主导特征变化的交互定位与时间方向敏感性。在所评估设置下，用未做大规模视频预训练的图像编码器即可取得有竞争力的识别效果，推理更快、INT4 量化精度下降小于 V-JEPA2/2.1。
Motivation: 手术器械-组织交互识别需要精确的时空表征，但预训练视觉编码器可能缺乏空间一致性，全局语义对齐也无法保证空间与时间上的精确表示。
Method: LAViFiT 在端到端视频-语言对齐过程中，分析并压缩逐帧特征变化得到 latent action，用其预测下一帧特征；无需额外空间或运动标注，并在多种编码器与 triplet 组件上分析 action capacity 与 prediction strength 对识别的影响。
Result: 分析发现语义对齐会增大逐帧特征变化的维度，但维度增大并不必然改善识别，且不同编码器主导变化向交互区域的局化程度不同；LAViFiT 在所评估设置下改善了主导特征变化的交互 grounding 与时间方向敏感性，用无大规模视频预训练的图像编码器取得有竞争力的识别效果，推理更快且 INT4 精度下降小于 V-JEPA2/2.1。
Conclusion: 把帧间变化显式建模为可预测的 latent action，比单纯追求更强的全局语义对齐更能带来精确的时空表征，且轻量图像编码器配合该目标即可支撑部署。

papers.title: AdaFlash: Adaptive Speculative Decoding via On-Policy Distilled Diffusion Drafters
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding, in which a lightweight draft model first generates a draft sequence that is then verified by the target model, has become a prevalent paradigm for accelerating large language model inference. Recent work such as DFlash further boosts drafting efficiency by leveraging diffusion drafters, whose parallel denoising mechanism enables draft generation in a single forward pass. In this work, we uncover a central pitfall of diffusion drafters: the global dependency, arising from bidirectional attention and KV injection in diffusion drafters, is a double-edged sword. On one hand, it endows the model with parallel generation and global contextual modeling capabilities; on the other hand, this global dependency introduces high variance at both the domain-level and the token-level: acceptance rates fluctuate substantially across different domains, and the acceptance probability varies across draft positions. To tackle this issue, we propose the AdaFlash framework, comprising two components: (i) an on-policy distillation (OPD) algorithm with reverse-KL divergence tailored for diffusion drafters, which delivers stable convergence and continuously adapts the drafter to the deployment distribution; and (ii) an adaptive length head that dynamically adjusts the candidate length on the fly, substantially lowering the verification cost of the target model. Experiments demonstrate that AdaFlash consistently improves the speedup during deployment, with especially significant gains under high-concurrency, achieving up to 66% higher average throughput than previous state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZinYY/AdaFlash.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaFlash 针对扩散式草稿模型 (diffusion drafter) 中由双向注意力与 KV 注入带来的全局依赖，指出其在领域级和 token 级都造成接受率高方差。框架用面向扩散草稿器的 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD, reverse-KL) 持续适配部署分布，并用自适应长度头在线调整候选长度以降低目标模型验证开销。部署吞吐最高比先前 SOTA 高 66%，高并发下增益尤其显著。
Motivation: 扩散草稿器的全局依赖使接受率在不同领域间大幅波动、不同草稿位置的接受概率也不一致，导致投机解码的加速收益不稳定且验证成本偏高。
Method: AdaFlash 含两部分：一是为扩散草稿器设计的 on-policy 蒸馏算法 (OPD)，采用 reverse-KL 散度以获得稳定收敛并持续适配部署分布；二是自适应长度头 (adaptive length head)，在解码过程中动态调整候选草稿长度，从而降低目标模型的验证开销。
Result: 部署中加速一致提升，最高达到比先前 SOTA 方法高 66% 的平均吞吐，且在高并发场景下增益尤其显著。
Conclusion: 用 on-policy 蒸馏压低接受率方差、再用自适应长度控制验证成本，可以让扩散草稿器的投机解码在真实部署分布下稳定提速，高并发收益最大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lightweight Wrappers for Adapting Time Series Foundation Models to Regional Drought Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large \emph{Time Series Foundation Models} (TSFMs) demonstrate strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across diverse domains. However, their application to regional climate forecasting faces practical challenges: model weights are often proprietary, local training records are limited, and computational budgets are constrained, making traditional fine-tuning approaches infeasible. To address these constraints, we introduce a lightweight, black-box adaptation framework (requiring no access to backbone parameters and no backbone fine-tuning) that enhances frozen TSFMs at inference time through two plug-and-play wrappers: \textbf{SMR\textsuperscript{2}} (Stationarity aware multi-resolution Residual), which decomposes the input into multi-resolution temporal views, learns stride specific residual corrections that capture regional dynamics, then adaptively ensembles them into a single forecast, and \textbf{MBB} (Moving Block Bootstrap), which preserves temporal dependencies through block resampling and ensembles over temporally coherent residual perturbations to stabilize the point forecast. Both wrappers instantiate the same bagging style principle: they build diverse views of the input or its residuals, forecast each with the same frozen backbone, and aggregate, so all adaptation comes from inference time ensembling rather than any weight update. Evaluated on one month ahead Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) prediction across multiple sites in South Australia, our framework consistently improves forecasting performance across several backbone models, demonstrating up to 26\% mean squared error (MSE) reduction over the corresponding frozen backbone while enabling practical deployment in resource constrained regional forecasting systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不接触、不微调骨干权重的前提下，用两个即插即用的推理期包装器把冻结的时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 适配到区域干旱预测：SMR² 做多分辨率分解并学习步长特定残差校正后自适应集成，MBB 用移动块自助法 (Moving Block Bootstrap) 生成时间上连贯的残差扰动再集成。在南澳多站点提前一个月的 SPEI 预测上，相对冻结骨干最高降低 26% 的 MSE。
Motivation: 区域气候预测中 TSFM 权重常为专有、本地训练记录少、算力预算有限，传统微调不可行，需要不改权重的适配途径。
Method: 两个黑盒包装器共享 bagging 式原理：SMR² 将输入分解为多分辨率时间视图，学习 stride 特定的残差校正以捕捉区域动态，再自适应集成为单一预报；MBB 通过块重采样保持时间依赖，对时间连贯的残差扰动做集成以稳定点预报。全部适配来自推理期集成，骨干保持冻结。
Result: 在南澳多个站点提前一个月的 SPEI（标准化降水蒸散指数）预测上，框架在多个骨干模型上一致改善预测，相对对应冻结骨干的 MSE 最高降低 26%。
Conclusion: 不更新任何权重、仅靠推理期多视图与残差扰动集成，就能把冻结 TSFM 适配到资源受限的区域干旱预测系统。

papers.title: Compiled Agency: Coding Agents as Game AI Researchers -- from a Roguelike to StarCraft II and Civilization
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly capable of sustained engineering and empirical research. Greater autonomy makes their research decisions themselves a target for evaluation: what to investigate, which experiments to run, and when to stop. We introduce Gauntlet, a develop-freeze-evaluate protocol for studying these decisions as agents build standalone game-playing programs. Starting from a game description, a raw observation/action interface, and an empty policy file, an off-the-shelf agent develops a controller from bare interaction in one autonomous session. We call the capability under study compiled agency: the shipped program plays with zero model calls. The capability is real and advancing: environment access adds 10 to 78 percentage points of held-out success over construction-only controls, and progress across model generations comes in steps, with tiers that defeat one generation entirely falling to the next. The protocol yields StarCraft II controllers that defeat every fair built-in AI, and in the newest generation the strongest cheating tier as well, and Civilization controllers that win complete games by conquest. Replaying more than 5,000 frozen versions exposes the research behind the programs: gains that plateau early; rigorous local investigation beside sparse validation of what actually ships; and stops that follow a race between the agent's own evidence and a model-specific transcript budget it was never given. When validation panels are refreshed mid-session, so that only the evidence changes, shipped success rises 12.4 points in nine of nine completed pairs of twelve initiated. The experiments an agent designs are part of the capability it delivers; Gauntlet makes them measurable and improvable--a step toward agents whose research practice, not just whose code, can be engineered. We release the benchmark, the corpus, and the replay tooling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 develop-freeze-evaluate 协议 Gauntlet，衡量 coding agent 在单次自主会话中从零写出可独立运行的游戏控制器并自行决定研究过程的能力（compiled agency，运行时零模型调用）。环境访问使留出成功率比仅构造对照高 10 到 78 个百分点；刷新验证面板使九对完成配对中的九对留出成功率上升 12.4 个百分点。
Motivation: coding agent 的自主性提高后，其研究决策本身（查什么、跑什么实验、何时停止）成为需要可测量的对象，而现有评测只看最终代码。
Method: Gauntlet 协议：给定游戏描述、原始观测/动作接口与空策略文件，off-the-shelf agent 在一次自主会话中从裸交互开发控制器，随后 develop-freeze-evaluate；回放 5,000 多个冻结版本以还原 agent 的研究轨迹，并在会话中途刷新验证面板，只改变证据。
Result: 环境访问相对仅构造对照使留出成功率提高 10 到 78 个百分点；跨模型代际的进步呈台阶式，某代被完全击败的 tier 在下一代失效；产出的 StarCraft II 控制器击败全部公平内置 AI，最新一代还击败最强作弊 tier，Civilization 控制器能以征服赢下完整对局；回放 5,000 多个冻结版本显示早期即平台化、局部调查严格而对实际交付物验证稀疏、停止由 agent 自身证据与从未被告知的模型特定 transcript 预算赛跑决定；刷新验证面板后九对完成配对（共发起十二对）中九对留出成功率上升 12.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: agent 交付的实验设计本身是其能力的一部分，Gauntlet 使研究实践（而不只是代码）可测量、可改进；发布 benchmark、语料与回放工具。

summary_sections.method: Gauntlet 协议：给定游戏描述、原始观测/动作接口与空策略文件，off-the-shelf agent 在一次自主会话中从裸交互开发控制器，随后 develop-freeze-evaluate；回放 5,000 多个冻结版本以还原 agent 的研究轨迹，并在会话中途刷新验证面板，只改变证据。
summary_sections.result: 环境访问相对仅构造对照使留出成功率提高 10 到 78 个百分点；跨模型代际的进步呈台阶式，某代被完全击败的 tier 在下一代失效；产出的 StarCraft II 控制器击败全部公平内置 AI，最新一代还击败最强作弊 tier，Civilization 控制器能以征服赢下完整对局；回放 5,000 多个冻结版本显示早期即平台化、局部调查严格而对实际交付物验证稀疏、停止由 agent 自身证据与从未被告知的模型特定 transcript 预算赛跑决定；刷新验证面板后九对完成配对（共发起十二对）中九对留出成功率上升 12.4 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: agent 交付的实验设计本身是其能力的一部分，Gauntlet 使研究实践（而不只是代码）可测量、可改进；发布 benchmark、语料与回放工具。

papers.title: A Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning Framework for Fine-Tuning Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We formulate reinforcement learning (RL) in continuous time with discrete state spaces and possibly arbitrary action spaces via a stochastic control approach, where the state dynamics are modeled as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). We consider policy optimization problems and derive corresponding policy gradient methods, leading to continuous-time variants of proximal policy optimization (PPO) and group relative policy optimization (GRPO). As a primary application, we develop a continuous-time RL framework for fine-tuning score-based discrete diffusion models, which enables reward-driven optimization without requiring differentiability on the reward signals. In contrast to the existing GRPO-based approaches that only rely on terminal rewards, our formulation allows intermediate reward or advantage signals to be incorporated throughout the denoising trajectory. Importantly, when specialized to masked diffusion models (MDMs), our framework encompasses a rich class of policy parameterizations over the vocabulary simplex with analytically tractable probability ratios, providing a unified perspective on exploration and policy optimization in MDMs. For diffusion large language models (dLLMs), we further propose trajectory subsampling techniques to efficiently estimate computationally prohibitive trajectory likelihoods, reducing the computational cost of computing per-position probability ratios. We showcase the effectiveness of our methods on both low-dimensional entropy-regularized optimization problems and RL post-training of dLLMs on reasoning and coding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离散状态、任意动作空间的强化学习写成连续时间受控 CTMC 的随机控制问题，导出连续时间版 PPO 与 GRPO，用于 score-based 离散扩散模型的奖励驱动微调，且奖励无需可微。相比只用终端奖励的 GRPO 方法，该框架可在整条去噪轨迹上注入中间 reward/advantage；对 dLLM 提出轨迹子采样以估计逐位置概率比。
Motivation: 现有 GRPO 类离散扩散微调只依赖终端奖励，无法在去噪轨迹中途利用信号；同时轨迹似然计算量过大，逐位置概率比难以高效获得。
Method: 以受控连续时间 Markov 链 (CTMC) 建模状态动力学，经随机控制推导策略梯度，得到连续时间 PPO 与 GRPO 变体；在 masked diffusion models (MDMs) 上给出词汇单纯形上可解析计算概率比的策略参数化，并提出 trajectory subsampling 技术估计轨迹似然。
Result: 在低维熵正则优化问题以及 dLLM 的推理与编码任务 RL post-training 上展示方法有效性；框架支持去噪轨迹全程的中间 reward/advantage，并降低逐位置概率比的计算成本。
Conclusion: 连续时间随机控制视角可统一 MDM 的探索与策略优化，并在奖励不可微、需要中间奖励信号的扩散模型微调场景下给出可操作的 RL 方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BARS: Benign-Anchored Ranking and Selection for False Alarm Reduction in Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: False alarms remain a major barrier to deploying network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). In high-volume environments, even a sub-1% false positive rate can generate tens of thousands of daily alerts. Filter-based feature selection is attractive because it operates upstream of the classifier and adds no inference-time cost. However, classical filters use class-symmetric criteria that ignore the asymmetry of intrusion detection, where benign traffic defines the baseline and attacks are deviations from it. A recent class-asymmetric filter, Classwise Mean Deviation (CMD), addresses this issue but anchors its score to a global mean that shifts toward attack distributions under class imbalance, weakening the deviations it aims to capture. We propose Benign-Anchored Ranking and Selection (BARS), a two-stage filter that replaces CMD's global anchor with the benign-class mean and applies an order-preserving decorrelation step. We evaluate BARS on CICIDS2017, CICDDoS2019, and UNSW-NB15 using feature budgets k = {5, 10, 20, 30, 40}. On attack-majority datasets, where global-anchor bias is strongest, BARS reduces false positive rate relative to CMD by 15.4% on UNSW-NB15 at k = 20 and by 21% to 23% on CICDDoS2019 at small feature budgets while preserving true positive rate and macro-F1. On benign-majority data, BARS and CMD converge, consistent with the theoretical limit where global- and benign-anchored scores coincide. BARS reduces false alarms by up to 32% while maintaining similar detection rates, with larger gains under stronger imbalance. Ablation results show that the two stages provide complementary benefits and select a consistent set of robust features. BARS retains linear-time scoring and a low memory footprint, making it suitable for resource-constrained deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BARS 把类非对称特征过滤器 CMD 的全局均值锚点换成良性类均值，并加一步保序去相关，在类别失衡的网络入侵检测中压低误报。在攻击占多数的数据集上，UNSW-NB15 k=20 时误报率相对 CMD 降 15.4%，CICDDoS2019 小特征预算下降 21%–23%，总体最多降 32% 而检测率基本持平。
Motivation: 高流量环境中低于 1% 的误报率每天也能产生数万条告警；经典过滤式特征选择用类别对称准则，忽略了入侵检测中良性流量为基线、攻击为偏离的非对称性，而 CMD 的全局锚在类别失衡下会被攻击分布拉偏。
Method: 两阶段过滤器 BARS：第一阶段用良性类均值替代 CMD 的全局均值作为偏离评分锚点，第二阶段做保序去相关 (order-preserving decorrelation)；在 CICIDS2017、CICDDoS2019、UNSW-NB15 上按特征预算 k={5,10,20,30,40} 评测，并做消融。
Result: 攻击占多数数据集上，UNSW-NB15 k=20 时 BARS 相对 CMD 误报率降 15.4%，CICDDoS2019 小特征预算下降 21%–23%，同时保持真阳性率与 macro-F1；良性占多数时 BARS 与 CMD 收敛一致。总体误报最多降 32%，检测率相近，失衡越强增益越大；消融显示两阶段互补并选出一致的稳健特征集，评分保持线性时间与低内存。
Conclusion: 把锚点定在良性类而非全局均值，可在类别失衡的 NIDS 中在不牺牲检测率的前提下显著减少误报，且保留过滤器的线性开销，适合资源受限部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One Threshold Is Not Enough: Prompt-Invariant Caching Schedules for Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models remain expensive because denoising repeatedly evaluates a costly model backbone. Dynamic caching methods like TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache reduce this cost by reusing prior outputs while an accumulated drift signal remains below a threshold $τ$. Although existing methods improve the drift signal, they hold $τ$ fixed throughout denoising. We show that fixed thresholds are structurally suboptimal: varying $τ$ across denoising achieves quality-latency tradeoffs unattainable by any fixed threshold across three caching methods with distinct drift signals. We further show that, surprisingly, each method's drift trajectory is nearly prompt-invariant across seven method-model combinations. The shape of the drift trajectory is determined by the model and caching method; therefore, a threshold schedule can be calibrated offline and reused across generations. Based on these findings, we present ACID (Adaptive Caching for vIDeo generation), which uses a low threshold during critical regions where drift changes rapidly and a high threshold across stable regions. ACID identifies these regions offline from the drift signal's second derivative, requires no training, and adds negligible runtime overhead. Across TeaCache, EasyCache, and DiCache on HunyuanVideo, Wan 2.1, and CogVideoX, ACID pushes the speed-quality Pareto frontier beyond fixed thresholds. On TeaCache with HunyuanVideo, it achieves 2.16x speedup over no caching and 38% additional speedup over a conservative fixed threshold, with less than 0.3 dB PSNR, 0.01 SSIM, and 0.01 LPIPS degradation relative to that fixed-threshold configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视频扩散的动态缓存把累积漂移阈值 τ 全程固定，ACID 改为按时变调度：用漂移信号二阶导离线识别漂移快速变化的关键区并给低阈值、稳定区给高阈值，无需训练且几乎不增加运行开销。由于漂移轨迹在七组方法-模型组合上近似 prompt 不变，调度可离线标定后跨生成复用；在 TeaCache + HunyuanVideo 上相对不缓存加速 2.16 倍，相对保守固定阈值再提速 38%，PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 劣化分别小于 0.3 dB、0.01、0.01。
Motivation: TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache 等动态缓存靠累积漂移信号低于阈值 τ 来复用骨干输出，但 τ 在整个去噪过程中固定，作者证明固定阈值在结构上次优，无法达到时变阈值的质量-延迟折衷。
Method: ACID（Adaptive Caching for vIDeo generation）在离线阶段用漂移信号的二阶导数划分关键区与稳定区，前者用低阈值、后者用高阈值，训练无关且运行时开销可忽略；调度在 TeaCache、EasyCache、DiCache 三种漂移信号不同的缓存方法上验证，覆盖 HunyuanVideo、Wan 2.1、CogVideoX 共七组方法-模型组合。
Result: 固定阈值在三种缓存方法上均被时变阈值支配，存在固定阈值无法达到的质量-延迟折衷；各方法的漂移轨迹在七组方法-模型组合上近似 prompt 不变，轨迹形状由模型与缓存方法决定。在 TeaCache + HunyuanVideo 上，ACID 相对不缓存加速 2.16 倍，相对保守固定阈值额外提速 38%，相对该固定阈值配置的 PSNR 劣化小于 0.3 dB、SSIM 小于 0.01、LPIPS 小于 0.01，并把速度-质量 Pareto 前沿推到固定阈值之外。
Conclusion: 阈值 τ 应按时变调度而非全程固定：漂移轨迹由模型与缓存方法决定且对 prompt 不敏感，因此调度可一次离线标定后跨生成复用，在不训练、不加开销的前提下同时提高视频扩散的速度与质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agent Hacks Agents: Autoresearch Discovers Vulnerabilities in Production Agents
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents such as Claude Code and Codex can modify files and execute commands, so safety failures become real destructive actions. Automatic red-teaming lets safety teams test beyond static suites at the pace of deployment updates. Existing methods retain successful attacks but not why each attack succeeded, so after a failed reuse testers cannot tell whether the weakness is gone or the attack no longer fits. We instead retain vulnerability concepts, each stating why an attack succeeds, the condition that enables it, and the evidence that would refute it. Agent Hacks Agents (AHA) discovers these concepts with a Karpathy-style autoresearch loop that tests falsifiable hypotheses on agent trajectories. Repeatedly confirmed concepts enter a vulnerability concept graph that links related weaknesses. Across 18 settings of three scenarios, three victim models, and two agents, the concepts divide into eight families. A shared core recurs across agents, while diverse families appear only in specific settings. On held-out instances the concepts reach a 47.0% attack success rate (ASR) against 32.8% for the strongest baseline, which uses more discovery queries. Beyond the discovery setting, the concepts support two kinds of reuse. Generalization carries concepts to new victims, scenarios, and harnesses, and coordination joins graph-linked concepts into stronger attacks on two of three scenarios. For defense, patching each concept's enabling condition lowers AgentHazard ASR by 41.11 points. The concepts explain why production agents fail and where to repair the agents. Our code is in https://github.com/henrymao2004/Auto-research-red-teaming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AHA 用 Karpathy 式 autoresearch 循环在 agent 轨迹上检验可证伪假设，产出说明「攻击为何成功、在什么条件下成立、如何被证伪」的漏洞概念，并把反复确认的概念连成漏洞概念图。在 18 个设置（3 场景 × 3 victim 模型 × 2 agent）上概念分成 8 个家族，held-out 实例 ASR 47.0% 对最强基线 32.8%；按概念的启用条件打补丁使 AgentHazard ASR 下降 41.11 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有自动红队方法只保留成功攻击本身，不保留攻击成功的原因；一旦复用失败，测试者无法区分漏洞已修复还是攻击不再适配。
Method: AHA 通过 autoresearch 循环在 agent 轨迹上迭代提出并检验可证伪假设，产出漏洞概念（含成功原因、启用条件、证伪证据）；反复确认的概念进入漏洞概念图，用于跨设置复用（generalization）与图链接组合（coordination），防御侧则针对每个概念的启用条件打补丁。
Result: 在 18 个设置、3 个场景、3 个 victim 模型、2 个 agent 上概念分为 8 个家族，存在跨 agent 复现的共享核心与特定设置独有的多样家族；held-out 实例上 ASR 47.0%，最强基线 32.8%（且该基线用了更多 discovery queries）；coordination 在 3 个场景中的 2 个上组合出更强攻击；按启用条件打补丁使 AgentHazard ASR 下降 41.11 个百分点。
Conclusion: 漏洞应以「为何失败、在何处修复」的概念形式被保留和复用，而不只是保留攻击样本；概念图既能迁移到新 victim、场景与 harness，也能直接指导防御补丁。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: AHA 通过 autoresearch 循环在 agent 轨迹上迭代提出并检验可证伪假设，产出漏洞概念（含成功原因、启用条件、证伪证据）；反复确认的概念进入漏洞概念图，用于跨设置复用（generalization）与图链接组合（coordination），防御侧则针对每个概念的启用条件打补丁。
summary_sections.result: 在 18 个设置、3 个场景、3 个 victim 模型、2 个 agent 上概念分为 8 个家族，存在跨 agent 复现的共享核心与特定设置独有的多样家族；held-out 实例上 ASR 47.0%，最强基线 32.8%（且该基线用了更多 discovery queries）；coordination 在 3 个场景中的 2 个上组合出更强攻击；按启用条件打补丁使 AgentHazard ASR 下降 41.11 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 漏洞应以「为何失败、在何处修复」的概念形式被保留和复用，而不只是保留攻击样本；概念图既能迁移到新 victim、场景与 harness，也能直接指导防御补丁。

papers.title: TopoExplore: Homology as an Exploration Signal
papers.abstract_en: Exploration signals in reinforcement learning are currently computed from what an agent has seen: visitation counts, density estimates, or a model's prediction error at individual states. None of these report the holes in the visitation space. To capture them, we compute the persistent homology of the agent's own archive of visited states during exploration and turn each detected class (an enclosed region the archive surrounds but has not entered) into a selection bonus concentrated on the archived states from which entry is possible, gated by an attempt counter that retires candidate entrances and prunes sealed structures. The method, TopoExplore, is Go-Explore plus one additive term, so the comparison with Go-Explore isolates that term. On the 189 held-out worlds of the open-source TopoGym benchmark of topologically varied hard-exploration environments, TopoExplore finds the goal in 167 worlds against 152 for Go-Explore and, where both find it, with a median 126k steps against 186k. On an environment that stress-tests far-apart chambers that create holes in the archive space, TopoExplore enters all six or eight chambers across 5 seeds, against 1 and 2 of 5 seeds for Go-Explore. On Montezuma's Revenge, built over the room graph, the term helps whenever the archive surrounds a room it has not entered, puts 33-45% of the selections on the surrounding rooms while it is active, and enters the room sooner in five of six cases; such enclosures are rare on this game, so the score is unchanged. Beyond discrete, restorable state spaces, the same signal drives an embodied explorer that walks to every target it selects and explores from depth alone; a vision-language-action navigation policy fine-tuned on its trajectories succeeds 58% more often on unseen scenes than one fine-tuned on shortest-path oracle demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoExplore 在 Go-Explore 上加一项加性探索奖励：对智能体已访问状态档案算 persistent homology，把每个被包围但未进入的空腔转成朝可进入入口的选择加成，并用尝试计数器淘汰候选入口、剪除封闭结构。在 TopoGym 的 189 个留出世界中找到目标 167 个（Go-Explore 152），双方都找到时中位步数 126k 对 186k。
Motivation: 现有 RL 探索信号（访问计数、密度估计、单状态预测误差）都只描述智能体见过什么，无法报告访问空间中的洞，因而抓不住被包围却未进入的区域。
Method: 对智能体自身的已访问状态档案计算 persistent homology，把每个检出的同调类（档案包围但未进入的封闭区域）转成集中于可进入入口处档案状态的选择加成；用尝试计数器淘汰候选入口并剪除已封闭结构。方法是 Go-Explore 加一个加性项，因此与 Go-Explore 的对比隔离出该项的作用。
Result: TopoGym 189 个留出世界中找到目标 167 个，Go-Explore 为 152 个；双方都找到时中位步数 126k 对 186k。在远距腔室压力测试环境上，TopoExplore 5 个种子全部进入 6 或 8 个腔室，Go-Explore 分别为 5 个种子中的 1 个和 2 个。Montezuma's Revenge（基于房间图）上该项在档案包围未进入房间时生效，激活期间 33–45% 的选择落在周围房间，6 例中 5 例更早进入该房间，但此类包围在该游戏罕见，分数不变。由其轨迹微调的 vision-language-action 导航策略在未见场景上的成功率比用最短路 oracle 演示微调的策略高 58%。
Conclusion: 把访问空间的洞（同调类）本身当作探索信号，能在拓扑多样的困难探索环境中提高找到目标的比例并降低步数；在包围结构罕见的环境（如 Montezuma's Revenge）中该项不改变分数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Across the Cardiac Amyloidosis Diagnostic and Management Pathway: From Single-Modality Detection to Multimodal Clinical Integration
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac amyloidosis (CA) is increasingly recognized but remains substantially underdiagnosed because its clinical and imaging phenotype overlaps with more common cardiomyopathies. Definitive subtype assignment and management further require integration of multimodal evidence to distinguish transthyretin from light-chain disease. Machine learning and deep learning have been applied across the diagnostic and management pathway. These applications span electrocardiography (ECG), echocardiography, and health record-based case finding, as well as cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) and nuclear interpretation, including single-photon emission computed tomography/computed tomography (SPECT/CT) biomarker quantification, prognostic modeling, and treatment response assessment. This narrative review synthesizes these studies by clinical tasks, namely screening, detection, quantification, prognosis, and longitudinal assessment after treatment initiation, rather than by input modality. This task-based organization clarifies why apparently similar AI models require different cohorts, reference standards, evaluation metrics, and implementation thresholds. The evidence reveals a maturity gradient. Binary detection and AI-assisted interpretation of cardiac scintigraphy with bone-avid tracers and SPECT/CT currently represent one of the more mature AI applications in cardiac amyloidosis, supporting standardized image interpretation and quantitative biomarker extraction. However, patient-level diagnosis still requires integration with monoclonal protein testing, SPECT/CT localization, clinical context, and biopsy or tissue typing when indicated.
papers.comment: Diana Shadibaeva and Rochak Dhakal contributed equally to this work. Total Pages = 35, No. of Figures = 4, No. of Tables on Manuscript = 1, Supplementary Tables = 6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇按临床任务（筛查、检出、定量、预后、治疗后纵向评估）而非按输入模态组织的心脏淀粉样变 AI 叙述性综述，覆盖 ECG、超声、电子病历、CMR 与 SPECT/CT。核心论断是 AI 成熟度呈梯度：骨亲和示踪剂心脏闪烁显像与 SPECT/CT 的二分类检出和 AI 辅助判读最成熟，可支持标准化影像解读与定量生物标志物提取，但患者层面分型仍须结合单克隆蛋白检测、SPECT/CT 定位、临床背景与必要时活检。
Motivation: 心脏淀粉样变 (CA) 因表型与其他更常见心肌病重叠而长期诊断不足，且需整合多模态证据区分转甲状腺素型与轻链型；按输入模态归类的既有综述无法说明为何相似 AI 模型需要不同队列、参考标准与评估阈值。
Method: 叙述性综述，按临床任务（screening、detection、quantification、prognosis、治疗后纵向评估）归拢 ML/DL 研究，而非按模态；对每类任务对比所需队列、参考标准、评估指标与实施阈值。
Result: 综述给出的定性结论是成熟度梯度：二分类检出与骨亲和示踪剂心脏闪烁显像、SPECT/CT 的 AI 辅助判读属于 CA 领域较成熟的应用，支撑标准化影像解读与定量生物标志物提取；患者层面诊断仍需与单克隆蛋白检测、SPECT/CT 定位、活检或组织分型整合。
Conclusion: AI 在 CA 中的价值取决于任务：影像侧定量与检出已可进入临床辅助，而亚型确诊与管理决策必须走多模态整合路径，不能由单一模型给出。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Causally Debiased Latent Action Model for Embodied Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) aim to simulate future observations conditioned on embodied actions. However, learning controllable ACWMs requires large-scale action-labeled data, which remains costly to collect. Latent action models (LAMs) mitigate this bottleneck by inferring latent actions from videos without executable action labels, but existing LAMs are typically trained with reconstruction-only objectives and therefore entangle action-relevant dynamics with action-irrelevant visual confounders. With such objectives, LAM favors visual context over action dynamics, therefore downstream ACWMs exhibit residual motion under zero actions and fail to reproduce supplied dynamics. We propose CD-LAM, a causally debiased framework for LAM-based ACWMs. CD-LAM introduces three debiasing objectives: embodiment-centric reconstruction, action-centric contrastive learning, and latent space calibration, which together encourage embodiment-focused, action-aware, and well-calibrated representations. CD-LAM reduces action-following error by up to 42% and 35% when conditioned on latent and robot actions, while improving fidelity, and matching DreamDojo reference with over 12$\times$ fewer adaptation updates. CD-LAM also adapts LTX-2.3-22B into an ACWM with competitive quality using only 3.2% of DreamDojo-14B's sample exposures. On X-VLA, pretraining with CD-LAM instead of baseline LAM consistently improves success rates by up to 5 percent point across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin C2R.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CD-LAM 用三个去偏目标（以具身为中心的重建、以动作为中心的对比学习、latent space 校准）训练 latent action model，把动作动力学从视觉混淆因子中解耦，从而消除零动作下的残余运动并复现所给动作。动作跟随误差在 latent 动作与机器人动作条件下分别最多降低 42% 与 35%，且在 LIBERO 等三个基准上把 X-VLA 预训练成功率最多提升 5 个百分点。
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型 (ACWM) 需要大规模带动作标签数据，而 latent action model (LAM) 只能从无动作标签视频推断 latent 动作；纯重建目标让 LAM 偏向视觉上下文而非动作动力学，导致下游 ACWM 在零动作下仍有残余运动、无法复现所给动力学。
Method: 提出 CD-LAM 框架，包含三个去偏目标：embodiment-centric reconstruction、action-centric contrastive learning、latent space calibration，联合约束表征以具身为中心、以动作为中心且校准良好；并用它适配 LTX-2.3-22B 为 ACWM，以及替换 X-VLA 预训练中的基线 LAM。
Result: 动作跟随误差在 latent 动作条件下最多降低 42%、机器人动作条件下最多降低 35%，同时保真度提升；匹配 DreamDojo 参考所需适配更新步数减少 12 倍以上；将 LTX-2.3-22B 适配为 ACWM 只用 DreamDojo-14B 样本曝光量的 3.2% 即达到有竞争力的质量；在 X-VLA 上以 CD-LAM 预训练替代基线 LAM，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin C2R 上成功率一致提升最多 5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把动作相关动力学与视觉混淆因子因果解耦，可让 LAM 学到的 latent 动作真正驱动下游 ACWM，从而在极少数据与更新步数下获得可用的动作条件世界模型与具身预训练收益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One Image, No Tokens: A Controlled Study of Glyph-Based Chinese Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models generally represent text as sequences of discrete token embeddings, an assumption deeply rooted in current practice but rarely questioned. We challenge this representation, especially for Chinese, by replacing index-based token embeddings entirely with a single rasterized image of the character sequence, processed by a vision encoder composed of a shared ResNet and a shallow Vision Transformer. To isolate the role of input representation, we construct a dual-branch controlled framework in which both a Vision-based model and an index-based baseline share an identical decoder backbone, training objective, optimizer, and data curriculum. Any performance difference is therefore attributable to the input modality only. Across all tested decoder backbones, the Vision-based model consistently outperforms the baseline, reaching a peak accuracy of 0.429 versus 0.355 for the index-based baseline---a 21\% relative improvement---while converging in about half the number of training epochs. The advantage emerges especially within the first five epochs (under 21\% of total data) and persists under moderate character corruption: the corrupted Vision model matches the \emph{clean} index-based baseline. Ablation studies reveal that the advantage requires both spatially coherent input and a ViT encoder with 2D positional encodings. A cross-script comparison on English shows the advantage does not transfer directly to alphabetic writing systems, suggesting that the uniform visual density and radical structure of Chinese characters are enabling conditions. These findings suggest that transformers are more modality-agnostic than commonly assumed, and that discrete tokenization is not a fundamental requirement for Chinese language modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把中文文本完全替换为单张栅格化字符图像，用共享 ResNet 加浅层 Vision Transformer 编码，与索引式 token 基线共用同一 decoder、目标函数和数据课程做受控对比。峰值准确率 0.429 对 0.355（相对提升 21%），训练收敛约减半，且在中等字符损坏下受损视觉模型仍追平干净的 token 基线；优势依赖空间连贯输入与带 2D 位置编码的 ViT，且不迁移到英文。
Motivation: 离散 token 嵌入是语言模型的默认输入表示，但对中文这一视觉结构规整的文字系统，该假设很少被检验；需要隔离输入模态本身的影响。
Method: 构建双分支受控框架：Vision 分支把字符序列栅格化为单张图像，经共享 ResNet 与浅层 Vision Transformer 编码；index-based 基线用离散 token 嵌入。两者共享完全相同的 decoder backbone、训练目标、优化器与数据课程，使性能差异只归因于输入模态；另做消融与英中跨文字系统对比。
Result: 所有被测 decoder backbone 上 Vision 模型均超过基线，峰值准确率 0.429 对 0.355，相对提升 21%；收敛所需训练 epoch 约为基线的一半。优势在前 5 个 epoch（不到 21% 数据）内出现并保持；中等字符损坏下受损 Vision 模型追平干净的 index-based 基线。消融显示优势同时需要空间连贯输入与带 2D 位置编码的 ViT；英文上优势不直接迁移。
Conclusion: Transformer 对输入模态比通常认为的更不敏感，离散 tokenization 并非中文语言建模的根本要求；其成立条件是汉字的均匀视觉密度与部件结构，而非通用。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 把中文文本完全替换为单张栅格化字符图像，用共享 ResNet 加浅层 Vision Transformer 编码，与索引式 token 基线共用同一 decoder、目标函数和数据课程做受控对比。峰值准确率 0.429 对 0.355（相对提升 21%），训练收敛约减半，且在中等字符损坏下受损视觉模型仍追平干净的 token 基线；优势依赖空间连贯输入与带 2D 位置编码的 ViT，且不迁移到英文。
summary_sections.motivation: 离散 token 嵌入是语言模型的默认输入表示，但对中文这一视觉结构规整的文字系统，该假设很少被检验；需要隔离输入模态本身的影响。

papers.title: $C^3$ASD: Multi-Level Consistency-Driven Representation Learning for Robust Active Speaker Detection
papers.abstract_en: Active Speaker Detection determines whether a visible person in a video is speaking at each moment. While recent audio-visual fusion methods perform well on clean data, they degrade under real-world corruptions such as background noise, occlusion, or simultaneous modality degradation. We attribute this limitation to the absence of explicit consistency constraints that promote robust, semantically aligned representations across modalities. Without such guidance, models tend to learn fragile modality-specific shortcuts that fail under corrupted conditions. We propose $C^3$ASD, a multi-level consistency-driven framework with three complementary constraints: embedding-level inter-modality consistency aligns audio-visual representations during speech; sequence-level intra-modality consistency separates speaking and non-speaking clusters via track-aware contrastive learning; and prediction-level consistency stabilizes fusion through knowledge distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements under diverse audio, visual and joint corruptions, while maintaining competitive performance on clean data.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Vision - ECCV 2026, LNCS 17056, pp. 171-195, Springer (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C³ASD 用三层一致性约束约束音视频主动说话人检测 (Active Speaker Detection)：嵌入级跨模态一致性对齐说话时的音视频表征，序列级模态内一致性用 track-aware 对比学习分开说话/非说话簇，预测级一致性用知识蒸馏稳定融合。在音频、视觉及联合损坏条件下均带来显著提升，同时干净数据上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有音视频融合方法在干净数据上表现好，但遇到背景噪声、遮挡或双模态同时退化等真实损坏就退化，根源是缺少显式一致性约束，模型学到脆弱的模态特定捷径。
Method: 提出多层一致性框架 C³ASD，含三个互补约束：嵌入级 inter-modality consistency 在说话时对齐音视频表征；序列级 intra-modality consistency 通过 track-aware contrastive learning 分离说话与非说话簇；预测级 consistency 用知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation) 稳定融合。
Result: 在多样音频、视觉与联合损坏条件下均有显著提升，同时在干净数据上保持竞争力表现。
Conclusion: 显式的一致性约束能抑制模态特定捷径，使主动说话人检测在损坏条件下更鲁棒而不牺牲干净数据性能。

papers.title: Simulating Eutopia: Revisiting Long-term Fairness with Outcomes, Performativity, and Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: As AI-driven Decision Makers (ADMs) influence our socioeconomic reality, their roles in both enhancing efficiency and amplifying the social biases have drawn significant attention. In this paper, we revisit the nuances of long-term fairness achievable by an ADM-- specifically, through the lens of a loan approver inducing a population-level wealth dynamics. The literature generally (a) considers passive environments, i.e. the decisions of an ADM does not change the population's behaviour, and (b) measures bias in terms of disparity in the instantaneous decisions rather than downstream equity. Modern ADMs challenge both the notions. To address these caveats, we first formalise the wealth dynamics induced by a loan approving ADM interacting with a multi-demographic population as a Performative Markov Decision Process. Then, we mitigate the absence of such a performative test-bed by developing Eutopia: a lending-process simulator enabled with a novel performative data generator to learn long-term fair strategies. With Eutopia, we test reinforcement learning algorithms with different fairness-aware utilities dependent on approval decisions and downstream wealth. Results show that performative dynamics-aware learning with fairness-aware utility that incorporates the downstream outcomes induce better long-term equity and inclusivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把贷款审批 AI 对人口财富的长期影响形式化为 Performative MDP，并发布 Eutopia 借贷过程模拟器与 performative 数据生成器。结果显示：把下游财富结果纳入公平效用、并让强化学习感知 performative 动态，能带来更好的长期公平与包容性。
Motivation: 既有长期公平研究把环境当作被动的（决策不改变人群行为），且只用即时决策差异衡量偏差，忽略了下游均衡公平；现代 ADM 恰恰同时打破这两点。
Method: 将贷款审批 ADM 与多人口群体的财富动态形式化为 Performative MDP；构建 Eutopia 借贷过程模拟器与新型 performative 数据生成器；在其中测试带不同公平感知效用（依赖审批决策与下游财富）的强化学习算法。
Result: 结果表明：感知 performative 动态的学习配合纳入下游结果的公平感知效用，能诱导更好的长期公平与包容性（inclusivity）。
Conclusion: 长期公平评估必须同时建模决策对人群行为的反身影响与下游财富结果，仅看即时决策差异会低估真实公平。

papers.title: OPINE-World: Programmatic World Modeling with Ontology-error-Prioritized Interactive Exploration for ARC-AGI-3
papers.abstract_en: Learning a useful world model from minimal interaction is central to building agents that adapt to unfamiliar tasks. Programmatic world modeling approaches such as WorldCoder quickly learn transition models when given pre-supplied symbolic representations; however, such approaches are insufficient when the symbolic representation and goal are unknown and continually changing, and are intractable under large action spaces due to rigid planning heuristics. Extending the programmatic world modeling approach, OPINE-World additionally maintains an abstracted representation in which provisional objects, incomplete causal explanations, and unresolved interactions can exist in a Bayesian, exploration-centric hypothesis space. This enables learning an unknown, dynamically evolving state, transition, and goal. Exploration and program revision share this evolving abstraction, allowing new evidence to revise both the hypothesized mechanics and their implementation in tandem at test time. ARC-AGI-3 presents this open-world problem as a general-intelligence learning benchmark. Through our OPINE-world model learning paradigm, we improve the Relative Human Action Efficiency score of Claude Opus 4.8 high from 1.5% to 78.40% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPINE-World 在符号表示与目标未知且持续变化的开放世界里，用一个允许临时对象、不完整因果解释和未解交互共存的贝叶斯抽象假设空间，让探索与程序修订共享同一表示，从而在测试时同步修正机制假设及其程序实现。在 ARC-AGI-3 上把 Claude Opus 4.8 high 的 Relative Human Action Efficiency 从 1.5% 提到 78.40%。
Motivation: WorldCoder 一类程序化世界模型依赖预先给定的符号表示，一旦表示与目标未知且不断变化就失效，且刚性规划启发式在大动作空间下不可解。
Method: 在程序化世界模型之上维护一个贝叶斯、探索中心的抽象假设空间，容纳临时对象、不完整因果解释与未解交互，以学习未知且动态演化的状态、转移与目标；探索与程序修订共享该抽象，测试时新证据同时修正机制假设及其程序实现。
Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上，Claude Opus 4.8 high 的 Relative Human Action Efficiency 从 1.5% 提升至 78.40%。
Conclusion: 把抽象假设空间与程序实现绑定修订，可以在符号表示和目标都未知的开放世界中学习状态、转移与目标，并大幅提高动作效率。

papers.title: Design and Implementation of Agentic Orchestrations and Orchestration of Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Business Process Management has gained momentum recently. The prospect is that the autonomy of AI agents, i.e., predominantly LLM-based agents, can be balanced with a certain level of robustness, tractability, and traceability through a combination with process technology. In this paper, we provide a classification framework for agentic orchestration options along properties such as task specificity, traceability and tractability, autonomy and reactivity, and correctness assurance and present qualitative decision criteria for realizations of different scenarios. We also provide metrics for the quantitative assessment of realization properties and show them through different agentic implementations of a predictive light sensing scenario. Altogether, this work aims at providing properties, criteria, and metrics for the design and implementation of agentic orchestrations and orchestration of agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 Agentic BPM 提出一套智能体编排分类框架，按任务特异性、可追溯性与可处理性、自主性与反应性、正确性保证等属性划分编排选项，并给出定性决策准则与量化评估指标。在预测性光传感场景的多种智能体实现上演示这些指标，说明不同编排方案在鲁棒性、可追溯性与自主性上的取舍可被度量。
Motivation: LLM 智能体自主性强但缺乏鲁棒性、可处理性与可追溯性，业务流程管理需要一套属性、准则与指标来在具体场景中选择编排方式。
Method: 构建沿任务特异性、traceability 与 tractability、autonomy 与 reactivity、correctness assurance 等属性的编排分类框架；给出面向不同场景实现的定性决策准则，并提出量化评估实现属性的 metrics，用预测性光传感 (predictive light sensing) 场景的多种智能体实现来演示。
Result: 产出分类框架、定性决策准则与量化指标，并在预测性光传感场景的多个智能体实现上演示指标用法；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 智能体编排的设计与实现可以用属性、准则和指标三件套来系统刻画，使自主性与鲁棒性、可追溯性之间的权衡可评估。
