papers.title: WarpHammer: Densifying Scene Warps with 3D Object Priors for Extreme View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Projection-conditioned novel view synthesis (NVS) warps an explicit 3D reconstruction of the input view into the target camera and conditions a generator on the warped rendering. This works well for small viewpoint changes but degrades sharply under large orbital motion: the warp becomes sparse around the orbited object, where hidden surfaces dominate the new view and mirror-like artifacts emerge, causing the generator to lose both pixel content and the implicit camera cue carried by the warp. We introduce WarpHammer, a training-free framework that resolves this failure mode by augmenting the warped scene with an explicit 3D reconstruction of the object obtained from a native 3D generative prior (e.g., SAM3D). The reconstructed object adds missing foreground surfaces and occludes background points that should no longer be visible, restoring both appearance and camera cues without fine-tuning the base model. The same explicit object representation further unlocks a capability current NVS pipelines do not support: incorporating auxiliary views of the object from sources outside the target scene, for example, a casual snapshot of a car paired with a manufacturer studio shot of the same model. We process the reference and auxiliary images jointly with a pretrained multi-view geometry foundation model, which predicts a unified point cloud that we fuse into the 3D object reconstruction. This yields substantially more faithful geometry than single-image reconstruction, without requiring user-provided camera poses for the auxiliary views. On five benchmarks, WarpHammer produces stable novel views at viewpoint deviations where strong baselines collapse, and is the first scene-level NVS method that can naturally fuse auxiliary, pose-unknown object views from an external source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WarpHammer 是一个免训练的投影条件新视角合成 (NVS) 框架：用 3D 生成先验（如 SAM3D）重建被环绕物体，补上缺失前景、遮挡本不该可见的背景点，从而在大视角偏转下同时恢复外观与 warp 携带的相机线索。它还可用多视角几何基础模型把外部辅助视图（相机位姿未知）融合进统一点云，在五个基准上于强基线崩溃的视角偏差处产出稳定新视角。
Motivation: 投影条件 NVS 在小视角变化下有效，但在大轨道运动下 warp 在被环绕物体周围变稀疏，隐藏表面主导新视图并产生镜面伪影，生成器同时丢失像素内容与 warp 携带的隐式相机线索。
Method: 免训练框架：以原生 3D 生成先验（如 SAM3D）对物体做显式 3D 重建并叠加到 warp 场景上；参考图与外部辅助图联合送入预训练多视角几何基础模型，预测统一点云并融合进物体重建，无需为辅助视图提供相机位姿，也不微调基座模型。
Result: 在五个基准上，WarpHammer 在强基线崩溃的视角偏差处仍产出稳定新视角；物体几何比单图重建更忠实；是首个能自然融合外部来源、位姿未知的辅助物体视图的场景级 NVS 方法。
Conclusion: 把显式物体级 3D 重建作为 warp 的补丁即可在大轨道运动下修复投影条件 NVS 的失效模式，并顺带解锁外部辅助视图融合这一现有管线不支持的能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 把显式物体级 3D 重建作为 warp 的补丁即可在大轨道运动下修复投影条件 NVS 的失效模式，并顺带解锁外部辅助视图融合这一现有管线不支持的能力。

papers.title: Mechanistic Personality Analysis of LLMs: Steering Personality via Latent Feature Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to simulate human-like OCEAN personality traits in generated text. Previous efforts have focused on prompt engineering or fine-tuning to shape LLM personality. In this work, we propose a mechanistic interpretability approach that directly intervenes on the model's latent features. Our method identifies latent directions in the residual stream corresponding to a target OCEAN trait using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and contrastive activation analysis. We formalize an additive steering vector in activation space and demonstrate how applying a small additive shift to the hidden states enhances the target trait while preserving overall language modeling performance. To determine the optimal combination of feature shifts, we explore a linear weighting heuristic with grid search optimization that balances personality expression with task performance. Our approach shows promise in controllably steering personality traits at the mechanistic level while maintaining high performance on standard benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 与对比激活分析在残差流中定位对应 OCEAN 人格特质的潜在方向，构造激活空间的加性 steering vector，对隐状态做小幅偏移即可增强目标特质且保持语言建模能力；再用线性加权启发式加网格搜索权衡人格表达与任务性能。
Motivation: 既有塑造 LLM 人格的方法依赖 prompt engineering 或微调，缺少在模型内部机制层面直接、可控的干预手段。
Method: 先用 SAE 与对比激活分析找出残差流中对应目标 OCEAN 特质的潜在方向，形式化为激活空间的加性 steering vector，对隐状态施加小幅加性偏移；再以线性权重启发式配合网格搜索优化，平衡人格表达与任务表现。
Result: 小幅加性偏移在增强目标 OCEAN 特质的同时保持整体语言建模性能；网格搜索得到的特征偏移组合在标准基准上维持高性能。
Conclusion: 在机制层面直接干预潜在特征即可可控地 steering 人格特质，无需 prompt 工程或微调，且不必牺牲基准性能。

papers.title: The Weakest Link Tells It All: Outcome-Supervised Process Reward Modeling via Learnable Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Process reward models (PRMs) enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by providing fine-grained feedback, yet training PRMs typically requires expensive stepwise annotations. Outcome-supervised PRMs offer a scalable alternative by learning from final-answer correctness alone, but this introduces a fundamental credit assignment challenge, i.e., attributing outcomes to responsible reasoning steps. Existing approaches rely on either uniform or causal assignment, both of which fail to anchor credit in step correctness and thus hinder process error identification. In this work, we propose Outcome-Supervised Process Reward Modeling via Learnable Credit Assignment (LCA), an outcome-supervised PRM framework that jointly learns credit assignment and reward modeling under the principle of Weakest Link Assignment: a reasoning chain is as strong as its weakest link. To address mutual dependence between credit assignment and reward modeling, we formalize outcome-supervised PRM as a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) problem and introduce Softmax-Weighted-Sum (SWS) pooling, an MIL pooling technique tailored for strong dependence and redundancy among reasoning states. We establish instance-level Bayes consistency of the resulting learning objective under mild assumptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LCA outperforms state-of-the-art outcome-supervised PRMs across multiple tasks and backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/JiaTianyu20031016/MIL.git.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Oral). Camera-ready version. Code: https://github.com/JiaTianyu20031016/MIL.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出结果监督的过程奖励模型框架 LCA：把 PRM 训练形式化为 Multiple Instance Learning (MIL)，用 Softmax-Weighted-Sum (SWS) 池化联合学习 credit assignment 与奖励建模，遵循 Weakest Link Assignment 原则（推理链强度取决于最弱一步）。在多个任务与骨干模型上超过现有结果监督 PRM。
Motivation: 结果监督 PRM 只用最终答案对错训练，省去逐步标注，但 credit assignment 无法把结果归因到具体出错步骤；现有均匀分配或因果分配都不以步骤正确性锚定信用，妨碍过程级错误识别。
Method: 将结果监督 PRM 形式化为 MIL 问题，提出针对推理状态间强依赖与冗余的 Softmax-Weighted-Sum (MIL pooling) 池化，联合学习 credit assignment 与 reward modeling；在温和假设下证明该学习目标的 instance-level Bayes 一致性。
Result: 在多个任务与多种骨干模型上，LCA 优于现有最先进结果监督 PRM；并给出学习目标的 instance-level Bayes 一致性证明。
Conclusion: 把 credit assignment 与 reward modeling 一起学、并按最弱一步分配信用，是结果监督 PRM 定位过程错误的有效路径，且目标在温和假设下保持 Bayes 一致。

papers.title: Full-Body Golf Swing Kinematic Reconstruction From a Smartwatch IMU
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative measurement of the golf swing is critical for evaluating technique and enabling individualized feedback. However, existing methods are impractical to use on the golf course: optical motion capture is laboratory-bound, camera-based methods require impractical camera placement, and multi-sensor inertial measurement unit (IMU) systems require multi-segment setup and calibration. We thus propose a single wrist-worn IMU approach for estimating full-body joint angles during golf swings. The proposed Wrist-IMU Temporal Kinematic Network (WIT-KinNet) combines IMU embedding, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), and temporal convolutional encoding. Thirty-six golfers, comprising beginner and skilled players, performed full, half, and quarter swings using seven club types: driver, 3-wood, 5-hybrid, 5-iron, 7-iron, 9-iron, and sand wedge. The proposed WIT-KinNet was evaluated under subject-wise cross-validation using synchronized smartwatch IMU data and ground-truth kinematics derived from an optical motion capture (OMC) system, with OMC-free IMU calibration and IMU-based swing segmentation. The proposed approach achieved a mean absolute error of $8.53\pm2.05^\circ$ across full-body joint angles. High temporal correlation was observed for pelvic rotation and upper torso rotation ($r=0.99$ for both), with X-factor and S-factor also showing strong correlations ($r=0.97$ for both). Linear mixed-effects models of the error revealed that swing amplitude significantly affected estimation error across all five trunk--pelvis variables ($p<0.05$). The results demonstrate the feasibility of full-body golf swing kinematic estimation from a commercial smartwatch, providing a potential solution for post-swing biomechanical analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WIT-KinNet 用单只腕戴智能手表 IMU 直接估计高尔夫挥杆的全身关节角度，靠 IMU embedding、FiLM 与时间卷积编码替代实验室光学动作捕捉。在 36 名球手、7 种球杆的 subject-wise 交叉验证下全身关节角 MAE 为 8.53±2.05°，骨盆与上躯干旋转 r=0.99，但挥杆幅度对五个躯干-骨盆变量的误差均有显著影响 (p<0.05)。
Motivation: 光学动作捕捉只能在实验室用，相机方案机位不现实，多 IMU 系统需多节段布置与标定，球场上的挥杆定量测量因此无法落地。
Method: WIT-KinNet 融合 IMU embedding、feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) 与时序卷积编码，从单腕 IMU 估计全身关节角；采用无 OMC 的 IMU 标定与基于 IMU 的挥杆分割，以同步智能手表 IMU 为输入、光学动作捕捉 (OMC) 派生运动学为真值，做 subject-wise 交叉验证。
Result: 36 名球手（初学者与熟练者）完成 full、half、quarter 挥杆，覆盖 driver、3-wood、5-hybrid、5-iron、7-iron、9-iron、sand wedge 七种球杆；全身关节角 MAE 8.53±2.05°，骨盆旋转与上躯干旋转 r=0.99，X-factor 与 S-factor r=0.97；线性混合效应模型显示挥杆幅度对全部五个躯干-骨盆变量的估计误差均有显著影响 (p<0.05)。
Conclusion: 单只商用智能手表 IMU 足以重建全身挥杆运动学，可用于挥杆后的生物力学分析，但误差随挥杆幅度显著变化。

papers.title: OmniSpace: Efficient Geometry Awareness for Autonomous Vehicles MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on 2D visual tasks, yet enhancing their spatial intelligence for real-world applications such as Autonomous Vehicles (AV) remains an open challenge. Existing geometry-aware MLLMs typically rely on auxiliary 3D models at inference time, introducing pipeline complexity and the risk of cascading failures. In this paper, we present OmniSpace, a simple yet effective plug-and-play paradigm for geometry-aware spatial reasoning from purely 2D observations. Motivated by our finding that current MLLMs are bottlenecked by weak cross-view correspondence and depth estimation, OmniSpace introduces a Camera Pose Injector, a Multi-view Epipolar Attention module, and a 3D Geometric Distillation objective that jointly address these two limitations by transferring geometric knowledge into the model. Extensive experiments show that OmniSpace surpasses existing methods on planning benchmarks (nuScenes, Bench2Drive), risk detection (nuInstruct), language (Omnidrive), and generalization (DriveBench).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniSpace 是面向自动驾驶 MLLM 的即插即用几何感知范式，仅用纯 2D 观测做空间推理，无需推理期外挂 3D 模型。它用 Camera Pose Injector、Multi-view Epipolar Attention 与 3D Geometric Distillation 联合缓解跨视图对应与深度估计两大瓶颈，在 nuScenes、Bench2Drive、nuInstruct、Omnidrive、DriveBench 上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有几何感知 MLLM 依赖推理期的辅助 3D 模型，带来流水线复杂度与级联失败风险；而当前 MLLM 的瓶颈在于跨视图对应与深度估计能力弱。
Method: 三个组件联合注入几何知识：Camera Pose Injecting 注入相机位姿，Multi-view Epipolar Attention 模块建模跨视图极线约束，3D Geometric Distillation 目标把几何知识蒸馏进模型，全程只用纯 2D 观测且为即插即用。
Result: 在规划基准 nuScenes 与 Bench2Drive、风险检测 nuInstruct、语言 Omnidrive、泛化 DriveBench 上均超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 把几何知识直接蒸馏进 MLLM，可以在不依赖辅助 3D 模型的前提下提升自动驾驶空间推理并保持流水线简洁。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Finite-Sample Performance of Gradient Descent in Logistic Regression with Gaussian Design
papers.abstract_en: We consider the parameter estimation problem in logistic regression with Gaussian design: the estimation of a fixed unknown parameter $θ^*\in \mathbb{R}^d$ ($\|θ^*\|_2\ge 1$) from $n$ i.i.d. samples $\{(x_i,y_i)\}_{i=1}^n$, where $x_i\sim N(0,I_d)$ and $y_i|x_i \sim {\rm Bernoulli}(1/(1+\exp(-x_i^\top θ^*)))$. Our main aim is to characterize the finite-sample estimation performance and convergence behavior of gradient descent (GD) on the maximum likelihood objective (i.e., the logistic loss). Under small $O(1)$ stepsize and $0$ initialization, we show that GD linearly converges to a small neighborhood of $θ^*$ achieving an $\ell_2$ error of order $O(\sqrt{\|θ^*\|_2^5d/n})$. This substantially goes beyond existing theoretical results that lack non-asymptotic estimation error rate and exhibit much slower parameter convergence. We also establish a faster local linear convergence to the same statistical error under a large $Θ(\|θ^*\|_2)$ stepsize. The main technical component is to show that the gradient of the logistic loss satisfies a certain approximate invertibility condition (AIC). To that end, we uniformly control the deviation of the gradient from its population counterpart by covering and peeling arguments, and then show that the population GD is a contraction by a delicate analysis based on the eigenvalues of population Hessian matrices. Finally, we build upon the recent work Matsumoto and Mazumdar (2025) and devise a novel efficient estimator that attains a sharper rate in high dimensions. This indicates that the existing non-asymptotic guarantees exhibit sub-optimal dependence on $\|θ^*\|_2$, and that in many regimes $Θ(\sqrt{\|θ^*\|_2d/n})$ is the tight estimation error rate. Numerical examples are provided to corroborate our theoretical results.
papers.comment: v1 has just been accepted to NeurIPS 2026. In v2, we make a few small corrections and add some relevant references, especially our follow-up work https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17260
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯设计的 logistic 回归中证明梯度下降 (GD) 的有限样本估计误差：小步长 O(1)、零初始化下 GD 线性收敛到 θ* 的小邻域，ℓ2 误差为 O(√(‖θ*‖₂⁵ d/n))；大步长 Θ(‖θ*‖₂) 下则有更快的局部线性收敛到同一统计误差。作者另给出高维下更锐的估计器，指出 Θ(√(‖θ*‖₂ d/n)) 才是许多区域中的紧误差率，即既有非渐近保证对 ‖θ*‖₂ 的依赖是次优的。
Motivation: 既有 logistic 回归 GD 的理论结果缺少非渐近估计误差率，且参数收敛速度远慢于实际，无法刻画有限样本下 GD 到达统计精度邻域的行为。
Method: 在 logistic loss 的最大似然目标上分析 GD，核心技术是证明梯度满足近似可逆条件 (approximate invertibility condition, AIC)：用覆盖与剥离 (covering and peeling) 论证一致控制梯度与总体梯度的偏差，再基于总体 Hessian 矩阵特征值证明总体 GD 是压缩映射；并基于 Matsumoto and Mazumdar (2025) 构造高维下更高效的估计器。
Result: 小步长 O(1)、零初始化下 GD 线性收敛，ℓ2 误差阶为 O(√(‖θ*‖₂⁵ d/n))；大步长 Θ(‖θ*‖₂) 下建立到同一统计误差的更快局部线性收敛。新估计器在高维下达到更锐的速率，表明 Θ(√(‖θ*‖₂ d/n)) 在许多区域是紧的估计误差率。摘要另称给出数值例子佐证理论结果。
Conclusion: GD 在高斯设计 logistic 回归中能在有限样本下线性收敛到统计误差邻域，而既有非渐近保证对 ‖θ*‖₂ 的依赖次优；高维紧速率应为 Θ(√(‖θ*‖₂ d/n))。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 小步长 O(1)、零初始化下 GD 线性收敛，ℓ2 误差阶为 O(√(‖θ*‖₂⁵ d/n))；大步长 Θ(‖θ*‖₂) 下建立到同一统计误差的更快局部线性收敛。新估计器在高维下达到更锐的速率，表明 Θ(√(‖θ*‖₂ d/n)) 在许多区域是紧的估计误差率。摘要另称给出数值例子佐证理论结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: GD 在高斯设计 logistic 回归中能在有限样本下线性收敛到统计误差邻域，而既有非渐近保证对 ‖θ*‖₂ 的依赖次优；高维紧速率应为 Θ(√(‖θ*‖₂ d/n))。

papers.title: When Can We Trust the Sparse Lens? A Certification Framework for SAE Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used to study internal representations in language models (LMs), but it remains unclear when an SAE-based representation reliably preserves the underlying model's predictive behavior. We introduce a post-hoc certification framework for this purpose. At a chosen layer, we replace the model's hidden activation with its pretrained SAE reconstruction and derive a bound on the expected loss of the original frozen LM through this SAE-based proxy. The resulting certificate depends on three quantities measured on held-out data: the proxy risk, the reconstruction loss gap, and support mismatch between the calibration feature pool and new inputs. We further derive a more conservative exact-$P$ extension whose proxy-risk concentration term is uniform over all feature pools of the same size. Empirically, the certificates become non-vacuous for GPT-2 Small, Gemma-2B, and Llama-3-8B. A detailed layerwise study of Llama-3-8B shows that later layers are easier to certify, driven mainly by improved reconstruction fidelity and weaker downstream amplification of reconstruction error. GPT-2 Small shows much weaker layer dependence, indicating that this pattern is not universal across model-SAE pairs. Overall, the framework provides a practical way to determine whether an SAE representation preserves enough of a frozen LM's predictive behavior to support certification of the original model. Code is available at: https://github.com/newcodevelop/sparse-lens-certification.
papers.comment: Accepted at Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL). Pre-MIT Press publication version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事后认证框架：在选定层用预训练 SAE 重建替换隐藏激活，为原冻结 LM 经该代理的期望损失推导上界，证书由代理风险、重建损失差、校准特征池与新输入的 support mismatch 三个量决定，另有对同规模特征池一致的 exact-P 保守扩展。证书在 GPT-2 Small、Gemma-2B、Llama-3-8B 上变为非空洞；Llama-3-8B 后层更易认证，主因是重建保真度更高且下游对重建误差的放大更弱，而 GPT-2 Small 层间依赖明显更弱。
Motivation: SAE 被广泛用于解释 LM 内部表示，但何时 SAE 表示能可靠保留原模型的预测行为并不清楚，缺少可判定的保证。
Method: 在选定层把隐藏激活替换为预训练 SAE 重建，推导原冻结 LM 经该代理的期望损失上界；证书用 held-out 数据上的代理风险、重建损失差、校准特征池与新输入的 support mismatch 三个量计算，并给出对同规模特征池一致的 exact-P 保守扩展。
Result: 证书在 GPT-2 Small、Gemma-2B、Llama-3-8B 上变为非空洞 (non-vacuous)。Llama-3-8B 的逐层研究显示后层更易认证，主要由更高的重建保真度与更弱的重建误差下游放大驱动；GPT-2 Small 层间依赖明显更弱，说明该模式并非跨模型-SAE 对普遍成立。
Conclusion: SAE 表示能否支撑对原模型的认证是可按层判定的，且该模式依赖具体模型-SAE 对，Llama-3-8B 后层更可信而 GPT-2 Small 不呈现同样梯度。

papers.title: DRIFT: Data Selection for LLM Instruction Tuning via On-Policy Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Data selection for instruction tuning is usually studied for efficiency, reaching strong performance with a fraction of the training data. We ask whether data selection can instead raise the performance ceiling, producing a better model than training on all the available data. To test this, we take a large language model (LLM) that has already completed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its full corpus and train it further on examples selected from that same corpus. Any gain therefore lifts the model above the ceiling set by full-data training. Existing selection methods yield little or no gain in this setting. We propose DRIFT (Data Refinement via On-Policy Influence Functions for Supervised Fine-Tuning), a data attribution method built on influence functions. DRIFT samples the model's own responses to validation queries and weights them by correctness to form a validation objective. It ranks the examples of the original corpus by their estimated influence on this objective, and the model then continues SFT on the top-ranked subset. This design is motivated by the proximity gap in influence function theory: we hypothesize that these on-policy responses are better validation targets than external references in terms of locality. DRIFT also corrects influence scores for their dependence on gradient norm within each validation task. DRIFT outperforms all evaluated data selection baselines on Olmo3-7B-Instruct-SFT and OpenR1-Distill-7B, raising average accuracy across eight benchmarks from 39.17 to 40.14 and from 57.23 to 58.66, respectively, with gains on benchmarks not used for attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRIFT 用 influence function 做指令微调数据选择，目标不是省数据而是抬高全量训练的性能上限：在已完成 SFT 的模型上继续用其自采样、按正确性加权的 on-policy 验证目标挑选 top 子集训练。在 Olmo3-7B-Instruct-SFT 上八基准平均准确率 39.17→40.14，OpenR1-Distill-7B 上 57.23→58.66，且增益出现在未参与归因的基准上。
Motivation: 数据选择通常只追求用少量数据达到全量性能，很少检验能否超过全量训练的上限；而已有选择方法在“全量 SFT 后继续训练”这一设定下几乎没有增益。
Method: DRIFT（Data Refinement via On-Policy Influence Functions for Supervised Fine-Tuning）基于 influence function：采样模型对验证查询的自身回答并按正确性加权构成验证目标，据此给原语料样本打影响分数排序取 top 子集继续 SFT；动机是 influence function 理论中的 proximity gap，假设 on-policy 回答比外部参考在 locality 上更合适，并在每个验证任务内按梯度范数校正影响分数。
Result: 在 Olmo3-7B-Instruct-SFT 上八基准平均准确率从 39.17 升到 40.14，在 OpenR1-Distill-7B 上从 57.23 升到 58.66，均超过全部被评估的数据选择基线，且在未用于归因的基准上也有增益。
Conclusion: 数据选择可以突破全量数据训练的性能上限，前提是验证目标用模型自身的 on-policy 回答而非外部参考来构造。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Should a Streaming Video Model Remember?
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding models must answer queries at any moment during an ongoing stream, using only what they have observed so far and under fixed memory and computation budgets. Existing methods address this by adding memory banks, retrieval modules, or visual token compression to preserve long-range history. However, strong recent-window baselines show that indiscriminate history injection can dilute current-scene perception, suggesting that the key challenge is not whether to use memory, but how to allocate it selectively. We formulate this as budgeted online latent evidence allocation and propose \textbf{SelectStream}, a selective latent-memory framework that keeps the current observation directly visible to a frozen VLM while exposing historical information only through a compact, query-conditioned evidence budget. Three coordinated mechanisms govern when to write, what to preserve, and how to retrieve: surprise-driven adaptive windowing, priority-preserving consolidation, and query-conditioned graph reasoning over a fixed-capacity latent memory graph. Retrieved evidence is calibrated and injected as latent tokens for answer generation, without replaying frames or growing the context with stream length. Experimental results show that SelectStream achieves strong online streaming performance and preserves general video understanding, reaching 82.67\% on StreamingBench, 67.03\% on OVO-Bench, and 74.4\% average accuracy on offline video benchmarks, while outperforming strong recent-window baselines and prior streaming memory methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelectStream 把流式视频理解重写为预算受限的在线隐证据分配问题：当前帧直接暴露给冻结 VLM，历史只经紧凑的、查询条件化的证据预算进入，由 surprise 驱动的自适应窗口、优先级保持的整合、查询条件化的图推理三机制决定何时写、存什么、怎么取。在 StreamingBench 达 82.67%、OVO-Bench 67.03%、离线视频基准平均 74.4%，超过强 recent-window 基线与既有流式记忆方法。
Motivation: 流式视频模型要在固定记忆与算力预算下随时回答查询，现有做法靠记忆库、检索模块或视觉 token 压缩无差别注入历史，反而稀释当前场景感知；关键不是用不用记忆，而是如何选择性分配。
Method: 提出 SelectStream：当前观测直接对冻结 VLM 可见，历史仅通过固定容量的隐记忆图 (latent memory graph) 按查询条件暴露；三个协同机制为 surprise 驱动的自适应窗口 (surprise-driven adaptive windowing)、优先级保持的整合 (priority-preserving consolidation)、查询条件化图推理 (query-conditioned graph reasoning)，检索证据校准后作为 latent token 注入生成答案，不回放帧、上下文不随流长增长。
Result: StreamingBench 82.67%，OVO-Bench 67.03%，离线视频基准平均准确率 74.4%；在在线流式任务上超过强 recent-window 基线与既往流式记忆方法，同时保持通用视频理解能力。
Conclusion: 记忆的关键在于按查询选择性分配而非无差别注入历史；在固定容量隐记忆图上做预算化证据分配，可在不回放帧、不随流长扩张上下文的前提下兼顾流式性能与通用视频理解。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Wasserstein Convergence of ODE-Based Samplers in Decentralized Diffusion Model via Velocity Field Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved impressive empirical success in generative tasks, and their convergence theory is now relatively well understood. Motivated by privacy and scalability, recent decentralized diffusion architectures replace a single global velocity field with multiple local experts and a routing mechanism, yielding a sampling dynamics with stochastic expert switching that falls outside standard diffusion convergence analyses. In this work, We study a decentralized diffusion framework with stochastic velocity fields and ODE-based sampling. We establish a convergence guarantee in Wasserstein-2 distance, showing that the distribution of the $N$-step discretization converges to the analytical solution at rate $\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/2}+\varepsilon)$ in $W_2$, where $\varepsilon$ captures the neural approximation errors. To our knowledge, this is the first $W_2$ convergence result for decentralized diffusion models with an ODE-based sampling scheme.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对去中心化扩散模型中多个局部专家速度场加随机切换路由、落在标准扩散收敛分析之外的采样动力学，给出 ODE-based 采样的 W2 收敛保证：N 步离散分布以 O(N^{-1/2}+ε) 收敛到解析解，ε 为神经逼近误差，是该类模型首个 W2 收敛结果。
Motivation: 去中心化扩散用多个局部专家替代单一全局速度场以兼顾隐私与可扩展性，但随机专家切换带来的采样动力学超出既有扩散收敛理论的适用范围。
Method: 研究带随机速度场 (stochastic velocity fields) 的去中心化扩散框架与 ODE-based 采样，通过速度场分解 (velocity field decomposition) 分析 N 步离散化，建立 W2 距离下的收敛保证。
Result: N 步离散化分布以速率 O(N^{-1/2}+ε) 在 W2 中收敛到解析解，其中 ε 刻画神经逼近误差；作者称这是去中心化扩散模型在 ODE-based 采样方案下的首个 W2 收敛结果。
Conclusion: 去中心化扩散的随机专家切换采样在 W2 意义下可被离散化误差与神经逼近误差共同界定，收敛阶为 N^{-1/2} 加常数逼近偏差。

papers.title: StarOR: Synergizing Tree Search and Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Optimization modeling is inherently hierarchical, requiring a precise sequence of symbolic commitments. Traditional learning-based automated optimization modeling methods improve modeling policies through large-scale annotated or curated training data, but are costly to adapt to new problem distributions. Meanwhile, one-shot generation remains brittle in hierarchical modeling, where early symbolic errors can propagate into invalid formulations. Test-time scaling offers a promising alternative by enabling structural exploration with additional instance-level computation; however, existing search-based methods typically rely on a fixed policy, causing repeated rollouts to inherit similar modeling biases and providing limited credit assignment for intermediate decisions. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{StarOR}, a synergistic search-and-adaptation framework that couples MCTS with Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for optimization modeling. StarOR decomposes the modeling process into four stages and updates a transient LoRA adapter via GRPO at each non-terminal node. By using MCTS-generated siblings as local comparison sets, StarOR transforms search-time exploration into instance-specific policy refinement. Moreover, an unsupervised multi-faceted reward system provides fine-grained feedback for intermediate formulation decisions without ground-truth labels. Across five optimization benchmarks, StarOR attains a 65.0\% average accuracy with a 4B backbone, matching the highest average and outperforming the evaluated same-backbone test-time baselines. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Liwow/StarOR}{StarOR}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StarOR 把优化建模拆成四个阶段，用 MCTS 搜索加测试时 GRPO 更新的瞬时 LoRA 适配器，把兄弟节点当作局部比较集，将搜索探索转成实例级策略精调。在五个优化基准上以 4B backbone 达到 65.0% 平均准确率，持平最高平均并优于同 backbone 的测试时基线。
Motivation: 分层优化建模中早期符号错误会传播成无效公式，一次性生成脆弱；基于标注数据的策略学习成本高、难适配新分布，而现有搜索方法用固定策略导致重复 rollout 继承相似偏差、对中间决策的 credit assignment 有限。
Method: MCTS 与测试时强化学习耦合：建模过程分四阶段，每个非终端节点上用 GRPO 更新瞬时 LoRA adapter；以 MCTS 生成的 siblings 作为局部比较集做实例级策略精调；用无监督多面奖励 (multi-faceted reward) 在无 ground-truth 标签下给中间公式决策提供细粒度反馈。
Result: 在五个优化基准上，StarOR 以 4B backbone 取得 65.0% 平均准确率，与最高平均持平，并优于所评估的同 backbone 测试时基线。
Conclusion: 把树搜索与测试时 RL 结合、用实例内比较替代固定策略，可以在不依赖大规模标注的情况下提升分层优化建模的准确率。

papers.title: Knowledge-Based Zero-Replay Debugging of Multi-Agent LLM Traces
papers.abstract_en: Reliable operation of multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems depends on debugging long execution traces, where the few causally decisive events are buried in unstructured logs of messages, routes, memory writes, and tool calls. The standard tool is counterfactual replay (rewind, edit, and re-run the trajectory to measure each event's effect), but its cost grows linearly with the number of candidate events, making exhaustive replay infeasible at scale. We frame trace debugging as a knowledge-based decision-support problem. Each trace is compiled into a structured event knowledge graph over routing, memory, tool-use, uncertainty, and latent evidence, and a calibrated predictor decides where a scarce replay budget should be spent. We do not propose a new replay oracle; we propose a method to predict its results without paying the replay cost. We formulate zero-replay counterfactual-effect prediction: given a trace under a fixed budget, predict which events the oracle would mark high-effect before any replay is performed. BranchPoint-Latent is a lightweight predictor over observable, structural, uncertainty, and latent features of the knowledge graph. Calibrated against a deterministic replay oracle across 37 trace families, a single learning-to-rank gradient-boosted predictor raises per-trace localization (Branch Recall@5) from 0.73 to 0.93 on held-out families at zero oracle-replay cost. Rather than claiming universal dominance, we characterize when cheap graph centrality suffices and when learned evidence is necessary. The result is an auditable, cost-efficient decision-support system for AI-reliability debugging, positioned explicitly on the cost-accuracy frontier with reproducible artifacts.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多智能体 LLM 长执行轨迹的反事实调试转成知识图谱上的排序问题：轨迹编译为覆盖路由、记忆、工具调用、不确定性与潜在证据的事件知识图谱，用校准的轻量预测器在零回放下判定哪些事件值得花回放预算。对确定性 replay oracle 校准后，learning-to-rank 梯度提升预测器在留出轨迹族上把 Branch Recall@5 从 0.73 提到 0.93，且不付任何 oracle 回放代价。
Motivation: 反事实回放（rewind、edit、re-run）成本随候选事件数线性增长，规模一大就无法穷举；而真正因果关键的事件淹没在消息、路由、记忆写入与工具调用的非结构化日志里。
Method: 先把每条轨迹编译成结构化事件知识图谱，再用 BranchPoint-Latent 在可观测、结构性、不确定性与潜在特征上做预测；以确定性 replay oracle 为标签校准，训练 learning-to-rank 梯度提升模型，在固定回放预算下预测 oracle 会标为 high-effect 的事件。
Result: 在 37 个 trace families 上校准，留出轨迹族的每轨迹定位指标 Branch Recall@5 从 0.73 升至 0.93，且为零 oracle-replay 成本；论文同时刻画了廉价图中心性足够与必须用学习证据的分界条件。
Conclusion: 作者主张不改进 replay oracle，而是预测其结果：零回放的图上排序预测器可把调试定位推到成本-精度前沿上，并明确给出可复现产物与适用边界而非宣称普遍占优。

papers.title: Multi-Bitwidth Quantization for LLMs Using Additive Codebooks
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware with varying resource constraints, the ability to adaptively manage the performance-efficiency trade-off without retraining is critical. We propose Drop-by-Drop, a novel multi-bitwidth post-training quantization framework enabling inference-time precision control over LLM weights from a single quantized model. As theoretical motivation, we prove that Gaussian sources are successively refinable under a weighted mean squared error distortion motivated by LLM loss functions: successive refinement across distortion levels incurs no rate penalty relative to encoding at each level separately. Drop-by-Drop approximates this hierarchical structure in practice by incorporating Matryoshka-style supervision into additive codebook training, inducing an ordering in which codebook prefixes yield accurate partial reconstructions at each precision level. Furthermore, a block-Hadamard rotation brings the weight distribution closer to our Gaussian source assumption. The result is a single model that serves multiple bitwidths by dropping codebooks, reducing storage and quantization cost relative to the static per-bitwidth models. Across Qwen, LLaMA, Gemma, and Mistral, Drop-by-Drop achieves lower perplexity than state-of-the-art multi-bitwidth methods with competitive zero-shot accuracy, while our specialized kernels further reduce decoding latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Drop-by-Drop 是一个 LLM 训练后多比特量化框架：用加性码本 (additive codebooks) 加 Matryoshka 式前缀监督，让同一量化模型按丢弃码本数量在推理时切换精度，无需重训。理论侧证明高斯源在加权 MSE 失真下可逐级精化 (successive refinement) 且不产生速率惩罚；block-Hadamard 旋转把权重分布拉近高斯假设。在 Qwen、LLaMA、Gemma、Mistral 上困惑度低于现有多比特方法，零样本精度相当，专用 kernel 进一步降低解码延迟。
Motivation: LLM 部署到资源异构的硬件时，需要在不重训的前提下动态权衡性能与效率；现有做法是为每个比特宽度各存一个静态模型，存储与量化开销大。
Method: 在加性码本训练中引入 Matryoshka 式监督，使码本前缀在各精度层级上构成有序的部分重建；用 block-Hadamard 旋转使权重分布更接近理论所设的高斯源；推理时通过丢弃码本切换比特宽度，配套专用 kernel 加速解码。理论部分证明高斯源在受 LLM 损失启发的加权 MSE 失真下逐级精化无速率代价。
Result: 在 Qwen、LLaMA、Gemma、Mistral 上，困惑度低于 state-of-the-art 多比特量化方法，零样本精度具竞争力，专用 kernel 进一步降低解码延迟；单模型服务多比特宽度，相对每比特一个静态模型降低存储与量化成本。
Conclusion: 把逐级精化的层级结构近似进码本训练，可以让单个量化模型覆盖多个推理精度而不牺牲质量，取代按比特宽度分别存模型的做法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mind the Perspective: Let's Reason Recursively for Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning requires inferring agents' beliefs from partial and asymmetric observations, which remains an open challenge for LLMs. Existing prompting-based approaches improve ToM reasoning through observable-event filtering or temporal belief chains, without explicitly modeling nested beliefs. We introduce RecToM, an inference-time framework for ToM reasoning that models nested beliefs via recursive perspective construction. RecToM constructs each character perspective from the preceding character perspective along the character chain specified by the question, reducing higher-order belief questions to actual-world questions within the final constructed perspective. We further provide a KD45 analysis showing that RecToM's perspective construction induces a well-formed belief modality beyond simple event filtering. Experiments on ToM benchmarks, including Hi-ToM, Big-ToM, and FanToM, across multiple LLM backbones show that RecToM consistently outperforms recent advanced approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Notably, RecToM reaches 100\% accuracy on Hi-ToM with GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.5, a benchmark requiring higher-order ToM reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/you68681/rectom.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted at EMNLP findings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RecToM 是一个推理时框架，沿题目给出的角色链递归构造每个角色的视角，把高阶信念问题约化为最终视角下的实际世界问题，从而显式建模嵌套信念。在 Hi-ToM、Big-ToM、FanToM 上跨多个 LLM 骨干一致优于近期方法并达到 SOTA，其中 Hi-ToM 在 GPT-5.4 与 Qwen3.5 上达到 100% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于提示的 ToM 方法只做可观测事件过滤或时间信念链，没有显式建模嵌套信念，难以处理部分且不对称观测下的高阶信念推断。
Method: RecToM 在推理时沿题目指定的角色链递归构造视角：每个角色视角由前一角色视角生成，把高阶信念问题约化为最终构造视角中的实际世界问题；并给出 KD45 分析，说明该视角构造诱导出良构的信念模态，超越简单事件过滤。
Result: 在 Hi-ToM、Big-ToM、FanToM 上跨多个 LLM 骨干一致优于近期先进方法并取得 SOTA；其中需要高阶 ToM 推理的 Hi-ToM 在 GPT-5.4 与 Qwen3.5 上达到 100% 准确率。
Conclusion: 递归视角构造加 KD45 模态分析足以让 LLM 处理嵌套信念，把高阶 ToM 约化为最终视角下的实际世界问题即可取得 SOTA。

papers.title: DroneShield-AI: A Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion Framework for Real-Time Autonomous Drone Threat Detection, Behavioral Intent Classification, and Swarm Intelligence in Contested Airspace
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) threats have emerged as a defining security challenge of the 21st century. This paper presents DroneShield-AI, a unified open framework integrating six processing layers: RF signal classification, acoustic motor-signature detection, YOLOv8-based visual detection, evidence-weighted sensor fusion, a Behavioral Intent Classification Engine (BICE), and a Graph Neural Network Swarm Intelligence Module (GNN-SIM). This v2 revision reports measured results on the completed implementation (495 automated tests), superseding the v1 simulation-only preprint. On real public data: RF presence detection reaches F1 0.9924; acoustic detection reaches 98.12% accuracy, though a 4-feature statistical baseline reaches 93.25% on the same split, so the model's drone-specific contribution is approximately 4.9 points, a property of dataset provenance rather than a leakage bug; visual detection (YOLOv8) reaches AP50 0.8782 on a held-out test split, from a model still improving when training stopped. No fused-accuracy figure is reportable, since the three real-data layers use independently collected, unsynchronized datasets with no shared ground truth. BICE and GNN-SIM remain evaluated on physics-calibrated simulation data pending real adversarial and swarm field data: BICE shows a consistent robustness advantage over a trivial baseline under distribution shift; GNN-SIM underperforms its own trivial baseline in-distribution but independently replicates BICE's noise-robustness advantage, regarded as this work's most durable finding. All code, trained checkpoints, and the full test suite are publicly released.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 20 tables. v2 adds Section 7.9 reporting measured results on the completed implementation (495 automated tests) and revision notes throughout Sections 3-9 and Appendix C; superscript daggers mark results still based on simulation data. Code available at https://github.com/mariusbayizere/DroneShield-AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DroneShield-AI 是一个开源的无人机威胁检测多模态框架，含 RF 分类、声学电机指纹、YOLOv8 视觉检测、证据加权融合、行为意图分类引擎 (BICE) 与图神经网络蜂群模块 (GNN-SIM) 六层。在真实公开数据上 RF 存在性检测 F1 0.9924、声学 98.12%（4 特征统计基线 93.25%，净贡献约 4.9 个百分点）、YOLOv8 AP50 0.8782；因三层数据不同步无共享真值，融合精度无法给出。
Motivation: 无人机威胁检测需要统一的实时多模态框架，但 RF、声学、视觉各层常各自为政，且意图分类与蜂群行为缺乏公开可复现的评测载体。
Method: 六层流水线：RF 信号分类、声学电机指纹检测、YOLOv8 视觉检测、证据加权传感器融合、BICE 行为意图分类、GNN-SIM 蜂群智能模块；v2 报告已完成实现的实测结果，含 495 项自动化测试，BICE 与 GNN-SIM 仍在物理标定仿真数据上评测，代码、检查点与测试套件全部公开。
Result: 真实公开数据上：RF 存在性检测 F1 0.9924；声学检测准确率 98.12%，同划分上 4 特征统计基线 93.25%，模型无人机特有贡献约 4.9 个百分点（归因于数据来源而非泄漏）；YOLOv8 在留出测试集 AP50 0.8782，且训练停止时模型仍在改善。融合精度不可报告，因三层数据独立采集、不同步、无共享真值。仿真数据上 BICE 在分布偏移下相对平凡基线有一致鲁棒性优势；GNN-SIM 分布内表现不及自身平凡基线，但独立复现了 BICE 的噪声鲁棒性优势，被作者视为最持久的发现。
Conclusion: 跨分布偏移的噪声鲁棒性优势是该框架最可复现的结论，而多模态融合精度要等三层共享真值的同步数据才能成立。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 真实公开数据上：RF 存在性检测 F1 0.9924；声学检测准确率 98.12%，同划分上 4 特征统计基线 93.25%，模型无人机特有贡献约 4.9 个百分点（归因于数据来源而非泄漏）；YOLOv8 在留出测试集 AP50 0.8782，且训练停止时模型仍在改善。融合精度不可报告，因三层数据独立采集、不同步、无共享真值。仿真数据上 BICE 在分布偏移下相对平凡基线有一致鲁棒性优势；GNN-SIM 分布内表现不及自身平凡基线，但独立复现了 BICE 的噪声鲁棒性优势，被作者视为最持久的发现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨分布偏移的噪声鲁棒性优势是该框架最可复现的结论，而多模态融合精度要等三层共享真值的同步数据才能成立。

papers.title: AugRelNet: Relation-Augmented Dynamics for Structure Discovery and Forecasting from Limited Data
papers.abstract_en: Complex dynamics often arise from persistent interactions whose effects vary with the system state. We introduce AugRelNet for short- and medium-horizon trajectory forecasting from limited data. A shared learnable relation matrix explicitly routes source signals to targets, while evolving local features \(u\) and a persistent response state \(η\) transform them into nonlinear, history-dependent responses. Feeding these responses back into the dynamics separates shared relational organization from its changing realization. The learned relations reflect dense coupling in Lotka--Volterra systems and develop structured, neighbour-preferential organization in locally interacting systems. On 40-dimensional Lorenz--96, AugRelNet uses about 4,000 training states, roughly an order of magnitude fewer than representative prior Lorenz--96 forecasting studies. Across five seeds, every true interaction ranks above every nonedge, with a mean absolute-weight contrast of approximately \(146{:}1\). Under the same data budget, eight-step RMSE is about \(23\)--\(59\times\) lower than MNO, DySLIM, DeepSkip, and AL-RNN, \(14\)--\(55\times\) lower than NRI and dense GraphODE, and 37\% lower than PySINDy with a matched quadratic dictionary. The same relational representation extends to grids by treating sites as variables and sharing relations across spatial offsets: in discrete (Game of Life), continuous (FitzHugh--Nagumo), and stochastic (Ising) dynamics, learned weights rank physical neighbours above other candidate offsets while supporting multi-step prediction. AugRelNet learns these relations through prediction losses and regularization, without structural labels or system-specific physical losses.
papers.comment: Major revision. Renamed MF-Net to AugRelNet, with a substantially revised formulation, new theoretical analysis, expanded experiments and baselines, and an accompanying public code release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AugRelNet 用一个共享可学习的关系矩阵把源信号路由到目标，配合演化局部特征 u 与持久响应状态 η 生成非线性、历史依赖的响应并回馈动力学，从而在有限数据下同时做结构发现与轨迹预报。在 40 维 Lorenz–96 上仅用约 4,000 个训练状态（比同类研究少约一个数量级），五个随机种子下所有真实交互的权重都排在所有非边之上，绝对权重对比约 146:1。
Motivation: 复杂动力学的相互作用随系统状态变化，而有限数据下既要发现真实耦合结构又要做好短中期轨迹预报；现有方法通常需要更多样本或结构标签。
Method: 共享可学习关系矩阵显式路由源到目标，演化局部特征 u 与持久响应状态 η 将其变换为非线性、历史依赖响应并回馈动力学，分离共享关系组织与其变化实现；仅用预测损失与正则化学习，不用结构标签或系统特定物理损失；网格情形把站点当变量、跨空间偏移共享关系。
Result: 40 维 Lorenz–96 上用约 4,000 个训练状态，约为代表性 Lorenz–96 研究的十分之一；五个种子下每条真实交互都排在所有非边之上，平均绝对权重对比约 146:1；同数据预算下八步 RMSE 比 MNO、DySLIM、DeepSkip、AL-RNN 低约 23–59 倍，比 NRI 与 dense GraphODE 低 14–55 倍，比匹配二次字典的 PySINDy 低 37%；在 Game of Life、FitzHugh–Nagumo 与 Ising 上学到的权重把物理邻居排在其他候选偏移之上并支持多步预报。
Conclusion: 把共享关系组织与其实现分离的回馈结构，能在无结构标签的条件下从有限数据中同时恢复耦合结构并支撑短中期多步预报，且可推广到网格动力学。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Driving Video Retrieval for Complex Queries with Structured Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video retrieval at scale is central to data curation and safety validation in autonomous driving, where users want to find not only scenes but also dynamic events such as cut-ins and hard braking. Existing vision-language and keyword-based retrieval methods often miss these events because the relevant motion may not be explicitly described in text or captured by lexical overlap. Rule-based retrieval can encode such events more directly, but it is brittle: generated or hand-written rules often fail when their assumptions do not match real driving data. We propose STRIVE-D, a data-calibrated retrieval framework for driving videos. It uses weakly labeled in-domain videos to estimate when a query rule is reliable, adapt rules that mismatch observed data, and fuse calibrated rule scores with vision-language and keyword-based retrieval signals. Across three driving benchmarks, including newly released human-annotated event data on DrivingDojo, STRIVE-D delivers up to 84% relative improvement in top-1 accuracy over state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRIVE-D 用弱标注的域内驾驶视频校准规则检索：先估计查询规则何时可靠、按观测数据改写失配规则，再把校准后的规则分数与视觉-语言、关键词检索信号融合。在三个驾驶基准（含新发布的人工标注事件数据 DrivingDojo）上，top-1 准确率相对当前最优方法最高提升 84%。
Motivation: 自动驾驶数据筛选需要检索 cut-in、急刹车这类动态事件，而视觉-语言与关键词检索依赖文本显式描述或词面重叠，常漏掉这些事件；规则检索能直接编码事件却很脆，规则假设与真实驾驶数据不符时即失效。
Method: STRIVE-D 是数据校准的驾驶视频检索框架：用弱标注的域内视频估计查询规则的可靠性，对与观测数据失配的规则做自适应改写，再将校准后的规则分数与 vision-language、keyword-based 检索信号融合。
Result: 在三个驾驶基准上（含新发布的人工标注事件数据 DrivingDojo），top-1 准确率相对 state-of-the-art 方法最高提升 84%。
Conclusion: 规则检索的脆性可以靠域内数据校准与多信号融合来缓解，从而更可靠地检索驾驶视频中的动态事件。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: nCMD: Benign-Anchored Feature Selection for Imbalanced Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is critical for network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) operating under high-dimensional, highly imbalanced traffic, as found in operational and defense networks. Traditional filter methods rank features using global statistics computed symmetrically across classes and thus fail to capture the asymmetry of intrusion detection, where attacks are best characterized as deviations from dominant benign traffic. We propose benign-anchored Classwise Mean Deviation (nCMD), a lightweight and interpretable method that scores feature relevance based on the deviation of attack-class distributions from the benign-class mean, rather than a globally biased reference. This approach aligns feature selection with the operational semantics of NIDS at no additional computational cost. Across four benchmark datasets (CICIDS2017, CICDDoS2019, NSL-KDD, and UNSW-NB15), multiple feature budgets, and three downstream classifiers, nCMD matches or exceeds classical filter baselines in macro-averaged F1-score. It achieves the best result on three of the four datasets and under every classifier, with the strongest improvements observed under tight feature budgets and severe class imbalance. These results support benign-anchored ranking as a scalable and interpretable preprocessing component for resource-constrained NIDS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: nCMD 用攻击类分布相对良性类均值的偏离度给特征打分，取代跨类对称的全局统计量，使特征选择对齐 NIDS 中“攻击是主导良性流量的偏移”这一语义。在 CICIDS2017、CICDDoS2019、NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15 四个基准上、多种特征预算与三个下游分类器下，其宏平均 F1 追平或超过经典 filter 基线，并在四个数据集中的三个上、且在每个分类器下取得最佳结果，紧预算与严重不平衡时提升最强。
Motivation: 高维且极度不平衡的网络流量中，传统 filter 方法用跨类对称的全局统计量排序特征，无法刻画入侵检测的非对称性——攻击应以偏离主导良性流量的程度来刻画。
Method: 提出 benign-anchored Classwise Mean Deviation (nCMD)：按每个攻击类分布相对良性类均值的偏离度 (mean deviation) 计算特征相关性，作为轻量、可解释且不增加计算开销的预处理步骤；在四个基准数据集、多个特征预算与三个下游分类器上与经典 filter 基线对比。
Result: 在 CICIDS2017、CICDDoS2019、NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15 四个数据集、多个特征预算和三个下游分类器下，nCMD 的宏平均 F1-score 追平或超过经典 filter 基线；在四个数据集中的三个上、且在每个分类器下取得最佳结果，特征预算收紧、类别不平衡加剧时提升最强。
Conclusion: 以良性类为锚的偏离度排序可作为资源受限 NIDS 的可扩展、可解释预处理组件，替代全局有偏的对称参考。

papers.title: Sci-Rho: A Multilingual Visually-Grounded Symbolic Benchmark for STEM Problems
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic benchmarks have emerged as a key approach to assess model robustness under minor modifications to STEM-related questions. However, existing symbolic benchmarks mostly remain limited to mathematical reasoning, lack visual grounding, and are predominantly in English. In this work, we introduce Sci-Rho (Science Rhobustness), a dynamic benchmark for visually-grounded STEM problems spanning five subjects and seven languages, comprising 4,242 problem templates (606 per language) crafted by domain experts, including Olympiad medalists. Each template is implemented as executable Python code that generates diverse but equivalent problem instances by varying numerical values, visual patterns, geometric shapes, color schemes, and function types, resulting in 42,420 instances in total, each paired with reasoning steps and ground-truth solutions. We evaluated 17 state-of-the-art VLMs and discovered a noticeable gap between worst-case accuracy (defined as the proportion of problem templates that a model answers correctly across every generated variation) and average accuracy. We also discovered that smaller models show noticeable performance degradation across languages, whereas proprietary and larger models remain robust. Step-level evaluation reflects this same trend, revealing a significant gap between average F1 and worst-case F1 scores. Finally, our inspection of attention heads of a VLM reveals substantial cross-lingual variation in the relative attention allocated to image tokens compared to text tokens. Our work highlights the importance of evaluation beyond static benchmarks as a metric to measure the quality of VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sci-Rho 是一个多语言、视觉接地的 STEM 符号鲁棒性基准：4,242 个专家模板（每语言 606 个）以可执行 Python 代码生成共 42,420 个等价变体实例，覆盖 5 个学科、7 种语言。评测 17 个 SOTA VLM 后发现 worst-case accuracy 与 average accuracy 之间存在明显落差，小模型跨语言退化显著而专有大模型保持稳健，注意力头分析还显示图像 token 相对文本 token 的注意力分配存在跨语言差异。
Motivation: 现有符号基准大多局限于数学推理、缺少视觉接地且以英语为主，无法衡量 VLM 在题目微小改动下的真实鲁棒性。
Method: 由领域专家（含奥赛奖牌得主）编写 4,242 个模板，每个模板实现为可执行 Python 代码，通过改变数值、视觉图案、几何形状、配色与函数类型生成等价实例，并附推理步骤与标准答案；对 17 个 VLM 做实例级与 step-level 评测，并检查其中一个 VLM 的注意力头。
Result: 基准含 5 学科、7 语言、4,242 个模板（每语言 606 个）与 42,420 个实例；17 个 VLM 的 worst-case accuracy（模板在所有生成变体上全对的比例）明显低于 average accuracy，step-level 上 average F1 与 worst-case F1 同样存在显著差距；小模型跨语言性能退化明显，专有与更大模型保持稳健；注意力头检查显示图像 token 相对文本 token 的注意力分配存在显著跨语言差异。
Conclusion: 静态基准不足以衡量 VLM 质量，必须报告 worst-case 而非仅平均指标，并关注跨语言与图文注意力分配的不均衡。

papers.title: ARAPDiffusion: Geometry-Distribution Feedback for Deformable 3D Shape Generation
papers.abstract_en: Deformable 3D shapes can undergo large changes in pose and morphology while still preserving plausible local geometry, yet generative models often produce samples with unnatural stretching or distortion. In latent generative models, such failures can arise from two coupled sources: the decoder determines the geometry produced at a latent code, while the generative distribution determines which latent regions are actually visited. We introduce ARAPDiffusion, a latent generative framework that establishes feedback between deformation geometry and the generative distribution. First, latent codes sampled from the current diffusion model determine where as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) constraint is applied, concentrating geometric supervision in regions that the generator actually visits. Second, generated shapes are evaluated by their deformation relative to the observed shape family, and these scores modulate the influence of generated samples during diffusion refinement. In this way, the generative distribution determines where geometry is enforced, while deformation quality in turn reshapes what the model generates. ARAPDiffusion applies to both consistently meshed shapes and unordered point clouds, and the learned prior can also be used for conditional reconstruction. Experiments across human, animal, and bone shape families show consistent improvements in generated-shape quality, distribution matching, and reconstruction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARAPDiffusion 在潜空间生成模型里把形变几何与生成分布做成双向反馈：用当前 diffusion 采样的 latent code 决定 ARAP 约束施加的位置，再用生成形状相对观测形变族的打分反过来调制扩散精修中生成样本的权重。在 human、animal、bone 形状族上，生成质量、分布匹配与重建精度一致提升，且同时适用于一致网格与无序点云。
Motivation: 可变形 3D 形状生成常出现不自然的拉伸或畸变：decoder 决定某 latent 码对应的几何，生成分布决定哪些 latent 区域被真正访问，两者解耦导致几何监督落在生成器不去的地方。
Method: 潜空间 diffusion 框架内建立双向反馈：先由当前 diffusion 模型采样 latent code，据此确定 as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) 约束的施加区域，把几何监督集中在生成器实际访问的区域；再按生成形状相对观测形变族的形变质量打分，调制这些生成样本在 diffusion 精修中的影响权重。方法同时支持一致网格与无序点云，学到的 prior 可用于条件重建。
Result: 在 human、animal、bone 三类形状族上的实验显示，生成形状质量、分布匹配 (distribution matching) 与重建精度均获得一致提升；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 让生成分布决定几何约束落在哪里、让形变质量反过来重塑生成内容，可以在可变形 3D 形状上同时改善生成质量与重建精度，且该 prior 可复用于条件重建任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual Advantage Fields
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning requires both long-horizon reachability estimates and local action comparisons. Dual goal representations provide value fields that capture global goal reachability, but they do not directly specify which action should be preferred at a given state. We propose Dual Advantage Fields (DAF), a policy-extraction method that turns a bilinear dual value model into a local advantage signal. Under bilinear dual parameterization, the goal embedding is the gradient of the value field with respect to the state representation, which directly specifies which action should be preferred. DAF introduces an action-effect model that predicts the discounted direction of change in state representation space induced by actions and scores them by the similarity between this change and the goal direction. In the realizable case, this score equals the goal-conditioned Bellman advantage, yielding a standard local policy-improvement guarantee. On OGBench locomotion, manipulation, and puzzle tasks, DAF improves aggregate RLiable metrics and performs strongly in settings where locally correct actions differ from direct movement toward the final goal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dual Advantage Fields (DAF) 把双线性 dual value model 转成局部 advantage 信号做离线目标条件策略提取：在双线性参数化下 goal embedding 即价值场对状态表征的梯度，直接给出动作偏好方向。可实现情形下该打分等于目标条件 Bellman advantage，从而得到标准的局部策略改进保证；在 OGBench locomotion、manipulation、puzzle 任务上提升了聚合 Rliable 指标。
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习同时需要长程可达性估计与局部动作比较，而 dual goal representation 给出的价值场只刻画全局可达性，不直接说明在某个状态下该偏好哪个动作。
Method: DAF 作为策略提取方法：利用双线性 dual 参数化中 goal embedding 等于价值场对状态表征梯度这一性质，引入 action-effect 模型预测动作在状态表征空间中引起的折扣后变化方向，再按该变化与 goal 方向的相似度给动作打分，作为局部 advantage 信号提取策略。
Result: 在可实现 (realizable) 情形下该打分等于目标条件 Bellman advantage，因而继承标准局部策略改进保证；在 OGBench 的 locomotion、manipulation、puzzle 任务上提升了聚合 Rliable 指标，尤其在局部正确动作不同于直接朝最终目标移动的设置中表现强。
Conclusion: 把 dual 价值模型的梯度结构转成 advantage 信号，可以在保留全局可达性的同时补上局部动作比较，从而在离线目标条件 RL 中实现带策略改进保证的策略提取。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Channel-Preserving Representation Alignment for EEG-to-Music Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing naturalistic music from EEG requires extracting music-specific information from weak signals distributed across electrodes. Existing spectrogram regression and diffusion approaches provide audio synthesis mechanisms, but learning the EEG-to-music mapping faces an information--estimation tradeoff. Combining electrode measurements into fewer features can ease estimation from limited recordings while obscuring distinctions between music segments. We propose channel-preserving representation alignment, separating electrode information retention from prediction regularization. Per-electrode tokenization preserves spatial identity for learned aggregation, while multi-view self-distillation and channel dropout encourage consistency across electrode subsets during pretraining and music alignment. The aligned representation conditions a pretrained audio generator. Our theory explains these complementary choices. A finite-sample regression analysis identifies when retained task information outweighs estimation cost. For nonlinear alignment, an exact decomposition reveals a prediction-consistency penalty in the masked contrastive objective, with margin-dependent bounds connecting prediction variability to ranking errors across electrode subsets. On NMED-T/H, our method improves within-subject 50-way identification from 0.388 to 0.485 and generated-audio CLAP similarity from 0.635 to 0.683 compared with previous work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出通道保持的表示对齐 (channel-preserving representation alignment)，把电极信息保留与预测正则解耦：逐电极 tokenization 保留空间身份，多视角自蒸馏与 channel dropout 在预训练和音乐对齐阶段强制电极子集间一致，对齐后的表示再条件化一个预训练音频生成器。在 NMED-T/H 上，被试内 50-way 识别从 0.388 提到 0.485，生成音频的 CLAP 相似度从 0.635 提到 0.683。
Motivation: 从弱 EEG 信号重建自然音乐存在信息-估计权衡：把电极合成较少特征便于有限录制下估计，却会抹掉音乐片段之间的区分，现有谱回归与扩散方法只提供合成机制而未处理该权衡。
Method: 逐电极 tokenization 保留空间身份供学习式聚合；预训练与音乐对齐阶段用多视角自蒸馏 (multi-view self-distillation) 和 channel dropout 促使电极子集间一致；对齐表示条件化预训练音频生成器。理论部分给出有限样本回归分析判定保留任务信息何时超过估计代价，并对非线性对齐给出精确分解，揭示 masked contrastive 目标中的 prediction-consistency 惩罚及连接预测变异性与电极子集排序错误的 margin 相关界。
Result: 在 NMED-T/H 上，被试内 50-way 识别率从先前工作的 0.388 提升到 0.485，生成音频的 CLAP 相似度从 0.635 提升到 0.683。
Conclusion: 把电极信息保留与预测正则分开处理，可在有限 EEG 录制下同时改善音乐片段判别与生成音频的语义对齐；理论给出保留信息何时胜过估计代价的条件。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SPR: Toward a Graph Foundation Model for Transferable Graph Cognition via Spectral Patterns and Relational Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have attracted increasing attention for their potential to learn unified and generalizable knowledge across diverse graphs, thereby supporting a wide range of graph scenarios. However, unlike natural language and images, graphs lack an intuitive and unified form for perceiving and organizing transferable knowledge. Therefore, despite many initial explorations, a key problem remains unresolved: the transferable cognitive mechanism for graphs. Existing GFMs usually rely on intuitively defined mechanisms to encode transferable graph patterns, such as handcrafted structural templates (e.g., cycles and trees), fixed propagation mechanisms, and predefined random-walk patterns. These mechanisms are often prescriptive and rigid, limiting their ability to flexibly characterize diverse graph patterns across domains. This motivates the exploration of a more flexible, graph-native, and transferable cognitive mechanism. To this end, we analyze graphs from the spectral perspective and propose SPR. SPR decomposes graph information into Chebyshev polynomial bases and learns shared spectral responses, enabling unified yet adaptive cognition of continuously varying spectral patterns across graphs. We further model cross-graph relational geometry to distill recurring pairwise organization from multiple graphs, providing a shared relational reference for transferring such graph cognition across domains. Extensive experiments across diverse graphs and downstream scenarios demonstrate that SPR enables effective and transferable graph cognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPR 把图信息分解到 Chebyshev 多项式基上并学习跨图共享的谱响应，再建模跨图关系几何以蒸馏反复出现的成对组织，作为跨域迁移的共享参照。作者称在多种图与下游场景的实验中 SPR 实现了有效且可迁移的图认知。
Motivation: 图缺乏语言与图像那样直观统一的可迁移知识组织形式，现有图基础模型依赖手工结构模板（环、树）、固定传播机制和预定义随机游走模式，刻画跨域图模式时僵硬受限。
Method: SPR 从谱视角分析图：将图信息分解到 Chebyshev 多项式基并学习共享谱响应，以统一而自适应地刻画跨图连续变化的谱模式；再建模跨图关系几何，从多张图蒸馏反复出现的成对组织，提供迁移图认知的共享关系参照。
Result: 在多种图与下游场景上进行实验，结果显示 SPR 实现了有效且可迁移的图认知（abstract 未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 谱响应加关系几何构成一种更灵活、图原生且可跨域迁移的图认知机制，优于依赖手工模板与固定传播的直觉式设计。

papers.title: AgentCL: Toward Rigorous Evaluation of Continual Learning in Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language agents spend substantial inference time solving individual tasks, yet the experience acquired in one episode is often underutilized in future episodes. Continual learning expects an agent to accumulate experience across a stream of tasks, improve over time, and avoid interference from irrelevant experiences. Unfortunately, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate this problem rigorously. Most efforts focus on retrieval and reasoning over long-context conversations or documents, while recent lifelong-adaptation benchmarks often stream existing datasets whose cross-task dependencies are unknown, making it difficult to understand what an agent learns and reuses over time. This paper presents an evaluation framework AgentCL for continual learning in agents, centered on distinguishable task streams and metrics for CL properties. AgentCL distinguishes three cross-task relations by the availability of reusable knowledge. In dependent streams, later tasks can reuse knowledge from earlier ones. In conventional streams, whether such reuse exists is unknown. Besides, independent tasks are held out with little transferable knowledge. We use the benchmark to evaluate non-parametric memory designs for continual learning. To diagnose how memory design choices affect continual learning, we develop MemProbe, a probing method that stores interactions, insights, and skills, while filtering unreliable experiences during consolidation. Empirical analysis across coding, deep research, and language understanding/reasoning tasks shows that conventional streams offer limited ability to distinguish memory designs, whereas dependent streams more clearly distinguish their plasticity. Meanwhile, conventional streams and independent tasks often yield limited gains and can expose memory-induced degradation. These results highlight the need for stronger memory designs that balance plasticity and stable reuse.
papers.comment: 9 pages in the main text, 28 pages in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentCL 把任务流按可复用知识分成 dependent、conventional、independent 三类，用以严格评测语言 agent 的持续学习 (continual learning)。在 coding、deep research、语言理解/推理任务上，conventional 流难以区分记忆设计且常暴露记忆导致的性能退化，dependent 流更能区分各设计的 plasticity。
Motivation: 现有持续学习基准多是流式投放来源各异的数据集，跨任务依赖未知，难以判断 agent 到底学到了什么、复用了什么，因而无法严格评测持续学习。
Method: 提出评测框架 AgentCL，按可复用知识的有无区分三类任务流（dependent 可复用、conventional 依赖关系未知、independent 几乎无可迁移知识）并配套 CL 属性指标；同时开发探针方法 MemProbe，在整合阶段存储 interactions、insights、skills 并过滤不可靠经验，用以诊断记忆设计选择如何影响持续学习。
Result: 在 coding、deep research、语言理解/推理任务上的实证分析显示：conventional 流区分记忆设计的能力有限，dependent 流更能区分各设计的 plasticity；conventional 流与 independent 任务往往收益有限，并会暴露 memory-induced degradation。
Conclusion: 任务流的跨任务依赖结构决定基准的区分力，评测必须用 dependent 流；现有非参数记忆设计需要在 plasticity 与 stable reuse 之间取得更强平衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SkillSmith: Co-Evolving Skills and Tools for Self-Improving Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly store capabilities in external skill and tool libraries. Libraries can grow, but execution must fit a finite context window and improvement consumes a finite iteration budget. We formulate external-policy evolution under these two budgets and introduce SkillSmith. A skill ecosystem allocates context through replicator dynamics, using randomized masking and Bayesian estimation to learn skill effects and interactions. Four typed operations repair tools and move reusable logic across the skill-tool boundary, freeing context for the ecosystem. Conflict-driven learning distills failed proposals into version-scoped nogoods that guide repairs and veto repeated failing proposals. We prove utility ascent for fixed-model continuous dynamics, conditions under which lower context costs expand attainable utility, and the need for synchronized interface migration under persistent exact-match dependencies. Across five Qwen3.5 scales, SkillSmith improves over EvoSkill by up to 10.2 and 9.8 percentage points on OfficeQA and SealQA, respectively, and sustains improvement beyond SkillClaw on WildClawBench. Skills compete for context; tools are how the system makes room.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillSmith 把 LLM agent 的外部技能/工具库演化形式化为上下文与迭代双预算约束下的外部策略演化：用复制子动力学 (replicator dynamics) 分配上下文，四类有类型操作在技能-工具边界迁移逻辑腾出上下文，冲突驱动学习把失败提案蒸馏成版本级 nogoods。在五个 Qwen3.5 规模上，OfficeQA 与 SealQA 相对 EvoSkill 分别最高提升 10.2 和 9.8 个百分点，并在 WildClawBench 上持续优于 SkillClaw。
Motivation: 外部技能库可以无限增长，但执行必须塞进有限上下文窗口，改进又受有限迭代预算约束；两个预算同时卡住 agent 的自我改进。
Method: 以复制子动力学分配上下文，配合随机掩码与贝叶斯估计学习技能效应及技能间交互；四类有类型操作修复工具并把可复用逻辑在技能-工具边界之间迁移；冲突驱动学习将失败提案蒸馏为版本作用域的 nogoods，用于引导修复并否决重复失败的提案。
Result: 在五个 Qwen3.5 规模上，SkillSmith 相对 EvoSkill 在 OfficeQA 上最高提升 10.2 个百分点、在 SealQA 上最高提升 9.8 个百分点，并在 WildClawBench 上相对 SkillClaw 保持持续改进。理论上证明了固定模型连续动力学下的效用上升 (utility ascent)、上下文成本降低何时扩大可达效用的条件，以及在持久精确匹配依赖下需要同步接口迁移。
Conclusion: 技能在上下文预算下相互竞争，工具是系统腾出上下文的手段；在双预算约束下联合演化技能与工具可稳定提升 agent 能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ForeSci: Evaluating LLM Agents for Forward-Looking AI Research Judgment
papers.abstract_en: AI research often requires decisions before future evidence exists: which bottleneck to attack, which direction to pursue, or where a project should be positioned. We introduce ForeSci, a temporally controlled benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can make such forward-looking research judgements from historical evidence. ForeSci contains 500 tasks across four fast-moving AI domains and four decision families. Each task is paired with a cutoff-aligned offline knowledge base; post-cutoff papers are hidden during generation and used only for validation. To avoid random future-event prediction, tasks are derived from pre-cutoff taxonomy branches and evidence signals, while generation-time retrieval and tools are restricted to the cutoff-aligned evidence package. We evaluate native LLMs, Hybrid RAG, and three research-agent adaptations across four backbones. Agent-based methods improve traceability over Hybrid RAG, while their gains in future-target alignment over native LLMs are modest and task dependent. Diagnostics reveal a recurring evidence-decision decoupling: agents may cite relevant evidence while forecasting the wrong research object. Task-specific checks between evidence and final decision reduce drift and improve future-target alignment. As research agents move from assisting known tasks to shaping open research directions, ForeSci offers a first controlled step toward measuring whether their judgement can be trusted to guide that future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForeSci 是一个时间受控基准，用 500 个任务考察 LLM agent 能否仅凭截止日期前的历史证据做出前瞻性的研究决策判断，截止后论文只用于验证。评测 native LLM、Hybrid RAG 与三种 research-agent 适配后发现：agent 提升了可追溯性但对未来目标的对齐增益有限且因任务而异，并暴露出证据-决策脱节；在证据与最终决策之间加入任务级检查可减少漂移、提升未来目标对齐。
Motivation: AI 研究常需在未来证据出现前做决策（选瓶颈、定方向、定位项目），而现有评测无法区分 agent 是真在推理还是随机猜未来事件，也难以衡量其判断能否被信任。
Method: 构建含 500 个任务、覆盖四个快速演进 AI 领域与四类决策族的基准；每个任务配一个与时间截止对齐的离线知识库，生成阶段检索与工具被限制在该证据包内，截止后论文隐藏仅作验证；任务从截止前的 taxonomy 分支与证据信号派生。评测 native LLM、Hybrid RAG 和三种 research-agent 适配，横跨四个 backbone。
Result: Agent-based 方法相对 Hybrid RAG 提升可追溯性；相对 native LLM 的未来目标对齐增益温和且因任务而异。诊断揭示反复出现的证据-决策脱节：agent 可能引用相关证据却预测错误的研究对象；在证据与最终决策之间加入任务级检查可减少漂移并改善未来目标对齐。
Conclusion: 研究 agent 的判断尚不能被直接信任去指导开放研究方向，需要在证据到决策的链路上加显式检查来约束漂移；ForeSci 提供了衡量这一点的首个受控基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, inference latency, and opaque decisions---limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that can score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and eight model families, we show that programmatic judges match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge at 47x higher throughput. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.
papers.comment: Project page and our demonstration can be found in https://sprocketlab.github.io/PAJAMA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAJAMA 把 LLM-as-a-judge 的判定逻辑蒸馏成可审查的程序委员会 (program distillation)，由程序直接打分并聚合出联合判定，低置信样本再回退给 LLM。在五个数据集、八个模型家族上，程序化 judge 以 47 倍吞吐量达到 13B LLM judge 的同等性能；用其输出做路由信号可同时提升准确率与吞吐量并推进 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 已成自动化评估标准，但推理成本高、延迟大、决策不透明，限制了可扩展性与可靠性。
Method: 程序蒸馏：不在此刻调用 LLM，而是把其判定逻辑综合成一组程序作为 judge，聚合各程序判定为联合 verdict，并内置回退机制把低置信样本选择性升级给 LLM；PAJAMA 还把程序输出用作路由信号，并用程序 verdict 蒸馏 reward model。
Result: 在五个数据集、八个模型家族上，程序化 judge 以 47 倍吞吐量匹配 13B 规模 LLM judge 的性能；以程序输出做路由信号时准确率与吞吐量同时改善并推进 Pareto 前沿；在 RewardBench 上，用程序 verdict 蒸馏的 reward model 超过用专有 LLM 标签训练的模型，而 API 成本低两个数量级。
Conclusion: 把 judge 的决策逻辑蒸馏成可编辑程序，可以在不牺牲判定质量的前提下消除逐样本 API 成本，并产出廉价有效的 reward 信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Capability Self-Assessment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The ability to recognize one's own limitations and decide whether to solve a problem or seek help is fundamental to reliable intelligent systems. Yet modern large language models tend to overestimate their competence and attempt queries they cannot solve. We study how models can learn Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) while preserving their problem-solving ability. Because the same model both assesses and solves queries, self-assessment training can change the capability it must recognize. We systematically compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating each trained model's self-assessment against its updated capability and measuring how well it retains its solving ability. Across model families, scales, and domains, RL provides the strongest assessment-retention trade-off. We also find that CSA transfers to the out-of-distribution settings we evaluate, and demonstrate its practical value for local-cloud routing at inference time and targeted data selection during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究大语言模型的能力自我评估 (Capability Self-Assessment, CSA)：同一模型既评估又解题，自评训练会改变它要识别的能力本身。系统比较 SFT 与 RL 后发现 RL 在评估准确性与解题能力保留之间给出最强折衷，且 CSA 能迁移到所评测的分布外设置，并用于推理时的 local-cloud 路由与训练时的定向数据选择。
Motivation: 现代 LLM 倾向高估自身能力、去尝试解不了的查询；而自评训练会同时改动被评估的能力，如何在学会自评的同时保住解题能力是一个未解的耦合问题。
Method: 在同一模型上分别用监督微调 (SFT) 和强化学习 (RL) 训练 CSA，把每个模型的自评结果与其更新后的真实能力对照，并同时度量解题能力的保留程度；评测横跨多个模型家族、规模与领域，另测分布外迁移及 local-cloud 路由、定向数据选择两个用途。
Result: 跨模型家族、规模与领域的对比中 RL 给出最强的评估-保留折衷；CSA 能迁移到所评测的分布外设置，并在推理时 local-cloud 路由与训练时定向数据选择上展示实用价值。
Conclusion: 要让 LLM 学会承认自身局限而不牺牲解题能力，RL 比 SFT 更合适，且学到的自评可外推到分布外并直接服务于路由与数据选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Legal-Bench: When the Answer Is in the Input. Label Leakage in Legal Benchmarks Built from Court Registries
papers.abstract_en: Court registries publish millions of decisions with structured metadata, which makes them an attractive source of labelled legal benchmarks: the court type, the form of the decision and its subject area come for free. We show that this convenience has a cost that registry-derived benchmarks rarely measure. We build Multi-Legal-Bench, which evaluates identical tasks on native court decisions from five national registries (France, the Netherlands, Poland, the Czech Republic and Lithuania), extending the Ukrainian UA-Legal-Bench, and audit what its cells actually measure. A keyword scan that uses no model reaches 96% on Dutch judgment-form classification against a 50% majority baseline, 84% on French court-type classification against 33%, and 66% on Polish judgment-form classification, where all nine models add at most seven points over it. Replacing the label names in the input by a mask brings the scan to the majority floor in all six affected cells, and eight of nine models lose accuracy significantly in most of them (39 of 54 model-cell pairs), by up to 48 points (Dutch judgment form: 100% to 52%); only Claude Sonnet 5 is essentially unaffected. Paired McNemar tests with Holm correction find a leader that beats every other model in only two of twelve cells, each a different model; but once the label names are masked, the same model leads both, and the spread between models widens in every masked cell. Part of the apparent parity between models is produced by the leakage itself. The audit also exposed a scoring defect in our own earlier release (answers written with diacritics were scored as wrong, understating Czech judgment-form accuracy by up to 90 points), which we correct and document. We recommend that every benchmark built from court registries report a no-model baseline and a masked control per cell. All data, prompts, predictions and scoring code are released.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables. v3 rewrites the paper around label leakage in registry-derived benchmarks, adds a masked control for nine models, and corrects a scoring defect in v1/v2. Data, predictions and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/multi-legal-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Multi-Legal-Bench 指出从法院登记册自动生成的法律基准存在标签泄漏：不调用任何模型的关键词扫描在荷兰判决形式分类上就达 96%（多数类基线 50%），法国法院类型 84%（基线 33%），波兰判决形式 66%，九个模型最多只比它高 7 个百分点。把输入中的标签名替换为 mask 后，扫描在全部六个受影响格子跌回多数类水平，39/54 个模型-格子对显著掉分，最大跌幅 48 个百分点（荷兰判决形式 100%→52%），仅 Claude Sonnet 5 基本不受影响。作者建议所有登记册来源的基准逐格报告 no-model 基线与 masked control。
Motivation: 法院登记册自带法院类型、判决形式、案由等结构化元数据，让构建带标签法律基准几乎零成本，但这种便利的代价——标签名直接泄漏进输入——在既有基准中很少被量化，导致模型间表面持平可能由泄漏制造。
Method: 构建 Multi-Legal-Bench，在法国、荷兰、波兰、捷克、立陶宛五个国家登记册的原生判决上评测同一组任务，扩展乌克兰 UA-Legal-Bench；对每个格子做不使用模型的关键词扫描审计，并加入把输入中标签名替换为 mask 的对照，在九个模型上运行，用配对 McNemar 检验加 Holm 校正比较模型。
Result: 无模型关键词扫描：荷兰判决形式 96%（多数类基线 50%）、法国法院类型 84%（基线 33%）、波兰判决形式 66%，九个模型在波兰上最多比扫描高 7 个百分点。mask 对照使扫描在全部六个受影响格子回落到多数类水平；39/54 个模型-格子对在多数受影响格子显著掉分，最大降幅 48 个百分点（荷兰判决形式 100%→52%），仅 Claude Sonnet 5 基本不受影响。McNemar+Holm 显示 12 个格子中仅 2 个存在击败其余全部模型的领先者且各不相同；mask 后同一模型在两格均领先，且每个 masked 格子的模型间差距都拉大。审计还发现 v1/v2 评分缺陷：带变音符号的答案被判错，捷克判决形式准确率被低估最多 90 个百分点。
Conclusion: 模型间相当一部分表面持平由标签泄漏本身造成，因此登记册来源的基准必须逐格报告 no-model 基线与 masked control，否则排名不可解读。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: Multi-Legal-Bench 指出从法院登记册自动生成的法律基准存在标签泄漏：不调用任何模型的关键词扫描在荷兰判决形式分类上就达 96%（多数类基线 50%），法国法院类型 84%（基线 33%），波兰判决形式 66%，九个模型最多只比它高 7 个百分点。把输入中的标签名替换为 mask 后，扫描在全部六个受影响格子跌回多数类水平，39/54 个模型-格子对显著掉分，最大跌幅 48 个百分点（荷兰判决形式 100%→52%），仅 Claude Sonnet 5 基本不受影响。作者建议所有登记册来源的基准逐格报告 no-model 基线与 masked control。
summary_sections.motivation: 法院登记册自带法院类型、判决形式、案由等结构化元数据，让构建带标签法律基准几乎零成本，但这种便利的代价——标签名直接泄漏进输入——在既有基准中很少被量化，导致模型间表面持平可能由泄漏制造。
summary_sections.method: 构建 Multi-Legal-Bench，在法国、荷兰、波兰、捷克、立陶宛五个国家登记册的原生判决上评测同一组任务，扩展乌克兰 UA-Legal-Bench；对每个格子做不使用模型的关键词扫描审计，并加入把输入中标签名替换为 mask 的对照，在九个模型上运行，用配对 McNemar 检验加 Holm 校正比较模型。
summary_sections.result: 无模型关键词扫描：荷兰判决形式 96%（多数类基线 50%）、法国法院类型 84%（基线 33%）、波兰判决形式 66%，九个模型在波兰上最多比扫描高 7 个百分点。mask 对照使扫描在全部六个受影响格子回落到多数类水平；39/54 个模型-格子对在多数受影响格子显著掉分，最大降幅 48 个百分点（荷兰判决形式 100%→52%），仅 Claude Sonnet 5 基本不受影响。McNemar+Holm 显示 12 个格子中仅 2 个存在击败其余全部模型的领先者且各不相同；mask 后同一模型在两格均领先，且每个 masked 格子的模型间差距都拉大。审计还发现 v1/v2 评分缺陷：带变音符号的答案被判错，捷克判决形式准确率被低估最多 90 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 模型间相当一部分表面持平由标签泄漏本身造成，因此登记册来源的基准必须逐格报告 no-model 基线与 masked control，否则排名不可解读。

papers.title: Nonstationary Generalized Linear Bandits with Discounted Online Mirror Descent
papers.abstract_en: We study nonstationary generalized linear bandits (GLBs), where the expected reward is modeled through a nonlinear link function with an unknown time-varying parameter. This framework encompasses a broad class of reward models, including linear, Bernoulli, and binomial rewards. Existing approaches are predominantly based on maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE), using sliding-window, restart, or discounting mechanisms to handle nonstationarity. Although these methods achieve statistically efficient regret guarantees, they generally require revisiting past observations at every round, which leads to computation and memory costs that grow with time; moreover, several of them rely on a non-convex projection step. In this paper, we propose DOMD-GLB, a new algorithm for nonstationary GLBs that utilizes discounted online mirror descent (DOMD) for parameter estimation, thereby incurring only $O(1)$ computation and memory costs per round. We prove dynamic regret bounds of order $\tilde{O} \big(c_μ^{-1/2} d^{3/4} P_T^{1/4} T^{3/4}\big)$ in drifting environments and $\tilde{O}\big(c_μ^{-1/3} d^{2/3} Γ_T^{1/3} T^{2/3}\big) $in piecewise-stationary environments, where $d$ denotes the feature dimension, $T$ the time horizon, $P_T$ the path length, $Γ_T$ the number of change points, and $c_μ$ a curvature parameter associated with the link function, while substantially improving computational efficiency over prior work. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm for nonstationary GLBs with per-round computation and memory costs independent of time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DOMD-GLB：用折扣在线镜像下降 (discounted online mirror descent) 估计非平稳广义线性 bandit 的时变参数，每轮计算与内存开销为 O(1)、与时间无关。证明漂移环境动态 regret 为 Õ(c_μ^{-1/2} d^{3/4} P_T^{1/4} T^{3/4})，分段平稳环境为 Õ(c_μ^{-1/3} d^{2/3} Γ_T^{1/3} T^{2/3})，是首个每轮开销与时间无关的非平稳 GLB 算法。
Motivation: 现有非平稳 GLB 方法基于 MLE 加滑窗、重启或折扣机制，统计上高效但每轮都要重访历史观测，计算与内存随时间增长，且部分依赖非凸投影步骤。
Method: 以 DOMD 取代 MLE 做参数估计，覆盖线性、Bernoulli、binomial 等奖励模型；用折扣处理时变参数，并对漂移与分段平稳两类环境分别推导动态 regret 界，涉及路径长度 P_T、变点数 Γ_T、特征维度 d 与链路函数曲率 c_μ。
Result: 漂移环境动态 regret Õ(c_μ^{-1/2} d^{3/4} P_T^{1/4} T^{3/4})，分段平稳环境 Õ(c_μ^{-1/3} d^{2/3} Γ_T^{1/3} T^{2/3})；每轮计算与内存 O(1)、与时间 T 无关，同时相对既有工作显著提升计算效率。
Conclusion: 非平稳 GLB 可以在保持统计效率量级 regret 的同时摆脱随时间增长的重访开销，且无需非凸投影；这是首个每轮开销与时间无关的非平稳 GLB 算法。

papers.title: DRIVESPATIAL: A Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Intelligence in VLMs for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Spatiotemporal intelligence in autonomous driving (AD) requires an agent to integrate multi-view observations into a coherent scene representation, maintain object continuity across viewpoints and time, and reason about spatial relations, interactions, and future dynamics. However, existing AD vision-language benchmarks largely focus on single-view, static, ego-centric, or single-source question answering, leaving it unclear whether current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can truly construct and reason over dynamic driving scenes. We introduce DriveSpatial, a benchmark of 15.6K human-verified QA pairs across 20 tasks from five large-scale AD datasets. DriveSpatial evaluates four abilities: Cognitive Scene Construction, Multi-view Relational Understanding, Temporal Reasoning, and Generalization. Unlike prior benchmarks, DriveSpatial is generated from a dynamic multi-relational scene graph that encodes object states, spatial relations, interactions, camera visibility, and temporal correspondences, enabling QA pairs that enforce genuine cross-view and spatiotemporal reasoning. Evaluating 15 representative VLMs reveals a substantial human-model gap: the strongest model trails humans by 28.4 points, with Cognitive Scene Construction emerging as the key bottleneck. Further diagnostics show that language-only prompting is insufficient, while explicit BEV grounding consistently improves performance. These results suggest that current VLMs lack the scene-construction ability needed for reliable spatiotemporal driving intelligence. DriveSpatial and its construction pipeline will be released to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriveSpatial 是面向自动驾驶视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的时空智能基准，含 15.6K 条人工核验 QA、20 个任务、来自五个大规模 AD 数据集，题目由动态多关系场景图生成以强制跨视角与时间推理。评测 15 个代表性 VLM 显示最强模型落后人类 28.4 分，瓶颈在认知场景构建；纯语言提示不足，显式 BEV grounding 能稳定提升表现。
Motivation: 现有 AD 视觉-语言基准集中在单视角、静态、以自车为中心或单源问答，无法判断 VLM 是否真能构建并推理动态驾驶场景。
Method: 从编码物体状态、空间关系、交互、相机可见性与时间对应的动态多关系场景图生成 QA，覆盖四大能力：认知场景构建、多视角关系理解、时间推理与泛化；在 20 个任务上评测 15 个代表性 VLM，并做语言提示与 BEV grounding 的对照诊断。
Result: 基准含 15.6K 条人工核验 QA、20 个任务、五个大规模 AD 数据集；15 个 VLM 中最强模型比人类低 28.4 分，认知场景构建是关键瓶颈；诊断显示纯语言提示不足，显式 BEV grounding 一致提升表现。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 缺乏可靠时空驾驶智能所需的场景构建能力，而把观测显式落到 BEV 表征是有效的改进方向；DriveSpatial 与其构建管线将开源。

papers.title: EntmaxKV: Support-Aware Decoding for Entmax Attention
papers.abstract_en: Long-context decoding is increasingly limited by KV-cache memory traffic as each generated token attends over a cache whose size grows linearly with context length. Existing sparse decoding methods reduce this cost by selecting subsets of tokens or pages, but are designed for softmax attention, whose dense tails make any truncation discard nonzero probability mass. In contrast, $α$-entmax produces exact zeros, turning sparse decoding from dense-tail approximation into support recovery: if the selected candidates contain the entmax support, sparse decoding remains exact. While recent entmax kernels enable efficient training, they do not address the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, where dense inference still streams the full KV cache before sparsity is known. In this work, we introduce EntmaxKV, an entmax-native sparse decoding framework that exploits sparsity before KV pages are loaded. EntmaxKV combines query-aware page scoring, support-aware candidate selection, and sparse entmax attention. We analyze truncation error through the dropped probability mass $δ$, showing that output error is controlled by $δ$ and vanishes when the entmax support is recovered. We further introduce a Gaussian-aware entmax selector that estimates the entmax threshold from lightweight page statistics, adapting the selected budget to the score distribution. Empirically, EntmaxKV drops less probability mass, retains more support tokens, and achieves lower output error than softmax-based sparse decoding at matched KV budgets. On long-context and language modeling benchmarks, it closely matches full-cache entmax while using a small fraction of the KV cache, achieving up to $2.88\times$ (softmax) and $5.5\times$ (entmax) speedup over full attention baselines as well as over $2\times$ speedup over softmax and entmax top-k at 1M context length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EntmaxKV 把 α-entmax 的精确零值用于长上下文解码的 KV cache 稀疏化：在加载 KV 页之前就用 query-aware 页打分与 support-aware 候选选择恢复 entmax support，使稀疏解码保持精确。在长上下文与语言建模基准上，1M 上下文相对 full attention 达到最高 2.88×（softmax）与 5.5×（entmax）加速，相对 softmax 与 entmax top-k 也有 2× 以上加速。
Motivation: 长上下文解码的瓶颈是 KV-cache 内存流量随上下文线性增长；现有稀疏解码为 softmax 设计，其稠密尾部使任何截断都会丢掉非零概率质量，而 entmax kernel 只解决训练、不解决自回归解码中必须先流式读完整 cache 才知道稀疏性的瓶颈。
Method: EntmaxKV 是 entmax 原生的稀疏解码框架，由 query-aware 页打分、support-aware 候选选择与 sparse entmax attention 三部分组成，在 KV 页加载前利用稀疏性；另提出 Gaussian-aware entmax selector，从轻量页统计量估计 entmax 阈值，使选择预算随分数分布自适应。
Result: 以被丢弃概率质量 δ 刻画截断误差，证明输出误差由 δ 控制且在 entmax support 被恢复时消失；在匹配 KV 预算下，比 softmax 稀疏解码丢弃更少概率质量、保留更多 support token、输出误差更低。在长上下文与语言建模基准上以极小比例的 KV cache 接近 full-cache entmax，最高 2.88×（softmax）与 5.5×（entmax）相对 full attention 加速，1M 上下文下相对 softmax 与 entmax top-k 加速超过 2×。
Conclusion: 利用 entmax 的精确零值可把稀疏解码从稠密尾部近似问题变成 support 恢复问题，在加载 KV 页之前先判定稀疏性即可在很小的 cache 预算下保持接近全 cache 的输出并大幅提速。
