papers.title: Preserve, Reveal, Expand: Towards Faithful 4D Video Editing with Region-Aware Conditioning and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: While 4D-driven video diffusion models can generate visually plausible videos, faithful 4D editing poses a stricter requirement: source-observed content should be preserved, while disoccluded and out-of-view regions must be synthesized naturally. We identify a key failure mode in existing methods, which we term Evidence-Role Mismatch: source-backed observations, uncertain rendered cues, and unsupported regions are entangled within a single conditioning signal, which can lead to preservation drift, ghosting, and unstable extrapolation. To mitigate this issue, we propose PREX (Preserve, Reveal, Expand), a region-aware framework that decomposes the target spatiotemporal volume into three distinct roles based on observation support and scene extent. PREX traces edited 4D points back to source frames and retrieves observed colors and pairs these appearance cues with geometry-aware confidence and region roles, and injects them into a frozen video diffusion backbone through an adapter trained with self-supervised proxy editing tasks. We further introduce PREBench, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed for 4D video editing, to expose and quantify such region-specific failures. PREBench separately evaluates Preserve fidelity, Reveal quality, and Expand plausibility of videos generated by 4D driven video diffusion models. Experiments show that PREX substantially reduces region-specific failure modes while maintaining strong visual quality and 4D edit control compared with existing 4D-based video diffusion methods. Code will be publicly released. Project Page: https://ricepastem.github.io/PREX-Open
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PREX 把 4D 视频编辑中的目标时空体按观测支撑拆成 Preserve、Reveal、Expand 三种区域角色，将编辑后的 4D 点回溯到源帧取回观测颜色，配几何感知置信度与区域角色注入冻结的视频扩散骨干，并用自监督代理编辑任务训练 adapter。配套提出 PREBench 分别度量三类区域失败，实验显示区域特定失败显著减少，同时保持视觉质量与 4D 编辑控制。
Motivation: 4D 驱动的视频扩散能生成视觉合理的视频，但忠实编辑要求更严：源观测内容要保留，被遮挡与视野外区域要自然合成。现有方法把源支撑观测、不确定渲染线索和无支撑区域纠缠在单一条件信号里，造成 preservation drift、ghosting 与不稳定外推。
Method: PREX 按观测支撑与场景范围把目标时空体分解为三种区域角色；将编辑 4D 点回溯到源帧检索观测颜色，与几何感知置信度和区域角色配对后，经 adapter 注入冻结的视频扩散骨干，adapter 用自监督代理编辑任务训练。另提出诊断基准 PREBench。
Result: 实验表明 PREX 相比已有 4D 视频扩散方法显著减少区域特定失败模式，同时保持强视觉质量与 4D 编辑控制；PREBench 分别评估 Preserve 保真度、Reveal 质量与 Expand 合理性。
Conclusion: 把条件信号按区域角色拆开并回溯源帧证据，是缓解 4D 视频编辑中证据-角色错配 (Evidence-Role Mismatch) 的有效路径；代码将公开发布。

summary_sections.method: PREX 按观测支撑与场景范围把目标时空体分解为三种区域角色；将编辑 4D 点回溯到源帧检索观测颜色，与几何感知置信度和区域角色配对后，经 adapter 注入冻结的视频扩散骨干，adapter 用自监督代理编辑任务训练。另提出诊断基准 PREBench。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明 PREX 相比已有 4D 视频扩散方法显著减少区域特定失败模式，同时保持强视觉质量与 4D 编辑控制；PREBench 分别评估 Preserve 保真度、Reveal 质量与 Expand 合理性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把条件信号按区域角色拆开并回溯源帧证据，是缓解 4D 视频编辑中证据-角色错配 (Evidence-Role Mismatch) 的有效路径；代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Learning Robust Recommenders from Noisy Implicit Feedback via GMM-Weighted Bayesian Transition Matrix
papers.abstract_en: Label noise is a central challenge in learning from implicit feedback for recommendation. Conventional approaches discard noisy examples for robustness, but this sacrifices data efficiency. Unlike filtering approaches, Bayes-label transition matrix (BLTM) based methods keep all data, but their transition matrix estimates are skewed in practice. To reduce this skew, we introduce GMM-weighted Bayes-label Transition Matrix (RGBT), which augments BLTM with GMM-based instance weights. A GMM assigns each instance a reliability score, and these scores calibrate the BLTM to reduce bias. We show theoretically that RGBT retains all samples, yields consistent estimates, and provably reduces variance compared to CLTM, generalizing to any method with deterministic labels and non-negative weights. Experiments on real and synthetic datasets show that RGBT handles noisy samples more effectively than sample-selection methods, and calibrates the transition matrix more accurately than existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐系统隐式反馈含标签噪声时，RGBT 用 GMM 给每个样本打可靠性权重并据此校准 Bayes-label transition matrix (BLTM)，保留全部样本而不做过滤。理论上对确定性标签与非负权重的方法一致估计且相对 CLTM 降低方差，实验中比样本选择法更有效、比既有方法更准地校准转移矩阵。
Motivation: 隐式反馈的标签噪声是推荐学习的核心难题：常规过滤法丢弃噪声样本牺牲数据效率，而保留全部数据的 BLTM 类方法其转移矩阵估计在实践中存在偏斜。
Method: 提出 GMM-weighted Bayes-label Transition Matrix (RGBT)：用高斯混合模型 (GMM) 为每个实例给出可靠性分数，以这些分数校准 BLTM 以减小偏差；理论分析覆盖任何使用确定性标签与非负权重的方法。
Result: 理论证明 RGBT 保留全部样本、给出一致估计，并相对 CLTM 可证明地降低方差；在真实与合成数据集上，RGBT 处理噪声样本优于样本选择方法，且比既有方法更准确地校准转移矩阵。
Conclusion: 用 GMM 实例权重校准转移矩阵，可以在不丢弃数据的前提下同时改善噪声鲁棒性与转移矩阵估计精度，且该结论可推广到确定性标签加非负权重的一类方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalized Functional ANOVA: A Complete Theoretical Framework
papers.abstract_en: The functional ANOVA provides a fundamental representation of square-integrable multivariate functions into main effects and higher-order interactions. For independent inputs, the components belong to mutually orthogonal Hilbert subspaces and admit an explicit representation. For dependent inputs, however, the components are only hierarchically orthogonal: although existence and uniqueness results are available, the Hilbert subspaces underlying the generalized decomposition have remained implicit. We resolve this representation problem for continuous inputs supported on a bounded hyperrectangle whose joint density is bounded above and away from zero. We introduce a distribution-adapted family of functions and prove that it forms a Riesz basis of the $L^2$ space, thereby guaranteeing a unique, stable, and unconditionally convergent representation. We then show that, for every coalition of variables, the corresponding block of this basis exactly characterizes the Hilbert subspace containing the functional ANOVA component. Our construction recovers the classical orthogonal decomposition under input independence. As a direct consequence, computing the generalized functional ANOVA reduces to estimating coefficients in an explicit, distribution-adapted basis. Finally, as a \emph{proof of concept}, we introduce an elementary, fast and model-agnostic estimator based on our theoretical results. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets illustrate its connections with established tabular explanation methods and show that low order components often capture most of the signal in the model output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在输入相关时，广义函数型 ANOVA 的各分量子空间只满足分层正交、底层 Hilbert 子空间一直隐式存在。本文在有界超矩形上、联合密度有上下界的连续输入条件下，构造分布自适应函数族并证明其构成 L² 的 Riesz 基，从而给出唯一、稳定且无条件收敛的显式分解，且每个变量联盟对应的基块恰好刻画该分量所在子空间；据此给出一个快速、模型无关的估计器，在合成与真实数据上显示低阶分量常捕获模型输出的大部分信号。
Motivation: 输入独立时函数型 ANOVA 分量落在互相正交的 Hilbert 子空间并有显式表示；输入相关时只剩分层正交，存在性与唯一性已有结果，但支撑这些分量的 Hilbert 子空间始终是隐式的，使广义分解难以显式计算。
Method: 在有界超矩形上、联合密度有上界且远离零的连续输入条件下，引入一族分布自适应函数，证明其构成 L² 空间的 Riesz 基；再证明对每个变量联盟，该基的对应块恰好刻画含该 ANOVA 分量的 Hilbert 子空间，输入独立时退化为经典正交分解。作为 proof of concept，给出一个基于该理论的快速、模型无关估计器。
Result: Riesz 基保证表示唯一、稳定且无条件收敛；每个变量联盟的基块精确刻画对应分量所在 Hilbert 子空间；在合成与真实数据集上，估计器与既有表格型解释方法建立联系，且低阶分量常捕获模型输出的大部分信号。
Conclusion: 把广义函数型 ANOVA 的计算化归为在一个显式、分布自适应基下估计系数，相关输入下的隐式子空间问题因此可解；低阶分量通常已承载输出的大部分信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Square Roots: A Memory-Efficient Explicit Factorization for Multi-Epoch Private Learning
papers.abstract_en: Correlated-noise mechanisms are among the most promising approaches for improving the utility of differentially private model training, but rigorous guarantees require explicit, analyzable factorizations, and practical deployment requires memory efficiency. Recent works have developed banded inverse factorizations, which address both requirements by exploiting a banded structure in the correlation matrix. The bandwidth controls the size of the noise buffer used to correlate noise across iterations, and thus governs the tradeoff between utility and memory cost. At the two ends of this tradeoff, DP-$λ$CGD achieves high memory efficiency by using only a one-step noise buffer, but this limits its utility gains, while the banded inverse square root (BISR) factorization exploits larger correlation windows and is asymptotically optimal for large bandwidths but performs poorly at low bandwidths. To bridge this gap, we introduce $γ$-BIFR, a unified generalization of both factorizations. In the low-memory, low-bandwidth regime, $γ$-BIFR improves RMSE, amplified RMSE, and private training performance, while yielding tighter theoretical guarantees for multi-participation error in multi-epoch training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 γ-BIFR，把 DP-λCGD 的一步噪声缓冲与 banded inverse square root (BISR) 统一为一个带参数 γ 的显式分解，在低内存、低带宽区间同时改善 RMSE、amplified RMSE 与私有训练性能，并给出更紧的多轮训练多参与误差理论保证。
Motivation: 相关噪声机制需要显式可分析的分解与内存效率，而带宽决定噪声缓冲大小与效用-内存权衡：DP-λCGD 内存省但效用增益受限，BISR 大带宽渐近最优却在低带宽表现差。
Method: 利用相关矩阵的带状结构做 banded inverse 分解，以带宽控制跨迭代噪声缓冲；γ-BIFR 作为 DP-λCGD 与 BISR 的统一推广，给出显式、可分析的分解并推导多轮多参与误差的理论保证。
Result: 在低内存、低带宽区间，γ-BIFR 改善 RMSE、amplified RMSE 与私有训练性能，并给出更紧的 multi-participation error 理论保证。
Conclusion: 带 γ 的统一分解可同时覆盖一步缓冲与大带宽渐近最优两端，低带宽下效用与内存不再二选一。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SRC-Flow: Compact Semantic Representations Enable Normalizing Flows for Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Normalizing flows (NFs) provide exact likelihoods and deterministic invertible sampling, but have historically lagged behind diffusion models for large-scale image generation. We identify a key obstacle: NFs are required to learn a single invertible transport over the full ambient space, making them highly sensitive to high-dimensional representations. This leads to a semantic-capacity mismatch in modern visual representation spaces, where semantic information is compact but encoded in overcomplete features. We propose SRC-Flow, which introduces a Semantic Representation Compressor (SRC) to compact high-dimensional RAE features into a low-dimensional semantic space before flow modeling and preserve reconstruction through the frozen RAE decoder. This compact space reduces the modeling burden of NFs and enables effective likelihood-based generation in semantic representation space. We further adopt constant noise regularization tailored to the fixed unconditional bijection learned by flows. On ImageNet 256x256 and 512x512, SRC-Flow achieves state-of-the-art generation quality among normalizing flow methods, with gFID scores of 1.65 and 2.07 under classifier-free guidance, while retaining exact likelihood computation in the compact semantic representation space and deterministic invertible sampling at the flow level. Codes and models will be released in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRC-Flow 用语义表示压缩器 (Semantic Representation Compressor) 把高维 RAE 特征压到低维语义空间再做 normalizing flow，并配合针对固定无条件双射的常数噪声正则。在 ImageNet 256x256 与 512x512 上，classifier-free guidance 下 gFID 分别达到 1.65 与 2.07，为 normalizing flow 方法中的最先进生成质量，同时保留精确似然计算与 flow 层面的确定性可逆采样。
Motivation: NF 必须在整个环境空间上学一个单一可逆传输，对高维表示极敏感；现代视觉表示空间语义信息紧凑却编码在过完备特征中，造成语义容量不匹配，使 NF 长期落后于扩散模型。
Method: 先用 SRC 将高维 RAE 特征压缩到低维语义空间，再在该空间上建 flow，重建由冻结的 RAE decoder 保证；另加入为 flow 学到的固定无条件双射定制的常数噪声正则 (constant noise regularization)。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 与 512x512 上，classifier-free guidance 下 gFID 分别为 1.65 与 2.07，在 normalizing flow 方法中达到最先进生成质量，并保留紧凑语义空间中的精确似然计算与确定性可逆采样。
Conclusion: 把 NF 的建模负担从过完备高维特征移到紧凑语义空间，是让 likelihood-based 生成在视觉表示空间中有效的关键；代码与模型将在未来发布。

papers.title: Wasserstein Saddle-Free Newton: Saddle Escape and Local Spectral Convergence
papers.abstract_en: Extending saddle-free Newton methods to Wasserstein space requires controlling Hessian dependent operators along nonlinear transport trajectories and accounting for a Hessian spectrum that may accumulate at zero. We address these challenges through Wasserstein Saddle-Free Newton (WSFN), a second-order method for nonconvex optimization over Wasserstein space that preconditions the Wasserstein gradient by a regularized inverse square root Hessian operator. The dynamics exploit curvature magnitude while maintaining negative curvature repulsion and positive curvature attraction, avoiding key Wasserstein Newton limitations. Whereas previous Wasserstein saddle escape results rely on perturbed first-order dynamics, WSFN uses curvature both to modify the deterministic transport and to construct the perturbation mechanism. Our analysis combines stability estimates for Hessian operators with a perturbative saddle escape argument to establish polynomial time convergence to approximate second-order stationarity under regularity of landscape assumptions. The contribution of the saddle curvature parameter $δ$ improves from $\tilde O(δ^{-4})$ for prior perturbed first-order Wasserstein methods to $\tilde O(δ^{-3})$. For benign landscapes, this implies proximity to global minimizers. The cubic dependence corresponds to the scale of the objective decrease that can be guaranteed from negative curvature under Lipschitz Hessian regularity. Near a minimizer, the possible absence of a uniform spectral gap prevents a uniform contraction result and instead calls for a spectral characterization. We prove geometric contraction of the linearized dynamics on positive curvature spectral bands bounded away from zero and polynomial decay under spectral source conditions. Together, these results connect quantitative saddle escape with the local spectral behavior of second-order Wasserstein dynamics.
papers.comment: Major revision: corrected and refined main theoretical results, leading to updates in the title, abstract, and core contributions. Restructured the main body and added new experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Wasserstein Saddle-Free Newton (WSFN)，用正则化逆平方根 Hessian 算子预条件 Wasserstein 梯度，在保留负曲率排斥、正曲率吸引的同时把确定性传输与扰动机制都建立在曲率上。鞍点逃逸的曲率参数依赖从既有扰动一阶方法的 Õ(δ⁻⁴) 改进到 Õ(δ⁻³)，并在正曲率谱带（远离零）上证明线性化动力学的几何收缩。
Motivation: 把 saddle-free Newton 推广到 Wasserstein 空间要沿非线性传输轨迹控制 Hessian 相关算子，且 Hessian 谱可能在零点堆积；既有 Wasserstein 鞍点逃逸结果依赖扰动一阶动力学，曲率利用不足。
Method: WSFN 是 Wasserstein 空间上非凸优化的二阶方法：以正则化逆平方根 Hessian 算子预条件 Wasserstein 梯度，用曲率同时改写确定性传输并构造扰动；分析结合 Hessian 算子的稳定性估计与微扰式鞍点逃逸论证，在景观正则性假设下给出多项式时间收敛到近似二阶驻点。
Result: 鞍点曲率参数贡献由既有扰动一阶 Wasserstein 方法的 Õ(δ⁻⁴) 改进到 Õ(δ⁻³)；该三次依赖对应 Lipschitz Hessian 正则下负曲率可保证的目标下降尺度。在良性景观下结论蕴含接近全局极小点；在远离零的正曲率谱带上证明线性化动力学几何收缩，在谱源条件下证明多项式衰减。
Conclusion: 曲率信息可以同时用于逃逸鞍点与刻画局部谱行为，把定量鞍点逃逸与二阶 Wasserstein 动力学的局部谱性质连起来；但极小点附近若无一致谱隙，只能给出谱刻画而非一致收缩。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: DCFold: Efficient Protein Structure Generation with Single Forward Pass
papers.abstract_en: AlphaFold3 introduces a diffusion-based architecture that elevates protein structure prediction to all-atom resolution with improved accuracy. This state-of-the-art performance has established AlphaFold3 as a foundation model for diverse generation and design tasks. However, its iterative design substantially increases inference time, limiting practical deployment in downstream settings such as virtual screening and protein design. We propose DCFold, a single-step generative model that attains AlphaFold3-level accuracy. Our Dual Consistency training framework, which incorporates a novel Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) scheduler, enables DCFold to achieve a 15x acceleration in inference while maintaining predictive fidelity. We validate its effectiveness across both structure prediction and binder design benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DCFold 用单次前向的生成模型替代 AlphaFold3 的迭代扩散采样，在 Dual Consistency 训练框架与 Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) 调度器配合下达到 AlphaFold3 级精度，推理加速 15 倍，并在结构预测与 binder 设计两类基准上验证有效。
Motivation: AlphaFold3 的迭代式扩散设计显著拉长推理时间，制约虚拟筛选、蛋白质设计等需要大量采样的下游部署。
Method: 提出单步生成模型 DCFold，配 Dual Consistency 训练框架与新提出的 Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) 调度器，目标是在一次前向中达到 AlphaFold3 级全原子预测精度。
Result: 推理加速 15 倍且保持预测精度（AlphaFold3-level accuracy）；在结构预测与 binder 设计基准上均验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 迭代扩散并非达到 AlphaFold3 精度的必要条件，单步生成加一致性训练即可在保持精度的同时把推理成本降一个量级，适合虚拟筛选与蛋白设计这类高频调用场景。

papers.title: SafeLens: Deliberate and Efficient Video Guardrails with Fast-and-Slow Screening
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of online video platforms and AI-generated content has made reliable video guardrails a key challenge for safety and real-world deployment. While most videos can be screened through fast pattern recognition, a small subset requires deeper reasoning over temporally complex content and nuanced policy constraints. Existing approaches typically rely on large vision-language models applied uniformly across all inputs, resulting in high inference costs and inefficient allocation of computation. We propose SafeLens, a video guardrail framework that introduces a fast-and-slow inference architecture for efficient and accurate content moderation with variable computational cost across inputs. Additionally, we construct a high-quality dataset by applying influence-guided filtering to the SafeWatch Dataset, retaining only 2.4% of the original data. To further address limitations of training-time scaling, we enable test-time reasoning by augmenting the filtered data with structured Chain-of-Thought traces. Across real-world and AI-generated video benchmarks, SafeLens achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong open-source video guardrails (e.g., SafeWatch-8B, OmniGuard-7B) and closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.1-pro) while significantly reducing inference cost, demonstrating that efficient design serves to be more effective than scaling data or model size alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeLens 用快慢两级推理做视频内容审核：多数视频走快速模式识别，只有时序复杂、政策约束微妙的少数样本才交给慢速深推理，从而按输入分配算力。它对 SafeWatch 数据集做 influence-guided filtering 只保留 2.4% 数据，再加结构化 Chain-of-Thought 轨迹启用测试时推理，在真实与 AI 生成视频基准上超过 SafeWatch-8B、OmniGuard-7B、GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1-pro，同时显著降低推理成本。
Motivation: 现有视频护栏对所有输入一律套用大型视觉-语言模型，推理成本高、算力分配低效；而绝大多数视频靠快速模式识别即可，只有小部分需要深推理。
Method: 提出 fast-and-slow 推理架构，按输入分配可变计算量；用 influence-guided filtering 从 SafeWatch Dataset 构造高质量子集（保留原数据的 2.4%），并以结构化 Chain-of-Thought 轨迹增强该过滤数据以启用 test-time reasoning。
Result: 在真实世界与 AI 生成视频基准上达到 state-of-the-art，胜过开源视频护栏 SafeWatch-8B、OmniGuard-7B 与闭源模型 GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1-pro，同时显著降低推理成本；过滤后数据仅占 SafeWatch 原始数据的 2.4%。
Conclusion: 高效的设计比单纯扩大数据或模型规模更有效：把算力按难易分流并配合测试时推理，能在降成本的同时提升视频审核效果。

papers.title: Fidelity Probes for Specification--Code Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Software modernization often relies on natural-language specifications recovered from an existing implementation. Incorrect or missing requirements can lead to defects in the modernized system. We introduce fidelity probes to check a specification against the code and guide its revision. Each probe pairs a question about program behaviour with a reference answer derived from the code. A language model answers the question using only the specification, and the fraction of agreeing answers defines fidelity. Disagreements flag conflicting claims or missing information and guide proposed corrections and additions to the requirements. An LLM generates probes directly from code or phrases facts selected through control-flow, data-flow, and call-graph analysis. We use an observability rule to focus probe questions on behaviour that the modernized system is intended to preserve, including user-visible outputs, changes to stored business data, and interactions with other systems. We revise the specification using fresh probes and evaluate each version on a fixed held-out set. A repair-regression model describes how new failures can offset the gains from repairs. On CardDemo, held-out fidelity improves from 0.59 to 0.89, exceeding free-form revision from source code. We also evaluate the method on industrial systems and public documentation, and assess probe quality and reported defects through human reviews and comparison with an independent requirements audit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 fidelity probes：从代码生成「问题+参考答案」探针，让 LLM 只读规格作答，一致率即 fidelity，分歧直接定位规格与代码冲突或缺失并驱动修订。在 CardDemo 上 held-out fidelity 从 0.59 提到 0.89，超过从源代码自由改写的基线。
Motivation: 软件现代化依赖从既有实现反推的自然语言规格，规格中错误或缺失的需求会让改造后的系统产生缺陷，而人工核对规格与代码一致性成本高。
Method: 每个 probe 配对一个程序行为问题与由代码导出的参考答案；LLM 直接从代码生成探针，或对控制流、数据流、调用图分析选出的事实措辞成题；用 observability rule 把问题限定在改造后需保留的行为（用户可见输出、业务数据变更、与外部系统交互）。修订后用新探针重测，并在固定 held-out 集上评估每个版本，另有 repair-regression 模型刻画新失败如何抵消修复收益。
Result: CardDemo 上 held-out fidelity 由 0.59 升至 0.89，超过 free-form revision from source code；另在工业系统与公开文档上评测，并通过人工评审及与独立需求审计的比对评估探针质量与所报缺陷。
Conclusion: 以代码为真值、按可观测行为出题的探针可以把规格-代码对齐度变成可度量、可迭代优化的量，修订效果须在固定 held-out 探针集上核验以防修复回归。

papers.title: Uncertainty-aware neural emulation reveals climate-resilient maize traits at scale
papers.abstract_en: Global food security depends on predicting crop responses to climate variability, yet process based crop models remain too computationally expensive for large scale exploration of genotype and environment interactions. Here we develop a probabilistic neural emulator of APSIM that reproduces key maize growth processes across 13 outputs with high fidelity (with R^2 of 0.93) while reducing simulation time by several orders of magnitude. Trained on two million simulations spanning diverse genetic, soil, and management conditions, and augmented with a convolutional synthetic weather generator that produces physically consistent climate sequences, the framework enables scalable exploration of crop responses under realistic and diverse environmental inputs while providing calibrated predictive uncertainty without costly Bayesian inference. Applying this framework across 100,000 trait configurations, six soil environments in Iowa and Illinois, and climate projections through the year 2100 under two emissions scenarios, we identify 181 maize trait combinations that consistently maintain high yield across all tested conditionsan analysis infeasible with the mechanistic model alone. We further show that radiation use efficiency and temperature driven root dynamics are dominant drivers of yield resilience. Notably, projected yield distributions vary substantially across locations, with some lower productivity sites exhibiting yield increases under future climate scenarios, indicating that climate change may reshape regional yield potential in nonintuitive ways. These results demonstrate how uncertainty aware emulation transforms mechanistic crop simulation from a computational bottleneck into an on demand discovery engine, one capable of interrogating the full genotype, environment and management space at a scale no process-based model can match.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 APSIM 的概率神经模拟器 (neural emulator)，在 13 个输出上 R² 达 0.93，仿真时间降低数个数量级，并配卷积式合成天气生成器提供校准的预测不确定性。在 10 万组性状配置、爱荷华与伊利诺伊 6 种土壤、至 2100 年两种排放情景下筛出 181 个跨全部条件保持高产的玉米性状组合，辐射利用效率与温度驱动的根系动态是产量韧性的主导因子。
Motivation: 机理作物模型计算成本过高，无法在大尺度上遍历基因型×环境×管理 (G×E×M) 组合，限制了气候变异下作物响应的探索。
Method: 用 200 万次覆盖多样基因、土壤与管理条件的 APSIM 仿真训练概率神经模拟器，输出 13 个关键玉米生长过程量并给出校准的预测不确定性（无需昂贵的 Bayesian 推断）；另加一个卷积式合成天气生成器，产生物理一致的气候序列作为环境输入。
Result: 13 个输出上 R² = 0.93，仿真时间降低数个数量级；在 100,000 个性状配置、6 种土壤环境、至 2100 年两种排放情景下识别出 181 个在所有测试条件下持续高产的玉米性状组合；辐射利用效率与温度驱动的根系动态为主导产量韧性因子；投影产量分布在地点间差异显著，部分低产站点在未来情景下产量反而上升。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知的模拟器可把机理作物仿真从计算瓶颈变为按需发现引擎，其探索规模是机理模型本身无法达到的，且气候变化可能以非直观方式重塑区域产量潜力。

papers.title: To MRL or not to MRL: Text Embeddings are Robust to Truncation Without Matryoshka Learning, Except In Heavy Truncation Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is a widely adopted approach for training text encoders so they provide useful text representations at various sizes, available by simply truncating the resulting vectors at sizes pre-determined at training time. Recent works have shown that randomly truncating text embeddings has minimal impact in downstream performance unless vectors are reduced in size by at least 70%, suggesting that embeddings are already robust to truncation without the use of MRL. However, no prior work has compared random truncation to MRL, so it is unclear how the two methods compare as effective embedding reduction methods. In this paper, we study this by applying the same truncation used by MRL to models trained with and without MRL. Our results across several models and downstream tasks show that, unless heavily truncating embeddings (i.e. reducing their size by at least 80%), truncated embeddings of non-MRL models are competitive with, and often outperform models trained with MRL. This suggests that truncation robustness may not necessarily come from MRL, and that the choice of spending the additional training cost of MRL depends on whether heavy truncation is desired. We make our code available for reproduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在相同截断方式下对比有无 Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) 训练的文本编码器，发现除非把向量维度削减至少 80%，未用 MRL 的模型截断后与 MRL 模型相当甚至更常胜出，说明截断鲁棒性未必来自 MRL，是否付出 MRL 的额外训练成本取决于是否需要重度截断。
Motivation: 已有工作表明随机截断文本嵌入在维度削减不足 70% 时对下游性能影响很小，暗示不加 MRL 也已具备截断鲁棒性，但此前没有工作把随机截断与 MRL 直接对比，两者作为嵌入降维手段孰优孰劣并不清楚。
Method: 把 MRL 训练时使用的同一套截断方式，分别施加到用 MRL 训练和未用 MRL 训练的模型上，在多个模型与多个下游任务上做对照比较。
Result: 跨多个模型与下游任务，只要不把嵌入维度削减至少 80%，非 MRL 模型的截断嵌入与 MRL 模型相当，且往往更优；此前工作显示削减不足 70% 时随机截断对下游性能影响极小。
Conclusion: 截断鲁棒性未必来自 MRL，是否值得付出 MRL 的额外训练成本取决于是否需要 80% 以上的重度截断；作者公开代码以便复现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在相同截断方式下对比有无 Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) 训练的文本编码器，发现除非把向量维度削减至少 80%，未用 MRL 的模型截断后与 MRL 模型相当甚至更常胜出，说明截断鲁棒性未必来自 MRL，是否付出 MRL 的额外训练成本取决于是否需要重度截断。
summary_sections.motivation: 已有工作表明随机截断文本嵌入在维度削减不足 70% 时对下游性能影响很小，暗示不加 MRL 也已具备截断鲁棒性，但此前没有工作把随机截断与 MRL 直接对比，两者作为嵌入降维手段孰优孰劣并不清楚。

papers.title: The End of Trust: How Agentic AI Breaks Security Assumptions
papers.abstract_en: For decades, the security of digital interaction has rested on an unacknowledged economic constraint. Attackers faced a tradeoff between the fidelity of a deception and the scale at which it could be deployed. Convincing impersonation required sustained human effort and was confined to a narrow set of high-value targets, while mass-market attacks sacrificed plausibility for reach. Detection systems, verification mechanisms, and user awareness training have all been implicitly calibrated to the artifacts of cheap deception that this tradeoff produced. Agentic AI collapses the tradeoff, allowing high-fidelity, individually tailored deception to be produced at mass-market scale. We argue that this shift exhausts a security paradigm rather than merely intensifying the threat landscape. We introduce the Infinite Impostor, an attack model in which an autonomous agent interposes itself between two parties who already trust each other, hijacking an existing relationship rather than building a new one from scratch. Detection-oriented defenses share an assumption that generative progress is eliminating, that synthetic outputs are distinguishable from authentic ones. We propose a suspect-by-default paradigm that shifts security from authenticating actors to evaluating actions, and examine the governance tensions that arise when platforms become the regulatory substrate of digital interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证 Agentic AI 摧毁了安全领域长期依赖的隐含经济约束：欺骗的逼真度与可部署规模不再此消彼长，高逼真、个性化欺骗可大规模量产，因此现有以检测合成内容为核心的安全范式被耗尽而非仅被加剧。作者提出 Infinite Impostor 攻击模型（自主 agent 插入两个本已互信的双方之间劫持既有关系），并主张转向 suspect-by-default：从认证行为者转向评估行为。
Motivation: 数十年来检测系统、验证机制与用户意识培训都建立在“廉价欺骗”留下的痕迹上；一旦逼真度与规模的权衡被打破，这套校准过的防御前提整体失效。
Method: 提出 Infinite Impostor 攻击模型，刻画 agent 劫持既有信任关系而非从零建立新关系的攻击面；论证检测型防御所依赖的“合成输出可与真实输出区分”假设正被生成式进步消除；据此提出 suspect-by-default 范式，把安全重心从认证 actor 转向评估 action，并讨论平台成为数字交互监管基底时的治理张力。
Result: 这是一篇立场/论证型论文：给出 Infinite Impostor 攻击模型与 suspect-by-default 防御范式，主张欺骗的逼真度—规模权衡被 Agentic AI 消除，检测型防御的可区分性假设失效。
Conclusion: 安全范式应从认证身份转向持续评估行为，因为合成与真实的可区分性这一检测前提正被生成式 AI 消除；同时平台作为监管基底会带来治理张力。

papers.title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered coding agents spend the majority of their token budget reading repository files, yet much of the retrieved code is irrelevant to the task at hand. Existing learned pruners compress this context with a single-objective sequence labeler, collapsing all facets of code relevance into one score and one transition matrix. We show that this formulation creates a modeling bottleneck: a single CRF transition prior must serve heterogeneous retention patterns, including contiguous semantic spans and sparse structural support lines. We propose LaMR (Latent Multi-Rubric), a structured pruning framework that decomposes code relevance into two interpretable quality dimensions, semantic evidence and dependency support, each modeled by a dedicated CRF with dimension-specific transition dynamics. A mixture-of-experts gating network dynamically weights the per-rubric emissions conditioned on the query, and a final CRF layer on the fused emissions produces the aggregate keep-or-prune decision. To supervise each dimension without additional annotation cost, we derive multi-rubric labels from the existing training corpus via AST-based program analysis, simultaneously denoising the teacher's binary labels. By effectively filtering distracting noise, LaMR frequently matches or even outperforms unpruned full-context baselines. Experiments on four benchmarks (SWE-Bench Verified, SWE-QA, LCC, LongCodeQA) show that LaMR wins 12 of 16 head-to-head multi-turn comparisons. It saves up to 31% more tokens on multi-turn agent tasks and improves Exact Match by up to +3.5 on single-turn tasks, while performance is frequently enhanced by denoising the context, and any remaining drops are marginal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LaMR（Latent Multi-Rubric）：把代码相关性拆成语义证据与依赖支撑两个维度，各配独立 CRF 与维度专属转移矩阵，再用 query 条件化的 MoE 门控融合打分，最后一层 CRF 给出保留/剪除决策。在四个基准上 16 组多轮对比赢 12 组，多轮任务最多多省 31% token，单轮 Exact Match 最多 +3.5，常追平甚至超过不剪枝的全上下文基线。
Motivation: 编码 agent 的 token 预算大多耗在读仓库文件上，而检索到的代码大量与任务无关；现有学习式剪枝用单一目标的序列标注器把所有相关性压成一个分数和一个转移矩阵，单一 CRF 转移先验要同时容纳连续语义片段与稀疏结构支撑行，形成建模瓶颈。
Method: LaMR 用两个专用 CRF 分别建模语义证据与依赖支撑，各自带维度专属转移动态；MoE 门控网络按 query 动态加权各 rubric 的 emission，融合后由最终 CRF 层输出 keep-or-prune 决策。监督信号不需额外标注，直接从既有训练语料经 AST 程序分析推导多 rubric 标签，同时对教师二值标签去噪。
Result: 在 SWE-Bench Verified、SWE-QA、LCC、LongCodeQA 四个基准上，LaMR 在 16 组多轮 head-to-head 对比中赢 12 组；多轮 agent 任务最多多节省 31% token，单轮任务 Exact Match 最多提升 +3.5；上下文去噪常带来性能增强，其余下降幅度很小。
Conclusion: 把代码相关性按多 rubric 分解并分别建模转移，可让剪枝后的上下文频繁追平乃至超过不剪枝的全上下文基线，剩余损失是边际的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: COTCAgent: Preventive Consultation via Probabilistic Chain-of-Thought Completion
papers.abstract_en: Sequential diagnosis requires ranking diseases from a sparse intake under a public budget of follow-up questions, which is diagnostic triage with missing findings rather than screening of people who have no symptoms. Because laboratory series arrive irregularly and histories remain incomplete, the ranking must be updated as new facts arrive, yet most pipelines are limited by unnamed numeric trends, unverifiable free-form chain of thought, and a negative bias from treating unasked findings as absent. To solve these, we propose COTCAgent, a sparse-intake consultation agent built on Chain-of-Thought Completion (COTC), which couples three modules on one shared ternary evidence log. The Temporal-Statistics Adapter (TSA) turns time series into typed predicates with named statistics, while the COTC module scores diseases with a learnable knowledge-base energy in which unknown findings add zero energy, after which bounded probabilistic completion selects unknown findings under the question budget and writes each answer back as present, absent, or unknown. Edge strengths and an absence scale are trained with listwise ranking under a sparse curriculum, so that the same energy chooses the next finding by a surrogate entropy reduction. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV show that these modules improve ranking under a matched question budget, with information-gain completion above asking nothing or at random and above protocol-matched askers and a local LLM, thereby providing a foundation for future calibrated scoring and prospective preventive consultation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COTCAgent 把稀疏问诊做成带问题预算的诊断分诊：TSA 把不规则检验序列转成带命名统计量的类型化谓词，COTC 用未知发现记零能量的可学习知识库能量给疾病排序，再在预算内做有界概率补全并把答案写回三值证据日志。在 DDXPlus 与 MIMIC-IV 上，按匹配问题预算排序优于不提问、随机提问、协议匹配提问器与本地 LLM。
Motivation: 序列诊断要在随访问题的公共预算下从稀疏入口给疾病排序，且检验序列不规则、病史不完整；现有流程受未命名数值趋势、不可核验的自由形式思维链，以及把未问发现当作缺失的负偏置所限。
Method: 三个模块共享一份三值（present/absent/unknown）证据日志：Temporal-Statistics Adapter (TSA) 将时间序列转为带命名统计量的类型化谓词；COTC 模块用可学习知识库能量给疾病打分，未知发现贡献零能量；有界概率补全在问题预算内选择未知发现，按替代熵减选择下一问题，答案写回日志。边强度与缺失尺度用 listwise ranking 加稀疏课程训练。
Result: 在 DDXPlus 与 MIMIC-IV 上，各模块在匹配问题预算下改善疾病排序；信息增益补全优于不提问与随机提问，也优于协议匹配的提问器和一个本地 LLM。
Conclusion: 把未知发现显式建模为零能量并按熵减提问，可在固定问题预算内提升稀疏问诊的排序质量，作者视其为未来校准打分与前瞻性预防性会诊的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reducing Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models through Hard Grounding Preference Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a major challenge in vision-language models (VLMs), particularly when linguistically plausible responses are unsupported by visual evidence. We study whether multimodal hallucination can be reduced by concentrating post-training supervision on hard grounding boundaries, where preferred and rejected responses are semantically close but differ in their support from observable visual evidence. Under a frozen visual encoder and cross-modal alignment pathway, we first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to establish broad decoder-side multimodal behavior and then construct hard grounding preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). These pairs target evidence utilization, calibration, and grounding consistency across fine-grained recognition, spatial reasoning, OCR, ambiguous or insufficient evidence, and false-premise queries. The resulting DPO model consistently improves over its SFT initialization on DocVQA, TextVQA, MMBench, and VQAv2. Across approximately 839 additional multimodal examples, it further achieves 6.2--8.2 percentage-point higher pairwise win rates under three independent LLM judges. We additionally release HardVQA-DPO, a curated and growing resource with more than 3K hard-grounding SFT examples and an initial set of DPO preference pairs.https://huggingface.co/datasets/vlmgrounding/hardvqa-sft-dpo These results show that decoder-side adaptation alone can improve a meaningful subset of grounding failures under a fixed multimodal representation, while preserving broader multimodal capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结视觉编码器与跨模态对齐通路的前提下，仅靠解码器侧后训练也能压低多模态大模型的幻觉：先用 SFT 建立广泛的多模态行为，再构造语义接近、但对可见视觉证据支持不同的 hard grounding 偏好对做 DPO。在 DocVQA、TextVQA、MMBench、VQAv2 上一致优于 SFT 初始模型，约 839 个额外样本上三位独立 LLM judge 的成对胜率高出 6.2–8.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型常给出语言上通顺却缺乏视觉证据支撑的回答，而现有后训练监督很少专门针对“偏好与拒绝回答语义接近、仅证据支持不同”的 hard grounding 边界。
Method: 冻结视觉编码器与跨模态对齐通路，先用监督微调 (SFT) 建立解码器侧多模态行为，再构造针对证据利用、校准与 grounding 一致性的 hard grounding 偏好对，覆盖细粒度识别、空间推理、OCR、证据模糊/不足与错误前提查询，用于 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)。
Result: DPO 模型在 DocVQA、TextVQA、MMBench、VQAv2 上一致优于其 SFT 初始模型；在约 839 个额外多模态样本上，三位独立 LLM judge 的成对胜率高出 6.2–8.2 个百分点；发布 HardVQA-DPO 资源，含 3K 以上 hard-grounding SFT 样本与初始 DPO 偏好对。
Conclusion: 在固定多模态表示下，仅解码器侧适配即可改善一部分 grounding 失败，同时保持更广的多模态能力。

papers.title: Watermarking Should Be Treated as a Monitoring Primitive
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking is widely proposed for provenance, attribution, and safety monitoring in generative models. We argue that it should be evaluated and governed as a monitoring primitive through two complementary observer models. Internal observers use detector or decoder access and entity mappings for attribution; external observers learn entity-specific signals from labeled outputs without keys or detectors. With persistent entity bindings and reliable inference, either pathway can support monitoring. We show that even zero-bit watermarking supports internal attribution under per-entity multi-key deployments without explicitly encoding identity, and demonstrate external identification in selected text and image configurations. External exposure depends on persistent, learnable watermark structure and is not universal, while internal attribution also remains conditional on reliability and access. These findings motivate governance of attribution access and deployment choices alongside evaluation of design-dependent entity linkability, de-anonymization or re-identification, beyond per-sample robustness.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Proteus: A Self-Evolving Red Team for Agent Skill Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend LLM agents with reusable instructions, tool interfaces, and executable code, and users increasingly install third-party skills from marketplaces, repositories, and community channels. Because a skill exposes both executable behavior and context-setting documentation, its deployment risk cannot be measured by single-shot audits or prompt-level red teams alone: a realistic attacker can use audit and runtime feedback to repeatedly rewrite the skill. We frame this risk as \emph{adaptive leakage} -- whether a budgeted attacker can iteratively revise a skill until it passes audit and produces verified runtime harm -- and present \ours{}, a grey-box self-evolving red-team framework for measuring it. Proteus searches a formalized five-axis skill-attack space. Each candidate is evaluated through a unified audit-sandbox-oracle pipeline that returns structured audit findings and runtime evidence to guide cross-round mutation. Beyond initial evasion, Proteus performs path expansion, which finds alternative implementations of successful attacks, and surface expansion, which transfers learned implementation patterns to new attack objectives beyond the original seed catalogue. Across eight phase-1 cells, Proteus reaches 40--90\% Attack Success Rate at $5$ rounds (ASR@5) with positive learning-curve slopes on both evaluated auditors. Phase-2 path/surface expansion produces 438 jointly bypassing and lethal variants, with SkillVetter bypassed at $\geq 93\%$ in every cell and AI-Infra-Guard, the strongest public auditor we evaluate, still admitting up to 41.3\% joint-success. These results show that current skill vetting substantially underestimates residual risk when evaluated against adaptive, feedback-driven attackers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Proteus 是面向 agent skill 生态的灰盒自演化红队框架，把风险形式化为 adaptive leakage：预算受限的攻击者能否反复改写 skill 直到通过审计并在运行时产生已验证危害。它在五轴 skill-attack 空间中搜索，用 audit-sandbox-oracle 流水线的结构化反馈驱动跨轮变异，再做 path expansion 与 surface expansion；在八个 phase-1 cell 上 5 轮内 ASR 达 40–90%，最强公开审计器 AI-Infra-Guard 仍放行最高 41.3% 的联合成功变体。
Motivation: 第三方 skill 同时暴露可执行行为与上下文文档，单次审计和 prompt 级红队测不出攻击者利用审计与运行时反馈反复重写 skill 所带来的风险。
Method: 在形式化的五轴 skill-attack 空间中搜索候选；每个候选经统一的 audit-sandbox-oracle 流水线评估，返回结构化审计发现与运行时证据指导跨轮变异；成功攻击后再做 path expansion（寻找同一攻击的替代实现）与 surface expansion（把学到的实现模式迁移到原 seed catalogue 之外的新攻击目标）。
Result: phase-1 八个 cell 中，Proteus 在 5 轮内达到 40–90% 的 ASR@5，且在两个被评估的审计器上学习曲线斜率均为正；phase-2 的 path/surface expansion 产生 438 个同时绕过且致命的变体，SkillVetter 在每个 cell 被绕过率 ≥93%，最强公开审计器 AI-Infra-Guard 仍放行最高 41.3% 的联合成功率。
Conclusion: 当前 skill vetting 在面对自适应、反馈驱动的攻击者时会大幅低估残余风险，因此审计需要按迭代改写的攻击者来评估。

papers.title: FIS-DiT: Breaking the Few-Step Video Inference Barrier via Training-Free Frame Interleaved Sparsity
papers.abstract_en: While the overall inference latency of Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can be substantially reduced through model distillation, per-step inference latency remains a critical bottleneck. Existing acceleration paradigms primarily exploit redundancy across the denoising trajectory; however, we identify a limitation where these step-wise strategies encounter diminishing returns in few-step regimes. In such scenarios, fewer intermediate states can limit opportunities for feature reuse or predictive modeling, motivating complementary forms of acceleration. To overcome this, we propose Frame Interleaved Sparsity DiT (FIS-DiT), a training-free and operator-agnostic framework that shifts the optimization focus from the temporal trajectory to the latent frame dimension. Our approach is motivated by an intrinsic duality within this dimension: the existence of frame-wise sparsity that permits reduced computation, coupled with a structural consistency that calls for maintaining coverage of frame positions in the global spatiotemporal context. Leveraging this insight, we implement Frame Interleaved Sparsity (FIS) as an execution strategy that manipulates frame subsets across the model hierarchy, refreshing all latent positions without requiring full-scale block computation. Empirical evaluations on Wan 2.2 and HunyuanVideo 1.5 demonstrate that FIS-DiT reaches 2.4$\times$ speedup while maintaining comparable performance on VBench, providing a scalable and robust pathway toward real-time high-definition video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIS-DiT 把视频 DiT 的加速重心从去噪时间轴转到潜在帧维度，用帧交错稀疏 (Frame Interleaved Sparsity) 在模型各层级只计算帧子集、同时刷新全部潜在位置，从而在少步推理下继续提速。在 Wan 2.2 与 HunyuanVideo 1.5 上达到 2.4× 加速，VBench 性能相当。
Motivation: 蒸馏虽能压低视频 DiT 的整体推理延迟，但单步延迟仍是瓶颈；现有沿去噪轨迹做复用或预测的加速策略在少步体制下中间状态太少、收益递减，需要新的加速维度。
Method: 训练免调 (training-free)、算子无关的框架：利用帧维上的稀疏性与结构一致性这对对偶性质，在模型层级间操纵帧子集执行计算，只算部分帧块但刷新全部潜在位置，避免全量 block 计算。
Result: 在 Wan 2.2 和 HunyuanVideo 1.5 上实测 2.4× 加速，VBench 上性能相当 (comparable performance)。
Conclusion: 少步视频生成的加速空间在帧维度而非时间轨迹，帧交错稀疏可作为通向实时高清视频生成的可扩展路径。

papers.title: Fast Training of Mixture-of-Experts for Time Series Forecasting via Expert Loss Integration
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel Mixture-of-Experts framework, referred to as Expert Loss Integration MoE (EliMoE), for time series forecasting. EliMoE addresses the optimization problem arising from small gating weights by incorporating expert-specific losses, which provide each expert with a direct learning signal independent of the gate-assigned weight. Specifically, the overall objective comprises the base forecasting loss and expert-specific losses, allowing individual expert prediction errors to directly influence parameter updates alongside the aggregate forecasting error. The framework also encourages different experts to learn from different temporal segments of the data. The proposed framework is further combined with a partial online learning strategy that enables efficient incremental updates of model parameters. By integrating expert-level loss information with partial online learning, EliMoE improves forecasting performance while retaining computational efficiency. Empirical results across five benchmark datasets from diverse application domains with different sampling frequencies show that the proposed approach generally outperforms state-of-the-art supervised neural forecasting models, including Transformer-based architectures such as PatchTST, as well as zero-shot time-series foundation models such as TimeMoE. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of the expert-specific loss integration strategy, highlighting its contribution to enhancing predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Expert Loss Integration MoE (EliMoE)：在时间序列预测的总目标里加入专家专属损失，使每个专家获得与门控权重无关的直接学习信号，缓解小 gating weight 导致的优化问题，并配合部分在线学习 (partial online learning) 做增量参数更新。在五个不同采样频率的基准数据集上，EliMoE 总体优于 PatchTST 等 Transformer 与 TimeMoE 等零样本时序基础模型，消融实验证实专家损失项对预测性能有贡献。
Motivation: MoE 门控中专家权重过小会使该专家几乎收不到梯度，个体预测误差无法直接驱动参数更新，时序预测训练因此低效且性能受限。
Method: EliMoE 的目标函数 = 基础预测损失 + 专家专属损失，让各专家的预测误差与聚合误差一同影响参数更新；同时鼓励不同专家学习数据的不同时间片段，并叠加 partial online learning 策略实现参数的高效增量更新。
Result: 在五个来自不同应用领域、采样频率各异的基准数据集上，EliMoE 总体优于包括 Transformer 架构 PatchTST 与零样本时序基础模型 TimeMoE 在内的监督神经预测模型；消融研究确认专家专属损失集成策略有效并贡献于预测性能提升。
Conclusion: 把专家级损失信息与部分在线学习结合，可在保持计算效率的同时提升时间序列预测性能，专家专属损失是性能增益的直接来源。

papers.title: PoDAR: Power-Decoupled Audio Representation for Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: The performance of audio latent diffusion models is primarily governed by generator expressivity and the modelability of the underlying latent space. While recent research has focused primarily on the former, as well as improving the reconstruction fidelity of audio codecs, we demonstrate that latent modelability can be significantly improved through explicit factor decoupling. We present PoDAR (Power-Decoupled Audio Representation), a framework that utilizes a randomized power augmentation and latent consistency objective to decouple signal power from invariant semantic content. This factorization makes the latent space easier to model, which both accelerates the convergence of downstream generative models and improves final overall performance. When applied to a Stable Audio 1.0 VAE with an F5-TTS generator, PoDAR achieves about a 2x acceleration in convergence to match baseline performance, while increasing final speaker similarity by 0.055 and UTMOS by 0.22 on the LibriSpeech-PC dataset. Furthermore, isolating power into dedicated channels enables the application of CFG exclusively to power-invariant content, effectively extending the stable guidance regime to higher scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PoDAR 用随机幂增强与潜空间一致性目标，把音频信号功率从语义内容中解耦出来，使 latent 更易建模。接到 Stable Audio 1.0 VAE 与 F5-TTS 生成器上，收敛到基线性能约快 2 倍，LibriSpeech-PC 上说话人相似度 +0.055、UTMOS +0.22；功率单独成通道后 CFG 只作用于功率不变内容，可推到更高 guidance scale。
Motivation: 音频 latent diffusion 的瓶颈常被归到生成器表达力与 codec 重建保真度上，而 latent 本身的可建模性被忽视；功率与语义纠缠使潜空间难学。
Method: PoDAR (Power-Decoupled Audio Representation)：随机 power augmentation 加 latent consistency objective，把信号功率与不变语义内容显式解耦；功率隔离到专用通道后，CFG 只施加在功率不变内容上。
Result: 在 Stable Audio 1.0 VAE + F5-TTS 生成器上，收敛到基线性能约加速 2 倍；LibriSpeech-PC 数据集上最终说话人相似度提升 0.055，UTMOS 提升 0.22；功率隔离使稳定 guidance 区间可扩展到更高 scale。
Conclusion: 显式因子解耦能同时加快下游生成模型收敛并抬高最终性能，且功率/内容分离让 CFG 可安全用到更大 guidance scale。

papers.title: Towards Effective Theory of LLMs: A Representation Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: We propose Representational Effective Theory (RET), a framework for describing large language model computation in terms of learned macrostates rather than microscopic details. RET learns these macrostates from hidden-state trajectories using a BYOL/JEPA-style self-supervised objective, coarse-graining activations into macrovariables that preserve higher-level structure relevant for prediction and interpretation. We evaluate whether these macrovariables are practically relevant for interpretability: RET yields temporally consistent states that reveal ``mental-state'' trajectories of reasoning, capture high-level semantic structure, support early prediction of behavioral outcomes such as sycophancy and alignment faking, while providing causal handles for steering generations toward interpretable computational phases. Together, these results suggest that LLM computation admits useful effective descriptions via RET: high-level, dynamically meaningful variables for interpretation, prediction, and control.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Max-pooling Network Revisited: Analyzing the Role of Semantic Probability in Multiple Instance Learning for Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination detection has become increasingly important for improving the reliability of large language models (LLMs). Recently, hybrid approaches such as HaMI, which combine semantic consistency with internal model states via Multiple Instance Learning (MIL), have achieved state-of-the-art performance. However, these methods incur substantial computational overhead due to repeated sampling and costly semantic similarity computations. In this work, we first provide a theoretical analysis of HaMI in terms of decision margins, revealing that scaling internal states with semantic consistency leads to an enlarged decision margin. Motivated by this insight, we revisit classical sentence classification models from a margin enlargement perspective, aggregating token-level features via max pooling and directly estimating sentence scores using a lightweight MLP. Without requiring semantic consistency computations, our approach achieves substantial efficiency improvements while maintaining competitive performance with state-of-the-art baselines through adaptive aggregation of internal feature representations. Code is available at https://github.com/FUJI1229/Hallucination_Detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 幻觉检测中 HaMI 类混合方法因重复采样与语义相似度计算带来的高开销，从决策 margin 视角证明对内部状态按语义一致性加权会放大决策间隔，并据此改用 max pooling 聚合 token 级特征、以轻量 MLP 直接估计句子分数。该方法完全省去语义一致性计算，在保持与 SOTA 基线相当性能的同时显著提升效率。
Motivation: HaMI 等语义一致性与内部状态结合的 MIL 方法虽达 SOTA，但重复采样和语义相似度计算开销大，限制了幻觉检测在实际 LLM 部署中的可扩展性。
Method: 先对 HaMI 做决策 margin 理论分析，证明按语义一致性缩放内部状态可放大间隔；受此启发从 margin 放大角度重访经典句子分类模型，用 max pooling 聚合 token 级特征，再由轻量 MLP 直接输出句子分数，通过自适应聚合内部特征表示替代语义一致性计算。
Result: 省去语义一致性计算后取得显著效率提升，同时性能与 SOTA 基线（如 HaMI）保持竞争力；摘要给出的是定性比较而非具体数值。
Conclusion: 语义一致性加权的作用可由决策 margin 放大解释，而用 max pooling 加轻量 MLP 的自适应聚合即可在不计算语义一致性的情况下保住竞争力，从而去掉该开销。

papers.title: ProcVLM: Learning Procedure-Grounded Progress Rewards for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires dense feedback that reflects how a task advances through its procedural stages, not merely whether the final outcome is successful. Existing reward models often rely on trajectory-level success labels or time-based interpolation, which can conflate elapsed time with true task progress and therefore fail to capture unfinished steps, stagnation, and failure states. We present ProcVLM, a progress-aware vision-language model that learns procedure-grounded progress as a dense reward signal for manipulation. Rather than deriving progress from terminal outcomes or temporal proxies, ProcVLM grounds progress estimation in procedural structure and intra-stage visual change, and further adopts a reasoning-before-estimation paradigm that infers the remaining atomic actions before estimating task progress. Specifically, we construct this supervision by synthesizing frame-level subtask-semantic annotations, assigning progress budgets according to subtask structure, and distributing each budget based on intra-subtask visual change. To train ProcVLM at scale, we build a standardized procedural supervision synthesis pipeline and construct ProcCorpus-60M from 30 embodied datasets with 60M annotated frames, from which we derive ProcVQA for procedure-aware pretraining, with progress estimation as the central task alongside action segmentation and future planning. Experiments on ProcVQA and reward-model benchmarks show that ProcVLM improves embodied procedural reasoning and yields more discriminative trajectory-internal progress estimates than representative baselines, supporting its use as a dense reward model for downstream reward-guided policy optimization. Project page: https://procvlm.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProcVLM 把机器人长程操作的进度估计做成由程序结构和阶段内视觉变化锚定的稠密奖励，而不是用终局成功标签或时间插值；训练前先推理剩余原子动作再给进度分。在 ProcVQA 与奖励模型基准上，它比代表性基线给出更具区分度的轨迹内部进度估计。
Motivation: 长程操作需要反映任务推进到哪个程序阶段的稠密反馈，而现有奖励模型依赖轨迹级成功标签或时间插值，把流逝时间当成真实进度，抓不住未完成步骤、停滞与失败状态。
Method: 合成帧级子任务语义标注，按子任务结构分配进度预算，再按子任务内视觉变化分发预算；构建标准化程序监督合成流水线，产出 ProcCorpus-60M（30 个具身数据集、60M 标注帧），并派生 ProcVQA 用于程序感知预训练，中心任务是进度估计，辅以动作分割与未来规划；推理采用 reasoning-before-estimation 范式。
Result: 在 ProcVQA 与奖励模型基准上，ProcVLM 提升具身程序推理，并比代表性基线给出更具区分度的轨迹内部进度估计；ProcCorpus-60M 含 30 个具身数据集的 60M 标注帧。
Conclusion: 以程序结构和阶段内视觉变化为锚的进度估计可作为下游奖励引导策略优化的稠密奖励模型，优于依赖终局结果或时间代理的进度来源。

papers.title: Recovering Physical Dynamics from Discrete Observations via Intrinsic Differential Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Recovering continuous-time dynamics from discrete observations is difficult because local supervision loses fidelity as the observation interval grows. We replace local supervision with a global structural constraint: any flow representing autonomous dynamics must satisfy the semi-group property under time translation. We train a time-conditioned secant velocity field whose deviation from this property---which we call Symmetry Rupture---serves two roles: as a training regularizer it confines the hypothesis space to flows that compose consistently across temporal scales; as an inference oracle it guides an adaptive solver to select the largest step size that preserves internal consistency, without relying on local truncation error estimates. On the diffusion-reaction and Navier-Stokes benchmarks, our method achieves the lowest rollout RMSE among all evaluated methods using $\leq 3$ function evaluations per step. On the near-conservative shallow water benchmark, our method matches or exceeds competing flow-based methods at far lower computational cost; the strongest Neural ODE baseline achieves lower absolute RMSE but at the expense of $>100$ function evaluations per step. In the direct auto-regressive setting, our solver maintains stable long-horizon rollouts where flow-matching baselines diverge and Neural ODE requires up to $12\times$ more function evaluations. The core contribution is a model that internalizes temporal consistency, removing the need for high-order external solvers to compensate for structural bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用半群性质 (semi-group property) 这一全局结构约束替代局部监督：训练一个时间条件化的割线速度场 (secant velocity field)，其对半群性质的偏离称为 Symmetry Rupture，既作训练正则把假设空间限制在跨时间尺度可复合的流上，又作推理 oracle 引导自适应求解器选取保持内部一致的最大步长。在 diffusion-reaction 与 Navier-Stokes 上，用每步 ≤3 次函数求值取得所有被评估方法中最低的 rollout RMSE；shallow water 上以远低计算量匹配或超过流方法，而最强 Neural ODE 基线绝对 RMSE 更低但每步需 >100 次函数求值。
Motivation: 从离散观测恢复连续时间动力学时，观测间隔变大就使局部监督失真；高阶外部求解器被用来补偿这种结构性偏差，代价是大量函数求值。
Method: 训练时间条件化的割线速度场，把对半群性质的偏离 (Symmetry Rupture) 同时用作训练正则与推理 oracle：正则约束流在时间平移下可一致复合，oracle 引导自适应求解器在不依赖局部截断误差估计的情况下选最大一致步长。评测覆盖 diffusion-reaction、Navier-Stokes、近保守 shallow water，以及直接自回归 (direct auto-regressive) 设定。
Result: diffusion-reaction 与 Navier-Stokes 上，rollout RMSE 在所有被评估方法中最低，且每步 ≤3 次函数求值 (NFE)。shallow water 上匹配或超过竞争流方法且计算量远低；最强 Neural ODE 基线绝对 RMSE 更低，但每步 >100 次函数求值。直接自回归设定下，该求解器保持稳定长时程 rollout，而 flow-matching 基线发散、Neural ODE 最多需要 12× 的函数求值。
Conclusion: 把时间一致性内化进模型，就能去掉对高阶外部求解器的依赖：以极少函数求值换取跨时间尺度可复合、长时程稳定的 rollout。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of Newton's Method for Neural Networks in the Overparameterized Limit
papers.abstract_en: A convergence analysis is developed for the regularized Newton method for training neural networks (NNs) in the overparameterized limit. As the number of hidden units tends to infinity, the NN training dynamics converge in probability to the solution of a deterministic limit equation involving a "Newton neural tangent kernel" (NNTK). Explicit rates characterizing this convergence are provided and, in the infinite-width limit, we prove that the NN converges exponentially fast to the target data (i.e., a global minimizer with zero loss). We show that this convergence is uniform across the frequency spectrum, addressing the spectral bias inherent in gradient descent. The eigenvalues of the NTK for gradient descent accumulate at zero, leading to slow convergence for target data with high-frequency components. In contrast, the NNTK has uniformly lower bounded eigenvalues if the regularization parameter is selected appropriately, allowing Newton's method to converge more quickly for data with high-frequency components. Mathematical challenges that need to be addressed include the implicit parameter update of the Newton method with a potentially indefinite Hessian matrix and the fact that the dimension of this linear system of equations tends to infinity as the NN width grows. This substantially complicates deriving the training dynamics in the overparameterized limit as well as proving the convergence of the finite-width dynamics thereto. Our analysis identifies a scaling formula for selecting the regularization parameter, which we show can vanish at a suitable rate as the NN width becomes larger. In addition, we prove that, for sufficiently large numbers of hidden units, the regularized Hessian remains positive definite during training and the Newton updates for individual NN parameters converge to zero, demonstrating that the model behaves as a linearization around the initialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在过参数化极限下，正则化 Newton 法训练神经网络的动态以概率收敛到由 Newton neural tangent kernel (NNTK) 决定的确定性极限方程，且无限宽时网络以指数速度收敛到零损失全局极小。收敛在全频谱上一致，克服了梯度下降的 spectral bias：NTK 特征值在零处聚集导致高频目标收敛慢，而 NNTK 在正则参数选取合适时特征值一致下界，使高频数据收敛更快。
Motivation: 梯度下降的 NTK 特征值在零处聚集，高频目标分量收敛极慢（spectral bias）；同时 Newton 法的隐式参数更新、可能不定的 Hessian、以及随宽度增长趋于无穷维的线性方程组，使过参数化极限下的训练动态推导与有限宽收敛证明都很困难。
Method: 对训练神经网络的正则化 Newton 方法做收敛分析：令隐单元数趋于无穷，证明训练动态以概率收敛到含 NNTK 的确定性极限方程并给出显式收敛速率；分析隐式参数更新与不定 Hessian，导出正则参数随网络宽度可消失的标度公式，并证明足够多隐单元下正则 Hessian 在训练中保持正定。
Result: 无限宽极限下网络以指数速度收敛到目标数据（零损失全局极小），且收敛在频谱上一致；NTK 特征值在零聚集导致高频分量收敛慢，而 NNTK 在正则参数选取合适时特征值一致下界，使 Newton 法对高频数据收敛更快；正则参数随宽度增大可按标度公式以合适速率消失，足够大隐单元数下正则 Hessian 保持正定、各参数 Newton 更新趋于零。
Conclusion: 正则化 Newton 法在过参数化极限下可作为围绕初始化的线性化处理，并以一致于频谱的指数速度消除 gradient descent 的 spectral bias，前提是正则参数按所给标度公式随宽度选取。

summary_sections.result: 无限宽极限下网络以指数速度收敛到目标数据（零损失全局极小），且收敛在频谱上一致；NTK 特征值在零聚集导致高频分量收敛慢，而 NNTK 在正则参数选取合适时特征值一致下界，使 Newton 法对高频数据收敛更快；正则参数随宽度增大可按标度公式以合适速率消失，足够大隐单元数下正则 Hessian 保持正定、各参数 Newton 更新趋于零。
summary_sections.conclusion: 正则化 Newton 法在过参数化极限下可作为围绕初始化的线性化处理，并以一致于频谱的指数速度消除 gradient descent 的 spectral bias，前提是正则参数按所给标度公式随宽度选取。

papers.title: Tool Calling is Linearly Readable and Steerable in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents can take real actions by calling tools, so choosing the wrong tool can cause errors that are difficult to undo. Most evaluations only observe the tool choice after the model generates a call. We read this choice from the model before generation, and we steer it. For each tool, we average the model's hidden states from a few example requests to obtain a tool vector. Comparing a new request with these tool vectors predicts which tool it needs. The difference between two tool vectors gives a steering direction that can move the model toward a chosen tool without retraining. Across eight instruction-tuned models from 4B to 27B parameters, steering changes the generated call to a chosen target tool in 56-78% of held-out tool pairs, depending on the model. We also observe steering on real APIs from $τ$-bench and ToolBench, though less reliably. At the final layer, steering could work simply by raising the score of the target tool name. To test this, we compare the steering direction with a direction that only raises that score, layer by layer. In the middle layers, on the three models we examine in depth, the steering direction switches more calls than the score-raising direction. So the tool vectors capture part of the tool choice before the final layer. The same tool vectors also help identify likely tool-selection errors before generation. Calls are more likely to be wrong when a request is similarly close to two tool vectors. Across four models, this signal achieves an AUROC of 0.61-0.78 and outperforms a first-token confidence baseline on three of them. Together, these results suggest that the model's hidden state provides a way to read, steer, and check tool choice before a call is made.
papers.comment: 54 pages. v3: revised manuscript with new experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具选择在语言模型隐藏状态中线性可读且可被无重训地操控：对每个工具用少量示例请求的隐藏状态均值构造 tool vector，用请求与各 tool vector 的相似度预测所需工具，两 tool vector 之差即为指向目标工具的 steering 方向。在 4B–27B 的八个指令微调模型上，steering 在留出工具对上把生成调用改到目标工具的比例为 56–78%；请求与两个 tool vector 距离相近时更易选错，该信号在四个模型上 AUROC 0.61–0.78。
Motivation: 工具调用智能体选错工具会造成难以回滚的真实动作错误，而现有评测只能在模型生成调用之后才观察到选择结果，缺少生成前的读取与干预手段。
Method: 对每个工具取若干示例请求的隐藏状态均值作为 tool vector，用新请求与各 tool vector 的比较预测所需工具；两 tool vector 之差作为无需重训的 steering 方向。逐层把该方向与只提升目标工具名分数的方向对比，并在 τ-bench 与 ToolBench 的真实 API 上检验。
Result: 在 4B–27B 的八个指令微调模型上，steering 在 56–78% 的留出工具对上把生成调用改到目标工具（随模型而异）；在 τ-bench 与 ToolBench 真实 API 上也观察到 steering，但可靠性更低。在深入考察的三个模型的中间层，steering 方向切换的调用多于只提升分数的方向。请求与两个 tool vector 距离相近时调用更可能出错，该信号在四个模型上 AUROC 0.61–0.78，并在其中三个上优于 first-token confidence 基线。
Conclusion: 模型隐藏状态在调用生成之前就编码了工具选择，因此可以被读取、被方向性操控、并用于检查潜在选错；在中间层 tool vector 捕获的不只是最终层的目标工具名分数。

papers.title: MELD: Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector for AI-Generated Text
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are widely used in everyday writing, making reliable AI-generated text detection crucial for academic integrity, content moderation, and provenance tracking. Yet high AUROC on clean, in-distribution benchmarks is not sufficient. Practical detectors must resist adversarial rewrites, generalize to unseen generators and writing domains, and maintain low false-positive rates (FPR). A pooled AI-versus-human objective does not explicitly require the model to distinguish among generator families, so it may fail to learn the generator-specific structure needed for generalization and attribution. We introduce MELD (Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector), which instead trains on class-balanced, family-specific AI-versus-human tasks while sharing a common representation of human writing. MELD produces detection, generator-family, rewrite-task, and token-level predictions in a single forward pass. Format normalization further makes its scores invariant to the modeled reformatting operations. MELD ranks first among open-source submissions in the public RAID leaderboard and matches or exceeds supervised baselines on five of six held-out evaluation pools. To evaluate transfer to unseen generators, we introduce MELD-eval, a held-out test pool built from four frontier chat models. Without further fine-tuning, MELD achieves 99.7% TPR at 1% FPR on MELD-eval and 98% TPR at the same FPR on a held-out generator whose family is absent from training. Finally, in a case study of 5.9 million scientific texts from 2016--2026, MELD's prediction scores remain stable through 2022 and increase from 2023 onward, coinciding with the widespread adoption of LLM-based writing tools. The model, MELD-eval pool, source code, and live demo are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MELD 在类均衡的、按生成器家族划分的 AI-文本 vs 人类文本多任务上训练，共享人类写作表示，单次前向同时输出检测、生成器家族、改写任务与 token 级预测，并对格式重排不变。在 MELD-eval（四个前沿聊天模型构成的留出池）上无需微调即达 99.7% TPR @ 1% FPR，对训练中缺席家族的留出生成器为 98% TPR @ 1% FPR。
Motivation: 干净、同分布基准上的高 AUROC 不足以支撑实际部署：检测器需抵抗对抗性改写、泛化到未见生成器与写作领域，并保持低误报率；而池化的 AI-vs-human 目标不显式要求区分生成器家族，难以学到泛化与归因所需的家族结构。
Method: 在类均衡、按生成器家族划分的多任务上训练并共享人类写作表示，单次前向输出检测、生成器家族、改写任务与 token 级预测；加入格式归一化使分数对所建模的重排操作不变。另提出 MELD-eval 留出测试池，由四个前沿聊天模型构成。
Result: 在公开 RAID 榜单开源提交中排名第一；在六个留出评测池中的五个上匹配或超过监督基线。MELD-eval 上无需进一步微调达 99.7% TPR @ 1% FPR，对训练中缺席家族的留出生成器为 98% TPR @ 同一 FPR。2016–2026 年 590 万篇科学文本的案例研究中，预测分数在 2022 年前稳定、自 2023 年起上升。
Conclusion: 按生成器家族拆分的类均衡多任务训练，加上格式归一化，可在不微调的前提下把 AI 生成文本检测泛化到未见生成器并保持低 FPR；分数时间序列可作为 LLM 写作工具普及的代理信号。

papers.title: Towards Fairness under Label Bias in Image Segmentation: Impact, Measurement and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Biases in annotation pipelines may introduce label bias: when annotation quality or style varies systematically across demographic subgroups, causing disparities in performance and auditability. Label bias in image segmentation remains underexplored, as even detecting it typically requires clean, unbiased annotations, which are not readily available. We present a Confident Learning framework adapted to segmentation for auditing label bias directly in the training data without a clean, unbiased ground truth. By comparing the provided training labels to the model's confident predictions, we measure the prevalence and direction of suspected label errors; where standard overlap metrics like Dice fail. We further show that label bias influences subgroup separability in the encoder's feature space, an artifact we leverage for bias mitigation rather than suppressing it. We evaluate three datasets spanning from synthetic to real-life bias and across experimental conditions, showing how our framework produces proxy audit signals without clean labels and mitigates disparities with a correctly identified cleaner reference group.
papers.comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Confident Learning 改造成分割版，用训练标签与模型高置信预测的比对在没有干净标注的情况下审计标签偏差，测出疑似标签错误的规模与方向，并利用标签偏差在编码器特征空间中造成的子群可分性做缓解。在三个覆盖合成到真实偏差的数据集上，该框架给出无干净标签的代理审计信号，且在正确指定更干净参考子群时能缩小子群间性能差距。
Motivation: 标注流水线的质量与风格随子群系统性变化会带来标签偏差，但检测它通常需要干净、无偏的标注，而这类标注恰恰拿不到，导致分割中的标签偏差长期缺乏审计手段。
Method: 将 Confident Learning 适配到图像分割：把给定训练标签与模型的 confident predictions 对比，估计疑似标签错误的流行度与方向，作为 Dice 等重叠指标失效处的审计信号；同时利用标签偏差在编码器特征空间中留下的子群可分性作为缓解依据，并以指定的更干净参考子群进行去偏。
Result: 在三个从合成偏差到真实生活偏差的数据集、跨不同实验条件下，框架在无干净标签时产出代理审计信号，并在正确识别出更干净参考子群时缓解子群间差距；摘要给出的是定性结论，无具体数值。
Conclusion: 标签偏差可以在没有无偏真值的训练数据上被审计，而它在特征空间中造成的子群可分性可反过来用于缓解，前提是存在一个正确指定的更干净参考子群。

papers.title: Enabling Unsupervised Training of Deep EEG Denoisers With Intelligent Partitioning
papers.abstract_en: Denoising electroencephalogram (EEG) is an inherently challenging task, since neural activity is not only subtle but also inseparable from spectrally overlapping noise artifacts. Today, effective EEG denoising is more important than ever, given the rapid adoption of wearables across various applications. Deep learning methods have shown promising results in decomposition-free denoising that handles the time-varying pervasive EEG artifacts. However, training highly expressive neural networks requires artifact-free EEG, which is inherently unobtainable. To address this, we propose Intelligent Partitioning for Self-supervised Denoising (iPSD). Our method eliminates the need for clean references by learning to partition an input EEG segment into independent noisy realizations with the same underlying signal. This enables self-supervision of deep learning denoisers, even in zero-shot settings where only a single EEG segment to be denoised is available. We validate iPSD through extensive experiments, including validations on wearable EEG from in-ear sensors. The results show that iPSD achieves state-of-the-art performance, most notably under extremely low signal-to-noise ratios (down to -10 dB) and challenging artifacts (e.g., EMG), with spectral fidelity orders of magnitude higher than competitive baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 iPSD（Intelligent Partitioning for Self-supervised Denoising）：把一段含噪 EEG 切分成共享同一底层信号的多个独立噪声实现，从而无需干净参考即可自监督训练深度 EEG 去噪网络，甚至在只有一段待去噪信号的 zero-shot 场景下也能工作。在含耳内可穿戴 EEG 的实验中，SNR 低至 -10 dB、面对 EMG 等伪迹时达到 state-of-the-art，谱保真度 (spectral fidelity) 比竞争基线高出若干数量级。
Motivation: 深度 EEG 去噪网络需要无伪迹的干净 EEG 来训练，而干净参考本质上不可获得；可穿戴设备普及使这一瓶颈更突出。
Method: iPSD 通过学习把输入 EEG 段划分成共享同一底层信号的独立噪声实现，构造自监督信号来训练深度去噪器，无需干净参考，并支持仅有一段 EEG 的 zero-shot 设置。
Result: 在包括耳内可穿戴 EEG 在内的大量实验中达到 state-of-the-art，尤其在极低 SNR（低至 -10 dB）和 EMG 等困难伪迹下，谱保真度比竞争基线高出若干数量级。
Conclusion: 用智能划分构造同源噪声实现，可以替代干净参考来监督深度 EEG 去噪器，并在极低 SNR 与强肌电伪迹条件下取得最优表现。

papers.title: How Deep Can LLMs Learn to Reason? Expressiveness Is Key
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet the systematic study of how training scales with task difficulty has been hampered by the lack of controlled, scalable environments. Observed LLM shortcomings in long-horizon reasoning have raised the prospect that they are fundamental to the autoregressive transformer architecture. To address this, we introduce ScaleLogic, a synthetic logical reasoning framework that offers independent control over two axes of difficulty: the depth of the required proof planning (i.e., the horizon) and the expressiveness of the underlying formal system. Our proposed framework supports a wide range of logics: from simple implication-only logic ("if-then") towards more expressive first-order reasoning with conjunction (''and''), disjunction (''or''), negation (''not''), and universal quantification ("for all"). Using this framework, we show that the RL training compute $T$ follows a power law with respect to reasoning depth $D$ ($T \propto D^γ$, $R^{2} > 0.99$), and the scaling exponent $γ$ increases monotonically with expressiveness, from $1.05$ to $2.60$. On downstream mathematics and general reasoning benchmarks, more expressive training settings yield both larger performance gains (up to $+10.66$ points) and more compute-efficient transfer compared to less expressive settings, demonstrating that what a model is trained on, not just how much it is trained, shapes downstream transfer. We further show that the power-law relationship holds across multiple RL methods, and curriculum-based training substantially improves scaling efficiency. More broadly, our results suggest that LLM shortcomings in long-horizon reasoning are not fundamental to the underlying architecture, and could be addressed by improved training methodology and data.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 训练内容（表达力）与训练量同等决定下游迁移，长程推理不足并非架构根本限制，可由改进训练方法与数据缓解。

papers.title: Hindsight Compacts but Does Not Repair: Rethinking On-Policy Self-Distillation in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising post-training method: requiring only privileged context, it enables token-level credit assignment from a self-teacher with hindsight, yielding higher accuracy with shorter responses. However, in thinking-enabled mathematical reasoning, where solving a problem takes long reasoning traces that explore, reflect, and backtrack, its length reductions persist but its accuracy gains largely do not. Does OPSD's hindsight signal, then, still repair failed trajectories, or does it only compact viable ones? We hypothesize compaction: in long traces, hindsight reveals which steps were unnecessary more readily than which steps would have repaired the solution. To test this, we apply OPSD separately to correct and incorrect rollouts. Training only on correct rollouts shortens responses by 18-29% while largely preserving accuracy, whereas training only on incorrect rollouts degrades it. The accuracy gap holds across three models, six benchmarks, and three seeds, and under a same-prompt control for difficulty. Neither branch raises the pass@k ceiling, and both suppress exploration and reflection markers, which viable traces can spare but failed ones need. Changing the divergence, enriching or reinjecting the privileged context, and training longer only move OPSD along the same accuracy-length tradeoff. Hindsight compacts reasoning the model can already produce but does not repair reasoning it cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验 On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 的 hindsight 信号究竟是修复失败轨迹还是只压缩可行轨迹：只在正确 rollout 上训练可把回复缩短 18–29% 且基本保持准确率，只在错误 rollout 上训练则使准确率下降。作者据此主张 OPSD 只压缩模型本已能产出的推理，不能修复它不会的推理。
Motivation: OPSD 用带 hindsight 的自教师做 token 级 credit assignment，常被当作既提准确率又缩短回复的后训练手段；但在需要长推理轨迹的数学推理中，长度缩短仍在、准确率增益却基本消失，其 hindsight 信号到底起什么作用尚不清楚。
Method: 把 OPSD 分别只应用于正确 rollout 与只应用于错误 rollout 做对照，并加一个同 prompt 难度控制；在三个模型、六个基准、三种子上检验，同时统计 pass@k 上限与探索/反思标记的变化，再尝试改 divergence、丰富或回注 privileged context、延长训练。
Result: 只训正确 rollout：回复缩短 18–29% 且准确率基本保持；只训错误 rollout：准确率下降。该准确率差距在三个模型、六个基准、三种子及同 prompt 难度控制下均成立。两个分支都不抬高 pass@k 上限，且都抑制探索与反思标记；改 divergence、丰富或回注 privileged context、延长训练只让 OPSD 沿同一 accuracy-length 权衡移动。
Conclusion: hindsight 信号能压缩模型已经能产出的推理，但不能修复它不会的推理；OPSD 的长度收益与准确率收益在长推理场景中应分开看待。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Dual Tracking to Clipping: Provably Faster Distributionally Robust Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has received growing attention in applications that require learning under multiple criteria. However, most existing MOO formulations do not explicitly account for distributional shifts in the data. We introduce distributionally robust multi-objective optimization (DR-MOO), which minimizes multiple objectives under their respective worst-case distributions. We propose Pareto-type solution concepts for DR-MOO and develop multi-gradient descent algorithms (MGDA) with provable guarantees. Leveraging a Lagrangian dual reformulation, we first design a double-loop MGDA that uses an inner loop to estimate dual variables and achieves a total sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-8})$ for reaching an $ε$-Pareto-stationary point. To further improve convergence, we combine large-batch sampling with gradient clipping to accommodate generalized smoothness and control bias in stochastic preference updates, eliminating the need for double sampling. This yields a single-loop double-clip MGDA with substantially improved sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$. Our theory applies to nonconvex problems without requiring uniformly bounded gradients of the dual objectives. Experiments demonstrate that our methods are competitive with state-of-the-art MGDA baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分布鲁棒多目标优化 (DR-MOO)：在各目标的最坏分布下同时最小化多个目标，用 Pareto 型解概念定义 DR-MOO 的解，并给出带可证保证的多梯度下降算法 (MGDA)。基于 Lagrangian 对偶重构的双循环 MGDA 达到 ε-Pareto 稳定点的总样本复杂度为 O(ε^-8)；再用大批次采样加梯度裁剪处理广义光滑性并控制随机偏好更新的偏差，得到单循环双裁剪 MGDA，样本复杂度改进到 O(ε^-4)，且无需双重采样。
Motivation: 现有 MOO 公式大多不显式处理数据分布偏移，而多准则学习场景中分布偏移会直接破坏最坏情形下的目标表现；同时已有 MGDA 的随机收敛分析常依赖对偶目标梯度一致有界等较强假设。
Method: 先定义 DR-MOO 的 Pareto 型解概念，再经 Lagrangian 对偶重构设计双循环 MGDA，内循环估计对偶变量；进一步结合大批次采样与梯度裁剪以适应广义光滑性 (generalized smoothness) 并控制随机偏好更新中的偏差，得到单循环双裁剪 MGDA，免除双重采样。理论覆盖非凸问题，不要求对偶目标梯度一致有界。
Result: 双循环 MGDA 达到 ε-Pareto 稳定点的总样本复杂度为 O(ε^-8)；单循环双裁剪 MGDA 将样本复杂度改进至 O(ε^-4)。实验中该方法与最先进的 MGDA 基线相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 用对偶重构加大批次采样与梯度裁剪，可以在非凸、梯度不必一致有界的设定下把 DR-MOO 的样本复杂度从 O(ε^-8) 降到 O(ε^-4)，并免除双重采样。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving Idea Graphs with Learnable Edits-and-Commits for Multi-Agent Scientific Ideation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-empowered multi-agent systems offer new potential to accelerate scientific discovery by generating novel research ideas. However, existing methods typically coordinate agents through temporary texts, such as drafts or chat logs; it is difficult to pinpoint the weaknesses in the generated ideas and how the agents refine them. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Evolving Idea Graphs} (EIG), a graph-based multi-agent scientific ideation framework that can generate high-performance research ideas across various benchmark-native metrics, such as novelty, feasibility, and clarity. Instead of coordinating solely through texts, EIG represents a partially formed proposal as an evolving idea graph, where nodes capture scientific claims and edges encode relations (e.g., support and conflict), enabling unresolved weaknesses to remain identifiable throughout the idea evolving process. Specifically, a learned two-head controller operates over the evolving graph to guide the ideation: one head selects graph edits for agents to execute, while the other decides when the graph is ready for commit as final proposal synthesis. On AI Idea Bench 2025 and LiveIdeaBench, EIG outperforms all compared systems on both automatic benchmark scores and blinded expert ratings. Ablations show that the graph-based state, its typed relations, and the learned edit-and-commit control each contribute to final proposal quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EIG 把多智能体科研构思的中间产物从临时文本换成持续演化的 idea graph，节点存科学主张、边存支持/冲突关系，由学习得到的双头控制器决定执行哪些图编辑以及何时提交为最终提案。在 AI Idea Bench 2025 与 LiveIdeaBench 上，EIG 在自动基准分数和盲评专家打分两套口径下都超过全部对比系统，消融显示图状态、带类型的关系、学习式 edit-and-commit 控制各自都对最终提案质量有贡献。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体构思方法只靠草稿或聊天记录这类临时文本协调，弱点藏在文本里，既难定位想法的具体缺陷，也难追踪智能体如何修补它。
Method: 把半成品提案表示为 evolving idea graph：节点是科学主张，边是支持、冲突等带类型关系，使未解决的弱点在演化过程中始终可定位。学习得到的两头控制器作用于该图，一头选择让智能体执行的图编辑，另一头判断图何时可 commit 为最终提案综合。
Result: 在 AI Idea Bench 2025 与 LiveIdeaBench 上，EIG 在自动基准分数（novelty、feasibility、clarity 等 benchmark-native metrics）与盲评专家打分两套评价下均超过所有对比系统；消融表明图状态、带类型关系、学习式 edit-and-commit 控制三者各自都贡献最终提案质量。
Conclusion: 用带类型关系的图而非文本承载构思状态，并让学习控制器同时调度编辑与提交时机，能提升多智能体科研构思产出的 novelty、feasibility 与 clarity。

papers.title: LAGO: Language-Guided Adaptive Object-Region Focus for Zero-Shot Visual-Text Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot visual recognition often depends on localized parts, attributes, and textures that are diluted in global image representations. Existing training-free localized methods alleviate this limitation by evaluating multiple image regions, but their candidate locations are typically generated before class semantics determine where to look, restricting language to post-hoc scoring of already sampled evidence. We introduce LAGO (LAnguage-Guided adaptive Object-region focus), which reframes localized recognition as language-guided directed region discovery. LAGO first establishes a compact, class-agnostic object-centric visual initialization, then constructs a soft semantic prototype from the intermediate prediction to actively steer subsequent search toward class-relevant evidence during inference. This object-first, language-second design addresses the circular dependence between recognizing a class and locating its supporting evidence, while preserving complementary local, contextual, and global cues. Across standard and distribution-shift benchmarks, LAGO transfers with a single fixed configuration and uses candidate regions more effectively under matched budgets. Controlled experiments further isolate the proposed mechanism, showing that allowing language to alter the search trajectory retrieves more relevant regions and improves recognition over applying the same semantic signal only after candidate generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAGO 把零样本局部识别重写为语言引导的定向区域发现：先做类无关的 object-centric 视觉初始化，再用中间预测构造软语义原型，在推理时主动改变后续搜索方向。受控实验显示，让语言改变搜索轨迹比把同一语义信号只用于候选生成后的打分能检索到更相关区域并提升识别，且在匹配预算下更高效地使用候选区域。
Motivation: 零样本识别依赖局部部件、属性与纹理，但这些信息在全局图像表征中被稀释；现有 training-free 局部方法先生成候选区域、再让语言做事后打分，语言无法决定该看哪里。
Method: LAGO（LAnguage-Guided adaptive Object-region focus）两阶段：先建立紧凑、类无关的 object-centric 视觉初始化，再从中间预测构造软语义原型 (soft semantic prototype)，在推理中引导搜索转向类相关证据，同时保留局部、上下文与全局线索；属 training-free 方法，采用单一固定配置。
Result: 在标准与分布偏移 (distribution-shift) 两类基准上，LAGO 以单一固定配置迁移，并在匹配预算下更有效地使用候选区域；受控实验隔离了所提机制，显示让语言改变搜索轨迹比仅在候选生成后施加同一语义信号能检索到更相关区域并改善识别。
Conclusion: object-first、language-second 的设计能解开识别类别与定位证据之间的循环依赖，语言应在搜索过程中改变轨迹而非只做事后评分。

summary_sections.motivation: 零样本识别依赖局部部件、属性与纹理，但这些信息在全局图像表征中被稀释；现有 training-free 局部方法先生成候选区域、再让语言做事后打分，语言无法决定该看哪里。

summary_sections.result: 在标准与分布偏移 (distribution-shift) 两类基准上，LAGO 以单一固定配置迁移，并在匹配预算下更有效地使用候选区域；受控实验隔离了所提机制，显示让语言改变搜索轨迹比仅在候选生成后施加同一语义信号能检索到更相关区域并改善识别。
summary_sections.conclusion: object-first、language-second 的设计能解开识别类别与定位证据之间的循环依赖，语言应在搜索过程中改变轨迹而非只做事后评分。

papers.title: MooD: Perception-Enhanced Efficient Affective Image Editing via Continuous Valence-Arousal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Affective Image Editing (AIE) aims to modify visual content to evoke targeted emotions. Although current approaches achieve impressive editing quality, they often overlook inference efficiency, which limits their applicability in computational social scenarios. Moreover, most methods depend on discrete emotion representations, which hinder the continuous modeling of complex human emotions and constrain expressive capabilities in interactive scenarios. To tackle these gaps, we propose MooD, the first VA-driven framework that directly leverages continuous Valence-Arousal (VA) values as editing instructions for fine-grained and efficient AIE in computational social systems. Specifically, we first introduce a VA-Aware Retrieval strategy to bridge vague affective values and detailed visual semantics. Building upon this, MooD integrates visual transfer and perception-enhanced semantic guidance to achieve controllable AIE. Furthermore, considering that existing VA-annotated datasets mainly focus on social scenarios and largely overlook natural scenes, we therefore construct AffectSet, a comprehensive VA-annotated dataset covering diverse scenarios, to support model optimization and evaluation. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experimental results demonstrate that our MooD achieves superior performance in both affective controllability and visual fidelity while maintaining high efficiency. A series of ablation studies further reveals the crucial factors of our introduced design. Our code is available at https://github.com/XinyiYin/MooD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MooD 是首个以连续 Valence-Arousal (VA) 值直接作为编辑指令的情感图像编辑 (AIE) 框架，用 VA-Aware Retrieval 把模糊情感值桥接到具体视觉语义，再结合视觉迁移与感知增强语义引导实现细粒度可控编辑。作者另构建覆盖多样场景的 VA 标注数据集 AffectSet，实验显示其在情感可控性与视觉保真上更优且保持高效率。
Motivation: 现有 AIE 方法推理效率低，限制其在计算社会场景中的应用；且多数依赖离散情绪表示，无法连续建模复杂人类情感，交互场景表达力受限。
Method: 提出 VA-Aware Retrieval 策略桥接模糊情感值与视觉语义，在其上集成视觉迁移与感知增强语义 guidance 实现可控编辑；同时构建 VA 标注数据集 AffectSet 覆盖自然场景等多样场景，用于模型优化与评估，并做一系列消融研究检验各设计要素。
Result: 定性与定量实验显示 MooD 在情感可控性与视觉保真两方面均取得更优表现，同时保持高效率；消融研究揭示了所引入设计中的关键因素。
Conclusion: 用连续 VA 值替代离散情绪标签作为编辑指令，配合检索式语义桥接，可在计算社会系统中同时兼顾细粒度情感控制、画质与推理效率。
