papers.title: VUDA: Enabling Controlled Spatial Sharing of Graphics and Compute on NVIDIA GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Graphics and compute increasingly share a single GPU in embodied AI simulators, AI-enabled games, and VR systems. Running these workloads concurrently can improve utilization, but contention can also compromise rendering and inference latency. Effective sharing therefore requires control over both concurrency and resource allocation. Native CUDA and Vulkan runtimes complicate this task: they place work in separate scheduling domains, while compute-oriented resource controls do not govern the graphics pipeline. We present VUDA, a system that enables controlled spatial sharing of native CUDA compute and Vulkan graphics on NVIDIA GPUs. An analysis of GPU scheduling, address translation, and workload dispatch reveals how to coordinate the two execution stacks without replacing either one. VUDA redirects CUDA channels into Vulkan's scheduling domain while preserving the runtimes' separate data address spaces. It then uses GPU front-end controls to partition execution resources between the graphics and compute pipelines, with allocations adjustable at runtime. Together, these mechanisms let applications control resource sharing without modifying GPU drivers or rewriting kernels and shaders. We evaluate VUDA across four application scenarios on three NVIDIA GPU platforms, covering throughput and latency objectives for graphics, compute, or both. In embodied AI simulation, enabling concurrency improves throughput by up to $1.62\times$ over the same asynchronous pipeline under default time sharing. In driving perception, partitioned co-execution reduces the measured inference-budget miss rate from 80.1% to zero while sustaining 60-FPS rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VUDA 在不改驱动、不重写 kernel/shader 的前提下，把 CUDA 通道重定向进 Vulkan 的调度域并保留两者独立地址空间，再用 GPU 前端控制在图形与计算管线间动态划分执行资源。在具身 AI 仿真中并发相对默认时间共享最高提升 1.62 倍吞吐；驾驶感知场景下分区共执行把推理预算超限率从 80.1% 降到 0，同时维持 60 FPS 渲染。
Motivation: 具身 AI 仿真、AI 游戏与 VR 中图形与计算共用单 GPU，争用会破坏渲染与推理延迟；原生 CUDA 与 Vulkan 分属不同调度域，面向计算的资源控制管不到图形管线，因而无法同时控制并发度与资源分配。
Method: 分析 GPU 调度、地址翻译与负载分发，把 CUDA channel 重定向进 Vulkan 调度域同时保留两套数据地址空间；再用 GPU 前端控制在图形与计算管线间划分执行资源，分配可在运行时调整，无需修改驱动或重写 kernel/shader。
Result: 在三个 NVIDIA GPU 平台、四个应用场景上评测吞吐与延迟目标：具身 AI 仿真中启用并发相对同一异步管线的默认时间共享吞吐最高提升 1.62 倍；驾驶感知中分区共执行把实测推理预算超限率从 80.1% 降到 0，同时保持 60 FPS 渲染。
Conclusion: 在不替换任一运行时的前提下协调 CUDA 与 Vulkan 两个执行栈，即可让应用在运行时控制图形与计算的空间共享，兼顾吞吐与延迟预算。

papers.title: Sliced-Regularized Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new regularized optimal transport (OT) formulation, termed sliced-regularized optimal transport (SROT). Unlike entropic OT (EOT), which regularizes the transport plan toward an independent coupling, SROT regularizes it toward a smoothened sliced OT (SOT) plan. To the best of our knowledge, SROT is the first approach to leverage a version of SOT plan as a reference to improve classical OT. We provide a formal definition of SROT, derive its dual formulation, and provide a post-Bayesian interpretation of SROT. We then develop a Sinkhorn-style algorithm for efficient computation, retaining the same scalability advantages as EOT. By incorporating a scalable SOT plan as a prior, SROT yields more accurate approximations of the exact OT plan than EOT under the same level of regularization. Moreover, the resulting transport plan improves upon the reference SOT plan itself. We further introduce the corresponding OT divergence induced by SROT, named SROT divergence, and analyze its topological and computational properties. Finally, we validate our approach through experiments on synthetic datasets and color transfer tasks, demonstrating that SROT is better than both EOT and SOT in approximating exact OT. Additional experiments on gradient flows further highlight the advantages of SROT divergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 sliced-regularized optimal transport (SROT)：把传输计划正则化到平滑的 sliced OT (SOT) 计划上，而非 EOT 那样的独立耦合。给出形式定义、对偶与后贝叶斯解释，配 Sinkhorn 式算法保持与 EOT 同级可扩展性；在合成数据与颜色迁移上比 EOT 和 SOT 更接近精确 OT，并导出 SROT divergence 用于梯度流。
Motivation: EOT 把传输计划拉向独立耦合，正则化强了会偏离精确 OT；SOT 计算可扩展但本身只是近似，缺少用它当参考来改进经典 OT 的正则化框架。
Method: 以可扩展的平滑 SOT 计划作为先验参考定义 SROT，推导其对偶形式并给出后贝叶斯解释；设计 Sinkhorn 式迭代算法求解，计算复杂度与 EOT 相当；另定义 SROT 诱导的 divergence 并分析其拓扑与计算性质。
Result: 在同等正则化强度下，SROT 对精确 OT 计划的近似比 EOT 更准，且优于作为参考的 SOT 计划本身；合成数据集与颜色迁移任务上的实验显示 SROT 在逼近精确 OT 上同时优于 EOT 与 SOT，梯度流实验进一步体现 SROT divergence 的优势。
Conclusion: 用 SOT 计划而非独立耦合做正则化参考，能在保持 EOT 级可扩展性的同时得到更准的 OT 近似，并产生可用于梯度流的新 divergence。

papers.title: Learning Evidence Highlighting for Frozen LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason well, yet often miss decisive evidence when it is buried in long, noisy contexts. We introduce HiLight, an Evidence Emphasis framework that decouples evidence selection from reasoning for frozen LLM solvers. HiLight avoids compressing or rewriting the input, which can discard or distort evidence, by training a lightweight Emphasis Actor to insert minimal highlight tags around pivotal spans in the unaltered context. A frozen Solver then performs downstream reasoning on the emphasized input. We cast highlighting as a weakly supervised decision-making problem and optimize the Actor with reinforcement learning using only the Solver's task reward, requiring no evidence labels and no access to or modification of the Solver. Across sequential recommendation and long-context question answering, HiLight consistently improves performance over strong prompt-based and automated prompt-optimization baselines. The learned emphasis policy transfers zero-shot to both smaller and larger unseen Solver families, including an API-based Solver, suggesting that the Actor captures genuine, reusable evidence structure rather than overfitting to a single backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiLight 为冻结 LLM 提出证据高亮框架：训练轻量 Emphasis Actor 在不改写的长上下文里插入最小 highlight 标签，再由冻结 Solver 做推理。在序列推荐与长上下文问答上稳定优于强提示基线与自动提示优化基线，且高亮策略零样本迁移到更小和更大的未见 Solver 家族（含 API Solver）。
Motivation: LLM 在长而嘈杂的上下文中推理时常常漏掉决定性证据；直接压缩或改写输入会丢弃或扭曲证据，而调 Solver 又受限于其冻结或闭源。
Method: 把证据选择与推理解耦：Emphasis Actor 只插入最小 highlight 标签、不压缩不改写原文；将高亮建模为弱监督决策问题，仅用 Solver 的任务奖励做强化学习优化，无需证据标签，也不接触或修改 Solver；随后由冻结 Solver 在强调后的输入上完成下游推理。
Result: 在序列推荐与长上下文问答两个任务上，HiLight 相对强提示 (prompt-based) 基线与自动提示优化基线均一致提升性能；学到的强调策略零样本迁移到更小与更大的未见 Solver 家族，包括一个基于 API 的 Solver。
Conclusion: 证据高亮可以与推理分离并只靠下游奖励训练，学到的强调策略捕捉的是可复用的证据结构而非对单一 backbone 的过拟合，因此能跨 Solver 规模与来源迁移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Demystifying the Unreasonable Effectiveness of Greedy Alignment Methods
papers.abstract_en: Greedy AI alignment methods based on Bradley-Terry reward-model fitting and KL-regularized Alignment are remarkably effective in both offline and online preference-learning pipelines, yet existing O(log T) online and O(1/epsilon) offline KL-regularized regret rate guarantees can seem pessimistic relative to their empirical performance. We argue that this mismatch reflects a distinction between two learning targets: KL-regularized regret measures how fast we can recover the KL-regularized aligned policy, whereas we often only ask how fast we can learn the reward function that induces the correct best response. To isolate this reward-learning component, we study the traditional temperature-zero regret criterion, which evaluates only the top-ranked response at inference time. Under realizability, compactness, and a uniform best-response margin over the fitted reward class, we prove that exact reference-logged offline RLHF achieves exponentially small expected temperature-zero regret, and therefore reaches expected regret at most epsilon with O(log(1ε)) offline comparisons. We also prove that exact greedy online RLHF achieves bounded O(1) cumulative temperature-zero regret; the same guarantee extends to its equivalent pairwise online DPO formulation. By separating selector identification from full soft-policy recovery, our results provide a sharper theoretical explanation for the empirical efficiency of greedy alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出 KL 正则化 regret 的 O(log T) 在线与 O(1/epsilon) 离线界之所以显得悲观，是因为它衡量的是恢复完整 KL 正则对齐策略的速度，而实践中往往只需学到能诱导正确 best response 的奖励函数。在 realizability、compactity 与一致 best-response margin 假设下，精确 reference-logged 离线 RLHF 的 temperature-zero regret 指数级小，达到期望 regret 不超过 epsilon 只需 O(log(1/epsilon)) 次离线比较；精确贪心在线 RLHF 的累计 temperature-zero regret 为 O(1)，该保证可等价推广到 pairwise 在线 DPO。
Motivation: Bradley-Terry 奖励模型拟合加 KL 正则的贪心对齐在离线与在线偏好学习中经验上非常高效，但现有 O(log T) 在线与 O(1/epsilon) 离线 regret 界与实测表现差距大，理论无法解释这种不合理有效性。
Method: 把 KL 正则 regret 拆成奖励学习与软策略恢复两部分，只保留 temperature-zero regret 准则（推理时仅评估排名第一的响应）；在 realizability、奖励类 compactity 与一致 best-response margin 下，分别分析精确 reference-logged 离线 RLHF 与精确贪心在线 RLHF，并把在线结论等价转写到 pairwise DPO 形式。
Result: 精确 reference-logged 离线 RLHF 达到指数级小的期望 temperature-zero regret，用 O(log(1/epsilon)) 次离线比较即可使期望 regret 不超过 epsilon；精确贪心在线 RLHF 的累计 temperature-zero regret 为 O(1)，同一保证适用于等价的 pairwise 在线 DPO 公式。

papers.title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is an effective post-training paradigm for large language models but requires a live teacher server throughout training, resulting in substantial infrastructure overhead. We investigate whether OPD can be performed offline by precomputing teacher log-probabilities once over SFT rollouts and reusing them during training. We find that naively doing so fails to reliably match standard OPD, and trace the root cause to a previously overlooked condition we term teacher consistency, requiring that the same teacher be used for both supervised fine-tuning and OPD. Violating this condition introduces a gradient bias that degrades performance for both offline and online OPD. Building on this insight, we propose Lightning OPD, an offline on-policy distillation framework that enforces teacher consistency and eliminates the need for a live teacher server entirely. We prove that, under teacher consistency, Lightning OPD shares the same optimum as standard OPD, with bounded gradient discrepancy and an implicit regularization effect that helps prevent policy drift. Experiments on math reasoning and code generation show that Lightning OPD achieves comparable performance to standard OPD while delivering 4.0x higher training efficiency. Starting from an SFT-initialized Qwen3-8B-Base model, Lightning OPD reaches 69.9% on AIME 2024 in just 30 GPU hours. Lightning OPD further scales to MoE architectures, training Qwen3-30B-A3B to 71.0% on AIME 2024 on a single 8xH100 node, substantially lowering the barrier for academic research on LLM post-training. Our code is released at https://github.com/jet-ai-projects/Lightning-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lightning OPD 把 on-policy distillation 的 teacher log-probability 在 SFT rollout 上一次性离线预计算，训练全程不再需要常驻 teacher server。关键前提是 teacher consistency：SFT 与 OPD 必须用同一个 teacher，否则引入梯度偏置，离线和在线 OPD 都掉点。在该条件下与标准 OPD 同最优、梯度偏差有界，数学与代码任务上性能相当而训练效率高 4.0 倍，Qwen3-8B-Base 起步 30 GPU 小时达 AIME 2024 69.9%。
Motivation: 标准 on-policy distillation 全程要挂一个活的 teacher server，基础设施开销大；直接离线复用预计算 log-prob 又无法稳定复现在线 OPD 的效果，此前原因不明。
Method: 先在 SFT rollout 上离线预计算 teacher log-probabilities，训练时复用；提出并强制 teacher consistency（SFT 与 OPD 用同一 teacher），并证明此时与标准 OPD 共享同一最优解、梯度偏差有界且带隐式正则抑制 policy drift。
Result: 数学推理与代码生成上性能与标准 OPD 相当，训练效率高 4.0 倍；从 SFT 初始化的 Qwen3-8B-Base 在 30 GPU 小时内达 AIME 2024 69.9%；扩展到 MoE，Qwen3-30B-A3B 在单个 8xH100 节点上达 AIME 2024 71.0%。
Conclusion: 离线 OPD 可行的前提是 teacher consistency，满足它就能在去掉常驻 teacher server 的同时保住标准 OPD 的效果并大幅降低训练成本。

papers.title: EffiPair: Improving the Efficiency of LLM-generated Code with Differential Execution Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate functionally correct programs that differ substantially in execution efficiency. Existing inference-time optimization methods typically refine each candidate using pointwise runtime or profiling feedback, which identifies how costly an implementation is or where the cost arises, but offers limited guidance on how the computation should change. We introduce DIFFERENTIAL EXECUTION FEEDBACK (DEF), which compares implementations that are nearby in structural program space but separated in performance, turning their execution and implementation differences into directional optimization evidence. We demonstrate DEF in EffiPair, a training-free, test-time framework that pairs structurally similar programs with different efficiencies, distills their relative execution behavior into compact feedback, and iteratively refines a candidate pool. Across EvalPerf, Mercury, and ENAMEL, using GPT-4o mini, DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash, and GPT-5 mini, EffiPair achieves the highest value on each benchmark's official efficiency metric in all nine model-benchmark settings under matched evaluation conditions. Moreover, two contrastive refinement rounds improve efficiency over the selected initial draft in every setting while preserving or improving Pass@1. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of relational execution feedback as a lightweight signal for test-time code optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EffiPair 用差分执行反馈 (Differential Execution Feedback, DEF) 在结构相近但效率不同的程序对之间做对比，把相对执行行为蒸馏成紧凑反馈，迭代精炼候选池。在 EvalPerf、Mercury、ENAMEL 三个基准 × GPT-4o mini、DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash、GPT-5 mini 共九个设置上，官方效率指标全部取到最高值，两轮对比精炼在每个设置都提升效率且保持或提高 Pass@1。
Motivation: LLM 能生成功能正确但执行效率差异很大的程序；现有推理时优化只用逐点 runtime/profiling 反馈，说明代价多大、出在哪里，却几乎不指示计算该怎么改。
Method: DEF 挑选结构程序空间中邻近、性能分离的实现对，把执行与实现差异转成方向性优化证据；EffiPair 是 training-free 的 test-time 框架，配对结构相似而效率不同的程序，蒸馏相对执行行为为紧凑反馈，迭代精炼候选池。
Result: 在 EvalPerf、Mercury、ENAMEL 上，用 GPT-4o mini、DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash、GPT-5 mini，在匹配评估条件下九个模型-基准设置的官方效率指标均取到最高值；两轮对比精炼相对所选初始草稿在每个设置都提升效率，同时保持或提高 Pass@1。
Conclusion: 关系型（差分）执行反馈可作为测试时代码优化的轻量信号，在不训练的前提下同时改善效率与 Pass@1。

papers.title: Relative Density Ratio Optimization for Stable and Statistically Consistent Model Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning language models with human preferences is essential for ensuring their safety and reliability. Although most existing approaches assume specific human preference models such as the Bradley-Terry model, this assumption may fail to accurately capture true human preferences, and consequently, these methods lack statistical consistency, i.e., the guarantee that language models converge to the true human preference as the number of samples increases. In contrast, direct density ratio optimization (DDRO) achieves statistical consistency without assuming any human preference models. DDRO models the density ratio between preferred and non-preferred data distributions using the language model, and then optimizes it via density ratio estimation. However, this density ratio is unstable and often diverges, leading to training instability of DDRO. In this paper, we propose a novel alignment method that is both stable and statistically consistent. Our approach is based on the relative density ratio between the preferred data distribution and a mixture of the preferred and non-preferred data distributions. Our approach is stable since this relative density ratio is bounded above and does not diverge. Moreover, it is statistically consistent and yields significantly tighter convergence guarantees than DDRO. We experimentally show its effectiveness with Qwen 2.5 and Llama 3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出相对密度比优化 (Relative Density Ratio Optimization, RDRO)：把偏好数据分布与偏好/非偏好混合分布之间的相对密度比作为建模对象，该比值有上界因而不发散，训练比 DDRO 稳定，同时保持统计一致性并给出比 DDRO 更紧的收敛保证。在 Qwen 2.5 与 Llama 3 上实验验证其有效性。
Motivation: DDRO 不假设 Bradley-Terry 等特定人类偏好模型因而具备统计一致性，但它建模的偏好/非偏好分布密度比不稳定、常发散，导致训练不稳定。
Method: 用语言模型建模偏好分布与偏好、非偏好混合分布之间的相对密度比，再通过密度 ratio estimation 优化；该比值有上界，避免 DDRO 中密度比发散，并推导出比 DDRO 更紧的收敛保证。
Result: 相对密度比有上界、不发散，训练稳定；统计一致性得以保持，收敛保证显著紧于 DDRO；实验在 Qwen 2.5 与 Llama 3 上展示方法有效性。
Conclusion: 以有界的相对密度比替代无界密度比，可以在不引入人类偏好模型假设的前提下同时获得训练稳定性与统计一致性，且收敛保证更紧。

papers.title: An Inspectable LLM Council for Multi-Model Research Answer Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Long-form research questions often require a single answer that combines details, reconciles conflicting estimates, and retains qualifications spread across several large language model (LLM) outputs. We present an inspectable LLM Council that separates synthesis into two stages: an analyst converts three independent candidate answers into a structured state, and a writer composes the final response from that state. We evaluate the workflow under closed-book conditions on 100 tasks from the Deep Research Accuracy, Completeness, and Objectivity (DRACO) benchmark, retaining 600 final answers, 100 analyst states, and 720 whole-answer judgments across the main and supplementary experiments. Under the primary rubric judge, Council scores 70.98, exceeding GPT and Gemini by 6.18 and 8.34 points; its 0.47-point difference from Claude has a 95% paired interval of $[-0.69,1.61]$. In the full supplementary comparison, Council scores 1.87 points above direct fusion (95% paired interval $[0.33,3.48]$) and covers 51.1% of positive rubric criteria covered by exactly one candidate, compared with 43.7% for direct fusion. On an exploratory 68-task subset with matching returned model labels, direct fusion scores higher, so the full comparison cannot isolate the analyst state's effect. Traced cases show how estimates, provenance qualifications, and selection decisions pass through the saved state into final answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可检视的 LLM Council：三个独立候选答案先由 analyst 压成结构化 state，再由 writer 据此撰写最终回答，使估计值、来源限定与取舍决策可沿保存的 state 追溯。在 DRACO 基准 100 个任务的闭卷设定下，Council 得分 70.98，比 GPT 与 Gemini 分别高 6.18 与 8.34 分，与 Claude 差 0.47 分（95% 配对区间 [-0.69,1.61]）。
Motivation: 长程研究问题需要把分散在多个 LLM 大输出中的细节、冲突估计与限定条件合成单一答案，直接融合难以追溯中间判断。
Method: 两阶段流水线：analyst 把三个独立候选答案转成结构化 state，writer 仅依据该 state 生成最终回答；在 DRACO 基准 100 个任务上闭卷评测，保留 600 份最终答案、100 份 analyst state 与 720 条整答判定，主实验用 rubric judge 打分。
Result: Council 得分 70.98，超 GPT 6.18 分、超 Gemini 8.34 分，与 Claude 差 0.47 分（95% 配对区间 [-0.69,1.61]）；补充全量比较中比 direct fusion 高 1.87 分（95% 配对区间 [0.33,3.48]），覆盖 51.1% 仅被单个候选命中的正向 rubric 条目（direct fusion 43.7%）；在 68 个模型标签匹配的探索性子集上 direct fusion 反而更高，故全量比较无法分离 analyst state 的净效应。
Conclusion: 结构化中间 state 能把候选间的估计与限定条件带进最终答案并使其可检视，但在模型标签匹配的子集上优势消失，state 的独立贡献尚未被隔离。

papers.title: Product-Stability: Provable Convergence for Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: Empirically, modern deep learning training often occurs at the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the sharpness of the loss exceeds the threshold below which classical convergence analysis applies. Despite recent progress, existing theoretical explanations of EoS either rely on restrictive assumptions or focus on specific squared-loss-type objectives. In this work, we introduce and study a structural property of loss functions that we term product-stability. We show that for losses with product-stable minima, gradient descent applied to objectives of the form $(x,y) \mapsto l(xy)$ can provably converge to the local minimum even when training in the EoS regime. This framework substantially generalizes prior results and applies to a broad class of losses, including binary cross entropy. Using bifurcation diagrams, we characterize the resulting training dynamics, explain the emergence of stable oscillations, and precisely quantify the sharpness at convergence. Together, our results offer a principled explanation for stable EoS training for a wider class of loss functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出损失函数的 product-stability 结构性质：对形如 (x,y)↦l(xy) 且极小值点 product-stable 的目标，梯度下降即使在 Edge of Stability（sharpness 超出经典收敛分析阈值）也能收敛到局部极小。用分岔图刻画训练动力学、解释稳定振荡的出现，并精确量化收敛处的 sharpness。
Motivation: 现代深度学习训练常发生在 EoS 区间，sharpness 超出经典收敛分析适用阈值；已有 EoS 理论要么假设过强，要么只覆盖平方损失类目标。
Method: 定义损失函数的 product-stability 性质，针对 (x,y)↦l(xy) 形式的目标证明梯度下降在 EoS 区间下的局部极小收敛；用 bifurcation diagram 刻画训练动力学与稳定振荡，并解析量化收敛时的 sharpness。
Result: 证明覆盖一大类损失（含 binary cross entropy），显著推广既有结果；给出稳定振荡出现的动力学解释与收敛 sharpness 的精确刻画。

papers.title: AromaGen: Interactive Generation of Rich Olfactory Experiences with Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Smell's connections with food, memory, and social experience have motivated researchers to bring olfaction into interactive systems. Multimodal AI opens new possibilities for generating smells from natural language, yet it remains unclear whether pretrained models encode sufficient olfactory knowledge to translate language into perceptible compositions. We present AromaGen, an AI-powered 12-channel wearable olfactory system that maps free-form natural-language descriptions to 12 base odorants selected to cover a semantically derived olfactory space, while supporting iterative refinement through natural-language feedback. In a between-subjects study (N=60) across 50 real-world benchmark smells, participants distinguished AromaGen-generated target smells above chance in a three-alternative forced-choice task, with retrieval-augmented AI composition performing comparably to human-expert composition and zero-shot AI composition. Natural-language feedback significantly improved the perceived similarity of both AI- and human-expert compositions. Our findings demonstrate the feasibility of using pretrained multimodal AI, with human aroma composition data, to generate perceptible olfactory experiences from natural language.

papers.title: The Model Says Walk: Measuring whether LLMs Condition on Hidden Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Asked whether to walk or drive to a car wash 50 m away, most language models say walk, forgetting that the car has to be there. Such failures are usually measured by accuracy on questions where the hidden constraint applies. We show that this is misleading: a model can answer these questions correctly without reasoning about the constraint at all, simply by favoring the cautious option. We instead ask whether a model's decision changes when the constraint is removed. We test this at three levels of control: log-probability sweeps on open-weight models, a 500-prompt stress test, and CORE, a new human-validated benchmark of minimal constraint-present/constraint-absent pairs. The picture is consistent. The constraint nudges decisions rather than governing them. Models still miss presence constraints like the car wash, yet elsewhere they apply constraints that are not there. As a result, standard accuracy flatters all ten models we evaluate and reorders their ranking, and prompting fixes that look effective largely vanish under paired scoring. Claims about hidden-constraint reasoning need paired evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出用「约束生效题」的准确率衡量 LLM 隐含约束推理是误导性的：模型可以靠偏好谨慎选项答对而不真正读取约束。改用成对评分（约束在场/缺席的最小对照对）后，约束只是轻微推动决策而非支配决策，十个模型的标准准确率都被高估且排名被重排，提示工程带来的改进在成对评分下基本消失。
Motivation: 现有评测只看约束生效题的准确率，无法区分「真的用了约束」与「碰巧选了保守答案」，导致对隐含约束推理能力的判断失真。
Method: 三层控制手段：开源模型上的 log-probability 扫描、500 条 prompt 的压力测试，以及新基准 CORE——人工校验的最小「约束在场/约束缺席」成对样本；用成对评分替代标准准确率。
Result: log-prob 扫描、500-prompt 压力测试与 CORE 基准结论一致：约束对决策只是 nudge 而非支配；模型仍会漏掉洗车这类 presence 约束，却在别处套用并不存在的约束；标准准确率高估全部十个被评模型并改变其排名，提示工程的改进在成对评分下 largely vanish。
Conclusion: 关于隐含约束推理的任何主张都需要成对证据（约束在场 vs 缺席的对照），单看准确率不足以支撑。

papers.title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by leveraging pre-trained vision-language backbones. However, in downstream robotic settings, they are typically fine-tuned with limited data, leading to overfitting to specific instruction formulations and leaving robustness to paraphrased instructions underexplored. To study this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Para, a controlled benchmark that independently varies action expressions and object references for fine-grained analysis of linguistic generalization. Across seven VLA configurations (0.6B-7.5B), we observe consistent performance degradation of 22-52 pp under paraphrasing. This degradation is primarily driven by object-level lexical variation: even simple synonym substitutions cause large drops, indicating reliance on surface-level matching rather than semantic grounding. Moreover, 80-96% of failures arise from planning-level trajectory divergence rather than execution errors, showing that paraphrasing disrupts task identification. Binary success rate treats all paraphrases equally, obscuring whether models perform consistently across difficulty levels or rely on easier cases. To address this, we propose PRIDE, a metric that quantifies paraphrase difficulty using semantic and syntactic factors. Our benchmark and corresponding code are available at: https://github.com/cau-hai-lab/LIBERO-Para
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference (Oral Presentation). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/cau-hai-lab/LIBERO-Para
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIBERO-Para 是针对 VLA 模型改写鲁棒性的受控基准，独立改变动作表达与物体指称。在 7 个 VLA 配置（0.6B–7.5B）上改写导致 22–52 pp 的成功率下降，且 80–96% 的失败源于规划层轨迹发散而非执行错误；作者据此提出按语义与句法难度加权的指标 PRIDE。
Motivation: VLA 模型在下游机器人任务上常用有限数据微调，过拟合到特定指令措辞，改写指令下的鲁棒性缺乏受控、可细粒度归因的评测。
Method: 构建受控基准 LIBERO-Para，独立变化动作表达与物体指称以做语言泛化的细粒度分析，覆盖 7 个 VLA 配置（0.6B–7.5B）；并提出 PRIDE 指标，用语义与句法因子量化改写难度，替代把所有改写等同看待的二元成功率。
Result: 改写下性能一致下降 22–52 pp；退化主要由物体层面的词汇变化驱动，简单同义词替换即造成大幅下降；80–96% 的失败来自规划层轨迹发散而非执行错误。
Conclusion: VLA 的改写脆弱性主要来自表层词面匹配而非语义接地，且失败发生在任务识别/规划阶段；评测应按改写难度分层而非只看二元成功率。

papers.title: HRIR-Former: Grid-Free Time-Domain Reconstruction of Head-Related Impulse Responses with a Spatially Encoded Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Individualized head-related impulse responses (HRIRs) enable binaural rendering, but dense per-listener measurements are costly. We address HRIR spatial up-sampling from sparse per-listener measurements: given a few measured HRIRs for a listener, predict HRIRs at unmeasured target directions. Prior learning methods often work in the frequency domain, rely on minimum-phase assumptions or separate timing models, and use a fixed direction grid, which can degrade temporal fidelity and spatial continuity. We propose HRIR-Former, a time-domain, grid-free binaural Transformer for reconstructing HRIRs at arbitrary directions from sparse inputs. It uses sinusoidal spatial features, a Conv1D refinement module, and auxiliary interaural time difference (ITD) and interaural level difference (ILD) heads. On SONICOM, it improves normalized mean squared error (NMSE), cosine distance, and ITD/ILD errors over prior methods; ablations validate modules and show minimum-phase preprocessing is unnecessary.
papers.comment: Published in Interspeech 2026, Sydney, Australia. Demo: https://shaohenry.github.io/HRIR-Former. Code: https://github.com/ShaoHenry/HRIR-Former
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HRIR-Former 是一个时域、无网格 (grid-free) 的双耳 Transformer，从稀疏个体 HRIR 测量直接重建任意目标方向的 HRIR，用正弦空间特征、Conv1D 精修模块与辅助 ITD/ILD 头替代频域建模和最小相位假设。在 SONICOM 上其 NMSE、余弦距离与 ITD/ILD 误差均优于先前方法，消融显示最小相位预处理并不必要。
Motivation: 个体 HRIR 密集测量成本高，稀疏测量下的空间上采样是必由之路；既有学习方法多在频域处理、依赖最小相位假设或独立时序模型，并绑定固定方向网格，损害时域保真度与空间连续性。
Method: 时域无网格双耳 Transformer：以正弦空间特征 (sinusoidal spatial features) 编码任意方向，Conv1D 精修模块处理波形，并挂接辅助的 ITD 与 ILD 预测头；从少量实测 HRIR 预测未测方向的 HRIR，无需最小相位预处理。
Result: 在 SONICOM 数据集上，HRIR-Former 在 NMSE、余弦距离 (cosine distance) 以及 ITD/ILD 误差三项指标上均优于先前方法；消融实验验证各模块贡献，并显示最小相位预处理是不必要的。
Conclusion: 时域、无网格的建模配合显式 ITD/ILD 约束可以在稀疏测量下重建任意方向 HRIR，且不必依赖最小相位假设。

papers.title: Synergizing Discriminative Exemplars and Self-Refined Experience for MLLM-based In-Context Learning in Medical Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: General Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often underperform in capturing domain-specific nuances in medical diagnosis, trailing behind fully supervised baselines. Although fine-tuning provides a remedy, the high costs of expert annotation and massive computational overhead limit its scalability. To bridge this gap without updating the weights of the pre-trained backbone of the MLLM, we propose a Clinician Mimetic Workflow. This is a novel In-Context Learning (ICL) framework designed to synergize Discriminative Exemplar Coreset Selection (DECS) and Self-Refined Experience Summarization (SRES). Specifically, DECS simulates a clinician's ability to reference "anchor cases" by selecting discriminative visual coresets from noisy data at the computational level; meanwhile, SRES mimics the cognition and reflection in clinical diagnosis by distilling diverse rollouts into a dynamic textual Experience Bank. Extensive evaluation across all 12 datasets of the MedMNIST 2D benchmark demonstrates that our method outperforms zero-shot general and medical MLLMs. Simultaneously, it achieves performance levels comparable to fully supervised vision models and domain-specific fine-tuned MLLMs, setting a new benchmark for parameter-efficient medical in-context learning. Our code is available at an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Synergizing-Discriminative-Exemplars-and-Self-Refined-Experience-ED74.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Clinician Mimetic Workflow：在不更新 MLLM 权重的前提下，用 DECS 从含噪数据中挑选判别性视觉 coresets 作为“锚定病例”，用 SRES 把多次 rollout 蒸馏进动态文本 Experience Bank，二者协同做医学图像上下文学习 (ICL)。在 MedMNIST 2D 全部 12 个数据集上超过零样本通用与医学 MLLM，达到与全监督视觉模型和领域微调 MLLM 相当的水平。
Motivation: MLLM 在医学诊断上抓不住领域细节、落后于全监督基线，而微调依赖专家标注且算力开销大，难以扩展。
Method: 框架含两个组件：DECS 在计算层面从含噪数据中选判别性视觉 coresets，模拟临床引用锚定病例；SRES 把多样化 rollout 蒸馏成动态文本 Experience Bank，模拟临床反思。全程冻结预训练 MLLM 主干权重，仅靠上下文示例与经验文本。
Result: 在 MedMNIST 2D 基准全部 12 个数据集上评测，方法优于零样本通用 MLLM 与零样本医学 MLLM，并达到与全监督视觉模型、领域微调 MLLM 相当的性能水平。
Conclusion: 判别性示例选择与自我精炼经验总结结合，可在不微调权重的前提下把 MLLM 的医学诊断推到接近全监督与领域微调的水平，即参数高效医学 ICL 可行。

summary_sections.conclusion: 判别性示例选择与自我精炼经验总结结合，可在不微调权重的前提下把 MLLM 的医学诊断推到接近全监督与领域微调的水平，即参数高效医学 ICL 可行。

papers.title: Stringological sequence prediction I: efficient algorithms for predicting highly repetitive sequences
papers.abstract_en: We propose novel algorithms for sequence prediction based on ideas from stringology. These algorithms are time and space efficient and satisfy mistake bounds related to particular stringological complexity measures of the sequence. In this work (the first in a series) we focus on two such measures: (i) the size of the smallest straight-line program that produces the sequence, and (ii) the number of states in the minimal automaton that can compute any symbol in the sequence when given its position in base k as input. These measures are interesting because multiple rich classes of sequences studied in combinatorics of words (automatic sequences, morphic sequences, characteristic words) have low complexity and hence high predictability in this sense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 stringology 出发给出序列预测算法，其 mistake bound 由序列的两个复杂度度量控制：最小 straight-line program (SLP) 的规模，以及以位置的 base-k 表示为输入的最小自动机状态数。由于 automatic sequences、morphic sequences、characteristic words 等词组合学类复杂度低，这类高度可重复序列可被高效且低错误地预测。
Motivation: 序列预测的效率与 mistake bound 通常不与序列本身的结构性复杂度挂钩，而词组合学中大量低复杂度（高度可重复）序列类尚未被预测算法利用。
Method: 提出基于 stringology 思想的时间与空间高效预测算法，mistake bound 关联两个复杂度度量：产生该序列的最小 straight-line program 大小，以及在给定位置 base-k 表示时计算任一符号的最小自动机状态数；本文为系列第一篇。
Result: 给出满足上述复杂度度量相关 mistake bound 的时间与空间高效序列预测算法；摘要未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 以 SLP 规模和最小自动机状态数作为复杂度度量，可为 automatic、morphic、characteristic words 等低复杂度序列类给出可预测性保证。

papers.title: Selective Deficits in LLM Mental Self-Modeling in a Behavior-Based Test of Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: The ability to represent oneself and others as agents with knowledge, intentions, and belief states that guide their behavior - Theory of Mind - is a human universal that enables us to navigate - and manipulate - the social world. It is supported by our ability to form mental models of ourselves and others. Its ubiquity in human affairs entails that LLMs have seen innumerable examples of it in their training data and therefore may have learned to mimic it, but whether they have actually learned causal models that they can deploy in arbitrary settings is unclear. We therefore develop a novel experimental paradigm that requires that subjects form representations of the mental states of themselves and others and act on them strategically rather than merely describe them. We test a wide range of leading open and closed source LLMs released since 2024, as well as human subjects, on this paradigm. We find that 1) LLMs released before mid-2025 fail at all of our tasks, 2) more recent LLMs achieve human-level performance on modeling the cognitive states of others, and 3) even frontier LLMs fail at our self-modeling task - unless afforded a scratchpad in the form of a reasoning trace. We further demonstrate cognitive load effects on other-modeling tasks, offering suggestive evidence that LLMs are using something akin to limited-capacity working memory to hold these mental representations in mind during a single forward pass. Finally, we explore the mechanisms by which reasoning models succeed at the self- and other-modeling tasks, and show that they readily engage in strategic deception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于行为的心理理论 (Theory of Mind) 测试范式，要求受试者对自身与他人的心理状态形成表征并据此策略性行动，而非仅作描述。2024 年后发布的多款开源与闭源 LLM 及人类受试者参加测试：2025 年中之前的模型全部任务失败，更新模型在他人建模上达到人类水平，而前沿模型在自我建模任务上仍失败——除非给出 reasoning trace 形式的草稿纸 (scratchpad)。
Motivation: LLM 在训练数据里见过大量心理理论描述，但它们学到的是可迁移到任意情境的因果心智模型，还是只会模仿表面描述，此前不清楚；纯描述式探针无法区分二者。
Method: 设计新实验范式，要求受试者表征自己与他人的知识、意图、信念状态并据此策略性行动；测试 2024 年以来的广泛领先开源与闭源 LLM 及人类受试者，并考察他人建模任务上的认知负荷效应与推理模型的成功机制。
Result: 三点发现：2025 年中之前发布的 LLM 在全部任务上失败；更近期的 LLM 在他人认知状态建模上达到人类水平；即便前沿 LLM 在自我建模任务上也失败，除非提供 reasoning trace 形式的 scratchpad。他人建模任务上观察到认知负荷效应，推理模型在自我与他人建模任务上会主动进行策略性欺骗 (strategic deception)。
Conclusion: LLM 的心理理论能力是选择性的：他人建模已接近人类，自我建模依赖外部推理痕迹才成立，且推理模型会把该能力用于策略性欺骗；认知负荷效应提示其在单次前向传播中以类似有限容量工作记忆的方式保持心理表征。

papers.title: Binary Classification from Coupled Pairwise Labels
papers.abstract_en: Even when it is difficult to assign absolute class labels to individual instances, relational information may still be available, such as whether two instances belong to the same class or which instance is more likely to belong to the positive class. In this study, we refer to these two types of information as Similarity/Dissimilarity (SD) labels and Pairwise Comparison (Pcomp) labels, respectively, and consider binary classification that uses both types of relational information from the same instance pairs. SD learning uses the distinction between similar and dissimilar pairs but does not use the ordering within each pair, whereas Pcomp learning uses the ordering within each pair but does not distinguish between similar and dissimilar pairs. We therefore propose SD-Pcomp learning, whose objective function simultaneously preserves the structures of both SD learning and Pcomp learning. The proposed objective function admits two decompositions: one consists of an SD estimator plus a term that represents ordering information from Pcomp labels, and the other consists of a Pcomp estimator plus a term that represents pair-type information from SD labels. These decompositions clarify how the complementary information provided by SD and Pcomp labels is integrated into the proposed objective function. Experiments on eight datasets compare the proposed method with SD learning, Pcomp learning, and a method that takes a convex combination of their objective functions. We evaluate the effect of using both types of relational information on classification performance in terms of classification accuracy and AUC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SD-Pcomp learning：对同一批实例对同时利用 Similarity/Dissimilarity 标签与 Pairwise Comparison 标签，目标函数同时保持两种关系结构，并给出两种等价分解（SD 估计器加排序项，或 Pcomp 估计器加对型项）以说明互补信息如何合并。在八个数据集上以分类准确率和 AUC 对比 SD learning、Pcomp learning 及二者目标函数的凸组合。
Motivation: 许多场景难以给单个实例赋予绝对类别标签，但成对关系信息仍可获得；SD 学习只用相似/相异区分而丢弃对内排序，Pcomp 学习只用排序而丢弃对型，二者各自浪费了另一半信息。
Method: 提出 SD-Pcomp 目标函数，同时保持 SD 学习与 Pcomp 学习的结构；该目标可分解为「SD 估计器 + 来自 Pcomp 标签的排序项」或「Pcomp 估计器 + 来自 SD 标签的对型项」两种形式，用以刻画两类标签的互补信息整合方式。
Result: 在八个数据集上比较所提方法与 SD learning、Pcomp learning 以及两者目标函数的凸组合，用分类准确率 (classification accuracy) 与 AUC 评估同时使用两类关系信息对分类性能的影响。
Conclusion: SD 与 Pcomp 标签携带互补信息，可经一个可双分解的目标函数统一整合进二分类，从而在只有成对关系标签、缺乏绝对标签时完成分类。

papers.title: When Should Humans Step In? Optimal Human Dispatching in AI-Assisted Decisions
papers.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly assist decision making by producing cheap factor-level assessments of complex inputs, but these assessments can be biased or incomplete. We study selective human evaluation: given AI signals, which factors should be dispatched to human experts? We formulate this human--AI collaboration problem as a factor-level information-acquisition problem. Under squared loss, the optimal dispatching rule maximizes a contextual reward; under a linear model, this reward admits a closed-form decomposition into two interpretable terms: predictive relevance and residual uncertainty in the human evaluation after conditioning on the AI signal. We instantiate the framework on peer review, decomposing papers into ten aspects and evaluating up to 3,408 ICLR submissions across three LLMs and multiple regression heads. In this retrospective proxy, where human aspect signals are extracted from existing reviews, predictions that query three of the ten aspects under the optimal dispatching rules match the full ten-aspect human benchmark. The finding holds when the human signal comes from a single noisy reviewer, and across review years. These results position principled dispatching as a practical building block for scalable human--AI decision systems. We also discuss safeguards under which such a rule can serve as decision support that leaves the final decision with a human.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把人机协作写成因子级信息获取问题：给定 AI 对各因子的廉价信号，最优派发规则最大化一个上下文奖励，该奖励在线性模型下分解为预测相关性与条件于 AI 信号后的人评残差不确定两项。在 ICLR 同行评审上把论文拆成十个方面、最多 3,408 篇投稿、跨三个 LLM 与多个回归头的回顾性代理实验中，只查询十个方面中的三个即可匹配全部十方面的人类基准，且在单一含噪评审人与不同评审年份下均成立。
Motivation: AI 系统给出的因子级评估廉价但可能有偏或不完整，全量交给人专家成本高；需要回答在给定 AI 信号下哪些因子值得派发给人，而不是笼统地决定是否接管。
Method: 将人机协作形式化为因子级信息获取问题：平方损失下最优派发规则最大化一个上下文奖励，线性模型下该奖励有闭式分解，由预测相关性与条件于 AI 信号后人类评估的残差不确定两项构成。实例化到同行评审，把论文拆成十个 aspect，用现有评审抽取人评信号作为回顾性代理，比较三个 LLM 与多个回归头下的派发策略。
Result: 在最多 3,408 篇 ICLR 投稿上，按最优派发规则只查询十个 aspect 中的三个，预测即可匹配全部十个 aspect 的人类基准；该结果在人评信号来自单一含噪评审人时仍成立，并跨评审年份保持。
Conclusion: 有原则的派发规则可作为可扩展人机决策系统的实用构件：把有限的人评预算集中到预测相关性高且 AI 信号后残差不确定大的 aspect 上，同时作者讨论了让最终决定留在人手中的保障条件。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Motion Forcing: A Decoupled Framework for Robust Video Generation in Motion Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: The ultimate goal of video generation is to satisfy a fundamental trilemma: achieving high visual quality, maintaining rigorous physical consistency, and enabling precise controllability. While recent models can maintain this balance in simple, isolated scenarios, we observe that this equilibrium is fragile and often breaks down as scene complexity increases (e.g., involving collisions or dense traffic). To address this, we introduce \textbf{Motion Forcing}, a framework designed to stabilize this trilemma even in complex generative tasks. Our key insight is to explicitly decouple physical reasoning from visual synthesis via a hierarchical \textbf{``Point-Shape-Appearance''} paradigm. This approach decomposes generation into verifiable stages: modeling complex dynamics as sparse geometric anchors (\textbf{Point}), expanding them into dynamic depth maps that explicitly resolve 3D geometry (\textbf{Shape}), and finally rendering high-fidelity textures (\textbf{Appearance}). Furthermore, to foster robust physical understanding, we employ a \textbf{Masked Point Recovery} strategy. By randomly masking input anchors during training and enforcing the reconstruction of complete dynamic depth, the model is compelled to move beyond passive pattern matching and learn latent physical laws (e.g., inertia) to infer missing trajectories. Extensive experiments on autonomous driving benchmarks show that Motion Forcing significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, maintaining trilemma stability across complex scenes. Evaluations on physics and robotics further confirm our framework's generality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Motion Forcing 把视频生成拆成 Point-Shape-Appearance 三级流水线：先用稀疏几何锚点建模动力学，再展开为显式三维深度图，最后渲染纹理，从而把物理推理与视觉合成解耦。训练时随机掩蔽输入锚点并强制重建完整动态深度（Masked Point Recovery），迫使模型推断缺失轨迹而非模式匹配。在自动驾驶基准上显著优于 SOTA 基线，并在物理与机器人评测中保持复杂场景下的三难（质量、物理一致性、可控性）稳定。
Motivation: 视频生成在简单孤立场景中能兼顾画质、物理一致性与可控性，但场景复杂度上升（碰撞、密集车流）时这一平衡脆弱并崩溃，需要把可验证的物理推理从视觉合成中分离出来。
Method: 分层 Point-Shape-Appearance 范式：将复杂动力学表示为稀疏几何锚点（Point），展开为显式解决三维几何的动态深度图（Shape），再渲染高保真纹理（Appearance）；训练阶段用 Masked Point Recovery 随机掩蔽输入锚点并要求重建完整动态深度，促使模型学习惯性等潜在物理规律以推断缺失轨迹。
Result: 在自动驾驶基准上显著优于 state-of-the-art 基线，在复杂场景中保持三难稳定；在 physics 与 robotics 评测上进一步确认框架的通用性。
Conclusion: 把物理推理与视觉合成显式解耦、并用掩蔽锚点重建来训练，能在复杂生成任务中维持画质、物理一致性与可控性的平衡，且可推广到物理与机器人任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RubiCap: Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Dense Image Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Dense image captioning is critical for vision-language pretraining and for text-to-image generation, but scaling expert-quality annotations is prohibitively expensive. While synthesizing captions from strong vision-language models (VLMs) is a practical alternative, supervised distillation often yields limited output diversity and weak generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) could overcome these, but its successes have so far been concentrated in verifiable domains that rely on deterministic checkers---a luxury not available in open-ended captioning. We address this verification bottleneck with RubiCap, an RL framework that derives fine-grained, sample-specific rewards from LLM-written rubrics. For each image, an LLM rubric writer compares captions from a diverse committee of VLMs to identify consensus strengths and diagnose the current policy's deficiencies. These findings are converted into explicit evaluation criteria, enabling an LLM judge to decompose quality assessment and replace coarse scalar rewards with structured, multi-faceted assessments. Across extensive benchmarks, RubiCap achieves the highest win rates on CapArena, outperforming supervised distillation, prior RL methods, human-expert annotations, and GPT-4V-augmented outputs. On CaptionQA, it shows superior word efficiency: our 7B model matches Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct, and our 3B model surpasses its 7B counterpart. Remarkably, using a compact RubiCap-3B as a captioner produces stronger pretrained VLMs than those trained on captions from proprietary models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RubiCap 用 LLM 写的逐样本 rubric 把开放域图像描述的奖励从粗标量变成结构化多维评分，从而让 RL 摆脱对确定性 checker 的依赖。在 CapArena 上取得最高胜率，CaptionQA 上 7B 模型追平 Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct、3B 超过其 7B 版本，且用 RubiCap-3B 生成的描述训出的预训练 VLM 强于用闭源模型描述训练的模型。
Motivation: 高质量稠密描述标注成本过高，用强 VLM 合成再做监督蒸馏又导致输出多样性不足、泛化弱；RL 的成功集中在有确定性 checker 的可验证领域，开放域描述缺少这种验证器。
Method: RubiCap 是一个 rubric 引导的 RL 框架：LLM rubric writer 对比来自多个 VLM 的委员会描述，找出共识优点并诊断当前策略缺陷，转成显式评价标准，再由 LLM judge 据此分解质量评估，用结构化多面评分取代粗粒度标量奖励。
Result: 在 CapArena 上胜率最高，超过监督蒸馏、既有 RL 方法、人类专家标注和 GPT-4V 增强输出；CaptionQA 上 7B 模型匹配 Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct，3B 模型超过其 7B 对应版本，体现词元效率优势；用紧凑的 RubiCap-3B 作描述生成器，得到的预训练 VLM 强于用专有模型描述训练的版本。
Conclusion: LLM rubric 提供的细粒度、逐样本奖励足以替代确定性 checker，使 RL 在开放域图像描述上同时胜过监督蒸馏与既有 RL，并让小模型生成的描述训出更强的 VLM。

papers.title: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning: Steering ViTs away from Spurious Correlations to Improve Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) often degrade under distribution shifts because they rely on spurious correlations, such as background cues, rather than semantically meaningful features. Existing regularization methods, typically relying on simple foreground-background masks, which fail to capture the fine-grained semantic concepts that define an object (e.g., ``long beak'' and ``wings'' for a ``bird''). As a result, these methods provide limited robustness to distribution shifts. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel finetuning framework that steers model reasoning toward concept-level semantics. Our approach optimizes the model's internal relevance maps to align with spatially grounded concept masks. These masks are generated automatically, without manual annotation: class-relevant concepts are first proposed using an LLM-based, label-free method, and then segmented using a VLM. The finetuning objective aligns relevance with these concept regions while simultaneously suppressing focus on spurious background areas. Notably, this process requires only a minimal set of images and uses half of the dataset classes. Extensive experiments on five out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves robustness across multiple ViT-based models. Furthermore, we show that the resulting relevance maps exhibit stronger alignment with semantic object parts, offering a scalable path toward more robust and interpretable vision models. Finally, we confirm that concept-guided masks provide more effective supervision for model robustness than conventional segmentation maps, supporting our central hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning 用 LLM 无标签提出类相关概念、再由 VLM 分割成空间概念掩码，微调时把 ViT 的内部 relevance map 对齐这些掩码并同时压制背景区域。只需极少量图像和一半类别，即在五个 OOD 基准上提升多种 ViT 模型的鲁棒性，且 relevance map 与语义部件对齐更强。
Motivation: ViT 在分布偏移下退化是因为依赖背景等虚假相关，而现有正则化只用简单前景-背景掩码，抓不住定义物体的细粒度概念（如鸟的 long beak、wings），因此对分布偏移的鲁棒性提升有限。
Method: 先用基于 LLM 的无标签方法提出类相关概念，再用 VLM 对概念做分割，自动生成空间接地的概念掩码（无需人工标注）；微调目标同时把模型 relevance map 对齐这些概念区域、并抑制对虚假背景的注意力，只用极少量图像和数据集一半的类别。
Result: 在五个 out-of-distribution 基准上，该方法提升了多种基于 ViT 的模型的鲁棒性；得到的 relevance map 与语义物体部件对齐更强；概念引导掩码比常规分割图提供更有效的鲁棒性监督。
Conclusion: 把微调监督从粗前景-背景掩码换成 LLM/VLM 自动生成的细粒度概念掩码，能同时改善 ViT 的分布偏移鲁棒性与可解释性，支撑作者的核心假设。

papers.title: EveryQuery: A Promptable Foundation Model for Clinical Prediction Tasks over Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive foundation models for electronic health records can make predictions for diverse clinical tasks without finetuning. These methods work by generating possible "synthetic futures" for patients, and then inferring downstream predictions over these simulated trajectories. Despite their strong capabilities, these methods have several flaws. (1) Inference is extremely computationally expensive, as each prediction requires simulating many trajectories, each with many observations. (2) Their performance is noisy due to the variance inherent to simulation, which in particular reduces efficacy on rare events, which are often of high importance clinically. (3) They are not promptable, as their only input is the patient's medical history, requiring indirect aggregation at inference time. We introduce EveryQuery, a promptable foundation model for structured EHR data. Building on the insight that clinical prediction tasks can be written in a structured query language, EveryQuery takes a query as a prompt alongside the patient's history and estimates the outcome directly. This allows EveryQuery to make predictions across diverse clinical tasks, such as classification and survival modeling, without simulation or finetuning. Across three EHR datasets, EveryQuery outperforms a competitive autoregressive baseline on clinically relevant classification and time-to-event tasks, with mean AUROC gains of 14.3% and 12.7% on MIMIC-IV and a large academic medical center and comparable performance on the smaller NWICU dataset. Its advantage is largest for rare outcomes, and it requires 580x less inference compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EveryQuery 把临床预测任务写成结构化查询语言，作为 prompt 与患者病史一起输入，直接估计结局而不再模拟合成未来。在 MIMIC-IV 与一大型学术医疗中心上，分类与生存任务的平均 AUROC 相对自回归基线分别提升 14.3% 与 12.7%，稀有结局上优势最大，推理算力少 580 倍。
Motivation: 自回归 EHR 基础模型每次预测要模拟大量轨迹，算力开销极大且结果受模拟方差影响而抖动，稀有事件上尤其不可靠；同时只能以病史为输入，无法直接下达查询式指令。
Method: 把临床预测任务形式化为结构化查询语言，EveryQuery 以查询加患者病史为输入，直接估计结局，覆盖分类与生存建模 (time-to-event)，无需模拟轨迹也无需微调。
Result: 在三个 EHR 数据集上对比一个有竞争力的自回归基线：MIMIC-IV 与一大型学术医疗中心的平均 AUROC 分别提升 14.3% 与 12.7%，较小的 NWICU 数据集上表现相当；优势在稀有结局上最大，推理算力需求低 580 倍。
Conclusion: 把临床任务改写成查询直接估计结局，可以在不模拟、不微调的前提下同时改善分类与生存预测，并大幅降低推理算力，尤其适合稀有结局。

papers.title: The Trace Is the State: Exact Credit Assignment for LLM Agent Teams
papers.abstract_en: Credit assignment for a team of LLM agents, what each message was worth, has mostly been treated as prediction: a learned critic, a trajectory-level score, or an agent ablation stands in for the counterfactual that defines credit, which is rarely run. Teams that communicate through a shared context are different: when everything a downstream agent reads is written into the trace, the trace is the state, and that counterfactual can be executed. A credit signal can then be judged as any estimator is: by bias, variance, and agreement with an independent reference. C3, credit assignment by counterfactual continuation, substitutes one message at a decision point and continues the run to the terminal reward, so its credit is unbiased, exact up to Monte Carlo error. Given the sampled alternatives, that error's variance follows a derived law with no term for the number of agents, and the observed noise follows the law on 6 workflows of 2 to 10 decision points. On the 2-agent chain, from 4 continuations, C3 ranks alternatives at 0.69 rank correlation against a 16-continuation reference, near the 0.73 at which 2 such references agree; a critic trained on the same rollouts reaches 0.29. Used as the advantage in training a 2-agent team, C3 beats MAGRPO, the stronger baseline in our comparison, and spends 37% fewer training tokens than MAPPO, since only the messages downstream of a decision point are regenerated. When the trace is the state, credit need not be predicted; it can be exact.
papers.comment: v3: substantially revised, new title. 30 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 C3（counterfactual continuation）：在共享上下文的 LLM agent 团队中，把 trace 直接当作 state，在决策点替换一条消息并续跑到终局奖励，从而得到无偏、仅受 Monte Carlo 误差限制的精确 credit。6 个含 2–10 个决策点的 workflow 上观测噪声符合理论推导的方差律（该律不含 agent 数目项）；2-agent chain 上 4 次续跑的排序相关 0.69（16 次续跑参考为 0.73），同 rollout 训练的 critic 仅 0.29。
Motivation: LLM agent 团队的 credit assignment 多被当作预测问题：学一个 critic、给轨迹级分数或做 agent 消融来代替真正很少执行的反事实，因而有偏且无法审计。
Method: C3 在决策点逐条替换消息并把运行续到终局 reward，以该反事实差值作为 credit；把 credit 信号按估计量的 bias、variance 与对独立参考的一致性来评估，并推导出只依赖采样备选项的方差律；随后把 C3 作为 advantage 训练 2-agent 团队，与 MAGRPO、MAPPO 对比。
Result: 观测噪声在 6 个含 2–10 个决策点的 workflow 上服从推导出的方差律，且律中无 agent 数目项。2-agent chain 上，4 次续跑对备选项的排序相关为 0.69（16 次续跑参考之间为 0.73），同一批 rollouts 训练的 critic 为 0.29。作为 advantage 训练 2-agent 团队时胜过对比中更强的基线 MAGRPO，且比 MAPPO 少用 37% 训练 token（只重新生成决策点下游的消息）。
Conclusion: 当 trace 就是 state 时，credit 不必被预测，可以直接算精确；C3 的误差只随采样备选项变化，不随 agent 数目增长。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Farther the Shift, Sparser the Representation: Analyzing OOD Mechanisms in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate how Large Language Models (LLMs) adapt their internal representations when encountering inputs of increasing difficulty, quantified as the degree of out-of-distribution (OOD) shift. We reveal a consistent and quantifiable phenomenon: as task difficulty increases, whether through harder reasoning questions, longer contexts, or adding answer choices, the last hidden states of LLMs become substantially sparser. In short, \textbf{\textit{the farther the shift, the sparser the representations}}. This sparsity--difficulty relation is observable across diverse models and domains, suggesting that language models respond to unfamiliar or complex inputs by concentrating computation into specialized subspaces in the last hidden state. Through a series of controlled analyses with a learning dynamic explanation, we demonstrate that this sparsity is not incidental but an adaptive mechanism for stabilizing reasoning under OOD. Leveraging this insight, we design \textit{Sparsity-Guided Curriculum In-Context Learning (SG-ICL)}, a strategy that explicitly uses representation sparsity to schedule few-shot demonstrations, leading to considerable performance enhancements. Our study provides new mechanistic insights into how LLMs internalize OOD challenges. The source code is available at the URL: https://github.com/MingyuJ666/sparsityLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 的最后一个 hidden state 随 OOD 偏移增大而系统性变稀疏：题目更难、上下文更长、选项更多时，表征都更稀疏，且这一稀疏度-难度关系跨模型、跨领域稳定出现。作者据此提出 Sparsity-Guided Curriculum In-Context Learning (SG-ICL)，用表征稀疏度来调度 few-shot 示例顺序，带来明显的性能提升。
Motivation: LLM 在难度递增的输入上如何调整内部表征缺乏可量化的机制解释，也缺少把这种内部信号反过来用于推理时干预的手段。
Method: 以 OOD 偏移程度量化任务难度（更难的推理题、更长上下文、更多选项），考察最后一个 hidden state 的稀疏度变化，并给出 learning dynamic 解释以说明该稀疏是稳定推理的自适应机制；再据此设计 SG-ICL，用稀疏度排序 few-shot demonstrations。
Result: 稀疏度随难度上升的关系在多种模型与领域上一致可测；受控分析支持该稀疏是稳定 OOD 推理的自适应机制而非偶然；SG-ICL 带来 considerable performance enhancements（摘要未给具体数值）。
Conclusion: 表征稀疏化是 LLM 应对 OOD 输入的自适应机制，可直接用作推理时调度 few-shot 示例的信号；代码已开源。

papers.title: Fast-Slow Thinking RM: Efficient Integration of Scalar and Generative Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward models (RMs) are critical for aligning Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). While Generative Reward Models (GRMs) achieve superior accuracy through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, they incur substantial computational costs. Conversely, Scalar Reward Models (SRMs) offer efficiency but suffer from limited performance and adaptability in complex scenarios. We introduce Fast-Slow Thinking Reward Models (F/S-RM), a hybrid RM architecture inspired by Dual Process Theory. It trains a single model to integrate two distinct reward paradigms: scalar-style first-token pairwise judgment (fast thinking) and CoT-based judgment (slow thinking), regulated by a dual-confidence activation mechanism that determines when to activate slow thinking. Under hybrid inference, F/S-RM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with an average score of 84.3 across benchmarks, while reducing token consumption by 22.5%.
papers.comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合奖励模型 F/S-RM：单模型内同时训练标量式首 token 成对打分（快思考）与 CoT 推理打分（慢思考），由双置信度激活机制决定何时触发慢思考。在多个基准上平均分 84.3 达到 SOTA，同时 token 消耗降低 22.5%。
Motivation: GRM 精度高但 CoT 推理计算成本大，SRM 高效却在复杂场景下性能与适应性受限，两条路线无法兼得精度与开销。
Method: 受 Dual Process Theory 启发的 F/S-RM 混合架构，用单一模型整合两种奖励范式：标量式首 token 成对判断（fast thinking）与基于 CoT 的判断（slow thinking），并以双置信度激活机制 (dual-confidence activation) 决定是否启动慢思考，用于 RLHF 奖励打分。
Result: 在多个基准上混合推理平均分 84.3，达到 state-of-the-art 准确率，同时 token 消耗减少 22.5%。
Conclusion: 把标量与生成式奖励范式合进单模型并按置信度按需触发 CoT，可在 RLHF 奖励模型上同时拿到高精度与更低推理开销。

papers.title: Smoothing the Semantic Landscape: Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection via Text-Induced Flatness
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative models have exposed a fundamental weakness of image fake detectors: they often fail to generalize to unseen synthesis methods. We attribute this failure to an optimization pathology in which detectors overfit to source-coupled artifacts and converge to sharp solutions, resulting in unstable decision boundaries under generator shifts. To address this issue, we propose a geometric optimization framework that treats diverse textual prompts as structured semantic perturbations in the joint image--text space. To ensure that these perturbations provide reliable supervision, we introduce an entropy-based anchor selection mechanism that discards ambiguous prompt conditions and retains semantically compatible anchors for each input. Based on these anchors, we further impose two complementary regularizations: (i) perturbation consistency regularization, which enforces stable predictions across nearby semantic conditions and encourages local smoothness of the decision function; and (ii) manifold expansion regularization, which preserves feature diversity in the residual space and alleviates representation collapse. Together, these components steer optimization toward flatter and more transferable solutions. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our method substantially improves cross-generator generalization, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods by 5.65\% in average accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI 生成图像检测器在未见过的生成器上失效，被归因为过拟合源耦合伪影、收敛到尖锐解。提出文本诱导平坦化框架：把多样文本提示当作图像-文本联合空间的结构化语义扰动，用基于熵的 anchor 筛选保留语义兼容条件，再加扰动一致性正则与流形扩展正则，把优化推向更平坦、更可迁移的解。多基准实验中平均准确率比此前 SOTA 高 5.65%。
Motivation: 图像伪造检测器面对未见过的合成方法时泛化失败，根源是优化病态：过拟合与生成源绑定的伪影并收敛到尖锐解，导致生成器切换时决策边界不稳定。
Method: 几何优化框架：将多样文本提示作为图像-文本联合空间中的结构化语义扰动；用基于熵的 anchor 选择机制丢弃模糊提示条件、为每个输入保留语义兼容 anchor；在此之上施加两项互补正则——扰动一致性正则（在邻近语义条件下保持预测稳定、鼓励决策函数局部平滑）与流形扩展正则（保持残差空间的特征多样性、缓解表征坍缩）。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验显示跨生成器泛化显著提升，平均准确率超出此前 SOTA 5.65%。
Conclusion: 把文本提示当作语义扰动并同时约束局部平滑与特征多样性，可使检测器优化走向更平坦、更可迁移的解，从而改善对未见生成器的泛化。

papers.title: Forecasting Bacterial Antimicrobial Resistance Trends Using Machine Learning on WHO GLASS Surveillance Data: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Policy Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Background: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global health threat. While the WHO Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS) provides standardized data, population-level machine learning forecasting of resistance trends remains limited. Translating forecasts into policy also requires transparent interpretation. Methods: Surveillance data (2021-2023) comprising 5,909 observations across 44 countries and five WHO regions were processed. Six models (Naive, Linear, Ridge, XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM) were benchmarked to forecast one-year-ahead resistance rates using prior-year resistance, antibiotic consumption, and related features. MAE, RMSE, and sMAPE were computed with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for MAE. A local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system (Gemma 4) translated forecast findings into policy guidance grounded in WHO documents. Results: XGBoost achieved the best predictive performance (test MAE = 6.13% [95% CI: 5.83-6.44]), an 85.3% error reduction versus the naive baseline (MAE = 41.79%). SHAP analysis identified prior-year resistance as the dominant predictor (50.5% gain). Regional forecast error tracked surveillance coverage, from 3.65% in the European Region to 8.61% in South-East Asia. The RAG pipeline generated source-attributed policy responses without fabricated citations. Conclusion: Short-term AMR resistance rates exhibit strong temporal autocorrelation that can be accurately forecasted using gradient boosting. Coupling these forecasts with a hallucination-resistant RAG system provides a scalable, evidence-based decision-support framework for AMR governance. v3 correction: a leakage audit found feature-construction defects; on the corrected panel a persistence forecast (MAE 5.79) significantly outperforms XGBoost (6.55), and the 85.3% claim is withdrawn (see Correction).
papers.comment: v3: correction. A leakage audit found four defects in the v2 feature construction; on the corrected panel a persistence forecast (MAE 5.79 pp) significantly beats XGBoost (6.55 pp, p = 0.001) and the v2 claim of an 85.3% improvement is withdrawn. See the Correction notice. Code and corrected panel: github.com/TanvirTurja/amr-forecasting-rag; full reanalysis under journal review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 WHO GLASS 2021–2023 共 5,909 条、44 国五区的监测面板做一年期耐药率预报，六个模型里 XGBoost 在 v2 版本上 MAE 6.13%（95% CI 5.83–6.44），较 naive 基线 41.79% 声称降误差 85.3%。但 v3 泄漏审计发现特征构造缺陷，修正面板上持久性预报 MAE 5.79 pp 显著胜过 XGBoost 6.55 pp（p = 0.001），85.3% 的说法被撤回。
Motivation: GLASS 已提供标准化耐药监测数据，但人群层面的 ML 耐药趋势预报仍少，且预报结果转成政策建议需要可追溯、不编造引用的解释环节。
Method: 处理 2021–2023 年 44 国、五个 WHO 区域共 5,909 条观测，用上一年耐药率、抗生素消费及相关特征做一年期预报，对比 Naive、Linear、Ridge、XGBoost、LightGBM、LSTM 六个模型，指标为 MAE、RMSE、sMAPE 与 MAE 的 95% bootstrap 置信区间；用 SHAP 归因，再接本地 RAG（Gemma 4）把预报结论转成基于 WHO 文档的政策指引。
Result: v2 版本：XGBoost 测试 MAE 6.13%（95% CI 5.83–6.44），相对 naive 基线 MAE 41.79% 声称误差下降 85.3%；SHAP 显示上一年耐药率为主导特征（50.5% gain）；区域误差随监测覆盖变化，欧洲区 3.65%、东南亚区 8.61%。v3 修正：泄漏审计发现四处特征构造缺陷，修正面板上持久性预报 MAE 5.79 pp 显著优于 XGBoost 6.55 pp（p = 0.001），85.3% 的改进声明被撤回。RAG 管线输出带来源标注的政策回复且无编造引用。
Conclusion: 短期耐药率具有强时间自相关，修正数据后简单持久性预报即胜过梯度提升，说明原 XGBoost 优势来自特征泄漏；与防幻觉 RAG 结合可作为 AMR 治理的可扩展决策支持框架，完整重分析正在期刊评审中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Descent-Guided Policy Gradient for Scalable Cooperative Multi-Agent Learning
papers.abstract_en: Scaling cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is fundamentally limited by cross-agent noise. When agents share a common reward, each agent's learning signal is computed from a shared return that depends on all agents, so the stochasticity of the other agents enters the signal as cross-agent noise that grows with $N$. Many engineering systems, such as cloud computing and power systems, have differentiable analytical models that prescribe efficient system states, providing a new reference beyond noisy shared returns. In this work, we propose Descent-Guided Policy Gradient (DG-PG), a framework that augments policy-gradient updates with a low-noise descent signal toward this reference. We prove that DG-PG reduces policy-gradient estimator variance from $\mathcal{O}(N)$ to $\mathcal{O}(1)$, preserves the stationary points of the cooperative objective, and achieves agent-independent sample complexity $\mathcal{O}(1/ε^3)$. We evaluate DG-PG on cloud resource scheduling and power dispatch tasks, which involve discrete and continuous decisions, respectively. In both tasks, DG-PG converges within 10 episodes on average at every scale up to 1500 heterogeneous agents.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables; plus 19 pages of appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享奖励的协作 MARL 中，各 agent 的学习信号被其他 agent 的随机性污染成随 N 增长的跨 agent 噪声。DG-PG 用可微解析模型给出的低噪声下降信号（descent signal）补充策略梯度更新，把估计量方差从 O(N) 降到 O(1)、保持协作目标的驻点，并在云资源调度与电力调度任务上平均 10 个 episode 内收敛，规模达 1500 个异构 agent。
Motivation: 共享奖励下每个 agent 的梯度估计都来自依赖全体 agent 的回报，跨 agent 噪声随 N 增长，使协作 MARL 难以扩展；云调度、电力系统这类有可微解析模型的工程系统能提供比噪声共享回报更干净的参考状态。
Method: 提出 Descent-Guided Policy Gradient (DG-PG)：在策略梯度更新上叠加一个指向解析模型所给高效系统状态的低噪声下降信号；理论上证明方差、驻点保持与样本复杂度，并在离散决策的云资源调度和连续决策的电力调度两类任务上验证。
Result: 理论上把策略梯度估计量方差从 O(N) 降到 O(1)，保持协作目标的驻点，得到与 agent 数无关的样本复杂度 O(1/ε^3)；实验中在云资源调度与电力调度上、规模最高到 1500 个异构 agent，每个规模平均 10 个 episode 内收敛。
Conclusion: 用可微解析模型的下降方向替代纯噪声共享回报做参考，可以在不改变协作目标驻点的前提下消除跨 agent 噪声随规模增长的扩展瓶颈。

papers.title: ReLoop: Structured Modeling and Behavioral Verification for Reliable LLM-Based Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language problem descriptions into optimization code, but the code is prone to silent failures: it executes and returns a solver-feasible solution while encoding a semantically incorrect formulation. On compositional problems, the resulting feasibility-correctness gap reaches 90 percentage points. We introduce ReLoop, which combines two mechanisms. Structured generation decomposes code production into a four-stage reasoning chain (understand, formalize, synthesize, verify) to reduce formulation errors during generation. Behavioral verification detects the errors that remain by testing whether the formulation responds correctly to solver-based parameter perturbation, a signal that comes from the solver rather than from LLM self-review and requires no ground truth. The two mechanisms address different error structures: structured generation gives the largest gain on compositional problems (+8.5pp accuracy on RetailOpt-190 with Claude Opus 4.6), and behavioral verification gives its largest gain on localized defects (+4.4pp on MAMO-ComplexLP). With diagnostic execution recovery, ReLoop reaches 100% executable code on Claude Opus 4.6, and relative to direct generation it raises or preserves every reported metric of the three chat-tuned foundation models on all three benchmarks. For the narrowly fine-tuned SFT model we test, the chain-of-thought prompt conflicts with its learned output format and lowers its accuracy on MAMO-ComplexLP; we document and analyze this interaction. We release RetailOpt-190, 190 compositional retail optimization scenarios in which several constraints interact.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLoop 针对 LLM 把自然语言优化问题写成可执行但语义错误的代码这一静默失败，提出结构化生成（understand→formalize→synthesize→verify 四段推理链）加行为验证（用 solver 参数扰动检验 formulation 响应，不依赖 LLM 自审与 ground truth）。组合问题上可行性-正确性差距可达 90 个百分点；结构化生成在 RetailOpt-190 上用 Claude Opo 4.6 提升 +8.5pp，行为验证在 MAMO-ComplexLP 的局部缺陷上提升 +4.4pp，配合诊断式执行恢复达到 100% 可执行代码。

Result: 组合问题上可行性-正确性差距达 90 个百分点；结构化生成在 RetailOpt-190 上对 Claude Opus 4.6 提升 +8.5pp accuracy，行为验证在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上提升 +4.4pp；诊断式执行恢复使 Claude Opus 4.6 达到 100% 可执行代码，相对直接生成在三个 chat-tuned 基础模型、三个 benchmark 上每项报告指标均提升或持平；对窄域 SFT 模型，chain-of-thought prompt 与其学到的输出格式冲突，降低其在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上的 accuracy。

papers.title: Preventing Rank Collapse in Federated Low-Rank Adaptation with Client Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Federated low-rank adaptation (FedLoRA) has facilitated communication-efficient and privacy-preserving fine-tuning of foundation models for downstream tasks. In practical federated learning scenarios, client heterogeneity in system resources and data distributions motivates the use of heterogeneous LoRA ranks across clients. However, we identify a previously overlooked phenomenon in heterogeneous FedLoRA with SVD-based allocation, termed rank collapse, where the energy of the global update becomes concentrated in the minimum shared rank, resulting in suboptimal performance and high sensitivity to rank configurations. Through theoretical analysis, we reveal the underlying mechanism of rank collapse: a mismatch between rank-agnostic aggregation weights and rank-dependent client contributions, which systematically suppresses higher-rank updates at a geometric rate over rounds. Motivated by this insight, we propose raFLoRA, a rank-partitioned aggregation method that decomposes local updates into rank partitions and then aggregates each partition weighted by its effective client contributions. Extensive experiments across vision, language, and reasoning tasks show that raFLoRA prevents rank collapse, improves model performance, and enhances robustness across diverse heterogeneous configurations compared with strong FedLoRA baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 异构 FedLoRA 中按 SVD 分配不同 LoRA rank 会出现 rank collapse：全局更新能量被压缩到最小共享 rank，根因是 rank-agnostic 的聚合权重与 rank-dependent 的客户端贡献不匹配，高 rank 更新按轮次几何速率被压制。提出 raFLoRA，把本地更新拆成 rank 分区并按各分区的有效客户端贡献加权聚合，从而阻止 rank collapse 并提升跨异构配置的稳健性。
Motivation: 联邦微调中客户端系统资源与数据分布差异要求使用异构 LoRA rank，但现有 SVD 分配下的聚合方式会让高 rank 更新被系统性压制，导致性能次优且对 rank 配置高度敏感。
Method: raFLoRA 采用 rank-partitioned aggregation：将各客户端本地更新分解为 rank 分区，再按每个分区的有效客户端贡献 (effective client contributions) 分别加权聚合；机制由理论分析给出，即 rank-agnostic 聚合权重与 rank-dependent 贡献的错配。
Result: 在 vision、language、reasoning 任务上的实验显示 raFLoRA 阻止了 rank collapse，相比强 FedLoRA 基线提升了模型性能，并在多种异构配置下增强了稳健性；理论刻画指出高 rank 更新被按轮次几何速率 (geometric rate over rounds) 抑制。
Conclusion: rank collapse 源于聚合权重与客户端 rank 贡献的结构性错配，按 rank 分区加权聚合即可消除该现象并改善异构 FedLoRA 的性能与稳健性。

papers.title: PrefillShare: A Shared Prefill Module for KV Reuse in Multi-LLM Disaggregated Serving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems increasingly orchestrate multiple specialized language models to solve complex real-world problems, often invoking them over a shared context. This execution pattern repeatedly processes the same prompt prefix across models. Consequently, each model redundantly executes the prefill stage and maintains its own key-value (KV) cache, increasing aggregate prefill load and worsening tail latency by intensifying prefill-decode interference in existing LLM serving stacks. Disaggregated serving reduces such interference by placing prefill and decode on separate GPUs, but disaggregation does not fundamentally eliminate inter-model redundancy in computation and KV storage for the same prompt. To address this issue, we propose PrefillShare, a novel algorithm that enables sharing the prefill stage across multiple fine-tuned models in a disaggregated setting. PrefillShare factorizes the model into prefill and decode modules, freezes the prefill module, and fine-tunes only the decode module. This design allows multiple task-specific models to share a prefill module and the KV cache generated for the same prompt. We further introduce a routing mechanism that enables effective prefill sharing in a vLLM-based disaggregated system. PrefillShare not only matches full fine-tuning accuracy on a broad range of tasks and models, but also delivers 4.5x lower p95 latency and 2.0x higher throughput in multi-model agent workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体系统对同一 prompt 前缀在多个微调 LLM 上重复做 prefill 并各自维护 KV cache，PrefillShare 把模型拆成 prefill 与 decode 两段、冻结 prefill 只微调 decode，让多个任务模型共享同一 prefill 模块与 KV cache，并在 vLLM 分离式部署中加路由机制。精度与全量微调持平，多模型 agent 负载下 p95 延迟降 4.5 倍、吞吐提 2.0 倍。
Motivation: 多 LLM agent 反复处理相同前缀，每个模型冗余执行 prefill 并持有独立 KV cache，加重 prefill 负载与 prefill-decode 干扰；分离式 serving 只把两者放到不同 GPU，未消除跨模型的计算与 KV 存储冗余。
Method: PrefillShare 将模型因式分解为 prefill 与 decode 模块，冻结 prefill、只微调 decode，使多个任务专用模型共享 prefill 模块与同一 prompt 的 KV cache；并在基于 vLLM 的 disaggregated 系统中引入路由机制实现共享。
Result: 在多种任务与模型上匹配全量微调 (full fine-tuning) 的精度；在多模型 agent 工作负载下 p95 延迟降低 4.5 倍，吞吐提高 2.0 倍。
Conclusion: 冻结共享 prefill、只微调 decode 即可在不损失精度的前提下消除多模型间的 prefill 与 KV 冗余，显著改善分离式 serving 的尾延迟与吞吐。

papers.title: GUI-GenBench: Evaluating Image Generation Models as Interactive GUI Environments
papers.abstract_en: An image generation model used as a graphical user interface (GUI) environment must produce not only a plausible screen but also the correct response to an action. Existing visual-generation benchmarks do not directly assess this combination of functional correctness and temporal consistency in GUIs. We introduce GUI-GenBench, a benchmark of 700 curated samples across five task suites: single-step transitions, multi-step planning, fictional-app generation, real-app trajectories, and coordinate-based grounding. We also introduce GUI-Score, a VLM-based metric that assesses Goal Achievement, Interaction Logic, Content Consistency, UI Plausibility, and Visual Quality. Evaluating 12 image generation models on Chinese and English subsets, we find that strong single-step performance does not consistently extend to coherent multi-step trajectories or accurate grounding. The highest aggregate GUI-Scores are 69.62 on the Chinese subset and 63.16 on the English subset. Qualitative analysis further identifies failures in text rendering, icon interpretation, and coordinate-conditioned transitions. Together, these results distinguish visual plausibility from functional reliability and identify limitations that must be addressed before generated GUIs can serve as dependable interaction environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI-GenBench 把图像生成模型当作可交互 GUI 环境来评测，含 700 个样本、五个任务套件，并提出 VLM 打分器 GUI-Score。评测 12 个模型的中英文子集后发现：单步生成强并不保证多步轨迹连贯与坐标定位准确，最高聚合 GUI-Score 中文 69.62、英文 63.16。
Motivation: 现有视觉生成基准不直接检验 GUI 的功能正确性与时间一致性组合，无法区分画面好看与真正可交互。
Method: 构建 700 个精选样本、五个任务套件（单步转换、多步规划、虚构应用生成、真实应用轨迹、坐标定位）；提出基于 VLM 的 GUI-Score，从目标达成、交互逻辑、内容一致性、UI 合理性、视觉质量五个维度打分；在中英文子集上评测 12 个图像生成模型。
Result: 最高聚合 GUI-Score：中文子集 69.62，英文子集 63.16；定性分析定位三类失败——文本渲染、图标解读、坐标条件转换；强单步表现不能一致外推到连贯多步轨迹与准确定位。
Conclusion: 视觉合理性与功能可靠性必须分开评测，生成 GUI 要成为可依赖的交互环境仍需解决上述失败模式。

papers.title: $f$-FUM: Federated Unlearning via min--max and $f$-divergence
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training while keeping raw data on clients. Deletion requests and the discovery of poisoned data create a need to remove selected contributions from an already trained model. This is challenging in FL because client data are decentralized and their influence is entangled through repeated aggregation. We present f-FUM, an active federated unlearning method that builds on teacher-student forget/retain optimization. Starting from a pretrained global model, the method keeps that model fixed as a teacher. Clients maximize an $f$-divergence between student and teacher predictive distributions on forget examples, then minimize KL-based teacher-student disagreement and supervised loss on retained examples. The updates are aggregated in separate, sample-weighted synchronization phases without moving raw data to the server or changing the model architecture. We evaluate forget-side divergence choices in client-level and data-level deletion settings involving backdoors, label confusion, and clean-data deletion. Under equal synchronization-phase budgets, divergence choice changes the forgetting-utility trade-off, yielding improvements in some settings and mixed results in others. In the evaluated configurations, f-FUM uses up to 8 times fewer synchronization phases than full federated retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: f-FUM 是一种主动联邦遗忘 (federated unlearning) 方法：固定预训练全局模型作为 teacher，客户端在遗忘样本上最大化 student 与 teacher 预测分布的 f-divergence，在保留样本上最小化 KL 分歧与监督损失，再按样本权重分相聚合。在后门、标签混淆与干净数据删除的客户端级/数据级删除设置中，f-divergence 的选择改变遗忘-效用权衡，部分设置改善、部分结果混杂；评估配置下比完整联邦重训练最多省 8 倍同步轮次。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端数据分散、影响经反复聚合相互纠缠，删除请求或发现被投毒数据时难以从已训练模型中移除特定贡献，而原始数据又不能集中到服务器。
Method: 以预训练全局模型固定为 teacher，客户端对遗忘样本最大化 student 与 teacher 预测分布之间的 f-divergence，对保留样本最小化基于 KL 的师生分歧加监督损失；更新在分离的、按样本加权的同步阶段聚合，不传输原始数据、不改模型架构。
Result: 在客户端级与数据级删除设置（后门、标签混淆、干净数据删除）中比较遗忘侧 divergence 选择：等同步阶段预算下 divergence 选择改变遗忘-效用权衡，部分设置有改进、部分结果混杂；评估配置下 f-FUM 最多比完整联邦重训练少用 8 倍同步阶段。
Conclusion: 遗忘侧 f-divergence 的选择是遗忘-效用权衡的可调旋钮，且 f-FUM 能以远少于完整联邦重训练的同步阶段完成删除。

summary_sections.motivation: 联邦学习中客户端数据分散、影响经反复聚合相互纠缠，删除请求或发现被投毒数据时难以从已训练模型中移除特定贡献，而原始数据又不能集中到服务器。
summary_sections.method: 以预训练全局模型固定为 teacher，客户端对遗忘样本最大化 student 与 teacher 预测分布之间的 f-divergence，对保留样本最小化基于 KL 的师生分歧加监督损失；更新在分离的、按样本加权的同步阶段聚合，不传输原始数据、不改模型架构。
summary_sections.result: 在客户端级与数据级删除设置（后门、标签混淆、干净数据删除）中比较遗忘侧 divergence 选择：等同步阶段预算下 divergence 选择改变遗忘-效用权衡，部分设置有改进、部分结果混杂；评估配置下 f-FUM 最多比完整联邦重训练少用 8 倍同步阶段。
summary_sections.conclusion: 遗忘侧 f-divergence 的选择是遗忘-效用权衡的可调旋钮，且 f-FUM 能以远少于完整联邦重训练的同步阶段完成删除。

papers.title: All-Atom GPCR-Ligand Dynamics Simulation via a Residual Latent Flow Mode
papers.abstract_en: G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), which are targeted by over one-third of approved drugs, undergo intricate conformational transitions to transduce signals. While Molecular Dynamics (MD) is essential for elucidating this transduction process, particularly within ligand-bound complexes, conventional all-atom MD simulation is computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we introduce GPCRLMD, a deep generative framework for efficient all-atom GPCR-ligand simulation. GPCRLMD employs an Atom-Anchored Thermal Variational Autoencoder (AAT-VAE) to first map the complex into a regularized dimension-preserving latent space, maintaining geometric topology via physics-informed constraints. Within this latent space, a Residual Latent Flow samples evolution trajectories, which are subsequently decoded back to atomic coordinates. By capturing temporal dynamics via relative displacements anchored to the initial structure, this residual mechanism effectively decouples static topology from dynamic fluctuations. Experimental results demonstrate that GPCRLMD achieves state-of-the-art performance in GPCR-ligand dynamics simulation, faithfully reproducing ensemble observables and critical ligand-receptor interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GPCRLMD：用 Atom-Anchored Thermal VAE (AAT-VAE) 把全原子 GPCR-配体复合物映射到保维正则潜空间，再在潜空间内用 Residual Latent Flow 采样演化轨迹并解码回原子坐标，以相对位移锚定初始结构、解耦静态拓扑与动态涨落。摘要称其在 GPCR-配体动力学模拟上达到 SOTA，能忠实再现系综观测量与关键配体-受体相互作用。
Motivation: GPCR 是超过三分之一已获批药物的靶点，其配体结合复合物的构象转变需要全原子 MD 才能看清，但常规全原子 MD 计算代价过高，难以高效采样系综。
Method: 两阶段深度生成框架 GPCRLMD：AAT-VAE 以物理约束保持几何拓扑，将复合物编码到正则化、保维的潜空间；Residual Latent Flow 在该潜空间采样演化轨迹，再解码为原子坐标，动态用相对初始结构的位移表示。
Result: 摘要报告 GPCRLMD 在 GPCR-配体动力学模拟上取得 SOTA 性能，忠实再现系综观测量与关键配体-受体相互作用；未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把全原子 GPCR-配体动力学放进物理约束潜空间并用残差流建模，可作为替代高昂常规 MD 的高效模拟路径。

papers.title: MolLangData: A Large-Scale Dataset for Molecular Structure-Language Description via a Rule-Regularized Method
papers.abstract_en: Molecular function is largely determined by structure. Accurately aligning molecular structure with natural language is therefore essential for enabling large language models (LLMs) to both understand structure for chemical reasoning and generate molecules from natural-language design intent. However, the substantial cost of human annotation makes it infeasible to construct large-scale, high-quality datasets of structure-grounded descriptions. This work proposes a fully automated annotation framework for generating precise molecular descriptions at scale, such that the original molecule can be unambiguously reconstructed from the description alone. Our approach extends a rule-based chemical nomenclature parser to interpret IUPAC names and construct enriched, XML metadata that explicitly encodes molecular structure. This is then used to guide LLMs in producing accurate natural-language descriptions. Using this framework, we curate MolLangData, a dataset of approximately $163$k molecule--description pairs. A rigorous validation protocol combining expert human and LLM-based reconstruction on a subset of $2,000$ molecules demonstrates $98.6\%$ description precision. Using the curated dataset, we train a $4$B-parameter LLM via large-scale reinforcement learning for language-conditional molecule generation. The proposed framework and dataset provide a reliable foundation for molecule--language alignment, readily beneficial to broader chemical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出全自动分子结构-语言描述标注框架：扩展规则化 IUPAC 化学命名解析器生成显式编码结构的 XML 元数据，再据此引导 LLM 产出可无歧义重建原分子的描述。据此构建约 163k 分子-描述对的 MolLangData，并用其对 4B 参数 LLM 做大规模强化学习以实现语言条件分子生成；2,000 分子子集上专家与 LLM 重建验证显示描述精度 98.6%。
Motivation: 分子结构与自然语言的对齐是 LLM 做化学推理与按设计意图生成分子的前提，但人工标注成本过高，无法大规模构造高质量的结构 grounding 描述数据。
Method: 扩展规则化化学命名解析器解析 IUPAC 名并构建显式编码分子结构的富化 XML 元数据，用它引导 LLM 生成自然语言描述；验证协议结合专家人工与基于 LLM 的重建，在 2,000 个分子子集上检验描述能否还原原分子；再用约 163k 分子-描述对训练 4B 参数 LLM，做语言条件分子生成的大规模强化学习。
Result: MolLangData 含约 163k 分子-描述对；在 2,000 个分子子集上的验证协议给出 98.6% 描述精度；训练的生成模型为 4B 参数 LLM，采用大规模强化学习。
Conclusion: 规则正则化的自动标注框架能产出可无歧义重建分子的高精度描述，为分子-语言对齐及更广的化学任务提供可靠数据基础。

papers.title: Forest-Guided Semantic Transport for Label-Supervised Manifold Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Label-supervised manifold alignment bridges the gap between unsupervised and correspondence-based paradigms by leveraging shared label information to align multimodal datasets. However, existing methods either rely on label-independent intra-domain geometry or incorporate supervision primarily through the alignment objective, rather than directly constructing task-aware intra-domain affinities. To address this limitation, we introduce FoSTA (Forest-guided Semantic Transport Alignment), which learns supervised forest geometries independently within each domain and uses their shared class-semantic structure to infer cross-domain correspondences without predefined anchors. FoSTA extends RF-GAP affinities to partially labeled data and aligns the resulting semantic representations through scalable hierarchical transport. Extensive comparisons with established baselines demonstrate strong correspondence recovery and semantic structure preservation on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, including multimodal data integration and single-cell batch correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoSTA 在每个域内用标签监督学出随机森林几何 (forest geometry)，把 RF-GAP 亲和度扩展到部分标注数据，再用共享的类语义结构经可扩展的层次化 optimal transport 推断跨域对应，无需预定义锚点。在合成与真实基准上表现出强对应恢复与语义结构保持，覆盖多模态数据整合与单细胞批次校正。
Motivation: 现有标签监督流形对齐要么依赖与标签无关的域内几何，要么只把监督放进对齐目标，没有直接构造任务感知的域内亲和度，导致跨域对应恢复受限。
Method: FoSTA (Forest-guided Semantic Transport Alignment) 在每个域独立学习监督森林几何，将 RF-GAP affinities 扩展到部分标注数据，用共享类语义结构推断跨域对应，并通过可扩展的层次化 transport (hierarchical transport) 对齐语义表示，不依赖预定义 anchors。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上与既有基线比较，展示了强对应恢复 (correspondence recovery) 与语义结构保持，任务覆盖多模态数据整合与单细胞批次校正 (single-cell batch correction)。
Conclusion: 把标签监督直接注入域内亲和度构造、再借共享类语义做无锚对应，是标签监督流形对齐在多模态与单细胞数据上可行的路径。
