papers.title: Environment-Conditioned Tail Reweighting for Invariant Learning under Mixed Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution generalization becomes challenging when spurious correlations vary across environments while difficult or underrepresented samples remain insufficiently emphasized within them. Invariant learning and reweighting address complementary aspects of this mixed-shift problem, yet applying reweighting only to prediction leaves the invariance constraint evaluated on a different training risk. We introduce Environment-Conditioned Tail Reweighting (ECTR), which couples cross-environment TV invariance with within-environment adversarial tail weighting through a shared weighted risk. Sample weights are normalized within each environment, and the resulting risk is used consistently for both predictive learning and the total-variation (TV) stationarity penalty, while an environment-wise KL term controls adversarial concentration. Our analysis characterizes the stationarity-dependent weighting signal and its KL-regularized distributional interpretation, alongside conditional-risk and optimization properties under the stated assumptions. Controlled mixed-shift ablations consistently support the shared-risk coupling across three difficulty settings. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, ECTR achieves favorable results under both observed- and inferred-environment settings, including improvements over TV-based parent methods and strong performance against additional invariant-learning baselines. Training-corruption experiments further show that ECTR assigns less excess weight to corrupted samples than the tested fixed-tail rules. Together, these results provide a unified theoretical and empirical account of environment-conditioned tail reweighting for invariant learning under mixed shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ECTR（Environment-Conditioned Tail Reweighting），把跨环境 TV 不变性约束与环境内对抗性尾部加权放进同一个共享加权风险，使不变性惩罚与预测学习在一致的风险上求驻点。在合成与真实基准、观测环境与推断环境两种设定下均取得有利结果，超过基于 TV 的父方法，并且给污染样本分配的多余权重少于所测固定尾部规则。
Motivation: 混合偏移下伪相关随环境变化，而环境内困难或欠代表样本未被充分强调；若只对预测做重加权，不变性约束却在另一个训练风险上评估，两者脱节。
Method: ECTR 将跨环境 total-variation (TV) 不变性与环境内对抗性尾部加权耦合到共享加权风险：样本权重在每个环境内归一化，同一风险同时用于预测学习与 TV 驻点惩罚，环境级 KL 项控制对抗集中度；分析给出驻点相关加权信号与 KL 正则分布解释，以及条件风险与优化性质。
Result: 受控混合偏移消融在三个难度设定上一致支持共享风险耦合；在合成与真实基准、观测环境与推断环境设定下 ECTR 均取得有利结果，包括超过基于 TV 的父方法并对其他不变性学习基线表现强劲；训练污染实验中 ECTR 分配给污染样本的多余权重少于所测固定尾部规则。
Conclusion: 把不变性约束与尾部重加权统一到同一个加权风险上，可以在混合偏移下同时改善不变性学习的预测与抗污染加权行为。

papers.title: Denoising Time Matters:Diverse Generation in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (Diffusion-LMs) generate text through iterative denoising, exposing a temporal structure that is largely absent from autoregressive decoding. In this paper, we show that this temporal structure provides a useful control axis for generation diversity: early denoising steps mainly determine high-level semantic trajectories, while later steps refine lexical realization. Motivated by this observation, we propose Time-Annealed Perturbation Sampling (TAPS), a training-free inference strategy that samples nearby conditioning trajectories through time-aware, manifold-constrained perturbations. TAPS encourages semantic branching during early denoising and anneals the perturbation away before refinement, improving exploration while preserving prompt alignment, generation quality, and reasoning ability. Experiments on multiple Diffusion-LM backbones, including non-autoregressive and semi-autoregressive models, show that TAPS consistently improves semantic and lexical diversity across open-ended and instruction-following generation tasks, while preserving reasoning ability on verifiable reasoning benchmarks with negligible overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散语言模型 (Diffusion-LM) 的迭代去噪存在时间结构：早期步决定高层语义轨迹，后期步只细化词汇实现。据此提出免训练推理策略 Time-Annealed Perturbation Sampling (TAPS)，在早期用时间感知、流形约束的扰动采样邻近条件轨迹以促进语义分叉，细化前退火掉扰动。在多个 Diffusion-LM 主干（含非自回归与半自回归）上一致提升开放式与指令跟随生成的语义和词汇多样性，同时在可验证推理基准上保持推理能力，开销可忽略。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型的去噪时间结构此前未被用作生成多样性的控制轴，而自回归解码基本没有这种时间结构可供调节。
Method: TAPS 是免训练推理策略：在早期去噪步施加时间感知、流形约束的扰动来采样邻近条件轨迹，鼓励语义分叉；在进入细化阶段前将扰动退火消除，以保住 prompt 对齐与生成质量。
Result: 在多个 Diffusion-LM 主干（非自回归与半自回归）上，开放式生成与指令跟随任务的语义多样性和词汇多样性一致提升；在可验证推理基准 (verifiable reasoning benchmarks) 上保持推理能力，额外开销可忽略 (negligible overhead)。
Conclusion: 去噪时间结构可作为多样性与质量之间的控制轴：只在早期步注入扰动、细化前退火，就能扩大探索而不牺牲对齐、质量与推理能力。

summary_sections.motivation: 扩散语言模型的去噪时间结构此前未被用作生成多样性的控制轴，而自回归解码基本没有这种时间结构可供调节。
summary_sections.method: TAPS 是免训练推理策略：在早期去噪步施加时间感知、流形约束的扰动来采样邻近条件轨迹，鼓励语义分叉；在进入细化阶段前将扰动退火消除，以保住 prompt 对齐与生成质量。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 Diffusion-LM 主干（非自回归与半自回归）上，开放式生成与指令跟随任务的语义多样性和词汇多样性一致提升；在可验证推理基准 (verifiable reasoning benchmarks) 上保持推理能力，额外开销可忽略 (negligible overhead)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 去噪时间结构可作为多样性与质量之间的控制轴：只在早期步注入扰动、细化前退火，就能扩大探索而不牺牲对齐、质量与推理能力。

papers.title: DP-λCGD: Efficient Noise Correlation for Differentially Private Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) is the gold standard for training machine learning models with formal differential privacy guarantees. Several recent extensions improve its accuracy by introducing correlated noise across training iterations. Matrix factorization mechanisms are a prominent example, but they can require storing previously added noise vectors, leading to substantial memory overhead. In this work, we propose a new algorithm for correlated-noise private training that correlates noise only with the immediately preceding iteration and cancels a tunable portion of it. By regenerating the previous noise using a pseudorandom number generator rather than storing it, our method has essentially the same memory footprint as DP-SGD. We show that the computational overhead is minimal and empirically demonstrate improved accuracy over DP-SGD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DP-λCGD 只与上一轮迭代的相关噪声做相关并抵消可调比例，用伪随机数生成器重建上一轮噪声而不存储，使内存占用基本等同 DP-SGD。计算开销极小，且实证精度优于 DP-SGD。
Motivation: DP-SGD 的跨迭代相关噪声扩展（如 matrix factorization 机制）能提升精度，但需要存储此前加入的噪声向量，带来显著内存开销。
Method: 提出 DP-λCGD：相关噪声只与紧邻的上一轮迭代相关并抵消可调比例 λ；上一轮噪声通过伪随机数生成器重建而非存储，从而保持与 DP-SGD 相同的内存足迹。
Result: 内存足迹基本等同 DP-SGD，计算开销极小；实证精度优于 DP-SGD。
Conclusion: 只与上一轮做相关噪声并用伪随机重建替代存储，可以在几乎不增加内存与计算的前提下提升差分隐私训练精度。

papers.title: GLOVE: Global Verifier for LLM Memory-Environment Realignment
papers.abstract_en: Most existing memory-enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) approaches implicitly assume that memory validity can be established either through external evaluators that provide task-specific success signals or through internal model cognition, such as reflection, for editing memory entries. However, these assumptions often break down in practical environments with dynamic drifts. We propose the Global Verifier (GLOVE), a framework that introduces a new design dimension for LLM memory systems by establishing a relative notion of truth. Through active probing to detect inconsistencies between retrieved memories and fresh observations, GLOVE enables memory-environment realignment by verifying and updating memory without access to ground-truth supervision or strong reliance on model introspection. We evaluate GLOVE on diverse benchmarks spanning web navigation, planning, and control, augmented with controlled environmental drifts that introduce non-stationarity beyond the original benchmark settings. Our results show that GLOVE substantially improves agent success rates, suggesting a robust pathway to cognitive agents capable of self-evolving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLOVE 为 LLM 记忆系统引入相对真值：通过主动探测 (active probing) 比对检索到的记忆与新观测，检测不一致后在无 ground-truth 监督、也不依赖模型内省的条件下验证并更新记忆，实现记忆-环境重对齐。在叠加受控环境漂移的网页导航、规划与控制基准上，GLOVE 显著提升智能体成功率。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强 LLM 方法依赖外部评估器给出任务成功信号或依赖模型自身反思来编辑记忆，这两类假设在环境动态漂移、非平稳的实际场景中会失效。
Method: 提出 Global Verifier (GLOVE) 框架，用主动探测比对检索记忆与新观测以发现不一致，据此验证并更新记忆条目，建立不依赖 ground-truth 监督与模型内省的相对真值判定。评测覆盖网页导航、规划与控制三类基准，并加入受控环境漂移以引入原基准之外的非平稳性。
Result: 在带受控环境漂移的网页导航、规划与控制基准上，GLOVE 显著提高智能体成功率；摘要以定性方式报告该提升，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 记忆有效性可以改由记忆与新观测的相对一致性来判定，而非依赖外部成功信号或模型反思；作者据此认为这是通向可自我演化 (self-evolving) 认知智能体的一条稳健路径。

papers.title: OP-Bench: Benchmarking Over-Personalization for Memory-Augmented Personalized Conversational Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented conversational agents enable personalized interactions using long-term user memory and have gained substantial traction. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on whether agents can recall and apply user information, while overlooking whether such personalization is used appropriately. In fact, agents may overuse personal information, producing responses that feel forced, intrusive, or socially inappropriate to users. We refer to this issue as \emph{over-personalization}. In this work, we formalize over-personalization into three types: Irrelevance, Repetition, and Sycophancy, and introduce \textbf{OP-Bench} a benchmark of 1,700 verified instances constructed from long-horizon dialogue histories. Using \textbf{OP-Bench}, we evaluate multiple large language models and memory-augmentation methods, and find that over-personalization is widespread when memory is introduced. Further analysis reveals that agents tend to retrieve and over-attend to user memories even when unnecessary. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Self-ReCheck}, a lightweight, model-agnostic memory filtering mechanism that mitigates over-personalization while preserving personalization performance. Our work takes an initial step toward more controllable and appropriate personalization in memory-augmented dialogue systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OP-Bench 把记忆增强对话代理的过度个性化 (over-personalization) 形式化为 Irrelevance、Repetition、Sycophancy 三类，并用 1,700 条经核验的长程对话实例评测多个 LLM 与记忆增强方法，发现引入记忆后过度个性化普遍存在，代理在不必要时也倾向检索并过度关注用户记忆。提出的轻量、模型无关的记忆过滤机制 Self-ReCheck 在缓解过度个性化的同时保住个性化性能。
Motivation: 现有基准只考察代理能否回忆并使用用户信息，不判断这种使用是否得当；过度使用会让回答显得生硬、冒犯或社交不当。
Method: 将过度个性化形式化为 Irrelevance、Repetition、Sycophancy 三类，构建 OP-Bench：1,700 条由长程对话历史构造并经核验的实例；用它评测多个大语言模型与记忆增强方法，并提出模型无关的轻量记忆过滤机制 Self-ReCheck。
Result: OP-Bench 含 1,700 条核验实例；评测发现引入记忆后过度个性化普遍存在，代理在不必要时仍倾向检索并过度关注用户记忆；Self-ReCheck 缓解过度个性化且保留个性化性能。
Conclusion: 记忆增强对话代理的个性化应当带过滤与可控性，否则记忆本身就会驱动不必要的检索与过度关注。

papers.title: FasterPy: An LLM-based Code Execution Efficiency Optimization Framework
papers.abstract_en: Code often suffers from performance bugs. These bugs necessitate the research and practice of code optimization. Traditional rule-based methods rely on manually designing and maintaining rules for specific performance bugs (e.g., redundant loops, repeated computations), making them laborintensive and limited in applicability. In recent years, machine learning and deep learning-based methods have emerged as promising alternatives by learning optimization heuristics from annotated code corpora and performance measurements. However, these approaches usually depend on specific program representations and meticulously crafted training datasets, making them costly to develop and difficult to scale. With the booming of Large Language Models (LLMs), their remarkable capabilities in code generation have opened new avenues for automated code optimization. In this work, we proposed FasterPy, a low-cost and efficient framework that adapts LLMs to optimize the execution efficiency of Python code. FasterPy combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), supported by a knowledge base constructed from existing performance-improving code pairs and corresponding performance measurements, with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to enhance code optimization performance. Our experimental results on the Performance-Improving Code Edits (PIE) benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across multiple metrics. The FasterPy tool and the experimental results are available at https://github.com/WuYue22/fasterpy.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 6 images, 15 tables, Manuscript revision submitted to a Journal (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FasterPy 用检索增强生成 (RAG) 加 LoRA 微调把 LLM 适配到 Python 代码执行效率优化：知识库由已有的性能改进代码对及其性能测量构成，检索到的优化先例与测量结果引导模型改写代码。在 Performance-Improving Code Edits (PIE) 基准上，实验结果显示该方法在多个指标上有效，工具与结果已开源。
Motivation: 规则式优化需为每类性能 bug 手工设计维护规则，劳动密集且适用面窄；基于机器学习的方法又依赖特定程序表示和精心构造的训练集，开发成本高、难以扩展。
Method: FasterPy 组合 RAG 与 LoRA：先用现有性能改进代码对及其性能测量构建知识库，检索时把相关优化先例注入 LLM 提示，再用 LoRA 对模型做低成本适配，共同提升代码优化输出。
Result: 在 PIE (Performance-Improving Code Edits) 基准上的实验表明 FasterPy 在多个指标上体现有效性；工具与实验结果发布于 github.com/WuYue22/fasterpy。
Conclusion: 用 RAG 知识库加 LoRA 低成本适配 LLM，即可有效提升 Python 代码执行效率优化效果，摆脱对手工规则与专用训练集的依赖。

papers.title: Role Support in Knowledge-Graph Error Ranking: Predictor Regimes and Evaluation Policies
papers.abstract_en: When do role-specific training counts improve knowledge-graph error ranking? We evaluate fifteen from-scratch predictors, nine development-selected continuation stages, and six fixed ensembles across three static graphs. A positive penalty for missing training support has no stable error-ranking orientation: stronger ComplEx training reverses its pooled error AUROC from 0.689 to 0.364 on FB15k-237, and from 0.729 to 0.430 in a prospectively specified CoDEx-S check. Pair decomposition shows that reversal also survives pair-weighted within-relation evaluation, but not equal-relation averaging. The statement depends on which relations and query pairs receive weight. Learned continuous counts remain useful: they improve AURC and Brier beyond explicit ensemble disagreement in twelve original ensemble/head comparisons and satisfy all four predefined external-dataset AURC contrasts. Binary indicators add no information beyond their defining counts and have less stable fitting effects. Candidate, target, population and acceptance policies change the comparisons; fixed development thresholds do not preserve a common test answer rate. The external study was fixed before inspection of its test outcomes, whereas subsequent explanations and reused-graph controls are explicitly exploratory. These measurements support relation-aware count baselines and policy-specific support diagnostics, not a new uncertainty decomposition, causal training mechanism, calibrated factual truth, or graph-population guarantee. Saved checkpoints, ledgers and separately authored numerical implementation replays make the scoped findings inspectable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三个静态知识图谱上系统检验角色特定训练计数何时改善错误排序：对缺失训练支持加正惩罚没有稳定方向，更强的 ComplEx 训练把 FB15k-237 的合并 error AUROC 从 0.689 反转到 0.364，CoDEx-S 前瞻性检验中从 0.729 反转到 0.430。作者主张采用 relation-aware 计数基线与按策略区分的支持诊断，而非新的不确定性分解。
Motivation: 知识图谱错误排序中，角色特定训练计数何时真正改善排序、以及评估策略如何改变结论，此前缺少跨预测器、跨图的系统证据；正惩罚的符号方向本身就不稳定。
Method: 评估十五个从头训练的预测器、九个开发集选定的续训阶段与六个固定 ensemble，覆盖 FB15k-237、CoDEx-S 等三个静态图；用 pair decomposition 做 pair-weighted 与 equal-relation 两种加权对照，并比较 candidate、target、population、acceptance 四类策略与固定开发阈值；外部数据集检验在查看其测试结果前预先固定，后续解释与复用图对照标为探索性。
Result: 缺失训练支持的正惩罚合并 error AUROC 在 FB15k-237 上由 0.689 反转为 0.364，在前瞻性指定的 CoDEx-S 检验中由 0.729 反转为 0.430；该反转在 pair-weighted within-relation 评估中保留，但在 equal-relation 平均下消失。学习到的连续计数在十二组原始 ensemble/head 对比中同时改善 AURC 与 Brier，且超越显式 ensemble disagreement，并满足全部四个预定义外部数据集 AURC 对比；二值指示在其定义计数之外不提供信息且拟合效应更不稳定。固定开发阈值无法保持共同的测试答案率。
Conclusion: 训练支持惩罚的方向取决于哪些关系与查询对获得权重，因此应报告 relation-aware 计数基线与策略特定的支持诊断；这些测量不支持新的不确定性分解、因果训练机制、校准事实真值或图总体保证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 训练支持惩罚的方向取决于哪些关系与查询对获得权重，因此应报告 relation-aware 计数基线与策略特定的支持诊断；这些测量不支持新的不确定性分解、因果训练机制、校准事实真值或图总体保证。

papers.title: PACGNet: Pyramidal Adaptive Cross-Gating Network for Multimodal Object Detection in Aerial Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Object detection in aerial imagery is challenging because targets are often small, backgrounds are cluttered, and imaging conditions vary substantially. Multimodal sensing can improve robustness by providing complementary visual and spectral information, but effective fusion must balance cross-modal interaction with computational cost. This paper presents PACGNet, a lightweight backbone-centric framework for multimodal aerial object detection. Its Symmetrical Cross-Gating (SCG) module performs bidirectional gated interaction between the two modality streams at the same feature scale while retaining residual pathways for the original representations. The Pyramidal Feature-aware Multimodal Gating (PFMG) module subsequently forms a single fused feature pyramid by using the preceding higher-resolution level as a spatial prior for fusion at the next level. PACGNet achieves 82.2% mAP50 on the held-out DroneVehicle test set and 82.1% mAP50 on VEDAI with only 5.2 M parameters and 13.2 GFLOPs. These results indicate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for lightweight multimodal aerial object detection. Code is available at https://github.com/Alianess/PACGNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACGNet 用对称交叉门控 (SCG) 在同一特征尺度上做双模态双向门控并保留残差通路，再用金字塔特征感知多模态门控 (PFMG) 以上一层高分辨率特征为空间先验逐级融合出单一特征金字塔。在 DroneVehicle 留出测试集上 mAP50 达 82.2%，VEDAI 上 82.1%，参数量仅 5.2 M、13.2 GFLOPs，说明轻量级多模态航拍检测可同时保住精度与算力效率。
Motivation: 航拍目标小、背景杂乱、成像条件变化大，多模态互补信息能提升鲁棒性，但跨模态交互与计算开销难以兼顾，需要轻量的融合结构。
Method: backbone-centric 轻量框架：SCG 模块在同一特征尺度上对两路模态流做双向门控交互并保留原始表示的残差通路；PFMG 模块以前一更高分辨率层级为空间先验，逐级融合生成单一特征金字塔。
Result: DroneVehicle 留出测试集 mAP50 82.2%，VEDAI mAP50 82.1%，参数量 5.2 M，计算量 13.2 GFLOPs。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果体现了轻量级多模态航拍目标检测中精度与效率的良好权衡，代码已开源。

papers.title: Shapley-based Data Valuation for LLM Alignment via Sequential Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Data valuation is a natural framework for understanding which data sources matter most when aligning a Large Language Model (LLM) from multiple sources. The standard game-theoretic approach treats each source, or equivalently each preference dataset, as a player in a cooperative game and assigns it a contribution score through the Shapley value. In practice, however, Shapley-based valuation is computationally prohibitive because it requires aligning a separate model for every possible coalition of sources, i.e., an exponential number of alignments. We address this challenge for Direct Alignment Algorithms (DAAs), including IPO, which learn through log-policy ratios with respect to a reference policy. We show that, when a model is aligned sequentially source by source, exact optimization makes each stage contribute additively to the log-probability of a full response, up to a prompt-dependent normalization constant. This allows the log-probability assigned by any coalition to a fixed response to be reconstructed from the base policy and the policies trained on each source individually. This reduces the alignment cost of Shapley-based valuation from exponential to linear, since only one model per source needs to be trained to evaluate coalition scores. We test whether this theoretical property remains approximately valid under finite training across several base models and real-world data sources. We finally compute the Shapley values of these sources under multiple reward models, showing how their estimated contributions vary across evaluation criteria.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 对齐中 Shapley 数据估值需对每个来源组合各训一个模型的指数开销，论文证明：当模型按来源顺序做 Direct Alignment Algorithms (DAA，含 IPO) 对齐时，精确优化使每个阶段对完整响应 log-probability 的贡献可加（差一个 prompt 相关归一化常数），因此任意联盟的打分可由基策略与各单来源策略重建，把估值成本从指数降到线性——每个来源只需训一个模型。
Motivation: 多来源偏好对齐中想知道哪些偏好数据集真正起作用，但标准 Shapley 估值要求对指数多个联盟各做一次完整对齐，计算上不可行。
Method: 针对基于 log-policy ratio、相对参考策略学习的 Direct Alignment Algorithms（如 IPO），推导顺序逐来源对齐下各阶段对响应 log-probability 的可加性，从而由基策略与单来源策略重建任意联盟打分；再在多个基模型与真实数据来源上检验该性质在有限训练下是否近似成立，并在多个 reward model 下计算来源的 Shapley 值。
Result: 理论上把 Shapley 估值的对齐开销从指数降为线性（每个来源只训一个模型）；在多个基模型与真实数据来源上检验有限训练下可加性近似是否保持；在多个 reward model 下计算各来源 Shapley 值，显示其估计贡献随评价标准而变化。
Conclusion: 顺序对齐的可加性使 Shapley 数据估值可在 LLM 对齐中以线性成本实现，而来源贡献的排序依赖于所用 reward model。

papers.title: On Memory: A comparison of memory mechanisms in world models
papers.abstract_en: World models enable agents to plan within imagined environments by predicting future states conditioned on past observations and actions. However, their ability to plan over long horizons is limited by the effective memory span of the backbone architecture. This limitation leads to perceptual drift in long rollouts, degrading the model's capacity to recall recently observed scenes. In this work, we investigate the effective memory span of transformer-based world models through an analysis of memory augmentation mechanisms. We introduce a taxonomy that distinguishes between memory \emph{encoding} and memory \emph{injection} mechanisms, motivating their roles in extending the world model's memory through the lens of residual stream dynamics. We evaluate twenty combinations of four encoding methods and five injection methods in the MemoryMaze environment. Using a state recall evaluation task across multiple imagination horizons, we measure the memory recall capacity of each mechanism and analyze their respective trade-offs in reconstruction quality, latent prediction error, and computational cost. We further ablate the effect of injection depth and compare the best memory-augmented vision transformer against a pure state-space model backbone. Our central finding is that the mLSTM memory encoder outperforms all alternatives in both reconstruction and latent fidelity metrics. Paired with additive injection, it exhibits the strongest recall capabilities at a moderate computational cost while matching or slightly exceeding a pure Mamba backbone. This evaluation is limited to a single environment and does not explore the effect of each mechanism on downstream task performance. We believe these research directions merit an in-depth study of their own to clearly isolate the effects, and therefore are left for future work.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Published in the Transactions on Machine Learning Research
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (09/2026), Paper 8547
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MemoryMaze 中评测 4 种记忆编码 × 5 种注入共 20 种组合，发现 mLSTM 编码器在重建与 latent 保真度上全面领先，配 additive injection 时召回能力最强、计算开销中等，且匹配或略优于纯 Mamba backbone。
Motivation: Transformer backbone 的有效记忆跨度限制了 world model 的长时程规划，长 rollout 中出现 perceptual drift，模型难以回忆最近观察到的场景。
Method: 提出区分 memory encoding 与 memory injection 的分类法，并从 residual stream dynamics 角度解释二者作用；在 MemoryMaze 中评测 4 种编码方法与 5 种注入方法的 20 种组合，用跨多个 imagination horizon 的 state recall 任务度量召回容量，并消融 injection depth，将最优记忆增强 ViT 与纯 state-space (Mamba) backbone 对比。
Result: mLSTM 记忆编码器在重建与 latent 保真度指标上均优于全部备选；配合 additive injection 时召回能力最强、计算开销中等，匹配或略超纯 Mamba backbone；各机制在重建质量、latent 预测误差与计算成本之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: 编码与注入机制的选择直接决定 world model 的有效记忆跨度，mLSTM + additive injection 是该设置下的最优组合；结论限于单一环境，未考察各机制对下游任务性能的影响。

papers.title: Why They Disagree: Decoding Differences in Opinions about AI Risk
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the reasons for disagreements between influential points of view on issues that affect the public can help produce informed policy responses, even if they do not bring disagreeing parties closer to agreement. We present a methodology for extracting reasoning chains - the sequences of premises that motivate or justify opinions - from natural discourse, and for characterizing the types of premises (facts, forecasts, definitions, causal beliefs, and evaluations) that make up these chains. We demonstrate the utility of this approach for two practical goals: diagnosing specific points of contention and aggregating arguments across speakers. We illustrate the methodology through an analysis of the debates on the nature of risks that AI poses to the public, using a corpus of interviews from the Lex Fridman podcast. We find that differences in perspectives among the podcast's guests on existential risk and employment risk from AI arise primarily from differences in causal premises and forecasts, whereas in the case of AI's effects on human social relationships, premises regarding what is valued and definitions about what counts as genuine human connection play a distinctively larger role. Our approach to analyzing reasoning chains at scale, using an ensemble of LLMs to parse textual data, can be applied to facilitate deliberation and aggregation of opinions on any topic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从自然语篇中抽取推理链（reasoning chains）的方法，用 LLM 集群把论证拆成前提序列，并将前提分类为事实、预测、定义、因果信念与评价五类，用于定位分歧点与跨说话人聚合论点。在 Lex Fridman 播客 AI 风险访谈语料上，存在风险与就业风险的分歧主要来自因果前提和预测差异，而 AI 对人际关系影响的分歧则更多由价值前提与“何为真实人类连接”的定义差异驱动。
Motivation: 公共议题上影响力观点之间的分歧难以被结构化诊断：现有讨论停留在立场对立，无法指出双方究竟在哪一类前提上不一致，因而难以支撑有针对性的政策回应。
Method: 从自然语篇中抽取推理链（即支撑观点的前提序列），并把前提分类为事实、预测、定义、因果信念、评价五类；用 LLM 集群 (ensemble of LLMs) 大规模解析文本，服务于诊断具体争点与跨说话人聚合论点两个目标，示例语料为 Lex Fridman 播客的 AI 风险访谈。
Result: 在播客嘉宾关于 AI 存在风险与就业风险的观点差异中，分歧主要源于因果前提与预测的不同；而在 AI 对人类社会关系的影响上，关于价值的前提以及“什么算真正的人类连接”的定义性前提作用明显更大。
Conclusion: 分歧的类型随议题而变：风险类议题分歧集中在因果与预测前提，关系类议题分歧集中在价值与定义前提，因此诊断争点需按议题区分前提类型；该推理链分析框架可迁移到任意议题的审议与意见聚合。

papers.title: The Devil in the Details: Emergent Misalignment, Format and Coherence in Open-Weights LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Prior work has shown that fine-tuning models on a narrow domain with misaligned data can lead to broad misalignment - a phenomenon termed "emergent misalignment" (Betley et al. 2025). While all tested models were susceptible to emergent misalignment, some models showed more resistance than others. Specifically the Qwen-2.5 family proved to be relatively resistant, while GPT-4o exhibited the strongest misalignment. In this paper we evaluate if current-generation open-weights models exhibit similar resistance to the Qwen-2.5 family and measure misalignment robustness over a range of model architectures and scales. We replicate the effect across nine modern open-weights models (Gemma 3 and Qwen 3 families, 1B-32B parameters). Models fine-tuned on insecure code generation show a 0.68% misalignment rate (compared to 0.07% for base models), matching the lower end of prior open-model results but dramatically lower than GPT-4o's 20%. We identify a critical format-dependent vulnerability: requiring JSON output doubles misalignment rates compared to natural language prompts (0.96% vs 0.42%). This suggests that structural constraints may bypass safety training by reducing the model's 'degrees of freedom' to refuse. These findings confirm emergent misalignment as a reproducible phenomenon in modern open-weights models, with rates substantially lower than observed in proprietary systems.
papers.comment: v2: corrects a misattribution. The 7.3% misalignment rate cited from Betley et al. (2025) was reported for Mistral-Small-Instruct-2501, not Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as stated in v1. Also fixes two appendix cross-references. No other changes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在九个现代开放权重模型（Gemma 3 与 Qwen 3，1B–32B）上复现 emergent misalignment：用不安全代码微调后错位率 0.68%，基座模型 0.07%，远低于 GPT-4o 的 20%。强制 JSON 输出使错位率翻倍（0.96% vs 自然语言 0.42%），说明结构化输出约束会压缩模型拒绝的自由度、绕过安全训练。
Motivation: 已有工作表明窄域错位数据微调可引发广泛错位，但开放权重模型在不同架构与规模上的抗性尚不清楚，且输出格式这类部署细节是否改变风险未被量化。
Method: 在 Gemma 3 与 Qwen 3 两个家族共九个模型（1B–32B）上复现 emergent misalignment 实验：以不安全代码生成数据微调，再对比自然语言提示与强制 JSON 输出两种格式下的错位率，并与既有开放模型结果及 GPT-4o 对照。
Result: 不安全代码微调后错位率 0.68%，基座模型 0.07%；GPT-4o 为 20%；JSON 输出 0.96% 对自然语言 0.42%，即翻倍。v2 更正：Betley et al. (2025) 引用的 7.3% 错位率属于 Mistral-Small-Instruct-2501 而非 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。
Conclusion: emergent misalignment 在现代开放权重模型中可复现但比率显著低于专有系统，而 JSON 之类的结构化输出约束构成关键的格式依赖脆弱点，会绕过安全训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PostCam: Camera-Controllable Novel-View Video Generation with Query-Shared Cross-Attention
papers.abstract_en: We propose PostCam, a streamlined framework for novel-view video generation that achieves superior detail preservation and precise camera trajectory editing in dynamic scenes. Current methods often struggle with a trade-off between pose-based control, which lacks visual detail, and rendering-based guidance, which is overly sensitive to geometric accuracy. Despite recent hybrid attempts, achieving precise motion and visual consistency remains challenging due to the lack of effective cross-modal alignment. We argue that robust control stems from the deep alignment of multimodal signals rather than increased input complexity. Our core contribution is the Query-Shared Cross-Attention mechanism, which projects 6-DoF poses and rendered features into a unified latent space. This allows the model to spontaneously achieve intrinsic consistency between motion cues and pixel-level guidance during denoising. Experiments demonstrate that PostCam maintains high-fidelity visual details while outperforming state-of-the-art methods by 20% in trajectory precision, exhibiting superior robustness in complex dynamic scenes. Our project webpage is publicly available at: https://cccqaq.github.io/PostCam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PostCam 用 Query-Shared Cross-Attention 把 6-DoF 位姿与渲染特征投到统一隐空间，让去噪过程中运动线索与像素级引导自发对齐，从而在动态场景新视角视频生成里同时保住细节与相机轨迹编辑精度。实验显示其轨迹精度比现有最先进方法高 20%，在复杂动态场景中更稳健。
Motivation: 现有方法在基于位姿的控制（缺视觉细节）与基于渲染的引导（对几何精度过敏感）之间取舍，混合方案又因跨模态对齐不足而难以同时做到精确运动与视觉一致。
Method: 核心是 Query-Shared Cross-Attention 机制：把 6-DoF 位姿和渲染特征投影到统一隐空间，在扩散去噪过程中共享 query，使运动线索与像素级引导内在一致；作者主张控制力来自多模态信号的深度对齐而非增加输入复杂度。
Result: 实验中 PostCam 在轨迹精度上超出最先进方法 20%，同时保持高保真视觉细节，并在复杂动态场景中表现出更强稳健性。
Conclusion: 相机可控的新视角视频生成的关键是把位姿与渲染特征对齐到同一隐空间，而非堆叠更多输入条件。

papers.title: Digital Agriculture Sandbox for Collaborative Research
papers.abstract_en: Digital agriculture is transforming the way we grow food by utilizing technology to make farming more efficient, sustainable, and productive. This modern approach to agriculture generates a wealth of valuable data that could help address global food challenges, but farmers are hesitant to share it due to privacy concerns. This limits the extent to which researchers can learn from this data to inform improvements in farming. This paper presents the Digital Agriculture Sandbox, a secure online platform that solves this problem. The platform enables farmers (with limited technical resources) and researchers to collaborate on analyzing farm data without exposing private information. We employ specialized techniques such as federated learning, differential privacy, and data analysis methods to safeguard the data while maintaining its utility for research purposes. The system enables farmers to identify similar farmers in a simplified manner without needing extensive technical knowledge or access to computational resources. Similarly, it enables researchers to learn from the data and build helpful tools without the sensitive information ever leaving the farmer's system. This creates a safe space where farmers feel comfortable sharing data, allowing researchers to make important discoveries. Our platform helps bridge the gap between maintaining farm data privacy and utilizing that data to address critical food and farming challenges worldwide.
papers.comment: Presents a privacy-preserving digital agriculture platform using federated learning, differential privacy, and secure data analysis to enable collaboration between farmers and researchers without exposing raw data. Demonstrates secure similarity search, model training, and risk-aware data sharing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Digital Agriculture Sandbox 是一个面向农业数据的隐私保护协作平台，用联邦学习、差分隐私和安全数据分析让农户与研究者在原始数据不出本地的前提下共享与建模。平台支持农户在无需技术背景和算力的情况下查找相似农户，研究者在敏感信息不离开农户系统的情况下训练模型，并演示了安全相似搜索、模型训练与风险感知数据共享。
Motivation: 农业数据能用于应对粮食与 farming 挑战，但农户因隐私顾虑不愿共享，研究者因此难以从数据中提炼改进 farming 的结论；同时农户缺乏技术与算力资源。
Method: 构建在线平台 Digital Agriculture Sandbox，组合联邦学习、差分隐私与数据分析方法：农户侧保留原始数据，研究者通过分布式训练与安全相似搜索获取效用，另加风险感知的数据共享机制控制暴露程度。
Result: 系统演示了安全相似搜索、模型训练与风险感知数据共享三项能力，使农户无需技术知识或计算资源即可识别相似农户，研究者可在敏感信息不离开农户系统的情况下构建工具。
Conclusion: 隐私保护技术可以在不暴露原始农场数据的前提下同时保住数据效用与协作空间，从而弥合 farm data privacy 与利用数据应对全球粮食挑战之间的缺口。

papers.title: Server-Enforced Watermarking in U-Shaped Split Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: U-shaped split federated learning (U-SFL) enables resource-constrained Internet of Things devices to collaboratively train models with an edge server while retaining raw data and labels locally. We consider model-service deployments in which a provider supplies proprietary models whose client-side segments reside on participating devices, creating risks of unauthorized copying and redistribution. Protecting these segments is challenging because the server cannot directly access client data, labels, or model parameters, and potentially malicious clients may refuse to perform watermark embedding. To address this challenge, we propose Sigil, a server-enforced watermarking framework for U-SFL. Sigil defines a secret watermark constraint in the server-visible activation space and embeds the watermark into client-side models by injecting a watermark gradient into the gradients returned during training. This mechanism requires neither access to clients' raw data and labels nor client-side watermarking operations. To limit interference with the main task and reduce detectability by gradient anomaly detectors, Sigil adaptively clips the watermark gradient relative to the main-task gradient. Experiments on two datasets and four model architectures demonstrate high watermark detection rates with limited impact on task accuracy, robustness against the evaluated removal attacks, and stealthiness against the evaluated gradient anomaly detector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 U 型分割联邦学习 (U-SFL) 中客户端可能拒绝嵌入水印的问题，提出服务器强制水印框架 Sigil：在服务器可见的激活空间定义秘密水印约束，通过向训练中客户端回传的梯度注入水印梯度来嵌入，并按主任务梯度自适应裁剪以降低对任务的干扰与被梯度异常检测器发现的风险。在两个数据集和四种模型架构上，Sigil 取得高水印检测率、对任务精度影响有限，并对所评估的移除攻击与所评估的梯度异常检测器表现出鲁棒性与隐蔽性。
Motivation: 供应商把模型的客户端分段部署到参与设备上时面临未授权复制与再分发风险，而服务器无法访问客户端数据、标签和参数，恶意客户端又可能拒绝配合水印嵌入。
Method: Sigil 在服务器可见的激活空间定义秘密水印约束，在训练期间向客户端回传的梯度注入水印梯度，从而在客户端侧模型中嵌入水印；同时相对主任务梯度自适应裁剪水印梯度，以限制对主任务的干扰并降低被梯度异常检测器察觉的可能。整个机制不需要访问客户端原始数据与标签，也不需要客户端执行任何水印操作。
Result: 在两个数据集和四种模型架构上的实验显示：水印检测率高且对任务精度影响有限；对所评估的移除攻击具有鲁棒性；对所评估的梯度异常检测器保持隐蔽。
Conclusion: 水印可以完全由服务器在训练梯度通路上强制嵌入，无需客户端协作或接触原始数据，同时兼顾检测率、任务精度、抗移除与隐蔽性。

papers.title: AI-driven ionic liquid discovery with unified chemical intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The rational discovery of functional solvents remains challenging because macroscopic solvent behaviors emerge from complex many-body interactions across vast chemical spaces. Ionic Liquids (ILs) constitute one of the most chemically diverse solvent families, yet their exceptional structural tunability remains only partially explored owing to the limitations of existing experimental and computational approaches. Here we introduce AIonopedia, a large-language-model-orchestrated agentic framework for IL research. Built around a domain-specific multimodal foundation model, it integrates information retrieval, chemical reasoning and autonomous tool execution within a unified architecture. Pretrained on large-scale unlabeled corpora and fine-tuned using over 80,000 curated measurements, AIonopedia learns expressive joint representations of multicomponent ionic systems, enabling accurate prediction across diverse physicochemical properties. Through a series of literature-grounded evaluations, AIonopedia exhibits robust out-of-distribution generalization, while many-body-expansion-based analysis provides physically grounded explanations of structure-property relationships. By coupling molecular screening and optimization with wet-lab validation in a closed-loop workflow, AIonopedia identifies high-performance ILs and reveals transferable design principles for the capture of various volatile organic compounds. This work establishes an end-to-end AI-driven paradigm for understanding and exploring complex ionic systems, demonstrating the promise of chemically specialized foundation models as a generalizable strategy for scientific discovery.
papers.comment: 25-page main manuscript with 5 figures; Supporting Information included (96 pages, 16 figures; 121 pages total)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AIonopedia：以领域专用多模态基础模型为核心、由 LLM 编排的离子液体 (IL) 智能体框架，把检索、化学推理与自主工具执行统一在一个架构里，并用闭环把分子筛选与湿实验验证接起来。模型在 80,000 余条精修测量上微调，展示出稳健的分布外泛化，识别出高性能 IL 并给出可迁移的挥发性有机物 (VOC) 捕获设计原则。
Motivation: 溶剂宏观行为源于跨巨大化学空间的多体相互作用，实验与计算手段都难以覆盖离子液体这一结构多样性极高的溶剂家族，其结构可调性至今只被部分探索。
Method: AIonopedia 由 LLM 编排，围绕一个领域专用多模态基础模型集成信息检索、化学推理与自主工具执行；先在大规模无标注语料上预训练，再用 80,000 余条精修测量微调，学习多组分离子体系的联合表示，并以 many-body expansion 分析给出结构-性质关系的物理解释，最后耦合分子筛选优化与湿实验验证构成闭环工作流。
Result: 在一系列文献支撑的评估中 AIonopedia 展现出稳健的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 泛化，可跨多种理化性质做准确预测；微调所用精修测量超过 80,000 条；闭环流程识别出高性能 IL 并提炼出适用于多种挥发性有机物捕获的可迁移设计原则。
Conclusion: 化学专用基础模型可以作为科学发现的可泛化策略，支撑从理解到探索复杂离子体系的端到端 AI 驱动范式。

papers.title: SPIDER: Scalable Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
papers.abstract_en: Learning agile robotic policies requires large-scale demonstrations, but translating abundant human motion data to robots is bottlenecked by the embodiment gap and missing dynamic information. To bridge this gap, we propose Scalable Physics-Informed DExterous Retargeting (SPIDER), a physics-based retargeting framework to transform and augment kinematic-only human demonstrations into dynamically feasible robot trajectories at scale. Our key insight is that human demonstrations should provide global task structure and objective, while a sampling-based solver can be used to find the feasible solution given the physics constraints. As a general framework, SPIDER is an efficient physics-based retargeting method that can be applied to both humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation and dexterous manipulation across 9 humanoid/dexterous hand embodiments, 6 datasets and 3 simulators. By bypassing the need for policy optimization, it achieves state-of-the-art performance while being 10x faster than reinforcement learning (RL) baselines. Furthermore, SPIDER enables physics-based data augmentation, such as imposing external payloads, perturbations, and new contact patterns, to generate diverse data. We demonstrate that the retargeted motion can be executed on the robot directly open-loop or serve as feasible reference motion for efficient RL policy learning. Our pipeline enables large-scale generation of robot trajectories from human motion, and we release a dataset of 6,520 simulated demonstrations across four hands and 191 dataset-specific object identities to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPIDER 用基于物理的重定向把纯运动学人体演示批量转成动力学可行的机器人轨迹：人体演示只提供全局任务结构与目标，采样式求解器在物理约束下找可行解，从而绕开策略优化。在 9 种人形/灵巧手本体、6 个数据集、3 个仿真器上达到 state-of-the-art 且比 RL 基线快 10 倍，并发布 6,520 条仿真演示（四只手、191 个物体身份）。
Motivation: 灵巧机器人策略需要大规模演示，但人体动作到机器人的迁移受本体差异 (embodiment gap) 和动力学信息缺失制约，纯运动学重定向的轨迹往往动力学不可行。
Method: SPIDER 是基于物理的重定向框架：人体演示提供全局任务结构与目标函数，采样式求解器在物理约束下求可行解，绕过策略优化；支持施加外载荷、扰动与新接触模式做物理数据增强，输出可直接开环执行或作为 RL 参考动作。
Result: 覆盖 9 种 humanoid/灵巧手本体、6 个数据集、3 个仿真器，达到 state-of-the-art 且比 RL 基线快 10 倍；发布 6,520 条仿真演示数据集，跨四只手与 191 个数据集内物体身份。
Conclusion: 把人体演示当结构、把可行性交给物理求解器，可以绕过策略优化大规模生成可执行机器人轨迹，重定向结果还能直接开环执行或用于高效 RL 学习。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Action-Driven Processes for Continuous-Time Control
papers.abstract_en: At the heart of reinforcement learning are actions -- decisions made in response to observations of the environment. Actions are equally fundamental in the modeling of stochastic processes, as they trigger discontinuous state transitions and enable the flow of information through large, complex systems. In this paper, we unify the perspectives of stochastic processes and reinforcement learning through action-driven processes, and illustrate their application to spiking neural networks. Leveraging ideas from control-as-inference, we show that minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between a policy-driven true distribution and a reward-driven model distribution for a suitably defined action-driven process is equivalent to maximum entropy reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把随机过程与强化学习统一为 action-driven process：动作触发状态的不连续跳变并驱动信息在大系统中流动，据此证明在该过程上最小化策略驱动真分布与奖励驱动模型分布之间的 KL 散度，等价于最大熵强化学习 (maximum entropy RL)，并以脉冲神经网络 (spiking neural networks) 作示例应用。
Motivation: 随机过程建模与强化学习对“动作”的理解长期分立：前者用跳变描述状态突变，后者把动作视为对观测的决策，缺少统一形式把 control-as-inference 与跳变过程接起来。
Method: 以 control-as-inference 为框架定义 action-driven process，构造策略驱动的真分布与奖励驱动的模型分布，对二者取 KL 散度并证明其最小化等价于最大熵强化学习；在脉冲神经网络上演示该过程的应用。
Result: 核心结论为等价性定理：action-driven process 上的 KL 散度最小化与最大熵强化学习等价；摘要给出的是理论推导与 SNN 应用示例，无实验指标或数据集数字。
Conclusion: 动作可作为统一随机过程与强化学习的原语，最大熵 RL 可由跳变式 action-driven process 的分布匹配推导出来，而非独立假设。

papers.title: Wavelet-Based Parity Detection Revisited: Representation Dependence, Generalization, and Mechanistic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Parity is exactly determined by the least significant bit (LSB), so machine learning is unnecessary for solving the task. This work instead uses parity as a controlled diagnostic for studying how a classical signal-processing pipeline preserves, amplifies, or suppresses access to symbolic information embedded in a numerical representation. Integers from 0 to 10,000 are encoded as fixed-width 32-bit binary signals, decomposed with a level-3 Daubechies-2 (db2) discrete wavelet transform, summarized by mean absolute coefficient magnitude, and clustered independently per subband with k-means. Clustering is unsupervised, while cluster-to-parity calibration uses training labels only under a stratified 60/20/20 train/validation/test protocol. The frozen configuration reaches 84.26% accuracy on the held-out test set (95% Wilson CI: 82.60-85.79%), and 84.20% +/- 0.57% across 20 stratified resplits. Raw binary summary statistics reach 61.30%, while masking the LSB reduces validation accuracy to 48.15%, consistent with chance. The A3 approximation band alone retains 83.20%, whereas detail bands remain near chance. Performance is strongly representation-dependent: moving the parity bit changes validation accuracy up to 98.60%, and changing the wavelet boundary mode ranges from 54.45% to 83.20%. Cross-magnitude extrapolation degrades from 79.98% on 10,001-20,000 to 59.69% on 100,001-1,000,000. These results do not show that wavelets discover the arithmetic rule of parity. Rather, they show that information already present in the binary encoding becomes more or less recoverable depending on multiscale filtering, spatial alignment, and boundary handling.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 13 figures, 2 tables. Substantially revised version with leakage-safe train/validation/test evaluation, robustness and out-of-distribution experiments, mechanistic ablations, and reproducibility artifacts. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/Ertugrulmutlu/Using-Wavelets-and-Clustering-to-Predict-Odd-or-Even-Numbers (tag: paper-v2)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 parity 作受控诊断，检验小波流水线如何保留或压制数值表示中嵌入的符号信息：0–10,000 的整数编成 32-bit 信号，经 level-3 db2 DWT、子带均值幅度摘要与 k-means 聚类后校准到奇偶标签，冻结配置在留出测试集达 84.26%。掩掉 LSB 后降到 48.15%（近随机），且移动 parity 位可让验证准确率变到 98.60%，说明可恢复性取决于多尺度滤波、空间对齐与边界处理，而非小波发现了奇偶规则。
Motivation: parity 由 LSB 唯一决定，机器学习本无必要；作者借此当受控诊断，考察经典信号处理流水线在何种表示下保留、放大或压制符号信息的可恢复性。
Method: 整数 0–10,000 编码为固定宽度 32-bit 二进制信号，做 level-3 Daubechies-2 (db2) 离散小波变换，按子带取平均绝对系数幅度作摘要，各子带独立 k-means 聚类（无监督），再仅用训练标签做 cluster-to-parity 校准，采用分层 60/20/20 train/validation/test 协议。
Result: 冻结配置留出测试集 84.26%（95% Wilson CI 82.60–85.79%），20 次分层重切分 84.20%±0.57%；原始二进制摘要统计 61.30%；掩蔽 LSB 后验证准确率降至 48.15%（近随机）；仅 A3 近似带保留 83.20%，细节带近随机；移动 parity 位使验证准确率最高变到 98.60%，改变小波边界模式在 54.45%–83.20% 之间；跨量级外推从 10,001–20,000 的 79.98% 降到 100,001–1,000,000 的 59.69%。
Conclusion: 结果不表明小波发现了 parity 的算术规则，而是表明二进制编码中本已存在的信息随多尺度滤波、空间对齐与边界处理而变得更可恢复或更不可恢复。

papers.title: SCORENF: Score-based Normalizing Flows for Sampling Unnormalized distributions
papers.abstract_en: Unnormalized probability distributions are central to modeling complex physical systems across various scientific domains. Traditional sampling methods, such as Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), often suffer from slow convergence, critical slowing down, poor mode mixing, and high autocorrelation. In contrast, likelihood-based and adversarial machine learning models, though effective, are heavily data-driven, requiring large datasets and often encountering mode covering and mode collapse. In this work, we propose ScoreNF, a score-based learning framework built on the Normalizing Flow (NF) architecture, integrated with an Independent Metropolis-Hastings (IMH) module, enabling efficient and unbiased sampling from unnormalized target distributions. We show that ScoreNF maintains high performance even with small training ensembles, thereby reducing reliance on computationally expensive MCMC-generated training data. We also present a method for assessing mode-covering and mode-collapse behaviours. We validate our method on synthetic 2D distributions (MOG-4 and MOG-8) and the high-dimensional $φ^4$ lattice field theory distribution, demonstrating its effectiveness for sampling tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ScoreNF：以 Normalizing Flow 为骨架的 score-based 学习框架，外接 Independent Metropolis-Hastings 模块，从非归一化目标分布做高效且无偏的采样。在合成二维分布 MOG-4、MOG-8 与高维 φ⁴ 格点场论分布上验证有效，且小规模训练集成即可保持高性能，减少对昂贵 MCMC 生成训练数据的依赖。
Motivation: 非归一化分布是物理系统建模的核心对象，但 MCMC 收敛慢、临界减速、模式混合差、自相关高；似然与对抗式模型又重度依赖大数据，并出现 mode covering 与 mode collapse。
Method: ScoreNF 在 Normalizing Flow 架构上构建 score-based 学习框架，并集成 Independent Metropolis-Hastings (IMH) 模块以保证无偏采样；另给出一套评估 mode-covering 与 mode-collapse 行为的方法，训练只需小规模集成。
Result: 在合成二维分布 MOG-4 与 MOG-8，以及高维 φ⁴ 格点场论分布上验证采样有效性；方法在小训练集成下仍保持高性能，从而降低对 MCMC 生成训练数据的依赖。
Conclusion: 把 score-based NF 与独立 Metropolis-Hastings 结合，可在少训练数据条件下对非归一化分布做无偏高效采样，适用范围覆盖合成二维到高维格点场论。

papers.title: Dinomaly2: A Unified Framework for Unsupervised Image Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) has evolved from specialized single-class models to unified multi-class models, yet existing multi-class models significantly underperform the most advanced one-for-one counterparts. Moreover, the field has fragmented into specialized methods tailored to specific scenarios (multi-class, 3D, few-shot, etc.), creating deployment barriers and highlighting the need for a unified solution. In this paper, we present Dinomaly2, a unified framework for image UAD. It bridges the performance gap in multi-class models by addressing over-generalization and contextual ambiguity, while extending across diverse data modalities and task settings. Guided by the "less is more" philosophy, we demonstrate that the orchestration of simple elements achieves superior performance in a standard reconstruction-based framework. This methodological minimalism enables natural extension across diverse tasks with minimal task-specific adaptations, establishing that simplicity is the foundation of unification. Extensive experiments on 15 UAD benchmarks demonstrate strong performance across multiple modalities, task settings, and application domains. For example, our unified multi-class model achieves unprecedented 99.9% and 99.3% image-level (I-) AUROC on MVTec-AD and VisA, respectively, with its effectiveness further extending to large-scale datasets containing hundreds of categories. Moreover, using only 8 normal examples per class, our method surpasses previous full-shot models, achieving 98.7% and 97.4%. For multi-view (Real-IAD, MANTA) and multi-modal (MVTec3D, MulSen-AD) inspection, Dinomaly2 demonstrates state-of-the-art performance through lightweight adaptations. The combination of minimalistic design, computational scalability, and broad applicability positions Dinomaly2 as a shared framework for a wide range of real-world anomaly detection applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dinomaly2 把多类、3D、少样本等分裂的无监督图像异常检测 (UAD) 统一到一个重建式框架里，靠“少即是多”的简单组件编排同时缓解多类模型的过度泛化与上下文歧义。在 15 个 UAD 基准上，统一多类模型在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 分别取得 99.9% 与 99.3% 的图像级 AUROC，每类仅 8 个正常样本时仍达 98.7% 与 97.4%，超过既往全样本模型。
Motivation: 多类统一 UAD 模型明显落后于逐类专用模型，且领域已碎裂为多类、3D、少样本等专用方法，部署成本高，缺少跨模态跨任务的统一方案。
Method: 在标准重建式框架下按“less is more”哲学编排简单组件，针对过度泛化与上下文歧义做设计；跨任务只需轻量适配即可扩展到多视角 (Real-IAD、MANTA) 与多模态 (MVTec3D、MulSen-AD) 检测。
Result: 在 15 个 UAD 基准上评测：统一多类模型图像级 (I-) AUROC 在 MVTec-AD 达 99.9%、VisA 达 99.3%，并延伸到含数百类的大规模数据集；每类仅 8 个正常样本时达到 98.7% 与 97.4%，超过此前全样本模型；多视角与多模态检测上通过轻量适配取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 简洁设计本身就是统一性的基础：一个最小化的重建框架足以跨越多类、少样本、多视角与多模态任务并保持竞争力，可作为真实场景异常检测的共享框架。

papers.title: AlignBeat: A Latent Variable Model for Multi-Class Beat Tracking from Partially Labeled Data
papers.abstract_en: Recent neural beat trackers predict beats and downbeats with two independent frame-wise binary classification heads, a convention adopted because a single multi-class head cannot fully exploit datasets that annotate only beats. The heads can disagree, so Beat This moves each predicted downbeat to the nearest predicted beat. We instead predict a sparse set of grid points, each with an event time and one distribution over downbeat, beat and no event, so a downbeat is a beat by construction and no reconciliation is needed. The alignment between grid points and annotated events is latent, and we fit the model by expectation-maximization. Where no downbeat labels were recorded the event class is latent too and is marginalized out. Over eight-fold cross-validation on eighteen datasets, retaining rather than discarding the beat-only labeled data raises beat CMLt by 4.6 points on the datasets that provide it; downbeat CMLt rises 3.6 points over Beat This, with both F-measures moving by less than one point and no post-processing at any stage.

Motivation: 现有神经节拍跟踪器用两个独立帧级二分类头，是为了迁就只标 beat 不标 downbeat 的数据集，但两个头会互相矛盾，Beat This 因此要靠后处理把预测 downbeat 挪到最近的 beat 上。
Method: 预测一组稀疏 grid points，每个点给出事件时刻和 downbeat/beat/no event 的单一分布；grid 与人工标注事件的对齐是隐变量，用 expectation-maximization (EM) 拟合；无 downbeat 标注处事件类别同样作为隐变量边缘化，从而可直接吃 beat-only 数据。
Result: 在 18 个数据集的八折交叉验证上：保留（而非丢弃）beat-only 标注数据，使提供此类数据的集合上 beat CMLt 提升 4.6 点；downbeat CMLt 相对 Beat This 提升 3.6 点；两个 F-measure 变化均小于 1 点；全流程无任何后处理。
Conclusion: 把 beat/downbeat 建成同一分布下的互斥事件类并用 EM 处理缺失标注，可以在不引入后处理的前提下同时吃下部分标注数据并抬高 CMLt。

papers.title: Adam or Gauss-Newton? A Comparative Study In Terms of Basis Alignment and SGD Noise
papers.abstract_en: Preconditioned methods are central to deep learning optimization. Predominant approaches include computationally light diagonal preconditioners such as Adam, which rely on gradient statistics, and second-order methods such as Gauss-Newton (GN), which capture richer curvature information. Seeking the best of both worlds, we disentangle the preconditioner design space into several factors, separating the choice of diagonal scaling (Adam-style versus GN-style) from 1) the basis choices under which the diagonal scaling operates, and 2) the gradient noises from mini-batching. Our theoretical results show that GN's optimality for linear regression no longer holds under a poorly chosen basis under both population and stochastic updates, or a move from linear regression to a non-convex variant of logistic regression. In these settings, Adam-style methods offer genuine advantages over curvature-inspired preconditioning, rather than serving merely as a tractable proxy. Empirical results on synthetic problems and CIFAR-10 support these findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预条件器设计拆成对角缩放形式（Adam 式 vs Gauss-Newton 式）、缩放所处的 basis、以及 mini-batch 梯度噪声三个独立因素。理论表明 GN 在线性回归上的最优性在 basis 选得差时失效（population 与 stochastic 更新皆然），或从线性回归转到非凸的 logistic 回归时也不再成立；此时 Adam 式方法相对曲率预条件具有真实优势，而不只是可计算的替代品。合成问题与 CIFAR-10 的实证结果支持该结论。
Motivation: 深度学习预条件优化中，轻量的 Adam 类对角缩放与曲率更丰富的 Gauss-Newton 二阶方法各占一派，但二者的差异混杂了缩放形式、作用 basis 与梯度噪声三个因素，GN 的最优性在何种条件下失效并不清楚。
Method: 将预条件器设计空间解耦为三个因素：对角缩放的选择（Adam 式 vs GN 式）、缩放所依据的 basis 选择、以及 mini-batch 带来的梯度噪声；在此分解下给出理论分析，并用合成问题与 CIFAR-10 做实证检验。
Result: 理论结果表明 GN 对线性回归的最优性在 basis 选得差时不再成立，population 与 stochastic 更新下皆然；从线性回归转到非凸 logistic 回归时该最优性同样失效，此时 Adam 式方法相对曲率启发的预条件具有真实优势。合成问题与 CIFAR-10 的实证结果支持这些结论。
Conclusion: GN 的最优性依赖于 basis 选择与问题凸性，basis 选差或转到非凸 logistic 回归时 Adam 式预条件是实质更优的选择，而非仅仅是可计算的代理。

papers.title: Optimal automation under overdispersed discrete risk: thresholds and hysteresis in a Negative Binomial model
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making under clustered uncertainty requires models that accommodate discrete overdispersed risk and endogenous control mechanisms. Standard approaches often impose equi-dispersion or Gaussian assumptions and treat control as exogenous or binary, limiting structural realism. In this paper, we developed a stochastic optimization framework in which risk follows a dynamic Negative Binomial process with time-varying success probability, generating persistent overdispersion and temporal dependence. A continuous control variable mitigated non-tail and tail exposure under convex implementation and adjustment costs. Analytical results showed that overdispersion reshapes the optimal policy, generating interior solutions, dispersion-dependent thresholds, and regime-dependent hysteresis effects that do not arise under equi-dispersed specifications. Simulation evidence confirms that overdispersion amplifies tail risk and induces nonlinear responses. An empirical analysis using daily S&P 500 index data documents significant overdispersion and persistent clustering. The results provide a structural basis for integrating discrete risk modeling with dynamic operational decisions under uncertainty.
papers.comment: Published in Journal of Industrial and Management Optimization, Volume 22, Issue 5, pp. 2503-2554 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在离散过离散风险下用动态 Negative Binomial 过程（时变成功概率）刻画风险，配合连续控制变量与凸实施/调整成本做随机优化。解析结果表明过离散会重塑最优策略：产生内点解、依赖离散度的阈值，以及等离散设定下不存在的体制依赖迟滞；模拟显示过离散放大尾部风险并诱发非线性响应。
Motivation: 标准方法常假设等离散或高斯分布，并把控制当作外生或二元变量，无法刻画聚集性不确定性和内生控制下的结构性现实。
Method: 构建随机优化框架：风险服从时变成功概率的动态 Negative Binomial 过程，产生持续过离散与时序依赖；连续控制变量在凸实施成本与调整成本下同时缓解非尾部与尾部暴露，并推导最优策略的解析结构。
Result: 解析结果给出内点解、依赖离散度的阈值与体制依赖迟滞，这些在等离散设定下不出现；模拟证据确认过离散放大尾部风险并诱发非线性响应；对 S&P 500 指数日度数据的实证分析记录到显著过离散与持续聚集。
Conclusion: 过离散不是可忽略的分布细节，而是决定最优控制阈值与迟滞结构的关键因素，离散风险建模可作为动态运营决策的结构性基础。

papers.title: How Does Preconditioning Guide Feature Learning in Deep Neural Networks?
papers.abstract_en: Preconditioning is widely used in machine learning to accelerate convergence on the empirical risk, yet its role on the expected risk remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate how preconditioning affects feature learning and generalization performance. We first show that the input information available to the model is conveyed solely through the Gram matrix defined by the preconditioner's metric, thereby inducing a controllable spectral bias on feature learning. Concretely, instantiating the preconditioner as the $p$-th power of the input covariance matrix, we prove that, for a single ReLU neuron, increasing $p$ monotonically shifts the learned feature's sensitivity toward higher-variance eigenspaces, even though all choices of $p$ attain the same limiting population loss. We then empirically investigate how this spectral bias interacts with task-relevant features in three settings: robustness to noise, out-of-distribution generalization, and forward knowledge transfer. Our experiments show that learned representations favor the spectral components emphasized by preconditioning, and that generalization improves when this bias aligns with task-relevant features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明预条件器的度量 Gram 矩阵是输入信息进入模型的唯一通道，由此在特征学习上引入可控的谱偏置：把预条件器取为输入协方差的 p 次幂时，单个 ReLU 神经元上学到的特征敏感度随 p 增大单调移向高方差特征空间，而所有 p 的极限总体损失相同。实验显示表征偏向预条件器强调的谱分量，且该偏置与任务相关特征对齐时泛化更好。
Motivation: 预条件 (preconditioning) 加速经验风险收敛的作用已被广泛研究，但它对期望风险与特征学习的影响仍不清楚：不同预条件器在极限总体损失相同的情况下，为何泛化不同缺乏解释。
Method: 把预条件器实例化为输入协方差矩阵的 p 次幂，先对单个 ReLU 神经元证明特征敏感度随 p 单调移向高方差特征空间；再在抗噪、分布外泛化、前向知识迁移三个设定下做实验，考察该谱偏置与任务相关特征的交互。
Result: 理论上：增大 p 单调地把学到的特征敏感度推向高方差特征空间，且所有 p 取到相同的极限总体损失。实验上：学到的表征偏向预条件器强调的谱分量，当该偏置与任务相关特征对齐时泛化改善（在抗噪、分布外泛化、前向知识迁移三个设定下检验）。
Conclusion: 预条件器通过 Gram 矩阵决定输入信息的谱通路，从而可控制特征学习的谱偏置；泛化提升的条件是这一偏置与任务相关特征对齐，而非极限总体损失的差别。

papers.title: Noise-adapted Neural Operator for Robust Non-Line-of-Sight Imaging
papers.abstract_en: This work has been submitted for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Computational imaging, especially non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging, the extraction of information from obscured or hidden scenes is achieved through the utilization of indirect light signals resulting from multiple reflections or scattering. The inherently weak nature of these signals, coupled with their susceptibility to noise, necessitates the integration of physical processes to ensure accurate reconstruction. This paper presents a parameterized inverse problem framework tailored for large-scale linear problems in 3D imaging reconstruction. Initially, a noise estimation module is employed to adaptively assess the noise levels present in transient data. Subsequently, a parameterized neural operator is developed to approximate the inverse mapping, facilitating end-to-end rapid image reconstruction. Our 3D image reconstruction framework, grounded in operator learning, is constructed through deep algorithm unfolding, which not only provides commendable model interpretability but also enables dynamic adaptation to varying noise levels in the acquired data, thereby ensuring consistently robust and accurate reconstruction outcomes. Furthermore, we introduce a novel method for the fusion of global and local spatiotemporal data features. By integrating structural and detailed information, this method significantly enhances both accuracy and robustness. Comprehensive numerical experiments conducted on both simulated and real datasets substantiate the efficacy of the proposed method. It demonstrates remarkable performance with fast scanning data and sparse illumination point data, offering a viable solution for NLOS imaging in complex scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向非视域 (NLOS) 成像的参数化逆问题框架：先用噪声估计模块自适应评估瞬态数据噪声水平，再以深度算法展开 (algorithm unfolding) 构造参数化神经算子近似逆映射，并融合全局与局部时空特征做端到端 3D 重建。在仿真与真实数据上均验证有效，对快速扫描数据与稀疏照明点数据表现稳健。
Motivation: NLOS 信号经多次反射散射后极弱且易受噪，大尺度线性 3D 重建逆问题需要物理过程约束，同时要在不同噪声水平下保持稳健。
Method: 构建面向大规模线性 3D 成像的参数化逆问题框架：噪声估计模块自适应评估瞬态数据噪声，参数化神经算子经深度算法展开近似逆映射实现端到端快速重建，并引入全局与局部时空特征融合以结合结构与细节信息。
Result: 在仿真与真实数据集上的综合数值实验验证了方法有效性；对快速扫描数据和稀疏照明点数据表现出显著的精度与稳健性提升。
Conclusion: 基于算子学习加算法展开的 NLOS 重建可通过噪声自适应与全局-局部特征融合，在复杂场景下实现可解释且稳健的快速重建。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Non-Asymptotic Class of Dense Precision Matrix Estimators: Complexity, Signal and Double Descent
authors: Mehmet Caner Agostino Capponi Maurizo Daniele Mihailo Stojnic
papers.abstract_en: Precision matrix estimation is a cornerstone concept in statistics, economics, and finance. Despite advances in recent years, estimation methods that are simultaneously (i) dense, (ii) consistent, and (iii) model-free are lacking. While each of these targets can be met separately, achieving them together is challenging.We address this gap by introducing a general class of estimators that unifies these features within a nonasymptotic framework, allowing for explicit characterization of the computational complexity, signal-to-noise ratio trade-off. Our analysis identifies three fundamental random quantities, complexity, signal magnitude, and method bias that jointly determine estimation error. A particularly striking result is that ridgeless regression, a tuning-free special case within our class, exhibits the double descent phenomenon. This establishes the first formal precision matrix analogue to the well-known double descent behavior in linear regression. Our theoretical analysis is supported by a thorough empirical study of the S\&P 500 index, where we observe a doubly ascending Sharpe ratio pattern, which complements the double descent phenomenon.

Motivation: 现有精度矩阵估计方法难以同时做到稠密、相合且免模型，三者各自可达但合取困难；经济学与金融学中对 S&P 500 这类数据的协方差/精度结构估计正需要这样的统一框架。

papers.title: Audio-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Audio Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Building on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) paradigm, a recent self-supervised learning framework that predicts latent representations of masked regions in high-level feature spaces, we propose Audio-JEPA (Audio Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture), tailored specifically for audio data. Audio-JEPA uses a simple Vision Transformer backbone to predict latent representations of masked spectrogram patches rather than reconstructing raw audio. We pre-train on unlabeled AudioSet clips (10s, 32kHz) with random patch masking on mel-spectrograms. We evaluate on the X-ARES suite covering speech, music, and environmental sound tasks. Although our implementation is a straightforward translation of the original model to audio, the results still show comparable performance to wav2vec 2.0 and data2vec while using less than one-fifth of their training data and with no hyper-parameter tuning. All code and pretrained checkpoints are available on GitHub.
papers.journal_ref: ICME 2025, Jun 2025, Nantes, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Audio-JEPA 把 JEPA 范式搬到音频：用 Vision Transformer 在 mel-spectrogram 的掩码 patch 上预测高层潜表征，而非重建原始波形。在未标注 AudioSet（10s、32kHz）上预训练后，于 X-ARES 的语音、音乐与环境声任务上取得与 wav2vec 2.0 和 data2vec 相当的性能，而训练数据不到后者的五分之一且未做超参调优。
Motivation: 音频自监督预训练普遍依赖原始信号重建与大规模标注或大数据配方，wav2vec 2.0、data2vec 这类模型训练开销高；把潜空间预测式预训练迁到音频能否在更少数据下达到同档性能尚不清楚。
Method: 以 Vision Transformer 为骨干，在 mel-spectrogram 上随机掩码 patch，预测被掩区域的潜表征而非重建原始音频；在未标注 AudioSet 片段（10 秒、32kHz）上预训练，随后在 X-ARES 套件上评测，代码与预训练 checkpoint 开源。
Result: 在 X-ARES 覆盖的语音、音乐与环境声任务上，性能与 wav2vec 2.0 和 data2vec 相当，而所用训练数据不足其五分之一（less than one-fifth），且未做任何超参调优。
Conclusion: 把 JEPA 直接平移到音频即可在显著更少数据下匹配主流音频自监督基线，说明潜空间预测式预训练对数据效率有效，且无需针对音频的架构或调参改造。

papers.title: From Reasoning to Generalization: Knowledge-Augmented LLMs for ARC Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Recent reasoning-oriented LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on challenging tasks such as mathematics and science examinations. However, core cognitive faculties of human intelligence, such as abstract reasoning and generalization, remain underexplored. To address this, we evaluate recent reasoning-oriented LLMs on the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) benchmark, which explicitly demands both faculties. We formulate ARC as a program synthesis task and propose nine candidate solvers. Experimental results show that repeated-sampling planning-aided code generation (RSPC) achieves the highest test accuracy and demonstrates consistent generalization across most LLMs. To further improve performance, we introduce an ARC solver, Knowledge Augmentation for Abstract Reasoning (KAAR), which encodes core knowledge priors within an ontology that classifies priors into three hierarchical levels based on their dependencies. KAAR progressively expands LLM reasoning capacity by gradually augmenting priors at each level, and invokes RSPC to generate candidate solutions after each augmentation stage. This stage-wise reasoning reduces interference from irrelevant priors and improves LLM performance. Empirical results show that KAAR maintains strong generalization and consistently outperforms non-augmented RSPC across all evaluated LLMs, achieving around 5% absolute gains and up to 64.52% relative improvement. Despite these achievements, ARC remains a challenging benchmark for reasoning-oriented LLMs, highlighting future avenues of progress in LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/you68681/kaar.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ARC 形式化为程序合成任务，提出九个候选求解器，其中重复采样规划辅助代码生成 (RSPC) 测试准确率最高；再提出 KAAR，用三层分级本体编码核心知识先验并逐级增广、每级后调用 RSPC 生成候选解。相比未增广的 RSPC，KAAR 在所有被评估 LLM 上约 5% 绝对提升、最高 64.52% 相对提升，且保持强泛化。
Motivation: 推理导向 LLM 在数学与科学考试上表现强，但抽象推理与泛化这两项核心认知能力仍缺乏系统评估，ARC 正好同时要求两者。
Method: 将 ARC 建模为程序合成任务并设计九个候选求解器；KAAR 用本体 (ontology) 把核心知识先验按依赖关系分为三个层级，逐级增广先验以扩展推理空间，每级增广后调用 RSPC（重复采样 + 规划辅助代码生成）产出候选解，分阶段推理以减少无关先验干扰。
Result: RSPC 在测试集上取得最高准确率并在多数 LLM 上展现一致泛化；KAAR 在全部被评估 LLM 上一致优于未增广的 RSPC，约 5% 绝对提升、最高 64.52% 相对提升。
Conclusion: 分阶段的知识先验增广配合规划辅助代码生成能稳定提升推理型 LLM 在 ARC 上的表现与泛化，但 ARC 对这类模型仍是困难基准。

papers.title: HERO: Preserving Structure and Semantics in Heterogeneous Continual Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning on heterogeneous graphs has advanced rapidly, driven by the diverse entities, relations, and semantics inherent in real-world data. However, most existing studies assume static graphs, whereas real-world graph data are often continuously updated. Continual learning in this setting is particularly challenging because historical knowledge is encoded not only in target-node representations, but also in their heterogeneous structural contexts and relation-dependent semantic responses. To this end, we introduce HERO, a heterogeneous continual graph learning framework that preserves historical knowledge at both structural and semantic levels while adapting to incoming tasks. We analyze experience replay as an approximation to the unavailable historical gradient and decompose its error into target-selection and context-reconstruction terms. This analysis shows that replaying target nodes alone is generally insufficient for relation-sensitive HGNNs, as removing typed neighborhood context can alter both representations and historical gradients. Motivated by this, HERO employs DiSCo to select representative target nodes and reconstruct compact heterogeneous contexts through relation-aware multi-type neighbor expansion. To further preserve knowledge that cannot be captured by replayed subgraphs alone, HERO aligns task-conditioned predictions and heterogeneous semantic responses through multi-level knowledge distillation. A lightweight look-ahead adaptation step is additionally used to improve plasticity on incoming tasks. Experiments on four datasets with three HGNN backbones show that HERO achieves the best or tied-best average performance among state-of-the-art baselines, while maintaining competitive forgetting. Our code is available at https://github.com/gqBond/HCGL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERO 在异构图持续学习中把历史知识拆成结构与语义两层来保留：DiSCo 选代表性目标节点并按关系感知的多类型邻居扩展重建紧凑异构上下文，再用多级知识蒸馏对齐任务条件预测与异构语义响应，辅以轻量 look-ahead 适应提升新任务可塑性。在四个数据集、三种 HGNN backbone 上取得与 SOTA 基线持平或更好的平均性能，同时保持有竞争力的遗忘水平。
Motivation: 真实图数据持续更新，历史知识不仅编码在目标节点表示里，还编码在其异构结构上下文与关系依赖的语义响应中；仅回放目标节点不足以保住关系敏感 HGNN 的历史梯度。
Method: 把经验回放视为不可得历史梯度的近似，并将误差分解为 target-selection 与 context-reconstruction 两项；据此用 DiSCo 选代表目标节点、以关系感知多类型邻居扩展重建异构上下文，再用多级知识蒸馏对齐任务条件预测与异构语义响应，另加轻量 look-ahead 适应步骤。
Result: 在四个数据集、三种 HGNN backbone 的实验中，HERO 在 SOTA 基线中取得最好或并列最好的平均性能，同时保持有竞争力的（competitive）遗忘水平。
Conclusion: 对关系敏感的异构图持续学习，只回放目标节点不够，必须同时重建带类型的邻域上下文并对齐语义响应，才能兼顾新任务可塑性与历史知识保留。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Why and When Deep is Better than Shallow: Implementation-Agnostic State-Transition Model of Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: We ask when adding hidden layers improves generalization, in a model that keeps the layers fixed and varies only their number. A hidden layer is a self-map of a state space, a depth-$k$ network composes at most $k$ hidden layers with an output layer, and depth is compared within the nested family $H_0\subset H_1\subset\cdots$ built from one class $F$ of hidden layers; this compares a deep network with shallower networks built from the same layers, not with wider ones. Our message is that the statistical cost of depth is the metric entropy of the set $B(k,F)$ of compositions. The estimation error is bounded by an entropy integral over $B(k,F)$ with constants that do not depend on the depth, and the bound is matched from below when the output layer can see the hidden states. For Lipschitz layers on a bounded state space this entropy grows at most polynomially in $k$, and it stays bounded, or grows only like $\log k$, under contraction, equicontinuity, or nilpotent structure. Balanced against the approximation error, this gives depths $k^\ast(n)$ that grow with the sample size, and it separates the models whose estimation error is independent of the depth from those whose estimation error grows with it. Deep ReLU networks, unrolled solvers, and chain-of-thought computation are worked out; for the last two the number of steps is derived rather than assumed. All statements are machine-checked in Lean~4; the formalization and its blueprint are available at https://shosonoda.github.io/lean-deepgen/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定层类、只变深度的嵌套假设族里，深度的统计代价被刻画为复合集 B(k,F) 的度量熵：估计误差由该熵的积分上界控制且常数与深度无关，输出层能看见隐状态时该界可被下界匹配。Lipschitz 层在有界状态空间上熵至多随 k 多项式增长，在压缩、等度连续或幂零结构下有界或仅按 log k 增长；与逼近误差权衡得到随样本量 n 增长的最优深度 k*(n)。
Motivation: 「加深网络是否更好」的既有比较通常同时改变宽度与深度，缺少在同一层类内只变深度时的统计代价刻画，也无法区分估计误差与深度无关还是随深度增长的模型。
Method: 把隐层建为状态空间自映射，深度 k 网络为至多 k 个隐层与输出层的复合，深度在嵌套族 H0⊂H1⊂… 内比较；用复合集 B(k,F) 的度量熵给出估计误差的熵积分上界（常数不依赖深度）并给出匹配下界，再与逼近误差平衡求 k*(n)。全部陈述用 Lean 4 机器验证。
Result: Lipschitz 层在有界状态空间上熵至多随 k 多项式增长，压缩、等度连续或幂零结构下有界或仅按 log k 增长；导出的最优深度 k*(n) 随样本量增长，并区分出估计误差与深度无关和随深度增长两类模型。深度 ReLU 网络、unrolled solvers、chain-of-thought 计算被逐一算出，后两者的步数是推导而非假设。
Conclusion: 深度的统计代价就是复合集的度量熵，结构性能压住熵的增长就能让估计误差不随深度恶化；unrolled solver 与 chain-of-thought 的步数应由该框架推出而非预先假定。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 深度的统计代价就是复合集的度量熵，结构性能压住熵的增长就能让估计误差不随深度恶化；unrolled solver 与 chain-of-thought 的步数应由该框架推出而非预先假定。

papers.title: LOD: Latent Objective Discovery in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) settings, agents are often heterogeneous with diverse intrinsic utility functions. In this study, we introduce Latent Objective Discovery (LOD) as a framework for decomposing agents' distinct utilities into mixed underlying objectives in a low-dimensional latent space. Latent objective discovery aims to capture flexible and abstract coordination patterns among agents and each abstract objective is associated with a shared value function. During learning, all the learned values are aggregated by each agent according to their personalized weights learned in an adaptive manner. Therefore, agents inherit objective-level estimates for policy updates and value learning, enabling structured information sharing without requiring access to other agents' policies. Algorithmically, we incorporate our approach into Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) to exploit this structure. Theoretically, we establish convergence guarantees under linear function approximation within the actor-critic framework. Empirically, we extensively validate the advantage of introducing latent objective discovery in popular multi-agent testbeds with heterogeneous agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LOD 把异质多智能体各自的效用函数分解到低维潜空间中的混合底层目标，每个抽象目标绑定一个共享价值函数，各智能体再按自适应学到的个性化权重聚合这些价值。方法嵌入 MAPPO，在线性函数逼近下给出 actor-critic 框架的收敛保证，并在多个异质多智能体测试平台上验证了引入潜目标发现的优势。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中各智能体的内在效用函数互不相同，直接共享策略或价值难以表达灵活的协调模式，需要在不访问他方策略的前提下做结构化信息共享。

Conclusion: 在潜空间中发现共享底层目标并按个性化权重聚合价值，可在不暴露各自策略的条件下实现结构化协作学习，且具备理论收敛保证。

papers.title: Recent Advances in Medical Imaging Segmentation: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging is a cornerstone of modern healthcare, driving advancements in diagnosis, treatment planning, and patient care. Among its various tasks, segmentation remains one of the most challenging problem due to factors such as data accessibility, annotation complexity, structural variability, variation in medical imaging modalities, and privacy constraints. Despite recent progress, achieving robust generalization and domain adaptation remains a significant hurdle, particularly given the resource-intensive nature of some proposed models and their reliance on domain expertise. This survey explores cutting-edge advancements in medical image segmentation, focusing on methodologies such as Generative AI, Few-Shot Learning, Foundation Models, and Universal Models. These approaches offer promising solutions to longstanding challenges. We provide a comprehensive overview of the theoretical foundations, state-of-the-art techniques, and recent applications of these methods. Finally, we discuss inherent limitations, unresolved issues, and future research directions aimed at enhancing the practicality and accessibility of segmentation models in medical imaging. We are maintaining a \href{https://github.com/faresbougourzi/Awesome-DL-for-Medical-Imaging-Segmentation} to continue tracking and updating innovations in this field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇医学图像分割综述，覆盖 Generative AI、Few-Shot Learning、Foundation Models 与 Universal Models 四类方法的理论基础、SOTA 技术与近期应用，并指出鲁棒泛化与域适应仍是核心瓶颈。配套维护 GitHub 上的 Awesome 列表持续追踪该领域进展。
Motivation: 医学图像分割受数据可得性、标注复杂度、结构与模态差异、隐私约束制约，且现有模型资源密集、依赖领域知识，鲁棒泛化与域适应难以达成。
Method: 以综述形式梳理 Generative AI、Few-Shot Learning、Foundation Models、Universal Models 在医学图像分割中的理论基础、前沿技术与近期应用，并讨论局限与未来方向；配套维护 Awesome-DL-for-Medical-Imaging-Segmentation 仓库。
Result: 综述给出上述四类方法的理论基础、SOTA 技术与近期应用的系统梳理，并归纳固有局限、未决问题与未来研究方向。
Conclusion: Generative AI、Few-Shot Learning、Foundation Models 与 Universal Models 是缓解医学图像分割标注稀缺与域偏移的主要路径，但实用性和可及性仍待提升。

papers.title: Building Intelligent Agents with Neuro-Symbolic Concepts
papers.abstract_en: This article presents a concept-centric paradigm for building agents that can learn continually and reason flexibly. The concept-centric agent utilizes a vocabulary of neuro-symbolic concepts. These concepts, such as object, relation, and action concepts, are grounded on sensory inputs and actuation outputs. They are also compositional, allowing for the creation of novel concepts through their structural combination. To facilitate learning and reasoning, the concepts are typed and represented using a combination of symbolic programs and neural network representations. Leveraging such neuro-symbolic concepts, the agent can efficiently learn and recombine them to solve various tasks across different domains, ranging from 2D images, videos, 3D scenes, and robotic manipulation tasks. This concept-centric framework offers several advantages, including data efficiency, compositional generalization, continual learning, and zero-shot transfer.
papers.journal_ref: Communications of the ACM, Vol. 69, No. 2, pp. 69-79, February 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以概念为中心的智能体范式：用一组接地于感知输入与动作输出的 neuro-symbolic 概念词汇（物体、关系、动作）作为学习与推理的中介，概念可组合、带类型，并以符号程序加神经网络表示联合编码。作者主张该框架在 2D 图像、视频、3D 场景与机器人操作等跨域任务上带来数据效率、组合泛化、持续学习与零样本迁移。
Motivation: 端到端神经智能体在跨域持续学习与组合泛化上受限：难以把已有知识重组合成新概念，也难以零样本迁移到新任务。
Method: 概念为中心的 agent：概念接地到感知输入与动作输出，按结构组合生成新概念，用类型系统约束，并以符号程序与神经网络表示的混合形式编码物体、关系、动作概念，支撑跨域学习与推理。
Result: 给出一个跨 2D 图像、视频、3D 场景与机器人操作任务的概念化框架，其宣称优势为数据效率、组合泛化、持续学习与零样本迁移；本文为 Communications of the ACM 刊发文章，摘要中无定量指标。
Conclusion: 把可组合、带类型的 neuro-symbolic 概念作为智能体的统一表示层，是同时获得持续学习与灵活推理的可行路径。

papers.title: Mallows-type model averaging: Non-asymptotic analysis and all-subset combination
papers.abstract_en: Model averaging (MA) and ensembling play a crucial role in statistical and machine learning practice. When multiple candidate models are considered, MA techniques can be used to weight and combine them, often resulting in improved predictive accuracy and better estimation stability compared to model selection (MS) methods. In this paper, we address two important problems in combining least squares estimators from both theoretical and practical perspectives. We first establish several oracle inequalities for least squares MA via minimizing a Mallows' $C_p$ criterion under an arbitrary candidate model set. Compared to existing studies, these oracle inequalities yield faster excess risk and directly imply the asymptotic optimality of the resulting MA estimators under milder conditions. Moreover, we consider candidate model construction and investigate the problem of optimal all-subset combination for least squares estimators, which remains an important yet not fully understood topic in the existing literature. We show that there exists a fundamental limit to achieving the optimal all-subset MA risk. To attain this limit, we propose a novel Mallows-type MA procedure based on a dimension-adaptive $C_p$ criterion. The implicit ensembling effects of several MS procedures are also revealed and discussed. We conduct several numerical experiments to support our theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Mallows-type MA estimator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇统计理论论文：针对最小二乘模型平均 (model averaging)，在最小化 Mallows' C_p 准则下对任意候选模型集建立 oracle 不等式，其超额风险收敛更快、且在更弱条件下直接蕴含渐近最优性。进一步证明最优全子集 (all-subset) 模型平均风险存在根本性极限，并提出基于维度自适应 C_p 准则的 Mallows 型 MA 程序以达到该极限，同时揭示若干模型选择程序的隐式集成效应。
Motivation: 最小二乘模型平均中，候选模型集如何构造、全子集组合的最优风险如何刻画，在现有文献中仍不充分理解；已有 oracle 不等式在条件强弱与收敛速度上也有改进空间。
Method: 在最小化 Mallows' C_p 准则下对任意候选模型集建立若干最小二乘 MA 的 oracle 不等式；研究最优 all-subset 组合问题，证明存在达到最优全子集 MA 风险的根本性极限，并提出基于 dimension-adaptive C_p 准则的新型 Mallows 型 MA 程序；另讨论若干模型选择 (MS) 程序的隐式集成效应，并辅以数值实验。
Result: 所得 oracle 不等式给出更快的超额风险收敛，并在更弱条件下直接蕴含 MA 估计量的渐近最优性；证明最优 all-subset MA 风险存在根本性极限，所提 dimension-adaptive C_p 的 Mallows 型 MA 程序可达该极限；数值实验支持理论发现并展示该估计量的有效性。
Conclusion: Mallows' C_p 框架下的模型平均在更弱条件下即可渐近最优，而全子集组合的最优风险有不可突破的极限，维度自适应的 C_p 准则是逼近该极限的可行路径。

papers.title: When do Random Forests work?
papers.abstract_en: We study the effectiveness of randomizing split-directions in random forests. Prior literature has shown that, randomization can reduce variance through decorrelation, and, randomization regularizes and works in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) environments. First, we revisit decorrelation and regularization by presenting a systematic analysis of out-of-sample mean-squared error (MSE) for different SNR scenarios based on commonly-used data-generating processes. We point out that there is no consensus in the literature on how the MSE is computed and the terms "variance" and "bias" are not uniquely defined. We obtain MSE decompositions by averaging over training sets first and then covariates. We find that variance reduction tends to increase with the SNR and forests outperform bagging when the SNR is low because, in low SNR cases, variance dominates bias for both methods. Second, we show that the effectiveness of randomization is a question that goes beyond SNRs. We present a simulation study with fixed and moderate SNR, in which we examine the effectiveness of randomization for other data characteristics. In particular, we find that (i) randomization can increase bias in the presence of fat tails in the distribution of covariates; (ii) in the presence of irrelevant covariates randomization is ineffective because bias dominates variance; and (iii) when covariates are mutually correlated randomization tends to be effective because variance dominates bias. Beyond randomization, we find that, for both bagging and random forests, bias can be significantly reduced in the presence of correlated covariates. This last finding goes beyond the prevailing view that averaging mostly works by variance reduction. Given that in practice covariates are often correlated, our findings on correlated covariates could open the way for a better understanding of why random forests work well in many applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定与中等信噪比 (SNR) 的模拟中，随机森林随机化分裂方向的效果由数据特征而非 SNR 单独决定：协变量厚尾时随机化会抬高偏差，存在无关协变量时因偏差主导方差而失效，协变量相互相关时因方差主导偏差而有效。低 SNR 下森林优于 bagging，因为两者的方差都压过偏差；相关协变量还能同时显著降低 bagging 与森林的偏差。
Motivation: 文献对随机化通过去相关降方差、在低 SNR 下起正则化作用已有共识，但对 MSE 如何计算、variance 与 bias 如何定义并无一致意见，且随机化何时有效超出 SNR 本身这一问题未被系统刻画。
Method: 先对常用数据生成过程做样本外 MSE 的系统分析，规定先对训练集取期望再对协变量取期望的 MSE 分解顺序；随后在固定与中等 SNR 下做模拟研究，分别改变协变量分布厚尾性、无关协变量、协变量间相关性三类数据特征，比较随机森林与 bagging 的偏差-方差结构。
Result: 方差削减随 SNR 增大而增大；低 SNR 下森林优于 bagging，因为此时两法都是方差主导偏差。固定中等 SNR 的模拟中：厚尾协变量分布下随机化会增加偏差；有无关协变量时随机化无效（偏差主导方差）；协变量相互相关时随机化有效（方差主导偏差）。对 bagging 与随机森林，相关协变量都能显著降低偏差。
Conclusion: 随机森林有效的原因不能只用方差削减解释——相关协变量下的偏差削减同样关键，而实践中协变量常相关，这为理解随机森林为何在多数应用中表现好提供了新路径。
Relevance: 0
