summary_sections.method: 先对常用数据生成过程做样本外 MSE 的系统分析，规定先对训练集取期望再对协变量取期望的 MSE 分解顺序；随后在固定与中等 SNR 下做模拟研究，分别改变协变量分布厚尾性、无关协变量、协变量间相关性三类数据特征，比较随机森林与 bagging 的偏差-方差结构。
summary_sections.result: 方差削减随 SNR 增大而增大；低 SNR 下森林优于 bagging，因为此时两法都是方差主导偏差。固定中等 SNR 的模拟中：厚尾协变量分布下随机化会增加偏差；有无关协变量时随机化无效（偏差主导方差）；协变量相互相关时随机化有效（方差主导偏差）。对 bagging 与随机森林，相关协变量都能显著降低偏差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 随机森林有效的原因不能只用方差削减解释——相关协变量下的偏差削减同样关键，而实践中协变量常相关，这为理解随机森林为何在多数应用中表现好提供了新路径。

papers.title: FEAT: Free energy Estimators with Adaptive Transport
papers.abstract_en: We present Free energy Estimators with Adaptive Transport (FEAT), a novel framework for free energy estimation -- a critical challenge across scientific domains. FEAT leverages learned transports implemented via stochastic interpolants and provides consistent, minimum-variance estimators based on escorted Jarzynski equality and controlled Crooks theorem, alongside variational upper and lower bounds on free energy differences. Unifying equilibrium and non-equilibrium methods under a single theoretical framework, FEAT establishes a principled foundation for neural free energy calculations. Experimental validation on toy examples, molecular simulations, and quantum field theory demonstrates improvements over existing learning-based methods. Our PyTorch implementation is available at https://github.com/jiajunhe98/FEAT.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2025; the first two authors contribute equally to this work; add an erratum to Appendix F.4 clarifying the applicability of the TSM loss
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FEAT 用 stochastic interpolants 学到的 transport 做自由能估计，基于 escorted Jarzynski equality 与 controlled Crooks theorem 给出一致的最小方差估计量，并同时给出自由能差的变分上下界。它把平衡与非平衡方法统一进一个框架，在 toy examples、分子模拟与量子场论上均优于已有学习型方法。
Motivation: 自由能估计是科学计算中的关键难题，现有学习型方法在平衡与非平衡路径上彼此割裂，且估计量的方差与一致性缺乏统一的理论保证。
Method: 以 stochastic interpolants 实现 learned transport，构造基于 escorted Jarzynski equality 和 controlled Crooks theorem 的一致、最小方差估计量，并推导自由能差的变分上界与下界，从而把平衡与非平衡方法纳入同一理论框架；提供 PyTorch 实现。
Result: 在 toy examples、分子模拟 (molecular simulations) 与量子场论 (quantum field theory) 三类实验中，相对已有学习型方法 (existing learning-based methods) 有改进；arXiv comment 另注明 Appendix F.4 增补勘误以澄清 TSM loss 的适用范围。
Conclusion: 学习型 transport 加上 Jarzynski/Crooks 的有限样本修正，可以为神经自由能计算提供统一且方差最小的估计框架，覆盖平衡与非平衡两条路线。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Towards Weaker Variance Assumptions for Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We revisit a classical assumption for analyzing stochastic gradient algorithms where the squared norm of the stochastic subgradient (or the variance for smooth problems) is allowed to grow as fast as the squared norm of the optimization variable. We contextualize this assumption in view of its inception in the 1960s, its seemingly independent appearance in the recent literature, its relationship to weakest-known variance assumptions for analyzing stochastic gradient algorithms, and its relevance in deterministic problems for non-Lipschitz nonsmooth convex optimization. We build on and extend a connection recently made between this assumption and the Halpern iteration. For convex nonsmooth, and potentially stochastic, optimization, we analyze horizon-free, anytime algorithms with last-iterate rates. For problems beyond simple constrained optimization, such as convex problems with functional constraints or regularized convex-concave min-max problems, we obtain rates for optimality measures that do not require boundedness of the feasible set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 重新审视随机梯度分析中“随机次梯度平方范数（或光滑问题的方差）可随变量平方范数增长”的经典方差假设，把它追溯到 1960s 起源及其与 Halpern 迭代的联系，并在该假设下给出无固定步长、anytime 的末次迭代 (last-iterate) 收敛率。对带函数约束的凸问题与正则化凸凹 min-max 问题，所得最优性度量的收敛率不要求可行集有界。
Motivation: 该方差假设自 1960s 提出以来在近期文献中反复独立出现，其与已知最弱方差假设的关系、以及在非 Lipschitz 非光滑凸优化确定性问题中的作用并不清楚；现有分析常依赖可行集有界等额外条件。
Method: 把该方差假设与 Halpern 迭代的联系加以扩展，构造针对凸非光滑（可为随机）优化的 horizon-free、anytime 算法并分析其 last-iterate 收敛率；再把分析推广到带函数约束的凸问题与正则化凸凹 min-max 问题，使用不需要可行集有界的最优性度量。
Result: 给出凸非光滑随机优化的 horizon-free anytime 算法及其 last-iterate 收敛率；对带函数约束的凸问题与正则化凸凹 min-max 问题，得到不依赖可行集有界性的最优性度量收敛率。
Conclusion: 该经典方差假设可通过与 Halpern 迭代的联系用于构造弱假设下的 anytime 算法，且其适用范围可扩展到超出简单约束优化的问题，无需可行集有界。

papers.title: Adaptive Lipschitz-Free Proximal Gradient Methods for Stochastic Composite Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose {\sf ALFPG}, an Adaptive Lipschitz-Free Proximal Gradient framework for stochastic composite nonconvex minimization. The framework adapts its stepsizes using information collected along the optimization trajectory, without requiring prior knowledge of smoothness constants or performing line search. For finite-sum problems, ALFPG-FS combines coordinate-wise stepsizes, Nesterov's extrapolation, and the SPIDER estimator, with ALFPG-D as its full-batch specialization. Under component-wise smoothness and a bounded effective domain, ALFPG-FS achieves $ε$-stationarity in expectation using $\mathcal O(N+\sqrt{N}ε^{-2})$ component-gradient evaluations. For expectation problems, we develop ALFPG-MVR1 and {\sf ALFPG-MVR2}, where MVR stands for momentum-based variance reduction. Both use one fresh sample per iteration: ALFPG-MVR1 uses one stochastic-gradient evaluation, whereas {\sf ALFPG-MVR2} uses at most two evaluations at different points with the same sample. ALFPG-MVR1 requires smoothness of the expected loss; {\sf ALFPG-MVR2} additionally requires uniformly smooth sample losses. When the regularizer is convex or Lipschitz continuous on its effective domain, and stochastic gradients are almost surely bounded, the two methods achieve $ε$-stationarity in expectation using $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(σ^2ε^{-4}+ε^{-2})$ and $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(σε^{-3}+ε^{-2})$ stochastic-gradient evaluations, respectively. Here, $N$ is the number of component functions, $σ^2$ bounds the gradient noise variance, and $\widetilde{\mathcal O}$ hides logarithmic factors. Neither expectation variant requires prior knowledge of $σ$, and both recover $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(ε^{-2})$ complexity in the zero-noise regime.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and extended, with a new title. Added ALFPG-MVR1 and ALFPG-MVR2 for expectation problems, together with noise-adaptive complexity guarantees
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自适应无 Lipschitz 常数的邻近梯度框架 ALFPG，步长沿优化轨迹自适应选取，无需已知光滑常数或线搜索。有限和问题上 ALFPG-FS 用坐标级步长 + Nesterov 外推 + SPIDER 达到 O(N+√N·ε⁻²) 次分量梯度求值；期望问题上 ALFPG-MVR1/MVR2 分别为 Õ(σ²ε⁻⁴+ε⁻²) 与 Õ(σε⁻³+ε⁻²)，零噪声时均退化为 Õ(ε⁻²)。
Motivation: 随机复合非凸优化中，步长通常依赖未知的光滑常数与噪声方差 σ，线搜索又增加开销；期望型问题的方差缩减方法往往需要每轮多采样。
Method: ALFPG 沿轨迹信息自适应步长。有限和版本 ALFPG-FS 组合坐标级步长、Nesterov 外推与 SPIDER 估计器，全批版本为 ALFPG-D；期望问题版本 ALFPG-MVR1 每轮一个新样本、一次随机梯度求值（要求期望损失光滑），ALFPG-MVR2 同一样本在不同点至多两次求值（额外要求样本损失一致光滑），正则凸或有效域上 Lipschitz、随机梯度几乎处处有界。
Result: ALFPG-FS 在分量光滑与有效域有界下用 O(N+√N·ε⁻²) 次分量梯度求值达到期望 ε-驻点；ALFPG-MVR1 与 ALFPG-MVR2 分别用 Õ(σ²ε⁻⁴+ε⁻²) 和 Õ(σε⁻³+ε⁻²) 次随机梯度求值，两者都不需先验知道 σ，零噪声体制下均恢复 Õ(ε⁻²)。
Conclusion: 不依赖先验光滑常数与 σ 的自适应步长，配合 SPIDER 或基于动量的方差缩减 (MVR)，可在有限和与期望两类随机复合非凸问题上给出噪声自适应的复杂度保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coreset-Based Task Selection for Sample-Efficient Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study task selection to enhance sample efficiency in model-agnostic meta-reinforcement learning (MAML-RL). Traditional meta-RL typically assumes that all available tasks are equally important, which can lead to task redundancy when they share significant similarities. To address this, we propose a coreset-based task selection approach that selects a weighted subset of tasks based on how diverse they are in gradient space, prioritizing the most informative and diverse tasks. Such task selection reduces the number of samples needed to find an $ε$-close stationary solution by a factor of O(1/$ε$). Consequently, it guarantees a faster adaptation to unseen tasks while focusing training on the most relevant tasks. As a case study, we incorporate task selection to MAML-LQR (Toso et al., 2024b), and prove a sample complexity reduction proportional to O(log(1/$ε$)) when the task specific cost also satisfy gradient dominance. Our theoretical guarantees underscore task selection as a key component for scalable and sample-efficient meta-RL. We numerically validate this trend across multiple RL benchmark problems, illustrating the benefits of task selection beyond the LQR baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模型无关的元强化学习 (MAML-RL) 中按梯度空间的多样性做 coreset 加权任务选择，把找到 ε-接近平稳解所需样本量降低 O(1/ε) 倍；在 MAML-LQR 且任务代价满足 gradient dominance 时进一步证明样本复杂度降低 O(log(1/ε))，数值验证覆盖多个 RL benchmark。
Motivation: 传统元 RL 假设所有任务同等重要，相似任务冗余导致样本效率低、对未见任务适应慢。
Method: 提出基于 coreset 的任务选择：按梯度空间的多样性对任务加权采样，优先信息量大且彼此多样的子集；将该选择嵌入 MAML-LQR (Toso et al., 2024b)，并在任务代价满足 gradient dominance 的条件下做理论分析。
Result: 找到 ε-接近平稳解所需样本数降低 O(1/ε) 倍；MAML-LQR 加 gradient dominance 下样本复杂度降低 O(log(1/ε))；在多个 RL benchmark 上数值验证该趋势，说明收益超出 LQR 基线。
Conclusion: 任务选择是元 RL 可扩展与样本高效的关键组件，其收益有理论保证并可迁移到 LQR 之外的 benchmark。

papers.title: Easier Said Than Done: Unpacking Intent-Behavior Gap in Jailbreaking LLM-based Robots
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based robots use Large Language Models (LLMs) as planners to translate natural language instructions into policies such as grasp(), move_to(), and open_gripper(). Jailbreak attacks on these robots extend the threat from generating malicious content to executing harmful behaviors. However, we find that existing jailbreak attempts against LLM-based robots that produce malicious-looking policies (intent jailbreaks) often fail to induce harmful physical actions by robots (behavior jailbreaks), due to robot-specific constraints, such as logical errors and hallucinated control APIs. In this paper, we demystify the intent-behavior gap and investigate its root causes to inform effective defenses. Our measurement study finds that current LLM jailbreak methods overlook robot-specific syntax constraints (e.g., executable control APIs) and physical feasibility (e.g., ordering of policies and hardware/kinematic constraints). To bridge the gap, we introduce POEF (Policy Effective Jailbreak), an automated red-teaming framework that takes into account the robot-specific constraints during both the optimization and evaluation processes. Specifically, POEF employs the hidden-layer gradients from an unaligned LLM to guide the jailbreak prompt optimization and uses a multi-agent evaluator to assess the feasibility of the generated policies. Experiments on commercial robots, including the Unitree G1, the Franka robotic arm, and simulators, show that POEF achieves an 80% behavior jailbreak success rate and transfers across various LLMs. In addition, we propose two defense strategies that mitigate the behavior jailbreak risks. Our findings indicate an urgent need for stronger countermeasures before LLM-based robots are deployed at scale. The homepage is available at https://zjushine.github.io/poef.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 机器人越狱中「意图越狱成功但行为越狱失败」的 intent-behavior gap，提出自动化红队框架 POEF：用未对齐 LLM 的隐层梯度优化越狱提示，并用多智能体评估器判断策略的语法与物理可行性。在 Unitree G1、Franka 机械臂及仿真器上行为越狱成功率达 80%，且可跨多种 LLM 迁移。
Motivation: 现有针对 LLM 机器人的越狱方法只产出「看起来恶意」的策略，却因机器人特有的可执行 API、策略顺序与运动学约束而无法触发真实有害动作，红队评估与真实风险脱节。
Method: POEF 在优化与评估两个环节都注入机器人约束：以未对齐 LLM 的隐层梯度引导越狱提示优化，再用多智能体评估器 (multi-agent evaluator) 检查生成策略的语法约束与物理可行性；另提出两种缓解行为越狱风险的防御策略。
Result: 在商用机器人 Unitree G1、Franka 机械臂及仿真器上，POEF 达到 80% 的行为越狱成功率，并可跨多种 LLM 迁移；测量研究指出当前 LLM 越狱方法忽视可执行控制 API 等语法约束以及策略顺序、硬件/运动学等物理可行性。

papers.title: Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning for Multi-Objective Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective learning endeavors to concurrently optimize multiple objectives using a single model, aiming to achieve high and balanced performance across diverse objectives. However, this often entails a complex optimization problem to balance the learning of potentially conflicting objectives, leading to solutions with higher memory requirements and computational complexity. This paper introduces a Multi-Objective Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning (MOGCSL) framework for automatically learning to achieve multiple objectives from offline sequential data. MOGCSL extends the conventional GCSL method to multi-objective scenarios by redefining goals from one-dimensional scalars to multi-dimensional vectors. It benefits from naturally eliminating the need for complex architectures and optimization constraints. Moreover, MOGCSL inherently disentangles uninformative or noisy training instances that fail to achieve desirable long-term rewards across multiple objectives. We also introduce a novel goal-selection algorithm for MOGCSL to model and identify desired and achievable goals for inference. In this paper, we focus on its application to the next action prediction problem in commercial-grade recommender systems. In this context, any viable solution needs to be reasonably scalable and also be robust to large amounts of noisy data that is characteristic of this application space. We show that MOGCSL performs admirably on both counts by extensive experiments. Also, analysis and experiments are included to explain its strength in discounting the noisier portions of training data in recommender systems with multiple objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MOGCSL，把 GCSL 的一维标量目标扩展为多维目标向量，用离线序列数据同时学习多个推荐目标，并附带目标选择算法在推理时挑选既期望又可达的目标。框架天然免除复杂架构与优化约束，且能自动过滤掉在多目标长期回报上不达标的噪声训练样本，在商业级推荐系统的下一动作预测上表现稳健。
Motivation: 多目标学习要在单一模型里平衡可能相互冲突的多个目标，导致优化复杂、内存与计算开销高，且商业推荐数据中大量噪声样本会拖累训练。
Method: MOGCSL 将常规 GCSL 的目标从一维标量重定义为多维向量，从而免去复杂架构与优化约束；同时提出新的 goal-selection 算法，对目标建模并在推理时识别期望且可达的目标，应用于商业级推荐系统的 next action prediction。
Result: 在商业级推荐系统上以大量实验证明 MOGCSL 在可扩展性与抗噪两方面表现良好，并通过分析与实验证明其能折扣（discount）多目标推荐训练数据中噪声较大的部分。
Conclusion: 把多目标平衡问题转成目标条件监督学习，可以在不引入复杂优化约束的前提下同时获得可扩展性与对噪声数据的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Red-Teaming Text-to-Image Models via In-Context Experience Replay and Semantic-Preserving Prompt Rewriting
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the capabilities of text-to-image (T2I) models in harmful content generation is essential to safety and compliance. However, human red-teaming is costly and inconsistent, driving the need for automatic tools that simulate realistic misuse attempts. Existing methods either require white-box access, fail to generalize across defenses, or produce uninterpretable adversarial tokens, while generating fluent prompts that preserve the original harmful intent remains underexplored despite its practical relevance. We propose ICER, a black-box framework that addresses this gap through two components: an LLM-based rewriter that produces fluent, natural-language adversarial prompts, and in-context experience replay that accumulates successful jailbreaking patterns into a reusable prior. These components are integrated via bandit optimization, enabling ICER to efficiently balance exploiting proven attack strategies with exploring new ones. Experiments across six safety mechanisms show that ICER outperforms seven baselines under both standard and semantics-preserving evaluation, with over 30% of generated prompts transferring to commercial systems like DALL-E 3 and Midjourney.
papers.comment: Accepted at COLM 2026, source code available at https://github.com/zhiyichin/ICER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ICER 是黑盒 T2I 模型红队框架：LLM 改写器生成保留原有害意图的自然语言对抗提示，in-context experience replay 把成功越狱模式累积成可复用先验，再用 bandit 优化在利用已验证策略与探索新策略间权衡。在六种安全机制上超过七个基线，超过 30% 生成提示可迁移到 DALL-E 3、Midjourney 等商用系统。
Motivation: 人工红队成本高且结果不一致，需要自动工具模拟真实滥用尝试；现有方法要么需要白盒访问、要么跨防御不泛化、要么产出不可解释的对抗 token，而生成保留原始有害意图的流畅提示长期未被充分研究。
Method: 黑盒框架 ICER 含两部分：基于 LLM 的 rewriter 产出流畅自然语言对抗提示；in-context experience replay 将成功 jailbreak 模式累积为可复用先验。两者经 bandit 优化整合，在利用已验证攻击策略与探索新策略之间做平衡。
Result: 在六种安全机制上，ICER 在标准评估与语义保持 (semantics-preserving) 评估下均超过七个基线；超过 30% 的生成提示可迁移到 DALL-E 3、Midjourney 等商用系统。
Conclusion: 黑盒红队不必依赖白盒访问或不可解释 token：把流畅改写与经验回放先验用 bandit 调度，就能跨多种防御保持攻击效力并迁移到商用模型。

papers.title: Self-eXplainable AI for Medical Image Analysis: A Survey and New Outlooks
papers.abstract_en: The increasing demand for transparent and reliable models, particularly in high-stakes decision-making areas such as medical image analysis, has led to the emergence of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). Post-hoc XAI techniques, which aim to explain black-box models after training, have raised concerns about their fidelity to model predictions. In contrast, Self-eXplainable AI (S-XAI) offers a compelling alternative by incorporating explainability directly into the training process of deep learning models. This approach allows models to generate inherent explanations that are closely aligned with their internal decision-making processes, enhancing transparency and supporting the trustworthiness, robustness, and accountability of AI systems in real-world medical applications. To facilitate the development of S-XAI methods for medical image analysis, this survey presents a comprehensive review across various image modalities and clinical applications. It covers more than 200 papers from three novel perspectives: 1) input explainability through the integration of explainable feature engineering and knowledge graph, 2) model explainability via attention-based learning, concept-based learning, and prototype-based learning, and 3) output explainability by providing textual explanations and visual counterfactual explanations. This paper also outlines desirable characteristics of S-XAI models for assessing explanation quality, while discussing major challenges and future research directions in developing S-XAI for medical image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇医学图像自解释 AI (Self-eXplainable AI, S-XAI) 综述，把可解释性直接嵌入训练过程而非事后解释，按输入、模型、输出三个视角梳理 200 余篇文献。核心主张是 S-XAI 生成的解释与模型内部决策过程更一致，从而比 post-hoc XAI 更能支撑可信度、鲁棒性与可问责性。
Motivation: 医学影像属高风险决策场景，post-hoc XAI 事后解释黑箱模型，其解释与模型真实预测的保真度 (fidelity) 受到质疑，需要把解释机制纳入训练本身。
Method: 综述按三个新视角组织：输入可解释性（可解释特征工程 + 知识图谱）、模型可解释性（attention-based、concept-based、prototype-based learning）、输出可解释性（文本解释与视觉反事实解释）；覆盖多种影像模态与临床应用，并给出评估解释质量的理想特性。
Result: 覆盖 200 余篇文献，按上述三类视角与多影像模态、多临床应用分类梳理，并提出评估 S-XAI 解释质量的特性框架与未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 把可解释性嵌入训练过程是医学影像 AI 提升透明度与可信度的可行路径，其质量应按输入、模型、输出三层分别评估。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Towards More Trustworthy and Interpretable LLMs for Code through Syntax-Grounded Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthiness and interpretability are inextricably linked concepts for LLMs. The more interpretable an LLM is, the more trustworthy it becomes. However, current techniques for interpreting LLMs when applied to code-related tasks largely focus on accuracy measurements, measures of how models react to change, or individual task performance instead of the fine-grained explanations needed at prediction time for greater interpretability, and hence trust. To improve upon this status quo, this paper introduces ASTrust, an interpretability method for LLMs of code that generates explanations grounded in the relationship between model confidence and syntactic structures of programming languages. ASTrust explains generated code in the context of syntax categories based on Abstract Syntax Trees and aids practitioners in understanding model predictions at both local (individual code snippets) and global (larger datasets of code) levels. By distributing and assigning model confidence scores to well-known syntactic structures that exist within ASTs, our approach moves beyond prior techniques that perform token-level confidence mapping by offering a view of model confidence that directly aligns with programming language concepts with which developers are familiar. To put ASTrust into practice, we developed an automated visualization that illustrates the aggregated model confidence scores superimposed on sequence, heat-map, and graph-based visuals of syntactic structures from ASTs. We examine both the practical benefit that ASTrust can provide through a data science study on 12 popular LLMs on a curated set of GitHub repos and the usefulness of ASTrust through a human study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ASTrust：把代码 LLM 的置信度按 Abstract Syntax Tree 的语法类别分发与聚合，生成对齐编程语言概念的局部与全局解释，并配套序列、热力图、图结构三种可视化。在 12 个流行 LLM 与精选 GitHub 仓库上的数据科学研究及人类研究中检验其实用性与有用性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代码解释技术多停留在准确率、扰动反应或单任务表现，缺少预测时刻所需的细粒度解释，因而难以支撑可解释性与可信度。
Method: ASTrust 将模型置信度分发并分配到 AST 中公认的语法结构上，取代 token 级置信度映射；在语法类别语境下解释生成代码，覆盖单段代码的局部层面与较大数据集的全局层面，并自动生成把聚合置信度叠加在序列、热力图与图结构可视化上的展示。
Result: 在 12 个流行 LLM 和一套精选 GitHub 仓库上开展数据科学研究，检验 ASTrust 能提供的实际收益，并通过人类研究检验其有用性。
Conclusion: 把模型置信度对齐到开发者熟悉的编程语言语法概念，而非 token，是提升代码 LLM 可解释性与可信度的可行路径。

papers.title: Revisiting Inexact Fixed-Point Iterations for Min-Max Problems: Stochasticity and Structured Nonconvexity
papers.abstract_en: We focus on constrained, $L$-smooth, potentially stochastic and nonconvex-nonconcave min-max problems either satisfying $ρ$-cohypomonotonicity or admitting a solution to the $ρ$-weakly Minty Variational Inequality (MVI), where larger values of the parameter $ρ>0$ correspond to a greater degree of nonconvexity. These problem classes include examples in two player reinforcement learning, interaction dominant min-max problems, and certain synthetic test problems on which classical min-max algorithms fail. It has been conjectured that first-order methods can tolerate a value of $ρ$ no larger than $\frac{1}{L}$, but existing results in the literature have stagnated at the tighter requirement $ρ< \frac{1}{2L}$. With a simple argument, we obtain optimal or best-known complexity guarantees with cohypomonotonicity or weak MVI conditions for $ρ< \frac{1}{L}$. First main insight for the improvements in the convergence analyses is to harness the recently proposed $\textit{conic nonexpansiveness}$ property of operators. Second, we provide a refined analysis for inexact Halpern iteration that relaxes the required inexactness level to improve some state-of-the-art complexity results even for constrained stochastic convex-concave min-max problems. Third, we analyze a stochastic inexact Krasnosel'skiĭ-Mann iteration with a multilevel Monte Carlo estimator when the assumptions only hold with respect to a solution.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ρ-cohypomonotonicity 或 ρ-weakly Minty VI 条件下的约束、L-smooth、可能随机且非凸-非凹 min-max 问题中，把一阶方法可容忍的非凸性参数从文献停滞的 ρ<1/(2L) 推进到 ρ<1/L，达到最优或最佳已知复杂度。核心是利用 conic nonexpansiveness 性质，并放松 inexact Halpern 迭代所需的非精确水平。
Motivation: 含双人强化学习与 interaction dominant min-max 在内的一类问题非凸程度由 ρ 度量，已有理论长期卡在 ρ<1/(2L)，而猜想的可容忍上限是 1/L，经典 min-max 算法在这些测试问题上失效。
Method: 三条技术路线：用 conic nonexpansiveness 性质改进收敛分析；对 inexact Halpern 迭代做精细化分析以放松所需非精确水平；在假设仅对解成立时分析带 multilevel Monte Carlo 估计量的随机 inexact Krasnosel'skiĭ-Mann 迭代。
Result: 在 cohypomonotonicity 或 weak MVI 条件下对 ρ<1/L 得到最优或最佳已知复杂度保证，改进了 ρ<1/(2L) 的既有结果；放松非精确水平后，即使对约束的随机凸-凹 min-max 问题也改进了部分最先进复杂度结果。
Conclusion: 一阶方法对非凸性的容忍上限确为 1/L，此前 1/(2L) 的限制来自分析工具而非问题本身；conic nonexpansiveness 与更细的非精确分析是放宽该界的关键。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在 ρ-cohypomonotonicity 或 ρ-weakly Minty VI 条件下的约束、L-smooth、可能随机且非凸-非凹 min-max 问题中，把一阶方法可容忍的非凸性参数从文献停滞的 ρ<1/(2L) 推进到 ρ<1/L，达到最优或最佳已知复杂度。核心是利用 conic nonexpansiveness 性质，并放松 inexact Halpern 迭代所需的非精确水平。
summary_sections.motivation: 含双人强化学习与 interaction dominant min-max 在内的一类问题非凸程度由 ρ 度量，已有理论长期卡在 ρ<1/(2L)，而猜想的可容忍上限是 1/L，经典 min-max 算法在这些测试问题上失效。
summary_sections.method: 三条技术路线：用 conic nonexpansiveness 性质改进收敛分析；对 inexact Halpern 迭代做精细化分析以放松所需非精确水平；在假设仅对解成立时分析带 multilevel Monte Carlo 估计量的随机 inexact Krasnosel'skiĭ-Mann 迭代。
summary_sections.result: 在 cohypomonotonicity 或 weak MVI 条件下对 ρ<1/L 得到最优或最佳已知复杂度保证，改进了 ρ<1/(2L) 的既有结果；放松非精确水平后，即使对约束的随机凸-凹 min-max 问题也改进了部分最先进复杂度结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 一阶方法对非凸性的容忍上限确为 1/L，此前 1/(2L) 的限制来自分析工具而非问题本身；conic nonexpansiveness 与更细的非精确分析是放宽该界的关键。

papers.title: Damped Gauss Newton Search for Multi Metric Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study hyperparameter optimization (HPO) from a numerical-optimization perspective and propose a black-box, target-seeking damped Gauss--Newton method for multiple validation responses. The method estimates trajectory-based numerical sensitivities from successive changes in hyperparameters and validation performance. These full-vector observations construct an iterative secant approximation of the local sensitivity, and a damped Gauss--Newton system jointly updates all hyperparameters. The method does not differentiate through model training or require coordinate-wise perturbation runs: after two initial evaluations establish the first secant, each subsequent iteration requires one new full-vector evaluation. Tikhonov regularization stabilizes the underdetermined local inverse problem. Unlike multi-objective HPO that approximates a Pareto front, our formulation seeks a specified operating point in multi-response performance space. We evaluate the method on four-dimensional XGBoost HPO across three classification datasets, six-dimensional LoRA/SFT post-training of Qwen3-VL-8B on a binary VQAv2 subset, and eight-dimensional threshold optimization on fixed classifier outputs. XGBoost results are comparable to grid, random, and TPE search with fewer model evaluations. The VLM study reveals non-monotonic response and sensitivity trajectories, while the threshold study demonstrates target seeking in an underdetermined system and sensitivity to initialization. Overall, the results support trajectory-based secant sensitivity as an evaluation-efficient local optimization mechanism complementary to global black-box HPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黑箱、目标寻优的阻尼 Gauss-Newton 多响应超参优化 (HPO)：用相邻迭代的超参与验证响应变化估计轨迹型数值灵敏度，构造 secant 近似后由阻尼 Gauss-Newton 系统一次性联合更新全部超参，Tikhonov 正则稳定欠定局部反问题。两次初始评估建立首个 secant，之后每次迭代只需一次全向量评估；在 XGBoost、Qwen3-VL-8B LoRA/SFT 与阈值优化上验证，XGBoost 结果与 grid、random、TPE 相当但模型评估次数更少。
Motivation: 多响应 HPO 通常被当作多目标问题去逼近 Pareto 前沿，而实际需求往往是命中性能空间中的某个指定工作点；同时逐坐标扰动或对训练过程求导的灵敏度估计评估代价高。
Method: 从超参与验证响应的连续变化中估计轨迹型数值灵敏度，用全向量观测构造局部灵敏度的迭代 secant 近似，再解阻尼 Gauss-Newton 系统联合更新全部超参；Tikhonov 正则化稳定欠定局部反问题，不反向穿过模型训练，也不做逐坐标扰动实验。
Result: 在三个分类数据集上的四维 XGBoost HPO 中，结果与 grid、random、TPE 搜索相当且模型评估次数更少；在二值 VQAv2 子集上对 Qwen3-VL-8B 做六维 LoRA/SFT 后训练，观察到非单调的响应与灵敏度轨迹；八维固定分类器输出的阈值优化展示了欠定系统中的目标寻优，并对初始化敏感。
Conclusion: 基于轨迹的 secant 灵敏度是一种评估高效的局部优化机制，适合作为全局黑箱 HPO 的补充，用于直接命中指定工作点而非逼近 Pareto 前沿。

papers.title: Bridging Generative and Discriminative Noisy-Label Learning via Direction-Agnostic EM Formulation
papers.abstract_en: Although noisy-label learning is often approached with discriminative methods for simplicity and speed, generative modeling offers a principled alternative by capturing the joint mechanism that produces features, clean labels, and corrupted observations. However, prior work typically (i) introduces extra latent variables and heavy image generators that bias training toward reconstruction, (ii) fixes a single data-generating direction (\(Y\rightarrow\!X\) or \(X\rightarrow\!Y\)), limiting adaptability, and (iii) assumes a uniform prior over clean labels, ignoring instance-level uncertainty. We propose a single-stage, EM-style framework for generative noisy-label learning that is \emph{direction-agnostic} and avoids explicit image synthesis. First, we derive a single Expectation-Maximization (EM) objective whose E-step specializes to either causal orientation without changing the overall optimization. Second, we replace the intractable \(p(X\mid Y)\) with a dataset-normalized discriminative proxy computed using a discriminative classifier on the finite training set, retaining the structural benefits of generative modeling at much lower cost. Third, we introduce \emph{Partial-Label Supervision} (PLS), an instance-specific prior over clean labels that balances coverage and uncertainty, improving data-dependent regularization. Across standard vision and natural language processing (NLP) noisy-label benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, lower transition-matrix estimation error, and substantially less training compute than current generative and discriminative baselines. Code: https://github.com/lfb-1/EMNL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出方向无关 (direction-agnostic) 的单阶段 EM 式生成式噪声标签学习框架：推导统一 EM 目标，其 E 步可特化为 Y→X 或 X→Y 任一因果方向而不改优化；用有限训练集上判别分类器构造的数据归一化判别代理替代难解的 p(X|Y)，避免显式图像合成；再引入 Partial-Label Supervision (PLS) 作为逐实例干净标签先验。在标准视觉与 NLP 噪声标签基准上达到 SOTA 精度、更低的转移矩阵估计误差，且训练算力显著少于现有生成式与判别式基线。
Motivation: 生成式噪声标签建模虽能刻画特征、干净标签与噪声观测的联合生成机制，但既有做法引入额外隐变量和重型图像生成器使训练偏向重建，固定单一数据生成方向而缺乏适应性，并假设干净标签均匀先验而忽略逐实例不确定性。
Method: 单阶段 EM 框架：先推导单一 EM 目标，E 步在不改整体优化的前提下特化为任一因果方向；再用判别分类器在有限训练集上计算的数据归一化判别代理替换不可解的 p(X|Y)，保留生成式结构而大幅降本；最后加入 PLS 逐实例先验，在覆盖度与不确定性之间权衡以强化数据依赖的正则化。
Result: 在标准视觉与 NLP 噪声标签基准上取得 state-of-the-art 精度、更低的转移矩阵 (transition matrix) 估计误差，以及比当前生成式和判别式基线显著更少的训练算力。
Conclusion: 生成式噪声标签学习可以不靠显式图像合成和固定方向实现：统一 EM 目标加判别代理即可保留联合建模的结构收益，PLS 的逐实例先验进一步改善正则化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Categorical Approach to Conflict Resolution:A Corrected Correspondence between Category Theory and the Graph Model for Conflict Resolution
papers.abstract_en: This note is a substantially revised version of the author's earlier preprint (version~1, 2023), which proposed a ``Categorical Graph Model for Conflict Resolution'' (C-GMCR). Several of the central definitions and claims of version~1 are incorrect, and this version replaces them. We first observe that the states and one-step moves of a graph model do not form a category; the correct construction is the free category on a quiver whose arrows are moves labelled by the decision maker (DM) who controls them. Controller labels are functorial: they define a functor into the free monoid on the set of DMs, and the legal move sequences underlying coalition reachability are exactly the paths whose label words contain no immediate repetition. Preferences, in contrast, are not functorial. We show that a map representing a DM's preference in a preordered set exists only if the preference is transitive, and that even then it extends to a functor on the path category if and only if every move, regardless of its controller, is weakly improving for the focal DM; in that case general metarationality, symmetric metarationality and sequential stability all collapse to Nash stability for the focal DM. Preferences therefore enter the categorical picture as a selection of a subquiver of improvements, not as a functor. We restate the four standard stability concepts in path language, work them out on the Prisoner's Dilemma, and take a first step towards comparing graph models via induced embeddings: Nash stability is reflected by induced embeddings, whereas general metarationality, symmetric metarationality and sequential stability are neither preserved nor reflected. A section lists each correction to version~1 explicitly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该笔记纠正了作者先前 C-GMCR（Categorical Graph Model for Conflict Resolution）中范畴论与图模型对应的错误：图模型的状态与一步移动并不构成范畴，正确构造是以「由决策者 (DM) 标注箭头的 quiver」上的自由范畴；控制者标签是函子性的，偏好则不是。核心结论是：只有当焦点 DM 的偏好传递、且每个移动（不论由谁控制）对其弱改进时，偏好才能延拓为路径范畴上的函子，此时一般元理性、对称元理性与序列稳定性对焦点 DM 全部退化为 Nash 稳定性。
Motivation: 作者 2023 年 v1 提出的 C-GMCR 中若干核心定义与论断不成立，需要给出范畴论与 Graph Model for Conflict Resolution (GMCR) 之间正确的对应关系，尤其是偏好与稳定性概念如何在范畴框架中表达。
Method: 把状态与移动重建为 quiver 上的自由范畴，箭头按控制 DM 标注；证明标签映射到 DM 集合自由幺半群上的函子，且联盟可达性对应的合法移动序列恰为标签词不含立即重复的路径。偏好改用改进子 quiver (subquiver of improvements) 表达，并给出其成为函子的充要条件；四种稳定性概念改写为路径语言，在 Prisoner's Dilemma 上具体演算，并通过 induced embeddings 比较不同图模型。
Result: 偏好映射存在当且仅当偏好传递；延拓为路径范畴函子当且仅当每个移动对焦点 DM 弱改进，此时一般元理性 (GMR)、对称元理性 (SMR)、序列稳定性 (sequential stability) 对焦点 DM 全部塌缩为 Nash 稳定性。Nash 稳定性被 induced embeddings 反映 (reflected)，而 GMR、SMR 与序列稳定性既不被保持也不被反映。文中另设一节逐条列出对 v1 的更正。
Conclusion: 范畴化冲突解析中，控制者标签天然是函子性的，而偏好只能作为改进子 quiver 的选择进入，不能当作函子；只有在极强的「所有移动均弱改进」条件下稳定性概念才统一。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedSysID: A Federated Approach to Sample-Efficient System Identification
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning a linear system model from the observations of $M$ clients. The catch: Each client is observing data from a different dynamical system. This work addresses the question of how multiple clients collaboratively learn dynamical models in the presence of heterogeneity. We pose this problem as a federated learning problem and characterize the tension between achievable performance and system heterogeneity. Furthermore, our federated sample complexity result provides a constant factor improvement over the single agent setting. Finally, we describe a meta federated learning algorithm, FedSysID, that leverages existing federated algorithms at the client level.
papers.comment: Paper accepted at L4DC 2023. This version refines the error bounds and correct typos in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedSysID 把多客户端各自观测不同动力系统的线性系统辨识问题写成联邦学习问题，刻画可达成性能与系统异质性之间的张力，并给出相对单智能体常数因子改进的联邦样本复杂度结果；其元算法 FedSysID 在客户端层面复用已有的联邦算法。
Motivation: 多个客户端各自观测不同动力系统时，如何在异质性下协作学习动力学模型并不清楚，且单智能体样本复杂度存在浪费。
Method: 将线性系统辨识形式化为联邦学习问题，分析性能与异质性的权衡并推导联邦样本复杂度界；提出元联邦学习算法 FedSysID，在客户端层面调用已有联邦算法。
Result: 联邦样本复杂度结果相对单智能体设定取得常数因子改进；该版本细化了误差界 (refines the error bounds)。
Conclusion: 在客户端系统异质的条件下，联邦化系统辨识可以比单智能体更省样本，FedSysID 提供了复用现有联邦算法的通用构造。

papers.title: Period Segmentation in Transition Network Analysis: A Topological Data Analysis Approach
papers.abstract_en: Temporal dynamics in learning behavior can be revealed through period segmentation in Transition Network Analysis (TNA). Cristea et al. demonstrated that segmenting courses into halves and quarters reveals how learning strategies evolve and relate to academic performance. Building on this approach, we investigate whether Topological Data Analysis (TDA), specifically connected components ($β_0$) change points from Zigzag Persistent Homology, can provide data-driven period boundaries that identify intervention windows. Analyzing 22 courses from the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset, we find that $β_0$-based segmentation captures greater between-period variation than time-based segmentation (median variance ratio (VR) = 4.10$\times$; 21/22 courses show VR $>$ 1.1). Permutation tests confirmed significance ($p < 0.05$) in 18% of individual courses, with 73% showing positive improvement over random breakpoints. Only one course showed better performance with time-based segmentation. However, analysis of academic outcomes reveals a key insight: final-period behavior shows lower correlation with outcomes in $β_0$-based segmentation than in time-based segmentation, reflecting a marked behavioral collapse where engaged learners rapidly disengage. We interpret this as evidence that final-period behavior reflects rather than causes outcomes: students who will pass maintain engagement, while those who will fail disengage. This reframes the value of $β_0$: rather than improving prediction, change points identify intervention windows. These are periods where behavioral structure shifts and targeted support may be most effective.

TL;DR: 用 Zigzag Persistent Homology 的 β0 变点为 Transition Network Analysis 提供数据驱动的学期分段，在 Open University Learning Analytics Dataset 的 22 门课上，β0 分段的期间间方差比中位数为 4.10×，21/22 门课 VR>1.1。但末期行为与学业结果的相关性反而低于按时间均分，说明变点的价值不在提升预测，而在定位干预窗口。
Motivation: Cristea 等人按学期对半或四等分做 TNA，分段边界是任意的；需要一种数据驱动的边界来识别行为结构真正发生转变、适合投放支持的时段。
Method: 对 OULAD 的 22 门课构建 Transition Network，用 Zigzag Persistent Homology 的连通分支数 β0 变点切分期间，与按时间均分的分段比较期间间方差比 (VR)，并用置换检验与随机断点作对照，再检验各期间行为与学业结果的相关。
Result: β0 分段的 VR 中位数为 4.10×，21/22 门课 VR>1.1；置换检验在 18% 的单门课上显著 (p<0.05)，73% 的课相对随机断点有正向改善；仅 1 门课按时间分段更好。β0 分段下末期行为与结果的相关低于时间分段。
Conclusion: β0 变点不应被当作提升结果预测的手段，而应被解读为行为结构转变的干预窗口：投入的学生维持参与、将通过的学生亦然，末期行为反映而非导致结果。

papers.title: GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games
papers.abstract_en: Powered by expert guidance, agents can operate in interactive environments; however, it is unclear whether they can learn autonomously from their own experience. To evaluate such self-improvement methods, we introduce GameBoyWorlds, a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games. GameBoyWorlds-Execution evaluates task execution on a collection of 5 distinct game series. Agents are allowed access to dedicated training games but are provided no demonstrations, documentation, or rewards. Agents must ground themselves in the environment through self-directed exploration and by inferring actionable knowledge from their own experience. At test time, agents must complete short-horizon tasks that evaluate their ability to navigate, interact, and engage with game-specific mechanics in unseen games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of the 500 tasks due to failures in multimodal grounding, establishing that self-improvement methods have room to push performance. We demonstrate that contemporary approaches to self-improvement are lacking, with world modelling and autonomous skill discovery failing, and a novel strategy that uses curiosity-based exploration to write guides achieving only partial success. GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough tests end-to-end game completion in two fan-made Pokémon games. We show that while frontier models have been pre-exposed to official releases such as Pokémon Red, they lack essential information on the games in our testbed. Instead of relying on their parametric knowledge to succeed, agents must learn from their own experience and autonomously improve over the course of the playthrough. We show that a sophisticated agentic pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach even the first major milestone in both games, establishing GameBoyWorlds as an ambitious target for self-improving agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GameBoyWorlds 是一个评测智能体自主自我改进能力的视频游戏测试床：无演示、无文档、无奖励，只给专用训练游戏，智能体须靠自主探索与从自身经验中提炼可行动知识。现成前沿模型在 500 个短程任务上完成率不足 50%，多模态 grounding 失败是主因；世界建模与自主技能发现两类自我改进方法失败，基于好奇心探索写攻略的新策略仅部分成功；在两款粉丝自制 Pokémon 游戏上，带多模态记忆与分层子目标的复杂 pipeline 连第一个主要里程碑都没达到。
Motivation: 智能体在专家指导下能交互操作，但能否只凭自身经验自主改进尚不清楚，缺少能隔离并评测这种 self-improvement 的环境。
Method: GameBoyWorlds-Execution 覆盖 5 个不同游戏系列，只提供专用训练游戏，禁止演示、文档与奖励，测试时在未见过的游戏中完成导航、交互与游戏机制相关的短程任务，共 500 个；GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough 则在两款粉丝自制 Pokémon 游戏上做端到端通关评测，检验智能体能否在长程过程中从自身经验学习并持续改进。
Result: 现成前沿模型完成 500 个任务中不到 50%，失败集中在多模态 grounding；世界建模与自主技能发现两类自我改进方法失败，好奇心探索写攻略的策略仅部分成功；在两款自制 Pokémon 游戏上，含多模态记忆与分层子目标的复杂 agentic pipeline 两个游戏都未到达第一个主要里程碑。
Conclusion: 现有自我改进方法远不足以让智能体在无外部知识的陌生游戏中靠自身经验持续进步，GameBoyWorlds 因此是一个有雄心的自我改进目标基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Evaluating and Improving Conversational Agents in Production
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for evaluating and improving a large-scale, multi-agent shopping assistant in production, and report lessons from its use. Offline evaluation of such a system faces three obstacles. (i) A logged conversation cannot be replayed against a modified system, because a different response changes every turn that follows. (ii) The unchanged system itself varies from run to run. Its LLM components are stochastic, and in product search the available products, their prices, and the customer's personalization signals change. (iii) Aggregate quality scores combine distinct behaviors, so they show that quality has changed but not which behavior caused the change. Our framework addresses each obstacle in turn. For a reported behavior, an Evaluation Harness generates targeted assertions and a fixed cohort of customer scenarios. It then reproduces the behavior in a local instance of the assistant through grounded user simulation. Instead of replaying the log, the simulator writes new customer turns conditioned on the recorded messages and context. Repeated runs of the unchanged system form a stored baseline. An Improvement Orchestrator turns the assertion results into hypotheses, implements each as an isolated modification, and compares it with the baseline using paired percentile bootstrap intervals over scenario-level differences. When an investigation ends, the harness may propose revisions to future evaluations, subject to human approval and without altering past decisions. We report production investigations with this framework. Assertion profiles showed which positions of a product carousel a failure affected, and repeated runs distinguished a real improvement from run-to-run fluctuation. Audits of the evaluation itself found a judge that lacked the evidence it needed and a model setting that was configured but not applied.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向生产环境大规模多智能体购物助手的评估改进框架：Evaluation Harness 用 grounded user simulation 在本地实例中复现目标行为并生成定向断言与固定客户场景队列，重复运行未改动系统构成存储基线，Improvement Orchestrator 把断言结果转成假设、逐个隔离实现，再用场景级差值的配对 percentile bootstrap 区间与基线比较。生产调查中，断言画像定位了 product carousel 中哪些位置受故障影响，重复运行把真实改进与 run-to-run 波动区分开；对评估本身的审计还发现一个缺少所需证据的 judge 和一个配置了却未生效的模型设置。
Motivation: 生产对话系统无法离线重放日志：改一处响应会改变其后每一轮；LLM 组件与商品、价格、个性化信号本身逐次波动；聚合质量分只说明分数变了，说不出是哪种行为变的。
Method: Evaluation Harness 针对报告的行为生成定向断言与固定客户场景队列，用 grounded user simulation 在助手本地实例中复现该行为——模拟器依据记录的消息与上下文写新的客户轮次而非重放日志；未改动系统的重复运行存为基线。Improvement Orchestrator 把断言结果转为假设，每条实现为隔离修改，用场景级差值的配对 percentile bootstrap 区间与基线比较；调查结束后 harness 可提议未来评估的修订，须经人工批准且不改动历史决策。
Result: 断言画像显示故障影响 product carousel 的哪些位置；重复运行区分出真实改进与 run-to-run 波动；对评估本身的审计发现一个缺少所需证据的 judge，以及一个配置了但未应用的模型设置。
Conclusion: 生产对话系统的质量变化要靠可复现行为、存储基线与配对统计区间来归因到具体行为，评估本身也需要被审计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns. We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.
papers.comment: Conditionally accepted to Middleware 2026. Extended version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张把 AI agent 的记忆从各 agent 内嵌的检索与持久化逻辑中抽离，做成可插拔的中间件层，并给出参考实现 ALTK-Evolve。它围绕六个系统挑战展开：双向可插拔、宿主原生拦截、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带溯源的联邦共享、生命周期治理。
Motivation: agent 默认跨会话无状态，重复犯错并丢弃经验；现有做法把检索、持久化与学习逻辑手工绑死在单一 agent 与单一存储引擎上，导致记忆无法被替换、共享、隔离或独立推理。
Method: 提出把 agent 记忆视为中间件问题，按六个系统挑战组织设计（双向可插拔、宿主原生 interposition、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带 provenance 的联邦共享、生命周期治理），并给出参考实现 ALTK-Evolve 作为论证载体。
Result: 给出六个系统挑战的框架与 ALTK-Evolve 参考实现，用以支撑更广的 memory middleware 研究议程；摘要中无定量实验结果。
Conclusion: agent 记忆应像数据访问、消息与持久化那样成为一等的可插拔中间件层，而非绑定在单个 agent 内部。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Should a Human Take Back Control? Optimal Delegation under Turbulent AI Risk
papers.abstract_en: Deploying AI systems requires deciding when to delegate tasks and when humans should intervene to monitor and mitigate risk induced by AI operations. These decisions are challenging when failures cluster: a hallucination or harmful output can trigger further errors, creating periods of elevated risk. We introduce a continuous-time framework for learning adaptive human oversight under such turbulent AI risk. Existing oversight and delegation formulations condition on history but do not model incident clustering, or its suppression by supervision effort, jointly with the delegation decision and this study fixes this gap. The self-exciting dynamics capture how risk events increase the likelihood of subsequent events, making their timing and history central to decision-making. We formulate a stochastic control problem combining human actions, monitoring effort, and switching between human-AI-assisted operation and full AI delegation, balancing operational rewards against oversight costs, and cascading AI-failures and induced uncertainty. Human participation is an endogenous component of risk management: the policy determines both when oversight is needed and how much effort to allocate. We study a relaxed switching formulation and propose Hawkes-PPO, a policy-gradient method that uses a bank of exponential filters of observed incident times. In a synthetic environment it attains a higher risk-adjusted objective than either fixed regime and approaches an approximate full-information oracle. We illustrate our results with numerical simulations by examining how cascade risks influence intervention and delegation, connecting reinforcement learning with adaptive human oversight of AI systems. In particular, we illustrate the benefit of our switching strategy and Hawkes-PPO algorithm to monitor the project efficiently along time, reducing turbulent risks occurrences and costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AI 失效事件自激聚集（Hawkes 式级联）的连续时间框架下，把人工监督努力与「人机协作/全 AI 委托」切换决策一起做随机控制，提出用观测事件时刻的指数滤波器组 (bank of exponential filters) 驱动策略梯度的 Hawkes-PPO。在合成环境中其风险调整目标高于任一固定策略，并逼近近似全信息 oracle。
Motivation: 现有 AI 监督与委托设定只以历史为条件，不把失效事件的聚集性以及监督努力对聚集的抑制与委托决策联合建模；而幻觉等失效会触发后续错误，形成风险抬升期。
Method: 将人类动作、监督努力、以及人机协作与全 AI 委托之间的切换写成连续时间随机控制问题，用自激 (self-exciting) 动态刻画风险事件相互触发；放松的切换表述下提出 Hawkes-PPO 策略梯度方法，其观测输入是事件时刻的指数滤波器组。
Result: 在合成环境中，Hawkes-PPO 的风险调整目标高于固定人机协作与固定全委托两种固定策略，并逼近近似全信息 oracle；数值仿真显示切换策略与该算法能沿时间更高效地监控项目，降低湍流风险发生次数与成本。
Conclusion: 把失效聚集及其被监督努力抑制的机制与委托决策联合优化，可得到优于任何固定委托模式的自适应人工监督策略；结论由合成环境与数值仿真支撑。

summary_sections.method: 将人类动作、监督努力、以及人机协作与全 AI 委托之间的切换写成连续时间随机控制问题，用自激 (self-exciting) 动态刻画风险事件相互触发；放松的切换表述下提出 Hawkes-PPO 策略梯度方法，其观测输入是事件时刻的指数滤波器组。
summary_sections.result: 在合成环境中，Hawkes-PPO 的风险调整目标高于固定人机协作与固定全委托两种固定策略，并逼近近似全信息 oracle；数值仿真显示切换策略与该算法能沿时间更高效地监控项目，降低湍流风险发生次数与成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把失效聚集及其被监督努力抑制的机制与委托决策联合优化，可得到优于任何固定委托模式的自适应人工监督策略；结论由合成环境与数值仿真支撑。

papers.title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
papers.abstract_en: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PAU (Python API Understanding) 基准：只给模型黑盒、API 级访问，模型须用探索性输入查询 Python 方法并从输出推断其真实功能。最强模型 Claude-4-Opus 仍无法理解超过 45% 的测试集，错误模式是过度自信导致探索不足、过早终止；借鉴机器人学习的 Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) 后训练后，AAC 调优的 Qwen3-8B 达到 GPT-5-mini 水平。
Motivation: 现有代码生成与理解方法依赖对源码的读取权限，而外部 API 只能黑盒交互，这一假设失效，无监督工具理解 (unsupervised tool understanding) 因此缺乏评测载体。
Method: 构建 PAU 基准，把代码片段当作只能靠交互理解的外部工具：模型以探索性输入查询 API、依据返回输出撰写功能描述；再借机器人学习的 Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) 范式对模型做交互式代码理解的后训练。
Result: 前沿模型在 PAU 上表现仍差，最佳模型 Claude-4-Opus 无法理解超过 45% 的测试集；错误分析显示模型过度高估当前假设质量，探索不足并过早终止；经 AAC 训练的模型探索更主动，AAC 调优的 Qwen3-8B 匹配 GPT-5-mini。
Conclusion: 黑盒 API 的功能理解不能靠读码式先验解决，交互探索量是瓶颈，而 AAC 后训练能显著提升小模型的探索积极性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
papers.abstract_en: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReFM 把跨骨架动作重定向 (motion retargeting) 改写为渐进式精修：先用 SO(3) canonicalizer 去掉冗余全局朝向变化，再用对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器给出角色不变表示，最后由能量引导的 flow 逐步精修初始目标动作，同时约束语义一致性、物理合理性、时间连贯与最小改动。框架兼容直接复制动作与 Autodesk HumanIK 两种初始化。
Motivation: 重定向缺少高质量成对数据，无法用回归目标直接学语义；而单次前向直接回归最终动作也不合理，因为重定向本身欠定，需在语义保真与目标角色的物理、时间约束之间权衡，而非匹配唯一成对目标。
Method: ReFM 是 source-mesh-agnostic 的能量引导模型：SO(3) canonicalizer 消除全局朝向冗余；对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器提供角色不变表示，同时用于优化引导与语义评估；以该表示为引导，用学习到的 flow 对初始化的目标动作做渐进式精修，能量项涵盖语义一致性、物理合理性、时间连贯和最小动作修改；初始化可为直接复制或 Autodesk HumanIK。
Result: 摘要给出的是方法构成与兼容性：SO(3) canonicalizer、对比预训练语义编码器、四能量项引导的渐进 flow 精修，以及对直接复制与 Autodesk HumanIK 两类初始化的兼容。
Conclusion: 在无可靠成对回归目标的条件下，把重定向当作受多能量约束的渐进精修，比朝复制动作回归更能同时保住语义与目标角色的物理、时间约束。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Correcting the Dropout-LayerNorm Expectation Gap Improves Protein Structure Models
papers.abstract_en: Although $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{dropout}(x)] = x$, here we show that $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{LayerNorm}(\mathrm{dropout}(x))]$ is not equal to $\mathrm{LayerNorm}(x)$. Accordingly, the pattern of a Dropout layer followed by a LayerNorm, which is common to many AlphaFold2-based protein structure predictors, produces a systematic bias at evaluation time that can hamper performance. To address this, we derive a closed-form, first-order correction for this gap, which we call a Dropout-LayerNorm Correction (DLC). DLC empirically matches the performance boost of large Monte Carlo dropout ensembles. We evaluate its effect across nine protein structure models (ESMFold, OpenFold, ABB3, FlashABB, Ibex, NbForge, Genie1, Genie2, Genie3) on both paired and single-chain antibody structures as well as one protein-ligand docking model (QuickBind). The correction is computationally negligible and improves accuracy in all ten models tested ($\sim0.3\%-13\%$), with a modest but consistent improvement in ESMFold and OpenFold and a substantial improvement in antibody-specific models. This work identifies the mathematical consequence of chaining together Dropout and LayerNorm and provides a free, principled adjustment to improve the evaluation performance of many pretrained models. Code to reproduce the experiments is available at https://github.com/oxpig/DLC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Dropout 后接 LayerNorm 会系统性偏离 LayerNorm(x)，作者推导闭式一阶修正 (DLC) 消除该偏差。在 9 个蛋白结构模型加 1 个对接模型上，DLC 计算开销可忽略，全部 10 个模型精度提升约 0.3%–13%，效果匹敌大规模 Monte Carlo dropout 集成。
Motivation: AlphaFold2 类结构预测器普遍堆叠 Dropout 与 LayerNorm，而 E[dropout(x)]=x 并不保证 LayerNorm(dropout(x)) 的期望等于 LayerNorm(x)，评估时产生系统偏差、拖累性能。
Method: 推导 E[LayerNorm(dropout(x))] 与 LayerNorm(x) 之间的一阶闭式修正 (Dropout-LayerNorm Correction, DLC)，在推理时直接补偿该偏差，替代大规模 Monte Carlo dropout 集成。
Result: 在 ESMFold、OpenFold、ABB3、FlashABB、Ibex、NbForge、Genie1/2/3 九个结构模型及蛋白-配体对接模型 QuickBind 上，DLC 使全部 10 个模型精度提升约 0.3%–13%；ESMFold 与 OpenFold 提升 modest 但一致，抗体特异模型提升显著，覆盖配对与单链抗体结构。
Conclusion: Dropout 与 LayerNorm 串联的数学后果可在推理时用免费、原则性的闭式修正消除，从而提升大量预训练模型的评估性能，无需重新训练。

papers.title: Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers
papers.abstract_en: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以合同约束 worker agent 行动的 AI 安全框架：把监督职责拆给 monitor 与 judge 两类角色，并给 monitor 与 worker 不对称的算力，从而可经验性地度量统计安全保证。框架适用于代码安全与 escape-the-box 等场景。
Motivation: 如何约束 AI agent 只执行被允许的行动，并让这种约束可验证、可度量，是 AI 安全中的核心治理问题。
Method: 用合同 (contract) 明确 worker agent 的许可行动集，由独立的 monitor agent 与 judge 分工负责指定与执行合同，并在 monitor 与 worker 之间设置不对称算力以支撑强制执行。
Result: 框架使统计安全保证可被经验性度量，并覆盖代码安全与 escape-the-box 两类场景；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以权力分立（separation of powers）加算力不对称来治理 agent，是让合同约束可执行、可度量的一条路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Depth Laws for the Precision Floor of Trained Neural Networks: Amplification, Residual Scaling, and a Quantization-Aware Training Paradox
papers.abstract_en: How many bits does a network need before its accuracy collapses, and how does this grow with depth? We study the precision floor, the perturbation level or bit-width at which accuracy falls halfway to chance, in MLPs, CNNs, Vision Transformers and nine pretrained language models, under post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization- or noise-aware training (QAT). (i) A first-order theory sets the floor through one full-precision quantity, the predictive amplification $G$: $η_c=Λ/G$, and $G^2$ grows linearly in depth at a rate proportional to the squared residual branch scale. (ii) The predicted equality $α_{PTQ}=ρ$ of depth exponents holds within 95% intervals in twelve of thirteen trained architectures and in GPT-2 from 12 to 48 layers, with $Λ=1.45\pm14\%$ across trained architectures. (iii) Residual branches scaled by $1/\sqrt{D}$ and pre-normalisation remove the depth penalty, and each quantizer turns noise into bits at a rate fixed by its step rule, giving $b_c=(α/γ)\log_2 D+C$. (iv) A QAT paradox: noise-aware training roughly doubles the tolerable noise of shallow networks, but the gain decays with depth, so the depth law steepens ($α_{QAT}/α_{PTQ}=1.45$-$1.47$ on two datasets, ten seeds each). Decision margins, cross-layer error cancellation and heavy tails do not set the floor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出训练后量化 (PTQ) 与量化感知训练 (QAT) 下网络精度地板的一阶理论：精度跌到随机一半的扰动阈值 η_c=Λ/G，由单一全精度量 predictive amplification G 决定，且 G² 随深度线性增长、速率正比于残差分支尺度平方。深度指数等式 α_PTQ=ρ 在 13 个训练架构中的 12 个及 GPT-2 的 12–48 层内落在 95% 区间，Λ=1.45±14%；1/√D 残差缩放与 pre-norm 可消除深度惩罚，而 QAT 虽把浅网络可容忍噪声约翻倍，增益随深度衰减，使深度律变陡 (α_QAT/α_PTQ=1.45–1.47)。
Motivation: 网络在多少 bit 下精度会崩、该阈值如何随深度增长，此前缺少可判定的一阶理论；量化部署需要在深度与精度之间给出可预测的 bit 预算。
Method: 在 MLP、CNN、Vision Transformer 与 9 个预训练语言模型上，于 PTQ 与 QAT/噪声感知训练下定义精度地板（精度跌到随机一半的扰动水平或 bit 宽度），用一阶理论把它与全精度 predictive amplification G 关联为 η_c=Λ/G，并推导 G² 随深度线性、速率正比残差分支尺度平方，以及 bit 阈值律 b_c=(α/γ)log₂D+C；同时检验决策边界、跨层误差抵消与重尾是否主导。
Result: 深度指数等式 α_PTQ=ρ 在 13 个训练架构中的 12 个以及 GPT-2 从 12 到 48 层内成立于 95% 区间，Λ=1.45±14%；1/√D 残差缩放与 pre-normalisation 消除深度惩罚；QAT 使浅网络可容忍噪声约翻倍但增益随深度衰减，α_QAT/α_PTQ=1.45–1.47（两个数据集、各 10 个种子）；决策边界、跨层误差抵消与重尾不决定该地板。
Conclusion: 精度地板由 predictive amplification 与残差分支尺度决定的深度律支配，可用 1/√D 缩放与 pre-norm 消除深度惩罚；QAT 的噪声容忍收益随深度递减，深度越大越不划算。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 在 MLP、CNN、Vision Transformer 与 9 个预训练语言模型上，于 PTQ 与 QAT/噪声感知训练下定义精度地板（精度跌到随机一半的扰动水平或 bit 宽度），用一阶理论把它与全精度 predictive amplification G 关联为 η_c=Λ/G，并推导 G² 随深度线性、速率正比残差分支尺度平方，以及 bit 阈值律 b_c=(α/γ)log₂D+C；同时检验决策边界、跨层误差抵消与重尾是否主导。
summary_sections.result: 深度指数等式 α_PTQ=ρ 在 13 个训练架构中的 12 个以及 GPT-2 从 12 到 48 层内成立于 95% 区间，Λ=1.45±14%；1/√D 残差缩放与 pre-normalisation 消除深度惩罚；QAT 使浅网络可容忍噪声约翻倍但增益随深度衰减，α_QAT/α_PTQ=1.45–1.47（两个数据集、各 10 个种子）；决策边界、跨层误差抵消与重尾不决定该地板。
summary_sections.conclusion: 精度地板由 predictive amplification 与残差分支尺度决定的深度律支配，可用 1/√D 缩放与 pre-norm 消除深度惩罚；QAT 的噪声容忍收益随深度递减，深度越大越不划算。

papers.title: Graph Forward Distribution Matching for Molecular Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: Achieving precise control over multiple properties without sacrificing chemical validity remains a central challenge in molecular inverse design. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods fine-tune graph diffusion models by treating **reverse** sampling as a sequential policy, using a single terminal reward to optimize hundreds of coupled decisions. They often suffer from instability, validity collapse, and limited property gains. We introduce GraphFDM (Graph Forward Distribution Matching), a new online RL paradigm for graph diffusion that performs optimization through the **forward** process. GraphFDM uses valid generations to define a reward-tilted target distribution jointly optimized over graph size and molecular structure for each property condition, incorporating reinforcement signals into supervised learning without storing reverse trajectories. We derive the unique optimal target, prove a condition-wise improvement guarantee, and show that the fixed graph-size prior of standard graph diffusion leaves an irreducible matching gap. In multi-conditional polymer and small-molecule generation, GraphFDM achieves the lowest MAE on every target property, with reductions of up to 53.0\% relative to the strongest baselines and chemical validity above 0.99. It further generalizes to out-of-distribution property combinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphFDM 把分子逆设计的在线 RL 从反向采样策略改为在图扩散的前向过程中做分布匹配：用合法生成样本定义按条件倾斜的目标分布，联合优化图大小与分子结构，把奖励信号直接并入监督学习且不存反向轨迹。在多条件聚合物与小分子生成上，各目标属性 MAE 均为最低，相对最强基线最多降低 53.0%，化学合法性高于 0.99，并能泛化到分布外属性组合。
Motivation: 现有 RL 微调图扩散的方法把反向采样当序列策略、只用单一终端奖励优化数百个耦合决策，导致训练不稳、合法性崩塌、属性提升有限。
Method: GraphFDM（Graph Forward Distribution Matching）在前向过程中优化：以合法生成样本构造按属性条件倾斜的目标分布，联合建模图大小与分子结构，将强化信号注入监督学习而不存储反向轨迹；同时推导唯一最优目标、给出按条件的改进保证，并论证标准图扩散的固定图大小先验留下不可消除的匹配缺口。
Result: 在多条件聚合物与小分子生成上，GraphFDM 在每个目标属性上取得最低 MAE，相对最强基线降幅最高达 53.0%，化学合法性高于 0.99，并在分布外属性组合上保持泛化。
Conclusion: 在图扩散的前向过程里做奖励倾斜的分布匹配，可以在保持化学合法性的同时实现多属性协同优化，且比把反向采样当策略的 RL 更稳；固定图大小先验本身构成匹配瓶颈。

papers.title: Tracing Decoder Artifacts for Compact Synthetic Speech Screening
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in speech synthesis and voice cloning have increased the need for reliable synthetic-speech detection, yet high-accuracy detectors increasingly rely on large pretrained models that are costly to invoke on every recording. Rather than replacing such detectors, we investigate a compact front-end screen that processes all inputs cheaply and forwards only suspicious recordings for more expensive analysis. To enable lightweight screening without a large learned encoder, we exploit spectral traces introduced by speech-generation operations. We analyze how learned upsampling and inverse short-time Fourier transform synthesis can produce predictable spectral artifacts and measure their presence directly in generated waveforms. Because the strength of these artifacts varies across generators, we combine decoder-guided spectral measurements with complementary descriptors of short-time spectral shape and temporal variation in a compact gradient-boosted tree. Across seven speech generators and two human-speech sources, the proposed screen achieves an equal error rate of 0.021\% with an estimated model storage of 151 KiB. When used as the first stage of a simulated cascade with a 1.15-billion-parameter detector, it reduces estimated detection energy by 84.4\% while operating at a 0.050\% synthetic-speech miss rate, demonstrating the potential of decoder-guided acoustic evidence for low-cost front-end screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出仅 151 KiB 的合成语音前端筛查器：直接测量生成器中学习式上采样与逆 STFT 合成留下的可预测频谱痕迹，配合短时谱形与时序变化描述子输入梯度提升树，只把可疑录音转给大模型。在七个语音生成器与两个人类语音源上 EER 为 0.021%，作为 11 亿参数检测器的级联首段时在 0.050% 合成语音漏检率下节省 84.4% 检测能耗。
Motivation: 高精度合成语音检测依赖大型预训练模型，对每条录音都调用代价过高，需要一个廉价的前置筛查把绝大多数录音挡在昂贵分析之外。
Method: 分析学习式上采样与逆短时傅里叶变换 (inverse STFT) 合成如何在生成波形中产生可预测的频谱伪影并直接测量其强度，再与短时谱形、时序变化描述子组合，训练一个紧凑的梯度提升树 (gradient-boosted tree) 作为筛查器。
Result: 在七个语音生成器和两个人类语音源上，筛查器 EER 为 0.021%，模型存储约 151 KiB；在与 11 亿参数 (1.15-billion-parameter) 检测器的模拟级联中，于 0.050% 合成语音漏检率下将估计检测能耗降低 84.4%。
Conclusion: 解码器引入的声学痕迹足以支撑低成本前端筛查，与大型检测器级联可在可接受漏检率下大幅削减能耗。

papers.title: EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproduction suite: https://github.com/bpoti001/epigraph
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EngramRAG 是面向多会话 LLM agent 的记忆架构：用 Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR) 让高频实体升为高中心度 Epistemic Macro-Hub，用 Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD) 按拓扑承重而非时间近因决定保留半衰期，再以 SUPERSEDES DAG 过滤过时事实。在 LoCoMo 全部 1,982 个 QA 对上，Recall@5 达 53.21%（dense vector RAG 38.29%，p<0.001），事实突变测试中 split-brain hallucination 从 70.0% 降到 0.0%。
Motivation: 多会话自主 agent 的常规记忆架构有三个缺陷：无法遍历多跳关系依赖（Associative Blindness）、时间衰减驱逐核心人设不变量（Scaffolding Amnesia）、以及忽略使用动态的静态图拓扑（Static Topology Stagnation）。
Method: 基于 Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) 原则，耦合低延迟 Waking State 反射与异步 Dreaming State 巩固循环；四个组件为 U-PPR（转移概率经 Hebbian 可塑性自适应）、CATD（保留半衰期按拓扑承重缩放，带 N_grace>=4 的冷启动宽限期）、Directed SUPERSEDES DAG 过滤、以及融合 dense vector、BM25 与 U-PPR 的动态 Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) 三源混合检索。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 的 10 段长对话共 1,982 个 QA 对上：Recall@5 53.21% vs dense vector RAG 38.29%（+38.9% 相对提升，p<0.001），MRR 0.4203 vs 0.2937（+43.1%）；优于 Okapi BM25 48.66% 与孤立静态图检索 8.50%。时序推理 Recall@5 62.33%（比 dense vectors 高 16.67 个百分点）。受控突变测试中 SUPERSEDES 将 split-brain hallucination 从 70.0% 压到 0.0%；90 天模拟在 26.21ms 交互检索反射下实现 100.0% scaffolding 保留。
Conclusion: 把使用动态写进记忆图的拓扑与保留策略，再配合多源混合检索，可以在长对话 agent 上同时提升多跳检索精度、时序推理与人设稳定性，且检索延迟保持在 26.21ms 量级。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Interactive Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Learning with General Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Model misspecification poses a fundamental challenge in multi-agent reinforcement learning, where transition uncertainty can be amplified by strategic interactions among agents. Distributionally robust Markov games (DRMGs) provide a principled framework for addressing such uncertainty, yet existing methods often rely on restrictive assumptions or scale poorly to large state and joint action spaces. We study online learning in general-sum DRMGs with general function approximation and $φ$-divergence uncertainty sets. We propose RoMEX-$φ$, a model-free framework that integrates equilibrium-based exploration with dual fitted learning. Through a functional dual representation of the robust multi-agent Bellman operator, RoMEX-$φ$ enables tractable worst-case value estimation from nominal interaction data using a centered empirical robust discrepancy. We introduce the robust Multi-Agent Decoupling Coefficient (robust MADC) to characterize the intrinsic exploration complexity arising from strategic interactions and adversarial transition uncertainty. We establish sublinear robust regret guarantees governed by the robust MADC rather than explicitly by the state and joint action space sizes, replacing tabular dependence with intrinsic function-class complexity. Numerical experiments on a scalable general-sum DRMG under total variation uncertainty show that RoMEX-$φ$ is substantially more resilient to transition shifts than its non-robust counterpart while remaining competitive with an exact tabular robust baseline. Our results provide a scalable framework for distributionally robust multi-agent reinforcement learning with general function approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RoMEX-φ：在一般函数逼近与 φ-散度不确定集下做一般和分布式鲁棒马尔可夫博弈 (DRMG) 的免模型在线学习，用平衡探索加对偶拟合学习，经鲁棒多智能体 Bellman 算子的函数对偶表示从名义交互数据估计最坏情形价值。在总变差不确定性的可扩展 DRMG 数值实验中，对转移偏移的鲁棒性显著强于非鲁棒版本，且与精确表格型鲁棒基线相当。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中模型误设会经由智能体间策略互动被放大，而现有分布式鲁棒马尔可夫博弈方法依赖限制性假设，或在大规模状态与联合动作空间上难以扩展。
Method: RoMEX-φ 是免模型框架，结合基于均衡的探索与对偶拟合学习 (dual fitted learning)；通过鲁棒多智能体 Bellman 算子的函数对偶表示，用中心化经验鲁棒差异 (centered empirical robust discrepancy) 从名义交互数据做可处理的最坏情形价值估计；并提出鲁棒多智能体系数 (robust MADC) 刻画由策略互动与对抗性转移不确定性带来的内在探索复杂度。
Result: 在总变差 (total variation) 不确定性下的可扩展一般和 DRMG 数值实验中，RoMEX-φ 对转移偏移 (transition shifts) 的鲁棒性显著优于非鲁棒对应方法，同时与精确表格型鲁棒基线保持竞争力；理论上线性次鲁棒遗憾 (sublinear robust regret) 由 robust MADC 控制，而非显式依赖状态与联合动作空间大小，把表格依赖替换为函数类的内在复杂度。
Conclusion: 分布式鲁棒多智能体学习在一般函数逼近下可按函数类内在复杂度（而非状态与联合动作空间规模）获得可扩展的遗憾保证，鲁棒 MADC 是刻画策略互动探索复杂度的合适量。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: RoMEX-φ 是免模型框架，结合基于均衡的探索与对偶拟合学习 (dual fitted learning)；通过鲁棒多智能体 Bellman 算子的函数对偶表示，用中心化经验鲁棒差异 (centered empirical robust discrepancy) 从名义交互数据做可处理的最坏情形价值估计；并提出鲁棒多智能体系数 (robust MADC) 刻画由策略互动与对抗性转移不确定性带来的内在探索复杂度。
summary_sections.result: 在总变差 (total variation) 不确定性下的可扩展一般和 DRMG 数值实验中，RoMEX-φ 对转移偏移 (transition shifts) 的鲁棒性显著优于非鲁棒对应方法，同时与精确表格型鲁棒基线保持竞争力；理论上线性次鲁棒遗憾 (sublinear robust regret) 由 robust MADC 控制，而非显式依赖状态与联合动作空间大小，把表格依赖替换为函数类的内在复杂度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分布式鲁棒多智能体学习在一般函数逼近下可按函数类内在复杂度（而非状态与联合动作空间规模）获得可扩展的遗憾保证，鲁棒 MADC 是刻画策略互动探索复杂度的合适量。

papers.title: Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CacheBack 用接收方的信息需求描述去过滤发送方的 KV cache，实现免训练的 receiver-conditioned latent communication。在 FanOutQA 上用 Qwen 3，相比文本通信移除 75% 状态、准确率提升 14.7 个百分点、任务完成中位延迟降低 3.2 倍。
Motivation: 多智能体系统把大上下文分摊到各 agent，latent communication 直接传 KV cache 虽省文本生成，但全量 KV cache 随单个 agent 的上下文长度和协同 agent 数量线性增长，显存与上下文开销常远超 GPU 容量和 context window。
Method: 接收方 agent 向发送方传一小段信息需求描述，用它过滤并压缩发送方的 KV cache；具体实例 CacheBack 基于发送方的 attention weights 做选择，免训练。
Result: 在 FanOutQA 上，CacheBack + Qwen 3 相对文本通信移除 75% 本会传给 agent 的状态，准确率提高 14.7 个百分点，任务完成中位延迟降低 3.2 倍；在覆盖 dense Transformer、Mamba-attention 混合与 sliding-window attention 的多个模型族上取得可比改进。
Conclusion: 只发送接收方局部任务所需的内容，可以在免训练条件下同时压缩 KV cache 状态、抬高准确率并压低延迟，且跨模型族稳健。

papers.title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 Document AI 综述，提出“无状态瓶颈 (statelessness bottleneck)”概念：当前系统是无状态函数，存储只提供持久性、检索只提供访问，都不把观测固化成能改进后续处理的知识。文中对十个代表性基准按八条 statefulness 准则做审计，判定跨会话状态演化尚未被测试，并给出含五个反事实指标的纵向基准 harness。
Motivation: Document AI 处理完一份合同或修订件后即清空状态，第二天从零开始：无 schema 保留、无矛盾检测、无经验继承。作者认为这是结构性选择而非规模问题，且参数扩展、上下文延长、检索增强都绕不开它。
Method: 综述性工作：把持久、证据锚定的文档状态形式化为统一框架，规定将多模态证据转成带出处 (provenance) 的持久状态所需的操作与不变量；再做 statefulness audit，用八条准则编码十个代表性基准；并推导纵向基准 harness，含 Experience Gain、Cost Efficiency、Memory Harm、Forgetting Fidelity、Coverage Retention 五个反事实指标。
Result: 审计结果为十个代表性基准在八条 statefulness 准则下均未覆盖跨会话状态演化；提出的 harness 用五个反事实指标刻画持久文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。
Conclusion: Document AI 缺少把持久状态与文档原生结构、出处和时间有效性耦合的机制，下一代系统的分界线在于跨文档、跨会话、跨时间保留了什么。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.
papers.comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ControlGS 把渲染输出到人眼之间的后处理与显示光路建进优化目标，并按运行时的下游处理参数动态生成条件化的 Gaussian primitives，使 XR 端到端画质随下游处理变化自适应提升。在不同 neural Gaussian backbone 与数据集上均改善 post-optics 端到端质量，且开销极小。
Motivation: XR 渲染结果要经过随相机位姿、显示功耗预算变化的后处理与显示光路才到人眼，传统 3DGS 要么默认这条链路保画质、要么无法随下游处理变化调整。
Method: ControlGS 是一条 XR Gaussian 渲染流水线：把渲染输出到人眼之间的整个下游处理过程建模并纳入优化目标，同时按下游处理参数动态生成 Gaussian primitives，实现端到端视觉质量优化。
Result: 实验显示 ControlGS 在不同 neural Gaussian backbone 和多个数据集上一致改善端到端 post-optics XR 质量，且开销极小（minimal overhead）。
Conclusion: 把下游后处理与显示光路纳入优化并对其做条件化，是提升 XR 端到端画质的有效路径，且可跨 backbone 与数据集泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScreenHaystack 是一个动态 needle-in-a-haystack 式 GUI grounding 基准：把受控目标图标在高分辨率界面背景上系统性重定位，测出 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 都存在盲区——目标外观与指令不变、仅位置不同，grounding 准确率就骤降。盲区可迁移到未见过的 ScreenSpot-Pro 样例，把目标移入盲区降准确率、移出则升；训练数据空间覆盖不均可诱发盲区，而面向盲区的增强 (blind-zone-oriented augmentation) 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上超过原始与随机增强的 Click-100k 微调。
Motivation: GUI grounding 模型在固定位置测试下看不出空间可靠性差异：同一目标换个屏幕位置就失效，而现有评测不系统改变目标位置，无法暴露这种位置依赖的失败。
Method: 构建动态基准 ScreenHaystack，在高分辨率 GUI 背景上系统性重定位受控目标图标并测量定位一致性；用受控合成实验检验训练数据空间覆盖不均是否诱发盲区；再提出 blind-zone-oriented augmentation，在盲区位置补充监督，基于 Click-100k 做微调。
Result: Qwen3-VL-8B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上落入盲区的目标准确率下降 16.1 个百分点；受控重定位显示移入盲区降准确率、移出升准确率；盲区可迁移到未见过的 ScreenSpot-Pro 样例；面向盲区的增强在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上优于原始 Click-100k 微调与随机增强微调。
Conclusion: GUI grounding 的空间盲区由训练数据空间覆盖不均诱发，且会迁移到新样本；在盲区定向补监督即可同时优于原始与随机增强的微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices
papers.abstract_en: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 固定权重、只切换推理模式的对照显示，推理会让模型的错误更集中：两个独立抽到的错误答案重合概率在全部十组数据集级比较中上升（p = 0.00098），在无界答案空间里推理把不同答案数压到非推理的 0.43–0.65。在 8 个模型、5 个基准、280 个方法-数据集-模型组合上，校正后没有任何置信度加权方法胜过朴素多数投票；作者主张置信信号应在决策层面而非区分度层面评估。
Motivation: self-consistency 的前提是采样之间独立、不确定时会分歧，因而一致即正确；若推理本身让错误答案互相重合，多数投票与置信度加权的可靠性基础就被破坏。
Method: 固定模型权重、仅切换推理模式（reasoning on/off）做受控对照，在 5 个基准上采样 74,944 个样本，统计错误答案重合概率、不同答案数与可用 headroom；再在 8 个模型 × 5 个基准的 280 个方法-数据集-模型组合上比较多数投票、加权投票与学习到的六信号组合，并检验答案 log-probability 的方向是否翻转。
Result: 错误答案重合概率在全部十组数据集级比较中上升（p = 0.00098），限制到双方都答错的题目后为九比九；无界答案空间中推理把不同答案数降到非推理的 0.43–0.65，有界空间中两侧选项集相同、推理把质量集中到该集合上。可判定答案多样性的问题集合在十个单元中全部缩小 2.7 倍，归一化 headroom 后两侧各用掉约四分之一。280 个组合中校正后无一胜过朴素多数投票；加权投票在 98.5% 的题目-方法对上与多数投票一致，其余部分正确率 56.3%；答案 log-probability 在关推理时预测正确、开推理时预测错误；学习的六信号组合在域外无增益。
