papers.title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
papers.abstract_en: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.
papers.comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Depth Any Seen 把同一射线上的多个可见表面表示为图像条件的 multi-Bernoulli 深度集合，每个分量给出一个深度或缺席，用辅助-free 的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli 目标 (ExactMB) 通过边缘化一对一指派来联合学习深度与存在性。相比 depth stacking，ExactMB 在 LD-Real 上相对降低过预测 88.2%、在 MD-3K 上降低 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度。
Motivation: 单图恢复可见 3D 结构时，一条射线上可能有多个表面，需要同时判定各表面是否存在并估计其度量深度；仅匹配期望计数无法解决分量与表面的指派歧义。
Method: 将表面建为图像条件的 multi-Bernoulli 深度集合（分量可缺席），提出 auxiliary-free 的 ExactMB 目标，通过边缘化到完整且互异目标的一对一指派来联合学习深度与存在性；在扩展的 real 与 synthetic 分层深度基准 (LD-Real、LD-Syn、MD-3K) 上评测深度精度、恢复支撑与过预测，并做 ordered assignment 与 count-regularized 配置的消融。
Result: 相对 depth stacking，ExactMB 在 LD-Real 上过预测相对下降 88.2%，在 MD-3K 上下降 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，在 LD-Syn 上条件度量深度误差相当。消融显示 ordered assignment 在深度准确的 recall 与 precision 上优于边缘化，而 count-regularized 配置在更低 recall 下取得更高的深层秩 (deeper-rank) precision。
Conclusion: 联合建模表面存在性与度量深度并用一对一指派边缘化目标，能大幅压低分层深度估计的过预测而不明显牺牲序数精度；期望计数匹配本身不足以确定分量-表面指派。

papers.title: Continuous-Time Trajectory Generation from Discrete Observations with Stochasticity
papers.abstract_en: Physical systems evolve continuously in time, yet their states are typically observed only at discrete times. Generating trajectories consistent with their probability densities from such observations therefore requires capturing the continuous-time evolution rather than only learning transition mappings between consecutive observations. We propose PhiBE-Flow, a framework that directly estimates the probability velocity field induced by the stochastic differential equation (SDE) which governs this continuous-time distributional evolution. PhiBE-Flow learns from discrete observations using a model-free approach requiring neither known SDE coefficients nor score estimation. We establish convergence guarantees for the method, accounting for both time-discretization and finite-sample errors. We evaluate PhiBE-Flow on systems of increasing complexity, from controlled stochastic numerical systems to Navier--Stokes dynamics and real-world videos. Our results show that PhiBE-Flow accurately recovers probability flows of stochastic dynamics, preserves multiscale physical statistics, and improves video generation performance over representative baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/R1fe/PhiBE-Flow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PhiBE-Flow：直接估计支配连续时间分布演化的 SDE 所诱导的概率速度场 (probability velocity field)，从离散观测中生成带随机性的连续时间轨迹，无需已知 SDE 系数或 score 估计。方法给出兼顾时间离散与有限样本误差的收敛保证，在受控随机数值系统、Navier–Stokes 动力学与真实视频上恢复概率流、保持多尺度物理统计，并在视频生成上优于代表性基线。
Motivation: 物理系统连续演化但只在离散时刻被观测，仅学习相邻观测间的转移映射无法捕捉连续时间上的分布演化，难以生成与概率密度一致的随机轨迹。
Method: PhiBE-Flow 以 model-free 方式从离散观测直接估计 SDE 诱导的概率速度场，既不需要已知 SDE 系数也不做 score estimation；作者为方法建立收敛保证，同时计入时间离散误差与有限样本误差。
Result: 在复杂度递增的系统上评估：受控随机数值系统、Navier–Stokes 动力学与真实视频；结果为准确恢复随机动力学的概率流、保持多尺度物理统计，并在视频生成上优于代表性基线。
Conclusion: 直接估计概率速度场是从离散观测生成连续时间随机轨迹的可行路径，且可给出同时覆盖时间离散与有限样本误差的收敛保证。

papers.title: SilentCall: Hidden Tool-Call Backdoors in Open-Weight Agents, and How to Catch Them
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight tool-calling agents are adopted on evidence of merit, usually benchmark scores and a record of reliable use. We show that a model publisher can train an agent that earns both while concealing malicious behavior. Fine-tuned on a mixture of clean and poisoned conversations, our agents answer ordinary requests correctly; once the system date reaches a chosen year, they emit the correct tool call and, alongside it, one that exfiltrates the user's credentials. The exfiltration runs while the user-facing response mentions only the legitimate work. We call this attack SilentCall. Under the trigger, it fires on at least $99.6$\% of requests, and no response ever mentions it. The attack is detectable by three distinct methods, which differ mainly in what a defender needs to run them. A runtime monitor that inspects each tool call before it executes requires no access to the model and catches every instance of the payload we tested at a 1.73% false-positive rate. High-temperature probing requires only the published weights. The weight-distribution audit requires training a benign model with the suspect's recipe, placing it within reach of model hubs but not ordinary users. Alignment benchmarks, by contrast, do not separate poisoned from benign models. SilentCall leaves no trace on standard benchmarks. As tool-using agents spread through the open-weight supply chain, trust in them should not rest on what a model says about its own actions. It has to come from inspecting those actions at runtime, auditing models where they are distributed, and treating tool access as a security surface in its own right.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SilentCall 是针对开放权重工具调用 agent 的隐藏后门攻击：发布者用干净与投毒对话混合微调，使模型平时基准分数正常，一旦系统日期到达指定年份就在正常工具调用旁附带一条外传用户凭证的调用，而面向用户的回复只提正当工作。触发后至少 99.6% 的请求都会触发且无任何回复提及；运行时工具调用监控在 1.73% 误报率下捕获全部所测载荷，而对齐基准完全无法区分投毒与良性模型。
Motivation: 开放权重 agent 依靠基准分数与使用记录获得信任，但发布者可以同时满足这两者并隐藏恶意行为，标准基准对此不留痕迹，信任机制本身失效。
Method: 用干净与投毒对话混合微调出 SilentCall agent，触发器为系统日期到达指定年份；检测侧给出三条路径：无需模型访问的运行时工具调用监控、只需已发布权重的高温探测 (high-temperature probing)、以及需按可疑配方训练良性模型的权重分布审计 (weight-distribution audit)。
Result: 触发条件下至少 99.6% 的请求发出外传凭证的工具调用，且没有任何回复提及该载荷；运行时监控捕获所测全部载荷，误报率 1.73%；对齐基准无法区分投毒与良性模型，SilentCall 在标准基准上不留痕迹。
Conclusion: 对开放权重工具调用 agent 的信任不能建立在模型对自身行为的陈述上，必须在运行时检查其工具调用、在分发处审计模型，并把工具访问本身当作安全面。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建面向 K-12 科学的 NGSS 对齐基准，用合成数据流水线、多裁判验证与项目级心理测量分析评测 9 个开源 LLM，发现若干小型本地可部署模型在多学科与多题型上取得高准确率，模型规模并不稳定预测成绩；人工复核显示合成题目与 NGSS 标准并非完全对齐，因此教育部署需有意选型并保留 human-in-the-loop 题目开发。
Motivation: 教育场景缺乏与标准对齐的 LLM 评测工具，现有基准多测通用语言或高阶科学推理，与中学科学课程直接相关的内容表现存在空白。
Method: 构建 NGSS 对齐的初中与高中科学基准，采用严格合成数据流水线、multi-judge 验证与 item-level 心理测量分析；系统评测 9 个开源权重 LLM，并把人工复核者加入循环核对题目与 NGSS 标准的对齐度。
Result: 9 个开源 LLM 被系统评测，多个较小的本地可部署模型在多样科学领域与题型上取得高准确率；模型规模与表现不呈稳定对应；人工复核显示合成生成的题目与 NGSS 标准并非完全对齐。
Conclusion: 教育部署应按任务有意选型而非按模型规模选型，题目开发需保留 human-in-the-loop，并把基准扩展到交互式、循证反馈的评测。

summary_sections.conclusion: 教育部署应按任务有意选型而非按模型规模选型，题目开发需保留 human-in-the-loop，并把基准扩展到交互式、循证反馈的评测。

papers.title: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DMM 把多智能体路径寻找 (MAPF) 中一次性动作采样换成跨通信轮次的离散迭代意图精炼，模仿学习预训练后用无 critic 的 MICPO 微调。在 1,600 个 MovingAI 任务上解出 1,598 个，为所评估方法中最高覆盖，代价接近最强基线，并可扩展到超过一百万个同时行动的智能体。
Motivation: 部分可观测下各智能体独立从自身分布采样，会把局部合法的选择重组成互不相容的联合动作；即使每智能体分布学对了，最终采样机制本身也会造成这种失败。
Method: DMM 用随机初始化的动作意图加多轮局部通信做离散迭代精炼（借鉴扩散模型的 denoising），在承诺前耦合各智能体选择；先用专家 MAPF 解做模仿学习预训练，再用 MICPO（面向多智能体多轮动作精炼的 critic-free group-relative 强化学习）微调。
Result: 在 1,600 个 MovingAI 任务上，MICPO 微调的 DMM 解出 1,598 个，为所评估方法中最高覆盖，解代价接近最强基线；成功率与解代价总体优于所评估的可学习基线，并在障碍密集环境中扩展到超过一百万个同时行动的智能体。
Conclusion: 轮次级的意图精炼能在保持去中心化执行的同时改善联合动作协调，问题根源在采样机制而非每智能体分布本身。

papers.title: Representation Learning for Exact Preimages
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural predictors can model highly nonlinear maps, but many scientific and engineering tasks require reasoning in the opposite direction: given a performance or safety level, the goal is to characterize the preimage, that is, the complete set of inputs which meet the desired target level and optimize over that set. For expressive neural predictors, however, such preimages typically have no explicit representation and are expensive to recover or optimize over. This creates a fundamental three-way challenge between expressive forward prediction, accurate preimage approximation, and tractable optimization over the preimage for downstream tasks. We introduce TRIO (tractable representations for preimage learning and inverse optimization), a framework for learning representations that make these objectives compatible by construction. Our key contribution is a preimage factorization: the forward model remains expressive through nonlinear radial transformations (including neural networks), while, under inversion, each transformation reduces to a single scalar radius, which yields simple geometric level sets. This yields an explicit geometric representation that is reusable for downstream optimization over the preimage, and, for linear objectives, we show that this admits a closed-form global solution. We finally prove a universal approximation theorem which shows that TRIO can approximate any continuous forward map and its entire family of potentially disconnected, nonconvex preimages arbitrarily well. Hence, TRIO combines expressive forward modeling, exact preimage recovery, and tractable global downstream optimization over preimages by design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TRIO（tractable representations for preimage learning and inverse optimization）：前向模型用含神经网络的非线性径向变换保持表达力，而每个变换在求逆时退化为单个标量半径，从而给出显式几何水平集。对线性目标，preimage 上的下游优化存在闭式全局解；并证明 TRIO 可任意逼近任意连续前向映射及其可能不连通、非凸的整族 preimage。
Motivation: 科学与工程中常需反向推理：给定性能或安全阈值，刻画满足该阈值的全部输入（preimage）并在其上优化。表达力强的神经预测器通常没有显式 preimage 表示，恢复代价高，导致表达性前向预测、准确 preimage 近似与可解优化三者冲突。
Method: TRIO 通过 preimage 分解构造性地调和三者：前向模型保留非线性径向变换（含神经网络），求逆时每个变换化为单个标量半径，产生简单几何水平集；该显式表示可复用于下游 preimage 优化，线性目标下给出闭式全局解。
Result: 对线性目标证明 preimage 上的下游优化有闭式全局解；并证明通用逼近定理：TRIO 可任意逼近任意连续前向映射及其整族可能不连通、非凸的 preimage。
Conclusion: 通过把求逆约束进表示本身，TRIO 按设计同时获得表达性前向建模、精确 preimage 恢复与可解的全局下游优化。

papers.title: VoiceNet: Fine-Grained Voice Understanding Beyond Emotion at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Expressive speech synthesis has outpaced expressive speech perception: systems now render fine-grained vocal performances that no public benchmark can score. Most benchmarks for this inverse problem stop at six to nine basic emotion categories, largely on acted speech. This paper introduces VoiceNet, a human-annotated representation-level benchmark for voice performance understanding on permissively-licensed in-the-wild speech. VoiceNet has two subsets: VoiceNet-Emo applies a 40-emotion taxonomy with three expert ratings per item, and VoiceNet-Ext, a preliminary subset, scores 57 talking-style attributes including speaking rate, vocal tension, breathiness, and register. The paper also releases Emolia, an emotion-annotated version of the Emilia corpus, with a curated rebalanced subset enriched by dense MOSS-Audio Thinking annotations. Two voice-text contrastive baselines train on this data: a 110M-parameter VoiceCLAP-Small for fast large-scale data filtering and a 7B VoiceCLAP-Large for state-of-the-art performance. Both outperform existing CLAP baselines, which sit near chance on VoiceNet-Emo. On VoiceNet-Emo, VoiceCLAP-Large aligns more closely with the aggregate expert consensus than individual experts agree with one another: a comparison against the majority label rather than evidence of surpassing human emotion perception. All systems evaluated here are voice-text embedding models: VoiceNet scores representation-level attribute recognition and retrieval, not end-to-end spoken-dialogue behaviour. Clustering and filtering uncurated speech corpora into subsets that span diverse talking styles and emotions remains an open challenge; VoiceCLAP embeddings offer a promising tool for this task. VoiceNet, Emolia, and VoiceCLAP are publicly available for research use.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Christoph Schuhmann and Robert Kaczmarczyk contributed equally. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/LAION-AI/emolia-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VoiceNet 是面向语音表演细粒度理解的人工标注基准：VoiceNet-Emo 用 40 类情绪分类、每条三个专家评分，VoiceNet-Ext 初步覆盖 57 个说话风格属性。配套发布 Emolia（Emilia 语料的情绪标注版）并训练 110M 的 VoiceCLAP-Small 与 7B 的 VoiceCLAP-Large 两个语音-文本对比基线，两者都超过现有 CLAP 基线——后者在 VoiceNet-Emo 上接近随机水平。
Motivation: 表现型语音合成已能渲染细粒度语音表演，但公开基准最多只到六到九个基本情绪类别且多为表演语音，无法给这类逆问题打分。
Method: 构建人工标注的表征级基准 VoiceNet（Emo 子集 40 类情绪、每条 3 个专家评分；Ext 子集 57 个说话风格属性，含语速、声带紧张度、气声、音区），发布 Emolia（Emilia 语料的情绪标注版，含再平衡子集与密集 MOSS-Audio Thinking 标注），在其上训练语音-文本对比模型 VoiceCLAP-Small（110M，用于大规模数据过滤）与 VoiceCLAP-Large（7B）。
Result: 两个 VoiceCLAP 都优于现有 CLAP 基线，后者在 VoiceNet-Emo 上接近随机水平；VoiceCLAP-Large 与专家集体共识的一致度高于单个专家彼此之间的一致度——摘要强调这是与多数标签的比较，而非超越人类情绪感知的证据。
Conclusion: VoiceNet 只评表征级属性识别与检索，不是端到端对话行为；用 VoiceCLAP embedding 对未整理语音语料做聚类过滤、覆盖多样说话风格与情绪仍是开放挑战。

papers.title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
papers.abstract_en: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TriO 是一个三模态无监督世界模型，用相机、LiDAR、RADAR 同时作输入和自监督来源，联合预测 4D occupancy、障碍物分割、光流与 LiDAR，无需人工标注即可把任意占据从可行驶表面中分割出来，缓解 open-set 方法在长尾物体上的失效。在 Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected 等多个数据集上，occupancy、flow、LiDAR 预测与零样本道路障碍分割均达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有 open-set 障碍物分割依赖人工标注或开放词汇先验，在长尾物体上失效；多模态世界模型也缺少能同时驱动占据、分割、光流与 LiDAR 预测的自监督信号。
Method: TriO 以 camera、LiDAR、RADAR 三种传感器模态作为输入，同时把它们当作自监督来源，联合预测 4D occupancy、obstacle segmentation、flow 与 LiDAR；新的监督形式使模型能把任意 occupancy 从 drivable surface 中分离，无需额外人工标注。
Result: 在多个 3D 与 4D 任务上取得 SOTA，涵盖 occupancy、flow、LiDAR 预测，以及跨数据集（Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected）的零样本道路障碍分割。
Conclusion: 把三种传感器模态同时用作输入和自监督信号，足以支撑无标注的通用占据感知，并在长尾障碍物上超越现有 open-set 方法。

papers.title: Human Activity Recognition via Ultra-Wideband Data: A Framework for Dimensionality Reduction, Pattern Discovery, and Predictive Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in sensor technology have enabled more effective human activity recognition (HAR), particularly in real-time systems with limited computational resources. However, Ultra-Wideband (UWB) radar data remain challenging due to high dimensionality, noise, complexity, and nonlinear characteristics. This research proposes a framework to efficiently reduce data size, uncover significant patterns, and classify six activity types (Standff, Liedown, Noactivity, Sit, Stand, and Walk) from UWB signals with high accuracy. Two novel dimensionality reduction techniques are introduced in this paper. The first, Clustered Polynomial Expansion with Incremental PCA (CPE-IPCA), combines clustering and polynomial feature expansion with Incremental PCA, preserving 100% of the variance in only 50 components. The second, Post-PCA Standardization Approach (PPSA), standardizes data after PCA and retains 99.1% of the variance in 80 components, achieving superior compression and computational efficiency compared to conventional nonlinear methods. Frequent patterns are identified using Apriori and FP-Growth, which are then classified with Random Forest and a Vector Space Model (VSM). The framework achieves 100% accuracy with Random Forest on CPE-IPCA and 99% on PPSA, while VSM attains 100% precision, recall, and F1 on PPSA and near-perfect performance on CPE-IPCA (precision 1.00, recall 0.98-1.00, F1 0.99-1.00), demonstrating a fast, interpretable, and robust HAR system suitable for healthcare, assisted living, and smart environments.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures. Manuscript prepared for submission to an IEEE journal in machine learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 UWB 雷达人体活动识别 (HAR) 的高维含噪问题，提出两条降维路线：CPE-IPCA 用聚类加多项式展开再接 Incremental PCA，仅 50 个主成分即保留 100% 方差；PPSA 在 PCA 后做标准化，80 个成分保留 99.1% 方差。配合 Apriori/FP-Growth 频繁模式挖掘与 Random Forest、VSM 分类，六类活动在 CPE-IPCA 上达 100% 准确率。
Motivation: UWB 雷达信号维度高、噪声大、非线性强，在算力受限的实时系统中难以直接分类；常规非线性降维方法压缩率与计算效率不足。
Method: 两条新降维法：CPE-IPCA（聚类 + 多项式特征展开 + Incremental PCA）与 PPSA（PCA 后标准化）；用 Apriori 与 FP-Growth 挖掘频繁模式，再以 Random Forest 和 Vector Space Model (VSM) 对六类活动（Standff、Liedown、Noactivity、Sit、Stand、Walk）分类。
Result: CPE-IPCA 以 50 个成分保留 100% 方差，PPSA 以 80 个成分保留 99.1% 方差且压缩与计算效率优于常规非线性方法；Random Forest 在 CPE-IPCA 上准确率 100%、在 PPSA 上 99%；VSM 在 PPSA 上 precision/recall/F1 均为 100%，在 CPE-IPCA 上 precision 1.00、recall 0.98–1.00、F1 0.99–1.00。
Conclusion: 聚类-多项式-增量 PCA 与后 PCA 标准化这两条降维路径，配合频繁模式挖掘与树/向量分类器，可在极少主成分下实现近乎无损的六类 UWB 活动识别，适用于医疗、辅助生活与智能家居场景。

summary_sections.method: 两条新降维法：CPE-IPCA（聚类 + 多项式特征展开 + Incremental PCA）与 PPSA（PCA 后标准化）；用 Apriori 与 FP-Growth 挖掘频繁模式，再以 Random Forest 和 Vector Space Model (VSM) 对六类活动（Standff、Liedown、Noactivity、Sit、Stand、Walk）分类。
summary_sections.result: CPE-IPCA 以 50 个成分保留 100% 方差，PPSA 以 80 个成分保留 99.1% 方差且压缩与计算效率优于常规非线性方法；Random Forest 在 CPE-IPCA 上准确率 100%、在 PPSA 上 99%；VSM 在 PPSA 上 precision/recall/F1 均为 100%，在 CPE-IPCA 上 precision 1.00、recall 0.98–1.00、F1 0.99–1.00。
summary_sections.conclusion: 聚类-多项式-增量 PCA 与后 PCA 标准化这两条降维路径，配合频繁模式挖掘与树/向量分类器，可在极少主成分下实现近乎无损的六类 UWB 活动识别，适用于医疗、辅助生活与智能家居场景。

papers.title: Is invariance all you need for algorithmic fairness? Removing demographic information can create new bias
papers.abstract_en: Encoded demographic information in internal model representations is a commonly assumed risk factor for algorithmic bias, with demographic representation invariance often being touted as the ideal state. However, while demographic shortcut learning is a genuine threat, some degree of encoding is necessary when demographics correlate with target labels. Here, we show, mathematically and empirically, that enforcing demographic invariance can actually hamper bias mitigation and even create new biases. We distinguish marginal from class-conditional representation invariance, and show that they imply the standard group fairness notions of demographic parity and equalized odds, respectively. We evaluate the effects on predictive performance and fairness of enforcing both invariance types, both theoretically and empirically across five tabular and two chest X-ray imaging datasets. Our findings support our mathematical argument that demographic representation invariance is neither desirable nor sufficient for fairness.
papers.comment: An earlier version is available as a non-peer reviewed preprint, cited in the paper. This submission supersedes it with consent of all authors; all experiments are new
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证并实证显示：当人口统计属性与标签相关时，强制模型内部表示对人口统计信息不变（demographic representation invariance）不仅会妨碍偏差缓解，还会制造新的偏差。作者区分边际不变性与类条件不变性，分别对应 demographic parity 与 equalized odds，并在五个表格数据集和两个胸片数据集上给出理论与实证证据，结论是人口统计不变性既不可取也不足以保证公平。
Motivation: 把内部表示中的人口统计编码默认视为偏差风险、并追求人口统计不变性是当前常见做法，但当人口统计与标签相关时一定程度的编码是必要的，这一默认目标可能适得其反。
Method: 区分边际 (marginal) 与类条件 (class-conditional) 表示不变性，并证明二者分别蕴含 demographic parity 与 equalized odds；从理论和实证两方面评估强制这两种不变性对预测性能与公平性的影响，实验覆盖五个表格数据集与两个胸片 (chest X-ray) 影像数据集。
Result: 数学论证与跨五个表格数据集、两个胸片影像数据集的实证结果一致表明：强制人口统计表示不变性会妨碍偏差缓解并可能产生新偏差；边际不变性对应 demographic parity，类条件不变性对应 equalized odds。
Conclusion: 人口统计表示不变性既不是公平的充分条件也不可取，公平目标应选对不变性的类型（类条件而非一刀切的边际不变），而非一味移除人口统计信息。

papers.title: What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在硬性逐因子范数预算下，LoRA 的秩 r 并不控制容量：可达更新恰是核范数球内秩不超过 r 的矩阵，而所分析的复杂度与位移泛函在该集合上均由秩一更新取到，故秩上限从不生效。线性读出模型类对所有 r≥1 相同，Rademacher 复杂度与源分布可移动距离均与 r 无关；秩真正决定的是哪些更新可达、以及抵消预训练主奇异方向的代价。
Motivation: 实践中普遍把秩当作容量旋钮，认为小秩即更简单、泛化更好；本文要说明在权重衰减与范数控制的理想化预算下这一直觉为何失效。
Method: 在逐因子范数预算下刻画 LoRA 可达集为核范数球内的秩≤r 矩阵，分析线性读出模型类、Rademacher 复杂度与源分布位移泛函；再把预算改为乘积上的联合预算以恢复秩敏感界，并对抵消预训练主奇异方向所需最小秩给出上下界。
Result: 所有被分析的复杂度与位移泛函在可达集上由秩一更新最大化，秩上限从不绑定；模型类对每个 r≥1 相同，Rademacher 复杂度不含 r，分布位移有与秩无关且被证明为紧的上界。联合预算恢复数据依赖的秩敏感界，但仅在特征分布充分铺开时出现、最坏情形仍与秩无关；最小可达对齐秩的上下界在双向谱衰减下匹配。
Conclusion: 秩应被理解为决定更新的可达性与抵消代价的量，而不是模型容量；只有把预算放到乘积上，秩才重新进入复杂度界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Plan to submit to SenSys Phase 2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SenseAgent 把跨域 IMU 活动识别从固定推理管线改成 LLM 运行时规划的闭环传感过程：用无标签诊断报告判断是否调用重力感知、原型迁移、风格归一化等工具，并由 verifier 把关高风险决策。在多个 IMU 数据集与部署偏移上，经验证的路线选择改善跨域识别，尤其在更难的放置偏移与复合偏移下，并能进一步利用少量用户反馈。
Motivation: IMU 模型换用户、换设备或换身体位置后即失效，而现有做法把它当作部署前的静态模型设计问题；实际中目标域是逐步出现的、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同的传感动作。
Method: LLM 不直接分类原始 IMU 信号，而是作为运行时规划器，操作传感工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆与 verifier；先从目标流生成无标签诊断报告，再决定保持原始推理还是调用 gravity-aware sensing、prototype transfer、style normalization 等专用工具，verifier 检查源标定、目标记忆可靠性与 no-harm 准则后才接受高风险工具决策；支持在不重训骨干的前提下利用稀缺反馈。
Result: 在多个 IMU 数据集与部署偏移上的评估显示，经验证的路线选择改善跨域传感，在更难的放置偏移 (placement shift) 与复合偏移 (compound shift) 下提升更明显，并能从有限用户反馈中进一步获益。
Conclusion: 跨域 IMU 传感应作为带诊断、工具选择与安全否决的闭环过程来设计，而非部署前选定的单一适配方法；高风险适配需先过 verifier 才能生效。

papers.title: VC Dimension and Expressivity of Real-Valued Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Whereas previous results on abilities and limitations of transformers have restricted the definition of transformers in various ways, here we study softmax-attention, multi-layer transformers operating on real values, with very few additional assumptions. Applying results from real geometry, we obtain upper bounds on the VC dimension and split VC dimension of such transformers ($O(n^4)$ and $O(n^6)$, respectively, where $n$ is the input length). Conversely, we also construct specific transformers witnessing lower bounds on these quantities ($Ω(n)$ in each case). These results have some notable consequences. For example, within the class of symmetric (permutation-invariant) functions, we show that transformers can uniformly express all functions over an alphabet of one symbol and non-uniformly express all functions over an alphabet of two symbols, but cannot (even non-uniformly) express some functions over an alphabet of six symbols. We also prove limitations on how many bits of a real number a transformer can access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在几乎不加额外假设的 softmax 多层实值 Transformer 上，用实几何 (real geometry) 得到 VC 维与 split VC 维的上界 O(n^4) 与 O(n^6)，并构造具体网络给出 Ω(n) 下界。对称函数类中，Transformer 可统一表达单符号字母表上的全部函数、非统一表达双符号字母表上的全部函数，但连非统一都无法表达六符号字母表上的某些函数；同时给出单个实数可被访问比特数的限制。
Motivation: 既有 Transformer 能力与局限结果大多靠限制模型定义得到，缺少在标准 softmax-attention、多层、实值设定下的紧致表达力刻画。
Method: 研究标准 softmax-attention 多层实值 Transformer，仅施加极少额外假设；借助实几何结果推导 VC 维与 split VC 维上界，并显式构造 Transformer 作为下界见证，另对称函数类与实数比特可及性分别给出刻画与限制。
Result: VC 维上界 O(n^4)、split VC 维上界 O(n^6)（n 为输入长度），两者下界均为 Ω(n)；对称函数类中单符号字母表可统一表达全部函数、双符号字母表可非统一表达全部函数、六符号字母表上存在（即便非统一也）不可表达的函数；并证明了 Transformer 可访问实数比特数的限制。
Conclusion: 标准实值 Transformer 的表达力在多项式上界与线性下界之间存在真实间隙，且字母表增大到六个符号时对称函数类中已出现不可表达的函数。

papers.title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
papers.abstract_en: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向视觉模拟仪表读数的联邦学习框架，把表盘定位、联邦训练的细结构分割、极坐标展开与刻度计数解码串成四阶段流水线，各站点不共享原始图像即可协同训练读数模型。同时发布 1,382 张带掩码标注的 MeterFL 数据集，按视觉属性用确定性规则构造部署导向的伪客户端，并在分割训练/测试划分间做 dHash 近重复控制。
Motivation: 工业现场仪表类型与环境各异，自动读数系统需逐场景单独开发；图像分散在各独立站点、标注有限，且因权属与隐私约束无法集中汇总。
Method: 四阶段流水线：表盘定位、跨客户端联邦训练的细结构分割、极坐标展开、刻度计数解码得到读数；评测同时覆盖分割质量与端到端读数准确率。

Conclusion: 仪表读数可在不共享原始图像的前提下跨站点联邦训练，且需要带掩码标注、按部署属性构造客户端的数据集来系统评测这一设定。

papers.title: Integrating Language Models into Listened and Imagined Speech Decoding from MEG
papers.abstract_en: Decoding imagined speech is an important goal for brain-computer interfaces but remains challenging due to weak neural responses, low signal-to-noise ratio, and limited imagined-speech datasets. Language models provide strong contextual cues for text prediction, but how much they can help neural decoding and whether their contribution differs for decoding perceived and imagined speech remains unclear. To investigate this, we use a paired listened-imagined MEG dataset and incorporate language-model information at two stages. First, we train a contrastive neural decoder that aligns MEG representations with acoustic and contextual language representations, improving cross-subject word decoding for both listened and imagined speech. Second, at inference, we introduce a neural-constrained beam-search framework that combines neural evidence with language-model next-word probabilities. We find that imagined-speech decoding benefits more from the language model than listened-speech decoding. For Imagined speech, the best-performing balance between neural and language-model evidence shifts toward the language model, and the gain over neural-only decoding is larger. Together, these results suggest that language priors are most useful when neural evidence is weaker, making them particularly valuable for imagined-speech BCIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在配对的聆听-想象言语 MEG 数据集上，把语言模型信息分两处接入神经解码：先用对比解码器对齐 MEG 表征与声学/上下文语言表征，再在推理时用神经约束 beam search 融合神经证据与 LM 下一词概率。想象言语的最优证据配平更偏向语言模型，相对纯神经解码的增益也大于聆听言语，说明语言先验在神经证据更弱时更有用。
Motivation: 想象言语神经响应弱、信噪比低、数据集有限，解码困难；语言模型能提供强上下文先验，但它对感知言语与想象言语的贡献差异尚不清楚。
Method: 用配对 listened-imagined MEG 数据集，在两阶段接入语言模型：训练阶段用对比神经解码器把 MEG 表征与声学表征及上下文语言表征对齐，做跨被试词语解码；推理阶段用神经约束 beam search，把神经证据与语言模型下一词概率组合。
Result: 对比解码器对聆听与想象言语都改善了跨被试词语解码；想象言语从语言模型获益多于聆听言语，其神经证据与语言模型证据的最优配平向语言模型一侧移动，相对 neural-only 解码的增益更大。
Conclusion: 语言先验在神经证据较弱时最有用，因此对想象言语 BCI 特别有价值。

papers.title: Can Circuit Alignment Predict OOD Generalization?
papers.abstract_en: Can out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization be predicted from a trained model's weights alone, without any target-domain data? Existing representational similarity metrics (CKA, SVCCA, RSA) compare activations rather than forecast generalization. We show they are provably insensitive to structural rerouting in the computational graph, the very change distribution shift induces. We close this gap with the Circuit Alignment Score (CAS), which compares class-specific circuits across domains via graph kernels, decomposed into same-class coherence and cross-class confusion. Casting CAS as a Lebesgue integral over the domain distribution, we prove its Monte Carlo estimate recovers the ground-truth ranking of learners by OOD accuracy, with pairwise inversion error vanishing at rate $O(1/M)$, where $M$ is the number of sampled domains. Across $48$ learners on PACS, CAS attains $0.88$ rank correlation with OOD accuracy, versus $0.58$ (CKA), $0.23$ (SVCCA), and $0.14$ (RSA), with similar trends on other benchmarks and even against data-dependent methods, making it the first provably consistent predictor of distributional robustness requiring neither target-domain data nor labels. The code is available at: https://github.com/ayanban011/ACE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Circuit Alignment Score (CAS)，仅凭训练后模型权重、用图核比较跨域的类别专属电路，把一致性写成域分布上的 Lebesgue 积分，证明其 Monte Carlo 估计能恢复按 OOD 精度排序的真实排序，成对反转误差以 O(1/M) 速率消失。在 PACS 的 48 个学习器上 CAS 与 OOD 精度的秩相关达 0.88，而 CKA 0.58、SVCCA 0.23、RSA 0.14。
Motivation: 现有表征相似度指标 (CKA、SVCCA、RSA) 只比较激活而非预测泛化，且被证明对计算图的结构性重连不敏感，而结构重连正是分布偏移引发的变化。
Method: CAS 用图核 (graph kernels) 比较不同域上的类别专属电路，分解为同类一致性 (same-class coherence) 与跨类混淆 (cross-class confusion)；再把 CAS 写成域分布上的 Lebesgue 积分，用 Monte Carlo 估计恢复学习器按 OOD 精度的排序。
Result: 在 PACS 上 48 个学习器中，CAS 与 OOD 精度秩相关 0.88，对比 CKA 0.58、SVCCA 0.23、RSA 0.14；理论给出成对反转误差随采样域数 M 以 O(1/M) 速率消失；在其他基准以及与依赖数据的方法比较上趋势相似。
Conclusion: CAS 是首个被证明一致的分布鲁棒性预测器，既不需要目标域数据也不需要标签，可从权重单独预测 OOD 泛化排序。

papers.title: Identifiability Limits of Gravitational Wave Phase Deviations: Multiclass Classification with a Multihead Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: We study how well gravitational-wave phase deviations can be identified using a neural network with classification and regression heads. The classification head distinguishes general relativity (GR) from six parametrized post-Einsteinian phase families with exponents $b\in\{-7,-5,-3,-1,+1,+2\}$; the regression head predicts the logarithm of the coupling magnitude, $\log_{10}|β|$. The network input is a response function quantifying the sensitivity of waveform mismatch to waveform deformations. We use stationary Gaussian noise with the Advanced LIGO design spectrum for 262 sources and a measured Hanford spectrum from the third observing run (O3) for 132 sources, and also test injections into recorded Hanford strain. On the two Gaussian datasets, the network identifies the exponent of deviations clearly above the noise with accuracies of $0.427$ and $0.329$. To interpret these results, we compare the network with an approximate classifier built from predicted waveform residuals for the six phase families and same sources. The two classifiers often confuse the same families. Examining residuals left by different phase corrections, we link these errors to similarities between the underlying deviations. On selected recorded Hanford strain, networks trained on simulated or recorded noise achieve overall classification accuracies close to those on simulated Hanford noise. Of thirteen neural-network variants tested on the Advanced LIGO design dataset, the recurrent network has the highest mean classification accuracy for loud deviations, although all variants remain below the approximate classifier. The network nearly matches that classifier's accuracy, indicating that identification is limited by similarities between neighboring phase families rather than by the network, for known intrinsic source parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用带分类头与回归头的神经网络识别引力波相位偏差：分类头区分广义相对论与六族参数化后爱因斯坦相位修正（指数 b∈{-7,-5,-3,-1,+1,+2}），回归头预测 log10|β|。在两个高斯噪声数据集上，明显高于噪声的偏差识别准确率分别为 0.427 与 0.329；十三种网络变体均不及由波形残差构造的近似分类器，说明瓶颈在相邻相位族本身的相似性而非网络。
Motivation: 引力波参数化偏差的可辨识性受限于不同相位族波形之间的相似，需要判断误差究竟来自网络表达能力还是物理可分性本身。
Method: 网络输入为量化波形失配对形变敏感度的响应函数 (response function)，分类头输出 GR 与六族相位修正，回归头预测 log10|β|；数据为 Advanced LIGO design 谱下 262 个源与 O3 Hanford 实测谱下 132 个源的平稳高斯噪声，并测试注入记录 Hanford 应变；另构造基于预测波形残差的近似分类器作对照，并检验十三种网络变体（含循环网络）。
Result: 两个高斯数据集上对明显高于噪声的偏差识别准确率为 0.427 与 0.329；两类分类器常混淆相同的相位族；在选定的记录 Hanford 应变上，模拟噪声与记录噪声训练的网络总体准确率接近模拟 Hanford 噪声上的结果；Advanced LIGO design 数据集上十三种变体中循环网络对响亮偏差的平均分类准确率最高，但全部低于近似分类器，网络已接近该分类器水平。
Conclusion: 在已知源内禀参数的条件下，相位偏差识别的限制来自相邻相位族之间的相似性，而非网络本身。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Reveals Shared Causal Subspaces in Brain-to-Speech Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Decoding covert speech, such as mimed or imagined, from brain activity is harder than decoding vocalized speech. Cross-modal transfer, where information from one speech form helps decode another, is a promising remedy; yet how a decoder internally represents and processes brain activity from different speech forms remains unclear. In this work, we ask: which internal neurons of a decoder carry cross-modal information, and are these neurons shared across different speech forms? To answer these questions, we leverage mechanistic interpretability, using recordings of the same sentences in vocalized, mimed, and imagined input pairs for activation patching. We insert the decoder's internal activity for a sentence in one condition into its processing of the same sentence in another and measure the change in decoding accuracy. We find that no single neuron drives this benefit; instead, it arises from small groups of neurons, with vocalized speech as the most useful source. These groups are largely condition-specific in the early stage of the decoder but overlap in the later stage. These findings point toward more data-efficient covert speech decoders through training objectives that encourage shared later-stage representations learned mainly from vocalized data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用激活修补 (activation patching) 做脑到语音解码器的机制可解释性分析，发现跨语音形式的增益不由单个神经元承担，而来自小群神经元；这些群在解码器早期阶段基本条件特异、在后期阶段重叠，且发声 (vocalized) 语音是最有用的迁移源。作者据此主张用鼓励后期共享表征、主要从发声数据学习的训练目标来做更数据高效的隐蔽语音 (covert speech) 解码器。
Motivation: 隐蔽语音（默读、想象）比发声语音更难解码，跨模态迁移是可行补救，但解码器内部如何表征与处理不同语音形式的脑活动尚不清楚，无法知道哪些内部神经元承载跨模态信息、是否跨形式共享。
Method: 基于机制可解释性，用同一句子在发声、默读 (mimed)、想象三种条件下的配对记录做 activation patching：把解码器处理某条件中一个句子时的内部活动插入到它处理另一条件下的同一句子，再测量解码准确率的变化。
Result: 跨模态增益不来自任何单个神经元，而来自小群神经元；发声语音作为源最有用。这些神经元群在解码器早期阶段基本为条件特异，在后期阶段出现重叠。
Conclusion: 共享表征主要出现在解码器后期而非早期，因此数据高效的隐蔽语音解码器应设计鼓励后期共享表征、以发声数据为主的训练目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

papers.title: Communication between Frozen Large Language Models via Prompt Optimization in a Referential Game
papers.abstract_en: We study communication between two frozen large language models from different providers, with different tokenizers, accessed through their API endpoints. The two play a referential game: one sees an object and describes it in a short fixed-length message over a small alphabet; the other must pick that object out of a candidate set. Neither model's weights are updated. Each agent's prompt is rewritten by an isolated prompt optimizer whose reflection model reads that agent's scored interactions. In the positional setting, optimized prompts carry a shared code that generalizes to held-out objects above a measured no-codebook baseline, including when the memory window is removed. In a second setting, independent per-letter blocks no longer fit within the message, although a whole-object place value code does. The base system fails to establish reliable communication: the sender struggles to retain an injective rule, and the receiver has too few confirmed examples in view. A sender collision penalty, retention of successful interactions, and sequential optimization enable successful place value communication in some runs. Outcomes vary across runs and reflection models. In successful runs, the protocol is written into the optimized prompts, where it can be read and audited directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两个不同厂商、不同 tokenizer、仅经 API 调用的冻结 LLM 之间做指称博弈 (referential game)：发送方用短定长消息描述物体，接收方从候选集中选出，双方权重不更新，各自 prompt 由独立的 prompt optimizer 依据带分数的交互记录重写。位置设定下优化出的 prompt 携带共享编码，在留出物体上超过实测的无码本基线，去掉记忆窗口后依然成立；加入发送方碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互与顺序优化后，部分 run 中建立起 place value 通信，但结果随 run 与 reflection 模型波动，且协议可直接写进 prompt 供阅读与审计。
Motivation: 不同供应商的冻结 LLM 各自 tokenizer 不同、只能走 API，无法联合训练或共享权重，要在这种隔离条件下建立可泛化、可审计的共享协议缺乏可行路径。
Method: 两个冻结 LLM 扮演指称博弈的发送方与接收方：发送方在小字母表上发短定长消息，接收方从候选集选目标；每个 agent 的 prompt 由独立的 prompt optimizer 重写，optimizer 的 reflection model 读取该 agent 带评分的交互记录。对比位置编码设定与逐字母块设定，并引入发送方碰撞惩罚、成功交互保留与顺序优化。
Result: 位置设定下优化 prompt 携带的共享编码在留出物体上超过实测无码本基线，移除记忆窗口后仍成立；逐字母独立块放不进消息长度，但整体物体的 place value 编码可以放入。基础系统无法建立可靠通信（发送方难以保持单射规则、接收方可见的已确认样例过少），加入碰撞惩罚、成功交互保留与顺序优化后部分 run 实现 place value 通信，结果随 run 与 reflection 模型变化。
Conclusion: 冻结 LLM 间的共享协议可以被写进优化后的 prompt 并直接读取审计，但可靠通信依赖碰撞惩罚、成功样例保留与顺序优化这些训练机制，且跨 run、跨 reflection 模型不稳定。

papers.title: Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Neural Networks With a Dissipative System
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the applicability of Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Neural Network models to a dissipative system that has explicit time dependence in its Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, and total energy. To do so we consider these neural network models for simulated systems of a harmonic one-dimensional, one-component oscillator with damping, as well as without damping for comparison. We find that both the Lagrangian and Hamiltonian approaches are able to predict the empirical physical behavior of the damped oscillator systems and to effectively ``learn'' to varying degrees the underlying Lagrangians and Hamiltonians, as has previously been shown to be the case with undamped oscillator systems. These investigations elucidate important properties of Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics, including properties that are not manifest when considering systems without explicit time dependence.
papers.comment: 14 Pages, 7 Figures, 2 Tables, in review. Comments welcome
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Lagrangian Neural Network 与 Hamiltonian Neural Network 用到显含时间、带阻尼的一维单组分谐振子上，检验它们能否在耗散系统中预测动力学并学到背后的 Lagrangian/Hamiltonian。结论是两种网络都能再现阻尼振子的经验物理行为，并在不同程度上学到显含时间的 Lagrangian 与 Hamiltonian，从而显露出无显式时间依赖系统中看不到的力学性质。
Motivation: LNN/HNN 此前主要在无耗散、无显式时间依赖系统上验证，而真实耗散系统的 Lagrangian、Hamiltonian 与总能量都显含时间，其可学性与适用边界未知。
Method: 在模拟的一维单组分阻尼谐振子上分别训练 Lagrangian Neural Network 与 Hamiltonian Neural Network，并以无阻尼情形作对照，比较两者对动力学的预测与对底层 Lagrangian/Hamiltonian 的拟合程度。
Result: 两种方法都能预测阻尼振子系统的经验物理行为，并在不同程度上有效学到其底层 Lagrangian 与 Hamiltonian，与此前在无阻尼系统上的结论一致；摘要未给出具体误差数值。
Conclusion: LNN 与 HNN 可推广到显含时间的耗散系统，且这类系统能揭示无显式时间依赖时不显现的 Lagrangian/Hamiltonian 力学性质。

papers.title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定编码器与预训练数据的受控设置下比较九种视觉-语言预训练目标，发现目标粒度与任务粒度在两端对齐：局部目标在异常检测领先，全局目标在分类领先；captioning 与对比学习的优劣随粒度反转，混合两者在分类与分布内生成最强，两个 captioning 目标配对在零样本报告生成泛化最好。结论是没有单一目标普遍最优，下游表现由目标类型、粒度与任务三者的交互决定。
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督空间粒度上差异很大，但这种分布对胸片解读任务的影响缺乏受控研究——以往目标、编码器与数据同时变动，无法归因。
Method: 受控研究：固定编码器与预训练数据，只变预训练目标，训练九种目标（全局与局部对比学习、captioning 及其组合），在五个空间粒度递增的胸片任务上评测。
Result: 局部目标在异常检测领先，全局目标在分类领先；局部目标在全局级生成与问答任务上也有竞争力；captioning 与对比学习的优劣随粒度层级反转；组合中 captioning+对比监督在分类与分布内生成最强，两个 captioning 目标配对在零样本报告生成泛化最佳。
Conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的预训练目标，胸片下游表现由目标类型、粒度与任务的交互共同决定，选目标需对齐目标任务的粒度。

papers.title: Understanding the Subspace Stabilization of the Hessian and Gradient Covariance Matrix
papers.abstract_en: The phenomenon of the top subspace stabilization of the Hessian matrix is an surprising and critical aspect in study of the second-order information of neural network training. Prior work argues that the top subspace of the Hessian stabilizes by measuring the overlap between the top subspaces of the step-wise Hessian, and explains this stabilization with diminishing parameter change in the late phase of training. In this paper, we define a new instability metric for the subspace evolution, and use it to detect subspace stabilization that is independent of the magnitude of parameter change. In the meantime, we observe that the gradient covariance matrix has a similar property of its top subspace to the Hessian. By using a between-class and within-class decomposition of the gradient covariance matrix, we identify an explicit form that gives a near-perfect approximation of the top-$(C-1)$ subspace of the Hessian and the gradient covariance matrix. In the gradient flow set-up, we show that the slow evolution of the idenfied approximation is due to the separation between the outlier and the bulk eigenvalues of the Hessian matrix, thus providing an explanation to the phenomenon of the top subspace stabilization of the Hessian matrix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出与参数变化幅度无关的子空间演化不稳定度量，用于判定神经网络训练中 Hessian 与梯度协方差矩阵顶部子空间何时稳定；通过类间/类内分解给出显式近似式，近乎完美地逼近 Hessian 与梯度协方差的 top-(C-1) 子空间，并在梯度流框架下把这种慢演化归因于 Hessian 特征值中离群值与 bulk 的分离。
Motivation: 既有的顶部子空间稳定解释依赖“训练后期参数变化变小”，无法把子空间本身的演化与参数移动幅度区分开；梯度协方差矩阵是否也有同样现象缺乏刻画。
Method: 定义一个新的子空间演化不稳定度量，独立于参数变化幅度来检测稳定；对梯度协方差矩阵做 between-class 与 within-class 分解，导出显式近似式逼近 Hessian 与梯度协方差的 top-(C-1) 子空间；在 gradient flow 设定下分析该近似式的慢演化来源。
Result: 所导出的显式近似式对 Hessian 与梯度协方差矩阵的 top-(C-1) 子空间给出 near-perfect approximation；在梯度流设定下，慢演化由 Hessian 特征值中 outlier 与 bulk 的分离解释。
Conclusion: Hessian 顶部子空间的稳定源于谱上离群值与 bulk 的分离，而非参数变化幅度变小；梯度协方差矩阵的顶部子空间具有同样性质。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Evasion Attacks on Cost-Utility-Based Adversarial Training for Online AutoML in IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: As Internet of Things (IoT) networks increasingly depend on machine learning for anomaly, malware, intrusion detection, and network monitoring, such systems have become attractive targets for evasion attacks. Evasion attacks pose a major security risk because an adversary intentionally modifies input data to mislead a trained model into producing incorrect predictions while evading detection. This study evaluates the impact of black-box evasion attacks on a cost-utility-based adversarial training defense strategy in an Online AutoML context for IoT networks. Specifically, evasion attacks were applied to online learners, including Hoeffding Tree (HT), Leveraging Bagging (LB), Streaming Random Patches (SRP), Hoeffding Adaptive Tree (HAT), and Adaptive Random Forest (ARF). By developing naive and adversarially trained (AT) versions of these online learners, we generated clean and adversarial accuracies for each model. The results show that the AT versions of LB and SRP performed best, achieving the highest adversarial accuracy (0.985) and high clean accuracy (0.993) at the highest cost budget of 1.00, with a maximum accuracy reduction of only 0.8%. Finally, drift detection was conducted using the Early Drift Detection Method (EDDM).

papers.title: Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可执行科学契约（精确正确性测试、profiling 要求、验收标准）驱动 Codex 与 Claude Code 代理自主优化粒子追踪的固定半径最近邻 (FRNN) 检索，代理自行去掉 PyTorch 依赖并做假设驱动的性能实验，产出独立 C++/CUDA 库精确复现参考结果，同步 NumPy 接口在含主机传输情况下仍比原 GPU 端 PyTorch 接口快 1.6 倍。
Motivation: 通用 coding agent 能跨多轮工具调用执行持久目标，但缺少它们能否做严格科学性能工程的证据；性能优化需要可验证的正确性与验收条件，否则代理无法自我校验。
Method: 以 PyTorch 依赖的 CUDA FRNN 实现为起点，给代理一个只规定精确正确性测试、profiling 要求和验收标准、不规定代码变换的可执行目标；主序列轨迹中代理自主移除 PyTorch 并进行假设驱动优化实验，另有独立重跑走不同假设序列。
Result: 产出的独立 C++/CUDA 库精确复现目标参考结果；同步 NumPy 接口相对原 GPU 端 PyTorch 接口加速 1.6 倍（尽管包含主机传输）；不同 GPU 架构与软件栈上观察到相似加速；独立重跑沿不同假设序列在目标工作负载上达到更好性能。
Conclusion: 目标持久型 coding agent 可以充当实验性性能工程师，而引导并验证其优化需要可执行的科学契约 (executable scientific contracts)。

papers.title: Bridging Stochastic Flow Maps and Boltzmann Generators with Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Generating independent, equilibrium samples of molecular systems at scale remains a central obstacle in computational statistical mechanics. Boltzmann Generators address this by pairing a generative model with importance sampling to obtain consistent samples from the target distribution. We introduce Normalizing Flow Flow Maps (NF$^2$M), which combines the strengths of recent stochastic flow maps with the tractability of classic normalizing flows to build a Boltzmann Generator. Unlike most methods, which correct the generative model only at the end, NF$^2$M reweighs each denoising transition as generation proceeds, avoiding wasted compute on trajectories that are ultimately discarded. At each denoising step, a conditional normalizing flow proposes clean configurations given the current noisy state (a simpler task than sampling directly from the target) and its exact likelihood enables correcting each proposal toward the true denoising transition of the target Boltzmann distribution. This is in contrast to most existing methods, whose likelihoods are approximate or expensive to evaluate, undermining the statistical reliability of the correction. We establish consistency of the corrected transitions and bound how approximation errors propagate through the sampling chain. We evaluate NF$^2$M on peptide systems, demonstrating improved sampling efficiency and sample quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Normalizing Flow Flow Maps (NF²M)，把随机流映射 (stochastic flow maps) 与经典 normalizing flow 结合成 Boltzmann Generator：每个去噪步用条件 normalizing flow 提出干净构型，用其精确似然把提议就地校正到目标 Boltzmann 分布的真实去噪转移上，而不是只在生成结束时做一次重要性校正。作者证明校正转移的相合性并给出近似误差沿采样链传播的界，在肽体系上展示了更高的采样效率与样本质量。
Motivation: Boltzmann Generator 需要独立的平衡态样本，但多数方法只在生成末端做校正，且似然近似或求值昂贵，导致大量算力浪费在最终被丢弃的轨迹上，统计可靠性受损。
Method: NF²M 在每个去噪步用条件 normalizing flow 从当前含噪状态提议干净构型（比直接从目标采样更容易），其精确似然用于把每个提议校正到目标 Boltzmann 分布的真实去噪转移；结合 stochastic flow maps 与可计算似然的 normalizing flow，并给出校正转移的相合性证明与近似误差沿采样链传播的误差界。
Result: 在肽体系 (peptide systems) 上评估，展示了改进的采样效率与样本质量；理论上建立了校正转移的相合性，并界定了近似误差在采样链中的传播。
Conclusion: 逐步用精确似然校正去噪转移，可以在生成过程中就修正提议、避免浪费算力，从而同时保证统计可靠性与采样效率。

papers.title: Model Casting and Low-Parameter Gating: Towards More Sparsely Activated FFNs
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces model casting, a mid-training recipe that drastically sparsifies the activations within the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layer. With this strategy, at inference time, we first compute the output of the gating matrix and, thanks to its high sparsity, we avoid computations with the two other matrices, reducing the FLOP count by up to 3x. While this theoretical speedup is an upper bound, model casting translates into significant speedups both on CPU and GPU. We then introduce LoPA Gating, a new FFN design that increases the maximum theoretical speedup. It is a low-FLOPs parameterization of the gating matrix that overcomes the 3x cap by allocating fewer FLOPs and parameters to the gating matrix, compared to the two other FFN matrices that are sparsely activated. We consider two cases: (i) we cast a pre-trained model with a sparsity inducing activation; (ii) we train with LoPA from scratch. In all settings, we significantly outperform existing pruning solutions and regular RELU-fication. For instance, at matched quality, we achieve a 3.2x FLOP speedup with LoPA Casting, against 1.6x at best for competing methods top-p and TEAL. Using dedicated kernels, we achieve an actual 3.31x speed-up on GPU at 90% sparsity, past the 3x ceiling of standard gating; RELU-fication, meanwhile, plateaus below 80% sparsity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 model casting：一种 mid-training 配方，把 FFN 激活大幅稀疏化，推理时先算 gating 矩阵输出，靠高稀疏跳过另外两个矩阵，FLOP 最多降 3 倍；再用低参数量的 LoPA Gating 突破该 3 倍上限。在匹配质量下 LoPA Casting 达 3.2x FLOP 加速（top-p 与 TEAL 最好仅 1.6x），专用 kernel 在 90% 稀疏度下 GPU 实测 3.31x。
Motivation: FFN 占 Transformer 推理算力大头，现有剪枝与 RELU-fication 方案在匹配质量下加速有限，且标准 gating 存在 3x FLOP 上限。
Method: model casting 作为 mid-training 配方稀疏化 FFN 激活，推理先算 gating 矩阵并跳过其余两矩阵；LoPA Gating 用低 FLOPs 参数化 gating 矩阵、给它分配更少 FLOPs 与参数以突破 3x 上限；覆盖两条路径：对预训练模型施加稀疏激活的 casting，以及从零用 LoPA 训练。
Result: 匹配质量下 LoPA Casting 达 3.2x FLOP 加速，竞争方法 top-p 与 TEAL 最好 1.6x；专用 kernel 在 90% 稀疏度下 GPU 实测 3.31x 加速，越过标准 gating 的 3x 天花板；RELU-fication 在 80% 稀疏度以下即停滞；理论上限 3x，CPU 与 GPU 上均有显著实际加速。
Conclusion: 把稀疏性集中到 gating 并降低其参数量，可在保持质量的同时把 FFN 推理加速推到 3x 以上，超过现有剪枝与 RELU-fication。

papers.title: Extraction of clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports: a comparison between specialists and Artificial Intelligence
authors: Ana Paula Wernz da Cunha Müller
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women in Brazil, and the time between the request and the release of mammography reports directly influences adherence to screening, making the agility in processing these reports a critical factor for early diagnosis. In this context, this study compares the performance of a Large Language Model (LLM) with manual extraction performed by a team of health researchers in identifying clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports written in Brazilian Portuguese. Named Entity Recognition (NER) was applied through Prompt Engineering using a few-shot strategy, employing the Gemini 2.5 Flash model, selected from preliminary exploratory tests with four candidate models. The Gemini 2.5 Flash model demonstrated the best performance, achieving a Macro F1 of 0.91 and a Micro F1 of 0.98. The subjective validation, in which 29 exams of different formats were evaluated by health researchers using a Likert scale, yielded an agreement index of 93.1%. The model outperformed human extraction in overall Macro F1 (0.91 vs. 0.72), as in four reports the model correctly identified information that had been omitted or incorrectly recorded during manual extraction, demonstrating its potential as a complementary verification tool alongside specialists. The results confirm the hypothesis that LLMs, when instructed through Prompt Engineering, can achieve performance comparable to or superior to manual extraction by health professionals.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine

summary_sections.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash Macro F1 0.91、Micro F1 0.98；总体 Macro F1 对比人工抽取为 0.91 vs 0.72；29 例不同格式报告的 Likert 主观验证一致率 93.1%；有 4 例报告中模型正确识别人工遗漏或错记的信息。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经 Prompt Engineering 指令的 LLM 抽取临床发现可达到与健康专业人员手工抽取相当甚至更优的水平，适合作为专科医生旁的补充核验工具。

papers.title: Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence
papers.abstract_en: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, plus 25-page online appendix (included). Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 CNN 与 Fox News 2011–2021 年共 695,464 个图文片段做人脸识别分析，发现女议员更多出现在分屏而非单人镜头；两项预注册实验（6,220 名被试）显示，静态分屏会降低女议员而非男议员的政治能力评价，而动态视频中该惩罚消失，取而代之的是愤怒语言对女议员温暖度的打击约为男议员的三倍。
Motivation: 既有研究多关注女议员是否出现在电视新闻中，却很少说明她们被如何视觉框定，而视觉呈现直接影响观众对其能力与权威的判断。
Method: 先对 CNN 与 Fox News 2011–2021 年的 695,464 个图文片段做人脸识别与镜头类型（分屏 vs 单人）标注，再开展两项预注册实验，共 6,220 名被试，操纵镜头形式（静态/动态）与语言情绪，测量政治能力、温暖度与外部政治效能。
Result: 女议员在分屏镜头中出现的比例高于单人镜头；静态分屏使女议员的政治能力评价下降而男议员不受影响；动态视频中该能力惩罚消失，愤怒语言使女议员温暖度下降幅度约为男议员的三倍；单人镜头提升女性观众外部政治效能的证据为提示性（p = .057）。
Conclusion: 视觉框定既塑造女议员的媒介可见度，也塑造其被感知的能力：分屏的负面效应只在静态画面成立，语言情绪的性别不对称才是动态视频中的主要机制。

papers.title: SNIP++: Fine-Grained Symbolic-Numerical Alignment for Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical expressions and the numerical behavior they produce are two views of the same underlying function, and connecting them is central to scientific discovery. Symbolic Regression (SR) relies on this connection directly: it searches for an expression that reproduces a given behavior. Recent multi-modal models learn this connection by embedding symbolic expressions and their numerical behavior in a shared representation space. We show that this embedding space is only globally aligned: complete expressions correspond to complete behaviors, but the contribution of individual parts of an expression is not represented. This granularity gap leaves the model unable to tell how a local edit to an expression changes its behavior, the central operation in SR. We introduce a compositional alignment method that closes this gap: a structural positional encoding exposes the substructure of an expression to the encoder, and a multi-granularity contrastive objective grounds each subexpression in the behavior it produces before propagating this grounding to the full expression. The resulting representations close much of the modality gap between symbolic and numerical embeddings, reliably distinguish the effects of local edits that the original alignment cannot, and transfer to external SR corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SNIP++ 指出多模态符号回归 (Symbolic Regression) 模型的符号-数值共享嵌入只做到全局对齐：整条表达式对应整体行为，但子表达式的行为贡献没有被表示，导致模型无法判断局部改写如何改变输出。它用结构位置编码 (structural positional encoding) 暴露表达式子结构，配合多粒度对比目标 (multi-granularity contrastive objective) 先把每个子表达式锚定到其产生的行为再传播到整式，从而缩小符号与数值嵌入的模态差距、可靠区分局部编辑的影响，并迁移到外部 SR 语料。
Motivation: 符号表达式与其数值行为之间的对应是科学发现的核心，但现有共享表示空间只在整式层面全局对齐，粒度缺口使模型无法回答 SR 的关键操作——局部编辑如何改变行为。
Method: 提出组合式对齐方法 SNIP++：结构位置编码把表达式的子结构暴露给编码器；多粒度对比目标先将每个子表达式与其产生的数值行为对齐，再把该 grounding 传播到完整表达式，从而在符号与数值模态之间建立细粒度对应。
Result: 所得表示大幅缩小符号嵌入与数值嵌入之间的模态差距，能可靠区分原始对齐方式无法区分的局部编辑效果，并可迁移到外部 SR 语料。
Conclusion: 符号-数值对齐必须做到子表达式粒度，而不止于整式层面，才能支撑 SR 中判断局部编辑后果这一核心操作。

papers.title: Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains. We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.
papers.comment: A preliminary version of this work was published as an extended abstract in the Proceedings of AAMAS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AgentsNet 分布式协调基准上，用符号引导谱系 (Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy, SGT) 调节 LLM agent 的自主度：从开放式自然语言推理到完全照搬算法伪代码分档施加引导。中间档的部分伪代码引导在复杂领域中持续优于无引导 agent 和完全规定式规格，说明自主度调节是 LLM 分布式协调的关键设计原则。
Motivation: LLM 作为自主 agent 部署到多智能体系统时，能否可靠执行分布式协调协议尚不清楚；在复杂领域中给予完全推理自主权常导致表现不一致或退化。
Method: 提出 Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)，把 agent 自主度划分为从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定式算法执行的连续谱，中间档提供部分伪代码引导；在 AgentsNet 分布式协调基准框架上按档位施加引导并比较。
Result: 中间自主度档位持续优于无引导 agent 与完全规定式规格两类极端；评测在 AgentsNet 复杂领域上进行，摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 自主度调节（既不完全放任也不完全规定）是基于 LLM 的分布式协调的关键设计原则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model-Agnostic Online Certificate-Driven Calibration for Time Series Forecasting Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Time series out-of-distribution generalization requires forecasters to remain reliable when deployment dynamics differ from training conditions due to covariate shift, concept shift, and temporal dependence. Probably Approximately Correct Bayesian domain adaptation provides computable certificates by decomposing target risk into a source risk term, a source-to-target mismatch term, and a complexity term, but standard analyses rely on independent sampling and distributional stability, assumptions that are violated in time series by serial dependence and nonstationary shift. We propose a model-agnostic online martingale Probably Approximately Correct Bayesian framework that yields finite-sample certificates under temporal dependence and distribution shift. The certificate replaces independent-sample concentration with martingale concentration that adapts to loss scale and predictable variation. We use the certificate as a surrogate regularizer for online calibration by training a gated residual Bayesian head on top of a fixed forecasting backbone, producing a corrective update that reverts to the backbone prediction when the gate is closed. Online calibration combines a source risk anchor, a posterior-shift penalty, and a time-adaptive mismatch term computed from target windows observed before forecasting. It follows a predict-then-update protocol in which outcomes become available only after forecasting and are used to update subsequent predictions. Experiments across convolutional, attention-based, and large language model-based forecasters show improved stability and accuracy under covariate and concept shift.
papers.comment: Oral presentation at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Published in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), Vol. 337, pp. 2244-2273
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research, Vol. 337, pp. 2244-2273, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模型无关的在线鞅 PAC 贝叶斯证书，用鞅集中替代独立采样集中，在序列依赖与分布漂移下给出有限样本风险证书，并把它作为在线校准的代理正则项：在固定预报骨干之上训练门控残差贝叶斯头，按 predict-then-update 协议产生修正，门关闭时回退到骨干预测。在卷积、注意力与 LLM 三类预报器上，协变量漂移与概念漂移下的稳定性和精度均有提升。
Motivation: PAC 贝叶斯域适应证书依赖独立采样与分布稳定性，而时间序列的序列依赖和非平稳漂移恰好违反这两条假设，使原有证书在部署动态偏离训练条件时失效。
Method: 用鞅集中 (martingale concentration) 替换独立样本集中，构造随损失尺度与可预测变差自适应的有限样本证书；将证书作为在线校准的代理正则，在固定预报骨干上训练门控残差贝叶斯头，校准目标由源风险锚点、后验漂移惩罚与基于预测前目标窗口的时间自适应失配项组成，按 predict-then-update 协议在结果可得后更新后续预测。
Result: 在卷积、注意力以及基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的多类预报器上，该在线校准在协变量漂移 (covariate shift) 与概念漂移 (concept shift) 下均带来稳定性与精度的提升。
Conclusion: 把独立采样证书换成自适应损失尺度与可预测变差的鞅证书，并用门控残差头做在线校准，可让任意固定时间序列预报骨干在分布漂移下保持可靠且可回退。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs
papers.abstract_en: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CaptchaArena：首个面向交互式 CAPTCHA 求解的大规模细粒度训练数据集，含 50K 谜题、20 种 CAPTCHA 类型、5 种交互模式，每条解法经执行验证。用它训练单一 9B 策略 CaptchaAgent（SFT 后接 RL，环境验证器直接给奖励），SFT 达 70.5 Pass@1，RL 进一步升到 71.7，并同时提升两个外部基准表现。
Motivation: 现有交互式 CAPTCHA 数据集在类型覆盖、交互保真度与轨迹监督之间存在取舍，缺少可支撑 computer-use agent 训练的大规模细粒度监督信号。
Method: 构建 50K 谜题数据集，覆盖 20 种 CAPTCHA 类型与 5 种交互模式，每条解法经执行验证；提供 50K 截图-动作轨迹，其中 46K 带逐步推理标注，并为不规则目标提供像素级 mask 标注。训练 CaptchaAgent：单一 9B 策略覆盖全部 20 类，先监督微调 (SFT) 再强化学习 (RL)，奖励由环境验证器直接给出。
Result: SFT 达到 70.5 Pass@1，RL 进一步提升至 71.7；RL 同时改善了两个外部基准上的表现。数据规模为 50K 谜题、50K 轨迹（46K 含逐步推理标注）、20 类 CAPTCHA、5 种交互模式，策略参数量 9B。
Conclusion: 大规模、细粒度的 computer-use 监督（执行验证的轨迹 + 推理标注 + 像素 mask）足以训练出覆盖全部 20 类交互式 CAPTCHA 的单一策略，RL 在 SFT 之上仍有增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Transformer MLP Gate Thresholds Are Couplings to a Carried Reference Direction
papers.abstract_en: The corpus-mean direction of a transformer's residual stream is a component shared across all inputs, and is commonly removed by mean-centering before representational analysis. We present evidence that it is a functional component: the reference against which the MLP gate population sets its operating point. In Phi-2, an exact decomposition of resting gate pre-activations shows that at mid-stack layers the resting inhibition of >99.9% of gates is carried by the coupling $w \cdot b_L$ to the carried mean direction, at 48-56$\times$ the explicit bias parameter, and the coupling is direction-specific: a random direction at matched norm orders the population's firing rates at Spearman $ρ\leq 0.09$ where the reference reaches 0.95. (That 0.95 is near-tautological on its own; the paper derives its null.) Causally, removing the stream's projection on the reference multiplies above-threshold firing by about 9$\times$, dose-monotonically, at 23-59$\times$ a norm-matched control; a random-initialised twin is flat, and replacement tests show that the direction carries the function and the magnitude does not. A direction-matched control makes the same point: noise injected along the reference costs 8-42$\times$ the same energy along a random direction. The decomposition replicates on four further families spanning both gate types (GELU with an explicit gate bias, bias-free SwiGLU), and the dose-response on two of them. Across an eight-model scan the mechanism is present in every GELU and SiLU family and absent only in OPT, where an opposing LayerNorm bias cancels the carried reference. Gate thresholds are implemented as couplings to a constant the network builds for the distribution it is reading, with the bias parameters contributing little; how much of that constant is carried in the stream and how much in parameters depends on the architecture.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/EvidentSolutions/llm-interp/tree/main/background. An earlier version of this paper is archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21498411; this version supersedes it and corrects several reported values

TL;DR: 论文主张 Transformer 的 MLP gate 阈值不是由 bias 参数实现，而是残差流中携带的语料均值方向作为参考方向被耦合：在 Phi-2 中层，>99.9% 门的静息抑制由 w·b_L 耦合承担，是显式 bias 的 48–56 倍；沿该方向移除投影使超阈值放电约 9 倍、剂量单调，且方向携带功能而模长不携带。
Motivation: 表示分析通常把残差流的语料均值方向当作可去除的公共分量做 mean-centering，但若该方向实际承担 MLP gate 的工作点设定，去除它会抹掉功能成分，使后续分析与干预结论失真。
Method: 对 Phi-2 的 gate 预激活做精确分解，把静息抑制拆成 w·b_L 对携带均值方向的耦合与显式 bias；用方向匹配的随机对照、随机初始化孪生模型、方向替换与沿参考方向的噪声注入做因果检验，并在四个额外模型族（含带 gate bias 的 GELU 与无 bias 的 SwiGLU）上复现分解、在其中两个上做剂量响应，最后扫描八个模型。
Result: Phi-2 中层 >99.9% 门的静息抑制由 w·b_L 耦合承担，为显式 bias 参数的 48–56 倍；匹配模长的随机方向对放电率排序仅 Spearman ρ≤0.09，参考方向达 0.95。移除参考方向投影使超阈值放电约 9 倍、剂量单调，是模长匹配对照的 23–59 倍；随机初始化孪生无效应；沿参考方向注入噪声的代价是等能量随机方向的 8–42 倍。八个模型扫描中机制存在于每个 GELU 与 SiLU 族，仅 OPT 缺失，因其 LayerNorm bias 方向相反而抵消了携带参考。
Conclusion: gate 阈值由网络为所读分布自行构建的常量（残差流携带的参考方向）实现，bias 参数贡献很小；该常量有多少放在流里、多少放在参数里取决于架构。

papers.title: On-Policy Attention Linearization
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid transformer architectures that replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention offer transformer-level quality at a fraction of the memory cost. Rather than pretraining such models, a growing body of work distills them from already trained full-attention transformers. However, these distilled models often collapse on long-context retrieval and reasoning tasks, particularly when operating in thinking mode, where the efficiency gains of hybrid architectures matter most. Since linear attention layers must compress context into a fixed-size state, their errors compound over long sequences. As off-policy distillation never teaches the student model to recover from this drift, tasks that necessitate longer sequence lengths become especially challenging. We introduce On-Policy Attention Linearization (OPAL) in which the hybrid attention student samples its own long-context trajectories and receives dense supervision from the frozen full-attention teacher. Applying OPAL to Qwen3-4B and MiMo-7B-RL-0530, we recover $87$--$94\%$ of full-attention performance on commonsense reasoning, $100\%$ on needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) retrieval, and $83$--$93\%$ on mathematical reasoning with only 3B training tokens. We achieve these results without supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Compared with the strongest prior linearization method, which recovers $68\%$ of its teacher's retrieval performance and $21.6\%$ absolute average mathematical reasoning accuracy, OPAL fully recovers retrieval and achieves $67.6$--$72.2\%$ on math reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPAL 让混合注意力学生模型自己采样长上下文轨迹，再由冻结的全注意力教师给出稠密监督，以纠正线性注意力压缩固定状态导致的误差累积。在 Qwen3-4B 与 MiMo-7B-RL-0530 上，仅用 3B 训练 token、不加 SFT 与 RLVR，常识推理恢复教师的 87–94%、NIAH 检索恢复 100%、数学推理恢复 83–93%。
Motivation: 线性注意力蒸馏出的混合模型在长上下文检索与推理上容易崩溃，尤其在 thinking mode 下；off-policy 蒸馏从未教学生从固定状态压缩的漂移中恢复，序列越长越难。
Method: 提出 On-Policy Attention Linearization (OPAL)：混合注意力学生自行采样长上下文轨迹，冻结的全注意力教师对这些轨迹提供稠密监督；应用于 Qwen3-4B 与 MiMo-7B-RL-0530，训练不用 SFT 也不用 RLVR。
Result: 仅 3B 训练 token 下，常识推理恢复全注意力性能的 87–94%，needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) 检索恢复 100%，数学推理恢复 83–93%。对比最强先前线性化方法（其检索仅恢复教师的 68%、数学推理绝对平均准确率 21.6%），OPAL 检索完全恢复，数学推理达 67.6–72.2%。

papers.title: Simple Extensions of Single-Objective Acquisition Functions and Hedge Strategies for Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) is commonly approached through specialized acquisition functions or scalarization schemes designed to explicitly account for trade-offs among non-preferential objectives. In this work, we show that such complexity might be unnecessary. We propose a framework that extends standard single-objective acquisition functions directly to the multi-objective setting through a hypervolume-based transformation. We further extend hedge strategies for acquisition functions, which are typically used only in single-objective optimization, to the multi-objective regime. Our approach requires minimal modification to existing Bayesian optimization pipelines and avoids the need for bespoke multi-objective formulations. We demonstrate how a broad class of commonly used single-objective acquisition functions and hedge strategies can be adapted in a principled manner to handle multiple objectives, while preserving their intuitive interpretation and computational efficiency. Empirically, we evaluate the proposed methods across a range of synthetic and real-world multi-objective benchmarks. Despite their simplicity, our extensions consistently match or outperform more complex state-of-the-art MOBO methods in terms of optimization performance and sample efficiency. These results suggest that effective multi-objective Bayesian optimization can be achieved by reusing and carefully extending well-established single-objective acquisition strategies, offering a simpler and more flexible alternative to existing approaches.
papers.comment: Accepted in 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把单目标采集函数经超体积 (hypervolume) 变换直接推广到多目标贝叶斯优化 (MOBO)，并把原本只用于单目标的 hedge 策略一并扩展到多目标。在合成与真实多目标基准上，这套简单扩展在优化性能与样本效率上持续追平或超过更复杂的方法。
Motivation: MOBO 通常要为权衡非偏好目标专门设计采集函数或标量化方案，管线改动大；作者质疑这种复杂性是否必要。
Method: 用基于 hypervolume 的变换把标准单目标采集函数直接移植到多目标设定，并把 hedge 策略扩展到多目标；只需对现有 BO 管线做最小修改，无需定制多目标公式，同时保留原采集函数的直观解释与计算效率。
Result: 在一系列合成与真实多目标基准上，所提扩展方法在优化性能和样本效率上持续追平或优于更复杂的状态级 MOBO 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 有效 MOBO 可以通过复用并谨慎扩展成熟的单目标采集策略实现，为现有方法提供更简单灵活的替代。
