papers.title: BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BioDyad 用 Monte Carlo graph search 把生物医学证据获取与可执行程序搜索耦合成两条层级：科学层级用先验生物医学指导加迭代发现并把计划与执行结果写入记忆复用，工程层级让候选程序依次经过 smoke 执行、train/validation 评估到全数据重训。在 76 任务的 BioXArena 上、每任务两小时预算、三个匹配 LLM 后端下，它在四种 agent 方法与一个 one-shot 基线中取得最高的 penalized all-task score 与任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 生物医学 ML 系统只连接了证据获取与程序搜索的部分环节，新证据难以持续引导候选构造、执行结果难以反馈后续发现与复用，验证要求也难与搜索预算匹配。
Method: 在 Monte Carlo graph search 内嵌两套层级：科学层级融合先验生物医学指导与迭代发现，并把生物医学计划与执行结果关联进记忆供跨候选复用；工程层级把候选程序从 smoke 执行推进到 train/validation 评估再到全数据重训。
Result: 在 BioXAArena 的 76 个任务、每任务两小时预算、三个匹配 LLM 后端设置下，BioDyad 在每个后端上都取得四种 agent 方法与一个 one-shot 基线中最高的 penalized all-task score 和任务成功率。
Conclusion: 把生物医学发现与 ML 工程在搜索全程协同起来，能把外部知识整合进可执行程序，覆盖异质的生物医学任务。

papers.title: Cache-Aware Conv3D Lowering Across Embedded World-Model Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models can provide visual rollouts for embodied planning, yet their feasibility on edge devices depends not only on the learned model but also on how the execution runtime represents its operations. We introduce a cache-aware lowering that expresses supported causal Conv3D calls as batched spatial Conv2D operations while preserving pretrained weights, temporal-cache semantics, convolution parameters, bias placement, and output layout. Across the complete Cosmos3-Edge image-to-video pipeline on a 64-GB NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the proposed route accelerates VAE decoding by approximately $7\times$ and reduces complete-generation latency by more than $2\times$, while repeated decoder evaluations maintain complete fast-path coverage without fallbacks. The unchanged lowering also improves Cosmos3-Nano and transfers to LingBot-World's architecturally distinct Wan2.1 VAE. A clean-device comparison against fully specialized TensorRT shows that TensorRT provides a further $1.36\times$ steady-state improvement, but requires substantially greater per-module and per-runtime-state AOT specialization. Same-latent BF16 and FP32 evaluations characterize the finite-precision differences introduced by the alternative execution order. Together, these results position cache-aware lowering as a lightweight runtime optimization that recovers most of the available decoder acceleration without modifying the learned models themselves.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. ECCV 2026 workshop paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 cache-aware lowering，把世界模型解码器中的因果 Conv3D 调用改写为批量空间 Conv2D，同时保留预训练权重、temporal-cache 语义、卷积参数、bias 位置与输出布局。在 64GB NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上跑完整 Cosmos3-Edge 图生视频流水线，VAE 解码约加速 7×，整条生成延迟降低 2× 以上，且重复解码器求值全程走 fast path、无 fallback。
Motivation: 生成式世界模型要在边缘设备上做具身规划，瓶颈不只在模型本身，还在执行 runtime 如何表示算子；朴素执行因果 Conv3D 代价高，而完全特化的 TensorRT 方案需要大量 per-module 与 per-runtime-state 的 AOT 特化。
Method: cache-aware lowering 将受支持的因果 Conv3D 调用下推为批量 Conv2D，保持预训练权重、temporal-cache 语义、卷积参数、bias 放置与输出布局不变；在 Cosmos3-Edge 完整 image-to-video 流水线上验证，并用同 latent 的 BF16/FP32 评测刻画改写执行顺序带来的有限精度差异。
Result: 在 64GB Jetson AGX Orin 的完整 Cosmos3-Edge 流水线上，VAE 解码约加速 7×，完整生成延迟降低 2× 以上，重复解码器求值保持完整 fast-path 覆盖、无 fallback；同一套未改动的 lowering 也提升 Cosmos3-Nano，并迁移到架构不同的 LingBot-World Wan2.1 VAE。与完全特化 TensorRT 的干净设备对比中，TensorRT 稳态再快 1.36×，但需要显著更多的 per-module 与 per-runtime-state AOT 特化。
Conclusion: cache-aware lowering 是一种不改动学习模型本身的轻量 runtime 优化，能拿回解码器可用加速的大部分；相对 TensorRT 的残余差距需要用大量 AOT 特化换取。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Verification as an Architectural Layer for LLM Agents: A V-Model Design, and a Pilot Study of Its Deterministic Core
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents built on the ReAct pattern concentrate four responsibilities in one model: selecting a strategy, choosing each action, formatting it, and judging whether the result is adequate. Nothing outside the generative loop can reject its output, so an agent that cannot make progress does not report failure; it runs until an external budget stops it. We propose treating verification as an architectural layer by adapting the V-model from software engineering: specification levels descend from requirements to individual steps, each level is paired with a dedicated verifier, a deterministic controller enforces every verdict, and only verification outcomes write to memory, so a rejection localizes the level that introduced the fault and an agent halts by declining rather than by exhaustion. Each verifier separates a zero-cost deterministic \emph{gate} from an optional LLM \emph{judge}, so the contribution and cost of each can be measured independently. We report a pilot implementing the acceptance- and unit-level verifier pairs, comparing five configurations that share one executor, tool set, and scorer and differ only in verification, on the four-hop stratum of MuSiQue with an 8B-parameter backbone. Across 47 executions, the two unverified configurations answered none of ten questions, every run ending at a step cap or provider token limit; the verified configuration without a planner answered eight and abstained on the rest. Deterministic gates produced eight of the nine observed corrections at zero marginal cost, and planning degraded performance once verification was present. These results characterize termination behavior, not accuracy at scale; we outline a twelve-month plan to complete and evaluate the full architecture, including the integration-level pair the pilot omits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把软件工程的 V-model 移植成 LLM agent 的验证架构层：规格从需求逐级细化到单步，每级配专属 verifier，deterministic controller 强制执行判定，只有验证结果可写入 memory，使 agent 以拒绝而非耗尽预算的方式终止。在 MuSiQue 四跳子集、8B backbone、47 次执行的 pilot 中，两个无验证配置十题零答对（均跑满步数或 token 上限），带验证无 planner 的配置答对八题并弃答其余；九次纠正中八次由零边际成本的 deterministic gate 完成，且验证存在时加入 planner 反而变差。
Motivation: ReAct 式 agent 把策略选择、动作选择、格式化、结果充分性判断四种职责压进同一个生成模型，生成回路之外没有任何东西能拒绝其输出，无法推进的 agent 不会报告失败，只会一直跑到外部预算耗尽。
Method: 将 V-model 的规格层级（需求到单步）各配一个专属 verifier，deterministic controller 强制执行每条判定，且只有验证结果写入 memory；每个 verifier 拆成零成本的 deterministic gate 与可选的 LLM judge，以便分别度量二者的贡献与成本。pilot 实现了 acceptance-level 与 unit-level 两对 verifier，五种配置共用同一 executor、工具集与打分器，仅在验证方式上不同。
Result: 在 MuSiQue 四跳子集、8B 参数 backbone、47 次执行中：两个无验证配置十道题一道未答，每次都在步数上限或 provider token 上限处结束；带验证但无 planner 的配置答对八题、其余弃答。九次观测到的纠正中八次由 deterministic gate 以零边际成本产生；验证存在时引入 planning 使性能下降。
Conclusion: 验证层能把 agent 的终止行为从预算耗尽改为主动拒绝，deterministic gate 是主要的低成本纠错来源；作者指出这些结果刻画的是终止行为而非大规模精度，并给出十二个月计划以完成并评估完整架构（含 pilot 缺失的 integration-level verifier 对）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ANaLOG: Anisotropic Native-Latent Operator Guidance for Solving Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Native-latent guidance is a recent paradigm for solving inverse problems with latent diffusion models. It replaces repeated evaluations of the image-space forward model, each requiring a decoder pass, with efficient guidance computed using a learned latent-space surrogate. However, existing methods apply guidance uniformly across latent dimensions, ignoring that measurements are informative only along certain directions and that the reliability of model predictions varies across inputs and timesteps. We propose ANaLOG, a framework for efficient uncertainty-aware guidance with pretrained latent diffusion models. ANaLOG models uncertainty by learning an anisotropic, input- and time-dependent covariance that is integrated into the guidance mechanism to emphasize reliable directions and downweight uncertain ones. We theoretically analyze this framework in a linear model setting and prove that anisotropic, uncertainty-aware weighting is necessary for correct sampling, whereas isotropic guidance induces sampling errors. Experiments across five challenging inverse problems show that ANaLOG improves perceptual reconstruction quality over existing methods while preserving efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ANaLOG 针对 latent diffusion 求解逆问题时原生-潜空间引导 (native-latent guidance) 各向同性加权的问题，学习一个随输入与时间步变化的各向异性协方差，把引导权重集中到可靠方向、压低不确定方向。在线性模型设定下证明各向异性不确定性加权对正确采样是必要的，而各向同性引导会引入采样误差；在五个逆问题上提升感知重建质量并保持效率。
Motivation: 现有 native-latent guidance 在所有潜变量维度上均匀施加引导，忽略了测量只在某些方向上有信息、且模型预测可靠性随输入与时间步变化，导致采样误差。
Method: ANaLOG 为预训练 latent diffusion 学习一个各向异性、输入与时间步相关的协方差，并将其嵌入引导机制，对可靠方向加权、对不确定方向降权；同时在线性模型设定下给出理论分析。
Result: 理论结果：在线性模型中各向异性不确定性加权对正确采样是必要的，各向同性引导会诱发采样误差。实验覆盖五个有挑战性的逆问题，ANaLOG 在保持效率的同时提升感知重建质量（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 按方向与可靠性差异化地加权引导是 latent diffusion 逆问题求解的必要条件，而非可有可无的工程细节。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Resource-Aware Federated Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Pruning for Onboard Learning in LEO Satellite Constellations
papers.abstract_en: Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites are increasingly expected to perform onboard learning for applications such as disaster response and environmental monitoring. However, conventional federated learning (FL) is ill-suited to onboard satellite learning, as it assumes computational, memory, and communication resources beyond the capabilities of resource-constrained LEO platforms, often necessitating the transmission of raw imagery to ground stations. We present COSMIC-FL, a resource-aware FL framework for efficient onboard learning in LEO satellite constellations. COSMIC-FL introduces two complementary Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures: a Sliced design that shares backbone representations while activating task-specific channel subsets, and a Modular design that employs lightweight gating to route inputs to physically separated expert networks. A semantic class-to-expert mapping enables each satellite to train, update, and communicate only the expert paths relevant to its local data. To further improve efficiency, COSMIC-FL integrates staged optimization with three structured pruning strategies: server-side pruning, client-side fixed-ratio pruning with mean-vote aggregation, and adaptive client-side per-layer pruning based on aggregated importance and a MAD-based gap criterion. Combined with semantic expert routing, these techniques jointly adapt computation and model sparsity to both data semantics and layer importance, yielding a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for heterogeneous space platforms. Experiments on six image classification benchmarks under highly non-i.i.d. settings show that COSMIC-FL maintains competitive accuracy while reducing communication, computation, and energy consumption by up to 80% over SOTA FL methods. We further validate COSMIC-FL on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, confirming its efficiency gains under realistic embedded deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COSMIC-FL 把资源感知的 MoE 与结构化剪枝搬进 LEO 卫星星载联邦学习：Sliced 与 Modular 两种专家架构配合语义类-专家映射，让每颗卫星只训练、更新、通信与本地数据相关的专家路径，再叠加服务端剪枝、客户端固定比例 mean-vote 剪枝与基于聚合重要性和 MAD 间隙准则的自适应逐层剪枝。在六个图像分类基准的强非独立同分布设置下，相对 SOTA FL 方法通信、计算与能耗最多降低 80%，并在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上验证了嵌入式部署的效率增益。
Motivation: 常规联邦学习假设的算力、内存与通信超出资源受限 LEO 平台能力，往往被迫把原始影像回传地面站，星载学习难以落地。
Method: 提出 COSMIC-FL：两种互补 MoE 架构（Sliced 共享骨干表征并激活任务特定通道子集；Modular 用轻量 gating 把输入路由到物理分离的专家网络），配合语义类-专家映射；再以分阶段优化串联三种结构化剪枝——服务端剪枝、客户端固定比例剪枝加 mean-vote 聚合、基于聚合重要性与 MAD 间隙准则的客户端自适应逐层剪枝，使计算与稀疏度同时适配数据语义和层重要性。
Result: 在六个图像分类基准、高度非独立同分布 (non-i.i.d.) 设置下，COSMIC-FL 保持有竞争力的准确率，同时相对 SOTA FL 方法将通信、计算与能耗最多降低 80%；并在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上验证了真实嵌入式部署约束下的效率增益。
Conclusion: 把专家路由与逐层自适应剪枝绑定到数据语义和层重要性，可在异构 LEO 平台上取得有利的准确率-效率折中，星载学习不必回传原始影像。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Artificial Neural Network Assisted Modelling of Tangent Galvanometer Measurements for the Determination of Horizontal Component of Earth's Magnetic Field
papers.abstract_en: The Tangent Galvanometer (TG) is a standard undergraduate laboratory experiment for estimating the horizontal component of Earth's magnetic field (BH) by measuring the angle of deflection of a magnetic needle corresponding to the current flowing through a circular coil. In this study, an artificial neural network (ANN) is used as a complementary data-driven model to predict the value of BH. A dataset comprising 225 observations obtained using 50-turn and 500-turn coils was used for developing the ANN model. After quality control, 223 observations were retained and divided into training (70%), validation (15%), and testing (15%) subsets. The model was optimized using a feed-forward neural network with Tanh activation. Three different models (Models A, B, and C) with different input variables were compared for optimum performance. Model C used five input variables: current, deflection angle, tan(theta), magnetic field produced by the coil, and number of turns. The addition of tan(theta) produced a substantial improvement in prediction performance, which was further improved by including the magnetic field produced by the coil. Model C gave the best test performance, with R2 = 0.99053, RMSE = 0.54076 microT, and MAE = 0.32940 microT. The experimental and ANN-predicted values of BH were also compared with an adopted local geomagnetic reference value of 39.0 microT. The mean experimental and ANN-predicted values were 37.38898 microT and 37.32161 microT, respectively. The results demonstrate the usefulness of ANN as a complementary tool for analyzing experimental variability and nonlinear relationships in an undergraduate physics laboratory experiment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在本科切线电流计 (Tangent Galvanometer) 实验中，用前馈 ANN 作为数据驱动的补充模型预测地磁场水平分量 BH，Model C 加入 tan(theta) 与线圈磁场后测试集 R²=0.99053、RMSE=0.54076 μT。ANN 预测均值 37.32161 μT 与实验均值 37.38898 μT 都接近本地参考值 39.0 μT，说明 ANN 可用于分析该教学实验的非线性关系与实验变异。
Motivation: 切线电流计测 BH 时读数受电流、偏转角等多变量非线性耦合影响，传统单一公式处理难以刻画实验变异，需要一个数据驱动的补充建模手段。
Method: 用 50 匝与 500 匝线圈采集 225 条观测，质控后保留 223 条，按 70%/15%/15% 划分训练、验证、测试；采用 Tanh 激活的前馈神经网络，比较三种输入组合，Model C 输入电流、偏转角、tan(theta)、线圈产生的磁场、匝数共五个变量。
Result: Model C 测试集 R²=0.99053、RMSE=0.54076 μT、MAE=0.32940 μT，为三模型中最佳；加入 tan(theta) 带来显著提升，再加入线圈磁场进一步改善。实验均值 37.38898 μT、ANN 预测均值 37.32161 μT，对照本地地磁参考值 39.0 μT。

papers.title: Recipe-Matching, Not Equivalence
papers.abstract_en: MathNet-Retrieve asks a retriever to find, for a math problem, a document stating the same problem. An LLM under one fixed prompt writes each gold document and its near-miss distractors; LLM judges filter them. We call this procedure the "recipe", training on pairs built the same way "recipe-matching", and ask how much score it buys beyond the ability the benchmark claims to test. Two models from one base, matched in rows and settings, differ only in the training file: pairs written under the benchmark's published prompt by another vendor's LLM and judge, or computer-algebra-verified pairs with no LLM anywhere. The first leads by 45 R@1 points on the easy tier. By a non-LLM paraphrase control, half to two thirds of that gap comes from the pairs being LLM-written at all: LLM rewrites under two unrelated prompts, with the verified model's negatives, recover 30 and 22 of the 45 points; back-translations with the same negatives recover almost none. The remaining 15 to 25 points appear only under the benchmark's own prompt and vanish on real duplicates no generator wrote, the same problem in two languages. The hard tier rewards the recipe's pair structure, a deep rewrite against a minimal-edit near-miss: LLM rewrites alone score zero on it, attaching negatives unlocks it, and every negative that does so costs cross-language points; the sets scoring highest on it separate near-misses no LLM wrote worse than LLM rewrites with verified negatives. MELD also moves when a model trains on pairs built its way, without losing retention; on SABER-Math the registered attack fails, and the one gain, from its LLM-written summaries, is small but holds at a matched budget. Only on MathNet-Retrieve could we pin an inversion, benchmark score up and real retention down, to one edit of a training file. We release the generator-free duplicate evaluations, the near-miss test and three trained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MathNet-Retrieve 的训练对由 LLM 按基准发布的 prompt 写成正例与近失负例再经 LLM 判别，作者把这套流程称为 recipe，检验它买到的分数有多少超出基准声称的能力。同基座、同行数与设置、只换训练文件的两个模型，用基准 prompt 训练的领先 45 个 R@1 点（easy tier）；非 LLM 改写对照显示其中一半到三分之二来自“对子本身是 LLM 写的”，回译几乎不恢复分数，剩下 15–25 点只在基准自家 prompt 下出现、在无人生成器写过的真实重复上消失。
Motivation: 检索基准的训练对常由 LLM 按固定 prompt 生成并由 LLM 判别，分数提升可能来自复现这套生成流程而非基准声称的去重/检索能力，需要把两者拆开。
Method: 同一 base 的两个模型，行数与设置对齐，只换训练文件：一份是按基准公开 prompt 由他家 LLM 与 judge 写的对子，一份是计算机代数验证、全程无 LLM 的对子；再加非 LLM 改写对照（两个无关 prompt 的 LLM 改写、同负例的回译）与跨语言真实重复测试，并在 MELD、SABER-Math 上检验迁移。
Result: easy tier 上基准 prompt 训练领先 45 个 R@1 点；LLM 改写在两个无关 prompt 下分别恢复 45 点中的 30 与 22 点，回译几乎为零，剩余 15–25 点仅在基准 prompt 下出现且在真实重复上消失。hard tier 上纯 LLM 改写得分为零，挂上负例才解锁，且每个解锁负例都损失跨语言分数；MELD 在按其配方构造对子训练时也移动且不损失 retention，SABER-Math 上注册攻击失败、唯一增益来自其 LLM 写的摘要且在匹配预算下成立。
Conclusion: 基准分数的相当部分是 recipe-matching 的产物而非被测能力：只有 MathNet-Retrieve 上能把“分数升、真实 retention 降”的反转定位到训练文件的一处编辑；作者发布无生成器的重复评测、近失测试与三个训练模型。

papers.title: Vibe Analysis: Exploring LLM Adoption by Data Visualization Practitioners
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are enticing in their promise to support data visualization (Vis) through faster and simpler workflows for data prep, analysis, and visualization creation. Yet LLMs are notoriously error-prone and not built for data visualization tasks. Few studies have explored LLM adoption among Vis practitioners. To fill this gap, we conducted semi-structured interviews with members of the Data Visualization Society, a global community of data visualization designers. Our findings show that Vis designers actively use LLMs for both creative and technical aspects of the visualization process. A new visualization workflow is emerging, a process we call vibe analysis, analogous to vibe coding. Some key challenges raised by participants parallel those of vibe coding, while others are Vis-specific, like gaps in Vis knowledge and chart verification. This work opens up opportunities for research combining LLM-mediated work with Vis tools that incorporate data visualization guidance, constraints, and best practices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Data Visualization Society 成员做半结构化访谈，发现可视化设计师已把 LLM 用于可视化流程的创意与技术环节，并形成一种类似 vibe coding 的新工作流，作者称之为 vibe analysis。参与者提出的挑战一部分与 vibe coding 同构，另一部分是可视化特有知识缺口与图表核验问题。
Motivation: LLM 易出错且并非为可视化任务设计，而可视化从业者如何采用 LLM 几乎没有实证研究，这一采纳过程与特有障碍缺乏刻画。
Method: 对 Data Visualization Society（全球数据可视化设计师社群）成员开展半结构化访谈，从访谈中归纳 LLM 在可视化流程中的使用方式与挑战类别。
Result: 访谈显示设计师在可视化流程的创意与技术两方面都主动使用 LLM；识别出一种新兴工作流 vibe analysis；挑战分为与 vibe coding 平行的通用问题和可视化特有问题（可视化知识缺口、chart verification）。
Conclusion: LLM 介导的可视化工作已经实际发生且自成工作流，后续研究机会在于把数据可视化指导、约束与最佳实践嵌入可视化工具。

papers.title: Overview of the TREC 2025 Million Large Language Models track
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI envisions ecosystems of intelligent agents collaboratively solving complex tasks with minimal human intervention. In such ecosystems, each agent possesses specialized expertise, making effective expert selection central to overall system performance. While most current approaches assume a small number of well-documented models, real-world expertise is far more diverse and cannot be adequately captured through static metadata or hand-written descriptions. We anticipate a future with millions of specialized language models (LLMs), each excelling in different domains or problem types. Rather than relying on predefined capability statements, we propose a retrieval-based paradigm in which an assistant agent infers expertise dynamically by examining models' observable behavior. Upon receiving a user query, the assistant ranks candidate LLMs based on demonstrated competence, enabling efficient and adaptive expert selection. The TREC Million LLM Track operationalizes this paradigm by shifting the retrieval target from documents to expert LLMs. Participants are given a discovery set consisting of queries, answers, and log-probabilities from more than one thousand LLMs and are challenged to infer meaningful expertise representations for each model. Given an unseen test query, systems must then rank the LLMs according to their expected performance, providing the first large-scale benchmark for expertise retrieval in agentic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TREC 2025 Million Large Language Models Track 把检索目标从文档换成专家 LLM：给定一千多个模型在发现集上的查询、回答与 log-probabilities，系统需为每个模型推断能力表示，并对未见测试查询按预期表现排序候选 LLM。这是 agentic AI 专长检索 (expertise retrieval) 的首个大规模基准。
Motivation: Agentic 生态中专家选择决定整体性能，但真实世界的专业能力远比少量静态元数据或手写描述多样，无法预先枚举模型能力。
Method: 提出基于检索的范式：助手 agent 不依赖预定义能力声明，而是考察候选模型的可观测行为（发现集含查询、回答、log-probabilities，覆盖一千多个 LLM）动态推断专长表示，再对测试查询排序模型。
Result: 构建发现集：超过一千个 LLM 的查询、回答与 log-probabilities；系统任务为对未见测试查询按预期表现排序 LLM，构成 agentic AI 专长检索的首个大规模基准。
Conclusion: 在百万级专用 LLM 的未来图景下，专家选择应改为从可观测行为检索排序，而非依赖静态元数据描述。

papers.title: ROTE: Benchmarking Neural Memorization on Complexity-Controlled Symbolic Sequences
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ROTE (RollOut Testing of Exact memorization), a benchmarking protocol for evaluating symbolic memorization of neural architectures. We study memorization and the extension of symbolic rules in neural sequence models by using sequences whose complexity is regulated by Lempel--Ziv--Welch (LZW) compression. Under ROTE, each architecture is trained as the same finite-context conditional predictor and is evaluated using teacher-forced one-step prediction as well as closed-loop rollout on the withheld symbols. Following a shared prediction-and-rollout evaluation routine, the benchmark evaluates gated recurrent, minimal recurrent, attention-based, and hybrid recurrent-attention models with their native computational characteristics preserved. Beyond standard predictive metrics, the benchmark reports normalized string distances, training time, memory usage, and parameter count across an LZW-complexity sweep. The study establishes a connection between the complexity of algorithmic sequences and the memorization capacity of neural architectures, revealing the trade-offs involving memorization quality, rollout stability, and computational expense. Our software and reproducible experimental code can be obtained from https://github.com/nla-group/rote.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROTE 用 LZW 压缩率控制符号序列复杂度，把各类神经序列模型统一当作有限上下文条件预测器，用 teacher-forced 单步预测加闭环 rollout 评测符号记忆与规则外推。在 LZW 复杂度扫描下同时报告归一化字符串距离、训练时间、内存与参数量，揭示记忆质量、rollout 稳定性与计算开销之间的权衡。
Motivation: 神经架构在符号序列上的记忆容量缺少统一、复杂度可控的评测协议，不同模型的原生计算特性也难以在同一流程下公平比较。
Method: 用 Lempel–Ziv–Welch (LZW) 压缩调节序列复杂度；每个架构训练为同一有限上下文条件预测器，按共享的预测加 rollout 流程在保留符号上评测，覆盖门控循环、极简循环、注意力与循环-注意力混合模型，并保留各自原生计算特性。
Result: 在 LZW 复杂度扫描上报告预测指标、归一化字符串距离、训练时间、内存占用与参数量；研究建立算法序列复杂度与神经架构记忆容量之间的联系，给出记忆质量、rollout 稳定性与计算开销的权衡关系。
Conclusion: 符号记忆能力应放在复杂度受控的序列上、连同 rollout 稳定性和计算开销一起衡量，代码与可复现实验已在 nla-group/rote 开源。

papers.title: Facial classification Using Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可在标准 CPU 上运行的混合量子-经典人脸识别流水线：图像经 gamma 校正、对比度增强与 PCA 后编码进八量子比特变分量子分类器，再由经典图像匹配完成识别。在 50,000 张图像（CelebA 25,000 张人脸 + CIFAR-10 25,000 张非人脸）上，其准确率与训练效率超过所报告的 CPU 训练 FaceNet 基线，CPU 单人推理 0.2–0.5 秒。
Motivation: 资源受限场景下的面部生物识别中，混合量子方法研究很少，且需要在不依赖专用硬件的前提下验证可行性。
Method: 预处理为 gamma 校正、对比度增强与 PCA；特征编码进八量子比特变分量子分类器 (variational quantum classifier)，识别由经典图像匹配完成；在 CPU、GPU 与量子硬件上运行，并在 Mahindra University 与 Lloyds Technology Centre 合作的考勤部署中测试。

Conclusion: 混合量子人脸识别可在现有 CPU 硬件上部署，无需专用量子设备即可支撑实际考勤应用。

papers.title: PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.
papers.comment: Preprint. 14 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/jianhai-zhang/RredRA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PredRA 把强配对医学图像翻译拆成可直接预测的确定性分量与残差中的随机分量：以确定性预测为基准，从残差里继续抽取确定性成分，并用全局标量控制随机精修的注入量，避免逐体素估计残差有用性带来的不确定性累积。在多个真实数据集上，该方案相对完整残差精修提高了对配对目标的保真度，同时保留生成模型的感知质量；参数量比同级 SOTA 少 1.4–11.9 倍（可训练参数少 3.1–26.2 倍），32 步 flow sampler 比匹配的 1000 步 DDPM 少 31.25 倍采样步数。
Motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中，纯确定性预测会抹平细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节却引入多余甚至有害的随机变化；逐体素判断残差是否有用并不可靠。
Method: PredRA 将基于残差的生成过程视为优化问题：以确定性预测为稳定参考，在生成精修中从残差继续提取确定性分量，并对残差精修的注入量做全局控制而非逐体素估计；推理用 32 步 flow sampler。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上，受控精修相对完整残差精修提高了对配对目标的保真度并保留大部分感知收益；相比显著更大的 SOTA 模型，总参数少 1.4–11.9 倍、可训练参数少 3.1–26.2 倍；32 步 flow sampler 相比匹配的 1000 步 DDPM 少 31.25 倍采样步数。
Conclusion: 医学图像翻译里残差细节应通过全局受控的随机精修回收，而非完全交给生成模型或逐体素裁量，这样能在更少参数与更少采样步数下同时守住保真度和感知质量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对胸片报告生成中 SFT 只优化词面相似、忽视临床正确性导致的幻觉，提出在 RL 阶段同时校验推理步骤与最终输出的框架：用解剖区域、边界框与区域级文本描述做视觉接地，并设计空间奖励与事实奖励。以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为基座，经领域 SFT、冷启动 SFT 与 RL 后，RL 带来 SFT 单独无法达到的增益，且联合校验推理与输出优于只校验其一；同时识别出多种 reward hacking 模式。
Motivation: SFT 以与参考报告的词面相似为优化目标，牺牲临床正确性，胸片报告幻觉严重；现有 RL 医疗工作只校验最终答案、忽略推理过程，而有缺陷的推理会拖累整体表现。
Method: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为基座，先做医学领域监督微调，再经冷启动 SFT 引入推理能力，最后用 RL 优化；奖励设计为空间奖励与事实奖励，通过整合解剖区域、bounding box 与区域级文本描述来校验推理过程，同时校验推理步骤与最终输出。
Result: RL 带来仅靠 SFT 无法达到的性能增益；联合校验推理步骤与最终输出带来的提升大于只校验其中任一者；在 RL 阶段识别出多种 reward hacking 模式；结构化 think trace 提升可解释性、便于临床审计。
Conclusion: 在胸片报告生成中，把推理过程与最终输出一起纳入可验证奖励的 RL 精炼，比只看答案或只做 SFT 更能抑制幻觉，但需同时防范 reward hacking。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedCode 让 LLM 在医疗计算题上先识别计算器、抽取输入变量，再生成可执行脚本交给确定性解释器做算术，从而拿到带单位的精确数值。在 MedCalc 与 ICU 计算数据集上做 SFT 与偏好训练（wDPO 自适应加权难分偏好对），LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B 的绝对准确率提升 20–30 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 在医疗考试与问答基准上表现好，但需要精确数值输出的医疗计算任务不可靠，而给药剂量、器官功能评估、预后评分这类计算支撑高风险决策，小误差即有临床后果。
Method: 框架 MedCode 训练模型生成 embedded executable code：给定临床情境识别相关计算器、抽取输入变量、产出脚本，把算术交给确定性解释器执行并返回数值、解释与单位。用 MedCalc 基准构建 SFT 与偏好数据集，另整理 ICU 场景计算任务数据集；提出 wDPO，自适应强调模型难以区分的偏好对。
Result: 在 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B 上实验，绝对准确率提升 20–30 个百分点；评测基于 MedCalc 基准与自建 ICU 计算数据集。
Conclusion: 把算术外包给确定性解释器的嵌入式代码生成，配合针对难分偏好对的 wDPO，能显著提高 LLM 医疗计算的精确数值正确率。

papers.title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmailBench 提出 206 个企业邮件与生产力场景（16 类任务），用类型化邮件 API、确定性合成 Enron 语料和 258 条静态断言加 211 条 LLM rubric 的混合评测协议评估八个 LM 配置。最佳配置仅通过 33.5% 场景，而其 99.7% 工具调用无 API 失败，说明工具调用有效不等于任务完成。
Motivation: 现有 agent 基准虽含生产力任务，但很少在自包含环境中围绕类型化邮件工作流展开，检索、状态变更、时序推理与多步协调的端到端能力缺乏统一评测。
Method: 构建类型化邮件 API 规范与 provider-neutral 命名，配确定性合成 Enron-inspired 语料；场景主题由交互原型的聚合任务意图遥测筛选。评测协议混合 258 条可执行静态断言与 211 条 LLM rubric，在固定单用户语料上跑八个 LM 配置。
Result: 206 个场景、16 个任务类别；258 条静态断言 + 211 条 LLM rubric；八个 LM 配置中最佳者仅通过 33.5% 场景，但其 99.7% 工具调用无观测到的 API 失败，且通过率在任务类别间差异显著。
Conclusion: 有效执行工具调用不等同于完成任务，二者之间存在明显缺口；作者把更广工具覆盖、多人格测试与重复运行评测列为后续工作。

papers.title: GT-VLA: Target-Conditioned Trace Guidance for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on robotic manipulation, but they often struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, configurations, and long-horizon settings. A key challenge is that VLAs overfit to training scenes and fail to follow novel language instructions. Off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs) often provide stronger generalization, but cannot directly control robot actions. To combine the common sense of VLMs with VLA control, we propose Guided Trace VLA (GT-VLA), a steerable framework that accepts guidance from an external generalist VLM through trace-conditioned action generation. GT-VLA uses a generalist model to identify semantic guidance for the current skill, converts this guidance into a 2D visual trace, and conditions its action policy on the resulting trace-rendered observation. This design separates semantic target acquisition, trace generation, and low-level action execution, allowing high-level guidance to propagate to robot actions. GT-VLA uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with skill-specific trace and action modules for robust execution. We evaluate GT-VLA on LIBERO and a physical robot platform, showing improved generalization over recent VLA baselines in both settings. The code and additional supplemental materials are available on our project website at https://ivaniz.github.io/gt-vla/.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Choir 把形式化数学项目拆成可由独立贡献者各自完成的任务，每人用自己的 agent 和 LLM 订阅，仅通过项目 GitHub 仓库协调，合并前每份贡献都过确定性检查门 (deterministic gate)。协议支持 Lean 4、Isabelle 与 Rocq，开源且模块化，可替换组件或扩展。
Motivation: 当前自动形式化 (autoformalization) 工作高度集中：单个团队运行全部 agent 并独自承担全部算力成本，阻碍开放参与。
Method: Choir 作为开放协议，将项目分解为独立任务，贡献者各自运行 agent 经 GitHub 仓库协调；每份贡献在合并前由确定性 gate 校验，协议支持 Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq，开源且模块化，各组件可替换或扩展。
Result: 提出并开源 Choir 协议本身：任务分解 + GitHub 协调 + 确定性合并前检查，覆盖 Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq 三个证明助手，组件可替换可扩展。
Conclusion: 自动形式化可以走出单团队集中模式，靠确定性校验门在开放、多方独立贡献的流程下保证合并质量。

papers.title: Understanding the Synergy between SFT, RLVR, and OPD in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM post-training composes supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), and on-policy distillation (OPD) into multi-stage pipelines, yet these stages are typically designed and evaluated in isolation. We show that this composition is consequential: a stage that improves the current model can make the next stage less effective. Through controlled experiments with Qwen3 models on math and science reasoning, we first characterize OPD across nine student-teacher pairs spanning 2x to 53x parameter ratios and show that OPD effectiveness depends on student-teacher compatibility rather than teacher scale alone. The surrounding stages of OPD reshape this compatibility in three ways: (1) A brief SFT warm-up improves subsequent OPD, while an RLVR-strengthened student regresses under distillation from the same teacher. (2) Adapting the teacher with RLVR raises downstream OPD accuracy in proportion to the capability it adds. Following these two interventions, we find that combining teacher adaptation and student warm-up alone raise average OPD accuracy from 29.2\% to 43.8\% (50\% relative improvement) after the same number of distillation steps, with additional preparatory training. (3) At comparable accuracy, OPD leaves a stronger initialization for downstream RLVR than SFT, with a gap that widens as RL compute scales. Our results suggest that each post-training stage should be chosen not only for the capability it adds, but for the learning interface it creates for the next stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用受控实验表明 LLM 后训练中 SFT、RLVR、OPD 的阶段顺序会互相改写效果：短 SFT 热身让后续 OPD 变好，而被 RLVR 强化的学生在同一教师的蒸馏下反而退化；教师做 RLVR 适配则按其新增能力等比例抬高下游 OPD 准确率。两者叠加在相同蒸馏步数下把平均 OPD 准确率从 29.2% 提到 43.8%（相对提升 50%）。作者主张选阶段时不仅看它加了什么能力，还要看它给下一阶段留下的 learning interface。
Motivation: SFT、RLVR、OPD 通常被孤立设计与评估，但一个能改进当前模型的阶段可能让下一阶段更难奏效，多阶段流水线的组合方式本身是被忽略的设计变量。
Method: 在 Qwen3 系列模型上做数学与科学推理的受控实验，先在 9 组学生-教师配对（参数比 2x 到 53x）上刻画 OPD，再分别施加 SFT 热身、学生 RLVR 强化、教师 RLVR 适配三种干预，比较相同蒸馏步数下的 OPD 准确率，并在可比准确率下比较 OPD 与 SFT 作为下游 RLVR 初始化的表现。
Result: OPD 有效性取决于学生-教师兼容性而非教师规模本身；9 组配对覆盖 2x–53x 参数比。短 SFT 热身改善后续 OPD，RLVR 强化的学生在同一教师下蒸馏退化；教师 RLVR 适配按新增能力等比例提升下游 OPD。教师适配加学生热身的组合在相同蒸馏步数下把平均 OPD 准确率从 29.2% 提到 43.8%（相对提升 50%）。同等准确率下 OPD 留下的初始化优于 SFT，且差距随 RL 计算量扩大而拉开。
Conclusion: 每个后训练阶段应按它为下一阶段创造的 learning interface 来选，而不只按它自身增加的能力来选。

papers.title: MAESTRO: a Multimodal Auditory-attention Egocentric Speech-TRacking Open corpus
papers.abstract_en: Humans rely on gaze, head movements, and visual cues to attend to speakers in noisy environments, yet auditory attention decoding (AAD) has been studied primarily using electroencephalography (EEG). We introduce the Multimodal Auditory-attention Egocentric Speech-TRacking Open (MAESTRO) corpus, the first AAD dataset to simultaneously record EEG, eye gaze, pupillometry, egocentric video, and head inertial measurement unit (IMU) data. MAESTRO includes four competing speakers and background noise across multiple signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, enabling attention decoding under realistic listening scenarios. Through a four-speaker attention decoding benchmark, we show that combining behavioral and physiological signals improves decoding performance over EEG-only approaches, enabling future advances in multimodal auditory attention decoding. These findings open the door to new applications, analyses, and methodological advances in multimodal AAD. The complete dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/aspire-osu/maestro-eeg-dataset . The official code repository is available at https://github.com/ASPIRE-OSU/MAESTRO .
papers.comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAESTRO 是首个同时记录 EEG、眼动注视、瞳孔测量、第一视角视频与头部 IMU 的听觉注意力解码 (AAD) 语料，含四说话人竞争与多档信噪比 (SNR) 背景噪声。四说话人注意力解码基准显示，行为信号与生理信号融合的解码性能优于仅用 EEG 的方案。
Motivation: 现有 AAD 研究几乎只用 EEG，在四说话人竞争加背景噪声的真实听觉场景下缺少可同时刻画视觉与行为线索的多模态数据。
Method: 构建 MAESTRO 语料，同步采集 EEG、眼动、瞳孔、第一视角视频与头部 IMU，设置四个竞争说话人与多档 SNR 条件；并给出四说话人注意力解码基准，对比多模态信号融合与 EEG-only 输入。
Result: 四说话人注意力解码基准中，行为与生理信号结合的解码性能高于 EEG-only 方法；数据集含多档 SNR 条件，公开于 Hugging Face，代码在 GitHub 的 ASPIRE-OSU/MAESTRO 仓库。
Conclusion: 多模态（EEG 加眼动、瞳孔、视频、IMU）是比单 EEG 更有效的注意力解码输入，该公开语料可支撑后续多模态 AAD 方法与应用。

papers.title: Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning
papers.abstract_en: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NashEval 从离线反馈学习上下文相关的博弈均衡，用去偏的上下文化收益矩阵估计加正交损失 (orthogonal loss) 拟合上下文到均衡的映射，避免逐上下文单独解博弈。理论上 nuisance 函数估计误差只以高阶项影响所学均衡的 exploitability；实验中它提升均衡学习稳健性，并在各上下文下一致识别出表现最优的 agent 集合。
Motivation: Bradley-Terry 等打分模型强加传递偏好序，在人类判断异质时无法反映集体偏好；而离线日志中每个上下文只覆盖部分 agent，朴素估计量有偏。
Method: 把评估建模为社会选择理论启发的两人 contextual game，双方各选 agent 上的分布作为策略，Nash 均衡的支撑即上下文特定的赢家集合；NashEval 先构造去偏的上下文化收益矩阵估计，再用定制的正交损失学习上下文到均衡的映射。
Result: 理论上证明收益矩阵底层 nuisance 函数的估计误差仅通过高阶项影响所学均衡的 risk（exploability）；跨多项实验，NashEval 提升均衡学习的稳健性，并在各上下文下一致识别出 top-performing agents 集合。
Conclusion: 上下文相关的 agent 评估应按均衡学习而非传递打分来做，正交去偏使单一模型可跨上下文给出稳健的赢家集合。

papers.title: Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation
papers.abstract_en: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 建筑工地自动标注流水线（人体检测 + NLF 关节估计 + 姿态分组）的质量过滤会不成比例地丢弃跪姿、弯腰等低姿态样本，使其只占保留样本约 2%。四种独立姿态线索（边界框形状、垂直身体跨度、沿场景竖直方向的姿态分组、图像外观）一致显示低姿态被过滤器拒绝得更多；在控制边界框高度与站立者匹配的模拟场景中，用公开建筑数据集微调的检测器仍更常漏检这类人员。结论是长尾人体数据筛选不能只依赖边界框或姿态线索。
Motivation: 工地机器人需要识别跪姿、弯腰的工人，但自动标注中的质量过滤可能系统性丢弃这些低姿态样本，使长尾姿态在训练集中稀缺且难以找回。
Method: 考察一条流水线：人体检测 → NLF 姿态/关节估计 → 相似姿态分组，并审计其质量过滤（拒绝低检测置信度或关节估计不确定的样本）；用四种替代姿态线索交叉检验过滤偏差，另在受控模拟场景中测试检测器。
Result: 低姿态仅占保留样本约 2%；边界框形状、垂直身体跨度、沿场景竖直方向的姿态分组、图像外观四种线索均显示低姿态被过滤器更频繁拒绝；在模拟场景中，即便把低姿态人员的边界框高度校正到与站立者一致，用公开建筑数据集微调的人体检测器仍更多漏检这些姿态。

papers.title: CyberWorld: World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Cyber Defense
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning has become a prominent approach to autonomous cyber defense. Existing methods are predominantly model-free and consequently require extensive environment interaction. World models provide an alternative by learning predictive dynamics and optimizing policies through imagined trajectories, yielding substantial gains in sample efficiency in robotics and embodied control. Extending this paradigm to cybersecurity raises a fundamental question: what should constitute the "world" in a cyber world model? We introduce CyberWorld, a Dreamer-style world modeling framework that learns latent cyber dynamics from vector, graph, textual, and multimodal representations of the defended network. Across all four scoreable CyberWheel attack strategies, the graph-based CyberWorld variant exceeds a strategy-agnostic control after 3.6k-15.8k environment steps, compared with millions of steps required by model-free PPO. Across representation choices, graph structure provides greater robustness under topology-dependent attacks, while simpler representations remain competitive in overall performance. Among successful runs, the number of episodes required to reach the control remains approximately constant as network size increases from 15 to 100 hosts. These results establish learned cyber dynamics as a sample-efficient and scalable basis for autonomous defense, and identify world representation as a central design axis for robustness and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyberWorld 把 Dreamer 式 world model 用于自主网络防御，从被防御网络的向量、图、文本与多模态表示中学习潜在动力学，在想象轨迹上优化策略。图表示变体在全部四种可评分 CyberWheel 攻击策略上，仅用 3.6k–15.8k 环境步即超过与策略无关的控制基线，而 model-free PPO 需要数百万步；网络规模从 15 扩到 100 台主机，成功运行到达控制基线所需回合数近似不变。
Motivation: 自主网络防御的主流 DRL 方法是 model-free 的，需要海量环境交互，代价高且难扩展；把机器人与具身控制中 world model 的样本效率范式迁移到网络安全时，核心问题是网络防御中的“world”该由什么表示构成。
Method: 提出 Dreamer-style 的 CyberWorld 框架，从被防御网络的 vector、graph、textual 与 multimodal 四种表示中学习潜在网络动力学 (latent cyber dynamics)，并在想象轨迹上优化防御策略；以与策略无关的控制 (strategy-agnostic control) 和 model-free PPO 作对照，用 CyberWheel 攻击策略与 15–100 台主机的网络规模做检验。
Result: 在全部四种可评分 CyberWheel 攻击策略上，图表示的 CyberWorld 变体在 3.6k–15.8k 环境步后超过策略无关控制，而 model-free PPO 需要数百万步。表示对比中，图结构在拓扑依赖型攻击下更稳健，更简单的表示在总体性能上仍有竞争力。成功运行中，到达控制基线所需回合数随网络规模从 15 台增至 100 台主机近似保持不变。
Conclusion: 学习到的网络动力学可作为自主防御的样本高效且可扩展的基础，而 world 表示的选择是决定稳健性与可扩展性的核心设计轴：拓扑依赖攻击选图表示，追求总体性能可用更简单表示。

papers.title: NVAlign: Direct-Gradient Optimization for Non-Verbal Control in Continuous Autoregressive Flow Matching Text-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: While modern text-to-speech (TTS) systems generate highly natural speech and support inline non-verbal vocalization (NVV) tags, accurate control over these events remains challenging. A key gap is the lack of established post-training methods for non-verbal control in continuous autoregressive flow-matching TTS. To this end, we present NVAlign, a direct-gradient post-training framework for NVV tag-following in this architecture. We first perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of TTS models and an NVV-aware automatic speech recognition (NV-ASR) model on NVV-annotated speech, then freeze the NV-ASR model to serve as the reward model for post-training. A two-step gradient surrogate enables efficient reward backpropagation through the flow-matching sampler to jointly update the autoregressive backbone and acoustic flow head. Fidelity penalties and reference-velocity regularization help preserve speaker similarity and speech quality. Results from NVV-SuperBench and human listening evaluations show that NVAlign improves tag-following accuracy over SFT and Flow-GRPO baselines. These findings demonstrate that direct reward-gradient optimization can improve non-verbal control in continuous autoregressive flow-matching TTS. Audio samples are available at https://nvalign.github.io/.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Audio samples: https://nvalign.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NVAlign 为连续自回归流匹配 TTS 的非语言发声 (NVV) 标签跟随提出直接梯度后训练框架：先在 NVV 标注语音上微调 TTS 与 NV-ASR，再冻结 NV-ASR 作奖励模型，用两步梯度代理把奖励反传穿过流匹配采样器，联合更新自回归骨干与声学流头。在 NVV-SuperBench 与人工听测上，标签跟随准确率高于 SFT 与 Flow-GRPO 基线。
Motivation: 连续自回归流匹配 TTS 架构缺少成熟的非语言控制后训练方法，内联 NVV 标签难以被准确执行。
Method: 先对 TTS 模型与 NVV 感知的 ASR 模型 (NV-ASR) 在 NVV 标注语音上做监督微调 (SFT)，随后冻结 NV-ASR 作为奖励模型；两步梯度代理 (two-step gradient surrogate) 让奖励高效反传穿过流匹配采样器，联合更新自回归骨干与声学流头，并以保真惩罚与参考速度正则 (reference-velocity regularization) 维持说话人相似度与语音质量。
Result: 在 NVV-SuperBench 与人工听测评估中，NVAlign 的标签跟随准确率优于 SFT 与 Flow-GRPO 两个基线；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 直接奖励梯度优化可以改进连续自回归流匹配 TTS 的非语言控制，且无需改动采样器结构。

papers.title: FARE: Deep Reinforcement Learning For Fair Exposure Constrained Uncertainty Aware Financial Content Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Content personalization systems in financial services must ensure fair exposure across diverse offerings-a requirement driven by contractual obligations and the need to prevent "rich-get-richer" dynamics where content with high click-through rate (CTR) dominates while other relevant products receive minimal visibility. Share of Voice (SOV) constraints, which guarantee each content category a target fraction of top-position exposure, address this by promoting product diversity and balanced user discovery. While re-ranking layers atop CTR models are common in practice, we propose two key novelties: (1) framing SOV-constrained ranking as a deep reinforcement learning problem analogous to constrained trade execution in algorithmic finance, and (2) explicitly incorporating CTR prediction uncertainty into the agent's state space and policy design-enabling larger ranking adjustments for high-uncertainty predictions where deviation from CTR-optimal ordering is less costly. We introduce FARE (Fair Ranking Executor), a modular uncertainty-aware execution layer that translates any black-box CTR model's predictions into SOV-fair rankings without retraining the underlying model. Our uncertainty-weighted proportional control policy (FARE-PC) and learned neural policies (FARE-ES, FARE-PPO) demonstrate that uncertainty-aware approaches can substantially reduce SOV deviation from fairness targets while minimizing engagement loss, with gradient-free evolution strategies outperforming policy gradient methods on synthetic data and the ordering reversing on KuaiRand-Pure.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted to the Advances in Financial AI: Towards Agentic and Responsible Systems Workshop at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FARE 把 Share of Voice (SOV) 公平曝光约束下的金融内容重排写成受约束交易执行式的深度强化学习问题，并把 CTR 预测不确定性放进状态与策略：不确定性高时允许更大排序调整。合成数据上梯度无关的 evolution strategies 优于 policy gradient，KuaiRand-Pure 上顺序反转。
Motivation: 金融内容分发里高 CTR 内容会挤占头部曝光，形成 rich-get-richer；纯 CTR 重排层无法保证各内容类别的目标曝光份额，而合同又要求 SOV 达标。
Method: FARE 作为模块化执行层套在任意黑盒 CTR 模型之上、不重训底层模型：把 SOV 约束排序类比算法金融的受约束交易执行，状态空间显式纳入 CTR 预测不确定性；策略包括不确定性加权比例控制 FARE-PC 与学习型策略 FARE-ES、FARE-PPO。
Result: 不确定性感知方法显著降低相对公平目标的 SOV 偏差同时控制互动损失；在合成数据上 gradient-free evolution strategies 优于 policy gradient 方法，而在 KuaiRand-Pure 上两者的排序反转。
Conclusion: 把 CTR 不确定性写进约束排序的策略设计能改善 SOV 公平与互动损失的权衡，但用哪种学习策略更优取决于数据分布，ES 与 PPO 的相对强弱会随数据集翻转。

papers.title: Knowledge-Driven XRD Phase Identification via Multi-View Retrieval and Explanation
papers.abstract_en: X-ray diffraction (XRD) is a experimental technique for determining the phase composition and structure of crystalline materials. However, interpreting XRD patterns is challenging, particularly in high-throughput materials discovery, where many novel materials may need to be characterized and no reference patterns are available. Consequently, machine learning is increasingly used to accelerate and automate the analysis while reducing errors associated with human interpretation. We propose a multi-decision framework for XRD phase analysis that integrates representation learning, similarity-based retrieval, and explainable decision support within a unified reference database. A convolutional autoencoder learns compact latent representations of XRD patterns that preserve structural similarity while remaining robust to variations arising from experimental noise and measurement conditions. By integrating multiple decision pathways within a shared latent space, the framework moves beyond single-label prediction toward ranked and interpretable phase analysis that mirrors expert practice. During inference, complementary decision mechanisms are applied, including latent-space classification and retrieval, explanation-guided similarity using Integrated Gradients, and composition-based similarity search. These mechanisms generate ranked candidate phase lists that are aggregated into a final prediction with an associated confidence score. Experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate strong predictive performance, achieving 98.85\,\% accuracy for crystal system classification and 95.82\,\% accuracy for space group prediction on the test set, while maintaining robustness under realistic perturbations. The framework supports reliable, analyst-friendly identification of crystal phases and structures in high-throughput and exploratory materials discovery settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 XRD 物相识别的多决策路径框架：卷积自编码器学习保留结构相似性的紧凑隐空间，推理时融合隐空间分类与检索、Integrated Gradients 解释引导相似度、成分相似搜索，输出带置信度的排序候选相列表。合成数据测试集上晶系分类准确率 98.85%、空间群预测 95.82%，并在 realistic perturbations 下保持稳健。
Motivation: 高通量材料发现中大量新物相缺少参考衍射谱，人工解读 XRD 谱易出错且难以扩展，单标签预测也无法给出可解释的候选排序。
Method: 卷积自编码器 (convolutional autoencoder) 学抗噪、抗测量条件变化的 XRD 隐表示；推理阶段并行使用隐空间分类与相似检索、基于 Integrated Gradients 的解释引导相似度、以及成分相似搜索，三条路径在共享隐空间中聚合为带置信度分数的排序候选相列表。
Result: 合成数据集测试集上晶系分类准确率 98.85%，空间群预测准确率 95.82%，并在 realistic perturbations 下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把表示学习、检索与可解释决策放进统一参考库，可在无参考谱的高通量场景给出可靠且面向分析人员的物相与结构识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DOHF: Online Diffusion Fine-tuning with Doob's $h$-transform Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reward-based diffusion fine-tuning faces practical challenges when desirable outcomes are rare or conditioning corrections are costly to estimate. In this work, we propose Diffusion Online $h$-guidance Fine-tuning (DOHF), which turns Doob's $h$-transform into a practical online training algorithm. DOHF assigns optimality weights to generated samples, estimates the normalized local correction $\nabla\log h$ under the current rollout policy, and distills it directly into the generative model. Theoretically, we characterize the population-optimal DiffusionNFT update as well as the various classfier free guidance methods through a unified $h$-transform perspective. Methodologically, our framework accommodates black-box and non-differentiable rewards without additional network evaluations. We further show improved alignments under three empirical scenarios. Our work demonstrates how adapting probabilistic conditioning through inexpensive estimation and iterative distillation can improve generative learning across statistical sampling and visual generation.

papers.title: TemporalGraphLLM: Temporal Graph Neural Networks with Large Language Models for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic text-attributed graphs (DTAGs), where nodes, edges, and textual attributes evolve over time, are crucial in applications such as social networks, citation graphs, and knowledge graphs. However, existing approaches struggle to jointly model the temporal evolution of graph structures and the semantic richness of textual attributes. While Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) capture evolving node relationships, they often lack contextual text reasoning. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in textual understanding but struggle with structured graph reasoning in temporal settings. To bridge this gap, we propose TemporalGraphLLM, a novel framework that can integrate any temporal GNN with an LLM for enhanced reasoning in DTAGs. Our approach fine-tunes LLMs using graph-time-aware instruction tuning and novel temporal GNNs injection to replace dedicated added tokens with graph embeddings. TemporalGraphLLM effectively leverages pretrained TGNNs within an LLM framework to achieve state-of-the-art performance on edge classification, link prediction, and edge-based text generation tasks. Extensive evaluation on real-world dynamic graph datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance. Our findings highlight the synergistic potential of LLMs and TGNNs, opening new directions for learning on evolving graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TemporalGraphLLM 把任意 temporal GNN 与 LLM 拼接用于动态文本属性图 (DTAG)，用 graph-time-aware 指令微调并以图嵌入替换新增专用 token，在边分类、链接预测和基于边的文本生成任务上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 动态文本属性图中图结构的时间演化与文本语义难以联合建模：TGNN 缺上下文文本推理，LLM 在时序结构化图推理上吃力。
Method: 提出可接入任意 temporal GNN 的 TemporalGraphLLM 框架，通过 graph-time-aware instruction tuning 微调 LLM，并用 temporal GNN 注入的图嵌入替代新增的专用 token，从而在 LLM 内利用预训练 TGNN。
Result: 在真实动态图数据集上，于边分类、链接预测、基于边的文本生成三类任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: LLM 与 TGNN 可以协同：把预训练 TGNN 以图嵌入形式注入 LLM，是在演化图上学习的有效路径。

papers.title: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Risk Assessment of Traffic Analysis Attacks on Cloud LLM Services
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-based Large language model (LLM) services create a network-level traffic side channel that can expose model, prompt, and task behavior despite encryption. From packet sizes, directions, timing, and burst structure alone, a passive local observer can infer the serving model, the user's prompt category, and the task executed by a collaborative multi-agent system. Yet current evidence is fragmented across separate datasets and settings, limiting reproducibility and comparison. We present, to our knowledge, the first unified measurement study and public benchmark of encrypted LLM traffic across both user--LLM and multi-agent executions. The large-scale benchmark contains 60,000 user--LLM interactions across 10 models and 6 prompt categories, plus 2,838 multi-agent executions covering 10 task categories and two coordination topologies. Using only encrypted packet metadata, we assess the risk of traffic analysis attack by characterizing traffic signatures, identifying the features most associated with leakage, and testing robustness under prompt reformulation, decoding-temperature changes, larger candidate model sets, and partial traffic observation. Model fingerprinting achieves 97.7\% balanced accuracy, prompt-category fingerprinting reaches 76.7\% mean accuracy, and multi-agent task fingerprinting achieves up to 90.7\% accuracy. Prompt reformulation weakens but does not remove model-specific leakage, and task fingerprints remain detectable even from a single agent's traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 云端 LLM 服务在加密流量中仍泄露模型、提示类别与多智能体任务身份：仅凭包大小、方向、时序与突发结构，被动本地观察者即可做指纹识别。在 60,000 次 user–LLM 交互（10 模型、6 提示类别）与 2,838 次多智能体执行（10 任务类别、两种协调拓扑）的基准上，模型指纹 97.7% balanced accuracy、提示类别 76.7% mean accuracy、多智能体任务最高 90.7%；提示改写只削弱不消除泄漏，单个智能体的流量仍可检出任务指纹。
Motivation: 加密 LLM 流量的侧信道证据分散在互不相通的数据集与设置中，难以复现和横向比较，风险被系统性低估。
Method: 构建首个统一测量研究与公开基准，覆盖 user–LLM 与 multi-agent 两类执行；仅用加密包元数据刻画流量签名、找出与泄漏最相关的特征，并在提示改写、解码温度变化、候选模型集扩大、部分流量观测四种扰动下测试鲁棒性。
Result: 基准含 60,000 次 user–LLM 交互（10 模型、6 提示类别）与 2,838 次多智能体执行（10 任务类别、两种协调拓扑）；模型指纹 97.7% balanced accuracy，提示类别指纹 76.7% mean accuracy，多智能体任务指纹最高 90.7%。提示改写削弱但不消除模型特异泄漏，任务指纹在仅观测单个智能体流量时仍可检出。
Conclusion: 加密不足以保护 LLM 服务的行为隐私：模型、提示类别与协作任务在包元数据层面可被指纹识别，且对提示改写和部分观测具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COUNTERMEM 用可执行世界模型（测试、证明检查器、求解器）在失败动作后对原始状态的副本或重置做局部反事实分支，把「原动作—修正动作—校验结果—复用条件」存成跨任务记忆，再由学习到的记忆使用策略决定检索还是跳过。在 6 个领域 12 个基准上，gpt-oss-120b 下同时提升 ReAct 与 Reflexion，平均较未增强版本高 12.6 个百分点，任务运行 token 下降 7.7–42.0%。
Motivation: 现有 agent 记忆只从与真实世界的交互中构建，从不追问「换个动作会怎样」；而在活跃环境中直接获取这种反事实反馈代价高，且会破坏用于对比的状态。
Method: 失败动作后从原始状态的 copy/reset 出发，用可执行世界模型（tests、proof checkers、solvers）评估局部替代动作，存储改进项、原动作与修正动作、校验结果及复用条件；学习得到的 memory-use policy 在检索记录与跳过记忆之间选择以权衡任务成功率与交互成本，base LLM 保持冻结，评估阶段记忆与策略均冻结。
Result: 在 6 个领域 12 个 benchmark 设置上，gpt-oss-120b 下 COUNTERMEM 同时改进 ReAct 与 Reflexion，全部 12 个基准平均较未增强版本提升 12.6 个百分点；跨两个 backbone 的 4 领域对比中任务运行 token 减少 7.7–42.0%（不含离线 selector 训练开销）。消融显示去掉 verification 或 persistent storage 会削弱增益，把校验过的修正用于不合适的决策会反转增益。
Conclusion: 经世界模型校验的反事实记忆能同时提高语言 agent 的任务成功率并降低交互 token 成本，但增益依赖校验与持久存储，且修正必须只施加于合适决策。

papers.title: CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CueKFS 是面向长视频问答的免训练关键帧选择方法：把问题-帧匹配改写为帧与动态生成的视觉 cue 集的比较，由 reasoning VLM 以 agent 方式依据各 cue 的证据反复修订 cue 集并重新探索视频，最后把帧预算分配给存活的 cue。在三个基准共 27 个有可比结果的设置上全部取得 SOTA，预算平均增益最高 +4.54%，中位仅需两次 VLM 调用。
Motivation: 按与问题的相似度给帧打分会在问题混合多个主体或时刻、或依赖字面未给出的隐含信息时失效；把问题拆成子查询的方法又因初始上下文静态而分解不准。
Method: 训练-free 流程：从初始显著帧集合出发把问题分解为 cues，每个 cue 并发探测视频各自寻找证据，reasoning VLM 依据证据 agent 式修订 cue 集并重新探索，再把关键帧预算在存活 cue 之间分配。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 上于全部 27 个有既有结果的设置取得 state-of-the-art，预算平均增益最高 +4.54%（相对先前基线），中位只需 2 次 VLM 调用；行为分析显示 agentic cue 修订驱动对视频的主动再探索，相对相似度增益最高达 92%（相对初始上下文）。
Conclusion: 把长视频关键帧选择从静态问题-帧打分改成由证据驱动的动态 cue 修订，能在极低 VLM 调用预算下稳定提升长视频问答的选帧质量。

papers.title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
papers.abstract_en: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances. We present IndustryLLM, an open-weight industrial language model trained from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base (35B total parameters with ~3B activated per token, with the vision encoder frozen). Rather than relying on generic text scaling, we introduce a failure-driven adaptation recipe spanning continued pre-training (CPT) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). CPT leverages a curated ~100B-token corpus integrating 5B tokens of national standards (e.g., GB/T) and technical archives, 10B tokens of de-identified real-world industrial transaction and inquiry records, and 60B tokens of general replay. To overcome register mismatch and factual brittleness, we systematically reconstruct an estimated 20B-token domain subset via multi-register rewriting across 10 genres and 8 writing styles, confidence-routed minimal factual editing, and error-targeted QA synthesis (resolving colloquial typos like '42-luo-mu' -> 42CrMo, expanding ambiguous codes like '16674' -> GB/T 16674, and clarifying conflicting dimensional specs). For downstream deployment, we formalize an evidence-gated constraint-evaluation interface enforcing three-valued logic where unverified product evidence remains unknown rather than satisfied. Offline evaluations demonstrate consistent gains on procurement-query structuring (+2.97 percentage points in exact match, 95% CI [2.11, 3.86] in No-Think mode), while randomized online A/B experiments in production yield substantial improvements (+4.25% GMV, +8.3% satisfied inquiries) alongside a latency reduction from 6-7 s to 1.5 s. Model weights and configs are released at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Equity Trading: Benchmarking Actor-Critic Methods with Forward Retraining
papers.abstract_en: Consistently profitable trading is difficult because equity markets are noisy, non-stationary, and only partially predictable from historical data. We benchmark five deep reinforcement learning (DRL) actor-critic methods: A2C, PPO, DDPG, TD3, and SAC, that learn trading actions end-to-end from market states, and compare them with a supervised price-forecasting baseline. Using daily data for 20 large-capitalization S&P 500 stocks from 2000 to 2020, enriched with trend-following technical indicators and log min-max scaling, we train on 2000-2018 and backtest on 2019-2020. Each agent is evaluated both when trained once and under forward retraining, in which it is retrained on all data available before each successive test window. DDPG achieves the highest annual return (55.5%), Sharpe ratio (1.38), and alpha (0.22), but also the highest market beta (1.24). TD3 and SAC offer a better risk-return balance, with Sharpe ratios of 1.37 and 1.33 and maximum drawdowns of about 25%. Forward retraining improves A2C, PPO, and SAC, leaves TD3 essentially unchanged, and reduces DDPG's annual return from 55.5% to 29.8%, consistent with TD3's greater robustness to hyperparameters. The forecasting baseline has the smallest maximum drawdown (9.6%) and the lowest beta (0.31), underscoring a trade-off between the higher returns of end-to-end DRL and the lower risk of forecast-driven strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 20 只 S&P 500 大盘股日线数据上基准五种 actor-critic DRL（A2C、PPO、DDPG、TD3、SAC）与监督式价格预测基线：DDPG 训练一次时年化收益最高 55.5%、Sharpe 1.38、alpha 0.22，但 beta 也最高 1.24；改为 forward retraining 后 DDPG 年化收益跌到 29.8%，而 TD3、SAC 的风险收益更稳（Sharpe 1.37/1.33，最大回撤约 25%）。
Motivation: 股票市场噪声大、非平稳、仅部分可预测，端到端 DRL 交易策略在样本外是否稳健、与预测驱动策略的风险收益如何权衡，缺少统一基准。
Method: 用 2000–2018 年 20 只 S&P 500 大盘股日线数据，加入趋势跟踪技术指标并做 log min-max 缩放；对比 A2C、PPO、DDPG、TD3、SAC 五种 actor-critic 方法与一个监督式价格预测基线，2019–2020 回测；每种 agent 分别在只训练一次与 forward retraining（每个测试窗口前用全部可得数据重训）两种设定下评估。
Result: DDPG 年化收益 55.5%、Sharpe 1.38、alpha 0.22、beta 1.24（均为最高收益与最高 beta）；TD3 与 SAC 的 Sharpe 分别为 1.37 和 1.33，最大回撤约 25%；forward retraining 提升 A2C、PPO、SAC，基本不改变 TD3，却把 DDPG 年化收益从 55.5% 降到 29.8%；预测基线最大回撤最小 9.6%、beta 最低 0.31。
Conclusion: 端到端 DRL 换来更高收益但承担更高 beta 与回撤风险，预测驱动策略风险更低；DDPG 对超参和重训敏感，TD3 更稳健，选型应在收益与风险之间权衡。

papers.title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
papers.abstract_en: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that a leading state-of-the-art macro planner routinely emits physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the next best hierarchical approach while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Metro-WM 指出分层 JEPA 规划中无约束的潜在子目标生成会产出物理上不可实现的子目标，改为从离线经验帧构成的图上检索真实状态作为子目标并规划路线。长时域目标到达上，它比次优分层方法成功率最高高出 37.33 个百分点、速度快至 10.9 倍，离线计算少 13–56 倍。
Motivation: JEPA+MPC 的零样本目标到达规划只在短时域有效；分层宏规划器补上长时域，但其无约束潜在子目标预测会发出不可实现的中间状态，导致长程规划失效。
Method: Metro-WM 用图结构替代潜在子目标生成：顶点取自离线专家演示或随机动作轨迹的真实观测帧，跨 episode 连接帧并拼接成通往目标的路线；全图规划使微观规划器偏离时能立即从当前状态重寻最优路径。
Result: 长时域成功率比次优分层方法最高高出 37.33 个百分点，速度最高快 10.9 倍，离线计算少 13–56 倍且调参超参数更少；找到的路径比离线演示更短，胜过依赖查询自身演示的 oracle，并在极稀疏数据条件下保持稳健性能。
Conclusion: 子目标必须是可实现的真实状态而非自由生成的潜在向量；用经验图做检索式子目标规划可同时提升长时域成功率、速度与数据效率。

papers.title: AirLog: Store-Level Indoor Life Logging Made Easy
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents AirLog, a smartphone-based life journaling system that automatically reconstructs users' store visits in shopping malls and summarizes them into human-readable journals. Unlike conventional indoor localization systems, AirLog avoids labor-intensive radio-map construction and dedicated wireless localization infrastructure and algorithm calibrations. Instead, it repurposes two cues already available in commercial spaces: semantic information exposed by ambient Wi-Fi SSIDs and indoor directory images. AirLog converts directory images into spatial maps and fuses Wi-Fi semantic anchors with inertial dead reckoning to recover store-level trajectories, which are then summarized into journals by an LLM. Such store-level life logs can support applications such as personal memory recall, activity reflection, and automated diary generation without requiring users to manually record where they have been. We implement AirLog on commodity smartphones and evaluate it on both a large-scale public dataset and a self-collected dataset. The results demonstrate that AirLog substantially improves store-level region recovery, semantic matching, trajectory reconstruction, and journal quality over existing baselines. A human evaluation further shows that the generated journals are coherent and faithful to users' visits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AirLog 用商场内已有的 Wi-Fi SSID 语义锚点与室内导览图，配合惯性航位推算恢复店铺级轨迹，再由 LLM 汇总成可读生活日志，免去射频地图构建与专用定位基础设施。在公开大数据集与自采数据集上，店铺级区域恢复、语义匹配、轨迹重建与日志质量均较既有基线明显提升，人工评估显示日志连贯且忠实于用户到访。
Motivation: 商场内店铺级到访记录依赖人工射频地图、专用无线定位设施与算法标定，成本高且用户需手动记录行踪。
Method: 把室内导览图 (directory image) 转为空间地图，将 Wi-Fi SSID 语义锚点与惯性 dead reckoning 融合以恢复店铺级轨迹，再用 LLM 把轨迹汇总为文字日志；在商用智能手机上实现。

Conclusion: 商用空间中已存在的语义线索（Wi-Fi SSID 与导览图）足以支撑店铺级生活日志，无需射频地图与专用定位设施。

papers.title: Prompting Particle Physics: Tokenized Multi-modal Foundation Models for Combinatorially Many Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction and simulation at a collider experiment are long chains of specialised algorithms, each tuned to a single step. We explore how one model can serve many of those steps at once, while still producing the intermediate objects (tracks, calorimeter cells, clusters, particles and jets) that make the chain interpretable. To do so, we represent every object in a jet in a single shared token vocabulary and train one model to map any subset of these modalities to any other. A task is then only a choice of which modalities to provide and which to request: particle flow, detector simulation and charged energy subtraction are all directions through the same set of weights. We train over all modality combinations, with a decoder emitting tokens either autoregressively or in parallel. With tokenisation, both architectures train stably with little tuning. In evaluations, both models produce realistic reconstruction and simulation objects, with the autoregressive model particularly faithful to output from Geant4. The autoregressive model also outperforms a state-of-the-art particle flow algorithm on many typical jet reconstruction metrics.
papers.comment: 47 pages. Code: https://github.com/FM-for-HEP/hep-any2any ; data and models: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22917591
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把对撞机喷注内的所有对象（径迹、量能器单元、簇、粒子、喷注）放进统一 token 词表，训练一个 any-to-any 多模态基础模型：任务只是选择提供与请求哪些模态，粒子流、探测器模拟、带电能量扣除都由同一组权重完成。自回归版本在多项典型喷注重建指标上超过最先进的粒子流算法，并与 Geant4 输出高度一致。
Motivation: 对撞机重建与模拟由一长串各自调优的专用算法串成，每步一个模型，链条难以解释也难以统一维护。
Method: 用共享 token 词表表示喷注内每个对象，训练一个模型映射任意模态子集到任意其他模态；在全部模态组合上训练，解码器支持自回归与并行两种出 token 方式，任务由提供/请求哪些模态定义。
Result: 两种架构在 token 化后都训练稳定、几乎不需调参；评测中两者都产出真实的重建与模拟对象，自回归模型对 Geant4 输出尤其忠实，并在多项典型喷注重建指标上超过 state-of-the-art 粒子流算法。
Conclusion: 一个 token 化多模态模型可以用同一组权重覆盖对撞机重建与模拟链条的多个步骤，同时保留中间对象使链条可解释；自回归解码在保真度与重建指标上是更受青睐的配置。

summary_sections.motivation: 对撞机重建与模拟由一长串各自调优的专用算法串成，每步一个模型，链条难以解释也难以统一维护。
summary_sections.method: 用共享 token 词表表示喷注内每个对象，训练一个模型映射任意模态子集到任意其他模态；在全部模态组合上训练，解码器支持自回归与并行两种出 token 方式，任务由提供/请求哪些模态定义。
summary_sections.result: 两种架构在 token 化后都训练稳定、几乎不需调参；评测中两者都产出真实的重建与模拟对象，自回归模型对 Geant4 输出尤其忠实，并在多项典型喷注重建指标上超过 state-of-the-art 粒子流算法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 一个 token 化多模态模型可以用同一组权重覆盖对撞机重建与模拟链条的多个步骤，同时保留中间对象使链条可解释；自回归解码在保真度与重建指标上是更受青睐的配置。

papers.title: LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design
papers.abstract_en: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this \emph{overlap sparsity} is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5\% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25\% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65\%. The two actionable levers are overlap \emph{quantity} and \emph{allocation}. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $ρ\geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM-as-a-judge 校准中，标注重叠稀疏 (overlap sparsity) 是错误部署决策的一阶决定因素：5% 成对重叠时错误决策率达 25%，十个候选中选错最佳 judge 的概率为 65%。作者给出最小重叠公式，非边界 judge 需 ρ≥0.25 即可，分层分配在 strata 有信息时把错误拒绝率相对随机采样减半。
Motivation: 标注预算通常不允许每个样本多标，重叠不足会直接导致选错 judge 或错误拒绝，而现有校准流程缺少对重叠量与分配方式的定量准则。
Method: 从重叠稀疏出发推导错误决策率的理论刻画与最小重叠公式 (ρ≥0.25)，并提出零成本的分层 (stratified) 重叠分配方案；在 10 个 LLM judge、覆盖视觉评估、因果推理与摘要生成的四套评估矩阵上验证。
Result: 5% 成对重叠下错误决策率达 25%，十个候选中选错最佳 judge 的概率 65%；非边界 judge 满足 ρ≥0.25 即足够，边界情形本质上仍困难；strata 有信息时分层分配使错误拒绝率相对随机采样减半；验证覆盖 10 个 LLM judge 与四套评估矩阵。
Conclusion: 重叠的数量与分配是校准 LLM judge 的两个可操作杠杆：先把重叠提到 ρ≥0.25，再用有信息的分层分配，可显著降低错误决策与错误拒绝。
