papers.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Modern GUI-agent frameworks achieve strong desktop task performance with frontier API models, yet persistent control information often remains implicit in growing interaction trajectories. At each step, the planner reconstructs the active task stage, accumulated evidence, and runtime feedback before deciding the next action. This dependence becomes more pronounced under weaker local reasoning backbones. Across four representative state-of-the-art frameworks, replacing GPT-5 with Qwen3.5-9B reduces average OSWorld SR-100 from 60.9\% to 35.2\%. Trajectory annotation further identifies at least one control failure in 94.7\% of failed trajectories. To address this problem, we introduce LocalLSTC, a training-free architecture that organizes control by temporal scope, maintaining persistent cross-step state to guide short-term execution commitments. The framework comprises two complementary mechanisms. Long-to-Short Planning forms each commitment from persistent state, while Short-to-Long Control integrates execution outcomes back into that state for progress assessment, recovery, and termination. With Qwen3.8-27B, LocalLSTC reaches 73.7\% SR-100 on OSWorld and 68.5\% on WindowsAgentArena, achieving the strongest local OSWorld result and a new state of the art on WindowsAgentArena. Ablations further support contributions from both mechanisms. Together, these results show that temporal organization of control information can reduce cross-step control failures and complement backbone scaling in locally deployed GUI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LocalLSTC 用训练无关的长短期控制架构组织 GUI agent 的跨步控制信息：持久状态驱动短期执行承诺，执行结果再回写状态。在 OSWorld 上以 Qwen3.8-27B 达到 73.7% SR-100，WindowsAgentArena 68.5%，并称后者为新 SOTA。
Motivation: GUI agent 的任务阶段、累积证据与运行反馈隐含在不断增长的轨迹里，每步都要重建；换成较弱的本地模型后这一依赖被放大——GPT-5 换成 Qwen3.5-9B 使四个 SOTA 框架的 OSWorld 平均 SR-100 从 60.9% 降到 35.2%。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 架构，按时间尺度组织控制：Long-to-Short Planning 从持久跨步状态生成每个执行承诺，Short-to-Long Control 把执行结果整合回状态，用于进度评估、恢复与终止。
Result: 四个代表性 SOTA 框架中，GPT-5 换成 Qwen3.5-9B 使 OSWorld 平均 SR-100 从 60.9% 降至 35.2%；轨迹标注发现 94.7% 的失败轨迹至少含一处控制失败。LocalLSTC 配 Qwen3.8-27B 在 OSWorld 达 73.7% SR-100、WindowsAgentArena 68.5%，消融支持两个机制各有贡献。
Conclusion: 按时间尺度组织控制信息可减少跨步控制失败，与单纯扩大本地 backbone 规模互补，而非替代。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 训练无关 (training-free) 架构，按时间尺度组织控制：Long-to-Short Planning 从持久跨步状态生成每个执行承诺，Short-to-Long Control 把执行结果整合回状态，用于进度评估、恢复与终止。
summary_sections.result: 四个代表性 SOTA 框架中，GPT-5 换成 Qwen3.5-9B 使 OSWorld 平均 SR-100 从 60.9% 降至 35.2%；轨迹标注发现 94.7% 的失败轨迹至少含一处控制失败。LocalLSTC 配 Qwen3.8-27B 在 OSWorld 达 73.7% SR-100、WindowsAgentArena 68.5%，消融支持两个机制各有贡献。

papers.title: Convergence Guarantees of Gradient Descent for Neural Networks via Generalized Lipschitz Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: We establish the first convergence guarantees of gradient descent for general feedforward neural networks of any width or depth, with any initialization or dataset. We only assume that the activation functions are linearly bounded, Lipschitz continuous, and Lipschitz smooth---properties that hold for linear, tanh, softplus, sigmoid, and smoothed ReLU functions---and that the loss function is Lipschitz smooth in the model outputs, a mild condition satisfied by mean squared error and binary cross-entropy loss. By relating the Lipschitz properties of one layer to the next, we obtain a novel generalized Lipschitz smoothness condition for an $L$-layer neural network where the change in gradient is upper bounded by the change in the parameter space, multiplied by a polynomial of the parameter norms at both endpoints of degree $2L - 2$. This yields a descent lemma where the loss decreases as long as the learning rate is small enough with respect to the parameter norms. By ensuring that the leading term of the polynomial grows at a controlled rate, we prove that the minimum squared gradient norm converges to zero in $T$ iterations at rate $O(1/T^{1/L})$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明任意宽度、深度、初始化与数据集下前馈网络梯度 descent 的首个收敛保证：只要激活函数线性有界、Lipschitz 且 Lipschitz 光滑，损失对模型输出 Lipschitz 光滑，L 层网络的梯度变化被参数空间变化乘以两端参数范数的 2L−2 次多项式上界。由此得到的 descent lemma 要求学习率相对参数范数足够小，最小梯度平方范数在 T 次迭代内以 O(1/T^{1/L}) 收敛到零。
Motivation: 一般前馈网络在任意宽度、深度、初始化与数据集下的梯度下降收敛性缺少保证，现有结论多依赖过强的凸性或特定结构假设。
Method: 逐层关联相邻层的 Lipschitz 性质，导出 L 层网络的广义 Lipschitz 光滑条件（梯度变化上界含参数范数 2L−2 次多项式），再据此构造 descent lemma；假设覆盖 linear、tanh、softplus、sigmoid、smoothed ReLU 激活与 MSE、binary cross-entropy 损失。
Result: 最小梯度平方范数在 T 次迭代内以 O(1/T^{1/L}) 速率收敛到零；损失下降条件为学习率相对两端参数范数足够小，多项式次数为 2L−2。
Conclusion: 只要激活与损失满足线性有界加 Lipschitz 光滑这类温和条件，任意深度前馈网络的梯度下降都有可证收敛，代价是速率随深度 L 变慢。

papers.title: A Reproducibility Study of Partial Residual Ablations in Pre-LN Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Residual connections are a fundamental component of transformer architectures, yet the roles of the attention and feed-forward residual pathways remain poorly understood when considered independently. This paper presents a reproducibility study of partial residual ablations in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers trained at two scales (10M and 124M parameters). I compare four architectural configurations by selectively removing the attention residual connection, the feed-forward residual connection, or both. At 10M scale, a controlled 8-seed deterministic sweep shows a clear asymmetry: removing the attention residual (FFNOnly) reaches the No-Residual collapse regime (3.350 +/- 0.002), whereas removing the feed-forward residual (AttnOnly) remains well separated from it (1.580 +/- 0.003). A subsequent controlled 124M sweep establishes that the direction of this asymmetry persists under matched seeds: across five seeds each, AttnOnly reaches 6.037 +/- 0.355 versus 7.569 +/- 0.001 for FFNOnly, with no overlap between the observed ranges. AttnOnly nevertheless remains substantially degraded relative to FullResidual (4.577 +/- 0.012) and exhibits markedly greater seed sensitivity at 124M. During the investigation, I identified and corrected an experimental measurement confound in runtime gain scaling and retained an intermediate reproduction failure rather than excluding it. I propose cross-position routing through self-attention as a falsifiable hypothesis for the observed asymmetry; no clean causal test of this mechanism has yet been completed. To support reproducibility, I release the source code, experiment configurations, training logs, and experimental results, including intermediate non-reproducing runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Pre-LN GPT 风格 Transformer 上做部分残差消融的可复现性研究：10M 与 124M 两个规模、四种配置（去掉注意力残差、去掉 FFN 残差、两者都去、完整残差）显示不对称性——去掉 FFN 残差（FFNOnly）会塌到 No-Residual 崩溃区，去掉注意力残差（AttnOnly）则与之明显分离，但相对 FullResidual 仍显著退化。
Motivation: Transformer 中注意力与前馈两条残差通路各自的作用在独立考察时仍不清楚，需要在受控、可复现的设置下分离二者贡献。
Method: 在 10M 与 124M 参数的 Pre-LN GPT 风格模型上比较四种架构配置（移除注意力残差、移除 FFN 残差、两者都移除、完整残差）；10M 用 8-seed 确定性扫描，124M 用匹配种子、每配置 5 个种子；作者还修正了 runtime gain scaling 的测量混淆，并保留一次中间复现失败；提出经由 self-attention 的 cross-position routing 作为可证伪假说。
Result: 10M 上 FFNOnly 达到 No-Residual 崩溃区 3.350 ± 0.002，AttnOnly 为 1.580 ± 0.003，二者明显分离；124M 匹配种子下（每组 5 个种子）AttnOnly 6.037 ± 0.355 对 FFNOnly 7.569 ± 0.001，观测区间无重叠；AttnOnly 相对 FullResidual 4.577 ± 0.012 仍大幅退化，且在 124M 上种子敏感性明显更高。
Conclusion: 两条残差通路的作用不对称且方向在 10M 与 124M 一致：FFN 残差缺失导致崩溃，注意力残差缺失只是退化；cross-position routing 只是假说，尚无干净的因果检验。

papers.title: Stochasticity Is Not the Hard Part: Reduction and Complexity in Instructional Sequencing over Prerequisite DAGs
authors: Kristian A. Stevens (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science
(3) School of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: When a student must learn concepts connected by prerequisite dependencies, when does the order of instruction matter, and what does it cost to find the best one? We study instructional sequencing as a stochastic shortest-path problem in which attempting a concept succeeds with a state-dependent probability and failure leaves the learner state unchanged. We first prove that this stochasticity can be eliminated exactly: the problem collapses to a deterministic shortest-path problem on the lattice of prerequisite order ideals, preserving optimal values and actions. The collapse removes stochastic complexity but not combinatorial complexity: optimal sequencing remains NP-hard -- via reduction from feedback arc set in tournaments -- even with no prerequisite edges, unit costs, uniform binary nonnegative transfer, and success probabilities at least $1/2$. Hardness is not uniform: when realizable transfer preferences remain jointly acyclic with the prerequisites, any topological order of the residual joint graph is optimal, and fixed prerequisite width yields polynomial-time exact dynamic programming. A computable diagnostic, $mΔ$, bounds the value of sequencing before optimization. On 70,893 interactions from an introductory CS course, the diagnostic certifies a doubly easy regime -- little value to optimize and little space to search -- while constructed transfer instances realize the challenging regime, where myopic sequencing suffers large regret yet exact A* with a consistent heuristic expands only linearly many states on that family.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Equal contribution among Y. Chen, J. Jiang, and T. Shi (alphabetical order)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把教学排序建模为随机最短路问题，并证明随机性可被精确消去：问题坍缩到先修关系序理想格上的确定性最短路，最优值与最优动作保持不变。坍缩只去掉随机复杂度，组合复杂度仍在——即使无先修边、单位代价、成功概率不低于 1/2，最优排序仍由反馈弧集 (feedback arc set in tournaments) 归约证明为 NP-hard；但当可实现的迁移偏好与先修关系联合无环时，残余联合图的任意拓扑序即最优，固定先修宽度下可用多项式精确动态规划求解。
Motivation: 教学排序何时值得优化、优化代价多大，此前缺少可计算的判据：随机性与组合难解性混在一起，无法区分“排序价值很小”与“搜索空间巨大”这两种不同的容易。
Method: 将排序表述为状态依赖成功概率、失败不改变学习者状态的随机最短路问题；证明其可精确坍缩到先修序理想格上的确定性最短路；用从锦标赛反馈弧集的归约给出 NP-hard 性，并刻画联合无环与固定先修宽度下的多项式可解情形；提出可计算诊断量 mΔ 来界定排序价值的上界。
Result: 在一门入门 CS 课程的 70,893 次交互上，诊断 mΔ 认证出“双重容易”区间——既几乎没有可优化的价值，也没有多少搜索空间；构造的迁移实例则实现困难区间，其中短视排序产生大 regret，而带一致启发式的精确 A* 在该实例族上只扩展线性数量的状态。硬度结论为：即使无先修边、单位代价、均匀二元非负迁移且成功概率 ≥ 1/2，问题仍为 NP-hard。
Conclusion: 随机性不是教学排序的难点，真正难的是组合结构：难度由联合图是否保持无环以及先修宽度决定，而 mΔ 可在优化前先判定排序是否值得做。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bayesian Complete-Pooling in Cross-Subject Classification for Motor Imagery Electroencephalogram
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have long sought calibration-free operation, yet classifiers are typically benchmarked on discrimination alone. Discrimination is blind to calibration, a meaningful gap given that electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are nonstationary and point-estimate classifiers can become overconfident under distribution shift. We conducted a large-scale study contrasting Bayesian complete-pooling models against frequentist baselines for cross-subject, left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery EEG classification across 20 datasets. Each of six frequentist pipelines was paired with an analogous Bayesian pipeline sharing identical feature engineering, fit via Markov chain Monte Carlo posterior sampling. Our primary metric was the Brier score, decomposed into reliability and resolution, alongside the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for discrimination and Shannon entropy for sharpness. For each metric we fit a random-effects meta-analysis with Knapp-Hartung adjustment, verified by leave-one-out influence analysis. Bayesian complete-pooling produced statistically significant improvements in reliability and increases in predictive uncertainty (lower sharpness), but 95% confidence intervals bounded both effects near zero, and neither held significance when datasets with flagged posterior sampling were excluded. Brier score, resolution, and discrimination showed no significant differences. Between-study heterogeneity was low across all metrics. Bayesian pipelines consumed roughly thirteen times more energy than their frequentist counterparts, a cost that remains modest relative to common household appliances. Bayesian complete-pooling alone offers limited benefit for cross-subject motor imagery classification, but its modest cost makes partial-pooling across subjects and sessions a feasible next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 20 个数据集的跨被试左右手运动想象 EEG 分类上，Bayesian complete-pooling 相对配对的频率学派基线只带来统计显著的可靠性 (reliability) 提升与预测不确定性增大（sharpness 下降），但 95% 置信区间把两个效应都压在零附近，且剔除被标记的后验采样数据集后不再显著；Brier、resolution 与 AUC 无显著差异，能耗约为基线的 13 倍。作者据此认为 complete-pooling 单独使用收益有限，成本尚可，下一步应转向跨被试与跨 session 的 partial-pooling。
Motivation: BCI 追求免校准运行，但分类器通常只按判别力评测，忽略校准；EEG 非平稳、点估计分类器在分布漂移下会过度自信，跨被试迁移时这一缺口尤其明显。
Method: 对 20 个数据集做跨被试左手 vs 右手运动想象分类，六条频率学派 pipeline 各配一条共享相同特征工程的 Bayesian pipeline，用 MCMC 后验采样拟合；主指标为分解为 reliability 与 resolution 的 Brier score，辅以 AUC 与 Shannon entropy（sharpness），每个指标做 Knapp-Hartung 校正的随机效应 meta 分析，并用 leave-one-out 影响分析验证。
Result: Bayesian complete-pooling 在 reliability 上显著提升、预测不确定性增大（sharpness 下降），但 95% 置信区间将两效应限制在零附近，剔除带后验采样标记的数据集后均不再显著；Brier score、resolution 与判别力无显著差异，各指标的研究间异质性均低；Bayesian pipeline 能耗约为频率学派的 13 倍。
Conclusion: Bayesian complete-pooling 单独用于跨被试运动想象分类收益有限，但成本相对家用电器仍属温和，因此跨被试与跨 session 的 partial-pooling 是可行的下一步。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: CoCurve: Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature for Structured LLM Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Resource-constrained deployment requires sustaining large language model (LLM) capabilities as models scale under fixed memory and computation budgets. Structured pruning advances this deployment frontier with smaller dense checkpoints, yet deciding what to prune remains bottlenecked by interactions among joint removals. We introduce Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature (CoCurve), which formulates structured pruning as set-dependent predictive risk over a unified inventory of attention heads and feed-forward groups. A co-pruning graph built from single-unit forward ablations assigns individual risk to nodes and reinforcement or cancellation to interaction edges, conditioning each decision on the units already removed. We evaluate 6 LLMs (3B--70B) and 3 vision--language models (VLMs) across 3 perplexity corpora, 12 language tasks, and 7 multimodal benchmarks. Across the five-model 20--40% grid and the 70B 10--50% sweep, CoCurve ranks first in 53/60 corpus comparisons (15/15 at 70B); matched-quality interpolation permits 2.2--6.6 more pruning points in 9/10 cases, while CoCurve leads all 6 VLM Avg$_7$ blocks. After the same lightweight recovery, its retained structures remain strongest through 50% pruning, where the 8B checkpoint regains 10.8 Avg$_{12}$ points; physical slicing delivers $1.58\times$ dense prefill throughput with 41% lower peak memory. Mechanism analysis across 10 LLMs and 7 VLMs finds organized within- and cross-module edge structure; matched low-saliency, high-coupling removals degrade 19/20 capability groups by up to 23.7 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCurve 把结构化剪枝写成对注意力头与 FFN 组统一清单的集合依赖预测风险，用单单元前向消融构建共剪枝图，节点记个体风险、边记单元间强化或抵消，使每次剪枝决策以已删单元为条件。在 6 个 LLM（3B–70B）与 3 个 VLM 上，53/60 语料对比中排名第一（70B 为 15/15），8B 检查点在 50% 剪枝后经同等轻量恢复仍回升 10.8 个 Avg_12 点。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝能给出更小的稠密检查点，但删什么仍受联合删除之间相互作用的制约：逐个或独立打分无法刻画单元间的强化与抵消。
Method: CoCurve 将结构化剪枝形式化为对注意力头与 FFN 组统一清单的集合依赖预测风险；先做单单元前向消融，据此构建共剪枝图，节点承载个体风险、交互边承载强化或抵消，每个决策都以已移除单元为条件；之后做物理切片与同等轻量恢复。
Result: 在 6 个 LLM（3B–70B）与 3 个 VLM、3 个困惑度语料、12 项语言任务、7 个多模态基准上评测：五模型 20–40% 网格与 70B 10–50% 扫描中，CoCurve 在 53/60 语料对比排第一（70B 15/15）；匹配质量插值在 10 例中 9 例多出 2.2–6.6 个剪枝点；6 个 VLM 的 Avg_7 全部领先。同等轻量恢复后优势保持到 50% 剪枝，8B 检查点回升 10.8 个 Avg_12 点；物理切片带来 1.58 倍稠密 prefill 吞吐、峰值内存降 41%。机制分析覆盖 10 个 LLM 与 7 个 VLM，发现模块内与跨模块的有组织边结构；匹配的低显著性高耦合删除使 20 个能力组中 19 个最多退化 23.7 点。
Conclusion: 把单元间交互显式建模进剪枝决策，可在同等或更少恢复代价下选出更优的联合删除，且该优势在 50% 剪枝深度与物理切片的吞吐/内存收益上仍然成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust Peak-cost Constrained Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study robust peak-cost constrained reinforcement learning (\ours), where the objective is to maximize expected reward while controlling the maximum cost encountered along a trajectory. This setting is motivated by safety-critical applications in which a single large violation can be catastrophic and therefore cannot be adequately captured by the standard CMDP framework based on expected cumulative cost. Existing reachability-constrained RL methods adopt Lagrangian-based approaches, yet the underlying duality properties of peak-cost constrained MDPs remain unclear. We show that, unlike standard CMDPs, peak-cost constrained MDPs may not admit zero duality gap. We further consider a robust formulation to address simulator-to-real-world mismatch in the transition dynamics. To solve this problem, we develop a surrogate optimization framework and a robust value estimation method based on integral probability metrics. We prove that, with appropriate hyperparameter choices, the surrogate solution attains the same robust reward value as the original problem while violating the constraint by at most \(ε\). Experiments show that the proposed method effectively enforces safety under dynamics perturbations while retaining strong reward performance across diverse environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究峰值代价约束强化学习 (peak-cost constrained RL)：在期望回报最大化的同时约束轨迹上遇到的最大代价，而非 CMDP 的期望累积代价。证明峰值代价 MDP 可能不存在零对偶间隙，与标准 CMDP 不同；针对仿真到现实的动力学失配，提出基于积分概率度量 (integral probability metrics) 的鲁棒值估计与代理优化框架，证明适当超参下代理解达到与原问题相同的鲁棒回报、约束违反至多 ε。
Motivation: 安全攸关场景中单次大代价违规即灾难性，标准 CMDP 的期望累积代价无法刻画；现有可达性约束 RL 多用 Lagrangian 方法，但峰值代价 MDP 的对偶性质尚不清楚，且仿真与真实动力学存在失配。
Method: 建立峰值代价约束 MDP 的对偶分析并证明可能非零对偶间隙；构造代理优化框架，配合基于积分概率度量的鲁棒值估计处理动力学扰动；给出定理：适当超参下代理解与原问题鲁棒回报相同、约束违反不超过 ε。
Result: 实验显示所提方法在动力学扰动下有效 enforcing 安全约束，同时在多种环境中保持较强回报表现；理论保证为约束违反至多 ε 且回报与原问题一致。
Conclusion: 峰值代价约束不能沿用标准 CMDP 的零对偶间隙假设，需用代理优化加鲁棒值估计来同时保证安全与回报。

papers.title: Extractable Memorization From First Principles
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on extractable memorization in language models suffers from two contrasting validity problems. Some studies overstate extraction, for example, by using sequences too short to distinguish memorization from predictability. Others imply that extraction is unreliable evidence because models can reproduce real-world text they weren't explicitly trained on. Both overlook what makes a valid extraction claim: the model must generate a training sequence with high enough probability to indicate memorization. To determine what's high enough, one has to perform a matched comparison, measuring generation probabilities of training and comparable non-training sequences. Since non-training sequences can't have been memorized, their probabilities are a baseline for predictability; exceeding this baseline is evidence of memorization. We formalize matched comparisons with (1) a conformal test calibrated to a chosen false-positive rate when sequences are sampled from populations, and (2) a single-document census that calibrates against a matched non-training document. Matched comparisons enable rigorous, calibrated memorization claims and clarify where prior setups have validity issues. On Wikipedia, OLMo 2 32B reproduces non-training 10-token suffixes roughly 24% as often as training ones: that share reflects false positives, not memorization. For Llama 3.1 70B on books, calibrated census thresholds reach as low as 10^(-27), supporting memorization claims for sequences no feasible sampling budget would extract. We therefore refine "extractable memorization" to require both a valid memorization claim and near-certain generation within a realistic budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对语言模型可提取记忆 (extractable memorization) 判定的两类效度问题，提出匹配比较框架：用训练序列与可比非训练序列的生成概率对照，超过非训练基线才算记忆证据。具体给出按选定假阳性率校准的 conformal 检验与单文档 census 两种工具；在 Wikipedia 上 OLMo 2 32B 复现非训练 10-token 后缀的频率约为训练序列的 24%，该比例属假阳性而非记忆。
Motivation: 现有可提取记忆研究要么用过短序列把可预测性误当记忆而高估提取，要么以模型能复现未训练文本为由否定提取证据；两者都缺少“生成概率高到何种程度才算记忆”的判定标准。
Method: 把匹配比较形式化为两件工具：一是按所选假阳性率校准、面向从总体抽样序列的 conformal 检验；二是以匹配的非训练文档为校准对象的单文档 census。判定依据是训练序列生成概率是否超过可比非训练序列构成的可预测性基线。
Result: 在 Wikipedia 上，OLMo 2 32B 复现非训练 10-token 后缀的频率约为训练序列的 24%，作者指出该份额反映假阳性而非记忆。在 books 上，Llama 3.1 70B 的校准 census 阈值可低至 10^(-27)，支持对任何可行采样预算都无法提取的序列作出记忆主张。
Conclusion: 作者据此把“可提取记忆”重定义为同时满足两条：有效的记忆主张，以及在现实预算内近乎确定的生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: LLMs memorize sensitive training data, including personally identifiable information (PII), creating a pressing need for reliable post hoc removal methods. Unlearning has emerged as a promising solution, with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods often following a localize-first, unlearn-second paradigm that targets specific model parameters. However, existing benchmarks evaluate unlearning solely at the output level, leaving open the question of whether unlearning truly erases knowledge from a model's parameters or merely obfuscates it, a concern reinforced by the success of resurfacing attacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce LACUNA: the first unlearning testbed with ground-truth parameter-level localization. LACUNA injects PII of synthetic individuals into predefined parameters of 1B and 7B OLMo-based models via masked continual pretraining, enabling direct evaluation of whether unlearning targets the weights responsible for knowledge storage. We use LACUNA to benchmark current SOTA unlearning methods and find that, despite strong output-level performance, existing methods are highly imprecise and susceptible to resurfacing attacks. We further show that when localization is successful, even a simple gradient-based unlearning method achieves strong erasure and robustness to resurfacing attacks, highlighting the importance of precise unlearning. We release LACUNA to complement behavioral evaluations and drive further advances in robust, localization-based unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LACUNA 是首个带参数级真值定位的 LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 测试床：用 masked continual pretraining 把合成个体的 PII 注入 1B 与 7B OLMo 模型的预定义参数，从而直接检验遗忘方法是否命中真正存储知识的权重。结果显示 SOTA 遗忘方法输出层指标虽强但定位极不精确、易被 resurfacing attack 攻破；而一旦定位成功，简单的基于梯度的遗忘即可实现强擦除与抗复现鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有遗忘基准只在输出层评测，无法区分知识是被真正从参数中擦除还是仅被遮蔽，而 resurfacing attack 的成功正说明这一区分关键。
Method: 通过 masked continual pretraining 将合成个体 PII 注入 1B 与 7B OLMo 系列模型的预定义参数，建立参数级真值定位；在此测试床上评测当前 SOTA 遗忘方法是否命中负责存储知识的权重，并对比定位成功时的简单梯度遗忘方法。
Result: 现有 SOTA 遗忘方法尽管输出层表现强，但定位高度不精确且易受 resurfacing attack；定位成功时，简单的基于梯度的遗忘方法即可获得强擦除效果与对 resurfacing attack 的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 精确定位是可靠遗忘的前提：只看输出层指标会高估遗忘效果，基于精确定位的梯度遗忘足以实现可抗复现的知识擦除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real-Time Hard Negative Sampling via LLM-based Clustering for Large-Scale Two-Tower Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: The two-tower model is widely used in the retrieval stage of large-scale recommendation systems, where training typically relies on in-batch and/or out-of-batch negative sampling. These methods, however, tend to produce easy negatives that the model learns quickly and that provide little training signal. This paper proposes a self-supervised, cluster-based hard negative sampling technique that draws negatives from the same semantic cluster as the positive item; in our production deployment the clusters are derived from large language model (LLM) based multimodal content representations, so that intra-cluster items are genuinely similar and yield informative negatives. To make this deployable at industrial scale, we realize the technique in a real-time, end-to-end framework that maintains a live in-memory item pool and draws cluster-based negatives from it on the fly via global out-of-batch sampling (GOOBS). The framework integrates directly into production two-tower training and serving and scales to billions of training examples with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on four public datasets and a 14-day online A/B test in a large-scale production system show that the proposed technique outperforms widely used industry methods, while also helping to break recommendation feedback loops and substantially reducing popularity bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐系统双塔召回的 in-batch/out-of-batch 负采样多为易负例，训练信号弱。本文提出自监督的聚类难负例采样：用 LLM 多模态内容表征聚类，从正样本所在同簇内在线抽取难负例，并以 GOOBS 全局出批采样维护实时内存物品池。在四个公开数据集与生产系统 14 天线上 A/B 中优于常用工业方法，同时打破推荐反馈回路、显著降低流行度偏差。
Motivation: 双塔召回训练依赖的 in-batch/out-of-batch 负采样容易抽到易负例，模型很快学会、几乎不提供训练信号，且工业规模下难负例难以实时获取。
Method: 自监督聚类难负例采样：以 LLM 多模态内容表征做聚类，从正样本同簇内抽负例保证语义相似；用实时端到端框架维护活跃内存物品池，通过 global out-of-batch sampling (GOOBS) 在线出批抽样，直接接入生产双塔训练与 serving。
Result: 在四个公开数据集和大规模生产系统 14 天线上 A/B 测试中，该方法优于常用工业方法；同时帮助打破推荐反馈回路并大幅降低流行度偏差；框架可扩展到数十亿训练样本且计算开销极小。
Conclusion: 同簇难负例加实时全局出批采样能在工业规模下提供更强训练信号，并同时改善反馈回路与流行度偏差，可直接嵌入生产双塔训练与服务链路。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 推荐系统双塔召回的 in-batch/out-of-batch 负采样多为易负例，训练信号弱。本文提出自监督的聚类难负例采样：用 LLM 多模态内容表征聚类，从正样本所在同簇内在线抽取难负例，并以 GOOBS 全局出批采样维护实时内存物品池。在四个公开数据集与生产系统 14 天线上 A/B 中优于常用工业方法，同时打破推荐反馈回路、显著降低流行度偏差。
summary_sections.motivation: 双塔召回训练依赖的 in-batch/out-of-batch 负采样容易抽到易负例，模型很快学会、几乎不提供训练信号，且工业规模下难负例难以实时获取。
summary_sections.method: 自监督聚类难负例采样：以 LLM 多模态内容表征做聚类，从正样本同簇内抽负例保证语义相似；用实时端到端框架维护活跃内存物品池，通过 global out-of-batch sampling (GOOBS) 在线出批抽样，直接接入生产双塔训练与 serving。
summary_sections.result: 在四个公开数据集和大规模生产系统 14 天线上 A/B 测试中，该方法优于常用工业方法；同时帮助打破推荐反馈回路并大幅降低流行度偏差；框架可扩展到数十亿训练样本且计算开销极小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 同簇难负例加实时全局出批采样能在工业规模下提供更强训练信号，并同时改善反馈回路与流行度偏差，可直接嵌入生产双塔训练与服务链路。

papers.title: Filtered Conformal Ellipsoids for Graph-Native Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Joint prediction sets for multivariate time series should control a single event while adapting to cross-coordinate dependence. We study filtered conformal ellipsoids: a frozen state-space filter emits a one-step predictive mean and covariance, and split-conformal calibration is applied to the resulting Mahalanobis scores. The filter is used to choose the ellipsoid shape; conformal calibration chooses the scalar radius, so the construction benefits from a learned predictive covariance without relying on Gaussian tail probabilities for coverage. The main difficulty is that filtered scores are dependent and learned recurrent filters need not contract in their raw hidden state; we therefore analyse contraction in an observable predictive-law quotient that identifies hidden states producing the same future sequence of emitted Gaussian laws. Under a stable Bayes Gaussian-projection filter, covariance bounds, and a finite-horizon observability Fisher condition, small excess Gaussian negative log-likelihood implies contraction of the learned emitted laws. Combined with a threshold-autocovariance envelope this yields a Chebyshev-type approximate coverage bound for filtered split-conformal prediction under dependence; a sharper Bernstein-type bound requires an additional geometric-mixing concentration assumption. Under Gaussian oracle realisability we also obtain a near-oracle log-volume comparison within the class of conditionally valid Gaussian ellipsoid rules. We instantiate the framework with a GCN-GRU filter with diagonal-plus-low-rank covariance. On moderate-size graph-native traffic benchmarks (METRLA-$20$ and PEMSBAY-$50$), the learned filter gives sharper at-target ellipsoids than static-covariance and non-filter baselines; at full-graph scale and on non-graph-native datasets, factor and copula baselines can be stronger.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 filtered conformal ellipsoids：冻结的状态空间滤波器输出一步预测均值与协方差，split-conformal 只在 Mahalanobis 分数上校准标量半径，从而在不依赖高斯尾概率的前提下控制多元时间序列的联合事件。理论在稳定 Bayes Gaussian-projection 滤波、协方差界与有限视界可观测性 Fisher 条件下，由小的超额高斯 NLL 推出发射律收缩，并给出依赖数据下的 Chebyshev 型近似覆盖界；在 METRLA-20 与 PEMSBAY-50 上，学习滤波器给出比静态协方差与非滤波基线更锐利的 at-target 椭球，但在全图规模与非图原生数据集上 factor 与 copula 基线可能更强。
Motivation: 多元时间序列的联合预测集需要同时控制单一事件并适配跨坐标依赖；filtered 分数彼此相关，且学习型循环滤波器的原始隐藏状态未必收缩，直接套 split-conformal 缺少覆盖与锐度的理论依据。
Method: 冻结状态空间滤波器输出一步预测均值与协方差，对 Mahalanobis 分数做 split-conformal 校准：滤波器定椭球形状，校准定标量半径。理论在可识别相同发射高斯律序列的 observable predictive-law quotient 中分析收缩，配合 threshold-autocovariance 包络得 Chebyshev 型覆盖界，Bernstein 型更紧界需额外 geometric-mixing 集中假设；实例化为 GCN-GRU 滤波器加 diagonal-plus-low-rank 协方差。
Result: 在图原生交通基准 METRLA-20 与 PEMSBAY-50 上，学习滤波器给出比静态协方差与非滤波基线更锐利的 at-target 椭球；在全图规模与非图原生数据集上，factor 与 copula 基线可以更强。理论结果包括：小超额高斯 NLL 蕴含发射律收缩、依赖下 Chebyshev 型近似覆盖界，以及 Gaussian oracle 可实现时在条件有效的高斯椭球规则类内的 near-oracle log-volume 比较。
Conclusion: 让学习滤波器负责形状、conformal 负责半径，可以在不假设高斯尾的情况下得到联合覆盖；该优势在中等规模图原生交通数据上成立，扩展到全图规模或非图原生数据时需改用 factor/copula 类基线。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: When Good Verifiers Go Bad: Silent Negative Transfer in Verifier-Guided VLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Verifier reliability is not portable across tasks. A verifier-guided self-DPO pipeline with genuine held-out gains on MathVista (+9.6 points on self-training data, +8.0 held out) can be harmful on MMMU. The failure is invisible from the target-task self-training signal: over six learner-verifier configurations, MMMU self-training performance still improves by +3.52 points while held-out performance drops by 1.42 points. We call this silent negative transfer: a verifier validated as useful before can still show signatures of successful self-training after its induced update stops transferring to unseen data. Downstream failure alone cannot diagnose this: poor generalization may mean the verifier induces a wrong learning direction, or that the correct direction itself does not generalize beyond the self-training distribution. We separate these effects via gradient fidelity F, the alignment between verifier-induced and correct training directions, and gradient transferability T, the alignment between correct and held-out directions, giving a conservative Safe-Transfer Margin: positive first-order held-out alignment is certified when arccos(F) + arccos(T) < pi/2. We then introduce Asymmetric Acceptance Gating (AAG), a precision-first filter selecting preference pairs by the verifier's absolute confidence in the response receiving the positive update. On MMMU, AAG raises fidelity from 0.29 to 0.42. In a same-cell analysis, the correct direction stays positively aligned with the held-out direction (T = 0.31), yet raw verification rotates the induced update to negative held-out alignment (-0.13); AAG restores positive alignment (+0.22). Across all six MMMU configurations, AAG beats raw verifier-guided training. Verifier reliability thus means not that it worked before, but that it induces the right update on the task at hand and that this update stays useful beyond the data that generated it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 验证器引导的 self-DPO 在 MathVista 上有真实增益（自训练数据 +9.6、held-out +8.0），迁移到 MMMU 却造成静默负迁移：自训练信号仍升 +3.52 而 held-out 降 1.42。提出梯度保真度 F 与可迁移性 T 的 Safe-Transfer Margin（arccos(F)+arccos(T)<π/2 才认证正向 held-out 对齐），以及按验证器绝对置信度筛偏好对的 Asymmetric Acceptance Gating，把 MMMU 上 F 从 0.29 提到 0.42。
Motivation: 验证器可靠性不跨任务迁移：在源任务上验证有效的验证器，其诱导更新可能在目标任务上停止泛化，而自训练信号完全看不出失败，下游表现差又无法区分是方向错还是方向本身不泛化。
Method: 定义梯度保真度 F（验证器诱导方向与正确方向的对齐）和梯度可迁移性 T（正确方向与 held-out 方向的对齐），给出保守 Safe-Transfer Margin：arccos(F)+arccos(T)<π/2 时认证一阶 held-out 正对齐；再提出 Asymmetric Acceptance Gating (AAG)，按验证器对获得正向更新的响应的绝对置信度筛选偏好对。
Result: MathVista 上 self-DPO 自训练数据 +9.6 点、held-out +8.0 点；MMMU 上六种 learner-verifier 配置中自训练性能升 +3.52 点而 held-out 降 1.42 点。AAG 在 MMMU 把 fidelity 从 0.29 提到 0.42；同格分析中 T=0.31 为正，raw verification 使 held-out 对齐变 -0.13，AAG 恢复到 +0.22；全部六种 MMMU 配置中 AAG 均胜过 raw verifier-guided 训练。
Conclusion: 验证器可靠不等于它以前成功过，而等于它在当前任务上诱导出正确更新、且该更新在生成它的数据之外仍然有用；仅靠下游表现无法诊断这一失败，需要 F/T 分解加置信度门控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From 'What' to 'How' and 'Why': Sharing LLM-Generated Retrospective Summaries of Older Adults' Passive Tracking Data with Remote Family Members
papers.abstract_en: With the growing prevalence of modern ubiquitous computing technologies, multi-modal tracking systems hold promise for providing timely awareness and reassurance to stakeholders such as remote family members (RFMs) of older adults, who play a central role in care coordination. However, combining heterogeneous data streams into high-level, meaningful content - such as retrospective summaries - remains challenging. While recent work has demonstrated the promise of large language models (LLMs) for interpreting multi-modal tracking data, less attention has been given to generating narrative accounts for stakeholders like RFMs, who possess rich personal knowledge of older adults and strong emotional responsibility, yet have limited visibility into their daily lives and limited capacity for caregiving. In this work, we explore how LLMs can be used to generate retrospective summaries from multi-modal tracking data for RFMs of older adults. We leveraged and customized an existing system, Vital Insight and GLOSS, to generate initial summaries on different dates and data availability scenarios as technology probes, and conducted interviews with 11 RFMs to gather feedback. Through thematic analysis, we found that RFMs' sensemaking shift from simply presenting ''What'' data were collected, to explaining ''How'' is my loved one doing and ''Why''.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 把老年人多模态被动追踪数据转成给远方家属 (RFM) 的回顾性叙述摘要，作为 technology probe 在不同日期与数据可用性场景下生成初稿，并对 11 位 RFM 做访谈与主题分析。发现家属的意义建构从「收集了什么数据」转向「亲人过得怎么样 (How)」与「为什么 (Why)」。
Motivation: 多模态追踪能给远程家属提供及时的照护感知，但异构数据流难以合成高层有意义的回顾性摘要；现有 LLM 工作多在解读数据本身，忽视了拥有丰富个人知识、情感责任重却对老人日常可见度低的家属。
Method: 复用并定制既有系统 Vital Insight 与 GLOSS，在不同日期和数据可用性场景下生成初始摘要作为 technology probe；对 11 位 RFM 做访谈收集反馈，并做主题分析 (thematic analysis)。
Result: 对 11 位远程家属的访谈经主题分析显示，其 sensemaking 从单纯呈现「收集了什么 (What)」数据，转向解释「亲人状况如何 (How)」与「为什么 (Why)」。
Conclusion: 给远程家属的追踪数据摘要应从数据罗列升级为解释性叙述，回答 How 与 Why 才契合家属的照护感知需求。

papers.title: ConTraIRL: Factorized Contrastive Abstractions for Transferable IRL
papers.abstract_en: Reward transfer in Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) is unreliable when policies must generalize to unseen combinations of environment dynamics and task goals. We propose Factorized Contrastive Abstractions for Transferable IRL (ConTraIRL), a framework that enables compositional reward transfer by learning decoupled latent representations of these two factors. ConTraIRL uses a dual-encoder architecture that maps observations into separate dynamics and goal latent spaces, trained with a dual contrastive objective. Temporal alignment encourages the dynamics encoder to learn goal-invariant structure, while the goal encoder captures dynamics-invariant features. This factorization supports reward inference under recombined dynamics-goal settings. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks demonstrate effective few-shot transfer to unseen dynamics-goal pairings, improving sample efficiency and reward recovery over transfer IRL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConTraIRL 把环境动力学与任务目标解耦成两个独立潜空间，用双编码器加双对比目标训练，使奖励能在未见过的动力学-目标组合上做组合式迁移。在连续控制基准上实现了对新组合的 few-shot 迁移，样本效率与奖励恢复均优于迁移 IRL 基线。
Motivation: IRL 学到的奖励在策略需要泛化到未见过的环境动力学与任务目标组合时迁移不可靠，因为奖励把两者纠缠在一起。
Method: 双编码器架构把观测分别映射到动力学潜空间与目标潜空间，用双对比目标 (dual contrastive objective) 训练：时间对齐使动力学编码器学到目标不变结构，目标编码器捕捉动力学不变特征，从而支持重组后的奖励推断。
Result: 在连续控制基准上展示了对未见过动力学-目标配对的有效 few-shot 迁移，相比迁移 IRL 基线提升了样本效率与奖励恢复 (reward recovery)。
Conclusion: 把动力学与目标因子化为解耦潜表征，可以让 IRL 奖励在重组的动力学-目标设定下组合式迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Anytime Training with Schedule-Free Spectral Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Standard neural network training relies on learning-rate schedules tied to a fixed horizon, leading to strong path dependence and costly re-tuning as data availability changes. Schedule-Free (SF) methods address this by removing explicit schedules, yet SF-AdamW, the current state-of-the-art anytime optimizer, consistently underperforms well-tuned AdamW baselines. We propose SF-NorMuon, a schedule-free spectral optimizer that closes this gap: with a single hyperparameter configuration, SF-NorMuon matches or exceeds tuned AdamW on 125M and 772M parameter language models across $1$--$8\times$ Chinchilla horizons, and trails horizon-aware, cosine-scheduled NorMuon by only $\sim 0.03$ nats, substantially narrowing the gap between anytime and scheduled spectral optimizers. On the theoretical side, we prove a stationarity guarantee for schedule-free spectral dynamics and identify weight decay at the fast iterate as essential for long-horizon stability. SF-NorMuon enables practitioners to obtain high-quality checkpoints at any point during training without committing to a horizon in advance. Fully matching horizon-aware spectral optimizers without a schedule remains an open problem, which we highlight as a direction for future work. By closing the performance gap with tuned AdamW baselines, SF-NorMuon makes horizon-free optimization more practical, taking a step towards truly open-ended, continual learning.

papers.title: Hessian Matching for Machine-Learned Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics enables simulations of atomic systems such as biomolecules at timescales inaccessible to all-atom (AA) methods, but existing CG neural potentials trained via force matching capture only the gradient of the free-energy surface, leaving its curvature unsupervised. We introduce a framework that augments force matching with stochastic Hessian-vector product (HVP) matching, instilling second-order curvature information into CG potentials without constructing the full Hessian. We derive a decomposition of the target CG Hessian into a model-independent projected AA Hessian, precomputed once before training, and a model-dependent covariance correction computed online at negligible cost. We then construct an unbiased stochastic estimator of the Hessian-matching objective by using random probe vectors. We evaluate our method by training on a benchmark set of nine fast-folding proteins and gauging agreement of the learned free-energy landscapes with reference data along the directions of slowest collective motion using time-lagged independent component analysis. HVP matching improves slow-mode accuracy over force matching for all but one of our benchmark proteins. It also sharpens local structure, reducing bond-length error on eight of nine proteins, and in several cases by an order of magnitude. Our results demonstrate that higher-order physical supervision is a practical path to more accurate CG potentials for biomolecular simulation.
papers.comment: 38 pages (9-page main text, references, and 3 appendices), 22 figures, 5 tables. v2: substantially revised; main experiments now train and evaluate directly on the nine-protein benchmark, the unseen-protein results move to Appendix C, and full per-protein results are added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在力匹配 (force matching) 之外加入随机 Hessian-向量积 (HVP) 匹配，为粗粒化 (CG) 神经势函数注入自由能面曲率监督：目标 CG Hessian 分解为训练前预计算的投影 AA Hessian 与在线计算的协方差修正，再用随机探针向量构造无偏随机估计量。在九个快速折叠蛋白基准上，HVP 匹配在除一个蛋白外的所有蛋白上都提升了慢模 (slow-mode) 精度，并在九个中的八个上降低键长误差，个别情况改善一个数量级。
Motivation: CG 神经势函数通常只用力匹配训练，只监督自由能面的梯度而曲率无人监督，导致慢模与局部结构不准，限制了粗粒化分子动力学对生物分子的长时间尺度模拟精度。
Method: 在力匹配目标上增补随机 HVP 匹配：把目标 CG Hessian 分解为与模型无关、训练前一次性预计算的投影 AA Hessian，加上在线以可忽略开销计算的模型相关协方差修正；用随机探针向量构造该 Hessian-匹配目标的无偏随机估计量，无需构造完整 Hessian。训练与评估直接在九蛋白基准上进行，用 time-lagged independent component analysis (tICA) 沿最慢集体运动方向比对学到的自由能面与参考数据。
Result: 在九个快速折叠蛋白基准上，HVP 匹配相对力匹配在除一个蛋白外的全部蛋白上提升慢模精度；在九个中的八个上减小键长误差，个别蛋白改善达一个数量级。
Conclusion: 更高阶的物理监督（曲率而非仅梯度）是提升生物分子粗粒化势函数精度的可行路径，且无需构造完整 Hessian。

papers.title: A Dual Representation of Influence Functions for Linearizable Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a dual representation of influence functions, whose computational complexity scales with dataset size rather than model size. Both analytically and experimentally, we show that this representation can be an efficient alternative to the original influence functions for estimating changes in parameters, model outputs and loss due to data point removal, when model size is large relative to dataset size, or when evaluating the original influence functions in parameter space is infeasible. The dual representation, however, is limited to linearizable models, which are models whose behavior can be approximated by their linearizations throughout training, and requires materializing a matrix, whose size grows with the product of model output dimension and dataset size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出影响函数 (influence functions) 的对偶表示，其计算复杂度随数据集规模而非模型规模增长，用于估计删除单个数据点后参数、模型输出与损失的变化。解析与实验都表明，当模型相对数据集很大、或在参数空间求原影响函数不可行时，该表示是更高效的选择；代价是仅适用于线性化模型 (linearizable models)，且需显式存储一个大小为模型输出维度乘数据集规模的矩阵。
Motivation: 原影响函数的计算开销随模型参数量增长，当模型规模远大于数据集、或参数空间求值不可行时无法使用。
Method: 给出影响函数的对偶表示，复杂度随数据集规模缩放；适用对象为训练全程行为可由其线性近似刻画的线性化模型，需物化一个维度为模型输出维度 × 数据集规模的矩阵。
Result: 解析与实验两方面均表明该对偶表示可在模型规模相对数据集较大时高效估计删点引起的参数、输出与损失变化；适用条件为线性化模型，存储开销随模型输出维度与数据集规模之积增长。
Conclusion: 对偶表示是原影响函数在大模型、小数据场景下的高效替代，但适用范围被线性化假设和输出维度 × 数据集规模的矩阵存储所限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Privacy in Data-Space Tabular Diffusion Models: Influential Factors, Attacker Knowledge, and Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data plays an important role in many fields and industries, including those with elevated privacy considerations and risks. As such, there is a rising interest in generating high-quality synthetic proxies for real tabular data as a means of reducing privacy risk and proprietary data exposure. With data-space tabular diffusion models (TDMs) demonstrating leading performance in synthesizing such data, understanding and measuring the privacy risks associated with these models is imperative. Leveraging state-of-the-art membership inference attacks for such TDMs in both black- and white-box settings, this work quantifies the impact of training setup, synthesis choices, and attacker knowledge on privacy leakage. Moreover, the results demonstrate that adversaries need not have perfect knowledge of the training setup, identical data distributions, or massive compute resources to construct successful attacks. Finally, the substantial pitfalls associated with heuristic privacy metrics, such as distance-to-closest record, are identified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对数据空间表格扩散模型 (data-space tabular diffusion models, TDM) 的隐私风险，用黑盒与白盒成员推断攻击 (membership inference attacks) 系统量化训练设置、合成选择与攻击者知识对隐私泄露的影响。发现攻击者无需完全掌握训练设置、相同数据分布或大量算力即可成功实施攻击，同时指出 distance-to-closest record 等启发式隐私指标存在严重缺陷。
Motivation: 表格合成数据被用来降低隐私与专有数据风险，而 TDM 合成质量领先，但其隐私泄露如何随训练配置、合成选项与攻击者知识变化缺乏量化，且常用启发式隐私指标可信度存疑。
Method: 在黑盒与白盒两种设定下采用当前最先进的 TDM 成员推断攻击，控制训练设置、合成选择与攻击者知识三类变量来量化隐私泄露，并检验启发式隐私指标（如 distance-to-closest record）的有效性。
Result: 结果显示攻击者不必拥有对训练设置的完美知识、相同的数据分布或大规模计算资源，也能构造成功的攻击；并识别出 distance-to-closest record 等启发式隐私指标存在实质性缺陷。
Conclusion: TDM 的隐私泄露对攻击者知识要求很低，启发式隐私指标不足以刻画真实风险，评估合成表格数据隐私时应依赖成员推断攻击而非 distance-to-closest record 一类指标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multiscale Euclidean Network Trajectories: Second-Moment Geometry, Attribution, and Change Points
papers.abstract_en: Understanding a dynamic network requires more than locating when it changes: we also want to know the magnitude and structural direction of change and which nodes contribute. Unfolded spectral embedding places network snapshots in a joint representation, but the underlying rectangular latent factorization is invariant under general linear transformations. Such transformations preserve edge probabilities while potentially distorting Euclidean second moments. We introduce Multiscale Euclidean Network Trajectories (MENT), whose central estimands are pairwise second-moment operators of the dynamic latent positions. Under an isotropic normalization of the shared anchor latent positions, these operators are identifiable up to simultaneous orthogonal conjugation. They yield a global trace variation distance and, through an aggregated operator, shared orthogonal directions for mode-wise distances. The squared global distance decomposes exactly across these modes. Classical multidimensional scaling turns the distances into global and mode-wise trajectories of time. A modified unfolded spectral estimator consistently recovers the operators and induced trajectories, and we establish bounds connecting node attributions to trajectory displacements and trajectory estimation to change point localization. Synthetic experiments validate geometric recovery and show improved detection of mode-specific changes against baselines. Analyses of two real networks illustrate interpretable mode- and node-level descriptions of temporal evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MENT（Multiscale Euclidean Network Trajectories），把动态网络快照的潜在位置二阶矩算子作为核心估计量，在各向同性归一化下使其在同时正交共轭意义下可识别，进而导出全局 trace 变化距离与按模态分解的轨迹。修改版 unfolded spectral 估计量一致恢复这些算子与轨迹，并给出节点归因到轨迹位移、轨迹估计到变点定位的界；合成实验显示对模态特异变化的检测优于基线。
Motivation: 动态网络的 unfolded spectral embedding 受一般线性变换不变性影响，边概率虽保持但欧氏二阶矩可能被扭曲，导致无法量化变化的幅度、结构方向与节点贡献，只能定位变化时刻。
Method: MENT 以动态潜在位置的成对二阶矩算子为核心估计量，在共享 anchor 潜在位置的各向同性归一化下，将这些算子识别到同时正交共轭；由全局 trace 变化距离与聚合算子得到共享正交方向上的模态距离，平方全局距离在各模态间精确分解，再用经典 MDS 把距离转成全局与模态时间轨迹；用修改版 unfolded spectral 估计量一致恢复算子与轨迹，并建立节点归因到轨迹位移、轨迹估计到变点定位的界。
Result: 合成实验验证几何恢复，并显示对模态特异变化的检测相对基线有改进；两个真实网络的分析给出可解释的模态级与节点级时间演化描述。
Conclusion: 把动态网络嵌入的不确定性归到二阶矩算子层面，可在保持边概率的同时量化变化的幅度与方向，并把模态距离、节点归因与变点定位统一到同一条轨迹几何框架中。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A Theory of Saddle Escape in Deep Nonlinear Networks
papers.abstract_en: In deep networks with small initialization, training can exhibit long plateaus separated by sharp feature-acquisition transitions. Whereas shallow nonlinear networks and deep linear networks are well studied, extending these analyses to deep nonlinear networks remains challenging. We derive exact scalar and matrix identities for the imbalance of layer weight norms, holding for any smooth activation and any differentiable loss, and use the resulting approximate balance law to control the full finite-width gradient flow through its first escape. This gives a scaling law in the escape time: with a prefix of $r$ layers initialized at the bottleneck scale $\varepsilon$, the escape time is $Θ(Γ^{-1})$ for $r=1$, $Θ(Γ^{-1}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ for $r=2$, and $Θ(Γ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-(r-2)})$ for $r\geq3$, where $Γ=\|\mathbb{E}[yx]\|$. We further show that a multimode teacher leaves the saddle once rather than in stages: with scalar output, all mode overlaps grow through a common amplitude, with relative weights fixed in advance. We find close agreement between our theory and experiment.

papers.title: Universal Quantum Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Classical continuous-space neural networks fundamentally struggle to lock into exact formal rules, whether mathematical, such as modular arithmetic and non-Abelian group algebra, or linguistic, such as systematic compositional generalization. To approximate these discrete logical rules, they often rely on massive parameter scaling, resulting in stochastic instability even after delayed generalization phenomena known as grokking. Here, we introduce the Universal Quantum Transformer (UQT), a novel, quantum-native computing architecture that uses the physical properties of multi-qubit systems as a universal inductive bias for exact algebraic and compositional reasoning. Rather than translating classical neural mechanisms, our framework relies entirely on parameterized geometric phase embedding and $SU(2)$ wave-interference. We demonstrate that an identical quantum attention circuit, operating on a highly compact 5 or 6 qubit substrate with only 551 to 1,650 trainable parameters, exactly learns three highly distinct formal classes: cyclic modular arithmetic ($\mathbb{Z}_{11}$), non-Abelian algebra (the $S_4$ permutation group), and systematic linguistic compositionality (the SCAN language). While standard classical models, including multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) and Transformers, exhibit stochastic instability at convergence, the UQT achieves mathematically exact, deterministic generalization. We define this stricter regime as crystallization: a step beyond the well-known phenomenon of grokking. Finally, we deploy the UQT on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware, achieving 97.5% accuracy on IBM Quantum computers. These results demonstrate that the UQT provides a structurally suited inductive bias for exact formal reasoning that standard classical continuous-space architectures do not natively provide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出量子原生架构 Universal Quantum Transformer (UQT)，用参数化几何相位嵌入与 SU(2) 波干涉作为归纳偏置，在 5–6 qubit、551–1,650 参数的电路上同一量子注意力电路精确学会 Z11 模运算、S4 置换群与 SCAN 语言组合三类形式规则，达到确定性精确泛化（作者称为 crystallization，超出 grokking），并在 IBM Quantum NISQ 硬件上取得 97.5% 准确率。
Motivation: 经典连续空间网络难以锁定精确的形式规则（模运算、非阿贝尔群、系统性组合泛化），只能靠大规模参数堆叠，即便出现 grokking 后仍有随机不稳定。
Method: UQT 不翻译经典神经机制，完全依赖参数化几何相位嵌入与 SU(2) 波干涉构造量子注意力电路；同一电路在 5 或 6 qubit 基底上训练，参数量 551–1,650，分别学习 Z11、S4 与 SCAN，并部署到 NISQ 硬件。
Result: 同一量子注意力电路在 5–6 qubit、551–1,650 可训练参数下精确学习 Z11、S4、SCAN 三类形式类；MLP 与 Transformer 等经典模型在收敛时表现随机不稳定，UQT 给出数学上精确的确定性泛化；在 IBM Quantum 计算机上达到 97.5% 准确率。
Conclusion: UQT 提供了标准经典连续空间架构原生不具备的、适合精确形式推理的结构性归纳偏置，并把 grokking 之外的确定性精确泛化定义为 crystallization。

papers.title: Alignment has a Fantasia Problem
papers.abstract_en: In accomplishing complex tasks, human cognition typically progresses from abstract to concrete (e.g., from brainstorming ideas to writing an essay). With the advent of highly capable AI assistants, people now offload various parts of their task to the system. However, instruction-tuned AI systems, even when designed to infer implicit intent, lack an understanding of humans' cognitive processes. When a user approaches AI while their goals and intentions are abstract, AI systems often short circuit their cognitive process through which those goals would be refined by jumping toward a final output (e.g., writing the essay entirely). Doing so takes away the user's agency in achieving the task: they may need to spend more time revising or, worse, settle on a suboptimal outcome. We call these failures Fantasia interactions after the famous Disney scene. We argue that Fantasia interactions demand a rethinking of alignment research, where AI systems optimize how cognitive responsibility is allocated within an interaction. We highlight gaps in state-of-the-art alignment methods, and outline a research agenda for training and evaluating models to achieve this vision.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026 Workshop HCAIR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Fantasia interaction 这一失败类型：当用户目标还处于抽象阶段时，指令微调的 AI 助手会直接跳到最终产出（如替用户把整篇 essay 写完），从而短路用户本应用于细化目标的认知过程，剥夺其 agency，导致返工时间增加或接受次优结果。作者据此主张对齐研究应从对齐输出转向优化一次交互内认知责任 (cognitive responsibility) 的分配，并给出训练与评估此类模型的研究议程。
Motivation: 人类完成复杂任务时认知从抽象走向具体，而现有指令微调系统即使被设计为推断隐含意图，也不理解这一认知过程；用户带着抽象目标来时，系统跳步输出会夺走其细化目标的机会。
Method: 定义并命名 Fantasia interaction 这一失败类别，据此审视现有对齐方法（SFT、RLHF 等）在认知责任分配上的缺口，并提出一个训练与评估模型的 research agenda；工作为 10 页、2 图的立场/议程论文。
Result: 给出 Fantasia interaction 的定性刻画：AI 直接产出完整最终结果会迫使用户花更多时间修订，或接受次优结果；并指出当前对齐方法在优化交互内认知责任分配上存在缺口。
Conclusion: 对齐的目标应改为优化一次交互中认知责任如何在人与 AI 之间分配，而不只是让输出符合意图；实现这一愿景需要新的训练与评估方法。

papers.title: Conformal Robust Set Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a robust conformal prediction method based on the half-mass radius $\dP(x):=\inf\{r>0:P(B(x,r))>1/2\}$. Its empirical version is exactly the distance from a point to its $\mathbf{k}$-th nearest neighbour, with $\mathbf{k}=\lfloor n/2\rfloor+1$. The resulting conformal sets retain finite-sample marginal validity and asymptotically target the robust population central set $\Qba:=\{x\in\R^d:\dP(x)\leβ_α\}$. We prove consistency in symmetric-difference probability, derive non-asymptotic exponential bounds and obtain the rate $O((\log n/n)^{1/2})$ under a local mass condition. Under the same local regularity on the uncontaminated law, we also establish quantitative $O(η)$ stability, uniformly over arbitrary contaminations of sufficiently small mass $η$, prove Hausdorff convergence of the empirical central sets, and provide computable ball-based representations using only pairwise distances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于半质量半径 (half-mass radius) 的稳健 conformal prediction：经验版恰为到第 ⌊n/2⌋+1 近邻的距离，所得集合保留有限样本边际有效性，并渐近收敛到稳健总体中心集。在局部质量条件下对称差概率达到 O((log n/n)^{1/2})，对任意质量 η 的污染给出 O(η) 稳定性。
Motivation: 标准 conformal 预测的覆盖依赖数据分布，面对污染或离群点时预测集会膨胀、中心集估计不稳；需要一个既保有限样本有效性、又对小质量污染定量稳健的集合估计量。
Method: 以半质量半径 ρ_P(x)=inf{r>0:P(B(x,r))>1/2} 定义中心集，其经验版本用到第 k=⌊n/2⌋+1 近邻距离实现；只依赖成对距离即可给出可计算的球表示，并证明经验中心集的 Hausdorff 收敛。
Result: 有限样本边际有效性成立；在局部质量条件下对称差概率速率 O((log n/n)^{1/2})；在无污染分布的同等局部正则性下，对任意质量足够小 η 的污染有一致的 O(η) 稳定性，并给出非渐近指数界。
Conclusion: 半质量半径把 conformal 集合的目标换成稳健总体中心集，同时保住有限样本有效性、O((log n/n)^{1/2}) 收敛率与对污染的 O(η) 稳定性，且只需成对距离即可计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Fine-Tuning Encourages Hallucinations and How to Fix It
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are prone to hallucinating factually incorrect statements. A key source of these errors is exposure to new factual information through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which can increase hallucinations w.r.t.~knowledge acquired during pre-training. Since these errors arise as a by-product of knowledge degradation, we explore whether established continual learning tools can mitigate them. We propose a self-distillation-based SFT method that facilitates effective factual learning while minimizing hallucinations w.r.t.~pre-existing knowledge by regularizing output-distribution drift. We also show that when new knowledge acquisition is unnecessary, suppressing factual plasticity by freezing parameter groups preserves task performance while reducing hallucinations. Lastly, we investigate the mechanism, contrasting capacity limitations, behavior cloning, and localized interference. Our experiments show that a main driver is interference among overlapping semantic representations, which self-distillation mitigates and an associative-memory model explains: forgetting grows with the overlap between new and stored facts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SFT 引入新事实会以牺牲预训练知识为代价抬高幻觉，作者用自蒸馏正则化输出分布漂移来同时保住事实学习与原有知识；当不需要学新知识时，冻结参数组抑制事实可塑性即可在保持任务性能的同时降低幻觉。机制上主因是重叠语义表征之间的干扰，遗忘随新旧事实重叠度增长。
Motivation: 监督微调 (SFT) 暴露新事实信息会作为知识退化的副产物增加对预训练知识的幻觉，需要在不牺牲事实学习的前提下抑制这类错误。
Method: 提出基于自蒸馏的 SFT 方法，通过正则化输出分布漂移 (output-distribution drift) 约束对既有知识的幻觉；另在无需获取新知识时冻结参数组以抑制事实可塑性 (factual plasticity)；并对比容量限制、行为克隆 (behavior cloning) 与局部干扰三种机制，用联想记忆模型 (associative-memory model) 解释。
Result: 实验显示主要驱动因素是重叠语义表征之间的干扰，自蒸馏可缓解该干扰，联想记忆模型给出遗忘随新旧事实重叠度增长的解释；冻结参数组在保持任务性能的同时减少幻觉。
Conclusion: 微调幻觉源于新旧知识表征重叠处的干扰而非单纯容量不足，因此用自蒸馏约束分布漂移、或在无需新知识时冻结参数，是可行的修复路径。

papers.title: HiFloat4 Format for Language Model Pre-training on Ascend NPUs
papers.abstract_en: Training large foundation models at low numerical precision is one of the most promising directions for reducing the compute and memory cost of modern AI. Recent 4-bit floating-point formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4 can be applied to linear GEMM operations in LLMs, but their limited dynamic range introduces numerical instability that prior work addresses by stacking stabilization mechanisms, typically executed at higher precision and partially eroding the efficiency gains that motivate FP4. In this work, we argue that numerical format design is itself a first-class lever for stable FP4 training, and present the first systematic study of FP4 LLM pretraining on energy-efficient Huawei Ascend NPUs. We compare the recently proposed HiFloat4 (HiF4) format against both MXFP4 and NVFP4, holding one recipe fixed across all three formats across dense (OpenPangu-1B, Llama3-8B) and Mixture-of-Experts (Qwen3-MoE-30B) architectures and executing all linear and expert GEMMs in FP4. At matched storage --- NVFP4 and HiF4 both spend 4.5 bits per value --- the three formats differ far more in what they require before they will train at all than in final accuracy. HiF4 reaches a relative loss of 1.55\% with no stabilization, below fully stabilized MXFP4 (1.79\%) and below NVFP4 carrying the per-tensor scaling it cannot train without (2.00\%); NVFP4 diverges under every combination of stochastic rounding and Hadamard transform we tried. Our results suggest that stable, accurate FP4 training does not require an ever-growing stack of stabilization techniques; it requires the right numerical format.

TL;DR: 在华为 Ascend NPU 上做首个 FP4 大模型预训练系统研究，固定同一训练配方对比 HiFloat4 (HiF4)、MXFP4、NVFP4，覆盖 dense (OpenPangu-1B、Llama3-8B) 与 MoE (Qwen3-MoE-30B) 架构的全部线性与专家 GEMM。HiF4 在完全不加稳定化机制时相对损失 1.55%，低于加满稳定化的 MXFP4 (1.79%) 与带 per-tensor scaling 的 NVFP4 (2.00%)；NVFP4 在所试的随机取整与 Hadamard 变换组合下全部发散。
Motivation: MXFP4、NVFP4 动态范围有限导致训练数值不稳，现有做法是叠加高精度执行的稳定化机制，反而侵蚀 FP4 想省下的算力与显存收益。
Method: 固定同一训练配方横向对比 HiF4、MXFP4、NVFP4 三种 4-bit 浮点格式，dense 模型用 OpenPangu-1B 与 Llama3-8B、MoE 用 Qwen3-MoE-30B，所有线性与专家 GEMM 均以 FP4 执行；NVFP4 与 HiF4 存储同为每值 4.5 bits。
Result: HiF4 无稳定化时相对损失 1.55%，MXFP4 加满稳定化为 1.79%，NVFP4 加其必需的 per-tensor scaling 为 2.00%；NVFP4 在所有尝试的 stochastic rounding 与 Hadamard transform 组合下发散。三种格式在最终精度上的差距，远小于它们在「能否训起来」所需前置条件上的差距。
Conclusion: 稳定准确的 FP4 训练不需要不断堆叠稳定化技术，而取决于选对数值格式本身；数值格式设计是 FP4 训练的一等杠杆。

papers.title: FlashSampling: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from a categorical distribution is mathematically simple, but in large-vocabulary decoding, it often triggers extra memory traffic and extra kernels after the LM head. We present FlashSampling, an exact sampling primitive that fuses sampling into the LM-head matmul and never materializes the logits tensor in HBM. The method is simple: compute logits tile-by-tile on chip, add Gumbel noise, keep only one maximizer per row and per vocabulary tile, and finish with a small reduction over tiles. In tensor-parallel decoding, FlashSampling replaces the all-gather of logits with streaming peer-to-peer writes: This overlaps GPU-to-GPU communication with computation and HBM loads across up to 8 GPUs, with near-ideal scaling at large batch sizes. Our kernel is exact because $\text{argmax}$ decomposes over partitions; grouped variants for online and tensor-parallel settings are exact by hierarchical factorization of the categorical distribution. FlashSampling demonstrates kernel-level speedups on decode workloads across 4 different datacenter GPUs (H100, H200, B200, B300), and in end-to-end vLLM experiments, it reduces time per output token by up to $10%$ on the models we test. These results show that exact sampling, with no approximation, can be integrated into the matmul itself, consolidating the bandwidth-bound sampling step in an efficient epilogue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashSampling 把大词表解码的采样融合进 LM-head matmul，片上逐 tile 算 logits、加 Gumbel 噪声、每行每 tile 只留一个 argmax，HBM 中从不物化 logits 张量。张量并行下用流式 peer-to-peer 写替代 logits all-gather，通信与计算重叠，最多 8 卡在大 batch 下接近线性扩展。在 4 种数据中心 GPU（H100、H200、B200、B300）上取得 kernel 级加速，vLLM 端到端每输出 token 时间最多降 10%，且 argmax 按分区可分解保证采样精确无近似。
Motivation: 大词表解码中，LM-head 之后的 categorical 采样会带来额外显存流量和额外 kernel，成为带宽瓶颈；张量并行还要 all-gather 整个 logits。
Method: 片上逐 tile 计算 logits 并加 Gumbel 噪声，每行与每个 vocab tile 只保留一个 maximizer，最后跨 tile 做小规模 reduction；张量并行下以流式 peer-to-peer 写替代 logits all-gather，重叠 GPU 间通信与 HBM 访问。精确性来自 argmax 在分区上的可分解性，在线与张量并行的 grouped 变体则由 categorical 分布的层级分解保证。
Result: 在 H100、H200、B200、B300 4 种数据中心 GPU 的 decode 负载上取得 kernel 级加速；vLLM 端到端实验中每输出 token 时间最多降低 10%；张量并行覆盖最多 8 卡，大 batch 下扩展接近理想。
Conclusion: 精确采样（无近似）可以直接并入 matmul 本身，把带宽受限的采样步骤收进高效 epilogue；正确性由 argmax 分区可分解与 categorical 层级分解保证。

papers.title: Patient-level validation of a foundation-model pipeline for pediatric lung sounds: physician-annotated adventitious events are recognized, disease groups are not reliably predicted
papers.abstract_en: Background: Lung-sound classifiers are usually evaluated on recording- or event-level splits, although each child contributes many recordings. We evaluated a foundation-model pipeline (PulmoVec) with the patient as the unit of partitioning and asked whether disease group can be predicted beyond age and sex. Methods: We analyzed 19693 physician-annotated respiratory events from 736 children in the public SPRSound database. A frozen Health Acoustic Representations (HeAR) encoder with low-rank adapters was trained for screening (normal versus adventitious), sound pattern (normal, crackles, wheeze/rhonchi) and disease group (pneumonia, bronchial disease, normal/other); event probabilities were stacked with age, sex and auscultation site. The primary analysis was nested patient-grouped cross-validation; comparators were the majority class, annotated event duration and demographics. Results: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) was 0.95 (95% CI 0.94 to 0.96) for both screening and sound pattern, against 0.78 and 0.75 for event duration alone; the positive predictive value for adventitious events was 0.72. Disease-group prediction reached an AUC of 0.58 (95% CI 0.54 to 0.62), and its accuracy was below the majority-class rate at event level (0.44 versus 0.62) and at patient level (0.46 versus 0.60). Conclusions: Recognition of physician-annotated adventitious events holds under patient-level validation and is not explained by event duration or demographics, although its positive predictive value would limit unaided use. Prediction of disease group, a clinical diagnosis, from lung-sound events alone was not demonstrated. Lung-sound studies should partition data by patient and report non-acoustic comparators.
papers.comment: v2 is substantially revised with a patient-level re-analysis (n=736) to correct v1's event-level data leakage. Acoustic event classification holds (AUC 0.95), but disease-group prediction is unsupported (AUC 0.58), superseding v1 conclusions. 17 pages, 4 figs, 3 tables; 32-page supplement appended
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结的 HeAR 编码器加 LoRA，在 SPRSound 上以患者为划分单位重做肺音分类：正常/异常筛查与声音模式（正常、crackles、wheeze/rhonchi）的 AUC 均为 0.95，明显高于仅用事件时长的 0.78 与 0.75；但疾病组预测 AUC 仅 0.58，准确率低于多数类基线。结论是肺音研究必须按患者划分数据并报告非声学对照。
Motivation: 肺音分类器多在录音或事件级划分上评估，而每个孩子贡献多条录音，事件级划分会泄漏到同一患者，导致性能被高估；同时缺少年龄、性别、事件时长等非声学对照，无法判断模型是否真的听到声学信息。
Method: 在 SPRSound 数据库的 19693 条医生标注呼吸事件（736 名儿童）上，用冻结的 Health Acoustic Representations (HeAR) 编码器加低秩适配器 (LoRA) 分别训练筛查、声音模式与疾病组三个任务；事件概率再与年龄、性别、听诊部位堆叠。主分析为嵌套的按患者分组交叉验证 (nested patient-grouped cross-validation)，对照为多数类、标注事件时长与人口学信息。
Result: 筛查与声音模式的 AUC 均为 0.95（95% CI 0.94–0.96），对照事件时长单独预测的 0.78 与 0.75；异常事件的阳性预测值 (PPV) 为 0.72。疾病组预测 AUC 0.58（95% CI 0.54–0.62），准确率在事件级 0.44 低于多数类 0.62、患者级 0.46 低于 0.60。
Conclusion: 医生标注的异常肺音事件在患者级验证下仍可被识别，且不被事件时长或人口学解释，但 0.72 的 PPV 限制其独立使用；仅凭肺音事件预测疾病组这一临床诊断未被证实。作者主张肺音研究按患者划分数据并报告非声学对照。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Architectural Physics Embedding for Large-Scale Wave Field Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale wave field reconstruction requires precise solutions but faces challenges with computational efficiency and accuracy. The physics-based numerical methods like Finite Element Method (FEM) provide high accuracy but struggle with large-scale or high-frequency problems due to prohibitive computational costs. Pure data-driven approaches excel in speed but often lack sufficient labeled data for complex scenarios. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) integrate physical principles into machine learning models, offering a promising solution by bridging these gaps. However, standard PINNs embed physical principles only in loss functions, leading to slow convergence, optimization instability, and spectral bias, limiting their ability for large-scale wave field reconstruction. This work introduces architectural physics embedded (PE)-PINN, which integrates additional physical guidance directly into the neural network architecture beyond Helmholtz equations and boundary conditions in loss functions. Specifically, a new envelope transformation layer is designed to mitigate spectral bias with kernels parameterized by source properties, material interfaces, and wave physics. Experiments demonstrate that PE-PINN achieves more than 10 times speedup in convergence compared to standard PINNs and several orders of magnitude reduction in memory usage compared to FEM. This breakthrough enables high-fidelity modeling for large-scale 2D/3D electromagnetic wave reconstruction involving reflections, refractions, and diffractions in room-scale domains, readily applicable to wireless communications, sensing, room acoustics, and other fields requiring large-scale wave field analysis.
papers.comment: Updated with more results, including ablation test and comparison to SOTA PINNs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PE-PINN 把物理引导直接嵌入网络架构而不只放在损失里，用由源特性、材料界面与波动物理参数化的 envelope transformation layer 抑制谱偏差。收敛速度比标准 PINN 快 10 倍以上，内存比 FEM 降低若干数量级，可做房间尺度 2D/3D 电磁波场重建。
Motivation: 标准 PINN 只把 Helmholtz 方程与边界条件写进损失，导致收敛慢、优化不稳与谱偏差，难以支撑大规模波场重建；FEM 精度高但对大规模或高频问题计算成本过高，纯数据驱动方法又缺标注数据。
Method: 提出 architectural physics embedded (PE)-PINN，在损失函数中的 Helmholtz 方程与边界条件之外，把额外物理引导嵌入网络架构；核心是新设计的 envelope transformation layer，其 kernel 由源特性、材料界面与波动物理参数化，以缓解谱偏差。
Result: 收敛速度比标准 PINN 提升 10 倍以上 (more than 10 times speedup)，内存使用相比 FEM 降低若干数量级 (several orders of magnitude)；arXiv comment 说明更新版补充了消融实验与和 SOTA PINNs 的对比。
Conclusion: 把物理约束从损失函数前移到架构本身，可在房间尺度 2D/3D 电磁波重建（含反射、折射、衍射）上同时拿到高保真与高效率，适用于无线通信、感知与房间声学等需要大规模波场分析的场景。

papers.title: SOCKET: SOft Collision Kernel EsTimator for Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Exploiting sparsity is key to efficient long-context inference, as attention dominates the cost of autoregressive decoding. Sparse attention reduces this cost by restricting computation to a subset of tokens, but its effectiveness hinges on fast and accurate token scoring and selection at inference time. Data-agnostic approaches offer an attractive way to perform this selection, but often incur substantial memory overhead to maintain high recall. We revisit Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) and introduce SOCKET, a SOft Collision Kernel EsTimator that replaces hard bucket matches with probabilistic, similarity-aware aggregation. Traditional LSH relies on binary collision signals, providing limited information for ranking tokens and necessitating many hash tables for accurate retrieval. In contrast, soft LSH accumulates graded collision evidence across hash tables, closely preserving the true top-$k$ ordering with significantly less memory. This reframes LSH from a candidate-generation mechanism into a principled scoring kernel for sparse attention. Building on this insight, SOCKET enables efficient token selection without ad hoc voting and matches or outperforms existing sparse attention methods across multiple long-context benchmarks and diverse language models. With a custom set of CUDA/Triton kernels for scoring, selection, and attention, SOCKET achieves up to approximately $1.5\times$ higher throughput than FlashAttention. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/amarka8/SOCKET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOCKET 把 LSH 的硬碰撞信号换成概率化的相似度感知聚合 (soft collision kernel)，直接作为稀疏注意力的 token 打分核，在长上下文推理中以更少内存保持 top-k 排序，并用自定义 CUDA/Triton kernel 实现约 1.5× 于 FlashAttention 的吞吐。
Motivation: 长上下文自回归解码中 attention 主导开销，稀疏注意力的效果取决于推理时 token 打分与选择的速度和精度；数据无关选择方式要维持高召回往往带来大量内存开销，而传统 LSH 的二值碰撞信号信息量少、需要很多哈希表。
Method: SOCKET 用软碰撞核替代硬桶匹配，跨哈希表累积分级碰撞证据来近似真实 top-k 排序，把 LSH 从候选生成机制改造成打分核，无需 ad hoc voting；打分、选择与 attention 均配自定义 CUDA/Triton kernel，代码已开源。
Result: 在多个长上下文 benchmark 与多种语言模型上，SOCKET 匹配或优于现有稀疏注意力方法；吞吐最高约为 FlashAttention 的 1.5×，同时以显著更少内存保持 top-k 排序。
Conclusion: 把 LSH 重构成概率化打分核，可以在不依赖投票机制的前提下兼顾 token 选择的召回与内存，从而提升长上下文推理吞吐。

papers.title: What If TSF: Reframing Time Series Forecasting as Scenario-Guided Multimodal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled time series forecasting to move beyond numerical observations and incorporate external information in multimodal settings. Such information can improve forecasting performance, but accuracy alone may not reveal whether models appropriately respond to it: a model may ignore relevant information, fail to distinguish scenarios with different implications, or overreact to irrelevant or weak signals. We introduce What If TSF (WIT), a benchmark for evaluating whether models effectively respond to future scenarios. WIT constructs controlled scenario sets by fixing the forecasting state while systematically varying future scenarios, enabling three complementary evaluations: Factual Comparison, which measures the predictive utility of factual scenario information; Relational Comparison, which evaluates whether forecasts satisfy expected direction, contrast, intensity, and restraint relations across scenarios; and Grounded Comparison, which assesses whether scenario-induced revision trajectories are empirically plausible relative to comparable real cases. Experiments show that factual accuracy gains do not consistently translate into appropriate responses to alternative scenarios, demonstrating the need to evaluate multimodal forecasting beyond predictive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: What If TSF (WIT) 把时间序列预报重构为场景引导的多模态预报评测基准：固定预报状态、系统变换未来场景，用 Factual、Relational、Grounded 三项互补评测检验模型是否恰当响应场景信息。实验显示事实性精度增益并不稳定转化为对替代场景的恰当响应，说明仅看预测精度不足以判断多模态预报是否真的用上了外部信息。
Motivation: LLM 多模态时间序列预报引入外部信息后，精度指标无法区分模型是忽略了相关信息、混淆了不同含义的场景，还是对无关或弱信号过度反应。
Method: WIT 构造受控场景集：固定预报状态、系统变换未来场景，配套三项评测——Factual Comparison 度量事实场景信息的预测效用，Relational Comparison 检查预报是否满足跨场景的方向、对比、强度与克制关系，Grounded Comparison 评估场景引发的修订轨迹相对可比真实案例是否经验上合理。
Result: 实验显示事实准确性增益并不一致地转化为对替代场景的恰当响应，表明需要在预测精度之外评测多模态预报。
Conclusion: 多模态时间序列预报的评测必须超越预测精度，直接度量模型对场景信息的响应是否方向正确、强度适度且有现实依据。

papers.title: NC-Bench: An LLM Benchmark for Evaluating Conversational Competence
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM benchmarks evaluate what models say, such as whether answers are correct, faithful, or helpful, but they do not test whether models produce the right type of conversational action at the right point in an interaction. The Natural Conversation Benchmark (NC-Bench) fills this gap by evaluating conversational competence: the ability to perform structurally appropriate actions such as repairing, closing, or refusing, as defined by conversation science. Grounded in the Natural Conversation Framework (NCF), NC-Bench comprises three sets: (1) the basic set evaluates fundamental sequence management practices, such as answering inquiries, repairing responses, and closing conversational pairs; (2) the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) set applies the same patterns but incorporates information-seeking via RAG; (3) the complex request set extends to requests involving more intricate sequence management. Each set tests a model's ability to produce contextually appropriate conversational actions in response to characteristic interaction patterns. Evaluations across six open-source models and one closed-source model on 14 interaction patterns reveal quantifiable shortcomings in conversational competence present in current models. By operationalizing fundamental principles of human conversation, NC-Bench provides a lightweight, extensible, and theory-grounded framework for identifying specific conversational action gaps in LLMs beyond topical or task-specific benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NC-Bench 用会话科学定义的 Natural Conversation Framework 把「在正确时机做出正确类型的会话动作」（修复、收尾、拒绝等）变成可测指标，而非只判答案对错。在 6 个开源模型加 1 个闭源模型、14 种交互模式上评测，量化出当前模型在会话动作上的系统性短板。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基准只评模型说了什么（正确、忠实、有帮助），不测它是否在交互的恰当时刻产出恰当类型的会话动作，这类结构能力缺口无从定位。
Method: 以 Natural Conversation Framework (NCF) 为理论基础，NC-Bench 分三个集合：basic set 测基本序列管理（回答、修复、关闭相邻对），RAG set 在同样模式上加入信息检索式交互，complex request set 覆盖更复杂的序列管理；每个集合针对特征性交互模式出题。
Result: 在 6 个开源模型与 1 个闭源模型、14 种交互模式上评测，得到可量化的会话能力短板；框架被描述为轻量、可扩展、理论驱动。
Conclusion: 把人类会话的基本原则操作化后，可以在话题或任务型基准之外，定位 LLM 具体缺哪一类会话动作。

papers.title: Manifold limit for the training of shallow graph convolutional neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We study the discrete-to-continuum consistency of the training of shallow graph convolutional neural networks (GCNNs) on proximity graphs of sampled point clouds under a manifold assumption. Graph convolution is defined spectrally via the graph Laplacian, whose low-frequency spectrum approximates that of the Laplace-Beltrami operator of the underlying smooth manifold, and shallow GCNNs of possibly infinite width are linear functionals on the space of measures on the parameter space. From this functional-analytic perspective, graph signals are seen as spatial discretizations of functions on the manifold, which leads to a natural notion of training data consistent across graph resolutions. To enable convergence results, the continuum parameter space is chosen as a weakly compact product of unit balls, with Sobolev regularity imposed on the output weight and bias, but not on the convolutional parameter. The corresponding discrete parameter spaces inherit the corresponding spectral decay, and are additionally restricted by a frequency cutoff adapted to the informative spectral window of the graph Laplacians. Under these assumptions, we prove $Γ$-convergence of regularized empirical risk minimization functionals and corresponding convergence of their global minimizers, in the sense of weak convergence of the parameter measures and uniform convergence of the functions over compact sets. This provides a formalization of mesh and sample independence, and hence of transferability across discretizations, for the training of such networks.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Extensive revision and added numerical results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在流形假设下证明浅层图卷积网络 (GCNN) 训练的离散到连续一致性：把无限宽浅层 GCNN 视为参数空间测度上的线性泛函，证明带正则的经验风险泛函 Γ-收敛，且全局极小元按参数测度弱收敛、函数在紧集上一致收敛。这为跨网格与跨采样分辨率的可迁移性 (transferability) 给出形式化。
Motivation: 图卷积网络在点云邻近图上训练时，离散化分辨率一变，训练问题本身也随之改变，缺少把不同网格/采样下的训练结果联系起来的严格框架。
Method: 谱定义图卷积（图 Laplacian 低频谱逼近底层 Laplace–Beltrami 算子），把浅层 GCNN 写成参数空间测度上的线性泛函；连续参数空间取单位球的弱紧乘积，对输出权重与偏置施加 Sobolev 正则、对卷积参数不施加，离散参数空间继承谱衰减并加自适应频率截断；证明正则化经验风险泛函的 Γ-收敛。
Result: 证明了正则化经验风险泛函的 Γ-收敛以及相应全局极小元的收敛，即参数测度弱收敛、函数在紧集上一致收敛；训练数据被构造为跨图分辨率一致。arXiv 注记称修订版含扩展数值结果与 1 张表。
Conclusion: 在流形与谱正则假设下，浅层 GCNN 的训练是网格无关、采样无关的，因而可跨离散化迁移。

papers.title: Deep Delta Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transformer residual streams are updated by addition. A sufficiently expressive residual block can represent content replacement, but the residual update itself has no operation that reads, compares, and replaces content. We introduce Deep Delta Learning (DDL), which applies the delta rule over network depth. Each layer reads the residual state along a learned direction, compares the readout with a learned target, and writes a gated rank-1 correction back along the same direction. A closed gate gives the identity map, and a unit gate overwrites the selected readout with the target. DDL works with the usual vector state or with an expanded state that stores several value channels, while attention and MLP blocks keep the original model width. We pretrain decoder-only models with approximately GPT-2 small and medium sizes on the FineWeb-Edu dataset. At both scales, every DDL variant has lower validation loss and higher average one-shot accuracy than the additive baseline, and the best expanded variants raise that average by 0.91 and 1.18 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 delta rule 从时间维搬到网络深度：每层沿学到的方向读出残差状态、与学到的目标比较，再写回门控的 rank-1 修正，门为零即恒等映射、门为 1 则用目标覆盖所读分量。在 GPT-2 small/medium 规模、FineWeb-Edu 预训练上，所有 DDL 变体的验证损失都低于加性基线，最优 expanded 变体把平均 one-shot 准确率分别抬高 0.91 和 1.18 个百分点。
Motivation: Transformer 残差流只做加法：残差块虽能表达内容替换，但更新本身没有“读—比较—替换”的操作，深度方向上缺少显式的内容覆写机制。
Method: Deep Delta Learning (DDL) 在每层沿学习方向读出残差状态，将读出与学习目标比较后写回门控 rank-1 修正；状态可为普通向量或存储多个 value channel 的 expanded state，attention 与 MLP 块保持原模型宽度。decoder-only 模型按 GPT-2 small 与 medium 规模在 FineWeb-Edu 上预训练，对比加性基线。
Result: 两个规模上所有 DDL 变体的验证损失均低于加性基线、平均 one-shot 准确率更高；最优 expanded 变体把该平均值分别提高 0.91 与 1.18 个百分点（对应 small 与 medium）。
Conclusion: 在残差更新中显式加入读—比较—替换的 delta 式操作，可在同等宽度下同时改善语言模型的验证损失与 one-shot 准确率，且 expanded state 变体收益最大。

papers.title: ABFR-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Functional Brain Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Functional connectivity (FC) analysis, a valuable tool for computer-aided brain disorder diagnosis, traditionally relies on atlas-based parcellation. However, issues relating to selection bias and a lack of regard for subject specificity can arise as a result of such parcellations. Addressing this, we propose ABFR-KAN, a transformer-based classification network that incorporates novel advanced brain function representation components with the power of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to mitigate structural bias, improve anatomical conformity, and enhance the reliability of FC estimation. Extensive experiments on the ABIDE I dataset, including cross-site evaluation and ablation studies across varying model backbones and KAN configurations, demonstrate that ABFR-KAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines for autism spectrum distorder (ASD) classification. Our code is available at https://github.com/tbwa233/ABFR-KAN.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:031
papers.journal_ref: Machine.Learning.for.Biomedical.Imaging. 2026 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ABFR-KAN：基于 Transformer、用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 构建脑功能表征组件，绕开 atlas 分区做功能连接 (FC) 估计，以缓解结构偏倚并提升个体特异性。在 ABIDE I 的 ASD 分类上，含跨站点评估与多骨干/KAN 配置消融，一致优于现有 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 基于 atlas 的分区做功能连接分析会引入选择偏倚、且忽略个体差异，影响计算机辅助脑障碍诊断的可靠性。
Method: Transformer 分类网络，结合新的脑功能表征组件与 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN)，直接估计 FC 以规避 atlas parcellation；实验覆盖不同模型骨干与 KAN 配置的消融及跨站点评估。
Result: 在 ABIDE I 数据集上做 ASD 分类，含跨站点评估与跨骨干、跨 KAN 配置的消融研究，ABFR-KAN 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基线。
Conclusion: 用 KAN 增强的个体化脑功能表征替代 atlas 分区，可缓解结构偏倚、提升 FC 估计可靠性，从而在 ASD 分类上稳定超过现有方法。

papers.title: Bregman geometry-aware split Gibbs sampling for Bayesian Poisson inverse problems
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel Bayesian framework for solving Poisson inverse problems by devising a Monte Carlo sampling algorithm which accounts for the underlying non-Euclidean geometry. To address the challenges posed by the Poisson likelihood -- such as non-Lipschitz gradients and positivity constraints -- we derive a Bayesian model which leverages exact and asymptotically exact data augmentations. In particular, the augmented model incorporates two sets of splitting variables both derived through a Bregman divergence based on the Burg entropy. Interestingly the resulting augmented posterior distribution is characterized by conditional distributions which benefit from natural conjugacy properties and preserve the intrinsic geometry of the latent and splitting variables. This allows for efficient sampling via Gibbs steps, which can be performed explicitly for all conditionals, except the one incorporating the regularization potential. For this latter, we resort to a Hessian Riemannian Langevin Monte Carlo (HRLMC) algorithm which is well suited to handle priors with explicit or easily computable score functions. By operating on a mirror manifold, this Langevin step ensures that the sampling satisfies the positivity constraints and more accurately reflects the underlying problem structure. Performance results obtained on denoising, deblurring, and positron emission tomography (PET) experiments demonstrate that the method achieves competitive performance in terms of reconstruction quality compared to optimization- and sampling-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Poisson 逆问题的非 Lipschitz 梯度与正值约束，提出基于 Bregman 几何的 split Gibbs 采样器：用 Burg 熵导出的两组分裂变量做精确/渐近精确数据增广，使各条件分布自然共轭，正则项条件用 Hessian Riemannian Langevin Monte Carlo (HRLMC) 在 mirror manifold 上采样以保持正值。在去噪、去模糊与 PET 重建实验中，重建质量相对优化类与采样类方法具有竞争力。
Motivation: Poisson 似然带来非 Lipschitz 梯度与正值约束，欧氏采样器难以在保持约束的同时高效后验采样。
Method: 推导基于 Bregman divergence（Burg 熵）的两组分裂变量的数据增广 Bayesian 模型，使条件分布具自然共轭并保留潜变量与分裂变量的内在几何；除含正则势的条件外全部用显式 Gibbs 步，该条件改用 Hessian Riemannian Langevin Monte Carlo (HRLMC)，在 mirror manifold 上满足正值约束。
Result: 在 denoising、deblurring 与 positron emission tomography (PET) 三类实验上，重建质量相对基于优化与基于采样的方法达到有竞争力的水平。
Conclusion: 把 Poisson 逆问题的正值约束与几何结构编码进分裂变量和 mirror manifold 上的 Langevin 步，可在显式 Gibbs 采样下取得有竞争力的重建质量。
Relevance: 18
