papers.title: Dynamic Buffers: Cost-Efficient Planning for Tabletop Rearrangement with Stacking
papers.abstract_en: Rearranging objects in cluttered tabletop environments remains a long-standing challenge in robotics. Classical planners often generate inefficient, high-cost plans by moving objects individually and using fixed buffers, temporary spaces such as unoccupied tabletop regions or static stacks, to resolve conflicts. When only free tabletop locations are used as buffers, planning in dense scenes becomes difficult, since placing an object can prevent others from reaching their goals and complicate subsequent planning. Stacking provides additional buffer capacity, but conventional stacking is static: the base object cannot be relocated while holding another, which limits efficiency. To address these limitations, a novel planning primitive called the Dynamic Buffer is introduced. Inspired by human grouping strategies, it enables robots to form temporary, movable stacks that can be transported as a unit. Dynamic buffers improve feasibility and efficiency in dense layouts and reduce travel in large-scale scenarios where buffer space is ample. Compared with a state-of-the-art rearrangement planner, the proposed approach reduces total manipulator travel cost by 13.48% in dense stationary-manipulator scenarios and by 4.34% in large-scale, low-density scenarios involving mobile manipulators. Practicality is validated through execution on a Delta robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. These results establish dynamic buffering as a key primitive for cost-efficient and robust rearrangement planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出桌面重排规划原语 Dynamic Buffer：机器人可把多个物体临时堆成可整体搬运的堆栈，替代只能用空闲桌面区域或静态堆叠做缓冲的经典做法。相比 SOTA 重排规划器，密集固定机械臂场景下总机械臂行程成本降 13.48%，大规模低密度移动机械臂场景降 4.34%，并在 Delta 机器人加平行夹爪上实机执行验证。
Motivation: 经典规划器逐个搬动物体并用固定缓冲区消解冲突；只用空闲桌面区域时，密集场景中放置一个物体会挡住其他物体到达目标，静态堆叠的底座物体又不能在托着别的物体时移动，导致规划低效甚至不可行。
Method: 引入 Dynamic Buffer 规划原语，受人类分组策略启发，允许机器人形成可作为整体运输的临时可移动堆栈，从而在密集布局中提升可行性与效率、在缓冲空间充裕的大规模场景中减少行程；与一个 SOTA 重排规划器对比，并在 Delta 机器人与平行夹爪上执行验证。
Result: 相对 SOTA 重排规划器，密集固定机械臂场景总机械臂行程成本降低 13.48%，大规模低密度移动机械臂场景降低 4.34%；实用性通过 Delta 机器人配平行夹爪的实机执行得到验证。
Conclusion: 动态缓冲（可移动堆栈）是成本高效且鲁棒的重排规划关键原语：密集场景提升可行性与效率，缓冲充足的大规模场景减少行程。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SHEFL: Sparse Heterogeneous Ensemble Federated Learning with Group-Balanced Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: System heterogeneity in federated learning (FL) requires training workloads and communication demands to be adapted to client resource capacities. Federated ensemble learning distributes multiple predictors across clients, but assigning one ensemble member to each client reduces the number of contributors to each member as the ensemble grows. We propose SHEFL, a global ensemble-based FL framework that uses the additional computation of high-power clients (HPCs) to train all ensemble members while low-power clients (LPCs) train one assigned member. SHEFL addresses increased HPC uplink demand and biased aggregation toward HPC updates through resource-aware sparse update allocation and group-balanced aggregation. Across four vision datasets, SHEFL improves over Fed-Ensemble (FedEns) in all data heterogeneity settings. Under a matched total uplink budget, SHEFL reaches the target accuracy in fewer rounds than FedEns and improves final accuracy by up to 14.65 points. Ablations further show that group-balanced aggregation improves accuracy and convergence under different resource allocations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHEFL 在系统异构的联邦集成学习中让高算力客户端 (HPCs) 训练全部集成成员、低算力客户端 (LPCs) 只训一个成员，用资源感知的稀疏更新分配和分组平衡聚合 (group-balanced aggregation) 抵消 HPC 上行压力与聚合偏置。在四个视觉数据集、全部数据异质设置下均优于 Fed-Ensemble，匹配总上行预算时更少轮次达到目标精度，最终精度最多提高 14.65 个百分点。
Motivation: 联邦集成学习中每个客户端分配一个成员会随集成增大而减少每个成员的贡献者数量；同时客户端算力异构导致上行负载与聚合更新向高算力客户端偏斜。
Method: SHEFL 让 HPCs 训练全部集成成员、LPCs 训练各自指派的一个成员；用资源感知稀疏更新分配控制 HPC 上行需求，用分组平衡聚合 (group-balanced aggregation) 抑制对 HPC 更新的偏置，并做不同资源分配下的消融。
Result: 在四个视觉数据集上，SHEFL 在所有数据异质设置下均优于 Fed-Ensemble (FedEns)；在匹配总上行预算下用更少通信轮次达到目标精度，最终精度最多提高 14.65 个百分点；消融显示分组平衡聚合在不同资源分配下同时改善精度与收敛。
Conclusion: 把额外算力集中到 HPCs 训练全部成员、再用分组平衡聚合纠正偏置，可在同等上行预算下比 FedEns 更快更准地训练联邦集成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Searching for Actual Causes: Approximate Algorithms with Adjustable Precision
papers.abstract_en: Causality has gained increasing attention in recent years, notably for improving the interpretability of machine learning models. Yet the field of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) has been criticized for emphasizing general tendencies rather than the situation-specific facts, which users typically expect as explanations. These expectations align with the notion of actual causes, which identify what made the observed outcome happen, in the specific context at hand. Halpern and Pearl provided a formal basis for actual causation, but identifying actual causes is NP-complete. Practical identification algorithms are extremely scarce, restricted to narrow classes of models, and typically identify only the shortest cause. We address this gap between the formal theory and its applicability through two main contributions. First, we introduce a baseline approximate polynomial-time algorithm with adjustable precision, together with two complementary algorithms that improve its efficiency. Second, we provide a theoretical result showing that the actual-cause identification problem can be decomposed into smaller sub-instances that preserve the set of solutions. This result directly motivates one of the complementary algorithms. Our experiments demonstrate that the baseline method can approximate the set of actual causes, notably for non-Boolean and stochastic models, and that the complementary algorithms further improve its performance in most cases.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (09/2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=3NlYZPCH9v. Code: https://github.com/SamuelReyd/SearchingForCauses
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Halpern-Pearl 实际原因 (actual cause) 识别的 NP-complete 问题，提出一个精度可调的多项式时间近似基线算法及两个提升效率的互补算法，并证明该问题可分解为保持解集的更小子实例。实验表明基线方法能近似实际原因集合，尤其适用于非布尔与随机模型，互补算法在多数情况下进一步提升性能。
Motivation: XAI 常给出一般性倾向而非用户期待的情境化事实解释；Halpern-Pearl 理论虽形式化了 actual cause，但识别是 NP-complete，现有实用算法极少、局限于狭窄模型类别且通常只找最短原因。
Method: 提出精度可调的多项式时间近似基线算法，加上两个互补的效率改进算法；另一贡献是证明实际原因识别可分解为保持解集的子实例，该理论结果直接导出其中一个互补算法；在非布尔与随机模型上做实验。
Result: 基线方法能近似实际原因集合，在非布尔和随机模型上尤为有效；两个互补算法在多数情况下进一步提升性能。
Conclusion: 精度可调的近似加子实例分解，可把实际原因识别从 NP-complete 的精确求解推向可扩展的实用算法，覆盖非布尔与随机模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bidirectional Information Flow (BIF) - A Sample Efficient Hierarchical Gaussian Process for Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Gaussian Process (H-GP) models divide problems into different subtasks, allowing different components to address each part, making them well-suited for problems with inherent compositional structure. However, existing H-GP frameworks typically employ one-way information sharing - either top-down or bottom-up - which limits sample efficiency and slows convergence. We propose Bidirectional Information Flow (BIF), which establishes continuous two-way communication. BIF retains the modular structure of hierarchical models-the parent conditions its own posterior on child summaries, treating them as structured priors-while introducing top-down feedback to softly decompose environment observations from the parent into sub-responses. This mutual exchange improves sample efficiency, enables robust training, and allows modular reuse of learned subtask models. We prove analytically that the regret of a GP with a learned kernel scales linearly with the mismatch to the true kernel, tightening in the hierarchical case to the sum of child-level errors. Ablation shows that removing the downward pathway collapses child $R^2$ by up to 58%. Across synthetic, neurostimulation, and HPO benchmarks, BIF achieves up to $4\times$ higher parent $R^2$ and $\sim 100\%$ AUC improvement over vanilla GPBO, and outscores all hierarchical state-of-the-art methods on child $R^2$ given the correct acquisition function, while supporting modular child transfer to novel composite tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BIF 让分层高斯过程 (H-GP) 的父层与子层持续双向通信：父层把子层摘要当作结构化先验来条件自身后验，同时自顶向下把环境观测软分解为子响应。去掉下行通路会使子任务 R² 最多崩掉 58%；在合成、神经刺激与 HPO 基准上，BIF 相对 vanilla GPBO 取得最高 4 倍父层 R² 与约 100% 的 AUC 提升。
Motivation: 现有 H-GP 框架只做单向信息共享（自顶向下或自底向上），限制样本效率并拖慢收敛，学习到的子任务模型也无法复用到新的复合任务。
Method: BIF 保留分层模型的模块结构：父层把子层摘要作为结构化先验条件自身后验，并新增自顶向下反馈，把父层的环境观测软分解为各子响应，形成持续双向交换。理论上证明学习核 GP 的 regret 随与真实核的失配线性增长，在分层情形收紧为各子层误差之和；实验覆盖合成、神经刺激 (neurostimulation) 与超参优化 (HPO) 三类基准，并做消融。
Result: 消融显示移除下行通路使子任务 R² 最多下降 58%；在合成、神经刺激与 HPO 基准上，BIF 相对 vanilla GPBO 取得最高 4 倍父层 R² 与约 100% 的 AUC 提升；在配合适当采集函数 (acquisition function) 时，子层 R² 打分超过全部分层 SOTA 方法，并支持把子模型模块化迁移到新的复合任务。
Conclusion: 双向信息流是分层 GP 提升样本效率与训练稳健性的关键，且学到的子任务模型可模块化复用；regret 上界表明分层误差可加性使性能随子层精度收紧。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Help Me Help You: The Aggregate Value of Source and Target Data in Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transfer learning, in regression or classification, concerns problems where one aims to use imperfect data from a source distribution $P$ to improve prediction w.r.t. a target distribution $Q$. While there is now much theoretical understanding of the unsupervised setting of this problem (where no labeled target data is available), the supervised setting with labeled target data remains under-studied. We identify and characterize an interesting dichotomy in the rates achievable in the supervised setting: there is a weak transfer regime where optimal rates are determined by information in either the source or target dataset but not both, and a strong transfer regime where much faster target rates are achievable, accounting for complementary information in source and target data. Furthermore, while previous theoretical tools for the unsupervised setting can be extended to capture the weak transfer regime, we argue that they cannot capture the strong regime due to limitations inherent in the various notions of relatedness they rely on. Instead, we provide an appropriate refinement of relatedness notions---termed weak and strong moduli of transfer---that reveal the two regimes and lead to a nontrivial characterization of which pairs of distributions $P$ and $Q$ adhere to which regime. Finally, the above dichotomy reveals a new categorization of existing algorithmic approaches in terms of their optimality or lack-thereof across supervised regimes, and we provide a generic approach that remains nearly optimal in all regimes without prior distributional knowledge.
papers.comment: This is a revision of a work previously posted to arXiv in 2024 by the same authors under the same arXiv number with a different title. The current version is revised to better highlight the key contributions. No AI was used in the production of this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有标签目标数据的监督迁移学习中，作者证明存在弱迁移与强迁移两种速率机制：弱迁移下最优速率只由源或目标单侧数据的信息决定，强迁移下源与目标的互补信息可带来快得多的目标速率。为此提出弱/强迁移模数 (weak and strong moduli of transfer) 这一相关性概念的细化，给出分布对 (P,Q) 落入哪个机制的非平凡刻画，并据此重新归类既有算法，给出在所有机制下无需先验分布知识仍近似最优的通用方法。
Motivation: 无监督迁移学习（目标无标签）已有大量理论，而有标签目标数据的监督迁移学习研究不足；既有相关性概念只能刻画弱迁移，无法解释源与目标互补信息带来的更快目标速率。
Method: 提出弱迁移模数与强迁移模数 (weak and strong moduli of transfer) 作为相关性概念的细化，据此对分布对 (P,Q) 刻画所属机制；用该二分法对既有算法按在各监督机制下的最优性重新分类，并给出一个无需先验分布知识的通用算法。
Result: 刻画出弱迁移机制（最优速率由源或目标单侧信息决定）与强迁移机制（目标速率可快得多，利用源与目标的互补信息）的二分，并给出哪些 (P,Q) 对落入哪一机制的非平凡刻画；论证既有无监督工具可扩展到弱机制但因内在局限无法覆盖强机制。
Conclusion: 监督迁移学习的速率由弱/强迁移模数决定的两种机制区分，通用方法可在缺乏分布先验时于所有机制下保持近似最优。

papers.title: Improving Causal Effect Estimation of Weighted RegressionBased Estimator using Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects from observational data informs us about which factors are important in an autonomous system, and enables us to take better decisions. This is important because it has applications in selecting a treatment in medical systems or making better strategies in industries or making better policies for our government or even the society. Unavailability of complete data, coupled with high cardinality of data, makes this estimation task computationally intractable. Recently, a regression-based weighted estimator has been introduced that is capable of producing solution using bounded samples of a given problem. However, as the data dimension increases, the solution produced by the regression-based method degrades. Against this background, we introduce a neural network based estimator that improves the solution quality in case of non-linear and finitude of samples. Finally, our empirical evaluation illustrates a significant improvement of solution quality, up to around $55\%$, compared to the state-of-the-art estimators.

TL;DR: 针对观测数据中因果效应估计在高维、样本有限时退化的问题，提出基于神经网络的加权回归估计器改进方案，在非线性与有限样本条件下提升解质量，经验评估显示相对现有最优估计器最高约 55% 的改进。

papers.title: Optimal transport meets speech: a tutorial review
papers.abstract_en: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for comparing and transforming probability distributions while preserving geometric structure. Recently, OT has gained significant attention in machine learning due to its ability to measure discrepancies between distributions, even when their supports do not overlap, making it effective for tasks such as generative modeling, domain adaptation, and transfer learning. Despite its success in fields such as computer vision and natural language processing, OT remains relatively underexplored in speech research. Speech signals present unique challenges, including temporal dynamics, speaker variability, noise, reverberation, and heterogeneous multimodal representations involving audio, text, and visual information. These factors often lead to distribution mismatches, where OT offers a natural framework for alignment and interpretation. This work aims to promote broader adoption of OT in speech processing by: (1) reviewing OT foundations through intuitive physical interpretations and highlighting connections to modern generative models; (2) presenting computational algorithms suitable for deep learning frameworks; and (3) demonstrating OT applications in cross-domain and cross-modal speech tasks, including speech enhancement, automatic speech recognition, language and speaker recognition, and audio spoof detection. We highlight OT's strong potential for addressing distributional variations in real-world speech applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇把最优传输 (Optimal Transport, OT) 引入语音处理的教程综述：以物理直觉讲 OT 基础及其与现代生成模型的联系，给出适配深度学习框架的计算算法，并展示其在跨域跨模态语音任务中的应用。核心主张是 OT 能在支撑集不重合时度量分布差异，因而是对齐语音中时序动态、说话人差异、噪声混响与多模态异构表示所导致分布失配的自然框架。
Motivation: OT 在计算机视觉与 NLP 中已广泛应用，但在语音研究中相对未被充分探索；语音的时序动态、说话人可变性、噪声混响以及音频-文本-视觉异构多模态表征常造成分布失配，需要一个能对齐并解释这些差异的原理性框架。
Method: 教程综述分三部分推进：以直观物理解释梳理 OT 基础并指出其与现代生成模型的联系；介绍适用于深度学习框架的 OT 计算算法；展示 OT 在跨域与跨模态语音任务中的应用，涵盖语音增强、自动语音识别、语言与说话人识别、音频反欺骗检测 (audio spoof detection)。
Result: 综述性工作，给出 OT 在语音处理中的基础、算法与应用脉络，主张 OT 在支撑集不重合时仍可度量分布差异，适用于上述跨域跨模态语音任务；摘要未给出实验数值。
Conclusion: OT 对处理真实世界语音应用中的分布变化具有强潜力，值得在语音处理中更广泛地采用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Convergence-Aware Pareto Selection of Covariate Scaling Transformations for Markov Deterioration Hazard Models: Evidence from Bridge Inspection Data
papers.abstract_en: Maximum likelihood estimation of Markov deterioration hazard models for infrastructure asset management is sensitive to the numerical conditioning of explanatory covariates, yet production pipelines often adopt a single scaling convention without systematic justification. We study four covariate scaling transformations---baseline max scaling, min-max scaling, z-score scaling, and Box-Cox transformation with a training-derived positivity shift---applied to an Exponential Hazard Markov (EHM) model estimated via L-BFGS-B on bridge inspection transition data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对桥梁检测数据上的指数风险 Markov 劣化模型 (Exponential Hazard Markov, EHM)，系统比较四种协变量缩放：baseline max、min-max、z-score，以及带训练集推导正值平移的 Box-Cox。用 L-BFGS-B 做极大似然估计时，缩放选择会改变数值条件性与收敛表现，作者提出以收敛感知的 Pareto 准则在这些目标之间选缩放方案。
Motivation: 基础设施资产劣化模型的极大似然估计对协变量数值条件性敏感，而生产流水线通常不加论证地固定一种缩放约定，缺少系统性的选择依据。
Method: 在桥梁检测转移数据上估计 EHM 模型，用 L-BFGS-B 做极大似然；比较 baseline max scaling、min-max scaling、z-score scaling 与带训练集推导正值平移的 Box-Cox 变换四种协变量缩放，并以收敛感知的 Pareto 准则在多个目标间做选择。
Result: 论文给出四种缩放变换在桥梁检测转移数据上的收敛感知 Pareto 比较，含 19 页、2 图、5 表；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 协变量缩放不应默认沿用单一约定，而应按收敛与数值条件性的 Pareto 权衡针对具体劣化模型选择。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Acoustic Pedestrian Detection
papers.abstract_en: Audio-only pedestrian detection is attractive for urban sensing but limited by weak acoustic cues. An appealing strategy is cross-modal knowledge distillation, in which a video teacher supervises the audio student during training so that the deployed model runs on audio alone. Under this task's severe class imbalance and wide video-audio modality gap, however, what such distillation contributes is unclear. We introduce Trust-Filtered Distillation (TFD), which selectively suppresses teacher supervision on pedestrian samples, and interpret its logit formulation as conditional label smoothing under a shared temperature. Across ten distillation configurations under five-fold cross-session validation on ASPED, most methods yield modest gains in macro accuracy accompanied by small changes in PR-AUC. The main effect is higher no-pedestrian accuracy at the cost of lower pedestrian recall. Adding TFD to logit distillation strengthens this trade-off without improving mean PR-AUC. These findings clarify the benefits and limitations of selective cross-modal supervision by distinguishing operating-point shifts from discrimination gains in imbalanced acoustic detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在纯音频行人检测的跨模态蒸馏中，提出 Trust-Filtered Distillation (TFD)，选择性抑制对行人样本的教师监督，并把其 logit 形式解释为共享温度下的条件标签平滑。在 ASPED 上做五折跨会话验证的十种蒸馏配置中，多数方法只带来 macro accuracy 小幅提升、PR-AUC 变化很小，主要效应是提高 no-pedestrian 准确率同时降低行人召回；叠加 TFD 会强化这一取舍而不改善平均 PR-AUC。
Motivation: 纯音频行人检测声学线索弱、类别极不平衡，视频教师到音频学生的跨模态蒸馏在模态差距大时究竟带来什么收益并不清楚，需要区分工作点移动与判别力提升。
Method: 以视频教师监督音频学生 (cross-modal knowledge distillation)，提出 Trust-Filtered Distillation (TFD) 选择性抑制对行人样本的教师监督，其 logit 形式在共享温度下等价于条件标签平滑；在 ASPED 上比较十种蒸馏配置，采用五折跨会话验证。
Result: 十种蒸馏配置中多数只带来 modest 的 macro accuracy 提升，PR-AUC 变化很小；主要效应是 no-pedestrian accuracy 升高而 pedestrian recall 下降；在 logit 蒸馏上加入 TFD 进一步强化该取舍，平均 PR-AUC 未改善。
Conclusion: 选择性跨模态监督在不平衡声学检测中主要移动分类工作点而非提升判别力，评估此类方法须把 operating-point shift 与 discrimination gain 分开看。

papers.title: Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在 16 个家族的 176 个 LLM checkpoint 上，单 witness 测试用 Frobenius cosine 定向父子决策正确率 95.3%；另评估根识别、兄弟节点区分、向 VLM 与 diffusion 家族的泛化以及链式排序；信号对权重噪声与稀疏剪枝稳健，SVD 权重降维变体比 Frobenius cosine 更稳健。

papers.title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSP-DiT 把全景场景程序 (panoptic scene program) 作为一等潜在变量与图像 latent 联合去噪，用全景对齐与循环一致性目标把实例、属性、关系、计数绑定到生成图像的视觉支撑上。在匹配训练与推理设置下，它在 GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score、DetailMaster 上超过强 flat-text 基线，计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系和长结构化提示提升最大，同时保持画质、推理开销适度、对不完美场景程序稳健。
Motivation: 文本到图像模型在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间顺序与角色敏感关系的组合式提示上仍然失败，因为文本被当作单一控制信号而非结构化场景表示。
Method: PSP-DiT 采用 diffusion-transformer 架构，通过耦合的 transformer 流联合去噪图像 latent 与场景程序 latent；训练中加入全景 grounding 与 cycle-consistency 目标，把对象实例、属性、关系、计数约束到生成图像的视觉支撑。
Result: 在匹配训练与推理设置下，PSP-DiT 在 GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score、DetailMaster 四个组合性基准上均优于强 flat-text 基线，最大增益出现在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系与长结构化提示；同时保持图像质量，推理开销适度，并对不完美的场景程序保持稳健。
Conclusion: 把场景程序作为联合去噪的潜在变量而非外部控制或事后解析，可以在不牺牲画质的前提下系统性改善组合式文本到图像生成，且对程序噪声不敏感。

papers.title: Beyond MSE: Rician Likelihood Denoising for Self-Supervised Cardiac $T2$ and $T1ρ$ MRI
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance imaging involves an inherent trade-off among spatial resolution, acquisition time, and noise. This trade-off contributes to long scan times and high cost. Deep learning has improved image denoising, but cardiac MRI remains difficult because high-resolution, rapid acquisitions generally lack corresponding low-noise ground truth. Self-supervised denoising offers a potential solution by learning from noisy image pairs or even single noisy acquisitions. However, we show that Noise2Void-style blind-spot denoising, which uses a mean squared error (MSE) loss and assumes zero-mean, independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) noise, is poorly suited to MR magnitude images. When applied to short-axis $T2$-weighted and $T1ρ$-weighted cardiac MRI with synthetic Rician noise, it produces biased denoised images and biased parametric maps of $T2$ and $T1ρ$. To address this limitation, we formulate self-supervised denoising as maximum likelihood estimation under a known Rician noise model. This yields unbiased denoisers that are competitive with supervised baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Noise2Void 式盲点去噪用 MSE 损失并假设零均值 i.i.d. 噪声，用到 MR 幅值图上会给出有偏的去噪图像和有偏的 T2、T1ρ 参数图。作者把自监督去噪改写为已知 Rician 噪声模型下的最大似然估计，得到无偏去噪器，性能与有监督基线相当。
Motivation: 高分辨率快速心脏 MRI 通常没有对应的低噪声真值，自监督去噪是可行路径，但标准盲点损失的高斯噪声假设与 MR 幅值图的 Rician 噪声不匹配，导致参数图偏差。
Method: 在已知 Rician 噪声模型下把自监督去噪表述为最大似然估计 (MLE)，替代 Noise2Void 风格的 MSE 盲点损失，用于短轴 T2 加权与 T1ρ 加权心脏 MRI，噪声为合成 Rician 噪声。
Result: MSE 盲点去噪产生有偏的去噪图像以及有偏的 T2 与 T1ρ 参数图；Rician 似然 MLE 去噪器给出无偏结果，且与有监督基线相当。
Conclusion: MR 幅值图的自监督去噪应按 Rician 似然而非 MSE 来做，才能消除 T2、T1ρ 参数图的偏差并达到有监督水平。

papers.title: Suitable Measures for the Potential Operational Utility of AI NWP Rainfall Forecasts Over Africa
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based weather prediction is approaching the skill of physical numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems at a fraction of the computational cost. This is particularly promising for Africa, where rainfall extremes are intensifying and many forecasting centres lack the infrastructure to run physical models at extended lead times. We present a calibrated comparison of GraphCast, GenCast and the Functional Generative Network (FGN) against the physical NWP model IFS for rainfall prediction across Africa. Deterministic and probabilistic forecasts are postprocessed using Isotonic Distributional Regression and evaluated with the Continuous Ranked Probability Score against IMERG, RFEv2 and CHIRPS across seasons, wet and dry regimes, elevation zones and lead times. All models retain skill beyond climatology across most seasons and at extended lead times. AI models generally outperform IFS in wet regions, whereas IFS performs better in dry, high-elevation areas, where its finer resolution better represents orographic controls on rainfall. Across observational datasets and seasons, AI models achieve a median improvement of approximately 5% over IFS. GraphCast achieves calibrated skill comparable to the ensemble-based FGN, although FGN provides greater significant skill at longer lead times. These results highlight the potential of calibrated AI weather prediction to provide accessible and computationally efficient rainfall forecasts across Africa, while demonstrating the continuing importance of spatial resolution, ensemble design and regional characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Isotonic Distributional Regression (IDR) 校准后，GraphCast、GenCast、FGN 与物理模式 IFS 在非洲全境做降雨预报的对比显示：AI 模式在湿区普遍胜出，IFS 在干旱高海拔区因分辨率更细而占优，跨观测数据集与季节 AI 中位改进约 5%。GraphCast 达到与集合式 FGN 相当的校准技巧，但 FGN 在更长时效上显著技巧更高。
Motivation: 非洲降雨极端在加剧，许多预报中心缺乏在长时效运行物理模式的基础设施，需要判断 AI 降雨预报在该区域是否真正可用、在哪些区域可用。
Method: 对 GraphCast、GenCast、Functional Generative Network (FGN) 与 IFS 的确定性和概率预报统一用 Isotonic Distributional Regression 后处理，以 CRPS 为指标，对照 IMERG、RFEv2、CHIRPS 三套观测数据，按季节、湿/干区、海拔带和时效分层评估。
Result: 所有模式在多数季节和长时效上技巧均高于气候态；AI 模式在湿区一般优于 IFS，IFS 在干旱高海拔区更好；跨观测数据集与季节 AI 相对 IFS 中位改进约 5%；GraphCast 的校准技巧与集合式 FGN 相当，FGN 在更长时效上给出更高的显著技巧。
Conclusion: 校准后的 AI 降雨预报在非洲具备可用且算力廉价的技巧，但空间分辨率、集合设计和区域干湿特征决定了谁赢，湿区用 AI、干旱高海拔区仍需 IFS 的细分辨率。

papers.title: Timed Rule-Based Supervision of an End-to-End Autonomous Parking Policy
papers.abstract_en: We study whether a manually specified runtime supervisor can correct recurring failures of an existing end-to-end parking policy in a fixed CARLA parking lot. The vision-based Transformer architecture is inherited from Yang et al.; our contribution is a timed, rule-based Parametric Safety Shield (PSS) applied to its control outputs. The PSS uses hand-calibrated speed, position, and duration thresholds to intervene in observed failure modes, including boundary exits, delayed braking, and stalled or oscillatory control. In the reported closed-loop evaluation, 16 held-out target slots and six initial poses are each evaluated in four rounds (384 attempts per configuration). Target success increases from 327/384 (85.16%) for the retrained policy to 375/384 (97.66%) with the PSS; mean position and orientation errors among successful attempts are 0.21m and 0.33 degrees. These results show an improvement within this simulator setup. The repeated attempts share one map, vehicle, and sensor configuration, and the PSS uses simulator world coordinates; thus the results do not establish generalization to other lots or real vehicles, or a formal safety guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CARLA 固定停车场里，给视觉 Transformer 端到端泊车策略外挂一个手工标定阈值的计时规则安全护盾 (Parametric Safety Shield, PSS)，针对驶出边界、刹车滞后、停滞或振荡等失效模式直接干预控制输出。目标位成功率从重训练策略的 327/384 (85.16%) 提到 375/384 (97.66%)，成功尝试的平均位置与朝向误差为 0.21 m 和 0.33 度。
Motivation: 端到端泊车策略在固定场景中反复出现可归类的失效模式，而纯学习策略本身难以按规则纠正这些可预测错误。
Method: 沿用 Yang et al. 的视觉 Transformer 端到端泊车策略，输出端叠加计时规则 PSS：用手动标定的速度、位置与时长阈值判定失效并介入；在 CARLA 固定停车场做闭环评测，16 个目标车位 × 6 个初始位姿 × 每配置 4 轮，共 384 次尝试。
Result: 目标成功率由重训练策略 327/384 (85.16%) 升至加 PSS 的 375/384 (97.66%)；成功尝试的平均位置误差 0.21 m、平均朝向误差 0.33 度；每配置 384 次闭环尝试。
Conclusion: 在该单一仿真配置内，计时规则护盾能显著纠正端到端泊车策略的重复失效；作者明确指出结果不构成对其他停车场、实车的泛化，也不是形式化安全保证。

papers.title: PRIME-ANC: Path-Ratio-Informed Modeling for Efficient Neural Filter Synthesis in Active Noise Control
papers.abstract_en: Changes in listener acoustics require active noise control (ANC) filters to be redesigned for new acoustic paths. We introduce PRIME-ANC, a shared neural synthesizer that learns a bounded, path-dependent logmagnitude correction to a regularized path-ratio base. Minimum-phase reconstruction and truncation produce finite-impulse-response (FIR) filters; training optimizes their noise-control performance. Across ten random training/test splits per dataset, PRIME-ANC achieves average held-out one-third-octave reductions of 18.81 and 17.76 dB over 50 Hz-5 kHz on a ten-path dataset and a public earphone database, respectively. On original earphone measurements, it improves upon the path-ratio base by 7.89 dB. Ablation studies support the contributions of both the analytic base and the path-dependent correction. Given calibrated paths for a held-out listener condition, PRIME-ANC generates a path-specific FIR without iterative optimization. With three Gauss-Newton updates, it reaches 21.43 dB reduction, approaching direct weighted least-squares design while producing lower amplification and root-mean-square control output.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose multimodal agents can write robot-control programs, but repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection can make execution slow. We study how external body knowledge, successful experience, and executable skills improve an XLeRobot controlled by GPT-6-Astra in a simulated and a physical elevator-button task. In 30 fixed-start simulation trials, complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% relative to a baseline with only the common control interface and no prior experience; images with synchronized action and state records reduce it by 68.6% without additional body assets. In nine paired comparisons (18 trials) at starts displaced by 10-100 cm, experience recorded at the original start reduces mean time by 58-63% relative to no experience, demonstrating generalization to the tested new starting positions. During experience experiments, GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generates a short visual-feedback program. Researcher-refactored versions reduce mean local-task time by 29-31% in 27 simulation trials. Finally, 12 real-robot trials using operator-confirmed button contact demonstrate sim2real reuse: at a shared nominal start, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, respectively; real experience also transfers to two new starts. These results suggest a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments around GPT-6-Astra: supply machine-readable body descriptions and synchronized demonstrations, and turn useful agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, while the agent adapts actions from current images. We release all task prompts, trial-level experimental data, and acquired skill implementations at https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, prompts, and skills: https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 XLeRobot 机器人上让 GPT-6-Astra 直接写控制程序，通过外部身体知识、成功经验和可执行技能减少反复探索：30 次固定起点仿真中，完整几何与相机信息使平均完成时间降 57.4%，同步动作-状态图像降 68.6%；12 次实机试验中仿真 XML 资产与仿真经验分别降 53.0% 与 49.9%。作者建议为通用操作实验提供机器可读的身体描述与同步演示，并把代理自生成的反馈程序改写为可复用技能。
Motivation: 通用多模态代理写机器人控制程序时，反复探索与模型中介的动作选择使执行缓慢；缺少身体知识与经验复用时，仿真中学到的技能难以迁移到实体机器人。
Method: 以 GPT-6-Astra 驱动 XLeRobot 完成电梯按钮任务，对比三类外部输入：完整机器人几何与相机信息、同步动作与状态记录的图像、在原起点录制的成功经验；代理在经验实验中自发生成视觉反馈程序，研究者再重构为可复用技能，最后在实体机器人上做 sim2real 复用。
Result: 30 次固定起点仿真试验中，完整身体信息使平均完成时间相对仅控制接口基线降 57.4%，同步动作-状态图像降 68.6%；9 组配对比较（18 次试验，起点偏移 10–100 cm）中经验使平均时间降 58–63%；27 次仿真试验中重构后的反馈程序使局部任务平均时间降 29–31%；12 次实机试验中仿真 XML 资产与仿真经验分别降 53.0% 与 49.9%，真实经验可迁移到两个新起点。
Conclusion: 机器可读的身体描述、同步演示与被重构的代理自生成反馈程序，是让 GPT-6-Astra 类代理在仿真与实体机器人上都更快完成操作任务的实用配方，且在测试过的起点偏移范围内可泛化。

papers.title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
papers.abstract_en: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UNMATCH 用方向性多尺度覆盖 (directional multiscale coverage) 表示图像-声明的局部对应：每个尺度上按两个方向各取均值、下四分位与两个阈值支撑率，方向均值之差补成九维描述子，三尺度拼接后交给轻量全局-局部分类器。在 Fauxtography 的 Snopes 子集上做泄漏感知三折三种子评测，Macro-F1 69.82、balanced accuracy 71.05，比 MCOT 改造版分别高 2.60 与 2.16 分。
Motivation: 上下文挪用与视觉篡改把图像配上误导性声明，现有成对检测器把两模态压成单一全局兼容分或依赖过灵活的交互模块，决定性的局部不匹配因此被掩盖。
Method: 构造方向性多尺度覆盖表示：三个空间尺度上，每个方向以均值、下四分位和两个阈值支撑率汇总局部图像-声明亲和度，方向均值的带符号差补成九维尺度描述子，三尺度拼接后输入轻量全局-局部分类器；评测用泄漏感知三折、三种子设计，并做匹配重配 (matched-reassigned) 干预。
Result: 在 Fauxtography 的 Snopes 子集上，UNMATCH 取得 69.82 Macro-F1 与 71.05 balanced accuracy，超过 MCOT 改造版 2.60 与 2.16 个百分点；匹配重配干预显示破坏真实配对会降低覆盖度，同时抬高差异度与假配对概率。
Conclusion: 把图像-声明对应压缩成方向性、多尺度的局部覆盖统计，比全局兼容分更能暴露决定性的局部不匹配，且该表示对配对是否真实敏感。

papers.title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HGPTrans 用分层图池化加 Transolver 注意力直接从整车表面网格预测气动阻力系数 C_D：GIN 卷积编码局部几何，physics-aware slice attention 以线性复杂度捕捉远距离表面区域的全局相互作用，冗余感知分层池化逐步删掉冗余节点。在 DrivAerNet 与 DrivAerNet++ 上取得所评估基线中最低的 MAE 与 MSE，实车数据集迁移的相对 L1 误差为轿车 1.56%、SUV 2.12%，单车推理约 0.293 秒。
Motivation: 造型迭代早期要评估大量候选几何，而单个构型的高保真 CFD 需要数小时到数天，无法支撑大规模设计探索。
Method: HGPTrans 由三个互补组件构成：graph isomorphism convolution 编码判别性局部几何，physics-aware slice attention 捕获全局交互且计算复杂度为线性，information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling 在保留有信息几何结构的同时逐步移除冗余节点；在 DrivAerNet 与 DrivAerNet++ 上训练与评估，并用包含轿车与 SUV 的实车数据集做迁移学习，另做消融研究检验各组件贡献以及深度与池化比的影响。
Result: 在 DrivAerNet 与 DrivAerNet++ 上取得所评估基线中最低的 MAE 与 MSE；实车数据集迁移的相对 L1 误差为轿车 1.56%、SUV 2.12%，单车推理时间约 0.293 秒；相对高保真 CFD 加速若干数量级，预测阻力系数与 CFD 参考值相差在几个百分点以内。
Conclusion: 把局部几何编码、线性复杂度全局注意力与冗余感知池化组合起来，可以在保持几个百分点精度的前提下把 C_D 预测从数小时级压到约 0.3 秒，从而支撑大规模设计探索。

papers.title: SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.
papers.comment: Paper accepted to, and to appear in, the 2026 IEEE HealthCom Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMARtCARE 用四状态（Stable/Meta-cognitive/Assisted/Regulated-Revoked）临床决策架构加六通道有损患者轨迹指纹，在既往住院掉出活动上下文时触发 Meta-cognitive 升级交临床医生复核，完整检索仅由医生在 Assisted 状态主动触发。MIMIC-III 上 14 名两次住院患者识别出 1 例既往模式复现，MIMIC-IV 上 9 名两次住院患者零指纹匹配，两次运行全部日志决策可追溯且归属正确。
Motivation: 长上下文临床 AI 在既往住院记录掉出活动推理窗口时会漏掉相关病史，使 ICU 中早期生命体征漂移看起来非特异，即使它与既往恶化模式相似。
Method: 四状态架构 Stable、Meta-cognitive、Assisted、Regulated (Revoked)；不自动检索既往记录，而是用患者既往轨迹的六通道有损指纹 (six-channel fingerprint) 比对当前漂移，命中且原记录不在上下文时升级给临床医生，完整检索仅在 Assisted 状态由医生动作触发；另设 patient-identity guard 在数据加载、日志、审计三层强制归属正确。评估由验证状态转移逻辑与估计器稳定性的合成 Monte Carlo 研究，加上 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos 的真实数据运行组成。
Result: MIMIC-III 上 14 名两次住院患者中识别出 1 例既往模式复现；MIMIC-IV 上同一流程在 9 名两次住院患者中零指纹匹配，说明固定规范模式库的局限。两次运行中所有日志决策完全可追溯且归属正确；合成 Monte Carlo 研究验证状态转移逻辑与估计器稳定性，摘要明确其不检验临床性能。
Conclusion: SMARtCARE 可作为可追溯、隐私感知的中层上下文风险浮出机制，但结果不构成临床疗效主张，固定规范模式库在跨库数据上匹配能力受限。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Accurate Sampling from Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: A new proposal called DM-SMC (Diffusion Model - Sequential Monte Carlo) is investigated, which samples ensembles defined in terms of an action, using diffusion models trained on samples from the ensemble. The SMC setup allows for accurate sampling in spite of an approximate diffusion model and the finite stepsize used in the numerical solution of the stochastic process. Improved update strategies are also investigated. Results are presented for a $Z_2$ symmetric scalar field theory in 2 dimensions near its 2nd order phase transition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DM-SMC（Diffusion Model - Sequential Monte Carlo），用在系综样本上训练的扩散模型加 SMC 更新来采样由作用量定义的系综，使近似扩散模型与随机过程数值解的有限步长下仍能准确采样。在二维 Z2 对称标量场论的二阶相变附近给出结果，并考察了改进的更新策略。
Motivation: 用扩散模型采样由作用量定义的物理系综时，模型本身是近似的、随机过程的数值解又是有限步长的，两者都会把采样拉偏，需要一种在此条件下仍准确的采样方案。
Method: DM-SMC：在系综样本上训练扩散模型作为提议分布，再用 Sequential Monte Carlo 的权重更新与重采样纠正近似误差；同时考察改进的更新策略，用于作用量定义的系综采样。
Result: 在二维 Z2 对称标量场论、二阶相变附近给出结果：SMC 设置使近似扩散模型与有限步长下仍能准确采样，并检验了改进的更新策略。
Conclusion: 把 SMC 的重加权机制接到扩散采样上，可以在扩散模型不精确、步长有限时仍得到作用量系综的准确采样。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: cSVR: Convolutional Slice-to-Volume Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Unpredictable fetal motion during MRI scans can result in oblique 2D slices that are difficult to interpret and often leads to prolonged scan times. Slice-to-volume reconstruction (SVR) methods align 2D oblique slices from multiple slice stacks into a coherent 3D volume. We propose a convolutional network that predicts slice poses by performing multiscale, unrolled optimization and further refines them and super-resolves the volume using model-based optimization. Our convolutional feed-forward SVR network achieves accuracy on par with state-of-the-art results while offering significant speedup, paving the way for scanner-side use of SVR. The code is available https://github.com/MedicalVisionGroup/cSVR.
papers.comment: Accepted to PIPPI Workshop of MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: cSVR 用卷积网络做胎儿 MRI 的 slice-to-volume reconstruction：多尺度 unrolled optimization 预测 slice pose，再用基于模型的优化精化位姿并对体数据超分辨。其 feed-forward SVR 网络达到与 state-of-the-art 相当的精度并显著加速，作者据此认为 SVR 有望搬到扫描仪侧使用。
Motivation: 胎儿在 MRI 扫描中不可预测的运动使 2D 层面呈斜切、难以判读，并常导致扫描时间延长；传统 SVR 对齐慢，限制了扫描仪侧部署。
Method: 提出卷积网络 cSVR：以 multiscale、unrolled optimization 的方式预测 slice poses，随后用 model-based optimization 进一步精化位姿并对重建体做 super-resolution；代码开源于 github.com/MedicalVisionGroup/cSVR。
Result: 卷积 feed-forward SVR 网络的精度与 state-of-the-art 结果相当，同时带来显著加速（significant speedup），为 scanner-side 使用 SVR 铺路。
Conclusion: 把 unrolled optimization 装进卷积前馈网络，可以在保持 SVR 精度的同时把重建加速到适合扫描仪侧部署的水平。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Generalization Analysis of Online Stochastic Gradient Descent for Overparameterized Two-Layer Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the generalization performance of online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for overparameterized two-layer neural networks under the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) regime. Leveraging the NTK approximation together with the convergence theory of stochastic approximation in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs), we develop a unified framework that connects the optimization dynamics of neural networks with kernel-based statistical learning. This framework enables us to derive sharp convergence rates for the \emph{generalization error of the last iterate} of online SGD. The obtained rates coincide with the optimal statistical rates for kernel methods under appropriate source assumptions on target function. In contrast to existing NTK analyses, which primarily establish optimization convergence or analyze averaged SGD, our results directly characterize the statistical behavior of the practically implemented last-iterate online SGD algorithm for streaming data. Moreover, our analysis substantially relaxes the required degree of overparameterization by reducing the network-width requirement from exponential to polynomial dependence on the sample size or the number of optimization iterations. These results provide a unified theoretical perspective on stochastic optimization, kernel methods, and statistical learning for overparameterized neural networks, while significantly narrowing the gap between existing theory and practical deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NTK 区间内证明过参数化两层网络在线 SGD 最后一次迭代 (last iterate) 的泛化误差收敛率，达到核方法在 source 假设下的最优统计速率。网络宽度需求从对样本量/迭代次数的指数级降为多项式级。
Motivation: 已有 NTK 分析多只证优化收敛或针对平均 SGD，与实际流式数据下运行的最后一次迭代在线 SGD 之间存在理论与实践差距，且所需过参数化程度常为指数级。
Method: 在 NTK 近似下结合 RKHS 中随机逼近 (stochastic approximation) 的收敛理论，建立连接神经网络优化动力学与核统计学习的统一框架，直接刻画流式数据下最后一次迭代在线 SGD 的泛化行为。
Result: 推导出最后一次迭代在线 SGD 泛化误差的尖锐收敛率，在目标函数满足适当 source 假设时与核方法最优统计速率一致；网络宽度需求由对样本量或优化迭代次数的指数依赖降为多项式依赖。
Conclusion: 随机优化、核方法与统计学习在过参数化神经网络下可统一刻画，且理论所需过参数化程度可大幅放松以贴近实践。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Can a robot improve itself the way coding agents now improve software? We built an agentic system to find out. It watches a robot fail, works out which capability is missing, writes new skills or finds and installs external models, tests every change in simulation, and repeats, with no human writing robot code. We ran it for 123 improvement rounds on household manipulation tasks. This report describes what we learned. The good news is that the agent can discover capabilities on its own: noticing that its targets were out of view, it asked for an active-viewing model, debugged it, and deployed a working search skill. The bad news is that its improvements did not add up. Changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task, putting condiments on the top shelf of a fridge, never succeeded. We found that the agent was rarely the bottleneck. Three things around it were. First, chained perception modules do not understand relations. Segmenters such as SAM 3 find shelves but not "the top shelf", so the agent filled the gap with ever more geometric rules that never converged, when what it needed was a different kind of model. Second, skill chains lock learning onto the first step. Long tasks mostly fail early, so evidence and fixes pile up there, and later skills are rarely reached, tested, or improved. Third, what the agent learns is decided by the harness. The agent optimized exactly what the evaluator measured, including where it was wrong, and weak tests and misleading memory turned activity into a standstill. We distill these lessons into concrete recommendations for building robot systems that improve themselves, each paired with an experiment that could prove it wrong.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建一个无人编写机器人代码的 agentic 系统，在家务操作任务上连续跑 123 轮自我改进：观察失败、定位缺失能力、写新技能或安装外部模型、在仿真中测试每个改动。结果是改动逐个通过测试但目标任务（把调料放到冰箱顶层）始终未成功，瓶颈不在 agent 而在三处——链式感知模块不理解关系（SAM 3 找得到架子但找不到“顶层架子”）、技能链把学习锁死在第一步、agent 学到什么由 harness 的评测决定。
Motivation: 机器人能否像 coding agent 改软件那样自我改进尚无答案；即便每轮改动都通过自身测试，长任务仍可能毫无累积进展，需要定位真正的瓶颈在哪。
Method: 搭建 agentic 系统：观察机器人失败，推断缺失能力，自行编写新技能或检索并安装外部模型，每个改动都在仿真中测试后进入下一轮，全程无人写机器人代码；在家务操作任务上连续运行 123 轮改进。
Result: 123 轮改进中 agent 能自主发现能力（发现目标不在视野内后主动索取 active-viewing 模型、调试并部署出可用的 search 技能），但所有改动持续通过测试而目标任务“把调料放到冰箱顶层”始终未成功；归纳出三条失效机制：SAM 3 类分割器能找架子却不能理解“顶层架子”这类关系、长任务早期失败导致证据与修复堆积在第一步而后续技能很少被触达与改进、agent 优化的恰是评测所测的（包括评测本身出错时）。
Conclusion: 机器人自我改进的障碍主要在 agent 之外——关系理解缺失、技能链首步偏置与 harness 评测设计；作者据此给出配套可证伪实验的具体构建建议。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Acoustic domain shift in spoken language identification from systematic domain generalization evaluation to real-world application
papers.abstract_en: Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust to conditions unseen during training. While DG has been systematically studied in computer vision through controlled benchmarks and diverse distribution shifts, its evaluation in spoken language recognition remains less structured. Existing speech datasets provide valuable benchmarks for robustness to real-world acoustic conditions, but are primarily designed around specific scenarios and large scale rather than as general-purpose tools for systematically constructing and evaluating domain shifts. In this work, we introduce a smallscale speech dataset and evaluation protocol for controlled studies of acoustic domain shifts. It enables the evaluation of spoken language recognition models under a variety of acousitc domain shifts. We introduce the speech modality into the DomainBed Domain Generalization framework and evaluate three domain generalization algorithms. We show that in-domain performance is not a reliable predictor of cross-domain robustness and verify that explicit domain invariant algorithms such as MMD or DANN algorithms do not outperform ERM. We further validate the generality of these findings on MMS-LID-126, a state-of-the-art spoken language identification system. We release the code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该工作把计算机视觉的 DomainBed 域泛化评测框架引入语音模态，构建小规模口语音识别数据集与受控声学域偏移评测协议，并在其中比较三种域泛化算法。结论是域内 (in-domain) 性能不能预测跨域鲁棒性，显式域不变算法 MMD、DANN 均不优于 ERM，且这些发现在 SOTA 系统 MMS-LID-126 上同样成立。
Motivation: 语音口音识别的域泛化评测缺乏结构化方法：现有语音数据集围绕特定场景和大规模构建，而非作为系统构造与评估域偏移的通用工具。
Method: 提出小规模语音数据集与受控声学域偏移评测协议，将 DomainBed 域泛化框架移植到语音模态，评测三种域泛化算法（含 MMD、DANN 与 ERM 对照），并在 SOTA 口音识别系统 MMS-LID-126 上复验结论，代码开源。
Result: 域内性能不是跨域鲁棒性的可靠预测指标；显式域不变算法 MMD 与 DANN 不优于 ERM；上述发现在 MMS-LID-126 上得到进一步验证。

papers.title: 3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting
papers.abstract_en: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? We introduce 3DGS-SC, a controlled static screen-content dataset and benchmark for examining this mismatch. Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. Complementing prior text-aware 3DGS research, 3DGS-SC targets controlled monitor interfaces and exact annotations; scene-wise robustness and acquisition effects remain open validation questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3DGS-SC 提出一个受控静态屏幕内容数据集与评测协议，把整图保真、屏幕区域保真、OCR 可读性、边缘保持分开打分。五方法对比中 LightGaussian 屏幕 PSNR 仅比 Mip-Splatting 高 0.08 dB，OCR 精度却低 12.7 个百分点；十组方法配对里有七组的屏幕 PSNR 排序与 OCR 排序不一致，说明只看保真度会选错方法。
Motivation: 3DGS 的高图像保真不等于屏幕文字可读，仅靠保真度指标做方法选择会失灵，而现有评测缺少受控屏幕场景与精确标注。
Method: 构建 3DGS-SC：十个程序化场景，提供固定多视角划分、精确相机、屏幕掩码、文本框与转写文本；评测协议分离整图保真、屏幕区域保真、OCR 可读性与边缘保持四个维度，并做五方法对比与十组方法配对排序比较。
Result: LightGaussian 屏幕 PSNR 比 Mip-Splatting 高 0.08 dB，但 OCR 精度低 12.7 个百分点；全部十组方法配对中，屏幕 PSNR 排序与 OCR 排序有七组不一致。
Conclusion: 仅凭保真度指标选 3DGS 方法会失败，屏幕内容场景应按 OCR 可读性等任务指标评测；场景层面稳健性与采集方式影响仍是待验证问题。

papers.title: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 360° 全景分割在相机旋转 90° 时精度损失过半，主因是 icosphere transformer 相对位置偏置的规范依赖 (gauge dependence)。提出参数无关的规范等变相对位置编码 GE-RPE（对 SO(2) 有限循环子群 C_n 的 Reynolds 平均），配合 teacher-token 置换 π_R 对齐 SSL 视图，旋转掉幅从 53% 压到 0.8%，val mIoU 68.30%。
Motivation: SOTA 球面模型在相机旋转 90° 时丢失过半分割精度，受控消融把原因定位到相对位置偏置的规范依赖，旋转稳定性因此成为全景理解的瓶颈。
Method: GE-RPE：对偏置在 C_n⊂SO(2) 规范旋转的有限循环子群上做参数无关的 Reynolds 平均，即为零参数、可插拔的相对位置编码，接入 SphereUFormer 主干；再用 teacher-token 置换 π_R 把 iBOT+MAE 的 SSL 视图对齐到旋转后的 student 帧，构成 EquiSSL 框架。构造可证 C_n-不变，且与连续 SO(2) 平均相差 O(n^{-2})。
Result: 旋转 90° 压力协议下，已发布 SphereUFormer checkpoint 掉 53%，匹配三 seed 的 GE-RPE 模型掉 1.3%，EquiSSL 进一步收到 0.8%，此时 val mIoU 68.30%；部署代价为零新增参数与 1.5–4.4% 前向延迟。1% 标签微调在 N=373 test split 上 +2.39 mIoU，在 N=40 val split 上 +4.10 mIoU；同一修复迁移到单目深度与零样本 Structured3D 分割。
Conclusion: 去掉规范缺陷并用 π_R 对齐 SSL 视图后，iBOT+MAE 预训练从拖累变成低标签下的有效杠杆，GE-RPE 可作为跨全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移的 360° 视觉计算原语。

papers.title: Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉触觉传感器的表面法线估计原本需要物理探针标定，本文改用 Universal Photometric Stereo 神经网络做免标定估计，在 3 种不同光学系统的传感器上，金属球受控实验平均角误差 6.56°，与标定方法持平；自然纹理物体 10.66°，dome 形 Digit 360 相对标定基线 10.18°。
Motivation: 高精度接触面法线与深度依赖用已知几何探针按压弹性体做逐传感器标定，无法跨传感器扩展，且标定难度随传感器形状与光学系统变化。
Method: 提出免标定流程：直接以触觉图像为输入，用在纯合成数据上训练的 Universal Photometric Stereo 神经网络估计接触面法线，在 3 种不同光学系统的真实传感器上做系列实验，并与标定方法对照。
Result: 金属球受控实验中 universal 方法与标定方法持平，平均角误差 6.56°；自然纹理物体的高频表面细节恢复整体平均角误差 10.66°；dome 形 Digit 360 上相对标定基线角偏差 10.18°。
Conclusion: 只要照明设置足够，仅用合成数据训练的模型即可估计表面法线，Universal Photometric Stereo 可作为跨视觉触觉传感器设计的统一接触面表示，支撑跨传感器可迁移的触觉感知。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Isolated Entities: Relation-Aware Multi-Entity Modeling for Unsupervised Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video anomaly detection for patrol robots and surveillance systems must recognize abnormal interactions among familiar entities. Existing pixel-reconstruction and isolated-entity methods may fail when individual entities appear normal but their spatial or motion relations are abnormal. This work presents Interaction-Centric Network for Temporal Entity-Relation Analysis and Consistency Testing (INTERACT), a framework for unsupervised video anomaly detection. Person-Object Appearance-Motion Interaction (POAMI) moves beyond isolated-entity encoding by jointly modeling the appearance, motion, and spatial configurations of persons and objects in each frame. The resulting representations capture both individual entity states and their cross-entity context. Based on these representations, Target Geometry-Guided Relational Interaction Prediction (TGRIP) predicts target entity interaction states from historical relational memory and target-frame geometry without explicit identity tracking. Motion-Interaction Reconstruction and Alignment (MIRA) then evaluates these predictions through conditional flow reconstruction and semantic consistency checking, providing complementary anomaly evidence beyond prediction error alone. INTERACT achieves state-of-the-art performance, obtaining a frame-level AUC of 84.5% on the ShanghaiTech benchmark. Ablation studies show that removing cross-entity attention causes the largest performance drop, demonstrating the necessity of relational modeling. INTERACT is particularly effective for anomalies caused by changes in relations among people and objects, while maintaining competitive performance in general scenarios. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ppworkhard/INTERACT.
papers.comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ppworkhard/INTERACT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督视频异常检测框架 INTERACT，用 POAMI 联合建模人-物外观、运动与空间构型，TGRIP 在不做显式身份跟踪下由历史关系记忆与目标帧几何预测交互状态，MIRA 再用条件流重建与语义一致性检验给出超越预测误差的异常证据。在 ShanghaiTech 上 frame-level AUC 达 84.5%，消融显示去掉 cross-entity attention 降幅最大。
Motivation: 巡逻机器人与监控系统需识别熟悉实体间的异常交互；像素重建与孤立实体方法在单个实体本身正常、但其空间或运动关系异常时失效。
Method: POAMI 逐帧联合编码人与物体的外观、运动和空间配置，得到个体状态加跨实体上下文的表示；TGRIP 基于历史关系记忆与目标帧几何预测目标实体交互状态，无需显式身份跟踪；MIRA 通过条件流重建与语义一致性检查评估该预测。
Result: 在 ShanghaiTech 基准上取得 frame-level AUC 84.5%，达到 state-of-the-art；消融中移除 cross-entity attention 造成最大性能下降；在人-物关系变化类异常上尤其有效，一般场景保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 关系建模是无监督视频异常检测的关键，跨实体注意力带来的关系上下文比单实体编码贡献更大，方法对关系型异常最有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

papers.title: Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video
papers.abstract_en: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 课堂情感状态识别中的类别不平衡是维度特异的：DAiSEE 上原始不平衡比最高约 79:1（Frustration），且各维度不平衡结构不同，统一的重加权、focal loss、二值化会按维度失效。提出的 AHLS 对失衡可控维度用四级分类、对严重长尾维度用二值分类，配合 null-class 占位把最大有效逆频率权重比从约 79× 压到至多约 8.5×；在 0.39 M 参数的 FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN 上四维度平均 Macro-F1 达 47.70%，为 11 种方法最高。
Motivation: DAiSEE 上的类别不平衡被当作单一幅度问题处理，但其结构随维度变化，统一的算法修补在不同维度上表现不一致，长尾少数状态识别因此受限。
Method: AHLS 按维度失衡程度分配标签粒度：可控维度用四分类、严重长尾维度用二分类，并引入 null-class 占位机制压缩有效逆频率权重比；在轻量 FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN（0.39 M 参数、0.07 G FLOPs）上做多任务训练，并与 11 种方法（5 个深度模型、5 个传统机器学习基线）比较，另做跨模型行为分析。
Result: DAiSEE 上 Frustration 原始不平衡比约 79:1；AHLS 把四维度最大有效逆频率权重比从约 79× 降到至多约 8.5×；四维度平均 Macro-F1 47.70%，在 11 种对比方法中最高，其中对比的深度模型最大参数量可达其 167×；跨模型分析显示分类策略对少数状态识别的影响可能强于继续扩大 backbone；另报告 DAiSEE 在少数情感状态上的标注密度限制。
Conclusion: 维度特异的标签策略比统一重加权或继续扩大模型更能提升长尾情感状态识别，而 DAiSEE 的标注密度本身可能与算法一样限制该基准上的进展上限。

papers.title: Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions. Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here. One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115]. Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining. We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三个开源 AI 生成图像检测器的五路分数做 stacking 融合（梯度提升元学习器，把检测器失效当缺失数据），并用三组对照检验，结论是融合只有在目标域上重训才划算：异域训练的元学习器在 2000 张 StyleGAN 人脸上 AUC 0.9896，低于最佳单模型 0.9961（McNemar p = 1.000），而域内重训的 stacker 相对该单模型加后校准取得 Delta-AUC +0.0025（[+0.0014, +0.0038]，p = 3.4e-4）。
Motivation: 融合多个检测器的收益常被默认成立，但缺少对照：跨域训练的元学习器是否真的胜过最佳单模型、检测器集体失效时融合是否安全，都未被先检验就部署。
Method: 三个开源检测器输出五路分数，由梯度提升元学习器做 stacking 融合，把单个检测器的失效视作缺失数据；部署后补做三组对照，包括与最佳单模型加后校准的比较、跨语料与域内重训的对照，以及对全 NaN 输入的失效注入。
Result: 异域训练的元学习器在 2000 张 StyleGAN 人脸上 AUC 0.9896 vs 最佳单模型 0.9961，McNemar p = 1.000；域内重训 stacker 相对该单模型加后校准 Delta-AUC = +0.0025（[+0.0014, +0.0038]，p = 3.4e-4）。80 张截图上所有模型的 AUC 区间都含 0.5，集成跌幅与最佳成员跌幅之差为 [-0.185, +0.115]。五个检测器中四个静默、幸存者报 real 时系统返回 P(AI) = 0.9985，全 NaN 输入在未见过缺失的 learner 上得 0.9995；三个 AIDE checkpoint 因共享预处理路径一起失效。Corpus A 存在仅凭 JPEG header 即可分离两类的类条件偏置。
Conclusion: 融合只有在目标域上重训才抵得过其成本，且需要要求两个不同架构的 quorum 规则才能在不重训的前提下同时挡住全 NaN 与共享预处理两类失效；Corpus A 的 header 偏置限制了所有域内数字。

papers.title: The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GazeEarth 把超高分辨率 (UHR) 遥感理解改写为「固定像素预算花在哪」的问题：冻结 MLLM 从索引全景图中选出证据单元，用确定性、保拓扑的 warp 把原图重采样到固定画布，放大选中区域邻域并压缩外围，再由同一冻结模型在至多两次 MLLM 调用内作答。在三个 UHR 遥感基准、四个冻结骨干上，相对直接作答提升 4.6 至 9.4 个百分点，相对全景作答提升 3.4 至 4.3 个百分点，超过任务训练方法。
Motivation: UHR 遥感影像远超 MLLM 的视觉输入预算，现有选择式方法要么按相关性打分剪 token/选 patch，要么反复裁剪局部，前者保留的是离散块、后者把裁剪与其上下文割裂，都没有在连续全景视图内重新分配像素。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的 GazeEarth 框架：问题引导的区域选择 + 全景中央凹 (foveated) 观测。MLLM 从带索引的 overview 中选证据单元，确定性保拓扑 warp 将原图重采样到固定尺寸画布，放大共享邻域、压缩外围，同一冻结模型在聚焦视图上作答；至多两次 MLLM 调用，不用外部选择器也不做迭代搜索。
Result: 在三个 UHR 遥感基准、四个冻结骨干上，基准平均准确率相对直接作答提高 4.6 至 9.4 个百分点，相对全景作答提高 3.4 至 4.3 个百分点，并优于任务训练 (task-trained) 方法。分析显示现有 MLLM 能自行引导在 UHR 图像中看哪里，而其从所选证据能推断出的内容取决于证据的呈现方式。
Conclusion: UHR 遥感理解的瓶颈不只是选哪里看，还包括所选证据如何呈现；用一次保拓扑的中央凹重采样替代裁剪，冻结 MLLM 即可在固定像素预算下显著提升准确率。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出诊断驱动的后训练配方：用教师 VLM 对学生模型做压力测试，找出超出人类先验的失败模式并转化为定向监督与偏好对齐，配合两种 visual-token 策略产出 NanoFull 与 FlashFull 两个变体。NanoFull 在 17 个基准上归一化平均 62.3，为公开发布的约 0.5B 模型中最高，较同架构同 token 预算的 base 高 7.4；FlashFull 保持 61.4 的同时把 Pixel 9 上的 warm time-to-first-token 从 138 s 降到 6.1 s（23×）。
Motivation: 亚十亿参数 VLM 已可上端侧部署，但体积小不等于可用：手机上首 token 仍可能超过两分钟，且标准基准只测准确率，测不出 doom loop 这类行为可靠性问题，也缺少对抗性安全探针。
Method: 诊断驱动后训练：教师 VLM 对学生做压力测试，挖掘超出人类先验的失败模式，将其转为定向监督数据与偏好对齐；再叠加两种 visual-token 策略，产出准确率-效率两个变体，并用过短答案与对抗提示的基准补测行为可靠性。
Result: NanoFull 在 17 个基准上归一化平均 62.3，为公开发布的约 0.5B 模型中最高，比同架构同 token 预算的 base 高 7.4，doom-loop 率不高于最强基线；FlashFull 归一化平均 61.4，Pixel 9 上 warm time-to-first-token 从 138 s 降至 6.1 s（23×）；手机上该量级模型首 token 可超过两分钟。
Conclusion: 把行为可靠性与准确率、效率一起纳入后训练，可让约 0.5B 的端侧 VLM 同时提高基准分数、压低首 token 延迟并控制 doom loop，走向实际可用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
papers.abstract_en: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms. The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PEEL-DDPM 把 NIG 证据回归中不可辨识的那一个自由度，用实测的最终图像方差补上：先训练并冻结测量条件化的 DDPM，再用最终图像证据网络只学可辨识的 Student-t 坐标，把 aleatoric 方差拆成 scanner-induced 与 sampler-induced 两支，进而把预测不确定性分解为 measurement、diffusion、epistemic 三项。在 8 个留出对象的可行性研究中，名义 50/80/90/95% 区间的经验覆盖率为 49.3%、80.3%、90.1%、95.6%，均方残差为预测方差的 0.967 倍。
Motivation: NIG 回归的边际 Student-t 似然只能定出四个参数中的三个组合，剩下一个自由度不可辨识，导致证据学习给出的不确定性无法唯一确定；扩散图像重建又同时受扫描仪噪声与采样器随机性两路 aleatoric 噪声影响，需要分开度量。
Method: 先用 epsilon-MSE 训练测量条件化 DDPM 并冻结，取其完整反向轨迹的重建结果与已知训练对象的残差，送入最终图像证据网络；网络只回归可辨识的 Student-t 坐标，重复扫描噪声实现与重复扩散轨迹构成嵌套 Monte Carlo，估计最终图像 aleatoric 方差并拆成 scanner-induced 与 sampler-induced 两部分，用该实测方差消解 NIG 剩余歧义。训练为顺序式，不需要 cross-loss 权重系数。
Result: 在 8 个留出对象的可行性研究中，名义 50%、80%、90%、95% 区间的经验中心区间覆盖率为 49.3%、80.3%、90.1%、95.6%；均方残差为平均预测方差的 0.967 倍；单图像 aleatoric head 对独立嵌套参考的合并 Spearman 相关为 0.785。跨五个剂量水平，scanner-induced 方差的 log-log 剂量斜率为 -1.15，sampler-induced 方差几乎与剂量无关，斜率为 -0.01。
Conclusion: 用实测方差补上 NIG 的不可辨识自由度，可让扩散图像重建的不确定性分解既可辨识又具物理可解释性；扫描噪声随剂量按约 -1.15 幂律下降，而采样器噪声基本不随剂量变化，两者应分开建模。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.
papers.comment: Project Page: https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/large-model-team/blog/uranus/ Inference Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-OSS Inference Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/D-Robotics/Uranus-Demo-Data SDK Code: https://github.com/D-Robotics-AI-Lab/Uranus-SDK Model Weights: https://huggingface.co/collections/D-Robotics/uranus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Uranus 是一个以关节轨迹为条件的自回归扩散机器人模拟器：在线接收未来关节位置轨迹，逐步自回归生成一个 latent 帧（对应 4 张 RGB 帧），无固定时域。推理优化后达到 24 FPS 的低延迟流式生成，并以统一接口支持不同机器人本体与相机配置的同步多视角生成。
Motivation: 机器人数据生成、策略训练与安全迭代依赖可扩展仿真，但真实交互成本高，传统模拟器需要大量人工搭建。
Method: 核心是 joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model：以未来关节位置轨迹为条件，自回归地逐步生成 latent 帧并展开为多张 RGB 帧，实现无固定时域的流式 rollout；推理侧做优化以压低延迟，并提供统一接口做同步多视角生成。
Result: 推理优化后达到 24 FPS；每个自回归步生成 1 个 latent 帧，对应 4 张 RGB 帧；在 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 数据上做了定量与定性评估，并公开代码与模型权重。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的自回归扩散模拟器可以做到低延迟、开放时域的流式机器人仿真与多本体多视角扩展，作者同时明确指出其当前局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code
papers.comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop of MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 CCTA 冠脉分割中 Dice 掩盖细小远端分支缺失的问题，提出基于二分图匹配 (bipartite assignment) 与局部血管半径容差的表面度量，把预测/参考表面点配对为 precision、recall、F1，并解耦假阳性（伪分支）与假阴性（漏分支）。据此再提出可微表面损失，同时抑制伪质量并恢复缺失结构；在 Image-CAS 与 ASOCA 上微调 nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU 三个骨干，相比 matched-epoch 对照在 Dice 相当的前提下显著提升 surface F1，补回漏掉的远端血管。
Motivation: Dice 等体积重叠指标不适合细管状解剖：体素大多集中在少数粗近端节段，漏掉一根远端分支几乎不降 Dice，却严重破坏临床所需的连通性，而且对称的 Dice 无法区分漏检与幻觉伪分支。
Method: 先定义表面度量：用二分图赋值 (bipartite assignment) 在局部血管半径容差内匹配预测与参考表面点，输出 precision、recall、F1，并把假阳性（spurious branches）与假阴性（missed branches）解耦；再基于该度量构造可微表面损失，同时抑制伪质量与恢复缺失结构，在两个公开基准上微调三个骨干网络。
Result: 强 Dice 基线遗漏的血管表面远多于其幻觉出的表面，这一不对称被高 Dice 掩盖；在 Image-CAS 与 ASOCA 上微调 nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU，与 matched-epoch 对照相比，表面 F1 显著提升且 Dice 相当，提升来自补回漏检的远端血管。
Conclusion: 冠脉分割应当测量并优化血管表面而非其重叠体积，因为体积指标对远端分支缺失不敏感且无法区分漏检与伪分支。
Relevance: 4
