papers.title: Seeing the Heat: Synthesizing High-Resolution Wood Thermal Responses from Optical Imagery
papers.abstract_en: The thermal behavior of wood is a critical factor in advanced material assembly. However, pixel-level thermal analysis remains fundamentally constrained by the low resolution and noise inherent to infrared thermography. To address this, we introduce an end-to-end computational framework that synthesizes high-resolution thermal responses directly from wood RGB images. We first establish a core physical linkage: because spatial color variation in natural wood is driven by cellular anatomy, optical intensity serves as a reliable geometric proxy for the localized solid volume fraction. By leveraging this theoretical insight, we develop an automated finite-element-method data engine that maps pixel-level optical intensity to a 3D thermodynamic voxel grid, generating high-fidelity synthetic thermal responses. We find that 1) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is uniform or linear, wood RGB images and their corresponding thermal responses exhibit extreme morphological similarities, and the lateral thermal diffusion acts as a low-pass filter that smooths out high-frequency details; 2) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is random, such morphological similarities are destroyed, and wood's 3D structure dominantly governs its thermal response. We further utilize these synthetic thermal responses to supervise a neural surrogate model built upon the DINOv3 foundation model. Our results demonstrate that the neural surrogate model successfully internalizes the governing thermodynamic laws, thereby bypassing computationally expensive simulations and enabling high-resolution thermal inference. This methodology effectively bridges the semantic and thermodynamic domains, unlocking systematic, pixel-level analysis of fine-grained wood thermal responses. Project: https://zekifayes.github.io/seeheat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从木材 RGB 图像直接合成高分辨率热响应的端到端框架：以光学强度作为局部固体体积分数的几何代理，用自动有限元 (FEM) 数据引擎把像素级光强映射到 3D 体素网格生成合成热响应，再用其监督基于 DINOv3 的神经代理模型。发现厚度方向热导均匀或线性时 RGB 与热响应形态高度相似、横向热扩散相当于低通滤波；热导随机时该相似性被破坏，3D 结构主导热响应。
Motivation: 红外热成像分辨率低且噪声大，像素级热分析受限；直接做 FEM 仿真计算代价高，难以支撑细粒度木材热响应的系统分析。
Method: 先建立物理关联：天然木材的空间颜色变化由细胞结构决定，故光学强度可作为局部固体体积分数的几何代理；据此构建自动 FEM 数据引擎，把像素级光强映射为 3D 热力学体素网格并生成高保真合成热响应，再用这些合成响应监督一个基于 DINOv3 基础模型的神经代理。
Result: 两项定性发现：厚度方向热导均匀或线性时，木材 RGB 图与其热响应形态极度相似，横向热扩散起低通滤波作用、抹平高频细节；厚度方向热导随机时该形态相似性被破坏，3D 结构主导热响应。神经代理模型成功内化支配性热力学规律，绕开昂贵仿真实现高分辨率热推断。
Conclusion: 光学强度到热响应之间存在可学习的物理映射：热导沿厚度均匀/线性时可用 RGB 直接推断热响应，热导随机时必须依赖 3D 结构；用 FEM 合成数据监督的 DINOv3 代理可替代仿真做像素级热推断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LukeNet: A lightweight CNN integrated with an XAI model for Smart acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection and management
authors: Md Taimur Ahad (Department of Management Information Systems
papers.abstract_en: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 IoMT 边缘设备的轻量 CNN LukeNet，用 depthwise separable convolution 平衡深度与计算效率，并集成 XAI 高亮显微图像中的相关区域。在三个 ALL 数据集上做五折交叉验证，模型准确率 99%、未见测试集准确率 99%，高于 DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16 及迁移学习模型与两个集成模型。
Motivation: 多数基于 CNN 的 ALL 检测系统停留在理论阶段、计算量大，无法部署到算力、内存和时延受限的 IoMT 边缘与可穿戴设备上，难以支撑实时监测与及时临床干预。
Method: 提出 LukeNet 轻量 CNN，用 depthwise separable convolution 平衡模型深度与计算效率、缓解深层梯度丢失，兼顾全局与局部特征提取；与可解释 AI (XAI) 方法结合高亮显微图像相关区域；在三个 ALL 数据集上以五折交叉验证训练，并与六个 SOTA CNN、迁移学习模型及两个集成模型对比。
Result: 在三个 ALL 数据集、五折交叉验证下，LukeNet 模型准确率 99%、未见测试准确率 99%，高于 DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16 六个 SOTA CNN 及迁移学习模型，也优于两个集成模型。
Conclusion: 深度与计算效率可以在 IoMT 边缘场景下由一个 depthwise separable 结构的轻量 CNN 同时满足，且配合 XAI 仍能保持 99% 级别的 ALL 检测准确率。

papers.title: Measuring the evolution of camera distance across a century of film
papers.abstract_en: The rise of computer vision and artificial intelligence has made possible new forms of large-scale computational measurement. We apply these techniques to a deep collection of 5,205 digitized films viewed in theaters between 1922-2025 (covering popular, prestigious, and independent movies) to trace the development of one of the most fundamental ways through which film communicates: by manipulating the space between the camera and its subject. This work finds abrupt changes with the rise of new technologies in sound and television, and allows us to shed an empirical light on gender disparity (women, despite having substantially less screentime than men, are disproportionately the subject of closer shots), and illustrate how animated films both inherit and break free from the norms of live-action filmmaking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用计算机视觉对 5,205 部 1922–2025 年数字化影片做大规模测量，追踪摄影机与被摄主体距离这一电影基本表意手段的百年演变。发现新技术（有声电影、电视）兴起时景别分布出现突变；女性虽总出镜时间远少于男性，却不成比例地出现在更近的镜头中；动画片既继承又偏离真人电影的规范。
Motivation: 电影如何通过摄影机与主体的空间距离进行表意，长期只能靠个案或人工标注讨论，缺少跨越百年、覆盖流行/艺术/独立影片的大样本经验证据。
Method: 将计算机视觉与 AI 的大规模计算测量应用于 5,205 部 1922–2025 年在影院上映的数字化影片（含流行、艺术与独立电影），测量摄影机到被摄主体的距离并按年代、技术变革、性别与动画/真人分组比较。
Result: 在 5,205 部影片、1922–2025 年跨度上发现景别随有声与电视等新技术兴起出现突变；女性出镜时间显著少于男性，却不成比例地成为更近景别镜头的被摄对象；动画片既继承真人电影规范又走出自己的路径。
Conclusion: 摄影机—主体距离是可以跨百年大规模量化的历史变量，其分布随媒介技术突变而跳变，并承载性别化的观看结构。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Retrieval Hurts: Measuring and Explaining Retrieval-Induced Hallucination in Chest X-ray Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation is an attractive way to improve chest X-ray reporting, because reports from similar prior studies supply clinical context a general vision-language model lacks. We show the same mechanism is a reliable source of clinical error. Over 100 MIMIC-CXR studies with a frozen LLaVA-1.5 generator and BioMedCLIP retrieval, CheXbert clinical F1 doubles under relevant retrieval (0.201 to 0.402) and collapses to 0.043 under clinically mismatched retrieval, a fifth of the image-only score; the retrieval-induced hallucination rate, counting only unsupported findings traceable to retrieved evidence, rises from 0.00 to 0.76 and 0.98. To show this is not an artefact of evidence-set coverage, we introduce a coincidental-overlap control that scores image-only generations against evidence they never saw, placing the chance base rate at 0.18, four to five times below the observed rates. The generator does not merely acquire findings, it transcribes text: 95% of reports produced under relevant retrieval contain an eight-word span occurring verbatim in the retrieved evidence but absent from the reference, against 0% without retrieval. We then explain the mechanism: a normal chest X-ray retrieves at least one abnormal precedent in 24 of 28 cases, because medical image-embedding similarity is dominated by anatomy and acquisition rather than by the presence of disease. This has a direct design consequence. Retrieval similarity does not predict harm (RIH rates 0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84 across similarity quartiles), so relevance gates conditioned on embedding similarity cannot work; gating on predicted pathology agreement removes 61% of unsupported evidence at no cost to useful coverage. We argue that retrieval-augmented clinical systems must be evaluated under retrieval failure, not only under retrieval success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MIMIC-CXR 上用冻结的 LLaVA-1.5 与 BioMedCLIP 检索证明：检索增强会系统性制造临床幻觉——相关检索下 CheXbert 临床 F1 从 0.201 升到 0.402，但临床不匹配检索时跌到 0.043（仅为无图基线的五分之一），检索诱导幻觉率 (RIH) 从 0.00 升到 0.76 与 0.98。根因是影像嵌入相似度由解剖与成像方式而非疾病主导，正常胸片在 28 例中有 24 例检索到异常先例；作者据此建议改用预测病理一致性做门控，可去掉 61% 无支持证据。
Motivation: 检索增强被当作给视觉-语言模型补临床语境的手段，但检索失败时它会把既往报告的错误直接写进新报告，而现有评测只在检索成功条件下进行，无法暴露这一失效模式。
Method: 在 100+ 例 MIMIC-CXR 研究上冻结 LLaVA-1.5 生成器、BioMedCLIP 做检索，对比相关检索、临床不匹配检索与无检索三种条件；引入 coincidental-overlap 对照，用生成结果从未见过的证据打分以标定偶然基线；再按嵌入相似度四分位与病理一致性门控分析 RIH。
Result: CheXbert 临床 F1：相关检索 0.201→0.402（翻倍），不匹配检索 0.043（约为仅图像分数的五分之一）；RIH 率 0.00→0.76 与 0.98，而偶然重叠对照给出的机会基线为 0.18，仅为观测值的四到五分之一；相关检索下 95% 报告含一个逐字来自检索证据、参考报告中没有的八词片段，无检索时为 0%；正常胸片在 28 例中 24 例至少检索到一个异常先例；RIH 在相似度四分位上为 0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84，按预测病理一致性门控可移除 61% 无支持证据且不损失有用覆盖。
Conclusion: 检索相似度不能预测危害，基于嵌入相似度的检索门控注定失效；临床检索增强系统必须在检索失败条件下评测，而门控应改用预测的病理一致性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: GERIS: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Filtering Instance-Dependent Label Noise in License Plate Data Augmentation
authors: Mehdi Ghatee (2) ((1) Department of Computer Science
(2) Department of Mathematics and Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose GERIS, a game-theoretic framework for instance selection in the data augmentation phase of license plate recognition systems. During augmentation, synthetic license plate images are generated and transformed using stochastic noise to simulate real-world conditions. However, certain noise configurations lead to highly distorted, unreadable images that degrade model performance by introducing instance-dependent label noise. GERIS formulates a non-cooperative game in which each noise vector competes for inclusion in the training set based on its similarity to labeled data and its contribution to model reliability. By identifying and pruning low-quality instances, GERIS improves the overall quality of the augmented dataset. Unlike traditional black-box learning methods, GERIS offers a transparent, theoretically grounded mechanism for data filtering. Experimental results demonstrate that GERIS outperforms existing instance selection methods in terms of classification accuracy and robustness.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. To appear in AUT Journal of Mathematics and Computing (AUT J Math Comput)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GERIS 把车牌识别数据增强中的实例筛选建模为非合作博弈：每个随机噪声向量按其与标注数据的相似度及其对模型可靠性的贡献竞争进入训练集，从而剔除产生不可读图像的实例依赖标签噪声。实验显示其在分类准确率与鲁棒性上超过已有实例选择方法。
Motivation: 车牌数据增强中部分随机噪声配置会生成严重失真、不可读的合成图像，形成实例依赖标签噪声并拉低识别模型性能，而传统黑盒筛选机制不透明。
Method: 提出博弈论框架 GERIS：将每个噪声向量作为博弈参与者，依据与标注数据的相似度和对模型可靠性的贡献决定是否入选训练集，剪除低质量增强实例，提供透明且有理论依据的过滤机制。
Result: 实验结果表明 GERIS 在分类准确率 (classification accuracy) 和鲁棒性上优于已有实例选择方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以非合作博弈做增强实例筛选，可以在车牌识别中透明地过滤实例依赖标签噪声并提升模型准确率与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-Capacity Robust Medical Image Exfiltration via Neural Network Weight Replacement
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative medical AI platforms allow researchers to train models on sensitive imaging data while restricting data export. However, trained models can serve as covert carriers of patient information: medical images may be encoded within model parameters and reconstructed outside the secure environment. Existing defenses rely on lightweight sanitization (e.g., fine-tuning, pruning, quantization) and limited statistical auditing, creating a realistic insider exfiltration risk. We introduce a high-capacity neural steganography attack that encodes medical images as continuous latent representations embedded into model initialization. A StyleGAN2-based adversarial autoencoder learns compact latent codes regularized to match standard weight initialization statistics, keeping embedded parameters statistically consistent with clean models. Noise injection during training improves robustness to export-time mitigation. The carrier model remains functional on its intended task and hidden images can be reconstructed directly from its weights after export. This continuous encoding enables robust and scalable exfiltration, allowing up to 99 brain MRI volumes to be embedded within a 30MB model, and remains recoverable under mitigations that disrupt prior bit-level schemes. While reconstructions are approximate rather than pixel-exact, embedded content remains anatomically recognizable and recoverable at scale, exposing a privacy risk distinct from prior bit-level approaches. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, BraTS, and LiTS demonstrate effectiveness across modalities, tasks, and architectures, highlighting the need for structural defenses beyond parameter-level sanitization. Code is available at https://github.com/ElieThellier/high-capacity-robust-medical-image-exfiltration.
papers.journal_ref: MICCAI 2026 - 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention, Sep 2026, Strasbourg, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于神经隐写 (neural steganography) 的医学影像外泄攻击：用 StyleGAN2 对抗自编码器把医学图像编码成连续隐空间表示，嵌入模型权重初始化，并在训练中注入噪声以抵抗导出时的净化。单个 30MB 模型最多可藏 99 个脑 MRI 体数据，且在破坏既有 bit-level 方案的缓解手段下仍可恢复。
Motivation: 协作式医学 AI 平台允许在敏感影像上训练但禁止导出数据，而现有防御只做微调、剪枝、量化等轻量净化与有限统计审计，训练后的模型可被当作隐蔽载体把患者信息带出安全环境。
Method: 用 StyleGAN2-based 对抗自编码器学习紧凑隐空间码，并以正则使其匹配标准权重初始化统计，从而让含隐参数与干净模型统计一致；训练时注入噪声提升对导出期缓解手段的鲁棒性，载体模型在原任务上保持可用，导出后直接从权重重建隐图像。
Result: 在 30MB 模型内最多嵌入 99 个脑 MRI 体数据；在破坏既有 bit-level 方案的缓解手段下仍可恢复；在 MIMIC-CXR、BraTS、LiITS 上跨模态、任务与架构验证有效。重建为近似而非像素级精确，但解剖结构仍可辨认并可规模化恢复。
Conclusion: 参数级净化不足以阻止连续编码的高容量外泄，防御需要结构性手段；该攻击暴露的风险与既有 bit-level 方案不同。

papers.title: SWT: Self-Supervised Video Object Segmentation via Sliding, Wavelet and Transportation
papers.abstract_en: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) aims to accurately segment target objects from consecutive video frames and track the changes of the objects in each frame of the video. Conventional VOS methods typically demand substantial quantities of pixel-level labeled video sequences for fully supervised learning, which limits the performance of the model in sparse video scenes, while existing VOS methods have limited adaptability to global changes in objects. Based on this observation, in this paper, we propose self-supervised VOS with Sliding window, Wavelet transform and optimal Transport (SWT), a self-supervised VOS framework entirely trained on static dataset using contrastive learning. Firstly, a rolling sample buffer reuses overlapping groups of independently sampled images across successive updates. Secondly, to address the long-distance modeling difficulty caused by simple convolutional structures, we introduce wavelet transform to expand the receptive field of convolutional kernels, thus improving the model's representational capability. Finally, we incorporate optimal transport to assist the model in finding the globally optimal match between the target across two frames, improving the model's ability to handle nonrigid deformations of objects. SWT only requires training on the COCO dataset once and achieves excellent results on five VOS datasets as well as an additional body part propagation dataset. The code will be released soon at [https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git](https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWT 把自监督视频目标分割 (VOS) 的训练完全搬到静态图像上：滑动窗口样本缓冲复用重叠图像组，小波变换扩大卷积感受野，最优传输 (optimal transport) 求两帧目标的全局最优匹配。只在 COCO 上训练一次，即可在五个 VOS 数据集和一个身体部位传播数据集上取得良好结果。
Motivation: 全监督 VOS 依赖大量逐像素标注的视频序列，在稀疏视频场景中受限；现有 VOS 方法对目标的全局变化适应性也有限。
Method: 框架含三部分：rolling sample buffer 在连续更新间复用独立采样图像的重叠组；用小波变换扩展卷积核感受野以缓解简单卷积结构的长程建模困难；用 optimal transport 辅助模型寻找跨两帧目标的全局最优匹配，以处理非刚性形变。整体用对比学习 (contrastive learning) 训练，且只在 COCO 静态数据集上训练一次。
Result: 仅在 COCO 上训练一次后，在五个 VOS 数据集以及一个额外的身体部位传播数据集上均取得良好结果；摘要未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 静态图像上的自监督对比学习配合滑动窗口、小波与最优传输，足以迁移到视频目标分割，无需逐像素标注的视频训练。

papers.title: Frequency-Domain AI-Generated Image Detection: Exploring Decoder and Channel Attention for Feature Refinement
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid progress of AI, the number of AI-generated images has increased significantly in recent years. However, the increasing variety of image generation models makes detection more difficult. In this work, we use Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) representation with EfficientNet-B0 for AI-generated image detection. EfficientNet-B0 provides a lightweight architecture that can be useful for resource-limited applications. Most frequency-domain detectors use a standard encoder to extract features from the FFT spectrum and directly pass them to a classifier. We explored a different approach by investigating ECA, U-Net, and Attention U-Net as alternatives to this direct encoder-to-classifier approach. ECA applies channel attention, while U-Net and Attention U-Net use decoder-based architectures to recover and refine spatial information in the extracted frequency features. We used a balanced subset of the MS COCOAI dataset that includes AI-generated images from five different models. Three runs were carried out for each experiment, and the average values were recorded. Experimental results indicate that EfficientNet-B0 obtained an accuracy of 84.64%, which is 4.50 percentage points higher than the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper. EfficientNet-B0 with U-Net provided a small improvement, achieving an accuracy of 84.85%, while ECA did not increase the overall performance. EfficientNet-B0 with Attention U-Net achieved the best overall performance, with an accuracy of 85.51% and an ROC-AUC of 92.99%. This represents an improvement of 0.87 percentage points in accuracy compared to the EfficientNet-B0 baseline and 5.37 percentage points over the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Optics, Machine Learning and Emerging Technology (OMLET)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 FFT 频谱加 EfficientNet-B0 做 AI 生成图像检测，并测试 ECA、U-Net、Attention U-Net 三种特征细化模块。在 MS COCOAI 平衡子集（含五种生成模型图像、每组三次实验取平均）上，EfficientNet-B0 准确率 84.64%，比数据集论文的 ResNet-50 基线高 4.50 个百分点；加 Attention U-Net 后达 85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%，为最佳组合，而 ECA 未带来提升。
Motivation: 生成模型种类增多使 AI 生成图像检测更难；现有频域检测器多用标准编码器直接把 FFT 特征送入分类器，缺少对频率特征的解码与细化。
Method: 以 Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) 表示输入，EfficientNet-B0 作为轻量编码器提取频谱特征；对比三种细化路径：ECA 通道注意力、U-Net 与 Attention U-Net 解码器恢复并细化空间信息，再接分类。数据为 MS COCOAI 的平衡子集，含五种生成模型的图像，每组实验跑三次取平均。
Result: EfficientNet-B0 准确率 84.64%，比数据集论文报告的 ResNet-50 基线高 4.50 个百分点；EfficientNet-B0 + U-Net 为 84.85%（小幅提升）；ECA 未提升整体性能；EfficientNet-B0 + Attention U-Net 最佳，准确率 85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%，较 EfficientNet-B0 基线高 0.87 个百分点、较 ResNet-50 基线高 5.37 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在 FFT 频域检测中，解码器式细化（尤其 Attention U-Net）比直接编码器到分类器更有效，而通道注意力 ECA 在该设置下无增益；EfficientNet-B0 提供适合资源受限场景的轻量架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Does the Watermark Hide? Push-Pull Disentanglement for Invisible Watermark Removal
papers.abstract_en: Fixed image distortions do not cover an attacker that learns from paired clean and watermarked images. We study this paired-training threat with single-image inference: deployment uses neither the clean reference nor the watermark key, payload, or decoder. An encoder maps each image to a structural latent $g$ and an auxiliary residual latent $u$. Push supervision reconstructs the watermarked image from $D(g_w,u_w)$. Pull supervision trains the zero-auxiliary output $D(A_g(g_w;k),0)$ toward the paired clean image. At $k=1.10,u=0$, the four-method sweep gives an average BER of $0.3958$, PSNR of $31.07$ dB, and SSIM of $0.9554$. Restoring $u$ from $0$ to $0.15$ moves average BER from $0.3893$ to $0.3357$, while PSNR falls from $30.99$ to $28.23$ dB. The intervention supports decoder dependence on the auxiliary input in the evaluated setting. The accompanying theory is a conditional, post-hoc account of this behavior rather than an experimentally verified information-relocation result.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对配对训练的隐形水印去除威胁（部署时无干净参考、无水印密钥/payload/解码器），提出 push-pull 解耦：编码器把图像拆成结构潜变量 g 与辅助残差潜变量 u，push 用 D(g_w,u_w) 重建含水印图，pull 让零辅助输出 D(A_g(g_w;k),0) 逼近配对干净图。在 k=1.10、u=0 的四方法扫描下平均 BER 0.3958、PSNR 31.07 dB、SSIM 0.9554；把 u 从 0 恢复到 0.15 使平均 BER 从 0.3893 降到 0.3357，同时 PSNR 从 30.99 降到 28.23 dB，支持解码器依赖辅助输入这一判断。
Motivation: 固定图像失真类攻击无法覆盖能从配对干净图与含水印图中学习的攻击者；该威胁下部署又拿不到干净参考与水印密钥，需要在单图推理设定下刻画水印信息被藏到哪里。
Method: 编码器将每张图映射为结构潜变量 g 与辅助残差潜变量 u；push 监督用 D(g_w,u_w) 重建含水印图，pull 监督把零辅助输出 D(A_g(g_w;k),0) 拉向配对干净图；在 k=1.10、u=0 下做四方法扫描，并干预 u（0→0.15）观察解码器行为，另附条件性的事后理论解释。
Result: k=1.10、u=0 时四方法扫描平均 BER 0.3958、PSNR 31.07 dB、SSIM 0.9554；u 从 0 恢复到 0.15 时平均 BER 由 0.3893 降至 0.3357，PSNR 由 30.99 dB 降至 28.23 dB。
Conclusion: 在所评估设定下，干预结果支持解码器依赖辅助输入 u 的判断；配套理论只是对这一行为的条件性事后说明，而非经实验验证的信息重定位结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LatentReRig: An SDF-Based VAE with Dual Decoders for Latent-Space Deformation Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Transferring deformation between characters with different geometry and topology is challenging because conventional rigs encode behaviour through character-specific structures and correspondences. We present LatentReRig, an experimental framework that investigates whether pose-associated changes can instead be represented as reusable directions in a learned geometric latent space. An SDF-based variational autoencoder is coupled with two decoders: one reconstructs the implicit field, while the other predicts target vertex positions from source geometry and latent deformation conditioning. The source geometry may be neutral or already deformed. Experiments on a controlled humanoid dataset show that several poses induce coherent latent directions across identities, particularly for broad articulated motions. These signals can guide deformation of unseen characters, but explicit predictions remain less accurate for localized changes and corrective contributions. Diagnostic comparisons with repeated SDF sampling show that inter-identity distances exceed same-geometry resampling variability on average, while pose signals exhibit different margins above this baseline. The results support the presence of reusable pose-related structure and identify stable local conditioning and accurate mesh decoding as complementary requirements for improving transfer.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LatentReRig 把角色变形表示为几何隐空间中的可复用方向：SDF-VAE 配双解码器，一个重建隐式场，一个在源几何加隐变形条件下预测目标顶点位置。受控 humanoid 数据集上，多个姿态跨身份产生一致的隐方向，宽幅关节运动尤其明显，可引导未见角色变形；但局部变化与 corrective 贡献的显式预测精度不足。
Motivation: 跨几何与拓扑不同的角色迁移变形困难，因为传统 rig 依赖角色专属的结构与对应关系，无法直接复用。
Method: 基于 SDF 的变分自编码器耦合双解码器：其一重建隐式场，其二从源几何（中性或已变形）与隐变形条件预测目标顶点位置；并用重复 SDF 采样做诊断性比较，区分跨身份距离与同几何重采样变异。
Result: 受控 humanoid 数据集上，多个姿态跨身份产生一致隐方向，宽幅关节运动最明显；这些信号可引导未见角色变形，但局部变化与 corrective 贡献的显式预测精度较低。诊断比较显示跨身份距离平均超过同几何重采样变异，而姿态信号高于该基线的幅度各不相同。
Conclusion: 隐空间中存在可复用的姿态相关结构；提升迁移需同时解决稳定的局部条件化与准确的 mesh 解码两个互补要求。

papers.title: MM-VeriRec: Failure-Guided Fusion for Verifiable Agentic Multimodal Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Images often carry recommendation constraints that text metadata only hints at. A movie may need to look dark, a product may need a minimal style, and a visually impossible request should be rejected. Agentic multimodal recommenders must reason over text-image evidence, decide when visual evidence is decisive, and abstain when no valid action exists. We introduce MM-VeriRec, a verifiable multimodal recommendation protocol and failure-guided fusion method for hidden visual constraints, image-text mismatch, and impossible-task abstention. MM-VeriRec builds tasks from real movie-poster and product-image datasets, verifies each recommendation with deterministic visual attributes, and converts failures into actionable labels: text-trap following, visual ignorance, and false acceptance. Fusion should not merely concatenate modalities, but should diagnose which modality failed and route to the appropriate repair. Across MM-ML 1M and Amazon Reviews datasets, stronger text and vision embeddings improve retrieval but do not remove these failure modes, whereas failure-guided fusion does. The adaptive attribute gate reads the same tags the verifier checks and its scores are verifier-aligned upper bounds testing whether the taxonomy routes to the correct repair. More informative is transfer under a non-aligned gate: an independently derived leave-one-out CLIP detector still reaches 0.7028 and 0.6111 visual-grounded success, above both a VBPR baseline and plain fusion. The text-versus-visual gap reproduces across two LLM families, and the repair that helps differs by domain. MM-VeriRec is both a benchmark and a practical diagnostic loop for trustworthy agentic multimodal recommendation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 1st International Workshop on Agentic Multimodal Intelligence: Models, Benchmarks, and Applications (AMI '26), co-located with ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.journal_ref: The 1st International Workshop on Agentic Multimodal Intelligence, co-located with ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MM-VeriRec 提出可验证的多模态推荐协议与失败引导融合 (failure-guided fusion)：用确定性视觉属性校验每次推荐，把失败归为 text-trap following、visual ignorance、false acceptance 三类标签，再据此诊断是哪个模态出错并路由到对应修复。在 MM-ML 1M 与 Amazon Reviews 上，更强的文本与视觉 embedding 只提升检索却消不掉这些失败模式，而失败引导融合能消掉；非对齐门控下独立推导的 leave-one-out CLIP 检测器仍达 0.7028 与 0.6111 的 visual-grounded success，高于 VBPR 基线与朴素融合。
Motivation: 图像常携带文本元数据只暗示的推荐约束（电影要暗、产品要极简），视觉上不可能的请求应被拒绝；现有 agentic 多模态推荐器无法判断视觉证据何时起决定作用、也无从在无有效动作时弃权。
Method: 从真实电影海报与商品图像数据集构建任务，用确定性视觉属性校验每条推荐，并把失败转化为三类可操作标签（text-trap following、visual ignorance、false acceptance）；融合不简单拼接模态，而是诊断失败模态并路由到相应修复。含读取校验器同款标签的 adaptive attribute gate，其分数作为 verifier-aligned 上界检验该分类能否路由到正确修复。
Result: 在 MM-ML 1M 与 Amazon Reviews 上，更强的文本与视觉 embedding 提升检索但不消除三类失败模式，失败引导融合可以消除；非对齐门控下独立推导的 leave-one-out CLIP 检测器 visual-grounded success 达 0.7028 与 0.6111，高于 VBPR 基线与朴素融合；文本与视觉的差距在两个 LLM 家族上复现，且有效修复因领域而异。
Conclusion: 多模态推荐的失败应被当作可诊断信号而非噪声：按失败类型路由修复比换更强 embedding 更有效，且该协议同时是 benchmark 与可信任 agentic 推荐的诊断闭环。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse.
papers.comment: Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PanoFuse 为语言条件机器人操作策略加入全景分支，用预训练全景基础模型提取语义与几何表征，并以解耦语义-几何路由 (DSGR) 把两路流分别经块状注意力送入状态与动作表征，而非直接混合异构特征。在七个评测设置上平均成功率 52.9%，超过所评测基线，且在新物体、未见背景与干扰物丰富设置下均取得一致增益。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 系统依赖视场有限的普通透视相机，缺少全局场景上下文，在视觉遮挡、干扰物与未见环境下操作不可靠。
Method: 专用全景分支用预训练全景基础模型从全向观测提取语义与几何表征；DSGR 将两类表征保持为独立上下文流，通过结构化 block-wise attention 选择性路由到下游状态与动作表示，保留预训练 VLA backbone 的任务相关语义。另构建同步数据采集流程与真实操作数据集，含全景 RGB、腕部视角图像、语言指令、机器人状态与动作。
Result: 在七个评测设置上平均成功率 52.9%，优于所评测基线；在 novel-object、unseen-background 与 distractor-rich 设置下取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 把全景全局上下文与局部操作观测解耦路由结合，可在遮挡、干扰与未见环境下提升 VLA 操作成功率；代码与数据将公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc.
papers.comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PanOVOcc 是一个免训练的全景具身开放词汇占据建图框架，把全景 SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期空间体素记忆放进在线架构，持续把几何与语义证据融合成可语言查询的全局地图。相对每个指标上最强的已评估基线，它在 Pan-Replica 上把 occupancy IoU 与 semantic mIoU 分别提高 +20.03 和 +7.06，在 Pan-Holo360D 上提高 +43.26 和 +20.16。
Motivation: 透视视角系统空间覆盖有限，现有全景方法又多从单次观测预测局部体素，难以支撑持久、全局、可查询的语义占据地图；该设定此前也缺少系统评测基准。
Method: 在线架构统一全景 SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期空间体素记忆，持续整合几何与语义证据构建全局语言可查询地图，且无需训练。同时建立 Pan-Replica 与 Pan-Holo360D 两个基准，把连续全景 RGB-D 序列与场景级语义占据真值配对，覆盖合成与真实场景。
Result: 相对每个指标上最强的已评估基线：Pan-Replica 上 occupancy IoU 提升 +20.03、semantic mIoU 提升 +7.06；Pan-Holo360D 上分别提升 +43.26 与 +20.16。
Conclusion: 免训练的全景序列 + 长期体素记忆路线能显著抬高开放词汇占据建图精度，且需要新基准才能公平评测这一设定；代码与基准将发布在 GitHub。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady 把单张 RGB 图加实例与地面提示重建成可物理执行的多物体场景：生成的 mesh 先放进共享的重力对齐坐标系，再用可微渲染优化相机空间位姿，并修正场景级支撑与接触，最后由 agentic 工作流把任务目标转成从原相机视角渲染的物理 rollout。实验显示它在输入视角对齐、接触合理性与物理稳定性上优于现有单图重建与场景生成基线。
Motivation: 单图 3D 生成只产出视觉上合理的物体资产，独立生成的 mesh 合成到同一空间后会与输入相机不对齐、违反重力、互相穿插或在物理仿真中失稳，无法支撑感知-推理-行动闭环所需的结构化场景表示。
Method: grounded refinement 框架：以单张 RGB 图与 instance/ground 提示为输入，将生成的物体 mesh 放入共享的重力对齐场景，用可微渲染 (differentiable rendering) 精修相机空间位姿，再修正场景级支撑与接触以保证物理执行稳定；随后由 agentic simulation 工作流把场景特定任务目标转成可执行的物理 rollout，并从原始相机视角渲染。
Result: 实验表明该方法在输入视角对齐 (input-view alignment)、接触合理性 (contact plausibility) 与物理稳定性上均优于现有单图重建与场景生成基线，并支持从单张图像出发的目标条件物理交互。
Conclusion: 把位姿优化与接触/支撑修正放进同一个 grounded refinement 环节，单图重建才能产出既对齐相机又能稳定跑物理 rollout 的仿真就绪场景，从而打通感知到行动的闭环。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: grounded refinement 框架：以单张 RGB 图与 instance/ground 提示为输入，将生成的物体 mesh 放入共享的重力对齐场景，用可微渲染 (differentiable rendering) 精修相机空间位姿，再修正场景级支撑与接触以保证物理执行稳定；随后由 agentic simulation 工作流把场景特定任务目标转成可执行的物理 rollout，并从原始相机视角渲染。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明该方法在输入视角对齐 (input-view alignment)、接触合理性 (contact plausibility) 与物理稳定性上均优于现有单图重建与场景生成基线，并支持从单张图像出发的目标条件物理交互。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把位姿优化与接触/支撑修正放进同一个 grounded refinement 环节，单图重建才能产出既对齐相机又能稳定跑物理 rollout 的仿真就绪场景，从而打通感知到行动的闭环。

papers.title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniFysics-Captioner 是面向物理感知视听描述 (physics-aware audiovisual captioning) 的统一框架：用 OmniFysics-Agent 协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具收集时空对齐、可追溯的跨模态证据，训练 PPM 与 Captioner，并用新基准评测物理证据恢复。在视听描述上匹配 Gemini 3.1 Pro，多个视频描述基准达到 SOTA，显著优于其他开源模型。
Motivation: 现有 omni-modal captioner 主要建模通用视听语义，忽略瞬时或空间局部的物理证据（接触、支撑、形变、状态转移），缺少细粒度监督。
Method: 数据管线先筛选物理信息丰富的片段，由 OmniFysics-Agent 调用音频、视觉与物理感知工具收集时空对齐的跨模态证据；其中物理感知模型 (PPM) 在约 200 万图像级样本上微调，专门抽取物体交互与状态变化线索。据此构建 Daily-Physics 50K 数据集与证据驱动的 OmniPhysCap (OPC) 基准，再训练 Captioner。
Result: 视听描述匹配 Gemini 3.1 Pro；在多个视频描述基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果并显著超越其他开源模型；消融显示 PPM 证据提升物理覆盖度，产出更细粒度、更可靠的跨模态描述。PPM 微调使用约 2M 图像级样本，数据集规模 50K。
Conclusion: 把物理证据作为可追溯的显式监督注入数据构建与训练，能让 captioner 在保持视听描述水平的同时恢复更多物理与跨模态证据。

papers.title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述把「视频理解智能体」定义为以视频为主要信息源、靠自适应状态构建与动作选择完成理解任务的系统，并给出 challenge-to-design 分类法：上下文瓶颈对应分层证据记忆、证据稀疏对应主动证据获取、时序因果对应状态与过程跟踪、多模态歧义对应角色专业化协作。核心论断是智能体之所以必要，在于固定的一次性 video-language 推理无法处理长时上下文与需要主动查证的任务。
Motivation: LLM 已能处理多模态与更长时序上下文，但固定式的视频-语言推理只能一次性消费全部内容，无法决定该查看、保留、验证什么；该综述要回答的正是智能体对视频理解为何必要。
Method: 先形式化一个 video understanding 的 agent loop，再按 challenge-to-design 分类法组织文献，把四类挑战与四类设计逐一配对；另按 state space 范式、学习范式、监督信号、benchmark 与评测协议分维梳理，并给出面向 agentic-native temporal modeling 与 video-native agents 的开放方向。
Result: 综述性工作，产出为分类框架与文献组织本身：四组挑战-设计映射（上下文瓶颈→分层证据记忆、证据稀疏→主动证据获取、时序因果→状态与过程跟踪、多模态歧义→角色专业化协作），以及 state space、学习范式、监督信号、benchmark、评测协议的分维综述；摘要未含实验数字。
Conclusion: 视频理解的下一步是 agentic-native 的时序建模与 video-native agent，即让模型主动决定查什么、留什么、验什么，而不是把整段视频一次性塞进固定推理管线。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把注意力 MIL 中高注意力实例的解释问题改写成统计假设检验，用 selective inference 显式建模注意力选例与自适应参考例两次数据依赖选择事件，从而算出条件有效的 selective p-value。合成数据与 MNIST 数据上控制 Type-I error，病理 WSI 上可用，且统计功效高于 conventional over-conditioning 方法。
Motivation: 注意力 MIL 里高注意力分数常被当作诊断重要区域的解释，但分数本身无法判断该实例是否显著区别于正常实例；而目标例与参考例都由数据依赖流程选出，标准假设检验失效。
Method: 把高注意力实例与基于特征相似度选出的代表性正常参考实例之间的偏离写成假设检验问题，提出 selective inference 框架，显式刻画 attention-based instance selection 与 adaptive reference selection 诱导的 selection events，在这些事件条件下计算 selective p-value。
Result: 在合成数据与 MNIST-based 数据上展示 Type-I error 控制，并在病理 WSI 上展示实际可用性；统计功效高于 conventional over-conditioning 方法。
Conclusion: 把注意力选例的选择事件纳入推断后，高注意力实例的解释可以给出条件有效的显著性结论，比 over-conditioning 更有功效。

papers.title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在孟加拉国三个水稻叶部病害数据集（5,419 张图、6 个跨数据集迁移对、3 个 CNN backbone、3 个随机种子）上做系统基准，诊断跨数据集迁移崩溃的成因。强数据增强使跨数据集 macro-F1 平均提升 +0.070（Wilcoxon p < 0.001，18 对中 15 对为正）；自监督 ViT（DINOv2 linear probe）与 CNN 同样崩溃，说明主因是采集条件偏移而非架构归纳偏置；自适应 batch normalization 一律损害迁移，损害幅度与源-目标标签先验差异及模型深度相关（Spearman rho = 0.621，p = 0.009）。
Motivation: 在一个图像集合上训练的水稻叶病模型部署到另一个集合时性能大幅下降，跨数据集迁移的失效来源此前缺乏系统刻画与诊断。
Method: 在三个孟加拉国水稻叶病数据集上做基准：5,419 张图、6 个迁移对、3 个 CNN backbone、3 个随机种子；对比强增强、两种独立分割去除非叶片内容、DINOv2 linear probe 作为架构对照、自适应 batch normalization，并用 Grad-CAM 归因分析 12 个采样预测，全部冻结结果与预设分析准则存入带 SHA-256 校验的公开仓库。
Result: 强增强带来平均跨数据集 macro-F1 +0.070（Wilcoxon p < 0.001，18 个迁移对中 15 对为正）；分割去除非叶片内容方向性收益平均 +0.066（p = 0.062，n = 36 对观测），在两种独立分割方法上一致但未达传统显著性；DINOv2 linear probe 与 CNN 呈现同等程度的跨数据集崩溃；AdaBN 一致损害迁移，损害幅度与源-目标标签先验分歧及模型深度相关（Spearman rho = 0.621，p = 0.009）；Grad-CAM 在 12 个采样预测上无法区分正确与错误的跨域预测（p = 0.462）。
Conclusion: 强增强是有效的跨数据集适配策略，AdaBN 无效；跨数据集崩溃主要由采集条件偏移驱动，常见归因代理在实际样本量下不足以诊断该偏移。

papers.title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
papers.abstract_en: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model. This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain. On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MDL-SG 把 BPE 的停止准则从外部指定词表大小改成数据驱动：候选词对按 Significance-Gain 在发现集上排序，用单侧超几何检验加 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正在复制集上验证，再在效用集上按最小描述长度 (MDL) 判定，无正增益即自动停止合并。在 WikiText-103 上 500K 字符样本停在 847 次合并、得到 1,017 个 token；计算对齐的 TinyGPT 上 test BPC 3.2436，低于 SG-BPE 3.2894 与 frequency BPE 3.3493，但 frequency BPE 的原始压缩率更高。
Motivation: 常规 BPE 必须外部指定合并次数或目标词表大小，而压缩最优的合并选择与语言模型效用并不重合，需要一个能自动停且按效用校准的准则。
Method: 三阶段流程：发现集上按 Significance-Gain 排序候选对，独立复制集上做精确单侧超几何检验并按迭代施加 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正，效用集上用 MDL 准则评估，无复制候选带来正的 held-out MDL 增益即停止。下游用参数量同为 2,024,448、各 500 optimizer updates 的 TinyGPT 做计算对齐比较。
Result: WikiText-103 上 120K/250K/500K 字符训练样本分别在 209/433/847 次合并处停止；500K 字符下选出 1,017 token 的存储词表而无需预设词表大小。TinyGPT 上 MDL-SG 的 validation/test BPC 为 3.2612/3.2436，SG-BPE test BPC 3.2894，frequency BPE test BPC 3.3493；frequency BPE 的原始压缩更强。
Conclusion: 以 MDL 增益做停止准则可以在不预设词表大小的情况下自动定长，并让语言模型 BPC 优于 SG-BPE 与 frequency BPE，但压缩率与 LM 效用是两个可分离的目标。

papers.title: Be Careful Who You Trust: Coordination Dynamics under Corrupted Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Games
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as interacting agents, but it remains unclear how robust their coordination is when public communication is unreliable. We study this question in iterated $N$-player Stag Hunt games played by homogeneous LLM groups under controlled programmatic action inversion, which changes both the public transcript and the actions used for execution. Across an experimental grid spanning group sizes, coordination thresholds, corruption levels, and seven LLMs, we observe three main patterns. First, honest agents' pre-flip Stag choices decline as corruption increases, but the sharp fall in public success is primarily mechanical. In the focal $N=5,M=3$ setting, pre-flip success remains 78% at 80% corruption, while public success falls to 12%. Second, honest choices are associated with the public history available at decision time, particularly under high corruption. Third, three threshold-style public-report benchmarks yield similar action-match rates to the LLM agents, showing substantial descriptive agreement between LLM decisions and these benchmarks. Overall, our results show that original choices, public actions, and executed outcomes must be separated when evaluating multi-agent robustness, as corrupted communication can severely and predictably degrade mutually beneficial cooperation.
papers.comment: To be published in REALM: The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 N 人 Stag Hunt 迭代博弈中对 LLM 群体施加程序化动作翻转 (action inversion)，同时污染公开记录与实际执行动作，发现诚实 agent 的原始选择随污染上升而下降，但公开成功率的骤降主要是机械性的：在 N=5、M=3 的焦点设定下，80% 污染时翻转前成功率仍有 78%，公开成功率却跌到 12%。作者主张评估多 agent 鲁棒性时必须把原始选择、公开动作与执行结果三者分开。
Motivation: LLM 作为相互交互的 agent 越来越普遍，但当公共通信不可靠时其协调鲁棒性如何仍不清楚；若把被污染的公开记录直接当作决策依据，会把机械性失败误读成策略退化。
Method: 在迭代 N 人 Stag Hunt 博弈中让同质 LLM 群体博弈，用程序化动作翻转 (programmatic action inversion) 同时改写公开 transcript 与执行动作；实验网格覆盖不同群体规模、协调阈值、污染程度与七个 LLM，并比较三类阈值式公开报告 benchmark 的 action-match rate。
Result: 焦点设定 N=5、M=3 下，80% 污染时 pre-flip 成功率仍为 78%，而 public success 降至 12%；诚实 agent 的 pre-flip Stag 选择随污染增加而下降，且其诚实选择与决策时可见的公开历史相关，在高污染下尤其明显；三类阈值式公开报告 benchmark 与 LLM agent 给出相近的 action-match rate。
Conclusion: 公开成功率的崩塌主要由污染的机械效应造成而非协调策略本身失效，因此多 agent 鲁棒性评估必须分离原始选择、公开动作与执行结果；被污染的通信会严重且可预测地削弱互利合作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLC-YOLO 在 YOLO26 分割原型头上加一个固定局部高通残差，由 64 个零初始化的有界通道门控控制，在四个乳腺超声数据集上把 group-macro Dice 分别提高 1.68、3.11、1.12、2.45 个百分点，仅 BUS-BRA 的配对 95% 置信区间不含零。开销为 64 个参数、0.0049 GFLOPs、T4 上 0.0966 ms 前向延迟。
Motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割的评估容易因患者或重复图像跨数据划分而虚高，且需要在不泄漏的前提下做实时精修。
Method: 提出 Channel Local Contrast (CLC)，作为 YOLO26 分割原型头的紧凑精修：固定局部高通残差加 64 个零初始化有界通道门控。在四个乳腺超声数据集 (BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST) 上各做五折匹配对比，按患者分组或重复图像分组划分，BUS-BRA 用患者不相交外层测试加独立内层验证。
Result: group-macro Dice 提升：BUS-BRA +1.68、BUS-UCLM +3.11、BUSI +1.12、BrEaST +2.45 个百分点；仅 BUS-BRA 的配对 95% 置信区间不含零。开销：64 个参数、0.0049 GFLOPs；640 像素、单 T4、batch 1、FP16 TensorRT 图时间 CLC 2.1478 ms vs 基线 2.0512 ms（不含前后处理），前向开销 0.0966 ms。
Conclusion: 在严格分组划分下 CLC 于四个数据集均提升 group-macro Dice，且参数与延迟开销极小，但统计显著性目前只在 BUS-BRA 上成立。

papers.title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
papers.abstract_en: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Experimental Biology and Agricultural Sciences 2026, Q2, ISSN: 2320-8694
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合残差注意力网络 (HRAN) 对家蚕图像做六分类（健康与多种病态），残差块提取深层特征、空间与通道注意力聚焦病态特征，并配套新优化器 Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer (IAMO) 加速收敛。在预处理与增强后的家蚕图像数据集上，IAMO 优化后 HRAN 分类准确率达 98.67%。
Motivation: 蚕病早期识别依赖人工肉眼判别，病态与健康外观差异细微、类别间易混淆，需要在蚕业 (sericulture) 中实现自动化检测。
Method: HRAN 用残差块做深层特征提取，叠加空间与通道两个维度的注意力机制突出病态相关特征；图像先做归一化、缩放、降噪与数据增强；训练采用新提出的 IAMO 优化器以改善收敛与训练效率。
Result: 在预处理与增强后的家蚕图像数据集上，HRAN 经 IAMO 优化后六分类准确率为 98.67%。
Conclusion: 残差结构加双维注意力配合 IAMO 足以支撑家蚕病害的早期自动检测，作者计划后续提升在不同环境下的可扩展性与效率。

summary_sections.motivation: 蚕病早期识别依赖人工肉眼判别，病态与健康外观差异细微、类别间易混淆，需要在蚕业 (sericulture) 中实现自动化检测。
summary_sections.method: HRAN 用残差块做深层特征提取，叠加空间与通道两个维度的注意力机制突出病态相关特征；图像先做归一化、缩放、降噪与数据增强；训练采用新提出的 IAMO 优化器以改善收敛与训练效率。
summary_sections.result: 在预处理与增强后的家蚕图像数据集上，HRAN 经 IAMO 优化后六分类准确率为 98.67%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 残差结构加双维注意力配合 IAMO 足以支撑家蚕病害的早期自动检测，作者计划后续提升在不同环境下的可扩展性与效率。

papers.title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
papers.abstract_en: Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint? We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work. Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在压缩域视频描述 (compressed-domain video captioning) 上做受控替换实验：把 CoCap 的 CLIP I-frame 编码器换成 SigLIP2、BERT 式解码器换成 GPT-2，三组配置在相同数据、采样预算与优化日程下对比。SigLIP2 单独替换使每项指标都上升（CIDEr +4.5），再叠加 GPT-2 则把这一增益吃掉，因为预训练解码器在 4,999 条片段上两个 epoch 内即过拟合。
Motivation: CoCap 的 CLIP 编码器与浅层 BERT 式解码器都早于更强的替代品，但无法判断精度瓶颈究竟卡在编码器还是解码器这一侧。
Method: 三种配置受控对比：原始配对、仅换 SigLIP2 编码器、SigLIP2+GPT-2 同时替换；数据、采样预算与优化日程完全一致，且全部对照作者自己复现的 CoCap 而非其发表数字。训练用 VATEX 的 4,999-clip 子集、降低后的采样预算，并逐配置报告推理延迟。
Result: 复现与发表结果接近：CIDEr 54.9 对 52.7、METEOR 23.4 对 23.2 略高，BLEU-4 29.7 对 31.4、ROUGE-L 48.9 对 49.4 略低，作者归因于评测子集差异。SigLIP2 单独替换使全部指标提升，CIDEr +4.5；再加 GPT-2 则侵蚀该增益，原因是预训练解码器在 4,999 clips 上两个 epoch 内过拟合。
Conclusion: 在该小数据设定下编码器是可解锁的瓶颈、更强的预训练解码器反而因过拟合成为拖累；绝对数值不可与原工作比较，且精度增益若以延迟为代价必须连同延迟一起报告。

papers.title: Normalise or condition? Noise-floor front-ends for on-board keyword spotting under UAV rotor ego-noise
papers.abstract_en: A microphone on the airframe of a small multi-rotor UAV is dominated by rotor ego-noise, so spoken flight commands arrive at negative signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). We study small-footprint keyword spotting (KWS) for a ten-word command vocabulary under real ego-noise, training on one quadrotor and testing on another. Besides per-clip accuracy we measure the streaming false-alarm rate on 4.4 h of continuous rotor noise. We compare classical noise-robust front-ends (CMN, PCEN, spectral subtraction), test-time adaptation, and two front-ends that track the per-band ego-noise floor over the two seconds preceding the decision window and either subtract it (normalisation) or feed it to the network as a second input channel (conditioning). Per clip, all front-ends look alike: +2-3 points on average, up to +14 at -15 dB. On continuous rotor noise they differ sharply. Normalising front-ends fire about ten times more often than plain log-mel at the same threshold and end up below it at a budget of one false alarm per hour (-9 points at 0 dB). Conditioning keeps the baseline's false-alarm rate and turns its gain into detections (+8 points at -10 dB over three seeds); on top of PCEN it gives the best per-clip accuracy and false-alarm rate, and a level-anchored variant is also invariant to the microphone gain. Real drone+interferer recordings expose the remaining failure mode, environmental sounds and bystander speech, which training negatives halve. A single script reproduces all on-device numbers on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX flight computer, where the complete pipeline costs 3 ms per 100 ms hop on the CPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 UAV 旋翼自噪声下做十词机载关键词识别 (KWS)，把决策窗前两秒的逐频带噪声底作为条件输入比做归一化更可靠：归一化前端在连续旋翼噪声上误触发约十倍、在 1 每小时一次虚警预算下反而比 log-mel 基线低 9 个点（0 dB），而条件化保持基线虚警率并把增益转成检出（-10 dB 下 +8 点，三个种子），叠加 PCEN 后同时拿到最好的逐条准确率与虚警率。
Motivation: 机体麦克风语音指令处于负 SNR，逐条准确率看不出前端差异：各前端在单条片段上都只 +2–3 点，但在 4.4 小时连续旋翼噪声的流式虚警上表现截然不同，需要一个既保检出又不烧虚警预算的前端设计。
Method: 对比经典降噪前端 (CMN、PCEN、谱减法)、测试时自适应，以及两种跟踪决策窗前两秒逐频带自噪声底的前端：归一化（减掉噪声底）与条件化（把噪声底作为第二输入通道送入网络）；在一台四旋翼上训练、另一台上测试，报告逐条准确率与连续噪声上的流式虚警率，另含麦克风增益不变的 level-anchored 变体，全部数字由单脚本在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上复现。
Result: 逐条片段上所有前端平均 +2–3 点，-15 dB 时最高 +14 点；连续旋翼噪声上归一化前端虚警约为 log-mel 的十倍，在每小时一次虚警预算下落到阈值以下（0 dB 时 -9 点）；条件化在 -10 dB 下 +8 点（三个种子）且保持基线虚警率，叠加 PCEN 得到最佳逐条准确率与虚警率，level-anchored 变体对麦克风增益不变；真实无人机+干扰者录音中环境声与旁人语音是剩余失效模式，训练负样本使其减半；Jetson Orin NX 上 CPU 每 100 ms hop 全流程 3 ms。
Conclusion: 把噪声底作为条件而非减掉，才能在负 SNR 旋翼噪声下把前端增益兑换成检出而不抬高流式虚警；逐条准确率不足以选前端，必须看连续噪声上的虚警预算。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
papers.abstract_en: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RPA 用 ViT 中间层的全部 patch token（而非单一全局 embedding）与 M/EEG 信号对齐做图像检索，在 THINGS-EEG2 上取得被试内 Top-1 95.4%、跨被试 35.5%，THINGS-MEG 上 65.2% 与 6.7%，两数据集均达 SOTA。消融显示对 patch token 做池化或掩码会劣化表征，CLS token 几乎不提供独有信息。
Motivation: 现有 M/EEG 视觉解码方法只把脑信号与预训练视觉编码器的单一全局 embedding 对齐，丢掉了中间层 patch 表征中更细粒度的视觉信息，中间表征能否改善表征学习尚不清楚。
Method: 提出轻量模块化适配器 Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，取 ViT 视觉编码器中间层的全部 patch token 做对齐；配套消融（池化/掩码 patch token、CLS token 作用）与六项定量特征分析（高层语义与颜色、纹理等低层特征），并测试替代脑编码器（含预训练 EEG foundation model）及可替换为卷积、注意力或 ConvNeXt 的即插即用接口。
Result: THINGS-EEG2 Top-1：被试内 95.4%，跨被试 35.5%；THINGS-MEG：65.2% 与 6.7%，两数据集均为 SOTA。消融中池化或掩码 patch token 会降低学到的表征质量，CLS token 独有信息很少；六项特征分析表明高层语义与颜色、纹理等低层特征对 EEG-to-image 对齐都必需。
Conclusion: 利用视觉编码器中间层完整 patch token 集合是 M/EEG 到图像表征学习的有效设计原则，且该适配方式对不同脑编码器均可迁移，可即插即用替换为卷积、注意力或 ConvNeXt 结构。

papers.title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
papers.abstract_en: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低光照会显著削弱 VideoChat2 等视觉语言模型描述视频中人体动作的能力；本文在投影层与语言模型之间插入轻量稀疏高斯过程误差估计模块，用不确定性感知系数缩放残差并加回原表示，从而在不微调 VLM 的前提下修正中间表示。修正模型仅用 ARID 数据集 44 个样本单独训练，推理只增加少量计算开销。
Motivation: 低光照条件下 VLM 生成的视频描述明显退化，而直接微调底层 VLM 成本高且数据需求大，需要一种只修正中间表示的轻量方案。
Method: 在投影层与语言模型之间插入稀疏高斯过程 (sparse GP) 误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与经校验目标表示之间的残差；残差经新提出的不确定性感知系数自适应缩放后加回原表示，并采用 partitioned combined-kernel 设计改进残差估计；模块独立训练，不改动 VLM 权重。
Result: 修正模型仅用 ARID 数据集 44 个样本训练，推理阶段只需少量额外计算开销；有效性通过定量残差预测与生成描述的定性分析两方面检验，实验基于 VideoChat2。
Conclusion: 不微调 VLM、只在中间表示上做不确定性感知残差修正，即可改善低光照下的视频描述质量；框架设计为可迁移到其他兼容的 VLM 架构。

summary_sections.method: 在投影层与语言模型之间插入稀疏高斯过程 (sparse GP) 误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与经校验目标表示之间的残差；残差经新提出的不确定性感知系数自适应缩放后加回原表示，并采用 partitioned combined-kernel 设计改进残差估计；模块独立训练，不改动 VLM 权重。
summary_sections.result: 修正模型仅用 ARID 数据集 44 个样本训练，推理阶段只需少量额外计算开销；有效性通过定量残差预测与生成描述的定性分析两方面检验，实验基于 VideoChat2。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不微调 VLM、只在中间表示上做不确定性感知残差修正，即可改善低光照下的视频描述质量；框架设计为可迁移到其他兼容的 VLM 架构。

papers.title: Data Processing for Offline Evaluation in Recommender Systems: a Survey
papers.abstract_en: Offline evaluation is the dominant experimental paradigm in recommender systems research, enabling reproducible and cost-effective comparisons on historical interaction data. Yet, while considerable attention has been devoted to recommendation models and evaluation methodologies, the data processing decisions that precede model training have received less scrutiny. These decisions determine the information available to recommendation algorithms and can affect the comparability and reproducibility of experimental results. This survey provides a systematic, cross-domain characterisation of data processing practices for the offline evaluation of recommender systems. We examine the data-centric pipeline, from dataset selection and interaction representation to data preparation, multimodal feature extraction, and train-validation-test splitting. Our analysis spans recommendation paradigms, including collaborative, sequential, session-based, graph-based, knowledge-aware, context-aware, multimodal, federated, cross-domain, contrastive-learning, and LLM-based recommendation. Beyond reviewing existing practices, we introduce a unified framework and taxonomy for describing data transformations and feature-extraction strategies, distinguishing data preparation from the extraction of representations from multimodal side information. Our empirical analysis reveals a landscape dominated by a narrow set of dataset-level transformations, particularly support-driven filtering, while representation-dependent transformations remain less common. We further identify substantial heterogeneity in how auxiliary information is prepared and represented, as well as inconsistencies in the specification of data splitting protocols, where similar labels may conceal different experimental conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于推荐系统离线评测数据处理的综述，系统梳理从数据集选择、交互表示、数据准备、多模态特征抽取到训练-验证-测试划分的全流程，并提出统一的数据变换与特征抽取分类框架。实证分析发现该领域被少数数据集级变换（尤其是基于支持度的过滤 support-driven filtering）主导，而依赖表示的变换较少见；辅助信息的准备与表示方式高度异质，数据划分协议的描述不一致——相同标签可能掩盖不同的实验条件。
Motivation: 推荐系统研究大量关注模型与评测方法，但训练之前的数据处理决策缺乏审视；这些决策决定算法可用的信息，并直接影响实验结果的可比性与可复现性。
Method: 对数据处理流水线做跨领域系统刻画，覆盖协同、序列、基于会话、图、知识感知、上下文感知、多模态、联邦、跨域、对比学习与 LLM 推荐等范式；在此基础上提出统一框架与分类法，区分数据准备与从多模态侧信息中抽取表示两类变换，并对既有实践做实证分析。
Result: 实证分析显示：数据集级变换占主导，尤以 support-driven filtering 最为普遍，而表示依赖的变换较少；辅助信息的准备与表示存在显著异质性；数据划分协议的描述不一致，相似标签可能对应不同实验条件。
Conclusion: 推荐系统离线评测的可比性与可复现性受制于数据处理环节的不规范：应统一数据变换与划分协议的描述规范，并区分数据准备与多模态表示抽取。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RemTraceNet 针对水印去除攻击的取证检测：把受限残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar 统计与 block-DCT 证据在原生分辨率上融合，用每条去除流水线 100 张攻击训练图做 few-shot 判别。在 23 条去除流水线、10 种水印配置、256×256 与 512×512 输入上，三分种子 TPR@1%FPR 按攻击与水印配置宏平均为 82.75%–88.17%，同标签同协议下比重训的 SRNet、ZhuNet、SiaStegNet 高 10.80–15.68 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有水印攻击方法只按抑制效果与感知质量评估，忽略取证隐蔽性：水印被破坏不等于去除过程不可检测，验证失败时缺少去除痕迹会让失败原因无法判定。
Method: 为每条已知去除流水线训练一个 specialist，融合受限残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar 统计与 block-DCT 证据，在原生分辨率分类；分设 Attack-vs-Clean 与 Attack-vs-Watermarked 两套评测以杜绝“水印存在与否”的捷径，后处理方案用图像对齐对照、生成器内嵌方案用 prompt 匹配对照。
Result: 在 23 条去除流水线、10 种水印配置、原生 256×256 与 512×512 输入上，每流水线 100 张攻击训练图、三分种子的 TPR@1%FPR 宏平均为 82.75%–88.17%（跨分辨率与对照类型）；同标签同协议下比重训 SRNet、ZhuNet、SiaStegNet 高 10.80–15.68 个百分点。
Conclusion: 擦除水印与擦除去除证据是两个不同挑战，去除痕迹在有限监督下仍可学习，可作为来源与所有权验证的补充证据。

papers.title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出与水印方法无关的攻击 DnD (Disentangle and Drop)，把含水印图像分解为语义灰度载体与辅助残差分支，再抑制残差分支以丢弃水印证据。在七个代表性水印家族上，同一套共享操作设置即可取得有竞争力的去除效果且保持高视觉保真；操作扫描与消融显示，更强噪声或扩散虽能抬高去除分数但靠损坏图像实现，实用区间来自丢弃残差 latent。
Motivation: 隐形水印的鲁棒性评测只覆盖压缩、缩放、模糊、变色等良性后处理，遗漏了保留语义内容、专门丢弃承载载荷的残差证据的学习型去除器这一威胁。
Method: DnD 将水印去除表述为表示路由 (representation routing) 问题：把含水印图像分解为语义灰度载体与辅助残差分支，再抑制残差分支；训练中加入 latent 谱扰动与低强度 diffusion exposure，使 drop 操作在自适应重建下保持稳定。
Result: 在七个代表性水印家族上，单一共享操作设置给出有竞争力的去除效果与高视觉保真；操作扫描与消融区分了可用攻击与损坏图像的设置：更强噪声或扩散会通过损伤图像抬高去除分数，而实用区间来自丢弃残差 latent。
Conclusion: 水印鲁棒性应在表示层面针对学习型去除器来评测，仅测常规图像编辑不足以支撑鲁棒性结论。

papers.title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/Explainable-AI}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套架构感知的 XAI 评估协议，在 780 张乳腺超声图像上用 Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage 三个空间指标，系统比较 9 种可解释技术在四类深度模型（超深、轻量、Transformer、混合）上的表现。结论是解释质量主要由模型架构与 XAI 方法的交互决定，没有任何单一技术跨架构通用，混合架构的空间连贯性最好，因此必须联合选择 DL 模型与解释方法。
Motivation: 乳腺癌识别中 XAI 技术的选型基本靠经验，缺少跨不同 DL 架构的系统化评估，导致解释质量无法预测、临床可信度受损。
Method: 在 780 张乳腺超声图像上，对 9 种常用 XAI 技术 × 4 类 DL 架构（very deep、lightweight、transformer-based、hybrid）做统一评估，用与临床对齐的空间指标 Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage 量化生成解释与专家标注病灶区域的一致性。
Result: 解释质量主要受模型架构与 XAI 方法交互影响，而非某一种技术稳定胜出；混合架构产生更空间连贯的解释，轻量与 Transformer 模型在不同方法间变异更大；没有任何单一技术跨架构与评估准则通用。
Conclusion: 可解释性取决于模型设计与解释策略的联合选择，不能独立看待；作者据此给出结构化评估协议与选型实践指南，并公开代码。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向工业制造质检的非专家用户，把微调后的视觉-语言模型 (vision-language model) 接成可读性强的 XAI 界面，为工业目标检测生成语境化解释。作者先基准测试现有 VLM，发现开箱即用模型难以给出清晰、贴合语境的解释；微调后在专有与公开机器人数据集上，解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像接地与语境感知相对 GPT-4o-mini 均有提升。
Motivation: 现有 XAI 方法面向技术专家，制造产线上做质量控制的非专业工人难以理解，解释的可访问性成为 AI 落地产线的信任瓶颈。
Method: 先对现有视觉-语言模型做基准测试，再微调一个 VLM 并集成进 XAI 界面，为工业目标检测输出面向非专家的直观解释；评测覆盖专有数据集与公开机器人数据集，对照 GPT-4o-mini。
Result: 微调后的 VLM 界面在解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像接地 (image groundedness) 与语境感知四项上相对 GPT-4o-mini 有提升，评测于专有与公开机器人数据集；开箱即用的 VLM 被基准测试判定为难以交付清晰、语境相关的解释。
Conclusion: 面向非专家的工业 XAI 需要对 VLM 做领域微调并接入界面，才能产出可访问、语境化的解释，而非直接使用通用模型。
