papers.title: 3-D Emissions Mapping and Social Cost Estimation for US Domestic Aviation at West Coast Hubs
papers.abstract_en: Existing aviation emissions inventories lack accurate trajectory data for high-resolution social cost and health impact assessment. This paper develops a 3-D emissions map by reconstructing flight trajectories for US west coast hubs to estimate regional environmental and near-airport health impacts. A physics-informed autoencoder (AE) is applied to ADS-B trajectory records for January 2025 covering US west coast hubs. The encoder combines a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a Bi-GRU, and a 3-D CNN with skip connection; the decoder is a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). It is benchmarked against a baseline-AE and cubic spline interpolation. Emissions are mapped via EUROCONTROL Base of Aircraft Data (BADA) performance tables and ICAO Engine Emissions Databank (EEDB) emission indices, with altitude corrections via Boeing Fuel Flow Method 2 (BFFM2). Social costs are quantified for all flight phases, with health impacts assessed for Landing and Takeoff cycles within 50 km of each hub. The proposed AE model outperforms both a TCN-AE and cubic spline interpolation across 5% to 50% missing rates. Monetizing the emissions inventory shows NOx produces a small net cooling effect in direct climate forcing, while accounting for 99.7% of monetized air-quality and health cost despite being under 0.4% of CO2 by mass, making it the dominant health-cost driver. To our knowledge, this is among the first studies combining AE-based trajectory reconstruction with separate spatial-temporal feature encoding and altitude-based emissions modeling to produce a regional aviation emissions inventory for air quality, climate impact and population exposure. The resulting emissions map and social cost estimates provide quantitative context for environmental impact assessment and near-airport health policy evaluation for US domestic aviation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 physics-informed autoencoder 从 ADS-B 记录重建美国西海岸枢纽航班三维轨迹，再经 BADA 性能表与 ICAO EEDB 排放指数映射为区域排放清单并货币化社会成本。在 5% 到 50% 缺失率下该 AE 均优于 TCN-AE 与 cubic spline 插值；货币化结果显示 NOx 占 CO2 质量不足 0.4% 却承担 99.7% 的空气质量与健康成本，是主导健康成本因子。
Motivation: 现有航空排放清单缺少准确轨迹数据，无法做高分辨率的社会成本与健康影响评估，尤其难以刻画机场附近的近地暴露。
Method: 对 2025 年 1 月美国西海岸枢纽的 ADS-B 轨迹记录，用编码器（CNN + Bi-GRU + 3-D CNN 加 skip connection）与 TCN 解码器的 autoencoder 重建轨迹，对照 baseline-AE、TCN-AE 与 cubic spline 插值；排放经 EUROCONTROL BADA 性能表与 ICAO EEDB 排放指数映射，高度修正用 Boeing Fuel Flow Method 2 (BFFM2)，并对全部飞行阶段货币化社会成本、对各枢纽 50 km 内 LTO 循环评估健康影响。
Result: 在 5% 到 50% 缺失率区间，所提 AE 在两个基线上均更优；货币化清单中 NOx 在直接气候强迫上呈小幅净冷却效应，却占空气质量与健康货币化成本的 99.7%，而其质量占比不足 CO2 的 0.4%。
Conclusion: 轨迹重建精度直接决定区域航空排放清单的社会成本分配，NOx 是美国国内航空近机场健康成本的主导因子，应作为健康政策评估的重点。

papers.title: What does FFN compression change downstream? Same-state causal restoration in diffusion language models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible, parallel generation, but their iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, motivating increasingly aggressive compression. Existing compression objectives largely measure how well compressed computation approximates the original locally, but local error does not reveal which removed computations actually matter to the downstream denoising trajectory. We introduce Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR), which restores the original FFN on the exact current input reached by the compressed model and measures how the resulting trajectory changes. To our knowledge, this is the first direct measurement of the same-current-input closed-loop effect of removed FFN computation in DLM compression. Across LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, compressed-side state ranks this downstream effect substantially better than local NMSE at fixed denoising phase, while controlled interventions show that correction structure matters beyond magnitude. Using task-label-free calibration, SSR freezes a single restoration window for held-out inference. Under aggressive LLaDA compression, restoring only four transitions recovers 89.9% of the lost accuracy while retaining an estimated 36.8% whole-model MAC saving and outperforming an equal-budget local-error baseline. Dream further shows that restoring dense behavior and repairing the final task are distinct outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Same-State Causal Restoration (SSR)：在压缩模型当前到达的同一输入状态上恢复原始 FFN，直接测量被删计算对下游去噪轨迹的闭环影响。在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 激进压缩下只恢复 4 个 transition 即找回丢失精度的 89.9%，同时保留约 36.8% 全模型 MAC 节省，并超过等预算的局部误差基线。
Motivation: 现有 DLM 压缩目标只度量压缩计算对原始计算的局部近似程度，而局部误差无法揭示哪些被删计算真正影响下游去噪轨迹。
Method: SSR 在压缩模型当前输入上恢复原始 FFN 并比较轨迹变化；用 compressed-side state 排序下游效应并与固定去噪阶段的局部 NMSE 对照，辅以受控干预区分修正结构与幅度；再用 task-label-free 校准冻结单一 restoration window 用于留出推理。
Result: 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上，compressed-side state 对下游效应的排序显著优于固定去噪阶段的局部 NMSE；受控干预显示修正结构比幅度更重要。激进 LLaDA 压缩下仅恢复 4 个 transition 找回 89.9% 丢失精度，保留约 36.8% 全模型 MAC 节省，并优于等预算局部误差基线；Dream 上恢复 dense 行为与修复最终任务是两个不同结果。
Conclusion: 下游效应应按同一状态闭环恢复来度量而非按局部误差，且用无任务标签的校准即可固定恢复窗口；恢复 dense 行为不等于修复任务精度。

papers.title: The Temporal Tug-of-War: Visualizing and Detecting RAG Conflicts in Diffusion Models via Trajectory Variance
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces a specific failure mode in discrete diffusion language models: when retrieved context contradicts parametric knowledge, the iterative denoising process becomes a visible battleground between competing knowledge sources. We identify temporal semantic divergence as an observable for detecting these conflicts and introduce the Trajectory Variance Score (TVS), a simple and interpretable measure of this divergence. TVS computes the mean pairwise cosine distance of answer embeddings across independent stochastic denoising trajectories, capturing the temporal tug of war between parametric and contextual attractors. Requiring as few as two parallel inference runs, TVS is computationally lightweight. Across four diverse datasets (Synthetic, SciQ, PopQA, and CounterFact), a simple Logistic Regression classifier using TVS achieves $70.10\%$ accuracy and $0.7647$ AUROC on LLaDA. On Dream 7B, increasing the number of trajectories from two to five improves accuracy from $63.91\%$ to $69.62\%$. More complex sequential models provide only marginal improvements over the linear classifier. Evaluation across LLaDA and Dream 7B demonstrates that conflict-induced trajectory dynamics and their key properties transfer across distinct diffusion architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at the UncertaiNLP Workshop at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在离散扩散语言模型的 RAG 中，检索上下文与参数化知识冲突会让去噪轨迹分叉，论文把这种时间语义分歧做成 Trajectory Variance Score (TVS)：对多次独立随机去噪轨迹的答案嵌入取平均两两余弦距离，最少两次并行推理即可算出。用 TVS 训练的 Logistic Regression 在 LLaDA 上四个数据集 (Synthetic, SciQ, PopQA, CounterFact) 达到 70.10% accuracy、0.7647 AUROC；Dream 7B 上轨迹数从 2 增到 5，accuracy 由 63.91% 升到 69.62%。
Motivation: RAG 让检索内容与参数化知识在离散扩散模型的迭代去噪中相互拉扯，这种冲突缺少可直接观测的检测信号。
Method: 提出 TVS：对多条独立随机去噪轨迹的答案嵌入计算平均两两余弦距离，作为冲突观测量；再以 TVS 为特征训练 Logistic Regression 二分类器检测冲突，并与更复杂的序列模型对比。
Result: LLaDA 上，TVS + Logistic Regression 在 Synthetic、SciQ、PopQA、CounterFact 四个数据集上取得 70.10% accuracy 与 0.7647 AUROC；Dream 7B 上轨迹数由 2 增至 5 使 accuracy 从 63.91% 提升到 69.62%；序列模型相对线性分类器只有边际提升。
Conclusion: 冲突引起的轨迹动力学及其关键性质可跨 LLaDA 与 Dream 7B 两种扩散架构迁移，TVS 以极少并行推理即可作为轻量、可解释的冲突检测量。

papers.title: Autonomous Research Project Management as an Agent Skill: A Case Study in Exact Spectral Spatial Regression
authors: Tong Xie (1 and 2) ((1) University of New South Wales
papers.abstract_en: This work presents an end-to-end demonstration of autonomous machine learning research conducted by an agent skill on consumer hardware. The demonstration evaluates an FFT-based Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) solver for regular spatial grids using 2005 monthly NOAA Kaplan SST v2 anomaly fields on a $36 \times 72$ grid. This was autonomously executed by DeepSeek V4 Flash, orchestrated by our agent skill suite within DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Experiments were executed on CPU-only hardware (Apple M2 Pro; 78.7 s solver time, 1.57 GB peak RSS). Long-horizon state was decoupled into a file-based epic- and issue-tracking substrate. Across 74 sub-agent sessions, the agent demonstrated closed-loop scientific resilience: routing two failed hypothesis review gates back to literature retrieval, patching bootstrap indexing bugs, and executing with only four discrete human steering events. Finally, we reflect on autonomous research governance, arguing that scientific credibility requires inspectable state, falsifiable review gates, and transparent reporting of negative results, urging the machine learning community to favour agent-accessible structured formats over static PDF manuscripts.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, submitted to Autonomous Machine Learning Research (AutoMLR) 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在消费级 CPU 硬件上，用 agent skill 全流程自主完成一项机器学习研究：DeepSeek V4 Flash 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以 FFT 加速的 Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) 求解 2005 年 NOAA Kaplan SST v2 月度距平场，74 个子 agent 会话中仅需 4 次人工干预，两次假设评审失败被自动回退到文献检索。作者据此主张科研可信度依赖可检查状态、可证伪评审门与负结果透明报告。
Motivation: 自主科研 agent 缺少端到端、可在消费硬件上复现的完整演示，且长程状态与评审失败处理常依赖人工兜底。
Method: 以 agent skill 套件编排 DeepSeek V4 Flash，在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 中执行 FFT-based Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR)，输入为 36×72 网格的 2005 年 NOAA Kaplan SST v2 月度距平场；长程状态解耦为基于文件的 epic/issue 跟踪层，评审门失败时回退到文献检索并修补 bootstrap 索引 bug。
Result: CPU-only（Apple M2 Pro）上求解耗时 78.7 s、峰值 RSS 1.57 GB；跨 74 个子 agent 会话仅 4 次离散人工引导，两次失败的假设评审门被自主回退处理。
Conclusion: 自主 ML 研究可在消费硬件上闭环完成，其可信度前提是可检查状态、可证伪评审门与负结果透明报告，并应采用 agent 可读的结构化格式而非静态 PDF。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
papers.abstract_en: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NIH Malaria 血涂片数据集上对比 ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19 与自提模型的疟疾检测：MobileNetV2 以 96.35% 准确率、8.49 MB 模型、1.35 ms 推理取得精度-效率最优折中，自提模型准确率 97.67%、AUC 0.9756 但推理 13.17 ms 最慢。剪枝后自提模型的准确率与推理时间略有改善；结论是追求部署速度时选 MobileNetV2，追求最高精度时用剪枝后的自提模型。
Motivation: 疟疾已在 80 多个国家报告、造成 61 万例死亡且预计上升，显微镜诊断依赖专家与专用设备、劳动密集，需要在资源受限场景下兼顾准确率、模型体积与推理速度的自动诊断方案。
Method: 在 NIH Malaria 血涂片数据集上训练并比较四种 DL 架构（ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19）并提出一个新模型，记录准确率、AUC、模型大小与推理时间；对自提模型进一步剪枝，并用 GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME 三种 XAI 方法给出可解释性分析。
Result: MobileNetV2 准确率 96.35%，模型 8.49 MB，推理 1.35 ms（四者中最小最快）；自提模型准确率 97.67%、AUC 0.9756，推理 13.17 ms（最长）；更大架构带来更大模型体积而准确率仅中等；剪枝后自提模型准确率与推理时间均有小幅提升。
Conclusion: 疟疾血涂片检测存在明确的架构权衡：MobileNetV2 提供最佳速度-体积-精度组合，自提模型精度更高但推理最慢，剪枝可同时小幅改善其准确率与推理时间；GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME 用于解释模型判断。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
authors: Baskaran P ((1) Vellore Institute of Technology)
papers.abstract_en: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using Vite.js, Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.
papers.comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 微调预训练 TrOCR（microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten）识别手写 Devanagari 字符，在近 5000 张字符图像上按 8:1:1 划分训练，得到字符错误率 (CER) 3.95%、字符级准确率 96.05%，优于此前 CNN 模型；并用 Vite.js + Golang + FastAPI 部署，单请求延迟低于 5 秒。
Motivation: Devanagari 含 36 元音、14 辅音、10 数字，笔形复杂导致手写字符识别困难；现有 CNN 方案精度不足，且缺少可实际服务的部署方案。
Method: 将输入图像标准化为 RGB、分批 tokenize 并接入 Hugging Face Dataset，微调 microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten；训练用 mixed precision、gradient checkpointing 与 early stopping 优化，数据按 8:1:1 划分为训练/评估/测试，共约 5000 张字符图像。
Result: CER 3.95%，字符级准确率 96.05%，优于此前基于 CNN 的模型；Web 应用单请求延迟低于 5 秒。
Conclusion: TrOCR 微调可构建可扩展的手写 Devanagari 字符识别系统，并为后续基于 Transformer 的 Devanagari 脚本识别研究提供基础。

papers.title: Does Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture Pretraining Help Time Series Forecasting?
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising self-supervised pretraining paradigm for time series, learning representations by predicting target embeddings in latent space rather than reconstructing raw signals. Yet evidence on their benefits remains mixed, and most studies test only a single backbone or a narrow set of architectures, leaving unclear whether JEPA pretraining is a reliable improvement or one that depends heavily on the downstream model. We address this gap through a large scale evaluation of one JEPA instantiation across nine backbones and eleven benchmarks spanning temporal and spatio-temporal forecasting, the most extensive cross architecture assessment of JEPA for time series to date. We find that the benefit of this instantiation varies sharply across backbones, producing consistent gains for some architectures and consistent degradation for others, even on the same dataset. This pattern holds across both task families, indicating the variability is a general property of this instantiation rather than a dataset specific artifact worth accounting for when choosing a backbone in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 JEPA（joint-embedding predictive architecture）自监督预训练在时间序列上的收益做跨架构大规模评估：在 9 种 backbone、11 个涵盖时序与时空预测的 benchmark 上，同一 JEPA 实例的收益随 backbone 剧烈变化——对部分架构稳定提升，对另一部分稳定变差，同一数据集上也如此。结论是 JEPA 预训练并非普适增益，选 backbone 时必须把这种架构依赖性计入。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 时间序列研究多只测单一 backbone 或很窄的架构集合，无法判断其收益是可靠的普适改进，还是高度依赖下游模型，导致实践者无从选型。
Method: 对一个 JEPA 实例做大规模跨架构评估：覆盖 9 种 backbone、11 个 benchmark，任务横跨时序预测与时空预测 (spatio-temporal forecasting)，以统一设置比较预训练带来的收益方向。
Result: 同一 JEPA 实例的收益随 backbone 差异极大：对部分架构一致提升、对另一部分一致下降，即使在同一数据集上也出现分化；该模式在时序与时空两类任务上都成立，说明是该实例的普遍属性而非数据集特有假象。
Conclusion: JEPA 预训练对时间序列的收益是架构依赖的，不能当作通用增强；在实践中选择 backbone 时需把这一变异性作为决策因素。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
papers.abstract_en: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 4,225 张覆盖七种家禽 Eimeria 的显微图像上评测 Gemini 的物种级诊断：给出候选标签后总体准确率仅 14.9%，且 74% 判成 E. tenella，E. acervulina、E. mitis、E. praecox 全部判错。结论是现有多模态大模型在没有领域微调和专家复核时不能独立做 Eimeria 诊断。
Motivation: 球虫病 (coccidiosis) 是家禽业的主要经济损失来源，控制依赖准确的物种级诊断，而通用多模态大模型能否直接承担这一任务此前未经检验。
Method: 用 Google Gemini 在 4,225 张显微图像上做两种提示条件的评测：不给候选标签与给定预定义类别列表；另测其病理报告生成能力，并用 BiomedParse 做寄生虫分割 (parasite segmentation)。
Result: 不给候选标签时输出宽泛且分类学不一致；给候选标签后总体准确率 14.9%，偏向 E. tenella 达 74%，E. acervulina、E. mitis、E. praecox 零正确分类。生成的治疗报告连贯但未经验证，分割仅部分完成。
Conclusion: 现有多模态模型尚不足以独立完成 Eimeria 诊断，必须配合领域微调与专家验证。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: When Keywords Drop but Classifiers Hold: Soft Refusals under KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: KV cache compression is widely used for long context LLM inference under memory constraints, while deployed systems typically score refusals after generation with keyword filters or learned classifiers. Such monitors are intended to indicate whether a model declined a harmful request under the serving regime actually used. However, it remains unclear whether matched compression that preserves task accuracy also preserves agreement between lightweight lexical monitors and stronger refusal classifiers. We study this with a paired protocol on n=200 harmful prompts with a long filler context: each prompt is answered once under full retention and once under matched eviction after a shared prefill, and the same replies are scored by keyword heuristics, the HarmBench Llama-2-13B classifier, an auxiliary LLM judge, and humans on disagreements. On Qwen2.5-3B, keyword refusal falls from 98.0% to 80.5% (McNemar p~1e-8) while classifier refusal stays near ceiling (99.0%-99.5%) and MMLU accuracy is unchanged (50.0%); human labels predominantly follow the classifier, consistent with soft refusals. The gap is not universal and weakens under short fillers and paired SnapKV, so safety auditing under compression should rely on several judges matched to the serving context rather than on keyword rates alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 KV cache 压缩下，关键词式拒绝监控会失真而分类器监控保持稳定：Qwen2.5-3B 上长填充上下文配对实验中，关键词拒绝率从 98.0% 降到 80.5%（McNemar p≈1e-8），HarmBench Llama-2-13B 分类器拒绝率仍维持 99.0%–99.5%，MMLU 精度不变（50.0%），人类标注主要跟随分类器，符合 soft refusal。作者建议压缩下的安全审计使用多个与服务上下文匹配的评判器，而不是只看关键词拒绝率。
Motivation: 部署系统常在生成后用关键词过滤或学习分类器判定模型是否拒绝有害请求，但任务精度得以保持的压缩是否同时保持轻量词法监控与强拒绝分类器之间的一致性尚不清楚。
Method: 配对协议：n=200 条带长填充上下文的有害提示，每条在 full retention 与共享 prefill 后的 matched eviction 下各回答一次；同一批回复由关键词启发式、HarmBench Llama-2-13B 分类器、辅助 LLM judge 打分，分歧交由人工判定。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B 上，关键词拒绝率 98.0% → 80.5%（McNemar p≈1e-8），分类器拒绝率保持 99.0%–99.5%，MMLU 精度不变为 50.0%；人类标签主要跟随分类器。该差距并非普遍存在，在短填充与 paired SnapKV 下减弱。
Conclusion: 压缩可能在保持任务精度的同时破坏词法监控与强分类器的判定一致性，因此压缩下的安全审计应依赖多个与服务上下文匹配的评判器，而非仅看关键词拒绝率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Specs-on-Faces (SoF) 数据集上用统一预处理、划分与优化协议对比三种预训练 CNN backbone 的部分人脸识别 (PFR) 迁移学习效果，FaceNet 微调配置 PFN 达到 97.4% 测试准确率，明显优于 ResNet-50 与 VGG-16，且是 SoF 上报告过的最高准确率与召回率。
Motivation: 人脸被配饰、前景物体或画幅边缘遮挡时识别精度急剧下降，而现实中多数人脸是不完整的，鲁棒的部分人脸识别仍待解决。
Method: 对 ResNet-50、VGG-16、FaceNet 三个预训练 backbone 做迁移学习微调，统一 160x160 输入、冻结 backbone 只训 head、固定 epoch 预算且不做逐 backbone 超参搜索，在 SoF 数据集上按相同协议比较。
Result: FaceNet 配置 PFN 在 112 个身份类上取得 97.4% 测试准确率，macro 平均 precision 87.04%、recall 84.61%、F1 84.17%，为 SoF 上报告的最高准确率与召回率，且明显优于另外两个 backbone。
Conclusion: 在相同协议下，FaceNet 作为 backbone 更适合部分人脸识别迁移学习，是 SoF 上当前最强的配置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Active Causal Discovery Benchmark: Evaluating LLM Agents Under Budgeted Interventions
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Active Causal Discovery Benchmark (ACDB), an SCM-grounded environment for evaluating whether LLM agents recover causal graph structure from observations and budget-constrained hard interventions. ACDB pairs a linear-Gaussian world generator with a fixed observe-intervene-submit API and a three-layer scoring contract that separates skeleton recovery, DAG recovery, and intervention efficiency. On the current six-level ladder, PC with a greedy active orientation heuristic is the strongest non-oracle method (directed F1 42.7%, SHD 4.79), ahead of Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active (31.7%, 7.25) and GPT-5.4 raw active (22.9%, 9.27). The most informative diagnostic is the precision-recall decomposition: PC under-commits with high precision, LLMs over-commit with lower precision, and statistical-tool access often increases abstention rather than useful intervention. A structure-blind random DAG baseline reaches 23.6% directed F1 on this dense v0 ladder; a density probe lowers this floor to 16.9%, motivating the v1 calibration pass. The current results should therefore be read as a benchmark audit and calibration report, not as evidence that current LLMs solve active causal discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACDB 是一个基于结构因果模型 (SCM) 的主动因果发现基准，用线性高斯世界生成器加固定的 observe-intervene-submit API，在预算受限的硬干预下评测 LLM agent 能否恢复因果图结构。六级阶梯上 PC 加贪心主动定向启发式最强（directed F1 42.7%、SHD 4.79），领先 Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active（31.7%、7.25）与 GPT-5.4 raw active（22.9%、9.27）；结构盲随机 DAG 基线已达 23.6% directed F1，密度探针把该下限压到 16.9%。
Motivation: LLM agent 在预算受限干预下做主动因果发现的能力缺少可复现的评测环境，且密集图上结构盲基线就能拿到很高的分数，容易被误读为模型真的学会了因果发现。
Method: ACDB 由线性高斯世界生成器、固定的 observe-intervene-submit API 和三层评分契约构成，分别度量 skeleton 恢复、DAG 恢复与干预效率；在六级难度阶梯上对比 PC（带贪心主动定向启发式）、LLM raw active 策略与结构盲随机 DAG 基线，并用密度探针校准基线下限。
Result: PC（贪心主动定向）directed F1 42.7%、SHD 4.79；Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active 31.7%、SHD 7.25；GPT-5.4 raw active 22.9%、SHD 9.27。结构盲随机 DAG 基线 directed F1 23.6%，密度探针将其降至 16.9%。精度-召回分解显示 PC 低承诺高精度，LLM 高承诺低精度，统计工具访问往往增加弃权而非有效干预。
Conclusion: 当前结果应作为一次基准审计与校准报告，而非 LLM 已能解决主动因果发现的证据；密集 v0 阶梯的高基线分数促使作者启动 v1 校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DVS-PedX 事件相机行人过街检测上，用单层 WTA-STDP 无监督学特征字典、仅线性分类器带监督，在 24,454 帧测试集达 90.3% 准确率与 0.936 AUROC，接近端到端监督 SNN 的 92.0% 与 0.943。恶劣天气下 AUROC 降至 0.913；换成经典 neuron-assignment 读出同一网络只有 0.70 AUROC，说明无监督 SNN 的短板主要在读出协议而非可塑性规则。
Motivation: 现有事件相机 SNN 过街检测器都靠监督反向传播训练，需要昂贵的逐帧过街标注，标签成本限制了部署。
Method: 单层脉冲网络用 winner-take-all 的 STDP 从未标注事件帧 patch 学字典；帧用与学到滤波器的余弦相似度编码，经空间池化后由唯一的监督组件——线性分类器——读出；在 DVS-PedX 上与同帧端到端监督 SNN 对比，并测试不同可塑性规则与读出协议。
Result: 24,454 帧测试集上 90.3% accuracy、AUROC 0.936，监督 SNN 为 92.0% 与 0.943；恶劣天气 AUROC 0.913；结果对可塑性规则不敏感，但经典 neuron-assignment 读出仅 0.70 AUROC；真实转换子集上重拟合读出把 AUROC 从 0.53（随机水平）提到 0.67，落在已发表监督区间内。
Conclusion: 在该基准上从特征学习中去掉标签的精度代价很小，而无监督 SNN 报告出的弱点应归因于读出协议而非学习规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
papers.abstract_en: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Noise2Noise 式无标签去噪中，无条件 rectified flow 的一步读出恰好等于 MMSE 去噪器，而多步积分必然偏离 MMSE：流终止于含噪数据分布而非干净信号分布，高斯模型中该偏离可精确给出，实验上多步 Euler 逐步降低保真度且训练越好（速度场越准）退化越重。关键成分是去相关的含噪配对而非流本身，一步回归器在配对噪声上取得最佳无标签结果（+1.99 dB）；在 CTDenoiser 低剂量 CT 基准上，监督去噪器 PSNR 约提升 4 dB 却使低对比度病灶的 channelized Hotelling observer 可检出性下降。
Motivation: 去噪领域普遍假设多步迭代或生成式精修优于单次回归，但对无标签去噪这一假设方向可能相反，且 PSNR/SSIM 会掩盖与临床检出性相关的退化。
Method: 在 Noise2Noise 设定下训练无条件 rectified flow，证明其一步读出即 MMSE 去噪器，并在可解高斯模型中解析刻画多步积分相对 MMSE 的偏离；用 CTDenoiser 受控低剂量 CT 基准横跨五种架构与监督、相似度、blind-spot、逐图四类方法，对照一步回归、多步 Euler 与 Noise2Sim、Noise2Void 等无标签方法，并以 channelized Hotelling observer 度量低对比度病灶可检出性。
Result: 一步流与直接回归器持平，多步 Euler 积分逐步降低保真度，且退化随训练质量提高而加剧；去相关配对的一步回归器给出最佳无标签结果 +1.99 dB。CTDenoiser 五架构四类方法中，无标签方法里只有考虑相关噪声的 Noise2Sim 改善含噪基线，Noise2Void 因 CT 噪声违反其像素独立假设而持平到变差。监督去噪器 PSNR 约提升 4 dB，但 channelized Hotelling observer 显示低对比度病灶可检出性下降，PSNR 与 SSIM 未捕捉这一临床相关退化。
Conclusion: 无标签去噪的收益来自去相关的含噪配对而非多步流机制，一步即最优；评估去噪器须用任务级可检出性而非只看 PSNR/SSIM。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We present NanoForecast v0.5, a 6.5M-parameter forecaster that competes with models 31x its size (TimesFM, 200M parameters) after training pipeline fixes and no architecture change. Retraining the v0.3 architecture with corrected loss-scope handling, tensor shape alignment, and wider augmentation coverage cuts overall Mean Absolute Scaled Error by 43.8% under one fixed protocol (MASE 3.030 to 1.704) on the same data and compute budget. NanoForecast v0.5 beats TimesFM on all three ETT datasets (MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 vs. 0.705/1.360/0.545) and on exchange rate (4.317 vs. 4.383); TimesFM keeps a clear lead on the high-cardinality electricity and traffic sets. Against PatchTST (15M+ parameters, official configuration), v0.5 wins all three ETT sets. Training takes about 12 hours on a single cloud GPU (NVIDIA T4, Google Colab) and inference needs no GPU (measurements in this paper are on an Apple M4 CPU). We release all code, pretrained checkpoints, and evaluation framework under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NanoForecast v0.5 是一个 6.5M 参数的时间序列预报模型，仅靠训练管线修复（loss-scope 处理、张量形状对齐、更宽的增强覆盖）而不改架构，就把整体 MASE 从 3.030 降到 1.704（降 43.8%），在固定协议下与 200M 的 TimesFM 竞争。它在三个 ETT 数据集和 exchange rate 上胜过 TimesFM，但在高基数 electricity/traffic 上仍落后；训练约 12 小时单卡 T4，推理无需 GPU。
Motivation: 小型预报模型常被认为容量不足以匹敌大模型；作者要说明在相同数据与算力预算下，训练管线的正确性问题（损失作用域、形状、增强覆盖）才是主要瓶颈，而非架构规模。
Method: 保留 v0.3 架构不变，重训时修复三处训练管线问题：loss-scope 处理、tensor shape alignment、更宽的 augmentation coverage；在同一数据、同一算力预算和一个固定评测协议下与 TimesFM（200M）和 PatchTST（15M+，官方配置）对比，评测框架与代码一并以 Apache 2.0 发布。
Result: 整体 MASE 从 3.030 降至 1.704（降 43.8%）；三个 ETT 数据集 MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 对 TimesFM 的 0.705/1.360/0.545，exchange rate 4.317 对 4.383；对 PatchTST 赢下全部三个 ETT 集；TimesFM 在 electricity 与 traffic 上保持明显领先。训练约 12 小时（单块 NVIDIA T4，Google Colab），推理在 Apple M4 CPU 上测量、无需 GPU。
Conclusion: 在固定协议与相同预算下，修正训练管线即可让 6.5M 模型在多数基准上追平或超过 31 倍参数量的 TimesFM，但高基数（electricity/traffic）数据集仍是小模型的短板。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Query-aligned video frame selection for long video understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process multimodal inputs by converting text, images, and videos into token sequences that are subsequently processed by a backbone language model. While MLLMs have achieved excellent performance in understanding the content of individual images, video understanding remains significantly more difficult because videos contain large number of video frames. MLLMs typically process only a subset of these frames, usually ranging from 8 to 64. MLLMs usually sample frames uniformly, regardless of their relevance to the question being answered. To address this limitation, several training-free, model-agnostic methods for selecting question-relevant frames have recently been proposed. In this work, we introduce a frame-selection method designed specifically for multiple-choice questions. We extend the query text by appending semantic cues derived from the answer choices and employ a direct query-frame alignment scoring mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to directly utilize answer choices as inference-time cues for selecting frames relevant to answering a question. The method first constructs a compact candidate pool by subsampling video frames at a fixed rate. The frames are then scored according to their maximum cosine similarity across all question-answer pairs to identify the most relevant frames for a given query. This approach preserves a fixed token budget while improving the relevance of the visual evidence provided to the downstream MLLM. We evaluate the effectiveness of our frame-selection method on the MLVU, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench benchmarks using three MLLMs: LLaVA-Mini, Qwen2-VL, and LLaVA-Video. Experimental results demonstrate that answer-aware frame selection generally outperforms uniform sampling and existing training-free frame-selection methods under the same frame budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多选题长视频理解中均匀抽帧与问题无关的问题，提出答案感知的帧选择：把答案选项的语义线索拼进查询文本，先按固定比例子采样构建候选池，再用查询-帧直接对齐打分（跨所有问答对取最大余弦相似度）选帧。在 MLVU、Video-MME、LongVideoBench 上用 LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL、LLaVA-Video 三个 MLLM 检验，同帧预算下整体优于均匀抽帧与已有免训练帧选择方法。
Motivation: MLLM 通常只处理 8–64 帧且均匀采样，不考虑与问题的相关性，导致长视频中与问答相关的视觉证据被漏掉。
Method: 面向多选题的免训练、模型无关帧选择：把由答案选项导出的语义线索追加到查询文本，按固定比例子采样构建紧凑候选池，再按每个问答对的最大余弦相似度给帧打分，选出最相关帧，同时保持固定 token 预算。
Result: 在 MLVU、Video-MME、LongVideoBench 三个基准上，用 LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL、LLaVA-Video 三个 MLLM 评测：同帧预算下，答案感知帧选择整体优于均匀抽帧与已有免训练帧选择方法。
Conclusion: 把答案选项作为推理时线索直接用于查询-帧对齐，可以在不增加帧预算的前提下提高送入下游 MLLM 的视觉证据相关性。

papers.title: Age-Adaptive Handwriting Reconstruction from an IMU-Based Digital Pen through Shared Representations and Domain-Specific Heads
papers.abstract_en: Digital pens are widely used to capture handwriting on digital devices, enabling precise trace recording and enhancing human-computer interaction. However, most are bundled with tablets and lack cross-brand compatibility. Recent digital pens equipped with kinematic sensors have emerged, designed for use on any surface. This especially opens significant potential for supporting handwriting acquisition in classrooms. Handwriting reconstruction from such an IMU-equipped pen poses a challenge due to the significant variability in sensor signals between adults and children. Even when producing visually similar traces, variations in writing dynamics, motor control, pen holding, and user confidence introduce substantial discrepancies in the captured signals. Additionally, the high variability in children's handwriting requires collecting large amounts of data, which is not feasible to implement in a school environment at scale. Furthermore, models trained exclusively on adult data fail to generalize to children's handwriting, and conversely, models trained on children's data perform poorly on adult writers. This crosspopulation degradation highlights the need for a unified model that can be deployed directly on the pen, without any user-specific adaptation. To address this issue, we propose a cross-domain learning, using an original neural network architecture based on a Temporal Convolutional Network and multiple prediction heads. The model is designed to be robust across age groups by leveraging shared features while effectively handling variability induced by differences in graphomotor development. This approach aims to improve handwriting trace reconstruction from sensor data, where each domain benefits from additional data provided by the other domain.
papers.journal_ref: Automatically Domain-Adapted and Personalized Document Analysis workshop (ADAPTA), ICDAR 2026, Sep 2026, Vienna (AUSTRIA), Austria
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 IMU 数字笔的手写轨迹重建提出跨域学习架构：以 Temporal Convolutional Network 提取成人与儿童共享特征，再接多个 domain-specific prediction heads，让两个年龄域互相借用数据。动机是仅用成人或仅用儿童数据训练的模型在对方人群上都失效，且儿童数据在学校难以大规模采集。
Motivation: IMU 笔的传感器信号在成人与儿童间差异极大，儿童书写数据难以在学校规模化采集，而成人数据训练的模型无法泛化到儿童、反之亦然（crosspopulation degradation），需要一个无需用户适配、可直接部署在笔上的统一模型。
Method: 提出跨域学习 (cross-domain learning) 的神经网络架构：以 Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) 为骨干提取跨年龄共享特征，配合多个针对各人群的 prediction heads 处理 graphomotor 发育差异带来的变异性，使每个域都能从另一域的额外数据中获益。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性设计主张：共享特征加多头结构旨在让成人与儿童两个域互相受益，改善从传感器信号到手写轨迹的重建，并支持无需用户特定适配的直接部署。
Conclusion: 跨人群手写重建应通过共享表征加域专属输出头的统一模型来解决，而不是为每个年龄组单独训练或做用户适配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Language-Augmented Video Action Anticipation: Design Fundamentals, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Action anticipation predicts future human actions from partial video under incomplete context and temporal uncertainty. Recent systems introduce large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), or language-derived semantics at different stages, but reported gains are difficult to interpret when task formulation, visual pretraining, supervision, decoder design, and evaluation code change simultaneously. The central contribution of this review is an evidence-aware design map that crosses task regime with the point at which language-derived information intervenes. We characterise task regimes along six axes. These axes organise the literature into five broad task families: single-action, sequence, object-interaction, cross-view, and planning-oriented settings. C1-C3 locate interventions in context construction, goal/intention modelling, and future decoding, while C4 is treated as an adjacent, emerging grounding/executability extension. Unlike a generic processing pipeline, the map links each intervention to an appropriate counterfactual, failure diagnosis, and permissible evidence claim. Supporting contributions include a protocol-level audit of Ego4D-LTA and EPIC-KITCHENS-100, a multidimensional evidence profile, and the Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP). The unresolved EK-100 record is treated as a reporting-comparability case study and is not used as a leaderboard. Evidence for LLM benefits, goal ambiguity, and horizon effects is therefore formulated as testable hypotheses requiring matched validation, not as causal conclusions. The accompanying package contains the coded evidence, source locators, protocol metadata, and versioned catalogue used in the review.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Review article. Supplementary material, machine-readable data, and public artifacts are available at https://github.com/mahsa7290/language-augmented-action-anticipation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇动作预判 (action anticipation) 综述，提出以「任务域 × 语言介入位置」交叉的设计地图：六个任务轴归纳出五类任务族，C1–C3 分别定位在上下文构建、目标/意图建模与未来解码，C4 作为相邻的可执行性扩展。配套对 Ego4D-LTA 与 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 做协议级审计并提出 BCAP 对比协议，把 LLM 增益、目标歧义与时程效应改写为需匹配验证的可检验假设，而非因果结论。
Motivation: 动作预判系统同时改动任务表述、视觉预训练、监督、解码器与评测代码，导致 LLM/VLM 带来的增益难以归因和比较。
Method: 构建任务域与语言介入点交叉的设计地图：六个任务轴划分 single-action、sequence、object-interaction、cross-view、planning-oriented 五类任务族，C1–C3 标注上下文构建、目标意图建模、未来解码三处介入，C4 作为相邻扩展；每个介入点绑定反事实、失败诊断与可允许的证据主张。配套产出 Ego4D-LTA 与 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 的协议级审计、多维证据画像，以及 Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP)。
Result: 综述整理出 6 个任务轴、5 类任务族与 C1–C4 四类语言介入位置；对 Ego4D-LTA 和 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 完成协议级审计，并将 EK-100 未决记录作为报告可比性案例而非排行榜；LLM 增益、目标歧义、时程效应的证据被表述为待匹配验证的假设。全文 29 页、5 图、19 表。
Conclusion: 语言增强的动作预判要取得可比结论，必须先固定任务表述与评测协议（如 BCAP），否则 LLM 的收益只能算假设；EK-100 记录不应被当作排行榜使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Drives Dialectal Jailbreaks? An Ablation of Surface Form, Cultural Framing, and Strategy Banks
papers.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that obscure language registers can weaken large language model refusal behavior, especially when paired with black-box prompt optimization. It remains unclear whether failures stem from non-standard surface form, culturally grounded framing, or optimization over an expressive prompt-strategy space. We study Chinese registers by extending a classical-Chinese red-teaming framework to Shanghainese and Cantonese and running a 36-cell ablation across surface forms, strategy-bank variants, and two target models. The main finding is corrective: dialectal surface form is neither necessary nor sufficient for high attack success. Non-optimized English, Mandarin, and naive dialect translations remain below 8\% attack success rate, whereas all conditions that retain an optimizer-controlled strategy bank reach 98--100\%. A culture-neutral generic strategy bank reaches the same ceiling at near-single-query cost, further indicating that strategy-bank expressiveness, rather than dialectal or cultural content, accounts for most of the observed effect. Dialect choice still affects query efficiency and response severity, and qualitative coding identifies recurring high-level mechanisms such as semantic glossing and procedural scaffolding. We qualify the absolute ceiling-level attack success rate by showing sensitivity to judge calibration and noting that the design does not fully separate one-shot strategy construction from iterative search.
papers.comment: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2026, 15 pages, 12 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在中文方言越狱 (dialectal jailbreak) 的 36 格消融中，方言表层形式对攻击成功率既不必要也不充分：未优化的英语、普通话和朴素方言翻译攻击成功率均低于 8%，而任何保留优化器控制的策略库 (strategy bank) 的条件都达到 98–100%。文化中立的通用策略库在接近单次查询的成本下就触及同一上限，说明效应主要来自策略库表达力而非方言或文化内容；方言选择仍影响查询效率与回答严重度。
Motivation: 已有工作认为冷僻语言寄存器能削弱大模型拒答，但失败究竟来自非标准表层形式、文化框架，还是对富表达提示-策略空间的优化，尚不清楚。
Method: 把经典中文 (Classical Chinese) 红队框架扩展到上海话和粤语，做覆盖表层形式、策略库变体和两个目标模型的 36 格消融；对回答严重度做定性编码，识别语义释义 (semantic glossing) 与程序性脚手架 (procedural scaffolding) 等高层机制。
Result: 未优化的英语、普通话与朴素方言翻译攻击成功率低于 8%；所有保留优化器控制策略库的条件达到 98–100% 攻击成功率；文化中立通用策略库以接近单次查询成本达到同一上限。绝对上限级成功率对 judge 校准敏感。
Conclusion: 方言越狱的效应主要由策略库表达力而非方言或文化内容解释，方言选择只调节查询效率与回答严重度；该设计未完全分离一次性策略构建与迭代搜索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

papers.title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForensicZoom 把通用 MLLM 改造成可自适应放大取证的工业级换脸检测框架：先注入取证感知视觉表征并对齐语言模型，再用 NEED_ZOOM 让模型在初始证据不足时自主请求可疑区域的放大视图，把固定单次分类变成多轮推理。在大规模工业身份验证数据上达到 97% 以上 TPR @ 0.1% FPR，同时产出可操作的取证归因。
Motivation: 在线身份验证中漏检威胁安全、误报打扰合法用户；专用取证检测器性能强但可解释性弱，MLLM 有语义理解与可解释推理却在换脸检测上明显偏弱，且标准分辨率下细微取证伪影难以呈现、统一高分辨率又太费算力。
Method: ForensicZoom 先为通用 MLLM 装备取证感知视觉表征并把语言模型与这些特征对齐；核心机制 NEED_ZOOM 让模型在初始证据不足时自主请求可疑区域的放大视图，形成多轮取证推理；缩放行为用奖励塑形 (reward shaping) 学习，平衡检测准确率与不必要的视觉检查，把额外算力集中到难例；最后用归因优化阶段改进自然语言取证报告并保持检测性能。
Result: 在大规模工业身份验证数据上，ForensicZoom 达到 97% 以上 TPR @ 0.1% FPR，大幅超过专用检测器与已有 MLLM 方法，并产出可操作的取证归因 (actionable forensic attributions)。
Conclusion: 让 MLLM 按需自适应放大取证证据，可以在保持可解释性的同时把换脸检测做到工业级精度与可扩展性。

papers.title: Parser, Chunking, and Embedding Interactions in Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Indian Government Regulatory Documents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are typically assembled from independently-chosen components -- a document parser, a chunking strategy, and an embedding model -- yet these choices are rarely evaluated jointly, and evaluations that do combine them are usually run on a single document or corpus. We present a controlled factorial study of 3 parsers, 3 chunking strategies, and 5 dense embedding models, together with a sparse BM25 baseline, evaluated against 800 question instances, each with one or more required evidence strings, with evidence strings automatically validated against source text and a 10% random sample manually reviewed, across four structurally distinct Indian central-government regulatory documents. We fit linear mixed-effects models with document-query-level random intercepts to the resulting 72,000-row result set, run Holm-corrected paired comparisons between matched dense and sparse configurations, and report clustered bootstrap confidence intervals for all 54 unique retriever configurations. We find that no single retriever family dominates across documents; parser and chunker choice interact significantly; MPNet-base is a consistent underperformer with a severe failure mode on table-derived questions; and the corpus exhibits a near-saturated evidence-preservation ceiling above 98%, indicating that retrieval differences are driven primarily by ranking quality rather than information loss during ingestion. We additionally report embedding-dimension and chunk-size/overlap ablations and an efficiency/quality Pareto analysis. We release our full evaluation harness, corpus manifest, and 800-question benchmark.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Retrieval-only factorial evaluation with supplementary ablations and reproducibility materials
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对印度中央政府监管文档的 RAG 检索做 3 解析器 × 3 分块策略 × 5 稠密 embedding（外加 BM25 稀疏基线）的受控因子研究，800 个带证据串的问题、72,000 行结果上拟合线性混合效应模型。结论是没有任何检索器家族跨文档占优，解析器与分块选择显著交互，MPNet-base 持续落后且在表格来源问题上严重失败；语料证据保留率接近 98% 的饱和上限，检索差异主要来自排序质量而非摄取阶段的信息丢失。
Motivation: RAG 管线的解析器、分块、embedding 通常各自独立选型，联合评估很少，且已有联合评测多局限于单一文档或语料，无法区分排序差异与摄取信息损失。
Method: 在四份结构差异明显的印度中央政府监管文档上做全因子组合：3 parsers × 3 chunking strategies × 5 dense embedding models 加 BM25 稀疏基线，共 54 个唯一检索配置；800 个问题各带一个或多个必需证据串，证据串自动对照源文本校验并随机抽 10% 人工复核。结果用带 document-query 级随机截距的线性混合效应模型拟合，稠密与稀疏匹配配置间做 Holm 校正的配对比较，全部 54 个配置报告聚类 bootstrap 置信区间，另含 embedding 维度与 chunk size/overlap 消融及效率-质量 Pareto 分析。
Result: 72,000 行结果集上：无单一检索器家族跨文档占优；parser 与 chunker 选择显著交互；MPNet-base 为持续欠优者并在表格来源问题上出现严重失败模式；语料证据保留率接近 98% 的饱和上限，说明检索差异主要由排序质量驱动而非摄取信息损失。
Conclusion: RAG 检索选型必须按文档联合评估 parser、chunker、embedding，因为三者存在显著交互且不存在跨文档通用赢家；在该语料上瓶颈是排序而非摄取保真。

papers.title: Cross-Material Support Transfer for Core-Loss Prediction Under Waveform Covariate Shift
papers.abstract_en: Power magnetic materials are characterized on the sinusoidal and triangular waveforms that excitation hardware conveniently produces, whereas deployed converters expose cores to trapezoidal, PWM-shaped flux trajectories, so loss models must predict exactly where their training data are thinnest. The final test of the MagNet Challenge embeds a deliberately extreme instance of this characterization-deployment mismatch: for material D, trapezoids form 16.4% of the test set but only 1.4% of the training set. The 95th-percentile relative error, hereafter p95, of the best submission, built on sequential transfer learning, stalled at 15.9%, the worst among the five materials. This paper shows that the obstacle is missing information under covariate shift rather than class imbalance, and that the missing support can be borrowed from sibling materials instead of being extrapolated. Controlled experiments first refute the imbalance reading: four standard remedies fail, and raising the trapezoidal share to the test-set level degrades accuracy further. The proposed material-identity support transfer, MIST, then trains one 2784-parameter predictor jointly on all five challenge materials. Material identity enters through feature-wise linear modulation, or FiLM, the scarce material's true-label loss is reweighted, and material D receives no fine-tuning, so that the bias of its trapezoid-free training set is never re-installed. MIST lowers the five-seed material-D p95 from 20.39+/-2.03% to 12.38+/-0.92% and the trapezoidal-class p95 from 37.4+/-8.8% to 15.16+/-1.69%, surpassing the best submission with one-sixth of its parameters and no fine-tuning stage; removing material identity at matched capacity inflates the error by an order of magnitude. These results argue that scarce materials should be characterized jointly with their siblings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MagNet Challenge 中材料 D 梯形波形训练样本极稀（测试集占 16.4%、训练集仅 1.4%）导致的协变量偏移，提出材料身份支持迁移 MIST：用 FiLM 注入材料身份、对稀缺材料真标签损失重加权，五种材料联合训练且材料 D 不做微调。五种子下材料 D 的 p95 相对误差从 20.39±2.03% 降到 12.38±0.92%，梯形类 p95 从 37.4±8.8% 降到 15.16±1.69%，以六分之一参数量超过最佳提交。
Motivation: 功率磁性材料在正弦/三角波下表征，实际变换器却施加梯形与 PWM 磁通轨迹，损耗模型恰在训练数据最薄处外推；MagNet Challenge 最终测试中材料 D 的梯形波形是刻意设置的极端分布错配，最佳提交的 p95 停在 15.9%，为五种材料中最差。
Method: MIST 用一个 2784 参数的预测器在全部五种挑战材料上联合训练：材料身份经 feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) 进入网络，稀缺材料的真标签损失重加权，材料 D 不做微调以免重新引入无梯形训练集的偏差；先用四种标准类不平衡补救措施做受控实验以否定不平衡解释。
Result: 材料 D 测试集梯形占 16.4%、训练集仅 1.4%；最佳提交（基于 sequential transfer learning）材料 D p95 为 15.9%。四种标准补救措施全部失败，把梯形占比提到测试集水平反而进一步降低精度。MIST 五种子材料 D p95 从 20.39±2.03% 降至 12.38±0.92%，梯形类 p95 从 37.4±8.8% 降至 15.16±1.69%，参数量为最佳提交的六分之一且无微调阶段；在同等容量下去掉材料身份，误差膨胀一个数量级。
Conclusion: 材料 D 的瓶颈是协变量偏移下的支持缺失而非类不平衡，缺失支持可从兄弟材料借得而非外推；稀缺材料应与其兄弟材料一起表征。

papers.title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Unknown-Class Detection in Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
papers.abstract_en: Ship classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is a critical computer vision task, yet the robustness of models under deployment shifts remains unclear. While models are often trained on one dataset and deployed on another, we lack a comprehensive understanding of their cross-dataset generalization. To address this, we evaluate six pretrained models on two SAR ship datasets in three settings: in-domain classification, cross-dataset transfer, and unknown-class detection. For unknown detection, we hold out all classes one at a time. In-domain, SARDet100K gives the best balanced accuracy on both datasets (73.4\% on FUSARShip and 53.2\% on OpenSARShip). In cross-dataset transfer, we observe strong failures: some models show moderate accuracy but near-chance balanced accuracy (for example, 64.5\% accuracy but 33.3\% balanced accuracy for OpenSARShip to FUSARShip). In unknown detection, performance depends on the held-out class and dataset, while MC-dropout variance is often close to random. These findings show that cross-dataset generalization in SAR remains limited and that task-specific uncertainty scores are often more informative than MC-dropout variance for held-out-class detection, although their relative ranking depends on the dataset and held-out class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 SAR 舰船分类上系统评测六个预训练模型的三种部署设定：域内、跨数据集迁移、逐类留出的未知类检测。域内 SARDet100K 在两个数据集上平衡准确率最高（FUSARShip 73.4%、OpenSARShip 53.2%）；跨数据集迁移出现接近随机的平衡准确率（OpenSARShip→FUSARShip 准确率 64.5% 但平衡准确率仅 33.3%），且 MC-dropout 方差常接近随机，任务专用不确定性分数对留出类检测更有信息量。
Motivation: SAR 舰船分类模型常在一个数据集上训练、另一个上部署，但跨数据集泛化能力缺乏系统评估，且未知类检测的不确定性度量可靠性不明。
Method: 在 FUSARShip 与 OpenSARShip 两个 SAR 舰船数据集上评测六个预训练模型，设定三种场景：域内分类、跨数据集迁移、逐类留出（每次 hold out 全部某一类）的未知类检测；比较任务专用不确定性分数与 MC-dropout 方差。
Result: 域内 SARDet100K 平衡准确率最高：FUSARShip 73.4%、OpenSARShip 53.2%。跨数据集迁移存在严重失效，例如 OpenSARShip→FUSARShip 准确率 64.5% 但平衡准确率 33.3%（接近随机）。未知类检测表现依赖留出类与数据集，MC-dropout 方差常接近随机水平。
Conclusion: SAR 跨数据集泛化仍然有限，任务专用不确定性分数通常比 MC-dropout 方差更能检测留出类，但两者的相对排序取决于数据集与留出类。

papers.title: Enhancing Foundation Models for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification via Targeted Oversampling
papers.abstract_en: Remote-sensing foundation models offer strong representations for SAR imagery, but their behavior under severe long-tail class imbalance is still not well characterized. We benchmark DOFA and SAR-JEPA on the imbalanced OpenSARShip dataset and compare them with ImageNet-pretrained baselines under a fixed, training-efficient protocol that keeps the backbone frozen. To mitigate imbalance without fine-tuning, we apply four oversampling methods in embedding space exclusively to minority classes and train a lightweight classifier head on the augmented embeddings. Across both foundation models, oversampling improves Macro-F1 and test accuracy relative to their respective baselines, with the largest Macro-F1 gains observed for DOFA using ADASYN (34.39 to 38.56) and for SAR-JEPA using SVM-SMOTE (25.89 to 32.30). We also report class-wise behavior, showing that aggregate improvements can coexist with persistent failures on specific rare classes. Code for embedding extraction and reproducible multi-seed evaluation is provided to support rapid experimentation on free-tier hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结骨干的前提下，用嵌入空间的少数类过采样缓解 SAR 船舶识别的长尾不平衡：对 DOFA 用 ADASYN 把 Macro-F1 从 34.39 提到 38.56，对 SAR-JEPA 用 SVM-SMOTE 从 25.89 提到 32.30。整体指标提升可以与个别稀有类持续失败并存，因此类别级表现必须单独看。
Motivation: 遥感基础模型在 SAR 影像上表征强，但在严重长尾类别不平衡下的行为尚不清楚，且通常需要微调才能缓解不平衡。
Method: 在 OpenSARShip 不平衡数据集上以固定、训练高效协议基准测试 DOFA 与 SAR-JEPA，并对比 ImageNet 预训练基线；骨干全程冻结，在嵌入空间对少数类施加四种过采样方法（含 ADASYN、SVM-SMOTE），仅在增广嵌入上训练轻量分类头，提供多 seed 复现代码。
Result: 两个基础模型上过采样相对各自基线均提升 Macro-F1 与测试准确率：DOFA+ADASYN 的 Macro-F1 34.39 → 38.56，SAR-JEPA+SVM-SMOTE 25.89 → 32.30；类别级分析显示总体提升可与特定稀有类的持续失败共存。
Conclusion: 不微调、只在嵌入空间对少数类过采样即可提升不平衡 SAR 船舶分类的 Macro-F1，但聚合指标的改善不代表稀有类已被解决，需按类检查。

papers.title: From Phase Transition to Systemic Failure: A Decoupled Analytics Framework for GNN Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Data quality is a major bottleneck for the reliable deployment of graph neural networks (GNNs) in real-world graph mining tasks. Among various sources of degradation, label noise and feature distribution shift (hereafter referred to as distribution shift) are two common yet fundamentally different challenges. To study their effects under controlled conditions, this paper constructs a synthetic homophilic graph regression benchmark in which the two factors can be manipulated separately. A total of 41 configurations and 410 runs are conducted to evaluate the behavior of representative GNN models under varying noise and shift conditions. The results show two distinct patterns. First, under additive label corruption, performance remains relatively stable over a broad range of noise settings and begins to deteriorate sharply only after an observed transition region around the 50 percent noise ratio. Second, under extreme feature distribution shift, all tested models suffer substantial degradation, with test MSE increasing by 48 times to 316 times and correlation dropping by 73 percent to 89 percent. These findings suggest that, in the present controlled setting, GNNs are considerably more tolerant to moderate label perturbation than to severe distribution mismatch. The study provides a controlled empirical baseline for understanding how data quality affects GNN-based graph mining systems and offers practical implications for deployment-oriented monitoring and model maintenance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自建的同质图回归合成基准上，标签噪声与特征分布偏移被分开操控，41 种配置、410 次运行显示 GNN 对两类退化的响应截然不同：加性标签噪声在约 50% 噪声比之前基本平稳、越过转变区后才急剧恶化，而极端特征分布偏移让所有被测模型立即大幅退化，test MSE 放大 48 至 316 倍、correlation 下降 73% 至 89%。结论是在该受控设定下，GNN 对中等标签扰动的容忍度远高于对严重分布失配的容忍度，部署监控应优先盯分布偏移。
Motivation: GNN 落到真实图挖掘任务时，数据质量是可靠部署的主要瓶颈；标签噪声与特征分布偏移是两类常见但机制不同的退化源，此前缺少能把两者单独操控的受控对照环境。
Method: 构造一个合成同质图回归 (homophilic graph regression) 基准，使标签噪声与分布偏移可独立调节；在不同噪声与偏移条件下评测代表性 GNN 模型，共 41 种配置、410 次运行。
Result: 加性标签噪声下性能在很宽的噪声范围内保持相对稳定，仅在约 50% 噪声比附近的转变区之后开始急剧下降；极端特征分布偏移下所有被测模型均严重退化，test MSE 增大 48 至 316 倍，correlation 下降 73% 至 89%。
Conclusion: 在该受控设定下，GNN 对中等标签扰动的容忍度明显高于对严重分布失配的容忍度；该基准可作为理解数据质量如何影响 GNN 图挖掘系统的受控经验基线，并指向面向部署的监控与模型维护。

papers.title: One Evaluation, Any Operating Point: Hypernetwork-Amortized MeanFlow for 3D MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Generative priors reconstruct accelerated 3D MRI well but pay heavily at deployment: tens of network evaluations per volume, and protocol-specific hyperparameter tuning. A third hidden cost is the scanner's fixed sampling pattern. We treat the whole operating point as an input. A 3D MeanFlow patch network (a one-step flow model) is fine-tuned end-to-end through a warm-started, five-iteration differentiable conjugate-gradient projection. A small hypernetwork maps the operating point (data-consistency weight, acceleration, and the Cartesian sampling pattern itself) to the network's per-channel modulation. Three findings follow. (i) Learning the acquisition is worth more than any other operating point: on clinical knee data, the learned mask gains up to +2.34 dB over the protocol's variable-density mask. This gain requires the solver: with a feed-forward reconstructor the same learned mask hurts at 4x (-1.7 dB), but with the data-consistency projection it adds +4.6 dB. (ii) One evaluation is highly effective: it beats a 20-step patch-diffusion prior by up to +3.1 dB on brain and +2.9 dB on knee. Three to five evaluations extend the front to +6 dB while using a quarter of the prior's network calls. (iii) Fully sampled targets are optional: trained self-supervised on a split of acquired samples, the reconstructor matches its supervised twin at 4x on real data. Finally, we report what failed and why: subject-adaptive acquisition from measured energy, combining self-supervision with learned acquisition, and amortising the data-consistency weight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 3D MRI 重建的整套运行点（数据一致性权重、加速倍率、Cartesian 采样 mask）作为超网络输入，调制一个一步 MeanFlow patch 网络，并端到端穿过 warm-start 的五次可微共轭梯度投影微调。在临床膝与脑数据上，学到的 mask 比协议变密度 mask 最多高 +2.34 dB，单次评估比 20 步 patch-diffusion 先验最多高 +3.1 dB（脑）与 +2.9 dB（膝），自监督训练在 4x 真实数据上追平监督版本。
Motivation: 生成式先验做加速 3D MRI 重建效果好，但部署代价高：每个体数据要几十次网络评估、需要按协议调超参数，且扫描仪采样 pattern 固定，三者都被当作不可动的常量。
Method: 3D MeanFlow patch 网络（一步流模型）端到端微调，前向穿过 warm-start、五次迭代的可微共轭梯度 (conjugate-gradient) 数据一致性投影；小型超网络把运行点（数据一致性权重、加速倍率、Cartesian 采样 pattern 本身）映射为网络逐通道调制；另设按已采集样本划分做自监督训练的版本。
Result: 临床膝数据上学到的 mask 比协议变密度 mask 最多 +2.34 dB；该增益依赖求解器——前馈重建器下同一 mask 在 4x 反而 −1.7 dB，配上数据一致性投影则 +4.6 dB。单次评估比 20 步 patch-diffusion 先验最多 +3.1 dB（脑）与 +2.9 dB（膝）；3–5 次评估把前沿推到 +6 dB，且只用先验四分之一的网络调用。自监督训练的重建器在 4x 真实数据上与监督孪生持平。
Conclusion: 把采样 mask 与数据一致性权重一起当作可学习、可摊销的运行点，配合可微数据一致性投影，单次网络评估即可超过多步扩散先验；作者同时报告了失败项：基于实测能量的受试者自适应采集、自监督与学习采集的组合、以及数据一致性权重的摊销。

papers.title: Beyond the Graph: An Adaptive Meta-Learner Fuses Explainability, Weather, and Dynamics for Robust Bus ETA Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate bus Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is vital for urban mobility, passenger satisfaction, and transit efficiency, yet existing models falter against nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, data sparsity, and factors such as weather. This paper proposes HYB(nm), an adaptive hybrid ensemble framework that dynamically fuses five complementary models - a historical baseline (MST-AV), periodical temporal pattern analysis (GDRN-DFT), Koopman Neural Operators for nonlinear dynamics (KOOP-NET), weather-integrated feature-engineered neural networks (FENN), and real-time graph convolutional networks (MGCN) - via a meta-learner attuned to real-time context. Evaluated on GPS and weather data from three Kolkata bus routes comprising more than 4,000 trips, the framework leverages the individual strengths of its components (for example, the low-latency explainability of MST-AV, the weather resilience of FENN, and the network-dynamics capture of MGCN) to deliver the superior robustness of HYB(2), state-of-the-art accuracy rivalling leading graph neural networks, and balanced trade-offs in stability and efficiency across prediction horizons and operating conditions. The extensible HYB(k) architecture equips transit agencies with flexible tools, ranging from economical single models to tailored high-fidelity hybrids, advancing predictive, equitable urban transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HYB(nm) 是公交 ETA 的自适应混合集成：用元学习器按实时上下文动态加权五个互补模型（MST-AV、GDRN-DFT、KOOP-NET、FENN、MGCN），把历史基线、周期模式、Koopman 非线性动力学、天气特征与实时图卷积融合起来。在加尔各答三条线路 4,000 余趟行程的 GPS 与天气数据上，HYB(2) 表现出最优稳健性，精度与领先 GNN 相当，并在不同预测时距与运行条件下取得稳定性与效率的平衡。
Motivation: 公交 ETA 现有模型难以处理非线性时空动态、数据稀疏以及天气等因素，导致在多变运行条件下精度与稳健性不足。
Method: HYB(nm) 由元学习器按实时上下文动态融合五个模型：历史基线 MST-AV、周期时序模式分析 GDRN-DFT、刻画非线性动力学的 Koopman Neural Operator（KOOP-NET）、天气集成的特征工程神经网络 FENN、实时图卷积 MGCN；HYB(k) 架构允许从单模型到定制混合的可扩展配置。
Result: 在加尔各答三条公交线路、超过 4,000 趟行程的 GPS 与天气数据上评估：HYB(2) 交付最优稳健性，精度与领先图神经网络相当，并在不同预测时距与运行条件下取得稳定性与效率的平衡；组件各司其职，如 MST-AV 的低时延可解释性、FENN 的天气稳健性、MGCN 的网络动态捕捉能力。
Conclusion: 按实时上下文动态加权的混合集成能在公交 ETA 上同时拿到稳健性与接近 GNN 的精度，且 HYB(k) 让机构在经济单模型与高保真混合之间自由选择。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Temporal-Attention Head Specialization During Video Diffusion Training
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers depend on temporal attention to coordinate information across frames, yet nearly everything known about this mechanism comes from analyzing trained models, so when and where temporal-attention structure forms during training remains poorly characterized. Population averages can also hide it, since a few specializing heads and a diffusing majority cancel in the mean. We therefore conduct a checkpoint-resolved census of every temporal-attention head across nine Open-Sora STDiT training runs spanning three model scales (306M to 1.03B parameters), scoring each head with an entropy-normalized measure of cross-frame attention concentration (CFAC) under a preregistered change-point and effect-size selection rule. The census reveals the sparse picture that averages obscure. Aggregate CFAC is flat or decreasing in every run, while a small minority of heads, roughly 4--13% in full-grid runs, develops pronounced concentration. Across seeds, the reproducible signal is positional but block-level. Selected heads repeatedly arise in the first temporal block, whereas individual head coordinates do not reproduce once block membership is accounted for. Among the analyzed 760M selected heads, attention maps converge to a small repertoire of local frame-routing motifs, self-frame diagonals and adjacent-frame bands, even when the responsible coordinates differ across runs. Correlation and ablation analyses do not establish a causal link to generated video quality, and we bound our claims accordingly. Beyond this STDiT family, the study contributes a transferable methodology. Checkpoint-resolved, per-head analysis under fixed selection rules can expose sparse temporal organization in other factorized video diffusion transformers and, with adapted routing metrics, in joint spatio-temporal architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Open-Sora STDiT 视频扩散训练过程做逐 checkpoint、逐 temporal-attention head 的普查，用跨帧注意力集中度 (CFAC) 发现：总体均值持平或下降，但约 4–13% 的 head 在训练中形成显著集中，且可复现的信号是块级位置（首个 temporal block）而非具体 head 坐标。作者明确限定因果结论：相关与消融分析未建立与生成视频质量的因果联系。
Motivation: 关于视频扩散 temporal attention 的既有认识几乎全部来自分析训练完成的模型，且总体平均会把少数特化 head 与多数扩散 head 相互抵消，导致该机制在训练中何时何处形成缺乏刻画。
Method: 在 9 次 Open-Sora STDiT 训练（3 个模型规模，306M 到 1.03B 参数）上做 checkpoint-resolved 普查，用熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度 (CFAC) 给每个 head 打分，并采用预注册的变点 (change-point) 与效应量筛选规则；辅以跨 seed 复现性、相关性与消融分析。
Result: 所有 run 的总体 CFAC 持平或下降，而 full-grid run 中约 4–13% 的少数 head 出现显著集中；跨 seed 可复现信号为块级位置，选中 head 反复出现在第一个 temporal block，具体 head 坐标在控制块归属后不复现；在所分析的 760M 模型中，选中 head 的注意力图收敛到少数局部帧路由 motif（自帧对角线与相邻帧带）。
Conclusion: 视频扩散训练中的 temporal attention 结构以稀疏、块级定位的方式形成，总体平均会掩盖它；固定筛选规则下的逐 head 分析可迁移到其他 factorized video diffusion transformer 乃至联合时空架构，但与生成质量的因果关系未被建立。

papers.title: Distributional sentiment modeling and anomaly detection for consumer complaint assessment
papers.abstract_en: Sentiment analysis is a common tool for converting unstructured text into quantitative signals in finance and risk management. Yet most applications reduce the output to a discrete polarity label or a single predictive feature, overlooking the distributional structure of sentiment intensity in consumer complaint narratives. In this paper we treat negative sentiment in consumer complaints as a bounded continuous variable and study its full distribution rather than a single label. We score each narrative with a transformer classifier, model the scores with Beta distributions, and compare the fitted distributions of meritorious and non-meritorious complaints through the Kullback Leibler divergence and the squared Hellinger distance. The fitted distributions are then linked with dollar amounts and company response outcomes to construct anomaly diagnostics that flag complaints whose textual severity is inconsistent with the recorded relief. We find that the two groups have strongly overlapping distributions, so negative sentiment intensity is not a sharp classifier of outcomes on its own; combined with monetary and categorical attributes, it isolates unusually severe complaints for operational risk monitoring. Treating sentiment analysis as continuous distributional measurement, this study links sentiment extraction, bounded response modeling, and anomaly detection in a unified framework for consumer complaint assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把消费者投诉中的负面情绪当作有界连续变量而非离散极性：用 transformer 打分后拟合 Beta 分布，再用 KL 散度与平方 Hellinger 距离比较有理投诉与无理投诉的分布，并与金额、公司回应结果结合做异常诊断。两组分布高度重叠，单靠情绪强度无法区分结果，只有与货币和类别属性联合才能挑出文本严重度与实际救济不匹配的异常投诉。
Motivation: 情绪分析在金融与风险管理中通常被压缩成离散极性标签或单一预测特征，丢掉了投诉叙述中情绪强度的分布结构，难以支撑运营风险监控。
Method: 对每条投诉叙述用 transformer 分类器打分，把负面情绪建模为有界连续变量并拟合 Beta 分布；用 Kullback-Leibler 散度与平方 Hellinger 距离比较 meritorious 与 non-meritorious 两组拟合分布，再将分布与美元金额、公司回应结果关联，构建标记文本严重度与记录救济不一致的异常诊断。
Result: 两组拟合分布高度重叠，负面情绪强度本身不是结果的锐利分类器；与货币及类别属性结合后，可隔离出异常严重的投诉用于运营风险监控。
Conclusion: 情绪分析应作为连续分布式测量而非单标签分类来用，其判别力来自与金额、回应结果等属性的联合，而非情绪强度单独。

papers.title: Open-Qwen-Music: An Auditable Framework for LLM-Based Music Composition and Diffusion Rendering
papers.abstract_en: We present Open-Qwen-Music, an open reconstruction of Qwen-Music and a fully specified research system for text-to-music generation that couples LLM-based semantic composition with diffusion-based acoustic rendering. The system comprises a 25 Hz single-codebook music tokenizer, a 3B-parameter autoregressive Music LLM, and a diffusion renderer producing 48 kHz stereo audio, following the cross-module interfaces reported by Qwen-Music. The strongest systems of this design remain closed, and prominent open music-generation projects release weights and inference code without their training corpora or end-to-end training implementations. This limits independent and controlled study of how information loss and prediction errors propagate from semantic representation through autoregressive planning to acoustic rendering. To our knowledge, Open-Qwen-Music is the first fully open release of an LLM-composition-plus-diffusion-rendering text-to-music system. Beyond model weights and inference code, the release includes the training datasets and provenance manifests, complete data-processing, annotation, training, inference, and evaluation pipelines, configurations, and pretrained weights for every learned module. Artifact manifests bind the identities of these artifacts across the complete workflow. Together, these artifacts establish a reproducible implementation of the modular architecture and provide an empirical basis for component-level analysis and future evaluation. We present the system as a transparent, executable research baseline and a starting point for the community, not as evidence of quality parity with Qwen-Music. Open-Qwen-Music is an ongoing effort, and we will continue to improve its generation quality, controllability, and robustness. All release artifacts are available at https://github.com/biang15343100-source/Open-Qwen-Music.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Open-Qwen-Music 把文本到音乐生成系统完整开源：25 Hz 单码本 tokenizer、3B 参数自回归 Music LLM 加 diffusion 渲染器输出 48 kHz 立体声，配套训练数据、溯源清单与全流程 pipeline。作者定位它是可审计、可执行的研究基线，明确不主张与 Qwen-Music 质量持平。
Motivation: 同设计的最强音乐生成系统闭源，开源项目只放权重和推理代码、不放语料与端到端训练实现，无法独立研究信息损失与预测误差如何从语义表示经自回归规划传到声学渲染。
Method: 按 Qwen-Music 报告的跨模块接口重建三段式架构：25 Hz 单码本音乐 tokenizer、3B 参数自回归 Music LLM、diffusion 渲染器；发布训练数据集与 provenance manifest、数据处理/标注/训练/推理/评估全流程、各学习模块的配置与预训练权重，并用 artifact manifest 绑定全流程产物身份。
Result: 系统规格为 25 Hz 单码本 tokenizer、3B 参数自回归 LLM、48 kHz 立体声 diffusion 渲染；据称是首个完全开源的 LLM 作曲加 diffusion 渲染文本到音乐系统，全部产物发布在给定 GitHub 仓库。
Conclusion: 模块化文本到音乐系统可以做到全流程可复现与可审计，作者将其作为社区起点和组件级分析的经验基线，而非质量对标 Qwen-Music 的证据，且项目仍在持续改进生成质量、可控性与鲁棒性。

papers.title: PalmLeaf-VQA: A Multi-Script Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Historical Palm-Leaf Manuscript Understanding Across Diverse Regions
papers.abstract_en: Historical manuscripts remain largely absent from modern vision-language benchmarks, leaving open how well multimodal large language models (MLLMs) handle culturally diverse, degraded, and non-Latin document images. We introduce \textbf{PalmLeaf-VQA}, a multi-script visual question answering benchmark for historical palm-leaf manuscript understanding across South and Southeast Asian traditions. PalmLeaf-VQA contains \textbf{923 curated manuscript images} and \textbf{7,384 question--answer pairs} from eight collection groups: Balinese, Grantha, Jathakam, Kambaramayanam, Kannada, Khmer, Sundanese, and Tamil. Unlike recognition-oriented resources, the benchmark targets manuscript-aware visual reasoning over preservation-relevant cues, including physical condition, line structure, material and coating, binding holes, margins, symbols, drawings, and localized visual artifacts. We evaluate recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under open-answer and constrained-answer prompting and provide fine-grained analysis across collections, question categories, and task types. The strongest evaluated model reaches only \textbf{58.00\% exact-match accuracy} on the held-out test split, revealing substantial limitations in current MLLMs for rare-script, degraded-layout, and preservation-oriented document understanding. PalmLeaf-VQA provides a standardized benchmark for advancing culturally grounded and layout-aware multimodal document analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PalmLeaf-VQA 是面向南亚与东南亚历史棕榈叶写本的多文字 VQA 基准，含 923 张写本图像与 7,384 个问答对，覆盖八个收藏组，考察物理状况、行结构、装订孔、边距等保存相关线索的写本感知视觉推理。在开放与受限两种提示下评测近期闭源与开源 MLLM，最强模型在留出测试集上 exact-match 准确率仅 58.00%，说明现有 MLLM 在稀有文字、退化版式与保存导向的文档理解上仍明显不足。
Motivation: 历史手稿基本缺席现代视觉-语言基准，多模态大模型如何处理文化多样、图像退化且非拉丁文字的文档缺乏可衡量的评测手段。
Method: 构建 PalmLeaf-VQA：923 张精选写本图像、7,384 个问答对，来自 Balinese、Grantha、Jathakam、Kambaramayanam、Kannada、Khmer、Sundanese、Tamil 八个收藏组；题目针对保存相关线索（物理状况、行结构、材质与涂层、装订孔、边距、符号、图画、局部视觉伪影）的写本感知视觉推理，以开放答案与受限答案两种提示方式评测近期闭源与开源 MLLM，并按收藏组、问题类别与任务类型做细粒度分析。
Result: 最强被评模型在留出测试集 (held-out test split) 上 exact-match 准确率仅 58.00%；评测覆盖开放答案与受限答案两种提示设置，分析维度为收藏组、问题类别与任务类型。
Conclusion: 现有 MLLM 在稀有文字、退化版式与保存导向的文档理解上存在实质性局限，PalmLeaf-VQA 为此类文化扎根、版式感知的多模态文档分析提供标准化基准。

papers.title: From Hand-Crafted to LLM-Based Variation Operators in Metaheuristics: A Tutorial
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being employed as variation operators in metaheuristics, generating or modifying candidate solutions, heuristics, or programs inside iterative search loops. This shift reframes variation as a model call conditioned on different types of information. We introduce an operator-level framework with two descriptors: (1) the type of prompt-conditioning information at variation time (\texttt{Numeric}, \texttt{Symbolic}, \texttt{Linguistic}), and (2) artifact persistence, identifying what survives the model call (\texttt{Transient}, \texttt{Amortized}, \texttt{Transfer}). The tutorial shows how to classify, build, and select these operators through a worked build template, a method survey, an evidence table, and a cost-aware decision guide.

papers.title: Energy Vision--Language--Action: A Controlled Multimodal Benchmark for Intent-Conditioned Residential Energy Management
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are studied mainly in robotics, where visual observations and language instructions are mapped to physical actions. This paper introduces Energy Vision-Language-Action (EVLA), a controlled multimodal benchmark for intent-conditioned residential energy management. EVLA frames battery scheduling as a multimodal trajectory-prediction problem in which an RGB energy-field representation, a numerical operating state, and a natural-language objective are mapped to a 16-step battery-action trajectory generated by a finite-horizon sampling-based reference generator. Source windows are derived from public residential electrical-load data, while electricity price, battery state of charge, indoor temperature, and time of day are generated benchmark metadata. A hidden operating regime is encoded only through energy-field texture, enabling paired visual changes while the explicit numerical state is fixed. Crossing 439,203 retained base windows with three hidden regimes and five language objectives yields 6,588,045 multimodal instances. An initial study evaluates 36 configurations over three training seeds using fixed subsets of 5,000 training, 500 validation, and 500 test instances. In the MobileNet-family comparison, removing processed language increases trajectory mean-squared error from 0.3856 +/- 0.0039 to 0.8628 +/- 0.0001, whereas removing vision yields 0.3843 +/- 0.0013, comparable to the full model. The results show strong asymmetry in modality use: the processed-language pathway is strongly associated with prediction quality, while the current RGB pathway provides no aggregate error advantage. These results characterize the fixed pilot subset and executed protocol rather than full-benchmark training. EVLA provides a controlled setting for studying how semantic intent and latent context influence residential energy-action prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EVLA：把住宅电池调度做成意图条件下的多模态轨迹预测基准，由 RGB 能量场、数值运行状态和自然语言目标映射到 16 步电池动作轨迹。在 MobileNet 系列的 5,000/500/500 固定子集试点中，去掉处理后语言使轨迹 MSE 从 0.3856±0.0039 升到 0.8628±0.0001，去掉视觉则为 0.3843±0.0013，与全模型相当——模态作用高度不对称，当前 RGB 通路不带来总体误差优势。
Motivation: VLA 模型主要在机器人领域研究，住宅能源管理缺少受控的、可隔离语义意图与隐含情境作用的多模态评测场景。
Method: EVLA 将电池调度建模为多模态轨迹预测：RGB 能量场表征 + 数值运行状态 + 自然语言目标，输出由有限时域采样式参考生成器产生的 16 步电池动作轨迹。源窗口取自公开住宅用电负荷数据，电价、电池荷电状态、室内温度与时刻为生成的基准元数据；隐藏运行机制仅编码在能量场纹理中，使显式数值状态固定时仍可做配对视觉变化。439,203 个基础窗口 × 3 种隐藏机制 × 5 种语言目标得到 6,588,045 个多模态实例。
Result: 初始研究在 3 个训练种子上评测 36 种配置，固定使用 5,000 训练 / 500 验证 / 500 测试实例。MobileNet 系列对比中，去掉处理后语言使轨迹 MSE 从 0.3856±0.0039 升至 0.8628±0.0001；去掉视觉为 0.3843±0.0013，与全模型相当。
Conclusion: 语义意图（处理后语言通路）与预测质量强相关，而当前 RGB 通路在总体误差上没有优势；这些结果刻画的是固定试点子集与已执行协议，而非全基准训练。
