papers.title: Typed Temporal Interaction Features for Simulation-Backed Forecasting of Open-Source Game Release Incidents
papers.abstract_en: Open-source video-game quality depends on inter-actions among code, assets, configuration, tests, contributors, and issue workflows, yet conventional defect predictors usually flatten or omit these relations. We investigate release-level forecasting of a quality incident within thirty days using GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot, a typed temporal feature pipeline with calibrated risk estimates and effort-aware ranking. Because the accessible OS-SGameBench materials do not provide manually audited release dates and outbreak labels, the executed evaluation is explicitly simulation-backed rather than an empirical claim about real games. Five seeded worlds each contain 120 projects and 24 releases, with project-disjoint validation and future cross-project testing. The pilot obtains an AUPRC of 0.520, AUROC of 0.673, Brier score of 0.207, and 29.68% effort-aware recall at a twenty-percent testing budget. Its closest local comparator, Static-Hetero-Reimpl, reaches 0.522 AUPRC; the -0.002 difference is not statistically significant after Holm correction. Inference requires 0.023 milliseconds per release in the measured environment. Ablations and controlled missingness, drift, engine, project-size, alert-threshold, and attribution analyses expose where typed interactions help and where they fail. Results support the reproducibility of the proposed protocol, not deployment effectiveness. Real OSSGameBench release reconstruction, stratified label audits, and official graph-model comparisons remain mandatory before journal submission or operational use in practice. This boundary protects research integrity and supports credible evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot 用带类型的时间交互特征对开源游戏发布后 30 天内的质量事件做发布级预报，并给出校准风险与 effort-aware 排序。在五个种子世界（各 120 项目、24 次发布）的仿真评测中 AUPRC 0.520、AUROC 0.673、Brier 0.207、20% 测试预算下 effort-aware recall 29.68%，与 Static-Hetero-Reimpl 的 0.522 AUPRC 差 -0.002 且经 Holm 校正后不显著；作者明确结论只支持协议可复现，不支持部署有效性。
Motivation: 开源游戏质量缺陷预测通常把代码、资产、配置、测试、贡献者与 issue 流程之间的关系压平或直接丢掉，发布级的 30 天内质量事件预报因此缺少可用的类型化交互建模。
Method: 提出 GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot：带类型的时间特征管线，输出校准风险估计与 effort-aware 排序；评测为 simulation-backed，五个种子世界各含 120 项目与 24 次发布，采用 project-disjoint 验证与 future cross-project 测试，并做消融与受控缺失、漂移、引擎、项目规模、告警阈值、归因分析。
Result: AUPRC 0.520、AUROC 0.673、Brier 0.207、20% 测试预算下 effort-aware recall 29.68%；最近的本地基线 Static-Hetero-Reimpl AUPRC 0.522，差值 -0.002 经 Holm 校正后不显著；单次发布推理 0.023 毫秒。
Conclusion: 结果支持该评测协议的可复现性而非真实部署效果；投稿或上线前仍需真实 OSSGameBench 发布重建、分层标签审计与官方图模型对比。

papers.title: Measurement-Error-Aware Causal Distributed-Lag Quantile Modeling of Indoor Air Pollution and Short-Term Lung-Function Deterioration
papers.abstract_en: Low-cost indoor air-quality sensors could support personalized asthma prevention, but their nonlinear measurement error, delayed exposure effects, time-varying confounding, and heterogeneous lower-tail responses limit risk estimation. We present CAUSALQUANT-ASTHMA, a measurement-error-aware causal quantile distributed-lag framework for short-horizon peak expiratory flow analysis. Sparse reference measurements train a nonlinear calibration model; stabilized sequential generalized-propensity weights address measured exposure assignment; and a susceptibility-modulated, smooth, noncrossing quantile model estimates lag-specific and sustained-exposure contrasts. Because no authorized cohort simultaneously provided dense indoor sensing, reference co-location, and outcome-compatible longitudinal data, evaluation used five semi-synthetic panels with known counterfactual truth, 150 patients and 12,600 patient-days per realization. Across eight methods, CAUSALQUANT achieved a dose-response integrated absolute error of 0.304 plus or minus 0.094, improving 24.2 percent over the strongest measurement-error and propensity-weighted baseline. It also obtained the lowest overall pinball loss, 1.065, while maintaining zero quantile crossings and 78.1 percent coverage for the nominal 80 percent interval. Sensor calibration reduced held-out exposure RMSE by 33.7 percent. Stress tests quantified degradation under sensor noise, missing personal measurements, and hidden confounding. These findings establish methodological feasibility and reproducibility, not clinical effectiveness; prospective, governance-approved external validation is required before patient-level interpretation or deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CAUSALQUANT-ASTHMA：面向低成本室内空气传感器的测量误差感知因果分位数分布滞后框架，用于短期呼气峰流速 (PEF) 恶化风险估计。在五个含已知反事实真值的半合成面板（150 名患者、每人日 12,600）上，剂量-反应 integrated absolute error 为 0.304±0.094，比最强的测量误差加倾向性加权基线改进 24.2%。
Motivation: 低成本室内空气质量传感器存在非线性测量误差、暴露效应滞后、时变混杂与个体下尾响应异质，直接做风险估计会失真；且没有权威队列同时提供密集室内传感、参考共置与结局兼容的纵向数据。
Method: CAUSALQUANT-ASTHMA 分三步：用稀疏参考测量训练非线性校准模型；用 stabilized sequential generalized-propensity 权重处理实测暴露分配；用 susceptibility-modulated、平滑且不交叉 (noncrossing) 的分位数模型估计滞后特异与持续暴露对比。评估用五个含已知反事实真值的半合成面板，每个 150 名患者、12,600 patient-days，共比较八种方法，并做传感器噪声、缺失个人测量与隐混杂的压力测试。
Result: 剂量-反应 integrated absolute error 0.304±0.094，较最强的测量误差与倾向性加权基线改进 24.2%；整体 pinball loss 最低为 1.065；分位数交叉为零；名义 80% 区间覆盖率为 78.1%；传感器校准使留出暴露 RMSE 下降 33.7%。压力测试量化了传感器噪声、个人测量缺失与隐混杂下的性能退化。
Conclusion: 该框架确立的是方法学可行性与可复现性，而非临床有效性；在用于患者层面解读或部署前，需要前瞻性的、经治理批准的外部验证。

papers.title: STAR: Adaptive Spatial-Temporal Normalization for Unified Microservice Incident Management
papers.abstract_en: Automated incident management in large-scale microservice systems relies on learning robust representations from multimodal observability data, including metrics, logs, and traces. Although recent self-supervised frameworks enable unified modeling for anomaly detection (AD), failure triage (FT), and root cause localization (RCL), they often struggle with non-stationary temporal dynamics and heterogeneous service dependency structures. In this paper, we propose STAR, a Spatial-Temporal Adaptive Representation learning framework that explicitly addresses these challenges through adaptive normalizations. STAR introduces two tightly coupled mechanisms: Temporal Adaptive Normalization (TAN), which dynamically normalizes multivariate time series using multi-scale temporal context, and Spatial Adaptive Normalization (SAN), which performs structure-aware normalization over service dependency graphs. Unlike prior methods that treat normalization as static or task-agnostic, STAR formulates it as a learnable, context-conditioned transformation aligned with the intrinsic properties of microservice systems. The resulting adaptive representations are integrated into a unified self-supervised framework, enabling end-to-end unsupervised support for AD, FT, and RCL tasks. Extensive experiments on two real-world microservice benchmarks demonstrate that STAR consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art baselines, yielding significant and stable improvements across all three tasks. Our results highlight adaptive normalization as a principled and effective mechanism for robust multimodal representation learning in complex software systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAR 用两个自适应归一化机制处理微服务可观测数据的非平稳时间动态与异构服务依赖：TAN 按多尺度时间上下文动态归一化多变量时序，SAN 在服务依赖图上做结构感知归一化，二者耦合后送入统一自监督框架，端到端无监督支持异常检测、故障分诊与根因定位三项任务。在两个真实微服务基准上，STAR 在全部三个任务上均稳定优于所有 SOTA 基线。
Motivation: 现有自监督框架把归一化当作静态、任务无关的预处理，难以同时应对微服务时序的非平稳动态与服务依赖图的异构结构，导致 AD、FT、RCL 三项任务的表示不稳。
Method: STAR 提出 Spatial-Temporal Adaptive Representation：Temporal Adaptive Normalization (TAN) 用多尺度时间上下文对多变量时序做动态归一化，Spatial Adaptive Normalization (SAN) 在服务依赖图上做结构感知归一化；归一化被形式化为随上下文条件化的可学习变换，输出表示接入统一自监督框架，端到端无监督训练覆盖 AD、FT、RCL。
Result: 在两个真实微服务基准 (benchmark) 上，STAR 在异常检测、故障分诊、根因定位三项任务上均一致超过全部 SOTA 基线，取得显著且稳定的提升。
Conclusion: 自适应归一化是复杂软件系统多模态表示学习中既原则性又有效的机制，可把三项异构运维任务统一到一个无监督框架内。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有自监督框架把归一化当作静态、任务无关的预处理，难以同时应对微服务时序的非平稳动态与服务依赖图的异构结构，导致 AD、FT、RCL 三项任务的表示不稳。
summary_sections.method: STAR 提出 Spatial-Temporal Adaptive Representation：Temporal Adaptive Normalization (TAN) 用多尺度时间上下文对多变量时序做动态归一化，Spatial Adaptive Normalization (SAN) 在服务依赖图上做结构感知归一化；归一化被形式化为随上下文条件化的可学习变换，输出表示接入统一自监督框架，端到端无监督训练覆盖 AD、FT、RCL。
summary_sections.result: 在两个真实微服务基准 (benchmark) 上，STAR 在异常检测、故障分诊、根因定位三项任务上均一致超过全部 SOTA 基线，取得显著且稳定的提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应归一化是复杂软件系统多模态表示学习中既原则性又有效的机制，可把三项异构运维任务统一到一个无监督框架内。

papers.title: MaD-RL: Matching Distributions for Calibrating LLMs with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used in language-model post-training to maximize rewards assigned to individual model outputs, such as scores from binary verifiers or reward models trained on human feedback. However, applications such as synthetic-data generation, fairness-related constraint satisfaction, and policy exploration require controlling the distribution of outputs across model generations rather than only maximizing expected reward. We propose a general RL-based framework for \textit{Distribution Matching} allowing matching the distribution of a latent categorical attribute of model outputs to a specified target distribution. Empirically, we demonstrate that dominant post-training recipes such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reduce output diversity by concentrating policy probability towards a single mode. Entropy regularization and sampling temperature can improve the spread of the distribution but have constrained effectiveness, limited to apply only in token space and toward uniform distributions. We show that prior work in this area is a specific case of Distribution Matching involving the $L_2$ divergence. We then propose reward functions for other divergences such as KL and Jensen-Shannon and motivate them with theoretical justification. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a set of experiments involving mathematical reasoning and programming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaD-RL 提出一个基于强化学习的分布匹配 (Distribution Matching) 框架，把模型输出中某一潜在类别属性的分布拉向指定目标分布，而非只最大化单条输出的期望奖励。实证显示 GRPO 会把策略概率集中到单一模式、降低输出多样性；熵正则与采样温度只能在 token 空间朝均匀分布改善，效果受限。作者为 KL 与 Jensen-Shannon 等散度给出奖励函数并配理论论证，在数学推理与编程任务上验证有效性。
Motivation: 合成数据生成、公平性约束满足与策略探索需要控制跨多次生成的输出分布，而主流后训练配方只优化单条输出的期望奖励，GRPO 还会压缩多样性。
Method: 提出通用 RL 分布匹配框架，将潜在类别属性分布与目标分布对齐；把已有工作归结为 L2 散度下的特例，并为 KL、Jensen-Shannon 散度设计奖励函数，辅以理论论证；实验落在数学推理与编程任务上。
Result: GRPO 降低输出多样性、把策略概率集中到单一模式；熵正则与采样温度能改善分布展开但受限于 token 空间且只能朝均匀分布；先前工作被证明是分布匹配中 L2 散度的特例；方法在数学推理与编程实验中展示有效性。
Conclusion: 把后训练目标从期望奖励换成显式分布匹配，可用 KL、JS 等多种散度控制输出分布，而熵正则与温度只是 token 空间内朝均匀分布的受限替代。

papers.title: Information Design Against Gaming and Learning Adversaries
papers.abstract_en: A principal who deploys a binary classifier with an abstention option must decide which queries the mechanism abstains on. The right choice depends on the adversary. A gaming adversary already knows the classifier and tries to manipulate features across the boundary, so the principal does best by abstaining on queries close to that boundary. The same boundary-localizing rule is the worst possible choice against a learning adversary who does not know the classifier: each abstention now tells the adversary that the boundary is nearby, which is enough to drive a binary search. We analyze this tension. The two natural defenses, abstaining at a fixed rate and abstaining near the boundary, are Blackwell-incomparable: neither can be simulated by post-processing the other's responses. The number of queries needed to reconstruct the boundary to error $\eps$ is $\tildeΘ(d/\eps)$ under the first defense and $Θ(d \log(1/\eps))$ under the second, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the classifier family and $\tildeΘ$ suppresses factors polylogarithmic in $d$ and $1/\eps$. The first rate is a worst case over query distributions; no reconstruction algorithm can close the gap at the distributions that attain it. We characterize the Pareto frontier between the two defense objectives, and confirm both rates on seven binary-classification tasks spanning tabular, image, and language-model-feature inputs: label-plus-counterfactual access extracts the boundary with up to $200\times$ fewer queries than a published label-only baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 带弃权选项的二分类器在面对两类对手时需要相反的弃权策略：对已知分类器、跨边界操纵特征的 gaming 对手，最优做法是在决策边界附近弃权；对不知分类器、靠弃权反馈做二分搜索的 learning 对手，边界附近弃权是最差选择。两种自然防御（固定弃权率、边界附近弃权）Blackwell 不可比，重建边界到误差 ε 所需查询数分别为 ~Θ(d/ε) 与 Θ(d log(1/ε))，d 为分类器族 VC 维。
Motivation: 部署带 abstention 的分类器时，主控方无法预知对手是已知模型的操纵者还是靠查询反馈学习模型的对手，而针对一种对手最优的弃权规则对另一种对手恰好最差，需要刻画这一张力及其代价。
Method: 把两种防御建模为对查询的弃权机制并比较其信息结构，证明固定弃权率与边界附近弃权 Blackwell 不可比；给出两类防御下重建边界的查询复杂度界（~Θ(d/ε) 与 Θ(d log(1/ε))，d 为 VC 维），并刻画两个防御目标之间的 Pareto 前沿。
Result: 固定弃权率下重建边界到误差 ε 需 ~Θ(d/ε) 次查询（对查询分布取最坏情形，且无重建算法能在达到该界的分布上缩小差距），边界附近弃权下需 Θ(d log(1/ε))。在覆盖表格、图像与语言模型特征输入的七个二分类任务上验证这两个速率；label-plus-counterfactual 访问抽取边界所需查询比已发表的 label-only 基线最多减少 200×。
Conclusion: 针对 gaming 对手与 learning 对手的最优弃权规则方向相反且信息论上不可互换，防御选择必须先判定对手类型；边界重建的查询代价由 VC 维与目标误差以两种不同速率决定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Product-Aware Deterministic Rounding for Quantized Matrix Multiplication
papers.abstract_en: Scalar rounding decisions interact through matrix multiplication. We study deterministic product-aware rounding after scales, clipping bounds, and grids are fixed, with each active scalar choosing between adjacent levels. For dynamic activation rounding, null-space reduction preserves the relaxed product while leaving at most $r$ fractional decisions, where $r$ is the rank of the active gap-weighted weight block. Conditional-expectation completion gives a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm with squared product error at most $ \mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}+rν_{\max}^2/4$, where $\mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}$ is the best admissible error and $ν_{\max}$ is the largest row norm of that block. For reusable static weights, the exact expected product-loss metric is the uncentered input second moment with fixed output bias; free bias recalibration yields the centered covariance. Exact optimization is NP-hard even at rank one. In balanced blocks with $K=1024$ and $r=16$, conditional- expectation completion attains a dither-normalized median error of $0.010$, compared with $0.899$ for round-to-nearest. Clipping-aware initialization reduces median normalized error by a factor of $43.4$ at ten-percent clipping. Held-out Digits experiments show that retaining the input mean or correcting the output bias improves median product error over round-to-nearest in all four tested bit-width and calibration-size settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究量化矩阵乘法中尺度、裁剪界与网格固定后的确定性 product-aware 舍入：动态激活舍入用 null-space reduction 把松弛乘积保持住、只留 r 个分数决策，再用条件期望补全 (conditional-expectation completion) 得到确定性多项式时间算法，平方乘积误差至多 OPT_dyn + rν_max²/4。在 K=1024、r=16 的 balanced block 上，dither 归一化中位误差 0.010，round-to-nearest 为 0.899；十 percent 裁剪下裁剪感知初始化把中位归一化误差降低 43.4 倍。
Motivation: 量化矩阵乘法中各标量的舍入决策通过乘积相互耦合，逐元素 round-to-nearest 不考虑这种交互，导致乘积误差大；静态权重情形下精确优化即使秩为 1 也是 NP-hard。
Method: 动态激活舍入：在尺度、裁剪界与网格固定后，用 null-space reduction 保持松弛乘积、将分数决策压缩到 r 个（r 为 active gap-weighted weight block 的秩），再用 conditional-expectation completion 在多项式时间内确定性补全。静态可复用权重：刻画精确期望乘积损失为带固定输出偏置的未中心化输入二阶矩，自由偏置重校准后得到中心化协方差，并给出裁剪感知初始化。
Result: 在 K=1024、r=16 的 balanced block 上，conditional-expectation completion 的 dither 归一化中位误差为 0.010，round-to-nearest 为 0.899；十 percent 裁剪时裁剪感知初始化使中位归一化误差降低 43.4 倍。Held-out Digits 实验中，在测试的全部四种 bit-width 与 calibration-size 组合下，保留输入均值或校正输出偏置的中位乘积误差均优于 round-to-nearest。理论上给出平方乘积误差上界 OPT_dyn + rν_max²/4（ν_max 为该块最大行范数），并证明静态权重精确优化在秩为 1 时仍 NP-hard。
Conclusion: 把舍入当作耦合的乘积优化而非逐元素取整，可在多项式时间内逼近最优乘积误差；静态权重下期望损失由二阶矩与输出偏置刻画，保留均值或校正偏置即可稳定优于 round-to-nearest。

papers.title: Measure Learning at Steady State: A BIRD-SQL Formula 1 Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Continual Learning Bench scores learning as short-horizon gain versus a reset baseline and finds naive full-context ICL strongest among the memories it tested. We treat ICL as one learning system and score it on a longer shared-world schedule. Steady-state learning is the gap versus baseline on a pre-set late window (last 40 of 174 BIRD-SQL formula-1 questions). We split the score into exploration efficiency (SQL probes), task reward (hits), and delivery cost (API dollars and context size). On gpt-5.6-luna, late probes fall from 4.6-5.6 to 0.95 while hits rise only modestly and ICL context grows to about 95k tokens with cost roughly doubling. Short-horizon gain understates the late probe saving and misses the cost inversion, so we find that unbounded ICL is a poor candidate for the learning mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Continual Learning Bench 的短程增益评测换成共享世界长程稳态评测，在 BIRD-SQL formula-1 的最后 40/174 题上度量 ICL 相对 reset 基线的稳态差距。gpt-5.6-luna 上后期 SQL 探针从 4.6–5.6 降到 0.95，命中数仅小幅上升，而 ICL 上下文涨到约 95k tokens、成本约翻倍，出现成本反转，故无界 ICL 不适合作学习机制。
Motivation: 现有 Continual Learning Bench 以短程增益对比 reset 基线打分，会低估后期探针节省并漏掉成本反转，无法判断记忆机制在长程共享世界中的稳态表现。
Method: 把 ICL 视为单一学习系统，在共享世界长程日程上评测：稳态学习定义为预设后期窗口（BIRD-SQL formula-1 共 174 题的最后 40 题）相对基线的差距，并拆成探索效率（SQL 探针数）、任务奖励（hits）与交付成本（API 美元与上下文规模）三个分量。
Result: 在 gpt-5.6-luna 上，后期探针数由 4.6–5.6 降至 0.95，hits 仅小幅上升，ICL 上下文增长到约 95k tokens，成本约翻倍（roughly doubling）。
Conclusion: 短程增益会低估后期探针节省并掩盖成本反转；按稳态与成本一起计分，无界 ICL 是差的学习机制候选。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Does Domain Adaptation Help on Physical Vibration Sensors? A Held-Out-Bearing Study of Neural-Operator and Convolutional Models
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing rolling-element bearing faults from vibration is a canonical physical-sensing task and a widely used benchmark for domain adaptation under operating-condition shift. Accuracies above 99 percent are commonly reported, but under evaluation splits that place the same physical bearing in both training and test. We revisit the task under a held-out-bearing protocol, assigning every bearing unit entirely to either the training or the test set, and find that source-only transfer is far weaker than such numbers suggest: on a change of shaft speed it reaches only $0.36$, against a target-supervised ceiling of 0.97. We then study what governs transfer. Treating computed order tracking, a shaft-angle resampling that places fault frequencies at fixed shaft orders independent of running speed, as a controlled change of representation, we find that a Fourier Neural Operator raises source-only transfer from $0.36$ to $0.61$ on the speed shift, where the fault peaks move, while a convolutional network of matched feature dimension stays near chance in both representations. The representation also decides whether unsupervised alignment can work: with the same normalized RBF-MMD loss and no target labels, the operator reaches 0.71 in the frequency domain but 0.95 in the order domain, within 0.02 of the target-supervised ceiling and above $0.86$ on every held-out bearing fold. Once the representation is right, a small label budget adds little. These results indicate that, for this task, the input representation rather than the alignment method decides whether adaptation helps. A second dataset, whose held-out units are fault diameters rather than bearings, shows that the same protocol exposes failures that even a target-supervised model cannot avoid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在滚动轴承故障诊断的 held-out-bearing 协议下（每个轴承单元整体只进训练或测试），源域迁移远弱于常见 99% 以上的报告：转速变化时 source-only 仅 0.36，而目标监督上限 0.97。把 computed order tracking（轴角重采样，使故障频率固定在与转速无关的轴阶上）当作受控的表示变换后，Fourier Neural Operator 把转速偏移下的 source-only 从 0.36 提到 0.61，同特征维度的卷积网络在两种表示下都接近随机水平；同一 RBF-MMD 无目标标签对齐在频域得 0.71、在阶域得 0.95，距目标监督上限 0.02 以内且每个 held-out 折都高于 0.86。作者的结论是：该任务上决定 adaptation 是否有效的不是对齐方法，而是输入表示。
Motivation: 振动故障诊断常报 99% 以上准确率，但训练与测试划分让同一物理轴承同时出现在两侧，掩盖了跨工况（转速变化）的真实迁移难度；需要在整单元留出的协议下弄清到底什么决定迁移成败。
Method: 采用 held-out-bearing 协议，把每个轴承单元整体划入训练集或测试集；以 computed order tracking（轴角重采样）作为受控的表示变换，对比 Fourier Neural Operator 与特征维度匹配的卷积网络；无监督对齐统一用 normalized RBF-MMD 损失、不使用目标标签，并考察小标签预算的作用。
Result: 常见报告准确率在 99% 以上（同轴承划分）；held-out 协议下转速变化时 source-only 仅 0.36，目标监督上限 0.97。转速偏移下 Fourier Neural Operator 将 source-only 从 0.36 提到 0.61，匹配维度的卷积网络在两种表示下都接近随机水平。同一 RBF-MMD 无目标标签：频域 0.71，阶域 0.95，距目标监督上限 0.02 以内，且每个 held-out 折均高于 0.86；表示正确后小标签预算增益很小。第二个数据集的留出单元为故障直径而非轴承，同一协议暴露出连目标监督模型也无法避免的失败。
Conclusion: 对振动故障诊断这类任务，决定 adaptation 是否有帮助的是输入表示而非对齐方法：先用 order domain 把故障频率放到固定轴阶，再做无监督对齐即可逼近目标监督上限；而整单元留出的协议能暴露同轴承划分掩盖的失败。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Energy-aware frugal Bayesian optimization
papers.abstract_en: Modern design optimization frameworks aim first and foremost for models with the most accurate predictions without balancing computational overhead. It remains a reason why scaled architecture and multidisciplinary design optimization problems are difficult to address, even with sample-efficient Bayesian optimizers. In this paper, a metric quantifying the computational energy footprint is introduced within a Bayesian optimization framework to guide the parameter setting of a model towards configurations that balance both performance and frugality. The computer experiments highlighted existing tradeoffs between optimum convergence and the underlying energy footprint, and sometimes resulted in both a better-found optimum and lower energy consumption.
papers.comment: Published in MATEC Web of Conferences 422, 02009. 7th International Conference on Engineering Optimization
papers.journal_ref: G. Plat, P. Saves, N. Bartoli, T. Lefebvre, J. Morlier, Energy-aware frugal Bayesian optimization, EngOpt, 2026, Volume 422, 2026, pp 02009
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 中引入一个量化计算能耗足迹的指标，用来引导模型参数设置同时兼顾预测性能与计算节俭性。计算机实验显示最优收敛与能耗之间存在权衡，某些配置下既找到更好的最优值又降低能耗。
Motivation: 现代设计优化框架只追求预测精度而不计计算开销，导致大规模架构与多学科设计优化问题即使用样本高效的贝叶斯优化器也难以处理。
Method: 在贝叶斯优化框架内引入一个量化计算能耗足迹 (computational energy footprint) 的指标，将其用于引导模型参数配置，在性能与节俭性 (frugality) 之间做平衡；实验为计算机实验。
Result: 计算机实验揭示了最优收敛与能耗足迹之间的既有权衡，并且在某些情况下同时得到更好的最优值与更低的能耗。
Conclusion: 把能耗足迹作为贝叶斯优化的引导指标，可以在不牺牲（有时还能改善）最优解质量的前提下降低计算能耗。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FIDAL: Diversity-Aware Federated Active Learning Under Real-World Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across institutions without centralizing data, yet high annotation costs, domain shifts, and class imbalance remain major obstacles, especially when irrelevant out-of-distribution (OOD) samples dilute the labeled data. Existing active learning methods target uncertainty or diversity within in-distribution (ID) data and overlook unknown samples in federated clinical settings. We propose FIDAL, an open-set federated active learning framework that combines calibrated global-local evidential uncertainty, support-set diversity weighting, and adaptive OOD rejection. The rejection gate thresholds a foundation-model Gaussian-coverage signal per client and per round with Otsu's criterion, so that highly informative ID samples are queried while irrelevant outliers are excluded without any hand-tuned threshold. Evaluated on three multi-center medical imaging benchmarks (dermatology, histopathology, and mammography with organically occurring artifacts) in realistic open-set scenarios, FIDAL outperforms detector-based open-set methods by up to about 12 percentage points of balanced accuracy and is the only method on the accuracy-ID purity Pareto front of all three benchmarks. At an equal query budget it spends at least 1.3 times fewer annotations on OOD samples than every accuracy-matched baseline, saving an estimated 7-29 hours of expert reading on the mammography benchmark. By labeling only a fraction of the data pool, it matches or exceeds fully supervised performance across modalities. These results highlight the value of integrating uncertainty, diversity, and OOD rejection in open-set federated active learning for medicine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FIDAL 是面向临床多中心场景的开放集联邦主动学习框架，用校准的全局-局部 evidential 不确定性、support-set 多样性加权与基于 Otsu 准则自适应阈值的 OOD 拒绝门挑选标注样本。在三个医学影像基准上，其 balanced accuracy 比基于检测器的开放集方法最高高出约 12 个百分点，且在同等查询预算下标注 OOD 样本的开销至少比所有精度匹配基线少 1.3 倍。
Motivation: 联邦学习中标注成本高、域偏移与类别不平衡并存，尤其无关的 OOD 样本会稀释已标注数据；现有主动学习只在 ID 数据内做不确定性或多样性采样，忽略了联邦临床场景中的未知样本。
Method: FIDAL 组合三部分：校准的全局-局部 evidential 不确定性、support-set 多样性加权，以及按客户端、按轮次对基础模型 Gaussian-coverage 信号用 Otsu 准则自动定阈值的自适应 OOD 拒绝门，无需手工调阈值。
Result: 在 dermatology、histopathology、mammography（含自然产生的伪影）三个多中心医学影像基准的开放集设定下，FIDAL 的 balanced accuracy 比基于检测器的开放集方法最高高出约 12 个百分点，是唯一同时位于三个基准 accuracy-ID purity Pareto 前沿的方法；同等查询预算下标注 OOD 样本的量至少比每个精度匹配基线少 1.3 倍，在 mammography 上估计节省 7–29 小时专家阅片时间；只标注数据池的一小部分即可匹配或超过全监督性能。
Conclusion: 在开放集联邦主动学习中同时整合不确定性、多样性与 OOD 拒绝，可以用少量标注在多个医学模态上达到全监督水平，并显著减少浪费在 OOD 样本上的标注开销。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Grounding Vision-Language Models in Driving Semantics: A Multi-Dataset Predicate Framework for Explainable Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet the semantic relations expressed in their outputs are often difficult to verify against the underlying traffic situation. This paper introduces a deterministic multi-dataset predicate framework that derives driving-scene semantics from measurable geometric, kinematic, temporal, map, and traffic-control evidence. Dataset-specific interfaces are used only to recover the required scene information, while predicate definitions remain unchanged across nuPlan and nuScenes and are materialised in a common Predicate Knowledge Graph. Quantitative semantic validation against manually annotated predicate relations on 200 scenarios from each dataset yields macro F1 scores of 0.94 on nuPlan and 0.93 on nuScenes, with an average cross-dataset difference of 0.02 across the shared predicates. The Predicate KG is further evaluated using a frozen LLaVA-OneVision-7B model on the nine NuPlanQA subtasks. Predicate grounding achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated visual-input conditions in seven of nine NuPlanQA subtasks, including Traffic Light (53.2% to 71.5%), Situation Assessment (76.2% to 86.1%), and Action Recommendation (82.9% to 89.0%). Weather/Lighting remains essentially unchanged (89.4% vs. 88.8%), consistent with the absence of corresponding predicates, while Predicate KG only input outperforms metadata-only input in eight of nine subtasks. The results show that deterministic predicates provide a consistent and traceable semantic representation and, under oracle grounding, can reduce visual dependence for reasoning tasks covered by the predicate vocabulary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出确定性多数据集谓词框架，把驾驶场景语义从几何、运动学、时序、地图与交通控制的可测证据中抽出，统一物化为 Predicate Knowledge Graph，谓词定义在 nuPlan 与 nuScenes 上完全一致。人工标注的 200 个场景/数据集验证 macro F1 达 0.94（nuPlan）与 0.93（nuScenes），共享谓词跨数据集平均差 0.02；接入冻结的 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 后，九个 NuPlanQA 子任务中七个取得最高准确率，如 Traffic Light 53.2%→71.5%。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在驾驶场景输出中的语义关系难以对照真实交通态势核验，且跨数据集表示不一致，缺少可追溯、可验证的语义 grounding 手段。
Method: 用数据集专用接口仅负责恢复场景信息，谓词定义保持跨 nuPlan/nuScenes 不变，基于几何、运动学、时序、地图与交通控制证据推导语义并物化为 Predicate Knowledge Graph；再以冻结的 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 在九个 NuPlanQA 子任务上比较谓词 grounding、仅 KG 输入与仅 metadata 输入等视觉输入条件。
Result: 在每个数据集 200 个人工标注场景上，谓词关系 macro F1 为 nuPlan 0.94、nuScenes 0.93，共享谓词跨数据集平均差 0.02。NuPlanQA 九个子任务中谓词 grounding 在七个取得最高准确率：Traffic Light 53.2%→71.5%，Situation Assessment 76.2%→86.1%，Action Recommendation 82.9%→89.0%；Weather/Lighting 基本不变（89.4% vs 88.8%），对应谓词缺失；Predicate KG 单独输入在八个子任务优于仅 metadata 输入。
Conclusion: 确定性谓词能提供一致且可追溯的语义表示，在 oracle grounding 下可降低谓词词汇覆盖的推理任务对视觉输入的依赖；谓词缺席的子任务（Weather/Lighting）准确率不动，说明收益来自谓词覆盖本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Next-Event Accuracy Cannot See: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Emergency Department Trajectory Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Clinical trajectory models are usually evaluated by next-event accuracy on observed histories. Simulation is different: models must condition on their own generated events, allowing errors to compound. Although this problem is well known in sequence modelling, it has not been systematically quantified for clinical trajectory simulators. We developed EDSim-Bench to evaluate this failure mode using 425,028 MIMIC-IV-ED stays, with external replication on MC-MED, and release the evaluation protocol and scoring code. Starting from held-out visit prefixes, models generate the remainder of each visit and are evaluated on termination, event composition, timing, conditional fidelity, and occupancy forecasting, with a train-only order-3 n-gram as a reference baseline. Despite next-event accuracies within 0.001, three neural architectures behaved very differently under rollout. Across seeds, one Transformer recipe ranged from 0.43 to 0.96 in termination score and from 4.2- to 137-fold the divergence of the n-gram; no prefix-trained neural model approached the n-gram on termination or event composition. Inference-time interventions improved termination but did not jointly recover composition and timing. Supervising every eligible sequence position rather than only the final prefix position was associated with one to two orders of magnitude lower divergence across Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models, with the pattern persisting under model scaling, temporal shift, and external-site evaluation. Nevertheless, even the best model generated visits approximately half as long as observed, and model rankings reversed on occupancy forecasting, a downstream quantity relevant to bed management. These results show that next-event accuracy is insufficient to evaluate clinical trajectory simulators and motivate closed-loop evaluation across seeds, rollout criteria, and downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EDSim-Bench 用闭环 rollout 评估临床轨迹模拟器，发现 next-event accuracy 相差不到 0.001 的三个神经架构在自回归生成下表现截然不同：一个 Transformer 配方的 termination score 跨随机种子在 0.43–0.96 之间波动，散度为 order-3 n-gram 基线的 4.2–137 倍。监督所有可行序列位置（而非仅最后的 prefix 位置）使散度下降一到两个数量级，但最佳模型生成的就诊时长仍只有实测的一半左右，且 occupancy forecasting 上模型排名反转。
Motivation: 临床轨迹模型惯用 next-event accuracy 在观测历史上评估，而模拟要求模型条件在自己生成的事件上，误差会累积；这一失效模式在临床轨迹模拟器上从未被系统量化。
Method: 提出 EDSim-Bench：从 held-out 就诊前缀出发让模型生成余下全程，按 termination、event composition、timing、conditional fidelity、occupancy forecasting 五个维度打分，参照基线为 train-only 的 order-3 n-gram；数据为 425,028 条 MIMIC-IV-ED 就诊，并在 MC-MED 上做外部复现，评估协议与打分代码开源。
Result: 三个架构的 next-event accuracy 差距在 0.001 以内，但 rollout 下行为分化：一个 Transformer 配方跨种子 termination score 0.43–0.96，散度为 n-gram 的 4.2–137 倍；无 prefix 训练的神经模型在 termination 与 event composition 上均未接近 n-gram。推理时干预提升 termination 但未同时恢复 composition 与 timing。监督全部可行序列位置使 Transformer、GRU、LSTM 的散度降低一到两个数量级，该模式在模型缩放、时间漂移与外部站点评估下保持。最佳模型生成的就诊长度约为实测的一半，occupancy forecasting 上排名反转。
Conclusion: next-event accuracy 不足以评估临床轨迹模拟器，应改用跨种子、多 rollout 判据与下游任务的闭环评估；即便最优模型也系统性低估就诊时长。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Symmetry-quotient Flatness and Generalization
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a theorem-level pipeline in symmetry-quotient settings: quotient linear stability implies quotient flatness, quotient flatness implies input smoothness, and input smoothness yields generalization under local covering assumptions. Flatness is often associated with generalization, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is frequently viewed as implicitly biased toward flat solutions. However, standard flatness measures are typically defined in the raw parameter space and are therefore not invariant under function-preserving symmetries such as positive rescaling. We develop a symmetry-aware theory of quotient flatness, quotient linear stability, input smoothness, and generalization on quotient spaces of neural-network parameters. For square loss and models equipped with function-preserving group actions, we define quotient flatness as the trace of the Hessian of the empirical loss on the regular quotient manifold. We show that quotient flatness controls input smoothness through a quotient-space analogue of the flatness-to-smoothness argument. We also prove that one-step mean-square quotient linear stability of the linearized SGD dynamics implies an explicit quotient-flatness bound in terms of the batch size and learning rate, and extend this analysis to higher-order tensor moments. Finally, under local covering and boundedness assumptions, we derive population generalization bounds in terms of quotient flatness and, consequently, in terms of quotient linear stability.
papers.comment: Accepted to 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026) as an extended abstract. This version is the full paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在神经网络参数的对称商空间上建立定理链：商线性稳定蕴含商平坦，商平坦蕴含输入光滑，输入光滑在局部覆盖假设下给出泛化界。对平方损失与保持函数的群作用，商平坦定义为正则商流形上经验损失 Hessian 的迹；一步均方商线性稳定给出以 batch size 和学习率显式表达的商平坦界，并可推广到高阶张量矩。
Motivation: 标准平坦度量定义在原始参数空间，对正重缩放这类保持函数的对称性不变，因此与泛化的关联在有对称性的网络上失效。
Method: 对配备保持函数群作用的平方损失模型，把商平坦定义为正则商流形上经验损失 Hessian 的迹；证明商平坦到输入光滑的商空间类比论证；由线性化 SGD 动力学的一步均方商线性稳定推出以 batch size 与学习率表达的显式商平坦界，并扩展到高阶张量矩。
Result: 得到四段蕴含：商线性稳定 ⇒ 商平坦 ⇒ 输入光滑 ⇒ 泛化；泛化界在局部覆盖与有界性假设下以商平坦（从而以商线性稳定）表达，batch size 与学习率显式出现在稳定到平坦的界中。
Conclusion: 把平坦度与 SGD 隐式偏置的讨论移到商空间后，泛化可以由商线性稳定这一动力学量直接控制，前提是满足局部覆盖与有界性假设。

papers.title: Enhancing generalization in endwall film cooling prediction: Incorporating the superposition principle into transformer-based neural operators
papers.abstract_en: In this study, a physics-enhanced neural operator framework is proposed to enhance the generalization prediction ability of the cooling layout of a turbine endwall with variable number of film holes. Specifically, inspired by the film cooling superposition principle, we propose a film cooling prediction model, namely superposition-based deep neural operator (SDNO), that divides the endwall temperature field prediction into two stages. In the first stage, the cooling layout of a turbine endwall is divided into several sub-parts with randomly assigned film holes, and a Transformer-based neural operator network, namely Calculate Net, is designed to predict the temperature field of each sub-part. Then, in the second stage, another neural operator network, i.e., Super Net, is trained to combine the temperature fields predicted by Calculate Net for each sub-part and obtain the superposed temperature field of the full cooling layout. Additionally, instead of directly taking the film cooling contours as pixel plots, a signed distance function (SDF) which is sensitive to the variable locations of cooling holes, is designed to encode the location information of cooling holes. Furthermore, the proposed endwall film cooling prediction model is trained with the samples that changing the number of film holes from 1-5 with variable locations. Then, the trained prediction shows excellent generalization prediction ability, which can accurately predict the film effectiveness of the cooling layout with 10-20 film cooling holes that are unseen in the training samples. The proposed SDNO also improves prediction accuracy relative to the fully supervised baseline. With the above, the effectiveness of our proposed prediction model has been well demonstrated.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于叠加原理的深度神经算子 SDNO，把涡轮端壁气膜冷却温度场预测拆成两阶段：Calculate Net 逐子区域预测，Super Net 再叠加成完整布局，并用 signed distance function (SDF) 编码气膜孔位置。模型在 1–5 个孔的样本上训练后，能准确预测训练中未见的 10–20 孔布局的气膜效率，且精度优于全监督基线。
Motivation: 涡轮端壁气膜孔数量与位置可变，直接端到端的神经算子难以把在少数孔布局上学到的规律外推到孔数更多的新布局，泛化能力不足。
Method: SDNO 两阶段框架：第一阶段把端壁布局切成含随机气膜孔的子区域，用 Transformer 神经算子 Calculate Net 预测各子区域温度场；第二阶段用 Super Net 按叠加原理合成完整布局温度场。孔位置不用像素云图，改用对孔位敏感的 signed distance function (SDF) 编码；训练样本覆盖 1–5 个孔、孔位可变。
Result: 在 1–5 孔、孔位可变的样本上训练后，模型可准确预测训练未见的 10–20 孔布局的气膜效率 (film effectiveness)，并相对 fully supervised baseline 提升预测精度。
Conclusion: 把气膜冷却的叠加原理嵌入神经算子的两阶段结构，配合 SDF 位置编码，能让模型从少孔训练外推到孔数多得多的未见布局。

papers.title: EEGAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Short- and Long-Horizon EEG Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis is evolving from short-segment classification toward long-horizon interpretation that demands iterative evidence accumulation, multi-step reasoning, and coordinated use of specialized signal-processing tools. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise as autonomous agents for EEG analysis, existing EEG agentic evaluations remain fragmented, covering limited tasks over narrow temporal horizons with inconsistent protocols, and providing no comprehensive assessment of agents' reasoning, tool-use, and workflow construction capabilities. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{EEGAgentBench}, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM agents on short- and long-horizon EEG analysis. EEGAgentBench spans six representative EEG applications ranging from knowledge question answering to sleep staging. It encompasses signal durations from 2 seconds to nearly 23 hours, with prediction targets ranging from class labels to event intervals and epoch-level sequences. This design supports unified evaluation across knowledge reasoning, short-horizon interpretation, long-horizon event detection, and sequential understanding. The benchmark further provides 10 deterministic EEG analysis tools that expose only task-relevant signal measurements. Agents must therefore select tools autonomously, accumulate evidence iteratively, and construct multi-step workflows. For evaluation, we benchmark 29 frontier LLMs from 15 model families. Results demonstrate that EEGAgentBench effectively distinguishes agent capabilities beyond model scale and inference cost, while revealing substantial limitations of current LLM agents in long-horizon EEG analysis, particularly in sustained evidence accumulation and multi-step reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EEGAgentBench：统一评测 LLM agent 在短时与长时 EEG 分析上的推理、工具使用与工作流构建能力，覆盖 6 类应用、2 秒至近 23 小时信号、10 个确定性信号分析工具，并对 15 个模型家族的 29 个前沿 LLM 做基准。结果显示该基准能区分超越模型规模与推理成本的 agent 能力，同时暴露当前 LLM agent 在长时 EEG 上持续证据累积与多步推理的明显不足。
Motivation: 现有 EEG agentic 评测任务碎片化、时间跨度窄、协议不一致，无法系统评估 agent 的推理、工具使用与工作流构建能力，而 EEG 分析正从短片段分类转向需要迭代证据累积的长时解释。
Method: EEGAgentBench 覆盖 6 个代表性 EEG 应用（从知识问答到睡眠分期），信号时长 2 秒至近 23 小时，预测目标从类别标签到事件区间与 epoch 级序列；提供 10 个只暴露任务相关信号测量的确定性 EEG 分析工具，迫使 agent 自主选工具、迭代累积证据并构造多步工作流；评测 15 个模型家族的 29 个前沿 LLM。
Result: 基准在 6 类应用、2 秒至近 23 小时信号、10 个工具的设置下评测 29 个前沿 LLM（15 个模型家族），能区分超越模型规模与推理成本的 agent 能力；当前 LLM agent 在长时 EEG 分析上暴露明显不足，尤其在持续证据累积与多步推理方面。
Conclusion: 统一的短时到长时 EEG agentic 基准可把能力差异与规模、成本解耦，并判定长时证据累积与多步推理是当前 LLM agent 的主要短板。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: OMP-MoE: Efficient Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language models but face critical deployment challenges due to massive memory requirements. Existing pruning methods either incur prohibitive search costs or neglect the dynamic interdependencies between experts. To address these challenges, we present OMP-MoE, a novel training-free compression framework for reducing expert redundancy in MoE-based LLMs. Based on observations of expert contribution patterns, we reformulate the pruning problem as a sparse signal reconstruction task solved through Orthogonal Matching Pursuit. Specifically, our method first treats individual expert contributions as dictionary atoms and selects experts that greedily minimize reconstruction error with linear computational complexity. Then, we optimize cross-layer expert allocation through a water-filling strategy that accounts for both reconstruction quality and routing stability. Finally, we introduce OMP-MoE†, an adaptive inference mechanism that dynamically adjusts expert activation based on energy prediction. Comprehensive experiments on Qwen, DeepSeek-V2, GPT-OSS, and Mixtral MoE demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods at 25-50% pruning ratios. For Qwen3-30B-A3B at 50% compression, we retain 93.3% of original performance, achieving 33$\times$ faster search and 1.55$\times$ inference speedup. Codes will be available after acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OMP-MoE 是免训练的 MoE 专家剪枝框架，把剪枝改写成稀疏信号重构问题，用 Orthogonal Matching Pursuit 贪心选专家，再用注水策略分配跨层专家预算，并以能量预测动态调整激活。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上 50% 压缩保留 93.3% 原性能，搜索加速 33×，推理加速 1.55×。
Motivation: MoE LLM 部署受显存限制，现有剪枝方法要么搜索代价过高，要么忽略专家之间的动态相互依赖。
Method: 把各专家贡献当作字典原子，用 Orthogonal Matching Pursuit 贪心选择使重构误差最小的专家（线性复杂度）；再用 water-filling 策略优化跨层专家分配，同时考虑重构质量与路由稳定性；OMP-MoE† 依据能量预测在推理时动态调整专家激活。
Result: 在 Qwen、DeepSeek-V2、GPT-OSS、Mixtral MoE 上，25–50% 剪枝率下相对现有方法一致改进；Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 50% 压缩时保留 93.3% 原始性能，搜索加速 33×，推理加速 1.55×。
Conclusion: 把专家剪枝当作稀疏重构并配合跨层预算与动态激活，可在 25–50% 剪枝率下以低搜索代价保住 MoE LLM 的大部分性能。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 把各专家贡献当作字典原子，用 Orthogonal Matching Pursuit 贪心选择使重构误差最小的专家（线性复杂度）；再用 water-filling 策略优化跨层专家分配，同时考虑重构质量与路由稳定性；OMP-MoE† 依据能量预测在推理时动态调整专家激活。
summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen、DeepSeek-V2、GPT-OSS、Mixtral MoE 上，25–50% 剪枝率下相对现有方法一致改进；Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 50% 压缩时保留 93.3% 原始性能，搜索加速 33×，推理加速 1.55×。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把专家剪枝当作稀疏重构并配合跨层预算与动态激活，可在 25–50% 剪枝率下以低搜索代价保住 MoE LLM 的大部分性能。

papers.title: Replay in the Silent Degrees of Freedom: Continual Learning Without an Offline Phase
papers.abstract_en: Replay-based continual learning almost always consolidates in a dedicated offline phase or by interleaving replayed samples with the input stream, whereas brains also consolidate during wakefulness through local sleep, brief use-dependent off-periods of individual circuits. We ask whether a network trained by local, biologically constrained rules can consolidate with no offline phase at all. An isolation rule confines replay updates to hidden synapses invisible to the current input under k-winner-take-all dynamics, with optimiser state advanced only inside the mask; a refractory rotation rule makes units that have just fired sit out the next competition, widening the consolidable set; a homeostatic pressure and a relative-novelty gate decide when replay bursts fire and when rotation runs. This inverts the usual direction of non-interfering continual learning: the hidden computation on the current input is held invariant (exactly on the proven channels, and for all but 0.3% of waking samples per update elsewhere) while past memories are written into the degrees of freedom the current batch leaves unused. On class-incremental split-MNIST the system reaches 91.6+-0.3% with no offline phase, at or above the best offline-night schedule on two held-out splits, tied with DER++ and above experience replay, ER-ACE, A-GEM and unmasked local replay; in a single pass it leads DER++ (91.8% against 90.1%) while the night falls to 76.9%. The advantage is largest at small buffers and gives way to the backpropagation references at large ones; on split CIFAR-10 the system leads offline rehearsal and experience replay but trails ER-ACE and DER++. Rotation carries most of the gain; isolation adds the invariance guarantee. The mechanism is not tied to the local rule: under the same schedule a backpropagation network with k-WTA hidden layers gains from rotation, and isolation is again free on top of it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无需离线阶段的持续学习机制：用隔离规则把回放更新限制在当前输入看不见的隐藏突触（k-WTA 下），配合不应期轮换扩大可巩固单元集合，由稳态压力与相对新颖度门控决定回放爆发时机。split-MNIST 类增量上无离线阶段达 91.6±0.3%，单遍时以 91.8% 对 90.1% 领先 DER++，而夜间离线调度掉到 76.9%。
Motivation: 回放式持续学习几乎总要专门的离线阶段或与输入流交错，而大脑能在清醒期通过局部睡眠式短间歇巩固；作者追问局部生物约束规则能否完全不设离线阶段。
Method: 三条规则：isolation rule 把回放更新限制在 k-winner-take-all 动态下当前输入不可见的隐藏突触，优化器状态只在掩码内推进；refractory rotation rule 让刚放电的单元退出下一轮竞争以扩大可巩固集合；稳态压力与相对新颖度门控决定回放爆发与轮换时机。反向思路是保持当前输入上的隐藏计算不变（在已证明通道上精确成立，其余唤醒样本每次更新仅 0.3% 受影响），把过去记忆写入当前批次未用的自由度。
Result: class-incremental split-MNIST 无离线阶段 91.6±0.3%，在两个 held-out splits 上达到或超过最佳 offline-night 调度，与 DER++ 持平并高于 experience replay、ER-ACE、A-GEM 与 unmasked local replay；单遍设置 91.8% 对 DER++ 90.1%，夜间调度 76.9%。优势在小 buffer 最大，大 buffer 时让位于反向传播参考；split CIFAR-10 上领先 offline rehearsal 与 experience replay，但落后于 ER-ACE 与 DER++。轮换贡献大部分增益，隔离提供不变性保证；同一调度下带 k-WTA 隐藏层的反向传播网络也从轮换获益。
Conclusion: 把回放写进当前批次闲置的自由度而非与输入竞争，可以在无离线阶段下达到离线夜间调度水平，且该收益来自轮换机制、可移植到反向传播网络。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChestPheNoT: Deployable, Auditable Label-Status-Evidence Extraction from Radiology Reports
papers.abstract_en: Structured phenotype extraction from radiology reports supports cohort construction, quality auditing, and clinical analytics, but practical deployment requires local inference and auditable predictions, while expert annotations remain scarce. Conventional labelers provide structured findings and assertion states but no supporting evidence, while API-hosted large language models may be unsuitable when clinical text cannot leave institutional infrastructure. We present CHESTPHENOT, a compact 0.5-3B language model that jointly extracts finding labels, three-class status (present/absent/uncertain), and verbatim supporting evidence spans. CHESTPHENOT is trained using hybrid CheXbert+72B silver supervision followed by supervised fine-tuning and lightweight GRPO refinement. Across three human-annotated gold sets spanning in-distribution, cross-taxonomy, and cross-institution evaluation, the 3B model remains below its CheXbert silver teacher in distribution but is competitive under distribution shift, significantly surpassing CheXbert on cross-institution detection (+2.0 F1). Task-specific training also enables the 3B model to match or exceed substantially larger prompted models on most detection and status comparisons. For evidence-grounded extraction, over 99% of final evidence spans are locatable in the source report, and the 3B model achieves 47.5 auditable-F1, outperforming Qwen2.5-7B one-shot prompting by 7.6 points and approaching Qwen2.5-72B. These results demonstrate that locally deployable models can provide competitive and directly auditable radiology-report extraction without relying on external inference APIs. Code and the full extraction/judge prompts will be made available at https://github.com/yukkai/ChestPheNoT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChestPheNoT 是一个 0.5–3B 的本地可部署放射报告表型抽取模型，联合输出 finding 标签、三类断言状态 (present/absent/uncertain) 和逐字证据片段。用 CheXbert+72B 银监督加 SFT 与轻量 GRPO 训练后，3B 模型在跨机构检测上比 CheXbert 高 2.0 F1，证据抽取 auditable-F1 达 47.5，超过 Qwen2.5-7B one-shot 提示 7.6 分，且 99% 以上证据片段可在原文定位。
Motivation: 放射报告结构化抽取需要本地推理与可审计预测，但专家标注稀缺；传统 labeler 不给支撑证据，API 托管 LLM 又受限于临床文本不能离开机构基础设施。
Method: 训练流程为 CheXbert+72B 混合银监督 → 监督微调 (SFT) → 轻量 GRPO refinement，模型规模 0.5–3B，联合抽取 finding 标签、三类状态与逐字证据 span；评测覆盖三个 gold set，分分布内、跨 taxonomy、跨机构三种设定。
Result: 3B 模型在分布内低于其 CheXbert 银教师，分布偏移下有竞争力，跨机构检测显著超过 CheXbert +2.0 F1；任务专用训练使 3B 模型在多数检测与状态比较上匹配或超过更大的提示模型；99% 以上最终证据片段可在源报告中定位，auditable-F1 47.5，比 Qwen2.5-7B one-shot 高 7.6 分，接近 Qwen2.5-72B。
Conclusion: 本地可部署的小模型无需外部推理 API 即可提供有竞争力且可直接审计的放射报告抽取；代码与抽取/judge 提示将开源。

papers.title: FUSION: a skill-based research agent for publicly obtainable nuclear-physics codes
papers.abstract_en: Running an unfamiliar nuclear-physics code is rarely difficult because of the physics alone. One must find and build the program, learn its input conventions, and decide whether a plausible output is actually correct. A general-purpose coding agent helps with the first two tasks but may make the last one harder: it can write an input file that runs with the wrong physical convention. FUSION addresses this problem with code-specific skills. A skill obtains the code from its public source, starts from a verified input, runs and parses the calculation, records known failure modes, and must reproduce a stated benchmark to a stated tolerance before reporting a result. The current release covers twenty codes, spanning optical models and reactions, nuclear structure, fission and statistical models, astrophysics and R-matrix analysis, and heavy-ion transport. It also includes an offline, searchable collection of 61 167 pages derived from the nucl-th literature. User notes and credentials remain outside the public repository. FUSION is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/jinleiphys/FUSION; documentation is at https://vibeinscience.com. Here I describe the design, the checks behind the current release, and one complete calculation from input to comparison with measured data.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 10 figures. Platform at https://github.com/jinleiphys/FUSION (MIT), documentation at https://vibeinscience.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FUSION 为 20 个公开核物理代码各写一个 code-specific skill：从公开源码获取、以已验证输入起步、运行并解析计算、记录已知失效模式，且必须在给定容差内复现指定 benchmark 才允许报告结果。发布版覆盖光学模型与反应、核结构、裂变与统计模型、天体物理与 R-matrix 分析、重离子输运，并附 61167 页 nucl-th 文献离线可检索集合。
Motivation: 通用 coding agent 能找到并编译陌生核物理代码、写输入文件，却可能用错误的物理约定跑出貌似合理的输出，判断结果是否正确反而更难。
Method: 每个 skill 封装取码、已验证输入、运行与解析、已知失效模式记录，并以「复现指定 benchmark 至指定容差」作为放行检查；另配 61167 页 nucl-th 文献的离线可检索集合，用户笔记与凭据不进公开仓库。
Result: 当前发布覆盖 20 个代码，横跨光学模型与反应、核结构、裂变与统计模型、天体物理与 R-matrix 分析、重离子输运；离线文献集合 61167 页；文中给出一个从输入到与实测数据比对的完整计算示例。
Conclusion: 把「必须复现 benchmark 到给定容差」写进 skill 的放行条件，可让 coding agent 在陌生核物理代码上给出可核验的结果而非貌似合理的错误约定；以 MIT 许可发布。

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks in nuclear binding energy prediction
papers.abstract_en: This study explores the application of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) in predicting nuclear binding energies, leveraging their ability to decompose complex multiparameter systems into simpler univariate functions. By utilizing data from the Atomic Mass Evaluation (AME2020) and incorporating features such as atomic number, neutron number, and shell effects, KANs achieved a significant lower root mean square error (0.26 MeV), surpassing traditional models. The symbolic regression analysis yielded simplified analytical expressions for binding energies, aligning with classical models like the liquid drop model and the Bethe-Weizsaecker formula. These results highlight KANs' potential in enhancing the interpretability and understanding of nuclear phenomena, paving the way for future applications in nuclear physics and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) 用于核结合能预测，输入原子序数、中子数与壳层效应等特征，在 AME2020 数据上把 RMSE 降到 0.26 MeV，低于传统模型；再用符号回归把网络压成简化解析式，其形式与液滴模型和 Bethe-Weizsaecker 公式一致。
Motivation: 核结合能的多参数系统难以同时做到高精度与可解释，传统唯象模型精度有限，而黑箱模型又给不出可读的解析形式。
Method: 用 KAN 把多参数映射分解为一元函数的组合，特征取原子序数、中子数与壳层效应，训练数据来自 Atomic Mass Evaluation (AME2020)；随后对训练好的网络做符号回归，提取简化解析表达式。
Result: 在 AME2020 上 KAN 的结合能 RMSE 为 0.26 MeV，低于所比较的传统模型；符号回归得到的表达式与液滴模型及 Bethe-Weizsaecker 公式相符。
Conclusion: KAN 在核结合能上既能压低误差又能还原出符合经典唯象公式的可解释形式，作者据此认为它可推广到核物理的其他问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bidirectional Neural Networks for Global Nucleon-Nucleus Optical Model Calculations
papers.abstract_en:
Modern nuclear data evaluation increasingly requires not only accurate scattering calculations, but also efficient methods for uncertainty quantification and parameter optimization, tasks that benefit from differentiable solvers amenable to gradient-based algorithms. I present a neural network emulator based on Bidirectional Liquid Neural Networks (BiLNN) that provides a fully differentiable mapping from optical potential parameters to scattering wave functions. The key innovation enabling generalization across the parameter space is the use of phase-space coordinates $ρ= kr$ that normalize the oscillation wavelength regardless of projectile energy, allowing a single network to span 1 to 200~MeV. Trained on Numerov solutions for twelve target nuclei (
uc{12}{C} to 
uc{208}{Pb}), both protons and neutrons, and partial waves up to $l=30$, the network achieves an overall relative error of 1.2\%. The predicted wave functions yield accurate $S$-matrix elements and elastic scattering cross sections, reproducing diffraction patterns spanning four orders of magnitude. Importantly, the model extrapolates successfully to nuclei not included in training (
uc{24}{Mg}, 
uc{63}{Cu}, 
uc{184}{W}) with comparable accuracy, demonstrating that it has learned the physics of the optical model rather than memorizing specific targets. The differentiable nature of the trained model opens the door to gradient-based optimization of optical model parameters and efficient uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Bidirectional Liquid Neural Networks (BiLNN) 的全可微核子-光学模型仿真器，用相空间坐标 ρ=kr 归一化振荡波长，使单一网络覆盖 1–200 MeV。在 Numerov 解上训练十二个靶核、质子与中子、分波至 l=30，整体相对误差 1.2%，并可外推到未参与训练的核。
Motivation: 核数据评价需要在散射计算之外做高效的不确定度量化与参数优化，而传统 Numerov 求解器不可微，难以接入基于梯度的算法。
Method: 以 BiLNN 建立从光学势参数到散射波函数的全可微映射；关键设计是采用相空间坐标 ρ=kr 归一化振荡波长，使单一网络跨 1–200 MeV 泛化。训练数据来自 Numerov 解，覆盖十二个靶核（12C 到 208Pb）、质子与中子、分波至 l=30。
Result: 整体相对误差 1.2%；预测波函数给出准确的 S 矩阵元与弹性散射截面，重现跨越四个数量级的衍射图样；对训练未包含的 24Mg、63Cu、184W 外推精度相当。
Conclusion: 该模型学到的是光学模型的物理而非记忆特定靶核，其可微性为基于梯度的光学势参数优化与高效不确定度量化打开路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SciFlow-Bench: Evaluating Structure-Aware Scientific Diagram Generation via Inverse Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Scientific diagrams convey explicit structural information, yet modern text-to-image models often produce visually plausible but structurally incorrect results. Existing benchmarks either rely on image-centric or subjective metrics insensitive to structure, or evaluate intermediate symbolic representations rather than final rendered images, leaving pixel-based diagram generation underexplored. We introduce SciFlow-Bench, a structure-first benchmark for evaluating scientific diagram generation directly from pixel-level outputs. Built from real scientific PDFs, SciFlow-Bench pairs each source framework figure with a canonical ground-truth graph and evaluates models as black-box image generators under a closed-loop, round-trip protocol that inverse-parses generated diagram images back into structured graphs for comparison. This design enforces evaluation by structural recoverability rather than visual similarity alone, and is enabled by a hierarchical multi-agent system that coordinates planning, perception, and structural reasoning. Experiments show that preserving structural correctness remains a fundamental challenge, particularly for diagrams with complex topology, underscoring the need for structure-aware evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciFlow-Bench 用逆解析把生成的科学示意图反解回结构图，按结构可恢复性而非视觉相似度评测文生图模型。闭环 round-trip 协议下，保持结构正确性仍是根本难题，复杂拓扑图尤甚。
Motivation: 现有示意图生成基准要么用对结构不敏感的图像/主观指标，要么只评中间符号表示而非最终渲染图，像素级示意图生成的结构质量缺乏评测。
Method: 从真实科学 PDF 构建数据集，每张原始框架图配一个规范真值图 (canonical ground-truth graph)；把模型当黑盒图像生成器，用闭环 round-trip 协议将生成图逆解析回结构图再比对，由分层多智能体系统协调 planning、perception 与 structural reasoning。
Result: 实验显示保持结构正确性仍是根本挑战，复杂拓扑的图尤其困难；评测以结构可恢复性为标准而非仅视觉相似度。
Conclusion: 科学示意图生成需要结构感知的评测范式，视觉上合理不等于结构正确。

papers.title: Exterior complex scaling enables physics-informed neural networks for quantum scattering
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful tool for solving differential equations, yet their application to nuclear scattering has been hindered by the oscillatory, non-decaying nature of scattering wave functions. In this work, I demonstrate that exterior complex scaling (ECS) transforms scattering boundary conditions into exponentially decaying waves suitable for neural network solutions, enabling PINNs to solve nuclear reaction problems for the first time. I develop a driven-equation formulation where the source term is confined to the real axis, avoiding the need to analytically continue nuclear potentials into the complex plane. The method is validated on nucleon-nucleus scattering (n+$^{40}$Ca at $E_{\text{lab}}=20$~MeV) with 21 partial waves, achieving phase shift accuracy of $Δδ\lesssim 0.1^\circ$ for the strongly absorbed channels ($\ell \leq 4$) and $Δδ\leq 0.60^\circ$ for all channels up to $\ell = 10$, when compared to conventional solvers. I further demonstrate the approach on heavy-ion scattering ($^6$Li+$^{208}$Pb at 40~MeV) with 41 partial waves and strong Coulomb effects, where an auto-adaptive anchor warm-down for weak-source channels yields a mean S-matrix accuracy of $|Δ|S_\ell|| \approx 3 \times 10^{-3}$ across the full angular momentum range, including the absorption-to-transparency transition region. This work establishes the foundation for extending PINNs to inverse problems where end-to-end differentiability enables direct fitting of optical potential parameters, coupled-channel reactions, and few-body scattering where traditional grid methods face exponential scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用外复标度 (exterior complex scaling, ECS) 把核散射的振荡不衰减边界条件变换成指数衰减波，使 PINN 首次可解核反应问题；配合源项限制在实轴的 driven-equation 构造，避免把核势解析延拓到复平面。在 n+40Ca（20 MeV, 21 个分波）上强吸收道相移误差 Δδ≲0.1°，全道至 ℓ=10 时 Δδ≤0.60°；6Li+208Pb（40 MeV, 41 个分波）上 S 矩阵平均精度约 3×10⁻³。
Motivation: 散射波函数振荡且不衰减，与 PINN 所需的可衰减解不匹配，核反应问题因此一直无法用 PINN 求解；传统网格法在少体散射上还面临指数标度。
Method: ECS 变换把散射边界条件转成指数衰减波；driven-equation 构造把源项限制在实轴，核势无需解析延拓到复平面；弱源道采用 auto-adaptive anchor warm-down，与常规求解器对照验证。
Result: n+40Ca 在 E_lab=20 MeV、21 个分波下，强吸收道 (ℓ≤4) 相移误差 Δδ≲0.1°，全部道至 ℓ=10 时 Δδ≤0.60°；6Li+208Pb 在 40 MeV、41 个分波且库仑效应强时，全角动量范围（含吸收-透明过渡区）S 矩阵平均精度 |ΔS_ℓ|≈3×10⁻³。
Conclusion: ECS 加 driven-equation 使 PINN 可解核散射，并为端到端可微的光学势参数反演、道耦合反应与少体散射奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Root Finding Problem Revisited: Beyond the Robbins-Monro procedure
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sequential Probability Ratio Bisection (SPRB), a novel stochastic approximation algorithm that adapts to the local behavior of the (regression) function of interest around its root. We establish theoretical guarantees for SPRB's asymptotic performance, showing that it achieves the optimal convergence rate and minimal asymptotic variance even when the target function's derivative at the root is small (at most half the step size), a regime where the classical Robbins-Monro procedure typically suffers reduced convergence rates. Further, we show that if the regression function is discontinuous at the root, Robbins-Monro converges at a rate of $1/n$ whilst SPRB attains exponential convergence. If the regression function has vanishing first-order derivative, SPRB attains a faster rate of convergence compared to stochastic approximation. As part of our analysis, we derive a nonasymptotic bound on the expected sample size and establish a generalized Central Limit Theorem under random stopping times. Remarkably, SPRB automatically provides nonasymptotic time-uniform confidence sequences that do not explicitly require knowledge of the convergence rate. We demonstrate the practical effectiveness of SPRB through simulation results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sequential Probability Ratio Bisection (SPRB)，把序贯概率比检验 (SPRT) 与二分法结合做随机逼近求根，在根处导数很小（至多为步长一半）时仍达到最优收敛率与最小渐近方差，而经典 Robbins-Monro 在该区间收敛率退化。回归函数在根处不连续时 Robbins-Monro 以 1/n 收敛、SPRB 达到指数收敛；一阶导数消失时 SPRB 也快于随机逼近。
Motivation: 经典 Robbins-Monro 的收敛表现依赖根处导数的大小：导数偏小或函数不连续时收敛率明显退化，需要一个能自适应局部函数行为的求根算法。
Method: SPRB 将序贯概率比检验与二分更新耦合，围绕根自适应局部采样与区间收缩；分析中导出期望样本量的非渐近界，并在随机停时下建立推广的中心极限定理 (generalized CLT)，由此自动给出不需已知收敛率的时间一致置信序列 (time-uniform confidence sequences)。
Result: 根处导数至多为步长一半时 SPRB 达到最优收敛率与最小渐近方差，而 Robbins-Monro 收敛率下降；函数在根处不连续时 Robbins-Monro 收敛率为 1/n、SPRB 为指数收敛；一阶导数消失时 SPRB 快于随机逼近。另给出期望样本量的非渐近界与随机停时下的广义 CLT，并以仿真展示实际效果。
Conclusion: SPRB 在导数退化与不连续两类病态求根场景下都优于 Robbins-Monro，且其置信序列无需预先知道收敛率。

papers.title: An Online Non-Stationary Simulation Optimization Approach Based on Regime Switching
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic and evolving operational and economic environments present significant challenges for decision-making. We explore a simulation optimization problem characterized by non-stationary input distributions with regime-switching dynamics across sequential decision stages. This problem encompasses both prediction uncertainty, arising from the regime-switching behavior of input distributions, and input uncertainty, resulting from parameter estimation for these distributions and their dynamics using finite data streams. To address these uncertainties, we develop a Bayesian framework that approximates the true objective function using a Markov Switching Model (MSM). We rigorously validate this approximation by establishing the consistency and asymptotic normality of the objective functions and optimal solutions. To solve the problem in an online fashion, we propose a metamodel-based algorithm that leverages simulation results from previous stages to enhance decision-making. Furthermore, we tackle scenarios with an unknown number of regimes through a Bayesian nonparametric method. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our algorithm achieves superior performance and robust adaptability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对输入分布带 regime-switching 的非平稳仿真优化问题，用 Markov Switching Model (MSM) 在线逼近目标函数，并用元模型 (metamodel) 算法复用历史阶段仿真结果做序贯决策；对 regime 数未知的情形再用贝叶斯非参数方法处理。数值实验显示该算法性能更优且适应性稳健。
Motivation: 运营与经济环境动态演化，序贯决策同时面临 regime 切换带来的预测不确定性和有限数据流估计参数带来的输入不确定性和，传统平稳假设的仿真优化方法失效。
Method: 构建贝叶斯框架，用 Markov Switching Model (MSM) 逼近真实目标函数，并证明目标函数与最优解的一致性和渐近正态性；提出基于元模型的在线算法，利用前序阶段的仿真结果增强决策；对 regime 数未知的情形引入贝叶斯非参数方法。
Result: 数值实验中该算法取得更优性能与稳健适应性；理论部分给出目标函数与最优解的一致性和渐近正态性。
Conclusion: 用 MSM 加元模型的在线贝叶斯框架可以同时处理 regime 切换的预测不确定性和有限数据的输入不确定性，并可扩展到 regime 数未知的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $l_{1-2}$ GLasso: $L_{1-2}$ Regularized Multi-task Graphical Lasso for Joint Estimation of eQTL Mapping and Gene Network
papers.abstract_en: A critical problem in genetics is to discover how gene expression is regulated within cells. Two major tasks of regulatory association learning are : (i) identifying SNP-gene relationships, known as eQTL mapping, and (ii) determining gene-gene relationships, known as gene network estimation. To share information between these two tasks, we focus on the unified model for joint estimation of eQTL mapping and gene network, and propose a $L_{1-2}$ regularized multi-task graphical lasso, named $L_{1-2}$ GLasso. Numerical experiments on artificial datasets demonstrate the competitive performance of $L_{1-2}$ GLasso on capturing the true sparse structure of eQTL mapping and gene network. $L_{1-2}$ GLasso is further applied to real dataset of ADNI-1 and experimental results show that $L_{1 -2}$ GLasso can obtain sparser and more accurate solutions than other commonly-used methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 L1-2 GLasso：用 L1-2 正则的多任务 graphical lasso 联合估计 eQTL 映射（SNP-基因关系）与基因网络，让两项任务共享信息。人工数据集上能捕捉两者的真稀疏结构，在 ADNI-1 真实数据上比常用方法得到更稀疏且更准确的解。
Motivation: eQTL mapping 与基因网络估计通常分开做，二者本可共享信息；统一模型下需要能同时恢复两块稀疏结构的正则化方法。
Method: 在联合估计 eQTL 映射与基因网络的统一模型上施加 L1-2 正则的多任务 graphical lasso（L1-2 GLasso），以同时诱导 SNP-基因关联矩阵与基因-基因网络的稀疏结构。
Result: 人工数据集上的数值实验显示该方法能捕捉 eQTL 映射与基因网络的真稀疏结构，表现具竞争力；在 ADNI-1 真实数据上，所得解比其他常用方法更稀疏、更准确。
Conclusion: 用 L1-2 正则把 eQTL mapping 与基因网络放进同一多任务 graphical lasso，可在人工与 ADNI-1 数据上同时拿到更稀疏、更准确的联合解。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: eQTL mapping 与基因网络估计通常分开做，二者本可共享信息；统一模型下需要能同时恢复两块稀疏结构的正则化方法。
summary_sections.method: 在联合估计 eQTL 映射与基因网络的统一模型上施加 L1-2 正则的多任务 graphical lasso（L1-2 GLasso），以同时诱导 SNP-基因关联矩阵与基因-基因网络的稀疏结构。
summary_sections.result: 人工数据集上的数值实验显示该方法能捕捉 eQTL 映射与基因网络的真稀疏结构，表现具竞争力；在 ADNI-1 真实数据上，所得解比其他常用方法更稀疏、更准确。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用 L1-2 正则把 eQTL mapping 与基因网络放进同一多任务 graphical lasso，可在人工与 ADNI-1 数据上同时拿到更稀疏、更准确的联合解。
